title_en: Direct calling system
title_ko: 직접통화장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an elevator emergency calling system and, more specifically, to a direct calling system which provides direct calling between people in an elevator and an emergency spreader. The direct calling system comprises: a circuit matching unit which forms a calling channel with an emergency calling device inside an elevator; a memory which stores a calling progress message, an emergency spreader terminal information, and a field identification information used when a maintenance office does not respond to an emergency calling; a key input unit and a display unit which displays input of the emergency spreader terminal information and the field identification information; a PSTN matching unit which forms a calling channel with a public telephone network; a PSTN connection sensing unit which senses connection with the public telephone network; and a control unit which forms a calling channel between the emergency calling device and the emergency spreader terminal when an intercom of the maintenance office does not respond to an emergency calling signal generated from the emergency calling device. The control unit reads the calling progress message indicating that a calling from the memory is in progress in order to control a voice transmission to the emergency calling device and call the emergency spreader terminal through the public telephone network; and forms a calling channel between the emergency calling device, generating the emergency calling, and the emergency spreader terminal when a response exists.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 승강기 비상호출 시스템에 관한 것으로, 특히 승강기 탑승자와 비상상황 전파자 사이에 직접 통화가 가능한 직접통화장치에 관한 것으로, 각 승강기 내의 비상호출기와 통화로 형성하기 위한 회선 정합부와; 비상호출시 관리실 인터폰이 무응답할 경우 이용하기 위한 호출진행 메시지 및 비상상황 전파자 단말정보, 현장식별정보가 저장되는 메모리와; 상기 비상상황 전파자 단말정보 및 현장식별정보를 입력 표시하기 위한 키입력부 및 표시부와; 공중전화망과 통화로 형성하기 위한 PSTN 정합부와; 공중전화망의 연결을 감지하기 위한 PSTN 연결 감지부와; 상기 비상호출기로부터 발생된 비상호출신호에 관리실 인터폰이 무응답할 경우 해당 비상호출기와 상기 비상상황 전파자 단말 사이에 통화로를 형성해 주기 위한 제어부;를 포함하되, 상기 제어부는 상기 관리실 인터폰 무응답시 상기 메모리에서 현재 호출 진행중임을 지시하는 호출진행 메시지를 독출하여 해당 비상호출기로 음성 송출 제어하면서 공중전화망을 통해 상기 비상상황 전파자 단말을 호출하고, 그 응답이 있을 경우 비상호출 발생한 비상호출기와 비상상황 전파자 단말 사이에 통화로를 형성해 줌을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Disaster indoor communication system with wireless communication network and the communication method thereof
title_ko: 무선네트워크부를 구비한 실내 재난 통신 시스템 및 실내 재난 통신 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an indoor disaster communication system equipped with a wireless network part and an indoor disaster communication method, which enable indoor disaster communication to be performed without discontinuation of communication even in a disaster situation, such as sinking or fire of a structure having a complex indoor constitution, such as a ship or a building. The indoor disaster communication system equipped with a wireless network part comprises a wireless network part which includes a plurality of wireless network nodes configured to selectively perform radio wave communication and sound wave communication in order to switch communication to the sound wave communication when flooding occurs during performance of the radio wave communication and which provides local area communication service inside a structure. In case of occurrence of a disaster, such as flooding or fire inside a ship or a large-sized building, communication is prevented from being discontinued inside a structure, a location and situation of a rescuee can be identified by a rescuer via a gesture or emergency message, and stable local communication service can be provided in case of a disaster by configuring the wireless network part by using an infrastructureless ad hoc network, thereby providing an effect of considerably facilitating rescue of human lives in case of occurrence of a disaster.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 선박 또는 건물 등의 복잡한 실내 구조를 가지는 구조물의 침몰, 화재 등의 재난 상황에서도 통신의 단절 없이 실내에서의 재난 통신을 수행할 수 있도록 하는 무선네트워크부를 구비한 실내 재난 통신 시스템 및 실내 재난 통신 방법에 관한 것으로, 
상기 무선네트워크부를 구비한 실내 재잔 통신 시스템은, 무선전파통신을 수행하는 과정 중 침수가 발생한 경우 음파통신으로 통신을 변경하도록 무선전파통신과 음파통신을 선택적으로 수행하는 다수의 무선네트워크노드들을 구비하여 구조물 내에서의 로컬영역 통신서비스를 제공하는 무선네트워크부;를 포함하여 구성되어, 
선박 또는 대형 건물 내에서의 침수, 화재 등의 재난 발생 시, 구조물 실내에서의 통신 단절을 방지하고, 제스처 또는 응급메시지를 통해 요구조자의 위치 및 상황을 구조자가 확인할 수 있도록 하며, 무선네트워크부를 인프라스트럭처를 구비하지 않는(infrastructureless) 애드 혹(ad hoc) 네트워크로 구성하는 것에 의해 재난 시에도 안정적인 국지적 통신서비스를 제공하며, 이에 의해 재난 발생 시의 인명 구조를 현저히 용이하게 하는 효과를 제공한다.
assignees: INDUSTRY-UNIV COOP FOUND SUNMOON UNIV

title_en: A kind of ad hoc network evacuation indication system and method based on wireless mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of ad hoc network evacuation indication system and method based on wireless mode, including presentation of information transmitting device, radio network gateway, wireless monitor module and backstage monitoring system, the wireless monitor module distribution multiple corners indoors, obtain the mobile phone signal of personnel nearby, the wireless monitor module by signal is by jumper connection or is directly connected to radio network gateway, and the radio network gateway signal link information shows transmitting device；Described information shows that transmitting device connects backstage monitoring system by network transmission module, backstage monitoring system signal connection trapped person's mobile phone and rescue personnel's terminal, operation principle of the present invention is simple, the position of trapped person can be positioned in real time, by ad hoc network cascade system data transmission to background system, when alert occurs, evacuation Way guidance can be sent to personnel near alert generation area by background system, and trapped person position is sent to rescue personnel.
assignees: JIANGSU WANYOU FIRE SAFETY REMOTE MONITORING SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Smart fire detector
title_ko: 스마트 화재감지장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart fire detector capable of notifying a fire occurrence in real time even in the middle of the night and absence and enabling rapid escape by checking an accurate ignition position, by coupling a wireless ad-hoc network module to a single type fire alarm to allow fire information to be shared in real time between devices. The smart fire detector comprises: a fire detection module for detecting fire; a sensor module for acquiring a monitoring image, voice information and ignition position information; a fire information sharing means for acquiring the ignition position information, the monitoring image, and the voice information through the sensor module when a fire is detected by the fire detection module, generating fire occurrence information by combining the acquired fire position information, the monitoring image, the voice information, and the fire detection information, controlling the fire occurrence information to be wirelessly transmitted to a nearby smart fire detector by using a bio-mimetic ad-hoc network algorithm, and generating fire alarm by receiving the fire occurrence information transmitted from surroundings; and a control module for wirelessly transmitting the fire occurrence information generated in the fire information sharing means, and receiving the fire occurrence information wirelessly received to transmit the same to the fire information sharing means.
abstract_ko: 단독형 화재경보기에 무선 애드혹 네트워크(Ad hoc network) 모듈을 결합하여 기기 간에 화재 정보를 실시간으로 공유하도록 함으로써, 심야 및 부재시에도 화재발생사실을 실시간 통보하고, 정확한 발화위치 확인으로 신속한 대피가 이루어지도록 한 스마트 화재감지장치에 관한 것으로서, 화재를 감지하는 화재감지모듈, 감시 영상과 음성 정보 및 발화 위치정보를 획득하는 센서모듈, 화재감지모듈에 의해 화재가 감지되면, 상기 센서 모듈을 통해 발화 위치 정보와 감시 영상 및 음성 정보를 획득하고, 획득한 발화 위치 정보와 감시 영상과 음성 정보 및 화재 감지 정보를 조합하여 화재발생정보를 생성하고, 생체모방 애드혹 네트워크 알고리즘을 이용하여 화재발생정보를 주변 스마트 화재감지기에 무선 전파하도록 제어하며, 주변에서 전파된 화재발생정보를 수신하여 화재 경보를 발생하는 화재정보 공유수단 및 화재정보 공유수단으로부터 생성된 화재발생정보를 무선으로 전송하고, 무선으로 수신한 화재발생정보는 수신하여 화재정보 공유수단에 전달하는 관제 모듈을 포함하여 스마트 화재감지장치를 구현한다.
assignees: SEMIKO POWER CO LTD

title_en: Portable IoT Sensor Kit for Smart Safety with Wireless Mesh and Artificial Intelligence
title_ko: 무선메쉬와 AI를 이용한 휴대가능한 지능형 화재예측 IoT센서 키트
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a portable intelligent fire prediction IoT sensor kit using wireless mesh and AI. As soon as power is applied, a sensor node composes a sensor network which can immediately transmit device information, measurement values, or the like of a sensor node itself to all the sensor nodes and intelligent connection nodes at low power through all adjacent sensor nodes and a wireless mesh network. When the sensor network is configured, the sensor node transmits measured sensor data through another sensor node or directly transmits to the intelligent connection node at a certain period or the moment when the data occurs in accordance with types. The intelligent connection node receives all the sensor data transmitted by the sensor node, stores the sensor data in a database of the control unit, and transmits the sensor data to a backend system. The control unit generates and modifies an artificial intelligence algorithm for predicting and determining the occurrence of fire through the sensor, location, and node information data in the database. Since fire detection, analysis, and prediction are possible by the sensor data, sensor data errors are removed, corrected, and accurate data is accumulated, so that an optimal prediction algorithm is generated and utilized.
abstract_ko:
국가적으로 큰 문제가 되고 있는 공공 및 민간 다중이용시설 (재래시장, 상가/쇼핑몰, 병원/요양원, 위락시설-극장, 실내놀이시설 등)에서의 화재발생과 유독가스 등의 누출시 발생 할 수 있는 대량 인명손실과 천문학적인 사회적 기회비용의 손해가 빈번히 발생하고 있는데, 이러한 화재 및 가스누출사고 발생시 즉각적으로 감지하고 징후를 판단하여 화재 확산의 예측이 가능하여 관련자 및 관련기관에 자동적으로 경보하고 전파하여 인명의 조기구조나 재산손실을 미연에 방지하기 위한 골든 타임을 확보 할 수 있도록 도와주는 (1) 경제적으로 보급이 가능하고  (2)구성 및 운용이 쉬우며 (3)휴대 또는 이동 하여 일반 초보자도 간편하게 사용 할 수 있는 화재 및 가스누출 등의 재난 방재와 사회안전 편익에 도움을 주는 “무선메쉬와 AI를 이용한 휴대가능한 지능형 화재예측 IoT센서 키트”에 관한 장치의 구성과  인공지능 프로그램에 관한 것이다 
      화재 재난현장에서 사용되는 사물인터넷(IoT) 스마트 센서는 센서데이터의 신뢰성이 매우 중요하기 때문에 센서데이타의 전송 신뢰도를 향상하기 위하여 센서 노드간에 연결성이 강화된 무선메쉬 센서네트워크를 구성하는 것이 안전하다. 
      아래 대표도 에서 보는 바와 같이, 센서노드는 전원이 인가되는 즉시 인접한 모든 센서노드와 무선메쉬네트워크를 통하여 센서노드 자신의 기기정보와 측정값 등을 모든 센서노드 및 지능형 접속노드에 저전력으로 즉각 전달 가능한 센서네트워크을 구성한다. 
      센서네트워크가 구성되면, 센서노드는 측정한 센서데이터를 종류에 따라서 일정주기 또는 데이터 발생 즉시 다른 센서노드를 통하거나 직접 지능형 접속노드에 전송한다. 
      지능형 접속노드는 센서노드가 전달한 모든 센서데이터를 수신하여 제어부의 데이터베이스에 저장하고 백엔드시스템에 전송한다. 제어부는 데이터베이스에서 센서, 위치 및 노드 정보 데이터를 통하여 화재예측 및 발생 판단을 위한 인공지능 알고리즘을 생성 및 수정한다. 
      지능형 접속노드에서 생성되는 인공지능 알고리즘(216) 및 백엔드시스템에서 생성되는 인공지능 알고리즘은 시간별, 센서별, 종류별 측정 데이터를 기준으로 각 센서의 오차 및 화재 발생 여부를 판단한다. 
     만일 인공지능 알고리즘이 화재 발생 상황이 일어났다고 판단한 경우, 지능형 접속노드(200)는 제어부를 통해 자동경보프로그램에 화재경보를 전달하며 자동경보프로그램은 관리자 등 관련자, 소방서 등 관련부처, 필요한 경우 미리 등록해둔 지자체에 화재 발생 사실과 해당 지능형 접속노드의 실제 위치정보를 전파한다. 
     센서데이타에 의해 화재 감지와 분석, 예측이 가능하기 때문에 센서데이터 오류를 제거하여, 보정하고 정확한 데이터를축적하여, 최적의 예측 알고리즘을 생성하여 활용한다. 
    센서데이타의 유형과 패턴에 따라 보다 정확한 분석을 위해 충분한 데이터를 확보하기 위하여 센서노드의 데이터 전송주기와 센서에서 측정되는 센서데이터 수치정보를 증가하여 전송하게하므로서 보다 밀도 있는 시계열 분석이 되도록 하여, 단기간내에 모든 데이터를 수집 분석하여  정확한 시나리오를 예측하고 이에 따른 경보 수준을 판단 한다. 
화재, 가스누출 등의 재난 방재 목적 이외에, 산업현장의 위험작업장, 예를 들면 유해가스 지역의 환경정보 감지 및 알람, 유류저장소, 원전과 같은 방사능 누출 지역, 고로, 사일로 등과 같은 시설파괴시 재해가 예상되는 장소나 기관의 구조물 등에도 간편하게 사용 할 수 있으며, 사회안전을 위한 공공SOC, 예를들면 교량, 도로, SOC구조물 등에서도 사용 할 수 있다.

title_en: Power distribution network toughness improvement method based on cooperative micro-grid after natural disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of restoration and evaluation of a power distribution system, in particular to a toughness improvement method for a power distribution network based on a cooperative micro-grid after natural disasters, wherein the natural disasters cause the power distribution network to fail to normally operate, distributed power supplies in the power distribution network participate in a power distribution network failure recovery strategy to form a plurality of micro-grid isolated islands powered by the distributed power supplies, so that the survival capacity of the power distribution system is improved, and the normal power supply of key loads of the power system is ensured; the method comprises the following steps: s1, setting the position of the distributed power source in the power distribution system; s2, analyzing the fault probability of each node of the power distribution system, and determining a fault node; s3, controlling the states of the switch equipment and the distributed power supply according to the positions of the fault node and the distributed power supply in the power distribution system, and forming a plurality of micro-grids capable of continuously supplying power; s4, recovering the key load in the power distribution network by the aid of the distributed power sources in consideration of the load priority; and S5, evaluating the toughness improvement effect of the power distribution network according to the proposed toughness evaluation index.
assignees: UNIV CHINA THREE GORGES CTGU

title_en: Air Rights-Based Safe Operation System and Method for Network-Disconnected Aircraft
title_ko: 공중권 기반 운항 중 네트워크 단절 비행체의 안전 운항 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for safely operating a network disconnected flight vehicle during a public ticket-based operation, which can safely operate even in a network disconnection situation. The operation unit 500 safely stores the path data in the local storage, verifies data integrity in connection with the blockchain server 300 and the verification unit 200, and automatically performs synchronization after network recovery. In addition, safety is enhanced by analyzing the possibility of path collision through a machine learning-based path search algorithm and setting an avoidance path. The present invention provides safe and efficient operation by integrally performing path maintenance, alarm transmission, data synchronization, path collision analysis, and avoidance setting.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 네트워크 단절 상황에서도 안전하게 운항을 지속할 수 있는 공중권 기반 운항 중 네트워크 단절 비행체의 안전 운항 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 조작부(500)는 경로 데이터를 로컬 저장소에 안전하게 저장하고, 블록체인 서버(300) 및 검증부(200)와 연계하여 데이터 무결성을 검증하며 네트워크 복구 후 자동으로 동기화를 수행한다. 또한, 머신러닝 기반 경로 탐색 알고리즘을 통해 경로 충돌 가능성을 분석하고 회피 경로를 설정하여 안전성을 강화한다. 본 발명은 경로 유지, 경보 발송, 데이터 동기화, 경로 충돌 분석 및 회피 설정을 통합적으로 수행함으로써 안전하고 효율적인 운항을 제공한다.
assignees: KANG SUNG WOON

title_en: Ground satellite signal distributed cooperative processing method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a distributed cooperative processing method and a system for ground satellite signals, which relate to the technical field of communication, wherein the method comprises the steps of extracting a user MAC address hash value, an emergency priority code and a frequency spectrum occupation matrix from a synchronous network to generate a triplet feature vector; the three-tuple feature vector is transmitted through a double-layer Mesh network, two reference target points with fixed geographic coordinates on the ground of a disaster area are selected, three-dimensional coordinates of the two reference target points are obtained, a space reference straight line is constructed, the vertical projection distance from each node to the space reference straight line is calculated according to real-time position data of each node, a node offset parameter is generated, a refraction correction coefficient of a signal propagation path is dynamically generated based on a comparison result of the node offset parameter and a preset threshold value, and when the offset exceeds the threshold value, a piecewise linear interpolation method is adopted to increase correction weight. The invention can realize high-reliability low-delay emergency communication coverage.
assignees: BEIJING SIGONG HUIZHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-network integrated emergency communication rapid ad hoc network method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid self-networking method and system for emergency communication integrating multiple networks, and relates to the technical field of tobacco processing equipment, wherein the method encodes multiple source states and information into a token sequence through a windowed token step, and obtains context representation through calculation of a weighting coefficient matrix based on content and structure through a self-adaptive context aggregation step; the aggregation weight is injected with the difference correlation indication quantity based on the reversible bloom lookup table sketch priority analysis set difference through the difference guiding aggregation and synchronous coupling step, cross-layer control vectors including cross-link scheduling scores, coding redundancy, layering confirmation threshold values, forward error correction sheet distribution plans and the like are decoded through the cross-layer parameter synchronous decoding and issuing step, accurate difference restoration, stable performance guarantee and efficient multi-network coordination can be achieved, and convergence speed and reliability of the emergency communication ad hoc network are remarkably improved.
assignees: YUNNAN YANBEN INFORMATION SECURITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster avoidance path dynamic planning method, system and related equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster avoidance path dynamic planning method, a disaster avoidance path dynamic planning system and related equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first position and a second position in a digital twin space corresponding to a target place; taking the first position as a starting point and the second position as an ending point, and carrying out path planning based on the passing cost of the sub-path between the first position and the second position to obtain the passing cost of a plurality of candidate paths; a target path is determined among the plurality of candidate paths based on the traffic cost for each candidate path. The distance of each candidate path and the influence degree of each candidate path on safety accidents are comprehensively considered, and the time spent and the risk faced by different candidate paths are weighed based on the passing cost of a plurality of candidate paths, so that a target path which accords with the actual production operation environment is dynamically planned, the personnel evacuation efficiency is improved, and the casualties are reduced.
assignees: CHINA MOBILE SHANGHAI INFORMATION COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD;CHINA MOBILE COMMUNICATIONS GROUP CO LTD;CMIM NETWORK CO LTD

title_en: Mine emergency escape system based on digital twinning and path planning method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a mine emergency escape system based on digital twinning and a path planning method thereof. According to the invention, the BIM model, the Internet of things technology and the optimization algorithm are comprehensively utilized, and when disasters occur, the shortest escape route can be planned for personnel at different positions underground on the premise of personnel safety, so that the timeliness and rationality of evacuation guidance are improved; when the escape route is planned, not only the dangerous area of the roadway is considered, but also the position information of personnel in the roadway is considered, so that the optimized escape route has more pertinence; by utilizing the three-dimensional visual function of BIM technology, the three-dimensional phase expression of evacuation guidance is realized, and the guidance effect is improved.
assignees: FUJIAN MEIFANG SHIDAI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Venue building evacuation route planning and security elimination management method based on digital operation and maintenance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a venue building evacuation route planning and security elimination management method based on digital operation and maintenance, which relates to the technical field of intelligent fire control management and comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model of a venue building based on BIM and Internet of things, and constructing a fire monitoring model by using the digital twin model and fire emergency event instance data; acquiring real-time multi-source security data through fire control equipment of a venue building to perform fire detection and early warning, determining fire scene dynamic parameters to update a fire monitoring model, and acquiring fire dynamic characteristics of different venue building areas; and acquiring key factors influencing evacuation efficiency, planning evacuation paths by combining an improved mouse swarm algorithm, and visually displaying the optimal evacuation paths of different venue building areas according to a preset mode. According to the invention, evacuation path planning and overall monitoring and management of fire safety of a venue are dynamically performed in real time according to the development situation of a fire disaster, so that loss in emergency situations such as the fire disaster is reduced.
assignees: ZHEJIANG UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY ENGINEERING DESIGN GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic environment-aware fire intelligent evacuation system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic environment-aware fire intelligent evacuation system and a dynamic environment-aware fire intelligent evacuation method, which relate to the technical field of fire protection and safety protection and comprise the steps of collecting real-time data in a fire scene, dividing an evacuation area into a plurality of grid units by utilizing a two-dimensional rasterization technology to form a real-time updated environment map, combining dynamic modeling data, generating an optimal evacuation path by utilizing an improved path planning algorithm, transmitting the evacuation path to trapped people in real time in a visual and auditory mode, wherein the visual and auditory mode comprises the use of dynamic indicator lamps, marker lamps, an electronic screen and a voice broadcasting system, adjusting guide content by combining the real-time data, optimizing evacuation efficiency, linking fire-fighting equipment, optimizing the environment of the evacuation path, and monitoring evacuation states by a dynamic data feedback mechanism. According to the invention, through the integrated sensor network, the dynamic modeling of the fire scene and the intelligent path planning algorithm, the evacuation path is calculated and updated in real time, and a safe and efficient evacuation scheme is provided for trapped people in the fire.
assignees: ANHUI ZHENGHUA TONGAN FIRE PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based park security emergency path planning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based park security emergency path planning system, in particular to the technical field of park security and emergency management, the system comprises a multisource dynamic perception data acquisition module, a digital twin space modeling fusion module, a risk and situation intelligent evaluation module, a dynamic collaborative path planning module and a result pushing and linkage control module which are connected in sequence. The method comprises the steps of establishing a park digital twin model through multi-source data fusion and unified space-time modeling, calculating dynamic safety and congestion joint weights of channels based on real-time accident information, crowd density and traffic congestion data to form a time-varying weight map, carrying out collaborative planning and joint solution on personnel evacuation paths and rescue vehicle paths by adopting a time expansion network and a multi-objective optimization method on the time-varying weight map, screening an optimal scheme through joint evaluation indexes comprising evacuation time, rescue time, accumulated risks and personnel-vehicle conflicts, and finally converting the scheme into a visual instruction and a device control signal.
assignees: SHANGHAI ZHENGXIANG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin evacuation early warning method for barrier-free channel of booster station
abstract_en: The application discloses a digital twin evacuation early warning method for a barrier-free channel of a booster station, which effectively solves the problem of path planning misalignment caused by insufficient fusion of multisource perception data. Through the spatial data integration of the digital twin model, the usable state and disaster influence range of the barrier-free facilities can be accurately identified. The dynamic path planning algorithm continuously optimizes the evacuation route in the disaster evolution process, and prevents personnel from entering the affected dangerous area. The multi-mode instruction generation mechanism ensures that people with different physiological characteristics can obtain adaptive evacuation guidance, the detention risk caused by single information transmission mode is reduced, the real-time state monitoring and path updating function further improves the response speed and reliability of the emergency evacuation system, the geometric dimension and the space coordinates of facilities are acquired excessively accurately, the consistency of a virtual model and an actual environment is ensured, and the data support is provided for evaluating the availability of the facilities in a disaster environment by configuring material characteristics and accessibility parameters.
assignees: POWERCHINA KUNMING ENG CORP LTD

title_en: Urban waterlogging resident emergency evacuation path guiding method for intelligent community
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city waterlogging resident emergency evacuation path guiding method for a smart community, and relates to the technical field of smart cities and emergency management; the method comprises the steps of firstly constructing a community digital twin substrate integrating geographic information, building information, sensing data of the Internet of things and a hydrodynamic model, realizing dynamic inversion and prediction of waterlogging situation by assimilating a multisource observation data driving model, calculating space-time dynamic risks of an evacuation road network based on prediction results and generating a risk map, adopting a double-layer optimization model combining macroscopic flow distribution and microscopic path planning to calculate a space-time evacuation scheme comprising optimal departure time and a specific path sequence for residents or families by combining resident personalized constraint, and finally issuing instructions through multiple channels such as intelligent terminals, broadcasting and the like and dynamically adjusting based on real-time monitoring.
assignees: SUZHOU JIUZHANG TONGSUAN INFORMATION IND CO LTD

title_en: Flood avoidance path planning method based on population dynamic distribution and flood inundation risk
abstract_en: The invention provides a flood avoidance path planning method based on population dynamic distribution and flood inundation risk, and relates to the technical field of flood control engineering. The method comprises the steps of acquiring position data of a mobile terminal in real time to determine a population gathering area, analyzing population short-time migration rules, determining population migration leading directions, utilizing historical road blocking events and real-time rainfall monitoring data to construct a road flooding evolution network defining a ponding propagation boundary by combining an urban road drainage pipe network structure, identifying path nodes with traffic conflict risks through space topology analysis, determining a node avoidance sequence according to node communication stability characteristics, and adopting an ant colony search model fused with a local path direction guiding mechanism to achieve precise planning of flood avoidance evacuation paths for avoiding road flooding risk areas, so that instantaneity and reliability of population evacuation path planning under flood disaster situations are effectively improved.
assignees: NANJING HYDRAULIC RESEARCH INST

title_en: Rainwate catch filter
title_ko: 빗물 차 집 필터
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A rainwater collecting filter is provided to remove and store foreign materials included in rainwater when the quantity of the rainwater is increased, and to prevent environmental contamination by clearly and conveniently managing and maintaining the filter. CONSTITUTION: A rainwater collecting filter comprises the following: a rainwater inflow pipe(23) receiving rainwater; a initial rainwater cut off bank(21) blocking inflow of the rainwater when the rainwater is flowed through the initial rainwater cut off bank; a first filtering net(18) filtering foreign materials included in the rainwater when a water level reaches the constant level; a second filtering net separating the foreign materials; a ceramic layer(25) rectifying the rainwater; and a storage tank storing the refined water.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 빗물 저장시설에서 빗물을 차 집 할 때 사용하는 방법으로서 더욱 상세하게는 빗물을 차 집 할 때 비가 적게 오거나 초기 빗물 속에는 이물질이 많아 이 초기 빗물을 버리고 이물질이 빗물과 같이 씻겨 내려가고 빗물의 양이 많아지면 수위센서가 감지하여 초기빗물차단문을 열어 빗물유입관으로 들어오는 빗물을 1차 거름망에서 이물질을 제거하고 차 집을 한 후 속 거름망에서 한번 더 거른 다음 이물질을 침전 실에서 최종 침전을 하고 저장탱크로 보내어 빗물을 저장할 때 사용하는 빗물 차 집 필터의 방법으로서 
빗물을 저장하여 사용하면 홍수를 예방하고 상수원을 공급할 때 사용하는 에너지를 절약하여 경제적인 파급효과는 물론 환경보전에서도 획기적인 파급효과가 있는 줄 알면서도 시설비가 많이 소요되고 유지관리가 어려워 지금까지 시설을 외면하여 왔다. 
그러나 세계적으로 홍수가 자주 발생하고 또한 우리나라는 유엔에서 정하는 물부족국가 이여서 최근에는 정부차원으로 빗물을 저장하여 사용하는데 많은 지원이 있어 많은 지방자치단체에서 빗물저장을 의무화하는 조례를 만드는 준비를 하고 있는 것으로 조사되었다. 
빗물저장시설에서는 가장 시급한 것이 빗물저장탱크로 이물질이 유입되는 것이다  이물질이 유입되면 아무리 좋은 시설을 하여도 그 시설은 무용지물이 되어 버리고 또한 유지관리 면에서도 많은 비용이 소요되어 빗물저장으로 인한 경제적인 효과가 없어 시설을 하였다 하더라도 경제적인 효과가 없으면 가동을 하지 않을 것이다.  
이에 본 발명의 빗물 차 집 필터를 개발하여 빗물 차 집 시에 이물질을 제거하고 빗물을 저장하면 유지관리 면에서는 물론 환경보전에서도 획기적인 파급효과가 있을 것이다.
assignees: MIRETECH CO LTD

title_en: Online SAR target detection method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an on-line SAR target detection method based on deep learning, which mainly solves the problem of low detection performance in a complex SAR scene in the prior art, and the implementation scheme is as follows: 1. acquiring a training sample slice from the MiniSAR data set; 2. expanding the training sample slice through random translation, and training an end-to-end real-time detection-based model YOLO by using the expanded training sample; 3. carrying out double-parameter Constant False Alarm Rate (CFAR) detection on the SAR image to be detected to obtain a section to be detected; 4. detecting each section to be detected by using the trained model, and merging the detection result into an original image to obtain an SAR image detection result; 5. and continuously updating the model by using the SAR image updated on line and the core set Coreset in the sample library, thereby improving the detection performance of the model. The method improves the detection performance of the target in a complex SAR scene, and can be used for disaster detection, environment detection and resource exploration.

title_en: The disaster broadcasting PA in public facility, the remotely functioning A/V smart broadcasting device, a closed network system
title_ko: 공공 다중이용시설 재난재해 동보방송 구내방송장치(PA)와 원격 협업기능 A/V(Audio/Video) 스마트 방송장치 및 폐쇄자가망 시스템
abstract_en: When a civil defense alarm terminal which can be remotely controlled by the Korea Air and Space Operations Center (KAOC) or a multi-use facility control server receives emergency broadcast broadcasting data (disaster alert, disaster risk, air strike, CTRN, text to speech (TTS) data) for inside/outside public buildings such as schools, public institutions, or the like including the Article 33 (3) of the Framework Act on Civil Defense, and the Article 55-2 of the Enforcement Decree of the same Act (propagation of civil defense alerts) of buildings subject to alarm propagation, emergency broadcast is made through a multi-use facility alert terminal.
abstract_ko: 한국항공우주작전본부(KAOC: Korea Air and space Operations Center)에서 원격제어가 가능한 민방위 경보단말기 또는 민방위기본법 제33조 제3항, 동법 시행령 제55조의2(민방위 경보의 전파) "경보전파 대상 건축물"을 포함하는 학교, 관공서 등 공공 건축물 내/외부에 대해 비상방송 방송데이터(재난경계, 재난위험, 공습, 화생방, TTS(Text To Speech) 데이터)를 다중이용시설 통제서버가 수신하면, 다중이용시설 경보단말기를 통해 비상방송을 한다.
assignees: CHAE RYEONG

title_en: The Ministry spread direction by electronic display board and The anti-crime CCTV system including the civil defense's improved disaster forecast-alarm broadcasting and The way to broadcast using an anti-crime CCTV and The integral unit and The civil defense/disaster forecast-alarm smart bell and The Military Demarcation Line prallel monitoring IR perspective filter backlight camera CCTV blackbox and The block type controller of DMG quantum code electronic protective wall
title_ko: 방범용 감시카메라 내부망을 이용한 행정안전부 전광판 활용 민방위경보 전파지침 표출 민방위 재난예경보 동보방송 방법 및 행정안전부 전광판을 활용한 민방위경보 전파지침 표출 전광판과 민방위 재난예경보 동보방송 성능개선 비상벨 일체형 함체를 포함하는 방범용 cctv 시스템 및 비상벨 일체형 함체 및 민방위 재난예경보 스마트 비상벨 및 군사분계선 평행감시 ir 투시필터 역광카메라 cctv 블랙박스 및 블랙박스형 비상벨 및 dmg 양자암호 전자방호벽 블록형 제어기 및 양자방호벽 시스템
abstract_en: In an integrated emergency bell enclosure, camera sets consisting of a high-focal distance camera and a low-focal distance camera are installed to and monitor 90 degrees in all directions on all four sides on top of the enclosure, such that a total of eight emergency bell cameras are installed with a fixed camera function for 360-degree surveillance without blind spots. The integrated emergency bell enclosure consists of a switch hub, a power supply, a broadcasting device, a video storage memory, and an Eve SERVER, wherein the Eve SERVER and a Bob SERVER communicate through an unlicensed frequency wireless communication device, videos from crime prevention surveillance cameras are transmitted to an integrated crime prevention center through the switch hub for real-time monitoring, and videos from emergency bell cameras are stored in the video storage memory. In a wireless integrated enclosure, four wireless cameras with a low focus distance are installed to monitor each 90 degrees in all directions on top of the enclosure, and the Eve SERVER and Bob SERVER communicate through the unlicensed frequency wireless communication device. When an emergency bell button is inserted in a front surface of the integrated wireless enclosure and the emergency bell button is activated, the Eve SERVER connects to a network with the Bob SERVER through an unlicensed frequency wireless private network and then establishes a two-way call with an Alice SERVER inside the integrated crime prevention center. Accordingly, performance is improved for surveillance without blind spots and distortion and effective dissemination of civil defense warnings.
abstract_ko:
비상벨 일체형 함체는 외함 상단에 고초점거리 카메라 및 저초점거리 카메라 2대 1조로 구성되어 90도 전방위를 감시하는 카메라 세트를 4면에 설치하여 사각방지용 360도 감시 고정카메라 기능의 총 8대의 비상벨 카메라가 설치된다. 
비상벨 일체형 함체는 스위치허브, 전원부, 방송장치, 영상저장 메모리, Eve SERVER를 포함하여 구성되어, Eve SERVER와 Bob SERVER는 비면허주파수 무선통신장치를 통하여 통신하고, 방범용 감시카메라의 촬영영상은 스위치허브를 통해 통합방범센터로 전송하여 실시간 감시하고, 비상벨 카메라의 촬영영상은 영상저장 메모리에 저장된다. 
무선 일체형 함체는 외함 상단에 각 90도 전방위를 감시하는 저초점거리 카메라 4대의 무선 카메라가 설치되고, Eve SERVER와 Bob SERVER는 비면허주파수 무선통신장치를 통하여 통신한다. 
무선 일체형 함체 전면에 비상벨 버튼이 삽입되어, 비상벨 버튼 작동시 Eve SERVER는 비면허주파수 무선자가망을 통해 Bob SERVER와 네트워크망 연결 후 통합방범센터 내부 Alice SERVER와 양방향 통화로 개통한다.
assignees: CHAE HYECN CHEOR

title_en: Slope monitoring module and monitoring system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slope monitoring module and a monitoring system thereof, and belongs to the field of slope early warning. In the monitoring system, a plurality of groups of information transmission units are arranged along the extending direction of the slope top of the slope; the information acquisition units are arranged at the sides of the information transmission units and can be used for carrying out signal transmission with the information acquisition units; the information acquisition unit is provided with a plurality of groups of monitoring modules, the monitoring modules are connected with each other, the monitoring modules are arranged along the slope bottom to the slope top of the slope, the monitoring modules are used for monitoring deformation information from the slope bottom to the slope top, the monitoring modules are arranged on the information acquisition unit through the plurality of groups of monitoring modules, so that the monitoring modules cover to form a monitoring surface, once the slope is displaced, the accessible monitoring data are fed back into the information acquisition unit, the data are transmitted to the information acquisition unit for information sharing through the Beidou system, and disaster early warning information is transmitted to the receiving terminal through the mobile network in time for disaster information propagation.
assignees: CHINA MCC17 GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Ship automatic broadcasting system
title_ko: 선내 자동 방송 시스템
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide an inboard automatic broadcasting system capable of clearly transmitting warning information from a long distance through a communication network without noise, and allowing a sailor to recognize and cope with a dangerous situation and an accident occurrence source when an alarm is generated and to avoid the dangerous situation to make an emergency escape by allowing a converted digital voice signal to include accident occurrence source information, corresponding emergency zone information, corresponding dangerous situation information, countermeasure instruction information, and emergency escape information. The inboard automatic broadcasting system comprises: a sensor unit; a monitoring server; an inboard broadcasting server; a plurality of IP speakers; an inboard network broadcasting unit; and a TCP/IP-based communication network, thereby replacing any one of the IP speaker and the analog speaker in case of an error thereon to propagate an emergency situation. According to the present invention, when an alarm is generated, a sailor can recognize and respond to a dangerous situation and an accident occurrence source and avoid the dangerous situation to make an emergency escape, and a network-based system can enable inboard broadcasting through satellite communication even on land.

title_en: Fire disaster prevention monitoring method and system for old wind turbine based on wireless temperature measurement technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire hazard prevention monitoring method and a fire hazard prevention monitoring system for an old wind turbine based on a wireless temperature measurement technology, and relates to the technical field of automatic monitoring. Through real-time monitoring and dynamic analysis of temperature and current data, the invention can rapidly and accurately identify potential fire risks, and obviously reduce accidents caused by equipment overheating or current abnormality. And secondly, the real-time performance of data acquisition and the maintenance convenience of the system are improved by utilizing a wireless technology, monitoring blind spots caused by equipment aging are reduced, and the integrity and real-time updating of monitoring data are ensured. In addition, the dynamic threshold adjustment and abnormal mode recognition functions in the invention further enhance the adaptability of the system to environmental changes and the prospective of early warning, and effectively avoid false alarm and missing report.

title_en: Mesh-Based Village Broadcasting Device and Method
title_ko: 메시 기반 마을 방송 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: A message-based village broadcasting apparatus is proposed according to an embodiment of the present invention to solve problems of a smart village broadcasting system, including technical accessibility issues, a requirement for an Internet connection, privacy concerns, cost issues, and participation rate issues. The apparatus comprises: a speech recognition unit configured to recognize content spoken through a microphone by a user and convert the recognized speech into text; a message management unit configured to manage editing of the recognized text, schedule management such as setting a transmission time and retransmission, transmission and reception of text messages, reception confirmation and inquiry through a touchscreen, history management of emergency situation dissemination, message transmission/reception requests, expansion of additional functions (for example, situation dissemination when an emergency occurs through video monitoring, warning lamp notification during an emergency situation, etc.), and other functions; a message transmission/reception unit configured to manage transmission and reception of messages and processing of transmission/reception errors according to a request from the message management unit; and a speech synthesis unit configured to synthesize the received text into voice and output the synthesized voice through a speaker. In addition, the apparatus and method can minimize the amount of transmission and reception data by converting broadcast content, which is voice, into text and transmitting the text, and can eliminate dependence on Internet infrastructure by synthesizing the text back into voice at a receiving side for listening.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실 시예에 따른 스마트 마을 방송의 기술접근성 문제, 인터넷 연결 필요, 개인정보 보호 우려, 비용 문제, 참여율 문제를 해결하기 위한 메시 기반 마을 방송 장치가 제안되며, 상기 장치는 전달하려고 하는 내용을 마이크로 통해 말로하면 이를 인식하여 문자로 변환하는 음성 인식; 상기 인식된 문자를 편집하거나, 언제 보낼지, 재전송하는 등의 스케줄 관리, 문자의 전송이나 수신, 터치스크린에 의한 수신확인 및 조회, 응급상환 전파 등에 대한 이력관리, 문자를 전송이나 수신 요청하는 메시지 전송/수신, 추가 기능(예: 영상감시를 통한 응급상황 발생 시 상황전파, 비상 상황시 경광등 알림, ...) 확장 및 기타 등을 관리하는 메시지 관리; 상기 메시지 관리 요청에 의해서 문자의 송수신, 송수신 오류 처리 등의 관리를 하는 메시지 송수신; 상기 수신된 문자를 음성으로 합성해서 스피커로 전달하는 음성 합성 등에 대한 상기 장치 및 방법으로 구성된다. 이외에 방송 내용인 음성을 문자로 변화해서 송수신 데이터의 량을 최소화해서 전송후, 수신측에서 다시 문자를 음성으로 합성하여 청취함으로써 인터넷 인프라의 의존성을 제외할 수 있다.

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for analyzing satellite meteorological data of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for analyzing meteorological data of a power distribution network satellite, wherein the method comprises the following steps of acquiring multisource satellite meteorological data and preprocessing to generate a space-time continuous meteorological element distribution map; extracting disaster related features through a meteorological element distribution map, constructing a first calculation model to train the disaster related features, outputting disaster distribution confidence intervals, performing risk space mapping on the disaster distribution confidence intervals and a power distribution network topological structure to generate a tower overturning risk assessment result, building a multi-stage early warning mechanism through the tower overturning risk assessment result, generating a three-dimensional risk map and deploying mobile terminal application. According to the invention, through a multisource satellite data fusion preprocessing technology, the problem of space-time blind areas caused by a traditional single data source is effectively solved, the collaborative acquisition and space-time registration of stationary meteorological satellites, polar orbit meteorological satellites and radar data are realized, and the problems of different satellite system resolution differences and cloud noise interference are overcome.

title_en: Elevator maintenance management apparatus
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To support an appropriate restoration operation of an elevator by a maintenance staff when a disaster occurs.  <P>SOLUTION: When a disaster information reception unit 14 of a center apparatus 2 in a monitor center receives disaster information indicating the occurrence of earthquake, an arithmetic unit 16 updates a priority parameter on a priority table stored in a priority information storing unit 31 of a main memory device 12 based on a current position of a maintenance staff at a predetermined time interval when and after the disaster occurs. A priority update unit 17 updates priority on the priority table based on an updated priority parameter. An assignment processing unit 19 selects an elevator maintained for restoration by the maintenance staff based on the distance between the maintenance staff current position information and the address of each building, and the priority of a property on the priority table. abstract_ko:
본 발명품은 1층 도로와 2층도로 한뭉치 도로 건립도로서대한민국의 땅은 한정되어 있는 실정에서 지역적으로 도로를 확장하고 새로운 도로를 건설 공사를 해야하는 오늘날에 1차산업 2차산업 3차산업의 균형된 발전을 이룩함과 동시에 도로를 확장하고 새로운 도로를 건설해야하는 우리의 과제가 주어집니다. 
     본 발명품은 교통안전 확보와 도로운행 혼잡을 미연에 방지하여 사망사고를 줄이는데 뜻을두었습니다. 
     본 설계도는 아름다운 자연을 살리면서 1차산업의 터전인 논·밭의 형질변경을 줄이고 교통의 발전을 도모할수 있는 2층도로 건립도가 절실히 요구되는 현실이 되고 있습니다. 확장해야 하는 도로에 많은 논·밭을 도로에 편입시키지 말고 2층도로 공사로 교통 문제점을 해결해야 할것이며 1층도로 신설공사 지역에는 100년앞을 내다보는 도로교통 발전의 일환으로 2층도로 건설공사를 후대에 할 수 있도록 터전을 마련하면서 1층도로공사를 시행 하도록 합시다. 
     ① 2층도로 바닥 기초기둥 도형이란? 
     도로 양쪽 가장자리에 사방 3m 폭 가로×세로로 터파기하여 철근을 깔고 사방 가로×세로 폭 1.5m로기둥을 세움과 도로중앙 가로 3m 세로양쪽3M 터파기와 철근을 깔고 기초 콘크리트 타설 중앙가로 1.5m 가로막대 기둥과 세로양쪽 1.5m×1.5m가로막대 기둥자리를 세울 양쪽 각각 3m폭 터파기를 해야합니다. 양쪽 3m중 중앙 1.5m×1.5m 세로 고정 막대 기둥을 세우게 됩니다.(상행선) 
     반대편 하행선 차도에는 상행선 기둥 자리와 기둥자리 중간 지점에 기둥자리 터파기를 함과 도로 중앙 기둥자리로 상행선 중간 기둥자리와 기둥자리 중간 지점에 기둥자리 터파기를 해야 합니다. 기둥자리에는 강관 또는 파일항타후 철근을 깔고 콘크리트 타설과 기둥을 세움과 가로세로 막대 고정후 상판을 깔고 도로 바닥 포장을 합니다. 
     터널을 통과하는 2층도로 에서는 터널 옆으로 새로운 터널을 뚫고서 2층 도로를 건설함과 1층도로위 2층 지점에 교차도로가 있을때 1km후방에서 서서히 다리 길이를 높게하여 2층 교차지점에서는 3층 높이로 도로가 통과할 수 있도록 한 후 차츰차츰 낮게 한후 1km지점에서는 2층 높이로 정상적으로 2층도로 건설 공사를 할 수 있도록 할 것. 강 육교 2층도로 공사로서 육교위 2층도로 공사를 할때는 육교도로 양쪽 끝부분에 기초다리 공사를 튼튼히 함과 육교중앙 도로를 기둥 폭 만큼 구멍을 브레이카로 뚫어서 기둥세움 2층 높이로 공사하는 공법과 기존도로 옆으로 새로운 육교도로 건설 공사 후 육교 끝부분 500m부근에서 2층도로 진입 정상적인 2층도로 공사를 시행공법이 있습니다. 2층도로 가장자리에서 손님이 탑승장소는 전부 엘리베이터로 오르내리게 함과 2층도로 건립은 조립식으로 공사하는 건설 공법입니다. 
     1.2층 전반에 공급되는 전기는 모두 자가발전소에서 발전 생산되는 전기를 공급하게 됩니다. 
     도로 상행선 가장자리에 3층.3색.거리표시 경고등을 250m에서∼500m까지 뒤의 차량에게 사고를사전에 알려주는 역할을 하게 됩니다. 하행선 가장자리도 똑같 이 상행선과 동일하게 설치하며 버튼 설치는 100m 거리 단위로 0m지점에 설치되어 있으며 안전장치인 휴즈박스 고장 경고등을 필히 설치함 연쇄충돌 사고를 예방하여 사망사고를 줄이는데 뜻이 있습니다. 3층 경고등 밑 부분은 파이프형 표면에 나사산 가공 2층 지붕에 구멍식 너트가공과 2층 경고등 밑부분에 파이프 식으로 표면에 나사산 가공 1층 천장에 구멍형속 너트 가공함. 도로 지하철이나 지하상가를 먼저 공사후 추운지방을 우선으로 눈이 많이오는 지방을 우선으로 도로굴곡. 경사가 많은 지방 도로를 우선으로 하여도로폭 3.5m중 열선틀 철근으로 제작 크기는 가로×세로 3m크기로 철근으로 제작후지정된 곳에 동파이프를 조립 파이프속에 넣고 캡에 고정함. 발열이 강한 니크롬선과같은 열선을 조립하여 도로3m폭으로 1차.2차.3차.4차선 도로까지 열선틀을 매설하게됩니다. 4차선까지 같은 배선으로 연결함과 배선으로 퓨즈박스도 설치해야 합니다. 고장시 3m폭으로 4차선까지 모두 터파기하여 철거후 다시 새것으로 교체매설함. 이렇게 계속 연결해 나가면서 매설하면 됩니다. 열선틀 공사를 함으로서 겨울철 동절기 결빙으로 인하여 미끄럼 연쇄충돌 눈폭설 교통대란 차량전복등의 사고를 예방 사망사고를 줄이는데 뜻을 두었습니다. 니크롬선 최고의 열기온도가 높고 낮음에 주석합금 동파이프 굵기와 두께와 주석합금을 결정함. 
     인도지하 양쪽벽 부품 조립도란? 
     도로인도 또는 가장자리에 3m∼3.5m폭과 깊이 3m∼5m깊이로 터파기하여 철근 콘크리트 타설옹벽 제작과 뚜껑 철근콘크리트 두께 30cm이상되게 제작하여 뚜껑은 6m∼10m길이 크기로 제작 크레인이나 기중기로 들어서 뚜껑을 덮게 됩니다. 지하벽  양쪽에 받침대 고정고리 각종 부품을 조립함. 지하바닥은 소형차량 레일을 깔것과 천장.조명등 CCTV를 설치하여 고장 유무를 관리소 모니터로 확인 하세요. 
     도로 차도에는 두번다시 터파기를 하지 못하며 공사시설 관리비는 공동으로 분담하고 공동으로 관리를 합니다. 공사후 내부조립 시에는 뚜껑을 개봉후 조립함. 지하차도 부품조립 공사는 도로차도 지하에 무질서하게 겹쳐지게 위험물등을 매설한 곳이라 부품 교체할 때 인건비도 많이들고 위험성도 크고 도로차도에 많은시설안전품도 매설하지 못하므로 새로신설되는 도로는 필히 도로안전 부품을 모두설치 매설후에 준공검사를 받게 합니다. 2층 도로 준공을 필한 고속도로에서는 1층도로 1차선은 고속버스 전용도로 2차선은 대형화물 전용도로 3차선은 중형화물차 전용도로 4차선은 긴급차량과 지역으로 출구도로 2층 고속도로에서는 1차선은 120km빠르기 승용차량선 2차선은 100km빠르기 승용차선 3차선은 80km빠르기 승용차선 경·소형 화물차량 4차선은60km빠르기 승용차겸 소형 화물차선 앞지르기 차량이나 차선 위반으로 진행방해 행위차량 지정된 차선외 차선진입 차량은 범칙금을 부과받게 됩니다. 
     종전에 1층도로 건설공사를 시행했던 원청이 2층도로 건설 공사를 함으로 1층과 2층 차량운행 숫자가 차이가 많이나게 됨으로 1층고속도로 건설공사를 시행한 원청업체가 2층고속도로 구간을 건설하게 되며 부득이한 사정으로 공사를 원청이 못할 때 공개입찰할것과 새로 신설고속도로 1층과 2층 공사는 공개입찰제입니다. 
     많은업체가 공사에 참여 짧은 구간공사로써 빠른 시일에 준공으로 안전사고를 예방합니다.

title_ko: 에어커튼기기를 이용한 제연방법 및 그 장치
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 아파트 및 업무용건물등 고층건물(이하"고층건물"이라한다)의 화재시 발생되는 연기 및 유독가스(이하"연기"라고 한다)를 차단하여 연기가 제연구역인 특별피난계단부속실 및 계단실로 전파되는 것을 방지하여 화재시 안전하고 신속히 대피할수 있도록 하는 고층건물의 부속실에 대한 제연방법 및 그 장치에 관한 것 으로서, 종래의 제연방식은 고층건물에 있어서 화재시 화재감지기등에 의해 화재발생이 감지될 경우 자동 또는 수동으로 옥상(또는 지하층)에 설치된 송풍기가 작동하여 옥외의 신선한 공기를 건물내 각층의 제연구역에 설치되어 있는 부속실로 공급하여 부속실의 공기압이 거실 또는 복도(이하 "거실"라고 한다)보다 높은 공기압을 유지토록 하여 화재가 발생한 거실의 연기가 부속실로 들어오지 못하도록 하는 부속실급기가압방식으로 되어 있었다. 
     이러한 방식이 유효하게 작동되기 위해서는 소방법령에 의거 부속실과 거실간의 차압을 40～60파스칼로 유지하여야 하고 이를 위해서는 각층의 제연구역 출입문이 닫혀 있어야 한다. 그러나, 아파트등 대다수 고층건물 거주자들의 화재안전에 대한 인식부족 및 관리소흘 등으로 인하여 상시 닫힌상태로 유지하고 출입시에만 일시적으로 개방하여야 하는 제연구역의 출입문을, 출입편의를 위해 상시 개방하여 놓거나, 또는 제연구역 출입문 부근에 물건등을 적치하여 출입문이 잘 닫혀지지 않게 하는등의 현행 관리실태는 부속실급기가압방식에 있어서 커다란 문제점으로 지적되어 왔다. 
     그리고 종래의 제연설비는 피난을 위하여 제연구역의 출입문이 일시적으로 개방되는 경우에 방연풍속(0.5～0.7m/s)을 유지하기 위하여 부속실에 보충해야할 공기량(이하 "보충량"이라고 한다)은 소방법령상 부속실이 20 이하인 경우에는 1개층이상, 20 초과시에는 2개층이상의 보충량을 반영토록 규정되어 있으나, 국내 소방시설설계업계에서는 특별피난계단제연설비 설계시 소방법령상 최소기준인 부속실이 20 이하인 경우에는 1개층, 20 초과시에는 2개층에 대한 보충량만을 반영하여 관행적으로 설계하였고 그대로 시공 되었다. 이는 실제 화재시 아파트등 고층건물에 거주(또는 통행)하는 다수의 인원(다중)이 화재경보에 접하여 특별피난계단을 이용하여 피난할 경우 혼잡성,급박성,공포감 등으로 인하여 여러개의 층에서 제연구역의 출입문이 동시다발 또는 지속적으로 개방되어있을 개연성을 도외시하는 심각한 오류를 범하고 있는 것 으로서 화재시의 현장상황을 반영하지 않은 탁상공론에 불과한 것 이었다. 
     따라서 본 고안은 상기와 같은 현행의 불합리한 제연방식을 개선하기 위하여 종래의 부속실급기가압방식과 다른개념의 제연방식인 에어커튼기기에 의한 연기차단방식을 새로운 제연방식으로 안출하게 되었다. 즉, 종래의 고층건물 부속실 급기가압제연시스템에서 급기용송풍기(옥상 또는 지하층) 및 급기댐퍼(각층)를 삭제하고 그 대신에 각층의 제연구역경계부분(부속실출입문내측 상단)에 외기 취입구, 수직·수평급기덕트와 연결된 에어커튼기기를 설치한 것 으로서 화재시 화재감지기등에 의해 화재발생이 감지될시 자동 또는 수동으로 각층의 에어커튼기기가 작동되어 에어커튼기기에서 토출되는 공기압에 의해 제연구역 경계부분에 에어커튼(공기막) 이 형성되며 이 에어커튼(공기막)이 화재시 거실에서 발생된 연기를 부속실로 들어오지 못하도록 차단하고, 아울러 에어커튼기기 작동과 동시에 옥상에 설치된 배출용송풍기가 작동하여 화재층 거실의 벽 또는 천장에 위치한 배출댐퍼가 개방되어 피난을 위하여 화재층 부속실출입문이 개방되었을시 거실측으로 유입되는 공기량을 수직배출덕트를 통해 옥상(옥외)으로 배출하므로서 화재층에 대한 공기공급을 억제하여 연소의 확대를 방지하는 제연방식 및 장치에 관한것이다.

title_en: Forest Fire Alarm real-time monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of Forest Fire Alarm real-time monitoring system.It comprises: forest ranger's carried terminal, relaying research station and Surveillance center; Described forest ranger's carried terminal comprises the first central processing unit, with the GPS module being connected respectively with described the first central processing unit, intercom system, the first wireless frequency expansion module and alarm, is also included as the supply unit of above-mentioned module for power supply; Described relaying research station comprises the second central processing unit, with the video acquisition device being connected respectively with described the second central processing unit, warning public address set, the second wireless frequency expansion module and the first wireless communication module; Described Surveillance center comprises control computing machine, and with the second wireless communication module and the Forestry Information database server that are connected respectively with described control computing machine, described Forestry Information database server also comprises map display system.So just can the also synchronous forest ranger of real-time update make an inspection tour information and Forest Fire Alarm information.

title_en: System for Alarm Broadcasting of Indoor and Method thereof
title_ko: 옥내용 경보 방송 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an indoor warning broadcasting system which receives a warning signal by using a media dualized into wired communications and a DMB broadcasting, and transfers a warning situation to people in a building, and a method thereof. According to the present invention, the system comprises: a warning signal reception unit for receiving an external warning signal; and a main control unit for analyzing a warning signal received through the warning signal reception unit, verifying validity determination and redundancy determination, and notifying the received warning signal to the inside of the building according to a predetermined performance scenario if the warning signal is determined as a valid warning signal. Also, an indoor warning broadcasting receiver for notifying the warning situation to residents in the building which exists as a shadow area in a warning wave of a conventional method is installed, and the warning situation is notified to the residents by using indoor emergency broadcasting equipment or a premises broadcasting facility which are equipped in the building, thereby reducing or preventing death and injury, and property damage to actively cope with the warning situation.
abstract_ko:

본 발명의 옥내용 경보 방송 시스템 및 그 방법에 따르면, 기존방식의 경보 전파에 음영지역으로 존재하던 건물 내 거주민들에게 경보상황을 전파하기 위한 옥내 경보 방송수신기를 설치하고, 건물 내에 구비하고 있는 옥내 비상 방송설비나 구내 방송시설을 이용하여 거주민들에게 경보상황을 전달함으로써, 경보상황에 대하여 능동적인 대처를 할 수 있도록 하여 인명피해와 재산 손실을 줄이거나 방지하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Meteorological early warning method of power transmission line icing gallop disasters
abstract_en: The invention provides a meteorological early warning method of power transmission line icing gallop disasters. The method includes the following steps that: a temperature tester, a humidity tester, a wind speed tester and a wind direction tester are arranged in an area to be measured; minimum temperature, relative humidity, wind speed and wind direction in the area are measured, and a meteorological factor prediction field data matrix related to an icing gallop risk analysis model is established; icing gallop risk prediction is performed on a corresponding area with measuring points which satisfy conditions that minimum temperature ranges from -4.0 to 0.5 DEG C, relative humidity ranges from 70% to 100%, wind speed ranges from 5.8 to 13.7 meters per second and wind direction is northeast; the data of each prediction lattice point is circulated, so that gallop risk trend analysis data of all prediction measuring points at current time can be obtained. With the method of the invention adopted, whether icing gallop distribution exists in a prediction area can be judged, and real-time update can be realized by means of numerical value prediction data. The meteorological early warning method has the advantages of high accuracy, high practicability, high reliability and the like.

title_en: A kind of detection system and its cooperation communicating and positioning method suitable for disaster assistance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of detection system suitable for disaster assistance and its cooperation communicating and positioning methods.Rescue network is established in emergency relief base station, induces mobile phone connection and Primary Location；Relaying and real-time auxiliary positioning are carried out by hand-held detecting terminal, hand-held detecting terminal passes through private communication channel and emergency relief base station communication, it holds detecting terminal reception induction signal simultaneously to amplify to communication blind district detection, after detection and amplification is sent to emergency relief base station；Emergency relief base station real-time broadcast cellphone information is sent to hand-held detecting terminal, and hand-held detecting terminal extraction mobile phone signal information uploads in real time with own location information；After emergency relief base station receives the data that all hand-held detecting terminals upload in real time, all mobile phones in disaster region are repositioned and broadcasted in real time, real-time update target mobile phones position.The method of the present invention can be in a wide range of interior implementation multiple target rescue task, and substantially low compared with mobile base station equipment cost, positioning accuracy is high, highly practical.

title_en: A kind of community's nine small place dangerous situations management system and application method based on LoRaWAN networks
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of community's nine small place dangerous situations management system and its application method based on LoRaWAN networks, including fire-fighting cloud platform, LoRaWAN cordless communication networks and detecting alarm, wherein, fire-fighting cloud platform is responsible for including the maintenance management of LoRaWAN wireless networks, data collection and distribution, role and access control, notice service as operation platform；The LoRaWAN wireless communication networks pass to the data that detecting alarm device detects in cloud platform using LoRaWAN gateways；The detecting alarm is responsible for real-time detecting fire alarm and starts buzzer, while passing through LoRaWAN Radio Transmission Technologys, transmission alarm notification to cloud platform.The present invention has the deployment of the wisdom fire-fighting in nine small place of community simple, implementation need not connect up, without building pre-buried mounting box, construction is simple, Internet of Things cloud platform has map display function, can show alarm place, data real-time update, other big data platforms can be docked to realize that system interconnects, reach the advantageous effect of the Display on the same screen of all information.

title_en: A kind of panel device of fire-fighting network information transmission equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of panel devices of fire-fighting network information transmission equipment, including panel shell, control panel, battery, processor, the panel housing forward end is provided with the control panel, the control front edge of board is provided with display, warning light is provided on the downside of the display, control button is provided on the downside of the warning light, loudspeaker is provided on the downside of the control button, panel shell upper end is provided with alarm lamp, panel shell side is provided with through-hole, the panel housing rear end is provided with device back plate, described device back plate rear end is provided with carry frame, the panel enclosure interior is provided with the battery, the battery side is provided with charger, the charger side is provided with DC-AC converter.Beneficial effect is: the utility model utilize much information transmission device real-time update fire information, and be equipped with battery, have a power failure when also can Fast Transferring Information, guarantee efficient information convey.

title_en: Monitoring data processing method and landslide forecasting procedure for landslide
abstract_en: This application discloses the monitoring data processing methods and landslide forecasting procedure for landslide, are related to disaster alarm field, by laying monitoring point in premonitoring region, obtain the multi -components monitoring data of monitoring point.Multi -components monitoring data include the variation of physics-mechanics character at monitoring point, the Characters of Geographical Environment of monitoring point and weather condition.Multi -components monitoring data are handled, the changing features of multi -components monitoring data are obtained.This feature variation is input in tree-model again, exports the landslide risk index of the monitoring point.Since the proposition of innovation is handled the multi -components monitoring data of the monitoring point in premonitoring region using tree-model, and then realize to the round-the-clock monitoring of landslide and the real-time update of data, early warning can be issued to the dangerous of landslide in time by the analysis to data.

title_en: Nuclear power plant's security against fire monitoring and managing method and system
abstract_en: A kind of nuclear power plant's security against fire monitoring and managing method and system, method include that the possibility for needing to carry out in each region is introduced into the field operation of fire risk to carry out real-time update in dynamic fire fighting database；And for each of dynamic fire fighting database region, risk assessment is individually carried out to each single item field operation that may introduce fire risk, superposed risk between assessing while being under the jurisdiction of the multinomial field operation of the same area, individually carried out based on every field operation risk assessment result and the superposed risk, assess the cumulative risk in each region in real time.Fire fighting database and live traffic are associated by the present invention, form dynamic database in real time, plant personnel is facilitated easily to inquire；Assessment risk in real time, it is also contemplated that the superposed risk between while multinomial field operation；Further, visualization Risk-warning and Precaution Tactics are provided for approving person；By the risk assessment criterion of different dimensions, the fire-fighting risk status in each region of power plant is provided.

title_en: Monitoring data processing method, method for forecasting earthquake and system for earthquake prediction
abstract_en: Monitoring data processing method, method for forecasting earthquake and system for earthquake prediction, it is related to disaster alarm field, by laying earthquake monitoring point in premonitoring region, a variety of physical quantitys and chemical quantity for monitoring earthquake monitoring point are monitored, and obtain multi -components monitoring data.Multi -components monitoring data at the earthquake monitoring point because the variation characteristic of physical field and chemical fields caused by underground activities is related.Multi -components monitoring data are handled, the changing features of multi -components monitoring data are obtained.This feature variation is input in tree-model again, exports the earthquake monitoring point or the Earthquake risk index in the premonitoring region.Since the proposition of innovation is handled the multi -components monitoring data of the earthquake monitoring point in premonitoring region using tree-model, and then realize to the round-the-clock monitoring of earthquake and the real-time update of data, early warning can be issued to the danger that earthquake occurs in time by the analysis to data.
assignees: UNIV PEKING SHENZHEN GRADUATE SCHOOL

title_en: A kind of electricity power engineering weather monitoring method for early warning based on GIS
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of electricity power engineering weather monitoring method for early warning based on GIS, the described method includes: constructing vector quantization grid for province GIS map, meteorological data in current and n hours of each weather monitoring point is associated with each electrical network facilities to vector quantization grid, meteorological data vector quantization grid is formed using interpolation algorithm, electrical network facilities scene meteorological data is predicted, when prediction result exceeds predetermined threshold, is alarmed and shown, and start live camera.Meanwhile this method is by the power parameter of the sensing data real-time update interpolation algorithm at electrical network facilities scene, so that prediction result is more accurate.The present invention realizes the meteorological prediction in electrical network facilities scene using interpolation algorithm, improves the predictive ability to electrical network facilities the condition of a disaster, reduces estimation range radius, reduce computational complexity, improves the efficiency of rescue.

title_en: Determination of seismic notification to reduce seismic notification time of earthquake early warning system for artificial earthquake and natural earthquake
title_ko: 인공지진 및 자연지진에 대한 지진조기경보 시스템의 지진통보시간을 단축하기 위한 지진통보 결정방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an earthquake notification determination method performed in an earthquake early warning system for artificial earthquakes and natural earthquakes, which collects earthquake information measured in real time at each earthquake observatory through an integrated earthquake observation network, which comprises: a step of receiving new earthquake information renewed when a combination of new Assoc. observatories is added while a trigger observatory increases as a P-wave phase propagates from an epicenter (S100); and a step of quickly notifying an earthquake when the new earthquake information has a noticeable reliability and is determined as a quick earthquake notification by a logical condition considering spatial characteristics of the earthquake observatory and the magnitude of energy of P waves and S waves.

title_en: Event-driven natural catastrophe modeling and model refinement for insurance and risk management
abstract_en: A system and method for event-based modeling and model refinement for natural catastrophe related risks, including but not limited to fires, floods, earthquakes, and hurricanes/tornados. The system and method feature simultaneous simulation of a plurality of industry models using a variety of risk information, including but not limited to real-time data, recent and historical event data, hypothetical data, and crowd-sourced data. The system and method use a variety of data sources in conjunction with machine learning to continuously and in real-time update and tune the simulated models performance and sensitivity to provide useful risk assessment and risk management data. Based on these model assessments, the system can produce notifications that can be made to enable automated and human actions.
assignees: QOMPLX INC

title_en: Mine disaster early warning method and device, storage medium and electronic device
abstract_en: The application discloses a mine disaster early warning method and device, a storage medium and an electronic device. The method comprises the steps of obtaining initial data in the GIS system; inputting updated data of the GIS system in the mine operation process into a preset digital twin mine system, wherein the preset digital twin mine system is obtained by modeling digitally based on initial data of the GIS system, and the modeling is used for simulating mine disasters based on the preset digital twin mine system; and carrying out early warning on the mine disasters which possibly occur through the simulation result of the preset digital twin mine system. The method solves the technical problem that real-time monitoring and management and control cannot be carried out on the mine disaster early warning. The safety monitoring and early warning of mine disasters are realized through the method and the device.

abstract_en: A system and method for event-based modeling and model refinement, for natural catastrophe related risks, including but not limited to fires, floods, earthquakes, and hurricanes/tornados. The system and method feature simultaneous simulation of a plurality of industry models using a variety of risk information, including but not limited to real-time data, recent and historical event data, hypothetical data, and crowd-sourced data. title_en: Active power failure early warning method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power failure active early warning method and device based on a Kafka message queue, comprising the following steps: the method comprises the steps that a plurality of terminal devices monitor power outage and restoration real-time messages at different nodes of a power grid and issue the power outage and restoration real-time messages to a Kafka cluster; the Kafka cluster server receives the power-off and power-on real-time message and pushes the power-off and power-on real-time message to a consumer subscribing the power-off and power-on real-time message; the dispatching automation platform subscribes to the power outage real-time message, generates an early warning power outage event and a power outage event according to the power outage real-time message, matches the early warning power outage event and the power outage event with the power outage event in the current power outage market, and if the matching is successful, combines the early warning power outage event with the matched power outage event to update the current power outage market; or deleting the power failure event corresponding to the power restoration event to update the current power failure bazaar, generating power restoration notification information, and sending the power restoration notification information to the mobile terminal of the corresponding power utilization client. According to the invention, the electricity consumption experience of the user can be improved.

title_en: Tunnel tunneling disaster monitoring and early warning system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunneling, in particular to a digital twinning-based tunneling disaster monitoring and early warning system. Comprising the following steps: the system comprises an inversion learning operation module, a tunnel construction entity module, a twin digital model and a twin database. The invention establishes a digital twin model based on the real development environment of the tunnel and the underground space, simulates the whole development process of the tunnel and the underground space, visualizes the whole construction state, gives early warning to the disasters about to happen, and can update and optimize the model according to the on-site construction, thereby developing the driving protection for the traffic country construction and the underground space in China.
assignees: CHINA CONSTRUCTION 3RD ENG BUREAU GROUP CO LTD;CHINA STATE RAILWAY INVEST CONSTRUCTION DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: A system based on ai and crowd dynamics invented to improve safety and efficiency while traveling in groups or clusters during crowded events like hajj and umrah
abstract_en: A wearable electronic travel aid device is disclosed for monitoring and guiding pedestrians in crowds, including those with visual impairments. The device uses positioning sensors and Al to generate accurate location estimations within a twenty-cubic-centimetre frame. It also includes a guidance communication system, audio signals, 3D Haptic communication, and a human-machine interface. The system uses RSSI and CSI techniques to characterise human presence and activities, and uses Wi-Fi fingerprinting for active localization. It is designed for crowd dynamics management, particularly for crowded Islamic rituals like Hajj. The system is based on active particle dynamics principles. The system uses particle dynamics to model crowds with discrete sets of pseudo-particles, allowing for realistic dynamic behaviour and event change detection. It also includes pedestrian dynamics, integrating groups of different sizes for crowded situations like Al Kaaba, Masjid al- Haram, and the Holy City of Makkah during Hajj or Umrah pilgrimages. The system uses clustering algorithms and supports vector machines to process pedestrians and optimize their paths. It also includes a dashboard for managing simultaneous requests and positioning data, ensuring safety for individual travellers or pilgrims. The dashboard uses big-data analysis to detect and predict crowd congestion in real-time, enabling timely interventions in emergencies or potential security threats. This crowd motion summarization approach can benefit industries such as public safety, event management, and urban planning by accurately estimating crowd density, predicting precise crowd motions, and forecasting trajectories. The system is designed to guide individuals to services such as restrooms, food, and medical care stations. It uses real-time crowd data analysis to estimate occupancy levels and propose alternatives. The system also functions as an intelligent traveling guide and companion, with a multitude of chatbots providing services like accommodation reservations, purchase requests, and site seeing. The bots use crowd dynamics to provide comprehensive guidance, hints, and alerts. They can assist with Islamic rituals, travel, tourism, and evacuation. The Evacuation Bot uses crowd dynamics and real-time data to manage evacuation procedures and ensure safety during emergencies. The Near Services Bot assists in finding nearby amenities and provides real-time updates on wait times. The system uses deep neural networks to suggest shortest paths and cost functions to ensure efficient and cost-effective travel.
assignees: BAJNAID MOHAMMADFAWZI

title_en: System for informing risk information in disaster areas using augmented reality
title_ko: 증강현실을 활용한 재난지역의 위험정보 알림 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a danger information notification system in a disaster area using augmented reality. The purpose of the present invention is to promote the safety of the people by transmitting image information to which augmented reality is applied to dangerous facilities in the event of a disaster such as flood, flooding, landslide, heavy snow, fire, earthquake, and tsunami so that the danger information can be intuitively understood and grasped. According to an embodiment of the present invention, disclosed is a system for notifying risk information of a disaster area using augmented reality, which comprises: a field disaster information acquisition unit acquiring field location information and field image information of a corresponding disaster area when a disaster alarm occurs; an AR disaster image information generation unit applying AR content to the field image information to generate AR disaster image information on which AR content is projected; and an AR disaster image information propagation unit identifying a subject located in the corresponding disaster area based on the field location information and propagating the AR disaster image information to a mobile communication terminal of the identified subject.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 증강현실을 활용한 재난지역의 위험정보 알림 시스템에 관한 것으로, 해결하고자 하는 과제는 홍수, 침수, 산사태, 대설, 화재, 지진, 해일 등 재난 발생 시 위험 시설물 등에 대하여 증강현실을 적용한 영상정보를 전파하여 위험정보를 직관적으로 이해 및 파악할 수 있도록 함으로써 국민의 안전을 도모하는데 있다. 
일례로, 재난경보 발생 시 해당 재난지역의 현장위치정보 및 현장영상정보를 각각 획득하는 현장재난정보 획득부; 상기 현장영상정보에 AR 콘텐츠를 적용하여 AR 콘텐츠가 투영된 AR 재난영상정보를 생성하는 AR 재난영상정보 생성부; 및 상기 현장위치정보를 기반으로 해당 재난지역에 위치하는 대상자를 식별하고, 식별된 대상자의 모바일통신단말로 상기 AR 재난영상정보를 전파하는 AR 재난영상정보 전파부를 포함하는 증강현실을 활용한 재난지역의 위험정보 알림 시스템을 개시한다.
assignees: CHAHOO CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic disaster monitoring system and method for coal and rock mining area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic disaster monitoring system and a method for coal and rock mining areas, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the system comprises a model construction module, a monitoring module, a data processing module and an early warning module; the model building module generates a virtual mining area model based on internal construction data of the coal and rock mining area; the monitoring module collects coal and rock condition data of the non-mining area and the mining area working face all over, and comprises the non-mining area coal and rock condition data, mining area working face stress information, mining area working face microseismic signals and corresponding coordinates; the data processing module updates the virtual mining area model in real time based on the coal and rock condition data, and analyzes the coal and rock disaster condition based on the coal and rock condition data; the early warning module sends out early warning based on the disaster condition of the coal rock and displays the disaster place in the virtual mining area model. The invention is based on the digital twin technology, and can more accurately predict the occurrence and development trend of dynamic disasters in coal and rock mining areas through the fusion of the actual monitoring data and the digital twin model.
assignees: UNIV TAIYUAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: AI-based intelligent restoration method and system for wind direction and wind speed history data in alpine region
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses an AI-based intelligent restoration method and system for wind direction and wind speed history data in alpine regions, and belongs to the technical field of data processing. The embodiment of the application aims to effectively improve the timeliness and accuracy of meteorological data by updating a meteorological monitoring data set, applying an advanced data restoration algorithm and carrying out multi-round wind load state vector mining based on a characteristic focusing strategy. By applying the embodiment of the application, the problem of delayed update of the meteorological data can be solved, the whole quality of the meteorological monitoring data can be obviously improved through deep data mining and intelligent restoration, thereby providing a more reliable data base for meteorological prediction, disaster early warning and the like, and having obvious technical progress and application value.
assignees: METEOROLOGICAL DATA CENTER OF HEILONGJIANG PROVINCE HEILONGJIANG METEOROLOGICAL DETECTION CENTER HEI

title_en: Real-time monitoring-based natural disaster early warning and responding method and device for electric power system
abstract_en: The invention provides a real-time monitoring-based power system natural disaster early warning and responding method, which relates to the technical field of power early warning response and comprises the following steps of data analysis and processing, wherein the data analysis and processing utilizes a long-short-period memory network to combine with a Bayesian network to analyze and process real-time monitoring data in a power system, a scheduling scheme is generated, the state of the power system is updated in real time and an optimal scheduling scheme is generated based on a multi-source data fusion and optimization method combining a Kalman filter and a genetic algorithm, an emergency response strategy is generated, the influence of a natural disaster on the power system is simulated in real time in a virtual model through a digital twin technology and a self-adaptive dynamic programming method, and an emergency response strategy is provided, and anomaly detection and self-healing are performed by combining big data analysis with edge calculation to perform anomaly detection and self-healing on the running state of the power system.
assignees: TIELING POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Fire control facility remote monitoring and intelligent management and control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote monitoring and intelligent management and control system for a fire-fighting facility, which belongs to the technical field of fire-fighting early warning, and concretely comprises the steps of deploying a multi-parameter sensor array, enabling sensor nodes to form a redundant monitoring network in a honeycomb topology structure, conducting real-time fusion analysis on sensor network data through an edge computing gateway, triggering an abnormal region positioning module when any monitoring parameter is detected to exceed a preset dynamic threshold value, constructing a three-dimensional thermodynamic diagram model based on parameter gradient changes of adjacent sensor nodes by the abnormal region positioning module, dynamically computing the diffusion direction and potential risk level of an abnormal region, enabling a mobile inspection robot cluster to receive coordinates and risk parameters of the abnormal region, automatically generating a multi-stage response path based on a real-time updated building digital twin model, enabling a primary path to be quickly abutted to a preset main road, enabling a secondary path to be dynamically adjusted according to the distribution of field obstacles, and enabling a terminal path to be rechecked by adopting a contact type detection module.
assignees: LINYI NEW SMART CITY OPERATION CO LTD

title_en: Landslide monitoring and early warning method and system based on digital twin technology
