abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide monitoring and early warning method and system based on a digital twin technology, which belong to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning, and concretely comprise the steps of collecting geographical information data of landslide in real time, constructing a dynamically updated multi-source space database, constructing a landslide simulation model, conducting grid subdivision on the landslide simulation model, carrying out solving based on the landslide hydraulic coupling model by introducing a stress field and seepage field numerical coupling algorithm, accurately analyzing landslide to represent a state, acquiring a safety coefficient of the landslide in real time by adopting an intensity folding method, establishing a disaster analysis model, deducing a landslide disaster forming range if the safety coefficient reaches a preset alarm threshold, calculating a disaster risk index, evaluating a risk level according to the disaster risk index, and carrying out early warning on the landslide disaster if the risk level is higher than the preset level. The intelligent landslide monitoring system and the intelligent landslide monitoring method realize accurate monitoring and intelligent safety early warning of landslide.
assignees: SUZHOU TURUISI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mountain engineering slope real-time monitoring and early warning method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of information data processing technology, in particular to a mountain engineering slope real-time monitoring and early warning method and system based on digital twinning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining original slope real-time monitoring data, carrying out standardization processing to obtain standardized slope real-time monitoring data, constructing a digital twin model by utilizing the standardized slope real-time monitoring data to obtain a preliminary slope digital twin model, and dynamically updating the preliminary slope digital twin model by utilizing the standardized slope real-time monitoring data and slope history multi-source monitoring data to obtain a real-time updated slope digital twin model. According to the invention, by updating the digital twin model in real time and combining multi-physical field coupling analysis and nonlinear stability prediction, the dynamic monitoring, stability evaluation, risk prediction and emergency response of the slope can be ensured to reflect the actual conditions in time, so that the scientificity and timeliness of disaster prevention and control are improved.

title_en: Distributed optical fiber sensing mass target data screening method based on image processing
abstract_en: A distributed optical fiber sensing mass target data screening method based on image processing is characterized in that space-time two-dimensional vibration signals are mapped into gray images, a multi-mode fusion technology is utilized, a lightweight convolutional neural network is combined to achieve efficient classification, a dynamic increment learning mechanism and a spatial propagation attenuation correction algorithm are introduced, and the problems of single characteristic representation, model update lag and insufficient positioning accuracy of a traditional method are solved. The method is suitable for the fields of perimeter security protection, pipeline monitoring, geological disaster early warning and the like, and can be used for screening and target recognition of mass vibration data under complex environment interference in real time. The invention breaks through the limitation of traditional time-frequency domain analysis through signal imaging characterization, obviously improves the distinguishing capability of similar events, simultaneously reduces the false alarm rate and the operation and maintenance cost by depending on a dynamic model optimization technology, effectively suppresses the influence of optical fiber attenuation on the positioning precision by combining a space correction algorithm, and provides reliable technical support for intelligent upgrading of a distributed optical fiber sensing system.
assignees: UNIV ELECTRONIC SCI & TECH CHINA

title_en: Digital twinning-based large-dip-angle stope coal rock dynamic disaster monitoring and early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twinning-based large-dip-angle stope coal rock dynamic disaster monitoring and early warning method and system, comprising the steps of acquiring sensor installation parameters and large-dip-angle stope geological environment information, establishing a correction model, and correcting large-dip-angle stope geological exploration data acquired by a sensor; the method comprises the steps of establishing a digital twin model of a large dip angle stope according to corrected parameters, establishing a coal-rock dynamic disaster early warning index system based on historical coal-rock disaster case data and expert experience, establishing a coal-rock dynamic disaster early warning model based on a machine learning algorithm, integrating the coal-rock dynamic disaster early warning model into the digital twin model, and carrying out real-time evaluation and early warning on the large dip angle stope dynamic disaster risk by the coal-rock dynamic disaster early warning model when the digital twin model is updated. The invention effectively reduces the occurrence risk of coal and rock dynamic disasters, ensures the life safety of stope operators and the normal operation of equipment, and improves the safety and economic benefit of coal exploitation.
assignees: UNIV XIAN SCI & TECHNOLOGY;TAIPING COAL MINE OF SICHUAN CHUANMEI HUARONG ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Automated in-patient medical emergency management system
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a patient monitoring system (102) for monitoring health of hospitalized non-ICU patients. This system (102) includes a set of monitoring devices (104) for displaying a comprehensive set of vital parameters related to patients. Additionally, a set of cameras (106) is integrated into the system, continuously capturing images of each monitoring device (104). The system is powered by processors (202) that execute instructions for image analysis using an AI engine. Through seamless communication with computing devices, the processors (202) facilitate swift transmission of alert signals to healthcare professionals, offering real-time updates upon detection of critical patient conditions. These alert signals include essential information about the identified vital parameter, enabling healthcare professionals to promptly intervene and address the needs of hospitalized non-ICU patients.
assignees: DAS PURNENDU BHUSAN

title_en: Method and system for observing earthquake response of existing building
abstract_en: The invention relates to an existing building earthquake response observation method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps of collecting building vibration response data under micro vibration and strong vibration and high-definition video data under the strong vibration of a building in real time, carrying out second-level early warning and minute-level early warning based on the building vibration response data, calculating displacement of an observation floor relative to the ground based on the high-definition video data, constructing an adjacent matrix based on the building vibration response data, updating the adjacent matrix by utilizing real-time data and a graph convolution neural network when the minute-level early warning occurs, carrying out hour-level early warning based on edge characteristics of the updated adjacent matrix, and simultaneously updating a digital twin model of the existing building based on a finite element model based on the calculated displacement, and evaluating the earthquake resistance and the security of the structure after the earthquake. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of remarkably improving the state identification precision of the building strong earthquake response stage, the earthquake resistance evaluation efficiency after earthquake and the like.

title_en: Three-dimensional tunnel water burst analysis method and system based on autonomous control
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunnel engineering safety monitoring, in particular to an autonomous controllable three-dimensional tunnel water burst analysis method and system; the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source heterogeneous geological, hydrologic and construction data, fusing and obtaining multi-source heterogeneous data, constructing a dynamically updated three-dimensional geological-construction coupling digital twin model after alignment coding, conducting water gushing evolution rolling prediction through multi-scale physical-AI mixed modeling and correcting real-time data, outputting prediction data, constructing a three-dimensional visual platform, starting multi-level linkage early warning based on a risk threshold, and enabling the system to comprise a data fusion module, a water gushing evolution rolling prediction module and a multi-level linkage early warning module, and meet the requirements of rapid early warning and timely decision making of water gushing disasters in the tunnel construction process by combining three-dimensional visual rendering and deep learning fluid simulation technology through fusion of geological data, hydrologic monitoring data and construction parameters.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY CHANGJIANG TRANSP DESIGN GROUP CO LTD;CHONGQING HIGH SPEED RAILWAY CONSTRUCTION WANKAIDA EXPRESSWAY CO LTD

title_en: Transportation risk optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent traffic and road disaster early warning, in particular to a transportation risk optimization method and system, comprising the following steps of S1 multimode event-infrared-optical fiber data acquisition and synchronous generation of a unified index data packet; the method comprises the steps of S2, combining energy conservation and causal inference assimilation, outputting a digital twin state tensor, S3, performing forward noise scheduling and reverse denoising by a conditional diffusion model, generating an icing probability field and extracting a high-frequency attention spectrum, S4, calculating road structure factors according to the probability field and the attention spectrum, constructing a binary unconstrained optimization model, mapping to an optical coherence Ising machine for solving, forming an interference scheduling scheme by strategy network soft update and safety verification, and performing effect write-back cyclic update. The invention realizes sub-second risk identification and millisecond optimization decision, and reduces accident rate and salt spraying cost.
assignees: CHONGQING FEIHONG TRANSP CO LTD

title_en: Mountain landslide grading early warning method based on multi-mode data change characteristics
abstract_en: The invention relates to a landslide grading early warning method based on multi-modal data change characteristics, which comprises the steps of establishing a mountain digital twin body, deploying a multi-node sensor network in a target area, configuring an edge calculation unit, collecting geological data in real time, screening the geological data based on the mountain digital twin body to form effective local data, constructing a lightweight multi-modal neural network model at each node, dynamically searching super parameters by utilizing an ant colony optimization algorithm to generate an encryption model weight update quantity package, dynamically calculating node weights by a central server according to disaster feature vectors output by the digital twin body, weighting and polymerizing to generate a global model and directionally distributing and updating, fusing real-time monitoring data and model prediction results, executing millimeter-level disaster evolution simulation through a variable-step physical engine, triggering advanced early warning signals when a deduction prediction risk exceeds a threshold value, and remarkably improving edge model adaptability, federal aggregation precision and early warning advance.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Method and system for realizing unmanned tunneling working face
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for realizing an unmanned tunneling working face, which comprise the steps of dividing equipment groups working on the tunneling working face into N rigid body groups which independently operate, installing an inertial navigation and a laser target on main rigid body equipment of each rigid body group, designing and installing a measuring and positioning robot, wherein the measuring and positioning robot comprises an inertial navigation and N automatic target-seeking total stations, establishing a digital twin platform of the unmanned tunneling working face, realizing pose calculation, fault diagnosis, disaster early warning, cooperative control, scene update, equipment start-stop and maintenance decision-making, and providing remote intervention and man-machine interaction interfaces to realize unmanned operation of the tunneling working face. The invention can realize the accurate measurement, positioning and attitude control of all equipment such as digging, drilling, anchoring, supporting, transporting, passing and the like in the tunneling working face, realize the unmanned operation of zero accident and zero fault of the tunneling working face, and provide technical support for avoiding personal injury and death and greatly improving the tunneling efficiency.

title_en: Energy gallery forest fire risk prediction method and system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy gallery forest fire risk prediction method and system based on multi-source data fusion, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a fusion data set and determining risk evolution parameters; triggering a vegetation difference analysis function if the risk evolution parameter exceeds a preset threshold value to obtain a section heterogeneity label, carrying out space-time heterogeneity compensation correction on historical data through a time sequence change tracking method after the section heterogeneity label is obtained, calculating the risk transition probability of each section, judging potential critical points, activating a difference early warning mechanism if the potential critical points are judged to be high probability, generating a targeted risk grade map according to the section heterogeneity label and the risk transition probability to obtain a dynamic early warning signal, carrying out iterative verification on the dynamic early warning signal by adopting a real-time update flow in a fusion data set, and combining the prediction output of a long-term and short-term memory network to adjust the risk grade to determine a final risk prediction result. The method and the device improve the timeliness and accuracy of fire risk prediction.

title_en: Landslide surge prediction method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide surge prediction method based on digital twinning, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster related fields. The method comprises the following steps of 1, realizing a digital model of a physical entity by a physical layer L1, 2, calculating the stability of a landslide and landslide surge by the model layer based on related data of the physical layer, 3, carrying out early warning prediction decision on a calculation result of a decision layer base model layer, and 4, carrying out new prediction calculation to evaluate an updated plan and disaster prevention measure effect. According to the invention, the physical layer is used for sensing the states of the rock mass and the water body of the landslide surge hidden danger point in real time, and the model layer is updated in real time by utilizing the information interaction capability of the digital twin model, so that the calculation model can perform simulation calculation according to the real working condition of the landslide surge hidden danger point, and further, the landslide surge hidden danger point can be more accurately early-warned and predicted. The invention also relates to a landslide surge prediction system based on digital twinning.
assignees: CHANGJIANG GEOTECHNICAL ENG CO LTD

title_en: Multi-mode agent cluster control system for dynamic evaluation of geological disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-modal intelligent agent cluster control system for dynamic evaluation of geological disasters, in particular relates to the technical field of three-dimensional geological modeling and digital twin, and is used for solving the problem that model expression disaster body states are inaccurate due to inconsistency of multi-modal monitoring data when digital twin models are fused; the multi-dimensional multi-modal monitoring data is collected by the data collection module by utilizing heterogeneous intelligent agent clusters, the cause judgment module judges whether the real disaster evolution is generated or not, the risk identification module identifies a high-risk critical area, the task generation module generates intelligent agent cluster collaborative observation task planning aiming at the high-risk critical area, the planning optimization module re-optimizes the collaborative observation task planning, and the execution updating module controls the heterogeneous intelligent agent cluster to execute the re-optimized task planning and feed back and update the digital twin three-dimensional model in real time, so that the dynamic accurate evaluation and early warning of the geological disaster are realized.
assignees: CHENGXIN ZHILIAN WUHAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting indoor rescue positioning method and system based on national secret trusted communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting indoor rescue positioning method, a fire-fighting indoor rescue positioning system and a fire-fighting indoor rescue positioning system based on national secret trusted communication, which relate to the technical field of indoor rescue personnel positioning and comprise the following steps that step 100, a hybrid positioning network is formed through a UWB positioning base station, a UWB positioning card and a visual positioning node; step 200, acquiring initial positions and motion tracks of trapped personnel, encrypting by adopting a national encryption algorithm, uploading to a command center digital twin platform, step 300, acquiring multi-source sensor data by a rescue personnel terminal, receiving UWB base station signals, generating real-time position information of the rescue personnel and sign information of the rescue personnel by combining a pre-stored indoor micro map, step 400, encrypting the real-time position information of the rescue personnel and the sign information of the rescue personnel by adopting the national encryption algorithm, selecting a communication frequency band by adopting a dynamic frequency spectrum allocation mechanism, transmitting to the command center digital twin platform, and step 500, fusing the real-time position of the rescue personnel and the information of the trapped personnel by the command center digital twin platform, generating a rescue obstacle avoidance path and transmitting to the rescue personnel terminal.
assignees: YUXI E GOVERNMENT INTRANET INFORMATION TECH CENTER

title_en: Audio life detection equipment for earthquake disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses an audio frequency life detection device for earthquake disaster, which mainly comprises: the detection device is transmitted with the main control equipment through a wireless network; the method comprises the following steps that a special microelectronic processor is adopted, micro vibration transmitted in air or solid can be identified, after a main control device is placed in a safe area, a detection device is controlled to enter a rescue area through a direction control touch screen, a camera shoots and transmits topographic images in real time, a micro vibration sensor probe and a voice sensor probe transmit information to a micro vibration signal display screen and a sound wave display screen, the micro vibration sensor probe senses weak seismic wave signals transmitted from the surface layer of the ground, and the voice sensor probe can be in voice communication with a rescuer; the main control equipment directly transmits the voice signal to the detection personnel; approaching the rescuers infinitely according to the signal intensity, and then rapidly making a detailed rescue plan.

title_en: Underground base facilities protection system using DAS system and drone
title_ko: Ｄａｓ 시스템과 드론을 이용한 지중매설 기반 시설 보호 시스템
abstract_en: A system for protecting underground buried infrastructure using a distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) system and a drone is disclosed. The system for protecting underground buried infrastructure using a DAS system and a drone comprises: an integrated control server linked with an underground buried infrastructure management system including pipelines, power and communication cables, gas pipelines, and oil pipelines, and a distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) system using an optical communication cable; and a drone. When the distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) system detects excavation work related to the underground buried infrastructure (pipelines, power and communication cables, gas pipelines, and oil pipelines), the drone is urgently dispatched to arrive at the excavation site of the construction work, transmits camera image data captured by the drone to the integrated control server, and performs a remote warning broadcast to workers using a speaker of the drone to alert them to excavation caution during the construction work, thereby preventing damage to the underground buried infrastructure in advance. The drone includes a GPS receiver, a camera, a directional speaker, and a 13.56 MHz RFID tag. Accordingly, by performing a warning broadcast for construction excavation caution using the speaker of the drone, damage to the underground buried infrastructure can be prevented in advance.
abstract_ko:
DAS 시스템과 드론을 이용한 지중매설 기반 시설 보호 시스템이 개시된다. 
DAS 시스템과 드론을 이용한 지중매설 기반 시설 보호 시스템은 배관, 전력 및 통신 케이블, 가스관, 및 송유관이 포함된 지하매설물 관리 시스템과 광통신 케이블을 이용한 분산 음향 감시(DAS) 시스템과 연동된 통합관제 서버; 및 상기 분산 음향 감시(DAS) 시스템이 지중매설 기반 시설(배관, 전력 및 통신 케이블, 가스관, 송유관)에 관련된 굴착 공사가 감지되면, 드론을 긴급 출동시켜 건설 공사 굴착 현장에 도착하여 드론의 카메라 영상 촬영 데이터를 통합관제 서버로 전송하고, 드론의 스피커를 사용한 작업자들에게 건설 공사 굴착 주의 원격 경고 방송을 하여 상기 지중매설 기반 시설의 손상을 사전에 방지되도록 하며, GPS 수신기와 카메라와 지향성 스피커 및 13.56MHz RFID 태그가 부착된 드론을 포함한다. 따라서, 드론의 스피커를 사용한 건설 공사 굴착 주의 경고 방송을 함으로써 지중매설 기반시설 손상을 사전에 방지한다.
assignees: TAESEUNG

title_en: Multi-sensor fusion life detection positioning system and positioning method
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of emergency rescue, disaster search and rescue and life detection positioning, and discloses a multi-sensor fusion life detection positioning system which comprises a sensor array module, a multi-sensor fusion life detection positioning method and a multi-sensor fusion life detection positioning system, wherein the sensor array module is composed of a plurality of sensors of different types and is used for collecting environment data in a target area, the multi-sensor fusion life detection positioning method comprises the following steps of S1, deploying a multi-type sensor array in the target area to collect the environment data of the target area, S2, conducting noise filtering and signal enhancement processing on the original data collected by the sensors, and extracting key characteristics of a living body. According to the application, through self-adaptive multi-mode fusion, deep learning feature recognition, nonlinear TDOA optimization and reinforcement learning path planning, the problems of single sensor failure, low signal-to-noise ratio erroneous judgment, complex environment positioning error, static path planning hysteresis and the like are solved, the accuracy of life detection and rescue response efficiency are improved, and the method is suitable for extreme disaster environments.
assignees: BEIJING SHENGBOLAN AUTOMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Correlation elimination method for multi-robot co-location
abstract_en: A correlation elimination method for multi-robot co-location belongs to the field of multi-robot co-location. The method solves the problem that the existing method cannot guarantee the coexistence of communication requirements and estimation consistency and positioning accuracy. The method comprises the steps of establishing a kinematic model, establishing a sliding window state model, establishing an absolute measurement model when a robot detects a landmark, storing corresponding measurement information, a jacobian matrix and a noise covariance matrix, establishing a relative measurement model when other robots are detected, projecting the relative measurement model onto the left zero space of the measured jacobian matrix of the detected robot to construct a pseudo absolute measurement model, storing information, the jacobian matrix and the noise covariance matrix of the pseudo absolute measurement model, stacking the measurement information, the jacobian matrix and the noise covariance matrix, and updating the state estimation and the covariance matrix of the robot. The method is used for the fields of disaster search and rescue, agricultural inspection, underwater exploration and the like.
assignees: UNIV HARBIN ENG

title_en: 3G network based wireless monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention provides a 3G network based wireless monitoring system. A wheel type mobile monitoring robot using a wireless network as a propagation medium is adopted. A camera is carried on the robot and used for acquiring video information, and the mobile robot is controlled to acquire relevant video information through a developed upper computer master control program and the wireless network. In addition, a plurality of sensors on the robot can acquire and return information of a lot of field environments, and the 3G network based wireless monitoring system can be used in mobile monitoring or earthquake disaster search and rescue and other special works.
assignees: Shanghai keyu marketing planning co ltd

title_en: An Emergency Situation Perception and Notifying Apparatus for Underwater Worker
title_ko: 수중작업자의 위급상황 감지 및 알림장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency situation detecting and notifying apparatus of an underwater worker which can transfer information on an accident position or the like through a wireless communications network by using a GPS as well as an agreed rescue request signal by floating a floating material having a wireless communications apparatus (RF transceiver) on the water when a rescue does not execute within several minutes (four minutes, a most desirable time) after accident occurring.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은, 수중작업자 스스가 위험에 노출된 것으로 판단되거나 감지하면 구조버튼을눌러 구조신호를 보내거나, 수중작업자(해녀 또는 잠수작업자)의 작업 패턴을 분석하여 발생이 의심될 때에 요구조자에게 경고 신호를 출력하여 사고유무를 파악하고 맥파등의 신체 정보를 활용하여 사고발생 후 최단 시간내에 사고 발생을 감지하여 사고로 파악되면 즉시 음향신호, 형광물질 표식 및 경광등, 초음파 통신등으로 사고 발생 사실을 전파하여, 주변 작업자들이 신속히 구조할 수 있도록 하고, 사고 발생 후 수분(가장 바람직하게는 4분)이내 구조가 실시되지 않으면 무선통신장치(RF송수신기)가 내장된 부유물을 수면에 띄워 약정된 구조요청신호와 더불어 GPS를 이용한 사고위치 등의 정보를 무선통신망을 통해 전달할 수 있도록 된 수중작업자의 위급상황 감지 및 알림장치이다. 
본 발명은, 수중 작업 중에 사고를 감지하거나 발생할 경우 인명의 손실을 줄이기 위해사고 발생(시작)부터 구조에 소요되는 시간이 매우 짧다는 것을 충분히 감안하여 사고 발생 인근에서 공동 작업 중인 동료들에게 사고 사실을 신속히 알려(전파)주고 발생지점을 표시하여 요구조자(구조요청자)를 신속히 구조할 수 있도록 하고,  또한 사고초기에 요구조자를 구조하지 못하더라도 사고자의 몸과 연결된 부유물을 수면에 표시하여 실종자를 신속히 발견 및 인양하게 하며, 실종자의 수색 및 그에 따른 시간과 사회적 비용을 줄이고 행정적 손실을 최소화할 수 있다. 
또 발명은, 수중작업자의 특성을 고려하여 구조를 간단히 하여 저가의 비용으로 용이하게 제조 및 보급할 수 있고, 장기간 사용하더라도 고장이 발생하지 않도록 할 수 있는 것이다.
assignees: DAEYANG ELECTRONICS;PARK MI JA

title_en: A kind of maritime affairs UAV Video image defogging method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of maritime affairs UAV Video image defogging method based on deep learning, comprising steps of 1) establishing marine video image data library according to atmospherical scattering model by the marine clear video image of unmanned aerial vehicle onboard video camera shooting；2) multiple dimensioned convolutional neural networks model is established, the training of marine video image data library is used；3) marine video image is acquired by the visible image capturing head being mounted on unmanned plane, obtains the I ' of image containing mist (x) of shooting；4) the trained multiple dimensioned convolutional neural networks model of mist image I ' (x) input will be contained to handle, obtain intermediate variable k (x)；5) formula is restored using clear image obtain mist elimination image J ' (x) to the end, the recovery formula of clear image are as follows: J ' (x)=k (x) (I ' (x) -1)+b, I ' (x) is the video image containing mist of shooting, J ' (x) is the clear image restored, k (x) is intermediate variable, and b can use arbitrary constant.The present invention can effectively solve the smudgy problem of video image of unmanned plane vision system acquisition under the conditions of the greasy weather, to improve the search and rescue ability of unmanned plane.
assignees: UNIV WUHAN TECH

title_en: Disaster relief robot control system and method
title_ko: 재난 구조 로봇 제어시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster rescue robot control system and a method thereof. The disaster rescue robot control system comprises: a slave arm of multiple degrees of freedom which is installed on a disaster rescue robot, and performs restoration and rescue operations in a disaster environment; a master arm to receive an operation command of a worker; a control unit linked to an operation of the master arm to control an operation of the slave arm; and an operation limiting unit to limit an operation of the master arm based on an operating area of the slave arm to allow an instruction of the master arm to be generated in the operating area of the slave arm. The slave is operated based on an operation applied to the master arm to perform restoration and rescue operations in a disaster environment. Even if the operating area of the slave arm and an instruction area of the master arm do not match each other, an instruction of the master arm can be limited to be prevented from being generated outside the operating area of the slave arm.
abstract_ko: 재난 구조 로봇 제어시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 재난 구조 로봇에 설치되고, 재난 환경에서 복구 및 구조 동작을 수행하는 다자유도의 슬레이브암, 작업자의 조작명령을 입력받는 마스터암, 상기 마스터암의 동작에 연동해서 상기 슬레이브암의 동작을 제어하는 제어부 및 상기 마스터암의 지령이 상기 슬레이브암의 동작영역 내부에서 발생하도록, 상기 슬레이브암의 동작영역을 기준으로 상기 마스터암의 동작을 제한하는 동작 제한부를 포함하는 구성을 마련하여, 마스터암에 가해지는 조작에 기초해서 슬레이브암을 동작시켜 재난 환경에서 복구 및 구조 동작을 수행하고, 슬레이브암의 동작영역과 마스터암의 지령영역이 서로 불일치하더라도 마스터암의 지령이 슬레이브암의 동작영역 외부에 생성되지 않도록 제한할 수 있다.
assignees: KOREA INST ROBOT & CONVERGENCE

title_en: Disaster relief robot control system and cross over operation method
title_ko: 재난 구조 로봇 제어시스템 및 그의 교차 운전 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster rescue robot control system. The disaster rescue robot control system includes: a plurality of disaster rescue robots dispatched to a disaster environment to perform restoration and rescue operations; and a control server identifying a disaster site situation through communication with each of the disaster rescue robots and integratively controlling the restoration and rescue operations. A robot control part controlling the operation of the disaster rescue robots is formed to set priority so as to drive the disaster rescue robots by crossing manual driving or remote driving, and control the disaster rescue robots so as to drive the disaster rescue robots by crossing remote driving or manual driving based on request signals of a riding operator and a remote operator and the set priority, thereby changing a control right of the disaster rescue robots by determining intentions of the riding operator and the remote operator in a complex disaster situation by setting priority over remote driving and manual driving, and changing a determination basis of the remote operator for determining a drivable state of the riding operator and a control right in accordance with the same in case of an emergency such as an injury or death of the riding operator.
abstract_ko: 재난 구조 로봇 제어시스템에 관한 것으로, 재난 환경에 투입되어 복구 및 구조 동작을 수행하는 복수의 재난 구조 로봇 및 각 재난 구조 로봇과의 통신을 통해 재난 현장 상황을 파악하고 복구 및 구조 동작을 통합적으로 관제하는 관제서버를 포함하고, 상기 재난 구조 로봇의 구동을 제어하는 로봇 제어부는 상기 재난 구조 로봇을 수동 운전 또는 원격 운전을 교차해서 운전하도록 우선 순위를 설정하며, 탑승 조작자와 원격 조작자의 의뢰 신호와 설정된 우선 순위에 기초해서 원격 운전 및 수동 운전을 교차해서 운전하도록 제어하는 구성을 마련하여, 원격 및 수동 운전에 대한 우선순위를 설정하여 복합 재난 상황에서 탑승 조작자와 원격 조작자의 의도를 판단해서 재난 구조 로봇의 제어 권한을 변경할 수 있고, 탑승 조작자의 부상 또는 사망과 같은 응급 상황에서 탑승 조작자의 운전 가능 상태를 판단하기 위한 원격 조작자의 판단 근거와 그에 따른 제어 권한 변경이 가능하다.
assignees: KOREA INST ROBOT & CONVERGENCE;NAT UNIV PUKYONG IND UNIV COOP FOUND

title_en: Fire scene low-quality image recovery method for rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire scene low-quality image recovery method for a rescue robot. According to the method, the flame region is segmented based on the region threshold segmentation algorithm, so that the influence of a flame light source on the global atmospheric light estimation is avoided; an atmospheric light detection operator is designed, accurate atmospheric light parameters are obtained based on the super-pixel block, and the problem of global atmospheric light estimation distortion is solved; a transmissivity estimation optimization module is constructed, the transmissivity is refined based on a bilateral weighting guide filtering method, and the problems of halation and the like caused by the traditional method are solved. The method provided by the invention is beneficial to improving the clarity of the fire scene image recovery, and provides a data basis for improving the scene detection, identification, environment mapping and path planning of the rescue robot.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Target detection method based on fusion of two modal images
abstract_en: The invention discloses a target detection method based on two-mode image fusion, which comprises the steps of constructing a relevant scene based on a AirSim platform to carry out simulation, collecting image data sets of different modes, constructing a bimodal image fusion network, training the fusion network according to a counter-propagation principle, simultaneously extracting features of images of two modes by using a Siamese neural network, reconstructing the features into a fusion image through deconvolution operation, carrying out inspection and evaluation on the quality of the reconstructed fusion image through quantized evaluation indexes, modifying the fusion network according to an evaluation result, directly inputting the fusion features output by the trained fusion network into a single-stage YOLOv target detection network, freezing trained network parameters of the fusion network, and training the target detection network to obtain an optimized fusion and detection network. The method is convenient to realize efficient and accurate bimodal image fusion and detection, and is beneficial to improving the target detection capability of the unmanned aerial vehicle in scenes such as emergency search and rescue.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle reinforcement learning path planning method integrating dynamic uncertainty perception
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle reinforcement learning path planning method integrating dynamic uncertainty perception, which belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous path planning and comprises the steps of constructing a city low-altitude simulation environment, calculating an unmanned aerial vehicle estimated position and an uncertainty matrix based on the city low-altitude simulation environment, constructing a 3D Gaussian probability distribution according to the unmanned aerial vehicle estimated position and the uncertainty matrix, calculating the collision probability of an unmanned aerial vehicle by combining Monte Carlo sampling, calculating rewards according to the collision probability of the unmanned aerial vehicle, maximizing accumulated entropy reinforcement rewards by adopting a strategy pi, and performing strategy learning by utilizing a Soft Actor-Critic, and further outputting an unmanned aerial vehicle path planning optimal control instruction. The method focuses on the urban complex environment, integrates dynamic uncertainty perception and reinforcement learning technologies, solves the problems of unmanned aerial vehicle positioning errors, obstacle collision risks and the like, realizes safe and efficient path planning, and is suitable for unmanned aerial vehicle application scenes requiring autonomous navigation, such as logistics transportation, post-disaster search and rescue and the like.
assignees: UNIV BEIHANG

title_en: Earthquake disaster search and rescue robot control system based on multi-sensor fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control, in particular to a multi-sensor fusion-based earthquake disaster search and rescue robot control system. The method comprises the steps of carrying out preliminary fusion on IMU and wheel type odometer data by adopting EKF, carrying out contrast correction by utilizing absolute pose observation obtained by LiDAR scanning and matching, carrying out real-time interpolation and maintaining smooth and continuous state estimation by an LSTM network in a LiDAR updating interval, ensuring the continuity of positioning data, eliminating state jump or delay caused by sensor asynchronism, carrying out space-time coordinate alignment of multi-mode features based on EKF, ensuring feature time consistency by using time alignment constraint, carrying out multi-mode confidence degree fusion, effectively integrating recognition results of different modes and improving recognition accuracy.
assignees: NORTH CHINA INST OF SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CHINA COAL MINE SAFETY TECHNOLOGY TRAINING CENTER

title_en: A kind of urban road road ability evaluation method for considering building earthquake collapse
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of urban road road ability evaluation method for considering building earthquake collapse, belongs to civil engineering and prevents and reduces natural disasters technical field.This method establishes the road net model that becomes more meticulous in GIS platform first；Then according to multilayer shear model region groups of building are carried out with the time-history analysis of seismic response, it is determined that the destruction of building, situation of collapsing；Building destruction, coverage of collapsing are calculated according to building collapse accumulation area probabilistic model afterwards；Building destruction, the influence collapsed to road are calculated according to the distance of width of roadway, building to road edge；Finally according to road passage capability damage situations and it is expected that departure place and the optimal path of the act of rescue and rescue, evacuation after shake in the calculating earthquake of destination.The present invention provides accurately and efficiently method to consider that the urban road road ability of building earthquake collapse is evaluated.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Apparatus, system and control method for people counting
title_ko: 피플카운팅 장치, 시스템 및 제어방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a people counting apparatus and a system and control method thereof and, more specifically, to a people counting apparatus including a lighting function and a disaster detection function, and a system and control method thereof. According to the present invention, the people counting apparatus detects a counting target passing a detection area and determines whether the counting target is a person to generate information about the number of counted persons, thereby counting the number of people passing the detection area. The people counting apparatus provides the lighting function lighting a predetermined range including the detection area. The people counting apparatus transmits the information on the number of people counted on the basis of an ad-hook network to other nodes or gateways, thereby facilitating installation and operation regardless of indoor or outdoor. The people counting apparatus provides a disaster detection function to detect occurrence of disaster situations such as building collapses, earthquakes, fires, and gas leaks and is configured to supply auxiliary power when operating power supply is cut off or the disaster situation is detected, thereby propagating information about a disaster situation or a rescue target even when operating power is cut off due to a disaster. The people counting apparatus comprises a sensing unit, a lighting unit, a control unit, and a communication unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 피플카운팅 장치, 시스템 및 제어방법에 관한 것으로, 구체적으로는 조명 기능과 재난 감지 기능을 구비하는 피플카운팅 장치, 시스템 및 제어방법에 관한 것이다. 
또한, 본 발명은 감지 영역을 지나는 카운팅 대상을 감지하고 카운팅 대상이 사람인지 판정하여 카운팅된 사람의 수에 대한 정보를 생성함으로써, 감지 영역을 지나는 사람의 수를 카운팅할 수 있고, 감지 영역을 포함하는 소정의 범위에 빛을 비추는 조명 기능을 제공하며, 애드훅 네트워크를 기반으로 카운팅된 사람의 수에 대한 정보를 타 노드 또는 게이트웨이에 송신하도록 구비됨으로써, 실내나 실외의 구분없이 설치 및 운용이 용이하며, 건물 붕괴, 지진, 화재 및 가스 누출을 포함하는 재난 상황의 발생 여부를 감지하는 재난 감지 기능을 제공하며, 동작 전원 공급이 차단되거나 재난 상황이 감지되는 경우 보조 전원을 공급하도록 구비됨으로써, 재난으로 인해 동작 전원이 차단된 상황에서도 재난 상황이나 구조 대상에 대한 정보의 전파가 가능하다.
assignees: CHEJU HALLA COLLEGE IND ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Digital twinning technology-based fire scene collapse risk early warning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire scene collapse risk early warning method based on a digital twin technology, which belongs to the technical field of fire scene collapse risk early warning, and mainly adopts the following scheme: acquiring fire scene building environment information, establishing a fire scene building environment digital twin model according to the fire scene building environment information, and determining a collapse initial profile according to the floor temperature distribution information of a combustion area; determining an additional collapse profile; determining collapse risk level by using the thickness information of the floor slab in the burning area and the weight information of the articles on the floor slab in the burning area; determining a predicted collapse profile according to the additional collapse profile and the initial collapse profile; and when the position of the firefighter is coincident with the predicted collapse profile, the predicted collapse profile information and the collapse risk level are timely sent to the firefighter so as to realize collapse risk early warning, and the firefighter in the collapse area is early warned, so that casualties caused by collapse of the building in a fire disaster are effectively avoided.
assignees: GUANGDONG GUANGYU SCIENCE AND TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Dam flood discharge energy dissipation structure safety risk assessment method based on Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dam flood discharge energy dissipation structure safety risk assessment method based on a Bayesian network, which comprises the steps of constructing a finite element simulation model of a dam and a Bayesian network of the dam flood discharge energy dissipation structure; searching a damage path in the finite element simulation model by adopting a flood discharge energy dissipation structure damage criterion; calculating the damage probability p  o  of each structural damage mode by adopting a Monte Carlo method according to the risk agent model, the mechanical parameters of the dam and foundation materials and the hydraulic parameters of the overflow surface; calculating the structural system damage probability p  α  of the flood discharge energy dissipation structure; when any damaged path o is assumed to be absent, calculating damage probability of flood discharge energy dissipation structure when disaster factors of damaged path o are not damaged based on the rest damaged paths and Bayesian network ; According to p  α  and Calculating the importance of disaster factors of the damaged path o; and selecting a failure path corresponding to the disaster causing factor with the highest importance as a main control path for destroying the flood discharging and energy dissipating structure.

title_en: Power grid disaster real-time regulating and control device and method based on intuition fuzzy rough set
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid disaster real-time regulating and control device and method based on an intuition fuzzy rough set. The method includes the steps that historical disaster data in a database unit are called; the collected historical disaster data are reduced through the method based on the intuition fuzzy rough set, and then disaster grade evaluation rules of a power grid are obtained; disaster data of the power grid are collected in real time, and the current disaster grade of the power grid is determined according to the formed historical disaster grade evaluation rules; the data which are evaluated in real time are updated to a historical database and used for addition and modification of a power grid disaster knowledge base; power grid disaster emergency responses are conducted, namely, corresponding emergency restoration measures are taken according to different disaster grades to regulate and control the power grid. According to the system and method, the situation that the data size used in the power grid disaster evaluation process has fuzziness, randomness, uncertainty, redundancy and other characteristics is taken into account, the defect that internal relations and potential relations of data attributes can not be acquired through a traditional probability theory and other method is successfully overcome by the utilization of the method based on the intuition fuzzy rough set, and evaluation accuracy is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;SHENYANG POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;UNIV NORTHEASTERN

title_en: Chemical industry park real-time quantitative risk assessment method based on multi-disaster real-time coupling
abstract_en: The invention relates to a chemical industry park real-time quantitative risk assessment method based on multi-disaster real-time coupling, introduces a Monte Carlo analysis method and solves the problem of uncertainty of setting of a model probability parameter. By effective integration of the Monte Carlo analysis method and a risk distance calculation method, a chemical industry park site selection risk protection distance is initially determined. According to an environmental risk system principle, by combining characteristics of the chemical industry, a chemical industry park enterprise comprehensive risk assessment index system based on inherent risks of a risk source, effectiveness of a prevention and control mechanism and vulnerability of a receptor is constructed. A catastrophe rating method is introduced to assess an environmental risk comprehensive level, a chemical industry enterprise environmental risk comprehensive assessment method based on a catastrophe principle is proposed, and comprehensive assessment grades are divided into five grade levels so as to discriminate a comprehensive risk level of a chemical industry park enterprise and timely take emergency response strategies. According to the chemical industry park real-time quantitative risk assessment method disclosed by the invention, planning evaluation and risk management of a chemical industry park can be implemented, and a risk prevention ability and a risk management level of the chemical industry park can be improved.
assignees: ZHEJIANG TOPINFO TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multiple current Tsunami disaster appraisal procedure based on Monte Carlo stochastic simulation
abstract_en: The multiple current Tsunami disaster appraisal procedure based on Monte Carlo stochastic simulation that the invention discloses a kind of, method include: that S1 applies a variety of focal shock parameter estimation methods to establish potential tsunami source region seismicity parameters logic tree；S2 establishes tsunami unit source Green's function database using linear tsunami numerical simulation；S3 generates Stochastic earthquake event set according to above-mentioned logic tree, using Monte Carlo stochastic simulation；S4 is simulated using random slippage according to tsunami unit source Green's function database and Stochastic earthquake event set and is generated tsunami wave amplitude collection；Analysis of uncertainty of the S5 according to tsunami wave amplitude collection, to multiple current Tsunami disaster distribution results statistics and result.The above method be able to solve risk evaluation result in the prior art it is higher and can not provide its correspond to probability of happening the problem of, a variety of uncertainties are fused in final assessment result, increase the confidence level of result, operational efficiency is improved simultaneously, policymaker is facilitated targetedly to make prevent and reduce natural disasters deployment and physical construction planning.

title_en: Urban masonry residential safety assessment method based on uncertainty analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a town masonry residential safety assessment method based on uncertainty analysis, and belongs to the field of engineering structure performance assessment. The method comprises the steps of firstly, carrying out acceleration acquisition on a structure under environmental vibration to obtain acceleration data. And secondly, automatically identifying structural modal parameters and uncertainty thereof by adopting a multi-reference-point covariance driven random subspace method and a convolutional neural network. And then, correcting the initial finite element model of the structure by taking the obtained uncertainty modal parameters as input and adopting a Bayesian model correction method based on a progressive Markov chain Monte Carlo method (TMCMC), so as to obtain the town masonry residential safety assessment model with uncertainty parameters. And finally, performing safety assessment on the model by simultaneously considering load action and structural parameter uncertainty. According to the invention, an effective town masonry residential security assessment model can be constructed, so that the aims of long-term security management and disaster early warning of the type of houses are fulfilled.

title_en: Distribution network disaster prevention material allocation method, device, terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a distribution network disaster prevention material allocation method, a device, a terminal and a storage medium, which take account of the uncertainty of disaster conditions and utilize the result of Bayesian network disaster condition inference, namely node outage probability of each node, and then fuse the node outage probability on the basis of the distribution network importance degree information such as weight coefficient and load quantity of the nodes, and the elastic risk index of the whole distribution network is taken as a judging objective function to obtain node material allocation quantity of each node when the elastic risk index meets the optimization requirement, thereby realizing the optimization of distribution network overall material allocation and solving the technical problems of unreasonable disaster prevention material allocation and high resource waste degree of the conventional distribution network disaster prevention material allocation mode.

title_en: Flow process analysis method for intensity index space variation flow state landslide
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flow process analysis method of an intensity index space variation flow state landslide, which comprises the steps of inputting boundary conditions of the flow state landslide, the geometric dimension of a landslide body and rock and soil body intensity index space variation parameters into a program, initializing the boundary conditions, the geometric dimension of the landslide body and the rock and soil body intensity index space variation parameters, utilizing a Karhunen-Lo e expansion method as a stochastic theory, modeling uncertainty and space propagation of a random variable to generate a random sample of the space variation flow state landslide, carrying out deterministic analysis on the flow process of the flow state landslide based on an SPH method, combining the stochastic theory with an SPH model, carrying out Monte Carlo simulation in the SPH method, and finally carrying out statistical analysis on simulation results of different stochastic examples to obtain a probability statistical rule of flow state landslide sliding distance and sliding speed; the method can evaluate the sliding distance, the sliding speed and the disaster causing range of the landslide under the influence of the spatial variability of the strength parameters.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Uncertainty quantification method for wind speed of atmospheric boundary layer
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of boundary layer wind speed numerical calculation in atmospheric science, and particularly relates to an uncertainty quantification method for wind speed of an atmospheric boundary layer. The method comprises the following steps: 1, decorrelating the viscosity coefficient of the random turbulence by utilizing K-L decomposition; 2, projecting the multivariate response value to a dimension by using a projection resampling method; 3, solving a full dimension reduction conversion matrix by using a slice inverse regression method; 4, regarding the dimension reduction space obtained in the step 3 as a control variable to restrain the error of the Monte Carlo method; and 5, solving the mean value and the variance of the wind speed of the atmospheric boundary layer along with the height change. The effect of inertia item has been kept in this application, has considered the change of torrent stickness coefficient along with the height, and calculates portably, is a practical and effectual mode of research atmospheric boundary layer, and its result is more accurate, and belongs to non-invasive method, can effectively overcome the problem of "dimension disaster", can also guarantee that the precision of result is more excellent simultaneously under the circumstances that the calculated amount is less than the Monte Carlo method.
assignees: NAT UNIV DEFENSE TECHNOLOGY PLA

title_en: Post-disaster power distribution network dynamic first-aid repair method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a post-disaster power distribution network dynamic first-aid repair method and a post-disaster power distribution network dynamic first-aid repair system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring state information of a post-disaster power distribution network to be dynamically repaired through an environment side; inputting the state information of the post-disaster power distribution network to be dynamically repaired to an intelligent body side comprising a reinforcement learning model to obtain a dynamic repair result of the post-disaster power distribution network output by the intelligent body; the intelligent agent side obtains a reinforcement learning state from the environment side, selects an action to act on the power distribution network based on a strategy, receives a corresponding reward value and the next state for iterative training, and obtains the reinforcement learning model after continuously updating network parameters. The embodiment of the invention realizes the high-efficiency and high-accuracy emergency repair effect of the post-disaster emergency repair of the power distribution network under the conditions of deep coupling of cooperative allocation, emergency repair recovery and power transfer and recovery of multiple emergency repair teams and uncertainty of disaster conditions.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Mountain area shallow landslide risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention provides a mountainous area shallow landslide risk assessment method, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring mountain rainfall data, soil strength parameters and terrain data through rainfall station field monitoring and indoor tests; s2, calculating the soil saturation condition by using the rainfall infiltration hydrological geological model, calculating the slope safety coefficient by combining the slope stability physical mechanical model, finally calculating the slope instability probability by using the Monte Carlo simulation method, and drawing the corresponding landslide risk map in the mountain area. The method is based on a physical mechanics control equation, considers the rainfall infiltration and slope stability change process, simultaneously considers the uncertainty of soil body parameters, realizes shallow layer landslide risk assessment under the condition of rainfall in the mountainous area, and provides an important theoretical basis for disaster prevention and reduction and emergency rescue work of geological disasters of landslides in the mountainous area.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Method for generating average shear wave velocity maps using proxy-based prediction models for earthquake disaster prediction, recording medium and device for performing the method
title_ko: 지진재해 예측을 위한 광범위 레이어 기반 예측 모델을 이용한 평균 전단파 속도 지도 작성 방법, 이를 수행하기 위한 기록 매체 및 장치
abstract_en: A method for generating an average shear wave velocity map using a wide range layer-based prediction model for earthquake disaster prediction comprises: a step of building a dataset including a shear wave velocity soil column map, topographic information, geological information, and distance information from mountain land; a step of analyzing a shear wave velocity in accordance with a soil layer, the type of soil, geological classification, and a rock formation from the built dataset; a step of generating a shear wave velocity estimation model in accordance with the geological classification and the topographic information based on the analyzed shear wave velocity; a step of correcting the generated shear wave velocity estimation model in accordance with the property of each geological age; and a step of using the corrected shear wave velocity estimation model to generate a shear wave velocity map based on the thickness of a sedimentary layer in accordance with the distance information from mountain land. Accordingly, the uncertainty from a land amplification effect can be lowered through accurate V_S30 estimation, and the reliability of Korean peninsula earthquake disaster analysis and seismic designs can be secured by using V_S30 for the Korean peninsula.
abstract_ko: 지진재해 예측을 위한 광범위 레이어 기반 예측 모델을 이용한 평균 전단파 속도 지도 작성 방법은, 전단파 속도 주상도, 지형 정보, 지질 정보 및 산지로부터의 거리 정보를 포함하는 데이터 셋을 구축하는 단계; 구축된 데이터 셋으로부터 토층, 흙의 종류, 지질 분류 및 암반층에 따른 전단파 속도를 분석하는 단계; 분석된 전단파 속도를 기반으로 지질 분류 및 지형 정보에 따른 전단파 속도 추정모델을 생성하는 단계; 생성된 전단파 속도 추정모델을 지질 시대별 특성에 따라 각각 전단파 속도 추정모델을 보정하는 단계; 및 보정된 전단파 속도 추정모델을 이용하여 산지로부터의 거리 정보에 따른 퇴적층의 두께를 기반으로 전단파 속도 지도를 생성하는 단계;를 포함한다. 이에 따라, 정확한 V S30 의 추정을 통해 부지증폭효과의 불확실성을 낮추고, 한반도용 V S30 을 사용하여 한반도 지진재해 분석 및 내진설계의 신뢰도를 확보할 수 있다.
assignees: KOREA METEOROLOGICAL ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Small hydropower station outage risk assessment method under typhoon disaster based on opportunity constraint model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small hydropower station outage risk assessment method under typhoon disasters based on an opportunity constraint model, which comprises the steps of carrying out Latin hypercube sampling according to a probability distribution function of predicted output of a small hydropower station, carrying out Monte Carlo simulation, substituting a sample value into an electric power system containing the small hydropower station to carry out probability flow calculation, analyzing the small hydropower station outage as an independent event, establishing an opportunity constraint optimal cut-load model when calculating the result of the small hydropower station outage risk and the uncertainty output of the rest small hydropower station of the system, converting the opportunity constraint optimal cut-load model into a deterministic equivalent model and solving the deterministic equivalent model by CPLEX, and multiplying the small hydropower station outage probability by the minimum cut-load cost of the electric power system containing the small hydropower station to obtain a small hydropower station outage risk value. The method effectively solves the contradiction that the safety and the economical efficiency of the power grid cannot be coordinated due to the shutdown of the small hydropower station, and can be used for evaluating the risk caused by the shutdown of the small hydropower station under typhoon disasters.

title_en: Mobile energy storage planning method considering reliability and elasticity of power distribution network in extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile energy storage planning method considering reliability and elasticity of a power distribution network in extreme weather, which comprises the following steps: establishing an element fault rate model, and modeling an uncertainty scene of a power distribution network fault disaster; extracting an extreme weather scene by a Monte Carlo method, reducing the extreme weather scene by adopting a K-means algorithm, and taking the uncertainty of load and distributed power output into consideration, extracting the load, the distributed power output and a power distribution network fault scene by adopting Latin hypercube sampling; selecting evaluation indexes from multiple angles, and calculating objective weights of the indexes to construct a power distribution network reliability and elasticity evaluation index system; taking two indexes of the loss before disaster and the recovery rate after disaster as optimization targets, and establishing a mobile energy storage optimization planning model considering the full disaster period; and adopting COBL-PSO algorithm to solve the mobile energy storage optimization planning model. The invention realizes the improvement of the reliability and elasticity of the power distribution network through the optimization planning scheme of the mobile energy storage.

title_en: Preventive microgrid generation method considering uncertainty of transmission line fault probability
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preventive microgrid generation method considering uncertainty of transmission line fault probability. And further converting the established distributed robust optimization model into an equivalent robust optimization model, and then performing iterative solution on the equivalent robust optimization model by adopting a C & CG algorithm. According to the technical scheme, uncertainty of line fault probability in the power distribution network is considered, a preventive micro-grid generation model of uncertainty of the fault probability of the power transmission line is constructed, and by generating a preventive island micro-grid, power failure loss caused by cascading faults is effectively reduced, and the power supply level of the power distribution network under extreme conditions and the coping capability of the power distribution network under disaster events are improved.
assignees: UNIV NANJING SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Power distribution system operation optimization method and system based on artificial bee colony and computer equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of operation scheduling and control in a distribution network, and discloses a method, a system and computer equipment for optimizing operation of a power distribution system under the regional power exchange constraint based on an artificial bee colony, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining uncertain photovoltaic output parameters in the power distribution network by adopting a Monte Carlo method, and constructing a photovoltaic output model; optimizing DG active power output in a dispatching area power grid by taking the minimum network loss of the operation of the power distribution network as a target, constructing an optimized dispatching model containing various DGs and setting constraint conditions; and adopting an artificial bee colony algorithm to solve the model, and calculating an optimal scheduling scheme for optimizing the distribution system of the regional power exchange and a disaster island division strategy. Compared with the prior art, the operation strategy obtained by the invention fully considers the uncertainty of photovoltaic output, can ensure that the safety constraint is met under various conditions, has a simple model, is easy to solve, and has certain theoretical value and engineering value.
assignees: HUAIAN POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method and apparatus for compensating photovoltaic output prediction uncertainty and intermittency
title_ko: 태양광 발전의 출력 예측 불확실성 및 간헐성 보상 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: A method performed by a device for compensating the output prediction uncertainty and intermittence of photovoltaic power generation according to one embodiment comprises the steps of: additionally generating an independent variable for reflecting a time unit delay value of photovoltaic power generation amount and the characteristics of time series data based on the past power generation amount data of a photovoltaic power generation facility as a dependent variable and disaster prevention weather observation data as an initial independent variable; selecting the variables to be used as an input, based on the correlation between the dependent variable, the initial independent variable, and the additionally generated independent variable; predicting the photovoltaic power generation amount of the photovoltaic power generation facility as an output of a deep learning artificial neural network by inputting the selected variables to the pre-learned deep learning artificial neural network; applying the intermittence by multiplying an actual photovoltaic power generation data value of the photovoltaic power generation facility by a random value following a Gaussian distribution; comparing the predicted photovoltaic power generation amount with the photovoltaic power generation amount to which the intermittency is applied; and determining an operation mode of a BESS as one of stop, a charging operation, and a discharging operation according to a result of the comparison. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the problem of limiting the output of renewable energy due to an imbalance in supply and demand can be alleviated.
abstract_ko: 일 실시예에 따른 태양광 발전의 출력 예측 불확실성 및 간헐성 보상 장치가 수행하는 방법은, 종속변수로서 태양광 발전설비의 과거 발전량 데이터와 초기 독립변수로서 방재기상관측 자료에 기초하여, 태양광 발전량의 시간 단위 지연값 및 시계열 데이터의 특성을 반영하기 위한 독립변수를 추가 생성하는 단계와, 상기 종속변수, 상기 초기 독립변수 및 상기 추가 생성된 독립변수 간의 상관 관계에 기초하여, 입력으로 사용할 변수들을 선정하는 단계와, 상기 선정된 변수들을 기학습된 딥러닝 인공신경망에 입력하여, 상기 딥러닝 인공신경망의 출력으로서 상기 태양광 발전설비의 태양광 발전량을 예측하는 단계와, 상기 태양광 발전설비의 실제 태양광 발전량 데이터 값에 가우시안 분포를 따르는 랜덤 값을 곱하여 간헐성을 적용하는 단계와, 상기 예측된 태양광 발전량과 상기 간헐성을 적용한 태양광 발전량을 비교하는 단계와, 상기 비교의 결과에 따라, BESS의 동작 모드를 정지와 충전 동작 및 방전 동작 중 어느 하나로 결정하는 단계를 포함한다.
assignees: RESEARCH & BUSINESS FOUND SUNGKYUNKWAN UNIV

title_en: Uncertainty quantification method for multi-dimensional parameters in electrical impedance imaging technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for solving the problem of uncertainty quantification of multi-dimensional parameters in an electrical impedance imaging technology. The method comprises the steps of firstly training a deep neural network to construct a substitution model of an original uncertain system, then analyzing and quantifying uncertain parameters based on the deep neural network substitution model and combining a univariate dimension reduction method, and finally obtaining distribution of uncertain output. And compared to the baseline method, the performance of the method of the invention was evaluated. The result shows that the method has high calculation precision and can accurately quantify the uncertainty of output; when the uncertainty dimensionality of the parameters is increased, the uncertainty quantification problem of the high-dimensional parameters can be effectively solved, the dimensionality disaster is relieved, the method is not limited by the interaction between variables, and the calculation cost is effectively reduced. In addition, the method can also be applied to the uncertainty system quantification in other complex fields.
assignees: ZHAO YINGGE

title_en: Natural disaster chain-power system-carbon emission estimation method based on Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a natural disaster chain-power system-carbon emission estimation method based on a Bayesian network, which is characterized in that an emergency model is used for carrying out basic modeling on a natural disaster chain-power system-carbon emission change process, on the basis, the basic model is analyzed by utilizing the advantages of the Bayesian network in uncertainty event analysis, key elements and incidence relations among the key elements are extracted from the basic model to form a node table and an adjacent matrix, the Bayesian network is constructed on the basis of the node table and the adjacent matrix to carry out reasoning calculation, and the carbon emission change analysis of a power system under the action of multiple natural disasters is realized. The method provides support for subsequent disaster-resistant optimization, energy structure optimization, emission reduction and carbon fixation measures and the like of the power system, and can be transferred and applied to other complicated carbon emission process analysis.
assignees: UNIV HANGZHOU DIANZI;NARI GROUP CORP;NARI TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Electric traffic coupling network vulnerability assessment method based on probability map
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric traffic coupling network vulnerability assessment method based on a probability map, which comprises the following steps: establishing a Bayesian network model of a power distribution network equipment outage event under a typhoon disaster, and predicting the power distribution network equipment outage probability based on a Bayesian network; establishing an alternating current optimal power flow model, analyzing the overload condition of a power distribution network line, and carrying out load shedding on a power system; evaluating the capability of the coupling network for resisting external interference by using a probability graph-based electric traffic coupling network vulnerability evaluation model; the method takes a probability graph as a support, establishes an electric traffic coupling network vulnerability assessment model, and realizes calculation of electric traffic coupling network elasticity measurement; based on historical meteorological data, the method can be used for predicting the cascade fault propagation mechanism of the electric power traffic coupling network under typhoon disasters, ensures the accuracy and rapidity of real-time estimation, and provides theoretical basis for emergency plans under typhoon weather.

title_en: Elasticity evaluation method for power distribution network containing distributed energy sources
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution system elasticity assessment method containing distributed energy, which comprises the steps of firstly adopting Gumbel probability distribution to generate disaster scenes; then randomly sampling the element fault state according to the vulnerability equation, and dividing the network state based on a graph searching algorithm; then establishing an island micro-grid optimization problem based on mixed integer programming, taking the minimum total cost of load shedding compensation and distributed energy running cost as an objective function, and taking reactive power and voltage control problems into consideration to carry out linearization treatment on alternating current power flow; and finally, considering time-varying characteristics of the distributed renewable energy output and the load demand, adopting non-sequential Monte Carlo simulation to simulate, recording the load state under each disaster simulation, and calculating to obtain the elasticity evaluation indexes of the node level and the system level. According to the invention, a set of complete elastic evaluation index system is established by considering various uncertainty factors, so that the defending and recovering capabilities of the distribution network system to extreme events are quantified.
assignees: HUANGGANG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Urban water supply pipe network anti-seismic toughness comprehensive calculation method considering water quality and water quantity indexes
abstract_en: A comprehensive calculation method for the earthquake-resistant toughness of an urban water supply pipe network taking water quality and water quantity indexes into consideration belongs to the field of water supply pipe network earthquake-resistant performance evaluation. The method comprises the following steps: probability P of pipeline shock hazard  f  Is calculated; pipeline lineConfirming the post-earthquake state; determining the area of a leakage hole of a leakage pipeline; establishing a pipe network hydraulic model of the earthquake damage scene; simulating a pipe network post-earthquake recovery process, and adopting a pipeline dynamic importance ranking method to collect the pipeline water source distance to determine the post-earthquake recovery sequence; establishing a hydraulic power and water quality model of a pipe network in the post-earthquake recovery process; calculating the anti-seismic toughness; and (5) calculating the mean value of the anti-seismic toughness. According to the method, the water quality index is incorporated into the evaluation index of the anti-service performance of the urban water supply network, and the anti-seismic toughness of the urban water supply network is comprehensively calculated; the method for integrating the pipeline water source distances by adopting the pipeline dynamic importance sorting method is adopted to determine the post-earthquake repair order, so that the determined pipeline repair order is more reasonable; the water supply toughness evaluation index disclosed by the invention can comprehensively reflect the post-earthquake anti-seismic toughness, the hydraulic power and water quality change characteristics and the relative difference of a pipe network, considers the uncertainty of pipeline damage under an earthquake scene and the uncertainty of leakage type of a leakage pipeline, and generates a sufficient number of random earthquake damage scenes through Monte Carlo simulation. Has guiding significance for post-earthquake disaster relief and repair work.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Multi-mode data fusion and uncertain estimation water level prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water level prediction method and system for multi-mode data fusion and uncertain estimation, which utilize various spatial-temporal data related to reservoir water level prediction to generate a plurality of parallel CNN branches for feature fusion and dimension reduction, and the parallel CNN branches are processed as input vectors of Bi-LSTM models to predict water level, and a Monte Carlo technology is introduced to evaluate uncertainty and confidence of a prediction result. According to the invention, a multi-mode data fusion technology is adopted, different CNN branches are built for parallel operation aiming at different types of space-time data, a Bi-LSTM network is built for prediction through PCA dimension reduction, a Monte Carlo technology is introduced for prediction and uncertainty and confidence assessment of a model, so that the prediction error of the model is effectively reduced, and the prediction reliability is improved. The method has higher practicability, can be widely applied to the fields of water conservancy, weather and the like, and provides more rigorous and effective prediction and decision for application scenes such as water resource management, disaster early warning and the like.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Power distribution network optimization method and system under typhoon disaster based on two-stage planning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network optimization method and system under typhoon disasters based on two-stage planning, comprising the following steps: modeling wind speed uncertainty, line uncertainty and load uncertainty by using the acquired power distribution network information, meteorological information and geographic information to obtain a distribution function about typhoon wind speed and power distribution line damage probability of the power distribution network, and generating load scenes by Monte Carlo simulation to obtain reactive load and active load in each scene; on the basis of a distribution function, a distribution line damage probability, reactive loads and active power in each scene, constructing a two-stage random planning elastic lifting model for the distribution network; and solving the model under the first-stage constraint condition and the second-stage constraint condition to obtain an optimization decision result, and optimizing the power distribution network through the optimization decision result. By adopting the embodiment of the invention, the accuracy of the decision aiming at the power distribution network is improved, and the elastic coping capacity of the power distribution network is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Three-dimensional geologic body sectioning method based on Markov chain and Monte Carlo simulation
