abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional geologic body sectioning method based on Markov chain and Monte Carlo simulation, which comprises the following steps of S1, acquiring PRB data, drilling data and a digital elevation model; s2, calculating a geological interface hidden function equation according to PRB data; s3, extracting a DEM point set in the digital elevation model to obtain a tetrahedral geological model; s4, utilizing the hidden function property to carry out section division; s5, simulating the stratum state of the virtual geological drilling by using a Monte Carlo method; s6, defining corresponding geological properties of geological areas in the section according to section combination to form a section model; the method is based on Markov chain and Monte Carlo simulation, can generate a deterministic model which cannot capture the uncertainty of stratum attributes through implicit three-dimensional geological modeling, can better reflect the complex spatial cutting relationship and stacking relationship among geological structures and the specific form inside the structures, and has the characteristics of being more modified, being capable of accurately explaining the ground, carrying out disaster early warning analysis decision and the like on underground excavation engineering.
assignees: UNIV XIAN ARCHITECTUR & TECH;CHINA ROAD & BRIDGE CORP

title_en: Disaster broadcasting wireless relay system that compensates for synchronization signals and improves broadcasting quality of radio shaded areas
title_ko: 동기신호를 보상하고 전파음영지역의 방송품질을 개선한 재난방송 무선중계시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a disaster broadcasting wireless relay system that compensates for a synchronization signal in a wireless section where data loss may occur and improves broadcasting quality in a radio shadow area so as to improve the reliability of disaster broadcasting. The disaster broadcasting wireless relay system that compensates for a synchronization signal and improves broadcasting quality in a radio shadow area comprises: a disaster broadcasting receiving device having an FPGA module for noise reduction to reduce noise caused by the surrounding environment when receiving a disaster broadcasting RF signal, and converting a digital demodulated signal from which the noise has been removed into Internet packet data and outputting the same; a main relay device that receives the Internet packet data output from the disaster broadcasting receiving device through a wired network and outputs the same as a short-range wireless signal; a sub-relay device that receives the short-range wireless signal output from the main relay device, modulates the same into a synchronized disaster broadcasting RF signal, and outputs the same; and a user terminal having a disaster broadcasting reception communication module for receiving the disaster broadcasting RF signal output through the sub-relay device.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 동기신호를 보상하여 불확실성을 갖는 무선구간의 신뢰성을 향상시키고 전파음영지역에 용이하게 재난방송을 전달할 수 있도록 하는 동기신호를 보상하고 전파음영지역의 방송품질을 개선한 재난방송 무선중계시스템에 관한 것으로, 전파음영지역의 건물내부에 설치되며 재난방송용 RF신호를 수신하는 경우에 주변환경으로 인한 노이즈를 저감시키기 위한 노이즈 저감용 FPGA모듈을 구비하여 노이즈가 제거된 디지털 복조신호를 인터넷 패킷 데이터로 변환하여 출력하는 재난방송 수신장치, 상기 건물내부를 구성하는 층별로 설치되고 상기 재난방송 수신장치에서 출력되는 인터넷 패킷데이터를 유선망으로 수신하여 근거리 무선신호로 출력하는 메인중계장치, 상기 메인중계장치가 설치된 층에 적어도 하나 이상 설치되며 상기 메인중계장치에서 출력되는 근거리무선신호를 수신하여 동기화된 재난방송용 RF신호로 변조하여 출력하는 서브중계장치, 및 상기 서브중계장치를 통해 출력되는 재난방송용 RF신호를 수신하기 위한 재난방송수신용 통신모듈을 구비하는 사용자 단말기;를 구비한다.
assignees: AGOS CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network rush-repair method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network rush-repair electricity method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: firstly, considering the uncertainty of the output of wind-light power generation during typhoon disasters, and predicting the power generation of wind power and photovoltaic by using a phase space reconstruction and Stacking integrated model; secondly, using pumped storage as a black start power supply, and establishing a mixed integer linear programming model of emergency power generation vehicles, gas generators, hydrogen fuel cells, wind-solar storage and other distributed power supplies participating in power distribution network rush repair scheduling and fault recovery; and solving by using a CPLEX solver to obtain scheduling strategies of the rush-repair teams and the emergency power generation cars under different scenes, and analyzing the influence of the output of each device on the power distribution network. The invention can accurately predict the output of the wind-light power generation equipment when key information such as meteorological environment is lost, greatly improves the power distribution network re-electricity efficiency under typhoon disasters, and effectively reduces the loss caused by power failure.
assignees: UNIV WUHAN TECH

title_en: Visual geographic cloud image data processing system for intelligent aerial view map customer service risk
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of electric power risk, and particularly relates to a visual geographic cloud image data processing system for intelligent aerial view map customer service risk, which comprises the following components: the system comprises a geographic sampling module, a probability evaluation module, an asset statistics module and a risk output module. According to the scheme, a GIS technology is adopted to analyze a flood disaster graph, the failure risk probability of the electric power asset and the potential influence thereof are quantized, and a process for monetizing and visualizing the generated risk results is established; the method comprises the steps of creating a cloud-shaped sampling point which is uniformly distributed in an influence area of each power distribution cabinet, generating a position of a sampling shape by using a Monte Carlo simulation method, randomly shifting the position of the cloud-shaped sampling point, and simulating the uncertainty of the position by using a fuzzy boundary; by means of the vulnerability profile without safeguarding or improvement measures, the losses or the extent of impact suffered by the electrical installation are evaluated in order to operate more robustly in the face of threats.
assignees: NANNING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method for evaluating power grid restoration supporting capacity of distributed photovoltaic-photo-thermal coupling system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of elasticity evaluation of power distribution networks, in particular to a method, a device and equipment for evaluating the supporting capacity of a distributed photovoltaic-photo-thermal coupling system to power grid recovery and a readable storage medium, which specifically comprise the following steps: dividing the operation scenes of the photovoltaic-photo-thermal coupling system under extreme weather conditions based on historical statistical data, optimally calculating the recovery capacity of the supporting power grid under different operation scenes of the photovoltaic-photo-thermal coupling system, and finally obtaining the comprehensive evaluation value of the recovery supporting capacity of the supporting power grid by combining the occurrence probability of each operation scene of the photovoltaic-photo-thermal coupling system; the uncertainty influence of extreme weather conditions on the photovoltaic output can be fully considered, and the power supply recovery support capability of the photovoltaic-photo-thermal coupling system on the power grid after disaster is reasonably evaluated, so that the adequacy of the output of the schedulable resources and the cooperative coordination among different resources can be fully considered when an application personnel makes a recovery strategy after disaster.
assignees: STATE GRID SUZHOU URBAN ENERGY RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power distribution network and drainage network topology collaborative reconstruction method for coping with storm water logging disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network and drainage network topology collaborative reconstruction method for coping with storm water-logging disasters, which comprises the following steps: step S1, constructing an electric power-drainage network coupling model based on partial differential constraint of pressure and non-pressure unsteady flow hydrodynamic force, and representing dynamic interactive evolution processes of power failure, rainwater overflow and road ponding of a power grid under a storm disaster; s2, establishing an equivalent linear complex algebraic equation of a drainage network nonlinear hydrodynamic partial differential equation in a frequency domain; s3, deducing a multi-hyperplane formula of an electric power-drainage composite safety area, and representing a feasible operation boundary of an electric pump-sluice group under the injection conditions of complex electric power and rainwater; and S4, taking rainfall uncertainty in heavy rain into consideration, adopting multi-scene random optimization based on Monte Carlo simulation, and solving an emergency scheduling decision scheme at the current moment through rolling optimization. The invention realizes the coordination reconstruction of the network topology of the power distribution network and the drainage network under the disaster of rainstorm and waterlogging.

title_en: Multi-type power source cooperative active recovery method and system after network disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for active recovery after disaster in a distribution network with cooperation of multiple types of power supplies, belonging to the field of recovery after disaster in a distribution network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: based on source load switching and source load uncertainty analysis, analyzing frequency indexes of a system under dynamic disturbance in a partition expansion process, and considering supporting effects of DG and MES in a distribution network on inertia, primary frequency modulation and load electric energy, constructing partition expansion constraint considering frequency safety and electric energy demand; and establishing a multi-partition net rack continuation model taking the multi-MES as a restoration starting point, and combining partition expansion constraint and source load restoration constraint to construct an overall active restoration model. The invention utilizes the flexible movement characteristic, the electric energy supporting characteristic and the frequency supporting characteristic of the MES, considers the recovery process after the disaster of the distribution network and cooperates with the DG to ensure that new energy is possible to be connected in advance on the premise of ensuring the frequency safety, and the power generation resources in the network are utilized in advance and fully, so that a larger amount of load can be recovered.
assignees: UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH

title_en: Building function probability prediction method under flood disasters based on deep learning algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building function probability prediction method under flood disasters based on a deep learning algorithm, which comprises the following steps: s1, collecting basic data and historical storm time sequence data of a research area; s2, processing the data; s3, constructing an FFC model based on a deep learning algorithm, training and verifying the FFC model, optimizing the affected building attention coefficient to obtain the optimal affected building attention coefficient for each building type, and testing the performance of the FFC model; s4, inputting the forecast rainfall time sequence into the FFC model tested for each building type, and performing repeated rolling iteration prediction to obtain probability distribution results of different functions of each building in a certain time range in the future of the research area. The obtained building function probability distribution result is beneficial to providing more information and uncertainty quantification for decision-making of decision-makers, thereby providing a good basis for the determination of the subsequent evacuation requirements.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Near-shore storm surge and typhoon wave forecasting method based on process and data dual driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a near shore storm surge and typhoon wave forecasting method based on process and data double driving, which comprises the steps of obtaining multisource meteorological data, and adopting a multi-model self-adaptive integrated forecasting method to process the multisource meteorological data so as to obtain high-precision meteorological forecasting data; based on high-precision weather forecast data, a multidimensional feature typhoon path extraction and probability forecast method is adopted for processing, so that probability typhoon path forecast data are obtained; based on the probability typhoon path forecast data, adopting a physical constraint variation assimilation wind field correction method to process so as to obtain corrected wind field data; based on the corrected wind field data, processing by using a multi-grid wind-wave-stream coupling model solving method to obtain near-shore storm surge and typhoon wave forecast data; and calculating to obtain a final forecasting result by adopting an integrated learning offshore disaster forecasting and uncertainty quantifying method. The invention realizes the rapid and accurate prediction of the wind, wave, tide and flow of the important offshore areas during typhoons.
assignees: NANJING HYDRAULIC RES INST

title_en: Extreme weather prediction method based on typical weather year
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of weather prediction, in particular to an extreme weather prediction method based on a typical weather year, which comprises the steps of firstly, constructing a typical weather year data set, combining ground, analysis and satellite data, and generating high-quality weather data through interpolation and fusion technologies; the method comprises the steps of generating the enhancement data of the countermeasure network, solving the problem of insufficient extreme event samples, extracting key meteorological variables through super-resolution and feature dimension reduction, constructing a deep learning model based on a convolutional neural network and a long-term and short-term memory network to conduct multi-task prediction, introducing physical constraint rules such as energy conservation and mass conservation to ensure that the prediction accords with the meteorological rules, generating confidence intervals of prediction results through an uncertainty quantization technology, and providing risk assessment and decision support information. The method improves the accuracy and the reliability of the extreme weather event prediction, and supports disaster prevention and reduction, resource scheduling, agricultural production and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST

title_en: Electric power-traffic coupling charging network toughness assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating toughness of an electric power-traffic coupling charging network, and belongs to the technical field of electric power system analysis. According to the method, an electric power-traffic coupling charging network is built, a Bezier curve is combined to simulate a typhoon path and a Holland wind field model to calculate wind speed, dynamic traffic flow distribution, alternating current optimal power flow and cascading fault models are built, a Monte Carlo simulation is utilized to generate a fault data set, a dynamic Bayesian network is utilized to train a fault prediction model, a dynamic probability map is output after the actually measured wind speed is input, and dynamic toughness indexes are calculated to evaluate the toughness of the electric power-traffic coupling charging network. According to the method, the problem of fault propagation and insufficient dynamic evaluation among the systems is considered, and the toughness evaluation precision of the power-traffic coupling charging network under typhoon disasters is improved.
assignees: UNIV NANJING NORMAL

title_en: Wide area landslide rapid identification method based on interpretable intelligent algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wide-area landslide rapid identification method based on an interpretable intelligent algorithm, which relates to the field of remote sensing science and technology, and is characterized in that a dual-channel feature extraction architecture is constructed through multisource spatial-temporal data fusion and dynamic weighting of a knowledge map, wherein a light CNN captures local textures of images, a graph-convolution network models the geological space relevance, an interpretable contribution thermodynamic diagram and a rule chain are generated by combining SHAP values and causal reasoning, a knowledge map bidirectional verification system is introduced, a priori rule is utilized to verify space logic contradiction, a model and a rule library are triggered to co-evolve based on misjudgment samples, a multidimensional reliability report is output, the analysis granularity is customized and interpreted according to roles by Monte Carlo Dropout quantization uncertainty, and a terrain self-adaptive block-flow processing architecture is adopted, and edge light deployment and federal learning are combined to realize wide-area real-time early warning and dynamic updating of the model. The scheme breaks through the limitation of the traditional black box model, and forms a disaster prevention closed loop of physical driving, transparent decision and second-level response.

title_en: Power distribution network flexible supply and demand resource scheduling strategy considering random faults
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexible supply and demand resource scheduling strategy of a power distribution network, which takes random faults into account, wherein S1 data acquisition is carried out, disaster parameters, power grid states and resource capacities are obtained in real time, multi-source data fusion and uncertainty quantification are carried out, a full-scene multi-source data monitoring system is constructed, S2 scene mapping is carried out, random fault scene modeling and generation are carried out based on the full-scene multi-source data monitoring system, disasters are converted into line faults and running state changes, S3 strategy generation is carried out, feasible scheduling strategies are enumerated and modeling constraints are constructed, a flexible supply and demand resource scheduling strategy library is constructed, S4 optimization solution is carried out, a robust optimization model of the random faults is established, an optimal strategy is solved according to an objective function selection algorithm, S5 feedback is carried out, issuing commands and real-time adjustment are carried out, closed-loop control is formed, dynamic closed-loop control and self-adaptive adjustment are carried out on the power distribution network, and the toughness and recovery capacity of the power distribution network in natural disasters can be improved, and the safety and reliability of power supply are ensured.
assignees: XUCHANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Intelligent tailing dam displacement prediction and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent tailing dam displacement prediction and early warning method, which belongs to the technical field of safety prediction and early warning, and comprises the steps of obtaining online monitoring historical data of a tailing dam, preprocessing data, constructing a GRU main prediction model to predict main prediction displacement, obtaining an error sequence through actual measurement data and the main prediction displacement, decomposing the error sequence into a trend item and a noise item error sequence through PSO-VMD-TOPSIS, respectively constructing a trend item and noise item error correction model based on GRU, obtaining error correction values and standard deviations of the trend item and the noise item through MC-dropout technology, constructing a dynamic weight calculation mechanism, obtaining a final displacement prediction value and a confidence interval through combining the main prediction displacement, judging whether to alarm or not, realizing high-precision real-time prediction, uncertainty quantization and real-time early warning of the tailing dam displacement, and providing intelligent decision support for the safety state assessment and disaster early warning of the tailing dam.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN SCI & ENG;YIBIN JIABO INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Agent index-based quick evaluation method and system for earthquake-resistant toughness of water supply pipe network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid evaluation method and a rapid evaluation system for earthquake-resistant toughness of a water supply pipe network based on an agent index, which belong to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of civil engineering and comprise the following steps of S1, pipe network topology modeling and information determination, S2, earthquake-resistant toughness time dimension division and index definition, S3, preparation index and agent index calculation, S4, robustness index and agent index calculation, S5, recovery index and agent index calculation, S6, adaptability index and agent index calculation, S7, monte Carlo simulation and uncertainty analysis, and S8, establishing a functional relation. The rapid evaluation method and the rapid evaluation system for the earthquake-resistant toughness of the water supply pipe network based on the agent index solve the problem of rapid evaluation of the earthquake-resistant toughness of the urban water supply pipe network and provide an effective approach for analysis and design of the earthquake-resistant toughness of the pipe network.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Extreme scene cascading failure modeling method considering new energy uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention relates to an extreme scene cascading failure modeling method considering new energy uncertainty, and belongs to the field of disaster simulation and early warning of electric power systems. The method comprises the steps of carrying out cascading failure simulation on a power grid in the typhoon scene, determining disconnection conditions of lines at each time point based on wind-induced failure rates of the lines at each time point in the typhoon scene and forming a wind-induced failure set, traversing the wind-induced failure set, calculating cascading failure caused by wind-induced failure at each time point based on the disconnection conditions of the lines and corresponding wind-electricity output, wherein the cascading failure comprises wind-induced failure and line disconnection failure caused by one or more thermal overloads, and determining key lines in the power grid based on the cascading failure in multiple simulation. The method provided by the invention accurately evaluates the influence of the cascading failure caused by typhoons on the power grid through the simulation of the cascading failure under typhoons by double time scales (typhoons and cascading failure time scales).
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Surface matrix map modification data processing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geology, in particular to a surface matrix map modification data processing method which comprises the steps of data dynamic acquisition, intelligent pretreatment, three-dimensional modeling, multi-scale nested analysis, decision deduction and dynamic visualization; compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the periodic manual acquisition and static database updating scheme is adopted, the data updating period is long, sudden environmental change is difficult to capture, the scheme adopts the multi-source data real-time access and AI dynamic cleaning scheme, the method has the advantages of real-time updating capability and automatic abnormal value correction, the earth surface matrix model can dynamically respond to environmental change, the timeliness of disaster early warning and emergency decision is remarkably improved, the deep learning fusion multi-mode data and Bayesian uncertainty quantification scheme is adopted, the method has the advantages of high-resolution three-dimensional modeling and risk area visualization, and complex geological structures can be accurately depicted and clear priority guidance is provided for manual verification.
assignees: QINGHAI GEOLOGICAL SURVEY INSTITUTE QINGHAI GEOLOGICAL MINERAL RES INSTITUTE QINGHAI GEOLOGICAL REMO

title_en: Historical similar runoff classification recommendation method based on characteristic index identification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a characteristic index identification-based historical similar runoff classification recommendation method which comprises the steps of historical runoff process restoration, historical scene water rising process extraction, historical runoff characteristic depiction, archive construction, scene runoff process cluster analysis and Siamese network architecture-based historical similar runoff process recommendation. According to the invention, the matching efficiency of the historical similar runoffs is shortened from the small hour level to the minute level, the real-time decision of flood control dispatching is supported, meanwhile, the short-term forecast is replaced by recommending the complete historical runoff process, the uncertainty conduction risk is effectively reduced, high-confidence data support is provided for reservoir group joint dispatching and disaster emergency response, and the initiative and the scientificity of flood control disaster defense are comprehensively improved.
assignees: BUREAU OF HYDROLOGY CHANGJIANG WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION;CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent mountain torrent disaster early warning monitoring system
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of natural disaster early warning, and discloses an intelligent early warning mountain torrent disaster monitoring system which comprises a data acquisition unit, a risk prediction unit and a dynamic utility evaluation unit, wherein the data acquisition unit is used for acquiring multi-source dynamic monitoring data and static geographic data, the risk prediction unit is connected with the data acquisition unit and is used for generating probabilistic prediction of mountain torrent disaster states in a specific time window in the future based on the multi-source dynamic monitoring data and the static geographic data, and the dynamic utility evaluation unit is used for combining a preset decision maker risk preference model and a public trust dynamic evolution model to quantify the comprehensive utility of different early warning decisions under different disaster situations. By fusing the multi-element heterogeneous data and applying a hybrid prediction model of dynamic Bayesian network and Gaussian process regression, the accuracy and reliability of mountain torrent risk prediction are obviously improved. Compared with the early warning mode relying on a single data source or a simple model in the prior art, the method effectively overcomes the defect that the data is not fully utilized and uncertainty is difficult to quantify.
assignees: Lang Zhengze

title_en: Wind deflection flashover probability prediction method for power transmission line based on conditional diffusion model
abstract_en: A method for predicting wind deflection flashover probability of an electric transmission line based on a conditional diffusion model relates to the field of wind deflection risk prediction of the electric transmission line, and a space-time joint probability generating frame is constructed by fusing meteorological data and line structural features so as to realize the refined prediction of the wind deflection flashover probability of the electric transmission line. The method comprises the steps of S1 obtaining meteorological data, line parameters and historical flashover data of a power transmission line, carrying out data preprocessing, S2 carrying out condition coding, diffusion processing and iterative denoising on the data based on a parameterized Markov chain, establishing a condition diffusion model, S3 completing uncertainty quantification according to hidden probability modeling, generating a confidence interval, evaluating the wind deflection flashover probability of the power transmission line, S4 constructing accuracy and uncertainty quantification evaluation indexes about model prediction results and the confidence interval, and dividing wind deflection risk grades of the power transmission line. The invention promotes the accurate prevention and control of the wind deflection flashover disaster of the power transmission line and provides technical support for constructing a novel power system safety protection system.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO RIZHAO POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Probabilistic hierarchical fault scene generation method for electric comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a probabilistic hierarchical fault scene generation method of an electric comprehensive energy system, which relates to the technical field of comprehensive energy system optimization and comprises the following steps of firstly, considering the uncertainty of earthquake intensity, dispersing a target earthquake magnitude range into a plurality of equidistant intervals and calculating the occurrence probability of earthquakes of different earthquake magnitudes; the method comprises the steps of modeling disaster causes of earthquakes of different earthquake levels by adopting a vulnerability curve, calculating expected values of damaged elements of a power distribution system and a natural gas system, then randomly generating a fault scene under each classified earthquake level by using a Monte Carlo method, carrying out simulation on cascading faults of an electric comprehensive energy system under the random fault scene, recording the total loss load of the system, and finally calculating average loss load under each classified earthquake level, selecting a typical fault scene and forming a classified fault scene set. The method quantifies the tail risk of the low-probability extreme event and provides a scene basis for the toughness promotion strategy formulation of the comprehensive energy system.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Embedded landslide real-time early warning method based on space-time feature decoupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses an embedded landslide real-time early warning method based on space-time feature decoupling, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent monitoring and early warning of geological disasters. The method comprises the steps of obtaining historical time sequence monitoring data of a landslide body, constructing a training data set, performing space-time characteristic decoupling on the data, decomposing the data into a global component and a detail component, constructing a double-branch lightweight time sequence convolution network comprising the global branch and the detail branch, completing joint training and self-adaptive weight fusion at a cloud end, performing differential lightweight processing on the trained network, deploying the trained network in an embedded terminal, performing characteristic decoupling and prediction by utilizing a real-time data stream at the embedded end, obtaining a predicted value and uncertainty estimation by combining a lightweight Monte Carlo Dropout method, and finally realizing dynamic threshold calculation and hierarchical early warning. The method effectively solves the problem that the existing method is difficult to consider the prediction precision and the calculation efficiency at the embedded terminal, and achieves real-time, accurate and self-adaptive early warning of landslide disasters.

title_en: In-service bridge vulnerability analysis method considering extreme climate influence
abstract_en: The invention provides an in-service bridge vulnerability analysis method considering extreme climate influence, which comprises the steps of obtaining state data, a target extreme climate data set and historical disaster data of an in-service bridge, determining vulnerable key structural components of the in-service bridge under corresponding extreme climate according to the historical disaster data, determining a dominant failure mode, constructing an in-service bridge model containing parameter uncertainty according to the state data of the bridge, the vulnerable key structural components under the corresponding extreme climate and the dominant failure mode by adopting finite elements, inputting the target extreme climate data set into the in-service bridge model, and calculating probability distribution of bridge damage states of the key structural components at the second moment under different intensities through Monte Carlo simulation of a plurality of groups of random parameter samples to generate an extreme climate intensity-failure probability vulnerability curve. By implementing the method, the efficiency and the precision are effectively balanced, and the safety risk of the bridge under extreme weather is reduced.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Transfer line sequencing method considering economic and social effects of power loss load of distribution network after disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transfer line sequencing method considering economic and social effects of power loss load of a distribution network after disaster, belongs to the technical field of safety planning operation of power systems, and solves the problems that the traditional sequencing relies on manual/single indexes, is difficult to cope with fault uncertainty and lacks a standardized model. The method comprises the steps of calculating load recovery weights based on population density and unit load economic loss by using an improved analytic hierarchy process, simulating and generating a multi-fault scene by using Monte Carlo, building an optimization model by taking minimum economic and social losses as targets and combining a complex electricity means and scheduling constraint, solving the model to obtain switch operation time, and determining transfer priority by using Copride sequencing. The invention provides a scientific scheme for emergency decision of complex fault scenes, meets the requirement of rapidly making an optimal transfer strategy after disaster, and reduces economic and social losses.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Automatic detection and restoration discrimination method for side slope damage area based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slope damage area automatic detection and restoration judging method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps of obtaining multi-time-phase slope monitoring data and preprocessing the multi-time-phase slope monitoring data to form multi-source input data, inputting the multi-source input data into a variant DeepLab to divide a network to generate slope damage area boundary data, carrying out time sequence analysis based on the slope damage area boundary data to generate slope damage evolution data, combining the boundary data with the evolution data, extracting areas, crack widths, displacement rates and slopes to form restoration judging parameter sets, inputting the restoration judging parameter sets into an improved multi-parameter restoration judging network to output restoration grade data, introducing an uncertainty modeling module into the network to generate restoration judging confidence coefficient data, matching restoration measure libraries according to the restoration grade data and the restoration judging confidence coefficient to generate restoration measure recommendation results and outputting a judgment report. The detection and discrimination are integrated, and the method is suitable for geological disaster monitoring and treatment.
assignees: GUANGXI ZHUANG AUTONOMOUS REGION GEOLOGICAL ENV MONITORING STATION

title_en: Network updating method for post-disaster road restoration map fused with heterogeneous disaster sensing data
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of emergency management and discloses a network updating method of a post-disaster road restoration map fused with heterogeneous disaster sensing data, which comprises the steps of converting acquired heterogeneous data into basic probability distribution of observation evidence; the method comprises the steps of predicting a physical field state based on a physical process simulator, generating basic probability distribution of prediction evidence, fusing the two to obtain posterior basic probability distribution, deciding and updating a road map network state according to the posterior basic probability distribution, and feeding the updated state back to the simulator as a dynamic boundary condition to form bidirectional coupling of the physical simulation and the road map state. According to the application, by constructing the simulation assimilation framework of the bidirectional coupling, the technical problems of physical simulation and infrastructure state fracture in the traditional method are solved, the uncertainty of data is effectively processed by utilizing the evidence theory, and the authenticity of disaster evolution prediction and the reliability of road state update are improved.

title_en: Multi-disaster power distribution network recovery method and device considering source-load uncertainty
abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-disaster power distribution network recovery method and device considering source load uncertainty, a storage medium and computer equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring meteorological data under the current disaster, determining the fault probability of each line through a preset line fault probability calculation formula based on the meteorological data, and determining a fault line; the method comprises the steps of identifying a power supply region to be restored from a target power distribution network according to a fault line, determining the predicted load demand of each load node in the power supply region to be restored according to a preset load uncertainty model, determining the rigid load demand and the flexible load demand of the power supply region to be restored based on the predicted load demand, generating various predicted disaster scenes corresponding to the power supply region to be restored according to meteorological data under current disasters, constructing an objective function and constraint conditions according to the network topology of the power supply region to be restored, and solving the objective function under each predicted disaster scene to obtain a power supply restoration scheme under each predicted disaster scene.
assignees: NANNING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based drainage basin intelligent flood control scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based watershed intelligent flood control scheduling method and a digital twinning-based watershed intelligent flood control scheduling system, which relate to the technical field of flood control and disaster reduction and comprise the steps of collecting static data and dynamic data of a watershed, constructing a hydrohydrodynamic coupling model based on the static data and the dynamic data to form a watershed digital twinning body, inputting a received numerical weather forecast into the watershed digital twinning body to simulate, generating various flood evolution scenes in a future period, calculating a dynamic flood risk probability map, constructing a simulation training environment by utilizing historical flood data and high-precision watershed digital twinning body, performing offline training on a scheduling strategy network in the simulation training environment based on a reinforcement learning algorithm, and outputting a scheduling strategy network with the training completion of a scheduling instruction according to a real-time watershed state. The invention effectively solves the core problems of insufficient timeliness of decision making and weak self-adaptation capability in an uncertainty environment in the traditional method.
assignees: HUBEI WATER RESOURCES TECHNICAL COLLEGE

title_en: Uncertainty landslide displacement prediction method based on TCN-Attention-EWT
abstract_en: The invention discloses an uncertainty landslide displacement prediction method based on TCN-Attention-EWT, and belongs to the field of intelligent prediction of geological disasters. The method comprises the steps of obtaining slope history monitoring data and normalizing, constructing a GRU deterministic prediction model to conduct displacement prediction and generate an error sequence, decomposing the error sequence into a low-frequency system error and a high-frequency random error by adopting a TCN-Attention-EWT combined method, respectively establishing a GRU error correction sub-model with Monte Carlo Dropout, calculating probability distribution dynamic fusion weights of the low-frequency system error and the high-frequency random error correction based on an information theory, fusing a deterministic prediction value with probability distribution of the two correction values, and obtaining a final displacement prediction mean value and a prediction interval through inverse normalization. The method realizes high-precision prediction and uncertainty quantification of landslide displacement and provides reliable technical support for landslide early warning.

title_en: Geological disaster emergency decision method and system based on self-adaptive generation type AI
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster emergency decision method and a system based on self-adaptive generation type AI, belonging to the technical field of geological disaster emergency response and artificial intelligence intersection, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, data acquisition and preprocessing; S2, landslide segmentation and uncertainty quantification, S3, feature extraction and uncertainty gating, S4, high confidence report Prompt construction, S5, low confidence retrieval enhancement processing, S6, final report generation and output, S7, active learning and model iteration. The geological disaster emergency decision method based on the self-adaptive generation type AI is used for realizing high-efficiency analysis, omitting emergency labeling and retraining cost, improving the reliability of a report, combining an external professional knowledge base which can be dynamically maintained, and enabling a power assisting system to self-evolve, so that the identification accuracy and robustness are continuously improved, and the low confidence coefficient target is reduced.
assignees: UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES WUHAN

title_en: Coal mine gas risk virtual deduction early warning method and system based on multi-source information fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a coal mine gas risk virtual deduction early warning method and system based on multi-source information fusion, and belongs to the technical field of gas risk early warning. The method comprises the steps of firstly collecting geological, mining and environmental multisource data, carrying out preprocessing and feature extraction, fusing to construct a high-dimensional risk feature vector, then driving a virtual working face system comprising mining, ventilation and gas emission intelligent agents to evolve by the vector, adopting a Monte Carlo tree search algorithm to prospectively deduce future multistep states, calculating risk entropy of each path, finally generating a dynamic risk probability map based on the deduction result, and solving a Pareto optimal decision set considering safety, efficiency and economy through multi-objective optimization. The invention realizes the transition from passive monitoring to active early warning of gas risk, effectively solves the problem of early warning hysteresis, and provides advanced and accurate scientific decision support for gas disaster prevention and control through risk visualization and space positioning.

title_en: Beach vegetation restoration evaluation method based on image feature analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of image analysis, in particular to a beach vegetation restoration evaluation method for image feature analysis, which comprises the steps of obtaining remote sensing images of two time phases of a target beach restoration area before and after an environmental disturbance event occurs, respectively dividing the remote sensing images of the two time phases in an object-oriented manner to generate a plurality of vegetation objects, extracting morphological stability features and ecological stress resistance features of each vegetation object in the two time phases, calculating the functional toughness index of each vegetation object based on the changes of the morphological stability features and the ecological stress resistance features before and after the environmental disturbance event, and evaluating the overall effect of vegetation restoration according to the functional toughness index. The invention changes the uncertainty problem of the traditional graph selection according to the fixed time interval, so that the vegetation restoration evaluation has the advantages of event driving, accurate time phase and effective data, and provides technical support for post-disaster ecological monitoring, post-coastal engineering evaluation and the like.
assignees: FIRST INSTITUTE OF OCEANOGRAPHY MINI OF NATURAL RESOURCES

title_en: Dam strong earthquake simulation system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of dam safety, and discloses a dam strong earthquake simulation system based on digital twinning, which comprises a physical digital entropy flow twinning body module, a disaster source generation module, a digital twinning simulation module and a model correction module, wherein the physical digital entropy flow twinning body module is used for constructing a finite element model of a dam and dynamically coupling a material constitutive relation in the finite element model with the structural entropy, the disaster source generation module is used for generating a disaster source combination pair, the digital twinning simulation module is used for carrying out dynamic response simulation calculation on the physical digital entropy flow twinning body module, and the model correction module is used for correcting parameters of the physical digital entropy flow twinning body module. According to the application, the structural entropy is introduced to comprehensively quantify the damage, energy dissipation and information uncertainty of the material, and a dynamic coupling mechanism of the constitutive relation of the material and the structural entropy is established, so that the digital twin model is converted from a traditional static parameter model into a dynamic evolution model capable of reflecting the degradation and damage accumulation process of the material by endogenous property, and the reality and fidelity of simulation are improved.
assignees: YUNNAN HUADIAN JINSHAJIANG MIDSTREAM WATER POWER DEV CO LTD LIYUAN GENERATING BRANCH

title_en: Pre-deployment robust optimization method and system for electric bus before disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pre-deployment robust optimization method and system before electric bus disaster, and belongs to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of electric power systems. The method comprises the steps of obtaining power grid, bus, load and disaster prediction data, adopting Monte Carlo simulation to generate a fault scene set, establishing a robust optimization model aiming at minimizing system load shedding, considering electric bus operation, dispatching, scheduling constraint and power distribution network system constraint, describing line fault uncertainty by constructing a reinforced confidence set, and adopting a C & CG decomposition algorithm solution model to obtain an optimal pre-deployment scheme. The invention effectively solves the problems of inflexible deployment and high cost of the traditional fixed energy storage in post-disaster recovery, and remarkably improves the post-disaster recovery speed and the elasticity level of the power distribution network and reduces the economic loss of power failure while ensuring normal public transportation service by utilizing the mobile energy storage characteristic of the electric public transportation.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: Mine working face stress monitoring and disaster early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for monitoring stress on a mine working face and early warning disasters, in particular relates to the technical field of coal mine safety monitoring, and aims to solve the problem that the reliability of disaster early warning is insufficient due to model uncertainty in the existing stress field inversion method; the method is characterized in that accurate early warning of working face dynamic disasters is realized by constructing a stress field analysis system containing uncertainty evaluation, surrounding rock strain data is obtained through an optical fiber sensing network, leading stress field distribution is obtained through inversion calculation, uncertainty transfer and amplification effects in the inversion process are analyzed, confidence intervals of stress values of all areas are calculated, the critical degree of the current stress state is evaluated by combining historical stress data, disaster early warning information is generated based on a multi-dimensional risk evaluation result, reliability of stress field analysis and accuracy of disaster early warning are effectively improved, and technical support is provided for safe production of the working face.
assignees: CHINA PINGMEI SHENMA HOLDING GROUP CO LTD;XIAN MEIKE TRANSPARENT GEOLOGICAL TECH CO LTD;INST ROCK & SOIL MECH CAS

title_en: Disaster-resistant toughness assessment method for urban comprehensive pipe rack, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster resistant toughness assessment method, a storage medium and electronic equipment for an urban comprehensive pipe rack, and relates to the technical field of urban comprehensive pipe racks. The method comprises the steps of obtaining disaster resistance toughness classification information of the urban comprehensive pipe rack, obtaining a comprehensive influence matrix based on relative influence among factors affecting the disaster resistance toughness of the urban comprehensive pipe rack in the classification information, analyzing centrality and causality based on the comprehensive influence matrix, obtaining a target reachable matrix based on the comprehensive influence matrix, constructing a layered network model for disaster resistance toughness assessment based on the target reachable matrix and analysis results of centrality and causality, mapping the layered network model into a Bayesian network, and carrying out disaster resistance toughness assessment on the urban comprehensive pipe rack by utilizing the Bayesian network after mapping. Therefore, uncertainty caused by the fact that a single expert is relied on for judgment can be reduced, and accuracy and dynamic response capability of an evaluation result are improved.
assignees: HEFEI INST PUBLIC SAFETY RES TSINGHUA UNIV;UNIV SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CHINA

title_en: Comprehensive evaluation system of pedestrian safetiness according to inunddation flow of underground facility, and method for the same
title_ko: 지하시설의 침수흐름에 따른 보행 안전성 종합평가 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_ko: 지하철 역사, 철도시설 등의 지하시설 침수흐름에 따라 대피자의 보행 안전성 분석과 대피경로 설정 의사결정을 위한 보행 안전성 평가를 위해서 다양한 평가지표를 종합적으로 고려한 종합평가점수 산정을 통해 보행 위험구간을 판별할 수 있으며, 또한, 여러 평가지표를 종합 판단한 결과에 따라 홍수로 인한 재난상황 발생시 시설 관리자의 의사결정의 불확실성을 줄임으로써 시설 이용자의 대피 안전성을 향상시킬 수 있는, 지하시설의 침수흐름에 따른 보행 안전성 종합평가 시스템 및 그 방법이 제공된다.

title_en: Electric power system toughness assessment method based on deep learning under large-scale uncertainty scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system toughness evaluation method under a large amount of uncertainty scenes based on deep learning, which aims to solve the problem that the existing power system lacks effective evaluation on various uncertainty scenes. The toughness evaluation method of the electric power system comprises the steps of firstly, constructing a maximum wind speed intensity measurement graph of the electric power system in a target area, secondly, simulating and generating resistance distribution of a power transmission tower in the electric power system by utilizing Monte Carlo, constructing a power transmission line damage scene, simulating power transmission tower damage based on random fields, thirdly, performing recovery simulation on the power transmission tower in the electric power system based on a function loss value, determining a toughness evaluation index, fourthly, establishing a toughness evaluation proxy model of the electric power system under a large number of uncertain scenes based on deep learning, and obtaining the toughness evaluation index of the electric power system based on the trained deep learning model. The method can more accurately evaluate the damage condition of the target power network under various actual uncertain typhoon disaster situations and uncertain power transmission tower damage situations, and improves analysis efficiency.
assignees: HARBIN INST TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Slope and foundation pit stability monitoring and early warning method based on remote sensing data fusion
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning, and particularly relates to a slope and foundation pit stability monitoring and early warning method based on remote sensing data fusion. According to the method, deformation monitoring precision and point density are improved through the combination optimization of a multiband SAR scattering mechanism, a weighted self-adaptive adjustment model is introduced to achieve objective fusion and uncertainty quantification of deformation-weather-background factors, and a deformation-weather coupling prediction model is constructed to achieve advanced early warning and hierarchical prevention and control. The invention solves the problems of sparse midpoint, low precision and insufficient early warning reliability in the traditional monitoring, and realizes high-precision and full-coverage stability evaluation and active prevention and control.
assignees: XINJIANG ROAD AND BRIDGE CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD;UNIV XIANGTAN

title_en: Power distribution network post-disaster rush repair scheduling optimization method considering load three-phase imbalance
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system rush-repair scheduling, and discloses a power distribution network post-disaster rush-repair scheduling optimization method considering load three-phase imbalance, which adopts the technical scheme that the weighting of the maximum load accumulation recovery amount and the minimum fuel cost of a mobile generator during the rush-repair of the power distribution network is adopted as a target, the three-phase unbalanced safety constraint and the wind power output uncertainty are considered, a random optimization model is built by modeling wind power output, coupling rush repair team scheduling, mobile generator scheduling and power distribution network operation constraint through a scene probability method, and a CPLEX solver is adopted to solve after linearization so as to coordinate various resources to promote the three-phase load accumulation recovery amount and ensure the operation safety of a system and equipment.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Bridge digital twin risk assessment method under extreme event
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bridge risk assessment method based on digital twinning under extreme events. Firstly, multi-source data in a short time window are collected to form a unified observation vector. The abnormal sensor is then identified and redundancy repair is performed. And then, constructing a triple calibration model, solving damage parameters, identifying a damage dynamic evolution field, constructing a full-link uncertainty propagation system, and calculating the residual bearing capacity and risk index. When the risk index or confidence interval thereof covers 1.0, a conservative traffic policy is output. And finally, generating a traffic control scheme by combining the risk indexes, and carrying out collaborative updating on multiple bridges in the area. The invention has the advantages of fault tolerance, robustness, causality interpretability, dynamic prediction, full link transparency, assessment-management closed loop and the like, can rapidly and reliably output the residual bearing capacity and traffic strategy of the bridge after an extreme event, and improves the emergency efficiency and operation safety after disaster.
assignees: GUANGXI XINFAZHAN COMMUNICATION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Transient electromagnetic and seismic wave multi-mode joint inversion imaging method based on physical information transducer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a transient electromagnetic and seismic wave multi-modal joint inversion imaging method based on physical information transducer, belonging to the field of geophysical exploration and artificial intelligence intersection. The method comprises the steps of performing anomaly detection, interpolation, filtering and normalization preprocessing on transient electromagnetic and seismic wave original data, extracting characteristics representing electrical property, elasticity and cross physical significance, serializing space data through a meshing and alternating fusion strategy, constructing enhanced codes fusing absolute, relative positions and physical properties, designing a physically constrained encoder-decoder architecture to perform multi-scale forward modeling-inversion, and quantifying uncertainty of inversion results by adopting a Bayesian Monte Carlo method to generate a confidence map. According to the invention, through the physical rule driving and multi-mode depth complementation fusion, the fine recognition capability and interpretation reliability of hidden disaster-causing geologic bodies such as underground goafs and collapse columns are effectively improved while the physical consistency of data is maintained.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING;UNIV KUNMING SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY;CHONGQING HUIKAN INDUSTRIAL TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Sampling method for rainfall forecast samples under complex terrain condition of mountain area
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and reduction, and relates to a sampling method for forecasting rainfall samples under the condition of complex terrains in mountain areas. On the basis of a rainfall probability distribution model, judging a sampling mode adopted by an early warning unit according to a forecast rainfall grade and the position of the early warning unit, wherein the sampling mode comprises tail enhanced sampling and Monte Carlo sampling, the tail enhanced sampling specifically comprises that the layering standard adopted by the early warning unit is judged by combining the forecast rainfall grade of the early warning unit and live rainfall data of the previous day and the position relation between the early warning unit and a major attention area, and corresponding layers are divided according to the layering standard, and the corresponding layers comprise a normal layer and a tail layer. The combination mode of tail reinforcement sampling and common Monte Carlo sampling is adopted, uncertainty and high disaster causing performance of rare events (high-intensity rainfall) at the tail of the rainfall are fully considered, and the problems of common sampling sample concentration and poor coverage are avoided.
assignees: CHINA GEOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT MONITORING INST GEOLOGICAL DISASTER TECHNOLOGY GUIDANCE CENTER OF MINIS

title_en: Basin risk assessment method and system based on geographic space and Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of natural disaster risk assessment and discloses a river basin risk assessment method and system based on a geographic space and a Bayesian network, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a digital elevation model diagram of a target river basin, multi-disaster investigation record and simulation research results, and extracting key points; establishing a disaster chain path according to the key points to complete Bayesian network modeling, carrying out node probability modeling and initializing parameters, establishing a disaster chain probability propagation mechanism to describe the sequential transmission process of disasters among nodes, establishing a high-dimensional joint distribution model to carry out forward reasoning propagation of a plurality of Bayesian networks, carrying out uncertainty compression of a disaster reasoning chain, carrying out probability propagation and reasoning, and calculating disaster probability of population loss and economic loss. By utilizing the scheme of the invention, the overall synergy of disaster chain reasoning and the delicacy of risk expression under a complex system can be improved, and the risk assessment capability of the model under the complex chain disaster system is improved.
assignees: CHINA RENEWABLE ENERGY ENGINEERING INST;CHINA RENEWABLE ENERGY ENGINEERING INST CO LTD;CHINA WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER ENG CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for evaluating risk of strong wind disaster of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution networks, in particular to a method and a system for evaluating the risk of a strong wind disaster of a power distribution network. The method comprises the steps of constructing a data vector of each node at t time by means of meteorological observation of wind resistance parameters, environmental parameters and t time of each node in a power distribution network topology model, constructing a node vulnerability model based on a wind pressure response-failure probability mapping function, acquiring failure probability of each node at t time, acquiring risk propagation weight between each node at t time and adjacent nodes based on electric adjacent strength, inverse proportion function of the geographic coordinates and meteorological consistency of each node and adjacent nodes, and dividing all nodes into a plurality of risk areas by considering consistency, connectivity, boundary complexity and time stability in the areas, and acquiring node level risk assessment results, area level risk assessment results and whole network level risk assessment results at t time. The method and the system effectively improve the evaluation precision of the risk of the wind disaster of the power distribution network.
assignees: SHIZUISHAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Multi-dimensional matrix construction method for disaster monitoring of power transmission corridor
abstract_en: The application provides a method for constructing a multidimensional matrix for monitoring disasters in a power transmission corridor, which relates to the field of disaster monitoring, and comprises the steps of establishing a three-dimensional main coordinate system of a chain pile-cross section-time by taking a central line of a power transmission line as a reference, and constructing a corridor multidimensional coordinate system; mapping a geographic observation point to corridor space coordinates through a space projection mapping relation, performing time resampling and covariance constraint spatial interpolation on multi-source monitoring data to achieve space-time alignment, constructing a fused disaster monitoring matrix, embedding uncertainty dimensions in the matrix, dividing each corridor local unit in the disaster monitoring matrix into a four-quadrant structure, modeling a coupling relation among disaster seeds through a Copula function, embedding map regularization constraint to obtain a multidimensional matrix, slicing the multidimensional matrix embedded with the disaster coupling relation, extracting local risk views, and outputting a risk cube with a confidence interval. The application breaks through the limitation of traditional two-dimensional geography or single disaster monitoring.
assignees: ZHEJIANG JUHONGKAI INTELLIGENT ELECTRIC CO LTD;UNIV HUBEI

title_en: Information update method and the real-time automatic update system for disaster damage investigation using wireless communication technology and web-gis
title_ko: 무선통신과 웹-지아이에스를 이용한 재해피해조사 실시간자동화 업데이트 시스템 및 그 운영방법
abstract_en: A system for automatically updating disaster damage investigation in real-time by using wireless communication and a web-GIS, and an operation method thereof are provided to quickly make a disaster prevention/restoration plan by automatically processing/uploading data received from various investigation equipment to a homepage and a bulletin board in connection with the web-GIS. A field equipment end(110) comprises portable damage investigation equipment capturing picture, moving picture, and sound data of a disaster area, obtaining coordinates of the disaster area, and receiving measurement from each measurer, and an ultra high speed wireless Internet modem transmitting data recombined and completed in the portable damage investigation equipment to a damage investigation information reception server(120). The damage investigation information reception server analyzes the received data by comparing the received data with basic damage data, registers the data to a disaster database, and transmits the data to a web server(130) and a web-GIS server(140) by classifying and converting the data into a protocol corresponding to each server.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무선통신과 웹-지아이에스를 이용한 재해피해조사 실시간 자동화 업데이트 시스템 및 그 운영방법에 관한 것으로, 각종 자연재해에 의해 발생한 인명피해 및 자연물, 인공물 등의 각종 피해에 대한 재해피해조사를 시행할 시에 디지털카메라, GPS, 음성녹음기 및 무선 초고속 통신장비 등의 장비를 이용하여 각 피해규모 산정의 객관성 확보와 과학적 근거를 확보하고 조사 과정을 신속하고 정확하게 할 수 있는 조사장비를 구비하고, 조사된 결과를 정리 및 입력하여 저장하고 가공하는 각종 데이터 작업과, 정리된 데이터를 각 서버단으로 전송하여 정해진 유형에 맞는 정보의 형태로 실시간으로 자동 가공하고 홈페이지 메인페이지, 게시판에 게시함은 물론 표준화된 재해 대장 형태로 가공하여 웹페이지를 생성하고, 발생 지점 좌표 등을 통해 Web-GIS 상에 피해 발생 지점 등록 및 그 속성을 표출하며, 이러한 홈페이지, 재해대장, Web-GIS 등을 연계하여 신속하게 각종 정보를 검색하고 확인할 수 있도록 함으로써 신속한 피해복구 대책 수립과 방재 정책 수립을 진행을 지원할 수 있고, 일반 인터넷상에 재해조사의 각종 정보를 게시함으로써 방재 및 재해복구 대책의 투명성을 확보하여 대민 정책 신뢰도를 제고할 수 있도록 지원하는 무선통신과 웹-GIS를 이용한 재해피해조사 실시간 자동화 업데이트 시스템 및 그 운영방법을 제공함에 그 목적이 있다.
assignees: INHA IND PARTNERSHIP INST;DATA PCS CO LTD

title_en: Geospatial information fusion systems for natural disaster research
title_ko: 자연재해 피해조사를 위한 지형공간정보 융합시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a geospatial information fusion system for natural disaster damage research. The geospatial information fusion system for natural disaster damage research includes: an aerial photograph DB (115); a land registration map DB (120); a topographic map DB (130); a search unit (135); a map image composition unit (140) programmed to compose lot number boundary lines of a disaster trace image, an aerial photograph image, and a land registration image and installed in a computer; a damage location extraction unit (145); a damage scale extraction unit (150); a field survey information acquisition unit (155); a damage calculation unit (160); and a geospatial fusion server (100).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 자연재해 피해조사를 위한 지형공간정보 융합시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 지형공간 정보를 이용하여 자연재해 피해조사를 수행하여 실시간으로 피해 위치 및 규모를 객관적이고 정량적으로 파악하여 신속한 복구 계획 수립을 위한 기초 자료 및 피해액 산정의 자료료 활용할 수 있는 자연재해 피해조사를 위한 지형공간정보 융합시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명인 자연재해 피해조사를 위한 지형공간정보 융합시스템은, 
좌표가 적용된 항공사진 이미지를 저장하는 항공사진디비(115)와, 
지적도 이미지를 저장하는 지적도디비(120)와, 
재해흔적이미지가 적용된 지형도 이미지를 저장하는 지형도디비(130)와, 
상기 디비들을 검색하도록 프로그램되어 컴퓨터에 설치되는 검색부(135)와, 
상기 검색부에 의해 디비들에서 검색한 동일 지역 이미지에서, 지형도 이미지의 재해흔적이미지와, 항공사진 이미지와, 지적도 이미지의 지번 경계선을 합성하도록 프로그램되어 컴퓨터에 설치되는 맵이미지합성부(140)와, 
재해 정보 혹은 재난 정보를 토대로 피해 위치를 추출하기 위한 피해위치추출부(145)와, 
상기 지번 경계선을 토대로 지번별 피해 규모를 추출하기 위한 피해규모추출부(150)와, 
현장조사원단말기(200)에서 제공한 현장 조사 정보를 획득하기 위한 현장조사정보획득부(155)와, 
상기 지번별 피해 규모와 현장 조사 정보를 토대로 피해액을 산정하기 위한 피해액산정부(160)를 포함하여 구성되는 지형공간융합서버(100);를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명을 통해 위성영상과 지적도를 융합한 새로운 형태의 자연재해 피해지도맵을 사용하여 지형에 대한 이해를 높이고, 피해 규모에 대한 정량적 조사를 동시에 수행할 수 있는 효과를 제공하게 된다. 
또한, 정량화된 피해 조사 구축으로 재해 담당자 업무경감 및 재난관리 역량 강화를 제공하게 되며, 대민 서비스와 연계하여 재해관련 정보를 제공하여 국민 편의성을 제고하게 된다.
assignees: UNIV HANNAM INST IND ACAD COOP

title_en: A kind of disaster monitoring damage identification method based on meteorology with Remote Sensing Data Fusion Algorithm
abstract_en: The invention belongs to agricultural insurance technical field, it is more particularly to a kind of based on the meteorological disaster monitoring damage identification method with Remote Sensing Data Fusion Algorithm, from agrometeorological hazard risk assessment, spatial analysis statistical function of the setting loss assessment with reference to GIS after disaster area remote sensing monitoring and calamity, using risk analysis of natural disaster as basic principle, from the danger of disaster Flood inducing factors, hazard-affected body fragility and mitigation ability is combated a natural disaster to build Flood inducing factors model, Flood inducing factors are used as to calculate accumulation monthly precipitation anomaly data by TRMM satellite datas, agricultural disaster is monitored from meteorological disaster, formulation for agricultural restructuring and disaster-proof measures provides foundation.With can a wide range of, round-the-clock, accurate in real time the advantages of grasping apparent and yield effect degree of the meteorological condition to crops, foundation is provided for work such as Making A Strategic Decision of The Agricultural Productions and post-disaster rescue and agricultural insurances.
assignees: HENAN RAINBOW REMOTE SENSING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Seismic damage estimation method and system for electric power system
title_ko: 전력계통의 지진 피해 예측 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for estimating damage to an electric power system on an earthquake scenario which is input. The method for estimating damage to an electric power system includes: a step of estimating electric power system component dependence in accordance with connection information on an electric power system from a network topology model in which database including connection information on the electric power system to be estimated, component position information, and component initial service supply information comprises a set of individual cells; a step of estimating a maximum ground acceleration of the electric power system component in accordance with the position information on the electric power system component and an earthquake scenario which a user inputs; a step of estimating common cause damage of the electric power system component in accordance with the estimated maximum ground acceleration; a step of estimating series damage of the electric power system component in accordance with the estimation of the common cause damage and the dependence of the electric power system component; and a step of estimating a final service providing rate of the electric power system after an earthquake based on initial service supply information of the electric power system component and estimation of the series damage.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 입력된 지진 시나리오에 대한 전력계통의 피해를 예측하는 방법에 관한 것으로, 평가 대상 전력계통의 연결정보, 구성요소 위치정보, 구성요소 초기 서비스 공급정보를 포함하는 데이터베이스가 개별 셀의 집합으로 이루어진 네트워크 토폴로지 모델로부터 전력계통의 연결정보에 따라 전력계통 구성요소 의존도를 평가하는 단계, 사용자가 입력한 지진 시나리오와 상기 전력계통 구성요소의 위치정보에 따라 상기 전력계통 구성요소 최대지반가속도를 추정하는 단계, 상기 추정된 최대지반가속도에 따라 상기 전력계통 구성요소의 공통원인피해를 평가하는 단계, 상기 전력계통 구성요소의 의존도와 상기 공통원인피해 평가에 따라 상기 전력계통 구성요소의 연쇄피해를 평가하는 단계 및 상기 연쇄피해 평가와 상기 전력계통 구성요소의 초기 서비스 공급정보로부터 지진 이후 전력계통의 최종 서비스 제공 가능도를 예측하는 단계를 포함한다.
assignees: SEOUL NAT UNIV R&DB FOUNDATION

title_en: Automatic damage detection method using low-resolution satellite images
title_ko: 중·저해상도 위성영상을 활용한 피해규모 자동탐지방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic method for detecting scale of damage based on a satellite for scientific investigation to figure out causes of natural disasters. An automatic system for detecting scale of damage for the method comprises: a database (120); a body (125) of the automatic system; and a module for automating scale of damage (130).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 자연재해 잰나원인 과학조사를 위한 위성기반 피해규모 자동탐지방법에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 위성영상과 GIS 주제도, 복구단가를 이용하여 피해조사전 개략적인 피해규모를 파악하고 신속한 복구 계획수립을 위한 기초자료 및 현장조사 우선순위 지역 선정의 근거자료로 활용하되, 고해상도의 위성영상 대신에, 보다 활용하기 쉬운 중·저해상도의 위성영상을  활용하여 자연재해 피해탐지를 자동화한 피해규모 자동탐지방법에 관한 것이다. 이를 위한 본 발명은, 인터넷망과의 네트워크 가능한 컴퓨터시스템 서버에서 연속지적도, 수치형도, 토지피복도, 행정구역도를 저장하는 GIS DB(105), 위성영상(Kompsat-2, Landsat-8)을 저장하는 영상 DB(110) 및, 복구단가를 저장하는 피해액 DB(115)를 포함하는 데이터베이스 (120); 영상 전처리 프로그램, 파일관리기능부, 피해정보 추출기능부, 기타 기능부를 포함하는 시스템인터페이스의 피해규모 자동탐지시스템 본체(125) 및; 위성기반 피해규모 자동탐지시스템 본체(125)에 적용될 자연 재해별 태풍이나 폭설의 피해규모 자동화모듈(130)을 포함하여 구성되어;  인터넷망의 USGS(United States Geological Survey) 홈페이지를 통해 누구나 무료로 다운받을 수 있는 Landsat-8 영상을 컴퓨터시스템 서버가 다운받아, 데이터베이스(120)의 영상 DB(110)로 저장하고; 영상 DB(110) 내의 Landsat-8  피해 전후 위성영상을 피해규모 자동탐지시스템 본체(125) 내에서 영상 전처리 프로그램을 통해 전처리를 수행하며; Landsat-8 영상을 피해규모 자동탐지시스템 본체(125)의 파일 관리기능부를 통해 피해규모 자동화모듈(130)에 입력하고; 이렇게 입력된 영상에 피해정보 추출 기능을 적용하기 위하여 피해규모 자동화모듈(130) 내의 범위설정 버튼을 클릭하여 변화탐지를 수행할 범위를 선택하고, 자동탐지실행 버튼을 클릭하여 피해탐지 수행하며; 피해탐지는 토지피복도 내에서 산림지역과 비산림지역을 구분하여 각각 다른 알고리즘을 적용하고, 토지피복도의 산림에 해당하는 지역의 경우에는 영상에 존재하는 분광학적 특성의 변화 크기 및 양상을 효율적으로 탐지할 수 있는 알고리즘인 CVA를 피해 전후 Landsat-8 위성영상의 R, G, B, SWIR1, SWIR2 밴드에 적용한 후 DNDVI 알고리즘을 적용하여 피해 전 영상보다 피해 후 영상에 식생이 증가한 지역은 피해지역이 아닌 것으로 간주하여 최종적인 피해면적을 산출하고;   토지피복도의 비산림에 해당하는 지역의 경우에는 위성영상의 정보를 통해 지표면의 명도, 식생, 수분 정보를 산출할 수 있게 하는 TCT 알고리즘을 통해, 명도, 식생, 수분 정보를 산출하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: NAT DISASTER MANAGEMENT RES INST

title_en: House vibration damage matrix curvonic analysis system and method based on earthquake vibration parameters
abstract_en: The invention provides a house vibration damage matrix curvoing analysis method based on earthquake parameters and a corresponding system, which adopts a maximum likelihood estimation method based on the corresponding relation between intensity and earthquake parameters to convert the damage ratio result of correct house vulnerability matrix or actual vibration damage statistics into a double-parameter vulnerability curve, overcomes the defect of the vulnerability curve based on intensity, and particularly provides a simpler way for obtaining the vulnerability curve aiming at the structure types which are difficult to carry out simulated analysis, such as civil engineering, masonry and the like; based on the relation between the intensity and the earthquake motion parameters, the characteristic parameters of the earthquake vulnerability curves of various house structures are given, and basic data can be provided for the house building earthquake damage assessment based on the earthquake motion parameters. The method and the system have high reliability and wide application, and can be used for checking and perfecting the existing vulnerability matrix or curve so as to better serve the fields of quick earthquake disaster assessment, risk assessment, insurance assessment and the like.

title_en: Automation system for disaster damage investigation
title_ko: 고해상도 위성영상을 활용한 재난피해조사 자동화시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic disaster damage investigating system using a high-resolution satellite image, which comprises: a database (120) including a GIS DB (105), an image DB (110), and a damage DB (115); an automatic damage investigating system main body (125) of a system interface; and an automatic damage investigating module (130) of a typhoon or heavy snow for each natural disaster.
assignees: NAT DISASTER MANAGEMENT RES INST

title_en: Crop growth remote sensing monitoring system and method based on crop model and assimilation technology
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of crop detection, and discloses a crop growth remote sensing monitoring system and a method based on a crop model and a assimilation technology, wherein the crop growth remote sensing monitoring system based on the crop model and the assimilation technology comprises: the system comprises a remote sensing data acquisition module, a data preprocessing module, a data transmission module, a central control module, a model construction module, a crop growth condition monitoring module, a growth condition parameter extraction module, a growth condition parameter assimilation module, a data storage module and an updating display module. The crop growth remote sensing monitoring system based on the crop model and the assimilation technology effectively improves the crop monitoring precision, is simple and convenient, and is easy to popularize and apply in a large area. Meanwhile, the data assimilation can effectively improve the monitoring precision of the monitoring model, reveal the growth change rule and ensure the stability and reliability of the result; the precision of crop monitoring and disaster damage assessment is obviously improved, and the method has an important application prospect.
assignees: AGRICULTURAL REMOTE SENSING AND INFORMATION RES INSTITUTE OF HEILONGJIANG ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SC

title_en: Building earthquake damage assessment model for optimizing BP neural network by improved genetic algorithm
