abstract_en: The building earthquake damage assessment model for optimizing BP neural network by improving genetic algorithm comprises the following steps: step 1, collecting building earthquake damage data from historical earthquake cases, wherein the building earthquake damage data comprise main influencing factors and damage levels of building earthquake damage; step 2, carrying out digital quantitative representation on the non-digital building earthquake damage data; step 3, carrying out equalization and normalization treatment on the digitized building earthquake damage data to obtain a sample data set; and 4, constructing a back propagation neural network, optimizing the back propagation neural network through an improved genetic algorithm, and constructing a building earthquake damage assessment model. According to the invention, by adopting a nonlinear self-adaptive cross rate and variation rate adjustment method, training individuals are regenerated, the fixed cross rate and variation rate of the traditional genetic algorithm are improved, the generalization capability of the back propagation neural network model is improved, the obtained model output result has good consistency with the actual result, the accuracy is high, and the rapid and accurate assessment of the building earthquake damage can be realized.
assignees: SICHUAN ZHENZAI RISK CONTROL CENTER

title_en: High earth and rockfill dam shock hazard rapid evaluation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of high earth and rockfill dam vibration damage assessment, in particular to a high earth and rockfill dam vibration damage rapid assessment system which comprises a cloud computing module, a fog computing module and a twin body synchronous rendering module, wherein the cloud computing module is used for acquiring and transmitting data of other servers and preprocessing the acquired data, the fog computing module is connected with the cloud computing module, the data preprocessed by the cloud computing module are analyzed and computed, the computing result is written into a database, and the twin body synchronous rendering module is connected with the fog computing module, and is used for mapping the computing result in the database by utilizing a digital twin technology to obtain a virtual detection model. The dam earthquake damage assessment is carried out by utilizing edge, fog and cloud calculation through an advanced distributed architecture, autonomous and online digital twin of the ultra-high earth-rock dam can be realized, a physical object, a virtual model and a mapping network are combined by utilizing a digital twin technology, and the digital twin of each dam can provide comprehensive and real representation, so that effective monitoring, analysis and decision making processes are realized.

title_en: Flood network flood bank flooding simulation and disaster damage assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood network flood bank flooding simulation and disaster damage assessment method, and belongs to the technical field of flood control and disaster reduction. The method comprises the steps of carrying out hydrodynamic analysis based on hydrologic geographic data to determine a potential overtop area, simulating the evolution of a bursting mouth based on accumulated scouring energy criteria aiming at the potential overtop area to generate a bursting mouth flow process, simulating flood evolution according to the bursting mouth flow process to generate a spatial disaster intensity field, and evaluating direct and indirect economic losses by combining the disaster intensity field and social economic data to generate a comprehensive disaster loss result. The invention introduces physical criteria based on accumulated scouring energy, adopts comprehensive strength indexes, three-dimensional vulnerability curved surfaces and applies graph neural networks to simulate cascade failure, and solves the problems of missing of a breach triggering mechanism, single disaster intensity measurement and static disaster damage assessment.

title_en: Artificial intelligence-based natural disaster damage intelligent assessment method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses an artificial intelligence-based natural disaster damage intelligent assessment method and system, which are characterized by acquiring images and disaster sensitive factors in a restoration period through a satellite remote sensing technology, performing intelligent interpretation of land utilization types, generating a grid layer, simultaneously automatically extracting geological disaster stress factors, innovatively coupling InVEST an ecological environment quality assessment model and an AI disaster damage assessment engine, synchronously calculating an ecological environment quality index and a disaster damage risk index, generating an ecological quality thermodynamic diagram and a disaster sensitive dynamic map, analyzing an ecological quality space pattern evolution rule by adopting a space-time-space diagram convolution network, combining a natural disaster damage degree-disaster resistance correlation matrix to quantify a synergistic effect, and finally realizing multi-dimensional visual deduction of natural disaster damage degree and disaster resistance in a three-dimensional digital twin platform to form an ecological restoration-disaster toughness double-target intelligent assessment loop.
assignees: SICHUAN HUADI CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD;SICHUAN GEOLOGICAL SURVEY RES CENTER

title_en: Transmission tower earthquake damage assessment and emergency response method and system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transmission tower earthquake damage assessment and emergency response method and system with multi-source data fusion, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source data of geological disasters of a transmission tower and preprocessing; establishing a dynamic transmission tower earthquake damage assessment model of multi-mode fusion-digital twin driving, assessing the preprocessed multi-source data, and generating a corresponding emergency response strategy based on an assessment result. According to the method, the multi-source data of the geological disasters of the transmission tower are analyzed and processed by utilizing the dynamic transmission tower earthquake damage assessment model driven by multi-mode fusion-digital twin, so that the current damage can be comprehensively assessed according to the multi-source data, the evolution trend under the aftershock and the secondary disasters can be accurately predicted, and the prospective early warning can be realized.
assignees: CSG EHV TRANS COMPANY BOSE BUREAU

title_en: A kind of wireless cognition network frequency spectrum access method based on two-stage poll
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of wireless cognition network frequency spectrum access method based on two-stage poll, the present invention is using two-stage polling system technology as core, to improve the availability of frequency spectrum, it is starting point to reduce user's frequency spectrum access delay, provide in cognition network after user access authorization frequency range, the preferential multiuser channel sharing policy of authorized user.Roll-call access control mode based on reservation can be prevented effectively from collision, for delay sensitive business in emergency communication, on the premise of authorized user's proper communication is ensured, only to there is the user of business demand to distribute channel, it is that cognitive user and authorized user provide QoS and ensured in terms of propagation delay time, network throughput.And sent using the information of the Method of Scheduling Parallel control cognitive user based on reservation, it can avoid conflicting and improving channel utilization, in addition, the fairness in channel between authorized user's priority and cognitive user can be effectively ensured using two-stage roll-call access control method.

title_en: System for village-oriented disaster response intelligent unmanned information terminal
title_ko: 마을 중심의 재난대응 지능형 무인 정보 단말 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a village-centered disaster response intelligent unmanned information terminal system that enables optimal response within the golden time, such as rapid disaster situation dissemination and distribution of relief supplies, through a village-centered independent disaster response system in a village with low accessibility and insufficient transportation infrastructure, in the event of a disaster. More specifically, the village-centered disaster response intelligent unmanned information terminal system according to the present invention includes a disaster response system server that provides various disaster information, including nuclear power plant accidents and natural disasters, in real time to an unmanned information terminal when a disaster occurs, and an unmanned information terminal that is installed in a public facility including a village hall, a senior center, etc., and receives disaster information from the disaster response system server when a disaster occurs, disseminates the disaster situation, and distributes relief supplies.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 접근성이 낮고 교통 인프라가 부족한 마을에 마을 중심의 독자적인 재난 대응 시스템을 통해 재난 발생 시, 신속한 재난 상황 전파 및 구호 물자 배포 등 골든타임 내 최적의 대응을 가능하게 하는 마을 중심의 재난대응 지능형 무인 정보 단말 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 본 발명에 따른 마을 중심의 재난대응 지능형 무인 정보 단말 시스템은, 재난 발생 시, 실시간으로 원전 사고 및 자연재난 등을 포함하는 다양한 재난정보를 무인정보 단말기로 제공하는 재난대응 시스템 서버 및 마을회관, 경로당 등을 포함하는 공동시설에 설치되어 재난 발생 시, 상기 재난대응 시스템 서버로부터 재난정보를 수신하여 재난 상황을 전파하고, 구호물자를 배포하기 위한 무인정보 단말기를 포함한다.
assignees: T HUB CO LTD

title_en: Risk scheduling method for water resource system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water resource system risk scheduling method which comprises the steps of obtaining regional basic data, constructing a supply and demand pressure field, identifying causal relations, generating heterogeneous computing grids and a space-time causal network, dynamically determining a water-required tail cutting threshold value by adopting a cascade buffer pool mechanism based on historical supply and demand sequence data of the heterogeneous computing grids and influence factors identified by the space-time causal network, outputting a regulated water-required sequence, generating a water scene set by adopting an optimal transmission method of tail conformal by utilizing the regulated water-required sequence, simplifying the water scene set into a representative scene subset, constructing a distributed robust optimization model aiming at the representative scene subset, and generating a water resource scheduling scheme and a risk assessment report by fairness constraint projection and causal path analysis. The invention can finely describe the space-time pressure, adaptively regulate and control the extreme requirements, and generate a scheduling scheme which takes robustness and fairness into consideration under the condition of keeping the tail risk characteristics.

title_en: Power grid emergency material intelligent supply chain dynamic allocation and priority ordering method based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for dynamically adjusting and prioritizing an intelligent supply chain of power grid emergency supplies based on reinforcement learning, which relates to the technical field of power grid emergency management and intelligent supply chains, in particular to a method for dynamically adjusting and prioritizing an intelligent supply chain of power grid emergency supplies based on reinforcement learning, comprising the steps of constructing a digital twin environment model integrating geographic information, real-time traffic, inventory status and fault prediction; defining a reinforcement learning framework, wherein a state space covers stock, in-transit materials, demand urgency and traffic states, an action space comprises material allocation instructions and task priority ordering, a reward function synthesizes shortage relief, delivery timeliness and cost, and a strategy network capable of outputting optimal dynamic allocation strategies is obtained through training an intelligent agent. The invention realizes intelligent dynamic allocation and priority optimization of emergency materials, and effectively improves the emergency response efficiency and resource utilization rate of the power grid.
assignees: MAT BRANCH OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle charges and emergency power source system based on electric automobile charging station
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle charging and emergency power supply system based on an electric vehicle charging station, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle direct current charging nuclear capacity unit, an emergency vehicle alternating current charging unit, an emergency guarantee alternating current output/input unit, an emergency guarantee alternating current output unit and an equipment alternating current input unit, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle direct current charging nuclear capacity unit is connected with a charging/discharging gun and used for charging an unmanned aerial vehicle or inputting electric energy of the unmanned aerial vehicle to the system, and performing active battery capacity verification on an unmanned aerial vehicle battery, the emergency vehicle alternating current charging unit is connected with the charging gun and connected with a quick wiring terminal and used for outputting alternating current or inputting electric energy of an external device to the system, the emergency guarantee alternating current output/input unit is connected with the quick wiring terminal and used for outputting alternating current with various powers, and the equipment alternating current input unit is connected with a charging station alternating current low-voltage system and used for supplying power to the unmanned aerial vehicle direct current charging nuclear capacity unit, the emergency vehicle alternating current charging unit, the emergency guarantee alternating current output/input unit and the emergency guarantee alternating current output unit. The invention can rapidly form an unmanned aerial vehicle charging infrastructure network and an emergency shelter with a reliable emergency power supply by utilizing the existing charging station network.
assignees: GUANGZHOU JINBO NEW ENERGY SERVICES CO LTD

title_en: Automatic cloud-based disaster recovery system including modifying a copy command based on a copy time threshold
abstract_en: Restoration devices in a cloud storage system are paired with source containers associated with a mainframe computer, and series of commands are generated based on the pairings to cause copies of data at the source containers to be stored to the restoration devices. A point-in-time copy of the copy of the data at the source containers may be stored to some restoration devices, and a second copy of the data may be stored to other restoration devices. The restoration devices may be reallocated from inactive source containers. Execution of the commands is monitored, and the commands are modified if the execution of the commands does not satisfy one or more desired conditions. For example, a cycle time associated with copying data to a restoration device may be measured, and if the cycle time exceeds a threshold, the command may be modified.
assignees: VERIZON PATENT & LICENSING INC

title_en: Intelligent video management system
title_ko: 지능형 영상 감시 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An intelligent video management system is provided to increases easily the monitor system by optimizing the operation between the server-client and each application. CONSTITUTION: The management server(210) provides the camera information. The IP camera part(220) generates the event information according to the generated image. The matrix decoding unit(242) decodes the video signal and the event information inputted through a network. The network video recorder part stores the video signal and the event information inputted through a network according to the camera group. The event server(260) informs the alarm situation by analyzing all event information within the administrative area. The workstation(271) controls an operation including the display about the whole camera within the operation group, the image restoration, the various events processing, and etc.
abstract_ko:

title_en: Automatic news text formation method and system based on mobile and web program
title_ko: 모바일과 웹의 연동에 의한 뉴스텍스트 자동생성 방법과 그 장치
abstract_en: Except for values of comments and editions, news, which have been so far written by heads and hands of peoples (reporters) by using information transferred by people as a material, have severe problems such as inaccuracy, slowness, and intentional perversion. Even reporters who handle news say that things written for news values can become news and others do not have values of news. By at least considering that accuracy and rapidness are the lives of accident and disaster reports, the present invention has been devised to direct mechanical news which transfers only facts in a rapid speed. This application of the present invention has been designed to transmit an image at the same time of pressing a shutter by collecting, in real time, data around a site along with position data and visual data needed for news sentences. The data are made to reach a news text automatic generation program mounted to a CMS on a server to be immediately included in a news text. Thus, a picture news can be generated within 5-7 seconds only by a shouter one-touch and a keyword input, and can be transmitted to journalism companies without an edition process. Such a mechanical generation system of news perfectly secures accuracy and rapidness in accident and disaster rapid reports, thereby entirely resolving problems of response time delays caused due to the properties of a report system of an administration organization which have not been resolved for a long time along with unnecessary life and asset damages. Accordingly, the present invention solves problems of all world disaster information reporting problems caused by reporting depending on manpower information network based on AP communications, and is expected to be a leading technology of a global news market which opens a new smart rapid reporting time.
abstract_ko: 이제까지 사람들이 전하는 정보를 재료로 사람(기자)의 머리와 손에 의해 쓰여져 온 뉴스들은 논평적, 편집적 가치를 제외하면 부정확하고, 느리고, 의도적으로 왜곡되어 온 등의 심각한 문제점을 안고 있었다. 심지어 뉴스를 다루는 기자들은 뉴스가치에 대하여 쓰면 뉴스가 되고, 안 쓰면 뉴스가치가 없다라고 말하기까지 한다. 적어도 사건사고, 재난보도에 있어서만큼은 정확성과 신속성이 생명이라는 착안에서 본 발명은 광속으로 팩트만을 전달하는 기계적인 뉴스를 지향하여 창안되었다. 이 어플은 뉴스문장에 필요한 위치 데이터, 시각 데이터, 현장 주변 데이터들을 실시간 수집하여 셔터를 누름과 동시에 영상과 함께 전송하도록 설계되었다. 이 데이터들은 서버 상의 CMS에 장착된 뉴스텍스트 자동생성 프로그램에 도달하여 즉시 뉴스텍스트에 포함됨으로써 셔터 원터치 및 키워드 입력만으로 5~7초 안에 사진뉴스가 만들어지고, 이를 편집과정 없이 각 언론사에 전송한다. 이와 같은 뉴스의 기계적 생산체제는 재난 및 사건사고 속보 보도에서 정확성과 신속성을 완벽하게 수행함으로써 불필요한 인명 및 재산피해와 함께 오랜 기간 고쳐지지 안항 온 행정조직의 보고체계 특성 상 대응시간 지연의 문제를 한꺼번에 해결할 수 있으며, 이는 곧 현재 AP통신을 중심으로 인적 정보 네트워크에 의존하여 전파되고 있는 전 세계 재난정보 전파 보도의 문제점들을 해결하면서 새로운 스마트 속보 보도 시대를 여는 글로벌 뉴스시장의 선도기술이 될 것으로 기대한다.

title_en: SAFETY SYSTEM OF SUBWAY WORKERS USING LOW-POWER LONG RANGE COMMUNICATION LoRa
title_ko: 저전력 장거리 통신 LoRa를 이용한 지하철 근로자 안전 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safety system for subway workers and, more specifically, to a safety system configured to safely evacuate subway workers using a low-power long range communication network (LoRa). In a system capable of preventing any accident from occurring in a subway through a LoRa (10), there is a step of recognizing an RF tag (20) using a smartphone (40) and primarily transmitting the recognized RF tag (20) to an RFID device (30). The smartphone is configured to primarily recognize the RF tag. A situation is transmitted to a central management center (50) and a subway that is in service at the same time when the situation is recognized. When the RF tag is recognized, a screen door is opened. Adversely, when a user is in an inner side of the screen door before the subway starts, the screen door is automatically opened through a system programed in the central management center, and thus, the user can safely evacuate. When the subway arrives at the previous station, the situation is transmitted to the smartphone (40) through the LoRa (10) so that it is possible to propagate the situation to the user. However, in order to prepare a case when a user does not know a notification, the central management center (50) is caused to recognize the situation so that the screen door can be automatically controlled. Therefore, it is possible to prevent any possible accident from occurring in the inner side of the screen door.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지하철 근로자 안전 시스템에 관한 것이다. 더욱 상세하게는 저전력 장거리 통신망 LoRa를 이용하여 지하철 근로자를 안전하게 대피시키는 것에 관한 것이다.LoRa(10)를 통한 지하철 안전 사고 예방이 가능한 시스템에 있어서, 스마트폰(40)으로 RF태그(20)를 인식하여 RFID 장치(30)로 1차 상황 전송이 가능한 단계이다. 스마트폰은 RF태그를 먼저 인식시킨다. 인식과 동시에 중앙관리실(50)에 상황을 전달하며 운행중인 지하철에도 동시에 상황을 전달한다. 이때 RF태그에 인식을 할 경우 스크린도어가 열리나 반대로 지하철이 출발하기 전에 사용자가 스크린도어 안쪽에 있을 경우 중앙관리실에서 프로그램된 시스템을 통해 자동으로 스크린도어가 열림으로써 사용자가 안전하게 대피할 수 있도록 하는 것이다. 상기 LoRa(10)을 통해 지하철이 전역에 도착할 경우 상기 스마트폰(40)으로 상황을 전송하여 사용자에게 상황을 전파가 가능하다. 하지만 사용자가 알림을 모를 경우를 대비하여 동시에 중앙관리실(50)에도 상황을 인지하도록 하여 스크린도어가 자동으로 제어 가능하게 할 수 있는 것을 특징으로 한다 이로 인해 스크린도어 안쪽에서 일어나는 사고를 사전에 방지할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Portable IoT Sensor Kit for Smart Safety with Wireless Mesh and Artificial Intelligence
title_ko: 무선메쉬와 AI를 이용한 휴대가능한 지능형 화재예측 IoT센서 키트
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a configuration of a device and an artificial intelligence program related to a portable intelligent IoT sensor kit for fire prediction using wireless mesh and AI. Since the reliability of sensor data is very important for an IoT smart sensor used in a fire disaster site, it is safe to construct a wireless mesh sensor network with enhanced connectivity between sensor nodes to increase the reliability of sensor data transmission.
abstract_ko:
국가적으로 큰 문제가 되고 있는 공공 및 민간 다중이용시설 (재래시장, 상가/쇼핑몰, 병원/요양원, 위락시설-극장, 실내놀이시설 등)에서의 화재발생과 유독가스 등의 누출시 발생 할 수 있는 대량 인명손실과 천문학적인 사회적 기회비용의 손해가 빈번히 발생하고 있는데, 이러한 화재 및 가스누출사고 발생시 즉각적인 감지하고 징후를 판단하여 화재 확산의 예측이 가능하여 관련자 및 관련기관에 자동적으로 경보하고 전파하여 인명의 조기구조나 재산손실을 미연에 방지하기 위한 골든 타임을 확보 할 수 있도록 도와주는 (1) 경제적으로 보급이 가능하고  (2)구성 및 운용이 쉬우며 (3)휴대 또는 이동 하여 일반 초보자도 간편하게 사용 할 수 있는 화재 및 가스누출 등의 재난 방재와 사회안전 편익에 도움을 주는 “무선메쉬와 AI를 이용한 휴대가능한 지능형 화재예측 IoT센서 키트”에 관한 장치의 구성과  인공지능 프로그램에 관한 것이다 
      화재 재난현장에서 사용되는 사물인터넷(IoT) 스마트 센서는 센서데이터의 신뢰성이 매우 중요하기 때문에 센서데이타의 전송 신뢰도를 향상하기 위하여 센서 노드간에 연결성이 강화된 무선메쉬 센서네트워크를 구성하는 것이 안전하다. 
      아래 대표도 에서 보는 바와 같이, 센서노드는 전원이 인가되는 즉시 인접한 모든 센서노드와 무선메쉬네트워크를 통하여 센서노드 자신의 기기정보와 측정값 등을 모든 센서노드 및 지능형 접속노드에 저전력으로 즉각 전달 가능한 센서네트워크을 구성한다. 
      센서네트워크가 구성되면, 센서노드는 측정한 센서데이터를 종류에 따라서 일정주기 또는 데이터 발생 즉시 다른 센서노드를 통하거나 직접 지능형 접속노드에 전송한다. 
      지능형 접속노드는 센서노드가 전달한 모든 센서데이터를 수신하여 제어부의 데이터베이스에 저장하고 백엔드시스템에 전송한다. 제어부는 데이터베이스에서 센서, 위치 및 노드 정보 데이터를 통하여 화재예측 및 발생 판단을 위한 인공지능 알고리즘을 생성 및 수정한다. 
      지능형 접속노드에서 생성되는 인공지능 알고리즘(216) 및 백엔드시스템에서 생성되는 인공지능 알고리즘은 시간별, 센서별, 종류별 측정 데이터를 기준으로 각 센서의 오차 및 화재 발생 여부를 판단한다. 
     만일 인공지능 알고리즘이 화재 발생 상황이 일어났다고 판단한 경우, 지능형 접속노드(200)는 제어부를 통해 자동경보프로그램에 화재경보를 전달하며 자동경보프로그램은 관리자 등 관련자, 소방서 등 관련부처, 필요한 경우 미리 등록해둔 지자체에 화재 발생 사실과 해당 지능형 접속노드의 실제 위치정보를 전파한다. 
     센서데이타에 의해 화재 감지와 분석, 예측이 가능하기 때문에 센서데이터 오류를 제거하여, 보정하고 정확한 데이터를축적하여, 최적의 예측 알고리즘을 생성하여 활용한다. 
    센서데이타의 유형과 패턴에 따라 보다 정확한 분석을 위해 충분한 데이터를 확보하기 위하여 여 센서노드의 데이터 전송주기와 센서에서 측정되는 센서데이터 수치정보를 증가하여 전송하게하므로서 보다 밀도 있는 시계열 분석이 되도록 하여, 단기간내에 모든 데이터를 수집 분석하여  정확한 시나리오를 예측하고 이에 따른 경보 수준을 판단 한다. 
화재, 가스누출 등의 재난 방재 목적 이외에, 산업현장의 위험작업장, 예를 들면 유해가스 지역의 환경정보 감지 및 알람, 유류저장소, 원전과 같은 방사능 누출 지역, 고로, 사일로 등과 같은 시설파괴시 재해가 예상되는 장소나 기관의 구조물 등에도 간편하게 사용 할 수 있으며, 사회안전을 위한 공공SCO, 예를들면 교량, 도로, SOC구조물 등에서도 사용 할 수 있다.

title_en: System for handling the state of emergency by using mobile phone
title_ko: 스마트폰을 이용한 비상 상황 대처용 경보 및 표시장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smartphone-based alarm and display device for emergency response. According to the present invention, button operation is performed in the event of an emergency related to a woman exposed to a crime from a third party. Then, voice content preset using a user′s smartphone is output and psychological self-control is induced on the third party′s part. As a result, the emergency can be avoided. In addition, it is possible to call for help by audio/video emergency recording and automatic transmission to an emergency contact network. As a result, the danger can be avoided and safety can be ensured. In addition, button operation is performed and an automatic emergency call to a rescue and relief agency such as a fire station and a police station is made in the event of an emergency on the part of a disabled person, a patient, a senior citizen, an ordinary person, and so on, examples of which include heart attack, cerebral hemorrhage, fall, house robbery, taxi robbery, female robbery, and kidnapping. The occurrence of the emergency is disseminated by means of voice output using a smartphone, audio/video recording, alarm, display through a display screen, and so on. As a result, an additional accident is prevented and safety is ensured by help from the outside. According to the present invention, user residential environment improvement can be achieved through visitor conversation and confirmation and doorplate and interior decoration, in-vehicle information such as boarding and unboarding can be disseminated by in-vehicle installation, promotion is possible, safe vehicle driving environment improvement can be achieved for a user through vehicle interior decoration, and profit creation is possible through promotion.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 스마트폰을 이용한 비상 상황 대처용 경보 및 표시장치에 관한 것으로서, 좀더 상세하게는 제3자로 부터 범죄 위험이 있는 여성에게 긴급 상황 발생시 버튼 조작으로 사용자의 스마트폰을 이용해 미리 설정한 음성 내용을 출력하면서 제3자의 심리적 자제력을 유도하므로 비상 상황을 회피하게 함은 물론 비상 상황을 음성 및 영상으로 녹화하고 이를 비상 연락망으로 자동 전송하는 방식에 의해 도움을 요청하면서 위험에서 벗어나 안전을 도모할 수 있도록 하고, 또한, 장애인, 환자, 노인과 같이 거동이 불편한 사람들이나 일반인들에게 심장마비, 뇌출혈, 넘어짐 사고 등으로 발생되는 응급 상황, 주택에 침입한 강도, 택시강도, 부녀자 강도 및 납치사건 등 긴급 상황 발생시 버튼조작으로 119, 112 등의 구조 및 구호기관에 자동 긴급 호출되고, 스마트폰을 이용한 음성출력, 음성 및 영상 녹화, 경보 또는 디스플레이 화면을 통한 표시 작동 등에 의해 비상상황 발생을 전파해 추가 사고를 방지하고 외부의 도움을 받아 안전을 도모하도록 하고, 문패, 인테리어 장식, 방문객 대화 및 확인을 통한 사용자의 주거환경 개선, 차량에 설치되어 승하차 등의 차량내 현황 전파, 홍보, 차량 인테리어를 통한 사용자의 차량 안전운전환경 개선, 홍보기능을 통한 수익이 창출되는데 그 특징이 있다.
assignees: SONG CHEONG HEE;LEE HAE JEONG;JANG YU GYEONG;LEE YUN JI

title_en: Flood control scheduling method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood control scheduling method based on digital twinning, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a digital twinning body of a flood control scheduling system; s2, tracking and updating the digital twin bodies of the flood control dispatching system to acquire the digital twin bodies of the flood control dispatching system in real time and synchronization; s3, a digital twin body of the flood control dispatching system based on real-time synchronization is utilized to develop weather and hydrologic set forecast by utilizing a weather model and a plurality of hydrologic models, the flood control dispatching process of a week in the future of the target reservoir is predicted, analysis and judgment are carried out on flood control situations according to the prediction result, and an adjustment scheme of the current dispatching rule of the reservoir is provided. The advantages are that: the method overcomes the defects that the existing flood control scheduling method cannot comprehensively reflect real-time information of flood control scheduling, the weather hydrologic forecast is short in effective forecast period and low in forecast accuracy, can accurately provide information of a flood control scheduling process, dynamically evaluates flood control risks, and is convenient for smoothly carrying out flood disaster defense work.

title_en: Emergency generator car configuration method and computer network system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of emergency repair of electrical equipment, and discloses an emergency power generation car configuration method, which comprises the following steps: 1. collecting records of multi-source data cases aiming at historical disaster sites, and selecting and determining a power failure emergency repair correlation factor; 2. determining the optimal emergency power generation vehicle configuration strategy for each case; 3. training a power generation vehicle configuration strategy selection model network based on a multilayer back propagation neural network by using sample data; 4. acquiring real-time data of a disaster site; 5. and inputting the multidimensional information data acquired in real time at the power disaster site into the model to obtain the optimal configuration of the emergency power generation car in real time. The invention also provides a computer network system which comprises an emergency power-generating car configuration module and a processing circuit, wherein the emergency power-generating car configuration module is stored with the power failure emergency repair correlation factor, and the processing circuit can call the emergency power-generating car configuration module to execute the emergency power-generating car configuration method. The method and the system can achieve the real-time acquisition of the optimal power generation vehicle configuration strategy, guide the field emergency command decision and improve the emergency repair efficiency.
assignees: DONGGUAN POWER BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Cascade hydropower station long-term optimization scheduling model considering incoming water nonuniformity
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of hydropower dispatching operation, in particular to a cascade hydropower station long-term optimization dispatching model for considering water inflow nonuniformity. The invention aims at the hydropower stations with weak regulating capacity and low water heads in the cascade hydropower stations and the characteristic that the generating capacity of the low water head hydropower station is limited by the warehousing flow, fits the relationship between the warehousing flow and the generating output of each hydropower station and each month, and optimizes the load distribution among the cascade hydropower stations by taking the cascade generating capacity as the maximum target. Compared with the conventional method for carrying out long-term scheduling on the cascade hydropower station only by means of output coefficient calculation, the method can quickly give out a reasonable hydropower scheduling result and meet the requirements of timeliness and practicability of actual operation of the power grid.
assignees: GUANGXI GUIGUAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD HONGSHUIHE JIKONG CENTER;UNIV DALIAN TECH

title_en: Control center dispatch service system using life crisis emergency bell
title_ko: 생명위기비상벨을 이용한 관제센터 출동 서비스 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a control center dispatch service system using a life crisis emergency bell that receives a rescue request signal from a caller terminal for detecting the ringing of the emergency bell, comprising: a database part for storing information on a caller or a recipient corresponding to the caller, information on a rescue request signal of the caller, CCTV information in a predetermined area and emergency dispatcher information; and a server for receiving a rescue request signal from the caller terminal and performing controls so that information including an emergency text, the location of the caller, and the on-site voice recording information of the caller can be transmitted to a predetermined number of recipient terminals corresponding to the caller. According to an embodiment of the present invention, when a woman, an elderly person, a child, and a female single-person household member are in an emergency or fire situation, an emergency bell (200) manually or automatically generates an inaudible frequency signal, and a terminal receives the same to transmit the same to a control center through a mobile communication network, and at the same time, disseminate the same to a plurality of pre-designated people, thereby preventing an emergency situation or rescuing the person.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 비상벨의 울림을 감지하는 발신자 단말기로부터 구조요청신호를 수신하는 생명위기비상벨을 이용한 관제센터 출동 서비스 시스템에 관한 것으로, 발신자 또는 발신자에 대응하는 수신자 정보, 발신자의 구조요청신호 정보, 소정 지역의 CCTV 정보, 긴급출동자 정보를 저장하는 데이터베이스부;  상기 발신자 단말기로부터 구조요청신호를 수신하고, 발신자에 대응하는 소정수의 수신자 단말기로 위급문자, 발신자의 위치 및 발신지의 현장음성 녹음정보를 포함한 정보를 송신하도록 제어하는 서버를 포함한다.  본 발명의 실시예에서는, 여성, 노인, 어린이, 여성1인가구 등의 구성원이 위급, 응급, 화재 상황에 처했을 때, 비상벨(200)이 수동 또는 자동으로 비가청주파수 신호를 발생하고, 단말기가 이를 수신하여 이동통신망을 통하여 관제 센터로 송신함과 동시에 미리 지정된 다수의 사람들에게 전파되도록 하여 위급 상황을 예방 또는 구조할 수 있다.
assignees: KWANG MYUNG SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Distribution line fault feature association method based on information fusion
abstract_en: The application provides a distribution line fault feature association method based on information fusion, which comprises the steps of obtaining wave recording data of a distribution line; extracting mutation information in the wave recording data by a wavelet technology; performing reduction on the mutation quantity information; and inputting the protocol information into a fuzzy Petri network for fault diagnosis. The method has the advantages of high reliability and good fault tolerance, contains time sequence information, provides accurate protection and breaker information for the optimized fault diagnosis model of the main station when the power grid has complex faults, is greatly beneficial to improving the overall diagnosis precision, occupies few bandwidth and other resources, accurately judges the fault position and the fault property, judges the action behavior of line protection, provides a manual fault analysis report for emergency dispatching, and assists a dispatcher to rapidly complete fault processing and avoid occurrence of line cascading faults.
assignees: PUER POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Relay protection method and system for transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of relay protection, in particular to a relay protection method and a relay protection system for a transformer substation, comprising the following steps: and collecting electromagnetic field data of the substation relay, and drawing an electromagnetic field distribution diagram by integrating node connection data of a substation power grid to generate an electromagnetic field data matrix. According to the invention, through numerical solution of an electromagnetic field data matrix and accurate spatial positioning of nodes, an electromagnetic field distribution diagram can be drawn in detail, an in-depth view of interaction between power grid nodes is provided, not only is the accuracy of fault positioning improved, but also the accuracy of fault analysis and simulation is improved through accurate correction of the node positions, the continuity and safety of transformer substation operation are ensured, timeliness and effectiveness of emergency response are further enhanced through on-site testing and sending of early warning signals, a stronger guarantee is provided for preventing large-scale power interruption and equipment damage, and potential service interruption is reduced.
assignees: GUANGDONG KEYUAN ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Power grid flood investigation method and system for analyzing topography surface morphology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid flood investigation method and system for analyzing topography surface morphology, comprising the following steps: collecting geographical information data of a disaster area; judging a disaster-stricken power equipment area, inputting disaster-stricken position monitoring data, and constructing a neural network; measuring and calculating disaster-related positions and inundation degrees of the power equipment areas and damage ranges of the power equipment areas due to disaster; and outputting a survey result of the topography surface morphology, and making a disaster-stricken area restoration power supply strategy. The method for surveying the flood disaster of the power grid for analyzing the topography surface morphology creatively realizes the functions of surveying flood disasters in real time all weather based on meteorological release, hydrologic release, water level monitoring and water level observation data, has excellent timeliness and accuracy in the measuring and calculating result of disaster receiving conditions, and is beneficial to an emergency command center to guide the development of emergency response, load transfer, flood control reinforcement, rush repair electricity, material allocation, customer service, grid planning and the like.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent operation and maintenance method and system for air conditioning system based on Internet of things technology
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent operation and maintenance method and system for an air conditioning system based on the Internet of things technology. And then, performing simulation analysis through a cloud digital twin model to generate performance prediction and fault point evaluation, and evaluating the fault probability by using a Bayesian network algorithm to generate personalized operation and maintenance suggestions. And then, optimizing operation parameters by adopting a genetic algorithm, and smoothly adjusting settings by adopting an adaptive control theory. When an abnormality is detected, the severity of the fault is judged by utilizing a multi-level threshold and fuzzy logic, an early warning mechanism is triggered immediately, and an emergency response scheme is pushed. And finally, recording maintenance process and user feedback, updating the digital twin model, forming a closed-loop operation and maintenance system, and ensuring high-efficiency stable operation and service quality improvement.

title_en: Intelligent emergency disposal method for hydrogen leakage explosion accident of hydrogen adding station
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of safety emergency treatment of a hydrogenation station, and discloses an intelligent emergency treatment method for hydrogen leakage explosion accidents of the hydrogenation station, which is realized by constructing an intelligent emergency response system and combining an accident domino effect network evolution model; the method comprises the following steps of accident evolution analysis, intelligent auxiliary decision making, emergency resource allocation, real-time monitoring and feedback. The intelligent algorithm based on real-time data analysis, simulated evolution and risk assessment automatically generates an optimal emergency treatment strategy, provides decision support for emergency commanders, ensures quick and accurate decision, can accurately extract the risk factor most prone to secondary accidents, avoids emergency response temporarily in the accident process, improves predictability and timeliness of accident control, and reduces personnel, property loss and influence to the greatest extent.
assignees: SHAANXI COAL NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD;SHAANXI COAL INDUSTRY XINNENG HYDROGEN ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: System for monitoring accident through image analysis based on deep learning in ship
title_ko: 딥러닝기반 영상인식을 통한 선박 내 사고 감지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a system for detecting accidents in a vessel based on deep learning-based image recognition, the system comprising: CCTV cameras (110) installed in an engine room, a wheelhouse, a crew room, an air-conditioning room, a pump room, a warehouse, a lounge, a cargo hold, and at a bow and a stern of an upper deck of a vessel, respectively, to capture images and generate image information; a network video recorder (NVR) (120) configured to receive the image information from the CCTV cameras (110) and record the image information in an internal database; an image analysis server (130) configured to analyze the image information through a deep learning-based image analysis algorithm to identify whether a hazardous situation occurs in the vessel and a level of occurrence thereof and to generate hazard information; and a monitoring server (160) configured to monitor the image information in real time, receive the hazard information, transmit a warning broadcast through an onboard broadcasting server (210), and transmit warning information to corresponding smart terminals (150) of a crew, an administrator, and passengers, respectively, wherein the system analyzes CCTV images to detect hazardous situations in the vessel and disseminates the same to the crew and the administrator, and is interworked with firefighting equipment in the vessel to enable initial suppression.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 선박 내 기관실과 조타실과 승조원실과 공조실과 펌프실과 창고와 휴게실과 화물창과 상부데크의 선수 및 선미에 각각 설치되어 영상촬영하여 영상정보를 생성하는 CCTV(110), CCTV(110)로부터 영상정보를 전송받아 내부 데이터베이스에 기록하는 NVR(Network Video Recorder)(120), 딥러닝기반의 영상분석 알고리즘을 통해, 영상정보를 영상분석하여 선박내 위험상황 발생 여부 및 발생 수준을 식별하고 위험정보를 생성하는 영상분석서버(130), 및 영상정보를 실시간 모니터링하며, 위험정보를 전송받아 선내 방송 서버(210)를 통해 경고방송을 전파하고, 선원과 관리자와 승객의 해당 스마트단말기(150)로 경고정보를 각각 전송하는, 모니터링서버(160)를 포함하여, CCTV 영상을 분석하여 선박 내 위험상황을 감지하여 선원 및 관리자에게 전파하도록 하고, 선박 내 소화장비들과 연동하여 초기 진압이 가능하도록 하는, 딥러닝기반 영상인식을 통한 선박 내 사고 감지 시스템을 개시한다.
assignees: ILJIN AND CO LTD

title_en: Emergency plan making method based on industrial park
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency plan making method based on an industrial park, which is characterized in that data acquisition and preprocessing are realized through a distributed sensing network and edge calculation, a park dynamic model is constructed by utilizing multi-source heterogeneous data fusion and a digital twin technology, a risk propagation path is analyzed by combining a graph neural network, and a preliminary emergency suggestion is generated based on a knowledge graph matching historical case. The invention further adopts a resource scheduling optimization and path planning algorithm to formulate a dynamic response scheme, evaluates the effects of different schemes through a situation evolution prediction model, finally generates an optimal emergency treatment scheme and issues a structural instruction. The method realizes the intelligent formulation of the emergency plan of the industrial park, improves the accuracy of risk identification and the timeliness of emergency response, and provides powerful support for park safety management.

title_en: Algorithm model operation monitoring method and system for power industry
abstract_en: The invention provides an algorithm model operation monitoring method and system for the power industry, and relates to the field of model monitoring. The method comprises the steps of collecting physical quantity data of power equipment through a dynamic causal chain construction module, generating a causal chain after noise suppression and preprocessing, binding with algorithm model parameters, recording mutation events and associated parameter update logs, utilizing a four-dimensional space-time lock synchronization module to attach geographic coordinates and time stamps to ensure data space-time consistency, constructing an optimization strategy by a multi-target game strategy engine module based on historical misinformation events and resource consumption records and combining SLA time constraint of a real-time detection task, triggering emergency response by a DEED-Trigger anti-intuitionism triggering module according to deviation between real-time data and the optimization strategy, injecting compound fault test causal chain robustness by a digital twin technology through a verification platform, and dynamically adjusting causal chain structure and strategy.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle emergency control management method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle emergency control management method and system based on digital twinning, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle control. The system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle data acquisition module, a virtual scene construction module, an emergency route analysis module, an execution scheme planning module and an operation visualization module, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle data acquisition module acquires image data in an emergency area and parameter records of unmanned aerial vehicles, the virtual scene construction module builds a virtual scene by utilizing a digital twin technology, maps and divides a three-dimensional grid in real time, the emergency route analysis module plans a feasible route for each unmanned aerial vehicle in the virtual scene and screens out an important route, the execution scheme planning module analyzes each scheme according to the important route planning scheme so as to set a communication scheme, and the operation visualization module monitors each unmanned aerial vehicle to fly according to the communication scheme and displays the virtual scene in real time through a visual page of a command center. According to the invention, through digital twin-driven multisource perception fusion, dynamic grid adaptation and nonlinear anti-interference path planning, the environment modeling precision and the communication link reliability of the unmanned aerial vehicle group in a disaster environment are improved.
assignees: TAIZHOU CHENGFA DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-node real-time cooperative scheduling and emergency response system and scheduling method for supply chain
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of dispatching and emergency response, in particular to a supply chain multi-node real-time collaborative dispatching and emergency response system and a dispatching method, wherein the system comprises a distributed data acquisition module, a control module and a dispatching module, wherein the distributed data acquisition module is used for acquiring inventory data, logistics states and equipment operation parameters of all nodes in real time; the system comprises a digital twin modeling engine, a collaborative decision center, an emergency response trigger, a multi-objective pareto optimization and a multi-objective pareto optimization, wherein the digital twin modeling engine is used for constructing a dynamic virtual mapping model of a supply chain network, the collaborative decision center is used for generating a multi-objective optimization scheduling scheme based on a reinforcement learning algorithm, the emergency response trigger is used for automatically starting a grading emergency plan through abnormal pattern recognition, second-level response is realized through millisecond-level data synchronization and edge calculation, so that decision timeliness is improved, multi-agent game and federal learning are adopted, cross-node collaborative efficiency is improved, and the time-consuming rate of orders and the toughness index of the network are improved on the premise of controllable cost through multi-objective pareto optimization.
assignees: GUANGXI ZHUBO WISDOM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster emergency scheme recommendation method for underground coal mine trackless rubber-tyred vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster emergency scheme recommendation method for a coal mine underground trackless rubber-tyred vehicle, which is characterized in that a digital twin platform is used for acquiring data acquired by a data acquisition module to construct a virtual environment of an operation roadway of the coal mine underground trackless rubber-tyred vehicle, an expert recommendation module is used for manually processing an emergency scheme before the emergency is acquired by an information recording module, recommending the disaster emergency scheme after analysis, inputting the scheme into the digital twin platform for simulation verification, a voice recognition module is used for converting manual voice recognition into a control command which can be recognized by a dynamic command module, and the dynamic command module is used for dynamically controlling the trackless rubber-tyred vehicle according to the control command and the disaster emergency scheme. Through the mutual cooperation of the modules, the trolley rubber-tyred vehicle can be rapidly and effectively processed when an emergency occurs in the operation process of the trolley rubber-tyred vehicle, the operation safety of the trolley rubber-tyred vehicle is ensured, and the working efficiency of the underground trolley rubber-tyred vehicle of a coal mine is finally improved.

title_en: Intelligent comprehensive monitoring and management platform for forest ecosystem
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent comprehensive monitoring and management platform for a forest ecosystem, and belongs to the technical field of ecological system monitoring and management. The intelligent forest ecological system comprehensive management system comprises a multi-source data acquisition subsystem, a data processing and fusion subsystem, an intelligent analysis and prediction subsystem, a decision support subsystem, a comprehensive management subsystem and a comprehensive management subsystem, wherein the multi-source data acquisition subsystem is used for realizing all-round real-time data acquisition of each element of a forest ecological system through an air-space-ground integrated perception network, the data processing and fusion subsystem is used for cleaning, standardizing and evaluating quality of multi-source heterogeneous data, and extracting through space-time alignment and characteristics, the intelligent analysis and prediction subsystem is used for evaluating the health of the ecological system based on a deep learning model and carrying out early warning and prediction on plant diseases and insect pests, fire risks and ecological degradation trends through an intelligent algorithm, the decision support subsystem is used for providing intelligent decision suggestions for resource scheduling optimization, management measure formulation and emergency response, and the comprehensive management subsystem is used for realizing visual display and collaborative management of the forest ecological system through a 3D digital twin and visual display platform and supporting multi-azimuth task scheduling and resource management.
assignees: HENAN ZHONGWEI JIANYE CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent duplicate electricity research and judgment method and system based on operation sensing of metering device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computers, and provides an intelligent duplicate power supply research and judgment method and system based on operation perception of a metering device, wherein the method comprises the steps of matching power failure distribution transformer equipment associated with an emergency repair work order based on the emergency repair work order identifier of the emergency repair work order; the method comprises the steps of carrying out time sequencing on the basis of initial time stamps of operation data recorded by a metering device in power outage distribution transformer equipment to obtain a sequenced time stamp sequence, comparing the earliest time stamp in the sequenced time stamp sequence with power outage starting time of the power outage distribution transformer equipment to obtain a distribution transformer restoration state judgment result, determining whether each power outage distribution transformer equipment associated with a repair work order is powered up or not on the basis of the distribution transformer restoration state judgment result, determining that the repair work order is powered up if the repair work order is powered up, and determining that the repair work order is powered up if the power outage distribution transformer equipment which is not powered up is powered up. The embodiment of the invention improves the sensing speed of the power grid duplicate and the transmission timeliness of the power supply recovery information, and improves the timeliness of power grid power dispatching.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Digital twin monitoring and fault early warning system for hydraulic junction engineering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin monitoring and fault early warning system for hydraulic hub engineering, and relates to the technical field of intelligent water conservancy. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing and storage module, a hydraulic semantic dictionary and a data storage module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring hydraulic data, the data processing and storage module is used for carrying out standardized cleaning on the hydraulic data to obtain standard hydraulic data, the hydraulic semantic dictionary is established, the standard hydraulic data are unified into a hydraulic event label, and the standard hydraulic data are stored according to space-time and service attributes in a separated mode, and full life cycle metadata are recorded. According to the invention, by constructing a virtual complex scene laboratory, an extreme disaster scene which rarely occurs in the history is generated and previewed, the defect of insufficient historical data of the digital twin is fundamentally overcome, the emergency response capability of the hydraulic junction engineering to the extreme disaster scene is enhanced, and the accuracy of the digital twin prediction is improved.
assignees: JIANGSU XIANGTONG CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic lease matching method for electric power construction equipment based on demand prediction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic lease matching method for electric power construction equipment based on demand prediction, and relates to the technical field of electric power construction. According to the power construction equipment dynamic lease matching method based on demand prediction, the fault range is determined based on the power system topological structure, the fault degree is determined according to the fault equipment set and the power fault data set, the lease scheme is preferentially matched with the fault range with the maximum fault degree, faults with more serious influence can be ensured to be preferentially processed, the pertinence and timeliness of fault emergency response are improved, meanwhile, the substitution degree of substitution equipment is obtained through the comparison of the required construction equipment set and the leasable equipment set and the equipment missing, and whether a substitution scheme or a replacement provider is accepted or not is judged by combining the substitution coefficient, the problem of equipment mismatch can be effectively solved, the dynamic landing of the lease scheme is guaranteed, the fault restoration due to equipment problems is avoided, the leased matching efficiency and reliability of the power construction equipment are finally improved, and powerful support is provided for rapid power fault restoration.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Park safety environment-friendly emergency integrated management and control platform
abstract_en: The invention provides a park safety and environmental protection emergency integrated management and control platform, which belongs to the technical field of park safety and environmental protection emergency management and comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a park multidimensional data acquisition network, acquiring safety, environmental protection, equipment operation and personnel flow data in real time, S2, carrying out fusion processing on the acquired data by adopting a dynamic weight self-adaptive algorithm, establishing a safety and environmental protection risk assessment model, S3, constructing a park virtual mapping body based on a digital twin technology, S4, analyzing the fused data by utilizing a deep learning algorithm, predicting potential safety and environmental protection risks and generating early warning information, S5, establishing a hierarchical response mechanism, and S6, tracking the whole emergency treatment process to form closed loop management. The method solves the problems of incomplete data acquisition, unsmooth information sharing, insufficient risk assessment accuracy and timeliness, low emergency response efficiency and lack of closed-loop management and self-adaptive learning mechanisms in the existing park safety and environmental protection emergency management.
assignees: GUANGDONG NANLING DOUBLE CARBON RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Multi-disaster-coupling emergency drilling simulation system and method for chemical industry park
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of chemical emergency management, and discloses a multi-disaster coupling emergency exercise simulation system for a chemical park. The system comprises a digital twin model, a multi-disaster coupling model, a VR/AR interaction device, a data acquisition module, an intelligent evaluation system and a report generation system, wherein the digital twin model is used for constructing a three-dimensional scene of a park through laser scanning and aerial mapping, the multi-disaster coupling model is used for simulating linkage evolution of fire, explosion and toxic gas leakage based on hydrodynamics, combustion and toxicology theory, the VR/AR interaction device is used for providing an immersive exercise environment and supporting fire-fighting equipment operation simulation, the data acquisition module is used for recording action tracks and operation data of participants in real time, and the intelligent evaluation system is used for carrying out quantitative evaluation based on multidimensional indexes and generating the report. The invention realizes the high-simulation multi-disaster coupling scene simulation, reduces the drilling cost by more than 60%, shortens the emergency response time by 40%, improves the operation accuracy by 25%, and remarkably improves the emergency management capability of a chemical industry park.
assignees: JINCHUAN GROUP CO LTD;JINCHUAN GROUP CHEMICAL NEW MAT CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent geological disaster emergency response and decision support system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent geological disaster emergency response and decision support system, and particularly relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and emergency management. The method aims to solve the problems of insufficient multi-source data cooperation, loss of dynamic risk quantification, stiff emergency decision and communication interruption in an extreme environment of the traditional system. The method comprises the steps of constructing a geological deformation dynamic field through a multi-source data fusion module, generating a risk partition based on a machine learning model coupling parameter dynamic range and a disaster chain rule, optimizing a resource scheduling path by combining a self-adaptive decision engine with digital twin deduction, and realizing instruction transmission and situation presentation by means of multi-channel communication and three-dimensional visualization. Finally, a full-flow closed loop control is formed, and the disaster response timeliness, the accuracy and the system toughness are improved.
assignees: LIU WEIYI

title_en: Nuclear accident radiation field feedback correction model based on self-adaptive depth assimilation network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nuclear accident radiation field feedback correction model based on a self-adaptive depth assimilation network, which comprises a data receiving module, an initial radiation field prediction module, an ADAN module, an intelligent optimization and feedback correction module and a real-time updating and visualization display module, wherein the data receiving module, the initial radiation field prediction module, the intelligent optimization and feedback correction module and the real-time updating and visualization display module are all connected with the ADAN module. The model utilizes a self-adaptive depth assimilation network to fuse and feedback and correct the real-time gamma radiation monitoring data and the data of the nuclear accident radiation field prediction model, thereby realizing high-precision dynamic prediction of radiation field distribution. The method comprises the steps of carrying out a depth assimilation process, wherein an adaptive parameter optimization and prediction result feedback correction mechanism is introduced in the depth assimilation process, so that a model can dynamically adjust assimilation network parameters according to real-time monitoring data, and carrying out iterative correction on the prediction result of an initial physical model chain, thereby forming a closed loop updating mechanism of radiation field prediction, assimilation correction and feedback optimization. The method is suitable for the fields of nuclear emergency management, nuclear accident result evaluation, radiation diffusion simulation and the like, and has the remarkable effect of improving the accuracy and timeliness of emergency response.
assignees: CHINA INST FOR RADIATION PROTECTION

title_en: Virtual power plant emergency control method for flexible resources in disaster by considering multi-energy coupling
abstract_en: The emergency control method of the virtual power plant of the flexible resources in the disaster which considers the multi-energy coupling considers the lowest voltage and power fluctuation after the power grid topology reconstruction and the flexible resources aggregation and the optimal overall index of the toughness-oriented scene in the pre-disaster stage, models and evaluates the toughness of the electric-gas multi-energy coupling system after the optimal aggregation of the flexible resources, and then performs emergency control operation on the virtual power plant of the flexible resources by considering the electric-gas coupling cascade fault caused by disaster diffusion. The invention can form a tie line switch action scheme and a flexible resource aggregate forming scheme with compact electrical structure and flexible resource in the pre-disaster stage, and considers the flexible resource virtual power plant emergency scheduling model in the disaster with multi-energy coupling, thereby improving the toughness of the system while reducing the total operation cost.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Ready-package emergency bridge and construction method for changing same into permanent bridge
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ready-package emergency bridge and a construction method for changing the same into a permanent bridge. The ready-package emergency bridge comprises at least two longitudinal beams and bridge road steel plates, wherein the at least two longitudinal beams are parallelly laid; the bridge road steel plates are laid on the longitudinal beams and can limit horizontal and longitudinal freedom degrees; each longitudinal beam comprises longitudinal beam segments which are sequentially fixedly connected along a longitudinal direction; the horizontal longitudinal beams are fixedly connected through horizontal linkage; and the bridge road steel plates are laid on the longitudinal beams in segments along the longitudinal direction. The standard longitudinal beam segments can be combined into the longitudinal beams and the longitudinal beams and the standard bridge road steel plates are combined into a temporary bridge when accidents happen so that the bridge can be fast constructed after the accidents and the traffic of roads are restored within a shorter time to ensure that supplement and supply lifeline can be established in time or normal transportation can be restored after a disaster; in addition, after the emergency temporary bridge is open to traffic, the emergency temporary bridge can be changed into the permanent bridge without maintaining or reconstructing the accident bridge under the condition that the transportation is not obviously influenced, therefore period from the accident to the normal traffic of the road is obviously shortened, and manpower and material resource cost is saved.
assignees: ZHIWEN ZHENG;HAIJUN WU;ZHIXIANG ZHOU

title_en: Optical integration system for disaster emergency proadcasting communivation
title_ko: 재해 비상 방송통신 광통합 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an optical integration system for disaster emergency broadcasting communication, including: sensor units which detect surrounding temperatures and strains and are separately located from each other; a broadcasting communication integration unit for transmitting an integrated broadcasting communication optical signal by multiplexing a received broadcasting signal and a received communication signal as optical signals having different wavelengths; reception units which receive the optical signal transmitted from the broadcasting communication integration unit, demultiplex the received optical signal according to each wavelength, transmit the separated broadcasting signal and the separated communication signal to a corresponding peripheral terminal, and transmit the information detected through the sensor units to the broadcasting communication integration unit; and a management server for determining a disaster state from the information which is detected through the sensor units and is received through the reception units and the broadcasting communication integration unit, and transmitting a processing signal through the broadcasting communication integration unit to the reception units according to the disaster state when determining the disaster state, wherein the management server transmits a signal to each guiding indication lamp connected to the separately arranged reception units on the basis of a location information database in which the location information of the sensor units is stored according to the recognized disaster state, and transmits an emergency guide broadcasting signal to the peripheral terminal, and each reception unit includes a mobile remote management server which further connects wireless sensor nodes so as to perform communication through the restoration of retrievable wired/wireless networks in the disaster state, and transmits the information through the wireless sensor nodes to the reception units by enabling communication with the management server and enabling remote connection with the wireless sensor nodes. The system of the present invention can induce reconstruction of destroyed power and information communication networks as emergency networks, and active evasion from a disaster area using independent emergency power in the disaster state.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재해 비상 방송통신 광통합 시스템에 관한 것으로, 주변의 온도 및 스트레인을 검출하며 분산되어 위치하는 센서부와, 수신된 방송신호와 통신신호를 서로 다른 파장을 갖는 광신호들로 다중화하여 융합된 통신 방송 광신호를 전송하는 방송통신 융합부와, 방송통신 융합부에서 전송된 광신호를 수신하여 파장대별로 역다중화하여 분리된 방송신호와 통신신호를 대응되는 주변 단말기로 전송하고, 센서부에서 검출한 정보를 방송통신 융합부에 전송하는 수신부와, 센서부에서 검출되어 수신부 및 방송통신 융합부를 통해 수신된 정보로부터 재해상황인지를 판단하고, 재해상황으로 판단된 경우 재해상황에 따라 방송통신 융합부를 통해 수신부에 처리신호를 전달하는 관리 서버를 구비하고, 관리 서버는 인지한 재해상황에 따라 상기 센서부에 대한 위치 정보가 저장된 위치 정보 데이터 베이스를 바탕으로 분산 배치된 수신부와 연결된 각 안내 지시등에 신호를 전달하고, 주변 단말기에 비상 안내 방송을 전달하며, 수신부는 재해 시 복구 가능한 유무선 망을 복구하여 통신하기 위해 무선 센서 노드를 더 연결하며, 관리 서버와 교신할 수 있으면서 무선센서노드와 원격으로 접속 가능하도록 구축되어 무선센서노드를 통해 수신부에 정보를 전달하는 이동형 원격 관리서버를 구비한다. 이러한 시스템에 의하면, 재해 시 파괴된 전력 및 정보통신 망을 비상망으로 재구축하고 자체 비상 전원으로 능동적으로 재해 장소를 피할 수 있도록 유도하는 효과가 있다.
assignees: CHOI HYUN BEOM;FON SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Coal mine underground network restoration and reconstruction method based on swarm robot system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine underground network restoration and reconstruction method after a disaster based on a swarm robot system. The coal mine underground network restoration and reconstruction method after the disaster based on the swarm robot system is characterized in that when a mine disaster occurs, a great number of automatically-movable intelligent robots with wireless communication functions are disposed underground, and the swarm of robots are used for searching remaining networks in an underworking and automatically form into columns to form the backbone of an underground communication network to rebuild the underground communication network. The coal mine underground network restoration and reconstruction method after the disaster based on the swarm robot system can assist a surface rescue command center to obtain underground relevant information for providing effective information support for accident rescue.
assignees: UNIV TAIYUAN SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Ground reinforcing structure for stone pagoda cultural heritage
title_ko: 석조문화재의 지반보강구조
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a ground reinforcing structure for stone cultural properties for reinforcing the ground corresponding to the location on which a stone cultural properties are put or increasing the bearing capacity of ground and more specifically, to a ground reinforcing structure for stone cultural properties performing a compaction process on part of a soil layer using an reinforced binder with the more excellent reinforcement force than soil by a ground reinforcement method, which is one of conventional soil grounding methods (plate built soil grounding), for building a foundation while compacting only soil layer upon layer. The present invention can apply the conventional ground reinforcement method and the conventional material as possible when the basement located in the lower part of the stereobate of a stone cultural properties is reconstructed, and can ensure the structural stability and the sufficient bearing power as similar as possible at the time of the stone cultural properties restoration. [Reference numerals] (A) Conventional method; (A-1,A-2,B-1,B-2,C-1,C-2) Sample; (AA) Section; (B) Compacting method; (BB,EE) Soil 10 cm rodding; (C) Reinforcement material; (CC) Soil+deviced stone 15 cm rodding; (DD) Soil+deviced stone 15 cm mechanical compaction; (FF,GG,II) Soil 10 cm mechanical compaction; (HH) Quicklime 10 cm mechanical compaction; (JJ) Inorganic binder 10 cm mechanical compaction
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 석조문화재의 기단이 놓일 위치에 해당하는 지반을 보강하거나 지반의 지지력을 증가시키기 위한 석조문화재의 지반보강구조에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하면, 예부터 알려진 지정(地定) 방법 중에 하나인 단순히 흙만을 달고질 하여 층층히 다지면서 기초를 쌓아올리는 지반보강방법(판축지정)의 흙층의 일부를 흙보다 보강력이 우수한 보강바인더를 이용하여 다짐처리한 석조문화재의 지반보강구조에 관한 것이다.
