assignees: NAT RESERCH INSTITUE OF CULTURAL PROPERTIES

title_en: Electric power supporting method taking adjacent systems into consideration
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric power supporting method taking adjacent systems into consideration, and relates to the field of recovery and control of an electric power system. The method comprises the following steps: a, establishing an object function; b, contracting a node; c, calculating a line betweenness; and d, optimizing and recovering a line. According to the invention, through recovering a generator and a load as much as possible and searching for an optimal power delivery path, the network reconstruction process is accelerated, and the path recovery time is shortened. Besides, path recovery and power support of adjacent electric power systems in the condition of a climate disaster are taken into consideration, and black-start recovery after an electric power system fails completely is safer and more reliable.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCH CONTROL CT OF GUIZHOU GRID CO LTD;UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Storage aggregate restoration
abstract_en: One or more techniques and/or systems are provided for controlling restoration of a storage aggregate. For example, a local storage device, located at a first storage site, and a remote storage device, located at a second storage site, may be assigned to a first storage aggregate. Responsive to a disaster of the first storage site, a gate may be created for the local storage device. The gate may block automated reconstruction and/or automated synchronization that may otherwise occur with respect to the local storage device. Until the local storage device is restored, the remote storage device may be used to service I/O requests that were otherwise directed to the local storage device. Responsive to receiving a user restoration command, the gate may be removed from the local storage device. Synchronization between the local storage device and the remote storage device may then be facilitated.
assignees: NETAPP INC;NETAPP INC

title_en: A kind of non-Muddy Bottoms Tideland resources arbor in river mouth suitable for afforestation disappear unrestrained forest belt structure and build method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of non-Muddy Bottoms Tideland resources arbor in river mouth suitable for afforestation disappear unrestrained forest belt structure and build method, belong to technical field of agricultural cultivation, comprise the following steps：A, artificial ditching, fetch earth and raise ground as pier, B, plantation arbor container seedling, C, mechanical site preparation plant mangrove, D, hand over arbor mangrove growing area is mixed, E, ditch cleaning, foster, promote tree growth and beach alluvial；The present invention makes the arbor species such as horse-tail energy normal growth on non-coastal river mouth Muddy Bottoms Tideland resources wetland suitable for afforestation, and improve shelter-forest survival rate, make to build the unrestrained forest belt that disappears on non-mud wetland suitable for afforestation and succeed implementation, be advantageous to the recovery and reconstruction of the non-mud wetland ecosystem suitable for afforestation, be advantageous to resist the major natural disasters such as coastal area typhoon, Hong Chao, to promoting China's marine economy development ＆ construction to play positive effect.

title_en: A kind of multi-index amalgamation landslide detection method based on high-resolution remote sensing image
abstract_en: The multi-index amalgamation landslide detection method based on high-resolution remote sensing image that the present invention relates to a kind of, comprising the following steps: (1) acquire high-resolution remote sensing image and stereogram；(2) it generates digital elevation model and carries out the calculating of features of terrain index；(3) remote sensing image is pre-processed；(4) remote sensing image image fusion is divided；(5) go out suitable characters of ground object index for different scale layer choosing and obtain their value；(6) by features of terrain index with characters of ground object index fusion treatment and by each characteristic index compared with the rule set of setting, realize landslide detection.Compared with prior art, the invention avoids the excessively scattered brought influence of noises in landslide areas provides support to solve the problems, such as that landslide identification caused by injuring naturally because of earthquake etc. extracts for post-disaster reconstruction reparation；Used characteristic index is able to reflect selected survey region atural object feature, and threshold value corresponding to characteristic index is unique, by the combination of feature and the determination of threshold value, successfully extracts research area landslide.

title_en: A kind of consideration wind pressure relevance and wind speed direction metal Roof disaster caused by a windstorm estimation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of consideration wind pressure relevances and wind speed direction metal Roof disaster caused by a windstorm estimation method, estimate the charming appearance and behaviour loss of metal structure roof boarding.In calculating process, the external wind pressure of roofing is obtained using POD interpolation；Internal pressure is obtained by simulation；Roof boarding connecting elements internal force is calculated using face method is influenced, and corresponding extreme value internal force is acquired by Gumbel conversion；With Monte Carlo simulation, roof boarding failure probability and integral roofing loss late are estimated, wherein connecting elements internal force correlation is considered by Nataf transformation；By the directionality of wind in view of obtaining the integrated charming appearance and behaviour earthquake loss estimation methodology of metal roofing board in charming appearance and behaviour estimated amount of damage.The method of the present invention carries out the reconstruction of roofing external wind pressure by POD method interpolation, to consider existing relevance between wind pressure, influence of the wind load correlation for roof boarding charming appearance and behaviour loss appraisal is quantified, and at the same time considering that wind pressure relevance and wind speed direction carry out charming appearance and behaviour estimated amount of damage to sheet-metal roofing.

title_en: A kind of remote sensing image landslide monomer division methods
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of remote sensing image landslide monomer division methods.This method includes：Based on the multispectral image data and dem data of survey region, carries out landslide extraction and obtain landslide object；NDVI standard deviation threshold methods are set, are merged obtained landslide object using blending algorithm；Making fused landslide object using the common boundary length threshold between landslide, further fusion obtains landslide trunk；And account for landslide perimeter percentage threshold using common boundary and landslide trunk is merged with surrounding landslide object, obtain landslide monomer.The landslide object that extraction obtains can be then divided into landslide monomer one by one by landslide monomer division methods according to the present invention, avoid the occurrence of unreasonable huge landslide areas.Particularly, rapid evaluation can be carried out to a wide range of landslide disaster caused by earthquake or heavy showers, obtains the area and quantity of landslide disaster, reference is provided for emergency management and rescue after calamity and restoration and reconstruction work.

title_en: Remodeling procedure after a kind of natural rubber woods calamity
abstract_en: The invention belongs to natural rubber woods post-disaster reconstruction technical field, remodeling procedure after a kind of natural rubber woods calamity, the integrated treatment measure for taking " support, prevent, controlling " three to combine are disclosed；Water and fertilizer management after " foster " calamity using reinforcement and reduction rubber tapping intensity；It is " anti-" to be rotted using the xylem for preventing bark beetle from causing harm, anti-wound exposes；" controlling " promotes healing using wound is administered；The rubber tree growth not handled after calamity is slower, is remolded after calamity notable to the increment impact effect of rubber tree；Disaster-stricken processing rubber tree restoration ecosystem speed is fast, resists bark beetle infringement, and the wind-fall tree death rate grows rubber tree level close to no calamity naturally.The present invention opens rubber tapping tree fire 3.5 kilograms of 1 annual yield of cave of post-processing；2.7 kilograms not handled after disaster-stricken；It is not disaster-stricken to grow 3.6 kilograms of gum naturally；It can be seen that influence of the calamity post-processing to the resistance of rubber tree, yield effect significant effect.

title_en: Reconstruction of Structural Section Using Waterproofing and Polishing Material of Ceramic Mortar
title_ko: 세라믹 몰탈 방수·방식 재료를 이용한 구조물 단면복구공법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a structure cross section restoration method using a waterproof and anti-corrosive material of ceramic mortar. The method comprises: a step (S10) of performing a penetrative coating on a cracked part of a cross section to be restored by using a hardener including 30-60 parts by weight of S.B.R latex, 20-40 parts by weight of E.V.A adhesive, 5-10 parts by weight of sodium bentonite, 4-8 parts by weight of acrylic adhesive, and 10-20 parts by weight of lactate based on 100 parts by weight of distilled water; a step (S20) of forming a primer layer by coating a cross section to be restored by using the hardener; a step (S30) of forming a restoration layer on the upper part of the primer layer by using a mortar mixture mixed with the hardener and a powder main substance including 80-120 parts by weight of jade powder, 150-250 parts by weight of silica sand, 40-60 parts by weight of silicate powder, 3-10 parts by weight of a vitric material, 1-3 parts by weight of earth, 3-10 parts by weight of methylcellulose, 3-10 parts by weight of microfiber, 5-15 of steel slag, and 0.1-0.5 part by weight of pigment based on 100 parts by weight of Portland cement; and a step (S40) of forming a finishing layer by coating the upper part of the restoration layer with the hardener. The method of the present invention increases durability such as corrosion resistance.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 증류수 100중량부에 대해 S.B.R 라텍스 30 내지 60중량부, E.V.A 접착제 20 내지 40중량부, 소디움벤조나이트 5 내지 10중량부, 아크릴계점착제 4 내지 8중량부, 유산소다 10 내지 20중량부를 포함하는 경화재를 이용하여 복구될 단면의 균열부위에 침투도장을 하는 단계(S10); 상기 경화재를 이용하여 복구될 단면을 도장하여 프라이머층을 형성하는 단계(S20); 포오틀랜드 시멘트 100중량부에 대해 옥 파우더 80 내지 120중량부, 규사 150 내지 250중량부, 규석분 40 내지 60중량부, 유리질 3 내지 10중량부, 회토류 1 내지 3중량부, 메틸셀로우즈 3 내지 10중량부, 마이크로섬유 3 내지 10중량부, 스틸슬래그 5 내지 15중량부, 안료 0.1 내지 0.5중량부를 포함하는 파우더주재와 상기 경화재를 혼합한 혼합몰탈을 이용하여 상기 프라이머층 상부에 복구층을 형성하는 단계(S30); 상기 복구층의 상부에 상기 경화재를 도포하여 마감층을 형성하는 단계(S40);를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 세라믹 몰탈 방수·방식 재료를 이용한 구조물 단면복구공법에 관한 것이다.
assignees: LIM KI CHAI

title_en: Resource allocation and network reconstruction optimization method for improving resilience of elastic power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a resource allocation and network reconstruction optimization method for improving the resilience of an elastic power distribution network, which comprises the steps of inputting the structural parameters of the power distribution network and the original data of loads and photovoltaic dispatching cycles; inputting upper optimization variables: initializing parameters of distributed power supply access position and capacity, tie line connecting node position, population scale and particle swarm with maximum iteration times; inputting a lower-layer optimization variable: initializing parameters of a switching state of a contact switch, an extreme disaster scene, a population scale and iteration times; performing optimal configuration on the elastic resources according to the upper-layer elastic resource optimal configuration model to obtain an optimal configuration result with optimal economy and maximum resilience; and according to the upper-layer optimized configuration result, executing a lower-layer network reconstruction optimization model by utilizing a PSO algorithm, and optimizing the switching state of the lower-layer network reconstruction interconnection switch to obtain a reconstruction result with the maximum resilience. The method and the system improve the restoring force of the elastic power distribution network after the extreme disaster accident, and guide power distribution network planning and operation management departments to carry out scientific planning.

title_en: A system that shares image with location of fire place and position of fire extinguisher when a fire occurs
title_ko: 화재시 발생장소 및 소방기구의 위치 및 영상을 공유하는 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for sharing a position and an image of an occurrence place and a fire extinguisher when a fire occurs capable of quickly taking an initial action against fire occurrence. According to the present invention, the system comprises: a user device held by members in a large-scale industrial facility, operated by execution of user operation of a first finder to propagate fire occurrence situation information when a fire occurs, and enabling each member to share the propagated fire occurrence situation information with each other; and a service control server receiving the fire occurrence situation information of the first finder to provide fire occurrence position information and map information including location information of a fire facility based on location information of the user device of the first finder.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재시 발생장소 및 소방기구의 위치 및 영상을 공유하는 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 화재시 발생장소 및 소방기구의 위치 및 영상을 공유하는 시스템으로서, 대규모 공장이나 여러 개의 구획으로 구성되는 대규모 산업시설에서의 구성원들이 휴대하며, 화재발생 시에 최초 발견자의 사용자 조작 실행에 따라 구동되어 화재발생 상황 정보를 전파하고, 각 구성원들이 전파되는 화재발생 상황 정보를 공유하는 사용자 디바이스; 및 상기 사용자 디바이스와 무선통신 방식으로 연동하며, 최초 발견자의 화재발생 상황 정보를 수신하여 그에 대응하는 화재발생 초기 대응이 가능하도록 화재발생 최초 발견자의 사용자 디바이스의 위치 정보에 기초한 화재발생 위치 정보와 소방시설의 위치 정보가 포함된 맵 정보를 제공하는 서비스 관제서버를 포함하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에서 제안하고 있는 화재시 발생장소 및 소방기구의 위치 및 영상을 공유하는 시스템에 따르면, 대규모 산업시설의 구성원들이 휴대하는 사용자 디바이스를 통해 특정 앱을 실행하는 상태에서, 화재발생을 최초 발견한 구성원이 화재발생 사실을 나머지 구성원들과 공유할 수 있도록 구성함으로써, 대규모 산업시설에서 발생되는 화재발생에 대한 신속한 초기대응이 가능하고, 그에 따른 화재 확산을 막아 2차적인 인명 및 재산 피해가 최소화될 수 있도록 할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명에 따르면, 특정 앱을 실행하는 사용자 디바이스들 간에 화재발생을 전파하여 서로 공유하되, 화재발생을 최초 발견하여 전파한 구성원의 사용자 디바이스의 위치 정보를 기반으로 정확한 화재발생 장소와 근처의 소방시설의 위치를 건물의 도면 맵 정보로 제공하고, 그에 따른 화재발생 초기에 성공적인 화재진압 대처가 가능하도록 할 수 있다. 
뿐만 아니라, 본 발명은, 화재 최초 발견자가 특정 앱의 동영상 촬영 및 음성 기능을 이용하여 특정 앱을 공유하는 구성원들이 화재현장으로 도우러 오면서 현장상황을 정확하게 파악하며 올 수 있도록 초기 화재현장을 지속적으로 전파할 수 있도록 할 수 있다.
assignees: LEE KI BAE

title_en: Communication network restoration and reconstruction and dynamic networking method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of communication network restoration and reconstruction and dynamic networking methods, under disaster environment, quickly networking is carried out using the network of remaining, node searching and registration are completed by way of multi-hop, and according to node demand and monitoring demand, dynamic group net and network slice are carried out, the communication efficiency under emergency communication is further promoted；When the present invention can also change in monitoring demand, the new communication resource is added or section communication node is loss, automatic dynamic networking update and network slice update, in the fast network reconstruction when present invention can be destroyed with application communication network.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Consistency group restoration from a secondary site
abstract_en: Techniques for replay of groups of I/Os for disaster recovery. At a primary site, a plurality of primary site computing entities that are to be restored from the secondary computing site after a disaster recovery event are identified as belonging to an entity group. At the primary site, I/O commands that are performed over any of the entities of the entity group are observed and streamed to the secondary site, where they are persisted into a log. Periodically, the primary site sends the secondary site an I/O map that associates a time with an indication of the last performed I/O commands pertaining to any observed I/O commands that had been performed over any one or more of the computing entities of the entity group. Upon receiving a disaster recovery request, the most recent I/O map and the secondary site log are processed to construct a snapshot for the entity group.
assignees: NUTANIX INC

title_en: A kind of earthquake disaster scene evolutionary model
abstract_en: The invention discloses the restoration and reconstruction stages after a kind of earthquake disaster scene evolutionary model, including earthquake monitoring and forecasting stage, earthquake defence stage, earthquake emergency rescue stage and calamity.The present invention effectively promoted earthquake monitoring and forecasting ability, more targetedly carry out earthquake defense work, more rapidly accurately carry out Disaster Assessment and emergency management and rescue and it is more scientific implement rebuilding in disaster-hit areas, for substantially reducing earthquake disaster bring economic loss and casualties, ensureing that people's production, living safety have important practical significance.
assignees: INST REMOTE SENSING & DIGITAL EARTH CAS

title_en: Urban architecture fire spalling degree Prediction System and application based on Internet of Things and BIM
abstract_en: The present invention relates to urban architecture fire spalling degree Prediction Systems and application based on Internet of Things and BIM.The invention includes: the Visualized Urban Outer Prestress BIM buildings model, embedded-type sensor, the explosion risk analysis model based on BIM technology.Concrete construction model is established by BIM first, assigns construction material attribute information in a model；It is associated with BIM model by the collected temperature and humidity information of the embedded-type sensor being arranged in building, carry out real-time update, storage；By burst risk evaluation model data are extracted and are analyzed, and by analysis result pass back in BIM model, in a model display alarm information and reach explosion required time；Finally it can determine that position occurs for explosion by model orientation.The present invention, which is beneficial in that, to predict the explosion risk of concrete after fire generation, and can estimate the explosion time of concrete, and the position that will be burst is accurately positioned out.Technical support is provided for Post disaster relief feasibility, and provides reference to building post-disaster reconstruction.
assignees: HEBEI BUILDING SCIENCE AND RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: A kind of distribution network restoration power quantitative evaluating method for considering communication and influencing
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of distribution network restoration power quantitative evaluating methods for considering communication and influencing, and obtain the distribution network system running state information in extreme disaster coverage area first；After extreme disaster occurs, according to power distribution network physical state information, communication failure is not considered, consider the optimization aim including breakdown repair after the reconstruct of the rack of power distribution network and calamity, obtain the load variations curve A of regional distribution network；It is next assumed that the recovery of power distribution network cannot be completed according to set objective when communication system failure, distribution network load change curve B is obtained；Finally the influence by communication system under extreme disaster to distribution network restoration power is set to the area surrounded by curve A and curve B.The present invention can more accurately assess the restoring force size of power distribution network under extreme disaster, and quantitative analyze influence of the communication system failure to distribution network restoration power under extreme disaster.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Remote sensing image burned area analysis method combining superpixels and deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a remote sensing image burned area analysis method combining superpixels and deep learning. And classifying the burned areas and the non-burned areas of the new samples by using the trained classifier, and calculating the affected area. The method can quickly and effectively evaluate the disaster area, avoids the defects of large workload, poor timeliness and the like of the traditional manual field measurement method, and plays an important guiding role in recovering and reconstructing work after forest fire disaster.

title_en: The mixed function station design scheme of digital seismograph cross-station and power station
abstract_en: In using wire-link telemetry seismographic oil exploration production, frequent occurrence because cable fracture or individual site disasters, which cause communication disruption, to stop production the case where.Ground observation construction team is huge, and the reparation for falling into a long wait communication network will cause heavy economic losses.The present invention relates to the manufacturing technologies of wire-link telemetry digital seismograph, provide the mixed function station design scheme of a kind of digital seismograph cross-station and power station.The mixed function station that the present invention designs, which can be switched fast, executes cross-station function or power station function, and in field, prospecting network network occurs quickly establish redundant communication links when communication failure, can reconstructing system communication function without waiting for fault restoration.The seismic data being previously interrupted not only can be all recycled, and normal production process can be recovered immediately, realizes the field seismic prospecting production process without downtime.
assignees: NANJING XIANGTONGZHOU NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Production safety accident scene construction and emergency capacity construction system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production safety accident scene construction and emergency capacity construction system, which adopts a technical route of scene analysis, task combing and capacity evaluation, and comprises risk management and emergency work management, wherein the risk management and the emergency work management are carried out in a circulating way, and the emergency work management comprises four processes of emergency preparation, emergency response, restoration reconstruction and prevention and disaster reduction. According to the invention, through research and judgment based on a large number of related typical accident cases at home and abroad, the logic chain and the common law of occurrence and development of related major accidents are researched and mastered, the core elements of the scenes are determined, the risk list and the task combing list are listed, a foundation is laid for construction of the related scenes and improvement of emergency capacity, the typical scenes of the typical cases are constructed through quantitative analysis of accident consequences based on mathematical modeling and computer simulation, the related emergency tasks of key nodes of the scenes are determined, and the practicability of construction of production safety scenes is improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN ZHONGZHIAN CO LTD;HUANENG JILIN POWER GENERATION CO LTD;HUANENG CHONGQING LIANGJIANG GAS TURBINE POWER GENERATION CO LTD;CHANGCHUN THERMAL POWER PLANT OF HUANENG JILIN POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Data disaster recovery reconstruction method, system, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a data disaster recovery reconstruction method, a system, a device and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of disaster recovery reconstruction. When the method is applied to an access platform of a data disaster recovery reconstruction system, the data disaster recovery reconstruction system comprises the following steps: the system comprises a main cluster platform, a standby cluster platform and an access platform. The access platform is respectively in communication connection with the main cluster platform and the standby cluster platform; the access platform receives an access request, wherein the access request comprises: an address of a primary cluster platform; and if the main cluster platform fails, the access platform forwards the access request to the standby cluster platform. By simultaneously establishing the main cluster platform and the standby cluster platform, when the main cluster platform fails, the standby cluster platform can be switched to in time, so that the service data can be restored in time, and the timeliness and the stability of the restoration of the power data system are improved.
assignees: JIANGSU FANGTIAN POWER TECH CO

title_en: Deterioration simulation system for falling zone of reservoir area
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster research, in particular to a reservoir area hydro-fluctuation belt degradation simulation system. The technical scheme simulates the rock mechanical property change of the falling zone rock mass under different water levels, different pressures and different temperature environments, the damage effect of pore water to the rock mass and the deterioration effect of dry-wet circulation to the rock mass, the method is used for improving the ecological restoration capacity and the landscape reconstruction capacity of the bank slope of the reservoir area, reducing the risk of secondary geological disasters in the reservoir area, improving the early warning and forecasting capacity of the geological disasters and guaranteeing the life and property safety of people.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST;CHONGQING INST GEOLOGY & MINERAL RESOURCES

title_en: Adaptive multifocal restoration method based on plankton digital holographic image
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of image processing, and particularly discloses a self-adaptive multifocal restoration method based on plankton digital holographic images, which comprises the steps of firstly shooting a holographic in-situ image, then reconstructing the in-situ image, performing edge detection and threshold segmentation on the reconstructed image to obtain contour information of plankton in the reconstructed image, shearing the reconstructed image data set according to the contour information to obtain a target image data set, generating a definition index based on the gradient and variance of the target image, screening out the clearest target image based on the definition index, splicing the clearest target image to the in-situ image according to the original coordinates, clear images of plankton can be extracted, the problem of huge data processing existing in an acquisition system is effectively solved, the engineering quantity of marine plankton detection is effectively simplified, and further, the change of the number of plankton is effectively monitored, so that disasters such as red tide are forecasted.
assignees: OCEAN UNIV CHINA

title_en: Method for evaluating damage condition of equipment of sewage treatment plant in flood
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evaluation method of damage conditions of equipment of a sewage treatment plant in flood, aiming at the problem that the damage conditions of extremely complicated equipment in the sewage treatment plant after the flood are difficult to accurately and truly evaluate by artificial subjective judgment, according to the principle of easy acquisition and representativeness, the appearance damage grade, the equipment integrity grade, the water inlet damage grade and other damage grades are selected as the evaluation indexes of the damage conditions of the equipment, and an equipment damage evaluation system of the sewage treatment plant after the flood is constructed. And grading the 4 state indexes according to an index evaluation principle, and quantitatively assigning values to the evaluation grades. On the basis, the influence of the equipment short plate problem on the normal operation of the equipment is considered according to the wooden barrel theory, the damaged condition of the equipment is comprehensively and quantitatively evaluated by adopting a mathematical model, and the treatment measures of the damaged equipment are determined according to the evaluation result. The method can reasonably judge the treatment measures of the original equipment, promote the orderly implementation of the project and provide a basis for scientific estimation of the post-disaster restoration and reconstruction project investment.
assignees: SHAANXI INST OF URBAN & RURAL PLANNING AND DESIGN

title_en: Power distribution network post-disaster first-aid repair decision method considering information fusion of traffic network and power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network post-disaster rush-repair decision method considering information fusion of a traffic network and a power distribution network, which is used for establishing a rush-repair strategy optimization model considering traffic network interruption according to acquired non-electric quantity information such as road congestion interruption under typhoon disasters in order to adapt to the change of an external road environment; and finally, coordinating resources such as construction teams, rush-repair materials, emergency mobile power supplies, power distribution network racks, distributed power supplies and the like on the premise of meeting the safe and stable operation constraint of the distribution network, and deciding the material transportation, construction team restoration, mobile power supply scheduling sequence, network rack reconstruction and island division schemes by aiming at minimizing load loss. The invention fully considers the cooperative optimization of fault first-aid repair and load recovery, achieves the aim of minimum economic loss and simplifies the coding of each part of solution.
assignees: UNIV NANJING SCI & TECH

title_en: Two-stage power distribution network post-disaster rush repair scheduling and load recovery collaborative optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-stage power distribution network post-disaster rush repair scheduling and load recovery collaborative optimization method and a two-stage power distribution network post-disaster repair scheduling and load recovery collaborative optimization system, which are used for evaluating the element damage condition of a power distribution system; partitioning the fault points; performing primary recovery by using a distributed power supply, establishing a nonlinear programming model of the primary recovery to obtain a linearized network reconstruction model, and solving to obtain a load recovery result of a first stage without considering a maintenance process as an initial recovery result; and solving a cooperative optimization model of allocation and load recovery of the first-aid repair personnel by taking the maximum load recovery amount and the minimum repair time as targets to obtain a network reconstruction time sequence change process, a first-aid repair personnel advancing line and a load recovery sequence result of a second stage of maintenance scheduling, which are taken into consideration, and taking the results as final results for guiding operating personnel to carry out post-disaster recovery to realize cooperative optimization. The invention improves the recovery capability of the power distribution network after disaster, reduces the downtime and economic loss and enhances the recovery force of the distribution system.
assignees: STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: Power distribution network resilience and reliability assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating the resilience and reliability of a power distribution network, which are used for establishing a reliability model of power distribution system elements and determining the type of the influence of each element fault on each load in the reliability model of the power distribution system elements by using a minimum path method; establishing a fault influence table, simulating the operation of the power distribution system by using a Monte Carlo method, and reconstructing a power distribution system network when a fault occurs; and inquiring the corresponding influence type in the fault influence table, counting the power failure times and the power failure time, and calculating the reliability index according to the power failure times and the power failure time to realize reliability evaluation. The method can recover more loads, reduce the load shedding amount, improve the restoring force of the system after disaster and improve the elasticity of the power system.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Reuse system of diaster stricken surplus soil
abstract_en: To provide a reuse system of a disaster stricken surplus soil in which, in disposal of disaster stricken surplus soil generated in flooding of a river due to sharp increase of a precipitation amount caused by typhoon or heavy rainfall, and government and private sectors exchange opinions and cooperatively implement restoration and reconstruction from a disaster so as to significantly reduce the volume of refuse and to allow only the reduced refuse to be carried out.SOLUTION: A reuse system 1 of a disaster stricken surplus soil removes, by a primary separation undertaker 2 of a public institution, concrete, large stones and the like from disaster stricken surplus soil obtained by digging rivers having been struck by heavy rainfall, so as to reduce volume, then carries out the disaster stricken surplus soil with the volume reduced to a temporary depot 4 of a secondary separation undertaker 3, then, removes drift wood, waste wood, plastic, glass and garbage from the disaster stricken surplus soil at a plant constructed by the secondary separation undertaker 3 of a private entrepreneur, so as to convert the disaster stricken surplus soil into surplus soil for reuse resource, and performs, at the plant, classification and washing to produce reuse products with reduced volume, then carries out the reuse products to a product yard 192 to provide them for reuse.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: FUKOKU PACKAGING MAT CO LTD;TAKANO CONCRETE CO LTD

title_en: Post-disaster recovery method and system for elastic power distribution network based on information physical collaborative optimization
abstract_en: The disclosure belongs to the technical field of elastic lifting of power distribution networks, and provides a post-disaster recovery method and system of an elastic power distribution network based on information physical collaborative optimization, wherein the post-disaster recovery method and system comprises the following steps: acquiring post-disaster physical information of an elastic power distribution network; according to the acquired information and a preset recovery model, post-disaster recovery of the power distribution network is realized; the recovery model comprises a first-stage recovery sub-model and a second-stage recovery sub-model, wherein the first-stage recovery sub-model takes the minimum load loss after the occurrence of faults as an objective function, and takes scheduling path constraint of maintenance personnel, time unified constraint of parallel maintenance personnel and network reconstruction constraint under the influence of information physical coupling as constraint conditions; and the second-stage restoration sub-model takes the minimum time cost of restoring the residual fault element after the load is fully restored as an objective function and takes the scheduling path constraint of maintenance personnel and the time unified constraint of parallel maintenance personnel as constraint conditions.

title_en: Land and ocean temperature restoration method and system and computer equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of meteorological monitoring, and discloses a land and ocean temperature restoration method, a system and computer equipment, which comprise the following steps: reconstructing large-scale surface temperature data by constructing a data restoration model based on MODIS surface temperature data; and analyzing the time-space change characteristics of the surface temperature under different time dimensions from the whole, local and single pixel multiple space dimensions, determining the area of the surface temperature abnormal change, and analyzing the surface temperature time-space change, particularly the driving factors of the annual abnormal change by combining multiple data information of earth surface, atmosphere, ocean and social and economic activities. The method effectively improves the data quality of the MODIS remote sensing surface temperature. The reconstructed monthly remote sensing surface temperature data cover a more complete earth surface area, and the actual application precision of the data reaches 1.5K; the method has important reference significance for restoration and reconstruction of remote sensing surface temperature data, climate change monitoring, meteorological disaster early warning and agricultural production work.
assignees: AGRICULTURAL RESOURCE AND AGRICULTURAL REGIONALIZATION RES INSTITUTE OF CHINESE ACADEMY OF AGRICULTU

title_en: Method for rapidly resisting earthquake and reinforcing pier
abstract_en: A method for rapidly reinforcing a pier against earthquake comprises the step of reinforcing by adopting fiber reinforced epoxy resin concrete, wherein the fiber reinforced epoxy resin concrete is obtained by uniformly stirring a cementing material, a recycled aggregate, natural river sand and fibers, and the reinforcing method is to pour the fiber reinforced epoxy resin concrete on the surface of a damaged pier for reinforcement. The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake resistance and disaster reduction, can ensure that a bridge is quickly repaired after an earthquake and meets the requirement of emergency traffic, and remarkably shortens the time for rescue and restoration reconstruction after the disaster.
assignees: QINGDAO TECHNOLOGY UNIV

title_en: Method for quickly recovering power grid after earthquake disaster under V2G auxiliary support
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for quickly recovering a post-earthquake power grid under V2G auxiliary support, which comprises the following steps: establishing a power distribution network element fault rate model, and generating a power distribution network fault scene under the earthquake disaster through random sampling; based on the travel characteristics of the EV and the travel demand of the user, travel data are fitted by adopting a travel chain theory, and an EV scheduling model in the early stage of the disaster is built on the basis of a power distribution network fault scene; based on a consumer psychology theory, bringing an EV scheduling model in the early stage of a disaster into consideration of post-disaster response selection behaviors of EV users, formulating a post-disaster reverse transmission incentive response mechanism, guiding the EV to participate in power supply recovery, and obtaining the output of each V2G station; considering power distribution network reconstruction and V2G station reverse charging, and establishing a power distribution network reconstruction alternating current optimal power flow model considering two-dimensional cone constraints; and solving the distribution network reconstruction alternating current optimal power flow model to obtain an optimal reconstruction power supply recovery scheme. The invention improves the restoring force of the power grid after earthquake disaster and the economical efficiency of power supply restoration.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Method and device for improving toughness of power distribution network and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power distribution network toughness improvement method, a device and a storage medium based on net rack reconstruction and V2G participation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the damage condition of a traffic system in a disaster scene; determining the travel selection of the electric automobile after the disaster based on a user balance principle and the damage condition of the traffic system; selecting and establishing a charging load distribution model based on the trip of the electric automobile after the disaster; determining an incentive mechanism of V2G users participating in power restoration after disasters based on a consumer psychology theory; determining the maximum V2G reverse transmission power of each charging station based on an excitation mechanism, user response rate, charging station electric vehicle flow, probability distribution of electric vehicle residual capacity and a charging load distribution model; establishing a distribution network toughness improvement model based on net rack reconstruction and V2G reverse power transmission; and determining a power supply recovery scheme based on the power distribution network toughness improvement model. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of real model, improvement of the toughness of the power distribution network, reduction of recovery cost and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Fault recovery method for AC/DC hybrid power distribution network under extreme disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recovery method of an alternating current-direct current hybrid power distribution network under extreme disasters, which is characterized in that a time sequence process considering fault recovery is established by taking the minimum system loss load and the minimum line active power network loss as objective functions, a mobile emergency power supply is rapidly deployed after an accident, a model for collaborative reconstruction of alternating current-direct current parts of the alternating current-direct current hybrid power distribution network is carried out in real time, and a mobile emergency power supply deployment and switching action time sequence scheme which enables the minimum system loss load and the minimum line active power network loss is obtained under given constraint conditions.

title_en: Nuclear disaster-damage resisting coal thermal electric power plant and nuclear disaster-damage resisting coal thermal electric power plant of carbon dioxide gas discharge suppressed type
abstract_en: To provide a coal thermal electric power plant covered with a strong wall, allowing scram of an apparatus by stretching gamma ray detectors on the wall, provided with means allowing restoration and reconstruction in a few days after bombing.SOLUTION: A site boundary of a coal burning thermal electric power plant is enclosed with an impact protection wall, and a lot of gamma ray detectors 1 are installed on a ground surface outside the impact protection wall or on apexes. The gamma ray detectors 1 are connected to motors and fans of a coal conveyor via underground electric cables, and causes scram of the power plant when neighborhood is subjected to nuclear attack. Discharged carbon dioxide gas is removed by a carbon dioxide gas removing preheater. When carbon dioxide gas is sufficiently reduced, steam is said to have higher greenhouse effect than carbon dioxide gas. A coal burning thermal electric power generation technique is secured until then.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2
assignees: SHIRAKAWA TOSHIHISA

title_en: A Evacuation Rooms Of Buildings Safe From Disasters Such As Fire, Earthquake, And Robbery
title_ko: 화재, 지진 시와 강도 침입 등의 재난으로부터 안전한 건축물의 대피 룸
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a room for enabling evacuees to safely escape from disasters such as fire, earthquake, and robbery and, more specifically, to an evacuation room, which has personal equipment for fire evacuation installed therein to have a location signal generation device and an oxygen supply device, has incombustible materials installed on the front of an inner side thereof, and has oxygen bottles, bottled waters, a pressure measuring device for the oxygen bottles, and a charging device for a battery installed therein. If a fire occurs, it is important for evacuees to survive safely. Thus, the Fire Services Act of Korea stipulates that public facilities that can accommodate people and buildings having a size or more enable an emergency escape, and the installation of space for the devices is mandatory. The present invention can provide the evacuation room, which can store the personal equipment required when a fire suddenly occurs in high-rise buildings, apartments, public buildings, hotels, motels, and complex shopping malls in which fires have occurred, can continuously maintain performance, and can enable evacuees to wait for rescue from the outside in a safe place if quick escape is impossible. The evacuation room can enable evacuees to generate the locations by using radio waves, wait for safety personnel while receiving oxygen, preserve life from invasion of robbers, and wait for rescue from the outside, in a special situation in which the evacuees cannot move from a fire site.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지진이나 화재, 강도의 침입 등의 재난으로부터 안전하게 대피하기 위한 룸에 관한 것이며, 보다 상세하게는, 위치신호 발생장치와 산소 공급 장치가 설치된 화재 대피용 개인용구가 설치되고, 내측의 전면이 불연재가 설치되며, 산소통과 생수; 상기 산소통의 압력측정 장치와 배터리의 충전장치 등이 설치된 대피 룸에 관한 것이다. 
이처럼 화재 발생 시 대피 자는 안전하게 생존하는 것이 중요하기 때문에 우리나라의 소방법 상에 사람을 수용할 수 있는 공공시설은 물론, 일정 크기 이상의 건물에는 비상 탈출을 할 수 있고, 그 장치의 공간 설치가 의무화 되어 있다. 
화재가 발생한 고층건물, 아파트, 공공건물과 호텔, 모텔, 복잡한 상가 등에서 갑작스런 화재발생시 필요한 개인용구를 보관하고, 성능을 지속적으로 유지하며, 신속한 탈출이 불가능할 경우, 안전한 곳에서 외부로 구조를 기다릴 안전한 대피 룸을 제공하며, 화재현장에서 이동할 수 없는 특수 상황에서 자신의 위치를 전파로 발생시키며, 산소를 공급받으면서 안전요원들을 기다리는 한편, 강도의 침입으로부터 생명을 보존하며, 외부로부터 구조를 기다릴 수 있는 안전 룸을 제공하는 데 있다.
assignees: EOM JAE PUNG;EOM YONG HO

title_en: Power system network reconstruction method based on comprehensive evaluation index
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system network reconstruction method based on comprehensive evaluation indexes, which comprises the steps of reducing the load flow threshold crossing according to a load flow threshold crossing circuit and a network adjustment strategy, and searching to obtain an alternative path; determining a grid-connected loop closing circuit according to the alternative path, performing load recovery strategy control weakening a closing angle according to the alternative path and a phase angle of the grid-connected loop closing circuit, and determining a circuit recovery sequence in the alternative path; calculating a first evaluation index comprising a line operation reliability, a load flow out-of-limit reduction degree and a closing phase angle difference reduction degree according to a line recovery sequence, constructing a comprehensive evaluation index of an alternative path, and determining an optimal closed-loop path according to the comprehensive evaluation index and the alternative path; and according to the optimal closed-loop path, carrying out network recovery on the power system, and realizing network reconstruction of the power system. According to the embodiment, the network architecture of the power system is optimized, the power recovery strategy is improved, and the transient steady-state operation stability of the power system after disaster is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: A Safe Room With Steam Room And Stress Relief Function
title_ko: 찜질방과 스트레스해소 기능을 설치한 세이프 룸
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safe room for safe evacuation from disasters such as earthquakes, fires, and invasion of burglars and, more specifically, to a safe room with stress relief functions such as a steam room and a karaoke room, in which incombustible materials are installed on a front side of the inside of the safe room, and oxygen cylinders and water bottles are installed and a pressure measuring device for the oxygen cylinders and a charging device for batteries are installed. In the event of a fire, it is important for evacuees to survive safely. According to Korea fire law, emergency escapes are allowed in public facilities capable of accommodating people and in buildings having a certain size or more, and installation of space for devices is mandatory. Thus, a safe room to evacuate in the event of a disaster and a safe room used for various purposes in normal times are required. The purpose of the present invention is to provide a safe room, which is used, in a daily life, for purposes such as steam rooms, karaoke rooms, and disease prevention rooms, and evacuees wait for rescue from the outside when the evacuees cannot quickly escape in the event of an earthquake or disaster and to provide a safe room, which evacuees can notify of a location thereof using radio waves in special situations where the evacuees cannot move from a fire scene, can wait for safety guards while receiving oxygen, can preserve life from invasion of robbers, and can wait for rescue from the outside.

본 발명의 목적은 일상에는 찜질방 또는 노래방, 질병 예방 실 등의 목적으로 활용하다가 지진 또는 재난 시신속한 탈출이 불가능할 경우, 안전한 곳에서 외부로 구조를 기다릴 안전한 세이프 룸을 제공하며, 화재현장에서 이동할 수 없는 특수 상황에서 자신의 위치를 전파로 발생시키며, 산소를 공급받으면서 안전요원들을 기다리는 한편, 강도의 침입으로부터 생명을 보존하며, 외부로부터 구조를 기다릴 수 있는 세이프 룸을 제공하는 데 있다.
assignees: EOM JAE PUNG;EOM YONG HO

title_en: A Safe Room Equipped With Virus Sterilization Air Shower And Indoor Air Purification Using Ion Wind
title_ko: 바이러스 살균 에어샤워장치와 이온 풍을 이용한 실내공기 정화장치 기능이 설치된 세이프 룸
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safe room for safely escaping from a disaster such as earthquake, fire, a raid, and the like and, more specifically, to a safe room, which has an inside front surface with non-combustible materials, has an oxygen tank, water, a pressure measurement device of the oxygen tank, a battery charging device, and the like, and is equipped with a virus sterilization air shower room and a household indoor virus sterilization and purification function. Since it is important for evacuees to survive safely in case of a fire, it is required to not only have a public facility that can accommodate people under the Korean Fire Protection Act but also have a multi-purpose safe room that can enable an emergency escape, serve as a safe room in case of a disaster, and be used for other purposes at ordinary times. An objective of the present invention is to provide a safe room serving as a safe place for waiting for rescue from the outside when quick escape is not possible in case of a disaster such as an earthquake while being used, at ordinary times, as a room for removing viruses contaminated when going out and being used as a virus sterilization air purifier of a household. Accordingly, the present invention can generate radio waves to enable a person to inform a position of the person in a specific situation where the person cannot move in a fire, wait for rescue workers while receiving oxygen, protect the life from a raid, and wait for rescue from the outside.

title_en: Post-disaster collaborative scheduling method and system for power distribution network based on rush-repair and network reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention provides a post-disaster collaborative scheduling method and system for a power distribution network based on rush-repair and network reconstruction, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring power distribution network information and fault line information; based on the power distribution network information and the fault line information, constructing a power distribution network fault recovery model which aims at minimizing the loss load and meets the emergency repair scheduling constraint, the fault point repair time constraint and the power distribution network constraint; and solving the power distribution network fault recovery model, obtaining a rush-repair scheduling result and a dynamic network reconstruction result, and carrying out cooperative scheduling on the power distribution network. The post-disaster collaborative scheduling method for the power distribution network provided by the invention can reduce the load loss as much as possible while meeting the requirements of rush-repair scheduling constraint, fault point repair time constraint and power distribution network constraint; the construction of the power distribution network fault recovery model synchronously considers the rush-repair work and the network reconstruction process, so that the network reconstruction process can dynamically update along with the fault rush-repair progress, the load loss is effectively reduced, and the recovery efficiency after disaster is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Urban water supply pipe network water quality risk and water supply reliability calculation method considering post-earthquake negative pressure effect
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for calculating water quality risk and water supply reliability of a city water supply network by considering post-earthquake negative pressure effect, and belongs to the field of post-disaster water quality safety evaluation of the city water supply network. The invention comprises the following steps: calculating the area of a pipeline leakage opening under the daily operation situation; generating a seismic damage scene of pipelines in a pipe network under the action of the earthquake by Monte Carlo simulation sampling; determining the situation that the pollutants invade a pipe network after the earthquake; establishing a pipe network model of a pollutant invasion scene; calculating the average water quality risk of the nodes; calculating the reliability of the water supply of the pipe network; calculating the average risk mean value of the node average water quality; and (5) calculating the reliability mean value of the pipe network. The method is based on the urban water supply pipe network negative pressure scene under the earthquake damage effect, calculates the pipe network water quality risk and the water supply reliability through the pollution invasion scene, and has great significance for guiding post-earthquake water quality early warning and coping strategies of the urban water supply pipe network, anti-earthquake upgrading and reconstruction of the pipe network and emergency repair measures after the earthquake.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Ecological restoration system and restoration method for erosion coastal zone
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological restoration system for an erosion coastal zone, which comprises: constructing a bank-connecting biological reef structure at the bank-connecting position of the coastal zone; a low beach biological reef structure which is constructed in a low beach area of the coastal zone and is positioned behind the shore-receiving biological reef structure; a first restored native vegetation planted in a beach area of the coastal zone and located behind the beach biological reef structure; a second remedial rural vegetation planted in a first half of the high beach area of the coastal zone; a plurality of tidal ditches are constructed in the front half section part of the middle and high beach area of the coastal zone at intervals along the direction vertical to the coastline; constructing a tidal pool in the latter half section of the mid-beach area of the coastal zone; and the ecological reconstruction slope protection is constructed on the sea wall slope protection. Also discloses a method for repairing the ecological repair system of the erosion coastal zone. The invention has the advantages of obvious treatment effect, obvious ecological support effect, outstanding disaster reduction effect and the like.
assignees: SHANGHAI WATER ENG DESIGN & RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Method for treating mining subsidence land of shallow-buried coal seam in channel region
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for treating a mining subsidence land of a shallow coal seam in a channel region, which comprises the following steps of dividing treatment strips; step two, mining subsidence land zonal treatment: the method comprises the steps of sequentially treating a plurality of treatment strips in a downstream-to-upstream sequence, firstly stripping and digging a subsidence land treatment area, and then filling a bottom water-resisting layer, a bottom water-bearing layer, a bottom soil layer, a top water-resisting layer, a water storage type core soil layer and a surface soil layer from bottom to top sequentially, and simultaneously setting a impervious wall and a drainage ditch. According to the invention, residual coal is recovered through stripping and digging type treatment, the spontaneous combustion hidden danger is removed, layered backfilling is carried out, the hidden danger of roof collapse is eliminated, a sponge stratum structure suitable for ecological restoration is reconstructed, water can be stored, permeated and purified during raining, the stored water is released and utilized during drought, the ecological restoration effect of a subsidence area and the capability of coping with natural disasters are improved, and the social and ecological benefits of a treatment area are improved.
assignees: UNIV XIAN SCI & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Ecological restoration system for erosion coastal zone
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an erosion coastal zone ecological remediation system, include: constructing a bank-connecting biological reef structure at the bank-connecting position of the coastal zone; a low beach biological reef structure which is built in a low beach area of the coastal zone and is positioned behind the bank-connecting biological reef structure; a first remedial local vegetation planted in a beach area of the coastal zone and located behind the beach biological reef structure; a second remedial earth vegetation planted in a first half portion of a mid-beach area of the coastal zone; a plurality of tidal ditches are constructed in the front half section part of the middle and high beach area of the coastal zone at intervals along the direction vertical to the coastline; constructing a tidal pool in the latter half section of the mid-beach area of the coastal zone; and the ecological reconstruction slope protection is constructed on the sea wall slope protection. The utility model has the advantages of obvious treatment effect, obvious ecological support effect, outstanding disaster reduction effect and the like.

title_en: Power distribution network and traffic network collaborative first-aid repair optimization method considering extreme disaster influence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network and traffic network collaborative first-aid repair optimization method considering extreme disaster influence, which comprises the following steps: collecting information of a power distribution network and a traffic network after the influence of extreme disasters; establishing a model for recovering maximization of a power distribution network and a traffic network; modeling the recovery process of the power grid and the traffic grid; adding a virtual node and rebuilding a network; carrying out power flow constraint on the reconstructed network, and finally obtaining a power distribution network and traffic network cooperative first-aid repair optimization method by using an objective function of a maximized model; the invention provides an optimization method for cooperative first-aid repair of a power distribution network and a traffic network, wherein the repair of the power distribution network and the repair of the traffic network are performed in a cooperative manner; and converting the problem into a mixed integer linear programming model by taking the restoration resources and the working personnel of the power distribution network and the restoration resources and the construction personnel of the traffic network as optimization variables. After the restoration time is appointed, a corresponding restoration strategy can be obtained by the constraint condition and the objective function, and the power distribution network and the traffic network are restored as much as possible.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: Large-scale urban power grid anti-vulnerability capacity lifting planning method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for improving and planning the anti-fragile capacity of a large-scale urban power grid, which comprises the following steps: s1, generating a fault scene based on Monte Carlo simulation; s2, screening representative extreme scenes based on k-means cluster analysis; s3, establishing an urban power grid planning optimization model oriented to limit viability improvement; s4, after the model is solved, the corresponding power supply configuration condition under the line reinforcement scheme is obtained. The distributed power supply is deployed in the planning stage, the important power transmission paths are reinforced/upgraded, and island operation of the power distribution network is guaranteed to be realized through topology reconstruction under the limit natural disasters, so that uninterrupted power supply of more important loads is guaranteed.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG

title_en: Surface soil reconstruction material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of ecological restoration, and discloses a surface soil reconstruction material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the surface soil reconstruction material comprises 30-70% of clay and 30-70% of sandy soil according to weight percentage; wherein, the clay contains clay particles of 85-90 wt% and the sand contains clay particles of 15 wt% or less. By adding sand into the surface soil reconstruction material, the pores and the permeability of the surface soil reconstruction material can be increased; and then when the surface soil reconstruction material is used for repairing the surface coverage, rainwater can infiltrate down at the time to form surface runoff, so that surface soil erosion and flood disasters can be avoided.
assignees: GUONENG LANGXINMING ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban street tree disaster-bearing capacity simulation method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twinning and artificial intelligence, in particular to a digital twinning-based urban street tree disaster-bearing capacity simulation method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring image data by adopting an unmanned aerial vehicle through oblique photography, and carrying out three-dimensional reconstruction on the whole scene of the region according to the acquired image data and position information; making a traffic photogrammetry route plan according to the distribution and the characteristics of the pavement tree; based on route planning, a data acquisition system is built through an unmanned aerial vehicle, and point cloud data and multispectral data of an uplink road tree of a route are acquired; taking data obtained by oblique photogrammetry as a digital twin base to construct a pavement tree fine model; simulating the influence on the pavement tree in the urban wind field by using fluid mechanics simulation according to the historical characteristic wind field grid data; and obtaining a disaster bearing capacity evaluation result and a distribution map of the street tree according to the simulation analysis. Compared with the existing artificial wind method, the method provided by the invention has the advantages that the application scene is more abundant and the area is larger.
assignees: URBAN PLANNING & DESIGN INST CO LTD OF SHENZHEN

title_en: Sparse data-oriented meteorological missing information fusion filling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sparse data-oriented meteorological missing information fusion filling method, which relates to the technical field of meteorological detection and comprises the following steps: the system comprises a data source unit, a data preprocessing unit, a missing data detection unit, a missing data filling unit, a data reconstruction unit, a data fusion enhancement unit and a data evaluation unit; missing data shim cell, specifically for: the global information is fully mined, the local detail information is complemented, and the integrity of meteorological observation data is improved; the data reconstruction unit is specifically used for reconstructing fine scale details in the high-resolution image, complementing the space and time relevance, effectively solving the defect of insufficient details of the large-magnification image and improving the space-time resolution of the meteorological satellite image; the data fusion enhancement unit is specifically used for: and the accuracy and the reliability of the filled data are improved. By the structure, the invention solves the actual difficulties of difficult acquisition of the observed data, sparse observation stations, aging hysteresis and the like in the current prediction service of specific areas at home and abroad, meets the requirements of the meteorological service on the quality of the data, and promotes the high-quality development of modern meteorological enterprises such as smart weather monitoring, prediction early warning, disaster prevention and reduction and the like by high-precision meteorological element data.
assignees: UNIV CHENGDU INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY;NO 10 INST OF CETC

title_en: Digital twinning-based disaster analysis method and system for multi-scale water supply system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a digital twinning-based disaster analysis method and system for a multi-scale water supply system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: based on the multi-scale relation and layout of the water supply system plant stations and the pipe network in the physical space, sequentially establishing BIM information models of all levels of structures of the water supply system; the BIM information model is imported into FEM software, a mechanical response numerical analysis model is built according to the boundary and constraint conditions of each level of structures, and stress and deformation responses of each level of structures of a plant station and a pipe network of the water supply system under the action of earthquake are calculated; and extracting a calculation result of the numerical analysis model, decoding and converting the calculation result, and importing the calculation result after decoding and converting into the BIM information model for reconstruction to generate a cloud image of the earthquake motion response of the BIM information model. The invention realizes the digital conversion from the BIM model to the disaster scene analysis twin model in the operation and maintenance process, and provides a high-efficiency mapping and global visual display method for the earthquake response of a water supply system.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-based three-dimensional map construction method for natural disaster areas
abstract_en: The invention relates to a three-dimensional map construction method of a natural disaster area based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, and belongs to the technical field of natural disaster emergency rescue. The unmanned aerial vehicle flies above the disaster area according to a preset track; estimating the internal and external parameters of the camera and sparse point clouds by adopting an incremental motion restoration structure method; calculating a direct depth map and reconstructing a dense point cloud based on PATCHMATCH method; and carrying out GPS information attachment on the dense point cloud to obtain the dense point cloud with GPS information. The method is used for generating the disaster area three-dimensional map with the GPS information after the natural disaster occurs. The verification experiment is carried out on a plurality of groups of open source high-altitude data, and the method has the characteristics of strong robustness and high reliability under the scene; the dense point cloud provided by the invention has GPS information, provides the direction and navigation of geographic information for disaster-fighting teams, and has stronger practicability and functionality.
assignees: BEIJING INSTITUTE TECH

title_en: Post-disaster power distribution network power supply recovery method based on expert demonstration guidance reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster power distribution network power restoration method based on expert demonstration guidance reinforcement learning, which comprises the steps of firstly, constructing an expert demonstration data set, establishing a multiple priority experience playback pool, including expert demonstration, normal operation and constraint violation experience playback pool, extracting experiences in batches from the expert demonstration experience playback pool, pre-training a reinforcement learning model, constructing and integrating an invalid action shielding module after the pre-training is completed, shielding invalid operation, then simulating operation in a large number of fault scenes, respectively storing the normal operation and constraint violation experience into the corresponding playback pool, extracting experiences in proportion for priority playback, training the model, and finally, recursively solving in a real-time fault scene by utilizing the trained model, and outputting an approximate optimal decision of post-disaster power restoration. The invention obviously improves the accuracy and efficiency of power supply recovery of the post-disaster power distribution network, and solves the problems of high calculation complexity and poor real-time performance in the prior art.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: Two-stage elastic recovery method, system, equipment and storage medium for power distribution system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-stage elastic recovery method, a system, equipment and a storage medium of a power distribution system, which comprise the following steps of S1, calculating the minimum repair time of a fault through a route and schedule model of a maintainer based on post-disaster data, S2, setting the recovery duration based on the minimum repair time, minimizing the load shedding in the recovery duration based on an optimal power distribution system recovery model, and outputting to obtain an optimal recovery strategy. A balance is struck between recovery duration and load shedding, an appropriate fault recovery duration is determined, and partitioning and fusion of the microgrid are considered, in comparison with existing dynamic network reconstructed recovery models. Finally, when a disaster occurs, the provided model can comprehensively consider the shortest restoration time and the tolerance of a decision maker, comprehensively consider the fusion between island micro-grids and the self-splitting of the micro-grids, and restore as much load as possible within one restoration duration time, thereby greatly improving the restoration capacity of the power distribution system.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: Power distribution system recovery method and device under rainstorm waterlogging disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power distribution network fault handling and reliability research, in particular to a power distribution system recovery method and device under a storm waterlogging disaster, comprising the steps of generating a typical scene during the storm waterlogging disaster by adopting a Monte Carlo method based on a power distribution network equipment failure probability function during the occurrence of the storm waterlogging disaster; the method comprises the steps of solving a power distribution network reconstruction optimization model under a typical scene of a storm waterlogging disaster occurrence period to obtain a switch optimization result of the storm waterlogging disaster occurrence period, carrying out power distribution network reconstruction by utilizing the switch optimization result, solving a power distribution network fault recovery model after the storm waterlogging disaster is over to obtain a mobile emergency energy storage device dispatching result, carrying out power distribution network restoration after the storm waterlogging disaster by utilizing the mobile emergency energy storage device dispatching result, and obviously improving the recovery capability of a system, and particularly showing unique advantages in a complex scene of serious traffic disaster.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Roadbed slope digital twin model construction method based on multi-mesh array visual perception and computer system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a roadbed slope digital twin model construction method based on multi-mesh array visual perception, which comprises the steps of manufacturing a preliminary digital twin model by combining a slope design drawing and construction planning, setting cameras of different types and numbers according to construction site conditions to form a multi-mesh visual perception array, correcting, enhancing and denoising the picture of the change condition in the construction process, extracting key construction characteristics, using a deep learning algorithm, updating and refining the roadbed slope digital twin model by using a three-dimensional reconstruction technology, updating the digital twin model in real time, carrying out structural analysis and dynamic simulation on the digital twin model, evaluating risks possibly occurring in different construction stages, and combining risk identification to formulate an emergency response strategy and preventive measures. The invention has the advantages of high efficiency, real-time and accurate monitoring of the change in the slope construction process, and powerful support for monitoring the construction process, guaranteeing the quality and predicting the risk.
assignees: UNIV TONGJI

title_en: Urban illumination control integration gateway system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban illumination control, and provides an urban illumination control fusion gateway system which comprises a multi-mode sensing network module, a causal reasoning diagnosis module, a survivability topology reconstruction module, a physiological adaptation dimming module and a disaster chain blocking module. The multi-mode sensing network module collects structural displacement, environmental data and weather forecast of the lighting facility through the unmanned plane, the ground nodes and the weather radar. The causal reasoning diagnosis module analyzes the aging reasons of the facilities through causal graph modeling. The survivability topology reconstruction module optimizes the power supply network topology. The physiological adaptive dimming module generates a color temperature-brightness parameter according to the people stream and the atmospheric optical characteristics. The disaster chain blocking module identifies disaster propagation nodes and triggers reinforcement instructions. The invention can improve the reliability, energy conservation and safety of the lighting system and optimize the comfort and emergency response capability of urban environment.
assignees: ZHANGZHOU ELECTRONIC INFORMATION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Forest fire monitoring system based on satellite remote sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest fire monitoring system based on satellite remote sensing, in particular to the field of forest fire monitoring, which is used for solving the problems of incomplete data coverage, inaccurate boundary identification, difficult restoration of a shielding area and the like in the forest fire monitoring process. The spectrum and vegetation dynamic change before and after the fire are continuously tracked, and continuous basic data is provided for evaluating the fire influence. The analysis of spectrum extremely poor and thermal signal propagation is combined, so that the fine recognition capability of a fire disaster high-temperature area and an edge area is enhanced, and particularly, the boundary recognition of a low disturbance area is effectively optimized. The space-time reconstruction and interpolation algorithm is adopted to comprehensively recover the data loss caused by the shielding of smoke and cloud, so that the integrity and continuity of the image are ensured, and the precision of disaster assessment and decision support is improved.
assignees: LINGBAO HUAXIANG WIND POWER DEV CO LTD;HENAN BRANCH OF CHINA THREE GORGES RENEWABLES GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Assimilation method for improving analysis precision of warm salt based on submarine pressure data
abstract_en: A method for improving the analysis precision of warm salt based on the data of the pressure of the sea bottom includes such steps as obtaining the observation data including the temp, salinity, sea surface temp, sea surface salinity and pressure of the sea bottom, increasing the altitude of sea surface, building the objective function of the space-time four-dimensional multi-scale data assimilation frame, setting the dynamic constraint condition of the space-time four-dimensional multi-scale data assimilation frame, inputting the prepared observation data, and assimilating the combined data to reconstruct the analysis field of warm salt. The invention can enhance the vertical structural precision of the thermal salt field, improve the data quality and reliability, and improve the overall precision of ocean state analysis, thereby improving the prediction precision of ocean disasters and improving the prediction and early warning of the ocean disasters.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: Real projective image generating method, storage medium and device based on three-dimensional Gaussian model
