abstract_en: The invention relates to a real projection image generation method, a storage medium and a device based on a three-dimensional Gaussian model, and aims to solve the problems of low image quality, low generation speed, detail loss and the like in the prior art. The method comprises the following steps of firstly obtaining image data through unmanned aerial vehicle or aerial photography, extracting camera gestures and sparse point clouds by utilizing a motion restoration structure (SfM) technology, constructing a three-dimensional Gaussian model based on the sparse point clouds, and carrying out iterative training through top-view orthographic projection combined gradient descent algorithm. In the training process, a densification strategy, a point deleting strategy, a blocking strategy and an image pyramid strategy are innovatively introduced, so that the image detail expressive force and the overall quality are remarkably improved. Specifically, the densification strategy realizes fine detail reconstruction by dynamically increasing the density of the Gaussian balls, and the point deleting strategy improves the rendering efficiency and optimizes the computing resource allocation by eliminating the redundant Gaussian balls; the image pyramid strategy generates a multi-level visual effect through multi-scale training, and the blocking strategy improves reconstruction accuracy through local optimization. Finally, based on the three-dimensional Gaussian model which is completed through training, real-time generation of high-quality real shot images in a large-scale scene can be realized. The method has remarkable advantages in the aspects of efficiency, precision and practicability, provides important technical support for the fields of geographic information systems, urban planning, disaster monitoring and the like, and has wide application prospects.
assignees: WUHAN TIANYUANSHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Charging station depth defense protection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a charging station deep defense protection method, relates to the technical field of fire early warning and safety protection, and aims to solve the problems of high fire early warning false alarm rate, fire isolation delay and insufficient credibility of accident tracing data in the prior art. The method constructs a full-period protection system of 'monitoring-disposal-tracing', wherein a temperature field, electrical parameters and environmental data are collected through multi-source sensor fusion before disaster, a self-adaptive safety threshold is generated based on a dynamic game model, a digital twin deduction and prejudging risk path is combined, a three-level response mechanism is adopted in disaster, an operation log is stored in a slicing mode through a blockchain space-time anchoring technology after disaster, and a digital twin reverse reconstruction accident evolution chain is utilized to generate tamper-resistant judicial evidence. According to the invention, early warning precision is improved through dynamic threshold optimization, response time is shortened through multistage linkage control, traceability reliability is guaranteed through a quantum evidence storage technology, and a closed-loop optimization system for fire protection of the charging station is formed.
assignees: QUZHOU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power system state estimation method considering unmanned aerial vehicle scheduling
abstract_en: The invention aims to solve the problem of insufficient robustness of a traditional power grid state estimation method in a post-disaster recovery and emergency communication scene, and provides an electric power system emergency state estimation method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative graph neural network. The method integrates unmanned aerial vehicle dynamic communication scheduling and a space-time diagram neural network, and solves the problems of data loss, topology time variation, communication interruption and the like. By constructing a simulation data set, designing a space-time diagram convolution network, generating a node voltage estimation and confidence coefficient thermodynamic diagram by combining a diagram characteristic reconstruction module, and formulating a recovery priority strategy. Meanwhile, an unmanned aerial vehicle emergency communication optimization model is built, and efficient communication resource allocation is achieved. The invention has the beneficial effects of providing a method for collaborative optimization of an information-physical system, providing a quick and reliable communication alternative scheme and solving the problems of measurement deficiency and topology time variation. And a closed loop feedback model is established, so that the communication resource allocation scheduling is dynamically optimized, and the real-time dynamic mode of the power system is adapted.
assignees: UNIV GUANGXI

title_en: Method for dynamically reconstructing power distribution network disaster based on look-ahead-pre-algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic reconstruction method in power distribution network disaster based on a look-ahead-pre-algorithm, and belongs to the technical field of power distribution network reconstruction. The dynamic reconstruction method in power distribution network disaster based on the look-ahead-pre-algorithm comprises inputting initial running state of the power distribution network, and acquiring system state at current moment Generating all feasible action sets at the current moment For each action Executing an evaluation flow, constructing a future disaster scene by using a Monte Carlo method, simulating a system evolution process by combining a basic strategy, and evaluating actions Selecting the action with the minimum expected cost as the optimal action at the current moment to execute and update the system state Updating the time step if the current time step Returning to S2 to continue decision, otherwise, stopping algorithm execution. The reconstruction method optimizes the current decision, considers the influence of the current decision on the future, realizes the efficient and rapid dynamic reconstruction decision in the disaster, and improves the reliability and the toughness of the power distribution network.

title_en: Multi-element main body-oriented earthquake emergency treatment method, system, medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of information processing, and discloses a multi-element body-oriented earthquake emergency treatment method, a system, a medium and equipment, wherein the multi-element body-oriented earthquake emergency treatment method acquires earthquake emergency treatment information and effects of different departments and different objects, carries out statistical analysis, and summarizes the requirements, effects and characteristics of the different departments and different objects on disaster information and emergency treatment in an earthquake emergency period; and constructing an emergency treatment refinement strategy in a specific scene, and providing a seismic emergency treatment scheme oriented to a multi-element main body. The system comprises a quick response module, an emergency rescue module and a transitional placement and restoration reconstruction module, wherein the system provides a multi-element main body-oriented earthquake emergency treatment scheme, improves the applicability, rationality and scientificity of the earthquake emergency treatment scheme, and provides technical support for effectively integrating earthquake emergency products and emergency decisions.
assignees: Sichuan earthquake emergency service center

title_en: Phonetic communication method based on pinyin and voiceprint coding and low-power consumption voice terminal
abstract_en: The invention provides a phonetic communication method based on spelling and voiceprint coding and a low-power consumption voice terminal, which firstly converts voice into spelling and voiceprint packet codes for transmission, the method is restored to a personalized voice mode at the receiving end, and breakthroughs of low data volume, low power consumption and high semantic restoration rate of voice communication are realized. The embodiment reduces the traditional voice communication data volume by more than 90%, reduces the power consumption by more than 30-50 times, and improves the terminal access quantity by more than 10 times. The method and the device are suitable for various scenes such as interphones, smart phones, emergency and military communication, and have revolutionary potential for reconstructing a voice communication mode in the smart phones. The embodiment transmits standardized text information, so that the data volume is greatly reduced, the system becomes simple, secret and easy to deploy, and a low-cost and low-power consumption emergency disaster relief communication system capable of being connected with a satellite network can be quickly established in remote areas or under the condition of resource shortage caused by war and disasters.
assignees: CHENDU WESTVALLEY DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Virtual power plant collaboration and transaction settlement-based power distribution network toughness improvement method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network toughness improving method based on virtual power plant cooperation and transaction settlement, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a multi-type virtual power plant participation power grid dispatching and power transaction whole-flow management framework comprising a virtual power plant management platform, a power transaction platform and a dispatching platform to conduct planning on VPP disaster accidents, S2, constructing a multi-type VPP cooperation optimized power distribution network power supply restoration model before and after disaster to formulate a network reconstruction strategy, a real-time dispatching strategy of emergency resources and a regulation strategy of the VPPs in each period, and S3, calculating the power supply restoration incentive unit price and compensation income of each VPP participation according to the actual response quantity of the VPPs issued by the dispatching platform, the declared response quantity reported by the virtual power plant management platform and the VPP historical participation degree by the power transaction platform. The invention solves the key problems of insufficient resource coordination, stage cutting, excitation rigidification and the like by integrating the full-flow closed-loop management of pre-disaster plan generation, post-disaster dynamic adjustment and transaction settlement.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Post-disaster power communication network collaborative recovery system and method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent power grid dispatching and communication network recovery, and provides a post-disaster power communication network collaborative recovery system and a post-disaster power communication network collaborative recovery method, wherein the system comprises a power network model, a power distribution system and a communication network collaborative recovery system, wherein the power network model is used for distributing power supply resources to each node by taking power supply of power network nodes of a shortest time recovery target area as a target; the system comprises a line restoration model, an electric vehicle path planning model, an unmanned aerial vehicle deployment communication network restoration model, an optimal scheme solving unit and a power communication network node, wherein the line restoration model is used for taking an electric vehicle as a load supply and mobile restoration unit, and realizing joint optimization of power network topology reconstruction and power restoration of a target area by coordinating path planning and resource allocation of the electric vehicle, the electric vehicle path planning model is used for taking maximum restoration of power supply of the target area as a target, enabling the electric vehicle to quickly restore the power network within a limited time by optimizing a moving path of the electric vehicle, the unmanned aerial vehicle deployment communication network restoration model is used for taking minimum restoration of the communication network as a target, and combining cooperative work of the electric vehicle and the unmanned aerial vehicle, the unmanned aerial vehicle is deployed as a temporary air base station while power is supplied by a base station node, and the optimal scheme solving unit is provided with a layered multi-target optimization problem for maximizing total power communication coverage time as a target function under the condition of minimizing the restoration time of the power communication network.

title_en: Security system for cross-domain communication and data sharing of network platform software
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computer network security, in particular to a security assurance system for cross-domain communication and data sharing of network platform software, which comprises a data security transmission module, an identity authentication and access control module, an encryption module, a security audit and anomaly detection module and an anti-interference disaster recovery module. The invention realizes the cooperative guarantee of key safety and transmission continuity in cross-domain audio transmission by linking with AI risk prejudging, reinforcement learning path planning, digital twin preverifying and failure automatic switching technology through the equipment fingerprint end-to-end encryption, threat self-adaptive dynamic key updating and time stamp-random number replay prevention mechanism, so that the encryption strength is dynamically upgraded along with threat, the transmission path is optimized in advance, and the audio stream is ensured to resist various network attacks and interferences in low-delay transmission.

title_en: Flood disk-restoring method based on distributed hydrologic-hydrodynamic coupling mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood restoration method based on a distributed hydrologic-hydrodynamic coupling mode, which comprises the steps of compiling a data set of a historical mountain flood disaster, determining a topological structure relation of a river basin, and drawing up a key node corresponding to the river basin, and based on the key node, constructing a hydrologic model above the key node, constructing N computing units based on the data set and according to the topological relation of the river basin, adjusting the parameters to obtain an optimal flood simulation result and a parameter result, constructing a hydrodynamic model below the key node in the river basin, carrying out simulation analysis on regional application and flood evolution of the flood based on the optimal flood simulation result and the parameter result, constructing the hydrodynamic model, more accurately reflecting the generation, confluence and evolution processes of flood in the river basin, improving the application effects of the flood in aspects of flood simulation, early warning and response, helping to restore the actual situation of the flood disaster more accurately in the flood restoration process, and providing reliable basis for post-disaster assessment, reconstruction and planning.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI;CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;HYDROLOGY BUREAU OF HAIHE RIVER WATER CONSERVANCY COMMISSION MINI OF

title_en: Geological disaster knowledge graph construction method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of knowledge graph construction, in particular to a geological disaster knowledge graph construction method and system based on artificial intelligence; the method comprises the steps of extracting a geological semantic triplet set by using a semantic physical collaborative type preprocessing method to construct a three-layer semantic ontology graph, generating a space section structure chain and a time sequence state chain by using a double-chain type space-time graph construction method to construct a double-chain coupling graph structure, carrying out node state propagation calculation by using a disturbance perception graph neural network mechanism to obtain a risk state prediction result of a landslide structure unit layer under each time node, generating a landslide risk propagation path chain by using a reverse causal path chain reconstruction method, and migrating propagation parameters and response rules in a historical landslide graph structure into the double-chain coupling graph structure to construct a double-chain coupling space-time geological disaster knowledge graph. According to the invention, landslide state prediction and causal path reasoning are realized through the double-chain diagram structure and the disturbance perception diagram neural network.
assignees: SICHUAN FIFTH GEOLOGICAL BRIGADE

title_en: Two-stage fault recovery method for improving elasticity of power distribution system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-stage fault recovery method for improving elasticity of a power distribution system, which comprises the steps of constructing a typhoon space-time evolution model to generate a predicted fault scene, simulating a power distribution line in the predicted fault scene by utilizing a Monte Carlo simulation method to generate a plurality of fault scenes, constructing an uncertain set based on an information entropy value of the fault scenes and a fault weight, further constructing a robust optimization model, solving the robust optimization model, determining a pre-layout scheme of a mobile energy storage system and a static reactive compensator in the worst fault scene before disaster, constructing a multi-source collaborative post-disaster multi-period multi-objective fault recovery model, and realizing recovery of a power loss load and the fault line of the power distribution system by reconstructing and optimally scheduling the mobile energy storage system, the static reactive compensator, a maintenance team and electric vehicles through a network. The invention remarkably improves the overall elasticity of the power distribution system, not only enhances the disaster resistance capability, but also improves the capability of quickly recovering power supply.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: Foundation deep three-dimensional vibration testing device and method in dynamic compaction construction process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geotechnical engineering test, in particular to a device and a method for testing deep three-dimensional vibration of a foundation in a dynamic compaction construction process, wherein the device comprises a centering positioning pipe which is vertically inserted into the soil body of the foundation; the self-adaptive centering structure is arranged on the electric push rod-vibration sensor composite structure. According to the invention, through the real-time linkage of the multidimensional and adjustable deep sensing network and the construction process, the limitation of planarization and discretization of traditional monitoring is broken through, the dynamic tracking and three-dimensional reconstruction of the vibration wave full-space propagation track are realized, and the core technical support is provided for accurate regulation and control of ramming energy, quantitative evaluation of foundation treatment effect and active prevention and control of engineering disasters, so that the intelligent transformation from experience driving to data driving of dynamic compaction construction is promoted.
assignees: CHINA UNITED NORTHWEST INSTITUTE FOR ENGINEERING DESIGN & RES CO LTD

title_en: Remote sensing image three-dimensional reconstruction method based on nerve rendering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing image three-dimensional reconstruction method based on nerve rendering, which uses an irradiance model to independently model sunlight and sky diffuse reflection light, uses sun correction rays to accurately learn a solar visibility function, and finally adds an attention mechanism to optimize a network architecture so that the network can dynamically allocate corresponding weights according to the importance of features. The method solves the problem of complex sampling and calculation by improving the sampling method, adopts an irradiance model, can capture the dynamic characteristics of transient objects and shadow areas more accurately, adds an attention mechanism into a network, fully utilizes key characteristic information in remote sensing images, improves reconstruction precision and optimizes detail expression. The invention can be applied to urban planning, digital twinning, ecological environment monitoring, disaster emergency response, cultural relic protection and other scenes, and provides more lifelike visual experience and more accurate shadow effect for users.
assignees: HUNAN XIGU NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for evaluating landslide surge disaster influence of reservoir area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide surge disaster influence assessment method and system in a reservoir area, and relates to the technical field of landslide surge disaster assessment. The method comprises the steps of performing direct loss evaluation, quantifying damage condition and economic operation loss of the disaster to the tangible asset, performing indirect economic loss evaluation, summarizing the integral influence of the disaster to society and economy, including the influence of economic growth, involved economy and financial balance of a warehouse area, performing post-disaster reconstruction cost evaluation, evaluating intervention measures required for starting recovery work in a short period and realizing comprehensive post-disaster recovery reconstruction fund requirements, performing macroscopic economic influence analysis, evaluating the influence of the surge disaster to long-term development of the warehouse area, performing personal and family influence evaluation, and analyzing the influence of the disaster to personal and family income and living standard. The invention provides a comprehensive methodology guidance for the economic evaluation of the reservoir area, and is helpful for making an effective landslide surge disaster coping strategy and a restoration plan.
assignees: HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;POWERCHINA KUNMING ENG CORP LTD;UNIV HOHAI;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER UPSTREAM HYDROPOWER CO LTD

title_en: Path optimization and resource intelligent scheduling method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a path optimization and resource intelligent scheduling method and system based on digital twinning, wherein the method comprises the following steps of constructing a digital twinning three-dimensional model of disaster area infrastructure to realize three-dimensional scene reconstruction; constructing an rush repair path optimization model based on a multi-objective function, and optimizing paths among all places in the digital twin three-dimensional model; the invention can realize the collaborative optimization of the rush-repair path and the resource scheduling, generate an optimal scheme by combining the topography and the risk constraint, and improve the rush-repair operation efficiency.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power grid topology toughness enhancement method based on pre-disaster prediction of graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grid topology toughness enhancement method based on pre-disaster prediction of a graph neural network, which comprises the steps of constructing a grid graph structure taking grid equipment as nodes, predicting node damage probability through the graph attention network, defining a high-risk node set, constructing a mixed integer programming model according to the high-risk nodes and propagation paths thereof, solving to generate an optimal grid structure adjustment strategy before disaster, generating a resource scheduling scheme by utilizing a deep reinforcement learning algorithm in combination with the strategy, calculating a grid toughness core index after simulation operation, optimizing the structure adjustment strategy if the index is lower than a preset threshold value, and uploading the optimized strategy and scheduling scheme to a scheduling platform to finish pre-disaster active defense deployment. The invention realizes the cooperative linkage of pre-disaster risk prediction and topology reconstruction and resource deployment, automatically generates a differential pre-disaster defense scheme, converts post-emergency repair into pre-disaster prevention and distribution, and remarkably improves the pre-disaster prevention and control response efficiency.

title_en: E-commerce search service recovery method and device, equipment and medium thereof
abstract_en: Starting a local search service deployed by a current fault node, sending a missing data request to a remote search service of any healthy node, wherein the request comprises a latest timestamp of a latest log record in a local transaction log library, and the healthy node and the fault node are disaster recovery nodes; receiving a complete transaction log file generated after the latest timestamp returned by the remote search service, grouping log records in the complete transaction log file according to commodity identification, determining a target log record with the largest global version number in each group, constructing the target log record into an incremental transaction log file, writing the incremental transaction log file into a local transaction log library for playback to search engine index data, and re-registering the local search service to a service registration center after the playback is completed. The application can quickly recover the fault node and ensure that commodity data among the searching service nodes has high consistency.
assignees: GUANGZHOU SHANGYAN NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Cooperative power restoration scheduling method and device for power distribution system in typhoon disaster scene
abstract_en: The application discloses a cooperative power restoration scheduling method and a device of a power distribution system in a typhoon disaster scene, which relate to the technical field of power grid operation and are characterized in that by fusing a high-precision typhoon disaster model, the improved beluga optimization algorithm is applied to dynamic island division, so that the reconstruction time of the power distribution system can be greatly shortened, and the minute-level decision requirement for post-disaster power restoration is met. The method comprises the steps of constructing a device fault probability model in a typhoon disaster scene in advance, carrying out island division on a power distribution system according to the device fault probability model in the typhoon disaster scene to obtain islands meeting first constraint conditions in the power distribution system, constructing a fault re-electricity optimization model on the basis of the islands obtained by division in the power distribution system, and solving the fault re-electricity optimization model by utilizing an improved white whale optimization algorithm to obtain an optimal power supply path suitable for collaborative re-electricity scheduling in the typhoon disaster scene.
assignees: NANNING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for improving toughness of AC/DC distribution area based on mobile energy storage soft switch
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for improving toughness of an AC/DC distribution area based on a mobile energy storage soft switch, which belong to the technical field of power distribution network fault recovery, wherein the method comprises the steps of considering a moving path of a meteorological center, constructing a line fault rate model under extreme ice and snow weather, and sampling to obtain a fault scene; the method comprises the steps of traversing all fault scenes, obtaining deployment positions with minimum total loss load of a network reconstruction and island division distribution network under different deployment positions of a mobile energy storage soft switch, carrying out pre-disaster placement according to the deployment positions, taking the positions with faults into consideration when traffic is not recovered after extreme weather faults occur, carrying out power restoration by adopting island division and network reconstruction modes around the pre-placement positions, and optimizing a repair strategy and updating the system topology by taking the sequence and the pre-placement scheme of fault position repair after traffic recovery after the disaster. The invention is based on the mobile energy storage soft switch, and obviously improves the power supply recovery capability and the operation reliability of the urban power distribution network for coping with extreme ice and snow disasters.
assignees: QINGDAO POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Method for restoring green ecology of mine goaf
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for restoring green ecology in a mine goaf, which relates to the technical field of ecological restoration and comprises the steps of firstly carrying out rock surface treatment, cleaning the exposed rock surface of a mine, preventing broken stone from falling during construction, then carrying out restoring green planting, carrying out seedling transplanting on the prepared rock surface, and then carrying out vegetation maintenance, and carrying out maintenance on planted seedlings and sown grass seeds, so that the vegetation can root and sprout. According to the invention, through vegetation reconstruction and ecological restoration, the surface coverage is quickly recovered, water and soil loss is reduced, geological disaster risks such as landslide and debris flow are effectively restrained, life and property safety of mining areas and surrounding residents are prevented from being threatened, super-accumulated plants can be utilized to purify heavy metal pollution of soil, vegetation is matched for adsorbing dust and adjusting microclimate, air quality and ecological environment of the areas are obviously improved, and meanwhile, the mining areas after being re-greened can be transformed into ecological parks, carbon-sink forests or agricultural bases, so that the land value is improved.
assignees: SHI BAIRONG

title_en: Method for predicting instability volume of reservoir side slope deformation body
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for predicting the instability volume of a reservoir bank slope deformation body, which comprises the steps of respectively obtaining surface displacement and rock mass internal deformation data through a millimeter wave radar and an inclination angle sensor, and identifying a key deformation area and generating a data set after processing through a self-adaptive noise decomposition algorithm. And carrying out space-time alignment on the data by utilizing the engineering coordinate system and the topological relation to generate a fusion matrix. And reconstructing a potential slip surface geometric model by combining the slip surface characteristics of the historical cases, and calculating the instability volume probability distribution by adopting Monte Carlo simulation. And finally, inputting the multidimensional data into a space-time prediction model, and outputting a destabilization volume prediction result with probability distribution. The method can improve the accuracy and reliability of the prediction result, and provide scientific basis and technical support for safety monitoring and disaster early warning of the bank side slope.
assignees: POWERCHINA KUNMING ENG CORP LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER UPSTREAM HYDROPOWER CO LTD

title_en: Mountain highway disaster identification method and system based on multi-source remote sensing image restoration and super-resolution reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plateau mountain road disaster identification method and system based on multi-source remote sensing image restoration and super-resolution reconstruction. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source remote sensing images of mountain areas of a plateau, preprocessing, extracting geomorphic metering parameters based on a digital elevation model, constructing a super-resolution reconstruction network integrating deformable convolution and a Transformer, reconstructing low-resolution images by utilizing composite loss function constraint training comprising the geomorphic metering parameters, carrying out feature extraction and self-adaptive weighted fusion on the preprocessed images and the high-resolution images obtained by reconstruction, identifying landslide, debris flow and subgrade subsidence disasters along the road by utilizing a multi-task deep learning model based on the fused images, carrying out morphological optimization and boundary refinement under GIS constraint on identification results, and outputting disaster thematic map. The invention effectively improves the accuracy and reliability of highway disaster identification under complex terrain environments.

title_en: Multi-network cascading failure propagation prediction method based on heterogeneous graph neural network under disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-network chained fault propagation prediction method based on a heterogeneous graph neural network under a disaster, which comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source data of the disaster, electric power, communication and traffic networks, constructing a four-layer heterogeneous graph model, defining multi-type interlayer edges, establishing a mapping relation between disaster physical quantity and physical node health states, predicting initial fault states at disaster impact time, defining multi-scale multi-mechanism propagation rules based on the interlayer edges, simulating chained fault processes, constructing a space-time heterogeneous graph neural network model, stacking a heterogeneous graph neural network module and a gating circulation unit module, adopting a double-head prediction layer to predict node continuous running states and discrete functional states in an autoregressive mode, carrying out post-processing on a state time sequence output by the model, and reconstructing a cross-domain chained fault propagation path through a causal attribution algorithm. The invention can accurately simulate the whole evolution process from disaster occurrence to multi-network cascading failure, and realize multi-scale failure prediction and causal analysis.

title_en: Method for identifying mao-bamboo forest snow disaster damage of airborne laser radar based on differential point cloud encryption strategy
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of forestry disaster monitoring, in particular to an identification method of an airborne laser radar phyllostachys pubescens disaster damage based on a differential point cloud encryption strategy; according to the method, the three-dimensional structure of the bamboo forest is reconstructed through fitting the axis of the bamboo trunk and image post-processing, different types of disaster damage are identified, virtual point clouds are generated to fill the scanning missing area, the accuracy of the axis of the bamboo trunk is effectively improved, the image expression of the bamboo trunk and the tree crowns is enhanced through layered reconstruction and principal component analysis technology, a finer disaster damage characteristic diagram is provided, and accurate disaster assessment is facilitated. In addition, the accuracy and reliability of disaster damage analysis are further improved through targeted image processing based on disaster damage types. In the whole, the invention provides high-efficiency and accurate technical support for post-disaster evaluation and ecological restoration of the bamboo forests.
assignees: INT CT BAMBOO & RATTAN

title_en: Reservoir landslide displacement prediction method, storage medium and device based on dynamic hysteresis identification and fuzzy entropy optimization
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of geological disaster prediction, and particularly provides a reservoir landslide displacement prediction method based on dynamic hysteresis identification and fuzzy entropy optimization, which comprises the steps of collecting and preprocessing landslide time sequence monitoring data; combining a distributed lag nonlinear model with a maximum information coefficient, dynamically analyzing the lag relation between displacement and rainfall and reservoir water level by a sliding window, outputting a self-adaptive lag period and constructing a lag characteristic set, decomposing the self-adaptive decomposition displacement sequence by a fuzzy entropy optimized variation mode, determining the optimal mode number according to the minimum fuzzy entropy, reconstructing an eigen mode function into a trend, a period and a random term, extracting local characteristics of a multi-lag characteristic space by CNN, inputting the local characteristics and the reconstructed displacement component into GRU capturing time dependence, introducing a attention mechanism weighting key time step, and outputting a predicted value and a confidence interval by quantile regression. The method integrates dynamic hysteresis capture, self-adaptive decomposition and CNN-GRU-Attention, and realizes high-precision and high-robustness prediction.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Post-disaster power distribution network optimization reconstruction method based on distributed power supply participation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster power distribution network optimization reconstruction method based on distributed power supply participation, which relates to the technical field of power distribution network optimization reconstruction and comprises the following steps of inputting a frequency state discrete vector set into a disturbance cross recognition model, calculating a frequency disturbance propagation factor and a response difference gradient between any two distributed power supplies based on a disturbance sensitivity algorithm of covariance deviation judgment, and recognizing a frequency disturbance source and a frequency inconsistency problem according to a determined local frequency state; constructing an adaptation capability assessment tensor, fusing a frequency disturbance propagation factor, a response difference gradient and a frequency state discrete vector set, executing fuzzy clustering and weight self-adaptive fusion mapping operation, generating a frequency adaptation index, and judging grid-connected adaptation capability of an island region. The method solves the technical problem that the frequency control isomerism of the post-disaster island region is difficult to identify the grid-connected suitability, and realizes the safety and coordination judgment of the multi-source isomerism distributed power supply access.
assignees: WUXI GUANGYING GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Mangrove forest ecological restoration system after standardized typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of ecological restoration, and particularly relates to a mangrove ecological restoration system after a standardized typhoon disaster. The method comprises the steps of dividing disaster degrees of typhoon damaged mangroves into heavy disasters, medium disasters and light disasters based on remote sensing images and field investigation, carrying out lodging tree classification cleaning operation and landform restoration aiming at the heavy disasters, selecting large seedlings for field planting in combination with tidal flat elevation to form reconstruction of a standardized mangrove ecological system, carrying out pruning and supplementing planting operation based on forest windows aiming at the medium disasters, improving primary forest stand recovery efficiency, adopting unmanned motor to monitor forest stand canopy closure degree aiming at the light disasters, and adopting corresponding grade intervention to realize accurate restoration. According to the method, the tidal flat environment and the salinity are based to adapt to the species of the rural tree, and differential restoration operation is adopted, so that the cooperative reconstruction of the mangrove ecological system structure and the coast protection function is realized, and the limitation of traditional restoration is broken through by a standardized operation system.
assignees: HAINAN ACADEMY OF FORESTRY HAINAN MANGROVE RESEARCH INST

title_en: Geological disaster early warning method based on troposphere delay decoupling
abstract_en: The application discloses a geological disaster early warning method based on troposphere delay decoupling, which relates to the field of geological disaster monitoring and navigation positioning, and comprises the steps of multi-modal data space-time synchronous acquisition; the method comprises the steps of performing geological decoupling on a troposphere delay component, converting atmospheric noise into a geological signal, constructing delay-catastrophe parameter dynamic mapping, performing terrain self-adaptive reference station dynamic reconstruction, performing virtual GNSS reference point network with the same height as a monitoring point by using Digital Elevation Model (DEM) dynamic reconstruction, performing three-dimensional reconstruction on a disaster risk field, fusing delay mapping factors and ground surface deformation data to generate a multi-dimensional risk field, constructing an early warning threshold self-evolution mechanism, and constructing a multi-cascade control early warning decision. The method can improve the accuracy of geological disaster early warning and provide intelligent technical support for disaster prevention and reduction.
assignees: NO 230 RESEARCH INST OF NUCLEAR INDUSTRY

title_en: Multi-degradation flame image recovery method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-degradation flame image recovery method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting a smoke sample and a flame real image of a cable fire in real time by simulating the situation of a high-voltage cable fire of an underground pipe gallery in reality, constructing an atmospheric scattering model, combining the smoke sample characteristics of the cable fire, generating smoke degradation images under various working conditions based on the flame real image, constructing and training a smoke image enhancement model based on an improved DCGAN framework, wherein the smoke image enhancement model comprises a generator and a discriminator, the generator is used for reconstructing the smoke degradation image to generate a flame restoration image, and the discriminator is used for carrying out true and false judgment on the flame restoration image and the real flame image, so that the difference between the flame restoration image and the flame real image is ensured to be continuously optimized by the generator. The invention effectively removes the dense smoke interference, restores the occluded image details and provides clear and reliable visual information for the subsequent fire disaster identification.
assignees: STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;FUZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Method, system and equipment for extracting road topology structure of remote sensing image through multitasking cooperation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of remote sensing image processing, in particular to a method, a system and equipment for extracting a road topological structure of a multi-task collaborative remote sensing image, which comprise the steps of data preparation, model training and road extraction, wherein a multi-task collaborative mechanism is introduced to fuse segmentation tasks with topology modeling tasks, and the process from feature extraction, key point detection and dynamic prompt generation to topology restoration forming end-to-end collaborative optimization is realized, so that unified modeling of road mask segmentation and topology structure reconstruction is realized, the topology connectivity and structural consistency of a road network are obviously improved while high segmentation precision is maintained, and the method has the advantages of clear structure, high calculation efficiency, strong generalization capability and the like, and can be widely applied to the fields of intelligent traffic, urban planning, disaster emergency, map automatic drawing and the like.
assignees: UNIV XIAMEN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Power supply capacity evaluation method and device after disaster of power distribution network and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for evaluating power supply capacity of a power distribution network after disaster and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps of determining a power failure area under the condition that equipment faults in a distribution network are affected by disasters, determining actual photovoltaic output, total V2G output and energy storage and discharge power for emergency power supply after the disasters are carried out on the power failure area based on a multi-source output model, determining target transfer load of the power failure area based on a tie switch network reconstruction model, determining predicted time sequence load of the power failure area in a current power utilization period, and determining a power supply capacity evaluation result of the distribution network in the current power utilization period based on the actual photovoltaic output, the total V2G output, the energy storage and discharge power, the transfer load and the predicted time sequence load. The method solves the technical problems of untimely power restoration caused by inaccurate power supply capacity evaluation after disaster of the power distribution network after the disaster causes the power distribution network equipment failure and power interruption in the related technology.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INST CO LTD;STATE GRID SHANGHAI ENERGY INTERNET RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Three-dimensional quantitative dynamic checking method for flood prevention capacity of transformer substation based on digital twin and multisource coupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional quantitative dynamic checking method for flood control capability of a transformer substation based on digital twin and multisource coupling, belongs to the technical field of evaluation and checking of flood control capability of the transformer substation, integrates multidisciplinary theories and technologies such as hydrology, hydraulics, geographical science, artificial intelligence, digital twin and the like, integrates multisource data such as high-resolution satellite remote sensing, unmanned plane laser radar, GIS space analysis, hydrologic monitoring and the like, builds a digital twin and distributed hydrologic-hydrodynamic coupling model of the transformer substation, builds a disaster-causing mechanism three-dimensional quantitative index system covering dangers, expositions and vulnerabilities, realizes a whole-flow technical closed loop from data acquisition-model simulation-quantitative checking-three-dimensional visualization-dynamic early warning, adapts to different scenes such as a lack of data area, a transformed transformer substation and the like, and accurately outputs a transformer substation flood control capability level, a thin-state distribution and flood risk evolution situation, and provides scientific support for flood control reconstruction design and emergency treatment.
assignees: STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INSTITUTE;JILIN ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: DCDC power failure diagnosis method and system suitable for new energy automobile
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fire-fighting weak current boxes, in particular to a DCDC power failure diagnosis method and system suitable for new energy automobiles, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, quantum dot enhanced self-reconstruction digital twin modeling, namely, a quantum dot film sensor is implanted on the surface of a DCDC power core device, the fluorescence intensity of the sensor generates nonlinear response along with the tiny changes of temperature, stress and electric field, and the hidden physical characteristics which cannot be identified by the traditional sensor can be captured; the full-dimension perception of hidden faults is realized by combining the characteristics of microscopic stress, electric field distortion and the like of a quantum dot sensing capturing device and combining electromagnetic-thermal-mechanical-environment four-field coupling characteristic fusion, and false association is eliminated by a causal reasoning model and a Do-Calculus algorithm, so that the direct causal relation of characteristic-root cause is quantized.
assignees: ZHANG TAO

title_en: Method for evaluating toughness of power distribution network in typhoon weather, storage medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-stage evaluation method, a storage medium and equipment for the toughness of a power distribution network in typhoon weather, wherein when no typhoon disaster occurs, the influence of the typhoon disaster on the power distribution network and the response process of the power distribution network to the typhoon disaster are simulated and analyzed, and the pre-disaster toughness index of the power distribution network is counted and calculated; in the typhoon disaster occurrence process, calculating toughness indexes in the power distribution network disaster according to real-time data returned by the power distribution network data acquisition and monitoring control system; acquiring actual data of emergency response and emergency repair of the power distribution network after the typhoon leaves the environment, and calculating a post-disaster toughness index of the power distribution network; the three-stage toughness level of the power distribution network is quantized, and the pre-disaster firmness degree, the in-disaster resisting capability, the post-disaster recovery efficiency and the comprehensive toughness of the power distribution network for coping with typhoon disasters are quantized. The method can be used for guiding reinforcement of the elements of the power distribution network when no typhoon occurs, emergency control in the process of typhoon disaster and emergency repair and power restoration after typhoon disaster, and provides quantitative basis for system planning, operation scheduling and restoration decision.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Full-link monitoring method and system for intelligently measuring complex service scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-link monitoring method and system for intelligently measuring complex service scenes, and relates to the technical field of power grids. Establishing a virtual model of an intelligent measurement system by utilizing a digital twin technology so as to simulate and monitor key business scenes; the data packet grabbing and analyzing technology is utilized to quickly locate service processing faults, and system abnormal conditions are timely found and analyzed; adding buried point codes at key nodes of the system, and collecting service processing indexes to evaluate processing efficiency and analyze system bottlenecks; based on the monitoring result, parameter adjustment, disaster recovery design and algorithm optimization are adopted to continuously improve the accuracy, response speed and reliability of the system. The invention carries out full-link simulation and monitoring based on digital twin thinking, can discover and solve potential problems in advance, and improves the reliability and stability of the system.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent extraction method for coal mining subsidence area ground surface cracks based on improved transducer model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent extraction method for earth surface cracks in a coal mining subsidence area based on an improved transducer model, and belongs to the technical field of remote sensing image processing. The unmanned aerial vehicle with the high-resolution optical camera is used for collecting images, the image overlapping rate of 70% -80% is guaranteed, and a training data set is constructed through professional labeling, cutting screening and data enhancement. The encoder of the innovative model has the characteristics that the self-adaptive multi-scale patch mapping layer can dynamically adjust the patch size according to the local complexity degree of the image, the characteristics are extracted efficiently, double-attention fusion is combined with optimized position encoding, long-distance dependency capture is enhanced, and the calculation amount and the overfitting of the dynamic sparse connection full-connection layer are reduced. And the residual attention enhancing pyramid pooling and space-channel attention bottleneck mechanism highlights key characteristics and suppresses noise, and the break point detection and connection rule determining module is utilized to realize complete restoration of the ground cracks. The data set is used for deployment after a model is trained, and the ground crack information can be accurately obtained through pretreatment, encoding and decoding and post-treatment, so that the data base is firmly built for mining area safety management and geological disaster prevention.
assignees: UNIV LIAONING TECHNICAL

title_en: Landslide potential displacement monitoring system using multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide hidden danger displacement monitoring system using multi-source data fusion, which comprises a multi-source sensing unit, an earth surface deformation sensing module and an edge computing unit, wherein the multi-source sensing unit comprises a satellite-borne radar sensing module, the satellite-borne radar sensing module is used for acquiring large-range earth surface deformation data through a synthetic aperture radar, the earth surface deformation sensing module is used for monitoring earth surface displacement in real time through a dual-frequency GNSS receiver and a fiber grating sensor, the underground stress sensing module is used for acquiring underground rock-soil body stress change through a microseismic monitoring array and a distributed fiber sensor, and the edge computing unit comprises a dynamic weight fusion module, and is used for dynamically distributing multi-source sensor weights according to geological states to generate high-precision fusion displacement field data. The invention can break through the bottleneck of the traditional monitoring system in terms of data quality, model precision and response efficiency through multisource data fusion, model parameter real-time updating and closed-loop optimization mechanism, and provides data support for accurate early warning and intelligent emergency of landslide disasters.
assignees: THE NATIONAL NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION AND CONTROL RES INSTITUTE OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMEN

title_en: Extreme weather elastic scheduling strategy previewing system, method, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of disaster prevention, disaster reduction and intelligent scheduling of an electric power system, and provides a system, a method, equipment and a medium for previewing an extreme weather elastic scheduling strategy, wherein the system comprises a meteorological-GAN modeling module, a reinforcement learning training module and a digital twin test platform which are connected in sequence; the method comprises the steps of generating an extreme weather power grid fault sequence with space-time correlation characteristics by a meteorological-GAN modeling module, training a power failure recovery decision model by a reinforcement learning training module based on the generated fault sequence, performing pressure test and robustness verification of a disaster evolution path on the decision model by a digital twin test platform, forming a closed-loop optimization framework by three modules through a bidirectional data channel, and breaking through the difficult problems of data dependence bottleneck and robustness verification of a power grid scheduling strategy under extreme weather by a collaborative mechanism of high-fidelity disaster scene generation, self-adaptive decision training and extreme pressure test.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Cascade machine learning-based hydrate region seabed landslide risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrate region submarine landslide risk assessment method based on cascading machine learning, and belongs to the technical field of marine geological disaster prediction. The landslide risk prediction method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining historical landslide data, hydrate occurrence data and various environmental characteristics of a research area, preprocessing, constructing a hydrate occurrence data set based on local hydrate data and the environmental characteristics, training a neural network model fused with physical constraints, predicting occurrence depth of all-area hydrate and generating a distribution map, finally fusing the predicted depth serving as a key characteristic with the environmental characteristics, constructing an enhanced landslide data set, training an integrated learning model by adopting a dynamic weight integration strategy based on a geological landscape unit, and finishing landslide risk prediction. According to the invention, the prediction bottleneck caused by the scarcity of the hydrate data is effectively solved through the cascade architecture, the rationality and the robustness of the model are improved through physical constraint, and the high-precision and interpretable evaluation of the submarine landslide risk of the hydrate region is realized.
assignees: Laoshan National Laboratory

title_en: Power grid cascading failure deduction and elastic recovery collaborative decision method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a collaborative decision method and a collaborative decision system for power grid cascading failure deduction and elastic recovery, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a state model of each power grid element in extreme weather, and acquiring the state transition probability of each power grid element in continuous time according to the state model; the method comprises the steps of constructing a system cascading failure evolution model under extreme weather according to state transition probability, calculating line real-time outage probability under a wind power grid-connected scene according to the system cascading failure evolution model, constructing an optimal power flow model according to the line real-time outage probability with minimized load shedding amount as a target, simulating a derating operation response process after grid failure to obtain a load reduction strategy of a system under each failure state, establishing a post-disaster emergency recovery model based on the load reduction strategy and system topology constraint, and determining a fault repair time sequence and a load recovery sequence. The invention can obviously improve the risk perception capability, decision scientificity and recovery efficiency of the power grid in an extreme event.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NINGBO POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Urban traffic system toughness enhancement and restoration method based on safe linear interval
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for enhancing and recovering toughness of an urban traffic system based on a safe linear interval, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a time-varying traffic network diagram of an urban road network, identifying bottleneck links of each OD pair, defining limiting links, calculating demand weighting coefficients of the limiting links, providing the safe linear interval for describing the change rule of link quality improvement contribution to network toughness in different intervals, establishing a linear relation between link quality improvement quantity and toughness gain in the safe linear interval, combining the demand weighting coefficients and static connectivity, optimizing weight parameters of a matrix by combining a double-objective optimization method, thereby constructing a traffic network weight matrix, simulating node competition interaction, identifying key nodes, and finally simulating node removal and recovery processes. The invention quantitatively improves the disturbance rejection and recovery capacity of the urban road traffic system, and provides a unified and efficient toughness enhancement and recovery scheme for daily disturbance and post-disaster interruption.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Integrated supervision and management system to improve the quality and efficiency of building facilities
title_ko: 건축 설비의 품질 및 효율성 향상을 위한 통합 감리 및 관리 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건축 설비의 품질 향상과 효율적인 관리를 위해 설계, 감리, 시공, 운영 및 유지보수 단계에서 활용할 수 있는 통합 감리 및 관리 시스템에 있어서, 전기설비 감리를 수행하기 위한 모듈로서, 전력기술 관리법에 따라 아파트, 공동주택, 공공건물, 플랜트 및 산업시설에 설치되는 태양광 발전, 송전, 배전, 조명설비 등의 전력시설물을 실시간으로 모니터링하고 품질을 평가하며, 전력 손실을 최소화하도록 설계된 전력 최적화 알고리즘을 포함하는 전기설비 모듈; 정보통신설비 감리를 수행하기 위한 모듈로서, 정보통신 공사업법에 따라 구내통신선로, TV 공시청, 홈네트워크 시스템, CCTV, 주차관제, 음향영상설비 등의 설치 및 운영 상태를 분석하고, 전송, 이동통신, 위성통신, 정보망, 항공항만통신 및 철도통신 신호설비의 안정성을 보장하기 위한 통신 품질 개선 알고리즘을 포함하는 정보통신설비 모듈; 소방설비 감리를 수행하기 위한 모듈로서, 소방공사업법에 따라 소화설비, 경보설비, 피난설비, 소화용수설비, 소화활동설비 등의 방화 시스템을 실시간으로 점검하며, 화재 발생 가능성을 사전에 예측하고, 최적의 대응 계획을 제안할 수 있는 방화 시뮬레이션 및 위험도 분석 알고리즘을 포함하는 소방설비 모듈; 상기 전기설비 모듈, 정보통신설비 모듈 및 소방설비 모듈과 연동하여 모든 설계 및 감리 데이터를 통합 관리하며, 시공 단계에서 발생할 수 있는 문제를 사전에 예방할 수 있는 디지털 트윈 기반 시뮬레이션 엔진과, 설계와 감리의 일체화를 통해 시공 품질을 향상시키는 협업 관리 플랫폼을 포함하며, 상기 모듈들이 생성하는 데이터를 중앙 서버에 저장하고 이를 기반으로 유지보수 단계에서 장비 수명을 예측하고, 신속한 문제 해결을 위한 AI 기반 자동 진단 및 추천 시스템을 제공하는 통합 데이터 분석 모듈을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: SANGJEEENG&CONST CO LTD

title_en: Method for predicting dynamic risk and vulnerability under fine dimension
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for predicting dynamic risk and vulnerability at fine scale and belongs to the scientific field of global information. The method is mainly characterized in that an optimized Bayesian network is searched from multi-source heterogeneous spatiotemporal data on the basis of a grid format with certain resolution at fine scale; domain knowledge is combined to improve the network; therefore, the uncertain estimation of disaster risk and the vulnerability, namely probability estimation, is carried out. In the method, a nuclear density method is put forward to train a sample according to a sample derivative grid; an optimized discretization method is put forward to discretize continuous variables so as to provide discrete state space input for the network; a simulated annealing optimization algorithm is adopted to search an optimized network structure; and a method of accurate reasoning combined with approximate reasoning to predict the probabilities of risk and the vulnerability is adopted. The method provided by the invention can position the positions of the disaster risk and the vulnerability in real time at the fine spatial scale, estimate the spatial distribution of the risk probability and has important theoretical significance and practical value for improving the effects on the reduction and relief of disaster and building an intelligent public emergency pre-warning system by the state.
assignees: INST GEOG SCI & NR RES CAS

title_en: Disaster recovery process simulation device, disaster recovery process simulation method and disaster recovery process simulation program
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To beforehand and serially analyze works for recovering lifelines in a disaster, such as an earthquake and a typhoon.  <P>SOLUTION: A local information storage part 120 stores local data 10. An electric power circulation facility information storage part 130 stores electric power circulation facility data 20.
