title_en: Combined drilling tool with drill hole control grouting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a combined drilling tool with a drill hole control grouting device. At present, the method of grouting consolidation is usually adopted in our country, which has the weaknesses of large construction quantity and long construction period, and has lower engineering reliability caused by poor aggregate and slurry retention condition for hydrodynamic condition projects, and is difficult to control the grouting range. The combined drilling tool comprises a drill rod, a drill bit and a casing, wherein a control grouting device is arranged between the drill rod and the drill bit, a high-strength nonwoven slurry protecting bag is arranged between an isolating pipe and the casing, and a power transmission device is arranged between the casing and the drill bit, and is connected on the upper middle portion of the drill rod through an intermediate connector. The combined drilling tool can guarantee the control grouting with quickness and high efficiency to the largest extent for satisfying the grouting rescue and relief works and production restoration requirements of mines, railways, roads, tunnels for water conservancy and laneway projects to the sudden flood and weather disasters with large passage, large flux and high concentration, and reduces the construction cost.
assignees: XI AN INST OF COAL SCIENCE RES INST

title_en: A rapid kill and restoration system for blowout wells
abstract_en: Well blowouts, such as happened in the PTTEPAA Montara gas well in the Timor Sea in August 2009 and the BP Macondo oil well in the Gulf of Mexico in April 2010, caused colossal disasters. The existing top kill technique by pumping in kill- weight mud failed. The relief well technique worked, however it was very costly and very late due to drilling the relief well. This invention is a rapid and reliable kill and restoration technique and its implementation system for the well blowout accidents. It uses solid particles to block, suppress and greatly reduce the blowout flow to gain time for repair or replacement of the damaged blowout preventer and other devices, and connection of production pipelines; It then takes out some of the solid particles to restore well production. In such a way, environmental damage is greatly reduced and the well is kept as a valuable production asset. While any shape of solid particles may be used, the ball shape is an optimum for the kill and restoration operation; hence kill balls are the recommended solid particles. The kill procedure is to sequentially release large, medium and small density balls into the blowout well. Balls of different densities can be made of different materials such as lead, iron, stone or rubber and can have a shell cover made of iron, steel or other environmental friendly material. An implementation system for the kill procedure consists of a tubing system, a blower or a pump, a ball injection device and a cage. The transporting fluid can be air, nitrogen, carbon dioxide, oil or other fluid depending on the operation safety assessment in regarding to the specific well blowout situation. The cage mounted on the tubing and sits on top of the well will temporally contain the blown out balls at the early stage of the kill process. Balls in the cage will fall down to the well as the flow is reduced. A technique for taking out some of the balls from the well to restore production is carried out by a tubing system, a pump and a balls storage tank.
assignees: LIU XIANHUA

title_en: Beach area predicating method based on Bayesian dynamic model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a predicating method of beach area. The method comprises the following steps of: obtaining Shanghai beach area in the recent 10 years through combination of RS (Remote Sensing), GPS (Global Positioning System) and GIS (Geographic Information System); selecting an initial training set of a Bayesian dynamic model according to the data; calling the model for predication; and comparing a predicating result with an actual value until the predicating result falls within a confidence interval of the actual value. By using the predicating method disclosed by the invention, fine predicating structure is obtained, the predicating accuracy is also improved while data expense is saved, a tool is provided for coastal fishermen to avoid marine disaster in the operation, and contributions are also made to national disaster prevention and reduction.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI OCEAN

title_en: Evaluation method of debris flow disaster risk based on Bayesian network model
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an evaluation method of the debris flow disaster risk based on a Bayesian network model. The evaluation method is characterized by comprising the following steps of: determining an evaluation unit; obtaining an evaluation index of the debris flow disaster risk of the evaluation unit by processing an evaluation parameter of the debris flow disaster risk of the evaluation unit; creating a training sample set according to historical data of the debris flow disaster risk in the evaluation unit and the evaluation index; creating the Bayesian network model according to the training sample set; and evaluating the debris flow disaster risk in an area to be evaluated by adopting the Bayesian network model. According to the evaluation method provided by the invention, the Bayesian network model is created by combining the historical data of the debris flow disaster risk in the evaluation unit and the evaluation index, the debris flow disaster risk in the area to be evaluated is evaluated by adopting the Bayesian network model, the accuracy of a debris flow disaster risk evaluation result is greatly increased, and the debris flow disaster risk in the area to be evaluated can be accurately evaluated by adopting the evaluation method.
assignees: INST GEOG SCI & NR RES CAS

title_en: A kind of appraisal procedure of section transmission line tower foundation side slope Rainfall Disaster risk
abstract_en: The methods of risk assessment of section transmission line tower foundation side slope Rainfall Disaster: the controlling factor obtaining pole and tower foundation side slope Rainfall Disaster risk, and it is quantized and normalized; With disaster statistics and rainmaking slope erosion test findings for training sample, set up the mapping relations of controlling factor and heavy rain landslide accident rate with modified BP neural network, obtain risk assessment mathematical model; To calculate basis, all fronts side slope mean storm landslide accident rate value of gained for reference value, obtain each side slope relative to heavy rain risk of landslip grade completely, the weight vectors of each section to different risk class side slope number percent is obtained by improvement level analytical calculation program, consider that each risk class side slope is different on the impact of Rainfall Disaster risk, continue to adopt improvement level analytical calculation program computation to obtain different risk class side slope to the weight vectors of Rainfall Disaster, each layer weight vectors synthesis is obtained the risk evaluation result of each section from top to bottom by rear computing machine.

title_en: Game theory-based optimal escape route generating method for large-scale crowd evacuation
abstract_en: The invention aims to generate an optimal strategy for crowd evacuation by calculating an optimal evacuation strategy and performing analytic statistics fpr a crowd phenomenon, the crowd density trend of each evacuation path and a key path crowd situation during an overall evacuation process on the basis of the optimal evacuation strategy in the process of simulating large-scale crowd evacuation when a disaster happens. The invention provides a game theory-based optimal escape route generating method for large-scale crowd evacuation. By the method, an optimal evacuation scheme is formed by performing quantitative risk analysis on crowdedness degree factors by adopting a Monte Carlo model according to a disaster radiation region range, the distance from the disaster to an emergency exit, the number of safety measures in escape paths, taking the assessed risk results as the input parameters of a revenue function of a path game, and deciding the choice of the evacuation path through a game theory.
assignees: UNIV JILIN

title_en: Disaster backup information system simulation method based on two places and three centers
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster backup information system simulation method based on two places and three centers. A simulated disaster backup information system is built according actual needs of a user. Disaster information system drilling processes, caused by a disaster, such as fault injection, fault repair, fault detection, data center switching and back-switching, data storage, and data validity verification are realized. Three signal states, namely a normal state, a fault state and a center replaced state exist in the system. System signals are utilized to realize disaster backup flow control, cost is lowered, work efficiency is increased, disaster backup data and production data sharing storage are user at the same time, and space is saved.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING POSTS & TELECOMM

title_en: Information processing method, information processing apparatus, and program
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To perform prior and sequential analysis of works for recovering lifelines when disaster, such as an earthquake and a typhoon occurs.SOLUTION: A local information storage part 120 stores local data 10. An electric power distribution facility information storage part 130 stores electric power distribution facility data 20. A commander simulation part 141, a patrolman simulation part 142, and a recovery person simulation part 143 refer to the local information storage part 120 and the electric power distribution facility information storage part 130, and simulate works done by a commander, a patrolman, and a recovery person, respectively. The recovery person simulation part 143 simulates moving of the recovery person to a disaster place and command waiting from the commander.
assignees: CENTRAL RES INST ELECT

title_en: Differentiation based power transmission network anti-disaster ability planning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a differentiation based power transmission network anti-disaster ability planning method which is used for improving an anti-disaster ability of a power transmission network when a meteorological disaster occurs. The differentiation based power transmission network anti-disaster ability planning method comprises the steps of: firstly, developing an IEEE standard based tri-state meteorological condition to obtain a relationship between a fault rate of a power transmission line at different anti-disaster protection levels and the meteorological disaster; obtaining a fragility index and a goal by utilizing Monte Carlo simulation and an optimized load shedding algorithm. The fragility index and a planned construction cost serve as an objective function of multi-goal power transmission network planning; an NSGA-II algorithm is used for obtaining optimal Pareto disaggregation of a power distribution network planning scheme and is used for decision-making in the later period. The verification shows that the provided power distribution network planning method can determine the anti-disaster protection level of each power distribution line exactly, accordingly improves the anti-disaster ability of the power distribution network efficiently when the meteorological disaster occurs, meanwhile reduces line construction cost to the maximum extent and achieves important reference value for the planning of the power distribution network in the environment where meteorological disasters occur frequently.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE POWER ECONOMIC RES INST;UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: One adopts fragmented rock body water sand migration pilot system and monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses one and adopt fragmented rock body water sand migration pilot system and monitoring method, it includes support, it is provided with test cabin on described support, described test cabin includes warehouse and lower warehouse, it has been evenly arranged multiple pressure transducer in described upper warehouse, it is evenly arranged multiple pore water pressure sensor in described lower warehouse, has been equipped with layer of sand in described upper warehouse, in described lower warehouse, is equipped with the sillar layer of different lithology and lumpiness；Moving down with described top board, loose sand and sillar layer are gradually compacted, and described fragility epoxy resin water-stop sheet also moves down, and the point of described crushing rod smashes described fragility epoxy resin water-stop sheet, make described upper warehouse be connected with described lower warehouse.The migration of water sand mixture and simulation test of gushing out can be carried out in fragmented rock body, obtain the water sand parameter of migration of Different Strata combination, improve seam mining induction water burst in face and burst the reliability of sand disaster characteristic identification.

title_en: System and method for testing influences of gas dynamic disasters on mine ventilation network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and method for testing influences of gas dynamic disasters on a mine ventilation network, and belongs to the field of coal mine gas disaster research. The system is composed of an inflation module, a dynamic action module, a simulation pipe network module and a metering module. The inflation module comprises a gas cylinder, an air cylinder, pressure reducing valves, solenoid valves, flow meters, a vacuum pump, an air compressor and valves. The dynamic action module comprises an explosion container, a pressure gauge, an ignition probe, an igniter, a membrane and a draught fan. The simulation pipe network module comprises a simulation pipeline, connecting pipelines, a flange plate, a bolt and nut, a slice and a rubber band. The metering module comprises pressure sensors, a data collecting instrument and a computer. The system and method for testing the influences of the gas dynamic disasters on the mine ventilation network mainly have the advantages that the influences of the gas dynamic disasters on the mine ventilation network are found by learning the spreading characteristics of gas pressure in the pipe network, and support is provided to the prevention of the gas dynamic disasters and rescue after accidents.
assignees: UNIV ANHUI SCI & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Method for partitioning map in RoboCup rescue platform based on cluster and convex hull
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for partitioning a map in a RoboCup rescue platform based on a cluster and a convex hull and belongs to the technical field of robot simulation. For the phenomenon that the perceptual information of a robot in a RoboCup robot rescue intelligent agent simulation platform has the features of locality, relativity and inaccuracy, a method for cognizing map information before an intelligent agent acts and in the acting process is elaborated, and the method comprises the steps of conducting cluster partitioning on map buildings through a K mean value according to distances and conducting dynamic convex set recognition on burning buildings to obtain state estimation on dynamic changing objects. Thus, the cognition of the intelligent agent on the disaster environment is made to be close to the real environment, and powerful support is provided for the upper layer behavior decision making of the intelligent agent.
assignees: UNIV NANJING POSTS & TELECOMM

title_en: Method for simulating complicated cascading failures of power grids under extreme meteorological disaster conditions
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for simulating complicated cascading failures of power grids under extreme meteorological disaster conditions. The method comprises the following steps: reading all the failure set lines, calculating and merging the line lengths, and calculating the total line length; selecting failure lines according to the total line length and correspondingly setting line failures; determining the time lengths and intervals of the failures and randomly generating group-occurring successive failures; setting a simulation termination criterion which comprises a splitting criterion, a power angle instability criterion and a network resolving non-convergence criterion; and carrying out time domain simulation on the generated group-occurring successive failures until a termination condition of the simulation termination criterion is satisfied. According to the method, the conventional large power grid breakdown analysis method which takes load flow calculation and line overload as basic means is expanded, and the time domain simulation of detailed models is considered, so that the disturbance factors and performance characteristics in the blackout evolution process can be reflected more comprehensively.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Street tree wind-caused damage rapid evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a street tree wind-caused damage rapid evaluation method. A simplified model of street tree wind-caused damage is established, and according to finite element theory, tree materials are hypothesized to be isotropic and uniform, and then material physical parameters of dynamic behaviors affect tree individuals are abstracted. By giving consideration to the different types and the growth conditions of the trees, and the individual shape and character differences of the trees are great, and the material physical parameters of the street tree wind-caused damage model are regarded as the random variables. Davenport spectrum is used to represent input fluctuating wind speed, and a pseudo excitation method is used for street tree wind-caused response fast calculation. A street tree wind-caused damage criterion is defined based on bending strength, and by adopting Monte Carlo simulation, fast evaluation of street tree damage probability under a condition of different wind load levels. The street tree wind-caused damage rapid evaluation method is advantageous in that wind disaster damages on the street trees in the city areas are accurately and effectively predicted, and practical meaning is provided during making of corresponding defense measures.
assignees: UNIV TONGJI

title_en: Mountain fire disaster early-warning method for overhead power transmission line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain fire disaster early-warning method for an overhead power transmission line. The method comprises the steps of A, acquiring and obtaining mountain fire occurrence information by utilizing a monitoring module, wherein the mountain fire occurrence information comprises combustible material characteristics, a terrain factor and a meteorological factor; B, obtaining a mountain fire influence factor in the mountain fire occurrence information, and establishing a relationship through a random forest model for threshold association between a mountain fire and the mountain fire influence factor of the mountain fire; C, performing time-space process modeling of mountain fire spread through a cellular automaton with the capability of simulating a complicated natural disaster time-space evolution process, and determining a cellular conversion rule of the cellular automaton by adopting the random forest model; and D, predicting a mountain fire spread process through a cellular automaton model, estimating time of the mountain fire spread to the overhead line, and assessing the risk of overhead line shutdown in combination with external disaster information and power grid internal characteristics. The method can assist in more effectively handling power system interlocking faults caused by a natural disaster prediction effect, so that economic and personnel loss of a power grid and power utilization units is reduced.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Wind hazard risk assessment system and method for responding to climate change
title_ko: 기후 변화 대응을 위한 도시 풍해 위험도 평가 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for analyzing a city wind hazard risk to respond to a climate change. The system and the method for analyzing a city wind hazard risk to respond to a climate change is invented for necessity of proper preparation of a national level and management technique as a loss of a life and a loss of a property occur due to an increased wind-related disaster caused by recent climate and environment change. The present invention relates to the IT-based system for analyzing a city wind hazard risk to respond to a climate change and, specifically, to a system for assisting a decision maker so that the decision maker rapidly responds, by analyzing a wind hazard in a city region by considering the climate change and displaying an analyzed hazard result on a WEB-GIS-based system. To achieve the purpose of the present invention, the system for analyzing a city wind hazard risk to respond to a climate change includes: a) a strong wind hazard factor analyzing module of simulating a wind speed due to typhoon using a moving path and a central air pressure change of the typhoon and statistically analyzing future typhoon by considering the climate change; b) a weakness analyzing module of analyzing weakness of each facility using weakness DB of the facility; c) a wind hazard risk analyzing module calculating a damage probability by each grid and each administrative district using a strong wind hazard factor and strong wind fragility; and d) a wind hazard risk index analyzing module expressing a wind hazard risk index on a unit administrative district by analyzing damage probability information by each region and exposure rate information for preparing for and restoring damage.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 최근 기후 및 환경변화로 인하여 바람관련 재해가 증가하고 이로 인하여 인명손실과 재산상의 손실이 발생함에 따라 국가차원의 적절한 준비와 대응 관리 기술의 필요성으로 고안되었다.  
본 발명은 기후변화 대응을 위한 도시 풍해 위험도 평가 IT 기반 시스템에 대한 것으로, 보다 자세하게는 기후변화를 고려하여 도시지역의 풍해 위험도를 평가하고 평가된 위험도결과를 WEB-GIS기반의 시스템에서 표출하여 의사결정자에게 신속한 대응을 할 수 있도록 보조해주는 시스템에 대한 것이다.  
상기 목적을 달성하기 위한 본 발명의 기후변화 대응을 위한 도시풍해위험도 평가 시스템은; a) 태풍의 이동경로와 중심기압변화를 이용하여 태풍으로 인한 풍속을 시뮬레이션하고 기후변화를 고려하여 미래태풍을 통계적으로 분석하는 강풍위험요인평가 모듈; b) 시설물의 취약성 DB를 활용하여 각 시설물의 취약성을 평가하는 취약성평가모듈; c) 강풍위험요인과 강풍취약도를 활용하여 격자별,행정구역별 피해확율을 산출하는 풍해위험도평가모듈; d) 지역별 피해확율 정보와 피해에 대비하고 복구할 수 있는 정도인 노출도정보를 분석해서 단위 행정구역에 대한 풍해위험도 지표를 표출하는 풍해위험도지표평가모듈을 그 특징 징으로 한다.
assignees: CUBERSOLUTION

title_en: Integrated Method and System for Flood Disaster Response
title_ko: 홍수 재난 대응을 위한 통합 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated method and a system for coping with flood disasters and, more specifically to an integrated method and a system for coping with flood disasters which establish a database required for a situation such as flood disasters, evaluate facilities such as a bank, etc. in advance by using the database, and generate beforehand information for visualizing a flood in 3D. According to the present invention, information can be propagated rapidly such that the generated information can be provided quickly. Also, an efficient 3-dimensional geographic information system (GIS) space analysis is performed to enable simulation of a flood. Since various data collected before the flood is standardized in a database, data standardization and expansion can be realized, which improves convenience in using the data and addresses a problem due to non-compatibility between conventional and current systems. And, it is convenient to collect or reprocess new data and manage legacy data. When a new system or a new module is to be included, it can be easily combined or connected organically, which facilitates maintenance of the conventional system. With respect to related parties, a task can be easily performed since there is no need to change a manual when a new system is utilized. The integrated method for coping with a flood disaster comprises a data acquisition step; a facility evaluation step; a bank vulnerability evaluation step; a flood visualization step; a space analysis 3D visualization step; a dynamic presentation step; and an information propagation step.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 홍수 재난 대응을 위한 통합 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는, 홍수 재난 등의 상황에 있어 필요로 하는 데이터베이스를 구축 하고, 이에 의한 시설물, 제방 등을 미리 평가하고, 흉수의 가시화를 위하여 3차원으로 미리 정보를 생성하고, 생성된 정보를 신속하게 제공하기 위하여 빠를 정보 확산을 가능하며, 효율적인 3차원 GIS 공간분석을 수행하여 그에 따른 홍수 시율레이션이 가능하여, 홍수 재난 발생 전 수집된 다양한 데이터를 구축 및 표준화를 통해 데이터 표준화 및 확장 성을 충분히 고려할 수 있으며, 사용 용이성이 증가할 수 있고, 기존의 시스템과 신규 시스템의 연결이 용이하지 않아서 발생하는 문제를 절감 할 수 있으며, 신규데이터를 수집하거나 재가공할 시, 레거시 데이터를 관리함에 있어서도 편리할 수 있고, 시스템이나 신규 모듈 등의 구축이 있을 시, 이를 병합하거나 유기적으로 연결하기에 용이할 수 있고, 신규 시스템이나 신규 모듈 등의 구축이 있을 시, 이를 병합하거나 유기적으로 연결하기에 용이하므로 기존 시스템을 유지 보수하기에 편리하며, 유관기관의 측면에 서는 시스템을 활용할 때 매뉴얼 변경 등의 불편한 사항이 줄어들기 때문에 업무 수행이 용이할 수 있게 하는 홍수 재난 대응을 위한 통합 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: A kind of time-based initial stage power grid cascading fault simulation emulation mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of time-based initial stage power grid cascading fault simulation emulation modes comprising is formulated influence of the fuel factor to route of circuit overload, respectively the parameter of analysis circuit；When being modeled to electric network fault, consideration cascading failure, rather than influence of the single failure to system；It is proposed electric network fault overload severity index；Consider the influence that load curve changes with time to system；It recalculates the trend of network, and using calculated result forms overload index to differentiate whether route because of the passage of time leads to the m times failure, traffic overload during electric network fault is monitored to realize with this；The present invention is Study on Power Grid Planning personnel optimization electric network composition, promotes power grid anti-disaster ability and provides help, can be more comprehensively more acurrate, and finer description electric network fault evolution process early period provides reference for Study on Power Grid Planning and researcher.

title_en: Technique and equipment for preventing coal rock dynamic disaster by coal rock mass impact for mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a technology and equipment for preventing coal-rock dynamic disasters by impact of a coal-rock body for mining. The technique radially integrates a plurality of pneumatic impactor members into a tubular device, radially impacting the borehole wall with the impactor members; the generated high-strength stress wave is transmitted in the coal rock mass and causes tension, compression and shearing damage to the coal rock mass; finally, a fracture network in a certain range around the drill hole is rapidly developed, so that the pressure of the coal rock body is effectively relieved, the gas desorption and seepage are promoted, the gas content of the coal bed is reduced, the stress in the coal body is released, and the coal rock dynamic disasters such as coal and gas outburst and rock burst are prevented.

title_en: A kind of historic building structure residual life Predicting Reliability method suitable for corrosive environment
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of historic building structure residual life Predicting Reliability method suitable for corrosive environment, comprise the following steps：（1）Analyze the material time-varying model under corrosion impact；（2）Set up the Load resistance ratio for considering corrosion；And timber structure bearing capacity life prediction is realized, it is modified using Monte Carlo join probability density function method to predicting the outcome, realizes the residual life interval prediction of structure；（3）Using finite element simulation obtain consider corrosion deformation when variate, the reliability life prediction of malformation value is realized based on Weibull models coupling DSMCs；（4）Decision-making goes out the earliest time limit that structure is most likely to occur failure.The present invention can provide the range intervals for the ancient architecture timber structure ultimate life for considering corrosion and influence of damaging by worms, so as to make the decision-makings such as disaster prevention scheme and strengthening by reparative method；The present invention is except considering that bearing capacity index is realized in material aspect in addition to predicting residual useful life, it is also contemplated that the influence that deformation values index is predicted structural life-time on component or even structural level, life prediction criterion is more reasonable.
assignees: UNIV FUZHOU

title_en: Random simulation method for evaluating reliability of urban water supply pipe network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a random simulation method for evaluating the reliability of an urban water supply network, and belongs to the technical field of anti-seismic safety of urban water supply networks. The invention comprises the following steps: calculating the earthquake damage rate of the pipeline; generating a water supply network seismic damage scene based on Monte Carlo simulation; hydraulic analysis of a low-pressure water supply pipe network based on a step-by-step iteration method; and (5) calculating an anti-seismic reliability index. The method does not need to modify the pipe network system file or write additional codes to solve the hydraulic equation of the low-pressure pipe network, and has the advantages of high calculation efficiency and good stability. The method provides a new idea for water supply pipe network hydraulic simulation and reliability evaluation in earthquake, and has certain guiding significance for post-earthquake disaster relief and repair work.

title_en: A kind of Oracle RAC databases disaster tolerance switches drilling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Oracle RAC databases disaster tolerance to switch drilling method, comprises the following steps：S1 early-stage preparations inspection first) is carried out to the data syn-chronization situation between production and disaster recovery database, DB Backup implementation status, the database key parameter related to switching, database listening port and disaster tolerance network state；S2) check and prepare before switching, follow-up plan is terminated if it can not meet switching condition；S3 role switching between storage facility located at processing plant and disaster tolerance storehouse) is performed；S4) operated after service observation and switching；S5 business service externally) is provided by disaster tolerance system, if necessary to carry out switchback test, is then prepared before continuing switchback, judgement carries out database role switchback after meeting switchback condition, and is operated after carrying out service observation and switching.The present invention is able to ensure that to produce during DR test can normally switch with disaster recovery database, reduces business interruption time, avoids all kinds of Problem-Errors easily sent out during DR test.

title_en: A kind of power grid icing waves Risk Forecast Method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the meteorological disaster technical fields of electric system, it discloses a kind of power grid icing and waves Risk Forecast Method, system and storage medium, to mitigate the disaster of waving that grid power transmission circuit is subjected to, improve grid power transmission circuit reply icing and wave the ability of disaster and safely and steadily run level；The present invention initializes the parameter value of limited Boltzmann machine algorithm according to training sample data collection, then repetition learning and undated parameter value, until limited Boltzmann machine algorithm meets the convergence of training sample data collection, and pass through the precision of prediction E for verifying the limited Boltzmann machine algorithm of sample data set verification avg If precision of prediction E avg It is not presetting within precision, is then continuing undated parameter, until meeting precision of prediction；It further establishes the power grid icing based on back-propagation algorithm and waves prediction model, the parameter for finally waving prediction model to power grid icing according to back-propagation algorithm is adjusted, and is obtained icing and waved prediction model.

title_en: Method for evaluating resilience of power system under disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating restoring force of an electric power system under disasters, which comprises the following steps: 1) determining the type and nature of the disaster; 2) obtaining the type and the related fault probability of the vulnerable component under the disaster; 3) acquiring the running state of the vulnerable equipment in the disaster environment by utilizing Monte Carlo simulation; 4) performing system minimum load shedding calculation based on the direct current optimal power flow; 5) and (5) index calculation and system resistance analysis are carried out. The method can be used for rapidly solving the expected operation state and the robustness of the power system under various natural disasters and artificial disasters, the type and the characteristics of the disasters are considered in the solving process, and the restoring force promotion limiting factors of the system under the disasters can be analyzed, so that the method can be used for providing reference suggestions for disaster prevention planning and construction of the power system.

title_en: The appraisal procedure of recovery capability after a kind of electric system calamity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of appraisal procedures of recovery capability after electric system calamity：1) clear electric system damage situations, acquisition system recovery scheme；2) repair process of analog line carries out Temporal Sampling using sequential Monte Carlo simulation to faulty line operating status；3) analysis system state carries out the system minimum tangential load based on direct current optimal power flow and calculates；4) it calculates land restoration index, draw recovery curve.Equipment after being destroyed by disaster to electric system using the method for the invention carries out rapid evaluation with load restoration ability, the evaluation process has taken into account the transportational process of disaster relief personnel and disaster relief supplies, and relevant evaluation index can be utilized, the economy of system is restored after analysis calamity response speed, recovery efficiency and recovery, and the desired effect of more different recovery policies can be used for providing reference proposition for the formulation of recovery policy after electric system calamity and calamity mitigation and relief.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: A kind of power grid Rainfall Disaster Risk Forecast Method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the meteorological disaster technical field of electric system, a kind of power grid Rainfall Disaster Risk Forecast Method, system and storage medium are disclosed；To mitigate the Rainfall Disaster that transmission line of electricity is subjected to, ability and the safe and stable operation for improving transmission line of electricity reply Rainfall Disaster are horizontal, achieve the purpose that initiative is strong, degree of intelligence is high, have a wide range of application；The present invention initializes the parameter value of limited Boltzmann machine algorithm according to training sample data collection, repetition learning and undated parameter value, the convergence for meeting training sample data collection to limited Boltzmann machine algorithm verifies the precision of prediction E of limited Boltzmann machine algorithm by verifying sample data set avg If precision of prediction E avg It is not presetting within precision, is then continuing undated parameter, until meeting precision of prediction；The power grid Rainfall Disaster prediction model based on back-propagation algorithm is further established, is finally adjusted according to parameter of the back-propagation algorithm to power grid Rainfall Disaster prediction model, and obtain Rainfall Disaster risk forecast model.

title_en: Dynamic emergency evacuation method for urban rail transit line failure
abstract_en: A dynamic emergency evacuation method for urban rail transit line failure relates to the technical field of rail transit control. The problem of the secondary propagation that leads to the fact the passenger flow is detained in the network to single station evacuation ability limited is solved. Establishing an attribute set and an operation state set of each station in a network; analyzing the passenger flow state of the station; using SAS software to predict subway passenger flow in short time, and simulating the passenger flow arrival process; determining an evacuation starting point and an evacuation finishing point; constructing an emergency state rail public transport collaborative evacuation network; constructing a path dynamic selection model in the end point range; determining an optimal evacuation path; determining the required number and the operation time interval of the emergency buses; determining the distribution rule of the passenger flow to be evacuated reaching the evacuation subway station; according to the rail transit train parameters, the train conveying capacity is determined, the subway station passenger flow is combined, the resource allocation is carried out on the train capacity, and a train operation scheme in an emergency state is formulated. The passenger flow evacuation capacity of a single node is increased, and the network evacuation efficiency is improved.

title_en: Landslide disaster prediction method based on improved Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide hazard prediction method based on an improved Bayesian network, which comprises the steps of firstly establishing a landslide body monitoring and early warning system, acquiring initial landslide hazard impact factor data, carrying out standardization processing, extracting by using a PCA algorithm, and screening out main impact factors; dividing the screened main influence factor sample data into a training sample set and a test sample set according to a proportion, and dividing a landslide occurrence grade; then, a landslide prediction model based on improved Bayes is constructed, the landslide occurrence probability after the feature quantity is introduced is calculated through weighting processing, and a closed-loop learning process is added to complete landslide disaster prediction; the method disclosed by the invention is used for weighting the characteristic quantity and outputting the landslide occurrence probability by screening the main influence factors of landslide disasters in an improved Bayes model and adding a closed-loop learning link, so that the fault tolerance rate is increased, and the forecasting precision is improved.

title_en: A kind of natural gas line fire incident hazard analysis method based on danger level
abstract_en: The natural gas line fire incident hazard analysis method based on danger level that the invention discloses a kind of, the accidents such as jet bubble reactor, the scintillation occurred first using FDS fire disaster simulation software simulation natural gas line due to leakage, obtain the thermal radiation flux distributed data around accident point；Secondly, using Crystal Ball risk analysis software the data at different location are fitted with the probability distribution for obtaining thermal radiation flux at the position according to distributed data；Then, by gained probability distribution in conjunction with fire heat radiation probability equation, the distribution situation that the simulation based on Monte Carlo finds out Death probit amount is carried out；Finally, finding out the danger level of corresponding position, the risk in each region of quantitative analysis according to the reversion accumulated probability that random sampling calculates gained Death probit amount.It realizes that fire incident, which occurs, to natural gas line carries out more accurate risk analysis, and advises accordingly to administrative staff, improves safeguard procedures.
assignees: UNIV CHANGZHOU

title_en: Multi-time space scale-based electric power meteorological numerical weather forecast method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for forecasting electric power meteorological values based on multiple time-space scales, which are characterized in that collected multi-source heterogeneous electric power meteorological observation data are fused; and then obtaining a mesoscale numerical weather forecast mode, and finally carrying out probability forecast, weather forecast, short-term forecast and refined forecast on the electric power meteorological elements. The invention is based on fused electric power weather data, takes a mesoscale weather forecast mode as a core, adopts a deep learning method, a real-time four-dimensional data assimilation method, a rapid cyclic updating method, a horizontal grid resolution optimization method, a mode physical parameter disturbance method and a continuous integration method, realizes short-term, fine, probability forecast and weather forecast, can support electric power weather numerical forecast of multiple simulation functions of new energy resource assessment, short-term and ultra-short-term power forecast, disaster early warning of thunder, storm, strong wind and the like, effectively improves the accuracy of weather forecast data, and comprehensively improves the support level of a weather service power grid.

title_en: Building group earthquake damage simulation visualization system and method based on BIM
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of earthquake disaster early warning analysis, and relates to a building group earthquake disaster simulation visualization system and method based on BIM, wherein the system comprises a user management module, a model management module and a model display module, the user management module comprises a user query and user deletion unit, the model management module comprises a model query, a model uploading unit, a model deleting unit and a time course data uploading unit, the model display comprises a BIM three-dimensional model display, a BIM shaking display, a BIM collapse display, a BIM damage display and a regional fire disaster simulation unit, the accurate modeling of a building entity from appearance design to internal structure can be realized, the high-reality restoration of the conditions such as shaking, collapsing and damage of the building group when an earthquake disaster occurs is realized, the expansion of earthquake disaster reduction series work is facilitated, and the earthquake disaster damage in urban areas is effectively reduced.

title_en: Landslide occurrence time prediction method based on mixed Gaussian hidden Markov model
abstract_en: According to the landslide occurrence time prediction method based on the hybrid Gaussian hidden Markov model, firstly, displacement data of a landslide body are collected through a laser displacement sensor arranged on the landslide body, and multi-state division is carried out on the collected displacement data in a time sequence direction; then, training the divided displacement data through a Baum-welch algorithm to obtain a multi-state MOG-HMM model, and marking the divided states; and finally, carrying out current state estimation on displacement data acquired in real time by adopting a Viterbi algorithm, and taking the current estimated state as the input of a Dijkstra algorithm, thereby predicting the occurrence time of landslide. According to the method disclosed by the invention, the current landslide evolution state is deduced according to the displacement data in the landslide evolution process, and the occurrence time of landslide disasters is calculated, so that the robustness performance of a general HMM method in prediction is improved, and the accuracy of geological disaster prediction is improved.

title_en: Methods for differentiation of earthquake signal and prediction of earthquake intensity using randomly generated artificial seismic training data for an arbitrary zone
title_ko: 임의 지진구역 대상 무작위 생성 지진학습데이터를 이용한 지진여부판별 방법 및 이에 의한 진도예측 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an earthquake determination method using randomly generated seismic learning data for arbitrary seismic zones. The earthquake determination method, an earthquake determination method using an artificial neural network technique, performed by an earthquake intensity prediction system for predicting an earthquake intensity using seismic waves in a target zone, comprises the steps of: collecting past earthquake data of the target zone and deriving seismic wave characteristic data from the collected past earthquake data; performing a pseudo earthquake probability model which reflects the derived seismic wave characteristic data to randomly generate learning data on general vibration and seismic vibration for the target zone; providing the learning data generated through the pseudo earthquake probability model to artificial neural network learning; inputting, if an actual P wave is detected, the P wave to an artificial neural network to determine whether an earthquake occurs; and generating an artificial S wave to estimate a structure′s response through the artificial neural network technique and predicting a damage scale of the structure using the generated artificial S wave to provide an earthquake warning. Therefore, the earthquake determination method of the present invention can be applied to smart seismometers in a house, a building, or the like, to improve the accuracy and reliability of earthquake warnings. The earthquake determination method can be also employed in a structural health monitoring (SHM) technology in construction and civil engineering fields to analyze a seismic impact on a structure. Moreover, the earthquake determination method is applied to a construction site to enable quick early evacuation and facility control in case of a natural disaster on the construction site.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 임의 지진구역 대상 무작위 생성 지진학습데이터를 이용한 지진여부판별 방법 에 관한 것으로서, 대상 지역의 지진파를 이용하여 지진 판별 진도를 예측하는 진도예측 시스템에 의해 수행되는 인공신경망 기법을 이용한 지진여부판별 방법에 있어서, 대상 지역의 과거 지진 데이터를 수집하고, 상기 수집된 과거 지진 데이터에서 지진파 특성 데이터를 도출하는 단계; 상기 도출된 지진파 특성 데이터를 반영하여 상기 대상 지역에 대한 일반 진동 및 지진 진동의 학습 데이터를 무작위로 생성하는 의사 진동 확률 모델을 수행하는 단계; 상기 의사진동 확률 모델을 통해 생성된 학습 데이터를 인공 신경망 학습에 제공하는 단계; 실제 P파가 감지되면, 상기 감지된 P파를 상기 인공 신경망에 입력하여 지진 여부를 판별하는 단계; 및 상기 인공 신경망 기법을 통해 구조물 응답 추정을 위해 인공 S파를 생성하고, 상기 생성된 인공 S파를 이용하여 구조물의 피해 규모를 예측하여 지진 경보를 제공하는 단계를 포함한다. 
따라서, 본 발명은 주택이나 건물 등의 스마트 지진계에 적용되어 지진 경보의 정확도와 신뢰도를 향상시킬 수 있고, 건축 및 토목 분야의 구조물 건전성 모니터링(SHM) 기술에 적용되어 구조물의 지진 영향을 분석할 수 있으며, 시공 중인 구조물에도 적용되어 공사 현장에 자연재해 발생 시 신속히 조기 대피 및 조기 설비 제어를 수행할 수 있다.
assignees: DAEWOO ENG & CONSTR CO LTD

title_en: Disaster-ridden kind of coupling grid cascading failure analysis method of power grid and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of disaster-ridden kind of coupling grid cascading failure analysis method of power grid and systems, comprising: obtains power grid primary parameter and electric grid secondary parameter, establishes dynamic power grid system model；External environment data are obtained, dynamic power grid system model is inputted, are judged to obtain if there is external electrical network event of failure under initial grid operation mode since external environment causes the sequence of electric network element failure；Establish power grid mixing differential algebraic equations；Dynamic power grid system model is emulated according to the primary condition of power grid cascading fault simulation analysis and the power grid mixing differential algebraic equations of foundation；When emulation, according to admittance matrix Y bus Judge power grid whether off-the-line, if power grid not off-the-line, continues operation；Judge whether to terminate emulation；Form electric network consecutive failure accident chain；Output emulation data, overall merit power networks risk.The present invention can consider influence of the disaster-ridden kind of coupling cascading failure of relay protection acting characteristic to electric network element.
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD DISASTER PREVENTION & MITIGATION CT;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Early warning method for damage of power transmission line under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for early warning damage of a power transmission line under typhoon disasters. The method comprises the steps of collecting meteorological information, equipment operation information, micro-terrain information and real-time damage information to construct a training set; information quantization, default value processing and standardization processing are carried out on the information in the training set; establishing a power transmission line damage probability hybrid prediction model based on extreme value I type probability distribution, a random forest method and a Monte Carlo method, and calculating damage probability; and calculating risk indexes according to the damage probability, and performing emergency repair after the disaster. The prediction model has stronger adaptability and higher reliability, and can reasonably estimate the needed emergency repair resources from the macroscopic view.

title_en: The change of current becomes the intensity inverting assessment of fire fire source and temperature field prediction method and system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of changes of current to become the intensity inverting assessment of fire fire source and temperature field prediction method and system, including following content: 1) establishing the change of current and become fire disaster simulation forward direction computation model；Complete the initialization of data assimilation state vector；2) it carries out the change of current and becomes the calculating of fire disaster simulation forward direction, obtain the data such as fire spread temperature field and export；3) thermocouple and heat-flow meter monitoring data are judged whether there is, if then using the calculated result of step 2 as predicted value by exporting result after data assimilation algorithm and being transferred to step 4；If being otherwise directly transferred to step 4；4) judge whether end simulation process, if then end simulation；If the result for otherwise obtaining step 3, which returns to the change of current, becomes fire disaster simulation forward direction computation model, it is transferred to step 2.The present invention accurately can quickly realize the inverting assessment of exchange rheology fire fire source intensity, and can predict the Temperature Distribution that the change of current becomes during fire spread, become the emergency response of fire for the change of current and decision provides foundation.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING

title_en: Northwest Pacific three-dimensional oil spilling business contingency forecast and assessment system
abstract_en: The invention discloses northwest Pacific three-dimensional oil spilling business contingency forecast and assessment system, system includes that oil spilling information fast processing module, environmental information processing module, oil spilling transport module, oil overflow air slaking module, data assimilation module, DATA PROCESSING IN ENSEMBLE PREDICTION SYSTEM module, geographic information data module, visual analyzing module and System Control Center module；The present invention can be realized the Comparison study for considering the three-dimensional short-term and medium-term and long-term numerical Simulation Prediction of the northwest Pacific sea area deep-sea oil spilling under wave effect and different vertical diffusion schemes；Pre-treatment can be carried out to a variety of oil sources information and oil spilling type and carry out prediction；Forcing field outside oil spilling model can be optimized using site observation date and best interpolation assimilation method in real time, to improve forecast accuracy；It can provide DATA PROCESSING IN ENSEMBLE PREDICTION SYSTEM result；Scientific research and the design of administrative department's contingency response system etc. are prevented and reduced natural disasters with important practical value to marine ecology.
assignees: LI YAN

title_en: A kind of appraisal procedure of the power system component different degree based on restoring force
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of power system component different degree appraisal procedures based on restoring force: 1) determining the property of the type and generation of disaster；2) fallible component type and relevant probability of malfunction under disaster are obtained；3) the fault configuration situation of element in system after disaster occurs is obtained using non-sequential Monte Carlo simulation；4) optimal recovery policy model after calamity is established, proposes objective function and constraint condition；5) recovery process after calamity repeatedly simulate and obtain each element reparation moment and be ranked up using the ranking method of Aaron Copland, to obtain component importance sequence.Electric system can be sought in all kinds of natural calamities and the component importance under man-made disaster using the method for the invention, finding process has taken into account Disasters Type and feature.It can provide to refer to for the determination of element Scheme of Strengthening before the formulation and calamity of recovery policy after calamity using the component importance result that this method obtains and build.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Consider extreme meteorological dynamic power distribution network scope of power outage prediction technique and system
abstract_en: This application involves extreme meteorological dynamic power distribution network scope of power outage prediction technique and system is considered, using history meteorological disaster data, the power outage that power distribution network may occur is emulated, and obtains distribution power-off event emulation data；Establish the Bayesian network with meteorological dynamic and distribution net equipment incidence relation；The training that Bayesian network is carried out using history meteorological disaster data and distribution power-off event emulation data, is determined simulation parameter, obtains the Bayesian network of training completion；The prediction of power distribution network scope of power outage is carried out in conjunction with weather forecast.Consider the dynamic process that meteorological DYNAMIC DISTRIBUTION situation especially fully considers meteorological disaster, consider influence situation of the meteorological dynamic to power distribution network, scope of power outage is predicted in terms of the structure of power distribution network and meteorological dynamic two, avoiding condition missing causes to predict that there are more serious inaccurate situations, it can be realized accurate power distribution network scope of power outage prediction, and have the advantages that the longer prediction result of application time is more accurate.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent command system for emergency restoration of railway disasters and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent command system for emergency restoration of railway disasters and a using method thereof, belonging to the field of railways, the intelligent command system for emergency restoration of railway disasters and the using method thereof can send real-time scenes of a disaster site to a command control center through a monitoring module and a scanning module, three-dimensional simulation software on the command control center can simulate disaster relief steps, thereby simulating the optimal disaster relief steps, and then the command control center can project the optimal disaster relief steps to a two-state projection screen plate of the disaster site through a projection module, thereby facilitating the real-time command of the disaster relief process of disaster relief personnel, further controlling the condition of expansion of disaster influence caused by improper processing of the disaster relief process to be the lowest, thereby improving the safety of disaster relief efficiency, accelerating the restoration speed of railway traffic, and converting the two states of the two-state projection screen plate, the method and the device can improve the watching of disaster relief personnel on the optimal projection step, and further improve the disaster relief efficiency.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG;CHENGDU NUOBIKAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Parallel multilayer Monte Carlo double-fed asynchronous fan parameter optimization method
abstract_en: The invention provides a parallel multilayer Monte Carlo double-fed asynchronous fan parameter optimization method, which reduces the time of group intelligent decision through a parallel multilayer simulation system. The method has the technical effects that: the method can realize quick parameter optimization decision and avoid the problem of dimension disaster in the common Monte Carlo method. The method can optimize the parameters of the proportional-integral-derivative controller of the double-fed asynchronous fan.
assignees: UNIV GUANGXI

title_en: Method for predicting residual life of rotating machinery of multilayer bidirectional gate control circulation unit network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for residual life of a rotary machine of a multilayer bidirectional gating circulation unit network, which comprises the steps of collecting vibration signals; constructing a health index; constructing a network training set; constructing a multi-layer bidirectional gating circulation unit network; training a multi-layer bidirectional gating circulation unit network; network testing, estimation of residual life and acquisition of a confidence interval; and (4) predicting and evaluating the residual life. The method combines the advantages of strong feature extraction capability of deep learning, utilizes the neural network of the bidirectional gating circulation unit to carry out regression prediction, and obtains the confidence interval of the residual life by a Bootstrap method. Aiming at the problems that the model precision of a recurrent neural network model is sensitive to the value of the learning rate in the training process, and the prediction performance of the model is influenced by overhigh and overlow, the natural index is utilized to attenuate the learning efficiency to train the neural network efficiently. The method can accurately predict the residual life and the confidence interval of the rotary machine, can greatly reduce expensive unscheduled maintenance, and avoids the occurrence of disasters.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Emergency regulation and control equipment reliability assessment method and system under disaster causing factor condition
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating the reliability of emergency control equipment under the condition of disaster causing factors, which integrate artificial intelligent machine learning into a reliability model, improve the accuracy and scientificity of an evaluation result and provide guidance for engineering practice of emergency control technical equipment. The method comprises the following steps: disaster situation feature simulation, namely determining a disaster situation disaster factor distribution rule according to a disaster factor evolution rule of fire, gas explosion and coal rock dynamic, and performing disaster situation simulation; the reliability analysis of the emergency control equipment comprises the steps of analyzing constituent units of the emergency control equipment, determining fault modes, fault reasons and fault influence factors of the constituent units, acquiring probability information of the fault modes, the fault reasons and the fault influence factors of the constituent units by using statistical data, determining logic relations among the fault influence factors, and carrying out the reliability analysis of the emergency control equipment based on a Bayesian network.

title_en: Typhoon disaster power distribution network tower fault prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting faults of a power distribution network tower in typhoon disasters, wherein real-time collected meteorological station data are input into a trained power distribution network tower fault prediction model based on a BP (back propagation) neural network, so that an output result of the neural network is obtained, and whether the tower has a trip fault or not is predicted; the training sample of the power distribution network tower fault prediction model based on the BP neural network comprises the following steps: selecting partial fault and non-fault samples from the new fault sample set and the non-fault sample set; the new fault sample set is formed by oversampling an original fault sample by adopting an SMOTE method; the new non-fault sample set is formed by undersampling the original non-fault sample by adopting an OSS method; the method can accurately predict the fault tripping of the power distribution network tower in the typhoon disaster occurrence process, can provide reference for typhoon disaster defense such as first-aid repair material allocation, rapid first-aid repair after failure and the like, and has certain theoretical value and engineering value.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;NARI GROUP CORP;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Rapid prediction method for gas explosion shock wave propagation state for emergency rescue
abstract_en: The invention provides a rapid prediction method for a gas explosion shock wave propagation state for emergency rescue. The method comprises the steps of obtaining big data of propagation states of disaster-causing factors such as gas explosion shock waves and flame propagation near a typical explosion source, a typical straight roadway and a typical roadway intersection by utilizing numerical simulation or an explosion experiment, taking factors influencing the gas explosion shock waves and flame propagation as input nodes of an artificial neural network, taking disaster-causing factors such as pressure, temperature and toxic and harmful gases as output nodes, establishing a rapid prediction model of the gas explosion shock wave propagation state, effectively solving the problems of large time consumption and the like in the processes of numerical simulation modeling, calculation, data analysis and processing and the like, and controlling the prediction of the full wind network propagation state of the explosion shock waves and flame to be completed within 60 seconds under the condition of assuming the known explosion source position and the explosion-participating gas content, thereby greatly meeting the requirements of emergency rescue.
assignees: UNIV LIAONING TECHNICAL

title_en: Power distribution network fault assessment and scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating and scheduling power distribution network faults, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing and obtaining a city digital distribution network topological map based on a geographic information system and distribution network construction information; positioning fault point distribution information based on distribution network terminal monitoring data and marketing data; planning a routing inspection path; the unmanned aerial vehicle group shoots images of the routing inspection path and fault points; inputting the shot image into a pre-trained convolutional neural network, and evaluating the disaster situation and the traffic situation to obtain an evaluation result; constructing and obtaining an optimal scheduling model according to a preset strategy; solving the optimal scheduling model by using a simulated annealing algorithm to obtain an optimal scheduling scheme; and implementing scheduling according to the optimal scheduling scheme. The method and the system can quickly locate the fault point and evaluate the disaster situation after the extreme meteorological event occurs, and provide an optimal emergency repair scheduling scheme and an emergency repair progress monitoring function.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: Urban accident disaster evolution simulation and risk prediction early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban accident disaster evolution simulation and risk prediction early warning method, and belongs to the technical field of machine learning. By establishing an urban accident disaster data warehouse fusing multiple types of data and constructing an urban accident disaster evolution simulation and risk prediction early warning machine learning prediction model by using a machine learning method, the rapid and accurate prediction of the accident disaster evolution and the rapid prediction and early warning of the accident disaster risk are realized. The data warehouse integrates urban accident disaster historical data, urban accident disaster experimental data, real-time monitoring data of various sensors and urban accident disaster evolution numerical simulation data with high confidence level. The urban accident disaster evolution numerical simulation data with high confidence level is generated by a numerical simulation model verified by accident disaster historical data or experimental data or generated by a numerical simulation model based on data assimilation technology for fusing the numerical simulation model with the accident historical data or the experimental data, so that the problem of insufficient data quantity of a data warehouse is solved.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING;UNIV PEOPLES PUBLIC SECURITY CHINA

title_en: Pre-disaster rush repair personnel pre-deployment method for improving power grid recovery speed
abstract_en: The invention provides a pre-deployment method for pre-disaster rush-repair personnel, which can improve the recovery speed of a power grid, and comprises the following steps: 1) after an upcoming disaster is predicted, combining weather prediction and geographic information of a power grid, obtaining fault probability of each element according to a vulnerability curve of the power grid element, and generating a fault scene under the disaster through time sequence Monte Carlo simulation; 2) acquiring information of a power grid, a repair team and a deployable position, establishing a two-stage random planning model, making a deployment scheme of emergency repair personnel in the first stage, and performing repair and recovery collaborative optimization according to a fault scene in the second stage to minimize power failure loss; 3) and decoupling and solving the two-stage stochastic programming model by a Progressive Hedging (PH) algorithm. The emergency repair personnel are deployed in the key link of the power grid before the upcoming meteorological disaster is predicted, so that the emergency response capability of the power grid after the disaster is improved, the repair of the fault element is accelerated, and a reasonable suggestion is provided for the formulation of the power grid emergency plan.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Earthquake disaster loss prediction and evaluation method and system based on Softmax regression model
abstract_en: A seismic disaster damage prediction and evaluation method and system based on a Softmax regression model relate to the technical field of seismic disaster damage prediction and evaluation, solve the problem of how to improve the accuracy of seismic disaster damage prediction and the training speed, use different seismic disaster damage degree grades as classification labels of the Softmax regression classification model, select past seismic disaster characteristic data for training, and predict the past seismic disaster damage by using the Softmax regression classification model; inputting new earthquake disaster characteristic data and classification labels in a Softmax regression classification model; judging the classification weight of the input data belonging to each earthquake disaster damage degree grade; determining a classification label corresponding to the input data according to the classification weight, thereby determining the damage degree grade of the new earthquake disaster; compared with a Back Propagation (BP) neural network and a Support Vector Machine (SVM), the method has the advantages of stronger capability of distinguishing the earthquake disaster loss, high test precision and short test time.
assignees: HEFEI INST PUBLIC SAFETY RES TSINGHUA UNIV;ANHUI THEONE SAFETY TECH CO LTD;HEFEI CITY LIFELINE ENG SAFETY OPERATION MONITORING CENTER

title_en: Automatic driving test scene construction method, device and equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and equipment for constructing an automatic driving test scene and a readable storage medium, wherein an element scene is extracted from a real traffic scene to establish an element scene description model, a description variable value is selected from an element scene description variable distribution interval, and the description variable is randomly sampled according to the description variable distribution by an importance sampling-based Monte Carlo method to generate a test element scene; the method can directly simulate an actual complex system, effectively solve the problem of result distortion caused by the simplification of the complex system and avoid the problem of dimension disaster that numerical solution errors of high-dimension problems rapidly increase along with the increase of dimensions; by adopting the high-risk scene strengthening generation method, more high-risk scenes are generated with smaller calculation overhead, the number of the high-risk scenes in the generated scenes is effectively increased, the number of the low-risk scenes is reduced, and the testing efficiency is improved.
assignees: CHANGAN UNIV

title_en: River mouth area extreme storm surge water level calculation method based on JPM-OS-Q model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a JPM-OS-Q model-based estuary region extreme storm surge water level calculation method, which comprises the following steps: s1, establishing a hydrodynamic force numerical model and verifying the reliability of the model; s2, clearly researching main influence factors of the extreme water level of the storm surge in the area, introducing upstream runoff, and establishing a probability model of each driving element; s3, generating astronomical tides based on a Monte Carlo stochastic model, generating typhoon paths changing along with time based on historical typical typhoons and mobile wind field and air pressure field parameters caused by each generated typhoon; and S4, predicting the extremely high water level of the estuary region based on the discrete product-solving joint probability optimization model. The method for calculating the extreme storm surge in the estuary area improves the parameter selection, typhoon path and other settings of the original JPM-OS-Q model, simulates and calculates the extreme storm surge high water level in the high recurrence period of the estuary area, improves the prediction level of the extreme water level, improves the marine disaster prevention and reduction capability, and can be widely applied to the calculation of the extreme storm surge in the estuary area.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Storm surge extreme water level prediction method based on random statistical model and hydrodynamic model coupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a storm surge extreme water level prediction method based on coupling of a random statistical model and a hydrodynamic model, and belongs to the technical field of ocean science and ocean engineering. The method comprises the following steps: s1, collecting hydrological and topographic data in the area, establishing a Delft3D hydrodynamic model and verifying; s2, establishing a main historical typhoon database and a Roche storm surge driving element set; s3, recombining storm surge driving elements based on Monte Carlo; s4, selecting and verifying a proper typhoon field model; and S5, simulating and predicting the extreme high water level based on the storm surge of the typical historical typhoon. The method comprehensively considers the influence of climate change and sea level rise on the extreme water level value, can be used for predicting the extreme water levels in different reappearance periods and numerical forecasting of storm surge, is favorable for preventing and reducing disasters so as to reduce the disaster loss of coastal vulnerable areas, and is favorable for reasonable planning and design.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Digital twin-based disaster guidance system for each floor
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 기반의 층별 재난대응시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster guidance system, which simulates evacuation behavior by applying various disaster situation modeling information to a digital twin building with digital twin technology applied to a multi-story building, thereby guiding evacuees to an optimal evacuation route which minimizes loss of life and evacuation time in the event of a disaster. More specifically, the present invention derives evacuation route information according to the situation of each floor of a digital twin building, but converts the evacuation route information for each floor into a DB as standard action procedure (SOP) data, which minimizes congestion by considering spatial information and personnel information for each floor, and when the disaster occurs, the evacuation route information for each floor corresponding to the disaster characteristic value information is matched and outputted to a guide module provided on each floor, thereby inducing the evacuees to accurately and stably recognize the evacuation route which matches the floor on which they are located and to evacuate quickly.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 다층 건물에 디지털 트윈 기술을 적용한 디지털 트윈 건물에 다양한 재난상황 모델링정보를 적용하여 대피행동을 시뮬레이션함으로써, 재난 발생 시 인명손실과 대피시간이 최소화된 최적의 대피경로를 대피자들에게 안내하는 재난대응시스템에 관한 것이다. 
보다 구체적으로는 디지털 트윈 건물의 각 층별 상황에 맞게 대피경로정보를 도출하되, 층별 공간정보와 인원정보를 고려하여 몰림 현상 등을 최소화시킨 층별 대피경로정보를 표준행동절차(SOP) 데이터로서 DB화하고, 실제 재난 발생 시 재난 특성치정보에 대응되는 층별 대피경로정보를 각 층에 구비된 안내모듈에 매칭 출력시킴으로써, 대피자들이 자신이 위치한 층과 매칭되는 대피로를 정확하고 안정적으로 인지하여 신속히 대피할 수 있도록 유도하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: CONNETIVITY & INTELLIGENCE SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Cascading failure simulation method for thermoelectric coupling system under extremely cold disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a cascading failure simulation method of a thermoelectric coupling system under an extremely cold disaster, which comprises the following steps: acquiring natural disaster meteorological data and system load data at the time t; calculating the line fault probability based on the Markov state space; randomly switching off the line according to the line fault probability, and updating the network topology of the thermoelectric coupling system; performing thermoelectric coupling load flow calculation based on the updated thermoelectric coupling system, and identifying a power out-of-limit circuit; and disconnecting the power out-of-limit line, updating the network topology of the thermoelectric coupling system, and calculating the load loss of the thermoelectric coupling system at the moment t. The method calculates the line fault probability of the thermoelectric coupling system under the extremely cold disaster based on the Markov state space, identifies the power out-of-limit line based on the power flow calculation, disconnects the fault line and the power out-of-limit line, can calculate the load loss of the thermoelectric coupling system under the disaster, and can simulate the cascading faults of the thermoelectric coupling system in the disaster occurrence process.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Dynamic risk analysis method for hazardous chemical substance fire domino accident under multi-disaster coupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic risk analysis method for a hazardous chemical substance fire domino accident under multi-disaster coupling, which comprises the steps of collecting basic information; analyzing the vulnerability of the equipment under the action of natural disasters to determine a possible initial accident scene; analyzing the equipment states at different time steps by using a distribution model of accident parameters; counting the states of the devices appearing at different time steps through Monte Carlo simulation; after all Monte Carlo simulations are completed, the dynamic domino accident probability is calculated. Under the coupling of multiple disasters, the evolution process of the fire domino accident has close time correlation, and the accident risk is larger. By adopting the method, the dynamic risk assessment of the fire domino accident of the large-area chemical equipment can be realized, and important decision support is provided for domino accident prevention and control.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: Method for calculating fault probability and reliability of same-tower multi-circuit power transmission line
