abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power transmission line fault calculation, and particularly relates to a method for calculating fault probability and reliability of a same-tower multi-circuit power transmission line; it comprises the following steps: calculating the fault probability of the same-tower multi-circuit power transmission line by a statistical analysis method; carrying out state simulation on the same-tower multi-circuit power transmission line by a Monte Carlo method; calculating the operation reliability index of the same-tower multi-circuit power transmission line; the method comprises the steps of firstly carrying out statistical analysis on fault probabilities of various natural disasters, then simulating the state of the line based on a Monte Carlo method, and finally calculating the reliability indexes of the line, wherein the reliability indexes comprise three indexes of load loss probability (LOLP), expected value of power shortage (EDNS) and expected value of power shortage (EENS).
assignees: ZHUMADIAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Mining area ecological environment restoration system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a mining area ecological environment restoration system, which relates to the field of ecological restoration, and aims to solve the problem that landslide disasters can occur under the rainy condition in the current ecological environment restoration scheme, and the environmental restoration effect is poor, the system comprises a waterproof layer laid on a side slope and a bearing component arranged on the upper side of the waterproof layer, wherein the bearing component comprises a plurality of mutually connected bearing trays, each bearing tray comprises a bottom plate and side plates vertically and fixedly connected at the edge positions of four sides of the bottom plate, the outer side surfaces of the side plates are respectively and fixedly connected with a clamping block, the outer side surfaces of the side plates are provided with clamping grooves, and the two bearing trays are attached to ensure that the clamping blocks are respectively embedded into the corresponding clamping grooves; the bottom plate is respectively provided with a plurality of through holes; a plurality of fixed drill rods are respectively arranged on the bottom plate and penetrate through the bottom plate to be inserted into the side slope; the bearing tray is provided with a soil improvement layer. The utility model discloses have the promotion and carry out prosthetic effect to the ecology, reduce the effect that phenomenons such as landslide appear.
assignees: BEIKUANGCHENG ECOLOGICAL TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Oil gas major infrastructure multi-disaster accident coupling three-dimensional simulation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-disaster accident coupling three-dimensional simulation system for major oil and gas infrastructure, which comprises an accident three-dimensional simulation module, an accident chain evolution prediction module, a model unit and a database module. The accident three-dimensional simulation module and the accident chain evolution prediction module are respectively connected with the model unit and the database module through signals; and the accident three-dimensional simulation module is in signal connection with the accident chain evolution prediction module. On the basis of the existing Natech accident analysis method, a Natech accident multi-disaster coupling link of a major infrastructure for oil and gas storage and transportation is considered, and all potential accident links are identified; in daily management, the probability and the accident consequence of accidents of each unit under the coupling of multiple kinds of disasters are analyzed, and a basis is provided for the reasonable arrangement of safety protection facilities and emergency evacuation drilling; in the emergency rescue stage after the accident occurs, the most probable propagation path and evolution time of the accident under the coupling of multiple kinds of disasters are analyzed, and decision support is provided for the development of emergency rescue actions.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: Remote sensing image small target detection method based on context and cascade structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing image small target detection method based on context and a cascade structure, and belongs to the technical field of image processing. The method comprises the following steps: 1) Acquiring a training sample and a test sample; 2) Constructing a remote sensing image small target detection network model; 3) Training a remote sensing image small target detection network model; 4) And acquiring a detection result of the remote sensing image small target. According to the invention, the context module frame is introduced, so that the target area is used for context sensing capability, the problem of difficult small target positioning is effectively solved, the quality of the prediction boundary frame is improved through the cascade structure, higher detection precision is realized, and the method can be used in the fields of resource exploration, natural disaster early warning, city planning, unmanned aerial vehicle target identification and the like.

title_en: Runoff simulation method and system based on SOM-BPNN model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a runoff simulation method and system based on a SOM-BPNN model, belongs to the technical field of runoff simulation, and aims to capture various features of runoff and improve the runoff simulation precision. The method comprises the following steps: multi-source data acquisition and processing; screening key influence factors; building an SOM neural network clustering model; constructing a SOM-BPNN runoff simulation model; and (4) runoff simulation. The method comprises the steps of firstly, carrying out unsupervised clustering on a sample data set by using an SOM model, and constructing a back propagation artificial neural network model according to the clustered sub-sample set to carry out runoff simulation. According to the method, two artificial neural network models are coupled together, the clustered sub-sample set is beneficial to back-propagation of the artificial neural network for multi-aspect feature learning of complex data, the runoff simulation precision of traditional machine learning can be further improved, and effective auxiliary decision means and solid theoretical basis can be provided for watershed water resource planning, flood control, disaster reduction and comprehensive treatment.
assignees: INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS

title_en: Method for identifying fragile line of electric power system in response to hurricane disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying a fragile line of an electric power system for dealing with hurricane disasters, which comprises the following steps of firstly, respectively quantifying the influence of hurricane wind speed and line tide out-of-limit on line fault probability; then, the failure of the power system under an extreme disaster such as hurricane is described as a continuous disturbance process considering the continuous influence of strong wind; then, simulating the faults of the system under the disaster by adopting a Monte Carlo simulation method to obtain a large number of cascading fault accident chains; and then constructing a fault association diagram CFGPD under continuous disturbance describing a line fault sequence and loss conditions, and finally providing a fragile line identification mode based on the CFGPD. According to the method, the influence degree of the disaster on the power system is calculated from two dimensions of time and space, and the load loss of the system is greatly reduced by taking corresponding reinforcement measures on the identified fragile line, so that support is provided for disaster prevention.

title_en: Landslide deformation displacement prediction method for improving BP neural network
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of neural networks, and discloses a landslide deformation displacement prediction method for an improved BP neural network, which comprises the following steps: collecting landslide training data and constructing a prediction data set; normalizing the prediction data set; establishing a BP neural network model by adopting an ant colony algorithm, and calculating the optimal solution of the BP neural network model; training the BP neural network model by adopting an optimal solution to obtain a landslide prediction model; and correcting the landslide prediction model according to the time error sequence to obtain a prediction result. According to the landslide prediction method and device, based on landslide historical monitoring data, a landslide prediction model is established by improving a BP (back propagation) data network, accurate prediction of landslide disasters is achieved under the condition that multiple influence factors exist and the influence factors show nonlinear changes, monitoring cost and construction cost are reduced through reasonable planning and design, and life and property safety of people is effectively protected.
assignees: JIANGXI NUCLEAR INDUSTRY SURVEYING AND MAPPING INST GROUP CO LTD;JIANGXI MANPU INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;JIANGSU KEBO SPACE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for improving toughness of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for improving toughness of a power distribution network, which are used for evaluating importance of power distribution network components in typhoon weather, establishing an element fault rate model under storm action, sampling the state of a wind power generation system by adopting a non-sequential Monte Carlo simulation method, establishing an optimal recovery strategy model and sequencing the importance of the components; acquiring fault conditions when disasters occur, and preferentially recovering elements with high importance according to the determined sequence to realize the improvement of the robustness of the power distribution network; the method comprises the steps of pre-deploying a mobile emergency power generation vehicle before a disaster and performing real-time scheduling after the disaster to form a plurality of micro-grids, establishing an objective function by taking the minimum power failure time of important loads in different scenes as a target, forming an MILP problem by the objective function and constraint conditions, obtaining the real-time distribution condition of the mobile emergency power generation vehicle after the disaster by solving the corresponding problem, and completing the recovery and the promotion of the power distribution network. The method and the device realize the improvement of the robustness of the power distribution network; the fault recovery time of the power distribution network is shortened, and the rapidity of power distribution network recovery is realized.

title_en: Method and system for simulating cascading failure of thermoelectric coupling system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a system for simulating cascading failures of a thermoelectric coupling system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring natural disaster meteorological data and system load data at the time t; calculating the fault probability of the line based on the natural disaster meteorological data, and updating the performance state of the thermoelectric equipment; randomly disconnecting the line based on the fault probability of the line, updating the topological structure of the thermoelectric coupling system network, and determining the current operation mode; performing thermoelectric coupling load flow calculation based on the current operation mode; analyzing the calculation result of the thermoelectric coupling load flow, and counting out the line with out-of-limit power; if no power out-of-limit line exists, counting the total line disconnection condition within the time t, and determining the load loss in the thermoelectric coupling system based on the system load data; and randomly disconnecting the line with the power exceeding the limit with a preset probability, updating the network topology of the system, determining the current operation mode, and then returning to the thermocouple load flow calculation and circulating until the line without the power exceeding the limit.
assignees: UNIV QINGHAI;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Airport emergency drilling method and system based on digital twins
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of computers, and provides an airport emergency drilling method and system based on digital twins, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring airport operation data, wherein the operation data comprises positions, operation data, signals, coupling relations of all equipment and buildings and quality information reflecting the operation states of the equipment and the buildings; establishing an emergency drilling digital twin model according to airport operation data; the emergency drilling data are input into an emergency drilling digital twin model to obtain an emergency drilling result, the emergency drilling digital twin model is established according to airport operation data, the airport operation data contain a coupling relation and can represent the damaged propagation relation of equipment and a building in an emergency state, the finally obtained emergency drilling result can reflect the space and the time sequence of the propagation of accident disasters, and corresponding countermeasures can be formulated according to the damaged propagation relation.
assignees: UNIV CIVIL AVIATION CHINA

title_en: Intelligent mine scene oriented digital twin evolution mechanism and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of machine vision, computer simulation and Internet of things, and discloses a digital twin evolution mechanism for an intelligent mine scene. The digital twin evolution mechanism and method for the intelligent mine scene are characterized in that a conventional mathematical simulation model is distinguished by a digital twin technology, the digital twin model emphasizes interaction between reality and can be updated and dynamically evolved in real time, so that dynamic real mapping of a physical world is realized, an immersive visualization technology can help a user to know mine disasters more clearly, more thoroughly and more abundantly, a three-dimensional virtual space can be simulated by applying a visual display component based on a 3R interaction technology, physical equipment in an intelligent energy system is displayed in front of the user in an almost real state, and the operation and control of a physical entity, an information network and a simulation model are indirectly realized through the operation and control of a virtual body.
assignees: SINOSTEEL MAANSHAN GENERAL INSTITUTE OF MINING RES CO LTD

title_en: Hull stress monitoring system using digital twin and prediction method for fatigue fracture of ship
title_ko: 디지털 트윈을 이용한 선체응력 모니터링 시스템 및 이를 이용한 선박의 피로 파괴 예측 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a hull stress monitoring system using a digital twin and a prediction method for fatigue fracture of a ship using the same, which are able to measure the stress of a hull by using one or more stress sensors placed on the hull, measure the corrosion degree of an outer plate of the hull by using an electric conductivity, add an environmental outer force information based on the measured stress and corrosion degree of the hull, and predict the fatigue fracture possibility of the ship after a simulation. Accordingly, the present invention is able to monitor the status of the ship in real time, collect various data in real time, constantly and simultaneously measure the data, make a database with the collected data, make it possible to perform the integrated management in accordance with the measuring point, perform a simulation of the collected data, and notify a user to perform the prevention and repair for a stress on the hull greater than a limit value or a measured region where corrosion occurs so that the user can take an immediate action. In addition, the present invention is able to predict the stress and the corrosion degree on the hull for a planned path for navigation through a simulation, prevent the fatigue fracture such as a crack or a cut which could occur on the hull, prevent a disaster on the sea, and extend the life of the ship.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 디지털 트윈을 이용한 선체응력 모니터링 시스템 및 이를 이용한 피로 파괴 예측 방법에 관한 것으로, 선체에 구비된 적어도 하나 이상의 응력 센서를 이용하여 선체의 응력을 측정하고, 전기 전도도를 이용하여 상기 선체의 외판의 부식 정도를 측정하며, 측정된 선체의 응력 및 부식 정도를 기초로 환경외력 정보를 추가하여 시뮬레이션 후 선박의 피로 과괴 가능성을 예측하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
이것에 의해, 선박의 상태를 실시간으로 감시하고 각종 데이터를 실시간으로 수집함으로써, 데이터의 연속적이고 동시적인 측정을 할 수 있고, 수집된 데이터를 데이터베이스화하여 측정지점에 따른 통합관리가 가능해지며, 수집된 데이터를 시뮬레이션 함으로써 선체에 가해지는 응력이 한계값 보다 큰 경우나 부식이 일어나고 있는 측정 지역에 대해서 예방 및 수리를 진행할 수 있도록 사용자에게 알림으로 즉각적인 조치가 가능하다. 
또한, 운항 예정 경로에 대하여 선체에 가해질 응력과 부식 정도를 시뮬레이션을 통해 예측하여 선체에 발생할 균열 또는 절단과 같은 피로 파괴를 방지하여, 해난을 방지할 수 있으며 선박의 수명을 연장할 수 있는 효과를 가진다.
assignees: KOREA MARITIME UNIV IND ACAD

title_en: Power grid operation risk situation sensing method for disaster weather
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid operation risk situation perception method facing to disaster weather. The method is based on a Bayesian network with time-varying wind speed, and a power grid time-varying risk propagation model considering the trend transfer caused by wind speed and disconnection faults is established; solving the running state parameters of the power grid by adopting a Monte Carlo simulation method of Latin hypercube sampling and combining an optimal direct current flow model; and constructing a power grid operation risk situation perception index system, and realizing presentation and prediction of line risk situation, load level situation and power grid toughness situation. An effective real-time perception method is provided for the power grid operation risk situation facing to the disaster weather.
assignees: UNIV HUBEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Multi-disaster power distribution network elasticity assessment method considering fault linkage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-disaster power distribution network elasticity evaluation method considering fault cascading, which comprises the following steps: step S1, modeling various disaster feature failure rates; step S2, based on sequential Monte Carlo simulation, the time sequence characteristics of the element in the disaster process are reserved, and an element running state model formed by a basic range fault rate and a characteristic fault rate is established; s3, analyzing the nonlinear association degree of the trend state characterization quantity sequences of the lines and the nodes in the N-1 scene set and the N-2 scene set through the gray theory, and establishing a coupling relation between fault scenes; s4, establishing a LLD index, an SEDT index and an economic index which comprehensively consider the load loss degree and the maximum frequency change rate of the active unbalance initial moment to form a weighted elasticity-economic space evaluation system, and carrying out elasticity evaluation by measuring the composite entropy weight Euclidean distance between the scene cluster center and the perfect elasticity point; the fault linkage in the disaster process can be prevented and inhibited, and the elasticity of the power transmission network in extreme weather is improved.

title_en: Simulation method and related device based on GIS system and model digital modeling
abstract_en: The application discloses a simulation method based on GIS (geographic information system) and model digital modeling and a related device. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a mine model through modeling based on digital information stored in a GIS system, wherein the mine model at least comprises a three-dimensional model of a mine, and the three-dimensional model of the mine is used as a preset constraint condition in a simulation process; carrying out digital modeling according to data acquired by sensors of a mine, structural mechanical data of the mine and a three-dimensional model of the mine to obtain a preset simulation model; and inputting data acquired by the sensor of the mine into the preset simulation model to obtain the digital twin mine system. The application solves the technical problem that an effective rescue scheme cannot be obtained in a simulation mode in the current system. The application provides rescue analysis prediction when underground mine disaster occurs based on the digital twin mine system.

title_en: Urban traffic lifeline construction method and system in extreme stormy weather
abstract_en: The application relates to a method and a system for constructing an urban traffic life line in extreme stormy weather, wherein the method comprises the following steps: carrying out rainstorm waterlogging simulation; removing waterlogging invalid road sections, and carrying out traffic simulation on the reserved effective road network to obtain severely congested road sections; according to the traffic accident data, analyzing black spots of urban road accidents, and obtaining a high-risk road section; combining the results of storm waterlogging simulation, traffic simulation and urban road accident black spot analysis, and identifying an initial traffic life line set; judging whether the traffic life line set meets the expected requirement, if so, outputting the urban traffic life line set in extreme stormwater weather, otherwise, perfecting the water drainage waterlogging prevention facility with the aim of recovering the use function of part of the invalid road sections, and re-identifying the corrected traffic life line set until the corrected traffic life line set meets the requirement. The method and the system are beneficial to identifying and perfecting the life line of the urban traffic and improving the disaster resistance capability of the urban traffic in extreme stormwater weather.

title_en: Urban water supply pipe network post-earthquake analysis and optimization method based on time delay simulation
abstract_en: A post-earthquake analysis and optimization method for an urban water supply pipe network based on time delay simulation relates to the technical field of safety risk assessment and comprises the following steps: s1: generating a leakage scene after the urban water supply pipe network is shaken: s2: analyzing the water demand space-time characteristics of the urban water consumption node after the earthquake: s3: calculating the delay reliability of the post-earthquake urban water supply node: s4: determining the optimized repair sequence of the damaged pipelines after the earthquake: s5: and (4) optimizing a dispatching model by a post-earthquake pipe network restoration team. The method adopts a Monte Carlo method to simulate a randomly generated earthquake damage scene of the water supply network, determines the time-space change relation of water demand/water consumption of user nodes after the earthquake by combining with the population evacuation rule, analyzes the hydraulic function of the water supply network after the earthquake based on a pressure driving node water distribution model, establishes an optimized model for restoring the functions of the pipe network after the earthquake by considering pipeline repair sequencing and maintenance team dispatching, and determines the restoration strategy of the earthquake damage pipeline in the water supply network.
assignees: UNIV HEBEI TECHNOLOGY;TIANJIN URBAN PLANNING AND DESIGN RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Disaster evacuation control and management system based on digital twin
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 기반의 재난 대피 제어 및 관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a digital twin-based disaster evacuation control and management system, which comprises: a disaster detection device installed in a designated place within a building or facility and using a plurality of sensors to detect the occurrence of a disaster damaging the building or facility; an evacuation control device controlling operations of a plurality of evacuation equipment to safely evacuate people existing in the building or facility according to the occurrence of the disaster detected by the disaster detection device; a terminal location tracking device detecting a radio signal transmitted from at least one user terminal wirelessly communicating within the building or facility to detect location tracking information of each user terminal; and a central control center receiving information on the occurrence of the disaster detected from the disaster detection device and the location tracking information of each user terminal detected from the terminal location tracking device to identify the type and location of the disaster on the basis of disaster prevention management information and evacuation control information for response to each disaster stored in a separate database and the location tracking information of each user terminal, performing a disaster prevention simulation on the basis of a preset digital twin to generate a specific control signal according to disaster prediction result information for the disaster so that the plurality of evacuation equipment equipped in the building or facility operate, and transmitting the control signal to the evacuation control device. Accordingly, when a disaster occurs, an optimal evacuation route for people is predicted and various types of safety-related facilities and related facilities that have already been installed are controlled/regulated, thereby providing an effect of minimizing damage to human life and property.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 디지털 트윈 기반의 재난 대피 제어 및 관리 시스템에 관한 것으로, 건물 또는 시설 내의 지정된 장소에 설치되며, 복수의 센서를 이용하여 해당 건물 또는 시설 내의 피해를 줄 수 있는 재난사고 상황의 발생을 감지하는 재난발생 감지장치와, 재난발생 감지장치로부터 감지된 재난사고 상황의 발생에 따라 해당 건물 또는 시설 내에 존재하는 사람들을 안전하게 대피시킬 수 있도록 복수의 대피장비들의 동작을 제어하는 재난대피 제어장치와, 해당 건물 또는 시설 내에서 무선 통신하는 적어도 하나의 사용자 단말로부터 송출되는 무선신호를 감지하여 각 사용자 단말의 위치 추적정보를 검출하는 단말위치 추적장치와, 재난발생 감지장치로부터 감지된 재난사고 상황의 발생정보 및 단말위치 추적장치로부터 검출된 각 사용자 단말의 위치 추적정보를 제공받아 별도의 데이터베이스(DB)에 기 저장된 재난사고 상황별 대응을 위한 방재관리정보 및 재난대피 제어정보와 함께 각 사용자 단말의 위치 추적정보를 바탕으로 재난사고의 종류 및 발생 위치를 파악함과 아울러 기 설정된 디지털 트윈 기반의 재난사고 방재예측 시뮬레이션을 수행하여 해당 재난사고 상황에 대한 방재예측 결과정보에 따라 해당 건물 또는 시설 내에 구비된 복수의 대피 장비들이 동작되도록 특정의 제어신호를 생성하여 상기 재난대피 제어장치로 전송하는 중앙 관제센터를 포함함으로써, 해당 재난사고 발생 시 사람들의 최적 대피 경로를 예측하고, 여러 종류의 안전 관련 시설물 및 기 설치된 관련 시설물에 대한 제어/통제를 진행하여 인명 및 재산 피해를 최소화할 수 있는 효과가 있다.
assignees: ELSOLTEC;LEE SO YOUNG

title_en: Multi-state association infrastructure network elasticity optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network elasticity optimization method for a multi-state association infrastructure, which comprises the following steps: step 1, collecting the structure and operation information of a related infrastructure network; step 2, establishing an operation strategy optimization model of the associated network; step 3, establishing a two-stage stochastic programming model; step 4, processing the two-stage random programming model into a mixed integer linear programming model; step 5, generating a large number of disaster scenes by using a Monte Carlo simulation method and reducing the number of the generated scenes by using a scene reduction technology; step 6, solving the two-stage random programming model after the linearization treatment by adopting an L-shaped method; and 7, solving the optimal protection strategy of the first-stage associated network and displaying the optimal protection strategy in an image mode. The invention can help a decision maker to seek the optimal protection strategy of the transport node and the link of the associated infrastructure network, improve the overall elasticity and the capacity of meeting the requirement of the associated network to the maximum extent, and reduce the influence of various disaster events.
assignees: UNIV ELECTRONIC SCI & TECH CHINA

title_en: Historical building fire monitoring method and system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for monitoring a fire disaster of a historical building based on a digital twin technology, wherein the method for monitoring the fire disaster comprises the following steps: building data are received to create a historical building model, and the historical building model is displayed visually; receiving real-time video data obtained by monitoring the historical building, carrying out fire identification on the real-time video data, carrying out visual processing on ignition point information obtained by fire identification, and then simulating and displaying the information in the historical building model; and carrying out influence analysis on the simulated fire condition in the historical building model to obtain a fire influence range, determining an optimal fire fighting route according to the fire influence range and pushing a fire message to a corresponding rescue placement point. The invention analyzes and simulates the fire condition, calculates the optimal rescue scheme through the simulation result, and informs related personnel to process in time, so as to discover the possibility of possibly damaging the historical building in time.
assignees: GUANGZHOU EUCLIDEAN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: System for evaluating performance of disaster response system using boundary value by using expert evaluation
title_ko: 전문가 평가를 이용하여 재난대응시스템의 성능을 평가하는 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for evaluating the performance of a disaster response system. The system of the present invention includes a disaster response system and a performance evaluation device. The disaster response system includes: a data collection unit collecting disaster data including past disaster data, institutional disaster data collected or processed by an institution, and environmental facility disaster data measured at an environmental facility; and a system control unit generating a disaster situation propagation plan and a disaster response plan by disaster type from the past disaster data, the institutional disaster data, and the environmental facility disaster data, generating a disaster manual by matching the disaster type, the disaster situation propagation plan, and the disaster response plan and manualizing the disaster situation propagation plan and the disaster response plan, performing decision making corresponding to the disaster type when the disaster type is input, and outputting the disaster situation propagation plan and the disaster response plan in accordance with the disaster manual included in the decision making. The performance evaluation device includes: an input control unit inputting an input value including the disaster type to the disaster response system; an output control unit receiving an output value including disaster situation propagation plan and the disaster response plan from the disaster response system; an evaluation input unit receiving a scenario result generated by applying the input value to a disaster response scenario; and an evaluation determination unit evaluating the accuracy of the decision making by comparison between disaster situation propagation plan and the disaster response plan included in the output value and the disaster situation propagation plan and the disaster response plan included in the scenario result.
abstract_ko: 일 실시예는 과거재난데이터, 기관이 수집 또는 처리한 기관재난데이터 및 환경시설에서 측정된 환경시설재난데이터를 포함하는 재난데이터를 수집하는 데이터수집부와, 상기 과거재난데이터, 상기 기관재난데이터 및 상기 환경시설재난데이터로부터 재난유형에 따른 재난상황전파방안 및 재난대응방안을 생성하고, 상기 재난유형, 상기 재난상황전파방안 및 상기 재난대응방안을 매칭시킴으로써 상기 재난상황전파방안 및 상기 재난대응방안을 매뉴얼화하여 재난매뉴얼을 생성하고, 상기 재난유형을 입력받으면 상기 재난유형에 대응하는 의사결정을 수행하며, 상기 의사결정에 포함된 상기 재난매뉴얼에 따라 상기 재난상황전파방안 및 상기 재난대응방안을 출력하는 시스템제어부를 포함하는 재난대응시스템; 및 상기 재난유형을 포함하는 입력값을 재난대응시스템에 입력시키는 입력제어부, 상기 재난상황전파방안 및 상기 재난대응방안을 포함하는 출력값을 상기 재난대응시스템으로부터 수신하는 출력제어부, 상기 입력값이 재난 대응 시나리오에 적용되어 생성된 시나리오결과를 수신하는 평가입력부, 상기 출력값에 포함된 재난상황전파방안 및 재난대응방안과 상기 시나리오결과에 포함된 재난상황전파방안 및 재난대응방안을 비교하여 의사결정의 정확도를 평가하는 평가판단부를 포함하는 성능평가장치를 포함하는 재난대응시스템의 성능을 평가하는 시스템을 제공할 수 있다.
assignees: KOREA TESTING LAB KTL

title_en: Method and system for acquiring influence degree of urban factors on inland inundation disaster loss
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for acquiring the influence degree of urban elements on waterlogging disaster loss, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a hierarchical Bayesian network structure under the scale of a city domain and a block, and respectively corresponding the structure in the ontology model of the influence mechanism of the city elements on the waterlogging disaster to the hierarchical Bayesian network structure; performing parameter learning training on the hierarchical Bayesian network structure by adopting a parameter learning algorithm to obtain the conditional probability of each node; and carrying out sensitivity analysis on each node according to the conditional probability of each node in the hierarchical Bayesian network structure so as to quantify the influence degree of the urban elements on the waterlogging disaster loss. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, the influence degree of the urban elements on the loss of the waterlogging disaster can be quantized, so that on one hand, the influence degree of each urban element on the loss of the waterlogging disaster can be visually observed by people, and on the other hand, a quantitative evaluation basis can be provided when the loss degree of the waterlogging disaster is evaluated.
assignees: HENAN INDUSTRIAL UNIV

title_en: Network security countermeasure method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a network security countermeasure method, a network security countermeasure device and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of network security. Firstly, initiating attack operation to a defending side host by utilizing each preset risk item of the defending side host. The method comprises the steps of determining an emergency response score of a defending side host according to emergency response operation of the defending side host, determining a reinforcement score of the defending side host according to attack cost and a restoration result of the defending side host to a preset risk item, and determining a counterattack score of the defending side host according to counterattack operation of the defending side host to a network security counterattack platform. And finally, determining the defending score of the defending side host according to the emergency response score, the reinforcement score and the counterattack score. The network security training of defending personnel more close to the actual network attack scene is carried out, and the defending capability of the defending personnel to the network attack is improved.

title_en: Power system restoring force evaluation method considering network attack
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system restoring force evaluation method considering network attack, which comprises the following steps: 1, establishing an electric power-communication composite system model; 2, calculating the probability of success of each node attack, simulating the influence caused by the attack, and carrying out cooperative recovery on the power transmission information physical system; 3, restoring force calculation and evaluation. The invention considers the influence of the network attack on the power system of the power system information network and evaluates the power grid restoration force, thereby improving the disaster resistance capability of the power system under the network attack.

title_en: Coal mine rock burst disaster monitoring and early warning system based on digital twins
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine rock burst disaster monitoring and early warning system based on digital twins, which comprises the following components: the monitoring system comprises a stress sensor, a local data storage center, a computer processing center, a cloud information storage center, a PC user information input client, a mobile device client, an alarm system and an alarm device, wherein the monitoring objects are the stress condition, the working face impact danger and the support stress condition of the coal rock mass in the current coal mining area. The invention applies a digital twin technology and combines a traditional numerical simulation method, overcomes the defect of the limitation of a monitoring area of the traditional stress monitoring method, can realize real-time monitoring of the stress condition of the coal rock mass in a mining area according to the monitoring data generated by a stress sensor at a specified position, evaluates the impact risk of a working face, pre-warns the occurrence of rock burst disasters, and provides support for safe mining.
assignees: LIAONING ENGINEERING TECHNOLOGY UNIV

title_en: Method for analyzing buckling failure vulnerability of vertical storage tank under coupling action of flood and hurricane
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for analyzing buckling failure vulnerability of a vertical storage tank under coupling action of flood and hurricane. The method comprises the following steps of determining basic information of a vertical storage tank, determining acting force borne by the vertical storage tank, calculating resisting load of the vertical storage tank, calculating external acting force of the vertical storage tank, establishing a limit state equation of storage tank buckling failure under coupling action of flood and hurricane according to storage tank buckling failure judgment basis, counting the times of buckling failure of a target storage tank by adopting a Monte Carlo simulation method, calculating failure probability, drawing a vulnerability curve of the storage tank under coupling action of flood and hurricane, and analyzing influence of different wind speeds, water depths and filling rates of the storage tank. The method can accurately calculate the buckling failure probability of the vertical storage tank under the coupling action of flood and hurricane, and provides a powerful basis for evaluating vulnerability of chemical process equipment under the coupling action of multiple disasters.

title_en: Multi-type distributed power supply two-stage planning method for power distribution network restoring force improvement
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-type distributed power supply two-stage planning method for improving the restoring force of a power distribution network, which comprises the following steps: 1, counting fault rates of distribution network lines under different disaster conditions and availability rates of different types of distributed power Supplies (DGs) according to regional historical disaster data; 2, simulating and generating a damage scene of the circuit after the power distribution network is subjected to extreme disasters of various types and levels by using a Monte Carlo method; 3, respectively optimizing planning positions of the distributed photovoltaic, wind power and a conventional distributed unit aiming at each scene; and 4, respectively counting the optimal planning positions of the distributed power supplies in all scenes contained under different disasters, sorting according to the descending order of the occurrence times of the positions, and taking the first several times of positions with the same number as the planning number of the power supplies as the optimal planning positions of the power supplies under the corresponding disasters. The invention can improve the capacity of supplying power to the load and the speed of recovering the load after the power distribution network encounters an extreme disaster, thereby improving the recovery power of the power distribution network.

title_en: Test simulation method and system for dumping disaster in high slope digital twin technology
abstract_en: The application discloses a test simulation method for dumping disasters in a high slope digital twin technology, which comprises the steps of arranging a simulation system, completely aligning cracks between a high-level disaster body parent rock part and a dumping deformation part, and filling gas into an air bag; the method comprises the steps of taking initial photos of a high-level disaster body parent rock part and a high-level disaster body dumping deformation part, discharging preset proportion of gas in an air bag, taking real-time photos of the high-level disaster body parent rock part and the dumping deformation part, repeating the steps of three and four until the high-level disaster body dumping deformation part falls off from an inclined supporting plate, and taking the taken initial photos and the real-time photos as machine learning materials. Therefore, the method constructs a test system for realizing the dumping instability of the slope disaster body, and realizes the simulation of the dumping disaster in the digital twin technology of the high slope. The application also discloses a test simulation system for dumping disasters in the high slope digital twin technology.

title_en: Simulation method for simulating cascading failure state of power grid under typhoon disaster effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation method for simulating a power grid cascading failure state under the typhoon disaster action, which comprises the steps of firstly establishing a circulating wind field model and a traveling wind field model of typhoon according to a typhoon data set, then establishing a typhoon space-time distribution model, then drawing a power grid element vulnerability curve to obtain the damage probability of the power grid element under different wind speeds, abstracting a working state set of the power grid element into a Markov state, and constructing a state transfer model of a power system to generate a failure power grid element set of the power system at different moments under the typhoon action; the invention considers the space-time characteristics of typhoon disasters, combines the vulnerability analysis of power grid elements, provides a power grid fault sampling simulation method, can realize the real-time prediction of the fault state of each element and partition of the power grid, accurately simulates the influence of extreme typhoons on the power grid, provides an effective reference basis for the normal operation and the real-time maintenance of the power grid in disasters, and is suitable for wide popularization and use.
assignees: STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Fire risk assessment method, system, terminal equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire risk assessment method, a fire risk assessment system, terminal equipment and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the fire risk assessment method comprises the following steps: constructing a fire risk structural equation model, training the fire risk structural equation model to obtain a model output parameter, displaying the model output parameter through a knowledge graph, and obtaining a path coefficient in the model output parameter; acquiring a dynamic fire development influence parameter, and determining fire development trend probability through a dynamic Bayesian network based on the dynamic fire development influence parameter and the path coefficient; and obtaining a dynamic fire evaluation network based on the fire evolution trend probability, a preset dynamic fire evaluation index system and preset expert knowledge, so as to quantitatively evaluate the risk of the fire through the dynamic fire evaluation network. The invention can improve the evaluation efficiency when the risk evaluation is carried out on the dynamic fire disaster.

title_en: Power system elasticity evaluation method considering cascading failure evolution under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system elasticity evaluation method considering cascading failure evolution under typhoon disasters, and relates to the field of power system analysis. The method comprises the steps of generating a fault scene through a power transmission line fault model under a typhoon disaster; utilizing a cascading failure evolution model based on short and long time scales to simulate cascading failures and an evolution process thereof of a power system caused by transient stability and thermal stability problems; and (4) evaluating the elasticity index value of the power system according to the system performance condition by combining a power system recovery model and adopting a sequential Monte Carlo simulation method. Compared with the electric power system elastic evaluation method without considering cascading failure evolution, the method can effectively simulate the initial failure condition and cascading failure evolution process caused by typhoon disasters, is more comprehensive and objective in describing the failure scene and closer to the actual failure development condition of the electric power system under the typhoon disasters, so that the elastic evaluation result is more accurate, and is beneficial to accurately evaluating the ability of the electric power system to cope with the typhoon disasters by power grid operators and formulating a targeted recovery strategy.
assignees: UNIV TAIYUAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Tunnel fire advanced prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting a fire disaster in a tunnel in advance, which comprises the following steps: establishing a fire model, and acquiring fire data under different working conditions according to the fire model; processing fire data under different working conditions, and establishing a fire database according to the processed fire data under different working conditions; establishing a fire prediction model, and dividing fire data under different working conditions in a fire database into a training set, a verification set and a test set so as to train the fire prediction model according to the training set and the verification set to obtain a trained fire prediction model; inputting the test set into a trained fire prediction module to obtain prediction data; establishing a data assimilation model, and performing data fusion on the prediction data and the real-time observation data according to the data assimilation model so as to correct the prediction data and obtain the optimal state estimation of the real-time fire; therefore, the method can be used for predicting the tunnel fire in advance, so that the real-time performance and the accuracy of the prediction of the tunnel fire are improved.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG

title_en: Method and system for evaluating vulnerability of wind disaster of vertical overlock metal roof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating vulnerability of a vertical overlock metal roof, which take a Monte Carlo simulation method as a probability analysis method to conduct vulnerability research on the metal roof, conduct random simulation through random sampling, acquire a large number of samples through a finite element model analysis method, then conduct simulation calculation on the samples, and obtaining the mean value and the logarithmic standard deviation of the sample, quantifying the performance level according to the sample data to obtain a damage parameter so as to establish a probability function of vulnerability to wind disasters, and finally fitting the probability function of vulnerability to wind disasters established under different wind speeds by combining the capacity demand ratio to obtain a final fitting function. According to the assessment method disclosed by the invention, the probability change rule of the roof system along with different performance levels of extreme wind pressure can be intuitively seen, and the probability of reaching different performance levels under the action of wind pressure with different polarity values is obtained, so that the assessment of the vulnerability of the vertical overlooking metal roof under different wind speeds can be completed.

title_en: Emergency repair method under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The application provides an emergency repair method under typhoon disasters, which comprises the steps of firstly determining a disaster area of a power grid according to typhoon monitoring information in a first stage before the disaster, collecting meteorological data, distribution network data, geographic data and other data of the disaster area, calculating line fault probability based on the collected data, establishing a temporary allocation center site selection model according to the fault probability and the position, and solving to obtain a temporary allocation center position. And then, a post-disaster broken line scene is generated by utilizing a Monte Carlo simulation and synchronous back-up scene reduction method in the post-disaster stage, a post-disaster distribution network emergency repair restoration optimization model is established based on the post-disaster broken line scene, and the model is solved to obtain a post-disaster area distribution network emergency repair restoration optimization strategy, so that rapid emergency repair restoration of the distribution network fault under typhoon disasters is realized.

title_en: Flood emergency rescue method and virtual command system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood emergency rescue method and a virtual command system based on a digital twin technology, which specifically comprise the following steps: s1, collecting relevant data of each river channel and the periphery of the river channel, wherein the relevant data comprises the height of a river bed, the type of the river channel, the width of the river channel and the cross section shape of the river channel; the invention relates to the technical field of aircraft simulation deduction platform support. According to the flood disaster emergency rescue method and the virtual command system based on the digital twin technology, by combining the specific characteristics of flood disasters, including strong burstiness, short rescue time and the like, a virtual command system frame is constructed, the frame mainly comprises seven modules, namely a physical module, a theoretical module, a task editor, a model editor, a driving engine, an aircraft performance evaluation module and a reinforcement learning module, and the seven modules are scientifically and reasonably arranged, so that command decision-making personnel can efficiently make emergency rescue decisions without professional flood disaster knowledge and can master rescue conditions in real time.
assignees: UNIV ZHONGSHAN

title_en: Method for evaluating and managing risk of slope-cutting landslide hazard in rural house building
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for evaluating and managing risk of landslide hazard in slope cutting during building of rural areas, which comprises the steps of calculating stability coefficients of grid unit bodies at different depths in an area through a TRIGRS model, obtaining an area damage probability distribution map by combining a Monte Carlo method, converting the grid units into slope units by using an ArcGIS platform to obtain an area risk distribution map, and determining whether building is allowed in the area according to risk; dividing the cut slope into a soil cut slope and a rock-soil mixed cut slope, calculating a cut slope stability coefficient and a potential sliding area under different parameter combinations based on Geostudio simulation, and determining whether to allow the cut slope according to the cut slope stability coefficient; obtaining a house design safety distance based on the potential sliding area; after a slope cutting design scheme is selected, evaluating slope cutting risks according to the safety evaluation standard of the slope cutting stability coefficient, and adopting corresponding prevention and control schemes according to different risk levels; all information is stored in the digitizing platform. The contents in the aspect of geological disaster prevention and control are systematically considered for the scientific site selection of rural house building.
assignees: UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES WUHAN

title_en: Water conservancy monitoring and disaster deduction method based on digital twin
abstract_en: A water conservancy monitoring and disaster deduction method based on digital twins comprises the following steps: 1) modeling water conservancy site landforms by using a three-dimensional model tool according to actual demands, carrying out fine modeling on water conservancy monitoring equipment, and introducing the water conservancy monitoring equipment into an illusion engine, so as to construct a vivid reservoir site model; 2) acquiring sensing data acquired by water conservancy monitoring equipment at a water conservancy station by using a database; 3) establishing a twin model and a deduction model of the water conservancy monitoring equipment, and mapping real sensor data of the water conservancy monitoring equipment into the water conservancy monitoring equipment model through data mapping; 4) according to the actual conditions of the water conservancy sites, a water conservancy site simulation scene is quickly constructed, and corresponding water conservancy monitoring and disaster deduction work of the water conservancy sites is completed.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Topic-guided remote sensing image subtitle generation method based on Transformer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for generating a subtitle of a remote sensing image of a Transformer based on theme guidance, which mainly solves the problems that the description generated in the prior art is single and the semantic information in the image cannot be accurately represented. The implementation scheme is as follows: constructing a theme encoder consisting of a Transformer and a theme vector, and pre-training on the classification data set; building a semantic decoder which is formed by cascading a random mask layer, an embedded layer, a Transformer decoder and a soft-max layer; connecting a theme encoder with a semantic decoder to obtain a remote sensing image subtitle generation network; setting training parameters, and iteratively training a remote sensing image subtitle generation network by using a standard RSICD data set; and generating a caption description by using the trained remote sensing image caption generation network. The invention improves the diversity and the accuracy of the generation description, and can be used for ground feature image retrieval, disaster prediction and image understanding.
assignees: UNIV XIDIAN

title_en: Digital twin-based watershed monitoring and early warning method and simulation platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based watershed monitoring and early warning method and a simulation platform, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring real-time watershed monitoring data, transmitting the real-time watershed monitoring data to a pre-constructed three-dimensional model, and building a three-dimensional virtual simulation watershed scene with synchronous data according to the three-dimensional model; a three-dimensional virtual simulation watershed is simulated and demonstrated based on a digital twin technology and a visual large screen; obtaining real-time early warning data through a pre-constructed early warning system based on the real-time watershed monitoring data, and judging and analyzing the danger degree of the real-time early warning data to obtain a solution corresponding to the danger degree; and carrying out scheme analysis by combining a solution corresponding to the danger degree and a simulation demonstration three-dimensional virtual simulation basin to obtain a final decision scheme corresponding to the danger degree. The invention can realize scene simulation, improve early warning efficiency, early warn in time and reduce hazard of disasters.
assignees: HUNAN XIANGYINHE SENSING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Elasticity evaluation method for information physical fusion power transmission network under ice disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses an elasticity evaluation method of an information physical fusion power transmission network under ice disasters, which aims at the power transmission network with OPGW as the only communication medium, firstly establishes an information physical fusion power transmission network model, then fully considers the information physical fusion characteristics of the fault, response and maintenance processes of the power transmission network, and finally evaluates the elasticity capability of the information physical fusion power transmission network under ice disasters through a Monte Carlo method. The invention analyzes the coupling characteristics of the information network and the physical network in the stages of 'response in disaster' and 'recovery after disaster', and simulates the further aggravation process of the information network fault on the physical network fault and the influence of the information network maintenance on the physical network. The method overcomes the defect of considering the single physical dimension, can more accurately reflect the fault and recovery characteristics of the power transmission network under the ice disaster, quantitatively evaluates the elasticity of the power transmission network for power engineering personnel, researches the elasticity improvement strategies in three stages of pre-disaster resistance, response during disaster and post-disaster recovery, and provides effective evaluation theoretical support.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: Kriging-based power transmission tower structure wind disaster vulnerability modeling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Kriging-based power transmission tower structure wind damage vulnerability modeling method, which comprises the steps of taking the average strength of a wind field, a wind direction angle and a power transmission line span as basic parameters, taking a tower-line structure design wind load calculation method as a basis, combining Kriging equivalent technology and a big data analysis algorithm, solving a wind resistance surface of a power transmission tower structure, constructing a self-adaptive equivalent modeling process of the wind resistance surface of the power transmission tower, carrying out power transmission tower wind induced vulnerability calculation by utilizing Monte Carlo simulation on the basis, establishing a four-dimensional vulnerability model of the failure probability of the power transmission tower structure with respect to wind speed, the wind direction angle and a horizontal span, and realizing high-dimensional vulnerability calculation and evaluation of the power transmission tower structure under the combined influence of the space-time change of the wind field and the space distribution of the power transmission line.
assignees: NANJING UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Monte Carlo algorithm-based power distribution network toughness evaluation method under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network toughness evaluation method based on a Monte Carlo algorithm under typhoon disasters, which comprises the following steps: s1: establishing a typhoon field model by taking the maximum wind speed radius as a boundary according to the rule that the wind speed is distributed in a vortex shape under typhoon disasters; s2: according to the mechanical effect of the power distribution network element under the typhoon disaster, a power distribution network element fault probability model based on the mechanical load effect theory is established; s3: obtaining fault probability data through a fault probability model, and determining a random fault scene of the power distribution network element by using Monte Carlo method simulation; s4: calculating to obtain a toughness evaluation index value by taking the difference integral of the total load and the operation load under the typhoon disaster as a toughness evaluation index of the power distribution network; the method provided by the invention only needs to consider the influence of the distribution network elements on the load points of the distribution network, can effectively solve the problem of calculated amount caused by excessive elements in the system, is suitable for large-scale distribution network toughness evaluation calculation, and has good comprehensiveness and operability for distribution network toughness evaluation.
assignees: NANJING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Flood disaster deduction method and system based on digital twin simulation platform
abstract_en: The invention provides a flood disaster deduction method and a system based on a digital twin simulation platform, which relate to the field of digital simulation platforms and comprise the following steps: defining a flood disaster monitoring area with multiple elements to be monitored; traversing the multielement elements to be monitored in a flood disaster monitoring area to obtain a multielement element distribution area list; traversing the multi-element distribution area list through a remote sensing monitoring platform to extract the landform features and obtain landform feature information; traversing the multi-element distribution area list through the unmanned aerial vehicle image exploration array to obtain multi-element characteristic information; traversing the multi-element distribution area list according to the landform characteristic information to generate a landform simulation result; inputting the characteristic information of the multiple elements into a landform simulation result to generate a multiple element distribution simulation result; and obtaining a flood simulation data set, and inputting a multielement element distribution simulation result to carry out disaster evaluation so as to generate a flood disaster deduction result. Solves the technical problem of lack of assessment on the development trend of flood disasters.

title_en: Geological disaster deduction method and system based on digital twin simulation platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster deduction method and a system based on a digital twin simulation platform, and relates to the field of geological disaster correlation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: connecting a data acquisition device to obtain geological component information and ground building information, and generating geological modeling data and building modeling data; inputting the geological modeling data and the building modeling data into a digital twin simulation platform for modeling to obtain a regional modeling result; acquiring a video data set according to the video acquisition device; according to the video data set, matching the region modeling result to perform modeling optimization, and obtaining an optimized modeling result; and taking the optimized modeling result as a deduction model, and taking a preset disaster deduction library as an input variable to obtain a deduction result database for dangerous identification. The method solves the technical problems of inaccurate geologic modeling means and low deduction efficiency, and achieves the effects of improving modeling accuracy and deduction efficiency by adopting a digital twin simulation platform to perform geologic modeling.

title_en: Novel geological disaster bare rock greening treatment equipment
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for a afforestation treatment equipment field, concretely relates to novel geological disaster bare rock afforestation treatment equipment, it includes the rock drill that is used for cutting the bare rock, the liquid reserve tank that provides the restoration liquid for the rock drill and the hose that is used for connecting the rock drill and the liquid reserve tank; the rock drill comprises a shell, a liquid distribution assembly and a crushing assembly, wherein the crushing assembly penetrates through the liquid distribution assembly. Run through the broken subassembly that sets up and join in marriage the liquid subassembly and can carry the restoration liquid to the deep rock base that the drill bit top was right in the breakage for the restoration of restoration liquid is effectual, and influence range is big, has removed simultaneously from to distribute and has consumeed the inconvenient part of a large amount of manpowers.
assignees: JINCHUAN GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Audio-visual cooperation based winged insect tracking and identifying method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for tracing and identifying winged insects based on audio-visual cooperation, which relate to the technical field of winged insect tracing and aim to solve the problem that the prevention and control of harmful winged insects are always a troublesome challenge, especially for greenhouse and greenhouse planting, if a small amount of sporadic insects enter a greenhouse and cannot be timely driven away and captured, the reproductive capacity of the insects can enable the small amount of insects to quickly become an insect disaster, and further huge loss is brought to farmers; the TCN network designed by the invention can effectively extract the characteristics of time sequence data, and has better robustness and recognition rate compared with manually selected characteristics or a traditional machine learning method; compared with the traditional non-machine learning method, the method drives the TCN network to perform feature learning through the training data, and avoids incomplete data information utilization caused by an artificial feature screening process.
assignees: DUT ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE INST DALIAN;DALIAN SAITING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Smart grid false data injection attack detection method based on signal processing and data reduction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a false data injection attack detection method of a smart power grid based on signal processing and data reduction, which can be used in a power system state estimation link, and firstly uses Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) technology to extract state quantity behavior characteristics to generate high-dimensional characteristic vectors; secondly, the high-dimensional feature vectors are reduced by using an Improved Extreme Learning Machine (IELM) to shorten the detector training time and avoid 'dimension disaster'; and finally, training a Long Short term memory network (LSTM) by using the newly generated low-dimensional feature vector to generate a false data injection attack detector of the smart grid. In the process, the newly generated low-dimensional feature vectors are stored in a database as an extended data set to continuously optimize the detector. The invention aims to provide a real-time and accurate detection method for false data injection attack of a smart power grid, and the safe and stable operation of a power system is ensured.
assignees: UNIV BEIHANG

title_en: Method and device for identifying fragile line of power transmission network under ice disaster and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and a storage medium for identifying a fragile line of a power transmission network under ice disasters, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining the ice coating thickness of each line in the power transmission network under ice disasters; determining the fault probability of each line according to the thickness of each ice coating; on the basis of the fault probability of each line, adopting Monte Carlo simulation to obtain a plurality of line cascading fault accident chains, and constructing a cascading fault incidence matrix according to the line cascading fault accident chains; wherein each element in the cascading failure incidence matrix is: the associated weight of the fault line corresponding to the element and another fault line; determining the node weight degree of each line according to the cascading failure incidence matrix; and taking the first M lines with the maximum node weight degrees as fragile lines. By implementing the method, the fragile line in the power transmission network under ice disasters can be effectively identified.

title_en: Drainage basin management method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a basin management method and system based on digital twinning, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining Beidou data, remote sensing data and Internet of things data of a hydropower station basin, and constructing a basin database; the method comprises the steps of carrying out digital mapping on hydropower station watershed through various engines based on a watershed database to generate a corresponding digital twin watershed, obtaining a watershed service, and carrying out service simulation in the digital twin watershed through a watershed service association algorithm, wherein the watershed service is one or more of gate control previewing, regional inundation analysis, watershed ground disaster early warning and dam stress early warning. According to the invention, based on various kinds of perception data of the hydropower station basin processed by various kinds of engines, the accurate and intelligent construction of the digital twin basin is realized, meanwhile, various basin services are simulated in the digital twin basin through various algorithms, and the management efficiency and emergency command capacity of the hydropower station basin are improved.

title_en: Offshore ecological environment numerical forecasting method and system
abstract_en: An offshore ecological environment numerical forecasting method, comprising: collecting various ocean related data to obtain satellite remote sensing sea surface temperature, chlorophyll a concentration, observation data and other ocean data, and making a driving field, an open boundary and an initial field by using the related data; the physical mode and the ecological mode are optimized according to the optimized parameter scheme of each sea area, the physical mode and the ecological mode are coupled by using a driving field, an open boundary and an initial field, a data assimilation correction mode initial field is developed to obtain a physical mode simulation forecast result and an ecological mode simulation forecast result, interpolation layering, marine disasters and environment analysis, inspection and filing are carried out to obtain a static forecast map, an explanation application analysis result and a verification and filing result, the offshore ecological environment with environmental differences and model uniformity can be more comprehensively and pertinently depicted, the offshore ecological environment comprises a nitrogen, phosphorus, silicon, oxygen and carbon multisource biological geochemical cycle process (particularly phosphorus cycle), and the detail degree of the depiction of the offshore ecological environment is improved.
assignees: NAT MARINE ENVIRONMENTAL FORECASTING CENTER

title_en: Method, device and equipment for generating basin flood beach disaster relief scheme based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and equipment for generating a basin flood beach disaster relief scheme based on digital twins. The method comprises the following steps: determining a corresponding flood plain area in the flow field based on a digital twin simulation model; determining a disaster risk level corresponding to the flood plain area based on the flood plain area water flow corresponding to the flood plain area; and determining a disaster relief scheme corresponding to the flood plain area based on the disaster risk level corresponding to the flood plain area through the digital twin simulation model. The method and the device solve the technical problem that the flood beach disaster relief scheme cannot be quickly and accurately generated based on the real-time condition in the related technology.
assignees: JIULING SHANGHAI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power transmission line maintenance sequence optimization decision method under extreme ice and snow disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power transmission line maintenance sequence optimization decision method under extreme ice and snow disasters, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: according to the extreme ice and snow disaster meteorological characteristics, an extreme ice and snow disaster meteorological model which comprehensively considers instantaneous wind and icing gravity borne by the line from the double-layer angle of time and space is constructed, the influence condition of the line is calculated by combining a power transmission network, and the line breakage and outage probability is simulated; determining a fault scene set based on a Monte Carlo state sampling method and in combination with the line outage probability, and realizing system toughness evaluation by using a toughness evaluation index according to system response and recovery conditions; and carrying out optimization decision on the maintenance sequence of the power transmission line under the extreme ice and snow disaster, comparing and analyzing the maintenance sequence with the maintenance effect according to the line breakage sequence, and analyzing the influence of the maintenance sequence optimization decision method of the power transmission line on the toughness of the system by comparing the evaluation result of the toughness of the power system. Has the advantages of scientific and reasonable structure, strong applicability and good effect.
assignees: STATE GRID HEILONGJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV NORTHEAST DIANLI

title_en: Digital twin-based watershed flood beach disaster risk assessment method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based method and a digital twin-based device for evaluating risks of flood area flood beach disasters, and relates to the technical field of evaluation of simulation disaster risks of flood area flood beach. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical hydrological information and real-time hydrological information of a drainage basin; processing historical hydrological information based on a digital twin simulation model to obtain N flood plain point positions of a drainage basin; determining the risk probability of the N overflowing beach point positions with overflowing beach disasters based on the water level overflowing beach influence factors of the N overflowing beach point positions; determining target flood plain point positions according to the risk probability to generate corresponding flood plain paths, and determining flood plain time corresponding to each target flood plain point position based on real-time hydrologic information; and evaluating the flood beach disaster risk level of the drainage basin based on the flood beach path, the flood beach time and the facility information corresponding to the flood beach path. The method solves the technical problem that the prior art cannot accurately evaluate the flood beach disaster risk level of the drainage basin.
assignees: JIULING SHANGHAI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD;SHANDONG HYDROLOGY AND WATER RESOURCES BUREAU

title_en: Real-time risk probability calculation method for domino accident of fire disaster in chemical storage tank area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time risk probability calculation method of domino accidents of fire disaster in a chemical storage tank area, which relates to the technical field of fire risk assessment in the chemical storage tank area, and is characterized in that basic data related to a chemical storage tank is obtained, then the vulnerability parameters of the chemical storage tank are calculated, monte Carlo simulation is carried out by setting simulation parameters, so that a failed chemical storage tank is determined, the time and space synergistic effect are not considered, and the incident heat radiation intensity, theoretical failure time and equivalent heat radiation flux of the residual chemical storage tank are respectively calculated; and (3) respectively calculating the cooperative theoretical failure time, probability unit value, accident upgrading probability and time-varying failure probability of the chemical storage tank by considering the time and space cooperative effect, carrying out multiple simulation, and counting the occurrence frequency of each accident scenario to obtain the accident scenario probability and the failure time and time-varying failure probability of the storage tank under the cooperative effect, thereby realizing the function of real-time probability calculation.

title_en: Vulnerability model construction method suitable for wind power tower structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for constructing a vulnerability model applicable to a wind power tower structure. The method comprises the steps of establishing a finite element model of a wind power tower structure, judging the type of disasters to be considered according to the geographic position and basic form of the model, simulating load time courses corresponding to the disasters to be considered, carrying out damage level on each part of the wind power tower, defining quantization indexes corresponding to each damage level, carrying out calculation analysis on the quantization indexes in finite element numerical simulation, carrying out nonlinear power time course analysis and incremental power analysis based on the finite element model and the simulated load time courses, constructing a fragility model, determining a loss ratio probability distribution model corresponding to the performance level of each part of the wind power tower, and establishing a vulnerability model based on the fragility model and the loss ratio probability model or the loss ratio constant value of each part of the wind power tower. The method aims at the vulnerability assessment of the wind power tower structure, and fills the gap in the technical field of the current wind power tower disaster risk assessment.

title_en: Riverbed change simulation deduction method, device and equipment based on three-dimensional scene model
