abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional scene model-based riverbed change simulation deduction method, a three-dimensional scene model-based riverbed change simulation deduction device and riverbed change simulation deduction equipment, and relates to the field of digital twins in a drainage basin, wherein the simulation deduction method comprises the following steps: collecting basin data of a target basin, establishing a three-dimensional scene model based on the basin data, performing riverbed change deduction by using the three-dimensional scene model based on river sand sediment deposition change data established by hydrologic data monitoring information, and adjusting a riverbed height parameter in the three-dimensional scene model according to sediment deposition parameters in the river sand sediment deposition change data under the condition of performing the riverbed change deduction. The invention solves the technical problem that the disaster cannot be early warned in time because a three-dimensional scene model capable of dynamically deducing the change of the riverbed cannot be established in the related technology.
assignees: JIULING SHANGHAI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD;SHANDONG HYDROLOGY AND WATER RESOURCES BUREAU OF YELLOW RIVER CONSERVANCY COMMISSION

title_en: Method for evaluating operation reliability of power system under heavy rainfall
abstract_en: The invention provides an evaluation method for the operation reliability of an electric power system under heavy rainfall, aiming at solving the problem that the conventional electric power operation and maintenance lacks the risk perception capability under the consideration of extreme heavy rainfall, and the evaluation method comprises the following steps: acquiring running state data of the power system under heavy rainfall; sampling the running state of the power system by a Monte Carlo simulation method; analyzing the running state of the sampled power system based on a direct current load flow optimal load shedding algorithm; the evaluation index of the operation reliability of the power system is calculated, the evaluation of the operation reliability of the power system under strong rainfall is realized, the risk perception capability of the power system under extreme weather conditions is improved, the decision of the disaster prevention and relief scheduling work of the power system is assisted, the influence of the strong rainfall and waterlogging disasters on the power system and the impact of the strong rainfall and waterlogging disasters on the society are effectively coped and reduced, and the efficient and orderly power scheduling and disaster reduction and relief under extreme disasters are realized.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD JIAXING POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: A digital twin system for predicting response of structures to natural disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to a computer-based digital twin system for predicting the response of a structure (200) to natural disasters. Accordingly, it is characterized in that it comprises a plurality of structure sensors (210) to detect at least one structure parameter of the multiple components; at least one environmental sensor (220) to measure at least one environmental parameter; an information processing device (100) configured to receive the signals generated regarding the measurements made by the said environmental sensor (220) and the said structure sensors (210); the said information processing device (100) comprises an information processing device (100) configured to access a virtual structure model (500) of the structure (200) and simulate the responses of the components of the said structure (200) in the real world according to the said structure parameters and environmental parameters in the said virtual structure model (500); the said information processing device (100) is configured to access a trained machine learning model using the environmental parameter measurements and the structure parameters measurements at the time these parameters are measured; to apply the test environment parameter values, which are in magnitude measured when the natural disaster occurs and are predetermined, to the machine learning model as input and to determine the damage status of the structure (200) according to the response structure parameters of the machine learning model to this and to simulate the response structure parameters in the virtual structure model (500).
assignees: EROL EDA

title_en: SAR image change detection method based on mixed convolution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a SAR image change detection method based on mixed convolution, which mainly solves the problems that the prior art is difficult to extract global information of an image and a reliable label training network is lacked under the condition of no labeling label, and the method comprises the following steps of constructing three-channel input and initial labels; building a graph convolution enhanced convolution network GECN formed by cascading a feature extraction module, a progressive fusion module and a label updating module, training by using three channel input and label pairs GECN, and inputting tested SAR images to a trained GECN to obtain a change detection result. The method and the device acquire the multiscale characteristics of local and global information of the SAR image through the characteristic extraction module, improve the characteristic extraction capability of GECN networks, acquire more reliable tag training GECN networks through the tag updating module, improve the generalization performance of GECN networks, and can be used for urban planning layout, natural disaster assessment and military dynamic reconnaissance.

title_en: Highway side slope monitoring and early warning system and equipment based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention provides a highway side slope monitoring and early warning system and equipment based on digital twinning. The system comprises: the system comprises a physical entity module, a virtual model module, a service module, a twin data module and a connection module. The real-time state of the highway side slope is efficiently reflected through the virtual digital twin body, the simulation of the whole catastrophe process, the early warning information publication and the prevention and control decision pre-modeling planning are realized, the visualization of the whole catastrophe evolution process of the three-dimensional highway side slope can be realized, the risk prediction precision of the side slope disaster is improved, and the risk prevention and control level of the highway side slope engineering is obviously improved.

title_en: Power distribution system damage and restoration dynamic process assessment method under extreme event
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution system damage and restoration dynamic process assessment method under an extreme event, which solves the defects of the prior art and comprises the following steps of S1, determining relevant parameters of the power distribution system and extreme event disaster information, specifically S101, determining network topology parameters of the power distribution system, wherein the parameters comprise line information, user information and power supply information, S102, determining disturbance intensity and duration of the extreme event, S103, determining failure rate of elements of the power distribution system and restoration rate of failed elements in the restoration process according to disturbance intensity and element vulnerability curves of the extreme event, S2, simulating the failure process of the power distribution system, S3, simulating the restoration process of the power distribution system, S4, repeating the steps of S2 and S3 for a plurality of times until the curves converge, S5, and calculating reliability indexes according to the obtained element damage curves, user damage curves, element restoration curves and user restoration curves.

title_en: Double-layer power distribution network toughness evaluation method and system considering disaster response and recovery
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of toughness evaluation of distribution networks, and particularly discloses a method and a system for evaluating toughness of a double-layer distribution network by considering disaster response and recovery, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical ice disaster, power distribution network structure and equipment information of a power distribution network to be evaluated; constructing a double-layer multi-dimension index system of a toughness planning layer and an operation layer of the power distribution network; sampling a fault line by adopting a Monte Carlo method to obtain a fault scene, and screening a typical fault scene based on scene information entropy; adopting a minimum cut load model and an optimal line rush-repair sequence model based on the load importance degree to realize the whole process simulation of a typical fault scene and generate a system performance change curve; and respectively calculating comprehensive evaluation values of the toughness of the power distribution network of the planning layer and the running layer according to the system performance change curve and the structure and equipment information of the power distribution network, and evaluating the toughness of the power distribution network. The toughness evaluation index system of the double-layer distribution network avoids repeated quantitative calculation of the toughness index value.

title_en: Disaster reacting and management system based on digital twin and artificial intelligent
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 및 인공지능 기반의 재난 대응 및 운영 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster response and operation system based on digital twin and artificial intelligence. The disaster response and operation system comprises: a disaster occurrence detection device; a sensor information collection device; a disaster environment simulation device; and an artificial intelligence learning device. According to the present invention, damage to life and property can be minimized.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 디지털 트윈 및 인공지능 기반의 재난 대응 및 운영 시스템에 관한 것으로, 건축물 내/외부의 지정된 장소에 설치되며, 복수의 감지센서를 이용하여 해당 건축물의 내/외부에 피해를 줄 수 있는 재난사고 상황의 발생을 감지하는 재난발생 감지장치와, 재난발생 감지장치에 구비된 각 감지센서로부터 기 설정된 감지센서 고유식별정보를 제공받아 이를 기반으로 해당 건축물 내/외부의 층별 및 위치별로 각 감지센서 고유식별정보를 그룹화화여 감지센서 그룹화 ID를 생성하고, 상기 생성된 감지센서 그룹화 ID와 각 감지센서로부터 감지된 현재의 각 센싱 정보를 전송하는 센서정보 취합장치와, 재난 또는 비재난 상황에서 센서정보 취합장치로부터 전송된 감지센서 그룹화 ID와 각 감지센서로부터 감지된 현재의 각 센싱 정보를 제공받아 이를 기반으로 관리자의 선택에 따라 생성된 가상의 재난환경에 대하여 해당 건축물의 디지털 트윈 환경에서 기 설정된 디지털 트윈 기반의 가상 재난환경 시뮬레이션을 단계별로 수행하는 재난환경 시뮬레이션 장치와, 재난환경 시뮬레이션 장치로부터 수행되는 각 단계에서 생성되는 시뮬레이션 결과정보를 제공받아 이를 기반으로 기 설정된 인공지능(AI) 기반의 기계 학습방법을 통해 해당 관리자의 선택에 따라 생성된 가상의 재난환경에 대한 재난발생 예측 또는 시계열적 재난확산 예측을 학습하여, 해당 관리자의 선택에 따라 생성된 가상의 재난환경에 대한 재난발생 예측정보 또는 시계열적 재난확산 예측정보를 생성하기 위한 인공지능 학습모델을 구축하는 인공지능 학습장치를 포함함으로써, 해당 재난사고 발생 시 사람들의 최적 대피 경로를 예측하고, 여러 종류의 안전 관련 시설물 및 기 설치된 관련 시설물에 대한 제어/통제를 진행하여 인명 및 재산 피해를 최소화할 수 있는 효과가 있다.
assignees: KEPCO ENG & CONSTR CO INC;ELSOLTEC

title_en: One-stop disaster recovery platform system
title_ko: 원스톱 재해복구 플랫폼 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an one-stop disaster recovery platform system, which provides recovery estimates and recovery simulations through on-site confirmation when damage occurs in a building due to various disasters such as fire, to help decision-making, and supports smooth damage recovery by selecting a recovery company, proceeding with restoration work, and processing insurance work in one stop. The one-stop disaster recovery platform system includes a database, a request module, a judgment module, an estimate module, a recovery support module, and a cost processing module.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건물에 화재 등 다양한 재해로 인한 피해 발생시 현장확인을 통한 복구견적 및 복구 시뮬레이션을 제공하여 의사결정을 돕고, 복구업체의 선정 및 복구작업의 진행과 보험업무처리를 원스톱으로 진행하여 원활한 피해회복을 지원하는 원스톱 재해복구 플랫폼 시스템에 관한 것이다.
assignees: YU EUN SANG

title_en: Power distribution terminal optimal configuration method considering extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution terminal optimal configuration method considering extreme weather, which comprises the following steps: generating a typical fault scene under extreme weather through Monte Carlo simulation and scene clustering; constructing a quantification system of power failure loss in a large-scale fault scene of a power distribution system; establishing a power distribution terminal configuration model with the minimum weighted annual power failure loss cost under various typical fault scenes; solving a power distribution terminal configuration model by using a self-adaptive improved bat algorithm; and obtaining the configuration position and type of the power distribution terminal with the minimum weighted annual power failure loss, and outputting a power distribution terminal configuration result. According to the method, the operation condition of the power distribution network in extreme weather is considered, the power distribution terminal planning considering the economy and the reliability is realized by improving the power failure loss quantification method considering the recovery fault of the power distribution terminal, and the extreme disaster coping capability of the power distribution system is further effectively improved.
assignees: UNIV NANJING SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Hydrologic data anomaly identification and repair method based on federal learning framework
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrological data anomaly detection and repair method based on a federal learning framework, which comprises a model training process and an identification repair process, wherein the model training process comprises the following steps of firstly preprocessing training hydrological data and carrying out anomaly processing, secondly building the federal learning framework, initializing model parameters by a server and sending a global model to each client, starting to learn local data characteristics after the client receives the model, extracting context information by the model by using a bidirectional LSTM with an attention mechanism, simultaneously optimizing anomaly detection and data repair functions in an anti-learning mode, and finally updating the model function through iterative interaction between the client and the server. According to the method, on the premise that the hydrological telemetering data privacy is protected, the anomaly identification and repair are carried out simultaneously, so that support is provided for improving hydrological forecasting performance and reducing loss caused by uncertain disasters.

title_en: Digital twin system for disaster inoculation process of ultra-large three-dimensional deep engineering
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twin system in a disaster inoculation process of ultra-large three-dimensional deep engineering, and relates to the technical field of physical simulation and digital twin of deep engineering disasters. The system comprises a deep complex geological digital twin body construction module for constructing a digital twin body; a real-time dynamic rendering module for accelerated rendering digital twinning; the deep engineering disaster inoculation mechanism model initialization module is used for initializing a deep engineering disaster inoculation mechanism model; the digital twin consistency verification module is used for carrying out deviation detection on the deep engineering disaster inoculation mechanism model; the deep engineering disaster inoculation mechanism model iteration optimization module is used for continuously correcting and optimizing the deep engineering disaster inoculation mechanism model; the system comprises a physical entity interaction control module for carrying out interactive control on ultra-large three-dimensional deep engineering disaster physical simulation facilities, a multi-element monitoring information space-time evolution fusion display module, a physical simulation test facility emergency risk avoiding module and a physical simulation test scheme intelligent real-time correction module.
assignees: UNIV NORTHEASTERN

title_en: Electric power weather monitoring network layout optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power meteorological monitoring network layout optimization method and system. The method comprises the steps of determining a numerical simulation test period of a typical power meteorological disaster, carrying out a high-resolution high-precision numerical simulation test based on the numerical simulation test period, constructing a real meteorological field of the numerical simulation test, determining real meteorological field data, extracting power meteorological monitoring data and diagnosing various power meteorological monitoring elements according to the real meteorological data, constructing an assumed site simulation monitoring set of the numerical simulation test, carrying out a data assimilation numerical simulation test of the simulation monitoring data according to the simulation monitoring set of the assumed site by controlling the simulation test and various sensitivity simulation tests, determining a data assimilation numerical simulation test result of the simulation monitoring data, carrying out data assimilation effect evaluation and verification according to the data assimilation numerical simulation test result of the simulation monitoring data, and determining an optimal power meteorological monitoring network layout scheme according to the data assimilation effect evaluation and verification by combining the real meteorological field data.

title_en: Reservoir informatization management system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir informatization management system based on digital twinning, which comprises a database, a model library and a computer end service function module, wherein the database is used for storing data of a reservoir; the database comprises basic data, service management data, monitoring data, external sharing data, geographic space data and video data and is used for storing information data related to the reservoir; the model library comprises a flood forecast model, a flood control scheduling model, a hydrodynamic model, a water resource optimization scheduling model and a safety evaluation model, and is used for simulating the operation of the reservoir in various service scenes and adjusting model parameters of the model library according to the simulated operation results; the computer-side business function module comprises a flood prevention scene, a water supply scene, a safety scene, data maintenance and system configuration, and is used for controlling the model library to retrieve information data from the database and executing the content of each business scene. The method solves the problems of reservoir information resource dispersion, poor system applicability and poor disaster defending capability, and comprehensively improves the reservoir informatization management level.
assignees: SHENZHEN DONGSHEN ELECT CO LTD

title_en: Multi-dimensional risk dynamic evaluation method and system for large-scale vehicle exhibition fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-dimensional risk dynamic assessment method and system for a large-scale vehicle-mounted fire disaster. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of identifying a vehicle-mounted fire risk in multiple dimensions, determining risk factors related to vehicle-mounted fire accidents, determining risk factor related information, and establishing a dynamic Bayesian topological structure of the vehicle-mounted fire accidents; based on the state Bayesian topological structure, carrying out data fusion on expert experience weights through DS theory, determining the prior probability of a basic event, constructing a conditional probability table, and determining the occurrence probability of a vehicle-spread fire accident by utilizing the forward reasoning technology of a dynamic Bayesian network; determining the probability of occurrence of a vehicle-mounted fire accident based on the prior probability of the basic event, deeply researching the sensitivity of the Bayesian network, and determining a sensitive event; and entering a unit event accident state through the unit event initial normal working state, completing dynamic mode transition, generating a dynamic simulation model, and predicting the accident occurrence trend according to the dynamic simulation model. The invention can realize multi-dimensional, full-scale and dynamic risk assessment.
assignees: BEIJING INST PETROCHEM TECH

title_en: Device and training method capable of realizing search and rescue training under multiple working conditions
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a method capable of realizing search and rescue training under multiple working conditions, wherein the device comprises a living space module, a limiting device, replaceable broken and detached components, a ladder stand and an openable cover plate, the living space module is provided with a ceiling and walls extending downwards from four sides of the ceiling, reserved broken and detached holes are formed in the living space module, the limiting device is fixedly or detachably connected to the two opposite sides of each reserved broken and detached hole, the replaceable broken and detached components are correspondingly arranged outside each reserved broken and detached hole of the living space module, the lower part of the living space module is connected with an underground space through the openable cover plate, and the ladder stand is arranged below the underground space corresponding to the openable cover plate. According to the invention, through realizing the shape adjustment of the building ruins, flexible replacement of broken components and diversified arrangement of searching scenes, the restoration degree of the searching and rescuing scenes after disaster is improved, and the flexibility requirement of searching and rescuing training is met.

title_en: Research and development type building multi-combustible fire coupling result evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a research and development type building multi-combustible fire coupling result evaluation method, which belongs to the technical field of building risk evaluation and specifically comprises the following steps of: summarizing synergistic effect events of the research and development type building, wherein the synergistic effect events comprise two synergistic effect events of visibility reduction and poison leakage caused by fire; qualitative description of synergistic effect events, namely two synergistic effects of visibility reduction and poison leakage caused by fire disaster; quantitatively analyzing the synergistic effect of the multiple combustible fire accidents of the developed building; and constructing a Monte Carlo simulation model, and analyzing the fire coupling accident results of the multiple combustibles of the developed building. The invention constructs the coupling result evaluation model capable of realizing the coupling result evaluation of different combustible fire and toxic substance leakage accidents of the research-type building, realizes the accurate evaluation of the research-type building fire result, and has very important practical significance for planning the research-type building intrinsically safe layout and guiding the research-type building emergency evacuation.

title_en: Integrated disaster prevention system using digital twin model and fire simulation and operation method of the same
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 모델 및 화재 시뮬레이션을 이용한 통합 방재 시스템 및 이의 동작방법
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, an integrated disaster prevention system comprises: a location detecting device for detecting locations of people in a building to generate location information; a route prediction device for tracking a movement route of the people on the basis of the location information detected by the location detecting device, and predicting a next movement route of the people; an evacuation route generating device for generating a plurality of evacuation routes by performing a fire simulation on the basis of at least one of the movement route, the next movement route, and virtual fire data; and a disaster prevention control device for controlling disaster prevention equipment in accordance with at least one of the evacuation routes when an actual fire occurs in the building. Therefore, an optimal evacuation route can be generated.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 통합 방재 시스템은, 건물 내 사람들의 위치를 감지하여 위치 정보를 생성하기 위한 위치 감지 장치; 상기 위치 감지 장치에 의해 감지된 상기 위치 정보를 기초로 상기 사람들의 이동 경로를 추적하며, 상기 사람들의 다음 이동 경로를 예측하기 위한 경로 예측 장치; 상기 이동 경로, 상기 다음 이동 경로 및 가상 화재 데이터 중 적어도 하나를 기초로 화재 시뮬레이션을 수행하여 복수의 대피 경로들을 생성하기 위한 대피 경로 생성 장치; 및 상기 건물 내에 실제 화재가 발생한 경우, 복수의 대피 경로들 중 적어도 하나에 따라 방재 설비를 제어하기 위한 방재 제어 장치를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: PETABREW CO LTD

title_en: Regional power grid resilience assessment method based on time sequence state deduction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a regional power grid resilience evaluation method based on time sequence state deduction, which comprises the following steps of: the method comprises the steps of obtaining a scene of shutdown and line damage of a regional power grid unit under an extreme disaster, constructing a model of a shutdown unit and a related power transmission line recovery path based on unit recovery characteristics, determining a target function and constraint conditions, and obtaining an optimal path; simulating and deducing a post-disaster recovery process of the regional power grid based on a time sequence state through the optimal path, and calculating a recovery index; and calculating a regional power grid restoration efficiency index based on the restoration force index. The method realizes quantification of restoring force in the regional power grid restoring process, effectively evaluates the level of the restoring force of the regional power grid facing to the extreme disaster, helps the power grid to enhance the restoring force of the power grid, and reduces damage and loss suffered by the power grid facing to the extreme disaster.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power system risk assessment method, device and storage medium in extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system risk assessment method, a device and a storage medium in extreme weather, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical data of different types of extreme weather, and generating a weather scene within one year by using a sequential Monte Carlo simulation method; based on the weather scene, obtaining disaster-causing factor distribution conditions in different time periods in one year by adopting a random sampling method according to a preset disaster-causing factor probability distribution model; obtaining the corresponding fault probability of the power element according to the disaster causing factor distribution condition and the vulnerability curve of the power element, and obtaining the states of the power element in different time periods within one year by adopting a random sampling method; and calculating to obtain the medium-and-long-term risk assessment index of the power system according to the power element state and the direct current power flow model. The method can evaluate the medium-and-long-term risk condition of the power system more comprehensively and accurately, and provide reference for further planning of the power system so as to resist the threat brought by extreme weather events.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Risk assessment method and device for hydrologic disaster condition and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for evaluating the risks of hydrologic disaster situations and electronic equipment, which relate to the field of three-dimensional digital twinning, and are used for inputting the forecast rainfall and the forecast rainfall time into a three-dimensional simulation model of a river basin after receiving the forecast rainfall of the target river basin in real time, outputting river basin water level change parameters, wherein the three-dimensional simulation model of the river basin comprises the dam heights of various river courses of the target river basin and the river basin water level heights acquired in real time, evaluating various points where the disaster situations possibly occur in the target river basin based on the river basin water level change parameters to obtain disaster situation point coordinates, and generating a disaster situation risk graph related to the target river basin based on the disaster situation point coordinates, the dam heights of the river courses and the river basin water level change parameters.
assignees: JIULING SHANGHAI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Accident disaster evolution simulation method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention provides an accident disaster evolution simulation method and system based on digital twinning, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the system comprises a safety risk background management module, a safety risk distribution diagram module and a three-dimensional accident evolution simulation module; the method comprises the following steps: uniformly managing the uploaded security risk data; meanwhile, uploading of safety risk data, management of safety risk information and accident emergency resource management are realized; constructing a three-dimensional scene of the chemical storage area, and realizing three-dimensional visual display of risk data of the chemical storage area by adopting a digital twin technology; and realizing evolution simulation of the progress of the chemical accident on a three-dimensional scene. The invention adopts a digital twin technology to display the impending risk of the chemical storage area, prejudges the accident, adopts corresponding positive measures and minimizes the influence of the accident; the full-direction display of the scene situation is realized through the three-dimensional scene, the damage caused by accidents is delayed, and the loss caused by the accidents is reduced.

title_en: Ultra-large deep engineering disaster physical simulation facility
abstract_en: The ultra-large deep engineering disaster physical simulation facility comprises a geological model long-time large load loading system, a deep oil-gas-water multiphase multicomponent complex geological model 3D printing system, a high-temperature-chemical-multiphase fluid collaborative injection, a monitoring and control system, a model internal complex engineering structure robot excavation and monitoring system under a deep geological environment, a deep metal mine complex drilling and transportation network intelligent ventilation system, a deep metal mine ultra-large stope intelligent filling system, a deep well enhanced geothermal safety intelligent mining system, a large geological model excavation and rupture process full-space-time intelligent high-precision monitoring system and an ultra-large physical simulation test multi-task intelligent collaborative total control and digital twin system; the facility meets the requirements of real triaxial high stress, structural stress and disturbance stress loading of the multiphase multicomponent 3D printing model under deep complex geological conditions, can intelligently and transparently monitor multi-element information under complex engineering activities such as excavation and the like, and can realize multi-task intelligent collaborative total control and big data cloud sharing.
assignees: UNIV NORTHEASTERN

title_en: Three-dimensional lightning positioning method suitable for complex terrain
abstract_en: The invention relates to a three-dimensional lightning positioning method suitable for complex terrains, and belongs to the technical field of meteorological disaster monitoring. According to the invention, a database of lightning electromagnetic wave propagation is established by a time domain finite difference method, and the actually measured electromagnetic wave waveform of the lightning detection equipment is matched with the simulation waveform in the database to determine the possible occurrence position of lightning. Based on the time difference method, monte Carlo random test and time finite difference, real surface relief and finite conductivity are considered, and inversion is carried out to obtain more accurate lightning positions. The invention is suitable for the real ground surface, especially in the fields of meteorological early warning, public safety, serious disasters and the like in complex terrain areas, and has wide application value in the aspects of detection of thunder and lightning, early warning and protection of thunder and lightning disasters.

title_en: Digital twin analysis method for flood disaster prevention in extreme rainstorm weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin analysis method for flood disaster prevention in extreme rainstorm weather, which comprises the following steps of; step one, building a data base plate, namely building the data base plate based on digital twin construction according to water conservancy basic data, high-precision geographic space data, dynamic monitoring data, business management data and cross-industry shared data; step two, rainfall forecast, which is to provide various rainfall forecast modes; according to the method, flood simulation and rehearsal under a digital scene are realized by four-forecast digital twin analysis of 'data bottom plate construction, rainfall forecast, flood forecast, evaluation and early warning, simulated rehearsal and management plan', flood prevention consultation decisions are effectively supported, weak links of the traditional flood prevention consultation process are further optimized, and the capacity and level of unified scheduling and unified management of flood disaster flood prevention are improved.
assignees: CASIC INTELLIGENCE IND DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Method for evaluating cascade failure influence of urban infrastructure under extreme precipitation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade failure influence assessment method of urban infrastructure under extreme precipitation, which belongs to the technical field of urban flood monitoring and comprises the following steps of S1, simulating an urban road network to obtain a simulated running road network; s2, collecting the depth and the range of urban inundation under extreme precipitation, and determining the affected nodes and road sections of an urban road network; s3, attacking the affected nodes and road sections and carrying out simulation to determine the failure state of the final road network; and S4, collecting urban infrastructure POI points, and evaluating the service capability change of the infrastructure before and after the road network failure and the cascade failure influence of the urban infrastructure under extreme precipitation. The method for evaluating the influence of cascade failure of the urban infrastructure under extreme precipitation, which is disclosed by the invention, solves the problem that the influence of the extreme precipitation disaster on the urban infrastructure under the extreme precipitation disaster is unknown in the field of urban disaster prevention and reduction at present.
assignees: UNIV JIANGSU

title_en: Flood prevention forecasting method and system for power grid facilities
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for forecasting flood control of power grid facilities, which relate to the technical field of flood control forecasting of the power grid facilities, and avoid artificial subjective consciousness by carrying out K-means cluster analysis processing, thereby avoiding the problem that the conversion of original data possibly affects the flood control forecasting result of the power grid facilities; the problem of index weighting in the traditional method is avoided, so that the influence of irrational property of the index weighting method on the final evaluation result is avoided; and secondly, a deep learning model is established by using a back propagation algorithm, data are input into the deep learning model for training, parameters of the classifier are automatically learned through the performance of the classifier on a classification task, the reliability is high, the problem of model overfitting is effectively relieved, the continuous learning capacity of the current deep learning model is effectively improved, the flood prevention forecast of power grid facilities is more accurate, and the risk of damage to the power grid facilities caused by disasters is reduced.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic monitoring and disaster early warning system for earth-rock dam seepage safety based on digital twin technology and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic monitoring and disaster early warning system for earth and rockfill dam seepage safety based on a digital twin technology and a construction method thereof, wherein the system comprises a physical layer, an information layer, a service layer and an application layer; the physical layer and the information layer comprise a monitoring system for digital twin bottom plate construction; the service layer comprises a prediction system, an early warning system and a plan release system for data fusion processing; the application layer includes a previewing system for digitized scene construction. The built system can better serve engineering practice, monitor various index data of the earth and rockfill dam in real time, predict the seepage security risk of the earth and rockfill dam in real time, and realize real-time dynamic simulation of seepage state of the earth and rockfill dam and seepage disaster automatic early warning plan.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CONSTRUCTION ENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Natural disaster comprehensive risk assessment system based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of natural disaster risk assessment, and particularly discloses a natural disaster comprehensive risk assessment system based on big data analysis. The application discloses a natural disaster comprehensive risk assessment system based on big data analysis, which comprises: a target model construction unit; a mark model generation unit; a period shooting unit; a water level identification recording unit for carrying out water level identification and recording; the point location identification recording unit is used for identifying and recording the point location; and the dynamic simulation evaluation unit is used for carrying out dynamic simulation display and carrying out disaster risk evaluation according to the display result. The method can construct a target three-dimensional model at a river dam needing important precaution, periodically shoots a plurality of evaluation points at shooting points, performs water level identification and point location identification, performs corresponding dynamic simulation display, and performs disaster risk assessment according to display results, so that the possibility of natural disasters such as flood, landslide and the like can be timely assessed, and early warning and restoration processing can be conveniently performed before the natural disasters occur.
assignees: Shandong Disaster Reduction Center

title_en: Remote sensing image change detection method combining U-shaped network and self-attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention provides a remote sensing image change detection method combining a U-shaped network and a self-attention mechanism, which mainly solves the problems of large memory occupation and complex network structure in the prior art, and comprises the following implementation steps: 1) Acquiring a training sample set and a test sample set; 2) Constructing a U-shaped variation detection network model, wherein the U-shaped variation detection network model comprises a multi-scale feature extraction module, a layered self-attention mechanism, a fusion up-sampling module and a classifier which are sequentially cascaded; 3) Inputting the training sample set into a U-shaped transformation detection network model and performing iterative training on the training sample set by using a back propagation method; 4) And inputting the test sample set into the trained U-shaped change detection network model to obtain a remote sensing image change detection visual image and a numerical result. The invention realizes lightweight change detection, obtains multi-scale fine granularity characteristics, reduces the complexity of a network structure, improves the detection precision, reduces the calculation resources, and can be used for geological disaster detection, urban planning and forest destruction detection.
assignees: UNIV XIDIAN

title_en: Multi-target intelligent scheduling method for river basin flood control engineering system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-target intelligent scheduling method of a river basin flood control engineering system, and belongs to the field of water resource regulation and control. Specifically, a river basin flood control engineering system multi-target cooperative scheduling index system is established; generating a drainage basin flood control scheduling data set based on the index system, and constructing a drainage basin flood control engineering system scheduling numerical simulation model; constructing an intelligent acquisition model of priori scheduling knowledge by combining a numerical simulation model to generate a drainage basin flood control scheduling plan library; constructing a river basin flood control engineering system multi-target cooperative scheduling decision model according to the plan library; combining a numerical simulation model to construct an automatic intervention model of a drainage basin flood control engineering system scheduling scheme; constructing a drainage basin flood control engineering system scheduling scheme evaluation model, and completing construction of a drainage basin flood control engineering system multi-target intelligent scheduling model; and inputting decision conditions of the intelligent scheduling model, and outputting a drainage basin flood control engineering system scheduling scheme. The invention is helpful to solve the problems of flood control and disaster reduction in watershed, water environment restoration, water resource supply and the like which restrict the local social and economic development.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Typhoon disaster risk assessment and dynamic forecasting method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a typhoon disaster risk assessment and dynamic forecasting method, which comprises the following steps: selecting a prediction index: at least comprising a risk index, a vulnerability index and an exposure index; extracting dangerous indexes: extracting the maximum rainfall, the process rainfall and the average maximum wind speed of a plurality of preset time lengths in administrative areas of each county; correlation analysis: carrying out pearson correlation analysis on the selected prediction index and the loss level; and (3) principal component analysis: reducing the dimension of the dangerous index related to the rainfall; dividing a sample set; constructing a machine learning model; training and testing a machine learning model; and (3) obtaining a forecast result: and dynamically updating the dangerous indexes input by the machine learning model, thereby realizing the real-time updating and forecasting of the typhoon disaster risk. The machine learning model updates the dangerous index input by the machine learning model by using the weather data of actual measurement and prediction, so that the real-time update and prediction of each county is realized.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Methods and systems for efficiently recovering from disaster damage to water treatment facilities through simulation
title_ko: 시뮬레이션을 통한 수처리 시설에 대한 재난 피해를 효율적으로 복구하는 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a method for efficiently recovering from disaster damage to water treatment facilities is a method of efficiently recovering disaster damage to water treatment facilities in the event of an actual disaster such as an earthquake, flood, or typhoon by determining a recovery sequence for each of water treatment process facilities included in the water treatment facilities through simulation. The method comprises: a facility information acquisition step of acquiring facility information, which is information about each of first to N^th process facilities in the water treatment facility, in which first to N^th steps which are water treatment processes are sequentially performed; a standard information acquisition step of acquiring standard information which is acceptable water quality information for each of the first to N^th process facilities; a measurement information acquisition step of acquiring measurement information, which is information obtained by measuring water quality for each of the first to N^th process facilities; and generating, based on the facility information, the standard information, and the measurement information, priority information for disaster damage recovery in the event of an actual disaster by simulating the disaster damage to each of the first to N^th process facilities due to the occurrence of the disaster.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 수처리 시설에 대한 재난 피해를 효율적으로 복구하는 방법은 시뮬레이션을 통해 수처리 시설에 포함된 수처리 공정 시설 각각에 대해 복구 순서를 결정하여, 지진, 홍수, 태풍과 같이 실제로 재난이 발생했을 경우, 수처리 시설에 대해 재난 피해를 효율적으로 복구하는 방법에 관한 것으로서, 수처리 시설 내, 수처리 공정인 제1 단계 내지 제N 단계가 순차적으로 수행되는 제1 공정 시설 내지 제N 공정 시설 각각에 대한 정보인 시설 정보를 획득하는 시설 정보 획득 단계; 상기 제1 공정 시설 내지 제N 공정 시설 각각에 대한 허용 가능한 수질 정보인 기준 정보를 획득하는 기준 정보 획득 단계; 제1 공정 시설 내지 제N 공정 시설 각각에 대한 수질을 측정한 정보인 측정 정보를 획득하는 측정 정보 획득 단계; 상기 시설 정보, 상기 기준 정보 및 상기 측정 정보를 기초로 재난 발생에 따른 제1 공정 시설 내지 제N 공정 시설 각각에 대한 재난 피해를 시뮬레이션하여 실제 재난 발생 시, 재난피해 복구에 대한 우선순위 정보를 생성하는 시뮬레이션 단계;를 포함하는, 시뮬레이션을 통한 수처리 시설에 대한 재난 피해를 효율적으로 복구하는 방법일 수 있다.
assignees: G&C ENV SOLUTION CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based emergency simulation method and system for flood and drought disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based method and a digital twinning-based system for emergent simulation of a paddy and dry disaster, which are used for extracting data to be simulated of the paddy and dry disaster; determining a simulation model according to the data to be simulated of the flood and drought disasters to obtain simulation model data, and performing underwater topography simulation analysis to obtain emergency simulation data; dividing into different historical arid areas and historical flood areas; obtaining the features and feature vectors of the terrains and underwater terrains of each region; analyzing the difference value of the characteristic vector of each different region; attributing the historical arid regions and the historical flood regions which are smaller than the threshold value to approximate regions; extracting historical underwater topography data values of the similar region; obtaining a verification index through a historical underwater topography data value; and obtaining emergency simulation data through the verification indexes and the underwater topography simulation emergency simulation. The scheme can effectively carry out accurate simulation prediction on the conditions of the flood and drought disasters in all areas, fully considers the characteristics of underwater topography, and accurately predicts the flood and drought disaster prevention and control strategies in the areas.
assignees: HUIJIE DESIGN GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Emergency pretreatment system and emergency treatment twin system for tank farm
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an emergency pre-treatment system and an emergency treatment twin system for a tank farm, and belongs to the technical field of safety engineering. The emergency pre-treatment system comprises: the tank field digital twin model corresponds to the tank field entity structure and is used for simulating the full life cycle process of the tank field; the system comprises a twin application module, a disaster simulation module and a control module, wherein the twin application module is configured with an accident simulation module and is used for simulating tank farm accident data by applying a tank farm digital twin model so as to predict accident evolution, and the disaster simulation module is configured with a disaster simulation module and is used for simulating the predicted accident evolution so as to predict various disaster scenes in the accident evolution; and a plan determining module for determining an emergency pre-treatment plan matched with the predicted disaster scene from a preset emergency treatment plan library. The application predicts various disaster scenes in the accident evolution of the tank farm by utilizing the digital twin model, and further can pertinently determine the emergency pre-treatment plan corresponding to the predicted disaster scene.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP;SINOPEC RESEARCH INSTITUTE SAFETY ENGINEERING CO LTD;UNIV BEIJING CHEM TECH

title_en: Reservoir water condition forecasting simulation method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water conservancy informatization and flood control and disaster reduction, in particular to a reservoir water regime forecasting simulation method and system based on digital twinning. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining geographic, remote sensing, topography, engineering characteristics and engineering structure series data of a specific reservoir engineering research area, and constructing a reservoir three-dimensional twin scene by combining a three-dimensional modeling technology; acquiring reservoir characteristic data, modeling the reservoir characteristic data by using a preset hydrological model construction mode, and constructing a reservoir storage forecast model; acquiring reservoir historical flood data, and performing data rating on a reservoir storage forecasting model by utilizing the reservoir historical flood data to acquire an accurate reservoir storage forecasting model; constructing a big data model according to the historical flood data of the reservoir, and constructing a big data warehouse-in flow forecast model; based on the coupling forecasting results of the two models, an interactive interface is developed, and dynamic simulation of the forecasting flow water level result in the reservoir twinning scene is realized.

title_en: Method for forecasting flood of medium and small river based on digital twin and AI technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster forecasting, and discloses a method for forecasting medium and small river floods based on digital twinning and AI technology, which comprises the following steps: screening out local river areas with high risk marks and medium risk marks; performing comprehensive evaluation analysis processing based on the high-risk marks and the medium-risk marks to acquire first output data; carrying out regression analysis processing on the historical river data by utilizing a pre-constructed flood regression model to obtain second output data; performing simulation analysis processing on the actually measured river data by using a pre-constructed river digital twin model to obtain third output data; taking the actually measured river data and the first output data as a first sample set, taking the historical river data and the second output data as a second sample set, and taking the actually measured river data and the third output data as a third sample set; constructing a flood prediction model based on the first sample set, the second sample set and the third sample set; and carrying out prediction analysis on the medium and small rivers by using a flood prediction model.
assignees: GUANGZHOU HUASHUI ECOLOGICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based gearbox fault diagnosis method and diagnosis system thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twin dynamics simulation, and discloses a digital twin-based gearbox fault diagnosis method, which comprises the following steps: s1: constructing a digital twin body of the gear box; s2: predefining fault types and verifying analysis; s3: and diagnosing faults of the gear box. The fault diagnosis system of the digital twin gearbox comprises a simulation model module; a diagnostic output module; and a display module. The model construction and simulation of the actual gear box are carried out by constructing a digital twin body and utilizing virtual reality, so that the operation simulation of the normal state and each fault type state of the existing gear box is formed, the collected operation parameters of the existing gear box are led into the model, whether the gear box has a fault and the fault type can be obtained in a countercheck mode, the working state of the gear box can be timely and effectively judged, the parts with the fault or potential faults can be timely replaced, and the disaster and economic loss caused by the fault can be reduced to a certain extent.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI DIANJI

title_en: Automatic monitoring system for disaster of expressway high slope
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method or a device for identifying a mode, in particular to an automatic monitoring system for disaster of a highway high slope, which comprises the following steps: the system comprises a data collection and feature extraction module, a deep learning training module, a risk assessment model construction module, an early warning notification module and an automatic early warning and processing suggestion module. According to the risk assessment method, a complete risk assessment framework is formed through the risk data collection and basic credibility grading module, the Bayesian network algorithm calculation and weight weighting module and the risk level calculation module, the risk assessment framework has high systematicness, the basic credibility of each risk factor after adjustment is calculated through the Bayesian network algorithm, and the weight weighting is carried out, so that the risk assessment result is more accurate, and different risk levels of high, medium and low can be effectively distinguished.
assignees: HENAN JIAOYUAN ENGINEERING TECH GROUP CO LTD;HENAN VOCATIONAL COLLEGE OF TRANSP HENAN TRANSP SECONDARY SPECIALIZED SCHOOL

title_en: Unknown scene remote sensing image subtitle generation method based on attribute learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing image subtitle generating method of an unknown scene based on attribute learning, which mainly solves the problem that the existing method can only generate words and sentences which appear in the training process and cannot accurately describe the unknown scene. The implementation scheme is as follows: building an attribute extractor, setting a learnable attribute identification vector A, and pre-training on a multi-label classification data set; constructing a decoder based on attribute learning, which is composed of an attribute reasoning module and a subject word generation module; cascading a theme encoder, an attribute extractor and an attribute learning-based decoder to form an unknown scene remote sensing image subtitle generating network based on attribute learning, and performing iterative training on the unknown scene remote sensing image subtitle generating network; and inputting the remote sensing images of the test set into a trained subtitle generating network to generate subtitle descriptions. The invention improves the description accuracy of the remote sensing image under the unknown scene, can adapt to various scenes of the remote sensing image, and can be used for ground object image retrieval, disaster prediction and image understanding.
assignees: UNIV XIDIAN

title_en: Power transmission line icing thickness prediction method based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for predicting the icing thickness of a power transmission line based on a digital twin technology, which comprises the following steps: collecting transmission line data; carrying out parameterized modeling according to the power transmission line data, and constructing a digital twin model of the power transmission line; numerical simulation, constructing a preliminary icing prediction model; and combining the digital twin model to construct an icing thickness prediction model. The method for predicting the icing thickness of the power transmission line based on the digital twin technology builds the power transmission line icing prediction model, and improves the prediction precision of the icing model. The icing thickness prediction model constructed by the method can accurately predict the icing thickness of the power transmission line, and has important significance for reducing icing disaster loss and improving power supply reliability.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method for evaluating functional toughness of urban multi-mode traffic network under flood disasters
abstract_en: The invention provides an evaluation method for the functional toughness of an urban multi-mode traffic network under flood disasters. The method comprises the following steps: and acquiring and researching urban road network data, ground public transportation network data and rail public transportation network data, and constructing a multi-mode traffic network structure model. Acquiring POI data to estimate traffic occurrence and attraction of the city, and simulating individual daily trip chains; and fusing the multi-mode traffic network structure model and the individual daily travel chains to construct the multi-mode traffic network function model of the city. According to the space destruction characteristics of the flood disasters, constructing a failure model of the multi-mode traffic network function model based on the structural failure model of the multi-mode traffic network, and evaluating the function toughness of the multi-mode traffic network function model under the flood disasters from the two aspects of passable demands and travel delays. The method can be applied to aspects of disaster prevention and reduction strategy evaluation, post-disaster infrastructure restoration strategy evaluation and the like of pre-disaster engineering and management, and can enhance urban toughness, thereby realizing sustainable development.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG

title_en: Power distribution system reliability assessment method considering meteorological factors
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution system reliability evaluation method considering meteorological factors, which comprises the following steps: firstly, acquiring average temperature, maximum wind speed and precipitation of each hour in a local certain time, clustering the three groups of data by using a Density Peak Clustering (DPC) algorithm, and forming a class library corresponding to one fault rate in each class of scenes by acquiring the real fault rate of a local overhead line in each class of scenes; then, evaluating the average temperature, the maximum wind speed and the precipitation of each hour of the network location of the reliability according to the requirement, and judging the category of the network location, so that the fault rate of the corresponding category is selected as the fault rate of the network line; and finally, based on the line fault rate, evaluating the reliability of the network by adopting a method of combining sequential and non-sequential Monte Carlo simulation on the basis of distinguishing conventional faults and extreme disaster faults by meteorological data of the place where the network is located.
assignees: NANJING INST TECH

title_en: Disaster area communication network multilayer information propagation model
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster area communication network multilayer information propagation model, which comprises the following steps: and designing a disaster area communication network multilayer information propagation model to obtain an information propagation equilibrium state in the model, and proving the influence of parameters such as node density, node communication range and the like on the information propagation equilibrium state. The interference optimization problem based on the disaster area communication network multilayer information propagation model is solved, the network deployment cost is minimized by using a convex optimization technology, the optimal node density and node communication range are obtained, and network interference is effectively avoided. The effectiveness of the proposed model is verified through experiments under different environments, and simulation results show that the disaster area communication network multi-layer information propagation model provided by the invention can describe the information propagation process between disaster area communication network nodes, and meanwhile, parameter optimization is provided for the disaster area communication network by considering the interference of the environments to the network and the cost of deployment and communication of rescue nodes.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING INF SCI & TECH

title_en: Intelligent test system for hydraulic engineering safety and disaster prevention and control
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of engineering prevention and control experiments, and provides a hydraulic engineering safety and disaster prevention and control intelligent test system, which comprises a construction hydraulic engineering intelligent physical model test system, a flood disaster formation mechanism and prediction and safety evaluation numerical simulation system and a drainage basin digital twin service support platform; according to the invention, by constructing an engineering entity prototype, a laboratory physical model and a digital twin model into a three-in-one intelligent test system for water engineering safety and disaster prevention, in the intelligent test system, powerful system software and a mathematical model are used for simulating, analyzing and researching the safety operation and disaster prevention of the water engineering, and decision support is provided under the visual condition, so that the scientificity and predictability of decision making are enhanced, the accuracy of experiments is further enhanced, and the intelligent test system for water engineering safety and disaster prevention is more comprehensive in operation mode, can be well adapted to various places and improves the adaptability of the water engineering test.
assignees: CHANGCHUN INST TECH;UNIV HOHAI;CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Method and system for evaluating toughness of park comprehensive energy system under extreme weather condition
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating toughness of a comprehensive energy system of a park under extreme weather conditions, and relates to the field of toughness evaluation of comprehensive energy systems. According to the method, a unified toughness evaluation index system is constructed, the toughness evaluation index system comprises a plurality of first-level indexes, each first-level index comprises a plurality of second-level indexes, and the comprehensive evaluation of the toughness of the park comprehensive energy system is realized; adopting a Monte Carlo simulation method to simulate a selected extreme weather disaster scene so as to obtain a second-level index value of each park comprehensive energy system to be evaluated under a toughness evaluation index system, constructing a standardized matrix, and realizing a scientific and reasonable index calculation method; acquiring the comprehensive weight of each secondary index by adopting an analytic hierarchy process-Critic method, and constructing a comprehensive weight coefficient matrix; and according to the standardized matrix and the comprehensive weight coefficient matrix, acquiring the toughness evaluation result sequence of each park comprehensive energy system to be evaluated, so that the toughness evaluation result of the comprehensive energy system under extreme weather conditions is more reliable.
assignees: UNIV HEFEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Disaster recovery and backup exercise network node health early warning method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster recovery drilling network node health early warning method, a disaster recovery drilling network node health early warning system, disaster recovery drilling network node health early warning equipment and a disaster recovery drilling network node health early warning storage medium; the method comprises the following steps: calculating the total energy consumption of the network node for completing the calculation task, and grading the energy consumption of the node according to the total energy consumption; acquiring service data volume transmitted by each network node from a historical database, and judging service weight scores of the network nodes according to the service data volume; performing health scoring on the network node according to the historical alarm times of the network node; adding the energy consumption score, the business weight score and the health score to obtain a total score of the network node; the network nodes with the highest scores form an optimal disaster recovery drilling link; and predicting the quality probability of the data transmitted by the optimal disaster recovery drilling link by using the quantum Bayesian network, and triggering the health early warning if the quality probability is lower than a threshold value. According to the invention, the power resource health state of the node is monitored in the full process of disaster recovery and backup exercise, the quantum Bayesian network is utilized to replace the traditional Bayesian network, the subjective probability of Bayesian probability prediction is corrected, and smooth progress of disaster recovery and backup exercise is ensured.
assignees: CHINA TELECOM DIGITAL INTELLIGENCE TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Roadway gas concentration prediction method based on model and big data double driving
abstract_en: A roadway gas concentration prediction method based on model and big data double driving belongs to the technical field of mine disaster intelligent prevention and control, and solves the technical problems of accuracy and instantaneity of gas concentration prediction in a roadway, and the method comprises the following steps: the coal mine tunnel environmental parameters, the gas concentration historical characteristic data set and the physical equation characteristic data set are combined into a data set, and training is carried out through a convolutional neural network RNN to obtain a predicted value; and further, through model evaluation and optimization, gas diffusion criterion constraint is added in a loss function of a standard RNN, and a standard back propagation algorithm and an Adam optimizer are adopted to train a learning model until a loss function result is minimized, so that accurate prediction of the roadway gas concentration is finally realized. The method can realize accurate and rapid prediction of the roadway gas concentration, provide reliable data support for coal mine safety decision, and effectively ensure safe and efficient mining of the coal mine.
assignees: UNIV TAIYUAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: ICSA-CNN-based coal-rock gas composite dynamic disaster prediction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine dynamic disaster prediction, in particular to a coal-rock gas composite dynamic disaster prediction method based on ICSA-CNN. Firstly, acquiring influence index data of a coal-rock gas composite dynamic disaster, and identifying and eliminating abnormal data by using an isolated forest method iForest; RF is selected as an estimator of a chained multiple interpolation method MICE to interpolate the missing data; then, an initial model framework of a convolutional neural network CNN is built, a Tent chaotic mapping improved crow searching algorithm CSA is used for obtaining ICSA, and super parameters of the model are optimized, so that prediction accuracy is improved; and finally, training a model, establishing a coal-rock gas composite dynamic disaster prediction model based on ICSA-CNN, and verifying the model accuracy by using a test set. The invention combines the superior optimizing capability of ICSA with the strong characteristic learning capability of CNN, and can realize the accurate prediction of the coal-rock gas composite dynamic disaster.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING

title_en: Stratum pregnancy disaster digital twin perception identification system
abstract_en: The invention provides a stratum pregnancy and disaster digital twin perception identification system, which belongs to the technical field of stratum analysis and comprises a plurality of main pipes drilled in the center position of a calibration area and a plurality of secondary pipes drilled in the position which is separated from the main pipes by a certain distance. And feeding the information related to the transmitter and the receiver back to the upper computer in real time, and presuming the specific position and the specific range of the stratum defect area by changing the positions and the angles of the transmitter and the receiver and reinforcing the defect area on the ground. The gas replacement and material data transmission are realized through the main pipe and the secondary pipe, and when an accident occurs, the transmitter is taken out from the main pipe and personnel rescue is carried out. The stratum pregnancy digital twin perception identification system provided by the invention can be used for fully detecting the stratum, so that the replacement of gas and the transmission of material data are realized, the integration level of the whole system is improved, the construction safety is improved, and the stable construction is ensured.

title_en: Method and system for realizing earthquake early warning simulation based on earthquake table network and WEBGL
abstract_en: A method for realizing earthquake early warning simulation based on an earthquake table network and WEBGL comprises the following steps: s100, acquiring seismic platform network data, monitoring station data and three-dimensional geologic body modeling data; s200, constructing a three-dimensional geologic body model according to a preset rule according to the acquired three-dimensional geologic body modeling data; s300, acquiring a seismic surface wave and a bulk wave result according to the acquired seismic station network data and the monitoring station data; s400, combining the obtained seismic surface wave and bulk wave results with the construction of a three-dimensional geologic body model to achieve the effect of simulating seismic wave propagation. According to the method, based on the combination of the Chinese seismic platform network monitoring data and WEBGL, comprehensive calculation analysis is carried out according to the stratum structure and medium attribute in the acquisition area and the detection data returned by the monitoring station terminal, the diffusion rate and the diffusion distance of the seismic point surface wave and the body wave are calculated respectively through a built-in calculation formula, the real-time seismic position and the diffusion range are finally displayed, and early warning and reference are provided for the earthquake prevention, control and disaster relief work of the area.
assignees: WUHAN ZHIBO CHUANGXIANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method, system and equipment for evaluating vulnerability of power CPS under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for evaluating electric power CPS vulnerability under typhoon disasters, wherein the method is based on typhoon historical record data, obtains typhoon occurrence frequency by adopting stable poisson distribution, adopts a line cutting model to fit typhoon paths, simulates typhoon disaster areas by a simulated circle method, and determines states of communication nodes and power grid observable domains according to power supply and monitoring coupling relations between power grids and communication networks under cascading faults caused by typhoon disasters so as to obtain working states of electric power lines. And (3) considering the processing method of the overload of the power line under different working states of the power line, updating the power flow distribution of the power grid, and calculating the load loss rate of the power CPS to quantify the vulnerability of the system. The method and the device fully consider the coupling relation of power supply and monitoring between the power and the communication network, the cascade fault process of the power CPS under typhoon disasters, the vulnerability assessment of the power CPS after the disaster is accurately simulated, and the safe and reliable operation of the power system is ensured.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD WENZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based multi-target collaborative fire emergency treatment method for high-rise building
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based multi-target collaborative fire emergency treatment method for a high-rise building, which belongs to the technical field of fire emergency of the high-rise building and comprises the following steps of S1, collecting building information data and fire scene information to establish a digital twin model of the building; s2, predicting the safe running time of the elevator by using a digital twin model of the building; s3, acquiring a rescue interval by utilizing the safe operation time of the elevator, and planning a rescue scheme according to the rescue interval; s4, acquiring the position information of the trapped crowd according to the rescue scheme, and coordinating the elevator by utilizing the position information of the trapped crowd to obtain the optimal firefighting emergency treatment scheme of the high-rise building. The digital twin model is utilized to simulate the situation of the high-rise building when the fire disaster occurs, so that the prediction of the fire disaster spreading situation is realized, an optimal treatment method is made through a prediction result, and the evacuation efficiency of trapped people in the high-rise building is increased; according to meeting conditions of trapped people on different floors, the elevator is matched with an emergency stair to evacuate.
assignees: GUANGDONG GUANGYU SCIENCE AND TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Mining vehicle operation optimization method based on digital twin technology in intelligent mine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of mines, and particularly discloses a mining vehicle operation optimization method based on a digital twin technology in an intelligent mine, which comprises the steps of hanging hygrothermographs at required measurement positions through hanging ropes, respectively placing three hygrothermographs at a mine mountain top, a mine mountain waist and a mine mountain foot, transversely spacing 1000m each hygrothermograph, and solving the average number of the three hygrothermographs to be used as temperature and humidity data of the mine mountain top, the mine mountain waist and the mine mountain foot; compared with the traditional mine blasting design, the mining vehicle anti-sinking and overturning safety hidden trouble caused by different terrains, wind speeds, wind directions, rainfall, earthquake actions and the like when the mining vehicle is in load transportation operation can be effectively reduced or even avoided, proper measures can be taken in advance, driving safety is ensured, the digital twin technology is adopted, the actual running condition of the mining vehicle can be simulated according to actual measured data, and the running condition of the mining vehicle is monitored in real time, so that a large amount of resources such as manpower and material resources are saved.
assignees: JIANGSU FANZAI INTELLIGENT TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV HEBEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Prediction method of lightning ground flash signal based on LSTM (least squares) circulating neural network
abstract_en: The application relates to a prediction method of lightning ground flash signals based on an LSTM circulating neural network. The method comprises the following steps: dividing a training set and a testing set by adopting the processed historical lightning electric field signals, constructing an LSTM model as a lightning electric field signal prediction model to be trained, initializing a weight matrix and a bias matrix of the LSTM model, inputting the training set into the LSTM model, carrying out forward propagation training by adopting a forward propagation algorithm, finishing training of the LSTM model by updating weights and biases by adopting an error back propagation algorithm, obtaining an optimal weight matrix and an optimal bias matrix, inputting the testing set into the LSTM model by adopting the optimal weight matrix and the optimal bias matrix for testing to reach preset precision, and obtaining a lightning electric field signal predicted by the trained lightning electric field signal prediction model in a future preset time period so as to determine whether lightning back shots occur or not and accurately realize lightning ground flash disaster prediction.
assignees: UNIV NANTONG;INST ATMOSPHERIC PHYSICS CAS

title_en: Digital twin drainage basin characteristic element identification method based on intelligent calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-stream domain feature element identification method based on intelligent computation, which is mainly oriented to feature elements with dynamic characteristics, such as wading engineering operation, disaster evolution, flow fields and the like, which change along with time.
