Aiming at the problems of obvious time variability, concealment and weakness of dynamic characteristic elements, an intelligent calculation model for simulating a double-flow mechanism is innovatively provided, and error accumulation of digital twin-flow-domain characteristic element identification is reduced.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Digital twin platform-based large-scale place crowd emergency evacuation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-scale place crowd emergency evacuation method based on a digital twin platform, which relates to the technical field of emergency evacuation, and comprises the steps of collecting movement tracks of crowds in a place to be evacuated, constructing a road network image of the place to be evacuated, emergency planning a crowd emergency evacuation scheme, and pushing the emergency evacuation scheme to a handheld terminal and a crowd evacuation deduction simulation platform; the crowd emergency evacuation is carried out according to an emergency evacuation scheme of the handheld terminal, the actual track of the crowd is fed back in real time, and the crowd evacuation deduction simulation platform synchronously deducts the crowd evacuation state to generate the crowd simulation track; judging whether the deviation of the actual track of the crowd and the simulated track of the crowd meets a set threshold value, if not, pushing deviation correction alarm information to the person deviating from the track until emergency evacuation is finished; the invention has low evacuation cost, can send alarm information to partial deviated crowd, realizes the purpose of 'virtual control and real control', and improves evacuation efficiency.
assignees: NANJING INST TECH

title_en: Cloud edge collaborative train fire hazard studying and judging early warning method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cloud edge collaborative train fire hazard studying and judging early warning method based on digital twinning, which comprises the following steps: building BIM models of running intervals, trains and fire sensors; according to fire simulation requirements, the BIM model is lightened, dynamic simulation is carried out on various fire working conditions, a digital twin model of the train fire development trend based on multiple sensor parameters is constructed, and a multiple sensor real-time parameter table at the moment of fire occurrence is extracted; disposing fire sensors on the train according to the position and parameters of the digital twin model, collecting and processing sensor data by the vehicle-mounted edge controller, and performing fire real-time research and judgment according to a multi-sensor real-time parameter table at the moment of fire occurrence; the vehicle-mounted edge controller and the train fire development trend digital twin model establish a real-time data channel, and the train fire development trend digital twin model carries out fire early warning according to sensor parameters transmitted by the vehicle-mounted edge controller; the invention can avoid train fire disaster as far as possible and ensure train safety.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY DESIGN CORP

title_en: Virtual reality interaction method, device and system thereof, and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual reality interaction method, equipment, a system and a readable storage medium thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring multi-modal data under a real disaster scene, and constructing a digital twin virtual disaster scene corresponding to the real disaster scene in real time through the multi-modal data; acquiring a corresponding space position of a user in the digital twin virtual disaster scene through virtual reality equipment; performing scene evolution prediction on disaster conditions based on the digital twin virtual disaster scene to generate a virtual disaster prediction scene with a preset time scale; acquiring prediction perception information of the spatial position based on the virtual disaster prediction scene; and feeding back the predictive sensory information to the virtual reality device to generate a natural and real first somatosensory experience. The real-time prediction perception of the digital twin virtual disaster scene is combined with the virtual reality equipment, so that the real somatosensory experience of a predicted event can be brought to a user, and the scientificity, efficiency and safety of rescue actions can be effectively improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG DABITE NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Four-pre-system based on data and model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a four-pre-system based on data and a model, belongs to the field of flood control prediction, and relates to the technology of data processing and model construction; the method comprises the steps of taking bottom plate data of a target monitoring area obtained by a bottom plate data obtaining unit as a base, constructing water conservancy professional models such as flood forecast, flood evolution, flood scheduling and flood inundation early warning of the target monitoring area by utilizing an emulation simulation engine, constructing a digital twin base platform, developing flood control four-pre application of the target monitoring area, supporting accurate flood control and disaster reduction decisions of the target monitoring area, converging knowledge such as forecast scheduling schemes, historical scenes, business rules and expert experience, developing a knowledge engine with business characteristics through extraction, fusion and reasoning, supporting flood control four-pre business of the target monitoring area, and providing knowledge support for flood forecast, sluice optimization scheduling and safe operation management of a river basin.
assignees: CHINA WATER SUNNY DATA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power supply-keeping decision analysis system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power supply-protecting decision analysis system and a method thereof, wherein the system comprises a weather disaster prediction module, a power supply-protecting decision generation module, a digital twin simulation module and a decision analysis output module; the weather disaster prediction module is used for predicting weather disasters in the target area; the power supply protection decision generation module acquires a power supply protection decision corresponding to the early warning weather disaster in the target area according to the weather disaster prediction result; the digital twin simulation module simulates weather disasters in a target area and executes power supply protection decisions to obtain simulation results; the decision analysis output module analyzes the simulation result and outputs the analysis result. The method makes a supply-keeping decision in a weather disaster early warning stage, and is accurate and effective in time abundance and supply-keeping decision; and providing improvement suggestions, simulating various supply protection decisions, taking measures in time when disasters occur, and adjusting the supply protection decisions in time according to the development trend and alternative schemes of the disasters so as to ensure the electricity safety, property safety and life safety in a target area.
assignees: NANJING NARI WATER CONSERVANCY AND HYDROPOWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster digital twin simulation method combining refined dynamic geologic model with GEOAI
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster digital twin simulation method combining a refined dynamic geologic model with GEOAI, and relates to the field of coal mine safety. Modeling and grid initialization of a refined dynamic geologic model; initializing parameters of a disaster simulation calculation unit of the refined dynamic geologic model; refining the simulation of the dynamic geologic model disaster simulation, and solving a disaster simulation result; real-time dynamic correction of disaster simulation input and boundary conditions is performed on the refined dynamic geologic model by using geologic disclosure and perception data; establishing a refined dynamic geological disaster evolution database; training a refined dynamic geological disaster simulation reasoning calibration model by using the geospatial artificial intelligence; and carrying out disaster evolution and inversion by using a dynamically corrected refined dynamic geologic model disaster simulation and simulation reasoning calibration model, and providing decision support for mine geologic disaster prevention and control.

title_en: Typhoon storm surge disaster chain catastrophe risk assessment method based on Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster risk management, and discloses a typhoon storm surge disaster chain catastrophe risk assessment method based on a Bayesian network, which comprises the following steps: constructing a disaster chain catastrophe scene library of typhoon-storm tide-flood-embankment based on the typhoon scene and catastrophe driving element combination scene; constructing a Bayesian network model according to the catastrophe mechanism and the chain transfer rule of a disaster chain of typhoon-storm tide-flood-embankment; and evaluating the catastrophe risks under different catastrophe scenes in the catastrophe scene library by adopting a Bayesian network model. The invention is based on the complex catastrophe mechanism of typhoon-storm tide-flood-embankment disaster chain and the chain transfer relation among elements affecting catastrophe, develops the Bayesian complex system network reasoning modeling of the disaster chain, simulates and analyzes the catastrophe risks of various disasters of the disaster chain under different catastrophe scenes, and has important significance for the risk management and disaster reduction work of typhoon disasters in coastal areas.

title_en: Disaster cooperative rescue system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a disaster cooperative rescue system and a disaster cooperative rescue method. And the unmanned aerial vehicle is in communication connection with the processing unit. The processing unit is configured to: planning a plurality of guiding paths in a three-dimensional virtual space based on the positions of a plurality of disaster sources and the positions of the safety exits; road nodes of a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles which go to a plurality of guiding paths are controlled to guide trapped personnel or rescue personnel to travel in a mode of constructing guiding identifiers of the guiding paths. According to the invention, the digital twin virtual module of the unmanned aerial vehicle is built in the three-dimensional virtual space, so that the structure, function, state and behavior of the unmanned aerial vehicle are reflected, and a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles are planned to form an array of three-dimensional guide marks in the air. According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle data is processed and analyzed in the three-dimensional virtual space, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle simulation, prediction, optimization and control are realized, the guiding effect of the unmanned aerial vehicle is reflected, and the unmanned aerial vehicle guiding planning, scheduling, coordination and evaluation are realized.
assignees: DMS CORP

title_en: Typhoon disaster prediction method for optimizing back propagation neural network based on genetic algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a typhoon disaster prediction method based on genetic algorithm optimization back propagation neural network, which comprises the steps of obtaining meteorological data of typhoon disasters to obtain a training set and a testing set; constructing a deep learning network, and extracting features to obtain first features; constructing an initial decision tree model through the first characteristics, and optimizing the initial decision tree model by adopting a genetic algorithm and a post pruning technology; establishing an initial model of typhoon disaster estimation based on the BP neural network model and the decision tree model; and inputting the training set into the typhoon disaster prediction model to obtain typhoon disaster prediction results. According to the invention, the typhoon disaster prediction model is established based on the classification decision tree mode, so that the influence of typhoon disasters on the environment can be predicted more accurately, and the disaster prevention and reduction work is guided scientifically.
assignees: CMA METEOROLOGICAL DEVELOPMENT AND PLANNING INST

title_en: Combined simulation method for cascading failure of gas-electric coupling system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a joint simulation method for cascading faults of a gas-electric coupling system, which is based on a joint simulation framework of an event driving mode, establishes a dynamic model of a power grid-natural gas network-coupling element, designs an information interaction interface on the basis of two mature commercial simulation software of the two systems, and realizes the space-time interaction of simulation information of a power system and a natural gas system on different platforms. The method has the advantages of high accuracy, convenient model construction and the like, and can realize the accurate depiction of the evolution process of the electric-gas fault. By applying the simulation method, the fault dynamic evolution process can be more effectively analyzed. In addition, the invention also provides a fault blocking strategy which can effectively block faults caused by extreme disasters from spreading across the energy system.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG

title_en: Extreme assessment method and system for storm-induced mountain torrent event
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for extremely evaluating a torrential rain-induced mountain torrent event, and belongs to the technical field of extreme climate research. Firstly, determining a rainfall area, acquiring geological information, rainfall data and flood data of the rainfall area, and determining a flood loss coefficient and a rainfall extreme index; then determining the geological information change of the flood impact area based on the digital twin simulated rainfall reproduction process, and calculating a geological damage coefficient; and finally, evaluating the extreme of the heavy rainfall induced flood event based on the flood loss coefficient, the rainfall extreme index and the geological damage coefficient. The method effectively integrates multi-source information such as extreme rainfall, flood loss, geological damage and the like, has more reasonable and reliable results compared with the traditional single evaluation method which only depends on rainfall, reproduction period or disaster index, and can comprehensively and accurately evaluate the extreme of heavy rainfall induced flood disasters.
assignees: UNIV LANZHOU JIAOTONG

title_en: Landslide surge near-far field propagation evolution coupling method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coupling method and a coupling system for near-far field propagation evolution of landslide surge, wherein the coupling method comprises the steps of simulating near-field motion of a landslide of a particulate body by adopting particle discrete elements and smooth particle fluid dynamics, calculating far-field motion of the landslide of the particulate body by taking the simulated near-field motion as an initial boundary condition, and completing near-far field propagation evolution of the landslide of the particulate body in the motion and water entering process based on drag force and buoyancy. According to the invention, through fine numerical simulation of key areas, the propagation path, speed and influence range of landslide surge can be predicted more accurately. This is critical for disaster early warning and risk assessment. Meanwhile, the model disclosed by the invention can be used for considering the topography, geology, hydrologic conditions and the like in more detail, so that the landslide surge simulation reality is improved. In addition, the invention can evaluate the potential influence of landslide surge on coastal structures, residential areas and key infrastructure by simulating different scenes, and provide dangerous analysis for rescue and planning.

title_en: Digital twin remote emergency medical multi-person collaborative training monitoring cabin device
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twin remote emergency medical multi-person collaborative training monitoring cabin device, which enables a training cabin to shake up and down and left and right through a shaking component, so that in the medical rescue process, the training cabin can be driven to shake up and down and left and right through a driving shaking component to simulate natural disasters such as earthquakes and the like when medical staff performs operations or treatment, and thus doctors can be simulated and trained, and the in-situ adaptability of the medical staff is improved; meanwhile, by the matched use of the auxiliary components, natural disasters such as a raining state, flood and the like can be simulated in the process of curing medical staff; finally, the simulated earthquake scene, flood scene and raining scene can be subjected to multidimensional environment projection and environment audio-visual simulation; therefore, the invention not only can increase the method and the state of strain of medical staff facing various disasters, but also can make the device teaching and practical training more real and efficient through simulating the disasters, thereby improving the practicability of the device.
assignees: The Third Medical Center Of Chinese Pla General Hospital

title_en: Hydrologic detection equipment layout method and system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hydrological detection equipment layout method and system based on the Internet of things, which belong to the technical field of hydrological monitoring, and are used for acquiring multi-frame continuous image information of a target detection area in a preset time period, introducing a hidden Markov model and a Baum-Welch algorithm for analysis to generate a time sequence dynamic model of the target detection area, calculating the occurrence probability of hydrological natural disaster types in a Bayesian network algorithm based on the time sequence dynamic model, analyzing and planning to obtain a first installation area, constructing a hydrological detection equipment simulation model, introducing the hydrological detection equipment simulation model into the first installation area for simulation measurement and screening the installation area to obtain a second installation area, constructing a quadratic polynomial regression curve model, and screening the final layout points of the second installation area based on the model to obtain a final layout scheme. The method can screen and plan the measurement layout points of the hydrologic detection equipment, realizes accurate and efficient measurement effect and has high reliability.

title_en: Multi disaster prevention system of railway facility based on digital twin, and method for the same
title_ko: 디지털트윈 기반 철도시설물의 복합재난 방지 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: While a digital twin for the interior of railway facilities such as railways, tunnels, and underground stations is constructed and managers can easily detect abnormalities inside railway facilities, indoor and outdoor positioning information through client terminals such as pedestrians and passers-by are accurately grasped and the optimal evacuation route in the event of a disaster is virtually simulated, thereby guiding people to the optimal evacuation route in the event of an actual disaster. In order to build a complex disaster prevention system for digital twin-based railway facilities, indoor and outdoor positioning technology to digital twin-based railway facilities are applied through a single platform, thereby easily performing disaster prevention and maintenance of railway facilities. In addition, when performing indoor and outdoor vertical positioning, the altitude change is measured and measured through the barometer built into the client terminal smartphone, real-time air pressure changes are compensated, thereby performing vertical positioning accurately.
abstract_ko: 철도, 터널, 지하역사 등의 철도시설물 내부에 대해 디지털트윈을 구축하고, 철도시설물 내부 이상을 관리자가 용이하게 감지하면서, 보행자 및 통행자 등의 클라이언트 단말을 통해 실내외의 측위정보를 정확하게 파악하고, 재난발생시 최적의 대피로를 가상으로 시뮬레이션하여, 실제 재난 발생시 최적 대피로로 유도할 수 있으며, 또한, 디지털트윈 기반 철도시설물의 복합재난 방지 시스템 구축을 위해서, 하나의 플랫폼을 통해 디지털트윈 기반 철도시설물에 실내외 측위기술을 융합 적용함으로써, 철도시설물의 재난방지 및 유지관리를 용이하게 수행할 수 있고, 또한, 실내외 수직 측위시, 클라이언트 단말인 스마트폰에 내장된 기압계를 통해 고도 변화를 측정하여 측위하되, 실시간 기압 변화를 보정함으로써, 수직 측위를 정확하게 수행할 수 있는, 디지털트윈 기반 철도시설물의 복합재난 방지 시스템 및 그 방법이 제공된다.
assignees: KRRI

title_en: Digital twin platform provision system for detecting and responding to fire in the installation area of electrical equipment in nuclear power plants
title_ko: 원전 내 전기설비 설치 영역의 화재 감지 및 대응을 위한 디지털 트윈 플랫폼 제공 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a digital twin platform provision system for detecting and responding to a fire in an installation area of electrical equipment in a nuclear power plant, implemented with a computing device including one or more processors and one or more memories storing commands executable by the processors, the system comprising: a digital twin construction unit for digitally modeling a target object, which is an object including equipment and auxiliary materials related to fire occurrence and damage spread in a place where electrical equipment is installed in a nuclear power plant to construct an initial digital twin; an attribute information application unit for constructing a digital twin by applying fire reactivity information, which is attribute information on fire occurrence factors and fire spread factors of the target object, as information received from the outside to the initial digital twin; and a simulation information provision unit for generating simulation information, which is information on spread simulation in the event of fire occurrence prediction and fire occurrence and response and evacuation scenarios in the event of fire occurrence, depending on user input using the digital twin to output the same to a user terminal. Besides, various other embodiments are possible as identified through this document.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 하나 이상의 프로세서 및 상기 프로세서에서 수행 가능한 명령들을 저장하는 하나 이상의 메모리를 포함하는 컴퓨팅 장치로 구현되는 원전 내 전기설비 설치 영역의 화재 감지 및 대응을 위한 디지털 트윈 플랫폼 제공 시스템에 있어서, 원전 내의 전기 설비가 설치된 장소의 화재 발생 및 피해 확산과 관련된 설비 및 부자재를 포함하는 객체인 대상 객체를 디지털 모델링하여 초기 디지털 트윈을 구축하는 디지털 트윈 구축부; 상기 초기 디지털 트윈에 외부로부터 수신된 정보로서, 상기 대상 객체의 화재 발생 인자 및 화재 확산 인자에 대한 속성 정보인 화재 반응성 정보를 적용하여 디지털 트윈을 구축하는 속성 정보 적용부; 및 상기 디지털 트윈을 이용하여 화재 발생 예측 및 화재 발생 시의 확산 시뮬레이션 및 화재 발생 시의 대응 및 피난 시나리오에 대한 정보인 시뮬레이션 정보를 유저 입력에 따라 생성하여 유저 단말에 출력하는 시뮬레이션 정보 제공부;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 이 외에도 본 문서를 통해 파악되는 다양한 실시 예들이 가능하다.
assignees: KFUBIS CO LTD

title_en: Network disaster tolerance attribute determining method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network disaster recovery attribute determining method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a digital twin model corresponding to a target network system, and acquiring at least one group of index data to be evaluated output by the digital twin model; determining characteristic information to be analyzed corresponding to the current index data to be evaluated based on a pre-constructed chaotic model aiming at each group of index data to be evaluated; determining a characteristic evaluation attribute corresponding to the current index data to be evaluated based on the characteristic information to be analyzed; and determining comprehensive evaluation attributes corresponding to the digital twin model according to the feature evaluation attributes corresponding to all the index data to be evaluated and the weights to be used. The system structure and the running state of the network system are accurately simulated, and the network disaster recovery capability of the target network system is evaluated in a scientific and objective evaluation mode.
assignees: AGRICULTURAL BANK CHINA

title_en: Grading assimilation method for digital twin model of mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grading assimilation method of a mine digital twin model, which comprises the steps of establishing digital twin models with different scales step by using the grading assimilation method, monitoring data of a whole mine, assimilating and establishing a primary digital twin model; then, a stress field of a primary digital twin model is utilized for a certain mining face, and a secondary digital twin model is established after simulation mining and assimilation treatment; finally, a stress field of a secondary digital twin model is utilized for a certain roadway of the mining face, and a tertiary digital twin model is established after simulation excavation and assimilation treatment; therefore, time and calculation process required by building each model are effectively reduced, different model precision criteria are designed according to different research scales, so that the operation speed is matched with the model precision, and finally ground stress distribution data similar to actual tests can be obtained through simulation under the condition of the precision required by different research objects, so that data support is provided for preventing abnormal dynamic disasters.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING

title_en: Residential building fire disaster overfire area prediction method, system, storage medium and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, a storage medium and a device for predicting fire disaster area of residential building, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a fire disaster area prediction model of the residential building based on a fire disaster heat release rate and a ventilation control type combustion mode; the method comprises the steps of determining combustion parameters of an excessive fire area according to a fire excessive fire area prediction model, obtaining fire history data of the combustion parameters, determining probability distribution of the combustion parameters according to the fire history data, randomly sampling the probability distribution of the combustion parameters to obtain a plurality of groups of combustion parameters corresponding to different probabilities, performing Monte Carlo simulation to obtain excessive fire area cumulative probability distribution of a residential building based on the fire excessive fire area prediction model and the combustion parameters corresponding to the plurality of groups of different probabilities, and determining fire risk levels of the residential building according to the excessive fire area cumulative probability distribution. The invention can accurately predict the fire disaster area of the residential building and determine the fire disaster risk level so as to formulate effective fire disaster prevention and control measures.

title_en: Railway disaster risk prevention and control method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a railway disaster risk prevention and control method and a system, which belong to the technical field of railway disaster risk early warning and acquire real-time meteorological disaster data and image data of railway monitoring points; displaying the state of the railway monitoring point, the risk value and the early warning information after disaster simulation evaluation; performing risk assessment and deduction prediction on railway disasters based on the monitoring data to obtain risk classification states of monitoring points and disaster follow-up development information; and pushing corresponding strategies according to the risk states of the monitoring points, performing strategy previewing and efficiency previewing on different pushed prevention and control or emergency strategies to obtain an optimal strategy for risk prevention and control, and guiding and optimizing emergency resource deployment. The invention applies digital twinning, and the Internet of things, state information, algorithm model, simulation deduction and the like form effective monitoring, simulation and prediction on physical entities through virtual-real data interaction, thereby realizing the functions of super-real-time state sensing and automatic emergency response linkage, and having good application and popularization values.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG

title_en: Transmission monitoring system for intelligent substation relay protection overhaul test
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system automation, in particular to an intelligent substation relay protection overhaul test transmission monitoring system. According to the invention, through the application of an information gain algorithm and a Gini coefficient, the accuracy of fault mode identification is enhanced, the combination of a random forest algorithm and a cyclic neural network improves the accuracy of equipment state prediction, the dynamic threshold adjustment of a Q learning and fuzzy logic algorithm improves the sensitivity of fault prediction, the network analysis of a graph theory algorithm improves the identification efficiency of equipment and fault propagation paths, the decision optimization of a system dynamics model and Monte Carlo simulation ensures the scientificity of maintenance strategies and the effectiveness of emergency response, and the application of a linear programming and network flow analysis method improves the overhaul test efficiency.
assignees: XUANCHENG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Open pit mine geological environment disaster and ecological restoration simulation device and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to an open pit mine geological environment disaster and ecological restoration simulation device, which has the structure that: a vibration control platform is arranged on the bottom surface of the closed simulation chamber, and a slope simulation platform is supported above the vibration control platform through a plurality of lifting platforms; a heating device, a condensing device and a flame spraying device are arranged in the slope simulation platform, and a temperature sensor and a humidity sensor are arranged in the slope of the slope simulation platform; a spraying device is arranged above the slope simulation platform and is positioned at the top of the closed simulation chamber; an acquisition point is arranged below the slope of the slope simulation platform; a monitoring instrument group is arranged at the top of the closed simulation chamber; a control console for controlling and operating each device is arranged in the closed simulation room. The simulation device can simulate the influence of various mine environment disasters on the stability of the pit slope of the open pit coal mine and simulate ecological restoration conditions, and provides a basis for the pit slope management of the open pit coal mine.
assignees: UNIV LIAONING

title_en: Coal mine digital twin model building method based on Bayesian network algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for establishing a digital twin model of a coal mine based on a Bayesian network algorithm, which relates to the technical field of machine learning and comprises the following steps: s1, determining a target mine and acquiring real-time data; s2, constructing an initial digital twin model; s3, determining disaster types and corresponding disaster causing factors of the target mine, further constructing and training to obtain a disaster causing factor analysis model, and outputting to obtain a topological relation of the disaster causing factors by using the disaster causing factor analysis model; s4, constructing a Bayesian model, and performing iterative training on the Bayesian model by utilizing superposition weight analysis; s5, embedding the disaster-causing factor analysis model and the Bayesian model into the initial digital twin model in series by utilizing the antagonism framework to obtain a final digital twin model. The invention is integrated with a Bayesian network algorithm, can analyze and predict input data to obtain the occurrence probability of mine disasters, and can take countermeasures or rectifying measures in advance for different disasters, thereby effectively improving the safety coefficient of the coal mine.
assignees: ORDOS CITY TENGYUAN COAL CO LTD;NANJING BEIDOU INNOVATION APPLICATION TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Big Data-Based Port Infrastructure Control System Data Linkage System For Port Infrastructure Disaster And Aging Digital Twin Construction
title_ko: 항만 인프라 재해 및 노후도 디지털 트윈 구축을 위한 빅데이터 기반 항만 인프라 관제 시스템 데이터 연계 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention proposes a big data-based port infrastructure control system data linkage system for port infrastructure disaster and aging digital twin construction, which can intuitively monitor the current state of the port infrastructure and the situation required for maintenance through virtual reality, and can monitor the port infrastructure through big data-based aging and disaster risk evaluation, analysis, and visualization by predicting the occurrence situation due to disaster occurrence and aging through digital twin-based simulation and establishing an immediate policy decision-making system.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 항만인프라의 현재 상태 및 유지관리 필요 상황을 가상현실을 통해 직관적으로 모니터링 가능한 관제 시스템과, 디지털 트윈 기반 시뮬레이션으로 재해 발생 및 노후화에 의한 발생 상황을 예측하고 즉각적인 정책적 의사결정 시스템 구축하여, 빅데이터 기반 노후도 및 재해위험도 평가와 분석, 가시화를 통한 항만 인프라 모니터링할 수 있는, 항만 인프라 재해 및 노후도 디지털 트윈 구축을 위한 빅데이터 기반 항만 인프라 관제 시스템 데이터 연계 시스템을 제안한다.
assignees: KOREA LOGISTICS NETWORK CORP

title_en: Corn disaster monitoring and ecological restoration assessment method based on multi-source remote sensing data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of remote sensing monitoring, in particular to a corn disaster monitoring and ecological restoration assessment method based on multi-source remote sensing data. Comprising the following steps: continuously measuring and sampling corn plots, extracting Sentinel data, and analyzing characteristic time variation; acquiring and processing high-resolution binary data to obtain a multispectral image and performing visual interpretation; establishing a sample data set of corn disaster degree; masking the Sentinel data as an input dataset; performing mask processing on the preprocessed Sentinel data, performing characteristic calculation, and creating a characteristic parameter set; constructing a random forest model; training and optimizing the random forest model to obtain a corn disaster degree monitoring model, obtaining a corn disaster degree spatial distribution result according to the model, and analyzing the corn ecological change condition to realize corn disaster monitoring. The advantages are that: and the dynamic change monitoring of the post-disaster growth of the corn is realized, and the post-disaster loss is estimated.
assignees: UNIV JILIN

title_en: Tunnel structure deformation three-dimensional visual monitoring method based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a three-dimensional visual monitoring method for tunnel structure deformation based on a digital twin technology. The method comprises the following steps: building a building information model of a target tunnel structure, and associating actual arrangement information of monitoring equipment in the target tunnel structure to the building information model; and acquiring monitoring data of the monitoring equipment in real time, and dynamically adjusting the building information model according to the monitoring data. By establishing a building information model and linking with actual monitoring data in real time, three-dimensional digital twin of tunnel structure deformation is realized, the characteristics of visualization, parameterization, diagonability, coordination and the like of the building information model are combined, multi-source fusion of monitoring, operation and decision data can be realized, and the structure evolution under the disaster condition of a tunnel and high-efficiency and accurate simulation in the aspects of emergency rescue and the like can be carried out by combining specific disaster disturbance information, so that the problems faced in the traditional tunnel safety operation and maintenance are solved.
assignees: UNIV SHENZHEN

title_en: Surge chain life disaster evaluation method considering failure probability of reservoir landslide
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of evaluation of inland reservoir landslide surge disaster risk, and discloses a surge chain-generated disaster evaluation method considering reservoir landslide failure probability, which comprises the following steps: step 1, defining a research area range; step 2, obtaining topographic data and rock-soil parameters according to the research objects and the range of the research area, and obtaining annual warehouse water level data and daily rainfall data in the research area; and 3, selecting a typical section of the potential landslide body, and performing 5000 Monte Carlo simulation calculations on the failure probability of the potential landslide body according to a Monte Carlo method. According to the landslide surge chain life disaster evaluation method, the potential landslide body failure probability of the landslide is introduced to reflect the influence of the failure probability of the landslide on the landslide surge chain life disaster evaluation, and the landslide failure probability, the landslide surge disaster risk and the landslide surge disaster bearing body vulnerability are multiplied to obtain the landslide surge disaster risk evaluation, so that the risk evaluation result is more reasonable, and a systematic landslide surge chain life disaster evaluation method is formed.

title_en: Regional Ripple Impact Analysis System Based on Interconnection and Dependence of National Core Infrastructure
title_ko: 국가핵심기반시설 상호연계성 및 의존도 기반 지역 파급영향 분석 시스템
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a regional spillover impact analysis system based on the interconnectivity and dependency of national key infrastructures, which analyzes the impact between facilities in the event of a functional outage or deterioration of individual national key infrastructures through a network-based scientific simulation that takes into account interconnectivity and dependency, by setting up a user scenario, and scientifically analyzes the spillover impact on the local community. The provided regional ripple impact analysis system based on the interconnectivity and dependency of national key infrastructures includes: database (10) comprising a national infrastructure DB (12), a local government DB, a statistics DB by department, a disaster statistics DB, and a local community disaster prevention capacity DB; a disruption risk scenario setting unit (20) that accesses the database (10), constructs a national key infrastructure and sub-facility DB in advance, selects national key infrastructures in each field, and then selects functions within the field; a facility-to-facility impact analysis module (30) that accesses the database (10) and constructs a national key infrastructure interconnectivity and dependency analysis matrix DB; and a community ripple impact analysis simulator (40) that selects variables of community impact due to national key infrastructures by constructing a DB for pre-impact relationship analysis.
assignees: LIG SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Landslide vulnerability analysis method based on causal discovery and structure learning
abstract_en: The application provides a landslide vulnerability analysis method based on causal discovery and structure learning. Firstly, multi-source geologic data and landslide catalogs of a monitoring area are acquired, a disaster causing factor set is constructed, and the disaster causing factor set is a causal discovery factor set and a vulnerability analysis factor set, wherein the vulnerability analysis factor set is required to be subjected to discretization; dividing a monitoring area into a causal discovery area and a vulnerability analysis area, and sequentially constructing a sample set; adopting an unsupervised causal discovery algorithm to construct a causal directed acyclic graph driven by data, and eliminating redundant data in an easy-occurrence analysis factor set and a sample set according to the result; and constructing a Bayesian network model by using the causal directed acyclic graph, sequentially training, predicting and evaluating the model by using a vulnerability analysis sample set, and finally carrying out landslide vulnerability analysis on a monitoring area. The method can fully excavate the coupling relation between the landslide and the disaster-causing factor, construct a model with low redundancy and high interpretability, and realize more accurate landslide susceptibility analysis.
assignees: UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES BEIJING

title_en: Method and device for analyzing coupling risk of energy and traffic system in extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for analyzing coupling risk of energy and a traffic system in extreme weather. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: respectively establishing a power system simulation operation model, a heating system simulation operation model, a traffic system simulation operation model and an extreme weather simulation model; after the electric power system simulation operation model, the heating system simulation operation model and the traffic system simulation operation model are coupled, an energy-traffic simulation operation model is established by considering the damage influence of the extreme weather simulation model; and based on the energy-traffic simulation operation model, carrying out risk analysis on the coupled energy-traffic system by utilizing Monte Carlo simulation. The invention can capture the mutual coupling and interdependence relation of different infrastructure systems when facing disaster damage, fully reveal the risks faced by the energy-traffic coupling system under the action of extreme weather disasters, and better assist the prevention and response of extreme weather events.
assignees: STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Big data-based digital twin control system for port infrastructure maintenance
title_ko: 항만 인프라 유지관리를 위한 빅데이터 기반 디지털 트윈 관제시스템
abstract_en: Provided is a big data-based digital twin control system for port infrastructure maintenance, which comprises: a port data collection unit (100) for integrally managing information on a building, a road, and a bridge constituting a port; a digital twin platform (200) for implementing a digital twin and outputting the same as virtual modeling data of the digital twin; an object modeling unit (210) for performing 3D or 2D virtual modeling work; a simulator unit (220) for predicting a damage occurrence situation due to disaster occurrence and aging of the port building/facility/road/bridge; a state detection unit (230) for monitoring the state of a sensor and whether the sensor is malfunctioning in real time; a structure analysis server (300) for calculating each remaining lifetime through information data transmitted from the port data collection unit (100) and structure analysis data on the port/road/bridge; a digital twin DB (400) for storing data on other ports which are already implemented; and a display unit (500) for displaying the virtual modeling data on a monitor. According to the present invention, the aging degree of the port infrastructure can be visually and immediately checked through the display unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 건물의 층/구분공간(zone)/설비별로 에너지 소비량을 디지털 트윈의 가상 모델링 데이터로 출력하는 복합용도 대규모 다중건물의 에너지 관리 및 최적화를 지원하는 디지털 트윈 플랫폼에 관한 것이다.  
종래 항만의 유지보수를 위해 디지털 트윈 플랫폼이 적용된 바 없으므로, 본 발명은 항만을 구성하는 건물과 도로 및 교량에 대한 정보를 통합 관리하는 항만 데이터 취합부와; 상기 항만 데이터 취합부에서 전달된 정보 데이터를 통해 객체 모델링부에 의해 디지털 트윈(Digital Twin)을 구현하고, 구조해석 서버에서 전달되는 항만건물/시설/도로/교량에 대한 구조 해석 데이터와 항만 데이터 취합부에서 전달된 노후도 정보를 기반으로 디지털 트윈의 가상 모델링 데이터로 출력하는 디지털 트윈 플랫폼과; 상기 항만 데이터 취합부(100)에서 전달된 정보 데이터에 의해 3D 또는 2D의 가상화 모델링 작업을 진행하는 객체 모델링부와; 상기 항만 데이터 취합부에서 전달된 정보 데이터를 통해 항만건물과 도로 및 교량에 대한 잔여 수명을 예측하는 시뮬레이터부와; 상기 항만 데이터 취합부의 정보 데이터에 포함된 센서의 상태 및 고장여부를 실시간을 감시하는 상태감지부와; 상기 항만 데이터 취합부에서 전달된 정보 데이터와, 항만/도로/교량에 대한 구조 해석 데이터를 통해 각각의 잔여 수명을 연산하는 구조해석 서버와; 기존에 구현되어 있는 다른 항만에 대한 데이터가 저장되는 디지털 트윈DB와; 상기 디지털 트윈 플랫폼(200)에서 구현되는 가상 모델링 데이터를 모니터에 표출하는 디스플레이부를 포함하여 구성되고, 상기 디지털 트윈 플랫폼에서는 디지털 트윈DB에 저장된 동일 또는 유사한 항만의 빅데이터(Big Data)를 머신러닝(Machine Learning) 알고리즘과 AI(Artificial Intelligence)를 적용하여 디지털 트윈 구현의 효율성을 향상시키는 것을 특징으로 하는 항만 인프라 유지관리를 위한 빅데이터 기반 디지털 트윈 관제시스템을 제안한다. 
본 발명에 의한 항만 인프라 유지관리를 위한 빅데이터 기반 디지털 트윈 관제시스템은 항만 데이터 취합부에서 전달되는 정보 데이터가 디지털 트윈 플랫폼에 전달되고, 객체 모델링부를 통해 각 구성요소에 대한 가상화 모델링 작업을 진행하며, 항만건물/시설/도로/교량의 노후도를 예측 및 시뮬레이션하여 디스플레이할 수 있으므로, 디스플레이부를 통해 시각적으로 항만 인프라의 노후도를 즉각 확인이 가능한 효과가 있다. 또한, 본 발명은 디지털 트윈 기반 시뮬레이션을 통한 재해발생 및 노후화에 의한 피해발생상황 예측 및 즉각적인 정책적 의사결정 시스템을 구축하고, 빅데이터(기본정보, 2내역/3내역 데이터 및 노후도/재해위험도 평가 데이터 등) 분석 및 가시화를 통한 항만 인프라 모니터링이 가능한 효과가 있다.
assignees: ROCKWONIT GLOBAL CO LTD

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster early warning misalignment risk analysis method based on Monte Carlo simulation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent disaster early warning misalignment risk analysis method based on a Monte Carlo simulation method, which comprises the steps of extracting and analyzing initial indexes of mountain torrent disasters, screening sensitive indexes and reducing weight to obtain a mountain torrent disaster index set, and constructing a mountain torrent disaster index system; weighting the mountain torrent disaster indexes to obtain comprehensive weights of the mountain torrent disaster indexes, and constructing a mountain torrent disaster early warning model; extracting historical mountain torrents data of a research area, inputting the historical mountain torrents into a mountain torrents disaster early warning model to obtain mountain torrents disaster early warning, setting an early warning misalignment threshold value based on a mountain torrents index system, and calculating mountain torrents disaster early warning misalignment probability; and (3) adjusting the decision of the mountain torrent disaster index weight and feeding back the mountain torrent disaster index weight into the mountain torrent disaster early warning model, setting iteration preset times, extracting the mountain torrent disaster early warning model after the iteration is input, and stopping iteration when the result after the iteration and the expected deviation are within the early warning misalignment threshold. The invention can effectively improve the early warning accuracy and the response efficiency of the mountain torrent disaster and is beneficial to reducing the loss caused by the mountain torrent disaster.
assignees: ZHEJIANG INST OF HYDRAULICS & ESTUARY ZHEJIANG MARINE PLANNING AND DESIGN INST

title_en: Tunnel disaster simulation method, device and equipment based on three-dimensional digital twin model
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a tunnel disaster simulation method, device and equipment based on a three-dimensional digital twin model. One embodiment of the method comprises the following steps: acquiring cable data of an actual cable tunnel and a cable tunnel disaster test case; inputting cable data and cable tunnel disaster test cases into a pre-established three-dimensional digital twin model of the tunnel to obtain a disaster state cable tunnel model; carrying out tunnel disaster scene detection on the disaster state cable tunnel model to generate a tunnel scene detection result; determining corresponding disaster processing information; calling a corresponding simulation tool to execute tunnel disaster processing operation; determining a tunnel scene detection result, disaster processing information and difference data between a called simulation tool and a test sample; and determining that the tunnel disaster simulation corresponding to the cable tunnel disaster test case is completed. This embodiment may reduce the damage of cable resources in case of disasters.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Farmer behavior prediction method based on agent modeling and Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a farmer behavior prediction method based on agent modeling and a Bayesian network, and belongs to the technical field of farmer behavior simulation prediction. The method comprises the following steps: a data collection stage; a Bayesian relation network and a group effect influence mechanism construction stage; a peasant household disaster prevention consciousness change mechanism construction stage; a peasant household long-term disaster response adaptation behavior prediction model construction stage; setting model parameters; and in the model information importing and simulating stage, inputting the external conditions of the target area, then simulating random outbreaks of geological disasters for a plurality of times, counting the decision behaviors of each simulated target agent, and taking an average value to obtain a peasant household behavior prediction result. The ABM method is adopted, so that the response behaviors of farmers in various disaster scenes can be simulated, influence factors and rules of the farmers are analyzed, and the method has high predictability and applicability; the phenomenon of emergence of the behaviors of the farmers can be mined in the simulation process.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN NORMAL

title_en: Underground infrastructure flood evacuation analysis method and system based on large model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood evacuation analysis method and system of underground infrastructure based on a large model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring flood image information, and outputting disaster descriptions and risk levels corresponding to the flood image information through a large-model flood analysis mode training system; inputting the data output by the large model flood analysis mode training system into a large model-digital twin real-time deduction system through an integrated system of the large model and the digital twin platform for calling; carrying out data deduction through the large model-digital twin real-time deduction system, and outputting an analysis result; the invention provides a new underground infrastructure flood evacuation analysis method, which improves the decision efficiency of flood evacuation and emergency.
assignees: UNIV SHENZHEN

title_en: Throwing type lifeboat intelligent release system based on pool test and digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a throwing type lifeboat intelligent release system based on a pool test and digital twin, which comprises a field control system, a digital twin system and a pool test system, wherein the field control system is used for acquiring field environment and real ship parameters and controlling the lifeboat to emit according to feedback data; the digital twin system is used for providing three-dimensional reproduction of the accident scene, so that the personnel can make decisions conveniently; the pool test system is used for simulating wind, wave and current environments of an accident site in a test pool and judging whether the on-site lifeboat is safe to launch. The invention establishes a set of intelligent release system of the throwing type lifeboat, which is formed by the complementary three of the actual physical environment, the digital model prediction and the scale test optimization, can realize the double reproduction of the digital and the physical model of the throwing type lifeboat, so that the life-saving personnel can accurately and effectively command the escape work in the disaster site, and the survival rate of the life-saving personnel is greatly improved.
assignees: UNIV JIANGSU SCIENCE & TECH;COSCO SHIPPING HEAVY IND YANGZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent prediction method for fire hazard change risk of reinforced concrete structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent prediction method for fire hazard change risk of a reinforced concrete structure, which comprises the following steps: establishing a fine and efficient numerical analysis model of the reinforced concrete structure; constructing a fire collapse simulation method of the reinforced concrete structure; acquiring a fire response data set of the whole reinforced concrete structure; establishing a fire damage evaluation model of the reinforced concrete structure, extracting residual bearing capacity of the target structural component and deformation data of the top and bottom among the layers of the target structural component, calculating to obtain the change rate of relative deformation among the layers of the target structural component, judging whether the target structural component collapses and the collapse direction, and further establishing a fire damage collapse behavior database of the reinforced concrete structure; and combining the neural network prediction model obtained by training with the reinforced concrete structure fine high-efficiency numerical analysis model to establish a reinforced concrete structure digital twin body for carrying out structural fire simulation analysis and prediction of structural fire behavior. The invention can realize the prediction of fire disaster high-temperature damage of the reinforced concrete structure.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: Disaster prevention safety emergency evacuation guiding system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster prevention safety emergency evacuation guiding system and a method thereof, wherein the system comprises a plurality of intelligent emergency marker lamps, a plurality of intelligent emergency illuminating lamps, a control host and a comprehensive operation control center; the intelligent emergency marker lamp is used for detecting personnel in a traffic channel and an evacuation channel and detecting the parking position of a vehicle accident, transmitting detected personnel movement data to the control host for analysis, and transmitting personnel distress information and flow density information obtained after analysis to the comprehensive operation control center to present a digital twin virtual reality scene so as to provide information support for rescue decisions; the intelligent emergency lighting lamp is used for detecting disasters in the traffic channel and the evacuation channel, transmitting detected disaster data to the control host for analysis, and transmitting disaster information obtained after analysis to the comprehensive operation control center to present a digital twin virtual reality scene so as to provide information support for rescue decisions. By implementing the invention, the intelligent degree is high, timely and comprehensive information support can be provided for emergency rescue workers, the emergency response speed is improved, and a reasonable rescue scheme is formulated.
assignees: XIJIAO HENGSHENG CHENGDU EMERGENCY TECH RESEARCH CO LTD

title_en: Urban multi-mode traffic network post-disaster restoration strategy efficiency evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating the efficiency of a post-disaster restoration strategy of an urban multi-mode traffic network, which belong to the technical field of urban traffic operation management and construct a multi-mode traffic network structure model by utilizing road network and public transport network open source data; simulating urban traffic distribution by using traffic travel demand data, and constructing a multi-mode traffic network function model; based on the multimode traffic network function model, constructing a multimode traffic network structure recovery model according to disaster space distribution characteristics and post-disaster network recovery strategies, and evaluating structure recovery efficiency; based on the multi-mode traffic network structure recovery model, the travel demands are reloaded, the multi-mode traffic network function recovery model is constructed, and the function recovery efficiency is evaluated. The invention can comprehensively consider multiple traffic modes and complex dynamic games among travelers, provides more accurate and comprehensive repair strategy evaluation, can enhance the toughness of the urban comprehensive traffic system, and can better cope with various disasters and emergency situations.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG

title_en: Three-quantity directional blasting pressure relief method under rapid tunneling of mine coal seam
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-quantity directional blasting pressure relief method under rapid tunneling of a mine coal seam, which comprises the steps of tunneling engineering, coal body blasting drilling construction, monitoring and quality control, shock absorption and restoration, and relates to the technical field of rock burst control. According to the three-quantity directional blasting pressure relief method under the rapid tunneling of the mine coal seam, the originally designed two large-diameter pressure relief drilling holes (construction interval 2 m) are changed into two-wall coal body blasting drilling holes (construction interval 15 m), the two large-diameter pressure relief drilling holes at the head are changed into one coal body blasting drilling hole, the tunneling efficiency of the high-stress coal seam underground tunneling and anchoring integrated machine is effectively improved through monitoring, quality control, shock absorption and restoration, the corresponding impact prevention and disaster control engineering quantity is reduced, the construction investment of corresponding rock burst disaster control is saved, and the popularization and application of the tunneling and anchoring integrated machine in the deep mine high-stress coal seam are promoted, so that the method has a good application prospect.
assignees: SHAANXI ZHENGTONG COAL IND CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for efficiently recovering from disaster damage to water treatment facility through simulation
title_ko: 시뮬레이션을 통한 수처리 시설에 대한 재난 피해를 효율적으로 복구하는 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: A method for efficiently recovering from disaster damage to a water treatment facility, according to one embodiment of the present invention, may efficiently recover from disaster damage to a water treatment facility when an actual disaster occurs, such as an earthquake, a flood, and a typhoon, by determining, through simulation, a recovery order for water treatment process facilities included in the water treatment facility.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 수처리 시설에 대한 재난 피해를 효율적으로 복구하는 방법은 시뮬레이션을 통해 수처리 시설에 포함된 수처리 공정 시설 각각에 대해 복구 순서를 결정하여, 지진, 홍수, 태풍과 같이 실제로 재난이 발생했을 경우, 수처리 시설에 대해 재난 피해를 효율적으로 복구하는 방법일 수 있다.
assignees: G&C ENV SOLUTION CO LTD

title_en: Power grid risk assessment method and device based on dynamic evolution of sudden natural disaster chain
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid risk assessment, in particular to a power grid risk assessment method and device based on dynamic evolution of sudden natural disaster chains. The method comprises the following steps: calculating according to regional weather information, geographical geological information, power grid equipment information and power grid electrical information to obtain the fault probability of the power transmission line; based on a risk element theory, according to the fault probability of the power transmission line, carrying out disaster chain construction through qualitative analysis of power grid disaster causes under sudden natural disasters to obtain a power transmission line disaster chain and a disaster chain Bow-tie model; calculating according to a preset expert questionnaire of the power transmission line fault to obtain the prior probability of the power transmission line fault; and according to the prior probability of the power transmission line fault and the disaster chain Bow-tie model, performing posterior probability calculation through Bayesian simulation software Netica to obtain a power grid risk assessment result. The power grid risk assessment method is strong in timeliness and high in accuracy according to dynamic evolution of natural disaster chains by combining a Bayesian network.
assignees: STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV BEIJING SCIENCE & TECH;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;XUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH CO STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: River basin flood forecasting method integrating multisource rainfall data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flood forecasting and computer combination, and discloses a river basin flood forecasting method integrating multisource rainfall data, which comprises the following steps: acquiring historical multi-source rainfall data, historical geographic data and historical disaster data of a river basin area, and preprocessing to construct a training data set; constructing a flood forecast model, training the flood forecast model by adopting a training data set, and generating a trained flood forecast model; acquiring real-time multisource rainfall data and real-time geographic data of a river basin, preprocessing the multisource rainfall data and the real-time geographic data, inputting a flood forecast model, and outputting a flood peak value at a set time point; according to the method, the historical multi-source rainfall data, the historical geographic data and the historical disaster data of the river basin area can be analyzed and learned through the flood forecast model, the influence parameters of the secondary disasters on the hydraulic characteristics of the river network system and the influence parameters of the interference flood propagation process are obtained, and the accuracy rate of flood forecast can be effectively improved.
assignees: SHUIFA DIGITAL TECH CO LTD;SHANDONG HAIHE HUAIHE XIAOQING BASIN WATER RESOURCES MAN SERVICE CENTER

title_en: Knowledge graph-based natural disaster risk assessment method for photovoltaic project
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic project natural disaster risk assessment method based on a knowledge graph, and relates to the field of key infrastructure risk assessment; firstly, utilizing big data depth of a disaster text to mine microscopic causal structures of risk components hidden in a large sample of historical disaster events, and drawing a generalized natural disaster risk knowledge graph of a photovoltaic project; based on the knowledge graph and the complex network view angle, describing the dynamic process of the composite risk system through machine simulation, and identifying key nodes and main paths of risk conduction; finally, constructing a photovoltaic project natural disaster risk assessment model based on the Bayesian network based on the key nodes and the main paths of risk conduction; the method can overcome the limitations of the current comprehensive index method and the mechanism model method in the aspects of strong subjectivity of risk assessment, difficult model verification and the like, and provides an innovative approach for objective and accurate assessment of natural disaster risk in photovoltaic projects.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CORPORATION SICHUAN ENERGY INVEST CO LTD;CHINA THREE GORGES CORP

title_en: Flood disaster emergency simulation method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flood disaster management, in particular to a digital twinning-based flood disaster emergency simulation method and system, comprising the following steps of S1, data acquisition and preprocessing, namely acquiring environmental data related to a flood disaster in real time; the method comprises the steps of S2, establishing a digital twin model of a flood disaster area, S3, simulating calculation, S4, optimizing a flood propagation path, identifying a mode and abnormality, S5, establishing an emergency plan by combining history flood disaster coping experience, S6, evaluating and improving, after flood disaster emergency response is finished, evaluating the execution effect of the emergency plan, summarizing experience teaching training, and optimizing the digital twin model and the emergency plan. The invention realizes accurate prediction and high-effect response to flood disasters.

title_en: Modeling method, device and equipment for digital twin tailing pond
abstract_en: The application discloses a modeling method, a device and equipment for a digital twin tailing pond, relates to the technical field of intelligent management and control of tailing ponds, and aims to realize the fine analysis of dam stability by carrying out fine flood simulation on the change process of Hong Shuiku water levels through a digital twin model of the tailing pond so as to ensure the safe operation of the tailing pond. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a digital twin model of the tailing pond, wherein the digital twin model of the tailing pond comprises a flood prediction early warning sub-model, a tailing dam stability simulation sub-model and a dam break simulation sub-model, carrying out different-time stability analysis on the tailing dam by using the tailing dam stability simulation sub-model according to the state parameters of the tailing pond in different time states, carrying out flood prediction by using the flood prediction early warning sub-model according to the predicted rainfall of weather prediction, and judging whether the predicted flood reaches the overtopping dam break condition, and if so, predicting the flood disaster influence condition of the downstream of the tailing pond by using the dam break simulation sub-model.
assignees: CHINA ENFI ENG CORP;CHINA NONFERROUS ENG CO LTD

title_en: Simulation calculation model construction, simulation evaluation method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a simulation calculation model construction and simulation evaluation method, a system, equipment and a medium, comprising the following steps: based on the obtained structure association information of each power grid facility in the region, constructing a digital twin model for connecting each power grid facility in series; establishing association between the disaster damage limit value of each power grid facility in the obtained region and the corresponding power grid facility in the digital twin model to obtain a disaster informatization model of the power grid facility in the region; performing grid subdivision on the disaster informatization model by using a finite element analysis method to form different grid units, so as to obtain a simulation calculation model of the power grid facilities in the region; according to the invention, the risk level of the power grid facility disaster is subjected to simulation evaluation by using the pre-established simulation calculation model, and the regional power grid facilities are taken as an integral evaluation unit, so that the relevance among various facilities in the regional power grid is improved, and the accuracy of the simulation evaluation result of the power grid facility disaster in the region can be improved.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD JIAXING POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Intelligent interactive monitoring and early warning system for geological disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning, and discloses an intelligent interactive monitoring and early warning system for geological disasters, which comprises the following components: the multi-source data fusion and enhancement module is used for fusing data of various data sources; the edge computing module is connected with the multi-source data fusion and enhancement module and is used for carrying out preliminary data processing and analysis at the front end of data acquisition; the digital twin geological model module is connected with the edge calculation module and is used for creating a digital twin geological model of the monitoring area and simulating and predicting the evolution process of geological disasters; and the blockchain data trusted management module is connected with the edge calculation module and is used for ensuring the authenticity and the non-tamper property of the geological disaster monitoring data. Through fusing a plurality of data sources such as satellite remote sensing, unmanned aerial vehicle aerial photography, ground sensors, social media and the like, the data are enhanced and processed by adopting a machine learning algorithm, and the comprehensiveness and accuracy of the data are obviously improved.
assignees: SICHUAN TIANFU NEW AREA INNOVATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE SOUTHWEST UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Digital twin prevention method and system for geological disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to a digital twin prevention method and a digital twin prevention system for geological disasters, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing an information sensing network; establishing a basic database; constructing an accumulated displacement prediction model; predicting the change trend and the maximum accumulated displacement of the geological disaster point; decomposing and accumulating displacement; obtaining an accumulated displacement prediction result; constructing a multi-factor early warning model; calculating and pushing the early warning grade in real time; judging the safety state of the geological disaster point, and simulating the stable state and deformation evolution trend of the geological disaster point under different working conditions; pushing a geological disaster safety prevention and control plan. The system comprises a monitoring sensing, predicting, early warning, previewing and planning module. The invention is based on digital twin technology, realizes on-line monitoring of ground disasters, predicts the development change of ground disasters in advance, early warns and pushes early warning information in time, previews simulated ground disaster deformation damage trend in real time and automatically pushes ground disaster plan response measures, can effectively improve the intelligent level of geological disaster prevention, and meets the requirements of intelligent prevention and management of geological disasters.
assignees: CHANGJIANG GEOTECHNICAL ENG CO LTD;SOUTH TO NORTH WATER DIVERSION MIDDLE ROUTE WATER SOURCE CO LTD

title_en: Mobile energy storage configuration method for improving power distribution network capacity under ice disaster influence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile energy storage configuration method for improving the capacity of a power distribution network under the influence of ice disaster, which comprises the following steps: according to the obtained line fault probability, considering the space-time transfer characteristic of the ice disaster, generating a fault state of each period of each line by using a time sequence Monte Carlo simulation method, and completing 1-time complete sampling of a fault scene of the distribution network under the ice disaster; repeating the sampling process until a plurality of scene sets are generated, and reducing the number of scenes by adopting a K-means clustering method to obtain S typical fault scenes; taking the minimum expected loss cost of the load of each node in S typical fault scenes in the ice disaster attack process as a target, and establishing a power distribution network mobile energy storage pre-disaster pre-layout random optimization model considering the dynamic evolution of the fault scenes in consideration of the readjustment process of the pre-disaster layout position of the mobile energy storage in each fault scene in the ice disaster dynamic evolution process; and converting nonlinear constraint in the model into linear constraint based on a Big-M method, generating a mixed integer linear programming model, solving, and outputting a dynamic scheduling scheme of the optimal pre-disaster distribution position of the mobile energy storage and each fault scene in the disaster period.
assignees: UNIV NORTHEAST ELECTRIC POWER;STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO;STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: CAVE rescue scene construction method and system adopting digital twin and holographic technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster relief, and discloses a CAVE relief scene construction method of digital twin and holographic technology, which comprises the following steps: digital twin technology, 3D real-time rendering technology, holographic technology, cave virtual reality technology, real-time collaboration module, S1, digital twin technology: this is a technique that builds a digital simulation in an informationized platform by integrating physical feedback data, aided by artificial intelligence, machine learning, and software analysis, which simulation is updated as physical entities change according to feedback to ensure that the virtual model matches the real world counterpart. According to the CAVE rescue scene construction method and system based on the digital twin and holographic technology, through integrating the digital twin, real-time rendering and holographic Cave technology, not only are the disaster rescue efficiency and safety improved, but also the immersion sense and interactivity are enhanced, so that the disaster rescue training and exercise are more scientific, efficient and real.
assignees: NANFANG HOSPITAL

title_en: Intelligent assessment method and system for landslide risk of tunnel peripheral area
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geologic material analysis, in particular to an intelligent assessment method and system for landslide risk in a tunnel peripheral region. According to the method, an initial data set with high information density is constructed through geologic elastic wave data analysis, the quality and efficiency of data screening are improved, the fine observation of stress distribution and earth surface displacement in the data selection process is optimized, the capturing capacity of dynamic change of geologic conditions is enhanced, cracks and cavities in geologic media are accurately analyzed through simulating elastic wave propagation, finer geologic heterogeneity insight is provided, landslide triggering factors are calibrated more accurately by the method, high risk areas can be effectively identified and evaluated, the risk management and early warning accuracy of tunnels and key infrastructure are greatly improved, and potential geologic disaster influence is reduced.

title_en: Disaster assessment device, disaster assessment method, and program
abstract_en: To provide a disaster assessment device or the like capable of comprehensively assessing a damage state caused by occurrence of a disaster and a restoration state.SOLUTION: A disaster assessment device 100 includes: a plurality of simulation units 140 to 14-N which executes simulation for damage states of a plurality of events due to occurrence of a disaster; a data conversion unit 150 which converts data representing the damage states being results of each of the simulation results of the plurality of simulation units 140 to 14-N to data representing common social value; and a social value assessment unit 160 which assesses a change of the social value caused by the disaster on the basis of the plurality of pieces of data obtained by the conversion by the data conversion unit 150. Further, the disaster assessment device 100 includes a transmitting and receiving unit 120 which, after occurrence of the disaster, receives disaster occurrence information indicating a scale and occurrence position of the disaster, and damage actual state data representing an actual state value of the damage caused by the disaster and actual circumstances of which have become clear.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3
assignees: NEC CORP;UNIV TOHOKU;NEC SOLUTION INNOVATORS LTD

title_en: Typhoon house damage risk prediction method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a typhoon house damage risk prediction method, device, equipment and medium, which comprise the following steps: acquiring a typhoon event data set corresponding to a target area; identifying feature data of typhoon events occurring in a plurality of administrative areas based on the typhoon event data set, so as to construct a target sample data set according to the feature data; training the machine learning model by using the target sample data set to obtain a house damage risk prediction model, wherein the house damage risk prediction model is used for carrying out dynamic risk prediction on house damage conditions when typhoon events occur in a target area. The invention can realize the real-time updating and forecasting of the dynamic risk in the real-time disaster field evolution process.
assignees: NAT CLIMATE CENTRE;BEIJING HONGXIANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital safety emergency drilling and commanding platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of project management, in particular to a digital security emergency exercise and command platform, which comprises a risk assessment module, an event propagation prediction module, a resource demand and scheduling module, a response time management module, a cost benefit analysis module, a network flow abnormality detection module and a security hole priority ordering module, wherein the invention utilizes the network flow abnormality detection module to introduce a real-time monitoring and response technology, the method has the advantages that the real-time monitoring and quick response to the network security event are realized, the response time of the security event is shortened, the risk and influence of the security event on the organization are reduced, in addition, the response time management module is utilized by means of an automatic emergency response technology, the automatic identification and processing to the common security event can be realized according to the set rules and procedures, the efficiency and the accuracy of the emergency response are improved, and the human error and delay are reduced.
assignees: HEJIE TECH LIAONING GROUP CO LTD
