title_en: Method, medium and system for constructing digital twin system of offshore embankment disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, medium and system for constructing a digital twin system of an offshore diffuse dike disaster, which belong to the technical field of image data processing or generation. And then, carrying out sea wave and hydrodynamic force simulation by using a real-time three-dimensional creation tool, and simultaneously carrying out real-time observation on a target area and inputting data into a system. And then constructing a sea wave model and a storm surge model based on the high-resolution numerical model or the artificial intelligence model, and forecasting sea waves and storm surge for at least 72 hours by using the models, and simulating disaster situations of histories and different reproduction periods and different disaster reduction measures. And finally, constructing a disaster prevention and reduction scene library based on the simulation result, and solving the problem that the three-dimensional dynamic characteristics of the sea area and the effects of various disaster reduction measures cannot be fully reflected in the prior art.
assignees: NORTH CHINA SEA MARINE FORECASTING CENTER OF STATE OCEANIC ADMINISTRATION QINGDAO MARINE FORECAST ST

title_en: Ocean digital twin platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ocean data application, in particular to an ocean digital twin platform which comprises a basic environment layer, a data layer, a platform layer and an application layer, wherein the data layer performs data interaction with an ocean data base, performs data processing on ocean data base data, acquires digital twin simulation ocean information by using an artificial intelligent model and processed ocean data base data, and displays the digital twin simulation ocean information by using the application layer. The invention realizes unified management and efficient processing of ocean data through integration with the ocean data base, breaks the island of the data and improves the utilization efficiency and accuracy of the data. The artificial intelligent model is utilized to carry out deep analysis and excavation on the processed ocean data, so that more accurate and comprehensive digital twin simulation ocean information can be obtained, and important decision support is provided for aspects such as ocean resource management, environment monitoring and disaster early warning.
assignees: SOUTHERN MARINE SCIENCE AND ENG GUANGDONG LABORATORY ZHUHAI

title_en: Fire disaster early warning device and fire extinguishing system for electrical power distribution cabinet
abstract_en: A fire early warning device and fire extinguishing system for electrical power distribution cabinet belongs to the alarm technical field. The fire disaster early warning device comprises a fire disaster recognition model which is trained through a Bayesian network, wherein the training process comprises the following steps of deducing the distribution of hidden variables Z through the parameters of the current time of the Bayesian network and the data vector of an ith training set, calculating the expectation of log likelihood about Z, acquiring the parameters of the Bayesian network at the next time t+1 according to the expectation, calculating the error of the data vector of the ith training set for training the Bayesian network, further updating the parameters of the Bayesian network according to the error, repeatedly executing the steps for training the Bayesian network, and verifying on a verification set until the stopping condition is reached, and completing the training of the Bayesian network to obtain the fire disaster recognition model. According to the invention, the Bayesian network is trained into the fire disaster recognition model through the observable variable and the hidden variable, so that the fire disaster recognition capability is improved.

title_en: Riverway flood control disaster reduction risk point AI identification method and device based on digital twin computable engine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a river flood control disaster reduction risk point AI identification method and device based on a digital twin computable engine. The method comprises the steps of obtaining three-dimensional scene basic data and hydraulic engineering parameters in a flow field, obtaining real-time rain condition, water condition, soil moisture content, reservoir condition and embankment monitoring data to obtain real-time data, building physical entities and twin simulation scenes according to the three-dimensional scene basic data and the hydraulic engineering parameters, performing AI simulation calculation of the water condition according to the real-time data to obtain simulation results, performing twin computable simulation according to the physical entities, the twin simulation scenes and the simulation results to obtain simulation results, and identifying risk points of a river channel in the flow field according to the simulation results. The method can solve the problems that the digital twin technology mainly lacks intelligent risk identification and multi-factor integration in river flood control and disaster reduction and influences prediction accuracy.
assignees: ANCHUANG QIYUAN HANGZHOU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Landslide risk evaluation method and system based on substation failure model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster risk research, in particular to a landslide risk evaluation method and system based on a transformer substation failure model. The method comprises the steps of carrying out detailed investigation on landslide of a transformer substation to obtain physical and mechanical properties of a rock-soil body, calculating seepage characteristics of the rock-soil body by using a rainfall infiltration hydrologic model, simulating landslide stability under different rainfall working conditions by using FLAC3D software, calculating annual instability probability by combining a Monte Carlo method, and calculating economic losses of the transformer substation under the working conditions by using a deformation damage model of various facilities in the transformer substation in the FLAC3D simulation landslide instability process to carry out fixed values on vulnerability of various facilities. The invention also comprises a corresponding system implementation. The method realizes comprehensive, quantitative and accurate assessment of landslide risk of the transformer substation by integrating geological investigation, hydrologic model, numerical simulation and statistical methods, provides scientific basis for security management of the power grid in the mountain area, and can be popularized and applied to risk assessment of other similar geological disasters.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Landslide hazard risk evaluation method and system based on transmission tower failure model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster risk evaluation research, in particular to a landslide disaster risk evaluation method and system based on a transmission tower failure model. The method comprises the steps of carrying out detailed investigation on a landslide area to obtain a deformation relation between a transmission tower and the ground surface, obtaining a deformation failure model and a mechanism of the transmission tower by utilizing FLAC3D and ANSYS numerical simulation software, calculating the annual instability probability of the landslide by adopting a FLAC3D-Monte Carlo method, establishing a vulnerability evaluation model of the transmission tower under the action of the landslide, and completing the landslide risk evaluation of the transmission tower based on a model of risk=risk×vulnerability×economic value. The invention also provides a corresponding risk evaluation system. According to the method, the transmission tower failure model is built, landslide deformation is associated with the tower failure, quantitative and fine assessment of the risk of the transmission tower in the landslide area is achieved, and a new technical means is provided for geological disaster risk management and control of power grid facilities in the mountain area.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Collapse geological disaster risk evaluation method and system for transformer substation structure damage model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster risk evaluation research, in particular to a collapse geological disaster risk evaluation method and system of a transformer substation structure damage model. The method comprises the steps of carrying out detailed investigation on a collapse dangerous rock body, evaluating stability by adopting a red flat projection graph method, calculating instability probability by adopting a Monte Carlo method, simulating a collapse dynamics process by utilizing FLAC3D and PFC3D coupling, completing dangerous evaluation by combining ArcGIS, establishing a substation electrical facility physical model and a structural damage model, establishing a vulnerability evaluation model based on collapse rock impact strength and electrical facility structural resistance, carrying out risk evaluation by adopting a matrix analysis method, and estimating economic loss. The invention also comprises a corresponding system implementation. According to the method, through combination of geological investigation, numerical simulation and structural analysis, comprehensive quantitative evaluation of the collapse disaster risk of the transformer substation is realized, the accuracy, reliability and pertinence of evaluation are improved, and scientific basis is provided for disaster prevention and reduction of the transformer substation in the mountain area.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Flood risk management method, system, computer and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a flood risk management method, a flood risk management system, a flood risk management computer and a flood risk management storage medium, wherein the flood risk management method comprises the following steps of carrying out numerical modeling based on surface characteristics by adopting a digital twin technology, and establishing a hydrodynamic model based on a shallow water equation; and optimizing the hydraulic building operation scheme based on the flood risk data, calling a hydrodynamic model, simulating the water network water flow evolution process of the hydraulic building optimized operation scheme, and monitoring and managing the water network. By combining the hydrodynamic model with flood risk assessment, the intelligent optimization algorithm can be automatically invoked to schedule hydraulic structures such as gates and dams while the flood risk is found, the flood risk is dealt with in real time, the influence of potential disasters is reduced, compared with traditional manual scheduling, delay or misjudgment caused by manual intervention can be reduced, and the efficiency and the accuracy of flood control scheduling are improved.
assignees: JIANGXI PROVINCIAL WATER CONSERVANCY INVESTMENT JIANGHE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;JIANGXI LAOHE ENG ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Digital twin emergency drilling implementation system based on intelligent oil field station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin emergency drilling implementation system based on an intelligent oilfield station, which comprises a safety evaluation module, an emergency drilling module and a personnel evacuation sensing and avoiding module. The system not only can accurately identify the dangerous factors in the oil field station, but also can simulate a real emergency scene when a fire disaster occurs, dynamically adjust the drilling process, plan the personnel evacuation path in real time according to the change of the fire disaster, and finally ensure the personnel safety and the high-efficiency management of equipment of the oil field station under the emergency condition.
assignees: SHENZHEN JIA YUN TONG ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Landslide event determining method and related device
abstract_en: The application provides a landslide event determining method and a related device, which are used for determining daily rainfall disaster causing probability in each region through a rainfall disaster causing probability model based on rainfall simulation data in a target time period, determining first landslide probability corresponding to each slope unit in each day based on the rainfall disaster causing probability and slope instability probability corresponding to each slope unit, randomly extracting in a [0,1] interval through a Monte Carlo method to obtain second landslide probability corresponding to each slope unit in each day, and determining that a landslide event occurs to each slope unit when the second landslide probability is smaller than or equal to the first landslide probability. According to the method, the possibility that each slope unit has a landslide in actual conditions can be considered through random extraction of the Monte Carlo method, so that whether the landslide occurs is determined without completely depending on the probability of the first landslide, and further whether a result of a landslide event occurs in a certain slope unit is determined to be more in line with the actual conditions, and the result is more accurate.
assignees: CHINA REINSURANCE GROUP CORP;CHINA REINSURANCE GROUP CATASTRIAL RISK MAN CO LTD

title_en: Logistics guarantee management system and method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a logistic guarantee management system and method based on digital twinning, relates to the technical field of logistic guarantee management, and solves the technical problems that the prior art cannot simulate and forecast flood conditions in advance, and therefore enough time is not available for planning rescue measures, and the rescue efficiency is low; the method comprises the steps of establishing a digital twin model of a target area, simulating weather conditions of the target area according to meteorological data, dividing the target area into a plurality of subareas with the same intensity of personnel, acquiring environment information of the subareas, evaluating flood disaster grades of the subareas, collecting and updating personnel information of the target area in real time by a rescue center, evaluating rescue emergency grades of the subareas based on the flood disaster grades and the personnel information, planning an optimal rescue path according to the rescue emergency grades and the topography of the subareas, effectively predicting influence of the flood disasters, realizing efficient rescue, and reducing loss caused by natural disasters.
assignees: CHONGQING CHANGKUO TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency electric power supply train dispatching system and method for recovering urban power supply
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency power supply trolley dispatching system and method for recovering urban power supply in the technical field of power systems, comprising the following steps of obtaining global state information in the current state; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a scheduling path and a power supply strategy of an individual power supply vehicle through a power supply vehicle scheduling neural network model which is built in advance and comprises a DQN network and a shared attention module based on global state information in a current state, evaluating a reward value of the power supply vehicle after scheduling and supplying power to the power supply vehicle based on the scheduling path and the power supply strategy, obtaining a scheduling path and the power supply strategy with highest combined total value after training and updating the power supply vehicle scheduling neural network model based on the reward value, and scheduling and supplying power to all the power supply vehicles based on the scheduling path and the power supply strategy with the highest combined total value. According to the invention, the dispatching paths and strategies of a plurality of power supply vehicles are optimized through the DQN network and the power supply vehicle dispatching neural network model of the shared attention module, so that the recovery speed and efficiency of urban lifelines after disasters are effectively improved.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power distribution network operation safety risk assessment method considering typhoon and storm composite disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network operation safety risk assessment method considering typhoon and storm composite disasters, which comprises the following steps of generating different typhoon paths as main scenes based on typhoon and storm disaster forecast data, giving weights to the main scenes according to occurrence probability, calculating corrected wind speeds according to the influence of micro-topography and rainfall intensity on wind speeds V (r) in the main scenes, calculating total failure probability of a power distribution line between nodes i and j according to failure probability of the power distribution line between the nodes i and j and failure probability caused by a foreign matter hanging wire, calculating failure probability of power distribution equipment according to water accumulation amount in a power distribution network area, simulating and generating N fault scenes S to form a fault scene set S by using a Monte Carlo method, giving weights to the fault scenes, constructing a risk assessment model by taking the minimum expected total loss load amount under all the fault scenes as an objective function, and solving the risk assessment model by combining constraint conditions.

title_en: Urban lifeline waterlogging risk assessment rapid simulation method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rapid simulation method, a rapid simulation system and a storage medium for urban lifeline waterlogging risk assessment, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining key data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-layer overlapped grid model comprising a ground surface layer, a subsurface pipe network layer and a life line facility layer based on key data, pre-calculating accumulated water depth distribution data under different rainfall intensities by using a numerical simulation method based on the multi-layer overlapped grid model, interpolating by using the pre-calculation method to obtain accumulated water depth values under the live rainfall intensities, overlapping the accumulated water depth values with the life line facility, calculating the flooding risk degree of the life line facility, and visually displaying the accumulated water depth distribution data and the flooding risk degree. According to the invention, the pre-calculation and the real-time interpolation of the ponding depth distribution under different rainfall conditions are realized, the accurate ponding depth distribution can be quickly obtained without complex real-time calculation under the live rainfall conditions, the simulation time is greatly shortened, and the high-efficiency technical support is provided for urban waterlogging emergency response.
assignees: NANJING HYDRAULIC RES INST;JIANGSU QINHUAI RIVER WATER CONSEVANCY ENG DIVISION;JIANGSU SURVEYING AND DESIGN INST OF WATER RESOURCES CO LTD

title_en: Disaster risk early warning method and system based on big data model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster early warning and risk management, and discloses a disaster risk early warning method based on a big data model, which comprises the following steps of S1, data acquisition, namely acquiring environmental data and social data through a sensor and Internet of things equipment; S2, calculating risks, namely calculating an environmental risk index according to the environmental data and calculating a social activity risk index according to the social data, and a disaster risk early warning system based on a big data model, wherein the disaster risk early warning system comprises a data acquisition module and a data acquisition module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for collecting the environmental data and the social data through a sensor and Internet of things equipment. By constructing a social-environment interaction risk model, introducing a risk chain conduction mechanism and intervention measures, dynamically evaluating a disaster risk propagation process, simulating various disaster scenes and calculating emergency response time, and optimizing emergency resource deployment, disaster expansion is effectively predicted, loss is reduced, and accuracy and efficiency of emergency response are improved.
assignees: TUZHIZHI BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for relieving natural disaster risk of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a natural disaster risk relieving method and device for an electric power system, which comprises an hour-level composite cascade event set generating module, a risk relieving module, a distributed resource evaluating module, a natural disaster influence module and a power grid control module, wherein the hour-level composite cascade event set generating module is used for generating an hour-level data set under various natural disaster scenes, capturing cascade effects of different disasters, providing data support for risk influence quantification of the electric power system and strategy generation of the risk relieving module, the distributed resource evaluating module is used for evaluating availability and power generation potential of distributed resources in a three-level area, analyzing the power generation potential of the distributed resources during various natural disasters by combining weather and disaster factors, the natural disaster influence module is constructed, the influence of the various natural disasters on the electric power system is simulated based on the hour-level composite cascade event set, the damage degree of the disasters on loads, power generation facilities, power transmission and distribution lines and the like is analyzed, the risk relieving module is constructed, a disaster emergency scheme is formulated for an area with the risk influence on the basis of a three-level collaborative mechanism, the power generation potential of the distributed resource evaluating module is used, and the power grid is quickly restored and stably operated by scheduling various distributed resources, repairing the power grid and load adjusting.

title_en: Long-term intelligent prediction method for wind-induced response of super high-rise building structure during typhoon passing
abstract_en: A long-term intelligent prediction method for wind induced response of a super high-rise building structure during typhoon passing is characterized by comprising the following steps of calculating structural wind induced vibration response corresponding to a target super high-rise building, training a cascading forward BP neural network model by adopting a Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm, predicting incoming flow wind field information of the target super high-rise building by utilizing an AI-driven transform weather prediction model and a linear typhoon model, inputting the incoming flow wind field prediction information and corresponding structural modal parameters into the trained cascading forward BP neural network model, and rapidly predicting structural wind induced vibration responses of the super high-rise building at different positions under different future time conditions. The method can rapidly, flexibly and reliably realize long-term prediction of wind vibration response of the super high-rise building structure during typhoon passing, and provide references for prediction and early warning of the structural vibration state of the super high-rise building during typhoon, thereby improving the urban related emergency response capability and realizing transition from passive emergency to decision forward.

title_en: Multi-scale direction sensing SAR target detection method based on global information fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-scale direction sensing SAR target detection method based on global information fusion, which mainly solves the problems of low detection precision and efficiency caused by insufficient global information and insufficient direction sensing characteristic extraction in the existing SAR target detection method. The implementation scheme includes the steps of obtaining a training sample set and a testing sample set of SAR images, constructing a multi-scale direction sensing SAR target detection network comprising two feature extractors and detection heads, training a target detection network model through back propagation iteration by using the training sample set, and inputting the testing sample set into the trained network model to obtain a target detection result. The first feature extractor designed by the invention utilizes a bidirectional attention mechanism to extract the direction and position information of an object, so that the object has stronger robustness under different target postures and angles, and the second feature extractor designed by the invention realizes the organic fusion of global and local features, ensures the improvement of target detection efficiency and can be applied to environment monitoring and disaster assessment.
assignees: UNIV XIDIAN

title_en: Disaster connectivity analysis system, server, and method
title_ko: 재난 연계성 분석 시스템, 서버, 및 방법
abstract_en: The disaster linkage analysis system and method analyze the specific process of the accident damage generation and simultaneous or serial disaster for the preemptive disaster management about the composite trouble by using the artificial intelligence technology. In addition, in order to increase the understanding of the analysis result through the embodiment, information is provided in the form of a scenario and a map by dividing the correlation analysis result of the disaster by disaster and accident type. In addition, through the embodiment, the networking of disasters is the most important factor in the analysis of composite disasters, and the connection between disasters is analyzed based on the relationship between disasters, accident types, and vulnerable factors.
abstract_ko: 재난 연계성 분석 시스템 및 방법은 인공지능 기술을 이용하여 복합재난에 대한 선제적 재난관리를 위해 동시다발적 또는 연쇄적 재난과 사고 피해 발생의 구체적 과정을 분석한다. 또한, 실시예를 통해 분석결과에 대한 이해도를 높이기 위해, 재난의 연계성 분석 결과를 재난, 사고 유형별로 구분하여 시나리오 및 지도 형태로 정보를 제공한다. 또한, 실시예를 통해 재난의 네트워크화를 복합재난 분석의 가장 중점적 요소로 두고, 재난, 사고 유형과 취약요소의 관계성을 근간으로 재난 간의 연계성을 분석한다.
assignees: NAT DISASTER MANAGEMENT RES INST

title_en: Collapse geological disaster vulnerability model and risk assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a collapse geological disaster vulnerability model and a risk assessment method and system, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster risk assessment, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting target rock mass information and preprocessing; the method comprises the steps of collecting monitoring data and long-term rainfall data of a triaxial acceleration sensor, analyzing acceleration fluctuation characteristics, combining the rainfall data to identify the risk of rock mass instability, quantifying the risk of rock mass instability based on a Monte Carlo method, predicting the movement path and the accumulation range of collapse rocks by utilizing numerical simulation, evaluating the threat of the collapse rocks to peripheral electric facilities, and carrying out hierarchical management on the peripheral area of a transformer substation through a risk level model. The invention adopts the technologies of real-time monitoring, probability calculation and numerical simulation, and solves the problems of lack of dynamic monitoring, accurate evaluation and hierarchical protection of electric power facilities in the prior art. The whole scheme realizes real-time and automatic monitoring and risk grading of collapse geological disasters, and effectively improves the safety and reliability of electric power facilities under disaster conditions.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based water conservancy and scenic spot disaster early warning and flood prevention platform and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water conservancy based on digital twin a disaster early warning flood prevention platform and a disaster early warning flood prevention method for a scenic spot, relates to the technical field of disaster early warning and flood prevention, and adopts the main scheme that: the method comprises the steps of collecting various data of a water conservancy and scenic spot by using a sensor, then respectively calculating water level, water flow speed, rainfall, geology and facility availability indexes, constructing a digital twin model based on three-dimensional modeling software by the indexes, simulating and calculating comprehensive environment data indexes, inputting the data indexes for a period of time in the future to simulate future conditions, finally setting a disaster early warning threshold value, comparing the future comprehensive environment data indexes with the disaster early warning threshold value, judging whether early warning is triggered, and generating and distributing early warning information if the early warning is triggered.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA UNIV OF FINANCE AND ECONOMICS

title_en: Firefighter sign monitoring and early warning method based on multivariate state estimation technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a firefighter physical sign monitoring and early warning method based on a multivariate state estimation technology, which relates to the technical field of firefighter physical abnormality monitoring and early warning and is realized by a vital sign acquisition device and a digital individual soldier, and comprises the following steps that S1, heart rate, respiration, body temperature, perspiration and blood oxygen data of a firefighter in a usual state are acquired by the vital sign acquisition device, wherein the usual state comprises a daily activity state, a training state and a state after continuous training for 1 hour; according to the invention, the physical state difference among firefighter individuals is comprehensively considered, the vital sign states of firefighter individuals can be more accurately estimated, early warning can be sent out in advance when potential dangerous states occur to firefighter bodies, a digital individual soldier carries out calculation and analysis on data, the influence caused by rescue site network abnormality is avoided, meanwhile, alarming information of firefighter body abnormal states can be sent out at the first time, and the alarming information can be sent to digital individual soldier terminals and site command parts on other teammates.
assignees: SHENYANG FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Digital twin model and method of coal mine disaster scene based on multi-modal data
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twin model of a coal mine disaster scene based on multi-mode data and a method thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting original data in a mine; the method comprises the steps of cleaning, normalizing and denoising original data, fusing different types of preprocessed original data by using a data fusion algorithm to construct a comprehensive digital twin model, establishing a virtual mirror image of a mine by using a digital twin technology, mapping the mine in the real world into the digital twin model, carrying out real-time mapping and simulation analysis based on the established digital twin model, predicting disaster development trend by monitoring the internal environment and equipment state of the mine, optimizing prevention and control measures of the coal mine disaster according to the analysis result of the model, establishing a real-time monitoring and early warning system of the disaster, finding abnormal conditions, and timely taking measures. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a model construction module and a model analysis module. The invention can improve the pertinence and the effectiveness of the disaster prevention and control of the coal mine.
assignees: SHAANXI HUADIAN YUHENG COAL AND ELECTRICITY CO LTD;HUADIAN COAL INDUSTRY GROUP SHUZHI TECH CO LTD;CHINA ACADEMY SAFETY SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Emergency material reserve dynamic optimization method and system based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency management, in particular to an emergency material reserve dynamic optimization method and system based on reinforcement learning, wherein emergency material demand prediction results are obtained through a machine learning algorithm according to disaster scene data and emergency material consumption data of a target electric power facility area; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a risk probability distribution of emergency material reserves based on emergency material demand prediction results through quantification by using a Monte Carlo simulation method, constructing a digital twin model of the emergency material reserves according to the risk probability distribution and multidimensional real-time state information of an emergency material reserve system, introducing a reinforcement learning algorithm into the digital twin model of the emergency material reserves, and obtaining an optimal emergency material reserve strategy through interactive learning. The invention combines the methods of digital twin technology, reinforcement learning algorithm and the like to improve the accuracy and efficiency of emergency material reserve, and can rapidly and accurately provide the required emergency materials, thereby remarkably improving the emergency response capability.
assignees: MAT BRANCH OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Real-time intelligent disaster early warning method based on multi-mode data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time intelligent disaster early warning method based on multi-modal data, which belongs to the technical field of disaster early warning and comprises the following steps of firstly constructing a multi-modal data platform, secondly obtaining a first training model by utilizing a graph neural network technology and obtaining a second training model by combining a federal learning technology, thirdly integrating the first training model and the second training model to obtain a disaster propagation model, fourthly deploying a response function on edge equipment close to a data source, and fifthly continuously collecting data of actual disaster occurrence, comparing the data with a model prediction result and performing early warning response. According to the disaster identification method, disaster data acquired by multiple data sources are integrated, more data sources can be acquired, the comprehensiveness and accuracy of early warning can be improved, and a disaster identification model is constructed by utilizing a graph neural network and federal learning, so that the generalization capability of the model can be remarkably improved, and the system can cope with various complex and changeable disaster scenes.
assignees: SHAANXI PUBLIC INFORMATION IND CO LTD

title_en: Vertical shaft type urban highway tunnel fire disaster position and scale prediction method based on temperature data
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for predicting fire position and scale of a vertical shaft type urban highway tunnel based on temperature data, which comprises the steps of constructing a full-size physical model of the vertical shaft type urban highway tunnel (URTS) based on fire simulation software, and determining geometric parameters of a driving area and a vertical shaft based on actual tunnel size; setting various fire positions and scales in combination with a fire scene, reasonably dividing the grid size, arranging temperature measuring points, carrying out three-dimensional dynamic numerical simulation and obtaining temperature data. After collecting fire temperature data under various working conditions, a database is established and data preprocessing is carried out, and a training set, a verification set and a test set are divided. A long-short-term memory neural network (LSTM) is selected as a prediction model, training and evaluation of the LSTM model are realized through programming, real-time temperature data are input when a fire disaster occurs, the position and the scale of the fire disaster are predicted, and iterative prediction is carried out to obtain the optimal state estimation. And (3) changing the arrangement interval and coverage range of the temperature sensors, and testing and comparing the R  2  values to obtain an optimal arrangement scheme.
assignees: NANJING UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Elastic power distribution network planning method based on wind-solar-energy-storage combined output
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power distribution network planning, and particularly relates to an elastic power distribution network planning method based on wind-solar-energy-storage combined output, which comprises the steps of S1, establishing a power distribution network fault rate model, S2, establishing and selecting a typical disaster scene, establishing and screening the typical disaster scene by combining a Monte Carlo simulation method with information entropy, S3, establishing an elastic power distribution network planning configuration model based on the disaster scene, establishing a power distribution network planning model under the disaster scene by combining elements such as wind power generation, photovoltaic power generation, a micro gas turbine and energy storage, S4, solving the planning model by adopting an NSGA-II algorithm, and obtaining an optimal configuration result of the power distribution network.
assignees: NANYANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SHANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Post-disaster risk assessment method for power distribution network considering natural disaster space-time evolution model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster risk assessment method of a power distribution network taking a natural disaster space-time evolution model into consideration, which comprises the steps of 1, taking account of causes and influence factors of various natural disaster space-time evolutions, carrying out natural disaster space-time correlation modeling, 2, providing a method for calculating the fault probability of power distribution network equipment based on the natural disaster space-time correlation model, 3, providing a power distribution network disaster risk assessment method, sampling equipment states by using a non-time sequence Monte Carlo method, simulating the operation conditions of the power distribution network equipment under the influence of various natural disasters, and 4, establishing a power distribution network disaster risk assessment system from the aspects of reliability and safety and calculating each risk index value. The method and the system can accurately evaluate the post-disaster risk of the power distribution network under the influence of various natural disasters, thereby accelerating the post-disaster recovery of the power distribution network.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV HEFEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Toughness assessment and toughness improvement method for distribution information physical system under disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating and improving toughness of a distribution information physical system under disasters, and belongs to the field of cooperative regulation and control and optimized operation of power systems. The method comprises the steps of randomly generating a damage scene of an urban power grid under disasters through Monte Carlo simulation sampling, establishing a multi-period dynamic joint toughness evaluation model of a power distribution network information physical system based on a scene basis, introducing toughness evaluation indexes to evaluate the toughness of the power grid, taking the recovery requirements of power network loads and communication system resources into consideration, carrying out strategy optimization by utilizing resources such as a distributed unit, energy storage equipment and the like in the power distribution network and cooperating with a mobile emergency power supply and a mobile communication vehicle, evaluating the toughness of the power distribution network information physical system under different configurations, and solving the optimal toughness improvement strategy of the power distribution network information physical system. By establishing a multi-period toughness evaluation model of the power distribution network in an extreme disaster scene and combining various resource configurations, the improvement of the toughness of the power distribution network is promoted on the basis of considering the coupling of the information network, and the method has higher application value.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Construction method of post-earthquake water-electricity correlation network cascade failure model based on functional coupling
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for constructing a post-earthquake water-electricity correlation network cascade failure model based on functional coupling, and belongs to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction toughness research of infrastructure. The method comprises the specific steps of S1, collecting basic information of a water network and a power grid, S2, defining a functional coupling relation, establishing a water-electricity correlation network topological structure model based on graph theory, S4, determining components triggering cascade failure in the water network and the power grid based on a vulnerability curve, S5, introducing a failure joint probability method, determining the functional failure condition of the components with the functional coupling relation, S6, carrying out water network cascade failure analysis, S7, carrying out power grid cascade failure analysis, and S8, carrying out functional loss calculation of the water network and the power grid. The invention considers the functional coupling relation between the water network and the power grid component, simulates a failure propagation mechanism based on physical characteristics, and can more effectively and accurately reflect the internal mechanism and external behavior of cascade failure of the water-electricity correlation network.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN TECH

title_en: Fire intelligent identification method and device, cloud equipment and computer device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of intelligent fire disaster identification, in particular to an intelligent fire disaster identification method and device, cloud equipment and a computer device, which improve the accuracy of fire disaster identification. The fire intelligent identification method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-level separation convolutional neural network, wherein the multi-level separation convolutional neural network is mainly composed of lightweight multi-view decoupling convolutional modules, the lightweight multi-view decoupling convolutional modules are formed by cascading at least two lightweight multi-view decoupling convolutional sub-modules with different convolutional directions, the output of the former sub-module serves as the input of the latter sub-module, and the input of the lightweight multi-view decoupling convolutional module is connected to the output of the latter sub-module through a residual path to form the final output of the lightweight multi-view decoupling convolutional module; training the multi-level separation convolutional neural network through the training data set, optimizing parameters of the multi-level separation convolutional neural network, and identifying fire disaster through the trained multi-level separation convolutional neural network. The invention is suitable for fire disaster identification.
assignees: GUANGAN VOCATIONAL & TECHNICAL COLLEGE

title_en: Time axis driven fire fighting digital twin dynamic response and evolution method and equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a time-axis-driven fire-fighting digital twin dynamic response and evolution method and equipment, which can provide real-time and accurate monitoring and emergency response support at each stage of fire disaster occurrence by combining a digital twin technology with time-axis-driven dynamic simulation, implement digital dynamic response and deduction for fire management and fire disaster emergency response, and enable fire departments and personnel to timely and accurately master fire disaster dynamics based on the realized fire-fighting digital twin when the fire disaster occurs, so as to avoid delay of the optimal time of the emergency response.

title_en: Strong typhoon wind speed and wind direction joint probability distribution generation method based on Monte Carlo Markov chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a strong typhoon wind speed and wind direction joint probability distribution generation method based on a Monte Carlo Markov chain, which comprises the steps of firstly realizing simulation of typhoon wind field values through a Emanuel typhoon radial section model and a near-surface typhoon wind speed conversion method, as well as an average wind vertical section model and a pulsating wind model, then carrying out random simulation on a typhoon process by using a typhoon overall process random simulation method, analyzing simulation results, calculating typhoon positions of the next moment step, carrying out probability distribution calculation on the typhoon wind field on the basis of the simulation results to obtain wind speed extreme values and wind directions, and finally adopting a two-dimensional Gaussian non-parametric kernel density estimation method to construct a strong typhoon wind speed and wind direction joint probability model. The invention combines the typhoon process random simulation result and the typhoon wind field simulation method, provides a more scientific and practical solution for wind resistance evaluation of the engineering structure, and provides key data support for typhoon disaster vulnerability analysis of the engineering structure.
assignees: RES INST ECONOMICS & TECH STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Digitization method of urban security risk assessment standard
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digitizing method of urban security risk assessment standards, which comprises the steps of identifying risk factors for historical accident time sequence data, carrying out relevance analysis to obtain a relevance function, further constructing an urban network topology structure, determining prior probability of nodes according to similarity of the nodes and pre-disaster data, generating a simulated accident scene, adding disturbance items to simulate burst risks, combining the prior probability of the nodes to obtain a risk propagation path, constructing a risk assessment model, assessing space-time influence ranges of the nodes on the propagation path, and carrying out weighted summation on assessment results of the nodes to obtain an urban security risk assessment result. The method is used for constructing the network topology structure by multi-stage analysis of the historical accident data, so that the risk propagation simulation is more accurate, the urban risk assessment can be accurately quantized, and meanwhile, the method has better interpretability.
assignees: CHINA NAT INST STANDARDIZATION

title_en: Intelligent railway operation and maintenance system, method, equipment, medium and product
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent railway operation and maintenance system, an intelligent railway operation and maintenance method, intelligent railway operation and maintenance equipment, intelligent railway operation and maintenance media and intelligent railway products, and relates to the field of railway operation and maintenance, wherein the intelligent railway operation and maintenance system comprises an air-ground-vehicle integrated transmission module for acquiring and transmitting sensor data of key parts of a train; the system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster module, a digital twin big model training module, a digital twin big model prediction module and an emergency guidance module, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster module is used for acquiring and transmitting environment image data within a set range of a railway line, the digital twin big model training module is used for constructing a digital twin big model according to sensor data and the environment image data, determining an integrated big model, predicting a train fault type and a natural disaster by using the integrated big model, and generating an emergency guidance scheme, and the integrated big model is a neural network model.

title_en: Hydropower station safety integrated management system and method based on digital twin scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hydropower station safety comprehensive management system based on a digital twin scene, which is characterized by designing a hydropower station data resource coding system, establishing a hydropower station digital twin base, integrating all related geospatial data, basic data, monitoring data and business management data of a hydropower station, constructing the hydropower station digital twin scene, predicting displacement and deformation conditions of a hydropower station building structure and the change trend of important facility equipment state indexes of the hydropower station, predicting and judging the safety risk of the hydropower station, forecasting or predicting the warehouse-in flow of the hydropower station, the water level and flow change of an upstream river channel and the power generation output and the power generation capacity of the hydropower station, providing a corresponding plan for flood early warning or weather disaster early warning or water level overrun early warning, combining a simulation engine and simulating key links of the plan, and carrying out simulation calculation on different power generation and reservoir scheduling strategies to obtain an optimal scheduling scheme. The intelligent hydropower station engineering safety management system realizes the intelligent management of hydropower station engineering safety, dispatching safety and power generation safety.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CORP

title_en: Dam safety monitoring system and method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dam safety monitoring system and method based on digital twinning, which belong to the technical field of data processing, and comprise the steps of acquiring acoustic emission signals of the surface of a dam and internal infrared thermal image data in real time through a multi-source sensor to generate a multidimensional damage characteristic matrix; the method comprises the steps of constructing a disaster node topological network by combining density peak value clustering and dynamic weight, calculating and improving Monte Carlo simulation based on gravitational field intensity, accurately predicting a damage chain reaction path, generating a dynamic risk thermodynamic diagram through space-time folding mapping and a bidirectional diffraction equation, extracting hidden danger indexes by adopting multi-axis domain feature distillation, dynamically comparing safety envelope functions, and generating a flood discharge scheduling and reinforcing scheme on line. The invention adopts the cross-modal fusion, the gravitational field dynamic topological network and the space-time folding mapping technology, can realize the accurate simulation of the damage energy conduction path, the carbonization-deformation bidirectional coupling prediction and the deep fusion of the intelligent treatment decision of the risk hidden danger, and improves the accuracy and the initiative of the dam safety pre-warning.

title_en: Evaluation method and system of novel power distribution communication network under extreme disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evaluation method and system of a novel power distribution communication network under extreme disasters, which are characterized in that a double-network coupling model of a novel power distribution system 10kV line, a power grid node failure model under the extreme disasters and a communication node failure model after power grid node energy supply is lost under the extreme disasters are constructed, the correlation characteristics of a power distribution system power grid and the communication network are fully considered, the failure conditions of the power grid node and the communication node are accurately judged, probability distribution of the power grid node flowing through wind speed under the extreme disasters is generated, the wind speed condition is truly simulated, a basis is provided for judging the power grid node failure, and cascading failure simulation is carried out based on the double-network coupling model of the novel power distribution system 10kV line, the power grid node failure model under the extreme disasters, the communication node failure model after power grid node energy supply is lost under the extreme disasters and the probability distribution of the power grid node flowing through wind speed under the extreme disasters, so that the reliability of the communication network is evaluated, and the reliability of the communication network is improved.
assignees: ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Flood disaster risk assessment method for infrastructure failure cascade
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flood disaster risk assessment method for infrastructure failure cascade, which comprises the following steps of constructing a traffic transportation network topology model of a research area, obtaining basic attributes of infrastructures in the research area, constructing a directed graph, constructing an infrastructure system model based on the directed graph and combining dependency relations among the basic attributes of the infrastructures, simulating flood conditions in the research area in real time, judging failure road sections based on flood simulation results and the traffic transportation network topology model, assessing infrastructure cascade failure conditions based on the failure road sections, the flood simulation results and the infrastructure system model to obtain failure conditions of all infrastructures, and assessing service states of the infrastructures during flood based on the failure conditions of all infrastructures to serve as risk assessment results. Compared with the prior art, the flood risk assessment method has the advantages of being more accurate and deep in flood risk assessment and the like.
assignees: SHANGHAI INST TECH;UNIV SOUTHERN SCI & TECH

title_en: Power grid assessment method based on extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid assessment method based on extreme weather, which comprises the following steps of taking typhoon as a representative event, firstly comprehensively considering wind speed characteristics and electric pole running states when typhoon logs in, building a power distribution network electric pole fault correction model under typhoon disaster conditions according to the relation between electric pole load and electric pole bending strength, further providing a load shedding risk index reflecting power supply capacity after power distribution network faults, calculating the load shedding risk when typhoon disasters happen by using a Monte Carlo state sampling method, and finally verifying the effectiveness of the method by using an IEEE33 system calculation example. The power grid risk assessment method based on the time sequence Monte Carlo simulation method has the advantages that the risk of the power grid under typhoon disasters can be reasonably assessed, and the safe operation level of the power distribution network is improved through risk early warning.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO;UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH

title_en: Intelligent energy digital twin management and control system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent energy digital twin management and control system and method, comprising a control component, a data acquisition module, a communication and transmission module, an emergency response module and a server, wherein the server comprises a digital twin system, the digital twin system comprises optimal value substitution, active exogenous progressive and passive exogenous learning, real-time data are extracted from a sensor data set at any time and the optimal value is determined, the real-time data are used as a reference value for setting next time, amplitude information of a control value is divided into a plurality of sub-amplitude values, each sub-amplitude value is transmitted to the control component of a subsequent time period in an equal value or decreasing value mode, based on a supervised learning method, the optimal value information extracted from sensor data of a previous time period is used as input data, and the neural network is used for deep learning training. According to the scheme, various data of the energy system can be collected and analyzed in real time by utilizing a digital twin technology, and a comprehensive and real-time energy efficiency analysis report is provided for a manager, so that energy scheduling and control are optimized.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU LITONG WATER CO LTD

title_en: Icing rate prediction method based on improved particle swarm back propagation neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to an icing rate prediction method based on an improved particle swarm back propagation neural network, which relates to the field of researches on ice disaster prevention strategies of power transmission lines, and comprises the steps of establishing an icing growth mechanism model of the power transmission lines in a low-temperature rain and snow freezing environment; the method comprises the steps of changing environmental parameters through numerical simulation, performing multi-factor analysis by using an icing growth mechanism model to obtain icing working condition data of multiple scenes, multiple moments, multiple weather, multiple terrains and the like, using 4 environmental characteristic values of liquid water content, environmental temperature, water drop diameter and wind speed in air as input values of a network, using the icing rate of a power transmission line as output quantity of the network, constructing a BPNN prediction model, and optimizing the weight and threshold of the BPNN by using IPSO (internet protocol security) to realize accurate prediction of the icing rate of the power transmission line. The method is simple and feasible, the algorithm optimizing speed is high, the model predicting accuracy is high, and a reference is provided for the icing predicting and early warning work of the power transmission line.
assignees: UNIV NORTHEAST FORESTRY;ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;SHENYANG INST ENGINEERING;UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: High-efficiency, high-safety and low-cost wind field operation and maintenance system based on VR/AR technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of offshore wind farm operation and maintenance, and provides a high-efficiency, high-safety and low-cost wind farm operation and maintenance system based on VR/AR technology, which comprises an AR/VR operation optimizing engine, a virtual environment and a virtual environment, wherein real-time data can be checked and analyzed in the operation process of the system by combining the AR/VR technology with digital twinning, and instant feedback is obtained, so that decision and operation are optimized; and the VR virtual environment feedback module is used for carrying out data dynamic adjustment by matching with the virtual simulation environment database to provide an immersed offshore operation and maintenance environment. The pain point of difficulty in actual operation of the wind power system is solved, and through simulation practical training of equipment cognition, operation and maintenance skills in virtual reality, students can be familiar with the structure and operation flow of wind power equipment under the safe condition, various maintenance skills are mastered, the actual operation capability and the emergency response capability are improved, and the risk and cost in the actual operation are reduced.
assignees: SHENNENGYUAN SHENZHEN INNOVATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Optimization method for garden plant space distribution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a garden plant space distribution optimizing method, which adopts a plant space self-adaptive layout algorithm, utilizes a laser radar or unmanned plane technology to generate a high-precision 3D model of garden terrains, generates a weight matrix according to soil types, illumination intensity and drainage characteristics, applies a dynamic weight Voronoi algorithm to the terrain model to generate a planting range of each plant, uses an underground imaging technology to establish a root system distribution model, combines underground hydrologic data to simulate the distribution dynamics of moisture and nutrients among root systems, utilizes a wireless network to acquire sensor data in real time, designs a dynamic irrigation scheme, optimizes plant planting density and irrigation range, integrates data of terrains, climates and the like into virtual gardens, interacts with a digital twin model through a sensor to ensure that the virtual gardens are consistent with actual states, predicts plant growth, ecological benefit changes and disaster risks through a visual interface, and allows users to modify and optimize the garden layout in real time.
assignees: THE PEOPLES PARK MAN STATION OF ANYANG CITY

title_en: Digital Twin-Based Fire Occurrence Prediction System
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 기반 화재발생 예측 시스템
abstract_en: In a digital twin-based fire occurrence prediction system (10), the prediction system (10) is divided into an actual system (100) and a digital twin virtual system (300), and the actual system (100) and the digital twin virtual system (300) are connected to each other through a virtual system communication module (330) for providing wireless communication and web services to an external or remote facility manager for detection signals, fire, and earthquake signals. When the digital twin-based insulation deterioration and fire occurrence tendency prediction system according to the present invention is used, it is possible to predict not only abnormal diagnosis of actual field facilities, but also insulation soundness and fire occurrence due to deterioration.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 수배전반 또는 빌딩제어시스템 내부에서 아크카운터 및 새그 카운터로부터 획득한 데이터를 센서 데이터 처리모듈로 송신하여 저장하는 계통고장 검출장치류;와 화재 및 지진(진동)발생시 상황을 검출하여 재난상황을 예측, 진단할 수 있도록 센서로부터 획득한 데이터를 센서 데이터 처리모듈로 송신하여 저장하는 방재감시용 센서류; 상기 계통고장 검출장치류, 방재감시용 센서류로부터 생성된 데이터를 수집하여 DB에 저장하고, 필요 정보를 현장 모니터에 표시하는 설비이상 진단장치; 상기 설비이상 진단장치를 통해 고장원인을 포함하는 고장 데이터를 통신으로 전송받아 디지털 트윈 가상 시스템에 정보를 제공하는 가상시스템 통신모듈;을 포함하고 상기 디지털 트윈 가상 시스템은 센서 데이터 처리 모듈에서 제공하는 데이터를 기반으로, 열화경향 예측, 화재감시 및 예측 그리고 설비이상 진단을 위한 시뮬레이션을 시행하는 가상 시뮬레이션 모듈; 상기 시뮬레이션 모듈에서 시뮬레이션을 시행할 시 조건값, 경계값을 설정하는 파라미터 셋업모듈; 시뮬레이션을 통해 이미지를 디스플레이 하도록 데이터를 가공처리하여 현장 설비운영자에게 정보를 전달하는 디지털 트윈 그래픽 생성모듈;을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 디지털 트윈 기반 설비이상 진단 및 절연열화 예측 시스템을 제공한다.
assignees: KIM HEE YEOL

title_en: Aqueduct earthquake-resistant disaster-reduction system and method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction in civil engineering, in particular to a digital twinning-based aqueduct earthquake-resistant disaster reduction system and a digital twinning-based aqueduct earthquake-resistant disaster reduction method, wherein the system comprises a data acquisition module, an earthquake early warning module, a control system, a gate valve control module, a notification module, a 3D visualization module and an aqueduct post-earthquake evaluation module; the invention realizes the real-time acquisition of the running state information and the earthquake early-warning information of the aqueduct through the joint detection of the earthquake early-warning module and the secondary acquisition module, and the control module is used for adjusting the water quantity in the aqueduct before the arrival of destructive earthquake waves so as to minimize the earthquake response of the aqueduct. The monitoring data, the manual inspection data and the seismic characteristic information are input into the control system, an aqueduct digital twin model is built, and seismic response simulation is carried out, so that the safety state of the aqueduct structure after the earthquake can be accurately evaluated, a post-earthquake aqueduct structure processing scheme is rapidly provided, and a reference basis is provided for earthquake relief decisions.

title_en: Method and system for path analysis and risk identification of water infiltration outside hydropower station grotto group
abstract_en: The invention provides a path analysis and risk identification method and a system for water infiltration outside a hydropower station cavern group, which dynamically simulate the propagation path of water flow by establishing a catchment network model of the underground cavern group, the risk of external water infiltration is comprehensively evaluated, the water flow path is displayed, and comprehensive path analysis and risk identification of external water infiltration of a complex underground cavern group are realized. The method effectively solves the problems that the result of risk assessment of water seepage of the hydropower station cavern group is low in accuracy, the propagation path and the sweep range of the water flow are difficult to predict accurately, provides a scientific water flow management and protection scheme for the hydropower station, provides scientific technical support for seepage prevention design, risk management and emergency response of the hydropower station underground plant, and has strong engineering practical significance.

title_en: Flood disaster digital twin processing method and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a flood disaster digital twin processing method and electronic equipment, which are applied to a flood disaster digital twin platform; the method comprises the steps of obtaining original data corresponding to a scene to be predicted, obtaining configuration information corresponding to the scene to be predicted, wherein the configuration information comprises at least one of boundary conditions and Manning coefficients, obtaining a flood prediction result of the scene to be predicted by using a flood simulation model according to the original data and the configuration information, wherein the flood prediction result comprises urban flooding data and drainage pipe network flow data, the urban flooding information is used for indicating the flooding height of each area in a city, and storing the flood prediction result. The user input interface and the operation method are provided, so that the transmission time is effectively reduced, the threshold of learning and using the flood disaster digital twin platform is reduced, and the flexibility and the adaptability of use are improved.
assignees: UNIV MACAU

title_en: Method of providing forest digital twin and apparatus using the same
title_ko: 산림 디지털 트윈 제공 방법 및 이를 이용한 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for providing a user interface for providing a forest digital twin. The method comprises the steps of: receiving forest data from at least one forest disaster detection device; and providing a three-dimensional digital twin for a forest based on the forest data. The three-dimensional digital twin for the forest is configured to provide at least one of landslide prediction data and forest fire prediction data based on a simulation for the forest.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 산림 디지털 트윈 제공을 위한 사용자 인터페이스 제공 방법으로서. 상기 방법은, 적어도 하나의 산림 재난 탐지 디바이스로부터 산림 데이터를 수신하는 단계, 상기 산림 데이터를 기초로, 산림에 대한 3차원 디지털 트윈을 제공하는 단계를 포함하도록 구성되고, 상기 산림에 대한 3차원 디지털 트윈은, 상기 산림에 대한 시뮬레이션을 기초로 산사태 예측 데이터, 산불 예측 데이터 중 적어도 하나를 제공하도록 구성된다.
assignees: E8IGHT CO LTD

title_en: Garden insect disaster prediction optimization method based on ecological model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a garden insect disaster prediction optimization method based on an ecological model. The technical scheme includes that garden ecological factors are divided into climate driving factors, plant health factors and insect pest biological factors according to biological levels, environmental levels and spatial levels, causality modeling is conducted on interaction relation among the factors, dynamic Bayesian network analysis ecological factors are introduced to identify potential insect disaster high risk trigger points, a Sobol sensitivity analysis method is used to identify key driving factors, decision basis is provided for model optimization, an environment pressure index including drought and illumination intensity fluctuation of an ecological system and a response relation of insect pest population dynamics are defined, a nonlinear response equation is built, an improved Lotka-Volterra model is fused, the environment pressure coefficient is added, expansion characteristics of the insect pest population under various ecological pressures are simulated, and meanwhile influence of long-term climate trend and short-term weather fluctuation on insect disaster is captured.
assignees: ANYANG GARDEN GREENING SCIENT RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Pollution tracing system and method based on drainage system water quality and water quantity monitoring analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pollution tracing system and a pollution tracing method based on drainage system water quality and water quantity monitoring analysis, which particularly relate to the technical field of water quality and water quantity monitoring, wherein water quality and water quantity parameters are collected in real time through a distributed sensor network, a denoising processing and anomaly detection algorithm are combined to ensure data quality, a multivariate dynamic analysis method and a space-time correlation model are utilized to identify anomaly change characteristics of pollutant concentration, a nonlinear superposition effect correction model is constructed to eliminate false peak interference at a junction, a real pollution source is positioned, a pollution propagation process is simulated based on a diffusion path and flow characteristics by combining a geographic information system and a drainage basin model, the geographical position of the pollution source is accurately determined, and finally, a tracing result is visually output to a user terminal to generate a pollution tracing report, scientific treatment advice and multi-level alarm signals are provided, and effective technical support is provided for pollution treatment and emergency response.

title_en: Method and device for performing fire evacuation simulation based on spatial network of semantic digital twin virtual model considering internal facility arrangement
title_ko: 내부 시설 배치를 고려한 시멘틱 디지털 트윈 가상 모델의 공간 네트워크를 기반으로 화재 대피 시뮬레이션을 수행하는 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for a server to determine an optimal evacuation route based on BIM information for a building. The method comprises the steps of: generating spatial semantic information for the building based on the BIM information for the building; and implementing a three-dimensional virtual space for the building based on the spatial semantic information for the building. The three-dimensional virtual space for the building includes at least one layer, and the at least one layer includes M unit spaces interconnected by N doors. According to embodiments, a server generates a space connection matrix and a door-space table based on BIM information on a building, thereby efficiently determining an optimal evacuation route using the space connection matrix and the door-space table.
abstract_ko: 실시예들은 내부 시설 배치를 고려한 시멘틱 디지털 트윈 가상 모델의 공간 네트워크를 기반으로 화재 대피 시뮬레이션을 수행하는 방법 및 장치를 제공한다. 일 실시예에 따른 상기 방법은, 상기 건물에 대한 BIM(building information modeling) 정보에 기반하여 상기 건물에 대한 공간 시멘틱 정보를 생성하고, 상기 건물에 대한 공간 시멘틱 정보를 기반으로 상기 건물에 대한 3차원 가상 공간을 구현하고, 상기 건물에 대한 3차원 가상 공간은 적어도 하나의 계층을 포함하고, 상기 적어도 하나의 계층은 N개의 출입문으로 상호 연결된 M개의 단위 공간을 포함하고, 상기 공간 시멘틱 정보는 M개의 단위 공간 각각을 형상화하기 위한 공간 폴리곤 정보, 외부 공간에 대한 정보, 상기 M개의 단위 공간과 연결되는 출입문을 나타내는 출입문 객체 정보, 상기 M개의 단위 공간 사이의 연결성을 나타내는 공간 연결 매트릭스 및 상기 N개의 출입문과 상기 M개의 단위 공간 사이의 매칭 관계를 나타내는 출입문-공간 테이블을 포함하고, 상기 공간 시멘틱 정보를 기반으로 상기 M개의 단위 공간 각각에 대해 최단 대피 경로를 결정하고, 상기 최단 대피 경로는 해당 단위 공간이 출발 노드로 설정되고, 해당 단위 공간에서 가장 가까운 외부 공간으로 연결된 출입문이 포함된 단위 공간이 도착 노드로 설정되고, 상기 공간 시멘틱 정보 및 상기 M개의 단위 공간 각각에 대한 구조물 정보를 기반으로 상기 M개의 단위 공간 각각에 복수의 에이전트를 배치하고, 상기 M개의 단위 공간 각각에 대한 구조물 정보 및 상기 최단 대피 경로를 기반으로 상기 복수의 에이전트 각각에 대한 최적 대피 경로를 결정하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다. 예를 들어, 상기 최적 대피 경로는 에이전트의 위치가 출발 위치로 설정되고, 상기 출발 위치가 포함된 단위 공간에서 가장 가까운 외부 공간으로 연결된 출입문이 도착 위치로 설정되고, 상기 출발 위치가 포함된 단위 공간의 최단 대피 경로를 구성하는 단위 공간마다 단위 공간 내부에 포함된 구조물을 제외한 영역을 지나는 경로로 결정될 수 있다.
assignees: SIMSYSGLOBAL INC

title_en: Method and device for intelligent early identification of large-area potential landslide
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for early intelligent identification of a large-area potential landslide, which belong to the technical field of image target identification and geological disaster monitoring, and the method comprises the steps of collecting historical data of a landslide area, obtaining earth surface deformation rate and gradient data, and forming a sample data set; the method comprises the steps of constructing a potential landslide identification model composed of a data input layer, a feature coding network and an identification result output layer, wherein the feature coding network is composed of 9 cascaded feature learning modules, each feature learning module is composed of a network hiding layer and a data normalization layer, training and verifying the potential landslide identification model to obtain a final potential landslide identification model, obtaining actual measurement data of a monitoring area, inputting the actual measurement data into the final potential landslide identification model, and outputting a potential landslide identification result of the monitoring area. The invention realizes the distinction between potential landslide candidate points and non-hidden danger points in a large area range, and provides reliable technical support for landslide disaster prevention and control.

title_en: Digital twin simulation method and device for preventing seawater intrusion by pumping underground salt water
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twin simulation method and a device for preventing seawater invasion by extracting underground salt water, which belong to the technical field of seawater invasion and comprise the following steps of S1, measuring corresponding values through a physical simulation device, utilizing a scaling factor and conversion to obtain physical basin information corresponding to nature, S2, constructing a digital twin model with multiple space-time dimensions, S3, constructing the digital twin model, S4, carrying out circular cross recombination on data characteristics based on a circular cross fusion mechanism, and carrying out fusion processing on the recombined characteristics by adopting a mixed Gaussian process, and S5, running the digital twin model in a virtual environment, simulating the seawater invasion condition under the real condition of nature, and realizing disaster monitoring in the physical basin range. The invention fully utilizes the digital twin technology to realize real-time synchronization of physical entities and virtual models, provides early warning for possible geological disasters, and provides decision support for orderly development and utilization of groundwater.

title_en: Reservoir flood control monitoring system and method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir flood control monitoring system and method based on digital twinning, which relate to the technical field of reservoir flood control monitoring and comprise a multi-source data acquisition module, wherein the digital twinning module is used for constructing and obtaining a digital twinning model according to real-time monitoring data of the multi-source data acquisition module, the coupling module is used for receiving a fusion data set provided by the digital twinning module and dynamically simulating the fusion data set to provide dynamic prediction results of dam seepage, deformation and flood evolution, the dynamic early warning module comprises a dynamic threshold adjusting unit and an early warning unit, dynamically optimizes the early warning threshold according to the real-time monitoring data and triggers early warning in real time, and compared with the traditional early warning system with fixed threshold, the system can adapt to the change of dam state and environmental conditions, identify potential abnormal events in advance, provide sufficient time for reservoir flood control to carry out emergency response and scheduling decision, so that disaster risk is effectively reduced, and safety of reservoir operation is ensured.

title_en: Urban power grid viability assessment method and device considering main-distribution coordination
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a device for evaluating the viability of an urban power grid considering main and auxiliary coordination, and relates to the technical field of power grid viability evaluation.
