The method comprises the steps of simulating a damaged scene of a power grid by adopting a Monte Carlo algorithm, constructing a first main network scheduling model and a first distribution network scheduling model before a target disaster occurs, calculating a first evaluation index, constructing each second distribution network scheduling model and a first distribution network foldback scheduling model under each load node in the target disaster, calculating corresponding net load demands, constructing a second main network scheduling model, calculating a second evaluation index, constructing each distribution network recovery model and a second distribution network foldback scheduling model under each load node after the target disaster occurs, calculating corresponding distribution network total load demands, constructing a third main network scheduling model, calculating a third evaluation index, and evaluating the survival capability of the target urban power grid according to the three evaluation indexes. The application can improve the evaluation accuracy of the survivability of the urban power grid.

title_en: Visualization method and apparatus for disaster spread prediction simulation
title_ko: 재난확산예측 시뮬레이션의 가시화 방법 및 그 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method for visualizing a disaster spread prediction simulation and an apparatus thereof. The visualization device divides a target model of a virtual space into a grid structure, assigns an analysis value of a disaster spread prediction simulation for the target model to each grid, grasps a color corresponding to the analysis value assigned to each grid, visualizes the color of each grid, and displays the visualized color in a digital twin space.
abstract_ko: 재난확산예측 시뮬레이션의 가시화 방법 및 그 장치가 개시된다. 가시화장치는 가상공간의 대상모델을 격자 구조로 분할하고, 대상모델에 대한 재난확산예측 시뮬레이션의 분석값을 각 격자에 부여하고, 각 격자에 부여된 분석값에 해당하는 색상을 파악하고, 각 격자의 색상을 가시화하여 디지털트윈공간에 표시한다.
assignees: CMWORLD CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin previewing submerged disaster assessment method, device and program product based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twin-forward submerged disaster assessment method, device and program product based on deep learning, wherein the digital twin-forward submerged disaster assessment method comprises the following steps of collecting basic geographic data, natural resource investigation data, geological data, meteorological data, water conservancy basic data and rainwater condition monitoring data; the method comprises the steps of training a convolutional neural network deep learning model by using basic geographic data, natural resource investigation data, geological data, meteorological data, water conservancy basic data and rainwater condition monitoring data, creating a terrain three-dimensional model according to image data and terrain data, extracting key features from the image data and the terrain data, constructing a digital twin base three-dimensional model based on the extracted key features and the terrain three-dimensional model, performing submerged disaster simulation and previewing by using the hydrodynamic model, the digital twin base three-dimensional model and the trained convolutional neural network deep learning model, evaluating based on simulation and prediction results, and visually displaying simulation results and evaluation data.
assignees: NEWCAPEC ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Flood disaster propagation simulation method based on bus-subway double-layer traffic network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flood disaster propagation simulation method based on a bus-subway double-layer traffic network, which comprises the steps of constructing the bus-subway double-layer traffic network according to bus nodes, bus node connection relations, subway nodes, subway node connection relations and bus-subway transfer nodes, introducing disaster disturbance into the bus-subway double-layer traffic network, simulating the influence of the flood disaster on the double-layer traffic network, obtaining a node state update formula and a flood disturbance formula, iteratively calculating the node states at all moments through the node state update formula and the flood disturbance formula, and obtaining a disaster chained propagation path based on dynamic evolution of the node states in time. Compared with the prior art, the invention fills the blank of complex network disaster propagation research, and the proposed dynamic model can comprehensively reveal the dynamic behavior of the bus-subway system in extreme weather.
assignees: UNIV TONGJI

title_en: Searching method for determining double-critical sliding surface of side slope of heterogeneous soil layer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a search method for determining a double-critical sliding surface of a side slope of a heterogeneous soil layer. The method utilizes Monte Carlo random simulation to combine with genetic algorithm to generate and screen parameter samples, and determines optimal parameter set assignment to a model through multi-index similarity function. Two groups of sliding surface candidate sets are synchronously generated based on an improved NSGA-II algorithm, a collaborative safety coefficient is constructed by combining a strength folding method and an energy method, and the mechanical response of a side slope is comprehensively considered. And solving failure probability through Monte Carlo simulation, and judging the double-critical sliding surface. And finally, locking the optimal critical sliding surface by using a particle swarm optimization and tabu search collaborative framework. The algorithm can accurately capture the double-critical sliding surface, is widely applicable to various geological and load conditions, improves calculation accuracy and efficiency, and provides key data support for slope engineering design, safety evaluation, disaster early warning and the like.

title_en: Campus fire monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to a campus fire monitoring method and system, and relates to the technical field of fire monitoring, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring smoke values sent by all smoke sensors in a campus and image information sent by a camera device; the method comprises the steps of judging whether a fire disaster happens or not based on smoke values and image information, determining a fire disaster occurrence area based on position information of a corresponding smoke sensor and image information sent by a fire disaster camera after the fire disaster is judged to happen, dynamically simulating a fire disaster spreading trend based on a digital twin model and combining a smoke spreading prediction algorithm to generate a dynamic thermodynamic diagram, dividing an affected area and a safe area based on the dynamic thermodynamic diagram, controlling display equipment and broadcasting equipment in the affected area to broadcast first warning information, controlling the display equipment and the broadcasting equipment in the safe area to broadcast second warning information, and monitoring escape conditions of personnel in all areas and updating the first warning information in real time. The application has the effects of enabling personnel in different fire areas to acquire targeted information and improving the efficiency of the personnel in coping with the fire.
assignees: SICHUAN VOCATIONAL & TECHNICAL COLLEGE

title_en: Digital twinning-based flood storage area risk-benefit dynamic game regulation and control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flood storage area regulation and control, in particular to a digital twinning-based flood storage area risk-benefit dynamic game regulation and control method. The method comprises the steps of dynamically simulating a real-time flood event based on a digital twin model to obtain probability distribution data, carrying out multi-objective iterative optimization solving on a historical flood diversion regulation strategy based on the probability distribution data to generate a multi-objective optimal balance set, generating a real-time controllable gate regulation instruction set based on the digital twin model and the optimal balance set, and carrying out quantitative evaluation on the risk and benefit regulated and controlled in a flood storage area in the process of regulating and controlling a gate in real time through the gate regulation instruction set. The invention realizes high precision, dynamic and intelligent regulation and control of the flood storage area, realizes accurate quantitative assessment of risk and benefit of the flood storage area, provides scientific basis for flood control decision, and effectively reduces flood disaster loss and ecological influence.
assignees: GUANGDONG RES INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER

title_en: Coal and gas outburst disaster prediction method and device based on multi-physical field coupling
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of disaster prediction and discloses a coal and gas outburst disaster prediction method and device based on multi-physical field coupling. The method comprises the steps of carrying out data enhancement and normalization processing on a training sample set to obtain a model training data set, carrying out pattern recognition and parameter optimization on the model training data set to obtain an outstanding disaster prediction model, carrying out probability distribution calculation on output data of the outstanding disaster prediction model to obtain a confidence interval, carrying out multi-dimensional cross validation on the confidence interval to obtain a prediction reliability assessment result, carrying out threshold grading and risk grading on the prediction reliability assessment result to obtain an early warning grade judgment result, and carrying out space-time correlation analysis on the early warning grade judgment result to obtain target early warning decision information. According to the application, the coupling relation among the multiple physical field parameters is analyzed, and the multiple physical field coupling prediction model is established, so that the accurate prediction of the coal and gas outburst disasters is realized, and the reliability and accuracy of the prediction are improved.

title_en: Intelligent control method and system for new energy transmission and distribution collaborative consumption
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy transmission and distribution collaborative consumption intelligent control method and a system, which relate to the technical field of new energy, and comprise the steps of collecting real-time monitoring data of each node in an electric power system and preprocessing; and constructing a complex network model of the power grid according to the adjacency matrix, calculating the power weight of each power transmission line, and storing all data into a relational database and managing. According to the method, the nodes and the edges of the power system are accurately modeled, the adjacency matrix is constructed, the topological structure of the power grid and the power flow of the power transmission line are comprehensively reflected, the load and the running state of the power grid are accurately estimated, errors in the traditional method are avoided, the propagation process of faults in the power grid is simulated in real time by calculating the degrees, the clustering coefficients and the expansion series of the nodes and combining the propagation dynamics model, the speed and the range of the fault propagation are predicted, multi-stage early warning is further realized, the accuracy of evaluating the vulnerability of the power grid is improved, and the stability and the emergency response capability of the power grid are enhanced.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: River basin digital twin construction method and system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The application provides a drainage basin digital twin construction method and system based on multi-source data fusion. The method is applied to the technical field of drainage basin digital twin construction, and comprises the steps of obtaining water level monitoring data, surface flood evolution path data, weather forecast rainfall data and terrain gradient change data, generating a runoff distribution relation by fusing the rainfall and the terrain gradient data, and identifying a high risk area by combining the water level abrupt change amplitude. And establishing a digital twin primary frame, and generating relevant characteristic parameters by utilizing reverse feedback of the flood path and the water level data. Inputting meteorological data, constructing a twin model based on boundary conditions of a water collecting area, and simulating abnormal flood direction and inundation early warning signals. And generating emergency schemes such as flood diversion gate scheduling, flood storage area starting and the like according to the pre-warning space-time distribution and the terrain elevation data, and realizing risk grading management and control. The technical scheme provided by the application improves the flood inundation prediction precision and emergency response efficiency, and provides accurate decision support for flood control in the river basin.

title_en: Method and system for deciding emergency treatment of natural disaster damage of reservoir dam system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of emergency treatment, and discloses a method and a system for determining natural disaster damage emergency treatment of a dam system, wherein the method comprises the steps of classifying preprocessed multi-source data by using a clustering algorithm and constructing a disaster information database based on a classification result; the method comprises the steps of constructing a risk assessment model to assess damage risk of natural disasters to a dam system, generating a plurality of emergency treatment strategies by combining a multi-objective optimization algorithm, screening out an optimal emergency treatment strategy by using a scene simulation technology, distributing resources by using a dynamic resource distribution algorithm, simulating the dam system in real time by using a digital twin technology to predict the damage risk, executing corresponding emergency treatment measures and recording emergency treatment effect data, assessing the emergency treatment effect data by using a data envelopment analysis algorithm, and optimizing the risk assessment model based on an assessment result. The invention enhances the data integration and processing capacity and improves the accuracy and stability of the prediction result.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;BEIJING IWHR KHL CO LTD

title_en: Distributed fire situation sensing and collaborative early warning method for building group
abstract_en: The invention provides a distributed fire situation sensing and collaborative early warning method for a building group, which relates to the technical field of building groups and comprises the steps of collecting fire data through smoke sensing, temperature sensing and infrared imaging nodes, generating a fire feature vector by adopting a distributed preprocessing algorithm, and constructing a multidimensional fire correlation matrix; and training based on the graph structure neural network to generate a dynamic evolution model of the building group fire disaster, and calculating a fire disaster spread prediction result by combining with a digital twin platform of the building group to generate a differential early warning instruction. The intelligent sensing, dynamic prediction and collaborative early warning of the fire conditions of the building group are realized, and the accuracy and timeliness of fire early warning are improved.
assignees: ARIC DALIAN SAFETY TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent monitoring and optimizing system and method for energy-saving combustion of supercritical carbon dioxide coal-fired boiler
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent monitoring and optimizing system and method for energy-saving combustion of a supercritical carbon dioxide coal-fired boiler, comprising a data acquisition and transmission module, a digital twin modeling module, a fault diagnosis and early warning module and an energy efficiency optimizing module, wherein the data acquisition and transmission module is used for acquiring real-time data in the operation process of the supercritical carbon dioxide coal-fired boiler, the digital twin modeling module is used for constructing a digital twin model according to the real-time data to realize the simulation of the combustion process of the coal-fired boiler, the fault diagnosis and early warning module is used for simulating the operation state of the coal-fired boiler according to the real-time data to diagnose and early warn faults of the coal-fired boiler, and the energy efficiency optimizing module is used for monitoring the energy efficiency of the coal-fired boiler according to the real-time data and simultaneously optimizing in real time according to monitoring results. The invention can acquire monitoring data in real time aiming at the large-capacity coal-fired power plant boiler from the aspects of intellectualization, economy, safety and operability, intelligently judges and sends out early warning, is beneficial to improving the safety and emergency response capability of the operation of the boiler, and effectively prevents possible safety accidents in the operation process.
assignees: HUANENG JILIN POWER GENERATION CO LTD;XIAN THERMAL POWER RES INST CO

title_en: Gas coal mine goaf coupling disaster monitoring method, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine disaster monitoring, in particular to a gas coal mine goaf coupling disaster monitoring method, an electronic device and a storage medium, wherein the gas coal mine goaf coupling disaster monitoring method comprises the following steps of acquiring comprehensive data of a goaf through a sensor network and preprocessing the data to obtain standardized data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model through a 3D modeling and geographic information system technology, carrying out data synchronization and model correction processing on the digital twin model, optimizing parameters and states of the digital twin model, constructing a fluid-solid-heat multi-field coupling model through a computational fluid mechanics and finite element analysis method, constructing a risk assessment model through a analytic hierarchy process and a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, training a disaster early warning model through a machine learning algorithm based on standardized data and the risk assessment model, integrating the digital twin model, the standardized data, the risk assessment model and the disaster early warning model, and constructing a visual interaction platform. The monitoring method can be used for coupling multiple disaster factors and dynamically evolving, so that the disaster prediction accuracy and timeliness are greatly improved.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Method for evaluating probability of river blockage of post-earthquake rainfall induced landslide-debris flow geological disaster chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-earthquake rainfall-induced landslide-debris flow geological disaster chain river blockage probability assessment method which comprises the following steps of 1) determining a study area for constructing a landslide occurrence probability assessment model, meshing the study area into a plurality of non-overlapping grid units, constructing the landslide occurrence probability assessment model, acquiring a landslide susceptibility distribution map, 2) acquiring a joint probability distribution model of occurrence times and volume of the landslide in a region to be measured, 3) acquiring migration characteristics of the debris flow in the region to be measured, and 4) obtaining river blockage probability of a river section in the grid unit where the river is located in the region to be measured through multiple Monte Carlo simulation based on rainfall intensity and distribution data. The invention provides a complete evaluation flow, which scientifically quantifies the river-block probability of a river reach by comprehensively calculating landslide occurrence probability and debris flow migration characteristics and combining a Monte Carlo simulation technology, thereby providing important support for disaster prevention and control.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Method and system for constructing Tibetan zone ground disaster early warning model based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for constructing a Tibetan zone ground disaster early warning model based on digital twinning, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning. The method comprises the main technical scheme of obtaining first geological data and second geological data, stage weather index data and stage disaster index data, constructing a first geological entity model and a second geological entity model corresponding to a target road section, integrating the stage weather index data into the first geological entity model to obtain a simulated geological entity model of the target road section, constructing a geological disaster early warning model based on the stage disaster index data and the simulated geological entity model, and optimizing parameters of the geological disaster early warning model based on differences between the second geological entity model and the simulated geological entity model. The model can simulate and forecast the influence of the extreme temperature difference on the property of the rock-soil body, and more accurately evaluate the geological disaster risk. The model can be continuously adapted to new environmental changes and geological disaster characteristics, and the prediction precision and long-term applicability of the early warning model are improved.
assignees: HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;SINOHYDRO ENGINEERING BUREAU 4 CO LTD

title_en: Automatic monitoring system for disaster of expressway high slope
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method or a device for identifying a mode, in particular to an automatic monitoring system for disaster of a highway high slope, which comprises the following steps: the system comprises a data collection and feature extraction module, a deep learning training module, a risk assessment model construction module, an early warning notification module and an automatic early warning and processing suggestion module. According to the risk assessment method, a complete risk assessment framework is formed through the risk data collection and basic credibility grading module, the Bayesian network algorithm calculation and weight weighting module and the risk level calculation module, the risk assessment framework has high systematicness, the basic credibility of each risk factor after adjustment is calculated through the Bayesian network algorithm, and the weight weighting is carried out, so that the risk assessment result is more accurate, and different risk levels of high, medium and low can be effectively distinguished.
assignees: HENAN JIAOYUAN ENGINEERING TECH GROUP CO LTD;HENAN COLLEGE OF TRANSP

title_en: Tunnel operation quality rapid detection method based on energy efficiency evaluation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunnel quality detection and discloses a tunnel operation quality rapid detection method based on energy efficiency evaluation, which comprises the following steps of S1, multi-source data fusion acquisition and modeling, namely deploying an Internet of things sensor network and constructing a three-dimensional tunnel model; S2, dynamic energy efficiency evaluation and self-adaptive scoring, namely calculating a multidimensional energy efficiency ratio based on real-time data, training a lightweight LightGBM model, updating the model every 24 hours in an increment mode, S3, automatically switching to an emergency energy efficiency mode when traffic congestion exceeds a threshold value and a fire disaster occurs in an extreme scene mode, S4, digital twin simulation and real-time optimization, S5, block chain knowledge precipitation and closed-loop management. By monitoring the congestion index and the pollutant concentration in real time, injecting extreme scene data in a virtual environment, locally training LightGBM models of all tunnels, encrypting and uploading parameters to a center for aggregation, and running the equipment according to a decision to realize the dynamic and traceability of energy efficiency evaluation under congestion or fire.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGJIAO GUOTONG INTELLIGENT TRAFFIC SYSTEM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Flood control dispatching simulation method and system suitable for multistage serial-parallel cascade reservoirs
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood control dispatching simulation method and system suitable for a multistage serial-parallel cascade reservoir, comprising the steps of collecting and arranging basic data; the method comprises the steps of extracting river network water systems, dividing sub-watershed, generating topological structures based on cascade reservoir serial-parallel connection relations, performing standardization treatment, constructing a model based on three layers of nested circulation on the basis of the cascade reservoir topological structure relations, realizing simulation of warehousing flood and flood control calculation processes of the cascade reservoirs step by step from upstream to downstream, simulating cascade reservoir flood control scheduling processes under different schemes through setting schemes, and performing scheme comparison analysis and effect evaluation. According to the invention, the data base plate and the water rain condition monitoring information are fully utilized, the cascade reservoirs with complex series-parallel connection relations such as series connection, parallel connection or series-parallel connection can be adapted, the simulation of the cascade reservoir flood forecasting and flood control scheduling process is realized, reliable guarantee is provided for scientifically and reasonably formulating a cascade reservoir scheduling scheme, and technical support is provided for improving flood control and disaster reduction capability.

title_en: Three-network collaborative power grid recovery method and system based on complex network theory
abstract_en: The invention provides a three-network collaborative power grid recovery method and system based on a complex network theory, which belong to the technical field of power systems, and effectively solve the problems that the traditional scheme only focuses on fault propagation in a single network, the simulation result and the actual physical condition of the traditional scheme are greatly different, and the traditional power grid recovery strategy mainly only considers a single traditional power generation power station due to the single structure of a current urban power station, so that the disaster recovery capability is poor, the disaster resistance capability is weak and the recovery strategy is not flexible enough.
assignees: UNIV LIAOCHENG

title_en: Quick visualization method and system for earthquake emergency information
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data visualization, in particular to a method and a system for quickly visualizing earthquake emergency information. The method comprises the steps of obtaining earthquake monitoring real-time data, dividing population density distribution of a seismic area and key facility positions based on the earthquake monitoring real-time data in a grid mode, generating a seismic area sensitivity matrix, dynamically simulating a seismic wave propagation process based on the earthquake monitoring real-time data and the seismic area sensitivity matrix, generating fluctuation propagation time sequence data, identifying earthquake medium topography and topography vector data of the earthquake monitoring real-time data, and respectively evaluating topography fluctuation and geological stability to obtain earthquake topography fluctuation index data and earthquake geological stability scoring data. According to the invention, through a data visualization technology, quick and accurate evaluation and visualization of earthquake hazard distribution are realized, so that the earthquake emergency response efficiency and the scientificity of disaster rescue decisions are improved.
assignees: INST OF GEOMECHANICS CHINESE ACADEMY OF GEOLOGICAL SCIENCES

title_en: Power distribution network line reinforcement decision-making method and system considering typhoon disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a line reinforcement decision-making method of a power distribution network under consideration of typhoon disasters, which comprises the steps of generating fault probability of each line after the occurrence of the typhoon disasters according to a power distribution network pole fault probability generation method, acquiring fault states of each line in the power distribution network after the occurrence of the typhoon disasters, non-electric vehicle user load data and electric vehicle initial states, then establishing a post-disaster flexible resource collaborative quick recovery model, simulating a restoration process after the occurrence of the typhoon disasters according to the post-disaster flexible resource collaborative quick recovery model, obtaining restoration moments of each line, sorting according to the restoration moments of each line by using a Copride sorting method, so as to obtain line importance sorting, and making line anti-station reinforcement decisions of the power distribution network according to the line importance sorting. The method can be used for making the line reinforcement strategy of the power distribution network under typhoon extreme natural disasters.
assignees: ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;WUHAN NARI LTD LIABILITY CO OF STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Digital twin river basin flood disaster early warning plan generation system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computer science and artificial intelligence, and discloses a digital twin drainage basin flood warning plan generation system based on deep learning, which comprises a data acquisition and processing module, a data processing module and a data processing module, wherein the data acquisition and processing module acquires and processes multi-source data such as drainage basin weather, hydrology, topography, remote sensing and the like in real time to provide real-time data input; the system comprises a digital twin modeling module, a deep learning prediction module, an emergency response generation module and a system feedback module, wherein the digital twin modeling module is used for constructing a digital twin model of a watershed hydrologic dynamic process according to real-time data and outputting a simulation result, the deep learning prediction module is used for receiving the simulation result, training the prediction model and outputting space and time distribution prediction of a flood disaster, the emergency response generation module is used for generating an emergency plan of the flood disaster according to the prediction result, and the system feedback module is used for evaluating the emergency plan and the prediction effect and providing adjustment basis for future disaster early warning. The method and the system can realize accurate flood disaster prediction based on real-time data, improve the accuracy and response efficiency of the emergency plan and reduce disaster loss.
assignees: Zhang Hangfan

title_en: Power distribution system toughness assessment method based on dynamic Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution system toughness assessment method based on a dynamic Bayesian network, and belongs to the technical field of disaster assessment and power system toughness analysis. The method comprises the steps of simulating a storm disaster by using a Chicago unimodal rainfall model, simulating urban waterlogging by combining a digital elevation model and a two-dimensional hydrodynamic model, establishing a power distribution equipment failure model based on ponding depth data to obtain node failure probability, simulating a power distribution system state by using a Monte Carlo sampling method, constructing a dynamic Bayesian network to calculate power accessibility, establishing a power distribution network trend model by considering load withdrawal and line topology change, calculating load loss and voltage offset, and evaluating system risks. According to the method, the influence of the storm disaster on the power distribution network is comprehensively considered through multi-model coupling and probability analysis, the toughness of the power distribution network under the storm disaster is accurately estimated, scientific basis is provided for planning, designing and emergency management of a power system, and the disaster resistance and reliability of the power distribution network are improved.

title_en: Urban infrastructure risk assessment method oriented to storm disaster chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a storm disaster chain-oriented urban infrastructure risk assessment method which specifically comprises the following steps of S1, uniformly coding urban infrastructure elements, S2, constructing a correlation network among urban infrastructure nodes, S3, constructing an urban storm disaster chain network, S4, simulating a secondary disaster risk caused by a storm disaster, S5, simulating an infrastructure risk caused by a storm disaster chain, S6, assessing cascade fault conduction of the infrastructure node risk, S7, and realizing real-time risk display based on uniform identification codes. According to the urban infrastructure risk assessment method for the storm disaster chain, support is provided for dynamic emergency decision making of multi-disaster linkage by considering the infrastructure node risk caused by the storm and the secondary disasters, so that the precise infrastructure node risk pre-judgment of timing and fixed points is realized, and the establishment of specific emergency decision making and the targeted resident disaster risk prevention are facilitated.
assignees: UNIV DONGGUAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Cloud platform-based data rescuing and archiving system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data rescuing and archiving system based on a cloud platform, which relates to the technical field of data management and comprises a plurality of functional modules, a digital twin simulation module, a reinforcement learning optimization module and a data reinforcement learning optimization module, wherein the data perception and acquisition module is used for acquiring operation data in real time through deployment of edge computing nodes, the operation data comprises sensor data, service logs and historical fault data, the transmission links are encrypted by a hybrid encryption technology and are transmitted to a cloud end through a unified data interface standardization, the digital twin simulation module is used for generating a multidimensional data state vector model based on a lightweight modeling engine, dynamically updating twin body states through an integrated space-time data fusion algorithm, introducing prepositive disaster conditions of virtual-real interaction tests, simulating the execution effects of data recovery plans under different disaster conditions through a Monte Carlo method, and performing disaster spreading simulation.

title_en: Power system network attack consequence evaluation method considering switch modularization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system network attack consequence evaluation method considering switch modularization, which relates to the technical field related to power system safety protection and emergency response and comprises the following steps of carrying out modularization modeling on key switch equipment in a power system to determine functional logic and fault propagation paths of the key switch equipment; and solving the optimal attack path and generating a defending configuration scheme by simulating strategy games of an attacker and a defender. The method can more accurately simulate the influence of the network attack on the power system, is beneficial to analyzing the fragile links and key nodes of the network attack, and identifies potential network attack paths and risks, thereby providing scientific basis for the safety protection and emergency response of the power system.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Big data-based digital twin control system for port infrastructure disaster and aging management technology
title_ko: 항만 인프라 재해 및 노후화 관리기술을 위한 빅데이터 기반 디지털 트윈 관제시스템
abstract_en: The present invention is for simulating and displaying prediction of a damage occurrence situation due to a disaster occurrence and aging of a port building/facility/road/bridge. A big data-based digital twin control system for port infrastructure disaster and aging management technology includes: a port data collection part configured to integratedly manage information on a building, a road, and a bridge constituting a port; and a digital twin platform configured to implement a digital twin by an object modeling part through information data transmitted from the port data collection part, and to output as virtual modeling data of the digital twin based on structural analysis data for the port building/facility/road/bridge transmitted from a structural analysis server and aging information transmitted from the port data collection part. According to the present invention, it is possible to immediately check a degree of aging of the port infrastructure visually through a display part.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 디지털 트윈 플랫폼에 관한 것으로서, 종래 항만의 유지보수를 위해 디지털 트윈 플랫폼이 적용된 바 없었다.  
본 발명에 의한 항만 인프라 재해 및 노후화 관리기술을 위한 빅데이터 기반 디지털 트윈 관제시스템은 항만을 구성하는 건물과 도로 및 교량에 대한 정보를 통합 관리하는 항만 데이터 취합부와; 상기 항만 데이터 취합부에서 전달된 정보 데이터를 통해 객체 모델링부에 의해 디지털 트윈(Digital Twin)을 구현하고, 구조해석 서버에서 전달되는 항만건물/시설/도로/교량에 대한 구조 해석 데이터와 항만 데이터 취합부에서 전달된 노후도 정보를 기반으로 디지털 트윈의 가상 모델링 데이터로 출력하는 디지털 트윈 플랫폼을 포함하여 구성되는 디지털 트윈 관제시스템에 있어서, 구조해석 서버에서는 항만 데이터 취합부에서 전달된 정보 데이터와, 항만/도로/교량에 대한 구조 해석 데이터를 통해 각각의 잔여 수명을 연산하며, 객체 모델링부에서는 항만 데이터 취합부에서 전달된 정보 데이터에 의해 3D 또는 2D의 가상화 모델링 작업을 진행하고, 시뮬레이터부에서는 항만 데이터 취합부에서 전달된 정보 데이터를 통해 항만건물/시설/도로/교량에 대한 재해발생 및 노후화에 의한 피해발생상황 예측하며, 상태감지부에서는 상기 항만 데이터 취합부의 정보 데이터에 회득하기 위한 센서의 상태 및 고장여부를 실시간을 감시하고, 해역별 항만시설물 노후화 평가기준을 통해, 항만시설물의 재해위험도 평가 지표를 결정하여, 각 항만시설물의 환경 위험도 평가기준을 수립하여, 재해위험도 예측 프로그램을 적용하는 것을 항만 인프라 재해 및 노후화 관리기술을 위한 빅데이터 기반 디지털 트윈 관제시스템을 제안한다.  
본 발명에 의한 항만 인프라 유지관리를 위한 빅데이터 기반 디지털 트윈 관제시스템은 항만 데이터 취합부에서 전달되는 정보 데이터가 디지털 트윈 플랫폼에 전달되고, 객체 모델링부를 통해 각 구성요소에 대한 가상화 모델링 작업을 진행하며, 항만건물/시설/도로/교량의 노후도를 예측 및 시뮬레이션하여 디스플레이할 수 있으므로, 디스플레이부를 통해 시각적으로 항만 인프라의 노후도를 즉각 확인이 가능한 효과가 있다. 또한, 본 발명은 디지털 트윈 기반 시뮬레이션을 통한 재해발생 및 노후화에 의한 피해발생상황 예측 및 즉각적인 정책적 의사결정 시스템을 구축하고, 빅데이터(기본정보, 2내역/3내역 데이터 및 노후도/재해위험도 평가 데이터 등) 분석 및 가시화를 통한 항만 인프라 모니터링이 가능한 효과가 있다.
assignees: ROCKWONIT GLOBAL CO LTD

title_en: Regional bedding side slope pre-reinforcement range determining method based on limited samples
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and control engineering, and particularly relates to a regional bedding side slope pre-reinforcement range determining method based on a limited sample. The method comprises the steps of firstly, counting disaster factors of regional bedding slopes, secondly, obtaining key disaster factors and distribution conditions of the key disaster factors by adopting a gray correlation method, amplifying limited samples by Monte Carlo simulation, screening out high-risk samples by taking a stability coefficient <1.0 as a standard, obtaining a pre-reinforcing range of the bedding slopes under complex geological conditions by adopting finite element simulation, and finally, establishing a correlation between the key disaster factors of the bedding slopes and the pre-reinforcing range by adopting a data preprocessing and XGBoost machine learning method to realize a regional bedding slope pre-reinforcing range determining method based on the limited samples. The method comprises the steps of amplifying a limited sample, establishing a correlation relation between a key disaster causing factor and a pre-reinforcement range, and finally obtaining the determination of the pre-reinforcement range of other bedding slopes in the area.
assignees: SICHUAN HIGHWAY PLANNING SURVEY DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE LTD;SICHUAN ROAD & BRIDGE GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Quantum calculation embedded power grid elasticity assessment method considering all potential risks
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of analysis and evaluation of power systems, and relates to a quantum computing embedded power grid elasticity evaluation method considering all potential risks, which comprises the following steps of 1, obtaining typhoon weather disaster information possibly occurring in a future period of time; the method comprises the steps of 2, generating probability distribution based on vulnerability analysis by using typhoon early warning data information, 3, rapidly evaluating system fault risk loss under short-time rolling risk early warning, 4, performing overall process simulation evaluation on the fault risk loss, 5, judging whether a disaster-stricken line is repaired at the moment of t  k , 6, judging whether Monte Carlo simulation meets convergence conditions, and accelerating estimation of line fault probability by introducing a quantum amplitude estimation algorithm, wherein the rapid multi-scene parallel evaluation capability supported by quantum calculation is utilized, and the evaluation efficiency can be remarkably improved under the condition of ensuring consistent precision by combining dynamic repair and quantum embedding elastic evaluation processes.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: Intelligent water conservancy digital twin simulation system based on multi-source data
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent water conservancy digital twin simulation system based on multi-source data, which belongs to the technical field of digital monitoring, and aims to realize minute-level data acquisition and transmission by constructing an air-space three-dimensional sensing network and combining edge intelligent preprocessing, acquire data by utilizing sensors such as millimeter wave radar, laser radar and the like, reduce noise and identify anomalies, perform dynamic data fusion and intelligent calibration, realize data second-level alignment and trusted verification by means of a space-time calibration algorithm, kalman filtering and a block chain verification technology, establish a hybrid simulation and intelligent decision model, and realize flood evolution minute-level prediction and emergency response by adopting a physical model, a machine learning architecture and a dynamic threshold decision tree.

title_en: Power grid line emergency repair scheduling and distributing method for complex multi-constraint disaster scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid line emergency repair dispatching distribution method for a complex multi-constraint disaster scene, and belongs to the technical field of power grid emergency management. The method comprises the steps of decomposing a complex rush-repair task into a plurality of quantifiable subtasks, establishing a matrix description of task requirements and technical capability requirements, establishing a multi-dimensional technical capability assessment index system, dynamically quantifying the technical capability level of emergency personnel through assessment and scoring, establishing an assessment model based on the technical capability satisfaction rate, estimating the rush-repair man-hour by combining a Monte Carlo simulation method based on Latin hypercube sampling, carrying out team internal task allocation by using a Hungary algorithm, and optimizing the multi-team task allocation by utilizing an ant colony algorithm of multiple traveling companies by combining the rush-repair man-hour estimation. The method can effectively improve the efficiency and accuracy of emergency task allocation, improve the utilization rate of limited resources and provide technical support for rush repair work in disaster scenes.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Knowledge graph-based bad weather power grid risk identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for identifying risks of a severe weather power grid based on a knowledge graph, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of collecting multisource weather forecast data and power grid topological structure data in a target area, carrying out data cleaning and space-time calibration, fusing the weather data and power grid state data by utilizing a knowledge graph technology, generating a physical risk correlation sub-graph and a linkage risk correlation sub-graph, analyzing the physical damage risk and the fault cascade diffusion risk of power grid facilities by adopting a probability simulation method and a graph theory cascade failure analysis method respectively, determining the comprehensive risk level of a power grid, and generating a power grid risk thermodynamic diagram according to the comprehensive risk level of the power grid. The visual expression of the risk level of the power grid region is realized, and a decision basis is provided for power grid dispatching operation and pre-disaster early warning.

title_en: Earthquake geological disaster monitoring and early warning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seismic geological disaster monitoring and early warning device which comprises an intelligent sensing system, an analysis system and an execution and feedback system, wherein the intelligent sensing system is used for collecting geological parameters, facility states and environmental factors in real time through a multi-mode sensor array, the distributed optical fiber sensing and capturing pipeline strain, an MEMS accelerometer is used for monitoring vibration, an InSAR satellite is used for providing deformation data, the analysis system is used for constructing a complex network modeling engine, a directed weighting network model is used for fusing a historical transition probability matrix and real-time deformation rate parameters, the two-channel causal reasoning engine is combined, the two-channel causal reasoning engine comprises a physical causal channel and a data causal channel, the physical causal channel is embedded into a coulomb rupture criterion to calculate fault stress accumulation rate and Darcy law to simulate pore pressure propagation, the data channel is used for generating a counterfactual causal link through CausalGAN and combining a time causal convolution network to trigger hierarchical early warning based on analysis results of the analysis system.
assignees: LIAONING EARTHQUAKE ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Monte Carlo simulation method-based substation flood season safe operation risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for evaluating the safe operation risk of a transformer substation in the flood period based on a Monte Carlo simulation method, which belongs to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of power grids and comprises the steps of classifying and dividing the flood period influence factors of the transformer substation; the method comprises the steps of constructing a judgment matrix and weights according to expert scoring of key influence factors, carrying out consistency check on the judgment matrix, adjusting element values of the judgment matrix if the consistency check of the matrix does not meet preset conditions, reassigning the weights until the preset conditions are met, constructing a dynamic risk calculation model based on Monte Carlo simulation, obtaining simulation results, analyzing, judging stability of fitting degree, obtaining main risk factors and taking precautionary measures corresponding to emergency management. The method has the advantages that various factors around the transformer substation are considered into influence factors through accident tree analysis, system integration of multi-dimensional environmental factors is achieved, objectivity and comprehensiveness of transformer substation risk assessment are remarkably improved, and analysis capability of complex environmental coupling effect is enhanced.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Landslide hazard risk assessment method, landslide hazard risk assessment equipment, landslide hazard risk assessment medium and landslide hazard risk assessment product
abstract_en: The application discloses a landslide hazard risk assessment method, equipment, medium and product, and relates to the field of geological hazard risk assessment. The method comprises the steps of constructing a disaster pregnancy factor system participating in landslide disaster risk assessment, uniformly sampling a research area according to preset sampling intervals to obtain a uniform point set, respectively collecting information amounts of disaster points and uniform points in the research area to form a positive sample set and a negative sample set, constructing a landslide disaster risk assessment model based on an artificial neural network, training the model by adopting the positive sample set and the negative sample set, outputting landslide disaster occurrence probability of each sample, further calculating prediction precision and prediction density of the model, calculating a weighted cross entropy loss function based on the prediction density, and carrying out error counter-propagation until the training is completed, and carrying out landslide disaster risk assessment on an area to be assessed by utilizing the trained landslide disaster risk assessment model, so that objectivity, rationality and accuracy of the landslide disaster risk assessment can be remarkably improved.
assignees: SICHUAN INST OF LAND AND SPACE ECOLOGICAL RESTORATION AND GEOLOGICAL DISASTER PREVENTION;UNIV CHENGDU INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Novel electric power system-oriented intelligent collaborative network safety emergency response device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent collaborative network safety emergency response device and method for a novel power system, wherein the intelligent collaborative network safety emergency response device comprises an edge probe acquisition module, an intelligent analysis module and a digital twin sandbox deduction module, the edge probe acquisition module is used for capturing power communication data streams in real time, the intelligent analysis module is based on a time sequence anomaly detection algorithm and a vulnerability database, the digital twin sandbox deduction module comprises a network attack simulator, a power business influence evaluator, a strategy generator, a strategy execution module, a strategy optimization module and a man-machine collaborative module, the technical scheme can realize quick adaptation of a model through an improved dynamic weight fusion mechanism and element learning online optimization, and the requirement on annotation data is remarkably reduced.

title_en: Coastal city storm surge disaster toughness assessment method based on graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating the toughness of a storm surge disaster in an coastal city based on a graphic neural network, which is used for collecting multi-source heterogeneous data related to the storm surge disaster in the coastal city, and comprises geographic information data, infrastructure data and historical storm surge data, constructing coastal city infrastructure network structure data according to the geographic information data and the infrastructure data, then constructing a graphic neural network model, merging characteristic parameters of the historical storm surge data with the coastal city infrastructure network structure data, inputting the trained graphic neural network model, simulating the progressive influence of the storm surge disaster on coastal city infrastructure nodes, evaluating the state evolution of each node in the coastal city infrastructure network under the influence of the storm surge based on the propagation result of the graphic neural network, and respectively carrying out summarizing analysis on different functional areas based on the obtained toughness evaluation index data of each node to form an integral coastal city toughness evaluation result.

title_en: Toughness improvement method for power transmission network based on improved Bayesian optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a toughness improvement method for a power transmission network based on improved Bayesian optimization, which aims to solve the problem that the existing toughness improvement method is low in efficiency in large-scale optimization of variables. The toughness improving method comprises the steps of firstly, including a plurality of power transmission lines in a power transmission network, reinforcing the power transmission tower as a measure for improving the toughness, obtaining vulnerability curves of the power transmission towers before and after reinforcement, secondly, simulating damage scenes of the power transmission towers through Monte Carlo under each typhoon scene, wherein the power transmission lines are damaged only when one power transmission tower is damaged, thirdly, determining the reinforcing sequence of the power transmission towers, fourthly, determining the relation between the number of the power transmission tower reinforcements on each power transmission line and the annual damage exceeding probability of the power transmission lines, and fifthly, improving the toughness of the power transmission network based on Bayesian optimization. The invention integrates an improved Bayesian optimization method, realizes reinforcement optimization of a large-scale network for various complex uncertainties, and can accurately evaluate the toughness improvement strategy of the electric power system under typhoon disasters.
assignees: HARBIN INST TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Clean workshop production environment quality control method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for controlling the quality of a production environment of a clean workshop, and relates to the technical field of environmental control, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-layer sensing network, deploying temperature and humidity, particle concentration, pressure difference and VOC gas sensors, and preprocessing data by each node through edge calculation; the method comprises the steps of integrating data based on a dynamic weight distribution algorithm, adjusting weight according to confidence score to generate an environment quality comprehensive index, establishing an LSTM pollution diffusion prediction model, combining airflow field simulation to calculate a diffusion path during sudden pollution to generate an emergency response partition strategy, utilizing reinforcement learning to optimize fresh air system control parameters, establishing a dynamic ventilation frequency adjustment model based on real-time environment quality index and historical energy consumption data, minimizing energy consumption on the premise of guaranteeing cleanliness through a Q-learning algorithm, setting a double-threshold early warning mechanism, starting local pressurization purification by the comprehensive index exceeding a first-level threshold, and forming a dynamic isolation barrier by the aid of the super-second-level threshold in linkage with adjacent areas, and simulating an intervention scheme effect through a digital twin system.
assignees: GUANGDONG GUANGYIN CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Landslide early warning and monitoring method and system based on NBIOT
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and detection, in particular to a landslide early warning and monitoring method and system based on NBIOT. The method comprises the steps of collecting data including rainfall data, soil humidity data and displacement data, conducting data processing and analysis, conducting integration and time synchronization processing on the collected data, comparing the integrated data with a preset alarm threshold, triggering a local alarm mechanism when the data exceeds the preset alarm threshold, otherwise, uploading the data to a cloud, conducting cloud data processing, conducting data preprocessing and building and training a BP neural network model, conducting random initialization on weights and threshold values of the neural network, extracting historical data to serve as training sample input, conducting training on the BP neural network through a back propagation algorithm, adjusting the weights and the threshold values, adjusting network structures or parameters to meet performance requirements, and conducting landslide probability prediction through the model. According to the technical scheme, the monitoring precision and timeliness can be improved, and the early warning accuracy is improved.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Hydraulic engineering full life cycle management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic engineering full life cycle management system, which comprises a model construction module, a high-order potential energy encoder module, a tensor coupling dynamic propagation module, a potential energy trend predictor module, a risk assessment module, a feedback adjustment module, a decision support module and a model training and optimizing module, wherein the model construction module is used for constructing a tensor potential energy evolution network model, the high-order potential energy encoder module is used for generating potential energy representation of a current life cycle stage, the tensor coupling dynamic propagation module is used for capturing time sequence and space dependency relationship and generating a hidden state tensor, the potential energy trend predictor module is used for generating a potential energy predicted value at the next moment, the risk assessment module is used for triggering risk early warning and generating a risk grade, the feedback adjustment module is used for dynamically adjusting a risk threshold and tensor potential energy evolution network model parameters, the decision support module is used for providing an emergency response and resource optimizing scheme, and the model training and optimizing module is used for optimizing tensor potential energy evolution network model parameters. According to the invention, dynamic monitoring, risk prediction and early warning of hydraulic engineering are realized through the tensor potential energy evolution network model, and the management safety and accuracy are improved.
assignees: ZHICHENG SHUCHUANG XIAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-disaster risk early warning method and equipment for overhead transmission line based on analysis of disaster-pregnancy mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and equipment for early warning multiple disasters of an overhead power transmission line based on disaster pregnancy mechanism analysis, and belongs to the technical field of disaster early warning of power transmission lines. According to the method, dynamic and accurate multi-disaster early warning of the overhead transmission line is realized by constructing a disaster-tolerant mechanism model, quantifying disaster coupling effect, monte Carlo simulation and comprehensive risk assessment.
assignees: UNIV CHANGCHUN SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Quantification method and system for planning toughness improvement contribution before disaster of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quantification method and a quantification system for planning toughness improvement contribution before power distribution network disaster, which belong to the technical field of analysis of toughness improvement effectiveness of power distribution network, and the method comprises the steps of generating various disaster scenes through Latin hypercube sampling, and generating a pre-disaster reinforcement scheme of reinforcement grade based on topological structures of the power distribution network and a traffic network; the method comprises the steps of calculating fault probabilities of electric lines and traffic roads under different scenes according to disaster scene parameters to generate a fault state set, optimizing a repair team path and a repair time sequence through a post-disaster repair scheduling model, calculating post-disaster accumulated disaster damage cost, inputting data into XGBoost for training, and analyzing toughness contribution of each reinforcement action by using a SHAP method according to reinforcement planning conditions and full link cost. The method can accurately identify the reinforcement priority of the key lines in the power distribution network and the traffic network, improves the fineness and the interpretability of the pre-disaster resource allocation, can guide the accurate release of limited pre-disaster resources, and has practicability and popularization significance.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: Intelligent scheduling system for power grid safety guarantee of multi-source data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent scheduling system for power grid safety guarantee of multi-source data analysis, which comprises an air-ground sensing layer, a multi-source data fusion engine, an extreme weather decision closed loop module, a power grid immune engine and an intelligent execution terminal, wherein the air-ground sensing layer is used for collecting meteorological data, equipment state data and power grid operation data, the multi-source data fusion engine is used for carrying out space-time alignment and feature extraction on multi-source heterogeneous data to generate a power grid panoramic state matrix, the extreme weather decision closed loop module is used for deducing a disaster propagation path through federal learning based on the power grid panoramic state matrix and outputting a scheduling control instruction, the power grid immune engine is used for receiving the power grid panoramic state matrix, simulating a hidden fault chain through a digital twin body and dynamically generating a protection device correction strategy, and the intelligent execution terminal is used for executing the scheduling control instruction and the protection device correction strategy and feeding back a physical power grid state to the digital twin body. According to the invention, through multi-source data fusion and an intelligent algorithm, panoramic sensing, disaster pre-judgment, dynamic protection and strategy optimization of the power grid are realized, and the safety guarantee capability is improved.
assignees: GUONENG CHANGZHOU POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Building structure intelligent management method and system based on BIM
abstract_en: The invention relates to a building structure intelligent management method based on BIM, which comprises the following steps of dynamic monitoring factor mining and multi-modal sensing, namely collecting weather hydrology, geological conditions, micro environments and natural disaster historical data, step two, namely performing virtual-real fusion dynamic analysis driven by a nerve operator, namely converting and mapping the collected data format into a BIM model, integrating a virtual-real synchronous engine, pre-training a Fourier nerve operator through real-time displacement and strain data reverse calibration model boundary conditions in a construction stage, establishing a direct mapping relation between external load and structure response, step three, namely performing multi-modal data cooperation and hierarchical authority interaction, namely forming a multi-dimensional feature matrix through time stamp and space coordinate association, step four, namely performing multi-modal graph convolutional network damage identification, namely extracting damage sensitive features through dynamic association among nodes of a self-adaptive graph convolutional layer, and step five, performing dynamic life early warning of digital twin driving, namely predicting residual service life of a structure.
assignees: UNIV SHAOYANG;HUNAN NATURAL RESOURCES SURVEY INST

title_en: Cooperative control method for distributed nodes and power grid through full-dimensional perception
abstract_en: The invention provides a cooperative control method of a distributed node and a power grid of full-dimensional perception, and relates to the technical field of power grid control. The method is based on innovative means such as a full-dimensional sensing system, a layered hybrid management and control architecture, combination of an improved genetic algorithm and deep reinforcement learning, digital twin simulation verification, TSN technology, disaster recovery mechanism and the like, and the power grid state is monitored in real time by deploying multi-dimensional sensing equipment, the layered hybrid management and control architecture is constructed to achieve global strategy formulation and local rapid regulation, the improved genetic algorithm and the deep reinforcement learning are used for multi-objective optimization, the digital twin simulation verification regulation scheme is introduced, the TSN technology is adopted to ensure hard and real-time transmission of key data, the disaster recovery mechanism and standardized interfaces are designed to improve the reliability and compatibility of the system, and the problems that in the prior art, the data confidence assessment is insufficient, the communication mechanism is imperfect, the cloud server is excessively dependent, the multi-objective optimization effect is poor and the like are effectively solved.
assignees: SHENZHEN DINGSHENGFENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent decision method for blocking-resistant aging emergency material transportation toughness based on chaotic annealing ant colony
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent decision method for blocking-resistant aging emergency material transportation toughness based on a chaotic annealing ant colony, and relates to the technical field of intelligent emergency scheduling and optimization. The method comprises the steps of firstly extracting scene data and converting the scene data into model parameters, secondly constructing a mathematical model with optimized survivability, thirdly initializing algorithm parameters and generating an initial path, fourthly dynamically adjusting the temperature and the volatilization rate of the pheromone, fifthly generating an anti-blocking perception path and implementing bypass restoration, sixthly updating the pheromone distribution based on an annealing criterion, and seventhly locking a key path and outputting an optimal transportation scheme. The method can ensure the timely delivery of materials in the complex road network blocking and sudden demand scene, improves the timeliness and toughness of the emergency transportation system through a chaotic annealing mechanism and an anti-blocking simulation technology, can be widely applied to the fields of natural disaster rescue, public health event response and the like, and provides scientific basis for emergency decision.
assignees: UNIV BEIHANG

title_en: Urban power grid post-disaster two-stage recovery method and system based on star-ground fusion communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster two-stage recovery method and a post-disaster recovery system for an urban power grid based on satellite-ground fusion communication, which relate to the field of post-disaster recovery of power grids, wherein in the first stage, an available post-disaster recovery time sequence of satellite communication is output through a real-time simulation result of a channel state of a post-disaster recovery period of low-orbit satellite communication; in the second stage, the coupling relation between information interaction and time sequence recovery of the power network and the information network under the star-ground fusion communication is considered, an optimization model is established to solve the post-disaster optimal recovery strategy under the satellite usable boundary, and the post-disaster efficient recovery of the urban power network under the star-ground fusion communication driving is realized. The invention considers the time-varying simulation condition of the low-orbit satellite communication during the post-disaster recovery, and also considers the complex coupling relation between the urban power grid information and the physical system and the restoration logic, thereby being beneficial to guiding the reasonable and efficient recovery of the urban power grid based on the satellite-ground fusion communication after encountering an extreme natural disaster and improving the toughness of the urban power system.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: Power system training management method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power system research and discloses an electric power system training management method, an electric power system training management system, an electric power system training management device and a storage medium, wherein the electric power system training management method comprises the steps of obtaining first operation data and first operation data; the method comprises the steps of generating a dynamic three-dimensional simulation training environment according to first operation data, linking the first operation data with the dynamic three-dimensional simulation training environment, constructing a first learning evaluation model, and generating a personalized learning path based on the cooperative action of an analysis mechanism and the first learning evaluation model. The dynamic fault propagation modeling and real-time operation feedback mechanism can truly simulate the running state of a power grid, is matched with a personalized learning recommendation function, can greatly improve the operation skills and emergency response capability of students, and has outstanding practical value and popularization prospect.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD TALENT DEV CENTER

title_en: Digital twinning-based power grid real-time optimal scheduling system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based power grid real-time optimal scheduling system and method, and relates to the technical field of power grid scheduling. The environmental parameters of the key nodes are collected in real time through deployment of sensors, a dynamic environmental condition coefficient is constructed, the power grid state is analyzed by combining the frequency stability and the relative strength index, a multi-model fusion prediction mechanism is built, and space-time double-dimension accurate prediction of load and power generation is realized. And a multi-objective optimization model is adopted, new energy consumption maximization and scheduling cost minimization are taken as core targets, a genetic algorithm is introduced to solve an optimal scheduling scheme, and a digital twin model is combined to forward simulation screening of a feasible solution. And the scheduling strategy is dynamically adjusted through abnormal early warning triggering, environment association degree analysis and model iterative optimization, so that the power supply efficiency and emergency response capability under an extreme scene are improved. The method effectively fuses multi-source heterogeneous data, and achieves real-time sensing of the running state of the power grid, collaborative optimization of multi-energy resources and self-adaptive iteration of a scheduling model.

title_en: Network public opinion intelligent classification and emergency decision system based on multi-mode fusion and dynamic evolution
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent classification and emergency decision system of network public opinion based on multi-mode fusion and dynamic evolution, belonging to the field of network public opinion monitoring, big data analysis and artificial intelligence. The system comprises a multi-source data acquisition and preprocessing module, a multi-dimensional classification engine module, a logic atlas construction and anomaly detection module, a stakeholder dynamic risk assessment module, an intelligent decision and emergency response module, a benefit correlator dynamic risk assessment module, a benefit decision and emergency response module and a classification response module, wherein the multi-source data acquisition and preprocessing module is used for crawling multi-mode data, constructing a propagation path atlas after preprocessing, identifying key propagation nodes, the multi-dimensional classification engine module is used for carrying out conflict intensity quantification on public opinion events, dynamically updating a rule thesaurus and keeping the adaptability of a conflict intensity quantification model, the logic atlas construction and anomaly detection module is used for constructing a public opinion propagation path and public opinion event commonality logic chain mode, monitoring the public opinion propagation speed and giving an alarm, the benefit correlator dynamic risk assessment module is used for carrying out fine classification on a network public opinion participation main body, providing basis for differentiation propagation intervention, simulating public opinion evolution and carrying out risk simulation, and the intelligent decision and emergency response module is used for executing emergency measures of different levels based on risk indexes according to a classification response strategy.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING POSTS & TELECOM

title_en: Universal wind speed prediction method and device for real-time typhoon rapid early warning
abstract_en: The invention provides a universal wind speed prediction method and device for rapid early warning of a typhoon in real time, and relates to the technical field of natural disaster early warning. The method comprises the steps of carrying out typhoon data analysis according to coastal city information and typhoon history information based on a simulated circle method to obtain typhoon basic information, carrying out model construction according to the typhoon basic information based on a mathematical statistics inference method to obtain a parameter probability distribution model, carrying out random sample generation according to the parameter probability distribution model by using a Monte Carlo method to obtain a first training data set, carrying out optimization training on a universal wind speed prediction model to be trained by using the first training data set and typhoon real-time information based on a dynamic elite retention strategy to obtain the universal wind speed prediction model to be optimized. The invention relates to a high-efficiency and accurate general wind speed prediction method based on a GA-BP neural network and a dynamic elite retention strategy.

title_en: Multi-mode traffic network robustness calculation method under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-mode traffic network robustness calculation method under typhoon disasters, which comprises the steps of constructing an inter-city public traffic network comprising a plurality of traffic modes, generating an air pressure attenuation model and a typhoon continuous influence model by combining space-time dynamic characteristics of the typhoon disasters, calculating failure probability distribution and state of the inter-city public traffic network under the typhoon disasters based on a system vulnerability curve and a Monte Carlo simulation method, establishing a traffic network cascade failure model according to the failure probability distribution and state of the inter-city public traffic network under the typhoon disasters, simulating the structure and function loss process of traffic network sites and lines under the disaster conditions, designing a traffic network robustness index calculation system, and quantifying the performance change of the inter-city public traffic network from two aspects of topological structures and service functions. The invention can accurately quantify the influence of typhoon disasters on a traffic system.

title_en: Real-time earthquake motion numerical prediction method fusing fracture directivity effect
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of real-time earthquake disaster early warning of earthquake engineering, in particular to a real-time earthquake motion numerical prediction method fusing fracture directivity effect, which carries out filtering and baseline correction on a real-time observation strong vibration waveform of an earthquake table network, corrects the ground earthquake motion waveform to a bedrock site by using an empirical site effect correction model, then converts the corrected acceleration record into energy parameters, and generating a meshed bedrock seismic energy field through Kerling space interpolation, simulating a seismic energy space-time propagation process based on an RTT model by utilizing a Monte Carlo method, and obtaining a predicted seismic energy field with a plurality of time steps.
assignees: INST ENG MECH CHINA EARTHQUAKE ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Transformer fire risk detection method and device and readable storage medium
