abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of electric power systems, and relates to a method and a device for detecting the fire risk of a transformer and a readable storage medium, wherein the method and the device are used for acquiring the operation parameters of all parts in the transformer, and acquiring the characteristic parameters of all parts in the transformer, the combustion thermodynamic characteristic parameters of combustible substances in the transformer and the load data of all parts of the transformer under the combustion thermodynamic characteristic parameters of the combustible substances based on the type and the voltage level of the transformer; the method comprises the steps of constructing a three-dimensional model of the transformer based on operation parameters and characteristic parameters of all components in the transformer, gridding the three-dimensional model of the transformer to obtain a three-dimensional grid model of the transformer, dynamically simulating the three-dimensional grid model of the transformer based on load data of all components of the transformer under the combustion mechanical characteristic parameters of combustible substances to output fire risk indexes of all components in the transformer, and calculating the fire risk indexes of the transformer to be detected based on the fire risk indexes of all components and fire risk propagation coefficients among all components.
assignees: STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD EHV COMPANY;STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Drainage basin hydrologic prediction method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a watershed hydrologic prediction method based on digital twinning, which comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source heterogeneous data, processing the multi-source heterogeneous data to obtain a multi-source data set, constructing a multi-dimensional space feature set according to the multi-source data set, simulating a hydrologic cycle process by adopting a finite volume method based on the multi-dimensional space feature set, obtaining a hydrologic cycle simulation result, obtaining an error value of the hydrologic cycle simulation result and actual observation data, carrying out nonlinear relation mining on the multi-dimensional space feature set by a neural network algorithm based on the error value to obtain a data driving prediction result, fusing the hydrologic cycle simulation result and the data driving prediction result by adopting a weighted fusion algorithm to obtain a fusion prediction result, constructing a digital twinning model based on the digital twinning model according to the fusion prediction result, and predicting the hydrologic state in real time. The invention can provide more effective decision support for water resource management and flood control and disaster reduction.
assignees: UNIV LANZHOU JIAOTONG

title_en: BIM-based pumping and storing station building foundation dangerous point management and control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a BIM-based system for managing and controlling basic dangerous points of a pumping and storing power station building, which comprises a data layer, an application layer, a model layer, a data layer and a disaster development path simulation layer, wherein the data layer organizes linear engineering monitoring data into a high-order tensor of 'pile number x time x sensor type x space position' by utilizing four-dimensional tensor modeling, dynamically identifies a strain rate mutation point in a compression process by combining sliding window anomaly detection and directly stores original data by utilizing a Tucker decomposition, and then implements a layered storage strategy on non-mutated data by utilizing a data value evaluation model driven by deep reinforcement learning, the model layer is used for fusing a physical information neural network, embedding a geotechnical constitutive equation into an LSTM network to construct a mixed loss function, combining project data to carry out small sample fine adjustment after pre-training a universal geological model by migration learning, and dynamically generating a dangerous source list and triggering instant early warning by utilizing a BIM model based on the output of the data layer, and simulating a disaster development path by combining a digital twin technology.
assignees: POWERCHINA HUADONG ENGINEERING CORP LTD

title_en: Digital twin airport oil depot based emergency drilling evaluation system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of digital twin technology and emergency management systems, and particularly relates to an emergency drilling evaluation system and method based on a digital twin airport oil depot. According to the multi-dimensional evaluation index system constructed by the comprehensive analysis and evaluation module based on the digital twin airport oil depot emergency exercise evaluation system and the method, the exercise effect is quantitatively evaluated from multiple aspects such as emergency response speed, resource utilization efficiency, loss control degree and the like by combining an analytic hierarchy process and a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, various problems in the exercise process can be deeply analyzed, the generated evaluation report not only contains detailed problem analysis, but also provides a targeted improvement suggestion, and meanwhile, historical data and industry standards can be compared, so that evaluation is more scientific and accurate, and powerful support is provided for emergency management decisions.
assignees: NANJING AIRPORT OIL CO LTD

title_en: Urban public safety intelligent emergency command method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban public safety intelligent emergency command method, which relates to the technical field of urban public safety and comprises the following steps of constructing a multi-source perception network in advance to collect fire data in real time, wherein the fire data at least comprises smoke concentration, temperature change and flame images, calculating a fire risk value in real time and triggering early warning based on a multi-source data fusion and early warning analysis model, predicting the occurrence probability of a fire by using a Bayesian network model, simulating the fire spreading trend and speed, scheduling emergency resources based on a multi-target optimization model, and performing post-disaster assessment. According to the invention, the analytic hierarchy process is adopted to fuse multi-source data and calculate weights, the Bayesian network model is used for predicting fire probability, the improved CellularAutomata model is constructed to simulate the spreading trend, the multi-target optimization model is combined to schedule emergency resources, the risk quantitative evaluation and the accurate resource configuration are realized, and decision bias and resource waste caused by experience judgment are avoided.
assignees: ANHUI COMMUNICATIONS SERVICES CO LTD

title_en: Disaster evaluation device, disaster evaluation method, and program
abstract_en: The present invention provides a disaster evaluation device, etc. that make it possible to comprehensively evaluate the status of restoration associated with the occurrence of a disaster. A disaster evaluation device according to the present invention is configured to: perform simulations, in response to the occurrence of a disaster, of the status of damage individually in relation to a plurality of types of events due to the disaster; convert data indicating the status of damage as the results of the simulations into data indicating a common social value; evaluate changes in the social value due to the disaster on the basis of the plurality of items of converted data; and recommend one or more countermeasures to the plurality of types of events on the basis of the degrees of decrease in the social value due to the evaluated disaster. The disaster evaluation device should perform simulations of the status of restoration from the disaster in relation to the plurality of types of events on the basis of received restoration plan information, should convert the data indicating the status of restoration into data indicating the common social value, and should evaluate changes in the social value due to restoration from the disaster on the basis of the plurality of items of converted data.
assignees: NEC CORP;UNIV TOHOKU;NEC SOLUTION INNOVATORS LTD

title_en: Hydraulic engineering data intelligent monitoring method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent monitoring method and system for hydraulic engineering data based on digital twinning, which comprehensively considers the actual physical structure, operation parameters and surrounding environment information of hydraulic engineering when a hydraulic engineering digital twinning model is constructed, breaks the limitation that the traditional monitoring means only pay attention to a single parameter or a few parameters, utilizes model associated data and visual display, enables management staff to visually check the state and parameter change of each part, improves the monitoring efficiency and the comprehensiveness, solves the limitation that the traditional monitoring means lacks effective analysis and excavation, adopts a risk assessment formula to convert the data into risk indexes, enables the management staff to intuitively know the safety condition, combines the model to simulate and analyze the risk development trend and the result when the risk assessment value exceeds the threshold value, finds out problems and risks in advance, triggers early warning, enables related staff to formulate corresponding measures according to the simulation result, such as adjusting flood discharge flow, reinforcing structures and the like, reduces disaster loss, and improves the safety and reliability of the hydraulic engineering.
assignees: ZHONGTOU DECHUANG CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Urban fire hazard early warning analysis method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for urban fire hazard early warning analysis based on big data, which relate to the technical field of disaster early warning and comprise the steps of initializing Gaussian kernel functions and bandwidth parameters of KDE based on characteristic dimensions, constructing quenching functions and coupling parameters as constraints by combining GIS information, and calculating the simulated defect density, calculating the actual critical index and the standardized deviation by combining the time sequence, constructing a thermal diffusion equation, solving by a two-stage constant-proximity method, generating a space-time risk field, and calculating a risk propagation speed field. According to the method, through a multi-index clustering method combining entropy weight and kernel density, risk identification precision of high-dimensional heterogeneous data is improved, an odd-symmetry abnormal point identification mechanism is constructed, accuracy and stability of abnormal point identification are improved, a thermal diffusion equation is constructed, a space-time risk field is generated through solving by a two-stage constant-proximity method, dynamic evolution display of urban fire risks is achieved, and early warning response efficiency is improved.

title_en: Accident scenario construction method and system for accident scenario construction
abstract_en: The invention discloses an accident scenario construction method and a system for accident scenario construction, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out accident data acquisition and data preprocessing on disaster-bearing objects, respectively extracting common features and individual features, generating a space-time aligned feature vector matrix, loading the feature vector matrix in real time to generate a space-time synchronous digital twin body, carrying out accident process mechanism analysis on the disaster-bearing objects, determining disaster-causing factors possibly causing accidents, adopting reinforcement learning algorithm to simulate accident evolution paths, generating scenario construction element model libraries required by accident scenarios of the disaster-bearing objects, collecting risk data and emergency preparation data of the disaster-bearing objects, and carrying out accident scenario construction by matching with the element model libraries. By effectively integrating the multi-source data, the authenticity of the constructed accident scene is effectively ensured, and meanwhile, the constructed accident scene is more targeted and applicable by adopting a dynamic deduction mode.
assignees: CHENGDU CITY SAFETY AND EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Infrastructure cascade failure prediction method and system for flood disaster scenario construction
abstract_en: The invention provides an infrastructure cascade failure prediction method and system for constructing flood disaster situations, which comprise the steps of constructing extreme storm flood disaster situations by using a numerical simulation method, constructing independent network topologies of traffic infrastructures, power infrastructures and communication infrastructures, analyzing cascade relations and disaster propagation mechanisms of the power-communication-traffic infrastructures under extreme storm impact, constructing a third-order network model of urban key infrastructure cascade failure, wherein the third-order network model comprises the third-order network topology model, the extreme storm flood model, the disaster propagation model and the cascade failure model, setting infrastructure failure conditions according to the submerged water depth of the urban infrastructure affected by the extreme storm, and performing infrastructure node failure prediction, independent infrastructure network failure prediction and urban key infrastructure cascade failure prediction. The invention can predict the cascade failure of the infrastructure.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Intelligent algorithm-based high-voltage transmission line safety assessment method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system safety, and discloses a high-voltage transmission line safety assessment method based on an intelligent algorithm; the method comprises the steps of constructing a database through multi-source data acquisition and fusion processing, analyzing the relevance of meteorological conditions and an icing formation mechanism by using a deep learning model, excavating an evolution rule of the correlation, carrying out multi-scene simulation and sensitivity analysis by combining physical characteristics and topographic information of a power transmission line, and establishing a line icing risk partition assessment system. According to the method, the mechanical strength and the ice coating thickness critical value of a circuit are calculated based on a mechanical model, a grading early warning threshold standard is formulated, a time sequence prediction algorithm and a risk propagation model are constructed to realize intelligent early warning, and an anti-icing resource optimal allocation and self-adaptive generation of a deicing scheme are adopted to form an anti-icing strategy. The invention effectively improves the capacity of the high-voltage transmission line for resisting ice coating disasters and enhances the safe and stable operation level of the power grid.

title_en: Railway intelligent construction site safety penetration type management messenger platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a railway intelligent construction site safety penetration type management messenger platform which comprises a multi-mode data fusion processing module, an edge computing node cluster, a three-dimensional visual penetration type management interface, an intelligent early warning and emergency response module, a self-adaptive network transmission module and the like, wherein the multi-mode data fusion processing module integrates various data, a dynamic data calibration algorithm is utilized to realize real-time cleaning, alignment and association analysis, and break a data island, the edge computing node cluster performs localized preprocessing and the like on the data in a key area to reduce the load of a central server, the three-dimensional visual interface supports drilling type viewing based on a digital twin construction model to realize three-dimensional monitoring, the intelligent early warning system adopts a reinforced learning model to automatically trigger multi-channel early warning, and the self-adaptive network transmission module dynamically switches communication modes to ensure low-delay transmission of the key data. The platform realizes the real-time collection and integration of the construction site data, and reduces the manual intervention.
assignees: HUATIE SHANDONG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD;CHINA RAILWAY NO 10 ENG GROUP CO LTD;CHINA RAILWAY TEN BUREAU GROUP EIGHTH ENG COMPANY;CR10G ELECTRIC ENG CO LTD

title_en: Mine safety training method and system based on digital twin and virtual reality
abstract_en: The invention provides a mine safety training method and system based on digital twin and virtual reality, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring laser scanning point cloud and geological exploration data of an underground roadway of a mine, and constructing a high-precision virtual underground environment model based on the data; based on the virtual underground environment model, combining explosion condition judgment, triggering disaster simulation, generating a virtual training environment by using a real-time rendering and dynamic labeling technology, acquiring operation behavior data of training personnel in the virtual training environment, evaluating the operation behavior data to obtain a behavior evaluation result, constructing and training an evaluation model by using machine learning based on the behavior evaluation result and environment parameter change data, and generating customized training contents by combining geological conditions and mining process characteristics of different mining areas. The method can construct a high-restoration-degree virtual scene, solves the problem of single traditional training scene, realizes quantitative evaluation of training effect, and improves training pertinence and effectiveness.
assignees: HSIKWANG SHAN TWINKLING STAR CO LTD;HUNAN INST TRAFFIC ENG

title_en: Three-dimensional visual emergency management system for mining area
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mining area emergency management, and discloses a three-dimensional visual emergency management system for a mining area, which comprises a data acquisition module and a three-dimensional sand table generation module. The three-dimensional sand table generation module processes the data through a three-dimensional visualization engine, wherein a data preprocessing unit completes space coordinate system unification, missing data complementation and outlier correction, and a scene rendering unit generates a three-dimensional dynamic sand table through texture mapping, space feature fusion, space coupling modeling and three-dimensional scene synthesis. The system has the functional modules of offline data loading, disaster diffusion simulation, escape route planning and the like, and supports cross-platform rendering and user interaction operation. According to the invention, three-dimensional dynamic display and emergency analysis of multi-source data of a mining area are realized, and the accuracy and timeliness of disaster early warning and emergency decision are improved.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA ANBANG SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Coal mine dynamic disaster hydraulic fracturing optimization method based on global model segmentation
abstract_en: The invention provides a coal mine dynamic disaster hydraulic fracturing optimization method based on global model segmentation, which comprises the steps of global model and stress result generation, sub-model cutting and stress inheritance, drilling parameterization information modification, fracture randomness simulation, loading injection pressure and fracturing fluid material parameters, high-precision structural grid division, stress cloud image and data extraction generated by an operation model, digital twin body construction, AI proxy model training and optimization decision, optimized drilling parameter generation, parameter feedback and iterative optimization. According to the hydraulic fracturing control method, the crack expansion process is simulated, the injection pressure and the fracturing fluid parameters are intelligently optimized, the hydraulic fracturing process is accurately controlled, the hydraulic fracturing rock burst prevention and control capacity is improved through intelligent and dynamic optimization, the rock burst risk is effectively reduced, and the prevention and control effect and the resource exploitation safety are improved.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Coal mine dynamic disaster drilling and blasting optimization method based on sub-model stress inheritance
abstract_en: The invention provides a coal mine dynamic disaster drilling and blasting optimization method based on sub-model stress inheritance, which comprises the steps of global model and stress result generation, sub-model cutting and stress inheritance, drilling parameterization information modification, TNT explosive parameter modeling, JWL state equation loading, high-precision structural grid division, operation model generation stress cloud image and data extraction, digital twin body construction, AI proxy model training and optimization decision, optimized drilling parameter generation, parameter feedback and iterative optimization. According to the invention, by constructing a digital twin body coupled with a global-local model, extracting the blasting stress response, establishing an AI proxy model by combining a deep neural network, carrying out dynamic decision and closed-loop optimization on key factors such as blasting drilling arrangement, explosive parameters and the like, a dynamic and accurate blasting pressure relief prevention and control scheme is provided, the blasting pressure relief effect and rock burst prevention and control capability are effectively improved, and a safe, efficient and intelligent technical support is provided for rock burst disaster prevention and control.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Stay wire space safety early warning method based on three-dimensional topographic data
abstract_en: The invention provides a stay wire space safety pre-warning method based on three-dimensional topographic data, and relates to the technical field of power transmission line construction safety. The method comprises the steps of obtaining point cloud, combining a BIM model to complete three-dimensional coordinate fusion, constructing a multi-body dynamics and finite element model, calculating tension and safety coefficients, extracting minimum distance between a stay wire and an obstacle by adopting a hierarchical bounding box method, collecting tension and gesture by using a key position layout sensor, fusing simulation and actual measurement data, estimating a structural state by Kalman filtering, evaluating a safety level, giving early warning and adjustment advice, displaying a stress vector and a risk thermodynamic diagram on a three-dimensional platform, establishing a real-time monitoring mechanism, an abnormal automatic pushing scheme, and constructing a fault tree and a Bayesian network to identify disaster factors and fault paths. The invention realizes the integrated assessment of the wire pulling space and the stress safety, improves the detection precision and the intelligent early warning capability, and is suitable for multiple scenes of iron tower construction and operation and maintenance.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;YANCHENG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Land degradation area vegetation restoration planning method based on AI image recognition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of land degradation restoration, and discloses a land degradation area vegetation restoration planning method based on AI image recognition, which integrates multi-source data such as satellite remote sensing, unmanned aerial vehicle, weather station, soil sensor and the like, generates a composite environment grid with unified space-time reference through a space-time diagram convolution network, extracts drought and heavy rain precursor characteristics, and predicts disaster probability by utilizing a space-time converter model; dividing a degraded area and a non-degraded area by UNet, embedding a 3-PG vegetation growth model in UNet, constructing a vegetation type library by combining meteorological areas, outputting planting parameters, carrying out regression optimization and verification through a Gaussian process, constructing a vegetation knowledge map by integrating multi-source data and logistics data, generating a restoration scheme through a graphic neural network, constructing a digital twin body based on a Unity engine, simulating the feasibility of the vegetation growth verification scheme, and updating model parameters by combining unmanned plane data through a set Kalman filter. The method realizes the precision and dynamic optimization of repair planning through the AI technology.
assignees: YANTAI LAND RESERVE AND UTILIZATION CENTER YANTAI MINERAL RESOURCES RESERVE CENTER YANTAI GEOLOGICAL

title_en: Method and device for constructing power grid icing scene library
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid icing disaster prediction, in particular to a power grid icing situation library construction method and device, comprising the steps of obtaining predetermined icing influence factor corresponding historical data and icing intensity historical data; the method comprises the steps of taking a group of preset ice coating influence factor corresponding historical data and ice coating intensity historical data as an ice coating scene, clustering all ice coating scenes, constructing a clustering cluster into an ice coating scene Jing Ku, taking the clustering center of the clustering cluster as scene description of the ice coating scene Jing Ku, generating different ice coating scenes by adopting a Monte Carlo simulation algorithm, classifying all the ice coating scenes, and adding the classified ice coating scenes to corresponding ice coating scenes Jing Ku. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, the power grid icing condition Jing Ku based on the artificial intelligence algorithm is established, the double breakthrough of the terrain quantization precision and the system dynamic property is realized, and the comprehensiveness, the accuracy and the practicability of the icing condition Jing Ku are improved.
assignees: STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER ENGINEERING RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Enterprise climate risk prevention and control system applying big data and artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of enterprise climate risk prevention and control, and provides an enterprise climate risk prevention and control system applying big data and artificial intelligence, which comprises a multi-source climate data acquisition module, a satellite, a ground station and enterprise Internet of things data are integrated through federal learning; the system comprises an enterprise asset digital twin module, an AI risk prediction engine, a dynamic risk assessment module, a self-adaptive response decision module, a hierarchical early warning and linkage insurance platform, wherein the enterprise asset digital twin module integrates BIM/GIS to construct a dynamic asset model, the AI risk prediction engine adopts a space-time convolutional neural network to analyze weather-asset relevance, combines physical simulation with generation of an countermeasure network quantification physical/transformation risk, the dynamic risk assessment module generates a risk thermodynamic diagram and calculates a supply chain interruption probability, and the self-adaptive response decision module outputs a hierarchical early warning and links the insurance platform to trigger automatic claim settlement. The system verifies the credibility of the data through the blockchain, utilizes the edge computing nodes to realize local disaster recovery decision when the network is interrupted, forms a closed loop control mechanism of 'monitoring-predicting-evaluating-responding-optimizing', and solves the problems of data island, responding delay and unknown risk prediction in the traditional scheme.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG WANLI

title_en: Flood disaster evolution method and system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of digital twinning, in particular to a flood disaster evolution method and system based on digital twinning technology, the method comprises the steps of collecting all point cloud data of river basin topography, constructing a three-dimensional topography model, obtaining reflection intensity and elevation data of each point cloud, clustering all point clouds corresponding to the ground, and recording the area where the ground in each cluster corresponds to all point clouds as each local area; calculating a coplanar characterization value, an erosion evaluation value, a destabilization risk value, a soil fixation evaluation value and a terrain evolution factor of each local area, constructing a digital twin simulation platform of river basin terrain by combining a three-dimensional terrain model, and carrying out simulation on flood disasters. The application can avoid the defect that the static terrain model cannot respond to the terrain evolution caused by the flood disaster, effectively reduce the simulation error generated by the digital twin simulation platform in the flood disaster evolution process, and improve the accuracy of risk assessment on the flood disaster.

title_en: Digital twin of thermal power plant operation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of digital twin and energy industry intellectualization, and relates to a digital twin system for a three-dimensional running state of a thermal power plant, which solves the technical problems of island, visual deletion and prediction hysteresis of the traditional running data. The system builds a multi-source data fusion-dynamic physical deduction-virtual-real interaction control system, wherein a multi-source data fusion engine breaks through a DCS/SIS barrier to achieve 20 ten thousand+data points/second millisecond synchronization, a GPU drives a VFX Graph particle system and an LOD rendering technology to achieve 90fps@4K smoke flow simulation on RTX 4080, and an AR instruction is directly connected with a PLC to build a virtual-real bidirectional control chain to form a closed loop of monitoring-deduction-intervention. The key indexes are that the fault early warning is more than or equal to 72h, the fault positioning is 0.5 h/time, the data delay is less than or equal to 10ms, and the model precision is +/-2 cm. And adopting an edge-cloud cooperative architecture, and performing lightweight deployment on the Unity model. The actual measurement of the Beijing energy Chifeng power plant is that the emergency response is shortened to 4.3 minutes from 26 minutes, and an innovative paradigm foundation for 'predictive intervention' driving is laid for the digitization of thermal power.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA HUIBO TECH ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for identifying generation and influence of sudden natural disaster fault scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for identifying generation and influence of sudden natural disaster fault scenes, belonging to the technical field of disaster risk assessment and toughness modeling of an electric power system; the method comprises the steps of calculating damage probability of each node by combining with the geographical coordinates of the nodes, generating an initial fault set by using a Monte Carlo sampling method, defining a node state vector, performing fault cascade propagation simulation until the node state vector reaches a stable state, respectively identifying an electric power failure area, a communication uncontrolled area and a traffic blocking area, and outputting the initial fault set, the stable state and the three areas together as simulated disaster scene samples to finish identification. The invention solves the problems of difficult multi-network cascade fault propagation and system interruption identification under the influence of complex disasters, supports the automatic generation of samples and the accurate identification of disaster influence areas, provides data support for the follow-up, and can be used for the evaluation of multi-network fusion and resource scheduling.

title_en: Power grid dispatching training method and system based on panoramic digital twin simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid dispatching training method and system based on panoramic digital twin simulation, which relates to the technical field of power grid dispatching training, and comprises the steps of integrating a power grid topological structure, equipment operation data and historical fault data, constructing a three-level dynamic simulation model of equipment level, station level and regional level, based on acquired real-time operation data, after the data are subjected to dimension reduction and anomaly detection, the parameters and the states of the three-level dynamic simulation model are updated, the updated model is utilized to drive simulation, disaster scenes are generated by combining power flow analysis, load prediction and stability assessment, cognitive process data are collected, quantitative analysis is performed by combining preset assessment indexes, and personalized training feedback is generated. The invention highly restores the running state of the power grid, improves the data accuracy, enriches the training content, enhances the training effect, improves the capability of a dispatcher to cope with complex situations, breaks the regional limitation and improves the training efficiency and the resource utilization rate.
assignees: HUANENG LIANCHENG POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Pre-disaster preventive island division method and system for constrained spectrum clustering power transmission system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pre-disaster preventive island division method and system for a constrained spectrum clustering power transmission system, which are used for acquiring power grid data comprising grid frame data, unit parameters, load data and typhoon path parameters, and calculating the maximum wind speed radius of typhoons by adopting a Holland wind field model based on the acquired power grid data And Holland B parameters Then calculating the wind speed of each node of the power grid, and obtaining the maximum wind speed radius of typhoons The method comprises the steps of calculating the fault probability of a power transmission line and a tower by wind speed of each node of a power grid, simulating cascading faults caused by single line faults to generate a high-probability fault scene set, calculating a risk index RI, carrying out fuzzy classification, outputting a risk grade, and executing preventive island division when the risk grade exceeds a set threshold value. Three cascade control of data-driven evaluation, dynamic risk decision-constrained spectral clustering isolation is adopted, so that the technical pain points of pre-disaster defense deficiency and island division rough in extreme weather are overcome, and core support is provided for the elastic power grid.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHAANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Multi-source data disaster prediction and simulation method based on AI and digital twin
abstract_en: The application provides an AI and digital twin-based multi-source data disaster prediction and simulation method, which relates to the technical field of intelligent emergency management and comprises the steps of preprocessing multi-source heterogeneous data through an edge computing node to output a standardized data set; the method comprises the steps of generating a disaster prediction result through an AI disaster prediction model based on a standardized data set, combining the disaster prediction result with a digital twin model to form a disaster simulation, generating a rescue scheme report based on the disaster prediction result and the disaster simulation, and analyzing the rescue scheme report to form an optimal scheme.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU HUALIANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster prevention strategy determination method, device, equipment and medium for main-distribution network
abstract_en: The application discloses a disaster prevention strategy determination method, device, equipment and medium of a main-distribution network, relating to the technical field of power system elasticity evaluation and comprising the steps of determining a target topology model of a system based on a preset island balance strategy and topology information of the main network and the distribution network in a power system with the cooperation of the main-distribution network; the method comprises the steps of carrying out random fault scene generation based on a preset improved Monte Carlo algorithm, carrying out trend analysis and cascading fault simulation analysis of a fault scene based on a fault generation result and a target topology model, analyzing fault coupling conditions of a main-distribution network based on a fault scene analysis result, a system collapse threshold and a seepage theory, determining a critical threshold curve in a two-dimensional failure space, and determining a criticality index corresponding to each component in the main-distribution network and a comprehensive toughness evaluation index of the system based on the critical threshold curve to determine a target disaster prevention strategy. The application can identify critical conditions of the cooperative failure of the main-distribution network and identify weak links of the system, thereby enhancing the resistance of the system.
assignees: STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER CO;INST ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCES STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Environment-adaptive corn emasculation period disease and pest green prevention and control system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent agriculture and green plant protection, and discloses a system and a method for controlling plant diseases and insect pests in a corn emasculation period based on environmental adaptation, wherein the control system comprises an environmental simulation unit, a plant diseases and insect pests simulation database, a predictive analysis module, an early warning decision module and an acquisition unit, according to the invention, by constructing a nonlinear mapping model of five-dimensional environment vectors (temperature, humidity, illumination intensity, rainfall and wind speed) and pest activities and adopting multiple regression analysis and Monte Carlo simulation, pest occurrence probability distribution under different climatic situations is generated, the limitation of a single threshold model is effectively overcome, and the prediction reliability under a complex environment is obviously enhanced; the method can early warn the outbreak risk of the plant diseases and insect pests by 72 hours in advance, reduce disaster loss by at least 30%, reduce the dosage of chemical pesticides by more than 40% through a grading green prevention and control strategy, and protect the biological diversity of farmlands and the ecological health of soil.
assignees: CANGZHOU ACAD OF AGRICULTURE AND FORESTRY SCIENCES

title_en: Urban subway network toughness pre-disaster-post-disaster double-stage optimization method under flood disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a pre-disaster-post-disaster double-stage optimization method for toughness of an urban subway network under a flood disaster, which comprises the steps of obtaining urban subway network information, road network information and flood disaster information, constructing an urban subway topological network and a road topological network, simulating flood depth space-time changes in the subway and the road network during the duration of the flood disaster, judging a subway network failure station set based on water accumulation depth, calculating flood control resource demand based on the number of stations, the types of the stations and the flood depth of each station in the failure station set, establishing and solving a pre-disaster-post double-stage optimization model for toughness of the urban subway network to obtain an optimal pre-disaster closing station decision, a flood control resource warehouse site selection decision and a post-disaster restoration decision, wherein the double-stage optimization model is a double-layer planning model, and an upper-layer model and a lower-layer model are mutually coupled and optimized through a pre-disaster closing station set and a post-disaster restoration process.
assignees: UNIV FUZHOU

title_en: Disaster multisource situation intelligent perception management and control method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to a disaster multisource situation intelligent perception management and control method and system. The method comprises the steps of collecting hydrological weather and topographic data, generating a standardized data set through space-time alignment and abnormal cleaning, constructing a directed topological graph containing node and edge attributes based on the extracted river network topological relation, further designing a graph neural network model, obtaining a flood dynamic route prediction model through physical constraint loss function training of an embedded water balance principle, inputting real-time hydrological data into the model to conduct graph convolution operation, predicting the water level, flow and split ratio change of each node in a future period, and finally combining a digital elevation model to conduct submerged simulation analysis to generate a flood control scheduling scheme and risk early warning information. The method realizes the deep fusion of a physical mechanism and data driving, effectively captures the flood propagation rule under the topological constraint of the river network by using the graph neural network, obviously improves the calculation efficiency while guaranteeing the prediction precision, and provides real-time and reliable decision support for flood disaster prevention and control in complex river network areas.
assignees: YELLOW RIVER INSTITUTE OF HYDRAULIC RES

title_en: Flood control four-pre-system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flood control forecasting, in particular to a digital twinning-based flood control four-pre-system, which comprises a database construction module, a data analysis module, a prediction simulation module and a data judgment module, wherein the database construction module is used for constructing a river basin database and an extreme weather database, the data analysis module is used for constructing a hydrologic twinning model of a target area and determining comprehensive impact indexes corresponding to a plurality of key early warning areas and associated extreme weather data, the prediction simulation module is used for carrying out flood prediction simulation based on the regulated hydrologic twinning model and the extreme weather database so as to obtain flood propulsion parameters of a flood flooding area and each key early warning area, and the data judgment module is used for determining flood control early warning parameters of the target area based on flood control early warning parameters and area characteristics of each key early warning area. The invention can improve the accuracy of flood control early warning and emergency response efficiency.
assignees: SHANDONG HAIHE HUAIHE XIAOQING BASIN WATER RESOURCES MAN SERVICE CENTER

title_en: Smart Farm Convection Control System with AI-based Prediction, Correction, and Disaster Response
title_ko: Ai 기반 예측·보정 및 재난 대응형 스마트팜 대류 제어 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 스마트팜 환경 제어 기술에 관한 것으로, 온실 내부의 공기 흐름을 인공지능(AI) 기반으로 예측·보정하여 균일한 환경을 유지하고, 폭염·한파·폭설과 같은 재난 상황에서도 안정적인 운전이 가능한 스마트팜 대류 제어 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 시스템은 센서 네트워크(10)와 기상 데이터 수집부(15)를 통해 환경 및 외부 기상 데이터를 수집하고, 이를 AI 기반 대류 제어부(20)에서 디지털 트윈 시뮬레이션, 예측, 보정 및 최적화 과정을 거쳐 송풍기(30)와 환기창 개폐기(40)를 제어한다. 또한 재난 대응 모듈(60)을 포함하여 이상 기상 상황 발생 시 AI 제어를 보정하거나 직접 제어를 수행함으로써 최소한의 대류를 보장한다. 
따라서 본 발명은 온실 내부 환경의 균일성 확보, 에너지 효율 향상, 재난 대응력 강화에 효과적이며, 결과적으로 농작물의 생산성과 품질을 높일 수 있다.

title_en: Geological disaster deduction method and system based on digital twin simulation platform
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological disaster deduction method and a system based on a digital twin simulation platform, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster deduction; the method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin body model based on multi-source data inversion and a three-dimensional geological modeling technology, updating geological parameters in real time to reflect the state change of the geological body, introducing a multi-level stepped early warning model, strengthening timeliness and foresight of early warning by fusing the physical model with deep learning prediction, combining the dynamic selection precision of the stepped disaster deduction model and generating a risk thermodynamic diagram, and improving the spatial fineness and decision support capability of geological disaster risk identification. The multi-dimensional organic coordination is realized, the overall accuracy and response speed of the system are enhanced, and the requirements of efficient and accurate disaster risk management under complex geological environment are met.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING THREE GORGES;CHONGQING INST GEOLOGY & MINERAL RESOURCES

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring system based on intelligent hidden danger discrimination
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological disaster monitoring system based on intelligent hidden danger discrimination, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring. The geological disaster monitoring system based on intelligent hidden danger discrimination comprises a multi-source heterogeneous data acquisition module, a data fusion module, a dynamic threshold self-adaption module, a digital twin and real-time early warning linkage module and an edge-cloud cooperative computing architecture module. According to the invention, through multi-source data fusion, dynamic threshold self-adaption, digital twin linkage and edge-cloud cooperative architecture, accurate identification and real-time early warning of geological disasters are realized. In a landslide monitoring scene, the early warning accuracy rate of the system reaches 89%, the response time is shortened to 10 minutes, the geological disaster prevention and control capability is obviously improved, and the stable operation of the system in a complex geological environment is ensured through hardware standardized deployment, model refined training and process automation linkage, so that the requirements of real-time monitoring and emergency response are met.
assignees: EAST CHINA UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY NANCHANG CAMPUS

title_en: Emergency rescue path planning method and system for self-adaptive risk avoidance
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency rescue path planning method and system for self-adaptive risk avoidance, which comprise the steps of establishing an emergency rescue path network structure, carrying out risk entropy driven self-adaptive Monte Carlo simulation analysis before an actual natural disaster comes, carrying out path information statistical analysis on Monte Carlo simulation results, establishing a pre-planned path library, temporarily setting up priori risk distribution of each planned path in the pre-planned path library when the actual natural disaster comes, carrying out dynamic correction on the priori risk distribution of each planned path in the emergency rescue process by adopting sequential Bayesian inference, carrying out dynamic planning on the emergency rescue path based on path posterior risk average values of each planned path after the sequential Bayesian inference, selecting an optimal rescue path and executing an emergency rescue task until the emergency rescue activity is ended. According to the invention, by means of the path dynamic adjustment strategy, the scattered transportation strategy, the path pre-planning strategy and the network-free communication strategy, the rescue resources can be ensured to efficiently and safely reach the target site in natural disaster scenes such as flood, typhoons and the like.

title_en: Backup disaster recovery optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a backup disaster recovery optimization method, which relates to the technical field of IT operation and maintenance and disaster recovery, and comprises the steps of analyzing statistical dependency relationship among basic performance indexes by utilizing a causal discovery algorithm based on standardized monitoring data flow to construct a directional weighted graph, triggering a reverse tracing positioning root cause component when the basic performance indexes in the directional weighted graph deviate from a normal performance base line, analyzing and identifying a service influence path through a forward path to generate a backup strengthening instruction, generating various potential disaster recovery switching schemes according to a historical exercise record and a strategy library in a digital twin environment, carrying out parallel deduction, quantitatively evaluating the performance influence of each potential disaster recovery switching scheme on a virtual service link in the deduction process, and selecting an optimal disaster recovery switching scheme through comparing evaluation results. The invention realizes prospective optimization and service influence minimization of disaster recovery decision, and enhances the automation, intellectualization and service adaptation capability of the backup disaster recovery system.
assignees: BEIJING BEIKONG DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Typhoon path simulation method for coupling machine learning with multi-source marine environment factors
abstract_en: The invention discloses a typhoon path simulation method of machine learning coupling multi-source marine environmental factors, belongs to the field of typhoon disaster simulation, and constructs a typhoon full-path machine learning prediction model integrating marine environmental factors. Firstly, key sea parameters such as sea surface temperature, vertical wind shear of the atmosphere, relative humidity, absolute vorticity, vertical speed, induced airflow and the like, typhoon path and strength time sequence data are integrated, a significant factor influencing typhoon path and strength is selected by combining a P value threshold method, and then, based on a logistic regression model, a counter propagation neural network, a circulating neural network and a support vector machine learning model, a super parameter optimization scheme is combined, so that a full path four-stage optimal prediction model of typhoon in a generation stage, a movement stage, a strength evolution stage and an attenuation stage is respectively constructed. Compared with the traditional statistical model, the machine learning model provided by the invention can better capture the complex interaction mechanism between typhoons and environmental fields.

title_en: Long tunnel remote automatic monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a long-and-large tunnel remote automatic monitoring method which comprises the following steps of S1, arranging sensors in and around a tunnel, S2, transmitting data acquired by the sensors, a camera and sound acquisition equipment to a remote monitoring center in real time through a remote data transmission system, S3, carrying out preprocessing on the data after the data are received by the remote monitoring center, constructing an intelligent data processing and analyzing model based on a neural network according to the preprocessed data, training and optimizing the network by utilizing a continuous counter-propagation algorithm and a random reinitialization technology, and evaluating the stability and safety of the tunnel by utilizing the intelligent data processing and analyzing model, S4, carrying out early warning and alarming, wherein when the monitored data exceed a preset threshold value, an automatic monitoring platform automatically triggers an early warning mechanism, and S5, carrying out emergency response and processing, and immediately starting an emergency pre-plan once the hidden danger or problem exists in the tunnel.
assignees: SICHUAN ZHIRUN SHUZHI TECH CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG;SICHUAN HIGHWAY PLANNING SURVEY DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE LTD

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring and early warning system based on rock-soil body microseism sensing network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster monitoring and early warning system based on a rock-soil body microseism sensing network, in particular relates to the technical field of geological disaster early warning, and is used for solving the problems of insufficient positioning accuracy and poor early warning reliability caused by neglecting formation heterogeneity in the existing seismic source positioning method; the method comprises the steps of obtaining geological exploration data of a monitoring area, constructing a three-dimensional heterogeneous stratum model containing cracks and faults, simulating a distortion propagation path of micro-seismic waves in an anisotropic medium, generating a waveform feature library, extracting time-frequency domain energy distribution of actual signals, matching the time-frequency domain energy distribution with the feature library, dynamically correcting equivalent wave velocity field parameters, combining sensor coordinates and a corrected wave velocity field to calculate a propagation time difference matrix, constructing a nonlinear equation set taking wave velocity deviation as constraint, solving seismic source space coordinates, finally generating dynamic early warning signals based on the distribution relation of the seismic sources and the stratum model, and remarkably improving seismic source positioning precision and early warning accuracy in a complex rock environment.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;XINJIANG GEZHOUBA DASHIXIA WATER CONSERVANCY PROJECT DEV CO LTD;XINJIANG XINHUA YEERQIANG RIVER BASIN WATER RESOURCES AND HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD;XINJIANG UYGUR AUTONOMOUS REGION TARIM RIVER BASIN CHEERCHEN RIVER WATER CONSERVANCY MAN CENTER

title_en: Urban lifeline facility flood disaster chain simulation method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention provides a big data-based urban lifeline facility flood disaster chain simulation method, which comprises the steps of simulating and verifying an urban flood model based on big data, constructing an urban lifeline facility flood disaster chain based on big data, dynamically simulating a lifeline facility flood disaster chain by coupling a numerical simulation and cascade failure method, and evaluating the influence of extreme storm flood on the evolution of the lifeline facility disaster chain. The method of the invention is based on big data, adopts the technical scheme of numerical simulation, big data and cascade failure, the dynamic simulation of the life line facility disaster chain is creatively realized, the technical method in the field is innovated, and the method has obvious technical progress.

title_en: Wind and rain, earthquake and wave disaster coupling experiment system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind and rain, earthquake and wave disaster coupling experiment system, relates to the field of ocean engineering experiment equipment, and aims to solve the problem that the degree of restoration of natural disaster experiments is not high. The system comprises a wind and rain simulation unit, a wave simulation unit, an earthquake simulation unit and a cooperative control unit, wherein the wind and rain simulation unit comprises a wind tunnel main body, a fan arranged in the wind tunnel main body and a rainfall simulation mechanism arranged in the wind tunnel main body, the wave simulation unit comprises a wave making pool arranged in the wind tunnel main body, a wave making mechanism and a flow making mechanism arranged in the wave making pool, the earthquake simulation unit comprises a vibrating table arranged in the wave making pool and used for bearing a building model, and the wind and rain simulation unit, the wave simulation unit and the earthquake simulation unit are all electrically connected with the cooperative control unit, and the cooperative control unit is used for controlling the working state of each simulation unit. The method is used for realizing the restoration simulation of multiple disasters of the traffic infrastructure in the coastal extreme environment.
assignees: UNIV SHIJIAZHUANG TIEDAO;HEBEI TRANSP INVESTMENT GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Underground space digital twin system of coal mine based on numerical simulation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine safety monitoring, and discloses a coal mine underground space digital twin system based on numerical simulation, which comprises the following modules: the multisource sensor assembly is arranged in roadway surrounding rock and used for collecting stress, displacement, anchor rod axial force and vibration data in real time. The underground space digital twin system of the coal mine based on the numerical simulation realizes the dimension crossing from single index trend analysis to full-field stress and displacement continuous evolution process prediction, and provides more comprehensive stability cognition. The model parameters are continuously updated through a dynamic self-calibration mechanism, the traditional method of relying on fixed experience values is replaced, and the long-term fidelity and the prediction accuracy of the model under complex geological conditions are remarkably improved. The system provides a visual risk map based on simulation deduction and a multi-scene simulation function, reduces the dependence on manual experience, and provides visual and scientific basis for support scheme optimization and disaster emergency decision.
assignees: SHANXI INST OF ENERGY

title_en: Intelligent decision method and device for realizing flood simulation and prevention by combining Cesium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of disaster prevention and management, and particularly provides a method and a device for realizing intelligent decision making of flood simulation prevention by combining Cesium, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, geographic data access; the method comprises the steps of S2, realizing real-time monitoring and analysis of hydrologic conditions, S3, constructing a flood simulation model, including hydrodynamic model construction, model parameter setting and optimization and a real-time updating mechanism, S4, unrealEngine, wherein a Chaos physical engine processes physical interaction of water flow, physical data of the Chaos are associated through modularized logic, S5, an integrated LSTM time sequence prediction model is combined with hydrologic real-time rainfall to realize flood evolution trend, S6, heatMap shows important disaster areas and disaster water level conditions, S7, identifying nearby refuge points, and scientifically and reasonably arranging emergency paths. Compared with the prior art, the invention can provide intelligent decision management for disaster pre-simulated pre-disaster prevention and post-disaster rescue recovery.

title_en: Boundary hierarchical grid physical constraint variation assimilation method embedded into deep neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a boundary hierarchical grid physical constraint variation assimilation method for embedding a deep neural network, which comprises the steps of establishing a momentum equation containing boundary hierarchical grid turbulence friction items, simulating the boundary layer turbulence friction items through the deep neural network, constructing weak constraint items of a variation assimilation frame cost function by using the momentum equation, training the deep neural network by using a data set constructed by a historical numerical weather forecast mode simulation result, linearizing the trained deep neural network to obtain corresponding tangential operators and accompanying operators, embedding the tangential operators and accompanying operators into the variation assimilation frame cost function, acquiring multi-source remote sensing observation data and a numerical weather forecast mode background field, and solving an analysis field by taking the cost function as a target to complete data assimilation. The invention can improve the assimilation and numerical forecast level of disaster weather data such as typhoons, and the like, in particular to the observation assimilation level related to boundary layers.
assignees: NANJING METEOROLOGICAL SCIENCE AND TECH INNOVATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Urban water supply system earthquake-resistant analysis method based on multi-fine digital twin model
abstract_en: The invention provides an earthquake-resistant analysis method of an urban water supply system based on a multi-fine digital twin model, which belongs to the technical field of intelligent disaster prevention and digital twin of urban infrastructure systems, and comprises the steps of geometrically modeling according to a rule of progressive from a bottom level to an upper level, and constructing a topological network model and a hydraulic model of an urban pipe network; the method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-fineness parameterized numerical model library, designing a dynamic scheduling engine based on event response, constructing a bidirectional data conversion interface and a unified semantic framework, constructing a multi-fineness twin model, simulating by utilizing the multi-fineness twin model to obtain a real-time simulation result, visualizing the comprehensive state of the urban water supply system based on the real-time simulation result, making an emergency decision, and completing earthquake-resistant analysis of the urban water supply system.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Goaf collapse risk assessment data fusion system based on big data processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a goaf collapse risk assessment data fusion system based on big data processing, which particularly relates to the technical field of geological disaster assessment, and comprises three major core modules, namely a multi-source data self-adaptive weighting fusion module, a physical-temporal neural network dynamic prediction module, a risk field three-dimensional splitting and emergency response module, a three-dimensional clustering and automatic calculation risk parameters of three-dimensional voxels of a high risk area, an emergency scheme generation by combining DEM data and an A-algorithm, a digital twin deduction assessment, and improvement of assessment accuracy and emergency scheme operability, wherein the non-raster data is converted into a continuous field by using a Kriging interpolation, the weight is dynamically allocated by combining information entropy and related coefficients, the enhanced feature field is generated by self-supervision pre-training, the physical-temporal neural network dynamic prediction module is integrated with elastoplastic constraint loss and multi-task learning, and the future multi-time step risk probability field and deformation prediction field are output by using a space-time convolution-memory network.

title_en: Urban drainage waterlogging prevention simulation regulation and control and water city adaptation method based on traditional wisdom
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traditional intelligent integrated urban drainage simulation and water city adaptation method, which belongs to the technical field of urban drainage waterlogging prevention, and the invention improves the coping capacity of cities to storm and flood disasters through digital technology such as three-dimensional dynamic simulation and digital twin, and realizes the harmonious adaptation of urban hydrologic environment and urban construction; the method comprises the key steps of sample database construction, ancient city drainage water conservancy calculation mode development, digital simulation, three-dimensional deduction system platform construction, system verification, optimization and the like; the technology also relates to the technology for evaluating the value of the heritage of the water-controlling and water-draining type, the stagnancy-accumulation-drainage text path construction of complex underlying surface and composite functional infrastructure, and the development of a digital base-based water-city history backtracking, city storm water-logging simulation and joint regulation and control decision support platform; the invention improves the coping capability of the city to storm and flood disasters through a digital technology, and realizes the harmonious adaptation of the urban hydrologic environment and urban construction.
assignees: JIANGSU YANGTZE RIVER DELTA SMART WATER RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;XINJIANG WESTERN UNITED DIGITAL IND DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;ZHEJIANG EAST UNITED WATER ENV CO LTD;ZHEJIANG WEIPU ENVIRONMENTAL TECH CO LTD;NANJING WEIPU WATER ENG CO LTD;NANJING WEIGAN IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring and early warning system and method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a digital twin-based geological disaster monitoring and early warning system and method, which comprises a data acquisition module, a model building module, an early warning module and a warning module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring data, a dynamic-static self-adaptive fusion algorithm is utilized for preprocessing the data, the model building module is used for building a deep learning model by using a deep learning algorithm and using a counter propagation algorithm for model training, the model weight and the deviation are continuously adjusted through iterative optimization, the quality of an output result is continuously improved, the output of a convolutional layer of a convolutional neural network is transmitted into the deep learning model for feature extraction again to finish testing, the digital twin-based model is obtained, the early warning module is used for inputting real-time monitoring data into the digital twin-based model to obtain a prediction result, and when the prediction result reaches an early warning grade, early warning information is generated, an early warning signal is triggered and is sent to relevant personnel for confirmation and release. According to the invention, the dynamic-static self-adaptive fusion algorithm and the deep learning classification algorithm are fused, so that the accuracy and the efficiency of analysis and processing of various geological disaster data can be further improved.
assignees: RUNJIAN CO LTD

title_en: Disaster influence full-chain joint simulation method for event-power grid-life line-user
abstract_en: The invention relates to a disaster influence full-chain joint simulation method for an event-power grid-life line-user, and aims to solve the problems that a composite extreme event cannot be covered, coupling modeling is inaccurate and a unified full-chain simulation frame is lacking in the prior art. The method generates extreme event scenes such as natural disasters, network attacks and the like, builds a multi-granularity lifeline model, and develops joint simulation in two stages (bi-directional coupling system iterative simulation and unidirectional influence system section simulation) to synchronously model 8 important users by combining time-event dual-drive interaction. The full-chain failure process can be accurately simulated, the power grid fault evolution, the life line function loss and the user service availability are output, and support is provided for urban life line toughness assessment and emergency decision.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: AI-based multi-mode water level monitoring and well lid alarming method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for monitoring water level and alarming a well lid based on AI multiple modes, which is characterized in that a water immersion and triggering alarm terminal integrating an electrode sensor and a Hall sensor is arranged in an open bin of a well lid base, terminal data, image data and environment data are integrated, and multiple modes fusion characteristics are generated after standardized processing. And taking the characteristic as core input, constructing an AI model, and outputting the abnormal water accumulation probability and the jacking probability of the well lid. And combining the pipe network topology, the historical data and the dynamic threshold value of the digital twin system, accurately judging the pavement ponding grade and the abnormal reason of the well lid, and verifying the effectiveness of the alarm through multi-source credibility fusion. Simultaneously, the alarm result and the treatment feedback are synchronized to a digital twin system, and the training data set is updated to iteratively optimize the model parameters. The invention effectively reduces the hysteresis and false alarm rate of the traditional monitoring, obviously improves the operation and maintenance efficiency and emergency response capability of the municipal pipe network, and provides reliable technical support for urban waterlogging prevention and control and road safety guarantee.
assignees: SHANGHAI ZHONGJING HANDING DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster chain risk prediction method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of risk monitoring, in particular to a disaster chain risk prediction method and system based on digital twinning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining training data in a digital twin platform, determining punishment weights of target samples in the training data, wherein the punishment weights are used for amplifying punishment when disaster samples are predicted in errors, determining a classification loss function by utilizing punishment weights and disaster label information, performing model training by utilizing the training data under supervision of the classification loss function to obtain a risk prediction model, and processing real-time geological hydrological data, real-time heavy rainfall data and real-time slope state data of a position to be predicted by utilizing the risk prediction model to obtain predicted landslide probability and predicted landslide quantity of the position to be predicted. Through the technical scheme, landslide risk can be predicted so as to avoid potential landslide disaster risk.
assignees: WUHAN ZHONGDI YUNSHEN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent distribution and control method for annular fire hose in construction temporary building area
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent distribution control method for an annular fire hose in a construction temporary building area, and belongs to the technical field of fire engineering and intelligent control. Aiming at the technical problems that the traditional fire hose in a construction temporary building area is low in deployment efficiency, poor in reliability, incapable of being dynamically adjusted in real time and slow in fault response, the invention plans an optimal laying path according to environment information, an intelligent coupler is connected with a water hose of a built-in sensing unit to form an annular closed loop, the loop is self-organized after power-on, a system state estimated value is generated through multi-mode sensing data fusion, an MPC controller is adopted to solve a hydraulic optimization problem in a rolling manner, the pressure of the pipe network is dynamically balanced, fault diagnosis and evaluation are carried out based on digital twin-body parallel simulation, and when a fault is completely invalid, a failure section is automatically isolated, degraded into a dendritic network, communication is maintained and is guided to a nearest water intake. The invention can remarkably improve the reliability, the self-adaptability and the emergency response capability of the fire-fighting water supply in the temporary building area.
assignees: CHINA HARBOUR ENG CO LTD

title_en: Supercritical CO2Digital twin regulation and control method and system for environmental safety of power generation sealed factory building
abstract_en: The invention provides a supercritical CO  2  power generation sealed factory building environment safety digital twin regulation and control method and system, belongs to the technical field of supercritical carbon dioxide circulating power generation, and can at least partially solve the problems that the existing traditional technology is difficult to capture dynamic evolution rules of complex working media, temperatures and flow fields, and the simulation precision is insufficient and the emergency response is lagged.
assignees: HUANENG JILIN POWER GENERATION CO LTD;XIAN THERMAL POWER RES INST CO

title_en: Cascading failure risk assessment method considering aging of power transmission line in typhoon weather
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of safety protection of power systems, and discloses a cascading failure risk assessment method considering power transmission line aging in typhoon weather, wherein a typhoon wind speed simulation model is established according to weather bureau forecast information, and a tower wind load is calculated by combining power grid geographic information; and (3) establishing a transmission tower fault probability calculation model considering ageing and a cascading fault probability calculation model of line ageing, and obtaining a risk value of power grid regulation by combining the cascading fault probability in consideration of comprehensive cost. And calculating the comprehensive risk of causing the cascading failure under the typhoon disaster by combining the risk value regulated by the power grid based on the risk value of the collapse of the tower, forecasting typhoons at each moment as a stage, and accumulating the risk values of all stages until the typhoons are finished to obtain the risk value of the final state of the system. According to the method, the tower aging and the transmission line aging influence are considered, and the tower collapse risk and the power grid regulation risk are considered, so that the risk assessment of typhoons on the power grid is more practical.
assignees: UNIV NANJING POSTS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS

title_en: Geological ecological restoration evaluation method and system for preventing and controlling geological disasters, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ecological restoration evaluation, and provides a geological ecological restoration evaluation method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium for preventing and treating geological disasters, wherein the method comprises the steps of researching data acquisition, setting of geological disaster types, initial evaluation, data preprocessing, model construction and training, risk determination before restoration, information acquisition after restoration, geological disaster risk prediction and geological ecological restoration evaluation; according to the method, the model is trained by utilizing the remote sensing image, the sound wave data and the initial evaluation data, prediction of an evaluation result by the remote sensing image and the sound wave data is achieved, difficulty and time of risk evaluation are reduced, in addition, surface features and structural features are simultaneously extracted by combining the remote sensing with the sound wave, a prediction effect of the model is optimized, the sensing capability of surrounding environment is improved by a multi-mode adjacent sensing model, prediction precision of a single block is improved, and a repair effect evaluation mechanism is optimized by a repair effect evaluation rule.
assignees: LIN YOUQUAN

title_en: Three-dimensional lithium battery mine visualization system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention provides a three-dimensional lithium battery mine visualization system based on digital twinning, which comprises a physical sensing layer, a data interaction layer and a data interaction layer, wherein the physical sensing layer is deployed on a lithium battery mine site and comprises a plurality of sensor networks for collecting geologic bodies, production equipment, environmental parameters, personnel positions and vehicle states, and the data interaction layer comprises a data integration platform and edge computing nodes and is used for cleaning, fusing, protocol conversion and edge side preliminary analysis of multi-source heterogeneous data uploaded by the physical sensing layer and uploading the multi-source heterogeneous data to a cloud. According to the invention, by integrating the slope monitoring sensor and the professional analysis model, real-time evaluation and advanced early warning of the slope stability and the safety of the tailing pond are realized, important accidents such as collapse, dam break and the like are effectively prevented, meanwhile, the migration paths of fluoride dust, radioactive substances and potential leakage pollutants in the atmosphere and water are dynamically simulated by utilizing the harmful element diffusion model, so that accurate decision support is provided for environmental risk emergency response, and the influence on the surrounding ecology is reduced to the greatest extent.
assignees: JIANGXI LITHIUM BATTERY IND DIGITAL TRANSFER PROMOTION CENTER

title_en: Optimal dispatching method, system, equipment and medium for cascading failures in extreme weather
