abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascading failure optimization scheduling method, system, equipment and medium under extreme weather, which belong to the technical field of disaster simulation and comprise the steps of calculating all line failure rates according to extreme weather data and power distribution network frame data, screening all lines to obtain a key line set, establishing an upper optimization model according to a first constraint condition, inputting the key line set into the upper optimization model to obtain an initial scheduling scheme, screening out a key line with the largest cut load in the initial scheduling scheme as a second constraint condition of the upper optimization model, inputting the second constraint condition into the upper optimization model to obtain a middle scheduling scheme, and adjusting the middle scheduling scheme to obtain a final scheduling scheme. The invention solves the problem that the prior art only aims at a single fault or static running state design strategy, realizes the design of a multi-angle and dynamic scheduling scheme, and meets the requirements of loss reduction and pre-prevention and control.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Urban underground space emergency drainage control method under flood disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban underground space emergency drainage control method under flood disasters, which comprises the steps of collecting multidimensional real-time data through a multisource heterogeneous digital twin drainage intelligent management and control platform, inputting a 1D-2D dynamic bidirectional coupling model to simulate the dynamic coupling relation between pipe network water flow and regional ponding to obtain water flow pressure distribution and ponding diffusion trend data, starting a space-time characteristic driving drainage scheduling algorithm to extract space-time correlation characteristics and construct a decision variable set, combining emergency drainage control parameters to screen variables, inputting the screened variables into the model for feedback verification, adjusting algorithm parameters if the screened variables do not meet the requirements, and sending control instructions to execution equipment through the platform if the screened variables meet the requirements. The method can improve the prediction precision of the ponding and water flow state, improve the adaptability and the reliability of a scheduling scheme, accelerate the response speed of emergency drainage, comprehensively improve the coping capacity of underground space flooding, and ensure the operation safety of the underground space.
assignees: CHENGDU CITY SAFETY AND EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Coal mine disaster early warning method based on multi-source data fusion and space-time diagram network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine disaster early warning method based on multi-source data fusion and a space-time diagram network. The method comprises (a) collecting multisource heterogeneous monitoring data, (b) constructing an anisotropic space-time diagram of a geologic-physical dual constraint, (c) training the diagram using a geologic-physical anisotropic space-time diagram neural network whose diagram volume lamination is designed to learn simultaneously And And (d) predicting disaster risk by using the trained model and generating early warning. According to the invention, geology and physical priori knowledge are taken as constraints to be incorporated into the topological structure of the GNN model, so that the model can follow a physical rule, and disasters (propagation) under anisotropic geological conditions are predicted, thereby being beneficial to improving the accuracy and timeliness of early warning.
assignees: GUIZHOU PANJIANG REFINED COAL

title_en: LES ultra-high resolution TC atmospheric air flow field numerical simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a numerical simulation method and a numerical simulation system for an LES ultra-high resolution TC atmospheric flow field, and relates to the fields of atmospheric observation, numerical assimilation and high resolution numerical simulation. According to the method, three-dimensional power-thermal information is obtained by cooperatively implementing airship platform radar observation and downward projecting sounding observation in a tropical cyclone core area, radar radial wind and profile observation operators are preprocessed and constructed, multi-source observation is fused in a multiple nested grid numerical mode by adopting a data assimilation strategy, and a three-dimensional initial/analysis field adapting to large vortex simulation is generated. And then, configuring a large vortex simulation solver on an innermost grid covering a tropical cyclone boundary layer, adopting fine horizontal grids and boundary layer encryption vertical layering, explicitly analyzing boundary layer vortex, small-scale convection and turbulence structures, and outputting an ultrahigh-resolution three-dimensional flow field product for fine evaluation of strong wind and disaster risks.

title_en: Method, equipment and storage medium for acquiring toughness improvement strategy of power distribution network
abstract_en: A method, equipment and storage medium for obtaining a toughness promotion strategy of a power distribution network are used for obtaining the toughness promotion strategy of the power distribution network for strong random and high-influence meteorological events and are applied to the technical field of evaluation and construction of a toughness power system, and comprise the following steps of calculating fault probability of a power distribution line from information such as meteorological data and reinforcing a high-probability line; generating a fault scene based on a Monte Carlo simulation method, taking the minimum configuration cost of an emergency vehicle and a distributed power supply and the minimum total cost at the time of disaster as an objective function of a pre-disaster toughness lifting strategy, taking the minimum loss load cost and the minimum total cost of power generation resources as an objective function of disaster resistance and recovery stages, drawing a performance curve of the power distribution network, and analyzing toughness indexes of the power distribution network. According to the invention, the line reinforcement, the distributed energy allocation and the emergency vehicle allocation are used as toughness lifting means, the optimization problem is solved to obtain an optimal scheme, the power supply capacity of the distribution network under extreme disasters is ensured, pre-disaster early warning and disaster emergency scheme making of the distribution network are facilitated, and the anti-vulnerability of the distribution network is improved.
assignees: NANJING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Urban rainfall flood impact cascade propagation simulation method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a city rainfall flood impact cascade propagation simulation method, a system and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing an infrastructure network according to city key infrastructure information; the method comprises the steps of constructing an interdependence matrix according to an infrastructure network, determining a dependency weight according to the interdependence matrix, determining an initial impact node in the infrastructure network according to urban meteorological observation data, inputting the infrastructure network, the upstream and downstream relation of the node, the dependency weight and the initial impact node into a cascade propagation simulation model to perform propagation simulation, and obtaining an urban rainfall flood impact cascade propagation simulation result. According to the embodiment of the invention, the infrastructure network, the node upstream-downstream relationship, the dependence weight and the initial impact node are input into the cascade propagation simulation model to perform propagation simulation, so that cascade simulation of the process from local node triggering to range diffusion of urban flood impact can be effectively realized, and the accuracy of urban flood disaster impact propagation simulation is improved.
assignees: INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS;UNIV JIANGXI NORMAL

title_en: End-to-end flow field flood risk influence forecasting method based on physical constraint
abstract_en: The invention discloses an end-to-end river basin flood risk influence forecasting method based on physical constraint, in particular to the technical field of meteorological hydrologic forecasting and artificial intelligence, which comprises the steps of S1, acquiring multisource space-time data of a target river basin, constructing a river basin diagram structure after space-time alignment and meshing, S2, constructing an end-to-end deep learning network comprising a self-adaptive multi-mode feature extraction module and an influence prediction module, and training the network by utilizing a loss function fused with physical constraints to obtain a flood risk influence prediction model, wherein the physical constraints at least comprise water balance constraints. According to the invention, the key problems of error accumulation, poor physical consistency and scarcity of disaster samples in the traditional cascade forecasting mode are solved by deeply embedding the physical mechanism into the data driving model, so that the forecasting precision and reliability are remarkably improved.
assignees: ANHUI INST OF METEOROLOGICAL SCIENCES ANHUI ECOLOGICAL METEOROLOGICAL AND SATELLITE REMOTE SENSING C

title_en: Risk early warning method and system for low-temperature rain, snow and freezing weather disasters
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent early warning and discloses a risk early warning method and system for low-temperature rain, snow and freezing weather disasters, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source data and constructing a heterogeneous diagram; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing data to obtain training and reasoning samples, constructing a graph neural network on a heterogeneous graph, carrying out joint learning on node time sequence characteristics and side relations to obtain graph representations representing cold air invasion, rain and snow zone movement and risk propagation delay, outputting road table temperature evolution, icing threshold arrival time and wire icing growth rate based on the physical guiding neural network, fusing characteristics obtained by the graph neural network with characteristics obtained by the physical guiding neural network, outputting asset-level risk scores and confidence intervals thereof, obtaining expected arrival time, and establishing early warning according to prediction results and observation results. The application provides finer and more reliable grading risk early warning, and improves the accuracy, the interpretability and the practicability of early warning.
assignees: HENAN METEOROLOGICAL OBSERVATORY YELLOW RIVER BASIN METEOROLOGICAL CENTER HENAN ENV METEOROLOGICAL F

title_en: Landslide geological disaster deduction method and system based on MPM method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide geological disaster deduction method and system based on an MPM method, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting disaster scene multisource data and synchronously constructing a digital twin body model; the method comprises the steps of adopting a qualitative and quantitative two-stage inversion calibration model, combining a qualitative layer with monitored displacement direction and deformation mode, preliminarily inverting key parameters such as adhesive force, internal friction angle and the like of a sliding belt, calculating a practical deformation range, a collapse position and displacement amount by using the quantitative layer comparison model, optimizing parameters to match a practical landslide state, embedding a rock-soil body aging characteristic model in landslide long-term evolution deduction, describing annual scale parameter degradation by using an exponential function, dividing prediction into continuous analysis steps, and completing current-to-future full-period simulation by means of mass particle method MPM calculation to output a deformation range, displacement amount and a collapse risk result. And reliable decision support is provided for disaster prevention and reduction.
assignees: INST ROCK & SOIL MECH CAS;UNIV WUHAN TECH;CHANGAN UNIV

title_en: Urban flood disaster chain propagation simulation method based on disaster-bearing body function destruction mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban flood disaster chain propagation simulation method based on a disaster bearing body function destruction mechanism, relates to the field of hydraulic engineering and disaster prevention and reduction, and solves the problems of insufficient mechanism description, imperfect relevance analysis and the like of the conventional method. The method comprises the steps of inputting flood inundation scenes, combining a disaster-bearing body direct function destruction mechanism and an indirect function destruction mechanism, determining a core disaster-bearing body destruction threshold and probability distribution, identifying a direct destruction unit, establishing a life line facility function association network, calculating the total function failure probability of the disaster-bearing body, identifying an indirect destruction unit, updating the function states of the disaster-bearing body scene by scene, constructing a space propagation model, forming different scene disaster chain networks, and finally outputting key information. The invention can accurately simulate the disaster chain propagation, improves the scientificity of risk assessment and emergency response, and provides reference for disaster prevention and reduction decisions.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: SOP (system on a chip) site selection and volume determination method, system, equipment and medium based on multi-disaster chain coupling
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of toughness optimization of power systems, and discloses a SOP (system on demand) site selection and volume determination method, system, equipment and medium based on multi-disaster chain coupling, which comprises the steps of establishing a time-varying dynamic fault model through a meteorological physical coupling mechanism and associating a typhoon path, an icing growth process and a line fault rate; the method comprises the steps of carrying out Monte Carlo disaster chain simulation, simulating a line cascade failure process under extreme weather, recording node voltage deviation and load reduction, carrying out multidimensional sensitive node evaluation based on Monte Carlo simulation results, outputting a sensitive node list, establishing a multi-objective optimization model by taking sensitive nodes as candidate positions, and solving an SOP optimal site and volume-fixing scheme by adopting a second-order cone planning algorithm. The method realizes the full-chain technology closed loop from meteorological data acquisition and sensitive node identification to flexible resource regulation and control, and achieves the purposes of improving the toughness and reliability of the system and optimizing the operation strategy of the power distribution system.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Multi-carbon balance defense method, system, equipment and storage medium for fusing physical and social factors of power grid information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-carbon balance defense method, system, equipment and storage medium for fusing power grid information physical social factors, which comprises the steps of constructing an information physical social system multidimensional coupling model, combining a finite state machine and historical disaster data, simulating a dynamic evolution track of the system under an extreme natural disaster condition, constructing a risk assessment model based on an event-driven mechanism, quantitatively evaluating the multidimensional coupling factors based on natural disaster events and artificial carbon emission emergency, presetting a stage collaborative defense strategy, constructing a carbon balance defense effect evaluation model, and quantitatively verifying emission reduction and restoration capacities of strategies of each stage by combining quantitative evaluation results. The method can synchronously optimize carbon emission and carbon sink layout under extreme disaster situations, enhance toughness and low-carbon transformation capacity of the power system, realize dynamic regulation and control of disaster-induced carbon unbalance, and ensure scientificity and executable performance of the scheme under complex conditions.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Plateau area construction monitoring system based on unmanned aerial vehicle and three-dimensional simulation technology
abstract_en: A construction monitoring system for a plateau area based on unmanned aerial vehicle and three-dimensional simulation technology is particularly suitable for the whole-flow digital management of construction under a complex plateau environment. The system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle platform carrying multiple sensors, a three-dimensional modeling module, a data processing module and a monitoring terminal. The unmanned aerial vehicle acquires high-precision terrain data, builds a digital twin reference model, a data processing module identifies safety equipment in real time based on an AI visual algorithm, monitors the temperature of a frozen soil roadbed, pre-warns geological disasters through a GIS and Beidou technology, and a monitoring terminal integrates construction progress analysis, quality detection and operation and maintenance path planning functions. The invention solves the core problems of severe highland climate, complex geology and the like through the whole-flow digital management before construction, during construction and after construction, and improves the construction efficiency and the safety.
assignees: HUADIAN NEW ENERGY GROUP CO LTD TIBET BRANCH;THREE GORGES HIGH TECH INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Simulation test system and method for secondary disaster induced by coal mine gas dynamic disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation test system and a simulation test method for secondary disasters induced by coal mine gas dynamic disasters. The system consists of a disaster inoculation induction module and a secondary disaster propagation evolution module, and can integrally simulate a series of complete chained processes of secondary disasters such as explosion, shock waves, wind current disturbance and the like, wherein the complete chained processes can be used for simulating deep coal beds to induce coal and gas outburst due to mining disturbance under the environments of in-situ stress, temperature and gas pressure, and further igniting gas-dust mixed clouds formed by the outburst. The invention can simulate the ventilation condition of the roadway and can be additionally provided with a water spraying/explosion suppression system for checking and evaluating the efficiency of the active disaster suppression technology. The invention can realize the accurate regulation and control of the outstanding source parameters, roadway environment and ignition conditions, and acquire multi-physical-field evolution data through the high-precision sensing network, thereby providing a key test platform and scientific basis for revealing the inherent mechanism of deep composite dynamic disasters, evaluating disaster risks, and checking and optimizing disaster prevention and reduction technologies.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING

title_en: Building waterproof supervision acceptance system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building waterproof supervision acceptance system and a method, and relates to the technical field of buildings, wherein the method comprises the steps of scanning a waterproof material sample through a micro-channel impedance tomography strategy, extracting pore communication paths and defect distribution characteristics, and constructing a three-dimensional infiltration network model comprising pore sizes, communication paths and defect distribution; based on a material family knowledge graph, mapping the water pressure and crack propagation law of a concrete structure in a historical engineering to a penetration network characteristic space of a current material to generate a composite test parameter set comprising a heavy rain impact waveform, a temperature circulation gradient and a structural deformation rate, synchronously applying dynamic load in a climate simulation test cabin according to the composite test parameter set, positioning a leakage high risk area according to a test result through a space-time correlation algorithm, and generating a decision scheme comprising maintenance priority, carbon footprint evaluation and disaster resistance prediction by combining a material durability database and area extreme climate data.
assignees: GUANGDONG CAIMAO CONSTRUCTION ENG CONSULTANTS CO LTD

title_en: Tunnel disaster monitoring method and blocking method based on earthquake damage-flood cooperation
abstract_en: The application discloses a tunnel disaster monitoring method and a blocking method based on earthquake damage-flood cooperation, and relates to the field of intelligent prevention and control of earthquake engineering and disasters, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining damage characteristics, seepage characteristics and aftershock characteristics based on DOFS data of a section in a decoupling way; the method comprises the steps of obtaining water pressure data through simulation according to multisource sensing data in a section, determining current damage variables, damage-seepage coupling indexes and crack hydraulic opening degrees based on various characteristics and historical data, determining seepage pressure gradients among sections according to water pressure values of various sections, determining seepage velocity vectors among sections according to the crack hydraulic opening degrees and the damage-seepage coupling indexes of the sections, determining system cascade failure risk indexes according to the damage variables of the sections and dynamic risk propagation weights among the sections, and determining disaster chain propagation strength indexes of a current tunnel by utilizing an entropy weight method. The method can realize real-time monitoring and risk assessment of the secondary flood disasters after tunnel earthquake.
assignees: UNIV TONGJI

title_en: Urban disaster risk monitoring method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based urban disaster risk monitoring method and system, and relates to the technical field of data analysis. The method comprises the steps of obtaining historical disaster monitoring records of a target area, combining with urban disaster priori knowledge, analyzing and determining an associated monitoring list of the target area, wherein the associated monitoring list comprises a data type list and a data range list, constructing an area disaster digital twin model corresponding to the associated monitoring list in the target area, configuring an acquisition time window for the target area, carrying out real-time data acquisition by combining with the associated monitoring list to obtain time sequence monitoring data, inputting the time sequence monitoring data into the area disaster digital twin model to carry out disaster evolution simulation analysis to obtain a simulation analysis result, and determining the disaster risk level of the target area. The method and the system effectively improve the accuracy and timeliness of urban disaster risk early warning.
assignees: NANYANG INST TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Hydrologic digital twin model construction method and system based on artificial intelligence technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrologic digital twin model construction method and a system based on an artificial intelligence technology, which relate to the technical field of hydrologic monitoring and intelligent early warning and comprise the steps of constructing a hydrologic element measuring point monitoring model fused with multi-source sensor data, and introducing a complex association of a graph convolution network capture environmental factor and hydrologic elements; the method comprises the steps of constructing a mapping model by utilizing an improved long-short-term memory neural network, designing balance data precision and space consistency of a multi-target dynamic monitoring loss function, fusing a measuring point predicted value and a global simulation value through field self-adaptive countermeasure training, generating a basic hydrologic digital twin model, constructing an interaction model by combining an extreme working condition parameter migration strategy, constructing an inference mechanism based on a hydrologic disaster knowledge graph, and outputting a physical engineering disposal scheme. The method solves the problems of weak generalization capability, insufficient data fusion, poor adaptability to extreme working conditions and the like of the traditional hydrologic model, and realizes high-precision real-time sensing and intelligent decision in the hydrologic process.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA WATER RESOURCES & ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Multi-dimensional coupling reversible mapping landslide susceptibility evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multidimensional coupling reversible mapping landslide susceptibility evaluation method, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster prediction. The method has the advantages of being more efficient in characteristic characterization, realizing low-dimensional sparse characterization by using one-hot coding of extremely random leaf nodes, reducing the calculated amount of a deep network, inhibiting overfitting through sparsity, retaining the combined meaning of geological factors corresponding to the leaf nodes, considering efficiency and interpretability, being more robust in network training, solving the gradient attenuation problem by lossless characteristic propagation of reversible residual blocks, improving the generalization capability of small samples by random subspace heavy parameter strategy, enabling the models to be stably trained in a landslide sample scarcity scene, and enabling overfitting gap to be less than or equal to 0.010.
assignees: UNIV TIBET

title_en: River course flood evolution simulation and flood prevention emergency decision support system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water conservancy informatization and flood control and disaster reduction, in particular to a river course flood evolution simulation and flood control emergency decision support system and method, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the system comprises a central decision correction server and a boundary space-time reference node arranged at the edge of a key flood prevention node, wherein the central decision correction server is provided with microsecond time synchronization capability and is used for collecting state data such as sluice opening, personnel transfer and the like and executing control instructions, the boundary space-time reference node is aligned with heterogeneous data through a high-precision timestamp, a digital twin situation under a unified space-time reference is constructed, and hydrodynamic model boundary conditions are dynamically corrected based on instruction execution deviation to trigger re-simulation and emergency decision updating. The invention solves or at least reduces the problem of disconnection between simulation results and reality caused by lack of closed loop feedback and unified time reference of simulation deduction and physical execution in the existing system, and provides a river flood evolution simulation and flood prevention emergency decision support system and method.
assignees: HENAN YONGKUN WATER CONSERVANCY CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Underground space fire-fighting early warning method, equipment and medium based on digital twin
abstract_en: The application discloses a digital twinning-based underground space fire-fighting early warning method, equipment and medium, and relates to the technical field of intelligent fire fighting; the method comprises the steps of judging fire state of a node network to obtain fire state parameters, deducing change conditions of the fire state parameters in real time through fire trend analysis to determine tunnel fire evolution trend data, dynamically rendering through smoke and thermodynamic diagram based on the fire evolution trend data to obtain simulation scenes of tunnel fire evolution, and carrying out personnel evacuation simulation on a tunnel according to the simulation scenes to determine real-time personnel evacuation planning under tunnel fire. The method solves the technical problem that fire prediction is inconvenient in fire-fighting early warning of the tunnel underground space in the prior art.
assignees: SHANDONG INSPUR WISDOM BUILDING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based system and method for improving toughness of distribution network under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based system for improving toughness of a power distribution network under typhoon disasters, which comprises a physical model layer, a data interaction layer, a simulation model layer and an application service layer, wherein the physical model layer is used for acquiring geographical information of the power distribution network, equipment account data of the power distribution network, topological structures of the power distribution network, user load information and historical typhoon scene libraries, the data interaction layer is used for accessing data acquired by the physical model layer, the simulation model layer is used for simulating typhoon fields, equipment failure rate calculation, typhoon scene simulation, load loss calculation, equipment toughness calculation and equipment vulnerability sequencing, and the application service layer is used for providing a reinforcement strategy for the power distribution network to cope with typhoon disasters. The utility model also discloses a method for improving the toughness of the distribution network under typhoon disasters based on digital twinning. According to the invention, real-time synchronization of a physical entity and a digital model is realized, multi-source heterogeneous data are deeply fused, and the reinforcement requirements of power distribution network equipment in two different reinforcement modes facing typhoon disasters are met by embedding two different toughness promotion models.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Method, equipment and medium for evaluating toughness of large-scale urban power grid recovered after disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, equipment and medium for evaluating toughness of a large-scale urban power grid recovered after disaster, which are used for constructing a large-scale urban power grid fault scene and a time-varying fault probability model of a power transmission line under earthquake disaster, generating an earthquake-fault combined scene based on Monte Carlo simulation, selecting k high-risk typical scenes, constructing a grid disaster cooperative recovery model by taking the total weighted load recovery amount in a system full recovery period as a core optimization target to maximum, constructing a multi-dimensional dynamic toughness index system based on grid frame robustness, system self-recovery capacity and post-disaster repair capacity, evaluating the toughness level of the large-scale urban power grid recovered after disaster cooperatively, and outputting the priority ordering of an optimization strategy. By evaluating the toughness level of the large-scale urban power grid which is cooperatively recovered after the power grid disaster, the overall process performance of the recovery can be comprehensively quantized, the advantages and disadvantages of strategies can be effectively distinguished, the recovery speed and the recovery degree can be accurately quantized, and therefore an effective recovery strategy can not be adopted, and a reliable basis is provided for the disaster prevention and emergency of the power grid.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Urban flood real-time dynamic risk assessment method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city flood real-time dynamic risk assessment method based on multi-source data fusion, belonging to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of smart cities; the method comprises the steps of firstly collecting physical perception data, virtual perception data and forecast data in parallel, then generating a dynamic flood deep water field with high space-time resolution through fusion and simplification of hydrodynamic model simulation, data assimilation correction and video and social multimedia ponding information identification, further carrying out real-time dynamic risk assessment by combining multidimensional disaster-bearing body data such as population, infrastructure and traffic to generate a comprehensive risk index, and finally visualizing the result and issuing early warning. The method effectively solves the problems of lag evaluation and low space precision of the traditional method, realizes accurate and dynamic sensing and evaluation of urban flood risk minute-level updating by introducing a multi-source data fusion and feedback learning mechanism, and remarkably improves urban flood prevention emergency response capability.
assignees: SUZHOU JIUZHANG TONGSUAN INFORMATION IND CO LTD

title_en: Bayesian network-based large-scale liquefaction disaster quick response analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Bayesian network-based large-scale liquefaction disaster quick response analysis method and a Bayesian network-based large-scale liquefaction disaster quick response analysis system, which relate to the technical field of geotechnical engineering earthquake resistance and comprise the steps of carrying out earthquake risk decoupling on an area to be analyzed based on CPSHA, and determining the magnitude and the midrange of a plurality of earthquake events; the method comprises the steps of simulating by adopting a kinematic mixed seismic source model of fault physical rupture to obtain seismic parameters of an area to be analyzed, constructing a liquefaction sample library, constructing soil liquefaction evaluation parameters, carrying out standardized treatment on the soil liquefaction evaluation parameters to obtain raster data, respectively extracting numerical values from the raster data and the liquefaction sample library to form a sampling table, carrying out accuracy analysis and data training on the sampling table to form a conditional probability table, and calculating liquefaction probability and non-liquefaction probability of the area to be analyzed through a naive Bayesian probability model and a weighted naive Bayesian probability model based on the conditional probability table. The invention relieves the technical problems of high cost and time consumption in the prior art.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN CHENGJIAN

title_en: Embankment underwater piping detection positioning system integrating distributed optical fiber acoustics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dyke underwater piping detection positioning system integrating distributed fiber acoustics, which relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering safety monitoring and comprises a voiceprint signal perception primary screening module, a primary filtering module and a secondary filtering module, wherein the voiceprint signal perception primary screening module is used for acquiring original acoustic vibration signals in a strong noise environment, primarily purifying and separating the original acoustic vibration signals to acquire eigenmode functions of different frequency bands, and separating weak piping suspected signals submerged in background noise. According to the invention, by introducing a digital twin technology, the inferred seepage network is mapped into a high-precision fluid-structure coupling model, and the evolution process of water level abrupt change and other extreme working conditions is simulated in a virtual space, so that the system can calculate the final form, size and position of a burst, the consequences of piping disasters are pushed from fuzzy qualitative judgment to precise quantitative prediction, and the dynamic deduction and quantitative prediction of the piping disaster process based on a physical mechanism are realized.

title_en: Intelligent collaborative supporting and recycling method for incomplete mining of special-shaped ore pillars in limited space
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent collaborative supporting and recycling method for incomplete mining of special-shaped ore pillars in a limited space, and belongs to the technical field of mining engineering. Aiming at the problems of narrow space, complex stress, high safety risk and the like faced by the recovery of the special-shaped ore pillars in a limited space, the method constructs an intelligent closed loop system of perception-decision-execution-feedback. The method comprises the steps of constructing a dynamic digital twin model by utilizing LiDAR and GPR fusion detection, carrying out extraction-support collaborative optimization design based on numerical simulation and AI algorithm, carrying out accurate segmented extraction by adopting low-disturbance blasting and miniature intelligent equipment, synchronously implementing 'extraction-support-charge' cyclic operation, quickly constructing an artificial key layer by utilizing quick-setting expansion materials, and finally realizing multistage intelligent early warning and dynamic regulation through a multi-element sensing network. The invention can obviously improve the recovery rate of the residual mine resources to more than 90%, effectively control the ground pressure disasters and realize the green, safe and efficient recovery of the mine resources.
assignees: GANNAN UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Intelligent landslide rainfall simulation system and method based on AI historical rainfall data drive
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent landslide rainfall simulation system and method based on AI historical rainfall data driving, and belongs to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning. Through automatic fusion of multisource monitoring data and space-time feature extraction and combination of deep learning and physical mechanism modeling, dynamic coupling analysis and high-precision simulation of rainfall process and slope stability are realized. The system can sense rainfall, soil moisture content and slope deformation multi-class data in real time, intelligently identify landslide induction risk, output grading early warning information and support digital twin and self-adaptive risk optimization decisions. The landslide hazard risk assessment and early warning accuracy and response timeliness are remarkably improved, the landslide hazard risk assessment and early warning method has good intelligence, expansibility and practical application value, and is widely applicable to the fields of geological disaster prevention and control and engineering safety monitoring.

title_en: Digital twin river basin geological disaster early warning prevention and control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-basin geological disaster early warning prevention and control system which comprises monitoring data such as rainfall, soil humidity, air temperature, earthquake, landslide, debris flow and the like, a risk judging module, a digital twin modeling module and a simulation system, wherein the monitoring data is used for collecting geological structures, land utilization conditions and vegetation coverage data in a current basin, the risk judging module is used for analyzing the collected data to judge whether geological disaster risks exist, the digital twin modeling module is used for constructing a virtual basin geological disaster model by utilizing various collected data, simulating various disaster scenes occurring in the current basin and comprising landslide, debris flow and flood.
assignees: INST OF GEOLOGY AND NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION GANSU ACADEMY OF SCIENCE

title_en: Mobile platform of goaf three-dimensional laser scanner
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a movable platform of a goaf three-dimensional laser scanner, which belongs to the technical field of general investigation of hidden disaster-causing factors of strip mines and comprises a vehicle body and an operation table, wherein a rubber gasket is arranged at the inner bottom of the vehicle body, two fixed steel plates are fixedly connected to the top of the rubber gasket, a fixed frame is arranged at the inner side of the fixed steel plates, a winch is arranged in the fixed frame, a drilling goaf scanner cable is arranged at the outer side of the winch, four supporting legs are fixedly connected to the bottom of the operation table, a control box is arranged at the top of the operation table, a probe rod is arranged at the right side of the fixed steel plates, the operation steps are basically only carried out two steps of assembly and scanning after the integration, the operation efficiency is improved by more than 1 time, the opened trunk tail door can also be used for assisting an operator in sunshade and rain-shielding, the humanization and comfortableness of the operation are greatly improved, only one main operator and one auxiliary operator can easily finish the operation after the integration, the manpower is reduced, the detachable connection mode is adopted, and the vehicle can be quickly restored to the original vehicle state, and the normal use of the vehicle is not affected after the restoration.
assignees: YITAI YILI MINING CO LTD

title_en: Multi-disaster-oriented environment-coupled power grid vulnerability assessment method, system and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-disaster-oriented environment coupling type power grid vulnerability assessment method and system, which relate to the technical field of fault assessment, wherein the power transmission line is decomposed into electric tower nodes and virtual nodes, so that the calculation complexity of linear damage is reduced, the second-level time sequence simulation of a power grid is supported, and a multi-disaster unified coupling mechanism is constructed, namely a geographic matrix, an environment matrix and a meteorological matrix are constructed, various disaster damage models are driven, and the joint quantification of a 'disaster chain' physical process is realized; and finally, taking the topological power supply availability and the cascade failure fault condition as damage measurement indexes, and respectively carrying out grid vulnerability assessment under the earthquake disaster scene and the storm disaster scene, thereby solving the problem of underestimation of faults caused by neglecting power redistribution in the traditional model.
assignees: PLA INFORMATION SUPPORT FORCE ENGINEERING UNIV

title_en: Digital twin-based equipment fault diagnosis and insulation degradation prediction system
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 기반 설비이상 진단 및 절연열화 예측 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 수배전반 또는 빌딩제어시스템 내부에서 아크카운터 및 새그카운터로 부터 획득한 데이터를 센서 데이터 처리모듈로 송신하여 저장하는 계통고장 검출장치류;와 화재 및 지진(진동)발생시 상황을 검출하여 재난상황을 예측, 진단할 수 있도록 센서로부터 획득한 데이터를 센서 데이터 처리모듈로 송신하여 저장하는 방재감시용 센서류; 상기 계통고장 검출장치류, 방재감시용 센서류로부터 생성된 데이터를 수집하여 DB에 저장하고, 필요 정보를 현장 모니터에 표시하는 설비이상 진단장치; 상기 설비이상 진단장치를 통해 고장원인을 포함하는 고장 데이터를 통신으로 전송받아 디지털 트윈 가상 시스템에 정보를 제공하는 가상시스템 통신모듈;을 포함하고 상기 디지털 트윈 가상 시스템은 센서 데이터 처리 모듈에서 제공하는 데이터를 기반으로, 열화경향 예측, 화재감시 및 예측 그리고 설비이상 진단을 위한 시뮬레이션을 시행하는 가상 시뮬레이션 모듈; 상기 시뮬레이션 모듈에서 시뮬레이션을 시행할 시 조건값, 경계값을 설정하는 파라미터 셋업모듈; 시뮬레이션을 통해 이미지를 디스플레이 하도록 데이터를 가공처리하여 현장 설비운영자에게 정보를 전달하는 디지털 트윈 그래픽 생성모듈;을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 디지털 트윈 기반 설비이상 진단 및 절연열화 예측 시스템을 제공한다.
assignees: GOLDTECH CO LTD

title_en: Camer with auto focus and light image stabilization function
title_ko: 자동 초점 및 광 이미지 안정화 기능을 갖는 카메라
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 수배전반 또는 빌딩제어시스템 내부에서 아크카운터 및 새그카운터로 부터 획득한 데이터를 센서 데이터 처리모듈로 송신하여 저장하는 고장검출장치;와 화재 및 지진(진동)발생시 상황을 검출하여 재난상황을 예측, 진단할 수 있도록 센서로부터 획득한 데이터를 센서 데이터 처리모듈로 송신하여 저장하는 방재감시장치; 상기 고장검출장치, 방재감시장치로부터 생성된 데이터를 수집하여 DB에 저장하고, 필요 정보를 현장 모니터에 표시하는 설비이상 진단장치; 상기 설비이상 진단장치를 통해 고장원인을 포함하는 고장 데이터를 통신으로 전송받아 디지털 트윈 가상 시스템에 정보를 제공하는 통신모듈;을 포함하고 상기 디지털 트윈 가상 시스템은 센서 데이터 처리 모듈에서 제공하는 데이터를 기반으로, 열화경향 예측, 화재감시 및 예측 그리고 설비이상 진단을 위한 시뮬레이션을 시행하는 가상 시뮬레이션 모듈; 상기 시뮬레이션 모듈에서 시뮬레이션을 시행할 시 조건값, 경계값을 설정하는 셋업모듈; 시뮬레이션을 통해 이미지를 디스플레이 하도록 데이터를 가공처리하여 현장 설비운영자에게 정보를 전달하는 디지털 트윈 그래픽 생성모듈;을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 디지털 트윈 기반 설비이상 진단 및 절연열화 예측 시스템을 제공한다.
assignees: GOLDTECH CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster early warning method and geological disaster early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster early warning method and a geological disaster early warning system, which relate to the technical field of geological disaster early warning, and the method comprises the steps of setting a geological disaster monitoring area, arranging a data terminal and a plurality of monitoring sensors in the set geological disaster monitoring area, setting a collection period at the same time, periodically collecting historical geological disaster data in the geological disaster monitoring area, processing the collected historical geological disaster data in a data processing mode, and analyzing the processed historical geological disaster data in a data analysis mode after the processing is completed; meanwhile, a geological disaster simulation prediction model is constructed based on the analyzed historical geological disaster data in a data fusion and digital twin mode, finally, the geological disaster data in the geological disaster monitoring area are collected in real time and input into the geological disaster simulation prediction model, and geological disaster early warning is carried out according to an output result, so that accuracy of the geological disaster early warning is improved.
assignees: NUCLEAR INDUSTRY SOUTHWEST SURVEY & DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Rapid emergency decision method and system for sudden natural disasters of electric power
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rapid emergency decision method and system for sudden natural disasters of electric power, and belongs to the technical field of emergency decision of electric power disasters. The method comprises the steps of deducing disaster intensity through superposition of early warning information and real-time states of a power grid, obtaining a predicted fault probability set, obtaining experience data through a matching history case, generating a defensive plan, carrying out feature extraction on multi-source heterogeneous monitoring data collected in real time, obtaining a confirmed fault equipment set based on evidence fusion, constructing the real-time states of the power grid by combining a CIM model, carrying out plan primary selection on the defensive plan and the real-time states of the power grid through multidimensional quantitative comparison, carrying out processing decision based on a matching result, and outputting an emergency disposal plan after simulation verification. Based on digital twin and multi-source data fusion, the method realizes equipment-level disaster damage prediction, minute-level situation awareness and second-level scheme generation, and continuously improves the disaster prevention and quick recovery capacity of the power grid through self-adaptive optimization.
assignees: DONGFANG ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Semantic interactive extreme scene generation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a semantic interactive extreme scene generation method and system, and belongs to the technical field of meteorological disaster simulation and safety analysis of an electric power system. The method comprises the steps of receiving natural language input of a user, converting the natural language input into structural parameters comprising time, quantity, intensity levels and geographic positions through semantic analysis, dynamically selecting and calling a specialized neural network model corresponding to the intensity levels or generating typhoon full life cycle parameters based on an empirical track model according to whether the specific intensity levels are specified, further simulating typhoon wind fields and rainfall fields, calculating influences of the typhoon wind fields and the rainfall fields on a transmission tower, an overhead conductor and a wind power field, obtaining response data of a power system, and finally simulating and generating a power system extreme scene under the action of typhoon through Monte Carlo. The method realizes the whole-flow intelligent generation from natural language driving to controllable-intensity typhoon scenes, improves the accuracy, efficiency and usability of scene generation, and is suitable for the elastic assessment and disaster prevention decision support of the power system.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: Method and system for post-disaster node disturbance quantification and energy storage optimization configuration of power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for quantifying node disturbance after a power grid disaster and optimizing energy storage, wherein the method and the system are used for randomly simulating disturbance influence of the typhoon disaster on each node of the power grid based on historical typhoon data by using a Monte Carlo method to obtain probability that each node is influenced by small disturbance under the typhoon disaster condition, and the method is used for reserving equivalent disturbance intensity of the nodes after reduction based on probability equivalent calculation by using a Kron reduction method, constructing a system state-space model based on the equivalent disturbance intensity, constructing an energy storage configuration optimizing problem based on the system state-space model and inertia values which can be provided by a distributed energy storage system to be configured, solving the optimizing problem by using a projection gradient descent method to obtain an optimal energy storage configuration result, accurately quantifying the disturbance intensity after the disaster on each node, effectively reflecting the influence of the disaster on the power grid node, and obviously improving the recovery capability of the power grid in case of frequency change and power disturbance after the disaster, thereby effectively improving the recovery capability and stability of the system when the power grid faces the disaster.
assignees: ECONOMIC RESEARCH INST OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Multi-user anti-interference decision method based on sparse strategy propagation
abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-user anti-interference decision method based on sparse strategy propagation, which comprises the steps of 1, determining the number of sub-slots of a user according to interference detection history, 2, determining the information transmission rate of sub-slots according to a spreading factor, 3, determining system throughput and an optimization target according to a signal-to-noise ratio of a receiving end, 4, determining a state space, an action space, a state transition probability matrix and rewards in a decision process, 5, obtaining lower-layer main network parameters according to experience samples and a loss function, 6, obtaining upper-layer main network parameters according to experience samples and a loss function, and 7, obtaining an optimal anti-interference strategy according to iterative training. The application reduces the decision complexity and avoids dimension disasters.
assignees: UNIV ARMY ENGINEERING PLA

title_en: Intelligent storm disaster early warning method and system based on risk assessment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a storm disaster intelligent early warning method and system based on risk assessment, which relates to the technical field of storm early warning, and comprises the steps of 1. Data acquisition, 2. Evacuation strategy generation and 3. Linkage control and optimization, wherein a ponding converging path and a water inlet source are traced back by acquiring multisource information of key areas of stations along the line of a motor car and utilizing a three-dimensional digital twin model along the line of the motor car and a hydrodynamic simulation engine thereof, the evacuation channel plugging risk is evaluated, a real-time optimal personnel personalized evacuation path and an emergency guiding instruction are generated and issued, the operation mode and the flood control equipment operation along the line are adjusted in a linkage mode, the evacuation efficiency is evaluated, the follow-up strategy is optimized, the problems that the plugging risk is inaccurate in research and judgment, personalized evacuation and closed loop optimization are lacking in the prior art are solved, and the storm disaster early warning and emergency handling capacity of each station along the line of the motor car is effectively improved.
assignees: Xining Meteorological Bureau

title_en: Scheduling method and system based on linear alternating current power flow
abstract_en: The invention discloses a scheduling method and a scheduling system based on linear alternating current power flow, which belong to the technical field of electric power, wherein the method comprises the steps of setting a probability threshold value based on a vulnerability curve of real-time disaster data, and screening to form an expected initial fault set; modifying the power grid topology according to fault and overload information, preferentially searching and identifying isolated islands according to breadth, calculating the expected lowest frequency of the isolated islands and executing recovery operation, calculating power flow based on a linear alternating current power flow model, simulating relay protection and self-installation operation, identifying overload branches according to overload severity indexes and circularly processing, and executing an optimal scheduling strategy to eliminate overload. The method solves the problems of low cascading failure simulation accuracy, unstable tide solving and the like under extreme disasters, improves the authenticity of failure simulation and the dispatching reliability, can effectively block cascading failure propagation, reduces load loss and provides support for stable operation of the power system in the disasters.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: Water-electricity coupling system toughness assessment method considering drought risk evolution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a toughness evaluation method of a water-electricity coupling system considering drought risk evolution, and relates to the technical field of water-electricity coupling systems. The method comprises the steps of S1, modeling a water-electricity coupling system network, S2, modeling drought risk propagation of the water-electricity coupling network based on seepage, and S3, performing system simulation and toughness assessment on the water-electricity coupling system network based on the two models. According to the method, a heterogeneous weighted double-layer network model is built, a trans-scale dynamics modeling method is developed, a seepage theory and physical flow are dynamically combined, a disaster cascade propagation bi-directional seepage equation is built, a toughness assessment framework based on the seepage theory is provided, the laws of different coupling effects of the hydro-electric system are revealed, and scientific basis can be provided for risk assessment, toughness improvement and emergency management strategy formulation of key infrastructure.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING CHEM TECH

title_en: Bridge collapse disaster early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bridge collapse disaster early warning method and system, and relates to the technical field of bridge monitoring. The bridge damage evolution prediction method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source health monitoring data of a bridge in real time, including strain monitoring data, displacement monitoring data, sedimentation monitoring data, vibration monitoring data, crack monitoring data, environment and load data, carrying out data fusion after preprocessing operation on the multi-source health monitoring data to obtain multi-source fusion data, constructing a bridge damage evolution prediction model based on a long-short-time memory neural network by taking the multi-source fusion data as input, predicting a bridge dynamic damage evolution trend, calculating collapse probability of the bridge in different time scales by adopting Monte Carlo simulation and combining static risk reference values and the bridge dynamic damage evolution trend, and setting a critical threshold value, wherein when the collapse probability reaches the critical threshold value, triggering an early warning signal and carrying out graded early warning. The method and the device identify the collapse precursor signal in advance, and early warning is accurate and efficient.
assignees: RESEARCH INST OF HIGHWAY MINISTRY OF TRANSPORT

title_en: Disaster prevention and reduction decision method and system for natural disasters and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to the technical field of intelligent emergency, and discloses a disaster prevention and reduction decision method, a system and electronic equipment for natural disasters, wherein the decision method comprises the steps of constructing a prediction set, a training set and a condition vector; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a first prediction set corresponding to real-time data based on a training set and a stacked long-short-time memory network, generating an countermeasure network by using conditions, obtaining a second prediction data set by combining a condition vector, carrying out weight fusion on the second prediction data set by using a self-adaptive deep convolutional neural network to obtain a fused space-time data sequence, and generating a future N-hour disaster risk distribution map by combining a multi-scale space-time convolutional neural network based on the fused space-time data sequence. The decision method and the decision system disclosed by the application have the advantages that the accuracy and the adaptability of filling the missing data are improved, the occurrence and the development of disasters are precisely matched in the space dimension and the time dimension, and the recognition and prediction accuracy of disaster situations is improved.
assignees: Zhangjiajie Meteorological Bureau

title_en: Control method for balancing cost and loss of service system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method for balancing cost and loss of a service system, which comprises the following steps of S1) constructing a service loss quantification model based on service influence analysis, converting service interruption time and data loss into economic losses and constructing a loss function, S2) constructing a technical cost quantification model comprising redundant resource cost, recovery operation cost and network bandwidth synchronization cost, constructing a cost function, S3) solving a multi-objective optimization function by adopting a balance algorithm engine, introducing constraint conditions to minimize total cost, dynamically generating an optimal RTO value and RPO value combination, S4) dynamically distributing disaster-tolerant resources based on service importance level hierarchical design, S5) simulating a disaster scene through a high-availability test, verifying actual RTO value and RPO value, and feeding back to the balance algorithm engine for parameter calibration. The invention can dynamically generate the optimal RTO/RPO combination, obviously reduce the comprehensive cost and improve the disaster recovery efficiency.
assignees: CHINA PACIFIC PROPERTY INSURANCE CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution rush repair construction method optimization method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution rush-repair construction method optimization method, a system, equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source data of a power distribution line in a disaster area, and constructing a basic power grid topological graph for post-disaster rush-repair according to the multi-source data; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a basic power grid topological graph, combining rush repair operation to obtain a topological evolution tensor, obtaining a preset atomic operation set to generate candidate work method sequences, evaluating the candidate work method sequences, calculating comprehensive scores of each candidate work method sequence, sequencing the candidate work method sequences by utilizing the comprehensive scores to obtain a preferable work method sequence, executing a power restoration operation according to the preferable work method sequence and the topological evolution tensor, carrying out on-line monitoring, establishing a digital twin model to simulate, correcting deviation of a monitoring result and a simulation result, optimizing the power restoration operation, and maintaining continuity and stability of voltage and current in the power restoration process.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Storm surge three-dimensional non-static pressure coupling forecasting method considering topographic abrupt change effect
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ocean numerical simulation and disaster prediction, and discloses a storm tide three-dimensional non-static pressure coupling prediction method considering a topography abrupt change effect, which is based on a non-static pressure ocean dynamics theory and a topography self-adaptive grid technology, establishes a storm tide three-dimensional non-static pressure coupling prediction system, is internally provided with a data acquisition module, a topography data preprocessing module, a non-static pressure three-dimensional hydrodynamic module, an atmosphere forced coupling module, a tide level boundary condition module, a topography abrupt change detection and correction module, a data assimilation module, a regional decomposition module, a prediction output module and a visualization module, the three-dimensional hydrodynamic model considering the non-static pressure effect is established through multi-source data acquisition and terrain mutation identification, a sigma coordinate system and a split format algorithm are adopted to accurately solve a speed field and a pressure field, the atmospheric forcing and tide boundary conditions are combined, the initial field is optimized through a data assimilation technology, and finally the forecasting results of storm surge tide level, three-dimensional flow speed and temperature and salinity are simulated effectively.
assignees: HUANENG CLEAN ENERGY RESEARCH INST;HUANENG YANTAI NEW ENERGY CO LTD;HUANENG OFFSHORE WIND POWER SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH CO LTD

title_en: Ground disaster rescue method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a ground disaster rescue method and a ground disaster rescue system, which belong to the field of unmanned aerial vehicles, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring real-time geological environment data of a geological disaster area, including geographic data, meteorological data and geological data, and constructing a digital twin model corresponding to the geological disaster area based on the real-time geological environment data; the method comprises the steps of inputting real-time geological environment data into a digital twin model for virtual simulation, obtaining expected change conditions of a geological disaster area, planning a search path according to the expected change conditions of the geological disaster area, sending the search path to an unmanned aerial vehicle, receiving trapped personnel information on the search path returned by the unmanned aerial vehicle, planning a rescue route based on the trapped personnel information and the expected change conditions of the geological disaster area, and sending the rescue route to an execution terminal to guide rescue. The application can provide real-time and accurate rescue paths according to the change condition of geological disasters.
assignees: CHINA TOWER CO LTD;TOWER ZHILIAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Regional level electricity-heat-disaster storage post-intelligent recovery method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent recovery method and system after regional electricity-heat-disaster storage, belongs to the technical field of power grid planning, and solves the problem that a power distribution network cannot recover autonomously under an extreme event. The method comprises the steps of obtaining historical data related to power grid equipment fault diagnosis, preprocessing, extracting features, constructing various extreme event scenes, evaluating survivability index prediction redundancy requirements, constructing island division and path optimization scheduling models and constraint conditions thereof to optimize load recovery efficiency, constructing a graph neural network model to predict energy storage configuration requirements, energy storage types and energy storage time windows, and constructing an area level recovery mechanism oriented to an electric-thermal-storage multi-energy system to generate a step recovery sequence through state vector modeling, block autonomous judgment, rule engine reasoning and state evolution simulation. The energy supply maintainability of the load points is measured through the viability index, and the recovery path is dynamically optimized by combining a strategy scoring mechanism, so that the autonomy, self-healing and efficient scheduling of the post-disaster system are realized.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Power grid emergency material scheduling method under rain, snow and freezing disasters based on robust optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid emergency material scheduling method under a rain, snow and freezing disaster, which comprises the steps of obtaining meteorological data and traffic facility information under the rain, snow and freezing disaster, constructing a line fault probability prediction model, adopting Monte Carlo simulation to generate a disaster scene, obtaining a typical disaster scene set through a scene reduction technology, constructing a joint scheduling optimization mathematical model which considers emergency material allocation and emergency equipment allocation and comprises a pre-disaster pre-deployment stage and an in-disaster dynamic response stage, adopting an improved column and constraint generation algorithm to solve the two-stage robust optimization problem, gradually converging to a robust optimal solution, outputting an optimal emergency material and emergency repair team scheduling scheme, determining a repair target and an optimal driving path of the emergency repair team, generating a post-disaster grid and traffic system cooperative recovery strategy, realizing quick recovery and reasonable configuration of emergency resources, and further improving the emergency response speed and recovery capacity of the power grid under the snow, freezing and the rain disaster.
assignees: STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER ENGINEERING RESEARCH INST CO LTD;UNIV FUZHOU

title_en: Marine product typhoon disaster risk assessment method based on raft culture and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a marine product typhoon disaster risk assessment method based on raft culture and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of assimilating multisource measured data into an environment model through a data assimilation algorithm, and simulating an environment field of a target culture sea area according to the assimilation corrected environment model; applying the environmental load corresponding to the environmental field to a structural model of the raft culture structure for dynamic response analysis, calculating a structural strength index according to an analysis result, calculating a vitality index of marine products according to a preset environmental factor, and determining the risk level of the valve culture structure through a random forest model according to the structural strength index, the vitality index of the marine products and the disaster-causing factor. The invention can realize comprehensive and objective risk assessment and can improve the accuracy of assessment.
assignees: ISTRONG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Heterogeneous evaporation waveguide channel monitoring system and method based on multilink multiband signals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heterogeneous evaporation waveguide channel monitoring system and method based on multilink multiband signals, wherein the heterogeneous evaporation waveguide channel monitoring system is built by combining a channel monitoring module, a data communication module and a data processing module, an objective function is built by combining monitoring data, an evaporation waveguide section model and an electric wave propagation model through multilink multiband actual measurement path loss and simulation path loss, an optimal group of heterogeneous evaporation waveguide channel characteristic distribution is searched and solved through an optimization algorithm, a nonlinear likelihood model between optimal heterogeneous evaporation waveguide channel characteristics and signal propagation path loss is built, probability distribution of the optimal heterogeneous evaporation waveguide channel characteristics is calculated, and confidence interval of the probability distribution is estimated. The invention improves the reliability and robustness of the inversion result of the non-uniform evaporation waveguide channel characteristics in the complex ocean environment, realizes the long-term real-time, efficient and high-precision inversion of the non-uniform evaporation waveguide channel characteristics in the large-area sea area, and provides full-time data support for the detection of the offshore beyond-view radar, the evaluation of the electromagnetic environment and the disaster early warning.
assignees: UNIV NORTHWESTERN POLYTECHNICAL

title_en: Multi-mode linkage control and remote state monitoring system of fire-fighting facility
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-mode linkage control and remote state monitoring system of a fire-fighting facility, which is used for collecting multi-mode data of the fire-fighting facility in real time through a sensor array, constructing a building digital twin model based on three-dimensional point cloud data and a BIM model, training in combination with a generated countermeasure network GANs, carrying out simulated simulation on a fire development trend, grading and risk assessment on the fire, formulating dynamic linkage rules of the fire-fighting equipment, respectively controlling linkage of different fire-fighting equipment based on different risk degrees of the fire and in combination with the self state of the fire-fighting equipment, optimizing the linkage rules of the fire-fighting equipment based on a reinforcement learning algorithm, and remotely monitoring the self state of the fire-fighting equipment in real time, and timely processing if the state is judged to be abnormal. The fire disaster identification accuracy is improved through multi-mode data linkage, the processing efficiency is improved based on digital twin dynamic mapping, and the linkage rule is intelligently adjusted according to the fire disaster and equipment states, so that multi-mode linkage control and remote state monitoring of the fire fighting equipment are realized.
assignees: GUANGZHOU CHUANGXIANGYUN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Flood disaster cascade event evolution prediction method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flood disaster prediction and discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for predicting the evolution of a flood disaster cascade event. According to the method, entity nodes and relationship types in a river basin are built into knowledge graphs updated along with time, the evolution of a flood disaster cascade event is reflected in real time by utilizing a node attribute dynamic update and a relationship edge weight dynamic adjustment mechanism, meanwhile, time features are embedded into the knowledge graph nodes and relationship edges, the time dependence represented by the nodes is enhanced, finally, a relationship evolution graph convolution neural network is adopted to infer the knowledge graphs, information of neighbor nodes is aggregated through the graph convolution neural network by utilizing each relationship edge, and respective propagation intensity is adjusted based on the relationship types, so that the result output by the graph convolution network is focused on the structural relationship among the nodes, the edge weight is adjusted according to the change of the node attribute, and the development venation of the flood disaster is accurately simulated.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CORP;CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD;CHINA INST OF WATER RESOURCES AND HYDROPOWER RESEARCH

title_en: Landslide hazard source identification and dynamic risk assessment method in mountain canyon region
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and control, and discloses a landslide hazard source identification and dynamic risk assessment method in a mountain canyon region, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of S1 regional pregnancy mode analysis and identification target region definition, namely constructing a comprehensive vulnerability evaluation model, and defining investigation target regions with different priorities by combining InSAR deformation monitoring; S2, fine identification of potential sliding sources, namely accurately identifying landslide boundaries and deep structures by adopting a star-machine-ground cooperative technology combining multi-stage LiDAR terrain change detection, unmanned plane multispectral and thermal infrared detection and geophysical exploration, and S3, dynamic risk assessment, namely establishing a dynamic and static load coupling stability model considering heavy rain and earthquake working conditions, adopting Monte Carlo simulation to calculate instability probability, and combining disaster-bearing body vulnerability analysis to realize quantitative risk classification. The method realizes early identification, accurate positioning and dynamic risk quantification of landslide hazard sources, and improves the prevention and control capability of landslide disasters in the high mountain channel Gu Ou.
assignees: The First Geological Brigade of Sichuan Province;SICHUAN INST OF GEOLOGICAL ENGINEERING INVESTIGATION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Emergency training situation deduction method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of industrial digital twinning, and mainly relates to an emergency training situation deduction method based on digital twinning, which comprises the steps of deploying a plurality of types of data sensors in a chemical plant, collecting equipment states and environment parameters in real time, fusing plant design drawings, and constructing a high-precision digital twinning body consistent with a physical field; a fault propagation mechanism is established, so that the simulation situation can automatically and intelligently dynamically evolve according to initial conditions; the method includes continuously integrating real-time sensor data into a digital twin body, driving a virtual model to synchronously update the state, adjusting a disaster evolution path and key parameters according to real data flow, enabling a training person to operate virtual equipment on the spot by combining an AR technology, and identifying potential hidden hazards of a factory by combining an AI algorithm.
assignees: BEIJING ANJIU QIUSHENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Drainage pipeline risk early warning method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent water affairs and urban disaster prevention, and provides a drainage pipeline risk early warning method, system, equipment and medium, comprising the following steps of dividing a risk area by combining pipeline GIS data and historical faults, and differentially distributing temperature and strain sensing optical fibers to form a double-parameter network; synchronous sampling by a demodulator, processing data by a dynamic self-adaptive sliding window with a preset threshold value, and identifying abnormal fragments; after multi-source fusion correction, the initial evaluation event type and risk of the pre-trained CNN-LSTM model are input, pipeline digital twin simulation results are used for medium and above risks, four-level risks are judged, early warning is pushed according to grades, response is triggered, treatment feedback is collected, model parameters and risk threshold values are dynamically adjusted through incremental learning, accurate capture of micro-anomalies of the drainage pipeline and real-time quantitative evaluation of risks are achieved, meanwhile, the life cycle of the system is prolonged, operation and maintenance cost is reduced, and intelligent safe operation and maintenance of the drainage pipeline are achieved.
assignees: NORTH CHINA MUNICIPAL ENGINEERING DESIGN & RESEARCH INST CO LTD;TIANJIN DRAINAGE MAN TRANSACTION CENTER

title_en: Data acquisition device suitable for mountain region photovoltaic digital twin disaster-resistant simulation
