abstract_en: The invention relates to a data acquisition device suitable for mountain photovoltaic digital twin disaster-resistant simulation, which comprises a case shell, wherein a bearing mechanism is arranged at the rear side of the case shell, an adjusting mechanism is also arranged at the rear side of the case shell, a driving mechanism is arranged at the outer side of the case shell, an assembling mechanism is fixedly connected to the outer side of the driving mechanism, the driving mechanism is used for driving the assembling mechanism to rotate, and the adjusting mechanism is used for pressing the assembling mechanism. According to the invention, by arranging the screwing motor, the output rod, the extension rod, the connecting sleeve and other parts, through the transmission fit of the screwing motor and the output rod and the extension rod and the sliding fit of the guide groove and the guide block, the connecting sleeve can drive the screwing wheel to precisely move and rotate through the rotation of the extension rod and the guide of the guide groove, so that the effect that the device can replace manual operation through mechanical transmission and automatically dock external wiring harnesses of different monitoring devices is achieved.
assignees: MCC WUKAN ENGINEERING TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Mountain area slope stability analysis method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain area slope stability analysis method based on multi-source data fusion, which particularly relates to the technical field of slope engineering simulation by a digital twin technology, and is used for solving the problem that an optimal treatment scheme is difficult to quickly search for due to calculation and combination explosion in emergency response of sudden geological disasters in the existing digital twin, wherein forward stability analysis is carried out by constructing the digital twin of a slope, key geological structure units are identified and targeted emergency treatment measure combinations are generated when the safety coefficient is lower than a threshold value, space-time conduction effects among measures are evaluated to screen efficient synergistic target combinations, and finally the digital twin is used for calculating and predicting the safety coefficient and selecting the optimal emergency scheme to realize active prevention and control of slope risks and quick decision support.
assignees: ANHUI WATER CONSERVANCY TECHNICAL COLLEGE;UNIV TONGJI;UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Power system vulnerability assessment method and system considering extreme weather influence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system evaluation, and discloses a method and a system for evaluating vulnerability of a power system in consideration of extreme weather influence, wherein a line time-varying fault probability under the dynamic weather influence is determined by constructing a line fault probability model of the power system under the extreme weather, and an countermeasure network model and a Monte Carlo simulation generation typical scene are generated through time sequence relativity matching with gradient penalty; the method comprises the steps of taking a generated typical scene as input, simulating cascade fault evolution through an alternating current cascade fault model, and outputting a cascade fault evolution path, and further realizing multi-level vulnerability quantification of the power system by combining severity analysis, structural vulnerability assessment and causal-probability prejudgment through a spectrogram theory and a Bayesian network based on a fault evolution result, solving the problems of insufficient single-level assessment and neglecting causal association in the prior art, and improving the risk assessment precision and disaster prevention capability of the power system under extreme weather.
assignees: STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECHNOLOGICAL RESEARCH INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;EAST CHINA BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA;STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LIMITED;STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: System and method for establishing disaster recovery plan based on digital twin using disaster resilience index evaluation
title_ko: 재난회복력 지표 평가를 이용한 디지털 트윈 기반 재해 복구 계획 수립 시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 디지털 트윈 기반 재해 복구 계획 수립 시스템은 재난 피해 지역의 위치 정보와 피해 현황을 포함하는 피해 정보를 입력받아 상기 피해 지역의 3차원 디지털 트윈 모델을 생성하는 디지털 트윈 생성부; 상기 디지털 트윈 모델로부터 피해 시설물의 물리적 제약 조건을 추출하고, 복구 공법 데이터베이스를 조회하여 적용 가능한 복수의 복구 공법을 자동으로 추출하며, 각 복구 공법을 적용한 복수의 복구 시나리오를 자동으로 생성하는 시나리오 생성부; 상기 복수의 복구 시나리오 각각에 대하여, 재난 저항성, 복구 속도, 탄력성 및 유지보수 용이성을 포함하는 재난회복력 지표와, 안정성, 경제성, 시공성을 포함하는 일반 평가 지표를 이용하여 정량적 평가를 수행하는 시나리오 평가부; 및 상기 평가 결과에 기초하여 최적의 복구 시나리오를 추천하는 추천부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: CORETEC

title_en: Regional high-resolution atmospheric analysis data construction method and system based on dynamic downscaling and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional high-resolution atmospheric analysis data construction method based on dynamic downscaling, which aims to improve the depicting capability of a medium-small scale weather process. The method takes global analysis data as a background field, fuses multisource observation data and high-resolution land utilization information, and gradually constructs an analysis data set with resolution of an hour level and a kilometer level by constructing a multi-layer nested WRF area mode and executing multi-time short-period simulation in combination with an assimilation strategy of analysis Nudging and observation Nudging. Through comparison and verification of multisource observation data, the constructed data set is obviously superior to ERA5 in the aspects of ground meteorological elements and vertical profile structure restoration, and has stronger regional adaptability and simulation precision. The method is suitable for various high-resolution weather application scenes such as regional artificial intelligent weather large models, urban fine weather service, high-impact weather disaster early warning, regional weather change evaluation, energy weather resource evaluation and the like.
assignees: UNIV EAST CHINA NORMAL

title_en: Waterlogging disaster prevention and control method based on digital twin and related equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a waterlogging disaster prevention and control method based on digital twinning and related equipment, which are applied to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the steps of obtaining target farmland area information and a training sample set, preprocessing the training sample set to generate the training sample set with target feature data, obtaining a preset waterlogging disaster damage amount prediction model, processing the preset waterlogging disaster damage amount prediction model based on the training sample set with the target feature data to generate a target waterlogging disaster damage amount prediction model, processing the target farmland area information based on the target waterlogging disaster damage amount prediction model to generate attribute information of the target farmland area, and processing the attribute information of the target farmland area based on the target waterlogging disaster damage amount prediction model to generate waterlogging disaster management information of a monitoring point to be predicted.
assignees: HUBEI ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES INST OF FOOD CROPS

title_en: Digital twinning-based agricultural disaster prevention and control method and related equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a digital twinning-based agricultural disaster prevention and control method and related equipment, which are applied to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the steps of obtaining target farmland area information, a target event set and a training sample set which are matched with the target farmland area information, preprocessing the training sample set to generate a training sample set with target feature data, processing a preset disaster distributed ecological hydrologic model based on the training sample set with the target feature data to generate a target disaster distributed ecological hydrologic model, processing the target event set to generate farmland ecological early warning information of the target farmland area, processing the target farmland area information based on the target disaster distributed ecological hydrologic model to generate attribute information of the target farmland area, and processing the attribute information of the target farmland area and the farmland ecological early warning information of the target farmland area based on the target disaster distributed ecological hydrologic model to generate farmland early warning information of a monitoring point to be predicted.
assignees: HUBEI ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES INST OF FOOD CROPS

title_en: Intelligent flood prevention method for hydraulic engineering
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent flood prevention method for hydraulic engineering, and belongs to the technical field of hydraulic engineering. The method comprises the following steps of constructing a digital twin model of the hydraulic engineering and establishing a digital map, acquiring the engineering running state and meteorological hydrologic data of an area where the hydraulic engineering is located in real time, extracting the change characteristics of water yield, rainfall and engineering conditions, updating the state of the digital twin model, simulating the running process of the hydraulic engineering to predict the flood situation and disaster development trend, timely sensing possible abnormal conditions by monitoring the surrounding environment of the hydraulic engineering in real time, carrying out real-time analysis and optimization decision, providing timely and effective flood prevention suggestions and automatically triggering flood prevention measures when necessary, periodically updating and optimizing the digital twin model, combining the actual running data and new technical progress, continuously improving the accuracy and reliability of the model, and ensuring that a flood prevention system is always kept in an optimal state.
assignees: RUIYANGTIAN TIANJIN TECH CO LTD

title_en: A Risk Management System for Monitoring and Prediction of Hazardous Chemical Substance Risk Situations utilizing Machine Vision
title_ko: 머신비전을 활용한 유해화학물질 모니터링 및 예측을 위한 위험관리시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 유해화학물질 취급 현장의 위험을 관리하는 자가 진단 및 자율 대응 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 위험관리시스템은 Wi-SUN Mesh 네트워크 기반 지능형 센서 네트워크부, 영상 데이터 수집부, 중앙 처리 서버를 포함한다. 중앙 처리 서버는 IoT 센서의 시계열 데이터, CCTV 영상의 공간적 특징, 네트워크 상태 데이터를 융합하여 확장된 상태 벡터를 생성하는 다중 소스 데이터 융합부와, 디지털 트윈 환경에서 강화학습을 통해 누적 위험 회피 보상을 최대화하는 최적 대응 정책을 자율 학습하는 강화학습 기반 자율 대응 결정부, 및 실시간 컨텍스트 정보를 반영하여 동적 표준 운영 절차(SOP)를 생성·전파하는 전자 SOP 실행 및 상황 전파부를 포함한다. 
본 발명은 위험 예측 기반 선제적 통신 관리를 통해 골든타임 내 안정적 대응을 보장하며, 사전 정의된 시나리오에 의존하는 종래 기술의 한계를 극복하여 복잡한 재난 상황에서도 진정한 자율 대응을 가능하게 한다.
assignees: JUBIX

title_en: Dynamic emergency resource scheduling method, system and medium based on multidimensional data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic emergency resource scheduling method based on multidimensional data analysis, which belongs to the technical field of emergency management and resource scheduling and comprises the following steps of S1, multidimensional data acquisition and fusion, S2, disaster chain network construction, construction of a disaster chain evolution network model based on data of the step S1, calculation of node degree, medium centrality and weakness, identification of key risk nodes and evolution paths, S3, dynamic risk assessment, quantification of current risk level and prediction of future risk situation, S4, emergency resource optimization scheduling decision, priority blocking of a high risk chain propagation path according to a risk assessment result of the step S3, and scheduling implementation feedback regulation. According to the invention, through effectively fusing multidimensional dynamic information such as real-time weather, infrastructure states, social disaster-bearing bodies and the like, dynamic simulation and risk assessment of a disaster chain evolution rule are actively carried out, disaster spread is effectively controlled, and overall loss is reduced.
assignees: URBAN SAFETY AND ENVIRONMENT SCIENCE INST BEIJING INST OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Ammonia fuel safety control system
abstract_en: The central safety control unit of the invention is used as an intelligent brain, integrates data from five core link monitoring modules of filling, storing, air supplying, consuming and discharging, and receives signals of a global environment monitoring network covering a full ship dangerous area. Based on the real-time information, the central control unit performs risk simulation and evaluation through a built-in digital twin risk early warning model, drives a linkage emergency response executing mechanism and executes accurate emergency actions. The high-efficiency ammonia leakage neutralization treatment module is integrated, and the safety and the efficiency of leakage emergency treatment are greatly improved by combining a directional water curtain and a negative pressure drainage technology. The safety challenges of the ammonia fuel ship in the aspects of complexity, toxicity and corrosiveness are systematically solved, and key safety guarantee is provided for decarburization in the shipping industry.
assignees: DALIAN SHIPBUILDING INDUSTRY

title_en: Urban water supply system earthquake resistance evaluation method considering function decline of water treatment plant
abstract_en: An urban water supply system earthquake resistance evaluation method considering the function decline of a water treatment plant belongs to the technical field of urban water supply network earthquake resistance analysis. The method comprises the following steps of utilizing Monte Carlo to simulate sampling, generating earthquake damage scenes of various pipelines in the water supply network under the action of an earthquake, quantitatively determining the residual functional state of the water treatment plant after the earthquake through the vulnerability curve of the water treatment plant, establishing a coupling analysis model of the water treatment plant and the water supply network, realizing the coupling of the functional change between the water treatment plant and the network, integrating the damage of the network and the functional attenuation of the water treatment plant, and calculating the earthquake resistance index of the urban water supply system. The method quantitatively reflects the function attenuation of the water plant after earthquake by introducing the vulnerability curve of the water plant, and combines the water plant-pipe network coupling model, so that the whole earthquake resistance of the urban water supply system under earthquake disasters can be more scientifically and comprehensively estimated, and the method has important theoretical and practical significance for guiding earthquake resistance design, toughness improvement and emergency decision of the urban water supply system.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Mine emergency rescue multi-level off-site collaborative command training method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a mine emergency rescue multi-level remote collaborative command training method and system, which belong to the technical field of emergency rescue training and comprise the steps of integrating a disaster physical engine based on a mine three-dimensional model, simulating dynamic changes of disaster conditions to construct a digital twin model of a dynamic disaster scene, generating tactical advice and rescue behavior options according to mine emergency rescue terms and a historical case library, generating simulated different rescue schemes according to the tactical advice and the rescue behavior options by the digital twin model, evaluating the rescue schemes by using a tactical evaluation algorithm, generating a quantized comparison report, deploying a main control engine, uniformly managing global logic and data, generating a multi-terminal collaborative sand table interactive tactic according to the quantized comparison report, acquiring cross-department disaster conditions and resource states in real time, improving the feasibility of the plan, synchronizing tactical decisions and execution, and reducing the cost of the plan exercise and reproduction.
assignees: CCTEG SHENYANG RESEARCH INST

title_en: Underground space energy management system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The application provides an underground space energy management system based on a digital twin technology, which comprises a data processing module, a disaster prevention prediction module and a disaster prevention management module, wherein the data processing module is used for collecting operation data and layout data of an energy system of an underground space, constructing a digital twin body according to the operation data, the layout data and a preset simulation model, the disaster prevention prediction module is used for carrying out simulation deduction on a monitored disaster scene through the digital twin body to generate a disaster prevention prediction report, and the disaster prevention management module is used for generating a disaster prevention scheduling strategy according to the disaster prevention prediction report.
assignees: UNIV QINGDAO TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for nonlinear simulation and prediction of transmission line galloping based on micro-topography multi-source data driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transmission line galloping nonlinear simulation and prediction method, a system, equipment and a medium based on micro-topography multi-source data driving, which comprise the steps of analyzing a transmission line GIM model and geographic elevation data to construct a three-dimensional digital twin model; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a macroscopic meteorological wind speed, obtaining a wire local flow field by introducing a micro-topography correction factor to conduct scale-down correction on the macroscopic meteorological wind speed, then establishing a 3-DOF coupling dynamics equation comprising vertical, horizontal and torsion degrees of freedom based on nonlinear aerodynamic characteristics of the icing wire, finally solving a wire galloping track and amplitude through a time integration algorithm, and issuing risk early warning based on a phase-to-phase distance threshold. The method can truly reflect the coupling mechanism of the micro-topography wind field effect and the multiple degrees of freedom, remarkably improves the prediction accuracy of the galloping disasters of the power transmission line, and provides scientific basis for disaster prevention of the power grid.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Evacuation system using digital twin
title_ko: 디지털 트윈을 이용한 대피 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따르는 디지털 트윈을 이용한 대피 시스템은, 건물 내부 또는 외부에 배치되어 재난상황을 감지할 수 있도록 형성되는 복수의 제1 감지부; 상기 제1 감지부를 통해 기설정된 재난상황이 감지될 때, 근접한 대피자들에게 수신된 이동경로를 전달하는 복수의 알람부; 상기 재난상황의 유형 및 시간별 변화를 파악하고, 이를 토대로 상기 이동경로를 산출하여 상기 알람부들에 전송하는 시뮬레이션 서버; 및 상기 이동경로를 따라 이동하는 상기 대피자들의 상태를 감지하는 제2 감지부를 포함하고, 상기 시뮬레이션 서버는, 상기 이동경로를 따라 이동하는 상기 대피자들의 상태를 토대로 상기 대피자들마다 각각 최적화된 이동경로를 산출하여 전달하고, 외부의 응급대응기관에 상기 대피자들의 상태를 전달할 수 있다.
assignees: JINSYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Development of a digital twin-based 3D building energy monitoring system
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 기반 3d 건물 에너지 모니터링 시스템 개발
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 디지털 트윈 기반 3D 건물 에너지 모니터링 시스템 개발에 관한것으로서, 건물 내 전기, 화재, 열, 공기 정보를 실시간으로 수집이 가능한 센서를 구축하고 구축된 센서 데이터를 바탕으로 전기 에너지 수용량 및 효율분석, 건물 공간별 공기질 분석, 화재 대피를 위한 시뮬레이션 기반 대피로 분석 등 다양한 분석 서비스를 제공하고자 한다 
또한 디지털 트윈 환경 내 가상 설비 배치 기능을 제공하여 건물 내 공간별 에너지 최적화 방안을 도출하는 서비스를 제공하고자 한다. 
본 발명은 디지털 트윈 기반 3D 건물 에너지 모니터링 시스템을 개발하는것으로 건물 도면 및 전력 정보, 건물 전체 에너지 소비율 분석, 에너지 사용량 시각화, 상세정보 등을 제공하므로써 건물 에너지 절감이 가능하다 
또한 가상 환경내 설비 배치를 통한 효율 최적화 서비스를 제공하므로써 설비 배치 시뮬레이션을 통한 예상 전력 사용량 및 피크 전력량 초과등 전력망 부하관리가 가능하다. 
또한 건물 전체 에너지 사용량 분석 기반 에너지 최적화 히트맵 정보와 에너지 낭비, 누수 알림, 장애 등 에너지 사용량에 따른 에너지 최적화 개선 피드백이 가능하다.

title_en: Apparatus and method for disaster management at power generation facility construction site
title_ko: 발전 설비 공사 현장의 재해 관리 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 디지털 트윈 기술을 활용하여 발전 설비 공사 현장의 재해 발생을 예측하고 관리할 수 있는 장치 및 방법이 개시된다. 일 실시예에 따른 재해 관리 장치는 수행중인 공사 단계, 공사 영역, 작업자 작업 현황, 공사 달성 정도, 및 공사기간 단축/지연 상황 중 적어도 하나에 대한 정보를 수신하여 현장 정보를 생성하는 현장 관리부; 현장 정보 및 공사 계획 정보를 기초로 공사 단계 별 시뮬레이션을 수행하여 재해 발생 종류 및 가능성을 예측하며, 예측된 결과를 기초로 재해 정보 및 안전 정보 중 적어도 하나를 생성하는 시뮬레이션부; 및 재해 정보 및 안전 정보 중 적어도 하나를 작업자에게 전송하는 작업자 관리부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Soft rock tunnel large deformation prediction method based on particle swarm optimization neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunnel engineering disaster prediction, and discloses a soft rock tunnel large deformation prediction method based on a particle swarm optimization neural network, which comprises the steps of selecting geological construction characteristic parameters such as surrounding rock water content, construction method and the like as input factors, and establishing qualitative index and quantitative numerical mapping; the method comprises the steps of constructing an engineering sample data set based on orthogonal test design and numerical simulation, carrying out normalization processing, carrying out global iterative optimization on initial connection weight and bias of an error back propagation neural network by utilizing a particle swarm optimization algorithm, obtaining an optimal initial value by taking a network error as an fitness value, finally inputting data training to generate a mature model, outputting a predicted deformation value and carrying out engineering early warning by combining a double verification mechanism. The method solves the problems of slow convergence and easy sinking into local optimum caused by random initialization of parameters of the traditional neural network, and effectively improves the prediction precision of the large deformation of the soft rock tunnel and the reliability of engineering early warning.
assignees: CHINA CONSTR 8TH ENG DIVISION;CHINA CONSTR CIVIL ENG CO LTD

title_en: Power grid toughness assessment method and system based on urban lifeline cross-system interconnection
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for evaluating toughness of a power grid based on cross-system interconnection of urban lifelines, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a communication network model of the power grid to be evaluated in a target area; the method comprises the steps of carrying out fault propagation on a power grid to be evaluated under a preset disaster situation through a preset cascading fault mechanism to obtain a fault propagation result, carrying out recovery simulation on the power grid to be evaluated under the preset disaster situation through a preset recovery mechanism to obtain a recovery simulation result, analyzing the fault propagation result and the recovery simulation result based on a predefined structural toughness index to obtain the structural toughness of the power grid to be evaluated, analyzing the fault propagation result and the recovery simulation result based on a predefined functional toughness index to obtain the functional toughness of the power grid to be evaluated, fusing the structural toughness and the functional toughness to obtain comprehensive toughness, and completing the toughness evaluation of the power grid to be evaluated. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device remarkably improve the comprehensiveness and accuracy of the power grid toughness evaluation.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Natural gas system toughness assessment method and device and computer equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a method, a device and computer equipment for evaluating toughness of a natural gas system, which comprise the steps of constructing an input-output relation model of each department according to total output of each department, an interdependence matrix among each department and a final demand vector of each department, obtaining non-operability data and economic loss of each department after each department is disturbed in a static scene based on the input-output relation model and the non-operability, constructing an evolution process model of system state changing along with time, simulating influence degrees, evolution results and recovery processes of different disturbance scenes according to the evolution process model of the system state changing along with time, determining non-operability data and accumulated economic loss of each department in a dynamic scene, and obtaining a natural gas system toughness evaluation result according to the non-operability data and the economic loss of each department in the static scene and the dynamic scene. The method can consider interaction of departments, and improves accuracy of toughness assessment of the natural gas system.

title_en: Dangerous perception guidance system of the member's store using the value-added network
title_ko: 밴사의 통신망을 이용한 가맹점의 위험감지 안내시스템
abstract_en: A danger sensing and guidance system for member stores using the VAN(Value-Added Network) is provided to offer a danger sensing and guidance service using a communication network connected to a control panel which operates, and controls various sensors installed in member stores and a danger sensing and guidance server connected to the control panel through the communication network. A danger sensing and guidance system for member stores using the VAN includes a danger sensor(10), a controller(20), a credit card inquiry terminal(30) and a VAN server(40). The danger sensor is installed in a member store, senses a danger in the member store and generates a danger sensing signal corresponding to the danger. The controller receives the danger sensing signal and processes the danger sensing signal into a danger generation signal. The credit card inquiry terminal stores identification information of the member store, receives the danger generation signal from the controller and combines the danger generation signal and the identification information. The VAN server receives the danger generation signal combined with the identification information from the credit card inquiry terminal and notifies a terminal(50) of a fire station or a police station of the danger of the member store.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 가맹점주에게 위험감지 안내서비스를 제공 시 별도의 기반시설의 구축 없이도 제공이 가능한 밴사의 통신망을 이용한 가맹점의 위험감지 안내시스템에 관한 것으로, 가맹점에 설치되는 것으로 가맹점 내에 위험이 감지된 경우 이를 위험감지신호로 생성하는 위험감지센서부(10)와, 상기 침입감지센서(11)로부터 생성된 위험감지신호를 전송받아 위험발생신호로 가공하는 컨트롤러(20)와, 해당 가맹점을 식별하는 식별정보인 가맹점 식별정보가 기저장된 것으로 상기 컨트롤러(20)로부터 위험발생신호를 전송받아 그 전송된 위험발생신호에 상기 가맹점 식별정보를 취합하는 신용카드조회단말기(30)와, 상기 신용카드조회단말기(30)로부터 가맹점 식별정보가 취합된 위험발생신호를 전송받아 해당 위험을 제압하는 위험제압업체가 운영하는 업체단말기(50)로 해당 가맹점의 위험이 통보되도록 제어하는 VAN사 서버(40)로 이루어진 것을 특징으로 한다.  
       
     신용카드조회단말기, 화재감지, 가스누출, 위험감지 안내, VAN사

title_en: Fire place smoke-removing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire scene smoke remover which can effectively eliminate the dense smoke and comprises a smoke removing chamber enclosed by a shell (1), an electric room positioned at the lower part of the shell (1) and a light activated switch (11) arranged at the upper part of the shell (1); wherein, the front wall of the chamber is provided with an air inlet while the side wall of the chamber is provided with an air outlet (6); two-track multi-layer networks (3, 4 ) are arranged in the chamber and between the air outlet (6) and the air inlet which is provided with a suction fan (2); the electric room is internally provided with a storage battery (5), a direct current voltmeter (7), an inverter (9), a high voltage direct current packet (10) and a buzzing alarm (12); direct current positive and negative electrodes of the high voltage direct current packet (10) are respectively connected with the two-track multi-layer networks (3, 4). When in use, the fire scene smoke remover can effectively eliminate the heavy smoke and lead people to see the escape direction clearly and to escape from the fire scene quickly.
assignees: WU JINGANG HUANG YANMIN

title_en: Power backup system
abstract_en:
An electrically powered node 3 of a telecommunications system has a battery power backup 37 associated with its power control unit 33. Under normal conditions it are maintained fully charged by means of trickle currents from the mains power feeds 14 to each of a number of mains- connected customer equipments 4, by way of the "final drop" 10 to the distribution point. These trickle currents are controlled by the respective power control units 33, 43, to prevent overcharging. Using an electrical copper connection 19 provided in parallel with the fibre connection 9, a battery backup 27 can also be maintained in nodes 2 further towards the exchange. 
     These feeds are made reversible, so that if a power outage removes the power supply 14 from the customer premises 4, a "lifeline" plain telephone service between the exchange 1 and the telephone handset 5 is maintained over the connections 9, 10, 13, using the local battery backup 27, 37 in the remote nodes 2, 3. By limiting the service to simple telephony, the battery power 27, 37, 47 can be sufficient to maintain the service for a reasonable duration. 
     The power management systems 23, 33, 43 can be used to transfer charge from one battery 27, 37 to another over the network according to the usage, or remaining life, of each battery 27, 37, 47.
assignees: BRITISH TELECOMM

title_en: System allowing person to live in person's own house even if lifeline is intercepted in disaster or the like
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To solve the inconvenience that a person has to live as an evacuee or the like when the lifeline is intercepted or a cut is imposed on water intake to cause shortage of water in a big earthquake.  <P>SOLUTION: Rainwater is stored underground, and is made to flow through a water cleaner to obtain cleaned water as a water source for potable water, bathing water and the like. A cycle battery of 12 V is charged by several solar cells, and used as a power source. A person can live in the person's own house by using various electric appliances of 12 V even if the lifeline is intercepted. Thus, the above problem is solved. When a mobile power generator or the like is used, the application is further widened.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Repair staff calling system, method and program
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To make contact for quickly calling repair work staff when an accident occurs in a public service business using an infrastructure network.  <P>SOLUTION: A repair staff calling system includes an accident information acquisition section 21 for acquiring accident information including the content and the location of the accident; a power distribution network information storage section 41; a required staff decision section 27 for deciding the number of staffs necessary for the repairing the accident concerned; a staff information storage section 42 for storing staff information; a meeting spot determination section 29 for determining a staff meeting spot; a staff location information reception section 28 for receiving present staff location information from a communication means carried by each staff; a distance decision section 30 for deciding the distance between each staff and the meeting spot; and a call staff determination section for determining staffs satisfying the number of staffs decided by the required staff decision section, as staffs to be called from among staffs who is decided by the distance decision section 30 to be located within a predetermined distance.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Power outage and restoration notification in an advanced metering infrastructure network
abstract_en: A method and system are provided to transmit a meter power status. The method includes recognizing a power status change at a meter. The method includes, if the meter is scheduled to transmit first, transmitting a notification message to at least one neighboring meter towards a mesh gate, wherein the notification message includes a power status indicator and a meter identifier. The method includes, if the meter is not scheduled to transmit first, waiting a predetermined time period to receive a notification message from at least one neighboring meter. The method includes, responsive to receiving a notification message, adding a meter identifier to the received notification message before retransmitting the modified notification message to at least one neighboring meter. The method includes retransmitting the notification message.
assignees: TRILLIANT NETWORKS INC;VEILLETTE MICHEL

title_en: Floating intelligent perimeter sensor system
abstract_en: A system, method, and floating intelligent perimeter sensor, provide protection for waterways and critical infrastructures. The system and method utilize one or more floating intelligent perimeter sensors to detect, and in some cases identify, hazardous materials associated with vessels in the waterways. The hazardous materials detected, and optionally identified, can include radiological materials, fissile materials, explosives, chemicals and biological materials (CBRNE). A set of radiation data associated with a radiation source in a vessel is received from the one or more floating intelligent perimeter sensors. At least one histogram is generated based on the set of radiation data. The at least one histogram is compared to multiple spectral images associated with known materials. The at least one histogram is determined to substantially match at least one of the multiple spectral images. A determination is made whether a material associated with the radiation source is a hazardous material.
assignees: INNOVATIVE AMERICAN TECHNOLOGY;FRANK DAVID L

title_en: Storage and infiltration structure and drainage method
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To keep safety from a flood disaster in view of an important subject of prior countermeasures against rainwater to cope with the severance of a lifeline because flood that occurs frequently cannot infiltrate underground from the ground surface to cause an enormous amount of rainfall flowing out of a river, and a flooded state leads to the disaster.  <P>SOLUTION: The ground surface of pavement, concrete or asphalt of a road has no rainwater infiltrating property. The ground surface water thereby flows out abnormally to the river without infiltrating underground to cause the flood disaster. As the countermeasure, a seepage pit is installed for promoting infiltration into the underground from the bottom of a waterway. The outflow of rainwater is thereby suppressed effectively to serve as the countermeasure against the flood disaster, thus acquiring safety and assurance.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT
assignees: SAWADA SHOJI

title_en: Recycling asphalt concrete for subbase layer of way using waste asphalt concrete and cinder
title_ko: 폐아스팔트 콘크리트 및 석탄재를 이용한 도로 기층용 상온 재생 아스팔트 콘크리트
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A room temperature recycling asphalt concrete for a sub-base layer using waste asphalt concrete and coal dust is provided to prevent carbon dioxide and toxic gas which is generated in heating concrete by manufacturing the concrete at room temperature without heating process. CONSTITUTION: A room temperature rejuvenated asphalt concrete for a sub-base layer comprises: coal dust 5 - 100 parts by weight; waste limestone or granular activated charcoal 1 - 12 parts by weight; blister steel low heat mixed cement 5 - 20 parts by weight; reject ash 0.1 - 10 parts by weight; anhydrous gypsum or blending material 0.1 - 5 parts by weight; an emulsifier 0.1 - 1 parts by weight; an elastomer 0.1 - 10 parts by weight; and calcium silicate aqueous solution 0.1 - 10 parts by weight.
abstract_ko:

title_en: Dynamic contingency avoidance and mitigation system
abstract_en: Systems and methods for allocating resources within an infrastructure, such as an electrical grid, in response to changes to inputs and output demands on the infrastructure, such as energy sources and sinks. A disclosed system includes one or more processors, each having respective communication interfaces to receive data from the infrastructure, the data comprising infrastructure network data, one or more software applications, operatively coupled to and at least partially controlling the one or more processors, to process and characterize the infrastructure network data; and a display, coupled to aid one or more processors, for visually presenting a depiction of at least a portion of the infrastructure including any changes in condition thereof, and one or more controllers in communication with the one or more processors, to manage processing of the resource, wherein the resource is obtained and/or distributed based on the characterization of said real time infrastructure data.

title_en: The method for routing control of packet transmission in vehicular communications
title_ko: 이동 차량간 패킷 전달 경로 제어 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A method for controlling a packet transmission route between moving cars is provided to change a defer time according to an inter-relay node distance using an ODAM(Optimized Dissemination of Alarm Messages) method to shorten an inter-end delay time, thereby effectively broadcasting an emergency warning message during communication between cars. CONSTITUTION: The distance between a transmission node and a relay node car is obtained. Density showing the number of cars located in a service area is obtained. A retransmission delay time of a relay node is adaptively changed by the density and a distance between cars. A car(210) witnesses an accident by the transmission node. The car broadcasts an emergency warning message to surroundings. Cars(220,230) receive the emergency warning message. A car operates as the relay node.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 차량간 통신인 VANET에 관한 것으로 VANET은 기반시설의 도움 없이 차량 간의 무선통신을 기반으로 자율적인 네트워크 구성을 통해 교통흐름제어, 운전자의 안전 및 편의 등을 크게 개선할 수 있는 기술을 말한다. VANET은 MANET과 달리 노드의 고속 이동성과 네트워크 토폴로지의 빈번한 변화, 노드의 밀집도 급변 등의 차량 환경 고유의 특징을 가진다. 이러한 VANET의 특징들은 MANET의 네트워크 토폴로지 기반 프로토콜의 성능을 저하시키는 주요 원인이 된다. 본 발명은 적응형 거리기반 방송 알고리즘을 사용한 긴급경고메시지 방송 프로토콜에 관한 것이다. 적응형 거리기반 방송 알고리즘은 긴급경고메시지 전송 노드의 전송영역의 가장 자리에 노드가 위치하지 않더라도 릴레이 사이의 거리에 따라 방송 패킷의 대기시간을 변화시키기 때문에 네트워크 토폴로지의 상황에 맞게 대기시간을 변화시킬 수 있다. 본 발명에서의 AODAM 알고리즘은 VANET 환경에서 낮은 노드 밀도와 잦은 토폴로지 변화에서도 낮은 네트워크 부하와 짧은 긴급메시지 전달 시간을 가지는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
       
     차량간 통신 (VANET), 패킷 경로 제어 방법, 적응형 거리기반 방송 알고리즘, 긴급경고메시지

title_en: Water supply system
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a water supply system which enables supply of drinking water and water for hygienic management at emergency disaster even when lifelines are completely broken.  <P>SOLUTION: The water supply system includes a raw water storage tank 3 which stores raw water by pumping up the raw water from various water sources by a storage pump, and a treatment tank 5 which removes a part of bacteria and viruses from the raw water stored in the raw water storage tank by driving a purification unit 4 to store the treated water. The treated water stored in the treatment tank is sterilized by electrolytic water generated by driving an electrolytic water unit 6 and then supplied as drinking water or water for hygienic management.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Multifunctional emergency kit
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multifunctional emergency kit which can be stored after folding. The multifunctional emergency kit comprises a lower bar, an adapter substitute, a spade surface, a spade surface joint, a pickaxe hook, a top joint bolt, a top joint nut, a fixing sleeve, a compaction gasket, a lower tong support, an upper bar, an upper tong support, a chisel, a rope sling, a lifeline, a lower tong piece, an upper tong piece, a handle joint, a hammerhead, an emergency lamp, an iron broom and a first aid box. By using different combinations and transformations of components as well as a locking mechanism, the multifunctional emergency kit can quickly transform structures to realize multiple functions. The multifunctional emergency kit has multiple functions, small volume and light weight, is convenient for carrying and operation, and the like, and can be widely used in emergency rescue, disaster relief and daily use for families or organizations.

title_en: Fire extinguishment device for small scale building
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a sprinkler device having initial extinguishment performance, ensuring drinking water by efficiently using service water, and having installment space diversity by solving problems such as: shortage of pressure and water amount of service water in spite of being an assumption, occurring in most cases at a sprinkler facility utilizing service water for small scale building; shortage of an installation space of the facility in an existing building; and a lifeline cutoff in a large scale disaster.SOLUTION: Water amount is ensured by connection of sprinkler pipings by switching a control valve of service water piping brought into at least two houses. Or, a water reservoir of service water is arranged, water amount for an initial extinguishment is secured with a water storage type water supply device by compressing inactive gas or compressed air, and means for feeding service water in combination and sharing of the water reservoir by houses and a piping type water reservoir are arranged so as to correspond to installation space diversity. The device functions even for one house and can keep drinking water storage function and the water amount for the initial extinguishment.

title_en: Physiologically active substance measuring system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a physiologically active substance measuring system capable of contributing to promoting a restoration of the infrastructure, when a lifeline is disconnected by a natural disaster, or the like, while maintaining health of a local resident by taking a prompt measure against an infecting bacteria including a bacterial pathogen such as virus concurrently with addressing an important challenge to secure infrastructure.SOLUTION: The present invention is a physiologically active substance measuring system which has a fuel cell as a power source to enable the same to be portable and effectively used. With the physiologically active substance measuring system, an infecting bacteria can be effectively and promptly identified in an environment where a commercial power source is not put in place or in a time of disaster.

title_en: Power supply system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a power supply system which can promptly determine damages at an occurrence of disaster to perform countermeasure to cope with the damages.SOLUTION: A server 12 predicts a damage situation such as collapse or damage of a building, and electric outrage on the basis of: prior information (e.g. power generation amount, power consumption in a high-rise apartment district 18, power consumption in a low-rise apartment district 20, height of the building, age of the building, structure, installation ground or district, number of vehicles 24 in the high-rise apartment building 18, number of vehicles 24 in the low-rise apartment building 20, etc.,); and disaster information (seismic intensity of earthquake, flood damage information, etc.,). Locations requiring a lifeline, and amounts thereof are predicted, and then countermeasure against disaster (prioritization of electric power generated by a large-scale photovoltaic power plant 14 and power supplied from grid-connected power 16, shifting of vehicles for power source) is determined to supply the required locations with the required amounts.

title_en: Natural circulation tree filter box system
title_ko: 자연순환형 나무화분여과시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A natural circulation tree filtering box system is provided to remove non-point pollution source of rain to prevent flood by reducing peak outflow. CONSTITUTION: A natural circulation tree filter box system has a concrete structure or a wood box having intensity fitted for the same, a filter and a space fumigant (20), a vegetation space, vegetation soil (33), a gravel layer (34) and a rain discharge pipe (14). A screen net for removing foreign substances when rain is flowed in is installed, and the space fumigant holds rain flowed in through an inlet. Shrub, arbor and the like can be vegetated in the vegetation space. The gravel layer increases water permeation speed. A filtering net is installed in the filter.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도로지역 등 도시지역 불투수면에서 발생하는 비점오염원을 도시기반시설을 활용하여 저감하는 빗물 생태저류시설을 조성할 수 있는 시설로서 기존에 식재되어 있는 조경수, 가로수 등을 이용할 수 있을 뿐 아니라 새로이 조성되는 도시지역 설계에도 적용이 가능하고 시설을 설치 후에는 도시지역 및 도로에서 발생되는 비점오염원을 저감시키는 작용과 처리된 우수를 하수도로 이송을 시키는 것이 아닌 지면저류 및 토양 저류를 통하여 첨두유량과 유출용적을 저감시켜 지하수 고갈 문제 해결 및 홍수 재해 방지에 도움이 되는 기술로서 자연순환형 나무화분여과시스템에 관한 것이다. 발명의 구성은 나무상자와 여재필터 충수공간 식재공간 식생토 자갈 및 배수구로 이루어져 있다. 상부 식재공간에는 교목(가로수) 및 관목을 식재하여 도심조경을 자연스럽게 할 수 있으며 하부에는 충수공간에 담수되어있는 오염된 우수를 여과필터를 통해 일부는 식생토를 통해 식재된 수목에 공급이 되며 일부는 지하로 순환되는 구조를 가진 자연순환형 나무화분여과시스템이다. 이 시스템을 우수가 많이 발생되는 지역 등에서는 우수체류장치를 연결하여 더 많은 우수를 지하수로 환수 시킬 수 있으며 나무상자에 우수체류장치를 우수연결관으로 연결하여 활용할 수 있다. 우수체류장치 상부에는 식재공간을 두어 교목 등 초하류를 식재하여 화단의 형태로 사용 할 수 있으며 식생분리판으로 분리된 지하부에는 충수공간을 두어 오염된 우수를 저장시켜 상부에 식재된 교목 등 초하류 등에 공급되고 일부는 우수연결관을 통해 우수박스로 보내지어 가로수 및 지하수로 돌아가게 된다.  자연순환형 나무화분여과시스템 설치 시  우수의 비점오염원 제거 및 첨두유출량 감소로 홍수 예방 등의 효과가 있다.

title_en: Reverse powering system for telecommunications node
abstract_en:
To initiate the transmission of electrical power over a telecommunications connection 14 from a power-collecting telecommunications interface unit 16 such as a customer premises equipment, connectable to a power supply 18, to a power-receiving unit (22, Fig 4) such as a kerbside electrical/optical interface, when a connection 14 is first established, or the collecting unit is first powered up, or in order to re-establish connection after a power outage, control signals are transmitted between low-power modems 55 in the interface units using a low-power communications protocol. This allows the controlled initiation of a larger power output and a higher speed exchange of data once the full telecommunications connection has been established. A low-powered beacon signal is transmitted over the telecommunications connection 14 by the power-collecting telecommunications interface unit on connection to a power supply 18, for detection by the power-receiving telecommunications interface unit. 
     In the event of a loss of power at the input 18, the low power modem 55 initiates power management control signals to cause the power-receiving telecommunications interface to shut down certain functions in order to preserve backup power for essential "lifeline" services.
assignees: BRITISH TELECOMM

title_en: Transverse elastic limiting and longitudinal hydraulic fusing damping combined support system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a transverse elastic limiting and longitudinal hydraulic fusing damping combined support system. The longitudinal restraint of a hydraulic fusing damping support and the transverse restraint of a limiting height adjusting rubber support are adopted. The hydraulic fusing damping support is located between the top of a first main pier and the bottom of a main beam, wherein the first main pier and the main beam are located on the same side of a midspan. The limiting height adjusting rubber support is located between the inner side of an arch springing and the outer side of the main beam. A second main pier opposite to the first main pier is provided with a two-way movable spherical steel support. The longitudinal restraint is in the locking state under normal circumstances, it is ensured that the longitudinal restraint is achieved under the effect of braking force and track force in the using period, unlocking is achieved in an earthquake, the damping effect is achieved, and locking is recovered after the earthquake. Transverse restraint ensures that transverse limiting is achieved in the using period, the support is not disengaged, and transverse earthquake force can be reduced. Under the effect of the earthquake and the rare occurrence earthquake, both the pier body and the foundation work within the elastic range, the earthquake intensity which a bridge can resist is greatly improved, connecting of traffic lifelines at key transportation nodes is kept, and the important effect on earthquake relief is achieved.
assignees: CN RAILWAY SIYUAN SURVEY & DES

title_en: Liquefaction countermeasure method of existing buried pipe
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a liquefaction countermeasure method of an existing buried pipe in which a liquefaction countermeasure of lifelines of gas-pipes, potable water pipes, sewer pipes, etc., in residential areas such as subdivision lots for sale where roads and detached houses are densely built can be performed simply and economically.SOLUTION: Two or more filling pipes 2 are installed at predetermined intervals in an extension direction of an existing buried pipe 1. Liquid chemicals are injected from the filling pipes 2 by either following methods, and the existing buried pipe 1 is integrated with an agglomeration body in the earth to be refilled, and thereby the floating of the existing buried pipe 1 in the earthquake is suppressed. (1) A method for suppressing the floating of the existing buried pipe 1 in the earthquake by fixing the existing buried pipe 1 in the non-liquefaction layer of the natural ground. (2) A method for suppressing the floating of the existing buried pipe 1 by solidifying the earth to be refilled under the existing buried pipe to thereby cause the earth of the non-liquefaction layer to fall into right and left parts and the upper part thereof in the earthquake. (3) A method for suppressing the floating by solidifying the upper surface or the side surface of the existing buried pipe 1 and integrating the existing buried pipe 1 with the agglomeration body to thereby increase the gravity applied to the existing buried pipe 1 and the agglomeration body.

title_en: The total prevention and PSR system to decrease heavy rain disaster
title_ko: 폭우 재해 저감을 위한 통합방재 및 psr 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a total prevention PSR system, capable of preparing plans for the reduction of flooding damage such as moving main base facilities or limiting the land use of a disaster vulnerable area (S) and a disaster occurrence point (P) in cities by running in parallel with the existing prevention system to prevent disasters such as flooding, caused by heavy rain; and preparing a space drainage system to distribute facilities, delaying and reducing the flow of rainwater, to various places in a city response region (R). Therefore, the flow of rainwater, concentrated on a flooding area, is delayed and reduced by using a city plan facility for the reduction of damage to the disaster vulnerable area (S) and the disaster occurrence point (P).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 집중호우나 장마철에 많은 강우량으로 인해 발생 될 수 있는 침수  등의 재해 발생 방지를 위해서 기존에 운영되고 있는 방재시스템과 병행하여 도시의 재해발생지점(P)과 재해취약지역(S)의 토지이용을 등급별로 분류하여 제한하거나 주요 기반시설을 이주하는 등의 침수피해 저감을 위한 방안을 마련하며, 도시대응지역(R)에는 우수의 흐름을 지연 및 저류시키는 시설을 중복되게 여러 장소에 분산하는 공간배수체계를 마련하는 것으로, 재해발생지점(P), 재해취약지역(S)의 피해 저감을 위하여 도시계획시설을 활용하여 침수구역으로 집중되는 우수의 흐름을 지연, 저류시키는 토탈방재 PSR 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Waterworks asset management system
title_ko: 상수도 자산관리 시스템
abstract_en: Provided is a waterworks asset management system, which can determine remaining service life of an asset using a failure mode, and can perform waterworks asset management more accurately by evaluating degree of danger of the asset on the basis of performance using business risk exposure (BRE), and also, can be linked with a geographic information system (GIS) easily by providing a waterworks asset management framework and a platform thereof corresponding to a domestic electronic government standard framework, and can be used in asset evaluation easily by being commercialized according to the real state of a local government, and also, can comply with an international standard by composing the waterworks asset management frame work on the basis of a framework of an international asset management standard (ISO55000) and an international infrastructure asset management manual (IIMM).
abstract_ko: 파괴모드(Failure Mode)를 이용하여 자산의 잔존수명(Remaining Service Life)을 결정하고, 비즈니스 위험도(BRE)를 이용하여 성능-기반의 자산 위험도를 평가함으로써 상수도 자산관리를 보다 정확하게 수행할 수 있고, 또한, 국내 전자정부 표준 프레임워크에 대응하는 상수도 자산관리 프레임워크 및 플랫폼을 제공함으로써 지리정보시스템(GIS)과 용이하게 연동시킬 수 있고, 지방자치단체의 실정에 맞게 실용화함으로써 자산평가 시에 용이하게 활용할 수 있으며, 또한, 국제자산관리표준(ISO55000) 및 국제 기반시설 자산관리 매뉴얼(IIMM)의 프레임워크에 근거하여 상수도 자산관리 프레임워크를 구성함으로써 국제표준에 적합하게 적용할 수 있는, 상수도 자산관리 시스템이 제공된다.

title_en: Fresh drinking water tank during drinking water lifeline cutoff and damage due to earthquake or disaster
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a water tank securing fresh water capable of coping with disaster.SOLUTION: A box body 3 in which a long thin water conducting pipe 4 is tightly folded and packed is installed midway between a water meter and a faucet. As all daily household supply water runs through the water conducting pipe 4, water exchange or antiseptic agents are not necessary and fresh water runs to be stocked in the box body 3 until an instance of disaster. When the box body 3 tilts or collapses from a normal installation position due to the disaster, inlet/outlet pipe is shielded instantaneously and the fresh water in the box body 3 is secured without leaking until the water is used.
assignees: TANAKA DENKI CO LTD

title_en: Portable multifunctional life-saving rope
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable multifunctional lifeline, which comprises: the life-saving rope comprises a storage bin and a life-saving rope body stored in the storage bin, wherein the life-saving rope body comprises a main steel rope, a floating body steel rope, an auxiliary steel rope, a floating ball, a retarder, a plurality of grabbing-assisting thin ropes and a sinking body steel rope. One end of the main steel rope is fixed on the inner wall of the storage bin, and the other end of the main steel rope is provided with the floating ball; 2 pieces of buffer devices are arranged on the main steel rope at intervals, and each buffer device is provided with two arms capable of gradually expanding; two ends of the floating body steel rope are respectively connected with the outer end of one arm of each retarder; two ends of the sinking steel rope are respectively connected with the outer end of the other arm of each retarder; the multiple grabbing-assisting thin ropes are interwoven in a net shape, and two ends of each grabbing-assisting thin rope are respectively connected with two arms of the two retarders or respectively connected with the floating body steel rope and the sinking body steel rope; a handle is arranged on the containing bin. The device is convenient to carry and simple to operate, is in a net shape after being unfolded, is convenient for a person falling into water to grasp, and is also convenient for a rescuer to rescue.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Quantitative analysis method for influence on grid real-time load control caused by communication failures
abstract_en: The present invention provides a quantitative analysis method for an influence on grid real-time load control caused by communication failures, and considers a power system and a communication system to be a coupled and interdependent complex system for analysis. The quantitative analysis method based on the influence on grid real-time load control caused by communication failures can make importance assessment on monitoring and control equipment in a grid through the load shedding quantity, and can implement risk assessment on the power communication complex system through statistical analysis on an equipment availability probability. Based on this, by taking potential risks of various communication failures occurrence and consequences thereof into consideration, centralized grid control measures are adjusted in real time to minimize the expanded risk of the grid accident, thereby providing an implementation basis to establish and design a grid online assistant decision-making system for communication risks.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Electric power communication network redundant path strategy acquiring method
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric power communication network redundant path strategy acquiring method. The method includes the following steps that: an electric power network fault propagation model is established according to the capacity load information of an electric power network node; a communication network model composed of a control center node and router nodes is established, an interdependent coupling network model of an electric power communication network is established according to connection relations between nodes in the electric power network fault propagation model and communication network nodes; and the minimum subnet of the interdependent coupling network model is obtained, wherein the minimum subnet describes the redundant path strategy of the electric power communication network. When the electric power communication network malfunctions, fault information occurrence can be suppressed according to the redundant route strategy, and therefore, cascaded power outage caused by fault propagation can be avoided or alleviated, and the reliability of an electric power communication network system can be improved.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Establishment and operation method of emergency communication system in a massive disaster situation
title_ko: 재난 상황에서의 긴급통신 시스템의 구축 및 운용 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method to establish and operate an emergency communication system in a situation that part or entire communication system malfunctions due to a natural disaster or a massive accident by propagating the disaster situation, rapidly establishing an emergency communication network and operate a system in an emergency communication mode, performing operation to recognize locations of victims and simultaneously providing a group communication function to command and control rescue agents when a communication life-line needs to be established and maintained to rescue the victims with minimum power consumption. Also, a method according to an embodiment of the present invention makes remote control of victims terminal possible in case of emergency by extending the conception of a public warning system (PWS). As such, base stations and terminals operating in an emergency mode can be operated in a minimum power-consumption mode. Also, a method according to an embodiment of the present invention performs a function to recognize locations of the victims by additionally performing functions related to accurate positioning and a function to increase a survival rate of the victims and victims′ terminals.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 자연 재해/재난 또는 대형 사고에 의하여 통신 인프라가 일부 또는 전체가 와해된 상황에서, 신속하게 긴급통신망을 구축하여 재난상황을 전파하고, 긴급통신모드로서 시스템을 동작한다. 피해자들의 위치를 파악하기 위한 동작을 수행하고, 시스템이 최소한의 전력을 소모하며 피해자의 구조를 위한 통신생명선 (communication life-line)을 구축 및 유지하기 위한  필요 시, 재난안전 요원들의 지휘통제를 위한 그룹통신 기능의 동시 제공  시스템의 구축 및 그 운용 방법을 제시한다. 기본적으로 PWS (Public Warning System)의 개념을 확장하여, 긴급 재난상황에서의 피해자 단말을 원격 제어할 수 있도록 한다. 이를 통하여, 긴급모드로 운용되는 기지국 및 단말이 최소 전력 모드로서 운용될 수 있도록 한다. 또한, 단말의 위치에 대한 정밀 측위와 관련된 기능들을 추가적으로 수행하여, 피해자의 위치를 파악하고, 추가적으로 피해자 및 피해자 단말의 생존성을 높이는 기능을 수행한다.

title_en: 3D Active Warning and Recognition Environment (3D AWARE): A low Size, Weight, and Power (SWaP) LIDAR with Integrated Image Exploitation Processing for Diverse Applications
abstract_en: An invention is disclosed for a multi-mode LIDAR sensor system that embodies a high pulse rate fiber laser operating in the SWIR wavelength at 1.5 microns, a long linear array of small SWIR sensitive detectors with very high speed readout electronics, and fully integrated methods and processing elements that perform target detection, classification, and tracking using techniques that emulate how the human visual path processes and interprets imaging data. High resolution three dimensional images are created of wide areas. Image exploitation processing methods detect objects and object activities in real time thus enabling diverse applications such as vehicle navigation, critical infrastructure protection, and public safety monitoring.
assignees: JUSTICE JAMES W;AZZAZY MEDHAT;Sapir ltzhak

title_en: A kind of meter and the Wind turbines short term reliability Forecasting Methodology of running status
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of meter and the Wind turbines short term reliability Forecasting Methodology of running status, comprise the following steps: obtain Wind turbines state parameter by status monitoring with data collecting system, status monitoring parameter is divided into two classes；For device temperature parameter, set up state parameter forecast model based on reverse transmittance nerve network, calculate protection act probability based on prediction residual distribution character, for remaining parameter, calculate protection act probability according to meter and threshold crossing time；By wind energy turbine set operation maintenance data and SCADA data, stoppage in transit number of times and the moment wind speed of stopping transport of Wind turbines are added up, set up the Wind turbines statistics outage model that wind speed is interdependent；Get over limit information in conjunction with stoppage in transit statistical information and state parameter, calculate Wind turbines short-term stoppage in transit probability.This method can evaluate Wind turbines stoppage in transit risk in a short time exactly, increases substantially the accuracy of Wind turbines short-term outage model, and the short term reliability for whole wind energy turbine set is assessed and safety and economic operation provides Technical Reference.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Wind power plant prediction model construction method and system based on space-time correlation
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method and a system for constructing a wind power plant prediction model based on time-space correlation, wherein a time-space dependency method for wind field multi-fan space lattice wind speed prediction is explored by using wind power plant position information and actually measured wind speed data; establishing a wind field multi-fan wind speed probabilistic prediction model combining space-time typical characteristic parameters and current fan operation state monitoring by combining a dependency model of typical wind field fan group wind speed tracking measurement and wind field multi-fan space lattice wind speed prediction; on the basis, a wind speed probabilistic prediction method of multiple wind turbines of a wind power plant on different time scales is researched. An effective analysis tool is provided for forecasting the wind speed field of the multi-fan in the complex terrain and climate variable environment, and the running efficiency of the fan is promoted to be improved.

title_en: Mobile field survey system and method
title_ko: 모바일 현장조사 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a location-based mobile field survey method and a location-based mobile field survey system implementing the method, which comprises the steps of: viewing field information, stored in a field survey management system server, through a field survey application loaded on a terminal; inputting, into the field survey application, the field information such as the address of a field, the names of buildings or facilities around the field, and the name of the field, and receiving, from the field survey management system server, a field survey method type, selected from the group consisting of point inspection, node checking and route following, as the field survey method type of the field corresponding to the inputted field information; and transmitting, to the field survey management system server, a field survey result carried out according to a field type. According to the present invention, when a field survey on various urban elements such as urban infrastructures, buildings, transportation, cultural assets, and public facilities in a complex city is carried out, the information that should be continuously collected for a long time can be systematically and integratively managed, and an efficient monitoring system can be implemented.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 단말기에 탑재된 현장조사 앱을 통해 현장조사 관리시스템 서버에 저장된 현장정보를 열람하는 단계, 상기 현장조사 앱에 현장의 주소, 현장 주변 건물이나 시설물 이름, 현장의 지명 등과 같은 현장 정보를 입력하고, 상기 입력된 현장 정보에 대응되는 현장의 현장조사방법 유형으로서, point inspection, node checking 및 route following으로 이루어진 군에서 선택된 현장조사방법 유형을 상기 현장조사 관리시스템 서버로부터 제공받는 단계 및 상기 현장 유형에 따라 수행된 현장조사 결과를 상기 현장조사 관리시스템 서버에 전송하는 단계를 포함하는 위치기반 모바일 현장조사 방법 및 이러한 방법을 구현하는 위치기반 모바일 현장조사 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따르면, 복잡한 도시에서 도시 기반시설, 건축물, 교통, 문화재, 공공시설 등 다양한 도시 요소들에 대한 현장조사 수행에 있어서, 지속적이고 장기적으로 수집해야 할 정보를 체계적이고 통합적으로 관리할 수 있고, 효율적인 모니터링 시스템을 구현할 수 있다.

title_en: Circulation type toilet system and wastewater treatment method for circulation type toilet
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a circulation type toilet system that can be used even though a lifeline is cut off in the event of a disaster or the like and can manage an electric power required for operating the toilet system only by a small scale of photovoltaic power generation apparatus.SOLUTION: In a circulation type toilet system 10 comprising subjecting sewage discharged from a flush toilet bowl 100 to solid-liquid separation in a solid-liquid separation tank 200 to form a primary treatment water, then subjecting the primary treatment water to soil treatment in a soil treatment tank 600 to thereby re-utilize the treated water in the flush toilet bowl 100, the use of a screw type lifting pump 400 as a wastewater pump for water-feeding the primary treatment water from a primary storage tank 300 to the soil treatment tank 600 reduces a starting current of the wastewater pump to a low level and as a result, an electric power required for operating the toilet system can be managed only by a small scale of photovoltaic power generation apparatus 900.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Pipe Supporting Device for Earthquake-proof Having 3D Displacement
title_ko: 3차원 변위량을 갖는 내진용 일체형 배관지지장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a seismic integrated pipe supporting device with three-dimensional (3D) displacement, comprising: a fixated bracket having a plurality of shaft coupling units protruding to one surface, and capable of being directly fixated on a ceiling or wall surface, or coupled to the same through a separate length adjustment means; a rotation central shaft to insert both ends into a shaft hole formed in the shaft coupling unit; a rod having a long hole-shaped through-hole formed on one end to receive the inserted rotation central axis to allow the 3D displacement in up/down, left/right, and front/rear directions, and allowing the other end to be coupled to a connection supporting member connecting or supporting the pipe; a coupling plate coupled to the fixated bracket by being spaced apart from the fixated bracket at a predetermined interval; and a shock absorption means connected to the coupling plate to receive the rod inside, and actively absorbing the 3D displacement to prevent breakage of the pipe upon an internal or external impact. According to the present invention, to minimize a secondary damage caused from breakage of a water transfer pipe, such as a rising pipe, a horizontal pipe, etc., of water firefighting equipment installed in main infrastructures upon an earthquake or other internal and external impacts, the device actively absorbs displacement and 3D-twisting to prevent breakage of the pipe when the pipe is moved as a consequence of these impacts.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 3차원 변위량을 갖는 내진용 일체형 배관지지장치에 관한 것으로, 일면으로 돌출되는 한 쌍의 축결합부를 갖으며, 천정 또는 벽면에 직접 고정되거나 별도의 길이조절부재를 통해 결합이 가능한 고정 브라켓과, 상기 축결합부에 형성된 축홀(hole)에 양단이 삽입되는 회전중심축과, 상기 회전중심축이 삽입되어 상하, 좌우 및 전후방향의 3차원 변위량을 갖도록 하는 장공형상의 관통홀이 일단에 형성되고, 타단은 배관을 연결 또는 지지하는 연결지지부재가 결합되는 로드와, 상기 고정 브라켓으로부터 일정간격을 두고 상기 고정 브라켓과 결합되는 결합 플레이트와, 상기 결합 플레이트에 연결되어 상기 로드를 내부에 수용하며 내외적인 충격 시 배관의 3차원 변위량을 능동적으로 흡수하여 배관의 파손을 방지하기 위한 완충수단을 포함하며, 지진 및 각종 내외적 충격발생 시 주요기반시설에 설치된 입상관 및 횡주관 등 수계소화설비 송수관의 파손으로 발생하는 2차 피해를 최소화하기 위하여 각종 충격 시 배관이 흔들릴 때 그 변위량과 3D-Twisting을 능동적으로 흡수하여 배관의 파손을 방지할 수 있다.

title_en: Use of composite particles for protecting a lifeline structure against seismic wave damage
abstract_en: Composite particles of a hard core coated by a layer of hydratable, swellable clay such as bentonite are useful for constructing, modifying and/or supporting lifeline structure such as dams, berms and levees, and/or pipelines or conduits for oil, gas, sewage, water, or cables or wires for transmission of electrical power or data information. The method involves placing the composite particles in a location within, below, or about the lifeline structure, and hydrating them to cause them to swell and fill and seal the voids around the structure to form a resilient support having a high damping ratio and low hydraulic conductivity that is maintained after exposure to strain forces. The composite particles are advantageous in damping seismic waves and reducing the potential damage from an earthquake, explosion, tremor, fatigue loading, or similar seismic event.

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a descending lifeline enabling people to make an emergency escape in case of a fire by using a wire rope and, more specifically, relates to a descending lifeline with a fire bell induction indicator, capable of enabling an escaper to make a quick escape by more easily recognizing the position of the descending lifeline through a chemical light emission lamp turned on after the detection of a fire bell for a predetermined time. The present invention comprises: a descending lifeline part having a wire rope wound thereon; and a lamp part for easy position recognition. The descending lifeline part comprises: a winding drum having a wire rope wound thereon; and a speed reducing gear part combined inside the winding drum to reduce the winding speed of the winding drum. The lamp part comprises: a descending display lamp turned on with supplied power; and a chemical light emission band lamp operated when power is cut off. According to the present invention, since the descending display lamp is turned on after an emergency bell sound is detected for a predetermined time, a malfunction of the descending display lamp caused by the malfunction of the emergency bell can be prevented, and also, even when power is cut off or backup power is discharged, the chemical light emission band lamp is operated to emit light chemically, and thus, the descending lifeline can always be recognized.
