abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for processing the interlocking effect of an electric-gas interdependent system. The method comprises the steps of establishing a rescheduling model of the power system, a rescheduling model of the natural gas system and a model of a coupling element according to the electric-gas interdependent system, further establishing a linkage effect analysis model of the electric-gas interdependent system, further obtaining a scheduling quantity of produced natural gas quantity and a cutting quantity of a natural gas load, adjusting the output of a generator set or cutting off part of the power load by adopting a power system scheduling mechanism, and adjusting the output of a gas source or cutting off part of the natural gas load by adopting a natural gas system scheduling mechanism. The invention couples the interlocking effect into the reliability of the electric-gas interdependent system by modeling the interlocking effect in the electric-gas interdependent system, and provides a basis for ensuring the reliable operation of the electric-gas interdependent system.

title_en: Construction system of disaster prevention type building structure
abstract_en: To provide a construction system for disaster prevention type building structure that appropriately implements BCP measures in an event of a natural disaster according to type, scale, and installation status of the structure, securing a lifeline of each building structure, and using hydrogen that is a clean energy source as a fuel to replace fossil fuels.SOLUTION: An automatic electrical power generation device 1 is provided that is installed in a building construction structure and comprises as one unit, a fuel cell 2, hydrogen generation and supply means generating and supplying hydrogen as fuel, and activation means activating the hydrogen generation and supply means to generate hydrogen. In the automatic electrical power generation device, the hydrogen generation and supply means is constituted of methylcyclohexane 4 and a dehydrogenation device 3, the activation operation is constituted of a heating device 5 heating a catalyst 18. After the activation of the dehydrogenation device, the catalyst is heated by the heat of separated and generated toluene in place of the heating device to separate the methylcyclohexane 4 into hydrogen and toluene to generate hydrogen, which is used as fuel for the fuel cell.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: TATSUMI RYOKI KK

title_en: Method for establishing water-energy contact network model with close coupling relation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for establishing a water-energy connection network model with a close coupling relation, which comprises the steps of firstly respectively establishing a power transmission network model, a gas transmission network model, a heat supply network model and a water distribution network model; building a water-energy contact network model which is interdependent and acts on the basis of the four built models; the water-energy connection network model is expressed as a mixed integer nonlinear programming model, and is optimized and solved through an IPOPT solver. The method builds a water-energy contact network which is interdependent and acted, thereby improving the reliability and flexibility of the operation of the whole system.

title_en: System for evaluating environmental load of steel box girder bridge (stb), and method for the same
title_ko: 강박스교의 환경부하량 평가 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a system for evaluating an environmental load of a steel box girder bridge, and a method thereof, which among various infrastructures such as water and sewerage, railroad, dam, port, airport, and the like, the most frequently applied steel box is selected for roads to evaluate an environmental load in each of the planning, design, and maintenance stages of single and complex facilities, and establishes a standard quantity-based environmental load evaluation model which can evaluate the environmental load with only basic design information to evaluate the environmental load at the design stage of the steel box bridge, so that reliability compared to the existing environmental load evaluation model can be improved, and constructs a maintenance environmental load evaluation model to evaluate the environmental load at the maintenance stage of the steel box bridge, so that reliability compared to the existing environmental load assessment model is provided.
abstract_ko: 상하수도, 철도, 댐, 항만, 공항 등 다양한 사회기반시설물 중에서 도로를 대상으로 가장 적용빈도가 높은 강박스를 선정하여 단일 시설물과 복합 시설물의 기획단계, 설계단계 및 유지관리단계 각각의 환경부하량 평가를 실시할 수 있고, 또한, 기본적인 설계정보만으로 환경부하량을 평가할 수 있는 표준물량-기반 환경부하량 평가모델을 구축하여 강박스교의 설계단계 환경부하량을 평가함으로써 기존의 환경부하량 평가모델에 비해 신뢰성을 향상시킬 수 있으며, 또한, 유지관리 환경부하 평가모델을 구축하여 강박스교의 유지관리단계 환경부하량을 평가함으로써 기존의 환경부하량 평가모델에 비해 신뢰성을 향상시킬 수 있는, 강박스교의 환경부하량 평가 시스템 및 그 방법이 제공된다.
assignees: KOREA MARITIME UNIV IND ACAD

title_en: Electrical Safety Emergency Response Systems and Related Methods
abstract_en: An electrical safety system and method is provided which includes a flexible electrical safety vest, a lifeline coupled with the vest in various configurations, and leg straps. The electrical safety vest includes a number of loops which are used to couple the lifeline in a variety of relationships that enable different types of maneuvering of a worker with relation to a hazard. Various embodiments of the invention can be used to rapidly and safety remove a worker from proximity to an immediate threat to their life, health, or safety. Direct and indirect extraction from a danger are enabled. A variety of methods are also provided for operating various embodiments of the invention.
assignees: US NAVY

title_en: Tunnel water leakage risk spatial dependency prediction method and prediction system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of dynamic sensing and control of water leakage risk of shield tunnels, and discloses a method and a system for predicting spatial dependence of water leakage risk of tunnels, wherein a risk index system influencing the water leakage of a shield tunnel is constructed by analyzing a risk causing mechanism of water leakage; model design: the method comprises the steps of PCBN model Bayesian network structure design, risk index optimal edge distribution identification and fitting; and (3) model verification: and model application comprises water leakage risk evaluation and correlation analysis of risk indexes. The method combines the dynamic reasoning and diagnosis of the Bayesian network model and the Copula theory for the interdependence processing advantages among indexes, establishes the Pair-Copula Bayesian model for shield tunnel water leakage risk assessment, and realizes fitting of the occurrence and development mechanism of water leakage diseases in the actual shield tunnel operation period to the maximum extent, thereby obtaining more accurate risk evaluation results as a risk management real-time decision support tool.
assignees: UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH

title_en: Multi-functional river floodgate of ecological river course in city
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-functional river floodgate of ecological river course in city, including spaning the main river check brake that main river course set up to and set up in the trash rack in main river check brake upper reaches, set up flood diversion check brake in the side flood diversion canal mouth of main river course, the upper reaches of main river check brake, main river check brake delivery port top position sets up the overflow weir, sets up the fishway along the rivers direction in main river course, sets up fishway controllable device in the fishway, and the fishway runs through whole river course setting, the setting up ecological basin is accepted in overflow weir low reaches. The utility model discloses use resource environment bearing capacity as the restraint, it is preferential to economize on water, makes and uses natural river lake water system as the basis, holds the introduction and carries the transfer intercommunication engineering to be the frame, has the accurate dispatch of intelligence, has the key node of the urban water basis infrastructure network system of "four water overall management" treatment effect in function in time and space, is the important link of realizing ensureing city flood control safety, reasonable water demand safety and ecological environment health safety.
assignees: PENG YUJIE

title_en: Multi-dimensional, multi-layer and multi-granularity multi-network fusion modeling method
abstract_en: The multi-dimensional, multi-layer and multi-granularity multi-network fusion modeling method provided by the embodiment of the application comprises the steps of constructing a multi-dimensional network model according to network data, wherein the multi-dimensional network model comprises a power grid multi-dimensional network, a telecommunication network multi-dimensional network, a broadcast television network multi-dimensional network and an Internet multi-dimensional network; in the multidimensional network model, constructing a multidimensional network model according to different network nodes serving as granularity units; connecting the related network nodes among different networks according to the coupling and association relation among the networks to construct a multi-layer network model; obtaining a multi-dimensional, multi-layer and multi-granularity complex network model for describing a complex system after multi-network fusion; the method and the system not only comprehensively reflect the association relations of different individuals, families and communities under multi-network fusion, but also can effectively analyze and predict the possible behavior activities of the users and the user groups, effectively reveal the complex, potential and inherent association relations among the four networks, and provide basic support for the four-network fusion application service.

title_en: Flush toilet facility for evacuation destinations
abstract_en: To provide a flush toilet facility for emergency use in the event of an unforeseen emergency, such as flooding of houses due to overflowing rivers or landslides caused by torrential rains that cut off lifelines, including electricity, water and sewage, and require several days for recovery.SOLUTION: A flush toilet facility that can be used as a flush toilet in normal times and as a disaster toilet that can be used even when water and sewage and electricity are not available in an emergency comprises a toilet bowl 3, a water storage tank 2 located above the toilet bowl, and a sewage storage tank 1 located below the toilet bowl. The sewage storage tank is a vertical tank, and its internal side surface is formed in a tapered shape (also called a cone shape) from a suitable height toward a bottom surface, and a discharge port 8 is provided at a tip portion thereof. The discharge port is held in the open state of a funnel plug 6 suspended from an upper part of the sewage storage tank in normal times, and in the closed state by the funnel plug in an emergency.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: UCHIDA KK

title_en: Novel lifeboat
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel lifeboat, including the lifeboat body, the inside fixed mounting of lifeboat body has fixed leg ware, and the upper surface of lifeboat body is provided with the wiring ware, one side fixedly connected with couple of lifeboat body, the surface of couple cup joints and installs the life buoy, one side fixed mounting of life buoy has the lifeline, the other end and the wiring ware fixed connection of lifeline, one side of lifeboat body is close to the rear surface position department fixed mounting of life buoy and has the bumper. The utility model discloses a set up fixed leg ware, can fix own both legs when the rescuer rescues, on pulling the lifeboat with the personnel of falling into water again, avoided sliding into the river from the lifeboat in, through setting up second spring and bolt, can come its fix according to the thickness of leg, through setting up first pivot, the rescuer can adjust the direction wantonly, has brought the convenience for the rescuer.
assignees: ZOU TING

title_en: Optimization method for coupling operation of multi-energy network and water distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimization method for coupling operation of a multi-energy network and a water distribution network, which comprises the steps of firstly, establishing a water-energy contact operation model which is interdependent and acted according to the coupling relation among the water distribution network, a power transmission network, a gas transmission network and a heat distribution network in a multi-energy system; the built model is a dual-target operation model of energy and resources; a double-objective decision framework is adopted to realize fair balance between two targets of energy and resources, and the water-energy connection operation model is expressed as a mixed integer nonlinear model; and processing a double-target competition relationship in the water-energy association operation model by using a double-target optimized Nash bargaining method, so as to realize the optimization of the coupling operation of the multi-energy network and the water distribution network. The method can realize the balance between the energy production cost and the water resource consumption, and provides a solution for the coordination and optimization under the comprehensive operation of energy and resources.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Power system load prediction method based on double-layer XGBoost considering multiple characteristics
abstract_en: A power system load prediction method based on double-layer XGBoost considering multiple characteristics adopts CART tree as a base learner, inputs preprocessed historical load and characteristic data, trains layer by constructing a plurality of weak learners to obtain a model and screens a characteristic set which obviously influences the load. In the second layer model training process, K-fold cross validation is introduced to divide a training set and a testing set of data, so that the influence on the model hyper-parameters is avoided, and finally, the characteristics of the testing set are input into the model to obtain a final prediction result. The method has the advantages of avoiding standardization of data characteristics, processing field missing data, avoiding concern about whether the characteristics are interdependent or not, having good model learning effect, providing a novel prediction method for accurate load prediction of the power system, ensuring safe and stable operation of the power system, ensuring reliability of power supply and improving social and economic benefits.

title_en: Water supply-energy supply coupling planning method for industrial park
abstract_en: The invention provides a water supply-energy supply coupling planning method for an industrial park, which comprises the following steps: step 1: firstly, respectively establishing a power distribution network model, a heat supply network model and a water distribution network model; step 2: based on the established model, a coupling planning model of the interdependent and acting water-energy contact network is established, and a specific planning model with a mutual coupling relation is established by combining with a coupling element; and step 3: and constructing a mixed integer nonlinear programming model taking the total investment operation cost as an objective function by combining a water-energy network, carrying out optimization solution on the model through an IPOPT solver, providing an optimal energy supply scheme, and exploring how to reasonably configure energy storage and water storage equipment to optimize the investment operation cost. The invention provides a new direction for the combined planning under the coupling action of energy and resources, and the coupled operation planning model of the energy and the resources has good social significance for building an intelligent integrated social comprehensive energy and resource network in the future.
assignees: WUHAN POWER SUPPLY DESIGN INST CO LTD;STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD WUHAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Electric power supply lifeline construction method based on secondary dry layer contact and mobile energy storage
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for constructing an electric power supply lifeline based on secondary dry layer contact and mobile energy storage, which comprises the following steps of: step S1, obtaining power consumer information and net rack basic information; step S2, constructing an important power consumer evaluation index, and acquiring an important power consumer set according to the obtained power consumer information; step S3, constructing an electric power supply scheme based on secondary dry layer contact according to the obtained important electric power user set and net rack basic information; step S4, establishing a mobile energy storage scheme according to the power load condition of an important power consumer; and step S5, comparing the electric power supply scheme based on the secondary dry layer contact and the mobile energy storage with the mobile energy storage scheme to obtain a better power supply scheme, and constructing an electric power lifeline based on the better power supply scheme. The invention solves the problem of the balance between the reliability and the economy of the power grid users, optimizes the power supply environment and further improves the power supply reliability of the power grid under the condition of better economy.
assignees: FUJIAN YONGFU POWER ENG CO LTD

title_en: Underground comprehensive pipe gallery design method considering civil air defense requirements
abstract_en: The invention provides a design method of an underground comprehensive pipe gallery considering the needs of civil air defense, which can meet the defense requirements considering the needs of civil air defense by carrying out protection design on a main structure of a pipe gallery, a personnel entrance, an exit, a vent, a feed opening, an in-gallery pipeline, electric of the pipe gallery and water supply and drainage of the pipe gallery and adapting protection measures, and can realize standard design, green intelligent construction, war conversion, short construction period and low cost. The invention can scientifically, economically and effectively improve the war time disaster prevention and damage resistance and the peaceful time natural disaster resistance of the comprehensive pipe gallery, is suitable for newly built and built comprehensive pipe galleries to meet the requirements of both civil air defense and implement peacetime function conversion, and ensures the toughness and safety of the urban lifeline system.
assignees: SHANGHAI TONGJI UNITED CONSTRUCTION DEV CO LTD;JINHUA CITY JINYI METROPOLITAN NEW DISTRICT MAN COMMITTEE;ZHEJIANG UNDERGROUND ARCHITECTURAL DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Tunnel construction risk assessment method and device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a risk assessment method and device for tunnel construction and a storage medium. The risk assessment method comprises the following steps: constructing a Bayesian network according to predetermined evaluation indexes, wherein the evaluation indexes comprise risk events of tunnel construction and influence indexes causing the risk events; acquiring construction site data of a current tunnel; determining the structural parameters of the Bayesian network according to the construction site data, the Copula function of the interdependence relation of the evaluation indexes and the marginal distribution parameters of each evaluation index; and constructing the risk event prediction model according to the structural parameters and the Bayesian network. According to the method and the device, the accuracy of the risk prediction model is guaranteed, the demand quantity and the model calculation quantity of data can be greatly reduced, and the method and the device can be used for evaluating multiple risks such as water inrush and mud gushing in the tunnel construction process.

title_en: City lifeline remote monitering system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city life line remote monitoring system, relating to the technical field of city management, and aiming at the problems of labor waste and labor waste in the prior art, the invention provides a scheme which comprises a cloud background monitoring system, wherein the cloud background monitoring system is remotely and wirelessly connected with an oil transportation online monitoring system, a hot gas online monitoring system, an electric power online monitoring system, a water supply online monitoring system, a sewage online monitoring system, a precipitation online monitoring system, a bridge online detection system, a special equipment online monitoring system, a fire fighting online monitoring system and a personnel online monitoring system, the invention can carry out nearby treatment at the first time, reduce the situation development, further reduce the damage caused by danger, maximally ensure the city operation and the life and property safety of people, simultaneously reduce the frequency of personnel detection, further reduce the working intensity and the labor input of personnel, the efficiency and the frequency of detection are increased, and the safe and stable operation of the lifeline is further ensured.
assignees: GUIZHOU GEOSPATIAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Comprehensive information management service system suitable for small-scale operator
abstract_en: The method is suitable for a comprehensive information management service system of a small-scale operator. The patent is used as a pioneer of a global small-scale operator comprehensive information management service system, forms a great leading position in the industry on the aspects of technology, completion degree, specialty degree and comprehensive performance, and has obvious characteristics. It mainly includes seven major centers of fund flow management system, stock receiving and dispatching system, commodity code scanning and trading system, customer management system, supplier management system, tourism information management system and financial management system. All subsystems in the system are interdependent and linked to form a powerful and efficient management system. With the complication of social business environment and the high-speed development of internet, mobile phone hardware equipment and software technology, it is important to bring the function and concept of the comprehensive information management system to the small-scale operator. It can help them improve financial performance, risk control awareness and ability to cope with emergency events.
assignees: ZHU JIE

title_en: Functional recovery decision-making method of interdependent hydropower system based on flexible city
abstract_en: The invention discloses a functional recovery decision-making method of an interdependent hydropower system based on a flexible city, which comprises the following steps: s1, initializing data: s2, randomly generating a plurality of sequences of the serial numbers of the damage components, wherein the sequences are used as chromosomes, namely an initial population, setting identity codes of chromosome slices and an information pool of the integral hydroelectric function level in a corresponding damage state, and setting the iteration times of a genetic algorithm; s3, judging whether the identity code of the chromosome slice to be evaluated exists in the information pool or not: if the water-electricity integral function level exists, the water-electricity integral function level in the information pool is directly called; otherwise, calculating to obtain the integral function level of the hydropower; and S4, operating the chromosome to obtain the next generation of chromosomes, and selecting the optimal chromosome based on the adaptive function value if the iteration times are reached. The method can meet the requirement of time urgency of recovery after disasters when optimizing the function recovery decision method of the interdependent hydropower system, thereby being really applied to actual disaster scenes.

title_en: Marine fire-fighting life-saving box with life cable
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a marine fire-fighting lifesaving case with lifeline, including fire-fighting lifesaving case body and stopper, the equal fixedly connected with gasbag in upper and lower surface of fire-fighting lifesaving case body, the equal fixedly connected with device box in the left and right sides of fire-fighting lifesaving case body, the transversal fretwork state of personally submitting of device box, one side that the fire-fighting lifesaving case body was kept away from to the device box all sets up porosely and has emboliaed the slide, the transversal rectangle of personally submitting of slide, the slide is located the inside one end fixedly connected with spring of device box, the quantity of spring is two and is the upper and lower symmetrical state, the inside fixed connection of spring and device box. Through the arrangement of the air bag, the device box, the sliding plate, the spring, the wheels, the bending plate, the limiting block and the life cable, the beneficial effect that people falling into water can float in water is achieved, the beneficial effect that the people falling into water are drowned in water is avoided, and the advantage that the people falling into water timely return to the ship side is achieved.
assignees: PIAO XUANCHUN

title_en: Natural Circulation Type Tree Flowerpot Filtering System to Reduce Non-point Pollution Sources from the Opaque in Urban Areas by Utilizing Urban Infrastructure
title_ko: 도시지역 불투수면에서 발생하는 비점오염원을 도시기반시설을 활용하여 저감하는 자연순환형 나무화분여과시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a natural circulation type tree planter filtration system which reduces non-point pollution sources generated from impervious surfaces in urban areas by utilizing an urban infrastructure. The natural circulation type tree planter filtration system of the present invention comprises: a wooden box; a media filter; an appendage space; a planting space; a vegetation gravel; and a drain. When the natural circulation type tree planer filtration system is installed, there are effects such as flood prevention due to removal of non-point pollution sources of a rainwater and reduction of a peak runoff.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도시지역 불투수면에서 발생하는 비점오염원을 도시기반시설을 활용하여 저감하는 자연순환형 나무화분여과시스템으로서, 기존에 식재되어 있는 조경수, 가로수 등을 이용할 수 있을 뿐 아니라 새로이 조성되는 도시지역 설계에도 적용이 가능하고, 시설을 설치 후에는 도시지역 및 도로에서 발생되는 비점 오염원을 저감시키는 작용과 처리된 우수를 하수도로 이송을 시키는 것이 아닌, 지면저류 및 토양 저류를 통하여 첨두유량과 유출용적을 저감시켜 지하수 고갈 문제 해결 및 홍수 재해 방지에 도움이 되는 기술로 된 자연순환형 나무화분 여과시스템에 관한 것이다. 발명의 구성은 나무상자, 여재필터, 충수공간, 식재공간, 식생토 자갈 및배수구로 이루어져 있다. 상부 식재공간에는 교목(가로수) 및 관목을 식재하여 도심조경을 자연스럽게 할 수 있으며, 하부에는 충수공간에 담수되어 있는 오염된 우수를 여과필터를 통해 일부는 식생토를 통해 식재된 수목에 공급이 되며, 일부는 지하로 순환되는 구조를 가진 자연순환형 나무화분 여과시스템이다. 이 시스템을 우수가 많이 발생하는 지역 등에서는 우수체류장치를 연결하여 더 많은 우수를 지하수로 환수시킬 수 있으며. 나무상자에 우수체류장치를 우수연결관으로 연결하여 활용할 수 있다. 우수체류장치 상부에는 식재공간을 두어 교목 등 초하 류를 식재하여 화단의 형태로 사용할 수 있으며 식생분리판으로 분리된 지하부에는 충수공간을 두어 오염된 우수를 저장시켜 상부에 식재된 교목 등 초하류 등에 공급되고, 일부는 우수연결관을 통해 우수박스로 보내어져 가로수 및 지하수로 돌아가게 된다. 본 발명의 자연순환형 나무화분 여과시스템 설치 시 우수의 비점오염원 제거 및 첨두유출량 감소로 홍수 예방 등의 효과가 있다.
assignees: NATURAL HARMONY CO LTD

title_en: Smart evacuation guiding system
title_ko: 스마트 라이프라인 피난 유도 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a smart lifeline evacuation guiding system. The smart lifeline evacuation guiding system according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a guide sign part for exposing guide sign content using an LED module and a voice output module; a sensor part for determining whether an emergency situation has occurred by sensing the surrounding situation; an IoT communication part for, if an emergency situation is detected by the sensor part, transmitting the current position information and an emergency situation occurrence signal to a control server and receiving evacuation line information from the control server; a control part for displaying the evacuation line information, which has been received from the control server, on the LED module and controlling a guide voice to be outputted through the voice output module; a power source part including a main power source part for receiving commercial power and supplying power and an auxiliary power source part for supplying emergency power; and a protection cover member for protecting an inside region from an external shock. Therefore, provided is a smart lifeline evacuation guiding system, wherein safe evacuation from a fire position is enabled.
abstract_ko: 스마트 라이프라인 피난 유도 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일실시례에 따른 스마트 라이프라인 피난 유도 시스템은 LED 모듈 및 음성 출력 모듈을 이용하여 안내 표지 내용을 노출하는 안내표지부; 주변상황 센싱하여 비상상황 발생 여부를 판단하는 센서부; 상기 센서부에서 비상상황이 감지된 경우, 현재 위치정보 및 비상상황 발생신호를 관제서버에 송신하고, 상기 관제서버로부터 대피동선정보를 수신하는 IoT 통신부; 상기 관제서버로부터 수신된 대피동선정보를 상기 LED 모듈 상에 디스플레이하고, 상기 음성 출력 모듈을 통해 안내 음성이 출력되도록 제어하는 제어부; 상용 전원을 공급받아 전원을 공급하는 주전원부와 비상 전원을 공급하는 부전원부를 포함하는 전원부; 및 외부 충격으로부터 내부 영역을 보호하는 보호커버부재;를 포함한다.

title_en: Urban lifeline water, electricity, gas and heat early warning management and analysis system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of city management, and discloses a city lifeline water, electricity, gas and warm early warning management analysis system which comprises a control center, wherein the control center consists of a data processing system and an execution system, the data processing system comprises a data collection module, the execution system comprises an instruction issuing module, the data collection module consists of an online data collection module and an offline data collection module, the control center also comprises a server, the output end and the input end of the server are connected with the output end and the input end of the data processing system, and the output end and the input end of the data collection module are connected with a data uploading module. According to the invention, the data collection module consists of the online data collection module and the offline data collection module, and bidirectional data collection is carried out by the online data collection module and the offline data collection module, so that the stability and accuracy of data collection are ensured, and the follow-up work can be more accurate and complete.

title_en: Wind farm short-term wind speed prediction method combining VMD and attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power plant short-term wind speed prediction method combining a VMD and an attention mechanism, which comprises the steps of firstly obtaining wind speed space-time data of a target site, establishing a series SWSM according to an original data set, carrying out VMD wind speed decomposition on SWSM, combining a CNN model with the attention mechanism, aiming at each son SWSM, using a SENet model at the bottom layer to extract airspace characteristics of wind speed, carrying out wind speed time domain characteristic extraction by using a GRU model at the top layer to obtain respective prediction results, accumulating each prediction result to obtain final prediction wind speed, fully utilizing the space-time correlation of wind speed, combining the VMD and the attention mechanism, improving the unstable characteristic of the original wind speed, utilizing the attention mechanism to optimize the CNN-GRU model, enabling the model to capture the characteristics of long-distance interdependence in the sequence more easily, effectively improving the wind speed prediction precision, and guaranteeing the reliable operation of a power system.

title_en: Electric power Internet of things security risk assessment method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of electric power automation, and discloses a safety risk assessment method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for an electric power internet of things, which comprises the steps of establishing an information network graph, an electric power network graph and an inter-network dependency relationship of the electric power internet of things based on a dependent network theory; acquiring attacked nodes in the information network graph, assigning the state values of the attacked nodes to preset attack success probability, and updating the state values of all the nodes in the information network graph according to an information side graph calculation method; determining attack success probability of each node in the electric power network diagram through interdependency relation among networks according to the updated state value of each node in the information network diagram; determining the state value of each node in the electric power network graph by a physical side graph calculation method according to the attack success probability of each node in the electric power network graph; and obtaining a safety risk evaluation value of the power internet of things according to the state value of each node in the power grid graph. The safety assessment accuracy and comprehensiveness are greatly improved, and guidance is provided for designing or improving the topology of the power Internet of things.

title_en: Anomaly detection method and system based on similarity learning fusion model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent power utilization, and provides an anomaly detection method and system based on a similarity learning fusion model. The method comprises the steps of obtaining electricity utilization information to be detected; carrying out power utilization anomaly detection based on the trained similarity learning fusion model; the training process of the similarity learning fusion model comprises the following steps: constructing a heterogeneous information network based on pre-acquired power data, and simultaneously learning user similarity power consumption behaviors to obtain similarity power consumption behavior groups; grouping based on the similarity power utilization behaviors, and respectively performing context learning on the power utilization behavior data of different groups to obtain power utilization expression vectors of users; capturing the interdependence relation between the similarity grouping vector and the electricity expression vectors of different groups by adopting a graph attention machine mechanism so as to obtain a comprehensive expression vector of a user; constructing a softmax prediction function by utilizing the comprehensive expression vector of the user; and training learning parameters of the similarity learning fusion model based on the loss function of the output value of the softmax prediction function.

title_en: Method for identifying and evaluating major safety risk of urban gas system

The invention is beneficial to mastering the safety condition of the urban lifeline in detail, making clear the key points of management and control and restraining serious accidents.

abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-resistant sealing protective cover for a sling anchor cup and a sling anchor cup protective system thereof; comprises a sealing cover body; the sealing cover body is a cylindrical body with openings at two ends; the inner surface of the sealing cover body is provided with a sealing fireproof layer; the sling anchor cup protection system comprises the fire-resistant sealing protection cover, and the sealing cover body is wrapped and fixed on the outer side of the sling anchor cup in a sealing manner and forms an isolation gap with the sling anchor cup; the sealing cover further comprises a dehumidification system used for introducing dry gas into the isolation gap, and an air inlet valve and an air outlet valve used for introducing the dry gas are arranged on the sealing cover body. title_en: Method and storage medium for realizing parallel computation of power dispatching mass data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing parallel computation of power dispatching massive data and a storage medium, wherein the method analyzes a computation request by means of a lexical analysis, analyzes different phrases and interdependencies of the computation request to obtain a lexical analysis table, combines the analyzed lexical analysis table into a multi-way tree to form a grammar analysis tree, converts the grammar analysis tree into a sequence dependency graph of object operation to form an object computation graph, converts the object computation graph into a series of vector primitive operations through a vectorization computation engine to form a vector computation graph, and enables the vector primitive operations to be executed on a multi-core processor, thereby improving the parallel efficiency of the power dispatching multi-element heterogeneous massive data computation.

title_en: Optimized control of power depots using multi-tenant charging system-of-systems
abstract_en: Optimization of independently operated power infrastructure sites, such as electric vehicle (EV) depots, can result in sub-optimal operation across a plurality of power infrastructure sites. Disclosed embodiments aggregate a plurality of power infrastructure sites, which support flexible loads, into a virtual site model, representing a multi-tenant charging system-of-systems, that can be optimized as a single unit, across one or more criteria, to maximize utilization of infrastructure assets and provide robustness against uncertainties during operation of the power infrastructure sites, while minimizing energy costs. When applied to EV depots, embodiments can mitigate or reduce delays in the operation of EV fleets.
assignees: HITACHI ENERGY LTD

title_en: Identification method and system for critical propagation path of cascading failure of power system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for identifying a critical propagation path of cascading failures of a power system, belonging to the technical field of power system failure identification, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring current information and voltage information of each node in the power system based on WAMS system data, and further determining the actual power of each node; constructing an overload outage probability model of the power transmission line according to the actual power of each node; constructing an evaluation model of the N-k fault event according to the overload outage probability model; linearizing the nonlinear constraint of the evaluation model based on the power balance constraint and the propagation path constraint to generate a multi-stage linear programming evaluation model; and determining a key propagation path of the cascading failure according to the linear programming evaluation model. In this way, the interdependencies of the outage lines in the event of an N-k fault can be directly revealed, and the critical propagation paths of cascading overload faults can be effectively identified.

title_en: Underground utilities managing system
title_ko: Rfid태그 이용 매설물 관리 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an underground facility management device using an RFID tag. More specifically, the underground facility management device using an RFID tag comprises: an electronic identification tag including a fixture fixed to a buried object to be managed, a string attached to the fixture, and an RFID tag unit fixed to the string; an electronic identification reader configured to communicate with the RFID tag in the RFID tag unit via the LF band and read information from the electronic identification tag; a GIS configured to exchange necessary information regarding the buried object with the electronic identification reader; and a GPS configured to provide location information of the buried object to the electronic identification reader. With this configuration, when a plurality of buried objects of different types are buried underground, an electronic identification tag incorporating a unique RFID tag can be installed for each buried object so as to enable each buried object to be identified without confusion.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 RFID태그 이용 매설물 관리 장치에 관한 것으로서 더욱 구체적으로는, 지하에 매설되어서 관리대상이 되는 매설물에 고정되는 고정체와, 상기 고정체에 부착되는 스트링과, 상기 스트링체 고정되는 RFID태그유니트로 이루어진 전자인식표시기와,  
상기 RFID태그유니트 내의 RFID태그와 LF대역으로 무선 통신하는 RFID리더로서의 기능을 가지고 상기 전자인식표시기의 정보를 판독하는 전자인식판독기와,  
상기 전자인식판독기와, 매설물에 관한 필요 정보를 교환하는 GIS와,  
상기 전자인식판독기에 상기 매설물의 위치정보를 제공하는 GPS를 포함하여 구성된다.  
이러한 구성을 통하면, 지중에 종류가 다른 다수의 매설물이 매설된 경우에는, 각 매설물 별로 고유의 RFID태그를 내장하는 전자인식표시기를 설치하여서 타 매설물과 혼돈하지 않고 구분을 할 수 있다.  
여기서, 매설물 예컨대 전기선로, 통신선로, 도시가스관, 상하수도관 등은 도시의 기반시설이며 도시를 유지하는 핵심요소이고 이러한 매설물은 안전하게 보호되기 위해서, 그리고 환경이나 도시 미관 등의 복합적인 요건을 충족하기 위해서 일반적으로 지하에 매립되어 설치된다.

title_en: Underground pipe network interaction risk early warning system for urban lifeline

title_en: Urban lifeline sensing and safe operation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban lifeline sensing and safety operation system, and relates to the technical field of urban safety management. title_en: Photovoltaic module profit prediction model system and method based on big data model

title_en: Modeling coupling method for electric power information physical system based on interdependence network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a modeling coupling method of an electric power information physical system based on an interdependence network, which comprises the following steps: establishing a power grid model according to a complex network theory, and calculating to obtain a power grid adjacency matrix; establishing an information network model according to a complex network theory, and calculating to obtain an information network adjacency matrix; establishing an information physical dependent model based on an inherent self-similar coupling theory, and constructing a topological structure of the electric power information physical system based on an electric power network and an information network adjacency matrix; and establishing a power grid and information network weight model based on the topological structure of the power information physical system and the power flow distribution characteristic of the power system, and obtaining corresponding line weights for reflecting the occupation condition of each line. According to the invention, on the basis of considering the power flow distribution characteristics of the power system, the analysis index is put forward to build the weight model, so that the model has more power characteristics, the model with higher coupling degree between the power network and the information network is obtained, and the energy is more reasonably scheduled.

title_en: Method for constructing reliability evaluation and maintenance optimization model of offshore wind farm in Internet of things background
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for constructing a reliability evaluation and maintenance optimization model of an offshore wind power plant in the background of the Internet of things, which can effectively solve the problem that the whole power grid is affected once the transmission process of the power grid is interrupted in the prior art; according to the characteristics of a layered architecture of the Internet of things and an offshore wind farm, a multi-layer network model of the offshore wind farm is built, a shape parameter change model, a fan and component reliability model thereof are built according to temperature data and wind speed data, and a perception layer node reliability evaluation model is built; according to the wind turbine fault sequence and distance, the offshore wind farm radius maintenance optimization model is established, the reliability of the sensing layer nodes and the communication path is evaluated, the fan fault time is predicted, and further the maintenance scheme is optimized, so that the operation and maintenance management of the offshore wind power network is intelligently maintained, and the method is an innovation on the offshore wind farm reliability evaluation and maintenance optimization model.

title_en: Method for monitoring infrastructure, site facility and human health and safety by using earthquake sensor
abstract_en: The present disclosure describes systems, methods, and workflows for real-time monitoring of modern urban infrastructure, computer-implemented methods, computer software products, and machine learning models based on seismic data. The infrastructure includes bridges, highway tunnels, airports, buildings and wind power towers. Monitoring is not limited to recorded seismic data. The present disclosure also emphasizes the importance of utilizing seismic sensors to monitor various critical infrastructures, including security sites and manufacturing facilities, to promote security and security capabilities, to detect infrastructure health, and to prevent unauthorized intrusion. In addition, the seismic sensors may also be used for indoor human activity monitoring. Bridge monitoring involves continuous assessment to ensure structural integrity and extend service life, highway tunnel monitoring focuses on optimizing traffic conditions and monitoring structural images, airport monitoring helps to improve runway safety, ensures optimal performance of aviation infrastructure, reduces potential risks to the greatest extent, and improves overall safety and efficiency of aviation travel. By deploying seismic sensors to monitor building infrastructure, detection and localization of potential risks to the building structure can be achieved. Monitoring of wind power towers is critical to optimizing green energy production and ensuring structural health of fans. The monitoring of security and manufacturing sites aims to ensure the safety and security of facilities and prevent unauthorized intrusion. By monitoring and analyzing the seismic data of indoor human activity, different types of activity can be identified and events such as walking, falling, etc. detected. By adopting the seismic sensors and processing the seismic data in real time, the monitoring systems jointly improve the safety, security, toughness and reliability of key infrastructure in different fields.
