title_en: Remote monitoring and early warning system for urban lifeline
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to the technical field of urban management, and discloses a remote monitoring and early warning system for an urban lifeline. The system comprises: the monitoring system, the middleware of the Internet of things and the server are electrically connected in sequence; the monitoring system is used for acquiring monitoring data related to the urban lifeline; the internet of things middleware is used for converting formats of all monitoring data into unified internet of things metadata, and converting the internet of things metadata corresponding to the monitoring data after format conversion into different business event data for processing by a server side according to different business rules preset by different types of monitoring data; the server side is used for respectively monitoring the states of the urban lifelines corresponding to the different types of monitoring data according to the different types of service event data, acquiring alarm data in the service event data, and carrying out early warning display on the alarm data when the states of the urban lifelines are abnormal. The application can realize the modern informatization comprehensive management of the urban lifeline.
assignees: XINGYI NORMAL UNIV FOR NATIONALITIES

title_en: Holographic sensing, monitoring and early warning method for urban lifeline
abstract_en: The invention discloses a holographic sensing, monitoring and early warning method for an urban lifeline, which relates to the technical field of urban management and comprises the following steps: s1: monitoring cities, and arranging gas, liquid pressure, flow sensors, liquid level sensors, temperature, humidity and TVOC related data monitoring or front-end sensing sensors to construct a sensor network; s2: collecting monitoring data in real time through the constructed sensor network, and transmitting the monitoring data to the cloud through a wireless transmission communication network; s3: after the cloud receives the data, analyzing and evaluating the monitoring data through the anomaly identification model, and outputting a prediction result; the holographic sensing, monitoring and early warning method for the urban lifeline realizes comprehensive sensing and dynamic monitoring of the urban lifeline and timely sensing and early prediction and early warning functions of urban safety risk.
assignees: CHINA ROAD & BRIDGE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Analysis method for financial behaviors between electric power material market
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power material financial behavior analysis, in particular to an analysis method of financial behavior among current markets of electric power materials, which is characterized in that a complex network of a spot market and a complex network of a future market are respectively established according to time sequences among various modes, acceptance factors of price fluctuation by current market participants are introduced, a coarse granulation method is established to classify node states in the complex network of the current market, steady state coefficients of price difference between the current market and the current market are introduced, a double-layer coupling complex network is established based on price evolution relation among the two complex networks, and price coupling strength indexes are established to analyze financial behavior characteristics of the market participants. By constructing a multilayer network, a new method for analyzing financial behaviors between spot markets and futures markets through historical prices of electric power materials and raw materials thereof is provided, so that the price fluctuation rule of the electric power materials can be mastered more accurately, and theoretical support and technical guidance are provided for minimizing the purchase cost of the electric power materials.
assignees: JIANGSU ANFANG ELECTRIC POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: the building structure for cosmos art gallery
title_ko: 코스모스아트갤러리용 건축구조물
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a building structure for a cosmos art gallery provided as a spiral pentagonal-type building structure capable of providing an infrastructure for tourism resources related to overall viewing, education, music, performances, images and cultural arts experience and performing complex functions in regard to cultural art fields such as astronomical constellation, ancient history, mathematics, sailing, philosophy, ideology and the like among the shining cultural heritage of Korea. The building structure for a cosmos art gallery includes: a work exhibition hall (104) in which an electric pipe facility space (EPS), a machine facility piping space (PS), a communication cable pipe space (TPS), and a fire-fighting alarm valve room (A/V) are arranged and formed in each floor of an art gallery main building (A), an outer side of a center core composed of a floor exhibition space and viewing routes and an inner wall surface is composed of an exhibition wall; a media facade module (102) for astronomical constellation display, in which an outer wall surface of each floor is recessed with one selected from among LED lighting and an LED panel; and a rooftop object (C) in which a media mapping system is installed on a certain spot in one selected from among the inside and outside of a sculpture in which crescent moon, sun and star shapes are vertically and sequentially built in the uppermost part of the rooftop.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 코스모스아트갤러리용 건축구조물에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세히는  우리나라의 빛나는 문화 유산중 천문(天文)관련 별자리,고대사,수리,항해, 철학,사상 등의 문화예술분야의 총체적인 관람, 교육, 음악, 공연, 영상 및 문화예술체험관련 관광자원의 기반시설제공 및 복합적인 기능을 수행할수 있도록 하는 아트갤러리본관 건축구조물로서,센터코어형 구조에 중추기능 집중화로 작품 주제별 배치가 용이하며, 작품관람동선의 순환성과 뷰(view)가 좋으며,평면적으로 유효면적이 증대되는 효과의 평면적 역할 이외에,구조적으로도 골조의 비틀림 저항성능도 확보시키며, 아트갤러리본관 각층은 코스모스아트갤러리용 건축구조물의 모티브를 극대화시키기 위하여,아트갤러리본관의 각층 외벽면을 천문별자리가 디스플레이되는 대형 미디어파사드모듈을 구축함과 동시에; 옥탑에 조성된 초승달,해,별형상의 옥탑오브제에 탑재투영되는 미디어맵핑시스템에 의한 주야간경관 연출에 따른 천문 포토존 제공과 볼꺼리 제공 및 문화예술관련 국내외 각종 전시공간 제공과 더불어 모티브가 천문(天文)인 독창적인 관광으뜸명소로 대두되게 하는 효과를 제공하도록 하는 유용한 발명인 것이다.
assignees: JEUN YOUNG WOO

title_en: System and method for analyzing cyber security postures and real-time asset validation for critical infrastructure
abstract_en: In an aspect, system and method for analyzing cybersecurity posture for an OT infrastructure is disclosed. The method comprises categorizing a plurality of devices of one or more plants of the OT infrastructure into a plurality of levels, based on an exposure of each device to a communication network, identifying CVEs of components of the plurality of devices, at each level. The method comprises assigning a severity value to the one or more CVEs of components and determining a plant cybersecurity posture score (PCPS) for the one or more plants. The method comprises computing a critical infrastructure cybersecurity posture score for the OT infrastructure. The method comprises applying remediation to one or more vulnerable components based on a prioritization sequence. In another aspect, system and method for real- time asset validation of connected devices in the OT infrastructure is performed based on the device critical parameters, cybersecurity parameters, and functional safety parameters.
assignees: ABB SCHWEIZ AG

title_en: Urban water relation-oriented urban storage and evacuation space optimization method and simulation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban water storage and drainage space optimization method and an urban water storage and drainage space simulation system, particularly relates to the field of urban water resource management and optimization, and aims to solve the problems of low efficiency and poor response capability of an urban water storage and drainage system, and avoid short-term season influence original data through a long-term and short-term memory network. Analyzing the contribution of the reservoirs in the dispatch network, calculating the comprehensive significance and interaction in combination with the multi-layer network analysis, and evaluating the importance of the reservoirs from multiple dimensions. And identifying a reservoir in a high-pressure area by adopting a clustering optimization method, performing space optimization, enhancing the adjusting capability and relieving the pressure in the high-load area. And combining a self-service method and Monte Carlo simulation test to optimize the reliability of the result, ensuring the stability and consistency of the high-influence area and avoiding accidental judgment. The urban water resource management system realizes the accurate regulation and control of the urban water storage and discharge system, improves the resource scheduling efficiency, ensures the stability and the sustainability of urban water resource management, and provides a scientific and effective optimization scheme.

title_en: Method for forecasting temperature in underground utility tunnel based on residual CNN-LSTM
title_ko: Residual CNN-LSTM 모델로 지하 공동구의 온도변화를 실시간으로 예측하는 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for predicting a temperature change of an underground common duct in real time with a residual cnn-lstm model. Since the underground common duct is an important national facility that jointly accommodates the city's lifeline such as electricity, communication, water supply, and heating, it is difficult to extinguish the fire as well as paralysis of the city's infrastructure in the event of a disaster such as a fire, so the damage increases out of control. Therefore, ordinary prevention and detection activities are important, and to this end, various monitoring equipment, such as a temperature sensor, a fire detection sensor, and various sensors for monitoring and detecting a disaster are installed. The present invention provides the method for predicting in real time how a temperature will change by using deep learning analysis for temperature information collected from temperature sensors in order to detect and predict in advance a sign of occurrence of a large-scale disaster that can occur in an underground common duct such as a fire.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, Residual CNN-LSTM 모델로 지하 공동구의 온도변화를 실시간으로 예측하는 방법에 관한 것이다. 지하 공동구는 전력, 통신, 수도, 난방 등과 같은 도시의 라이프 라인을 공동으로 수용하는 국가 중요 시설물이기 때문에 화재 등 재난의 발생 시 도시 인프라의 마비는 물론 화재 진압이 어려워 피해가 걷잡을 수 없이 커진다. 따라서 평상시 예방 및 탐지 활동이 중요하며, 이를 위하여 재난 발생의 감시 및 탐지를 위한 이를 위한 각종 감시장비들과 온도센서, 화재감지 센서 등 다양한 센서들이 설치되어 있다. 본 발명에서는 화재 등과 같이 지하 공동구에서 발생할 수 있는 대형 재난의 발생 징후를 사전에 탐지하고 예측하기 위하여 온도 센서들에서 수집되는 온도정보들에 대하여 딥러닝 분석을 이용하여 온도가 어떻게 변화할지를 실시간으로 예측하는 방법을 제공한다.
assignees: VAIV COMPANY INC

title_en: Method and system for predicting icing galloping of power transmission line
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for predicting icing galloping of a power transmission line, comprising the following steps: obtaining galloping monitoring data of a power transmission line; based on the galloping monitoring data of the power transmission line, a pre-trained deep learning galloping prediction model is utilized to obtain a prediction result of icing galloping of the power transmission line; the deep learning galloping prediction model is obtained by training a stacked self-encoder by taking historical galloping monitoring data as input data of training data and icing galloping index values corresponding to the historical galloping monitoring data as output data of the training data, wherein the stacked self-encoder comprises an input layer, at least two continuous hidden layers and a Softmax output layer; according to the application, the deep learning galloping prediction model constructed by stacking self-encoders based on a multi-layer network structure can be used for carrying out efficient and accurate icing galloping prediction on a large number of conditions.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network risk assessment method considering network coupling
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power distribution network risk assessment method considering network coupling, and belongs to the technical field of power distribution networks. The method comprises the following steps: step S1: based on the BAG model, calculating the probability of success of RTU attack; step S2: analyzing an uploading signal of the RTU through the FA system, judging whether the FA system executes a fault processing process, if so, performing fault positioning, isolation and recovery, operating a power recovery model considering network coupling, and outputting interrupt cost; step S3: and (2) after the calculation of the interrupt cost is finished in the step (S2), judging whether a simulation stopping condition is met, and if so, calculating the system risk according to the system risk assessment index. According to the invention, by establishing the power supply recovery model considering the interdependence between the network and the physical system, the model is expressed as Mixed Integer Linear Programming (MILP) in mathematics, and can be solved by the existing solver, compared with the prior art, the power supply recovery model is simpler and more convenient to calculate and has higher calculation precision.
assignees: DONGFANG ELECTRONICS CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Urban road network toughness measurement method under multi-layer traffic network dependence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban road network toughness measurement method under multi-layer traffic network dependence, which comprises the following steps of collecting space vector data of urban roads, subways and public transport networks, mapping different space layer data into a multi-layer network model formed by nodes and edges, gradually removing the road network edges and other traffic network lines connected with the road network edges, drawing a relation curve between road network structure indexes and removal proportions under the support of the connection of the rest different traffic layer networks, and comparing phase change threshold values and disaster tolerance changes of the space structures of the road networks under the support of the different traffic layer networks. The invention builds the interconnection model and the toughness measurement model of the road network and other multi-layer traffic networks, can reveal complex mechanisms of the mutual support and the destructive propagation of the road network and the traffic network, can identify key threshold values and important areas of the road space structure change under the multi-layer traffic support, and provides a technical tool for accurately measuring the toughness of the urban road network.

title_en: Multi-station photovoltaic power generation power prediction method and system based on graph attention network
abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-station photovoltaic power generation power prediction method and a system based on a graph attention network, wherein the method comprises the following steps of obtaining a space dependency model containing a station space relationship according to the station dependency relationship based on the graph attention network; the method comprises the steps of constructing a time-dependent model containing site time relation based on an autoregressive long-term memory network and a probability framework, constructing a first missing data filling layer according to a spatial feature compensation strategy, constructing a second missing data filling layer according to a temporal feature compensation strategy, constructing a third missing data filling layer according to the space-time correlation of a neighbor site set, constructing a space-time data processing layer, and constructing a photovoltaic power generation power prediction model according to the spatial-dependent model, the time-dependent model and the time-space data processing layer by utilizing historical operation data of a photovoltaic site. The method has the beneficial effects of reducing the requirement on training data, improving the photovoltaic power generation power prediction pertinence, and improving the photovoltaic power generation power prediction accuracy and the model applicability.

title_en: Water-grain-energy-ecological correlation system collaborative configuration method considering unconventional water utilization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-grain-energy-ecological association system collaborative configuration method considering unconventional water utilization, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a water-grain-energy-ecological association system collaborative configuration model, quantitatively analyzing interaction relations among water resource distribution, agricultural production, energy utilization and ecological protection, quantifying complex interdependencies among a plurality of random variables by adopting a vine copula method, solving the model by adopting an integrated vine copula and multi-stage random optimization method, and analyzing influence of brackish water utilization rate, joint default probability and water level on WFEE association systems. The invention considers the cooperative allocation of unconventional and conventional water resources, reduces the shortage pressure of regional water resources and reflects the complex mutual influence relationship among a plurality of subsystems.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING NORMAL

title_en: Multi-region-oriented wind power, load and electricity price combined prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-region-oriented wind power, load and electricity price combined prediction method and system. The method comprises the steps of firstly collecting wind power, load and electricity price data of a plurality of areas, obtaining relevant weather and geographical position information, processing the obtained data to form a characteristic input channel, then constructing multi-scale graph convolution by carrying out frequency decomposition on a Laplacian matrix of a graph, capturing multi-scale information in the characteristic channel, defining a new loss function and parameter updating rule to optimize model training, then sharing an intermediate characteristic layer, integrating intermediate characteristics of all target variables to form a shared characteristic matrix, inputting the shared characteristic matrix into the model for training, and finally outputting the wind power, the load and the electricity price target variables simultaneously. The method can extract the unique characteristics of each region, capture the interdependence between different regions and target variables, remarkably improve the prediction precision, and is suitable for the scenes of wind power output, load demand, electricity price prediction and the like of multiple regions.

title_en: Early overflow detection and grading early warning processing system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an early overflow detection and grading early warning processing system and method, and belongs to the technical field of well control safety in petroleum and natural gas drilling engineering. According to the invention, potential nodes are introduced as intermediate variables, so that the dependency relationship among attribute variables is simplified, and a plurality of attribute variables are independent relative to the intermediate variable conditions, so that the model structure is simplified, and meanwhile, the interdependence relationship among the nodes can be reflected, thereby being applied to actual working conditions and achieving the purposes of improving the overflow monitoring accuracy and reducing the discrimination error. In addition, the invention also increases a plurality of grading early warning thresholds, constructs an overflow early warning risk assessment part and an early warning grading and processing mode part, can more comprehensively understand stratum characteristics, judge overflow causes and control subsequent shaft pressure, and has important significance.
assignees: PETROCHINA CO LTD

title_en: Lifeline incapacitation grading method, device, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, a system and a storage medium for classifying life line incapacitation levels, which comprise the steps of S1, obtaining group mental state influence factors of sudden events, S2, obtaining sudden power disaster event influence factors, S3, correlating the group mental state influence factors with the sudden power disaster event influence factors, and carrying out sudden power disaster event severity assessment through a comprehensive fuzzy evaluation method. By adopting the technical scheme of the invention, the severity level of different sudden power disaster events can be given according to the actual conditions of the events.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Multi-target library real-time data synchronization method for electric power metering
abstract_en: The invention provides a power metering-oriented multi-target library real-time data synchronization method which comprises the steps of constructing a metering data dependency model based on a power load curve theory, optimizing a multi-target scheduling strategy by utilizing an improved non-dominant sorting genetic algorithm, processing power data by applying an intelligent slicing and mixed compression strategy, executing synchronization based on a multi-level buffering strategy and a batch writing algorithm, and implementing multi-dimensional consistency verification and generating a layered restoration scheme. The scheme realizes the real-time synchronization of the power metering data with high efficiency, high reliability and low resource consumption, and provides a high-quality data base for the power grid dispatching decision.

title_en: Power grid project risk assessment system and method integrating Pareto and Borda rules
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid project risk assessment system and method integrating Pareto and Borda rules, and belongs to the technical field of project risk assessment. The system comprises a multi-dimensional risk interaction relation identification module, a risk interaction weight generation module, a risk ranking and Pareto processing module and a multiparty dynamic game decision module, wherein the multi-dimensional risk interaction relation identification module is used for analyzing the interdependence relation among all risk factors of a target power grid project and constructing a multi-dimensional risk relation network map, the risk interaction weight generation module is used for determining interaction weights among all the risk factors, the risk ranking and Pareto processing module is used for ranking all the risk factors based on a Pareto analysis method to obtain a preliminary risk priority ranking list and key risk factors, and the multiparty dynamic game decision module is used for performing game decision on ranking schemes of a plurality of project participants based on a Borda rule and combining the preliminary risk priority ranking list to obtain a final risk priority ranking list. The risk ranking method and the risk ranking device can improve the rationality of risk ranking, and based on the ranking result, the effect of risk assessment on the items can be improved.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Informer model improvement-based intelligent automobile charging load probability prediction method
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent automobile charging load probability prediction method based on Informer model improvement, which comprises the steps of 1, collecting and arranging charging data of a relevant area, 2, improving an original model, designing a space-time multi-scale attention network (SMAN) module and a bidirectional interaction attention (DDI) module, 3, obtaining an accurate charging demand prediction model through training, calculating a prediction error, comparing with the prediction effect of other existing models, and 4, carrying out an ablation experiment, and comparing the improvement effects of different modules on model performance. And 5, realizing probability prediction of the charging load of the electric automobile, improving prediction precision and assisting power grid management. The invention creatively provides the SMAN and the DDI module based on Informer model, the SMAN module aims at solving the space-time dependency modeling problem in the charge load prediction, the prediction precision is obviously improved, the DDI module captures the space-time dependency relationship more effectively, and the accuracy of the dynamic charge demand prediction is further improved.
assignees: UNIV CHANGSHA SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Multi-layer coupling considered integrated modeling method for information physical system of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of information physical fusion of power systems and discloses an integrated modeling method of an information physical system of a power distribution network, which considers multi-layer coupling, and comprises the following steps of dividing system layers according to the entity architecture of the information physical system of the power distribution network, wherein the system layers comprise a physical layer, an information physical coupling layer and an information layer; the method comprises the steps of converting a physical architecture of a power distribution network information physical system into a graph theory model by using a complex network theory framework, characterizing system topology and functional interaction characteristics by establishing a multi-layer network structure, constructing a physical layer model, an information physical coupling layer model and an information layer model in a layered mode, describing coupling relations and association characteristics among all layers of models by using an association matrix, and accurately describing essential characteristics of a multi-layer heterogeneous system by considering coupling relations among multiple layers, so that dynamic regulation capacity and operation efficiency of the system are improved.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Fault Detection and Diagnosis System of Sensors Network for Critical Infrastructure System
title_ko: 주요기반설비의 센서 망에 대한 고장 탐지 및 원인 진단 시스템
abstract_en: Provided is a failure detection and diagnosis system of a city gas pipe network comprising: a receiving part (110) for receiving measured value data from a SCADA system (100) installed for data collection of a city gas pipe network by one method from among csv, MYSQL, and MS-SQL; a preprocessing module (120) for removing noise of the received data with a bandband filter and an index weighted moving average filter; a failure detection module (130) for detecting a failure of a measurement sensor when the failure determination index is greater than that of a failure determination upper limit value by using an SPE failure determination index derived from a PCA model, which is a multivariate statistical analysis technique, for data from which noise is removed from the measured value received from the preprocessing module (120); a failure block diagnosis module (140) for identifying a block comprising a failure sensor through an erroneous instruction correction-based algorithm derived from the PCA model when the measurement sensor failure is detected by the failure detection module (130); a failure sensor diagnosis module (150) for identifying a failure sensor through the erroneous instruction correction-based algorithm derived from the PCA model from among sensors included in the block identified by the failure block diagnosis module (140); and a transmission part (160) for transmitting a sensor failure diagnosis result determined by the failure sensor diagnosis module (150) to a terminal (200). In an embodiment of the present invention, an accident, wherein the city gas supply to the end consumer is stopped, can be reduced by the occurrence of the city gas pressure drop due to a delay in failure identification, thereby reducing customer dissatisfaction.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 CIS의 하나인 도시가스 배관망의 고장 탐지 및 진단 시스템에 관한 것으로,  수신부(110), 수신한 데이터의 잡음을 제거하는 전처리 모듈(120), 상기 전처리 모듈(120)로부터 제공받은 측정값에서 잡음이 제거된 데이터에 대해 다변량통계분석 기법인 PCA 모델로부터 도출된 소정의 수식을 이용하여 측정센서의 고장을 탐지하는 고장탐지 모듈(130), 상기 고장탐지 모듈(130)에서 측정센서 고장이 탐지되면, 다중블록 PCA(MBPCA)  모델로부터 도출된 소정의 수식을 통해 고장센서가 포함된 블록을 식별하는 고장블록 진단 모듈(140), 상기 고장블록 진단 모듈(140)에서 식별한 블록에 포함된 센서들을 대상으로 PCA 모델로부터 도출된 소정의 수식을 통해 고장센서를 식별하는 고장센서 진단 모듈(150), 상기의 고장센서 진단 모듈(150)에서 결정한 센서 고장 진단 결과를 단말기(200)로 보내는 송신부(160)를 포함한다. 본 발명의 실시예에서, 객관적인 성능 지수를 개발하여 PCA와 비교하여 성능이 개선될 경우에만 MBPCA를 사용하도록 하여 도시가스 배관망의 고장 탐지 및 진단 시스템의 성능을 높일 수 있다.
assignees: TECHDAS CO LTD

title_en: Vulnerability assessment method based on mixed transmission allocation factors
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vulnerability assessment method based on mixed transmission allocation factors, which belongs to the technical field of interdependent network vulnerability assessment and comprises the steps of constructing a coupling system model comprising an electric power network layer, a hydrogen energy network layer and a logistics network layer, respectively calculating the transmission allocation factors of the electric power network layer, the hydrogen energy network layer and the logistics network layer, establishing an interlayer sensitivity coupling relation through a coupling weight matrix, forming a global mixed transmission allocation factor (MTDF) matrix by adopting a layered sensitivity calculation and cross-layer coupling mapping technology, realizing cross-layer influence quantification of new energy output fluctuation, automatically identifying key fragile nodes and establishing a cascading fault propagation model, and solving the technical problem of assessing the coupling vulnerability of a three-layer network of a green harbor electric power-hydrogen energy-logistics by calculating L2 norm to propose a vulnerability assessment index before and after a fault.

title_en: Urban energy system interaction influence and lifting method based on electric-thermal interdependence
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric-thermal interdependence-based urban energy system interaction influence and lifting method, and belongs to the field of energy utilization. The method comprises the steps of establishing a coupling model of three subsystems of electric power, natural gas and heat supply, providing a multidimensional toughness assessment index to assess comprehensive performance under extreme events, introducing an emergency resource scheduling strategy, planning position deployment of a power generation vehicle in the extreme events by using a power generation vehicle scheduling model, optimizing a repair path of a maintenance person under the condition of power network damage by using a maintenance person scheduling model, dynamically reconstructing a topological structure of a power distribution network under the condition of power system damage, maintaining the temperature of the building under the condition of insufficient heat supply by using thermal inertia of the building, and cooperatively optimizing resource allocation of three energy systems. The cooperative operation and emergency recovery of the multi-energy system are realized, the overall performance, the resistance and the restoring force of the system under extreme conditions are improved, and the safety and the stability of energy supply are ensured.
assignees: STATE GRID XIONGAN SIJI DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Transmission and distribution network collaborative optimization method and system considering electric power and traffic multilayer network coupling model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cooperative optimization of transmission and distribution networks, in particular to a cooperative optimization method and a cooperative optimization system of transmission and distribution networks, which take an electric power and traffic multilayer network coupling model into consideration. Because the single-moment operation feasible region of the power distribution network is influenced by the current state parameters of the system, the method adopts a deep learning method to realize the prediction of the single-moment operation feasible region of the power distribution network, and simultaneously, the lower boundary of the operation feasible region of the power distribution network is approximately processed in order to improve the accuracy of the prediction.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Cascade fault analysis method based on digital twin and physical power and related components
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascading failure analysis method and related components based on digital twin and physical power, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a double-layer coupling network model through a digital twin virtual network and a physical power network; setting a cascading failure propagation process through the load information of the digital twin virtual network and the physical power network and a preset load redistribution strategy, so as to construct a multi-layer network cascading failure model, updating the multi-layer network cascading failure model according to the communication delay between the digital twin virtual network and the physical power network to obtain a target cascading failure model, and carrying out cascading failure analysis on a specified power system by utilizing the target cascading failure model. The invention is based on the coupling symbiosis between the digital twin virtual network and the physical power network, and combines communication delay to construct the target cascading failure model, and the analysis accuracy and reliability of the cascading failure of the power system can be effectively improved through the target cascading failure model.
assignees: HANGZHOU ZHONGHENG ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Multi-time space supply and demand risk identification method for electric power system based on scene simulation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a scene simulation-based multi-time space supply and demand risk identification method for an electric power system, which comprises a data acquisition preprocessing unit, a risk identification module, a scene simulation module, a dynamic mapping module, an acquisition and prediction model, a time-varying relation network and a machine learning model, wherein the data acquisition preprocessing unit is used for generating a database with space-time labels to construct an electric power network model, the risk identification module and the scene simulation module are used for displaying risk and adequacy data of each region and each time period in a thermodynamic diagram and distribution diagram form to form an electric power network fluctuation area, different variables in the electric power network system are acquired to generate dynamic nodes, interdependence relations among the variables form edges among the nodes, the time-varying relation network of each time period is constructed, the time-varying relation network is combined with the machine learning model to construct a prediction model reflecting nonlinear dynamic change of the electric power network, the prediction model of the nonlinear dynamic change is constructed to adjust the electric power network model, and the evaluation precision of the space-time distribution of the electric power network is guaranteed, and the method has the advantages of establishing the time-varying relation network, improving the prediction precision and response speed and precisely capturing risk factors.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Active power distribution network forward push back generation tide optimization calculation method, medium and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forward push back generation tide optimization calculation method, medium and equipment for an active power distribution network, which relate to the technical field of power distribution network analysis, operation and control, and are characterized in that an active power distribution network is constructed based on a physical connection structure of the active power distribution network, and layered to obtain a multi-layer network; predicting iteration times based on parameters of a multi-layer network and corresponding association coefficients to obtain the lowest iteration times, calculating a PV node sensitivity impedance matrix based on all node attributes in the network, judging whether the current iteration times reach the lowest iteration times after forward-pushing back substitution is carried out on the active power distribution network, stopping iteration based on node voltage convergence or iteration times upper limit judgment if the current iteration times reach the lowest iteration times, obtaining a calculation result, and continuing iteration if the current iteration times do not reach the lowest iteration times. By means of the minimum iteration number prediction, the efficient PV node sensitivity impedance matrix construction method and the dynamic optimized relaxation factor, on the premise of guaranteeing calculation accuracy, efficiency and robustness of forward push back power flow calculation of the active power distribution network are remarkably improved.
assignees: SHANGHAI NUCLEAR ENG RES & DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Planning and optimizing configuration method for active traction network energy system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a planning and optimizing configuration method of an active traction network energy system, which is characterized in that a planning and optimizing configuration method with universality is constructed through three typical scenes, and planning configuration is carried out on new energy and an energy storage system in the traction network by taking running cost and full life cycle net present values into consideration, so that the economic feasibility of a railway system is ensured, the carbon reduction of the railway system is ensured, and meanwhile, the energy source is maximally realized. According to the invention, a double-layer optimization model is adopted to perform capacity configuration optimization, an intelligent algorithm is adopted to perform capacity planning on a renewable energy system and an energy storage system by an upper-layer optimization model, the net present value cost in the whole life cycle is the lowest, the operation cost is calculated by a solver by a lower-layer optimization model, the operation cost of operation and maintenance, purchase, electricity selling and the like is reduced, the upper layer and the lower layer are interdependent, the whole life cycle cost and the real-time operation efficiency are considered, and the scientificity and the operability of the energy system planning are improved.
assignees: QINGHAI NEGO NEW ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Urban lifeline gas pipeline flood emergency prevention and control system and method based on large model
abstract_en: The invention provides a large-model-based urban lifeline gas pipeline flood emergency prevention and control system and method, which are applied to the technical field of gas pipeline flood emergency. The system comprises an emergency supervision management platform, wherein the emergency supervision management platform is configured to construct a gas pipe network map based on pipeline pressures and gas flow rates of a plurality of pipeline nodes, determine a plurality of suspected leakage points and leakage confidence degrees, execute an evaluation step for each suspected leakage point, determine sampling radius according to the leakage confidence degrees, determine corrosion risks and deformation risks of the suspected leakage points based on water body data and image data, determine comprehensive risk values of target pipeline nodes based on the plurality of corrosion risks and the plurality of deformation risks through a prediction model, and automatically send control signals to a drainage robot to drive the drainage robot to drain water in response to the comprehensive risk values meeting drainage conditions. The invention can automatically perform risk assessment and emergency treatment and timely eliminate the potential safety hazard of damage to the gas pipeline caused by flood disasters.

title_en: Supply chain risk dynamic early warning method and system based on time sequence data association analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a supply chain risk dynamic early warning method and system based on time sequence data association analysis, wherein the system comprises a perception layer, an analysis layer and an application layer; the sensing layer comprises sensors applied to various links of a supply chain, the analysis layer comprises a time sequence data processing module, a dynamic dependency modeling module and a real-time risk calculation module, the application layer comprises an intelligent early warning module, and when the comprehensive risk score obtained by the real-time risk calculation module reaches a corresponding early warning threshold value, the intelligent early warning module is triggered and timely sends early warning information out through integrating different communication interfaces. The invention forms an intelligent and closed-loop industrial monitoring and diagnosis system through various front edge technologies, realizes transition from passive response to active prediction, accurate positioning, quick treatment and root cause treatment, and provides a powerful technical support for ensuring the safe, stable and efficient operation of complex systems.
assignees: CHENGDU JIUZHOU ELECTRONIC INF SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent management and control method and system for risk of switching misoperation of transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transformer substation switching misoperation risk intelligent management and control method and system, which relate to the technical field of safety production of electric power systems and comprise the steps of collecting multidimensional real-time risk factor data, constructing a dynamic probability dependency model based on the risk factor data, quantifying the association influence among different dimensionalities and updating model parameters, converting characteristic information of a current operation scene into a standardized vector, carrying out similarity matching with a scene template, screening an adaptive basic strategy, dynamically adjusting the basic strategy according to a real-time risk assessment result to generate a scene risk management and control strategy, implementing the scene risk management and control strategy, collecting multidimensional feedback data in the executing process, generating a new generation of optimization strategy based on the feedback data, and updating a strategy library. According to the invention, the risk management and control strategy is generated and regulated according to the actual situation, the strategy is continuously optimized, the safety and reliability of switching operation of the transformer substation are improved, accidents caused by misoperation are reduced, and the stable operation of the power grid is ensured.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Wind power multi-scale decomposition prediction method
abstract_en: A wind power multi-scale decomposition prediction method. The current single-point prediction is not comprehensive and accurate enough, and cannot be adapted to the quantitative and accurate requirements of wind power plants and power grid dispatching institutions on risk management. The method comprises the steps of sequentially performing feature selection and data decomposition processing on actually obtained wind power data to form an original wind power sequence, constructing a depth prediction model according to the multi-scale modal data, completing a determination process of a probability prediction interval in a residual error distribution mode depth prediction model through self-adaptive bandwidth kernel density estimation, establishing an initial model after the actually obtained wind power data is formed into the original wind power sequence, performing feature selection processing on the initial model, namely calculating weighted marginal contribution on each feature of the initial model according to all related feature subsets by utilizing a SHAP algorithm based on a Shapley value in a game theory, and completing a feature data acquisition process of accurately quantifying interdependence and interaction effects among features.
assignees: UNIV INNER MONGOLIA SCI & TECH

title_en: Urban lifeline pipeline risk identification method based on GIS
abstract_en: The invention discloses a GIS-based urban lifeline pipeline risk identification method which comprises the steps of S1, collecting underground water initial data, metal mineral initial data, pipeline data, engineering longitude and latitude coordinates and population distribution map data, preprocessing, S2, extracting underground environment characteristics through a convolution layer, updating a preprocessed pipeline map model to obtain an updated pipeline map model, constructing an improved double-gate map neural network, extracting fusion characteristics of all pipelines, S3, extracting construction influence characteristics of the pipelines and population risk characteristics of the pipelines, combining the fusion characteristics of all the pipelines, extracting comprehensive risk characteristics, converting the comprehensive risk characteristics into risk grades, and S4, calculating the pipeline risk map model and identifying and displaying in a GIS platform. The method can solve the problems that the traditional method has low inspection efficiency, is difficult to combine multi-source heterogeneous data, and further cannot realize accurate risk identification of urban lifeline pipelines.
assignees: CHANGSHA HAITU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban water supply system toughness critical threshold identification method, system and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and equipment for identifying toughness critical threshold values of an urban water supply system, which comprise the steps of respectively modeling a physical domain and an information domain of the water supply system based on a graph theory method, establishing a double-domain coupling mechanism according to a control theory principle, constructing an information-physical interaction coupling model, introducing an information network fault scene based on the coupling model to analyze the influence of the information network fault on the running state of the urban water supply network, and further establishing a service performance attenuation rate as a toughness critical threshold value evaluation index based on a performance-time curve characteristic, and identifying and outputting the toughness critical threshold values of the system through quantitative calculation. The method has strong systematicness and clear flow, provides a direct basis for the accurate reinforcement and toughness improvement of the system, effectively improves the accuracy and practicability of system modeling by the constructed coupling model, can completely capture the dynamic behavior of the system from function attenuation to recovery, can support the toughness research of a multilayer key infrastructure network, and has important theoretical significance and engineering application value.
assignees: INST URBAN ENVIRONMENT CAS

title_en: Power scheduling method and system based on multi-mode multi-agent RAG
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power dispatching method and a system based on a multi-mode multi-agent RAG, which are characterized in that a dispatching plan is generated through the cooperative work of a plurality of heterogeneous agents with different labor division, query input containing power dispatching tasks is received, and a planner agent decomposes the power dispatching tasks into a plurality of interdependent sub-tasks and generates a corresponding execution plan; according to the execution plan, the searcher agent sequentially executes two-stage fine-granularity multi-mode search from the multi-mode power knowledge base for each subtask, the first stage carries out coarse-granularity whole-page search, the second stage carries out fine-granularity regional fine reading and modal expansion, the evidence related to the current subtask is obtained and added into an evidence pool, and according to all the evidence in the evidence pool, the responder agent answers the initially input inquiry to generate a dispatching plan. The invention effectively solves the problems of timeliness and multi-scene adaptability in ultra-large scale power dispatching and provides an innovative path for guaranteeing dynamic safety and stability of the power grid.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Intelligent operation and maintenance operation management system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent operation and maintenance operation management system based on artificial intelligence, which comprises a multi-source data collection module, a data optimization module, a power plant equipment maintenance prediction model building module and an operation and maintenance intelligent operation management module. The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to an intelligent operation and maintenance operation management system based on artificial intelligence, which creatively proposes that equipment is used as a network node, equipment process dependence is used as a directed edge, a network diagram structure is constructed for equipment maintenance, and a risk transmission chain among different equipment can be effectively identified, so that the operation and maintenance management of a power plant is changed from local prediction to global association modeling; by adopting a direct and indirect double-layer spatial dependency joint modeling mechanism, the direct spatial dependency models the explicit process relationship between adjacent devices through a graph attention network, the indirect spatial dependency models the implicit relationship of non-adjacent devices through a spatial attention mechanism, the prediction precision is improved, and the accuracy of an intelligent operation and maintenance operation decision is improved.

title_en: Lifeline differential planning method for improving toughness of urban power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lifeline differentiation planning method for improving toughness of an urban power grid, and belongs to the technical field of power grid planning methods. A life line differentiation planning method for improving toughness of an urban power grid comprises the steps of constructing a local power grid limit survival capacity quantification index, quantifying power supply guarantee levels of loads with different importance levels in an extreme fault scene, based on an improved commodity flow model, establishing multi-path power supply topology constraint applicable to the loads with different importance levels, guaranteeing requirements of the life line loads on power supply path redundancy, establishing an urban power grid life line differentiation planning model, and realizing optimal construction of a multi-level local power grid through local power grid boundary division, resource allocation and level constraint. The lifeline differentiated planning method for improving the toughness of the urban power grid can solve the problem that the existing method can not well realize the grade load differentiated guarantee under the limited resource condition.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG

title_en: Photovoltaic power prediction method and system based on attention mechanism and LSTM
abstract_en: The application provides a photovoltaic power prediction method and a system based on an attention mechanism and LSTM, and belongs to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a meteorological environment data sequence when a photovoltaic panel operates in a current time period, inputting the meteorological environment data sequence into a photovoltaic power prediction model, wherein the photovoltaic power prediction model comprises a multi-head attention module, an LSTM module and a regression module which are sequentially connected, extracting features of the meteorological environment data sequence through the multi-head attention module to obtain a first feature vector, carrying out time sequence dependency modeling analysis on the first feature vector through the LSTM module to obtain a second feature vector, and mapping the second feature vector through the regression module to obtain a predicted power generation sequence of the photovoltaic panel in a future time period, wherein the photovoltaic power prediction model is obtained after super-parameter optimization and training are carried out on a pre-built initial model. The photovoltaic power prediction method and the photovoltaic power prediction device can improve accuracy and efficiency of photovoltaic power prediction.
assignees: Foshan Xianhu Laboratory;WUHAN BUILDING MATERIAL INDUSTRY DESIGN & RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for predicting landslide instability of reservoir area
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for predicting landslide instability in a reservoir area, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining porosity, cohesive force and sliding mass density of target landslide sliding belt soil, establishing a normal stress and rate dependency model according to rate dependency data of residual friction coefficients of the sliding belt soil, coupling to obtain a combined model, dispersing the target landslide into cylinders, calculating dead weight stress, hydrostatic pressure, superporous water pressure, water resistance, floating force, dynamic friction resistance and cohesive force of each cylinder, listing and solving a dynamic balance equation to obtain landslide acceleration of each cylinder, calculating initial motion state of each cylinder by taking rapid downward sliding moment of the landslide as an initial time point, iteratively calculating motion state, acceleration and speed of each cylinder at all moments, obtaining friction coefficients through experimental data and combining the superporous water pressure, and accurately calculating the motion speed of the target landslide.
assignees: UNIV CHINA THREE GORGES CTGU

title_en: Distributed power supply generated power prediction method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for predicting the generated power of a distributed power supply, which belong to the technical field of power generation power prediction and comprise the steps of collecting wind speed data and radiation intensity data during power generation of the distributed power supply, and calculating a wind speed influence coefficient and radiation conversion efficiency based on the wind speed data and the radiation intensity data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a distributed power prediction network comprising an input processing layer, a feature mapping layer, a space-time fusion layer, an optimization feedback layer and a prediction output layer, generating a power generation predicted value, and calculating a confidence interval of the power generation predicted result through the power generation predicted value based on a Bayesian inference method. The invention effectively solves the problem of uncertainty in the prediction of the power generated by the distributed power supply by combining the space-time feature extraction and the Bayesian inference method. Compared with the traditional method, the method can accurately capture the fluctuation and the interdependence of radiation conversion and wind speed influence in time and space dimensions, thereby improving the precision of the prediction of the generated power.
assignees: XINGYUAN ZHIYUAN TECH CHENGDU CO LTD;SHANGHAI JIAO TONG UNIVERSITY SICHUAN RESEARCH INST

title_en: Multi-mode large model-based intelligent power system fault diagnosis method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent diagnosis method and system for a power system fault based on a multi-mode large model, comprising the steps of collecting multi-source heterogeneous data in the operation of the power system through a power fault multi-mode knowledge center, transmitting the data to the multi-mode large model, extracting local features corresponding to the data and cross-mode associated features, inputting the extracted features into an electrical diagram RAG fault positioning algorithm, positioning a fault region and outputting a candidate set through graph structure matching, retrieval enhancement and range correction, inputting the candidate set feature data into a stacked self-encoder diagnosis model, performing layer-by-layer feature conversion and analysis through a multi-layer network, outputting fault feature vectors, inputting the vectors into a fault probability map reasoning algorithm, and determining fault types and probabilities through temporary map construction, rule screening, probability calculation and verification fusion, and feeding the results back to the knowledge center and performing visual presentation. The invention improves the positioning precision and the feature analysis depth of the fault area and effectively meets the fault diagnosis requirement of the modern power system.
assignees: GUANGDONG RUIYUN TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Emergency rescue scheduling optimization method based on multilayer network heterogeneous transport means
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency rescue dispatching optimization method based on a multilayer network heterogeneous transport means, and relates to the technical field of emergency rescue dispatching. The method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-layer network model, defining parameter representation of a transportation tool dispatching optimization scene, establishing a mixed integer linear programming model based on emergency rescue dispatching optimization of multi-layer network heterogeneous transportation tools, taking transportation tool selection, transportation tool dispatching distribution and transportation route planning schemes as decision variables, and taking total rescue time as an optimization target, and constraining the optimization model. And fifthly, solving a model. The invention has good engineering practicability, controllable calculation process, easy realization, convenient grasping, popularization and application of engineering technicians, can be used as an important decision tool for the allocation and optimization management of emergency rescue tools, and provides powerful support for improving rescue efficiency and optimizing rescue transportation tool allocation.
assignees: UNIV BEIHANG

title_en: Power-Aware: DFOS Deployment A Hybrid Heuristic and Integer Linear Programming Strategy
abstract_en: A novel, two-stage Distributed Fiber Optic Sensor (DFOS) placement strategy and method that ensures resilient monitoring of critical infrastructure during electrical power supply failures. This strategy and method combines a heuristic algorithm, PURE (Power Source-aware Route Exploration), with Integer Linear Programming (ILP) optimization. The PURE algorithm explores potential DFOS routes while explicitly considering the dependency of DFOS devices on the electrical power distribution network, ensuring routes electrically powered by the same electrical power feeder are disjoint. Subsequently, the ILP selects the optimal set of DFOS placements to minimize the total number of deployed sensors while meeting critical infrastructure monitoring requirements, such as redundant monitoring for high-importance links. The method enhances the observability of critical links, achieving 100% monitoring coverage for important links during simulated power outages affecting an electric feeder.
assignees: NEC LAB AMERICA INC

title_en: Multi-layer network cascade failure-based multi-mode intermodal network toughness assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-layer network cascading failure-based multi-mode intermodal network toughness assessment method, and belongs to the technical field of multi-mode intermodal network operation and toughness assessment. The method comprises the steps of constructing a public molten iron weighted undirected multilayer network model by adopting an ML-space method according to the multilayer structure of a multi-modal network and the characteristic of freight transportation circulation, calculating the multi-layer centrality and freight transportation level of nodes to determine node importance degree by fusing network topology and freight transportation attribute double view angles on the basis, constructing a load-capacity cascade failure model comprising initial load, node capacity and differential load distribution strategies by combining sub-network heterogeneity, constructing a full-stage toughness assessment system comprising resistance capacity, absorption capacity and recovery capacity on the basis of a toughness triangle theory, and comparing network toughness under different cascade failure and recovery strategies through MATLAB software numerical simulation to reveal the influence rule of node capacity coefficient on toughness. The invention starts from the actual operation scene of the multi-mode intermodal network, considers the multi-layer characteristics and the cascade failure propagation rule, provides the accurate evaluation method of the toughness of the multi-mode intermodal network under the cascade failure scene, and provides scientific references for planning construction, risk prevention and control and toughness improvement of the multi-mode intermodal network.
assignees: NANJING UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Wind speed prediction method and device based on FFT-Rankpooling-LSTM
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wind speed prediction and discloses a wind speed prediction method and device based on FFT-Rankpooling-LSTM, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source wind speed time sequence data, and generating frequency domain characteristics through normalization and FFT decomposition; the method comprises the steps of screening core features by using a sequencing pooling algorithm, constructing a space-time associated data matrix, fusing the features by using a multichannel attention mechanism, reducing the dimension, generating a time sequence feature coding vector, modeling and optimizing hidden state propagation based on an LSTM network, constructing a prediction evolution model, and finally generating a result by multi-step rolling prediction. The device comprises frequency domain decomposition, feature pooling, space-time modeling, prediction engine and other modules, and supports data smoothing, visualization and parameter self-adaptive optimization. According to the method, the precision and the generalization capability of wind speed prediction are improved by integrating frequency domain analysis, hierarchical feature pooling and space-time correlation modeling, and the method is suitable for multi-step wind speed prediction scenes in the fields of wind power, weather and the like.
assignees: NO 63968 TROOPS OF CHINESE PEOPLES LIBERATION ARMY

title_en: Petroleum storage tank field system dynamic risk propagation behavior evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of security risk evaluation, and discloses a method and a system for evaluating dynamic risk propagation behaviors of a petroleum storage tank farm system, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a single-layer IRML risk model, converting the single-layer IRML risk model into a GDS network model, sequencing risk factors according to a key set and a vulnerability set of target nodes, determining risk nodes of the petroleum storage tank farm system, constructing a multi-layer risk network of the tank farm system, carrying out static attribute analysis on the multi-layer risk network, and carrying out dynamic attribute analysis on the multi-layer risk network through the security key nodes or the edge characterization risk factors to determine a risk propagation rule. The single-layer IRML risk model constructed by the invention can more comprehensively identify risks, and the risk factors can be ranked according to the key set and the vulnerability set, so that the risk factors at the system level can be more visual by the visualization of the GDS network model.
assignees: CHINA NAT PETROLEUM CORP;CNPC ENGINEERING MATERIALS R & D CO LIMITED

title_en: Power system risk assessment method based on hierarchical regional graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic digital data processing, and discloses a power system risk assessment method based on a hierarchical regional graph neural network, which comprises the steps of dividing a power system into a plurality of regions and constructing a local graph structure for each region; establishing a connection relation among areas to form an area level graph, acquiring multi-source heterogeneous operation data of the power system as input features of corresponding nodes, adopting a graph neural network to learn and aggregate node features in each local graph to obtain area feature representations of the corresponding operation areas, aggregating the area feature representations in the inter-area connection graph based on a graph attention mechanism, fusing risk information, and respectively generating risk assessment results of node levels, area levels and system levels according to the feature representations of the nodes and the areas and the risk information. The problems of layering of an effective area, undefined risk propagation mechanism and lack of multi-level output are solved, and the purposes of multi-source data fusion, multi-level evaluation and dynamic adaptation to topology change are achieved.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG;LINFEN POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Attention mechanism-based environmental risk early warning method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence early warning, and provides an environmental risk early warning method and system based on an attention mechanism, which are used for improving the accuracy and pertinence of environmental risk early warning. The method comprises the steps of dividing multi-dimensional environment risk characteristics with labels through a hierarchical structure to obtain multi-level risk characteristics, determining updating weights, adjusting hierarchical parameters of an initial pyramid network to construct an environment risk early warning pyramid network, embedding attention gates and feature cross models in each hierarchical network, matching environment monitoring data to be processed to corresponding hierarchical networks according to types, extracting key risk characteristics through the attention gates, mining nonlinear association through the feature cross models to obtain a risk characteristic matrix fused with multi-dimensional association information, inputting a time sequence cascade prediction model to conduct progressive reasoning to generate an environment risk conduction reasoning graph, and combining the hierarchical weights and risk node association assignment to generate a hierarchical risk early warning result.
assignees: BEIJING CHAOYANG ENV GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Multi-day electricity price prediction method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a multi-day electricity price prediction method, system, electronic device, and storage medium, which employ a hybrid model combining time series processing advantages of an LSTM network and nonlinear prediction capabilities of XGBoost models to cope with highly nonlinear and time series characteristics of electricity market price, divide an overall prediction task into a plurality of time periods, use a plurality of horizontally cascaded prediction models to take charge of different prediction time period ranges, concentrate each model on electricity price prediction for a specific prediction time period, and select an optimal model to output a final prediction result, which can more sensitively identify abnormal fluctuations in price data, and rapidly react when price fluctuations occur. The method has the advantages that the unique extremum theory and change point analysis are applied, the prediction accuracy and stability of the peak electricity price under the condition of price fluctuation are improved, the frame is simple, the realization and maintenance are easy, and the prediction complexity and cost are reduced.
assignees: HUANENG CLEAN ENERGY RESEARCH INST;HUANENG HENAN CLEANING ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Full-polarization programmable antenna unit
abstract_en: The full-polarization programmable antenna unit comprises a digital amplitude phase programmable matching network module and a horn-type radiation antenna module, wherein the digital amplitude phase programmable matching network module comprises a T-shaped power divider, a 90-degree directional coupler, an FPGA control module and two 360-degree digital phase shifters, and the amplitude is realized by mutually cascading the power divider, the 360-degree phase shifters and the 90-degree directional coupler, and the FPGA control module is used for realizing programmable regulation. The amplitude and phase modulation of two polarization components of the antenna unit can be realized through the digital amplitude phase programmable matching network module, specifically, the programmable matching network module for feeding is connected with the antenna radiator through the radio frequency coaxial line, so that the full polarization programmable capacity is greatly improved, the polarization loss can be reduced and the polarization interference capacity can be improved through polarization change in a complex and changeable electromagnetic environment, and the method can also be applied to application scenes such as polarization imaging in combination with related algorithms in the aspect of polarization information identification.
assignees: UNIT 63893 OF PLA

title_en: Ultra-thin digital flat-panel loudspeaker device of optical network vision linkage broadcast
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of public broadcasting, in particular to an optical network visual linkage broadcasting ultrathin digital flat-panel loudspeaker device which comprises an optical network interface, a frame component, a surface sound source sounding system, a signal processing module, a visual identification component and a cluster cooperative component, wherein the frame component comprises a surrounding frame integrated with the optical network interface, a metal bottom plate, an insulating bottom plate and front and rear surface sound-transmitting metal mesh plates. The ring network cascade function of the network switch module is used for forming a serial broadcast terminal node, the directional guidance is formed by combining the volume differentiation control of the digital power amplifier module, the disaster prevention emergency broadcast evacuation efficiency is effectively improved, the ring network double-link redundancy network architecture is constructed by means of the optical cable, and the all-optical network broadcast system is formed, so that the problem of low connection reliability which is easy to occur when the traditional network cable is connected with a loudspeaker is solved, the technical defects of network interruption, high data transmission error rate and the like of the traditional network cable caused by electromagnetic interference are avoided, and the stable transmission of broadcast signals in a complex environment is ensured.
assignees: SAISITE TIANJIN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Near-field DoA estimation method based on CCKAN
abstract_en: A near-field DoA estimation method based on CCKAN includes the steps of simulating received signals of array element channels in an off-line stage, generating simulated signals influenced by near-field effect according to a near-field propagation model to serve as a sample set, extracting characteristic data of the received signals of each array element channel, obtaining covariance characteristics of the received signals by using empirical autocorrelation, further using the covariance characteristics to train CCKAN, and carrying out real-time DoA estimation through CCKAN after training in an on-line stage. According to the invention, complex-valued convolution is introduced into a Kolmogorov-Arnold network (KAN), and the internal relation of signal amplitude and phase is enhanced by simulating complex-valued operation in the convolution, and KAN with better interpretability is introduced as feature extraction, so that excellent DoA resolution can be obtained under far field and near field conditions.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: Energy storage system safety assessment method, device and equipment
abstract_en: An energy storage system safety assessment method, device and equipment relate to the technical field of energy storage systems. The method comprises the steps of obtaining first operation data of an energy storage system, wherein the first operation data comprise fault data describing at least one basic fault type, determining prior probability of the basic fault type represented by leaf nodes in a Bayesian failure propagation network according to the first operation data, enabling root nodes in the Bayesian failure propagation network to be used for representing failure modes of the energy storage system, enabling a directed path from the leaf nodes to the root nodes to represent propagation links of the failure modes caused by the basic fault type, reasoning posterior probability of the corresponding failure modes of the energy storage system according to the prior probability and the directed path from the leaf nodes to the root nodes, and obtaining an evaluation result of the energy storage system according to the posterior probability.
assignees: HUAWEI DIGITAL POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Cascade type fire detector base with positioning and communication functions
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cascading fire detector base with positioning and communication functions, which comprises a base shell and a base circuit board, wherein bus terminals are arranged in the base shell, and the circuit board integrates an RJ45 network port, a memory, a switch chip, a network transformer, a network chip, a Bluetooth chip power chip, a radio frequency switch, a double antenna and an LED indicator lamp. The base is connected with the fire-fighting two buses through bus terminals to supply power to the detector and provide an interface, and is connected with an external PoE switch through an RJ45 network port to realize network power supply. The network data is transmitted to the switch chip through the network transformer, and the network chip is connected with the switch chip through the transformer to realize data forwarding. The Bluetooth chip controls the network chip to receive and transmit control and positioning information through TCP/IP. The power chip reduces the high-voltage direct current to 3.3V, supplies power for each module, and isolates interference through the magnetic beads. The Bluetooth chip is connected with the radio frequency switch, switches the dual antennas to receive and transmit data, and the modules work cooperatively to realize the functions of positioning, communication and cascading.

abstract_ko:

title_en: Method and system for leak localization in complex pipeline networks using a digital twin
title_ko: 디지털 트윈을 이용한 복합 배관망의 누설 위치 탐지 방법 및 시스템
abstract_ko: 디지털 트윈을 이용한 복합 배관망의 누설 위치 탐지 방법 및 시스템이 개시된다. 디지털 트윈을 이용한 복합 배관망의 누설 위치 탐지 방법은 (a) 유체 이송을 위한 복합 배관망의 복수 지점에 설치된 센서로부터 누설에 의한 압력 및 유량 변동을 실시간 측정한 계측 데이터를 수집하는 단계-상기 계측 데이터는 측정된 계측 정보 및 측정된 시점에 대한 타임스탬프를 포함함; (b) 상기 각 센서의 계측 데이터에 포함된 타임스탬프를 이용하여 기준 센서에 대한 상대 도달 시간으로 정규화하는 단계; (c) 상기 복합 배관망의 기하 정보를 기초로 디지털 트윈 기반 가상 배관망을 시뮬레이션하고, 환경 변수 및 실측 도달 시간을 반영하여 상기 가상 배관망에 대한 전파속도 보정값을 산출하는 단계; (d) 상기 디지털 트윈에서 상기 가상 배관망을 복수의 로컬 구역으로 분할하고, 각 로컬 구역에 대해 서로 다른 로컬 연산 모델을 적용하여 상기 전파 속도 보정값을 이용해 센서별 예측 도달 시간을 산출하는 단계; 및 (e) 상기 센서별 예측 도달 시간과 센서별 상대 도달 시간의 오차를 최소화하는 로컬 누설 후보 위치를 추정하고, 상기 추정된 로컬 누설 후보 위치들 중 오차가 최소인 위치를 최종 누설 위치로 결정하는 단계를 포함한다.
