title_en: System for notifying emergency in wireless
title_ko: 학내 비상상황 발생 통보시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A system for notifying an emergency in a school is provided to transmit a voice and an image to a wireless communication network which is connected with a wireless sharing unit, thereby applying the voice and the image to a wireless broadcast and a wireless CCTV in a school. CONSTITUTION: A broadcasting speaker(121~123) receives an emergent signal from an emergent remote controller(111~114), the broadcasting speaker transmits the emergent signal and location information corresponding to the emergent remote controller to an in-school server(140). The in-school server identifies the emergent remote controller by the emergent signal. The in-school server controls execution of a selected emergent situation program. A light(130) is turned on/off by control of the in-school server.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일실시예에 따른 학내 비상상황 발생 통보시스템은, 사용자 입력이 있는 경우, 비상신호를 브로드캐스팅(broadcasting)하는 비상 리모컨; 하나 이상의 구역에 각각 설치되고 해당 구역에서 브로드캐스팅되는 비상신호를 상기 비상 리모컨으로부터 수신하는 경우, 상기 비상신호 및 상기 비상 리모컨에 대응하는 위치정보를 하기 학내 서버로 전송하는 방송용 스피커; 상기 방송용 스피커로부터 상기 비상신호 및 상기 위치정보를 수신하는 경우, 상기 비상신호를 통해 상기 비상 리모컨을 식별하고, 선정된(predetermined) 비상상황 프로그램의 수행을 제어하는 학내 서버; 및 상기 하나 이상의 구역에 각각 설치되고, 상기 학내 서버의 제어에 따라 동작하는 경광등을 포함하되, 상기 비상상황 프로그램은 상기 비상 리모컨을 사용하는 사용자의 비상상황이 상기 방송용 스피커를 통해 전파되도록 하고 상기 경광등이 동작하도록 하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Foam injection system for extinguishing fires and preventing smoke propagation in case of tunnel fires
title_ko: 터널 화재시 질식소화 및 연기전파 방지를 위한 발포폼 분사 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A foam injecting system for extinguishing fires and preventing smoke in case of tunnel fires are provided to seclude oxygen from outside and prevent diffusion of smoke, thereby minimizing damage of human life and property. CONSTITUTION: A foam injecting system for extinguishing fires comprises a fire detection tool(10), a mixer(20), a foaming form injection nozzle(30), a feed pump(40), and a controller(50). The fire detection tool senses fire break out existence and nonexistence in a tunnel. The mixer mixes foaming agent and water in a constant rate. The foam injection nozzle discharges the foam and is installed with constant intervals. The feed pump compulsorily transfers foams to a nozzle.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 터널 화재시 질식소화 및 연기전파 방지를 위한 발포폼 분사 시스템에 관한 것으로; 터널 안의 화재발생 유무를 감지하는 화재감지수단과, 발포제와 물을 일정비율로 혼합하는 혼합기와, 상기 발포제와 물의 혼합반응에 의해 발생되는 발포폼을 배출하되 터널에 설치되는 발포폼 분사노즐과, 상기 발포폼 분사노즐로의 발포폼을 강제이송하는 이송펌프와, 상기 화재감지수단을 통해 화재감지신호가 입력되면 상기 혼합기와 이송펌프를 구동하여 상기 발포폼 분사노즐로 발포폼을 배출하도록 제어하는 제어기로 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.  
본 발명에 따르면, 터널 내에서 밀폐공간을 형성하여 질식소화를 유도함에 따라 A급인 일반화재, B급인 유류화재, C급인 전기화재 이외에 금속화재 가스화재 등을 모두 소화할 수 있음은 물론, 밀폐공간을 형성함에 따라 화재연기 및 온도 전파 발생이 적이 터널내 시설물 피해를 최소화할 수 있다. 특히, 본 발명은 터널의 개방된 공간에서는 화재지점의 양측을 완전 밀폐하여 질식소화를 유도하고, 완전밀폐가 불가능한 지역은 제연경계벽을 형성할 수 있도록 운영함으로써 인명과 재산피해를 최소화할 수 있다.

title_en: Improved integer programming method-based optimum PMU (Power Management Unit) placement method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an improved integer programming method-based optimum PMU (Power Management Unit) placement method. A PMU is adopted to serve as the fingerprint features of a failure trend, and thus, the mathematical model for observable OPP (Optimum PMU Placement) problems of an electric network is a formula (shown as a drawing), wherein f(X)=AX=Y, Y1 and Y2 are subsets of Y, Y1 represents a corresponding vector set of nodes irrelevant to 0 injection nodes, Y2 represents a corresponding vector set of nodes relevant to the 0 injection nodes, X= [x1, x2 to xn] and represents a placement vector of the PMU of a node, xi is a binary variable, the value of the xi is equal to 1 when a node i is placed with the PMU and is equal to 0 when the node i is not placed with the PMU; A is a node-relevant matrix, and all diagonal entries of the A are 1; supposed that m nodes are irrelevant to the 0 injection nodes, a formula (shown as a drawing) is a m*1 matrix; and Tmj represents a relational matrix of the 0 injection nodes and relevant nodes of the 0 injection nodes, and Bmj represents a corresponding vector set. With the adoption of the technical scheme, the method has the advantages that: the decision-making level fusion based on switching value failure diagnosis and electrical quantity failure diagnosis is effectively achieved, the real-time performance is high, the essence of cascading failures can be grasped, meanwhile, the defects in the traditional failure diagnosis are made up to some extent, and the investment can be effectively saved at the same time that the diagnostic accuracy is ensured.

title_en: Selecting and disaster tolerant method and selecting and disaster tolerant system for accessing supporting node and access control device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a selecting and disaster tolerant method and a selecting and disaster tolerant system for accessing a supporting node and an access control device. The access control device is connected with a plurality of access gateway devices simultaneously, and corresponding relation of terminal identification and access gateway devices is configured on the access control device. During a terminal access process, the access control device accesses a terminal to the access gateway devices corresponding to the terminal identification according to the corresponding relation of the configured terminal identification and the access gateway devices. The selecting and disaster tolerant method and the selecting and disaster tolerant system for accessing the supporting node and the access control device can be applied to an identification locator separation network, the access control device is connected with a plurality of average sample numbers (ASNs), the plurality of ASNs form a service area. When a certain SAN in the service area is failed and escapes service, other available ASNs or spare ASNs can provide service fast, and service interruption time is reduced.

title_en: Insulated union for explosion- proof
title_ko: 방폭용 절연 유니온
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 주로 가스 또는 증기지역, 화학약품이 사용되는 장소 및 정유시설이나 가스 정제시설 등 인화성 물질을 취급 항시 폭발 및 화재의 위험이 상존하는 지역에서 이용되는 전기 에너지를 필요로 하는 각종 기기들의 전원 케이블, 전기스위치 및 스위치박스, 컨넥터 등)의 라인에 연결되어 절연 기능을 하므로써 각종 전기기에 낙뇌와 같은 돌입되는 전기를 방지하여 전기기의 오동작과 파손을 방지할 수 있고,내부폭발 시 화염전파를 방지 할 수 있는방폭용 절연 유니온에 관한 고안이다. 
방폭용 절연 유니온은 기기에 고정되는 고정부재와 고정부재에 연결되는 연경부재와 이들을 고정시키는 나사캡으로 구성되며 연결부재는 내측 부재와 외측 부재로 분할 구성하여 절연부재 접착면을 구비시키며 외측부재와 내측부재 사이에 접착고정되는 절연부재는 양쪽으로 접착면이 구비되고 내면 중앙에는 보강 절연부가 구비된다.

title_en: Combination forecast modeling method of wind farm power by using gray correlation analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combination forecast modeling method of wind farm power by using gray correlation analysis, belonging to the technical field of wind power generation modeling. In particular, the invention is related to a weighted combination forecast method of wind power based on a least square support vector machine and an error back propagation neural network. The forecast method comprises that forecasted values of wind speed and wind direction are acquired in advance from meteorological departments while real-time output power is acquired from a wind farm data acquiring system; that the forecasted values of wind speed and wind direction and the real-time output power are inputted into a data processing module for data analyzing extraction and data normalization, and then normalized data is loaded to a database server; processed data in the database server is extracted by a combination forecast algorithm server to carry out model training and power forecast, and the wind farm sends running data to the data processing module in real time to realize rolling forecasting. The method of the invention achieves the goal of combination forecast of wind farm output in a short time. The method not only maximally utilizes advantages of two algorithms but also increases forecast efficiency by saving computing resources and shortening computing time.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELEC POWER

title_en: Ship-cabin chain fire-disaster alarming priority assessment method
abstract_en: The invention provides a ship-cabin chain fire-disaster alarming priority assessment method which comprises the following steps: acquiring the fire situation information obtained by the combustible gas detectors and the detectors for sensing the temperature and the smoke of all the ship cabins adjacent to the ship cabin with fire disaster; reading the fire-disaster danger level information of the ship cabin with fire disaster; pre-processing the fire situation information obtained by the detectors and the fire-disaster danger level information of the ship cabin in a normalizing way; and sending the processed data to a three-layer feedforward error back propagation neural network for processing to obtain the chain fire-disaster alarming priority assessment results of each ship cabin, namely the primary alarming probability, the intermediate alarming probability and the advanced alarming probability. The comprehensive, early, accurate and reliable automatic alarming of the ship fire-disaster alarming system is realized, the purpose of reducing the wrong and neglected alarming rate is achieved, and the probability that the ship cabins can be subjected to chain fire-disaster to lead to the heavy loss of the ship is reduced.

title_en: HSS (home subscriber server) data disaster tolerant algorithm based on artificial intelligence and neural network
abstract_en: An HSS (home subscriber server) data disaster tolerant algorithm based on an artificial intelligence and neural network includes: firstly, newly adding four zone fields for an HSS database, wherein the zone fields include a user registration status change frequency, a PPR transmission frequency, a RTR transmission frequency and predicted user types after BP (back propagation) neural network study; when optional one of the user registration status change frequency, the PPR transmission frequency or the RTR transmission frequency exceeds a preset neuron threshold value, adding a user into a specific list by a HSS database to trigger backup algorithm, wherein the backup algorithm refers to an artificial intelligence and neural network algorithm. The HSS data disaster tolerant algorithm based on the artificial intelligence and neural network has the advantages that zones frequent in service handling can be designed individually by means of analysis and discovery of some HSS data variations, for example: server performances of the zones are improved and data of the zones are backed up to two or more than two adjacent zones so that risks are avoided.
assignees: QINGDAO CENTLING TECHNOLOGIES CO LTD

title_en: Method, equipment and system utilizing broadband intelligent network to call service disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, equipment and a system utilizing a broadband intelligent network to call a service disaster. The method comprises the following steps: when the link is switched, an SIP (Session Initiation Protocol) proxy server distributes the call services to SCPs (Service Control Point) of the broadband intelligent network according to a preset distribution strategy; and the SCPs notify the cells required to be in communication with the SCPs in the broadband intelligent network to be in communication with the SCPs. According to the method, the equipment and the system provided by the invention, when the broadband intelligent network is used for SCP service disaster switching, the related cells can be correspondingly switched, as a result, the service interruption caused by untimely synchronous switching is avoided.
assignees: ZTE CORP

title_en: Control federation for utility grids
abstract_en: In one embodiment, a federation device receives one or more grid control-based signals over a computer network, applies one or more utility grid control policies to the one or more grid control-based signals, and federates the one or more signals and/or the one or more utility grid control policies into one or more federated control-based signals. The federation device then propagates the one or more federated control-based signals to one or more grid-related devices.

title_en: System which makes it possible to determine parameters and observe an energy network
abstract_en: System which makes it possible to determine parameters and observe an energy network without making contact with the network and at a variable distance from the latter by detecting low-frequency radio waves which are emitted by said network, are picked up by magnetic and electrical antennas, are amplified and are filtered by active filters and by digital signal processing software. This information is then corrected using information from vibration, inclination and temperature sensors located in the base of the antennas, finally obtaining the voltage, current, frequency, current direction, power factor and active and reactive power parameters. In addition to this, the system makes it possible to obtain vibration and inclination information relating to energy network structures and towers and to provide event alarms for the measured parameters. Using several of these systems makes it possible to obtain energy balance parameters, to measure transients, to determine the location where lines are physically cut off, and to measure the intensity and propagation of earthquakes. Said system includes an electric field filter, software for determining the optimum location for installing the system in the field, software for measuring the internal electromagnetic noise of the system and software for calibrating and determining parameters without the need to measure the distance between the system and the electrical line being studied.

title_en: Carry-over storage year-end fluctuating level prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carry-over storage year-end fluctuating level prediction method and system. The method comprises the following steps of: 1, establishing a carry-over storage year-end fluctuating level prediction model, and storing the carry-over storage year-end fluctuating level prediction model in a model library; 2, optimizing a scheduling target through a prediction server according to the maximum total cascade energy, and calculating and selecting a corresponding carry-over storage year-end fluctuating level prediction model; and 3, calling a model solution algorithm in an algorithm library through the prediction server, solving the carry-over storage year-end fluctuating level prediction model, and obtaining the year-end fluctuating level rule. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the solution process is simple, the benefits in the later scheduling period after the carry-over storage year-end are considered, and the accuracy of the prediction method can be improved; and compared with a BP neural network and other methods, the method is suitable for a reservoir with short runoff data series.
assignees: GUIZHOU WUJIANG HYDROPOWER DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Rainstorm disaster risk evaluation method for foundation slope of transmission line tower
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rainstorm disaster risk evaluation method for a foundation slope of a transmission line tower. The method comprises the following steps of: obtaining disaster causing factors controlling the rainstorm risk of the foundation slope of the transmission line tower according to extensive disaster statistics and artificial rain slope corrosion test statistics; and performing quantification and normalization processing on the disaster causing factors and slope stability, and calculating a weight vector of influence of each disaster causing factor on the disaster causing of rainstorm by adopting an improved hierarchical analysis calculation program; establishing a mapping relationship between the disaster causing factors and a slope stability safety coefficient by adopting an artificial intelligence method and an improved back propagation (BP) network to obtain a mathematical model for evaluating the rainstorm landslide risk of the foundation slope of the transmission power tower; quantifying vulnerability factors, obtaining a weight vector of influence of each vulnerability factor on the disaster causing risk of the rainstorm by adopting an expert analysis method, and establishing a rainstorm risk evaluation mathematical model for the foundation slope of the transmission line tower according to a relationship that the risk is equal to a product of danger and vulnerability; and accurately evaluating the rainstorm risk of the foundation slope of a specified transmission line tower.

title_en: Cascade outage recognition and risk evaluation method of power grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of safety protection of a power system, and in particular relates to a cascade outage recognition and risk evaluation method of a power grid. The cascade outage recognition and risk evaluation method comprises the following steps of: obtaining power grid historical fault information, determining a power gird anticipated accident list, determining a cascade fault propagation and evolution mechanism, determining possibility, ponderance and a risk measurement value of a power grid cascade fault, and establishing a cascade fault recognition and risk evaluation model. According to an actual physical propagation process and a mathematical property of the power grid cascade fault, credibility measurement and total load loss of accident occurrence possibility and ponderance are established by a credibility theory, and are solved by adopting a fuzzy simulation method and load flow calculation, and the contradiction between simulation precision and sampling frequency in the traditional method is solved. Simulation analysis on a WSCC 9 node testing system proves that the method has correctness and robustness, is little in dependence of a sample, and has important theoretical significance and practical significance in preventing large-area power failure accidents of a power grid.

title_en: Neural network prediction method for generated output of photovoltaic power station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a neural network prediction method for the generated output of a photovoltaic power station. According to the invention, a neural network model fitting corresponding function relationships can be established by using a BP (back-propagation) neural network with momentum according to temperatures and illuminations in meteorological history data and generated power history data, and the most similar historical situation can be found according to the weather conditions of the latest two hours, then accordingly, the generated power of the photovoltaic power station in a future period can be predicted. An operation of predicting the output power of a photovoltaic power station helps power grid dispatching departments to comprehensively arrange the coordination of conventional power sources and photovoltaic generated power, timely adjust dispatching plans, and reasonably arrange the running modes of power grids.

title_en: Power system state estimation method and the system of model is estimated based on set theory

abstract_ko:

본 발명의 목적은 점검 대상 네트워크 영역의 OS별 취약점, 네트워크 장비 취약점 및 웹 응용프로그램 취약점을 스캐닝하여 해당 로그 파일을 취약점DB에 저장하는 취약점 센서과정; 취약점 센서과정의 프로세스 결과와 SSO 인증 로그를 취합하는 취약점 수집과정; 취약점 수집 결과에서 IP기준으로 관리자가 자산을 등록하는 자산 등록과정; 등록된 자산에 대응하는 관리 대상 네트워크의 IT 자산의 자산가치를 내부 보안 운영 방침을 기준으로 관리자가 정의한 자산가치 연산식을 이용하여 자산가치를 산정하는 자산 분석과정; 위협 빈도와 위협 영향을 파악하여 위협영향 및 위협빈도수를 산출하는 위협 분석과정; 취약점 센서과정에 의해 수집된 데이터에서 취약성 수준을 도출하는 취약성 분석과정; 및 산정한 자산가치와 위협 영향값을 연산하여 자산별 파급 강도인 자산별 위협지수를 산정하고, 위협빈도수와 취약성지수를 통해 자산별 위험도를 산정하는 자산별 위험도 산정과정을 포함하여 이루어진 것을 특징으로 한다.

CONSTITUTION: A forest fire prevention integration server(110) stores and generally manages local forest fire prevention related information. A forest fire prevention client device(130) communicates with an integration server and comprises an input part, an information loading part, a calculation part, and a countermeasure planning part. The information loading part loads forest fire prevention related information from the forest fire prevention integration server. abstract_ko: 본 발명은 산불 예방 자원 및 산불 진화 자원 정보를 도면화하여 전략적 산불 방지 계획을 수립할 수 있는 산불 방지 통합 시스템, 산불 방지 장치 및 산불 방지 통합 서버를 개시하고 있다. 산불 방지 통합 시스템은 전자 지도 - 전자 지도는 컴퓨터의 기억장치에 좌표, 면적, 등고선 간격 및 방위각을 시간과 기상자료를 포함하여 저장됨 - 상에 지역별 산불 방지 관련 정보를 저장하고 통합 관리하는 산불 방지 통합 서버; 및 상기 통합 서버와 통신하는 산불 방지 클라이언트 장치를 포함하되, 상기 산불 방지 클라이언트 장치는 사용자 인터페이스를 통해 산불 발생 지역을 입력하였을 때, 상기 산불 발생 지역 및 상기 산불 발생 지역의 주변의 산불 방지 관련 정보를 상기 산불 방지 통합 서버로부터 로딩하여 상기 로딩된 정보를 이용하여 상기 산불 발생 지역과 관련된 산불 진화 종합 정보를 계산하고, 상기 계산의 결과를 근거로 최적의 산불 진화 대책을 수립한다. 따라서, IT 기반 체계적 산불 진화 대응으로 산불 상황실 상황 전파, 인력 및 장비의 효율적 배치 등 전략적 산불 진화 대응 능력을 향상시킨다.

title_en: On-line intelligent identification method of provincial level power grid cascading failures
abstract_en: Provided is an on-line intelligent identification method of provincial level power grid cascading failures. A graph theory principle is used for dividing a system line into branches and links. Aiming at a tree-shaped structure of a system, a synergetic multi-group genetic algorithm is used, optimal solution ecological niche radiuses are solved in a self-adapting mode, and therefore a batch of dangerous tree-shaped structures of different modes can be found. Branches which are over a limitation in trend are selected in the dangerous tree-shaped structures and used as target lines, and a line, strongly corresponding to each target line, in the links is found. The lines and target lines form a key section. According to the method, the dangerous tree-shaped structures are only found in a system tree-shaped structure, then the key sections are searched only in the dangerous tree-shaped structure, problem solving space is greatly reduced, line failure reasons are not limited, and non-common-reason multiple failures which can cause the cascading failures can be found.

title_en: Automatic registration algorithm for low-voltage distribution network carrier terminal
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic registration algorithm for a low-voltage distribution network carrier terminal. It uses each district concentrator as a centre, relies on a domain carrier node which has finished registration, and falls into neighbourhood node registration and non-neighbourhood node registration and neighbourhood and non-neighbourhood node supplementary registration, etc. to complete the registration process of the electric meters of the overall electric grid in a multi-stage wave manner, measures the proximity of the electric-grid registration nodes by virtue of signal quality parameters carried by power-line narrow-band carrier signals during cross-district propagation, and collects, calculates and compares these parameters through a home-domain confirmation algorithm, thereby accurately determining the home district of a carrier node. In addition, a high-efficiency conflict avoidance and multi-priority carrier packet transceiving control algorithm based on a physical-layer CSMA technology is adopted to process the priorities of conflict and discharging messages so that all types of communication nodes in a district simultaneously compete to use one and the same communication medium. The present invention can be used for electric-meter registration of a plurality of types of electric-grid meter-reading networks, and is in particular suitable for electric-meter registration of an electric-power carrier remote meter-reading network in a relatively complicated communication environment.

title_en: Back propagation (BP) neural network landslide forecasting method based on optimized input layer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a back propagation (BP) neural network landslide forecasting method based on an optimized input layer. The BP neural network landslide forecasting method includes steps: (1) related parameters of landslide of the input layer are collected; (2) BP neural network training is performed; (3) whether requirements are met is judged, the known expected value is t, errors are calculated according to an error formula of an output node, sample training is completed if the requirements are met, otherwise Vij theta i is firstly adjusted and then Wij theta j is adjusted according to the error reducing principle, and the corrected value is used for training until the requirements are met; and (4) after sample training is completed, the initialized forecasting sample value is input, and the forecasting value can be obtained. The BP neural network is adopted so that the BP neural network landslide forecasting method is simple to operate, strong in learning ability and good in adaptability.

title_en: Detection method for key propagation path and central node on microblog platform
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the research category of information propagation influence on a social network in a complex network research system, relates to a detection method for a key propagation path and a central node on a microblog platform and solves the detection problem of the central node on microblog advertising communication flow on the microblog platform. According to the detection method, the abstract problem of detection of the central node is tightly combined with the problem of the shortest propagation path in a complex network, and a detection model of the shortest propagation path of the advertising communication flow on the Sina microblog is established, so that the problem of detection of the central node on a microblog advertising propagation path, namely the detection problem of an advertising typhoon eye, is solved.

abstract_ko: 본 발명은 다단중계 VHF 통신기능이 내장된 재난예경보 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는, 경보국 장치를 포함한 각각의 지국장치를 통제국 장치와 다단중계로 통신하게 구성한 로컬 경보시스템에게 사용자가 지정한 대용량 재해재난 메시지를 경제적인 통신방식으로 전달하여 경보를 발령하게 함은 물론이고 로컬 경보시스템 내에서의 다단중계도 1단 중계망에서 사용하던 패킷의 프레임을 그대로 사용하여 2단 또는 3단 중계망을 구축할 수 있어 통신망 구성 범위의 확장 및 통신품질의 향상이 가능한 다단중계 VHF 통신기능이 내장된 재난예경보 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Single-frequency propagation multi-channel calamity public emergency information system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a single-frequency propagation multi-channel calamity public emergency information system, comprising an information acquisition processing portion, a monitoring center processing portion, a transmitting portion and a terminal receiver; wherein the information acquisition processing portion comprises a monitoring computer, a calamity early warning information acquisition server, a science popularization information acquisition server, a public information acquisition server, and a convenient information acquisition server; the monitoring center processing portion comprises a VPN (Virtual Private Network) router, a monitoring center server, a short message operating platform, a short message monitor, a network switch, and a control computer. The single-frequency propagation multi-channel calamity public emergency information system of the utility model has the advantages of wide coverage, wide suitable objects, quick propagation, various functions, little environment affection, capacity for realizing public information, calamity alarm information, science popularization information and convenient information to the home, capacity for automatically broadcasting text information content in a voice way, etc.

title_en: Method for predicating short-period output power of photovoltaic power generation based on BP (Back Propagation) neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicating the short-period output power of photovoltaic power generation based on a BP (Back Propagation) neural network. According to the method, the BP neural network is adopted for predicating the output power of a photovoltaic power generation system, and the influence of weather factors on the output power of the photovoltaic power generation system is subjected to statistical analysis. The method comprises the following steps of firstly mapping weather types as day types used as the input data of the BP neural network, and utilizing power generation power during each time period of a prediction day as output data; then determining the quantity of hidden layer nodes through formula calculation and repeated cut-and-try operations according to the quantity of input and output units; performing normalization treatment on the input data, performing reverse normalization treatment on the output data, and training the BP neural network by utilizing the treated operating data; and finally predicating the power generation power of the predication day by utilizing a trained model, thereby obtaining the predication result. The data processing method and a prediction model can be used for effectively predicating the short-period output power in photovoltaic power generation under multiple weather types.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Method for predicating output power of photovoltaic power generation system based on BP (Back Propagation) neural network model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicating the output power of a photovoltaic power generation system based on a BP (Back Propagation) neural network model. The method comprises the following steps of selecting influencing factors of the output power of the photovoltaic power generation system; generating input vectors according to the historical data of the selected influencing factors, and utilizing the historical data of the output power of the corresponding photovoltaic power generation system as output, thereby obtaining training samples; training a BP neural network by utilizing the training samples, thereby obtaining the trained BP neural network; generating test input vectors according to real data at the to-be-predicated moment of the selected influencing factors, inputting the test input vectors into the trained BP neural network, so that the output is the predicted value of the output power of the photovoltaic power generation system at the to-be predicated moment. According to the method for predicating the output power of the photovoltaic power generation system, modeling prediction is performed; the invention provides a predication method based on the BP neural network; the favorable nonlinear function approximation capability of the BP neural network is utilized, so that the precision and generalization capability of a prediction model are improved.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;HUAI AN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CORP;JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Circuit on power system state transition probability prediction analysis method under vile weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses the circuit on power system state transition probability prediction analysis method under a kind of vile weather, comprises the following steps：A：Build with line fault probability as dependent variable index and with meteorological factor as the regression model of independent variable index；B：Calculate the flow transferring relativity factor of other each branch roads after certain branch road breaks；C：Obtain each branch road cascading trip probabilistic model；D：Obtain line status transition probability model under bad weather condition.The present invention can realize each membership transition probability assessment under bad weather condition, so as to obtain high-risk fault branch information, it is ensured that electrical network is run in inclement weather with security and stability.

title_en: Electrical power system load prediction method based on back propagation (BP) neural network
abstract_en: An electric power system load prediction method based on a back propagation (BP) neural network comprises the following steps of (1) confirming input-output vectors according to specified electric power load prediction; (2) establishing a BP neural network model according to the input-output vectors; (3) training the BP neural network; (4) inputting a test sample to test the trained BP neural network, judging whether an error of an output predicted value and an actual value is smaller than a set threshold value or not and if so, carrying out a step (5); and (5) obtaining actually required load prediction according to the predicted value. The implicit presentation of internal relation of predictive factors is achieved through automatic learning of the BP neural network model and weight distribution of the BP neural network, the accuracy of the electric power system load prediction is high, and safe and stable operation and economical efficiency of an electric power system can be guaranteed effectively.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI DIANJI

title_en: A kind of method of Identification of Power System generation cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of method of Identification of Power System generation cascading failure.Consider generator speed governing and load responding, set up more realistic electric power system tide computation model, the method, in the model of Load flow calculation, overcomes the impact that traditional power flow algorithm can not reflect generator regulating action and load responding.From system cloud gray model champion angle, analyze the relation between voltage stabilization and fault in cascading failure.For the relation of quantitative analysis charge threshold level and system running state, by analyzing the change of Jacobian matrix element value, the critical value of derivation system voltage stability index and this index.Along with the increase of load, the risk of systems face cascading failure increases.In the process, system voltage stabilizes index can decline gradually, and critical value all the time critical value to maintain 0.5 (± 0.03) constant.In systems in practice, can not be changed in cascading failure by the charge threshold level calculated, choose 0.6 critical value of collapsing as line voltage in real system, whether identification electrical network faces the risk of having a power failure on a large scale.Therefore, the inventive method has good actual directive significance.

title_en: Identification method for complex power grid self-organization critical state
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying a self-organization critical state of a complex power grid in the technical field of power system cascading failure prevention. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring actual load loss of a power grid in a random fault; calculating the cumulative probability of the random fault of the power grid according to the actual load loss of the random fault of the power grid and the set load loss amount; performing regression analysis on the set load loss and the accumulated probability so as to determine whether the power grid is in a self-organization critical state; and when the power grid is in the self-organization critical state, calculating the expected load loss value of the power grid and determining the relative probability of the power grid having load loss faults. The method can accurately judge whether the current power grid is in a self-organization critical state or not and the probability of the current power grid in cascading failure, calculate the load loss after the cascading failure occurs, and simultaneously estimate the relative probability of large-scale load loss power failure accidents.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;INST OF ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CORP;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELEC POWER

abstract_en: PURPOSE: A wireless social networking method supporting direct communication, relaying, group communication, and broadcasting between terminals and a system thereof are provided to establish bidirectional topology within a short time, thereby enhance usability. CONSTITUTION: A plurality of participants join a group conversation using limited resources. Users who are not able to join the conversation listen to the conversation using a broadcasting function which does not limit the number of listeners by establishing a group communication network. A plurality of wireless communication networks independently operate small groups like a wireless social group game. In case of an emergency situation, a plurality of the independent wireless communication networks, which operates separate small groups like a wireless social group game, are connected together and cooperates on emergency message receiving and rescue activities. 마지막으로 미래의 5G 이동통신에서 증가하는 트래픽을 소화하기 위해 그룹 게임, 사용자 간의 소셜 정보 교환은 직접 단말기 간에 이루어지게 하여 네트워크의 트래픽 부담을 덜어주는 단말기간 직접 통신, 중계, 그룹 통신과 방송이 가능한  무선 소셜 네트워킹 네트워킹 방법 및 시스템 구성에 관한 기술이다.
assignees: RYU SEUNG MOON

title_en: Evaluation method of operational risk of electric system
abstract_en: The invention provides an evaluation method of an operational risk of an electric system. The method comprises the following steps: (1) risk evaluation index system of the electric system is established; (2) the index in the index system is calculated; (3) and evaluation to the operational risk of the electric system is performed according to the calculated value of the index. According to the evaluation method of the operational risk of the electric system, the risk evaluation is performed on potential incidents that endanger the operational safety in the electric system like an out-of-limit flow, an out-of-limit voltage, an out-of-stability voltage and cascading faults so that the safe and stable operation of a power grid is ensured.
assignees: EAST CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: A kind of wind power base cascading failure risk perceptions method for early warning
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of wind power base cascading failure risk perceptions method for early warning and system thereof.The present invention obtains electrical network and the real time operation mode data of wind energy turbine set by SCADA and WAMS, obtain the foundation of current electric grid contingent wind power disturbance in conjunction with wind energy turbine set historical data and be reasonably expected that fault set, the Wind turbines dynamic model set up and fan safe protection model, wind energy turbine set dynamic operating conditions after simulating grid fault, carry out the Power Network Transient Stability analysis after wind power base breaks down, and after failure removal, carry out static security analysis, by the serial index being applicable to the cascading failure early warning of large-scale wind electricity base set up, safety and stability situation after current electric grid generation wind power disturbance is calculated assessment, analyze large-scale wind electricity base and the risk of cascading failure occurs, realize the safety on line early warning of power system after wind power disturbance.The present invention is easily achieved, it is possible to reflect the power system safety and stability ruuning situation comprising large-scale wind power base intuitively.

title_en: Security system and method using wireless transmitter-receiver
title_ko: 무선 송수신기를 이용한 보안 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A security system which uses a radio frequency (RF) transceiver and a method thereof are provided to obtain locations of people inside of a building even in a situation of an emergency situation or emergency disaster like fire or a power outage in which the security system does not operate. CONSTITUTION: A portable terminal exists within a unit space. An RF transceiver (200) senses the radio field intensity of the portable terminal within the unit space. Center control servers (310,320) grasp the location of the portable terminal through the location information of the RF transceiver and the radio field intensity of the portable terminal which are provided from the RF transceiver. The RF transceiver includes at least three RF transceivers. [Reference numerals] (310) Server 1; (320) Server 2; (410) Internal power; (420) External power; (AA) Cellular phone radio wave antenna; (BB) Wireless LAN router; (CC) Bluetooth transceiver; (DD) NFC transceiver; (EE) Data; (FF) Power line; (GG) Building; (HH) Communication network; (II) Public office (a fire station, a police station)
abstract_ko: 건물과 같은 공간에서 발생한 화재 등의 위급 상황 시에도 건물의 전원 상태에 구애받지 않고 건물 내부의 사람들의 위치 추적 정보를 실시간으로 클라우드망을 통해 외부 공공기관과 공유할 수 있도록 하는 무선 송수신기를 이용한 보안 시스템 및 방법이 제공된다. 상기 무선 송수신기를 이용한 보안 시스템은 단위 공간 내에 존재하는 휴대용 단말기; 상기 단위 공간 내에서 상기 휴대용 단말기의 전파 강도를 감지하는 무선 송수신기; 및 상기 무선 송수신기로부터 제공받은 상기 휴대용 단말기의 전파 강도 및 상기 무선 송수신기의 위치정보를 통해 상기 휴대용 단말기의 위치를 파악하는 중앙 제어 서버를 포함한다.
assignees: SAMSUNG TECHWIN CO LTD

title_en: Networking method and communication system of emergency communication network for mining area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a networking method and a communication system of an emergency communication network for a mining area, which enable each downstream node to select a superior node with the shortest path and the strongest received signal for communication, and gradually reduce the transmitting power of each downstream node to the lowest level capable of being communicated, thereby being capable of flexibly and quickly establishing a low-power-consumption communication network; the problem of mutual interference between terminal access and network cascade channels is effectively solved by adopting a multi-radio frequency communication mode, so that the network communication rate and the uninterrupted transmission capability of comprehensive data services are improved. Therefore, the implementation of the embodiment of the invention provides a high-quality scheme for the construction, maintenance and use of the emergency communication network for the low-power-consumption mining area, and provides powerful communication guarantee for emergency rescue in mining area accidents.

title_en: High performance real-time relational database system and methods for using same
abstract_en: A database system supporting persistent queries, comprising a client software application, a persistent query service, and a plurality of network-attached data sources. On receiving a request to create a persistent query from the client software application, the persistent query service: creates a query virtual table; parses the persistent query; creates a plurality of intermediate virtual tables; establishes listeners for the query virtual table; creates a plurality of data source virtual tables; causes the plurality of data source virtual tables to retrieve initial data from data sources; and propagates data via intermediate virtual tables to the persistent query virtual table. On detection of a data change in a data source, the associated data source virtual table causes the data change to propagate via intermediate virtual tables to the persistent query virtual table, and the client software application executes client code of at least one listener.
assignees: ARIA SOLUTIONS INC;ARIA SOLUTIONS INC

title_en: Method for online prediction of quiescent voltage stability limit of electric system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for online prediction of the quiescent voltage stability limit of an electric system. The method is composed of a sample dimension reduction method based on a Lasso method, a sample selection method based on a self-organizing feature map, and an error back propagation type neural network. According to the method, a large number of random training samples generated by the electric system in an offline simulation mode are preprocessed through the self-organizing feature map and the Lasso method, the Lasso method is used for reducing the number of dimensions of input variables, the self-organizing feature map is used for reducing the number of the training samples, and then offline training and online prediction are carried out on the quiescent voltage stability limit of the electric system by means of the error back propagation type neural network. The method can effectively improve offline training efficiency and the online prediction effect of the error back propagation type neural network.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: The ecosystem protection facilities of river
title_ko: 하천의 친환경 생태 보호 시설
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an eco-friendly facility for protecting the ecosystem of rivers and, more specifically, to an eco-friendly facility for protecting the ecosystem of rivers, capable of providing habitat in which fish can stably inhabit around the river without disturbing the flow of river water and providing spacious large habitat in case the amount of the river water is rapidly increased caused by flood.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 하천의 친환경 생태 보호 시설에 관한 것으로, 하천수의 흐름을 방해하지 않으면서 하천 변에 어류 등이 안전하게 서식할 수 있는 서식지를 제공하고, 홍수와 같이 하천수의 양이 급격히 증가하는 경우 보다 넓은 은신처를 제공하여 하천에 서식하는 어류 등을 안전하게 보호함을 목적으로 한다. 
본 발명에 의한 하천의 친환경 생태 보호 시설은, 하천 변에 연쇄적으로 연결되도록 설치되는 다수의 생태 블록(10)과; 상기 생태 블록의 하천쪽 면에 형성되며 하천수의 양에 따라 상기 생태 블록의 내부와 통하는 은신처를 제공하는 생태 보호 루프(20)를 포함하고, 상기 생태 블록은, 앵커를 통해 하천 바닥에 정착되는 바닥부(11a)와 상기 바닥부 위에 박스 형태로 형성되는 블록부(11b)로 이루어진 블록 본체(11), 상기 블록 본체의 블록부 내부에 길이방향을 따라 양측이 개방되도록 형성되면서 입구쪽에 제1거름망(12a)이 구비된 서식홀(12), 상기 블록 본체의 블록부의 하천을 향하는 면에 상기 서식홀과 통하도록 형성되며 제2거름망(13a)이 구비된 제1이동홀(13), 상기 블록 본체의 바닥부 내부에 양측이 상기 하천과 상기 서식홀에 연통되도록 형성되는 다수의 제2이동홀(14)을 포함하고, 상기 생태 보호 루프는, 상기 제1이동홀의 좌우 양측에 상하 종방향으로 형성되는 승강레일(24), 상기 승강레일에 승강 가능하게 연결되며 내부에 부력재가 주입되어 상기 부력재를 통해 하천수의 수위에 따라 승강하고 상측의 표면이 물결형태로 형성된 루프체(21), 상기 루프체에 식재되어 상기 생태 블록의 전면을 녹화하는 수초(25), 상기 루프체의 하부에 설치되는 한 쌍이며 각각의 저부는 상기 블록 본체에 회전핀(22a)을 통해 회동 가능하게 연결되며 상부는 상기 루프체의 저면에 형성된 절첩레일(21a,21b)에 슬라이딩 가능하게 연결되어 상기 루프체의 승강에 따라 절첩되어 상기 루프체의 승강시 상기 루프체와 함께 공간을 형성하는 제1,2벽체(22,23)로 구성된다.
assignees: OKTO ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Methods and systems for restoring power based on forecasted loads
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a system for restoring power that identifies back-feeding pathways that reduce the risk of cascading power failure and the need for additional network reconfigurations as a result of restoring power in a power distribution network.SOLUTION: A method for restoring power on the basis of forecasted loads is described. The method includes identifying at least one zone within a power distribution network, and predicting a first energy demand of the at least one zone. The method also includes identifying at least one alternate source of power for the at least one zone, identifying at least one switch within the power distribution network capable of supplying power from the at least one alternate source to the at least one zone, and generating a restoration plan for restoring power to the at least one zone.
assignees: GEN ELECTRIC

title_en: Method for forecasting load capacity limit of electric power system online
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for forecasting the load capacity limit of an electric power system online. The method is composed of a sample screening method based on the power grid state similarity, the Lasso method and an error back propagation type neural network. According to the sample screening method based on the power grid state similarity, on the basis of a sample load capacity limit value and a quantitative index of the power grid state similarity, training samples are selected. According to the Lasso method, regression analysis is conduced on the training samples, and the system state quantity, capable of best explaining the load capacity limit, among all state quantities is determined. The error back propagation type neural network is used for conducting off-line fitting on the load capacity limit through the simplified training samples and conducting online forecasting. According to the method for forecasting the load capacity limit of the electric power system online, on the premise that the forecasting precision is guaranteed, the off-line training efficiency of the error back propagation type neural network can be remarkably improved.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: System translation look-aside buffer integrated in an interconnect
abstract_en: System TLBs are integrated within an interconnect, use a and share a transport network to connect to a shared walker port. Transactions are able to pass STLB allocation information through a second initiator side interconnect, in a way that interconnects can be cascaded, so as to allow initiators to control a shared STLB within the first interconnect. Within the first interconnect, multiple STLBs share an intermediate-level translation cache that improves performance when there is locality between requests to the two STLBs.
assignees: QUALCOMM TECHNOLOGIES INC

title_en: Multilayer forest fire prevention center
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multilayer forest fire prevention center. The multilayer forest fire prevention center comprises an alarm, multiple bottom-layer monitoring centers, a remote monitoring system, a top-layer monitoring center and multiple intermediate-layer monitoring centers, wherein the top-layer monitoring center is provided with a top-layer alarm server, a cascade server and a top-layer network switch cabinet which are successively interconnected; the intermediate-layer monitoring centers comprise intermediate-layer alarm servers and intermediate-layer network switches; the intermediate-layer alarm servers are connected with the intermediate-layer network switches; the intermediate-layer network switches are interconnected with the top-layer network switch cabinet; the bottom-layer monitoring centers comprise video control servers, bottom-layer alarm servers and bottom-layer network switches; the remote monitoring system is connected with the bottom-layer network switches through a network; the bottom-layer network switches, the video control servers and the bottom-layer alarm servers are successively interconnected; the alarm is connected with the bottom-layer alarm servers; and the bottom-layer network switches are in redundancy connection with the intermediate-layer network switches. The multilayer forest fire prevention center has the advantages of scientific decision-making, high response capability and high operation efficiency.
assignees: CHENGDU JINGLIN ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Power system energy efficiency test management system and test method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system energy efficiency test management system and a test method. The whole system includes three layers, the first layer is a network management layer, a PXI or IPC/PC104 main control computer is managed in a centralized manner by a server, and an Ethernet local area network is formed by a concentrator and cascaded to other local area networks. The second layer is a measurement and control layer provided with a PXI system or IPC/PC104 system of an embedded controller, serves as a client of a centralized management system, also serves as a main control computer for on-site measurement and control equipment and functions as a gateway. The third layer comprises various monitoring and test equipment units mounted on an operation site of monitored equipment, and the types and the number of the units are determined according to monitoring requirements. Remote energy consumption real-time dynamic monitoring, energy consumption management and energy efficiency analysis work for power equipment at all levels of a power system are realized, and real-time energy management and energy consumption of the power system are realized.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID SHANDONG ENERGY SAVING SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Disaster recovery method, system and equipment in IMS network
abstract_en: There is provided a kind of disaster recovery method in the ims network, control system and equipment.Disaster recovery method in IMS network includes：By user equipment registration to the multiple IMS access devices communicated with equipment of the core network；The state of multiple IMS access devices is safeguarded in equipment of the core network；And when the service disruption of the IMS access devices that user equipment is used, equipment of the core network is based on the state of multiple IMS access devices, other IMS access devices in selection multiple IMS access devices are communicated with user equipment.According to presently filed embodiment, user equipment can be made to use IMS network un-interrupted in the case where the IMS access devices for being used cannot provide service.

title_en: Method and apparatus for propagating public safety multicast and broadcast services among public safety personnel
abstract_en: Public safety user equipment (PS UE) that establishes a first wireless communication channel over a primary network to at least one multimedia multicast or broadcast service management entity and establishes one or more alternative wireless communication channels over one or more alternative networks ( 310 ). The public safety user equipment receives at least one multimedia multicast or broadcast service message over the first wireless communication channel ( 320 ), Then, the PS UE extracts data contained in the multimedia multicast or broadcast service message and storing the data in a local cache ( 330 ). The PS UE receives a cache request from the one or more user equipment over one or more alternative wireless communication channels ( 340 ) and then the PS UE transmits the stored data to the one or more PS user equipment ( 350 ).
assignees: MOTOROLA SOLUTIONS INC

title_en: A kind of flow nodes backing method for intelligent grid scheduling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of flow nodes backing method for intelligent grid scheduling, comprise the following steps：Node rollback processing relevant information and the relevant position stored to database are set；Flow promoter selects the circulation handling process set in database, and submits data；Inquired about in database and obtain current node information and the node rollback processing authority of present node, it is determined whether need to retract；If need not or can not retract, into next node, repeat the above steps；If necessary to retract, then by current node state, node rollback flow is performed.For the present invention by realizing that operation node retracts in dispatching of power netwoks flow, dynamic, which specifies node retracted position and cascades deletion, has completed node, can meet the flow rollback demand in actual electric network business well.

title_en: Multilayer forest fireproof monitoring center
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multilayer forest fireproof monitoring center. The multilayer forest fireproof monitoring center comprises an alarm, a plurality of bottom-layer monitoring centers, a remote monitoring system, a top-layer monitoring center and a plurality of interlayer monitoring centers. The top-layer monitoring center is equipped with a top-layer alarm server, a cascade server and a top-layer network switch cabinet which are connected orderly and mutually. Each interlayer monitoring center comprises an interlayer alarm server and an interlayer network switch, the interlayer alarm servers are connected with the interlayer network switches, and the interlayer network switches are connected with the top-layer network switch cabinet mutually. Each bottom-layer monitoring center comprises a video control server, a bottom-layer alarm server and a bottom-layer network switch, and the remote monitoring system is connected with the bottom-layer network switches via a network. The bottom-layer network switch, the video control server and the bottom-layer alarm server are connected orderly and mutually, the alarm and the bottom-layer alarm servers are connected, and the bottom-layer network switches are in redundancy connection with the interlayer network switches. The multilayer forest fireproof monitoring center realizes the scientific decision, and is strong in response capability and high in operation efficiency.
assignees: CHENGDU JINGLIN ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for obtaining information of fire hazard site in building
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for obtaining information of a fire hazard site in a building, and belongs to the technical field of fire hazard industry monitoring. The method and the device have the technical scheme that the device comprises a remote monitoring upper machine (1), a monitoring host machine (2), a plurality of monitoring extension machines (3) and a plurality of individual machines (4), wherein the monitoring host machine is connected with the monitoring extension machines through an in-situ wireless network, of the monitoring expansion machines are connected with the individual machines through the in-situ wireless network, the remote monitoring host machine and the monitoring host machine are connected through a wireless or wired network, the monitoring expansion machines transmit all monitored information of all individual machines and monitoring extension machines to the monitoring host machine in a cascade connection mode, the monitoring host machine transmits the information to the monitoring host machine through a remote network, and the obtaining of information of the fire hazard site in the building can be realized. The method and the device provided by the invention have the positive effects that the personnel distribution and the fire condition of the fire hazard situation site can be known in real time, the first information is provided for the danger elimination and rescue organization, and the personnel casualties and the property loss are reduced.
assignees: TANGSHAN MODERN IND CONTR TECH

title_en: Urban well lid anti-theft monitoring method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to an urban well lid anti-theft monitoring method and device, and belongs to the technical field of monitoring of the municipal industry. According to the technical scheme, the urban well lid anti-theft monitoring device comprises a remote monitoring upper computer (1), a main monitor (2), slave monitors (3) and well lid monitors (4), wherein the main monitor and the slave monitors are connected through in-situ wireless networks; the slave monitors and the well lid monitors are connected through in-situ wireless networks; the remote monitoring upper computer and the main monitor are connected through the wireless or wired network. The slave monitors transmit all monitored information of all well lid monitors to the main monitor in a cascading mode, the main monitor transmits the information to the remote monitoring upper computer through the remote network, and the monitoring information of well lids is obtained. The urban well lid anti-theft monitoring method and device have the advantages that whether an urban road well lid is lost or not is known in time, the remedial measure is taken in time, and casualties and vehicle and property losses are reduced.
assignees: TANGSHAN MODERN IND CONTR TECH

title_en: Wireless social group communication system
title_ko: 무선 소셜 그룹 통신 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a technology related to a wireless social networking method and a system configuration capable of executing direct communication, relay communication, and group communication, and broadcasting between the terminals which connect peripheral users using the social networking between the users using the network using a wireless method and to a technology for developing the group communication by applying the local broadcasting using the wireless network protocol technology of a content method and a communication fusion technology (application number 10-2012-0091879) to an actual use system and without interference between the users in the compact condition of the users. A terminal can be widely used in store management or industrial site, and for a leisure sport because the terminal can execute the group communication with the Ad-hoc relay with an infrastructure. In addition, the present invention relates to a useful technology capable of constructing a communication network related to disaster and safety using the terminal in a disconnected condition with stop of the all infra structure in a disaster site and capable of enabling a user to execute communication by relaying between the terminals.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 네트워크를 이용한 사용자간의 소셜 네트워킹을 무선 방식을 이용하여 주변의 사용자들을 연결시켜주는 단말기간 직접 통신, 중계, 그룹 통신과 방송이 가능한 무선 소셜 네트워킹 네트워킹 방법 및 시스템 구성에 관한 기술과 사용자가 밀집한 상황에서도 사용자 간의 간섭없이 다양한 서비스를 하나의 프로토콜로 해결할 수 있는 컨테이너 방식의 무선 네트워크 프로토콜 기술을 이용한 근거리 방송과 통신 융합 기법(출원번호 10-2012-0091879)을 실제 사용하는 시스템에 적용하여 그룹 통신용으로 발전시킨 기술에 관한 것이다. 
인프라가 없는 상황에서 단말기만으로 Ad-hoc 중계와 함께 그룹통신이 가능하여 레저 스포츠용은 물론 산업 현장이나 매장 관리 등에서 널리 사용될 수 있고 또한 재난 현장에서 모든 인프라가 마비되어 통신망이 두절된 상황에서도 단말기 만으로도 재난 안전에 관한 통신망 구축과 재난 방송이 가능하고 전파가 차단되는 지하 구조물까지 단말기간의 중계에 의한 통화 소통이 가능한, 실생활에 매우 유용한 기술에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Apparatus for inspecting electric power conduit in underground using mobile device
title_ko: 모바일 기기를 이용한 지중 전력구 점검장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and method for inspecting an electric power conduit in underground by using a mobile device. The apparatus receives degradation damage in a two-dimensional model and realizes and expresses the degradation damage in a three-dimensional model based on correlation between mutual spatial coordinates by independently utilizing the mobile device without support of an external computer system based on a GPS and wired/wireless communication networks when inspecting and diagnosing the electric power conduit in underground at the electric power conduit in underground which is a radio wave shadow area. Therefore, it is possible to improve economic efficiency by reducing time and labor for an additional work for the three-dimensional model realization, and it is also possible to realize and confirm a three-dimensional degradation damage model in real time at the electric power conduit site in underground. Consequently, it is possible to improve the reliability of diagnosis information and a visual inspection check by previously preventing artificial mistakes and errors that can occur in a conversion process of performing three-dimensional regeneration or re-input based on maintenance information and two-dimensional graphic information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 모바일 기기를 이용한 지중 전력구 점검장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로서, 전파 음영지역인 지중 전력구에서 지중 전력구의 점검과 진단시 GPS와 유무선 통신네트워크 등에 기반한 외부 전산시스템의 지원없이도 독립적으로 모바일 기기를 활용하여 열화손상을 2차원 모델로 입력받아 상호 공간좌표의 연계성에 근거하여 3차원 모델로 구현하여 표출할 수 있도록 함으로써 3차원 모델 구현을 위한 추가적인 작업을 위한 시간과 인력을 줄여 경제성을 향상시킬 수 있으며, 지중 전력구 현장에서 실시간으로 3차원 열화손상 모델을 구현하고 확인할 수 있어 2차원적 그래픽정보와 유지관리정보를 바탕으로 3차원적으로 재생성하거나 재입력하는 변환과정에서 발생될 수 있는 인위적인 실수와 오류를 사전에 방지할 수 있어 외관조사의 점검 및 진단 정보의 신뢰성을 높일 수 있다.
