abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Tetra Multi-Carrier basestations based on emergency mobile communication, antenna, combiner, the shunt being connected with duplexer including duplexer and respectively, also the n single carrier Tetra base station with unique carrier frequency including being connected with combiner, shunt respectively；Mainboard interface that the base station is connected by Tetra digital signal processing modules and respectively with Tetra digital signal processing modules, constituted from plate interface, clock module, it is connected in cascaded fashion with from plate interface by mainboard interface between base station, determine principal and subordinate's carrier wave, complete clock synchronization；Each base station, to Tetra interchangers, completes the parameter configuration of each carrier wave by network interface connection.The present invention uses full IP Design of digital, realize Tetra Digital Clustering GSMs, the volume for greatly reducing equipment is, the weight for alleviating equipment, and can be according to actual conditions the need for, flexibly increase and decrease the number of multicarrier by way of cascade, can be applied to the emergency communication field under mobile environment.

title_en: Method for detecting smoke or fire by using infra-red laser in a wide space
title_ko: 광역 화재감지를 위한 적외선 레이저 연기 검출 방법
abstract_en: The present invention suggests a method of detecting smoke to detect a fire in a wide area including a tunnel and an airport etc. using infrared ray and visible ray laser. A system which forms the method of detecting smoke comprises; an infrared ray laser transmission and reception device; a visible ray laser which facilitates the infrared ray laser transmission and reception matching at long range; and a Zigbee wireless communication network which spreads a fire alarm. If smoke is generated between an infrared ray laser transmission device and an infrared ray laser reception device, that the size of a reception signal becomes smaller than a standard value is checked and the smoke is detected. If the infrared ray laser transmission device is a long way from the infrared ray laser reception device, it is difficult to match a signal because a fairly great change is formed in a reception side with a small change of a transmission side. The present invention suggests a method which uses infrared ray laser to detect wide area smoke and uses a visible ray for the effective matching. The present invention developed a smoke detection system which transfers an alarm though the Zigbee wireless network when smoke is detected.
abstract_ko:
본 발명에서는 적외선과 가시광선 레이저를 이용하여 터널, 공항 등의 넓은 공간에서의 화재를 감지하기 위하여 연기검출 방법을 제안한다.  
본 발명에서 제안하는 연기검출 방법을 구현하는 시스템은 적외선 레이저 송수신기와, 원거리에서 적외선 레이저 송수신 정합을 편리하게 하기 위한 가시광선 레이저, 그리고 화재 경보를 전파하기 위한 Zigbee 무선통신 네트워크로 구성된다. 
적외선 레이저 송신기와 수신기 사이에 연기가 발생하면 수신 신호의 크기가 기준값보다 작아지기는 것을 확인하고 연기를 검출한다.  
적외선 레이저 송신기와 수신기 사이의 거리가 먼 경우에는 송신 측의 작은 변화에도 수신측에서는 상당히 큰 변이가 생겨 신호를 정합하는데 어려움이 있다. 
본 발명에서는 광역 연기 검출을 위하여 적외선 레이저를 이용하고 효율적인 정합을 위하여 가시광선을 이용하는 방법을 제안하며, 연기가 감지되면 Zigbee 무선네트워크를 통하여 경보를 전달하는 연기검출 시스템을 개발하였다.
assignees: UNIV KYUNGSUNG IND COOP FOUND

title_en: Power grid development assessment method with economical efficiency and security considered
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid development assessment method with economical efficiency and security considered. The method comprises the steps of collecting initial state data of a power grid to be researched; conducting evolution simulation on the development state of the power grid based on the initial state data of the power grid; conducting statistics on relevant information of newly-built power plants, transformer substations and lines and simulating cascading failures of the power grid based on an obtained power grid evolution simulation result, calculating the construction cost of the power grid based on the statistics information, and obtaining the load loss information of the cascading failures of the power grid based on the simulation of the cascading failures of the power grid; calculating the outage cost of the power grid to obtain the total outage cost of power grid evolution; calculating the development cost of the power grid according to the construction cost of the power grid, the outage cost of the power grid and additionally-supplied load profit; changing the control parameters of evolution simulation of the development state of the power grid and obtaining power grid development cost values under different evolution simulation control parameters through calculation; making an assessment according to the principle that the lower a power grid development cost value is, the more reasonable power grid development is under the corresponding development speed.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE POWER ECONOMIC RES INST;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Intelligent high-voltage parallel capacitor device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an intelligent high-voltage parallel capacitor device. The intelligent high-voltage parallel capacitor device comprises a plurality of intelligent capacitance device cabinets and a central intelligent console. Each intelligent capacitance device cabinet comprises a cabinet body, a front end intelligent processing unit and a sensor. A plurality of intelligent capacitance control cabinets are connected in a cascade mode and are connected with the central intelligent console through the network. The intelligent high-voltage parallel capacitor device is characterized in that: the front end intelligent processing unit comprises a communication unit, a data processing unit, a signal acquisition unit and a power supply management unit; The power supply management unit is respectively connected with the data processing unit, a signal acquisition unit and a communication unit; the signal acquisition unit is respectively connected with the sensor and the data processing unit, carries out data reception processing of the signal received by the sensor and sends the processed signal to the data processing unit; the communication unit is connected with the data processing unit, and sends the data processed by the data processing unit to the central intelligent console. The intelligent high-voltage parallel capacitor device can give an early warning of a sub-healthy capacitor in advance, avoids sudden failures and disasters, does not need artificial intervention and automatic all-day on-line monitoring, and reduces power failure time of traditional manual maintenance greatly.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;ELECTRIC POWER ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RES INST JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;ZHONGWANG ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Cascade hydropower station group daily power generation plan making method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade hydropower station group daily power generation plan making method which comprises the steps that 1. turning-on-off constraint of a power plant power generator unit is not considered, the target that the similarity degree of the power generation load of a hydropower station group and the daily typical load of a power plant is highest is used as one of optimization targets, and a cascade hydropower station group daily power generation plan is obtained through primary optimization; 2. according to the cascade hydropower station group daily power generation plan, a power plant power generator unit turning-on-off state process is prepared; and 3. power plant power generator unit turning-on-off state process constraining conditions are increased, the target that the similarity degree of the power generation load of the hydropower station group and the daily typical load of the power plant is highest is used as an optimization target, and a cascade hydropower station group daily power generation plan is obtained through secondary optimization. Power grid requirements are considered, a hydropower station power generating strategy which accords with practical situations better can be obtained, and the method is suitable for single hydropower station and cascade hydropower station group daily power generation plan making.
assignees: UNIV WUHAN

title_en: Surface-layer half water retention type permeable bituminous pavement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel surface-layer half water retention type permeable bituminous pavement structure and a preparation method thereof. The novel surface-layer half water retention type permeable bituminous pavement structure comprises a permeable bituminous surface layer and a base layer, wherein the bituminous surface layer is divided into an upper surface layer which is 25-30mm thick and a lower surface layer which is 70-90mm thick; the lower surface layer which has half road breadth in the middle of a pavement is filled with a water retention material; the base layer is divided into an upper base layer and a lower base layer; the upper base layer is a bituminous gravel base layer which is 80-120mm thick, and the lower base layer is a cascaded gravel base layer which is 180-220mm thick; the water retention material is prepared by doping 15-20wt% of slaked lime and 60-80wt% of water into a powder body material consisting of 85-95wt% of blast furnace slag powder and 5-15wt% of coal ash. According to the novel surface-layer half water retention type permeable bituminous pavement structure, a quick permeable pavement and the water retention functional material on the lower surface layer are combined together; being an auxiliary of a municipal water drainage facility, the novel surface-layer half water retention type permeable bituminous pavement structure can greatly improve the capacity of an urban road for resisting flood disasters and enhancing the traffic safety, effectively reduce the temperature of the urban road, relieve the high-temperature condensation effect of the bituminous surface layer to a certain extent, delay the bituminous aging speed and prolong the service life of the pavement.

title_en: Cascade hydropower station multi-object optimal scheduling mixed searching method coupling peak shaving and navigation demands
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of comprehensive development and utilization and optimized scheduling of water resources, in particular to a cascade hydropower station multi-object optimal scheduling mixed searching method coupling peak shaving and navigation demands. The function of a navigation counter regulation power station can be fully performed, the peak shaving of a power grid and river channel navigation application requirements are taken into account, and a cascade operation plan which is practical and more reasonable in scheduling is obtained. According to the technical scheme, the minimum of the maximum value of the redundant loads of the power grid and the minimum of the variance of the counter regulation power station downstream river channel water level process are adopted as objects, in the NSGA-II searching process, for the complex constrains of the climbing upper limit, the output fluctuation control limit, the machine starting and shutting down minimum lasting time, the term end water level control and the like, time coupling constraint handling strategies, end water level correction strategies and improved genetic manipulation operators are put forward, so that the searching and solving efficiency of the method can be improved, a calculating result meeting engineering application request is obtained, and the method is suitable for being adopted and popularized in the scheduling operation of a cascade hydropower station with navigation requests.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN TECH

title_en: Trans-provincial power transmission cascade hydropower station group peak-shaving dispatching two-phase search method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of hydropower dispatching operation, and discloses a trans-provincial power transmission cascade hydropower station group peak-shaving dispatching two-phase search method. The characteristics of load complementation between receiving-end power grids can be fully utilized and different peak power demands of multiple receiving-end power grids can be taken into consideration to realize reasonable allocation of quality resources between the multiple power grids. The technical scheme is as follows: the trans-provincial power transmission cascade hydropower station group peak-shaving goal is realized in two phases according to the characteristics of the trans-provincial power transmission peak-shaving issue; in the optimization calculation process, load curves with great difference of a plurality of provincial power grids are reconstructed into an overall load by adoption of a load reconstruction strategy, and the hydropower station power output process is determined on the basis by adoption of a variable-scale optimization method; and then the allocation process of output power of the station between the receiving-end power grids is optimized by adoption of an exterior point search method, an initial solution is generated through successive load shedding, and the peak power sizes of the receiving-end power grids are corrected in an iterative mode by taking load level as heuristic information to meet the peak-shaving demands of the multiple power grids. Peak-shaving demands of multiple provincial power grids can be taken into consideration, and a peak-shaving result better than actual dispatching can be obtained. The method is feasible.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN TECH

title_en: Tetra and GSM (Global System for Mobile Communication) common base station platform based on software radio
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Tetra and GSM (Global System for Mobile Communication) common base station platform based on software radio. The Tetra and GSM common base station platform comprises a digital processing platform and a radiofrequency processing platform, wherein the digital processing platform comprises an MCU (Microprogrammed Control Unit), a DSP (Digital Signal Processor), an FPGA (Field Programmable Gate Array) and a clock module; the clock module is connected with the FPGA; a PLL (Phase Locked Loop), a CIC (Cascade Integrator Comb) filter and a digital receiving filter are arranged inside the FPGA; the FPGA is used for processing a clock signal through the PLL and transmitting the processed clock signal to the MCU and the DSP which are connected with the FPGA; the radiofrequency processing platform comprises a transmitting module, a receiving module, a PLL module, a combination module and a digital-to-analog/analog-to-digital conversion module; and the digital processing platform is connected with the radiofrequency processing platform through the digital-to-analog/analog-to-digital conversion module to realize information transmission. The two modes of Tetra and GSM are realized on the same hardware platform, the design period is shortened greatly, and the design cost is reduced; private network and public network communication services are provided by loading different applications according to scene requirements, and the Tetra and GSM common base station platform is suitable for mobile emergency communication.
assignees: SUN KAISENS BEIJING TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Cascading failure search comprehensive evaluation method based on probability index and severity index
abstract_en: According to the cascading failure searching comprehensive evaluation method based on the probability index and the severity index, the probability index and the severity index of the failure of the next-stage alternative line are respectively obtained through analyzing the operation state of the power grid after each stage of failure, and the cascading failure comprehensive risk index of the alternative line is obtained through grading and comprehensive.
assignees: CHINA SOUTH POWER GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO;UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: Correlation assessment method of power grid cascading failure accident chains
abstract_en: A correlation assessment method of power grid cascading failure accident chains comprises the steps that (1) a system is initialized to be in a normal operation working condition; (2) initial failures happen to circuits with equal probability, circuit initial failures are circuit three-phase permanent short-circuit failures, relay protecting action failure removing in a set time is carried out, and for direct-current circuit, the initial failures are direct-current circuit single-pole locking failures; (3) based on the previous circuit failure situations, transient stability analysis is carried out on an electric system, if system transient is unstable, the step (7) is carried out; and if system transient is stable, the step (4) is carried out; and other steps are carried out. According to the method, on the basis that the correlation between cascading failures can be considered, system transient stability failures can be subjected to effective searching, searching correlation probability is given, system states and topology are considered, meanwhile, high computing efficiency is achieved, and certain guiding effect is achieved on cascading failure searching and accident chain recognition.

title_en: Local disaster prevention warehouse
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a local disaster prevention warehouse for protecting human life, which can be easily installed at a nearby point, with which rescue/care activity for neighbors can be performed not only in the daytime but even during service interruption at night without waiting for official rescue/care activity, and which allows electric power to be supplied to information equipment and information to be obtained.SOLUTION: A local disaster prevention warehouse comprises: a solar panel 4 receiving sunlight to generate electric power; and a warehouse body 2, on which the solar panel 4 is installed at a predetermined angle, in which batteries 6 for accumulating the electric power from the solar panel 4 is housed, and which has an openable and closable door 3, is compact, and is suitable for transport. Rescue/care equipment, living supplies, a broadcasting facility, and radio communication equipment are stored in the warehouse body 2. Moreover, a fan for ventilation 11 using the batteries 6 as an electric power source, an external broadcast speaker 16, a television monitor 17, and automatic lighting and extinguishing LED lamps 13 are provided in the door 3.
assignees: HAMRON TEC CO LTD

title_en: Power system cascading failure mode prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system cascading failure mode prediction method, and relates to the technical field of power system cascading failure mechanism analysis. The power system cascading failure mode prediction method of the invention comprises the following steps: a, the steady-state power flow of a system before an initial failure is calculated; b, the comprehensive vulnerability index is calculated; c, the initial failure is determined; d, the comprehensive vulnerability index after failure is calculated; e, the comprehensive margin index Cij(s+1) of the system after failure is calculated; f, the (s+1)-level failure is determined; and g, whether the search termination condition is met is judged. According to the power system cascading failure mode prediction method of the invention, the possible cascading failure mode of the system is predicated by combining the power grid structure and state parameters, the predication indexes are combined with the actual situation of the power system, the calculation speed is high, a cascading failure set having a serious effect on the system is worked out and analyzed, and prevention of major blackout accidents caused by cascading failure can be enhanced.

title_en: A kind of Hydropower Stations Real time optimal dispatch method under Complex Constraints restriction
abstract_en: The present invention relates to Electric Power Network Planning and management and running field, disclose the Hydropower Stations Real time optimal dispatch method under the restriction of a kind of Complex Constraints, it will include in real-time scheduling by generation schedule a few days ago, maximum as optimization aim using the total accumulation of energy of Hydro Power Systems with Cascaded Reservoirs, meet the requirement of the fail safe of Real-Time Scheduling, ageing, practicality, economy.Its technical scheme is: by by power station a few days ago generation schedule and inter-plant load deviation optimize the superimposed mode of allocation result, roll generate real-time generation schedule, hide unit vibration district in real time.Abandoning the power station of water for existing, devising and a kind ofly practically abandoning water adjustable strategies, utilizing step hydropower station to regulate advantage, adopt to let out in advance and rise storehouse, avoid unnecessary generation of abandoning water, improve water utilization rate.The invention has the beneficial effects as follows the future development of prediction electrical network, for Hydropower Stations Real time optimal dispatch system Construction provides solid theoretical foundation.

title_en: Electric network fault partition method
abstract_en: A kind of electric network fault partition method, the method comprising the steps of: A, sets up the vulnerability inder of circuit in electrical network, forms the vulnerable line set of electrical network；B, when breaking down in electrical network, it is judged that whether fault occurs in vulnerable line set, if then operating procedure C, otherwise terminates；C, with faulty line node or the node of vulnerable line that is attached thereto as starting point, judge the vulnerability inder of connected circuit, if vulnerability inder is less than predetermined threshold, then described circuit is included into border circuit, another node of the most described circuit is included into fault zone, continue to judge the vulnerability inder of connected circuit, until finding border circuit.D, electrical network is divided into fault zone or non-faulting region.By using the electric network fault partition method of the present invention, it is possible to when breaking down, faulty line is isolated in a little region, makes fault to propagate on a large scale, prevent the generation of large-scale blackout.

title_en: Giant salamander Bionic reproduction facility
abstract_en: Giant salamander Bionic reproduction facility, relates to a kind of aquatic products propagation technique field, particularly relates to a kind of giant salamander Bionic reproduction facility.Giant salamander Bionic reproduction facility of the present utility model, is characterized in that setting up cultivation place on tableland or gentle slope, excavates small stream ditch within it; Above small stream ditch, weep pipe is set, aperture water supply drip is equidistantly set below weep pipe and falls, in weep pipe, valve is set; Small stream ditch delivery port position arranges filter screen and drainpipe, and drainpipe is connected with escape canal; Xi Gou excavates both sides several Ecology caves, and bottom is communicated with small stream ditch.Giant salamander Bionic reproduction facility of the present utility model, by the construction to cultivation place, small stream ditch and Ecology cave, simulation and reduction giant salamander fit ecotope that is raw and breeding, are conducive to growing of close salamander; The natural calamities such as storm flood can be avoided; Effectively can prevent the harm of natural enemy; Be convenient to manage and protect, giant salamander safety, water quality and safety thereof all can effectively be ensured.

title_en: Support data transmission and the visible ray of location and power line communication method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses visible ray and power line communication method and the device supporting data transmission and location, method includes: be coupled in electric lines of force be transmitted by transmitting signal；Extract and launch signal, according to the first signaling information from launching selection business information signal, merge the positional information of LED with carrying out automatic growth control process and frequency division multiplexing according to the source of location information, obtain merging signal；Merging signal sent into LED and merging signal is converted to current signal, by the luminous intensity of regulation LED, current signal being converted to visible light signal；Receive visible light signal, demodulate corresponding business information according to the second signaling information, and obtain LED location information.The signal of telecommunication of power line transmission is directly gone out by LED emission with line-of-sight propagation, and take into account data transmission and location application, there is network construction cost low, the advantages such as building time is fast, can be used for the fields such as intelligent grid, digital home, public safety monitoring.

title_en: nest prevention equipment fov telegvaph poles
title_ko: 전주용 둥지방지장치
abstract_ko:
본 고안은, 전주에 축조된 까치둥지로 인한 불시정전사고로 전력시설파손을 비롯하여 냉장냉동식품손괴와 산업체의 생산라인가동중단 등 상당한 피해를 낳고 있으므로, 그에 대처할 수 있는 간편하고 반영구적인 장치에 관한 것이다. 
     본 고안에 따르면, 까치가 전선을 지지하는 완철(24)상단을 둥지를 짓는 발판으로 이용함으로, 까치의 착지가 불가능하도록 기울어진 경사판 완철커버(6)상단에 요철 형 수직연쇄첨단부(8)를 형성시켜 까치접근 시 발바닥에 솟아 있는 감각돌기를 찌르게 하여 둥지를 짓는 위치에 접근하지 못하도록 구성했으며, 또한 본체하단의 완철 삽입부(14)(16)내에 본체전면 장착부(16)와 본체후면 장착부(18)를 두어 고공작업을 용이케 한 전주용 둥지방지장치를 제공하게 된다. 
     
     경사판(40°) 완철커버. 요철 형 수직연쇄 스파이크. 우측 경사판 지지부. 좌측 경사판 지지부. 완철전면 삽입부. 완철후면삽입부. 본체전면 장착부. 본체후면 장착부. LP애자(라인포스트). 완철. 전주.

title_en: Diversion route calculation method in emergency
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To solve the conventional problem that channel quality to be prioritized may not be secured, due to simultaneous and frequent occurrence of service interruption channels during a large-scale fault in a serious disaster etc. and further the restoration time may be long.SOLUTION: A network supervision and control device connecting a plurality of transmission devices calculates a diversion route from a relatively high priority between channels, on the basis of a service level regulation in an emergency, including the upper limit value of a service interruption time and the channel quality, so as to set a schedule including a path route, a sequence and a time limit.
assignees: HITACHI LTD

title_en: Short-term power generation prediction method applied to high-concentration-ratio photovoltaic power generation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-term power generation prediction method applied to a high-concentration ratio photovoltaic power generation system. The method comprises the following steps of collecting historical data of the high-concentration ratio photovoltaic power generation system, and determining input of a BP (back-propagation) neural network for predicting short-term power generation according to a related coefficient analytic method; training the initialized BP neural network according to each input historical datum; obtaining the predicted short-term power generation according to the input historical data and the trained BP neural network. According to the short-term power generation prediction method applied to the high-concentration ratio photovoltaic power generation system, short-time prediction and daily prediction can be carried out, short-time average errors between prediction results and actual results are not greater than 10 percent, and the prediction accuracy is greatly improved.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING POSTS & TELECOMM

title_en: Ultra-short period wind power prediction method based on wind speed factor control model
abstract_en: The invention provides an ultra-short period wind power prediction method based on a wind speed factor control model. The ultra-short period wind power prediction method includes performing an ultra-short period prediction according to an ARIMA (autoregressive integrated moving average) model; performing the ultra-short period power prediction according to a BP (back propagation) neutral network model; completing the ultra-short period wind power prediction based on the wind speed factor control model. In this way, at the premise that the ARIMA model and the BP neutral network model are evaluated, the ARIMA model and the BP neutral network model can be switched according to the running environment, so that accuracy of the ultra-short wind power prediction is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: A kind of Study of Risk Evaluation Analysis for Power System method based on deterministic parsing
abstract_en: A kind of Study of Risk Evaluation Analysis for Power System method based on deterministic parsing, has considered the change of the power flow transfer after system is disturbed and node voltage, proposes more perfect power network fragility comprehensive analysis index.The present invention is comprised the following steps：1) the trend distribution after analysis system topological structure, computing system steady-state operation and disturbance, including the effective power flow and reactive power flow of each branch road, each node voltage and its phase angle difference.2) each evaluation index in the evaluation system, including the pre- risk assessment factor and the network synthesis risk assessment factor are calculated.3) the index grade according to setting carries out risk assessment to power system.Study of Risk Evaluation Analysis for Power System method of the invention, more comprehensively reflect the risk information of system,, Voltage Instability out-of-limit to system trend that may be present and cascading failure make unified metric decision in the face of risk, be conducive to operations staff to make quickly and accurately to judge, take measures guarantee system safe and stable operation in time.

title_en: Photovoltaic system generating efficiency comprehensive evaluation method based on BP (back propagation) neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic system generating efficiency comprehensive evaluation method based on a BP (back propagation) neural network. Weight assignment on various evaluation indexes is carried out by the BP neural network, influences of human factors on weight can be gradually eliminated in a training process, the weight is corrected, a photovoltaic power generating system is classified, the whole efficiency of the photovoltaic power generating system is evaluated, the running efficiency level of the photovoltaic system and the running efficiency level of key equipment of the photovoltaic system can be judged effectively, key factors which affect the efficiency level of the photovoltaic system and the efficiency level of the key equipment of the photovoltaic system are uncovered, a generating efficiency improvement strategy is discovered, and the generating efficiency of the photovoltaic system and the generating efficiency of the key equipment of the photovoltaic system are improved. By the method, reliable and accurate multi-item efficiency analysis and comprehensive evaluation analysis results are provided for an optional photovoltaic power station, a theoretical basis is provided for an operation and maintenance strategy of the photovoltaic power station, data are provided for design optimization of the photovoltaic power station, the generating efficiency of the photovoltaic power station is improved, the generating capacity is improved, the economic benefit is increased, and the application value is high.
assignees: XUJI GROUP CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Appraisal procedure and system based on social networking application information disclosure model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of appraisal procedure and system based on social networking application information disclosure model.This method includes：The information communication process of social networking application is analyzed and is abstracted, establishes social networking application information disclosure model；Based on social networking application information disclosure model, social networking application information propagation risk is decomposed into every factor according to hierarchical relationship, and every factor is carried out by aggregation combination according to hierarchical relationship according to the correlation between every factor, generation deceptive information propagates risk evaluation model；Wherein, the hierarchical relationship of deceptive information propagation risk evaluation model specifically includes：System layer, physical layer and risk point layer；Initial data based on risk point in the risk point layer for propagating risk evaluation model by deceptive information, the deceptive information faced to the social networking application are propagated threat and assessed.

title_en: Public emergency rescue device with video communication
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a public of utensil video communication propagation is with urgent rescue apparatus, it includes a containing box that can supply to accomodate first aid equipment, after the containing box is opened and takes out first aid equipment, can start triggering module, photographic module passes through this user's of photographic analysis characteristic, transmit the message through network module and carry out the analysis to remote server in, this remote server passes through the audio-visual module of internet control, and through audio-visual module to this user broadcast first aid equipment's correct operation demonstration and relevant medical information, furthermore, be equipped with the module of charging on the containing box, can supply the usefulness that the mobile device charges, especially people are when viewing and admiring the display screen broadcast program, usable time charges.
assignees: ZHOU YANWEN

title_en: Power management device, power management method, and program
abstract_en: An object is to generate a possibility to obtain a price without impairing convenience of a power storage apparatus while a power grid is in a service interruption state, and further provide a motivation for promoting use of the power storage apparatus. A power management system (10) includes a first administrator (11), a second administrator (12), a first estimator (13), a second estimator (14) and a determiner (15). The first administrator (11) manages a residual capacity of a power storage apparatus (21). The second administrator (12) manages interruption information regarding a power grid (30). The first estimator (13) estimates, as first power information, an amount of power that is consumed by an electric load (2) during an interruption period. The second estimator (14) estimates an estimation residual capacity that is the residual capacity at an end point of the interruption period, based on the first power information. The determiner (15) determines that a condition for participating in a power trade market is met, when the estimation residual capacity exceeds a reference value.
assignees: PANASONIC IP MAN CO LTD

title_en: Electric power system tide shifts dangerous line method for fast searching
abstract_en: A kind of electric power system tide shifts dangerous line method for fast searching, methods described first according to graph theory and voltage phase angle search broken string circuit etc. phase angle parallel powerline, then look for the shortest path of the phase angle parallel powerlines such as the process between the Origin And Destination of broken string circuit, by the railway superstructures power flow transfer line set on the path, the line power after the active power transfer limit and power flow transfer further according to each power flow transfer circuit tries to achieve the power flow transfer hazard index of each power flow transfer circuit, power flow transfer dangerous line is finally determined according to power flow transfer hazard index.The present invention can start to the of short duration time of action in overload reserve protection, the dangerous line of power flow transfer rapidly and accurately be searched, to prevent cascading trip and large-scale blackout from providing technical support.In addition, this method also has the advantages that amount of calculation is few, and search speed is fast, suitable for the analysis and Control of bulk power grid.

title_en: Cloud data center security management platform
abstract_en: The invention provides a cloud data center security management platform comprising a cloud, a piece of managed equipment, and a security management platform. The cloud and the managed equipment are connected by a wireless communication network, and the cloud and the security management platform are connected by the wireless communication network. The security management platform comprises a Linux operating system module, a backup and recovery module, an intelligent cloud mirror service module, and a fault-tolerant mechanism module. The cloud data center security management platform has the beneficial effect that the platform can realize safe and efficient cloud storage services, alleviate data storm and avoid attacks to servers and service interruption caused by hardware failure, and becomes a novel application mode for helping industries to achieve massive data storage, data security, disaster recovery and backup, realize green computing and promote energy saving and emission reduction.
assignees: TIANJIN XINYUN NETWORK TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: System for propagating messages for purposes of demand response
abstract_en: A system having a utility, a communications intermediary and demand response resources. The utility may be connected to the communications intermediary via a network. The demand response resources may be connected to the communications intermediary via another network. A single dispatch destined for the demand response resources may be sent to the communications intermediary. The dispatch may be disaggregated at the communications intermediary into a multitude of dispatches which may be dispersed to their respective destined demand response resources. The demand response resources may send telemetries to the communications intermediary that aggregates the telemetries into a single telemetry. The single telemetry may be sent to the utility.
assignees: HONEYWELL INT INC

title_en: Asynchronous remote data copying method and device
abstract_en: An asynchronous remote data copying method is executed separately in a production center and a disaster tolerance center; an application in a local production center host system sends out a plurality of write requests successively; following writing can be continued just after data are written into a production center storage system; the production center and the disaster tolerance center perform multiple data copying successively, namely, lag of multiple writing operations between two systems is allowed. The invention further provides a device of executing the method. The scheme provided is suitable for small network link bandwidth and high network propagation delay.
assignees: INSPUR BEIJING ELECT INF IND

title_en: Island detection method based on wavelet packet logarithmic energy entropy and genetic algorithm optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses an island detection method based on wavelet packet logarithmic energy entropy and genetic algorithm optimization. The island detection method based on wavelet packet logarithmic energy entropy and genetic algorithm optimization introduces the genetic algorithm to optimize a BP (back-propagation) neural network and introduces logarithmic energy entropy as the input signals for optimizing the BP neural network by the genetic algorithm. The method specifically comprises, firstly, collecting common coupling point voltage signals to perform appropriate wavelet decomposition to obtain wavelet packet coefficients in 8 frequency bands under three-dimensional scales; secondly, performing reconstruction and normalization to obtain logarithmic energy entropy; lastly, performing mode recognition on islanding phenomena and non-islanding phenomena through the BP neural network optimized by the genetic algorithm. The island detection method based on wavelet packet logarithmic energy entropy and genetic algorithm optimization overcomes the defect of non-detection zones existing during load matching of a traditional passive island detection method by optimizing the weight and the threshold of the BP neural network through the genetic algorithm, the BP neural network can obtain comprehensive search capability and avoid maloperation during sudden load change and grid voltage harmonic disturbance, and meanwhile, when the output power of an inverter is matched with or not matched with load, islands can still be detected rapidly and accurately.
assignees: UNIV HEFEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Wind power prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power prediction method. The method comprises the following steps: collecting sample data and processing; establishing a BP (Back Propagation) neural network model by using the processed sample data, and training the BP neural network model to obtain a final weight, a threshold value and a relative error sequence of a prediction value relative to a sample value; solving an initial prediction value of output power according to the weight and the threshold value after the training is completed; calculating a calculation relative error state corresponding to the initial prediction value of the output power by using a markov chain error correction model; combining the initial prediction value of the output power with the corresponding calculation relative error state to calculate corrected power. According to the method, the accuracy of wind power prediction is further improved, and an accurate wind power prediction value is provided for daily power generation scheduling and secure economic dispatch of a wind power generation power grid.
assignees: UNIV CHINA AGRICULTURAL

title_en: Method for predicting radio disturbance of electric transmission line by using improved BP (back propagation) neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for predicting radio disturbance of an electric transmission line by using an improved BP (back propagation) neural network. The method comprises the following steps of acquiring and preprocessing data parameters; establishing a BP neural network predicting model of the data parameters; performing optimal training on the BP neural network by using a genetic algorithm and a simulated annealing algorithm; and predicting radio disturbance of the electric transmission line by using the network. The method is high in prediction precision, high in convergence and high in stability; the problem that the BP neural network is caught in a local minimum point is solved; and the method has a great guiding significance on prediction of radio disturbance of the electric transmission line and research on reduction of radio disturbance.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: PH (potential of hydrogen) value predicting method of BP (back propagation) neutral network based on simulated annealing optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pH (potential of hydrogen) value predicting method of a BP (back propagation) neutral network based on a simulated annealing (SA) algorithm optimization. The pH value predicting method comprises the following steps: step one, selecting a sample according to a sample selecting strategy and inputting; step two, according to the BP theorem, determining the structure of the BP neutral network; step three, according to a network training strategy, applying the simulated annealing algorithm to optimize the BP network weight parameter; training the BP network by using the input sample, and determining the optimal weight and optimal hidden node number of the BP network; step four, according to the well trained BP neutral network, structuring a predicting model of the pH value. The pH value predicting method overcomes the randomness of the BP network in terms of weight selection, improves the rate of convergence and study ability of the BP neutral network. Besides, the method optimizes the selection of the training sample and the network hidden neutral element number, and improves the generalization ability of the BP neutral network. Moreover, the pH value predicting method is high in predicting accuracy of pH value and good in nonlinear fitting ability.
assignees: UNIV JIANGNAN

title_en: Power system short-term load prediction method based on IEEMD-BPNN (improved ensemble empirical mode decomposition-back propagation neutral network)
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system load prediction, and particularly relates to a power system short-term load prediction method based on an IEEMD-BPNN (improved ensemble empirical mode decomposition-back propagation neutral network). The power system short-term load prediction method includes: step 1, using IEEMD to decompose non-steady-state and nonlinear historical power load data to acquire a series of stable intrinsic mode function (IMF) components and a tendency allowance; step 2, removing first-order IMF components (IMF1) acquired in step 1; step 3, using a BPNN to predict IMF components and tendency allowances, at each order, acquired in step 1 and step 2 respectively; step 4, using the BPNN for nonlinear combining of the IMF components and the tendency allowances, at each order, acquired in step 3 to acquire a final power load prediction result.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: The classification method and device of electric business client
abstract_en: The invention discloses the classification methods and device of a kind of electric business client.The items list of commodity is bought as the cum rights network on side using client by vertex, the client this method comprises: establishing according to order data, wherein the items list includes the title and price of commodity；Cum rights label propagation algorithm is executed to the cum rights network, obtains multiple customer groups, and label is defined to each customer group；Each client vertex in the multiple customer group is traversed, according to the label on all neighbours vertex on each client vertex and the multi-tag classification results of each client of weight calculation.The present invention can generate multiple labels to same client, so that more comprehensively and accurately to the description of client, achieving the effect that carry out Accurate classification to client, maintaining efficient in runing time, can apply on more massive data set.

title_en: Power grid risk prevention and control system based on cascading failure sequence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid risk prevention and control system based on a cascading failure sequence. The power grid risk prevention and control system comprises a comprehensive importance unit, an accident severity unit and an accident risk assessment unit. The comprehensive importance unit is used for establishing the comprehensive importance factor of each element according to the structure importance factors and the state sensitivity factors of the elements in a power grid; the accident severity unit is used for carrying out processing according to the comprehensive importance factor, obtained by the comprehensive importance unit, of each element, the severity factor of the power grid running state and the severity factors of the load loss and then obtaining the comprehensive severity factor after a power grid accident. The accident risk assessment unit is used for conducting calculating according to the comprehensive severity factor to obtain the accident risk assessment factor. The power grid risk prevention and control system can completely represent the importance of different elements in the power grid and is close to the power grid practice, a risk assessment result is more reliable and more accurate, and therefore the extra manpower and material resource loss is reduced.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCES RES INST OF STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Portable Collective Intelligent Routing Robots System for FireFighters and Network Formation Method Thereof
title_ko: 소방 방재용 투척형 군집지능 라우팅 로봇 시스템 및 그 네트워크 형성 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a throwing type collective intelligence routing robot system for extinguishing fire and a method for forming a network thereof. According to the present invention, the throwing type collective intelligence routing robot system expects a distance between robots and a propagation environment to provide an activity range capable of communicating to a firefighter using communication information between the collective intelligence routing robots in the environment where an infrastructure is collapsed. Moreover, the present invention automatically rearranges the thrown robot in accordance with a change in the propagation environment to form a stable communications network to monitor the status information of the firefighter.
abstract_ko: 발명은 소방 방재용 투척형 군집지능 라우팅 로봇 시스템 및 그 네트워크 형성 방법에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명에 따른 소방 방재용 투척형 군집지능 라우팅 로봇 시스템은 인프라가 무너진 환경에서 군집 지능 로봇 간의 통신 정보를 이용하여 로봇 간의 거리와 전파환경을 예측하여 소방관에게 통신 가능한 활동범위를 제공하고, 전파환경 변화에 따라 투척된 로봇의 자동 재배치로 안정적인 통신망을 구축하여 소방관의 상태 정보를 모니터링하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: KOREA ELECTRONICS TELECOMM

title_en: A kind of Model for Cascade Hydroelectric Stations management system towards transprovincially peak regulation demand
abstract_en: Towards a Model for Cascade Hydroelectric Stations management system for transprovincially peak regulation demand, be made up of load reconstructed module, conversion body module and output distribution display module three part.Wherein load reconstructed module is system input device, the workload demand comprised for each electrical network analyzes submodule and the power transmission amount proportion grading submodule two parts for each power station, by the workload demand analysis of each electrical network and the power transmission amount proportion grading in each power station, completion system load recombination function; Conversion body module is for belonging to switching device shifter, comprise distributing electric power submodule two parts between the interior output of power station distribution sub module of net and net to form, be connected with load reconstructed module by server, obtain the Back ground Information in each electrical network, each power station, and to complete in each electrical network net output of power station successively by the multiple stage computing machine included by module and distribute and distributing electric power function between the net of each power station; Output distribution display module is system output device, is connected with switching device shifter by client, realizes switching device shifter to the real-time control of output unit and renewal, completes the Presentation Function of output distribution process.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN TECH

title_en: System for rescue request during emergency and method therefor
title_ko: 위급상황 구조요청 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present invention relate to a system and a method for requesting rescue in emergency. In emergent abscondence such as child-missing, abduction, and kidnap, when an absconder has a confirmation medium having his/her personal information and physical information recorded therein, information identical to or matching with the personal information and physical information of the confirmation medium is transmitted through a communication network to people within a particular distance from the absconder, so people can recognize the absconder and help rescuing the absconder. The system according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a mobile electronic device for storing user information for authenticating a user, and transmitting a help request signal having an identification function to an external server though a communication network in emergency; and an emergency managing server for storing the user information of the mobile electronic device, detecting corresponding user information of a received help request signal when the help request signal is received from the mobile electronic device, generating help request information based on the detected user information, and transmitting the generated help request information through a communication network to an electronic device disposed within a predetermined radius from the mobile electronic device based on position information of the mobile electronic device.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예들은 미아 발생, 유괴, 납치 등에 기인한 위급한 실종 상황 발생 시 실종 당사자가 자신의 개인정보 및 신체정보를 기록한 확인 매체를 소유하고 있는 동시에 이러한 확인 매체의 개인정보 및 신체정보와 동일하거나 매칭되는 정보가 실종 당사자를 중심으로 소정 거리 내에 있는 사람들에게 통신망을 통해 전파되어 다수의 사람이 실종 상황을 인식하는 동시에 실종자의 구조에 도움을 줄 수 있게 하는 위급상황 구조요청 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 위급상황 구조요청 시스템은 사용자 본인의 확인을 위한 사용자 정보가 저장되며, 비상상황 발생 시 식별 기능이 있는 도움요청 신호를 통신망을 통해 외부의 서버에 전송하는 모바일 전자장치와, 상기 모바일 전자장치의 상기 사용자 정보가 저장되어 상기 모바일 전자장치로부터 도움요청 신호 수신 시 수신된 도움요청 신호의 해당 사용자 정보를 검출 후 검출된 사용자 정보를 기반으로 도움요청 정보를 생성하고 생성된 도움요청 정보를 상기 모바일 전자장치의 위치정보를 기준으로 상기 모바일 전자장치로부터 사전 설정된 반경 내에 위치한 전자장치에 통신망을 통해 전송하는 위급상황 관리서버를 포함하여 구성된다.
assignees: KWON HYUNG SEOK

title_en: Seismic Infrasound Analysis Method and Computer Program Media
title_ko: 음원 자동화 분석 방법 및 이를 수행하는 컴퓨터 프로그램을 가진 기록매체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic sound source analysis method, and more specifically, to a method for collecting sound sources such as earthquake vibration, atmospheric sound, underwater sound, etc. which are physical phenomena occurring in a threat force or other specific targets and activities in a computer network system to monitor, analyze, report, and disseminate an abnormal symptom related to the sound source, and a recording medium having a computer program performing the same. The present invention can collect the sound sources such as the earthquake vibration, the atmospheric sound, the underwater sound, etc. which are physical phenomena occurring in the threat force or the other specific targets and activities. The present invention can continuously monitor an abnormal symptom of the targets or activities of the threat force for twenty four hours. The present invention can collect information independently while having a high level security by using a method for analyzing, reporting, and disseminating the physical phenomena occurring in the threat force or the other specific targets and activities.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 음원을 자동으로 분석하는 방법에 관한 것으로, 보다 자세하게는 컴퓨터 네트워크 체계 안에서 위협 세력이나 기타 특정 표적과 활동 등에서 나타나는 물리적 현상인 지진동, 대기음향 및 수중음향 등의 음원을 수집하여 음원관련 이상 징후를 감시하고 분석하여 보고 및 전파하는 방법 및 이를 수행하는 컴퓨터 프로그램을 가진 기록매체에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 위협 세력이나 기타 특정 표적과 활동 등에서 나타나는 물리적 현상인 지진동, 대기음향 및 수중음향 등의 음원을 수집할 수 있다.

assignees: MINISTRY OF NAT DEFENSE

title_en: A kind of power network key branch road recognition methods based on coupling branch road betweenness
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of power network key branch road recognition methods based on coupling branch road betweenness, comprises the following steps：Establish side right connection matrix, Branch Power Flow weight matrix, node branch road interconnection vector and node reactance matrix；Disconnected branches L ij If grid disconnection, by branch road L ij It is included in the first crucial branch road subset；If the non-off-the-line of power network, by branch road L ij It is included in alternative collection；Coupling branch road betweenness is calculated, and branch road is ranked up, 0.5 branch road is more than for coupling branch road betweenness, is included in the second crucial branch road subset；Obtain power network key branch road collection.The present invention asks for shortest path using Floyd algorithms, and has asked for transmission direction, better than conventional method；It is comprehensive assessment index to couple branch road betweenness, has both considered the absolute size of active power, it is also contemplated that the relative value of power margin, and front and back stages failure is combined, acquired results more conform to power network actual conditions；Coupling branch road betweenness can fully reflect the critical impact of branch road in cascading failure landslide evolution process.

title_en: Cognitive scoring of asset risk based on predictive propagation of security-related events
abstract_en: A method (and system) of scoring asset risk includes determining, using a processor, a risk value for each entity of a plurality of entities within a network and ranking each risk value.
assignees: IBM

title_en: Power grid risk pre-control method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid risk pre-control method based on big data. The method comprises steps of 1, scrolling check of multiclass scheduling plan modes; 2, component outage model construction based on reliable data, real-time external factor data and equipment status data; 3, fault filtering based on topology analysis, failure influence domain and probability to automatically generate a real-time fault set; 4, static safety analysis based on multiple algorithms and consideration of cascading failures; and 5, load loss calculation method based on sensitivity. According to the invention, the component outage probability modeling is achieved based on real-time external environmental information, the fault set is automatically generated based on topology analysis and failure influence domain, the static safety analysis based on consideration of cascading failures is achieved, potential risks of a power grid are quantified into load shedding amount, risk indexes are calculated, and a powerful tool for analyzing current power grid risks is provided to dispatchers.
assignees: HANGZHOU WR POWER TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Method for analyzing reliability of transformer based on service year and load level
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a method for analyzing reliability of a transformer based on service year and load level, comprising the following steps: (1) determining load levels of transformers; (2) determining load values of the transformers in an original state; (3) obtaining hot-spot temperatures of the transformers; (4) obtaining insulation lives of the transformers according to the hot-spot temperatures of the transformers; (5) obtaining a failure probability cumulative distribution function of the transformers; (6) obtaining an average failure rate index of the transformers in the original state and an average failure rate index of the transformers in a failure state; (7) obtaining a cascading failure starting probability index Pic and a cascading failure weak link indicatrix Pvc, and identifying the transformers in a critical state in a system by sorting of the Pic and the Pvc. The method provided by the present invention improves accuracy of analysis for the reliability of the transformers in the case of cascading failure by combining influences of self structures, functions, service years of the transformers and a coupling relation between the transformers in a regional power grid on equipment reliability.
assignees: CENTRAL CHINA GRID CO LTD;UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH

title_en: A kind of modularization energy-storage system evolution analysis method based on Complex Networks Theory
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of modularization energy-storage system evolution analysis method based on Complex Networks Theory, object in modularization energy-storage system is abstracted as the node in modularization energy-storage system network model, interaction in modularization energy-storage system between object is abstracted as the company side between network node, using two subnetwork model building module energy-storage system network models, the physical significance of modularization energy-storage system network model is clear, is easy to engineering staff's operation and realizes；For under conditions of total monomer battery node quantity is constant, modularization energy-storage system has voltage responsive ability (cascaded structure), two kinds of current-responsive ability (parallel-connection structure) basic evolution modes, define Evolution Evaluation index, it can effectively find evolution of system structure rule, the reason of influencing modularization energy-storage system structure evolution and key factor are disclosed, targetedly to propose that modularization energy-storage system optimization design provides scientific basis.

title_en: A kind of power system weak link identification method based on cascading failure
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of power system weak link identification method based on cascading failure, cascading failure model is incorporated into the state analysis of risk assessment, consider and originate fault progression as the influence after cascading failure to power network, suit large-scale blackout dynamic, the chain rule of development, the weak link for influenceing large-scale blackout can be recognized by means of cascading failure process analysis procedure analysis, the element to be played a crucial role in large-scale blackout really is filtered out, the weak link result drawn is more comprehensively accurate, has more reference value；The maturation theory of the invention effectively inherited based on Monte Carlo Analogue Method risk assessment, without carrying out the derivation of complex relationship formula, without enumerating for failure is carried out, when especially system is larger, advantage of the invention will be apparent from.

title_en: Method for analyzing the influence of human factor on cascading failure of power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for analyzing the influence of a human factor on cascading failure of a power grid. The method comprises the following steps: 1) analyzing dispatching operation of a power grid dispatcher, and decomposing and obtaining the cognitive behavior according to the requirement of the current operation state of the power grid; 2) analyzing the failure mode included in the cognitive behavior; 3) solving the probability basic value HEP0 for occurrence of human failure; 4) analyzing the scene of task operation and determining the level of the behavior influence factor to obtain a failure probability correction factor; 5) solving the human failure probability under specific operation situation; and 6) taking the N-1 fault as the initial condition, performing reliability assessment for the system. The method for analyzing the influence of a human factor on cascading failure of a power grid improves the reliability in operating the power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;MAINTENANCE CO STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Sewage treatment based on self-organizing cascade neural network is discharged total phosphorus prediction technique
abstract_en: Sewage treatment water outlet total phosphorus prediction technique based on self-organizing cascade neural network had not only belonged to Control Science and Engineering field, but also belonged to Environmental Science and Engineering field.Aiming at the problem that sewage disposal process water outlet total phosphorus in current city is difficult to real-time online measuring, the present invention realizes the online real-time prediction of water outlet total phosphorus.This method devises the subtended network configuration of self-organizing growth form, the contribution rate calculation formula of variable, and the Weight Training method of differentiation improves the precision of prediction of municipal sewage treatment process water outlet total phosphorus by adjusting the structure and connection weight of cascade network of relation in real time.The experimental results showed that the intelligent Forecasting can accurately measure municipal sewage treatment process water outlet total phosphorus concentration in real time.Material to the relevant control link during municipal sewage treatment and in biochemical reaction is adjusted, and improves the effluent quality quality of sewage treatment, and sewage disposal process safety, even running is promoted to provide theory support and technical guarantee.

title_en: The apparatus of muti data between marine object and ocean floor object with network zone
title_ko: 해상가시광네트워크망을 통한 수중객체와 해상객체 간의 멀티데이터 송수신장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device for transceiving multi-data between an underwater object and a marine object through a marine visible light network. The device comprises: a control server (100) transmitting a multi-data signal toward an LED visible light module for a lighthouse; an LED visible light module (200) for a lighthouse transmitting a multi-data signal toward an LED visible light module for a marine ship and an LED visible light module for a buoy and receiving a response data signal about the transmission to transfer the response data signal to the control server; the LED visible light module (300) for a buoy located on one side of a buoy; and the LED visible light module (400) for a ship located on one side of a ship. Therefore, the device for transceiving multi-data performs near-field communication of a point-to-point (PTP) type by using LEDs under water.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에서는 종래 등대 및 부표가 단지, 불빛을 통한 항로표지의 역할만 할 뿐, 등대를 기준으로 이웃하는 부표, 선박, 그리고 수중객체(수중시설물, 침몰된 선박) 사이의 네트워크 연결이 어려워, 근해에 해상사고 발생시 재난구조 및 방재조치를 신속하게 처리할 수 없는 문제점과, 세월호와 같은 선박사고시, 침몰된 선박까지 접근한 수중다이버의 위치를 해상의 작업 통제실에서 정확히 파악할 수가 없고, 또 다른 수중사고 발생시 해당 사고에 대한 빠른 인지와 긴급한 구조 인원의 투입에 큰 어려움을 개선하고자, 제어서버(100), 등대용 LED 가시광모듈(200), 부표용 LED 가시광모듈(300), 선박용 LED 가시광모듈(400)로 구성됨으로서, 등대용 LED 가시광모듈을 기준으로 이웃하는 또 다른 부표용 LED 가시광모듈 또는 선박용 LED 가시광모듈과 해상가시광네트워크망을 형성시킬 수 있어, 원격지의 제어서버에서 보내는 멀티데이터신호를 가시광통신을 통해 해상객체와 수중객체로 실시간으로 전송시킬 수 있고, 이로 인해 해상사고 발생시 재난구조 및 방재조치를 신속하게 처리할 수 있으며, 수중객체의 위치와 수중상태를 해상의 작업 통제실에서 1:1 모니터링하면서 명령신호를 양방향데이터를 보낼 수 있고, 해상 및 수중에서 기본 조명과 데이터 통신을 동시에 수용시킬 수 있으며, 해상 및 수중에서 채널 전송 시 인접 주파수 대역 간섭이 기존 육상 환경에서 널리 사용되는 전파 통신 비교하여 상대적으로 적고, 수중에서 LED를 이용하여 빛을 집중시켜 Point-to-Point(PTP)방식의 근거리 통신을 할 수 있는 해상가시광네트워크망을 통한 수중객체와 해상객체 간의 멀티데이터 송수신장치 및 방법을 제공하는데 그 목적이 있다.
assignees: NAT UNIV SEOUL TECH CTENTER

title_en: Cascade hydropower station peak regulating method based on random continuous optimization strategy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade hydropower station peak regulating method based on a random continuous optimization strategy. The cascade hydropower station peak regulating method comprises the following steps: (1) generating an initial solution, selecting water levels in front of a dam from hydropower stations from upstream to downstream as discrete state quantities; taking a minimum power grid residual load mean square error as a target to carry out single reservoir peak regulating optimization calculation; (2) randomly and continuously carrying out optimized search step by step; and (3) updating iteration judgment: if reaching the tail of a time period, finishing a regulating process when a stopping condition of a successive optimization algorithm is reached, and outputting a final result, if the stopping condition of the successive optimization algorithm is not reached, setting a time period number to be a starting time period and turning into the step (2) to carry out the next time of iteration optimization, and if not reaching the tail of the time period, adding one to the time period number and turning into the step (2) to carry out two-phase regulation of the next time period. With the adoption of a constraint handling method provided by the invention, complicated cascade hydropower station coupling operation constraint of the cascade hydropower stations can be completely decoupled, and a constraint handling process of the algorithm is simplified; and a decision-making variable dimension is reduced, a reasonable optimization space is found and the method is suitable for solving a peak regulating problem of a large-scale cascade hydropower station group.
assignees: UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH

title_en: Probabilistic Model For Cyber Risk Forecasting
abstract_en: A system and method are presented for forecasting the risk of cyber-attacks on targeted networks. The described technology quantifies linear and non-linear damages to network-dependent assets by propagating probabilistic distributions of events in sequence and time in order to forecast damages over specified periods. Damage-forecasts are used to estimate probabilistically time-varying financial losses for cyber-attacks. The described technology incorporates quantities and dependencies for pricing insurance, re-insurance, and self-insurance, assessing cost-benefit tradeoffs for sequenced implementation of security control measures, and detecting attacks in the targeted network.
assignees: NEO PRIME LLC

title_en: A kind of cascading failure recognition sequence system and method
abstract_en: A kind of cascading failure recognition sequence system, including：Trend fault detection analysis module, weather conditions fault detection analysis module, circuit resultant fault probabilistic module, the trend fault detection analysis module are used to analyze the Line Flow probability of malfunction calculated under the influence of Line Flow；The weather conditions fault detection analysis module is used to analyze the weather conditions failure rate calculated under inside even from weather；The circuit resultant fault probabilistic module calculates circuit resultant fault probability for integrating the Line Flow probability of malfunction and the weather conditions failure rate.The cascading failure recognition sequence system of the present invention, considers internal time-varying operating status and outside environmental elements, it is proposed that a scheme for searching out failure path in power grid.

title_en: Big data-based electrical load prediction system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a big data-based electrical load prediction system. According to the system, a prediction is carried out on the electric load capacity of one place in the future by an error back-propagation neural network method; the error back-propagation neural network method comprises an input layer, a hidden layer and an output layer; a mathematic model of the error back-propagation neural network method can be established through a function relationship among the input layer, the hidden layer and the output layer; input layer information corresponds to historical data of the electric load capacity; output layer information corresponds to predicted data of the electric load capacity; and the hidden layer corresponds to the function relationship between the predicted data and the historical data. According to the big data-based electrical load prediction system, the prediction is carried out the electric load capacity in the future by the error back-propagation neural network method; and the mathematic model of the error back-propagation neural network method is established, so that the prediction result is relatively accurate; the error can be accurately calculated; and a great convenience is brought to life.
assignees: GUANGZHOU VINWO ELECTRONIC CO LTD

title_en: A kind of meteorological transmission line forest fire sprawling method for early warning of combination public network
abstract_en: A kind of meteorological transmission line forest fire sprawling method for early warning of combination public network, comprises the following steps：Obtain fiery point coordinates；Based on the fiery point coordinates, the rate of propagation that the fire point spreads direction is calculated；According to the rate of propagation, linear position of the fire point after spreading the time on sprawling direction is calculated, obtains spreading coordinate；According to the sprawling coordinate, the sprawling area that the fire is put is calculated；According to the sprawling time, warning grade definition is carried out to the transmission line of electricity in the sprawling area, and issue early warning.The present invention judges that power network mountain fire the condition of a disaster provides effective information support for power department；The present invention can calculate fire point and arrive transmission line forest fire rate of propagation, and according to mountain fire rate of propagation, passage time judges the warning grade of transmission line of electricity, has higher accuracy and practicality, is played an important role to safeguarding the safety and stability of power network and mitigating casualty loss.

title_en: Accident Prevention System And Method For Military
title_ko: 병영생활 안전사고 예방 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and method for preventing an accident in the barracks to notify an emergency occurring in the barrack life regarding an individual or a unit to a unit control room or to other units by coupling a signal generation device. The system includes: the signal generation device which is coupled to the identification tag worn by a soldier to generate an emergency signal notifying the dangerous situation of the soldier; a plurality of repeaters which are installed on the boundary of the barrack and the inside and outside of the barrack, and builds an independent communications network in order to sense and propagate the emergency signal from the signal generation device; and a situation propagation device which is installed in the control room to output the emergency signal of the signal generation device being transmitted through the communications network.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 군인의 인식표에 신호를 발생시킬 수 있는 신호 발생 장치를 결합하여 병영 생활 중 발생할 수 있는 개인별 혹은 부대별 위급 상황을 부대 상황실이나 타 부대에 전파할 수 있는 병영생활 안전사고 예방 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명의 실시 예에 따른 병영생활 안전사고 예방 시스템 및 방법은, 군인이 착용하는 인식표와 결합되어 착용 군인의 신상에 이상이 있음을 알리기 위한 비상 신호를 발생시키는 신호 발생기, 신호 발생기의 비상 신호를 감지 및 전파하기 위하여 영내 및 영내와 영외의 경계에 설치되어 자체 통신망을 구축하는 복수의 중계기, 통신망을 통해 전송되는 신호 발생기의 비상 신호 표출을 위해 상황실에 설치되는 상황 전파 장치를 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: SINSUNG TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of power distribution network isolated island division methods based on Pulse Coupled Neural Network
abstract_en: The present invention is a kind of power distribution network isolated island division methods for being based on Pulse Coupled Neural Network (PCNN), belongs to the power distribution network isolated island containing distributed generation resource and divides field.There is a problem of that division speed is slow, supply district is small when carrying out isolated island division for the power distribution network currently containing distributed generation resource, present invention introduces time delay Pulse Coupled Neural Network (DPCNN, Delay PCNN) model, it takes full advantage of PCNN and inherits the undamped characteristic with propagated in parallel of the pulse come, using each distributed generation resource as root neuron, it scans for simultaneously, greatly reduces the storage of ephemeral data, supply district is expanded while improving the speed of service.The isolated island that this algorithm partition comes out is for other algorithms, and faster, scheme is more accurate for the speed of division, in engineering closing to reality, with more operability.

title_en: Ultra short-term scheduling method for cascade hydropower station group sequencing based on indexes
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra short-term scheduling method for a cascade hydropower station group sequencing based on indexes. A day-ahead power generation schedule is brought into ultra short-term scheduling; an objective function is the minimum of the maximum value of relative deviation between a calculating water level at the end of the scheduling period and an ideal water level, and the requirements of safety, timeliness, practicability and economical efficiency of the ultra short-term scheduling are met. According to the technical scheme, the ultra short-term scheduling method comprises the following steps: predicating interval incoming water and utilizing an upstream and downstream flow time-lag relationship to predicate reservoir inflow; then, utilizing a mode of determining water with power to check tail water level, and carrying out water abandoning treatment; then, computing deviation between total output and load demand; selecting relative deviation between the calculating water level at the end of the scheduling period and the ideal water level as a quantitative index, and sequencing by utilizing the index to guide the power station to increase or reduce output until the load demand and the total output are balanced. The ultra short-term scheduling method has the beneficial effects of looking ahead of future development of a power grid and providing theoretical basis for establishing an ultra short-term scheduling system of the cascade hydropower station group.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN TECH;YUNNAN ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCH CONTROL CT

abstract_en: The invention provides an alternating current-direct current power grid cascading failure analysis method based on key power transmission section recognition, which comprises the following steps of: A. searching all power transmission sections between a direct current transmitting end and a receiving end by adopting a power transmission section traversal algorithm based on graph theory; from the direct current sending end node v S Starting from, forming a set S of nodes 0 ＝{v S Then search for S 0 All cut sets of branches between adjacent points and adopting gradually outward expansion of node set S 0 The traversal search is completed. B. Further identifying a key power transmission section which possibly causes a larger cascading failure risk by utilizing the power flow transfer coefficient and the section maximum overload rate index; C. and (4) giving out cascading failure sets with larger risks in each key power transmission section and key branches to be monitored in a key mode through transient stability calculation. By adopting the method, the key power transmission section and the key branch which are easy to have cascading failure after the direct-current monopole is locked can be effectively determined.
