title_en: Prisoner monitoring device using id information and patent information and the method thereof
title_ko: 아이디 정보와 환자 정보를 이용한 수용자 호출 관리 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for managing a prisoner call using ID information and patient information and a method thereof. Specifically, a guard who has a proper authority can confirm individual information and patient information of a prisoner through a monitor of a prisoner accommodating room in immediate response to a call signal by an emergency call button in a prisoner accommodating room by taking into consideration a special facility that is a correctional facility, in a room of a person in charge by day or in an all-source situation room at night. Therefore, it is possible to process a subsequent action for the prisoner by using an apparatus which classifies and stores each prisoner information, the patient information, and a guard patrol record in a database of a central server according to the time or place. In the apparatus for managing a prisoner call using ID information and patient information, which includes a prisoner monitor module unit connected to the central server via a network, the prisoner monitor module unit comprises: a monitor managing module which manages the monitor of the prisoner accommodating room; a guard ID managing module which manages individual information of the guard and determines whether the individual information of the guard matches with information of a short-range radio wave identification tag; a prisoner ID managing module in which, in a case where the short-range radio wave identification tag has the proper authority, a prisoner group ID number or a prisoner individual ID number is inputted and which controls the monitor managing module to display information corresponding to a group ID number or an individual ID number; and a patient information managing module which, in a case where the patient information of the prisoner accommodating room is present, controls the monitor managing module to display the patient information.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 아이디 정보와 환자 정보를 이용한 수용자 호출 관리 장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 교정시설이라는 특수시설을 감안하여 주간에는 담당근무자실 또는 야간에는 보안과 종합상황실에서 수용거실 내에서의 비상 호출 버튼에 의한 호출신호에 즉시 응답하여 정당한 권한을 가진 교도관이 수용자 수용거실의 모니터를 통해 수용자의 개인 정보 또는 환자 정보를 확인할 수 있으며, 각 수용자 정보와 환자 정보와 교도관의 순찰 기록을 중앙서버의 데이터베이스에 시간 또는 장소에 따라 구분하여 저장하는 장치를 이용하여, 수용자에 대한 차후 조치를 원활하게 처리할 수 있도록 활용할 수 있는 아이디 정보와 환자 정보를 이용한 수용자 호출 관리 장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 중앙서버와 네트워크 연결되는 수용자 감시 모듈부를 포함하는 아이디 정보와 환자 정보를 이용한 수용자 호출 관리 장치에 있어서, 상기 수용자 감시 모듈부는, 수용자 수용거실의 모니터를 관리하는 모니터 관리 모듈; 교도관의 개인 정보를 관리하여, 근거리 전파 식별 태그의 정보와 일치하는지 판별하는 교도관 ID 관리 모듈; 근거리 전파 식별 태그가 정당한 권한을 가진 경우, 수용자 단체 ID 넘버 또는 수용자 개인 ID 넘버를 입력하면 단체 ID 넘버 또는 개인 ID 넘버에 대응하는 정보를 모니터 관리 모듈을 통해 디스플레이하도록 제어하는 수용자 ID 관리 모듈; 상기 수용자 수용거실의 환자 정보가 존재하는 경우, 환자 정보를 모니터 관리 모듈을 통해 디스플레이하도록 제어하는 환자 정보 관리 모듈;을 포함한다.
assignees: YANG YOUNG HWAN

title_en: System for integrated management of reservoir
title_ko: 저수지 통합 관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a reservoir integrated management system and, more particularly, to a reservoir integrated management system to discriminate and determine a risk element in advance by monitoring the water level change, discharge flow, and collapse related information of a reservoir in real time, to rapidly inform an emergency situation through on-line or a mobile communication network, and to establish measures. The reservoir integrated management system according to the present invention comprises: a water level measuring unit to measure a water level; an overflow quantity measuring unit to measure water amounts which are flowing over a spillway of a bank of the reservoir; a reservoir managing unit to collect information measured by the water level measuring unit and the overflow quantity measuring unit and to transmit the information; a manager server to receive the information from the reservoir managing unit, to process the information, and to identify and transmit a reservoir state; a manager terminal to receive information related to the reservoir state transmitted from the manager server; and a warning broadcasting unit to broadcast the information by a signal received from the manager server.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 저수지 통합 관리 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 저수지의 수위변화, 방류량, 붕괴관련 정보를 실시간으로 모니터링하여 위험요소를 사전에 판별 및 판단할 수 있도록 함으로써 위급상황에 대하여는 온라인이나 이동통신망을 통하여 신속하게 전파하고 그에 대한 대책수립이 가능하도록 한 저수지 통합 관리 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 저수지 통합 관리 시스템은, 저수지 수위를 측정하기 위한 수위 측정기와, 저수지 둑의 여수로로 넘치는 물의 양을 측정하기 위한 여수량 측정기와, 상기 수위 측정기 및 여수량 측정기에 의해 측정된 정보를 수집하여 송신하기 위한 저수지 관리기와, 상기 저수지 관리기로부터 송신된 정보를 수신하여 해당 정보를 처리하여 저수지 상태를 파악하고 이를 송신하는 관리자 서버와, 상기 관리자 서버에 의해 송신된 저수지 상태와 관련된 정보를 수신하는 관리자 단말기와, 상기 관리자 서버로부터 수신된 신호에 따라 이를 방송하는 경고 방송기를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: ZIONTECHNICS CO LTD

title_en: Dryer exhaust systems for fiber
title_ko: 섬유용 건조기의 배기장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an exhaust device, capable of preventing fire while discharging moisture and exhaust gas in a fiber dryer (1). The device comprises: an exhaust part (10) connected to the upper part of the dryer (1), and including an exhaust duct (11) discharging exhaust gas and moisture from the inside to the outside; a blocking part (20) including a blocking panel (21) blocking chain diffusion and oxygen supply by fire while controlling emission in the exhaust part (10), and an actuator (25) connected with the blocking panel (21) to open and close; a fire extinguishing part (30) installed in the exhaust duct (11) and the dryer (1), and including a nozzle (35) to spray fire extinguishing substances by receiving a signal of a sensor (31) sensing the fire by ignition; and a control part electrically connected with the blocking part (20) of the exhaust part (10) and the fire extinguishing part (30), and controlling power of the dryer (1) while controlling the fire extinguishing part (30) and the blocking part (20) according to a set sequence. Therefore, the present invention is capable of increasing facility efficiency and making the external appearance beautiful by making exhaust smooth by installing a cylindrical exhaust duct in a zigzag form, and blocking chain diffusion and oxygen supply by fire while controlling the amount of discharge air with precise balance by using the actuator and the blocking panel.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 섬유용 건조기(1) 내의 배기가스 및 수분을 방출하면서 화재를 예방하는 배기하는 장치에 관련되며, 그 구성의 특징으로서 상기 건조기(1)의 상부에 연통되게 장착되고, 내부에 배기가스 및 수분을 외부로 방출하는 배기덕트(11)를 구비하는 배기부(10); 상기 배기부(10)의 내부에 방출량을 조절하면서 화재에 의한 산소 공급과 연쇄확산을 차단하는 차단판(21)을 구비하고, 상기 차단판(21)과 연결되어 개폐시키는 엑추에이터(25)를 구비하는 차단부(20); 상기 건조기(1)와 배기덕트(11)의 내부에 장착되고, 발화에 의한 화재를 감지하는 감지기(31)의 신호를 전달받아 소화물질을 분사하도록 노즐(35)을 구비하는 소화부(30); 및 상기 배기부(10)의 차단부(20), 소화부(30)와 전기적으로 연결되고, 설정된 시퀀스에 따라 차단부(20)와 소화부(30)를 제어하면서 건조기(1)의 전원을 단속하는 제어부;를 포함하여 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
이에 따라 본 발명은, 배기덕트를 원형의 통으로 양측을 지그재그 형식으로 장착하여 배기를 원활하게 해주어 설비효율을 높여주고 외관을 미려하게 함은 물론, 차단판과 엑추에이터를 이용해 배출에어의 양을 정밀한 밸런스로 조절하면서 화재에 의한 산소공급과 연쇄확산을 차단하는 효과가 있다.
assignees: SAMILL MECHANICS CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting emergency broadcast output controller
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire-fighting emergency broadcast output controller including a main circuit board, a network controller module, output control modules, a power module, an RJ45 interface, an audio input interface, an audio output interface, and a local power supply interface. The network controller module, the output control modules, and the power module are inserted into the corresponding slots of the circuit board, the RJ45 interface, the audio input interface, the audio output interface, and the local power supply interface are arranged on the rear panel and are connected with the main circuit board via cables, at most 12 output control modules are arranged, and the network controller module and the output control modules are connected. The output controller realizes the flexible switching and distribution of audio input, the audio input can be one to one and one to more, the equipment functions are diversified, the switching is flexible, the number of the audio output to broadcast areas is greatly increased, and multiple equipment can be cascaded and the number of the broadcast areas can be expanded by times. The fire-fighting emergency broadcast output controller has the advantages of convenient use and flexible layout.
assignees: TIANJIN BEIHAI COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power network mom|nitering system and method thereof
title_ko: 전력 망 모니터링 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: A power network monitoring system includes a master device which is installed at least one or more substations among a plurality of substations and a plurality of slave devices which are installed in the remaining substations except the substation in which the master device is installed. The master device analyzes data transmitted from each slave device, generates a command for operating the corresponding slave device based on an analysis result, and transmits the command to the corresponding slave. Accordingly, the present invention can previously prevent a cascading phenomenon due to a power outage and a fault accident.
abstract_ko: 전력 망 모니터링 시스템은, 다수의 변전소 중 적어도 하나 이상의 변전소에 설치된 마스터 장치와, 마스터 장치가 설치된 변전소를 제외한 나머지 변전소에 설치된 다수의 슬레이브 장치를 포함한다. 마스터 장치는 슬레이브 장치 각각으로부터 전송된 데이터를 분석하고 그 분석 결과를 바탕으로 해당 슬레이브 장치의 조치를 위한 명령을 생성하여 해당 슬레이브 장치로 전송한다.
assignees: LSIS CO LTD

title_en: Method for evaluating information physical security risks in power system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for evaluating information physical security risks in a power system. The method comprises the following steps: S1, randomly assuming that any one information cell in an information space fails due to a network attack; S2, according to connections between power cells and information cells, determining whether certain power cells fail; S3, if so, calculating a power system trend, and determining whether certain power cells exceed a limit at a next time point, and if not, waiting until simulation is carried out at the next time point; S4, according to state conversion rules between the power cells and the information cells, updating states of the information cells and the power cells at the next time point, and based on this, updating the system trend; and S5, counting the system scale of a power space. According to the invention, propagation of the information physical security risks between the power space and the information space can be displayed in a graphical manner and the information physical security risk level of the power system in the background of wide interaction between the power system and an information system can be evaluated.
assignees: STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: System Of Notifying And Requesting Emergency Rescue And Method Thereof
title_ko: 긴급구조 전파요청 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a system for spreading an emergency rescue request which includes: a transmitting device transmitting characteristic information of a user and an emergency rescue request in the event of an emergency situation; a user terminal receiving the emergency rescue request from the transmitting device through a near field communication network, and transmitting the emergency rescue request and the characteristic information to a registered terminal and a registered institution through a mobile communication network; and a neighboring terminal receiving the emergency rescue request and the characteristic information from the transmitting device through the near field communication network. Therefore, the present invention is capable of maximizing the efficiency of initial response.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 긴급상황 발생 시 긴급구조요청 및 사용자의 특성정보를 전송하는 발신장치와; 근거리무선통신망을 통하여 상기 발신장치로부터 상기 긴급구조요청을 전송 받고, 이동통신망을 통하여 상기 긴급구조요청 및 상기 특성정보를 등록단말 및 등록기관으로 전송하는 사용자단말과; 근거리무선통신망을 통하여 상기 발신장치로부터 상기 긴급구조요청 및 상기 특성정보를 전송 받는 주변단말을 포함하는 긴급구조 전파요청 시스템을 제공한다.
assignees: PARK JUN KYU;UTILLIGHTING CO LTD;CHANG SEI YUL

title_en: Method and device for determining electric larceny suspect user
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method and device for determining an electric larceny suspect user. The method comprises the following steps of 1, building an expert sample library according to the historical electricity use data of a user, wherein sample data included in the expert sample library includes historical electricity use data of the user and an electric larceny suspect coefficient; 2, optimizing a weight sequence of a BP (Back Propagation) neural network model by using a genetic algorithm, and obtaining the optimized BP neural network model; 3, training the BP neural network model by using the sample data included in the expert sample library; 4, analyzing the electricity use data to be analyzed of the user according to the trained BP neural network model, and determining the electric larceny suspect coefficient of the user according to the analysis result; and 5, determining the electric larceny suspect user according to the electric larceny suspect coefficient. The electric larceny suspect user can be efficiently, conveniently and fast recognized.
assignees: PNS (BEIJING) SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Master-slave ownership-based AGCF device disaster-tolerant backup method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a master-slave ownership-based AGCF device disaster-tolerant backup method and relates to the next-generation network (NGN) communication technology. According to the technical scheme of the invention, based on a master-slave ownership mechanism, the fixed network user of a conventional non-IMS domain can be accessed to an IMS network by two AGCF devices, wherein the two AGCF devices are responsible for mutual backup and load sharing. In this way, the system disaster-tolerant performance is effectively enhanced. Meanwhile, the service interruption duration due to the failure of AGCF devices is greatly shortened.
assignees: HEBEI FAREAST COMMUNICATION SYSTEM ENG CO LTD

title_en: Ship emergency situation alarm system and method using hull communication
title_ko: 선체 매질 통신을 이용한 선박 비상상황 알람 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a system and a method for providing a ship emergency situation alarm using hull communication which can quickly monitor various accidents. According to an aspect of the present invention, the system for providing a ship emergency situation alarm using hull communication comprises: a sensor-type safety helmet which is worn by a hull worker, and senses an emergency situation in a hull to output a signal; an emergency situation receiving unit to receive the signal outputted from the sensor-type safety helmet through the hull as a medium; and an emergency situation transmitting unit which is connected to the emergency situation receiving unit via a wired/wireless network, uses a signal transmitted from the emergency situation receiving unit to determine whether an emergency situation occurs, and distributes alarm information when an emergency situation occurs.
abstract_ko:
선체 매질 통신을 이용한 선박 비상상황 알람 시스템 및 방법에 관하여 개시한다.  
본 발명의 일 측면에 따르면, 선체 작업자가 착용하며 선체 내 비상상황을 감지하여 신호를 출력하는 센서형 안전모; 상기 센서형 안전모로부터 출력된 신호를 선체를 매질로 하여 전송 받는 비상상황 수신부; 및 상기 비상상황 수신부와 유무선 네트워크를 통해 연결되며, 상기 비상상황 수신부로부터 전송된 신호를 이용하여 비상상황 유무를 판단하고 비상상황 발생 시 알람 정보를 전파하는 비상상황 전파부를 포함하는 선체 매질 통신을 이용한 선박 비상상황 알람 시스템을 제공한다.
assignees: DAEWOO SHIPBUILDING & MARINE

title_en: Ship accident alarming system in an ocean
title_ko: 해양 사고 통보 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a marine accident reporting system capable of automatically reporting a marine accident of a vessel on a voyage to neighboring vessels, being suitable when an accident occurs in a small vessel around littoral sea, and easily finding neighboring vessels around the vessel on a voyage. According to the present invention, the marine accident reporting system includes: an accident vessel including a communication control part transmitting an accident signal of the vessel through mobile communication or satellite communication; a communication network delivering the accident signal transmitted through the mobile communication or satellite communication; a disaster situation reporting server transmitting an accident spread signal to neighboring vessels if an accident situation is determined by analyzing the accident signal delivered from the communication network; and a vessel position database storing communication method information and position coordinate information of the accident vessel and neighboring vessels.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 항해 중인 선박에 사고가 발생하면 자동으로 주변 선박에 통보할 수 있고, 연근해에서 조업하는 소형 선박의 사고 발생시에 적합하며, 항해 중인 사고 선박의 주변에 위치한 선박을 찾아내기가 용이한 해양 사고 통보 시스템을 제공한다. 
본 발명에 따른 해양 사고 통보 시스템은, 이동통신방식 또는 위성통신방식으로 선박의 사고신호를 전송할 수 있는 통신제어부를 포함하는 사고선박; 상기 이동통신방식 또는 위성통신방식으로 전송되는 사고신호를 전달할 수 있는 통신네트워크; 상기 통신네트워크로부터 전달되는 사고신호를 분석하여 사고 상황으로 결정되면, 주변선박으로 사고 전파 신호를 송출하는 재난 상황 고지 서버; 및 상기 사고선박과 주변선박의 위치좌표정보와, 통신방식정보를 저장하는 선박위치데이터베이스를 포함한다.
assignees: LKWAY CO LTD;CHEJU HALLA COLLEGE INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Integration control system using overlay multicasting and unicasting
title_ko: 오버레이 멀티캐스팅과 유니캐스팅을 기반으로 한 통합 보안관제 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is an integrated security control system capable of rapidly propagating and broadcasting a situation to each scene. The integrated security control system comprises: a plurality of monitoring cameras; a display device; an integrated control server consisting of an event detection module for providing the display device with event images, an input means for receiving control information, and a control module for transmitting the control information to the outside through a communication network in overlay multicasting and unicasting schemes; an agent server for transmitting the received control information to a child node selected by the integrated control server among the designated child nodes; and a base terminal for outputting the control information, which is provided from the agent server, in a sound. The system of the present invention can help members of a corresponding region in performing an initial response by checking the occurrence of events such as disasters, fires, traffic accidents, and crime accidents through the images selectively displayed on the display device in a comprehensive situation room and providing a customized control broadcast to each region in which the event has occurred.
abstract_ko: 각 현장에 신속한 상황전파 및 방송이 가능한 통합 보안관제 시스템이 개시된다.  이를 위하여 복수의 감시 카메라와, 디스플레이 장치와, 이벤트가 발생된 영상을 상기 디스플레이 장치로 제공하는 이벤트 감지모듈과 관제정보를 입력받는 입력수단과 상기 관제정보를 오버레이 멀티캐스팅 및 유니캐스팅 방식으로 통신 네트워크를 통해 외부로 전송하는 제어모듈로 구성된 통합관제서버와, 상기 관제정보를 수신받아 지정된 자식 노드 중 통합관제서버에 의해 선택된 자식 노드에 전송하는 에이전트 서버, 및 상기 에이전트 서버로부터 제공된 관제정보를 음향으로 출력하는 거점 단말기를 포함하는 통합 보안관제 시스템을 제공한다.  본 발명에 따르면, 재난재해, 화재, 교통사고, 방범사고 등의 이벤트 발생을 종합상황실에서 디스플레이 장치에 선택적으로 표시되는 영상을 통해 확인하고, 이벤트가 발생된 지역별로 맞춤형 관제방송을 제공함으로써, 해당 지역의 구성원으로 하여금 신속한 초기 대응을 수행할 수 있도록 도와준다.

title_en: Multi-function monitoring and tracking system for crime and fire
title_ko: 다기능 범죄·화재감시 추적 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a multi-function monitoring and tracking system for crime and fire. The multi-function monitoring and tracking system includes: a visible light camera module rotating 360 degrees, and with an optic angle lens attached thereto; a camera including the visible light camera module with the optic angle attached thereto and an infrared light camera module; a support unit installed in an upper area of the camera; an anemometer or weather information obtainment module obtaining a wind speed of an area where the camera is installed; an illuminance sensor measuring illuminance of the area where the camera is installed; multiple microphones installed in the camera; and a monitoring and tracking module having a combustion product detection module and an image comparison module, thereby reliably monitoring and tracking a forest fire and a body.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 다기능 범죄·화재감시 추적 시스템에 대한 것으로서, 특히, 산불을 감시하고 추적하는 기능과 인체를 감시하고 추적하는 기능을 모듈화하여 기능의 업그레이드와 유지 및 보수가 용이한 다기능 범죄·화재감시 추적 시스템을 제공할 수 있다. 본 발명은 360도로 회전하며 틸트되는 카메라를 구비하여 전방향에 대해서 화재와 범죄를 감시할 수 있으며, 감시 추적 모듈을 모듈화하여 기능의 업그레이드와 유지 및 보수가 용이하다. 또한, 본 발명은 차분 영상으로 연기와 불꽃 등을 감지하여 화재의 발생을 정확하게 판단할 수 있다. 또한, 본 발명은 조도 센서를 구비하고 조도 센서에서 획득된 조도를 임계값으로 고정 이진화를 수행하여 영상에서 하늘 영역을 특정하고, 하늘 영역에서 구름 영역을 삭제한 후 연기를 감지하여 연기를 더욱 정확하게 감지할 수 있다. 또한, 본 발명은 풍속계 또는 기상 정보에서 풍속 정보를 획득하고 이를 기반으로 차분 영상 사이의 프레임 간격을 유동적으로 설정하여 바람의 세기에 관계없이 연기 등을 감지하여 화재의 발생을 정확하게 판단할 수 있다. 또한, 본 발명은 화재 발생 위치와 예상되는 진행 경로를 예측하고 이를 지도에 표시하여 제공함으로써 화재 진화를 효과적으로 수행할 수 있다. 또한, 본 발명은 화재 발생 조건에 따라 코드를 부여하고 상황을 전파하여 관리자가 화재 발생 상황을 쉽게 판단할 수 있다. 또한, 본 발명은 범죄 감시 및 추적 시 영상에서 인체를 감지하고 해당 인체를 추적한 후 인체가 범죄를 행할 것으로 예측되면 탐조등이 인체를 추적하도록 광을 조사하여 범죄 예방 효과를 증가시킬 수 있다. 또한, 인체가 범죄를 행할 것으로 예측되는 행동을 중지하지 않을 경우, 탐조등의 광량을 증가시고 경고 방송을 하여 범죄 예방 효과를 더욱 증가시킬 수 있다. 더욱이, 본 발명은 근접한 감시 추적 모듈을 네트워크로 연계하여 탐지된 인체를 근접한 감시 추적 모듈끼리 연계하여 추적하고, 범죄를 행할 것으로 예측되면 탐조등을 비추되, 근접한 감시 추적 모듈간에 탐조등을 연계하여 비춤으로써 탐조등으로 범죄 가능성이 있는 인체를 추적하여 범죄 예방 효과를 극대화할 수 있다. 또한, 본 발명은 영상에서 인체 탐지 시 차분 영상을 이용하되, 인체의 각 부위별로 특징을 고려하여 별도로 경계를 설정함으로써, 인체의 범죄 행동 여부를 쉽게 판별할 수 있으며, 인체의 일부분만 탐지되거나 직립 보행중이 아니더라도 쉽게 인체를 판별하고 범죄 행뎡 여부를 판별할 수 있으며 추적할 수 있다.

title_en: Photovoltaic generating system confidence capacity evaluating method
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of photovoltaic generating system confidence capacity evaluating method, four factors including proposing influence photovoltaic generating system confidence capacity: the timing dependence that photovoltaic permeability, data sampling time interval, photovoltaic-load power output fluctuation and photovoltaic are contributed with load fluctuation；Using sequential Monte Carlo simulation calculation Power System Reliability, confidence capacity is solved by Secant Method；Establish three layers of error backward propagation method between four factors and confidence capacity；Utilize the inputoutput data collection training neural network obtained under different irradiation modes；The generalization ability for the neural network completed using training obtains the photovoltaic generating system confidence capacity under specified criteria；Photovoltaic generating system confidence capacity evaluating method proposed by the present invention can be used for the planning and designing of the generating and transmitting system containing photovoltaic, and no longer need to individually carry out sequential Monte Carlo emulation to each specific photovoltaic generating system, solve the problems, such as that versatility is not strong in the prior art.

title_en: Daily electricity consumption prediction method based on artificial neural network
abstract_en: A daily electricity consumption prediction method based on an artificial neural network belongs to the power supply technology field. A topology structure of a neural network model comprises an input layer, a hidden layer and an output layer, and the learning rules of the neural network model are that: a parallel distribution processing model of an error back propagation algorithm is adopted, a steepest descent method is used, and the weight and the threshold value of the network are adjusted continuously by the back propagation, so that the error sum of squares of the network is minimum. By the training sample learning, a prediction model can be established automatically and is hidden inside the artificial neural network, by using the electricity consumption prediction method in a short-term load predication, a time sequence model can be supplemented beneficially. The daily electricity consumption prediction method based on the artificial neural network can be widely used in the load predication and load management field of an electric power system.

title_en: Disaster response method that is based on the machine to machine
title_ko: 사물지능통신을 기반으로 하는 재난대응방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster response method based on machine to machine. The disaster response method includes the following steps: (S100) collecting surrounding situation information for disaster prevention by regional groups; (S110) analyzing and checking the collected surrounding situation information for disaster prevention by regional groups; (S120) setting an accident danger circle (r1); (S130) generating a danger propagation evasion-based shortest path (MR); and (S140) displaying the danger propagation evasion-based shortest path (MR) and transmitting the same to a terminal for an affiliated person, thereby minimizing the loss of life even after the occurrence of a calamity accident.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 유해화학가스 확산, 원유유출, 플랜트폭발, 방사능누출사고 등의 다양한 인재사고의 확산으로 인한 피해범위의 광역화와 누적적 장기화로 인한 불특정 다수의 주민과 생물환경에 심대한 영향을 주는 인적재난에 대해, 빅데이터를 기반으로 사고상황 발생 전부터 지속적으로 체크함으로써, 고확산, 고위험이 수반되는 유해화학물질의 관리를 체계적으로 수립 및 해당 지역 주민들에게 안내하여 사고발생 전부터 해당 지역 주민들에게 신속하게 대응 및 대처할 수 있게 안내하여 야기될 수 있는 위험성을 극소화시킴과 더불어 실제로 재난사고가 발생한 상태에서 지역 소속자들이 그 재난사고가 발생된 지역을 인지하고, 그 재난사고가 전파되는 지역을 회피하면서 안전한 지역까지 최단경로로 이동하게 안내하여 줌으로써, 재난사고 발생후에도 인명피해를 최소화시켜주는 사물지능통신을 기반으로 하는 재난대응방법에 관한 것으로, 재난대응서버(300)에서 사물지능 방재센서부(100)로부터 생성되는 산업시설 주변지역의 상황을 감지한 정보인 지역별 방재용 주변상황정보를 수집하는 단계(S100)와; 상기 재난대응서버(300)에서 재난분석엔진(320)을 운영하여, 상기 수집된 지역별 방재용 주변상황정보를 분석하고, 그 분석된 값이 이상 없음, 사고발생 예측상황감지 및 사고발생 감지 중 어느 것인지 확인하는 단계(S110)와; 상기 수집된 지역별 방재용 주변상황정보의 분석된 값이 사고발생 감지인 경우 상기 재난대응서버(300)에서 재난사고대응 안전이동경로 생성엔진(330)을 운영하여, 그 사고가 감지된 방재용 주변상황정보를 전송한 해당 사물지능 방재센서부(100)를 인지하며, 산업시설 주변지역 소속자용 단말(200)들로부터 산업시설 주변지역 소속자 위치좌표정보들을 전송받고, 산업시설 주변지역 사물지능 방재센서 위치 안내용 지도 목록정보 DB(316)에서 산업시설 주변지역 사물지능 방재센서 위치 안내용 지도정보를 추출하여 그 추출된 산업시설 주변지역 사물지능 방재센서 위치 안내용 지도정보 상에 상기 사고가 감지된 방재용 주변상황정보를 전송한 해당 사물지능 방재센서부(100)를 중심으로 사고위험반경(r1)을 설정하는 단계(S120)와; 상기 재난대응서버(300)의 재난사고대응 안전이동경로 생성엔진(330)에서, 상기 추출된 산업시설 주변지역 사물지능 방재센서 위치 안내용 지도정보 상에 상기 사고가 감지된 방재용 주변상황정보를 전송한 해당 사물지능 방재센서부(100)로부터 안전한 지역을 나타내는 안전지역(SZ)을 선정한 후 상기 전송된 산업시설 주변지역 소속자 위치좌표정보들을 참조하여 상기 추출된 산업시설 주변지역 사물지능 방재센서 위치 안내용 지도정보 상의 사고위험반경(r1)의 외(外)에 위치하는 소속자들을 인지하며, 그 인지된 해당 소속자들의 위치에서 상기 안전지역(SZ)까지 최단으로 이동하는 경로인 위험전파 회피기반 최단경로(MR)를 생성하는 단계(S130)와; 상기 재난대응서버(300)의 재난사고대응 안전이동경로 생성엔진(330)에서, 상기 추출된 산업시설 주변지역 사물지능 방재센서 위치 안내용 지도정보 상에 상기 검색된 위험전파 회피기반 최단경로(MR)를 표시하고 이를, 상기 사고위험반경(r1)의 외(外)에 위치하는 소속자들의 산업시설 주변지역 소속자용 단말(200)들로 전송하는 단계(S140);를 포함하되, 상기 위험전파 회피기반 최단경로(MR)의 생성은, 상기 재난대응서버(300)의 재난사고대응 안전이동경로 생성엔진(330)에서, 상기 산업시설 주변지역 사물지능 방재센서 위치 안내용 지도정보 상의 사고위험반경(r1)의 외(外)에 위치하는 상기 산업시설 주변지역 소속자용 단말(200)을 소유한 소속자 위치인 산업시설 주변지역 소속자 위치좌표에서 안전지역(SZ)까지 이동가능한 경로를 모두 검색하는 단계(S1301)와; 상기 재난대응서버(300)의 재난사고대응 안전이동경로 생성엔진(330)에서, 상기 검색된 모든 이동경로 중 제일 짧은 이동거리를 갖는 이동경로를 선택하는 단계(S1302)와; 상기 재난대응서버(300)의 재난사고대응 안전이동경로 생성엔진(330)에서, 상기 선택된 이동경로 중 해당 소속자 산업시설 주변지역 소속자용 단말(200)의 산업시설 주변지역 소속자 위치좌표에서 상기 선택된 이동경로를 따라 안전하게 이동 가능한 거리를 확인하기 위한 안전이동거리(SD)를 상기 선택된 이동경로에 기설정된 간격으로 분할표시하는 단계(S1303)와; title_en: Cascading failure risk recognition method for power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascading failure risk recognition method for a power system, and the method gives comprehensive consideration to the internal operation condition of a power grid and the external natural disaster early warning information, carries out the overall planning of internal and external factors of the power grid, and reflects the actual working condition of the power grid more truly. A mathematic method employed in the system is the theory of credibility measurement, depicts the internal and external complex nondeterminacy of the power grid, calculates the cascading failure risk measure through combining a comprehensive severity index, and enables a risk recognition sequence to much closer to the reality. Therefore, the system achieves the early warning of the cascading failure risks more precisely.

title_en: System for providing observation data for marine environment
title_ko: 해양환경 관측자료 제공시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for providing observation data of the marine environment. The collects data from various institutions, monitors and analyzes the environment on the basis of the data, and provides a forecast and a warning through an information prediction, and more efficient, accurate and specialized marine environmental information. The system comprises: a network group having an environmental information server which senses the marine environmental information on a specific area, according to a predetermined period or in response to a request from a monitoring server, and stores the same; a communication system which is dually built with the internet and the telephone network on the basis of wired (RS485 module) and wireless (DASH7 module) communications; a marine environmental collection system which builds a marine environment database through a data collection unit which receives marine environmental data from the environmental information server of the network group via the communication system; a prediction/analysis system which predicts marine disasters and analyzes the marine environment by using the collected data through the marine environmental collection system; and condition propagation system which propagates the predicted and analyzed marine disaster condition via the communication system.

title_en: Floor drain structure of apartment building
title_ko: 공동주택용 바닥 배수시설
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a floor drain structure of an apartment to process water on the floor of an apartment (parking lot, rooftop, etc.) by maximizing water containing capacity and preventing flooding of the floor of an apartment by rapidly draining out water by changing a drain in accordance with an amount of water. A floor drain structure of an apartment according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a drain duct (10) having left and right vertical units, a partitioning wall in the center, an upper layer drainage path (11) and a lower layer drainage path (12) separated by the partitioning wall and a bottom unit on the bottom and a through hole formed in the partitioning wall to connect the upper layer drainage path to the lower layer drainage path; a drain unit connected to at least one between the upper layer drainage path and lower layer drainage path to drain out waste water collected to the upper layer drainage path and lower layer drainage path to a sewage system; and a grating (20) coupled to an upper part of the drain duct to be able to be separated. The drain duct comprises: a plurality of duct bodies (130) including an ′H′-shaped cross section by the left and right vertical units and partitioning wall in the center and serially connected one another; a bottom plate (14) coupled to the bottom unit of the duct bodies to form the lower layer drainage path; and a socket (15) including a bottom support unit formed in an opened manner upward to support the bottom plate at the bottom and left and right support units extended from both sides of the bottom support unit to block a leakage by covering the left and right vertical units of the duct bodies from the outside and connect the duct bodies.

title_en: Metallurgical gas integrated dynamic balance scheduling system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metallurgical gas integrated dynamic balance scheduling system and method, and belongs to the technical field of multiple gases balance scheduling control. Based on real-time state data and production plan data, and on the basis of a combined model of a K-Nearest Neighbor(KNN) algorithm model, a back-propagation neural network algorithm model, a RBF neural network learning algorithm model, prediction is conducted on gas production/consumption value, gas tank place value, and pipe network fluctuating value in a future time period, and corresponding prediction values are obtained, and in accordance with a gas balance scheduling expert database, dynamic balance scheduling on the gas is completed in combination with the aforementioned prediction values. The system and the method of the invention are advantaged in that on the basis of the completion of the gas balance scheduling, functions of online adding algorithm model are expanded, and functions of online correcting balance scheduling expert database is expanded, and in cases that stable and safe operation of a gas system, real-time correction of system defects are achieved, so that gas can be more reasonably utilized and usage efficiency of gas is provided.

title_en: System for integrated management of reservoir
title_ko: 저수지 통합 관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated management system for a reservoir and, more specifically, to an integrated management system for a reservoir which rapidly publicizes an emergency situation via online or a mobile communication network and enables the establishment of a plan about the emergency situation by identifying and determining a risk factor in advance as information related to change in water level, the water discharge amount, and collapse is monitored in real time. The integrated management system according to the present invention comprises: a water level measurement unit for measuring the water level of the reservoir; an overflow measurement unit for measuring the amount of water overflowing to a spillway of a reservoir bank; a reservoir management unit for collecting and transmitting information measured by the water level measurement unit and the overflow measurement unit; a manager server which receives information transmitted from the reservoir management unit and processes the received information to check a state of the reservoir and transmit thereof; a manager device which receives information related to the state of the reservoir transmitted by the manager server; and a warning broadcasting unit which broadcasts in accordance with a signal received from the manager server.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 저수지 통합 관리 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 저수지의 수위변화, 방류량, 붕괴관련 정보를 실시간으로 모니터링하여 위험요소를 사전에 판별 및 판단할 수 있도록 함으로써 위급상황에 대하여는 온라인이나 이동통신망을 통하여 신속하게 전파하고 그에 대한 대책수립이 가능하도록 한 저수지 통합 관리 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 저수지 통합 관리 시스템은, 저수지 수위를 측정하기 위한 수위 측정기와, 저수지 둑의 여수로로 넘치는 물의 양을 측정하기 위한 여수량 측정기와, 상기 수위 측정기 및 여수량 측정기에 의해 측정된 정보를 수집하여 송신하기 위한 저수지 관리기와, 상기 저수지 관리기로부터 송신된 정보를 수신하여 해당 정보를 처리하여 저수지 상태를 파악하고 이를 송신하는 관리자 서버와, 상기 관리자 서버에 의해 송신된 저수지 상태와 관련된 정보를 수신하는 관리자 단말기와, 상기 관리자 서버로부터 수신된 신호에 따라 이를 방송하는 경고 방송기를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: ZIONTECHNICS CO LTD

title_en: Pipe connecting device, and pipe construction method using same
title_ko: 배관 연결장치 및 이를 이용한 배관 시공방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a pipe connecting device embedded in and provided to a through-hole part, which penetrates a wall or a slab forming a part between the floors of a building, so as to connect and fix a penetration pipe passing through the through-hole part, and provides a pipe connecting device comprising: a sleeve body provided at the through-hole part, which is formed in a pipe shape, having a through-hole into which the penetration pipe is inserted, and having a foaming agent accommodation space formed to be expanded from one end portion thereof such that one side of the accommodation space is open; a foaming refractory filler accommodated in the foaming agent accommodation space; and a flange part coupled to the sleeve body so as to close the foaming agent accommodation space, wherein the sleeve body, the foaming refractory filler and the flange part are formed to be packaged. Therefore, the spreading of fire can be effectively blocked if a fire breaks out, both workability at a worksite and facility stability can be improved, and the standardization and modularization of products are enabled.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건물의 층간을 형성하는 슬래브 또는 벽체를 관통하는 관통구에 매립 설치되어, 상기 관통구를 관통하는 관통배관을 연결고정하기 위한 배관 연결장치로서, 상기 관통구에 설치되며, 관 형상으로 상기 관통배관이 내측으로 끼워지는 관통홀이 형성되고, 일측이 개방되도록 상기 일측 단부로부터 확장 형성되는 발포제 수용공간이 형성된 슬리브몸체, 상기 발포제 수용공간에 수용되는 발포내화충진제 및 상기 발포제 수용공간을 패쇄하도록 상기 슬리브몸체에 결합하는 플랜지부를 포함하고, 상기 슬리브몸체와 상기 발포내화충진제와 상기 플랜지부가 패키지화되어 형성되는 배관 연결장치를 제공한다. 따라서 화재 시 화염전파를 효과적으로 차단할 수 있으며, 현장에서의 작업성 향상은 물론 시설 안정성을 향상시킬 수 있고, 제품의 규격화 및 모듈화가 가능하도록 하는 효과가 있다.
assignees: HWANG HYE JA

title_en: Emergency situation transmitting system and method based on location of public facility
title_ko: 공공시설물 위치에 기반한 안전재난 정보전파 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a system for transmitting disaster information based on a location of a public facility. The system for transmitting disaster information based on a location of a public facility comprises: a control server to analyze a disaster when the disaster occurs to calculate a range influenced by the disaster, then set a disaster information transmission area based on address information of a smart grid facility including a utility pole, a collection device, a power meter, an AMI modem, and a power communication network or a smart city facility including a streetlight, a security light, and a CCTV pole, and transmit disaster information; a disaster information transfer network which comprises a wide area network including an optical communication network, a mobile communication network, a TRS network, and a dedicated disaster network or a local area network including a wireless LAN, binary CDMA, TVWS, RF communication, power line communication, and a wired LAN, and is a communication connection network for transmitting/receiving the disaster information to/from the control server; a disaster information transmission device which is attached to the smart grid facility or the smart city facility, and receives and transfers the disaster information based on location information of the smart grid facility or the smart city facility; a disaster information notification device to transmit the disaster information to the disaster information transmission device; and a disaster information display device to receive a disaster information transmission command from the disaster information transmission device or the disaster information notification device to display the disaster information transmission command.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 안전재난 발생 시 이를 분석하여 안전재난의 영향력이 미치는 범위를 계산한 후 전신주, 수집장치, 전력량계, AMI 모뎀, 전력 통신네트워크를 포함하는 스마트그리드시설물 또는 가로등, 보안등, CCTV주를 포함하는 스마트시티시설물의 주소 정보를 기반으로 안전재난 정보전파 영역을 설정하고, 안전재난 정보를 전송하는 관제서버; 광통신망, 이동통신망, TRS망, 재난전용망을 포함하는 광역망 또는 무선랜, 바이너리 CDMA, TVWS, RF 통신, 전력선통신, 유선랜을 포함하는 지역망을 포함하며 상기 관제서버와 안전재난 정보를 송수신하는 통신연결망인 안전재난정보전달망; 상기 스마트그리드시설물 또는 스마트시티시설물에 부착되며, 상기 스마트그리드시설물 또는 스마트시티시설물의 위치정보를 기반으로 안전재난 정보를 수신하여 전달하는 안전재난정보전파장치; 상기 안전재난정보전파장치로 안전재난 발생 정보를 전송하는 안전재난정보통지장치; 및 상기 안전재난정보전파장치 또는 안전재난정보통지장치로부터 안전재난 정보 전파명령을 입력받아 표시하는 안전재난정보표시장치를 포함하는 공공시설물 위치에 기반한 안전재난 정보전파 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: System for integrated management of reservoir having colalpse sensing function
title_ko: 붕괴 감지 기능을 갖는 저수지 통합 관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated management system for a reservoir with a collapse detecting function and, more specifically, to an integrated management system for a reservoir with a collapse detecting function, which enables a user to grasp a collapse state and a collapse possibility of a reservoir bank in an initial stage by installing a collapse detector on the reservoir bank to rapidly report an emergency situation online or via a mobile communication network and to establish countermeasures. According to the present invention, the integrated management system for a reservoir with the collapse detecting function includes: a water level measuring device for measuring a water level in the reservoir; an overflowing rate measuring device for measuring the amount of water overflowing to an overflow path of the reservoir bank; a reservoir management device for collecting and transferring information measured by the water level measuring device and the overflowing rate measuring device; a manager server receiving information transmitted from the reservoir management device and grasping the state of the reservoir by processing the information and transferring the graphed state of the reservoir; a manager terminal receiving information related to the state of the reservoir transmitted by the manager server; and a warning broadcasting device broadcasting in accordance with a signal received from the manager server. The integrated management system also includes the collapse detector for measuring change in a slope of the reservoir bank. The reservoir management device transfers the information on the change in the slope, which is received from the collapse detector, to the manager server, and the manager server determines the collapse state and the collapse possibility based on the received information on the change in the slope and transfers the information thereof to the manager terminal and the warning broadcasting device.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 붕괴 감지 기능을 갖는 저수지 통합 관리 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 저수지 둑에 붕괴 감지기가 구비되어 저수지 둑의 붕괴 가능성 및 붕괴 여부를 조기에 파악할 수 있도록 함으로써 위급상황에 대하여는 온라인이나 이동통신망을 통하여 신속하게 전파하고 그에 대한 대책수립이 가능하도록 한 붕괴 감지 기능을 갖는 저수지 통합 관리 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 붕괴 감지 기능을 갖는 저수지 통합 관리 시스템은, 저수지 수위를 측정하기 위한 수위 측정기와, 저수지 둑의 여수로로 넘치는 물의 양을 측정하기 위한 여수량 측정기와, 상기 수위 측정기 및 여수량 측정기에 의해 측정된 정보를 수집하여 송신하기 위한 저수지 관리기와, 상기 저수지 관리기로부터 송신된 정보를 수신하여 해당 정보를 처리하여 저수지 상태를 파악하고 이를 송신하는 관리자 서버와, 상기 관리자 서버에 의해 송신된 저수지 상태와 관련된 정보를 수신하는 관리자 단말기와, 상기 관리자 서버로부터 수신된 신호에 따라 이를 방송하는 경고 방송기를 포함하는 저수지 통합 관리 시스템에 있어서, 상기 저수지 둑 경사면의 변화를 측정하기 위한 붕괴 감지기가 더 구비되고, 상기 저수지 관리기는 상기 붕괴 감지기로부터 수신된 경사면 변화에 대한 정보를 상기 관리자 서버로 송신하고, 상기 관리자 서버는 수신된 경사면 변화에 대한 정보로부터 붕괴 가능성 및 붕괴 여부를 판단하여 이에 대한 정보를 관리자 단말기 및 경고 방송기로 송신하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: ZIONTECHNICS CO LTD

title_en: A kind of Distributed Power Flow controller site selecting method based on accident chain model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Distributed Power Flow controller site selecting method based on accident chain model, method is：It is not restrained with trend first or power-angle oscillation diverging is the end condition of fault chains, scan the whole network cascading failure fault chains.The multidimensional index system for characterizing each fault chains influence degree is resettled, including variation index, frequency shift (FS) index, trend equilibrium degree index and burden with power loss late index, quantitative assessment is carried out using influence of the Grey Comprehensive Evaluation method to each fault chains.Finally, the prediction index of comprehensive evaluation index and each link of fault chains is influenced with reference to fault chains, defines and calculates circuit importance index, Distributed Power Flow controller is completed according to index ranking results and recommends addressing.Grey Comprehensive Evaluation is introduced into the impact analysis of fault chains by the present invention, meets the few feature of power grid accident chain sample size, can provide reference for the preconsolidation stress addressing of Distributed Power Flow controller.

title_en: Fire Managing Method in Network, Intelligent Fire Extinguisher, and Managing Server Used Therein
title_ko: 지능형 소화 도구를 이용한 네트워크 상의 화재 관리 방법, 이에 사용되는 지능형 소화 도구 및 관리 서버
abstract_en: Disclosed are a fire management method on a network using an intelligent fire extinguisher, and an intelligent fire extinguisher and a management server used therein. The present invention comprises: a sensing unit using usage of the fire extinguisher by a user in a fire situation; and a communications unit transmitting a fire notice message in the case that the sensing unit senses the usage of the fire extinguisher. The present invention can provide fire situation propagation and escape information to people instantly in the case that the fire occurs. In addition, the present invention implements rapid fire situation propagation to a fire station and administrator under the control in the case that the fire occurs, thereby being capable of performing early fire suppression.
abstract_ko: 지능형 소화 도구를 이용한 네트워크 상의 화재 관리 방법, 이에 사용되는 지능형 소화 도구 및 관리 서버가 개시된다. 본 발명은, 화재 상황에서의 사용자에 의한 소화 도구의 사용을 감지하는 감지부, 및 감지부가 소화 도구의 사용을 감지하는 경우에 화재 알림 메시지를 송신하는 통신부를 구비한다. 본 발명에 따르면, 화재가 발생하는 경우 사람들에게 즉각적인 화재 상황 전파 및 대피 경로 정보를 제공할 수 있게 된다. 아울러, 본 발명에 따르면 화재가 발생하는 경우 관할 소방서 및 관리자 등에게 신속한 상황 전파가 이루어짐으로써, 조기 화재 진압이 가능하게 된다.
assignees: SEHWA HIGH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Jellyfish capture device
title_ko: 해파리 포획장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a jellyfish capturing device (1) with which jellyfish can be captured in quantity by means of a net. The present invention includes: a metallic inflow frame (3) configured to be coupled with an inlet of a front inflow portion (21) of a sack net (2) having the front inflow portion (21) open forward and a back storage portion (22) coupled with the back of a front inflow portion and having a back end configured to be closed; a front buoy (4) connected to a depth adjustment rope (7) adjusting the depth of the inflow frame (3) by being connected to an upper side of the inflow frame (3) and a ship (A) with both front sides of the inflow frame (3) being connected to the ship (A) by a traction rope (6); a back buoy (5) connected to a back end of the back storage portion (22) by a supporting rope (8); and a salvage rope (9) having both ends connected to a net hauler (B) of the ship (A) and surrounding a boundary portion (23) between the front inflow portion (21) and the back storage portion (22). According to the present invention, various species of jellyfish can be captured in quantity, and the boundary portion (23) is squeezed during salvage so that the jellyfish can be captured alive, jellyfish losses can be prevented, and the jellyfish can be provided with freshness as food. In addition, the present invention can forestall accidents, fishing losses, and industrial facility damage attributable to jellyfish, have positive economic effects, and have many other positive effects.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 해파리를 그물을 이용하여 대량으로 포획할 수 있도록 한 해파리 포획장치(1)를 제공하는 것으로서, 상기 본 발명은 전방으로 개방되게 형성된 전반유입부(21)와 전반유입구의 후방으로 결합되어 후단이 폐쇄되게 구성된 후반저장부(22)로 이루어진 자루그물(2)의 전반유입부(21) 입구에 결합 구성된 금속제 유입틀(3)이 구비되며, 유입틀(3)의 전면 양측이 견인로프(6)로 선박(A)과 연결 구성되면서 유입틀(3)의 상측과 선박(A)에 연결되어 유입틀(3)의 깊이를 조절하는 깊이조절로프(7)가 연결된 전방부표(4)가 구비되며, 후반저장부(22) 후단과 지지로프(8)로 연결 구성된 후방부표(5)가 구비되며, 전반유입부(21)와 후반저장부(22)의 경계부(23)를 둘러싸면서 선박(A)의 양망기(B)에 양단이 연결된 인양로프(9)가 구비된 것을 특징으로 하며, 이러한 본 발명에 의하면 각종 해파리를 대량으로 포획할 수 있으며, 인양 시 경계부(23)가 죄여 해파리의 유실을 방지하면서 산채로 포획하여 식용으로 사용할 시 신선도를 높일 수 있으며, 해파리에 의한 인명사고, 어업손실 및 산업시설의 손실 등을 근원적으로 해결할 수 있으며, 그밖에도 경제적으로 향상된 파급효과를 미치는 등 다수의 효과를 기대할 수 있는 것이다.
assignees: LEE SANG SOOL

title_en: Cascade hydropower station group long-term generating scheduling method based on bidding strategies
abstract_en: The invention provides a cascade hydropower station group long-term generating scheduling method based on bidding strategies. The cascade hydropower station group long-term generating scheduling method is characterized by solving the cascade hydropower station group scheduling problem in the market environment in three steps, step 1, for Price-Taker-based power generation enterprises, direct deduction from the demand is carried out according to the historical transaction proportion, for Price-Maker-based power generation enterprises, the power generation capacity is estimated by means of a largest power generation capacity model; step 2, the market electricity price and electric quantity relation and the hydropower operation cost and generating capacity relation are described by linear functions; and step 3, the maximum cascade total generating benefit is taken as the control target, the solution is carried out by means of a gradual optimization algorithm and discrete differential dynamic program mixed optimization algorithm to obtain the water level and output processes of the cascade hydropower stations. The invention realizes the combination of the bidding strategy in the market environment and the cascade hydropower station group dispatching process, and has important significance to the participation of the cascade hydropower station group of the other power grids of our country in the electric power market.
assignees: HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;UNIV DALIAN TECH

title_en: A kind of system and method transmitting information based on street lamp
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of system and methods transmitting information based on street lamp, the system for transmitting information based on street lamp includes at least a master control street lamp and at least a controlled street light, for the master control street lamp for receiving an information and exporting a signal to the controlled street light, the controlled street light issues described information according to the signal.Based on the street lamp as communal facility as communication media, the publication of information is realized by the transmission of signal between street lamp, widely distributed, quantity is more, expands while information plays range and improves the redundancy for propagating information.Further, due to information, information is propagated in a manner of optical signal, is accelerated spread speed, is reduced property loss caused by disaster.

title_en: A method of for excavating fragile node and route in electric power networks
abstract_en: A method of for excavating fragile node and route in electric power networks, it is characterized in that, comprehensively consider the topological property and electrical characteristic of electric power networks, the fragile node and route of power grid are excavated, comprising the following steps: establish power network model, establish network key degree index, calculate topological property criticality index and electrical characteristic criticality index, calculate comprehensive criticality index, the high fragile unit of output criticality, the high as fragile unit of the weakness numerical value.It is significant to the emergency prevention and control of cascading failure to excavate fragile unit in electric power networks so that the transmission process of electric power networks energy is quantified for the method for the present invention efficiency with higher, simple and convenient easy realization.

title_en: Hadoop framework-based short-term load prediction method for distributed BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Hadoop framework-based short-term load prediction method for a distributed BP (Back Propagation) neural network. The method specifically comprises the steps of obtaining an initial load data set; dividing the load data set into small data sets and storing the small data sets in data nodes of a distributed file system; initializing BP neural network parameters and uploading a parameter set into the distributed file system; training the BP neural network according to a current load sample, and obtaining correction values of a weight and a threshold of the BP neural network in the current data set; performing statistics on sum of weight and threshold parameters of all layers and between the layers of the network according to a key value of a key value pair; judging whether the convergence precision or the maximum iterative frequency is reached or not in a current iterative task, and if yes, establishing a distributed BP neural network model, or otherwise, performing correction of the weight and threshold parameters of the network; and inputting prediction day data and obtaining load power data of a prediction day. According to the method, the load prediction speed is increased and the requirements of load prediction precision are met.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: A kind of modeling method of millimeter wave FET
abstract_en: The present invention provides the modeling methods of millimeter wave FET a kind of, comprising steps of millimeter wave FET to be divided into the input electrode in passive structures area and the grid source-drain electrode in output electrode and active structure area；Active structure area is divided into several level-one subelements along grid width direction；Calculate input electrode S parameter, output electrode S parameter and several level-one subelement S parameters of multiport network；Level-one subelement is divided into the second level subelement with grid index mesh equal parts, calculates the intrinsic parameters of second level subelement；The intrinsic parameters of input electrode S parameter, output electrode S parameter, several level-one subelement S parameters and second level subelement based on multiport network, connect to obtain the model of millimeter wave FET in a manner of matrix cascade.By the above-mentioned means, the present invention can simulate the influence of row wave effect when millimeter-wave signal is propagated in FET electrode, model accuracy is higher, can be used for frequency extrapolation, performance of the prediction device in higher frequency.

title_en: Bulk power grid critical circuits recognition methods based on FP-growth algorithm
abstract_en: The present invention proposes a kind of bulk power grid critical circuits recognition methods based on FP-growth algorithm, it is characterized by comprising the active incidence relation matrix of route is obtained using DC power flow algorithm, line disconnection probabilistic model is established based on operation of power networks state, Line Flow constraint condition and the active incidence relation matrix of route；Monte Carlo simulation is carried out to cascading failure based on line disconnection probabilistic model, generates cascading failure collection；Based on FP-growth algorithm, frequent-item is carried out to cascading failure collection, determines critical circuits.Route effective power flow generation minority routes jumpy can be identified and are controlled within failure short time early stage using technical solution of the present invention, be of great significance to the safe and stable operation for inhibiting cascading failure guarantee electric system.

title_en: Orthotropic elasticity coefficient inversion method free of initial value dependence and angle dependence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an orthotropic elasticity coefficient inversion method free of initial value dependence and angle dependence. The method includes the steps that 1, the mathematic relation between the propagation wave velocity of ultrasonic waves in tissue in different directions and the medium elasticity coefficient; 2, a three-layer BP artificial neural network is established, and training is carried out; 3, in actual measurement, ultrasonic wave velocity information in the tissue is collected according to the BP artificial neural network input standard, and the elasticity coefficient of the biological tissue can be obtained through wave velocity inversion. According to the method, an orthotropic elasticity model is adopted to replace a traditional isotropic elasticity model to represent human tissue, so that the modeling accords with the truth of the human body better; by using the BP artificial neural network as a tool and adopting a special network input mode, the problems that an inversion iterative initial value must be considered in a traditional inversion method and the precision of the traditional inversion method is low are solved; it is not needed to provide the angle relation between the wave velocity and propagation direction of the ultrasonic waves and the elasticity coordinate system of the tissue in the method, and thus the method is more suitable for clinical detection.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: A kind of have meat, medicinal, the Gallus Domesticus breeding method of type at a slow speed of ornamental value
abstract_en: The invention discloses and a kind of there is meat, medicinal, the Gallus Domesticus breeding method of type at a slow speed of ornamental value, it is sheerly as breeding material with Donglan Gallus Domesticus pure lines, Gallus Domesticus of reaching the clouds pure lines and Wenchang Chicken Margarita plumage, through more than four locking selection-breeding from generation to generation, after Major Economic controls below 10%, by for generations, father and mother's generation and three grades of expanding propagation mechanism of commercial generation form a complete production network.The Gallus Domesticus of type at a slow speed of the present invention is compared with tradition Gallus Domesticus, overcome the defect that wild nature disaster is raised, father and mother improve more than 12% for egg laying performance, the commercial broiler flocks speed of growth improves more than 15%, survival rate improves more than 1.5%, feedstuff-meat ratio reduces by 0.1, has medicinal, meat and ornamental value, improves culture benefit.
assignees: LAIBIN XINCHENG COUNTY RUNHUA ANIMAL HUSBANDRY CO LTD;GE HONGWEI

title_en: A method of network system robustness is promoted by optimizing the switch state of link
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of method for improving network system robustness by optimizing the switch state of network link, this method designs suitable network protective strategy to cascading failure phenomenon from the angle of complex network.Initially set up the model that electrology characteristic and network topological information combine；Then inhibit the propagation of cascading failure using the Preservation tactics of cutting corresponding link; it is damaged to reduce cascading failure to power grid bring; and considers that the number for cutting off link in actual operation cannot be too big, convert multi-objective optimization question for power network link state control problem；The multi-objective optimization question finally is solved using non-dominated ranking binary system differential evolution algorithm, the switch state of each link of power grid is controlled according to optimal link scheme.The present invention takes excision properly to connect the network protective strategy on side by the electrology characteristic of consideration power grid, can improve the robustness of power grid in the case that even number of edges amount is few in excision, so that cascading failure be effectively reduced to the harm of power grid bring.

title_en: Gas sensor platform for real-time detection of various toxic chemicals and emergency alert system using thereof
title_ko: 다종 유해 화학물질의 실시간 감지를 위한 가스센서 플랫폼 및 이를 이용한 재난경보 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a gas sensor platform to detect harmful chemical materials in the air. According to the present invention, a problem of gas detectors for an existing technology which is difficult to construct a social safety network to prepare the exposure of the harmful chemical material with a high price is solved without a connecting function through a network capable of detecting the restricted specific chemical material. Provided are a gas sensor platform and a disaster warning system capable of monitoring and detecting various harmful materials in real time with a short analysis time and capable of rapidly spreading information in the occurrence of an accident by including a connecting function through a network, capable of effectively constructing the disaster warning system to prepare the exposure of the harmful chemical material with a cheap price, and capable of detecting the various harmful chemical materials in real time. The gas sensor platform comprises: a sensor array unit including a plurality of sensors to selectively detect various harmful gases; a pre-processing unit to more accurately detect the detection of the sensor array unit by concentrating the harmful gas inserted from the outside; an environment sensor unit to collect and provide information for an external environment including a temperature, a humidity, a wind direction, and a wind speed of an installation position in which the gas sensor platform is installed; a communication unit including a wireless communication module to communicate with the external apparatus; a display unit to display a detecting result of the sensor array unit and an operating state of the gas sensor platform; an input unit to input a setting for an operation or a control command; and a control unit to control the whole operation of the gas sensor platform.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 공기 중의 유해 화학물질을 검출하기 위한 가스센서 플랫폼에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따르면, 제한된 특정 화학물질의 검출만이 가능하고 네트워크를 통한 연동기능이 없으면서도 고가격으로 인해 유해 화학물질 누출에 대비한 사회 안전망을 구축하기 어려웠던 종래기술의 가스감지기들의 문제점을 해결하여, 짧은 분석시간을 가지고 다양한 유해물질에 대하여 실시간으로 검출 및 감시가 가능하며, 네트워크를 통한 연동기능을 구비하여 사고발생시 신속한 전파가 가능한 동시에, 저렴한 가격으로 구현 가능하여 유해 화학물질 누출에 대비한 재난경보 시스템을 효율적으로 구축할 수 있도록 구성되는 다종 유해 화학물질의 실시간 감지를 위한 가스센서 플랫폼 및 이를 이용한 재난경보 시스템이 제공된다.

title_en: Apparatus, system and method for managing asset of water treatment plant
title_ko: 정수처리장의 자산관리장치, 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, in order to manage properties of a water treatment plant, the present invention is capable of more accurately managing cycles and items for maintenance by water treatment device based on actual malfunction and driving records of each water treatment device, collected from a management device (SCADA) of a water treatment plant system, by being connected with the management device, and sensing and handling an abnormal change in device. Moreover, the present invention is capable of enabling well-timed maintenance by providing information about the cycles for maintenance to a worker terminal, and enabling more systematic budget management than the estimation of priorities about repair or replacement by calculating an importance degree considering an effect of repair or replacement, caused by the malfunction of a device, on the management of the water treatment plant system as a weighted value. The present invention includes: a communication part transceiving data with a management device or worker terminal through a communication network; and a property management device managing maintenance information about a reference maintenance cycle.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따르면, 정수처리장의 자산관리에 있어서, 정수처리장 시스템의 운영장치(SCADA)와 연계하여 운영장치로부터 수집되는 정수처리 관련장치별 실제 운전 이력과 고장 이력을 기반으로 자산관리장치에서 정수처리 관련장치별 정비 항목과 정비 주기를 보다 정확히 관리하고, 장치별 비정상적인 변화를 감지하여 대처할 수 있도록 한다. 또한, 장치별 정비 주기에 대한 정보를 작업자 단말로 제공하여 시기적절한 정비가 이루어지도록 하고, 장치의 고장으로 인한 수리 또는 교체 시 장치별 정수처리장 시스템 운영에 미치는 파급력을 가중치로 고려하여 중요도를 산출함으로써 수리 또는 교체의 우선순위를 추산할 때 보다 체계적인 예산 운영이 가능하도록 한다.

title_en: A kind of Multifunctional security equipment based on 4G network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Multifunctional security equipment based on 4G network, this equipment includes: double-core CPU, also including formaldehyde sensor, Temperature Humidity Sensor, Infrared Remote-Control Sending diode, gas security, cigarette propagated sensation sensor, power management module, photoconductive resistance, battery, mike, voice recognition unit, loudspeaker, communication module, photographic head, WIFI module, above-mentioned modules is all connected with double-core CPU；This advantage is: realize the multiple household safety-protection sensors such as photographic head and cigarette sense, combustion gas, humiture, formaldehyde are concentrated one, one equipment just can solve the problems such as fire prevention, antitheft, gas leakage preventing, video intercom, environmental monitoring, the intelligent domestic system of overturning over all uses distributed sensor, wiring to install complicated problem；And there is the network communications technology of WiFi and 4G, the APP connecting user mobile phone end sends warning message to owner, property, the fire department very first time quickly and easily.

title_en: Endowment apartment public administration epidemic prevention facility
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an endowment apartment public administration epidemic prevention facility. Including hanger plate and bactericidal lamp, the structure of hanger plate is the rectangular channel, opens the through -hole of installation bactericidal lamp all around, the inslot fixed surface of hanger plate has fluorescent lamp, smoke alarm and combustible gas alarm, does the surface of hanger plate is opened have 2  10cm's rectangle shallow slot, shallow slot fixed surface has switch and domestic earthquake warning ware. The utility model discloses to the insect pest epidemic prevention in the indoor place in the asylum for the aged, design a real -time sterile epidemic prevention facility, this facility adopts indoor hoist and mount lamp plate, is fixed with ultraviolet lamp side by side in the position that the lamp plate leaned on the wall all around, carries out the clearance to insect pests such as mosquitoes through ultraviolet lamp, avoids the propagation of disease, installs smoke alarm and combustible gas alarm and domestic earthquake warning ware moreover and protect indoor hazardous gas and natural disasters jointly on this facility.

title_en: Short-term wind speed calculation method based on hazardous chemical accident diffusion model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-term wind speed calculation method based on a hazardous chemical accident diffusion model. The short-term wind speed calculation method comprises the following steps of by combining an ABC (artificial bee colony) algorithm and a BP (back propagation) nerve network, optimizing the weight and threshold value of the BP nerve network by the ABC algorithm, accurately predicting the wind speed, and quickly and efficiently performing accurate evaluation on the influence degree and influence range of hazardous chemical leakage accidents in a chemical industrial park. Compared with a PSO-BP (particle swarm optimization-back propagation) nerve network and a GA-BP (genetic algorithm-back propagation) nerve network, the short-term wind speed calculation method has the advantages that the predicting accuracy is obviously improved, the high-efficiency predicting is realized, and the economic cost is reduced; the predicting accuracy on short-term wind speed is improved, and the error rate is only 1.82%; the site accidents can be effectively treated, the emergency rescue and high-efficiency population evacuation can be quickly performed, and the personal casualty and economic loss in the accidents are decreased.
assignees: SHANGHAI ZHONGWEITIANAN PUBLIC SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ultra-wideband gallium nitride device small-signal model and parameter extracting method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-wideband gallium nitride device small-signal model and a parameter extracting method thereof. Three interconnected capacitor and cascaded inductor network structure forms are adopted for the grating end, the source end and the drain end of the small-signal model respectively, and the small-signal model comprises 18 parasitic parameters and 10 intrinsic parameters; the parasitic parameters comprise outer layer parasitic capacitance Cpgi1, Cpdi1, Cgdi1 and others, parasitic inductance Lgi1, Ldi1, Lsi1 and others and parasitic resistance Rg, Rd and Rs; the intrinsic parameters comprise intrinsic capacitance Cgd, Cgs and Cds and intrinsic resistance Rgs, Rgd and Rds, wherein an intrinsic current source Ids is equal to Gm plus ta as parameters in ViGme-j omega ta. The model can accurately describe the characteristics of a high-frequency device, has wider application frequency band and can adapt to a W frequency band as the highest; by the utilization of the parameter extracting method, the model parameters can have good stability within the frequency range of 0.2-110 GHz.
assignees: XU YUEHANG;UNIV ELECTRONIC SCIENCE & TECH CHINA

title_en: Method and system for optimally dispatching cascade reservoirs on basis of quantum-behaved particle swarm algorithms
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for optimally dispatching cascade reservoirs on the basis of quantum-behaved particle swarm algorithms. The method includes acquiring initialized population according to established objective functions for solving problems for optimally dispatching the cascade reservoirs and utilizing the initialized population as parent-generation particles; constructing small-world networks to obtain adjacent matrixes; updating the parent-generation particles according to the adjacent matrixes and generating child-generation particles; computing the fitness of the child-generation particles according to fitness functions; comparing the fitness of the parent-generation particles to the fitness of the child-generation particles by the aid of competition operators, selecting the child-generation particles with the good fitness and utilizing the selected child-generation particles as parent-generation particles for next iteration; judging whether current iteration numbers are larger than the maximum thresholds or not; carrying out computation if the current iteration numbers are larger than the maximum thresholds and outputting cascade reservoir optimal dispatching computation results. The method and the system have the advantages that the quantum-behaved particle swarm algorithms are improved by small-world network models, so that the population diversity can be kept by improved algorithms, the shortcoming of easiness in trapping in local optimization of basic quantum-behaved particle swarm algorithms can be overcome, and effects of optimally dispatching the cascade reservoirs can be improved.
assignees: UNIV GUANGDONG TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Complete distributed charging scheduling management method based on mobile public transportation buses
abstract_en: The invention provides a complete distributed charging scheduling management method based on mobile public transportation buses. Charging stations and electric automobiles carry out information interaction through intermediate agents, the intermediate agents are public transportation buses, each charging station, as an information issuer, periodically issues its own charging service supply condition to the intermediate agents, the public transportation buses driving on lines realize issuing/subscribing aiming at information propagation through vehicle-to-vehicle communication, and the electric automobiles needing charging service obtain state information of all the charging stations in a network through accessing public transportation buses they accidentally meet so as to execute a decision about where they should go for charging. The method is characterized in that: 1, the intermediate agents are mobile, charging management information is obtained through reliance on the mobile lines of the intermediate agents, and thus the flexibility is high; 2, only a quite small number of mobile intermediate agents are needed so that the network configuration cost is quite low; and 3, a distributed charging management mode is employed, and thus the privacy susceptibility is quite low.
assignees: UNIV HARBIN ENG

title_en: Large power grid disturbance propagation characteristic evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a large power grid disturbance propagation characteristic evaluation method, which combines the characteristics of energy transmission evolution and the large power grid disturbance propagation characteristics of disturbance tracks to evaluate: firstly, dividing a disturbance propagation process after a fault into a transient energy injection stage, a transient energy conservation stage and a transient energy gradual attenuation stage according to the change characteristics of transient total energy after the fault; secondly, determining an evaluation object according to transient energy change characteristics of each stage; performing simulation calculation by adopting a time domain simulation method, performing simulation calculation by adopting the time domain simulation method, selecting related items of transient energy from simulation results of different stages, and defining the related items as observation indexes; judging the influence elements with disturbance, and generating an influence element set; thereby acquiring key factors affecting transient energy transmission; so as to realize the evaluation of the disturbance propagation characteristics of the large power grid.

title_en: Disaster response method that is based on the machine to machine
title_ko: 사물지능통신을 기반으로 하는 재난대응방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster response method based on machine-to-machine communication. The disaster response method based on machine-to-machine communication according to an embodiment of the present invention includes the steps of: collecting surrounding situation information (S100); analyzing and checking the collected surrounding situation information (S110); setting an accident risk radius (r1) around a corresponding machine intelligent disaster prevention sensor unit (100) to transmit the surrounding situation information sensing an accident (S120); generating a risk propagation avoidance-based minimum route (MR) (S130); displaying the risk propagation avoidance-based minimum route (MR) and transmitting the risk propagation avoidance-based minimum route (MR) to terminals (200) (S140); and controlling electronic valves of a harmful dangerous gas pipe (P) to be blocked (S150). Therefore, the present invention can minimize damage due to the explosion and leakage of a dangerous gas.

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a pressurized water nuclear reactor for nuclear waste disposal, and more particularly, to a pressurized water nuclear reactor for nuclear waste disposal of an ocean nuclear and hydroelectric power plant including a dual structure block tank collector of a dual structure egg type for the nuclear waste disposal or a dual structure block tank collector comprising nuclear waste disposal execution for continuously operating a nuclear power plant in the nuclear and hydroelectric water nuclear power plant. abstract_ko:
본 발명은 핵폐기물처리용 가압수형 원자로설비에 관한 것인데,더욱 상세하게는,원자력수력발전소에 핵폐기물처리를 위한 이중구조 계란형태의 이중구조블록탱크집진기 또는 이중 관 구조캡슐형태 다수개의 원자로설비에 구비되는 핵폐기물처리 차폐장치의 각개 부위를 연결하는 이중구조저장탱크와,핵연료폭발방지 제어용품의 냉각수와 황토혼합물 운송체인 어도터널 설치 및 강 하구와 해양에 침몰방지체류선에 건설기계를 구비해 소형,중형,대형의 해양원자력수력발전소의 부양식독을 강 하구와 해양에 투입하여 원전가동용 핵폐기물처리의 이중구조바지선인 부양식독 운반선들로 이중구조블록탱크 집진기 연결구조물의 운반을 마련하고,지속적인 원전가동을 위한 핵폐기물처리조절 수행을 구성하는 이중구조블록탱크집진기를 구비한 해양원자력수력발전소의 핵폐기물처리용 가압수형 원자로설비에 관한 것으로 
핵폐기물처리용 가압수형 원자로설비는 상기와 같은 상기한 문제점을 해결하기 위해 창안한 것으로,종래의 원자력발전소 원자로설비의 분배투입장치에 있어서, 
상기 종래의 원자력발전소의 원자로설비의 분배투입장치에는, 
보통 물을 사용하는 비등수형 원자로와 가압수형 원자로의 구조로 구성되어 있고,발전용 원자로는 주로 경수로가 많이 사용되고 있는데 비등수형 원자로에 가압수형 원자로를 갖춘 원자력발전소와 기체냉각로에 다목적 고온가스로와 신형전환로에 고속증식로 원자로설비를 갖춘 원자력발전소들이 육지와 도서 지역으로 연결되어 다수개의 원자력발전소의 원전가동 중에 자연 발생적인 태풍,지진, 해일, 산불, 황사와 화산 폭발 전후 시의 화산재 발생 등으로 인해 종래의 자연재해로부터 원자로설비들이 폭발하여 원전가동이 정지되는 사태를 종종 나타내고 있다. 
이와 같이 종래의 원자력 발전소의 원자로 설비의 분배투입장치에 있어서는,종래의 원전가동 중에,예컨대 도 105에 도시하는 바와 같이 자연재해 발생 전 후 시로부터 종래의 각개의 원자로 설비들은 서로 밀집되어 근접하는 경우로 연쇄적인 핵연료 폭발로 인해 핵발전소의 안전성에 지대한 영향을 미치는 경우가 있다.

원전가동 대체 발전전력 생산을 위한 풍력발전기와 화력발전기에 수력발전기를 침몰방지체류선에 건설기계들을 구비해 강 하구와 해양 등지에 해양원자력수력발전소를 연결 이동을 마련하고, 
원자력수력발전설비부에서는 핵폐기물처리를 위한 핵연료폭발방지 제어용품의 냉각수를 믹서기계로 혼합한 황토혼합물 운송체인 어도터널을 구비해 원자력발전 핵폐기물처리부를 구성하는 조절축과 구분하는 분배축들로 구비해 이중구조블록탱크집진기를 구비한 핵폐기물처리용 가압수형 원자로설비를 마련하며, 
원자력발전 원전가동 중단 전후 시 대체 발전전력 생산을 위한 풍력발전기와 화력발전기에 수력발전기로 전력생산을 구성하는 전력생산제조부와,이중구조바지선으로 건설기계를 이동 투입하는 건설기계의 교통운송부와,선박과 우주로켓을 구비해 핵폐기물을 분배하여 배출을 구성하는 핵폐기물동력전달부와,온도감지센서를 구비해 원전가동 설비안전을 위한 통제관리생산전장부와,전자제어조절장치를 구비해 전자제어조절을 위한 전자제어조절장치 건설기계조절부와,지주탱크의 수직수평 조절을 위한 전자제어조절장치와 결합을 구성하는 나사조절부와,냉각수를 믹서기계로 혼합한 황토혼합물을 구비해 재해를 차단하는 재해차단예방조절부와,냉각수 공급을 위한 유압굴착기를 구비해 심층수 용량 공급조절을 위한 지하수와 해양심층수 용량 공급조절부와,공유지 및 공유수면 매립처리조절부와,핵폐기물처리를 위한 인공위성과 우주로켓을 구비해 우주발전   및 핵 방사능 오염방지의 인공위성조절 부와,전자센서밸브를 구비해 이중구조 바지선 선체의 높낮이 조절을 위한 전자센서밸브 나사조절부를 구성하는 이중구조블록탱크집진기를 구비한 해양원자력수력발전소의 핵폐기물처리용 가압수형 원자로설비에 관한 것으로 
이러한 본 발명이 해결하고자 하는 기술적 과제는,핵폐기물처리용 해양원자력수력발전소의 원자로설비를 구성하는 이중구조블록탱크집진기를 구비한 해양원자력수력발전소의 핵폐기물처리용 가압수형 원자로설비에는, 
거센 풍랑 파도로부터 해양원자력수력발전소의 원자로설비의 원전가동 보장을 위한 해양원자력수력발전소는 해수면(S L L) 상단 40M 위치의 부양식독 선체갑판데크 상단부(S D U)로 설치하고,해양원자력수력발전소의 안전도를 위하여 0.5k m 간격 거리로 1개소에는 지주 블록탱크 교각들로 구비해 부양식독 선체 갑판데크에 구성하는 이중구조블록탱크집진기를 구비한 해양원자력수력발전소의 핵폐기물처리용 가압수형 원자로설비를 구성하며, 
해양원자력수력발전소 설비를 구성하는 부양식독 선체 갑판데크를 구비해 해수면(S L L) 상단부 핵폐기물처리장치 이중구조블록탱크 관 교량 해양터널교통장치와 연결위치 중간에는 고정식 부양식독 선체갑판데크 상단부(S D U)로 위치하는 해양원자력수력발전소와 항해선박의 비상대피소 구획을 위한 지주탱크 상단의 이중구조 바지선선체 선체갑판 상단부(S D U)에 위치하는 가이드 레일을 갑판데크 좌측과 우측으로 설치하고 5000톤 용량의 크레인(861)들을 갑판데크 가이드레일 위에 위치를 마련해 항해선박을 끌어올리는 항해선박의 비상대피소를 구성하고,무공해 전력공급을 위한 해양에서 원자력발전장치의 생산전력과 조류의 속도를 구비한 수력발전장치들로 구성하고,송전선 연결을 구비해 원자력수력발전설비부의 전력생산 제조부로부터 동력을 공급받아 산업현장으로 동력을 전달하는 동력전달부를 구비해 지구촌의 각 지역으로 전력생산 공급을 마련하고, 
상기 핵폐기물처리용 해양원자력수력발전소의 원자로설비 본체 내부로 구성하는 송전선 연결을 구비해 전력 공급라인이 핵폐기물처리장치 이중구조블록탱크 관 교량 해양터널교통장치와 연결되는 송전선 연결을 구비한 지역으로 전력공급을 재개하면서 핵폐기물처리용 가압수형 원자로설비 본체 내부로 구성하는 해상철구조물에는 핵 폭탄에서부터 재래식 전쟁물자 일체를 유엔안전보장 회원국 합의 일체로 핵 폭탄의 폐기처분을 마련하고,육지에서는 어떠한 명분으로도 핵 물질을 상호 각국은 보유할 수 없도록 마련한 규정을 구성하며, 
핵폐기물처리용 가압수형 원자로설비를 구성하는 해양원자력발전소 주변에 위치하는 핵보유국 다수의 국가는 전쟁과 테러방지를 위한 핵폐기물처리용 가압수형 원자로설비 본체 내부로 구성하는 핵폐기물처리 연결구조물 이중구조블록탱크 관 교량 해양터널교통장치에는, 
인공위성발사대와 우주로켓발사대 위치로 핵폐기물처리장치를 마련하는 인공위성과 우주로켓을 핵폐기물의 탑재를 구비해 핵폐기물처리를 마련하고,기상예보 관측용 기상예보관측소의 일기예보를 발표해서 자연 발생적인 태풍,지진,해일,산불,황사와 화산 폭발 전후 시의 화산재 발생의 피해를 기상예보 관측용 기상예보방재장치로 자연재해를 사전에 방지하며, 
홍수가뭄을 사전예방을 구성하는 해양터널교통장치에는, 
상기 해양터널교통장치를 구성하는 해저선로 분사노즐 연결구와 해저선로 분사노즐에 해저선로배선이 마련되며 핵폐기물처리 이중구조블록탱크 해양터널교통장치를 구비해 생산전력에너지를 핵폐기물처리장치에 선 제공을 마련하고, 
이중구조블록탱크집진기를 구비한 해양원자력수력발전소의 핵폐기물처리용 가압수형 원자로설비를 구성하는 해양원자력수력발전소에는, 
우주과학 발전장비를 구비해 심해저 광물자원과 천연가스 에너지자원을 탐지하고 그 후 석유에너지 굴착장비를 투입해 심해저 광물자원과 천연가스 에너지자원 생산을 마련하며,풍력발전기와 수력발전기의 생산전력을 변전소의 변압기와 송전선을 구비해 지구촌에 공급을 이루도록 구성하고,핵폐기물처리용 이중구조블록탱크 관 교량 해양터널교통장치의 연결구조물들로 구비해 해양원자력수력발전소를 마련하고,해양선박을 대체하는 교통장치설비의 안전운항을 위한 밧데리를 구비해 전력에너지를 선 제공을 마련하고, 
상기 전력에너지를 선 제공을 구성하는 원자로설비 가동중지와 원자로설비 폭발 전 후 시를 대비하여 기존의 원자로 제4벽 격납용기 둘레면에 이중구조블록탱크집진기를 구비해 원자로설비 가동 중지를 없애고 지속적인 원자로설비의 폭발방지를 이루도록 제4벽 격납용기 둘레면에 이중구조블록탱크집진기를 구성하는 이중구조블록탱크집진기를 구비한 해양원자력수력발전소의 핵폐기물처리용 가압수형 원자로설비에 관한 것이다.

title_en: A kind of intelligent building firefighting monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of intelligent building firefighting monitoring system, comprise fire station, Surveillance center and multiple Data Detection for fire hazard aerosol fog detection and transmission terminal, described Data Detection and transmission terminal are connected with Surveillance center, and described Surveillance center is connected with fire station；Described Data Detection and transmission terminal comprise fire cigarette propagated sensation sensor, signal modulation module, signal demodulation module, data processing module, sound and light alarm module, controller module, radiofrequency launcher and power module, present invention employs high performance microprocessor SPCE061A is the networking fire protection warning monitoring system that core achieves a kind of intelligent building, through reality test, this system has stronger network communications capability, high real-time, the feature of communication fast and reliable, has the highest practical value.
