title_en: Method for manufacturing an elastic ceramic matrix composite
abstract_en: The present invention relates to: i. damage-resistant ECMCs that need to work and remain elastic between minus 120ºC and positive 300°C (350°C exceptionally); ii. ECMCs that need to be able to contain a flame of 1900ºC for more than 90 minutes (for example in the case of a fire); iii. composite structures and, in particular, highly stressed structures, for example helicopter engine compartments, aeroplane engine nacelles, aeroplane thrust reversers, jet engine afterbodies, heat shields of missiles intended to fly well beyond the sound barrier (hypersonic speed), structural components, heat shields and interior fire-fighting arrangements of aeroplanes, boats, trains and road vehicles, as well as industrial or leisure components. One of the characteristic problems of ceramic matrices is their fragility. Indeed, when a fracture starts, it propagates easily in the matrix. The present invention relates to elastic ceramic matrix composites (ECMCs), and differs in that: the ceramic matrix is split into solid "ceramic microdomains" (CMDs) (2); the CMDs are connected to one another by a dense network of "elastic microelements" (EMEs) (1); and the bonds between the EMEs and the CMDs are strong chemical bonds, preferably covalent.

title_en: Disaster indoor communication system having function of providing position information and the communication method thereof
title_ko: 위치정보 제공 기능을 구비한 실내 재난 통신 시스템 및 실내 재난 통신 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an indoor disaster communication system having a function of providing location information and an indoor disaster communication method therefor, which enable indoor disaster communication to be performed without disconnection even when a disaster, such as sinking, fire, or the like, occurs in a structure, such as a ship, building, or the like, having a complicated internal structure. The indoor disaster communication system having a function of providing location information comprises: a wireless network unit which includes a plurality of wireless network nodes configured to perform communication by selectively using radio wave communication and sound wave communication so that a communication method is changed into sound wave communication when sinking occurs during performance of the radio wave communication, and which provides local area communication service within a structure; a location identification unit which includes location information transmitters each configured to be installed within the structure and to transmit location identification information for location identification when a user terminal is disposed within a preset range from a corresponding location information transmitter; a user terminal which transmits the location identification information to a disaster management server after receiving the location identification information, and in which a disaster management application, configured to output a location transmitted by the disaster management server in response to the location identification information, is installed; and the disaster management server which provides a location information provision service. In this case, the location information provision service extracts information about a location at which a location information transmitter corresponding to the received location identification information has been installed within the structure after the location identification information has been received from the user terminal and transmits the information about the location to the user terminal, or the location information provision service computes a location of the user terminal and transmits the computed location to the user terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 선박 또는 건물 등의 복잡한 실내 구조를 가지는 구조물의 침몰, 화재 등의 재난 상황에서도 통신의 단절 없이 실내에서의 재난 통신을 수행할 수 있도록 하는 위치정보 제공 기능을 구비한 실내 재난 통신 시스템 및 실내 재난 통신 방법에 관한 것으로, 상기 위치정보 제공 기능을 구비한 실내 재난 통신 시스템은, 무선전파통신을 수행하는 과정 중 침수가 발생한 경우 음파통신으로 통신을 변경하도록 무선전파통신과 음파통신을 선택적으로 수행하는 다수의 무선네트워크노드들을 구비하여 구조물 내에서의 로컬영역 통신서비스를 제공하는 무선네트워크부; 상기 구조물 내에 설치되어 사용자 단말기가 기 설정 거리 내로 인접되는 경우 위치식별을 위한 위치식별정보를 송출하는 위치정보송신기들로 구성되는 위치식별부; 상기 위치식별정보를 수신한 후 재난관리서버로 전송하고, 재난관리서버에서 송신된 상기 위치식별정보 대응 위치를 출력하는 재난관리앱이 탑재되는 사용자 단말기; 및 상기 사용자단말기로부터 상기 위치식별정보를 수신한 후 수신된 위치식별정보에 대응하는 상기 구조물 실내의 위치정보송신기 설치 위치 정보를 추출하여 상기 사용자 단말기로 전송하거나 상기 사용자 단말기의 위치를 연산하여 상기 사용자 단말기로 전송하는 위치정보 제공서비스를 제공하는 재난관리서버;를 포함한다.

title_en: Photovoltaic power generation prediction research system based on Matlab
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic power generation prediction research system based on Matlab, and belongs to the field of photovoltaic power generation prediction. The system comprises a data importing and exporting unit, a BP (Back Propagation) neural network training and prediction unit and a comprehensive assessment unit of training effects, wherein the data importing and exporting unit can import meteorological environment data and synchronous corresponding photovoltaic power generation power data, and can export a photovoltaic power generation power prediction value; the BP neural network training and prediction unit has flexible BP neural network parameter setting, training and prediction functions; and the comprehensive assessment unit of the training effects can comprehensively reflect the training effect of the BP neural network in real time and provides a reference for determining a prediction model. The photovoltaic power generation prediction research system is one set of integral prediction research system and is realized in the GUI (Graphical User Interface) environment of the Matlab, which is different from a situation that the Matlabe is provided with a toolbox nntool. By use of the research system, the establishment, the prediction and the interaction with a Windows system of the BP neural network training and prediction model can be more efficient and convenient, and a practical reference value is provided for the research and application of the power generation prediction.

title_en: A kind of Transmission Network Reliability appraisal procedure based on cascading failure accident chaining search
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of Transmission Network Reliability appraisal procedure based on power grid cascading failure accident chaining search, the method includes cascading failure fault chains search step and carries out reliability assessment step according to the cascading failure result for obtaining.The actual electric network factor such as system stability restraint condition and bus-bar fault, transformer fault is considered in cascading failure accident chaining search；Using new improved cascading failure loss expectation in reliability assessment, existing reliability index is improved, and based on 599 command of State Council and the actual reliability index proposed based on accident gradation of electrical network, there is to engineering practice certain directive function.

title_en: Disaster guidance system using digital information display and the method thereat
title_ko: 디지털정보디스플레이를 이용한 재해안내 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster guidance system using a digital information display and a method thereof, wherein a digital information display device calculates an evacuation route by position information having surrounding topographic information and facilities information and displays the calculated information thereon to propagate a situation when receiving disaster occurrence information. The disaster guidance system using the digital information display comprises: a communication unit configured to transmit and receive the disaster occurrence information; a central processing unit configured to calculate the evacuation route by the disaster occurrence information received from the communication unit, the surrounding topographic information, and the facilities information; the digital information display device configured to display the evacuation route calculated from the central processing unit. According to the disaster guidance system and the method thereof, the digital information display not only can perform a simple information display function, but also can evacuate users more safely and rapidly to reduce risks by propagating the disaster occurrence information and the evacuation route in case of disaster.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 디지털정보디스플레이 장치가 재해 발생 정보를 수신하면 주변 지형정보 및 시설정보가 포함된 위치정보로 대피경로를 산출하고, 이 산출된 정보를 디지털정보디스플레이 장치에 표시하고, 상황을 전파하는 디지털정보디스플레이를 이용한 재해 안내 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다.

본 발명에 따른 디지털정보디스플레이를 이용한 재해안내 시스템 및 방법에 따르면 디지털정보디스플레이가 단순히 정보 표시 기능만 하는 것이 아닌 재해 발생 시 재해 발생 정보 및 대피 경로를 전파를 통해 보다 안전하고 신속하게 이용자를 대피시켜 위험을 줄일 수 있게 하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Safe Evacuation System for optimal evacuation in case of emergency and the method therof
title_ko: 비상시 안전 유도 표시 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to safe guidance display system and method in case of emergency and, more specifically, to a system and method which display an evacuation route using a digital information display or a laser light to help people in a space to be safely evacuated in case of emergency such as the occurrence of a disaster. The safe guidance display system in case of emergency according to the present invention comprises: a scanning unit which recognizes the type of emergency and location; a storage unit which stores information on evacuation routes; a central processing unit which calculates the risk of each evacuation route based on information on the type of emergency and the location which are recognized by the scanning unit, and information on the evacuation routes which is read from the storage unit, and generates a safe evacuation route through the calculated risk; a display unit which displays the evacuation route generated by the central processing unit; and a situation broadcasting unit which broadcasts the evacuation route generated by the central processing unit by voice or lighting. According to the present invention, the safe guidance display system and method guides people to the optimal evacuation route and quickly evacuates them from a facility, which is used by many people, when an emergency occurs.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 비상시 안전 유도 표시 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 재난 발생 등 비상시 해당 공간에 있는 사람이 안전하게 대피를 유도할 수 있도록 디지털 정보 표시장치나 레이저 조명을 이용하여 대피로를 표시해 주는 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 비상시 안전 유도 표시 시스템은 비상 발생 종류와 위치를 인지하기 위한 검지부,대피 경로의 정보를 저장하고 있는 저장장치부, 검지부로부터 인지한 비상 발생 종류와 위치 정보 그리고 저장부로 무터 읽어 들인 대피 경로 정보를 바탕으로 대피 경로별 위험도를 계산하고, 계산된 상기 위험도를 통해 안전 대피 경로를 발생하는 중앙처리장치, 중앙처리장치에서 발생한 대피 경로를 표시하기 위한 표시부, 중앙처리장치에서 발생한 대피경로를 음성이나 조명으로 전파하기 위한 상황전파부를 포함하는 것이다. 
본 본발에 따른 비상시 안전 유도 표시 시스템 및 방법은 비상시 안전 유도 표시 시스템 및 방법에 의하면 다중 이용자가 이용하는 시설에서 비상 발생 시 최적의 대피 경로를 안내 받아 신속하게 대피하여 이용자의 안전을 확보할 수 있는 효과가 있다.
assignees: EH DEV CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for determining environment protection information transmission effect of grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and system for determining an environment protection information transmission effect of a grid. The method comprises: an evaluation index system of an environment protection information transmission effect of a grid is established; a hierarchical structure graph of a transmission effect is constructed; a value of an importance degree of an influence on an environment protection information propagation effect of the grid by each first-order index is determined; on the basis of the values, a determination matrix A is established; a maximum feature value and a maximum feature vector of the matrix A are calculated and consistency checking is carried out on the determination matrix A; when the determination matrix passes the consistency checking, a grid environment protection information transmission effect evaluation formula is established based on the maximum feature value of the determination matrix and the corresponding feature vector, wherein the formula is as follows: an information transmission effect=omega01*(attention rate)+omega02*(interest rate)+omega03*(query rate)+omega04*(action rate)+omega05*(haring rate)+omega06*(query-sharing rate); and on the basis of the evaluation rate, index assignment is carried out for an environment protection propagation activity plan of the power grid and a quantitative evaluation result of the information transmission effect is determined.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Enhanced V-pass apparatus for emergence calling
title_ko: 비상호출 기능 등이 강화된 브이패스 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a technique utilized for reporting a position of a ship, especially to a V-pass apparatus technology of emergency call function which can transmit a distress signal stably even in a sinking situation of the ship and report position data that existed in a shadow area. A purpose of the present invention is to improve the emergency call function of a fishing boat by complementarily interlocking a special role of the V-pass and a multifunctional role of a smartphone. Thus, a transmitting and receiving terminal only for transmission and reception having a location reporting communications and emergency communications means is interlocked with a display terminal for providing users convenience are interlocked, wherein the transmitting and receiving terminal and the display terminal are interlocked by a single V-pass apparatus integrated with Bluetooth, and are automatically detached at a time of sinking, and an SOS signal is transmitted simultaneously with the smart phone in an emergency call. Therefore, the present invention is able to obtain a variety of effects, such as switching to a good network in a boundary area of a communication channel, and transmitting an emergency call signal stably.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 선박의 위치보고 등에 활용되는 기술로서, 특히 선박의 침몰 상황에서도 안정되게 조난신호 발신이 가능하고 전파음영지역에 존재했던 위치데이터도 추가보고 가능한 비상호출 기능의 브이패스 장치 기술이다. 
본 발명은 브이패스의 전문 역할과 스마트폰의 다기능 역할을 상호 보완적으로 연동하여 어선의 비상호출 기능을 개량하고자 하는 목적으로, 위치보고통신과 비상통신 수단이 구비된 송수신 전용의 송수신터미널 및 사용자 조작편의성을 제공하는 디스플레이단말을 연동하되, 상기 송수신터미널과 디스플레이단말은 블루투스로 연동되어 통합된 하나의 브이패스 장치를 구성하고 침몰 시에 자동 탈거되고, 비상호출에서 스마트폰과 동시에 SOS신호가 송출되는 등의 구성을 특징으로 한다.  
본 발명에 의하면 특히 통신권의 경계지역에서 양호한 네트워크로 전환되어 비상호출 신호가 안정되게 전송되는 등 다양한 효과를 얻을 수 있다.
assignees: SDSYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Simulation method and device for cascading failures of power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation method and device for cascading failures of a power grid. The method comprises the steps of carrying out stability analysis on the power grid and determining a key failure component in the power grid; generating a cascading failure sequence of the power grid on the basis of the key failure component; carrying out dynamic simulation for a whole process on the basis of the cascading failure sequence; and determining the state of the power grid after the cascading failures through a simulation result. According to the simulation method and device, the technical problem of high workload of cascading failure simulation of the power grid is solved.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Ultra-high-voltage AC/DC hybrid grid stability analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-high-voltage AC/DC hybrid grid stability analysis method based on risk assessment in the technical field of electric power system reliability. The method, on the basis of reasonably setting system fault and carrying out analog simulation, introduces risk assessment indexes, comprising important components of low-voltage risk, power angle difference risk and frequency instability risk and the like. The method is characterized by, after determining a component outage model, selecting system failure states and calculating probability thereof; carrying out simulated assessment on the consequence of each selected state; and finally, calculating risk indexes and analyzing stability of a power grid. Compared with a conventional power grid stability analysis method, the method combines the accident occurring probability and the consequence of each index loss and combines risk and benefit, and quantitatively reflects system safety indexes, so that the method is more suitable for stability analysis of a complex hybrid grid when having cascading failure or large-area blackout.
assignees: STATE GRID INNER MONGOLIA EASTERN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ECONOMIC AND TECH RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Method and device for evaluating influence of electrified railway on power grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for evaluating the influence of an electrified railway on a power grid. The method comprises the following steps of: utilizing an element negative sequence equivalent model, a negative sequence current source equivalent model and a regional power grid structure parameter to establish a regional power grid simulation model; utilizing a simulation model to establish a mathematical equivalent circuit which carries out propagation when negative sequence voltage and current components pass through a power transmission line, a transformer and a circuit branch, and solving propagation coefficients according to the mathematical equivalent circuit; utilizing the propagation coefficients of the power transmission line, the branch circuit and the transformer of a practical power grid as well as negative sequence voltage and current injected into a point of common coupling by a known electrified railway to obtain the negative sequence voltage and current of each load node in an adjacent power grid; taking the negative sequence voltage and current of different busbar power supply regions of an adjacent single transformer substation of a traction substation as evaluation objects to establish an electric energy quality comprehensive evaluation model for evaluating the negative sequence influence of the regional power grid; and utilizing the electric energy quality comprehensive evaluation model to evaluate the influence of the electrified railway on the power grid.
assignees: NORTH CN ELEC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG;STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD CHENGDE POWER SUPPLY CO;ZHANGJIAKOU POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID JINBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Long-term operation method of cross-basin cascade hydropower station group under dynamic production of giant hydropower station
abstract_en: The invention relates to a long-term operation method of a cross-basin cascade hydropower station group under the dynamic production of a giant hydropower station, which comprises the following steps: step 1, load is predicted. And 2, deducting the power station output process which does not participate in calculation from the monthly average load. And 3, calculating the natural water inflow process of the whole network watershed with different frequencies. Step 4, calculating the output process of each hydropower station; and 5, calculating the output process of the thermal power station. The method combines the actual operation characteristics of the Yunnan power grid, and divides hydropower stations into two types: the power stations which participate in calculation mainly comprise hydropower stations and thermal power stations with good regulation performance and large installed scale, the power stations which do not participate in calculation mainly comprise wind power, photovoltaic power, hydropower stations with lower regulation performance and partial thermal power, the long-term operation process of the power stations is not changed greatly, and the output process of the power stations can be given according to the actual operation condition of a power grid.

title_en: Endless-walk formula restoration methods based on bandwidth fairness in a kind of WDM optical-fiber networks
abstract_en: The endless-walk formula restoration methods based on bandwidth fairness in a kind of wavelength-division multiplex (WDM) optical-fiber network are claimed in the present invention, belong to Communication Network Technique field.This method is directed to the business recovery problem in disaster loss network, the method restored using endless-walk formula, and providing fairness bandwidth for different brackets business restores.By flexibly dividing the grade of service and adjustment and recovery step-length, the business that is damaged to different brackets carries out interim or step-by-step movement and restores successively, realizes the relative fairness of each grade business recovery；The recovery priority of business is damaged according to bandwidth loss rate dynamic adjustment ad eundem, in a manner that least unit bandwidth cycle is restored, realizes the fairness of ad eundem business recovery；By the recovery operation of multiple endless-walk formula, effectively improve the service fairness of recovery business and reduce the Service disruption ratio of the whole network.

title_en: A method of extracting power system frequency dynamic space-time distribution character information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of methods for extracting power system frequency dynamic space-time distribution character information, the mains frequency dynamic data that electrical power system wide-area measuring system measures is decomposed first with complex empirical orthogonal functions method, extract the standing wave ingredient and traveling wave ingredient in frequency dynamic change procedure, and the speed that frequency dynamic is propagated in power grid is calculated, obtain the relevant information of characterization power system frequency dynamic space-time distribution character.This method is applied to actual electric network by the present invention, the dynamic variation characteristic of mains frequency after analysis disturbance, the traveling-wave component and standing wave in mains frequency dynamic process can be efficiently extracted, it is analyzed in real time by the metric data to electrical power system wide-area measuring system, the propagation characteristic in power grid can be disturbed with on-line analysis, effective decision information is provided for dispatcher, there is good practical value and application prospect.

title_en: Electromechanical-electromagnetic hybrid simulation method and system
abstract_en: The application provides an electromechanical-electromagnetic hybrid simulation method and system, comprising the following steps: determining that a bus connected with a power transmission line meeting preset conditions at an electromagnetic transient network side is a hybrid simulation interface position; the electromagnetic wave propagation delay tau on the power transmission line is larger than the electromagnetic transient simulation step delta t; the k side of the power transmission line is connected with an electromechanical transient network, and the j side of the power transmission line is connected with the rest of the electromagnetic transient network; the other networks of the electromagnetic transient network, the power transmission line and the electromechanical transient network are equivalent to the following three parts: the power transmission line j side and the rest of the network part of the electromagnetic transient network, the equivalent circuit part of the power transmission line k side and the electromechanical transient network, and the equivalent circuit of the electromagnetic transient network and the electromechanical transient network part; and respectively solving the three parts to obtain the power grid state of the electromagnetic transient network and the electromechanical transient network. The technical scheme provided by the application can greatly reduce the interface calculation amount and improve the calculation efficiency.

title_en: Adaptive deep confidence network bearing fault diagnosis method based on Nesterov momentum method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a self-adaptive deep confidence network bearing fault diagnosis method based on a Nesterov momentum method, which comprises the following steps: carrying out sample division on original signals of different health states of the rolling bearing to generate training samples; building a DBN (constrained Boltzmann Machine) by a cascading constrained Boltzmann Machine, adding a Nesterov momentum method and an independent self-adaptive learning rate, inputting a training sample into the DBN, and pre-training the DBN by a batch stochastic gradient descent method and a greedy layer-by-layer unsupervised algorithm; adding a Softmax classifier at the top layer of the pre-trained model, using a supervision algorithm to train the Softmax classifier independently, and carrying out global fine adjustment through a Back Propagation algorithm and a conjugate gradient method to obtain optimal parameters of the model; and inputting unknown state signals to form a test sample set, and then inputting the test sample into the trained DBN model and the Softmax classifier to judge the fault type of the rolling bearing. By adding a Nesterov momentum method and an independent self-adaptive learning rate, the DBN pre-training speed is increased, and the fault classification precision is improved.
assignees: UNIV SUZHOU

title_en: Emergency information transmits covering method and device
abstract_en: This application provides emergency information transmission covering method and device, it is related to broadcasting communication technology field, wherein, emergency information transmission covering method includes：First, responding agencies judge whether current network is unimpeded, if the judgment is Yes, emergency information is sent to multistage linking link and is responded by responding agencies, if the judgment is No, emergency information is sent to device link and is responded by responding agencies, multistage linking link and device link are caused by this kind of method while being present in a system, so, responding agencies can be according to environmental condition, suitable link is selected to be transmitted emergency information, it is achieved thereby that the extensive covering of emergency information and fast propagation.
assignees: BEIJING SUMAVISION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Voltage stability evaluation fault set forming method for multi-direct current feed-in receiving end alternating current system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for forming a voltage stability assessment fault set of a multi-direct current feed-in receiving end alternating current system, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: acquiring the fluctuation data of a recent multi-direct-current feed-in direct-current receiving end system, the corresponding transmission curve of a direct-current transmission system with the maximum power, the current regional load and the starting mode to form a relation table, carrying out rule reduction on the relation table according to a reduction rule, and determining a typical operation mode in a future period; calculating a voltage stability level coefficient of a receiving end system in a typical operation mode; calculating the voltage stability level coefficient S of the direct current receiving end system under the condition of various line faults and disconnection n (ii) a Sequencing the line faults according to the voltage stability level coefficient of the direct current receiving end system; and combining the power flow transfer condition after the fault, the low voltage point and the electrical distance risk coefficient of the fault point to combine the worst cascading fault set. The method can quickly evaluate the voltage instability risk of the receiving end power grid of the direct current system after the fault by carrying out characteristic analysis on the transient voltage instability accident possibly existing in the existing alternating current-direct current hybrid power grid.

title_en: Power network self_organized criticla quantitative evaluating method based on multi-layer variable-weight theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses cascading failure in power system prevention and the power network self_organized criticla quantitative evaluating method based on multi-layer variable-weight theory in defence field, including：It is determined that the key index collection of influence power network self_organized criticla；Determine the self-organized criticality of power network under each running status in sample set；Original physical index set is divided into physical layer and factor layer and based on positive and negative preferable variable-weight theory, in calculating sample set under each running status physical layer index weight；The expression formula and dimension of level of factor are calculated based on principal component analysis, it is ensured that level of factor information is not overlapped；The uniformity judgment matrix and the principal component information representation factor built based on physical layer index weights, calculate the weight of factor layer index；It is input with factor layer index using sum of ranks than comprehensive estimation method, calculates assessed value；Can each factor of comprehensive description to the Influencing Mechanism of power network self_organized criticla, the self-organizing critical condition of qualitative assessment power network, and calculating speed is very fast.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: A kind of grid disturbance Forecasting Methodology and device
abstract_en: A kind of grid disturbance Forecasting Methodology and device are the embodiment of the invention provides, by the Monitoring Data for obtaining power network interior joint；According to Monitoring Data, whether decision node disturbs；When one or more nodes are disturbed in node, using the state of disturbance value at node current time as LSTM RTRBM deep learning models input；By LSTM RTRBM deep learning models, the state of disturbance value of one or more the time step interior nodes after current time is predicted；The state of disturbance value of the multiple time step interior nodes after according to current time, predict the situation that disturbance is propagated with one or more time steps among the nodes, computing is carried out without the various actual physics parameters in power network, disturbance can just be predicted by complete data-driven using LSTM RTRBM deep learnings models and spatially and temporally go up two propagation conditions of dimension, improve the efficiency and accuracy of propagation of disturbance prediction.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV BEIJING POSTS & TELECOMM;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Disaster response system that is based on the machine to machine and method thereof
title_ko: 사물지능통신을 기반으로 하는 재난대응시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 유해화학가스 확산, 원유유출, 플랜트폭발, 방사능누출사고 등의 다양한 인재사고의 확산으로 인한 피해범위의 광역화와 누적적 장기화로 인한 불특정 다수의 주민과 생물환경에 심대한 영향을 주는 인적재난에 대해, 빅데이터를 기반으로 사고상황 발생 전부터 지속적으로 체크함으로써, 고확산, 고위험이 수반되는 유해화학물질의 관리를 체계적으로 수립 및 해당 지역 주민들에게 안내하여 사고발생 전부터 해당 지역 주민들에게 신속하게 대응 및 대처할 수 있게 안내하여 야기될 수 있는 위험성을 극소화시킴과 더불어 실제로 재난사고가 발생한 상태에서 지역 소속자들이 그 재난사고가 발생된 지역을 인지하고, 그 재난사고가 전파되는 지역을 회피하면서 안전한 지역까지 최단경로로 이동하게 안내하여 줌으로써, 재난사고 발생후에도 인명피해를 최소화시켜줄 뿐만 아니라 사고발생지역에 위치하는 소속자들이 보유한 단말과 중앙관제시스템 간의 무선인터넷망이 재난사고로 인해 본연의 구실을 수행하지 못하더라도 사고발생지역에 위치하는 소속자들의 위치를 확인하고 이를 통해, 소속자들이 안전하게 탈출할 수 있는 경로를 소속자들에게 제공하여 주는 사물지능통신을 기반으로 하는 재난대응시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 산업시설 주변지역의 상황을 감지하여 기설정된 주기마다 지역별 방재용 주변상황정보를 생성하고, 이를 TCP/IP 인터넷통신모듈(130)을 이용하여 TCP/IP 기반 인터넷망을 통해 전송하는 사물지능 방재센서 관리부재(100)들과; 상기 사물지능 방재센서 관리부재(100)들이 설치된 산업시설 주변지역에 속하는 소속자가 연결하여 이루어지는 영역을 포함하는 설치지점지역을 나타내는 설치지점별 주변지도정보가 저장된 설치지점별 주변지도 목록정보 DB(511a)를 더 포함하며, 상기 재난대응서버(300)는 상기 방재용 주변상황정보들의 분석된 값이 사고발생 예측상황감지에 해당하는 경우 기설정주기마다 상기 산업시설 주변지역 소속자용 단말(200)로 무선인터넷망이 정상작동된다는 것을 안내하는 무선인터넷망 정상작동안내신호를 전송하며, 상기 산업시설 주변지역 소속자용 단말(200)은 상기 재난대응서버(300)로부터 무선인터넷망을 통해 기설정주기마다 전송되는 무선인터넷망 정상작동안내신호가 전송되지 않는 경우 사용자 식별정보 및 서버단절 안내정보를 포함하는 무선단절 안내신호를 블루투스 통신모듈(230)을 이용하여 근거리통신망을 통해 전송하고, 위치안내단말(500a)로 전송하고, 상기 한 쌍의 위치측정용 슬레이브측 설치지점별 근거리 위치안내단말(500b,500c)과 한 조를 이루는 상기 위치측정용 마스터측 설치지점별 근거리 위치안내단말(500a)은 RSSI 측정모듈(520a)을 운영하여 그 수신된 무선단절 안내신호의 세기(RSSI)를 측정하고, 그 측정된 값인 마스터측 세기측정정보와 상기 BLE통신모듈(530a)을 통해 수신되는 한 쌍의 슬레이브측 세기측정정보를 토대로 상기 무선단절 안내신호를 수신한 해당 위치측정용 마스터측 설치지점별 근거리 위치안내단말(500a) 및 한 쌍의 위치측정용 슬레이브측 설치지점별 근거리 위치안내단말(500b,500c)의 삼점(三點)으로 연결되는 설치지점지역에서 상기 무선단절 안내신호를 송신한 상기 산업시설 설치지점별 주변지도정보를 블루투스 통신모듈(230)을 통해 수신하고, 그 수신된 탈출안내용 설치지점별 주변지도정보에 취합된 사용자 식별정보를 토대로 사용자 식별을 수행한 후 탈출안내용 설치지점별 주변지도정보를 출력 안내하는 시스템 및 이를 이용한 방법을 제공하는 특징으로 한다.

title_en: A kind of power network weakness zone on-line identification method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a kind of power network weakness zone on-line identification method, for solving, existing power network weakness zone discrimination method is no and Real-Time Power System Operation States are associated, it is often on electric network composition or weakness zone of the power network under certain malfunction that it, which picks out the power network weakness zone come, is not the technical problem of the weakness zone under current electric grid running statu.A kind of power network weakness zone on-line identification method of the embodiment of the present invention includes：Operation of power networks state is obtained from current EMS system, and cascading failure emulation is carried out by OPA models of having a power failure on a large scale, and receives preset fault set；The load loss of current failure is counted, each node accident of current failure or event class is judged, and counts current failure dead electricity nodes, excision circuit number, current failure disaster degree, risk factor is calculated；By each node accident or event class of current failure, current failure disaster degree, risk factor, the accident or event harm value of each node of current failure are calculated.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CENTER OF GPGC

title_en: THz spectrum rapid nondestructive testing method for fresh meat freshness K value
abstract_en: A THz spectrum rapid nondestructive testing method for fresh meat freshness K value comprises the following steps: first) meat collection and processing: uniformly cutting fresh meat into meat slices, and refrigerating; when sampling and cutting, the fat and connective tissue of the meat are avoided; II) measuring the THz spectral data of the meat: a THz attenuated total reflection ATR detection mode is adopted to rapidly detect a sample; when the spectrum is collected, the temperature and the humidity of the environment are kept stable; thirdly), rapidly detecting the freshness K value of the fresh meat by adopting a relation prediction model between the THz spectrum data and the fresh meat K value: the relation model is a principal component regression PCR prediction model or a back propagation neural network regression BPANN prediction model. And substituting the THz spectrum data obtained in the step two) into the relation prediction model, and quickly calculating the K value of the unknown sample. The method for sample pretreatment of the invention, which only needs to cut the sample to form the meat slices to be put into an instrument for measurement, is much simpler and faster than the existing method.

title_en: System and method for dynamic deployable wireless services
abstract_en: A system and method for intelligently and dynamically deploying a plurality of mobile robotic machines capable of carrying out a complex series of actions automatically to propagate wireless network connectivity comprising, at least, a mechanical framework, sensors, actuators, communications capability, an energy source, a propulsion means, a control mechanism, and a payload. The payload may comprise electronic or mechanical communication equipment to propagate services such as wireless networking services, in for example, a first responder or emergency environment, or electronic and mechanical jamming services in a military or anti-terrorism environment.

title_en: It is a kind of based on power flow transfer than thermally-stabilised key transmission channel recognition method
abstract_en: The invention discloses it is a kind of based on power flow transfer than thermally-stabilised key transmission channel recognition method, belong to Power System and its Automation technical field.The present invention carries out Contingency screening by monitoring element load factor after failure judgement and failure prior fault element load rate to forecast failure set；For the power flow transfer ratio of monitoring element after the calculation of fault failure in critical failure set, main power flow transfer element is screened than threshold value according to power flow transfer, the cascade connection and the limitation of total transfer ratio threshold value for further considering element determine main power flow transfer element；The main power flow transfer element of critical failure is constituted into the key transmission passage of candidate together with fault element, the thermally-stabilised power limit based on power flow transfer than estimating passway for transmitting electricity determines key transmission passage by thermally-stabilised power limit nargin in candidate collection.The present invention can meet the requirement for considering that the thermally-stabilised key transmission passage of forecast failure scene Recognition carries out safety on line monitoring under power network current operating situation.

title_en: A kind of power system excessive risk cascading failure fault chains searching method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of power system excessive risk cascading failure fault chains searching method.The accident chain model for being currently based on Complex Networks Theory have ignored the exclusive feature of the power networks such as electrical characteristic, operation characteristic and characteristics of tidal flow, the not fully security and stability analysis suitable for power network and control.The present invention is based on accident chain model; consider existing two, the anti-configuring condition in three roads; propose key element protection control action evaluation index; the uncertain factor controlled for quantized key element protection; the action probability of the key element protection control under critical condition is calculated, the successor of cascading failure fault chains is determined；In addition, the control cost according to needed for after protection control action probability and its action, assesses the risk of fault chains, excessive risk cascading failure fault chains are screened, are had a power failure on a large scale offer analysis foundation for prevention cascading failure.

title_en: Method for measuring and calculating cascade robustness of water supply network of dynamic emergency recovery mechanism
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for measuring and calculating cascade robustness of a water supply network of a dynamic emergency recovery mechanism, which comprises the following steps: loading basic hydraulic information and a topological structure of a water supply network; setting a tolerance parameter range and an iteration increment; calculating the maximum water pressure constraint condition of the node according to the tolerance parameter; calculating the cascade robustness of a dynamic emergency recovery mechanism water supply network of the single-node breakdown; iteratively calculating the robustness of a water supply network cascade system of a dynamic emergency recovery mechanism in which all nodes in the initial collapse node range collapse in sequence; iteratively calculating a robustness evaluation matrix of a water supply network cascade system of a dynamic emergency recovery mechanism in which all nodes collapse in sequence within a tolerance parameter range; and identifying the optimal emergency strategy and giving the priority sequence of the emergency strategy. The method can combine the water supply network entity flow attributes, consider the cascading failure and the dynamic emergency strategy, accurately calculate the robustness of the emergency strategy and give priority ranking of the emergency strategy.

title_en: City gas pipeline system pipeline fault propagation impact evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the present invention discloses a kind of city gas pipeline system pipeline fault propagation impact evaluation method and system, and the method includes the network structure topological diagram of city gas pipeline system is established according to city gas pipeline system；Network model is established according to network structure topological diagram；According to network model and preset constraint condition, obtains the corresponding first flow pressure of city gas pipeline system normal condition and distribute information；Pipeline fault is simulated in network model, and according to preset pipeline fault propagation rule and constraint condition, is obtained city gas pipeline system corresponding second flow pressure under pipeline fault state and distributed information；Compare first flow pressure distribution information and second flow pressure distribution information carries out the assessment of pipeline fault propagation effect to city gas pipeline system.The system is for executing the above method.The embodiment of the present invention improves the accuracy of city gas pipeline system pipeline fault propagation impact evaluation.

title_en: Fracture network fluid flow simulation with enhanced fluid-solid interaction force determination
abstract_en: An illustrative hydraulic fracturing flow simulation method includes: identifying a network of fractures within a formation rock matrix; modeling each fracture in the network as fluid flow path having discrete points at which a fluid pressure is determined; representing the rock matrix with discrete nodes at which a fluid-solid interaction force is determined, each said discrete node being associated with multiple discrete points along a fluid flow path; deriving the fluid-solid interaction force for each node from the fluid pressure at the associated discrete points; estimating an extent of fracture propagation based in part on the fluid-solid interaction forces; and displaying a visual representation of the fracture propagation extent. The deriving includes: obtaining an analytic integral of the fluid pressure as modified by a weighting function for each interval between adjacent ones of the associated discrete points; evaluating the analytic integrals for each interval to obtain contributions; and summing the contributions.

title_en: Citation network academic influence evaluation ranking method based on credibility
abstract_en: A citation network academic influence evaluation ordering method based on credibility belongs to the technical field of academic influence evaluation, combines the characteristics of a citation network, defines a series of rules according to article background information, improves a TrustRank algorithm and an Anti-TrustRank algorithm to select a seed set mechanism, calculates the credibility value and the non-credibility value of a network node in a circulating iteration mode, and finally integrates the results of the credibility value and the non-credibility value to give a score. And acquiring and outputting academic influence sequencing of scientific documents in the citation network according to the final descending sequencing result of the comprehensive reputation value. The invention aims to provide a reasonable and fair evaluation method, which can accurately evaluate the influence of documents so as to evaluate high-quality thesis data in a certain subject. Scientific researchers can also quickly search literature data and grasp the hot direction of the current research, and more time is distributed on the scientific theory research. The research of the invention has important theoretical significance for understanding the structure and propagation characteristics of the citation network and evaluating the influence of the literature.

title_en: Apparatus and method for Indoor Fire Test Facility

To this end, the present invention includes: a structure body; a fire implementation portion configured to implement artificial jet fire and pool fire; and a fire protection portion configured to block heat emission, flame propagation, flame spread, radiant heat, and the like, which occur when the fire implementation portion is operated.

title_en: Broadcasting system suitable for emergency broadcasting

abstract_en: In the present invention, data is easily restored with a less noise effect by using a coded orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (COFDM) to simultaneously transmit data in several frequencies, and a wide audible band increases a broadcasting effect while a single frequency network is established to maximize transmission rate of broadcasting, thereby increasing disaster broadcasting effect to minimize damage from disasters. In particular, the present invention is as follows: stably transmitting desirable data to a digital broadcasting station by being formed to be able to transmit data to the digital broadcasting station by means of at least one social network service (SNS); the digital broadcasting station transmitting the data to a portable terminal in the COFDM method, such that a radio wave efficiency of data can be maximized. In addition, according to the present invention, since the digital broadcasting station and the portable terminal can transmit and receive to/from each other in a signal frequency network (SFN) method, which is a single frequency method, the establishing of a network is easy and the data transmission can be effectively in a nationwide or in a local area through a single network.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 직교 부호화 주파수 분할 다중방식(COFDM)을 이용하여 여러 개로 나눈 주파수로 데이터를 동시에 전송하여 잡음 영향이 적으면서도 데이터를 쉽게 복원할 수 있고, 가청 지역이 넓어 방송 효과를 높이면서도 단일 주파수 망을 구축하여 방송의 전송률을 극대화할 수 있으므로 재난 방송 효과를 높여 재난피해를 최소화할 수 있게 한 것이다. 특히, 본 발명은 적어도 하나의 사회적 네트워크 서비스(SNS)로 데이터를 디지털 방송국에 전송할 수 있게 구성하므로 원하는 데이터를 디지털 방송국에 안정적으로 전송할 수 있고, 다시 이 데이터를 디지털 방송국에서 COFDM 방식으로 휴대용 단말로 전송하므로 데이터 전파 효율을 극대화할 수 있게 한다. 또한, 본 발명은 디지털 방송국과 휴대용 단말을 단일 주파수 방식인 SFN(Signal Frequency Network) 방식으로 송수신할 수 있게 하여 망 구축이 쉬우면서도 단일망으로 전국적 또는 국지적으로 필요한 지역에 데이터 송신을 효과적으로 할 수 있게 한다.

title_ko: 원자력 시설에서 핵 물질의 인-시투 처리 및 격납을 위한 비상 시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko: 비상 사태 동안 방사능 물질(M)을 안전하게 격리시키는 시스템 및 방법(10)은, 물질(M)을 안전하게 격리시키기에 충분한 깊이와 근접하여 위치된 보어홀(20)을 포함한다.  일 실시예에서, 어떠한 외부 전원도 필요하지 않다.  또 다른 실시예에서, 증기 폭발을 생성할 위험 없이 고온의 물질(M)이 안전하게 격리될 수 있는 건조한 구멍을 생성하기 위해 하부(25)에서 절연 배리어를 가지는 완전히 케이싱된 보어홀(20)이 사용된다.  일 실시예에서, 오염된 물(W)을 격리시키는데 사용되는 실시예에서, 보어홀 케이싱(21)은 천공되고, 천공(23)은 물(W)이 쉽게 흐를 수 있는 투과성 영역을 가로지른다.  또 다른 실시예에서, 중력 균열은 보어홀(20)의 하단부(25)에 위치되며, 방사능 물질(M)은 중력 균열에 진입한다.  밀도가 큰 슬러리 또는 유체는 방사능 물질(M)과 혼합되어 방사능 물질(M)이 처리됨에 따라 중력 균열을 생성 및 전파할 수 있다.

title_en: Dynamic reliability assessment method for power flow controller of in-phase power supply system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic reliability evaluation method for a power flow controller of an in-phase power supply system, which comprises the steps of calculating the junction temperature of a power element by taking account of the influence of the randomness and the impact of actual traction load on the junction temperature fluctuation of the power element, calculating the failure rate of a power module of the power flow controller by adopting a power loss and thermal network model, combining a physical model based on a failure mechanism and a linear fatigue damage accumulation model, and analyzing the reliability of PFC by adopting a dynamic reliability evaluation method taking account of the change of the failure rate of the element. The redundancy of the power module is analyzed, the number of the cascaded modules of the power flow controller is optimized, and necessary basis is provided for engineering design and operation maintenance of the same-phase power supply system.

title_en: In order to small, medium size enterprise, Visible prognostics system for the machinery out of order and quality failure on the advanced factory automatic based on the embeded I.O.T technology
title_ko: 중소.중견기업에 최적화된 내장된 i.o.t기술을 응용한 첨단제품 제조 자동화 라인의 설비고장과 품질불량의 가시적 예지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a visible prognostic system of an equipment failure and a poor quality of a high-tech product manufacturing automation line utilizing an embedded I.O.T technology optimized for small or mid-sized firms. The visible prognostic system comprises: an automation production line (10); a trouble and human error processing means (20); a plurality of shop servers (30); a quality analysis center (40); a virtual personal network (50); a company server (60); and a central control tower (70). The present invention initially recognizes problems and prevents an unplanned outage to completely exclude unexpected problems in a high-tech product manufacturing automation line; identifies what is managed/why it is managed/how it is managed while a plan stops to make valid supposition possible and prevents determination based on impulsive intuition in future decision-making; increases a planned period for conveniences and makes cooperation and correction activities possible to handle an emergency situation when errors (failure and faulty) suddenly occur; makes writing of an automated integration report possible to greatly reduce waste of time taken for reporting a result as well as self-management or cooperation with a related engineer in case of faulty; and maintains prognosis, shares unexpected problems, allows related people or organizations to voluntarily participate, and develops an internal limited I.O.T technology (development of Appls) such that handling processes of occurring problems are recorded to make post evaluation possible.

title_en: Ambient vibration monitoring and processing method for building
title_ko: 건물 상시진동 모니터링 및 측정치 처리 방법
abstract_en: The present invention is to perform simultaneous control on a vibration measurement apparatus of a plurality of unspecific buildings by regularly measuring and recording vibration of a building, transmitting the vibration to an integrated server (40) at a remote place to integrally manage the vibration, and transmitting the vibration through a push service of a wireless network (60) when an abnormal situation like an earthquake or the like occurs. According to the present invention, not only a regular vibration measurement value of the building can be effectively collected and measured, but also measurement facilities installed in the plurality of unspecific buildings can be integrally controlled even when the abnormal situation like the earthquake or the like occurs, thereby collecting time series primitive information transmitted by a vibration sensor (30), and integrally managing the collected information. Therefore, the utilization of the information can be improved.
abstract_ko:

본 발명을 통하여, 건물의 상시진동 계측치를 효율적으로 수집 및 관리할 수 있을 뿐 아니라, 지진 등 이상 상황 발생시에도 불특정 다수의 건물에 설치된 계측설비를 일시에 제어하여, 진동센서(30)에서 송출되는 시계열 원시정보를 누락 없이 수집할 수 있으며, 수집된 정보를 통합 관리함으로써, 정보의 활용도를 제고할 수 있다.

title_ko: 원자력 발전소의 수소폭발 방지를 제공하는 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 원자력 발전소의 비상 보호에 관한 것으로,　특히 화재를 방지하고수냉식 발전소(WWER)로 원자력 발전소(NPP)의 보호 격납실(AO)에서 폭발성 가스의 축적을 방지하여 수소폭발 방지를 제공하는  기술에 관한 것이다. 또한,　제안된 본 발명은 다량의 경량 연료가스의 방출 및 시설의 닫힌 구내에서의 위치 파악과 관련하여 잠재적으로 위험한 비상처리를 유발할 가능성이 있는 다른 시설에 적용할 수 있다. 청구된 본 발명에 의해 달성된 기술적 결과는 다음과 같다. 원자력 발전소의 보호 범위 내에서 기체 매체를 점화할 가능성을 감소시키고,　약한 연소파의 자체 소멸 생성,　원자력 발전소의 보호 격납실에서 가스 환경의 점화시 원자력 발전소의 벽면에 가해지는 동적 하중을 줄여 충격강도를 약화시킨다. 이 기술적 결과는 원자로 발전소의 수소폭발 안전성을 확보하기 위한 방법으로서,　원자로의 보호 격납실의 환기 및 원자로의 보호 격납실 내의 수소 재조합을 촉매산화에 의해 행하는 것으로써 달성된다. 상기 해결책에 따라,　반사기가 보호 격납실에서 가압된 수소　함유 증기　-　가스 제트의 잠재적 우연한 전파경로를 따라 배치되며,　원자로의 격실 사이의 벽의 구멍(개구)는 이들 벽의 면적의　35%　이상의 크기로 형성되고, 수소 함유 증기　-　가스 혼합물의 연소의 초점의 잠재적인 위치의 장소에서 과도한 열이 제거된다.

title_en: Online cascading failure analysis method and device based on large event driving
abstract_en: The invention relates to an online cascading failure analysis method and device based on large event driving, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining predicted power flow data of each element in a power grid; determining the predicted outage probability of each element in the power grid according to the predicted power flow data of each element in the power grid; judging whether the power grid has a major event of cascading failure according to the predicted power flow data and the predicted outage probability of each element in the power grid; if yes, searching a cascading failure path of the power grid according to the current outage probability of each element in the power grid; if not, judging whether the power grid has a major event of cascading failure or not again according to the predicted power flow data and the predicted outage probability of each element in the power grid. And carrying out cascading failure analysis on the power grid based on the large event drive, and carrying out prevention and control measures on the power grid by utilizing the cascading path analysis result, so that the monitoring capability of the outage risk of the power grid equipment is enhanced.

title_en: Fire detecting apparatus and the method thereof

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire detection apparatus, using an automatic smoke detection algorithm by a camera surveillance system and an image processing technology to detect smoke and track a moving object, and then using a cascade classification model using a convolutional neural network (CNN) to divide the smoke and a non-smoke object, so as to detect fire; and a method thereof. According to the present invention, the fire detection apparatus comprises: a smoke region detection unit (110) detecting a change in a background pixel with respect to a fire detection target region image inputted from a fire surveillance camera (10) and clustering connected pixels to classify a candidate smoke region; and a smoke region classification unit (120) receiving and classifying the candidate smoke region into a smoke region and a non-smoke region so as to extract and output the smoke region when the smoke region exists.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 카메라 감시 시스템과 영상처리 기술에 의한 자동 연기 감지 알고리즘을 이용하여 연기를 감지하고 움직이는 물체를 추적한 다음 컨볼류션 신경 회로망(CNN: Convolutional Neural Network)을 사용한 캐스케이드(cascade) 분류 모델을 사용하여 연기와 연기가 없는 물체를 구분하는 것에 의해 화재를 감지할 수 있도록 하는 화재 감지 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Command and control cascade failure model method for building up based on m rank adjacency matrix
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of command and control cascade failure model method for building up based on m rank adjacency matrix, is as follows：Step 1：Calculate each node angle value and node betweenness in network；Step 2：The initial load of calculate node；Step 3：Count operation link total number；Step 4：It calculates in sensing node to the shortest path between Strike node by the item number of specified node；Step 5：Calculate operation link betweenness；Step 6：Respectively initial load is calculated according to node degree and operation link betweenness；Step 7：Foundation degree index calculate node importance；Step 8：According to operation link betweenness calculate node importance；Step 9：Calculate the initial load of network；Step 10：Load capacity model is obtained according to initial load.The application establishes nonlinear load capacity model, effectively resists the cascading failure of command and control network, to improve the survivability of network according to the non-linear relation of load and capacity.

title_en: Symmetric entropy based key line identification method for two roles of power transmission network
abstract_en: A key line identification method based on two roles of a power transmission network of symmetric entropy comprises the steps of obtaining relevant data information of the power transmission network; establishing a power evaluation quantification set of two roles of easy transmission and easy infection when the power transmission line is in normal operation; establishing a power evaluation quantification set of two roles of easy transmission and easy infection when the power transmission line runs in a fault; constructing a symmetrical entropy formula for identifying two roles of easy transmission and easy infection of the power transmission network; and identifying key lines with two roles of easy propagation and easy infection of the power transmission network by using the symmetric entropy. According to the method, two roles of easy propagation and easy infection of the key line are distinguished by constructing the symmetric entropy, and by distinguishing the two roles, the roles of the key lines with different roles in the cascading failure process are favorably disclosed, so that the key line identification is more refined.

title_en: Maintaining computational flow in a data-dependent constraint network
abstract_en: Presented are methods for determining computational flow for a data-dependent constraint network that are especially useful for modeling and trading off alternative configurations in a single computational environment, during design analysis and optimization of an engineering system. These methods leverage a preexisting constraint management system that uses a bipartite graph of variables and constraints to model an engineering system and employ logic formulae based world sets to determine the applicability of the constraints to different system configurations. These methods ensure that a data-dependent constraint network is in a consistent state, and are the essential foundation for other techniques that rely on a consistent constraint network to produce computational plans for propagating values and uncertainties through the constraint network during tradeoff analyses.
assignees: BOEING CO

title_en: Uncertain system modeling method based on interval feedback neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides an uncertain system modeling method based on an interval feedback neural network, and relates to the technical field of system modeling in an industrial process. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring actual input and output data pairs of a system; collecting system data pairs under condition UBB; normalizing the input of the actual point value and the output data of the actual interval corresponding to the actual point value; taking the normalized data as training data to perform off-line training on the interval feedback neural network to obtain a trained interval feedback neural network; and testing the trained interval feedback neural network by using the test sample and completing output value prediction. The uncertain system modeling method based on the interval feedback neural network provided by the invention utilizes the nonlinear approximation capability of the interval feedback neural network and adopts the gradient descent algorithm based on error back propagation to carry out network weight learning, thereby avoiding a large amount of input of neurons and the requirement on a system mechanism model, and being widely suitable for the modeling process of a high-order dynamic system with unknown errors and being bounded.

title_en: Urban track traffic risk chain group construction method based on multitiered network
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of urban track traffic risk chain group construction method based on multitiered network.This method includes：It determines urban track traffic risk point and risk accidents type, all risk points is constituted into risk point set, all risk accidents types are constituted into risk accidents collection；According to the connection relation between multitiered network theoretical definition risk point, the contextual definition in each layer network between each risk point is interior connection, and the connection relation between different layer network risk points is defined as outer connection；It determines that the logical relation between risk point, the logical relation include propagation relationship and correlativity, is connected to each risk point for having propagation relationship；By the last one risk point in the propagation relationship of connection and risk accidents type matching, risk chain group is formed.The present invention can global control risk accidents generating process, corresponding control measure can be taken on this basis, accident of reducing risks.

title_en: Textile fabric defect detection model and training method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a textile fabric defect detection model and a training method and application thereof, wherein the training method comprises the steps of collecting sample textile fabric defect images, establishing a data set, and establishing the textile fabric defect detection model based on YOLOv 2; using dimension clustering before training the model, and performing direct coordinate prediction, loss value calculation and back propagation during model training to obtain a current network weight parameter; and updating the network weight parameters of the textile cloth defect detection model by using the current network weight parameters, and then performing multiple times of network weight calculation and updating by using the training set to obtain the optimal network weight parameters, thereby obtaining the trained textile cloth defect detection model. And then collecting textile cloth images in real time, and detecting by using the trained textile cloth defect detection model to obtain defect detection results of the textile cloth images. The defect detection model for textile fabric defects has the advantages of high defect accuracy, strong real-time property and universality.

title_en: Riadry risk assessment method based on network risk entropy difference
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rumor risk assessment method based on network risk entropy difference, which comprises the following steps: s1, establishing a rumor propagation model based on an SIR model for a network platform to be evaluated; s2, identifying rumor sources and propagation time by using a rumor source identification method based on the network structure of the rumor propagation model; s3, simulating a rumor forward propagation process in the network structure to obtain the probability that each node in the network is in different states at the current moment; s4, calculating the maximum risk entropy and the minimum risk entropy of the network at the current moment according to the probability that each node is in different states at the current moment; s5, calculating the network risk entropy at the current moment by using the maximum risk entropy and the minimum risk entropy of the network at the current moment; s6, calculating the network risk entropy difference according to the network risk entropy of the network at the current moment and the previous moment, and evaluating the potential risk of the rumor at the current moment on the network platform according to the network risk entropy difference. The invention can quantitatively and accurately evaluate the risk of the rumor on the network in real time.

title_en: Management server, control method and control program in power exchange network system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To construct a power exchange network system which enables an individual to easily buy and sell power, and is useful even during service interruption caused by disaster or accident.SOLUTION: A management server for managing a power exchange system which has a shop or the like expanding in the whole country or a region as an axis comprises power exchange management means which stores power to power storage means prepared in the shop or the like through a power line or through an electric vehicle from a user's dwelling house, and manages the shop or the like and the user who purchases power to the user's dwelling house through the power line or through the electric vehicle from the power storage means. Here, the management server prepares power points given or consumed by power exchange, and can apply the power point to purchase of power in the shop or the like or value payment of merchandise or the like by using the power point. Moreover, the management server comprises processing means at the time of the service interruption which changes the service interruption region or the shop or the like adjacent to the service interruption region into a mode at the time of the service interruption, according to acquisition of service interruption information including the range of the service interruption region, when the service interruption occurs in a specific region, and executes special processing at the time of the service interruption.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Quantitative detection method for sea surface typhoon wind field
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quantitative detection method for a sea surface typhoon wind field, which comprises the following steps: establishing and training a back propagation neural network, wherein a training set comprises back scattering coefficients of microwave scatterometers in a plurality of wind units, polarization modes of the back scattering coefficients, observation incidence angles, azimuth angle information, numerical values of observation brightness and temperature of a multi-band microwave radiometer, corresponding observation frequency bands, polarization modes, observation angles and corresponding wind field numerical values; and acquiring observation data in real time or in a specified period, and inputting the observation data into the trained back propagation neural network to obtain a wind field value in real time or in the specified period. The quantitative detection method can improve the measurement accuracy of the sea surface typhoon wind field.

title_en: A kind of multipotency streaming system optimizing operation method considering region heat supply network transient state heat-transfer character
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of multipotency streaming system optimizing operation methods considering region heat supply network transient state heat-transfer character, including：Step 1) establishes the region heat supply network transient state heat-transfer character model for considering return pipe net topological structure, pipeline section temperature change dynamic process and pipeline section propagation delay time based on graph theory, which includes mainly six aspect contents：Heat source characteristic, thermic load characteristic, node flow balance, node power fusion characteristics, pipeline section heat-transfer character and pipeline section temporarily/steady state heat transfer Performance criteria；Step 2) establishes multipotency streaming system optimal operation model, with the minimum object function of total operating cost in 4 hours futures of system, the operation constraints that should meet in conjunction with system, determine each equipment in multipotency streaming system it is real-time contribute, the real-time supply and return water temperature etc. of each heat source of heat supply network, realize that the United Dispatching of system and optimization are run.The present invention considers the transient state heat-transfer character of region heat supply network, and the optimized operation state of multipotency streaming system is made more to coincide with actual motion state.

title_en: Assessing network assets based on downstream events and measurements
abstract_en: A method for rating network assets based on downstream events may include: receiving communications from one or more sensors in the power distribution network, the communications indicating an occurrence of a network event; calculating, for each network asset in an affected area of the network, a probability of the network asset causing the problem indicated by the event; calculating, for each network asset in an affected area of the network, a propagation probability of the network asset causing the problem; calculating a probability of network asset failure for each network asset in an affected area of the network based on the probabilities and the propagation probabilities; comparing the probability of the network asset failing to a threshold; based on the comparison, determining the network asset having the highest probability of failure; and controlling one of more other network assets to alleviate the problem.

title_en: Seismic data-based oil and gas reservoir distribution-oriented convolutional neural network learning and predicting method
abstract_en: A seismic data-based oil and gas reservoir distribution-oriented convolutional neural network learning and predicting method. Said method comprises firstly taking original seismic data as a basis, extracting seismic attributes which can represent oil and gas characteristics; then designing a convolutional neural network model, taking several preferred seismic attributes as an input layer of a network, extracting seismic attribute values at a well location, taking the void ratio, permeability and oiliness of the well location as a training sample, performing back propagation by means of a BP neural network, so as to continuously correct parameters such as the convolution kernel, weight W and bias b until the model training is completed; and then testing data of an area having no wells, so as to implement lateral prediction of reservoirs from an area having wells to an area having no wells. Said method directly performs convolutional neural network learning on oil and gas sensitive attribute bodies, being able to implement lateral prediction of seismic information characteristics of unknown seismic reservoirs in the same block and even cross regions.

abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of wisdom prison generalized information management system, including front end hardware equipment and back-end processing system.Front end hardware equipment includes mainly graphic images acquisition module, it is seen that light image acquisition module, infrared emission detecting module, front end recognition module, handheld terminal, comprehensive management module, A/D conversion modules.Back end processing module includes rear end recognition detection module, multiple cascading networks module, emergency command module, central processing regulation and control module, GIS positioning display modules, voice monitoring and broadcast module, information inquiry module, personal management module.The visible images acquisition module is all connected with the input terminal of front end recognition module with graphic images acquisition module output end；The front end recognition module and infrared emission detecting module are connected with comprehensive management module；Handheld terminal is connected with A/D conversion modules.A/D conversion module back-end processings are connected.This practical advantage is personnel positioning, high-definition video monitoring, recognition of face and image trace.The safety management of the Code in Hazardous Special Locations such as detention house, prison is met, while being also beneficial to resource-sharing and the personnel placement scheduling on the ground such as each detention house, prison.

title_en: Mechanical fault diagnosis method using parallel deep neural network hierarchical feature extraction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mechanical fault diagnosis method based on parallel deep neural network hierarchical feature extraction, which comprises the following steps: taking a rotating machinery fault data set as a sample set to obtain initial parameters of a deep neural network model; inputting all samples in the sample set into a deep neural network model to obtain an output result; comparing the output result with the sample label, and calculating a total classification error; calculating the error of each layer by using the classification error through an error back propagation algorithm, and updating the parameters of the network; recalculating the output result of each sample by using the deep neural network model after the network parameters are updated; and (5) performing iteration until the classification error reaches a preset value or the iteration frequency reaches an upper limit, and outputting network parameters and a classification result. The invention directly takes the collected mechanical signal as input, avoids a large amount of preprocessing operation, and improves the classification precision and the calculation efficiency by the layered feature extraction of the parallel deep neural network.

title_en: Upstream and downstream water level prediction method for cascade power station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting upstream and downstream water levels of a cascade power station, which comprises the following steps: step 1, selecting an input variable and an output variable; step 2, carrying out standardization processing on the data to eliminate the influence of dimensions; step 3, determining input vector dimension, LSTM layer number, output vector dimension and time step; step 4, forward propagation process and error backward propagation process of LSTM; the forward propagation process is sequentially input into the LSTM network according to time steps to obtain corresponding output values; the sum of the squares of the errors of the output value and the true value is taken as a loss function, and the parameters are updated by carrying out reverse propagation of the errors along the time; and 5, performing multi-time continuous prediction by using the trained model. The LSTM is applied to the water level prediction of the cascade power station, so that the hysteresis influence information of an upstream power station on a downstream power station can be captured, the prediction precision is improved, and more reliable theoretical support is provided for scientific scheduling decision.

title_en: Improved NSGA-III-based multi-objective optimization scheduling method for cascade hydropower station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-objective optimization scheduling method for a cascade hydropower station based on improved NSGA-III, which comprises the steps of obtaining basic information of the cascade hydropower station; establishing a multi-target power generation optimization scheduling mathematical model considering water balance and other hard constraints; generating an initial population and an initialization reference point based on Latin hypercube sampling; initializing the reproduction rate of each operator, and generating offspring based on the reproduction rate of each operator; merging the parent and the offspring, calculating the fitness value of the individuals, performing non-dominant sorting, and taking the parent P with high non-dominant sorting level as the next generation evolution parent t+1 (ii) a According to P t+1 Calculating the reproduction rate of each operator and executing generation of filial generation operation; and combining the parent population and the child population, performing non-dominated sorting, selecting the dominant individuals to form a new population, calculating the reproduction rate of each operator, and repeating iteration until a termination condition is met. The method improves the economic benefit of the hydropower station and the operation stability of the power grid.

title_en: Device for supplying DC voltage using power of equivalent signal of traffic signal light

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a direct current voltage substituting and supplying device using equivalent signal power of a crosswalk pedestrian signal light. The present invention comprises: a first diode bridge; a second diode bridge; a charging capacitor; a transformer; a switching unit; and a pulse width control unit. In a blackout situation in which a red signal light is not operated, an alternating current voltage is supplied from a green signal light to provide an output voltage. In a blackout situation in which a green signal light is not operated, an alternating current voltage is supplied from a red signal light to provide an output voltage.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 횡단보도 보행자 신호등의 등가 신호 전력을 이용한 직류 전압 치환 공급 장치는, 횡단보도 보행자 신호등의 레드 신호등 제어용 교류 전압과 접지 전압을 전달받아 전파 정류 전압을 제공하는 제 1 다이오드 브리지와; 횡단보도 보행자 신호등의 그린 신호등 제어용 교류 전압과 접지 전압을 전달받아 전파 정류 전압을 제공하는 제 2 다이오드 브리지와; 상기 제 1 다이오드 브리지가 제공하는 전파 정류 전압을 전달받아 충전하고, 상기 제 2 다이오드 브리지가 제공하는 전파 정류 전압을 전달받아 충전하는 충전 커패시터와; 상기 충전 커패시터에 충전되어 있는 제 1 다이오드 브리지의 전파 정류 전압과 제 2 다이오드 브리지의 전파 정류 전압을 전달받아 필요한 출력 전압으로 변압하는 트랜스포머와; 상기 트랜스포머의 입력단을 온오프시키는 스위칭부; 및 상기 스위칭부(FET)에 인가되는 상기 제 1 다이오드 브리지(DIODE BRIDGE1)에서 제공되는 레드 신호등 제어용의 전파 정류 전압 또는 제 2 다이오드 브리지(DIODE BRIDGE2)에서 제공되는 그린 신호등 제어용의 전파 정류 전압에 대한 입력 신호의 듀티비(duty ratio)를 조절하는 펄스폭 제어부를 포함하며, 상기 레드 신호등 제어용 교류 전압과 상기 그린 신호등 제어용 교류 전압을 이용하여 횡단보도 신호등과 연계되어 레드 신호등이 작동하지 않는 정전 시에는 그린 신호등으로부터 교류 전압을 제공받아 출력 전압을 제공하고, 그린 신호등이 작동하지 않는 정전 시에는 레드 신호등으로부터 교류 전압을 제공받아 보행안전을 위한 장치 및 시설물에 출력 전압으로 제공하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Measuring system for air quality
title_ko: 공기질 측정 시스템
abstract_en: An air quality measurement system comprises: a measurement module for measuring indoor air quality, and including a floating matter detection sensor for detecting the size, number, and concentration of floating matters by irradiating laser beams to floating matters (particle) floating in air; a data communications network for transferring information of the indoor air quality measured by the measurement module; a data collection server for receiving the information of the indoor air quality through the data communications network, and collecting outdoor weather information and outdoor air quality information; a control server for receiving each air quality information collected by the data collection server; a database for providing correspondence information to the control server by holding the correspondence information corresponding to each information of air quality; and a user terminal for receiving each of the information of air quality and the corresponding information from the control server. Accordingly, extremely ultra-fine dust of PM 1.0 may be detected early, and a service performer or a beneficiary may recognize a current state. Therefore, various service scenarios can be provided, so that service performance or service indication can be performed, a service beneficiary can recognize a situation early through a warning alarm or an alarm indication in the event of exposure of a harmful substance causing serious damage to a human body or occurrence of a fire, and the situation can be quickly propagate to promote subsequent tasks.
