title_en: Method for constructing supply chain network risk cascade model
abstract_en: A method for constructing a risk cascade model of a supply chain network comprises the following steps: s1, constructing a supply chain network G with enterprises as nodes N and trade relations among the enterprises as edges E; s2, calculating an initial risk value of each node by adopting a function of the degree and the betweenness; s3, calculating the maximum tolerance risk value of each node according to the proportional relation between the node capacity and the initial risk; s4, calculating the current risk value of each node at the current moment; s5, comparing the current risk value and the maximum tolerance risk value of each node, and determining a failure state; and S6, if the current risk value of a certain node exceeds the maximum tolerance value, judging that the node fails, and performing load redistribution according to the capacity of the surrounding adjacent nodes. The invention has clear logic, mature scheme and clear operation process and has good use and popularization foundation.

title_en: Combined operation control method for cascade reservoir group flood discharge facilities
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined operation control method for a cascade reservoir group flood discharge facility, which comprises the following steps: s1: step reservoir group flood scheduling theory research and analysis; s2: the flood discharge facilities use digitalization, and a classification calculation method of a flood discharge facility combination scheme is adopted to simplify the processing; s3: the flood discharge facility combines the dynamic control technology. The invention has the advantages that: the precision of the reservoir discharge curve can be greatly improved; the fine control level of reservoir flood discharge facilities is improved; the problems of low control accuracy, large workload and the like of the flood discharge facilities are solved, and the refinement and the intellectualization of the operation control of the reservoir flood discharge facilities are facilitated.

title_en: A kind of power distribution network regulation and administration weak link identification method based on cascade weight
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of power distribution network regulation and administration weak link identification methods based on cascade weight, are primarily based on analytic hierarchy structure, calculate power distribution network regulation and administration base values and cascade weight；Then using index connection weight between entropy assessment calculating power distribution network regulation and administration level；The contribution margin of each base values is finally calculated according to the calculated result of step S1 and step S2, and it is sorted from low to high, contribution margin is lower, and weak degree is higher, to realize that weak link recognizes.The present invention can scientifically and accurately identify the weak link in power distribution network regulation and administration business.

title_en: A kind of social networks degree of belief calculation method based on evidence theory
abstract_en: A kind of social networks degree of belief calculation method based on evidence theory, including A1,60~90% are chosen from all users as training users and being trained；Training user is investigated in A2, training process when making trust decisions to the preference of attribute；A3, several first interval numbers are generated by preference of all training users to attribute；A4, second interval number is converted by the attribute of user to be assessed；A5, it is generated by first interval number and second interval number and trusts evidence；B1, the risk probability for refusing combination family is leaked by connection relationship calculating user's Content of Communication between user；B2, risk evidence is generated by risk probability；C1, the degree of belief between user is obtained to trust evidence and risk evidence progress evidence fusion.The present invention has comprehensively considered user when making trust decisions to the degree of concern for being evaluated each dimension social attribute of user and to two factors of worry of propagation path privacy compromise risk, and the result of trust decisions is made accurately to agree with the trust psychology demand of user.
assignees: UNIV ZHENGZHOU

title_ko: 비행기구들을 보강하기 위한 시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko: 공기 보다 가벼운 리프트에 기초한 많은 시스템들에 적용 가능하고, 구조적 지지 및 네트워크 상호 연결을 위한 안전 장치가 되어 있는(fail-safe) 비행기구 시스템이 논의된다.  발명은 보강 구조 및 최적 연결부와 통합 구조(보강 및 통합 구조(2))를 구비한 시스템으로서, 안전 장치가 되어 있는 설계를 가지는 수소 셀 또는 수소 셀들을 보강하는 시스템을 기재한다.  이론적 구조는 폭발력들을 견디기에 충분히 강하고, 충격파 손상 및 화재의 전파를 피하고, 수소 셀 또는 셀들(1)은 자동적으로 자기 제어되고, 리프트 강도 및 다중 파라미터 제어를 획득하도록 독립적으로 작동한다.
assignees: MELO ANDRE AUGUSTO CEBALLOS

title_en: Computer-implemented method, computer-readable storage medium, and computer system for providing technical selection parameters for energy supply systems
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a computer-implemented method of providing technical selection parameters for an energy supply system providing electrical energy to a facility connected to a public power grid that may experience service interruption, comprising the steps of: inputting a power consumption schedule of the facility (S1); inputting a photovoltaic production capacity limit and an energy storage unit capacity limit (S9); estimating a ratio of self-sufficient or self-consuming or internal profitability (S11); displaying a plurality of energy supply system configurations on the user interface device (S13); wherein each configuration is associated to a sensitivity parameter allowing to determine an optimized technical choice parameter of the energy supply system with respect to the reliability of the public power grid. The invention also relates to a computer readable storage medium having stored therein instructions intended to be executed on a computer system for implementing the computer implemented method.

title_en: Transformer oil density prediction model modeling method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a modeling method and a device of a transformer oil density prediction model, which optimize a first transformer oil density regression prediction model established by a back propagation neural network based on temperature compensation and a genetic algorithm, establish a nonlinear mapping relation between transformer oil multi-frequency ultrasonic parameters and oil density by adopting the genetic algorithm, and reduces the error influence brought by the mapping relation by temperature compensation, realizes the regression prediction of the transformer oil density, has the characteristics of high efficiency, high speed and strong self-adaptive learning capability, the transformer oil density can be directly monitored through the regression prediction model, the size of the transformer oil density can be obtained in real time, the prediction result is accurate and reliable, the problems that the existing transformer oil density testing method is time-consuming and labor-consuming are solved, and the real oil density of the transformer can not be monitored in real time and accurately reflected.

title_en: Fire response characteristic and physicochemical property damage experiment platform for high-voltage transmission line
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-voltage transmission line fire response characteristic and physicochemical property damage experiment platform, which comprises a fire source occurrence and steel core aluminum stranded wire coupling action module A, a mass loss and thermal field data acquisition module B1, a smoke dust characteristic and component analysis module B2, a steel core aluminum stranded wire surface state and mechanical and electrical property characterization module B3, a line melt acquisition and analysis module B4 and a computer; the modules B1-4 are respectively connected with the module A, and each item of collected data is stored in a computer. The advantages are that: systematically discussing the evolution characteristics of mechanical properties, electrical properties and component phase states of the steel-cored aluminum stranded wire before and after the fire under the coupling action of the mountain fire nonlinear coupling propagation process and the power transmission line; the method has the advantages of accurately grasping the fire damage characteristics and mechanisms of the power transmission line, revealing key influencing factors and behavior sequences of mountain fire for inducing the tripping of the high-voltage power transmission line, and having important engineering significance for disaster action modes, characteristics, mechanisms and prevention of mountain fire on the high-voltage power transmission line in intelligent power grid high-voltage power transmission.

title_en: Method for modeling and optimizing cascade failure survivability of airspace sector network
abstract_en: The invention defines the cascade failure of the airspace sector network, adopts an improved capacity-load model, combines a network topological structure with the actual work of the airspace management, considers the flow and the airspace structure to define the load of the network nodes of the airspace sector, and defines the capacity of the node of the sector which is more in line with the actual situation of the airspace management. And establishing a model according to the cascade failure process of the airspace sector network, and determining a critical threshold value and a sector abnormal rate as a measure index of the cascade failure survivability of the airspace sector network. And optimizing the cascade failure survivability of the airspace sector network by optimizing a load redistribution mode, and providing a strategy of adjacent load redistribution and local load redistribution based on the residual capacity. Taking a central and south control sector network as an example to perform an analog simulation cascade failure process, analyzing to obtain that a sector node which is close to a large-load capacity sector node and has a small value and strength is easy to become a failure bottleneck, and simultaneously finding out a congestion bottleneck node; further simulation verifies that the critical threshold value and the abnormal sector rate can be reduced by both optimization strategies.

title_en: Method for reconstructing running track of main road vehicle based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for reconstructing a running track of a main road vehicle based on multi-source data fusion. The method aims to comprehensively and accurately reproduce the time-space distribution and the evolution rule of the main road traffic state, so that the estimation and prediction precision of the traffic state parameters is improved, and the signal control benefit is improved. Based on the variational theory of three-dimensional shock waves, firstly, estimating the slopes of a forward arc and a backward arc by adopting fixed-point detector data, and establishing an initial artery space-time network diagram; secondly, estimating a queuing propagation curve profile by fusing floating car data and signal timing data; and finally, reconstructing a complete running track of the vehicle based on a shortest-path algorithm under the constraints of three dimensions of the floating vehicle track, the queuing boundary and the signal timing. The method solves the technical problems that the vehicle running track is difficult to accurately estimate in the current congestion state and the research based on the sampling track data has high permeability requirement at present.

title_en: Cascading failure risk assessment method and system for high-proportion wind power integration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascading failure risk assessment method and a cascading failure risk assessment system for high-proportion wind power integration, wherein the cascading failure risk assessment method comprises the following steps: establishing a wind power prediction error model according to the historical data of the wind power prediction error to obtain wind power output distribution; selecting an initial fault set; and (3) starting accident chain search when a certain fault of the initial fault set occurs: judging whether the power system is disconnected, if so, carrying out island balance and stopping current accident chain search; and if the power system is not split, performing random load flow calculation, if the load flow calculation result is not converged to a preset value, performing load shedding control, and calculating a power system load loss risk index and a line importance index according to the generated accident chain set. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, the influence caused by wind power uncertainty is fully considered in the accident chain evolution process, the risk assessment of the system is more comprehensive, and the method is suitable for the background of high-proportion wind power grid connection.

title_en: A kind of pumping plant unit diagnostic method based on depth forest and oneself coding
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of based on depth forest and from the pumping plant unit diagnostic method of coding, is related to hydraulic fault diagnosis technology field.This method, Feature Conversion is carried out to the original vibration signal first with more granularities scanning of depth forest, then unsupervised feature learning is carried out from coding structure using multilayer, obtain the feature vector with fault signature, training step by step for supervision is carried out in the cascade forest of feature vector substitution depth forest described in finally obtaining with fault signature, final classification is obtained as a result, completing pumping plant unit intelligent diagnostics.Using depth forest model, deep neural network is avoided applied to the complicated theory analysis in fault diagnosis field, cumbersome tune ginseng process；Using multilayer from encoding, it is big to avoid dimension in cascade forest training, time-consuming big problem；The limitation of manual features extraction and the problem that shallow-layer machine learning diagnostic accuracy is low are avoided, the end-to-end intelligent trouble diagnosis from primary monitoring data is realized.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Dynamic hydropower station load adjustment method based on unilateral matching mechanism
abstract_en: The invention provides a hydropower station load dynamic adjustment method based on a unilateral matching mechanism, which comprises the following steps: acquiring an initial scheduling process; determining a load adjustment time t, and calculating a load matching coefficient R of the upper and lower hydropower stations on the current day; making a load adjustment strategy based on a unilateral matching mechanism; carrying out full-period scheduling calculation, and implementing operation water level and river flood prevention early warning judgment; outputting a load adjustment scheme meeting the early warning requirement, and analyzing the matching of the load process before and after adjustment of the cascade hydropower station; and evaluating the safety of the obtained scheme in both reservoir dispatching and power grid operation. Aiming at the defects of the prior art, the invention provides a hydropower station load dynamic adjustment method based on a unilateral matching mechanism, which improves the matching performance of the upstream and downstream step load processes, promotes the adaptability of the hydropower station regulation capacity to the uncertainty of the incoming water and the load process, and ensures the operation safety of the hydropower station.

title_en: APSO-BP-based double-counterweight-disc automatic balance control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an APSO-BP (active power generation-back propagation) -based automatic balance control method for a double-counterweight plate, which combines a BP neural network, fully utilizes balance data of each time, fits and optimizes balancing parameters and realizes automatic balance control. The input parameters are the initial positions A1 and B1 of the two balance blocks, the rotating speed N and the unbalanced force The optimization objective is the system vibration response The optimal output is the target positions A2, B2 of the two weights. On the premise that initial positions, rotating speeds and initial values of system vibration response are obtained, a BP neural network is used for fitting system vibration values, and optimization is carried out by combining self-adaptive particle swarm to obtain the optimal target positions of the two balancing weights. The particle swarm can be optimized by utilizing an improved method for adaptively adjusting the weight value according to the fitting input-output relationship of the neural system, so that the global optimization is facilitated, the convergence speed is accelerated, and the control accuracy of the automatic balancing system and the data validity are improved.

title_en: Short-term optimization scheduling model considering step dynamic water flow time lag
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grids, and discloses a short-term optimization scheduling model considering cascade dynamic water flow time lag, which comprises the following steps: constructing an original model; constructing a multi-section real time lag mixed integer linear programming model; linearizing the two-dimensional nonlinear relation of the water level and the reservoir capacity by using a piecewise linearization method; linearizing a two-dimensional nonlinear relation of tail water level and discharge capacity by using a piecewise linear method; linearizing the three-dimensional nonlinear relation of the power station power characteristic curve by using a three-dimensional linear interpolation method; converting an original model considering the short-term optimization scheduling of the step dynamic water flow time lag into a mixed integer linear programming model; and optimally scheduling the cascade hydropower station group by using a mixed integer linear programming model. The method can be used for describing the water flow delay finely in the short-term optimized dispatching of the cascade hydropower station.

title_en: A kind of human skeleton extracting method relied on based on joint
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of human skeleton extracting methods relied on based on joint, comprising the following steps: S1, image data collection is pre-processed and expanded, and is divided into training set and test set；The human skeleton that S2, building joint rely on extracts network；S3, the human skeleton that training set input joint relies on is extracted into network, the human skeleton for obtaining joint dependence extracts the prediction category in network model and joint；S4, the prediction category according to joint extract network model to the human skeleton that joint relies on using back-propagation algorithm and optimize, and the human skeleton for obtaining optimal joint dependence extracts network model；S5, the human skeleton that test set input optimal joint relies on is extracted into network model, obtains the test category in joint；S6, the test category according to joint, extract human skeleton；The present invention solves the problems, such as that optimization of the existing technology is difficult, process is complicated, the relationship modeling effect between joint is poor, accuracy is low and practicability is low.
assignees: UNIV ELECTRONIC SCI & TECH CHINA

title_en: Data center heat management method based on temperature prediction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data center heat management method based on temperature prediction, which is characterized in that a joint prediction framework is established to realize a data center temperature prediction algorithm based on a neural network according to the local characteristics of heat propagation of a data center, a server node is used for operating data, wireless sensor data and CFD simulation data in real time to train an artificial neural network prediction model, and the inlet temperature distribution of a data center server is predicted; and then managing the temperature of each node of the data center by using a feedback control strategy, and performing heat management by adjusting the working load of the nodes. The invention aims to research a heat management method of a data center, and the energy consumption of refrigeration equipment is the lowest on the premise of ensuring the heat safety requirement of the data center.

title_en: A kind of short-term load forecasting method of multi-model fused neural network
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of short-term load forecasting method of multi-model fused neural network, step are as follows: data acquisition and pretreatment obtain data set；It is training set and verifying collection by Segmentation of Data Set；Individually a variety of models of the construction based on back-propagation algorithm, use the input vector sequence training pattern of training set；Use the output of a variety of independent models as input one top layer DNN model of training；By individually trained model and top layer DNN Model Fusion, accurate adjustment is carried out；Trained model is verified with verifying collection, by the precision and error of contrast test collection and verifying collection, adjusts model parameter, by repeatedly training, the model for selecting verifying collection to behave oneself best is as training result；When relatively large deviation occur in predicted value and actual value training set training pattern again is added in latest data by moving model in the actual environment.The present invention reduces the complexity of deployment by the way of independent training, combination tuning, and precision is better than single model, has good practical value.

title_en: A kind of emotion Internet communication dynamic model based on SIRS and the emotion propagation analogy method using the model
abstract_en: A kind of emotion Internet communication dynamic model based on SIRS of the present invention and the emotion propagation analogy method using the model, by improving original traditional viral transmission model, provide the kinetics equation of SIRS propagation model, the stability of the model is proved, it compares classics SIRS viral transmission and the simulation experiment result analysis is carried out to each emotion variable density, which can preferably react emotion propagation characteristic.The present invention by emotion this subjective psychology concept together with social networks action amalgamation, reasonable mapping that both model accurately reflects.It can be used for similar negative public sentiment event mood wave fission in propagation process.

title_en: Complex network-based fraud group recognition and risk propagation prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fraud group identification and risk propagation prediction method based on a complex network, which comprises the following steps: acquiring individual attributes; determining an attribute value unique code of the subject attribute and the non-subject attribute; filtering data; establishing a data structure for storage and calculation; establishing a connected graph, abstracting the main body attribute values and the non-main body attribute values into nodes, abstracting the attribution relationship of the main body attribute values and the non-main body attribute values into edges connecting the nodes, wherein the nodes and the edges form the connected graph; obtaining a model diagram according to the connected diagram; calculating model parameters according to the data structure; and carrying out fraud group identification and fraud risk propagation prediction according to the model parameters. The method calculates the model parameters according to the knowledge of the graph theory and carries out hierarchy on the model graph according to the known cheating users, thereby achieving the aim of accurately identifying cheating groups and forecasting cheating risk propagation.

title_en: Machine predictive maintenance method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a machine predictive maintenance method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: collecting a vibration signal of the screw rod during operation from the screw rod by using a vibration sensor; collecting signals with a sliding frame in a fixed length; randomly selecting samples to construct a training set and a testing set database, and marking the training set and the testing set as impulse response and non-impulse response; training data sets and test data and learning models for training and testing the sparse automatic encoder layer and the error back propagation neural network layer; determining the dynamic performance of the screw rod along with the time according to the impulse response; using indexes based on the similarity of dynamic performance to indicate and monitor the service life state of the screw rod; the maximum speed, acceleration, and the like are limited depending on the life. The invention firstly predicts the service life, limits the highest rotating speed, the highest load and the like of the screw rod on the basis of the service life, and achieves the purposes of prolonging the service life and improving the utilization rate by limiting the highest rotating speed or the acceleration and the like of the screw rod.

title_en: Short-term power load prediction method
abstract_en: The invention provides a short-term power load forecasting method, which comprises the steps of establishing a short-term power load forecasting model based on a front-stage and back-stage BP cascade neural network, clustering historical power load data by adopting an improved maximum deviation similarity criterion clustering algorithm, carrying out hierarchical clustering on class centers, obtaining similar load classes of a forecasting day through class cluster combination, and taking load data of a Z class as training data of the back-stage BP neural network, thereby improving the convergence speed and the forecasting precision of the neural network. The short-term power load prediction method provided by the invention has the advantages of high calculation speed and high prediction precision, and can better meet the demand of a power grid on power load prediction.

title_en: Auxiliary radio communication system based on optical cable
title_ko: 광케이블 기반 무선통신 보조 설비 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an auxiliary wireless communication facility system based on optical cables. The auxiliary wireless communication facility system includes: a wireless communication module which transmits, receives, and relays wireless communication signals including, at least, fire radio signals and disaster broadcast signals while additionally including terrestrial trunked radio (TETRA) signals and public safety LTE (PS-LTE) signals; a master unit (MU) which converts electric signals corresponding to the wireless communication signals to optical signals using multiplexing and wavelength division schemes to output the optical signals as well as converting the optical signals converted by using multiplexing and wavelength division schemes before being transmitted through optical cables to the electric signals to transmit the electric signals to an optical module; multiple remote units (RUs) which is installed in a high-rise building or under the ground with a weak wave propagation rate and transmits and receives the optical signals converted by using multiplexing and wavelength division schemes; and an optical coupler which generates the optical signals converted by using the multiplexing and wavelength division schemes to be output from the MU in a number matching the number of the RUs, transmits the optical signals to the individual RUs through the optical cables, and couples the optical signals converted by using the multiplexing and wavelength division schemes before being transmitted to the individual RUs to transmit the optical signals through the optical cables. Each of the RUs can receive the optical signals converted by using the multiplexing and wavelength division schemes from the optical coupler, converts the optical signals to wireless communication signals, outputs the wireless communication signals to enable the communication with wireless communication devices, and receives the wireless communication signals from the wireless communication devices to convert the wireless communication signals to the electric signals and generate the optical signals converted by using multiplexing and wavelength division schemes. The optical signals can be transmitted to the optical coupler through the optical cables.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 광케이블 기반의 무선통신 보조설비 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 그 무선통신 보조설비 시스템은 적어도 소방무선신호 및 재난방송 신호를 포함하고, TETRA 신호와, PS-LTE 신호가 더 포함될 수 있는 무선통신 신호들을 송수신 및 중계하는 무선통신모듈과, 그 무선통신 신호들에 상응하는 전기신호를 파장분할 다중화된 광신호로 변환하여 출력하고, 광케이블을 통해 수신되는 파장분할 다중화된 광신호를 전기신호로 변환하여 무선통신 모듈로 전달하는 광모듈을 구비하는 마스터장비(MU); 전파의 도달이 원활하지 않는 지하나 고층건물에 설치되며, 파장분할 다중화된 광신호를 송수신하는 복수의 리모트 장비(RUs); 및 마스터 장비로부터 출력되는 파장분할 다중화된 광신호를 복수의 리모트 장비 수 만큼 생성하여 광케이블을 통해 리모트 장비 각각에게 전달하고, 리모트 장비 각각으로부터 수신되는 파장분할 다중화된 광신호를 결합하여 광케이블을 통해 전달하는 광커플러를 포함하고, 리모트 장비 각각은 광커플러로 부터 파장분할 다중화된 신호를 수신하여 무선통신기기들과 통신할 수 있는 무선통신 신호로 변환하여 출력하고, 무선통신 기기들로부터 무선통신 신호를 수신하여 전기신호로 변환하여 파장분할 다중화된 신호로 생성하여 광케이블을 통해 광커플러로 전송한다.

title_en: Control method and system of wire nonlinear vibration controller
abstract_en: The invention relates to a control method and a system of a conductor nonlinear vibration controller, which determine output displacement based on external excitation of a transmission conductor; inputting the external excitation and the output displacement into a pre-established wire nonlinear vibration controller to obtain a control force amplitude required by wire vibration prevention; outputting feedback external excitation to the lead according to the control force amplitude, the preset frequency and a preset actuator; and realizing the control of the wire nonlinear vibration controller through power flow propagation based on the feedback external excitation force. The wire nonlinear vibration controller based on the power flow theory realizes active defense against wind vibration disasters of the power transmission line, improves the capability of the power transmission line in resisting natural disasters, ensures the operation safety of the power transmission line and improves the power supply reliability of a power grid.

title_en: Business risk recognition methods, device and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: This application provides a kind of business risk recognition methods, which comprises pre-establishes enterprise network figure, includes the side collection between associated nodes and the associated nodes in the enterprise network figure；Risk assessment request is responded, determines the first associated nodes corresponding with risk assessment request in enterprise's network chart；Enterprise's network chart is begun stepping through from first associated nodes, determines that the associated nodes and side concentrate risks and assumptions and the Risk of Communication path for meeting preset condition.In this manner, the weight of associated nodes and the weight of propagation path codetermine suitable path and go to traverse, and obtain the biggish associated nodes of weight and propagation path, so that the risk analysis result to enterprise is more accurate and efficient.

title_en: Fire-fighting management system for apartment house
title_ko: 공동주택의 전기와 통신시설을 이용한 소방관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire-fighting management system using electricity and a communications facility of an apartment house. It is possible to prevent occurrence of a fire in advance by monitoring electricity usage situations of households in an apartment house such as a studio, an efficiency apartment, or the like in real time and by immediately propagating worries about occurrence of a fire to an electric facility manager of a corresponding apartment house and a household member of a corresponding household when there is a household causing worries about occurrence of a fire. The fire-fighting management system using electric and a communications facility of an apartment house according to the present invention comprises: a fire risk detection unit which includes a control module, a fire detection facility, a detection sensor module, a disaster prevention device, a wired/wireless communications network, and a computer, and is installed on a distribution board of an apartment house; a fire risk analysis unit which is installed to be linked to the fire risk detection unit on or around the distribution board; and a first communications module and a second communications module.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 아파트, 오피스텔 등의 공동주택에서 세대들의 전기 사용 상황이 실시간 감시되고 이를 통해 화재 발생이 우려되는 세대 존재 시 그 사실이 해당 공동주택의 전기시설 관리자 및 해당 세대의 세대원에게 즉시 전파되어 화재 발생이 사전에 차단될 수 있도록 하는 공동주택의 전기와 통신시설을 이용한 소방관리 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명에 따른 공동주택의 전기와 통신시설을 이용한 소방관리 시스템은 제어 모듈, 화재탐지설비, 감지 센서 모듈, 방재장치, 유무선 통신망 및 컴퓨터를 포함하는 동시에 공동주택의 분전반에 설치되는 화재위험 감지부 및 상기 분전반 내지 그 주변에 상기 화재위험 감지부와 연계되도록 설치되는 화재위험 분석부, 제1 통신모듈 및 제2 통신모듈을 더 포함하여 구성된다.

abstract_en: This application discloses a kind of disaster tolerance system and a kind of disaster recovery method, which includes: main storage subsystem, the business datum sent for receiving production host；First passes through the business datum that the first asynchronous remote copy link is sent from storage subsystem, for receiving the main storage subsystem；Second passes through the business datum that the second asynchronous remote copy link is sent from storage subsystem from storage subsystem, for receiving described first.The application by main storage system and first between storage system the first asynchronous remote copy link, first realize cascade networking mode from the second asynchronous remote copy link between storage system from storage system and second; and then realize the data protection of more copies, improve the safety of business datum；In addition, can be utilized after breaking down from the Backup Data adapter tube business in storage system, the probability of service disconnection is reduced.

title_en: A kind of training method and device of service quality assessment model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of training method of service quality assessment model and devices, wherein this method comprises: according to machine performance data, network characterization data and the quality monitoring data of fixed cycle acquisition service node；Characteristic value is determined based on the machine performance data and the network characterization data；Aimed quality data are determined based on the quality monitoring data；Utilize the characteristic value and the aimed quality data；Service quality assessment model is constructed using the training set.The indexs such as machine performance data, network characterization data and service quality are associated by the present invention by the Feature Engineering function of deep neural network itself, it is trained in conjunction with back-propagation algorithm, and it is fitted non-linear relation therein, the artificial time loss for carrying out Feature Engineering, while the accuracy for assessment of improving service quality can be reduced.
assignees: WANGSU SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid stability real-time prediction method based on adaptive neural network
abstract_en: A generator rotor angle prediction method based on an adaptive artificial neural network comprises the following steps: generating data by adopting an automatic data generation algorithm and storing the data in a database; normalizing data in a database; training data through a back propagation algorithm; and finally, the power grid is predicted in real time by predicting the stability of the rotor angle of the generator. The method provides decision support for predicting the stability of the power grid in real time when the power system fails, and has great significance for improving the medium-long-term voltage stability margin of a large-scale power grid and improving the economy and quality of the operation of the power grid.

title_en: The risk analysis method and system of the concurrent cascading failure of power grid mountain fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of risk analysis method and systems of concurrent cascading failure of power grid mountain fire disaster, and the method comprising the steps of: according to mountain fire Monitoring and forecasting system in real-time as a result, calculating the mountain fire tripping probability of impacted transmission line of electricity and transmission line of electricity；According to the mountain fire of all impacted transmission lines of electricity tripping probability, building primary fault combination；Calculate the certainty cascading failure line set under primary fault combination；According to transmission line of electricity and its operation characteristic of protection element, on the basis of certainty cascading failure line set, the probability cascading failure line set of failure combination is generated；It is combined for each failure, calculates the power grid risk index under failure combination condition；According to power grid risk index, the degree of risk of every transmission line of electricity is calculated.The present invention can quickly obtain the concurrent cascading failure combination of power grid under mountain fire disaster, so that the degree of risk of every transmission line of electricity be calculated.
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD DISASTER PREVENTION & MITIGATION CT;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: A kind of quick adaptive neural network optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of quick adaptive neural network optimization methods, comprising: S1, initialize neural network optimizer parameter；S2, the gradient data that the initial parameter of the optimizer and neural network propagated forward come are as the input of the optimizer；S3, the gradient data according to neural network, the current time single order moment of momentum is calculated using current time gradient, last moment gradient and the last moment single order moment of momentum, calculates the current time second order moment of momentum using current time gradient, last moment gradient and the last moment second order moment of momentum；The initial learning rate of S4, the amendment optimizer；S5, the network parameter of the neural network is updated according to revised learning rate, the current time single order moment of momentum and the current time second order moment of momentum；S6, weight decaying is carried out to the gradient of the neural network, then the gradient after being decayed with weight continues to update the obtained network parameter of step S5.Optimization method performance of the invention is better than existing SGD method.
assignees: GRADUATE SCHOOL SHENZHEN TSINGHUA UNIV

title_en: A kind of operation of power networks failure disposition data visualization analysis method of Process-Oriented
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of operation of power networks failure disposition data visualization analysis method of Process-Oriented, firstly, establishing operation of power networks failure Analysis of The Disposal assessment indicator system；Secondly, configuring corresponding weight and scoring element in the database to evaluation index；Then, the event of failure for needing to analyze is chosen, assay is started, analysis evaluation module is independently calculated, goes out corresponding calculated value according to the scoring element factor calculation of configuration, further calculate out overall assessment result further according to the weight of configuration；Finally, assay result is formed visualization assessment report.The causality of the hierarchical relationship and failure disposal process between evaluation goal can be fully demonstrated using the present invention, trace the specific origin cause of formation of operation risk, track the implementation progress of failure disposition, the effect assessment for drawing failure disposition meets the business habit and functional requirement of operation risk evaluation index and the cascade inquiry of failure disposal process data flowization.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD;NARI GROUP CORP

title_en: Intelligent visual emergency broadcase system
abstract_en: A kind of intelligent visual emergency broadcase system, including host, loudspeaker and emergency APP and small routine；Host includes input mould group, power supply mould group, alarming controller, power amplifier and memory.The advantages of the present invention over the prior art are that: under the mess of the natural calamity power-off suspension of burst, it keeps operating normally using the battery in the photo-voltaic power supply or host of emergency, receive warning information by multiple input modes, warning information is propagated in the form of high-frequency signal loudspeaker, it is sent on the electronic equipment for being preinstalled with emergency APP and small routine in distance range, even if powering off, communication network is unsmooth, without under the states such as net, emergency APP and small routine also can receive graph text information, the people is allowed to understand disaster scenarios it in time, avoid fear；Loudspeaker propagates warning information by acoustic information in the form of intermediate frequency high-decibel in a voice form simultaneously, directly transmitting information.

title_en: Consider the power information physics system Risk of Communication parser that risk status is propagated
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of power information physics system Risk of Communication parsers that consideration risk status is propagated.Establish Risk of Communication framework, system is divided into electric power, power information and information space, and Risk of Communication is divided into information space, the Risk of Communication in electric power space, between electric power and information space, and there are nodes in space；Risk Propagation Model and risk status propogator matrix are constructed, risk status propogator matrix is solved, the system risk state vector after acquiring under risk not homogeneous Risk of Communication, develop each node Risk of Communication process, until reaching stable state, Risk of Communication terminates；Risk hypersensitivity node is found out by analyzing venture influence.The present invention solves the problems, such as impact analysis of the risk in different spaces with the architectural characteristic of the characteristic of spatial and system to Risk of Communication, quantify the propagation path of power information physics system network structure and risk, disclosure risks change procedure, finds out risk hypersensitivity node.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Optimized control method for water level between upstream reservoir and reverse regulation reservoir dam thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimization control method for water level between an upstream reservoir and a counter-regulation reservoir dam thereof, which is characterized in that a plurality of neural networks are trained based on historical operation data, the working condition matching closest to the historical working condition is searched according to the current working condition, the neural network corresponding to the working condition matching is selected, and the prediction of the water level after the upstream reservoir is loaded on the dam and the water level before the counter-regulation reservoir dam is realized; and on the basis of forecasting the water level behind the upper reservoir dam and the water level in front of the reverse regulation reservoir dam, performing optimal control trial calculation on the water level between the cascade reservoirs by taking the flow of the upper reservoir dam as a variable, and realizing the maximum total output of the cascade. The cascade hydropower station cascade power generation control method fully utilizes the historical operation data of the cascade hydropower station, solves the complex problem of water level control between the reverse regulation reservoir and the upper reservoir dam, and can provide a solution for optimizing and controlling the water level between the dams to provide cascade power generation benefits.

title_en: Stability judgment method for extracted online social network data
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for judging stability of extracted online social network data, which comprises the following steps: s1, E 0 ＝(1,0,0) T Initial state, balance point when no information is transmitted; at the step of S2, the method comprises the steps of, a termination state, a balance point after information has passed through the entire network; s3, in On the premise that the information reaches the equilibrium point of a temporary stable state in the competition propagation process
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Transmission quantitative analysis method and system for assembly characteristic deviation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transmission quantitative analysis method and a system for assembly characteristic deviation, which firstly measure the assembly characteristic deviation of different assembly units of an airplane with different numbers of frames to obtain the assembly characteristic deviation of each assembly unit; secondly, determining a transfer entropy according to the assembly characteristic deviation of the two assembly units; then constructing an assembly characteristic deviation transmission network model according to the assembly characteristic deviation of each assembly unit; and finally, carrying out quantitative analysis on assembly characteristic deviation transmission according to the transmission entropy and the assembly characteristic deviation transmission network model, determining topological relation among assembly deviation variables and indexes for measuring causality by using the transmission entropy, disclosing an assembly deviation propagation mechanism and a coupling rule of the complex structure product in a small-batch development mode, and realizing the assembly tolerance optimization of the complex structure product in a small-batch production mode.

title_en: Enterprise breaks one's promise Risk of Communication inquiry system and method
abstract_en: It breaks one's promise Risk of Communication inquiry system and method the present invention relates to a kind of enterprise, which includes: basic data library module, for inputting and storing the information of Target Enterprise and its affiliated party；Network map construction module, input terminal are connect with the output end of basic data library module, for extracting data from basic data library module, and construct the network map being made of Target Enterprise and its affiliated party；Computation model module, input terminal are connect with the output end of network map construction module, for being based on the network map and Risk Propagation Model of breaking one's promise, estimate the risk profile value of breaking one's promise of each affiliated party of Target Enterprise；Front end interactive module, input terminal are connect with the output end of computation model module, are used for input inquiry condition, and export the risk profile value of breaking one's promise of the affiliated party under the querying condition.This system and method can inquire the risk profile value of breaking one's promise of the affiliated party of any hierarchical relationship.
assignees: CHENGDU BUSINESS BIG DATA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Foundation pit displacement prediction method based on GA-BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a foundation pit displacement prediction method based on a GA-BP neural network. In the construction stage, the prediction simulation of the deformation of the foundation pit structure is one of key technologies of foundation pit construction safety guarantee. The traditional foundation pit construction heavy monitoring and light prediction often take remedial measures after deformation is found, and the optimal time for deformation support repair is often missed. According to the invention, the possible deformation of the foundation pit in the future is predicted and simulated by using the GA-BP neural network method, so that the time point of supporting and repairing is effectively advanced, the difficulty of supporting and repairing is reduced, and finally the foundation pit is protected by safe driving. The invention carries out quantized simulation analysis and research on time domain (only time sequence) characteristics, airspace (only adjacent points) characteristics and time domain airspace combination characteristics in the genetic back propagation neural network, relies on engineering examples for predicting horizontal and vertical displacement deformation of the monitoring points of the Zhoushan foundation pit, and carries out multidimensional comparison with support vector machine regression (SVR) and random forest Regression (RF) methods.

title_en: The generation method in the train system fault propagation path based on failure potential energy field
abstract_en: The present invention provides the generation methods in the train system fault propagation path based on failure potential energy field, comprising: building railway train system complex network model；According to viral transmission model and failure potential energy field theory, probability of spreading model between railway train system component is constructed；According to probability of spreading model between railway train system component and railway train system complex network model, railway train system fault- traverse technique is constructed；It is iterated judgement according to the railway train system fault- traverse technique, obtains train system fault propagation path.The present invention analyzes train system fault propagation process from railway train system network structure and the state itself and inherent mechanism of node, and then obtains all possible propagation path and its probability, facilitates more good carry out maintenance work.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG

title_en: Elevator network for emergency operation
abstract_en: A kind of emergency operation controller for elevator, the emergency operation controller arrives the corresponding emergency operation controller of other elevators by network connection, and each controller constitutes the node in network.When the controller detects emergency, other controllers for the adjacent node that the controller generates emergency situation detection message and constitutes the controller into the network transmit the emergency situation detection message, and when other controllers detect emergency, other controllers that the controller constitutes the adjacent node of the controller from the network receive emergency situation detection message.The emergency situation detection message includes propagating to count.Described propagate counts other controllers for being configured to be transferred to emergency situation detection message whenever a controller adjacent node after constituting and subtracts one.The emergency situation detection message is continuously transmitted on, until propagation counting reaches zero.
assignees: OTIS ELEVATOR CO

title_en: Hydropower station short-term multi-target power generation plan compilation method and system for power grid peak regulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydropower station short-term multi-target power generation planning method and a system for power grid peak regulation, and the method comprises the following steps of firstly, constructing a cascade hydropower station short-term multi-target power generation planning model; determining an economic operation mode of the power station according to the input conditions; randomly generating a plurality of particles in a feasible space, determining an individual extreme value of each particle based on an objective function value of each particle, and storing the independent particles in an external archive set; updating the position and the speed of each particle, randomly selecting partial particles to carry out polynomial variation, repairing infeasible solutions, and calculating the objective function value of each particle again; updating the individual extreme value of each particle according to the recalculated objective function value of each particle; and updating the external archive set according to the domination relation and the crowding distance of the particles, and outputting the external archive set if a preset termination condition is met, thereby obtaining a global extremum. The invention can effectively reduce the peak load of the system and improve the power supply quality. The power grid can be operated safely, stably and economically.

title_en: Multi-stage combined extension planning method and system for power transmission and distribution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-stage combined extension planning method and a multi-stage combined extension planning system for power transmission and transmission, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of utilizing a fuzzy clustering method to reduce operation data with space-time characteristics to serve as a planning operation scene in a research period, respectively using the total life cycle cost and the cascading failure risk as economic and reliability targets, and using each horizontal year in the research period as a planning stage to establish a multi-target and multi-stage power generation and transmission combined expansion planning model for optimizing. The invention coordinates the economy and the operation reliability of the system in the whole research period, forms a progressive expansion planning mode with the network source structure matched with the load requirement, and can obtain the pareto optimal solution set and the recommended stage expansion planning sequence through optimization.

title_en: Combined decentralized coordination optimization method for trans-regional power grid unit containing new energy power generation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined, dispersed and coordinated optimization strategy of a trans-regional power grid unit containing new energy power generation, which is based on a target cascade technology, boundary node voltage phase angle values influencing the power of interconnection lines between interconnected power grids are used as coordination variables between regions to avoid the problem of circulation between the regions, an upper layer coordinator is formed for the coordinated optimization of the boundary node voltage phase angle of each region, a lower layer is optimized for the parallel solution of the SCUC problem of each region, the solution is alternately iterated through the upper and lower layer coordinated optimization problems, then the convergence is judged, and if all the regions are converged at any time, the iteration is finished to obtain the optimal solution; therefore, coordinated optimization of the on-off plan and the standby plan of the unit in the region and the transmission power of the connecting line is realized. The strategy provided by the invention can reasonably control and economically schedule the power grid resources, meet the actual requirements of network safety and line flow, realize source-network-load coordination and resource sharing among regions, and effectively improve the economical efficiency and reliability of power grid operation.

title_en: Static engine and neural network for a cognitive reservoir system
abstract_en: Implementations described and claimed herein provide systems and methods for developing a reservoir. In one implementation, observed data points in a volume along a well trajectory and well logs corresponding to observed data points are received at a neural network. Feature vectors are generated using the neural network. The feature vectors are defined based on a distance between each of the observed data points and randomly generated points in the volume. A 3D populated log is generated by propagating well log values of the feature vectors across the volume. Uncertainty is quantified by generating a plurality of realizations including the 3D populated log. Each of the realizations is different and equally probable, core values are generated from the realizations, and a static model of the reservoir is generated by clustering the volume into one or more clusters of rock types based on the core values.
assignees: BEYOND LIMITS INC

title_en: Underground coal mine distributed object positioning system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of underground coal mine distributed object positioning systems in mine communication and safety in production field, floor control work station including being set to ground, underground location computer, underground interchanger, optical fiber, bus, reference mode, destination node, the power supply of underground coal mine scene is mainly solved by requirement of explosion proof, cable laying, the limitation such as tunnel condition, the problem of bringing inconvenience to the power supply of mine position computer, the utility model is by introducing distributed frame in traditional mine positioning system, so that the function of position computer moves down and is distributed across underground, improve the timeliness of positioning system, propagation delay time caused by reducing because of transmission network congestion, system emergency rescue efficiency and anti-interference ability can under equal conditions be significantly improved, greatly simplify Distributed localization computer time complexity, reduce energy Consumption, more conducively practical application of the object locating system in underground coal mine.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING

title_en: Lightning stroke risk assessment method and device based on cascade simulation
abstract_en: The application provides a lightning stroke risk assessment method and device based on cascade simulation. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a three-dimensional electric field model and a two-dimensional circuit model of the target area; inputting the three-dimensional electric field model into electromagnetic field simulation software to obtain electromagnetic field distribution in the three-dimensional electric field model under the preset lightning stroke energy; converting the electromagnetic field distribution into a transient pulse waveform; inputting the two-dimensional circuit model into circuit simulation software, and taking the transient pulse waveform as an energy source to acquire circuit response information; and carrying out lightning stroke risk assessment on the target area through the circuit response information. The lightning stroke risk assessment method and device based on the cascade simulation can analyze lightning strokes from multiple angles and improve the power supply reliability of the power distribution network.

title_en: Production network linkage effect research method based on propagation dynamics in disturbance environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of chain effect analysis of production workshops, in particular to a method for researching chain effect of a production network in a disturbance environment based on propagation dynamics, which takes a manufacturing node in a production system as a node, takes a process relation between production activities as a continuous edge, determines parameters in a propagation model according to an established production network, adopts a 5W2H analysis method in combination with a process route theory to evaluate and judge disturbance intensity according to delay time and economic loss, classifies disturbance influence degree into four types of slight disturbance, moderate disturbance, severe disturbance and serious disturbance, selects different nodes in the network as propagation source nodes for activation, and deeply researches the interrelation between a production network topological structure and disturbance propagation dynamics characteristics so as to reveal a unique chain propagation rule of an operation workshop in the disturbance environment. The invention provides effective reference and basis for the stable operation control of the production workshop.

title_en: Rumor propagation risk analysis method and device, storage medium and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a rumor propagation risk analysis method and device, a storage medium and computer equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring social data of a social network platform user; calculating the effective distance between users according to the social data; obtaining the length of the shortest effective path between users by using the effective distance between users; the propagation risk of the users is analyzed according to the length of the shortest effective path between the users. According to the application, the propagation effective distance between users is quantified by using the user social data of the social platform, so that the shortest length of the effective path between users is determined, and the propagation risk is quantitatively analyzed.

title_en: Large-scale network information propagation calculation method and device based on distributed platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-scale network information propagation calculation method and device based on a distributed platform, and the implementation steps of the method comprise the steps of constructing a configuration network according to network parameters, constructing an information propagation model, selecting and setting parameters of the network and the information propagation model according to requirements, configuring an information format, an individual attribute, a message transfer function, a message fusion function and a message processing function, inputting the network, the information format, the individual attribute, the message transfer function, the message fusion function and the message processing function, carrying out iterative calculation through a parallel distributed platform, and screening out nodes with propagation activities and connected edges thereof in the network containing propagation records to obtain the propagation records and outputting the propagation records. The invention has the advantages of strong parallel computing capability, strong user customization capability, good transmission computing universality and adaptability, and simple and efficient development process, can greatly reduce the development difficulty of parallel distributed computing, and does not need to additionally consider the problem of parallel distributed storage.
assignees: NAT UNIV DEFENSE TECHNOLOGY PLA

title_en: Modeling and optimizing method of solvent deasphalting device based on data driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modeling and optimizing method of a solvent deasphalting device based on data driving. The modeling method of the solvent deasphalting device based on data driving comprises the following steps: (1) Preprocessing field data, including production operation data, feedstock and product property analysis data for a solvent deasphalting unit; (2) Screening characteristic variables according to process principles and processes; (3) Performing dimension reduction on the characteristic variable by adopting a Principal Component Analysis (PCA); modeling the dimensionality reduced data set by adopting a Back Propagation (BP) neural network, and respectively establishing a yield model of deasphalted oil (DAO) and a desulfurization and carbon residue removal model. The optimization method comprises the step of optimizing the operating conditions of the solvent deasphalting device by using the constructed data-driven-based solvent deasphalting device model.

title_en: Air Quality Information Sharing System and Method of Multi-use Facilities
title_ko: 다중이용시설의 공기질정보 공유시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an air quality information sharing system of a multi-use facility and a method thereof, and, more specifically, to a system which enables residents or users (visitors) of a multi-use facility like an indoor car park to receive and share rapidly transferred measured air quality data and a method thereof. An embodiment of the present invention provides the air quality information sharing system of the multi-use facility comprising: an air quality sensor installed at places of the multi-use facility to periodically measure and output air quality items listed in indoor air quality related rules; an air quality management server collecting and analyzing air quality data outputted by the air quality sensor and controlling an on-site output device to output the air quality data; and the on-site output device installed on the spot of the multi-use facility and outputting air quality related environmental information to the users and the residents of the multi-use facility in various manners by controlling the air quality management server, digitizing and displaying the air quality data to enable the users to see the air quality, and inducing guidance and evacuation by sound (voice) or lighting (flickering) in the case that the measured value (air quality data) is higher than a reference or a state of the air quality exceeds a reference which has a harmful effect on a physical body.
assignees: KOO HYEONG SEO

title_en: Business risk recognition methods, device and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: This application provides a kind of business risk recognition methods, which comprises enterprise network figure is divided into multiple community networks according to preset relation, wherein includes the propagation path between at least one associated nodes and the associated nodes in the community network；Risk assessment request is responded, determines that the corresponding community network of the first associated nodes corresponding to corresponding risk case is requested in the risk assessment；Start to traverse the community network along at least propagation path for meeting preset condition with first associated nodes, risks and assumptions and the Risk of Communication path for meeting preset condition are concentrated with the determination associated nodes and side, wherein, the propagation path is connected with first associated nodes.By business risk recognition methods provided by the present application, the associated nodes probability for obtaining and being affected to business risk is improved, target data can be rapidly obtained, without repeatedly repeatedly traversing tabular array, and then improves the speed that memory reads valid data.
assignees: CHONGQING BAIXING INTELLIGENT DATA TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: A kind of construction method of refrigeration unit multi-sensor data prediction model
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of construction methods of refrigeration unit multi-sensor data prediction model, comprising the following steps: data attention mechanism is added in the input terminal of encoder；Refrigeration unit control parameter corresponding to decoder a certain moment timing information to be predicted and environment temperature are combined into vector form, collectively as the input of decoder together with the output cascade of time attention mechanism；Data attention mechanism and time attention mechanism are added in coder-decoder network, the refrigeration unit multi-sensor data prediction model for relying on thresholding recurrent neural network is established.The present invention has rational design, realizes the accurate dynamic prediction function to refrigeration unit multi-sensor data information, can accurately and rapidly position to refrigeration unit multisensor failure, avoid energy waste, improve the service life of equipment.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: Online social network information propagation prediction system based on time-varying damping motion
abstract_en: The invention provides an online social network information propagation prediction system based on time-varying damping motion, which comprises: the individual characteristic data acquisition module is used for acquiring individual characteristics on the online social network nodes; the acceleration calculation module is used for calculating the acceleration of information propagation according to the individual characteristics acquired by the individual characteristic data acquisition module; the stress analysis module is used for acquiring stress conditions of information spread on the network nodes according to the acceleration calculated by the acceleration calculation module; and the data judgment module is used for judging whether the information residual energy is greater than or equal to the information preset energy threshold value. The invention can predict the hot spots of the online network events, and verifies the rationality and the effectiveness of the prediction system through numerical analysis, simulation experiment and empirical data analysis.

title_en: Online social network information propagation construction method based on time-varying damping motion
abstract_en: The invention provides an online social network information propagation construction method based on time-varying damping motion, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring individual characteristics of the online social network nodes; s2, calculating information propagation acceleration according to the individual characteristics acquired in the step S1; s3, acquiring the stress condition of information spread on the network node; and S4, judging whether the residual energy of the information is greater than or equal to the preset energy threshold of the information, S5, counting the user transmission amount on the network node, and predicting the hotspot degree. The invention can carry out statistics on online network events through the constructed model and predict the event heat.

title_en: Method and system for measuring network information propagation influence and influence maximization method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for measuring network information propagation influence, which comprises the following steps: according to historical propagation data of message propagation in the social network, constructing an activation pair of a node and a propagation source; taking a user in a social network as a node, taking a node with the participation time of 0 in the propagation data of the given message as a propagation source of the given message, aggregating the influence of the propagation source on the node through an aggregation function, and then obtaining the probability of the node being activated under the propagation source through an influence margin decreasing function; and (3) taking historical propagation data as training data and taking the maximum log-likelihood of probability as a target, and performing parameter learning on all activated pairs by using random gradient descent to obtain influence among nodes so as to obtain influence measurement of the propagation source set. The influence maximization method based on data driving provided by the invention is directly based on the influence measurement obtained by learning of the invention, and the marginal effect of the node is estimated, so that the node set selection of influence maximization is efficiently carried out.

title_en: Coupling analysis system for ecological process and hydropower cascade development of mountain watershed water system
abstract_en: The invention provides a coupled analysis system for a mountain watershed water system ecological process and hydropower cascade development, which comprises a processor, an input device, an output device and a memory, wherein the processor is configured to call the program instructions and execute the following method: constructing a complex network model according to the modeling principle of natural attributes of rivers flowing from high terrains to low terrains; setting a river reach between a source and a junction or between the junction and the junction in the drainage system of the drainage basin to be analyzed as a node, and setting the flow direction of the drainage system in the drainage system of the drainage basin to be analyzed as an edge connecting each node; constructing an index system based on a complex network model; and constructing a coupling coordination index by using the index system, and performing coupling analysis on the ecological process of the watershed water system to be analyzed and the hydropower cascade development. The system can utilize a complex network to carry out coupling analysis of the ecological process of the mountain watershed water system and the development of the hydropower cascade, and has high accuracy.

title_en: Wind-solar-water complementary power generation plan calculation method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of planning and design of power dispatching systems, in particular to a wind-light-water complementary power generation plan calculation method based on power grid structure and cascade hydropower station hydraulic connection coupling in a hydropower, wind power and photovoltaic power generation mutual compensation operation mode. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a layered structure covering the basin hydropower stations, the wind power and photovoltaic physical power stations and the power supply set according to the power output channels of the wind power, photovoltaic and cascade hydropower stations in the basin; on the basis of the established power station and power supply layered structure, establishing a wind, light and water complementary scheduling model comprehensively considering the hydraulic connection between a power station sending-out channel and the power station in a drainage basin; the model is solved according to a hierarchical coordination method, and the requirements of power grid operation-oriented cascade hydropower station, basin wind power and photovoltaic power supply complementary power generation operation and planning are met.

title_en: A kind of power information physics emerging system safety situation evaluation method
abstract_en: A kind of power information physics emerging system safety situation evaluation method, the described method comprises the following steps: a. is according to the importance update abnormal point set of abnormal point: b. calculates threat propagation desired value；C. electric power CPS risk assessment；Threat propagation tree is generated by threat propagation tree create-rule；The desired value that all effective heat source nodes are constituted a threat in threat propagation tree is calculated, networks security situation assessment value is obtained.The present invention devises the real-time joint-detection system towards security threats all kinds of in electric power CPS, propose the threat situation evaluation system based on intelligent assessment algorithm, effectively improve the identification capability to all kinds of high-risk security threats occurred in real time in electric power CPS, it realizes and the macroscopic view of electric power CPS operation conditions is judged, strengthen the purpose for all kinds of high-risk security threat safeguard procedures, facilitate the operation conditions for improving electric power CPS from whole level, ensures its safe and stable operation.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION BRANCH;NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV BAODING

title_en: Analysis method for coupling propagation mechanism of successive faults of distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an analysis method of a distribution network successive fault coupling propagation mechanism, which comprises the following steps of firstly, selecting a high-voltage transmission line with a plurality of feeder successive faults, and collecting relevant parameters of the high-voltage transmission line; step two, a high-voltage side simulation model is built, and a high-voltage side simulation model feeder line is built according to relevant parameters of the high-voltage transmission line; and thirdly, accessing an arc model on the feeder line, recording a simulation result of the arc model, and comparing the simulation result with an actual wave recording waveform and sequence record. The simulation model built by the ATP-EMTP simulation software is used for conveniently comparing the simulation result with the actual wave-recording waveform and event sequence record through selection and improvement of the arc model, and the built simulation model and parameter setting are subjected to feedback improvement according to the simulation result, so that the development history of the unstable ground fault of the system is analyzed, and the general rule of the fault coupling propagation mechanism can be given.

title_en: System for Alarm Broadcasting of Indoor using Broadcasting Means
title_ko: 방송 수단을 이용한 옥내용 경보 방송 시스템
abstract_en: According to the present invention, an indoor alarm broadcasting system using a broadcasting means can spread a disaster situation to the inside of buildings in a disaster area, a major organization, and a densely populated area by using a VHF communication network in an event of the disaster situation, so that an active response can be performed with respect to an alarming situation by delivering the alarming situation to residents in the buildings which exist as the shaded area in a conventional alarming wave. Therefore, the loss of life and property can be reduced or prevented.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 방송 수단을 이용한 옥내용 경보 방송 시스템에 따르면, 재난 상황 발생 시 VHF 통신망을 이용하여 신속하게 재난 지역, 주요 기관 및 인구 밀집 지역의 건물 내부로 재난 상황을 전파할 수 있도록 하여, 기존 방식의 경보 전파에 음영 지역으로 존재하던 건물 내 거주민들에게 경보 상황을 전달함으로써, 경보 상황에 대하여 능동적인 대처를 할 수 있도록 하여 인명 피해와 재산 손실을 줄이거나 방지할 수 있도록 하는 효과가 있다.
assignees: ONPOOM CORP

title_en: A kind of power grid considering key node closes on the danger level calculation method of cascading trip
