abstract_en: The invention discloses the danger level calculation methods that a kind of power grid for considering key node closes on cascading trip, step 1, for the cascading trip scene of power grid, using DC power flow algorithm, power grid is provided in the branch current after primary fault generation and the mapping relations between node electrical control amount and disturbance quantity；Step 2 forms a new vector；Step 3 defines penalty according to the mathematical model that formula (5) provides, and particle swarm optimization algorithm is selected to be solved.Main advantages of the present invention are only to consider the key node for influencing cascading trip in power grid on the basis of Exact Analysis, calculate the degree of danger that power grid current state occurs apart from cascading trip event with this, can substantially reduce the time of calculating, improve analysis efficiency.
assignees: UNIV FUJIAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: A kind of electric power in information society emerging system reliability estimation method based on stream association analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of electric power in information society emerging system reliability estimation methods based on stream association analysis.Electric power in information society emerging system is mapped as the double-deck coupling network by the present invention.Compared with conventional information electric power emerging system reliability estimation method, the data flow of Information Level in electric power in information society emerging system is mapped as the stream in the double-deck coupling network by the present invention, by being analyzed based on the remaining largest connected accounting flowed under associated failure cascading failure the double-deck coupling network, to assess the reliability of the electric power in information society emerging system, so that assessment result is more in line with reality, there is engineering value.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING POSTS & TELECOMM

title_en: Aviation network delay propagation model based on SIS and establishment method
abstract_en: The invention provides an aviation network delay propagation model based on SIS, which is characterized in that an airport network is established by taking airports as nodes and taking flight flows among the airports as edges; constructing historical values, and counting the states of the research targets in the same environment; obtaining normal node proportion SI (t), delay node proportion IS (t), delay source node proportion IA (t) and delay propagation probability PS  i,t  Delay dissipation probability PI  i,t  Delay spontaneous probability PA  i,t  Delay statistical probability Nc  i,t  Delay factor Therefore, an aviation network delay propagation model is constructed, the propagation condition of delay in the whole network is taken as a research object, the influence among airport delays and the characteristics of the airport network are analyzed from a more macroscopic view, and reference is provided for solving the airport delay problem.

title_en: BP neural network-based interval water demand prediction method
abstract_en: The application discloses a genetic algorithm optimization back propagation neural network interval water demand prediction method based on grey correlation analysis. The method comprises the steps of firstly, processing original data by using a gray correlation analysis method, and finding out main factors of campus water; then, a BP neural network is selected as a prediction algorithm, and the BP neural network is optimized by adopting a genetic algorithm, so that the BP neural network with the optimal state is obtained for prediction; and then searching the optimal upper and lower boundaries of the prediction interval through the residual errors of the predicted value and the actual value of the output point, so that the fluctuation range of the water consumption in the future period can be accurately predicted. Compared with the traditional BP prediction method, the water demand prediction method is more effective and has higher accuracy.

title_en: A kind of integrated energy system Risk Identification Method propagated based on multipotency stream faults coupling
abstract_en: Invention describes a kind of integrated energy system Risk Identification Methods propagated based on multipotency stream faults coupling, it is related to comprehensive energy security analysis field, comprising the following steps: 1) establish electric system, therrmodynamic system, the mathematical model of natural gas system, electrical heat Coupling device respectively；2) risk identification System Design: include multipotency Source Type for integrated energy system, propose various dimensions risk identification index system；3) comprehensive energy network tide optimization algorithm is combined to calculate the load margin Optimized model of analysis electrical heat coupled system；4) risk based on load margin loss probability, the key energy hinge mutually converted between crucial branch, node, coupling propagation path and the heterogeneous energy stream for determining energy transport net in integrated energy system.The invention proposes a kind of integrated energy system Risk Identification Methods propagated based on multipotency stream faults coupling, improve safety, the flexibility, reliability of social energy supply.
assignees: UNIV CHANGSHA SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Coupling method and device based on node importance of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coupling method and a coupling device based on the node importance of a power system, wherein the device is used for realizing the method; implementing cascade failure attack on the power network in the model, dynamically adjusting the actual output power of each power supply node under the condition of ensuring that the power utilization node obtains the conventional input power, obtaining the output power of each power supply node under each stable state in dynamic adjustment, respectively calculating the node influence and the node vulnerability, and obtaining a node d by weighted summation of the node influence and the node vulnerability  0  The importance of the nodes is ranked from small to small based on the importance of the nodes to generate a new power network, and the new power network is heterogamy coupled with a communication network to generate a new power system model. The invention obtains the node importance through the calculation of the direct current load flow model to obtain a more accurate simulation result, and then performs the different distribution coupling of the new power network and the communication network, thereby improving the robustness of the power system network under the attack.

title_en: Neural network inverse control method for SCR denitration system of coal-fired unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a neural network inverse control method for a coal-fired unit SCR denitration system, which comprises establishment of a mechanism model of the SCR denitration system, training of an inverse model and application of a feedforward controller based on the inverse model; the establishment of the SCR denitration system mechanism model comprises the following steps: based on Langmuir-Hinshellwood mechanism and Eley-Rideal mechanism, a model of the SCR denitration system is established; the optimal parameters of a mechanism model are obtained by analyzing field real data and optimizing by using particle swarm or genetic algorithm, and the model can basically represent a real system; training of the inverse model includes: based on the constructed accurate mechanism model of the SCR denitration system, giving a group of random numbers to an input end, setting simulation time as long as possible, and generating random output of the model; training an inverse model by utilizing the generated random data and utilizing an NARX neural network; the application of the feedforward controller based on the inverse model comprises the following steps: and the generated inverse model is combined with the original cascade PID control system of the coal-fired unit to form the SCR denitration inverse control system.

title_en: Power distribution network switch state identification method based on probability map model
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution network switch state identification method based on a probability map model, which comprises the following steps: a plurality of interconnected distribution transformers are equivalent to a load group, and a simplified circuit diagram of a physical model of the distribution network is obtained; analyzing the dependency relationship between the voltage correlation among the load groups and the switching state in the power distribution network, and constructing a probability graph model with the voltage correlation and the switching state as nodes; calculating initial probability distribution of each node and conditional probability distribution among the nodes based on historical operation data of the power distribution network, and finishing learning of a probability graph model; analyzing influence propagation among nodes in the probability graph model, and determining necessary observation variables to enable states of the remaining nodes in the network to be inferred through effective traces; and under the condition that necessary observation variables can be observed, the on-off state of the whole power distribution network is obtained through a confidence coefficient propagation algorithm. The method can deduce the running state of the whole power distribution network by using an artificial intelligence algorithm under the condition that partial distribution transformer data are difficult to obtain.

title_en: Bayesian network-based dynamic risk analysis method for high-speed rail overhead line system
abstract_en: The invention provides a Bayesian network-based dynamic risk analysis method for a high-speed rail contact network, which comprises the steps of establishing a risk propagation chain model of insulator flashover of the high-speed rail contact network, carrying out dynamic mathematical modeling on the risk chain model by using characteristic quantity-dynamic probability, and calculating the dynamic mathematical modeling in the Bayesian network to obtain risk occurrence probability; determining the dynamic severity of risks in two dimensions of time and space by using the passenger flow intensity index, calculating the severity of risk consequences caused by train delay at different times by using basic time granularity and stations as basic units for obtaining real-time monitoring data and using a risk propagation path and a propagation process as the principle of calculating the passenger flow intensity index; and combining the dynamic probability with the severity, and obtaining the dynamic risk level of the risk chain according to the risk assessment matrix.

title_en: Urban road network electric vehicle charging station deployment method based on structural hole theory
abstract_en: The urban road network electric vehicle charging station optimized deployment method based on the structural hole theory converts the extracted road map into a road network; selecting candidate station site nodes of the charging stations from the converted road network by adopting a constraint propagation algorithm based on a structural hole theory; establishing a dual-target planning model and converting the dual-target planning model into a single-target planning model; solving the single-target planning model to obtain a final station building node: the station building node is a road in the actual road graph, so that the intersection of the road with the maximum road constraint is solved as a station building site of the charging station by using a structural hole theory, and the specific position of the charging station is determined. The invention considers the influence of the actual road on the station building position, carries out mathematical modeling on the deployment problem of the charging station from the aspects of investment and users, optimizes the deployment problem of the charging station by combining the actual road and other influencing factors, and solves the specific position of the deployment of the charging station.

title_en: A kind of power grid fragility node automatic identifying method based on neighbour's propagation clustering algorithm
abstract_en: Present invention relates particularly to a kind of power grid fragility node automatic identifying method based on neighbour's propagation clustering algorithm, the present invention combines Power Grid Vulnerability Assessment with AP clustering algorithm, according to node structure vulnerability inder calculation method, assessment result is constantly updated into its Attraction Degree matrix of iteration and degree of membership matrix by AP clustering algorithm, the architectural vulnerability assessment result of nodes all in power grid is automatically separated into the multiclass from " very fragile " to " not fragile ", effectively recognizes the weak link in power grid.The present invention can meet the needs of bulk power grid fragility link or region automatic identification and be not required to manual intervention.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Private network mirroring
abstract_en: Techniques for private network mirroring are described. Users can select one or more existing private networks to be mirrored in the same or different network area. Any network configuration changes made in the selected private network (e.g., "master" private network) can be propagated automatically to the mirror private network. This enables users to utilize resources in another network area for disaster recovery, ensuring that the network configuration of the mirror private network is consistent with the master private network through real-time updates. Additionally, users managing infrastructure that includes multiple private networks can select one master private network and propagate configuration changes to other private networks, reducing management overhead incurred by these multi-private network installations.
assignees: AMAZON TECH INC

title_en: Service reliability and bandwidth recovery method based on multiple paths
abstract_en: The invention requests to protect a service reliability and bandwidth recovery method based on multiple paths, belonging to the technical field of communication networks. Aiming at the serious damage and threat of a large-scale disaster event to a backbone optical network, the method adopts a flexible route configuration and bandwidth supplement method to recover the damaged service in the network. In order to deal with the conditions of network resource shortage and network component reliability reduction after disaster, the routes and the number of recovery paths are dynamically adjusted according to the service reliability requirement, the bandwidth is distributed and adaptively upgraded according to the service bandwidth requirement in a balanced manner, and the routes and the bandwidth are further supplemented for the damaged service according to the resource utilization rate maximization principle, so that the performances such as the service interruption rate, the reliability, the bandwidth loss rate and the like are greatly improved.

title_en: SAR change detection method based on deep learning classification comparison
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting SAR change by comparing after deep learning classification, which comprises the following steps: and respectively extracting the depth features of the SAR images at two moments before and after the disaster by using the characteristic that the MDPS-CNN has two network channels and can have different weights. Meanwhile, the texture features and the gray features of the original SAR image at two moments are obtained, and then the texture features, the gray features and the depth features are fused in the MDPS-CNN network. In addition, in order to make a balance under the conditions of different depth layers and high accuracy guarantee for specific SAR images, the MDPS-CNN adopts segmented back propagation to optimize a network so as to automatically select a proper number of layers. And classifying the two groups of fused images by using a threshold method. And finally, comparing the obtained two classification images with the water area change to obtain a final water area change detection image.

title_en: Near infrared spectrum modeling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a near infrared spectrum modeling method, which comprises the steps of establishing a plurality of identical one-dimensional convolution neural networks as sub-networks in negative correlation learning, adding a negative correlation penalty term after an error function of each sub-network, using the composite error function to reversely propagate the sub-networks to carry out parameter iterative optimization adjustment on each sub-network, realizing convergence of each sub-network by carrying out parameter iterative optimization adjustment on each sub-network, and finally optimizing the converged sub-network to obtain the constructed near infrared spectrum; the method has the advantages that the one-dimensional convolutional neural network is used as a basic model, the one-dimensional convolutional neural network is combined with a negative correlation learning method, and the model is trained and converged by the negative correlation learning method, so that the model has higher precision, the training convergence is faster, and the required modeling time and computer resources are less.

title_en: A method of it is predicted for energy consumption
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of method for energy consumption prediction, comprising: step 1, data target standardization: the energy-consuming influence factor of arrangement and total energy consumption experimental data are standardized, and realize nondimensionalization；Step 2 establishes prediction time in advance solving model and solves prediction time in advance: the prediction time in advance based on invention is theoretical and designs solving model, finds out each index to standardized data and predicts time in advance, and forms one group of new experimental data；Step 3, Data Dimensionality Reduction processing: dimensionality reduction is carried out to previous step data based on principal component analysis, eliminates multiple conllinear influence；Step 4, neural network prediction: joined momentum term in the error back propagation of traditional neural algorithm and improve, and by upper step, treated that data band enters the complete network training of neural model, is finally predicted.Using technical solution of the present invention, it can more accurately realize that energy-consuming is predicted.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Tree-shaped river network cascade reservoir hydrodynamic water quality sediment coupling simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water conservancy researches, in particular to a tree-shaped river network cascade reservoir hydrodynamic water quality sediment coupling simulation method and system, which solve the problems of integrity and reliability of river terrain sections and control line hydrologic station data; after the cascade reservoir is added, how to solve the joint solution of the river network and the cascade reservoir, and a western river midstream river network integral hydrodynamics simulation calculation platform which integrates a cascade reservoir scheduling mode and a one-dimensional river network hydrodynamics model is established by relying on the latest actually measured river channel water depth topography data. The model calculation is based on a one-dimensional Save Vigna equation, a calculation sequence for establishing a model from four layers of river networks, sub-river networks, river channels and nodes is provided, the river networks and the cascade reservoirs are generalized, the river segments are connected into a whole through a transmission relation between a water conservancy junction scheduling mode and external boundary conditions, and the calculation whole is connected with each river segment, so that synchronous real-time simulation and calculation are realized, and research means of river network cascade reservoir scheduling are enriched.

title_en: Method and apparatus for analyzing radio wave environment in a wireless communication system
title_ko: 무선 통신 시스템에서 시뮬레이터의 전파환경 분석 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for analyzing a radio wave environment of a simulator in a wireless communication system. The method comprises: a step of allowing a simulator to receive geographic information and location information in which a transmitter and a receiver can be located within the geographic information; a step of generating radio waves for at least one direction of a sphere having a consistent radius from the transmitter of the simulator located in a random location according to the location information; a step of grouping the radio waves into at least one group based on the moving path of the generated radio waves; a step of setting each group as a calculation unit (warp/wavefront) for a graphics processing unit (GPU); and a step of analyzing the radio wave environment by using the GPU in which the calculation unit is set. Therefore, the method can allow a simulator to analyze the radio wave environment by improving performance of 5G wireless communication network simulation using a GPU.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무선통신 시스템에서 시뮬레이터의 전파환경 분석 방법에 대한 것으로서, 본 발명의 방법은 시뮬레이터가 지형 정보, 및 상기 지형 정보 내에서 송신기와 수신기가 위치할 수 있는 위치 정보를 수신하는 단계, 상기 위치 정보에 따른 임의의 위치에 배치된 시뮬레이터의 송신기로부터 반지름이 일정한 구의 적어도 하나의 방향에 대한 전파들을 생성하는 단계, 상기 생성된 전파들의 이동 경로에 기반하여 적어도 하나의 그룹으로 그룹화 하는 단계, 상기 각 그룹을 GPU(Graphics Processing Unit)에 대한 연산 유닛(Warp/Wavefront)으로 설정하는 단계 및 상기 연산 유닛이 설정된 상기 GPU를 이용하여 전파환경을 분석하는 단계를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: SAMSUNG ELECTRONICS CO LTD;UNIV YONSEI IACF

title_en: Daily power load prediction method and prediction device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a daily power load prediction method and a prediction device, belonging to the field of short-term load prediction of a power system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: sampling S ephemeris history load data to obtain S first load sequences at any tth moment in a day to be predicted; normalizing the first load sequence, and obtaining a target load sequence of each day in S days from a normalization result; respectively obtaining effective influence factor sequences of each day in S days and the day to be predicted and normalizing; the target load sequence and the normalized effective influence factor sequence are used as input, and a trained daily power load prediction model is used for predicting a load value at the t-th moment in the day to be predicted; the daily power load prediction model comprises a cascaded composite network and a second RBF neural network, wherein the composite network is formed by an ELMAN neural network, a BP neural network and a first RBF neural network in parallel. The invention can improve the prediction precision and the data utilization efficiency of the daily load of the power system.

title_en: The compact reservoir physical parameter intelligent Forecasting of data-driven
abstract_en: Present disclose provides a kind of compact reservoir physical parameter intelligent Forecastings of data-driven, construct learning sample collection using 3-D seismics Wave data and well-log information, pre-process to learning sample collection；The machine learning network model that building convolution is mixed with inner product operator, uses convolution operation to pretreated 3-D seismics Wave data, inner product operation is used to additional space position, along network propagated forward；The training that machine learning network model is carried out using learning sample collection, until the network model for obtaining meeting error requirements；Centered on sampled point, multiple data are acquired in a plurality of directions as sampled data, using sampled data as the input variable for the machine learning network model trained, compact reservoir physical parameter is predicted in realization.Disclosure substitution relies on the inversion method of empirical model, realizes the compact reservoir physical parameter intelligent predicting of data-driven, solves the problems, such as small-sample learning between well logging-earthquake.

title_en: Disaster alarm broadcasting system reflecting climate disaster information and wireless alarm terminal for it
title_ko: 기후 재난 정보를 반영한 재난 경보 방송 시스템 및 이를 위한 무선 경보 단말기
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster warning broadcasting system reflecting climatic disaster information, and a wireless warning terminal thereof. According to the present invention, the disaster warning broadcasting system comprises a plurality of fine dust sensor devices and wireless terminals installed at a different place in a living zone. The disaster warning broadcasting system automatically switches and transmits normal broadcasting, guidance broadcasting, and emergency warning broadcasting step by step in accordance with the fine dust concentration measured by the fine dust sensor device and a national measurement network. When a warning signal is transmitted from the wireless warning terminals, the disaster warning broadcasting system propagates a disaster occurrence situation of a predetermined place to surrounding living zones, and automatically switches and transmits emergency warning broadcasting. Accordingly, correct life-contact type information of a real living zone, not observatory atmospheric information by the national measurement network, can be confirmed and thus, disaster warning broadcasting reflecting an environment and climatic disaster information of the living zone is provided, thereby quickly and correctly transmitting correct life-contact type disaster situation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 기후 재난 정보를 반영한 재난 경보 방송 시스템 및 이를 위한 무선 경보 단말기에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 재난 경보 방송 시스템은 생활 구역의 서로 다른 장소에 복수 개의 미세먼지 센서 장치들과 무선 경보 단말기들을 설치한다. 재난 경보 방송 시스템은 미세먼지 센서 장치 및 국가 측정망을 통해 측정된 미세먼지 농도에 따라 단계별로 일반 방송, 안내 방송 및 비상 경보 방송을 자동 절체하여 송출한다. 또 재난 경보 방송 시스템은 무선 경보 단말기들로부터 경보 신호가 전송되면, 특정 장소의 재난 발생 상황을 생활 구역의 주변에 전달하고 비상 경보 방송을 자동 절체하여 송출한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 국가 측정망에 의한 측정소 대기 정보가 아닌 실제 생활 구역의 정확한 생활 밀착형 정보를 확인할 수 있도록 하고, 이를 통해 생활 구역에 대한 환경 및 기후 재난 정보를 반영하여 재난 경보 방송을 제공함으로써, 생활 밀착형의 재난 상황을 정확하고 신속하게 전달할 수 있다.
assignees: LEE JONG HAN;NOWSYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Resist the intelligent distribution network communication network planing method of random attack and premeditated network attack
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of intelligent distribution network communication network planing method for resisting random attack and premeditated network attack, it can avoid cascading failure a wide range of as caused by network attack, the key step of realization includes: that (1) increases a new node, is connected by two sides with two nodes of communication network；(2) pass through attack and this communication network node of calculated attack at random, remove the malfunctioning node of corresponding electric power networks, it calculates trend and is distributed and rejects out-of-limit route, then by electric power networks fault message return communication network trouble-shooting node, repeat this process to cascading failure and stop；(3) electric power networks maximal connected subgraphs number and the corresponding fitness function value of communication network Path converted quantity are calculated and is recorded, best company's side mode is found out.Repeat (1), (2) process to node growth terminates.Side in communication network is allocated optimization in being to plan by the major function of this method, prevents large-scale blackout caused by hacker attack powerline network.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI

title_en: Post-disaster coupling recovery analysis method for urban infrastructure system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster coupling restoration analysis method for an urban infrastructure system, which comprises four parts, namely disaster analysis modeling, structural damage analysis, functional loss estimation and functional restoration prediction, wherein after a disaster happens, a load model with time space variability and correlation in an urban scale range is established by using a random field theory, the damage states of all monomers and infrastructure system subcomponents of an urban building community under the action of random loads are calculated based on the established load model, then a system theory method is used for researching the cascade effect generated by functional coupling between the urban building community and all types of infrastructures, the functional loss of the building community and the infrastructure system is evaluated, and finally the post-disaster restoration time and restoration tracks of all infrastructure systems are predicted; the method realizes the quantitative analysis of the post-disaster functional loss and recovery process of the urban infrastructure system, is a key step of quantitative evaluation of the toughness city, and can provide a theoretical basis for developing a decision model for improving the toughness of the city.

title_en: A kind of transformer substation switch division condition detection method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of transformer substation switch division condition detection method based on deep learning, include the following steps: the first step, building transformer substation switch division mark data collection: multiple switch division visible images of collection in worksite are chosen as data set and are labeled, data set contains the switch state of " dividing ", " conjunction " two states；Second step, training neural network: select YOLOv3 network as basic network model, multiple dimensioned training is added to detect using multiple dimensioned to various sizes of target, on the basis of YOLOv3 network structure, remove the network layer of smallest dimension, residual block uses the residual error structure of ResNet, carry out twice of up-sampling, cascading layers are used for the splicing of tensor, and the up-sampling result of deep layer convolution characteristic pattern is spliced with the correspondence shallow-layer convolution characteristic pattern of identical size, expands the dimension of tensor.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: Mechanical anomaly detection method based on potential feature codes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mechanical anomaly detection method based on potential feature codes. The invention relates to a mechanical anomaly detection method based on potential feature codes, which comprises the following steps: data preprocessing: preprocessing the vibration signal data, including Fourier transformation and normalization; forward propagation: and inputting the preprocessed signals into a first full convolution network to encode data. The invention has the beneficial effects that: aiming at the problem of abnormal sample loss, the method learns the data distribution of normal signal samples by utilizing the characteristic mining capability of a deep network, and transfers the signals to a potential space for data distribution comparison by coding, decoding and recoding the signals.

title_en: Comprehensive emergency command and dispatch system based on multifunctional three-proofing mask
abstract_en: A comprehensive emergency command and dispatch system based on a multifunctional three-proofing mask comprises the multifunctional three-proofing mask, a command and dispatch center, a comprehensive emergency command and dispatch platform, a storage system, an interface gateway and a third party emergency platform; the command dispatching center adopts a cascade management architecture of a multi-level center according to the mechanism setting of the user, namely an overall command center and a sub command center; the comprehensive emergency command scheduling platform is deployed in the general command center, one end receives a dangerous signal sent by the multifunctional three-proofing mask through the interface gateway, and the other end performs data butt joint with the third-party emergency platform through the SDK development kit to feed back an emergency plan; the storage system is a storage platform supporting multiple services such as voice, video, short messages, messages and the like based on an IP network; the interface gateway adopts an IP technology and is in butt joint with a main control box in the multifunctional three-proofing mask; the third party emergency platform comprises medical emergency centers, traffic management centers and fire rescue centers which are distributed at all places.

title_en: Method and system for identifying major event of power grid cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for identifying a large event of a power grid cascading failure, and belongs to the technical field of power system safety. The method comprises the following steps: 1.1, acquiring a power grid running state by using a power grid real-time state tracking technology; 1.2, screening an expected event set according to a preset index; 1.3, selecting risk elements in the set of expected faults, and exiting the operation of the risk elements and checking; 1.4, carrying out tide calculation aiming at the whole network, obtaining a calculation result, cutting off risk elements if the calculation result is not converged, and listing faults of the risk elements to be cut off as large events to be evaluated; 1.5, when the power grid is determined to have no overload or 3 overload lines are disconnected, obtaining the result index of an expected event, when the power grid is determined to have overload and 3 overload lines are not disconnected, disconnecting an overload element as a lower event, and entering 1.4; and determining the big event according to the big event evaluation index. The invention enables the major event of the power grid cascading failure to be identified in advance, and corresponding prevention and control measures are adopted aiming at the identification result.

title_en: Cascading failure simulation method for alternating current-direct current series-parallel power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascading failure simulation method for an alternating current-direct current series-parallel power grid, which comprises the following steps of: s1, determining parameters of a power grid; s2, performing cycle simulation on the power grid, and compared with the previous simulation, increasing the capacity and the load level of the generator according to a certain proportion, and increasing the capacity of the line with the fault in the previous simulation according to a certain proportion; s3, simulating all lines to be disconnected according to a certain probability each time; s4, carrying out power flow optimization on the power grid after disconnection, judging whether a line reaches a heavy load, if the line reaches the heavy load, entering S5, and if not, entering S6; s5, disconnecting the heavy load line according to a certain probability, repeating S4 if a new line is disconnected, and otherwise, entering S6; and S6, judging whether the simulation times reach preset times, if so, ending the simulation, and otherwise, repeating the S2. The cascading failure simulation method provided by the invention can take a direct-current line model and a direct-current protection measure into consideration, and is suitable for cascading failure simulation of an alternating-current and direct-current series-parallel power grid.

title_en: Shield tunneling machine parameter optimization method based on deep neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shield tunneling machine parameter optimization method based on a deep neural network. The invention utilizes a neural network algorithm to establish a forward model of the shield tunneling machine excavation parameters for predicting complex geological conditions, if an expected output value cannot be obtained in an output layer, the sum of squares of an output error and an expected error is taken as a target function, backward propagation is carried out, partial derivatives of the target function to each neuron weight are calculated layer by layer to form a gradient of the target function to the weight vector, the gradient is used as a basis for modifying the weight, and the learning of the network is completed in the weight modifying process. When real data are used for prediction, the model prediction value is consistent with the change rule of original data, the average error is within 12%, the lightweight and generalization capability of the model structure meet the field construction requirements, an effective scheme is provided for predicting the excavation parameters of the shield tunneling machine, and the method has certain practical value.

title_en: Method for simulating continuous wave lidar sensor
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for simulating sensor data of a Continuous Wave (CW) light detection and ranging lidar sensor, comprising the steps of: generating a light ray set including at least one light ray based on the CW signal 51, each light ray in the light ray set having an emission start time (T _ 0) and an emission duration (T); for each ray of the set of rays, propagating the ray in a simulated scene including at least one object; calculating for each ray in the ray set a signal contribution 71 of the propagating ray at the detection position in the simulated scene; generating an output signal 73 based on mixing the CW signal 51 with the calculated signal contribution of the concentrated light; and at least one of storing and outputting the output signal. The present invention provides analog data corresponding to a full waveform signal of a CW lidar sensor. The provided sensor data also enables additional information to be determined, such as object shape and object class, and object orientation. In addition, the sensor data also includes artifacts present in the real lidar data that originate from physical characteristics of the lidar sensor and the environment and are not present in the point cloud type data, such as multiple reflections of the lidar beam. Thus, sensor development can also be improved by taking this artifact into account. The present invention accurately simulates how a real CW lidar sensor works and thus accurately reproduces the output of a real CW lidar sensor. The provided high-quality data is complete and accurate for the real world, and has high value for developing a signal processing algorithm, training a neural network, performing virtual verification and the like.

title_en: A kind of power-system short-term load forecasting method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of power-system short-term load forecasting methods based on deep learning.First, obtain the data such as historical load, week type, festivals or holidays, weather information, and it is normalized and encodes etc. after pretreatment as input feature vector, further feature to the deepness belief network Level by level learning being made of the limited Boltzmann machine of stacking and is extracted using contrast divergence algorithm, finally the parameter of entire depth belief network is finely adjusted using back-propagation algorithm, i.e., load forecasting model is constructed by off-line training.On-line prediction is carried out to the load after electric system 24 hours, obtains prediction load.The present invention improves the precision of power-system short-term load forecasting.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN TECHNOLOGY & EDUCATION

title_en: Multitiered network minimum dominant set building method
abstract_en: Multitiered network minimum dominant set building method of the invention, is realized by following steps: it is empty set that a) initialization, which dominates set D,；By the association probability of connected node i and j be initialized as section (0,1] in random value；B) construct belief propagation equation, calculate each node be in be occupied shape probability of state；C) node adds, and by node according to the arrangement of state probability values descending is occupied, the node of preceding r ratio is added in dominant set；D) connects the deletion of side and node；E) pinches leaf algorithm process；F) iteration again；G) is until obtaining an effective dominant set D.Multitiered network minimum dominant set building method of the invention, belong to the marginal probability of multitiered network minimum dominant set by the belief propagation equation calculation multitiered network node of building, and pinch leaf algorithm using multitiered network to reduce computational complexity, can Fast Construction go out the approximate minimum dominant set of extensive multitiered network.
assignees: SHANDONG COMPUTER SCIENCE CT NAT SUPERCOMPUTER CT JINAN;UNIV CIVIL AVIATION CHINA

title_en: Fire alarm system using Internet of thing
title_ko: 사물 인터넷을 이용한 화재경보시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire alarm system using IoT, which comprises: a fire detection unit detecting the fire by a thermal image detection method, and outputting a fire detection signal having a specific voltage level when detecting the fire; an information transmission unit propagating the fire detection signal by using a wireless communication network or a wired communication network of a wide band and a local band; and a portable terminal receiving the fire detection signal from the information transmission unit to display a fire occurrence situation in real time.
abstract_ko: 사물 인터넷을 이용한 화재경보시스템은, 열화상 감지방식으로 화재를 검출하며, 화재 감지시 특정 전압레벨을 갖는 화재감지신호를 출력하는 화재 감지부와, 광대역 및 로컬 대역의 무선 통신망 또는 유선 통신망을 이용하여 상기 화재감지신호를 전파하는 정보 전달부와, 상기 정보 전달부로부터 상기 화재감지신호를 전달받아 화재발생상황을 실시간으로 표시하는 휴대용 단말기를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: KUMOH NAT INST TECHNOLOGY IND ACAD COOP FOUND;SEO JAE WOO;CHA MIN SEOK

title_en: A kind of multistep abnormal point detecting method based on neighbour's propagation clustering algorithm
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of multistep abnormal point detecting method based on neighbour's propagation clustering algorithm, by excavating normal application to get normal data stream mode, then Malware is detected using multistep abnormal point detecting method, it is final to realize that the purpose that initial stage accomplishes effective early warning be occurred in Android malware by not depending on known malware model.The present invention can effectively solve the problems, such as " dimension disaster " faced when outlier detection, to avoid interference of the noise data of redundancy feature or excessive extraneous features to abnormal point survey technology；Traditional abnormal point survey technology based on cluster or based on distance is overcome to depend on initial value selection unduly simultaneously, the real data assembly obtained by Virusshare and Google Play, which is puted the palms together before one, rolls over cross-validation method verifying effectiveness of the invention, to sum up, the present invention has broad application prospects in network safety filed.
assignees: UNIV JIANGSU

title_en: Method for determining influence maximization seed set size based on seepage model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining the size of an influence maximization seed set based on a seepage model, which comprises the steps of firstly carrying out seepage simulation on a target network to obtain the maximum connected subgraph size after seepage of the target network corresponding to different propagation probabilities; fitting the different propagation probabilities and the maximum connected subgraph size values after the target network seepage simulation corresponding to the different propagation probabilities to obtain a fitting function of the propagation probabilities and the maximum connected subgraph size after the target network seepage simulation corresponding to the propagation probabilities; obtaining a seepage value of the target network through a fitting function; and finally, solving the size of the target network influence maximization seed set through the seepage value. The method can quickly obtain the size of the seed set with the maximized influence of the target network, and has good robustness.

title_en: A kind of dual-active disaster recovery and backup systems with read and write abruption function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of dual-active disaster recovery and backup systems with read and write abruption function, including successively cascade network layer, application layer, data Layer, accumulation layer；The network layer provides the user channel for accessing operation system；The application layer passes through unified graphic interface all software and hardware resources states, the warning information Dynamic Display in unified interface in system；The data Layer includes two movable data centers, is used to carry out organization of unity management to business datum；The accumulation layer is for providing storage, synchronous, copy function.The system constructs the disaster recovery and backup systems of dual-active layer by layer using redundancy standby resources in strange land and primary data center in network layer, application layer, data Layer and accumulation layer, while utilizing read and write abruption cluster, realizes master/slave data center read and write abruption, mitigates primary data center load.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;INFORMATION COMMUNICATION COMPANY OF STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Power amplifier frequency domain behavior modeling method based on FFT and BP neural network model
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a power amplifier frequency domain behavior modeling method based on a Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) and Back Propagation (BP) neural network, which models a power amplifier from the perspective of a frequency domain and effectively solves the problem that the frequency domain precision of a common power amplifier behavior model is not high. The back propagation neural network model utilized by the method has good description capability on nonlinear data, and has the advantages of simple model structure, less required parameters and high convergence rate. The method can well describe the nonlinear characteristic and the memory effect of the power amplifier, especially the frequency domain characteristic of the power amplifier, and has higher model convergence speed and higher precision.

title_en: Power grid cascading failure modeling simulation method based on colored stochastic Petri network
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid cascading failure modeling simulation method based on a colored random Petri network, which comprises the following steps of: step 1, determining corresponding actions of a related relay protection device when each element fails according to a power grid system wiring diagram; step 2, classifying each level of relay protection devices of the elements according to the properties of the colored Petri network, and establishing a local CPN model for removing faults; step 3, integrating the local CPN models of all the elements with the fault removed into a CPN model of a fault removal route of the whole system; and 4, considering the possible fault condition of the relay protection device, and establishing an SCPN model of the whole system by using a random Petri network.

title_en: A kind of flexible measurement method for the reaction of high density polyethylene (HDPE) polymerization cascade
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of flexible measurement methods for the reaction of high density polyethylene (HDPE) polymerization cascade, data prediction is carried out using data correlation techniques and data mining technology, rule is found among creation data and analysis data, Intelligent software measure model and high density polyethylene (HDPE) unit consumption of product model are established using FL neural networks, use regularization method majorized function Connection Neural Network structure, the modeling accuracy for improving FL neural networks, ultimately forms high density polyethylene (HDPE) reaction process intelligent soft-measurement method.Technical solution provided by the invention has the characteristics that the response time is fast, modeling accuracy is high, provides help for the safety progress of guarantee high density polyethylene (HDPE) production, raising polymeric articles quality, saving production cost.FL neural networks provided by the invention based on regularization optimize weight by setting regularization parameter, to reduce network error, improve modeling accuracy and calculating speed.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING CHEM TECH

title_en: Fire-fighting safety management system using communication facility of apartment house
title_ko: 공동주택의 통신시설을 이용한 소방 안전관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a firefighting safety management system using a communication facility of an apartment house, which allows a fire for each household of an apartment house to be sensed and propagated based on a sensing signal of a home fine dust measurer installed at each household of an apartment house and a communication facility of a corresponding apartment house. According to the present invention, the firefighting safety management system using a communication facility of an apartment house comprises a fine dust measurer, a household intercom, a household indoor air measurement value database server, a firefighting control server, an intercom system, a robot cleaner, and a mobile smart device. According to the present invention, the fire in the corresponding household is sensed based on a sensing signal of a fine dust measurer installed in each household of an apartment house to normally maintain a 24-hour operation status, thereby fundamentally solving the mismanagement of a corresponding sensor due to dependency only on an existing firefighting-dedicated sensor and a non-operation phenomenon caused thereby.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 공동주택의 세대별 설치되는 가정용 미세먼지측정기의 감지 신호 및 해당 공동주택의 통신시설을 기반으로 공동주택의 각 세대별 화재 감지 및 전파가 이루어질 수 있도록 하는 공동주택의 통신시설을 이용한 소방 안전관리 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명에 따른 공동주택의 통신시설을 이용한 소방 안전관리 시스템은 미세먼지측정기, 세대 인터폰, 세대 실내공기 측정값 데이터베이스 서버, 소방 제어 서버, 인터폰 시스템, 로봇 청소기 및 모바일 스마트 디비이스를 포함하여 구성되며, 이러한 구성에 따라 공동주택에 세대 단위로 설치되어 통상 24시간 작동 상태를 유지하는 미세먼지측정기의 감지 신호를 기반으로 해당 세대의 화재 감지가 이루어짐에 따라, 기존의 소방 전용 센서에만 의존하는데 따른 해당 센서의 관리 부실 및 그에 따른 미작동 현상이 근본적으로 해결될 수 있게 된다.
assignees: I B ENG CO LTD

title_en: Seismic vibration isolation system for building, and method for constructing this same
title_ko: 건축물 기둥용 면진 시설물 및 이의 시공 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a vibration isolation facility for a building column and a construction method thereof. An objective of the present invention is to prevent a movement of ground from propagating to a column by an effective separation movement of the ground and the column during an earthquake to prevent shaking of the column and collapse of a building. According to the present invention, the vibration isolation facility for a building column comprises: a moving plate (11) seated on ground and fixed by an anchor settled in the ground to move with the ground; a plurality of ball transfers (12) installed on the moving plate to move with the moving plate; a movement absorption plate (13) fixed on a lower end of the column to be placed on the ball transfers and prevent movements of the moving plate and the ball transfers from propagating to the column; and a link (14) wherein both vertical ends thereof are connected to the movement absorption plate and the moving plate. The present invention includes a column installation groove (20) formed on the ground, opened upwards, and sealed by a cover. A lower portion of the column is inserted and installed in the column installation groove.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 건축물 기둥용 면진 시설물 및 이의 시공 방법에 관한 것으로, 지진 시 지반과 기둥의 원활한 분리 거동을 통해 지반의 거동이 기둥으로 전파되는 것을 막아 기둥의 흔들림과 건축물의 붕괴를 막아주는 것을 목적으로 한다. 
본 발명에 의한 건축물 기둥용 면진 시설물은, 지반에 안착되며 지중에 정착된 앵커를 통해 고정되어 지반과 함께 거동하는 거동판(11)과; 상기 거동판의 위에 설치되어 상기 거동판과 함께 거동하는 다수의 볼 트랜스퍼(12)와; 상기 기둥의 하단부에 고정되어 상기 볼 트랜스퍼 위에 올려지며 상기 거동판과 상기 볼 트랜스퍼의 거동이 기둥에 전파되는 것을 차단하는 거동흡수판(13)과; 상하 양단부가 상기 거동흡수판과 상기 거동판에 각각 연결하는 링크(14)를 포함한다. 본 발명은 지반에 상부를 향해 개방 형성되며 덮개를 통해 밀폐되는 기둥 설치홈(20)을 포함하며, 상기 기둥은 저부가 상기 기둥 설치홈 안에 삽입 설치된다.
assignees: BYUN DUK GYU

title_en: A kind of bunch wire crosstalk prediction technique based on BP-FDTD algorithm
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of bunch wire crosstalk prediction techniques, relate to the extracting method of bunch wire RLCG parameter matrix and the calculation method of bunch wire crosstalk.Include the following steps: step 1: establishing the physical model of bunch wire, bunch wire is considered as to the parallel multi-conductor transmission lines being cascaded by the straight wire of unlimited " short "；The RLCG parameter matrix of the parallel multi-conductor transmission lines of step 2: on extraction bunch wire in single pitch on different location " short "；Step 3: being learnt using RLCG parameter matrix of back propagation (BP) neural network to extraction and training, is obtained the bunch wire RLCG parameter matrix based on BP neural network and is extracted model；Step 4: extracting model for the bunch wire RLCG parameter matrix based on BP neural network and Implicite Wendroff finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) algorithm combine, and solves the time domain crosstalk of bunch wire single-frequency point；Step 5: by the excitation source frequency in control FDTD algorithm, the frequency domain crosstalk of bunch wire is obtained.
assignees: ZHENJIANG INST FOR INNOVATION AND DEVELOPMENT NNU

title_en: Power distribution network blocking scheduling method
abstract_en: The application discloses a power distribution network blocking scheduling method, which is applied to a central controller of a multi-energy system and comprises the steps of obtaining system information, load requirements and energy market information of the multi-energy system; performing target optimization according to system information, load demand and energy market information under constraint conditions to determine equipment output and interactive power information of the multi-energy system, and reporting the interactive power information to a power distribution network dispatching center; and receiving safety constraint information sent by the distribution network dispatching center when the distribution network is blocked and judging the existence of the interactive power information and the node information of each node under the distribution network, and performing target optimization according to the safety constraint information to obtain the corresponding equipment output. The method can effectively solve the problem of reverse blocking of the power distribution network while realizing cascade utilization of energy. The application also discloses a power distribution network congestion scheduling method applied to the power distribution network scheduling center, a central controller and the power distribution network scheduling center, and the power distribution network congestion scheduling method, the central controller and the power distribution network scheduling center have the technical effects.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Method for short-term generation scheduling of cascade hydropower plants coupling cluster analysis and decision tree
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of hydropower scheduling, and relates to a method for short-term generation scheduling of cascade hydropower plants coupling cluster analysis and decision tree. Linear regression technique is adopted to determine a matching relationship of energy production between upstream and downstream hydropower plants. With the relationship, typical generation curves of each hydropower plant can be clustered from lots of historical data. These typical generation curves and impact factors of generation scheduling such as planned daily electricity, reservoir level, and power grid characteristics, are together trained to obtain decision-making library for generation scheduling of cascaded hydropower plants. Thus, the decision tree method can be used to rapidly determine an operational scheme for generation scheduling of cascaded hydropower plants. Finally, a correction strategy for operation constraints is introduced to ensure feasibility of the operation scheme. The invention can quickly obtain generation schedules of cascade hydropower plants.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN TECH

title_en: Short-term practical scheduling method for super-large-scale hydroelectric station group
abstract_en: A short-term practical scheduling method for a super-large-scale hydroelectric station group, belonging to the field of hydroelectric scheduling and operation. In the method, all hydroelectric stations are divided into three types according to scheduling features such as system levels, spatial attributes, task requirements and particularity of plans, a peak adjustment response based surplus water correction strategy and a valley-hour load balance and cutdown strategy are proposed, realizing the check analysis and contribution adjustment for power stations under a fixed scheduling mode. For small and medium-sized basin cascaded hydroelectric stations, taking a total contribution process as a control condition, and for the goal of minimum water consumption, load distribution between cascaded hydroelectric stations is optimized; and for large-scale basin cascaded hydroelectric stations, a peak adjustment scheduling model is constructed, and an equal load rate scheduling method for balancing power stations is proposed, so as to realize system peak adjustment response and full-time load balance. The method can quickly give a rational hydroelectric scheduling result, satisfying the timeliness and practicability requirements of actual operation of a power grid and providing a new technological approach for efficiently solving super-large-scale hydroelectric system scheduling.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN TECH

title_en: Power grid fragile line classification method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a classification method and a classification device for fragile lines of a power grid, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring accident chains of a power grid to be processed, calculating and obtaining a cascading failure accident chain set of the power grid to be processed according to the accident chains, analyzing the cascading failure accident chain set of the power grid to be processed to obtain a weight index between the lines in the power grid to be processed, and determining the fragile type of the line from a plurality of preset fragile types according to the weight index between the lines. By the aid of the power grid fragile line classification method and device, lines in a power grid to be processed can be accurately classified.

title_en: Clairvoyant type soundproof and fireproof door
title_ko: 투시형 방음문
abstract_en: The present invention takes precautions against fire by construct new skyscrapers, high-rise apartments, and factories, and focuses on development of products supplemented with facilities. The present invention relates to a fireproof door for acquiring a checking window which enables a flame position and a fire propagation state to be recognized at the other side so that an evacuator can easily determine excavation passage. The fireproof door is provided with an inner panel, an outer panel, and a reinforcement material disposed between the inner and outer panels. Moreover, the fireproof door comprises: front and rear reinforcement glass members formed on the fireproof door by forming a perforator on the inner panel and the outer panel; a fixing molding member configured to fix the front and rear reinforcement glass members at four sides; and a coolant (extinguishing liquid) inserted between the front and rear reinforcement glass members.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 초고층빌딩, 초고층아파트, 공장 등이 새롭게 건설됨으로서 화제의한 대비책을 강구 및 시설물을 보충한 제품개발에 역점을 두고 있으며, 그 중에 본 발명은 방화문에 역점을 두고 개발하여 상대쪽에서 화염위치와 전파상태를 알 수 있도록 하여 대피자가 대비통로 등을 쉽게 결정할 수 있는 확인창을 얻기 위한 것이바, 내측판넬과 외측판넬과 상기 내/외측판넬 사이에 보강재를 구비한 방화문에 있어서, 상기 방화문에 내측판넬과 외측판넬 
에 천공구를 형성하여 형성한 전/후방 강화유리부재와 상기 전/후방 강화유리부재를 사면에서 고정하도록 구성된 고정몰딩부재와 상기 전/후방 강화유리부재의 사이에 삽입 구성된 냉각재(소화액 등)를 구성한 특징이 있다.

title_en: A kind of depth calculation model for Fault Diagnosis of Aircraft Engine Gas Path
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of depth calculation models for Fault Diagnosis of Aircraft Engine Gas Path, belong to field of computer technology, include the following steps: that (1) is split pretreatment to continuous boat volatility data；(2) space characteristics of data object block are extracted using convolutional neural networks；(3) the local nonlinearity feature in multi-layer perception (MLP) learning data object block is utilized；(4) using Recognition with Recurrent Neural Network extract data object block in it is long when dependence characteristics；(5) using method, i.e. joint error back-propagation algorithm end to end, training depth mixed model.The present invention implements the characteristics of considering aero-engine model, merge the spatial character of gas circuit performance data of its generation, nonlinear characteristic and it is long when dependency characteristic, construct the road fault diagnosis model of getting angry that navigates, and using classification task as target, devises joint error back-propagation algorithm and trained end to end for depth mixed model.

title_en: The Unit Combination dispatching method that multistage power grid links in regional power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses the Unit Combination dispatching methods that multistage power grid in a kind of regional power system links, comprising steps of determining multistage power grid active load and power grid unit operating parameter at different levels in regional power system；Establish the security constraint Unit Combination economic load dispatching model for considering that Unit Commitment, power grid active load at different levels are linkage decision content；Analytic approach solving model is cascaded based on target, determines system optimal scheduling result.Microgrid constraint includes microgrid power-balance constraint, the constraint of microgrid tie-line power transmission.The present invention surrounds a certain regional power system, using district system overall operation cost minimization as target, under the premise of meeting power grid layers at different levels and respectively constraining, establish the security constraint Unit Combination model for considering that Unit Commitment, power grid layer initiative ability at different levels are linkage decision content, realize the united analysis and decision to Integrated power system, and the model is solved using the target of Distributed Parallel Computing cascade analytic approach (ATC), realize complication system source net lotus cooperative scheduling.
