title_en: Hybrid cascade reservoir combined flood control optimal scheduling method considering branch flood storage civil application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined cascade reservoir combined flood control optimal scheduling method considering branch and flood storage civil-oriented application, which comprises the following steps: s1, obtaining flood diversion flow, flood diversion time and flooding area/flood diversion volume samples when the civil-oriented potential flood diversion is used; s2, training an artificial neural network model based on the sample, and constructing a civil flood diversion flow-inundation area/flood diversion volume space-time prediction knowledge base; s3, establishing a flood control optimization scheduling model which is applied by a branch flood storage consumer-oriented machine in consideration; and S4, based on the space-time prediction knowledge base, calculating and analyzing a hybrid reservoir group and flood control optimal scheduling model which is applied by considering the branch flood storage and the hybrid reservoir group and the civil-oriented vehicle to obtain an optimal scheduling scheme. The invention constructs a flood diversion flow-flooding area/flood diversion amount space-time prediction knowledge base by training an artificial neural network, and uses the knowledge base as a boundary condition of a combined flood control optimization scheduling model of the series-parallel cascade reservoir, thereby extracting flood diversion information in real time and realizing real-time scheduling.

title_en: Power grid node importance degree evaluation method, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid node importance degree evaluation method, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining power grid node information according to the power grid data information; preprocessing the power grid node information to obtain training data; performing clustering analysis processing on the training data to obtain clustering data; obtaining a membership function according to the clustering data; initializing the rule parameters of the membership function to obtain initialized rule parameters; and obtaining a power grid node evaluation value function according to the membership function and the initialized rule parameters, performing cluster analysis processing on the power grid node information, and constructing the membership function to construct a power grid node importance evaluation model, thereby obtaining the power grid node evaluation value function, namely forming a multi-rule power grid node importance evaluation model to realize comprehensive evaluation of the power grid node importance, effectively preventing power grid cascading faults, guaranteeing safe and stable operation of a power grid, and ensuring the economic benefit of a power grid enterprise.

title_en: Photovoltaic power station short-term power prediction method based on gated cyclic unit network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a photovoltaic power station short-term power prediction method based on a gated cyclic unit network. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: step S1: selecting meteorological parameters as model input according to weather types of days to be predicted, wherein the dominant meteorological parameters are different in different weather types; step S2: processing 20 days of history data before the day to be predicted, eliminating abnormal values and values of the night, and then performing normalization processing on the historical power and the historical NWP meteorological parameters to serve as a training data set; step S3: learning the training data set by adopting a gate control cycle unit network, and adjusting parameters of the network by using a root-mean-square back propagation algorithm; step S4: and taking the NWP meteorological parameters of the day to be predicted as the input of the model to obtain the predicted power value. The method can obviously improve the accuracy and reliability of the short-term power prediction of the photovoltaic power station.

title_en: Cross-basin hydropower station group peak shaving optimization scheduling method considering water abandoning risk
abstract_en: The invention discloses a peak shaving optimization scheduling method for a cross-basin hydropower station group considering water abandoning risks, which comprises the following steps of: s1, constructing a hydropower station group peak regulation optimization scheduling model; s2, calculating the water abandoning risk of each cascade hydropower station; s3, coordinating and distributing the generated energy of each power station based on the water abandoning risk of each power station; and S4, calculating the optimal solution of the peak regulation optimal scheduling model of the hydropower station group based on the electric quantity distribution of each power station to obtain the output process line of each power station, and finishing the combined peak regulation scheduling of the hydropower station group. The risk of water abandonment of the hydropower station is quantitatively analyzed through runoff frequency, peak shaving electric quantity of different basin hydropower station groups is coordinately distributed based on the water abandonment risk value, the water abandonment risk of each power station can be fully considered, runoff compensation and electric power compensation benefits of the different basin hydropower station groups are brought into play, the risk of water abandonment of hydropower is greatly reduced when a power grid hydropower system peaks shaving, and the electric quantity of water abandonment of hydropower is reduced.

title_en: Consider the real-time generation schedule optimization method of northern Shensi cascade cross-section limitation linkage adjustment
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of real-time generation schedule optimization method of consideration northern Shensi cascade cross-section limitation linkage adjustment, it include: based on all kinds of basic datas of real-time generation schedule, it constructs broad sense and gets in touch with the off line province's two-stage real-time generation schedule Coordination and Optimization Model of ray mode, cascade cross-section limitation combined optimization for real-time generation schedule and northern Shensi and unit original plan value and the initial trend value of section are provided；Based on all kinds of basic datas of real-time generation schedule, unit original plan and the initial trend value of section, building considers the real-time generation schedule Optimized model of northern Shensi cascade cross-section limitation linkage adjustment, it is minimum that optimization aim introduces northern Shensi virtual partition new energy abandonment amount, constraint condition introduces northern Shensi subregion and cascades section, the constraint such as Central Shanxi Plain subregion receiving ability, realize the combined optimization of unit output and stable cross section limit, Shaanxi Province northern Shensi subregion new energy consumption potentiality are sufficiently excavated, improve the utilization rate of northern Shensi cascade section, the lean for improving the scheduling of northwest regional power grid new energy is horizontal.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;NORTHWEST CHINA GRID CO LTD;STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Nonlinear smearing language power distribution network node Vulnerability Assessment based on complex network
abstract_en: This application involves the nonlinear smearing language power distribution network node Vulnerability Assessments based on complex network, comprising: according to distribution network data, constructs power distribution network complex network model；It determines the importance measurement index of power distribution network node, constructs network node Assessment of Important database；Determine the parameter of fuzzy rule in power distribution network complex network model；Data clusters analysis is carried out to database using clustering method；Establish the nonlinear smearing language power distribution network node Evaluation of vulnerability model based on complex network；Carry out parameter optimization；Power distribution network node fragility is analyzed using the evaluation model after optimization；Power distribution network node is safeguarded based on the analysis results.Analysis and the accurate evaluation of power distribution network node fragility are realized using nonlinear smearing language, to be safeguarded to power distribution network node, reduce cascading failure risk, ensure the safe and stable operation of power distribution network, and then meet the power demand of user, promote the economic benefit of user power utilization quality and power grid enterprises.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Construction method of risk chain group of rail transit system based on infectious disease model
abstract_en: The invention provides a construction method of a rail transit system risk chain group based on an infectious disease model, which comprises the following steps: determining risk points in the rail transit system, and connecting through edges according to the action relationship of the risk points to form a risk network; then calculating the initial risk point migration measure of the risk points and the coupling measure between the risk points, and further calculating the heterogeneous risk propagation comprehensive probability according to the initial average infection rate of the risk points; on the basis of a traditional infectious disease model, a risk point state migration measure, a risk point coupling measure and a heterogeneous risk propagation probability are combined to construct a rail transit system risk propagation evolution dynamic model, and a risk chain group of a rail transit system is constructed by using an asynchronous updating method according to the rail transit system risk propagation evolution dynamic model. The risk chain group obtained by the method can reflect the propagation and evolution rules of risks in the rail transit system, and can provide theoretical support for rail transit operation management.

title_en: Business service disaster recovery method, device, system, management server and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a kind of business service disaster recovery methods, device, system, management server and electronic equipment, method includes: that management server receives the bind-request message based on network channel address negotiation protocol that client is sent, according to the address information of the client of bind-request message carrying and the server info for the multiple service servers being obtained ahead of time, from multiple service servers, it is assigned as client and the standby traffic server of specified services service is provided, the protocol message based on network channel address negotiation protocol is sent to client, the address information of protocol message carrying about standby service server, so that client parses the address information of standby traffic server from protocol message, and when detecting specified services exception, according to the address information of standby traffic server, handover access standby traffic service Device improves service experience to realize to reduce occurring the case where specified services service disruption or Caton.
assignees: BEIJING QIYI CENTURY SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic module fault diagnosis method, system and equipment based on deep convolution countermeasure network
abstract_en: The invention provides a photovoltaic module fault diagnosis method for generating a countermeasure network by deep convolution, which comprises the following steps: establishing a mathematical model of the photovoltaic module; acquiring a fault image of the photovoltaic component; setting partial fault data as training samples; constructing a training model of a deep convolution countermeasure network; a generator G inputs a noise vector and outputs a pseudo image through a deconvolution layer; inputting a real sample and a pseudo sample by a discriminator D, extracting convolution characteristics through convolution operation, and obtaining the probability of the real sample; optimizing weight parameters through a back propagation algorithm, then starting the next cycle, and outputting a test image every 300 cycles; and inputting the real sample and the obtained test sample into a classifier, classifying the fault types, and realizing fault diagnosis. According to the fault diagnosis method, a large number of fault images are generated by utilizing the deep convolutional network, and a fault image database is expanded, so that the classification of faults is more detailed, and the diagnosis of the faults is more accurate.
assignees: NANJING UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Earthquake regulating type stand chair
title_ko: 지진통제형 관람석
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an earthquake-controlled seat, which can minimize the casualties as save evacuation induction of a visitor and on-site control are quickly made when detecting an earthquake, while automatically detecting the occurrence of the earthquake, at the same time. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the earthquake-controlled seat comprises: a seat body provided in a public viewing facility and having a plurality of seat chairs cascaded in accordance with a plurality of rows and columns; an earthquake detection sensor installed in the seat body and detecting an intensity of vibration transmitted from the ground; an electronic board installed at one side of the public viewing facility; and an evacuation induction controller receiving a sensor signal of the earthquake detection sensor and displaying earthquake occurrence facts and emergency evacuation route information through the electronic board when detecting the vibration intensity over a set value.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지진 발생여부가 자동으로 감지됨과 동시에 지진 감지시에 관람객의 안전한 대피유도와 현장 통제가 신속하게 이루어짐에 따라 인명피해가 최소화될 수 있도록 한 지진통제형 관람석에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 지진통제형 관람석은, 대중관람시설에 구비되고 복수의 관람석 의자가 다수의 행과 열에 맞춰 계단식으로 설치되는 관람석본체와, 상기 관람석본체에 설치되고 지면으로부터 전달되는 진동의 강도를 감지하는 지진감지센서와, 상기 대중관람시설의 일측에 설치되는 전광판과, 상기 지진감지센서의 센서신호를 수신하여 설정값 이상의 진동 강도 감지시에 상기 전광판을 통해 지진발생사실과 긴급대피로 정보를 표시하는 대피유도컨트롤러를 포함한다.
assignees: NSEATING CO LTD

title_en: Air pollution treatment method based on air pollution propagation mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air pollution treatment method based on an air pollution propagation mode, which comprises the following steps: (1) according to meteorological data and air pollution data, aiming at each air monitoring station at each moment, constructing an air pollution transportation modeling based on sampling simulation between the air pollution transportation modeling and the surrounding air monitoring stations, and obtaining an air pollution transportation example; (2) according to the air pollution transportation example, connecting the air pollution transportation examples which are continuous in space and time by adopting an algorithm of breadth search to form a large amount of air pollution propagation networks; (3) carrying out frequent sub-graph mining on a large number of air pollution propagation networks, and extracting frequently-occurring pollution propagation paths to obtain an air pollution propagation mode; (4) and adopting corresponding air treatment measures according to the air pollution propagation mode. The air pollution treatment method can adopt corresponding air treatment means according to the air pollution propagation mode, and improves the air treatment effect.

title_en: A kind of step power station load variations real-time adaptive method considering daily electricity deviation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to Optimized Scheduling of Hydroelectric Power fields, are related to a kind of step power station load variations real-time adaptive method for considering daily electricity deviation.Since the network load used in power grid generation schedule formulation a few days ago predicts that there are deviations, it is in actual operation realization balancing the load, the variation according to network load is needed, the generation schedule in part power station is adjusted in real time, and step power station is usually as this kind of balancing the load power station.The present invention, which is used, determines step hydropower station power output increase and decrease sequence relative to the abandoning water reduced rate of step electric quantity change, the daily electricity deviation ratio more than limitation, the step accumulation of energy increase rate relative to step electric quantity change three criterion with priority, and the distribution of day part step load increase and decrease amount is successively carried out according to sequence.This method can take into account step waterpower utilization rate and power grid needs, be more easily the receiving of cascade operation department, practicability is stronger.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN TECH;GUIZHOU QIANYUAN POWER CO LTD

title_en: Multistage scheduling mechanism coordinated step hydropower station real-time scheduling water abandoning reduction method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of hydropower dispatching operation, and particularly relates to a cascade hydropower station real-time dispatching water abandoning reduction method coordinated by a multi-stage dispatching mechanism. The method can carry out real-time plan quick adjustment on the water abandon possibly generated in the day at the cascade centralized control center end by considering the load balance and the stable operation factors of the power grid, improve the receptivity of the total dispatching and the intermediate dispatching to the real-time dispatching scheme, or reduce the adjustment range of the total dispatching and the intermediate dispatching to the centralized control proposal real-time dispatching scheme, and improve the real-time dispatching coordination efficiency of the multistage dispatching mechanism.

title_en: Cascade hydropower station short-term multi-objective optimization scheduling method considering peak shaving requirements
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of hydropower dispatching operation, and relates to a short-term multi-objective optimization dispatching method for a cascade hydropower station in consideration of peak shaving requirements. Aiming at adjusting the peak load of a power grid and improving the hydroelectric generation efficiency, considering both the complex operation requirement of the cascade hydropower station and the constraint of a unit vibration region, constructing a multi-target short-term optimization scheduling model of the cascade hydropower station by using mixed integer nonlinear programming, solving the model by using an improved normalization method plane constraint method, and obtaining a Pareto solution set containing a plurality of non-inferior solution schemes to provide powerful support for the final decision of a scheduling staff; in addition, the invention also uses a membership value calculation method based on fuzzy evaluation to evaluate each solution in the solution set, and selects a decision proposal scheme for the reference of dispatchers. The invention starts from the practical situation of short-term optimal dispatching of hydropower station, comprehensively considers the complex power generation operation constraint of the power station, gives consideration to the comprehensive operation benefits in multiple aspects, and meets the complex dispatching operation requirement of the cascade hydropower station.

title_en: System and method for managing national disaster safety based on a blockchain
title_ko: 블록체인을 기반으로 한 국가 재난 관리 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for national disaster management based on a block chain. The system for national disaster management includes a block chain network includes a plurality of nodes whose identities are verified, and context information for nodes participating in the block chain network is recorded in blocks of a block chain. Also, a node to provide disaster-related information generates a transaction including encoded data and an access tree, digitally signs the generated transaction by using a private key of the node, and then generates a block including the signed transaction to disseminate the block to the block chain network. The data are disaster-related data. The access tree is generated by using context information of nodes having an access right to a block including a corresponding transaction, and preferably has access right information for encoded data included in the corresponding transaction.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 블록체인을 기반으로 한 국가 재난 관리 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 상기 국가 재난 관리 시스템은, 신원이 증명된 다수 개의 노드들을 포함하여 구성된 블록체인 네트워크를 구비하고, 상기 블록체인 네트워크에 참여하는 노드들에 대한 컨텍스트 정보는 블록체인의 블록에 기록된 것을 특징으로 한다. 또한, 본 발명에 따라 재난 관련 정보를 제공하고자 하는 노드는 재난 번호, 암호화된 데이터 및 액세스 트리를 포함한 트랜잭션을 생성하고, 상기 생성된 트랜잭션을 자신의 개인키를 이용하여 디지털 서명한 후, 상기 서명된 트랜잭션을 포함하는 블록을 생성하여 블록체인 네트워크로 전파하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 상기 데이터는 재난 관련 데이터이며, 상기 액세스 트리는 해당 트랜잭션을 포함하는 블록에 대한 접근 권한을 갖는 노드들의 컨텍스트 정보들을 이용하여 생성된 것으로서, 해당 트랜잭션에 포함된 암호화된 데이터에 대한 접근 권한 정보를 갖는 것이 바람직하다.

title_en: A kind of forest rocket detection method based on region division and feature extraction
abstract_en: The forest rocket detection method based on region division and feature extraction that the present invention provides a kind of, belongs to computer image processing technology field, comprising: establish forest rocket sample data set；Choose suitable static nature and training cascade neural network；The first frame of video to be processed is chosen, adaptive region segmentation is carried out；Motion detection is carried out to video to be processed；Prediction classification is carried out to doubtful pyrotechnics region.The method of the present invention calculates simply, reduces operand and a large amount of erroneous detections, has relatively good real-time in the not high equipment of calculating speed, while rate of false alarm is greatly reduced；The method of the present invention has important application value in terms of forest rocket, is of great significance in forest fire protection field of video monitoring.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Automatic conversion method and system for D5000-matpower grid multi-disaster coupling cascading failure model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic conversion method of a D5000-matpower grid multi-disaster coupling cascading failure model, which comprises the following steps: acquiring first data from a D5000 system; acquiring second data from the relay protection setting calculation system; converting the transformer model of the first data into a power transmission line model; taking the capacity of the transformer in the first data as the limit carrying capacity of the power transmission line in the power transmission line model, and updating the capacity into the first data; judging whether the component name in the second data is matched with the component name in the first data; selecting parameters required for describing the matpower primary model and the matpower secondary model from the first data as member variables, and respectively establishing the primary model and the secondary model; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a power grid element fault set and the probability of each fault in the set under the multi-disaster coupling condition, determining parameters required by describing each fault in the power grid element fault set as member variables, and obtaining a power grid multi-disaster coupling cascading fault model. The invention improves the efficiency and the accuracy of the model generation.

title_en: Automatic active load adjustment method and system for cascade power station group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for automatically adjusting active load of a cascade power station group, which comprises the following steps: s100, a daily active load plan curve of each power station power grid of a drainage basin is issued through a non-control network II area scheduling support system, a given daily active load plan curve text file is automatically extracted, then the daily active load plan curve text file is automatically read by a control network I area computer monitoring system, corresponding data safety check is carried out, and the daily active load plan curve is converted into an active load regulation curve meeting power grid active load regulation rules through an algorithm; and S200, automatically issuing an active load regulation curve to AGC centralized control active set values of each power station in real time according to requirements by a control network I area computer monitoring system, and automatically adjusting the active load. The method can realize automatic adjustment of the active load at the side of the power station in the convection area, replace manual adjustment of a load plan curve, reduce the operation frequency of dispatching personnel, reduce the working pressure of daily dispatching on duty, improve the working efficiency and safety and improve the load adjustment precision.

title_en: Maritime distress rescue system
title_ko: 해상 조난 구조 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a maritime distress rescue system. While enabling closed communication between a gateway of a ship and distress signal transmitters of passengers in the ship, a rescue request signal of the distress signal transmitter can be received by a gateway of another ship in the event of a distress accident, such that a rescue operation for a rescuer is conducted quickly and accurately. Also, when the distress accident occurs, a mesh network is formed between the distress signal transmitters such that the rescue request signals transmitted from the distress signal transmitters are propagated without omissions and crosstalk. According to an embodiment, a maritime distress rescue system comprises: a plurality of distress signal transmitters determining a distress situation, transmitting a distress signal when the distress situation occurs, and consisting of a plurality of groups; a plurality of gateways each communicating with the plurality of distress signal transmitters belonging to the same group, and receiving the distress signal; and a master device controlling a signal receiving authority of the other group of each gateway by communicating with the plurality of gateways.
abstract_ko: 선박의 게이트웨이와 선박 내 탑승자들의 조난용 신호 송출기 간의 폐쇄적인 통신을 가능하게 하면서, 조난 사고 발생시에는 조난용 신호 송출기의 구조 요청 신호를 다른 선박의 게이트웨이에서도 수신할 수 있도록 하여, 조난자의 구조 활동이 신속하고 정확하게 이루어지도록 하고, 또한 조난 사고 발생시, 조난용 신호 송출기들 간에 메쉬 네트워크를 구성하여 조난용 신호 송출기들에서 전송된 구조 요청 신호가 누락 없이 그리고 혼선 없이 전파될 수 있도록 하는 해상 조난 구조 시스템이 개시된다. 일 실시예에 따른 해상 조난 구조 시스템은, 조난 상황을 판단하고 조난 상황 발생시 조난 신호를 전송하며 복수의 그룹으로 이루어진 복수의 조난용 신호 송출기; 각각 동일한 그룹에 속하는 상기 복수의 조난용 신호 송출기와 통신하며 상기 조난 신호를 수신하는 복수의 게이트웨이; 및 상기 복수의 게이트웨이와 통신하여 각 게이트웨이의 타 그룹의 신호 수신 권한을 제어하는 마스터 장치를 포함한다.
assignees: STORYFORYOU CO LTD

title_en: Private network mirroring
abstract_en: Techniques for private network mirroring are described. Users can select one or more existing private networks to be mirrored in the same or different network area. Any network configuration changes made in the selected private network (e.g., “master” private network) can be propagated automatically to the mirror private network. This enables users to utilize resources in another network area for disaster recovery, ensuring that the network configuration of the mirror private network is consistent with the master private network through real-time updates. Additionally, users managing infrastructure that includes multiple private networks can select one master private network and propagate configuration changes to other private networks, reducing management overhead incurred by these multi-private network installations.
assignees: AMAZON TECH INC

title_en: Short-term electric vehicle charging load prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-term electric vehicle charging load prediction method and system. When the daily load prediction model is established, the data mining is carried out on the samples in the sample library by using a neighbor propagation method, so that the prediction efficiency of the prediction model can be effectively improved. Meanwhile, the method fully utilizes the characteristic extraction advantages of the convolutional neural network, converts the charging load numerical value in the sample into image data by utilizing an RGB color mapping method, and simultaneously considers the influences of seasons, weather, temperature, holidays and traffic volumes on the charging load, thereby greatly improving the prediction accuracy of the prediction model. On the basis, the weight and the threshold of the convolutional neural network are subjected to multi-objective optimization by using a non-inferior ranking genetic algorithm, and then the convolutional neural network is trained based on the optimal initial weight and the optimal initial threshold, so that the problem of long network training time caused by initialization random giving of neurons in the network can be effectively solved, and the prediction speed of a prediction model is further improved.
assignees: UNIV YANSHAN

title_en: Load prediction method based on improved cuckoo-neural network algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a load prediction method based on an improved cuckoo-neural network algorithm, which comprises the following steps: calculating the maximum influence factor: collecting local meteorological data and historical load power data recorded by a system by using a monitoring system arranged on a load side, and finding out the type of influence factor with the maximum load influence degree by using an average influence value algorithm (MIV); selecting similar days: selecting a similar day according to the maximum influence factor calculated in the step one; the invention has the beneficial effects that: finding the first n environmental factors with the largest influence on the load by adopting an average influence value algorithm (MIV), selecting a similar day by combining the optimal similarity, finally improving the traditional cuckoo algorithm, applying the improved algorithm to a BP (back propagation) neural network, and predicting the load; the improved cuckoo algorithm can avoid the algorithm from falling into a local optimal solution and has stronger global search capability.
assignees: UNIV DONGGUAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Short-term load prediction method based on BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of load prediction of an electric power market, in particular to a short-term load prediction method based on a BP (back propagation) neural network.
assignees: UNIV GUANGDONG TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Automatic avoidance method for high-water-head irregular multiple restricted areas of main flow cascade hydropower station group
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of hydropower dispatching operation, in particular to an automatic avoidance method for a high-water-head irregular multi-restricted area of a main flow cascade hydropower station group. The technical scheme is as follows: on the basis of mathematical definition of unit limited area constraints, an automatic analysis technology subdivision is carried out on an irregular limited area by using a Hertel-Mehlhorn convex subdivision algorithm, and then a convex optimization theory and an extraction planning theory are adopted to carry out modeling on a subdivided result. The method can automatically avoid irregular multiple restricted areas, and achieves the effect of automatic modeling and solving. The method has important significance for responding to the new situation that the hydropower output changes frequently under the marketization condition in the future in response to the differentiated and automatic scheduling application of the power grid.

title_en: Fire-fighting apparatus using communication facility of apartment house
title_ko: 공동주택의 통신 시설을 이용한 소방 안전 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire safety apparatus using a communication facility of an apartment house which allows a person recognizing a fire when the fire occurs in an apartment house to quickly and easily spread the occurrence of the fire to people inside each household in the corresponding apartment house and then escape out of the corresponding apartment house to greatly lower the risk of loss of the life of the person spreading the occurrence of the fire and allow the people inside the corresponding apartment house to check a fire emergency warning accurately spread by other people inside the apartment house and an intercom in the corresponding household without considering malfunction of a fire alarm and then quickly evacuate. According to the present invention, the fire safety apparatus using a communication facility of an apartment house comprises an apartment house firefighting server, a first communication module, a second communication module, a household intercom, and an outdoor bell unit. The outdoor bell unit includes a case, a forward/reverse rotation motor, a decelerator, a rotary plate, a doorbell switching part, a fire emergency switching part, a pushbutton, a bell function display lamp, and a control part.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 공동주택의 화재 발생 시 그 사실을 인지한 사람이 해당 공동주택 내 각 세대의 재실자들에게 화재 발생 사실을 매우 신속하고 용이하게 전파 후 해당 공동주택의 외부로 빠져나올 수 있도록 함으로써, 화재 발생 사실을 전파하는 사람의 인명피해 위험성이 크게 낮아지는 동시에 해당 공동주택의 재실자들은 화재경보기의 오작동 등을 고려함 없이 타 재실자들 및 해당 세대 인터폰을 통해 정확히 전파되는 화재 비상 경보를 확인 후 신속하게 대피에 나설 수 있도록 한 공동주택의 통신 시설을 이용한 소방 안전 장치에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명에 따른 공동주택의 통신 시설을 이용한 소방 안전 장치는 공동주택 소방서버, 제1 통신모듈, 제2 통신모듈, 세대 인터폰 및 그 실외 벨 유닛을 포함하여 구성되고, 상기 실외 벳 유닛은 케이스, 정역회전모터, 감속기, 회전판, 초인종 스위칭부, 화재 비상 스위칭부, 누름버튼, 벨 기능 표시램프 및 제어부를 포함하여 구성된다.
assignees: CHEONIL E&C CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for determining power grid power failure key line based on cascading failure model
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for determining a power failure key line of a power grid based on a cascading failure model, which comprises the steps of obtaining a power grid model to be calculated and corresponding relevant model information thereof, and obtaining a topological structure of the power grid according to the power grid model and the corresponding relevant model information thereof; and determining the total number of days of cascading failure simulation mode simulation formed by the topological structure of the power grid, simulating by taking each day as a unit, obtaining the line number of the disconnected line output by each day of simulation after the total number of days of simulation is finished, further counting the number of the line numbers of the disconnected line output by each day of simulation, and outputting the disconnected line with the maximum number of the line numbers as the power grid power failure key line. By implementing the method and the device, the key line which has important influence on the cascading failure of the power system can be identified, and data support is provided for line capacity expansion.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Tri-Training-Lasso-BP network-based static voltage stability margin prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Tri-Training-Lasso-BP network-based static voltage stability margin prediction method. The method applies technologies such as neural network, semi-supervised Training, ensemble learning and the like to the prediction of the static voltage stability margin of the power system, and provides an online prediction method based on a Tri-Training-Lasso-BP network, which consists of a three-body Training method (Tri-Training), a least absolute value shrinkage selection (Lasso) method and a BP (back propagation) neural network. The method can reduce the requirements on the quantity and quality of the data of the training set, give full play to the advantages of mass data acquired in the daily operation process of the power system, improve the generalization capability and prediction precision of the network, reduce manual intervention, and solve the problems that the traditional method is difficult to realize online real-time prediction of the voltage stability margin, needs a large number of training samples and is easy to generate overfitting.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Water body dissolved oxygen detection device based on machine vision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a machine vision-based water body dissolved oxygen detection device, which comprises: the sampling device is used for sucking a water sample from a water body to be detected and storing the water sample in a sample storage bottle; the dropping device is used for storing a plurality of titrated solutions or reagents and reacting with dissolved oxygen in the water sample; the quartz glass reaction vessel is used for receiving the water sample output from the sample storage bottle and the solution or the reagent output from the dropping device and carrying out reaction in the quartz glass reaction vessel; the information processing module comprises a shooting module and a control panel, wherein the shooting module is used for shooting liquid in the quartz glass reaction vessel, an image obtained by shooting is input to a processor of the control panel, the processor is used for processing the image, RGB components of the image are extracted, the RGB components are converted into HSI components, and then the HSI components are used as input quantities to be input into a trained neural network to obtain the concentration of dissolved oxygen; the neural network is trained by an error back propagation method.

title_en: Method and system for analyzing forest fire cascading failure risk of power transmission line of power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for analyzing forest fire cascading failure risks of a power transmission line of a power grid, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a virtual topology of the power transmission line of the power grid according to the power transmission line database and the map database of the power grid; determining a tidal current limit value of each power transmission line according to the heat capacity limit of each power transmission line, and establishing a corresponding relation between tidal current and load on each power transmission line; calculating the mountain fire trip probability of each power transmission line, and calculating the trip probability of the corresponding power transmission line: when the power flow of the tripped power transmission line is transferred to other power transmission lines, the load needs to be cut off when the power flow of other power transmission lines does not exceed the power flow limit value of the other power transmission lines; and combining the mountain fire trip probability of each power transmission line and the total load shedding amount of the power grid as risk evaluation indexes of mountain fire cascading faults of the power transmission lines of the power grid. The method can predict the risk of each power transmission line to the power grid due to the cascading failure caused by the forest fire.
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD DISASTER PREVENTION & MITIGATION CT;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power supply and distribution online maintenance simulation communication system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a power supply and distribution online maintenance simulation communication system, including high-pressure electric energy meter, high-pressure relay, low pressure electric energy meter, first switch, second switch, industrial network line, install the first computer that supplies the power distribution to overhaul simulation system and install the second computer that supplies the power distribution monitoring system, first computer and second computer are through peer-to-peer network connection first switch, several high-pressure electric energy meters are connected through industrial network line row by row, the one end of every row of high-pressure electric energy meter is connected with high-pressure relay, several rows of high-pressure electric energy meters are connected first switch through star type structure; the plurality of low-voltage electric energy meters are connected in a row through the industrial network cable, the plurality of low-voltage electric energy meters are connected with the second switch through the star-shaped structure, and the second switch is connected with the first switch through the industrial network cable in a cascading mode. The utility model discloses a communication network of mixed type provides the hardware environment that operating personnel on-line simulation overhauld the study, improves learning efficiency.
assignees: CHINA TOBACCO GUANGDONG IND CO

title_en: Automatic transfer switch
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an automatic transfer switch for the power management system of family, apartment, facility and building circuit includes the electric wire netting interactive system, and this electric wire netting interactive system includes patchcord, connects and the connection to outside electric power generation device to the electricity of socket. Embodiments include an automatic transfer switch for safely transferring a source of electrical power for an electrical circuit from a main power supply to a power generation device. The automatic transfer switch may include a microcontroller, a current regulator, a relay, and a circuit, wherein the switch is configured to prevent power from the primary power supply from propagating back into the secondary power supply. Additionally, the system may include a communication interface or an automatic interface associated with the system that detects a power outage or other grid or time related event.
assignees: JOULE CASE INC

title_en: Radio wave propagation simulation model creation method, creation system, creation device, and creation program
abstract_en: To solve a problem in the conventional technology in which it is difficult to automatically set a medium constant of an object such as a structure and to automatically create a radio wave propagation simulation model.SOLUTION: A radio wave propagation simulation model creation method includes: a first step of acquiring a large amount of texture image data from a network and accumulating first learned data for determining a medium corresponding to each piece of texture image data by deep learning; a second step of creating a 3D shape model of a communication area; a third step of extracting an object in two-dimensional image data corresponding to the 3D shape model and determining the medium corresponding to a surface image of the object by deep learning on the basis of the first learned data; a fourth step of referring to a database storing a medium constant for each medium and estimating a medium constant of the medium corresponding to the determined object; and a fifth step of setting the estimated medium constant to each object in the 3D shape model and creating a radio wave propagation simulation model in the communication area.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: NIPPON TELEGRAPH & TELEPHONE;UNIV HOKKAIDO

title_en: Petrochemical pipeline flange sealing surface bolt fixed-moment fastening method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for fastening a flange sealing surface of a petrochemical pipeline by bolts with fixed moment, which comprises the following steps of collecting the properties of the pipeline, the size of the flange and the number of bolts used, and determining the risk level and the fastening mode based on a BP (back propagation) neural network; determining an input layer neuron vector of the three-layer BP neural network; mapping the input layer vector to a hidden layer, wherein the number of neurons of the hidden layer is m; and step four, obtaining the neuron vector of the output layer. By collecting the pipeline property and the flange size and using the number of bolts, determining the risk level and the fastening mode based on the BP neural network, and after determining the fastening mode through the neural network, accurately controlling the bolt fixed torque according to the parameters of the flange and the gasket, the sealing quality is ensured, and the construction safety and efficiency are also improved.

title_en: Real-time tiny face detection method based on preprocessing mechanism
abstract_en: The invention mainly relates to the problem of target detection in the field of artificial intelligence. Aiming at the problem of tiny human faces in a complex environment, a cascading human face detection method is provided, and the method mainly comprises two neural networks and a preprocessing mechanism. Firstly, a first neural network, namely SSD is used for detecting a pedestrian confidence frame, then the region is transmitted into a preprocessing mechanism, the mechanism automatically predicts the region of interest of the face according to the length and the width of the confidence frame, and performs image pyramid processing on the region of interest, and the algorithm enables a second face detection network to detect faces with different sizes as the input size of the second network is fixed. The method provided by the invention can accurately and effectively detect the extremely small faces in a plurality of complex environments, and can be potentially used and integrated in the fields of public safety detection, face recognition and the like.
assignees: UNIV NANCHANG

title_en: Distributed reactive power optimization method and device for load prediction of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses  distributed reactive power optimization method and device for load prediction of an electric power system, wherein the method comprises the steps of dividing electric load information, meteorological information and holiday information of a predicted place into a test set of  input neurons, establishing an initial LSTM network, bringing a training set into the initial LSTM network for forward calculation and backward propagation training, inputting neuron information required by prediction of days through the trained LSTM network to perform load prediction on  time points, analyzing reactive power compensation characteristics of a distributed power supply, collecting target parameters of the distributed power supply to establish a reactive power model of the distributed power supply, establishing a reactive power optimization model of the power grid with the minimum network loss as a target function, and performing distributed optimization control calculation according to the reactive power average utilization rate and an instantaneous communication topology matrix to achieve distributed optimization.
assignees: UNIV CHINA AGRICULTURAL;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;NORTH CN ELEC POWER RES INST

title_en: Short-term optimized scheduling method and system for cascade reservoir group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-term optimized dispatching method and a short-term optimized dispatching system for a cascade reservoir group, which belong to the field of cooperative optimized dispatching of water-fire power stations, and are characterized in that the fitness of each individual in an initial population is obtained, and the positions of an optimal fitness individual, a suboptimal fitness individual and a third optimal fitness individual in the population are updated; then updating the positions of all individuals in the population and generating a temporary population; screening the population by adopting a variation strategy based on the population and the temporary population obtained after updating all individual positions of the population; and the self-adaptive boundary strategy is adopted to effectively prevent the population from falling into local optimum. And updating all individual positions in the population through iteration, and outputting the individual position with the optimal fitness as the optimal scheduling process of the cascade hydropower system after the stop condition is reached. The method has the advantages of high convergence speed, high solving precision, strong optimizing capability, capability of effectively avoiding being trapped in local optimal solution and the like, can well coordinate the water-fire power station cooperative scheduling among the power grids, improves the economic benefit, and has very high practical value.
assignees: UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH

title_en: Material S parameter measuring method based on de-embedding error
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for measuring S parameter of material, which comprises establishing signal flow chart of measuring process, and determining state equation of embedding error; according to a signal flow chart of a measurement process, five state models of a port network in the material S parameter measurement system are constructed by changing a test sample; establishing a fixture S parameter state equation of the five state models, and determining fixture S parameters; and substituting the S parameter of the clamp into a state equation of the embedding error, and calculating to obtain the real S parameter of the material to be measured. Compared with the three states of the traditional TRL principle-based embedded error port network model, the invention provides five state models. Then, a state equation is established according to the five state models. In the analysis of the dual-port cascade network, the correlation equation of the S parameter is directly listed, the traditional S parameter and T parameter conversion method is not adopted, and the data processing is simpler and more visual.

title_en: Emergency logistics network risk propagation method and system based on material reliability
abstract_en: An emergency logistics network risk transmission method based on material reliability comprises the steps of firstly, introducing emergency material reliability factors, constructing an emergency logistics network by combining a complex network theory, and analyzing risk transmission by combining an improved infectious disease model; further analyzing an emergency logistics risk propagation mechanism and an evolution rule from the network structure and the evolution rule thereof; and finally, analyzing and discussing the utility and risk propagation influence factors of the model by a simulation technology, and providing an emergency logistics risk management and control strategy according to the result. The invention also comprises a system for implementing the emergency logistics network risk propagation method based on the material reliability. According to the method, the main factors influencing the risk propagation of the emergency logistics are analyzed in combination with the actual situation, and a strategy for controlling the risk propagation of the emergency logistics is given, so that the loss caused by the risk is reduced.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG GONGSHANG

title_en: Cable formula seabed earthquake monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cable type submarine earthquake monitoring system, which comprises: a main subsystem and a plurality of secondary expansion subsystems; the main subsystem is formed by connecting two earthquake monitoring shore base stations on the shore with a plurality of primary ocean bottom earthquake monitoring stations in series to form an energy and data gathering connection network of the ocean bottom earthquake monitoring system; the secondary expansion subsystem consists of a primary ocean bottom earthquake monitoring station and a plurality of secondary ocean bottom earthquake monitoring stations which are cascaded layer by layer; the primary ocean bottom earthquake monitoring station is used for acquiring earthquake data and carrying out digital processing on the acquired data, receiving the data transmitted by the secondary ocean bottom earthquake monitoring station connected with the primary ocean bottom earthquake monitoring station, summarizing all the data and transmitting the summarized data to an earthquake monitoring bank base station; the secondary ocean bottom earthquake monitoring station is used for acquiring earthquake data, carrying out digital processing on the acquired data, receiving the data transmitted by the secondary ocean bottom earthquake monitoring station connected with the secondary ocean bottom earthquake monitoring station, and transmitting all the data to the upper-stage ocean bottom earthquake monitoring station through the expansion submarine cable after being aggregated.

title_en: Method and detection for peripheral vehicle risk based on image analysis and communication connection between portable communication terminals and building cctv camera
title_ko: 이동통신단말 및 건물 cctv카메라 간의 통신연결 및 영상분석 기반의 주변차량 위험상황 감지 및 방법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, even if a vehicle does not have a separate device or facility, in order to enable emergency communication between vehicles, a situation is shared based on a cellular network between smartphones, emergency situations are transmitted to nearby vehicles. As vehicle owners drive vehicles while holding their smartphones in the vehicle, a situation notification service may be performed through such network communication between smartphones. In particular, by acquiring the CCTV image of the building, the dangerous situation is detected through image analysis, and is transmitted to the smartphone of the nearby vehicle, so as to perform compensation for the emergency situation awareness.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 차량에 별도의 장치나 설비를 구비하지 않더라도, 차량 간 긴급 통신이 가능하도록 하기 위해, 스마트폰 간의 셀룰러 네트워크 기반으로 상황을 공유 함으로써, 주변 차량에 위급상황을 전파하는 기술이다. 차량의 차주들은 스마트폰을 차량내에 소지하고 운전하기 때문에, 스마트폰 간의 이러한 네트워크 통신을 통해 상황 알림 서비스가 수행될 수 있다. 특히, 건축물의 CCTV의 영상을 획득하여, 영상 분석을 통해 위험상황을 감지하여, 주변 차량의 스마트폰에 전송함으로써, 위급상황 인지에 대한 보완을 수행할 수 있다.
assignees: MA IN ENG & ARCHITECTS CO LTD

title_en: Economic dispatching method considering safety constraints of N-1 and N-2 of power grid
abstract_en: The application discloses an economic dispatching method considering the safety constraints of a power grid N-1 and a power grid N-2, heavy load lines which are easy to have cascading failures are screened out by carrying out power grid N-1 power flow analysis on an economic dispatching model P0 which does not consider the safety constraints, N-2 fault pairs are formed by the heavy load lines and corresponding branches which are analyzed by the N-1 one by one to generate a new N-2 fault set, then power flow verification is carried out on the fault set based on branch breaking distribution factors to obtain harmful fault scenes, the harmful fault scenes are added to P0 to obtain a new economic dispatching model P1, P1 is updated through continuous verification and re-verification steps until the number of the harmful N-1 and N-2 fault scenes is zero to obtain a final dispatching model P2, a dispatching scheme meeting the criteria of the line N-1 and the N-2 is obtained by solving P2, the further propagation and development of the initial fault of the power grid N-1 are effectively avoided, and the problem that the power grid cascading failure power failure is caused by the fact that the secondary fault is easy to occur on a heavy-load line after the N-1 fault is not considered in the existing economic dispatching method considering the safety constraint of the power grid N-1 is solved.

title_en: Ultrasonic back scattering homodyne K model parameter estimation method based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultrasonic backscattering homodyne K model parameter estimation method based on a neural network, which is characterized in that according to parameters mu and K of a known ultrasonic backscattering homodyne K model, Monte Carlo simulation is utilized to generate ultrasonic backscattering signal samples with homodyne K models independently distributed; calculating feature parameters based on the samples; training to obtain a back propagation neural network model by using the characteristic parameters obtained by calculation and the known mu and k; for an ultrasonic backscatter signal sample to be detected, firstly, the characteristic parameters of the ultrasonic backscatter signal sample are calculated, and then the characteristic parameters are input into a back propagation neural network model obtained through training, so that the estimation results of homodyne K model parameters mu and K of the sample to be detected can be obtained. Compared with the prior art, the method has higher estimation precision and higher estimation speed.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Electric power system transient stability self-adaptive evaluation method based on transfer learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transient stability self-adaptive evaluation method of a power system based on transfer learning, which takes time series data of 27 geometric characteristics of a generator power angle track cluster after fault removal as original input characteristics; constructing a transient stability prediction model based on a convolutional neural network, wherein the transient stability prediction model consists of input features, a convolutional layer 1, a pooling layer 1, a convolutional layer 2, a pooling layer 2, a full-link layer, a classification layer and an output result; and improving a loss function of a back propagation algorithm; finally, parameters of a network structure, two convolution layers, two pooling layers and a full-connection layer of a pre-training model obtained in an operation mode and topological structure system are migrated to a new model by using a migration learning strategy, only the parameters of the classification layer are initialized randomly, and the classification layer is trained by using a training sample set in a new scene in the new operation mode and the topological structure, so that the new model can quickly track the change of the operation mode and the topological structure of the power system, and higher prediction accuracy is kept.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG;ELECTRIC POWER RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power distribution network line risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network line risk assessment method, which comprises the steps of calculating scores of screening factors by adopting a principal component method according to historical fault data of a power distribution network line fault unit through stepwise regression screening indexes, converting score values and bringing the score values into an EMLR algorithm for machine learning to obtain a risk value calculation model of the power distribution network line fault unit, then popularizing the risk value calculation model by using a BP (back propagation) neural network, and finally importing test data into the neural network calculation model to realize prediction and assessment of the risk values of the line units; through integrating and analyzing the existing power distribution network line data, the digitization and the visualization of the risk degree of the power distribution network line are realized, and the purposes of differential operation and maintenance of risk line units, targeted engineering transformation and safe production are achieved. Through the prediction of the risk, the target investigation of high-risk projects can be facilitated, the occurrence probability of power failure accidents is effectively reduced, and the power supply reliability of the power distribution network is improved.

title_en: Power grid virtual data injection attack detection method based on deep belief network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting power grid virtual data injection attack based on a deep belief network, which comprises the following steps: s1: constructing a deep confidence network detection model, wherein the deep confidence network detection model comprises the following steps: the RBM network comprises a plurality of layers of RBM networks and a single-layer BP neural network, wherein the RBM networks are connected in a full connection mode; s2: acquiring IEEE standard node measurement data, and adding random noise and an attack vector to the acquired data to generate attack data; s3: dividing the data after normalization of the attack data into a test data set and a training data set according to a set proportion; s4: the method comprises the steps that an RBM (radial basis function) network is trained layer by layer from top to bottom by unsupervised learning, model parameters are adjusted through back propagation errors of a BP (back propagation) neural network, and a trained deep belief network detection model is obtained; s5: and inputting the test data set into the trained deep confidence network detection model, and outputting a prediction result. The invention overcomes the dependence of the traditional detection method on the detection threshold value and realizes the detection of various attack modes.
assignees: UNIV GUANGDONG TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Noise reduction method for constructing secondary channel estimation by using neural network, computer readable storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a noise reduction method for constructing secondary channel estimation by utilizing a neural network, a computer readable storage medium and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a second neural network model, and taking the second neural network model as secondary channel estimation S' (z) in an adaptive feedforward type active noise reduction architecture based on the architecture. The invention changes S' (z) into the second neural network model to realize the estimation of the secondary channel more accurately, and improves the harmonic wave and intermodulation distortion phenomenon caused by nonlinear links in the propagation path from the B-bit loudspeaker to the C-bit error microphone.

title_en: Power information physical system data propagation modeling method considering three defense lines of power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data propagation modeling method of a power information physical system considering three defense lines of a power grid. The technical scheme adopted by the invention is as follows: establishing a data transmission architecture, wherein data transmission is divided into data transmission in an information space, an electric power space and between the electric power space and the information space, and nodes and communication channels exist in the spaces; aiming at a data transmission architecture, a data transmission model based on a transmission matrix is constructed, and model quantization is carried out on data transmission from an information space receiving end to a power space transmitting end; and solving the system data state vector under each time period based on the data propagation matrix and the system initial data state vector. The invention combines the information space and the security defense system of the power system by analyzing the influence of data propagation in the power information physical system, and can guide the development of three defense measures.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Complex seam network reconstruction method based on event point and crack propagation double-field coupling
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of unconventional oil and gas reservoir production increase transformation, and discloses a complex fracture network reconstruction method technology based on event point and fracture expansion double-field coupling, which comprises 3 key methods and technologies such as a fracturing event point effectiveness studying and judging method based on double-field coupling, an event point fracture reconstruction technology based on space and stress constraint, hydraulic fracture dynamic parameter explanation based on event point space distribution and the like.
assignees: CNPC CHUANQING DRILLING ENG CO;CHINA NAT PETROLEUM CORP

title_en: Cascade hydropower station optimal scheduling system and method and safety power grid system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimized dispatching system and method for a cascade hydropower station and a safety power grid system, wherein the optimized dispatching method comprises the following steps: carrying out preliminary calculation on each power station of the cascade power station group through the predicted warehousing flow condition and the planned output of each power station of the cascade power station group to obtain the state of the cascade power station group; traversing the state sequence of each power station of the cascade power station group according to the time sequence, finishing the calculation of the scheduling time period if the state of the current time period of the cascade power station group meets the set requirement, and carrying out water abandoning risk assessment according to the length of the pre-abandoning time and carrying out output adjustment on the current time period if the state of the current time period of the cascade power station group does not meet the set requirement. By the scheme provided by the invention, under the condition that each power station of the cascade meets the integral operation optimization of the cascade in the whole scheduling process, the water abandoning risk is balanced, the water abandoning is relatively reasonable, the cascade hydroelectric operation is optimized, and the cascade hydroelectric energy resource is fully utilized.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Cascade reservoir random optimization scheduling method based on deep Q learning
abstract_en: A cascade reservoir random optimization scheduling method based on deep Q learning comprises the steps of describing a reservoir warehousing diameter process: establishing a Markov decision process MDPS model; establishing a probability transition matrix: establishing a cascade reservoir random optimal scheduling model; determining a constraint function of the model: introducing a deep neural network, extracting runoff state characteristics of the cascade reservoir, and simultaneously realizing approximate expression and optimization of a target value function of a dispatching model; applying reinforcement learning to reservoir random optimization scheduling; establishing a DQN model; and solving the cascade reservoir random optimization scheduling model by adopting a deep reinforcement learning algorithm. The random optimized dispatching method for the cascade reservoir based on the deep Q learning realizes the random optimized dispatching of the cascade reservoir, so that the generator set is fully utilized in the dispatching period, the power consumption requirement and various constraint conditions are met, and the annual average power generation benefit is maximum.
assignees: UNIV CHINA THREE GORGES CTGU

title_en: Multimode oscillation on-line monitoring and early warning system based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-modal oscillation online monitoring and early warning system based on edge calculation, which comprises an acquisition layer, an edge node layer and a central layer, wherein the acquisition layer comprises an AD acquisition conversion module and a multi-modal synchronous phasor calculation module; the edge node layer extracts modal information and synchronous phasor data obtained by the acquisition layer, and extracts the characteristics of each modal oscillation by analyzing the multi-modal synchronous phasor data; the center layer analyzes the oscillation source and the propagation path by combining the power network topological structure according to the analysis result of the edge node layer, so that multi-mode oscillation early warning is realized. The system of the invention realizes a new electric power automatic dispatching system architecture, and breaks through the frame that all the original collected data are sent to the dispatching center and are managed and analyzed by the dispatching center system in a unified way. The method realizes the in-situ and real-time basic analysis, reduces the calculation load of a dispatching center, avoids the data problem caused by the transmission problem, and further improves the accuracy and the real-time performance of the analysis.

title_en: Wind power prediction error interval evaluation method based on TCN
abstract_en: The invention relates to a TCN-based wind power prediction error interval evaluation method, which comprises the steps of obtaining wind power original data, normalizing the wind power original data, and dividing the wind power original data into a training set and a testing set; initializing the weight of the TCN network, and setting parameters of iteration times, the number of residual modules, the number of network layers, expansion coefficients, the size of a convolution kernel, a learning rate and the number of hidden layer neurons; inputting the training set data into the TCN network in a batch mode, calculating the output error of the effective historical length, and reversely propagating the error to update the TCN network parameters; completing training until the TCN network precision meets the artificially given error or reaches the iteration times; test data are input and a prediction result is output, so that real-time error prediction of wind power is realized. Error prediction can be realized by depending on the flexible receptive field and learning ability of the TCN, thereby providing a basis for real-time scheduling.
assignees: XUZHOU SHANGRUO TECH CO LTD

title_en: Explosion-proof toughened glass
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an explosion-proof toughened glass, including two curb plates, through first toughened glass fixed connection between two curb plates, first toughened glass's bottom is provided with first vacuum layer, one side and the curb plate fixed connection that first vacuum layer is close to the curb plate, the bottom on first vacuum layer is provided with second toughened glass. The utility model discloses a curb plate, first toughened glass, first vacuum layer, second toughened glass, first explosion-proof layer, the explosion-proof layer of second, first flame retardant coating, second flame retardant coating and second vacuum layer mutually support, the effectual effect of explosion-proof has been realized, when meetting the conflagration, the condition that toughened glass explodes can be effectively prevented from taking place, the glass piece of effectively having avoided exploding explodeing and splitting causes the condition emergence of injury for personnel in the fire scene, good syllable-dividing effect has also been played simultaneously, can effectively completely cut off low-frequency noise's propagation, bring very big facility for the user, explosion-proof toughened glass's practicality has been improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN CITY YINGLIAN OPTICS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution low-voltage distribution area load prediction method and device based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for predicting load of a power distribution low-voltage distribution area based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting measurement data of a power distribution low-voltage transformer area; iteratively updating the weight of the neural network based on a back propagation algorithm through an Adam optimization algorithm according to the measured data of the distribution low-voltage transformer area, generating an input value of a prediction model, and training the prediction model; and after the prediction model meets the preset conditions, acquiring the current distribution low-voltage distribution area measurement data, and inputting the current distribution low-voltage distribution area measurement data into the trained prediction model to obtain a distribution low-voltage distribution area load prediction result. The method is based on an LSTM model, and a brand-new load prediction model is built by combining the information expression characteristics of a Wide module and a Deep module, so that the load prediction precision of a low-voltage distribution station area is improved.
assignees: SHENYANG POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;UNIV TSINGHUA;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Building material supply chain financial risk assessment algorithm based on complex network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building material supply chain financial risk assessment algorithm based on a complex network, which is characterized by comprising building material supply chain financial network generation, building material supply chain financial network robustness analysis and building material supply chain financial default risk propagation calculation. According to the invention, through research and analysis on the characteristics of the building material supply chain, a building material supply chain weighted network evolution model based on a growth mechanism, local selection, connection preference and reconnection quit is provided, and on the basis, a building material supply chain financial weighted network is generated according to a mapping rule, robustness analysis is carried out on the building material supply chain financial weighted network obtained by different mapping parameters, an attack strategy is provided for simulating damage which can be possibly suffered in reality, different robustness is presented on building material supply chain finance, the robustness is influenced by the difference of network structures, and a corresponding countermeasure is made to prevent the generation and propagation of the financial default risk of the building material supply chain.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG GONGSHANG

title_en: Hydropower station group power generation electric scheduling rule extraction method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of hydropower station energy optimization, and particularly discloses a hydropower station group power generation regulation extraction method, which comprises the steps of establishing a target function with the maximum annual power generation amount of a hydropower station group as a target and a constraint condition thereof, and solving to obtain an optimal solution of output flow of each time period of each reservoir; establishing a generalized regression network by taking the input flow and the reservoir water level corresponding to each time interval of each reservoir as input and the output flow as output; and optimizing a generalized regression network smoothing factor to obtain a scheduling function by adopting a particle swarm method based on the known optimal solution of the input flow, the reservoir water level and the output flow corresponding to each time interval of each reservoir and the training error minimum objective function. According to the invention, deep learning and cascade hydropower station power generation scheduling are combined, the generalized regression network corresponding to the scheduling function is established, the cascade hydropower station power generation scheduling rule based on the community gravity particle swarm and the generalized regression network is extracted, the defect that the basic traditional particle swarm algorithm is easy to fall into local optimization is overcome, and the reliability is high.
assignees: UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH

title_en: Neural network-based multi-parameter life prediction method for three-phase alternating current asynchronous motor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a neural network-based multi-parameter life prediction method for a three-phase alternating current asynchronous motor, which belongs to the field of industrial motor security inspection systems, and realizes the multi-parameter life prediction of the motor by using the state parameter and the protection event parameter recording information of a microcomputer relay protector and combining a deep learning network, wherein the prediction step comprises the following steps: establishing a neural network training set, a half life training subset and a loss training subset, sending the training set into a neural network for training, correcting network parameters by using an error back propagation algorithm, obtaining parameterized description of the network on the service life of the motor, establishing a motor loss test set, inputting the established neural network and predicting; the complex modeling process is avoided, the accuracy of prediction is improved, the potential safety hazard of abnormal shutdown of the factory process is avoided, and the economic loss and the casualty risk caused by safety accidents are reduced.

title_en: Step hydropower station generating capacity prediction method based on long-term and short-term memory network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a step hydropower station generating capacity prediction method based on a long-short term memory network, which comprises the steps of carrying out stability test on a hydropower station generating capacity time sequence; carrying out correlation test on the generated energy time series; converting the generated energy time series data into supervised learning data; establishing a generating capacity prediction model based on a long-term and short-term memory network; performing integrated empirical mode decomposition on the generated energy data to obtain a training set and a test set; training the generated energy prediction model by using a training set, and performing model hyper-parameter optimization by using an improved discrete differential evolution algorithm to obtain optimal model parameters; and adopting a power generation amount prediction model to predict the power generation amount of the cascade hydropower station. The method can be suitable for predicting the generated energy of large and medium-sized step power stations; the generated energy prediction model based on the LSTM neural network has more advantages on the generation energy prediction of the multi-year regulation power station, and the fitting precision of the model is improved by the super-parameter optimization of the model.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CORP

title_en: High-voltage cascade energy storage device
