abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-voltage cascade energy storage device which comprises a high-voltage switch station cabinet, an incoming line cabinet, a starting cabinet, a reactance cabinet, an energy storage container, an EMS monitoring cabinet and a PCS main control cabinet, wherein an energy storage system, a PSC cabinet, a fire-fighting cabinet and a ventilation system for ventilating and radiating the container are arranged in the energy storage container, the energy storage container is connected with the EMS monitoring cabinet and the PSC main control cabinet after passing through the respective PCS cabinet, a plurality of energy storage containers are connected with the power storage container through the starting cabinet and the incoming line cabinet switch station cabinet at 10KV bus side after passing through the reactance cabinet, and a fireproof isolation wall is arranged among the energy storage containers. The energy storage container disclosed by the invention is designed with various ventilation structures, the problem of uneven heat dissipation of the battery pack in the container is solved, a certain number of energy storage units are connected in series at the alternating current side, and a 10kV power grid is directly connected without a transformer, so that the dispatching performance of a large-scale energy storage power station is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD JIAXING POWER SUPPLY CO;JIAXING HENGCHUANG ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Network cascade processing system and method for repairing size based on key box
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large and small repair network cascade processing system and a method thereof, wherein the system comprises: the system comprises a large and small repairing network cascade module, a large and small repairing network cascade module and a large and small repairing network cascade module, wherein the large and small repairing network cascade module comprises an operation safety analysis template, a work ticket template and an isolation certificate template; the major and minor repair network cascade device is used for mapping the entity key boxes into virtual key boxes one by one, dividing the virtual key boxes into different areas according to the repair specialties, reading the isolation certificate templates and the work ticket templates in the virtual key boxes, connecting the key boxes through cascade lines, reflecting the real cascade cross relationship, and generating all work tickets in the repair period at one time according to the generated work ticket templates, the isolation certificate templates, the operation safety analysis templates and the cascade cross relationship when major and minor repair begins. The network cascade processing system and the network cascade processing method for the overhaul reduce the burden of the overhaul personnel during the overhaul period, so that the overhaul personnel can put into the overhaul work in full body, the work efficiency is improved, and the billing time is saved.
assignees: ZHUHAI TOHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Medium-and-long-term load prediction method and device for power market
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a method and a device for predicting medium and long-term loads of an electric power market, wherein the method comprises the following steps: processing missing values and abnormal values of the historical daily load data and the corresponding index data, counting according to a preset time period to obtain load data and index time of the preset time period, and performing normalization processing; setting the number of hidden layer nodes of a feedback neural network model, the weight and the threshold of each connection, inputting the data after normalization processing into the feedback neural network model for calculation to obtain a predicted value, calculating the variance of the predicted value and the real-time power load, obtaining an adjusting formula of the weight and the threshold through a back propagation operation method according to the variance and the power cost, adjusting the weight and the threshold through the adjusting formula to calculate the predicted value, and repeating training until the predicted value and the variance of the actual charge accord with the preset variance or the iteration times to obtain the target feedback neural network model. The problem that the balance between the power cost and the prediction precision is not considered in the conventional power prediction method is solved.

title_en: Method for simulating continuous burst flood of cascade reservoir group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for simulating continuous burst flood of a cascade reservoir group, which comprises the steps of extracting river network information, carrying out evolution calculation on flood in a river channel by adopting a holy-Venn equation and a Massa-Kyoto equation, carrying out flood detention and flood traveling outside the river channel along the topographic direction, carrying out flood regulation calculation on a reservoir, taking the whole process of dam break outflow as inflow flood of a downstream river section of a dam, and returning to the step S2. According to the method, the dam break process, the flood routing and the reservoir regulation and storage are comprehensively considered, the Saint-Venn equation and the Mas Kyoto equation are adopted to carry out the routing calculation on the flood in the river channel, and a generalized dam break process line method is adopted, so that the simulation calculation aiming at the continuous dam break of the step reservoir group is realized, the measurement cost is reduced, and the calculation efficiency is improved.

title_en: Power grid service risk assessment method, device and equipment based on meteorological disasters
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a power grid service risk assessment method, a device and equipment based on meteorological disasters. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring operation statistical data of a power grid system; acquiring the occurrence probability of the set fault type in each subnet and the service interruption time length caused by the set fault type according to the operation statistical data; constructing an interruption time matrix between the set fault category and the service interruption time, and calculating a service loss vector according to the interruption time matrix and the service importance vector; calculating a first risk value according to the occurrence probability of the set fault category in each subnet and the service loss vector; adjusting the first risk value according to a network scale coefficient to obtain a second risk value; and respectively sequencing the first risk value and the second risk value of each subnet to obtain a risk evaluation result. The accuracy of power grid service risk assessment can be improved, and the assessment result has stronger objectivity and practicability.
assignees: BIG DATA CENTER STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA

title_en: Rural power grid transformation method based on cascade combination scoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rural power grid transformation method based on cascade combination scoring, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps of combing the main problems existing in the current situation of the rural power grid, respectively defining corresponding single evaluation indexes, constructing a calculation formula matched with each evaluation index according to the actual operation rule and the internal development change rule of the rural power grid, carrying out grading treatment on the severity of each problem, setting the cascade evaluation standard of each evaluation index, and constructing an evaluation index system capable of fully reflecting the weak link and the severity of the rural power grid; determining equipment with modification requirements according to the index values, taking the equipment as an evaluation object, scoring the evaluation object according to the scoring standard of the evaluation indexes, determining the weight among all the evaluation indexes by adopting a CRITIC method, calculating the comprehensive score of the evaluation object, and finishing the graded combination score of the evaluation object; and performing descending order according to the size of the comprehensive scores, and preferentially modifying the equipment with the front ranking of the scores so as to realize the modification of the rural power grid.

title_en: Prediction method for cascading failure sequence of power transmission network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a prediction method of a power transmission network cascading failure sequence, which comprises the following steps of firstly, randomly selecting a line of a non-generator outgoing line and a transformer line in a power transmission network as an initial failure line in the cascading failure sequence, wherein the number of failure stages is set to be 1; secondly, counting the number of the overload lines; thirdly, judging a fault line of the next stage, and adding 1 to the number of fault stages; and fourthly, disconnecting all the determined fault lines, judging the running state of the generator, stopping prediction if the power transmission network is disconnected and the generator is in an unsafe running state, outputting the cascading failure sequence, or stopping prediction if the failure series number of the cascading failure sequence reaches the predictable maximum sequence number of 5, and outputting the cascading failure sequence, or else, discharging all the determined fault lines, repeating the steps from the second step until the prediction is stopped, and outputting the cascading failure sequence. The invention relates to a prediction method of a cascading failure sequence of a power transmission network, which can predict all possible cascading failure sequences of the power transmission network in advance.
assignees: UNIV XIAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Matching short-term load prediction method based on intelligent sensing technology of Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution short-term load prediction method based on an intelligent sensing technology of the Internet of things, wherein the data source of the method is electricity consumption data collected by intelligent electric meters of all users under the same distribution in a certain geographic area. Firstly, data cleaning and completion are completed through a correlation coefficient, a per unit curve of electricity consumption data is obtained through per unit processing, then the per unit curves of similar days are obtained through combination after clustering through an affine propagation algorithm, finally, the per unit curves of the future days to be tested are obtained through weighted summation, and a complete daily load curve to be tested is obtained after combination with a basic value, so that the whole configuration short-term load prediction work is completed. The method is applied to the similar data of other distribution transformers for calculation and analysis, can make up for the current situation of lean operation and maintenance of the low-voltage distribution network, provides support for a reactive power compensation strategy control scheme of the low-voltage distribution network, provides basis for updating of low-voltage equipment and reconstruction of a low-voltage distribution system, and has low cost of required materials and manpower, high accuracy and good operability.

title_en: Comprehensive energy system dispatching management platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive energy system dispatching management platform. The disclosed platform includes: the system comprises a demand configuration module, a data acquisition module, an operation calculation module and a scheduling management module, wherein the demand configuration module is used for a user to select an energy supply side system configuration mode, energy equipment and an optimization target according to demands; the data acquisition module is used for acquiring system operation data time by time within a certain total time length; the scheduling management module is used for receiving the operation data acquired by the data acquisition module and sending the operation data to the model calculation module; meanwhile, the system is used for receiving result data of the operation calculation module and outputting the result data to the corresponding upper-layer energy network and energy equipment to adjust the operation condition; and the operation calculation module is used for calculating the result of the optimization target selected by the demand configuration module on the premise of constraint conditions. The invention can realize the cascade utilization of energy in the comprehensive energy system, improve the energy utilization rate and is suitable for supplying energy to areas such as commercial areas, residential areas, industrial parks, villages and the like.
assignees: POWERCHINA NORTHWEST ENG CORP LTD

title_en: Intelligent energy system fusion station based on ubiquitous power Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent power grids, in particular to a smart energy system fusion station based on ubiquitous power Internet of things, which comprises an energy station, an energy storage station, a data center, a charging station and a switching station, wherein the data center comprises a cold channel type machine room, computer equipment, communication equipment, a machine room fire-fighting system and a UPS (uninterrupted power supply), the computer equipment and the communication equipment are both arranged in the cold channel type machine room and are powered by the UPS, the UPS is connected with commercial power, the computer equipment is connected with the communication equipment, the machine room fire-fighting system is arranged in the cold channel type machine room, the fire-fighting state of the computer equipment is monitored, and fire is extinguished when a fire occurs, the energy station comprises a gas generator set and a lithium bromide water chilling unit, the energy storage station comprises a high-voltage cascade energy storage device, and the charging station comprises an intelligent power supply and a plurality of charging piles: all stations are coordinated and matched, so that the construction cost is saved, and the economic benefit is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD JIAXING POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Power data fingerprint evaluation method based on Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention provides a power data fingerprint evaluation method based on a Bayesian network, which comprises the following three parts: establishing a power data fingerprint evaluation index system, and establishing a Bayesian network evaluation model and Bayesian network reasoning. Analyzing a specific flow of the power data fingerprint, screening evaluation indexes from all indexes by using an entropy weight method, and constructing a power data fingerprint evaluation index system; the dependency relationship of each index node is distinguished, a Bayesian network structure is given, and the reasonable Bayesian network structure is beneficial to accurate inference evaluation; the security of the power data is high, and in order to solve the problem that only small sample data exist, according to the characteristics of the power data, the Beta distribution is equivalently approximate to the normal distribution, and then the maximum posterior probability method of Bayesian estimation is used for calculating the estimated value of the parameter, so that the Bayesian network parameter learning is completed; and the accurate reasoning of the Bayesian network is carried out by utilizing the clique tree propagation algorithm, so that the reasoning time is saved, and the reasoning accuracy is improved.
assignees: UNIV NANJING POSTS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS

title_en: Dam deformation prediction system and method based on convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for predicting dam deformation based on a convolutional neural network. The convolutional neural network for dam deformation prediction fully uses the parallel computing capability of the network, two-dimensional data is input into a plurality of paths in parallel, and a plurality of convolutional layers and pooling layers are alternately cascaded in each path, so that different convolutional kernel sizes can be set for obtaining more characteristics; while the invention contemplates that the features extracted by these paths are not necessarily complementary, the system uses addition operations in combining the output results of these paths. The method improves the automation level of dam deformation prediction, and simultaneously improves the efficiency and speed of deformation prediction.

title_en: Contagion risk detection, analysis and protection
abstract_en: A method, system, and computer-usable medium for protecting against contagion-based risk events are disclosed for monitoring behavior of users to construct a contagion network relationship map of connection and influence relationships between different users and then analyzing a received stream of events from the users to identify a critical event performed by a first user having a first risk score so that one or more propagated risk scores can be generated from the first risk score for at least a first connected user based on connection and influence relationships between the first user and the first connected user that are extracted from the contagion network relationship so that an adaptive response may be automatically generated to protect and control against actions by at least the first connected user based on the one or more propagated risk scores.
assignees: FORCEPOINT LLC

title_en: Comprehensive judgment method for breakout prediction of slab caster
abstract_en: A comprehensive judgment method for breakout prediction of a slab caster belongs to the technical field of continuous casting production monitoring methods. The technical scheme is as follows: establishing a cyclic neural network model for each thermocouple on the crystallizer copper plate to judge whether the temperature curve of the thermocouple has the characteristic of adhesive breakout; establishing a logic judgment model according to a propagation rule of a casting blank bonding point on a space to judge whether a thermocouple of a temperature curve with bonding breakout characteristics has bonding breakout space propagation characteristics; all thermocouples with bonding breakout space propagation characteristics are alarm thermocouples, different weights are given to different alarm thermocouples according to the different positions of the alarm thermocouples, and a system gives a final bonding breakout alarm signal when the sum of the weights of the alarm thermocouples is greater than a specified threshold value. The invention utilizes the respective characteristics and advantages of the artificial intelligence model and the logic judgment model, and the miss-report rate and the false-report rate of the comprehensive model algorithm are obviously reduced compared with the single model, and are obviously superior to the traditional model algorithm.

title_en: Modeling simulation method of language competition microscopic simulation model based on partitioned double-layer network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a modeling simulation method of a language competition microscopic simulation model based on a partitioned double-layer network, which improves a modeling method based on an agent social circle network, constructs a social network with a remote weak connection relation, and can describe the reinforcing trend of the weak relation of the social network caused by regional population flow and communication connection under the urbanization background. Besides considering the influence of the language position and the language population proportion, the language evolution mechanism of different crowds introduces a new mechanism of influence of bilingual on the conversion from monolingual to bilingual and influence of language attitude on language selection behavior. An improved agent language horizontal and vertical propagation model is provided, and the propagation model comprehensively considers factors such as language status, language density, language attitude, influence of bilingual on monolingual, remote connection weight and the like.

title_en: Deep reinforcement learning-based economic scheduling method for cogeneration system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined heat and power system economic dispatching method based on deep reinforcement learning, which comprises S1, aiming at a combined heat and power system operation model, describing the operation model by using a Markov chain model, strictly converting an objective function and a constraint target in an optimization method respectively, and giving a proof; s2, improving the DPPO algorithm in the deep reinforcement learning to train the intelligent agent under various operation states, firstly, before each training round begins, the operation environment will randomly generate operation data in a reasonable operation range; the intelligent agent in the turn generates a control strategy according to the current internal neural network parameters, and interacts with the operating environment; and after the round is finished, the accumulated reward in the maximized round is used as the target for back propagation, and the network parameters of the intelligent agent are optimized, so that the intelligent agent learns the economic dispatching strategy for different operation states of the cogeneration system. The invention greatly improves the convenience of use. And has better convergence performance.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Neural network algorithm-based material deformation and failure prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for predicting material deformation and failure based on a neural network algorithm, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step 1: acquiring experimental data of the mechanical property of the material, and dividing the experimental data into a training set and a testing set; step 2: establishing a multilayer feedforward neural network; and step 3: training the multilayer feedforward neural network by using a training set according to an error inverse propagation algorithm; and 4, step 4: testing the multi-layer feedforward neural network after training by using a test set; and 5: and predicting the deformation and failure behaviors of the material and guiding the manufacturing process. The invention establishes a brand new experiment-neural network-simulation-manufacturing research route, greatly reduces the calculation cost and improves the research and development efficiency.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: Key line identification method and device for cascading failure of power system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for identifying a key line of cascading failures of a power system, belonging to the field of cascading failure risk analysis and stability research of the power system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: performing cascading failure direct current power flow simulation on the power system to acquire failure chain data required by identification; decomposing the fault chain data into states at different moments to form a state network; based on a state network, solving a line risk value of a line fault in the state of the cascading faults at different moments by using an SARSA algorithm; and determining the line corresponding to the line risk value exceeding the given threshold value as the critical line of the cascading failure. The method can realize high-risk fault line identification based on cascading fault data, and carry out risk mitigation, prevention and control on cascading faults at different moments so as to guarantee safe and stable operation of the power system.

title_en: Seismic oscillation peak acceleration prediction method based on second-order neuron deep neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seismic oscillation peak acceleration prediction method based on a second-order neuron deep neural network, belongs to the field of seismic engineering, and aims to solve the technical problem of low accuracy of seismic oscillation prediction. The earthquake motion peak acceleration prediction method comprises the following steps: selecting a seismic magnitude, a projection distance, a shear wave velocity, an area, a covering layer thickness, a fault type and a period as input parameters in a data set, wherein the corresponding seismic oscillation peak acceleration is a target parameter; establishing a deep neural network comprising three hidden layers, wherein neurons are second-order elements, a hyperbolic tangent function is adopted as an activation function, a mean square error function and an Adam self-adaptive optimization function are adopted for back propagation, and an average absolute error function is taken as an evaluation function; thirdly, training a deep neural network model; and fourthly, predicting the peak acceleration. The invention adopts a multi-input structure and a second-order neural network, which can not only improve the precision of predicting the earthquake motion peak acceleration, but also ensure the applicability of a deep neural network model.
assignees: HARBIN INST TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Water resource risk assessment method aiming at multiple risk sources of cascade reservoir group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water resource risk assessment method aiming at multiple risk sources of a cascade reservoir group, which comprises the following steps: identifying the structural characteristics of a cascade reservoir group system of the water transfer project; identifying risk sources corresponding to the reservoirs of all units in the water diversion project respectively; constructing a nested Bayesian network risk assessment model of the water diversion project step reservoir group according to the structural characteristics and the risk source, and obtaining the risk level of the water diversion project water resource through model analysis; carrying out sensitivity analysis through a nested Bayesian network risk assessment model, finding out key factors of risks, and making remedial measures; the method comprises the steps of utilizing a model to analyze the overall risk level of the stepped reservoir group of the water diversion project after renovation, stopping analysis if the overall risk level reaches an acceptable risk level, and searching a new risk key factor for further analysis if the overall risk level does not reach an expected risk level until the acceptable risk level.
assignees: UNIV YANGZHOU

title_en: Ceiling earthquake damage identification method based on convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ceiling earthquake damage identification method based on a convolutional neural network, belongs to the field of computer vision, and aims to solve the problem that the efficiency of field earthquake damage degree investigation of professionals is low. The identification method comprises the following steps: firstly, normalizing the ceiling seismic damage picture; secondly, rotating and mirroring the target sample; loading a pre-trained AlexNet model, modifying the last full-connection layer of the model, and performing back propagation by adopting a cross entropy loss function and an Adam self-adaptive optimization function to obtain a primary training AlexNet model; fourthly, continuing to train the model, and adjusting the learning rate, the blocksize and the like of the neural network; and fifthly, evaluating the test sample by using the trained AlexNet model. The invention can accurately and quickly evaluate the use function of the earthquake-caused building in time only by using a certain hardware module and combining with the trained model, and the model has high accuracy.
assignees: HARBIN INST TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Interface protocol between alarm terminal and alarm system for building
title_ko: 건물용 경보단말과 통제시스템간 인터페이스 프로토콜
abstract_en: Provided are a communication method using an interface protocol between an alarm terminal for a building and a building alarm terminal control system and a system thereof. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the communication method comprises the following steps of: allowing an alarm terminal of a predetermined building to use an alarm terminal connection primitive to be connected to the building alarm terminal control system; when the building alarm terminal control system is connected, allowing the alarm terminal of a building to use an alarm terminal registration primitive to perform a registration procedure; and when an alarm is issued, allowing the building alarm terminal control system to use an alarm data transmission primitive to transfer alarm data to the registered building alarm terminal. Accordingly, when a disaster occurs, a disaster alarm is automatically propagated to a plurality of unspecified persons inside a multiuse facility, thereby promoting emergency evacuation of the plurality of unspecified persons who exist in a room inside the multiuse facility. Moreover, an alarm system based on a common alarm protocol, which is a domestic/overseas standard, is provided to alarm propagation in the multiuse facility, thereby contributing to establishment of a standard-based multiuse facility alarm propagation system.
abstract_ko: 건물용 경보단말과 건물용 경보단말 통제시스템 간 인터페이스 프로토콜을 이용한 통신 방법 및 시스템이 제공된다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른, 건물용 경보단말과 건물용 경보단말 통제시스템 간 인터페이스 프로토콜을 이용한 통신 방법은 특정 건물용 경보단말이, 경보단말 연결 프리미티브를 이용하여 건물용 경보단말 통제시스템과 연결하는 단계; 상기 건물용 경보단말이, 상기 건물용 경보단말 통제시스템에 연결되면, 경보단말 등록 프리미티브를 이용하여 등록 절차를 수행하는 단계; 및 상기 건물용 경보단말 통제시스템이, 경보가 발령되면, 경보 데이터 전송 프리미티브를 이용하여 경보 데이터를 상기 등록된 건물용 경보단말에 전달하는 단계;를 포함한다. 이에 의해, 재난 발생 시, 다중이용시설 내의 불특정 다수의 사람에게 자동으로 재난 경보를 전파하여, 다중이용시설 내에 재실 중인 불특정 다수의 사람들의 긴급 대피를 도모할 수 있으며, 다중이용시설 내의 경보 전파를 위해 국내외 표준인 공통경보프로토콜 기반의 경보 시스템을 제공함으로써, 표준기반의 다중이용시설 경보 전파 체계 수립에 기여할 수 있다.
assignees: THE REPUBLIC OF KOREA MINI INTERIOR

title_en: Alarm terminal for facility and alarm interface
title_ko: 건물용 경보단말 경보 인터페이스
abstract_en: Provided are a method using an alarm terminal and an alarm interface for a building and an apparatus thereof. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the method using the alarm terminal and the alarm interface for a building includes: a step in which an alarm terminal control system for a building issues an alarm; a step in which an alarm terminal for a building prepared in a specific multipurpose facility receives alarm data from the alarm terminal control system; and a step in which the alarm terminal for a building outputs the received alarm data through at least one information display system built in the multipurpose facility. Therefore, in case of a disaster, an alarm can be issued in various forms such as a text, a sound, an icon, a picture and the like through various alarm display devices in a multipurpose facility. Thus, unspecified individuals staying in the multipurpose facility can be urged to evacuate the place urgently. Moreover, since an alarm system based on a common alarm protocol which is a domestic and overseas standard is provided for alarm propagation in the multipurpose facility, the present invention can contribute to the establishment of a standard-based multipurpose facility alarm propagation system.
abstract_ko: 건물용 경보단말 및 경보 인터페이스를 이용한 방법 및 장치가 제공된다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른, 건물용 경보단말 및 경보 인터페이스 방법은 건물용 경보단말 통제시스템이, 경보를 발령하는 단계; 특정 다중이용시설에 마련된 건물용 경보단말이, 상기 건물용 경보단말 통제시스템으로부터 경보 데이터를 수신하는 단계; 및 상기 건물용 경보단말이, 상기 수신된 경보 데이터가 상기 다중이용시설 내에 구축된 하나 이상의 정보 표출 시스템을 통해 출력되도록 하는 단계;를 포함한다. 이에 의해, 재난 발생 시, 다중이용시설 내의 다양한 경보 표출장치를 이용하여 텍스트, 소리, 아이콘, 그림 등 다양한 형태로 경보를 알릴 수 있어, 다중이용시설 내에 재실 중인 불특정 다수의 사람들의 긴급 대피를 도모할 수 있으며, 다중이용시설 내의 경보 전파를 위해 국내외 표준인 공통경보프로토콜 기반의 경보 시스템을 제공함으로써, 표준기반의 다중이용시설 경보 전파 체계 수립에 기여할 수 있다.
assignees: THE REPUBLIC OF KOREA MINI INTERIOR

title_en: Smart pole linkage system that can provide intelligent city information
title_ko: 지능형 도시정보 제공이 가능한 스마트 폴 연계 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart pole linkage system capable of providing intelligent city information. An integrated control center receives various types of city information via a communication network from a local government information providing server. The city information includes municipal public relations, public advertisements, event promotion, local government promotion, emergency disaster situation information, traffic information, tourist information, living information, weather information, and location information related to a city. The city information is output and provided in real time through a kiosk. As a result, a user can check desired city information in real time. The present invention includes a local government information providing server (100), an integrated control center (200), a management server (300), and a kiosk (400) as main components so that crimes can be prevented by real-time monitoring of the zone where the kiosk is provided and the integrated control center quickly disseminates the occurrence of an emergency disaster situation through the kiosk in a case where the emergency disaster situation has occurred in the zone.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지능형 도시정보 제공이 가능한 스마트 폴 연계 시스템에 관련되며, 보다 상세하게는 통합관제센터로 지자체 정보제공 서버로부터 통신망을 통하여 해당 도시와 관련된 시정홍보, 공익광고, 행사홍보, 지자체 홍보, 긴급 재난상황 정보, 교통정보, 관광정보, 생활정보, 날씨정보, 위치정보를 포함하는 각종 도시정보를 수신하고, 상기 도시정보를 키오스크를 통해 실시간으로 출력하여 제공함으로써, 사용자가 원하는 도시정보를 실시간으로 확인할 수 있으며, 해당 지역의 긴급 재난상황이 발생할 경우 통합관제센터에서 이를 신속하게 키오스크를 통해 전파하고, 키오스크가 구비된 지역을 실시간 모니터링하여 범죄예방을 도모하기 위해 지자체 정보제공 서버(100), 통합관제센터(200), 관리서버(300) 및 키오스크(400)을 주요구성으로 이루어진다.
assignees: KOREA LAND & HOUSING CORP

title_en: Process to reduce the probability of large cascading failures in a transmission network
abstract_en: Described is a system for decreasing the frequency of large cascading failures in a transmission network. Based on sensors distributed throughout the transmission network, the system determines if a cascading failure is present in a transmission network. Following determination of the cascading failure, the system activates at least one switch of a plurality of switches distributed in the transmission network in order to switch transmission lines, thereby altering connectivity in the transmission network.
assignees: HRL LAB LLC

title_en: Integrated management system for industrial gas supply facility
title_ko: 산업용 가스공급 설비 통합 관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated management system for an industrial gas supply facility including: an information collection unit including gas detection modules detecting gas leakage, fire detection modules detecting a fire, an earthquake detection module detecting an earthquake, and video recording modules imaging a monitoring target region, installed in the monitoring target region, collecting event information related to the occurrence of gas leakage, a fire, and an earthquake, and transmitting the collected event information through a communication network; a management server unit evaluating the occurrence or non-occurrence of gas leakage, a fire, and an earthquake by receiving the event information transmitted through the communication network from the information collection unit and generating and transmitting notification information including the event information and an event response method in a case where it is evaluated that gas leakage, a fire, or an earthquake has occurred; and an individual terminal unit receiving the notification information generated by the management server unit. According to the present invention, the system is capable of quickly detecting and distinguishing various types of gases leaking out of the monitoring target region and capable of determining whether a fire and an earthquake have occurred. As a result, industrial gas supply facilities can be safely managed. In addition, the event including gas leakage, a fire, and an earthquake can be quickly disseminated through the communication network and damage to people and properties can be minimized.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은, 가스 누출을 감지하는 복수 개의 가스 감지 모듈, 화재를 감지하는 복수 개의 화재 감지 모듈, 지진을 감지하는 지진 감지 모듈, 감시 대상 영역을 촬영하는 복수 개의 영상 촬영 모듈을 포함하고, 감시 대상 영역에 설치되어 가스 누출, 화재 및 지진 발생에 관련한 이벤트 정보를 수집하고, 수집한 이벤트 정보를 통신망을 통해 전송하는 정보 수집부; 통신망을 통해 상기 정보 수집부에서 전송한 이벤트 정보를 수신하여 가스 누출, 화재 및 지진 발생 여부를 평가하고, 가스 누출, 화재 또는 지진이 발생한 것으로 평가한 경우 이벤트 정보 및 이벤트 대응 방법을 포함하는 알림 정보를 생성하여 전송하는 관리 서버부; 및 관리 서버부에서 생성한 알림 정보를 수신받는 개별 단말부;를 포함하는 산업용 가스공급 설비 통합 관리 시스템을 제공한다. 
본 발명에 따른 산업용 가스공급 설비 통합 관리 시스템은 감시 대상 영역에서 누출되는 다양한 종류의 가스를 단시간에 검출 및 판별할 수 있고, 화재 및 지진 발생 여부를 판별할 수 있어 산업용 가스공급 시설을 안전하게 관리할 수 있고, 가스 누출, 화재, 지진을 포함하는 이벤트를 통신망을 통해 신속히 전파하도록 하여 인명 및 재산 피해를 최소화할 수 있다.
assignees: YOO JAE KYUNG

title_en: Load prediction method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a load prediction method and a device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving first initial load predicted values currently output by at least two single prediction models; inputting each first initial load predicted value into a pre-trained Back Propagation Neural Network (BPNN) model; and determining a target load predicted value based on the BPNN model. In the embodiment of the invention, when the load prediction is carried out, the first initial load predicted value is determined based on the single prediction model, then each first initial load predicted value is input into the pre-trained BPNN model, and the target load predicted value is determined based on the BPNN model and combined with each first initial load predicted value, so that the problem that the single model is prone to falling into local optimization under the conditions of poor convergence, large fluctuation and influence of emergencies on data sets is avoided, and the determined target load predicted value is more accurate.
assignees: YANGZHONG INTELLIGENT ELECTRICAL RESEARCH CENTER OF NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV

title_en: Method for predicting charging behavior of electric vehicle user based on BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for predicting charging behavior of an electric vehicle user based on a BP neural network, which comprises the following steps: step 1, data preprocessing. Step 2, determining training data, verification data and test data of the neural network; step 3, establishing a neural network architecture; step 4, selecting an activation function delta (z) and a loss function A cost function J (w, b); step 5, calculating a loss function by forward propagation from the input layer to the hidden layer And a cost function J (w, b); step 6, judging whether the calculated loss function meets the pair errorIf the requirement is met, jumping to step 7, if the requirement is not met, correcting the bias matrix b of the weight matrix omega by adopting a gradient descent method, and jumping to step 5 to recalculate by using the newly calculated weight matrix omega; and 7, using the trained weight matrix omega bias matrix b for testing data, and comparing and evaluating the obtained neural network prediction result with a real result. The invention provides a considerable and reliable basis for the charging behavior prediction.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Method, system and equipment for calculating and predicting daily operation efficiency of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and equipment for calculating and predicting daily operating efficiency of a power distribution network, which comprise the following steps: calculating the real-time operation efficiency of the power distribution equipment; calculating the daily operation efficiency of the power distribution system based on the real-time operation efficiency of the power distribution equipment; analyzing the influence factors of the daily operation efficiency of the power distribution system; screening main influence factors from the influence factors by utilizing grey correlation analysis; and predicting the daily operating efficiency of the power distribution system by using a back propagation algorithm according to the main influence factors. The method and the device predict the operation efficiency through grey correlation analysis and a Back Propagation (BP) algorithm, thereby considering the influence of the influence factors on the operation efficiency, and select the main influence factors through the grey correlation, thereby dynamically considering the influence of the influence factors on the operation efficiency, solving the defect that the analysis of the operation efficiency and the influence factors in the prior art only stays at a qualitative level, and promoting the reasonable development of the power distribution network.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Power information physical system modeling method and system considering multilayer coupling
abstract_en: The modeling process is divided into three parts, namely a power network, a communication network and an information network, based on the idea of information physical fusion, and an uplink/downlink communication channel model responsible for information transmission is established for the monitoring and control functions of the power dispatching automation system and serves as a core component of the communication network. The power grid, the communication network and the information network are associated through establishing an inter-network interface model, a power information physical system integration model considering multilayer coupling is further obtained through derivation, a multilayer coupling association mechanism of the power CPS is determined, and therefore the power information physical system integration model considering multilayer coupling is established. The method has important significance for exploring researches in aspects of cyber attack risk propagation mechanism, cascading failure evolution process, security analysis, vulnerability assessment and the like of the CPS.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG

title_en: Vehicle network system harmonic time-frequency analysis method based on synchronous compression wavelet transform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle network system harmonic time-frequency analysis method based on synchronous compression wavelet transformation, which comprises the steps of observing network side current and voltage signals by setting different switching frequencies and traction network equivalent parameters under the cascade operation of an equivalent traction network and a CRH5 type vehicle rectifier under the condition of considering time delay generated by a digital control circuit, and analyzing the signals by utilizing the synchronous compression wavelet transformation; the analysis result of the method has good time-frequency resolution, and the amplitude and the frequency of harmonic amplification can be effectively identified when the system has harmonic instability; the invention is convenient to implement and has higher adaptability.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG

title_en: Harmonic stability analysis method for high-speed railway vehicle network system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a harmonic stability analysis method for a high-speed railway vehicle network system, which comprises the steps of firstly establishing a mathematical model of a dual-port network of a long-distance high-speed railway traction network; establishing an admittance model under a complex frequency domain of the motor train unit converter based on a harmonic linearization theory; and finally, solving the closed loop stability of the train network system based on the impedance analysis theory of the cascade system, and analyzing the network side parameters of the train network system and the parameter stability of the motor train unit control system according to the generalized Nyquist stability criterion. The invention applies the impedance model based on the harmonic linearization theory, and can also apply the linear control theory even on the premise of a nonlinear car network system, so that the system model is clear and concise; harmonic characteristics of the high-speed railway vehicle network system are obtained based on a harmonic linearization theory, and therefore harmonic stability analysis is conducted on the system.

title_en: Power system load power protection control method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a load power protection control method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for a power system. The power system load power protection control method comprises the following steps: establishing an element model of the power system; determining risk indexes of various fault states in the power system according to the element models and the operation reliability indexes; and determining a load power protection control strategy of the power system by combining the operation reliability index, the risk index and the risk degree of the cascading failure. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention relieves the technical problems that the technical support means cannot meet the service requirement and the adaptability of the solution scheme is not strong and the like caused by the fact that most power distribution network scheduling depends on experience scheduling or blind scheduling in the prior art, improves the reliability and lowers the economic cost brought by comprehensively considering various factors, is beneficial to establishing an optimal control decision scheme and forms a whole set of real-time monitoring, evaluation, early warning and control system.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD CHAOZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Cascading failure evolution path online identification method considering alternating current and direct current influences
abstract_en: The invention discloses an online identification method of a cascading failure evolution path considering the influence of alternating current and direct current, which aims at a manually set cascading failure initial failure set or a cascading failure initial failure set formed by equipment failure probability, utilizes transient time domain simulation to simulate direct current commutation failure caused by initial alternating current failure under the influence of alternating current and direct current interaction, safety control action caused by direct current continuous commutation failure locking, new energy cascading network disconnection and two-three line-defense action of a power grid, determines lower-stage evolution failure according to equipment overload and voltage out-of-limit and dynamically searches a safety control current value control strategy, and simulates equipment successive disconnection through multi-evolution branch static safety analysis, so that the complex cascading failure evolution path under the influence of alternating current and direct current interaction is accurately identified, and the problem of accurate prejudgment of the cascading failure evolution path of an ultra-high voltage power grid under the online mode is solved. The method can provide a support means for the scheduling personnel to comprehensively master the cascading failure evolution path and the accident risk, and has good application value.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD;NARI GROUP CORP

title_en: Method for identifying abnormal data of power system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for identifying abnormal data of an electric power system, which comprises the steps of taking normal data of the electric power system as a training sample, and training a neural network; inputting data to be detected into the trained neural network to obtain a residual sequence; clustering residual training based on an affine propagation clustering algorithm; and judging abnormal data according to the characteristics of each category and the intra-category distance. The invention utilizes the chaotic particle swarm algorithm to train the neural network, and simultaneously adopts the affine propagation clustering algorithm to realize data clustering, thereby obviously reducing the calculated amount, simultaneously not depending on sampling distribution, and effectively improving the accuracy of identifying abnormal data of the power system.
assignees: INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION BRANCH STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;SHENYANG INST AUTOMATION CAS

title_en: Method and system for determining optimal energy distribution strategy of traffic network layer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for determining an optimal energy distribution strategy of a traffic network layer, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining basic parameters of a high-ratio electric automobile traffic power basic coupling complex network graph model; establishing a coupling complex network visual topological graph model; constructing and updating an adjacency matrix of an undirected graph, an adjacency matrix of a directed graph, an adjacency matrix of a three-dimensional graph, a side maximum capacity matrix and a node maximum storage energy value matrix; calculating traditional complex network indexes based on a topological structure; calculating a mixed complex network index based on energy flow characteristics and a topological structure; constructing a power grid attack fault simulator based on the high and low dynamics based on the traditional complex network index and the mixed complex network index; and verifying by adopting the fault simulator according to the traffic network layer energy distribution strategy to obtain the traffic network layer energy optimal distribution strategy. The method can reduce the risks of road congestion, power grid congestion and cascading faults, and enables the charging station to be more reasonable in planning.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Earthquake early warning terminal equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an earthquake early warning terminal equipment, including seismic data network center and early warning terminal, through communication module interactive connection between seismic data transceiver module and the seismic data network center, seismic data transceiver module's first signal output part is connected with the signal input part of the analytic module of seismic data, and the signal output part of the analytic module of seismic data is connected with seismic data output module's signal input part, and seismic data output module's signal output part is connected with seismic data display module's signal input part. The utility model discloses a seismic data receiving and dispatching module carries out seismic data information's collection, parses seismic data information through seismic data analysis module, adopts multiple approach to show the public to early warning information through seismic data output module and seismic data display module, and the ageing of propagation information is stronger and propagation approach and audience's scope is wider, can to a great extent avoid personnel's injures and deaths.
assignees: TIANJIN TASHI TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Information analysis method, device, equipment and storage medium of complex relation network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of big data, and discloses an information analysis method, device, equipment and storage medium of a complex relationship network, which are used for enhancing the identification and control capacity of community group risks. The information analysis method of the complex relationship network comprises the following steps: dividing a network topological structure of a complex relation network to be analyzed to obtain communities and community information; carrying out linear dimensionality reduction on the community information to obtain community characteristics, and obtaining community characteristic vectors according to the community characteristics; calculating the target similarity between every two community feature vectors, and determining candidate community information according to the target similarity; obtaining target community information, and generating a community weighted graph according to the target community information; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a community to be evaluated, a weighted risk value and a risk value of the community to be evaluated in a community weighted graph, analyzing the weighted risk value through a preset label propagation algorithm to update the risk value of the community to be evaluated, and obtaining the risk degree of the community to be evaluated and the identification degree of the risk through the updated risk value.
assignees: SHENZHEN ONECONNECT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power material demand plan prediction method based on BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power material demand plan prediction method based on a BP neural network, which comprises the following steps: preparing a historical power material demand plan data sample; the output and input of the neural network are determined. Selecting proper hidden layer number, defining the learning rate of each layer of the network, and establishing a BP neural network; initializing a network; calculating the error in the current network, then reversely propagating the error, and adjusting the connection weight and the threshold according to the gradient items of each layer; starting the iterative procedure until the training error has reached a small value; selecting a plurality of groups of different parameters to initialize a plurality of neural networks and searching for relative 'global minimum'; and calculating to obtain network output according to the selected BP neural network. The invention can provide effective guidance suggestions for electric power engineering construction projects. And powerful support is provided for the aspects of planning purchasing plans and project progress control of project teams.
assignees: Jiangsu electric power information technology co ltd;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Fire Sign Detection System of Power equipment
title_ko: 전력설비의 화재 징후 감지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire sign detection system of a power facility, which is attached to a fire weakness part to detect a fire sign in advance to prevent a fire through inspection guidance, and is easily installed in a clip form and manufactured in a micro size to save installation costs and make low power driving possible. The fire sign detection system of a power facility comprises: a plurality of arc detection units coupled to a plurality of power cables of a power facility, respectively, and detecting a resistance heat generated according to generation of an arc to transmit an arc detection signal to the outside through wireless communications; a transmission terminal formed in the power facility to receive the arc detection signal detected by each of the arc detection units and transmit the arc detection signal to the outside; a relay receiving the arc detection signal from the transmission terminal, and amplifying the arc detection signal to overcome a wave shadow zone and extend and enlarge a transmission distance; a collector receiving the arc detection signal from the relay to collect arc information data generated from the power facility; and a management server receiving, storing and analyzing data on the arc information of the power facility collected from the collector.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재 취약 부분에 부착하여 화재 징후를 사전에 감지함으로써 점검 유도를 통해 화재를 미연에 방지함과 더불어 클립 형태로 설치가 용이하고 초소형으로 제작하여 설치비를 절감과 함께 저전력 구동이 가능하도록 한 전력설비의 화재 징후 감지 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 전력설비 중 다수의 전원 케이블에 각각 결합되고 아크 발생에 따라 발생하는 저항열을 검출하여 무선 통신을 통해 외부로 전송하는 다수의 아크 검출부와, 상기 전력설비에 구성되어 상기 각 아크 검출부로부터 검출된 아크 검출신호를 전달받아 외부로 전송하는 전송 단말기와, 상기 전송 단말기로부터 아크 검출 신호를 전달받아 증폭하여 전파 음영지역을 극복하고 전송거리를 연장 및 확장하는 중계기와, 상기 중계기로부터 아크 검출 신호를 수신하여 상기 전력 설비에서 발생하는 아크 정보 데이터를 수집하는 수집기와, 상기 수집기로부터 수집된 상기 전력설비의 아크 정보에 대한 데이터를 전달받아 저장하고 분석하는 관리 서버를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: U-TRON CO LTD

title_en: Dynamics-based synchronous cross information propagation analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a synchronous cross information propagation analysis method and a system based on dynamics, which comprises the following steps: dividing the state of a network user into three user states of a susceptible state, a forwarding state and an immune state; constructing a cross information synchronous propagation dynamic model of the user changing between different user states along with the propagation of the two pieces of information; collecting two pieces of information of which the release time interval is smaller than a set value, dividing the user states of network users of the two pieces of information, inputting a plurality of user states of the two pieces of divided information into a cross information synchronous propagation dynamic model, and predicting the total number of individuals of different crowds changing along with time. The above method and system consider the interaction between two pieces of information.

title_en: Adaptive scheduling method and system for reservoir group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir group adaptive scheduling method and system, and belongs to the field of water resource utilization. The initial population is generated in the search space, the fitness value of each individual in the population is evaluated, the individual optimal position and the global optimal position in the population are updated, the global exploration strategy in the coevolution algorithm is adopted to conduct global exploration so as to improve the population convergence speed, and the local development strategy in the coevolution algorithm is adopted to conduct local search so as to improve the individual precision. And updating the positions of the individuals in the population through iterative evolution, and outputting the individuals corresponding to the global optimal solution as a final solution after a search stopping condition is reached. The embodiment proves that the method has good convergence speed and search precision, can coordinate the relationship between exploration and development, effectively solves the problem of cascade reservoir group scheduling, and obviously improves the economic benefit of the whole power grid.
assignees: UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH

title_en: Virtual simulation experiment system for softwood cutting propagation of ginkgo biloba
abstract_en: A virtual simulation experiment system for softwood cutting propagation of ginkgo biloba, comprising four procedures: cutting medium preparation, cuttings treatment, cutting process and post-cutting management, and fourteen specific operation steps thereof; furthermore, six modules are provided for experiment preview and self test, for full process experiment, for exploratory experiment, for knowledge learning and expansion, for experiment tips and help, and for experiment examination and evaluation; an experiment scenario is virtually simulated, and an experimental facility is constructed; corresponding parameters of an experiment design are set by means of a virtual experiment environment parameter setting device, and an experiment result is presented on a front end terminal of the system in a visualized form such as a scenario, a graph, and a table. The constructed system is powerful in function, reproduces the whole process and environment of cutting propagation production, and has a high simulation degree and a strong closeness to reality; and said system simulates and restores the teaching effect and environment of a real experiment, shortens the experiment time and improves the learning efficiency, and has wide popularization and utilization prospects in the teaching of cutting propagation experiments in universities such as agriculture and forestry colleges.
assignees: UNIV NANJING FORESTRY

title_en: Medium-and-long-term hidden random scheduling method for cascade hydropower station of combined wind power photovoltaic power station
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for carrying out medium-term and long-term hidden random scheduling on a cascade hydropower station of a combined wind power photovoltaic power station, and belongs to the technical field of hybrid energy system scheduling. According to the method, lunar runoff uncertainty is considered, and a radial basis function neural network is used for fitting a scheduling model through a hidden random scheduling method. The model reasonably considers wind power photovoltaic uncertainty and impact of a reverse peak regulation phenomenon which can occur to a power grid, considers that short-term wind and light uncertainty is reserved for standby in medium and long-term scheduling, and distributes enough daily electric quantity to deal with pressure of the reverse peak regulation phenomenon to the power grid peak regulation. The model result of the method is greatly different from the result without considering the short-term standby wind power photovoltaic, the method can effectively utilize wind power photovoltaic output and cascade hydropower station optimized scheduling information, and provides a reference basis with strong operability for the cascade hydropower station scientific decision under the condition of large-scale new energy grid connection.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Abnormal user behavior identification method based on bidirectional long-short term memory network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an abnormal user behavior identification method based on a bidirectional long-short term memory network. The invention provides a method for establishing an abnormal user behavior recognition model based on a bidirectional long-short term memory network and a BP neural network by combining electric power data. And acquiring user behavior data from a database, cleaning and filling the data, extracting the characteristics of the data through a bidirectional long-short term memory module, and then connecting a BP (back propagation) neural network for classification so as to judge whether the data is abnormal or not. The results show that: compared with a support vector machine, a BP network, a long-short term memory network and a bidirectional long-short term memory network, the bidirectional long-short term memory network can be used for more accurately judging the abnormal user behaviors. It has also been shown that it is effective to extend the data by the Smote algorithm to prevent the over-fitting phenomenon.
assignees: UNIV HANGZHOU DIANZI

title_en: Storage battery life prediction method based on optimized multilayer residual BP (back propagation) depth network
abstract_en: A storage battery life prediction method based on an optimized multilayer residual BP depth network comprises the following steps: s1, collecting real-time data of storage batteries in working states in the energy storage power station, and constructing an index system; s2, preprocessing the data according to the established index system, and initializing a multi-layer residual BP deep learning network; s3, solving a predicted value by forward propagation of a residual error network; s4, substituting the cost function into the cost function, calculating the network error, judging the error condition, if the requirement is not met, performing the step S5, and if the requirement is met, performing the step S6; s5, determining an error gradient, adjusting weight learning, and then turning to the step S3; s6, completing network learning to obtain a storage battery life model, and turning to the step S7; and S7, finishing the calculation. The method can predict the service life of the storage battery with high precision, and is helpful for guiding the scheduling scheme of the energy storage power station charging station, so that the running reasonability and the economical efficiency of the electric vehicle charging station with the energy storage system are effectively ensured.
assignees: NANJING INST TECH

title_en: Oil temperature prediction method and device and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an oil temperature prediction method and device and a computer readable storage medium, and belongs to the field of petroleum transportation. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a training data set, wherein the training data set comprises a plurality of data samples; calling an oil temperature prediction model based on a plurality of data samples to perform oil temperature prediction to obtain a plurality of predicted historical oil temperatures, wherein the oil temperature prediction model is obtained by training a back propagation neural network by adopting a training data set; subtracting the plurality of predicted historical oil temperatures from the historical downstream incoming oil temperatures of the plurality of predicted historical oil temperatures respectively to obtain a residual value sequence; calling an autoregressive moving average model to predict a residual value of the residual value sequence at the next moment; calling an oil temperature prediction model to perform oil temperature prediction based on oil temperature data to be predicted to obtain predicted oil temperature at the next moment, wherein the oil temperature data to be predicted comprises upstream oil temperature, upstream ground temperature, downstream station-entering ground temperature and output; and adding the residual value at the next moment and the predicted oil temperature at the next moment to obtain a predicted value of the inbound oil temperature at the next moment.

title_en: Reservoir water level prediction method based on cyclic neural network and attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of reservoir operation control, and discloses a reservoir water level prediction method based on a recurrent neural network and an attention mechanism, which comprises the following steps: collecting flow and water level data to form a data set, and classifying the data set; converting the water level and flow values of the data set to obtain a standard data set; constructing a cyclic neural network model with an attention mechanism, and defining a target function; selecting data of a standard data set to train the recurrent neural network model; verifying and testing the trained recurrent neural network model; and predicting the water level of the key section by using the trained recurrent neural network model. The calculation precision of the model can be continuously improved along with the accumulation of the reservoir operation data, the dependence on the accuracy of the boundary condition is low, and the problem of low calculation precision of the traditional hydrodynamic method can be effectively solved; in reservoir flood season scheduling, the key section water level can be accurately predicted, and technical support is provided for flood control and prosperity scheduling decisions of large-scale reservoirs or cascade reservoirs.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CORP

title_en: New energy scene generation method and system based on confrontation learning model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a new energy scene generation method and a system based on an antagonistic learning model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: generating a sample set for neural network training against a learning model and a label for each sample; constructing a discrimination network D and a generation network G; inputting the random vector z and the label of the sample into a generation network G to obtain a simulation sample G (z), and simultaneously inputting the simulation sample G (z), the real sample and the label of the sample into a discrimination network D; carrying out back propagation training on the neural networks of the generation network G and the discrimination network D, and carrying out iteration; and after iterative convergence, generating a network G to generate and output an optimized new energy operation scene. The method can solve the problems of single generated output parameter, inaccurate result, large quantity of simplified assumptions and the like of the traditional method, optimizes the new energy output parameter, and provides data basis and guarantee for random optimization operation control of the energy Internet.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Intelligent power grid operation information issuing system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent distribution system of power grid operation information, relating to the technical field of intelligent service systems; the method aims to solve the problems of publishing accuracy, dynamics and interactivity; the system specifically comprises a power failure plan input subsystem, a distribution network fault repair receiving subsystem, a distribution network automatic repair subsystem, a server, information release equipment, a switch and a release terminal. The invention integrates the power failure information generation, reporting, maintenance distribution and power failure information release processes of planned power failure and accidental power failure, effectively provides the efficiency and accuracy of a power grid for dealing with power failure events, improves the data accuracy, expands the information exchange channel and range, improves the influence and the propagation speed, ensures that the power failure information is informed in place, randomly splices and plays videos and broadcasts according to the needs of users, carries out non-contact experience, browsing, inquiry and release information and free editing by recognizing the gesture operation of the users to realize timely interaction with the users, and finally realizes intellectualization, digitalization and interactive linkage.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Radion Frequency Repeater System of Disaster Broadcasting capable of Improving Quality using Noise Reduction of Digital Demodulation Signal
title_ko: 디지털 복조신호의 노이즈 리덕션 기능을 구현하여 전파음영지역의 방송품질을 개선한 재난방송 무선중계시스템
abstract_en: A disaster broadcasting wireless relay system having improved broadcasting quality in radio-shaded areas by implementing a noise reduction function of a digital demodulated signal according to the present invention includes: a disaster broadcasting receiving device installed inside a building in a radio-shaded area and equipped with a noise reduction FPGA module to reduce noise caused by the surrounding environments when receiving RF signals for disaster broadcasting to convert and output the digital demodulated signal from which noise has been removed into internet packet data; a main relay device installed to each floor constituting the interior of the building to receive the internet packet data outputted from the disaster broadcasting receiving device through a wired network and outputting the data into a short-range wireless signal; at least one sub-relay device installed to the floor in which the main relay device is installed to receive a short-range wireless signal outputted from the main relay device, modulate the signal into an RF signal for disaster broadcasting, and outputting the signal; and a user terminal having a disaster broadcasting reception communication module for receiving the RF signal for disaster broadcasting outputted through the sub-relay device. Therefore, according to the present invention, the disaster broadcast is easily delivered to radio-shaded areas, and the noise reduction function of the digital demodulated signal inputted to the disaster broadcasting reception facility is implemented, so that the reliability of a disaster broadcasting is improved.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 디지털 복조신호의 노이즈 리덕션 기능을 구현하여 전파음영지역의 방송품질을 개선한 재난방송 무선중계시스템, 본 발명에 따른 디지털 복조신호의 노이즈 리덕션 기능을 구현하여 전파음영지역의 방송품질을 개선한 재난방송 무선중계시스템은, 전파음영지역의 건물내부에 설치되며 재난방송용 RF신호를 수신하는 경우에 주변환경으로 인한 노이즈를 저감시키기 위한 노이즈 저감용 FPGA 모듈을 구비하여 노이즈가 제거된 디지털 복조신호를 인터넷 패킷데이터로 변환하여 출력하는  재난방송 수신장치; 상기 건물내부를 구성하는 층별로 설치되고 상기 재난방송 수신장치에서 출력되는 인터넷 패킷데이터를 유선망으로 수신하여 근거리 무선신호로 출력하는 메인중계장치; 상기 메인중계장치가 설치된 층에 적어도 하나 이상 설치되며 상기 메인중계장치에서 출력되는 근거리 무선신호를 수신하여 재난방송용 RF신호로 변조하여 출력하는 서브중계장치; 및 상기 서브중계장치를 통해 출력되는 재난방송용 RF신호를 수신하기 위한 재난방송수신용 통신모듈을 구비하는 사용자 단말기;를 구비할 수 있다. 
따라서, 본 발명은, 전파음영지역에 용이하게 재난방송을 전달할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 재난방송 수신설비에 입력되는 디지털 복조신호의 노이즈 리덕션 기능을 구현하여 재난방송의 신뢰성을 향상시킬 수 있는 전파음영지역의 방송품질을 개선한 재난방송 무선중계시스템을 제공하는 효과가 있다.
assignees: DAONSYSTEMS CO LTD

title_en: Marine personnel search and rescue signal lamp convenient to height-adjusting
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to search for and rescue the device field, especially, marine personnel search for and rescue with signal lamp of being convenient for height-adjusting, the position to the signal lamp on the equipment of existing search for and rescue is not convenient for adjust, can not enlarge signal propagation range, searches for and rescues the not good problem of effect, proposes following scheme now, and it includes the control box, the top fixed mounting of control box has two fixed plates, and the fixed slot has all been seted up to one side that two fixed plates are close to each other, and slidable mounting has same connecting plate in two fixed slots, the top fixed mounting of connecting plate has the movable plate, and the top of movable plate is seted up flutedly, and the rotation seat is installed to the recess internal rotation, rotates the top fixed mounting of seat and has the. The utility model discloses rational in infrastructure, convenient operation, the position of the signal lamp on this search and rescue equipment is convenient for adjust, can enlarge signal propagation range, and the search and rescue effect is good.
assignees: YANG ZHIWEI

title_en: Method for realizing multi-MCU cascade centerless video conference
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing a multi-MCU cascaded centerless video conference, which comprises the steps that firstly, a terminal is connected with a LAN2 network port of a slave MCU, and the slave MCU is connected and cascaded with LAN1 network ports of all main MCUs through a LAN1 network port; then each terminal collects video and audio, and then codes, compresses and transmits the video and audio to the connected slave MCU; each slave MCU decodes the media data of the terminal, then carries out picture synthesis and sound mixing processing, codes and sends the coded data to all the master MCUs; each master MCU decodes the media data of all the slave MCUs, then carries out picture synthesis and sound mixing processing, codes and sends the coded data to all the slave MCUs; each slave MCU decodes the media data sent by all the master MCUs, then carries out picture synthesis and sound mixing processing, codes and sends the coded data to a terminal communicated with the slave MCU; each terminal decodes the media stream data of the slave MCU connected with the terminal and plays the data through video output and audio output equipment. The invention can realize the low-coupling multistage cascade conference, and the conference supports remote disaster recovery and has good recoverability, stability and compatibility.
assignees: SHENZHEN RONGXUN VISION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Cascade hydropower day-ahead scheduling method considering power grid section constraint
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of cascade reservoir group power generation optimizing and dispatching, in particular to a cascade hydropower day-ahead dispatching method considering power grid section constraint.

title_en: Semi-physical antenna simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a semi-physical antenna simulation method and system, belonging to the technical field of microwaves. Extracting S parameters of a double port of a matching circuit by using a vector network analyzer, importing S parameter data into three-dimensional electromagnetic simulation software, and then cascading the S parameter data with an antenna model; and then simulating the semi-physical antenna model by three-dimensional electromagnetic simulation software, and obtaining the final antenna performance result by means of the simulation software. The invention takes the influence of resistance loss, parasitic capacitance and inductance in the circuit on the antenna into consideration, avoids the interference of ground and surrounding environment on the antenna measurement in actual measurement, and more accurately and conveniently obtains the far field performance of the antenna.

title_en: Enterprise power distribution network energy saving evaluation system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an enterprise power distribution network energy-saving evaluation system and relates to the technical field of power distribution networks. The intelligent electric energy meter comprises an intelligent electric energy meter, a Z-wave wireless network, an electric power information acquisition terminal, an Ethernet and a power distribution network energy-saving evaluation terminal; the electric power information acquisition terminal is a computer with a built-in program and is used for electric power information acquisition and calculation; the power distribution network energy-saving evaluation terminal is a computer with built-in evaluation software and is evaluated by adopting a propagation neural network method. In addition, the invention also provides an energy-saving evaluation method for the enterprise power distribution network. The method adopts the advantage of the self-learning capability of the propagation neural network, the multi-factor energy-saving evaluation of the enterprise power distribution network is efficient in evaluation and high in reliability of evaluation results, relevant factors influencing energy saving in the enterprise power distribution network can be effectively analyzed, energy-saving reconstruction is facilitated, the power utilization efficiency of enterprises is improved, the power utilization cost is saved, and the cost is saved.
assignees: JIANGSU WEINENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for indicating escape path of forest fire based on A-Star algorithm
