abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to a method and a system for indicating escape paths of forest fires based on an A-Star algorithm, which are used for acquiring target images of fire extinguishing areas of fire extinguishers by image acquisition equipment, processing the target images to obtain three data, namely flame area growth rate, flame circularity and flame sharp angle width, in the images, inputting the three data into a BP (back propagation) neural network model to identify whether a fire disaster occurs at a position corresponding to the target images, establishing a rasterized map according to geographical positions and identified target image structures, searching the escape paths of the fire extinguishers on the rasterized map by adopting the A-Star algorithm, wherein the escape paths are used as indications for the fire extinguishers to safely leave a fire scene, so that the safety of the fire extinguishers is ensured, and the problem that the existing system or the method for planning the escape paths of the fire scene is mainly indoor and has no outdoor fire such as forest fires, causing fire extinguishing personnel to be in danger.
assignees: UNIV GUANGDONG TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Substation power utilization analysis system and method
abstract_en: The application relates to a substation power utilization analysis system and method. The system comprises a front-end sensor and a data server, wherein the front-end sensor and the data server are in communication in a wireless mode, the front-end sensor is used for detecting electric energy parameters of the transformer substation and sending the electric energy parameters to the data server, and the data server is used for analyzing the electric energy parameters based on a BP (back propagation) neural network, establishing a power grid fault early warning model and predicting the load of the transformer substation according to the power grid fault early warning model. The front-end sensor and the data server are communicated in a wireless mode, the use cost can be reduced, communication lines do not need to be laid, the safety of the transformer substation is improved, the electric energy parameters of the data server are subjected to data analysis modeling, a fault early warning model based on the electric energy parameters is obtained, the model can be used for predicting the load of the transformer substation, faults are pre-judged in advance, so that solving measures can be taken in time, and the use reliability of the power utilization analysis system of the transformer substation is improved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Network public opinion analysis method, device, system, equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a network public opinion analysis method, device, system, equipment and readable storage medium. The method disclosed by the application comprises the following steps: acquiring network information published by different propagation channels in real time; extracting hotspot information in the network information; analyzing the positive and negative trends of the hotspot information by using a Bayesian algorithm; and adding the positive and negative trends to a prediction parameter of the hotspot information, and predicting the public sentiment risk of the hotspot information according to the prediction parameter. The method and the device can predict the public opinion risk brought by the network information in time, so that the risk can be estimated in advance, and early warning is realized.
assignees: DBAPPSECURITY CO LTD

title_en: Repeater
title_ko: 환경 감시 기능이 통합된 재난 통신망 스마트 중계 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster communication network smart repeater in which an environmental monitoring function is integrated. More particularly, the present invention relates to a disaster communication network smart repeater in which an environmental monitoring function is integrated into an existing disaster communication network repeater. To this end, disclosed is a disaster communication network smart repeater in which an environmental monitoring function is integrated, which comprises: a plurality of disaster communication network repeaters which are connected to a base station or a user′s terminal to provide a communication network service, and are arranged at preset distances to quickly relay and propagate the situation in the event of a disaster; a plurality of sensor network modules which are connected to each other through a sensor network so as to be connected to each of the plurality of disaster communication network repeaters, and which detect disaster information and environmental information based on an installation location and transmit it to the connected disaster communication network repeater through the sensor network; and a first server connected to and connected to the plurality of disaster communication network repeaters to exchange the disaster information and environmental information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 환경 감시 기능이 통합된 재난 통신망 스마트 중계기에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 기존의 재난 통신망 중계기에 환경 감시 기능을 통합한 환경 감시 기능이 통합된 재난 통신망 스마트 중계기에 관한 것이다. 이를 위해 기지국 또는 사용자의 단말과 접속되어 통신망 서비스를 제공하며, 재난 발생시 상황을 신속히 주변에 중계 전파하도록 기 설정된 거리마다 배치되는 복수의 재난 통신망 중계기, 복수의 재난 통신망 중계기의 각각과 연결 접속되도록 센서 네트워크망으로 서로 연결 접속되며, 설치 위치에 기반한 재난정보 및 환경정보를 감지하여 접속된 재난 통신망 중계기에 센서 네트워크망을 통해 전송하는 복수의 센서 네트워크 모듈부, 복수의 재난 통신망 중계기와 서로 연결 접속되어 재난정보 및 환경정보를 주고받는 제1 서버를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 환경 감시 기능이 통합된 재난 통신망 스마트 중계기가 개시된다.
assignees: PARIDIGM INC

title_en: Method and system for evaluating energy utilization flexibility of comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for evaluating the energy utilization flexibility of an integrated energy system. The method comprises the following steps: s1, establishing a mapping model of a comprehensive energy system based on physical characteristics of energy equipment and an energy network topological structure; s2, establishing uncertainty test sets of supply and demand ends according to historical operation data of the comprehensive energy system and historical load data in a supply area, and generating energy demand and energy supply pairs of demand ends under all the test sets; s3, respectively calculating the flexibility of different energy flows according to the generated energy demand and energy supply pairs; and S4, determining the overall energy utilization flexibility of the comprehensive energy system based on a fuzzy analytic hierarchy process. The invention can provide guidance for the cascade utilization of energy and the optimization of operation scheduling of the comprehensive energy system, enhance the interaction of the supply and demand ends and reduce the adverse effect caused by the uncertainty of the system.

title_en: Power grid disturbance evaluation method based on SIS model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of network topology dynamics, relates to the field of intersection with electric power information safety, in particular to a power grid disturbance evaluation method based on an SIS model, which is based on the idea of a 'bin model', establishes an extension model of a power grid disturbance crisis event by referring to the SIS model, and realizes power grid static stability evaluation by means of dynamics analysis; the method comprises the following steps: step 1: nodes of the power grid topological structure, node weights and branch weights are calculated and data are processed; step 2: forming a high-dimensional random matrix and processing analysis standard data; step 3: calculating M-P rate or circular rate, and randomly matrix eigenvalue and average spectrum radius; step 4: calculating the infection rate and the cure rate, and solving a differential equation of the SIS model; and finally analyzing the disturbance propagation dynamics characteristics of the power grid.

title_en: Cascading failure successive cut-off disturbance setting method and system considering new energy grid connection influence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascading failure successive cut-off disturbance setting method and system considering new energy grid-connected influence, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a boundary condition vector of a power grid severe fault simulation calculation mode based on the severe and harsh requirements of operating conditions; constructing a grid-connected new energy correlation requirement-based initial element set vector of successive cut-off of a power grid; constructing a sequential on-off element triggering condition set vector considering the fault ride-through characteristic of the new energy power supply; designing and designing a cascading failure successive cut-off disturbance setting flow influenced by new energy grid connection based on the boundary condition vector of the grid serious fault simulation calculation mode, the grid successive cut-off initial element set vector and the successive cut-off element triggering condition set vector; and acquiring a cascading failure successive switching disturbance final serious fault set considering the new energy grid connection influence based on the cascading failure successive switching disturbance setting process.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Aviation network risk propagation identification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aviation network risk propagation identification method, which is applied to the field of civil aviation risk assessment and comprises the following steps: determining an airport risk coefficient for the preprocessed airport pair risk time sequence data based on a pre-established airport risk coefficient model; determining a checking order according to the airport risk coefficient, and determining a corresponding residual square sum based on the checking order and the corresponding airport risk time sequence; the residual sum of squares is examined to identify risk propagation relationships between the airport pairs. The method determines the corresponding residual sum of squares based on the inspection order and the corresponding risk time sequence of the airport; and (4) the sum of squares of the residual errors is checked to identify the risk propagation relationship between the airport pairs, so that the judgment of whether risk propagation exists between two airports in the aviation network is realized.

title_en: Risk propagation determination method and device, computer system and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, a computer system and a readable storage medium for determining dynamic risk propagation, which relate to the technical field of information security and comprise the following steps: establishing a risk network and acquiring a target moment, and preprocessing the risk network to acquire a target network; acquiring a preset attenuation coefficient, and calculating risk factors corresponding to each propagation relation in a target network at the target moment based on the creation moment and the preset attenuation coefficient; determining risk data of each individual data of the state to be determined in the target network at the target moment according to the risk factors; and carrying out risk state marking on each state individual data to be determined in the target network based on the risk data to obtain a target result, thereby solving the problem that the accuracy of a risk evaluation result made by an entity with unknown risk is low in the prior art because the time and the structural change of a risk network structure are not considered by the prior static network.
assignees: SHENZHEN ONECONNECT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Analysis method for online and offline double-layer network information propagation mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses an analysis method of an online and offline double-layer network information transmission mode, relates to a double-layer routing information transmission method, and solves the problems that influence in an offline mobile network is not considered in an information transmission method in the conventional social network, so that the transmission effect is poor and the like. The first k nodes forming the best set, i.e., key propagators, are found in a single-tier network. The influence of k nodes is not simply the sum of each node, but the total weight of the outline edge of the node set formed by the k nodes. The IMOOP algorithm proposed by the present invention can select the best person at a key node in order to maximize the impact of the information before the information expiration date. The method of the invention brings a more comprehensive angle for the information transmission algorithm, so that the accuracy of information transmission is greatly improved.
assignees: UNIV JILIN

title_en: Method and system for predicting power grid cascading failure set
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting a power grid cascading failure set, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a basic operation mode tide data file, a transient and medium-long term model data file and a security control strategy configuration file, establishing a secondary system model, and forming a whole-process dynamic simulation input model file; performing multi-entropy index calculation of betweenness correction based on a basic operation mode flow data file to generate a power grid fragile element set; performing iterative sand heap model simulation based on a basic operation mode tide data file to generate an expected critical threshold value of the occurrence of the blackout; generating a steady-state fault sequence set by taking the power grid fragile element set as an initial fault and referring to an expected critical threshold value; injecting a steady-state fault sequence set and a full-process dynamic simulation input model file into PSD-FDS software together, executing full-process dynamic simulation calculation, and outputting secondary system protection action information; and forming a power grid cascading failure set based on the effective cascading failure set and the secondary system protection action information.

title_en: Power system state estimation method combining particle filtering and convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a power system state estimation method combining particle filtering and a convolutional neural network, which comprises the following steps: an off-line learning part measures fusion data by using a historical RTU/PMU, analyzes probability distribution of system injection power, generates a training sample by using Monte Carlo sampling through a Bayesian estimation-based particle filter algorithm, and trains a convolutional neural network; and the online state estimation part is used for preprocessing the real-time PMU measurement data, establishing a network according to a convolutional neural network structure and a weight value obtained from the training of the offline learning part, and then completing the state estimation of the power system through forward calculation and backward propagation. Compared with the Newton method iterative algorithm of the traditional least square estimation, the method can effectively improve the calculation speed and improve the precision and the robust capability of state estimation.
assignees: UNIV WUHAN;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Automatic Wireless Train Protection System based on LTE-R and Method thereof
title_ko: 열차통합무선망 기반 열차무선방호시스템
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a train wireless protection system based on an integrated train wireless network utilizes an LTE-R based system to minimize the establishment of separate infrastructure, prepares a method for accurately specifying trains subject to emergency alert propagation in consideration of the speed and characteristics of the operating line and the direction of the train, seeks a method of real-time monitoring of protection devices and local control panel status checks and notification of results, includes a real-time log collection and storage method, and a code generation method for securing security, improves reliability by enabling immediate response in an emergency through real-time condition monitoring of the conventional VHR type train wireless protection device by using the LTE-R based system, applies GPS and cell positioning technology to improve train positioning accuracy, categorizes vehicles individually, and transmits emergency alerts only to vehicles moving to an emergency situation, thereby minimizing train operation delays, thereby satisfying customer service satisfaction and ensuring train operation safety at the same time.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 열차통합무선망 기반 열차무선방호시스템에 따르면, LTE-R 기반시스템을 활용하여 별도의 기반시설 구축을 최소화하고, 운행선 속도 및 특성, 열차의 방향성을 고려하여 비상 경보 전파 대상 열차들을 정확하게 특정 짓는 방법을 마련하며, 방호 장치 및 로컬 관제 조작반 상태 점검 실시간 모니터링 및 결과에 대한 통보 방법을 모색하며, 실시간 로그 수집 및 저장 방법, 보안성 확보를 위한 코드 생성 방법이 포함되고, 종래의 VHF 방식의 열차무선방호장치를 LTE-R 기반 시스템을 활용하여 실시간 상태 모니터링을 통한 비상 시 즉각 대응이 가능해 신뢰성을 높이고, GPS와 셀 측위기술을 적용하여 열차 위치측위 정확성을 향상시키며, 차량들을 개별적으로 구분하여 비상상황이 발생한 지역으로 이동하는 차량에게만 비상경보를 송출하여 열차운행 지연을 최소화 시켜 고객서비스 만족 및 열차운행 안전성 확보를 동시에 만족시킬 수 있는 효과가 있다.
assignees: KOREA RAILROAD CORP

title_en: Node importance identification method based on complex network dependent seepage model
abstract_en: The invention provides a node importance identification method based on a complex network dependent seepage model, and aims to determine influence of nodes in a network according to seepage characteristics and cascade dynamics process when the network fails. The invention comprises an edge-dependent network modeling module and a real network verification module, wherein the edge-dependent network modeling module comprises the following steps: (1) Constructing a network model based on an edge dependency mechanism, and introducing a weak dependency seepage model to adjust the dependency strength between the connected edges in the network model; (2) Performing failure investigation on nodes in the network model in the step 1, setting the dependency strength among the adjustable parameter control nodes, and performing a new round of failure judgment according to whether new dependency edge failures exist in the network model until the network model is stable, so as to obtain the final value of the maximum connected component of the network model; (3) The importance of the node is evaluated based on the edge-dependent strength threshold and the maximum connected component that lead to network collapse when the node is deleted.

title_en: Electric power information physical system cascading failure prediction method based on risk element theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting cascading failure of a power information physical system based on a risk element theory, which comprises the following steps: 1. correcting the power grid community partition result by a Prim algorithm; 2. constructing a power information physical system; 3. constructing a risk transfer function of the fault, and calculating the initial fault probability of the line and the initial failure probability of the information node to form an initial fault set of an accident chain; 4. selecting a fault stage, and when corresponding fault on-off information is uploaded to a dispatching center, the dispatching center issues a corresponding control command; 5. sequentially selecting a fault line and a failure node in the next fault stage according to a subsequent risk transfer function; 6. and traversing the initial fault set, repeating the steps 4-5 until the end condition is met, recording accident chain data and outputting the accident chain data. The method can dynamically describe the development process of the interactive propagation of the faults in the power grid and the information grid in the power information physical system, thereby providing theoretical guidance for the prevention and control of the cascading faults of the power information physical system.
assignees: UNIV HEFEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Time-varying network model construction method and system and rumor propagation time-varying network model construction method
abstract_en: The application relates to a time-varying network model construction method, a time-varying network model construction system and a rumor propagation time-varying network model construction method, which belong to the technical field of time-varying network model research, wherein a two-dimensional grid network with the node number of N and L is set, node spacing and accumulated edge connection times sum are obtained on the basis of the space coordinates of nodes and the edge connection condition of each moment node, the edge connection preference probability of each moment active node is obtained by combining the node spacing and the accumulated edge connection times sum, and the time-varying network model is obtained by performing edge connection on the basis of the edge connection preference probability of each moment active node; by utilizing the time-varying network model construction method, a node information acquisition module, a preference probability acquisition module, an instantaneous network model forming module and a time-varying network model generating module are obtained, so that a time-varying network model construction system is obtained; and a construction method for obtaining a rumor propagation time-varying network model. Compared with the related art, the method has the effect of reducing the limitation of the time-varying network model to a certain extent.
assignees: UNIV FUDAN

title_en: Partitioned landslide detection system and method based on cascaded deep convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sectional landslide detection system and method based on a cascade deep convolution neural network. The method for detecting the landslide in the subareas comprises an image acquisition module for acquiring landslide disaster images, a database module for constructing and storing landslide disaster image samples with different attributes and different areas, a landslide detection model preparation module for preprocessing the images, constructing an image pyramid and determining corresponding area coefficients of each area, and a landslide detection model generation module for generating landslide disaster identification detection models corresponding to different areas, wherein the landslide detection model generation module comprises a visual DLNet detector generation optimization module and a multilayer cascade deep convolution neural network detection model module. The method combines the artificial intelligence technology with landslide disaster identification, and generates detection models aiming at different areas by utilizing the area commonality of landslide disasters; and a deep convolution neural network with cascade characteristics is constructed, so that the landslide disaster can be intelligently interpreted, and the landslide disaster identification accuracy is improved.

title_en: Power communication network maintenance drilling method and system based on fault simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power communication network maintenance drilling method and device based on fault simulation, wherein maintenance task information is obtained, corresponding equipment and optical cable resources are obtained based on maintenance contents in the maintenance task information, and maintenance preview simulation is carried out; simulating and setting corresponding faults according to the correlation between the maintenance task information and the equipment and the optical cable, and presenting the diffusion and the propagation of the faults on the network topology and the operation state; and analyzing the fault influence according to the fault alarm to realize the maintenance drilling. The method and the device finally realize the maintenance rehearsal of the power communication network based on fault simulation, improve the pertinence and effectiveness of the maintenance rehearsal analysis, and improve the efficiency of related operation and maintenance personnel in the maintenance work of the power communication network.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION COMPANY;NANJING NARI INFORMATION COMM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Recursive graph convolution network system for power grid transient stability evaluation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recursive graph convolution network system for power grid transient stability assessment. The invention designs a new graph relation matrix of a convolution layer by taking line admittance as a reference to form a special graph convolution network, and adopts a graph convolution algorithm to realize transmission and fusion of power grid node state information based on topological relation; the space extractor comprising the special graph convolution network is cascaded with the time sequence extractor comprising the long and short memory network (LSTM), and a time pooling layer is designed behind the time sequence extractor to aggregate the prediction results of a plurality of time steps, so that a recursive depth graph convolution model suitable for power grid stability assessment is formed, and space layer and time layer characteristic aggregation and characteristic extraction of power grid state quantity data can be sequentially realized, so that a power grid transient stability assessment system established based on the space extractor can adapt to the change of a power grid topological structure, excellent generalization capability is shown, and the assessment result is accurate.

title_en: Method and device for repairing missing power load data based on cascade convolution self-encoder
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for repairing missing power load data based on a cascade convolution self-encoder. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring original power load data without loss, establishing a loss mask generation model, simulating and generating a grading sub-mask, and generating simulated incomplete data by combining the original power load data; preprocessing the original power load data, the simulated incomplete data and the graded sub-masks to serve as a training set, establishing a cascade convolution self-encoder network, and training the cascade convolution self-encoder network; and after the incomplete power load data to be repaired and the corresponding grading sub-masks are preprocessed, inputting the data into the trained cascade convolution self-encoder network to obtain the repaired power load data. The method disclosed by the invention can be used for repairing the incomplete power load data, and higher repairing precision is realized.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Urban rail transit network cascade failure evaluation method based on redundancy recovery
abstract_en: A redundant recovery-based urban rail transit cascade failure assessment method comprises the following steps: and acquiring the inbound passenger volume and the outbound passenger volume of a certain time period, and modeling the rail transit network by using a space L method. The important nodes in the network are respectively identified from three aspects of node degree, betweenness and node strength. And establishing a passenger flow distribution model to simulate the passenger flow distribution process in the cascade failure process of the rail transit network and establishing a redundancy recovery scheme to simulate the system recovery of the Nanjing rail transit network under the fault condition. And evaluating the vulnerability of the urban rail transit network by simulating attacks under different scenes. The invention considers the vulnerability of the rail transit network under the condition of actual passenger flow, and establishes a node capacity model and a redundancy recovery strategy to analyze the performance of the rail transit network under cascade failure. Therefore, the nodes which have great influence on the network are identified, and theoretical support is provided for maintenance work of urban rail transit managers and later-stage rail transit expansion of designers.
assignees: UNIV JIANGSU NORMAL

title_en: Power network vulnerability assessment method based on multiple attack strategies
abstract_en: A method for evaluating the vulnerability of an electric power system based on multiple attack strategies comprises the following steps: 1) and constructing a power grid model. 2) The node importance in the network is evaluated from four aspects of node degree, betweenness, local centrality and node fault loss, and the establishment of an attack strategy is completed according to the network node importance. 3) And establishing an betweenness virtual flow model to simulate the process of cascading fault propagation in the power system. 4) Establishing a vulnerability index based on the betweenness virtual flow model, simulating network attack by adopting various attack strategies, and evaluating the vulnerability of the IEEE300 power system network according to the change of the vulnerability index. Aiming at the vulnerability of the power network under the condition of various attack strategies, the method establishes an betweenness virtual flow model and the various attack strategies to analyze the performance change of the power grid under the cascade failure. The method can identify the importance of the nodes in the power network and provide decision support for maintenance work of power system managers and designers when power system fault prevention is carried out.
assignees: UNIV JIANGSU NORMAL

title_en: Electric power market clearing method, system, device and medium containing step hydropower
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a system, a device and a medium for clearing an electric power market comprising step hydropower. The method comprises the steps of obtaining unit operation boundary conditions, power grid operation boundary conditions, daily water level control interval information and quotation data of each unit in a power spot market issued by a power dispatching mechanism, and further obtaining a daily safety constraint unit combination model comprising hydraulic constraint conditions of a step hydroelectric unit; and the operation cost of the units is minimized as an objective function to clear the power market in the future, so as to obtain the clear result of the output of each unit. In the discharging and cleaning model of the electric power spot market, the embodiment of the application considers the upstream-downstream coupling relation of the cascade hydroelectric generating sets, linearizes the cascade hydroelectric generating sets through hydraulic constraint conditions, embeds the safety constraint set combination model to execute discharging and cleaning, is beneficial to the normal operation of the hydroelectric generating sets at all levels, and reduces the resource waste caused by water discarding of the hydropower station. The application can be widely applied to the technical field of electric power.

title_en: Aviation network risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aviation network risk assessment method. According to the method, on the basis of the risk of a single airport, more serious airspace risk caused by risk cascade is researched, and airspace-oriented risk assessment is carried out, so that the control of the overall operation situation of the airspace is facilitated. On the other hand, potential safety risks such as airport saturation and flight delay are selected as evaluation factors, from the factors causing aviation network risks in the pre-tactic stage, time points of risk evaluation and adjustment measures are advanced, major flight accidents such as collision are prevented from developing, and high-risk operation of tactical levels is reduced. Meanwhile, flight delay and airport saturation are dynamic, so that the safety risk assessment of the aviation network based on delay and congestion is dynamic, and the risk level assessment of each airspace of the whole aviation network is more reliable.
assignees: CIVIL AVIATION MAN INSTITUTE OF CHINA;ZHEJIANG JIANDE GENERAL AVIATION ACAD

title_en: Design method of broadband miniaturized VICTS antenna feed network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a design method of a broadband miniaturized VICTS antenna feed network, which comprises the steps of determining the level of a power distribution network according to the transverse size of the feed network, and determining the number of T-shaped nodes according to the level of the power distribution network and the longitudinal size of the feed network; analyzing a field mode propagated in the waveguide, calculating the initial frequency and the termination frequency of a main mode, establishing a miniaturized T-shaped junction model, and establishing a relation between structural parameters of the T-shaped junction and a reflection coefficient; a broadband technology is adopted to design a broadband and miniaturized T-shaped junction, and a full-wave analysis method is applied to extract the relation between the broadband T-shaped junction and a reflection coefficient. Adjusting the amplitude and the phase of the T-shaped junction to meet the in-phase excitation output of specific power distribution; and designing a port conversion module and a transition matching and polarization adjusting module, and checking the relevant indexes of the excitation source to achieve the set indexes. The invention realizes the effective compression of the longitudinal dimension of the feed network, realizes the accurate control of the amplitude while outputting in phase within the required frequency band range, thereby ensuring the gain and standing wave characteristics of the antenna.
assignees: CHONGQING XINGGUI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Charging facility site selection method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a charging facility site selection method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a preset primary factor and a preset secondary factor of site selection of a charging facility according to expert opinions; determining a causal relationship between a preset primary factor and a preset secondary factor according to the prior knowledge; constructing a Bayesian network model according to a causal relationship between a preset primary factor and a preset secondary factor, and calculating joint probability distribution of each node in the Bayesian network model as the probability of station establishment rationality of the node position; verifying the constructed Bayesian network model by adopting sensitivity analysis and propagation analysis, generating a first-level factor influencing site selection of the charging facility, and judging whether a preset first-level factor is consistent with the first-level factor influencing site selection of the charging facility; and if the maximum joint probability of each node in the Bayesian network model is consistent with the maximum joint probability of each node in the Bayesian network model, selecting the position of the first-choice station, and synthesizing uncertainty factors in the actual site selection process based on the Bayesian network model, so that the method has practicability and guidance for site selection of charging facilities.
assignees: GLOBAL ENERGY INTERCONNECTION RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID EV SERVICE CO LTD;STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Wind power project investment estimation method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wind power project investment estimation method and device, comprising the following steps: acquiring engineering characteristic factor data related to kilowatt investment of a wind power unit; and inputting the engineering characteristic factor data related to the kilowatt investment of the wind power unit into a pre-trained error back propagation neural network model, and determining the estimated value of the kilowatt investment of the wind power unit. The technical scheme provided by the invention improves the capacity and accuracy of model optimization, further improves the precision and generalization capacity of investment estimation, realizes rapid and reasonable estimation of wind power project investment, provides scientific and objective basis for investment decision and project establishment, and has important social significance.

title_en: Genetic algorithm, system and device for planning and optimizing power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a genetic algorithm, a system and a device for planning and optimizing a power distribution network. Therefore, the method forms the initial value individuals with high environmental adaptability into the high-quality population at the initial stage of the algorithm, namely classifies the initial value individuals which have extremely strong competitiveness and are easy to propagate to the next generation in the initial population, and then optimizes the initial value individuals except the initial value individuals forming the high-quality population, thereby avoiding the phenomenon of early maturity in the traditional genetic algorithm.
assignees: YUHANG BRANCH HANGZHOU ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG HANGZHOU YUHANG POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;HANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Visual analysis method and system for simulation verification of safety event of power system
abstract_en: The invention provides a visual analysis method and a visual analysis system for simulation verification of a safety event of an electric power system, and provides a multi-level and omnibearing visual scheme from data, a model and knowledge aiming at the visual presentation problem of multidimensional heterogeneous information under a safety event simulation verification scene of an electric power industrial control system. Based on the visual view of the basic data and priori knowledge of analysts, a network domain model and a physical domain model are constructed, so that the internal rule and logic relation in the information can be deeply explored; the obtained knowledge is extracted and generalized from two perspectives of attack and defense, abstract knowledge is quantized, and knowledge propagation understanding is facilitated. Through visual display of the original information, the process information and the analysis result information, the operation situation in the simulation verification process of the safety event is comprehensively perceived, and the safety analysis capability and the efficiency of decision-making and disposal of the problems are improved.

title_en: Bird risk prediction and evaluation method in bird sucking environment of aircraft engine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bird risk prediction and evaluation method in an aircraft engine bird sucking environment, which comprises the steps of obtaining aircraft engine bird sucking event probability according to historical data, writing an M file program by using MATLAB language, realizing BP neural network algorithm, predicting economic loss caused by aircraft engine bird sucking events by using a BP neural network model, and performing risk evaluation by combining the aircraft engine bird sucking event probability and a risk evaluation matrix. And finally, designing a GUI (graphical user interface), selecting eight factor data such as the airplane quality, the engine installation number, the engine type, the month, the weather, the bird type, the bird number, the bird size and the like in the statistical data according to the correlation degree of the influence factors in the bird sucking event of the aircraft engine, and calling a BP (back propagation) neural network algorithm through the M file to obtain a result. The model can be used to predict the probability value, severity and risk assessment level of a future flight of an aircraft for the ingestion of a bird at a specified time period and at a specified altitude.
assignees: UNIV NANJING AERONAUTICS & ASTRONAUTICS

title_en: Risk propagation information evaluation method, risk propagation information evaluation system, storage medium and computer equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of enterprise information query, and discloses a risk propagation information evaluation method, a system, a storage medium and computer equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining information of a storage target enterprise and related parties thereof, and constructing a multi-level and multi-classification related party database; extracting data from the database of the related party according to the database of the related party, and constructing a multi-level relational network based on the target enterprise; each entity on the relationship network inspects the basic credit worthiness condition and gives a quantized score; and applying a propagation model based on a complex network, giving a driving risk propagation event, analyzing a risk propagation process, and realizing the risk intensity quantification of the target enterprise and the associated party thereof. According to the method, a relationship network of a social association network is established, and a large amount of transaction industry backgrounds are combined, so that when risk change occurs to a certain enterprise on the relationship network, a risk propagation model is applied to quantify a risk propagation process and risk strength, and risk evaluation of a main body to be listed is achieved.
assignees: UNIV XIAN SCI & TECHNOLOGY

abstract_en: RQD based on laser scanning, BQ and optimal threshold t Anisotropy solving method, belonging to RQD t The field of anisotropy resolution, comprising the steps of: (1) three-dimensional laser scanning of the structural surface is rapidly acquired; (2) Drawing a structural plane polar diagram and a trend rose diagram; (3) calculating the rock mass based on the BQ index; (4) generating and sectioning a rock three-dimensional fracture network model; (5) RQD t Drawing an anisotropy map; (6) solving method of optimal threshold t based on BQ inversion; (7) RQD t And (3) an anisotropy solving method. abstract_en: RQD based on three-dimensional laser scanning and BQ inversion t The optimal threshold t solving method belongs to RQD t The optimal threshold value t solving field comprises the following steps: (1) three-dimensional laser scanning of the structural surface is rapidly acquired; (2) knotDrawing a texture polar point diagram and a trend rose diagram; (3) calculating the rock mass based on the BQ index; (4) generating and sectioning a rock three-dimensional fracture network model; (5) RQD t Drawing an anisotropy map; (6) and solving the optimal threshold t based on BQ inversion. title_en: Power distribution room equipment state online intelligent monitoring system and method based on embedded GPU platform and deep learning
abstract_en: The monitoring equipment uploads image data of the state of the power distribution room equipment to the embedded GPU platform in a video stream mode in real time, an equipment state recognition model which is deployed in the platform and constructed based on a deep learning technology analyzes and monitors the uploaded data, and a detection result and a monitoring picture are displayed on a Web interface. The invention realizes the online intelligent monitoring of the state of the equipment in the power distribution room, finds the equipment which is not normally operated in time by identifying the on-off image of the equipment indicator lamp and gives an alarm. The invention uses the improved Cascade R-CNN deep learning algorithm, reduces the external influence, has more stable operation and greatly improves the identification precision: the method can accurately identify the target in the monitoring range, and provides powerful technical support for guaranteeing the safety of power grid constructors.

title_en: Power distribution network edge side load prediction method based on k-nearest neighbor mutual information feature simplification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network edge side load prediction method based on k-nearest neighbor mutual information feature simplification, which establishes a load prediction training and verification data set through preprocessing modes such as complementing missing values, performing independent heat coding on weather date types and the like, and then performing forward and backward propagation training on a daily total load prediction cyclic neural network; after the total daily load is predicted, estimating mutual information between the multidimensional input vector and the multidimensional output vector, performing feature selection to simplify operation and save edge calculation energy consumption, and taking weather and date data after feature simplification, the total daily load and time-sharing load data as a new data sample to train a time-sharing load prediction network; and finally, inputting the relevant information of the predicted day into a time-sharing load prediction network after training is completed to obtain the total daily load and the time-sharing load predicted value of a certain day in the area. The method is simplified integrally, improves the efficiency of the edge computing task in the area to a certain extent, and perfects the edge computing architecture of the power distribution Internet of things.

title_en: Urban rail transit epidemic propagation risk quantitative evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for quantitatively evaluating urban rail transit epidemic propagation risks, which comprise the following steps: taking each urban rail transit station as a center, acquiring cell distribution data of peripheral traffic hubs, hospitals and confirmed or suspected cases; calculating station-level epidemic propagation risks of all stations according to the passenger flow congestion degree of urban rail transit stations, distribution data of peripheral traffic hubs, hospitals and districts with confirmed or suspected cases and corresponding input risk values; calculating the line level epidemic propagation risk passing through each station according to the station level epidemic propagation risk of each station; and calculating the overall network epidemic propagation risk of the rail transit line according to the station level epidemic propagation risk of each station. The invention comprehensively considers factors such as land property and passenger flow scale around the site, establishes a dynamic quantitative evaluation method for the propagation risk of the point-line-network multi-level integrated urban rail transit system, and provides quantitative basis for the refined and normalized epidemic situation prevention and control.
assignees: JINAN RAIL TRANSIT GROUP CO LTD;BEIJIAO INTELLIGENCE SHANDONG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for providing situation propagation platform to strengthen disaster response capabilities
title_ko: 재난 대응역량 강화를 위한 상황전파 플랫폼 제공 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for providing a situation propagation platform to strengthen disaster response capabilities, which supports a site-centered customized disaster response system, and an apparatus thereof. According to the present invention, the method comprises the following steps: establishing a standard operation procedure for collaboration functions for each type of disaster; in response to the occurrence of a disaster situation, receiving a selection for the collaboration function to generate a task management process for managing the standard operation procedure; when the task management process is started, activating the uniquely assigned emergency contact network function and situation propagation function, respectively, tracking a situation propagation target′s access to an emergency contact network in real-time, and monitoring transmission and reception status between the situation propagation targets; and generating and providing a checklist on standard response tasks to the situation propagation targets based on the standard operation procedure in accordance with the flow of situation propagation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난 대응역량 강화를 위한 상황전파 플랫폼 제공 방법 및 장치에 관한 것으로, 상기 방법은 재난 유형 별로 협업기능에 관한 표준운영절차(Standard Operation Procedure)를 구축하는 단계; 재난 상황의 발생에 따라 상기 협업기능에 관한 선택을 수신하여 상기 표준운영절차의 관리를 위한 업무관리 프로세스를 생성하는 단계; 상기 업무관리 프로세스가 개시되면 고유 할당되는 비상연락망 기능 및 상황전파 기능을 각각 활성화하고, 상황전파 대상자들의 상기 비상연락망에 대한 접속상황을 실시간 추적하며 상기 상황전파 대상자들 간의 송·수신 상태를 모니터링 하는 단계; 및 상기 표준운영절차를 기초로 상황전파의 흐름에 따라 상기 상황전파 대상자에게 표준대응업무에 관한 체크리스트를 생성하여 제공하는 단계를 포함한다.
assignees: 4STEC INC

title_en: Method for evaluating and improving vulnerability of electricity-gas comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating and improving the vulnerability of an electricity-gas integrated energy system. Establishing a network topological structure of the electricity-gas comprehensive energy system; simulating the initial fault of the system by using a Monte Carlo algorithm according to a given initial fault proportion to obtain the initial running state of the system; establishing a fault propagation model of the electric-gas integrated energy system to obtain a fault propagation seepage equation; continuously iterating the seepage equation according to the fault propagation termination condition until the fault propagation termination condition is met to obtain the final running state of the system; and establishing vulnerability parameters of the electric-gas integrated energy system, calculating to obtain the vulnerability result of the electric-gas integrated energy system, and implementing improvement. The method can quickly evaluate and obtain the vulnerability result of the electric-gas integrated energy system, find the weak link of the electric-gas integrated energy system, and inhibit the propagation of the fault in the system by taking measures, thereby effectively improving the vulnerability of the electric-gas integrated energy system and reducing the probability of large-area breakdown of the system.

title_en: Analysis method for fault propagation of urban rail train system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a fault propagation analysis method of an urban rail train system based on a disaster spreading propagation dynamics model, which comprises the following steps: step S110, constructing a topological network model of the urban rail train system; step S120, dividing a network community structure for the urban rail train system according to the topological network model of the urban rail train system; step S130, determining the service life distribution and the fault probability of each node in the topological network of the urban rail train system; step S140: and establishing a fault propagation model of the urban rail train system based on a disaster spreading propagation dynamic model by combining the network community structure of the urban rail train system and the fault probability of the node, and analyzing the possible fault propagation state of the urban rail train system.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG

title_en: Blind fast network synchronization algorithm for reducing LTE public safety product costs
abstract_en: Systems and methods are provided for providing blind fast network synchronization for reducing LTE public safety products costs, comprising, in one embodiment: determining if location setup is required to mitigate timing offset due to propagation delay from the synchronization source and adjusting downlink timing, and when location setup is required then providing one of manual setup in terms of timing samples, limited power RACH based on SIB2 parameters, and based on observed time difference of arrival and position reference signal; coordinating network listening periods based on graphs and hash function to avoid common silence for two or more neighboring eNodeBs; and providing continuous synchronization using blind carrier estimation.
assignees: PARALLEL WIRELESS INC

title_en: Multifunctional complementary combined cooling heating and power micro-grid framework and modeling method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-energy complementary combined cooling heating and power micro-grid framework and a modeling method thereof. The invention relates to the technical field of a multi-energy complementary combined cooling heating and power micro-grid, in the multi-energy complementary micro-grid, a comprehensive energy network system which integrates various energy supply equipment, loads, energy conversion devices, cooling, heating and power energy storage devices and the like and is provided with a protection device is provided. The multi-energy complementary micro-grid can supply various energy sources such as cold, heat, electricity and the like at the same time, and different energy sources can be mutually converted or utilized in a cascade mode, so that the energy utilization efficiency in the region is improved to the greatest extent. Compared with the energy supply mode of the traditional microgrid, the multi-energy complementary microgrid has obvious advantages.
assignees: STATE GRID HEILONGJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;HARBIN INST TECHNOLOGY;INDUSTRIAL TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF HEILONGJIANG PROVINCE;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power demand prediction method based on multi-dimensional gray-neural network hybrid coordination
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power demand prediction method based on multi-dimensional gray-neural network hybrid coordination, which comprises the following steps: forming a multi-dimensional grey prediction model by taking the power demand original data sequence E as a characteristic sequence and taking the key influence factor sequence as a related factor sequence; accumulating the power demand data sequence and the related factor sequence to generate a new sequence, estimating the new sequence by using a least square method to obtain a prediction result sequence E of the total power demand DM (ii) a Obtaining E and E DM Residual error epsilon between the two, and B-P back propagation network prediction is carried out on epsilon sequence to obtain epsilon AN (ii) a Obtaining epsilon and epsilon AN Of a sequence of differences epsilon 2 With historical power demand residual sequence ε 2 B-P back propagation network prediction is carried out as the sequence of influencing factors, and the result is epsilon 2AN (ii) a Will E DM 、ε AN 、ε 2AN And adding to obtain a prediction result sequence. The invention can make up the deficiency of a single prediction algorithm and can consider a plurality of key factors simultaneously.
assignees: STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Edge coupling-based dependent network seepage analysis method and analysis system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of complex network seepage phase change behavior analysis, and discloses a dependent network seepage analysis method and an analysis system based on edge coupling, wherein the dependent network seepage analysis method based on edge coupling comprises the following steps: constructing an edge-edge dependent network model; establishing a theoretical analysis frame of the edge-edge dependent network model by adopting a self-balancing probability theory; and analyzing the seepage phase change behavior and the seepage threshold of other edge dependent network models under the condition of facing random failure based on the constructed theoretical analysis framework. The method adopts a self-balancing probability theory to establish a theoretical analysis frame of the model, can directly write out a state equation after the system is stable without tracking the cascade failure process, and has the advantages of intuition and conciseness. The method analyzes the phase change behavior and the seepage threshold value of the model under the condition of random failure based on the theoretical framework, and has a reusing meaning for understanding the robustness of the edge coupling network in the real world.
assignees: UNIV EAST CHINA JIAOTONG

title_en: BP neural network-based heating unit peak regulation upper limit evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat supply unit peak regulation upper limit evaluation method and system based on a BP neural network. And then, establishing a neural network evaluation model, and reducing the error of calculating the peak shaving upper limit to the maximum extent by means of the self-learning and error back propagation characteristics of the BP neural network model, so that the more objective and accurate peak shaving upper limit can be obtained. The whole evaluation process can not influence normal heat supply and power supply, and the workload and the consumed time are relatively small.

title_en: Multi-parameter joint prediction method based on grid neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grid neural network-based multi-parameter joint prediction method, which comprises the following steps: step 1, normalizing K-order measurement points by a dispersion standardization method to obtain a data representation X; step 2, extracting prediction parameters of X through an LSTM network, wherein the LSTM is trained by adopting a counter-propagation algorithm along time, h t‑k For implicit expression, including And the hidden state of the previous layer being used as the next layerInputting to form a prediction characteristic depth excavation structure; step 3, adjusting the weight of an output layer of the feedforward neural network by taking the incidence relation among the characteristic quantities extracted in the step 2 as an initial parameter, taking the feedforward neural network as a reasoning prediction layer, and outputting a prediction result; and 4, testing the state quantity of the future moment in the test set according to the prediction parameters obtained by the training data, and verifying the prediction precision. The invention can monitor the running state of the power equipment by using the multivariate data collected on line.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Subway passenger flow regulation and control plan compilation method based on demand evolution and flow propagation
abstract_en: The invention provides a subway passenger flow regulation and control plan compiling method based on demand evolution and flow propagation, which comprises the following steps of: fusing multi-source automatic fare collection data, and extracting distribution characteristics of current commuting travel demands; according to the utility perception principle of the commuter on the passenger flow regulation and control measures, constructing a commuter departure time adjustment and trip mode transfer behavior NL model, embedding the NL model into a random user balanced distribution model, and predicting demand evolution characteristics under the passenger flow regulation and control measures; constructing a flow propagation model covering the whole travel link, and calculating the net transport energy utilization rate and the passenger delay balance degree under passenger flow regulation and control measures by using the flow propagation model and the demand evolution characteristics; and constructing a subway line network passenger flow regulation plan double-layer planning model, and outputting an optimal passenger flow regulation plan with balanced transportation energy utilization and delay balance. According to the invention, the influence mechanism of the passenger flow regulation and control measures on the individual behaviors of the commuters is revealed through big data, so that the accurate control of the controlled group scale and the regulation and control effect is realized.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG

title_en: Central monitoring system for detecting dangerous substances
title_ko: 위험물 유출 중앙 감지시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a central system for dangerous substance outflow detection. According to the present invention, a plurality of dangerous substance outflow warning means installed at dangerous facilities nationwide and terminal means of workers at the dangerous facilities are connected to one central control center using a communication network. Dangerous substance outflow information from the warning means and the terminal means is gathered to determine the presence or absence of dangerous substance outflow. Then, an automatic shutoff facility can be put into operation or a worker can take a countermeasure such as accident notification and evacuation and on-site dispatch for confirmation, accident response, and restoration. According to the present invention, a decrease in costs for constructing the facility can be achieved, a problem attributable to sensor malfunction can be solved, and an accident can be responded early and quick restoration can be performed by the dispatched facility worker even if the automatic shut-off facility does not work due to a malfunction. Those other than the worker can quickly evacuate the dangerous facility and damage to the accident can be minimized.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전국 각지에 산재한 위험 시설물에 설치된 복수의 위험물 유출 경보수단 및 상기 위험 시설물에 근무하는 근무자들이 휴대하는 단말수단을 통신망으로 하나의 중앙관제센터에 연결하고, 상기 경보수단 및 단말수단으로부터 통보되는 위험물 유출정보를 종합하여 위험물 유출 여부를 판정하며, 그에 따라 자동 차단설비의 작동을 지시하거나 근무자에게 확인, 사고 수습 및 복구를 위한 현장 출동, 사고 전파 및 대피 등의 대응조치를 취하도록 구성된 위험물 유출 중앙 감지시스템을 제공함으로써, 첫째 설비 구축비용이 감소하고, 둘째 센서의 오작동에 따른 문제가 해소되며, 셋째 자동 차단설비가 고장으로 작동하지 않더라도 해당 시설 근무자가 신속히 출동하여 조기에 사고를 수습하고 긴급히 복구하며, 기타 인원들은 위험 시설물로부터 신속히 대피할 수 있도록 함으로써 사고 피해를 최소화할 수 있는 효과가 있다.
assignees: YOO JONG GEUN

title_en: Quality control and data processing system for observation data of surface ocean current
title_ko: 표층해수유동 관측자료의 실시간 품질관리와 자료처리를 수행하는 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device for real-time quality management and data processing of surface seawater flow observation data, which analyzes a signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) data and determines seasonal or long-term tendency characteristics of received waves for an observed sea area to determine whether to use Level 1 data, calculates an ensemble average again in a Level 1 stage except for defective data, and reproduces Level 2 and Level 3 data from low-level data through real-time QC, thus to be utilized in various fields such as pollutant (waste oil outflow, red tide, etc.) diffusion and human life search and rescue through more accurate predicted-tidal current generation and to provide various public services. According to the present invention, the device for real-time quality management and data processing of surface seawater flow observation data comprises a remote seawater flow observation unit, a central server, and a manager terminal, and the remote seawater flow observation unit comprises an HF Radar, a remote seawater flow observation server, and a communication network.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 신호대 잡음 비(SNR : Signal to Noise Ratio)의 분석 및 관측 해역에 대한 수신 전파의 계절적 또는 장기 경향 특성을 파악하여 Level 1 자료의 사용 여부를 판단하고, Level 1 단계에서 불량 자료를 제외하고 평균(Ensemble Average)을 다시 하며, Level 2 및 Level 3 자료를 하위 수준의 자료부터 실시간의 QC를 통해 재생산함으로써, 보다 정확한 조류예측생산(predicted-tidal current generation)을 통해 오염물질(쓰레기 유류유출, 적조 등) 확산, 인명 수색 구조 등 여러 분야에서 활용되면서 다양한 대국민 서비스가 가능할 수 있도록 하는 표층해수유동 관측자료의 실시간 품질관리와 자료처리장치에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명에 따른 표층해수유동 관측자료의 실시간 품질관리와 자료처리장치는 해수유동 원격 관측부, 중앙서버 및 관리자 단말기를 포함하여 구성되고, 상기 해수유동 원격 관측부는 HF Radar, 해수유동 관측 원격서버 및 통신망을 포함하여 구성된다.
assignees: KIM CHANG SOO

title_en: Power system parallel recovery partitioning method based on label propagation algorithm and game theory
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of parallel recovery of power systems, and particularly discloses a parallel recovery partitioning method for a power system based on a label propagation algorithm and a game theory, which comprises the following steps: edge weight B for initializing power system after power failure ij Node weight C i A weighted adjacency matrix W and a partition discrimination matrix F; initiating cooperative game league C g ＝F 0 ，F 0 An initial partition discrimination matrix which is a partition discrimination matrix F; and updating the labels of the nodes in the initial network based on a label propagation algorithm until the partition discrimination matrix F converges, and outputting a node set of each subsystem of the power system during convergence. The invention comprehensively considers the network topology structure and system of the power gridAccording to the practical characteristics of the system, a partitioning method based on a label propagation algorithm and a cooperative game theory is provided, the partitioning problem of the nodes is decided by calculating a Shapley value according to the relation between the nodes and the subsystems, partitioning constraints are embedded in an iteration process, and a partitioning scheme meeting the requirements of equivalent subsystem scale, compact internal structure, power balance and the like is quickly obtained.
assignees: UNIV GUANGXI

title_en: Power grid cascading failure risk assessment method considering relay protection refusal influence
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid cascading failure risk assessment method considering the relay protection refusal influence, and belongs to the technical field of power grid operation risk assessment. The method comprises the following steps: s1, selecting a target system, considering the influence of the running environment and running state of the relay protection equipment, and establishing a failure probability model of the relay protection equipment; s2, obtaining the action rejection probability of each relay protection device in the target system according to the action rejection probability model of the relay protection device established in S1; s3, obtaining the state probability of the target system according to the primary failure probability of the target system and the action rejection probability of each relay protection device; and S4, performing risk assessment on the cascading failure of the target system according to the improved state space segmentation method.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Method for predicting reliability of offshore wind turbine generator system facing manufacturing process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting the reliability of an offshore wind turbine generator system facing a manufacturing process, which establishes a membership function between a manufacturing process capability index and a fault mode occurrence probability on the basis of analyzing the manufacturing process capability index of key parts of each subsystem of the offshore wind turbine generator system; by analyzing the fault propagation influence among the subsystems, parts and fault modes of the offshore wind turbine generator system, a reliability prediction network model of the offshore wind turbine generator system is constructed, the sensitivity index of the reliability minimum cut set of each fault mode to the reliability of the offshore wind turbine generator system is analyzed, and the influence degree of the actual manufacturing process to the reliability of the offshore wind turbine generator system is further quantized; on the basis, primary and secondary fault modes of each subsystem are identified, and the inherent reliability of the offshore wind turbine generator is predicted by taking the reliability and the correlation of the primary and secondary fault modes of each subsystem as input under the condition of considering the current manufacturing process by adopting an improved second-order narrow limit theory.
assignees: HUANENG YANCHENG DAFENG NEW ENERGY POWER GENERATION CO LTD;XIAN THERMAL POWER RES INST CO;JIANGSU CLEANING ENERGY BRANCH OF HUANENG POWER INTL INC

title_en: Method for determining real-time alarm for local target earthquake early warning using mechanical learning
title_ko: 기계학습을 이용한 지역대상 지진조기경보를 위한 실시간 경보 결정 방법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a method for an early warning of a local target earthquake by using machine learning by collecting seismic observation data from seismic observatories of a seismic observation network in real time to detect a P wave propagating from an epicenter, and advancing an alarm time point as much as possible and minimizing a false alarm when issuing a warning about an analysis result based on the machine learning includes: detecting the P wave arriving at an observatory close to the epicenter (S100); calculating an earthquake motion observation value for a predetermined time period before and after an arrival time point of the detected P wave (S200); calculating a feature vector from the earthquake motion observation value to determine whether the P wave is a P wave generated from an earthquake by classification through a machine learning model trained in advance (S300); calculating a characteristic value of the P wave from the earthquake motion observation value to predict a maximum earthquake motion magnitude at an observation point through a maximum earthquake motion prediction formula, and determining whether a prediction result is greater than or equal to an alarm criterion (S400); detecting a P wave arriving at another seismic observatory of the seismic observation network during or immediately after the steps S100 to S400 (S500); determining whether an observed position of the P wave detected at another seismic observatory falls within a predetermined distance section from an observation position of the observatory close to the epicenter (S600); determining whether an arrival time of the P wave detected at another seismic observatory falls within a predetermined time interval before and after the arrival time of the P wave that is initially detected (S700); and determining issuance of an early warning for an earthquake by using a determination result (S800).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 기계학습을 이용한 지역대상 지진조기경보를 위해 지진관측망의 지진관측소들에서 실시간으로 지진 관측자료를 수집하여 진원으로부터 전파되는 P파를 탐지하고 기계학습을 기반으로 분석한 결과를 경보할 때, 경보 시점을 최대한 앞당기고, 오경보를 최소화하는 방법으로서, 진원으로부터 가까운 관측소에 P파가 도달하여 탐지하는 단계(S100); 상기 탐지된 P파의 도달 시점을 기준으로 전후 일정 시간 구간에 대한 지진동 관측값을 산출하는 단계(S200); 상기 지진동 관측값으로부터 특징 벡터를 산출하여 사전에 학습된 기계학습 모델을 통한 분류로 지진으로부터 발생한 P파인지 판정하는 단계(S300); 상기 지진동 관측값으로부터 P파의 특성값을 산출하여 최대 지진동 예측식을 통해 관측 지점의 최대 지진동 크기를 예측하고, 예측 결과가 경보 기준 이상인지 판정하는 단계(S400); 상기 단계(S100 내지 S400)가 진행되는 동안 또는 직후 지진관측망의 다른 지진관측소에 P파가 도달하여 탐지하는 단계(S500); 상기 다른 지진관측소에서 탐지된 P파의 관측 위치가 상기 진원으로부터 가까운 관측소의 관측 위치와 일정 거리 구간 내에 속하는지 판정하는 단계(S600); 상기 다른 지진관측소에서 탐지된 P파의 도달 시점이 최초 탐지된 P파의 도달 시점을 기준으로 전후 일정 시간 구간 내에 속하는지 판정하는 단계(S700); 및 상기 판정 결과를 이용하여 지진조기경보의 발령을 결정하는 단계(S800); 를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: KITVALLEY CO LTD

title_en: Electric-gas region comprehensive energy system elasticity evaluation method based on heterogeneous dependency network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an elasticity evaluation method of an electricity-gas region comprehensive energy system based on a heterogeneous dependency network, which comprises the steps of 1) constructing an elasticity index system of the electricity-gas region comprehensive energy system from two dimensions including fragility and restoring force facing the elasticity of extreme events, wherein the elasticity index system comprises 5 indexes for quantifying the elasticity of the electricity-gas region comprehensive energy system and each elasticity index is defined in a complex form; 2) establishing a heterogeneous dependency network model of the electric-gas region comprehensive energy system, converting the heterogeneous dependency network model into a double-layer digraph, and calculating values of 5 indexes; 3) and determining the weights of the 5 indexes by using a geometric mean G1-entropy weight method, and calculating to obtain a comprehensive elasticity value of the system to realize the elasticity evaluation of the comprehensive energy system in the electricity-gas region. The method considers the dependency and heterogeneity of the power grid and the natural gas grid, facilitates fault propagation analysis, considers the subjective and objective weights of the indexes, and can scientifically and effectively quantify and evaluate the elasticity of the electric-gas regional comprehensive energy system.
assignees: UNIV XIANGTAN

title_en: Direct current transmission simulation platform based on RTDS
abstract_en: An RTDS-based direct current transmission simulation platform, comprising: the system comprises an operator control layer, a field layer and an RTDS simulator; the operator control layer is connected with the control layer through an in-station local area network and transmits a control instruction to the control layer; the control layer is connected with the field layer and transmits the command of the switching action and the information of the switching state, the alternating current quantity and the direct current quantity to the field layer; the field layer is connected with the RTDS simulation layer, converts the optical signal of the RTDS simulation layer into an electric signal and sends the electric signal to the control layer; the RTDS simulator comprises a layered access simulation subsystem and a hybrid cascade simulation subsystem, and switching between the layered access simulation subsystem and the hybrid cascade simulation subsystem is realized by selecting DFTs in different engineering original files. The simulation platform reasonably distributes the functions of the pole control layer and the valve group layer of the control system, improves the expansibility of a control system device, achieves the purpose of being applied to a conventional direct current simulation system and a hybrid cascade simulation system, and saves the test research cost and the reconstruction cost.
assignees: XUJI GROUP CORP;XUJI ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Building energy consumption prediction method based on longicorn stigma optimization algorithm and neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building energy consumption prediction method based on a longicorn stigma optimization algorithm and a neural network, which comprises the following four main steps: 1) collecting building energy consumption related data, and performing principal component analysis and normalization pretreatment on the data; 2) determining input and output items and a network structure of a multi-layer feedforward neural network model with an error back propagation learning function; 3) optimizing the connection weight and the threshold of the BP network by using a longicorn algorithm; 4) and carrying out short-term prediction on the building electric power energy consumption by using the BAS-BP prediction model obtained by optimization. The method utilizes the principal component analysis algorithm to carry out principal component analysis on the pre-input variables, and selects the variables meeting the principal component extraction requirement, thereby reducing the input dimension; and optimizing the structure and parameters of the neural network model by using the global optimization capability of the longicorn algorithm. Compared with the existing building energy consumption prediction method, the prediction model provided by the invention has the advantages of simple structure, high prediction precision, short operation time and the like.
assignees: JIANGSU POLYTECHNIC COLLEGE AGRICULTURE & FORESTRY
