title_en: Wind power prediction method based on secondary modal decomposition and cascade deep learning
abstract_en: The application discloses a wind power prediction method based on secondary modal decomposition and cascade deep learning, which comprises the steps of firstly acquiring original wind power data and wind speed data, preprocessing the acquired data, decomposing the wind power and wind speed time sequence into a series of relatively stable subsequences by using the secondary modal decomposition, carrying out effective modal decomposition on the wind power signal, then extracting implicit characteristics of a coupling relation between the time subsequences generated by decomposition and the wind speed by using a convolutional neural network-gated circulation unit prediction model (CNN-GRU), further extracting time correlation among the time subsequences, and finally outputting a predicted value of the wind power.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Intelligent power grid economic dispatching method based on integrated neural network
abstract_en: An integrated neural network-based intelligent power grid economic dispatching method is used for acquiring power generation parameters of a power grid system, wherein the power generation parameters comprise power generation cost functions of all power generators in the system and upper and lower limits of the load of the power generators; generating a large data set using an existing optimal non-convex optimization algorithm; constructing a deep neural network named as EDNet by using a current data set, and learning data in the data set through a back propagation technology to enable the output of the network to gradually approach an output part in the data set; fine-tuning the output of the EDNet by using a fine-tuning algorithm to obtain an optimal solution which strictly meets the problem constraint; using AdaboosSequentially training M EDNet by using the t.R2 algorithm as a training strategy, and parallelly arranging the M EDNet to form E 2 DNet; and selecting the solution with the minimum power generation cost from the M optimal solutions as the optimal solution of the whole integrated network. To be trained completely E 2 DNet is put into use, and economic dispatching problems of the smart grid are processed on line.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Power grid adaptability evaluation analysis method considering access of step power station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid adaptability evaluation analysis method considering access of a cascade power station, which comprises six steps of determining an evaluation index set and a comment set; obtaining an index matrix and standardizing the matrix; calculating the entropy weight of the index matrix, determining a subjective weight set, and determining a comprehensive weight set of the index matrix according to the entropy weight and the subjective weight set; constructing a fuzzy evaluation matrix; determining the membership degree of a comment set corresponding to an access scheme; and evaluating the access scheme by utilizing the comment with the highest membership degree in the comment set. The invention establishes a power grid evaluation system from adaptability indexes of a power supply and a power grid respectively, and comprehensively evaluates a planning scheme of rolling development of the cascade power station and accessing the power grid by adopting an evaluation method based on a fuzzy entropy weight method on the basis, thereby embodying the characteristics of realizing safe, economic and reliable operation of the power grid and the degree of consumption of the cascade power station.
assignees: SOUTHWEST BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA;UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Electric power information physical system modeling method based on alternating current power flow model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for modeling a power information physical system based on an alternating current power flow model, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: the method comprises the steps of power network modeling, information network modeling and interaction flow of the power network and the information network, and the modeling of the power information physical system is realized by considering the load flow characteristic of the power network and the monitoring and control function of the information network. Compared with a modeling method based on a complex network theory, the method provided by the invention can better reflect the dynamic characteristics of the power grid, and the optimal economic dispatching algorithm adopted by the information grid not only meets the supply and demand balance of the power system, but also considers the economic operation of the system, can quantitatively reflect the influence of various parameter changes of the power information physical system on the system, and can be widely applied to the fields of safety analysis, cascading failure propagation process, vulnerability assessment and the like of the power information physical system. Has the advantages of scientific and reasonable method, strong applicability, good effect and the like.
assignees: UNIV NORTHEAST ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Method for analyzing coupling rule of wind farm harmonic waves in power grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for analyzing the coupling rule of wind farm harmonic waves in a power grid, which comprises the following steps: step one: detecting parameters of wind power plant harmonic waves based on a windowed interpolation FFT algorithm, and obtaining images and waveforms of the harmonic waves; step two: when n harmonic couplings exist at a certain node of the power grid, constructing a harmonic coupling expression; analyzing influence factors of harmonic wave propagation in a power grid; establishing a harmonic coupling simulation model of the power system containing the wind power plant, simulating, displaying waveforms of the harmonic coupling expressions in the second step, and analyzing simulation results through influence factors in the second step. And the specific rule of coupling the harmonic waves of different wind power stations on the power grid is obtained by coupling the harmonic waves generated by different wind power stations on the power grid through model simulation, and finally, guidance can be provided for power grid dispatching.

title_en: Intelligent auxiliary overhaul flow analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent auxiliary overhaul flow analysis method and system, comprising the following steps: analyzing the influence factors of the overhaul, taking an analysis service communication channel as a main line, completing multiple analyses, and analyzing each link one by one to obtain the influence range in the overhaul; according to the fault influence service analyzed before overhaul, the current running state of the overhaul influence service is analyzed one by combining with the real-time alarm of the current network manager, and whether overhaul starts or ends is determined; based on the completed overhaul project, analyzing the collected alarm information generated by overhaul, comparing the project plan to judge the execution condition of the project, automatically producing an alarm comparison report, obtaining a working operation quality report, and completing the overhaul flow analysis. According to the invention, an overhaul decision maker is assisted to quickly and comprehensively determine the overhaul influence range, and data support is provided for overhaul decision making; the maintenance implementation personnel are assisted to know the real-time situation, and unplanned service interruption is avoided; and carrying out post-analysis on the quality of the overhaul engineering.

title_en: Interconnected micro-grid layered distributed optimization scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention provides a hierarchical distributed optimal scheduling method for an interconnected micro-grid, which comprises the following steps: s1, establishing a cloud-edge cooperative interconnected micro-grid operation communication framework; s2, constructing an optimized scheduling model of an interconnected micro-grid system with the upper layer cooperatively interacting with a large power grid; s3, constructing a microgrid operator economic dispatching model for processing source load uncertainty at a lower layer; s4, decoupling an optimized scheduling model of the interconnected micro-grid system and an economic scheduling model of a micro-grid operator based on a target cascade method, and establishing a decoupled distributed optimized scheduling model of the interconnected micro-grid system to enable the system to calculate and operate in a distributed mode; s5, carrying out parallel solution on the distributed optimized scheduling model of the interconnected micro-grid system; and S6, performing distributed optimal scheduling control on the interconnected micro-grid system based on the result obtained by the solution in the step S5. The invention can realize the cooperative interaction between the interconnected micro-grid system and the large power grid, reduce the influence of renewable energy and load fluctuation on the system scheduling operation, support the local privacy protection of micro-grid operators and improve the system operation calculation efficiency.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: Dynamic parameter identification method and device for power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for identifying dynamic parameters of a power distribution network. The method comprises the following steps: preprocessing the collected operation data of the power distribution network and the external environment data to generate a dynamic parameter identification sample of the power distribution network; discretizing a dynamic parameter identification sample of the power distribution network to obtain a discretized sample; based on a pre-established probability map model, acquiring parameters of the probability map model according to the discretized sample; the probability map model is a two-time slice probability map model; and acquiring dynamic parameters of the power distribution network based on a confidence propagation algorithm according to the observation variables and the probability map model after acquiring the parameters. According to the method, the dynamic parameters of the power distribution network can be deduced by utilizing the probability graph model under the condition that part of measured data or external environment data are missing, and the method is beneficial to improving the parameter identification precision under the condition that part of power distribution area operation modes are suddenly changed or external environment is suddenly changed.

title_en: Power grid GIS-based electric power emergency disposal safety pre-control intelligent identification method
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid GIS-based electric power emergency disposal safety pre-control intelligent identification method, and relates to the field of electric power emergency disposal. The invention positions the accident scene and the position of emergency disposal personnel on the power grid GIS. Positioning on a power grid GIS according to longitude and latitude coordinates of an accident scene; according to the method, real-time positions are displayed on a power grid GIS by wearing a follow-up terminal high-precision multi-relocation module by emergency disposal personnel, an early warning identification area is divided and constructed through monitoring and early warning of the emergency disposal site environment, after a site operation electronic fence is automatically generated based on the early warning identification area, a small-scale mountain fire and hazardous chemical substance diffusion and propagation model is established according to meteorological data, topographic data, geomorphic data and the like, the development trend is dynamically predicted, calculation results of dynamic and quantitative diffusion and propagation directions, ranges, speeds and the like are formed, the influence condition of the analysis and judgment on power grid facilities is analyzed, and a basis is provided for scientific and rapid emergency disposal of accident sites. The invention reduces the working pressure of the central platform, improves the disaster and area division accuracy, and can store the data acquired when the disaster occurs.
assignees: EMERGENCY MAN CENTER OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Power grid vulnerability analysis method based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid vulnerability analysis method based on reinforcement learning, and relates to the technical field of power system safety. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, establishing a reinforcement learning model and a power grid cascading fault model, and simultaneously setting a certain proportion of circuits as key circuits; then, selecting a group of non-key lines in the power grid to be sequentially removed by using a reinforcement learning model according to the state of the power grid cascading fault model, recording the states of the power grid before and after line removal, optimizing parameters of the reinforcement learning model by taking maximum power grid damage as a target, and repeating the steps for a plurality of rounds; and finally, obtaining the attack sequence and the maximum damage which can be caused by sequential attack and can enable the power grid to be damaged to the maximum when part of the key lines cannot be removed. The method fully considers the condition that partial elements of the power grid are additionally protected in the actual scene, and improves the search efficiency of the optimal attack sequence by using the reinforcement learning method.

title_en: Multi-attribute important node evaluation and planning method for power grid
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system automation, and particularly relates to a multi-attribute important node evaluation and planning method for a power grid. The invention comprises the following steps: establishing a complex network topology diagram of a dependent network by collecting data of a target information physical fusion system; establishing a fault propagation model for the dependent network, and calculating the influence of the information node on the physical system and the information system after being attacked; respectively establishing the condition numbers of the information nodes and the physical nodes, and respectively evaluating the vulnerability of the information nodes according to the failure difficulty of the information nodes; according to the topological structure of the complex network, the hub degree of the information node is evaluated by taking the intermediate degree center degree and the degree center degree of the node as hub degree indexes; and reasonably planning the nodes according to influencing factors in the node importance index to improve the risk resistance of the cps. The invention provides a new view for the safety analysis and protection method research of the power grid cps, and provides a basis for planning and defending deployment of power grid nodes.

title_en: Mid-term peak regulation scheduling method for cascade reservoir group coupled with water flow time lag
abstract_en: The invention provides a cascade reservoir medium-term peak regulation scheduling method coupled with water flow delay aiming at frequent fluctuation of power grid daytime load and complex hydraulic connection of a cascade reservoir group. Firstly, constructing a multi-target model of power grid medium-term dispatching by using the targets of optimal power grid peak regulation and maximum cascade power generation capacity; then, a middle-stage segmental water flow delay description method and a parameter determination method are provided based on a water quantity balance principle, and a calculation method of scheduling period and delay period cascade comprehensive benefits under the influence of water flow delay is determined according to the middle-stage segmental water flow delay description method and the parameter determination method; and finally, fitting complex nonlinear constraints in the model by using a polynomial. The calculation result of taking the 11-seat cascade hydropower station in the laneway river as a research object shows that the calculation result of the method is more consistent with the actual operation condition by introducing the water flow time-lag factor, so that the scheduling plan deviation influenced by the hysteresis is effectively reduced, the water and electricity utilization benefit is improved, and the method has a good medium-term peak regulation effect.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO;UNIV DALIAN TECH

title_en: Integrated moving average autoregression-back propagation neural network prediction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an integrated moving average autoregressive-back propagation neural network prediction method, which provides a two-step modeling principle, refines the interior of a prediction model into a basic model and a correction model, selects an ARIMA model to carry out initial prediction on data, carries out secondary correction on errors by a BP model, and weakens error fluctuation through secondary modeling to achieve the aim of accurate prediction. The method realizes accurate fitting of various data, can flexibly process the data prediction problem with short-term fluctuation characteristics, expands the application range of the prediction field, greatly improves the prediction accuracy compared with the traditional prediction method, and provides a method for providing reference for decision makers in the energy field.
assignees: UNIV CHINA PETROLEUM EAST CHINA

title_en: Malignant data injection attack defense method based on multi-stage dynamic game
abstract_en: The invention provides a malignant data injection attack defense method based on multi-stage dynamic gaming, and relates to the technical field of power information physical systems. The method comprises the steps of firstly regarding a game process as a double game participated by both the attack and the defense, and regarding one action of both the attack and the defense as one stage of the attack and the defense game process; calculating node centrality to represent importance of different nodes of the power grid, taking the node centrality as a weight vector, and calculating the optimal load reduction amount of the power grid as benefits of both attack and defense parties; then calculating seepage propagation probability of malignant data propagated among grid nodes, and establishing a multi-stage attack and defense game model; finally, based on an improved Q learning algorithm, introducing different learning rates in each game stage, redefining a maximum profit calculation formula of both attack and defense parties, solving Nash equilibrium solutions in each game stage, judging whether the total stage gamma of attack and defense game prediction is reached, and if so, obtaining an optimal defense strategy; otherwise, proceeding next attack and defense game.

title_en: Method and system for minimizing risk of cascading failures of power grid under multi-fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid cascading failure risk minimization handling method and a power grid cascading failure risk minimization handling system under a multi-fire disaster.

title_en: Mechanism and data hybrid-driven generation type countermeasure network soft measurement modeling method
abstract_en: Mechanism and data mixingThe driven generating type countermeasure network soft measurement modeling method comprises the following steps: sampling the auxiliary variable to obtain data q, sampling the random noise to obtain data z, inputting the q and z into a generator to be identified, which consists of a mechanism model and a data driving error compensation model, to obtain a generated sample Will generate a sample Inputting the real sample x into a discriminator, and back-propagating the obtained loss to obtain the optimal generator parameters; the optimal generator is taken out to serve as a trained soft measurement model, the interpretability of the model is analyzed by using a method for manipulating latent variables, and the prediction performance of the model is analyzed by comparing the model with a single-drive soft measurement model, so that the limitations that dynamic characteristics among data cannot be captured by a static model, modeling errors exist in a mechanism-drive soft measurement model, label-free data are difficult to utilize in data-drive soft measurement and the interpretability is poor are overcome, and compared with the single-drive soft measurement method, the method has the characteristics of accuracy and reliability in prediction.

title_en: Power grid operation scene division method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and a storage medium for dividing a power grid operation scene, which aim at the problem of low transmission efficiency caused by mutual coupling of multistage cascade power transmission channels of a power grid, identify a high-load key section of the power transmission channel based on historical power flow operation data, excavate the time-space correlation factor of the key section, and perform clustering and grading by establishing a correlation evaluation model and calculating a channel limited index, thereby dividing the whole target power grid operation mode. The method can obtain a relatively ideal power grid operation mode division result, provides data and theoretical support for formulation of a scheduling mode and an operation scheme, and has wide popularization value and application prospect.

title_en: Combined optimization scheduling method for combined cooling, heating and power supply microgrid and active power distribution network considering IDR (Integrated data Rate)
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined optimization scheduling method for a cooling, heating and power combined microgrid and an active power distribution network, which takes IDR (Integrated Demand response) into account. Firstly, modeling the combined cooling heating and power microgrid equipment; then respectively establishing an active power distribution network optimization scheduling model and a combined cooling heating and power microgrid scheduling model considering IDR; the randomness of new energy and the cooling, heating and power loads in the combined cooling, heating and power micro-grid is processed by using opportunity constraint planning; and finally, an IATC (Improved adaptive Target tracking, improved Target Cascading method) is used for solving the combined optimization scheduling model of the combined cooling, heating and power supply microgrid and the active power distribution network considering the IDR. The method provided by the invention can effectively improve the energy utilization rate, reduce the system operation cost and obtain the optimal economic dispatching result of the active power distribution network and the combined cooling heating and power micro-grid on the basis of protecting the privacy of the respective areas.

title_en: Power transmission network risk assessment optimization method based on transient energy imbalance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission network risk assessment optimization method based on transient energy imbalance, which comprises the following steps: step SS 1: establishing a transient energy function of the alternating current-direct current hybrid power system based on an energy transfer relation of the alternating current-direct current hybrid power system; step SS 2: and based on historical operating data of the power grid, performing risk assessment optimization on the transient energy function of the AC-DC hybrid power system in the step SS1 based on a BNG model. Aiming at the problem of neglecting safety influence caused by fault prediction and cascading faults in the current network risk evaluation model, in order to accurately evaluate the target network risk, a transient energy function of an alternating-current and direct-current hybrid power system is established based on the energy transfer relation of the alternating-current and direct-current hybrid power system, a transient energy efficiency variable is introduced based on historical operation data of a power grid, the variable is blended into the calculation of the probability to obtain the prior risk probability of each node in the network, and therefore the network risk is statically evaluated.
assignees: BEIJING KEDONG ELECTRIC POWER CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD;CENTRAL CHINA BRANCH STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Aero-engine multiple fault diagnosis device based on self-association neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides an aeroengine multiple fault diagnostor based on an auto-associative neural network, which comprises eight auto-associative neural networks; searching an optimal self-association neural network structure by the eight self-association neural networks according to the standard which is closest to the input and has the best noise reduction performance, and then keeping the structure to adjust the weight of the network according to the simulation data of the normal model and the fault model and the improved back propagation algorithm; and judging the fault condition of the engine according to the relation between the residual error and the set threshold value. The invention can effectively diagnose and isolate faults of the aircraft engine, can diagnose and isolate faults of a single component and faults of a plurality of sensors at the same time, can effectively avoid economic loss caused by the reasons of flying stop and the like, and can avoid unnecessary component replacement; the engine can be effectively ensured to have higher stability and reliability, the safe operation of the engine is ensured, the performance of the engine is fully exerted, and the safety and the performance of the airplane are improved.
assignees: UNIV NORTHWESTERN POLYTECHNICAL

title_en: Power distribution network fault risk early warning method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid fault early warning, and discloses a power distribution network fault risk early warning method and system based on deep learning, so that the accuracy of fault early warning is improved. The method comprises the following steps: screening initial characteristic information related to the power distribution network fault and preprocessing the initial characteristic information; calculating the weight of each initial feature and removing the initial features lower than a weight threshold value to obtain target feature information; the power grid data and the meteorological data are mapped in an associated mode based on the target characteristic information, a data set is constructed, and a corresponding label is generated; taking the target characteristic information as the input of the deep neural network, and training and verifying the deep neural network according to the corresponding label; and the LSTM network which predicts meteorological factors based on historical data is used for obtaining the meteorological factors in the target characteristic information, the LSTM network and the deep neural network are cascaded to obtain a fault early warning model based on the deep neural network, and then early warning is carried out according to the fault early warning model based on the deep neural network to obtain an early warning conclusion.
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Charging station power consumption prediction method based on deep clustering model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a charging station power consumption prediction method based on a deep clustering model, which comprises the following steps: enhancing and preprocessing the charging station data; determining a cluster to which the charging station belongs based on the feature mapping of the deep clustering model; charging station power prediction based on nearest neighbor algorithm. The method uses a deep neural network to learn the feature representation and the cluster distribution of the charging station data at the same time, iteratively optimizes a clustering target and reconstructs loss by mapping the data to a hidden feature space, and reduces the possibility of error propagation; the charging station power consumption is further predicted using a nearest neighbor algorithm. Compared with the conventional charging station electricity utilization prediction method, the method can mine the implicit characteristics of the data, reduce the search space and have higher prediction accuracy.
assignees: JIANGSU FRONTIER ELECTRIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Risk identification method and system for label propagation algorithm of client network characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk identification method and a system of a label propagation algorithm of client network characteristics, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining historical customer data information and preprocessing the historical customer data information; obtaining an account-level fund transaction table and a client-level fund transaction table according to the preprocessed historical client data information; obtaining a first point file and a first relation file according to the account-level fund transaction table and the client-level fund transaction table; constructing a network model according to the first point file and the first relation file; obtaining network characteristic information of the first client according to the network model; obtaining a risk conduction coefficient of the first client according to the network characteristic information of the first client; analyzing the risk of the first customer according to the risk transmission coefficient of the first customer. The method solves the technical problems that in the prior art, the identification rate of the client with the risk is low in risk identification, and the application method is obviously insufficient and limited.

title_en: Electricity stealing behavior detection method based on BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power stealing behavior detection method based on a BP (back propagation) neural network. The model firstly preprocesses the electricity utilization data of a user and determines an electricity stealing evaluation index; then, a Principal Component Analysis (PCA) method is adopted to realize the feature extraction of sample data, so that the efficiency of the model is improved, and the load of a detection system is reduced; and then, the BP neural network is used for finishing the diagnosis of the electricity stealing behavior of the user, so that the judgment of normal users and electricity stealing users is realized. The practical applicability and the universality of the invention are verified by carrying out example analysis on the power utilization data of large enterprise users provided by a certain power grid company.
assignees: HUANENG POWER INT INC;XIAN THERMAL POWER RES INST CO

title_en: Method and device for constructing dependent network robustness measurement indexes
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for constructing a dependent network robustness measurement index, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the network efficiency of each layer network under the initial state of the dependent network model; carrying out cascade failure attack, obtaining the maximum connected subgraph proportion of each layer of the attacked model and the network efficiency of the maximum connected subgraph, and obtaining the relative efficiency of the initial state of the model and the attacked maximum connected subgraph; obtaining the relative efficiency ratio of the maximum connected subgraph of the model, namely the relative efficiency ratio of the maximum connected subgraph under the initial state after being attacked; the index is used for measuring the robustness of the dependent network, and when the maximum connected subgraph is larger in relative efficiency ratio, the robustness of the dependent network is better. According to the method, a new dependent network robustness measurement index is provided on the basis of the maximum connected subgraph proportion and the network efficiency, and the change condition of the network node in the cascade failure process of the dependent network and the comparison effect of the dependent network before and after being attacked can be reflected.
assignees: UNIV YUNNAN

title_en: Fracture propagation model solving method and system considering fracture network complexity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fracture expansion model solving method and system considering fracture network complexity f Describing the influence of the crack complexity, constructing a logging evaluation index of the plane crack complexity based on the primary weak plane development degree and the horizontal main stress difference, and calculating the length, the width and the like of the crackThe crack geometric parameters fully consider the development rule of the crack under the volume fracturing condition, the calculation result of the crack geometric parameters is more accurate than that of a two-dimensional PKN model, and reliable guarantee can be provided for fracturing design optimization.
assignees: CHINA NAT PETROLEUM CORP;CHINA PETROLEUM LOGGING CO LTD

title_en: Landslide prediction method and system based on elastic waves
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide prediction method based on elastic waves, which is applied to the technical field of landslide prediction and comprises the following specific steps: constructing a multi-target landslide probability prediction model; acquiring elastic wave signals transmitted in the side slope; picking up the signal characteristics of the elastic wave signals by using a characteristic extraction network; and the signal characteristics are brought into an equation of the multi-target landslide probability prediction model to judge whether landslide occurs or not. The invention discloses a landslide prediction system and a method based on elastic waves, which are used for constructing a multi-target landslide prediction model, determining a prediction result by utilizing the wave speeds of the elastic waves at different moments, greatly improving the prediction precision, dividing the elastic wave propagation process into different time periods by utilizing a division principle, respectively calculating the wave speeds, judging whether the landslide occurs, substituting historical data into the multi-target landslide probability prediction model, determining the wave speed threshold of the elastic waves with the landslide, and determining whether the landslide occurs according to the duration time of the different wave speeds and the current wave speed.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING

title_en: Market clearing method, system, equipment and readable storage medium for water-electricity coupling
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of electric power markets and discloses a hydropower coupling market clearing method, a hydropower coupling market clearing system, hydropower coupling market clearing equipment and a readable storage medium, wherein the market clearing method comprises the following steps: acquiring operation boundary conditions, market declaration information and water regime information of a power grid; establishing unit operation constraint, system balance constraint and network constraint of the power grid according to operation boundary conditions and market declaration information based on a future state network topology model of the power grid; establishing power generation water constraint according to the water regime information, and establishing power generation amount constraint according to the power generation water constraint and the market declaration information; based on a future state network topology model and market declaration information of the power grid, the method uses the minimization of power generation cost as an optimization target, and carries out market clearing calculation under the conditions of meeting unit operation constraint, system balance constraint, network constraint and power generation amount constraint to obtain a clearing result. Clear calculation of the power grid containing the cascade hydropower is realized, and technical support is provided for the deep reformation of the power market.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Active emergency exit device
title_ko: 액티브 비상구 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an active emergency exit device, which is the active emergency exit device disposed at a predetermined interval in a specific place to indicate the location of an emergency exit and guide the emergency exit direction. The emergency exit device includes: a disaster occurrence detection unit for detecting the occurrence of a disaster in the specific place; a disaster occurrence notification unit for propagating the occurrence of the disaster to other emergency exit devices through the network; and an emergency escape processing unit providing a notification regarding the occurrence of the disaster to at least one user terminal and providing an evacuation route which is dynamically generated based on feedback on the notification for a user to emergency escape.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 액티브 비상구 장치에 관한 것으로, 특정 장소에서 소정의 간격으로 배치되어 비상구의 위치를 표시하고 비상 탈출 방향을 안내하는 비상구 장치에 있어서, 상기 특정 장소에서의 재난 발생을 검출하는 재난 발생 검출부, 상기 재난 발생을 네트워크를 통해 다른 비상구 장치로 전파하는 재난 발생 알림부 및 적어도 하나의 사용자 단말에게 상기 재난 발생에 관한 알림을 제공하고 사용자의 비상 탈출을 위해 상기 알림에 대한 피드백을 기초로 동적으로 생성되는 대피경로를 제공하는 비상 탈출 처리부를 포함한다.
assignees: NAT DISASTER MANAGEMENT RES INST

title_en: Multi-energy collaborative optimization method and system for data center
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for multi-energy collaborative optimization of a data center, and relates to the technical field of optimization of energy systems of the data center. Firstly, acquiring a data network load based on a network load prediction model; then classifying the data network load and determining the priority of the processing sequence; constructing a multi-energy collaborative optimization model of the data center based on a data center comprehensive energy system comprising a waste heat recovery unit; and finally, solving the multi-energy collaborative optimization model, and optimizing the data center based on the solution result. The invention realizes the collaborative optimization scheduling of data network load and various energy sources in the data center, realizes the cascade utilization of energy, simultaneously recycles the waste heat resources of the data center, reduces the energy consumption of the data center and improves the energy utilization efficiency.
assignees: UNIV HEFEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Event-driven power distribution network information physical system risk assessment calculation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a risk assessment and calculation method for a power distribution network information physical system based on event driving. And then, based on a cross-space cascading failure evolution model, providing and establishing a distribution network operation quantitative risk assessment index. Finally, a risk assessment calculation method of the power distribution network information physical system based on event driving is provided. The invention discloses a risk evaluation calculation method of a power distribution network information physical system, which aims at extracting key elements of the power distribution network cross-information-physical space cascading failure, provides description on risk conduction of different levels and propagation and mapping relations of risks among the different levels, and provides a calculation evaluation method for the risks of the power distribution network information physical system based on an event-driven model.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: Substation Remote Control System of Transformer Fault Based on Block Chain
title_ko: 변전소 변압기 사고 시 블록체인 기반의 변전소 원격 제어 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a blockchain-based remote substation control system for managing a fault of a transformer. According to the present invention, a remote substation management server matches substation-related basic data for each substation with each substation and each distribution line and each transformer of the substation to distribute, register, and store the matched data in a related system and a worker's smart phone; and perform recovery of an accident according to a standard protocol while transmitting and sharing, with the related system and the worker's smartphone, main facility status information, operation information, and monitoring information generated from a relay operation to correcting and recovering the accident in the event of the accident with respect to an accident in a transformer of the substation. Accordingly, when an accident occurs in a transformer of a substation, the accident is processed with respect to a system rather than a person, so that the accident can be systematically managed, thereby preventing safety and power spillage accidents caused by erroneous operation of field facilities.
abstract_ko: 본 발명 변압기 사고 시 블록체인 기반의 변전소 원격 제어 시스템은 변전소 원격 관리 서버가 변전소 관련 기초 데이터를 변전소별, 변전소의 배전 선로별, 변압기 별로 매칭하여 관련 시스템과 근무자 스마트 폰에 분산 등록 저장하고 변전소에서 변압기 사고를 중심으로 하여 사고 시의 계전기 동작부터 사고를 수습하고 복구하기 까지의 생성되는 주요 설비 상태 정보, 조작 정보, 감시 데이터 정보들을 상호 관련 시스템과 근무자의 스마트 폰을 통하여 전송 공유하면서 기준 절차대로 사고 복구하도록 하는 것으로  변전소 변압기 사고 시 사고 수습을 사람 중심이 아닌 시스템 중심으로 처리하도록 하여 사고를 시스템적으로 수습하도록 함으로써 특히 현장 설비의 오조작으로 인한 안전 사고 및 전원 파급 사고를 방지하도록 하는 것이다.
assignees: SGENG CO LTD

title_en: Cascading failure evolution path tracing and predicting method and device based on knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascading failure evolution path tracing and predicting method and device based on a knowledge graph, which can be applied to an alternating current-direct current power grid cascading failure risk assessment and early warning system. The method extracts key characteristic quantities by combining a physical mechanism and a correlation analysis method, automatically learns and judges the incidence relation between characteristic events through a machine learning algorithm, realizes the matching and judgment of the upper and lower incidence relation of the characteristic events by constructing a knowledge graph of two levels, judges the result and the time sequence characteristics according to the incidence relation of the characteristic events, and identifies the cascading failure evolution path based on a depth-first search strategy. The method introduces an intelligent learning and analyzing engine to replace thinking and judgment of scheduling personnel, and provides effective technical support for tracing and prejudging the complex cascading failure.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus for uhd disaster broadcasting
title_ko: Uhd 재난 방송 수신 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an UHD disaster broadcast receiving device capable of quickly propagating a disaster situation by using an UHD broadcast signal, and an UHD disaster broadcast system including the same. The UHD disaster broadcast receiving device includes: an UHD broadcast receiving part receiving an ultrahigh definition (UHD) broadcast signal from a broadcast network, and confirming whether disaster broadcast data exists from the UHD broadcast signal; a control part generating subtitle image data and a voice signal based on the disaster broadcast data from the UHD broadcast receiving part; an image display part displaying disaster-related subtitles based on the subtitle image data from the control part; and a sound output part outputting a disaster-related sound based on the voice signal from the control part.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 UHD 방송 신호를 이용하여 재난 상황을 신속히 전파할 수 있는 UHD 재난 방송 수신 장치 및 이를 포함하는 UHD 재난 방송 시스템에 관한 것으로, 방송망으로부터의 UHD 방송(Ultra High Definition) 신호를 수신하고, 상기 UHD 방송 신호로부터 재난 방송 데이터의 존재 유무를 확인하는 UHD 방송 수신부; 상기 UHD 방송 수신부로부터의 재난 방송 데이터를 근거로 자막 영상 데이터 및 음성 신호를 생성하는 제어부; 상기 제어부로부터의 자막 영상 데이터를 근거로 재난 관련 자막을 표시하는 영상 표시부; 및 상기 제어부로부터의 음성 신호를 근거로 재난 관련 음향을 출력하는 음향 출력부를 포함한다.
assignees: ONPOOM CORP

title_en: System for uhd disaster broadcasting
title_ko: Uhd 재난 방송 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a ultra high definition (UHD) disaster broadcasting system for quickly spreading disaster situations using UHD broadcasting signals, which includes: a UHD disaster broadcast receiving device for receiving a UHD broadcast signal from a broadcasting network; and a peripheral device for transmitting various types of information in a building to the UHD disaster broadcast receiving device, wherein the UHD disaster broadcast receiving device includes: a UHD broadcast receiving unit for confirming the presence or absence of disaster broadcast data from the UHD broadcast signal; a control unit for generating caption image data and audio signals based on the disaster broadcast data from the UHD broadcast receiving unit; an image display unit for displaying disaster-related subtitles based on the subtitle image data from the control unit; and a sound output unit for outputting a disaster-related sound based on the voice signal from the control unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 UHD 방송 신호를 이용하여 재난 상황을 신속히 전파할 수 있는 UHD 재난 방송 시스템에 관한 것으로, 방송망으로부터의 UHD 방송(Ultra High Definition) 신호를 수신하는 UHD 재난 방송 수신 장치; 및 건물 내의 각종 정보들을 상기 UHD 재난 방송 수신 장치로 전송하는 주변 장치를 포함하며, 상기 UHD 재난 방송 수신 장치는, 상기 UHD 방송 신호로부터 재난 방송 데이터의 존재 유무를 확인하는 UHD 방송 수신부; 상기 UHD 방송 수신부로부터의 재난 방송 데이터를 근거로 자막 영상 데이터 및 음성 신호를 생성하는 제어부; 상기 제어부로부터의 자막 영상 데이터를 근거로 재난 관련 자막을 표시하는 영상 표시부; 및 상기 제어부로부터의 음성 신호를 근거로 재난 관련 음향을 출력하는 음향 출력부를 포함한다.
assignees: ONPOOM CORP

title_en: Risk target identification method, risk target identification device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data analysis, and provides a risk target identification method, a risk target identification device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The risk target identification method comprises the following steps: obtaining abnormal behavior data from preset behavior data, wherein each abnormal behavior data carries a data identifier, and part of the data identifiers carry risk labels; constructing a relationship graph by taking each data mark as a vertex based on the abnormal behavior data; screening relationship subgraphs with risk labels from the relationship graph, and carrying out label propagation on each relationship subgraph based on the risk label of each relationship subgraph; and calculating the risk value of each relation sub-graph after label propagation, and identifying the data identification of the relation sub-graph with the risk value higher than the threshold value as a risk target. According to the invention, the hidden risk relation network can be rapidly and effectively identified from massive preset behavior data through graph calculation and big data analysis, and the wind control interception capability is improved.

title_en: Virus transmission inhibition method
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a method for inhibiting viral transmission, comprising the steps of: constructing a trust value model of an interactive trust value mechanism, and giving trust values for all links; evaluating infection parameters according to the current network infection condition, and calculating a strategy parameter threshold value for adopting a corresponding virus propagation inhibition strategy; receiving infection feedback information; and responding to the infection feedback information, and adjusting the current network security level according to the trust value. The method provided by the disclosure can reduce the damage of the network structure on the premise of inhibiting the spread of the network viruses, and can adapt to the change of the network security environment to dynamically adjust the network structure.
assignees: UNIV PLA AIR FORCE ENGINEERING

title_en: Swarm unmanned aerial vehicle fault propagation analysis method based on time sequence network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a swarm unmanned aerial vehicle fault propagation analysis method based on a time sequence network, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle fault analysis. The method solves the problem of difficult fault propagation modeling of the swarm unmanned aerial vehicle, can effectively describe the fault condition of the unmanned aerial vehicle, understand the propagation process of the fault in the swarm unmanned aerial vehicle, and provide a theoretical basis for the prevention and solution of the fault of the swarm unmanned aerial vehicle.

title_en: Prediction method and device for clearing price of auxiliary service for peak regulation based on deep learning
abstract_en: Disclosed is a prediction method and device for a clearing price of an auxiliary service for peak regulation, including: acquiring continuous N days of historical data of clearing prices of an auxiliary service market for peak regulation and respectively moving data of original clearing prices forwards by 1, 2, . . . k days, so as to obtain D−1, D−2 . . . D−k data columns; performing first-round training and prediction by adopting a BP (Back Propagation) neural network, a BP neural network optimized by a PSO (Particle Swarm Optimization) algorithm and an LSSVM (Least Square Support Vector Machine), and forming a BP-expansion column, a PSO_BP-expansion column and an LSSVM-expansion column; training the BP neural network by taking first N−k days of time points and D−1, D−2 . . . D−k clearing prices, the BP-expansion column, the PSO_BP-expansion column, the LSSVM-expansion column and the original clearing prices as training data; and performing prediction for the clearing price.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;STATE GRID ELEC VEHICLE SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Power grid cascading failure element failure probability evaluation method and system under fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating the failure probability of a power grid cascading failure element under fire disaster, which take power flow transfer, state defects of components of the cascading failure element at the current stage and the rejection of the cascading failure element at the previous stage caused by the high-resistance state of a fire point into account, calculate the failure probability of the cascading failure element, and are more accurate compared with the traditional method.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;NARI GROUP CORP

title_en: Central monitoring and management system for detecting dangerous substances
title_ko: 위험물 유출 센트럴 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a central monitoring system for detecting leakage of hazardous substances, which centrally and comprehensively controls leakage detection and response measures for a number of scattered hazardous facilities. According to the present invention, the central monitoring system for detecting leakage of hazardous substances comprises: an alert means (10) installed in a hazardous facility to detect leakage of hazardous substances and transmitting a detection result to a terminal means (20) and a central control center (30); the terminal means (20) carried by a user who works in the hazardous facility, detecting whether a hazardous substance is leaked, and automatically transmitting a detection result to other terminal means (20) and the central control center (30); and the central control center (30) receiving the leakage result of hazardous substances from any one or more of the alert means (10) and the terminal means (20) and issuing a countermeasure. Accordingly, an initial situation is transmitted upon leakage of hazardous substances and a situational trend is continuously checked even after issuance of countermeasures and an instruction for actively responding to changes in the situation is issued, thereby providing an effect of minimizing damage caused by the leakage of hazardous substances.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 산재해 있는 다수의 위험시설물에 대한 위험물 유출감지 및 대응조치를 중앙에서 종합적으로 통제할 수 있는 위험물 유출 센트럴 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 위험시설물에 설치되어 위험물의 유출 여부를 감지하고, 상기 감지결과를 단말수단(20) 및 중앙관제센터(30)에 송신하는 경보수단(10), 상기 위험시설물에 근무하는 사용자가 휴대하며, 위험물의 유출 여부를 감지하고, 그 감지결과를 타 단말수단(20) 및 중앙관제센터(30)에 자동으로 송신하는 단말수단(20) 및 상기 경보수단(10) 및 단말수단(20)의 어느 하나 이상으로부터 위험물 유출 여부를 수신하고 그 대응조치를 발령하는 중앙관제센터(30)를 포함하여 구성되고, 위험물 유출 시 최초의 상황전파 및 대응조치 발령 이후에도 상황추이를 지속적으로 파악하고, 상황변화에 적극 대응토록 지시함으로써 위험물 유출에 따른 피해를 최소화할 수 있는 효과가 기대된다.
assignees: YOOHANTECH CO LTD

title_en: Monitoring and management method for detecting dangerous substances
title_ko: 위험물 유출 중앙 관리방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for central management of the leakage of dangerous substances, that can centrally and comprehensively control the detection and countermeasures for the leakage of dangerous substances for a number of scattered dangerous facilities. The present invention comprises: a warning means (10) installed in a hazardous facility to detect whether dangerous substances are leaked and to transmit the detection result to a terminal means (20) and a central control center (30); the terminal means (20) carried by a user working in the hazardous facility, detecting whether dangerous substances are leaked, and automatically transmitting the detection result to other terminal means (20) and the central control center (30); and the central control center (30) for receiving whether dangerous substances are leaked from any one or more of the warning means (10) and the terminal means (20) and issuing countermeasures thereof. In case of leakage of dangerous substances, even after the initial situation propagation and the issuance of countermeasures, it is possible to minimize the damage caused by the leakage of dangerous substances by continuously monitoring the situation and instructing the user to actively respond to changes in the situation.

assignees: YOOHANTECH CO LTD

title_en: Wind power prediction method based on DE-BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power prediction method based on a DE-BP neural network, which is implemented according to the following steps: step 1, acquiring and processing wind power related data; step 2, adjusting the weight and the threshold of the BP neural network by using a gradient descent method and back propagation, and establishing the BP neural network; step 3, searching the optimal values of the initial weight and the threshold of the BP neural network established in the step 2 by using a DE algorithm to obtain a DE-BP neural network model; and 4, using the DE-BP neural network model for wind power prediction to predict the wind power. The wind power prediction method based on the DE-BP neural network solves the problems that the prediction method in the prior art is easy to fall into a local optimal value and the convergence rate is too slow.
assignees: UNIV XIAN TECHNOLOGY;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Method, system, equipment and storage medium for planning cascade hydropower
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of automation of electric power systems, and discloses a method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for planning cascade hydropower plans, which comprises the following steps: acquiring step hydropower prediction data of a day to be compiled; inputting the cascade hydropower prediction data of the day to be compiled into a cascade hydropower plan deep learning model obtained by training the length-time memory network model by using the historical cascade hydropower prediction data, so as to obtain the cascade hydropower plan of the day to be compiled. The cascade hydropower plan compiling method does not need to research the internal mechanism of the operation of a power grid, and constructs a cascade hydropower plan deep learning model representing the mapping relation between cascade hydropower prediction data and a cascade hydropower plan based on a deep learning method.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Fault leakage current separation method and device based on cross self-coding network
abstract_en: The invention provides a fault leakage current separation method and a fault leakage current separation device based on a cross self-coding network, the method is based on the principle of minimum reconstruction error, two independent automatic coding networks are respectively learned on a residual current data set and a fault leakage current data set, a residual current feature coding module and a fault leakage current feature decoding module are intercepted and cascaded to form the cross self-coding network, migration fine tuning training is carried out on the cross self-coding network by adopting paired residual current-fault leakage current data, and finally a mapping model for separating fault leakage current from residual current is obtained, so that fault leakage current separation is realized. The method can effectively separate the fault leakage current from the residual current, thereby improving the cross network training efficiency and enhancing the generalization capability and robustness of the obtained model.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Power consumption prediction method and prediction system for cement raw material grinding system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for predicting the power consumption of a cement raw material grinding system, which provide a basis for reducing the power consumption of the cement raw material grinding system by predicting the power consumption in real time, take a long-short term memory network as a basic model, adopt an encoding and decoding structure and establish a power consumption prediction model comprising an encoder and a decoder; inputting system variables into an encoder, mining the nonlinear relation among the variables, converting system variable data into feature codes containing the nonlinear relation among the variables, inputting the feature codes and historical power consumption data into a decoder together, mining the relevance between the system variables and the historical power consumption, and obtaining a predicted value at the next moment; meanwhile, model parameters are corrected by adopting a back propagation algorithm, the convergence precision is improved, and then the trained model is used for predicting the power consumption in real time. The invention can be used for accurately predicting the power consumption of the cement raw material grinding system.
assignees: UNIV YANSHAN

title_en: Damping separation method suitable for sub-synchronous oscillation analysis of photovoltaic transmission system through LCC-HVDC
abstract_en: The invention discloses a damping separation method suitable for sub-synchronous oscillation (sub-synchronous oscillation, SSO) analysis of a line-commutated high-voltage direct current (LCC-HVDC) outgoing system of a photovoltaic power grid. Firstly, according to a closed loop transfer function block diagram of a photovoltaic through an LCC-HVDC (liquid crystal control-high voltage direct current) transmission system (hereinafter referred to as PVSL system), a coupling path of a subsynchronous component during propagation between the photovoltaic and the LCC-HVDC is ascertained, then a damping torque method is applied to analyze an SSO mode of the PVSL system, finally, based on a superposition principle of a linear system, a transfer function block diagram is reconstructed to realize PVSL system damping separation, and the influence of subsynchronous interaction of the photovoltaic and the LCC-HVDC on system damping is quantitatively evaluated. The damping separation method overcomes the defect that the PVSL system is regarded as a whole when SSO problems are studied in the conventional analysis method, achieves the purpose of analyzing sub-synchronous interaction among subsystems by analyzing damping of an oscillation coupling path, and provides powerful support for analysis of the sub-synchronous interaction of the PVSL system.

title_en: Water-wind-fire short-term optimization scheduling method considering wind-electricity uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-wind-fire short-term optimization scheduling method considering wind-power uncertainty, which constructs a multi-objective optimization scheduling model with the maximum clean energy utilization rate and the minimum thermal power unit output fluctuation on the basis of meeting water-wind-fire constraints, and the model utilizes the advantages of flexible start and stop of cascade hydropower, high climbing speed and the like to stabilize wind-power output fluctuation. Because the cascade hydropower, wind power and thermal power combined optimization scheduling problem is a highly complex mixed integer nonlinear programming problem, the overall solving difficulty is high. The method is based on a layered solving idea, the model is decomposed into a wind power dispatching layer, a hydroelectric dispatching layer and a thermal power dispatching layer, the layers are associated with each other by means of surplus loads, a solving framework integrating a neural network, interval estimation and an improved genetic algorithm with a heuristic algorithm is provided, and the model is rapidly solved.
assignees: POWERCHINA ZHONGNAN ENG CORP LTD

title_en: BP neural network-based track circuit fault intelligent diagnosis method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fault diagnosis of track circuits, and discloses an intelligent fault diagnosis method of a track circuit based on a BP (back propagation) neural network, which comprises the following steps of firstly, monitoring variables of a track circuit section in real time; dividing a training sample and a test sample; step three, the normalization processing of a training sample data set and a test sample data set; step four, training the BP neural network net 1; and step five, diagnosing the track circuit fault by using the BP neural network net 1. The invention tests 29 kinds of fault data in the track circuit through the BP neural network, and the test accuracy is higher; when a fault occurs, the position of the fault can be quickly positioned, the accuracy can reach 99.9%, and the fault type can be specifically judged, wherein the accuracy is 97.13% -99.4%; the method can provide guidance for field maintenance personnel, reduce maintenance time and improve the reliability of a signal system.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU YOUXIN ALGORITHM INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Civil aircraft operation risk assessment method oriented to multiple failure modes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a civil aircraft running risk assessment method for multiple failure modes, which belongs to the technical field of aircraft safety and comprises the steps of establishing a failure model based on mixed Weibull distribution and carrying out model parameter estimation based on an EM algorithm optimized by PSO aiming at the characteristic that a civil aircraft structural member has multiple loss failure, executing a Monte Carlo simulation algorithm, simulating the number DA of defective aircraft with multiple loss failure in a fleet according to the failure model, constructing a Bayesian network to carry out failure propagation analysis on initial cause events which cause unsafe results, and calculating unsafe result occurrence probability CP under the condition of the initial cause events.

title_en: Urban rail transit network cascading failure modeling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modeling method for urban rail transit network cascade failure, relating to the technical field of rail transit and control science; it includes: according to two indexes of passenger flow volume proportion coefficient and node efficiency, solving the importance degree through an importance degree contribution matrix method, and setting the initial capacity of the station; building station capacity based on node overload; and establishing a residual load redistribution strategy based on the dynamic edge weight to obtain a rail transit network cascade failure model. According to the construction method of the cascade failure model, by considering passenger flow factors in the urban rail transit network, a residual load redistribution strategy considering dynamic side weights is provided, the propagation condition of cascade failures in the real urban rail transit network is fitted, the propagation of the failures is controlled and prevented, and the influence of cascade failure on the urban rail transit network is reduced.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN JIAOTONG

title_en: Network security situation sensing method based on electric power CPS
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network security situation perception method based on an electric power CPS, which comprises the following steps: s1: preprocessing alarm data; s2: fusing alarm data, namely fusing multi-source alarm information by using an alarm information fusion method based on credibility; s3: power CPS security risk assessment based on a threat propagation tree. According to the network security situation sensing method based on the electric power CPS, correlation analysis can be performed by utilizing the time-space characteristics in the preprocessing of the security alarm log data, redundant data are further merged, and the processing efficiency is improved; the effectiveness is high, the safety threatening action often leaves traces in logs of different devices, and the traces are often correlated in time and space and are often the same or similar in time and space, and the false data and  threat can be effectively distinguished by the property.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Air conditioner room energy consumption amount prediction method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to an air conditioner room energy consumption prediction method based on deep learning, which comprises the steps of obtaining input parameters of air conditioner room energy consumption, temperature and humidity, building operation business and the like at different time, training and normalizing data through an LSTM network memory model, calculating a minimum loss function by adopting a time back propagation algorithm, updating a weight value, finally repeatedly calculating to obtain an optimal network weight parameter set, obtaining an optimized model, and predicting the air conditioner room energy consumption. The air conditioner room energy consumption amount prediction method based on deep learning has the advantages of improving relevance and accuracy of prediction data, improving training speed, improving use universality and the like.
assignees: SUZHOU INSTITUTE OF BUILDING SCIENCE GROUP COMPANY LTD

title_en: Prediction algorithm for residual service life of aero-engine with convolution memory residual error self-attention mechanism
abstract_en: An aviation engine remaining service life prediction algorithm of a convolution memory residual error self-attention mechanism. The identification method comprises the following steps: preprocessing the sensor data of the aircraft engine, extracting the bottom-layer characteristics of the data through a convolutional neural network, correlating the time sequence characteristics by using a long-short-term memory network, carrying out position coding on the characteristics by using a position encoder, retraining the characteristics by using a residual error self-attention mechanism, and finally outputting the result through a full-connection layer. Aiming at the defect of the self-attention mechanism, a double-layer residual error network is introduced to inhibit the diffusivity in the back propagation of an error function, and a deep learning method of the residual self-attention mechanism is provided. The invention provides a residual error self-attention mechanism, which can effectively optimize a weight matrix, further constructs an aero-engine residual life service algorithm of the convolution memory residual error self-attention mechanism and has a promoting effect on aero-engine state monitoring.

title_en: Urban rainstorm disaster risk assessment method and system based on GA (genetic algorithm) optimization BP (back propagation) neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a GA (genetic algorithm) optimization BP (back propagation) neural network-based urban rainstorm disaster risk assessment method and system, relates to the technical field of urban rainstorm disaster risk assessment, and aims to solve the problems that an evaluation mechanism is not visual enough, the reliability of an evaluation result is not enough, and real-time dynamic risk assessment is lacked in the currently adopted assessment method. The key point of the technical scheme is that a rainstorm disaster risk assessment system comprising disaster-causing factor danger, pregnant disaster environment sensitivity, vulnerability of disaster-bearing bodies and disaster prevention and resistance capability is established; generating a risk grade label based on the k-means clustering historical disaster damage data; constructing a GA (genetic algorithm) optimized neural network rainstorm disaster risk evaluation model according to the rainstorm disaster risk evaluation system and the risk grade label; and inputting the real-time rainfall into the rainstorm disaster risk assessment model to obtain a risk grade label in a specific time period. The invention achieves the effect of improving the comprehensiveness and accuracy of evaluation.
assignees: NANJING NRIET IND CO LTD

title_en: Systems and methods relating to effective management of fluid infrastructure
abstract_en: Fluid stream management systems and methods are described. An exemplar fluid stream management system includes a neural network connected to a cascading treatment processor. The neural network calculates an initial distant flow condition attribute value for a distant fluid treatment facility. The cascading treatment processor using hydrological information and the initial distant flow condition attribute value computes a predicted modified contribution value for the distant fluid treatment facility. The cascading treatment processor instructs multiple fluid flow controllers, each of which controls the operation of a flow-directing device such that a sum of the predicted modified total load value and a real time total load value of the distant fluid treatment facility is minimized. The real time total load value of the distant fluid treatment facility is based upon real time measurements obtained from one or more of the distant fluid treatment facility sensors.
assignees: EMNET LLC

title_en: Method and system for optimizing and predicting short-term wind speed interval based on random sensitivity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-term wind speed interval multi-target optimization prediction method and system based on random sensitivity, which comprises the steps of firstly pretraining a neural network by adopting a counter-propagation training mode, then improving the random sensitivity so as to be suitable for a special prediction mode, namely a prediction interval, and then carrying out two important indexes of the prediction interval: the interval coverage accuracy and interval width are used as three objective functions together with the constructed random sensitivity for predicting the interval, a multi-objective genetic optimization algorithm NSGA-III is used for optimizing the pre-trained neural network, wherein the random sensitivity can be used for calculating the anti-interference capability of a model on surrounding samples added with random disturbance; after training, heuristic selection is carried out on the pareto optimal population finally obtained. The method provided by the invention can be used for different network structures and has high expandability; the number of the super parameters is greatly reduced by utilizing multi-objective optimization and specially selecting an optimal solution scheme, and the method has good practical application value.

title_en: Method for generating hydrogen-storing metal-organic framework of hydrogen-fueled automobile
abstract_en: The method relates to a metal-organic framework (MOF) algorithm for generating hydrogen for hydrogen-fueled vehicles. The MOF structure is considered to consist of metal clusters, organic linkers and topological networks. The algorithm mainly comprises Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) and is divided into 4 stages: selection, expansion, simulation, and backtracking. Firstly, obtaining a path capable of generating a complete SMILES character string through an MCTS selection and extension stage, then, predicting the next character of the current SMILES character string by using an improved GRU as a strategy network in a simulation stage according to the SMILES character string in the selected path to obtain a complete SMILES character string, namely an organic connection base of the MOF, then, constructing the MOF by using a metal cluster, a topological network and the organic connection base in Zeo + +, and then simulating the hydrogen adsorption quantity of the constructed MOF by using RASPA, wherein the value of the adsorption quantity is used as a reward value of the path selected when the MCTS generates the organic connection base. Finally, in the backtracking stage of MCTS, the reward value is propagated backwards and the information of the nodes in the path is updated. When the maximum value of the hydrogen adsorption amount of MOFs remained unchanged for 7 hours, it was considered that MOFs having the best hydrogen adsorption performance were obtained at this input.
assignees: THE BEIJING PREVENTION AND TREAT HOSPITAL OF OCCUPATIONAL DISEASE FOR CHEMICAL INDUSTRY

title_en: Online determination system and method for optimal operation mode of heat pump cascade heat supply unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses an on-line determining system and a method for the optimal operation mode of a heat pump cascade heat supply unit, which adopt field operation data, take the lowest coal consumption under the conditions of fixed heat supply load and power supply load as an optimization objective function, adopt a univariate comparison method, sequentially adjust the operation backpressure of the unit and the steam pressure of middle-exhaust steam extraction to a heat pump, compare the standard coal consumption of the unit with a reference working condition, and if the standard coal consumption of the unit is greater than the reference working condition, the original reference working condition is still used as the reference working condition; if the parameter is smaller than the preset reference value, the operation working condition corresponding to the parameter is used as a new comparison reference working condition, the operation back pressure of the unit and the steam pressure of the middle-exhaust steam extraction to the heat pump are continuously adjusted, and next iteration optimization is carried out. The method takes the lowest standard coal consumption as a target function on the premise of meeting the dispatching of the power grid and the heat supply network, obtains the optimal control values of the running back pressure and the middle exhaust steam extraction pressure of the heat pump cascade heat supply unit under boundary conditions of different heat supply loads, power supply loads, return water temperatures and the like on line, and realizes the lowest running cost and the maximum profitability.

title_en: Real-time power load prediction system based on sparse pruning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time power load prediction system based on a sparse pruning method, which adopts connection sensitivity to express the importance of neural network connection and removes connection with smaller relevance to an objective function in the network back propagation process according to the connection importance, so that GRU neural network connection in the prediction system becomes sparse, the sparse GRU neural network only needs to carry out single pruning on the GRU neural network, and the prediction performance is optimized by using a fine tuning mode. Through actual tests, results show that 99.3% of parameters in the GRU prediction system are removed by a single pruning algorithm based on connection sensitivity, the classification accuracy of the system is not lost under the condition of realizing high sparsity, and the problems of parameter redundancy and huge calculation amount of the GRU prediction system in a training stage are solved.

title_en: Reservoir group scheduling decision behavior mining method and reservoir scheduling automatic control device
abstract_en: The invention provides a reservoir group scheduling decision behavior mining method and an automatic reservoir scheduling control device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step 1, determining a research situation, collecting basic data of a reservoir group system, historical scheduling data and meteorological data of reservoir area sites, and determining influence factors and decision variables of reservoir group scheduling behaviors; step 2, determining a deep learning algorithm for excavating reservoir group scheduling decision behaviors; step 3, checking the accuracy of the reservoir group scheduling data; step 4, constructing a reservoir group scheduling decision behavior mining model coupling the reservoir basic principle and the deep learning model; and 5, calibrating the hyper-parameters of the model based on the training set sample, reversely propagating and updating the network parameters of the model based on the model loss function, determining the optimal hyper-parameters of the model according to the simulation precision of the model in the test set, and finally establishing the mapping relation between the influence factors of the reservoir group scheduling behaviors and the decision variables to realize the mining of the reservoir group scheduling decision behaviors.
