title_en: Method and system for analyzing influence of social network community structure on information propagation
abstract_en: The invention provides an analysis method and a system for the influence of a social network community structure on information propagation, wherein the analysis method is based on a zero model and comprises the following steps: constructing an information transmission tree; applying an information propagation tree zero model to generate an information propagation tree randomized copy; respectively realizing community discovery of the information dissemination tree and the information dissemination tree randomized copies; the expansion importance profile measures communities of the information propagation tree and the information propagation tree randomized copies, and further analysis of community structures on information propagation influence is achieved. According to the technical scheme, the propagation of specific information in the online social network is taken as a research object, and the role of the community in information propagation is explored.
assignees: UNIV SUZHOU

title_en: Day-ahead optimal scheduling method and system for electric heating load of commercial building
abstract_en: The invention provides a day-ahead optimal scheduling method and system for commercial building electric heating loads, and relates to the technical field of electric power optimal scheduling. The electric heating day-ahead load optimization scheduling method for the commercial building provided by the invention coordinates all devices in the system at the same time, realizes the cascade utilization of energy, improves the utilization efficiency of the energy, reduces the energy utilization cost of the commercial building, promotes the balance of supply and demand of electric power and ensures the safety of an energy system. The invention uses the deep neural network to predict the electricity, heat load and photovoltaic output power of the commercial building, overcomes the uncertainty of two sides of energy supply and demand, and ensures that the obtained optimized dispatching scheme is more accurate and effective.
assignees: XIAN TUJI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus and method for providing personal location information-based disaster response information
title_ko: 개인 위치정보기반 재난 상황 대응정보 제공 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device for providing disaster situation response information based on personal location information, which includes: a disaster information delivery server which disseminates disaster occurrence and situation information through a text message service of a mobile communication network; and a user terminal which automatically guides the emergency disaster text received from the disaster information delivery server and provides disaster response information corresponding to the received emergency text message to the user.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 개인 위치정보기반 재난 상황 대응정보 제공 장치에 관한 것으로, 재난 발생 및 상황 정보를 이동통신망의 문자메시지 서비스를 통해 관련 정보를 전파하는 재난정보전달 서버; 및 재난정보전달 서버로부터 수신된 긴급재난문자를 자동으로 안내하고, 수신된 긴급재난문자에 대응되는 재난대응 정보를 사용자에게 제공하는 사용자 단말을 포함한다.
assignees: ELECTRONICS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS RES INST

title_en: Electric power information physical system robustness analysis method based on reachable matrix
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power information physical system robustness analysis method based on a reachable matrix, which comprises the following steps: inputting an adjacency matrix Ep of the power network, an adjacency matrix Ec of the information network, and a dependency matrix Epc between the power network and the information network; determining an attack node in the power network, wherein the attack node is a starting point of fault propagation, deleting fault nodes which appear in an adjacent matrix Ep and an adjacent matrix Ec after the fault propagation based on a dependent matrix Epc, and outputting the adjacent matrix Ep, the adjacent matrix Ec and the dependent matrix Epc; updating the dependency matrix Epc, and forming an attacked widened adjacent matrix based on the adjacent matrix Ep, the adjacent matrix Ec and the updated dependency matrix Epc; and calculating the system robustness index after the attack based on the extended adjacency matrix. The modeling complexity of the mutual coupling network can be reduced, the structural characteristic change and the dynamics rule of network connection in the system are clearly and intuitively displayed, the complexity of an attack graph is reduced, and the understanding and analysis of safety personnel are facilitated.

title_en: Drainage basin cascade power plant maintenance monitoring management system and use method
abstract_en: The invention provides a watershed cascade power plant maintenance monitoring management system and a using method thereof. The drainage basin cascade power plant overhaul information sending module, the power grid production data receiving module, the public service module, the centralized control center worker workstation and the overhaul information monitoring management display module are connected with the centralized control center host, and the centralized control center host transmits data of all the modules to the drainage basin cascade power plant overhaul monitoring management database for storage. The system monitors and manages the whole process from the application of the overhaul ticket to the completion of overhaul of the watershed step power plant overhaul work, and ensures that the overhaul work does not have a task problem. All modules are managed and coordinated through a centralized control center, and the system monitors and manages the whole process from the application of a maintenance ticket to the completion of maintenance of the power plant maintenance work of the drainage basin cascade, so that no problem is caused in the maintenance work.
assignees: HUBEI QINGJIANG HYDROELECTRIC DEV CO LTD

title_en: Method for identifying dressing specification of distribution network field operating personnel
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for identifying dressing specifications of distribution network field operators, which comprises the following steps of image classification: intercepting a distribution network field operation video as an image book set, and dividing the image book set into a verification set and a training set according to a proportion; formation of training data set: training a target detection and image instance segmentation model by using a Mask-RCNN algorithm, and verifying the trained model by using a verification set to obtain a detection, identification and segmentation model; intercepting images from an original image by using a personnel position coordinate, a work clothes category and a work clothes pixel segmentation image obtained by Mask-RCNN inference to form a training data set for image recognition; constructing a classification model: constructing an image recognition model based on a MobileNet-v2 algorithm, and recognizing whether the working clothes worn by an operator are standard or not; identification of dressing regulations: the method is characterized in that a target detection model, an image instance segmentation model and an image recognition model which are constructed by adopting Mask-RCNN and MobileNet-v2 algorithms are cascaded to realize the detection, the recognition and the segmentation of whether an operator wears a working garment normally or not.
assignees: INF CT YUNNAN GRID POWER CO LTD

title_en: Cascade hydropower station group water level prediction method and device and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade hydropower station group water level prediction method, a cascade hydropower station group water level prediction device and a computer readable storage medium, and the technical key point of the invention is that a K-means++ clustering algorithm is used for identifying the current hydrologic state of a cascade hydropower station group so as to accurately divide hydrologic periods; based on the method, the sequence prediction method based on the LSTM network is utilized, and the collected hydrologic information and the meteorological information are combined to predict the water level of the cascade hydropower station group. The invention can accurately predict the water level change condition of the subsequent period according to the running condition of the cascade hydropower station and the surrounding hydrologic and meteorological condition changes, thereby providing basis for the dispatching running of the hydropower station and improving the overall economic benefit and risk prevention capability of the cascade hydropower station group.

title_en: Fault hazard index calculation and vulnerability assessment method for smart power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault hazard index calculation and vulnerability assessment method for an intelligent power grid, which comprises the following steps of: constructing a dependent coupling network topology model of the smart power grid in an abstract mode according to the power grid and the information network; acquiring a fault element set according to the node fault of the power grid and the node fault of the information grid, and acquiring a fault hazard index of a node according to the fault element set; obtaining coupling secondary fault propagation of the node according to the interactive propagation of the fault and the bidirectional coupling of the smart grid, and obtaining a coupling secondary fault hazard index of the node according to the coupling secondary fault propagation of the node; and acquiring a node secondary comprehensive fault hazard index according to the node fault hazard index and the node coupling secondary fault hazard index, and acquiring a node vulnerability evaluation index according to the node secondary comprehensive fault hazard index. The method considers the coupling of the smart grid and the interactive propagation of the fault, and the obtained system vulnerability analysis result is more visual and accurate.

title_en: Method for establishing strip mine slope displacement prediction model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of strip mine excavation engineering, in particular to a method for establishing a strip mine side slope displacement prediction model, which comprises the steps of obtaining side slope deformation monitoring sample data, determining a topological structure of a BP (back propagation) neural network, and determining the number of neurons of an input layer, a hidden layer and an output layer; determining the population scale and the dimension of the particle swarm according to the topological structure of the BP neural network to determine a fitness function and a system error; the sample data is brought into each particle, the forward propagation calculation of the network is carried out, and the fitness value of each particle is calculated one by one; comparing fitness function values, and replacing the individual optimal solution after the variation and the global optimal solution after the variation if the fitness value of the individual optimal solution of the particles after the variation or the fitness value corresponding to the global optimal solution of the particle swarm is smaller than that before the variation; and initializing a BP neural network by using vector elements corresponding to the global optimal solution after iteration is stopped, wherein the BP neural network is the prediction model of the slope displacement of the strip mine.
assignees: UNIV LIAONING TECHNICAL

title_en: Hybrid rolling short-term load prediction method based on GAN network and semi-supervised regression
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mixed rolling short-term load prediction method based on a GAN network and semi-supervised regression, wherein a GAN generation confrontation network consists of a generation layer G and a discrimination layer D, the generation layer of GAN can generate a virtual data sample similar to a real value, the discrimination layer receives two inputs of the generated virtual sample and the real sample, a cluster of error discrimination results based on cross entropy is generated by carrying out data processing on two groups of data with different real values, the error is fed back to the generation layer and the discrimination layer through a back propagation algorithm, a GAN model is corrected by changing mathematical parameters in the GAN model in an iteration mode, and load data are predicted through a trained GAN model. The invention solves the problem of insufficient fitting of the traditional GAN network, solves the problem of possible insufficient historical data by using a rolling self-adaptive method, can realize one-step prediction and multi-step prediction, and obtains good prediction effect.
assignees: JIAXING GUODIANTONG NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD;BEIJING GUODIANTONG NETWORK TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD;UNIV SHANDONG

title_en: Dynamic network analysis-based micro-grid disturbance propagation dynamics modeling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic network analysis-based modeling method for micro-grid disturbance propagation dynamics, which specifically comprises the following steps: 1) acquiring and preprocessing real-time meteorological and electric energy quality data of a microgrid; 2) estimating the running state of the micro-grid with measurement uncertainty; 3) sorting key nodes of the microgrid; 4) perturbation space-time distribution of the micro-grid; according to the method, the micro-grid operation data is subjected to state estimation by adopting a micro-grid operation state estimation method of content measurement uncertainty, so that the accuracy of obtaining internal operation information of the micro-grid system and sensing the operation state is improved; evaluating the susceptibility degree of electrical nodes in the system under the current operation condition by adopting a disturbed microgrid key node sorting method based on a structure hole theory and ListNet; on the basis, based on a structural perturbation and mutation dynamic network analysis method, the interaction mode and strength among nodes in the microgrid network are objectively mapped.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Flight operation risk network construction and control method based on unsafe events
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flight operation risk network construction and control method based on unsafe events. The method constructs a flight operation risk network based on civil aviation unsafe event data, and performs logic supplementary connection on the network according to flight operation actual services; and improving a risk propagation and control process based on an SIR virus propagation model, distinguishing risk propagation probabilities among different nodes according to the occurrence frequency of different unsafe events, and simulating the propagation process of the risk in the network. The propagation of risks in the network is controlled by two methods of controlling nodes and network attack, and the probability of risks of unsafe events is reduced by establishing defense for important nodes, so that a reliable and effective flight operation risk control scheme is provided. The flight operation risk network is constructed, so that the relationship among flight risk factors and the relationship between risks and accidents can be known, the risk propagation process is more consistent with the actual flight operation condition, and the reliability of the determined risk control scheme is higher.
assignees: UNIV CIVIL AVIATION CHINA

title_en: Traffic characteristic prediction method and system applicable to long-time prediction based on control information
abstract_en: The invention relates to a traffic characteristic prediction method and a system based on control information and suitable for long-time prediction, wherein the control information is introduced into traffic characteristic prediction to respectively process traffic speed, road network structure and traffic control data; the data are respectively sent to a neural network to obtain space embedding, time embedding and control embedding, and the space embedding, the time embedding and the control embedding are combined to form comprehensive embedding; and finally obtaining the predicted traffic speed value through an encoder based on a space-time attention mechanism module, a data conversion module and a decoder based on the space-time attention mechanism module. The invention improves the effectiveness of the speed prediction of the signal control road network, can better model the dynamic space correlation and the nonlinear time correlation, and simultaneously can avoid the error accumulation to relieve the error propagation effect, thereby improving the long-term traffic flow prediction performance and solving the problem of being suitable for long-term traffic prediction.
assignees: ZHEJIANG YINJIANG INTELLIGENT TRAFFIC ENGINEERING TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Capacitive blocking device configuration optimization method based on genetic algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for optimizing the configuration of a capacitive blocking device based on a genetic algorithm, which comprises the following steps: based on the genetic algorithm optimizing process and improvement, an objective function is established by taking the minimum treatment cost as a target under the condition that the direct current magnetic bias suppression effect is met, the installation problem of the capacitance blocking device is equivalent to a discrete function optimization problem, and the optimization configuration scheme of the capacitance blocking device is obtained through calculation. The invention considers the propagation path of the subway stray current in the urban district power grid and specifies the possible occurrence probability event, realizes the optimized suppression of the transformer direct current magnetic bias caused by the subway stray current, and saves the treatment cost of enterprises.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG

title_en: Cascading failure risk assessment method based on network dependency relationship
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascading failure risk assessment method based on a network dependency relationship, which comprises the following steps: 1, constructing an electric power information physical system, improving conditions of network dependency relationship, 2, constructing a risk transfer function, forming an initial fault set of information nodes, 3, selecting an initial fault, wherein the fault is transmitted between a power grid and an information network in a cross-space mode due to risk transfer, 4, selecting an initial fault line and a subsequent fault line of the power grid according to the risk transfer function, and if corresponding fault on-off information is uploaded to a dispatching center, the dispatching center issues a corresponding control command; if the information uploading is unsuccessful, the dispatching center is not controlled, the protection and safety device traverses the initial fault set according to the system state action 5, the steps 3-4 are repeated until the end condition is met, the accident chain data are recorded, and the risk is calculated. On the basis of network dependence, the invention takes the transmission characteristics of the power grid and the information grid into consideration, thereby researching the cross-space propagation process of the fault and providing theoretical guidance for the prevention and control of the cascading faults of the electric power information physical system.

title_en: Remote verification method for propagation type charging pile
abstract_en: The invention provides a remote verification method for a propagation type charging pile, which is characterized by collecting charging process data, wherein the charging process data comprises a charging pile interface ID number, an electric vehicle VIN code, an electric vehicle BMS measured voltage, an electric vehicle BMS measured current, an electric vehicle BMS metered electric energy, a charging pile measured voltage, a charging pile measured current and a charging pile metered electric energy, subtracting the charging process data to obtain a measurement error, and completing remote pre-verification of the charging pile; the method has the advantages that the measurement accuracy of the plurality of charging piles with high use frequency is guaranteed, and the standard quantity value is transmitted to a network formed in the whole charging process by means of the charging behavior of the electric automobile, so that remote pre-verification of the charging piles is completed; the workload of verification personnel is greatly reduced, the verification efficiency is improved, and the cost consumed by the verification work is saved. Meanwhile, as an online remote verification system, the system can find problems at the first time, and real-time performance is guaranteed.
assignees: SHENZHEN ACADEMY OF METROLOGY & QUALITY INSPECTION NAT HIGH TECH METROLOGY STATION NAT DIGITAL ELECT;HARBIN INST TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Explosion diameter inversion method based on transient flow
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for realizing the inversion of the diameter of a burst pipe, in order to realize the location of the burst pipe in a pipe network, a high-frequency SCADA system is applied to monitor a pressure abnormal signal in the pipe network, and on the basis of the location of the burst pipe, a total monitoring signal is decomposed into branch monitoring signals from each propagation path according to the propagation characteristics of transient flow; inverting the propagation path and characteristics of the transient flow, namely inverting the local loss and the friction loss in the original propagation process to obtain the reciprocal of the local loss and the friction loss, converting the reciprocal of the local loss and the friction loss into gain, inverting the excitation signals from each path, and superposing the excitation signals to form a total inversion excitation signal; and according to the relation between the detonation excitation signal and the detonation diameter, the excitation signal takes the maximum amplitude, the detonation diameter takes the maximum value, and the detonation diameter is calculated. The comparison of the diameter of the detonation calculated by the method with the actual diameter of the detonation and the instantaneous flow attenuation method proves that the positioning precision of the method is higher, and the method can effectively solve the problem of the diameter inversion of the detonation.

title_en: Emergency communication perception equipment system efficiency evaluation method based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency communication perception equipment system efficiency evaluation method based on a neural network, and belongs to the technical field of efficiency evaluation. In order to reflect the actual combat effectiveness of the emergency communication perception equipment system more reliably, an emergency communication perception equipment system effectiveness evaluation method based on a neural network is provided. The method selects the efficiency evaluation index with larger entropy value after calculating the entropy value of each efficiency evaluation index, thereby screening the efficiency evaluation index and further reducing the dimension of the efficiency evaluation index by combining a principal component analysis method. And finally, setting weight parameters by adopting a back propagation algorithm, and constructing a BP neural network efficiency evaluation model. The method has the advantages of high judgment accuracy, high timeliness and small calculated amount, and can effectively avoid blindness, subjectivity and prejudice when weight parameters are set manually.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING INF SCI & TECH

title_en: Customized Disaster Information Provision System and Method
title_ko: 맞춤형 재난정보 제공시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a customized disaster information providing system and a method thereof and, more specifically, to a system and a method which generate and disseminate area-customized and medium-customized disaster information when a disaster occurs to minimize unnecessary disaster information reception and quickly disseminate disaster information. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the customized disaster information providing system comprises: an information collection unit collecting weather information and disaster information if a disaster occurs in a specific facility or an area; a control unit monitoring location information included in the disaster information of the information collection unit for reference in real time, and performing an approval procedure for notification; an analysis unit analyzing the disaster information and the weather information collected by the information collection unit to derive a disaster situation and a damage prediction range, and checking facilities and warning systems within the damage prediction range; a disaster information generation unit generating multimedia disaster information content in accordance with the facilities and the warning systems within the damage prediction range based on information analyzed by the analysis unit; and a notification unit notifying the facilities and the warning systems within the damage prediction range of the multimedia disaster information content generated by the disaster information generation unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 맞춤형 재난정보 제공시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 재난 발생시 지역맞춤형과 매체맞춤형의 재난정보를 생성 전파하여 불필요한 재난정보 수신을 최소화하고 신속하게 재난상황을 전파하는 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 
 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 맞춤형 재난정보 제공시스템은, 특정 시설물이나 지역에 재난이 발생한 경우 재난정보와 기상정보를 수집하는 정보수집부와, 상기 정보수집부의 재난정보에 포함된 위치정보를 참고로 실시간 모니터링하고 통보에 대한 승인절차를 수행하는 관제부와, 상기 정보수집부에서 수집한 재난정보와 기상정보를 분석하여 재난상황 및 피해예상 범위를 도출하고, 그 피해예상 범위 내 시설물과 경보시스템을 확인하는 분석부와, 상기 분석부에서 분석한 정보를 기반으로 피해예상 범위 내 시설물과 경보시스템에 따라 멀티미디어 재난정보 콘텐츠를 생성하는 재난정보생성부, 및 상기 재난정보생성부에서 생성된 멀티미디어 재난정보 콘텐츠를 피해예상 범위 내 시설물과 경보시스템에 통보하는 통보부를 포함하여 구성된다.
assignees: KITVALLEY CO LTD

title_en: an antifire structure for a duct and electric pipe space with an excellent air permeability and fire resistance
title_ko: 통기성 및 차화성이 우수한 덕트 및 전기시설물 스페이스용 차화 구조물
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an anti-fire structure for a duct and an electric facility space having excellent air permeability and fire resistance which normally maintains the flow of air in a duct space effectively and can prevent a fire from spreading through a duct and an electric facility space when the fire occurs. The anti-fire structure for a duct and an electric facility space having excellent air permeability and fire resistance comprises: an anchor member installed and fixed on the inner circumferential surface of a duct and an electric facility space; a first member crossing the internal space of the duct and the electric facility space to divide the internal space of the duct and the electric facility space into a plurality of areas, wherein both ends thereof are connected to and fixed on the anchor member; a second member wherein one end thereof is connected to and fixed on the first member, and the other end thereof is connected to and fixed on the anchor member or another first member to individually divide a plurality of ducts and electric facilities; a plurality of third members connected to and fixed on one or more among the anchor member, the first member, and the second member, and coming in contact with and surrounding the outer circumferential surfaces of the individually divided ducts and electric facilities; and an anti-fire member having a sheet form with a vent hole formed therethrough in the longitudinal direction of the duct and the electric facility space, and mounted to cover an area formed between two or more among the anchor member, the first member, the second member, and the third members.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 평소에는 덕트 스페이스 내 공기의 흐름이 원활하게 유지되고 화재 시에는 덕트 및 전기시설물 스페이스를 통한 화재의 전파를 차단할 수 있는 통기성 및 차화성이 우수한 덕트 및 전기시설물 스페이스용 차화 구조물에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은 덕트 및 전기시설물 스페이스의 내주면에 설치되어 고정된 앵커 멤버, 덕트 및 전기시설물 스페이스의 내부 공간을 가로질러 덕트 및 전기시설물 스페이스의 내부 공간을 복수 개의 영역으로 나누고 양단이 앵커 멤버에 연결되어 고정되는 제1 멤버, 일단이 제1 멤버에 연결되어 고정되고 타단이 앵커 멤버 또는 다른 제1 멤버에 연결되어 고정되어 복수 개의 덕트 및 전기시설물을 개별적으로 구획하는 제2 멤버, 복수 개로서 앵커 멤버 제1 멤버 및 제2 멤버 중 어느 하나 이상에 연결되어 고정되고 개별적으로 구획된 덕트 및 전기시설물의 외주면에 접하여 에워싸는 제3 멤버 및 덕트 및 전기시설물 스페이스의 길이 방향으로 관통되어 형성된 통기구를 가지는 시트 형태로서 앵커 멤버 제1 멤버 제2 멤버 및 제3 멤버 중 2 이상의 사이에 형성된 영역을 커버하도록 장착되는 차화 멤버를 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: KWANG WOON TECH CORP

title_en: Video providing system for the location of the fire site of the building and the firefighting equipment
title_ko: 건물의 화재장소와 소방기기의 위치에 대한 영상제공시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a video providing system for the location of the fire site of a building and firefighting equipment. The video providing system for the location of the fire site of a building and firefighting equipment according to an embodiment of the present invention is includes a user device, a firefighting facility, an alarm, a CCTV, and a service control server. Because a member who first discovered fire can share the fact of the fire with the rest of the member, damage to life and property can be minimized.
abstract_ko: 건물의 화재장소와 소방기기의 위치에 대한 영상제공시스템이 제공된다. 건물의 화재장소와 소방기기의 위치에 대한 영상제공시스템은, 사용자 디바이스, 소방시설, 경보기, CCTV 및 서비스 관제서버를 포함하는 건물의 화재장소와 소방기기의 위치에 대한 영상제공시스템에 있어서, 사용자 디바이스는, 화재발생을 발견하고 전파하는 화재전파용 제1 사용자 디바이스와, 제1 사용자 디바이스로부터 화재발생을 수신하고 공유하는 제2 사용자 디바이스를 포함하고, 소방시설은 소화기 및 위치 알림 거치대를 포함하고, 위치 알림 거치대는, 소화기가 거치되는 본체 및 본체에 내장된 알림부를 포함하며, 알림부는  소화기의 거치유무를 판단하는 제1 알림부 및 화재발생시 빛을 출력하는 광원부와 소리를 출력하는 음향출력부를 포함하는 제2 알림부를 포함하고, 경보기는, 바디부와, 상기 바디부의 하면에 배치된 스피커부와, 스피커부를 둘러싸는 커버부를 포함하고, 바디부는 서로 이격된 제1 모듈부 및 제2 모듈부를 포함하고, 제1 모듈부 및 제2 모듈부는 바디부의 외면에 내장되며, 제1 모듈부 및 제2 모듈부 각각은, 제1 방향으로 순차적으로 배치된 제1 센서부, 제1 발광부, 제2 센서부 및 제2 발광부를 포함하고, 제1 센서부 및 제2 센서부 각각은 연기 센서, 열 센서, 습도 센서 중 적어도 하나를 포함하고, 커버부는 제1 부분 및 제2 부분을 포함하고, 제1 부분 및 제2 부분은 제1 방향으로 교번하여 다수 배치되며, 제1 부분은 테드라데칸으로 이루어지되, 제2 부분은 금속재질로 이루어지고, CCTV는, CCTV를 고정시키는 고정부, 고정부와 연결되는 연장부, 연장부와 연결되며 외부 하우징부, 외부 하우징부에 수납되며 촬영부와 보조 촬영부를 포함하는 내부 하우징부를 포함하고, 고정부는, 제1 고정부 공기통로 및 제2 고정부 공기통로를 다수 포함하고, 제1 고정부 공기통로 내부에는 실리콘 충전되며, 제2 고정부 공기통로 내부에는 테드라데칸이 충전되되, 제1 고정부 공기통로 및 제2 고정부 공기통로는 서로 교번하여 배치되고, 제1 고정부 공기통로 및 제2 고정부 공기통로 각각은 원 기둥 형상으로 이루어지며, 제1 고정부 공기통로 및 제2 고정부 공기통로 각각의 지름은 0.05cm 내지 0.4cm이고, 연장부는 고정부와 외부 하우징부를 연결하되, 길이가 가변되고, 외부 하우징부는 금속재질로 이루어지되, 내부에 제1 외부 하우징부 공기통로 및 제2 외부 하우징부 공기통로를 다수 포함하고, 제1 외부 하우징부 공기통로 내부에는 실리콘 충전되며, 제2 외부 하우징부 공기통로 내부에는 테드라데칸이 충전되되, 제1 외부 하우징부 공기통로 및 제2 외부 하우징부 공기통로 각각은 원 기둥 형상으로 이루어지며, 제1 외부 하우징부 공기통로 및 제2 외부 하우징부 공기통로 각각의 지름은 0.1cm 내지 0,8cm이고, 외부 하우징부의 하면에는 제1 센서 모듈 및 제2 센서 모듈이 배치되고, 제1 센서 모듈은 열 감지 센서를 포함하고, 제2 센서 모듈은 사람의 음성 주파수를 인식하는 음성인식센서 및 GPS신호를 분석하여 위치 정보를 획득하는 GPS 센서를 포함하며, 제1 센서 모듈 및 제2 센서 모듈 각각은 외면에는 열전도 차단막이 배치되되, 열전도 차단막은 글라스파이버 75 중량%, 페놀수지 17중량%, 탄산칼슘은 8중량%를 포함하여 이루어지며, 열전도 차단막의 두께는 0.1cm 내지 0.3cm이고, 열전도 차단막은 다수의 홀을 포함하며, 다수의 홀의 직경은 0.01cm 내지 0.03cm이며, 서비스 관제서버는, 제1 사용자 디바이스 및 제2 사용자 디바이스, 소방시설, 경보기 및 CCTV와 무선통신 방식으로 연동하며, 각 지역별 건물의 도면 맵을 저장 관리하는 맵 정보 저장 관리부를 포함한다.
assignees: JINIL ENG CO LTD

title_en: Substation Remote Control Method of Fault Based on Block Chain
title_ko: 사고 시 블록체인 기반의 변전소 원격 제어 방법
abstract_en: According to a block chain-based remote substation control method of the present invention, the substation remote control server matches the substation-related basic data for each substation, each distribution line of the substation, and each transformer to distribution register and store the data in interrelated systems and workers' smart phones, and transmits and shares major facility status information, operation information, and monitoring data information generated from a relay operation upon accident to correcting and recovering the accident, through the interrelated systems and the workers' smart phones, while focusing on ground faults, short circuit accidents and transformer accidents, which are the main causes of accidents in substations, so as to enable the workers to recover the accident according to standard procedures. Thus, in the event of a substation accident or distribution line accident, the accident is dealt based on a system-centered manner rather than human-centered manner, in particular, so as to prevent accidents and power spillage accidents caused by erroneous operation of on-site facilities.
abstract_ko: 본 발명 블록체인 기반의 변전소 원격 제어 방법은 변전소 원격 관리 서버가 변전소 관련 기초 데이터를 변전소별, 변전소의 배전 선로별, 변압기 별로 매칭하여 관련 시스템과 근무자 스마트 폰에 분산 등록 저장하고 변전소에서 사고의 주 원인이되는 지락, 단락 사고와 변압기 사고를 중심으로 하여 사고 시의 계전기 동작부터 사고를 수습하고 복구하기 까지의 생성되는 주요 설비 상태 정보, 조작 정보, 감시 데이터 정보들을 상호 관련 시스템과 근무자의 스마트 폰을 통하여 전송 공유하면서 기준 절차대로 사고 복구하도록 하는 것으로  변전소 사고 또는 배전 선로 사고 시 사고 수습을 사람 중심이 아닌 시스템 중심으로 처리하도록 하여 사고를 시스템적으로 수습하도록 함으로써 특히 현장 설비의 오조작으로 인한 안전 사고 및 전원 파급 사고를 방지하도록 하는 것이다.
assignees: SGENG CO LTD

title_en: Network attack damage degree quantification method for power system
abstract_en: The invention provides a network attack destruction degree quantification method facing an electric power system, which is characterized in that a network attack destruction degree quantification model is constructed based on an attack propagation probability representation method of a community structure; representing a dynamic evolution process of the network attack by the propagation of the network attack, constructing a power system penetration dependence attack graph, and determining an attack path set; designing a damage degree quantization model based on an attack path, determining an attack strategy set by constructing a network attack graph of the power system, respectively designing objective functions of an information layer and a physical layer, and constructing the damage degree quantization model by taking an attack strategy as conditional constraint; and finding an optimal strategy from the attack strategy set, and improving the artificial immune algorithm to realize model solution by utilizing a cross recombination operator to enhance the cooperation efficiency among antibodies. The method and the device realize the accurate representation of the network attack propagation probability in different conditions and at multiple angles, realize the numerical representation of the potential consequences of the network attack, and are favorable for accurately mastering the safety state of the power system.

title_en: Tube burst positioning method based on transient flow
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for realizing the positioning of pipe explosion, in order to realize the accurate positioning of a complex pipe network, a high-frequency SCADA system is applied to monitor a pressure abnormal signal in the pipe network, the whole change (system abnormity) and the transient change (transient flow abnormity) of the pressure are analyzed after the pressure abnormal signal is filtered, and the pipe explosion event is identified; simulating transient flow excited by pipe explosion according to the momentum theorem and the actual operation numerical value of opening the ball valve, and simulating the monitoring point transient flow according to the propagation characteristic of the transient flow on the basis; judging pipe sections of the pipe burst through numerical simulation of monitoring point signals of pipe burst of each pipe section; the pipe bursting positioning is realized by judging the monitoring point signals of pipe section pipe bursting through numerical simulation; compared with the actual pipe burst position and the positioning position of the negative pressure wave method, the method proves that the positioning precision is higher, and the method can effectively solve the problem of precise positioning of the complex pipe network.

title_en: Intelligent training method, evaluation method and system for weak evaluation of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a training method, an evaluation method and a system for a power system weakness evaluation intelligent agent, and belongs to the field of power system weakness evaluation. The method is based on a deep reinforcement learning algorithm and a power system cascading failure model, an agent based on a deep Q network decides an attack line which most easily causes the power system to crash, a power flow transfer process after the attacked line exits from running is simulated based on the power system cascading failure model, and the power transmission line with the most serious power flow out-of-limit is automatically cut. And continuously utilizing the intelligent agent to decide the attack line until the outage line or the loss load reaches a certain threshold value, judging the breakdown of the power system, and outputting an attack sequence decided by the intelligent agent. In the process, experience samples required by reinforcement learning are stored and the updating agent is trained. According to the method, the intelligent agent obtained by deep reinforcement learning algorithm training can be used for effectively deciding the attack sequence which most easily causes the breakdown of the power system under the current tide working condition, so that the weakness degree of the power system is evaluated.

title_en: Production equipment of Hua diao chicken
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a production facility of chicken is drunk to hua diao, close the upper cover on the body including body and lid, can dismantle to be connected with the base body bottom, the base top is open structure with the bottom, the base includes main part and support, main part and support be the integrated into one piece structure, a plurality of archs of body bottom fixedly connected with, protruding and base contact cooperation, the utility model discloses a production facility of chicken is drunk to hua diao through fixed connection support on the base, makes the burning things which may cause a fire disaster concentrate more in the body bottom, through protruding and the base contact cooperation of body bottom, makes the speed and the efficiency of heat propagation higher to reduce the stewing time of chicken is drunk to hua diao.
assignees: HUNAN INST ENGINEERING

title_en: Electric power system fragile line evaluation method and system considering cyber attack risk
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating a fragile line of an electric power system by considering cyber attack risks, which fully consider the influence mechanism of the cyber attack on the line vulnerability and the cascading process of line faults and provide the method for evaluating the fragile line of the electric power system by considering the cyber attack risks. By calculating the potential maximum power flow of the line under the network attack and carrying out comprehensive risk evaluation by using the line fault disguise degree index and the minimum tangential load, the screening and risk sequencing of the high-risk line are realized, and the defects that the network attack threat and the network attack physical consequence are not considered in the current evaluation method are overcome.
assignees: UNIV HUNAN

title_en: Atmospheric storage tank area domino accident dynamic prediction method, system and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of storage tank accident detection, and discloses a method, a system and a device for dynamically predicting domino accidents in a normal-pressure storage tank area, wherein the key points of the technical scheme are that basic data of a tank area to be evaluated are collected; determining an initial storage tank according to the basic data; determining an initial accident mode according to the basic data of the initial storage tank; determining an accident evolution mode according to the initial accident mode; calculating physical effects for each accident evolution mode; judging whether the physical effect exceeds a threshold value, and if so, determining an accident mode of an adjacent storage tank; constructing a static Bayesian network according to the accident mode of the adjacent storage tank; constructing a dynamic Bayesian network according to the static Bayesian network and fire-fighting factors; and calculating dynamic probability according to the dynamic Bayesian network, and determining the most possible extended accident chain and key storage tanks.
assignees: NANJING UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY;NANJING NJTECH SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent networking method based on automatic fire alarm system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent networking method based on a fire-fighting fire automatic alarm system, which comprises a plurality of controllers which are cascaded in a tree-shaped topological structure and are in communication connection, wherein a controller at a root node is taken as a first node controller for a main fire-fighting control room, and the other sub-nodes are taken as branch node controllers for a secondary fire-fighting control room; each controller is matched with a corresponding networking communication ID number, and the network logic node of each controller is set by the networking communication ID number of the controller and the networking communication ID number of a superior node controller networked with the controller; the message identifier of the networking communication ID number of the head node controller is the smallest among all the controllers, and the message identifier of the networking communication ID number of the branch node controller is increased in order of the hierarchy based on the message identifier of the communication ID number of the head node controller. The invention realizes the aims of centralized management, unified coordination and hierarchical control.
assignees: SHENZHEN FANHAI SANJIANG ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Central monitoring and management system for detecting dangerous substances
title_ko: 위험물 유출 감지 중앙 감시 관리 시스템
abstract_en: The technical idea of the present invention relates to a central monitoring and management system for detecting the leakage of dangerous substances. An objective of the present invention is to provide the central monitoring and management system for detecting the leakage of dangerous substances that can observe dangerous facilities and report an accident on the dangerous facilities where the accident has occurred. The present invention observes the state of a dangerous facility, reports an accident on the dangerous facility where the accident has occurred, when an accident is expected according to a result of observation, and informs people with terminals around the dangerous facility of the accident to evacuate them from the dangerous facility.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 기술적 사상이 되는 위험물 유출 감지 중앙 감시 관리 시스템에 관한 것으로, 본 발명은 위험 시설물을 관찰하고 사고 발생된 위험 시설물에 대해 사고 신고할 수 있는 위험물 유출 감지 중앙 감시 관리 시스템을 제공하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 본 발명은 위험 시설물의 상태를 관찰하고, 관찰 결과 사고 발생이 예상되는 경우 사고 발생된 위험 시설물에 대해 사고 신고하고, 위험 시설물 주변 단말기로 사고 발생을 전파해서 단말기를 소지한 사용자 또는 주위 사용자가 사고 발생을 인지하고 대피하는 효과를 가질 수 있다.
assignees: YOO JONG GEUN

title_en: DI-SCIR-based double-layer coupling social network public opinion propagation model construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a DI-SCIR (DI-social communication protocol-assisted link) based double-layer coupling social network public opinion propagation model construction method, which comprises the steps of firstly, based on a traditional SCIR model, considering dynamic time variation and direct immunization of the number of network users, and combining with real network public opinion propagation conditions to formulate public opinion propagation rules; secondly, an interlayer strong coupling connection method based on the LBRank is provided; and finally, according to public opinion propagation rules, state transition probability is provided, a differential equation of a public opinion propagation model is established, a final propagation model is generated, and the public opinion propagation process in the double-layer coupled social network can be effectively and accurately reflected.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN JIAOTONG

title_en: Power grid node classification method and computer readable medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid node classification method and a computer readable medium, wherein the power grid node classification method comprises the following steps: step 1: calculating the propagation strength according to the physical attributes and the propagation probability of the power grid nodes; step 2: calculating the network cohesion degree based on the power grid segmentation; and step 3: establishing a fuzzy representative point clustering model based on the degree of agglomeration; and 4, step 4: calculating an objective function value of the fuzzy representative point clustering model based on the degree of cohesion and judging whether an error condition is met, if so, executing the step 5, otherwise, returning to the step 1; and 5: sequencing objective function values to obtain a clustering center; step 6: and carrying out clustering division according to the clustering center to obtain a power grid node classification result. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of high classification accuracy, capability of providing theoretical support for power grid planning and the like.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI DIANJI

title_en: Disaster prediction system and method using major keyword analysis technology of artificial intelligence
title_ko: 인공지능에 의한 빅데이터의 주요 키워드 분석기술을 활용한 재난예측 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a disaster prediction system capable of predicting disasters by analyzing disaster keywords in SNS messages shared between people through the Internet instead of using data detected from various detection devices and a method thereof. To this end, the disaster prediction system comprises: a message screening module analyzing message data published on social media through an Internet network to select the message data containing disaster keywords as disaster message data; a keyword extraction module extracting the disaster keywords on the basis of the disaster message data; a keyword classification module selecting a disaster type matched with the disaster keyword and classifying and storing the disaster keyword by disaster type; a risk estimation module estimating disaster risk by evaluating a value of disaster keywords collected by disaster type for a predetermined time; and a disaster prediction response module comparing and analyzing the disaster risk with a threshold value specified for each type of disaster to propagate disaster prediction information through the Internet network when the disaster risk exceeds the threshold. Accordingly, big data can be built by collecting messages containing disaster keywords from SNS messages published through an Internet network, and disasters such as building collapse can be detected in real-time and be predicted by analyzing the big data.
abstract_ko: 각종 탐지장치로부터 감지된 데이터를 활용하는 대신 인터넷을 통해 사람들 사이에 공유되는 SNS 메시지의 재난 키워드를 분석하여 재난을 예측할 수 있는 재난예측 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다.  이를 위하여 인터넷망을 통해 소셜 미디어에서 공개된 메시지 데이터를 분석하여 재난 키워드가 포함된 메시지 데이터를 재난메시지 데이터로 선택하는 메시지 선별모듈과, 상기 재난메시지 데이터를 기반으로 재난 키워드를 추출하는 키워드 추출모듈과, 상기 재난 키워드에 매칭된 재난 유형을 선정하고, 상기 재난 키워드를 재난 유형별로 분류하여 저장하는 키워드 분류모듈과, 미리 지정된 시간동안 재난 유형별로 수집된 재난 키워드의 가치 평가를 통해 재난 위험도를 산정하는 위험도 산정모듈, 및 상기 재난 위험도를 재난 유형별로 미리 지정된 임계값과 비교 분석하여 재난 위험도가 임계값을 초과하면 재난예측정보를 인터넷망을 통해 전파하는 재난예측 대응모듈을 포함하는 인공지능에 의한 빅데이터의 주요키워드 분석기술을 활용한 재난예측 방법을 제공한다.  본 발명에 의하면, 인터넷망을 통해 공개된 SNS 메시지 중 재난 키워드가 포함된 메시지를 수집하여 빅데이터를 구축하고, 이 빅데이터의 분석을 통해 건축물 붕괴 등의 재난을 실시간으로 감지할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 미리 예측할 수도 있다.
assignees: CATHOLIC UNIV KOREA IND ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Digital power transformer health state fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method
abstract_en: The application discloses a digital power transformer health state fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, which comprises the following steps of 1: selecting evaluation indexes influencing the state of the digital power transformer and carrying out hierarchical division; step 2: dividing the evaluation states of the digital power transformer; and step 3: classifying the evaluation indexes according to the priority and the degradation direction; and 4, step 4: respectively establishing evaluation index membership functions of various categories, determining the weights of evaluation indexes of different levels through a BP (back propagation) neural network, and obtaining a fuzzy evaluation matrix; and 5: and carrying out fuzzy operation by adopting a fuzzy evaluation matrix, and normalizing the operation result to obtain a final evaluation result. According to the method, the evaluation index and the evaluation level are determined according to the influence on the health state of the digital power transformer, and different weights are configured, so that the evaluation result is more reasonable and accurate, the digital power transformer can be effectively evaluated, and the reliability is higher.
assignees: MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Method for predicting importance of nodes of power system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a power system node importance prediction method, which is based on the convolution long-short term memory network to predict the importance of the power system node, and comprises a training set construction process, a model training process and an importance prediction process; the method comprises the following steps that a training set is constructed in the training set construction process based on historical power flow data of power system nodes, a prediction model is trained by using the training set in the model training process to obtain a trained prediction model, and the importance prediction of the power system nodes is carried out by using the trained prediction model in the importance prediction process. The method for predicting the importance of the power system nodes can be used for rapidly and accurately predicting the importance of the power system nodes, so that data guidance is provided for preventing cascading failures in advance and avoiding failures.
assignees: HARBIN INST TECHNOLOGY WEIHAI

title_en: One-key control method and platform for cascade power station group
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power station group control, and discloses a one-key control method for a cascade power station group, which comprises the following steps: obtaining historical order-adjusting data, and inputting the historical order-adjusting data into an order-adjusting model to form an order-adjusting library; matching and associating the typical ticket with the order library to obtain an order ID corresponding to the order of the typical ticket in the order library; associating the specific operation items in the typical ticket with the order ID to establish a ticket rule expert library; the invention uses artificial intelligence technology to realize intelligent ticket forming, network ordering and the like, updates the traditional scheduling business working mode into a new information regulation and control management mode taking artificial intelligence as a core, and does not need to adopt the traditional scheduling business working modes of manually compiling operation tickets, ordering by telephone and the like.
assignees: GUONENG DADU RIVER BASIN HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Cascade power station hydraulic relationship coupling method based on deep learning theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade power station hydraulic relation coupling method based on a deep learning theory, which relates to the technical field of hydroelectric operation and comprises the following steps: s1, selecting input factors based on the conditional mutual information theory in the mutual information; s2, constructing a first model, and performing data processing on the input factors through the first model to obtain a deep learning network model of upstream ex-warehouse traffic and downstream in-warehouse traffic; s3, determining the hydraulic coupling relation of the upstream and downstream cascade power stations according to the deep learning network model of the upstream ex-warehouse flow and the downstream in-warehouse flow, and determining the warehouse flow of the downstream power station based on the hydraulic coupling relation of the upstream and downstream cascade power stations; the design realizes the coupling calculation of the hydraulic power relation of the upstream and downstream cascade power stations in the electric power spot market, and can provide important technical support for the operation of the electric power spot market mainly based on water and electricity.
assignees: STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SICHUAN;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: Urban power grid cascading failure risk assessment method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a city power grid cascading failure risk assessment method and system, wherein tidal current probability models of wind power generation, photovoltaic power generation and electric vehicle charging stations are respectively built, and compared with the prior art, the consideration factors are more comprehensive. In the process of solving the probability trend, a semi-invariant method is used for converting random variables into semi-invariant, and meanwhile, compared with a Monte Carlo method, the semi-invariant method adopting a Cornish-Fisher series expansion formula has higher calculation speed and is more beneficial to realizing online evaluation; compared with the semi-invariant method of the Gram-Charlie series expansion, the situation that the probability density function has negative values does not occur. The urban power grid cascading failure risk assessment method based on the probability trend has the advantages that the established model is more complete, the considered factors are more comprehensive, the solving method is more efficient and the like. Therefore, the technical problem that the risk of the actual power grid cascading failure can not be quickly and accurately evaluated in the prior art is solved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ZHUHAI POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Multi-time-scale nested wind, light and water multi-energy complementary scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-time scale nested wind, light and water multi-energy complementary scheduling method, which belongs to the technical field of multi-energy comprehensive utilization and is used for exerting electric quantity compensation benefits of wind, light and water multi-energy complementation on a long term and electric power compensation benefits on a short term; the core of long-term scheduling is that the complementary advantage of multi-energy complementary electric quantity is played by changing the water level control mode of a large reservoir in a drainage basin, and the utilization efficiency of clean energy is improved; on the premise of meeting long-term water level constraint, short-term scheduling utilizes the flexible water and electricity regulation capability to carry out 'primary power compensation' regulation on the natural randomness, the intermittence and the fluctuation of wind and light output, thereby reducing the impact of the wind and light output on the safe and stable operation of a power grid; and the wind and light forecast deviation is regulated by 'secondary power compensation' by scheduling in real time and utilizing the water power, a day-ahead output plan is tracked, the power supply reliability of the system is ensured, and sufficient energy storage is left for the cascade hydropower station system through the control of the last storage capacity so as to ensure the long-term power generation benefit of the system.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Multi-beam feed network design method based on 180-degree directional coupler
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-beam feed network design method based on a 180-degree directional coupler, which comprises the following steps: s1: according to the requirements of application scenes, executing a feed network structure design scheme to obtain a feed network cascade structure; s2: executing a device optimization design scheme according to the feed network cascade structure to obtain an optimization result; s3: determining the power distribution ratio of the 180-degree directional coupler according to the optimization result; s4: obtaining the specific structure of the 180-degree directional coupler according to the power distribution ratio; s5: and cascading a plurality of 180-degree directional couplers to obtain a final comprehensive multi-beam feed network. The method for designing the multi-beam feed network based on the 180-degree directional coupler can solve the technical problem that the existing multi-beam feed network cannot simultaneously consider the number of network ports and the beam forming requirement.

title_en: Electric energy quality analysis and identification method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric energy quality analysis and identification method based on deep learning, which comprises the steps of collecting electric energy signals to be detected, randomly dividing the electric energy signals to be detected into a training sample set and a testing sample set, inputting the training sample set into a long-short term memory network (LSTM) model for training to obtain the trained LSTM model, and inputting the testing sample set into the trained LSTM model for testing the electric energy quality disturbance classification condition. According to the method, the long-time memory network is used as a model for electric energy signal classification, the model is trained through a Softmax function and a back propagation algorithm, convergence is rapidly achieved, feature extraction through human intervention is avoided, electric energy quality signal classification is directly achieved, errors are reduced, identification accuracy is improved, and the method is high in practicability.
assignees: UNIV XIAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Fault diagnosis method and device for electric vehicle charging equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault diagnosis method, a fault diagnosis device and a storage medium for electric vehicle charging equipment, wherein the fault diagnosis method for the electric vehicle charging equipment comprises the following steps: acquiring state parameter information data of the charging equipment; the state parameter information comprises the fault time, the fault type, the fault position and the equipment state parameter of the equipment; extracting the parameter characteristics of the state parameter information data by adopting sampling windows, convolution kernels and step lengths with different sizes based on a convolution neural network CNN to obtain multi-scale characteristics; and inputting the multi-scale features into a trained error back propagation BP neural network, and outputting the fault reason of the charging equipment by the BP neural network. The method combines the CNN and the BP neural network, acquires the key characteristics of the fault types through the CNN, and performs iterative learning based on error reverse direction propagation on the fault reasons of the equipment and the system parameters of the charging equipment by combining the BP neural network, thereby realizing accurate diagnosis of the fault reasons of the charging equipment.
assignees: GCI SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD;GUANGZHOU JIESAI COMM PLANNING & DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Non-stationary multivariable causal relationship analysis method for gas turbine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-stationary multivariable causal relationship analysis method for a gas turbine. The method is used for extracting the data fluctuation trend through the rank vector and converting the data fluctuation trend into a limited symbol sequence set aiming at the large-range non-stable operation working condition continuously appearing in the operation process of the gas turbine, and quantitatively evaluating the direction and the strength of information transmission between variables by using the multivariate symbol transfer entropy. Meanwhile, a statistical hypothesis testing process is designed, and the significance of the causal relationship of the actual variables is judged by randomly recombining the variable time sequence information as a reference group, so that the redundant false causal relationship among the variables is simplified. And finally establishing a multivariable causal connection network. The method not only can reveal the variable causal relationship of a large-range non-stationary process, but also has robustness to noise interference in a severe industrial environment, establishes a system bottom layer interaction mechanism model in a data driving mode, and provides a high-efficiency and reliable new thought for state evaluation and fault propagation path analysis of a gas turbine system.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Distribution-gas network distributed collaborative planning method and system considering influence of power transmission network
abstract_en: The utility model provides a distribution-gas network distributed collaborative planning method and system considering the influence of a power transmission network, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a typical operation scene of a power distribution-gas network; obtaining an optimal distributed collaborative planning scheme of the power distribution-gas network according to the obtained typical operation scene and a preset power distribution-gas network distributed collaborative planning model; the power distribution-gas network distributed collaborative planning model comprises a power transmission network sub-problem mixed integer quadratic planning model, a power distribution network sub-problem mixed integer quadratic planning model and a gas distribution network sub-problem mixed integer quadratic planning model, and distributed iterative solution is sequentially carried out on the three mixed integer quadratic planning models by using a target cascade analysis algorithm. According to the distributed collaborative planning method, a distributed solving process based on a target cascade analysis algorithm is established by establishing a mixed integer quadratic planning model of a power transmission network, a power distribution network and a gas distribution network, and distributed collaborative planning of a plurality of power distribution-gas networks is realized.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO WEIFANG POWER SUPPLY CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Distributed energy transaction method and system among multiple participating subjects
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed energy trading method and system among multiple participating subjects, which combines a game theory and an energy blockchain, complementarily optimizes the energy Internet through a blockchain technology, can effectively reduce the security guarantee cost without the advantage of a third party trust mechanism, promotes the efficient operation of a service, considers the game behavior generated by benefits between an energy user and an energy merchant and the physical constraints of energy quantity, security and the like, ensures that the trading process is safer and more reliable, reduces the network propagation overhead through improving PBFT algorithm, shortens the block consensus time, and can more meet the service requirement of the energy Internet on the trading efficiency.

title_en: Complex power grid priority protection set determination method fusing associated structure holes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining a priority protection set of a complex power grid fusing associated structure holes, which comprises the following steps: s1: acquiring data information of a power system; s2: constructing a self-dual bipartite graph; s3: establishing a fault line breaking model; s4: calculating a disconnection sensitive factor; s5: calculating an improved betweenness centrality index; s6: calculating the characteristic index of the associated structure hole; s7: calculating the improved betweenness centrality index after normalization; s8: calculating the normalized associated structure hole characteristic index; s9: calculating a distribution weight coefficient; s10: compute node v i The comprehensive index of (a) is fragile potential energy; s11: compute node v i+1 The comprehensive index of (a) is fragile potential energy; s12: computing the comprehensiveness of all nodesThe index is fragile potential energy; s13: arranging the fragile potential energy in a descending order to obtain a priority protection set; the method can effectively identify the fragile line of the power grid, solve the problem of relevance between power transmission lines after the power grid fault occurs, and reduce the occurrence probability of cascading faults.
assignees: UNIV XIHUA

title_en: Emergency signal priority and social vehicle dynamic path induction collaborative optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency signal priority and social vehicle dynamic path induction collaborative optimization method, which is based on a complex network theory to construct a road network toughness capability index; and deleting the nodes with lower toughness. On the basis, an emergency rescue path double-layer planning model is constructed, and the upper-layer target is to maximize the reduction amount of emergency signals preferentially corresponding to the delay of emergency rescue vehicles, so that the travel delay of the emergency rescue vehicles is minimum; the underlying goal is to optimize traffic flow distribution such that travel time of social vehicles is minimized. And after the emergency vehicle passes through one intersection, updating the sub-network, the emergency rescue path, the emergency signal priority strategy and the social vehicle guidance scheme according to the traffic state of the current road network until the emergency vehicle reaches the accident site. The invention considers the negative influence of the emergency rescue task on the road network toughness capability, constructs a double-layer planning model to realize game balance between the emergency rescue efficiency and the social vehicle passing efficiency, and effectively avoids the occurrence of road network cascade failure and even secondary traffic accidents.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Electric DebtRank algorithm-based electric power system fragile line identification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric power system fragile line identification method based on an electric DebtRank algorithm. Firstly, establishing a dual topology model of the power system, wherein lines in the power system correspond to nodes in the dual topology model, and the connection relationship among the lines corresponds to edges of the dual topology model; then, the three states of the normal state, the heavy load state and the fault state of the line are included in the identification process of the fragile line, and an electric DebtRank algorithm considering the line load flow and the network topological structure is provided for identifying the fragile line of the power system; finally, through power system cascading failure simulation comparative analysis, the weak line identified by the electrical DebtRank algorithm is proved to have larger influence on the power system compared with the existing method. The method can identify the fragile lines in the power system, strengthen and protect the fragile lines, can effectively prevent cascading failures caused by the weak links, and can provide a certain reference value for avoiding blackout accidents.
assignees: UNIV XIANGTAN

title_en: Multi-index power grid node vulnerability assessment method fusing structure hole characteristics
abstract_en: A multi-index power grid node vulnerability assessment method fusing structural hole characteristics is characterized in that node degree and clustering coefficient indexes are selected by considering topological characteristics; selecting low-power risk factors, node voltage out-of-limit risks and node electrical betweenness indexes by considering electrical performance; selecting a loss load index in consideration of the cascading failure result; and selecting PageRank, LeaderRank and HITs indexes based on the sorting of the feature vectors, and comprehensively sorting the power grid nodes by 9 evaluation indexes from the four aspects. Constructing a power grid key node sorting algorithm considering the structural hole characteristics based on ListNet sorting learning, firstly randomly generating initial weight coefficient values of all node indexes, and obtaining initial scores of all nodes by using a scoring function h (x); and then substituting the index weight coefficient into a linear neural network model, updating the index weight coefficient by a gradient descent method, controlling circulation by using iteration times until the obtained index weight coefficient value reaches a stable state, outputting the weight coefficient value at the moment, and finally obtaining the scores of all nodes of the power grid according to a scoring function h (x) and sequencing.
assignees: UNIV XIANGTAN

title_en: Power transmission and distribution coordination planning method considering generalized load random characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission and distribution coordination planning method considering generalized load random characteristics, which decomposes a power transmission and distribution coupling system into a plurality of small systems according to a physical structure and then constructs a distributed decision framework of power transmission and distribution iteration interaction. Firstly, fitting a probability density function of generalized load containing distributed new energy according to actual measurement data, randomly sampling generalized load values by using a Monte Carlo sampling method, and sequentially connecting the generalized load values into a power distribution network with new energy power generation. And independently operating each power transmission system and each power distribution system, and solving the boundary power between power transmission and power distribution. The invention provides the method for realizing information transfer between the power transmission system and the power distribution system by using the mean value and standard deviation of boundary power as shared variables and using a probabilistic target cascading algorithm, and writing the target function with the Lagrange penalty function by using the lowest total running cost of the system as a target column, thereby not only not reducing the calculation precision, but also greatly improving the calculation speed.

title_en: Method for evaluating stability of multi-layer urban group comprehensive passenger transport network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating the stability of a multilayer urban group comprehensive passenger transport network, which comprises the following steps: step 1: constructing a traffic district-traffic subnet multi-layer city group comprehensive passenger transport network model; step 2: simulating the stability cascade failure of the multi-layer urban group comprehensive passenger transport network; and step 3: and simulating and analyzing the network stability under the condition of sudden increase of passenger flow of the key nodes. The invention has the advantages that: the urban internal traffic is considered, an urban comprehensive passenger transport network model closer to the reality is constructed, a plurality of practical influence factors of networks of different layers are fully considered for weighting, the capacity of the passenger transport traffic network for dealing with emergency is enhanced, the capacity limit of stations and different overload degrees of nodes are fully considered, the node state is closer to the congestion degree of the practical stations, the conditions of surge and cascade failure of node passenger flow are considered, a network stability measure index is provided, and the capacity of the network for dealing with emergency such as station failure, surge of passenger flow and the like is enhanced.
assignees: UNIV INNER MONGOLIA

title_en: Power grid unit combination and technical improvement plan combined optimization method
abstract_en: A power grid unit combination and technical improvement plan combined optimization method comprises the steps of firstly, respectively constructing unit combination and technical improvement plan combined optimization submodels of a power transmission network and a power distribution network by taking the minimum sum of unit combination cost and technical improvement cost as a target, and then solving the constructed power transmission network optimization submodels and power distribution network optimization submodels by adopting an improved target cascade analysis algorithm on the basis of topology, load, units, new energy, technical improvement projects and electricity price parameters of the power transmission network and the power distribution network to obtain unit combination and technical improvement plan optimization results of the power transmission network and the power distribution network. The method not only effectively considers the load power supply requirement and the technical improvement construction requirement of the system, but also improves the convergence, and shows strong adaptability in a high-proportion new energy power system.

title_en: Power distributing board having system for sensing and checking deterioration of electrical equipment insulator
title_ko: 전기설비의 절연물 특성 열화 감시 및 진단 시스템을 내장한 수배전반
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a switchgear having an insulation object feature deterioration monitoring and diagnosing system of an electrical facility embedded therein. The switchgear comprises: a detection unit comprising an ultraviolet detection sensor, an ultrasonic detection sensor, and a helical antenna; a photographing unit made of a plurality of cameras; a first operation unit generating first deterioration information of internal devices; a second operation unit generating second deterioration information of the internal devices; and a determination unit that determines deterioration of an insulation object of the internal devices. Therefore, the switchgear can quickly respond to an emergency situation in which an electrical facility abnormality occurs.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전기설비의 절연물 특성 열화 감시 및 진단 시스템을 내장한 수배전반이고, 상기 전기설비의 절연물 특성 열화 감시 및 진단 시스템은, 수배전반 내부기기들의 절연물의 열화에 의하여 발생되는 자외선을 검출하는 자외선 감지센서와, 수배전반 내부기기들의 절연물의 열화에 의하여 발생되는 초음파를 감지하는 초음파 감지센서와, 수배전반 내부기기들의 절연물의 열화에 의하여 발생되는 전파를 감지하는 헬리컬 안테나로 구성되고, 수배전반 내부에서 발생되는 자외선, 초음파 및 전파 발생량에 따라 전기신호를 발생시키는 검출부; 복수 개의 카메라로 구성되어 상기 수배전반 내부기기들의 절연물을 포함하는 절연물 이미지를 촬영하는 촬영부; 상기 검출부에서 검출된 전기신호를 연속적으로 공급받아, 이를 기초로 생성되는 열화상태 변화율값 및 열화상태 변화누적값을 연산하며, 상기 열화상태 변화율값 및 열화상태 변화누적 값을 이용하여 상기 검출부에 의하여 검출된 내부기기들의 제1 열화정보를 생성하는 제1 연산부; 상기 절연물 이미지에 포함된 절연물 영역에 대하여 픽셀 당 RGB (Red Green Blue) 값을 확인하고, 픽셀당 RGB 값에서의 R 색상, G 색상 및 B 색상 간의 관계를 이용하여 내부기기들의 제2 열화정보를 생성하는 제2 연산부; 및 상기 제1 열화정보 및 제2 열화정보와 기준 열화정보를 비교하고, 비교 결과를 기초로 소정의 열화판정 알고리즘에 의하여 내부기기들의 절연물의 열화를 판정하는 판정부를 포함하여 구성되는 전기설비의 절연물 특성 열화 감시 및 진단 시스템을 내장한 수배전반에 관한 것으로, 수배전반의 열화에 따른 자외선, 초음파, 전파 및 온도 정보 등을 종합적으로 감지하여 검출하고, 신뢰성, 실용성 및 경제성이 있는 열화감시 및 진단방법을 통해 전기설비 이상 발생 시 긴급상황에 신속하게 대처할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: TCMS network fault propagation analysis method based on SIR model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a TCMS network fault propagation analysis method based on an SIR model, which comprises the following steps: carrying out architecture analysis on the TCMS system, and establishing a TCMS fault propagation structure network based on an architecture establishing method; carrying out propagation mechanism hypothesis on the TCMS fault propagation structure network, and determining an SIR fault propagation model suitable for TCMS fault propagation characteristic analysis; solving and analyzing an SIR fault propagation model through SIR evolution equation application; carrying out simulation test on the TCMS software system by using a Netlogo programmable simulation platform to obtain a fault propagation simulation numerical analysis diagram under different simulation parameters; and carrying out fault propagation prediction analysis according to each fault propagation simulation numerical analysis graph to obtain a TCMS network fault propagation conclusion. The invention can reduce the fault propagation probability of the TCMS network, reduce the occurrence of fault propagation and improve the reliability of the TCMS system.
assignees: CRRC CHANGCHUN RAILWAY VEHICLES CO LTD

title_en: Predicting method of wildfire propagation areas and system thereof
abstract_en: A predicting method of a plurality of wildfire propagation areas includes a network constructing step, a normalized adjacency matrix constructing step, a node ranking value calculating step, a state ranking value calculating step, a source node determining step and an occurrence probability calculating step. The node ranking value calculating step is performed to calculate a ranking value and a plurality of states of each of the nodes. The normalized adjacency matrix constructing step is performed to construct a normalized matrix. The state ranking value calculating step is performed to calculate a state ranking value and a state probability of each of the nodes. The source node determining step is performed to determine a source node of the wildfire propagation areas and the states corresponding to the source node. The occurrence probability calculating step is performed to calculate the occurrence probability of the wildfire propagation areas.
assignees: UNIV NAT TSING HUA

title_en: Distributed generalized energy storage convergence coordination method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed generalized energy storage convergence coordination method which is suitable for converging scattered generalized energy storage resources in space-time distribution and assisting power grid operation.
