It includes: 1) acquiring relevant operation parameters of distributed generalized energy storage; 2) evaluating the schedulable potential of the distributed generalized energy storage participating in convergence by utilizing an analytic hierarchy process based on the obtained parameters; 3) designing the schedulable potential of distributed generalized energy storage according to the relative importance degree of the rule layer factors of the analytic hierarchy process, and establishing a aggregator-distributed generalized energy storage shunting step convergence utilization framework; 4) on the basis of a shunting cascade convergence utilization architecture, a convergence cooperative interaction model is established by using a Stackelberg game, so that convergence multiplexing is realized. The distributed generalized energy storage convergence collaborative modeling method can realize the schedulable potential evaluation of the distributed generalized energy storage, the multiplexing scene shunting and individual cascade output sequencing of the distributed generalized energy storage with different characteristics, and the distributed generalized energy storage convergence collaborative modeling, and finally realize the distributed generalized energy storage convergence multiplexing.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: Wind power prediction method based on combination of transfer learning and deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power prediction method based on combination of transfer learning and deep learning, which comprises the steps of extracting historical samples of a newly-built wind power plant and peripheral wind power plants through an SCADA (supervisory control and data acquisition) system and numerical weather forecast, training BP-NN (back propagation-neural network) by using a small amount of historical samples of the newly-built wind power plants, predicting a large amount of historical samples of the peripheral wind power plants, and calculating a correlation coefficient of each historical sample of the peripheral wind power plants according to a prediction result; according to the correlation coefficient, a large number of historical samples of the peripheral wind power plant are taken as strong correlation samples, medium correlation samples and weak correlation samples; respectively using three model migration methods of sequential migration, reverse order migration, unordered migration and the like to construct a prediction model for a newly-built wind power plant and respectively giving prediction results; and finally, integrating the three prediction results by using a B-LSTM network, and outputting a final prediction result. According to the method, a prediction model suitable for a newly-built wind power plant is obtained by data mining and combining a deep learning algorithm and utilizing multi-level model migration, the prediction precision of the newly-built wind power plant is improved, and the method has popularization value.
assignees: UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Active disturbance rejection control system for static optimization of central air-conditioning refrigeration station
abstract_en: The invention discloses an active disturbance rejection control system for static optimization of a central air-conditioning refrigeration station, wherein an air-conditioning load prediction unit is used for predicting load through a BP (back propagation) neural network; the central air-conditioning refrigeration station model calculation unit is used for executing one of a single model modeling mode and a multi-model fusion modeling mode; the system working point optimization unit is used for calculating the optimal working point of the system by using an optimization algorithm; and the central control refrigeration station control unit is used for tracking control by adopting an active disturbance rejection controller. The invention also discloses an active disturbance rejection control method for the static optimization of the central air-conditioning refrigeration station. The system and the method determine the optimal working point of the system closest to the actual value by accurately establishing a static model and predicting the cold load, and adopt the active disturbance rejection controller to carry out tracking control on the optimal working point of the system, thereby realizing the optimization and energy conservation of the central air-conditioning refrigeration station.
assignees: LI ZHUANGJU;GUO HONG

title_en: Charging equipment fault rate analysis system and method based on BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power grid informatization, and particularly relates to a charging equipment fault rate analysis system and method based on a BP (back propagation) neural network. The data preprocessing module is used for preprocessing data derived from the Internet of vehicles platform; the index system building module comprehensively constructs indexes influencing the fault rate of the charging equipment from multiple dimensions to form a charging equipment fault rate analysis index system; the model construction module constructs multi-dimensional wide-table data of the charging equipment according to the fault rate analysis index system, and constructs and trains a BP neural network model to predict the fault rate of the charging equipment; and the analysis and decision module analyzes factors influencing the failure rate of the charging equipment in a multi-dimensional manner and provides data support for decision making. The invention can fully utilize the multi-dimensional information of the operation of the charging equipment, comprehensively and effectively predict the failure rate of the charging equipment and provide effective support for improving the equipment investment yield.
assignees: BRILLIANT DATA CO LTD

title_en: Method, device and equipment for quantitatively evaluating risks of cascading failures of power grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method, a device and equipment for quantitatively evaluating risks of power grid cascading failures, belonging to the technical field of risk evaluation of power systems, wherein the method, the device and the equipment obtain risk factor data of target power grid cascading failures, and the risk factor data comprises the following steps: grid structure, target power grid power supply structure and target power grid overall tide distribution information; determining the occurrence probability of each risk factor and the grade of the consequences generated after the cascading failure occurs based on a preset model and risk factor data; according to the occurrence probability of each risk factor and the grade of the consequences generated after the cascading failure occurs, quantitative evaluation is performed on the risk of the target grid cascading failure, so that the risk of the grid cascading failure is evaluated, early warning is performed on the risk, loss is reduced, and the problem to be solved urgently in the prior art is solved.
assignees: POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL BRANCH OF INNER MONGOLIA POWER GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Distributed energy source cold, heat and power active variable working condition optimization regulation and control method and system based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention provides a distributed energy combined cooling heating and power active variable working condition optimization regulation and control method and system based on edge calculation, wherein a control optimization system is divided into two layers, one layer is deployed at the cloud end, and planning management of a large number of distributed energy subsystems is realized; the system comprises a distributed energy source, a network and load key equipment, wherein one layer is arranged on the edge side, data acquisition and direct management of the distributed energy source, the network and the load key equipment are realized, aiming at a distributed energy system which is constantly changed and is technically updated, the acquisition and analysis of energy data are realized through a two-layer system of cloud computing and edge computing, an optimal scheme is calculated, an optimal operation strategy and parameters are designed, update application can be pushed in time through the management of the edge computing, the cascade utilization of the energy can be carried out according to the space-time change of distributed energy according to the requirement of islands, meanwhile, the refrigeration and dehumidification are driven by the waste heat of a recovery diesel engine, the energy utilization efficiency of an energy supply system is greatly improved, and meanwhile, edge cloud cooperative computing is utilized.
assignees: HAINAN GREEN ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENTAL ENGINEERING INSTITUTE OF TECH

title_en: Automatic searching and early warning method, device and equipment for power grid cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method, a device and equipment for automatically searching and early warning cascading failures of a power grid, belonging to the technical field of risk early warning of power systems, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring initial fault information of a target power grid; calculating the line load rate, the electrical betweenness and the on-off influence value of each line of the target power grid; and according to the line load rate, the electrical betweenness and the on-off influence value of each line of the target power grid, and a dispatcher experience elicitation and a non-public cause cascading failure search strategy, starting a preset system cascading failure search rule through periodic triggering and/or non-periodic triggering, performing enumerated automatic search on a power flow transfer path after initial multiple failures of the power grid occur, taking a branch with heavier load and larger transfer factor in the transfer path as a candidate cascading failure, finding out a dangerous path set possibly causing the power grid cascading failure from the candidate cascading failure, obtaining a target power grid cascading failure prediction path, and performing early warning on the target power grid cascading failure prediction path to reduce loss.
assignees: POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL BRANCH OF INNER MONGOLIA POWER GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Method for eliminating rubber interference gasoline identification by using back propagation neural network method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for eliminating rubber interference gasoline identification by using a back propagation neural network method. According to the invention, on the premise of considering the actual fire scene environment as much as possible, the gas chromatograph-mass spectrometer is utilized to detect the rubber and gasoline samples, and meanwhile, the influence of other interference conditions on analysis and classification is considered; compared with the traditional manual identification, the method has the advantages of rapidness, high efficiency, high accuracy and the like, provides a method for eliminating the interference of rubber on gasoline, and provides a scientific reference for fire investigation personnel.

title_en: Minimization of service interruption
title_ko: 서비스 중단의 최소화
abstract_en: User equipment (UE) may detect a disaster condition, and the resolution thereof, based on broadcast information, RRC messaging, NAS messaging, the ability to connect to an allowable PLMN, and indications from forbidden PLMNs. In a disaster condition, a UE may perform an enhanced PLMN selection procedure wherein, for example, the UE will not consider PLMNs that are in a disaster situation if the disaster situation applies to a current location of the UE, prioritize forbidden PLMNs for disaster roaming connection. For disaster roaming connection, the UE may be configured by an otherwise forbidden PLMN with information about what services the UE can access and what type of authentication procedure the network is able to perform with UE. Upon detecting that the disaster condition is over, the UE move back to an allowable PLMN.
abstract_ko: 사용자 장비(UE)는, 브로드캐스트 정보, RRC 메시징, NAS 메시징, 허용가능 PLMN에 접속하는 능력, 및 금지된 PLMN들로부터의 표시들에 기초하여 재난 조건, 및 그의 해결책을 검출할 수 있다.  재난 조건에서, UE는 향상된 PLMN 선택 절차를 수행할 수 있으며, 여기서 예를 들어, UE는, 재난 상황이 UE의 현재 위치에 적용되는 경우 재난 상황에 있는 PLMN들을 고려하지 않고, 재난 로밍 접속을 위해 금지된 PLMN들을 우선순위화할 것이다.  재난 로밍 접속을 위해, UE는, UE가 어떠한 서비스에 액세스할지 그리고 네트워크가 UE와 어떠한 유형의 인증 절차를 수행할 수 있는지에 관한 정보로 달리 금지된 PLMN에 의해 구성될 수 있다.  재난 조건이 종료되었음을 검출할 시에, UE는 허용가능 PLMN으로 다시 이동한다.
assignees: INTERDIGITAL PATENT HOLDINGS INC

title_en: Internet of Thing (IoT) and Cyber Security Technique based Plant Emergency Monitoring and Communication Network
title_ko: IoT 및 암호화 통신보안 기반을 이용한 원자력발전소 플랜트 통제시스템 및 이를 이용한 감시통제 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to nuclear power plant emergency monitoring and Wi-Fi communication technology employing Internet-of-Things technology and an encryption communication security technique and, more specifically, to a system employing FPGA-based hardware and driven with lithium-ion batteries, thereby making a contribution to the minimization of the range and influence of an incident by promptly transmitting necessary information to an emergency situation room through the attachment of a modularized IoT device when the function of an existing monitoring facility is stopped in case of an emergency in a plant. Therefore, in the present technological field, when every power source of the plant is disabled and even a wired communication network cannot be connected, a near field communication network such as Wi-Fi is autonomously formed to necessarily provide information, and, moreover, hardware-based FPGA technology having a recovery force to minimize influences from a cyberattack by a hacker, or a local electromagnetic interference situation during a data transmission procedure can be applied.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 사물인터넷 기술과 암호화 통신보안 기법을 적용한 원자력발전소 비상상태 감시 및 와이파이 통신 기술에 관한 것으로서, FPGA를 이용한 하드웨어를 채택하고 리튬-이온 지로 구동하는 것을 특징으로 하여, 플랜트에 비상상태가 발생하여 기존의 감시설비의 기능이 정지되었을 때 모듈화된 IoT 기기를 부착하여 비상 상황실에 필요한 정보를 제때에 전송하여 사고의 파급범위와 영향을 최소화하는데 기여하는 시스템에 관한 것이다. 따라서 본 기술분야에서는 플랜트의 전원이 모두 불능상태가 되고 유선 통신망마저 연결되지 않을 때 와이파이와 같은 근거리 통신망을 자체적으로 구성하여 정보를 제공하는 것이 필수적이며, 아울러 데이터 전송과정에서 해커에 의한 사이버 공격이나, 국부적인 전자파 장애 상황에도 영향을 최소화할 수 있는 회복력을 가진 하드웨어 기반의 FPGA 기술을 적용하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: KINGS R&DB FOUND

title_en: Dynamic simulation method for ground wire current of power distribution system of data center
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic simulation method for ground wire current of a power distribution system of a data center, which is used for calculating the ground wire current of the whole topological network through simulation after obtaining the ground wire current characteristic and the circuit topological structure of end-use electric equipment (namely leaf nodes), so as to promote the cognition and the mastering of the distribution rule of the ground wire current of the power distribution system, be conductive to studying and judging the rationality of the ground wire current value, further improve the operation safety of the data center, and further effectively solve the problem that the distribution characteristic of the ground wire current of the data center cannot be determined and the propagation rule of the distribution characteristic cannot be mastered in the prior art.
assignees: NAT COMPUTER NETWORK & INF SECURITY MANAGEMENT CT

title_en: Oil reservoir fracturing fracture network expansion path calculation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for calculating a fracture propagation path, which comprises the steps of acquiring geological parameters of various reservoirs required to be used in the fracture propagation process, and determining the circumferential stress distribution formed by the tip of a fracture and the critical fracture stress of each geological unit body around the tip of the fracture according to the geological parameters of the various reservoirs and the distribution rule of natural fractures; for a geological unit body with a formed secondary fracture, when the circumferential stress around the fracture tip is greater than the critical fracture stress, the fracture morphology is output. The method also calculates the crack initiation stress intensity according to the circumferential stress and the crack initiation critical stress; determining the crack propagation probability of each geological unit body around the secondary crack tip according to the crack initiation stress intensity and the fractal probability index; and determining the crack propagation direction by combining all the crack propagation probabilities. According to the method, the problem that the description of a deterministic fracture propagation simulation method is unclear due to unclear reservoir parameters is solved through the fractal probability index.
assignees: UNIV YANGTZE

title_en: Construction resource monitoring method and system for cascade development and construction of hydropower basin
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a construction resource monitoring method and system for hydropower basin step development and construction, belongs to the technical field of hydropower engineering, and the construction resource monitoring system for hydropower basin step development and construction comprises: the construction scheme acquisition module is used for acquiring a construction scheme, and the construction scheme comprises a construction period, a construction area, a transportation route, constructors and transportation vehicles; the construction resource monitoring module comprises a wireless network unit, a constructor mobile monitoring unit and a transport vehicle mobile monitoring unit, wherein the constructor mobile monitoring unit is used for acquiring the personnel position information of constructors based on the wireless network unit in the construction period, and the transport vehicle mobile monitoring unit is used for acquiring the transport track of a transport vehicle; and the data processing module is used for detecting construction abnormal behaviors based on the transportation route, the construction area, the personnel position information and the transportation track to generate a detection result.
assignees: GUONENG DADUHE BIG DATA SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Multi-provincial power grid weekly operation planning method
abstract_en: The application relates to a multi-provincial power grid weekly operation planning method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring boundary data for calculating the operation period of the power grid; creating a long-period optimized scheduling model according to the boundary data, and obtaining day boundary data of a future week through the long-period optimized scheduling model; and performing multi-day rolling optimization calculation on the day boundary data of the next week to obtain a daily power generation and transmission plan. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device can divide the problem of the work-out of the power grid weekly operation plan into two processes of long-period unified optimization calculation and multi-day rolling optimization calculation, and differential modeling is adopted in a long-period unified optimization model and a day-ahead optimization scheduling model, so that the accuracy and the solving efficiency of the model are ensured, the feasibility and the safety of the multi-provincial power grid operation considering cascade hydropower are improved, and the actual application requirements are met.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Demand response potential evaluation method based on deep forest
abstract_en: The invention discloses a demand response potential evaluation method based on deep forest, which comprises the following steps: collecting historical electricity utilization data and flexible load data of a user for preprocessing to obtain analysis data of user demand response potential, and dividing the analysis data into training data and verification data; sampling the training data to obtain sampled data; generating and training a neural network by taking the sampled data as input according to a BP back propagation algorithm, and establishing a plurality of neural network identification models according to the requirements of data scale and precision; and the neural networks are connected in parallel to form a deep forest model; verifying the deep forest model; inputting the demand response potential analysis data of the target user into the demand response potential prediction of the trained deep forest model, and finishing the demand response potential evaluation of the target user; the technical problems that the method in the prior art consumes a large amount of time, manpower and material resources, and is poor in effect, small in information amount, low in user acceptance degree and the like are solved.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Improved SIR information transmission model and method for multi-source regional distribution
abstract_en: The invention discloses an improved SIR information transmission model and method for multisource regional distribution, which mainly carry out simulation analysis on information transmission through the following steps, firstly, an information transmission model is selected; secondly, constructing an information propagation model; then, improving the model according to an information transmission mode; secondly, carrying out simulation analysis on the improved model; and finally, outputting a simulation result of the SIR information transmission model. The invention can carry out model simulation of the transmission information from the time and space angles by carrying out model simulation on different information types, different transmission media and different audience characteristics. Meanwhile, the invention sets cross-region transmission based on social network model link, and the simulated information can be transmitted from any position at any time, thereby conforming to the information deployment mode and transmission effect in the information network era. The invention can effectively analyze the information transmission effects of different subjects.
assignees: BEIJING QINGXIN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-hop ad hoc network equipment cascade test device based on passive device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of performance test of ad hoc network equipment used in fire fighting and rescue fields of fire fighting and rescue teams, in particular to a multi-hop ad hoc network equipment cascade test device based on a passive device. Including shielding case lid and shielding case, testing arrangement inside be equipped with two arm bridge I, two arm bridge II, two merit divide ware I, two merits divide ware II, the ad hoc network equipment that awaits measuring, the one end of attenuator is connected with N type radio frequency adapter I on the shielding case, the outside load of shielding case is connected with N type radio frequency adapter II on the shielding case. The frequency of the first power divider I is 350-2700 MHz, and the frequency of the second power divider II is 800-2700 MHz. The power of the first double-arm bridge I is 800 plus 2700MHz, and the power of the second double-arm bridge II is 350 plus 1000 MHz. The ad hoc network equipment to be tested is connected with the network switching interface on the shielding box body through the network cable.
assignees: SHENYANG FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Opportunity constraint considered maximum energy supply capacity evaluation method for electrical coupling system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evaluation method for the maximum energy supply capacity of an electric coupling system in consideration of opportunity constraint, which comprises the steps of constructing an evaluation model for the maximum energy supply capacity of the electric coupling system in consideration of random wind energy output and opportunity constraint; secondly, converting the wind energy output joint opportunity constraint into an equivalent mixed integer linear constraint group by adopting a Boolean reconstruction method; then, converting the model into a mixed integer second-order cone programming model containing a penalty term by adopting a convex-concave method; and finally, decomposing the model into power grid and gas grid submodels for distributed iterative solution based on a target cascade analysis method. According to the method, the coupling relation of the power grid and the air network is fully considered, the influence of the output randomness of the fan is considered, and a maximum energy supply capacity evaluation model of the electric coupling system is established; the method is based on a target cascade decomposition method, decomposes the integral model into a power grid sub-model and a power grid sub-model for distributed independent solution, and meets the actual engineering requirements better.

title_en: Foldable temporary fire-fighting water tank
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a foldable temporary fire-fighting water tank, which comprises a fire-fighting water tank main body, wherein the fire-fighting water tank main body comprises a horizontally arranged bottom plate and a fixed frame positioned above the bottom plate, and waterproof cloth is hermetically and circularly connected between the fixed frame and the side of the bottom plate; the two opposite sides of the bottom plate and the fixed frame are connected through a support piece, the support piece comprises a pair of symmetrical connecting plates, the pair of connecting plates are respectively and rotatably connected with the sides of the bottom plate and the fixed frame, and a clamping mechanism capable of vertically fixing the pair of connecting plates is rotatably connected between the pair of connecting plates; the clamping mechanism comprises an installation shell and a clamping ring which are respectively fixed at one end of a pair of connecting plates, the end of the connecting plate is close to one end of the clamping ring, a limiting insertion plate penetrates through the installation shell, and the limiting insertion plate penetrates through the bottom wall of the installation shell and is connected with the clamping ring in an inserting mode. This interim fire water tank of folded cascade, it is rational in infrastructure, be convenient for fold and support fixedly, the practicality is strong, easily promotes.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY CONSTR ENG GROUP;CHINA RAILWAY CONSTRUCTION ENG GROUP NORTHERN ENG CO LTD

title_en: System for evaluating performance of disaster response system by adjusting input data
title_ko: 입력데이터 조정을 통해 재난대응시스템의 성능을 평가하는 시스템
abstract_en: One embodiment may provide a system comprising: a disaster response system including a data collection unit that collects disaster data including past disaster data, institutional disaster data collected or processed by the institution, and environmental facility disaster data measured at environmental facilities, and a system control unit for generating a disaster situation propagation plan and disaster response plan according to the type of disaster from the past disaster data, the institutional disaster data, and the environmental facility disaster data, matching the disaster type, the disaster situation propagation plan, and the disaster response plan to manualized the disaster situation propagation plan and the disaster response plan to generate a disaster manual, performing a decision-making corresponding to the disaster type when the disaster type is input, and outputting the disaster situation propagation plan and the disaster response plan according to the disaster manual included in the decision-making; and a performance evaluation device including an input control unit for inputting an input value including the disaster type to the disaster response system, an output control unit for receiving an output value including the disaster situation propagation plan and the disaster response plan from the disaster response system, and an evaluation unit for evaluating the accuracy of the decision-making on the basis of the error of the output value. The input value is generated from input data composed of a plurality of classes defined by different boundary values according to the disaster type, and the performance of the disaster response system corresponding to a value belonging to one of the classes is evaluated. It is possible to evaluate the accuracy of decision-making or the accuracy of disaster costing.
abstract_ko: 일 실시예는 과거재난데이터, 기관이 수집 또는 처리한 기관재난데이터 및 환경시설에서 측정된 환경시설재난데이터를 포함하는 재난데이터를 수집하는 데이터수집부와, 상기 과거재난데이터, 상기 기관재난데이터 및 상기 환경시설재난데이터로부터 재난유형에 따른 재난상황전파방안 및 재난대응방안을 생성하고, 상기 재난유형, 상기 재난상황전파방안 및 상기 재난대응방안을 매칭시킴으로써 상기 재난상황전파방안 및 상기 재난대응방안을 매뉴얼화하여 재난매뉴얼을 생성하고, 상기 재난유형을 입력받으면 상기 재난유형에 대응하는 의사결정을 수행하며, 상기 의사결정에 포함된 상기 재난매뉴얼에 따라 상기 재난상황전파방안 및 상기 재난대응방안을 출력하는 시스템제어부를 포함하는 재난대응시스템; 및 상기 재난유형을 포함하는 입력값을 재난대응시스템에 입력시키는 입력제어부, 상기 재난상황전파방안 및 상기 재난대응방안을 포함하는 출력값을 상기 재난대응시스템으로부터 수신하는 출력제어부, 상기 출력값의 오류에 기반하여 상기 의사결정의 정확도를 평가하는 평가판단부를 포함하는 성능평가장치를 포함하고, 상기 입력값은, 상기 재난유형에 따라 상이한 경계값으로 규정되는 복수의 클래스로 구성되는 입력데이터로부터 생성되되, 상기 복수의 클래스 중 하나의 클래스에 속하는 값에 해당하는 재난대응시스템의 성능을 평가하는 시스템을 제공할 수 있다.
assignees: KOREA TESTING LAB KTL

title_en: Lightning arrester fault judging method, device, equipment, medium and product based on LSTM
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of electric power, and provides a lightning arrester fault judging method, device, computer equipment, storage medium and computer program product based on modified LSTM. The application can accurately judge whether the lightning arrester has surface pollution fault or damp fault. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a fault data set of the lightning arrester, wherein the fault data set comprises real-time attributes, geographical position factors and monitoring data of wind, constructing a space-time correlation model according to the real-time attributes and the geographical position factors of the wind, constructing a leakage current prediction model based on LSTM (least squares) on the basis of a space-time correlation model, an average absolute error condition and a reverse propagation algorithm neural network of errors, inputting the monitoring data into the model, obtaining resistive current of the lightning arrester at the next moment and obtaining a resistive current fundamental wave and a third harmonic value, judging that the lightning arrester is a surface pollution fault if the resistive current fundamental wave and the third harmonic value meet a growth rate condition, and judging that the lightning arrester is a damp fault if the resistive current fundamental wave meets a threshold condition.

title_en: Product supply chain risk propagation method based on complex network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a product supply chain risk propagation method based on a complex network, which comprises the following steps: firstly, the method comprises the following steps: constructing a complex product collaborative network: the method comprises the steps that a complex product collaborative network is constructed according to the collaboration among enterprises in the complex product collaborative network process, a supply chain network is divided into four levels, the collaboration exists between the upper level and the lower level from a part supplier, a part supplier and a first-level supplier to a main manufacturer from top to bottom, a single enterprise can be associated with a plurality of enterprises on the upper layer or the lower layer, and the cross-level collaboration does not exist among different levels; secondly, constructing a complex product cooperation mechanism network risk transfer model: describing by adopting a load-capacity model in the cascade failure, introducing a concept of supply chain risk flow, leading the node to be attacked and failed, and terminating the cascade failure process until no other overloaded enterprises or the whole network are paralyzed in the whole complex product cooperative network after the load is redistributed; and thirdly, simulating cascade failure.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: IES-CPS system information-physical combination expected fault generation method, device, storage medium and computing equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an IES-CPS system information-physical combination expected fault generation method, a device, a storage medium and a computing device, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing an IES-CPS information expected fault set and a physical expected fault set; setting physical expected faults and determining an information fault propagation mode by combining the current system operation mode; searching an information transmission path according to the determined information fault propagation mode, an operation control strategy under the current fault and a network layered coupling model; an information expected failure is set in the information transmission path, and the information expected failure and the set physical expected failure constitute an information-physical combination expected failure. The invention comprehensively considers the multi-network layered coupling relation of the neutron energy system in the IES-CPS system, generates the information-physical combination expected fault, analyzes the safety of the IES-CPS when the combination fault occurs, and can obtain the severity of the fault through the safety analysis result, thereby screening out the key nodes or the serious faults.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ECONOMIC RES INST;STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power system sequence recovery method and device based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system sequential recovery method and device based on deep reinforcement learning. Based on the electric power network after cascade failure, the recovery capability of the electric power network system to cascade failure in the system recovery process is evaluated through the bus recovery sequence obtained after deep reinforcement learning, reinforcement learning is combined with the electric power network, the recovery problem of the electric power network is considered in the angle of an defender, and the combination of the reinforcement learning and the neural network expands the realization range of the electric power network, so that the recovery optimal strategy of the large-scale electric network can be found.

title_en: Method and system for field infrared camera deployment, control and site selection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a field infrared camera deployment, control and site selection method and a system, which relate to the technical field of infrared camera application and comprise the following steps: acquiring a digital map and a digital terrain model of an area to be monitored; determining an infrared camera layout area; determining a signal propagation environment in an infrared camera arrangement area, and establishing a field wireless signal propagation model according to the signal propagation environment; calculating the communication distance of the field infrared camera according to the communication parameters of the camera end and the field wireless signal propagation model; and arranging infrared cameras in the infrared camera arrangement area according to the communication distance of the outdoor infrared cameras and the digital terrain model. The invention relates to a field infrared camera distribution and control site selection method and system, which are based on a determined monitoring area and a novel field infrared camera with a wireless networking function, and realize visual distribution and control site selection of the novel field infrared camera by combining topographic data. Therefore, a data wireless recovery network is constructed, and the monitoring timeliness is effectively improved.
assignees: UNIV ELECTRONIC SCI & TECH CHINA;CHENGDU PANDA BREEDING RES BASE

title_en: Power system cascading failure key node identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, in particular to a method and a system for identifying key nodes of cascading failures of a power system, comprising the steps of obtaining historical failure data in the power system, and quantifying the historical failure data to obtain initial failure data and final failure scale data; the method comprises the steps of extracting a high-nonlinearity mapping relation from initial fault data to a final fault scale, quantifying cascading fault risks of all nodes of the power system under different fault types based on the high-nonlinearity mapping relation from the initial fault data to the final fault scale, and identifying key nodes by utilizing quantified indexes according to the cascading fault risks of all the nodes under different fault types. And extracting a highly nonlinear mapping relation between an initial fault and a final fault scale in the historical fault through the LM optimized BP neural network, predicting the final fault scale according to the initial fault based on the mapping relation, and considering a critical node identification method in cascading faults.

title_en: Short-term wind power prediction method based on SSA (simple sequence analysis) optimization BP (back propagation) neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a short-term wind power prediction method based on an SSA (simple sequence analysis) optimized BP (back propagation) neural network, which comprises the following steps: acquiring real-time data of a wind power plant, preprocessing the data, loading the data into an SSA (simple sequence analysis) optimization BP (back propagation) neural network model, and acquiring a short-term wind power prediction result; calculating the fitness of each sparrow through a sparrow search algorithm in the training process of the SSA optimization BP neural network model, updating the positions of the finder, the joiner and the detector until the optimal position and the optimal fitness value are obtained, and then respectively assigning values to the BP neural network model to be used as a parameter weight and a threshold value, so that the optimal SSA optimization BP neural network model is obtained. Compared with the prior art, the method improves the network training speed and the wind power prediction precision by optimizing the weight and the threshold of the BP neural network algorithm through SSA.
assignees: SHANGHAI MOTOR COLLEGE

title_en: Regional multi-system double-layer distributed optimization scheduling method considering double-layer carbon emission optimization distribution model
abstract_en: The invention provides a regional multi-system double-layer dispersion optimization scheduling method considering a double-layer carbon emission optimization distribution model, which constructs the regional multi-energy system double-layer carbon emission optimization distribution model, wherein an upper-layer multi-energy main system mainly considers a power distribution network, a gas distribution network and a heat distribution network system, real-time carbon emission constraint is formulated based on real-time environment monitoring, historical carbon emission of each multi-energy subsystem in a lower-layer region is decomposed to each multi-energy subsystem in the lower-layer region in real time, and each multi-energy subsystem in the lower-layer region needs to meet the real-time carbon emission constraint while being optimized; and finally, solving a double-layer dispersion optimization scheduling model of the multi-energy system in the region between the upper layer and the lower layer by adopting an improved target cascade analysis method. The method can reduce the total network loss of the upper distribution network system of the regional multi-energy system, reduce the operation cost of each energy subsystem in the lower region, and determine the optimal distribution scheme of the whole carbon emission of the regional multi-energy system.
assignees: CENTRAL INSTALLATION GROUP LTD COMPANY

title_en: Intelligent water regime detection and early warning system based on single chip microcomputer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water regime detection and early warning, and discloses an intelligent water regime detection and early warning system based on a single chip microcomputer, which comprises: the water level meter comprises a water level meter signal acquisition module, a data comparison module, a single chip microcomputer, a data recording module, a wireless matching module and a wireless data transmission module; the water level meter signal acquisition module is used for acquiring data signals sent by the water level meter; through the design of wireless matching module and wireless data transmission module, can automatically carry out automatic connection and send out the regimen early warning signal to the wireless network equipment around the lake shore when the water level in large-scale lake rises and surpasss the early warning value, thereby can appear the very first time of early warning at the regimen and carry out the early warning suggestion to pedestrian around the shore and the resident of living around the lake, thereby can make people in time prevent the regimen calamity that will appear, the untimely condition that leads to appearing serious harm takes place for the warning information propagation of the regimen has been avoided.
assignees: SHENZHEN YUAN MICROELECTRONIC LTD COMPANY

title_en: Method and device for predicting power of offshore wind turbine generator
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for predicting power of an offshore wind turbine, wherein the method comprises the following steps: performing space-time-power characteristic analysis on the offshore wind turbine generator; acquiring operation data of an offshore wind turbine generator, and extracting a characteristic vector of the acquired data; clustering the acquired operation data; and constructing a model based on the cuckoo optimization algorithm back propagation neural network according to the clustering of the operating data. The method ensures the strong correlation between the variables used in modeling and the predicted power; a cuckoo optimization algorithm is introduced into parameter optimization of the constructed offshore wind power prediction back propagation neural network model, so that the accuracy of a prediction result is effectively improved, and the stable operation of a power grid is promoted.
assignees: BEIJING HUAENAN NEW SHARP CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Neural network-based prediction method for basic electricity charge of large industrial power
abstract_en: The invention discloses a neural network-based prediction method for basic electricity charge of large industrial power, which comprises the following steps of: (1) firstly, carrying out statistical preprocessing on historical electric load data of an enterprise; (2) secondly, carrying out normalization processing on the load data, and converting the load data into an input vector on a [0,1] interval; (3) then, an error back propagation algorithm neural network model is constructed according to the input vector and the required output vector; (4) after the training and the test are finished, putting the test into use, selecting the maximum value of the output result and carrying out normalization reduction; (5) and converting the predicted load value into a predicted value of the basic electricity fee of the demand. The neural network has a three-layer structure, 12 input layer neurons, 25 intermediate layer neurons, and 12 output layer neurons. After the basic electric charge is predicted through the neural network, the enterprise can reasonably select the payment mode of the basic electric charge, so that the electric charge expense is effectively reduced, and the production cost is reduced. The method has the advantages of high prediction accuracy, good stability and the like.
assignees: BEIJING GUIKE WEIDA ELECTRIC POWER ENERGY SAVING SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Wind, light and water multi-energy complementary day-ahead risk scheduling method considering output stationarity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind, light and water multi-energy complementary day-ahead risk scheduling method considering output stationarity, which comprises a power grid next-day load forecasting process, a wind power plant and photovoltaic power plant next-day output process, a cascade hydropower station warehousing runoff and interval inflow process; obtaining a typical load process and the probability thereof, and a typical wind-solar combined output process and the probability thereof by adopting a scene reduction algorithm; establishing a risk-controllable day-ahead power generation planning model of the wind-solar-water complementary system with three targets; step four: and constructing a double-layer nested optimization framework to solve the model. The invention can effectively deal with the uncertainty of load prediction and wind-light output prediction under the condition of ensuring the system output stability.
assignees: XIAN SCIENCE AND ENGINEERING UNIV

title_en: Method for calculating backwater range of reservoir
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for calculating a backwater range of a reservoir, which comprises the steps of collecting corresponding data of the reservoir, and developing a one-dimensional flood evolution model suitable for a current river network structure according to the principles of Saint-Venn equation sets; reducing each water level value in the water level process by a fixed value according to the water level condition applied in front of an actual dam in the field flood, and calculating a group of virtual water level line change processes for the reservoir by applying the flood evolution model; according to the flood process data of the field, selecting the highest water level line of the reservoir area and the corresponding time, comparing the highest water level line and the corresponding time with the virtual water level line at the same time, wherein the difference value of the water levels of the highest water level line and the virtual water level line is smaller than a given value, and the range from the dam address to the tail end of backwater is a backwater influence range; the method can reduce the dependence on hydrological data of the natural river channel before the reservoir is built; the applicability under the condition of flood is good, and the coverage of the traditional method can be expanded; the calculation precision is higher than that of the traditional method, and technical support can be provided for flood control and benefit scheduling decisions of large-scale reservoirs or cascade reservoirs.
assignees: YANGTZE RIVER THREE GORGES GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for predicting risk in corporte internal documents using artificial neural networks
title_ko: 인공 신경망을 이용하여 기업 내부 문서의 리스크를 예측하는 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and a device for predicting a risk in a corporate internal document using an artificial neural network. The device includes: at least one processor; and a memory storing instructions for the at least one processor to execute at least one operation. The at least one operation includes the following steps of: receiving article information from an external server; generating keyword impact information with respect to a risk detection keyword based on the article information; receiving a corporate internal document and enterprise information from an enterprise terminal; inputting the corporate internal document, the enterprise information, and the keyword impact information to an artificial neural network supervised-learned in advance; and determining the risk score of the corporate internal document based on an output value of the artificial neural network. The risk score means a score quantifying a risk that is a negative effect on an enterprise in the case of leakage of the corporate internal document.
abstract_ko: 인공 신경망을 이용하여 기업 내부 문서의 리스크를 예측하는 방법 및 장치가 개시된다. 인공 신경망을 이용하여 기업 내부 문서의 리스크를 예측하는 장치는, 적어도 하나의 프로세서(processor); 및 상기 적어도 하나의 프로세서가 적어도 하나의 동작(operation)을 수행하도록 지시하는 명령어들(instructions)을 저장하는 메모리(memory)를 포함하고, 상기 적어도 하나의 동작은, 외부 서버로부터 기사 정보를 수신하는 단계; 상기 기사 정보에 기초하여 리스크 검출 키워드에 대한 키워드 파급력 정보를 생성하는 단계; 기업 단말로부터 기업 내부 문서 및 기업 정보를 수신하는 단계; 상기 기업 내부 문서와 상기 기업 정보, 및 상기 키워드 파급력 정보를 미리 지도학습(supervised learning)된 인공 신경망에 입력하는 단계; 및 상기 인공 신경망의 출력값에 기반하여 상기 기업 내부 문서의 리스크 점수를 결정하는 단계를 포함하고, 상기 리스크 점수는 상기 기업 내부 문서가 유출되었을 경우 기업에 끼치는 부정적인 영향력인 리스크(risk)를 정량화한 점수를 의미한다.
assignees: DATAEYE SOLUTION CO LTD

title_en: Method for simplifying and representing fracturing fracture morphology of shale gas well
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of oil field fracturing, and particularly relates to a method for simplifying and representing the fracture morphology of a shale gas well. The technical scheme is as follows: a method for simplifying and characterizing the fracture morphology of shale gas well fracturing comprises the following steps: s1: fracturing the reservoir to form a fracture network; s2: describing a hydraulic fracture propagation rule and interaction conditions with natural fractures according to a field micro-seismic monitoring result, and acquiring related parameters of a formed fracture network according to a field micro-seismic interpretation result: long crack, extended crack width, and crack area. S3: quantitatively characterizing the crack; s4: simplified characterization of fracture fractures: obtaining a fractal dimension D of a complex fracture system by adopting a fractal theory; and combining the fractal dimension D of the characterization parameter of the fracture complexity with the quantitative characterization parameter. The invention provides a method for simplifying and depicting a complex structure of a shale gas well fracturing fracture network to reveal the shale gas well fracturing fracture network distribution.
assignees: CHINESE PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS STOCK LTD COMPANY

title_en: Road side unit optimized layout method considering coexistence of vehicle-vehicle and vehicle-road communication
abstract_en: The invention provides a road side unit optimized layout method considering coexistence of vehicle-to-vehicle and vehicle-to-road communication, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: discretizing a road network into a road network topological structure G (N, A) of nodes and road sections based on graph theory, wherein G is the road network, N is a node set in the road network, and A is a road section set; step two: based on the road network topological structure, Z is set as a candidate node set in the RSU layout, layout scheme z of road side unit is [ z ═ z 1 ,…,z i ,…z |Z| ]， Step three: constructing an RSU optimized layout model according to positive income brought by information coverage, negative income related to RSU equipment installation cost and a layout scheme z based on a traffic flow-information flow coupling propagation theory; step four: and solving the RSU optimized layout model to obtain an optimal road side unit layout scheme and an optimal line network layout scheme corresponding to the maximum total negative revenue sum related to the positive revenue and the RSU equipment installation cost brought by information coverage. The method can remarkably improve the information flow coverage rate and the comprehensive benefits after layout, and reduce the cost.
assignees: CHANGQIAN UNIV

title_en: Information-epidemic co-evolution analysis method under dynamic multisource information and behavior response effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses an information-epidemic co-evolution analysis method under the action of dynamic multi-source information and behavior response, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a multi-layer time sequence network model with partially coupled nodes, then constructing unconscious-conscious-unconscious, susceptible-infected-susceptible models to analyze information-epidemic propagation dynamics processes, describing epidemic states and information state transitions of the nodes, deducing epidemic threshold beta  c , then simulating the dynamic evolution processes of epidemic propagation and information diffusion, and finally counting the proportion of infected nodes and conscious nodes in the network in steady state to finish the information-epidemic co-evolution process. According to the invention, the influence of individual time-varying self-consciousness and behavior response on the cooperative evolution of the information-epidemic disease is considered in the multi-layer time sequence network with the nodes partially coupled, the state transition of the nodes is described through a micro Markov chain method, the critical threshold beta  c  of the epidemic disease is theoretically solved, and guidance is provided for the intervention and control of other sudden epidemic diseases which possibly burst in the future.

title_en: Air conditioning system load prediction method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air conditioning system load prediction method based on deep learning, which comprises the steps of 1, selecting characteristic elements influencing the load of an air conditioning system, 2, collecting original data of the load of the air conditioning system, 3, processing the load data, 4, building a deep learning model based on a neural network, 5, determining a deep learning optimal model, and 6, predicting the load of the air conditioning system. The invention fully utilizes the multi-source characteristic information influencing the energy consumption of the air conditioning system, and determines the deep learning optimal model by selecting different neuron numbers and hidden layer numbers and comparing the prediction results. At the same time, the learning rate of back propagation by introducing a Gaussian function The method can solve the problem of gradient disappearance which is easy to occur in the calculation process, improves the load prediction precision, further can provide energy consumption fluctuation information, adjusts the operation strategy of each device in the refrigeration system in advance, and avoids the energy consumption loss of the air conditioning system caused by the delay of feedback signal transmission.

title_en: Taxpayer risk evaluation method based on graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a taxpayer risk evaluation method based on a graph neural network, which comprises the following steps: 1) constructing a data set of a graph risk propagation model; 2) constructing a graph network based on the basic information of each taxpayer in the data set, wherein the graph network is used as a taxpayer attribute information network; establishing a taxpayer bill flow relation information network by taking value-added tax special invoice information as a basis; 3) combining the taxpayer attribute information network and the taxpayer ticket flow relation information network to obtain a final graph network; then acquiring an adjacency matrix of the final graph network; 4) feature vectors of each taxpayer in the data set; 5) taking the adjacency matrix as a network parameter of the graph risk propagation network, and training the graph risk propagation network by using the characteristic vectors of the taxpayers in the data set; 6) and for a group of taxpayers to be evaluated, acquiring the characteristic vector of each taxpayer in the group of taxpayers, and inputting the characteristic vector into the trained graph risk propagation network for prediction to obtain the risk grade of each taxpayer and whether a group situation exists.
assignees: CHINESE SOFTWARE AND TECH SERVICE STOCK LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Wind power prediction method based on weighted fuzzy clustering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power prediction method based on weighted fuzzy clustering, which comprises the following steps: 1, selecting strongly relevant meteorological features based on a grey correlation theory; dividing a key meteorological feature set into data sample subsets by using a feature weighted fuzzy C-means clustering algorithm, and performing classified modeling by using a back propagation neural network; and 3, calling a model most similar to the characteristics of the current time period to predict the power, and synthesizing a plurality of prediction models by utilizing the membership function to confirm the wind power output of the model in order to perfect the affiliation of the boundary data. According to the method, the matching degree of meteorological features and the sample subset is strengthened from two angles of classification modeling and feature matching, potential relation is mined from the randomly fluctuating wind power signals, and the prediction precision of the wind power model is improved.
assignees: ENERGY RES INSTITUTE ANHUI PROVINCE ENERGY LABORATORY OF COMPREHENSIVE NATIONAL SCIENCE CENTER;FERTILIZER COMBINING INDUSTRIAL UNIV

title_en: Critical infrastructure protection blueprints generation and utilization in an interdependent critical infrastructure architecture
abstract_en: Critical infrastructure (CI) protection blueprint generation in an interdependent CI architecture includes constructing a digital twin of a heterogeneous collection of CI elements associated with respectively different services provided to a common community. Thereafter, hypothetical sensor data is specified in the digital twin for a target CI element in the hierarchy. In response, sensor data is read for other CI elements dependent upon the target CI element so as to identify impacted CI elements. For each impacted CI element, additional sensor data is read for further CI elements in the hierarchy dependent upon the impacted CI elements and the process repeats until no additional impacted CI elements are identified. A listing of all impacted CI elements is written to a blueprint for the hierarchy in association with the hypothetical sensor data in order to define a cascading effect of the hypothetical sensor data upon the hierarchy within the digital twin.
assignees: Inlecom Group BV

title_en: Low-voltage distribution network cascading failure early warning method based on risk assessment model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-voltage distribution network cascading failure early warning method based on a risk assessment model, which comprises the following steps: data acquisition and processing: collecting load data, weather data and fault data of a low-voltage distribution network, and performing data preprocessing on the collected data; selecting fault characteristics: performing optimization selection on the fault characteristics of the low-voltage distribution network by adopting an improved G-Relieff algorithm; cascading failure search: performing subsequent fault search according to the line outage model and the key line model to generate an accident chain and evaluate the accident chain; fault early warning: and calculating a risk evaluation coefficient of the element and the line, determining the fault occurrence probability through the risk evaluation coefficient, and finally performing comprehensive risk evaluation on the fault to calculate the risk level. The method is used for predicting and mastering the safe operation state of the low-voltage distribution network, discovering potential danger and judging the fault development trend so as to improve the accuracy of fault early warning and further avoid large-area power failure.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY SALT CITY POWER SUPPLY BRANCH COMPANY;STATE GRID JIANGSU PROVINCE POWER SUPPLY BRANCH COMPANY IN COUNTY COUNTY LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY

title_en: Stepped hydroelectric and photovoltaic short-term complementary scheduling method and system with unit as scheduling unit
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a cascade hydroelectric and photovoltaic short-term complementary scheduling method and system with a unit as a scheduling unit, and relates to the technical field of clean energy. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a model for optimizing and scheduling the maximum consumable electric quantity of the cascade water-light complementary system in a short period by taking one day as a scheduling period based on predicted output data of the photovoltaic power station; and carrying out model conversion and solving. Therefore, the unit is taken as the minimum dispatching unit, power station constraint, unit constraint and power grid constraint faced by the complementary system are considered in a refined mode, a short-term optimized dispatching model with the maximum electric quantity consumption capability of the cascade hydroelectric complementary system is established, and the overall electric quantity consumption level and dispatching plan performability of the complementary system are improved through hydraulic and electric redistribution of cascade hydroelectric power.
assignees: QINGHUA SICHUAN ENERGY INTERNET RES INSTITUTE;UNIV QINGHUA;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE OF SICHUAN PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY OF STATE GRID

title_en: Method and apparatus for minimizing service disruption
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to methods and apparatus for minimizing service disruption. There is provided a method implemented in a wireless transmit/receive unit, the method comprising sending a first message to a first network via a non-3 GPP access, the first message comprising information indicating support service interruption; receiving a second message from the first network, the second message including information indicating one or more disaster condition handling preferences for the first network associated with maintaining on the first network via non-3 GPP access and one or more other disaster condition handling preferences associated with roaming to another network; receiving a third message from the first network, the third message including information indicating one disaster condition for the first network associated with the 3GPP access; determining whether to stay on the first network or roam to another network via a non-3 GPP access based on a second message, the second message based on a disaster condition handling preference; and maintaining on the first network via the non-3 GPP access based on the determination.
assignees: INTERDIGITAL PATENT HOLDINGS INC

title_en: Methods and systems for forecasting estimated time of restoration during service interruption
abstract_en: Machine learning may be used to forecast an estimated time of restoration (ETR) during a service interruption. To forecast an ETR, the collection of information from the multiple sources may be provided as inputs to a machine learning model, such as a deep long-short term memory recurrent neural network, a predictive model, and/or the like. The machine learning model may be trained to optimize the temporal cost function of sustained service interruptions and forecast ETRs for service interruptions (in minutes). The machine learning model may process data/information in real-time and provide an ETR when inputs are not yet available in the repair/resolution process, and update (reforecast) the ETR in real-time as the inputs late become available.
assignees: COMMONWEALTH EDISON COMPANY

title_en: Demand side response resource calling method based on grey correlation point ideal point method
abstract_en: A demand side response resource invocation aid decision based on a grey correlation ideal point method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: and constructing a value index weighting model for the demand side resources by using an objective and subjective combination weighting method, and constructing a value evaluation index system. Step two: model evaluation is carried out based on a grey correlation ideal point method, and on the basis of the original evaluation model, grey correlation analysis is combined with TOPSIS, so that the effectiveness of the evaluation result is improved. Step three: and performing value grade correction on the evaluation result through a variable weight method to form an evaluation result, and forming a calling sequence by adopting a cascade utilization strategy when the power grid needs to mobilize resources on the demand side. Based on the characteristic that the resource types of the power demand side are various, the invention provides a demand side response resource calling auxiliary decision method based on a grey correlation point ideal point method, aiming at the problem that the conventional demand side resource scheduling lacks theoretical basis.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA EASTERN POWER TRANSACTION CENTER LTD COMPANY;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Power distribution network risk sensing method and system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a power distribution network risk perception method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which belong to the field of data processing, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical monitoring data; establishing improved fault models of various electrical equipment based on historical monitoring data; establishing a model integrating the operation reliability of all electrical equipment; acquiring online monitoring data; and inputting the online monitoring data into all the electrical equipment operation reliability models to obtain the fault probability of each electrical equipment. The system comprises: the system comprises a historical data acquisition module, a fault model creation module, a reliability model creation module, an online data acquisition module and a fault probability calculation module; according to the method and the device, weak links and potential fault equipment under the current operation condition can be found, and accidental shutdown equipment caused by the external environment can be found in the cascading failure propagation process, so that an auxiliary decision can be provided for power grid operators.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV QINGHUA

title_en: Comprehensive protection method of electric-gas coupling system under heavy load distribution attack
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive protection method of an electric-gas coupling system under heavy load distribution attack, which comprises the steps of simulating bilateral collaborative LR attack by an attacker visual angle; considering the influence of the power grid cascading failure caused by bilateral collaborative LR attack on system load, establishing an electric-gas coupling system loss evaluation model, and uniformly measuring the load loss of the power grid and a natural gas grid in the electric-gas coupling system by adopting economic loss; solving an electric-gas coupling system loss evaluation model through a linearization method and KKT condition conversion, calculating economic loss caused by attack on the electric-gas coupling system, and determining the vulnerability of each load node in the system; analyzing the comprehensive vulnerability and the height degree of each load node under different attack resource degrees; and the comprehensive protection is carried out on the electric-gas coupling system by adopting a load node with high comprehensive vulnerability of strengthening protection and limiting the gas-to-electricity load reduction proportion. The invention improves the capability of the system for resisting attacks and reduces the economic loss of the IEGS.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Coombined Fire Sensing and Extinguishing System at Home
title_ko: 가정에서의 통합 화재감지 정보 전파 및 화재 소화 시스템
abstract_en: An integrated fire detection dissemination and fire extinguishing system at home of the present invention includes a home server, a fire detection module, a user smart terminal, a camera control module, a plurality of camera units, and a fire extinguishing robot. The present invention is to prioritize dissemination of a fire alarm according to a predetermined criterion so that fire extinguishing and human evacuation can be performed quickly.
abstract_ko: 본 발명 가정의 통합 화재 감지 전파 및 소화 시스템은 가정 구성원의 스마트 단말기 번호 정보, 카메라 고유 정보와 포인트 정보를 등록 저장받고, 화재 발생 시의 기준 온도 정보를 저장하며, 등록 저장된 가정 구성원 스마트 단말기 번호 정보를 기초로 화재 경보 전파의 우선 순위를 설정하며, 화재 감지 모듈로부터 화재 감지 정보를 수신하고, 가정 구성원의 스마트 단말기와 통신하여 각 가정 구성원의 위치 정보를 수신하고 수신된 각 가정 구성원 스마트 단말기의 위치 정보가 홈 서버의 위치 정보와 일치하는지 여부를 판단하며, 일치하는 경우, 일치한 가정 구성원 스마트 단말기를 메모리에 저장하고 메모리에 저장된 홈 서버의 위치와 일치하는 가정 구성원 스마트 단말기 중에서 기 설정하여 저장된 화재 경보 전송 우선 순위에 따라서 화재 경보를 전송하며, 각 카메라부로부터 고유정보, 영상정보 및 다수 포인트의 온도 정보를 수신하고 수신된 다수 포인트의 온도 정보를 기 설정하여 저장된 화재 발생 시의 기준 온도 정보와 비교하여 화재 발생 여부를 판단하고, 화재가 발생한 것으로 판단되면 해당 카메라의 포인트 정보를 화재 소화 로봇으로 전송하는 홈 서버와, 화재를 감지하고 화재 감지 정보를 홈 서버, 화재 소화 로봇 및 카메라 제어 모듈로 전송하는 화재 감지 모듈과, 홈 서버로부터 화재 감지 정보를 수신하고 화재 경보 앱을 활성화하며 부착된 AI 스피커로 화재 경보 정보를 전송하여 음성으로 반복 제공하도록 하는 사용자 스마트 단말기와, 화재 감지 모듈로부터 화재 경보를 수신한 카메라 제어 모듈이 슬립모드에서 워킹 모드로 전환되고 카메라 제어 모듈이 네트워크로 연결된 각 카메라부로 제어 신호를 전송하여 각 카메라를 구동시키는 카메라 제어 모듈과, 카메라 제어 모듈로부터 제어 신호를 수신하여 구동되고 카메라 고유정보, 촬영된 영상정보 및 다수 포인트의 온도 정보를 홈 서버로 전송하는 다수의 카메라부와, 홈 서버로부터 화재가 발생한 장소에 설치되는 카메라의 포인트 정보를 수신하고 기 설정된 경로에 따라서 해당 카메라 포인트로 이동하며, 부착된 적외선 카메라가 촬영한 다수 포인트의 온도 정보를 수신하고 온도가 가장 높은 포인트 방향으로 소화기 노즐이 회전하도록 이동 로봇의 방향을 회전하고 소화기 노즐을 개방하여 소화액을 분사하도록 하는 화재 소화 로봇을 포함하여 구성된 것을 특징으로 하는 것이다.
assignees: GK ENG CO LTD

title_en: Line loss calculation method based on data prediction filling and global dynamic model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a line loss calculation method based on data prediction filling and a global dynamic model, which belongs to the technical field of line loss detection and comprises the following steps: step 1: determining abnormal data, enumerating line loss data types, and inputting main reasons of data abnormality as cluster number; step 2: clustering and grouping, namely performing data grouping on abnormal data by using a neighbor propagation algorithm, and repeatedly iterating to enhance the accuracy; and step 3: missing data prediction filling, adopting a DNN algorithm to respectively train and learn each type of data, and predicting by using the data outside the package; and 4, step 4: and theoretical line loss calculation, namely associating operating equipment in the power grid with line loss, and establishing a global network dynamic model, so that the accuracy of line loss calculation can be enhanced, and the accurate positioning of the abnormal line loss defect can be assisted.
assignees: MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF LIAONING PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Complex product system risk source identification method based on zero model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a complex product system risk source identification method based on a zero model, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a complex network according to functional index items in a complex product system, and then calculating the function index items as metering indexes of the nodes, and dividing the function index items into different groups according to the node degree centrality. And constructing a zero model for the group with the same degree centrality, and judging the importance degree of the functional index item by comparing the variation of the modularity with the zero model of the network construction. And finally, selecting a functional index item with short risk propagation time as a complex product system risk source by using a linear threshold model. The method can identify the risk source from the system structure of the complex product system, and provides a new thought for identifying the risk source, thereby improving the safety of the complex product system.

title_en: Trend convergence adjusting method based on deep reinforcement learning and cascade graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for adjusting the convergence of a power flow based on deep reinforcement learning and a cascade graph neural network. The reinforcement learning can learn an adjustable action strategy through the reward of the environment for the action by continuously interacting the action (the trend adjustment action) and the environment (the current trend parameter), and construct a nonlinear mapping relation between different actions and the final value of the action in the current environment by utilizing deep learning. The method takes the power flow convergence probability obtained by the cascade diagram neural network as one of design references of the reward function, finally obtains the power flow convergence adjustment strategy, and has important significance for guaranteeing safe and stable operation of the power system.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Competitive impact propagation maximization method considering community consensus and related equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a competitive influence propagation maximization method considering community consensus and related equipment, which can realize a better influence propagation effect for a social network. The method comprises the following steps: activating K initial nodes selected from the social network to obtain a forward node set; if the target group meets the group activation condition, activating the target group through positive influence or competitive influence; if the target nodes which are not activated and are not in the activated group exist in the social network and the target nodes meet the node activation condition, activating the target nodes through forward influence or competitive influence; adding nodes activated by the forward impact to the forward node set and nodes activated by the competing impact to the competing node set; and activating the unactivated nodes in the social network based on the forward node set and the competitive node set after the nodes are added until a termination condition is reached, so as to obtain a forward final set.

title_en: Method for identifying cascade fault accident chain of wind power-containing alternating current/direct current series-parallel power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying a cascading failure accident chain of an alternating-current and direct-current mixed power grid with wind power, which comprehensively considers basic indexes for measuring the importance degree of a line from four aspects of wind power output level, stable state of alternating current and direct current interaction, trend running condition and network global topological structure angle, obtains subjective and objective weights as basic weights by calculating wind power access proportion short-circuit ratio indexes, multi-feed short-circuit ratio indexes, weighted trend entropy indexes and line transmission medium number indexes through a relevance coefficient and entropy weight method, and linearly combines the two basic weights to obtain comprehensive weights; solving by using a gray wolf algorithm to obtain a combination coefficient, obtaining the comprehensive weight of each index, sorting according to the magnitude of the comprehensive index value, and identifying the key transmission line as a next-stage accident chain of the cascading failure; and determining a cascading accident chain according to the criterion of ending the cascading failure prediction. The method is beneficial to prediction of the chain accident chain and has an effective guiding effect on engineering practice.

title_en: Fault processing method for distribution information physical system under DOS attack
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of power information physical systems, and particularly relates to a fault processing method of a power distribution information physical system under DOS attack. The application comprises the following steps: step 1, establishing an information attack possibility model; step 2, establishing a transmission delay model caused by DOS attack; and 3, constructing a power distribution network according to the step 1 and the step 2, analyzing the evolution mechanism of the power distribution information physical system under DOS attack, and providing a fault processing method of the power distribution information physical system under DOS attack. Aiming at the new network security risk and more complex and severe cascading failures and blackout accidents possibly suffered by the system caused by the combination of the electric power information network and the electric power gateway, the application researches the modeling technology of the electric power information physical system, analyzes the propagation mechanism and path of the network attack risk, invalidates DOS attack by controlling decision execution analysis, remarkably improves the security of the electric power network, and further effectively reduces and avoids the occurrence of electric power accidents.

title_en: Wind power prediction method based on fluctuation sequence classification correction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power prediction method based on fluctuation sequence classification correction, which comprises the following steps: 1, predicting a wind power reference value in N hours in the future by using a reference model; 2, dividing a power fluctuation process by adopting a characteristic clustering method, and mining the correlation between meteorological forecast errors and model generalization errors under different fluctuation sequences from the output power angle; 3, aiming at a small dynamic sequence with gentle output, adopting a CNN-LSTM time sequence model 1 to deduce the power change in a future time period; aiming at the non-small fluctuation sequence, a CNN-LSTM time sequence model 2 and a back propagation neural network are combined to interactively correct double-layer errors; and 4, combining the reference power correction results again according to the time sequence to obtain the final wind power output. The invention adopts a composite method combining time sequence analysis and feature learning to realize the correction of errors by extracting features from multiple dimensions and fit the actual error distribution rule, thereby ensuring that the model has good accuracy.
assignees: FERTILIZER COMBINING INDUSTRIAL UNIV;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE OF ZHEJIANG PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LIMITED COMPANY OF STATE GR

title_en: Short-term wind power prediction method and system based on neural network imbalance optimization
