abstract_en: The invention provides a short-term wind power prediction method and a short-term wind power prediction system based on neural network imbalance optimization, which relate to the technical field of wind power prediction.A wind speed time sequence, a wind direction time sequence and a wind power time sequence are preprocessed to obtain a characteristic vector, a neural network is constructed, an intermediate characteristic layer is selected, the characteristic vector is used as the input of the neural network, and characteristic tensor similarity processing is carried out on the intermediate characteristic layer, so that the characteristic similarity of samples with similar wind power is improved, wind power samples with small data volume can enhance the fitting effect by depending on the propagation of the samples with similar wind power in the neural network, and the processing capacity of the neural network to unbalanced wind power sequence samples is improved; and carrying out multidirectional imbalance optimization on the training loss of the neural network, and expanding the capability of training optimal fitting parameters of the neural network based on imbalance adjustment, so that the generalization capability of the neural network is enhanced, and the prediction precision of the wind power is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG INDUSTRIAL UNIV

title_en: Water luminous output joint prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-light output joint prediction method, and belongs to the technical field of water-light joint power generation. The method of the invention comprises the following steps: s10, collecting photovoltaic power station data; s20, predicting the output of the photovoltaic power station; s30, acquiring data of the cascade hydropower station; s40, optimizing output of the cascade hydropower station; and S50, constructing a water luminous output combined model. According to the water-light output combined prediction method, the output of the solar photovoltaic power station is predicted by predicting the target, then the particle swarm optimization algorithm is adopted, the output of each target cascade hydropower station is optimized correspondingly, and the finally constructed water-light output combined model has guiding value on the power generation plan of the cascade hydropower station and photovoltaic power station combined system, so that the impact of photovoltaic grid connection on a power grid can be effectively reduced, the photovoltaic consumption is promoted, and the light abandoning rate is reduced.
assignees: NANJING YUHUA INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Nuclear power plant network security threat early warning and disposal system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nuclear power plant network security threat early warning and disposal system, which comprises a nuclear power plant network security situation perception system, a nuclear power plant local network security threat early warning and disposal response work order system and a nuclear power plant network security threat early warning cascade work order disposal system, wherein the nuclear power plant local network security threat early warning and disposal response work order system comprises a first work order and a second work order; the nuclear power plant network security threat early warning and handling system realizes the circulation of the nuclear power plant local network security threat early warning and handling worksheets through the nuclear power plant network security situation perception system, and forms a nuclear power plant network security threat early warning and handling worksheet processing method knowledge base. The nuclear power plant network security threat early warning and disposal system realizes the standardized flow of the early warning and disposal of the nuclear power plant network security threat and forms a method knowledge base of the early warning and disposal of the nuclear power plant network security threat; and (3) efficiently and standardly optimizing the safe operation management work of the nuclear power plant network.
assignees: CHONGKARYOTIC WUHAN NUCLEAR POWER OPERATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid cascading failure prediction method based on Q learning network attack
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid cascading failure prediction method based on Q learning network attack, which comprises the following steps: 1 constructing a network attack model, determining the success probability of each attack path of the fault-free tripping attack of the circuit breaker, 2 constructing a cascading fault evolution model based on Q learning, training by using a Q learning algorithm, generating a Q value table to select an optimal network attack scheme, and screening out attack paths with larger risks. According to the invention, on the basis of considering the success probability of the network attack, the Q learning algorithm is utilized to select the network attack path, so that the large-scale calculation similar to the traversal algorithm can be avoided, the calculation time is greatly shortened, the workload and the completeness are well balanced, and theoretical guidance is provided for the power grid cascading failure prevention and control under the network attack scene.

title_en: Risk propagation detection method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a risk propagation detection method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of information security. The risk propagation detection method calculates propagation risk values of other nodes except for the preset nodes in the node network by constructing the node network of the data to be predicted, and then: and determining whether the other nodes are nodes with abnormal risk propagation according to the propagation risk values of the other nodes. And constructing a node network by using fields in the data to be predicted, calculating propagation risk values of other nodes by using propagation risk values of preset nodes in the node network for reference, and detecting nodes with abnormal risk propagation according to the propagation risk values of the other nodes. The detection method for data risk propagation is optimized, so that the detection is more stable and the detection result is more reliable.
assignees: FLASH INFORMATION TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Contact rates in malware simulation for responsive measure deployment
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method of simulating the propagation of malware in a network is provided. The method comprises accessing a model of the network, where the model comprises a plurality of computer nodes and where each computer node of the plurality of computer nodes is connected to at least one edge of a plurality of edges. Each edge of the plurality of edges connects a pair of computer nodes of the plurality of computer nodes. The method further comprises initiating an outbreak of the malware in the model at a predetermined source computer node of the plurality of computer nodes, and propagating the malware through the model of the network from the source computer node. The propagation is determined based on a rate of transmission, where the rate of transmission is based upon a contact rate for each edge of the plurality of edges, and the contact rate for each edge of the plurality of edges is based upon the network traffic passing between the computer nodes connected by that edge over a predetermined time period.
assignees: BRITISH TELECOMM

title_en: Time-based approaches in malware simulation for responsive measure deployment
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method of simulating the propagation of malware in a network is provided. The method comprises accessing a model of the network, where the model comprising a plurality of computer nodes and where each computer node of the plurality of computer nodes is connected to at least one edge of a plurality of edges. Each edge of the plurality of edges connects a pair of computer nodes of the plurality of computer nodes. The method further comprises initiating an outbreak of the malware in the model at a predetermined source computer node of the plurality of computer nodes, and propagating the malware through the model of the network from the source computer node over a plurality of step-times. The propagation is determined based on a rate of transmission per step-time for each edge, and each step-time of the plurality of step-times corresponds to a temporal point that is universal across the network, such that at each step-time the malware propagation through the network occurs simultaneously for each edge of the plurality of edges according to the rate of transmission per step-time for each edge.
assignees: BRITISH TELECOMM

title_en: Fault diagnosis method and system based on transformer data sample expansion
abstract_en: The invention provides a fault diagnosis method and a fault diagnosis system based on transformer data sample expansion, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring main transformer test data, performing data cleaning on the main transformer test data, and dividing the main transformer test data after the data cleaning into main transformer test training data and main transformer test data according to a preset proportion; carrying out normalization processing on the main transformer test training data; establishing a back propagation neural network model for transformer fault diagnosis through the normalized main transformer test training data and the loss function, and optimizing the back propagation neural network model for transformer fault diagnosis through the main transformer test data; and inputting the operation data of the transformer into the optimized back propagation neural network model for transformer fault diagnosis to obtain a fault result of the transformer. The invention aims at the unbalanced sample to realize the performance improvement of transformer fault category identification.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE OF GUANGDONG POWER GRID LIMITED RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY

title_en: Audit data processing method suitable for distribution network engineering
abstract_en: The invention provides an audit data processing method suitable for distribution network engineering, which comprises the following steps: generating first twin distribution network 3D data based on first component information of a first distribution network engineering number at the current moment; acquiring all second component information in current audit data received at the current moment to obtain a second component set, and segmenting the first twin distribution network 3D data based on the second component set to obtain second twin distribution network 3D data; acquiring third twin distribution network 3D data corresponding to the second twin distribution network 3D data in the first twin distribution network 3D data; verifying the current audit data of the 3D data of the second twin distribution network to obtain a first verification result based on the historical audit data and/or the information cascade strategy of the 3D data of the third twin distribution network; and correspondingly storing the current audit data, the first verification result and the 3D data of the second twin distribution network, and updating the 3D data of the first twin distribution network.
assignees: ZHEJIANG PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY OF STATE GRID;JINHUA POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF ZHEJIANG PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY OF STATE GRID

title_en: Distributed power distribution network electricity price adjustment method based on convolution network and collaborative filtering
abstract_en: The invention provides a distributed power distribution network electricity price adjustment method based on convolution network and collaborative filtering, which comprises the following steps of 1, extracting characteristics according to power distribution network data; 2, constructing a scoring matrix, 3, decomposing singular values, 4, calculating the similarity degree, 5, confirming users to be recommended, and 6, selecting recommended users according to the sequence of the users. According to the method, the output prediction of the distribution network with the distributed power supply is realized by adopting a convolutional neural network method, the data characteristic extraction is realized, the period with abundant output of the distribution network with the distributed power supply is predicted, and the electricity price is adjusted by utilizing the prediction result. The collaborative filtering method based on the singular value decomposition and the model is also used for pushing electricity price preferential information to users, the application range of the singular value decomposition method is wide, the method is suitable for large-scale data, the collaborative filtering performance can be improved, and sorting can be more accurately screened. And determining a final recommended user according to the similarity sequence between the user and the target user, and reducing unnecessary information propagation cost.

title_en: Method for evaluating cascading failure vulnerability of power system including wind power plant
abstract_en: The invention relates to an evaluation method for cascading failure vulnerability of a power system including a wind power plant, which comprises the following steps of: 1) constructing an optimal power flow model based on a line overload model; 2) under the power grid cascading failure, the line shutdown routing is carried out by combining a thermal stability model and a random model of the power transmission line, and the total trip occupation ratio of the line is obtained; 3) performing cascading failure simulation based on the mixed optimal power flow model and the random model, constructing a power grid vulnerability index considering the wind power uncertainty level and the penetration rate, and evaluating the influence of the power grid vulnerability through the total percentage of line tripping and the total load shedding percentage under the cascading failure. Compared with the prior art, the method effectively solves the problems of uncertainty and permeability of the power grid caused by popularization of renewable energy sources such as wind power generation and the like, quickly and accurately evaluates the vulnerability of the power grid to different uncertainty levels and penetration rates during cascading failures, and is helpful for technicians and decision-makers to more efficiently solve related practical problems.
assignees: SHANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY OF STATE GRID;SHANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER UNIV

title_en: Electrical equipment operation data classification method based on BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electrical equipment operation data classification method based on a BP (Back propagation) neural network, belongs to the field of power grid data service, relates to the technical field of BP neural network models, and particularly comprises an electrical equipment data acquisition module, a classification model building module and a data classification model application module. The electrical equipment data acquisition module is mainly used for collecting and integrating the operating data of the electrical equipment and transmitting the acquired data to the model building module; the classification model building module is mainly used for training data, determining and correcting model parameters and forming a data classification model so as to improve the generalization capability of the model; the data classification model application module applies the established model to the actual operation process to classify the data. The method has the advantages of high reliability, strong application capability, good prediction capability and the like, and can be widely applied to various classification scenes of the operation data of the power grid equipment, such as the classification of normal, abnormal and invalid data.
assignees: SOUTHWEST TRAFFIC UNIV;LIMITED COMPANY OF STATE GRID INSTITUTE OF ECONOMICS AND TECH

title_en: Power grid system construction optimization method based on cascade failure simulation
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid system construction optimization method based on cascade failure simulation, which comprises the steps of firstly designing an initial network model of a power grid system to be constructed, then carrying out cascade failure simulation on the network model containing a failure link, including current redistribution and link state updating, obtaining a network model after cascade failure, and finally judging whether the initial network model meets design requirements according to the network model after cascade failure. The method and the device are applied to the construction process of the real power grid, can be used for detecting the safety of the existing power grid, and can be used for checking whether the designed power grid meets the construction requirement when the real power grid is constructed.

title_en: System for providing power supply service for cost saving based on Time of Use (TOU) and method therefor
title_ko: 계시별 요금제를 기초로 비용 절약을 위한 전력 공급 서비스를 제공하기 위한 시스템 및 이를 위한 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for providing a cost-saving power supply service based on a time-of-use rate plan. The system includes: a service server generating a transaction by signing a smart contract including service details to be provided to a user device with a service private key and transmitting the generated transaction to a blockchain network; and node devices forming the blockchain network. Here, a node device that is one of the node devices and has succeeded in mining extracts the smart contract from the transaction, generates a block including the extracted smart contract, and propagates the generated block to the node devices. The node devices verify the block and connect the block to the blockchain when the verification is successful.
abstract_ko: 계시별 요금제(TOU: Time-of-Use)를 기초로 비용 절약을 위한 전력 공급 서비스를 제공하기 위한 시스템이 제공된다. 상기 시스템은 사용자장치에 제공할 서비스 내역을 포함하는 스마트계약서를 서비스 개인키로 서명하여 트랜잭션을 생성하고, 생성된 트랜잭션을 블록체인네트워크로 전송하는 서비스서버와, 상기 블록체인네트워크를 형성하는 복수의 노드장치를 포함한다. 여기서, 상기 복수의 노드장치 중 채굴에 성공한 노드장치는 상기 트랜잭션으로부터 스마트계약서를 추출하여 추출된 스마트계약서를 포함하는 블록을 생성하고, 상기 생성된 블록을 상기 복수의 노드장치로 전파하고, 상기 복수의 노드장치는 상기 블록을 검증하고, 검증에 성공하면 블록체인에 상기 블록을 연결하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: OMNISYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Power information network defense system and method based on honey net
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of network security, and particularly relates to a power information network defense system and method based on a honey net. The invention establishes a malicious software propagation model of a double-layer coupling network containing a honey net in the coupling network, and establishes a power information network defense system based on the honey net according to the model; constructing a non-uniformly distributed double-layer coupling network according to an actual network structure; the construction of the unevenly distributed double-layer coupling network is a malware propagation model of the double-layer coupling network containing the industrial control honeypot, and comprises the following steps: power information networks and honey nets. When the network structure is constructed, the heterogeneous network structure is considered to be more consistent with a real power information network, the honeynet technology is utilized, malicious software which is widely spread in the power information network can be pertinently and effectively resisted, the prediction result of the model can be visually displayed by utilizing the visualization technology, and meanwhile, the research result is also beneficial to improving the deployment efficiency of honeypots.
assignees: LIAONING PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY OF STATE GRID;UNIV NORTHEAST;INFORMATION COMMUNICATION BRANCH COMPANY OF LIAONING PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY OF STATE GR

title_en: Two-step ring-opening planning method and system for receiving end alternating current electromagnetic ring network containing direct current feed
abstract_en: The invention provides a two-step ring-opening planning method for a receiving-end alternating-current electromagnetic ring network with direct-current feed, which carries out priority sorting on optimization targets according to importance differences to form a two-step optimization framework. The first step aims at the 'direct current cascading failure avoidance' target with obviously stronger importance and priority, and the second step aims at other loop-opening targets by taking the result generated in the first step as a constraint condition. The method can be used for electromagnetic ring network ring opening planning of an alternating current-direct current hybrid power grid, comprehensively considers the ring opening requirement of a new electromagnetic ring network related to direct current, and achieves the aims of avoiding direct current cascading failure, controlling short-circuit current level, tide, load balancing and the like.

title_en: Methods, apparatus, and systems using closed access group (cag) support in minimization of service interruptions (mint)
abstract_en: Methods, apparatus, and systems are disclosed. A method, implemented by a Wireless Transmit/Receive Unit (WTRU) may use a first Public Land Mobile Network (PLMN) not affected by a disaster condition and a second PLMN affected by a disaster condition. The method may include: receiving from a CAG cell of the first PLMN, broadcast information indicating: (1) that the CAG cell supports disaster inbound roaming (DIR) of WTRUs associated with the second PLMN and (2) that the CAG Cell accepts CAG-supporting disaster inbound roamers; selecting the CAG cell of the first PLMN based on the broadcasted information; and sending a Registration Request message including information indicating a DIR indication and an identifier of the second PLMN. The method may further include receiving new CAG information associated with the first PLMN; and initiating a cell (re)selection procedure using the new CAG information associated with the first PLMN.
assignees: INTERDIGITAL PATENT HOLDINGS INC

title_en: Power distribution network safe and economic dispatching method considering multiple systems
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for safely and economically scheduling a power distribution network considering multiple systems, which comprises the following steps of: s1, establishing a park comprehensive energy system model; s2, establishing a dispatching model of the park comprehensive energy system with the aim of minimum comprehensive cost; s3, establishing an optimized dispatching model of the active power distribution network system; and S4, coupling the park comprehensive energy system and the active power distribution network system by using a target cascade method, and solving an optimal scheduling scheme. The invention not only considers the economy of the power distribution network, but also considers the operation risk problem of the power distribution network, constructs a weighted objective function, and adopts a target cascade method combined with a harmony search algorithm to solve, thereby achieving the balance of safety and economy.
assignees: YANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH COMPANY OF JIANGSU PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY OF STATE GRID;STATE GRID JIANGSU PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY

title_en: Method for making short-term power generation plan of cascade hydropower station by considering peak shaving depth
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for making a short-term power generation plan of a cascade hydropower station by considering peak shaving depth, which relates to the field of short-term optimized dispatching of cascade hydropower stations in the power industry and comprises the following steps: step 1: determining a short-term power generation plan making idea considering the peak shaving depth; step 2: aiming at the characteristics of different peak regulation amplitudes and different water abandonment amounts in different periods, respectively establishing flood season, dry season and open season models, and determining model constraint conditions by taking peak regulation at different depths and water abandonment amount reduction as targets and combining a cascade energy storage control strategy of a key time node in an actual scheduling process and cascade power station peak capacity meeting power consumption requirements of a power grid, wherein the constraints comprise water balance, reservoir water level constraint, final water level control, peak regulation depth constraint, power generation flow constraint, ex-reservoir flow constraint, power station output constraint and the like, and determining a model solving algorithm; and step 3: and carrying out short-term optimization scheduling solution by using a heuristic algorithm.
assignees: POOL POOL HYDROELECTRIC POWER PLANT OF HUAYUFU NEW ENERGY CO LTD;LIMITED COMPANY OF ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE OF CHINA

title_en: Method for realizing networking communication of low-power-consumption wireless equipment for fire fighting
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for realizing networking communication of low-power-consumption wireless equipment for fire fighting, which comprises a mode of communication between the wireless equipment and a host and a mode of independent work of the wireless equipment, and realizes remote communication of the wireless equipment through wireless networking under the condition that a repeater is not required to be installed. In the mode of communication between the wireless equipment and the host, the wireless equipment is arranged according to the coding address sequence in a link mode, each wireless equipment is used as a transfer station, information is transmitted to the next stage according to the direction of raising or lowering the coding address, a first wake-up command is sent when the information is transmitted, the first wake-up command is used for activating the whole link, all the wireless equipment is in a wake-up mode, then the information is sent again, the sleep mode is entered after the information is sent, and the information is a control command sent by the host or fire alarm and fault information reported by the wireless equipment. Under the mode that the wireless equipment works independently, a plurality of wireless equipment are arranged according to the coding address sequence in a link mode or an array mode to form array type or cascade type alarm in the area.
assignees: CRUMP TIANJIAN FIRE FIGHTING EQUIPMENT LTD COMPANY

title_en: Dynamic cooperative economic dispatching method for multi-microgrid access new energy power distribution system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power systems, and particularly relates to a dynamic cooperative economic dispatching method for accessing a multi-microgrid into a new energy power distribution system, which comprises the steps of obtaining the load of the new energy power distribution network system, the maximum output of each unit of the power distribution network and the microgrid and the power generation cost; establishing a DED model of the distribution network, and calculating the optimal production cost of the distribution network meeting the load requirement; establishing a microgrid DED model, and calculating a power transmission scheduling mode meeting the lowest total operation cost; and establishing a dynamic cooperative economic dispatching model containing a multi-microgrid access new energy power distribution system, and carrying out optimization management on the overall energy. The invention considers the randomness of distributed energy power generation and the difference between benefit bodies of a distribution network and a microgrid, establishes an active power distribution system DED model under the condition of multi-microgrid access based on an analysis target cascade theory, can provide effective technical support for safe, stable and economical operation of the active power distribution system, and is beneficial to the optimal management of power grid operators on the overall energy of the whole active power distribution system.
assignees: CHINESE POWER CONSTRUCTION GROUP QINGHAI PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INSTITUTE LTD COMPANY

title_en: Real-time power system cascading failure risk assessment method and system based on space-time diagram neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time power system cascading failure risk assessment method and system based on a space-time diagram neural network. According to the cascading failure risk real-time prediction method and system, the highly nonlinear mapping relation between the time sequence electrical characteristics in the historical failures and the final failure models is extracted through the space-time diagram neural network, and the cascading failure risk is predicted according to the real-time operation data of the power system based on the mapping relation. The method considers the real-time prediction of the cascading failure risk, and has important significance for guaranteeing the safe and stable operation of the power system.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Establishment method of comment analysis model based on social network rumor propagation
abstract_en: A method for establishing a comment analysis model based on social network rumor propagation comprises the following steps: classifying the population, and determining a rumor dynamics propagation mechanism according to the classification result; constructing a rumor propagation model with a comment mechanism according to the rumor propagation mechanism; carrying out global kinetic analysis on the rumor propagation model to obtain a basic regeneration number function determining the kinetic property of the system; according to the basic regeneration number function, whether a global stability point of the rumor propagation model exists is judged, if yes, the rumor propagation model is taken as a target model, and the invention considers the promotion and popularity of new mechanisms such as barrage, message leaving, praise and the like under the current network environment, thereby improving the problem existing in the traditional rumor propagation mode and further enabling the rumor propagation model to conform to the actual situation.
assignees: UNIV GUANGZHOU

title_en: Power system toughness assessment method considering delay cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating toughness of a power system considering a time delay cascading failure, which comprises the steps of (1) sampling a line failure, setting the line failure as a system initial failure, establishing a cascading failure simulation model frame considering time sampling, (2) establishing a cut load constraint for the frame in the step 1 under each broken line condition according to power grid line and load data, (3) referring to a recovery mode of the power grid after the failure in actual operation, establishing a line failure recovery time model for the frame in the step 1, and establishing a power grid constraint considering a motor climbing rate, (4) sampling a plurality of accident chains, integrating the total load rate of the power grid to change with time, and realizing toughness evaluation for a certain determined power grid under fault impact. The invention can realize the cascading failure typical mode evaluation aiming at the power grid system by taking the development of the cascading failure in time as the purpose, thereby providing reference for the prevention of the power grid cascading failure loss.

title_en: Power distribution network line loss calculation method for optimizing BP neural network by improving sparrow search
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network line loss calculation method for improving sparrow search and optimizing a BP (back propagation) neural network, which comprises the steps of continuously collecting data of a plurality of required historical moments through a power grid advanced measurement system, and preprocessing the data; secondly, inputting the preprocessed data of each historical moment into a BP (back propagation) neural network for prediction to obtain the predicted line loss rate of each historical moment, constructing a BP neural network loss function model by combining the predicted line loss rate with the data, and further performing optimization solution by a sparrow search algorithm which is improved by chaotic initialization and t-distribution variation fusion to obtain an optimized BP neural network; finally, the data collected in real time are input into the optimized BP neural network for prediction to obtain the real-time predicted line loss rate.
assignees: UNIV WUHAN

title_en: Power system scheduling method based on cascading failure prevention
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system scheduling method based on cascading failure prevention, which comprises the following steps: (1) according to the topology of the power system, the parameters and the constraints of the related lines, a cascading failure model of the power system is established through direct current load flow calculation; (2) calculating line parameters representing the correlation of cascading failures in the power system according to the cascading failure accident chain data, and establishing corresponding power system operation constraints; (3) according to the power grid line and load data, ensuring the power quality and the power safety, and establishing a scheduling method model which meets all load consumption with the lowest power generation cost or fuel consumption; (4) and obtaining a safe operation optimization strategy of the power system by taking the lowest power generation cost and load shedding cost of the generator as optimization targets. The method can optimize the operation of the power system by taking the cascading failure prevention as a target, and improves the toughness and the safety of the power system while considering the economy of the power system.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID JIANGSU POWER CO LTD

title_en: Wind speed prediction method of towering spatial structure based on ICEEMDAN-BP
abstract_en: The invention discloses a towering spatial structure wind speed prediction method based on ICEEMDAN-BP, which comprises the following steps: determining the number of wind speed sequences for training a neural network, and inputting a training set wind speed sequence; performing a full set empirical mode decomposition of the improved adaptive noise on the data; performing Hilbert transform on the intrinsic mode function subsequence; summing Hilbert spectrums and reconstructing a wind speed sequence; carrying out normalization processing on the reconstructed wind speed sequence; inputting training set data to train the back propagation neural network; predicting a wind speed sequence by using the neural network model; and (5) performing inverse normalization on the output result of the neural network model to obtain a predicted wind speed sequence. The wind speed prediction method provided by the invention effectively solves the problem of low precision of the antenna near-field nonlinear non-stationary wind speed direct prediction, and the effective wind speed prediction is accurately realized through modal decomposition and a neural network, so that the regulation and control systems of high-rise structures such as an antenna, a radar and the like are guided to compensate for the deformation caused by wind load in advance.
assignees: UNIV XIAN ELECTRONIC SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Thermal power generating unit control system modeling method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a method, a device, equipment and a medium for modeling a thermal power generating unit control system, belongs to the technical field of data processing, and specifically comprises the following steps: collecting a time sequence data set; converting a transfer function model corresponding to a thermal power unit control system into a discrete form of a state space model with an uncertain item through a neural ordinary differential equation network to obtain a state equation; inputting the state variable and the input variable into a state equation to obtain an approximate value of first order differential; normalizing the approximate value, inputting the normalized approximate value into an ordinary differential solver, and calculating a predicted value; and (4) performing back propagation on the predicted value, and iteratively training weight parameters in the neural ordinary differential equation network until convergence, so as to obtain a prediction model corresponding to the thermal power unit control system. According to the scheme disclosed by the invention, the neural ordinary differential equation network is taken as a basis, the state space model of the system is combined, and the state equation structure knowledge is introduced to model the system, so that the prediction accuracy and the adaptability after modeling are improved.
assignees: UNIV CENTRAL SOUTH

title_en: Infectious disease propagation model modeling simulation method based on time sequence network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an infectious disease propagation model modeling simulation method based on a time sequence network, which constructs a novel time sequence network model with multiple interaction modes and researches a basic infectious disease propagation process on the model. The invention improves the time sequence network model by distinguishing the interaction mode of the common node and the leader node, considers the situation of many-to-many communication in real life by utilizing the concept of the leader node in the time sequence network model, and combines the time sequence network model with a single-to-single communication, so that the model is more suitable for the operation mechanism of the actual society. Has important guiding significance for controlling the spread of diseases and the negative information transmission.
assignees: UNIV HANGZHOU NORMAL

title_en: Active power distribution network partitioning method based on graph convolution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an active power distribution network partitioning method based on a graph convolution network, which comprises the following steps: 1. establishing an undirected graph model of the active power distribution network; 2. preprocessing characteristic data of nodes of the active power distribution network to serve as training samples; 3. constructing a graph convolution neural network; 4. updating network parameters of the graph convolution neural network through a gradient descent back propagation algorithm; 5. and realizing network partition of the active power distribution network according to the optimal model. According to the method, the optimal partition result can be obtained without establishing and solving a complex active power distribution network partition mathematical optimization model, so that the time cost is reduced, the operation, control and management instructions of the active power distribution network can take effect in time, and the voltage quality is improved.
assignees: FERTILIZER COMBINING INDUSTRIAL UNIV

title_en: Fault diagnosis method for high-power magnetic plasma electric propulsion system
abstract_en: The invention provides a fault diagnosis method of a high-power magnetic plasma electric propulsion system, which belongs to the field of fault diagnosis and specifically comprises the following steps: firstly, establishing a high-power magnetic plasma propeller simulation model, and obtaining data in a fault-free state after operation; then setting a fault factor and adding the fault factor to a high-power magnetic plasma propeller simulation model to form a fault simulation simulator, and acquiring data of a fault state; building a cascade feedforward neural network, and performing supervised learning training by using fault-free data and fault data; finally, fault data serving as test signal state quantity are input into the trained neural network by using a fault simulation simulator, output results of the neural network are counted and compared with real fault states, and accuracy is counted; the invention has the characteristics of high diagnosis accuracy and strong adaptability.
assignees: UNIV BEIHANG

title_en: Evolution optimization method for gas pipe network regulation and control scheme
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evolutionary optimization of a gas pipe network regulation and control scheme, which aims to optimize gas supply ratio of each pressure regulating station on the premise of meeting the load demand of a gas pipe network, sets the maximum value of the individual number of a population as N, randomly selects the gas supply ratios of the pressure regulating stations of two feasible schemes as chromosomes, and performs cross/variation calculation on the chromosomes until N offspring are generated to form the population, thereby completing the first generation evolutionary reproduction; selecting two optimal individuals from the population as chromosomes through an evaluation function, and performing cross/variation calculation again until N offspring are generated to form the population, thereby completing the second generation evolution and propagation; and carrying out multi-generation evolution and propagation according to the method until the algorithm is converged, wherein the optimal individual in the final generation of population is the optimal solution of the air supply ratio of each pressure regulating station. And optimizing the regulation and control scheme by taking the optimal solution as a target, and providing required key capacity for intelligent regulation and control and safe and high-quality gas supply of the gas pipe network.
assignees: BEIJING AEROSPACE TOPOLOGY HIGH TECH LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY

title_en: Key line identification method for AC/DC power grid accident chain
abstract_en: A key line identification method of an AC/DC power grid accident chain comprises the following steps: step 1: acquiring an alternating current/direct current power grid cascading failure accident chain to be processed, identifying a key line, and recording the occurrence probability and load loss of the accident chain; step 2: constructing indexes aiming at the influence of lines in an accident chain on system power flow, voltage, topological structure and load loss; step 3: respectively solving subjective weight w 'and objective weight w' of the constructed indexes; step 4: establishing an objective function of w', w ", searching the most linear combination coefficient, carrying out combination weighting, and measuring the local importance IN  i  of the line L  i  IN the accident chain L  j ; step 5: the key index of each line l  i  in the AC/DC power grid is obtained as follows Step 6: sequencing the criticality indexes of all the lines, and taking a plurality of lines in front of the criticality indexes as the critical lines of the AC/DC power grid; and identifying the key circuit of the cascading failure of the AC/DC power grid through the steps.

title_en: Universal spacecraft heuristic time planning modeling and solving method
abstract_en: The invention provides a general spacecraft heuristic time planning modeling and solving method, which is characterized in that the general spacecraft model and mathematical expression thereof are provided by fully combining the characteristics and actual requirements of a space engineering task, a time constraint and an energy constraint of the spacecraft inspection detection state transition are represented by a time network structure diagram, constraint propagation and problem solving are carried out on the network structure diagram by adopting a forward pruning strategy, and the problem relaxation of a heuristic control function based on the maximum time span is designed and realized so as to improve the solving efficiency. The field model constructed by the method is more complete in expression, the complexity of planning solving and calculating is reduced by adopting a temporal network structure diagram technology, and the complexity of algorithm design is greatly simplified.

title_en: Power distribution network line reinforcement strategy considering flexibility of demand side resources
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network line reinforcement strategy considering the flexibility of demand side resources, which comprises the following steps: acquiring frame information and the ground meteorological data of a certain power distribution network, performing load flow calculation based on node load data and network topology information of the power distribution network, and judging whether a voltage out-of-limit node and an overload branch exist in the network; defining the flexibility requirement of the system by the net load difference value of adjacent time periods of the system; predicting the output of a photovoltaic power station based on a multi-Markov chain Monte Carlo model, and clustering to generate a typical flexibility demand scene based on a neighbor propagation algorithm; aggregating and modeling the adjustable boundary of the multi-energy heterogeneous resources at the demand side based on the virtual battery model; optimizing the gears of the on-load tap changing transformer by taking the minimum voltage deviation degree of the node of the power distribution network as a target; if the node voltage is out of limit or the line is overloaded, then the day-ahead economic dispatching of the power distribution network for considering the resource flexibility of the demand side is carried out; searching a line reinforcement economic scheme by adopting an evolutionary particle swarm algorithm, introducing the maximum annual insufficient electric quantity index to evaluate risks and selecting a reinforcement scheme with the minimum index; and updating network topology information, repeating the steps until all the years in the traversal planning period, and outputting a line reinforcement optimal scheme. By adopting the strategy of the invention, the flexibility of the demand side resources can be effectively utilized to slow down the high-volume investment of the strengthening of the power distribution network lines, and the strategy has positive significance on the economic planning and decision of the strengthening of the power distribution network lines.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Time series load prediction method based on convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a time series load prediction method based on a convolutional neural network, which comprises the following steps: preprocessing the related data; establishing a time series load prediction model according to the preprocessed data, and carrying out forward propagation training on the time series load prediction model to obtain a forward propagation prediction result; calculating a mean square error according to the forward propagation prediction result and the actual value, carrying out BP (back propagation) backward propagation calculation on the mean square error, and correcting model parameters; fitting and training the corrected model parameters and training data until the training result of the time series load prediction model is converged, and predicting the power load by using the trained time series load prediction model; the method can effectively avoid the under-fitting condition of the model, and meanwhile, the time sequence load prediction model is built based on the convolutional neural network, so that the parameter training is reduced, the gradient descent trap is avoided, and the prediction precision is effectively improved.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY

title_en: Method and device for improving power grid benefit and stable operation of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for improving power grid benefit and stable operation of a power system, wherein the method comprises the steps of inputting parameters to construct a unit combination objective function, cascade hydroelectric power and thermal power and system constraint; establishing a unit combination model of the cascade hydroelectric power and thermal power considering a complex vibration area, and solving the model; and applying the solution to a power system according to the solution result to reduce the output fluctuation and the start-stop times of the thermal power generating unit. The invention establishes the cascade hydroelectric-thermal power system unit combination model considering the characteristics of the complex vibration region, effectively avoids the problems of poor safety of a power system, low operation benefit and the like caused by flexible peak regulation operation of hydroelectric in the vibration region, and has important significance for ensuring the safe, stable and economic operation of a power grid.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH CHINA SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Power battery cascade utilization decision-making method and system based on scene matching
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power battery recycling and discloses a scene matching-based power battery cascade utilization decision method, which comprises the steps of obtaining cascade utilization standard use parameters of various practical application scenes on a power battery, and basic parameters and performance parameters of the power battery; and comparing the obtained power battery performance parameters with the cascade utilization standard use parameters of the power battery in various practical application scenes based on the trained neural network classification model, thereby obtaining a decision result of the cascade utilization of the power battery. The invention also discloses a corresponding system. The invention can not only process big data more quickly and comprehensively and improve decision efficiency and accuracy, but also effectively solve the problems of disassembly depth decision of various retired power batteries and matching decision with various practical application scenes.

title_en: Problem data processing method and system for distribution network engineering management
abstract_en: The invention provides a problem data processing method and system for distribution network engineering management, which specifically comprise the following steps: determining a problem information transmission path corresponding to the first power monitoring information in the digital twin distribution network model, and taking each node in the problem information transmission path as a target screening node; acquiring all other distribution network equipment connected with the target screening node in the problem information transmission path to generate a twin node topological graph, taking all other distribution network equipment as auxiliary screening nodes, classifying the auxiliary screening nodes corresponding to the target screening nodes according to the twin node topological graph, and acquiring a verification screening set corresponding to each target screening node; sequentially traversing each target screening node in the node screening sequence, and screening according to a verification screening set corresponding to each target screening node to obtain the problem data; and processing the problem data based on an information cascade strategy and a preset twin strategy database to obtain corresponding processing data.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;JINHUA POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Industrial network data switch
abstract_en: The invention discloses an industrial network data switch, which relates to the technical field of communication and comprises a shell, wherein a display screen for man-machine interaction operation is arranged on the shell, and the industrial network data switch also comprises a central processing unit module, a battery module, a POE module, a plug-in module, a cascade plug-in module, a PHY module, an MAC chip module, an Atmega128 module, a CPLD module, a FLASH module, a storage module, a serial communication module, an industrial field communication module and a Bluetooth communication module. The invention has certain fault resistance and can adapt to emergency situations under industrial working conditions; the access of a conventional interface and various communication protocols can be supported, data exchange is facilitated, and the universality of the switch is improved; the display screen has a display screen capable of being manually operated, is convenient for processing data, and has certain computing power.
assignees: SUZHOU HUIYUNDING TECH SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Short-term personal load prediction method, system, equipment and terminal for privacy protection
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of data security, and discloses a short-term personal load prediction method, a system, equipment and a terminal for privacy protection.A user load data collection stage for privacy protection is that a user collects short-term load data of an intelligent power grid, randomly splits the data and uploads a ciphertext to a training model training server; in the training preprocessing stage, a security protocol is utilized between training model training servers to generate a private computation auxiliary data matrix multiplication triple; in the safe forward propagation stage, the load predicted value is safely calculated by using the encrypted historical data; in the safe reverse propagation stage, according to the difference between the real value and the predicted value, calculating new parameters of the prediction model in a private manner, and iterating for multiple times; and stopping iteration, obtaining load prediction model parameters under ciphertext training, and sending the load prediction models of the two parties to a user for actual prediction. The privacy protection scheme provided by the invention is efficient in the aspects of calculation, communication overhead and the like of the user and the server.
assignees: UNIV XIDIAN

title_en: Cascade reservoir group optimal scheduling method and system considering generated energy and minimum output
abstract_en: The invention provides a cascade reservoir group optimal scheduling method and system which give consideration to generated energy and minimum output, which can enable the generation of the cascade reservoir group to be more coordinated with the power grid demand and promote the cascade reservoir group to fully utilize the water energy. The cascade reservoir group optimization scheduling method taking the generated energy and the minimum output into consideration comprises the following steps: step 1, establishing a cascade reservoir group multi-objective optimization scheduling model with the aim of maximum cascade power generation capacity and minimum power output according to the basic situation of a river basin and comprehensive utilization requirements; step 2, solving a multi-objective model by adopting a DDDP-SA algorithm combined with penalty factors, and obtaining a non-inferior solution set with uniform and wide multi-objective problem distribution by controlling the variation range of the penalty factors and selecting discrete penalty factors in the range; and step 3, determining the optimal solution of the cascade reservoir group optimal scheduling according to the non-inferior solution set.

title_en: Data-driven risk analysis method and device fusing physical knowledge
abstract_en: The invention provides a data-driven risk analysis method and device fusing physical knowledge, which comprises the steps of acquiring and processing accident data, judging risk association relations in advance through the physical knowledge, determining mandatory relations among node variables, selecting a Bayesian search algorithm, a greedy algorithm and a PC algorithm for structure learning, constructing a data-driven model, developing parameter learning by combining an expectation maximization algorithm, quantizing probability distribution among the node variables, selecting a cause association relation model with better learning performance from k-fold cross validation results, and determining risk priority by considering the dependence and sensitivity of different risks on the whole network through a risk propagation effect. The method provided by the embodiment combines physical knowledge, considers insufficient and unbalanced blowout accident data, selects different structure learning algorithms, combines parameter learning to establish a blowout accident cause evolution model, analyzes the blowout accident risk association relation and the importance degree, and is beneficial to accident risk prevention and control.
assignees: BEIJING INSTITUTE TECH

title_en: Reducing wireless device service interruptions
abstract_en: Apparatuses, systems, and methods for reducing wireless device service interruptions. An indication of a disaster condition may be provided to a wireless device. The disaster condition may affect a home public land mobile network of the wireless device. The wireless device may perform cell selection in a manner influenced by the indication of the disaster condition. This may include considering cells associated with a forbidden public land mobile network for the cell selection, or excluding cells associated with the home public land mobile network of the wireless device that are unavailable, for example due to the disaster condition, among various possibilities.
assignees: APPLE INC

title_en: Power grid construction progress and safety identification method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep learning-based power grid construction progress and safety identification method, which comprises the following steps of: preprocessing a capital construction project image and making a data set; zooming the data set, and sequentially inputting the data set to the recognition model according to the set number of images; performing forward propagation calculation on the input through the identification model, and calculating a loss value according to a forward propagation result and a real frame in the labeled image; calculating the gradient of each weight matrix and the bias parameter of the recognition model by the loss value respectively, and updating the recognition model; if the updated recognition model is not converged or does not reach the maximum training frequency, performing forward propagation calculation on the input again through the updated recognition model, and stopping training the recognition model until the updated recognition model is converged or the maximum training frequency is reached; identifying the image of the infrastructure project by using the trained identification model; the intelligent construction site monitoring system can accurately monitor the construction site progress, provides decision basis for a construction site, and realizes automation and intelligence of the intelligent construction site.
assignees: GUANGZHOU CITY SAI HAO INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and apparatus to reduce service interruption in communication system
abstract_en: A method of a user equipment (UE) is provided. The method includes identifying a disaster condition for a first network, identifying whether the UE is in a registered state and a connected state over a first access based on the identified disaster condition, and performing a disaster roaming based on an identification that the UE is not in the registered state and the connected state over the first access.
assignees: SAMSUNG ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Holding Reinforcement with Elastic Material
title_ko: 탄성소재를 구비한 지주 보강재
abstract_en: A general dual floor having a poor earthquake response ability requires the securement of an earthquake response ability through dual floor support seismic reinforcement. In accordance with the present invention, a dual floor support is reinforced through a support combination reinforcement material, a diagonal reinforcement material and a horizontal reinforcement material, wherein not every support in a corresponding room is reinforced, and, instead, a support in an area excluding an equipment area is selectively reinforced. In the equipment area, there is difficulty for a person to work because most dual floor supports in the area are no more than 40cm in height. There is difficulty not only for a newly constructed dual floor but also for an existing dual floor in most cases. In accordance with the present invention, a reinforcement material is developed to basically reinforce the flange of a dual floor room to be reinforced, and, when seismic reinforcement is determined as lacking through seismic analysis, achieve sufficient seismic performance by additionally reinforcing a support column (row) in which there is no equipment. Moreover, the reinforcement material is developed to be installable on an existing dual floor without the need for the dismantlement of a support. In accordance with another characteristic of the present invention, a material with a high frictional force is applied to the reinforcement material such that the support and the reinforcement material can properly come in tight contact, which can lead to an improvement in seismic performance. As the reinforcement material has passed a test of the National Radio Research Agency 2020-1 test method (6.8 on the Richter scale) in an authorized test institution, the performance thereof is proved.
abstract_ko:
일반적인 이중마루는 지진에 대한 대응 능력이 약하여 이중마루 지주 내진보강을 통하여 지진에 대한 대응능력을 확보하여야 한다. 본 발명에서는 지주결합보강재와 대각보강재, 수평보강재를 활용하여 이중마루지주를 보강하되 해당실 전체 지주를 보강하는 것이 아닌 장비영역을 제외한 영역의 지주를 선택적으로 보강한다. 장비가 있는 영역은 이중마루 지주의 높이가 40cm 이하인 경우가 많아 사람이 작업하기가 사실상 어렵다. 신설 이중마루인 경우도 어렵지만 기 시설된 이중마루의 경우에는 사실상 지주를 보강하는 것은 대부분 어렵다. 
본 발명에서는 보강대상 이중마루실의 테두리를 기본적으로 보강하고 내진해석을 통하여 내진보강이 부족할 경우에는 장비가 없는 지주열(행)을 추가적으로 보강하여도 충분한 내진 성능을 가지도록 하는 보강재를 개발하였다. 또한, 기 설치된 이중마루에 설치하기 위해서 지주를 해체하지 않고 설치가 가능하도록 개발되었다. 본 발명의 또다른 특징은 지주와 보강재가 밀착이 잘될 수 있도록 마찰력이 강한 소재를 보강재에 적용하여 내진 성능을 향상시켰다는 것이다. 본 보강재를 사용하여 공인시험기관에서 ‘국립전파연구원 2020-1 시험방법(리히터규모 6.8수준)’의 시험을 완료하여 성능을 입증하였다.
assignees: CHAMSOL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wireless communication auxiliary equipment system using CATV system, and main equipment and remote equipment therefor
title_ko: Catv 시스템을 활용한 소방무선통신보조설비 시스템과, 그를 위한 메인장비 및 리모트 장비
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a wireless communication auxiliary fire-fighting facility system utilizing a CATV system, a main device, and a remote device for the system. The wireless communication auxiliary facility system comprises: a main device which controls the overall wireless communication auxiliary facility system, receives disaster prevention signals from a wireless communication device of a central control room, removes frequency modulation and noise from the signals, and outputs the signals; a plurality of remote devices which are installed on underground and aboveground floors of a building where radio waves are not easily accessible, and communicate with firefighters' radios located on underground or aboveground floors of the building; a combiner which receives a signal, in which a disaster prevention signal of a first frequency band (f1) and an upward broadcast signal are combined, from a transmission line facility, separates the disaster prevention signal of the first frequency band (f1), and outputs the separated signals to the main device, receives and combines a disaster prevention signal of a second frequency band (f2) output from the main device and a downward broadcast signal from a head end facility, and outputs the combined signal to the transmission line facility; and a splitter which combines a disaster prevention signal of the first frequency band (f1) output from the remote device and an upward broadcast signal of the transmission line facility, receives a signal, in which the disaster prevention signal of the second frequency band (f2) and the downward broadcast signal are combined, from the transmission line facility, separates the disaster prevention signal of the second frequency band (f2), and outputs the separated signals to the remote device, wherein the main device uses different transmission and reception frequencies when communicating with the combiner, and the remote device uses different transmission and reception frequencies when communicating with the splitter. Therefore, the present invention provides a solution to communication disorders caused by phenomena such as howling and vibration, thereby enabling improvement of communication quality.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 CATV 시스템을 활용한 무선통신보조설비 시스템과,그를 위한 메인장비 및 리모트장비에 관한 것으로서, 그 무선통신보조설비 시스템은  무선통신보조설비 시스템을 전반적으로 제어하고,중앙통제실의 무선통신기기로부터 방재신호를 수신하여 주파수 변조 및 잡음을 제거하여 출력하는 메인장비; 전파 도달이 원활하지 않는 건물의 지하층 및 지상층에 설치되고, 상기 건물의 지하층 또는 지상층에 있는 대원무전기와 통신하는 복수의 리모트장비; 전송선로 설비로부터 제1주파수(f1) 대역의 방재신호와 상향 방송신호가 결합된 신호를 수신하여 제1주파수(f1) 대역의 방재신호를 분리하여 메인장비로 출력하고, 메인장비로부터 출력되는 제2주파수(f2) 대역의 방재신호와 헤드엔드설비로부터 하향 방송신호를 수신하여 결합한 후 전송선로 설비로 출력하는 컴바이너; 및 리모트장비로부터 출력되는 제1주파수(f1) 대역의 방재신호와 전송선로 설비의 상향 방송신호를 결합하고,전송선로 설비로부터 제2주파수(f2) 대역의 방재신호와 하향 방송신호가 결합된 신호를 수신하여 제2주파수(f2) 대역의 방재신호를 분리한 후 리모트 장비로 출력하는 분기기를 포함하고, 그 메인장비는 컴바이너와의 통신시 송신주파수와 수신주파수를 달리하고, 그 리모트장비는 분기기와 통신시 송신주파수와 수신주파수를 달리한다.
assignees: ZEN RFT CO LTD

title_en: System for fire response and propagation system
title_ko: 화재대응 및 전파 시스템
abstract_en: According to one aspect of the present invention, a fire response and propagation system includes: a management server connected to a CCTV network and transmitting a fire warning signal; and a warning propagation means receiving the fire warning signal through the CCTV network to propagate the signal outwards. The present invention derives real-time priority of an entrance path of a fire engine by using a real-time fire road state collected from the CCTV network and fire road data stored in a fire road database. The management server transmits the fire warning signal to the warning propagation means located in the derived entrance path of the fire engine.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 측면에 따른 화재대응 및 전파 시스템은 CCTV 망과 연결되며, 화재경보 신호를 송신하는 관리서버; 및 상기 화재경보 신호를 CCTV 망을 통해 전달받아 외부에 전파하는 경보전파 수단;을 포함하며, 상기 CCTV 망으로부터 수집된 실시간 소방도로 상태와 소방도로 데이터베이스에 저장된 소방도로 데이터를 활용해 소방차 진입경로의 실시간 우선순위를 도출하고, 상기 관리서버는 도출된 상기 소방차 진입경로에 위치하는 상기 경보전파수단에 상기 화재경보 신호를 송신하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: NINE TELECOM NET CORP;FOREDEN CO LTD;KIM SU MI

title_en: Serious gaming for interdependent critical infrastructure (ci) resilience determination
abstract_en: Serious gaming for interrelated critical infrastructure (CI) resilience improvement includes receiving from a serious gaming participant a selection of an anomalous event for a geographic region for which a hierarchy of CI elements has been modeled, and a specified change in allocation of at least one resource in a corresponding one of the CI elements. A previously determined cascading impact upon the CI elements resulting from the anomalous event is then retrieved and compared to a hypothetical cascading impact produced by a simulation of the model with the specified change. A visualization of the comparison is transmitted to the serious gaming participant so as to show the result of the hypothetical change in resources upon the cascading impact of the event in the hierarchy of CI elements.
assignees: UNIV DUBLIN;Nurogames GmbH

title_en: New energy power grid cascading failure prediction method based on machine learning and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy power grid cascading failure prediction method based on machine learning and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps of: constructing a high-ratio new energy power grid cascading failure database based on historical cascading failure actual measurement data and simulation data; extracting characteristic indexes capable of representing complex network topological characteristics and system running states from a macro level, a medium level and a micro level based on a cascading failure database; analyzing the correlation between the extracted characteristic indexes and the system cascading failure operation state, and selecting the characteristic indexes with strong correlation to form a complex network cascading failure characteristic index set; based on a long-term and short-term memory neural network, a mapping relation between a complex network cascading failure characteristic index and a system running state in a historical cascading failure process is learned, and a high-occupancy-ratio new energy power grid cascading failure prediction model is constructed. The method can accurately and quickly predict the cascading failure of the high-proportion new energy power grid, is beneficial to effectively preventing and controlling the cascading failure of the complex-structure power system in the high-proportion new energy form, and improves the safe and stable operation capacity of the power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Disaster condition indication for serving PLMN
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a new mechanism involving a network node (100) and a client device (300) for indicating that a serving PLMN (610) is in a disaster situation. The network node informs the client device that the serving PLMN of the client device is in a disaster situation through control signaling (510). Thus, the client device may take appropriate measures to avoid service disruption, e.g., by initiating a PLMN selection procedure to register at a visited PLMN (620) that is not in a catastrophic condition. Examples of control signaling that may be used in this context are SIB, NAS, RRC messages or paging messages. Furthermore, the invention relates to a corresponding method and computer program.
assignees: HUAWEI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Connection maintaining method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a connection keeping method, a connection keeping device and electronic equipment, and belongs to the field of mobile communication. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a disaster relief message of a second network side; and responding to the disaster relief message, and executing a first operation to enable the terminal to maintain network connection. By the embodiment of the application, the terminal can still maintain network connection under the condition that the disaster of the second network is relieved, and service interruption is avoided.
assignees: VIVO COMM TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Distributed emergency scheduling method for power distribution network considering coordination of electric buses
abstract_en: The invention relates to a distributed emergency scheduling method of a power distribution network considering the cooperation of electric buses, which comprises the following steps of constructing a self-scheduling sub-model of the power distribution network; constructing an electric bus company self-dispatching sub-model for supporting the operation of the power distribution network by the electric bus company; based on a distribution network self-dispatching sub-model and an electric bus company self-dispatching sub-model, constructing a distribution network-electric bus company-electric bus cooperative emergency dispatching double-layer distributed model by adopting an extended Lagrangian method; and carrying out distributed iterative optimization on the power distribution network-electric bus company-electric bus collaborative emergency dispatching double-layer distributed model by adopting a target cascading method, and solving by utilizing a solver to obtain an optimal emergency dispatching strategy of the power distribution network and the electric bus company. According to the invention, emergency dispatching is performed from a distributed angle, so that the data privacy of a power distribution network and an electric bus company can be effectively protected, and the optimal solving speed of dispatching problems is improved through a double-layer distributed architecture.

title_en: BP neural network-based risk evaluation method for high consequence area of oil and gas pipeline
abstract_en: The invention relates to a BP neural network-based risk evaluation method for a high-consequence area of an oil and gas pipeline. Different from conventional error linear input and output, the evaluation system adopts a three-layer topological structure to perform an error back propagation algorithm, adds a hidden layer between an input layer and an output layer, and performs active learning optimization by alternating three layers of layers. The evaluation accuracy of the invention can be continuously optimized along with the training times, and the invention can carry out associative restoration on the missing input information and has more accuracy and cautiousness.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST PETROLEUM

title_en: Power accident cause analysis method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a power accident cause analysis method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an accident report of the power accident, and extracting a plurality of causative events in the accident report; determining the relation among a plurality of causative events according to the sequence and the frequency of occurrence of the plurality of causative events, and constructing an accident causative network; the importance of the network nodes is analyzed through the topological property of the accident cause network, the cause risk of the electric power accident is calculated by utilizing the cascading failure theory, and a risk management and control suggestion is generated, so that the specific cause of each type of accident can be effectively found, and the cause which plays a greater role in directly causing the accident can be conveniently determined. Therefore, the problems that the related technology cannot find the specific key cause of each type of accident, is not beneficial to determining the key cause from the perspective of the direct cause of the accident, does not fully consider the dynamic process of the domino effect, and is insufficient in simulating the actual occurrence process of the accident are solved.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Cement raw meal grinding system power consumption prediction method based on circulating high-speed neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting power consumption of a cement raw material grinding system based on a circulating high-speed neural network, which belongs to the technical field of industrial big data analysis and comprises the following steps: step 1: selecting variable data with the highest correlation with power consumption from an energy management database of a cement enterprise, cleaning abnormal values, then carrying out normalization and standardization processing, and arranging to obtain a complete time sequence; step 2: establishing a power consumption prediction model based on a circulating high-speed neural network, and predicting the power consumption value at the next moment by using variable data and a historical value of the power consumption value; and step 3: performing model training by adopting a supervised learning method, and adjusting and optimizing parameters of a coder decoder in a model by utilizing an error inverse propagation algorithm; and 4, step 4: and (4) realizing the real-time prediction of the power consumption of the cement raw material grinding system by utilizing the model completed in the steps. The prediction method reasonably schedules resources, and further provides possibility for reducing energy consumption and improving cement production efficiency.
assignees: UNIV YANSHAN

title_en: Bid electricity quantity boundary determination method for step hydropower station group participating in day-ahead spot market
abstract_en: The invention relates to the fields of electric power markets, hydro-electric scheduling and power grid operation, and discloses a bidding power quantity boundary determination method for a cascade hydropower station group participating in the daily spot market. Along with the continuous perfection of the construction of the electric spot market in China, the participation of hydropower in the spot market is imperative. In the electric power market, the clearing efficiency is related to the safe and stable operation of the power grid. Aiming at the problems that a spot delivery model is complex, the delivery efficiency is low and water and electricity are easy to participate in spot market, water abandon and trade results are difficult to execute and the like caused by complex hydraulic connection of a step upstream water reservoir and a step downstream water reservoir, the invention determines the daily market boundary conditions of the step hydropower station, provides the concept of absolute feasible electric quantity interval of the hydropower station, reveals the evolution rule of the electric quantity boundary of the step hydropower station along with the change of self-generatable water quantity, completely avoids the problem of unmatched upstream and downstream power stations, improves the delivery model solving efficiency, and provides a feasible idea for market operators to manage the participation of water and electricity in spot market.

title_en: Power transmission section searching method based on variable-scale neighbor propagation clustering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission section searching method based on variable-scale neighbor propagation clustering, which comprises the following steps of: 1. establishing a power network model; 2. and searching the power transmission section by variable-scale neighbor propagation clustering. The method considers the requirements of the power network, and divides the whole power network by different scales through carrying out multiple scale-variable partition operations on the power topological graph, so as to search out more potential power transmission sections, and be beneficial to a dispatching department to adjust the operation mode in time, thereby avoiding large-area power failure accidents of the power grid, ensuring safe and stable operation of the power grid and optimizing dispatching.
assignees: UNIV HEFEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Short-term wind power prediction method based on improved depth forest
