abstract_en: The invention relates to a short-term wind power prediction method based on an improved depth forest, which comprises the following steps: splicing time sequence data in the numerical weather forecast data to form multi-dimensional time sequence data, adding wind power labels to the multi-dimensional time sequence data to form a data set, and dividing the data set into a training set and a testing set; inputting the training set into an improved depth forest, performing network training, and forming a time sequence identity mapping of numerical weather forecast data and wind power forecast data; the improved depth forest is formed by combining a multi-granularity scanning layer and stacking layers and connecting cascade forests; and inputting the test set into a trained network, and outputting short-term wind power prediction data. According to the invention, by carrying out self-adaptive feature extraction which is beneficial to wind power prediction on the multidimensional input data through stacking layers and the multi-granularity scanning layers, wind power information under the condition of complex weather can be effectively extracted, the effectiveness of the extraction of the prediction features is improved, and the prediction accuracy is high.

title_en: Cascade hydropower station participation combined power market optimization scheduling method considering dynamic water flow time lag
abstract_en: The optimized scheduling method for the cascade hydropower station participation combined power market considering the dynamic water flow time lag aims at maximizing the medium and long term contract participation of hydropower enterprises and the power generation profit of the spot combined power market at present, comprehensively considers the dynamic water flow time lag between an upstream power station and a downstream power station, the power station operation constraint, the unit operation constraint and the power constraint, and improves the refinement level of the optimized scheduling of the cascade hydropower station. Aiming at nonlinear constraints in the model, such as a target function, a unit vibration region, dynamic water flow delay between cascade power stations and a unit running state, a series of linearization processing methods are provided, an original nonlinear mixed integer programming model is converted into a standard mixed integer linear programming model, and then a LINGO solver is used for solving the model. The invention maximizes the profit of power generation enterprises participating in the combined power market by using the compensation and regulation function between upstream and downstream reservoirs, improves the short-term optimization and scheduling precision of the cascade power station, and ensures the safe and efficient operation of the power station and the power grid.
assignees: UNIV ZHENGZHOU;YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method for monitoring capability of lifting well-ground integrated micro-seismic monitoring system
abstract_en: A method for improving the monitoring capability of a well-ground integrated micro-seismic monitoring system comprises the steps of firstly, selecting a plurality of candidate points which can be provided with wireless sensors on the ground to form a candidate point set of natural number codes, and randomly selecting a fixed number of candidate points from the candidate point set to form a well-ground integrated micro-seismic monitoring table network with the sensors which are installed underground; after multiple random selections, a well-ground integrated microseismic monitoring station mesh arrangement scheme with a certain scale is generated; and then, for each scheme individual, constructing a monitoring capability evaluation model by adopting a propagation relation of the microseismic energy and the P wave first arrival peak amplitude to form an initial population, solving by adopting a genetic evolution algorithm to obtain an optimal individual, and determining an optimal ground wireless sensor layout scheme for remarkably improving the well-to-ground integrated microseismic monitoring capability. The method provides effective guidance for on-site adjustment and optimization of the installation position of the ground wireless sensor, and ensures that the well-ground integrated microseismic monitoring system can observe the microseisms with various energy levels generated in the mine excavation production process.

title_en: Method for realizing power grid alarm data association traceability system based on density clustering and self-organizing network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing a power grid alarm data correlation traceability system based on density clustering and a self-organizing network, which comprises the following steps: segmenting original alarm data of multiple power stations based on multiple dimensions, and performing feature vectorization by using feature keywords of each dimension; extracting target suspicious alarm data from the vectorized alarm data, establishing a correlation index ConValue, and clustering the target alarm data and the alarm data of each power station by using a DBSCAN to obtain a plurality of pieces of correlation data; extracting the associated data and the alarm starting time and the latest occurrence time of the target alarm data, defining the port entry and the port exit of the associated data by taking the time of the target alarm data as an origin, and constructing an attack propagation diagram with two time dimensions; and performing secondary feature segmentation on the associated data of the multiple power stations, and performing secondary feature mining by using a self-organizing network to obtain fine-grained feature description of the associated data. The invention can ensure the safe and stable operation of the power monitoring system.
assignees: INF & TELECOMMUNICATION CO STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Disaster roaming method, device and system
title_ko: 재난 로밍 방법, 장치 및 시스템
abstract_en: The method, the device and the system for disaster roaming can reduce service interruption of terminal equipment, minimize service interruption and improve user experience. Specifically, the terminal equipment determines a first PLMN according to the stored information of the disaster roaming public land mobile network PLMN; the information of the disaster roaming PLMN comprises identification information of at least one PLMN allowing the terminal equipment to perform disaster roaming, wherein the first PLMN is a PLMN in the at least one PLMN; the terminal equipment sends a registration request message to the first PLMN, wherein the registration request message comprises disaster roaming indication information, and the disaster roaming indication information is used for indicating the terminal equipment to request disaster roaming registration; the terminal device receives a registration acceptance message sent by the first PLMN.
abstract_ko: 본 출원의 실시예는 단말 디바이스의 서비스 중단을 감소시키고, 서비스 중단을 최소화하며, 사용자 경험을 향상시킨, 재난 로밍 방법, 장치 및 시스템을 제공한다. 자세한 내용은 다음과 같다. 단말 디바이스는 저장된 재난 로밍 공공 육상 모바일 네트워크(public land mobile network, PLMN)에 관한 정보에 기초해서 제1 PLMN을 결정한다. 재난 로밍 PLMN에 관한 정보는, 단말 디바이스가 재난 로밍을 수행하는 것을 허용하는 적어도 하나의 PLMN의 식별 정보를 포함한다. 제1 PLMN은 적어도 하나의 PLMN 중 한 PLMN이다. 단말 디바이스는 제1 PLMN에 등록 요청 메시지를 송신하되, 등록 요청 메시지는 재난 로밍 표시 정보를 포함하며, 재난 로밍 표시 정보는 단말 디바이스가 재난 로밍 등록을 수행하도록 요청했음을 표시한다. 단말 디바이스는 제1 PLMN에 의해 송신되는 등록 수락 메시지를 수신한다.

title_en: Weather factor-based power transmission network cell group organization type P system fault diagnosis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for diagnosing faults of a power transmission network cell group organization type P system considering weather factors, which relates to the field of power transmission networks, and is based on the power grid partition modeling of a power loss area, when multiple faults and cascading faults occur, all suspicious fault elements do not need to be traversed, the complexity of fault diagnosis cannot be increased along with the increase of the suspicious fault elements, the complexity of the diagnosis method is effectively reduced, and the method has stronger applicability to the treatment of the multiple faults and the cascading faults; the network topology in the cppTPS fault diagnosis model is coupled with the protection device, so that when the network topology structure changes, the model can be adaptively adjusted along with the network topology change, correct reasoning after the network topology change can be realized without changing reasoning rules, and the cppTPS fault diagnosis model is good in universality and convenient; according to the method, the distortion possibility of the alarm signal is increased in the transmission process under the disaster weather condition, the weather factor is considered in the fault diagnosis process, and the accuracy of the diagnosis method is improved.
assignees: UNIV XIHUA

title_en: Incremental power distribution network source-network-storage coordination planning strategy considering carbon emission cost
abstract_en: The invention discloses an incremental power distribution network source-network-storage coordination planning strategy considering carbon emission cost, which comprises the following steps: acquiring basic information required by planning of an incremental distribution network in a certain place; constructing a power distribution network optimization planning model by taking the comprehensive income maximization of a power grid company as a target; constructing a multi-benefit main body cost-benefit model considering carbon emission cost, and constructing an incremental distribution network source-load-storage coordination planning model based on the multi-benefit main body cost-benefit model; constructing a power distribution network-incremental power distribution network coordination planning model, and decomposing and solving an optimization target by adopting an objective cascade Analysis (ATC); and describing the interaction relation of the multi-interest subjects in a cooperative game mode, and dividing the profits of the subjects based on a Shapley value method. By adopting the strategy of the invention, the planning scheme can better adapt to the aim of 'double carbon', and the method has positive significance for coordinating the relationship between national investment and social capital investment in power grid construction and exploring a comprehensive income dividing mode suitable for multi-benefit subjects.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Deep learning-based urban village risk assessment and risk factor positioning method
abstract_en: The invention provides a deep learning-based urban village risk assessment and risk factor positioning method, which comprises the steps of searching various risk accidents by using a crowd sensing technology, clustering each type of risk accidents, taking the risk accidents exceeding a threshold value as risk hot spots, and acquiring risk hot spot scene data according to urban village risk hot spots, wherein the risk hot spot scene data comprises urban village scene data and scene data; extracting urban village level scene characteristics from urban village level scene data, and extracting scene level scene characteristics from scene level scene data; inputting the scene characteristics of the village level in the city and the scene level in the city into a constructed trained residual network model, evaluating the risk of the village in the city, and adopting a layer-by-layer correlation propagation algorithm to locate risk factors; the heterogeneous data fusion is realized, the advantages of high efficiency and low consumption are achieved, and meanwhile, higher accuracy is achieved.

title_en: Water supply system scheduling agent decision method
abstract_en: A water supply system dispatching agent decision method comprises the steps of 1) collecting actual measurement monitoring data of water delivery engineering, including water level, flow and gate opening and closing conditions. The sample data is divided into a training set, a test set and a prediction set. 2) And constructing a BP neural network model, which consists of an input layer, an implicit layer and an output layer. 3) The training set sample data is input into a BP neural network model, and the training process comprises an information propagation process and an error propagation process. 4) And 3) outputting the control decision step 3) to obtain an ideal BP neural network model, wherein the output result of the output layer is in the interval [0,1], and the output result is subjected to inverse normalization processing to obtain the opening value of the gate, and the control decision of the gate is output. The invention can reflect the mutual connection and the mutual influence among the elements of the water delivery system, can predict the valve opening value through the elements such as the water level, the target flow and the like, has reliable result, can provide reference for actual dispatching management, ensures that the water dispatching decision is more intelligent and accurate, and is convenient for the operation management of actual engineering.

title_en: Rumor propagation model establishment method with anti-rumor mechanism based on social network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rumor propagation models, and discloses a rumor propagation model establishing method with an inverse rumor mechanism based on a social network, which comprises the following steps: s1: establishing a rumor propagation model with a reverse rumor mechanism; s2: simplifying the rumor propagation model to obtain a simplified rumor propagation model; s3: obtaining the basic regeneration number of the simplified rumor propagation model; s4: analyzing the relation between the local stable condition of the boundary balance and the basic regeneration number; s5: global stability was demonstrated without rumor balance points; the S1 includes: s11: constructing an SDICR rumor propagation model with a guide extreme value, and dividing propagation nodes into an unknown person S, a hesitant person D and a propagator I. The rumor propagation model establishment method based on the social network with the anti-rumor mechanism has the advantages that the rumor propagation system rumor dissipates the balance point global stability, and therefore the model can be used as a target model for analyzing the rumors.
assignees: UNIV GUANGZHOU

title_en: Modeling and threshold algorithm for rumor propagation system under random switching visual angle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rumor propagation prediction, and discloses a modeling method of a rumor propagation system under a random switching visual angle, which comprises the following steps: classifying the population in the social network rumor model, drawing a relation flow chart of each population, constructing a differential equation expression of the rumor model, searching a rumor-free balance point and a rumor-having balance point of the model according to whether the rumors are popular, and solving a basic regeneration number, thereby further explaining a switching model. The invention firstly provides an assumption that a social network is assumed to exist and is composed of N individuals, the individuals can be regarded as nodes in the network, the relationship between the individuals can be regarded as connecting edges between the network nodes, in the whole network, the switching model is further explained, the contact infection rate is added with a Markov chain by using the nonlinear coupling relationship, and the anti-rumor is added on the basis of the traditional model, thereby conforming to the more practical situation.
assignees: UNIV GUANGZHOU

title_en: Transformer substation grounding grid rapid modeling method suitable for CDEGS
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid modeling method of a transformer substation grounding grid suitable for CDEGS, which specifically comprises the following steps: according to conductor parameters and embedding depth in a design standard of a transformer substation grounding grid, transformer substation dimensions, grounding grid grounding resistance and soil resistivity obtained through actual measurement, calculating the initial size of an equivalent grounding grid by using a grounding resistance calculation formula, establishing the equivalent grounding grid in CDEGS software, calculating the grounding resistance of the equivalent grounding grid by using the software, changing the size of the equivalent grounding grid to enable the grounding resistance of the equivalent grounding grid to be continuously close to an actual value, and further obtaining a conductor structure of the equivalent grounding grid according with the actual grounding resistance. The invention lays a foundation for analyzing the electrical characteristics and the operating condition of the grounding grid under the influence of stray current, is beneficial to analyzing the characteristics and properties of the distribution rule, the propagation characteristics and the like of the stray current in a power grid system, and provides a basis for the prevention and treatment of the direct current magnetic biasing of the transformer and the structural corrosion of the urban power grid.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG

title_en: Power grid planning method considering cascading failure risk
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid planning method considering cascading failure risks, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: step 1: obtaining model parameters in a power grid; step 2: calculating an economic index, a safety index, a abundance index and a flexibility index; and step 3: establishing an evaluation index system based on each index by adopting an analytic hierarchy process; and 4, step 4: and establishing a power grid planning model and solving to obtain an optimal planning scheme. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of improving the utilization rate of new energy, improving the capability of a power grid for coping with cascading failures and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Underground water model uncertainty control method based on Stacked GPR
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground water model uncertainty control method based on a Stacked GPR (general purpose processor), which is characterized in that a complex underground water model is converted into a modularized hierarchical GPR submodel combination, data of multiple sources of each submodel are fused, the underground water model structure uncertainty analysis of each submodel is independently carried out based on the GPR, and the propagation process of uncertainty in a GPR network is described. The method can analyze the structural uncertainty of a complex underground water model, and overcomes the defect that the traditional GPR method is limited to the structural uncertainty analysis of a single simple model; the propagation process of model uncertainty is effectively described, the defect that the uncertainty propagation among submodels is not generally considered when the uncertainty of the model structure is analyzed by a traditional GPR method is overcome, and the uncertainty of a model prediction result is reduced; the data from various sources are fused, the defect that the traditional GPR method cannot fully utilize other types of observation data to analyze the structural uncertainty of the model is overcome, and the accuracy of model prediction is improved.
assignees: NANJING UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Method and device for analyzing vulnerability of urban infrastructure group
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for analyzing the vulnerability of an urban infrastructure group, wherein the method for analyzing the vulnerability of the urban infrastructure group comprises the following steps: acquiring city infrastructure data; dividing all infrastructures in a city into city infrastructure groups according to the city infrastructure data; constructing a facility group cascade failure model for the city infrastructure group; analyzing the vulnerability of the urban infrastructure group according to the facility group cascade failure model; discovering a fragile infrastructure from all of the infrastructures of the city infrastructure group according to the vulnerabilities. According to the method, the urban infrastructure group is constructed based on the relevance among the infrastructures, the operation condition of the infrastructures is analyzed in a non-isolated manner, the actual cascade failure model of the infrastructure group is constructed based on the infrastructure load distribution after the external disturbance occurs, and the results of vulnerability analysis and the fragile infrastructure excavation are closer to reality and more effective.

title_en: Port petrochemical region transportation risk early warning method and system based on cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of risk early warning, provides a port and petrochemical region transportation risk early warning method and a system based on cascade failure, and solves the problems that the existing petrochemical port region road transportation network is easily disconnected after being attacked, so that traffic jam is easy to occur, and the social risk and the personal risk value of a petrochemical port region are increased; the early warning method comprises the following steps: acquiring a port petrochemical region basic road network architecture; extracting key road network nodes of the port petrochemical region in a port petrochemical region basic road network framework, and evaluating the initial potential transportation risk of the key road network nodes; acquiring an initial potential transportation risk result of a key road network node; according to the embodiment of the invention, the importance of important nodes in the geographic network of the petrochemical port area is researched through a multi-attribute decision method to carry out comprehensive sequencing, so that the safety and the efficiency of the network are better guaranteed, the practical significance is provided for the road planning and transportation safety organization of the petrochemical port area, and the road congestion of the petrochemical port area is reduced.

title_en: Method for identifying key line of electric-gas coupling system based on maximum flow theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric-gas coupling system key line identification method based on a maximum flow theory, which is based on the maximum flow theory and combines a complex network theory, improves the traditional line betweenness, overcomes the defect that energy or power between nodes of an integrated energy system is supposed to be propagated along the shortest path between the nodes, considers all possible transmission paths of the integrated energy system, and better accords with the characteristics of the integrated energy system. Meanwhile, considering from two aspects of structural importance and state importance of the line, a line comprehensive importance index reflecting the structural centrality and the transmission bearing capacity of the line is established, so that the identification of the key line of the comprehensive energy system is more accurate and reliable, and a new thought and a new method are provided for the identification of the key line of the comprehensive energy system. The method can be used for identifying the key line of the comprehensive energy system, can also be popularized and used for identifying the key line of a thermodynamic system, a traffic system, a logistics system and other large-scale complex systems, and has wide application value.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST PETROLEUM

title_en: Foundation pit deformation safety risk assessment method based on artificial neural network and entropy method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating the safety risk of foundation pit deformation based on an artificial neural network and an entropy method, which belongs to the technical field of engineering monitoring informatization and comprises the following steps: 1. collecting foundation pit construction data and foundation pit deformation monitoring data, and establishing a data set; 2. establishing an artificial neural network based on a back propagation algorithm; 3. training an artificial neural network model; 4. performing foundation pit deformation prediction; 5. calculating the weight of the foundation pit deformation safety risk index; 6. and calculating the comprehensive risk score of the foundation pit deformation safety. The method for determining the risk factor weight based on the entropy method can objectively, accurately and dynamically determine the weight of the foundation pit deformation safety risk factor based on the foundation pit monitoring historical data, eliminates the influence of human factors, and obtains a more objective and convincing conclusion.
assignees: HANGZHOU COMMUNICATIONS INVEST GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Hydropower station emergency ecological environment risk prediction early warning method
abstract_en: The invention provides a hydropower station ecological environment risk prediction early warning method which comprises the following steps: establishing and generalizing a pollution risk propagation path based on hydropower station ecological environment risk source identification; determining a contamination propagation path based on the solute transport diffusion model; screening a pollution propagation path by adopting a multi-source data fusion method based on a Bayesian network, and obtaining the pollution propagation path needing ecological risk assessment; acquiring environmental monitoring department data, and preliminarily determining pollution elements of environmental pollution risk evaluation; according to the function of the hydropower station and the sensitive target of the ecological environment; carrying out probability judgment on multi-source data; and fusing the data of the solute migration and diffusion model and the data of the Bayesian network to evaluate the risk of the water ecological environment. Data from various sources are difficult to couple through a mechanism model, and finally an improved Bayesian network model is established, so that comprehensive assessment of ecological environment risks of the hydropower station is realized.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Peak regulation optimization scheduling method for cascade water-light complementary power generation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a peak regulation optimization scheduling method of a cascade water-light complementary power generation system, which comprises the following steps: establishing a peak regulation optimizing and scheduling objective function of a cascade water-light complementary power generation system by taking the minimum residual load maximum value of a receiving end power grid in a scheduling period as an objective function; establishing a step hydropower station output constraint condition considering unit combination and a photovoltaic power station output constraint condition considering uncertainty; linearizing the constraint conditions, and constructing a mixed integer linear model for peak regulation optimization scheduling of the cascade water-light complementary power generation system according to the objective function and the constraint conditions after linearizing; and solving the mixed integer linear model of peak regulation optimization scheduling of the cascade water light complementary power generation system to obtain a scheduling scheme of the cascade water light complementary power generation system. The invention considers the unit combination condition and reservoir operation scheme of the hydropower station, can fully utilize the characteristic of easy adjustment of the hydropower unit to consume the photovoltaic output, meets the peak regulation requirement of the power grid, and has strong practicability.

title_en: Cascade failure simulation method, equipment and storage medium based on weighted dependent network
abstract_en: The invention provides a cascade failure simulation method, equipment and storage medium based on a weighted dependent network, wherein the cascade failure simulation method comprises the following steps: acquiring a cascade failure model based on a weighted dependent network, wherein the cascade failure model comprises a plurality of network layers, and each network layer is provided with a plurality of nodes; setting initial load according to node strength of the node and node strength of neighbor nodes, and setting node capacity of the node according to a nonlinear relation between the node capacity of the node and the initial load; and simulating a cascade failure process by adopting the cascade failure model, wherein the cascade failure process comprises interlayer cascade failure and intra-layer cascade failure, and in the simulation process, load redistribution is performed according to the residual capacity and importance of neighbor nodes of the failure node. The technical scheme of the invention can improve the robustness of the cascade failure model, thereby improving the simulation effect on cascade failure.

title_en: Transmission System of Fire Alarm Propagation and Escape Road at Apartment
title_ko: 아파트 화재 발생 시의 화재 발생 경보 전파 및 대피로 제공 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for disseminating a fire alarm and providing an evacuation route when a fire breaks out in an apartment building. The system for disseminating a fire alarm and providing an evacuation route, according to the present invention, comprises: an apartment management server; a user smart terminal for each household; a rooftop entrance digital door lock module; a fire detection module; and an Internet network or a wireless communication network. According to the present invention, when a fire breaks out in a collective residential area, it is possible to quickly provide a fire alarm to the upper floor, lower floor, and next door of a corresponding apartment house number, such that residents can evacuate.
abstract_ko: 본 발명 각 세대가 지정한 사용자 스마트 단말기 고유 정보와 사용자가 거주하는 아파트 메인 출입구와 거주 층을 나타내는 호수 정보 및 해당 옥상 출입문 디지털 도어락 모듈의 고유 정보 및 각 세대별로 설치되는 화재 감지 모듈 고유 정보를 등록받아 저장하고, 임의의 화재 발생 아파트 호수를 기초로 대피로를 미리 설정하여 이미지 형태로 저장하며, 아파트의 어느 호수에서 화재가 발생하여 해당 화재 감지 모듈로부터 화재 감지 정보를 수신하고, 수신된 화재 감지 정보를 기초로 해당 동 해당 호수의 화재 발생 경보를 생성하며, 해당 동 해당 호수 화재 발생 정보를 기준으로 기 등록하여 저장된 사용자 스마트 단말기 전화 번호 정보를 그룹핑하며, 그룹별로 기 설정하여 저장된 대피로 정보를 해당 그룹핑된 해당 사용자 스마트 단말기 전화 번호로 해당 동 해당 호수 화재 발생 경보와 함께 제공하고, 화재 발생 경보를 해당 동 해당 호수가 속하는 해당 옥상 출입문 디지털 도어락 모듈로 전송하는 아파트 관리 서버와, 아파트 관리 서버에 저장 등록되는 것으로 화재 발생 시에는 해당 동의 해당 화재 발생 호수를 기준으로 아파트 관리 서버에 의하여 그룹핑되며, 그룹별로 아파트 관리 서버로부터 해당 동 해당 호수 화재 발생 경보와 대피로 이미지 정보를 수신하여 제공하는 해당 아파트 동별, 호수별 각 세대의 사용자 스마트 단말기와, 아파트 각 동의 메인 출입구 계단 상부 끝단에서 옥상으로 출입하도록 옥상 출입문에 설치되는 것으로 아파트 관리 서버로부터 해당 동의 해당 호수 화재 발생 경보를 수신하여 도어의 록킹을 해제하도록 제어하여 옥상으로 주민이 대피하도록 하는 해당 동의 해당 호수가 속하는 옥상 출입문 디지털 도어락 모듈 및 아파트 각 세대에 설치되는 것으로 다수의 화재 감지 센서가 연결되어 화재 발생시에 화재 감지 정보와 고유 정보를 아파트 관리 서버로 전송하는 화재 감지 모듈로 구성된 것을 특징으로 하는 것이다.
assignees: GK ENG CO LTD

title_en: Transient model of transformer winding
abstract_en: The invention provides a transient model of a transformer winding. The model enables a winding to be equivalent to a multi-conductor transmission line, and innovation processing is carried out on discrete difference operation at the port of the transmission line based on a time domain finite difference method of a conventional multi-conductor transmission line, so that the model gets rid of the terminal characteristic of an external network, and can be independently packaged and modularized, and integration of a transient model of the transformer winding and an external complex transformer substation network is realized. Compared with the original time domain finite difference method, the algorithm of the transient model can reduce the error to 0.025%. The method lays a foundation for analyzing the propagation characteristics of the high-frequency signals in the transformer substation network and the influence of the topological structure on online diagnosis of winding deformation.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Complex power grid fragile flow transfer capturing method based on fluctuation process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a complicated power grid fragile energy transfer capturing method based on a fluctuation process, which comprises the steps of obtaining a power flow transfer distribution factor matrix and a line disconnection distribution factor matrix; converting the power grid topological graph into a node-branch mapping graph by adopting a graph theory method; defining a node connection strength matrix; acquiring an inter-node electric coupling strength matrix; acquiring a normalized electric coupling dielectric center index and an improved structure hole index; constructing node weakness energy; establishing a node capacity model, and selecting an initial fault point; acquiring node fragile energy of each node after energy transmission according to the fluctuation energy attenuation transmission process of the stimulus waves and the response waves; acquiring a set comprising a fault sequence, the number of fault stages and the number of fault nodes according to the time and space relation of the out-of-limit generated energy; the method can quickly and accurately identify the fragile line under the cascading failure, and effectively avoids the cascading failure by applying key protection and reinforcement to the identified fragile line.
assignees: UNIV XIHUA

title_en: Delay propagation-oriented high-speed train operation adjustment modeling and evaluation method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a delay propagation-oriented high-speed train operation adjustment modeling and evaluation method and device. The method is oriented to potential abnormal event disturbance in the daily transportation process of the high-speed railway, the dynamic interaction between the driving adjustment and the delay propagation is considered comprehensively, a two-stage optimization decision model is constructed, and a delay propagation evaluation method is provided. The method has the advantages that the model is subjected to pareto optimization considering cumulative weighting delay and train average adjustment times in the first stage, and is subjected to global equilibrium optimization based on the game theory in the second stage, dynamic operation grade coefficients of trains are constructed and an objective function is introduced by further considering heterogeneity of transportation scenes and schemes, and maximum train avoidance times and the number of affected trains are innovatively considered in constraint conditions and mathematical description is realized. In the aspect of delay propagation evaluation, the invention combines delay propagation characteristic definition and constructs two dynamic analysis indexes of train accumulated delay and instantaneous delay, and provides technical support for disclosing a networked propagation mechanism of train delay.
assignees: UNIV YANGZHOU

title_en: New energy output prediction method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a new energy output prediction method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: step (1), according to a time sequence, sorting historical new energy output data and historical natural environment data to remove error data; step (2), carrying out normalization processing on the historical data to finish the data preparation of deep learning; step (3), inputting historical data into a deep learning algorithm according to the time sequence, training a loss function, completing network parameter setting in the deep learning algorithm through back propagation, and obtaining a short-term new energy output prediction model; and (4) inputting the current short-term data of the natural environment into a short-term new energy output prediction model to predict the current new energy output data. The invention can provide powerful data support for the stable operation of the power grid and the relevant dispatching of the power grid based on the short-term new energy output prediction of the LSTM recurrent neural network algorithm in the deep learning.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ECONOMIC RES INST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN CONSULTATION CO LTD

title_en: Method for evaluating maximum transmission capability of direct-current tie line of asynchronous power grid
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for evaluating the maximum transmission capability of a direct-current tie line of an asynchronous power grid, which constructs a hierarchical optimization evaluation model containing a plurality of decision makers, and specifically comprises the following steps: the upper layer coordinator solves the main problem to determine the maximum transmittable power of each direct current connecting line in the normal operation state; TSO of a transmitting end power grid and a receiving end power grid on the lower layer solves the optimal power flow sub-problem under the frequency constraint; the evaluation model integrates a fast frequency suppression strategy and a slow frequency suppression strategy to ensure that a transmitting-end power grid and a receiving-end power grid do not trigger a third defense line after a direct current bipolar blocking fault occurs, and the purpose of improving the maximum transmission capacity of the direct current connecting line is achieved by utilizing the potential control capacity of the transmitting-end power grid and the receiving-end power grid. Finally, the evaluation model is solved by an accelerated target cascade analysis algorithm. The method has guiding significance for planning and scheduling operation of the large-capacity multi-direct-current-link asynchronous power grid.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV HUNAN;ZHENGZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HANAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power grid vulnerability assessment method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a power grid vulnerability assessment method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring data of a heterogeneous power network; acquiring a first attack cost corresponding to a transformer substation and a second attack cost corresponding to a transmission line; acquiring an alternative combined attack strategy set according to a preset initial attack cost threshold, a first attack cost and a second attack cost; carrying out simulation attack and cascade failure judgment on an attack target of the combined attack strategy to obtain an attack gain function and a task completion degree of the combined attack strategy corresponding to each attack target; and judging the attack income function and the task completion degree according to a preset task threshold value to obtain a vulnerability evaluation result. The method and the device perform simulation attack and benefit evaluation on the alternative combined attack strategy set under the limited cost, calculate the target cost budget of the power grid under different attack purposes, plan the actual power grid according to the evaluation result, and improve the robustness and accuracy of the power network evaluation result.

title_en: Method for constructing accident chain search model of power grid cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing an accident chain search model of power grid cascading failures, and belongs to the field of failure early warning. Aiming at the defects of the existing research, firstly, a cascading failure analysis model based on an accident chain is established, then, the historical statistical failure rate of each power transmission line is considered, the initial failure risk index of the line is calculated, the risk index which simultaneously considers the probability importance of the line failure and the importance of the line structure is calculated, and finally, the multi-attribute index is calculated by adopting a grey correlation algorithm based on the dispersion maximization. The construction method of the power grid cascading failure accident chain search model accords with the general evolution process of the power grid cascading failure, and provides a basis for preventing the occurrence of the blackout accident.
assignees: NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV BAODING

title_en: Method and system for modeling layered characteristics of unmanned environment and storage medium thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for modeling hierarchical characteristics of an unmanned environment and a storage medium thereof. The method comprises the steps that the unmanned vehicle obtains surrounding environment information of the unmanned vehicle and carries out layering; respectively encoding the layered environment information to obtain a pseudo picture representing the environment information of the corresponding type; inputting the pseudo-picture into a convolutional neural network for hierarchical feature extraction; clustering the hierarchical features of the environments respectively corresponding to the pseudo pictures of different levels by using a clustering algorithm, and performing clustering modeling on the subsequent hierarchical features after training the convolutional neural network by using the back propagation of the clustering result. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the combination of the environment characteristic layered extraction and the scene type layered clustering is adopted, so that the layered characteristics are more obvious and denser after clustering, and the function of the method is provided with a comprehensive and complete basis for describing the environment of the unmanned scene.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: Fire detection method using iot time synchronization delay
title_ko: 아이오티 시간동기 지연을 이용한 화재 감지 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for detecting a fire in an IoT wireless networking space by utilizing a propagation delay phenomenon of a radio signal. The present invention determines whether a flame is occurred by detecting a delay time in a process of periodically performing IoT time synchronous processing and comparing the delay time with a reference value. Through the present invention, the detection of flame can be performed early in a general IoT-based wireless network environment without expensive optical detection and related signal processing devices, and wireless network configuration information accompanying fire alarm through flame detection, as well as it is possible to minimize encroachment on computing resources of communication devices.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 전파(電波) 신호의 전파(傳波) 지연 현상을 활용하여 아이오티(IoT) 무선망 조성 공간내 화재를 감지하는 방법에 관한 것으로서, 주기적으로 수행되는 아이오티 시간동기 처리의 수행 과정에서 지연시간을 검출하고, 이를 기준치와 비교함으로써 화염 발생 여부를 파악하는 것이다. 
본 발명을 통하여, 고가의 광학 감지 및 연관 신호 처리 장치 없이도, 일반적인 아이오티 기반 무선망 환경에서 화염의 감지를 조기에 수행할 수 있을 뿐 아니라, 화염 감지를 통한 화재 경보에 수반되는 무선망 구성 정보통신기기의 전산자원 잠식을 극소화할 수 있다.
assignees: U INFRAWAY CO LTD

title_en: Multi-target scheduling MILP (minimum Driving Linear prediction) method for cascade hydropower station with peak regulation and navigation functions
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of hydropower dispatching and power grid operation, and discloses an MILP (micro-electro-hydraulic Loop) method for multi-target dispatching of a cascade hydropower station with peak regulation and navigation functions. The contradiction between the peak regulation of a power grid and the navigation requirement of a river channel is a prominent problem in the cascade scheduling of hydropower shipping, and the complexity of the problem is aggravated by the jacking effect of interval return water. The method establishes an MILP model of the short-term multi-objective optimization scheduling of the cascade hydropower station group considering backwater influence, takes the minimum of the average distance of the residual load and the average distance of the downstream tail water level as a target in the model, uses a right hexahedron rasterization technology and an SOS2 constraint method to realize constraint linearization after nonlinear constraint is subjected to function aggregation, and finally uses an NBI method to solve to obtain a Pareto solution set of the multi-objective problem. The method can fully take the influence of backwater jacking into account, gives consideration to peak regulation and navigation requirements, efficiently solves the multi-target scheduling problem and obtains a more ideal result, and is a practical and effective method.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO;UNIV DALIAN TECH

title_en: Earthquake motion parameter prediction method based on artificial intelligence and earthquake motion empirical model mixing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seismic motion parameter prediction method based on artificial intelligence and seismic motion empirical model mixing, and aims to solve the problem that the physical significance of prediction precision and attenuation relation cannot be simultaneously reserved by the existing method. The earthquake motion parameter prediction method comprises the following steps: selecting a traditional empirical formula of the seismic oscillation attenuation relation, and determining an operation form, an input parameter item, an output parameter item and an unknown coefficient in the traditional empirical formula; secondly, building a seismic oscillation data set; establishing a neural network combined with a traditional empirical formula; and fourthly, performing network training by combining the neural network with the seismic oscillation data set, calculating the gradient of unknown coefficients through back propagation of the neural network, and continuously reducing the loss function through continuous iterative training to obtain a training result of the optimal coefficients. And fifthly, predicting earthquake motion parameters. The seismic oscillation parameter prediction method comprises an empirical model, and is better in robustness. And an effective basis is provided for structural seismic design and seismic risk analysis.
assignees: HARBIN INST TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Toughness calculation method for electric power information physical system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a toughness calculation method of a power information physical system, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: constructing an initial network architecture of the electric power information physical system; constructing a node multi-state model and a branch state model of an information system and a power system, and generating a fault element set and an effective network of a power information physical system in an initial state; constructing a fault propagation dynamic model in an information system; constructing a node power balance model of fault propagation in the power system; constructing a virus infection dynamic model of fault propagation between an information system and a power system; and (4) iteratively solving to obtain the stable state of the fault propagated in the electric power information physical system, and calculating the toughness index of the electric power information physical system. The method provided by the invention comprehensively analyzes the operation structure difference between the power system and the information system, simulates the propagation mechanism of the fault in the two systems and between the two systems, and overcomes the problems of singleness and adaptability of toughness research of the traditional power information physical system.
assignees: NANJING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Diesel generating set carbon emission quantitative calculation method based on BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quantitative calculation method for carbon emission of a diesel generator set based on a BP (back propagation) neural network, which aims to quantitatively calculate the carbon emission generated by different diesel generators burning different quality oil for power generation based on the BP neural network, and combines an online acquisition technology to realize quantitative dynamic calculation of the carbon emission of the diesel generator set and improve the calculation efficiency and accuracy; the invention provides a quantitative calculation method for carbon emission of a diesel generating set based on a BP neural network, which overcomes the technical problems that the carbon emission of the diesel generating set is difficult to calculate effectively, particularly the on-line dynamic calculation; the method has the advantages of simple flow, reasonable calculation model structure, BP neural network training calculation superposition, comprehensive calculation data quantity, clear intermediate structure meaning in the calculation process, strong practicability, contribution to use and popularization of carbon emission control calculation of the diesel generating set, contribution to mastering carbon emission rules of different types of diesel generating sets and support of carbon emission reduction of the diesel generating set.
assignees: LIYANG RESEARCH INSTITUTE SOUTHEAST UNIV;NANJING DONGBO SMART ENERGY RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: City infrastructure group network elasticity analysis method, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: A city infrastructure group network elasticity analysis method, electronic equipment and a storage medium belong to the field of city infrastructure group analysis. The method aims to solve the problem of analysis of urban cascade failure influence. The method comprises the steps of constructing a cascading failure model of an urban infrastructure group network; adopting the theory and the model of the classical elastic triangle from the two aspects of time and space to carry out elastic analysis on the infrastructures in the urban infrastructure group; elasticity analysis for city infrastructure groups: and (3) introducing a fault mode in which multipoint failures occur simultaneously to calculate network elastic parameters of the urban infrastructure group, introducing spatial position information at the same time, analyzing the elastic parameter conditions of the infrastructure group in a central area and an edge area, and finally performing tree analysis on the cascading failure model process. The invention establishes an elasticity analysis system of the urban infrastructure group network, and provides effective support for researching and improving the elasticity of the urban infrastructure.

title_en: Non-intrusive load decomposition method based on cascade width learning and sparrow algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-intrusive load decomposition method based on cascade width learning and a sparrow algorithm. The method uses a lightweight width learning algorithm, solves the technical problems of complex structure, extremely time-consuming training and high requirement on computing resources of a deep learning-based non-intrusive load decomposition network, and can simultaneously obtain the running state and detailed power information of the target equipment. In addition, the invention constructs a cascade width learning load decomposition network by improving the connection mode of the width learning characteristic nodes, and optimizes network parameters by using a sparrow search algorithm, thereby improving the load decomposition precision. Compared with the traditional non-invasive load decomposition method based on deep learning, the method provided by the invention has the advantages that the decomposition precision is ensured, the training time is greatly reduced, the network structure is simple, the method is convenient to be integrated with embedded equipment, and the algorithm support is provided for the popularization of the non-invasive load decomposition.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Power grid key branch identification method and system based on overload cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power grid safety analysis, and provides a method and a system for identifying a critical branch of a power grid based on overload cascading failures, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing improved direct current flow considering voltage and reactive power, and rapidly estimating the voltage and reactive power of the system on the premise of ensuring the convergence of regional flow; considering the action of an automatic control device of the system and rough corrective control measures of the system, and establishing an overload cascading failure evolution model; performing large-scale cascading failure simulation on the system based on an overload cascading failure evolution model to obtain an accident chain, a load loss rate and a branch loss rate corresponding to each cascading failure, and calculating importance indexes of each branch according to the probability of each branch appearing in the accident chain and the loss caused to the system, so as to screen out key branches; the method provides importance evaluation indexes of current-carrying branches of the power grid, and calculates the importance indexes of the current-carrying branches through large-scale cascading failure simulation to effectively identify key branches of the power grid.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG

title_en: City infrastructure group elasticity analysis method, electronic device, and storage medium
abstract_en: An urban infrastructure group elasticity analysis method, electronic equipment and a storage medium belong to the technical field of evaluation analysis. In order to solve the technical problems that the existing urban infrastructure analysis method is too simple, breaks away from the analysis of actual conditions and the like, the method for constructing the cascade failure model of the urban infrastructure group network comprises the steps of counting the operation data of urban infrastructures, and converting the operation data of the urban infrastructures into the operation function values of the urban infrastructures; establishing a city infrastructure group as an analysis basic unit based on the operation function value of the city infrastructure, and performing primary division on the city infrastructure group; performing secondary division on the primarily divided urban infrastructure group by adopting a DBSCAN algorithm to obtain a final urban infrastructure group; establishing a cascade failure model of the urban infrastructure group; and performing elasticity analysis on infrastructures in the urban infrastructure group and the urban infrastructure group. The elasticity analysis of the invention is more comprehensive, and the elasticity capability measurement of the actual system is more reasonable.

title_en: Traffic cascading failure emergency regulation strategy generation method, system, terminal and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, a terminal and a medium for generating an emergency regulation strategy of a traffic cascading failure, which relate to the technical field of traffic failure and have the technical scheme that: acquiring a target cascading network diagram formed by fault locating points and fault association points in a target area; at least one fault locating point is selected as a regulating and controlling central point, and the cascade failure relation in the target cascade network diagram is updated by keeping all the fault locating points normally working as targets when the regulating and controlling central point operates, so that an emergency regulating and controlling strategy set is obtained; inputting all emergency regulation strategies in the emergency regulation strategy set into the multi-objective optimization function to obtain the optimal emergency regulation strategy. The invention can effectively reduce the difficulty of recovering the traffic cascade faults, and update the cascade failure relationship, effectively enhance the stability of the whole traffic system under the influence of secondary natural disasters, and provide data support for solving the failure state of the traffic infrastructure caused by the traffic cascade faults under emergency conditions.

title_en: Risk platform identification and risk propagation prediction method in bulk commodity trading market
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk platform identification and risk propagation prediction method in a bulk commodity transaction market. The method is suitable for monitoring and serving of a large commodity electronic commerce transaction market, a transaction network is established by analyzing historical transaction data, abnormal transaction modes are screened according to the topological characteristics of the abnormal transaction modes, and the affiliated risk platform is determined. And establishing a maximum association network according to the commodity overlapping association between the platforms, and predicting the risk propagation path and range by taking the risk source platform as a starting point, so that the risk platform is identified, the platforms possibly influenced by risk propagation are predicted, and the risk propagation path and range are excavated. The invention carries out risk platform identification and risk propagation prediction, and can be used for reference of risk prevention of a transaction platform and reference of institutional health of a supervision department.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: System and method for optimizing supply chain of hydrogen distribution network
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates generally to the production, transportation, distribution and storage of hydrogen fuel, and more particularly, to a system and method for optimizing the supply chain of a hydrogen distribution network. The centralized server triggers the production facility to produce gaseous/liquid hydrogen. A centralized server stores the produced gaseous/liquid hydrogen in Liquid Organic Hydrogen Carrier (LOHC) molecules at a storage facility based on hydrogenation of chemicals. The centralized server sends instructions for transporting the hydrogenated LOHC molecules from the production facility to a warehouse with tanker trucks, and the centralized server dehydrogenates the hydrogenated LOHC molecules at low pressure at the warehouse to release hydrogen. The centralized server compresses the released hydrogen at the warehouse and fills the compressed hydrogen into a high pressure pipe trailer/flat tank cascade. The centralized server determines the optimal route of the transport vehicle from the warehouse to the retailer/consumption site and stores the compressed hydrogen gas into the low pressure tank/high pressure buffer tank at the retailer/consumption site. The centralized server outputs information corresponding to the inventory of low pressure tanks/high pressure buffer tanks at the retailer/consumption site.
assignees: GEO PLATFORMS LTD

title_en: Electric-betting-based power grid fragile line identification method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for identifying a fragile circuit of a power grid based on novel electric betters, which comprises the steps of constructing the power grid into a network diagram, sequentially removing circuits in the network diagram, and sequencing the novel electric betters of each circuit from large to small; constructing a complex network cascading failure nonlinear model considering overload and weighted edges, and respectively performing two line removing modes on the ordered novel electrical betweenness, namely sequentially removing preset proportion lines and sequentially removing all lines until no new lines are removed from the network diagram; and acquiring the change of the generator-load power before and after each line removal, and evaluating the severity of the power grid fault based on the change of the generator-load power to finish the identification of the fragile line of the power grid. The invention obviously reduces the calculation cost and can better consider the accuracy and the efficiency.

title_en: Power grid line fault identification method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep learning-based power grid line fault identification method, which comprises the following steps: training a target detection model according to pre-collected power grid transmission line image data; acquiring image data of a current power transmission line by using an unmanned aerial vehicle; inputting the acquired image data into the target detection model, and identifying target equipment of the power transmission line in the image; and inputting the identified target equipment image into a trained fault identification model, determining the type of the identified target equipment and judging whether the target equipment has faults or not. The invention adopts the cascade network to decompose the small sample fault detection problem into two parts of target detection and small sample learning, firstly utilizes the detection network to position all target components, and then carries out accurate fault identification on the positioned target components, thereby realizing the automatic interpretation of the power grid inspection image and realizing the accurate identification of the transmission line fault.
assignees: JINING RENCHENG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;JINING POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Disaster weather power grid cascading failure prediction method based on holographic geographic information model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster weather power grid cascading failure prediction method based on a holographic geographic information model, which comprises the following steps of: (1) inputting a data source; (2) establishing a power grid semantic position scene model; (3) Obtaining a holographic power grid semantic position scene model by utilizing a holographic technology; (4) Predicting the risk of the power grid line equipment under the extreme disaster weather by using a holographic power grid semantic position scene model according to weather forecast information, and performing risk evaluation; (5) And analyzing the correlation characteristics among different equipment of the power grid, and predicting the chain accidents possibly caused among the equipment under the extreme disaster weather. According to the method, a power grid semantic position scene model is constructed through natural language matching and natural language-image matching, holographic geographic information is applied to prediction of power grid cascading failures in disaster weather, random change of extreme weather and operation mechanism of power grid equipment elements are considered, and power grid cascading failures can be accurately and quickly predicted.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG;ZHEDA ELECTRIC POWER TECH HANGZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Physical simulation test method and device for mine water inrush and propagation process
abstract_en: A physical simulation test method and device for the mine water inrush and spreading process are disclosed, which are based on the similarity theory to determine the scale relationship between the test model and the prototype; according to the evolution characteristic of the burst water permeability, the position and the flow curve of the burst water are used as inflow conditions of the test to form a preset test working condition; planning test steps under preset test working conditions by combining test purposes; acquiring test water level and flow under a preset test working condition, and acquiring flow state data through video monitoring; constructing a water level curve according to the water level data, constructing a flow curve according to the flow data, and performing flow state indication according to the flow state data; and evaluating the rationality of numerical simulation of the mine water inrush and spreading process by using the obtained test monitoring result. The method overcomes the difficulties in field sudden water penetration and spreading process measurement and in-situ test implementation, and reveals the flow rule of water flow in a complex roadway network; and a scientific theoretical basis is provided for the reliability evaluation of numerical simulation results and the formulation of emergency rescue schemes.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING

title_en: New energy plant network interaction layered optimization scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy plant network interaction layered optimization scheduling method, which comprises the following steps: (1) Acquiring grid structure data, new energy output historical data and load demand historical data of a power grid; (2) Establishing a probability distribution model of new energy output and a probability distribution model of load demand by adopting mixed Gaussian distribution; (3) Dividing a power distribution network containing a new energy power plant into a plurality of grid power supply units and performing layered definition; (4) Establishing a local scheduling model of each sub-layer power supply unit in the new energy plant network interaction hierarchical optimization; (5) defining interaction variables; (6) And establishing an upper layer coordination control model based on a multilayer target cascading method, thereby forming a new energy plant network interaction layered optimization upper layer coordination control framework. The invention considers the distributed new energy and the load randomness, reduces the data sharing range between the plant networks as much as possible on the basis, and realizes the safe and optimized operation of the whole network.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD YANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Fault propagation analysis method and system based on causal layered topology network model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of failure analysis of electromechanical equipment, and discloses a failure propagation analysis method and a system based on a causal hierarchical topology network model, so as to more accurately determine an actual failure hierarchical propagation path of a source failure node in a specific failure mode. The method comprises the following steps: according to the propagation relation of signals among all longitudinal nodes when the electromechanical equipment actually works, all the longitudinal nodes are connected through directed edges to form a topological network, the directed edges comprise transverse causal edges and longitudinal causal edges, and a fault propagation model based on a causal hierarchical topological network is established; and then, aiming at a specific fault mode, starting from fault disturbance borne by a bottom-layer element, calculating whether each potential directed edge can propagate the fault mode of the node due to the fault to the node due to the fault one by one, and obtaining a fault actual layered propagation path based on a fault propagation model of the causal layered topology network.
assignees: PEOPLE'S LIBERATION ARMY NATIONAL UNIVERSITY OF DEFENSE TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Earthquake acquisition footprint denoising method based on unsupervised model driving type deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake acquisition footprint denoising method based on unsupervised model driving type deep learning, which is applied to the field of earthquake data processing, and aims at the problem that the footprint removing effect is poor due to priori knowledge of hand making when an earthquake image has unexpected characteristics beyond the assumption of the earthquake image, wherein a model driving footprint removing network FR is provided for unsupervised acquisition footprint suppression without any valuable signal assumption, and a unidirectional total variation acquisition footprint model is designed by an FR-Net network according to the inherent directivity of noise. The depth convolution self-encoder is strongly regulated by using the UTV model, so that the FR-Net network is ensured to convert DCAE from complete data driving to model driving, and the advantages of the DCAE and the footprint model are inherited. The FR-Net network is optimized by a back propagation algorithm, projecting the complete separation of the footprint noise and the useful signal in an unsupervised manner.

title_en: Power transmission and transformation transformer equipment fault prediction analysis method under extreme meteorological condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting and analyzing the faults of power transmission and transformation transformer equipment under extreme meteorological conditions, which comprises the following steps: step 1, collecting fault data of a power transmission and transformation transformer which occurs under various extreme meteorological conditions, and presetting fault types; step 2, preprocessing data parameters; step 3, establishing a deep learning network; step 4, updating the gradient and optimizing the parameters by using an error back propagation algorithm, and training a neural network; step 5, predicting faults, and verifying the accuracy of the neural network; the method solves the technical problems that the existing fault prediction model has certain deviation under extreme meteorological conditions in the fault prediction of the power transmission and transformation transformer equipment in the prior art, the fault prediction accuracy of the existing fault prediction model is influenced by the extreme meteorological conditions, and the existing fault prediction model is not applicable under the condition.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Charging safety state evaluation method and system based on BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a charging safety state evaluation method and a charging safety state evaluation system based on a BP (back propagation) neural network, wherein power battery safety data are obtained from historical message data; setting an evaluation index SOS of a safety state, establishing a BP neural network, and predicting the SOS according to the BP neural network; performing SOS calculation according to the real-time message data, and performing charging control according to the calculation result; the scheme of the invention combines the advantage that the neural network can process big data with the advantage of a specialist law, provides the safety state index SOS, predicts the safety state SOS of the electric vehicle in charging by using the BP neural network building model, can effectively make different judgments on the safety condition of the power battery pack according to the battery safety state SOS, and effectively improves the safety monitoring efficiency.
assignees: SHANGHAI JIEMA ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Cascading failure evolution mode identification method and system considering influence of prevention and control measures
abstract_en: The invention provides a cascading failure evolution mode identification method and a system considering the influence of prevention and control measures, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining the running state information of a power grid and obtaining the prevention and control measures after failures; screening out high-probability cascading failures caused by the current failures by considering the prevention and control measures, and calculating the risk value of the high-probability cascading failures to obtain a high-risk cascading failure set; and taking the high-risk cascading failure set as a sequence, mining a pattern based on prefix projection, and identifying a key evolution pattern in the sequence. Aiming at the measures of output adjustment, direct current modulation and load shedding of the generator, a planning model is established, and the model can quickly provide an optimal power grid prevention and control strategy; calculating cascading failure risks, sequencing, and finally screening to obtain a high-risk cascading failure set; and the key evolution mode of high-risk cascading failure concentration is identified, and weak links of power grid prevention and control can be effectively identified. The invention considers the influence of the prevention and control measures on the cascading failure and can obviously reduce the risk value.
assignees: JINAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Cascading failure modeling method for power information physical system under distributed denial of service attack
abstract_en: The invention provides a cascading failure model of a power information physical system under distributed denial of service attack, which simulates a dynamic evolution process of power network cascading failure under the condition that power network circuit overload information and scheduling information issued by a control center are lost due to distributed denial of service attack by constructing the cascading failure model. The invention provides an optimal load shedding control method in the dynamic process of cascading failures, which is characterized in that distributed denial of service attacks are applied to a communication channel of a power information physical system, the attacks lead to the loss of power grid state information in an uplink communication channel and scheduling information in a downlink communication channel, the power grid cascading failure evolution process under the distributed denial of service attacks is simulated, and the load loss rate and the node loss rate of the remaining power grid after the cascading failures are finished are counted, so that the influence of the network attacks on the power grid is analyzed.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI

title_en: Micro-grid distributed event-driven elastic control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a micro-grid distributed event driven elastic control method, which comprises the following steps: step 1, controlling primary droop of a micro-grid; step 2, determining whether bad data injection attack occurs in the process of interaction voltage and frequency states of the distributed generation units; step 3, updating the local trust value based on the consistency cooperation index; step 4, obtaining a comprehensive trust value based on a trust propagation mechanism, and updating communication link weight among the distributed power generation units based on the comprehensive trust value; and 5, establishing an event-driven distributed elastic control protocol based on the dynamic communication connection limit, and realizing the recovery of the frequency and the voltage of the micro-grid under the condition of network attack. According to the invention, the communication burden is reduced, meanwhile, the bad data injection attack is timely detected and isolated, and the node recovered from the attack can be added into the micro-grid again, so that the running elasticity of the micro-grid is improved, and the safety of the power system is improved.

title_en: Urban rail transit operation risk point association relationship chain construction method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for constructing an incidence relation chain of urban rail transit operation risk points, which belong to the technical field of urban rail transit operation maintenance, and are used for collecting and processing risk point data in a specific accident scene; based on an association rule Apriori algorithm, judging the association action relationship among the risk points, and constructing a risk propagation chain according to the association action relationship among the risk points; and based on the risk propagation chain, drawing a risk point propagation association relation chain under a specific accident scene by combining a graph theory model. The invention constructs an active risk prevention and control method for preventing accidents from the perspective of networked operation overall situation, and has important theoretical and practical significance for promoting the risk management of rail transit operation safety and guaranteeing safe and efficient operation.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG

title_en: Method for calculating fault tolerance performance of interdependent circuit network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for calculating the fault tolerance performance of an interdependent circuit network, which belongs to the field of fault tolerance, robustness and reliability of the interdependent circuit network. Most dependent networks are not vulnerable in the real world. Therefore, in order to find a more accurate model to explain the mechanism of the actual cascading failure, the relationship between the fault-tolerant distribution and the interdependency network robustness is deeply determined, so that the problem of calculating the fault-tolerant performance of the interdependency circuit network is solved. Through the fault-tolerant performance of the joint circuit calculated by the method, the circuit structure or the node capability in the circuit is changed in real time, the fault-tolerant capability of the joint circuit is maximized, and the robustness and the stability of the joint circuit are improved.
assignees: UESTC

title_en: Parallel oil and gas pipeline domino effect risk analysis method based on Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a parallel oil and gas pipeline domino effect risk analysis method based on a Bayesian network, which comprises the steps of determining a source pipe, and distributing source pipe nodes and other nodes in the Bayesian network; determining an upgrading vector according to the type of the pipe transmission medium and the failure mode; evaluating the strength of an upgrade vector sent by a target pipeline receiving source pipe; calculating the accident upgrading probability of the target pipeline; evaluating the probability of domino accidents of the target pipeline; judging whether the target pipeline continuously transmits the domino effect or not to obtain a domino accident sequence of the multi-pipe parallel system; and simulating different domino accident scenes and evaluating the failure probability of the multi-pipe parallel system.
