The village and specific area broadcasting system comprises: a user terminal (15); a security officer terminal (25); a central server (30); an administrator terminal (31); a transmitter (35); a relay unit (40); an environmental sensor (45); and a controller (50). Therefore, disaster broadcasts, environmental broadcasts, news, and administrative broadcasts can be automatically disseminated.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 의한 자가통신망을 통해 재난 및 환경 정보의 전파가 가능한 마을·특정지역 방송 시스템(10)은 특정 지역에 속하는 다수의 가구에 마을방송을 전파하기 위한 것으로, 상기 자가통신망을 통해 재난 및 환경 정보의 전파가 가능한 마을·특정지역 방송 시스템(10)은 상기 특정 지역에 속하는 다수의 가구에 각각 다수 설치되는 사용자단말기(15), 상기 특정 지역을 순찰하는 보안관에게 제공되는 보안관단말기(25), 관리자가 상기 다수의 사용자단말기(15)를 상시 모니터링하기 위한 중앙서버(30), 상기 관리자에게 제공되어, 상기 관리자가 특정 메시지를 입력 처리하기 위한 관리자단말기(31), 재난, 환경, 동보 및 행정데이터를 상기 중앙서버(30), 관리자단말기(31), 사전에 설정된 제1 전파거리 이내의 다수의 사용자단말기(15) 및 중계부(40)로 전송하는 송출기(35), 상기 송출기(35)와 이격되게 구비되어, 상기 송출기(35)로부터 전송받은 데이터를 상기 송출기(35)를 중심으로 상기 제1 전파거리 이내에 속하지 않은 다수의 사용자단말기(15) 및 상기 보안관단말기(25)로 각각 전송하는 중계부(40), 상기 송출기(35)의 일측에 구비되어, 상기 특정 지역의 소음의 크기 및 미세먼지의 농도와 같은 환경데이터를 측정하는 환경센서(45) 및 상기 송출기(35)의 타측에 구비되어, 상기 송출기(35)의 데이터 송출 및 상기 특정 지역에 속한 다수의 사용자단말기(15)의 장애 여부를 점검하는 컨트롤러(50)를 포함하고, 상기 송출기(35)는 기상청으로부터 상기 특정 지역의 지진, 호우, 가뭄, 산불 발생 여부와 같은 재난데이터를 전송받는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: PARK JIN HYO

title_en: Risk assessment method and device for leakage of fuel gas pipeline, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a risk assessment method and device for gas pipeline leakage, equipment and storage medium, wherein the assessment method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining a first disaster event set and a first disaster bearing body set by carrying out data processing on an accident case set; constructing a first propagation network according to causal relationships among a plurality of first disaster events; dynamically adjusting the first propagation network according to the peripheral condition of the target gas pipeline to obtain a second propagation network; determining the probability that the third disaster event causes the event to be evaluated to occur; determining connectivity of the event to be evaluated according to the second propagation network; determining a loss coefficient of the event to be evaluated according to a disaster-bearing body associated with the event to be evaluated; and determining the risk value of the event to be evaluated according to the probability, the connectivity and the loss coefficient. The invention can accurately predict the disaster event possibly caused by the gas pipeline and the propagation risk of the disaster event.

title_en: Medical system risk management and control prior prediction method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical system risk management and control pre-prediction method and system based on deep learning, relates to the technical field of risk management and control of medical systems, and aims to solve the problems of large data volume and low risk evaluation accuracy rate caused by risk evaluation indexes in the conventional risk prediction based on a neural network. The risk category prediction model comprises an LSTM network, a CNN convolutional network and an attention bidirectional RNN network; during training, a BP feedback propagation algorithm is adopted for gradient feedback, the average absolute error MAE is used for distinguishing risk types, and the root mean square error RMSE is used for carrying out regression learning on the risk evaluation grade. The method predicts the non-occurrence risk by adopting algorithms of different risk categories, and ensures that the risk evaluation accuracy of the neural network is higher by adopting an attention mechanism.
assignees: WEST CHINA HOSPITAL SICHUAN UNIV;CHENGDU AIJIA FEISHITE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for identifying weak link of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for identifying weak links of an electric power system, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a basic operation model of the electric power system to obtain a planning scheme that a power grid meets all loads when lines are in a normal operation state; the accident tolerance of the planning scheme is verified by establishing a power system fault selection model; establishing an operation model of the power system for coping with the fault, and acquiring the load loss amount; and carrying out simulation analysis in a standard system, and outputting a weak link identification result of the power system. Firstly, establishing a basic operation model of the power system; establishing a power system fault selection model on the basis; and then establishing an operation model of the power system for coping with the fault, and finally carrying out system joint evolution calculation to verify the effectiveness and the practicability of the modeling method. The weak link in the power system is effectively identified by establishing a system planning model of cascading failures based on robust optimization and failure simulation ideas, and compared with the existing model, the calculation efficiency is improved.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: Power grid telemetering jump data screening method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for screening telemetering jump data of a power grid, which comprises the following steps: acquiring power grid telemetering acquired data, and identifying the telemetering type of the power grid telemetering acquired data; if the power grid telemetering acquired data are in the data interval range corresponding to the telemetering type, the power grid telemetering acquired data are determined to be effective telemetering data; otherwise, determining the data as hopping data to be screened; the calculation of the data interval range comprises the following steps: acquiring a data set of historical telemetering data of a power grid; according to the data set of the historical telemetering data of the power grid, clustering analysis is carried out by adopting a neighbor propagation algorithm to obtain clustering relevance data of different telemetering types; and calculating the mean value and the standard deviation of the relevance data of different telemetry types to obtain the data interval ranges corresponding to the different telemetry types. The data interval range is obtained from the historical power grid telemetering data, and whether the subsequent power grid telemetering acquired data is jump data or not is analyzed and screened based on the characteristics of the data, so that the method has strong universality and expansibility.
assignees: GUODIAN NANJING AUTOMATION CO

title_en: Baseline load prediction method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a baseline load prediction method, a baseline load prediction device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining historical load data, historical day data and prediction day data determined by indexes, determining principal components in the indexes and corresponding principal component comprehensive scores of a matrix formed by the historical day data by adopting a principal component analysis method improved based on an entropy method, calculating weather similarity of the prediction day and the historical day according to the historical day data and the prediction day data corresponding to the indexes divided by the principal component comprehensive scores, determining a historical day set similar to the prediction day according to the weather similarity and the time similarity of the prediction day and the historical day, and obtaining the prediction day load data according to the historical load data, the historical day set, the weather matrix and the prediction day data by adopting a back propagation neural network. The invention solves the problem of low quality of data obtained by preprocessing the data before the baseline load prediction in the related technology.

title_en: Safe driving auxiliary system based on dynamic coupling of people, roads and environment
abstract_en: The safe driving auxiliary system based on dynamic coupling of people, roads and environments is characterized in that a dynamic coupling subsystem takes a driver, a vehicle, a road and an environment as a characteristic index set for driving risk prediction, a driving risk regression prediction model based on a BP (Back propagation) neural network is constructed, the driving risk regression prediction model predicts the risk to be met in the driving process of the driver, and judges the risk level and adopts an early warning scheme of the corresponding level; the third-level early warning subsystem carries out a third-level early warning scheme according to the danger level prediction, wherein the third-level early warning scheme comprises voice early warning, contact with an emergency contact and automatic positioning warning; and in the early warning tracking subsystem, after the driver is subjected to three-stage early warning, early warning tracking is adopted, and the early warning tracking content comprises the response of the driver to the three-stage early warning and whether corresponding driving decision behavior is adopted or not. The invention effectively improves the comfort and the safety of automobile driving, reduces the occurrence frequency of traffic accidents and provides basic guarantee for social public safety.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING JIAOTONG

title_en: Method for identifying water exchange and heat exchange network optimization potential of petrochemical enterprise
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of engineering optimization methods, and relates to a method for identifying the water exchange and heat exchange network optimization potential of petrochemical enterprises. And performing cascade analysis on the process auxiliary system in the production process of the specific petrochemical enterprise by using a cascade analysis table method. Firstly, determining a process flow and making a process flow chart; secondly, collecting auxiliary system data such as water consumption and energy consumption in the production process; next, optimizing a model of a production process-water exchange network-energy exchange network of a petrochemical enterprise; then, a cascade table analysis method is utilized to carry out WSCA (water exchange network cascade analysis) and ESCA (energy exchange network cascade analysis); and finally, analyzing the result. The optimization potentials of the water exchange network and the energy exchange network are analyzed from the total process flow, the optimal value of the auxiliary system under the current condition is identified, a reference basis is provided for the specific engineering optimization design, and an improvement scheme is provided.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN TECH

title_en: Multidimensional collaborative scheduling method for cascade reservoir group
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-dimensional cooperative scheduling method for a cascade reservoir group, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: step 1: generalizing the river cascade reservoir groups according to the distribution topography of the river cascade reservoir groups, and constructing a system network node diagram of the watershed hydraulic connection; step 2, constructing a multidimensional collaborative scheduling simulation model target function according to a system network node diagram of watershed hydraulic connection; and 3, solving the objective function of the multi-dimensional cooperative scheduling simulation model according to the real-time data. The invention establishes the multi-dimensional cooperative control principle of the cascade reservoir group and provides an optimization solving method, and breaks through the problem of complex multi-dimensional cooperative control of the cascade reservoir group. The invention adopts the representative series to calculate and optimize the long-series yellow river step reservoir group cooperative scheduling scheme, realizes the matching of the river basin water supply and demand processes and the reasonable reservoir and river channel silt flushing process, improves the system generating capacity and stability, basically ensures the river ecological water quantity and process, and improves the overall benefit of the yellow river step reservoir group system.
assignees: UNIV ZHENGZHOU

title_en: Analysis method for possible maximum disaster of cascade hydroelectric junction group
abstract_en: The invention discloses an analysis method for the maximum possible disaster of a cascade hydroelectric hub group, which divides the dam break generation factors of the cascade hydroelectric hub group into an extreme load action unit and a dam break influence unit, divides the influence result of the dam break of the hydroelectric hub group into a disaster-bearing body disaster-suffering loss unit, considers the extreme load combination of 4 disaster-causing factors of extreme flood, giant earthquake, dammed lake and giant landslide, and can simply and scientifically calculate the maximum possible disasters of 3 disaster-bearing body losses of dam affiliated facilities and downstream building damages, personal casualties and ecological interferences thereof caused by cascade hydroelectric hub group continuous collapse by constructing an analysis method for the maximum possible disaster of the cascade hydroelectric hub group based on a Bayes network and utilizing the dam break influence unit in the Bayes network, thereby being beneficial to scientifically and quantitatively analyzing the disaster influence degree of the cascade hydroelectric hub group and helping to determine a reasonable hydroelectric hub risk control decision.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;UNIV BEIJING TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Emergency bell device with sensor detection and output port on/off function of remote control terminal
title_ko: Cctv 원격 제어 단말의 센서 감지 및 출력 포트 온/오프 기능을 갖는 비상벨 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency bell device having sensor detection and output port on/off functions in a CCTV remote control terminal. The emergency bell device comprises: a sensor part; a remote control terminal; and an emergency bell server. According to the present invention, a corresponding sound source can be automatically transmitted for each sensor detection port by using the remote control terminal.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 원격 제어 단말의 센서 감지 및 출력 포트 온/오프 기능을 갖는 비상벨 장치에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 원격 제어 단말의 센서 감지 및 출력 포트 온/오프 기능을 갖는 비상벨 장치로서, 도심의 재난이나 재해를 감지하기 위한 적어도 하나 이상의 센서를 구비하는 센서부; 상기 센서부의 적어도 하나 이상의 센서와 전기적으로 연결 접속되는 센서 감지 포트를 구비하고, 상기 센서부의 센서 감지에 대응하는 해당하는 음원을 출력하는 원격 제어 단말; 및 상기 원격 제어 단말과 네트워크를 통해 연결 접속되며, 상기 원격 제어 단말의 센서 감지 포트를 관리하기 위한 비상벨 서버를 포함하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에서 제안하고 있는 원격 제어 단말의 센서 감지 및 출력 포트 온/오프 기능을 갖는 비상벨 장치에 따르면, 도심의 재난이나 재해를 감지하기 위한 적어도 하나 이상의 센서를 구비하는 센서부와, 센서부의 적어도 하나 이상의 센서와 전기적으로 연결 접속되는 센서 감지 포트를 구비하고, 센서부의 센서 감지에 대응하는 해당하는 음원을 출력하는 원격 제어 단말과, 원격 제어 단말과 네트워크를 통해 연결 접속되며, 원격 제어 단말의 센서 감지 포트를 관리하기 위한 비상벨 서버를 포함하여 구성함으로써, 비상벨 서버의 원격 제어 하에 원격 제어 단말을 통해 센서 감지 포트별로 해당하는 음원을 자동으로 송출할 수 있도록 할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명의 원격 제어 단말의 센서 감지 및 출력 포트 온/오프 기능을 갖는 비상벨 장치에 따르면, 비상벨 서버의 원격 제어 하에 원격 제어 단말을 통해 센서 감지 포트별로 해당하는 음원을 자동으로 송출하되, 센서 감지 포트별로 해당하는 음원이 자동으로 송출될 수 있도록 구성함으로써, 도심의 재난이나 재해에 따른 해당 음원의 송출로 현재의 재난 상황을 신속하게 전파함은 물론, 그에 따른 도심의 재난이나 재해의 모니터링 및 상황 관리의 효율성이 더욱 향상될 수 있도록 할 수 있다.
assignees: THE ZONE SYSTEM

title_en: Information physical safety early warning method, device and equipment for liquefied natural gas receiving station
abstract_en: The application provides a physical safety pre-warning method, device and equipment for information of a liquefied natural gas receiving station. The method comprises the steps of respectively identifying nodes on each subsystem of each layer, determining a risk node and a connection mechanism of the risk node, acquiring a risk network structure according to the risk node and the connection mechanism of the risk node, respectively acquiring the risk entropy, the risk state and the energy influence value of each risk node by adopting an SIRS model, and respectively acquiring the propagation processes under two preset propagation mechanisms according to the risk entropy, the risk state and the energy influence value of each risk node so as to predict a risk path. Compared with the prior art, the method and the system for quantitatively analyzing the risk propagation by using the energy influence value realize quantitative analysis of the risk propagation according to the risk entropy, the risk state and the energy influence value, and complete the prediction of the risk path by performing qualitative analysis on the nodes in the station by staff according to the personal service level and the working experience.

title_en: Supply chain network risk propagation assessment method based on Markov process
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of epidemic prevention, and particularly relates to a supply chain network risk propagation assessment method based on a Markov process, which comprises the following steps: step 1, constructing a complex supply chain network model; mapping enterprises in a complex supply chain network into nodes of the network, setting the number of initial nodes as n, and dividing each node into 4 layers which represent a supply layer, a manufacturing layer, a distribution layer and a retail layer in the supply chain network; step 2, constructing a supply chain network failure propagation model based on a Markov process: establishing a multi-period dynamic failure degree evolution network based on a Markov process based on a complex supply chain model; and 3, constructing a failure evaluation model of the network node of the supply chain and carrying out a simulation experiment. The failure degree of each node is quantified, and a dynamic multi-period supply chain network failure degree evaluation model is established, so that the protection and prevention of the nodes with high failure degree are enhanced, and effective parameters can be provided for the supply chain network optimization process.
assignees: UNIV NORTHEASTERN

title_en: Mobile firefighting system in apartment house
title_ko: 공동주택의 이동식 소방장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mobile firefighting system in an apartment house. An objective of the present invention is to provide a mobile firefighting system in an apartment house that can prevent a door from being heated by being movably installed along a hallway of the apartment house to move to the front of a door of a household in which a fire is detected, and spray firefighting water toward the door, and can reduce time consumed for extinguishing a fire by shortening a time of moving from the firefighting system to a fire occurrence point. More specifically, the present invention relates to a detection system detecting a fire occurrence of any one household in the apartment house with a plurality of separated households sharing one hallway on each floor, and a mobile firefighting system in an apartment house provided in the hallway of the apartment house to spread the fire occurrence to surrounding areas by receiving the fire occurrence signal from the detection system that has detected the fire occurrence. The mobile firefighting system in an apartment house comprises: a main body which has a firefighting facility including a fire extinguisher and a fire hose therein and is movably installed along a hallway wall; a reception unit which is installed in the main body to receive the fire occurrence signal from the detection system; a filming device which is installed in the main body to transmit an image or video obtained by filming a door side of the household from the hallway; a spreading unit which is installed in the main body to spread the fire occurrence by turning on and off an LED lamp and ringing a warning sound at the same time when the reception unit receives the fire occurrence signal; and at least one rail which is formed to protrude in a longitudinal direction of the hallway wall from the other side surface of the hallway wall, has an outer surface repeatedly formed with serrated curves to guide a moving route of the main body, and is coupled to one side surface of the main body.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 공동주택의 복도를 따라서 이동가능하게 설치되어, 화재 발생이 감지된 세대의 출입문 앞으로 이동하여 출입문을 향해 소화수를 분사하여 출입문이 가열되는 것을 방지하고, 종래의 복도 일측에 고정되어 구비되는 소화장치로부터 화재 발생 지점까지 이동하는 시간을 단축하여 화재진화에 소요되는 시간을 줄일 수 있는 공동주택의 이동식 소방장치를 제공하는 것을 목적으로 하고, 상세하게는 각각의 층에 하나의 복도를 공유하는 다수의 구분된 세대들이 모인 공동주택 중 어느 하나의 세대의 화재 발생을 감지하는 감지시스템과 화재 발생을 감지한 상기 감지시스템으로부터 화재발생신호를 수신하여 화재 발생을 주변에 전파하도록 상기 공동주택 복도에 구비되는 공동주택의 이동식 소방장치에 있어서, 내부에 소화기, 소방호스를 포함하는 소방시설이 구비되되, 복도벽체를 따라서 이동가능하게 설치되는 본체; 상기 본체에 설치되어 상기 감지지스템으로부터 화재발생신호를 수신하는 수신부; 상기 본체에 설치되어 복도에서 상기 세대의 출입문 쪽을 촬영하여 촬영한 이미지 또는 영상을 상기 감지시스템으로 전송하는 촬영장치; 상기 본체에 설치되어 상기 수신부가 화재발생신호를 수신하면 LED램프를 점멸함과 동시에 경보음을 울려 화재 발생을 전파하는 전파부; 상기 복도벽체의 타측면에서 상기 복도벽체의 길이방향을 따라 돌출되어 형성되되, 외면은 톱니형상의 굴곡이 반복적으로 형성되어 상기 본체의 이동경로를 가이드하고, 상기 본체의 일측면에 결합하는 적어도 하나 이상의 레일;을 포함한다.
assignees: SEOJEON GENERAL ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Vulnerability assessment method for intelligent power grid information physical system based on complex network
abstract_en: The invention provides a vulnerability assessment method of a smart grid information physical system based on a complex network, which comprises the following steps: step 1: acquiring a public power grid data set from an open source website, carrying out data analysis and mining on the data set, and carrying out abstract network modeling on a power system; step 2: based on complex network theory and data set, constructing information layer network model of communication system; step 3: further considering the coupling relation between the physical layer and the information layer, constructing a double-layer network interconnection model with different coupling mechanisms; step 4: based on a multilayer complex network theory, carrying out static analysis on a power grid information physical system, and considering vulnerability measurement indexes under different attack conditions; step 5: and carrying out cascade fault propagation dynamic simulation analysis on the constructed information physical system network model, and evaluating the vulnerability of the system according to the dynamic simulation analysis result.
assignees: UNIV BEIHANG

title_en: Line active stop and network reconstruction method for preventing typhoon weather cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a line active pulling and stopping and network reconstruction method for preventing typhoon weather cascading failure, which comprises the steps of main distribution network model splicing, expected failure set analysis, power grid risk assessment, pulling and stopping, reconstruction scheme construction, selection and the like, wherein the risk analysis of multi-voltage-level combination is carried out on lines passing by a typhoon path, possible cascading failure is analyzed, some lines are actively pulled and stopped, and network reconstruction is carried out, so that power supply of residents and important loads can be ensured to the greatest extent after the line failure occurs under the typhoon condition. The method provided by the invention can effectively prevent the occurrence of large-area power failure of the power grid, has strong operability and has more remarkable popularization.

title_en: Latency-capacity-and energy-aware vnf placement in edge computing environments
abstract_en: One example method includes creating an ILP model that includes a delay model, an energy model, and a QoS model, and modeling, using the integer linear programming model, a VNF placement problem as an ILP problem, and the modeling includes: using the delay model to identify propagation, transmission, processing, and queuing, delays implied by enabling an instance of the VNF at an edge node to accept a user VNF call; using the energy model to identify energy consumption implied by enabling an instance of the VNF at an edge node to accept a user VNF call; and using the QoS model to identify end-to-end delay, bandwidth consumption, and jitter, implied by enabling an instance of the VNF at an edge node to accept a user virtual network function call. The problem modeled by the ILP model may be resolved by a heuristic method.
assignees: EMC IP HOLDING CO LLC

title_en: Smart grid robustness assessment method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and equipment for evaluating robustness of a smart power grid, which relate to the technical field of smart power grid safety analysis and solve the technical problems that the traditional power system safety evaluation method only starts from the angle of electrical characteristics or only starts from the angle of a network topology and can not accurately describe the robustness under the evolution rule of the cascade fault of the power network, and the technical scheme is as follows: based on the perspective of a topological structure or electrical characteristics alone in the past, the structural robustness of the power supply and demand service function of the power grid and the functional robustness of the electrical topological structure characteristics are considered, and the structural robustness and the functional robustness are combined with efficacy subgraphs under different interference modes, so that the static and dynamic combined intelligent power grid robustness assessment method is obtained from the aspects of the inherent advantages of the anti-destruction capability of the intelligent power grid and the outward appearance of the service viability. The evaluation method is a result under multi-aspect quantitative analysis, and can more comprehensively and comprehensively reflect the actual robust characteristic performance of the intelligent power grid.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: smart home service platform system and method
title_ko: 스마트 홈 통합 플랫폼 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a smart home integration platform system comprises: a database server which stores data including in-house system identification information, in-house data and analysis information, event occurrence information, and emergency situation information for a plurality of subscribers; a data analysis server which receives and analyzes the in-house data provided from the in-house system, stores the in-house data and analysis information in the database server, based on the analysis information, detects an emergency in a house in which the in-house system is installed, generates emergency notification information based on the detection and outputs the emergency notification information to the outside; and an intelligent emergency system which provides emergency notification information to predetermined client systems or terminals corresponding to the in-house system identification information included in the emergency notification information so as to propagate an emergency situation when the emergency notification information is provided from the data analysis server, and generates response information for the emergency situation according to a request from the client system or the terminal and stores the response information in addition to the emergency situation information. In particular, the intelligent emergency system generates report information upon request from the client system or the terminal after the emergency situation is propagated and transmits the report information to a social safety network service provider system. According to the present invention, smart home services can be provided stably and efficiently.
abstract_ko:
본 발명에 따르는 스마트 홈 통합 플랫폼 시스템은, 다수의 가입자에 대한 댁내 시스템 식별정보, 댁내 데이터 및 분석정보, 이벤트 발생정보, 응급상황 현황정보를 포함하는 데이터를 저장하는 데이터베이스 서버; 댁내 시스템으로부터 제공되는 댁내 데이터를 제공받아 분석함과 아울러 상기 댁내 데이터 및 분석정보를 상기 데이터베이스 서버에 저장하고, 상기 분석정보를 토대로 어느 한 댁내 시스템이 설치된 댁내의 응급상황을 검지하고 그에따른 응급상황 통지정보를 생성하여 외부로 출력하는 데이터 분석 서버; 및 상기 데이터 분석 서버로부터 응급상황 통지정보가 제공되면, 상기 응급상황 통지정보에 포함된 댁내 시스템 식별정보에 대응되게 미리 정해진 클라이언트 시스템 또는 단말기들로 응급상황 통지정보를 제공하여 응급상황을 전파함과 아울러 상기 클라이언트 시스템 또는 단말기로부터의 요청에 따라 응급상황에 대한 대응정보를 생성하여 상기 응급상황 현황정보에 부가하여 저장하는 지능형 응급 시스템;을 포함한다.  
특히 상기 지능형 응급 시스템이, 상기 응급상황의 전파후에 상기 클라이언트 시스템 또는 단말기로부터의 요청에 따라 신고정보를 생성하여 사회안전망 서비스 제공자 시스템으로 전송;함을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: SANDEUL INFORMATION & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Simulation method for botnet propagation model analysis and target construction for Internet of things equipment
abstract_en: A simulation method for botnet propagation model analysis and target construction for Internet of things equipment comprises the following steps: constructing a network topology structure for botnet virus transmission; finding out the Internet of things equipment with weak password holes, and acquiring and analyzing equipment firmware; simulating the acquired firmware information by using a QEMU simulator through a system level simulation technology, and simulating a target topological structure; and (5) completing the propagation reproduction of the botnet and packaging the botnet into a target. According to the method, through analysis of Mirai propagation processes, functions of resisting restarting, preventing process death and the like of malicious codes are achieved, a QEMU simulator is used for simulating firmware, and a constructed target scene is focused on customization of typical botnet virus simulation and propagation model analysis.
assignees: UNIV NANJING POSTS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS

title_en: Multi-factor-based hydropower station generator deduction oil level prediction method
abstract_en: A hydroelectric power station generator deduction oil level prediction method based on multiple factors comprises the following steps: obtaining original data through a sensor, and then obtaining an original factor data matrix R and an original oil level matrix D; carrying out dimensionless treatment on the original factor data matrix R and the oil level original matrix D; obtaining a standardized factor data matrix X; weighting the standardized factor data matrix X; establishing an oil level prediction model, and training the oil level prediction model by using a three-layer back propagation neural network; inputting training samples to calculate errors; judging whether the oil level prediction model is trained; and if the training is completed, predicting by using the oil level prediction model. The method improves the accuracy and efficiency of deducing the oil level, uses multidimensional factors to establish a temperature prediction model, and avoids the influence on the historical trend analysis of the oil level; therefore, the oil level prediction result is more reasonable and accurate. The operation reliability of the hydropower station generator set can be effectively improved.

title_en: Postal wheel risk prevention and control method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for preventing and controlling the risk of a mail wheel, which belong to the technical field of risk assessment and solve the problems that the prior method can not quantitatively assess the accident risk degree of sudden public health events and can not effectively early warn nodes with large transmission risk, and the method comprises the following steps: obtaining a target mail wheel structure plan; constructing an accident cause complex network based on accident influence risk factors; calculating the architecture reliability of the mail-wheel propagation network architecture based on the accident cause complex network, calculating the severity of the sub-nodes of the target mail-wheel propagation network architecture, and calculating the potential risk values of the sub-nodes of the mail-wheel propagation network architecture based on the severity of the sub-nodes and the domino effect; the method and the system calculate the potential risk value of the mail-wheel propagation network architecture sub-node based on the sub-node severity and the domino effect, so that the evaluation result is more objective and accurate, and method support is provided for the mail-wheel sudden public health event accident risk classification and management and control.

title_en: Social network privacy risk assessment model based on evolutionary playing and propagation dynamics
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of privacy protection. The method comprises the steps of firstly evaluating importance degree of privacy information of a user through a privacy risk evaluation model, then constructing relation dynamics based on a graph evolution game theory, quantifying strategy or behavior change of heterogeneity of a complex network structure to different user groups, constructing a dynamic evolution mechanism of user privacy information propagation based on an infectious disease infection model, and finally dynamically adjusting state transition among different user groups by combining a user edge relation change rate of the evolution game theory and an infection rate of a user privacy information propagation dynamic model. In summary, the improved infectious disease model effectively reduces the transmission of private information in the social network, so that the privacy security of users in the social network is protected.
assignees: UNIV CHANGSHA SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Apparatus for disseminating an emergency situation based on network separation and method therefor
title_ko: 망 분리 기반의 비상 상황을 전파하기 위한 장치 및 이를 위한 방법
abstract_en: A device for disseminating emergency situations is configured to perform a plurality of operations in which weights between a plurality of layers are applied to a field image through a detection network including a plurality of layers connected with learned weights to calculate an output value which indicates with probability whether a situation in the field image is a normal situation or an emergency situation, and includes a detection unit which detects a scene video as the emergency situation video, if the probability indicates that the situation in the scene video is the emergency situation.
abstract_ko: 비상 상황을 전파하기 위한 장치는 감시영상장치로부터 현장 영상을 수신하면, 학습된 가중치로 연결되는 복수의 계층을 포함하는 검출망을 통해 상기 현장 영상에 대해 복수의 계층 간 가중치가 적용되는 복수의 연산을 수행하여 현장 영상의 상황이 정상 상황인지 혹은 비상 상황인지 여부를 확률로 나타내는 출력값을 산출하고, 상기 확률이 현장 영상의 상황이 비상 상황임을 나타내면, 해당 현장 영상을 비상상황영상으로 검출하는 검출부를 포함한다.
assignees: IHYEON TELECOMMUNICATIONS CO LTD

title_en: Fire source positioning method and system based on artificial neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire source positioning method and a fire source positioning system based on an artificial neural network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting indoor wall pictures after fire disaster through an image collecting module; the collected pictures are subjected to graying by utilizing an image preprocessing module and converted into gray images, and the gray images are further subjected to binarization to obtain binary images; identifying fire burning trace areas in the binary images by adopting an image identification module to obtain edge coordinates of burning traces; converting the edge coordinates into actual space coordinates through a feature extraction module, and extracting features of the converted coordinates; and inputting the extracted characteristic value into a fire source prediction module, and obtaining a fire position prediction value through forward propagation. The invention uses the artificial neural network to identify the wall surface image after fire disaster and position the fire source, realizes the intelligent fire source position identification in fire disaster investigation, and overcomes the defects of high labor intensity and low working efficiency of the artificial identification method.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH CENTRAL NATIONALITI

title_en: Mobile energy network optimization scheduling method based on fuel cell energy cascade utilization
abstract_en: The invention provides a mobile energy network optimization scheduling method based on fuel cell energy cascade utilization, which comprises the following steps: step 1: a mobile energy network based on the energy cascade utilization of the fuel cell is established, electric propulsion load and household electric load are supplied through a hydrogen fuel cell and a diesel generator, electric load demands are supplemented through an electric storage device, and heat load demands are guaranteed through the hydrogen fuel cell, an electric heat pump and a heat storage device; step 2: establishing a ship navigation model under the condition of ship stall; step 3: establishing a mobile energy network optimization scheduling model based on fuel cell energy cascade utilization, and performing constraint; step 4: and solving the mobile energy network optimization scheduling model, and performing optimization scheduling on the mobile energy network. The invention realizes the optimal scheduling strategy by taking the minimum running cost and the minimum carbon emission cost of the ship mobile energy system as targets on the premise of ensuring the reliable supply of the thermal power and the electric load of the ship energy network and the timely arrival of the ship safety.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: Method for estimating risk of infectious disease spread in facilities
title_ko: 시설물의 감염병 전파 위험도 판단 방법
abstract_en: A method for determining the risk of infectious disease transmission in a facility is provided. The method for determining the risk of infectious disease transmission in a facility according to an embodiment of the present invention may detect whether there are contacts of a confirmed person with an infectious disease, identify facilities where the detected contacts came into contact with the confirmed person, and determine the risk of infectious disease transmission at the identified facilities. As a result, the risk of infectious disease transmission in facilities can be determined based on objective standards, making it possible to take reasonable, systematic, and effective follow-up measures for facilities visited by confirmed infectious disease patients. Ultimately, the present invention can contribute to the prevention and suppression of infectious disease pandemics.
abstract_ko: 시설물의 감염병 전파 위험도 판단 방법이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 시설물의 감염병 전파 위험도 판단 방법은, 감염병에 확진된 확진자와 접촉한 접촉자가 있는지 탐지하고, 탐지된 접촉자가 확진자와 접촉한 시설물을 파악하며, 파악된 시설물의 감염병 전파 위험도를 판단한다. 이에 의해, 시설물의 감염병 전파 위험도를 객관적인 기준에 의거하여 판단할 수 있으므로, 감염병 확진자가 방문한 시설물에 대한 합리적이고 체계적이며 효과적인 사후 조치가 가능해져, 궁극적으로 감염병 대유행의 예방과 억제에 기여할 수 있게 된다.
assignees: KOREA ELECTRONICS TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Systematic financial risk assessment method based on functional data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a systematic financial risk assessment method based on functional data in the technical field of systematic financial risk assessment, which comprises the following steps: performing functional processing on the calculation result by using a functional data analysis method; introducing a traditional discrete entropy weight method into a functional data analysis model; identifying systematic financial risk events by combining the functionalized financial risk index data and the entropy weight function of time-varying dynamics; clustering weekly industry systematic financial risk index functions, and determining real-time conditions of risks in a financial system; judging the propagation direction and the conduction path of the risk in the financial system by using a transfer entropy causal inspection method of a variable hysteresis term; and constructing a network model. The method of the invention is beneficial to improving the accuracy and the robustness of the systematic financial risk measure, wherein the introduced complex network method is beneficial to visualizing the conduction path and the infection intensity of the systematic financial risk among industries.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Method for establishing rail transit network cascading failure model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for establishing a cascading failure model of a rail transit network, and belongs to the technical field of calculation, calculation or counting. The method comprises the steps of obtaining data, constructing a rail transit network model, removing fault nodes, generating a new rail transit network model, simulating node states considering the change of requirements and the action of time delay, and calculating a cascade failure influence index. The cascade failure model established by the invention can simultaneously consider the demand change and the time delay effect under the cascade failure state of the rail transit network, and reveal the cascade failure mechanism in the real world.

title_en: High-proportion clean energy power grid vulnerability assessment method considering cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-proportion clean energy power grid vulnerability assessment method considering cascading failures. First, the power grid is abstracted into a topological graph connected by nodes and lines based on the topological structure of the power grid, and the line betweenness of the power grid considering the electrical characteristics is calculated on the basis of the topological graph. And then, analyzing the source load fluctuation characteristics of the power grid, analyzing a corresponding typical daily load curve for load fluctuation based on industrial, commercial and residential load historical data, and establishing a wind-light unit output model for the time sequence fluctuation of wind-light renewable energy sources, and obtaining a typical sunrise force curve of the wind-light unit based on historical wind speed and illumination data in a region. Then, establishing a grid vulnerability evaluation index; and finally, obtaining corresponding grid vulnerability evaluation indexes according to the power grid cascading failure results under different line failure conditions. The invention realizes the evaluation of the vulnerability of the power grid under the known power grid topology and the source load fluctuation historical data, and can provide a theoretical basis for the operation scheduling of the power system.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power supply control method and device and user equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a power supply control method, a device and user equipment, and relates to the technical field of power supply. The method comprises the following steps: predicting a first power generation amount obtained by a user through photovoltaic power generation in a time period to be predicted through a power generation prediction model of the user; and predicting a first electric quantity of the user in the period to be predicted through time sequence analysis; controlling the power supply of the user in the period to be predicted according to the first power generation amount and the first power generation amount; the power generation prediction model is obtained by training a back propagation BP neural network model. The scheme of the invention solves the problem of how to intelligently switch the photovoltaic power generation of a user and the power supply of a commercial power supply office, thereby fully utilizing the photovoltaic power generation.
assignees: CHINA MOBILE SHANGHAI INFORMATION COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD;CMIM NETWORK CO LTD;CHINA MOBILE COMMUNICATIONS GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Knowledge graph construction method for solid rocket engine test
abstract_en: The invention provides a knowledge graph construction method for a solid rocket engine test, which aims to solve the problems that the traditional flat storage type solid rocket engine test related data based on a relational database cannot be effectively mined, analyzed, fully utilized and the like. The steps are as follows: s1: building a neural network infrastructure by extracting test data information; s2: the test data information extraction neural network propagates forward; s3: the test data information extracts neural network errors to be back propagated; s4: the test data information extracts the neural network weight and bias update. Compared with the existing flat storage form based on the relational database, the knowledge graph construction technology in the field of solid rocket engine test can achieve the degree of autonomous data management, and the unstructured data and the semi-structured data are subjected to structure visualization processing, so that the direct association mining analysis capability of the data is greatly enhanced, and the complex implicit relation in the solid rocket engine test is intuitively displayed.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA AEROSPACE POWER MACHINERY TESTING INST;UNIV NORTHWESTERN POLYTECHNICAL

title_en: Risk minimization multipath routing calculation method for power grid key control service
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk minimization multipath routing calculation method for a key control service of a power grid, which comprises the following steps: step a: establishing a risk minimization disjoint double-route optimization model under the condition of natural disasters, and setting objective functions and constraint conditions; step b: and calculating risk values of all disjoint double routes under the condition of natural disasters, and selecting the double route with the minimum risk value as an optimal result to be output. Aiming at key control business of a power grid, a risk minimization disjoint double-route optimization model under the condition of natural disasters is established, a multi-route active defense method is researched, and the route survivability of the multi-route active defense method is improved; the method solves the problem that natural disasters bring great difficulty to fault defense, weakens the dependent coupling relation between the power grid and the communication network, improves the capability of resisting initial faults, enhances the survivability of routes in the cascading process, and inhibits the further propagation of cascading faults.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD WENZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Robustness assessment method for electric heating comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robustness assessment method of an electric heating comprehensive energy system, and belongs to the field of energy systems. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a dynamic model according to system topology information, comprehensive tide characteristics and a cascading failure mechanism, wherein the model is based on an energy flow analysis method, and reflects an actual operation mechanism of an electrothermal comprehensive energy system by referring to a complex network theory; improving the existing complex network index, providing a new key link identification index, and quantifying the structural and functional characteristics of the system through a robustness evaluation index; and simulating the attack possibly suffered by the system, and simulating the dynamic process of the analysis system under the cascading failure according to the provided robustness assessment method to obtain a robustness conclusion. The invention comprehensively considers the structure and physical characteristics of the system and provides powerful support for improving the safe and stable operation capability of the electric heating comprehensive energy system.
assignees: UNIV JIANGSU NORMAL

title_en: Multi-energy collaborative power supply self-adaptive online optimization method
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-energy collaborative power supply self-adaptive online optimization method, which not only considers the operation cost, but also comprehensively considers pollution cost and energy loss by establishing a multi-energy collaborative power supply optimization objective function and constraint conditions, optimizes the utilization of resources, reduces investment and operation cost, consumes clean energy sources such as wind power, photovoltaic and the like to the maximum extent, establishes a wind power prediction model and a photovoltaic power generation power prediction model, predicts wind power by a prediction method based on a BP-GA model or a support vector machine, predicts photovoltaic power generation power by a K-Cascaded-attention network, improves the accuracy of wind power and photovoltaic power generation power prediction, and dynamically planning and scheduling the multi-energy to obtain a multi-energy collaborative power supply scheme and improve the utilization rate of the energy.

title_en: Analysis method and system for transmission path of gas transmission pipe network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for analyzing a transmission path of a gas transmission pipe network, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, determining a key node set and an end node set; the method comprises the steps of S2, setting an acquisition strategy corresponding to a propagation path analysis request, S3, determining a target node set based on the acquisition strategy, and S4, determining a target node propagation path based on the target node set, the key node set and the terminal node set. According to the invention, the transmission path is analyzed based on the quantized key degree, the target node is rapidly positioned and forms a pipe network node which takes the target node as the center and is not concerned in the simulation process and presentation, so that the analysis, simulation and presentation efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: Smart apartment complex security system that implements crime prediction through video analysis
title_ko: 영상분석을 통한 범죄 예측을 구현한 스마트 공동주택 보안 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present invention is a smart apartment complex security system, including: an optical camera (110) that captures the inside and outside of an apartment complex and generates first image information; an infrared camera (120) installed inside the household to capture thermal images and generate second image information; a home network server (130) that integrates and manages IoT smart home appliances (131) that perform security, intrusion prevention, heating, cooling, ventilation, cooking, illumination control, and safety accident prevention, respectively, by linking therewith, performs real-time control and reservation control, generates first warning information when the front door is attempted to be opened using unregistered biometric information, and receives the first image information and the second image information to analyze the intrusion of an unregistered outsider into the apartment complex and generate second warning information; a resident terminal (140) that receives and monitors operation detection information, first image information, and second image information according to operation from the home network server (130), and spreads an alarm according to the first warning information and second warning information; and a management office server (150) that is connected to the home network server (130) and the resident terminal (140) through a communication network to receive first warning information and second warning information, receive and store the corresponding image information, and transmit an alarm to a public safety center server (160). Therefore, crimes caused by outsider intrusion can be prevented in advance.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 공동주택 내외부를 촬영하여 제1영상정보를 생성하는 광학카메라(110), 세대 내부에 설치되어 열화상을 촬영하여 제2영상정보를 생성하는 적외선카메라(120), 보안과 침입탑지와 난방과 냉방과 환기와 요리와 조도와 안전사고예방을 각각 수행하는 IoT 스마트 가전기기(131)와 연동하여, 통합관리하며, 실시간 제어 및 예약 제어를 수행하고, 미등록 생체정보에 의한 현관도어의 개방시도시에 제1경고정보를 생성하고, 제1영상정보 및 제2영상정보를 전송받아 해당 공동주택의 미등록 외부인의 침입을 분석하여 제2경고정보를 생성하는, 홈 네트워크 서버(130), 홈 네트워크 서버(130)로부터 운용에 따른 작동감지정보와 제1영상정보와 제2영상정보를 전송받아 모니터링하고, 제1경고정보 및 제2경고정보에 따라 알람을 전파하는, 입주민 단말기(140), 및 홈 네트워크 서버(130) 및 입주민 단말기(140)와 통신네트워크로 연결되어 제1경고정보 및 제2경고정보를 전송받아 해당 영상정보를 전송받아 저장하고, 치안센터서버(160)로 알람을 전송하도록 하는 관리실 서버(150)를 포함하여, 외부인 침입에 의한 범죄를 사전에 방지하는, 스마트 공동주택 보안 시스템을 개시한다.
assignees: YEAJU CO LTD

title_en: Wind power prediction method based on Quartiles and DBN
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for eliminating abnormal points of wind power and accurately predicting the wind power based on Quartiles and DBN. First a single step/multi-step prediction of wind speed at a specified future time scale is made. And then, completing data cleaning, and removing the corresponding wind power outlier at the specified wind speed interval based on a quartile method. The outliers are classified into four categories according to the v-p point distribution characteristics. In the preliminary elimination, first, second and other abnormal points are found out, and wind power outliers corresponding to the specified wind speed interval and outlier wind speed values corresponding to the specified wind power interval are cleared. And constructing a WTP model through the DBN deep neural network. Inputting cleaned data, and initializing parameters by using the stacked RBM. And (3) fine-tuning the parameters of the whole DBN network through BP back propagation, and completing the construction of the WTP model. Substituting the wind speed predicted value obtained before into a WTP model to obtain a single-step/multi-step wind power predicted value under the same time scale.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Transmission and distribution network distributed coordination recovery method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed coordination recovery method, a distributed coordination recovery system, distributed coordination recovery equipment and a distributed coordination recovery storage medium for a transmission and distribution network, which relate to the technical field of power systems, and the distributed coordination recovery method comprises the steps of decomposing a global transmission and distribution network recovery model into two types of transmission and distribution network recovery sub-models based on a target cascade analysis method; relaxation treatment is carried out on the consistency constraint of the coupling variable in the form of an augmentation Lagrangian penalty function, and the relaxation treatment is added into a transmission network recovery and distribution network recovery sub-model objective function respectively; describing the ambiguity of renewable energy source predicted power as the ambiguity of constraint conditions, and converting the uncertain constraint conditions containing fuzzy variables in the transmission network recovery and distribution network recovery sub-model objective function into clear equivalent class forms of fuzzy opportunity constraint; and (3) introducing a diagonal quadratic approximation method to approximate the extended Lagrange penalty function, and solving the objective function of the transmission network recovery and distribution network recovery sub-model in full parallel to complete distributed coordination recovery of the transmission network and the distribution network. The invention can improve the solving efficiency.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Urban intelligent management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban intelligent management system, which belongs to the technical field of urban intelligent management and comprises a cloud control platform, an image acquisition module, an image processing module, a road network management control module, a cascade tracking module, a positioning module, an alarm feedback module and a log detection module, wherein the cloud control platform is used for verifying manager information and carrying out corresponding data display and function control according to a manager operation instruction; the invention can collect and forecast traffic flow information in each period in real time, ensures the accuracy of traffic signal control, does not need to manually maintain traffic flow, is beneficial to saving resident travel time, can perform full cross-equipment matching, avoids the condition of missed detection, greatly improves the accuracy of target detection, is convenient to use, reduces the difficulty of target analysis, and improves the working efficiency.
assignees: CHENGDU QINGYANG BIG DATA CO LTD

title_en: Double-layer collaborative optimization method for fixed and movable charging facilities of expressway
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-layer collaborative optimization method for fixed and mobile charging facilities of an expressway, which comprises the following steps: constructing an optimization model framework, the optimization model framework comprising: an upper layer collaborative site selection optimization model and a lower layer collaborative capacity optimization model; the upper layer collaborative site selection optimization model optimizes the position of a charging station and determines the position and time of the charging requirement for deploying TMC; the lower layer collaborative capacity optimization model optimizes the capacities of TMC and FC of the candidate sites and improves the utilization rate of FC; and (3) carrying out equivalent linear processing on the nonlinear problem by adopting a large M method, converting the nonlinear problem into a mixed integer linear programming model, and realizing the data exchange process between the upper layer and the lower layer by adopting target cascade analysis. The invention improves the utilization rate of the charging facility on the highway, enhances the flexibility of the charging facility, can effectively acquire the time-space distribution of the charging requirements of TMC and FC, completes the cooperative optimization of the charging facility, and provides a new choice for charging station operators and electric vehicle users.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: Automatic blending combustion method and system for coal yard, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic blending combustion method, an automatic blending combustion system, electronic equipment and a storage medium for a coal yard, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a constraint condition and an objective function for acquiring the optimal mixed burning scheme; solving the objective function by adopting a Lagrange's method, and determining an optimal mixed combustion scheme meeting the constraint condition; in the solving process, the physical property parameters of the mixed coal of the blending combustion scheme are calculated by adopting a trained error inverse propagation neural network model; and controlling a bucket wheel machine of the coal yard to automatically take materials based on the optimal blending combustion scheme. The method realizes the calculation of the physical property parameters based on the trained error inverse propagation neural network model, improves the accuracy of the physical property parameter calculation, and avoids the occurrence of unfavorable combustion conditions caused by the inaccuracy of the physical property parameter calculation.
assignees: BEIJING NONVIA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Network threat protection method and device for power transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for protecting network threat of an electric power transformer substation, which comprise the steps of analyzing intelligent transformer substation system configuration files in an intelligent transformer substation, extracting assets in the substation and forming an intelligent transformer substation asset list; analyzing the flow of real-time circulation to obtain real-time asset information, and marking abnormal assets by the flow to the asset table of the intelligent substation to obtain an asset list; setting actions generated by assets in the asset table as pass tags, and setting actions generated by assets which are not in the asset table as packet loss tags; and setting an emergency response threshold for the packet loss label, and closing an interface management state if the illegal access flow hit exceeds the threshold, so as to realize network threat protection. The flow of unauthorized asset access is controlled through the table entry, access threat detection is continuously carried out, and the access threat detection is processed according to the interface emergency treatment module, so that the threats of virus propagation, malicious attack and the like obtained by an illegal terminal are avoided in advance.

title_en: Fire Place Data Collection and Spreading Systewm by Using Throw Ball Throwing to Fire Place
title_ko: 화재 공간에 투척되는 투척 볼을 통한 정보 수집 및 전파 시스템
abstract_en: An information collection and transmission system using a throwing ball thrown into a fire space of the present invention, for reasonably determining whether to deploy firefighters and where to deploy firefighters, comprises: a throwing ball which is thrown into a fire site, is equipped with a temperature sensor, humidity sensor, oxygen saturation sensor, camera unit, and the like to determine an internal condition of the fire site before firefighters are deployed to the fire site, and transmits information sensed by a sensor module and video information captured by the camera unit to a fire chief terminal; a smart name tag module which is attached to an oxygen cylinder carried by a firefighter, displays oxygen pressure information or oxygen remaining information of the oxygen cylinder, additionally displays and provides affiliation and name information, is equipped with a motion sensor to display and provide information on the firefighter's collapse, transmits the oxygen pressure information, affiliation and name information, and collapse information to the fire chief terminal, and displays information transmitted from a fire chief through two-way communication with the fire chief terminal; a fire chief terminal which receives and displays the information transmitted from the name tag module and transmits information such as withdrawal order information and firefighter movement information transmitted by the fire chief to the name tag module; and a mesh network which performs a plurality of relay functions to bi-directionally connect the throwing ball, name tag module, and fire chief terminal to a network.
abstract_ko: 본 발명 화재 공간에 투척되는 투척 볼을 통한 정보 수집 및 전파 시스템은 화재 현장에 투척되는 것으로 화재 현장에 소방관이 투입되기 전에 화재 현장의 내부 상태를 파악하기 위하여 온도 센서, 습도 센서, 산소 포화도 센서, 카메라부 등을 구비하고 있으며 센서 모듈이 센싱한 정보들과 카메라부가 촬영한 영상 정보를 소방대장 단말기로 전송하는 투척 볼과, 소방관이 메고있는 산소통에 부착되는 것으로 산소통의 산소 기압 정보 또는 산소 잔여 정보를 표출하고 소속, 이름 정보를 추가적으로 표출 제공할 수 있으며, 모션 센서가 장착될 수 있어서 소방관의 쓰러짐 정보를 표출 제공할 수 있고, 상기 산소 기압정보, 소속, 이름정보, 쓰러짐 정보를 소방대장 단말기로 전송하고 소방대장 단말기로부터 양방향 통신을 통하여 소방대장으로부터 전송되는 정보를 표출할 수 있는 스마트 네임 태크 모듈과, 상기 네임태크 모듈로부터 전송되는 정보를 수신하여 표출하고 소방 대장이 전송하는 철수 명령정보, 소방관 이동 정보와 같은 정보를 네임태그 모듈로 전송하는 소방 대장 단말기와, 투척 볼, 네임태그 모듈 및 소방대장 단말기를 네트워크로 양방향으로 연결하는 다수의 중계 기능을 수행하는 메쉬 네트워크로 구성된 것을 특징으로 하는 것이다
assignees: UNO SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Multi-energy complementary scheduling method and system for cascade hydropower station
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-energy complementary scheduling method and a system for a cascade hydropower station, comprising the following steps: constructing a wind, light, water and fire storage optimization scheduling model of the hybrid power station; the wind, light, water and fire storage optimization scheduling model of the hybrid power station is used for acquiring wind, light and water-based running parameters of the cascade hydropower station in a mode of the hybrid power station based on input data; constructing a wind, light, water and fire optimal scheduling model of the non-mixed power station; the wind, light, water and fire optimization scheduling model of the non-mixed power storage station is used for acquiring wind, light and water-based operation parameters of the cascade hydropower station in the non-mixed power storage station mode based on input data; comparing the wind-light water-based operation parameters in the mixed power station mode with the wind-light water-based operation parameters in the non-mixed power station mode, determining the value and the action of the mixed power station, and determining whether the mixed power station is started for electric energy scheduling according to the value and the action of the mixed power station; so as to better improve the wind and light absorbing capacity and improve the running quality and reliability of the power grid.
assignees: ENERGY STORAGE RES INSTITUTE OF SOUTHERN POWER GRID PEAK LOAD AND FREQUENCY REGULATION POWER GENERAT

title_en: Method for realizing BELLHOP underwater acoustic channel model based on NS3
abstract_en: The invention provides a BELLHOP underwater acoustic channel model realization method based on NS3, which can accurately calculate parameters required by sound field propagation calculation by using the BELLHOP model, thereby simulating a more real channel environment. The BELLHOP underwater acoustic channel model for UASNs network simulation based on NS3 breaks through the defect of channel propagation loss calculation of the original platform experience model, and provides a technical thought and implementation means for promoting the development of UASNs protocol simulation reliability; the accuracy of the sound field propagation calculation result is improved, and parameters required by sound field propagation calculation are accurately calculated by using the BELLHOP model, so that a more real channel environment can be simulated, the performance of a UASNs link layer and a routing protocol can be accurately evaluated, and a scientific basis is provided for rapidly developing and satisfying the UASNs protocols for military and civil use.
assignees: YICHANG TESTING TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Non-optimal cause tracing method, system and storage medium for sewage treatment process
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-optimal cause tracing method, a system and a storage medium for a sewage treatment process. The non-optimal cause tracing method comprises the following steps: acquiring non-optimal process data of a sewage treatment process to screen a plurality of candidate variables causing non-optimal states; sequentially selecting two candidate variables, establishing a simplified model only containing the past information of the two candidate variables and a full model containing the past information of all the candidate variables, calculating residual errors of the simplified model and the full model, constructing a Grignard index according to the residual errors, and judging whether causal relationship exists between the two candidate variables or not until causal analysis between the candidate variables is completed; constructing a network structure according to the causal analysis result to determine a route with practical process meaning in the network structure; determining a conditional probability table of variable nodes of each candidate variable based on the network structure; and acquiring input evidence of the evidence node, and updating the conditional probability table by using a sum-product belief propagation algorithm to determine non-optimal cause variables causing non-optimal states.
assignees: EAST CHINA UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Hydropower plant power generation control method considering power grid operation stability
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hydropower plant power generation control method considering the operation stability of a power grid, and belongs to the technical field of hydropower. The method includes the steps that based on historical electricity price data, a date with the highest similarity to working conditions on an operation day is identified by considering electricity price influence factors, and electricity price data on the similar day is used as a prediction training set; adopting a Gaussian process regression method to predict a probability interval, and determining a confidence interval and an interval discrete electricity price point of each time interval on the operation day; establishing an upstream hydropower station day-ahead market application and return optimization model; solving by adopting a self-adaptive particle swarm optimization algorithm; further obtaining a day-ahead market declared volume curve of the upstream hydropower station in each time period all day; then generating a downstream power station declared rating curve based on the cascade output coupling relation; and finally, performing power generation control based on the reported electric quantity. The method can prevent the water abandon of the power station, not only can save the waste of water resources, but also can ensure the safety and stability of the operation of the power grid, and is easy to popularize and apply.
assignees: KUNMING ELECTRIC POWER TRANSACTION CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Distributed computing method for collaborative perception of intelligent agent cluster situation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed computing method for collaborative awareness of an agent cluster situation. The algorithm comprises the confirmation and information propagation and cooperation methods of the information source, the dynamic construction of attribute state values which excite propagation based on the event and the type thereof, and the design of a mixed modulation process which is mutually influenced between attribute states. The essence of group situation collaborative perception is a process of dimension reduction-transmission-restoration of surrounding environment information, an individual firstly determines the source of battlefield dynamic information, screens main information, describes an emergency by using dimension reduction compression means, then carries out information transmission and cross verification through a local network structure of a cluster, and finally uses the received dimension reduction information to reevaluate and draw an information map of the individual. The algorithm of the invention is similar to the mechanism of biological hormone regulation and control and nerve information transmission, and provides a calculation method capable of carrying out dimension reduction processing on complex situation information and local cooperation of an intelligent agent under the condition of regional refusal of low communication.

title_en: Information and communication facility integrated management system and its management method
title_ko: 공동주택 건축물의 정보통신 시설 통합 관리 시스템 및 그 관리방법
abstract_en: Provided are an information and communication facility integrated management system of an apartment house building and a management method thereof, which can monitor, analyze, and manage objects to be controlled in a plurality of specific areas efficiently and effectively. The information and communication facility integrated management system includes a control server that analyzes a disaster when the disaster occurs to calculate a range on which the disaster has influence, sets a disaster information propagation region based on address information of a smart grid facility, which includes a telegraph pole, a collection device, a watt-hour meter AMI modem, and a power communication network, or a smart city facility including a streetlight, a security light, and a CCTV pole, and transmits the disaster information. For the information and communication facility integrated management system, a monitor facility installed at a field performs a handling process including installation and transfer at the field, and the monitoring of a specific area at the field.
abstract_ko: 공동주택 건축물의 정보통신 시설 통합 관리 시스템 및 그 관리방법을 제공한다. 정보통신시설 통합관리 시스템은 안전재난 발생 시 이를 분석하여 안전재난의 영향력이 미치는 범위를 계산한 후 전신주, 수집장치, 전력량계AMI 모뎀, 전력 통신네트워크를 포함하는 스마트그리드시설물 또는 가로등, 보안등, CCTV주를 포함하는 스마트 시티시설물의 주소 정보를 기반으로 안전재난 정보전파 영역을 설정하고, 안전재난 정보를 전송하는 관제서버를 포함하되, 상기 정보통신시설 통합관리 시스템은 현장에 설치되는 모니터설비에 의하여 상기 현장에서의 설치와 이송을 포함하는 취급과정 및 상기 현장에 대한 특정구역의 감시가 수행된다.
assignees: XPOWER ENG SERVICE

title_en: Coordinated multi-region power transmission maintenance method, device, computer equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power grid overhaul, in particular to a coordinated multi-region power transmission overhaul method, a coordinated multi-region power transmission overhaul device, computer equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the net load peak-valley time periods of each region, and constructing a key time period set; acquiring the output cost relation and the electric quantity standby relation of each area in the key time period set; constructing an upper maintenance plan model according to the output cost relation, the electric quantity standby relation, the tie line power and the upper constraint of each area; constructing an area maintenance plan model according to the output cost relation of each area, the power of the connecting line and the area constraint; and (3) carrying out iterative computation on the two models by adopting a target cascading algorithm based on the tie line power to obtain the power transmission maintenance plan of each region. By implementing the invention, the current cascade algorithm is adopted, and different optimization modes of two-stage scheduling are considered through two-stage coordination. Meanwhile, the calculation scale under the complex constraint of regional standby, related network safety and the like is reduced, and the calculation efficiency can meet the actual requirements of multi-region power grid dispatching.

title_en: Linkage method, device and equipment for emergency handling of overseas oil and gas pipeline accidents
abstract_en: The application provides a linkage method, device and equipment for emergency handling of accidents of overseas oil and gas pipelines, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring all mechanisms along the line corresponding to overseas oil and gas pipeline accidents and all tasks to be treated; each mechanism is expressed as a mechanism unit, each task to be treated is expressed as a task unit, and each mechanism unit and each task unit establish a mechanism emergency linkage network model; taking a preset target mechanism unit as an activation starting moment in the model, and performing activation propagation between the mechanism unit and the task unit of the mechanism emergency linkage network model according to preset execution logic; recording the activation propagation paths and sequences between each mechanism unit and each task unit when all task units enter an activation state, and calculating the accumulated sum of benefits of each propagation scheme as the propagation scheme; and determining the propagation scheme corresponding to the maximum profit accumulation sum as a target propagation scheme for emergency treatment. And the completion of all emergency treatment tasks in the shortest time is realized.
assignees: UNIV CHINA PETROLEUM BEIJING

title_en: Prediction method, system and prediction terminal for effective period of photovoltaic power generation
abstract_en: The invention provides a prediction method, a prediction system and a prediction terminal for a photovoltaic power generation effective period, which relate to the technical field of distributed new energy, and are used for collecting and acquiring data information of a distributed photovoltaic power station in a prediction area and carrying out normalization processing; establishing an undirected graph with weights to consider spatial correlation among the distributed photovoltaic power stations; determining a neighbor power station set of each power station by adopting a graph convolution neural network; adopting a back propagation neural network to process missing values and abnormal values in the system; based on the data information of the distributed photovoltaic power station in the system, performing four-rule operation to obtain the operated characteristics of the data information; and establishing a prediction model by utilizing an integrated learning strategy, and executing a prediction process on the power generation effective period based on the prediction model. The method can help energy management personnel to better predict the available time period of new energy power generation, thereby optimizing energy supply and use plans and improving energy utilization efficiency.
assignees: STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD;AOSTAR INF TECH CO LTD

title_en: Complex network-based industrial chain risk propagation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an industrial chain risk propagation method based on a complex network, which comprises the following steps: step one: the system determines the region and industry to be evaluated, and collects regional enterprise basic information data; step two: mounting an enterprise on a corresponding industry chain node, and constructing an industry chain complex network comprising the relationship between the enterprise and the enterprise, the relationship between the enterprise and the industry and the relationship between the industry and the industry; step three: acquiring an original risk value of an enterprise node while determining the original risk value of an industrial chain link point; step four: carrying out association strength calculation of risks among enterprises, enterprises and industries and industry; step five: performing risk propagation analysis; step six: according to the total calculated risk transfer value of each industrial chain, the result of the industrial risk value is evaluated, analyzed and predicted.
assignees: JIANGSU FENGYUN TECH SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Real-time forest fire spreading simulation method, fire extinguishing decision method and early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest fire spreading real-time simulation method, a fire extinguishing decision method and an early warning system. The invention provides a forest fire spreading real-time simulation method, which specifically comprises the following steps: inputting topographic data (slope direction, gradient and combustible type distribution) of a forest fire spreading simulation area, and establishing a grid network according to the topographic data; selecting the geographical position of the fire point, and calculating the coordinates of the fire point in the grid network from the position of the fire point; starting to perform spreading simulation in the grid network from the ignition point, simulating the propulsion of the fire scene range based on a shortest path algorithm and a boundary epitaxial extension method, and obtaining the ignition time of the grid network; and visually displaying according to the firing time of the grid network.
