Methods are then presented according to this propagation method to aid in direct and indirect fire extinguishing decisions, respectively. Finally, a forest fire spreading simulation and early warning system is provided based on the method, and an auxiliary decision function is provided for forest fire extinguishment.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Cable joint insulation state assessment method based on pressure wave detection
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cable joint insulation state evaluation method based on pressure wave detection, which comprises the following steps: step 1: constructing a simulation calculation model of the propagation rule of the pressure wave in the cable joint; step 2: constructing a pressure wave detection system of typical defects of the cable joint; step 3: constructing a cable joint partial discharge fault type identification model; step 4: constructing a model for identifying the partial discharge fault type of the cable joint based on the BP neural network; step 5: evaluating the insulation state of the cable joint based on a data statistics theory; the invention has the advantages of timely finding out the defects of the cable joint, no damage to the cable and high accuracy.
assignees: KAIFENG POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Wide-area tracing method, system, equipment and storage medium for broadband oscillation of power grid
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power system automation, and discloses a wide-area tracing method, system, equipment and storage medium for broadband oscillation of a power grid, which comprises the steps of obtaining oscillation characteristic quantity information of nodes of each station; the method comprises the steps of obtaining oscillation station nodes in each station node and oscillation current flowing directions of each oscillation station node according to oscillation characteristic quantity information of each station node, obtaining oscillation amplitude of each oscillation station node, obtaining oscillation propagation directions of each oscillation station node according to the oscillation amplitude of each oscillation station node and the oscillation current flowing directions of each oscillation station node, and carrying out oscillation tracing according to the oscillation propagation directions of each oscillation station node to obtain an oscillation source. The method has the advantages that the accurate analysis of the oscillation propagation path and the influence range is realized, the tracing and the accurate positioning of the oscillation source are realized, and further, powerful support is provided for the operation monitoring of the power grid and the targeted inhibition of oscillation, the operation monitoring service is strongly supported and scheduled, and the operation safety of the power grid is ensured.

title_en: Active defense method for intelligent power grid cascading failures
abstract_en: The invention discloses an active defense method for intelligent power grid cascading failures, which comprises the following steps: step 1): before disaster generation occurs, the system acquires disaster generation distribution data of the smart grid, which is affected by the smart grid; step 2): the system calculates the failure probability of the grid node or the grid element based on disaster-causing distribution data, and calculates the capacity reduction amount of the equivalent fault effect of the grid node or the element; step 3): the system predictively improves the capacity of the intelligent power grid nodes or elements according to the capacity reduction; step 4): when disaster is caused, the system acquires disaster causing data of the intelligent power grid node and judges whether the power grid node fails or not; step 5): the system executes the sequential fault defense of the power grid node or the power grid element according to the condition of whether the intelligent power grid node or the power grid element fails; the invention has the beneficial effects that: the method can effectively actively defend the cascading failure of the power grid.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Routing method applied to indoor fire-fighting communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses a routing method applied to indoor fire-fighting communication, which comprises the following steps: step 1: modeling a wireless signal propagation model under a scene to obtain related parameters; step 2: information interaction of scenes is realized through a neighbor discovery algorithm, and link duration LET is estimated; step 3: improving an intra-area routing algorithm, and constructing an intra-area routing table based on LET; step 4: the route discovery process is improved and inter-area routes are updated based on the LETs. The invention estimates the link duration by combining the indoor propagation model and the node motion state on the basis of the original ZRP, so that the node can predict the link state, thereby maximizing the route survival time. Through simulation verification, the method can reduce the end-to-end time delay, reduce the packet loss rate and improve the network throughput.
assignees: UNIV XIDIAN;SHAANXI XILU ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Artificial intelligent resource allocation method for intelligent power grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of smart power grids, in particular to a smart power grid artificial intelligence resource allocation method. The method comprises the following steps: collecting the data of the light energy power generation area equipment in charge of the intelligent power grid system, preprocessing the data, generating vectors by using different data and generating a photovoltaic system data set by using a normalization standardized formula; performing photovoltaic energy consumption calculation on the photovoltaic system data set by using a machine learning algorithm, so as to generate a photovoltaic energy consumption data set; collecting historical electricity consumption, and performing power demand analysis and calculation on the historical electricity consumption by utilizing a data prediction model combining a momentum method and a back propagation network, so as to generate a power demand value; and carrying out load balancing analysis according to the power demand value and the photovoltaic energy consumption data set, thereby generating a dynamic resource allocation adjustment scheme. The invention can improve the efficiency of resource allocation of the intelligent power grid in the new energy field.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;ELECTRIC POWER RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Thermal data analysis method based on convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of data processing, in particular to a thermal data analysis method based on a convolutional neural network. Labeling tag values of all fault categories of different reasons of each thermal data and then dividing the fault categories into a training set and a testing set; building a convolutional neural network model, inputting a training set into the convolutional neural network model for forward propagation and backward propagation to adjust parameters of the convolutional neural network model, and obtaining a trained convolutional neural network model; inputting the test set into a trained convolutional neural network model for prediction, performing forward prediction and softmax operation, taking the maximum probability value in the probability values as a final prediction value, and performing imaging on the accuracy of the test set. The invention analyzes the massive thermal data by establishing the convolutional neural network model, thereby not only realizing the supplement and early warning measures when the DCS system fails, but also carrying out further excavation on the thermal data.
assignees: Guodian changyuan hanchuan first power generation co ltd

title_en: Evaporation waveguide beyond-view-range emergency communication modeling method and system based on ray tracing
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wireless communication networks, and provides an evaporative waveguide beyond-view-range emergency communication modeling and system based on ray tracing. The method comprises calculating vertical distribution of atmospheric thermodynamic temperature, atmospheric pressure and water vapor pressure, inverting evaporating waveguide parameters to obtain distribution of refractive index in vertical direction, tracking ray track according to the distribution of refractive index in vertical direction, comparing height of each ray at horizontal distance of receiving antenna with height of receiving antenna to obtain possible intrinsic rays meeting preset condition, determining whether possible intrinsic rays are intrinsic rays, screening the intrinsic rays to find several intrinsic rays with obviously different paths as exit angle The central ray of the ray tube calculates the maximum height difference of all rays in the ray tube at the horizontal distance of the receiving antenna to obtain the vertical cross section width of the ray tube, thereby calculating the propagation factor and the path loss of each intrinsic ray.

title_en: Epidemic disease along with ship risk propagation analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for analyzing epidemic disease along with ship risk propagation, comprising the following steps: acquiring space-time data of N ships in an AIS system in a specific water area; determining the berthing time of N ships according to the space-time data of the N ships; determining ship infection risk values during N ship berthing output ports according to the berthing time; constructing an offshore route topology network according to the data information in the AIS system; determining an input port epidemic risk value according to the ship infection risk value and the offshore route topology network; determining an epidemic spreading ductility calculated value according to the input port epidemic risk value; the invention has the following beneficial effects: according to the invention, the data information in the AIS system can be utilized to form an offshore navigation topological network, and the epidemic situation and the evolution trend of the city of the output port are combined, so that the comprehensive judgment of the epidemic risk of the abdomen of the input port is realized, and the epidemic risk situation can be considered from the perspective of water transport.
assignees: UNIV JIMEI

title_en: AdaGrad-based optimization neural network power transmission network project material demand prediction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for predicting the demand of materials of a power transmission network project based on an AdaGrad (advanced-oriented-data-oriented) optimization neural network, wherein the BP neural network is divided into an input layer, a hidden layer and an output layer, when the error between an output result and an expected result does not meet the requirement, the back propagation is carried out, the network weight and a threshold value are modified layer by layer from the output layer through the error, the forward propagation is carried out by using the modified parameters, and the parameters are circulated to an optimal model parameter through the forward and the back directions, and the method is characterized in that: the method for predicting the demand of the basic building materials of the power transmission network comprises the steps of predicting the demand of the power transmission network power materials and predicting the investment amount of the project of the power transmission network. The invention improves the accuracy of the power grid material report demand plan, predicts the power grid basic building material demand by modeling by utilizing the historical data, reduces the power grid resource waste, reduces the situations of redundant backlog stock of materials caused by material multi-report, delay construction period caused by material less report and the like, and provides reference for the high-quality construction of the power grid.
assignees: JINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method, device and medium for measuring survivability of living material supply network considering cascade failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and a medium for measuring the survivability of a living material supply network considering cascade failure, wherein the method comprises the following steps: basic data of a target area are obtained, preprocessing is carried out, and grid division is carried out on the target area; the basic data comprise mobile phone signaling data, POI data, urban road data and administrative data; based on the administrative data after preprocessing, a supply-demand network is constructed according to the mobile phone signaling data and the POI data, and the service quantity of each supply point in the supply-demand network is calculated; constructing a supply network according to the service quantity of each supply point and the preprocessed urban road data; based on community toughness sorting, main supply points corresponding to low-toughness communities are found in a supply-demand network, and an attack strategy is formulated; based on the cascade failure model, the destructiveness of the service efficiency of the supply network under the attack strategy is measured. The method provides references for the urban living material supply and guarantee system and urban management under sudden heavy disasters.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: Active power distribution network reliability assessment method considering unknown network topology
abstract_en: The invention relates to an active power distribution network reliability evaluation method considering unknown network topology, and belongs to the technical field of active power distribution network reliability evaluation methods. Firstly, identifying related variables of faults, and finding a variable set affected by the faults; secondly, mining causal relations among observables affected by faults, and identifying causal relations among variables; finally, the propagation path of the fault is displayed in a graph mode. The invention provides a causal relationship inference-based fault propagation path identification method, which reveals the occurrence and propagation connotation of faults from the causal relationship angle.
assignees: YANTAI POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Knowledge graph-based illegal risk prediction method for marketing enterprises
abstract_en: The invention discloses a knowledge graph-based method for predicting illegal risks of a marketing enterprise, which comprises the steps of constructing an enterprise associated party hypergraph and a Hyper-GNN hypergraph representation learning model, and incorporating risk assimilation factors of an enterprise associated party cluster into enterprise illegal predictions; improving a graph transfer algorithm propagation mechanism, defining an illegal risk diffusion range by adopting a community division algorithm, introducing enterprise benefit association closeness and a probabilistic mechanism into a graph migration algorithm, simulating graph migration paths of simulation propagation of bad risk sources among enterprises, and accurately evaluating the illegal risk degree of suspicious enterprises by means of convergence trend after deep iteration of the graph transfer algorithm; and designing a Legal-GNN neural network, fusing enterprise risk features with enterprise associated party cluster features, enhancing the difference between sparse suspicious enterprise node features and large-scale Legal enterprise node features, weakening the feature similarity degree when nodes are embedded and represented, and improving the discrimination precision of a prediction model to illegal enterprises.
assignees: UNIV QINGDAO TECHNOLOGICAL

title_en: Resource abnormality prediction method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a resource abnormality prediction method, device and equipment, relates to the technical field of distribution, and can add popularization capability of information propagation and accumulation of higher-order risks of more than two steps of individual participants in a resource abnormality prediction process, so that accuracy of a resource abnormality prediction result is improved. The method comprises the following steps: setting a service performance process in combination with a distribution scene, and abstracting a historical distribution order into a heterogeneous graph with service meaning according to the service performance process, wherein the heterogeneous graph comprises multiparty nodes related to the service scene and different edge types formed by the nodes; describing vector characterization of multi-party nodes on different edge types in a heterogeneous graph by using a graph neural network aiming at the different edge types formed by the nodes; responding to a prediction instruction of the occurrence of the resource abnormality of the order to be distributed, and predicting the resource of the order to be distributed by utilizing vector characterization of multiparty nodes on different edge types in a heterogeneous graph with service meanings to obtain a prediction result of the occurrence of the resource abnormality of the order to be distributed.
assignees: RAJAX NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Tidal current diagram layout method and device of power supply network, medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid systems, in particular to a tidal current diagram layout method and device of a power supply network, comprising the following steps: acquiring power grid data of a power supply network area based on a power grid map model, wherein the power grid data comprises a plurality of pieces of equipment information and line connection information; clustering the plurality of device information through an improved intimacy propagation clustering algorithm to obtain a plurality of device clusters, wherein each device cluster is provided with at least one clustering center device; determining the relative positions of the equipment clusters in the areas based on the primitive division according to the geographic position information of the plurality of clustering center equipment, and laying out the plurality of equipment clusters in the areas based on a preset layout rule to obtain a plurality of tide areas; when judging that line connection exists between any two devices positioned in different tide areas according to the line connection information, controlling the two devices to be positioned in the same straight line and performing line connection. The method can improve the accuracy, intuitiveness and identification of the layout of the tidal current diagram.
assignees: XIAN XINSHI SPACE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Signed social network forward influence maximization method based on polarity reverse reachable set
abstract_en: The invention provides a signed social network forward influence maximization method based on a polarity reverse reachable set. The method specifically comprises the following steps: step 1, constructing a signed social network G according to known information; step 2, calculating the required number theta of the polarity-reversal reachable sets by using a halving guessing method according to the signed social network G and the number k of the seed nodes; step 3, regenerating theta polarity reverse reachable sets, and adding the theta polarity reverse reachable sets into the set R  +  In (a) and (b); step 4, in the set R  +  Selecting k seed groups S  *  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the Step 5, seed subset S  *  Substituting the influence propagation model for propagation so as to complete the influence maximization process. According to the method, enough polarity reverse reachable sets can be formed according to the signed social network, and seed nodes capable of maximizing forward influence are selected in the polarity reverse reachable sets, so that the maximum forward influence is formed.

title_en: Cascade water-light complementary day-ahead robust peak shaving scheduling method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of multi-energy complementary power generation, in particular to a method, a system, equipment and a medium for gradient water-light complementary day-ahead robust peak regulation and scheduling, which comprise the following steps: establishing an objective function of step water-light complementary day-ahead robust peak regulation scheduling by taking the minimum peak-valley difference of the residual load of the receiving-end power grid as an objective; establishing a day-ahead scheduling constraint condition taking hydraulic coupling into account mainly step hydropower constraint; performing uncertainty set modeling and robust equivalent transformation on the photovoltaic output, and transforming the nonlinear constraint of the step hydropower into linear constraint; constructing a mixed integer linear programming model of cascade hydropower joint optimization scheduling by using an objective function and linear constraint; and solving the planning model to obtain the day-ahead robust scheduling method of the cascade water-light complementary combined power generation system. According to the invention, uncertainty of photovoltaic output can be fully considered, peak regulation effect and photovoltaic digestion of the combined power generation system are considered, and complementary operation of step hydropower and photovoltaic is realized.

title_en: Method and apparatus for controlling selection of plmn candidates for disaster roaming
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a 5G or 6G communication system for supporting a higher data transmission rate. Embodiments herein disclose a device and methods for managing and selecting Public Land Mobile Networks (PLMNs) for disaster roaming during Minimization of Service Interruption (MINT) situations. A UE is configured for selecting one of the “list of PLMN(s) to be used in disaster condition” configured by a HPLMN/EPLMN, and “list of PLMN(s) to be used in disaster condition” configured by a VPLMN, in a disaster situation based on a UE configuration. The method discloses selection of at least one Forbidden PLMN (FPLMN) by the CE in a disaster situation, when a primary PLMN list configured by a HPLMN/EPLMN is different from at least one secondary PLMN list configured by at least one VPLMN.
assignees: SAMSUNG ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Enterprise risk prediction method and device, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an enterprise risk prediction method, an enterprise risk prediction device, electronic equipment and a medium, wherein the enterprise risk prediction method comprises the following steps: according to the acquired enterprise operation activity data, extracting main event information required by a preset enterprise for risk prediction and information of related enterprises; based on the subject event information and the information of the related enterprises, constructing a subject event sequence and generating an event network diagram; the main event sequence comprises an event chain of a preset enterprise and preset candidate events; inputting an event initial code generated by the main event sequence and an event propagation matrix generated by the event network diagram into a pre-constructed and trained risk prediction model to obtain a risk prediction result of the preset enterprise; the risk prediction model comprises a graph neural network GNN and a long-short-term memory network LSTM, and is obtained by training with the minimum edge loss function margin as a target through historical data of enterprise business activity events. The method and the device effectively improve the accuracy of enterprise risk prediction.
assignees: HUATAI SECURITIES COMPANY LTD

title_en: Three gorges reservoir dam front drift prediction method based on improved neural network model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a three gorges reservoir dam front floating quantity prediction method based on an improved neural network model, which comprises the following steps: collecting three gorges reservoir entering flow, exiting flow and dam front floating amount data and dividing training and testing sets; setting a particle swarm algorithm and improved neural network structures and parameters; training the improved neural network by using a training set, and optimizing and solving the weight and the threshold of the improved neural network by using an improved particle swarm algorithm in the training; calculating a prediction error and judging whether the prediction error is qualified or not; the trained improved neural network is used for real-time prediction of the forward drift of the three gorges reservoir dam. According to the invention, after the training process of the error counter propagation neural network is optimized and improved by utilizing the particle swarm algorithm, the improved error counter propagation neural network is used as a front drift amount prediction model of the three gorges reservoir dam, so that the connection weight of the prediction model is more approximate to an optimal ideal value, and the prediction precision of the drift amount and the adaptability to the uncertainty of the data information of the reservoir dam are improved.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CORP

title_en: Reservoir group multi-energy complementary scheduling method and system for coping with uncertainty of new energy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir group multi-energy complementary scheduling method and system for coping with uncertainty of new energy. The method comprises the steps of firstly collecting a long-sequence scene set of historical output and predicted output of new energy, generating a future actual output expected scene based on analysis of new energy output errors according to the long-sequence scene set, secondly constructing a scheduling model which is integrated with decision variables, objective functions, constraint conditions and the like of a coupling cascade hydropower station and the new energy output scene, then solving by adopting a high-performance self-adaptive population evolution algorithm according to hydropower station water regime information and the new energy output scene, quickly obtaining a multi-energy complementary scheduling scheme meeting operation requirements, and finally continuously updating a new energy historical prediction and actual output database to form a long-term and rolling multi-energy complementary scheduling scheme decision system. The method can comprehensively consider the uncertainty factor of the new energy, improve the reliability of the multi-energy complementary scheduling scheme of the cascade reservoir group, reduce the running risk of the power grid and has remarkable comprehensive benefit.

title_en: Traffic system elasticity assessment method based on multilayer complex network theory
abstract_en: The invention provides a traffic system elasticity assessment method based on a multilayer complex network theory, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: the method comprises the following steps: step 1, acquiring related data of a traffic system, abstracting the related data into a complex network model aiming at a single research object, and analyzing the topological characteristics of the network; step 2: improving the recovery process of the traditional dynamic propagation model simulation traffic network after being interfered, and exploring the dynamic propagation mechanism of faults; step 3: analyzing the fault propagation process, and exploring the relation between the system recovery probability and the elastic performance thereof and the network structure aiming at a single traffic network based on an improved model; step 4: combining interdependent complex traffic system data, constructing a mutually coupled multi-stage complex traffic network based on the multi-layer network theory by considering the directionality of links, and exploring the structural characteristics of the network; step 5: and (3) expanding a propagation model, analyzing the propagation process of faults between layers in the layer, evaluating the elasticity of the multi-layer traffic system, and determining the quantitative relation between the network characteristic index and the system elasticity performance.
assignees: UNIV BEIHANG

title_en: Three-dimensional model quantitative retrieval method and system for multi-mode underwater image
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional model quantitative retrieval method and a system for multi-mode underwater images, which comprise the steps of collecting the underwater images, inputting a graph attention network model, outputting a three-dimensional model retrieval result, wherein the graph attention network model comprises a two-dimensional image dataset and a three-dimensional model library for constructing the underwater images, an image feature extraction network and a model feature extraction network are established to obtain feature vectors of the two-dimensional images and the three-dimensional models, the feature vectors are mapped into the same high-dimensional space to establish an adjacent matrix and establish a graph structure, the self-attention mechanism and the graph attention network are utilized to obtain feature vectors after graph embedding, model parameters are updated through back propagation of a loss function, the underwater images to be detected obtain the three-dimensional model retrieval result through the trained graph attention network, and the three-dimensional model retrieval can be realized for the underwater optical images or sonar images and the occlusion graph for effective features of the existing parts of the underwater images, so that the three-dimensional model quantitative retrieval is beneficial to the application in the submarine environment detection and underwater search and rescue fields.

title_en: Wind power generation power prediction method and system based on multi-scale double space-time network area
abstract_en: The invention provides a wind power generation power prediction method and a wind power generation power prediction system based on a multi-scale double-space-time network region, which are used for eliminating the influence of high-frequency noise on wind power prediction, decoupling wind power data of different frequencies, adopting a wind power prediction strategy based on wavelet decomposition, respectively predicting future trends of obtained subcomponents after the wavelet decomposition of the historical wind power data, and summing the future trends to obtain final wind power prediction. The present invention proposes a more efficient model to learn the spatio-temporal representation. Two key space-time correlation layers are realized in the invention, including a synchronous space-time layer and an asynchronous space-time layer. Wherein the synchronous time-space layer learns the similarity between the time series of sites, and the asynchronous time-space layer learns the wind propagation between sites. In order to solve the space-time correlation deviation caused by time variation, the invention adopts a multi-scale structure. Robust representation of wind sites is achieved by learning spatiotemporal correlations over multiple scales.

title_en: Photovoltaic power prediction method based on neural network and honeypot optimization
abstract_en: The invention relates to a photovoltaic power prediction method based on neural network and honeypot optimization, and provides a photovoltaic power generation prediction model based on a badger algorithm and an enhanced counter-propagation neural network aiming at the defect that random initial weight and bias seriously affect the performance of a BP neural network. The solar irradiance per hour and the ambient temperature of the peltier cell are used as input data for the predictive model, and the historical power generation per hour (power) is used as the expected output. HBAs are introduced in the BP neural network to optimize initial weights and biases. The simulation results of various indexes show that the prediction accuracy of the HBA-BP neural network is improved to a certain extent relative to a BP prediction model.
assignees: UNIV NORTHWESTERN POLYTECHNICAL

title_en: Method for identifying damage of steel structural beam after fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of steel structure engineering, in particular to a method for identifying damage of a steel structure beam after fire disaster, which is based on self-vibration frequency measurement and a back propagation neural network technology and has the advantages of simple operation and less required detection equipment; the method comprises the steps of carrying out preliminary appearance damage identification on a steel structure through a CCD camera in combination with detection software, collecting a self-vibration main peak frequency signal of the steel structure beam after fire with uncertain appearance damage, obtaining a first characteristic value, inputting the first characteristic value into an input layer of a back propagation neural network, outputting a second characteristic value by an output layer, comparing the second characteristic value with a mathematical model M1 of the nondestructive steel structure beam, obtaining an output value X, comparing the second characteristic value with a damaged mathematical model M3, obtaining an output value Y, comparing the X with the Y, obtaining Z, judging whether the steel structure is qualified after the fire, and further determining and detecting the steel structure after the fire which is judged to be uncertain.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY NO 9 GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic prediction method for secondary domino accident of fire disaster in pressure storage tank area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic prediction method of a fire disaster secondary domino accident in a pressure storage tank area, which relates to the field of data processing systems specially used for prediction purposes, considers the influence of the fire accident of the pressure storage tank on the accident spread among adjacent storage tanks and the influence of coupling factors on the accident spread, evaluates the accident chain probability by combining a Bayesian network method, provides a determination method of the most probable accident chain and the most probable accident storage tank of the fire disaster secondary domino accident in the pressure storage tank area under the influence of time and space coupling, carries out effective risk evaluation on the pressure storage tank area, effectively controls and reduces the occurrence of the fire disaster secondary domino accident in the pressure storage tank area, has extremely important theoretical significance and application value for the prevention and control of the fire disaster domino effect in the pressure storage tank area, and provides guidance for the pressure tank area layout and the fire emergency treatment of chemical enterprises.
assignees: NANJING UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Method and device for optimizing park energy system operation based on load clustering
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for optimizing the operation of a park energy system based on load clustering, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring energy consumption data of a park user; performing cluster analysis on the energy consumption data to obtain energy requirements and typical energy consumption behaviors of park users; positioning the energy grade requirement of a user according to the energy requirement and the typical energy utilization behavior; combining a preset energy grade dividing result and the energy grade requirement to obtain a corresponding energy cascade utilization energy supply structure; and constructing an energy pipe network model according to the energy cascade utilization energy supply structure, and generating an optimized operation strategy of an energy system based on the energy pipe network model. The invention can optimize the operation of the energy system.

title_en: Hurricane path prediction method and system based on recurrent neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a hurricane path prediction method and a system based on a recurrent neural network, comprising the following steps: carrying out gridding treatment on the delimited hurricane path area; calculating the moving distance and the moving angle of each coordinate point as data enhancement; using a three-layer long-short term memory network as a main cyclic neural network of a prediction model; the main network is a long-short term memory model carrying Dropout layer with the proportionality coefficient of 0.1; the output layer is a full-connection layer activated by a hyperbolic tangent function, a gradient descent algorithm RMSProp based on momentum is used for training the model, and the training target is the square error of the predicted longitude and latitude coordinates; the output layer of the prediction model is composed of a grid ID prediction layer and a coordinate correction part to form a final hurricane coordinate prediction. In the prediction stage, the prediction only depends on the forward propagation of the model based on the recurrent neural network reasoning, and the correlation search of a historical database is not needed, so that the performance of the hurricane path prediction is greatly improved.
assignees: EAST CHINA COMPUTER TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE THE 32ND RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GR;PEOPLES LIBERATION ARMY 61540 TROOPS

title_en: Dual-branch tropical cyclone strength and scale estimation method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention designs a method and a system for estimating strength and scale of a double-branch tropical cyclone based on deep learning. The invention relates to the technical field of ocean atmosphere remote sensing image processing. The method and system comprise the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: data preprocessing and data set construction: the method is used for the task of double-branch tropical cyclone strength and scale estimation, data are derived from a HURSAT public data set, infrared and microwave remote sensing images are adopted, and tropical cyclone strength and wind radius are collected. Step two: tropical cyclone strength and scale estimation encoder module: and extracting high-level features on the strength and scale of the tropical cyclone by using a convolutional neural network and an attention mechanism according to the input tropical cyclone remote sensing images of the infrared and microwave channels. Step three: a tropical cyclone strength and scale estimation dual-branch decoder module: the two-branch decoder module is composed of two different branches, one branch is used for estimating the strength of the tropical cyclone, and the other branch is used for estimating the radius of the tropical cyclone. Step four: and combining the two modules in the second step and the third step, and jointly forming an algorithm part of the deep learning-based dual-branch tropical cyclone strength and scale estimation system based on a back propagation principle. And deploying the trained model and system at the cloud end by using the relevant knowledge of software engineering to form a final system.
assignees: UNIV CHINA PETROLEUM EAST CHINA

title_en: Photovoltaic panel fault identification method based on cascade region convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a photovoltaic panel fault identification method based on a cascade area convolutional neural network, which is used for collecting images of photovoltaic panels of a photovoltaic engineering village level and a household level distributed power station; classifying the collected images, and carrying out fault and defect label processing on various images; the images of the photovoltaic panels are in one-to-one correspondence with fault and defect labels, and are divided into a training set and a verification set; taking images of village-level and user-level distributed power station photovoltaic panels as input of a cascade area convolution neural network, and taking corresponding fault and defect labels as output of the cascade area convolution neural network to obtain a trained cascade area convolution neural network model; checking whether the trained cascade region convolutional neural network model meets the requirements or not through a verification set; the defect fault identification is carried out on the data image acquired in real time through the trained cascade region convolution neural network model, the photovoltaic panel image can be automatically identified, the fault type of the photovoltaic panel can be judged, and the fault region can be marked.
assignees: LIAOYANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Forest fire detection method based on cascade network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a forest fire detection method based on a cascade network, which is characterized in that a smoke flame detection network comprising a global feature extraction network and a local feature extraction network is designed by an MC-YOLOv5s structure, forest fire local images and suspicious mist local images are detected aiming at forest shooting images, primary forest fire detection is realized, and according to the conditions that the forest fire local images do not exist and the suspicious mist local images exist, the preset meteorological element values of a forest area when the suspicious mist local images are shot are combined, a smoke classification network of an SCN structure design is further applied, classification analysis is carried out aiming at the suspicious mist local images, and secondary forest fire detection is realized by distinguishing smoke or mist, so that forest fire false alarm phenomena are effectively avoided, and forest fire detection precision is improved.
assignees: UNIV NANJING INFORMATION SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Optimized operation and bundling and delivery method for watershed cascade water-light complementary power station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a watershed cascade water-light complementary power station optimizing operation and bundling and delivering method, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: establishing a water-light complementary peak regulation model, establishing a peak regulation objective function and a peak regulation constraint condition of the optimized operation of the water-light complementary power station, and obtaining the water-light complementary peak regulation model with the maximum peak regulation benefit; obtaining the daily power generation load of the cascade hydropower station group through the water-light complementary peak regulation model with the maximum peak regulation benefit; establishing an optimized operation model of the river basin cascade hydropower station; the method has the advantages that the running scheme of each power station is obtained by solving the hydropower station optimizing running model by combining the power station objective function and the power station constraint condition with the daily power generation load of the cascade hydropower station group through a particle swarm algorithm, the defect that the output has fluctuation, randomness and indirection when the photovoltaic power station generates electricity can be effectively overcome, the regulating performance is better, the photovoltaic light rejection rate can be effectively reduced, and the capacity of the power grid for absorbing the photovoltaic electric power is improved.
assignees: SOUTHWEST ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD CHINA POWER ENG CONSULTING GROUP

title_en: Residential electricity risk assessment method based on large-scale power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a residential electricity risk assessment method based on a large-scale power distribution network, and relates to the field of fusion application of power system analysis and risk assessment theory. 1. Establishing a power system partitioning method aiming at avoiding cascading failures, and determining a partitioning range of a power distribution system; 2. the concept of the claim-free electric quantity risk index is provided, and even if cascading failures occur, the comprehensive loss of a user can be minimized; 3. aiming at inherent diffusion properties of cascading failures, a risk economic index evaluation method of the power system is provided, wherein the risk economic index evaluation method is used for taking risks into account. When a power failure fault occurs, the power grid is partitioned according to the topological structure of the power grid, so that the number of connecting lines among the areas is reduced, and the diffusion path of cascading faults is reduced; the concept of the electric quantity free of claim is put forward, and the comprehensive loss of resident users is reduced; providing a state screening method based on a random matrix, and screening out fault states with the power outage quantity larger than the claim-free electric quantity according to the similarity of the states; the rationality of loss assessment is improved.
assignees: UNIV TAIYUAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Typhoon time sequence knowledge graph construction method and terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a terminal for constructing a typhoon time sequence knowledge graph, which are characterized in that a trained cascade neural network model is used for carrying out joint extraction of entities and relations on typhoon text data to be constructed, time sequence triples corresponding to the typhoon text data to be constructed are obtained, and the typhoon time sequence knowledge graph is constructed according to the time sequence triples.

title_en: Methods and systems for streaming buffer numerical propagation
title_ko: 버퍼 수치 전파를 스트리밍하기 위한 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: Systems, methods, and instructions of computer-readable media may include obtaining, at a client machine, a user-selected configuration parameter for an orbit simulation; sending, from the client machine to a remote system, via a network connection, a first set of configuration parameters for the orbit simulation, wherein the first set of configuration parameters comprise the user-selected configuration parameter; receiving, at the client device from the remove device, via the network connection, a stream of orbital data comprising points along an orbit, wherein the points along the orbit are determined by the remote system based on the first set of configuration parameters; and presenting, at a display, a dynamic rendering of the orbit simulation, wherein the orbit simulation is based on the stream of orbital data.
abstract_ko: 시스템, 방법 및 컴퓨터 판독 가능 매체의 명령어는 클라이언트 머신에서, 궤도 시뮬레이션을 위한 사용자 선택 구성 매개변수를 획득하는 단계; 네트워크 연결을 통해, 클라이언트 머신으로부터 원격 시스템에 궤도 시뮬레이션을 위한 제1 구성 매개변수 세트를 전송하는 단계 - 여기서 제1 구성 매개변수 세트는 사용자 선택 구성 매개변수를 포함함 - ; 네트워크 연결을 통해, 클라이언트 장치에서 원격 디바이스로부터 궤도를 따르는 포인트를 포함하는 궤도 데이터 스트림을 수신하는 단계 - 여기서 궤도를 따르는 포인트는 제1 구성 매개변수 세트에 기초하여 원격 시스템에 의해 결정됨 - ; 및 디스플레이에서, 궤도 시뮬레이션의 동적 렌더링을 표시하는 단계 - 여기서 궤도 시뮬레이션은 궤도 데이터 스트림에 기초함 - 를 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: SLINGSHOT AEROSPACE INC;MARCHAND BELINDA GRACE;LEDERMAN JOSHUA;KOENIG DANIEL;JONDROW MATTHEW

title_en: Method for simulating infection in urban resident office commuting under epidemic normalization
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for simulating infection in urban resident office commuting under epidemic normalization, which comprises the following steps of collecting traffic data: constructing a complex city commuting network by using a network node module and a connecting line setting module; setting infection rules among the environment, community nodes and resident individuals by using a network infection propagation module; inputting the acquired traffic data into the complex city commuting network, and performing simulation prediction on the intelligent office scheme under epidemic normalization; and visualizing a chart of the result of the simulation prediction. The invention provides a method for simulating infection in urban resident office commuting under epidemic disease normality, an urban complex commuting network is constructed based on real flow data, and network node design can better restore the process of resident attendance and further better support the simulation prediction of intelligent office schemes under multiple scenes.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING UNION

title_en: Offshore wind power and soft and straight cooperative black start optimization method based on target cascade analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a target cascade analysis method based offshore wind power and flexible-direct cooperative black start optimization method, which comprises the following steps: establishing a black start optimization model of the offshore wind power transmission network and the flexible direct system transmission network; establishing an optimization model of the problem of the offshore wind power black promoter; establishing a problem optimization model of the soft and straight end black promoter; solving an optimization model of the offshore wind power black promoter problem and an optimization model of the soft and straight black promoter problem by adopting mixed integer quadratic programming; when a power failure accident is monitored, the problem of the black promoter is solved by the cooperation of the offshore wind power end and the flexible straight end. The invention comprehensively considers the coupling relationship between the onshore alternating current system and the offshore wind power plant, fully utilizes the power prediction information of the offshore wind power, can effectively improve the efficiency of the system for recovering to be normal through the black start process, can independently make decisions of all elements and is proved by strict convergence, the offshore wind power end and the onshore flexible straight end can realize parallel optimization, and the efficiency and the effectiveness of the black start are improved.
assignees: JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for quantitatively analyzing propagation characteristics of oscillation in MMC
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flexible direct current transmission, in particular to a method, a device, equipment and a medium for quantitatively analyzing propagation characteristics of oscillation in MMC, which comprise the following steps: describing multi-harmonic characteristics of MMC bridge arm voltage and current by utilizing Fourier decomposition and Euler formulas; according to the characteristics of multiple harmonics, linearizing the multiple harmonics through Toeplitz steady-state matrixes and vectors, and establishing a main circuit small signal model of the MMC in a frequency domain; according to the application scene of the MMC, a small signal model of the MMC control circuit in the frequency domain is established; and according to the main circuit small signal model and the control circuit small signal model, establishing a relation between MMC bridge arm current disturbance and alternating current-direct current port voltage disturbance through elimination, and establishing a three-dimensional oscillation propagation matrix. According to the invention, the propagation characteristics of oscillation between the alternating current side and the direct current side of the MMC can be accurately quantified. The topology and parameters of the AC/DC side power grid are not limited in the modeling process, namely, the AC/DC power grid connected by the model is a black box, so that the model has good expansibility and applicability.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: HEPA filter with flameproof function
title_ko: 방염 기능을 가지는 헤파 필터
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present invention is a HEPA filter having a flameproof function. The present invention consists of a flameproof material and/or antibacterial material in a HEPA filter applied to products such as air conditioners, air purifiers, and conditioning equipment. Accordingly, in the event of a fire from a product installed in public transportation or a multi-use facility, the flame is prevented from spreading through the HEPA filter. The present invention also effectively removes viruses in closed indoor spaces of public transportation or multi-use facilities where products with HEPA filters are installed. Therefore, the present invention prevents contamination of closed indoor spaces, prevents damage caused by virus transmission between people, and ensures the safety of use of public transportation and multi-use facilities.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 방염 기능을 가지는 헤파 필터를 개시한다. 이러한 본 발명은 에어컨, 공기청정기, 공조기 등의 제품에 적용되는 헤파 필터에 방염성 소재 및/또는 항균성 소재를 구성한 것이고, 이에 따라 대중교통수단이나 다중이용시설에 설치되는 제품으로부터 화재 발생시 헤파 필터를 통해 화염이 확산되는 것을 방지함은 물론, 헤파 필터를 적용한 제품이 설치되는 대중교통수단이나 다중이용시설의 밀폐된 실내공간에서 바이러스를 효과적으로 제거하여, 밀폐된 실내 공간이 오염되는 것을 방지하고, 사람들간 바이러스 전파로 인한 피해를 방지하면서 대중교통수단이나 다중이용시설에 대한 이용 안정성을 확보하는 것이다.
assignees: PRISCHE CO LTD;PENJIN CORP;JEONG YONG HWAN

title_en: Digital twin layered modeling method for evolution of Natech event of oil and gas major infrastructure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin layering modeling method for evolution of a Natech event of an oil and gas major infrastructure, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: step 1: the method comprises the steps of carrying out scene demand analysis, wherein modeling demands are real-time analysis and prediction on different links of equipment domino effect evolution, probability and accident results thereof in a Natech event scene caused by natural disasters of an oil gas storage major infrastructure; step 2: agent-based scene multi-scale multi-dimensional decomposition; step 3: modeling based on unit attribute and state twinning of multi-source data mechanism fusion; step 4: demand-oriented visualization and interaction. The accident scene is mirrored virtually, a Natech accident twinning scene of an oil gas storage and transportation major infrastructure is constructed, the probability and the accident result of accidents of each unit under multi-disaster coupling can be conveniently analyzed, domino accident risk assessment under multi-disaster coupling is conveniently carried out, daily risk assessment and accident emergency decision are guided, and the power assisting is reduced.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: Electric power system toughness assessment method and system considering incremental power distribution network support
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating toughness of a power system considering incremental power distribution network support, which relate to the technical field of power systems and comprise the following steps: receiving an IEEE standard node data set, and performing Gaussian sampling near a standard node load of the IEEE standard node data set to generate a node load sample set; receiving power grid related data, inputting the power grid related data into a pre-established cascading failure simulation model added with time sampling to obtain cut load quantity, load recovery quantity and accident chain data, and calculating to obtain toughness indexes by using the cut load quantity, the load recovery quantity and the accident chain data; inputting the obtained node load sample set and the toughness index into a pre-established BP neural network model to obtain a power system toughness evaluation result.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD LIANYUNGANG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Annual planned electric quantity curve decomposition method for cascade hydropower station group
abstract_en: A method for decomposing annual planned electric quantity curves of a cascade hydropower station group comprises the following steps: step one: taking the differentiated load regulation requirements of a plurality of receiving end power grids into consideration, and constructing a peak regulation criterion model of electric quantity curve decomposition; step two: determining a typical load curve of each receiving-end power grid in a peak shaving criterion model; step three: using the large M method, a 0-1 variable b is introduced  sc,d,k,m  Large number M, two continuous variables x  sc,d,k,m  、o  sc,d,k,m  At this time, the mathematical description of the positive and negative deviation can be abstracted into a general rule of the power market performance problem, and then a mixed integer programming model is adopted for solving. The method can obtain reasonable annual month-by-month electric quantity decomposition curves of multiple power grids of the cascade hydropower stationAnd the differential peak shaving requirements of different receiving end power grids can be effectively responded, and the differential load response capability of the cascade hydroelectric system to the receiving end power grids is improved.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Reinforced learning-based power distribution network reconstruction optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network reconstruction optimization method based on reinforcement learning, wherein the training stage of the model provided by the invention adopts forward propagation of a deep mental network to predict Q value, a greedy algorithm is used for selecting actions, when the actions pass through a training environment, a deep reinforcement learning agent obtains rewards (or punishments) according to the performances of the actions, a target Q value is obtained according to reward calculation, a mean square error is adopted as a loss function, errors are propagated reversely to update DNN weight, and finally a trained DRL agent is used for finding out an optimal power distribution network structure. The model based on Q learning is used for improving the reliability of a power distribution network system. DNR can optimize the existing resources through the model provided by the invention, and reconstruct the configuration of the power distribution network through changing the states of the sectionalizing and interconnecting switches, so as to ensure the power supply reliability of the power distribution network.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Engine system safety analysis method and system and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an engine system safety analysis method, an engine system safety analysis system and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of system safety analysis. The invention constructs the finite state machine network model to describe the transfer characteristic of the functional state of the engine system and the propagation rule of the system failure more clearly and accurately. Three main security analysis factors can be accurately determined based on a system state transition network, so that potential risks of the initial state of the system can be identified as early as possible by determining the security risks in the actual application process; by excavating a critical path of system failure propagation, risk prevention and control are facilitated in advance, and large-scale diffusion of system failure is prevented; the fault tree is generated, so that the reasons and rules of the occurrence of the risk event can be diagnosed in a targeted way towards the system safety requirement, and the problems that the subjective factors are strong or the influence caused by poor interaction among the states of the components is difficult to capture in the existing safety analysis method can be solved, and the safety boundary of the engine system is accurately determined.
assignees: UNIV BEIHANG

title_en: Terminal mobility management method and device using nas
title_ko: Nas를 활용한 단말 이동성 관리 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a 5G or 6G communication system for supporting higher data transmission rates. The present disclosure may provide a device and method for managing the mobility of a terminal in a wireless communication system. Disclosed is a method for selecting a PLMN or SNPN, in a process of confirming service disruption of a first communication provider communication network and utilizing service of a second communication provider communication network, on the basis of capability information about the ability of a terminal in a wireless communication system to utilize a communication network of a provider that the terminal is not subscribed to in a disaster situation.
abstract_ko: 본 개시는 보다 높은 데이터 전송률을 지원하기 위한 5G 또는 6G 통신 시스템에 관련된 것이다. 본 개시는 무선 통신 시스템에서 단말의 이동성을 관리하기 위한 장치 및 방법을 제공할 수 있다. 본 발명은 무선 통신 시스템에서 단말이 재난 상황에서 가입되지 않은 사업자의 통신망을 활용하는 능력에 대한 캐퍼빌리티(capability) 정보를 기초로, 제1 통신 사업자 통신망의 서비스 중단을 확인하고 제2 통신 사업자 통신망의 서비스를 활용하는 과정에 있어, PLMN 또는 SNPN을 선택하는 방법을 개시한다.
assignees: SAMSUNG ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Novel rapid dynamic thermal simulation method based on discrete event simulation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of heat supply pipe network dynamic simulation, and discloses a novel rapid dynamic thermal simulation method based on discrete event simulation, which is used for simulating a heat supply pipe network by considering heat loss and time lag of water in pipes, accurately and rapidly calculating heat propagation of each pipe, and playing a key role in planning and optimizing a pipe network system. The discrete event simulation is applied to the simulation of the regional heating network for the first time, can effectively and accurately process the changed inlet temperature and flow, and is also applicable to the working condition of zero flow. The variable space-time discretization is automatically determined by input data, and the numerical value diffusion of transmission delay and temperature is not considered during calculation, so that the rapid calculation of heat loss and temperature drop can be rapidly calculated. The model is efficient and flexible, achieves unprecedented efficiency on the premise of ensuring precision, and is suitable for various large-scale dendritic and annular pipe networks. The pipeline model can be used for fast dynamic thermal simulation of a variable-time and variable-space step large-scale central heating pipe network.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN TECH

title_en: Clustering parallel communication method for underwater sensor network
abstract_en: The application discloses an underwater sensor network clustering parallel communication method based on repeated calculation and improved K-means clustering, which aims at the defects that the underwater energy propagation model and the cluster head node broadcasting parallel transmission time slot allocation information are not considered in the current underwater LEACH protocol based on the K-means clustering, so that the self energy consumption is increased and the network communication speed is influenced, and the application proposes that the underwater energy propagation model is adopted in the K-means clustering to optimize the clustering quantity, and the cluster head node and the network clustering are determined according to the underwater energy propagation model; meanwhile, each node obtains own parallel transmission time slot by repeatedly calculating, namely independently running the same determining algorithm at the same time, and cluster head nodes are not required to broadcast parallel transmission time slot allocation information, so that the energy consumption of a network is reduced, and the service life of the network is prolonged. The application can be applied to the underwater sensor network of the network structure such as underwater ecological monitoring, early warning detection, disaster monitoring and the like.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: Wind power generation power prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power generation power prediction method and system, and relates to the technical field of new energy power generation control. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring wind turbine generator set information, wind condition information and topographic information; constructing a wind speed model based on a back propagation neural network and predicting to obtain a primary wind speed prediction result; determining the coordinate and relative position relation of the wind turbine generator according to the topographic information, and determining the wake flow superposition condition; correcting the primary wind speed prediction result and reconstructing a wind speed model; carrying out wind speed prediction by using the reconstructed wind speed model to obtain a final wind speed prediction result; and predicting wind power generation power through a wind power prediction model according to the final wind speed prediction result. The method solves the problem that wind power generation power prediction is inaccurate because wind speed is difficult to accurately calculate due to the characteristics of complex and changeable topography, frequent wind speed and direction changes, high turbulence intensity and the like in low wind speed areas.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY WENSHANG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY;JINING POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Method for minimizing negative information influence under basic social grid treatment
abstract_en: The invention designs a method for minimizing negative information influence under basic social grid treatment, belonging to the technical field of rumor inhibition; the multi-label state variable linear threshold propagation model is designed, the information propagation process is simulated, the information propagation process when multiple types of nodes coexist can be simulated, and the multi-label state variable linear threshold propagation model has good expansibility and compatibility; in addition, the competition strategy and the blocking strategy are combined together to form a strategy set, and the execution cost of different strategies in the strategy set is different; selecting a seed subset and determining a rumor inhibition scheme according to the current propagation condition, the given budget and the strategy execution cost factors; and a multi-turn multi-label algorithm is provided to explore the performance problem of the rumor inhibition method under the limit of cost; the method can be applied to a large-scale network, and the optimal rumor inhibition strategy is adaptively selected under various cost budget conditions, so that the aim of finally believing the minimum rumor number is fulfilled.
assignees: UNIV NORTHEASTERN

title_en: Proppant laying form prediction method and system based on cascade neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a proppant laying form prediction method and system based on a cascade neural network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: (1) Adopting a numerical simulation method to establish a crack grid model with the same experimental test scale, and calculating relevant parameters of proppant migration; (2) Grid node data of the vertical slit width section is obtained through calculation according to the slit grid model, and uniform grid surface data is obtained through an interpolation method; (3) Dividing the data obtained after interpolation in the step (2) into a training sample and a test sample, and constructing a cascade neural network model, (4) optimizing the grid size of the crack grid model, and adjusting the neural network parameters and hidden layer node numbers of the cascade neural network model until the error requirement is met; (5) And predicting the proppant laying morphology by using the cascade neural network model. The invention realizes the whole form and dynamic change prediction of the sand dike based on data driving and has the advantages of small error and high calculation efficiency.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST PETROLEUM

title_en: Critical infrastructure blueprint selection for optimized response to state changing conditions
abstract_en: Critical infrastructure (CI) blueprint selection for optimized response to state changing conditions includes defining a hierarchy of interdependent CI elements of a community in a digital twin and receiving characterization data for different nodes of the digital twin. A fingerprint is generated for the hierarchy based upon the characterization and a blueprint which corresponds to the fingerprint retrieved from a data store, the blueprint defining a set of parameters to be applied to different computing elements of different nodes in the hierarchy determined to minimize a cascading effect of a state changing condition in one of the nodes. Finally, the set of parameters of the retrieved blueprint is applied to corresponding computing elements of the digital twin and a state changing condition is simulated in the digital twin in a selected node so as to compute the cascading effect of the state changing condition to other nodes dependent upon the selected node.
assignees: Inlecom Group BV

title_en: Mountain landslide detection method and device based on multi-mode data fusion perception
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain landslide detection method based on multi-mode data fusion perception in the technical field of remote sensing information processing, which uses a cascade multi-layer perceptron network and aims to solve the problems that the existing mountain landslide detection method based on remote sensing data cannot realize accurate and rapid prediction in a non-observation area due to limited observation data types and neglected structure information of neighbor grids by an existing algorithm. The method comprises the following steps: rasterizing registration and splicing are carried out on the multi-mode data of the observation area based on ArcGIS software, so that a raster attribute diagram of the multi-mode data of the observation area is obtained; building and training a cascade multi-layer perceptron network: the first-level network is based on a grid attribute diagram of multi-mode data, multi-mode data feature extraction and feature integration are achieved through superposition of multi-layer perceptrons, and the second-level network is based on the integrated features output by the first-level network, and prediction of whether landslide occurs in an observation area is achieved through the multi-layer perceptrons.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Blasting parameter determining method based on 3D printing jointed rock
abstract_en: The application provides a blasting parameter determining method based on 3D printing jointed rock, which comprises the following steps: acquiring on-site surrounding rock joint characteristic information according to geological survey; generating different joint densities based on Monte-Carlo method according to surrounding rock joint characteristic informationThe three-dimensional discrete joint fracture network model is used for obtaining a joint fracture rock digital model containing a joint fracture network by using three-dimensional modeling software; based on the digital model of the joint fracture rock, manufacturing discrete fracture rock with different joint densities; developing an SHPB test to explore the influence rule of the joint density on the dynamic strength of the discrete fracture rock, and obtaining a relation between the joint correction coefficient and the joint density; determining radial sigma at a remote explosion source r based on stress wave propagation theory and rock stress wave attenuation law  r  And tangential stress sigma  θ  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the And calculating the radius of the blasting crack area according to the tangential stress condition at the distance r from the blasting source and the joint correction coefficient, and determining the blasthole distance according to the stress wave and blasting gas combined action theory.
assignees: HUNAN ROAD & BRIDGE CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD;UNIV CENTRAL SOUTH

title_en: Natural language processing method suitable for power dispatching
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power dispatching, and discloses a natural language processing method suitable for power dispatching, which comprises the following steps: collecting data of a power generation unit to generate a feature vector of the power generation unit; constructing a knowledge graph based on the circuit layout, inputting a first neural network, outputting grid-connected point voltage at the next time point, generating a loss value, back-propagating an updated parameter feature vector, and then re-inputting the updated parameter feature vector into a fourth hidden layer; the invention generates the reactive power scheduling parameter for each power generation unit by a deep learning method, and can utilize the reactive power generated by the power generation unit to adjust the power balance of the power generation system.

title_en: Circuit line risk value determination method, device, computer equipment and medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method, apparatus, computer device and medium for determining risk value of a circuit line, including: performing cascading failure simulation on the power system based on a preset initial random failure to obtain a simulation failure chain, wherein the cascading failure simulation is used for performing simulation processing on system operation of the power system after the initial random failure is triggered; performing fault forward on the simulation fault chain to obtain a fault network set sequence, wherein the fault network set sequence comprises a plurality of fault network sets, each fault network set corresponds to a circuit line, and the circuit lines are used for describing lines generating faults; determining an optimal load shedding of the set of faulty networks based on the operating parameters of the power system; and determining the target risk value of the circuit line corresponding to the fault network set based on the optimal load reduction of the fault network set. Therefore, the evaluation efficiency of the risk value is effectively improved by measuring and counting the influence of cascading failure propagation on the circuit line.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST EAST INNER MONGOLIA ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Electrical appliance demand response potential prediction method and device based on C-LSTM
abstract_en: A C-LSTM-based electrical appliance demand response potential prediction method and device are provided, wherein historical load data of an electrical appliance are collected as a data set; constructing a C-LSTM network model for improving the long and short memory network, and inputting a data set into the C-LSTM network model for training to obtain a training model; wherein the C-LSTM network model is based on the improvement of the LSTM network model, the neuron structure of the LSTM network model is improved to obtain the C-LSTM network model, and C is the same as that of the neuron structure of the LSTM network model  t‑1  Introduction of forgetting door F  t  Input gate I  t  Output gate Q  t  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the Carrying out demand prediction of the electric appliance by adopting a training model to obtain demand response potential of the electric appliance, namely obtaining electric appliance load prediction; the C-LSTM network model can better capture the ultra-long-term trend of the electric quantity time sequence through forward calculation and backward propagation along time, so that the prediction model has higher prediction precision.
assignees: QINGDAO POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY METERING CENTER;BEIJING ZHIZHONG ENERGY TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;SHANDONG LURUAN DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Method for establishing network information propagation model in multi-data propagation environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of network information propagation models, and discloses a method for establishing a network information propagation model in a multi-data propagation environment, which comprises the following steps: s1, constructing a network information propagation model in a multi-data transmission environment; s2, simplifying a network information propagation model in the multi-data transmission environment to obtain a simplified network information propagation model in the multi-data transmission environment; s3, acquiring the basic regeneration number of a network information propagation model in a simplified multi-data propagation environment; s4, carrying out numerical simulation on a network information propagation model in a multi-data transmission environment, analyzing group types and state conversion relations in the data interaction propagation process, establishing a network information propagation system in the multi-data transmission environment, giving out a dynamic equation, and calculating to obtain a balance point of the model, so that the network information propagation model constructed on the basis of data interaction propagation is more in line with the actual propagation situation.
assignees: UNIV GUANGZHOU

title_en: Electric vehicle charging guiding method considering random path behaviors
