abstract_en: The invention provides an electric vehicle charging guiding method considering random path behaviors, which comprises the steps of constructing a multi-type user path selection model and obtaining user travel path selection probability; based on an improved random user balancing principle, a semi-dynamic traffic flow distribution model considering the random path behavior of the user is constructed; constructing an optimal power flow model of the power distribution network considering slow charge load response; based on a target cascade analysis method, a traffic network and power distribution network distributed collaborative optimization model is constructed, and a multi-type user travel path and an electric vehicle user charging strategy are planned. According to the invention, the traffic network and the power distribution network are respectively subjected to layered optimization, different charging guiding strategies are formulated according to the charging demand difference of the electric vehicle, the user path decision randomness and the slow charging load response are considered, the charging demand of the electric vehicle is met, the safe operation of the power distribution network is ensured, and the traffic jam is effectively relieved.
assignees: NANJING INST TECH

title_en: Wireless communication auxiliary equipment system transmitting disaster broadcasting using building terminal box or household terminal box of the transmission line equipment in broadcast joint reception facility, and remote equipment therefor
title_ko: 방송 공동수신설비에서 전송선로설비의 동 단자함 또는 세대 단자함을 이용하여 재난방송을 송출하는 무선통신보조설비 시스템과, 그를 위한 리모트 장비
abstract_ko: 본 고안은 전송선로설비의 동 단자함 또는 세대 단자함을 이용하여 재난방송을 송출하는 무선통신보조설비 시스템과,그를 위한 리모트장비에 관한 것으로서, 그 무선통신보조설비 시스템은,무선통신 보조설비 시스템을 전반적으로 제어하고, 중앙통제실의 무선통신기기(관제실무전기)로부터 소방무선신호를 수신하여 필터링, 증폭 및 신호레벨을 조정하여 소방신호를 출력하는 메인장비(MU);건물의 전파의 도달이 원활하지 않는 지하층 및 고층에 설치되어 있고, 건물의 지하층 또는 지상층에 있는 무선통신기기(대원무전기)와 메인장비와 통신하는 복수의 리모트장비(RUs); 및 메인장비로부터 소방신호를 수신하여 복수의 리모트 장비로 소방신호를 분배하고, 복수의 리모트 장비로부터 소방신호를 수신하여 메인장비로 전송하는 적어도 하나의 분배기를 포함하고, 그 리모트 장비는 메인장비로부터 소방무선신호를 분배기를 통해 수신하여 무선통신기기(대원무전기)로 전송하고, 무선통신기기(대원무전기)부터 소방무선신호를 수신하여 분배기를 거쳐 메인장비로 전송하는 소방무선신호부; 및 방송공동수신설비로부터 재난방송 신호를 수신하여 출력하는 재난방송부를 포함한다.

title_en: Power data price determining method and device based on neural network and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a power data price determining method, a device and a storage medium based on a neural network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a value evaluation index of the power data to be processed; inputting a value evaluation index of the power data to be processed into a power data price determining model to obtain the price of the power data to be processed; wherein the power data price determination model is obtained based on the steps of: initializing parameters of a Back Propagation (BP) neural network model based on a value evaluation index of sample power data; optimizing a BP neural network model by using SSA; and determining a power data price determining model based on the optimized BP neural network model. According to the power data price determining method, device and storage medium based on the neural network, the power data price determining model is designed based on the BP neural network optimized by SSA, accuracy of pricing the power data is improved, and power data resource waste is reduced.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING POSTS & TELECOMM;STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO;ECONOMIC TECH INSTITUTE STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Explosion-proof wireless emergency communication method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses an explosion-proof wireless emergency communication method and system, and relates to the field of emergency communication positioning. The method comprises the following steps: the control end sends an initialization instruction with unique emission frequency to the emergency communication device, and after each time of sending the initialization instruction, the control end receives the registration instructions returned by a plurality of emergency communication devices; the control end selects the transmitting frequency corresponding to the initialization instruction with the largest number of the register of the emergency communication device and the smallest register delay as the system transmitting frequency; and setting the wireless transmission frequency of all the network devices as the system transmission frequency. According to the method, the system transmitting frequency with the strongest signal penetrability can be found according to different environments to carry out networking by the self-developed transmitting frequency determining mode, so that positioning data under the disaster condition can be uploaded through high penetrability wireless signal cascade. When in post-disaster emergency rescue, the application scene range can be obviously enlarged, the reliability of signal transmission is greatly improved, and the communication quality is higher.

title_en: Distribution network direct impact Lei Zhixin degree calculation method based on lightning positioning system data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network direct attack Lei Zhixin degree calculation method based on lightning positioning system data, which comprises the following steps: s1: determining lightning strike data to be used for analysis and determining an error magnitude of the data; s2: determining a direct impact exposure distance of the distribution network line by selecting an electrical geometry model or a lead propagation model based on whether the equipment is provided with a lightning conductor or not; s3: calculating the direct impact Lei Nailei level of the distribution network line through ATP-EMTP software simulation; s4: and calculating the direct impact Lei Zhixin degrees of the distribution network lines. The invention provides a concept of direct impact Lei Zhixin degrees, wherein the confidence degree is the reliability, the direct impact confidence degree is the reliability of the distribution network line flashover fault caused by the lightning strike of the line monitored by a lightning positioning system, and the higher the direct impact Lei Zhixin degrees of a certain lightning strike, the higher the possibility of the line lightning strike fault caused by the lightning strike is, so that effective guidance is provided for the distribution network fault identification.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Extreme precipitation event analysis method and system for observation site data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydrologic water resource analysis, and provides an extreme precipitation event analysis method and system for observation site data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring daily precipitation data and precipitation occurrence time of each site; screening according to the daily precipitation data to obtain an extreme precipitation event; judging whether the extreme precipitation events are synchronous or not according to whether the delay between the extreme precipitation events occurring at any two stations exceeds a preset delay threshold value or not; and for the extreme precipitation events judged to be synchronous, quantifying the overall space-time connection of the corresponding extreme precipitation events based on the synchronous intensity of the events, characterizing the overall propagation direction of the extreme precipitation events based on the obvious delay intensity, carrying out the significance test on the synchronization of the extreme precipitation events to obtain a obvious synchronous intensity matrix and a obvious delay intensity matrix which pass the significance test, forming an undirected network and a directed network of the extreme precipitation events, and outputting the undirected network and the directed network as an analysis result of the extreme precipitation events.
assignees: UNIV ZHONGSHAN

title_en: Scheduling method, device, equipment and medium of water-wind-storage complementary power generation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid dispatching and discloses a dispatching method, a device, equipment and a medium of a water-wind-storage complementary power generation system, wherein the method is used for constructing a target optimization model by taking the minimum system operation cost and the maximum system stable operation index as targets; constructing constraint based on power balance constraint, generator set output constraint, reactive power constraint, regional load constraint, node voltage constraint and cascade hydropower station constraint of the generator set; solving the target optimization model to obtain an optimal solution conforming to constraint conditions; forming a scheduling scheme based on the optimal solution to complete power scheduling according to the scheduling scheme; therefore, a group of optimal solutions which can ensure the stable operation of the system and enable the operation cost of the system to be the lowest are obtained, and further, a scheduling scheme can be formed according to the optimal solutions to finish the scheduling work of the power.

title_en: Water, fire and wind combined dispatching model building method containing river basin step hydropower
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for establishing a water-fire-wind joint scheduling model of river basin cascade hydropower, which comprises the steps of generating a wind power generation scene frame of a countermeasure network (WGAN) based on an improved condition Wasserstein, establishing an objective function of water-fire-wind joint low-carbon power scheduling, a pre-scheduling stage constraint condition and a rescheduling stage constraint condition, and establishing the water-fire-wind joint scheduling model of the river basin cascade hydropower through the objective function, the pre-scheduling stage constraint condition and the rescheduling stage constraint condition. The river basin cascade hydropower station group coupling scheduling model comprehensively considers various complex operation constraints such as water system coupling, water flow time lag, flow and reservoir capacity limitation of the cascade hydropower station. The effectiveness of the model is verified through simulation of an improved IEEE-24 node system example, and a certain guiding significance is provided for water, fire and wind joint optimization scheduling containing large-scale wind power and step hydropower.
assignees: FUJIAN HUADIAN FURUI ENERGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Reverse remote language propagation model based on hypergraph
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of inverse remote language propagation, in particular to an inverse remote language propagation model based on hypergraph, which comprises the following steps: constructing an OSN anti-rumor high-order system propagation model based on hypergraph; analyzing the hypergraph OSN high-order network principle and composition; constructing a heterogeneous differential equation set of a hypergraph OSN (open-system analysis) anti-rumor high-order system propagation model and verifying the positive and the bounded nature of a model solution; calculating basic regeneration number of model or judging whether rumors are automatically dead threshold R  0  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the And carrying out numerical simulation verification on the model. The reverse remote speaking propagation model based on hypergraph carries out microscopic analysis on the rumor propagation of OSN from the angles of hypergraph and complex network theory, establishes a high-order information propagation model of OSN, and focuses on multilayer network based on hypergraph modeling toAnd model heterogeneity, emphasizes combinations of network structures, and emphasizes the characteristics of multi-level, and multi-dimensional networks of online social networks.
assignees: UNIV GUANGZHOU

title_en: Group cascade photovoltaic fire-fighting safety rapid shutoff device and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a group cascade photovoltaic fire safety rapid turn-off device; the device comprises a control module, wherein the control module is electrically connected with a closed-loop control module, the closed-loop control module is electrically connected with a processing module, the processing module is electrically connected with a receiver module, and the receiver module is electrically connected with a detection module; the closed-loop control module and the control module are electrically connected with a driving module together, and the driving module is electrically connected with an emitter module which is electrically connected with the assembly photovoltaic network; the control module is electrically connected with a communication module, and the communication module is connected with mobile equipment in a communication way; according to the invention, the receiver module is used for receiving and transmitting the data information of the component photovoltaic network detected by the detection module, the closed-loop control module is used for calculating, controlling and adjusting, the transmitter module is used for switching off, controlling and adjusting the component photovoltaic network, and the communication module is used for communicating with the mobile equipment, so that the remote operation, control and adjustment are convenient.
assignees: CHANGZHOU SUOTONG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power transmission line partial discharge detection method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a transmission line partial discharge detection method which comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining an original transmission line electric signal, dividing the original transmission line electric signal into training samples and test samples, S2, inputting the training samples into a multi-scale one-dimensional convolutional neural network in batches, setting a threshold value, a multi-scale one-dimensional convolutional neural network structure and the convolution kernel size of the multi-scale one-dimensional convolutional neural network structure, performing forward propagation layer by layer to obtain the characteristics of the training samples, calculating to obtain errors expected to be output and actual to be output, S3, performing backward propagation on the errors from the output to the input, performing fine tuning on network parameters layer by layer, S4, repeating the steps S2 and S3 until all the training samples are completed, calculating the accuracy of a network on the test samples, if the accuracy is larger than the set threshold value, obtaining an ideal network, otherwise, returning to the step S2, and outputting the accuracy of the ideal network on the test samples. The invention solves the problem of partial discharge diagnosis of the power transmission line and achieves better effect under the arrangement of different frequency data and different convolution kernels.

title_en: Cascade hydropower spot water-electricity price coupling clearing method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric power clearing, and discloses a step hydropower spot water price coupling clearing method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the water-electric coupling degree is expressed as a function of the missing electric quantity and the abandoned electric quantity, and a hydraulic power matching degree measuring method between the cascade power stations is provided; constructing a water-electricity price coupling clear model objective function according to minimization of electricity purchasing cost and maximization of water-electricity coupling degree; constructing a hydropower price coupling clear model constraint condition according to the unit output constraint, the power station output constraint, the power grid constraint and the hydropower class constraint; model comprehensive dimension reduction is carried out from three aspects of model structure layering, search space reduction and time period combination; and nesting and solving a water-electricity price coupling out-of-definition model by adopting a price sorting-improved PSO coupling algorithm. According to the invention, the economy and the resource utilization rate are comprehensively considered, the model solving complexity is reduced, and the improved algorithm solving model is adopted, so that the better market price and the winning bid amount of the generator are realized.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Typhoon prediction method, system, equipment and medium based on space-time attention
abstract_en: The invention discloses a typhoon prediction method, a typhoon prediction system, typhoon prediction equipment and typhoon prediction media based on space-time attention, wherein the method obtains sea surface variable characteristics by inputting typhoon data to be predicted into a preset two-dimensional convolution network to learn the space characteristics of sea surface variables; inputting typhoon data to be predicted into a preset three-dimensional convolution network to learn spatial characteristics of atmospheric variables, and obtaining the characteristics of the atmospheric variables; the three-dimensional convolution network comprises a plurality of cascaded three-dimensional convolution layers, and a three-dimensional space-time attention module combining a spatial attention mechanism and a channel attention mechanism is arranged between at least one pair of adjacent two three-dimensional convolution layers; combining and connecting the sea surface variable characteristics and the atmosphere variable characteristics to obtain combined characteristics; inputting the combined characteristics into a preset long-period and short-period memory network for characteristic learning to obtain typhoon time sequence characteristics; and predicting the strength of typhoons according to the typhoon time sequence characteristics. The typhoon prediction method and the typhoon prediction device can improve accuracy of typhoon prediction.
assignees: PEOPLE'S LIBERATION ARMY NATIONAL UNIVERSITY OF DEFENSE TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Charging station load small sample detection method based on graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a charging station load small sample detection method based on a graph neural network, which comprises the following steps: according to the graph theory, the electric power system is represented as a graph, and then the characteristic extraction capability of the encoder is utilized by utilizing the variational graph, and the low-dimensional vector representation of the electric vehicle charging station on each time slice is obtained; combining the low-dimensional vector with the load data label of the time slice to serve as a node of the input graph convolution neural network, and then constructing a support set and a query set and constructing a graph required by the required input graph convolution neural network; inputting the constructed graph into a graph convolution neural network, and performing iterative update solution by utilizing space-based graph convolution neural network operation; the information is propagated and shared in the network, and is stabilized after a plurality of recursions, and the node label information to be detected is a detection result. The invention fully considers the relation of time series and the influence of the space full graph, and captures more information to detect the load by considering the integrity of the power system.
assignees: UNIV YANSHAN

title_en: Enhancements for Minimization of Service Interruption
abstract_en: A user equipment (UE) is configured to identify a disaster condition applies to a first public land mobile network (PLMN), select a second PLMN for disaster roaming services, wherein one or more tracking areas (TAs) of the second PLMN are in a forbidden list stored locally at the UE and wherein the second PLMN and the first PLMN have a roaming agreement for disaster roaming services and register with the second PLMN for disaster roaming services in the one or more TAs of the second PLMN from the forbidden list.
assignees: APPLE INC

title_en: Short-term power load prediction improved layering model containing temperature sensitive load
abstract_en: A short-term power load prediction improved layering model containing temperature sensitive load is a short-term load prediction model and is applied to the field of load prediction containing temperature sensitive load. Step 1: and establishing a transverse layering model. Step 2: and training a transverse layering model. Step 3: and obtaining a predicted load result. The method can solve the problem that errors occur due to the fact that a first layer of neural network cannot refer to comparison non-temperature factors when temperature sensitive components are stripped in a longitudinal layered model, and is high in calculation speed; the constructed transverse layered neural network load prediction model is characterized in that a first layer of neural network considers the nonlinear influence of temperature on the load, a second layer of neural network considers the influence of other factors which do not influence the load by temperature, two layers of neural networks are complexed into a whole through an addition layer, temperature related and temperature independent components are continuously distributed to corresponding neural networks through a back propagation algorithm in the model training process, so that more accurate stripping of temperature sensitive components and non-temperature sensitive components in the load is realized, and short-term power load prediction of the temperature sensitive load in summer is completed. The method is simple and flexible in thought, and can greatly improve the prediction accuracy of the model.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN TECH

title_en: Distributed energy-containing power distribution network and multi-microgrid day-ahead random scheduling method based on generation countermeasure network
abstract_en: A daily random scheduling method for a distribution network containing distributed energy sources and a multi-microgrid based on a generated countermeasure network belongs to the field of electric scheduling. The method comprises the steps of establishing a multi-micro-grid and power distribution network day-ahead joint random optimization scheduling framework; analyzing the photovoltaic output scene in the micro-grid based on a data driving method to obtain a typical processing scene; based on a data driving generation countermeasure network method, learning wind power photovoltaic processing characteristics and generating a renewable energy source output scene; and (3) performing scene reduction by using a K-media method, and performing typical feature extraction to obtain a typical scene. Aiming at the difficult problem of coordinated scheduling of the access of the multiple micro-networks to the power distribution network, a random optimization model between the power distribution network and the multiple micro-networks in the future is established, the overall optimal solution of the model is obtained by utilizing a target cascading analysis method, and finally, a scheduling scheme with higher economical efficiency and new energy consumption rate is obtained, so that the coordinated operation of the multiple micro-networks and friendly interaction between the multiple micro-networks and the power distribution network are realized. The method is suitable for the field of coordinated operation management between the micro-grid system and the power distribution network.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV WUHAN

title_en: Rumor propagation model building method based on official clarification and platform supervision mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rumor propagation model building method based on an official clarification and platform supervision mechanism, which is characterized in that four groups of a susceptible person S, a hesitant H, an infected person I and an immune person R are assumed to exist on a social media platform, an official clarification person C and a banker B are added into the rumor propagation model for the first time, a SHIR-CB model is built, and the synergistic effect of the official clarification mechanism and the platform supervision mechanism in rumor treatment is emphasized. In addition, the model considers the influence of the social media platform network structure on rumor propagation, and the validity of the model can be evaluated by utilizing real social media platform rumor data. The designs enable the model to more truly depict and predict the actual effect of an official clarification mechanism and a platform supervision mechanism in the joint inhibition of rumor propagation, thereby remarkably improving the prediction precision of rumor propagation and the practical value of the model.
assignees: UNIV SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CHINA

title_en: Non-invasive load identification method and system based on Gram angle field and feature fusion
abstract_en: Non-invasive load identification method and system based on a gladhand angle field and feature fusion, the method comprising: step 1, converting one-dimensional active power data into two-dimensional image data by adopting a Graham angle field visualization technology; step 2, respectively inputting the two-dimensional image data and the one-dimensional active power data into a trained convolutional neural network and a trained counter-propagating neural network to extract features, and fusing the extracted image features and power features; and step 3, inputting the fusion characteristics into a trained classification network to identify the load category, thereby completing non-invasive load identification. The identification accuracy on the low-frequency sampling data can be effectively improved, and the high efficiency and accuracy under the low-frequency acquisition scene are met.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD SUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH

title_en: Method, system, device and storage medium for evaluating offshore wind power system line
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a system, a device and a storage medium for evaluating a line of an offshore wind power system, aiming at the problem of uncertainty of offshore wind power output in typhoon weather, a typhoon scene is constructed based on historical typhoon data, uncertainty of wind power output is described by adopting interval number theory, and an interval tide model considering wind power access is established; aiming at the problem of system line fault propagation in typhoon scenes, a time-varying risk propagation model of the power system is established based on a dynamic Bayesian network according to uncertainty of wind power output and power flow transfer caused by line faults; and (3) considering the real-time comprehensive vulnerability assessment indexes of the line fault and the system risk propagation definition line in the typhoon scene, classifying the vulnerable line under the influence of typhoon by adopting a clustering algorithm, and realizing accurate assessment of the vulnerable line of the offshore wind power system in the typhoon scene. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of reflecting space-time related risks of the power system, accurately evaluating the fragile line under the influence of typhoons and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SHANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: System methodology for autonomous monetary and commerce generation, regeneration, distribution, and redistribution
abstract_en: A comprehensive Socio-Financial, Socio-Economic, Socio-Commerce, distribution and re-distribution system comprised of various technologies adapted to achieve an (Eco) System Network engineered specifically to generate “Autonomous Money” in addition to varied forms of Finance and Commerce propagation. The generation and propagation are accomplished through a dynamic exchange of money, goods, or services, through a unique methodology, accomplished through a series of fully and/or semi-automated, synchronous, homogenous internet interactions and transactions. The purposeful outcome in one sense is to provide a comprehensive, realistic and reliable residual income type system that is organic and possible-of-attainment by the greater masses of humanity. In another aspect, the system is capable of producing considerable worldwide economic stimulation as well as realistically enabling a Universal Basic Income (UBI) without burdensome taxation. However, because this System possesses a multifaceted approach to Commerce, as well as the generation of wealth, the UBI humanitarian aspect is but one of various applications.
assignees: SAINT MICHAEL ANTHONY CHRISTOPHER

title_en: Wind power cluster power ultra-short-term prediction model establishment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power cluster power ultra-short-term prediction model establishment method, wherein the model establishment process comprises the following steps: calculating the relevance among the nodes by considering historical wind power data of a plurality of wind power stations so as to construct a wind power cluster map; step 2: based on the wind farm nodes in the step 1, determining node neighborhood weights by using an attention score calculation method so as to extract spatial features; step 3: based on the space information captured in the step 2, mining the association of the wind power sequence in the time dimension, and based on the principle of a gating circulating unit, establishing a space-time characteristic fusion propagation model; step 4: outputting a wind power cluster power result based on the model established in the step 3, correcting a fully-connected network weight value, and finally outputting a predicted power vector time sequence of the wind power plant cluster; the method can excavate the time and space relation of the wind power clusters, and can realize the real-time efficient utilization of the space-time characteristics and the improvement of the prediction effect.
assignees: PUYANG POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Co-earthquake landslide susceptibility prediction CGboost algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a common-earthquake landslide susceptibility prediction CGboost algorithm, equipment and storage equipment, which are used for constructing a common-earthquake landslide influence factor set according to a common-earthquake landslide disaster-inducing environment and disaster-inducing characteristics; cross GAT was proposed based on GAT, simplified attention, and cascade aggregation; integrating CGBoost networks according to cross gat and XGBoost: coupling 2 branches of cross gat and XGBoost integrated learning, and extracting associated characterization of the inside of the slope units, between the slope units and between the prediction index and the susceptibility; inputting the same-earthquake landslide influence factor set into a CGboost network, carrying out self-adaptive weighted fusion on the associated features to obtain rich high-level features with higher discrimination, converting the high-level features into the probability of the vulnerability, carrying out the prediction of the vulnerability of the wide area, and grading the vulnerability of the wide area according to the probability of the vulnerability. The utility model provides a same earthquake landslide susceptibility prediction equipment and storage device for realize same earthquake landslide susceptibility prediction CGboost algorithm. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the method is applied to the newly-generated large earthquake event in future, and the quick emergency landslide susceptibility prediction after earthquake is realized.
assignees: UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES WUHAN

title_en: Distribution line wind disaster vulnerability assessment method considering cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wind resistance and disaster prevention of electric power infrastructure, and discloses a distribution line wind disaster vulnerability assessment method considering cascading failure. The invention can rapidly and accurately calculate the vertical and horizontal overturning angles of the invalid distribution pole under the action of strong wind and the additional overturning force to the adjacent distribution pole caused by the vertical and horizontal overturning angles, and gets rid of the inefficiency limit of the traditional explicit finite element method in analyzing cascade invalidation. The invention discloses the propagation process of the failure in the whole line in a parameterized form, and accurately judges the direct failure caused by wind load and the indirect failure caused by additional overturning force. Meanwhile, the invention can help engineers to determine the safe operation tension and horizontal span in the construction erection stage, and has strong creativity. The invention has simple implementation, high analysis efficiency and calculation precision, can provide effective guidance for engineering design, construction erection and daily operation and maintenance of the electric power infrastructure, and has wide applicability and high practicability.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN TECH

title_en: Virtual earthquake scene playing system based on mobile equipment propagation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual earthquake scene playing system based on mobile equipment propagation, which comprises an earthquake at a playing making layer and an application layer interaction terminal which is in wireless communication with the earthquake playing making layer through a network communication layer, wherein the earthquake playing making layer comprises the following components: the invention relates to the technical field of seismic performance, in particular to a seismic virtual image model importing module, a virtual space coordinate system creating module, a seismic virtual image model processing unit, a machine position real-time tracking module and a seismic virtual image model matching unit. The virtual seismic scene playing system based on mobile equipment propagation can realize image self-adaption processing between virtual video models corresponding to different shooting machine positions to realize continuity switching operation, eliminate time difference of regenerating virtual images to ensure smoothness of image watching of people, and achieve adjustment of self-adaption positions and image scaling areas through the whole virtual image model along with movement of shooting equipment.
assignees: SHANDONG EARTHQUAKE AGENCY

title_en: Wind power grid-connected system cascading failure risk assessment method considering frequency modulation characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascading failure risk assessment method of a wind power grid-connected system considering frequency modulation characteristics, and relates to the field of grid operation and maintenance. The failure risk of the wind power grid-connected system is not comprehensively considered. The method comprises the following steps: adding the generator and the load frequency modulation characteristic equation to a power flow equation to obtain a power flow equation considering frequency modulation characteristics; linearizing the tide equation which takes into account the frequency modulation characteristic to obtain a node voltage linear tide equation and a line tide equation which take into account the frequency modulation characteristic of the system; establishing a Gaussian mixture model of the output power of the fan to obtain a probability distribution function of the output power of the fan; based on the obtained probability distribution function, the severity degree of node voltage out-of-limit, line overload and system frequency out-of-limit of the system are calculated respectively; judging whether the severity of the overload of the line exceeds a set value; the risk of the system during the entire cascading failure is assessed. The technical scheme accords with the actual situation, and effectively evaluates the risks of voltage out-of-limit, line overload and frequency instability of wind power access.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ZHOUSHAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Micro-grid group optimal scheduling method, device, terminal and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a micro-grid group optimal scheduling method, a device, a terminal and a medium, wherein the method quantifies uncertainty of new energy and load in a micro-grid group by adopting opportunistic constraint planning, sets a confidence level, converts rotation reserve constraint into a probability constraint form, converts the opportunistic constraint planning into a source load output deterministic model by adopting a deterministic equivalent conversion method, establishes an active power distribution network economic scheduling model containing a multi-main micro-grid group, and establishes a two-level hierarchical optimal scheduling model by adopting a target cascade analysis method so as to realize independent optimization after decoupling of the two-level hierarchical optimal scheduling model. Therefore, the embodiment of the invention can effectively protect privacy of multiple benefit bodies, meet benefit requirements, fully utilize the autonomous running capability of the sub-micro-grid, simplify the dispatching calculation burden of the micro-grid group energy management system and quantify the uncertainty of new energy and load in the micro-grid group.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Infrastructure pipe network failure cascade analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade analysis method for failure of an infrastructure pipe network, which comprises the following steps: constructing a network topology structure diagram of the target area by adopting geographic information system software according to the general survey data of the pipe network of the target area; determining a supply node and a load node of a network according to a network topology structure diagram; according to the supply node and the load node, analyzing and acquiring the reliability of network communication; and obtaining an important supply pipeline and a weak supply node according to the network communication reliability. By the method, important supply pipe sections and weak supply nodes of various infrastructure networks can be identified, and guidance for disaster prevention planning is facilitated.
assignees: UNIV TONGJI

title_en: Optimized scheduling method and system for marine pasture micro-grid
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of power grid optimization, and provides an optimization scheduling method and system for a micro-grid of a marine pasture, wherein empirical data required for building a wind-light scene is determined by utilizing an empirical equation according to historical data; then, generating a wind-light scene by using empirical data, and establishing a decision model aiming at minimizing the net current cost in the service life based on the generated wind-light scene; finally, calculating the minimum value of the objective function in the decision model, and carrying out optimal configuration on the marine pasture micro-grid; when the experience model parameters in the experience equation are determined, uncertainty propagation is carried out through taylor series approximation to obtain the experience model parameters in the prediction interval, the prediction uncertainty measurement is converted into the prediction interval problem, the purpose of considering the influence of cognitive uncertainty such as algorithm uncertainty, structure uncertainty and the like can be achieved on the basis of considering the influence of random uncertainty, and the scheduling optimization effect is improved.
assignees: WEIHAI POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Network disaster recovery method, disaster recovery core network equipment and communication system
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a network disaster recovery method, disaster recovery core network equipment and a communication system. The network disaster recovery method comprises the following steps: periodically synchronizing a user terminal context and a session management context with a first device in a service core network, wherein the disaster recovery core network and the service core network share a Radio Access Network (RAN); if the service core network is perceived to be invalid, session updating is carried out with the second equipment still in the working state in the service core network; and creating a data path between the disaster recovery core network equipment and the RAN equipment so that the user terminal can interact with a control plane of the disaster recovery core network through the RAN equipment and interact with a user plane of the service core network through the RAN equipment. The method and the device can effectively reduce service interruption time and improve resource utilization rate of core network equipment.
assignees: CHINA TELECOM CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic coordination pricing optimization method based on dynamic wireless charging of electric automobile
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic coordination pricing optimization method based on dynamic wireless charging of an electric automobile, and relates to the field of optimal scheduling of traffic-power distribution coupling systems. The method comprises the following steps: simulating the propagation process of traffic flow by adopting a cell transmission model based on a path; calculating travel costs according to the dynamic coordination pricing policies; establishing a dynamic user balance model of the traffic network to determine congestion fees and vehicle route selection; establishing an optimal power flow model of the power distribution network to determine power price and power generation capacity; and finally, solving the dynamic network equilibrium state of the coupled traffic-power distribution network model by adopting a self-adaptive step length projection algorithm, and determining dynamic coordination pricing. Experiments prove that the method can improve the network efficiency, effectively relieve traffic network congestion and promote the safe and economic operation of the power distribution network.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Power grid cascading failure risk scene identification method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for identifying a power grid cascading failure risk scene, which relate to the field of power risk scenes, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining historical operation data of a power grid; performing cascading failure simulation on the historical operation data of the power grid to obtain an active power flow entropy; carrying out imaging representation on the historical operation data of the power grid and the active power flow entropy to obtain a multi-line thermodynamic diagram; dividing the multi-line thermodynamic diagram into a training set and a testing set; training the neural network by using the training set to obtain a power grid cascading failure risk scene identification model; and testing the power grid cascading failure risk scene identification model by using a test set to obtain a risk scene identification result. The risk identification method and the risk identification device can accurately realize risk identification of the current running scene of the power grid.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Characterization of interactions between compounds and polymers using attitude ensembles
abstract_en: Systems and methods for characterizing interactions between compounds and polymers include obtaining multiple sets of atomic coordinates. Each set of atomic coordinates includes the compound bound to the polymer in a corresponding pose of a plurality of poses. Each respective set of atomic coordinates or its encoding is input into the neural network in turn to obtain a corresponding initial embedding as output, thereby obtaining a plurality of initial embeddings. Each initial embedding corresponds to one of the sets of atomic coordinates. The attention mechanism is applied to the plurality of initial embeddings in a cascade to obtain an attention embedding. A pooling function is applied to the attention embedment to derive a pooling embedment. The pooling insert is input into a model to obtain an interaction score for the interaction between the compound and the polymer.
assignees: ATOMWISE INC

title_en: Smoke control system with adjustable neutral zone position
title_ko: 중성대 위치조절형 제연시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smoke control system with an adjustable neutral zone position. The smoke control system includes: an upper damper installed on a path connecting a vertical shaft with outside air on an upper side; a lower damper installed on a path connecting the vertical shaft with the outside air on a lower side; a differential pressure measuring sensor measuring differential pressure between the vertical shaft and the outside air; and a control part separately controlling opening rates of the upper damper and the lower damper such that the pressure of the vertical shaft located at the same height as a fire floor becomes positive pressure using the measurement value of the differential pressure measuring sensor in the event of a fire. Therefore, smoke from the fire floor can be displayed to the outside air, and, in accordance with the composition, without applying an intake/exhaust mechanism of an air blower to a building, the spread of smoke to the other floors can be prevented due to a smoke chimney effect at a low cost, and, as a result, a smoke control system can be created at a lower cost than a pressure smoke control facility using an air blower.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 중성대 위치조절형 제연시스템에 관한 것으로서, 그 구성은, 상측의 수직샤프트와 외기를 연결하는 경로 상에 설치되는 상부댐퍼; 하측의 상기 수직샤프트와 외기를 연결하는 경로 상에 설치되는 하부댐퍼; 상기 수직샤프트와 외기 사이의 차압을 측정하는 차압측정센서; 및 화재 발생시 상기 차압측정센서의 측정값을 이용하여 화재층과 동일한 높이에 위치한 상기 수직샤프트의 압력이 양압이 되도록 상기 상부댐퍼 및 상기 하부댐퍼의 개도율을 각각 조절하도록 제어하는 제어부;를 포함하여, 상기 화재층의 연기가 외기로 배출되도록 하며, 상기의 구성에 따르면, 건축물에 송풍기의 급배기 방식을 적용하지 않고, 저비용으로 연돌 효과로 인한 연기의 타층 전파 방지를 할 수 있어, 송풍기를 이용한 가압 제연설비에 비해 저비용으로 제연시스템을 구현할 수 있다.
assignees: EAM TAE KYOUNG

title_en: Comprehensive energy system transmission and distribution cooperation layering optimization scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive energy system transmission and distribution collaborative hierarchical optimization scheduling method, belonging to the field of comprehensive energy system transmission and distribution optimization; the comprehensive energy system transmission and distribution collaborative hierarchical optimization scheduling method comprises the following steps: constructing a hot water network equivalent model and a terminal building equivalent model, and fusing to obtain a thermodynamic system equivalent model considering thermal inertia; constructing a natural gas pipeline equivalent gas circuit model, and constructing a natural gas system equivalent model considering the pipe storage characteristic based on the natural gas pipeline equivalent gas circuit model; based on a thermodynamic system equivalent model and a natural gas system equivalent model, constructing a grid-transfer layer system optimization scheduling model and a distribution network layer system optimization scheduling model by taking economic optimization as a target; and decomposing the network layer optimizing problem and the distribution network layer optimizing problem by adopting a target cascading method, and respectively solving a network layer system optimizing and scheduling model and a distribution network layer system optimizing and scheduling model.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Load identification method based on dynamic threshold
abstract_en: The invention discloses a load identification method based on a dynamic threshold value, which comprises the following steps: acquiring electricity consumption data of an electric power user, and detecting switching events of all loads in the electricity consumption data; extracting voltage-current track images of each load according to voltage and current data of preset periods before and after the switching event of each load; respectively identifying each voltage-current track image according to a preset load identification network model to obtain a load category corresponding to each voltage-current track image; wherein the load identification network model is trained by back-propagating a weighting function of supervised loss and unsupervised loss; the unsupervised loss is calculated by selecting a voltage-current track image meeting a preset standard in combination with a dynamic threshold; the dynamic threshold is obtained by dynamically adjusting the first threshold of each load according to the learning effect of each load. The method provided by the invention realizes more accurate identification of the load category through semi-supervised learning.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Network propagation simulation method and device for introducing imitator node
abstract_en: A network propagation simulation method and device for introducing a simulator node, wherein the simulator node becomes an active node after a designated node in a neighbor node corresponding to the simulator node becomes the active node, comprises the steps of firstly constructing a random network graph, secondly determining the node type and the state in the random network, thirdly determining respective state updating rules of the simulator node and a common node, fourthly, cascading and propagating network information, and counting the number of the active nodes after the number of the active nodes in a fifth random network is stable. The invention expands the original threshold model, considers the role of the imitator node in the social network, and is convenient for researching how the heterogeneous performance of the node in behavior enables information to be transmitted in the network.

title_en: Adaptive positioning method for target node environment of underwater search and rescue wireless sensor network
abstract_en: The invention relates to an underwater search and rescue wireless sensor network target node environment self-adaptive positioning method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring position information of an anchor node; constructing a path loss model of the anchor node for receiving the target node to be searched and rescuing based on the position information, attenuation loss and absorption effect of the underwater signal propagation; based on the path loss model, constructing a distance-based underwater search and rescue wireless sensing network target node positioning model by adopting a Taylor expansion type; approximating the target node positioning model to a sum expression of two least squares using a least maximization strategy; and solving a target node positioning optimal solution by using an interior point method based on the approximated least square sum expression. Compared with the prior art, the method is highly suitable for the underwater search and rescue environment with high dynamic state and severe communication environment, and has the advantages of improving the positioning calculation precision and the like.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI MARITIME

title_en: District electricity prediction method based on graph multi-head attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to a district electricity prediction method based on a graph multi-head attention mechanism, which comprises the following steps: obtaining geographical position data, historical electric quantity data and historical external factor data of a cell; preprocessing historical electric quantity data, historical external factor data and geographic position data; historical external factor data includes gas temperature and electricity price; constructing a space-time diagram neural network model based on a diagram multi-head self-attention mechanism; obtaining a prediction result through a space-time diagram neural network model based on a diagram multi-head self-attention mechanism; comparing the predicted result with the true value to obtain a loss value; performing reverse error propagation through the loss value, and training the model; and predicting the future electricity consumption of the cell through the trained model. The method models the historical electricity consumption data, models the spatial relationship among the cells and the time characteristics of the historical data, and fully mines the space-time relationship in the cell electric quantity prediction problem.
assignees: STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Fault propagation analysis method and device for power information physical system
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of electric power, and provides a fault propagation analysis method and device for an electric power information physical system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: injecting faults caused by target uncertainty factors into the power network, and collecting relevant data of the target uncertainty factors in the power network; according to the related data, analyzing probability statistical characteristics of the target uncertain factors; calculating power flow information of the power network according to the probability statistical characteristics; determining a fault element in the power network according to the tide information, and controlling the fault element to send an abnormal data packet to a dispatching center of the power information physical system at a corresponding node in the information network; adjusting the power network according to the abnormal data packet received by the dispatching center; the propagation characteristics of the fault are analyzed based on the changes in the power network before and after the adjustment. The method can analyze the influence of the uncertain factors on the fault propagation of the power information physical system.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;HEBEI HUIZHI POWER ENG DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Method for predicting depth and midrange of seismic source based on physical information neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting depth and center distance of a seismic source based on a physical information neural network, which aims to solve the technical problems of low prediction precision of the depth and center distance of the seismic source and poor interpretability of a data driving network. The method for predicting the depth and the midrange of the seismic source comprises the following steps: 1. three-component earthquake motion records are selected from the data set to serve as input parameters, and the corresponding earthquake focus depth and earthquake focus middle distance are used as label parameters; 2. establishing a deep neural network comprising a convolution layer and a residual block, adopting a linear rectification function as an activation function, adopting an Adam self-adaptive optimizer to perform counter propagation, and combining a mean square error function and a seismic wave travel time difference equation as a loss function; 3. training a deep neural network model; 4. and predicting the depth and the midrange of the seismic source. The invention adopts the deep neural network which integrates the physical information, not only can improve the prediction precision, but also can ensure that the deep neural network model has a certain interpretation, and improves the prediction precision.
assignees: HARBIN INST TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Method for controlling power generation capacity of elevator-level hydropower station in real time by using water and related device
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for controlling the generating capacity of an elevator-level hydropower station in real time by using water, which comprises the following steps: establishing a hydropower station reservoir operation constraint library based on upstream hydropower station reservoir data information and downstream hydropower station reservoir data information; determining an upstream water power station water surface area and a downstream water power station water surface area based on the upstream water power station water level and the downstream water power station water level; determining the power generation amount of the upstream water power station and the delivery flow of the upstream water power station based on the water surface area of the upstream water power station and the water surface area of the downstream water power station; determining the power generation amount of the downstream water power station and the power output flow of the downstream water power station based on the power output flow of the upstream water power station and the water level of the downstream water power station; determining a step joint total power generation amount based on the power generation amount of the upstream water power station and the power generation amount of the downstream water power station; the cascade reservoir group real-time economic optimization operation of cascade combined power generation and reservoir energy storage is realized, the optimal scheduling decision can be rapidly acquired to provide a reference, and the power generation of the cascade reservoir group and the power grid demand are more fully coordinated.
assignees: GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Fire spread modeling method for coupling network model lithium ion battery energy storage system
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire spread modeling method of a coupled network model lithium ion battery energy storage system, which belongs to the technical field of lithium ion battery model construction and simulation methods, and comprises the steps of obtaining battery electrochemical parameters, material thermophysical parameters and geometric characteristic parameters of the battery energy storage system; establishing a three-dimensional geometric model of an air domain in the energy storage system and dividing grids; calculating heat generation inside the battery during thermal runaway; solving the heat transfer and thermal runaway propagation processes among the batteries, and calculating the temperature of the batteries; calculating gas production inside the battery during thermal runaway; solving jet flow kinetic parameters of the battery; solving a conservation equation of a fluid region of the battery energy storage system, and predicting fire spreading behaviors inside the energy storage power station; according to the method, the thermal runaway propagation behavior of the lithium ion battery at the energy storage system level can be calculated, and meanwhile, the fire evolution condition inside the energy storage system after an accident occurs can be simulated.
assignees: UNIV CHINA PETROLEUM EAST CHINA

title_en: Power communication network topology optimization method based on complex network theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power communication network topology optimization method based on a complex network theory; the method comprises the steps of firstly establishing a graph model of an electric power communication network, embedding a power flow parameter in the electric power network and a service flow parameter in the communication network into a weight matrix of the graph model, quantifying the coupling degree between layers according to the similarity of nodes, and constructing a coupling model of the network. And then, providing an elasticity evaluation index of the power communication network, evaluating the elasticity of the power communication network at different moments by using a dynamic form of a kirchhoff coefficient, and tracking the development evolution process of the network in the cascade fault process. And finally, taking the elasticity evaluation index as an objective function, establishing an optimization model by adopting a simulated annealing method, and solving the optimal elasticity topology of the network. The invention is a planning method of network topology, considers the characteristics of electric power and communication network coupling, and can enhance the structural strength of the electric power communication network by adjusting the topological relation of the communication network, thereby improving the resistance of the network in faults.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: A multifunctional lantern worn on the chest
title_ko: 가슴에 착용하는 다기능 랜턴
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a multi-functional lantern (100) worn on the chest which comprises: a control unit (100a) provided on a lantern body (120) and selectively controlling an operation of the multi-functional lantern; an on/off switch (102) selectively turning the power of the multi-functional lantern on and off; a microphone and speaker (103) with a walkie-talkie function allowing various uses of calling and recording; a battery (106) supplying the power to the multi-functional lantern; a radio (110) receiving radio waves sent from a broadcasting station and allowing a user to hear the same as voices; an alarm (111) emitting an alarm sound to the user and people in case of a dangerous situation to evacuate therefrom; an LED lamp (112) emitting light to illuminate the front so that the user can watch the front; and a shoulder strap (150) worn over the user's shoulder and waist to secure the lantern body (120) close to the chest. The multi-functional lantern worn on the chest is secured tightly to the user's body so that the user can use both hands freely when using the lantern, and is especially designed to be conveniently used in dark bridge interiors, tunnels, etc. during safety diagnosis of facilities. Accordingly, the quality and reliability of multi-functional lantern products worn on the chest are greatly improved so that the various needs of consumers can be satisfied and a good image can be created.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 가슴에 착용하는 다기능 랜턴에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은 이를 위해 가슴에 착용하는 다기능 랜턴(100)에 관한 것으로, 랜턴몸체(120)에 구비되며, 다기능 랜턴의 동작을 선택적으로 제어하는 제어부(100a); 다기능 랜턴의 전원을 선택적으로 온,오프시키는 온,오프스위치(102); 통화와 녹음을 다양하게 사용할 수 있도록 한 무전기 기능의 마이크 및 스피커(103); 다기능 랜턴에 전원을 공급하는 배터리(106); 방송국에서 보낸 전파를 수신하여 음성으로 들을 수 있도록 한 라디오(110); 위험상황시 본인 및 주변사람들에게 경보음을 발산시켜 대피시킬 수 있도록 한 경보기(111); 전방을 주시할 수 있도록 빛을 발산시켜 앞을 비추는 LED램프(112); 및 사용자의 어깨와 허리에 걸쳐지도록 하여 랜턴몸체(120)를 가슴쪽 위치에 밀착시키도록 한 멜빵(150);이 포함된다. 상기와 같이 구성된 본 발명은 렌턴 사용시 사용자의 양손을 모두 자유롭게 사용할 수 있도록 하기 위해 랜턴을 사용자의 몸에 밀착 고정시킨 것이고, 특히 시설물의 안전진단 조사시 어두운 교량 내부, 터널 등에 적용하여 편리하게 사용할 수 있도록 한 것이고, 이로 인해 가슴에 착용하는 다기능 랜턴 제품의 품질과 신뢰성을 대폭 향상시키므로 사용자인 소비자들의 다양한 욕구(니즈)를 충족시켜 좋은 이미지를 심어줄 수 있도록 한 것이다.
assignees: DAEAN ENG INC

title_en: Fault alarm method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a fault alarm method, a fault alarm device and electronic equipment. According to the method, network fault information is sent to a plurality of public land mobile network PLMNs through a network detection end, the PLMNs forward the network fault information to a shared base station, and then when the shared base station detects that the network fault information forwarded by the faulty PLMNs is not received, the terminal corresponding to the faulty PLMNs cannot know that the faulty PLMNs enter disaster conditions, so that the network fault information is broadcast to the terminals corresponding to the faulty PLMNs, the problem of communication service can be rapidly identified by the terminals, the network service interruption time of the terminals is reduced, and the user experience is improved.

title_en: Aggregation method for cascade multi-time scale adjustable load
abstract_en: The application relates to a cascading type multi-time-scale adjustable load aggregation method, which realizes multi-level cascading of distributed adjustable load resources from a short time scale level to a long time scale, and avoids the problems of mass data processing and complex function design caused by single-level aggregation. In addition, the distributed adjustable load resources can meet the operation requirements of the power grid under different response scales and time scales through cross-time scale aggregation. The application is beneficial to promoting the aggregation and the utilization of distributed adjustable load resources, improving the new energy consumption capability of the power grid, keeping the power supply stable and supporting the construction of a national novel power system and the realization of a double-carbon target.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Method and system for identifying weak links of power grid in high-proportion new energy region
abstract_en: The method and the system for identifying the weak links of the regional power grid of the high-proportion new energy source judge that the power grid has the cascading failure if the connecting line has direct current when the capacity of the regional power grid is the same in order of magnitude as that of the external power grid and the short circuit ratio is more than 3; if the connecting lines have no direct current, reducing the number of fault connecting lines to perform stability control calculation, and determining weak links of the regional power grid according to a calculation result; when the magnitude of the regional power grid capacity is smaller than that of the external power grid capacity, performing stability control calculation according to the influence of the capacity of the accessed thermal power generating unit on the regional power grid trend direction, wherein the stability control calculation comprises the following steps: when the regional power grid sends power flow to the external power grid, performing stable control calculation of transient power angle stabilization, main transformer or line overload and outlet section bayonet; when the regional power grid flows down the grid, performing stable control calculation of transient power angle stabilization, main transformer or line overload, grid section opening and transient voltage and steady voltage; and determining the regional power grid weak links according to the calculation result. The application improves the efficiency and quality of stability control analysis.
assignees: SUIZHOU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY HUBEI PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY STATE GRID COOP;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;BEIJING SIFANG PROJECT CO LTD

title_en: Mechanical-non-mixed three-dimensional macroscopic basic diagram construction method based on cellular automaton model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a machine non-mixing three-dimensional macroscopic basic diagram construction method based on a cellular automaton model, which is characterized in that interaction logic and quantization characteristics of a motor vehicle and a non-motor vehicle in a machine non-mixing process are analyzed, a vehicle motion rule at a machine non-mixing road section and an intersection is established, and a microscopic traffic simulation model based on the cellular automaton is constructed so as to obtain a macroscopic basic diagram; firstly, a macroscopic basic diagram theory is extended to a three-dimensional space, and the relationship between road network traffic output and motor vehicle density and non-motor vehicle density is established, so that macroscopic features of the machine non-mixed dual-mode traffic system can be more comprehensively described; according to the invention, a three-dimensional macroscopic basic diagram of the mixed traffic is constructed through data analysis, theoretical modeling and traffic simulation means, the formation, propagation and dissipation mechanisms of traffic jam under the interference of the non-motor vehicles are explored, the road network performance reduction caused by the non-motor vehicle interference and the generated traffic flow additional delay are quantified, and technical support is provided for efficiently using urban road resources and the like.
assignees: UNIV HENAN SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Fault information early warning system and method based on power equipment inspection knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power inspection information processing, and particularly relates to a fault information early warning system and method based on an inspection knowledge graph of power equipment. The system extracts relevant corpus of the power equipment from a corpus of the power equipment through a knowledge graph construction module and constructs a patrol knowledge graph of the power equipment; the information transmission module based on the iterative characterization enhanced graph convolution neural network utilizes the constructed power equipment inspection knowledge graph, and combines the iterative characterization enhanced graph convolution neural network to enable fault information of the power equipment to be transmitted among different equipment; and the early warning information identification module carries out fault judgment on the propagated information and carries out early warning. The invention enables the early warning information to be transmitted among different power equipment nodes, and accurate judgment is carried out in fewer power equipment samples.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD EHV BRANCH;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Pumped storage and cascade hydropower joint scheduling method based on virtual power plant
abstract_en: The invention provides a pumped storage and step hydropower joint scheduling method based on a virtual power plant. Acquiring pumping data of a plurality of distributed pumped storage power stations and storage capacity data of an upper warehouse and a lower warehouse, and confirming unit parameters of a virtual pumped storage unit in a virtual power station; acquiring power generation data and upstream and downstream water level data of each stage of power stations in the step power plant, and confirming unit parameters of a virtual step hydroelectric unit in the virtual power plant; responding to a power grid load instruction, and confirming load scheduling schemes of the virtual pumped storage unit and the virtual step hydroelectric unit based on unit parameters of the virtual pumped storage unit and the virtual step hydroelectric unit; the load scheduling scheme comprises a pumping instruction of the virtual pumped storage unit and a load scheduling instruction of the virtual step hydroelectric unit. The invention solves the technical problems of large management difficulty and poor effect caused by the scheduling management of the river basin step power plant and the pumped storage respectively in the prior art.

title_en: Photovoltaic power generation scheduling method, equipment and storage medium based on virtual power plant
abstract_en: The application provides a photovoltaic power generation scheduling method, equipment and a storage medium based on a virtual power plant. The method comprises the following steps: a plurality of data acquisition devices are arranged at the photovoltaic power plant to acquire illumination data; confirming a plurality of power generation data of the photovoltaic virtual machine set based on the illumination data; based on the grid connection time and the grid connection power, confirming that a plurality of hydroelectric units in the cascade hydroelectric power plant are used as grid connection adjusting units, and confirming a load instruction of each grid connection adjusting unit; when the grid-connected time is reached, each grid-connected adjusting unit adjusts according to the corresponding load instruction; based on the net-withdrawing time and net-withdrawing power, confirming that a plurality of hydroelectric units in the cascade hydroelectric power plant are used as net-withdrawing regulating units, and confirming a load instruction of each net-withdrawing regulating unit; when the network-quitting time is reached, each network-quitting adjusting unit adjusts according to the corresponding load instruction. The technical problem that the load adjusting effect is poor when the photovoltaic power plant is connected with and disconnected from the grid is solved.
assignees: HUBEI QINGJIANG HYDROELECTRIC DEV CO LTD

title_en: Urban traffic flow dynamic allocation method and system based on arc resistance function
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban traffic flow dynamic allocation method and system based on an arc impedance function, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing an urban traffic flow dynamic allocation model based on the arc impedance function: reconstructing a topological model of the urban traffic network based on travel chain origin-destination points and key nodes of traffic users; describing the passing time of different automobiles in different arc segments according to the arc segment flow differentiation, and constructing an arc resistance function model; constructing a dynamic traffic flow propagation model; minimizing the economic trip cost of the vehicle as an objective function; and solving an urban traffic flow dynamic distribution model based on the arc impedance function. According to the invention, the urban traffic network reconstructed by introducing the virtual arcs of the starting point, the charging station and the gas station can effectively describe the traffic network topology structure under the multi-energy supply system; according to the dynamic traffic flow propagation model provided by the arc resistance function, the propagation condition of traffic flow between road sections can be reliably identified, and further, the travel behavior of the traffic flow is guided through the economic travel cost of the vehicle, so that the efficient and economic travel of the vehicle is assisted, the congestion condition of a traffic network is relieved, and the balanced distribution of the dynamic traffic flow of the traffic network is realized.
assignees: UNIV KUNMING SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Earthquake response and damage evolution simulation method and equipment for ground fracture zone tunnel lining
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and equipment for simulating earthquake response and damage evolution of a tunnel lining with a ground fissure, and relates to the field of earthquake engineering. The invention is based on the constructed vibrating table model, a numerical simulation model is established by adopting a method for correcting lattice spring-discrete crack network coupling numerical values, then an MLSM-DFN model of a tunnel structure section of a ground crack zone is established based on the numerical simulation model, and the ground crack zone tunnel lining earthquake response and damage simulation are completed based on the model, so that the expansion and propagation rules of the ground crack can be completely and truly simulated, the activity development trend of the ground crack can be accurately predicted and quantified, and meanwhile, the influence factors and action mechanisms of the tunnel structure failure induced by coupling dynamics response can be accurately judged, so that a more definite theoretical basis and a more technical support are provided for better and targeted earthquake-proof design of the tunnel structure.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING CHEM TECH

title_en: Multi-distribution network collaborative distributed optimal scheduling method and system based on target cascading method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-distribution network collaborative distributed optimal scheduling method and system based on a target cascading method, and relates to the technical field of comprehensive energy system and power system transmission and distribution collaboration. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring operation data and interaction data of a power transmission network and a power distribution network; constructing a transmission network optimization scheduling model and a distribution network optimization scheduling model; carrying out coupling solution on the power transmission network optimization scheduling model and the power distribution network optimization scheduling model by utilizing a target cascading algorithm; and carrying out optimal scheduling on the power transmission network and the power distribution network according to the solving result. According to the invention, power interaction between the power transmission network and the power distribution network is considered, coupling power exchange between the power distribution network is also considered, an optimal scheduling model of a plurality of power distribution networks and the power transmission network is established, analysis and optimization are carried out, and more efficient power use and more stable power network operation are ensured.
assignees: TAIAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Systems and methods for a synthetic infrastructure model for vulnerability, failure, and future transition planning
abstract_en: A computer-implemented SynF (Synthetic Infrastructure) model is designed to estimate the location and characteristics of urban water and power distribution networks, estimate how those networks are interconnected and connect to buildings and transportation systems, and assess how failures propagate within and across the systems. The model was designed using Phoenix metro area cities but has been extended to other cities.
assignees: CHESTER MIKHAIL;AHMAD SK NASIR;JOHNSON NATHAN;HOFF RYAN;UNIV ARIZONA STATE

title_en: Signal-free area network coverage equipment based on ad hoc network
