abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of network equipment, in particular to an ad hoc network-based no-signal area network coverage device, which comprises a broadband transmission module, a narrowband transmission module, a universal transmission module, a short-distance data transmission module and a public network interface module; the circuit control board in the device comprises a double-frequency bidirectional signal amplifier, a wireless broadband data transmission link and a narrowband data transmission link. The invention can increase the production data return distance of the non-moving signal area through the double-frequency bidirectional signal amplifier: and the unmanned aerial vehicle automatically patrols and examines the position transmission communication guarantee. The emergency information communication backhaul guarantee is based on broadband transmission equipment, narrowband transmission equipment, universal transmission equipment, a short-distance data transmission module and public network interface equipment, the propagation characteristics of wireless broadband signals and narrowband signals are fully utilized, equipment development is carried out through automatic adjustment of network data transmission strategies and reasonable layout of communication nodes, and no-signal area network coverage and reliable transmission online rate are realized.
assignees: YUXI POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Automatic early warning method for stability of foundation pit based on feedforward and circulating neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic pre-warning method for stability of a foundation pit based on a feedforward and circulating neural network, which comprises the following steps: s1, determining the type of acquired data; s2, installing measuring instruments at corresponding positions of the foundation pit to collect data; s3, preprocessing the data acquired in the step S1; s4, establishing a feedforward neural network; s5, establishing a back propagation mechanism; s6, obtaining the maximum value of each control index of foundation pit deformation according to the feedforward neural network model, taking the maximum value as a threshold value, and defining the safety level of the control index; s7, respectively establishing a single-layer RNN (RNN-network) circulating neural network for each control index in the S6 and training; s8, comparing the result of the change of each control index predicted by the RNN circulating neural network model along with the working condition with the threshold value in S6, and judging the safety level of each control index under the current working condition. The method solves the technical problem that the construction safety risk is high due to the fact that the deformation of the foundation pit cannot be accurately predicted and controlled in the foundation pit excavation process.
assignees: CHINA CONSTR 2ND ENG BUREAU

title_en: Mixed cascade multi-terminal direct current transient overvoltage risk suppression strategy determination method
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for determining a mixed cascade multi-terminal direct current transient overvoltage risk suppression strategy, which can determine a transient overvoltage target suppression strategy for reducing energy absorption of an energy dissipation device and improve the safe and stable operation level of a mixed cascade direct current and a transmitting and receiving end alternating current power grid. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring first operation information of an actual hybrid cascade multi-terminal direct current control system and second operation information of a transmitting-receiving-terminal alternating current power grid; constructing a first simulation model and a second simulation model according to the first operation information and the second operation information; carrying out electromechanical-electromagnetic hybrid simulation by adopting a first simulation model and a second simulation model, simulating line faults at different positions of the receiving end alternating current power grid, and screening out fault line sets with risks according to energy absorption values of energy dissipation devices under different fault lines; and carrying out inhibition operation on each fault line in the fault line set by adopting a preset transient overvoltage inhibition strategy, and determining a target inhibition strategy corresponding to each fault line.
assignees: EAST CHINA BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Power system toughness evaluation modeling method considering cascading overload fault occurrence under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system toughness assessment modeling method considering cascading overload faults under typhoon disasters, and relates to the field of power system analysis. The method establishes two fault models of physical faults and overload faults caused by an extreme typhoon scene, and analyzes the internal relation between the space-time change of the fault probability of the power transmission line and the overload outage probability and the operation limit thereof; the method has the advantages that a two-dimensional time sequence fault model under typhoon continuous disturbance is built, the whole fault evolution process takes the fault occurrence time as a unique retrieval standard, and the precision of fault path retrieval is improved; and a power transmission system toughness evaluation model is established, the whole toughness of the system is quantized and a weak toughness line of the clamping system is identified, the capability of a power grid operator for accurately sensing the typhoon disaster coping of the power system is facilitated, and a targeted toughness improvement strategy is formulated. The research result of the invention can provide thought for the future typhoon disaster to effectively carry out toughness expansion and upgrading on the power transmission system and the establishment of operation control strategies.
assignees: UNIV TAIYUAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Minimizing service disruption
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to minimizing service disruption. A User Equipment (UE) may detect a disaster condition and its solution based on broadcast information, RRC messaging, NAS messaging, capability to connect to allowed PLMNs, and an indication from a barred PLMN. In a disaster condition, the UE may perform an enhanced PLMN selection procedure, wherein, for example, if the disaster situation applies to the current location of the UE, the UE will prioritize forbidden PLMNs for the disaster roaming connection without regard to the PLMNs in the disaster situation. For disaster roaming connections, the UE may be configured by the otherwise barred PLMN with information about what services the UE may access and what types of authentication procedures the network can perform with the UE. When the end of the disaster condition is detected, the UE moves back to the allowed PLMN.
assignees: INTERDIGITAL PATENT HOLDINGS INC

title_en: Bayesian network-based fault diagnosis method for complex system in nuclear power plant
abstract_en: The application discloses a Bayesian network-based fault diagnosis method for a complex system in a nuclear power plant, which is based on a dynamic fault tree and utilizes a conversion rule to construct a dynamic Bayesian network model of the system, and specifically comprises the following steps: establishing a dynamic fault tree; constructing a system dynamic Bayesian network model by using the conversion rule; determining a conditional probability table of the Bayesian network; calculating to obtain a diagnosis result. The application combines dynamic fault tree analysis with Bayesian network, describes the fault behavior and fault propagation of the system by utilizing the dynamic fault tree model, then converts the fault behavior and fault propagation into the Bayesian network model, realizes fault diagnosis of the nuclear power plant system by means of probabilistic reasoning and learning, has large calculated amount by combining complex T-S dynamic gate description rules and dynamic fault tree algorithms, and solves the problem of complex calculation of the dynamic fault tree by utilizing condition independence assumption and bidirectional reasoning algorithm to calculate node failure probability and posterior probability in the dynamic Bayesian network.
assignees: UNIV HARBIN ENG

title_en: Method for reducing prediction power supply quantity error of power grid based on CNN-BILSTM algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for reducing the power supply quantity error of a predicted power grid based on a CNN-BILSTM algorithm, which comprises the following steps: acquiring data, cleaning the data, constructing characteristics, constructing an algorithm, improving a model (optimizing a data set), and verifying the model; according to the invention, based on a convolutional neural network-long and short term memory network (CNN-LSTM) algorithm, a two-way sequence propagation (BILSTM) is adopted for LSTM, so that the convolutional neural network-two-way long and short term memory network (CNN-BILSTM) is formed, the power supply quantity of a power grid is modeled and predicted through the algorithm, the model error is reduced by optimizing a data set under the condition of not damaging an original trained model, multiple training of the model is avoided, time and labor are saved, and the model error is effectively reduced.

title_en: Communication method and communication device
abstract_en: The application provides a communication method and a communication device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving a registration request from a terminal device, wherein the registration request is used for requesting registration to a first core network device; transmitting first request information to the second core network equipment based on the registration request, wherein the first request information is used for requesting to start disaster roaming; the first core network device is located in a first network, the second core network device is located in a second network, and the first network and the second network share access network devices. The disaster roaming mechanism under the architecture of the shared network is provided, the service interruption time of the terminal equipment is reduced, and the communication reliability is improved.
assignees: HUAWEI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent park energy management method and system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent park energy management method and system based on a digital twin technology, wherein the method comprises the following steps: data acquisition, data preprocessing, principal component analysis, random forest prediction model construction, back propagation neural network prediction model construction, combined model prediction analysis and digital twin model construction. The invention relates to the technical field of digital twin, in particular to an intelligent park energy management method and system based on a digital twin technology.
assignees: UNIV SHENZHEN TECHNOLOGY;SHENZHOULONG SPACE TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Risk transfer method for cascade hydropower junction group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a step hydroelectric junction group risk transfer method, which comprises the steps of drawing a step hydroelectric junction group risk network diagram aiming at different step compositions of a step hydroelectric junction group; based on the cascade hydroelectric junction group risk network diagram, constructing a graph neural network model, and establishing a risk transfer calculation method between different risk nodes and edges; acquiring historical water level, flow, gradient and intensity data of each step of a step hydropower junction group in a research area, and converting related data into dimensionless data serving as a graph neural network training data set; and (3) giving scenes of different water levels, flow rates and gradients, and calculating by using a graph neural network model to obtain risk values of all network nodes. The method fully digs the interaction relation of different levels of the cascade hydroelectric junction group and multiple elements in the levels, and solves the problem of insufficient consideration of the traditional risk analysis method on the interaction between factors.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium for evaluating cascade influence of local energy crisis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a local energy crisis cascade influence evaluation method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium based on an input-output model, which mainly comprise the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining an energy supply pressure index, obtaining an energy shortage probability, obtaining energy crisis sensitivity, obtaining energy crisis and cascade influence evaluation and determining a key supply link path. The invention provides a monetization index of the energy crisis, analyzes cascade influence from a view angle of a supply chain, namely analyzes the transfer relation and a driving mechanism of the energy crisis in an area department, identifies a supply chain conduction path of the energy crisis, has the advantages of wide application range, quick calculation mode and the like, and can provide a method and data support for improving the toughness of a trade network to the energy crisis.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING NORMAL

title_en: Pre-disaster scheduling pre-control method and system for considering line load rate under complex weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pre-disaster scheduling pre-control method and system for considering line load rate under complex weather, comprising the following steps: acquiring network parameters of a power grid, and acquiring a line affected by a disaster; constructing a disaster prevention pre-control scheduling mathematical model considering the load balance degree of the power grid according to the network parameters of the power grid and the disaster affected line; the optimization target of the model comprises the steps of taking the minimization of the average load rate of a line affected by disaster as an optimization target I, taking the minimization of the average absolute deviation of the load rate of the whole network transmission line as an optimization target II and taking the minimum running cost of the electric power system as an optimization target III; and solving the model to obtain a pre-disaster power dispatching scheme of the generator output and power flow distribution of the power grid. The invention realizes the effects of lower line load affected by disaster and more balanced overall load rate of the power grid, reduces the probability of cascade overload shutdown accidents caused by shutdown of the line affected by disaster, and improves the running reliability of the power grid and the toughness for resisting the influence of the disaster.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;JINHUA POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Space complex network collapse method based on cascade failure
abstract_en: The invention relates to a space complex network collapse method based on cascade failure, which relates to the technical field of space complex networks and solves the problems that the current space complex network collapse method does not consider the change of a topological structure to cause the material flow change in a network, and the network collapse effect cannot be accurately reflected. Comparing the evaluation index values obtained by the method with those obtained by other complex network disintegration methods, the method has better disintegration effect in the real network.
assignees: UNIV NORTHEAST DIANLI

title_en: Method and device for solving failure of ventilation network air quantity and air quality under condition of external fire
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for resolving failure of air quantity and air quality of a ventilation network under the condition of external fire, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an unsteady state ventilation network settlement mathematical model, a flue gas dispersion-diffusion unsteady state mathematical model, a heat exchange propagation unsteady state mathematical model and an oxygen consumption-migration unsteady state mathematical model; and combining a thermal diffusion coefficient and a flue gas diffusion coefficient calculation model, coupling an unsteady state ventilation network calculation mathematical model, a flue gas diffusion-diffusion unsteady state mathematical model, a heat exchange propagation unsteady state mathematical model and an oxygen consumption-migration unsteady state mathematical model, constructing a multi-field coupling network calculation mathematical model and a calculation method of air quantity-air temperature-oxygen concentration-flue gas concentration in the ventilation network in a fire period, and forming a wind network air quantity and wind quality failure calculation model and a calculation method in the fire period. The method can realize quantitative prediction of the failure result of the wind quality of the wind network system in the fire period, and perfect the intelligent ventilation and disaster emergency wind control theory and technology of the mine.
assignees: MEIKE TONGAN BEIJING INTELLIGENT CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wind-solar-water network hybrid optimization game scheduling method based on green evidence mechanism
abstract_en: A wind-light-water network hybrid optimization game scheduling method based on a green certificate mechanism comprises the following steps: the wind-light power station and the cascade hydropower station form a wind-light hydration alliance, a green certificate corresponding to the internet surfing power is obtained when the wind-light power station surfing the internet, the green certificate is sold into a green certificate market, and the regional power grid purchases the green certificate from the green certificate market; constructing a multi-objective multi-stage short-term optimization scheduling model of the wind-light water network; and respectively solving a multi-objective multi-stage short-term optimization scheduling model of the constructed wind, light and water network by adopting a Kriging meta-model solving algorithm, an ADMM algorithm and a GA algorithm. The method considers the wind-light-water uncertainty risk cost to reduce the uncertainty execution risk of the scheduling scheme; wind-solar water-combined alliance and regional power grid bilateral transaction based on master-slave game optimization model, and alliance benefit and regional power grid benefit are maximized; the water electricity regulation compensation electricity price is optimized through Nash bargaining, so that the benefits of multiple members are effectively improved compared with those before cooperation, and the step water electricity is stimulated to participate in wind and light absorption while the stability of the alliance is ensured.
assignees: UNIV CHINA THREE GORGES CTGU;CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Electrical coordination hub planning optimization method considering advanced adiabatic compressed air energy storage
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric coordination hub planning optimization method considering advanced adiabatic compressed air energy storage, belonging to the technical field of comprehensive energy system planning optimization; the electric coordination hub planning optimization method considering advanced adiabatic compressed air energy storage comprises the following steps: constructing a city-level electric coordination hub multi-energy cascade utilization frame, a multi-energy equipment model and an advanced heat-insulating compressed air energy storage refinement model; constructing an urban-level electric collaborative interconnection system model of regional combined cooling heating power and regional inter-electric ring network coupling; linearizing and dimension-reducing nonlinear items in an urban electric coordination hub multi-energy cascade utilization frame, a multi-energy equipment model, an advanced heat-insulating compressed air energy storage refined model and an urban electric coordination interconnection system model; based on the city-level electric coordination hub after dimension reduction and the city-level electric coordination interconnection system model, a city-level electric coordination hub planning optimization model considering advanced heat-insulating compressed air energy storage is built.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Method for trading medium-and-long-term electric power markets of hydropower enrichment power grid with compatible excitation
abstract_en: The invention provides a medium-long-term electric power market trading method for a hydropower enrichment power grid with compatible excitation, which is characterized by adopting the maximum individual power generation benefit and the minimum power purchase cost at the power grid side as targets, firstly carrying out optimal scheduling on a hydropower system with the maximum minimum output of the hydropower system as targets to obtain guaranteed electric quantity, then splitting the guaranteed electric quantity into basic electric quantity, inner-provincial electric quantity and east-west electric quantity to participate in corresponding market trading respectively, adopting a reinforcement learning algorithm to carry out loop iteration solution, and finally selecting different water supply frequencies and analyzing the power supply stability under different forms and different guaranteed electric quantities. The method has guiding significance for the problems of default, insufficient water resource utilization and the like caused by unreasonable competition of the cascade power stations, uncertain natural water supply and mismatching of the winning power quantity, and provides effective advice and direction for medium-long term transaction modes of the hydropower enrichment power grid.

title_en: Novel radio frequency identification network planning modeling method based on multistage cascade and supply chain layering
abstract_en: A novel radio frequency identification (Radio Frequency Identification, RFID) network planning (RFID Network Planning, RNP) modeling method based on multistage concatenation and supply chain layering, specifically comprising the following steps: firstly, acquiring a novel RNP communication link equation with multistage cascade characteristics according to connectivity between a tag and a reader, between adjacent readers and between the reader and a terminal; secondly, describing a novel RNP problem based on a supply chain structure, classifying roles of readers and providing three brand-new link modes, and then constructing an RNP optimization target model around positioning accuracy, label coverage and forwarding hop count. The novel RNP modeling method designed by the invention has certain guiding significance for deployment of readers and selection of links in large-scale RNP problems.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN POLYTECHNIC

title_en: Combined optimization method of transmission and distribution cooperative safety constraint unit based on target cascading method
abstract_en: The wind power installed capacity optimization method considering dynamic frequency constraint and multiple uncertainties comprises the following steps: step 1: constructing a transmission and distribution cooperative system, wherein: the power transmission network layer comprises a large-scale centralized wind turbine generator set, a traditional thermal power generating unit and a load; the distribution network layer comprises controllable distributed energy power generation, distributed renewable energy power generation, energy storage and load. Step 2: respectively constructing an upper-layer power transmission network unit combination model and a lower-layer power distribution network economic dispatch model; step 3: and (3) converting the nonlinear term in the step 2 model into a mixed integer linear programming problem by adopting an incremental segmentation method and a second order cone technology. Step 4: and taking the exchange power of the connecting lines between the transmission and distribution networks as coupling variables, decoupling an upper-layer transmission and grid unit combination model and a lower-layer distribution network economic dispatch model by adopting a target cascading method, and carrying out parallel optimization solving. The optimization method of the invention not only can ensure the accuracy of solution, but also can ensure the safe and economic operation of the transmission and distribution network.
assignees: UNIV CHINA THREE GORGES CTGU

title_en: Method, system, electronic equipment and medium for predicting residual life of intelligent ammeter
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system, electronic equipment and a medium for predicting the residual life of an intelligent ammeter, which are suitable for the technical field of intelligent ammeters and can improve the accuracy of predicting the residual life and the fault probability of the intelligent ammeter. The method comprises the following steps: according to the application environment data, the factory verification data and the characteristic values of the correlation coefficient matrix of the real-time monitoring data of the intelligent electric meter, determining the accumulated contribution rate of each related data of the intelligent electric meter and a main parameter sequence affecting the residual life of the intelligent electric meter, inputting the main parameter sequence into a transformation neural network and a counter-propagation neural network, training a model for predicting the residual life of the intelligent electric meter, and obtaining the residual life predicted value of the intelligent electric meter based on the model.
assignees: State Grid Tianjin Electric Power Company Marketing Service Center;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Wind power ultra-short-term prediction method and system based on improved TCN-LSTM model
abstract_en: The application provides a wind power ultra-short-term prediction method and system based on an improved TCN-LSTM model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a wind power plant power generation power data set, and preprocessing the wind power plant power generation power data set to generate a wind power preprocessing data set; establishing a TPA-TCN network according to a time convolution network and a time sequence mode attention mechanism; performing feature extraction on the wind power pretreatment data set according to the TPA-TCN network to generate a wind power feature data set; cascading the long-term memory network with the TPA-TCN network to construct a TPA-TCN-LSTM network model; and optimizing and iterating the super parameters in the TPA-TCN-LSTM network model according to a sparrow search algorithm to generate the TPA-TCN-LSTM network model with optimal parameters so as to predict wind power and solve the problem of low accuracy of real-time prediction of wind power.
assignees: LINCANG POWER SUPPLY BUREAU YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Short-term load prediction method based on multiple similar days and stacked learning
abstract_en: A short-term load prediction method based on a plurality of similar days and stack learning 1) processes time-series power load data with high nonlinearity and non-stationarity by using a sliding window algorithm; 2) The integrated learning method of the stacked neural network is provided, in the pre-training process, a radial basis function, a random vector function link and a back propagation neural network are integrated into a base layer network to provide a robust prediction model, and the base layer network utilizes a deep belief network and an improved generalized learning system to improve the prediction precision; 3) A similarity day prediction method is provided for extracting similar characteristics of the power load data in different time dimensions, so that the robustness and accuracy of the model are further enhanced. The present invention is achieved by using three strategies: the sliding window algorithm, the stacking algorithm and the similar day prediction method effectively extract the space-time characteristics of the historical load data, reduce the calculated amount, effectively improve the model prediction precision and enhance the robustness and accuracy of the prediction model.
assignees: UNIV NANCHANG

title_en: Method for calculating input impedance of defective cable
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for calculating input impedance of a defective cable, which belongs to the technical field of cable defect detection, and comprises the following steps: constructing a simulation cable corresponding to the defective cable; determining basic electrical parameters of the simulation cable and each set frequency point on a preset frequency band signal to be fed into the simulation cable; dividing the defective cable into a healthy unit section and a defective unit section according to basic electrical parameters, cascading each unit section to form a composite network so as to multiply the chain parameter matrixes to obtain the chain parameter matrixes of the whole simulation cable, and calculating the input impedance of the defective cable under each set frequency point by utilizing the downlink parameter matrixes of each set frequency point; the chain parameter matrix of each unit section can be calculated in parallel to further obtain the chain parameter matrix of the whole simulation cable and the corresponding input impedance, so that the technical problem that the calculation efficiency is low due to the fact that the impedance of each unit needs to be iterated one by one in the calculation of the input impedance of the existing defective cable is solved.
assignees: UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH

title_en: Numerical simulation method and system for simulating expansion of fracture in conglomerate
abstract_en: The invention relates to a conglomerate reservoir hydraulic fracture propagation numerical simulation method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, establishing a geological model of a conglomerate oil reservoir according to geological feature parameters of the conglomerate oil reservoir; s2, establishing a geomechanical model of the conglomerate oil deposit according to geomechanical parameter characteristics of the conglomerate oil deposit; s3, analyzing geological characteristic parameters and geomechanical parameters of the conglomerate oil reservoir to obtain a ground stress direction and natural crack distribution parameters; s4, analyzing the conglomerate oil reservoir fracturing technological parameters, and establishing a pumping program; and S5, combining the results obtained in the step S3 and the step S4, and performing hydraulic fracturing complex fracture network expansion simulation calculation to obtain a fracture simulation result. The invention can consider the interaction of complex fracture network expansion and the intersection of the hydraulic fracture tip and the natural fracture, and judge whether the hydraulic fracture is crossing or cutting off; the stress shadows can be calculated by taking into account fracturing fluid flow and proppant migration, applying the boundary element method, and taking into account inter-fracture interference.
assignees: PETROCHINA CO LTD

title_en: TEM inversion method based on nearest unit multi-head attention and multi-scale coding mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a TEM inversion method based on a nearest unit multi-head attention and a multi-scale coding mechanism, which comprises the following steps: improving the encoder module based on the visual transducer ViT having multiple heads of attention; constructing an input cascade patch module; constructing a mark position code embedding module; improving the decoder; the method comprises the steps of combining and connecting an input cascade patch module, a mark position coding embedding module, an encoder and a decoder to construct a TEM inversion converter network model; and training a TEM inversion converter network model, and predicting the ground electric structure and landslide water-bearing layer structure of the unknown ground by using the TEM inversion converter network model. The built TEM inversion converter network model has the advantages of good imaging accuracy and high speed, and can finely detect the shallow structure within the depth range of 100 meters.
assignees: HUBEI UNIV OF ECONOMICS

title_en: Markov Process cascading failure path generation method and device starting from meteorological disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to a Markov Process cascading failure path generation method and a Markov Process cascading failure path generation device starting from a meteorological disaster, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when extreme weather occurs, all line load flow states in a network topology structure of the power system are detected, the line load flow states are calculated through a load flow state outage model, the economic loss condition of the power grid is comprehensively considered according to the topology change and the load loss quantity, the risk index of a chain fault path is determined by combining the line outage probability and the economic loss condition of the power grid, the outage line is determined by the index, and a plurality of rounds of circulating processing are carried out to obtain early warning information.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;WUHAN QIYI ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Multi-target optimal power flow calculation method and terminal based on cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-target optimal power flow calculation method and a terminal based on cascading failures, which calculate the power grid risk based on the action characteristics of distance type backup protection of a power system, so that the power grid risk degree of the current power grid to the cascading failures can be reflected by combining the action characteristics of the distance type backup protection on the basis of analyzing the cascading failure expression form. The power generation cost is defined by considering the power grid economy of cascading failures, equation constraint conditions and inequality constraint conditions are set for the initial failures of the power system, a multi-target optimal power flow model is built by combining the power grid danger degree, the minimum power generation cost, the equation constraint conditions and the inequality constraint conditions, the advantage complementation of the system safety and the economy can be achieved, the power generation cost can be reduced, and meanwhile, the power grid safety margin is improved, so that an optimal power flow calculation result considering both the safety and the economy is obtained.
assignees: STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD YONGAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY;SANMING POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Nuclear power plant state prediction method based on interpretable machine learning
abstract_en: A nuclear power plant state prediction method based on interpretable machine learning constructs and trains a feedforward-backward propagation full-connected neural network model comprising an input layer, an output layer and a hidden layer in an off-line stage, calculates marginal contribution of each feature output by the trained feedforward-backward propagation full-connected neural network model through an SHAP interpretable algorithm in an on-line stage, and judges parameters with larger influence on target parameters in multiple parameters. The invention predicts the key parameters of the system under the accident condition of the reactor by using the multi-layer feedforward-back propagation fully-connected neural network added with the interpretable algorithm, and simultaneously judges the parameters with larger influence on the target parameters in the multi-parameters, thereby being capable of deeply mining the hidden value in the data generated in the nuclear power production and operation process, guiding the operation and maintenance decision and improving the utilization rate of the data asset.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: Power generation plan analysis method for power grid direct-regulation basin cascade hydropower station
abstract_en: The invention provides a power generation plan analysis method for a grid direct-regulation basin cascade hydropower station, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of grid-connected unit number limiting factor design, climbing period factor design, unit start-stop variable factor design, duty record template factor design, unit start-stop and grid-connected unit number criterion design, automatically acquiring power generation plan related data from a related system according to fixed data reading frequency, and obtaining hydropower station power generation plan change conditions, unit start-stop advice and initial duty record through designed system core algorithm logic calculation. The method can solve the problems that the hydropower station in the river basin cascade is not timely in scheduling connection, and the scheduling flow is not standard in the execution process of the power generation plan.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Multi-layer collaborative optimization method, system, equipment and medium for power distribution network-energy storage-user
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network-energy storage-user multilayer collaborative optimization method, a system, equipment and a medium, belongs to the technical field of power distribution network planning, and aims to provide a novel power distribution network-energy storage-user multilayer collaborative optimization method, a system, equipment and a medium. Comprising the following steps: the distributed energy storage of the combined user and the centralized energy storage of the energy storage operators form a distributed energy storage set and a centralized energy storage sharing cloud energy storage mode; constructing a multi-layer collaborative operation optimization model, wherein the multi-layer collaborative operation optimization model comprises an upper-layer power distribution network model, a middle-layer shared energy storage model and a lower-layer user cluster model; and carrying out layered optimization solution on the multi-layer collaborative operation optimization model by adopting a target cascade analysis algorithm to obtain an optimal scheme, and carrying out optimization scheduling on energy storage of the cloud energy storage mode according to the optimal scheme. The layering optimization solution of the model is realized by adopting a target cascading analysis algorithm, so that the economic benefit of each participating main body is improved, and the influence caused by the grid connection of the distributed clean energy is reduced.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Reaction diffusion model for negative information propagation and construction method thereof
abstract_en: A reaction diffusion model for negative information propagation is shown in a formula (1), and the construction method of the reaction diffusion model comprises the steps of dividing people in a social network into three types, carrying out negative information and positive information propagation processes, determining balance points and basic regeneration numbers of the reaction diffusion model, and determining local asymptotic stability conditions of the balance points of the reaction diffusion model. Because the invention adopts the positive information, the infected user I  2  (x, t) and diffusion coefficient d, solving the problem of the prior art that the infected user I with positive information  2  The problem that (x, t) and the diffusion coefficient d are not considered at the same time has the advantage of more clearly characterizing the user behavior in the social network, and the advantage that increasing the conversion rate of the positive information eventually leads to the elimination of the negative information. The model can be used as a target model for the following purposesThe propagation mechanism of the negative information is analyzed.
assignees: UNIV SHAANXI NORMAL

title_en: SVR-SMA-based alternating current-direct current series-parallel power grid cascading failure prediction and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an alternating current-direct current series-parallel power grid cascading failure prediction and early warning method based on SVR-SMA, and belongs to the technical field of safety and stability analysis of power systems. The method comprises the following steps: screening out a cascading failure characterization variable from electric data acquired by an alternating current/direct current multi-feed cascading failure receiving end power grid, and taking the cascading failure characterization variable as an input quantity of a prediction model; the coordinated optimization algorithm based on the SMA and the SVR is provided, the punishment parameter C of the SVR and the bandwidth sigma of the Gaussian kernel function are optimized through an SMA random search strategy, and an alternating current-direct current series-parallel power grid cascading failure prediction model is established; through the position relation between the normal voltage of the li-clear converter bus and the fault hyperplane and the predicted value, the cascading fault online early warning method is provided. The cascading failure early warning method and the prediction system can be used for simulating the failure condition of each converter station when the important alternating current line of the alternating current/direct current multi-feed receiving end power grid fails, and have the accuracy and the rapidness required by engineering practice.
assignees: UNIV KUNMING SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Risk assessment method and system based on coupling analysis of power grid and power communication network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk assessment method and system based on coupling analysis of a power grid and a power communication network, and belongs to the technical field of power communication. Primary line risk identification is carried out on a power grid side through power grid risk evaluation indexes, importance ordering of power lines is carried out, power grid guarantee requirements are obtained and transmitted to a power communication network side, and guarantee measures are formulated on the power communication network side; according to the risk assessment results, the risk points are sequenced at the power communication network side through the communication risk assessment indexes, the reliability sequencing results are obtained, and the communication risk is transmitted to the power network side, so that the power network side is ready to deal with the plan. Fully considering the risk bidirectional transfer process between two networks, performing risk assessment on the operation of the two networks, and avoiding large-scale fault cascading; the problem that the risk transfer flow and the fault range control strategy are not clear is solved.
assignees: INFORMATION COMMUNICATION CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Man-machine terminal picture data interaction method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a man-machine terminal picture data interaction method and a system, which relate to the technical field of data interaction and comprise the following steps: installing a traveling wave sensor, acquiring fault electromagnetic waves, determining a time stamp and traveling wave propagation speed, and determining a fault area through a fault positioning algorithm; acquiring traveling wave signal data of fault electromagnetic waves according to a fault region, simultaneously acquiring power grid topology data, extracting traveling wave characteristics and topology characteristics, determining structural characteristics, identifying the shortest path of nodes in a power grid topology graph, and combining clustering coefficients to perform characteristic fusion to obtain a comprehensive topology vector; the method comprises the steps of encoding a comprehensive topological vector based on a graph neural network, carrying out node feature fusion on traveling wave features and the encoded comprehensive topological vector, generating initial node features, updating the initial node features through the graph neural network by combining a attention mechanism introduced in advance, generating input node features, combining the traveling wave features, carrying out fault location through a random forest module in the graph neural network, and determining a fault position.

title_en: Electric vehicle charging station load prediction method under electric-traffic coupling system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting the load of an electric vehicle charging station under an electric-traffic coupling system, which comprises the following steps: obtaining training data; adjusting an updating strategy of the depth model to enable the depth model to be suitable for a training process under a safe federal linear regression framework, ensuring data privacy safety of a power distribution network and a traffic network in a combined training process, and obtaining an EGAT-LSTM space-time correlation prediction model after adjustment of the updating strategy; arranging the EGAT-LSTM load prediction model after the update strategy adjustment on a power distribution network and traffic network computing platform respectively, setting the EGAT-LSTM load prediction model as a power distribution network and traffic network sub-model in federal learning, and integrating the EGAT-LSTM load prediction model into a subsequent safe federal linear regression training framework; the power grid and traffic network training data are respectively input into a VFedEGAT-LSTM electric vehicle charging station load prediction sub-model, and under the condition that the privacy of a power distribution network and a traffic network is ensured, the sub-model carries out a forward propagation process and interacts an intermediate result to realize global space-time correlation training and prediction.
assignees: UNIV YANSHAN

title_en: Robust optimization scheduling method, device, equipment and medium for gradient water-light complementary distribution
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of optimal scheduling of a multi-energy complementary power generation system, in particular to a robust optimal scheduling method, device, equipment and medium for cascade water-light complementary distribution, which comprises the following steps: taking peak-valley difference of a receiving end power grid, minimum hydropower intra-day adjustment power and minimum light rejection into consideration, and establishing an objective function of a step water-light complementation two-stage distribution robust model before and in the day; establishing two-stage constraint conditions of a day-ahead stage and a day-in stage; based on a data driving method, establishing a confidence set considering 1-norm and ++norm constraint uncertainty probability distribution; based on piecewise linearization and McCormick relaxation, converting the distributed robust model into a mixed integer linear programming model; and solving the mixed integer linear programming model by adopting a column and constraint generation algorithm to obtain the gradient water-light complementary distribution robust optimization scheduling method. According to the invention, the peak shaving capacity of complementary operation can be improved, and the operation risk caused by uncertainty of photovoltaic output prediction can be reduced.

title_en: Low-heat-release low-toxicity weather-resistant environment-friendly flame-retardant looped network cable for rail transit
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cables, in particular to a low-heat-release low-toxicity weather-resistant environment-friendly flame-retardant looped network cable for rail transit, which comprises a wire, a looped network layer and an outer protective layer, wherein the wire is made of stranded tinned copper wires, an insulating layer is wrapped on the upper surface of the wire, the insulating layer is made of crosslinked polyethylene, the looped network layer is wrapped on the upper surface of the insulating layer, and the looped network layer is made of polyimide woven mesh tubes. Through the cable, the wires of the stranded tinned copper wires are guaranteed to have good conductivity, meanwhile, the corrosion resistance, oxidation resistance and flexibility of the wires are further improved, and the upper surfaces of the wires are wrapped with the insulating layers of the crosslinked polyethylene, so that the cable has good electrical insulation performance and heat resistance, and is suitable for insulation requirements in a high-temperature environment. The aluminum oxide material of the flame-retardant layer can effectively improve the flame retardant property of the cable, ensure that the cable can slow down the fire and delay the flame propagation when a fire disaster occurs.
assignees: JIANGSU RUNHUA CABLE SHAREHOLDING CO LTD

title_en: SCADA-based gas pipe network operation data transmission system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of gas pipe networks, and discloses a gas pipe network operation data transmission system based on SCADA, which comprises a main dispatching control center and a main dispatching control center, wherein the main dispatching control center is used for data operation and transmission control of a total natural gas station; the sub-dispatching control center is used for assisting in data operation and transmission control of the global total natural gas station and the local natural gas station; and the disaster recovery backup center is used for asynchronously copying and receiving the database data, the file system data, the operating system data and the like after disaster is suffered by the main scheduling control center and the sub scheduling control center. In the invention, after the main dispatching control center stops service, the operation of the disaster recovery center is manually or automatically switched to ensure that the business of the sub dispatching control center is not interrupted. After the service of the main dispatching control center is restored, the main dispatching control center can be manually or automatically switched back, and lost data is returned from the backup center of the sub dispatching center to the main dispatching control center, so that the situations of data loss and service interruption are avoided.
assignees: HEBEI GAS CO LTD

title_en: Wind-solar capacity double-layer optimization configuration method for cascade water-wind-solar multi-energy complementary power generation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind-solar capacity double-layer optimization configuration method of a cascade water-wind-solar multi-energy complementary power generation system, and belongs to the technical field of new energy power generation. The method solves the problem that the capacity of the wind-solar power station is unreasonable in the prior art, builds a multi-energy complementary power generation system, and builds a multi-energy complementary power generation system output model; acquiring constraint conditions of a multi-energy complementary power generation system; establishing a double-layer optimization model, and establishing an outer-layer capacity optimization configuration model by taking the maximum light capacity regulation and the maximum total water-wind-light output of the multi-energy complementary power generation system as objective functions; establishing an inner-layer operation optimization configuration model by taking the highest output and the highest power grid load tracking degree and the highest economical efficiency of the multi-energy complementary power generation system in the daily combined power generation process as objective functions; the multi-energy complementary system comprises three energy forms of water power, wind power and photovoltaic, fully considers the natural complementary characteristics of wind and light resources and the peak regulation capability of water power, and realizes the selection of the optimal capacity of the wind and light new energy power station.
assignees: SOUTHWEST BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA

title_en: Step-down mining capacity prediction method of natural gas hydrate by deep neural network
abstract_en: To provide a production capacity prediction method of decompression mining of a natural gas hydrate based on deep neural network.SOLUTION: A method for constructing a neural network model, and training, optimizing, testing and evaluating a model, using existing step-down mining test data of a multi-scale natural gas hydrate includes: collecting and pre-treating step-down mining test data of a multi-scale natural gas hydrate; constructing a deep neural network model including one input layer, three hidden layers and one output layer; optimizing a network parameter through a reverse propagation algorithm; evaluating calculation accuracy of a model using two parameters of a determination coefficient and an average relative error and obtaining a production capacity prediction model having high accuracy and small errors; and predicting production capacity of a step-down mining test of a natural gas hydrate in different scales and mining parameters, by designing and using a production capacity prediction module.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Method for improving water and electricity-new energy complementary capacity in flood season
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of influence evaluation of dynamic flood limit water level on water and electricity-new energy, and discloses a method for improving complementary capacity of water and electricity-new energy in a flood season, which comprises the following steps: s1, constructing a cascade hydropower-new energy complementary model, wherein the cascade hydropower-new energy complementary model comprises an objective function with the maximum source-load matching degree under a certain power rejection rate condition, and power grid constraint, power station constraint and hydraulic constraint; s2, designing a dynamic flood limit water level determining method to determine the upper limit of the dynamic flood limit water level of the hydraulic class constraint in the cascade hydropower-new energy complementary model; and S3, solving the cascade hydropower-new energy complementary model by using a genetic algorithm to obtain the hydropower and new energy corresponding generated energy and electric quantity shortage when the source charge matching degree is maximum. In the actual dispatching operation, the invention can combine the flood forecasting condition, and adopts the means of pre-discharging in advance before the flood comes to vacate a certain adjustment storage capacity so as to promote the water and electricity-new energy consumption.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;SICHUAN NEW POWER SYSTEM RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Relay protection fixed value risk assessment method based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a relay protection constant risk assessment method based on a neural network, which belongs to the field of relay protection cascading failure type identification and risk assessment, and comprises the steps of collecting historical data of a power system to form a historical data sample set, processing the collected data, substituting the processed data into a model for training, screening the trained data as experience data for relay protection constant risk assessment.
assignees: BAOTOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH COMPANY INNER MONGOLIA POWER GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Optimized scheduling method, device, equipment and medium for cascade water wind-solar complementary system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of optimal scheduling of power systems, in particular to an optimal scheduling method, device, equipment and medium of a cascade water wind-light complementary system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing constraint conditions of step water wind-solar complementary system scheduling, wherein the constraint conditions comprise: electric power characteristic constraint, hydraulic characteristic constraint and water-electricity coupling characteristic constraint of the cascade hydropower station, and water-wind-light coupling characteristic constraint and output characteristic constraint of the cascade water-wind-light complementary system; according to constraint conditions, taking the maximum sum of the medium-long-term scheduling effect and the short-term scheduling effect of the cascade water-wind-solar system as an objective function, and constructing a cascade water-wind-solar complementary system scheduling model; and solving the scheduling model by using a linearization method to obtain an optimized scheduling result. According to the invention, a step hydroelectric-wind power-photovoltaic complementary system power generation scheme meeting the constraint can be provided, the overall utility of the system is improved, the waste wind and the waste light are reduced, the resource integration of a new energy power generation system is realized, and the safe and stable operation of a power grid is ensured.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI;YALONG RIVER HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Carbon emission prediction method and system based on improved long-term and short-term memory network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy consumption prediction, in particular to a carbon emission prediction method and system based on an improved long-short-term memory network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring training data of a node, wherein the training data comprises a historical load sequence and a corresponding carbon emission factor; taking the super-parameters of the LSTM network as the variables of Bayesian optimization, training the super-parameters of the LSTM network according to the training data, and updating the super-parameters of the LSTM network by combining loss function evaluation and back propagation; determining sampling points of the next iteration based on Gaussian process regression, and iteratively training super parameters of the LSTM network to obtain a trained LSTM network; acquiring a real-time load sequence, and predicting carbon emission factors corresponding to the real-time load sequence on line by utilizing a trained LSTM network; the invention can rapidly predict the carbon emission factor.
assignees: FOSHAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF NORTHEASTERN UNIV

title_en: Three-dimensional assembly model change propagation influence evaluation method based on feature driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional assembly model change propagation influence evaluation method based on characteristic driving, which specifically comprises the following steps: step 1, establishing a characteristic assembly relation network of a three-dimensional assembly model; step 2, selecting the part relation network in the step 1 to evaluate the influence of part change; and 3, selecting the characteristic assembly relation network in the step 1 to evaluate the characteristic change propagation influence. The method comprehensively considers 4 aspects of importance of the part assembly topological structure, characteristic change propagation paths, characteristic change propagation indexes and characteristic change propagation evolution rules, and comprehensively analyzes and evaluates the characteristic change propagation influence of the three-dimensional assembly model; when the geometric topological shape of the three-dimensional part model is changed, the influence of the part and the characteristic granularity layer on the part can be comprehensively evaluated, and a foundation is provided for the change propagation decision and control of the three-dimensional assembly model.

title_en: Dynamic risk assessment method for photovoltaic-containing power grid by short-term power prediction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic power grid dynamic risk assessment method utilizing short-term power prediction, which comprises the following steps: according to the historical power output of the photovoltaic power generation field and the current weather forecast parameters, obtaining a power forecast value of the photovoltaic power generation field in the power grid, and establishing a fault propagation mechanism model for simulating the evolution process of the power failure accident of the system; according to the model, carrying out simulation on power failure accidents, and recording four index data of node voltage deviation, system load rate, load loss rate and inertia loss rate; and screening a plurality of groups from the index data, and calculating weights of four indexes by adopting a comprehensive weighting method combining an objective entropy weighting method and an improved analytic hierarchy process to obtain a risk assessment result. According to the invention, the dynamic power output prediction is carried out on the power system containing the photovoltaic power generation, the index data is obtained by simulation under the power system fault propagation mechanism model, the index weight is calculated, the power grid dynamic risk assessment result is obtained, and the assessment is accurate.
assignees: HENAN JIUYU ENPAI ELECTRIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Forest fire risk prediction method based on graph convolution neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a forest fire risk prediction method based on a graph convolution neural network. By establishing a characteristic representation method and a graph construction technology suitable for geospatial data and combining a graph convolutional neural network (GCN) which is a deep learning technology focusing on a graph structure, comprehensively considering the influence of weather, topography and vegetation space-time data characteristics of adjacent areas of a prediction target area on fire occurrence and propagation, a novel method which is different from a method for predicting forest fire risk by considering only the space-time data characteristics of the prediction target area is formed, so that a forest fire occurrence rule is better understood, and a technical approach is provided for realizing more accurate forest fire risk assessment.
assignees: AEROSPACE INFORMATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Node division and time step selection method, device and equipment for pipe network transient flow
abstract_en: The invention discloses a node division and time step selection method, device and equipment of pipe network transient flow, and relates to the technical field of energy power engineering simulation, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out node division on a pipe network and calculating to obtain the pressure fluctuation amplitude of each node of a pipeline; setting a pressure fluctuation amplitude threshold to divide a pipe network into a sensitive area and a non-sensitive area, and determining short pipes in the sensitive area based on pressure wave propagation time; acquiring a pipeline with the shortest pressure wave propagation time except for a short pipe in the sensitive area as the shortest pipeline, determining a time step, and dividing pipeline nodes in the sensitive area; dividing the pipeline nodes of the non-sensitive area based on the determined time step, adopting an elastic model for the pipelines except the shortest pipeline in the sensitive area, adopting a short pipeline model for the time delay effect for the pipeline in the non-sensitive area, and performing transient flow calculation. According to the method and the device, the number of pipe network segments is greatly reduced and the calculation efficiency is greatly improved on the premise that accuracy and the accuracy of a physical process are guaranteed.
assignees: NO 719 RES INSTITUTE CHINA STATE SHIPBUILDING CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent analysis method and terminal for power grid monitoring signals
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent analysis method and a terminal of a power grid monitoring signal, which are characterized in that the power grid monitoring signal is obtained from an original power grid monitoring signal database, the power grid monitoring signal is encoded to obtain an encoded value, the encoded value is clustered by using a neighbor propagation clustering algorithm, the power grid monitoring signal is stored in a classification database according to the obtained clustering result, the power grid monitoring signal is effectively and accurately classified in a mode of encoding before clustering, and a monitoring person can know different types of fault conditions only from the classification database, so that the workload of the monitoring person is reduced, and the power grid monitoring efficiency is effectively improved.
assignees: ZHANGZHOU ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Method and device for building and predicting load prediction model of power distribution network
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to the field of power systems, and in particular, to a method and apparatus for building and predicting a load prediction model of a power distribution network. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a power consumption load data set and an influence factor data set; extracting a power utilization characteristic set from the power utilization load data set; performing multi-level hierarchical clustering on the electricity utilization feature set to obtain electricity utilization aggregation information; establishing a training sample set according to the electricity consumption aggregation information, the electricity consumption load data set and the influence factor data set; constructing a neural network model cascaded with a group intelligent optimization algorithm to optimize the weight and the threshold of the neural network model; and training the neural network model by using the training sample set, and taking the trained neural network model as a power distribution network load prediction model. According to the embodiment of the specification, the electricity load prediction accuracy of the power distribution network, which is continuously changed along with the development of the emerging industry, can be improved.
assignees: STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RES INST STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Hydropower station group peak-welting summer peak capacity analysis method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of cascade hydropower station group scheduling, in particular to a hydropower station group peak-to-peak summer peak capacity analysis method, which has important significance for relieving peak power supply pressure of a power grid and ensuring safe operation of a power system. The technical proposal is as follows: firstly, setting corresponding constraint conditions of a peak power generation scheduling model of a hydropower station according to an electric quantity plan issued by a power grid and an initial water level and incoming water prediction condition of a hydropower station, and ensuring electric quantity supply when hydropower participates in system peak regulation; on the basis, a rapid solving method based on hydropower station daily maximum power generation capacity trial calculation and hydropower station operation mode dynamic classification is provided, and the electric quantity distribution rolling calculation is utilized, so that the hydropower station peak problem is efficiently solved. According to the method, the working position can be dynamically adjusted according to the power generation capacity of the hydropower station, a reasonable hydropower mid-term peak operation result is obtained rapidly, reasonable arrangement of hydropower mid-term planning is achieved, and decision support is provided for the regional power grid hydropower station group peak-welcome summer scheduling operation.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Financial risk assessment management method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a financial risk assessment management method and a system in the technical field of risk management, and the method comprises the following steps: based on the financial data set, a decision tree classification algorithm is adopted to conduct subdivision and identification of historical risk events, correlation among risk events is learned and analyzed through correlation rules, potential risk patterns are revealed, and a risk pattern analysis result is generated. According to the invention, a huge financial data set can be processed more quickly and effectively by using a decision tree classification algorithm and association rule learning, the timeliness and accuracy of risk assessment are improved, a graph network analysis method and a dynamics principle are adopted, a risk propagation path in a complex financial network can be analyzed deeply, more comprehensive systematic risk assessment is provided, the randomness and uncertainty of financial data are processed effectively by using a Bayesian network model and an autoregressive moving average model, and the flexibility and adaptability of short-term and long-term financial behavior prediction are improved.
assignees: CHENFENG PLANNING SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Automatic voltage control method for AC/DC hybrid power grid containing high-proportion new energy
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic voltage control method of an alternating current-direct current hybrid power grid containing high-proportion new energy, which is used for determining a calculation model of the dynamic reactive power reserve evaluation of the alternating current-direct current hybrid power grid according to the operation constraint condition of the dynamic reactive power reserve evaluation of the alternating current-direct current hybrid power grid; the method comprises the steps of taking the minimum dynamic reactive power reserve of an alternating current-direct current hybrid power grid as a target, and establishing a corresponding optimization model based on a calculation model of the dynamic reactive power reserve evaluation of the alternating current-direct current hybrid power grid; and then solving an optimization model of the AC-DC hybrid power grid dynamic reactive power reserve estimation according to whether the operation constraint conditions of the AC-DC hybrid power grid dynamic reactive power reserve estimation are linear or not by adopting different strategies, so as to obtain an optimization result of the AC-DC hybrid power grid dynamic reactive power reserve estimation. The method can rapidly determine the boundary of the dynamic reactive power reserve of the alternating current-direct current hybrid power grid on the premise of ensuring the calculation precision of the dynamic reactive power reserve, and provides conditions for real-time online application, thereby helping to avoid cascading failures and voltage breakdown.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Method and system for evaluating high-frequency harmonic wave propagation characteristics based on cable modeling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating high-frequency harmonic propagation characteristics based on cable modeling, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a PI model structure of the cable based on the structural parameters of the cable; calculating model parameters of the PI model structure; based on the calculated model parameters, the risk of resonance occurring in the propagation of the high frequency harmonics in the cable is evaluated. The cable modeling method suitable for high-frequency harmonic wave propagation characteristic analysis can simulate the response characteristic of the cable under high-frequency harmonic wave input, and is applied to the practical application scene of high-frequency harmonic wave propagation characteristic and resonance risk research of a large power grid.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Cascade hydroelectric annual power generation plan manufacturing method considering uncertain water supply
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for manufacturing a step hydroelectric annual power generation plan by considering uncertain water supply, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: it comprises the following steps: s1, running a long-series running process of the running water level under water; s2, determining annual planning production of the underwater step power station; according to the invention, by considering complex constraint limits such as practical unit overhaul arrangement and power grid load demands, the obtained water level operation process of each power station in the step is smooth, and is closer to the historical practical dispatching operation condition and water level process of each power station in the step for many years; meanwhile, as the annual running plan of the step power station is produced by taking the actual complex water conditions of history into consideration in long-series calculation, the acquired annual water level process of the step power station has stronger adaptability to different water of steps, and meanwhile, the model has higher solving and calculating efficiency.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: BP neural network algorithm and temperature measurement system capable of being used for temperature prediction of electrical equipment of transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a BP neural network algorithm for predicting the temperature of electrical equipment of a transformer substation, in particular to a multi-input single-output three-layer BP neural network, which comprises an input variable X, an hidden layer node Y, weights W of the variable X and the hidden layer node Y and weights V of the hidden layer node Y and an output Z node, and comprises forward propagation and backward propagation. The invention also discloses a temperature measurement system which can monitor and predict the temperatures of all important areas and equipment of the transformer substation by combining with the BP neural network algorithm.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power system risk assessment method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system risk assessment method, a system, equipment and a medium, and relates to the technical field of power systems. And constructing a network attack model corresponding to the power system by acquiring architecture data of the power system and adopting the architecture data. And carrying out cascading failure analysis on the network attack model based on a preset network attack type to generate system load loss. And calculating the product of the system load loss and the corresponding attack probability to generate a system risk value. And performing resource allocation based on the safety resources corresponding to the power system, the system risk value and the system load loss, and generating a risk assessment result corresponding to the power system. Considering the cascade effect caused by network attack, the cascade effect can lead to the spread of faults to be quicker and wider, and the risk assessment result is inaccurate when the cascade effect is ignored. The risk of different types can be quantitatively evaluated, the severity of the risk can be better known, and corresponding defensive measures are adopted.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Power distribution network station line-to-user identification method and system based on power frequency distortion signals
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power grid equipment line identification and power supply, and relates to a power distribution network station line household change identification method and system based on a power frequency distortion signal. The invention realizes the identification of the power distribution website-line-transformer-household power supply relation based on the power distribution network power frequency voltage distortion signal, has unique working mechanism and easy realization, and has the advantages that the signal can directly penetrate the distribution transformer to the low-voltage user side, and the invention has the advantages of long propagation distance and coverage of all medium-low voltage power distribution networks.
assignees: HEBI POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HANAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Asteroid gravitational field reconstruction method based on physical information neural network
