abstract_en: The invention relates to an asteroid gravitational field reconstruction method based on a physical information neural network, which comprises the following steps of completing sampling of data points and generation of auxiliary points based on an asteroid substance point group model, constructing a gravitational potential function solver, preprocessing data for the data points and the generated auxiliary points, calculating the gravitational potential of each sampling point, calculating a Laplace equation and an gravitational acceleration rotation equation of the auxiliary points and an gravitational acceleration equation of the data points by using a partial differential equation solver for the gravitational potential of the sampling points, constructing a total loss function by combining a mean square error of the equations, carrying out error back propagation for the loss function, optimizing network parameters and each loss weight, evaluating a model prediction result for the optimized model, carrying out key sampling in a key area with larger prediction error, and finally adding the sampling result to an auxiliary point data set for continuous training.

title_en: System for be used for electric power mobile office and intranet and extranet linkage
abstract_en: A system for electric mobile office and internal and external network linkage belongs to the field of mobile office. On the basis of the national network SG186 system, a data layer, a technical support layer, a business service layer, a control distribution layer, a presentation layer and an application layer are arranged; splitting business logic into a plurality of service components, and distributing data on a plurality of nodes by adopting software based on a cloud computing architecture; by means of mobile terminal performance signboard analysis, the 'power grid' result is fused, and the mobile internet technology is adopted to release statistical data products in an online and visual mode, so that statistical propagation force, influence and convenience are improved; the mobile terminal is used for realizing on-line dynamic tracking management of key performance indexes, and the dynamic perception of line loss management and on-line collaborative management capability are enhanced to promote the conversion of a new mode of mobile on-line operation and on-line service.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: DC multi-grid peak shaving model for cascade hydropower station group
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of hydropower dispatching operation, in particular to a DC multi-grid peak shaving model of a cascade hydropower station group, which is a multi-grid cascade short-term peak shaving dispatching model taking DC operation constraint and hydropower and DC coupling operation constraint into consideration. The model aims at the minimum maximum value of residual loads of multiple power grids, and considers the operation constraint of a complex high-voltage direct-current transmission line and the operation coupling constraint between the direct-current line and a hydropower station. In the model solving stage, the model is converted into a mixed integer programming model through objective function linearization, hydropower operation constraint linearization and direct current operation constraint linearization. The result of the research of a giant hydropower station group in southwest areas of China is taken as an example, and shows that the model can utilize the flexibility of sharing hydropower by a high-voltage direct-current transmission line, realize multi-grid peak regulation, ensure that the direct-current transmission line runs in a safe interval, and has better practicability.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Inertial monitoring system of the power system and operating method for the same
title_ko: 전력 계통 관성 감시 시스템 및 그에 따른 운영방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an inertial monitoring system of a power system and an operating method thereof, and particularly, provides an inertial monitoring system of a power system comprises: a power generation and transmission system; a power control system which controls the power generation and transmission system; a power system data processing module which receives various data generated on the power network of the power generation and transmission system and provides power system information including generator information such as generator operation status, facility capacity, and output to the power control system; and a system inertia monitoring module which receives power system information including generator information such as generator operation status, facility capacity, and output and inertia index data from the power system data processing module, determines the necessity of reserve power, calculates the total amount of required reserve power, and provides the same to the power control system, and an operating method thereof. Therefore, the inertial monitoring system of a power system uses power system data to calculate system inertia and critical inertia in real time, and manages frequency stability using the results, in order to improve the reliability of the power system and prevent large-scale power system chain failures and load shedding by under-frequency relays (UFRs) and other wide-area blackouts.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전력 계통 관성 감시 시스템과 그 운영방법에 관한 것으로 특히, 발전 및 송전 시스템과; 상기 발전 및 송전 시스템을 제어하는 전력제어 시스템과; 상기 발전 및 송전 시스템의 전력 네트워크상에서 발생되는 각종의 데이터를 수신하여 상기 전력제어 시스템측에 발전기 운전상태, 설비용량, 출력량 등 발전기 정보를 포함한 전력계통의 정보를 제공하는 전력계통 데이터처리모듈; 및 상기 전력계통 데이터처리모듈로부터 발전기 운전상태, 설비용량, 출력량 등 발전기 정보를 포함한 전력계통의 정보들과 관성지수 데이터를 입력받아 예비력의 필요성을 판단하고 필요예비력의 총량등을 연산하여 이를 상기 전력제어 시스템 측에 제공하는 계통관성 감시모듈을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 전력 계통 관성 감시 시스템과 그에따른 운영방법을 제공하여, 전력계통의 신뢰도를 향상시키고 대규모 발전기 연쇄 고장 및 저주파수계전기(Under Frequency Relay: UFR)에 의한 부하차단 예방 등 광역정전을 예방하기 위하여 전력계통 데이터를 이용하여 실시간적으로 계통 관성 및 임계 관성을 연산하고, 그 결과를 이용하여 주파수안정도를 관리할 수 있도록 한다.
assignees: KOREA ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: BP network-based electric energy meter metering self-adaptive compensation method and equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electric energy meter metering self-adaptive compensation method and equipment based on a BP neural network, comprising the following steps: step 1: initializing an adaptive compensation model, and step 2: initializing a BP neural network compensation model, and step 3: optimizing an initial weight threshold of the BP neural network compensation model by adopting an improved artificial fish swarm algorithm; step 4: training the BP neural network compensation model; step 5: updating the weight threshold of the neural network in the error back propagation stage, calculating the number of times of training, judging that all samples are trained when the number of times of training or the error precision is higher than a set value, otherwise, training the next group of samples, and returning to the step 3; step 6: and inputting the output of the ammeter model, the temperature parameter, the moderate parameter, the altitude parameter and the environmental quality parameter into a trained BP neural network compensation model, and outputting an energy value h. The invention has the advantages that: and the influence of multidimensional environmental factors is considered, so that the metering precision of the gateway electric energy meter of the ultra-high voltage transformer substation is further improved.
assignees: GREAT POWER SCIENCE AND TECH STOCK CO LTD STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CORPORATION;STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD

title_en: Device is established to complicated electromagnetic environment of improved generation has
abstract_en: The invention provides an improved complex electromagnetic environment constructing device and an operation method, comprising the following steps: the system comprises a three-dimensional visualization module, a data processing module, a geographic data updating module, a topography measurement calculation module, an electromagnetic signal and geographic topography database; the data processing module comprises: the device comprises a far-field electromagnetic power measuring module, a near-field electromagnetic signal measuring module and an input module; the geographic data updating module acquires the geographic information of the topography of each region through a network, converts the geographic information into geographic longitude and latitude data and surface topography data, and inputs the geographic longitude and latitude data and the surface topography data into a geographic topography database; the terrain measurement calculation module is used for converting the terrain geographic information measured in the field into geographic longitude and latitude data and surface morphology data and inputting the geographic longitude and latitude data and the surface morphology data into the geographic morphology database; the three-dimensional visualization module generates a three-dimensional topography for display and an electromagnetic radiation propagation map superimposed on the three-dimensional topography.
assignees: GUOKE DIANLEI BEIJING ELECTRONIC EQUIPMENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Port comprehensive energy system and bulk cargo wharf distribution cooperative scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a port comprehensive energy system and bulk cargo wharf distribution collaborative scheduling method, which promotes the economic and efficient operation and the green low-carbon development of ports, and comprises the following steps: constructing a multi-energy production and marketing integrated model; establishing a port comprehensive energy system under double-layer excitation, a bulk cargo wharf logistics system and an operator collaborative framework of an infrastructure; based on the lowest cost target, establishing a port comprehensive energy system multi-energy cooperation dispatching and output optimizing model, a bulk cargo wharf logistics system equipment joint dispatching and energy consumption optimizing model considering bidirectional logistics, and a bulk cargo wharf infrastructure dispatching and energy consumption optimizing model considering energy consumption comfort; constructing a bulk cargo wharf bidirectional logistics pipeline scheduling flow optimization model based on a synchronous parallel machine operation principle; establishing a distributed collaborative scheduling model of different operators by adopting a target cascading analysis method; and solving the model to obtain a port comprehensive energy system and bulk cargo wharf collaborative scheduling scheme.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Probability prediction method of non-equidistant monotonic compound quantile regression based on iMICN
abstract_en: The invention provides a probability prediction method of non-equidistant monotone compound quantile regression based on iMICN, which comprises the following steps: 1) Feature screening and data preprocessing are carried out on the data set by using a Pearson analysis engine; 2) Dividing the data set into a training set, a testing set and a verification set according to the ratio of 8:1:1; 3) Training by using an iMICN model to obtain a high-precision median value, and predicting the condition quantile by using non-equidistant monotonic compound quantile regression; 4) Through an Adam algorithm, back propagation training model parameters are carried out according to a marbles loss function, and training effects of the model parameters are judged according to loss values of a verification set; 5) And applying the trained network to a test set to obtain a final probability prediction result, and evaluating the probability prediction result through an evaluation index. The iMICN deep learning model greatly improves the prediction precision, reduces the width of a prediction interval under the condition of not reducing the coverage probability, and combines non-equidistant monotone compound quantile regression to show excellent performance in short-term load probability prediction.
assignees: UNIV NANCHANG

title_en: Power data center station network fault diagnosis method based on dependent network model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power data center station network fault diagnosis method based on a dependent network model, which comprises the following steps: constructing a cascading failure model of a power data center station dependent network according to log information of terminal equipment accessing the power data center station; calculating initial load and capacity of each side in the network, simulating a random network fault and updating a network state, calculating current load of each side in the updated network, and deleting the side from the network if the current load is larger than the capacity of the side; repeating the state updating, the load calculating and the deleting until all sides in the power data middle station network meet the capacity that the current load is smaller than or equal to the sides, or all nodes in the network are isolated nodes; and calculating the current network model function value, and giving a quantized research and judgment result. The invention is oriented to complex power data center station scenes, captures and acquires the real-time change of the node state through the modeling of the dependent network model, and effectively supports the state sensing and fault analysis of the node state.
assignees: INFORMATION COMMUNICATION BRANCH STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Electric power network robustness prediction method based on improved BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a power network robustness prediction method based on an improved BP neural network, which comprises the following steps of; step one, acquiring system operation data, selecting and further abstracting fields affecting system robustness, and calculating to obtain corresponding index data reflecting an index evaluation system; and secondly, optimizing the weight and the threshold of the BP neural network by using a chaotic mapping self-adaptive whale optimizing algorithm CA-WOA. To find the initial parameters with better training effect; step three, after the parameters transmitted by the CA-WOA are received, the BP neural network is further adjusted by adopting forward propagation and backward propagation so as to achieve a better training effect, and finally, a predicted value of robustness of the power dispatching data network is obtained; the invention uses the chaotic mapping self-adaptive weight whale optimization algorithm to optimize the neural network training and complete the prediction work of the robustness of the power dispatching data network; a set of feasible solutions is provided for power network robustness prediction research.
assignees: UNIV FUZHOU;GREAT POWER SCIENCE AND TECH STOCK CO LTD STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CORPORATION

title_en: Electric heating energy network toughness assessment method and system in extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating toughness of an electrothermal energy network in extreme weather, which belong to the field of toughness evaluation, and comprise the following steps: establishing a line fault model of an electric heat energy network in extreme weather; the line fault model comprises an external force fault model and an overload fault model; simulating extreme weather by adopting a Monte Carlo simulation method, and cutting off fault lines caused by the extreme weather based on an external force fault model; balancing islanding, calculating power flow, and cutting off overload lines based on an overload fault model; reconstructing an electrothermal energy network based on a two-stage optimization model, balancing power, and calculating the weight of a cascading failure graph edge; and establishing a cascade fault diagram of the electric-thermal energy network, and calculating element-level toughness indexes and system-level toughness indexes. The method considers the influence of continuous disturbance and cascade faults on the electrothermal energy network, more accurately identifies the weak links of the electrothermal energy network, and improves the toughness of the electrothermal energy network.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Distribution network low-voltage data analysis method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a distribution network low-voltage data analysis method and system based on big data, which are used for respectively carrying out deep analysis on voltage fluctuation characteristics and power consumption mode characteristics by using a self-attention unit and synchronously processing the two characteristics so as to generate mode characteristic data. The target state evaluation network integrates the feature data to effectively extract key features and update network weights, so that the prediction capability of the low-voltage state is enhanced. That is, the present application can more accurately capture the potential low voltage state characteristics by synchronously processing the voltage fluctuation and the power consumption mode characteristics, thereby improving the prediction accuracy. By means of the generation of the target mode characteristic data, not only can the low-voltage event be predicted, but also the control push data can be provided for power grid management, and corresponding measures can be taken in time, so that the stability of power grid operation is promoted, and the equipment damage and service interruption risks caused by voltage problems are reduced.
assignees: Jianyang Power Supply Branch Of State Grid Sichuan Electric Power Company

title_en: Main transformer operation state identification method based on ant colony optimization BP neural network
abstract_en: A main transformer operation state identification method based on ant colony algorithm optimization BP neural network belongs to the technical field of power grid operation and maintenance. The invention adopts BP neural network optimized based on ant colony algorithm to identify the fault of the main transformer. Training the initial weight v due to classical BP neural network  ij  ,w  jk  And the choice of threshold b will directly affect the neural networkThe convergence speed of the network. If the initial weights and thresholds are not appropriate, the network is prone to falling into a locally optimal solution, and cannot find a globally optimal solution. This may result in poor performance or inability to converge of the network. The initial values of the weights and thresholds also affect the propagation of gradients in the network. According to the invention, the ant colony optimization algorithm is adopted to optimize the initial weight and the threshold value of the BP neural network, and a group of optimal weight and threshold value combination is found, so that the BP neural network model achieves a better convergence effect, and the accurate identification of the main transformer fault can be realized.
assignees: ANSHAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Reservoir water level disturbance interval assessment and control method under cascade hydropower response flexibility demand mode
abstract_en: The invention provides a reservoir water level disturbance interval assessment and control method under a step hydropower response flexibility demand mode, which belongs to the field of novel power system dispatching, and comprises the following steps: collecting initial calculation conditions, and calculating new energy prediction deviation in the future 1 day; the power grid predicts deviation according to new energy, combines flexibility supply capability to issue flexibility requirements to the cascade hydroelectric power in real time, and adopts a linear distribution mode to carry out dynamic distribution; constructing a minimum objective function of peak-valley difference of the residual net load of the power grid and giving constraint conditions; taking the power station output, the power generation flow and the storage capacity in the planned implementation stage as random variables, and meeting the operation constraint; controlling the fluctuation range of the water level at the end of the scheduling period; performing equivalent reconstruction on constraint items containing random variables to obtain a linear programming model without the random variables; and carrying out model solving by using an optimization solver. The invention can effectively cope with the uncertainty of the flexibility requirement of the high-proportion new energy power system and grasp the running state of the flexibility requirement provided by hydropower.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN TECH

title_en: Abnormality factor estimation device, learning device, precise diagnostic system, and abnormality factor estimation method
abstract_en: The present invention involves: a sensor data acquisition unit (10) that acquires a plurality of sets of time-series sensor data collected by a plurality of sensors (300) provided in a plurality of facility components constituting a target facility; an abnormality detection unit (30) that detects a plurality of abnormality-detecting sensors that are experiencing abnormality on the basis of the plurality of sets of sensor data; an abnormality detection order estimation unit (40) that estimates the abnormality detection order in which the plurality of abnormality-detecting sensors have been detected as experiencing abnormality; an abnormality propagation path tracing unit (50) that estimates the abnormality propagation order in which an abnormality has propagated on the basis of abnormality-detecting sensor information regarding the plurality of abnormality-detecting sensors and an estimated structure that shows dependencies between the facility components; and an abnormality factor estimation unit (60) that estimates factors for the abnormality on the basis of the abnormality detection order and the abnormality propagation order.
assignees: MITSUBISHI ELECTRIC CORP

title_en: Artificial intelligence-based chemical enterprise security risk identification method
abstract_en: The invention provides an artificial intelligence-based chemical enterprise security risk identification method, which comprises the following steps: constructing a flow-oriented Petri network based on the safety risk identification process of the chemical enterprises, wherein the position of the Petri network represents the state of resources, identification sequence or operation, and the transition of the Petri network represents the start or end of the operation; acquiring a cascade effect of safety risk factors of chemical enterprises based on the Petri network; based on the cascading effect, a security risk factor is determined and evaluated. The invention can more accurately acquire the safety risk factors of chemical enterprises.
assignees: HANGZHOU KAIMIAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for storing intelligent power grid operation information data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, and discloses a method and a system for storing operation information data of a smart grid, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step S1, collecting power grid operation data and constructing a similarity matrix of the power grid operation data; step S2, clustering power grid operation data by using a neighbor propagation clustering method; step S3, setting an X-Y plane, setting a sensor node and an IED node in a wireless sensor network on the X-Y plane, and obtaining a logic grid ID number of the IED node; step S4, updating a clustering result of the power grid operation data according to the IED node; and S5, forwarding the sensing signal to the IED node on the X-Y plane, calculating a grid ID number of the sensing signal, and storing power grid operation information data corresponding to the grid ID number. The system comprises: the intelligent electronic device comprises a data acquisition module, a data clustering module, an IED node setting module and a storage module. The application also discloses an electronic device and a computer readable storage medium.
assignees: AOSTAR INF TECH CO LTD

title_en: Analysis method and system for power grid data
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for analyzing power grid data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring power system data of a plurality of time sections of the power grid to be analyzed according to the constructed bus branch model, the set combination model and the safety constraint combination model; and carrying out safety analysis on the power system data of the plurality of time sections by using parallel graph tide calculation and LU decomposition technology to obtain an analysis result of the power grid to be analyzed. By implementing the method and the device, the problem of low accuracy of analysis of the power grid data in the prior art can be solved, so that when power grid dispatching is performed, dispatching actions are more targeted and timely, and early or late dispatching actions are avoided; the parallel graph tide calculation and LU decomposition technology are adopted, so that the method has higher calculation speed and calculation efficiency and better numerical stability when facing a large-scale matrix, and reduces the propagation of numerical errors.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: System, method and program for building and managing a network of underground communal areas in preparation for disaster situations
title_ko: 재난상황을 대비한 지하공동구의 네트워크 구축 및 관리 시스템, 방법 및 프로그램
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a network construction and management system for an underground common duct in preparation for a disaster situation, and provides an effect of providing a network construction and management system capable of determining an optimized wi-fi connection device separation distance, installation location, and channel in the underground common duct based on a pre-irradiation result of a radio wave environment of the underground common duct.
abstract_ko: 본 개시는 재난상황을 대비한 지하공동구의 네트워크 구축 및 관리 시스템에 관한 것으로, 지하공동구의 전파환경 사전조사 결과를 기반으로, 해당 지하공동구에 최적화된 와이파이 연결장치 이격 거리, 설치 위치, 채널을 결정할 수 있는 네트워크 구축 및 관리 시스템을 제공하는 효과를 제공한다.
assignees: CYBERTELBRIDGE CO LTD;ELECTRONICS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS RES INST

title_en: Guide plate optimization design method and device based on physical driving parameterized proxy model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deflector optimal design method and device based on a physical driving parameterized proxy model, which comprises the steps of firstly, confirming boundary conditions and basic physical properties of a flow field environment where a deflector is positioned and a value range of design parameters of the deflector, and defining physical field variables and performance indexes of requirements; then, a physical driving neural network model is established, partial differentiation of each physical field variable with respect to space-time coordinates is calculated based on back propagation, a control equation is carried in to calculate residual errors, and neuron weights are trained and adjusted; finally, parameterizing and solving flow fields around the guide plate by using the inference model obtained by training, and further solving the optimized guide plate placement position and geometric shape design parameters. The invention only uses one-step parameterized flow field unsupervised learning to replace a series of repeated manual operations of the traditional numerical simulation method, and the method does not need to collect any training data in advance, so that the overall modeling and simulation design period is greatly shortened.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG;SHANGHAI ADVANCED RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ZHEJIANG UNIV

title_en: Resource allocation method of municipal facility system based on signal game
abstract_en: The invention discloses a resource allocation method of municipal facility systems based on signal games, which aims at cascading municipal facility systems to obtain strategy sets of defensive parties and randomly generated signal sets; setting an attack strategy by a refined Bayesian game technology, launching the attack and judging the attack to generate an attack strategy set with an unknown attack strategy; determining system unit benefits, outputting specific benefit values, calculating the ratio of the specific benefit values to the previous round of benefit values, and determining whether to update each defender strategy set; after stopping updating each defending party policy set, outputting each stage of attack policy set to obtain each stage of attack policy set; according to the attack strategy set of each stage, obtaining the optimal attack resource investment and defending resource configuration of the hit unit; the game method defines strategies of both the attack and the defense and dynamically adjusts, simulates multiple attacks in deliberate attack, and provides overall optimization of attack resources and defense resources for municipal facility systems.
assignees: UNIV ARMY ENGINEERING PLA

title_en: Method and system for predicting illegal gold absorption and storage melting risk of enterprise
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting illegal gold absorption and storage melting risks of enterprises, which belong to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting a financial institution collection to be monitored, an individual depositor collection and a plurality of enterprise entities; acquiring transaction information and enterprise information of an enterprise entity; establishing a knowledge graph; combining the higher-order graph neural network, and extracting a dynamic sub-graph of the knowledge graph according to the transaction information; determining initial propagation nodes of the dynamic sub-map based on the average value of the network centrality index; performing risk propagation on the initial propagation node based on the improved SIR algorithm to acquire a risk propagation path; combining the risk propagation path with paths in the dynamic sub-map to obtain a combined risk propagation path, and calculating the predicted risk probability of each sub-path in the combined risk propagation path; and carrying out early warning on the risk propagation path comprising the sub-path under the condition that the predicted risk probability is larger than the risk probability threshold. The manual intervention is reduced, and the monitoring accuracy and the real-time performance are improved.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ZHELIXIN CREDIT REPORTING CO LTD

title_en: Power system multi-dimension index risk assessment method based on fuzzy comprehensive evaluation and LSTM
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power system multi-dimensional index risk assessment method based on fuzzy comprehensive assessment and LSTM, which comprises the following steps: step 1, establishing a power grid cascading failure probability grading model, and solving a power grid cascading failure probability fuzzy evaluation vector; and step 2, grading the severity of the grid cascading failure, determining the comprehensive early warning level of the cascading failure, and further finishing the risk assessment of the multidimensional index of the power system. The invention can effectively identify the weak links of the novel power system and effectively and accurately early warn the cascading faults with low probability and high risk.
assignees: STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power system external threat destructive power assessment method based on cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system external threat destructive power assessment method based on cascading faults, which is characterized in that network attack causes initial faults, load flow calculation is carried out to obtain node voltage and line load flow, if at least one of the node voltage and the line load flow is out of limit, recovery control is carried out, load flow calculation and recovery control are continuously carried out aiming at cascading faults until the faults do not have further evolution risk, and the difference between the initial load quantity and the final load quantity of the system is calculated and is used as an assessment index of the network attack destructive power; and obtaining the expected loss of the power system caused by the faults in the preselected fault set through repeated experiments. The invention can comprehensively consider the fault propagation path and the cumulative effect of faults, and simulate and evaluate the occurrence and the spread of cascading faults, thereby more comprehensively evaluating the damage force of external threat to the power system.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: Method for evaluating electromagnetic ring network unlocking safety between partitions of regional power grid
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for evaluating the ring opening safety of an electromagnetic ring network among partitions of a regional power grid, which comprises the following steps: s1, analyzing the necessity of ring opening of the electromagnetic ring network among partitions according to a main grid structure and by combining the running condition of a power grid; s2, analyzing safety risks existing in the transmission line of the electromagnetic ring network itself and the local power network in the near zone after the electromagnetic ring network is disassembled; s3, analyzing safety and stability risks possibly caused by different fault modes of extra-high voltage direct current in the subarea after the electromagnetic ring network is disassembled; s4, analyzing the influence of the electromagnetic ring network decyclization on the oscillation mode and damping among the regional power grid partition clusters; s5, judging the feasibility of the electromagnetic ring network ring opening. The invention evaluates the possible safety and stability risks of the system after the electromagnetic looped network decoiling network structure is weakened to a certain extent in all-round aspects such as cascading failure, decoiling effect on the feeding capacity of the direct current group, influence on the oscillating mode of the inter-partition cluster and the like which are possibly caused by different fault modes of the extra-high voltage direct current.
assignees: CENTRAL CHINA BRANCH STATE GRID CORP CHINA;CENTRAL SOUTHERN CHINA ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD OF CHINA POWER ENG CONSULTING GROUP

title_en: Wind-light-step hydroelectric power producer alliance method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind-light-step hydroelectric power producer alliance method and a system, wherein the system comprises a step hydropower station, a new energy power station and a power grid; the cascade hydropower station and the new energy power station are respectively connected with the power grid and used for transmitting the generated electricity to the power grid; the cascade hydropower station is connected with the new energy power station to form a alliance, the electric quantity distributed by the cascade hydropower station is distributed to the new energy power station to stabilize fluctuation of the electric quantity of the new energy power station, and the new energy power station compensates benefits corresponding to the electric quantity distributed by the cascade hydropower station. The cascade hydropower station and the new energy power station are connected to form a alliance, and the cascade hydropower station distributes electric quantity to the new energy power station to stabilize fluctuation of the electric energy generation capacity of the new energy power station and reduce impact on a power grid, so that the safety and stability of the power grid can be ensured, the new energy power station compensates benefits corresponding to the electric quantity distributed by the cascade hydropower station, and the enthusiasm of the cascade hydropower station for promoting new energy consumption is ensured.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Multi-energy coordination rapid scheduling method based on quantum neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-energy coordination rapid scheduling method based on a quantum neural network, and belongs to the technical field of micro-grid operation. The multi-energy coordination economic dispatch model considering the hydraulic power, wind energy and solar energy is defined, and multi-class operation constraint of the cascade hydropower is considered. A quick synchronous machine information prediction model based on QNN is constructed, and the model realizes quick prediction of the state and the output of the synchronous machine in a day according to the actual measurement data of new energy and load. A closed loop hot start framework of the QNN and multi-energy coordination optimization scheduling model is constructed, QNN decision information is transmitted to an initial optimization model, and the solved optimal solution is fed back to QNN learning evolution, so that a high-quality optimization scheduling result is obtained rapidly.

title_en: Minimization of service interruptions of core network failure
abstract_en: Techniques are disclosed for the minimization of service interruptions for core network failure. One example includes a method in which a disaster control function (DCF) receives, from an access and mobility function (AMF), an address of a base station managed by the AMF. The DCF detects an interruption of services provided by the AMF. The DCF transmits, to the base station and using the address, a message indicting the interruption of services provided by the AMF.
assignees: APPLE INC

title_en: Method of propagating information on power grid energy flows, device, and machine-readable instruction code
abstract_en: To make information on an energy flow composition available for an electric power system (40), devices (31-36) of a communication system (30) exchange data specifying the energy flow composition. The devices (31-36) are operative to exchange the data by means of a message exchange that generally follows the energy flow paths in a power grid (10) of the electric power system (40).
assignees: HITACHI ENERGY LTD

title_en: Power system cascading failure simulation method and medium based on comprehensive load model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system cascading failure simulation method and medium based on a comprehensive load model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a power transmission network differential algebraic model, wherein the power transmission network differential algebraic model comprises a generator, a speed regulator and an exciter differential algebraic model and a network tide algebraic model; establishing a relay protection logic model and a comprehensive load model of each power distribution network, wherein the comprehensive load model comprises a power distribution network equivalent branch impedance model, a static ZIP load model, a dynamic induction motor load model, a distributed power supply model and a reactive compensation capacitor model; and performing cascading failure simulation on the power system according to the differential algebra model, the relay protection logic model and the comprehensive load model of the power transmission network. The invention considers the influence of the dynamic process of the distributed power supply on the overall process of the cascading failure in the cascading failure simulation, thereby ensuring the accuracy of the cascading failure simulation data result and simultaneously ensuring the high efficiency of modeling work and simulation.
assignees: UNIV WUHAN

title_en: Distribution network scheduling method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a power distribution network scheduling method, a power distribution network scheduling device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: calculating the data propagation duration from a first terminal to a second terminal based on the sending time of a positioning instruction sent by the first terminal, the positioning duration from the receiving of the positioning instruction to the returning of positioning information to the first terminal by the second terminal, and the receiving time of the positioning information received by the first terminal; wherein the positioning information includes a coordinate position of the second terminal; determining a distance between the first terminal and the second terminal based on a product of the data propagation duration and the light propagation speed; and determining the height of the first terminal relative to the ground based on the coordinate position of the first terminal, the coordinate position of the second terminal and the distance between the first terminal and the second terminal. By adopting the technical scheme disclosed by the invention, the height of the high-altitude staff relative to the ground can be accurately positioned.
assignees: YUEQING ELECTRIC POWER IND CO LTD;WENZHOU TUSHENG HOLDING GROUP CO LTD;YUEQING POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power load prediction method based on multi-element self-encoder
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power load prediction method based on a multi-element self-encoder, belongs to the field of power grids, and aims to solve the problems of the existing power load prediction network structure. The prediction method adopts a time prediction neural network model based on an encoder-decoder architecture to predict the power load, and the time prediction model is realized by adopting a multi-element self-encoder; the construction step of the time prediction neural network model comprises the following steps: s1, building a training set of a historical sequence-a predicted sequence; s2, splitting the history sequence into a trend part and a period part; s3, generating trend partial codes by an encoder module of the MLP; the encoder module of the transducer generates a periodic partial code; s4, decoding the two parts of codes by a decoder module connected with the input MLP to obtain a final prediction result; s5, repeating the S2-S4 operation to output all prediction results, calculating the loss between the real sequence and the prediction sequence by using a loss function, and carrying out gradient back propagation and gradient descent according to the loss value to update model parameters.
assignees: STATE GRID HEILONGJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV HARBIN SCIENCE & TECH;HARBIN INST TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Power distribution network weak link identification method based on cascade combination scoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of identification of weak links of power distribution networks, and discloses a method for identifying weak links of a power distribution network based on cascade combination scoring. The method mainly comprises the following steps: based on analyzing the problems existing in the power distribution network in actual operation, an evaluation index for representing the weak links of the power distribution network is established; giving out a calculation formula matched with each grading index, and constructing a calculation model of each single index; and determining corresponding cascade combination evaluation scores according to the calculation index model, and realizing quantification of the problem degree. The method can objectively analyze the existing problems in the power distribution network, comprehensively score each feeder line of the power distribution network, and assist relevant practitioners in the power industry to formulate a power distribution network weak link optimization transformation scheme.
assignees: SHANGRAO POWER SUPPLY BRANCH COMPANY STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV SHANGRAO NORMAL

title_en: Cascading failure blocking control method and system considering source-network-load coordination
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cascading failure blocking control method and system considering source-network-load coordination, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the space-time characteristics of element fault cascade evolution are considered, an overload leading type cascading failure simulation model is established, a failure chain is generated, and a power failure risk index is calculated; calculating time-risk comprehensive importance indexes by considering the system fault reaction capacity and coping cost performance, and determining the optimal input position of the blocking control strategy in fault development; respectively considering the rapid and flexible network topology switching characteristics and the load grading characteristics of the climbing of the gas turbine unit at the source, network and load sides, constructing a blocking control model based on source-network-load joint adjustment, and solving to obtain an optimal blocking control strategy; and controlling the power transmission network based on the optimal input position and the optimal blocking control strategy. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of effectively relieving the power failure risk of the cascading failure, obviously improving the economical efficiency and reliability of blocking control, and the like.

title_en: Photovoltaic equipment generated power prediction method and system
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a method and a system for predicting the generation power of photovoltaic equipment, and relates to the technical field of new energy generation control. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring photovoltaic equipment data, illumination related data and topographic data; constructing a solar radiation intensity model based on a back propagation neural network according to the acquired data, predicting the current solar radiation intensity, and obtaining a preliminary radiation intensity result; determining the sea distance according to the acquired data, carrying out weight distribution on the water vapor salt fog and the attached salt fog based on the sea distance, and calculating the radiation intensity loss rate influenced by the salt fog; correcting the primary radiation intensity result by the loss rate of the radiation intensity influenced by the salt fog, and reconstructing a solar radiation intensity model according to the correction result; predicting the radiation intensity by using the reconstructed solar radiation intensity model to obtain a final radiation intensity result; and predicting the photovoltaic power generation power according to the final radiation intensity result. The influence of salt mist on the photovoltaic power generation power is considered, and the accuracy of photovoltaic power generation power prediction is improved.

title_en: Stability improving method for symmetrical phase-locked grid-connected variable current system based on virtual damping
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stability improving method of a symmetrical phase-locked grid-connected variable current system based on virtual damping. Aiming at the problem that the stability margin of the grid-connected variable current system induced by the voltage coupling path of the symmetrical phase-locked loop is greatly reduced, the virtual damping loop of the grid-connected point voltage to current loop control instruction is introduced into the dq coordinate system of the controller, the cascade loop coupling inhibition link eliminates the negative influence of the voltage coupling path of the symmetrical phase-locked loop, and a first-order high-pass filter is introduced as a loop damping enhancement unit, so that the stability margin of the symmetrical phase-locked grid-connected variable current system in a middle-low frequency range is greatly enhanced while the symmetry of the dq axis control structure is maintained, and the stable operation capacity and the loop response speed of the symmetrical phase-locked grid-connected variable current system under the weak current network working condition are remarkably improved.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power network fault propagation analysis method based on dynamic evolution of fragile community network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power network fault propagation analysis method based on dynamic evolution of a fragile community network, which comprises the following steps: constructing a topological dual network model, a fault concentric circle network and an initial fragile community network, and setting boundary nodes and internal nodes of the fragile communities; constructing a fault chain model, and updating a topology dual network and a fault concentric network; repartitioning the fragile communities, updating the fragile community network, and forming a network evolution fault chain model; setting fault propagation intensity; defining an electrical distance between branches and fault propagation attenuation; setting a field propagation effect; screening a potential recovery node set, and calculating and setting the recovery probability of the potential recovery node; evaluating node vulnerability, and adding nodes with higher vulnerability ranks to a node priority protection set; the method can effectively analyze the vulnerability of the high-order structure of the power grid and the vulnerability of the multidimensional state, is suitable for evaluating the vulnerability of the large-scale complex power grid, and is beneficial to ensuring the safe and stable operation of the power system.
assignees: UNIV XIHUA

title_en: Fault recovery method and system for cascade faults of power distribution network information physical system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault recovery method and a system for cascading faults of an information physical system of a power distribution network, which relate to the technical field of power system automation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: and acquiring fault information of the target power distribution network, and establishing an information-physical system recovery model. And inputting element information in the fault information into a model, and determining the recovery time and the first maintenance sequence of each fault element. And determining the first recovery cost of the physical system of the target power distribution network according to the recovery time and the maintenance sequence. And adjusting the first maintenance order to obtain a second maintenance order, and determining a second recovery cost. Comparing the second recovery cost with the first recovery cost, if the second recovery cost is smaller, updating the maintenance sequence and returning to the previous step; otherwise, fault recovery is carried out according to the first maintenance sequence. The invention can comprehensively consider the recovery requirements of the information system and the physical system, and improve the recovery speed of the system and reduce the influence of cascading faults by optimizing the maintenance sequence and the recovery cost.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Multi-precision residual error quantization method in power monitoring and identification scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-precision residual quantization method under a power monitoring and identification scene, which comprises the steps of selecting a data set and preprocessing images in the data set; training an identification network, and applying a multi-precision residual quantization method in a residual structure of a backbone network to obtain backbone network image characteristics; integrating the image features of the backbone network through the pooling layer and the feature arrangement layer, and optimizing the updating rule of the gradient during training the network to obtain a final power monitoring and identifying model; the method is suitable for target detection tasks under power monitoring and identification scenes, has universality for the identification network with a residual structure, introduces a concept of multi-precision quantization in the traditional residual structure, and removes partial calculation redundancy of cyclic convolution; in the back propagation part, the gradient updating rule in training is modified, so that the convergence speed is increased.

title_en: Power distribution management system
title_ko: 전력 분배 관리시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a power distribution management system and, more specifically, to a power distribution management system capable of managing meter reading data for each household online by measuring distribution power through an auxiliary meter arranged according to the number of households living in a specific building. To this end, the power distribution management system comprises: a main meter arranged to measure the total supply power; at least one auxiliary meter continuously distributed and connected from the main meter and arranged to measure the distribution power distributed from the total supply power; and a relay device deriving meter reading data for each household based on the total supply power and the distribution power, encrypting the meter reading data for each household using a public key, and wirelessly relaying the encrypted meter reading data for each household through a network, wherein the relay device is arranged in any one meter, in which a radio interference signal corresponds to a minimum value, among the at least one auxiliary meter.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전력 분배 관리시스템에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는, 특정 건물에 입주한 세대수에 따라 배치된 보조계량기를 통해 분배 전력을 계측하여 세대별 검침데이터를 온라인으로 관리할 수 있는 전력 분배 관리시스템에 관한 것이다. 이를 위해, 전력 분배 관리시스템은 전체 공급 전력을 계측하도록 배치된 메인계량기, 상기 메인계량기로부터 연속적으로 분배 연결되고, 상기 전체 공급 전력으로부터 분배되는 분배 전력을 계측하도록 배치된 적어도 하나의 보조계량기 및 상기 전체 공급 전력과 상기 분배 전력에 기초하여 세대별 검침데이터를 도출하고, 상기 세대별 검침데이터를 공개키를 통해 암호화하여 네트워크를 통해 무선으로 중계하는 중계장치를 포함하고, 상기 중계장치는 상기 적어도 하나의 보조계량기 중 전파간섭신호가 최소값에 해당하는 어느 하나의 계량기 내부에 배치된다.
assignees: CHOICE COMPANY CO LTD

title_en: Method, device, medium and equipment for predicting carbon emission of coal-fired power plant
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a prediction method, a device, a medium and equipment for carbon emission of a coal-fired power plant, and relates to the technical field of carbon emission, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring target coal quality industrial analysis data; inputting target coal quality industrial analysis data into a carbon emission prediction model to obtain a carbon emission prediction result; the carbon emission prediction model is obtained through training in the following way: and combining the multi-layer sensor neural network and an error back propagation algorithm, taking sample coal quality industrial analysis data as input, taking predicted carbon emission as output, training the multi-layer sensor neural network, propagating errors between a predicted result output by an output layer of the multi-layer sensor neural network in the training process and an actual test value to an input layer, and performing iterative training to obtain a carbon emission prediction model. The carbon emission prediction model obtained by combining the multi-layer sensor neural network and the error back propagation algorithm is accurate in carbon emission prediction result.
assignees: LONGYUAN BEIJING CARBON ASSET MANAGEMENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Optimal power flow calculation method for power load unbalance
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimal power flow calculation method for power load unbalance, which comprises the following steps: 1, modeling a power grid to obtain classification results aiming at different nodes; 2, considering the power generation cost and the load regulation cost, and respectively establishing corresponding objective functions aiming at the direct current and alternating current models; 3, respectively constructing respective constraints for direct current power flow and alternating current power flow; and 4, calculating the power flow according to the objective function and the constraint to obtain the optimal voltage amplitude and phase angle of each node and the load quantity required to be reduced by each load. The optimal power flow calculation method for power load unbalance can provide a proper load regulation strategy for the power grid under the condition that the power grid is damaged or in cascade failure, so that the malignant expansion of the power grid failure range is avoided.
assignees: DATA SPACE INST

title_en: AI-based intelligent regulating method and device for reducing loss of distribution network 10KV line technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AI-based intelligent regulating method and device for reducing loss of a distribution network 10KV line technology, comprising the following steps: acquiring real-time data of a 10KV line of the distribution network, and preprocessing; step 2: establishing a robust deep learning model; step 3: training the deep learning model through historical data to improve the accurate prediction capability of the deep learning model on line loss, optimizing model parameters by using a back propagation algorithm, and introducing a data enhancement technology of training data to improve the robustness of the model; step 4: monitoring the real-time data by using an anomaly detection algorithm; step 5: comparing the model prediction result with actual observation data, monitoring the state of the system in real time, and introducing a self-adaptive control strategy to adjust the system; step 6: setting performance indexes, and performing iterative optimization through continuous monitoring data and user feedback. Compared with the traditional method, the method has stronger adaptability and robustness, and can better cope with the complexity and uncertainty of the power system.

title_en: Railway risk factor identification and evaluation method and system based on comprehensive importance
abstract_en: The invention provides a railway risk element identification and evaluation method and system based on comprehensive importance, which belong to the technical field of transportation risk element identification and evaluation, wherein a risk element set of a railway system is obtained through accident cause analysis, a network relation among risk elements is obtained according to a risk propagation theory, a multi-granularity network model is established, principal component analysis is carried out through indexes in the model, a first principal component is selected as a functional importance index weight, and the risk importance weight obtained through scoring processing by a cloud model-entropy weight expert is subjected to linear weighting, so that the comprehensive importance weight of the risk element is obtained and is used as an evaluation basis of the importance degree of the railway system level risk element. The invention builds a multi-granularity network model of the railway system level, and realizes the rapid identification and evaluation of key risk elements of the railway system level; the method provides important basis for early protection of the railway system for risks and targeted measures before the railway system is put into operation, and improves the reliability and safety of the railway system operation.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG;CHINA STATE RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD;RAILWAY SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT CENTER CHINA ACADEMY OF RAILWAY SCIENCES CORPORATI;CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD

title_en: Short-term power load prediction method based on PSR-DBN (Power System support-direct-base network) combined model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid load power prediction, in particular to a PSR-DBN (power system-direct-current neutral network) combined model-based short-term power load prediction method, which comprises the following steps: preprocessing the power load data; processing the time series data by adopting a phase space reconstruction technology, and reconstructing a phase space by determining delay time and embedding dimension; after the phase space is reconstructed, performing feature extraction and prediction by using a deep confidence network; performing layer-by-layer pre-training and fine tuning on the deep confidence network, wherein the layer-by-layer pre-training utilizes the weight and bias of the layer-by-layer training network of an unsupervised learning algorithm, and the overall fine tuning is based on the layer-by-layer pre-training, and performs fine tuning on the deep confidence network by using forward propagation and reverse propagation combined with the supervised learning algorithm; model evaluation and optimization. The invention provides rich data samples, enhances the understanding and capturing capability of the model to complex nonlinear relations, and shows remarkable high accuracy in the power load prediction task by combining the two methods.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Park gateway time synchronization self-holding method and system supporting no external connection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a park gateway time synchronization self-holding method and a system supporting no external connection, comprising the following steps: preprocessing historical frequency correction data for input into a neural network model; constructing a neural network model suitable for supporting time synchronization self-holding of a park gateway without external connection; the neural network model includes: an input layer, a hidden layer and an output layer; the historical frequency correction data is used as the input of the neural network, the clock frequency of the communication gateway crystal oscillator of the park is predicted by the neural network under the condition of no external connection, and the updated neural network weight is corrected by using an extended Kalman filter in the back propagation process of the BP neural network, so that the training process and fitting precision of the neural network are accelerated, the time synchronization precision of the communication gateway of the park is improved, and the time synchronization self-holding of the communication gateway of the park without external connection is supported under the condition of no external connection.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION COMPANY STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: High-resolution image building extraction method integrating local and global features
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of seismic disaster assessment, in particular to a high-resolution image building extraction method integrating local and global features, which adopts grouping convolution (ResNeXt) with the same topological structure to replace standard convolution of a backbone network ResNet in a TransUnet coding layer, and improves the capability of quickly acquiring building features under the condition of not increasing the quantity of parameters. The relative position coding mode in the depth separable convolution substitution TransUnet is adopted to implicitly construct the position information of the building feature, so that the transducer can obtain the global feature information and the local feature information of the building at the same time; the channel attention mechanism is adopted to improve the layer jump, cascade the multi-scale building characteristics, and the weight of the building characteristics in the key channel is improved by enhancing the remarkable characteristic representation in the channel dimension. And finally, carrying out a wide experiment on the GF2 image data set to verify the effectiveness and the practicability of the model.
assignees: INST OF EARTHQUAKE FORECASTING CEA

title_en: Power prediction method, system and storage medium of wind power plant
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power prediction method, a system and a storage medium of a wind power plant, wherein the method comprises the following steps: setting a wind field machine position in a wind field to collect wind speed of an area where a wind driven generator is located, and collecting other meteorological data in the wind field; reconstructing airflow distribution in the wind field range according to the acquired data; predicting future airflow distribution of the wind field according to the airflow distribution in the reconstructed wind field range; selecting a machine position, and selecting a predicted wind speed value corresponding to the machine position from predicted future airflow distribution; and converting the predicted wind speed value corresponding to the machine position into a power predicted value. Compared with the prior art, the method can effectively predict the power change of the wind farm for 1-15 minutes, brings huge safety and economic benefit for countries and regions with insufficient power grids and under the scene that the wind farm is directly supplied to the load side, and can effectively position and track the wind flow propagation motion trail without accumulating a large amount of historical data.
assignees: ENVISION ENERGY LTD

title_en: Risk assessment method, system, equipment and medium suitable for high-voltage power grid maintenance VR simulation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a risk assessment method, a system, equipment and a medium suitable for a high-voltage power grid maintenance VR simulation system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: extracting spatial position information and conductive properties of an electric correlation model in a high-voltage power grid overhaul scene, and constructing a current conduction model in the scene; extracting spatial position information and voltage attributes of a high-voltage power grid in a high-voltage power grid overhaul scene, and constructing an electric field propagation model in the scene; estimating the position of a worker in a virtual system according to coordinate information of the VR helmet and the handle, judging the possibility of forming a conductive path between an object at the position of the worker and the ground by combining a current conduction model in a scene, and obtaining a related risk index I; estimating the behaviors of the staff according to the coordinate information of the VR helmet and the handle, calculating the maximum electric field intensity of the limbs of the staff by combining an electric field propagation model in a scene, and obtaining a related risk index II; and combining the first risk index and the second risk index to calculate and obtain a safety risk index of the current behavior of the staff at the current position. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of quantifying risk indexes, enabling an evaluation result to be close to reality and the like.
assignees: WEIHAI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Step small hydropower station group optimization scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade small hydropower station group optimal scheduling method, which comprises the steps of firstly determining a scheduling objective function according to scheduling requirements of a cascade small hydropower station group; determining a scheduling constraint condition; inputting basic data of a hydropower station, initializing a water level of the hydropower station for one year, calculating the power generation amount and guaranteeing the output size to perform non-dominant sorting through water level change of one year; and then improving the badger algorithm, performing mutation operation on data in an initialization stage by utilizing the improved badger algorithm, calculating the generated energy and guaranteeing the output size, performing non-dominant sorting to select an optimal solution, adding the optimal solution into an archive set, iterating, and finally outputting a global optimal solution in the iterating process to obtain an optimal solution set. The invention has good local refinement capability along with the continuous self-adaptive adjustment of iteration, overcomes the defects of early maturity convergence, local optimal solution instead of global optimal solution and the like of the scheduling solution of the previous cascade small hydropower station group, and greatly improves the economic benefit and cascade small hydropower peak regulation capability of the cascade small hydropower station important by a power grid.
assignees: ZHUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Cascade reservoir joint scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention provides a cascade reservoir joint scheduling method, wherein the cascade reservoirs are annual regulating reservoirs or multi-annual regulating reservoirs, each reservoir is provided with a hydropower station, the distribution load borne by the hydropower station of the cascade reservoirs under an electric network is reasonably distributed, regulated and decomposed by combining the real-time reservoir water level of each hydropower station, and the regulating capacity of each reservoir is excavated on the basis of the distribution of each station meeting the distribution load, so that the optimal matching of the reservoirs and the distribution load is realized.
assignees: HENAN WATER CONSERVANCY NO 2 ENG BUREAU GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Method and equipment for identifying, early warning and positioning key line of cascading failure of power transmission network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a line identification technology of an electric power system, in particular to a key line identification, early warning and positioning method and equipment for cascading failure of a power transmission network, wherein the method obtains characteristic data at a plurality of historical moments according to a tide transfer model to generate a power transmission network characteristic data set; constructing an LSTM-based power transmission network security situation prediction early warning model, inputting a time sequence power grid state into the security situation prediction model established by the invention, performing data preprocessing through ADASYN oversampling and other steps, and dividing a training set and a verification set; and then calculating the dimension input at each time point, inputting the generated data into an input layer of the LSTM network for calculation, and finally outputting results such as whether cascading failure occurs at a specific moment in the future, the position of the failure and the like. The invention can early warn and judge the region in advance for the cascading failure caused by the tide transfer, thereby effectively improving the lean management and control level and providing reliable decision support for the lean operation and maintenance of the transmission network.
assignees: UNIV WUHAN;STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Power system operation mode identification method, system and medium based on data driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and a medium for identifying an operation mode of an electric power system based on data driving, which comprise the following steps: acquiring time sequence production operation data in a preset historical time period of the power system; inputting the time sequence production operation data into an improved neighbor propagation clustering model for clustering to obtain an operation mode clustering result; selecting key influencing factors representing the characteristics of the load sequence and taking the key influencing factors as time sequence load characteristics; according to the time sequence load characteristics, predicting to obtain a prediction result; calculating total daily load, daily load rate and peak-valley difference of the daily load corresponding to the target date according to the prediction result, and taking the total daily load, the daily load rate and the peak-valley difference of the daily load as daily load characteristics; and based on the mapping relation between the daily load characteristics and the typical operation mode labels, establishing a future power grid operation mode identification model, and carrying out future typical operation mode identification. The method can well overcome the defect that the typical operation mode is formulated based on experience, and can accurately analyze and identify the typical operation mode of the power grid.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP;STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power grid and traffic network cascading failure analysis method, system and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electric automobile and electric traffic fusion technology, in particular to a method, a system and a medium for analyzing cascading faults of a power grid and a traffic network, wherein the method comprises the steps of analyzing the frequency and the trend change process of the power grid under the condition of large-scale electric automobile load access based on a direct current trend model of frequency response, and simulating the propagation process of the power grid faults in the frequency and trend change process of the power grid; establishing a travel decision model of an electric vehicle user with limited rationality under a fault based on the regret theory, and establishing a dynamic traffic balance model to analyze traffic jam faults and an evolution process of electric vehicle charging load; and constructing fault cross-space propagation discrimination conditions for power grid fault propagation to a traffic network and traffic network fault propagation to the power grid based on the load-capacity model, and realizing simplified analysis of power grid and traffic network cascading faults by separating and simulating three cross-space propagation processes. The method can effectively reflect the influence of large-scale electric vehicle charging load transfer on the grid cascading failure.
assignees: UNIV WUHAN;STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Lifting platform suitable for special scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of civil unmanned aircrafts, in particular to an elevating platform suitable for special scenes. The invention provides a lift-off platform suitable for special scenes, which can better meet the use requirements of urban environments, emergency situations and other special scenes by means of a 'beyond-the-horizon flight control' mode, an air-land dual-purpose design of flight and vehicle rows and combining the functions of an environment self-adaptive mechanism, an action design and the like. The 'beyond-the-horizon flight control' mode relies on a mobile communication network (public network, main network) or a wireless local area network (WLAN ad hoc network, auxiliary network) to realize wireless communication, and relates to two layers of contents: one is "curvilinear communication", i.e., the aircraft and the console can normally communicate in both line-of-sight and non-line-of-sight (NLOS) propagation environments; secondly, the control is carried out by remotely controlling the flying hand to communicate with the airplane through a network (public network or ad hoc network), namely, the control can be realized under two conditions of on-site short distance and long-distance in different places.
assignees: YAO CHENXI

title_en: Dynamic safety margin assessment method for novel electric-gas interconnection power system
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic safety margin assessment method for a novel electric-gas interconnection electric power system, and relates to the technical field of electric power systems. Measuring and summarizing measured values of nodes at all sampling moments based on the multi-time scale characteristics of the novel electric power system with electric-gas interconnection, and performing data conversion and standardization treatment; constructing a heterogeneous data detection matrix, obtaining a characteristic value and a maximum characteristic vector by carrying out singular value decomposition on the heterogeneous data matrix, and further processing the characteristic value and the maximum characteristic vector to correspond to the node state so as to form a sample data set; building a depth map convolution neural network model and building a distributed perception learning module; training the model by inputting the processed data set; after the mean value of the real-time operation data is removed, the obtained left and right singular matrixes are input into a trained model to detect the safety margin of the electric-gas coupling network. The invention can achieve the purpose of timely and effectively evaluating the operation safety margin of the system and avoiding major accidents such as power failure cascading failures.
assignees: UNIV NORTHEASTERN;UNIV SHANDONG

title_en: Power distribution network state characterization method based on graph mask reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, in particular to a power distribution network state characterization method based on graph mask reconstruction, which comprises the following steps of S1, modeling a topological structure of a power distribution network as an abnormal graph; S2, reconstructing a path through a path mask predictor, S3, reconstructing node attributes through a node attribute mask predictor, and S4, optimizing the model. The power distribution network state calculating method based on the heterogeneous graph mask modeling can accurately model topological relation and state variables of the power distribution network, the model can capture complex graph structures containing semantics, node attributes and edges of a more efficient predictive graph, the state of the power distribution network can be rapidly and accurately calculated through a pre-trained graph neural network model, power distribution topological data of the power distribution network are abstracted into heterogeneous graph structures, and the method has high efficiency, intuitionistic and flexible performance data and higher accuracy in a state estimation task compared with a back propagation network and a convolution neural network.
