title_en: Risk propagation pattern graph-based contact network part association characteristic analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a contact net part association characteristic analysis method based on a risk propagation pattern diagram, which specifically comprises the following steps: acquiring historical fault associated data of contact net parts; defining a simultaneous fault incidence relation and a time sequence fault incidence relation; constructing a risk coefficient model of the fault association relationship; constructing a virtual path, acquiring a virtual path set between two parts, and acquiring a shortest virtual path set according to a reduction rule; mapping the set of shortest virtual paths into a risk association graph; defining the risk coefficient weight of each virtual path in the risk correlation diagram; constructing a risk propagation pattern diagram taking any fault part as a starting point, and evaluating risk levels of each fault association relation; the invention can evaluate the risk degree of the known fault association relationship and the risk degree of the potential fault association relationship, can reveal the association characteristics among the contact net parts under different time scales and provides decision basis for preventing occurrence of cascading faults.

title_en: Key personnel risk prediction method based on time sequence knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention relates to a key personnel risk prediction method based on a time sequence knowledge graph, which comprises the following steps: acquiring risk data, and carrying out entity identification and relation extraction to form a time sequence knowledge graph quadruple format; dividing four tuples according to the time stamp, generating a map snapshot in corresponding time, converting a risk prediction task into predicting the correct probability of a tail entity under the condition that a head entity and a relationship are known; and calculating the classification loss according to the calculated prediction classification value, and carrying out parameter updating of the model by back propagation until the prediction classification loss tends to be stable. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: according to the invention, through calculation of the neural network and back propagation of errors, a loss function is minimized, and the probability of correct prediction of the entity at the next moment is improved, so that the prediction of risk probability of key personnel at the future time stamp is realized. The whole model combines the time sequence evolution characteristic and the history correlation characteristic of the atlas, and obtains better prediction accuracy.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Flange Cover for Back Fire Prevention
title_ko: 역화방지용 플랜지 커버
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a flange cover for backfire prevention, which is installed to surround a flange connection unit of a pipe piping, and protects the flange connection unit from external impact and the environment by directing leaking chemicals or fluids in a specific direction, and applies a backfire preventer for an explosive environment to prevent fire from spreading through the pipe piping in the event of a fire, thereby protecting human life and facilities. The flange cover comprises: a cylindrical body (10) which forms a space in which a flange connection unit of a pipe piping (100) is accommodated, and both ends are closed; a pipe receiving unit (20) provided on both sides of the body so as to accommodate the pipe piping (100); and a backfire preventer (50) provided on a lower side of the body (10) to block an external flame from spreading into the inside of the body (10). The body (10) and the pipe receiving unit (20) are formed by being divided in half and integrated by a connecting member.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 파이프 배관의 플랜지 연결부를 감싸도록 설치되어 누설되는 화학물질 또는 유체를 특정 방향으로 유도함으로써 플랜지 연결부를 외부 충격 및 환경으로부터 보호하고 폭발 환경에 대비한 역화방지기를 적용하여 화재발생시 파이프 배관을 통해 화재가 전파되는 것을 방지하여 인명과 시설물을 보호할 수 있도록 한 역화방지용 플랜지 커버에 관한 것으로,  
파이프 배관(100)의 플랜지 연결부가 수용되는 공간을 형성하며 양단이 막혀 있는 원통 형상의 바디(10); 파이프 배관(100)이 수용되도록 바디의 양측에 구비되는 배관수용부(20); 바디(10)의 하측에 구비되어 외부의 화염이 바디(10)의 내측으로 전파되지 않도록 차단하는 역화방지기(50);를 포함하고, 상기 바디(10)와 배관수용부(20)는 반으로 분할 형성되어 연결부재에 의해 일체화되는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: SKYENTEC

title_en: Flange Safe Ring for Back Fire Prevention
title_ko: 역화방지용 플랜지 쉴드
abstract_en: A flange shield for backfire prevention comprises: a belt-shaped ring member (10) provided on each of two facing pipes (100); an insert member (20) provided on the inner surface of the ring member (10) to block fluid leaking to the outside of a gasket provided on a flange connection unit; a fastener locking member (30) provided on an end unit of the ring member (20); and a metal fire prevention device (50). The flange shield for backfire prevention of the present invention can effectively block leakage of fluid through the gap between the ring member and the flange.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 파이프 배관의 플랜지 연결부를 감싸도록 설치되어 플랜지 연결부에서 누설되는 화학물질 또는 유체의 확산을 차단하여 유해 화학물질에의 노출 및 폭발에 따른 인명사고 발생을 방지함과 아울러 폭발 환경에 대비한 역화방지기를 적용하여 화재발생시 파이프 배관을 통해 화재가 전파되는 것을 방지하여 인명과 시설물을 보호할 수 있도록 한 역화방지용 플랜지 쉴드에 관한 것으로,  
마주하는 두 파이프 배관(100)에 각각 구비되어 개스킷을 개재하여 결합되는 한 쌍의 플랜지(110) 사이로 누설되는 유체를 차단하도록 상기 플랜지(110)의 외면에 밀착되며 양단이 서로 겹쳐지도록 형성되는 띠 형상의 링부재(10); 플랜지 연결부에 구비된 개스킷의 외측으로 누설되는 유체를 차단하도록 상기 링부재(10)의 내면에 구비되어 상기 플랜지(110) 사이에 위치되는 삽입부재(20); 상기 링부재(10)의 양단이 겹쳐진 상태로 조여 고정하도록 상기 링부재(20)의 단부에 구비되는 매미고리 잠금부재(30); 및 외부의 화염이 플랜지 연결부 사이로 전파되지 않도록 매미고리 잠금부재(30)의 반대쪽에서 링부재(10)에 설치되는 금속재질의 역화방지기(50);를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: SKYENTEC

title_en: Public opinion information propagation prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a public opinion information propagation prediction method and system. The method comprises the following steps: step 1: dividing crowd nodes in a social network into unknown state nodes, support state nodes, opposite state nodes and neutral state nodes according to the attitudes of the crowd nodes to public opinion information; step 2: setting probability factors for converting an unknown state node into other three state nodes at unit time and probability factors for converting a neutral state node into a supporting state node or an opposite state node respectively; step 3: based on the proportion of each state node at the current moment and each probability factor, constructing a first differential equation for obtaining the proportion change of each state node according to an average field theory algorithm; step 4: and according to the first differential equation, a numerical simulation method or an analog simulation method is adopted to display the change process of the number of the state nodes.
assignees: UNIV INFORMATION ENG

title_en: Economic dispatching method for cascade hydropower, photovoltaic and full-power variable-speed pumped storage
abstract_en: The invention discloses an economic dispatching method for cascade hydropower, photovoltaic and full-power variable-speed pumped storage, which is used for carrying out economic dispatching and optimal allocation among the cascade hydropower, photovoltaic and full-power variable-speed pumped storage according to the running state, water supply mode and running state of each unit; the method is based on a combined operation system consisting of step hydropower, photovoltaic and full-power variable-speed pumped storage, wherein the step hydropower, photovoltaic and full-power variable-speed pumped storage units are all converged in the same transformer substation; according to the cascade hydropower, photovoltaic and full-power variable-speed pumped storage combined operation system, the system is connected into an alternating current power grid in a region after converging, and according to the operation condition of a circuit connected with the cascade hydropower and photovoltaic combined operation system and the alternating current power grid, a grid-connected state and a grid-off state are set; the cascade water and light accumulation combined operation system is provided with three water supply modes, including a water-rising mode, a water leveling mode and a water-withering mode. The method has the advantages of reducing the operation cost and improving the economic benefit.
assignees: POWERCHINA HYDROPOWER DEV GROUP CO LTD;SICHUAN XIAOJINCHUAN HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Risk community identification method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application provides a risk community identification method, a device, equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a risk number, wherein the risk number comprises a known fraud number and a number associated with the known fraud number; taking the risk numbers as entities, and constructing a relationship network map according to the association relationship among the risk numbers and the relationship weight among the risk numbers, wherein the relationship network map comprises the entities carrying the labels, the association relationship among the entities and the relationship weight among the entities; traversing each entity in the relation network map by adopting a label propagation algorithm so as to update the labels of the entities; and judging the cell in which the risk number corresponding to the entity carrying the fraud label is located in the updated relation network map as a risk community. The application constructs and updates the relation network map to determine the cell of the entity corresponding to the fraud label, thereby realizing the positioning and identification of the fraud label and improving the identification range and the identification accuracy of the fraud number.
assignees: China Unicom

title_en: BIM-based subway station congestion analysis method, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: BIM-based subway station congestion analysis method, electronic equipment and storage medium belong to the technical field of subway operation. In order to perform congestion analysis on a subway station by using a BIM technology, the invention sets operation nodes of the subway station based on the theory of a complex network to construct a subway station network; acquiring operation data of operation nodes of the subway station to obtain an operation data time sequence of the operation nodes of the subway station, performing data correction and normalization processing on the operation data of the operation nodes of the subway station to obtain operation time sequences of all the operation nodes of the subway station, and performing correlation analysis of the operation nodes of the subway station and congestion propagation process analysis of the operation nodes of the subway station to obtain correlation lag parameters among the operation nodes of the subway station; and setting subway station operation nodes to optimize measures, performing simulation analysis in a BIM model, and performing optimization adjustment on congestion of the subway station operation nodes. The analysis process of the invention is reasonable and effective.
assignees: SHENZHEN URBAN TRANSP PLANNING CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Knowledge and data driving-based photovoltaic system fault diagnosis mixing method
abstract_en: The invention aims to classify and identify five different states of normal operation, open-circuit fault, short-circuit fault, aging fault and shadow blocking fault. A fault diagnosis model based on the DBN is established. The dataset was generated based on Matlab/Simulink models of the photovoltaic array under different operating conditions. Training a DBN model, and optimizing the quantity of neurons of each hidden layer by adopting a BA algorithm to achieve the optimal training result. Then inputting the test data set into a BA-DBN model for photovoltaic array fault diagnosis, wherein the accuracy is obviously higher than that of a K nearest neighbor (K-nearest neighbors, KNN), a back propagation neural network (backpropagation neural network, BPNN) and an original DBN algorithm, and the accuracy reaches 98%.
assignees: SHAOXING DAMING ELECTRIC POWER CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for rapidly calculating traffic noise map, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid calculation method, a rapid calculation device, electronic equipment and a rapid calculation medium for a traffic noise map, wherein the rapid calculation method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of forming a noise source file through multi-source data, converting a building contour shape file into a building binary image, then obtaining an initial noise map grid matrix through a road network and the building contour shape file in a receiving point sound pressure level prediction stage, establishing an initial noise propagation matrix for each road section according to atmospheric attenuation, angle attenuation and road section limited correction coefficients, calculating building density noise attenuation through a Bresenham algorithm, calculating front building noise shielding attenuation according to the building contour shape file, and finally carrying out mapping and acoustic energy superposition on the noise propagation matrices of all road sections according to the initial noise map grid matrix in a result aggregation stage to obtain a road traffic noise map with a complete research area, wherein the method can be widely applied to the technical field of data processing.
assignees: UNIV SUN YAT SEN;SHENZHEN ECOLOGICAL ENV INTELLIGENT PIPE CONTROL CENTER

title_en: Fault detection early warning method and system for new energy charging pile
abstract_en: The application provides a fault detection and early warning method and a system for a new energy charging pile, which relate to the technical field of fault testing, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a charging pile distribution network of a target management area; determining a fault cascade network; a supervision training fault detection module; determining preliminary detection data; if the preliminary detection data is abnormal, performing fault decision and tracing analysis to determine a fault detection result; and transmitting the fault detection result to a charging pile management system for fault visual early warning and operation and maintenance management. The application can solve the technical problem of inaccurate fault detection result caused by the mutual influence and the expansion of the fault range in the prior art, and constructs a fault cascade network by carrying out the multi-element association analysis and the visual compatible analysis of the faults, and combines the charging pile distribution network and the fault cascade network to carry out fault detection early warning, thereby achieving the technical effects of improving the accuracy and the comprehensiveness of fault detection.

title_en: Automobile merchant intelligent risk identification system based on merchant state self-monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of risk identification, in particular to an automobile merchant intelligent risk identification system based on merchant state self-monitoring, which comprises a market dynamic prediction module, a strategy network analysis module, a risk level assessment module, a resource dynamic allocation module, a fuzzy logic risk assessment module, an anomaly detection early warning module, a time window analysis module and a risk management strategy generation module. According to the invention, the opportunity and risk identification accuracy is improved through an autoregressive moving average algorithm and a linear regression model, the social network analysis method is applied to strategy network analysis, the risk propagation path prediction accuracy is improved, the fault tree analysis method and the fuzzy logic model are applied, the risk management effectiveness is improved, the dynamic allocation of resources is optimized through a linear programming model, the resource allocation efficiency is improved, the statistical method and the moving average method are improved, the abnormal point identification accuracy and the risk early warning timeliness are improved, the multi-criterion decision analysis and Monte Carlo simulation are enhanced, and the risk management strategy formulation and optimization are enhanced.

title_en: Bridge deck pavement crack propagation sensitivity analysis method, device and storage medium based on GA-BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bridge deck pavement crack propagation sensitivity analysis method, a device and a storage medium based on a GA-BP neural network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step S1: acquiring a plurality of groups of test data, wherein the test data comprise values of all sensitivity parameters and corresponding values of the maximum crack volume; step S2: training a fracture volume prediction model based on the acquired test data, wherein the fracture volume prediction model is a GA-BP neural network; step S3: selecting a sensitivity parameter; step S4: controlling the selected sensitivity parameters to change in a corresponding preconfigured range, keeping other sensitivity parameters unchanged, obtaining a plurality of target prediction data sets, and inputting each obtained target prediction data set into a trained fracture volume prediction model to obtain a prediction value of the maximum fracture volume corresponding to each target prediction data set; step S5: judging whether traversing of all the sensitive parameters is completed, if yes, executing a step S6, otherwise, selecting one sensitive parameter which is not traversed and returning to the step S4; step S6: and obtaining the local contribution degree and the global sensitivity of each sensitivity parameter based on all target prediction data sets and the prediction value of the corresponding maximum crack volume. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of high speed, high accuracy and the like.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Attack and defense game model based on malicious attack damage analysis of power grid and application method of attack and defense game model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an attack and defense game model based on power grid malicious attack damage analysis and a use method thereof, wherein an attacker destructive power model is established according to the maximum attack equivalent of power grid unit damage association propagation and attacker investment; establishing a defender power system hit scheduling model by considering the associated hit state of the power grid unit; according to the optimization targets of the attacker and the defender, an objective function of the attack and defense game problem is proposed; the mixed integer nonlinear two-person zero and game problem in the original problem is successfully converted into a mixed integer linear optimization problem by applying KKT conditions and linear transformation, and finally, an attacker optimal attack path and an defender optimal scheduling scheme under the malicious attack scene of the power grid are solved by a conventional solver. The model and the method can help the power grid defense dispatcher to formulate more effective defense measures, optimize the resistance strategy and the recovery capacity of the power system, and provide scientific basis for emergency response and recovery planning of the system.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Cross-space cascading failure monitoring method and system for information physical system of active power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention provides a cross-space cascading failure monitoring method and system for an active power distribution network information physical system, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting ADNCPS real-time operation data, and carrying out index calculation and classification according to a cascading failure monitoring index system, wherein the cascading failure monitoring index system at least comprises a plurality of basic indexes and operation environment indexes; judging whether the information physical system of the active power distribution network enters an abnormal working state or not based on a pre-established ADNCPS running state migration model and the classified indexes; and taking the historical operation state of the active power distribution network information physical system as a reference, and determining an operation state evaluation result of the active power distribution network information physical system by utilizing a multi-objective planning method. According to the invention, the running environment index is considered in the running state evaluation flow of the information physical system, and meanwhile, the relevance and the fluctuation between balance indexes can be considered by solving by adopting a multi-objective planning method, so that the accuracy of an output result is ensured.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: Risk analysis method for predicting domino effect accident probability of LNG storage tank
abstract_en: The invention provides a risk analysis method for predicting domino effect accident probability of an LNG storage tank, which comprises the steps of firstly analyzing a damage unit of the domino effect accident according to factors such as layout characteristics of an LNG storage tank area and the like, and judging accident results of the damage unit according to structural characteristics of the damage unit; judging a propagation mode according to the accident result, and further determining the probability of other unit damage caused by the propagation mode; dividing all potential accident units according to domino effect grades, and mapping the potential accident units into a Bayesian network; and finally, analyzing by utilizing the reasoning calculation characteristics of the Bayesian network. The invention has reasonable conception, the constructed model is more scientific and reasonable, the problem of uncertainty of the transmission sequence is solved, the analysis result is more practical, and the analysis and research of the transmission sequence with the maximum possibility are facilitated.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: Tool residual service life prediction method based on space-time feature extraction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for predicting the residual service life of a cutter based on space-time feature extraction, which comprises an end-to-end framework comprising a signal segmentation module, an information extraction module and an information aggregation module, wherein a cutter service life degradation process is modeled by utilizing multipath monitoring signals acquired from a cutter cutting process; constructing an augmentation feature matrix containing space-time related information, performing self-extraction of time domain space domain depth features by using a bidirectional depth convolution architecture, and realizing the relation mapping from space-time features to residual life by using a multi-layer perceptron; dynamically updating the network parameter values to obtain an optimal solution for making the error trend to zero by using a back propagation algorithm around a smooth average absolute error between the real life value and the predicted life value; the gradient descent process is optimized based on the adaptive moment estimation, and an initialization weight is determined according to the input dimension so as to improve the adaptability of the model. Experiments are carried out by using the cutter data, so that the method has good comprehensive performance, and the full life cycle degradation process of the cutter can be well predicted.
assignees: SHENYANG INST AUTOMATION CAS

title_en: Yolov 5-based forest fire detection optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest fire detection optimization method based on yolov, which belongs to the field of target detection in the field of image processing, and comprises the following steps: firstly, the invention designs a trunk network combining the cascading pyramid feature extraction and MobileNetv, which is used for improving the detection efficiency of the forest multi-scale targets and further accelerating the training speed of the network. Secondly, the invention designs a convolution structure which inserts the deformable convolution into the bneck blocks in MobileNetv to improve the precision of the whole detection network, effectively improves the detection precision of fire and smoke with various forms under a complex background, and simultaneously ensures that the detection speed can also meet the requirement of real-time detection.
assignees: UNIV YANSHAN

title_en: Three-dimensional geoelectromagnetic forward modeling method for pre-training model cyclic transfer learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional geomagnetic forward modeling method for pre-training model cyclic transfer learning, which solves the problem of time consuming forward modeling in the prior art and comprises the following steps: randomly generating a three-dimensional ground model; forward computing is carried out on the three-dimensional ground model to obtain three-dimensional forward response data; constructing a three-dimensional deep learning network for extracting self-attention mechanism features; inputting training sample pairs into a three-dimensional deep learning network extracted from self-attention mechanism features, adopting cyclic sharing network weights, combining three-dimensional forward modeling response data of any parameter in any polarization direction, adopting back propagation to calculate gradients, and updating parameters of the three-dimensional deep learning network through an optimizer; establishing nonlinear mapping between the three-dimensional ground model and three-dimensional forward response data of any parameter of any polarization direction to obtain a trained three-dimensional deep learning network; and inputting the verification sample pair into the trained three-dimensional deep learning network to obtain three-dimensional geoelectromagnetic forward data.

title_en: Railway engineering safety risk cause and conduction mechanism analysis method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a railway engineering safety risk cause and a conduction mechanism analysis method thereof, which comprises the steps of obtaining railway engineering safety accident cases, and further comprising the following steps: analyzing railway work safety accident cases, and mining risk causes; according to the risk cause, processing the accident case and forming a railway work safety risk cause data table; substituting the railway engineering safety risk cause data table into a multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm, screening out railway engineering safety risk key causes, and forming a railway engineering safety risk key cause data matrix; substituting the data matrix of the railway safety risk key causes into a Bayesian network, performing structure learning and parameter learning, and analyzing the occurrence probability, posterior probability and conduction mechanism of the risk key causes. According to the invention, index screening meets the requirements of practical application, the Bayesian network structure is optimized, and the propagation diagnosis and probability of the risk key indexes are analyzed to obtain a causal logic chain for generating accident results.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING UNION

title_en: Intelligent rapid aggregation method for air conditioner load groups
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent rapid aggregation method for air conditioner load groups, which comprises the following steps: step one: aiming at the load of a single air conditioner connected in a power grid, a typical air conditioner load model is established based on an equivalent thermal parameter model; step two: aiming at a large number of air-conditioning loads under the same node of an access power grid, designing an air-conditioning load group adjustable potential evaluation model, and evaluating the schedulable capacity of the air-conditioning load group; step three: forming an electric comprehensive distance based on the adjustable potential, active-voltage sensitivity and reactive-voltage sensitivity of the air conditioner load group, and generating an air conditioner load group history aggregation scheme library based on an affinity propagation clustering algorithm, wherein the method comprises the following steps: and constructing a voltage-power fitting model based on the generalized regression neural network based on the historical aggregation scheme library of the air conditioner load group. The invention generates an aggregation scheme by carrying out rapid intelligent aggregation on the air conditioner load groups in the system, thereby laying a model foundation for improving the voltage stability and economy of the system.
assignees: STATE GRID HUNAN COMPREHENSIVE ENERGY SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Satellite emergency communication vehicle and emergency communication system
abstract_en: The application provides a satellite emergency communication vehicle and an emergency communication system, wherein the satellite emergency communication vehicle comprises: the system comprises a vehicle-mounted base station and vehicle-mounted satellite communication equipment; the vehicle-mounted base station is used for receiving multimedia data collected by the unmanned aerial vehicle and sent by the wireless communication system base station, and sending the multimedia data to the vehicle-mounted satellite communication equipment; and the vehicle-mounted satellite communication equipment is used for transmitting the received multimedia data to a satellite so that the multimedia data can be transmitted to a ground gateway station through the satellite. Since the satellite emergency communication vehicle can mount a larger-sized satellite communication device, the transmission bandwidth of the base station can be enlarged. At the same time, the multimedia data is transmitted to the ground gateway station through the satellite. Because the communication capacity of satellite is big, consequently can enlarge the frequency of propagation, be difficult to cause the network to block up to satisfy unmanned aerial vehicle and gather the demand of data transmission.
assignees: China Unicom

title_en: Water-wind-solar-energy-storage multifunctional complementary real-time intelligent operation method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-wind-solar-energy storage multifunctional complementary real-time intelligent operation method, a device and equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring operation data of a river basin cascade hydropower station, a river basin cascade hydroelectric power station and a hybrid power station and a water, wind and light storage multifunctional complementary system; taking a day as a dispatching cycle, an hour as a dispatching time period, taking the minimum power grid residual load variance as a dispatching target, and simultaneously taking the operation constraint of a water-wind-light energy storage source and the constraint of an electric power system into consideration to construct a water-wind-light energy storage day-ahead joint optimization dispatching model; and carrying out water-wind-solar-storage multifunctional complementary real-time intelligent operation scheduling according to the water-wind-solar-storage day-ahead combined optimization scheduling model. According to the invention, the minimum power grid residual load variance is used as a scheduling target, and the water-wind-solar-storage combined optimal scheduling is carried out, so that the optimal running control scheme of the water and the wind power before and after the water-wind-storage bundling is realized, the peak-valley difference of the power grid residual load is reduced, the safety and the good digestion capability of the power grid are ensured, and the clean energy utilization rate is improved.
assignees: GUIZHOU QIANYUAN POWER CO LTD

title_en: Structural seismic response prediction method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a structural seismic response prediction method and a system based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: based on the dynamic characteristics of the structure, extracting parameter indexes of all seismic records in a seismic database, and constructing a parameter index set; carrying out nonlinear time-course analysis NLTHA on the parameter index set, and calculating response results of the structure recorded in all earthquake motions to obtain a structure reaction set; carrying out multiple rounds of comparison and selection on the parameter indexes through an artificial neural network, and selecting a parameter index chain set of the optimal combination; and training the BP neural network based on the parameter index chain set and the structure reaction set of the optimal combination, and predicting earthquake responses of other structures through the trained BP neural network. The invention realizes the quick, accurate and wide-application-range earthquake response prediction method through the error back propagation algorithm in the deep learning.
assignees: UNIV GUANGZHOU

title_en: Power grid real-time operation risk identification and power restoration management system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of deep learning, in particular to a power grid real-time operation risk identification and power restoration management system based on deep learning, which comprises a data center: the system is used for collecting multisource information of a power grid and storing data in a classified mode; analysis processing unit: the data fusion correlation analysis is used for preprocessing the received data and carrying out data fusion correlation analysis; risk identification unit: the risk position and the cause are determined according to the analyzed data; and (3) a management and control center: for taking corresponding measures against the impact of the risk event. According to the invention, risk real-time sensing and identification can be carried out, range reasons related to fault information and cascading fault events can be obtained through analysis based on deep learning, intelligent early warning is carried out, the fault information can be displayed on a large screen in real time, and after fault burst, a reasonable and safe power supply restoration path can be quickly selected based on historical fault information.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD ZUNYI POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Hydrogen-containing comprehensive energy system optimal scheduling method and system considering auxiliary service
abstract_en: The application discloses an optimization scheduling method and system of a hydrogen-containing comprehensive energy system considering auxiliary service, wherein the method is used for performing optimization scheduling on the hydrogen-containing comprehensive energy system considering the provision of electric auxiliary service, and comprises the following steps: the hydrogen energy cascade utilization is considered, and the hydrogen-containing comprehensive energy system model is established; considering providing frequency modulation and standby auxiliary services for an external power grid, and establishing an operation model of the comprehensive energy service provider containing the auxiliary services; taking maximum operation profit as a target, and taking an auxiliary service model and a green license-carbon transaction mechanism into consideration to establish an optimal scheduling model of the hydrogen-containing comprehensive energy system; and carrying out global optimal solution on the optimal scheduling model to obtain the optimal auxiliary service providing quantity and the optimal scheduling scheme of the comprehensive energy system. The application can solve the problem that the existing other comprehensive energy system scheduling models can not consider hydrogen energy utilization and can not consider providing electric auxiliary service outwards.
assignees: JINGMEN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;HAINAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ZHEJIANG UNIV;HUBEI JINGNENG POWER TRANS AND TRANSFORMATION ENGINEERING CO LTD;JINGMEN SHENGHE ELECTRIC POWER SURVEY AND DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Noise-based power grid cascading failure model optimization method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid cascading failure model optimization method, a system and a storage medium based on noise, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing an importance model of the power grid node and calculating an initial load strategy; calculating a load capacity strategy according to the initial load strategy; calculating a load redistribution policy according to load transfer and noise; constructing a noise-based power grid cascading failure model; calculating a power grid load capacity critical threshold according to the influence of different variable parameters on the power grid cascading failure model; and optimizing a power grid load capacity critical threshold according to the influence of noise on the power grid cascading failure model. The method solves the problems that node importance values cannot be comprehensively considered and evaluation on external interference factors is lacking in the current power grid cascading failure model.
assignees: HANGZHOU ZHONGHENG ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Hydropower station emergency escape exercise method, system, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a hydropower station emergency escape exercise method, a hydropower station emergency escape exercise system, a storage medium and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of emergency exercises, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a cascade hydropower station VR virtual reality server infrastructure supporting multi-person collaboration; establishing a dynamic emergency environment generation model based on the historical emergency accident data; designing emergency escape simulation resources according to a dynamic emergency environment generation model; remotely monitoring escape performance of each user in the escape process, and judging whether the user is in an acceptable range; the escape performance emergency coefficients of different drilling groups are obtained through calculation, and improvement suggestions are provided for an emergency escape drilling command center, a team and a user; the invention solves the problems that the common emergency exercise flow is difficult to truly simulate the actual emergency situation, and the exercise flow is complicated and single in configuration or is limited by time, space and resources, so that a large amount of manpower and material resources are wasted.

title_en: Double-cluster management method based on openGauss database
abstract_en: The invention relates to a double-cluster management method based on openGauss databases. The method is based on openGauss providing cascading flow copying capability from hadr _main_standby to castade_standby, dividing a part of standby in a single-cluster scheme into a new cluster, and selecting one standby in the new cluster as hadr _main_standby, wherein the standby performs flow copying from primary; the rest of the standby in the new cluster is taken as a cascade_standby, and the cascade flow copy is carried out from hadr _main_standby. The double-cluster high-availability scheme provided by the invention can easily realize the deployment of double clusters and the switching among clusters. When the main cluster fails, the standby cluster can be manually lifted to be the main cluster, so that service can be continuously provided, and disaster recovery is realized. The method not only can lighten the flow replication pressure of primary, but also can greatly reduce the network resource occupation caused by flow replication in a disaster recovery scene in different places, and simultaneously provides a simple method for improving the standby cluster to the master cluster.
assignees: GUANGZHOU MASS DATABASE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Expressway multi-scale traffic situation deduction method under unpredictable traffic event
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for deducing multi-scale traffic situation of a highway under the occurrence of an unpredictable traffic event, which utilizes the state information of vehicles recorded by a highway side unit and a toll station under the occurrence of the unpredictable traffic event to acquire multi-scale traffic parameter data through information coupling; constructing a highway traffic situation propagation model under the occurrence of unpredictable traffic events based on the infectious disease model so as to accurately describe the propagation characteristics of traffic behaviors in the network; based on traffic parameter data, traffic behavior propagation characteristics and expressway traffic node division, the spatial-temporal correlation of the multi-scale traffic parameter data is modeled by using a hypergraph convolutional neural network, so that traffic situation deduction at the expressway node level is realized. The invention can fill the defect of real-time perception of the unexpected traffic event on the expressway, provide accurate traffic situation evolution information for the management department, and assist the management department to quickly formulate reasonable traffic control and emergency rescue measures.
assignees: UNIV XINJIANG;UNIV TONGJI;RES INST HIGHWAY MINI TRANSP

title_en: Landslide image segmentation method based on multi-layer feature information fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide image segmentation method based on multi-layer characteristic information fusion, which specifically comprises the following steps: acquiring a landslide image data set, preprocessing the landslide image data set, and dividing the landslide image data set into a training set and a verification set; the landslide image semantic segmentation network model based on multi-layer characteristic information fusion is constructed, and the landslide image semantic segmentation network model comprises an encoder and a decoder, wherein the encoder comprises a main network, a cascading strip-shaped space pyramid pooling module and a high-efficiency channel attention module, and the decoder comprises a multi-layer characteristic information fusion structure; respectively training and verifying the network model by using the training set and the verification set, calculating a loss function, carrying out back propagation, and updating network model parameters to obtain a trained landslide image semantic segmentation network model; inputting the landslide image to be segmented into a trained landslide image semantic segmentation network model to obtain a segmentation result of the landslide image to be segmented. According to the invention, the detection capability of the landslide region is improved by enhancing the edge information of the landslide image.
assignees: UNIV WUXI

title_en: Power system load prediction method based on deep belief network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system load prediction, in particular to a power system load prediction method based on a deep belief network, which comprises the steps of obtaining training samples and test samples, constructing a DBN complex neural network formed by RBMs, using two classifier models, predicting and analyzing the advantages and disadvantages of the two classifications by using a classification recognition deep belief network algorithm, determining a final classification strategy of an input factor and an output factor, training the RBMs in a layer-by-layer iteration mode, and constructing a power load prediction model by using classification data to obtain a predicted value of the power system load. According to the power system load prediction method based on the deep belief network, a limited Boltzmann machine and a supervised back propagation algorithm are applied, a deep power load prediction model is built, and input high-dimensional load data are subjected to dimension reduction processing, so that the network can fully capture the characteristics of the data, the characteristic extraction capacity of the prediction model is improved, and the accuracy and the stability of load prediction are improved.
assignees: UNIV CHINA THREE GORGES CTGU

title_en: Optimal scheduling method, device, equipment and medium for cascade water-light complementary power generation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of new energy of electric power systems, in particular to an optimized dispatching method, device, equipment and medium of a cascade water-light complementary power generation system, which comprises the following steps: based on the data analysis of the historical electricity price, constructing a spot price prediction model; acquiring typical photovoltaic output scenes representing different weather conditions by adopting a density peak clustering algorithm; the method is characterized by taking the maximum electricity price gain of a water-light complementary power generation system and the minimum peak-valley difference of a receiving end power grid Yu Fuhe as double targets, and simultaneously taking the complex constraint of cascade hydropower and the limit of the transmission capacity of the outgoing power into consideration; constructing a multi-objective optimization scheduling model of the cascade water-light complementary power generation system considering the peak regulation requirement of the power grid and the economic benefit of the system; and solving the multi-objective optimization model based on NSGA-NPSO non-dominant layered niche particle swarm algorithm to obtain the optimal scheduling method of the cascade water-light complementary power generation system, so that the scheduling result is more matched with the actual situation, and the economy and safety of the system are improved.

title_en: System for monitoring fire accident of engine room in ship
title_ko: 선박 엔진룸 화재사고 감지 시스템
abstract_en: A technical task to be achieved by an idea of the present invention is to provide a ship engine room fire accident detection system that measures mist oil and predicts a possibility of a fire through video analysis based on artificial intelligence, and enables more stable and rapid identification of and response to an initial fire situation even in an event of a power failure of a power grid or sensor malfunction at the time of the initial fire. Provided is the ship engine room fire accident detection system comprising: an optical camera that takes a video and generates first video information; a thermal image camera that takes a thermal video and generates second video information and temperature rise information; a first prediction part that extracts an object of a worker from the first video information and the second video information, and predicts a possibility of a fire according to the distribution and concentration of mist oil by the first video information; a second prediction part that extracts the object of the worker from the first video information and the second video information, analyzes a behavioral pattern, and predicts the possibility of the fire according to the behavioral pattern; a third prediction part that extracts a flame pattern, a smoke pattern, and a temperature rise pattern from the first video information and the second video information, and predicts the possibility of the fire thereby; and an integrated monitoring part.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 제1영상정보를 생성하는 광학카메라(110), 제2영상정보와 온도상승정보를 생성하는 열화상카메라(120), 딥러닝기반의 제1예측알고리즘을 통해, 제1영상정보에 의한 미스트오일의 분포와 농도에 따른 화재가능성을 예측하는 제1예측부(130), 딥러닝기반의 제2예측알고리즘을 통해, 제1영상정보 및 제2영상정보로부터 작업자의 객체를 추출하고 행동패턴을 분석하여 행동패턴에 따른 화재가능성을 예측하는 제2예측부(140), 딥러닝기반의 제3예측알고리즘을 통해, 제1영상정보 및 제2영상정보로부터 불꽃패턴과 연기패턴과 온도상승패턴을 추출하고 이에 따른 화재가능성을 예측하는 제3예측부(150), 및 제1예측부(130) 또는 제3예측부(150)에 의한 화재가능성에 따라 화재경고를 전파하고, 통합가능성을 산출하여 실재 화재상황을 식별하여 화재경고를 전파하는, 통합 모니터링부(160)를 포함하여, 화재초기상황을 신속하게 판단하여 신속하게 대응하도록 하는, 선박 엔진룸 화재사고 감지 시스템을 개시한다.
assignees: ILJIN AND CO LTD

title_en: New energy cluster grid-connected planning method and system considering off-grid risk
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy cluster grid-connected planning method considering off-grid risk, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: acquiring power planning information in a target area; constructing a new energy cluster access and regional power grid coordination expansion planning model considering off-grid risks; and inputting the power supply planning information into a new energy cluster access and regional power grid coordinated expansion planning model to solve, so as to obtain a grid multi-stage expansion planning scheme suitable for the transmission and the consumption of the new energy cluster. According to the method, the coordination and expansion planning model and related constraint conditions are constructed by considering the large-scale new energy offline risk existing under the condition of the grid-connected line fault of the collecting station, so that the large-scale new energy cascading offline risk under the condition of the grid-connected line fault of a certain collecting station can be handled, and the overall technical economic benefit of the scheme is optimal.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Method and system of learning-based problem management for information technology (it) operations
abstract_en: An architecture of an enterprise can be fully on on-premises with multiple computing systems or on cloud or on Hybrid. Enterprise information technology (IT) departments are continually adopting new technologies and changes leads more complex, and increased probability of service disruption, through malfunctions in software, hardware, networks, natural disasters, simple human error. Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a method and system to detect problem associated with the computing system in an enterprise. A plurality of data associated with each resource in the enterprise is received. The plurality of data is considered to iteratively perform (a) derive a parameter associated with a metric data, and an incident data to obtain an analyzed data, (b) detect a problem associated with each resources by processing the plurality of analyzed data based on a propositional logic, and (c) generate a feedback associated with each problem of the resources in a subsequent iteration.
assignees: TATA CONSULTANCY SERVICES LTD

title_en: High-voltage energy storage power unit supplied without power outage
abstract_en: The utility model provides a high-voltage energy storage power unit supplied without power outage, which belongs to the technical field of power electronics, and comprises: the device comprises an uncontrolled rectifying module, an inversion module, a DCDC module and a battery cluster. The uncontrolled rectifying module and the inversion module can realize variable frequency operation of a rear-stage load motor, and the DCDC module and the battery cluster can realize energy storage and release. The high-voltage energy storage power unit can realize energy flow among the uncontrolled rectifying module, the inversion module and the DCDC module according to the state of the main power grid. The utility model can drive the motor to perform variable frequency operation after a plurality of units are cascaded, and simultaneously realizes the storage of the energy of the power grid or the release of the stored energy to the inversion module, thereby ensuring the continuous uninterrupted operation of the load after the power failure of the main power grid.
assignees: SHANDONG WINDSUN ELECTRONICS SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wind-powered electricity generation intelligent monitoring and early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent wind power monitoring and early warning system, which comprises: the intelligent sensing terminal, the big data analysis and processing module, the power prediction module, the data correction module, the intelligent monitoring module, the network-related scheduling module, the intelligent storage module, the safety protection module, the intelligent equipment maintenance module, the fault statistics analysis module and the fault prediction module are used for realizing the functions of real-time weather information acquisition, ultra-short-term prediction of wind power, real-time monitoring and fault early warning of wind power equipment and the like of the wind power equipment. The power prediction module adopts a BP neural network model based on L-M optimization, and can improve the accuracy of wind power output prediction under various meteorological conditions through the processes of data preprocessing, network initialization, training sample selection, forward and backward propagation, improvement of L-M algorithm optimization, training optimization, wind power prediction and the like, and the accurate control of wind power output is realized by combining variable confidence interval correction.
assignees: HUANENG LUOYUAN POWER GENERATION CO LTD;XIAN THERMAL POWER RES INST CO

title_en: Cascade reservoir group joint scheduling rule optimization method based on big data samples
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade reservoir group joint scheduling rule optimization method based on big data samples, which comprises the steps of collecting and sorting reservoir group scheduling basic data; generating a big data random runoff sample set by using a deep convolution to generate an countermeasure network; constructing a reservoir group joint optimization scheduling cloud parallel model and a cloud computing cluster; constructing a joint scheduling rule input factor and a decision variable sample set; constructing a multi-input multi-output cascade reservoir group joint optimization scheduling rule model by adopting a random forest regression algorithm; and performing scheduling operation simulation on the trained scheduling rules, and evaluating scheduling operation results. According to the invention, the large data sample is efficiently obtained through the deep convolution generation countermeasure network and the Spark-based cloud parallel computing technology, and the multi-input multi-output type dispatching rule is optimized based on the large data sample, so that the application precision and generalization capability of the cascade reservoir group joint dispatching rule are improved, and the large-scale high-dimensional reservoir group optimized dispatching and refined management are realized.

title_en: Interference SAR sample generation model and image target detection model construction method
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of image detection and discloses a method for constructing an interference SAR sample generation model and an image target detection model, wherein the method for constructing the sample generation model comprises the steps of obtaining an interference-free SAR image and an interference SAR image of a research object, and synthesizing the interference-free SAR image and the interference SAR image to obtain a content image; and training the content image and the style image respectively into a style migration network to generate an interference SAR sample, calculating training loss, updating network parameters through counter propagation to improve the fidelity of generating the interference SAR sample, and training for multiple times until the training loss converges to obtain an interference SAR sample generation model. The style migration network comprises a reversible residual error module, a channel refinement module and a conversion module. By the method, the problem of lack of the current SAR data sample can be solved, and more realistic interference SAR samples can be rapidly generated.

title_en: Power grid operation decision analysis method, system and equipment based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a machine learning-based power grid operation decision analysis method, a system and equipment, which relate to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical power grid operation data; a trend increment module is constructed; an improved autoregressive model with a multi-layer gating circulating unit is built, and a trend increment module and the improved autoregressive model are connected in parallel to obtain a fusion prediction model; training the fusion prediction model, and performing super-parameter optimization by taking the minimized loss function as a target; acquiring real-time power grid operation data; inputting real-time power grid operation data into the trained fusion prediction model, and outputting a power prediction sequence; determining an error propagation coefficient positively correlated with the predicted time length of the fused power characteristic sequence, and calculating the total power dispatching amount in the preset time length by combining the error propagation coefficient and the instantaneous power demand; and performing power scheduling according to the instantaneous power demand and the total power scheduling amount. The error propagation influence in the prediction process is reduced, and the prediction accuracy is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;BEIJING KEDONG ELECTRIC POWER CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD;PINGTAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF XIAMEN UNIV

title_en: Position and capacity optimization method for distributed photovoltaic access power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention provides a position and capacity optimization method of a distributed photovoltaic access power distribution network, which comprises the following steps of S1: defining Beta distribution of solar light intensity, and probability density functions of photovoltaic output power and electric load, and simulating power generation and load fluctuation under actual conditions; step S2: constructing a voltage evaluation model of propagation uncertainty by configuring a local agent and a central coordinator and defining a coordination function; step S3: the uncertainty in model output is quantified by a Sobol method through multi-agent reinforcement learning and optimization parameter updating strategies; step S4: and (3) through dispersing calculation tasks and exchanging information, establishing a model to optimize the address and capacity of the photovoltaic access node, minimizing line loss and considering constraint conditions. The invention provides powerful support for stable operation, efficiency improvement and sustainable development of the power grid through accurately processing and quantifying the uncertainty in the power grid and optimizing the distributed photovoltaic access strategy.
assignees: NANJING ANENGJIE ELECTRIC POWER IND CO LTD

title_en: PMU (Power management Unit) point distribution method and system considering fault reconstruction and state estimation precision
abstract_en: A PMU (Power management Unit) dotting method and system considering fault reconstruction and state estimation precision utilizes pseudo quantity measurement, SCADA (supervisory control and data acquisition) quantity measurement and PMU and DULR (coordinated measurement and calculation) to calculate state estimation voltage and state estimation error covariance matrix; based on E-optimal design standard, taking the magnitude relation between the characteristic value of the state estimation error covariance matrix and the specified value as the state estimation precision index of the power distribution network; taking the minimum installation cost as an objective function of a PMU (Power management Unit) distribution model, taking the power flow operation constraint and the topology constraint of the power distribution network as basic constraint of the distribution model, and taking the fault propagation constraint and the load loss constraint of the power distribution network as relay protection characteristic constraint of the distribution model; and under the condition that the state estimation precision index of the power distribution network is met, carrying out joint solution on an objective function, basic constraint and relay protection characteristic constraint, and determining PMU joint optimization distribution points by taking the state estimation precision in a normal state and the load loss rates in a plurality of fault scenes as constraint conditions.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD SUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH

title_en: Comprehensive power quality assessment method, system, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, in particular to a comprehensive power quality assessment method, a system, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein the comprehensive power quality assessment method comprises the following steps: based on the historical data of the power grid, the power factor of the power grid is simulated by combining time fluctuation, the power factor fluctuation driven by load change, power grid faults and power supply instability factors is analyzed, and a power factor fluctuation statistical model is generated. According to the invention, through analyzing historical data and time fluctuation of the power grid, the evaluation accuracy of the power factor and harmonic behavior of the power grid is improved, the electric energy quality of the power grid under various operation conditions is calculated and analyzed, the extremum and fluctuation range of the power factor are identified and predicted, the influence of the harmonic on the power grid quality is evaluated through simulating the generation, propagation and attenuation processes of the harmonic in the power grid in real time, and scientific data support is provided for evaluating the electric energy quality by combining with the stability of the power factor analysis, so that accurate fault prediction and quality control are performed.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Distributed coordinated operation method of active power distribution network and electric hydrogen production and hydrogenation integrated station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed coordinated operation method of an active power distribution network and an electro-hydrogen production and hydrogenation integrated station, belonging to the technical field of operation optimization of grid-connected electro-hydrogen production and hydrogenation integrated stations, comprising the following steps: taking the operation characteristics of equipment such as an electrolytic tank, a compressor, a hydrogen storage bottle group, a hydrogenation machine and the like adopting a PEM technology into consideration, and constructing a refined model of the electro-hydrogen hydrogenation integrated station; the method comprises the steps of establishing a double-layer optimization model of coordination of operation of an active power distribution network and an electric hydrogen production and hydrogenation integrated station by taking the optimal operation of the active power distribution network and each electric hydrogen production and hydrogenation integrated station as a target; the convergence performance of the target cascade analysis method is improved, the double-layer optimization model is converted into a distributed framework by the method, and solvers CPLEX and MOSEK are embedded to solve the distributed framework. The invention can realize the distributed coordination operation between the active power distribution network and a plurality of electric hydrogen production and hydrogenation integrated stations.
assignees: XINJIANG PRODUCTION AND CONSTRUCTION CORPS XINGXIN VOCATIONAL AND TECHNICAL COLLEGE

title_en: Big data-based energy management system
abstract_en: The application discloses an energy management system based on big data, which relates to the technical field of energy management, and comprises a data screening module: the method comprises the steps of obtaining network data, screening to obtain screening results, and processing the screening results to obtain target data; and a data analysis module: the method comprises the steps of obtaining the propagation rate of target data based on the target data; history analysis module: the method comprises the steps of extracting historical data in network data to obtain a historical reddening city and a historical reddening industry, and obtaining a reddening mode; load prediction module: the method is used for obtaining electricity load change data of the city according to the reddening mode and the propagation rate; and the energy management module is used for: the power utilization control system is used for obtaining power utilization control requirements according to power utilization load change data, and carrying out energy management layout on urban power energy based on a target area and the power utilization control requirements. The application has the effect of improving the flexibility and the stability of the electric quantity management of the city when the electric load changes.
assignees: ZHONGNENG GUANGHE SUZHOU NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wavefront sensor construction method based on coding and decoding combined optimization
abstract_en: The application provides a wave front sensor construction method based on coding and decoding combined optimization, which comprises the following steps: carrying out mathematical modeling on the propagation process of the optical wave to obtain a coding module, and constructing a network architecture comprising the coding module and the decoding module; based on a depth learning technology, carrying out joint training on the structure of the coding layer and a wavefront reconstruction algorithm to obtain optimized coding structure and reconstruction parameters; preparing an optimized coding layer by using a novel material, and replacing original protective glass on the surface of the wavefront sensor with the prepared coding layer; and carrying out physical calibration on the structure of the integrated coding layer, fine-tuning the network architecture based on the current application task, and adjusting a reconstruction algorithm of the wavefront sensor according to the fine-tuned reconstruction parameters. The method can construct a miniaturized and lightweight wave-front sensor to reconstruct wave-front with high quality and high efficiency by carrying out joint optimization on the coding layer structure and the wave-front reconstruction algorithm.
assignees: BEIJING INSTITUTE TECH

title_en: Power grid performance prediction method and system based on depth matrix decomposition technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid performance prediction method and a system based on a depth matrix decomposition technology, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring data in a smart grid sensor, normalizing the data, forming an original data matrix from the normalized data, and generating an indication matrix corresponding to the original data matrix; stacking a plurality of fully-connected neural networks into a deep neural network model, inputting regularized variables into the deep neural network model as potential variables, and simultaneously taking an original data matrix as input and output of a denoising self-encoder to obtain a smart grid data matrix; based on a back propagation optimization algorithm, the optimal weight matrix and bias coefficient of the smart grid data matrix are obtained to obtain a corresponding reconstruction data matrix; according to the method, the nonlinear relation in the measured data is considered for normalization, and the reconstructed data matrix is utilized to recover the lost measured data of the power grid, so that the problem that the nonlinear characteristics in the measured data cannot be extracted is effectively solved.
assignees: STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION BRANCH;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;INFORMATION COMMUNICATION BRANCH STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Mine energy electric load prediction method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power prediction, in particular to a mine energy electric load prediction method and device. The method comprises the steps of removing abnormal values of mine energy electric load data by adopting a clustering algorithm to obtain processed data; based on the processed data, constructing a deep learning model for predicting the mine energy electric load by using a Bi-directional long-short-term memory network Bi-LSTM; training the deep learning model through a back propagation algorithm, judging the training progress of the deep learning model by using a Huber loss function, and obtaining a trained deep learning model after training is completed; and acquiring mine energy electric load data in real time, and inputting the mine energy electric load data into a trained deep learning model to obtain the mine energy electric load prediction. By accurately predicting the mine energy electric load, a relevant decision maker can make scheduling decisions on the mine energy use condition in advance, thereby being beneficial to optimizing the production process, reducing the production cost and improving the efficiency.
assignees: QINGHAI YELLOW RIVER MINING IND CO LTD;STATE NUCLEAR ELECTRIC POWER PLANNING DESIGN & RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Cascade tap hydropower station water level prediction and regulation method supporting new energy flexibility
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of complementary coordination scheduling of multiple energy sources of water, wind and light, in particular to a cascade tap hydropower station water level prediction and regulation method supporting the flexibility of new energy sources, aiming at improving the power supply and absorption capacity of a drainage basin tap hydropower station supporting power grid under the uncertain background of the power generation capacity of the runoff power generation and the wind and light new energy sources.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN TECH

title_en: Fault emergency scheduling method and system for cascade hydropower station equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a fault emergency dispatching method and system for cascade hydropower station equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical operation data and real-time operation data of each level hydropower station in the cascade hydropower station; determining important power flow sections of hydropower stations of all levels in a power grid topology; analyzing and monitoring equipment faults based on important tide sections and combining real-time operation data with power grid topology; calculating the power generation loss of the faulty hydropower station according to the fault analysis result of the equipment fault analysis monitoring; combining the real-time operation data and the power loss and adopting a genetic algorithm to generate an initial emergency scheduling scheme of the cascade hydropower station; predicting maintenance recovery time for recovering all the faulty hydropower stations to a normal running state; and combining the real-time operation data, the power loss and the maintenance recovery time, and adopting a second generation genetic algorithm to generate an optimal emergency scheduling scheme of the cascade hydropower station. The invention has the effect of safely and rapidly carrying out real-time emergency dispatch.
assignees: WUHAN HUAFEI INTELLIGENT ELECTRICAL TECH CO LTD;CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Automatic elevator call formation device and method using a pressure sensor tag-type wireless signal transmission module on a Braille sidewalk block for the visually impaired
title_ko: 시각장애인용 점자보도블럭상에서의 압력센서태그형 무선 시그널 송출모듈을 통한 엘리베이터 호출 자동형성장치 및 방법
abstract_en: Provided is an automatic elevator call forming device which generates a tag signal by sensing pressing pressure, activates a wireless antenna, and then transmits a wireless signal for automatically pressing an elevator call button to call an elevator. The automatic elevator call forming device using a pressure sensor tag type wireless signal transmission module on a braille sidewalk block for the visually impaired comprises: a braille sidewalk block pressure sensor tag type wireless signal transmission module (100) which transmits a wireless signal for automatically pressing an elevator call button to call an elevator to a wireless signal reader module; and a wireless signal reader module (200) which transmits a call button automatic pressing signal for automatically pressing an elevator call button to call an elevator. In the present invention, compatibility is excellent by being compatible with an existing braille sidewalk block through a powerless structure of a pressure sensor tag type wireless signal transmission unit consisting of a pressure sensor tag unit and a unidirectional powerless wireless signal transmission unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에서는 종래 장애인이나 몸이 불편한 환자 등이 엘리베이터를 쉽게 호출할 수 있도록 하는 풋 버튼 기술, 엘리베이터 카의 호출장치의 경우에, 시각장애인이 엘리베이터 앞에 왔을 때 결국에는 시각장애인 스스로가 호출버튼을 눌러야 하기 때문에, 호출버튼을 찾지 못해 헤매다가 엘리베이터 문에 손이 끼는 안전사고의 문제점과, 바닥면에 시각장애인 전용 인식장비 설치시, 점자보도블럭과 호환되지 않고, 별도로 설치해야 하므로, 설치비용이 비싸지고, 무엇보다, 전기를 사용하기 때문에 전력소모가 많이 발생되는 문제점을 개선하고자, 점자보도블럭 압력센서태그형 무선 시그널 송출모듈(100), 무선 시그널 리더기모듈(200)로 구성됨으로서, 압력센서태그부, 단방향 무(無)전력 무선 시그널 송출부로 이루어진 압력센서태그형 무선 시그널 송출부의 무(無)전력구조를 통해, 기존 점자보도블록에 호환시킬 수 있어, 호환성이 우수하고, 기존보다 60% 저렴한 가격에 설치할 수 있으며, 무엇보다 전력소비 제로율과 함께, 밀봉효과가 우수하고, 배터리가 필요없어 별도의 유지보수가 필요없으며, 바닥 청소시, 물기 유입에 구애받지 않고, 정상구동시킬 수 있어, 실제 활용도를 기존에 비해 80% 향상시킬 수 있고, 시각장애인이 엘리베이터 앞의 점자보도블럭상에 위치했을때, 눌러지는 압력센싱에 의한 태그신호를 생성시켜, 무선 안테나를 활성화시킨 후, RFID 식별번호와 함께 시각장애인이 점자보도블럭부상에 있으므로, 엘리베이터 호출버튼이 자동으로 눌러지면서 호출되도록 하는 무선 시그널을 무선 시그널 리더기모듈쪽으로 송출시킬 수 있어, 시각장애인의 엘리베이터 앞 안전사고발생율을 기존에 비해 80%이하로 낮출 수 있으며, 점자보도블럭 압력센서태그형 무선 시그널 송출모듈에서, 무선 시그널 리더기모듈을 통해 형성된 RF송출거리인 50cm~100cm에 맞게, RF인식거리를 20cm~30cm로 형성시켜, RF전파(Radion waves) 에너지를 수신받고, 무선 시그널 리더기모듈쪽에 유도기전력을 발생시켜 신호화한 IC칩부의 고유정보를 전송시킬 수 있어, 기존에 비해 하중에 따른 센싱정밀성을 1.5배~3배 향상시켜, 엘리베이터 호출 자동형성 뿐만 아니라, 아파트나 병원의 현관문 자동 개폐시설, 경기장 입장객 압사사고방지용 하중계산 기초데이터, 건축물 붕괴사고 방지데이터에 널리 응용시켜 새로운 압력센서태그시장을 주도해 나갈 수 있는 시각장애인용 점자보도블럭상에서의 압력센서태그형 무선 시그널 송출모듈을 통한 엘리베이터 호출 자동형성장치 및 방법을 제공하는데 그 목적이 있다.
assignees: ZION ELECTRONICS CO LTD;LEE YONG MIN

title_en: Hierarchical distributed scheduling method and system for multi-microgrid power distribution system under carbon flow tracing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hierarchical distributed scheduling method and system of a multi-microgrid power distribution system under carbon flow tracing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing operation constraint of the multi-micro-grid power distribution system according to the selected system parameters and scheduling parameters of the multi-micro-grid power distribution system; based on a carbon emission flow theory, reasonably and averagely spreading carbon responsibility of a power distribution network source side to a load side, guiding a power distribution network-micro network interaction low-carbon energy consumption behavior, and constructing a power distribution network system carbon transaction constraint and a multi-micro network system carbon transaction constraint under carbon flow tracing; establishing a multi-microgrid power distribution system layered distributed scheduling model under carbon flow tracing by utilizing a target cascading theory; and decoupling the interaction power by a target cascading method and carrying out iterative solution. The invention is based on a layered distributed optimization idea of a target cascade analysis method and a multi-microgrid power distribution system collaborative complementary operation strategy, and adopts a correlation solver to solve a mixed integer linear programming model in an optimization stage to obtain a system operation scheme in a scheduling period.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING

title_en: Power supply area dividing method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power supply area dividing method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: determining a power supply area to be divided and an infection probability matrix of nodes of the power supply area; updating the states of nodes in the power supply area according to the infection probability matrix and the virus transmission model, and dividing the nodes with the same virus information into corresponding power supply areas; acquiring at least one node and node power, dividing the node into power supply areas, and determining at least one benefit value of the power supply areas divided by the node; and determining nodes in at least one power supply area according to the maximum profit value. According to the technical scheme, the power supply area is divided through the virus propagation model and the constructed infection probability matrix, the power supply area divided by the nodes is determined based on the maximum benefit value calculated by the cooperative game theory, dynamic division of the power supply area is realized, and the robustness, rationality and scientificity of the division of the power supply area of the power grid are improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;HUIZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Cluster division-based power distribution network hybrid energy storage site selection method and terminal
