abstract_en: The invention discloses a hybrid energy storage location method and a terminal of a power distribution network based on cluster division, which take the cluster of the power distribution network as a unit, calculate the key index of a node by adopting a power flow tracking algorithm, determine the topological characteristic coefficient of the node, determine the power flow direction coefficient of the node according to the branches of the node and the access point of distributed renewable energy power generation, determine the power flow propagation index of the node according to the key index, the topological characteristic coefficient and the power flow direction coefficient of the node, calculate the comprehensive electrical distance between the nodes based on a jacobian matrix, and determine the access position of hybrid energy storage based on the comprehensive electrical distance between the power flow propagation index of the node and the node, thereby determining the access position of hybrid energy storage from the two aspects of sensitivity and electrical connection tightness of the node to the distributed renewable energy power generation fluctuation, and being more reliable and accurate, thereby realizing the hybrid energy storage location more simply and effectively.
assignees: ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Hydropower and thermal power electric quantity distribution method and system considering high-proportion wind-solar access
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water power and thermal power electric quantity distribution method considering high-proportion wind-light access, which comprises the following steps: acquiring historical data and self requirements of energy, matching corresponding influence factors according to the historical data and the self requirements of the energy, and analyzing multi-energy coordination scheduling requirements of an electric power system under the condition that new energy is accessed to obtain the power grid energy output characteristic; according to the power grid energy output characteristics, selecting full new energy consumption as a boundary condition, taking the minimum average thermal power load distance as an objective function, and establishing a hydroelectric and thermal power optimal scheduling model by combining constraint conditions; and solving the hydroelectric and thermal power optimal scheduling model by utilizing an improved successive load shedding algorithm to obtain a time-period-by-time optimal scheduling result, smoothing a thermal power generation process line, optimizing thermal power operation working conditions, improving the generating capacity of cascade hydroelectric power, providing technical support for power system power generation planning, power generation strategy optimization and the like.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Cascade power plant joint scheduling system and method for water surface photovoltaic power generation
abstract_en: The application provides a step power plant joint scheduling system for water surface photovoltaic power generation, which comprises a centralized control unit, a power plant unit, a reservoir unit, a water surface photovoltaic unit and a power grid; the centralized control unit is used for controlling the power plant unit and the water surface photovoltaic unit to generate power, and the power plant unit and the water surface photovoltaic unit are uniformly connected to a power grid after generating power; the power plant unit comprises an upstream power plant component, a midstream power plant component and a downstream power plant component, the reservoir unit comprises an upstream reservoir component, a midstream reservoir component and a downstream reservoir component, and the water surface photovoltaic unit comprises an upstream water surface photovoltaic component, a midstream water surface photovoltaic component and a downstream water surface photovoltaic component. The application can efficiently utilize the water surface of the reservoirs of the step power plant, the photovoltaic power generation is preferentially carried out, the step power plant carries out supplementary regulation, the utilization rate of the reservoirs of the step power plant is effectively improved, the centralized control center carries out unified dispatching operation management, the power generation benefits of the step power plant and the photovoltaic power plant on the water surface are fully exerted, and the regulation capability of the step hydropower plant is fully utilized.
assignees: HUBEI QINGJIANG HYDROELECTRIC DEV CO LTD

title_en: Load-intensive area-oriented carbon flow distribution calculation and carbon flow optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for calculating and optimizing carbon flow for a load-intensive area carbon flow distribution, which comprises the following steps: step 1, constructing a multi-energy coupling model by analyzing an electric power system, a natural gas system and a heat supply network system in a multi-energy flow network and utilizing a coupling matrix; step 2, constructing a multi-energy flow network optimization model by calculating the loss of the system as an energy resistance coefficient; step 3, utilizing a carbon flow bidirectional tracking method based on forward carbon flow tracking and reverse carbon flow tracking to quickly solve carbon emission of each link and each node in the system; and 4, constructing an ultra-short-term carbon flow prediction model based on a genetic algorithm back propagation neural network. The invention can realize the real-time calculation of the carbon emission of various energy sources in the load energy center and the accurate tracking of the carbon flow distribution condition.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Step reservoir optimal scheduling system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of collaborative optimization scheduling of water and thermal power stations in a short-term power grid, and discloses a cascade reservoir optimization scheduling system, which comprises the following steps: the data acquisition and monitoring are used for establishing a hydrological observation network; the hydrologic forecasting and simulating device is used for forecasting and simulating rainfall, snow melting and inflow conditions in a certain period in the future; the multi-objective optimization scheduling algorithm is used for designing and applying the multi-objective optimization scheduling algorithm suitable for the cascade reservoir; the multi-source data fusion is used for fusing the hydrological observation data with satellite remote sensing data and unmanned plane data multi-source data; the decision support system is used for integrating hydrologic forecasting and simulation results and output information of an optimized dispatching algorithm into one decision support system, optimizing reservoir dispatching, improving forecasting precision and accuracy, and enabling the dispatching system to be better suitable for changing environmental conditions and demands.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD;UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Fault analysis simulation method and device for energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault analysis simulation method and device for an energy system, which are used for obtaining an admittance matrix of the power grid system by acquiring data information generated by an electricity-gas integrated energy system in operation and performing steady-state modeling based on standard information of the power grid system and obtaining a time sequence two-port transmission matrix of the natural gas system by performing dynamic modeling based on the standard information of the natural gas system; the method comprises the steps of determining initial fault information of the comprehensive energy system, determining a fault propagation strategy according to the initial fault information, carrying out power flow scheduling simulation on the power grid system and the natural gas system when faults occur according to the fault propagation strategy and the admittance matrix, and obtaining load shedding conditions of all nodes in the power grid system and the natural gas system when the power flow scheduling simulation is carried out, so that personnel can evaluate the comprehensive energy system according to the load shedding conditions.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Electric power knowledge graph construction method based on text enhancement and double-channel triplet extraction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing an electric power knowledge graph based on text enhancement and double-channel triplet extraction, which comprises the following steps: 1. preprocessing data; 2. text represents an enhanced pre-training model; 3. the model is extracted based on the triplets of the two channels. The pre-training model of the method adopts a BERT model, and words in BERT input are embedded into spliced external knowledge. Then, the entity relation extraction model mainly extracts entity sets in the entity decoding stage, then fuses decoding results of the better in the relation set prediction network stage, and extracts relation triples in the data. Through joint decoding, the entity type can provide important information for relation extraction so as to obtain accurate prediction of the entity and the relation, avoid error propagation, solve the problems of redundancy, poor generalization and the like. Compared with the current latest mainstream method, the method has higher accuracy and F1 value and has excellent overall performance.
assignees: INFORMATION COMMUNICATION COMPANY OF STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Product configuration changing method based on parameter network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a product configuration changing method based on a parameter network, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: constructing a product parameter information association constraint network model; constructing a change influence propagation mode of a product parameter information association constraint network model; determining a method for calculating the cost of a parameter change scheme, wherein the cost is based on the comprehensive cost of network nodes and is used for evaluating the cost and efficiency of the change scheme; generating a hierarchical tree model of the parameter network; the method is characterized in that a lowest cost driven change scheme decision method is adopted, each potential change scheme is determined according to a hierarchical tree model of the generated parameter network, and a scheme with the lowest cost is selected as a final product change scheme by comparing the costs of different potential change schemes.
assignees: TIANJIN RENAI COLLEGE

title_en: Hybrid type pumping and accumulating day-ahead peak regulation scheduling method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of new energy power generation optimized scheduling, in particular to a hybrid pumping and accumulating day-ahead peak shaving scheduling method, device and equipment and a storage medium, which comprise the following steps: constructing a wind-light-step hybrid pumping and accumulating day-ahead peak regulation scheduling model by taking the minimum residual load peak-valley difference of the receiving end power grid as an objective function; establishing constraint conditions of a scheduling model, wherein the constraint conditions comprise: the conventional cascade hydropower station is additionally provided with hydraulic characteristic constraint, electric characteristic constraint and hydroelectric coupling characteristic constraint after pumping and storage; linearizing the objective function and the constraint condition; and solving the linearized scheduling model to obtain an optimized scheduling result. According to the invention, a day-ahead peak regulation scheduling model is established, and finally, an optimal scheduling result is obtained by solving the model, so that a power generation scheme of the wind-light-step hybrid pumping and accumulating system meeting constraints can be provided, wind power and photovoltaic digestion is promoted, and compared with a water-wind-light complementary power generation system, the effects of better peak clipping and valley filling are realized.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Power grid side combined energy storage robust planning operation method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of multi-energy complementary power generation, in particular to a power grid side combined energy storage robust planning operation method, device, equipment and medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of considering various costs of combined energy storage including step pumping and storage and electrochemical energy storage, and establishing a capacity configuration model of the combined energy storage; the method comprises the steps of taking the lowest running cost of a system as a target, taking the running constraint of cascade extraction and storage and electrochemical energy storage and the line trend constraint into consideration, establishing a running optimization model of the system, establishing a combined energy storage distribution robust planning-running double-layer model comprising the steps of establishing uncertainty of wind power and photovoltaic output probability distribution and converting the linearization model, and solving the double-layer model by adopting a column constraint generation algorithm to obtain a combined energy storage planning running method. According to the invention, the capacity of the combined energy storage under the coordination of the source network and the charge storage can be determined, the system operation can be optimized, the waste electric quantity is reduced, the peak regulation pressure of the thermal power is relieved, the frequent start and stop of the thermal power and hydroelectric generating set are reduced, and the result is robust.

title_en: Training method and device for space-time perception building equipment operation risk identification model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of risk identification, in particular to a training method and a training device for a space-time perceived building equipment operation risk identification model, comprising the steps of carrying out different behavioral pattern cluster analysis on extracted building equipment state space-time perceived characteristics, and calculating the similarity between a low-frequency behavioral cluster and a high-frequency behavioral cluster to obtain a risk cluster similarity matrix so as to determine a risk space-time comprehensive weight; and constructing a device risk propagation network by traversing nodes in the space-time perception graph neural network, and training a risk identification model according to the space-time perception characteristics of the building device state and the device risk propagation network to obtain a building device operation risk identification model. According to the invention, the time-space sensing characteristics of the state of the building equipment and cluster information obtained by cluster analysis are fused, so that the risk identification model not only can learn the time-space dynamic characteristics of the operation of the equipment more comprehensively, but also can analyze the performance of the characteristics under different behavioral modes, and the identification accuracy of the operation risk of the building equipment is improved.

title_en: Field road and field cascade simulation method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of antennas, and relates to a field path and field cascade simulation method. The method comprises field simulation, path simulation, cascade simulation and iteration; setting the electrical performance parameters of the antenna according to the performance parameters and the structural parameters of the antenna through field simulation; outputting SnP parameters of the matching circuit through path simulation; constructing a cascade simulation model comprising a plurality of ports through cascade simulation; importing SnP parameters into a cascading simulation model; connecting an antenna element port with an antenna through a matching circuit; adding an excitation signal to an input port of the output matching circuit; and (5) simulating and solving the electrical performance parameters of the antenna. The invention combines electromagnetic field antenna simulation and circuit simulation, completes the evaluation of the overall matching performance and radiation performance of the antenna after the matching network is introduced, realizes the predictability of design, and can obtain the optimal antenna after the comprehensive vibrator and the matching circuit through multiple iterations.
assignees: CHENGDU ZHONGYA TONGMAO TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for monitoring voltage state of regional network point device
abstract_en: A voltage state monitoring method and equipment of regional network point equipment relate to the field of equipment monitoring, and the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of receiving voltage fault event information of regional network points, calculating a fault degree index according to fault voltage data, determining a fault propagation path by using a power grid simulation model if the fault degree is greater than a threshold value, acquiring equipment information of regional network point equipment on the path, calculating an influence index of the voltage fault on the regional network point equipment, generating corresponding fault response measures if the influence index exceeds the threshold value, sending a measure instruction to the regional network point equipment for execution, and simulating the fault propagation path of the voltage fault event, so that the monitoring range is enlarged, the voltage fault diffusion can be effectively prevented, the safe operation of key equipment is protected, the voltage fault is timely and effectively processed, and the reliability and the stability of the power grid operation are improved.
assignees: JIANGSU LINGJIN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Adaptive power distribution network power flow analysis method and device based on enhanced ELM model
abstract_en: The method builds an enhanced ELM model on the basis of an extreme learning machine, and builds a new hidden layer for the enhanced ELM model at each stage so as to expand the neural network structure of the extreme learning machine; the method comprises the steps that through modification of a loss function of a power distribution network power flow model, in a counter-propagation stage of neural network structure training of a multi-layer extreme learning machine, step length and gradient update in a neural network parameter optimization process of the multi-layer extreme learning machine are guided by the power distribution network power flow model, and network parameters of an adaptive power distribution system are obtained; and (3) under an evolution scene, self-adapting the neural network parameters of the multi-layer extreme learning machine by using an incremental learning mode, and characterizing the random variable distribution change of the power distribution system by using the self-adapting neural network parameters of the multi-layer extreme learning machine. The invention can improve the nonlinear fitting capability of the original neural network, effectively update network parameters and improve the self-adaptability of model parameters.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: Method for evaluating fluctuation defending capacity of cascade hydropower station on new energy source end of power grid
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of multi-energy power system dispatching, and relates to a method for evaluating fluctuation defending capacity of a cascade hydropower station on a new energy source end of a power grid. The technical proposal is as follows: firstly, constructing a reference model with the maximum final energy storage of the cascade hydroelectric dispatching as an objective function, taking the final energy storage of the cascade hydroelectric dispatching solved by the model as a final energy storage control reference value, and then constructing an disturbance optimizing evaluation model with the maximum requirement for regulating the extreme electric quantity for optimizing the defending capability of the target cascade hydroelectric station to the fluctuation of the new energy source end. The framework can be used for analyzing and quantifying the defending capability of the step hydropower on the fluctuation of the new energy source end, and the result can provide guidance for power and electric quantity balance scheduling and planning in extreme weather. The invention makes quantitative evaluation on the defending capability of the cascade hydropower station to the fluctuation of the new energy source end for the first time.

title_en: Power system cascading failure emergency blocking control method and device based on risk assessment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of safe operation and control of power systems, and provides a power system cascading failure emergency blocking control method and device based on risk assessment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: designing each action strategy, objective function and constraint condition of emergency blocking control; setting a cascading failure simulation round, simulating cascading failures, and counting average load loss and average unit loss; based on each action strategy of the optimal emergency blocking control of the Monte Carlo tree searching method, model training is carried out based on an improved depth deterministic strategy gradient algorithm, and a cascading failure emergency blocking control model is established; predicting and obtaining the load shedding action quantity of the emergency power shedding machine in various states to form an emergency blocking control scheme of the power grid to be predicted; the invention gives consideration to the safe operation and economy of the system, effectively blocks the cascade fault process and ensures the safe stability of the operation of the new energy grid-connected system.
assignees: UNIV WUHAN;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power distribution network marginal carbon emission calculation method for low-carbon operation of power distribution network and application
abstract_en: A power distribution network marginal carbon emission calculation method and application facing power distribution network low-carbon operation comprise the following steps: s1, establishing a power distribution network scheduling model based on a second order cone plan SOCP; s2, analyzing emission propagation and responsibility from power supply to load demands and distribution of active power and reactive power through a distribution network scheduling model based on second order cone planning SOCP; s3, calculating marginal carbon emission of each node in the power distribution network, namely power distribution node marginal emission DLME, based on emission transmission and responsibility distribution results between the power supply and the load demands obtained in the step S2, calculating and considering the distribution of active and reactive power and the sensitivity of each node to the total emission change of the system, wherein the obtained DLME is used as a specific basis for implementing emission reduction excitation measures. Compared with the traditional method, the method has higher carbon reduction effectiveness and higher DLME carbon reduction response capacity based on the demand response model evaluation.
assignees: TSINGHUA SHENZHEN INT GRADUATE SCHOOL

title_en: Method and system for identifying key vehicle nodes of local traffic network for intelligent network-connected vehicle decision planning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for identifying key vehicle nodes of a local traffic network for intelligent network vehicle decision planning, which combines dynamic vehicle network characteristics and complex network theory, considers the direct and indirect propagation of risks and network dynamic characteristics, and provides a method for identifying key vehicle nodes in the local traffic network based on epidemic propagation mechanism. The method has the advantages that the path diversity from the risk of abnormality of the vehicle nodes to the neighbor nodes is directly considered in the propagation, and the potential propagation risk of the vehicle nodes is considered in the indirect propagation on a larger scale, so that the key nodes in the dynamic vehicle network can be more accurately excavated. Helping intelligent automobiles form a more rapid and effective driving strategy.
assignees: UNIV JIANGSU

title_en: Household air conditioner load prediction method based on building load prediction and matching
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of air conditioner load prediction, and discloses a household air conditioner load prediction method based on building load prediction and matching, wherein the method uses TRNSYS to establish a building load calculation model, and combines meteorological parameters and the building model to calculate building load; building an air conditioner load matching function for matching the building load with the household air conditioner load by combining the household air conditioner load; and taking the meteorological parameters as input and the building load as output, establishing a building load back propagation neural network prediction model, and matching the building load calculated by the back propagation neural network load prediction model with the household air conditioner load through an air conditioner load matching function to realize the load prediction of the household air conditioner. The method is suitable for household electricity behavior analysis, is used as the basis of household electricity intelligent management strategies, and has good application prospects.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Power grid dynamic modeling method and system for fusion of power grid equipment and service resources
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid dynamic modeling method and a system for fusion of power grid equipment and service resources, belongs to the technical field of power, and solves the problem that the existing method cannot predict and evaluate the running state of a monitoring node, so that effective identification cannot be performed when the monitoring node has potential risks, and the method comprises the following steps: obtaining modeling parameters associated with a target power grid, and carrying out normalization pretreatment on the modeling parameters to obtain standard modeling parameters and obtain a visual three-dimensional model containing dynamic nodes; the risk identification model performs evolution propagation based on a fault evolution rule, identifies potential fault dynamic nodes in the visual three-dimensional model, and in the invention, the risk identification model can perform evolution propagation based on the fault evolution rule, therefore, dynamic nodes with potential faults in the visual three-dimensional model are identified, the efficiency of data processing and analysis is improved, and the power grid equipment and service resources can be fused in practical application, so that more accurate prediction and early warning are provided.
assignees: MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for analyzing failure disaster chain of gas pipeline
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for analyzing a failure disaster chain of a gas pipeline, which relate to the technical field of gas pipeline analysis and comprise the following steps: when the natural gas transmission pipeline fails, taking all disaster events of the current natural gas transmission pipeline as nodes in a network, taking induction factors among the disaster events as directed continuous edges in the network, and constructing a disaster chain network according to the nodes and the directed continuous edges; calculating topological structure parameters comprising an input degree, an output degree, a total degree value and a clustering coefficient in a disaster chain network, and determining an evolution mechanism of failure disaster chain risk propagation of the current natural gas transmission pipeline based on the topological structure parameters; calculating the risk degree of a failure disaster chain of the current natural gas transmission pipeline based on the disaster rate, the loss degree and the directed continuous edge weakness degree of the disaster chain network; analyzing the current natural gas pipeline according to an evolution mechanism of the risk propagation of the failure disaster chain of the current natural gas pipeline and the risk degree of the failure disaster chain of the current natural gas pipeline.
assignees: UNIV CHINA PETROLEUM BEIJING

title_en: Circumferential weld performance prediction method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a circumferential weld performance prediction method which can solve the technical problem of insufficient circumferential weld management of a natural gas long-distance pipeline. The circumferential weld performance prediction method comprises the following steps: normalizing the girth weld original data set to obtain an initial data set; obtaining an initial training set according to the initial data set; training the weld joint value transmission model according to the initial training set to obtain a weld joint fusion ratio to be tested; establishing a weld cooling speed model according to the initial data set and the weld cooling speed; obtaining the initial cooling speed of the weld joint to be measured according to the weld joint cooling speed model; and training to obtain a first weld toughness prediction model to be tested based on the counter propagation artificial neural network model according to the fusion ratio of the weld to be tested and the initial cooling speed of the weld to be tested. Through the girth weld performance prediction technology, a basis is provided for newly-built pipeline girth weld performance optimization, the girth weld failure probability is reduced, and a technical support is provided for in-service pipeline girth weld integrity management.
assignees: NAT PETROLEUM PIPELINE NETWORK GROUP CO LTD;WEST EAST TRANSP BRANCH OF NATIONAL PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS PIPELINE GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Multi-dimensional state monitoring method for sewage treatment equipment based on cascade long-term and short-term memory neural network
abstract_en: A sewage treatment blower state monitoring method based on a multidimensional cascade neural network belongs to the field of urban sewage treatment and equipment management. Aiming at the problem that the multidimensional state of the blower for urban sewage treatment cannot be monitored efficiently at present, the invention designs a model for monitoring the state of the blower for sewage treatment based on a multidimensional cascade neural network, thereby realizing the efficient monitoring of the multidimensional state of the blower in an urban sewage treatment plant; the result shows that the prediction model can rapidly and accurately monitor the multidimensional state of the blower, has higher state prediction precision, and ensures the safe and stable operation of equipment of a sewage treatment plant.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Civil aircraft cockpit man-machine system risk analysis method based on node elasticity evaluation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a civil aircraft cockpit man-machine system risk analysis method based on node elasticity evaluation, which comprises the following steps: analyzing the operation task of the flight unit in a typical flight phase; analyzing and decomposing the functions of the man-machine system of the cockpit based on a functional resonance analysis method, and screening out main functional units of the man-machine system; analyzing the output characteristics of the functions, taking the internal and external influence factors of the functions into consideration to obtain functional failure links, and constructing a human-computer system risk propagation network model; calculating propagation indexes of all nodes in a risk propagation network of the human-computer system; based on a node elasticity evaluation method, calculating a node elasticity value by a random simulation method, and analyzing key nodes of a man-machine system. The invention can analyze risk events and the damage degree of risks to the system in the complex man-machine system, and has important significance and value for improving the safety, the risk resistance and the recovery capability of the future intelligent aircraft cockpit man-machine system.
assignees: UNIV NANJING AERONAUTICS & ASTRONAUTICS

title_en: Power grid cascading failure risk assessment method and system based on snow ablation algorithm
abstract_en: The power grid cascading failure risk assessment method based on the snow ablation algorithm comprises the following steps: and respectively calculating subjective weight and objective weight of each risk index, wherein the risk index comprises: a unit power angle difference severity index, a weighted power flow entropy index and a load loss severity index; based on subjective weight and objective weight of each risk index, calculating comprehensive weight of each index by adopting a snow ablation algorithm; calculating the risk value of each line in the power grid according to the comprehensive weight of each risk index; and evaluating the risk of the grid cascading failure according to the risk value of each line. The design reduces index redundancy while guaranteeing the accuracy of the evaluation result.
assignees: CENTRAL CHINA BRANCH STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV WUHAN

title_en: Power distribution network fault self-healing method and system considering photovoltaic output
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution network fault self-healing method and system considering photovoltaic output, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical operation data of a photovoltaic power station and observation data of illumination intensity of a meteorological station; based on historical operation data of the photovoltaic power station and illumination intensity observation data of the meteorological station, predicting the power generation of the photovoltaic power station by using a convolution long-short-term memory recurrent neural network model considering sparrow search; according to the power generation power of the photovoltaic power station, the sectional switch state of the power distribution network and the network topology of the power distribution network, constructing an objective function and constraint conditions of a power distribution network fault self-healing model, and obtaining the power distribution network fault self-healing model; solving a power distribution network fault self-healing model by using a propagation search algorithm to obtain an optimal recovery strategy; executing the optimal recovery strategy through a sectionalizing switch and a node load; the invention can realize the self-healing of the power distribution network faults on the premise of ensuring the minimum cost of the distributed power supply, the minimum network loss and the minimum node voltage deviation.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Hybrid game coordination optimization method for active power distribution network containing multiple micro-grids by considering dynamic power coefficient of grid passing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hybrid game coordination optimization method of an active power distribution network containing multiple micro-grids, which considers dynamic power coefficients of an over-grid, and comprises the following steps: 1, establishing a power distribution network framework structure containing point-to-point power interaction of a plurality of micro-grids aiming at a power interaction system consisting of a power distribution network and the micro-grids; 2, the leader establishes a main distribution network optimization model with minimum total operation energy consumption; 3, the follower establishes a slave multi-micro-grid point-to-point electric energy interaction model with the minimum running energy consumption as a target; and 4, establishing a hybrid game coordination optimization model of the active power distribution network with the multiple micro-grids based on the dynamic power coefficient of the passing network based on the Stackelberg game theory, and solving by combining a dichotomy method with a target cascade analysis method based on diagonal quadratic approximation to obtain a hybrid game coordination optimization scheme of the active power distribution network with the multiple micro-grids. The invention can dynamically update the networking power coefficient so that the networking power coefficient can effectively cover the energy loss generated by network resources.
assignees: UNIV HEFEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Data processing method and device considering cascading failure transient response of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data processing method and a data processing device considering the cascading failure transient response of a power system, which are used for acquiring the operation data and the operation mode of the power system to be tested and constructing a first mixed differential algebraic equation of the power system to be tested; acquiring fault data, and simulating a first mixed differential algebraic equation based on the fault data to obtain grid structure parameters corresponding to the first mixed differential algebraic equation; judging whether the parameters of the grid structure change or not; if yes, recalculating a network structure matrix of the current power system to be tested, constructing a second mixed differential algebraic equation based on the network structure matrix, simulating the second mixed differential algebraic equation based on fault data to obtain network structure parameters corresponding to the second mixed differential algebraic equation, and judging whether the network structure parameters change or not again; if not, recording simulation data generated by a corresponding mixed differential algebraic equation without changing the grid structure parameters, so that a user performs operation and maintenance deployment on the power system to be tested.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Vulnerability assessment of power information physical system based on improved structural entropy
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, in particular to vulnerability assessment of a power information physical system based on improved structural entropy, which comprises the following steps: s1, constructing a power network and information network coupling network model; s2, monitoring and optimizing scheduling of power grid tide conditions; s3, analyzing vulnerability of the electric power information physical system by using improved structure entropy judgment; s4, establishing a cascading failure model to analyze vulnerability of the power information physical system. According to the invention, the coupling relation between the power network and the information network in the power information physical system is modeled, and the dynamic process of cascading faults can be reflected by combining the system power flow characteristics in the cascading fault model, so that the actual situation can be better simulated; the method can overcome the limitation of the entropy index of the single-layer network structure, can identify the influence of important nodes on the vulnerability of the system, and lays a foundation for the reasonable distribution of subsequent defense resources.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Electric power material emergency supply prediction method based on dynamic network link
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of computers, and particularly relates to a power material emergency supply prediction method based on dynamic network link. The method is based on encoding discrete historical data of a supply chain network, based on time sequence state characteristics and graph structure characteristics of dynamic network links, the time sequence states of nodes are updated through a plurality of historical interaction increments, and tasks of dynamic link prediction are completed by combining graph structure information generation node representation, so that all processes from alignment cascade processing of the features, feature fusion and dynamic node embedding generation to dynamic network link prediction are realized, and supply and demand relation changes of electric power materials under the condition that emergency possibly occurs in the future can be predicted.
assignees: MAT COMPANY OF STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for building DC micro-grid simulation model
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for constructing a DC micro-grid simulation model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a network topology structure of a direct-current micro-grid corresponding to a power station; determining first modularized distribution information of the direct current micro-grid according to the network topology structure; determining a first switch distribution characteristic of the direct current micro-grid according to the first module distribution information; determining second modularized distribution information of the direct-current micro-grid according to the first switch distribution characteristics; and constructing a model based on the second modularized distribution information to obtain a DC micro-grid simulation model corresponding to the power station. According to the technical scheme, modularization of the direct-current micro-grid simulation model, parameter adjustment and high simulation model precision are achieved, various micro-grid topologies can be directly built according to requirements, and the technical effects of repeated elimination and propagation of simulation building, rapid selection and building are achieved.
assignees: STATE POWER INVESTMENT CORPORATION SCIENCE & TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Main-auxiliary cooperative multi-level autonomous control method considering multi-type resources
abstract_en: The invention discloses a main-distribution cooperation multi-level autonomous control method considering multi-type resources, which comprises the following steps: (1) Analyzing and modeling the operation characteristics of multiple types of resources of the power distribution network; (2) Taking the internal autonomous characteristics of the hierarchy into consideration, and constructing a platform autonomous model; (3) Dynamically dividing a feeder line layer region based on a modularity function; (4) constructing a main-coordination cooperative multi-level autonomous control model; (5) And solving the main-coordination cooperative multi-level autonomous control model by adopting a target cascading method. According to the method, the operation characteristics of multiple types of resources of the power distribution network are fully considered, the internal autonomy and inter-regional coordination of multiple layers and multiple regions are considered, a main-cooperation multi-layer autonomy control model is built, a target cascading method is adopted for solving, a research object is decomposed into independent decision units, the independent decision units are independently decided and solved in a distributed mode, the optimization solving efficiency is remarkably improved, and the convergence performance is better.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ZHENJIANG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST

title_en: Method for evaluating robustness of airway network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a route network robustness assessment method, which belongs to the technical field of route network robustness assessment and comprises the steps of determining route network nodes according to a target route network and route segment flow, determining a proper cascade failure model according to target route network characteristics, carrying out network attack on the route network nodes based on the cascade failure model, and calculating robustness indexes of the route network according to network attack results. According to the method, key nodes in the air path network are identified according to the air space air path network structure and the air segment flow pertinence, and the appropriate cascade failure model is combined, so that the robustness index of the target air path is calculated according to the network attack result through the common nodes and the key nodes of the network attack air path network, the robustness of the air path network after the network attack is evaluated, the robustness evaluation result is real, the actual situation of the air space in China is fitted, and the planning of the air path is facilitated.

title_en: Transmission and distribution collaborative hierarchical distributed risk scheduling method for high-proportion distributed energy access
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transmission and distribution collaborative hierarchical distributed risk scheduling method for high-proportion distributed energy access, and relates to the technical field of power system scheduling optimization. The method comprises the following steps: providing a transmission and distribution collaborative hierarchical distributed risk scheduling framework, and dividing the whole power system into a transmission grid scheduling layer and a distribution network scheduling layer according to structures and functions; constructing a transmission and distribution collaborative hierarchical distributed risk scheduling model, wherein the transmission and distribution collaborative hierarchical distributed risk scheduling model comprises a transmission grid scheduling model and a distribution network scheduling model; the power generation equipment of the power transmission network dispatching layer is independently and optimally dispatched through the power transmission network dispatching model, the power generation equipment of the power distribution network dispatching layer is independently and optimally dispatched through the power distribution network dispatching model, boundary power information is exchanged, the power transmission and distribution collaborative hierarchical distributed risk dispatching model is subjected to power transmission and distribution dispatching iteration solution through a target cascading method, when convergence conditions are met, an optimal solution is obtained as a final risk dispatching strategy, centralized coordination and scattered autonomy are achieved, and the economy of the whole operation of the power grid is improved.
assignees: UNIV NORTHEAST ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Regional power grid capacity expansion planning method, device and equipment considering hydropower station cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional power grid capacity expansion planning method, device and equipment considering hydropower station cooperation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring unit data of a target regional power grid, wherein the unit data comprises cost data and parameter data; based on the cost data and a preset cost rule, constructing a capacity expansion planning model of the target regional power grid; according to the parameter data and the cascade hydropower station attributes, constraining the capacity expansion planning model to obtain constraint conditions of the capacity expansion planning model; and calculating a capacity expansion planning model based on constraint conditions, and characterizing the obtained calculation result as an optimal configuration strategy of the target regional power grid. The invention can realize the determination of the optimal configuration combination of conventional power generation, energy storage and intermittent renewable energy under the condition of meeting the preset variable new energy permeation target, and effectively reduce the total cost of the water-wind-solar-energy-storage combined power generation system; by considering the time correlation of the natural inflow and the forced outflow of the hydropower station, a high-fidelity rule curve is constructed for the hydropower station.
assignees: LISHUI POWER SUPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Visualized monitoring device for hanging hole of electric hoist of ring chain of wind turbine generator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a visual monitoring device for a hanging hole of a ring chain electric hoist of a wind turbine, which comprises a mounting frame and a monitoring camera, wherein a mounting mechanism for mounting the monitoring camera is arranged in the mounting frame; the mounting mechanism comprises four fixing rods which are symmetrically and fixedly connected to the bottom of the mounting frame, two sliding plates are connected to the side walls of the fixing rods which are close to each other in a sliding mode, and arc-shaped plates are fixedly connected to the side walls of the inner walls of the mounting frame, which are far away from the sliding plates. According to the utility model, the monitoring camera is directly opposite to the suspended object for monitoring, and is connected to the display screen of the operating position of the small yaw platform crane in a network cable or wireless cascading manner, so that when an maintainer operates the small crane, the ascending and descending condition of the suspended object can be observed in real time through the display screen, the collision phenomenon with the platform cover plate and the fence is avoided, and the occurrence of casualties and damage accidents of personnel and equipment under the tower possibly caused by the scattering of the suspended object is avoided.
assignees: GUANGXI CGN CONTRACT ENERGY MAN CO LTD

title_en: Three-dimensional earthquake fault identification model based on cross-channel interaction strategy and training method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional earthquake fault identification model based on a cross-channel interaction strategy and a training method, comprising the following steps: the network comprises a VNet network and a cross-channel interaction module arranged in the network; the output of the encoder is combined with the output up-sampling result of the symmetrical decoder through the cascade layer and is used as the input of the decoder of the next stage; the cross-channel interaction module comprises a channel attention module and a space attention module, and is used for acquiring the combined feature images, sequentially carrying out channel attention and space attention calculation, carrying out feature optimization, outputting the optimized feature images, taking the optimized feature images as the final output of the decoder at the current stage, carrying out up-sampling, and inputting the optimized feature images to the decoder at the next stage; according to the invention, the VNet convolutional neural network is used as a basic network, and the cross-channel interaction is used for carrying out feature optimization, so that local attention is paid to the faults of the three-dimensional seismic data in channels and spaces, and the continuity and the accuracy of the low-order fault identification result are improved.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING

title_en: Method, device and medium for analyzing full-chain evolution of blackout event
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and a medium for analyzing full chain evolution of a blackout event. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a complete chain evolution network model of the blackout event; calculating a plurality of preset typical indexes of a full-chain evolution network model of the blackout event; based on a plurality of preset typical indexes, constructing node importance evaluation indexes and connecting edge importance evaluation indexes of a full-chain evolution network model of the blackout event; constructing path propagation efficiency indexes of each path in the full-chain evolution network model of the blackout event according to the node importance evaluation indexes and the link importance evaluation indexes; and respectively determining key nodes, key links and key paths in the full-chain evolution network model of the blackout event according to the node importance evaluation index value, the link importance evaluation index and the path propagation efficiency index, and determining a coping strategy of the blackout event.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Control method, device, equipment and medium for power distribution network and electrochemical energy storage
abstract_en: The invention provides a control method, a device, equipment and a medium for power distribution network and electrochemical energy storage, wherein the control method for the power distribution network and the electrochemical energy storage comprises the following steps: constructing a coupling operation model of the power distribution network and the energy storage system, and determining a propagation path of abnormal electric quantity; the power distribution network and the energy storage system form a coupling system; based on the propagation path of the abnormal electric quantity, determining the fault protection of the energy storage system and the triggering condition of thermal runaway of a lithium battery pack in the energy storage system; determining a safe operation boundary of the energy storage system under the stable condition of the power distribution network according to the triggering condition; and determining a coordination control strategy of the coupling system according to the safe operation boundary of the energy storage system. The invention can realize the coupling coordination control of the power distribution network and the energy storage system, and solves the problem of poor control effect of the power system in the prior art.
assignees: UNIV WUHAN

title_en: Photovoltaic network topology automatic modeling method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic network topology automatic modeling method, a system, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: detecting ground point cloud data, and extracting point cloud data from which interference data are removed; clustering the point cloud data by adopting an improved neighbor propagation algorithm to obtain multi-source data; adopting an improved D-S algorithm to fuse clustered multi-source data; performing interconversion and phase identification; according to the fusion result and the phase identification result, carrying out dynamic evolution of the distributed photovoltaic network topology model to complete model construction; the invention can make topology modeling finer and more accurate and more close to the change condition of the actual network.
assignees: NANJING NARI INFORMATION COMM TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO;STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Day runoff prediction method based on multi-feature fusion and two-dimensional time convolution network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a daily runoff prediction method based on multi-feature fusion and a two-dimensional time convolution network, which comprises the following steps of carrying out feature mining and feature fusion on hydrologic and meteorological multi-source data of a target river basin, and constructing a multi-source fusion feature matrix as input of a space-time feature extraction stage; and constructing an overall network framework model, determining training parameters of a network, and training and predicting. The method has the advantages that the method adopts a double-layer routing attention mechanism to perform feature fusion on internal mode features and screening features, focuses key information in multi-source features, introduces residual connection to enhance information flow and gradient propagation, relieves gradient disappearance problem in deep networks, extracts key detail features and simultaneously retains original feature information, and regards the fused multi-source feature sequence as two-dimensional features to perform expansion convolution instead of a one-dimensional sequence of a plurality of channels so as to enhance the capability of capturing fine granularity information of the network.

title_en: Multi-source distributed power grid space-time information management method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multisource distributed power grid space-time information management method, which relates to the technical field of intelligent operation and maintenance of power systems and comprises the steps of converting power grid basic data into a power grid topological graph data structure; designing a general graph calculation function library as a basic calculation unit for constructing a power special graph calculation engine; collecting all-link multi-source heterogeneous power data, preprocessing, fusing and mapping the all-link multi-source heterogeneous power data into a unified power knowledge graph, and establishing indexes for space-time dimension data; based on a general graph calculation function library, performing graph analysis operation on graph data constructed in the power knowledge graph so as to support multidimensional graph data analysis; in the power knowledge graph, a graph calculation function library correlation algorithm is utilized, and the propagation path and causal link of the power grid fault event are tracked by combining the established space-time data index. The invention builds a unified power knowledge graph, fuses multi-source heterogeneous power data, and provides a knowledge, structuring and intelligent data base for power grid analysis decision-making.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Fire extinguishing bomb throwing strategy simulation method and system based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire extinguishing bomb throwing strategy simulation method and system based on a neural network, comprising the following steps: s1: collecting historical fire scene parameters and fire extinguishing bomb throwing strategy parameters as an original data set, and carrying out normalization or single-heat coding treatment on each parameter in the data set to obtain a preprocessed data set; s2: oversampling the preprocessed data set by using a data enhancement algorithm to obtain an enhanced data set; s3: training the self-coding network based on the enhanced data set, and obtaining the encoded data set by using the self-coding network after training; s4: constructing a fire extinguishing bomb throwing strategy generating network based on the coded data set and calculating a forward propagation process; s5: and constructing a loss function, training a fire extinguishing bomb throwing strategy generation network, and simulating the fire extinguishing bomb throwing strategy by using the trained fire extinguishing bomb throwing strategy generation network. The invention can provide a comprehensive, efficient and intelligent fire extinguishing bomb throwing strategy simulation solution.
assignees: HUNAN GUANGHUA DEFENSE TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Construction method of industrial brain system for industrial chain
abstract_en: The invention provides a construction method of an industrial brain system for an industrial chain, which comprises the steps of constructing the industrial brain system based on an autonomous cognition thinking atlas functional module, an autonomous interactive decision functional module and a dynamic behavior active regulation functional module, wherein the autonomous cognition thinking atlas functional module is used for autonomously executing sensing, cognition, decision and regulation tasks on various situations of ductile seepage phase transition of an industrial chain supply chain network, the autonomous cognition thinking atlas functional module is used for real-time sensing, measurement, cognition and storage of the ductile seepage phase transition of the industrial chain supply chain network, the autonomous interactive decision functional module is used for ductile situation identification, event accurate positioning and situation comprehensive research and judgment of all elements, and the dynamic behavior regulation module is used for regulating the vulnerability and risk propagation dynamic behavior of the industrial chain supply chain network according to a generated decision scheme. Thus, various situations of the ductile seepage phase transition of the complex giant chain network are accurately identified, measured, predicted in disaster and actively regulated and controlled in behavior.
assignees: INST AUTOMATION CAS

title_en: Power grid dynamic knowledge graph link prediction method for quantum walk and quantum thermodynamics
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for predicting dynamic power grid knowledge graph links of quantum wander and quantum thermodynamics, which relates to the technical field of defect diagnosis and dynamic graph representation learning of main equipment of a power system, and comprises the steps of collecting relevant data of dynamic power grid knowledge graphs, including states, connection relations and time stamps of power grid equipment, constructing a data set, and dividing the data set into a training set and a testing set; constructing a power grid dynamic knowledge graph link prediction model based on quantum migration and quantum thermodynamics, wherein the model comprises a quantum migration perception encoder and a temperature perception mixed expert model decoder; training the model by using training set data, and optimizing model parameters by a back propagation algorithm to obtain a trained model; and evaluating the trained model by using the test set. The method can accurately predict possible faults of the power grid equipment in the future and improve the stability and safety of the power grid.

title_en: Risk propagation analysis method for production line design change
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of production lines, and particularly relates to a risk propagation analysis method for design change of a production line. The method comprises the steps of obtaining production line information, establishing a first production line parameter association network according to the production line information, setting initial load and node capacity of each node in the first production line parameter association network, taking production line change data as input of a second production line parameter association network, calculating change risks of the production line by the second production line parameter association network according to the production line change data to obtain a change propagation result, and analyzing robustness of the second production line parameter association network through normal state rates of the nodes in the second production line parameter association network to obtain an analysis result. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device can effectively analyze the dynamic process of the design change propagation, and learn the influence of the dynamic change propagation on each part of the production line, thereby better optimizing the production line.

title_en: Building construction fire-fighting detection method and system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building construction fire control detection method and system based on the Internet of things, which relate to the technical field of electric digital data processing and specifically comprise the following steps: dividing the areas and grading the sensitivity of the areas of the building construction sites according to the manual marking results; according to the environmental data collected by the wireless sensor network, node cluster grouping and node energy coefficient calculation are carried out, and leader node election is completed through energy coefficient sequencing; video recording is carried out on the fixed monitoring area to obtain video data, and the video data is sent in real time; establishing an environment data set, calculating according to the D-S model to obtain a confidence level probability model, and carrying out probability screening through a confidence interval to obtain a fire judgment result; processing video data by a frame difference method, extracting image characteristics, and obtaining a fire judgment result according to a back propagation neural network and a fixed threshold detection method; and (5) performing on-site acousto-optic alarm, cloud platform alarm reminding and sending notification to a fire department based on the fire judgment result to complete fire detection and early warning.
assignees: WEIHAI AOXUN SOFTWARE CO LTD

title_en: Fire-resistant silicone rubber composition and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fireproof silicone rubber composition and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of silicone rubber. The technical proposal is as follows: the composition comprises the following components in parts by mass: methyl vinyl silicone rubber: 40-60 parts of hydroxyl silicone oil: 5-15 parts of hydrogen-containing silicone oil: 3-8 parts of a refractory filler: 20-40 parts of vulcanizing agent: 1 to 3 parts of coupling agent, 0.1 to 1.5 parts of processing aid and 0.1 to 2.0 parts of processing aid. The silicon rubber composition disclosed by the invention has the beneficial effects that the proper combination and proportion of the refractory filler can obviously improve the refractory flame retardant property of the material, can effectively inhibit flame propagation in a high-temperature environment, prevent the material from burning, and ensure the safe operation of power grid equipment under extreme conditions such as fire disaster and the like.
assignees: WEIHAI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Trade data processing method and system based on blockchain
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of blockchains, in particular to a blockchain-based trade data processing method and a blockchain-based trade data processing system. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring real-time trade data and historical trade data; carrying out standardized processing on the real-time trade data to obtain standard trade data; constructing a trade blockchain network based on standard trade data; carrying out trade product flow direction identification based on a trade blockchain network to obtain circulation link data; generating dynamic demand data based on the circulation link data; performing supply and demand perception modeling on the dynamic demand data to construct a dynamic supply and demand perception model; performing node capacity bottleneck calculation on the trade blockchain network by using a dynamic supply and demand perception model to generate node capacity bottleneck data; generating delivery efficiency data based on the node capacity bottleneck data; risk propagation analysis is performed on the delivery efficiency data to generate risk delivery path data. The method realizes efficient trade data processing.
assignees: SICHUAN RUIHUA HEZONG IND CO LTD

title_en: Power grid vulnerability assessment method and device based on cascading failure model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid vulnerability assessment method and device based on a cascading failure model, which are characterized in that power grid parameters are initialized according to response signals, random disturbance event simulation is implemented on a power grid until the power grid evolves to a stable state based on the cascading failure model, an agent is triggered to read state data of the power grid, then the agent is controlled to decide an attack line number according to the state data, so that a system executes a corresponding attack event and evolves to the stable state, subsequent state data and load loss are output and fed back to the agent, the agent is used for carrying out attack line decision and training sample data storage, and the system is iteratively updated to an output test agent for carrying out vulnerability test assessment. Through random disturbance event simulation and evolution based on a cascading failure model, accuracy and practicality of sequence vulnerability assessment are improved, the outputted key sequence also realizes targeted hierarchical protection of the power grid key sequence, and loss caused by cascading failures to the power grid is reduced.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Urban flood cascade composite disaster event network construction and evaluation method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for constructing and evaluating an urban flood cascade composite disaster event network, which comprise the steps of acquiring a plurality of initial urban flood disaster text data, preprocessing the initial urban flood disaster text data, determining a plurality of target urban flood disaster text data, carrying out causal relation extraction on the target urban flood disaster text data, generating a plurality of dominant event text data and a plurality of display recessive event text data, analyzing the dominant event text data and the display recessive event text data, carrying out event fusion, determining a plurality of target event text data, constructing the target urban flood cascade composite disaster event network according to the target event text data, evaluating the target urban flood cascade composite disaster event network, generating urban flood disaster evaluation data, and solving the technical problems that the conventional urban flood network construction and risk evaluation technology is difficult to comprehensively and effectively evaluate risks brought by urban flood disasters.

title_en: Urban building earthquake damage prediction method and system based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city building earthquake damage prediction method and system based on a neural network; the invention relates to the technical field of building parameters; the reading YOLOv algorithm framework includes forward propagation, loss calculation, and back propagation of the input data x using Darknet53 as the backbone network. Wherein the input data x corresponds to any one of the samples in the data set D, YOLOv uses Darknet53 as a backbone network (backbone) for feature extraction. For a set of building images I of a given area, input x at step S2, predictions are made using a trained YOLOv model M. The invention can more accurately identify and classify the building and accurately predict the earthquake damage degree by adopting an advanced YOLOv algorithm and a powerful Darknet-53 deep convolutional neural network structure. The high-precision prediction capability is beneficial to decision makers to make more accurate decisions and optimize resource allocation, so that the emergency rescue efficiency is improved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU VOCATIONAL AND TECHNICAL UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Regional comprehensive energy system optimal scheduling method
abstract_en: An optimization scheduling method of a regional comprehensive energy system comprises the following steps: constructing an area comprehensive energy system operation communication framework based on cloud management side ends; establishing a double-layer distributed scheduling model of an area comprehensive energy system considering waste heat recovery based on a ladder-type carbon transaction mechanism, establishing an optimized scheduling model aiming at low carbon and economical efficiency by considering the situation that the area comprehensive energy system participates in demand response and electricity purchasing and selling, and establishing an optimized scheduling model considering waste heat recovery by considering the characteristics of subsystem energy coupling equipment waste heat in a lower layer; and introducing consistency constraint and an augmented Lagrange penalty function, and adopting a target cascade analysis algorithm to realize decoupling of the double-layer model, so as to realize efficient solution in a plurality of iterative processes. According to the invention, the user is guided to participate in the power grid interaction by the method for adjusting the flexible resource output, and the economical efficiency and the low carbon performance of the system operation are improved on the premise of protecting multiparty privacy and benefit appeal.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN TECHNOLOGY;UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: Typhoon wind field simulation method and system capable of adaptively enhancing complex terrain influence and site linkage effect
abstract_en: The invention relates to a typhoon wind field simulation method and a typhoon wind field simulation system capable of adaptively enhancing complex terrain influence and site linkage effect, wherein meteorological observation site data, low-resolution typhoon wind field data and high-resolution terrain data are acquired through a data acquisition and standardization preprocessing module, and standardization processing is carried out; A site space position diagram and a characteristic correlation diagram are built based on observation site data, a multi-scale wind-topography characteristic fusion module extracts neighborhood wind fields and topography information, a space linkage network prediction module predicts fusion characteristics and observation values, a typhoon field model training module minimizes L2 loss of prediction noise and real noise through counter propagation optimization parameters, a target lattice point is inserted into a station point diagram in a typhoon field reconstruction module to construct edges and calculate wind components, reconstruction of the typhoon field is achieved, and the problem that complex topography and site linkage effect expression in an existing typhoon field simulation method is insufficient is solved.
assignees: SHANGHAI INSTITUTE OF TYPHOON RES CHINA METEOROLOGICAL ADMINISTRATION SHANGHAI METEOROLOGICAL SCIENC;UNIV SHANGHAI

title_en: Intrinsically safe power distribution network diagnosis analysis and grid planning method
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution network diagnosis analysis and grid planning method based on intrinsic safety, which comprises the steps of firstly obtaining planning information of a target power distribution network; then, establishing a source network load storage collaborative planning model according to planning information; then, applying random faults to the target power distribution network, and evaluating intrinsic safety indexes of the target power distribution network under the faults; the intrinsic safety index is determined by a tide overload coefficient, a cascading failure coefficient and minimum node inertia; and finally, optimizing the source network load storage collaborative planning model according to the intrinsic safety index to obtain an optimal planning scheme of the target power distribution network. And calculating an intrinsic safety index through the combination of the tidal current overload coefficient, the cascading failure coefficient and the minimum node inertia, and further optimizing the planning of the target power distribution network based on the intrinsic safety index on the basis of minimizing the cost, so that the power distribution network can be ensured to effectively prevent and cope with accident risks.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RES INST STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power system information physical collaborative attack optimization modeling method for multiple protection cooperation refusal of transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, in particular to a power system information physical collaborative attack optimization modeling method for multiple protection cooperation refusal of a transformer substation, which comprises the following steps: s1, constructing a transformer substation model and configuration of protection and circuit breakers: describing the configuration modes and the interrelation of relay protection devices and circuit breakers of a transformer substation; s2, cooperating with the attack strategy and the system state change after attack: the network attack and the physical attack are combined to cause refusal of the internal protection device of the power system; s3, constructing an abstract graph model: describing the corresponding relation between the relay protection device and the circuit breaker; s4, modeling short-circuit fault propagation: establishing a mathematical model of short-circuit fault propagation, and describing fault propagation and isolation processes; s5, collaborative attack optimization modeling: and establishing an optimization model of the collaborative attack. The invention is beneficial to improving the protection capability of the power system and the scientificity and effectiveness of coping strategies.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Fan off-grid cascading failure risk assessment method and system based on neural network
