abstract_en: A fan off-grid cascading failure risk assessment method based on a neural network comprises the following steps: constructing a simulation model of an alternating current power grid containing fans; acquiring stator side current simulation data and rotor side current simulation data of each fan under different states of an alternating current power grid through a simulation model, and acquiring training data according to the stator side current simulation data and the rotor side current simulation data of each fan; constructing a prediction model based on a BP neural network, and optimizing super parameters of the prediction model based on a DCS algorithm; predicting the stator side current of each fan in a future period of time through a prediction model; and calculating the off-grid risk index of each fan according to the prediction result, and evaluating the cascading failure risk of the alternating current power grid according to the off-grid risk index of each fan. The design can effectively evaluate the risk of disconnection and cascading failure of the fan in the alternating current power network containing the fan.
assignees: CENTRAL CHINA BRANCH STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV WUHAN

title_en: Primary load re-electricity optimization method and system for distribution line reverse pole under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, in particular to a primary load re-electricity optimizing method and a primary load re-electricity optimizing system for a distribution line reverse pole under typhoon disasters, wherein the primary load re-electricity optimizing method comprises the steps of obtaining the cascade reverse pole fault probability of a plurality of special power supply distribution lines of a primary load user under typhoon disasters according to the single line reverse pole fault probability so as to calculate the cascade reverse pole fault load loss power of the primary load user in a typhoon influence area; and constructing a cascade reverse pole fault power restoration optimization model of the primary load user line by taking the maximized primary load user load loss recovery power supply as an optimization target, and solving by using a long-short-term memory artificial neural network and a Markov chain method to obtain the grid loss primary load power restoration optimization power when the cascade reverse pole fault occurs. According to the invention, by combining the long-term memory artificial neural network and the Markov chain method, the high-efficiency and accurate solving of the primary load re-electricity optimization problem in typhoon multi-line reverse pole disasters is realized, and necessary technical support is provided for safe and stable operation of an electric power system.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Regional cold and heat source energy supply network optimization method and system based on dual physical information neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic regional cold and heat source optimization technology, and provides a regional building cold and heat load prediction and multi-target cold and heat source scheduling optimization method, system and equipment based on a dual physical information neural network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring and preprocessing a historical load data set, and establishing cold and hot load physical information constraint based on a thermodynamic prior mechanism; s2, building and training a building load prediction model based on the data set and the constraint; s3, constructing a regional cold and heat source multi-objective optimization model based on an energy cascade utilization principle; s4, optimizing and configuring the cold and heat sources by adopting a multi-target particle swarm algorithm according to the model load prediction result; s5, analyzing prediction load prediction and optimization results, and establishing multidimensional physical information constraint of the cold and hot loads; s6, building and training a building cold and heat source optimizing model based on the result and the constraint; s7, realizing automatic source network tuning based on predicted load through a control system.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Water-wind-solar short-term risk scheduling method considering remaining water resource utilization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-wind-solar short-term risk scheduling method considering the utilization of remaining water resources, which is characterized in that a water-wind-solar complementary system day-ahead risk scheduling model considering the comprehensive utilization of remaining water resources is constructed by considering the power discarding and load losing risks of the water-wind-solar complementary system and the peak regulation targets of a power grid under the condition of uncertainty of wind and photoelectric output through a response function of the current state of a constructed cascade reservoir and the comprehensive utilization targets of remaining water resources, and the day-ahead power generation scheduling model of the complementary system is constructed by considering the stability requirements of the system output.

title_en: Ultra-wideband antenna with substrate integrated waveguide feed structure and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-wideband antenna with a substrate integrated waveguide feed structure and a manufacturing method thereof, belonging to the field of antennas, the antenna structure is further cascaded and combined by constructing a hybrid substrate integrated waveguide ring structure, a two-dimensional dual-polarized single-pulse feeding network, a slot substrate integrated waveguide back cavity antenna and other components, so that the ultra-wideband antenna with single-layer feeding of the substrate integrated waveguide is realized. The amplitude and phase distribution of the output port of the antenna accords with the amplitude and phase excitation signals required by the single-layer structure for realizing the dual-polarized ultra-wideband antenna. The antenna provided by the invention has a simple structure, can effectively realize ultra-wideband transmission of radio frequency signals, and has wide practicability and operability.
assignees: SICHUAN AEROSPACE VOCATIONAL COLLEGE SICHUAN AEROSPACE ADVANCED TECHNICAL SCHOOL

title_en: Shipping network risk and fault interaction propagation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a shipping network risk and fault interactive propagation method. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a target shipping network, and then adopting a node attack mode to the target shipping network to obtain an attacked node; acquiring a fault state node communication state and a corresponding upstream port network node fault state by using a forward fault cascading model; acquiring the probability of risk caused by a fault node by using a risk and fault interaction propagation model, and acquiring a risk state caused by the fault node, evolution of a node fault state caused by the risk node and evolution of a network node communication state; acquiring the evolution degree of the node and the network fault and the evolution of the network node communication state by using a node fault degree conversion model; and obtaining node failure rate and maximum connectivity rate by using the failure evolution degree and the connectivity state among all state nodes to obtain the risk and failure interaction propagation condition of the network. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of fully fitting the real scene of interaction between risks and faults in the shipping network and the like.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI MARITIME

title_en: High-credibility functional resonance analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-credibility functional resonance analysis method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: qualitative depiction of system functions, analysis of coupling dependency relationships and drawing of network function diagrams; the underlying changes in function are analyzed according to simple and complex variability, and the variability propagation is subdivided into five variability phenotypes; generalizing k=pi, combining semantic evaluations of five phenotypes with numerical variables, refining granularity of a propagation factor, and obtaining coupling variability between an upstream function and a downstream function; taking the base 10 logarithm of the global system variability, combining the simple variability and the complex variability, and analyzing the uncertainty of the global system variability by calculating the global system variability interval value. Compared with the prior art, the invention qualitatively refines the semantic evaluation criterion; quantitatively refining the granularity of the propagation factors and providing a general formula; the number of intervals on the result reflects the change direction and fluctuation range of the system variability under different attributes well.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI MARITIME

title_en: Short-term wind speed prediction method, system and storage medium for refined wind field
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of weather state prediction, and relates to a short-term wind speed prediction method, a short-term wind speed prediction system and a storage medium for a refined wind field. The invention improves the existing prediction recurrent neural network PredRNN, adds a residual structure, so that the relation between data can be better mined by adopting the prediction recurrent neural network based on residual improvement to establish the first wind speed prediction model of the wind field, the problem that the model is easy to have gradient disappearance at the bottom layer along with the deepening of the network layer number in the back propagation process is solved, and the prediction accuracy of the wind speed prediction model is greatly improved. According to the invention, the first wind speed prediction model is fused with the existing weather prediction mode WRF to obtain a second wind speed prediction model, and the accuracy of the weather prediction mode WRF in the middle and rear section wind speed prediction of the refined wind field and the accuracy of the LSTM series model in the front section wind speed prediction of the refined wind field are combined; the wind speed prediction of the refined wind field in the whole period is quite accurate.
assignees: NANJING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST

title_en: Power distribution network risk assessment method under storm-ice disaster common influence scene considering cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network risk assessment method under a storm-ice disaster common influence scene considering cascading failure, which comprises the following steps: acquiring power distribution network data and storm-ice disaster common influence scene data; modeling a storm risk source and an ice disaster risk source according to weather patterns and weather parameters to obtain the weather intensity of a scene affected by storm-ice disaster; according to the weather intensity of the scene affected by the storm and the ice disaster, and combining the fault rate function, the time-varying fault rate of different distribution lines of the distribution network under the weather of the scene affected by the storm and the ice disaster is obtained; constructing a cascading failure model under the scene of storm-ice disaster common influence according to the time-varying failure rate of different distribution lines of the distribution network under the scene of storm-ice disaster common influence, and obtaining the overload outage probability of the lines; and introducing the overload outage probability of the line into a fuzzy segmentation multi-target risk frame to obtain a comprehensive risk assessment result of the power distribution network. The invention can reflect the risk level of the system more comprehensively and carefully.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;UNIV ANHUI

title_en: Cascade hydropower station power generation risk benefit balanced scheduling method based on forecast runoff correction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade hydropower station power generation risk benefit balance scheduling method based on forecast runoff correction, which comprises the steps of providing an improved orthogonal mode decomposition method IVMD for effectively reducing the runoff forecast error, constructing a prediction model of the runoff forecast error based on a long-short term memory network LSTM, and correcting the forecast runoff; simulating the scheduling operation of the cascade hydropower station based on the corrected forecast runoff, counting a risk error sequence of insufficient generated energy, quantifying the risk of insufficient generated energy of the cascade hydropower station based on the VAR, and establishing an association relation between the risk of insufficient generated energy and the forecast runoff and hydropower station decision; and constructing an optimized scheduling model with balanced power generation risk benefits by taking minimum risk of insufficient power generation and maximum power generation as targets, and making a power generation plan of the cascade hydropower station. The invention effectively ensures the completion rate of the power generation plan of the cascade hydropower station by reducing the uncertainty of the runoff forecast and optimizing the scheduling decision.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Urban rail transit risk chain group construction method based on multilayer network
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for constructing an urban rail transit risk chain group based on a multilayer network. The method comprises the following steps: determining urban rail transit risk points and risk accident types, forming a risk point set by all risk points, and forming a risk accident set by all risk accident types; defining connection relations among risk points according to a multi-layer network theory, wherein the relations among the risk points in each layer of network are defined as internal connections, and the connection relations among the risk points in different layers of network are defined as external connections; determining a logic relationship among risk points, wherein the logic relationship comprises a propagation relationship and a correlation relationship, and connecting the risk points with the propagation relationship; and matching the last risk point in the communicated propagation relationship with the risk accident type to form a risk chain group. The invention can globally control the risk accident occurrence process, and can take corresponding control measures on the basis, thereby reducing the risk accident occurrence.
assignees: BEIJING SUBWAY OPERATION CORP;BEIJING SUBWAY ENGINEERING MAN CO LTD

title_en: Electric vehicle charging station planning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric vehicle charging station planning method, which is based on power distribution information physical system data, a data acquisition module, charging station modeling in a normal operation stage and charging station modeling in a fault emergency treatment stage; wherein: the data acquisition module establishes a mutual coupling relationship between an initial communication network and a power grid of the charging station according to parameters of the information physical system of the power distribution station; the charging station modeling in the normal operation stage constructs a novel charging station according to balanced market operation and user requirements when the charging station operates normally; the fault emergency treatment charging station modeling is used for mobilizing the electric automobile and the emergency power generation automobile to supply power to the power grid when the power distribution information physical system fails; in the pre-configuration stage, the network side opens a looped network in the power grid through a remote control switch and a manual switch at the same time, and an operator cuts off the charging electric automobile; meanwhile, the electric automobile and the emergency power generation vehicle are remotely scheduled to supply power to the power grid and the communication network; in the degradation stage, determining whether the communication network can continuously control the power grid remote control switch by judging the power grid node fault and the influence on the communication node and the route thereof after the power grid node fault; in the service recovery stage, if the remote control switch in the power grid can be controlled by the communication side continuously, the remote control switch can act continuously to isolate faults according to the fault propagation condition; meanwhile, the electric automobile and the emergency power generation automobile are scheduled to supply power to the non-fault area; according to the invention, the toughness of the electric vehicle charging station facing to extreme environments is improved by restraining information physical data through the bidirectional energy transmission fusion between the electric vehicle and the power grid of the charging station.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: Power system and task load system coupling analysis method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coupling analysis method of a power system and a task load system, which comprises the following steps: acquiring node types of all nodes in the power network and the task load network, establishing node connection, constructing a node task chain with corresponding functional attributes, and calculating an arrival matrix of all the nodes under the corresponding node task chain; modeling a power network and a task load network as a dependent network model according to the arrival matrix to obtain a mapping relation between power nodes and load nodes; and establishing a dielectric coupling failure model by adopting a capacity load model and a nearest neighbor distribution principle to obtain a coupling relation of the mutual influence of the power system and the task load system. The system can analyze the complementation and linkage mechanism of the power-task load system, accurately obtain the performance reduction process of the task load system caused by cascade failure of the power system, and provide auxiliary decision making for maintenance and construction of power nodes and task load nodes.
assignees: NAT UNIV DEFENSE TECHNOLOGY PLA

title_en: Flexibility optimization scheduling method, system, equipment and medium for cascade small hydroelectric group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexibility optimization scheduling method, a system, equipment and a medium of a cascade small hydropower group, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining the rainfall of the cascade small hydropower group and quantifying the flexibility adjustment capacity of a hydropower station system according to the rainfall; quantifying the flexibility requirement of the hydropower station system, and quantifying the flexibility shortage of the hydropower station system in each period according to the flexibility requirement and the flexibility regulating capacity obtained by quantification; respectively carrying out uncertainty modeling on rainfall and net load of a hydropower station system to obtain a rainfall prediction model and a net load uncertainty set; based on the flexibility deficiency, the rainfall prediction model and the net load uncertainty set, an optimal scheduling model of the hydropower station system is constructed, the optimal scheduling model is solved, an optimal scheduling scheme of the hydropower station system is obtained, and a power grid terminal connected with the cascade small hydropower station group is controlled to execute the optimal scheduling scheme, so that the flexibility of the cascade small hydropower station is fully excavated, and the scheduling operation strategy of the hydropower station system is optimized.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV ZHEJIANG;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Electric comprehensive energy system fault analysis method based on infectious disease model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of fault analysis of an electric comprehensive energy system, and particularly relates to a fault analysis method of the electric comprehensive energy system based on an infectious disease model, which comprises the following steps: and (3) model establishment: establishing an air network fault propagation model based on an SIS model and a power network fault propagation model based on an SIR model; a propagation threshold calculation step: calculating the propagation threshold value of the fault in the power grid and the air network according to the complex network theory, the air network fault propagation model based on the SIS model and the power grid fault propagation model based on the SIR model; calculating a network propagation intensity coefficient: and according to a power grid fault propagation model of the fault on the power grid and the air grid, and according to network node parameters and a topological structure, calculating to obtain a network propagation intensity coefficient of the fault on the comprehensive energy system. The method can consider different node characteristics of the gas network and the power network and the propagation characteristics of faults of the gas network and the power network to analyze the faults of the electric comprehensive energy system.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI DIANJI

title_en: Natural gas station working state probability value determining method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for determining the probability value of the working state of a natural gas station, which relate to the technical field of computers and comprise the following steps: acquiring equipment fault statistical information in a natural gas station so as to determine a control equation in a Markov process based on the equipment fault statistical information; constructing a target neural network model based on the control equation, performing preset training on the target neural network model, and performing preset gradient calibration operation to obtain a trained neural network model; the preset training comprises feedforward propagation and back propagation; and inputting the current equipment information of the current natural gas station into the trained neural network model to obtain a corresponding working state probability value. According to the invention, based on physical information neural network training, the physical fusion neural network is introduced to improve the calculation efficiency, and the gradient correction is introduced to improve the stability of network training and convergence, so that the efficiency, stability and accuracy of working state probability value calculation are improved.
assignees: UNIV CHINA PETROLEUM BEIJING

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for daily optimal scheduling of multi-level power system
abstract_en: The invention provides a daily optimization scheduling method, a daily optimization scheduling system, daily optimization scheduling equipment and daily optimization scheduling media for a multi-level power system, which relate to the technical field of power scheduling and specifically comprise the following steps: acquiring operation data of a power transmission network, a power distribution network and a micro-grid in a multi-level power system; according to the acquired operation data, constructing a daily optimization scheduling model of the multi-level power system; decoupling and solving an intra-day optimal scheduling model by adopting a self-adaptive target cascading algorithm to obtain an optimal intra-day scheduling scheme of micro-coordination of transmission and distribution, and finishing intra-day optimal scheduling of a multi-level power system; the self-adaptive target cascading algorithm introduces a self-adaptive punishment pair multiplier updating mechanism into the target cascading algorithm, and accelerates updating of a punishment function pair multiplier according to the analysis error among the layers; the invention takes the coordination of transmission and distribution into account, realizes decoupling and parallel optimization of transmission, distribution and microgrid through an improved ATC algorithm, improves the energy utilization efficiency and improves the comprehensive benefit of system operation.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG;STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO WEIFANG POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Optimized scheduling method, equipment and storage medium for cascade hydropower station
abstract_en: The application discloses an optimized dispatching method, equipment and a storage medium of a cascade hydropower station; establishing an optimized Markov model, learning the optimized Markov model by adopting an unsupervised learning algorithm, and regressing the model according to the characteristic of joint Gaussian distribution so as to obtain a runoff forecasting result in the cascade hydropower station; establishing an optimized dispatching model, wherein the optimized dispatching model uses a reinforcement learning method, utilizes related data of the cascade hydropower stations and a runoff forecasting result, and aims at the hydropower with the lowest running cost and the greatest water and electricity consumption; and training and updating strategy neural network parameters of the intelligent agent to converge to obtain the cascade hydropower station optimized scheduling strategy in the scheduling period. And the economic, safety and real-time requirements of the scheduling plan of the cascade hydropower station-power grid system under the variable flow are met.
assignees: POWERCHINA HUADONG ENGINEERING CORP LTD;HANGZHOU HUACHEN ELECTRIC POWER CONTROL CO LTD;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Method for identifying key node set of shield machine cutterhead production supply chain network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying a key node set of a supply chain network for shield machine cutterhead production, and belongs to the technical field of supply chain risk propagation. According to the method, a complex network model of a shield machine cutterhead production supply chain is established, a proper propagation model is selected to simulate and analyze a risk propagation process in the shield machine cutterhead production supply chain network, a key node set in the shield machine cutterhead production supply chain network, namely a node set with the largest risk propagation, is identified by using a deep reinforcement learning method, and a function of protecting risks in the shield machine production process in advance is achieved. According to the method, the complex modeling is carried out on the shield tunneling machine cutterhead supply chain network, the CML propagation model is applied to simulate the risk propagation condition, the property of the supply chain network can be analyzed, the importance of the node set is rapidly measured through the propagation result, the key node set on the network is identified through the maximum propagation influence range, and the method provides favorable support for risk protection on the shield tunneling machine cutterhead supply chain network.
assignees: BEIJING INSTITUTE TECH

title_en: Day-ahead load prediction method and system based on MIC theory and monotonic value decomposition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a daily preload prediction method and a system based on MIC theory and monotonic value decomposition, which relate to the technical field of cascade hydropower scheduling and comprise the steps of acquiring a multisource data set of a target regional power grid and supplementing the multisource data set; analyzing the characteristic parameters of the data after the deficiency, and screening the characteristic parameters to construct a data set; constructing a load prediction model, and training the load prediction model by adopting the data set; and defining a loss function of the load prediction model, and carrying out load prediction by adopting the load prediction model to obtain a load prediction result. According to the invention, the original time sequence is decomposed into three components of trend, period and random, different complementation strategies are respectively adopted for the missing values, the accuracy of data complementation is improved, and methods such as moving average, same-period average and the like are introduced, so that local trend and periodic characteristics can be better captured, and estimation is closer to the actual situation.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Interphone relay management method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wireless communication, in particular to a method and a device for managing interphone relay, which comprise the following steps: based on the environment monitoring equipment, the topography and the environment data of the relay station are collected, the attenuation degree of the interphone signal under various environments and transmission distances is analyzed and calculated, and a signal attenuation analysis result is obtained. According to the invention, the influence of various environmental factors and transmission distance data on signal attenuation is analyzed, the signal gain and frequency are adjusted in real time, the signal compensation parameters are calculated, the signal transmitting power and the signal propagation path are adjusted, the signal transmission quality and the communication stability are improved, accurate and rapid signal transmission is realized in a complex and wide coverage area, the overall quality and the coverage area of the signal are enhanced, the communication access priority is adjusted by analyzing the equipment characteristics and the communication behaviors, the emergency communication requirement is responded quickly, the efficiency and the response speed of a communication system are improved, and the adaptability and the reliability of a radio communication network are enhanced.
assignees: QUANZHOU HENGLUDA ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Hydropower cluster division method suitable for hydropower enrichment power grid power dispatching
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydropower cluster division method suitable for power dispatching of a hydropower enrichment power grid. The hydropower station adjustment capacity data acquisition method comprises the steps of carrying out scale division on a hydropower station to obtain hydropower station scale data, carrying out adjustment capacity division on the hydropower station to obtain hydropower station adjustment capacity data, carrying out three-level cluster division on the hydropower station to obtain third-level cluster data of the hydropower station, obtaining a hydraulic topology structure diagram with installed scale attributes and adjustment capacity attributes, obtaining a final hydropower cluster division result, and calculating the power generation capacity of hydropower clusters according to the final hydropower cluster division result. The method is suitable for not only serial cascade hydropower station clusters, but also cross-basin cascade hydropower station clusters developed in parallel, and comprehensively considers the attribute of the power section, the attribute of the dispatching main body, the attribute of the investment main body, the attribute of the regulation, the attribute of the hydraulic connection and the attribute of the installation scale of the hydropower station, and is more suitable for dividing hydropower clusters of the electric power dispatching of the hydropower enrichment power grid.

title_en: Power distribution network maintenance strategy generation method of heuristic algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network maintenance strategy generation method of a heuristic algorithm, which comprises the steps of evaluating the aging degree of a coating and judging whether the coating needs to be replaced or repaired or not according to multidimensional health state indexes such as the aging degree of the surface of an insulator, a glaze crystal structure, geometric dimension deviation, surface cracks, temperature distribution and the like in a power distribution network, dividing a maintenance area and determining an optimal maintenance path by analyzing the geographic position of a tower where the insulator is located, surrounding vegetation coverage conditions and electromagnetic interference level; in the ground inspection process, three-dimensional point cloud data of the power transmission line are obtained, and whether the insulator is damaged or polluted is judged; measuring the width and length of the surface crack, predicting the crack propagation trend and the residual life, making a maintenance time window and scheduling maintenance resources; after the insulator is replaced or repaired, detecting the temperature distribution of the insulator to judge the installation quality; finally, through multidimensional data analysis, an optimal overhaul decision sequence of the whole life cycle of the insulator is generated.
assignees: MAOMING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network cascading failure severity prediction method and related device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power systems, and discloses a method and a related device for predicting severity of cascading failures of a power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining nodes of each attack object of the power distribution network; acquiring active sensitivity factors of all attack object nodes in the power distribution network to all nodes under the influence of cross-domain attack, and power fluctuation values of all attack object nodes; according to the active sensitivity factors of all the attack object nodes in the power distribution network to all the nodes under the influence of the cross-domain attack and the power fluctuation values of all the attack object nodes, the voltage amplitude change quantity average value of all the nodes of the power distribution network is obtained and is used as the predicted value of the severity of the cascading failure under the cross-domain attack of the power distribution network, so that the accurate and quantitative description of the severity of the cascading failure under the cross-domain attack of the power distribution network is realized, the trend data information of the power system is fully utilized, the influence of the cross-domain attack on the power distribution network can be fully represented, the safety protection precision of the cross-domain attack is further assisted to be improved, and the safe and stable operation of the power distribution network is ensured.
assignees: STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD YANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Chemical field event prediction method and system based on logic atlas
abstract_en: A chemical field event prediction method and system based on logic atlas comprises the following steps: (1) Defining event trigger words and event elements, and extracting events from accident reasons in a chemical accident investigation report; (2) constructing a map of the chemical field logic; (3) Performing initial embedding on the chemical event, inputting the initial embedding into BiLSTM networks, and obtaining the representation of an event sequence; (4) According to logic atlases, stacking a plurality of embedded propagation layers by using a graph neural network to represent the high-order vector of the event node; (5) And calculating the vector similarity of each candidate follow-up event and the event context, and selecting the candidate event with the maximum similarity as a prediction result. The invention provides an event prediction model based on logic maps for the problem of low current event prediction accuracy; for the problem of lack of events and insufficient pre-warning in the chemical field, the method is applied to the chemical field, and a chemical field event prediction system based on logic maps is realized.
assignees: UNIV LIAONING

title_en: Optimized scheduling method and device for wind power and cascade hydropower combined system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power and cascade hydropower combined system optimal scheduling method and device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a daily random optimization scheduling model of the wind power and step hydropower combined system based on Monte Carlo tree search, wherein the daily random optimization scheduling model is used for maximizing the generated energy of the wind power and step hydropower combined system in one day and minimizing the total fluctuation of power generation; determining constraint conditions of the daily random optimization scheduling model; defining a step hydropower station with solar regulation capacity as an intelligent body, taking a wind power and step hydropower combined system as an interactive environment, and performing discretization treatment on a state space and an action space; randomly generating wind power plant output by adopting a fractional regression long-short-term memory neural network model; and solving a daily random optimization scheduling model by using a Monte Carlo tree searching algorithm to obtain an optimal scheduling scheme. The method realizes the dual goals of maximizing the generated energy of the combined system and minimizing the total fluctuation through the Monte Carlo tree search of reinforcement learning, and remarkably improves the energy utilization efficiency and the power grid stability.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Power information physical system safety assessment method considering wind power and cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety evaluation method of an electric power information physical system considering wind power and cascading faults, which comprises the steps of constructing a mathematical model of the electric power information physical system, starting network attack aiming at the electric power information physical system, designing a wind power randomness model based on a Markov-Monte Carlo method after the cascading faults occur, acquiring active and reactive power injection of each node in the electric power system according to wind power at each cascading fault simulation moment, calculating voltage of each node and power transmission line trend in the electric power system by using an improved linearization alternating current power flow calculation method, updating running temperature of the power transmission line according to the power transmission line trend at each simulation moment, calculating the disconnection probability of the power transmission line, and providing cascading fault safety evaluation indexes considering output and load fluctuation of a wind turbine generator set simultaneously according to entropy theory, wherein the influence of the power transmission line disconnection on subsequent evolution of the cascading faults can be analyzed, and the dynamic safety of the system in the cascading fault process is evaluated.

title_en: Modeling and risk assessment method and system for cascading failure of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modeling and risk assessment method and a system for cascading faults of a power system, and relates to the technical field of power system risk assessment, wherein the modeling and risk assessment method comprises the steps of constructing a cascading fault simulation model, determining initial fault conditions, judging whether line power flow overload exists or not, and calculating system power flow and voltage; calculating a node load loss rate based on the node voltage and the line power flow, and evaluating the system load loss rate; and analyzing the influence of different attack combinations on the system load loss rate, and evaluating the risk of cascading failures. Aiming at the problem of simultaneous tripping of the power transmission line under the condition of cascading failure, a cascading failure model is established, a weighted random disturbance mechanism is introduced, the influence of different attack scenes on the power grid is quantitatively analyzed and evaluated, the critical point of the system is obtained, multi-level cooperative protection and fault tolerance measures are provided, the risk resistance and the reliable operation capability of the power grid are obviously enhanced, and the method has important significance in improving the safe and stable operation of the power system.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power information physical system key node identification method based on cascading failure characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a key node identification method of an electric power information physical system based on cascading failure characteristics, which comprises the following steps: 1. constructing an electric power information physical system comprising a power grid and an information network, 2, calculating a node transfer characteristic matrix of a link matrix, a voltage sensitivity matrix S  e  of a random matrix, a voltage safety margin index L of a dynamic damping factor, 3, calculating PageRank values R  P  of power grid nodes, 4, calculating an information network key index of each information node, 5, calculating a coupling key index vector K of a coupling node, and recording a key node identification result. The invention can screen out key nodes which possibly cause serious cascading failures, thereby providing preventive protection for power system disasters.
assignees: UNIV HEFEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Chained risk propagation quantification method for water resource system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a chained risk propagation quantification method of a water resource system, electronic equipment and a storage medium. Firstly, identifying causal relation of the related elements; then, collecting causal relations among the partition associated elements to form a subunit network, integrating each subunit network through hydraulic links among the areas to form a watershed water resource system risk multilink network, calculating the degree and the betweenness centrality of each node, and defining a risk propagation mechanism: a starting stage: calculating importance level, safety bearing threshold, risk sensitivity and initial load of the nodes according to node characteristics calculated by the risk multilink network; propagation phase: calculating probability of risk propagation by using node network characteristics, and calculating propagation load; the regression phase: defining a fading coefficient to reduce node load; the slave nodes, links and networks analyze the change condition of risks in the propagation process. And finally, providing a risk prevention and control strategy through node characteristics in the network. The invention can perfect the risk analysis technology of the water resource system under complex conditions.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Substation monitoring alarm information studying and judging method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for studying and judging power transformation monitoring alarm information. The method comprises the steps of obtaining history monitoring alarm information without labels; inputting unlabeled historical monitoring alarm information into an initial model for pre-training to obtain a pre-training model; marking the unlabeled historical monitoring alarm information by utilizing expert system eventing rules, and checking marked data against a scheduling log to obtain the labeled historical monitoring alarm information; inputting the history monitoring alarm information with the tag into a pre-training model, fine-tuning the pre-training model, and updating model parameters of the pre-training model through back propagation to obtain a trained network model; and acquiring monitoring alarm data during the monitoring operation of the power transformation centralized control station, inputting the monitoring alarm data into a trained network model, and acquiring a power transformation monitoring alarm event studying and judging result. The scheme of the invention can realize the autonomous research and judgment of the transformer monitoring alarm event, and improve the accuracy and fault tolerance of the event research and judgment strategy.
assignees: STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST;HUNAN XIANGDIAN TEST RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power distribution network cascading failure risk assessment method and system with large-scale distributed energy access
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network cascading failure risk assessment method and system with large-scale distributed energy access, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring circuit fault data, output state data of a photovoltaic unit and load level data of a target power distribution network; establishing a distributed photovoltaic low voltage ride through capability uncertainty model based on circuit fault data, output state data of a photovoltaic unit and load level data of a target power distribution network, and a power distribution network fault scene set containing large-scale distributed energy access; and simulating the uncertainty model of the distributed photovoltaic low voltage ride through capability, outputting the average power shortage amount in each scene, and evaluating the cascading failure risk. The invention considers the uncertainty of the low voltage ride through capability of the distributed generator set in the risk assessment of the cascading faults of the power distribution network containing large-scale distributed energy access, has more accurate assessment results, and can accurately predict the propagation paths of the cascading faults.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Flexible power grid regulation and control method and system based on wind, light and small hydropower
abstract_en: The application discloses a flexible regulation and control method and a flexible regulation and control system for a power grid based on wind, light and small hydropower stations, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a head loss prediction model according to historical operation data of each hydropower station in the cascade small hydropower stations; the method comprises the steps of constructing a target hydropower prediction model by using a photovoltaic power generation prediction model and a wind power generation prediction model, constructing a bus topology diagram by using each hydropower station in a cascade hydropower station as a bus topology node, using a water flow line between each hydropower station as a data transmission line in a bus, constructing an optimized objective function according to the head loss prediction model, the target hydropower prediction model and the bus topology diagram based on minimum energy consumption and minimum path overlapping rate, and outputting a hydropower station scheduling strategy. The application has the beneficial effects of reducing the dependence of hydroelectric power on a single path while reducing the energy consumption, and improving the redundancy and stability of a power grid.

title_en: Capsule network box-type substation fault diagnosis method based on residual improvement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault diagnosis method of a capsule network box-type transformer substation based on residual improvement, which belongs to the technical field of transformer substations and comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of carrying out data set processing, namely data set division and independent heat coding on fault types of the box-type transformer substation; constructing a capsule network based on residual improvement; inputting the training set and the verification set into a capsule network for training, training a residual capsule network by using a back propagation algorithm, and continuously optimizing parameters in the model by forward excitation propagation and back weight updating to obtain a trained box-type substation fault diagnosis model; and inputting the test set into a trained box-type substation fault diagnosis model to obtain a box-type substation fault diagnosis method result. The invention can solve the problem of model performance degradation caused by network deepening due to numerous data of the traditional convolution network model, effectively solve the problems of gradient disappearance and gradient explosion, accurately mine the state characteristics contained in the model, and improve the accuracy of fault diagnosis of the box-type transformer substation.
assignees: UNIV XIAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Distributed robust recovery method and terminal for electric-gas comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed robust recovery method and a terminal for an electric-gas comprehensive energy system, wherein a built upper-layer electric system recovery model accounts for pumped storage and wind power uncertainty, the upper-layer electric system recovery model is reconstructed based on the distributed robust model to obtain a reconstructed upper-layer electric system recovery model, a built lower-layer natural gas system recovery model accounts for gas storage and pipe storage, the reconstructed upper-layer electric system recovery model and lower-layer natural gas system recovery model are solved by using an analysis target cascade method to obtain an optimal recovery decision of an electric system, the influence of a natural gas network on a high-capacity electric system recovery process is considered, the concurrent influence of a pumped storage hydropower station and a wind power generation field is considered, the excessively conservative recovery decision is avoided, the balance point of the proposed double-layer optimization problem can be accurately calculated, the privacy of an electric network and a natural gas system is ensured, and the recovery effectiveness and reliability after the system failure are improved.
assignees: SHANXI ENERGY INTERNET RES INSTITUTE;UNIV SHANDONG

title_en: Cascading failure risk assessment method and system for large-scale wind power access power grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid risk assessment, in particular to a cascading failure risk assessment method and system for a large-scale wind power access power grid, wherein the assessment method comprises the steps of establishing a power transmission line disconnection probability model; establishing a load loss model according to the load loss of the node; constructing a fault model of the wind turbine; performing cascading failure simulation analysis based on the established model; according to the invention, the accurate assessment of the power transmission line disconnection probability is realized by establishing the power transmission line disconnection probability model; modeling the disconnection probability of the power transmission line by adopting a piecewise linear model effectively simulates the disconnection risk of the power transmission line under different load states, and provides powerful guarantee for the safe operation of the power grid; by carrying out cascading failure simulation analysis, whether the power flow of the power transmission line is out of limit or not is used as a termination condition of failure evolution, and the cascading failure risk after wind power is connected into a power grid can be comprehensively estimated.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic carbon emission factor prediction method based on data driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data-driven dynamic carbon emission factor prediction method, which comprises the following steps: historical load data, non-low-carbon power supply and distributed new energy historical power generation power data are obtained, a power distribution network topological structure and power supply and load access positions are identified, and a main network access carbon potential is calculated; synthesizing various power supplies and loads, generating power grid tide data in a simulation mode, and generating a label of a training sample according to an improved dynamic carbon emission factor calculation method; constructing an initial sample set according to the generated label and the history data; extracting a time sequence dependency relationship of the multivariate time sequence based on the Fea2Vec framework; dividing an initial sample set into a training set, a verification set and a test set, carrying out training by taking a Fea2Vec-BiLSTM model, and cutting off the training process when the error of the test set is converged; and obtaining a prediction result through a forward propagation process. The invention can predict the dynamic carbon emission factor of the hour-level area of the future day and provide data support for the low-carbon energy utilization mode.
assignees: XUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH CO STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Doubly-fed wind farm transient equivalent modeling method and system suitable for cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of equivalent calculation, in particular to a transient equivalent modeling method and a transient equivalent modeling system for a doubly-fed wind power plant suitable for cascading failure, which are used for clustering units in groups by using a hierarchical condensation clustering algorithm according to the reactive power supporting capability of doubly-fed wind power units in the cascading failure period to ensure that the units in the same group have similar cascading failure characteristics and the characteristics of the units among different groups have differences, establish an equivalent calculation principle, the method comprises the steps of ensuring the accuracy and rationality of equivalent calculation by a set input wind speed equivalent principle, a generator parameter equivalent principle and a collector network line impedance equivalent principle, performing model construction, extracting reactive current response and stator and rotor current axis components as grouping indexes, performing equivalent calculation to obtain equivalent set parameters and collector network equivalent impedance parameters, performing simulation verification on a wind power plant detailed model, and comparing the simulation verification with the detailed model to verify the accuracy of the equivalent model.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method for evaluating importance degree of coupling network node of supply dependent system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating importance of a coupling network node of a supply-dependent system, which can characterize failure risk of the node, guide dynamic risk control of the supply-dependent system and can be used as a key decision basis of the supply-dependent system for coping with cascade failure. The method comprises the following specific steps: constructing a double-layer supply dependent system coupling network model, and establishing a multiple supply-dependent coupling relation between coupling network layers; in the cascade failure process of the coupling network model of the supply dependent system, designing a node importance index for representing the node failure risk, namely node pressure; calculating the pressure, degree centrality, medium centrality, approximate centrality and H index of nodes in the network according to the state parameters of the network; and (3) using node pressure, degree centrality, medium centrality, near centrality and H index to give an importance assessment of the nodes of the coupling network of the supply dependent system.
assignees: UNIV BEIHANG

title_en: Construction method based on dynamic evaluation model of petroleum engineering safety risk
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of model construction, in particular to a construction method based on a dynamic risk assessment model of petroleum engineering safety. The method comprises the steps of obtaining geological data of an oil engineering area, carrying out multidimensional sensor deployment on the geological data of the oil engineering area to generate an oil exploitation sensor deployment network, carrying out environment sensing data acquisition based on the oil exploitation sensor deployment network to obtain standard oil exploitation environment acquisition data, carrying out oil exploitation geographic elevation conversion on the standard oil exploitation environment acquisition data to generate oil exploitation geographic elevation data, carrying out multi-level oil exploitation influence evaluation based on the oil exploitation geographic elevation data to generate oil exploitation multi-level influence data. According to the invention, the dynamic sensing and instant response capacity of the petroleum engineering safety risk is improved by carrying out data integration, dynamic monitoring and risk propagation path analysis on the petroleum engineering stage data and carrying out petroleum engineering safety risk assessment.

title_en: Topology optical switch structure design method and system based on multi-network cascading model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a topological optical switch structure design method and a system based on a multi-network cascading model, which relate to the field of topological optical switch structure design, wherein the topological optical switch structure design method based on the multi-network cascading model mainly comprises the steps of constructing a one-dimensional convolution reverse design network, an amplitude coupling ratio prediction network, a mathematical model based on a transmission matrix method and a transmission spectrum forward prediction model; the method comprises the steps of independently training each sub-model, cascading the trained sub-models to enable the output of each network to be the input of the next network, obtaining a multi-network cascading model, integrally training the multi-network cascading model, obtaining an optimized one-dimensional convolution reverse design network, and obtaining target structural parameters according to target transmission spectrum data by utilizing the optimized one-dimensional convolution reverse design network. By implementing the topology optical switch structure design method and system based on the multi-network cascading model, the accuracy of the topology optical switch structure design can be improved.

title_en: Power grid cascading failure prevention control method and system considering power flow transfer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid cascading failure prevention control method and system considering tide transfer, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting power grid state data in real time: collecting power grid state data in real time from a power grid monitoring system, wherein the power grid state data comprises power flow data of all lines, generator output data and load data of each node; n-1 fault scan is performed: n-1 fault scanning is carried out based on the tide data of all lines, and weak and heavy-load lines of the power grid are identified; constructing mirror image simulation data: mirror image simulation data are built based on the power grid state data and used for realizing power flow transfer ratio matrix calculation through power flow calculation; and obtaining power grid cascading failure control based on the power flow transfer ratio matrix. The invention can reduce the influence of cascading faults on the power grid and improve the stability and reliability of the power system.
assignees: GUANGXI GUANGTOU BEIHAI POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Thermal management method of Ka frequency band microstrip waveguide conversion and power synthesis device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thermal management method of a Ka frequency band microstrip waveguide conversion and power synthesis device, which relates to the technical field of thermal management, and comprises the following steps: performing digital modeling to generate a power simulation model; collecting a waveguide synthesis test sample of the target integrated device; inputting the waveguide synthesis test sample into a power simulation model for power density test to generate a power density distribution network; performing temperature propagation analysis based on the power density distribution network to generate a temperature distribution network; generating an optimal fluid channel network; thermal management control is performed based on the optimal fluid channel network. The technical problems that the existing Ka frequency band microstrip waveguide conversion and power synthesis device is difficult to accurately simulate the power distribution and heat generation conditions of the microstrip-waveguide conversion and power synthesis device under high-frequency and high-power conditions, and further heat dissipation requirements cannot be met are solved, the stability and service life of the device are poor, and the technical effects of improving the heat dissipation efficiency and stability of the device are achieved.
assignees: HEBEI LINGKUN ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wide-area energy storage step configuration device and optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wide area energy storage cascade configuration device and an optimization method, which relate to the technical field of energy integration configuration, and in particular relates to a wide area energy storage cascade configuration device and an optimization method, comprising a base, wherein a gas boiler is arranged on one side above the base, a burner is arranged above the gas boiler, a gas pipeline is arranged in the gas boiler, one end of the gas pipeline is connected with a conveying pipeline, and one end of the conveying pipeline is connected with a filter box; the inner wall of gas holder is provided with the heat preservation, gas boiler's outside is provided with the heat collection box, and the inner wall of heat collection box is provided with the heat-conducting plate, the outer wall of heat collection box is provided with the heat preservation skin. The wide-area energy storage cascade configuration device and the optimization method solve the problem that the existing energy system is usually composed of relatively single energy networks, and the coordination among different energy networks is not considered in the networks, so that the energy utilization rate is not high.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Point-to-point marking method and system based on defect-free state change
abstract_en: The invention discloses a point-by-point marking method and a point-by-point marking system based on defect eliminating state change, which relate to the field of association analysis and comprise the following steps: collecting data of a power distribution network, establishing a topology model of the power grid, and analyzing the topology structure change of the power grid in different states; based on a topological model and running state data of a power grid, establishing a correlation model of states among all nodes of the power grid, and analyzing a fault propagation path and an influence range; identifying the influence degree of the fault propagation path analysis node based on the state association model, and marking the key node; and constructing a genetic algorithm optimization model, expressing a node marking scheme as a chromosome in the genetic algorithm, and defining an fitness function to evaluate the quality of the chromosome according to the analyzed node influence degree. According to the invention, by establishing the power grid topology model and the state association model, analyzing the fault propagation path and the node influence degree, designing the genetic algorithm to optimize the key node mark, improving the accuracy of fault identification and processing, and enhancing the running stability and reliability of the power grid.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Step hydroelectric dispatching method, system, equipment and storage medium based on TD3 algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydropower station scheduling, in particular to a step hydropower station scheduling method, a system, equipment and a storage medium based on a TD3 algorithm, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a long-term optimized scheduling model based on basic data and running conditions of the cascade hydropower station; the method comprises the steps of converting a scheduling problem in a long-term optimized scheduling model into a Markov decision process, solving the Markov decision process by utilizing a double-delay-determination strategy gradient algorithm TD3 to obtain a long-term scheduling decision scheme of each power station in the cascade hydropower station, and outputting a long-term scheduling decision result based on an actual cascade hydropower station. According to the invention, the continuous action space value under the state can be output according to the state quantity, the problem of network overestimation is reduced, the problem of error accumulation is solved by adopting a delay strategy update and a noise smoothing target strategy, and the power generation benefit of the cascade hydropower station can be effectively improved.

title_en: Social network node importance ranking method based on inherent propagation mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a social network node importance ranking method based on an inherent propagation mode, which comprises the following steps of: step 1, dividing a propagation model on a social network into a deterministic propagation model and an uncertainty propagation model; step 2, sampling the proposed distribution importance of event propagation of the uncertainty propagation model in the step 1 by a Monte Carlo simulation method; calculating a linear propagation matrix of the deterministic propagation model in the step 1; step 3, constructing a directed acyclic graph of event propagation based on the linear propagation matrix obtained in the step 2; and 4, calculating the propagation centrality score of each node by using a dynamic programming method based on the directed acyclic graph, thereby realizing importance ranking. The invention can excavate important node users of the social network in advance in a fixed propagation mode, and is beneficial to formulating better public opinion management strategies.
assignees: TIANJIN UNIV HEFEI INNOVATION DEVELOPMENT RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Power distribution auxiliary monitoring and early warning system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution monitoring, in particular to a power distribution auxiliary monitoring early warning system which comprises the steps of collecting operation parameters of all nodes in a power distribution system in real time, collecting temperature and strain data in real time by utilizing sensors arranged on a plurality of nodes in the power distribution system, identifying complex temperature and strain modes to perform fault diagnosis on the collected operation parameters and the temperature and strain data, generating early warning signals according to fault diagnosis results to establish a topological structure model of a power grid, and providing real-time topological structure change and fault influence assessment. The invention can efficiently identify and classify fault modes, thereby improving the accuracy and response speed of fault diagnosis, ensuring that the model keeps high performance and reliability in a complex and dynamic power distribution environment, improving the accuracy of monitoring the running state of the power grid and the accuracy of simulating fault propagation paths, and providing powerful technical support for the reliable running of the power grid.
assignees: ZHEJIANG WELLSUN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Electric power physical information system cascading failure assessment method considering information transmission failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascading failure assessment method of an electric power physical information system considering information transmission failure, which comprises the steps of 1, building an electric power physical information system model, 2, selecting a continuous attack node set, 3, judging that an information node or an electric power line fails according to a dependency relationship and a topological relationship, 4, judging that a power grid is separated and balanced with power, 5, judging that the electric power line is seriously overloaded and disconnecting the seriously overloaded line, 6, judging that the transmission of the seriously overloaded information is successful, 7, judging that the line is generally overloaded, 8, judging that the transmission of the generally overloaded information is successful, 9, making a control strategy by a dispatching center and issuing, 10, judging that the general overload of the line is eliminated and the disconnection of the overload line is not eliminated, 11, calculating a cascading failure assessment index, 12 and traversing the continuous attack node set. The invention can more accurately predict information transmission failure and simulate the cascading failure process under continuous node attack, thereby providing theoretical guidance for the cascading failure prevention and control of the power physical information system.
assignees: UNIV HEFEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Complex dynamic oil reservoir simulation method based on adaptive physical meaning neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of oil deposit engineering and discloses a complex dynamic oil deposit simulation method based on an adaptive physical meaning neural network, which comprises the following steps of 1, acquiring complex production dynamic oil deposit development data; step 2, establishing an adaptive physical meaning neural network model, initializing model parameters and setting a production regulation schedule, step 3, responding to input initial pressure data of an oil reservoir, adjusting internal boundary conditions according to the production schedule, calculating gradients by forward propagation mapping and reverse propagation, step 4, updating saturation according to the pressure data output by the model, and step 5, iteratively executing the steps 3 and 4, and continuously solving the simulation process of the whole oil reservoir by using the pressure field output by each step and the neural network parameters obtained by training as input of the next step. The invention can be rapidly adapted to the severe change of the oil reservoir under the complex production dynamic state.

title_en: Method and device for determining overhaul cost data of transformer substation
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a device for determining overhaul cost data of a transformer substation, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining cost influence data, wherein the cost influence data is influence data which has influence on the cost data and has influence degree of m bits at the front, the cost data is overhaul cost of primary equipment of the transformer substation, and the cost influence data comprises at least one of engineering parameters of the transformer substation, equipment parameters of the transformer substation and process parameters of the transformer substation; calculating the cost influence data by adopting a preset model to obtain a plurality of calculation results, wherein the preset model comprises a target depth confidence network, a target back propagation neural network and a target gray prediction model; and carrying out fusion processing on the multiple calculation results to obtain target cost data, wherein the fusion processing at least comprises quantile regression average processing. The method solves the problem of insufficient reliability in the process of determining the cost data in the prior art.
assignees: ZHANJIANG POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Space-time operation situation deduction method for urban lifeline complex system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of simulation deduction, and discloses a space-time operation situation deduction method of a complex system of an urban lifeline. The method comprises the steps of S100, constructing a multi-layer network model of the urban lifeline complex system corresponding to an actual space position under the same space coordinate reference frame, S102, constructing a space grid model or a field model aiming at each external factor under the same space coordinate reference frame, S104, evaluating and obtaining the damage degree generated under the coupling influence of multiple external factors according to the multi-layer network model and the space grid model or the field model of the urban lifeline complex system, S106, analyzing the cascade fault propagation dynamics of the urban lifeline complex system according to the correlation relationship between the damage degree generated under the coupling influence of the multiple external factors and the nodes in the urban lifeline complex system, evaluating and obtaining the damage degree under the influence of the multiple external factors and the correlation relationship, S108, judging whether to finish deduction, if so, finishing deduction, and returning to S102.
assignees: CASIC INTELLIGENT TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Method, device and equipment for detecting electricity stealing user based on mixed element heuristic optimization
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power detection, and discloses an electric larceny user detection method, device and equipment based on mixed element heuristic optimization, which are characterized in that an original electric power consumption data set is obtained by acquiring the original electric power consumption data set of a user, the original electric power consumption data set is preprocessed, the preprocessed original electric power consumption data set is subjected to characteristic extraction by a mixed element heuristic optimization algorithm to generate the electric power consumption data set, and performing iterative training on the Cascade area convolutional neural network Cascade R-CNN model by using the electric power consumption data set after feature extraction to generate a Cascade R-CNN classification detector model, and finally inputting the original electric power consumption data of the user to be detected into the Cascade R-CNN classification detector model to judge whether the user is an electricity stealing user or not, and performing anomaly marking. The accuracy of electricity stealing detection is effectively improved, and the false alarm rate is reduced.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Bi-TCN-LSTM network model-based transmission line icing galloping prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission line icing galloping prediction method based on a Bi-TCN-LSTM network model, which comprises the steps of generating a weather data set according to historical weather forecast data including but not limited to temperature, humidity, precipitation, wind speed, wind direction, air pressure and weather conditions, wherein the weather conditions include sunny days, rainy days and snowy days, matching and labeling historical icing galloping information of the power transmission line with the weather data set to obtain the icing galloping data set, carrying out feature extraction on the icing galloping data set according to a time sequence convolution network model to obtain an icing galloping feature data set, cascading a bidirectional long-short-term memory network model and a time sequence convolution network model to construct a Bi-TCN-LSTM network model, training the Bi-TCN-LSTM network model according to the icing galloping feature data set, inputting target weather forecast data into the trained Bi-TCN-LSTM network model, and predicting the icing galloping information of the power transmission line. According to the invention, the TCN model and the Bi-LSTM model are combined, so that the long-term and short-term dependency relationship in the time sequence data is effectively captured, and the prediction accuracy is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Assembly line rapid reconstruction method based on forward modification network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid reconstruction method of an assembly line based on a forward modification network, which summarizes the multi-domain conduction principle of 'product similarity-system configuration similarity-system execution similarity' of a man-machine cooperation assembly line, and uses five dimensions of 'function-structure-behavior-execution-performance' to describe the physical and logical reconstruction connotation of the man-machine cooperation assembly line, comprehensively considers each layer of the assembly line, and improves the comprehensiveness and coordination of the whole design. In the flexible production line design process taking the production line rapid deformation design as a core, the optimal production line change scheme can be more scientifically and objectively selected by adopting a parameterized node network model and an alignment theory, and the time period from information induction to scheme implementation is shortened. And constructing a mathematical model with the change propagation risk, the change propagation time and the change propagation cost as comprehensive targets according to the actual production condition of enterprises, so as to realize fine management and cost optimization and reduce cost.
