assignees: UNIV GUANGDONG TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Method, system and device for evaluating influence of extreme weather on power generation power of power grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid security risk assessment, in particular to a method, a system and a device for evaluating the influence of extreme weather on power generated by a power grid, which are used for firstly acquiring weather cloud images and microclimate data corresponding to the extreme weather; the method comprises the steps of inputting a meteorological cloud image into a VIT prediction model to conduct prediction to obtain a first sub-decision, inputting microclimate data into a transducer prediction model to conduct prediction to obtain a second sub-decision, and finally inputting the first sub-decision and the second sub-decision into a multi-mode fusion decision machine to conduct cascade fusion to obtain probability of influencing power generation power of a power grid. The method combines the prediction results of the two modes of the weather cloud image and the microclimate data to carry out decision fusion, integrates the different dimensional information collected when the extreme weather occurs, and accurately predicts the influence of the extreme weather on the power generation power of the new energy power grid.

title_en: Electric power visual knowledge distillation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric power visual knowledge distillation method and system, the method comprises the steps of collecting electric power visual image data, establishing an electric power visual data set, inputting the electric power visual data set into a first model for training to obtain a teacher model, constructing a second model, combining a detection frame of the teacher model with a backbone network of the second model to construct a student model, inputting the electric power visual data set into the teacher model and the student model to obtain an output result, calculating the difference degree between the output results of the teacher model and the student model by using a composite loss function, updating parameters of the student model according to the difference degree by using a back propagation algorithm and an Adam optimizer, and enabling the difference degree to be smaller than a set value through a plurality of rounds of iteration to output the student model. On the premise of greatly reducing the resource consumption, the student model has higher calculation speed, recognition accuracy close to that of a teacher model and smaller model size, and the electric power visual knowledge distillation system is suitable for various resource-limited environments.
assignees: NANJING NARI INFORMATION COMM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Virtual power plant optimized operation method for polymerizing electric vehicles and carbon capture
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimized operation method for a virtual power plant for polymerizing an electric automobile and carbon capture. The method comprises the steps of S1, simulating user charging load through analyzing electric vehicle user behaviors, providing a virtual power plant operation strategy, S2, aiming at peak Gu Chalv and virtual power plant income, clearing wind power, photovoltaic output and electric vehicle discharge to market in the future, using a GAs turbine to bear basic load, wind-light prediction deviation and electric vehicle charging demand, S3, considering seasonality of wind power and photovoltaic output, avoiding prediction deviation penalty through compensation, decomposing peak frequency band and GA optimization counter-propagation neural network BP by using a chaos theory set empirical mode, namely GABP, carrying out seasonality prediction on the GABP, adopting a carbon trapping system to reduce carbon emission and participating in carbon market transaction, and S4, finally, comparing simulation on ordered and disordered charging and discharging through a calculation example, and verifying effectiveness and practicability of the provided strategy.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Graph theory-based electric CPS vulnerability assessment method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of power system application, in particular to a graph theory-based power CPS vulnerability assessment method and a graph theory-based power CPS vulnerability assessment system, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing an unauthorized network topology model of a power CPS network, and acquiring nodes of the power CPS network, connecting edges among the nodes and load voltage data of the nodes; the method comprises the steps of obtaining load abnormality of each node of a power CPS network, obtaining voltage recovery responsiveness of each node of the power CPS network, obtaining operation robustness of each node of the power CPS network, obtaining communities and associated communities of each community in the power CPS network, obtaining voltage abrupt change time sequences of each node in the power CPS network, obtaining cascading failure degree of each community in the power CPS network, obtaining cascading criticality of each community in the power CPS network, obtaining vulnerability factors of the power CPS network and evaluating the vulnerability of the power CPS network. The application reduces the risk of damaging the safety of the power system.
assignees: BOYUAN ELECTRICAL TECH XIAN CO LTD

title_en: House power load prediction method based on brand new end-to-end
abstract_en: The invention discloses a brand new end-to-end-based residential power load prediction method which comprises the steps of 1) carrying out feature screening on a data set by using a Pearson correlation coefficient method and carrying out data preprocessing, wherein the feature normalization and the independent heat coding are included, 2) dividing the preprocessed data set into a training set, a testing set and a verification set according to a ratio of 8:1:1, 3) adopting a brand new end-to-end network model to extract features of the training set data, learning data distribution and change rules of the training set data and constructing a deep learning neural network model, 4) carrying out back propagation on training model parameters according to a marble loss function through an Adam algorithm, judging the training effect of model parameters according to the loss value of the verification set, and 5) predicting short-term residential power loads by using the optimal deep learning neural network model trained in the step S04 and verifying the prediction precision of the network model. The method has the advantages of high prediction speed, good generalization capability and high accuracy of the prediction result.
assignees: UNIV NANCHANG

title_en: Power distribution equipment fault detection method, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault detection method of power distribution equipment, which belongs to the technical field of deep learning and solves the problem of low fault detection precision caused by the lack of operation and maintenance data in a power system, and the method comprises the steps of collecting operation and maintenance data of a power distribution network, carrying out data segmentation on a state data set based on a time sequence, extracting spatial characteristics through a graph rolling network, and extracting and learning time dependence and nonlinear relation in the data by adopting a multi-layer perceptron; the method comprises the steps of carrying out feature stitching, unifying the dimensionality of data, merging feature vectors after adding the unified dimensionality bit by bit, merging the feature vectors with environment information, sending the merged feature vectors into a deep learning network consisting of a multi-layer perceptron and a full-connection layer for training, evaluating model deviation by using a mean square error loss function, and updating and optimizing model parameters by using back propagation and gradient descent.
assignees: TIANJIN UNIV HEFEI INNOVATION DEVELOPMENT RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: User notification for service interruption
abstract_en: System and methods for selecting customers to notify of a service interruption or outage are described. A network may receive an interruption notification indicating when a service interruption is to occur. In some examples, the interruption notification may also include a particular set of equipment, such as a base station, that will experience the interruption, such as being taken offline for maintenance or a power outage affecting the base station. A notification module determines which customers will be affected by the service interruption and transmits a notification to the customers, informing the customers of the service interruption.
assignees: T MOBILE USA INC

title_en: Flow monitoring-oriented supply chain intelligent tracking system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a supply chain intelligent tracking system oriented to flow monitoring, which relates to the technical field of supply chain intelligent management and is used for solving the problems of flexibility and risk resistance of supply chain breakpoint management; the method comprises the steps of collecting original data from supply chain link points, combining time sequence, classification characteristics and high-dimensional data processing technology, generating effective characteristics, constructing a breakpoint prediction model through a gradient lifting decision tree, identifying and evaluating breakpoint risks, constructing a supply chain network topological structure, recursively calculating propagation paths and influence ranges of the breakpoint risks, determining affected node sets, combining prediction results to formulate adjustment and recovery strategies, optimizing resource allocation and logistics routes, quickly recovering key nodes, ensuring continuity of the supply chain, upgrading early warning mechanisms to dynamically monitor risks, and accordingly improving management flexibility and risk resistance of the supply chain.
assignees: SHENZHEN DINGRUN JIETONG SUPPLY CHAIN CO LTD

title_en: Construction method and system of power grid safety production index system
abstract_en: The invention provides a construction method and a construction system of a power grid safety production index system, and relates to the technical field of power grid safety monitoring, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining safety production condition data of power grid operation and obtaining an index demand result according to the safety production condition data; the method comprises the steps of selecting an initial index according to an index demand result and a power industry safety production target, selecting a plurality of secondary indexes of five primary indexes of the initial index, screening key indexes from the plurality of secondary indexes of each primary index through an expert belief propagation-decision laboratory analysis method, and carrying out weighted fusion on all the screened key indexes to obtain a power grid safety production index system. The invention can comprehensively and accurately reflect the safe production condition of the power grid by constructing the index system covering various aspects of human factors, equipment, environment and the like, and provides comprehensive information support.
assignees: GUILIN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Complex equipment elastic reliability assessment method considering fault and repair factors
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating the elastic reliability of complex equipment by considering fault and repair factors, which comprises the following steps: the prior parameters are calculated, which is aimed at the prior parameters to be used as input parameters of the dynamic bayesian network and the dynamic propagation properties. And step two, establishing a multi-level topological directed graph model, wherein the multi-level topological directed graph model is used as a structure model of the dynamic Bayesian network. And step three, calculating dynamic fault propagation attributes, wherein the purpose of the step is that the dynamic propagation attributes are used as input parameters of a conditional probability table in a dynamic Bayesian network. And step four, applying a conditional probability table. And fifthly, applying evidence information, wherein the aim of the step is that the evidence information is used as an input parameter of an evidence node in the dynamic Bayesian network. And step six, evaluating the elasticity reliability. The method fully considers the influence of a fault propagation mechanism and a repair factor, and can evaluate the elastic reliability of any complex equipment.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Hydropower station reportable electric quantity upper and lower limit determining method and system based on cascade reservoir dispatching model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydropower station reportable electric quantity upper and lower limit determining method and system based on a cascade reservoir dispatching model, comprising the following steps of linearizing an electric quantity expression through a mathematical programming algorithm to obtain a linearized electric quantity expression; the method comprises the steps of carrying an expression of the linearized generated energy into a minimum potential generated energy model and a maximum potential generated energy model, obtaining the maximum potential difference between the upper limit and the lower limit of the generated energy of the hydropower station by solving a linear optimization problem, inputting other constraint conditions of long-term dispatching in the hydropower station and the maximum potential difference between the upper limit and the lower limit of the generated energy of the hydropower station as parameters into an actual dispatching generated energy boundary optimization model of the hydropower station, solving an actual dispatching generated energy boundary optimization model of the hydropower station, and outputting the upper limit and the lower limit of the generated energy of the hydropower station in the first month in a dispatching period. The invention provides a basis for reporting the upper and lower limits of the electric quantity when the power grid sets the hydropower station to participate in the electric power market.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Risk domain control method and system based on train formation operation risk cause analysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a risk domain control method and a system based on train formation operation risk cause analysis, which belong to the technical field of train operation control and realize adjacent train state information interaction based on a train-to-train communication technology, wherein a dynamic Bayesian network is utilized to construct a risk situation propagation model and carry out sensitivity analysis and sequencing on each risk node by taking a braking anti-skid system with low efficiency and a formation inter-train communication link failure as risk sources under abnormal weather and taking a formation train collision as an accident result, a nonlinear vibration theory and a Rayleigh equation are utilized to describe vibration characteristics and microscopic evolution processes in the risk situation change, a sensitivity weight value of a node with the largest influence on the occurrence probability of a collision accident is taken as a damping coefficient of the Rayleigh equation, and the relation between a control variable and the damping coefficient is explored based on damping control, so that the risk domain is converged in an initial safety state. The invention can realize the risk domain control oriented to train formation operation from the system level angle.

title_en: Medium-long term plan typical curve decomposition method applicable to cascade hydropower station with multiple power grid load demands
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for decomposing a typical curve of a medium-long-term plan of a cascade hydropower station, which is suitable for multiple power grid load demands, wherein the method is used for determining a decomposition criterion of the typical curve of the medium-long-term plan of the cascade hydropower station by considering the differentiation condition of different provinces, determining the typical output curves of the different provinces of the different power stations by using a flat peak ratio and Gu Fengbi so as to reduce the dimension of a solving problem, determining the income coefficient of the different provinces of the different power stations according to the differentiation condition of the provinces of each receiving end, and finally solving by using an intelligent optimization algorithm so as to obtain the flat peak ratio and the valley peak ratio of the different provinces of the different power stations so as to obtain the typical decomposition curve of the medium-long-term plan. Through the verification analysis of the cascade power station consisting of 4 huge power stations in a river basin in the southwest area, the invention can obtain a reasonable medium-long term plan decomposition curve of the cascade hydropower station suitable for the load demands of multiple power grids, and can effectively respond to the different peak shaving demands of different receiving end provinces and give consideration to the income of the cascade power station.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: LSTM water quality prediction method based on multilayer reverse cell state
abstract_en: The invention provides an LSTM water quality prediction method based on a multi-layer reverse cell state, which is based on big data of the whole sewage treatment process, and does not input all data at one time during model training, but performs data input and verification step by step and step, thereby more effectively capturing the running state of a water plant and fitting the complex biochemical reaction process of the water plant. By introducing back-propagation of the model cell states, the accurate training model captures the operating state of the water plant processing unit. On the basis, the biological treatment layer and the three-stage treatment layer are connected in series through two-layer networks, so that ordered flow of data and deep fusion of information are realized. The biological treatment layer can simulate the biological treatment process in sewage treatment, and the three-stage treatment layer simulates further advanced treatment so as to predict the water quality of the effluent. Through the improvement of the series structure and the reverse propagation path, the invention not only improves the adaptability of the model to the complexity of the sewage treatment process, but also enhances the accuracy of the prediction result.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING FORESTRY

title_en: Information propagation prediction method, system and medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of network information processing, and discloses an information propagation prediction method, an information propagation prediction system and a medium. The prediction method comprises the steps of constructing entity attributes and state variables according to topic propagation data in a social network, respectively constructing corresponding differential propagation dynamics equations and cellular automata based on the entity attributes and the state variables, analyzing stability and parameter sensitivity of a propagation state vector field according to the propagation dynamics equations, and analyzing propagation network structures and entity differences through cellular automata simulation. The invention solves the challenges in the traditional information propagation dynamics simulation, namely, realizes the stability analysis of the propagation state of the macroscopic population and the differential analysis of the propagation capacity of the microscopic entity while ensuring the grasping of the propagation trend of the macroscopic level and the effective mapping of the individual propagation behavior characteristics of the microscopic level, and provides a reliable tool for accurately analyzing the evolution trend of the information propagation.

title_en: Multi-gradient mountain wireless channel modeling method combining digital elevation model and ray tracing
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-gradient mountain wireless channel modeling method combining a digital elevation model and ray tracing, and belongs to the field of wireless communication. The unmanned aerial vehicle base station is used for assisting communication, and is suitable for rapidly deploying an efficient communication network in natural disasters or emergency events. The real mountain environment with different slopes and the acquired mountain slope can be established through the digital elevation model, and the signal propagation path and the propagation characteristics of the acquired signals can be predicted through a ray tracing method. The modeling method comprises the steps of firstly establishing a real mountain scene, extracting mountain gradient, then obtaining channel model parameters, analyzing channel characteristics, and finally adjusting transmitter parameters according to channel characteristic data to realize multi-gradient mountain wireless channel modeling. The modeling method provided by the invention has the main ideas that the channel model is analyzed through accurate topographic data and channel characteristic data, and the reliability of the wireless communication system is improved through adjusting parameters. Design suggestions are provided for emergency communication and technical innovation.
assignees: UNIV KUNMING SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Public opinion evolution analysis model integrating network playing and opinion dynamics and establishment method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a public opinion evolution analysis model integrating network playing and viewpoint dynamics and an establishment method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of social network analysis. The public opinion evolution analysis model combines the social network chess and the opinion dynamics theory, builds a public opinion evolution mathematical model (POEM) according to the related theory in the social science while considering more comprehensive factors, realizes scientific simulation of psychological activities of individuals in the public opinion propagation process, breaks through two major limitations of single behavior statistics and lack of behavior characterization in the opinion dynamics model in the traditional network game model, and utilizes the uncertainty mathematical theory to characterize psychological movement and decision behaviors of the social individuals in the public opinion evolution process, thereby more accurately describing the influence of the individual propagation behaviors on the social public opinion evolution.

title_en: Flexible power supply system and method based on photovoltaic energy storage
abstract_en: The application discloses a flexible power supply system and a method based on photovoltaic energy storage, which are characterized in that a time sequence analysis is carried out on historical power generation capacity and historical weather data of a photovoltaic power station by adopting an artificial intelligence technology based on deep learning, a time sequence dynamic change mode of the historical power generation capacity and the historical weather data in a global time domain is respectively captured by a local time sequence feature extraction and feature time sequence propagation aggregation mechanism, and a nonlinear association relation between the power generation capacity and weather conditions is excavated by carrying out multi-scale interactive response analysis on the historical power generation capacity and the historical weather data, so that decoding prediction of the photovoltaic power generation capacity is carried out. Therefore, the prediction accuracy can be effectively improved, complex and changeable weather conditions can be better adapted, and the requirements of the modern intelligent power grid on accurate prediction and efficient management are met.
assignees: HENAN FIVEWIN ARCH DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Method, system and storage medium for lightening power scheduling model under meta-universe
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method, a system and a storage medium for lightening a power scheduling model under a metauniverse, which comprise the following steps of carrying out intelligent data reduction on a three-dimensional model based on a self-adaptive face-reduction compression technology of deep learning by combining an advanced texture mapping and curve thinning algorithm so as to optimize model details and reduce data quantity, simultaneously keeping key characteristics, dynamically adjusting display details of the power grid model according to the visual angle of an observer through cascade loading and visual rejection of the power grid, realizing model resource management and dynamic scheduling by asynchronous loading and rendering, and realizing quick loading and rendering of the model by applying a multi-detail level technology and a progressive loading technology by combining an intelligent preloading and prediction mechanism, and realizing fine resource allocation and detail management. The invention can realize the light-weight processing of the power dispatching meta-universe three-dimensional model and achieve the aims of real-time efficient rendering and rapid interaction of meteorological data, power grid operation information and plant station equipment models.
assignees: STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;BEIJING YONGSHANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wind-solar-load multi-stage scene tree generation method based on source-load uncertainty feature extraction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a source load uncertainty feature extraction-based wind-light load multi-stage scene tree generation method which comprises the steps of extracting wind-light load scene features based on a constructed stacked sparse self-encoder model to obtain a wind-light load scene feature set, clustering the wind-light load scene feature set based on a density peak value improved neighbor propagation algorithm to obtain a wind-light load typical day curve serving as a root node of a scene tree, generating the wind-light load scene tree year by year based on different load growth modes according to the root node of the scene tree, and reducing the scene tree by a Sinkhorn-distance scene tree reduction method to reduce the scale of the scene tree. The wind-solar-load multi-stage scene tree generated by the method can reflect the time sequence information of the new energy output and the load, represents the randomness and the fluctuation of the new energy output and the load, can reflect the uncertainty of the long-term growth of the new energy output and the load, and has important significance for planning and building a power grid.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI

title_en: System for realizing national standard superior service disaster recovery fast recovery by utilizing Redis record cascade and equipment information
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for realizing a national standard superior service disaster recovery rapid recovery system by using Redis record cascade and equipment information, which comprises the steps of constructing a Redis storage management system to record the cascade and the equipment information, and rapidly judging recovery links or waiting to register on line according to the Redis information when the service is restarted abnormally. The first time of searching the shared equipment information adopts multithreading to put in storage, so that the efficiency is improved. And comparing the Redis with the reported information at the time of secondary retrieval, performing difference processing, and checking consistency at fixed time. The lower level searches the resource information to the upper level synchronously, and by means of the Kafka component, the database and the Redis are accurately operated according to the information content, so that the data synchronization is ensured to be complete in time. The steps work cooperatively, so that the problems that the conventional national standard cascade service realizes disaster recovery and quick recovery when facing various emergency conditions such as service faults, network anomalies and the like, improves the overall performance, disaster recovery capacity and data accuracy, and meets the requirements of a video monitoring system on efficient, stable and reliable operation and accurate resource sharing are solved.
assignees: HANGZHOU ARGES TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method, system, equipment and storage medium for associating electric power safety knowledge
abstract_en: The invention relates to a correlation method, a system, equipment and a storage medium of electric power safety knowledge, which comprise the following steps of obtaining multi-dimensional data of electric power safety knowledge, fusing the multi-dimensional data to obtain electric power safety knowledge fusion data, carrying out map modeling based on the electric power safety knowledge fusion data to obtain an electric power safety knowledge map, obtaining electric power fault information, carrying out fault correlation analysis on the electric power fault information based on the electric power safety knowledge map to obtain an electric power fault propagation path, carrying out causal relation mining on the electric power fault propagation path to obtain electric power fault equipment and an induction mechanism corresponding to the electric power fault equipment, carrying out influence range analysis on the electric power network equipment based on the induction mechanism to obtain an influence power network area range, and formulating a management strategy corresponding to equipment in the influence power network area range, thereby solving the technical problem that comprehensive analysis and prediction cannot be timely and accurately carried out when complex electric power faults are faced.
assignees: DONGGUAN POWER BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Lifesaving guidance illumination line management system based on multi-network converged communication search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of life-saving illumination lines, in particular to a life-saving guiding illumination line management system based on multi-network fusion communication search and rescue, which comprises a processing planning module, a matching risk detection module, an interface stability monitoring module and a management terminal; the invention integrates the communication means of private network and public network by adopting a multimode fusion communication mode combining wired and wireless, realizes short-range and long-range command scheduling and supports multi-hop cascade relay forwarding, acquires all the component devices of the life-saving guide illumination line to be installed by the processing planning module, analyzes the availability of all the component devices, and judges the matching risk of all the component devices by the matching risk detection module when the component devices corresponding to low availability signals do not exist, thereby being beneficial to ensuring the use safety and stability of the installed life-saving guide illumination line, reducing the use management difficulty of the life-saving guide illumination line and having high intelligent degree.
assignees: NANJING ZHENGZE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-heat source cooperative heat supply energy cascade utilization optimization method
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-heat source cooperative heat supply energy cascade utilization optimization method. The multi-heat source energy cascade control method based on the heat load demand gap is established by orderly combining four energy supply forms of a heat supply secondary network, a ground source, a water source and an air source, the multi-energy heat supply control system based on an autonomous controllable hardware architecture is used for realizing multi-stage optimal utilization of heat supply energy, the dependence degree on a single heat source is reduced to the greatest extent, the diversification of heat supply carriers is obviously promoted, and a new clean energy heat supply mode is realized.

title_en: Quantitative evaluation method, device, terminal and medium for overhead transmission line channel safety
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quantitative evaluation method, a quantitative evaluation device, a terminal and a medium for the safety of an overhead transmission line channel, wherein the method comprises the following steps of establishing a three-layer physical system model of the overhead transmission line channel; the method comprises the steps of carrying out system failure analysis based on a three-layer secondary physical system model of an overhead transmission line channel, establishing an overall failure model of the overhead transmission line channel, establishing an overhead transmission line channel safety evaluation model based on the overall failure analysis model of the overhead transmission line channel, and carrying out quantitative evaluation on the safety of the overhead transmission line channel to be evaluated by utilizing the overhead transmission line channel safety evaluation model. The invention considers the influence of failure damage of different elements and cascade failure of a plurality of lines in the overhead transmission channel on the safe and stable operation of the whole channel, and can accurately evaluate the safety degree of the overhead transmission channel, thereby providing more reliable scientific basis and technical support for the safe operation and maintenance management of the power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV CHONGQING;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Water diversion serial cascade power station scheduling method based on real-time cooperative fault response model
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of optimal scheduling of hydropower stations and discloses a scheduling method of a diversion serial cascade power station based on a real-time collaborative fault response model, which aims to solve the problem that the stability of a power grid is affected in the existing scheduling scheme, and mainly comprises the steps of constructing an objective function and constraint conditions of planned load and actual output of the diversion serial cascade power station, and constructing a mixed quadratic programming model according to the objective function and the constraint conditions to obtain the real-time collaborative fault response model of the diversion serial cascade power station; and solving a real-time collaborative fault response model by utilizing a solver based on the boundary conditions to obtain the planned output of each generator set, and carrying out real-time scheduling on the diversion serial cascade power station according to the planned output of each generator set. The application improves the dispatching accuracy of the diversion cascade power station and the stability of the power grid.

title_en: Operation and maintenance management method and system for railway power supply and distribution
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of railway power supply and distribution, in particular to an operation and maintenance management method and system for railway power supply and distribution, which are used for solving the problem of low operation and maintenance management efficiency caused by poor accuracy of fault identification and positioning. The method comprises the steps of receiving equipment operation data of a railway power supply and distribution system acquired by a sensor network through the Internet of things, inputting the data into a pre-trained pattern neural network model, identifying fault equipment identification and fault modes, determining a target fault propagation path according to the fault equipment identification, the fault modes and a multi-level power supply and distribution knowledge graph, wherein the multi-level power supply and distribution knowledge graph comprises an equipment-level knowledge graph, a regional-level knowledge graph and a system-level knowledge graph which are mutually related, predicting fault severity according to the target fault propagation path by adopting a fault severity assessment model, determining a corresponding operation and maintenance management report, and carrying out corresponding processing according to the operation and maintenance management report. The technical scheme provided by the invention improves the efficiency of operation and maintenance management.
assignees: FIRST ENG CO LTD OF CHINA RAILWAY ELECTRIFICATION BUREAU GROUP

title_en: Emergency communication optimization method for low-orbit satellite heterogeneous network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency communication optimization method for a low-orbit satellite heterogeneous network. The method comprises the steps of calculating the propagation loss of a communication link in a low-orbit satellite heterogeneous network and the gain in the line array direction, calculating the intensity ratio of a received signal and a signal to interference plus noise of a ground terminal, optimizing the transmitting power of a ground base station to maximize the energy efficiency of the low-orbit satellite and the ground network, solving the optimizing problem of the transmitting power through a continuous convex approximation algorithm, and introducing regularization factors to the optimizing problem of the transmitting power and the limiting condition thereof. According to the invention, the antenna array radiation gains of the satellite base station and the ground base station and the signal transmission path length are respectively calculated, and the energy efficiency maximization of the whole network is realized by adjusting the transmitting power, the beam forming strategy and the resource allocation through an optimization algorithm based on the channel complex impulse response function expression and the path loss characteristic.
assignees: NANJING CHINA SPACENET SATELLITE TELECOM CO LTD

title_en: Alarm broadcasting system based on fm signals
title_ko: Fm신호를 기반으로 하는 경보 방송 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system including a disaster warning device based on FM (Frequency Modulation) frequency, which is spaced apart from a predetermined distance from an event location on a road. The system includes a main device connected to the disaster warning device and connected to be capable of communicating with a network; and the disaster warning device including first to nth directional transmission antennas based on FM. The present invention can prevent accidents in advance by clearly transmitting to vehicles a dangerous situation in a tunnel and a situation in a foggy area using an FM frequency band starting from a point 500 m from a tunnel entrance and a foggy area.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도로의 이벤트 위치로부터 미리 설정된 거리에 이격 배치되는 FM(Frequency Modulation) 주파수를 기반으로 하는 재난경보장치를 포함하는 시스템으로서, 상기 재난경보장치와 연결되며, 네트워크와 통신 가능하도록 연결된 메인장치; 및 FM을 기반으로 하는 제1 내지 제n 지향성 송신안테나를 포함하는 상기 재난경보장치; 를 포함하고, 상기 재난경보장치는, 미리 설정된 FM 주파수 대역으로 각각 구성된 제1 내지 제m 채널의 외부방송신호를 수신하는 FM 수신안테나; 상기 FM 수신안테나를 통해 수신된 상기 제1 내지 제m 채널에 대한 외부방송신호의 전파세기를 측정하는 전파감지부; 및 상기 이벤트에 대한 미리 설정된 음성신호를 FM 주파수로 변조하여 경보방송신호를 출력하는 전파출력부로서, 상기 제1 내지 제m 채널 각각의 전파세기보다 더 큰 전파세기를 독립적으로 출력하도록 상기 채널별 이득을 조정하고, 조정된 상기 이득을 기반으로 상기 제1 내지 제m 채널에 경보방송신호를 상기 외부방송신호에 겹쳐서 출력하는, 전파출력부; 를 포함하는, 시스템을 제공한다.
assignees: Ims co ltd;KISAN TELECOM CORP

title_en: NOx emission prediction method based on physical neural network ensemble learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a NOx emission prediction method based on physical neural network ensemble learning, which comprises the following steps of 1, establishing a physical prediction model according to a physical rule generated by diesel engine NOx, 2, collecting test data by using a diesel engine bench, carrying out data normalization on the collected data, training a feed-forward neural network by using normalization data to obtain a neural network prediction model by adopting a back propagation method, 3, fusing the physical prediction model of the step 1 and the neural network prediction model of the step 2 by a method of constructing a fusion loss function, constructing the physical neural network prediction model, training the physical neural network prediction model by adopting a back propagation method, and 4, fusing the models of the steps 1-3 by adopting an ensemble learning combination strategy to obtain an ensemble learning model, and predicting the emission amount of NOx by using the ensemble learning model. The method has higher prediction accuracy, and reduces the cost and difficulty of data collection.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: Port group toughness assessment method, device, equipment, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of shipping networks, and discloses a port group toughness assessment method, a port group toughness assessment device, port group toughness assessment equipment, a port group toughness assessment storage medium and a port group toughness assessment program product. The method comprises the steps of collecting port and route information, constructing a port group shipping network based on hypergraph, taking each port and each ship as an intelligent body, constructing a port group shipping ABM model based on the port group shipping network, simulating a response mechanism and a dynamic evolution process of the port group shipping network under normal conditions and risk events to obtain network density and strong communication branch quantity at different moments, ship quantity in a waiting state and cargo delay time corresponding to each ship, constructing toughness indexes from three dimensions of structure, operation and service, and further calculating the port group toughness value. According to the method, the hypergraph theory is combined with the intelligent agent simulation, so that the influence propagation process of the risk event on the port group shipping network is more truly described, the toughness value is calculated based on multiple dimensions, and the accuracy of port group toughness assessment is improved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU MARITIME INST

title_en: Satellite operation risk quantitative evaluation model construction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a satellite operation risk quantification evaluation model construction method which comprises the steps of constructing an event tree model of a satellite, constructing a fault tree of the satellite, converting the satellite fault tree model into a satellite operation risk quantification evaluation model by using a Bayesian network modeling tool according to the serial-parallel connection relation of events in the fault tree model of the satellite, setting the states of all nodes in the satellite operation risk quantification evaluation model according to the single-machine on-orbit fault type and the cascade relation of the nodes in the satellite operation risk quantification evaluation model, and setting a condition probability table according to the serial-parallel connection logic relation of the nodes with connection relation according to the AND gate or OR gate relation of each event in the fault tree model of the satellite.
assignees: CHINA AEROSPACE STANDARDIZATION INST

title_en: Asset and project management platform for service industries
abstract_en: An asset and project management platform for field service industries includes a delegation of work hierarchy having a pool of field service industry providers for performing a field service build out, upgrade, or repair of a new or an existing infrastructure is disclosed. Work orders and corresponding data files are associated with the pool of field service industry providers and the field service build out, upgrade, or repair of the new or existing infrastructure. A data file management system provides data cascading and reverse cascading protocols and permissions for information exchange of data files across the delegation of work hierarchy. The platforms include labor, materials and the application of labor and materials management systems for organizing labor, materials, and the application of labor and materials for the field service build out, upgrade, or repair of the new or existing infrastructure corresponding to one or more work orders.
assignees: HELLCAT TECH INC

title_en: TimesNet-Crossformer-LSTM-based short-term power load prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-term power load prediction method based on TimesNet-Crossformer-LSTM, which comprises the steps of 1) screening features of an imported data set, normalizing selected features, 2) dividing a training set, a verification set and a test set, inputting the training set and the verification set into a model for training, 3) extracting information from an input time sequence by the model, extracting a relation between a period and a period in the time sequence, 4) adjusting parameters of a neural network by adopting an Adam algorithm, training the network by utilizing back propagation, evaluating training effects of model parameters by observing loss values on the verification set, 5) selecting tanshark as an activation function of the model according to an ablation experiment result, 6) inputting the test set into the trained model, obtaining a point prediction result, and evaluating the model prediction effect by four evaluation indexes. Compared with the prior art, the method has higher precision in the short-term power load prediction task.

title_en: Mine emergency communication system
abstract_en: The invention provides a mine emergency communication system which comprises network management equipment, a downlink laser communication access device, a cascade laser communication device, an uplink laser communication access device and the like, wherein the network management equipment is used for establishing a communication network, and the downlink laser communication access device is communicated with the uplink laser communication access device in a laser wireless mode under the relay support of the cascade laser communication device, so that a laser wireless backbone communication link is established, and communication service is provided for underground wireless terminal equipment. The system has the advantages of high bandwidth of a wired communication system and easy deployment of a wireless multi-hop network communication system, solves the problems of low bandwidth, short distance and the like of the conventional wireless multi-hop network emergency communication system, can be widely applied to coal mines and non-coal mines, and has important application value in the aspects of improving the technical level of mine emergency communication, improving the mine disaster rescue efficiency, reducing casualties and property loss and the like.

title_en: Unmanned intelligent patrol equipment cooperative scheduling method and system in photovoltaic power generation scene
abstract_en: The invention provides a cooperative scheduling method and a system for unmanned intelligent patrol equipment in a photovoltaic power generation scene, which relate to the technical field of intelligent patrol of photovoltaic power stations and comprise the following steps: task priority classification and time sequence association analysis are carried out based on a dynamic self-adaptive neural network and a sequence predictor, a task dependency graph is constructed, a candidate task allocation scheme is generated based on a deep reinforcement learning framework, the candidate scheme is optimized by combining a collaborative decision system constructed by a multi-objective genetic algorithm and a graph injection force mechanism with the aim of minimizing the completion time, energy consumption and maximizing the coverage rate, the task allocation constraint is updated by utilizing a confidence propagation network, abnormal conditions are judged by a Bayesian inference algorithm, and finally an optimal scheduling scheme is output, so that the inspection efficiency of the photovoltaic power station can be effectively improved, the energy consumption is reduced, and the inspection coverage rate is improved.

title_en: Output distribution method and system for economic operation of hydropower station
abstract_en: The application discloses an output distribution method and system for economic operation of a hydropower station, comprising the following steps of S1, obtaining a 96-point power generation plan of each step power station in a whole factory and water level information of a source reservoir, searching a reservoir flow-optimal output relation curve according to the water level of a superior reservoir or a drainage basin at the current level of the hydropower station, S2, searching the optimal output flow of the current level of the hydropower station according to the output of the given superior power station and the output flow-optimal output relation curve of the current reservoir level, S3, obtaining Mao Shuitou of the hydropower station at the current output flow of the hydropower station according to the water level of the reservoir and the output flow, and S4, obtaining the flow and the output of each unit of the current hydropower station. The application can obtain the optimal operation solution of the cascade hydroelectric generating set, effectively ensure the stable and safe operation of the hydropower station and the power grid, fully reduce the energy consumption and improve the energy utilization efficiency.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power station key equipment temperature prediction method based on multi-source heterogeneous data fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power station equipment temperature prediction, and provides a power station key equipment temperature prediction method based on multi-source heterogeneous data fusion, which comprises the following steps of collecting multi-source heterogeneous data of a hydropower station, preprocessing the multi-source heterogeneous data, extracting features, selecting features and fusing the features to obtain temperature prediction fusion features; the method comprises the steps of performing super-parameter optimization on an initial back propagation neural network through an improved underwater foraging optimization algorithm to obtain an optimized back propagation neural network, inputting temperature prediction fusion characteristics into the optimized back propagation neural network to obtain a temperature prediction value, comparing the temperature prediction value with a temperature actual value, and generating a temperature prediction table when the error of the temperature prediction value is in a preset range. The method can find out temperature abnormality in time, is beneficial to early warning of equipment faults, generates the temperature prediction table, is suitable for processing complex multi-source heterogeneous data, and enhances the accuracy of temperature prediction.
assignees: UNIV WUHAN TECH

title_en: Multi-dimensional grid service package gridding configuration and positioning synchronization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-dimensional grid service package gridding configuration and positioning synchronization method, which relates to the technical field of data processing, and comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of grid service packages, collecting on-site multi-mode information, carrying out dynamic parameter configuration after determining an operation and maintenance scene, and establishing a plurality of gridding configuration spaces; the method comprises the steps of constructing a configuration evaluation module based on multidimensional evaluation factors, introducing propagation constraint functions, optimizing and optimizing a configuration space by combining the evaluation module, carrying out accurate parameter configuration on a power grid service package based on an optimizing result, and realizing positioning synchronization. The method solves the technical problems of lack of flexibility, insufficient equipment cooperation and slow response of the traditional power grid service package configuration method in the prior art when facing complex operation and maintenance scenes, and achieves the technical effects of improving the operation and maintenance efficiency, resource utilization and emergency response capability of the power grid through power grid service package configuration optimization based on multidimensional evaluation factors.
assignees: BEIJING CHINA POWER INF TECH;NANJING YUNAN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Novel physical information neural network for solving seismic wave equation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake engineering, in particular to a novel physical information neural network (gs-PINN) for solving a seismic wave equation, which comprises the steps of establishing the novel physical information neural network, dividing configuration points required by network training, determining the form of incident waves, developing network training, namely acquiring a solution of a one-dimensional seismic wave fluctuation equation, wherein the first layer of hidden layer of each sub-network is composed of two sub-networks, the parameters of which are untrainable parameters, the values of which are determined by the propagation direction of the seismic wave, and the rest parameters are trainable parameters, so that the network can automatically meet the one-dimensional seismic wave fluctuation equation, the network is effectively prevented from being trapped into local optimum, the training difficulty is greatly reduced, and a powerful technical support is provided for solving the one-dimensional seismic wave fluctuation equation.
assignees: HARBIN INST TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Power grid fault cascading identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power systems, in particular to a power grid fault linkage identification method and a system, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring alarm information and WAMS synchronous measurement data in a power grid; and carrying out relevance analysis on fault events among a plurality of fault events generating alarm information by utilizing the rule base based on the power grid topology model and WAMS synchronous measurement data, wherein the relevance analysis comprises at least one of a time type, a space type and an electrical type, and the rule base records the causal relationship among the fault events.
assignees: BEIJING SIFANG ENG CO LTD;BEIJING SIFANG AUTOMATION CO

title_en: Controllable scene generation method based on countermeasure network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a controllable scene generation method based on an countermeasure network, which solves the defects of the prior art and comprises the following steps of 1, collecting new energy power generation historical time sequence data as a training set, constructing a latent space input on a construction manifold to optimize historical data, wherein the latent space input comprises a control vector c and a random noise vector z with characteristic indexes with interpretable physical meanings, 2, generating the countermeasure network through iterative training, sequentially training a generator G, a discriminator D and an auxiliary network Q through a counter propagation optimization algorithm in each iterative round until reaching convergence criteria, and 3, adjusting the control vector c along one or more interpretable characteristics in the process of generating the countermeasure network to realize controllable scene generation.
assignees: ZHEJIANG BADA ELECT INSTR CO LTD

title_en: Electromagnetic transient fault analysis method, device and equipment based on large model
abstract_en: The application discloses an electromagnetic transient fault analysis method, device and equipment based on a large model, wherein the method comprises the steps of preprocessing real-time operation information obtained from a power grid to obtain time sequence operation information, carrying out fault reasoning analysis according to the time sequence operation information based on a preset fault analysis large model and a thinking chain technology to obtain a fault analysis result, wherein the fault analysis result comprises a fault position, a fault type and a fault root cause, and analyzing the cascading effect of faults according to a space-time feedback reasoning chain in the preset fault analysis large model by combining power grid topological structure information and the fault analysis result to obtain a fault influence analysis result. The method and the device can solve the technical problems that the analysis precision is insufficient, the calculated amount is large, and the influence analysis and evaluation are difficult to carry out aiming at various faults of different types in the prior art.

title_en: Building body flexible regulation potential prediction method
abstract_en: A building body flexible regulation potential prediction method includes the steps of building a building group energy consumption model based on a back propagation neural network, enabling each energy consumption system sub-model to take characteristic data of influence parameters of energy consumption of each energy consumption system as input, enabling the power saving rate of the corresponding energy consumption system to be the maximum first-stage optimization target, outputting energy consumption prediction values of each energy consumption system under different time periods, adopting a distributed entropy improved self-adaptive grid searching particle swarm method, enabling the power saving rate of a building group to be the maximum second-stage optimization target, determining energy consumption prediction minimum values of each energy consumption system under different time periods, utilizing the extreme value of each energy consumption system and the deviation of the power saving rate of the building group to update the energy consumption prediction minimum values, enabling the energy consumption prediction minimum values of each energy consumption system under different time periods to be spliced according to time sequence to serve as building group energy consumption prediction values, enabling the difference between the building group energy consumption actual values and the building group energy consumption prediction values to be the ratio in the building group energy consumption actual values, and enabling accurate prediction to be achieved.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID SHANGHAI COMPREHENSIVE ENERGY SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Industrial chain risk assessment method and system based on co-occurrence emotion and graph annotation meaning force
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic industrial chain risk assessment method and a system based on co-occurrence emotion and graph annotation meaning force, wherein the method comprises the steps of generating a co-occurrence relation graph, extracting co-occurrence emotion to obtain co-occurrence emotion scores, and aggregating multi-dimensional characteristics of neighbor nodes through a graph annotation meaning mechanism to obtain multi-dimensional characteristic embedded representation of enterprise nodes; and carrying out binary risk classification on the industrial chain company nodes by utilizing a new risk embedding representation after the neural network model is combined with the co-occurrence emotion score adjustment, so as to realize dynamic evaluation on the industrial chain risks. The invention provides real-time insight on information such as enterprise reputation, market emotion and the like through co-occurrence emotion analysis, and the attention mechanism strengthens recognition of a key risk propagation path, thereby improving sensitivity and accuracy of risk assessment. And learning expression of the industrial chain state-owned enterprise industrial node co-occurrence relationship, efficient calculation of co-occurrence emotion scores, timely capturing of risks and dynamic evaluation of industrial chain node risks are realized.
assignees: SICHUAN HOMWEE TECHNOLOGY CO

title_en: Distribution network and micro-grid distributed collaborative planning method and system based on improved target cascading analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed collaborative planning method and system for a power distribution network and a micro-grid based on an improved target cascading analysis method. The method comprises the steps of taking the topology and safety constraint of a power distribution network into consideration, taking the minimum total cost of the power distribution network planning as a target, establishing an upper-layer power distribution network planning model, taking the aggregate capacity of a micro-grid to various internal resources into consideration, taking the minimum total planning cost of the micro-grid as a target, establishing a lower-layer multi-micro-grid planning model, and solving a micro-grid collaborative planning model by adopting an improved target cascade analysis method. Aiming at the power grid planning problem in the future multi-planning main body background, the invention plays a role in integrating various distributed energy sources by the micro-grid, coordinates planning resources of the micro-grid and the power distribution network, and reduces the planning cost of each planning main body. The method has the advantages that the power generation resources in the power distribution network and the micro-grid can be reasonably planned, collaborative planning is realized only by a small amount of information on the premise that global equipment information is not needed, the privacy of information of each planning main body is protected, and meanwhile, the economy of each planning main body scheme is improved.

title_en: Data analysis method and system for multi-energy complementary power distribution system based on deep learning
abstract_en: According to the deep learning-based multi-energy complementary power distribution system data analysis method, firstly, preprocessing and feature extraction are carried out on multi-source heterogeneous sensor data, and key indexes reflecting the health state of equipment are obtained. And then obtaining the globally consistent equipment state representation through a space-time data fusion technology. And then constructing a multi-fault mode knowledge base, and identifying fault types by adopting a multi-label classification algorithm of deep learning. And finally, establishing a mapping relation between the equipment topological structure and the fault propagation path by using an attention mechanism and a graph rolling network, and deducing the specific position of equipment breakage through fault tracing and influence analysis. The invention also adopts methods such as data enhancement, transfer learning and the like to improve the robustness and generalization capability of the model, and realizes real-time and reliable fault positioning through edge calculation. The method can accurately locate equipment faults in the multi-energy complementary power distribution system, and improves the reliability and safety of the system.
assignees: SHAANXI HUATIAN JUNENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Heterogeneous monitoring data fusion method in photovoltaic power station based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep learning-based heterogeneous monitoring data fusion method in a photovoltaic power station, which comprises the following steps of 1, obtaining system operation data of the photovoltaic power station system and various heterogeneous monitoring data in the power station, deleting erroneous data in the system operation data, carrying out denoising treatment, 2, carrying out variance automatic weighting treatment on the various heterogeneous monitoring data in the power station, carrying out weight adjustment on the various heterogeneous monitoring data according to the importance of the monitoring data, and 3, inputting the processed various heterogeneous monitoring data into a deep learning algorithm LSTM circulating neural network according to the front-back sequence, training a loss function in the deep learning algorithm, and then setting network parameter setting in the LSTM circulating neural network by using back propagation, so as to obtain a deep learning model for data fusion.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD;CHANGDIAN XINNENG CO LTD;NANJING NARI RELAYS ENG TECH

title_en: Prediction method of internal magnetic field of aluminum electrolysis cell based on physical information network PINN
abstract_en: The invention discloses a prediction method of an internal magnetic field of an aluminum electrolysis cell based on a physical information network PINN, which comprises the following steps of inputting relevant data of a magnetic field to be predicted into a trained PINN model and outputting prediction data, wherein the specific content of constructing the trained PINN model comprises S1, constructing a physical model of an internal magnetic field of a target aluminum electrolysis cell, S2, constructing a PINN model, constructing a loss function according to the physical model of the internal magnetic field of the target aluminum electrolysis cell, calculating physical loss in a reverse propagation process through iterative training and reverse propagation through the loss function, finishing training if preset conditions are met, and obtaining a PINN model for predicting the internal magnetic field of the target, and S3, finishing verification of the PINN model to obtain the trained PINN model.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA DATANG INT HOHHOT ALUMINUM & POWER CO LTD;UNIV HUNAN

title_en: Typical adjustable resource optimization method and system for power grid adjustment scene
abstract_en: A typical adjustable resource optimization method and system for a power grid adjustment scene comprises the steps of carrying out step extraction on operation data according to historical operation data of different adjustable resources, setting typical scene response characteristics according to response characteristic differences of the adjustable resources in different power grid adjustment scenes, constructing an adjustable resource response potential evaluation index system for the power grid adjustment scenes and calculating various evaluation indexes, constructing an adjustable resource comprehensive evaluation model according to matching degree differences of multi-type adjustable resource response characteristics and power grid adjustment requirements, realizing comprehensive evaluation of the adjustable resource response potential in a specific scene, adopting a combined evaluation and neighbor propagation algorithm to carry out rapid grouping and optimization on the adjustable resources according to the combination of the adjustable resource response characteristic combination and the comprehensive evaluation model, realizing classification and optimization of adjustable resource groups with different response potentials, and analyzing user demand response potentials and optimizing energy management and demand response strategies according to classification and optimization results.
assignees: NANJING UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY;ELECTRIC POWER RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Multi-time-scale operation scheduling method for power grid considering pumping storage and step hydropower
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems and discloses a power grid multi-time scale operation scheduling method considering pumping storage and cascade hydropower, which comprises the following steps of S1, deducing bidirectional coupling relations of different time scales by considering the characteristics of a pumped storage multi-basin cascade hydropower station; the method comprises the steps of S2, constructing a annual scheduling model, a pericycle scheduling model and a daily scheduling model, S3, establishing a robust optimal scheduling strategy based on a confidence interval, and S4, outputting a scheduling scheme through the robust optimal scheduling strategy of the confidence interval. The invention has the advantages that each index of the long time scale plan and the short time scale plan can be considered, the two-way coupling relation of different time scales is considered, and simultaneously, the peak regulation requirements in the week and the day are ensured, so that the multiple targets of power supply protection, consumption protection and economy are achieved.
assignees: CHANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;SICHUAN ENERGY INTERNET RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF TSINGHUA UNIV

title_en: Cascade reservoir dispatching method based on dynamic planning combined gradual optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cascade reservoir dispatching method based on a dynamic programming joint gradual optimization algorithm, which fully considers the characteristics of close cascade hydraulic connection and complex relation in the cascade power station dispatching process, establishes an objective function based on different dispatching situations such as water dispatching process, total dispatching amount and the like, considers demands such as drainage basin self water dispatching, cross drainage basin dispatching, power station utilization and the like, considers cascade hydropower station group water supply and power generation joint optimization dispatching restriction to determine constraint conditions, adopts the dynamic programming joint gradual optimization algorithm to solve and select an optimal dispatching scheme, can more scientifically, accurately and efficiently dispatch a drainage basin cascade power station, provide higher-quality and stable power supply for a power grid, improve the power generation income of a hydropower development company and support the actual production operation of a cascade hydropower station.
assignees: UNIV JIANGSU;CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;CHANGAN UNIV

title_en: Load prediction adjusting method and device of combined cycle power generation system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a load prediction adjusting method and device of a combined cycle power generation system, belongs to the technical field of combined cycle power generation, and solves the problems that when the traditional method processes unit data, an LSTM neural network model is poor in self-adaption and cannot avoid gradient dispersion on the unit data; the load prediction model is constructed by combining the group intelligent algorithm and the back propagation neural network, has the advantages of processing time sequence working parameters by the group intelligent algorithm and the back propagation neural network, can accurately output the load curve of the combined cycle power generation system in the next period, and provides a basis for distributed adjustment of the combined cycle power generation system.
assignees: XIAN THERMAL POWER RES INST CO;HUANENG JILIN POWER GENERATION CO LTD JIUTAI ELECTRIC FACTORY;HUANENG GUANGDONG ENERGY DEV CO LTD;HUANENG GROUP TECH INNOVATION CENTER CO LTD

title_en: N/N-1 power flow embedded graph convolution neural network-based operation mode power flow coupling relation characterization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an operation mode power flow coupling relation characterization method based on an N/N-1 power flow embedded graph convolution neural network, which comprises the following steps of 1) providing a graph convolution forward propagation strategy based on N/N-1 power flow embedded graph convolution, deducing a design graph convolution module forward propagation expression by an N/N-1 power flow physical model, 2) constructing a neural network architecture based on cooperation of a plurality of layers of graph convolution and convolution modules, and 3) training to obtain an operation mode power flow coupling relation model to characterize a power flow coupling relation in an N/N-1 state of a power system. The power flow coupling relation model of the operation mode constructed by the invention can represent the power flow coupling relation in the N/N-1 state with high precision, so that the key problems of fault diagnosis, stability evaluation, optimal control and the like in the power system can be analyzed later.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING;INST ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCES STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: New energy output medium-long term random scene generation method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for generating a medium-long-term random scene of new energy output, and belongs to the field of power grid operation scheduling. The method for generating the medium-long term random scene in the new energy output comprises the steps of reducing dimensions of a historical daily scene to extract significant features of the historical daily scene, clustering a historical day show scene significant feature set by adopting a neighbor propagation clustering algorithm, dividing the generated day show scenes into corresponding clusters, simulating evolution characteristics among different categories of the daily scene based on a Markov chain, and generating the medium-long term random scene through Monte Carlo simulation. The invention can accurately fit the probability distribution, time sequence characteristics and spatial correlation of the medium-long term scene of the new energy output, and can provide effective data support for the medium-long term power transaction and operation mode formulation.
assignees: UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH

title_en: Intelligent building operation and maintenance management system and method based on BIM platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent building management, in particular to an intelligent building operation and maintenance management system and method based on a BIM platform. The method comprises the steps of constructing a device connection topology network according to acquired target BIM building model data to generate device physical connection topology data, automatically removing logic conflict of the device physical connection topology data to generate device connection topology data, analyzing fault influence links of the device connection topology data to generate fault propagation link data, evaluating fault severity of the fault propagation link data to generate device fault severity data, and performing intelligent operation and maintenance path planning according to the device fault severity data to obtain intelligent device operation and maintenance path data. According to the invention, through the fine division of the operation and maintenance equipment management space and the analysis of the equipment fault propagation link, the intelligent scheduling of fault operation and maintenance tasks is realized, and the operation and maintenance efficiency and the precision of resource allocation are obviously improved.

title_en: Equipment cascading failure risk assessment method and system based on distribution network twin model
abstract_en: A device cascading failure risk assessment method and system based on a distribution network twinning model are characterized by comprising the steps of generating N-1-k expected failure sets and N-I-1 expected failure sets for different initial expected outage elements when failure occurs according to failure states of equipment elements and topological relations among the equipment elements in a distribution network, wherein the distribution network topology is extracted to judge the topological connection mode of the initial expected outage elements in the distribution network, generating N-1-k expected failure sets or N-1-1 expected failure sets based on the topological connection mode, calculating failure probability of each equipment element in the distribution network, calculating low-voltage risks of all nodes and overload risks of all lines in the expected failure sets according to each expected failure set to generate distribution network cascading failure risk for each expected failure set, and sequencing importance of different expected failure sets based on the distribution network cascading failure risk of each expected failure set.
assignees: NANJING NARI INFORMATION COMM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic power station set time power prediction method based on network model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting the set time power of a photovoltaic power station based on a network model, which comprises the following steps of 1, counting historical data of factors influencing the set time power of the photovoltaic power station according to a set period according to the sequence of the historical time, deleting error data in the historical data, and finally obtaining sample data of photovoltaic power prediction according to a normalization method, 2, carrying out salient operation on the factors influencing the set power of the photovoltaic power station by utilizing an ant colony algorithm to assist a BP neural network model, carrying out deep learning on weighted historical data of various factors by utilizing the BP neural network model, and carrying out forward propagation from an input layer to an output layer.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD;CHANGDIAN XINNENG CO LTD;NANJING NARI RELAYS ENG TECH

title_en: Reliability analysis method and enhancement method for river and sea intermodal transportation network based on network destruction resistance
