abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for analyzing the reliability of a river and sea intermodal network based on network destructiveness and an enhancement method, wherein the analysis method comprises the steps of S1, obtaining the river and sea intermodal network to be detected, respectively constructing a non-cascade port failure model and a cascade port failure model according to the river and sea intermodal network, S2, respectively attacking the non-cascade port failure model and the cascade failure model in a random attack and deliberate attack mode, and calculating the relative size performance parameters of the maximum connected subgraph and the overall efficiency performance parameters of the network after being attacked. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that after a single node fails, more accurate global influence can be obtained, and the like.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Agricultural product quality anomaly propagation path prediction system and method based on graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for predicting an agricultural product quality abnormal propagation path based on a graphic neural network, wherein S1 is used for collecting a quality data set in an agricultural product supply chain, S2 is used for forming a characteristic vector used for being input by the graphic neural network, S3 is used for constructing an agricultural product supply chain quality abnormal propagation path prediction model based on the graphic neural network, S4 is used for inputting a preprocessed historical quality data set into the abnormal propagation path prediction model, S5 is used for monitoring the quality state of each node in real time, S6 is used for dynamically updating the weight of edges in the graph based on an edge weight self-adaptive adjustment mechanism, S7 is used for calculating the optimal propagation path of quality abnormality again by the abnormal propagation path prediction model and generating a prediction path, S8 is used for identifying potential risk nodes according to the recalculated abnormal propagation path, and S9 is used for updating the abnormal propagation path prediction model through real-time data. The method and the system realize accurate prediction and real-time adjustment of the quality anomaly propagation path in the agricultural product supply chain network.
assignees: GUANGXI POLICE COLLEGE

title_en: Active power distribution network two-stage planning method and device considering network attack
abstract_en: The invention provides a two-stage planning method and device for an active power distribution network considering network attacks, which comprise the steps of giving corresponding punishment cost coefficients according to node importance degrees, establishing an objective function, carrying out first-order planning on line reinforcement and remote control switch deployment on the objective function according to preset expense budgets, constructing first-order planning decision constraints, carrying out second-order planning on the objective function according to line faults and propagation of the line faults under attack scenes based on the first-order planning decision constraints, obtaining second-order planning decision constraints, solving the objective function according to the first-order planning decision constraints and the second-order planning decision constraints, and obtaining optimal defense strategy and optimal planning strategy vectors corresponding to worst attack scenes, so that the active power distribution network can be regulated and controlled according to the optimal defense strategy and the optimal planning strategy vectors.

title_en: Wind power equipment fault tracing method and system based on fault decoupling multi-level model
abstract_en: The invention provides a wind power equipment fault tracing method and system based on a fault decoupling multi-level model, which relate to the technical field of fault intelligent diagnosis, and are used for collecting fault analysis information of wind power equipment, constructing a fault decoupling multi-level network model, obtaining a fault propagation path set of the fault decoupling multi-level network model, obtaining node propagation strength and link propagation strength based on reliability features and topological features of all nodes and links among the nodes in the fault decoupling multi-level network model, calculating propagation strength of each propagation path in the fault propagation path set according to a path propagation strength function, the node propagation strength and the link propagation strength, calculating a path node attribute update value, obtaining path indexes of each propagation path according to the path node attribute update value and a path index function, selecting propagation paths meeting preset accuracy and preset confidence in the fault propagation path set as fault propagation paths, and sequencing the fault propagation paths according to a preset path index order to determine a fault source. The invention is beneficial to improving the accuracy of fault source positioning.
assignees: ZHIXIN ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Sea island micro-energy network two-stage optimization method considering hydrogen energy cascade utilization
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sea island micro energy network two-stage optimization method considering hydrogen energy cascade utilization, which belongs to the field of comprehensive energy, and comprises the steps of constructing a sea island micro energy network integrating a hydrogen energy cascade utilization device, constructing a day-ahead stage objective function taking the maximum net profit of a day-ahead market as a target based on historical data of wind power, photovoltaic and photo-thermal power stations and energy supply equipment, storage equipment, a gas turbine and hydrogen fuel cell output of the sea island micro energy network, solving the day-ahead stage objective function based on the day-ahead supply and demand balance constraint, unit constraint and demand response constraint to obtain day-ahead market electricity, heat and gas transaction quantity, constructing a real-time stage objective function taking the minimum real-time market deviation adjustment cost of the sea island micro energy network as a target, solving the real-time objective function based on the uncertainty of real-time supply and demand balance constraint, unit constraint, demand response constraint, supply and demand cooperation, and electric, heat and gas transaction quantity of the day-ahead market to obtain an optimal solution of each unit output and a reduction quantity capable of reducing load on a demand side.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING TECHNOLOGY;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;BEIJING XINYUAN SMART INTERNET TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power transmission network cascading failure risk assessment device and method based on optimization domain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission network cascading failure risk assessment device and method based on an optimization domain, which belong to the technical field of power transmission network failure assessment and comprise a cascading failure optimization domain generation module, a power transmission network cascading failure risk assessment module and a power transmission network cascading failure risk assessment module, wherein the cascading failure optimization domain generation module is used for constructing a cascading failure risk assessment model based on historical data and generating an optimization domain; the system comprises a power transmission network, a disconnection judging module, a cascading failure deduction module and a cascading failure evaluation module, wherein the power transmission network is used for transmitting a single fault to a power transmission network, the offline judging module is used for judging the on-network state of all generators in the power transmission network based on the current running state, the cascading failure deduction module is used for judging the cascading line failure caused by the single fault and updating an optimization domain based on the current topological state, and the cascading failure evaluation module is used for constructing the mapping from a running space to the optimization domain based on all potential renewable energy scenes so as to realize rapid cascading failure evaluation. The power transmission network cascading failure risk assessment device and method based on the optimization domain can effectively assess the influence of a large-scale scene on cascading failures, and can remarkably improve the speed and efficiency of cascading failure assessment.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: Influence blocking maximization algorithm based on overlapping interest community detection
abstract_en: The invention provides an influence blocking maximization algorithm based on overlapping interest community detection. The method comprises a competition propagation model considering multiple factors and an algorithm based on the model and overlapping interest community detection, and is used for modeling a multi-information competition propagation process and selecting active information seed nodes in a social network. The modeling of the competition propagation process and the blocking of influence maximization are hot spots of social network analysis, the traditional model is expanded based on IC and LT, the actual propagation process is difficult to accurately describe, the traditional community-based algorithm divides communities based on a topological structure, and user interest preference is ignored. The method comprehensively considers the interest preference of the users, the information interaction time delay and the trust degree between the users, can better model the competition propagation process, expands the traditional community concept to the interest communities, improves the community detection accuracy, and guides the selection of the active information seed nodes through overlapping the interest community structure so as to achieve the expected negative information influence blocking effect in a short time.

title_en: Method, system, equipment and storage medium for classifying online and national network users based on graph roll-up neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of big data processing, in particular to a method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for classifying online and national network users based on a graph roll-up neural network. The method for classifying the online Chinese net users based on the graph convolution neural network comprises the following steps of extracting user explicit and implicit characteristics, specifically comprising the steps of firstly taking online Chinese net user data as input to construct a user graph model, using a stack network formed by the convolution neural network to extract characteristic information in the graph data, using a cyclic convolution operation to propagate vector representations of aggregation users and neighbor users thereof, and using the graph convolution neural network model to construct an online Chinese net user portrait, and deeply mining dominant and implicit characteristics of the users to form accurate user characteristic vectors. Meanwhile, user vector subdivision is realized according to probability expression output by the full connection layer, and potential user groups are effectively identified.
assignees: CUSTOMER SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Tunnel crack micro defect detection method based on generation countermeasure network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tunnel crack micro defect detection method based on a generated countermeasure network, which comprises the steps of S1, acquiring a space-time crack data set containing tunnel surface micro crack information, S2, generating a preprocessed space-time crack data set, S3, generating a crack expansion image data set, S4, designing and generating a countermeasure network model comprising a generator and a discriminator, S5, inputting the preprocessed space-time crack data set into the generated countermeasure network model, S6, deploying the trained generated countermeasure network model into a tunnel monitoring system, S7, classifying the cracks into different risk grades according to the form, the size and the expansion trend of the cracks, and S8, and according to the crack detection result and the expansion trend thereof. The invention not only improves the accuracy of tunnel crack detection and the capability of predicting crack propagation, but also remarkably improves the automation level of the system, and can realize efficient and accurate crack detection and monitoring in complex environments.
assignees: NANJING INST TECH

title_en: Electric power spot market price prediction method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention provides an artificial intelligence-based electric power spot market price prediction method and system, which relate to the technical field of electric power price prediction and comprise the steps of calculating influence factor weights based on historical transaction data and external associated data by utilizing a deep reinforcement learning optimization fuzzy reasoning system, carrying out wavelet transformation decomposition on the data to obtain a characteristic fluctuation sequence, and carrying out weighted fusion to generate a market characteristic fusion sequence; the method comprises the steps of constructing a bidirectional feedback neural network by using a graph attention network, extracting market transaction characteristics, generating characteristic correction parameters, generating a layered early warning signal by combining a cascading forest algorithm, constructing a dynamic market behavior characteristic map, inputting an optimized characteristic map into a prediction model group comprising a plurality of prediction sub-models, realizing information sharing and complementary learning by a cross-modal characteristic interaction module, generating an initial prediction result, carrying out constraint correction according to an intelligent clearing rule, correcting the correction prediction result, and finally outputting the predicted price of the electric power spot market.
assignees: BEIJING REAL WISDOM POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fault diagnosis method and system for energy storage system under multi-level converter topological structure
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of energy storage systems, and provides a fault diagnosis method and system for an energy storage system under a multilevel converter topological structure. The method comprises the steps of identifying a cascade series-parallel topology of a target converter, traversing the cascade series-parallel topology, setting diagnosis point cloud distribution, constructing a swinging function, executing network construction control risk map mining in a multi-working mode based on the diagnosis point cloud distribution and the swinging function, constructing a fault diagnosis module, interacting topology electric signals, carrying out point cloud data diagnosis decision in the target working mode by combining the fault diagnosis module, determining a fault diagnosis list, displaying and early warning the fault diagnosis list by a terminal, and triggering an emergency plan, so that the technical problems that when the complexity of a topological structure of the multi-level converter is increased, fault diagnosis cannot be rapidly positioned, fault tolerance is insufficient, and the operation stability of an energy storage system is reduced are solved.
assignees: SUINING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;XUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH CO STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Cascade hydropower integration transformation and grid planning cooperative method for improving system flexibility
abstract_en: A cascade hydropower integration reconstruction and grid planning cooperative method for improving system flexibility is provided, and a typical scene generation method based on an improved generation countermeasure network and a K-means clustering method is provided for providing a typical scene set for a cascade hydropower integration reconstruction and line extension configuration model, and then a cascade hydropower integration reconstruction and line extension double-layer optimization model for improving system flexibility is established, wherein the cascade hydropower integration reconstruction and line extension double-layer optimization model comprises an upper-layer configuration model based on multi-objective whale algorithm solution and a lower-layer operation model based on a McCormick convex hull relaxation method. And finally, solving the double-layer model to obtain a gradient hydropower integration transformation and line expansion configuration scheme. The invention comprehensively considers the mutual influence of flexibility and economy, and ensures that the cascade hydropower integration transformation provides effective utilization of flexibility.
assignees: CENTRAL CHINA BRANCH STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV WUHAN

title_en: Power distribution network measurement data super-resolution sensing method based on transfer learning
abstract_en: The application relates to a power distribution network measurement data super-resolution sensing method based on transfer learning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a high-frequency time sequence, preprocessing to obtain training sample data, constructing a cascade model based on a graph attention network and a transducer network, inputting the training sample data and an incidence matrix into the cascade model, pre-training the cascade model, enabling the incidence matrix to represent a topological connection relation of a power distribution network, dividing the pre-trained cascade model into a learner part and a decision maker part, performing migration learning training, and reserving model parameters reaching a training target to obtain a final super-resolution perception model, wherein the learner part comprises all layers except the linear output layer of the transducer, the decision maker part comprises the linear output layer of the transducer, and inputting real-time measurement data into the super-resolution perception model to obtain a super-resolution measurement generation result.

title_en: Energy-saving configuration method and system for self-adaptive power supply based on energy cascade utilization
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-adaptive power supply energy-saving configuration method and a self-adaptive power supply energy-saving configuration system based on energy cascade utilization, which relate to the technical field of power supply management and comprise the steps of collecting operation parameters of electric equipment, establishing an electric model and carrying out self-adaptive correction, then constructing a multi-level energy distribution matrix according to the corrected electric model, carrying out energy efficiency grading on the electric equipment, adopting a bidirectional attention mechanism to carry out space-time characteristic extraction and self-calibration network combination to generate an electric equipment priority strategy, further calculating the energy distribution proportion of each level of electric equipment, finally generating a control signal according to the energy distribution proportion, adjusting the power supply of each level of electric equipment, distributing the excess power to the electric equipment with the energy conversion efficiency being the next highest when the power value exceeds a target power threshold, and outputting an self-adaptive energy balance control instruction to adjust the operation state of the electric equipment according to a prediction control model.
assignees: CHANGZHOU RUIWU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-component coupling-oriented life prediction method, device and system for chain transmission system
abstract_en: A service life prediction method, device and system for a chain transmission system for multi-component coupling comprise the steps of carrying out topological structure decomposition on multiple components of the chain transmission system, extracting fault relations among all the components of the system by combining historical fault data and expert knowledge, preprocessing the fault data to obtain a structured fault feature matrix, establishing a fault propagation network of the chain transmission system by utilizing a cloud model symbol directed graph, constructing a modularized fault propagation path reasoning model based on functional relations and working condition changes of the components of the system, carrying out dynamic simulation and real-time analysis on fault propagation of the system by compatible path search and qualitative and quantitative conversion of the cloud model, carrying out unified quantification on random uncertainty and cognitive uncertainty, modeling degradation trend of the chain transmission system by adopting a regression model, optimizing model parameters, carrying out residual service life prediction of the chain transmission system by combining a first-time method, and giving confidence of service life prediction by confidence interval analysis.
assignees: ZHEJIANG HENGJIU TRANS TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;UNIV ZHEJIANG TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Hybrid pumping and accumulating optimized scheduling method and system considering peak regulation and risk avoidance
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of multi-objective optimization operation of a hybrid pumping and accumulating water-wind power complementary system, and discloses a hybrid pumping and accumulating optimization scheduling method and system capable of achieving peak regulation and risk avoidance, wherein historical data of a cascade watershed water-wind power station and a power grid load are obtained, scheduling initial data are generated through prediction, scheduling scene data capable of representing new energy uncertainty are generated based on the scheduling initial data and prediction errors, an optimization model is built, the optimization model is solved, scheduling instructions of the cascade watershed hydropower station and the hybrid pumping and accumulating power station are generated based on the solution of the optimization model, collaborative optimization for minimizing the power loss load risk of a hydropower side and meeting the peak regulation requirement of the power grid side is achieved through the optimization model, flexible regulation advantages of the hybrid pumping and accumulating are fully exerted, stable operation and reliability of the system are promoted, the speed and accuracy of the solution are facilitated through linearization processing, the real-time calculation efficiency of the system is guaranteed, and the scheduling decision making is more efficient.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Method for predicting cascading faults of power grid of graph neural network based on physical information guidance
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power system cascade fault prediction, and relates to a method for predicting a grid cascade fault of a graphic neural network based on physical information guidance, which comprises the steps of obtaining operation data of a cascade fault, inputting the operation data of the cascade fault into a trained grid cascade fault prediction model, and obtaining a prediction result; the grid cascading failure prediction model comprises a co-embedded graph neural network and a structure coding module, wherein the data enhancement is carried out by utilizing the structure coding based on multi-step random walk matrix and node degree representation considering the line attribute of the grid, the capability of capturing topology information is improved, the co-embedded graph neural network is utilized to promote the interaction of grid nodes and grid lines, the accuracy of grid cascading failure prediction is improved, the node-side interaction aggregation function of the co-embedded graph neural network is changed through the power transmission distribution factor of the grid, the description capability of the complex interaction relation of the actual grid is improved, and the accuracy of grid cascading failure prediction is improved.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING POSTS & TELECOM

title_en: Abnormal electricity utilization detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an abnormal electricity utilization detection method and system, comprising the steps of obtaining first electricity data of a target electricity user, and carrying out first preprocessing on the first electricity data to obtain second electricity utilization data; according to the second electricity consumption data, the first time sequence coupling characteristic is obtained by combining the first characteristic extraction model, the second pretreatment is carried out on the first time sequence coupling characteristic to obtain third electricity consumption data, and the third electricity consumption data is input into the first electricity detection model to carry out abnormal electricity consumption detection. The power consumption data is utilized to divide the load subsequence, so that the input characteristics are more representative, and the adaptability of the model to complex power consumption modes is improved. The dimension reduction of the user behavior characteristics is performed through the characteristic selection framework, redundant information is reduced, the running efficiency of the model is improved, and the calculation cost is reduced. The application of the cascade forest network enables the detection process to be more stable, and can process more nonlinear relations, so that the false alarm rate and the false alarm rate are reduced.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: New energy automobile supply chain network risk node identification method, system and equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a new energy automobile supply chain network risk node identification method, a system and equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of taking a new energy automobile supply chain enterprise as a node, constructing an adjacency matrix, and further constructing a new energy automobile supply chain network; the method comprises the steps of calculating network indexes of all nodes in a network, calculating immune transmission evaluation indexes of all nodes in the network, wherein the immune transmission evaluation indexes are used for reflecting the influence intensity of infection transmission caused by a single node, calculating the survivability indexes of the nodes by simulating attack through traversing the nodes, sequencing the nodes based on the network indexes, the immune transmission evaluation indexes and the survivability indexes, and determining key nodes in the nodes according to sequencing results. According to the method, potential hidden key nodes in the new energy automobile supply chain network can be found through comprehensive and multidimensional fusion risk propagation key node identification, and risk prevention of the new energy automobile supply chain network is optimized.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHIXIN TRACING INFORMATION TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for discriminating single-phase disconnection faults of power distribution network, terminal equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, terminal equipment and a computer readable storage medium for discriminating single-phase disconnection faults of a power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a power distribution network topological structure diagram to be evaluated, and determining a first node characteristic and a first adjacency matrix of each node in the diagram; the first node characteristics comprise three-phase circuit effective values on a distribution network line, the first node characteristics and the first adjacent matrix of each node are input into a trained single-phase disconnection fault positioning model, so that the model carries out forward propagation for a plurality of times according to the first node characteristics and the first adjacent matrix of each node, in the forward propagation process of each time, the model aggregates node characteristics of adjacent nodes of each node according to the connection relation of the nodes in the first adjacent matrix, and the class label of each node is output according to the aggregated node characteristics of each node in forward propagation. By implementing the method and the device, the retraining time and resource cost can be reduced, and the mobility of the model can be improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake phase pickup method based on time-frequency analysis and deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a seismic phase pickup method based on time-frequency analysis and deep learning, which belongs to the field of seismology, and comprises the steps of establishing a deep neural network comprising an empirical mode decomposition module, a residual error contraction module, an LSTM layer, a transducer layer, an up-sampling layer and a convolution layer, adopting a linear rectification function as an activation function, adopting an Adam self-adaptive optimization function to carry out counter propagation, adopting a binary cross entropy loss function as a loss function, and adopting an average absolute error function, an error standard deviation, an accuracy rate, a recall rate and an F1 fraction as evaluation indexes to obtain a deep neural network model. When the frequencies of noise, P wave and S wave are different, the empirical mode decomposition can effectively separate the P wave from the S wave, thereby helping the network to better identify the P wave and the S wave. Even for broadband noise, the noise is decomposed into different eigenmode functions, so that the noise content in the eigenmode functions where the P wave and the S wave are located is reduced. The time-frequency analysis method can effectively improve the noise immunity of the network.

title_en: Control method for cascade H-bridge photovoltaic grid-connected inverter under unbalanced power grid working condition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric energy quality control, in particular to a control method of a cascade H-bridge photovoltaic grid-connected inverter under an unbalanced working condition of a power grid, which comprises the steps of S1, establishing a direct current side total voltage control method to obtain a reference value of an active current component required to be injected into the power grid by the inverter, S2, establishing a current positive and negative sequence inner loop control method to track positive and negative sequence current instructions to obtain positive and negative sequence voltage modulation signals, S3, generating a negative sequence current feedforward term based on a negative sequence current injection method, merging the feedforward term into calculation of a direct current side voltage control output value to complete phase-to-phase power balance control, and S4, carrying out carrier phase-shifting modulation based on a phase-shifting angle which changes in real time to complete phase-to-phase power balance control. The invention can better solve the problem of unbalanced power of the cascade H-bridge photovoltaic grid-connected inverter under the unbalanced working condition of the power grid, and ensures that the inverter safely and stably provides three-phase balance current.
assignees: UNIV SHIHEZI;TBEA XINJIANG SUNOASIS CO LTD

title_en: Vulnerability stain detection system based on industrial asset fingerprint identification
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vulnerability detection, in particular to a vulnerability taint detection system based on industrial asset fingerprint identification. The invention acquires the flow data of each industrial asset device in operation in real time to generate fingerprint information, matches the data acquired in real time with a vulnerability database according to the fingerprint information, identifies the known vulnerability, deduces a possible stain propagation path according to network topology and a stain source by constructing a network topology diagram, identifies the affected device, evaluates the flow change of the affected device, calculates the influence degree of the stain source on the network to identify abnormal activities in the stain propagation process, evaluates the network security risk, and timely adjusts a monitoring strategy and a threshold value according to the evaluation result so as to ensure the accuracy and the reliability of a monitoring system.
assignees: GUONENG XINKONG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution information physical risk assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk assessment method and a risk assessment system for distribution information physics, which relate to the technical field of distribution information physics system researches and comprise a comprehensive assessment method for defining information system risks and physical system risks, wherein potential threats of information flow interruption or tampering to safe operation of a distribution network are assessed, an evolution mechanism of cross-space cascading failures is revealed, validity under different attack scenes is verified through example simulation, and risk assessment of distribution information physics is completed. The method and the system can effectively quantify the cross-space propagation influence of the faults of the information system on the physical system, accurately evaluate the comprehensive risk level of the information system, the physical system and the information physical system, remarkably improve the accuracy and efficiency of risk evaluation, not only can identify high-risk nodes, but also can quantify the propagation mechanism of the cascading faults, and provide reliable support for the safe operation and planning design of the distribution information physical system, thereby improving the reliability and toughness of the distribution network.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Mixed pumped storage scheduling method for reducing water consumption rate of step hydroelectric operation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hybrid pumped storage scheduling method for reducing the running water consumption rate of cascade hydropower, which comprises the steps of establishing a cascade hydropower and light storage complementary power generation scheduling model, establishing a minimum objective function for the total water consumption of a cascade hydropower station based on the cascade hydropower scheduling model, determining constraint conditions of the objective function according to the cascade hydropower scheduling model, establishing a solving model based on an Actor-Critic algorithm, inputting time sequence data in historical data sets as environment state parameters into a deep reinforcement learning algorithm model, solving an optimal day-ahead scheduling strategy through an iterative training network model, and calculating the water consumption rate by using the obtained optimal scheduling strategy result to evaluate the result. By introducing an Actor-Critic algorithm in deep reinforcement learning, an optimization decision strategy under a complex environment is realized, the economic operation efficiency and the power generation benefit of the system are effectively improved, and the water consumption rate of cascade hydropower is remarkably reduced.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Demand response optimization method and device based on load side resource three-layer cooperative scheduling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a demand response optimization method based on three-layer collaborative scheduling of load side resources, which comprises the steps of respectively establishing basic models of power grid, aggregators and users participating in demand response scheduling, carrying out coupling optimization on the basic models of power grid, aggregators and users by utilizing a target cascading algorithm, establishing a three-layer collaborative scheduling model based on a power grid-aggregator-user architecture, and solving the three-layer collaborative scheduling model to obtain an optimization scheme of the power grid, the aggregators and the users participating in demand response scheduling. The method and the system promote reasonable allocation of main body resources of all parties in demand response, are favorable for promoting the normalization of mass user side resources to participate in interactive regulation, realize cooperative optimization of energy-consumption side adjustable resources, and ensure efficient utilization of power resources and stable operation of a power grid.
assignees: MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;JIANGSU FANGTIAN POWER TECH CO

title_en: Transmission and distribution network cooperative scheduling method considering wind power uncertainty and frequency modulation constraint
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transmission and distribution network collaborative scheduling method considering wind power uncertainty and frequency modulation constraint, which comprises the steps of constructing frequency modulation safety constraint by combining frequency modulation response capacities of a wind turbine generator, an energy storage system and a thermal power generating unit, acquiring operation data of a transmission network and a distribution network and unit parameters, respectively establishing an upper layer transmission network unit combination model and a lower layer active distribution network scheduling model containing the frequency modulation safety constraint, linearizing nonlinear parts in the models by utilizing a second order cone technology and a large M method, and realizing parallel optimization solution of a transmission and distribution system by adopting a distributed optimization method based on a target cascading algorithm by taking interconnection line interaction power and auxiliary frequency modulation power between the transmission and distribution network as coupling variables. The method ensures the solving accuracy, realizes the efficient linkage of the transmission and distribution network system in the resource scheduling and frequency response, and obviously reduces the frequency modulation pressure caused by large-scale grid connection of wind power to the traditional thermal power generating unit.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Power distribution network information system risk assessment method and system based on graph convolution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk assessment method and a risk assessment system for a power distribution network information system based on a graph convolution network, and relates to the technical field of power distribution network information physical systems, wherein the risk assessment method comprises the steps of combining time dynamic characteristics in an LSTM capturing fault propagation process to accurately assess the risk level of node voltage out-of-limit; and under the non-fault condition, the electrical characteristics of the system are learned, the evaluation precision is improved, and the risk evaluation of the information system of the power distribution network is completed. According to the invention, by introducing a combined model based on the graph rolling network GCN and the long-short-term memory network LSTM, the space-time characteristics in the information physical system of the power distribution network can be effectively captured, the risk level of node voltage out-of-limit is accurately estimated, and the accuracy and instantaneity of risk estimation are remarkably improved.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Three-dimensional earthquake simulation method based on residual Fourier neural operator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional earthquake simulation method based on a residual Fourier neural operator. A data-driven deep learning seismic wavefield simulation technique embedded in physics is presented. The method embeds a fourier wave propagation operator structure into a convolutional neural network structure, alternately performing wave propagation simulation in a spatial domain and a wave number domain. Because the network structure conforming to the wave field propagation mode is adopted, and the wave field propagation mechanism implicit in the data can be automatically satisfied, the method greatly improves the efficiency of the deep learning earthquake simulation method, reduces the requirement of the deep learning earthquake simulation method on the training data quantity and the training time, and can strengthen the generalization performance of the deep learning model. Compared with the classical finite difference numerical solution, the method has higher operation efficiency, occupies less storage space, is not constrained by the size of the space grid and the time step, and is more suitable for the seismic wave simulation requirement of large-range high-frequency complex medium.
assignees: SINOPEC OILFIELD SERVICE CORP;SINOPEC PETROLEUM ENGINEERING GEOPHYSICS CO LTD;NORTH CHINA BRANCH OF SINOPEC PETROLEUM ENG GEOPHYSICS CO LTD

title_en: Power grid abnormal situation sensing method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid abnormal situation sensing method and system, the method comprises the steps of obtaining power grid data in real time and calculating different power grid situation assessment indexes, weighting each power grid situation assessment index, correcting the weight of the abnormal index, then linearly weighting all power grid situation assessment indexes to obtain situation assessment values, constructing a prediction model with a double-layer gating cyclic neural network, an attention layer and an output layer cascade, inputting historical data of the power grid situation assessment indexes, outputting future situation assessment prediction values, inputting new historical data of the power grid situation assessment indexes into a trained prediction model to obtain corresponding future situation assessment prediction values, and matching the future situation assessment prediction values with pre-divided security levels to determine whether the abnormality occurs. According to the method, a deep learning framework is utilized to construct a model for predicting the running situation of the power grid based on the double-layer gated circulating neural network of the attention mechanism, so that a better prediction effect and higher accuracy are realized.
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Network construction energy storage, location and volume selection method for supporting transient stability of high-proportion new energy power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network construction energy storage site selection and volume determination method for supporting transient stability of a high-proportion new energy power grid, which comprises the steps of obtaining power grid measurement data, extracting space-time characteristics through segmented Hankel matrix recursion decomposition and dynamic weighted graph decomposition, constructing characteristic tensors through multi-scale tensor fusion, analyzing transient response characteristics based on layered sparse principal component mapping, constructing stability indexes through multi-scale coupling evaluation, obtaining node scores through self-adaptive weight fusion, screening candidate nodes through affinity propagation clustering, evaluating supporting capacity through multi-time scale influence propagation, optimizing capacity configuration through score planning constraint, realizing real-time evaluation based on recursive state estimation, generating response strategies through multi-time scale layered decision, and realizing cooperative control through distributed consistency optimization. The invention effectively improves the transient stability of the high-proportion new energy power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO;ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Cascade water-wind-solar combined peak regulation method and system for hybrid type pumping power station
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system optimization operation, and discloses a cascade water-wind-light combined peak regulation method and system of a hybrid pumping power station, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining historical data of a cascade watershed wind-light power station and predicting scheduling data of the cascade watershed wind-light power station; and generating a scheduling instruction of the step river basin wind-solar power station based on the solution of the optimization model. Through the optimization model, the adjustment efficiency of the hybrid pumped storage power station is effectively improved, and the hybrid pumped storage power station can flexibly participate in peak regulation of a power system. Meanwhile, the consumption rate of new energy sources such as wind power, photovoltaic and the like is remarkably improved, and the electricity discarding phenomenon is reduced. By reasonably controlling the operation of the thermal power generating unit, the dependence on thermal power is reduced, so that carbon emission is reduced, and environmental protection and sustainable development are promoted. In addition, the invention reduces the peak-valley difference of load, enhances the stability of the power grid and reduces the economic burden of system operation by smoothing the residual load of the system.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Water-wind-solar complementary strategy optimization method and system based on large-scale water-wind-solar cluster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-wind-solar complementary strategy optimization method and system based on a large-scale water-wind-solar cluster, and belongs to the technical field of power system optimization scheduling. The method comprises the steps of dividing a water-wind-solar complementary power system optimization object of a large-scale water-wind-solar cluster through a power grid aggregation model and a power cluster, obtaining the generalized optimization object, establishing constraint conditions of the water-wind-solar complementary power system, including power transmission channel constraint, wind-solar output constraint and hydropower constraint, constructing a water-wind-solar complementary power system complementary strategy optimization model by taking maximization of dead-time energy retention capacity of a cascade water-wind-solar system and maximization of annual energy generation of the water-wind-solar as objective functions and combining the constraint conditions, and solving the water-wind-solar complementary power system complementary strategy optimization model to obtain a water-wind-solar complementary power system complementary strategy. The method improves the accuracy and the calculation efficiency of the optimization modeling of the large-scale system, and realizes the multi-objective optimization of the water-wind-solar complementary power generation based on the large-scale water-wind-solar clusters.
assignees: BEIJING KEDONG ELECTRIC POWER CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Source network load storage collaborative planning method and system considering multi-main-body hybrid game
abstract_en: The invention relates to a source network charge storage collaborative planning method and system considering multi-main body mixed games, wherein the method comprises the following steps of establishing a power distribution network collaborative planning model considering source network charge storage main body master-slave-collaborative mixed games, wherein the power distribution network collaborative planning model is a double-layer model and comprises a power distribution network operator, an upper layer master-slave game sub-model of other main bodies and a lower layer laminated game sub-model between source charge storage side main bodies; and solving the collaborative planning model of the power distribution network by adopting a solving strategy combining a target cascading analysis method and a self-adaptive coefficient alternating direction multiplier method to obtain an optimal planning scheme of a newly-built and distributed power supply and an energy storage device of the circuit. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of realizing efficient configuration and coordinated utilization of the source network charge storage resources, improving planning reliability and the like.

title_en: Method for detecting integrity of full-link simulation signals of backboard and sub-board combined backboard
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of signal integrity detection, in particular to a method for detecting the full-link simulation signal integrity of a backboard and a sub-board base plate, which comprises the steps of connecting all circuit boards well to obtain a connecting circuit board, adopting a network analyzer to evaluate the electrical performance of the connecting circuit board, carrying out topology analysis on the connecting circuit board to confirm the worst condition of the connecting circuit board, carrying out high-speed channel modeling on the connecting circuit board, and carrying out cascade eye simulation.
assignees: NO 34 RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORPORATION CETC

title_en: Power equipment operation state prediction and anomaly simulation method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power equipment operation state prediction and abnormal simulation method based on digital twinning, and relates to the technical field of power grid operation. According to the method, the prediction and abnormal simulation of the running state of the power equipment are realized by establishing a digital twin model and real-time data analysis of the power equipment. The method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model by analyzing the physical structure, the operation characteristics and the load distribution of the power equipment, performing multidimensional analysis on real-time data by utilizing edge calculation, extracting electrical characteristics and behavior patterns, generating an equipment state data set, constructing an abnormal causal chain model based on the model and the data set, identifying a fault mode caused by uneven load or overload, and evaluating the influence of the abnormal state on the stability and the efficiency of the power system through virtual simulation and fault propagation analysis to obtain an abnormal influence index of the power equipment. The accuracy of power equipment fault prediction is improved, the stability and efficiency of a power system are optimized, and support is provided for intelligent operation and fault early warning.
assignees: BEIJING ZHIDAKE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: New energy power equipment operation risk assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power equipment risk assessment, and discloses a new energy power equipment operation risk assessment method and a system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a scene basic event of a fault of a power system of a power distribution network accessed by new energy; the method comprises the steps of screening key scenario events from the scenario basic events through an expert trust propagation-decision laboratory analysis method, inputting the key scenario events into an interpretation structure model for analysis to obtain a scenario level diagram of key fault events, carrying out scenario analysis and deduction on the scenario level diagram to obtain a power system fault probability prediction result, and analyzing the power system fault probability prediction result to obtain the influence degree of different power equipment running states on power system faults. The invention evaluates the risk degree of the power equipment faults on the operation of the power system, comprehensively considers the interrelation among the equipment and the overall operation condition of the system, and provides support for the emergency management decision of the power system.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Intelligent electricity-saving scene building method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of three-dimensional modeling of computer graphics, and particularly relates to an intelligent electric field protection scene building method based on digital twinning. The invention comprehensively collects the running, state and power grid topology data of the equipment. And (3) deeply analyzing the equipment relationship by combining the improved graph neural network with multi-scale and time sequence characteristic modeling. The key is that the electricity-keeping scene is constructed by comprehensively considering the equipment fault probability, fault propagation and load fluctuation based on the digital twin model. And the dynamic simulation simulates the evolution of the power grid, and the influence of the scene on the stability of the power grid is accurately evaluated. The method can dynamically adjust the scene according to the actual working condition, effectively improve the scientificity and effectiveness of the construction of the electricity-protecting scene, ensure the stable operation of the power grid and provide powerful support for electricity-protecting work of the power system.
assignees: SHANDONG LURUAN DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for evaluating power grid risk under extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of risk assessment of power systems, in particular to a power grid risk assessment method, device, equipment and storage medium under extreme weather, and the method comprises the steps of analyzing an abnormal action mechanism of extreme weather factors under tropical weather on power grid equipment to obtain a wind power abnormal output space-time matrix under the extreme weather, sampling by power transmission line fault probability to obtain a line fault state space-time matrix, comprehensively obtaining an abnormal state matrix of a power grid, combining the abnormal state matrix with power flow redistribution to obtain a power grid abnormal coupling process considering the extreme weather and the power flow redistribution, rescheduling a unit and island processing in the power grid abnormal coupling process to obtain a power grid abnormal propagation path, determining an abnormal propagation path evolution flow, obtaining abnormal propagation paths of different power grids through simulation, determining risk assessment indexes aiming at the abnormal propagation paths of different power grids, and calculating to obtain a risk assessment result considering the abnormal space-time evolution of the power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Temperature regulation and control system applied to water-cooled air conditioner of machine room
abstract_en: The invention discloses a temperature regulation and control system applied to a water-cooled air conditioner of a machine room, and relates to the technical field of temperature regulation and control. The system comprises a coupling analysis module, a cooperative control module, a dynamic regulation and control module and a correction module. The heat flow propagation model is constructed by collecting temperature distribution and power consumption data of the cabinet in real time and utilizing the graph neural network, and the refrigerant flow velocity and the tail end air outlet temperature set value are output. And (3) combining efficiency curves of the water pump, the fan and the compressor, optimizing total energy consumption, equipment service life and refrigeration stability of the system by using a non-dominant sequencing genetic algorithm, and generating a control instruction. And verifying thermodynamic constraint conditions and generating a refrigerant distribution priority matrix according to the layout and regulation and control instructions of the machine room, and ensuring the coordination response of the equipment. And comparing actual data with simulation data through the digital twin platform, and reversely correcting the edge weight of the heat flow propagation model to optimize the system performance. The system can realize accurate regulation and control of the machine room environment, improve the energy efficiency and the service life of equipment, and ensure the refrigeration stability.

title_en: Generated power prediction method, storage medium, electronic device, and program product
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a power generation prediction method, a storage medium, electronic equipment and a program product, and relates to the field of power generation control. The method comprises the steps of obtaining meteorological data of a photovoltaic station, inputting the meteorological data into a trained power generation prediction model to obtain power generation output by the power generation prediction model, wherein the power generation prediction model is of a back propagation neural network structure, a characteristic attention mechanism layer and a regularization mechanism layer are embedded in a hidden layer of the power generation prediction model, the weight attention mechanism layer is used for increasing input characteristic weight of a prediction result output by the power generation prediction model, and the regularization mechanism layer is used for preventing the power generation prediction model from being subjected to over fitting.

title_en: Power distribution station house monitoring method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution station room monitoring method, a device and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining power distribution station room electromagnetic interference intensity distribution and line real-time state data, and determining a sensor type selection scheme by combining equipment working conditions; the fault traveling wave arrival time difference, the line model parameters and the wave speed difference are used for calculating a fault propagation path, determining the position of a fault point and generating a positioning result, associating the sensor type selection and the fault positioning, judging whether the fault point is in a layout area or not, primarily judging the fault type, generating a recovery path candidate scheme based on real-time state data and the fault positioning result, fusing the fault traveling wave characteristics and the recovery path line state parameters, establishing a comprehensive evaluation model, taking power supply recovery efficiency and load loss rate as optimization targets, and determining an optimal recovery path scheme. The method has the following effects that the rapid and accurate positioning and intelligent power supply recovery of the faults of the power distribution network are realized, and the running reliability and efficiency of the power distribution network are improved.

title_en: Method and device for inverting continuous vertical structure of ocean solitary wave by satellite remote sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a satellite remote sensing inversion method and device for a continuous vertical structure of an ocean solitary wave, and belongs to the technical field of synthetic aperture radars. The method comprises the steps of collecting ocean real stratification data, extracting ocean stratification parameters, carrying out numerical simulation and radar simulation experiments, setting a numerical simulation initial density field based on the ocean stratification parameters, constructing an internal solitary wave vertical structure-remote sensing characteristic parameter and ocean environment parameter pair sample data set, training a counter-propagation neural network by using the sample data set to obtain a trained internal solitary wave vertical structure inversion model, obtaining the remote sensing characteristic parameter of an internal solitary wave of a target and the ocean environment parameter of a corresponding position, namely the ocean stratification parameters and ocean surface wind field data, and inputting the trained internal solitary wave vertical structure inversion model to obtain the internal solitary wave vertical structure of the target. The inner solitary wave density line offset obtained by the method has extremely high consistency with the on-site measurement result.
assignees: HAINAN KONGTIAN INFORMATION RES INSTITUTE;AEROSPACE INFORMATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Method and system for recommending optimal operation scheme of cascade pump station group with stable fusion operation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for recommending a cascade pump station group optimization operation scheme with stable fusion operation, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a mathematical model, analyzing the correlation degree between a machine set working condition parameter and a stability parameter by utilizing a maximum information coefficient method, calibrating the working condition parameter according to the correlation degree, respectively constructing a deep neural network model for each stability parameter, taking the working condition parameter calibrated by a pump station machine set as input data and the stability parameter as output data, training to obtain a mapping relation between the machine set working condition parameter and the stability parameter so as to establish a working condition-stability relation model, solving the mathematical model, constructing a scheme library, respectively calculating the pump station machine set stability parameter under each scheme, and obtaining an optimal operation scheme considering economy and stability according to a parameter comparison result. The invention can perform operation stability analysis on the schemes in the step pump station group optimization operation scheme library, and comprehensively select the optimal operation scheme considering economy and stability.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: Method and system for extracting relationship of entities involved in electric carbon market transaction based on cascade pointer network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for extracting entity relation in electric carbon market transaction based on a cascade pointer network, comprising the following steps of constructing an electric carbon market transaction field word segmentation dictionary, constructing PowerSpanBERT models, training PowerSpanBERT models by introducing improved gradient accumulation-projection gradient descent countermeasure training strategies, identifying and extracting candidate head entity sets, introducing a multi-head attention mechanism to calculate a word embedding vector output by a PowerSpanBERT model, decoding the candidate head entity set feature vector and the word embedding vector by CPN to obtain candidate tail entity sets, predicting relation types between the candidate head entity sets and head-tail entity pairs in the candidate tail entity sets, outputting the head-tail entity pairs and the corresponding relation types, and generating entity relation triplets according to irrigation results. The invention provides a more accurate and efficient entity relation extraction solution for electric carbon market transaction.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Intelligent substation relay protection operation risk identification method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for identifying relay protection operation risks of an intelligent substation, the method comprises the steps of constructing a protection association matrix aiming at a main wiring diagram of the intelligent substation, constructing a Petri network of each protection and a coupling relation library and a coupling state library of information transmission of the Petri network, searching each adjacent protection of original protection, setting a primary equipment failure, sequentially enumerating the pressing plate error switching of the corresponding protection, which violates an operation rule, sequentially calling the normal action Petri network and the abnormal action Petri network of the original protection and each adjacent protection to conduct deduction, exhausting the action deduction of all the adjacent protection, recording each protection action after deduction, forming an event chain, obtaining an extra-tripping breaker set, and taking the extra-tripping breaker set as an expansion result of a linkage fault caused by a protection risk point. According to the invention, adjacent protections of the original protections can be searched, the risk of the protection pressing plate throwing and retreating errors is identified through deduction analysis, and the development and the expansion range of cascading failures caused by the protection pressing plate throwing and retreating errors are obtained.
assignees: INST ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCES STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY EHV BRANCH;STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Public opinion event propagation analysis method, system and computer program product
abstract_en: The application belongs to an event analysis method, and provides a public opinion event propagation analysis method, a system and a computer program product, which aim at the technical problems that mathematical models are not fully used for exploring causes and propagation mechanisms in network space in the current research about the emotion of netizens, analyze propagation conditions of public opinion events by adopting different models at different stages of the public opinion events, divide progress of the public opinion events according to whether bifurcation occurs, describe the network public opinion events by using a mode of combining a chaotic dynamics model with an infectious disease model, analyze the propagation processes of the public opinion respectively at each stage, and further can fundamentally know reasons and essential reasons that the network public opinion events become network violent events, thereby making a strategy for controlling the trend of the public opinion according to the method. The comprehensive model provided by the application can be improved, the public opinion process which can possibly appear a web storm can be completely described, and in practical application, treatment suggestions can be given by combining data analysis.
assignees: UNIV XIAN POSTS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS

title_en: Potential landslide identification method and system based on surface deformation cause analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a potential landslide identification method and system based on ground surface deformation cause analysis, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining radar data and preprocessing to obtain ground surface deformation phase data, constructing and training IDANet-1 networks, predicting to obtain ground surface deformation abnormal areas, respectively processing terrain DEM data, multi-time-phase MODIS data and optical image data to obtain ground surface subsidence type, glacier snow melting type and mine subsidence type ground surface deformation areas, performing difference set operation on the ground surface subsidence type ground surface deformation areas after collecting operation to obtain a landslide type ground surface deformation target, training IDANet-2 networks by using a landslide type ground surface deformation identification data set, and inputting wide area comprehensive remote sensing data into a IDANet-2 network model for reasoning to obtain wide area potential landslide hidden danger distribution information. According to the technical scheme, multi-layer cascade connection of multi-source multi-mode remote sensing data is realized, the ground deformation information is accurately identified, and the identification efficiency of potential landslide hidden danger in a large area is effectively improved.

title_en: Betweennesss algorithm-based local energy shortage risk cascade effect evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating a local energy shortage risk cascade effect based on a Betweennesss algorithm, and relates to the field of energy resource management, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining energy pressure indexes of all areas and energy dependency of all departments, calculating according to the energy pressure indexes to obtain energy shortage probability, and calculating according to the energy shortage probability and the energy dependency of all departments to obtain initial energy shortage risk; S2, combining the initial energy shortage risk with a multi-region input-output model to construct a virtual energy shortage risk transmission network, and S3, evaluating and identifying key transmission nodes of the local energy shortage risk cascade effect in the virtual energy shortage risk transmission network based on Betweenness algorithm. The method has the advantages of wide application range and high calculation mode, fills the blank of the prior research, and can provide effective method and data support for improving the toughness of the trade network for coping with the energy shortage risk.

title_en: Conduction logic and cascading model analysis method in energy and power field
abstract_en: The invention discloses a conduction logic and cascading model analysis method in the field of energy and power, which comprises the following steps of data collection and pretreatment: global energy trade data including energy importation and importation, prices, etc. are collected and preprocessed to construct global energy cascade conductive networks. And (3) establishing an underload cascade fault model considering overload limitation based on the collected data, wherein the model can simulate a cascade fault process in the energy trade network. Setting different scenes, simulating the fluctuation of the upper limit and the lower limit of the node load, and performing simulation analysis by using a model. And analyzing and reporting the results, namely analyzing the influence of the international energy power pattern on the energy safety of China according to the simulation results, generating an analysis report and providing reference for policy makers. The invention can find the influence of the international energy power pattern on the energy power development of China through simulation under different situations.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID ENERGY RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Power system risk assessment method in extreme weather scene based on hybrid simulation
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a power system risk assessment method based on hybrid simulation in an extreme weather scene, and belongs to the field of power system risk assessment. The evaluation method comprises the steps of obtaining power grid data and extreme weather scene data, modeling according to the obtained extreme weather scene data, constructing a fault model of a line in an extreme weather scene to calculate the fault probability of the line, and calculating a risk index of the power system based on Monte Carlo simulation and the fault probability of the corresponding line. The assessment method can integrate various extreme weather factors, characterize initial faults and cascading failure dynamic evolution characteristics so as to support planning and operation decisions of the power grid.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Transmission and distribution collaborative low-carbon economic dispatching method and system based on target cascading method
abstract_en: The invention provides a transmission and distribution cooperation low-carbon economic dispatching method based on a target cascading method, which comprises the steps of establishing a transmission and distribution layered dispatching framework, analyzing interactive power characteristics under typical load output, setting decoupling variables of a transmission and distribution network by combining a physical coupling relation, constructing related criteria of transmission and distribution cooperation consistency based on the target cascading method, and constructing a transmission and distribution cooperation low-carbon optimization model based on the target cascading method by combining constraint conditions such as voltage constraint, tide constraint and the like according to the transmission and distribution layered dispatching framework and considering an electric carbon coupling calculation method. According to the invention, the transmission and distribution collaborative low-carbon economic dispatching method based on the target cascade method is applied to the transmission and distribution collaborative dispatching, so that the influence of the dynamic carbon emission factor on the purchase and sale power of the transmission network and the distribution network is considered, and compared with the traditional transmission and distribution collaborative dispatching, the transmission network layer can be guided to purchase clean electric energy, and the carbon emission of a traditional unit is reduced.

title_en: Comprehensive evaluation method for watershed cascade water-light complementary system
abstract_en: The application provides a comprehensive evaluation method of a watershed cascade water-light complementary system, which relates to the technical field of data processing and comprises the steps of obtaining a watershed cascade hydropower station and a photovoltaic power station of a target watershed, wherein the watershed cascade hydropower station comprises K hydropower stations, performing synchronous power generation monitoring data, obtaining a water-light complementary power generation capacity sequence, determining a system power supply deviation factor, obtaining K hydropower station power generation cost, K hydropower station benefits and photovoltaic power station benefits, and calling a benefit evaluation network layer to analyze the system power supply deviation factor, the K hydropower station power generation cost, the photovoltaic power station power generation cost, the K hydropower station benefits and the photovoltaic power station benefits to determine a target benefit comprehensive evaluation result. The method and the device can solve the technical problem of inaccurate yield evaluation caused by lack of fluctuation analysis of the generated energy in the prior art, and achieve the technical effect of improving the accuracy of the yield evaluation of the water-light complementary system.
assignees: DATANG XIANGCHENG HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD;DATANG HYDROPOWER SCIENCE & TECH RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Urban comprehensive pipe rack operation environment temperature determining method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for determining the operation environment temperature of an urban comprehensive pipe rack, which relate to the technical field of electric digital data processing and comprise the steps of acquiring first information, second information, pipe rack heat source, structure data and third information; the method comprises the steps of inputting historical data in first information into a preset neural network for training to obtain a prediction model, inputting real-time data in the first information into the prediction model to obtain predicted soil surface temperature, establishing a pipe gallery operation model according to the predicted soil surface temperature, second information and pipe gallery heat source and structure data, performing heat exchange calculation on the pipe gallery operation model to obtain predicted pipe gallery operation environment temperature, and comparing the predicted pipe gallery operation environment temperature with third information to obtain a pipe gallery operation state. According to the invention, the soil surface temperature in a future pipe gallery construction area is predicted by using a back propagation algorithm, and the predicted soil surface temperature, the pipe gallery heat source and the structural data are simulated, so that the safe operation state of the pipe gallery can be effectively estimated, and the normal operation of the pipe gallery is ensured.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG

title_en: System and method for suspending HF antennas
abstract_en: A system and method for extending and holding aloft a long-wire radio antenna using an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), optimizing high-frequency (HF) radio communication where ground-based infrastructure is impractical. The UAV-based system pulls an antenna wire from a reel vertically and hovers in place holding the antenna at a length resonant on the transmitting frequency, enabling effective skip propagation. The system includes mechanisms for precise impedance matching and standing wave ratio (SWR) tuning through automatic adjustments of antenna length, facilitated by onboard sensors and control systems. The antenna wire is connected to a reel anchored to the ground and connected to a wire-mesh ground plane. In one embodiment, the system constantly feeds electric power to the UAV, with filters isolating RF and power currents, enabling both antenna and power transmission functions on the same wire. This system addresses the challenges of maintaining HF communication in remote or disaster-stricken regions.
assignees: PERRITT JR HENRY HARDY

title_en: Evolution traceability analysis method and system for complex faults of power distribution network coefficients
