abstract_en: The invention discloses an evolution traceability analysis method and system for complex faults of a power distribution network coefficient, comprising the steps of obtaining a first signal of a target power distribution line, and performing first preprocessing on the first signal to obtain a second signal; the method comprises the steps of establishing a first characteristic matrix, obtaining a third signal according to a second signal, inputting the third signal into a pre-trained first judging network, obtaining the fault category of a fault point, and carrying out fault position evolution tracing. The focusing performance of the power grid fault signal at the fault point is remarkably enhanced through time reversal operation, amplitude attenuation, phase change and energy reflection characteristics of signal propagation in a complex power grid are accurately described by combining BLT super matrix modeling, and fault classification and position accuracy under a complex fault scene are improved by combining deep feature learning of a Siam network and energy focusing verification and least square optimization.
assignees: GUIGANG POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GRID COMPANY OF GUANGXI

title_en: Wind-solar-water-storage multi-energy complementary intelligent scheduling system and method based on energy storage big pump
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind-solar-water storage multi-energy complementation and intelligent scheduling system and method based on an energy storage big pump, wherein the system comprises a power generation module, a wind power station and a photovoltaic power station, wherein the wind power station and the photovoltaic power station are used for providing intermittent and unstable electric quantity output, a step reservoir power station utilizes the water level difference of a reservoir to generate power, and the energy storage module is used for pumping the electric quantity which is not incorporated into a power grid when wind power or photovoltaic power generation is excessive and pumping water from a downstream water reservoir to an upstream reservoir; the scheduling module is used for carrying out overall optimized scheduling of the wind, light and water storage system by utilizing the intelligent scheduling system according to weather forecast and load prediction information; the monitoring and control module is used for monitoring the running state of the system in real time, controlling energy distribution among wind power generation, photovoltaic power generation, energy storage pump stations and cascade reservoir power stations, and optimizing wind, light, water and multi-energy complementary scheduling. The invention ensures stable large-scale grid connection of photovoltaic and wind power generation, obviously reduces power waste and reduces operation cost.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;NORTH UNITED POWER CO LTD;INNER MONGOLIA MENGDA POWER GENERATING CO LTD

title_en: Method for carrying out risk early warning analysis on food safety by simulating propagation and diffusion of heavy metals in environment through complex network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for carrying out risk early warning analysis on food-derived food safety by simulating the propagation and diffusion of heavy metal pollution in the environment through a complex network, which uses the complex network to build an atmosphere-soil pollutant interaction complex network model and considers the propagation dynamics of heavy metal among nodes, the method comprises the steps of carrying out propagation behaviors such as propagation in the atmosphere and the soil, atmospheric sedimentation, migration in the soil and the like, combining a network topological structure with a propagation dynamics model among nodes to form an atmosphere-soil pollutant interaction complex network model, realizing effective combination of physical driving and data driving, and providing more accurate and reliable risk early warning. According to the invention, through network topology structure analysis, the key nodes are identified to pay attention in risk management and control, and the node food safety risk is quantified through diet exposure evaluation, so that uncertainty caused by only relying on qualitative analysis or rough estimation is avoided, and decision basis is provided for developing targeted food safety risk prevention and control work.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING TECHNOLOGY & BUSINESS

title_en: Multi-source monitoring data analysis method and system based on earthquake active source
abstract_en: The invention provides a multisource monitoring data analysis method and system based on an earthquake active source, which relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and by introducing a pre-trained earthquake wave reinforcement analysis network, the seismic wave strengthening analysis network is composed of a plurality of cascaded model functional layers, and each layer is embedded with a multi-stage knowledge migration unit, so that deep learning and efficient analysis of seismic wave data are realized. The multi-stage knowledge transfer learning mechanism not only can effectively extract key features in time period waveform data, but also gradually enhances understanding and identifying capabilities of seismic wave sequences through layer-by-layer knowledge transfer and node fusion. The method not only improves the accuracy and the robustness of seismic wave data analysis, but also remarkably enhances the sensitivity and the prediction precision of seismic monitoring. By generating the reinforced waveform data and the reinforced learning seismic wave sequence, more reliable and data support is provided for earthquake early warning, seismology research and earthquake disaster assessment.
assignees: EARTHQUAKE ADMINISTRATION OF GANSU PROVINCE

title_en: Intelligent equipment integrated management system for power grid distribution network inspection
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent equipment comprehensive management system for power grid distribution network inspection, which comprises a data preprocessing module, a distributed anomaly detection module, a self-adaptive threshold adjustment module, a fault locating and spreading analysis module and an alarm and visualization module, wherein the data preprocessing module carries out hierarchical clustering on sensors to construct a tree structure, each cluster node is provided with a local anomaly detector, the distributed anomaly detection module calculates anomaly scores of data collected by bottom nodes by using a RASA algorithm, the middle nodes gather bottom leaf node information to carry out local anomaly detection, the top nodes gather middle node information to carry out global anomaly detection, the self-adaptive threshold adjustment module dynamically adjusts an anomaly threshold by using an ATA algorithm, and when an anomaly is detected by the fault locating and spreading analysis module, the GCN-FPA module is activated to analyze a fault source and a possible propagation path, and the system can be used for rapidly locating the fault source and predicting the fault propagation path.
assignees: KUITUN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Comprehensive energy system scheduling method based on improved multi-target dung beetle optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive energy system scheduling method based on an improved multi-target dung beetle optimizing algorithm, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a comprehensive energy system model, excavating low-carbon resources from two sides of a source load and analyzing low-carbon characteristics, secondly, establishing a demand response model on an energy utilization side, finally, solving the comprehensive energy system optimizing scheduling model by adopting the improved multi-target dung beetle optimizing algorithm, respectively introducing a rapid non-dominant sorting and crowding degree calculation, introducing a self-adaptive weight coefficient into a dung beetle rolling ball position updating formula, introducing a spiral bubble network optimizing mode into a dung beetle propagation and dung beetle foraging formula, and introducing a Levy flight strategy into the dung beetle foraging position updating formula to improve the convergence accuracy and searching speed of the multi-target dung beetle optimizing algorithm. The invention obviously improves the consumption of new energy output, reduces the emission of CO  2 , reduces the operation cost of the comprehensive energy system and improves the energy utilization benefit of the user side.
assignees: TIANJIN HUAKAI ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Power coal blending method based on improved counter-propagating neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent coal blending, and discloses a power coal blending method based on an improved back propagation neural network, which comprises the steps of obtaining coal blending historical data of different furnace types of a power plant and dividing the coal blending historical data into a plurality of categories; preprocessing the coal blending historical data of different furnace types, dividing the coal blending historical data into a training set, a verification set and a test set, training a preset BP model to obtain a basic model, carrying out model test on the basic model, establishing a target model, collecting raw coal information as input of the target model, and outputting a coal charging proportioning scheme with the lowest comprehensive cost after analysis and calculation of the target model. According to the invention, a BP model is optimized by utilizing a dynamic cuckoo search algorithm, a coal proportioning scheme with the lowest comprehensive cost of coal in a furnace is obtained under the influence of factors such as a production process, a boiler design, coal type characteristics and the like, and the problems that the calculated index coefficient is fixed and cannot be further popularized and a global optimal solution cannot be obtained when an exhaustion method is used for obtaining the optimal solution are solved.
assignees: NINGXIA BAOFENG ENERGY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Modeling method and system for urban environment
abstract_en: The application discloses a modeling method and a modeling system for urban environment, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a Fresnel zone according to longitude and latitude coordinates of a preset zone, extracting environment parameters affecting electric wave propagation in the Fresnel zone according to an electric wave propagation theory, obtaining potential variables in the Fresnel zone according to a preset algorithm, inputting the environment parameters and the potential variables into a preset prediction model to obtain a path loss prediction result, realizing accurate prediction of a point-to-point large-scale channel of the dense urban environment by the method, and the output prediction result can be applied to urban network planning and optimization.
assignees: NAT UNIV DEFENSE TECHNOLOGY PLA

title_en: Power transmission line inspection data asset management method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a transmission line inspection data asset management method and system, which are used for acquiring multi-mode data of a transmission line through various sensors arranged in the transmission line and surrounding environment and sensors carried by a helicopter and an unmanned plane; and generating a fusion data set by processing the multi-mode data based on the space-time correlation model. Analyzing the fusion data set by utilizing a self-adaptive feature extraction algorithm to generate a structured power transmission line data asset comprising environmental features, defect features and hidden danger features, evaluating the possibility of triggering defects by environmental conditions based on the association of the environmental features and the defect features, constructing a graph network model which takes the power transmission line as a node and sensor data as side weights according to the hidden danger features and the environmental conditions, analyzing a defect propagation path and predicting the time and space distribution of hidden dangers, generating a defect risk level early warning based on a prediction result, generating a power transmission line hidden danger distribution map by combining environmental meteorological data, and providing accurate assistance for inspection and maintenance planning.
assignees: STATE GRID POWER SPACE TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: BP neural network-based photovoltaic power station power prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic power station power prediction method and a system of a BP neural network, which relate to the technical field of operation and maintenance and comprise the steps of collecting weather information and historical light power data related to the power of the photovoltaic power station and classifying the historical light power data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a BP neural network model, training the BP neural network by using an error back propagation algorithm, minimizing a loss function, optimizing and iterating a particle swarm based on the prediction error of the BP neural network by defining an fitness function, and finding out an optimal weight and bias combination. The method disclosed by the invention improves the recognition capability of the model to the power change of the photovoltaic power station under different meteorological conditions, lays a foundation for accurate prediction, improves the prediction accuracy, enables the model to be better adapted to the environment change due to the self-adaptive learning capability of the neural network, improves the prediction robustness, improves the generalization capability of the neural network model, reduces the prediction error and improves the overall performance of the power prediction of the photovoltaic power station.
assignees: HUANENG NANJING JINLING POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Power load prediction method and system based on weather prediction model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power load prediction method and a power load prediction system based on a weather prediction model, and relates to the technical field of load prediction, comprising the following steps of acquiring historical power load data and corresponding multidimensional weather data, constructing a weather coupling effect analysis model, and calculating a dynamic coupling weight matrix among weather parameters through an attention mechanism network; the method comprises the steps of carrying out feature fusion on a coupling weight matrix and multidimensional meteorological data through a gating circulation unit to generate space-time coupling feature vectors, establishing an electric load prediction model, extracting short-term fluctuation features and long-term trend features of the electric load from the space-time coupling feature vectors based on a depth residual error network architecture and a parallel convolution channel, updating a dynamic coupling weight matrix based on prediction error back propagation, and realizing self-adaptive adjustment of meteorological parameter coupling relations. According to the invention, the dynamic fusion of the space-time characteristics is realized through the cross gating unit, so that the model can simultaneously utilize the space-time information to predict the power load, and the prediction precision is improved.

title_en: Method and system for adjusting energy consumption of machine room based on AI
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for adjusting energy consumption of a machine room based on AI, which relate to the technical field of energy consumption adjustment, and the method collects all energy consumption devices in the machine room, calculates the importance of each energy consumption device on the work of the machine room, and screens out primary devices and secondary devices; training the preprocessed data by deep learning, capturing the change trend of the energy consumption data along with a time sequence, constructing an energy consumption prediction model, training the preprocessed data by using a convolutional neural network, performing feature learning on equipment state data, constructing a fault early warning model, calculating the correlation between equipment faults and energy consumption changes, analyzing the influence degree of the faults on the energy consumption to obtain a fault energy consumption function, constructing a fault propagation map in a machine room, performing real-time monitoring on the energy consumption data in the machine room by combining the energy consumption prediction model and the fault early warning model, and preparing an energy source regulation strategy according to different monitoring results.
assignees: BEIJING YINGFENGTE ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-micro-network cooperative scheduling method based on master-slave cooperative game and target cascading analysis
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power system dispatching, and relates to a multi-micro-grid cooperative dispatching method based on master-slave cooperative game and target cascading analysis, which utilizes the cooperative dispatching problem of power resources and carbon emission of a multi-micro-grid system to construct a double-layer master-slave cooperative game framework, wherein an upper-layer power grid operator coordinates the power dispatching and operation strategy of a micro-grid alliance based on tide analysis, voltage regulation and carbon emission control; the method comprises the steps of realizing power transaction and resource sharing of each micro-grid of a lower micro-grid alliance through cooperative game, dynamically adjusting the power of a connecting wire by introducing an Andersen acceleration method based on a target cascade analysis algorithm, combining the processing constraint of an augmented Lagrange penalty function, optimizing the decoupling iterative process of the upper layer and the lower layer, accelerating convergence, effectively solving the problem of low efficiency of multi-main-body cooperative optimization, ensuring stable system power and reasonable distribution of electric energy resources, and providing technical support for the operation of a multi-micro-grid system.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Intelligent positioning and diagnosing method for optical fiber composite faults of power distribution network based on hybrid sensing
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent positioning and diagnosing method for optical fiber composite faults of a power distribution network based on hybrid sensing, which relates to the technical field of power distribution networks and comprises the steps of acquiring and preprocessing optical fibers and electric sensing data, extracting time-frequency domain characteristics through a multichannel convolutional neural network, and calculating a dynamic weight coefficient by using an attention mechanism to perform feature fusion, constructing a dynamic fault propagation diagram, and performing space-time feature extraction by combining diagram convolution and causal convolution to realize fault positioning and type identification. The invention can fully utilize multi-source heterogeneous data, improves fault positioning accuracy and diagnosis reliability, and is suitable for fault diagnosis of a complex power distribution network.

title_en: Elasticity evaluation method for AC/DC series-parallel power information physical system under cooperative attack
abstract_en: The invention discloses an elasticity evaluation method of an alternating current-direct current hybrid power information physical system under a collaborative attack, which is used for constructing a multidimensional heterogeneous model of the alternating current-direct current hybrid power information physical system according to an actual information network framework and completing matrixing modeling of the alternating current-direct current hybrid power information physical system based on a method of an incidence matrix. And then, based on a matrixing modeling method, information physical cooperative attack is constructed, so that diversified cooperative attack can be carried out on the multidimensional heterogeneous model, and cascade fault diffusion is caused. Finally, a new elastic index, namely a cascading failure recovery index CFRI, is provided, wherein the index considers the factors such as the node number, branch number and load quantity of the system during the cascade failure diffusion so as to evaluate the disconnection capability and recovery capability of the AC/DC series-parallel power information physical system in the face of the cascade failure. The method can effectively complete the elasticity evaluation of the AC/DC series-parallel power information physical system under the cooperative attack, and reduce the influence of an attacker on the power grid to the greatest extent.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: Multi-traffic subarea distributed collaborative optimization method and system based on double-layer architecture
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-traffic subarea distributed collaborative optimization method and system based on a double-layer framework, which relate to the technical field of traffic control and automatic control and comprise the steps of constructing a weighted directed graph by utilizing a road network model, dividing the weighted directed graph into a plurality of traffic subareas, constructing an upper-layer multi-subarea collaborative optimization model based on a macroscopic basic graph of each traffic subarea to obtain the optimal accumulated number of vehicles of each traffic subarea under collaborative control, taking the optimal accumulated number of vehicles of each traffic subarea as the constraint of a lower-layer single-subarea optimization control model, optimizing each intersection timing in the traffic subarea to obtain the optimal timing scheme of a controlled road network, solving the optimal accumulated number of each subarea under collaborative control by the upper layer based on the double-layer cascading framework, and carrying out cascading and continuous parameter updating on the conditions of each intersection in the subarea by the subarea boundary control, thereby carrying out multi-subarea collaborative optimization.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG

title_en: Supply chain network optimization method and equipment based on risk classification propagation and dynamic recovery
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of supply chain management and risk control, and particularly relates to a supply chain network optimization method based on risk grading propagation and dynamic recovery, which provides a supply chain risk propagation and recovery model based on a complex network theory and an optimization method thereof, wherein a supply chain model based on a supply chain network topology structure is firstly constructed, a supply chain network topology structure G= (V, E) is formed by N nodes and E edges, and each node represents an enterprise in a supply chain network; and simulating risks of each enterprise in the supply chain by using a supply chain model, and optimizing the enterprises in the supply chain based on simulation results. The method is used for simulating risk propagation dynamics among enterprises and optimizing a network structure, and improves the overall toughness and risk resistance of a supply chain network.
assignees: UNIV HANGZHOU DIANZI

title_en: Multi-layer coupling power system risk propagation analysis method based on space-time diagram neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a time-space diagram neural network-based risk propagation analysis method for a multi-layer coupling power system, and belongs to the technical field of power systems. The method comprises the steps of constructing an information-electric power-traffic three-layer heterogeneous coupling network model, collecting physical quantity in the heterogeneous coupling network, constructing graph data based on neighborhood and connectivity, constructing a risk propagation prediction model based on a space-time multi-graph neural network, enabling a space learning network to comprise k parallel graph convolution layers, enabling a time learning network to be realized by combining a long-short-period memory network LSTM and an attention mechanism, obtaining history graph data of normal operation of the heterogeneous coupling network and history graph data with faults, inputting the history graph data into the prediction model for training, enabling the graph structure to be adaptively updated, and predicting a risk propagation path in the three-layer heterogeneous coupling network by using the trained risk propagation prediction model. The invention realizes the risk propagation path in the three-layer heterogeneous complex network structure of information-electric power-traffic and can reflect the real-time space-time relationship.

title_en: Lake and reservoir type water source protection area precise division method based on multi-time space scale index dynamic coupling
abstract_en: The invention provides a lake and reservoir type water source protection area precise dividing method based on multi-time space scale index dynamic coupling, which constructs a risk propagation network and a multi-scale index dynamic weight distribution model in a water source area through multi-time space scale decomposition and feature extraction, utilizes a cross-scale index association transfer calculation frame to realize information fusion among different time space scale indexes, constructs a time-space scale self-adaptive QQEM-PSR evaluation system based on a scale coupling feature space and a dynamic weight matrix, and solves the technical problems of difficult multi-time space scale index coupling, insufficient risk evaluation staticization and protection area boundary optimization and the like in the traditional method, thereby realizing precise division and dynamic optimization management of the water source protection area.

title_en: Power plant steam extraction energy storage and power generation optimization method and system based on molten salt heat storage
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for optimizing steam extraction energy storage and power generation of a power plant based on molten salt heat storage, and relates to the technical field of power, and the method comprises the steps of adopting an intelligent regulating valve group to accurately control steam extraction quantity and steam extraction pressure, introducing extracted steam into a multistage serial steam-molten salt heat exchanger group, adopting a multi-path parallel molten salt conveying system to convey high-temperature molten salt to a cascade molten salt-water heat exchanger group when the load of a power grid is higher than a preset dynamic threshold value, adopting a structure combining countercurrent heat exchange and spiral heat exchange pipes in the molten salt-water heat exchanger group to improve heat exchange efficiency and generate superheated steam, conveying the generated high-temperature high-pressure steam to an improved steam turbine with variable air inlet area, dynamically regulating the air inlet area according to the load requirement of the power grid, optimizing the efficiency of the steam turbine, and realizing bidirectional interaction of a power generation end and a power utilization end by utilizing an intelligent power grid technology and a requirement side response strategy to dynamically balance the power supply and demand.
assignees: GUONENG HEBEI LONGSHAN POWER GENERATION CO LTD;HEPU ENERGY ENVIRONMENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic power generation power ultra-short-term prediction method and system based on hybrid neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a photovoltaic power generation power ultra-short-term prediction method and system based on a hybrid neural network, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring and preprocessing historical characteristic data, constructing the input of the neural network, and carrying out original sampling time sequence of the photovoltaic power generation power in the preprocessing characteristic time sequence Performing CEEMDN decomposition to obtain CEEMDAN decomposition sequence, and combining to obtain combined characteristics The method comprises the steps of constructing M+1 GRU-Attention neural network models, processing combined characteristics to obtain a final predicted value IM F  m  of an mth GRU-Attention neural network, and training the M+1 GRU-Attention neural network models through back propagation and gradient descent algorithms to obtain a photovoltaic power generation short-term prediction model so as to predict photovoltaic power generation power. The method solves the technical problems that modeling capability of time dependence is not strong, photovoltaic power generation power prediction precision and calculation efficiency are to be improved, stability and integrity of a decomposition process are difficult to ensure, noise interference is caused by a modal aliasing phenomenon, and adaptability and robustness of a model to photovoltaic power generation fluctuation characteristics are low.
assignees: STATE GRID ANHUI POWER CO LTD CHUZHOU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY;UNIV HEFEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Earthquake prediction method and system based on optical fiber micro-vibration monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake prediction method and system based on optical fiber micro-vibration monitoring, comprising the following steps of S1, adopting a dynamic self-adaptive acquisition frequency adjustment mechanism to acquire micro-vibration signals, acquiring data at the frequency of 1kHz in a distributed optical fiber sensing network, simultaneously acquiring the fluctuation condition of the data, setting a fluctuation threshold, and when the fluctuation condition of the micro-vibration signals continuously exceeds the fluctuation threshold in m continuous time windows, acquiring the frequency to be increased to 10kHz to acquire the data and count all micro-vibration signal data, S2, constructing a cross-correlation coefficient matrix of the micro-vibration signal data among different acquisition frequencies through all the micro-vibration signal data, acquiring direction information and propagation velocity information among different monitoring points based on corresponding values in the cross-correlation coefficient matrix to form spatial characteristic parameters, comprehensively capturing the spatial propagation characteristics of the signals, and effectively solving the one-sided problem of the traditional method.

title_en: Method for adjusting annual power generation plan of step hydropower under electric power market environment before month
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of hydroelectric power generation, and discloses a method for adjusting a cascade hydroelectric annual power generation plan before month in an electric power market environment, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a power generation plan adjustment model, modeling benefits and operation requirements of hydroelectric power generation, inter-provincial power transmission and provincial power consumption, introducing opportunity constraint to describe risks of water level overrun of a hydropower station caused by runoff uncertainty, constructing two indexes of line disturbance rate and contract net adjustment rate to respectively manage influences of contract adjustment on a power transmission side and a power consumption side, modeling points on coupling relations between two types of power transmission modes of a network and a network-to-network and multi-provincial and multi-variety contracts, and then constructing The solving method is used for converting the power generation plan adjustment model into an SAA model and iteratively adjusting the risk level of the SAA model And finally, obtaining a contract adjustment scheme of the step hydropower. The invention can effectively solve the problem of contract adjustment, and the provided solving method can accelerate the obtaining of a feasible solution with high confidence on the basis of ensuring the solving precision.

title_en: Electric power construction process early warning method and system based on high-precision three-dimensional model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an early warning method and system for an electric power foundation construction process based on a high-precision three-dimensional model, and relates to the technical field of electric power foundation construction, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source data of an electric power foundation construction site and constructing the high-precision three-dimensional model comprising equipment space coordinates, construction time sequence labels and environmental parameters; the method comprises the steps of inputting a space-time diagram into a space-time diagram convolution network, outputting a risk propagation probability matrix of a three-dimensional space and a construction time sequence dimension, identifying high-risk nodes and associated construction stages, dynamically marking root coordinates and a risk diffusion range in a high-precision three-dimensional model, generating an early warning instruction containing a visual path, a root report and a treatment priority, and pushing the early warning instruction to a terminal through an edge node in real time. The method is based on a layered space-time attention-physical constraint graph convolution network, dynamically distributes inter-node cross-stage association weights, optimizes convolution kernel parameters in combination with physical connection strength, and remarkably improves space-time association of high-risk node identification.

title_en: Quantitative evaluation method and system for fire risk of distribution network equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quantitative evaluation method and a quantitative evaluation system for fire risks of distribution network equipment, wherein the quantitative evaluation method comprises the steps of obtaining distribution network equipment data, constructing a quantitative first risk evaluation model based on the data, carrying out preliminary risk judgment based on the quantitative first risk evaluation model, analyzing fault transfer risks and calculating overall risk state values, constructing a quantitative second risk evaluation model for predicting the change condition of risk parameters, dynamically updating the overall risk state values, and carrying out fire risk early warning by combining the change condition of the risk parameters. According to the method, the transfer risk among the risk factors of the equipment can be dynamically monitored by calculating the starting condition value and the propagation threshold value according to the fuzzy membership degree of the nodes of different risk factors, and the nodes with high risk membership degree are amplified by calculating the risk contribution degree through the nonlinear function, so that the influence on the overall risk is more remarkable, and the influence on key nodes is facilitated to be highlighted when the overall risk of the system is evaluated.

title_en: Power distribution network reliability assessment method and device
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of power grid systems, and particularly discloses a power distribution network reliability assessment method and device. According to the application, by acquiring one or more reliability index data which are strongly related to the reliability of the power distribution network in the current period, obtaining entropy values and weight data corresponding to the one or more reliability index data through an entropy value method, calculating the reliability evaluation result of the power distribution network in the future period by applying a back propagation neural network to the obtained entropy values and weights, accurately predicting the reliability of the power distribution network, and improving the reliability of the power distribution network under the development of distributed power generation.
assignees: NO 709 RES INSTITUTE OF CHINA STATE SHIPBUILDING CORPORATION LIMITED

title_en: Distributed marine seismic monitoring and data processing system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a distributed marine seismic monitoring and data processing system based on the Internet of things, which comprises a marine node seismic sensor network, edge computing equipment, a distributed Internet of things platform, a central data processing server, a multi-wave source numerical simulation module and a visual early warning platform, wherein a data processing algorithm is used for optimizing wave field simulation of marine seismic and submarine landslide, displaying a tsunami wave propagation path, intensity and expected arrival time in real time, and carrying out abnormal wave detection and early warning based on wave field topology change rate.
assignees: OCEAN UNIV CHINA

title_en: Container port cascade failure risk assessment method based on ship flow distribution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a container port cascade failure risk assessment method based on ship flow dynamic allocation, which comprises the steps of extracting airlines from mass container ship AIS track data and constructing a directional weighted shipping network, generating alternative substitute port sets for an interrupted port based on network topology features and space neighbor effects, determining 3 optimal substitute ports of the interrupted port by integrating multi-source shipping big data of the port, constructing a port cascade failure risk modeling method based on linear Motter-Lai model assumption, constructing 3 port cascade failure risk assessment indexes under a shipping scene, assessing the influence degree of the container shipping network after the port is interrupted, and exploring a dynamic cascade failure risk diffusion process and a dynamic cascade failure risk diffusion mechanism by combining a geographic visualization method. The method enriches the prior knowledge system of dynamic risk assessment of the global container transportation system, and provides important practical significance for container cascade failure risk management and countermeasure research.
assignees: INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS

title_en: Power load prediction model establishment method based on convolution two-way long-short-term memory network and attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power load prediction model building method based on a convolution two-way long-short-term memory network and an attention mechanism, which is characterized in that a one-dimensional convolution network is used for fully extracting characteristics of original complex power load data, and the characteristics of factors influencing load, the trend, periodicity, randomness and the like of load change can be more fully mastered by considering multi-element characteristics, and compared with the traditional LSTM, the two-way structure of BiLSTM can more comprehensively capture the two-way dependency relationship in load sequence data through forward propagation and backward propagation, so that the understanding of the model on the data is improved. In addition, the invention applies the attention mechanism widely applied in the natural language processing field to the research of multi-element short-term power load prediction, and the attention mechanism can focus on key information in a load sequence to further improve the prediction precision, and experiments are carried out on a real multi-element load data set, so that the precision of multi-element short-term load prediction can be effectively improved by adding a one-dimensional convolution network and the attention mechanism.
assignees: UNIV GUILIN ELECTRONIC TECH

title_en: Reservoir dispatching method considering power grid load change
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir dispatching method considering power grid load change, which makes up the defect that a power station lacks consideration to the overall change trend of a power grid and lacks consideration to the benefits of the power station when carrying out peak regulation, provides a concept of the power grid load demand satisfaction rate for representing the consistency strong and weak relation between reservoir output and the power grid load change process, introduces the power grid demand satisfaction punishment factors into a traditional reservoir power generation dispatching model, designs ten groups of conversion functions, calculates the punishment factors in the power generation process of the power grid and the power grid load change process, and builds a cascade reservoir dispatching model considering the power grid load demand satisfaction rate.

title_en: Airport apron operation risk assessment method based on complex network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an airport apron operation risk assessment method based on a complex network, and belongs to the technical field of risk control. The method comprises the steps of analyzing an apron safety report by adopting an event chain analysis method to construct a complex network, determining a risk static index of each node, simulating a dynamic propagation process of risks in the complex network based on a SIRS model, determining the risk dynamic index of each node, classifying the nodes by adopting a spectral clustering algorithm with the dynamic and static indexes of each node as characteristics, respectively calculating an average risk comprehensive value of each cluster node and determining a risk grade of each cluster node based on a quantile, acquiring a risk event of an airport apron at a certain moment, determining the risk comprehensive value and the risk grade of each risk event, and carrying out hierarchical classification management on the risk comprehensive value and the risk grade. The invention constructs a multidimensional risk assessment index system to assess the risk transmission capacity and blocking capacity of the nodes, realizes the classification and grading of the risk nodes, and can provide scientific decision support for airport managers.
assignees: UNIV CIVIL AVIATION FLIGHT CHINA

title_en: Cascade hydropower span power supply capacity pricing method and system for responding peak regulation demand of receiving end power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pricing method and a pricing system for cascade hydropower span power supply capacity in response to peak regulation demands of a receiving end power grid, and belongs to the field of hydroelectric generation. The method comprises the steps of dividing the electricity price peak-to-valley period of a receiving end, drawing up a feasible time-sharing electricity price scheme set, then establishing a cascade hydroelectric multi-province power generation model, finally inputting the time-sharing electricity price scheme into the cascade hydroelectric multi-province power generation model, calculating an output force curve of the cascade hydroelectric for 24 hours, calculating two evaluation indexes of electricity purchasing cost and peak regulation effect of the receiving end power grid, optimizing the time-sharing electricity price scheme through a non-dominant sorting algorithm, setting index weight, defining a preference function, and selecting a scheme with the smallest preference function value as an optimal time-sharing pricing scheme. Under the condition of meeting the maximum generating income, the invention effectively promotes the response of the peak shaving requirement of the power grid of the receiving end, realizes the balance of the self-generated power and the electric quantity of the sending end and the receiving end at the level of hours, has controllable purchasing cost of the power grid of the receiving end, and realizes win-win of the power plant and the power grid of the receiving end.

title_en: Power grid cascading failure risk prediction method, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid cascading failure risk prediction method, equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of power system safety. The power grid cascading failure risk prediction method comprises the steps of obtaining voltage or power flow of a target line, determining risk measurement results of the target line at different time phases by adopting risk measurement indexes based on fluctuation of the voltage or the power flow, and determining risk prediction results of the target line by weighting and accumulating the voltage or the power flow at each time phase based on the risk measurement results. When predicting the risk, the method divides the voltage or the power flow into time periods, and weights and accumulates the voltage or the power flow in each time period based on the risk measurement result of the voltage or the power flow in the time period, namely, the contribution degree of the voltage or the power flow data to the line risk is considered in the time dimension and the risk dimension.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Oil-gas pipe network running state risk perception early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk perception early warning method and a system for the running state of an oil-gas pipe network, wherein the method comprises the steps of fusing multidimensional features of the running state of the pipe network according to real-time running data of the oil-gas pipe network to generate a space-time feature matrix; the method comprises the steps of inputting a space-time feature matrix into a deep Gaussian process model, carrying out probabilistic modeling on abnormal features in the running state of a pipe network, outputting a risk feature vector with confidence, constructing a three-dimensional risk concentration distribution field according to the risk feature vector, predicting the propagation path and the diffusion trend of the risk concentration distribution field, constructing a self-adaptive early warning threshold generation model based on the generation of an countermeasure network aiming at a prediction result, generating a multi-level early warning threshold changing along with the running state of the pipe network, and realizing risk perception early warning of the running state of the oil-gas pipe network according to the comparison result of the real-time risk feature and the early warning threshold. By utilizing the embodiment of the invention, dynamic risk assessment and self-adaptive early warning can be realized, and the safety and emergency response capability of the pipe network are enhanced.

title_en: Multi-physical-field collaborative simulation optimization method for structure and function integrated phased-array antenna
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-physical-field collaborative simulation optimization method of a structure and function integrated phased array antenna, which comprises the steps of splitting an overall model of the antenna, sequentially carrying out electromagnetic simulation on an electromagnetic simulation model of a power division network, carrying out circuit simulation on a chip equivalent spice cascade circuit simulation model, carrying out full-array thermal simulation and a radome force simulation model, carrying out force simulation on the full-array thermal simulation model, carrying out circuit simulation again on the chip equivalent spice cascade circuit simulation model, carrying out electromagnetic simulation on subarray electromagnetic simulation models of each antenna, carrying out full-array directional diagram synthesis on subarray directional diagrams, judging whether parameters output by each simulation model of a collaborative simulation optimization overall process meet preset requirements, completing collaborative simulation optimization of multiple physical fields of paths, heat, force and electromagnetism, otherwise, adopting an optimization algorithm to adjust optimization variables of corresponding module simulation models, and realizing efficient collaborative simulation optimization of the antenna under the coupling action of multiple physical fields of force, heat, electricity and the like.
assignees: BEIJING RES INST MECHANICAL & ELECTRICAL TECH

title_en: Short-term load prediction method based on multi-scale space-time DCNN feature extraction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-term load prediction method based on multi-scale space-time DCNN feature extraction, which specifically comprises the following steps of S1, acquiring and preprocessing historical load data of an electric power system and related influence factor data, S2, carrying out correlation analysis on the load data, determining the maximum correlation time lag of a load time sequence, further determining the size of an optimal sliding time window, S3, constructing a backbone network based on a recursive feature pyramid, adopting expansion convolution as a feature extraction network, combining a bidirectional gating circulation unit to carry out time sequence feature modeling, carrying out counter propagation by using calculation loss in a joint loss function, and updating model parameters, S4, predicting the load data in the future in a short term by using a trained model, and evaluating the prediction accuracy of the model by using a correlation evaluation index. According to the invention, the time sequence is analyzed through ACF and PACF, and the sliding time window is scientifically set. The RFP-DCNN-BiGRU model fully combines the capabilities of DCNN and BiGRU in feature extraction and time sequence data modeling, and achieves more accurate short-term load prediction.
assignees: UNIV CHANGSHA SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Smart power grid relay protection reliability assessment and promotion control method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating and improving the reliability of a smart power grid relay protection, and relates to the technical field of smart power grid relay protection. The fault mode, collaborative anomalies, and reliability levels are identified at the device level, interval level, and station level, respectively, using a multi-stage fault diagnosis model, and the fault propagation paths and effects are predicted based on a causal inference network. And finally, constructing a layered cooperative control strategy, and realizing coordination optimization of protection fixed values through multi-objective optimization, distributed game optimization and layered rolling optimization, thereby improving the reliability of the relay protection device, reducing the fault propagation probability and ensuring the safe and stable operation of the power grid.
assignees: MINYUE NETWORK POWER OPERATION CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;EHV BRANCH STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Self-healing control and energy efficiency optimization method and system for box-type substation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric power automation, and particularly relates to a self-healing control and energy efficiency optimization method and system of a box-type transformer substation, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting three-phase current, voltage waveforms and temperature parameters of equipment in the box-type transformer substation, constructing a space-time correlation characteristic matrix, and extracting a dynamic operation mode; the method comprises the steps of constructing an impedance parameter nonlinear propagation model, calculating node credibility propagation values, constructing a multi-objective optimization model for dynamic weight optimization, solving a topology reconstruction strategy under asymmetric constraint conditions, optimizing voltage in energy storage scheduling parameters based on the topology reconstruction strategy, generating an inertia weight self-adaptive control instruction by combining an optical fiber self-healing ring network communication channel, and correcting the voltages in the dynamic weight and the energy storage scheduling parameters in real time through a closed loop feedback mechanism to complete dynamic performance compensation and energy efficiency optimization iteration. The invention realizes rapid and accurate fault diagnosis, self-healing control and dynamic energy efficiency optimization by monitoring and optimizing the operation parameters of the box-type substation in real time.
assignees: BEIJING HEROSAIL POWER SCI & TECH CO LTD;TAIHE POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Remote correlation feature mining method, system, equipment and medium for flood cascade
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote correlation feature mining method, system, equipment and medium for flood cascade, which relate to the technical field of flood disaster assessment and comprise the steps of constructing a cascade flood database through extreme flood events, constructing a plurality of directed complex networks, inputting time information of cascade flood into the directed complex networks, analyzing the outflow and inflow of the flood by using single variable pairs and cross variable pairs of the flood, carrying out flood synchronization on precipitation and runoff, precipitation and flow and between runoff and flow, representing a flood cascade phenomenon, extracting network indexes of flood propagation features, network clustering and synchronization strength in the flood cascade phenomenon, and taking the network indexes as remote correlation features of the flood cascade. The invention adopts a complex network analysis method to clarify flood propagation and synchronization mechanism, comprises a plurality of hydrologic variables such as precipitation, runoff and flow, and the like, and researches reveal some remarkable characteristics, and compared with other networks, the flood network related to runoff shows higher connectivity.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI;UNIV EAST CHINA NORMAL

title_en: Water supply plant residual chlorine prediction method based on cascade time sequence neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a residual chlorine prediction method for a water supply plant based on a cascade time sequence neural network, and relates to the technical field of water quality prediction. The invention discloses a water supply plant residual chlorine prediction method based on a cascade time sequence neural network, which comprises the steps of collecting historical data, carrying out data cleaning on the historical data, constructing a water supply plant residual chlorine prediction model of the cascade time sequence neural network, training the model by using preprocessed data until the model converges, comprehensively evaluating the prediction performance of the model by adopting test set data.
assignees: ANHUI SHUNYU WATER AFFAIRS CO LTD

title_en: Flood risk propagation assessment method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood risk propagation assessment method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of calculating a flood risk value of each sub-river basin in a research area according to an acquired flood risk assessment index variable of the research area; the method comprises the steps of grading flood risk values to obtain flood risk grades of each sub-river basin in a research area, constructing a Markov chain space-time model, determining a flood risk space-time propagation rule according to the Markov chain space-time model, fitting a flood risk propagation function according to the flood risk space-time propagation rule, determining a flood risk transfer blocking effect of the flood control hydraulic engineering according to the flood risk propagation function, flood control hydraulic engineering operation information data and historical flood data, constructing a flood risk space-time propagation network model with space-time dependency relationship, and evaluating the research area according to the flood risk space-time propagation network model to obtain a flood risk propagation evaluation result.
assignees: UNIV XIAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Large power grid cascading failure electromagnetic transient simulation scene construction method, system and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large power grid cascading failure electromagnetic transient simulation scene construction method, and discloses a system and a medium with the large power grid cascading failure electromagnetic transient simulation scene construction method, wherein the large power grid cascading failure electromagnetic transient simulation scene construction method provides a cascading failure scene constructed by cascading failure simulation scenes of primary and secondary system automatic modeling and splicing of a large power grid, and compared with the cascading failure scene based on tide data or electromechanical transient simulation data, the cascading failure scene construction method has higher precision, and can meet the modeling requirements of novel power system cascading failure scenes containing a large number of power electronic equipment. The full-grid electromagnetic transient modeling efficiency and the scale of the large power grid are remarkably improved, and an effective simulation means is provided for accurate reproduction of the large power grid cascading failure evolution process.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Urban rail transit network cascade failure analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network cascading failure analysis method and system for urban rail transit, which belong to the technical field of rail transit and control science, and are characterized by acquiring self capacity of each station, identifying key stations of a time-varying network of the urban rail transit in each time step, marking the stations attacked by the key stations as failure stations, judging whether each station fails by comparing whether real-time loads of the stations of the time-varying network of the urban rail transit in each time step exceed self capacity of corresponding stations, marking the stations with the real-time loads exceeding the self capacity as failure stations, acquiring residual capacity of adjacent stations of the failure stations, redistributing real-time loads of the failure stations, and analyzing the cascading failure process of the urban rail transit network according to a redistributing result. The method can accurately grasp the dynamic change of the key stations of the urban rail transit time-varying network in the cascade failure process, so that the cascade failure process of the urban rail transit network is better analyzed.
assignees: UNIV LANZHOU JIAOTONG

title_en: Inlet end impedance calculation method of saturated reactor broadband equivalent circuit model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an input impedance calculation method of a saturated reactor broadband equivalent circuit model, and relates to the technical field of impedance analysis of power systems. The method comprises the steps of enabling a broadband equivalent circuit model of a saturation reactor in a converter valve to be equivalent to a passive two-port network connected with a load, conducting decoupling equivalent operation on inductance containing mutual inductance in the passive two-port network, taking each element except the load in the broadband equivalent circuit model of the saturation reactor after decoupling as one two-port, determining a transmission parameter matrix of each two-port, obtaining the transmission parameter matrix of the passive two-port network according to a two-port cascading principle and the transmission parameter matrix of each two-port, and determining the input impedance of the broadband equivalent circuit model of the saturation reactor according to the relation between the transmission parameter matrix of the passive two-port network and input voltage, input current, output voltage and output current. The method can improve the calculation efficiency of the impedance of the input end of the wideband equivalent circuit model of the saturation reactor.
assignees: CSG EHV POWER TRANS CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: Smart power grid load prediction system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power load prediction, in particular to a smart grid load prediction system and a smart grid load prediction method. According to the method, the load change rate is extracted, the load increment and the load flow proportion are calculated, the load dynamic coupling relation is described, the voltage phase angle deviation is calculated by combining the power grid topology, the connectivity of a load prediction area is enhanced, the response capacity of a model to sudden fluctuation is improved based on the forward load propagation delay adjustment parameter, the load slope is analyzed by combining weather data, the temperature and humidity sensitive interval is set, the extreme weather adaptability is enhanced, the input parameter is optimized by utilizing the load coupling correction value, the data distortion is reduced, the long-term prediction stability is improved, the load dynamic adjustment, the weather influence modeling and the input optimization precision are improved, and the accurate support is provided for power grid dispatching.

title_en: Urban infrastructure cascade fault analysis method based on high-order network model
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of urban construction, and provides a method for analyzing cascading faults of urban infrastructure based on a high-order network model. The method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-layer network model of an urban infrastructure system, characterizing interaction among a plurality of network nodes in the multi-layer network model by adopting a simple replica structure to obtain a high-order network model of the urban infrastructure system, setting a node fault mechanism and a region fault mechanism of the high-order network model, performing cascading failure simulation on the high-order network model under a preset cascading failure situation, and finally identifying high-risk nodes in the high-order network model according to cascading failure simulation results based on network comprehensive factors of cascading failures of the defined high-order network model so as to improve elasticity of the urban infrastructure system corresponding to the high-risk nodes. By means of the method, the high-risk nodes of the urban infrastructure are more effectively identified, and the elastic risk-resistant capability of the urban infrastructure system is improved to provide support and basis.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING;STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Method for minimizing service interruption and related equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a method and related equipment for minimizing service interruption, and relates to the technical field of wireless communication. The method comprises the steps that a terminal device sends a registration request message to a first network element, the registration request message carries indication information of supporting MINT by the terminal device, a registration acceptance message sent by the first network element is received, the registration acceptance message is generated according to subscription data of the terminal device sent by a second network element to the first network element, and the subscription data of the terminal device comprises PLMN information used under a disaster condition and PLMN associated access type information used under the disaster condition. The method and the device can fully ensure the continuity of the terminal data service and can develop wide-area emergency communication service.
assignees: CHINA TELECOM CO LTD;CHINA TELECOM CORP LTD TECHNOLOGY INNOVATION CENTER

title_en: System security analysis method based on complex state network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a system security analysis method based on a complex state network, and belongs to the technical field of system security. The system refers to an aircraft overall system or an aircraft component system, and comprises the steps of constructing a finite state machine network comprising a state transition relation based on each key component of the system and a function influence relation among the key components, forming a state vector representing the overall state of the system at a certain moment based on the state of each key component at the moment, determining evolution rules of all the state vectors based on the finite state machine network, constructing a state evolution network of the system based on the evolution rules, determining a plurality of final vectors of the overall state of the system based on the state evolution network, determining risk levels of all the final vectors, and obtaining a safety analysis result of the system based on the risk levels and propagation paths corresponding to the final vectors. According to the invention, the safety boundary of the system state evolution is determined based on the attractor theory of the dissipation system, and the potential safety risk of the system is obtained through analysis, so that the early warning and avoidance of the risk are realized.
assignees: UNIV BEIHANG

title_en: Automatic monitoring and early warning method for water environment
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic water environment monitoring and early warning method which comprises the steps of constructing a space model of a water environment change state, simulating a water power and water quality space distribution field of river nodes, obtaining historical water quality pollution data of a river basin node relation network, calculating a time interval when pollutants in an upstream river basin node reach a current river basin node based on the space model of the water environment change state, taking the historical water quality pollution data of the upstream river basin node at a starting point of the time interval as input, taking the historical water quality pollution data of the current river basin node at an ending point of the time interval as output, obtaining a trained feedforward depth neural network, and predicting the water environment data of the current river basin node at the next moment by taking the trained feedforward depth neural network as input. The invention can more accurately simulate the propagation process of pollutants in the water body, and improves the accuracy and reliability of water quality prediction.
assignees: YUNNAN ACADEMY OF ECO ENV SCIENCES

title_en: Underground cavern group rock drilling efficiency prediction method and equipment based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground cavern group rock drilling efficiency prediction method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps of 1, collecting relevant data of underground cavern group drilling efficiency and influence factors thereof, taking the collected data as original data, 2, preprocessing the collected original data, compiling a sample data set, 3, building a drilling efficiency prediction model based on a back propagation neural network, training the drilling efficiency prediction model by adopting the sample data set, 4, optimizing super parameters of a hidden layer structure in the drilling efficiency prediction model by adopting a BFO algorithm, 5, monitoring the underground cavern group drilling efficiency and the influence factors thereof in the construction process, preprocessing the monitored data, and predicting the drilling efficiency in the construction process by adopting the optimized drilling efficiency prediction model. According to the invention, the bacterial foraging optimization algorithm is selected to optimize the model hyper-parameters, so that the model training effect is improved.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: Generalized topology recapture method for totally blind power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention provides a generalized topology restoration method for a full-blind power distribution network. And sequentially injecting natural transient disturbance generated by system operation by utilizing the edge nodes, sequentially collecting transient disturbance response waveforms of all receiving points, extracting distortion points of the transient disturbance response waveforms of all receiving points based on wavelet analysis, calculating disturbance propagation length according to the distortion points, calculating the length of a common cable, and extracting a trunk branch matrix. The sampling rate is further improved, the non-branch variable cross section nodes are extracted, and the network topology is reconstructed. And (3) identifying the branch section by extracting the edge cable section according to network topology and cable variable section rule analysis. Tests on a real 10kV network confirm the feasibility of the method on generalized topology recapture. The method provides a possible solution for solving the new challenges of topology re-picking of the full-blind distribution network.
assignees: UNIV KUNMING SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Dynamic identification method for risk evolution law of complex water network system
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic identification method of a complex water network system risk evolution law, which comprises the steps of collecting basic information and identifying risk factors to obtain a risk factor sample set, dividing hydraulic engineering of a water network research area into three-level mutual feedback layered structures to construct a multi-target real-time risk scheduling model, solving to obtain a risk scheduling scheme set, combining the risk scheduling scheme set and aiming at the layered structures of the complex water network system, establishing a real-time scheduling risk propagation model and a global real-time risk propagation network model of each level, respectively identifying vulnerability nodes and key risk paths of each level based on the global real-time risk propagation network model, and carrying out cross-level node dominance mapping on the vulnerability nodes and the key risk paths of the whole water network system. The method comprehensively considers multiple uncertainties, improves the calculation efficiency and the accuracy of risk positioning, and has important significance for risk regulation and control of the water network system.

title_en: Urban energy system uncertainty propagation reasoning method based on evidence theory
abstract_en: The invention relates to an uncertainty propagation reasoning method of an urban energy system based on an evidence theory, which is technically characterized by establishing network node topology according to an energy conveying structure, judging connection relation between two nodes, calculating integral uncertainty information of the two nodes if the two nodes are connected in series, respectively calculating uncertainty ranges of the two nodes if the two nodes are connected in parallel, respectively forming two pieces of evidence by utilizing the information of the two nodes, respectively rewriting initial evidence through a weighted mass function, obtaining a synthesis result by adopting a D-S synthesis rule, establishing a class probability likelihood function to carry out information distribution, calculating the uncertainty information based on the information distribution result, and forming integral uncertainty information of the two nodes.
assignees: UNIV HEBEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Construction and resolving method for optimal scheduling model of cascade hydropower station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction and resolving method of an optimal scheduling model of a cascade hydropower station, and relates to the technical field of construction of optimal scheduling models of cascade hydropower stations. According to the invention, by means of the dynamic optimization scheduling method, the cascade hydropower station can optimize water resource allocation according to hydrologic changes, power grid requirements and reservoir adjustment capacity, so that the water energy utilization rate is improved, and water abandoning is reduced. Under the support of power grid load prediction, the output of the hydropower station is adjusted, the peak regulation capacity is enhanced, and the stability of the power system is improved. The successive approximation dynamic programming algorithm is adopted, so that the calculation complexity of multi-reservoir joint optimization is reduced, the scheduling efficiency is improved, the overall scheduling is optimized by combining with the artificial intelligent algorithm, and the economical efficiency and the reliability of the operation of the cascade hydropower station are ensured.
assignees: HUANENG TIBET YARLUNG ZANGBO RIVER HYDROPOWER DEVELOPMENT AND INVEST CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent power transmission line management and control method and system based on power distribution data feedback
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent control method and system for a power transmission line based on power distribution data feedback, which relate to the technical field of power transmission line control and comprise the following steps: by integrating multi-source data, a historical environment-electric coupling characteristic matrix is constructed, a long-short-time memory network is utilized to extract time sequence characteristics, a convolutional neural network is combined to capture a spatial distribution rule, and a dynamic line loss prediction model is established to simulate minimum line loss values in different environment scenes. Detecting abnormal time periods through an isolated forest algorithm, screening key damage factors by combining Pearson correlation analysis and SHAP value analysis, dynamically generating and executing a damage reduction strategy priority event, and optimizing model parameters by utilizing error back propagation and reinforcement learning. And finally, generating a typical environmental scene loss reduction case library based on an optimization model, and simulating strategy effectiveness under extreme conditions through a digital twin technology to form a reusable decision rule set, so that the running efficiency and the power supply reliability of the power transmission line are improved.
assignees: KARAMAY PETROLOR ENERGY SERVICES CO LTD;XINJIANG PETROLOR ENERGY SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Hydrogen energy system safety assessment method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrogen energy system safety assessment method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps of S1, collecting dynamic operation parameters of a hydrogen energy system and preprocessing the parameters to generate an input feature matrix, S2, inputting the feature matrix into a multi-resolution feature sensing module to generate a high-dimensional feature map, S3, inputting the high-dimensional feature map into a dynamic time bending network to generate a parameter association matrix, S4, optimizing feature weight distribution based on a self-adaptive differential evolution algorithm, S5, capturing abnormal distribution through a dynamic map convolution network to generate a dynamic abnormal map, S6, simulating an abnormal propagation path, generating a cascading abnormal analysis result by combining a dynamic tracing mechanism, S7, optimizing the cascading abnormal analysis result through a gray wolf-firefly hybrid optimization algorithm, and S8, adjusting the dynamic operation parameters based on a final cascading risk prediction result to finish the hydrogen energy system safety assessment. The method combines deep learning and a hybrid optimization algorithm and the like, and realizes safety assessment of anomaly detection and risk prediction of the hydrogen energy system.
assignees: SHAANXI ZHONGYUAN SHANGQING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Energy internet load prediction method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides an energy internet load prediction method, an energy internet load prediction device and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of power equipment detection, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining a first load matrix based on historical data of energy internet load; determining whether the information entropy of a second load matrix is smaller than a preset first information entropy threshold, if yes, determining that a prediction model adopts a backward propagation network, otherwise, determining that the prediction model adopts an echo state network, acquiring a plurality of training samples from the second load matrix, training the prediction model by using the plurality of training samples, acquiring input data from the second load matrix, and processing the input data by using the trained prediction model to obtain a predicted value of the energy internet load at a target time position. The method and the system improve the accuracy and the robustness of the prediction of the energy internet load.
assignees: TOYOTA MOTOR CORP;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Fly-by-wire system security analysis method and device, terminal equipment and storage medium
