abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of system safety analysis, and provides a fly-by-wire system safety analysis method which comprises the steps of establishing a Bayesian network structure corresponding to a system according to a fly-by-wire system structure, establishing a nominal model and an expansion model corresponding to the system by using a Simulink simulation tool, establishing directed edges according to a system signal transmission direction to determine causal relation, generating a fault combination, injecting the fault combination into the expansion model, monitoring the response of a next layer subsystem, determining a fault propagation relation according to the response of each layer subsystem, finally combining the fault probability corresponding to the fault propagation relation with the fault probability of each layer node to obtain a condition probability table of each layer node, and obtaining the occurrence probability of leaf node events according to the condition probability table. According to the application, all fault combinations do not need to be traversed, the sample size is greatly reduced, the problem of state space explosion is avoided, the workload of analysts is effectively reduced, and the analysis efficiency is improved.
assignees: UNIV NANJING AERONAUTICS & ASTRONAUTICS

title_en: Nuclear power key index prediction device based on optimal deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nuclear power key index prediction device based on optimal deep learning, which comprises a sodium iodide spectrometer database, a data acquisition and preprocessing module, a one-dimensional CNN-LSTM cascading model module, a multi-target self-adaptive particle swarm optimization algorithm module and a nuclear power key index prediction and online correction module. The method realizes online prediction and parameter optimal online optimization, can robustly and swiftly predict the nuclear power key indexes in the running process of the nuclear power facility, does not need to manually design prediction features or rules, overcomes the defects that the conventional nuclear power key index prediction device is low in precision and easy to be influenced by human factors, and the prediction model is easy to mismatch, so that the prediction effect is poor and even the system is crashed, and improves the prediction efficiency and accuracy of the long-term online running of the nuclear power key index prediction in the radiation environment.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Medical digital supply chain risk analysis method, system, equipment and product
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of supply chain risk control, and aims to provide a medical digital supply chain risk analysis method, a system, equipment and a product. In the invention, the node attribute information is dynamically updated and the subsequent calculation of the risk score of the participant node is carried out by utilizing the supply chain graph and the time sequence prediction model, so that the dynamic change in the appointed supply chain structure can be comprehensively captured, the sensitivity of risk early warning is enhanced, the real-time monitoring and quick response requirements on the whole flow of the supply chain can be met, in addition, the setting of a graph rolling network is introduced in the risk propagation modeling, the potential risk path can be effectively identified, the problem of difficult risk identification in a complex scene in the prior art is solved, and the efficient circulation and the safe supply of medical supplies in each link of the supply chain are ensured.
assignees: HANGZHOU YISHULIAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Thermal power generating unit coordinated load change rate control method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power systems, and discloses a method and a system for controlling the coordinated load change rate of a thermal power unit, wherein the method comprises the steps of regarding the thermal power unit as a network node and establishing a connection relation between the thermal power units; defining attributes of nodes and edges, constructing a network topological structure, analyzing interaction and synergistic effects among thermal power units, constructing a load fluctuation propagation model, predicting the influence of load fluctuation on other units and transmission paths of the load fluctuation, determining an optimized load scheduling strategy by utilizing a cooperative control mechanism of a complex network, and combining the load fluctuation propagation model and an information transmission mechanism to adjust the load change rate of each unit in real time. According to the intelligent power grid dispatching method, load dispatching is optimized through the cooperative control mechanism and the load fluctuation propagation model, dispatching efficiency and stability of a power system are improved, influence of load fluctuation on the system is reduced, response capacity and adjustment flexibility of a unit are improved, and development of the intelligent power grid can be effectively promoted.
assignees: JINING HUAYUAN THERMAL POWER CO LTD;SHANDONG NAXIN ELECTRIC POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for calculating propagation influence intensity of multi-source adaptability modification of product based on path coupling
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for calculating the propagation influence intensity of multi-source adaptive modification of a product based on path coupling, and belongs to the technical field of engineering modification. According to the method, a product adaptability change propagation network is constructed according to propagation influence relations among product parts, coupling nodes and coupling paths of multi-source adaptability change propagation are identified, the correlation of structural change attribute changes of corresponding parts caused by the coupling nodes when the coupling nodes are influenced by different change source propagation is determined, the direct propagation influence intensity of a front end node of the coupling paths on a rear end node during multi-source change is calculated, and the product multi-source adaptability change propagation influence intensity is calculated according to the correlation of the coupling paths, the direct propagation influence intensity of the coupling nodes and the change complexity of the parts. The invention can effectively identify the coupling nodes and the coupling paths with multisource adaptive modification, can improve the design efficiency of products, reduce modification cost and provide basis for the adaptive modification in the personalized customization process of the products.

title_en: Cascade power station scheduling parameter access and influence factor prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a step power station scheduling parameter access and influence factor prediction method, which relates to the technical field of power station scheduling and comprises the following steps of obtaining operation parameter data of each step power station, including but not limited to flow, output, storage capacity and water level; multidimensional impact factor data is collected relating to power plant scheduling, including meteorological data, geographic data, and hydrographic data. According to the method, the reservoir water level is accurately predicted through multi-source data fusion and deep learning, prediction errors are reduced, scheduling is optimized, and the method is especially suitable for extreme weather. The feedback adjustment mechanism is introduced to reduce water waste and improve the water and electricity utilization efficiency and the flexibility of the power grid. And by combining an intelligent optimization algorithm and deep reinforcement learning, a scheduling scheme is dynamically adjusted, so that the utilization of water and electricity resources is maximized, the safety of a power grid is ensured, overload or insufficient supply of loads is avoided, and the emergency response capability and stability of the power grid are enhanced.
assignees: HUANENG TIBET YARLUNG ZANGBO RIVER HYDROPOWER DEVELOPMENT AND INVEST CO LTD

title_en: Multi-user energy storage power station charge and discharge control method and system based on electricity price
abstract_en: A multi-user energy storage power station charge-discharge control method and system based on electricity price comprises the steps of setting a monitoring terminal on energy storage equipment, collecting load data of each energy storage equipment, carrying out data preprocessing on the collected load data, constructing a cascade neural network prediction model, training the model by using the preprocessed load data to generate a regional total load demand predicted value of a future period, designing a deep reinforcement learning model DRL by using the regional total load demand predicted value to obtain a preliminary power adjustment amount, designing an objective function considering battery aging cost by using the preliminary power adjustment amount, determining a preliminary value range of coefficients in the objective function of an optimization model according to constraint conditions, considering a multi-objective optimization problem, and obtaining a Pareto optimal solution set based on the preliminary value range to determine a final power distribution scheme. The method can accurately predict the load, optimize the charge and discharge strategy, reduce the electricity consumption and operation cost, balance the service life and economic benefit of the battery and improve the intellectualization and high efficiency level of the energy storage power station.
assignees: CEEC BEIJING ENERGY RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Filling station equipment monitoring system and method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of monitoring of gas station equipment, in particular to a gas station equipment monitoring system and method based on the Internet of things; the method comprises the steps of collecting multidimensional operation parameters of equipment and node dynamics of business flow in real time, constructing a bidirectional coupling graph model of equipment and business, extracting high-order characteristics of physical association and business logic interaction between the equipment by utilizing a graph convolution network, predicting equipment fault risks by adopting a dynamic health scoring mechanism, backtracking a risk propagation chain by combining an attention mechanism, mapping multidimensional data into interpretable fault diagnosis information by an abnormal semantic generation network, introducing a double-layer reinforcement learning game mechanism, coordinating equipment maintenance and risk suppression strategies in an inner layer, and integrating business efficiency and safety targets in an outer layer to generate optimization actions such as resource scheduling, oil allocation and the like to form a perception-diagnosis-decision closed loop. The invention realizes full-time sensing of the equipment state, active fault early warning and cross-domain collaborative optimization, and remarkably improves the operation and maintenance efficiency and safety of the gas station.

title_en: Ecological scheduling scheme optimization simulation coupling decision-making method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence-based ecological scheduling scheme optimization simulation coupling decision method which comprises the steps of determining ecological scheduling starting time and ecological scheduling key parameters, determining proper intervals of the ecological scheduling key parameters required by fish propagation, constructing a reservoir multi-objective optimization ecological scheduling model for promoting fish natural propagation by applying an optimization algorithm, solving optimization schemes of reservoir ecological scheduling under different scenes, arranging the optimal scheduling schemes to form a scheduling track sequence data set, constructing a reservoir ecological scheduling scheme simulation decision model based on a long-short-term memory network deep learning algorithm, constructing a loss function with a physical mechanism, and taking the scheduling track sequence data set as training data to autonomously learn a reservoir ecological optimal scheduling rule from the data set. The invention can rapidly give out the ecological dispatching outflow scheme which is suitable for various actual working condition scenes, assist the optimization decision of the ecological dispatching scheme and realize the improvement of the ecological dispatching scheme from static state to real-time dynamic state.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Zero-carbon power system modeling method and system based on closed-loop feedback optimization order reduction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a zero-carbon power system modeling method and system based on closed-loop feedback optimization order reduction, which relate to the field of zero-carbon power system modeling and combustion mechanism optimization, and are used for carrying out mechanism order reduction on a chemical reaction mechanism network of a zero-carbon power system to obtain a key reaction path; the method comprises the steps of adopting an improved dynamic force model to dynamically layout an energy network constructed based on a key reaction path to obtain a dynamic energy network, adopting a closed loop feedback mechanism to optimize the dynamic energy network to obtain a simplified mechanism network, obtaining multidimensional data based on the simplified mechanism network and extracting features to obtain a low-dimensional feature vector, and inputting the low-dimensional feature vector into a comprehensive mapping model to predict to obtain a prediction result of key combustion parameters. The method of the directed relation graph with the error propagation of the plasma is combined with a closed-loop feedback mechanism to reduce the order of a mechanism network, multidimensional data of the mechanism network is reduced in dimension, and the high-precision and quick response prediction of key combustion parameters is realized by utilizing a multi-model fusion strategy.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG

title_en: Photovoltaic active distribution network-containing voltage out-of-limit problem tracing method
abstract_en: The invention provides a voltage out-of-limit problem tracing method for a photovoltaic active distribution network, which comprises the steps of receiving research data and carrying out multi-scale feature analysis to obtain a standardized multi-dimensional feature matrix and a space-time correlation matrix, constructing an initial causal graph based on basic research data and physical constraints of a power grid, constructing a multi-layer causal network by calculating causal strength, extracting dynamic feature sequences and analyzing propagation features to generate a propagation path set and a path weight matrix, carrying out tensor completion and state estimation on the research data to obtain a state estimation matrix and estimation uncertainty, and outputting out-of-limit source positions, out-of-limit risk scores and early warning information based on pattern matching analysis and risk assessment. According to the invention, through the combination of multidimensional feature analysis and multi-layer causal network, accurate positioning and risk early warning of a voltage threshold crossing source are realized, and the tracing accuracy and analysis efficiency are improved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;Quanzhou Power Supply Company Of State Grid Fujian Electric Power Company;LONGYAN POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Auxiliary decision-making method and device for distribution network based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network auxiliary decision-making method and device based on artificial intelligence, which relate to the technical field of distribution networks, wherein the method comprises the steps of decomposing a signal of a current corresponding to each network element in a target distribution network topological graph, converting the signal into an initial space-time characteristic graph, substituting a preset network for fault detection, carrying out depth-first search by taking a fault position as a starting point if the fault detection is fault, generating a target fault influence area, determining the final fault probability of the network element according to each network element in the target fault influence area, and carrying out scheme decision according to the final fault probability of each network element. The signal decomposition and the modal component extraction can more accurately capture the tiny fault signals, then convert the initial modal components into space-time characteristic diagrams, better reflect the state change of the power distribution network before and after the fault, accurately predict the spreading range of the fault by combining the fault influence area, and improve the fault processing efficiency when the fault is propagated in the face of the power grid topology.
assignees: DONGXU LANTIAN SMART ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid service identification model generation method and power grid service identification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a generation method of a power grid service identification model and a power grid service identification method. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a training sample set formed by power grid business data, inputting types of training samples and model tasks into a teacher network model for recognition to obtain a first recognition result, inputting types of the training samples and model tasks into a student network model to be trained for recognition to obtain a second recognition result, determining a first loss function and a second loss function according to the first recognition result, the second recognition result and label data, calculating a fitting loss function according to the first loss function and the second loss function, and carrying out back propagation on the student network model to be trained based on the fitting loss function to obtain the student network model to be trained for the next iteration until iteration convergence conditions are met to obtain the power grid business recognition model, and solving the problems that the model recognition accuracy is low, the high delay is high, and multi-business data cannot be processed.

title_en: Real-time monitoring and optimizing method and system for virtual power plant platform source network charge storage equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a real-time monitoring and optimizing method and system for virtual power plant platform source network charge storage equipment, which relate to the technical field of intelligent optimization scheduling of virtual power plants and comprise the steps of collecting equipment operation data, carrying out noise reduction and feature compression to obtain feature data, identifying equipment fault types based on the feature data, decoupling and reconstructing the feature data in time and space dimensions to obtain an equipment association matrix, constructing an equipment topological graph based on the equipment association matrix and trusted fault types, carrying out bidirectional tracking on the equipment topological graph according to fault diffusion probability to generate a fault propagation path, carrying out hierarchical sequencing on equipment on the fault propagation path, outputting a fault influence prediction result and an equipment priority list, and carrying out collaborative scheduling optimization on equipment in the virtual power plant by adopting a hierarchical reinforcement learning algorithm to realize collaborative scheduling optimization of the virtual power plant equipment.

title_en: Method for realizing multi-channel data acquisition of earthquake waves and sound waves by network remote control
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing multi-channel data acquisition of earthquake waves and sound waves by network remote control, which comprises the steps of adopting a high-sensitivity sound wave sensor array to acquire sound wave signals of all directions and multiple angles in a target area, establishing a sound wave signal propagation attenuation model according to the physical characteristics of sound wave propagation, carrying out attenuation compensation and amplitude normalization processing on the acquired original sound wave signals, adopting an adaptive filtering algorithm to carry out noise reduction processing on the normalized sound wave signals according to the characteristics of complex background noise, further adopting a wavelet transformation algorithm to carry out time-frequency domain analysis and feature extraction on weak signals on the basis of adaptive filtering noise reduction, adopting a time-frequency domain joint analysis method to further verify the authenticity of the signals for the identified suspected target signals, and carrying out positioning and parameter estimation on the confirmed target signals according to the results of signal identification and verification to acquire key parameter information of the signals.
assignees: ZHONGZHEN HUACHUANG SHENZHEN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Subway network key station identification method considering cascading failure, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a subway network key station identification method, electronic equipment and storage medium considering cascade failure, which simulate a cascade failure process after station failure based on a constructed subway weighted time-varying network and initial state and degree values of stations in each period, and establish a passenger flow distribution rule based on consideration of passenger origin-destination points to obtain the subway weighted time-varying network after cascade failure is caused by stations in each period. Based on node failure rate, network maximum communication rate and network passenger flow intensity entropy after each station is failed in each period, comprehensive importance of each station in each period is calculated, and key subway stations in each period are identified based on the comprehensive importance. The method and the system are used for assisting public transportation operators to identify key stations in each period in the subway network, so that decision support is provided for emergency plan making under emergencies, and scientific basis is provided for emergency operation scheduling and management of the subway network.
assignees: UNIV NANJING POSTS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS

title_en: Water, wind and solar energy storage multi-target scheduling method based on improved mixed particle swarm gray wolf optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system optimization scheduling, and particularly relates to a multi-target day-ahead peak regulation scheduling method of a step water-wind-solar-energy storage complementary power generation system. The method comprises the specific steps of establishing a mathematical model of a water-wind-solar complementary system, constructing a multi-objective optimization framework considering power generation benefits and peak regulation effects, constructing a prediction network by using a self-adaptive multi-time scale Improved LSTNet to conduct daily prediction on water inflow of a cascade river basin section, power generation of a photovoltaic power station and power generation of a wind power station to serve as input data of the model, solving the modeled model by adopting an improved multi-objective mixed particle swarm gray wolf optimization algorithm (IMOPSO-GWO), coordinating global exploration and local development capability through a convergence factor self-adaptive adjustment mechanism, introducing a dynamic mutation operator to enhance Pareto front search efficiency, and finally obtaining a daily scheduling scheme of the complementary system. The invention has remarkable effects in reducing the residual load fluctuation of the power grid and improving the power generation income by optimizing the output of the step hydroelectric generating set and the energy storage.

title_en: Karst landform remote sensing dynamic evolution analysis method and system thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of remote sensing image processing, in particular to a karst landform remote sensing dynamic evolution analysis method and a system thereof, which can be applied to the fields of resource management, environmental protection, geological disaster early warning and the like in karst areas; the method comprises the steps of obtaining karst landform change information through multi-time-phase remote sensing image data, constructing a space-time analysis model consisting of self-attention enhancement, a feature pyramid and a circulating neural network, combining a karst landform priori knowledge design constraint module to realize accurate prediction, enabling multi-source data fusion to improve feature capture capability, particularly achieving obvious observation advantages under complex weather conditions, enabling multi-module cascade design to accurately model space-time dynamic changes, improving prediction accuracy, introducing priori knowledge constraint to enhance feature recognition, reducing misclassification, and integrally effectively integrating multi-disciplinary technology, improving accuracy and reliability of karst landform dynamic evolution analysis and providing a powerful tool for relevant field research.
assignees: INST KARST GEOLOGY CAGS

title_en: Emergency team informatization management system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of chemical safety and emergency management, and discloses an emergency team informatization management system and method, wherein the emergency team informatization management method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-level Bayesian network model, showing the condition dependence of chemical accident evolution chain event nodes, establishing an uncertainty propagation analysis model, quantifying an accident risk transfer rule, developing multi-dimensional node influence evaluation, comprehensively considering structural importance, propagation characteristics and dry pre-feasibility, identifying optimal intervention points according to the evaluation, constructing an intervention scheme by combining resource constraint, intelligently simulating, evaluating and optimizing intervention effects and assisting an emergency team iteration strategy.
assignees: NANJING NAIYUN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban rainfall flood process forecasting method based on data assimilation and multi-mode coupling
abstract_en: The invention relates to a city rainfall flood process forecasting method based on data assimilation and multi-mode coupling, which comprises the following steps of ⑴ collecting historical meteorological data, hydrological data, topographic data, soil texture data, vegetation data and city infrastructure data in an area, inputting all the data into a visual analysis and decision platform based on a GIS technology after quality control and format standardization, ⑵ establishing parameter transfer rules among WRF, SHUD and a two-dimensional hydrodynamic model, ⑶ operating the WRF, obtaining area high-resolution rainfall forecast data, carrying out EnKF dynamic update and inputting the data into the platform, ⑷ driving SHUD, obtaining area surface runoff and groundwater forecast data, carrying out EnKF dynamic update and inputting the data into the platform, ⑸ driving the two-dimensional hydrodynamic model, obtaining flood propagation paths and space-time release data of a inundation area and inputting the data into the platform, and ⑹ utilizing a threshold automatic identification technology to form risk level assessment and inputting the risk level assessment into the platform. The invention has high practicability and can realize accurate forecasting.
assignees: NORTHWEST INSTITUTE ECO ENVIRONMENT & RESOURCES CAS

title_en: River basin cascade reservoir joint scheduling optimization method and system under complex hydrologic condition
abstract_en: The application discloses a river basin cascade reservoir joint dispatching optimization method and system under complex hydrologic conditions, and relates to a hydropower dispatching technology, wherein the river basin cascade reservoir joint dispatching optimization method comprises the steps of arranging a hydrologic monitoring station along the river basin cascade reservoir and arranging vibration monitoring devices for units of all cascade power stations to form an Internet of things sensing network; the method comprises the steps of acquiring river basin data based on a constructed internet of things perception network, constructing a distributed hydrologic model according to the acquired river basin data, establishing a step scheduling model of each step power station unit, generating a Pareto scheduling optimal solution set by applying an NSGA-III algorithm based on the distributed hydrologic model and the step scheduling model, and carrying out visual display based on a three-dimensional model according to the Pareto scheduling optimal solution selected by a user. The method is used for meeting the condition that the combination of all hydropower stations reaches the expected optimal value as much as possible, and realizing the combined optimal scheduling of the auxiliary cascade power stations.
assignees: HUANENG TIBET YARLUNG ZANGBO RIVER HYDROPOWER DEVELOPMENT AND INVEST CO LTD

title_en: Line load processing method, device, server and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a method and a device for processing load of a line, a server and a storage medium. Relates to the technical field of power distribution networks. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a load prediction request, and obtaining load data to be predicted according to the load prediction request, wherein the load data comprises weather condition data and date type data at least at one moment. And carrying out load prediction processing on the load data according to a preset back propagation neural network model to obtain a load prediction result of at least one moment, wherein the preset back propagation neural network model is trained according to weather condition data and date type data of a plurality of historical moments, and the load prediction result comprises load data of a preset line. And according to the load prediction result, carrying out adjustment processing on the load data of the line. The method is used for achieving the effect of reducing the occurrence of fault events caused by excessive line load.
assignees: HUIZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD;GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Acceleration simulation solving method and system of controllable self-recovery energy dissipation device
abstract_en: The application provides an acceleration simulation solving method and system of a controllable self-recovery energy dissipation device, comprising the steps of S1, respectively establishing a circuit model for a linear network and a nonlinear network by equivalent of an inductance element between the nonlinear network and the linear network in a hybrid cascade direct current transmission system as a short transmission line, S2, obtaining the value of a current controlled voltage source based on the node voltage of one simulation time step on the linear network and the nonlinear network, the value of a controlled voltage source and an information interaction format, S3, carrying out node voltage solving based on the value of the controlled voltage source of the current simulation time step to obtain the node voltage of the current simulation time step, stopping if the iteration times are met, otherwise, jumping to S2, wherein the nonlinear network comprises the controllable self-recovery energy dissipation device, and the application divides the linear main circuit in the energy dissipation device and the circuit system into the network, reduces the calculated amount, solves the problem by using an iteration algorithm to ensure high-efficiency high-precision simulation of the nonlinear network and the linear network.
assignees: STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Underwater wireless sensor network propagation model construction method based on cellular automaton
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of wireless sensor networks, in particular to a method for constructing an underwater wireless sensor network propagation model based on cellular automata, which comprises the steps of constructing an underwater wireless sensor network model, and acquiring the position of each time node, continuously updating the state and the position of the node by adopting a new cellular space and an updating rule, and constructing an underwater wireless sensor network propagation model based on the cellular automaton based on a new updating mechanism. The application describes the spatial distribution change of the malicious program propagation in the underwater wireless sensor network and the global change trend of the infected nodes, and solves the problem that the malicious program propagation description of the underwater wireless sensor network is lacking in a malicious program propagation model based on a cellular automaton model in the prior art.
assignees: UNIV QINGDAO SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Power distribution network planning method and device containing large-scale hierarchical aggregation adjustable resources
abstract_en: The application provides a power distribution network planning method and device containing large-scale hierarchical aggregation adjustable resources, and relates to the technical field of power distribution network planning. The method comprises the steps of constructing a grid-connected multi-micro-grid system planning model, solving the grid-connected multi-micro-grid system planning model by adopting a target cascading method to obtain an optimal power distribution network planning scheme of the power distribution network, wherein the upper planning model is constructed based on construction data, operation data, energy flow data and carbon tax data of the power distribution network, and the lower planning model is constructed based on construction data, operation data, corresponding compensation data on a demand side, carbon tax data and energy transaction data of micro-grids of the lower layer of the power distribution network. The application can improve the energy utilization rate and the economical efficiency of the system under the planning of the power distribution network.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Petroleum and petrochemical fire control interlocking control equipment based on SIS
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of petrochemical fire control, in particular to an interlocking control device for petrochemical fire control based on SIS, which comprises a sensing fusion unit for acquiring optical fibers, radars, acoustics, event cameras and dual-band images, and generating a characteristic tensor and an attitude matrix through multi-scale synchronization and gating sparse fusion. The prediction and risk assessment unit utilizes the graph neural network space-time model and generates countermeasure correction output disaster prediction data, a propagation potential energy matrix and risk entropy. The interlocking control unit builds a binary optimization model by taking the minimum action number and the residual potential energy as targets, obtains a minimum action set by means of quantum annealing and minimum and maximum game, and writes the minimum action set into the memristive programmable logic array to generate an interlocking instruction stream. The execution and feedback unit controls the two-phase flow injection device, the robot team and the heat shielding device to finish treatment, and the feedback event flow is used for model increment learning and action deviation correction. The invention realizes millisecond cascade lock triggering, redundant action drop and obviously reduces the fire spreading radius.

title_en: Urban key infrastructure toughness assessment method under typhoon disaster and related device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of natural disaster risk and infrastructure toughness assessment, and discloses a method and a related device for assessing urban key infrastructure toughness under typhoon disasters, which are used for acquiring typhoon disaster data, analyzing main risk factors, acquiring a risk factor set and a cascade disaster set, analyzing risk factors in the risk factor set contained in the typhoon disasters to be analyzed, acquiring the coupling types and frequencies of the risk factors, acquiring the coupling degrees of different risk factors by using an N-K model and the frequencies of the coupling types of the risk factors, further determining the risk factors which are most easily coupled with other risk factors, decoupling each cascade disaster in the cascade disaster set by using an interpretation structure model, obtaining an evolution path of the cascade disaster, further obtaining key nodes, determining the failure probability of the key nodes in a selected area by using the interpretation structure model, and evaluating the failure probability by using a sequencing centroid method. The invention can realize the early warning of the failure of the key infrastructure.
assignees: UNIV XIAN ARCHITECTUR & TECH

title_en: Hydraulic engineering risk intelligent regulation and control system based on knowledge graph embedment
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent hydraulic engineering risk regulation and control system based on knowledge graph embedment, and belongs to the technical field of hydraulic engineering. The system comprises a multi-level knowledge graph construction module, a graph embedding representation module, a risk identification and evaluation module, a reinforcement learning regulation and control decision module, a dynamic feedback optimization module and a visual interaction module, wherein the multi-level knowledge graph construction module is used for constructing a multi-level knowledge graph to form a dynamically updated knowledge network, the graph embedding representation module is used for encoding entity attributes, relationship features and time sequence evolution characteristics of the entity attributes, the risk identification and evaluation module is used for integrating graph embedding features and expert knowledge rules and analyzing risk features of hydraulic engineering and space propagation modes of the entity features so as to realize accurate identification and quantitative evaluation of risks, the reinforcement learning regulation and control decision module is used for encoding risk states and regulation and control targets into state-action space based on a deep reinforcement learning frame, the dynamic feedback optimization module is used for automatically updating entity states and relationship strength so as to form a closed loop for continuous optimization and knowledge accumulation, and the visual interaction module is used for visually displaying risk situations, regulation and control effects and propagation paths of the hydraulic engineering.
assignees: LUANNAN WATER CONSERVANCY MAT SUPPLY AND MARKETING CO LTD

title_en: Method and related device for identifying key elements of supply chain system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a related device for identifying key elements of a supply chain system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining logistics data among enterprises, determining cooperation and competition relation among the enterprises according to the logistics data among the enterprises, establishing a supply chain network according to the cooperation and competition relation among the enterprises, obtaining a risk propagation process of the supply chain network by combining external and internal disturbance factors based on the flow relation of products among the enterprises to obtain a risk propagation chain of the enterprises, and determining key nodes and key edges in the supply chain network according to the risk propagation chain of the enterprises.
assignees: UNIV XIAN ARCHITECTUR & TECH

title_en: Urban public transport network toughness measurement method in extreme stormwater weather
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for measuring toughness of an urban public transportation network in extreme stormwater, which comprises the steps of obtaining urban public transportation network station and line data, stormwater disaster information and passenger flow data, constructing a bus-subway double-layer transportation network, establishing a linear relation between stormwater rainfall intensity and passenger flow change based on the constructed bus-subway double-layer transportation network, calculating disturbance values of stormwater on stations and edges in the network, constructing a bus-subway double-layer transportation network cascade failure model considering passenger flow, representing a dynamic evolution process of the urban public transportation network in extreme stormwater, determining network performance measurement indexes by utilizing the constructed bus-subway double-layer transportation network cascade failure model, and measuring the toughness level of the urban public transportation network in extreme stormwater. The method is favorable for accurately measuring the toughness of the urban public transportation network and improving the coping capacity of the urban public transportation system in extreme stormwater weather.

title_en: Establishment method and application of mountain road network cascading failure model under influence of rainfall landslide
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of complex network cascading failure and urban risk disaster prevention and control, in particular to a method for establishing a mountain road network cascading failure model under the influence of rainfall landslide and application thereof, which can be used for establishing a road network cascading failure model under the influence of rainfall landslide disaster, further can be applied to the network invalidity research of mountain road infrastructure under extreme environment, the disturbance form and cascade failure characteristics of rainfall landslide disasters on a mountain area road network are comprehensively considered, a rainfall-type landslide cascade failure model is constructed based on the nonlinear space-time distribution characteristics and road traffic flow changes of the rainfall landslide disasters through improving a coupling mapping lattice theory and a network seepage theory, the state changes of road network nodes and connecting traffic flows are observed, and then the change of the mountain area road network situation under the influence of the rainfall landslide is judged. The invention has important significance for improving the disaster risk and emergency cooperative security capability of the road traffic infrastructure in the mountain area.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG

title_en: Power distribution network and multi-micro-grid collaborative optimization operation method considering hybrid soft switch multi-mode adjustment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network and multi-micro-grid collaborative optimization operation method considering hybrid soft switch multi-mode adjustment, which relates to the technical field of power system optimization, and comprises the following steps: based on a parallel structure of the interconnection switch and the intelligent soft switch in the hybrid soft switch, a hybrid soft switch power model is established, and the working mode of the hybrid soft switch is adaptively switched according to different operation scenes of the power distribution network and the micro-grid; the method comprises the steps of taking the minimum running cost of a power distribution network and each micro-grid as an optimization target, establishing a power distribution network and multi-micro-grid collaborative optimization running model considering hybrid soft switch multi-mode adjustment, establishing a dynamic target cascading algorithm based on a target cascading algorithm by introducing convergence speed quantization indexes, solving the power distribution network and multi-micro-grid collaborative optimization running model through the dynamic target cascading algorithm, and verifying the optimization effect of the hybrid soft switch. The invention can cooperatively optimize the power distribution network and the multiple micro-grids, and effectively reduce the running cost.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Marine seismic signal processing method based on distributed optical fiber vibration sensing
abstract_en: The invention provides a marine seismic signal processing method based on distributed optical fiber vibration sensing, and belongs to the technical field of seismic signal processing. The method comprises the steps of collecting ocean seismic signals through a distributed optical fiber vibration sensor, carrying out data preprocessing on the collected seismic signals to construct a seismic waveform chart data set, carrying out feature extraction on the preprocessed seismic signals through a U-KAN network according to preprocessed data to obtain feature data, identifying and classifying the feature data to obtain P waves and S waves, calculating time difference between the P waves and the S waves according to the identified P waves and the identified S waves, and estimating seismic source distance and seismic magnitude according to the time difference and seismic wave propagation speed. The invention improves the degree of automation of seismic signal processing, accurately determines the arrival time of seismic waves, improves the response speed and accuracy of marine seismic monitoring, and provides scientific basis for marine seismic disaster prevention and reduction.
assignees: UNIV GUANGDONG POLYTECHNIC NORMAL

title_en: Oil and gas station system corrosion risk identification method based on graph theory topological structure
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of pipeline maintenance, and particularly discloses a corrosion risk identification method of an oil and gas station system based on graph theory topological structure, which is used for collecting data, determining corrosion risk nodes and connection mechanisms in the oil and gas station system from three angles of physical equipment, personnel management operation and natural environment of the oil and gas station system, establishing an oil and gas station system corrosion risk network, collecting oil and gas station system data, the risk network structure attribute analysis is carried out based on the constructed corrosion risk network of the oil gas station system to obtain the corrosion risk identification result of the oil gas station system, the risk factors and the visualizations of the oil gas station system can be identified on the system level, and the importance ordering of the risk factors can be quantitatively carried out to qualitatively describe the importance of the risk nodes in the station and increase the community structure of risk propagation, so that support is provided for decision makers and technicians to risk management and control.
assignees: CHINA NAT PETROLEUM CORP;CNPC ENGINEERING MAT R & D COMPANY LIMITED

title_en: Data fusion-based taxi electricity utilization abnormality early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rental house electricity consumption abnormality early warning system and method based on data fusion, and relates to the technical field of electricity consumption abnormality early warning; according to the invention, a non-invasive load decomposer, a distributed temperature sensor and a high-frequency current transformer are deployed at distribution boxes, sockets and cable nodes, space-time alignment of current, temperature and load data is realized through a sliding time window algorithm, LSTM model parameters are improved by adopting an optimization algorithm, the recognition accuracy of abnormal appliances is improved, a digital twin model is built, a distribution network topology is mapped into a graph structure, the abnormal propagation probability is dynamically calculated and a risk path is visualized, hierarchical early warning is realized through a dynamic weight model integrating current deviation degree, temperature rise gradient and load mutation, the recognition accuracy of complex abnormal modes is improved, the visual prejudgment of the risk propagation path is realized, and the complete closed loop from risk early warning to active protection is realized.
assignees: SHAOXING YUEDEAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Operation and maintenance method for power transformation main equipment and related device
abstract_en: The application provides an operation and maintenance method for power transformation main equipment and a related device, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining m pieces of equipment characteristic information and m pieces of running state data corresponding to m pieces of power transformation main equipment; the method comprises the steps of constructing a dynamic graph model according to m pieces of equipment characteristic information, adjusting the dynamic graph model according to m pieces of running state data to obtain a dynamic graph neural network model, determining fault propagation paths of each of m pieces of power transformation main equipment according to the dynamic graph neural network model to obtain m pieces of fault propagation paths, determining m pieces of fault probability according to the m pieces of fault propagation paths, determining an operation and maintenance scheme according to the m pieces of fault propagation paths and the m pieces of fault probability, and guiding operation and maintenance personnel to maintain the m pieces of power transformation main equipment. The accuracy and the flexibility of fault prediction of the power transformation main equipment can be improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Climate risk prevention and control method and device based on graph theory and knowledge graph
abstract_en: The application discloses a climate risk prevention and control method and device based on graph theory and knowledge graph. The method comprises the steps of collecting weather data, traffic facility data and geographic topology data from multi-source heterogeneous data, constructing a knowledge graph by utilizing entities extracted from the data and relationships among the entities, enabling the knowledge graph to represent knowledge by using triplets and updating by using a dynamic updating mechanism, constructing a multi-time aerodynamic network based on graph theory technology, enabling the multi-time aerodynamic network to introduce time dimension and describe a dynamic propagation process of weather risks by using a nonlinear dynamics model, describing the dynamic propagation process of the weather risks by using the nonlinear dynamics model in the multi-time aerodynamic network, and identifying key nodes and risk propagation paths and optimizing the multi-time aerodynamic network by analyzing the multi-time aerodynamic network. The method solves the technical problem that the prior art lacks a corresponding optimization strategy due to the fact that key risk nodes and propagation paths are difficult to accurately identify.
assignees: CHINA WATERBORNE TRANSP RES INST

title_en: New energy offline risk assessment method and device for direct-current layered access system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy off-grid risk assessment method and device of a direct-current layered access system, belonging to the technical field of power system control, wherein the method comprises the steps of enabling all alternating-current systems, loads and new energy units in a receiving-end power grid to be equivalent to voltage sources with impedance; substituting the power signal and the equivalent voltage source parameter into a receiving end power grid voltage expression of the direct current layered access system to calculate a first transient low voltage of a receiving end converter bus, so as to calculate a first evaluation index of the new energy off-grid risk and determine whether the system has new energy low on-off grid. According to the invention, based on the power coupling relation of alternating current-direct current-new energy sources in the receiving end power grid, the transient voltage of the receiving end converter bus is calculated under the condition of direct current blocking so as to obtain the evaluation index of the new energy source off-grid risk, meanwhile, the possible new energy source off-grid risk of the system after the occurrence of the direct current blocking is evaluated based on the causal relation among the cascading failures, and the strong impact of the direct current blocking on the alternating current-direct current-new energy source system is disclosed.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH

title_en: Electric power and electric quantity balancing method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric power and electric quantity balancing method, an electric power and electric quantity balancing device and electronic equipment, wherein the electric power and electric quantity balancing method comprises the steps of determining a regional power grid participating in typical daily electric power and electric quantity balancing according to a power supply range of a target hydropower station, obtaining relevant data for developing electric power and electric quantity balancing of an electric power system and water quantity balancing of a cascade hydropower station, carrying out cascade joint runoff adjustment calculation on the cascade hydropower station to obtain month-by-month average output, constructing a water quantity balancing calculation model based on the month average output of the cascade hydropower station, and adjusting and determining the daily average output of the cascade hydropower station participating in typical daily electric power and electric quantity balancing. The invention can more reasonably evaluate and quantify the electric capacity benefit of the conventional hydropower station in the electric power system, and give consideration to the requirements of the conventional hydropower station on water regulation and electricity regulation, provides scientific basis for the demonstration of the characteristic parameters of the power station, and can solve the problem that the water quantity among typical daily stepped hydropower stations is not matched with the power station output in the prior related technology.
assignees: CHANGJIANG INST SURVEY PLANNING DESIGN & RES CO LTD

title_en: Typhoon path prediction method, typhoon path prediction system, typhoon path prediction equipment and typhoon path prediction medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a typhoon path prediction method, a typhoon path prediction system, typhoon path prediction equipment and typhoon path prediction media, wherein the typhoon path prediction method comprises the steps of determining a wave equation describing typhoon path evolution according to propagation characteristics of typhoons in the atmosphere; the physical information neural network PINN is introduced into the last layer of the multi-layer composite radial basis function network MCRBNN, a MCRBNN-PINN model is constructed, initial and boundary conditions of a wave equation are embedded into a loss function, the model is trained, historical meteorological data is input into the trained model MCRBNN-PINN, and typhoon path prediction is carried out. Compared with the prior art, the physical information neural network is introduced into the last layer of the multi-layer composite radial basis neural network, so that the typhoon path physical law is deeply embedded, the interpretation of the model on typhoon path prediction problem is enhanced, and the typhoon path prediction precision is further improved.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Micro-grid cluster cascading failure control method, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a control method, electronic equipment and a medium for cascading failure of a micro-grid group. The method comprises the steps of establishing a micro-grid group longitudinal output model, analyzing distributed resource data according to a clustering algorithm to obtain micro-grid group output distribution, and performing cascading failure control through the micro-grid group output distribution. According to the application, through the research of the cascading failure analysis and emergency control of the power grid containing the micro-grid group, the safety and reliability of the power system are improved.
assignees: HETIAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Enterprise digital management method and system based on data mining
abstract_en: The invention discloses an enterprise digital management method based on data mining, which comprises the steps of obtaining information flow data and resource allocation data, analyzing according to the information flow data and the resource allocation data to obtain an initial network diagram, carrying out cluster analysis according to the initial network diagram, carrying out path optimization to obtain a dynamic network diagram, carrying out feature extraction on the dynamic network diagram to obtain predictive analysis data, identifying nodes of a network according to the dynamic network diagram and the predictive analysis data to obtain key nodes and high risk nodes, combining the key nodes and the high risk nodes, identifying key propagation paths to obtain key propagation paths, predicting key positions where resource bottlenecks and conflicts occur based on the key nodes, the high risk nodes and the key propagation paths, and generating resource optimization suggestions. The method can identify the dynamic change of the implicit dependency of the enterprise, locate the high-risk nodes and the key propagation paths, and optimize the resource allocation.

title_en: Power network key ring detection method based on simulated annealing algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a detection method of a power network key ring based on a simulated annealing algorithm, which comprises the following steps of 1, constructing a power network topology model; step 2, constructing a solution space, step 3, constructing an initial solution set, and step 4, detecting a key ring. The invention adopts a simulated annealing algorithm comprising a neighborhood search strategy to detect the key ring of the power network, can successfully detect the key ring of the power network, effectively improves the detection efficiency, is applicable to a large-scale network, expands the application range of the network, simulates the fault process of a real power network by adopting a cascade failure process, can detect the fragile structure of the power network, and provides effective support for the safety protection of the power network.
assignees: UNIV XIANGTAN

title_en: Power grid key line identification method based on topology and operation characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid key line identification method based on topology and operation characteristics, and belongs to the technical field of power grid key line identification. In the aspect of operation characteristics, an improved webpage link algorithm is adopted, the product of the initial load rate and the historical fault rate of each line is taken as an algorithm initial value, and the trend fluctuation caused by disconnection of each line on other lines is counted in sequence to construct a link matrix required by the algorithm. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a propagation matrix and a fragile matrix, obtaining a line key propagation value vector and a key fragile value vector of a power grid by adopting initial values and propagation/fragile matrix calculation, and obtaining a line key value by weighting and summing the key propagation value and the key fragile value of each line. The importance of the line on the local topology of the power grid is considered, the comprehensive degree of nodes at two ends of the line is constructed, a line key value correction coefficient is formed, and then a line comprehensive key value is constructed. And sequencing the comprehensive key values of all the lines, and identifying the line arranged in the front as a key line. The method can obtain the key degree of each line of the power grid and has certain effectiveness.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG

title_en: Mine ecological risk prediction method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention provides a mine ecological risk prediction method and system based on artificial intelligence, which are characterized in that multisource ecological monitoring data are collected through a distributed sensor network deployed in a mine area, a space-time alignment treatment is carried out to generate a space-time correlation feature set, a pre-trained ecological risk prediction model is called to predict features to generate a risk conduction mode set comprising a risk propagation path, a starting node, a propagation direction and strength, an ecological risk evolution network is constructed based on the risk conduction mode set, the topological structure and time sequence dependency relationship of risk nodes are displayed, a risk early warning instruction set comprising a risk classification result and an ecological restoration strategy is generated according to the ecological risk evolution network and is sent to an ecological management platform, so that mine ecological risks can be comprehensively and accurately predicted, effective risk early warning and ecological restoration strategies are provided, and mine ecological safety is guaranteed.

title_en: Transient overvoltage evaluation method for multi-type clean energy via direct-current island delivery system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transient overvoltage assessment method of a multi-type clean energy via a direct current island transmission system, which comprises the following steps of S1, establishing models of various power generation systems, S2, establishing a back propagation neural network model according to the voltage and power characteristics of the direct current island transmission system, S3, performing global optimization on weights and thresholds of the back propagation neural network model by using a self-adaptive genetic algorithm, S4, training the back propagation neural network model by using power grid simulation data, and inputting the output of the active power of each power generation system in a power grid to be tested into the trained back propagation neural network model to output a transient overvoltage value. According to the invention, through evaluating the transient overvoltage after the commutation failure, a theoretical basis is provided for the subsequent transient overvoltage suppression, so that the economy and efficiency of the power system are improved on the premise of ensuring safety and stability.
assignees: SOUTHWEST BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA

title_en: Dangerous chemical transportation path dynamic risk prevention and control system and method based on space-time fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of intelligent traffic safety, in particular to a system and a method for preventing and controlling dynamic risks of a dangerous chemical transportation path based on space-time fusion, which are used for calculating a multidimensional risk index matrix through a risk index quantization module and realizing accurate assessment of dynamic risks of a road section by combining a space-time environment sensitivity prediction matrix generated by an environment sensitivity analysis module and a risk propagation probability cloud picture of a risk diffusion prediction module; the system establishes a collaborative risk factor assessment model, adjusts a safety threshold according to historical accident data to generate a time-space road network risk scoring matrix, determines an early warning level according to the safety threshold, selects prevention and control measures, optimizes a transportation path, makes an emergency response plan for a high-risk road section and outputs an intelligent decision instruction set.

title_en: Photovoltaic power parallel prediction method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power prediction, in particular to a photovoltaic power parallel prediction method, which comprises the steps of obtaining a photovoltaic power generation power sequence according to a preset time interval, carrying out data decomposition on the photovoltaic power generation power sequence based on an REMD-OVMD model to obtain a plurality of intrinsic mode functions IMF, carrying out feature extraction on each subsequence in channel dimension and time dimension by utilizing a FreMLP-based time sequence prediction model FreTS by taking the plurality of IMFs as subsequences, carrying out photovoltaic power prediction by utilizing a Dlinear-Tranformer parallel structure prediction model which is constructed in advance based on the fused features of each subsequence, taking the sum of photovoltaic power prediction values corresponding to each subsequence as a photovoltaic power prediction result, carrying out learning and prediction on an error sequence of the photovoltaic power prediction result by utilizing a TCN model, optimizing network parameters by reverse propagation, and finally modifying the photovoltaic power prediction sequence. The application adopts the parallel prediction method, and can simultaneously operate a plurality of sub-models, thereby reducing the calculation time and improving the real-time performance.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Typhoon cascading waterlogging sensitivity assessment method and system for coastal water network area
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a typhoon cascading waterlogging sensitivity assessment method and system for a coastal water network area, wherein the method comprises the steps of dividing a target area into sub-watershed areas, and dividing a water network grid by combining the target area and the sub-watershed areas; the method comprises the steps of obtaining index data of a sub-river basin, calculating rain Hong Chao coupling sensitivity based on the index data, dynamically weighting the rain Hong Chao coupling sensitivity, calculating a comprehensive sensitivity index, defining encountering indexes of grid indexes in a water network grid, calculating the sensitivity index based on the encountering indexes, dynamically weighting the sensitivity index, calculating a rain Hong Chao encountering sensitivity index, and generating a sensitivity evaluation graph of a target area by spatial superposition based on the comprehensive sensitivity index and the rain Hong Chao encountering sensitivity index.
assignees: THE ARCHITECTURAL DESIGN & RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ZHEJIANG UNIV CO LTD

title_en: Power equipment fault cross-domain collaborative analysis system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power equipment fault cross-domain collaborative analysis system and a method, which relate to the technical field of power grid dispatching and comprise the steps of acquiring multisource heterogeneous data of preprocessed power equipment, based on the topological relation of the preprocessing data and the historical fault data, a cross-domain knowledge graph is constructed, a fault propagation path is marked, and an embedded representation is carried out by adopting a graph neural network. And designing a space-time multi-branch network, respectively extracting space, time sequence and modal interaction characteristics by using the space-time multi-branch network, and fusing at a characteristic fusion layer to obtain fusion characteristics and branch weights. Combining knowledge graph embedded representation, constructing a collaborative reasoning model by using a Bayesian network, carrying out reasoning decision on the fusion characteristics, finally obtaining a cross-domain collaborative analysis result of the power equipment fault, and realizing fusion and efficient reasoning of multi-source heterogeneous data by combining the knowledge graph and a space-time multi-branch network, thereby improving the accuracy and efficiency of fault diagnosis.

title_en: Quick evaluation method for earthquake damage performance of high-speed railway bridge based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bridge earthquake damage performance evaluation, and particularly discloses a quick evaluation method for the earthquake damage performance of a high-speed railway bridge based on machine learning, which comprises the steps of collecting multisource data of a bridge structure of the high-speed railway, a historical earthquake database and a BI M model of the bridge structure in real time through a heterogeneous data collection system; the method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-mode feature space containing time-frequency domain features, space features and partial features of probability features, constructing a hierarchical machine learning framework based on a dynamic Bayesian network damage propagation model, a mixed model of a multi-scale convolutional neural network and a long-short-time memory network and an uncertainty quantification and dynamic updating mechanism, establishing a vibration loss performance evaluation model based on the hierarchical machine learning framework, evaluating the vibration loss performance of the multi-mode feature space by adopting the vibration loss performance evaluation model to generate damage probability distribution, effectively mining potential vibration loss-related information behind data, and more accurately simulating and predicting the vibration loss condition of a bridge in an earthquake.
assignees: UNIV HEFEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Method for predicting running state of power supply network and related equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power supply networks and discloses a method for predicting the running state of a power supply network and related equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining a vulnerability function of a target node in the power supply network; the method comprises the steps of determining damage conditions of target nodes based on vulnerability functions and exposure degrees of the target nodes, calculating comprehensive reliability measures of the target nodes based on the damage conditions, constructing a probability map model based on the comprehensive reliability measures and relations between the target nodes and adjacent nodes, and predicting operation states of a power supply network based on the probability map model. According to the prediction method, the vulnerability function of the node is determined, and then the damage condition of the node is evaluated by combining the exposure degree of the node. And then, determining the comprehensive reliability measure of the node by using a heuristic search algorithm. The relationships between the nodes are then analyzed to construct a probability map model. And finally, carrying out state reasoning through a belief propagation algorithm, and predicting the running state of the whole power supply network.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;HEFEI INST PUBLIC SAFETY RES TSINGHUA UNIV

title_en: Intelligent scheduling method for cascade reservoir
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent cascade reservoir dispatching method, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent cascade reservoir dispatching. The method comprises the steps of S1, establishing a comprehensive database, periodically grabbing scheduling data of each weather station, a hydrological center, a power plant and a power grid to prepare models for calling operation, S2, establishing an intelligent simulation model, carrying out medium-long-term runoff rolling forecasting and flood forecasting on a tap reservoir with the performance of being regulated in a season and serving as a forecasting object according to the data of the number of the databases, carrying out medium-long-term runoff rolling forecasting and flood forecasting on all the power plants, S3, selecting scheduling objects and calculating time spans according to actual conditions by operators, adjusting input and constraint conditions, selecting proper optimization targets according to different scene requirements, and S4, outputting a scheduling scheme according to input information by the intelligent simulation model, and supporting manual intervention. The method solves the technical problems of low decision efficiency and insufficient precision due to the fact that the conventional step reservoir dispatching depends on manual experience judgment.
assignees: GUANGXI GUIGUAN ELEC POWER CO LTD;DATANG YANTAN HYDROPOWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: E-commerce supply chain anti-outage decision system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of logistics supply and discloses an e-commerce supply chain anti-outage decision system based on multi-source data fusion, which comprises a heterogeneous graph network construction and risk prediction module, wherein the heterogeneous graph network construction and risk prediction module is used for constructing a heterogeneous graph network representing the relationship of the e-commerce supply chain based on multi-source data and predicting an outage risk propagation path by utilizing a time sequence sensitive graph annotation force network; the invention builds an abnormal composition network and realizes a time sequence sensitive graph annotation force network, so that the system can accurately capture cascading effect and risk propagation paths in a complex supply network, improve the prediction accuracy of the fault cargo risk propagation path and greatly reduce false alarm and missing alarm.

title_en: Reverse design method for concave super structure for obtaining specific mechanical property
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reverse design method for obtaining a concave super structure with specific mechanical properties, which comprises the steps of constructing concave lattice structures with different configurations, obtaining stress-strain curves and Poisson ratio values of each lattice structure, dividing all samples of the lattice structures into a training set and a testing set, taking the stress values and the Poisson ratio values as input parameters and θ, t and loading directions as output parameters, training and verifying a reverse propagation neural network model to obtain a mapping relation between the mechanical properties of the concave super structure and configuration parameters thereof, inputting a mechanical property curve of host bone tissues, and matching the configuration parameters of the concave super structure based on the mapping relation. By adopting the method, the machine learning algorithm and the reverse design are combined, and the multi-element nonlinear mapping relation between the mechanical property of the lattice structure and the configuration parameter of the lattice structure is established, so that the implant structure with specific mechanical property is rapidly obtained, and the personalized design aiming at different patients is realized.
assignees: UNIV TAIYUAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: High-efficiency autonomous controllable electromagnetic transient real-time simulation method and simulation platform
abstract_en: A high-efficiency autonomous controllable electromagnetic transient real-time simulation method and a simulation platform relate to the field of electric digital data processing, and the method comprises the following steps: and (3) constructing a space-time diagram neural network model according to the power grid equipment and the connection relation thereof, inputting physical parameters of the power grid equipment into node feature vectors, calculating a fault signal propagation time matrix, dynamically layering power grid nodes according to the fault signal propagation time matrix, dividing a core layer, a near-domain layer, a transition layer and a far-domain layer, calculating a basic step length of the core layer due to the fact that the core layer is close to a fault point, calculating a layer far from the fault point, for example, calculating a large time step length of the far-domain layer, calculating electrical feature parameters of the fault nodes at the core layer to identify a key node set, taking interlayer boundary node parameters in the key node set as adjacent layers to calculate boundary conditions, and outputting transient process data of each power grid node, dynamic change data of a fault influence range and parameter alarm information of the key nodes. By implementing the method, the consumption of computing resources of electromagnetic transient real-time simulation is reduced.
assignees: JINPIN COMPUTER TECH TIANJIN CO LTD

title_en: Flood monitoring device and method
title_ko: 홍수 모니터링 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a flood monitoring device comprises: a power supply unit supplying power generated by a solar panel as operation power of each unit; a vertical support installed at a first length on the ground; a horizontal support installed at a second length on the vertical support; a camera installed to photograph a water level indicator on the horizontal support and photographing a water level display plate image; a water level sensor installed in a vertical direction on the horizontal support and measuring a water level of flowing water in a non-contact manner; and a water level monitoring device installed on the vertical support, receiving outputs of the camera and the water level sensor, and wirelessly spreading the water level indicator image and the output of the water level sensor to a communication network.
