abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 홍수 모니터링 장치는, 태양광 패널에 의해 발전되는 전원을 각부의 동작전원으로 공급하는 전원부; 지상에서 제1길이로 설치되는 수직 지지대; 수직 지지대에서 제2 길이로 설치되는 수평 지지대; 수평 지지대에서 수위표시자를 촬영할 수 있도록 설치되며, 수위표시판 이미지를 촬영하는 카메라; 수평 지지대에서 수직 방향으로 설치되며, 흐르는 물의 수위를 비접촉식 방식으로 측정하는 수위감지센서; 수직 지지대에 설치되며, 카메라 및 수위감지센서의 출력을 수신하며, 수위표시자 이미지 및 수위감지센서의 출력을 통신망에 무선전파하는 수위감시장치를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: UNIV KYUNGIL INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOP;WINITECH CO LTD

title_en: Fmea-based ac power system asset management target equipment selection method considering failure probability and failure impact, and recording medium storing program for executing the same, and computer program stored in recording medium for executing the same
title_ko: 고장확률, 고장영향을 고려한 fmea 기반 ac 전력계통 자산관리 대상 설비 선정 방법, 이를 구현하기 위한 프로그램이 저장된 기록매체 및 이를 구현하기 위해 매체에 저장된 컴퓨터프로그램
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for selecting an FMEA-based AC power system asset management target facility in consideration of failure probability and failure impact. More specifically, the present invention provides a method for selecting an FMEA-based ac power system asset management target facility in consideration of failure probability and failure impact, which is a method for selecting an asset management target facility of an AC power system by expanding a failure mode and effect analysis (FMEA) technique to a power system and analyzing a failure effect for each failure mode of a system configuration facility, and quantifying and considering a failure probability of failure (POF) of the system configuration facility and a secondary damage (consequence of failure (CoF)) that is spread due to a failure as an amount.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 고장확률, 고장영향을 고려한 FMEA 기반 AC 전력계통 자산관리 대상 설비 선정 방법에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 FMEA(Failure Mode and Effect Analysis)기법을 전력계통으로 확장, 계통 구성설비의 고장모드별 고장 영향을 분석하여 AC 전력계통의 자산관리 대상설비를 선정하는 방법으로 계통 구성설비의 고장확률(PoF, Probability of Failure)과 고장으로 인해 파급되는 2차 피해(CoF, Consequence of Failure)를 금액으로 정량화하여 고려한 고장확률, 고장영향을 고려한 FMEA 기반 AC 전력계통 자산관리 대상 설비 선정 방법을 제공한다.
assignees: UNIV NAT MOKPO IND ACAD COOP GROUP

title_en: Water supply quantity prediction method, device and storage medium based on water quantity-water pressure coupling
abstract_en: The invention relates to a water supply quantity prediction method, water supply quantity prediction equipment and a storage medium based on water quantity-water pressure coupling, and belongs to the technical field of water supply quantity prediction and deep learning. By constructing IAMformer network, introducing multi-head sparse attention layer based on EMD distance in encoder and decoder, inputting the historical data of water supply quantity and instantaneous flow and holiday information into encoder to obtain main characteristic Q of water supply quantity prediction, inputting pressure data into decoder to obtain pressure auxiliary characteristic A capable of fusion, inputting both characteristics into main and auxiliary attention layers in decoder to make main and auxiliary attention matrix calculation and fusion to obtain fusion characteristic, outputting predicted water supply quantity by full connection layer, and back-propagation optimizing and updating model parameters according to composite loss function of water supply quantity loss and pressure loss. The invention can reduce the indirect influence of the water pressure prediction error on the water supply quantity prediction, and can reduce the complexity of an algorithm model and improve the robustness of the model.
assignees: SHANDONG FENCER INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid cascading failure early warning method based on risk assessment model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid cascading failure early warning method based on a risk assessment model, which comprises the steps of dynamically monitoring the load condition of a line in a coverage area by using the risk assessment model, marking the line judged to be abnormal by the risk assessment model as a potential risk line, acquiring a line associated with the potential risk line, determining a load transfer amount according to the current load quantity of the associated line, calculating the difference value between the load transfer amount and the local reserved load of the potential risk line, marking the difference value as the local reserved load, comparing the ratio of the local processing amount to the local reserved load, and sending early warning when the ratio is larger than or equal to a set value. According to the power grid cascading failure early warning method and system based on the risk assessment model, the risk assessment model is combined with the mode that the risk assessment model predicts and the later adjustment means intervenes to correct the result given by the risk assessment model.
assignees: KAIFENG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Safety management method and system for heat distribution pipe network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of safety management, in particular to a safety management method and system of a heating power pipe network, comprising the following steps: applying heat pulse to key sections of a heating power pipe network, monitoring propagation, collecting temperature, pressure and flow data, analyzing delay, temperature change and pressure fluctuation, determining a propagation path, evaluating transmission efficiency, adjusting heat distribution, monitoring regional temperature in real time, evaluating safety risk, sending an adjustment instruction, updating management and control priority, and generating a pipe network state feedback result after dispatching. According to the invention, by capturing the dynamic change of heat transmission, the heat transmission path and efficiency can be evaluated in real time, the heat distribution of the pipe network is optimized, the real-time analysis of the temperature data of the pipe network area is performed, the risk area is identified, the risk evaluation is performed, the priority control of the key area is ensured, the flexibility and response speed of the pipe network to the change are improved, the possibility of fault occurrence is reduced, and the stability and safety of heat supply are ensured.
assignees: HENAN HONGYE CONSTRUCTION MAN CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent content generation system based on open source data analysis
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent content generation system based on open source data analysis, which relates to the technical field of monitoring analysis and comprises a data preprocessing module, a map construction and extraction module, an intelligent content generation module and an optimization module, wherein the data preprocessing module is used for carrying out multi-mode content acquisition on a heterogeneous open source data platform to obtain a structural semantic feature matrix, the map construction and extraction module is used for carrying out domain knowledge map construction based on the structural semantic feature matrix to obtain a domain evolution feature vector, the intelligent content generation module is used for inputting the domain evolution feature vector into a multi-mode generation countermeasure network to carry out semantic-visual cross-mode mapping to obtain style enhanced intelligent generated content, the optimization module is used for carrying out propagation effect simulation prediction on the style enhanced intelligent generated content to generate a content propagation influence matrix, carrying out optimization iteration on the intelligent generated content according to the content propagation influence matrix to generate final optimized content and pushing the final optimized content to a target terminal.

title_en: Reservoir dispatching method and device based on multi-target reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir dispatching method and a device based on multi-objective reinforcement learning, which belongs to the technical field of reservoir dispatching and comprises the steps of constructing a data set according to preprocessing data, inputting a group of training space state data into a preset multi-objective deep reinforcement learning network, outputting predicted space state data, updating parameters of the multi-objective deep reinforcement learning network based on a back propagation mode according to a loss function, and taking the predicted space state data as new training space state data to obtain an updated target deep reinforcement learning network, inputting the training space state data of other groups in the training space state data into the updated target deep reinforcement learning network according to the training space state data of the plurality of groups to obtain a trained multi-target deep reinforcement learning network, inputting the space state data acquired in real time into the trained multi-target deep reinforcement learning network, and outputting a real-time optimized reservoir dispatching strategy. The invention realizes rapid and accurate reservoir dispatching.
assignees: MINISTRY OF WATER RESOURCES PEARL RIVER WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION TECH CONSULTATION GUANGZHOU CO LT

title_en: Digital twinning-fused power grid fault prediction system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twinning, in particular to a power grid fault prediction system and method integrating digital twinning. According to the invention, a structural state tensor is constructed by fusing multi-source heterogeneous sensing data and executing a space-time alignment algorithm, the Laplace operation is combined with a stress wave propagation model to analyze non-rigid deformation characteristics, a load transfer path map is generated to reveal hidden mechanical association, a finite element grid dynamically corrects Young modulus to form a structural degradation coefficient matrix, and a time sequence difference and a long-short term memory network capturing device degradation trend are combined, the Kelmogorov test quantifies the space-time distribution probability of faults, so that the power grid device is predicted to rise from single threshold early warning to multi-physical field coupling, the space-time resolution and dynamic adaptability of fault prediction are improved, the dependence of manual experience is reduced, and the robustness of a complex working condition system is enhanced.
assignees: SHANDONG TIANZHUO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Cascade hybrid pumped storage power station short-term scheduling method based on additional pump station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-term dispatching method of a step hybrid pumped storage power station based on an additional pump station, which comprises the steps of adding an energy storage pump station between step serial hydropower stations, and dynamically setting a reservoir capacity constraint by adopting a reservoir capacity dynamic control strategy considering the step hybrid pumped storage power station; the method comprises the steps of constructing a step hybrid pumped storage power station short-term dispatching model based on an additional energy storage pump station with the minimum mean square error of the residual load of a power grid as a target, solving the dispatching model based on an improved gradual optimization algorithm POA, constructing a comprehensive risk-benefit evaluation system, considering multi-dimensional targets of a system dispatching layer and a power station operation layer, and deeply analyzing the influence of the additional energy storage pump station on the power grid risk and benefit. The invention can be used for guiding daily scheduling of the step hybrid pumped storage power station based on the additionally arranged pump station, and can reduce the wind and light discarding phenomenon to the maximum extent while ensuring the safe and stable operation of the power system, thereby improving the absorption capacity of wind and light resources and the power supply reliability of the power system.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Automatic establishment and pushing method for load optimization distribution strategy of cascade hydropower station
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic establishment and pushing method for a load optimization distribution strategy of a cascade hydropower station, and belongs to the technical field of information automation of hydraulic and hydroelectric engineering. The method comprises the following steps of S1, establishing a comprehensive database for model call calculation, S2, establishing an intelligent simulation model, adjusting input and constraint conditions according to data of database numbers, selecting proper optimization targets according to different scene demands, S3, outputting a long-term scheduling scheme, a medium-term scheduling scheme and a short-term scheduling scheme by the intelligent simulation model, S4, establishing a unit combination and output distribution model, inputting unit state constraint conditions, outputting an optimization unit combination and output distribution strategy, and carrying out corresponding plan issuing or adjustment by personnel at a power grid mechanism side. The technical problems that the traditional cascade hydropower station load distribution strategy cannot meet the requirement that a user can not automatically formulate and implement the cascade hydropower station load optimization distribution strategy and cannot realize automatic pushing are solved.
assignees: GUANGXI GUIGUAN ELEC POWER CO LTD;DATANG YANTAN HYDROPOWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent park digital twin system and method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent park digital twin system and method based on artificial intelligence, which particularly relate to the technical field of digital twin simulation optimization and are used for solving the problems of low simulation distortion and emergency preview reliability caused by insufficient dynamic relevance modeling of entity behaviors in the prior art, constructing a propagation path hierarchical analysis network by collecting entity attribute data and dynamic interaction behavior data in real time, identifying key disturbance nodes based on path length and behavior type division groups and individual behavior data and quantifying propagation path relevance strength of the key disturbance nodes, generating a simulation model adjustment strategy by dynamic change difference and relevance strength, correcting propagation direction and density weight parameters of the key nodes to generate a high-precision simulation result, and forming a virtual-real linkage closed-loop optimization system by reversely updating the behavior weight based on the relevance strength based on a feedback mechanism of non-key node behavior deviation so as to improve the reliability of digital twin simulation in a complex scene.

title_en: Deep learning-based charging pile load prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep learning-based charging pile load prediction method which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a regional grid and initializing a cell basic attribute vector, S2, collecting historical load data and external influence factors, unifying the historical load data and the external influence factors into input tensors, S3, generating a time continuous evolution state by a nerve ordinary differential equation modeling module, S4, constructing a current moment state vector, S5, executing one-time space state propagation by a microcell automaton module, S6, carrying out multiple rounds of space propagation iteration, outputting an enhanced state representation, S7, outputting future multi-moment predicted values by a load prediction module, S8, calculating errors, executing end-to-end training optimization model parameters, and S9, outputting a final optimization model as a load prediction method. The invention obviously improves the response capability of the model to sudden disturbance and the stability of multi-region collaborative prediction, and can be widely applied to various application scenes such as intelligent energy management, electric traffic scheduling, intelligent optimization of urban public infrastructure and the like.
assignees: DONGFANG ZHONGTONG ENERGY SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Variable-working-condition multi-stage fatigue crack propagation prediction method for deep sea pressure-resistant cabin
abstract_en: The invention relates to a variable-working-condition multi-stage deep sea pressure-resistant cabin fatigue crack propagation prediction method, which relates to the technical field of deep sea pressure-resistant cabin fatigue detection, and comprises the steps of establishing a complete machine finite element model of a deep sea pressure-resistant cabin, carrying out fine modeling on weak link analysis, establishing a stress intensity factor-Gaussian process proxy model, carrying out deep sea pressure-resistant cabin fatigue crack prediction based on a dynamic Bayesian best-worth network model, carrying out sensitivity analysis on uncertainty parameters in the dynamic Bayesian network model based on a fatigue life prediction model of a small time scale, and reducing the influence of the uncertainty parameters in the crack propagation process based on a mixed self-adaptive resampling intelligent particle filtering parameter reasoning algorithm.

title_en: Universal repeated alarm suppression method for power transmission line monitoring system based on time sequence sample analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a general repeated alarm suppression method for a power transmission line monitoring system based on time sequence sample analysis, according to the method, through combining feature map analysis and time sequence sample modeling of a deep learning algorithm, the change condition of an abnormal region can be analyzed and judged, and whether to continue alarming or not is further determined. The invention makes repeated alarm effectively inhibited by comparing time sequence analysis with thermodynamic diagram. The method utilizes the weighted combination of the gradient map and the output layer characteristic map of the neural network counter propagation to generate the activation response thermodynamic diagram, thereby accurately identifying the region with the greatest contribution to the abnormal output result in the image. By global averaging pooling and ReLU activation functions, the system is able to pinpoint the region where the anomaly occurred. The technical means improves the accuracy of abnormal region identification and provides a reliable basis for subsequent alarm suppression.
assignees: Jiangsu electric power information technology co ltd

title_en: Energy storage cluster online frequency modulation method considering degradation cost and SOC balance
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy storage cluster on-line frequency modulation method considering degradation cost and State of Charge (SOC) balance, which comprises the steps of grouping energy storage power stations by adopting a neighbor propagation algorithm by taking structural indexes into consideration, obtaining an objective function of an on-line frequency modulation model by comprehensively considering consistency of the frequency modulation cost and the SOC, obtaining the difference of Lyapunov drift functions at adjacent moments according to dynamic constraint conditions of virtual queue backlog variables, establishing the on-line frequency modulation model of the energy storage clusters, analyzing to obtain optimal Charge and discharge power of the energy storage clusters at all moments, and establishing an energy storage cluster frequency modulation distribution model based on a capacity sensing water injection algorithm to obtain the Charge and discharge power of each energy storage power station in the Charge and discharge states. The invention can respond to the power grid frequency modulation signal in real time on the premise of not depending on the future frequency modulation signal, and can achieve balance between energy storage SOC balance and degradation cost reduction.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Cascade water light storage system optimal scheduling method and system considering receiving end load and frequency safety
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of multi-source power system optimal operation, and discloses a cascade water light storage system optimal scheduling method and system considering the load and frequency safety of a receiving end. The method comprises the steps of considering coordination optimization potential between direct current output power and water light storage complementation, constructing an optimization adjustment mode of direct current output power according to water and electricity retention requirement of a power grid at a transmitting end and load peak regulation requirement of a power grid at a receiving end, carrying out source load matching on the direct current output power and the load at the receiving end, defining indexes to quantify and evaluate the matching degree of the direct current output power and the load at the receiving end, calculating active and reactive losses of a line and a converter station, combining frequency safety of system operation, aiming at minimizing system operation cost and light abandoning punishment, providing a long-term optimization scheduling model in a cascade water light storage system, and solving through a column and constraint generation algorithm. The invention ensures the stable output of the direct current output power, improves the operation efficiency and stability of the whole power system, and can avoid the potential frequency safety problem after accidents happen.
assignees: STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV SICHUAN;SOUTHWEST BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA

title_en: Information fusion operation and maintenance system between zero carbon park industries
abstract_en: The invention discloses an information fusion operation and maintenance system between industries of a zero carbon park, in particular to the technical field of dynamic control of carbon emission, which is used for solving the problem of carbon accounting distortion caused by state deviation of an existing static carbon emission model and a physical system; an initial carbon bank model containing energy efficiency reference parameters is established through a design stage, an operation boundary characteristic spectrum is obtained through multi-working-condition dynamic calibration in a construction stage, thermodynamic tracks are synchronously collected, topological fragile nodes are identified based on Lyapunov exponent stability analysis and optical flow method thermal gradient analysis, a carbon bank cascade conduction effect is quantized by combining an equipment energy topological network, a dynamic carbon bank model correction instruction is generated to update energy efficiency parameters, and finally double-instruction cooperative management and control is executed in an operation and maintenance stage, so that full-period carbon data flow closed loop is realized, and the effect of continuously reducing carbon bank intensity in a park is achieved through multi-source information fusion and conduction chain modeling.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring method and system for water conservancy facilities based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent monitoring method and system for water conservancy facilities based on the Internet of things, which belong to the technical field of water conservancy projects, and comprise the steps of collecting data through a sensor, generating a physical dependency graph, fusing the physical dependency graph and a short-time dependency graph into a space perception graph, and establishing a space perception model, obtaining an abnormal propagation link and an abnormal score set, extracting high-confidence abnormal links, aggregating the high-confidence abnormal links in the space perception model to obtain a global model, and generating a scheduling decision through the global model. According to the intelligent monitoring method and system for the water conservancy facilities based on the Internet of things, under a multi-facility distributed monitoring scene, the space-structure dependency relationship between multi-dimensional monitoring data in the water conservancy facilities can be fully modeled, the space accurate positioning and propagation path tracing of abnormal events are realized, and the abnormal detection capability in single facilities is remarkably improved.

title_en: Method and system for interpolating missing value of reduction current voltage monitoring data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a method and a system for interpolating missing values of reduction current and voltage monitoring data, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining isolated missing values of historical load data in a micro-grid; estimating a target missing value based on a neighboring value of the isolated missing value, carrying out data randomness restoration on the historical load data based on the target missing value by adopting a missing value interpolation network to obtain restored load data, wherein the missing value interpolation network is obtained by combining a particle swarm algorithm and a back propagation neural network, training the missing value interpolation network based on the restored load data to obtain a trained network, and carrying out load prediction on the micro-grid based on the trained network to obtain the load data of the micro-grid. The method can accurately repair the data randomness of the historical load data, and improves the accuracy of load data prediction.
assignees: TIANTAI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Equipment asset management and control method, system and medium based on cyclic neural network
abstract_en: The application discloses a device asset management and control method, a device asset management and control system and a device asset management and control medium based on a cyclic neural network, which mainly relate to the technical field of device asset management and control and are used for solving the problems that the existing scheme lacks the capability of dynamic adjustment according to the actual requirements of devices, mainly focuses on management and control of single devices and neglects the systematicness and the integrity of asset management. The method comprises the steps of scaling initial sample data to the same preset numerical range to obtain training sample data, adding influence factors among equipment assets as marking data to the training sample data, completing training of a circulating neural network by using the training sample data, optimizing the trained circulating neural network through back propagation to obtain a final circulating neural network, obtaining actual operation data of current equipment assets, inputting the actual operation data into the final circulating neural network to obtain output management and control data and influence factors on other equipment assets after processing according to the management and control data.
assignees: INSPUR GENERAL SOFTWARE CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent weather risk early warning system for mining industry
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mining safety management, in particular to a mining-oriented weather risk intelligent early warning system which comprises the steps of acquiring multi-source heterogeneous data such as mining area weather, geology and the like in real time by constructing a mining area multi-field coupling monitoring network, providing rich and accurate data bases for subsequent risk analysis, dynamically synthesizing mining area sceneries of weather threat factors by combining mining scene metadata and time sequence features through condition antagonism, accurately capturing weather risk features under different mining scenes, and helping a manager to quickly know mining area risk conditions by establishing a geologic body-weather field coupling risk propagation topological graph and generating a regional risk potential energy thermodynamic diagram, identifying medium and high risk areas by spatial clustering analysis, generating scene self-adaptive regulation and control instructions, improving pertinence and effectiveness of emergency response, and being beneficial to quickly controlling risks and reducing losses.
assignees: ZIJIN MINING GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Wheat gluten production quality assessment method based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of quality evaluation, and particularly relates to a wheat gluten production quality evaluation method based on machine learning. Firstly, flour and water are mixed according to a proportion to prepare dough, visual images of wet gluten and cleaning liquid are collected when the dough is cleaned, and core attention areas are extracted through image pretreatment, enhancement, morphological operation and differential screening. Based on this region, the wet gluten color index and starch granule dispersion are calculated, and the optimum value is obtained by changing the ratio of flour and water with the minimum value of the two as an objective function. An improved cascade neural network model is constructed, an input layer fuses optimal indexes, dispersion and production process parameters, a cascade structure processes prediction quality through a BP neural network and a convolution neural network, and the neural network parameters are determined by an improved firefly algorithm. The method solves the problems of low efficiency, poor consistency and the like of the traditional manual evaluation, realizes objective and accurate evaluation, and meets the requirement of industrial production on quality control.

title_en: Soft magnetic material single-chip broadband dynamic hysteresis modeling method based on Cauer network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of electromagnetic characteristic analysis of magnetic elements, and discloses a soft magnetic material single-chip broadband dynamic hysteresis modeling method based on a Cauer network, wherein the magnetic field distribution of the soft magnetic material single-chip is deduced, the magnetic flux is obtained through integration, the magnetic permeability is further obtained, the Taylor of the magnetic flux is unfolded, and the effective impedance and impedance network of the soft magnetic material single-chip are deduced; generating a cascade magnetic circuit Cauer network, calculating the magnetic field intensity corresponding to the single-chip macroscopic vortex of the soft magnetic material under the high-frequency skin effect, extracting the parameters of a continuous reverse Play hysteresis model by using a genetic algorithm method, calculating hysteresis loss by using the continuous reverse Play hysteresis model, calculating eddy current loss by using the Cauer network, and calculating abnormal loss according to Bertotti equation. The invention provides a new model suitable for soft magnetic material broadband dynamic hysteresis simulation, and solves the industrial problem of soft magnetic material broadband hysteresis characteristic prediction.
assignees: UNIV CHINA THREE GORGES CTGU

title_en: Intelligent building collaborative optimization operation method considering toughness constraint
abstract_en: The invention provides a cooperative optimization operation method of an intelligent building considering toughness constraint, which relates to the technical field of building comprehensive energy scheduling and comprises the steps of constructing a source network load storage integrated module of an intelligent building comprehensive energy system, integrating distributed energy, an energy storage unit and load data through an energy router, and realizing cascade utilization of electric energy, heat energy and cold energy based on a multi-energy complementation principle; the method comprises the steps of constructing toughness indexes to quantify the capability of an intelligent building comprehensive energy system for coping with emergency, constructing a double-layer optimization scheduling model based on the intelligent building comprehensive energy system and the toughness indexes, and solving the double-layer optimization scheduling model by utilizing an improved gray wolf optimization algorithm to obtain an optimal energy scheduling strategy. The invention can comprehensively consider the system economical efficiency and toughness indexes, ensure the electricity utilization safety of the building, improve the new energy consumption capacity, reduce the total power generation cost of the whole building comprehensive energy system as much as possible, and solve the optimization problem through an improved gray wolf algorithm.
assignees: FUJIAN BRANCH OF CHINA HUADIAN GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Broadband electromagnetic radiation interference characteristic modeling method for shielded cable network
abstract_en: A broadband electromagnetic radiation interference characteristic modeling method of a shielded cable network comprises the following steps of 1) obtaining a scattering parameter matrix of a shielded connector and a transmission parameter matrix of a bent shielded cable, 2) constructing an equivalent N-port model of the shielded connector by using the scattering parameter matrix, deducing the transmission parameter matrix of the shielded connector, 3) establishing a multi-conductor transmission line equation for distributing reactive interference current on the shielded cable by using the transfer impedance of the shielded cable, 4) cascading all the transmission parameter matrices of the bent shielded cable and the shielded cable to obtain the transmission parameter matrix of the whole shielded cable network, 5) solving the multi-conductor transmission line equation by combining boundary constraint conditions to obtain common-mode interference current of a shielding layer of the shielded cable, and calculating electric field radiation of the shielded cable network by using a dipole array theory. The invention is suitable for single-core and multi-core wire harness shielding linear uniform and non-uniform shielding cables and shielding cable networks, and has good universality.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Optical power prediction method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention provides an artificial intelligence-based optical power prediction method and system, the method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-data source information of photovoltaic power generation, preprocessing to obtain standardized multi-mode input tensors, determining disturbance criteria at each moment based on the multi-mode input tensors, determining whether current weather has severe change or not to generate corresponding indication signals, constructing a graph structure according to component state data constructed by the multi-mode input tensors, constructing an edge set and calculating edge weights according to the structure/physical/environmental coupling relation among components, conducting disturbance propagation based on an improved graph neural network according to the constructed graph structure, outputting disturbance feature representations of a plurality of components, integrating the disturbance feature representations of the components, and outputting a system-level optical power predicted value at the current moment.
assignees: THE SECOND GEOLOGICAL SURVEY INST OF HEILONGJIANG PROVINCE

title_en: Multi-source heterogeneous system data collaborative distribution network graph real consistency checking system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data analysis, in particular to a power distribution network graph real consistency check system with data collaboration of a multi-source heterogeneous system, which comprises a topological feature extraction module, a cross-system topological alignment module and an anomaly tracing module, wherein the topological feature extraction module extracts multi-dimensional attribute features and topological connection relations of equipment nodes from the multi-source heterogeneous system to generate dynamic fingerprint vectors, the cross-system topological alignment module receives the dynamic fingerprint vectors and builds an intermediate semantic layer to output standard fingerprint vectors, a unified topological model is generated by analyzing the differential topological rules of the multi-source heterogeneous system, comparison difference values of the standard fingerprint vectors among different systems and equivalent connection relations of electrical connection features are calculated, the anomaly tracing module receives the comparison difference values and builds an anomaly propagation tree to generate an anomaly propagation path, and the anomaly root nodes are positioned by analyzing the coupling weights of the comparison equivalent connection relations and the comparison difference values.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Enterprise digital operation real-time data analysis method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses an enterprise digital operation real-time data analysis method based on multi-source data fusion, which relates to the technical field of data processing and solves the technical problems that firstly, an enterprise comprehensive benefit index is difficult to analyze and predict, secondly, a knowledge graph is difficult to embed into a vector space to construct a dynamic graph neural network, then, an equipment abnormal offset, a supply chain abnormal offset and customer activity are difficult to analyze, a risk matrix is constructed, a comprehensive benefit index descending propagation path is identified, service link resources are difficult to dynamically allocate according to an analysis result of the risk matrix, and finally, the data analysis result is difficult to visually display. According to the invention, by collecting and preprocessing enterprise multisource data, a three-dimensional vector space and a dynamic graph neural network are constructed, enterprise benefits and risks are predicted by combining multiple technical analysis, resources of a business link are dynamically allocated, and a data analysis result is visually displayed.

title_en: Automatic operation and maintenance intelligent management system of transformer substation based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power equipment, in particular to a digital twin-based substation automation operation and maintenance intelligent management system, which comprises an information acquisition module, a data simulation module and an intelligent operation and maintenance module, wherein the information acquisition module is used for acquiring real-time operation data of equipment, the data simulation module is used for performing substation simulation operation according to the real-time operation data of the equipment, the intelligent operation and maintenance module is used for performing equipment fault prediction according to a simulation operation result and performing intelligent operation and maintenance according to a prediction result, the digital twin-based substation power flow simulation module is constructed based on a digital twin technology, active power, reactive power and branch power flow simulation are realized, simulation precision is optimized through deep reinforcement learning, fault prediction is performed by merging a graph-convolution network, the equipment health score and a fault propagation model are combined, the topological relation is dynamically adjusted, the prediction accuracy is improved, and the priority of maintenance tasks and the resource allocation strategy are intelligently adjusted based on the fault prediction result, so that the priority maintenance of key equipment is ensured, and the operation and maintenance efficiency of the substation is improved.
assignees: TUOYUN ELECTRIC HANGZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Method, device, equipment and product for generating voltage sag propagation characteristics of power distribution network
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a method, a device, equipment and a product for generating a power distribution network voltage sag propagation characteristic, which are applied to the technical field of power system automation. The method comprises the steps of responding to a voltage sag event, collecting current electrical parameter values of each electrical connection point of a power distribution network and topology structure data of the power distribution network, wherein the topology structure data are used for indicating connection relations among the electrical connection points, generating a data feature matrix corresponding to the voltage sag event based on the electrical parameter values of the electrical connection points and the topology structure data, inputting the data feature matrix into a pre-trained voltage sag positioning prediction model to obtain predicted fault positioning corresponding to the data feature matrix, and inputting the predicted fault positioning into a digital twin model corresponding to the power distribution network to obtain propagation features corresponding to the voltage sag event. The method achieves the technical effect of determining the efficiency of the voltage sag propagation characteristics.
assignees: SHANTOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for establishing short-term probability prediction model of comprehensive energy load polymer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for establishing a comprehensive energy load polymer short-term probability prediction model. The method comprises the steps of preprocessing and dimension reduction of collected historical data of the comprehensive energy load aggregate, grouping the dimension reduced data by adopting an affinity propagation clustering algorithm based on comprehensive similarity, extracting centroid characteristics of each group as representative load characteristics, inputting the representative load characteristics into a prediction model, and constructing a comprehensive energy load aggregate short-term probability prediction model fused with a Copula self-adaptive correlation analysis, a cross characteristic-time diagram neural network and a mixed density network. According to the invention, the accuracy of the short-term probability prediction of the comprehensive energy load aggregate is effectively improved through a dynamic coupling relation mining and space-time characteristic joint learning mechanism.

title_en: Face recognition-based power transmission line constructor identity verification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a face recognition-based power transmission line constructor identity verification method, which relates to the technical field of power engineering safety management and comprises the steps of collecting multispectral face data to generate a spectral three-dimensional feature matrix, extracting micro-blood flow pulsation features, skin texture features and thermal imaging temperature distribution features from the spectral three-dimensional feature matrix, constructing a three-layer cascading anti-fake verification mechanism to carry out comprehensive living judgment, establishing a distributed feature matching network, matching the spectral three-dimensional feature matrix with a pre-stored feature library, collecting constructor geographic position tracks and operation behavior patterns, carrying out multidimensional cross verification with an identity matching result to generate a multi-level safety evaluation index, writing the identity verification process and the multi-level safety evaluation index into a distributed account book to generate a verification credential. The invention effectively solves the problem that the traditional face recognition system is easy to be falsified by the identity by carrying out cross analysis on the identity matching result and the behavior characteristic of constructors.
assignees: GUANGDONG SENXU GENERAL EQUIPMENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban rail transit network toughness assessment method considering passenger flow dynamics
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban rail transit network toughness assessment method considering passenger flow dynamics, and relates to the technical field of urban rail transit network assessment. The urban rail transit network system comprises a modeling of an urban rail transit network by using a complex network theory, calculation of traffic demands among stations in the urban rail transit network to obtain passenger flow demand data, acquisition of passenger flow distribution by adopting a user balancing model according to the passenger flow demand data from an origin to a destination among nodes, establishment of an urban rail transit network cascade failure model considering station overload, establishment of an urban rail transit network recovery model considering passenger flow redistribution and station repairing states, quantification of urban rail transit network recovery capacity through three indexes of nodes, lines and topology, and evaluation of urban rail transit network toughness. The invention constructs the performance evaluation index from three aspects of nodes, lines and topology, and can comprehensively grasp the change of the urban rail transit network operation performance in all aspects.
assignees: BEIJING POLYTECHNIC

title_en: BIM-based power management and control method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power management and control, in particular to a BIM-based power management and control method and system, comprising the following steps: and extracting construction information and material characteristic parameters of the building power equipment from the BIM model, calculating a material thermal stress accumulation value by combining a temperature change curve in the operation data, and estimating the damage degree based on the fatigue parameter to obtain a thermal damage estimation result of the power equipment. According to the invention, damage identification precision is improved by analyzing the construction information and the operation data of the power equipment, a power supply path is optimized based on the comparison of a damage value and a endurance limit, overload is prevented by dynamically adjusting power distribution by utilizing real-time load data, fault propagation is deduced by combining a fault node power supply line, a power flow direction and impedance parameters, prediction capacity is improved, a recovery scheme is optimized by adjusting the capacity and the power attenuation ratio of a standby power supply path, intelligent coordination of monitoring, evaluation, adjustment and recovery is realized by depending on BIM data dynamic update, and power grid operation efficiency and strain capacity are improved.
assignees: ZHONGZHIXIN JIANGSU ENERGY STORAGE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Host machine fault disaster recovery method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a host machine fault disaster recovery method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium, wherein the method comprises determining whether each host machine contains a fault risk according to the condition of receiving network communication information sent by each host machine; if the host computer with the fault risk exists, stopping receiving the network communication information sent by the host computer with the fault risk, and isolating the storage resource of the host computer with the fault risk; selecting a host from hosts without fault risks, and rebuilding virtual machines running on the hosts with fault risks on the selected hosts. According to the method and the device, the potential faults of the host can be found as soon as possible, and the problems of software and hardware of the host with the fault risk can be detected conveniently and subsequently through isolating and reserving the site, and the virtual machines on the host with the fault risk are rebuilt on other healthy hosts, so that the service interruption time of the host is reduced.
assignees: HANGZHOU YOUYUN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Electric power facility toughness evaluation system based on multi-source seismic data
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric power facility toughness assessment system based on multi-source seismic data, which relates to the technical field of data processing and is used for acquiring a seismic data set, screening the seismic data set, removing seismic data irrelevant to a target facility in a seismic center position, obtaining the seismic screening data set, extracting inflection points of vibration amplitude change, dividing the seismic screening data set into a plurality of data segments according to the inflection points, splicing according to time sequences, obtaining continuous vibration data, establishing a vibration transmission path according to the spatial position and the connection relation of each component in the target facility and the propagation direction and the action time of the spliced vibration data, calculating vibration response values of each component in the target facility, determining the component numbers and the vibration response values, and calculating toughness indexes of the target facility to obtain a toughness assessment result of the target facility. The invention can evaluate the toughness index of the electric power facilities in the multi-source seismic data.
assignees: POWER EMERGENCY CENTER OF STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP;Sichuan Seismic Station;XIAMEN DIJIA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Real-time supervision system of intelligent box-type substation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent monitoring of power equipment, in particular to a real-time supervision system of an intelligent box-type transformer substation, which comprises a multi-source data acquisition module, a voiceprint fault diagnosis module, an antitheft space-time prediction module, a cooperative arbitration module and a database; the fault classification unit takes MobileNetV as a model, classifies real-time voiceprint characteristics after training, identifies fault types, the anti-theft space-time prediction module creates an LSTM model to output a vibration baseline value and calculates real-time deviation, analyzes a vibration propagation path by means of a graph convolution network to obtain a space abnormality index, further calculates a comprehensive threat value, and the collaborative arbitration module divides rule types according to TAS and the voiceprint fault types.
assignees: SHANDONG BOAO ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Improved DBSCAN abnormal node identification method based on space-time fusion characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses an improved DBSCAN abnormal node identification method based on space-time fusion characteristics in the technical field of power systems, which comprises the steps of constructing a distribution area adjacent matrix, extracting five spatial topological characteristics such as node approximate centrality, intermediate centrality and hierarchical depth, combining 16 time sequence characteristics such as voltage fluctuation index, current peak-valley difference and power integral to form space-time dual characteristic representation, adopting Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to perform dimension reduction treatment on the fusion characteristics, and reserving variance information of more than 90% to reduce calculation complexity. According to the method, the propagation rule of electricity stealing disturbance in a power grid is effectively described through space-time feature fusion, the problem of dimension disaster is solved through PCA dimension reduction, the adaptation of DBSCAN to complex topological scenes is improved through dynamic parameter optimization, the false detection rate is reduced by more than 50% compared with that of the traditional detection technology, the calculation efficiency is improved by 80%, and the method can be widely applied to the fields of electricity stealing screening, abnormal electricity behavior monitoring and the like of high-loss areas and provides technical support for the safe operation of an electric power system.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Social information networking monitoring and early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a social information networking monitoring and early warning method and system, and relates to the technical field of information early warning; the method comprises the steps of obtaining semantic similarity of cross-time semantics according to feature vectors and feature weights extracted from multi-source information by a distributed semantic model, obtaining an event association strength network according to the information source weights and the semantic similarity, obtaining risk propagation indexes for evaluating the influence of an information propagation path on risk amplification according to the distribution characteristics of depths of network nodes in the event association strength network, generating early warning comprehensive indexes for monitoring social information networking according to the risk propagation indexes, the information source weights, the semantic similarity and the association strength among events in the event association strength network, and determining early warning grade results corresponding to the early warning comprehensive indexes according to preset threshold intervals. The method and the system can improve accuracy and timeliness of social information networking monitoring and early warning.
assignees: YUESHENGDA TIANJIN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Meteorological disaster risk grading intelligent assessment and pushing method for town areas
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for intelligently evaluating and pushing weather disaster risk grades for a town area, which relates to the technical field of weather disaster early warning and comprises the steps of extracting and fusing space-time characteristics and geographic element characteristics by utilizing a space-time attention mechanism and a dynamic weight mechanism through acquiring weather monitoring data of a plurality of monitoring points in the town area, and generating weather disaster risk grades through a bidirectional long-short-time memory network; and finally, constructing a distributed storage network through a hierarchical cascade block chain, and encrypting and pushing the early warning information in fragments. The method can realize accurate assessment and efficient early warning of the risk of the meteorological disaster in the town area, and improves the reliability and timeliness of early warning information.
assignees: Yangjiang Meteorological Observatory

title_en: Artificial intelligence-based risk early warning method for supply chain of automobile part enterprise
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of automobile parts and discloses an artificial intelligence-based risk early warning method for an automobile part enterprise supply chain, which comprises the steps of collecting and processing supply chain data, constructing a map, evaluating suppliers based on the map to generate an image matrix, based on the image matrix, combining production parameters, carrying out model training, constructing a prediction engine to generate a part quality risk prediction result, carrying out anomaly detection on nodes to form a monitoring network, producing a risk assessment result, based on the map, constructing a supply chain network topology model, carrying out risk propagation path analysis, generating a risk conduction diagram, establishing a risk assessment model, integrating the risk prediction result, the risk assessment result and the risk conduction diagram, carrying out integrated assessment on risks of each link of the supply chain to form a scoring system, and based on the scoring system, generating a dynamic risk early warning threshold, constructing a risk response decision tree, providing an intelligent risk response suggestion, so that the risk treatment efficiency of the enterprise is improved.

title_en: Low-voltage distribution network fluctuation risk research and judgment and intelligent early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-voltage distribution network fluctuation risk studying, judging and intelligent early warning method and system, and relates to the technical field of intelligent early warning of electric power systems, wherein the method comprises the steps of performing fusion analysis on power grid operation data and environment data through a space-time convolutional neural network to generate an associated feature matrix of power grid operation state and environment risk; the method comprises the steps of carrying out dynamic modeling on a power grid topological structure by utilizing a physical information dynamic graph attention network, extracting a dynamic risk propagation path, adopting a Bayesian network to calculate fault probability distribution of each node of the power grid in combination with the dynamic risk propagation path, optimizing an early warning strategy through a reinforcement learning algorithm to generate an optimal early warning scheme, and scheduling rush repair resources by utilizing a multi-objective optimization algorithm to generate a rush repair resource scheduling scheme. The method has the beneficial effects of remarkably improving the accuracy of fault early warning and the rush-repair efficiency and providing reliable technical support for the intelligent operation and maintenance of the low-voltage distribution network.

title_en: Water and electricity weak flexible power grid flood period daily peak regulation and compensation model method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a daily peak regulation and compensation model method for a hydropower weak flexible power grid in a flood season, which comprises the steps of obtaining daily planned load curves, wind power, hydropower and thermal power parameters of the power grid, subtracting the wind power load from the power grid load, updating the residual equivalent loads of water and thermal power, constructing a daily total water rejection minimum model of a cascade power station, subtracting the residual load of the power grid from the water power output, updating to obtain the residual load of thermal power, constructing a total cost minimum model of thermal power, calculating to obtain the output plan of each thermal power unit, compensating the opportunity cost loss and the deep peak regulation caused by shutdown of the thermal power units participating in the deep peak regulation, introducing a peak regulation contribution coefficient to distribute peak regulation benefits, obtaining the compensation amount of each power station, and distributing the deep peak regulation benefits of the deep peak regulation power station. The invention compensates the opportunity cost loss and the depth peak shaving caused by shutdown of the thermal power generating units participating in the depth peak shaving, obtains the compensation amount of each unit, and realizes the depth peak shaving benefit distribution of the depth peak shaving power station.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Substation monitoring method and system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention provides a transformer substation monitoring method and system based on the Internet of things, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining an original electromagnetic disturbance signal of a transformer substation, constructing an electromagnetic disturbance feature matrix, adopting a self-adaptive attention mechanism to combine asymmetric abnormal detection loss to detect the abnormality of the electromagnetic disturbance signal, inputting a time sequence input vector into a fault classification model to identify fault types, outputting fault type labels and severity, calculating fault propagation paths of the fault type labels and severity to obtain fault propagation paths, simulating fault evolution through a digital twin model, predicting fault development trend, secondary fault influence range and future state vectors, and finally generating maintenance priority, a time window and a resource scheduling scheme. The invention breaks through the limitation of the traditional monitoring technology, improves the intelligent level of the transformer substation, reduces the maintenance cost and improves the safety and reliability of the operation of the power grid.
assignees: DINGXI GUOXUN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake isolation and shock absorption system based on tree space layout form
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of earthquake prevention and disaster reduction, and provides an earthquake isolation and shock absorption system based on a tree space layout form. The system comprises a density gradient tree layout area, a periodic lattice tree array area, a target protection area and a buffer transition zone. The density gradient layout area is positioned at the front end of the system, the density of trees is gradually increased along the propagation direction of the earthquake waves and is used for realizing impedance smooth transition and guiding wave energy to enter the array area, the trees in the periodic array area are distributed at equal intervals to form a quasi-periodic elastic structure which is used for generating Bragg scattering band gap effect and reflecting and dissipating the earthquake waves in a specific frequency section, the target protection area is used for laying buildings or infrastructures to be protected, and the buffer transition area is arranged between the tail end of the array and the target area and is used for absorbing residual wave energy and reducing echo amplification effect. The application constructs a green, low-cost and sustainable natural shock isolation system, and has good earthquake wave control effect and engineering adaptability.
assignees: UNIV TONGJI

title_en: Engineering supply chain risk conduction analysis system and method based on graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides an engineering supply chain risk conduction analysis system and method based on a graph neural network, which are used for acquiring supply chain operation data from supply chain nodes of multiple levels, constructing a graph structure model among the supply chain nodes according to the operation data, identifying and quantifying the association relation among the nodes, simulating the occurrence of risk events of the supply chain nodes on the graph structure model, calculating the probability and influence value of risk propagation from the occurrence node to other nodes based on the graph structure model, identifying a main risk propagation path, detecting an abnormal subgraph mode in the risk propagation process of the graph structure model by using a Motif abnormality detection module, carrying out representation learning and association prediction on the graph structure model by using a self-supervision graph neural network, mining potential hidden risk association, and automatically identifying a hidden high-risk link and a key propagation path by constructing a multi-level supply chain association graph and introducing risk disturbance simulation.
assignees: CETHIK GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Gas pipe network defect hidden danger assessment method, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gas pipe network defect hidden danger risk assessment method, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of hidden danger risk assessment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step 1, gas pipe network early warning information acquisition, step 2, gas pipe network threat analysis, step 3, gas pipe network gas interruption processing and step 4, gas pipe network post-disaster test processing, the invention analyzes the influence of earthquake waves on a gas pipe by considering not only the damage of environmental data on the gas pipe but also the propagation direction of the earthquake waves and the installation direction of the gas pipe during an earthquake, the method and the device screen the gas-cutting off gas pipelines of each section of the urban gas pipe network, so that the judgment accuracy is improved, the possibility of gas leakage is reduced, the gas ventilation test is performed in advance before the gas supply is carried out again, and the problem of whether the gas-cutting off gas pipelines of each section of the urban gas pipe network leak gas is judged, so that the safety of the gas pipelines is improved.
assignees: HANGZHOU GELUNBU ROBOT CO LTD

title_en: Cascade reservoir optimization regulation and control method based on water nitrogen and phosphorus circulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade reservoir optimization regulation method based on nitrogen and phosphorus circulation of a water body, which relates to the technical field of water resource management and optimization, and aims to collect multidimensional data of a gradient reservoir, construct a space-time aligned multimodal data set, deduce a physical equation of the nitrogen and phosphorus circulation according to a bio-geochemical process of the nitrogen and phosphorus circulation, design a physical constraint loss term and form a mixed loss function by weighting and combining the physical constraint loss term and data driving loss. According to the invention, by constructing the physical constraint neural network model and embedding the physical equation of the nitrogen-phosphorus cycle into the neural network loss function, not only is the strong fitting capacity of the data driving model utilized, but also the output of the model is ensured to accord with the bio-geochemical rule through the physical constraint, and the key parameters of the physical equation are calibrated through the Bayesian optimization algorithm, so that the prediction precision of the model on the nitrogen-phosphorus migration conversion process is further improved, the dependence on big data is effectively reduced, and a reliable prediction result can still be provided especially under the condition of lower data space-time resolution.
assignees: INST HYDROGEOLOGY & ENV GEOLOGY CAGS;HEBEI NEW CITY URBAN AND RURAL STATISTICS DEV SERVICE CENTER

title_en: System Evaluation via Multiplex Network Science and Multiscale System Dynamics
abstract_en: A multiplex network science (MNS) model represents infrastructure of an environment and an installation as a plurality of nodes connected by links, the links defining dependencies between the plurality of nodes. A multiscale system dynamics (MSD) model represents the installation as a plurality of nested subsystems and resource flows connecting the nested subsystems. A hybrid model integrating the MNS model and the MSD model is generated, the hybrid model linking the MNS model and MSD model via boundary conditions representing dependencies between the installation and the infrastructure of the environment. The hybrid model simulates an alteration to the infrastructure of the environment and propagation of effects of the alteration through at least one of the boundary conditions to the installation.
assignees: UNIV NORTHEASTERN;BATTELLE MEMORIAL INSTITUTE;UNIV CALIFORNIA

title_en: Post-disaster power distribution network island division method and system considering fault propagation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster power distribution network island division method and system considering fault propagation. The method comprises the steps of firstly, detecting and identifying node and line damage conditions through multiple rounds, constructing a node and line damage state detection model considering fault propagation, then combining the node and line damage condition detection models to construct a post-disaster power distribution network island division model facing fault propagation isolation, and finally, carrying out linearization treatment on the constructed model to reduce solving difficulty and combining solving to obtain an optimized power distribution network island division and node power supply strategy. According to the technical scheme, fault propagation is considered in the island division process of the power distribution network, a fault area can be effectively isolated, and the safety and the effectiveness of a power supply recovery scheme of the power distribution network after disaster are improved.
assignees: UNIV NANJING SCI & TECH;NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Heat supply network operation efficiency evaluation method based on data prediction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of heat supply network operation efficiency evaluation, and discloses a heat supply network operation efficiency evaluation method based on data prediction. The method comprises the steps of constructing a structure transformation result matrix, constructing a graph modeling structure, extracting disturbance characteristics, constructing a graph propagation modulation mechanism, generating a structure disturbance response representation, identifying a structure behavior type, completing node flow prediction by combining a basic predictor, comparing and analyzing a prediction result with actual operation data, judging the degree of fit between the node operation state and a target heat supply requirement, and outputting an operation efficiency evaluation result of a heat supply network. According to the method, through introducing a disturbance-driven graph propagation mechanism and a multi-mode structure identification strategy, modeling capacity and prediction accuracy of nonlinear structure response in a complex heating system are effectively improved, and support is provided for real-time evaluation and efficiency management of the system running state.
assignees: JINING JIAXIANG PUBLIC HEAT SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Transparent fusion perception visualization scene construction method and system for low-voltage power distribution network
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent power grids, and provides a method and a system for constructing a transparent fusion perception visualization scene of a low-voltage power distribution network, wherein the method and the system comprise the steps of synchronously acquiring voltage, current and equipment state data by utilizing power line carrier communication, an intelligent ammeter and a power distribution terminal, and establishing a circular queue with time marks aligned; the method comprises the steps of constructing a tree topology structure based on three-phase attributes, generating a connection matrix, dividing users into visual levels with different transparencies through electric distance calculation, realizing gradual change coloring and special effect warning of an overload circuit through combining current saturation mapping, fusing physical positions and electric parameters through polar coordinate system conversion, generating dynamic particle flows to intuitively display current distribution, and analyzing a voltage distortion propagation path through waveform similarity backtracking when voltage is in sag, positioning disturbance sources and triggering pulse diffusion animation. The transparent fusion sensing of the running state of the low-voltage distribution network is realized, the real-time early warning of line overload and the second-level positioning of disturbance sources are realized, and the intelligent operation and maintenance efficiency is improved.

title_en: Coal mine safety monitoring system based on big data
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of industrial big data, in particular to a coal mine safety monitoring system based on big data. The system comprises a sensor module, a dynamic topology construction module, a risk propagation calculation module and a cooperative control module, wherein the sensor module is used for acquiring mine data and preprocessing, the dynamic topology construction module is used for establishing a dynamic connection map between mine areas and constructing a risk conduction network, the risk propagation calculation module is used for calculating a risk conduction value and a target threshold value, the cooperative control module is used for judging abnormality, generating a cross-area equipment linkage instruction set, judging whether the instruction set is effective according to a risk attenuation rate, executing the instruction set if the instruction set is effective, and then generating an operation record and storing the operation record. Therefore, the problems that the multi-region risk conduction effect cannot be predicted in the monitoring of coal mine safety, the equipment control instruction is executed in isolation, the system-level linkage is lacked, and the historical accidents are not deeply related with the real-time data are solved.

title_en: Traffic transportation operation monitoring early warning and decision analysis method based on vehicle-road cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traffic operation monitoring, early warning and decision analysis method based on vehicle-road cooperation, and relates to the technical field of intelligent traffic. The invention realizes real-time acquisition of dynamic traffic elements through multidimensional sensing networks and V2X communication of vehicle ends, road sides and environments, ensures unified space-time basis of multisource data, builds a 'road-vehicle-environment-event' semantic network, combines hierarchical feature extraction, realizes multidimensional identification of abnormal events such as accidents, congestion, bad weather and the like, improves identification accuracy, predicts an abnormal event propagation path, has global road network situation prediction capability, generates differential early warning based on comprehensive risk indexes, triggers multistage response such as traffic signal adjustment, path planning and the like, greatly shortens response time, optimizes emergency response efficiency, establishes a real-time feedback mechanism of decision execution effect, continuously optimizes system performance along with data accumulation, and avoids the defect that a large data platform lacks intelligent decision closed loop.
assignees: CHANGAN UNIV

title_en: Method and system for tracing metering error of carbon emission flow of electric power system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric carbon emission, in particular to a method and a system for tracing a metering error of a carbon emission flow of an electric power system, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a carbon emission factor calculation model of each node based on a topological relation of the electric power system, and determining an upstream-downstream dependency relation between the nodes; according to the error source of the distributed metering system, the relative uncertainty of the metering equipment error at the source side and the data transmission error between the nodes is quantized, the relative uncertainty of the carbon emission factors of each node from the source side to the user side is calculated step by step according to the error transmission rule, a global error propagation path is generated, the total relative uncertainty of the carbon emission amount at the user side is calculated, disturbance analysis is carried out on power grid power data through a probability statistical simulation method, and abnormal nodes are identified. The method aims at realizing error tracing of the carbon emission metering flow and avoiding reduction of accuracy of the carbon emission metering caused by node errors in the power system.
assignees: BEIJING SMARTCHIP MICROELECTRONICS TECH CO LTD;BEIJING ZHIXIN SEMICONDUCTOR TECH CO LTD;SICHUAN ENERGY INTERNET RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF TSINGHUA UNIV

title_en: Dynamic visual data-based power quality assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic visual data-based electric energy quality assessment method and a dynamic visual data-based electric energy quality assessment system, which relate to the technical field of electric energy assessment of a power distribution network. And extracting voltage sag characteristics by wavelet transformation, combining LSTM mining harmonic time sequence characteristics, capturing environmental space distribution by CNN, and constructing a multidimensional characteristic matrix. And then, inputting a TCN-GAT model to fuse space-time characteristics, calculating node voltage sensitivity, harmonic propagation weight and risk index, and outputting the electric energy quality comprehensive score. And triggering visual analysis and knowledge graph matching according to the comprehensive scores of the electric energy quality to realize abnormality diagnosis and strategy generation. According to the method, through multi-dimensional feature fusion and space-time analysis, the evaluation accuracy, the instantaneity and the interpretability are improved, and an intelligent scheme is provided for power distribution network dispatching and fault prevention and control.
assignees: JINAN ZIRUI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Modeling method and device for disaster propagation and risk evolution of power system
abstract_en: The invention provides a modeling method and device for disaster propagation and risk evolution of a power system, and relates to the technical field of power systems. The modeling method of disaster propagation and risk evolution of the power system comprises the steps of determining risk key nodes in a target area according to historical disaster damage data of the target area, wherein the risk key nodes comprise risk disturbance source nodes, equipment fault nodes and terminal loss nodes, determining edges among the risk key nodes according to risk conduction causal relations among the risk key nodes to obtain a disaster chain evolution network, and constructing a disaster deduction model according to the disaster chain evolution network. The invention can deduce the evolution process of various risk paths caused by the risks caused by equipment faults of the power system under extreme weather conditions, and provides basis for timely taking countermeasures when the extreme weather comes.
