assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Submarine cable risk dynamic assessment method and system based on multi-modal deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a submarine cable risk dynamic assessment method and system based on multi-mode deep learning, and belongs to the field of marine infrastructure operation and maintenance. Aiming at the problems of incomplete data coverage, incomplete generation scene, low evaluation reliability and the like in the prior art, the method comprises the steps of 1) constructing a multi-source heterogeneous data set containing six types of data such as geology, ocean, ships and biology, adopting space-time grid coding to realize data alignment, 2) designing a physical constraint generation countermeasure network, generating risk scene data conforming to a hydrodynamic rule through Navier-Stokes equation constraint, 3) creating a layered space-time fusion network (HST-transform), combining CNN spatial feature extraction, a time sequence attention mechanism and a dynamic memory module to realize multi-mode fusion, 4) establishing a mixed uncertainty quantization frame to distinguish cognitive uncertainty and inherent data noise, and 5) integrating a digital twin platform to realize risk propagation simulation and inverse fact intervention analysis. According to the invention, the rare risk event detection rate is improved by 62%, the evaluation accuracy rate reaches 91.7%, and compared with the traditional method, the false alarm rate is reduced by 34%, so that submarine cable breakage accidents can be effectively prevented.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Air conditioner resource allocation method and system based on cold accumulation prediction algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air conditioner resource allocation method and system based on a cold accumulation prediction algorithm, and relates to the field of air conditioner cold accumulation, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting historical load operation data of an air conditioner, analyzing the historical load operation data by adopting a gray correlation analysis algorithm, and constructing a cold load prediction model by combining the cold accumulation prediction algorithm; the method comprises the steps of training a cold load prediction model by using a back propagation neural network algorithm, inputting load operation data collected in real time into the trained cold load prediction model, outputting a cold load prediction result, combining the cold load prediction result and electricity price information, formulating an air conditioner resource allocation strategy, and optimizing the allocation strategy by using a model prediction control algorithm. According to the invention, through the integration of the load prediction technology and the real-time electricity price information, the cooling load demand of the whole day can be accurately predicted, the energy waste is reduced, the energy utilization efficiency is improved, the dynamic electricity price market can be responded, and the economic maximization is realized.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU COMPREHENSIVE ENERGY SERVICE CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;MAN TRAINING CENTER OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for solving seismic wave propagation equation based on physical information neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake engineering, and provides a method and a system for solving a seismic wave propagation equation based on a physical information neural network, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining a space domain, a time domain, an initial condition and a boundary condition of a one-dimensional seismic wave equation; the method comprises the steps of randomly extracting initial value coordinate points to serve as a training data set constraint network, generating space-time domain configuration points by utilizing Latin hypercube sampling to meet partial differential equation constraint, establishing a physical information neural network model, inputting space-time coordinates, automatically calculating equation residuals by differential, constructing a composite loss function by combining initial value loss and the physical residuals to train, providing a residual-based self-adaptive region sampling strategy, resampling a high residual region according to average residual values of the configuration points during training, fusing new points with initial configuration points, and iteratively optimizing network parameters. According to the method, the sampling density of the high-error area is dynamically enhanced, so that the relative error of L2 of a prediction solution is reduced by one order of magnitude, the network is effectively prevented from being trapped into local optimum, the convergence efficiency is remarkably improved, grid dispersion or priori data support is not needed, and a high-precision grid-free solution scheme is provided for a one-dimensional seismic wave equation.
assignees: UNIV SHAANXI NORMAL

title_en: Multiconductor transmission line system analysis method and design method
abstract_en: To enable the analysis of noise characteristics of a multiconductor transmission line system having branches to be easily carried out.SOLUTION: The present invention analyzes the noise characteristic of a multiconductor transmission line system including a plurality of conductor lines 12, 13, each having branches, by using a propagation model in which it is assumed that a noise signal propagates by being multiple reflected between a first terminal network 31 and a second terminal network 32 via a uniform line group 30. The propagation model constitutes the uniform line group 30 by lines 33-39 bridging over between the first terminal network 31 and the second terminal network 32, and the first terminal network 31 and the second terminal network 32 are constituted by terminal elements located on both sides of it, when it is assumed that each of conductor lines 12, 13 is laid so as to reciprocate between the first terminal network 31 and the second terminal network 32, taking a characteristic impedance change position including branches 20, 21 from a parallel-running section 14 as a turnaround point.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2
assignees: SOKEN INC;TOYOTA MOTOR CORP

title_en: Task risk early warning method and system based on project management data
abstract_en: The invention provides a task risk early warning method and system based on project management data, which relate to the technical field of project management early warning, and the method and system provided by the invention have the advantages that task risk index weights are automatically adjusted to adapt to process states and external environment changes of different stages of projects, so that the accuracy and flexibility of risk assessment are obviously improved, the method and system have good dynamic adaptability, the tasks of each stage of the projects are assessed in a grading manner by means of quantitative comprehensive risk values, priorities are clearly managed, a project team is assisted to focus on key risks, task cooperation relations are visually presented by constructing a task cooperation network, a central node and a fragile link are accurately identified, a risk propagation path is effectively mastered, and real-time monitoring and grading early warning are realized by combining dynamic risk early warning rules, so that the risks can be timely found and dealt with.
assignees: JIANGXI HARRL GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Distributed light Fu Fu power prediction-based power distribution network voltage regulation and control method combining group and cooperation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power distribution network voltage regulation and control, and discloses a power distribution network voltage regulation and control method based on distributed light Fu Fu power prediction cluster-cooperation, which integrates photovoltaic historical data, inputs an improved counter-propagation neural network model to output predicted photovoltaic active power, and estimates reactive capacity boundaries of all nodes in real time based on the running state of a grid-following inverter; the method comprises the steps of establishing a two-dimensional module degree function of a net load index and an equivalent electrical distance, dividing a distributed photovoltaic cluster, providing a multi-device differentiated cooperative control strategy aiming at the voltage out-of-limit risk in the cluster, constructing an optimization function aiming at minimum network loss and voltage offset, and carrying out optimization solution function by using an improved multi-tissue particle swarm optimization algorithm to obtain a multi-device adjustment sequence and device action quantity. The invention improves the capacity of renewable energy consumption and reduces the network loss while guaranteeing the voltage stability of the power distribution network, and optimizes the comprehensive regulation cost.
assignees: UNIV NANJING POSTS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS

title_en: Geological disaster networking monitoring and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster networking monitoring and early warning method, which relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning, and comprises the following steps of S1, collecting original data of multiple types of monitoring equipment in a monitoring area, extracting a high-amplitude mutation area and a frequency drift factor according to time and frequency distribution of the original data, constructing a high-frequency disturbance sensing matrix, and generating a disturbance characteristic index map for representing spatial distribution of unnatural disturbance sources. According to the invention, the high-frequency disturbance perception matrix and the disturbance index map are constructed, so that the active recognition and modeling of the unnatural disturbance are realized, disturbance propagation analysis and residual difference are combined to strengthen precursor signal characteristics, the risk level is accurately judged through trend recognition and causal analysis, finally, the early warning model parameters are dynamically optimized by means of response regulation factors, a closed-loop mechanism of disturbance recognition, signal purification, trend extraction, risk judgment and strategy adjustment is formed, and the early warning stability, accuracy and practicability of the system in a high-disturbance environment are remarkably improved.
assignees: NANJING KENTOP CIVIL ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wind farm diagnosis method and system for multi-mode feature fusion and fault propagation analysis
abstract_en: The application relates to a wind power plant diagnosis method and system for multi-mode feature fusion and fault propagation analysis, which belong to the technical field of wind power equipment fault diagnosis, wherein visible light, infrared and LiDAR multi-mode data of wind power plant equipment are cooperatively collected through an unmanned aerial vehicle group, and a weighted fusion feature vector is generated by adopting a dynamic gating mechanism to fuse YOLOv extracted local features, a Transformer extracted thermodynamic feature and PointNet ++ extracted spatial structure features. And identifying the fault type, the position and the confidence coefficient by fusing the feature vectors through a multi-task neural network, and embedding a material failure model optimization diagnosis result of the wind power equipment. And positioning a fault source and an influence range by combining the power grid topology model and a fault tracing algorithm. And finally, generating a maintenance decision according to the fault propagation evaluation result.
assignees: HUANENG HENAN CLEANING ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic power generation prediction method of multi-algorithm hybrid model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation, in particular to a photovoltaic power generation prediction method of a multi-algorithm hybrid model, which comprises the following steps of S1, preprocessing historical data, dividing the historical photovoltaic data into three data sets of sunny days, cloudy days and overcast and rainy days by adopting a BIRCH algorithm, screening key influence factors through pearson correlation coefficients, S2, EEMD decomposition and reconstruction, carrying out ensemble empirical mode decomposition on the preprocessed photovoltaic data, reconstructing data according to energy distribution and contribution rate of IMF components, S3, constructing a hybrid prediction model, processing non-stationary IMF components by utilizing BiLSTM neural networks, processing stationary IMF components by adopting a Holt-windows model, and outputting a final photovoltaic power prediction value by means of back propagation weighted fusion prediction results. The method combines the advantages of deep learning and statistical model, performs fine pretreatment and decomposition reconstruction on the data, and effectively improves the precision and stability of photovoltaic power prediction.
assignees: HUAFENG TECH NANJING CO LTD;YANG HAIJIN;CHEN CHAO;ZHANG SHUAISHUAI

title_en: Deep migration learning-based flue gas waste heat cascade utilization system optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flue gas waste heat cascade utilization system optimization method based on deep transfer learning, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a flue gas waste heat system simulation model under multiple working conditions based on EBSILON simulation platforms to generate simulation data sets covering key operation parameters of the flue gas waste heat system under different loads, environmental conditions and the like, then constructing a deep neural network pre-training model based on the simulation data, adding linear and nonlinear calibration networks based on the simulation data, performing super-parameter updating on the calibration network by utilizing on-site operation data, transferring the pre-training model to a characteristic space adapted to the operation data, and dynamically adjusting flue gas bypass parameters by combining a genetic algorithm based on the super-parameter updating model to realize the maximum utilization of waste heat resources. The invention not only overcomes the limitation of scarce on-site effective operation data samples on model training, but also improves the overall energy efficiency of the system through intelligent regulation and control.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Dynamic stress field generation method for fault state of annular mechanical structure bolt
abstract_en: A dynamic stress field generation method for a fault state of a bolt with an annular mechanical structure belongs to the technical field of mechanical health monitoring. The method aims to solve the technical problem of mathematical modeling of nonlinear stress wave propagation paths in the annular mechanical structure bolts. The method comprises the steps of initializing parameters of annular mechanical structure bolts to generate a loosening parameter data set, constructing a bidirectional stress field model, executing bidirectional stress calculation on each node bolt in the annular mechanical structure bolts, calculating each level of stress components in a circumferential acceleration direction by a forward stress component, calculating joint attenuation components in a circumferential deceleration direction by a reverse stress component, then calculating total stress of each node bolt in the annular mechanical structure bolts to construct an annular mechanical structure bolt self-adaptive measuring point network, adjusting measuring point positions according to a dynamic phase deviation matching formula, optimizing measuring point layout, superposing simulation noise conforming to N (0, sigma  2 ) normal distribution on each measuring point of the annular mechanical structure bolts, and generating a standard characteristic waveform library.
assignees: HARBIN ELECTRIC MACHINERY CO LTD

title_en: Multi-objective cascade hydropower station optimal scheduling method and system based on multi-step return A3C reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-objective cascade hydropower station optimal scheduling method and system based on multi-step return A3C reinforcement learning, which are characterized in that a multi-objective reward function with adjustable dynamic weight is built by taking water level deviation minimization, power generation benefit maximization, flood control safety and ecological protection as collaborative optimization targets, future multi-step accumulated rewards are adopted as return for improving the A3C reinforcement learning, a long-term optimal scheduling strategy is generated through joint estimation of the future multi-step rewards and state values, water balance, water turbine output limit and ecological flow requirements are embedded into a reinforcement learning strategy network, the scheduling scheme is ensured to meet physical feasibility and safety constraint, and the weight coefficient of the reward function is dynamically adjusted according to real-time power requirements and ecological priority, so that a scheduling instruction of self-adaptive multi-objective balance is output.
assignees: FUJIAN HUADIAN FURUI ENERGY DEV CO LTD;UNIV FUZHOU

title_en: Method, system, device and storage medium for planning using unmanned aerial vehicle network
abstract_en: The application provides a planning method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for using an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV), wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting control points and environment data by using the UAV, inputting the environment data into a neural network model to generate coordinates of each tower between a starting point and an ending point, verifying the mechanical characteristics of the towers through calculation and adjusting model parameters through reverse gradient propagation in the training process of the neural network model, carrying out point lofting in batches based on the tower coordinates, identifying point lofting errors by using a visual model, carrying out retesting on the coordinates of the corner towers based on the control point coordinates, carrying out line lofting after correcting the point lofting errors to obtain a power grid planning result, and establishing twin model storage data corresponding to the power grid planning result. The application designs a power grid planning method by using an unmanned aerial vehicle as a whole, and the method comprises the comprehensive functions of controlling point acquisition, determining the position of a tower by a newly built line, point lofting and line lofting, and comprehensively replaces manual design.
assignees: BENXI POWER INSTALLATION CO LTD

title_en: Virtual power plant and power distribution network distributed cooperative regulation and control method considering shared energy storage
abstract_en: The application provides a distributed cooperative regulation and control method for a virtual power plant and a power distribution network, which considers shared energy storage, and belongs to the field of power system automation and scheduling. The method is based on three-layer distributed regulation and control frames of power distribution network-virtual power plant-shared energy storage, each layer of optimal scheduling sub-model is built respectively, the power distribution network adopts a second-order cone planning branch power flow model to minimize network loss and voltage deviation, an economic operation model is built by virtual power plant comprehensive demand response and a low-carbon target, the shared energy storage is modeled by taking maximized operation income as a target, finally, an Andersen acceleration thought is combined to improve a target cascade analysis method, and distributed collaborative solving is carried out on the three-layer model, so that convergence speed is improved. The method and the device can reduce the carbon emission and the comprehensive cost of the system and realize progressive regulation and control between layers while ensuring the safe operation of the power distribution network.
assignees: GAOMI CITY POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Fault evolution analysis method for power transmission and distribution-gas comprehensive energy system under extreme typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a fault evolution analysis method of a power transmission and distribution-gas integrated energy system under an extreme typhoon disaster, which is characterized by calculating time-varying fault probability of a power transmission and distribution network element based on a mechanical stress model of typhoon-rain load, generating an initial breaking set through Monte Carlo sampling, identifying a serious overload line caused by power flow transfer and executing protection cutting through affine power flow calculation of power transmission and distribution network coupling, analyzing a power transmission and distribution-gas load shedding strategy by adopting a dynamic affine model, combining a natural gas pipe existence equation and an electric-gas coupling equipment operation constraint, quantifying the influence of power line breaking on pressure fluctuation and pipe existence change of a natural gas system, balancing overload power of a general overload line, processing a bilinear term, adopting rotary second-order cone relaxation to convert non-convex constraint, and quantifying the natural gas system fault propagation risk caused by power transmission and distribution line breaking and power transmission and gas load shedding by combining the coupling operation constraint of an electric drive compressor, a gas turbine and electric-gas conversion equipment.

title_en: Typhoon path and strength prediction method based on multi-mode fusion network model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a typhoon path and strength prediction method based on a multi-mode fusion network model, and belongs to the technical field of meteorological monitoring. The method comprises the steps of obtaining position coordinates, central wind speed and central air pressure of typhoons and analysis data of wind fields and potential heights of typhoons in a central area, constructing a multi-mode fusion network model driven by the data and physics together, constructing a loss function of the multi-mode fusion network model, updating parameters of the multi-mode fusion network model through counter propagation to obtain a trained multi-mode fusion network model, inputting data in a test set into the trained multi-mode fusion network model, and outputting typhoons paths and intensities. The method analyzes the space-time characteristics of the dynamic association relation and the potential height field in the wind field, provides effective physical constraint for typhoon path and strength prediction, is used for typhoon path and strength prediction, and can improve the accuracy of typhoon path and strength prediction.
assignees: UNIV NANJING INFORMATION SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Port equipment cluster multi-energy control method based on quantum deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-energy control method for port equipment clusters based on quantum deep reinforcement learning, which comprises the steps of obtaining energy related data and equipment state data of a port, preprocessing the data, converting the preprocessed energy related data and the preprocessed equipment state data into quantum state data according to quantum coding rules, generating probability distribution for selecting energy combinations according to the quantum state data by utilizing a quantum strategy network, selecting optimal energy combinations according to greedy strategies, updating and quantum counter-propagation optimization by utilizing a reward function, a value network, optimizing the optimal energy combinations, and controlling energy equipment of the port according to the optimized optimal energy combinations. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device can comprehensively consider the factors such as cost, energy utilization rate, carbon emission and the like according to the actual operation condition of the port, accurately select the most suitable energy, effectively improve the energy utilization rate and reduce the energy waste.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI MARITIME

title_en: Integrated disinfection monitoring management system based on quantitative risk assessment
abstract_en: The invention provides an integrated disinfection monitoring management system based on quantitative risk assessment, and belongs to the technical field of disinfection monitoring. The environment and behavior parameter collection module is used for constructing a first data set, a second data set and a third data set, constructing a prediction risk model by utilizing a convolutional neural network, respectively constructing an ith regional environment bacteria breeding coefficient, a bacteria propagation coefficient and a behavior breeding bacterial coefficient based on the first data set, the second data set and the third data set, combining the ith regional environment bacteria breeding coefficient and the behavior breeding bacterial coefficient, constructing a comprehensive disinfection behavior coefficient, and evaluating to generate a corresponding strategy. The bacteria in the station are monitored through multidimensional linkage, and a proper disinfection scheme is adopted according to the bacteria breeding degree.
assignees: THE SECOND AFFILIATED HOSPITAL ARMY MEDICAL UNIV OF PLA

title_en: Reservoir group flood control optimal scheduling method and system based on quadratic programming
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flood control optimization scheduling, in particular to a reservoir group flood control optimization scheduling method and system based on quadratic programming, wherein the method comprises the following steps of constructing a flood control scheduling topological network according to space distribution of key nodes and hydraulic connection of the space distribution of the key nodes of a system according to hydraulic engineering facilities and hydrologic elements in a flow field to obtain a reservoir group flood control optimization scheduling topological graph; and (3) establishing a reservoir group flood control optimal dispatching quadratic programming model according to the reservoir group flood control optimal dispatching topological graph, and optimally solving the reservoir group flood control optimal dispatching quadratic programming model by using a gradient method and a quasi-Newton method based on a MINOS library of GAMS. According to the invention, the propagation of flood among reservoir groups is coupled in a mathematical equation set, so that complex simulation sequence coding is avoided, modeling is easy, universality is good, and a model is easy to seek an optimal solution, so that the flood control capacity, peak clipping effect and reasonable scheduling of reservoir water storage capacity of the reservoir can be balanced, and the accuracy and efficiency of flood regulation are improved.

title_en: Heavy haul railway construction safety risk assessment method and device
abstract_en: The application relates to a heavy haul railway construction safety risk assessment method and device. The method comprises the steps of establishing a risk index system aiming at construction safety of a heavy haul railway business line, constructing a risk assessment network for describing risk propagation based on the risk index system, determining importance of each index in the risk index system by utilizing a cloud model fuzzy algorithm, generating an index weight cloud model, determining fuzzy condition probability of the risk assessment network by combining quantitative weight and qualitative importance of each index and logic interrelation among the indexes, obtaining risk occurrence probability of each index, mapping the risk occurrence probability into fuzzy probability based on a triangular fuzzy number model, obtaining prior probability of the risk assessment network after fuzzy processing, and calculating the risk probability of each index in the risk assessment network based on the risk index system, the fuzzy condition probability and the prior probability to obtain a risk assessment result. By adopting the method, the accuracy and timeliness of the security risk assessment can be effectively improved.
assignees: GUONENG SHUOHUANG RAILWAY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Beidou signal high-precision positioning and measuring method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of communication, and particularly relates to a Beidou signal high-precision positioning and measuring method, which comprises the following steps of researching the correlation and analysis algorithm of a Beidou signal structure, a propagation path and receiving processing, and improving the observation precision from the perspective of a data source; according to the Beidou multi-frequency RTK deep coupling technology, calculating a double-difference three-frequency pseudo-range and carrier combination observed value, cooperatively applying a regional network error model, carrying out coordinate calculation and error correction on the basis, and combining an accurate time synchronization and dual monitoring system to obtain high-precision positioning data. According to the invention, through a precise and efficient positioning and attitude determination algorithm, the data processing precision of the Beidou signal is improved, and more accurate data support can be provided for the fields of transportation, public safety, disaster reduction, disaster prevention and the like.
assignees: GUANGXI PRODUCTION RESEARCH INSTITUTE SPACE TIME INFORMATION TECH INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV GUILIN ELECTRONIC TECH

title_en: Power distribution network operation risk control method based on Bayesian optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network operation risk control method based on Bayesian optimization, which comprises the following steps of S1, utilizing power distribution network multi-source operation data to establish a node-side double-space coupling dynamic diagram, S2, based on the dynamic diagram, generating space-time embedded vectors through self-supervision tasks of multi-level space-time interaction of nodes and node neighborhood, S3, constructing a risk sensitive network with multi-scale dynamic clustering, predicting risk propagation tracks, S4, utilizing the risk propagation tracks to form a risk evolution link which is continuous and dynamic in a cross period and divide power distribution network risk control subdomains, S5, evaluating subdomain risk dynamic evolution, constructing a joint optimization state space, S6, constructing a distributed bidirectional information cooperation link between the neighborhood, S7, monitoring decision convergence conditions in real time and carrying out path switching. The invention improves the real-time performance and accuracy of the risk control of the power distribution network and ensures the safe and stable operation of the power distribution network.

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for generating fault first-aid repair scheme of low-voltage distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for generating a fault first-aid repair scheme of a low-voltage distribution network, which are used for generating a high-precision preliminary fault signal by collecting current, voltage and power data of a power grid in real time and adopting an isolated forest algorithm to perform anomaly detection; the method comprises the steps of combining a convolutional neural network to intelligently classify fault types and candidate fault points, constructing a power distribution network model based on historical topological data, dynamically analyzing fault propagation paths by utilizing a minimum spanning tree algorithm, accurately extracting fault influence ranges and key nodes, optimizing a rush-repair resource allocation scheme through a genetic algorithm, balancing time and cost, planning an optimal rush-repair path by fusing an A-algorithm and real-time GIS data, improving path efficiency, finally constructing a multi-objective optimization model, comprehensively planning rush-repair time, resource cost and power failure loss, outputting a global optimal scheme, realizing full-flow intellectualization, and improving fault positioning precision, resource allocation rationality and path planning efficiency.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Automatic monitoring data processing method for pipe network pressure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pipe network data processing, in particular to an automatic pipe network pressure monitoring data processing method. The method comprises the steps of obtaining pipe network structure data, constructing a pipeline topology network based on the pipe network structure data to generate a pipeline topology network, screening a main pipeline and branch pipes of the pipeline topology network to obtain pipe network circulation data, deploying pipe wall microwave resonators on the main pipeline and the branch pipes based on the pipe network circulation data, capturing pipeline circumferential deformation harmonic waves in real time through the deployed microwave resonators, analyzing longitudinal wave propagation delay of the pipe network circulation data, constructing a pipe body structure dynamic resonance map by combining the pipeline circumferential deformation harmonic waves, and resolving pipe network internal pressure and pipe wall equivalent stress of the pipeline topology network through the pipe body structure dynamic resonance map. The invention improves the accuracy of monitoring and identifying the pipe network pressure by combining the pipeline topology analysis, the microwave resonator monitoring, the dynamic resonance spectrum and the bidirectional fluid-solid coupling analysis.

title_en: Non-natural earthquake phase identification method based on image processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses an image processing-based non-natural earthquake phase identification method, which relates to the technical field of image processing and comprises the following steps of capturing continuous signals with the amplitude changing along with time in the earthquake wave propagation process in real time based on sensors distributed on an earthquake monitoring station network, forming an original amplitude sequence, converting the collected continuous signals into three-channel images, and automatically adjusting the brightness of the images according to the dynamic range of earthquake wave data. According to the invention, a three-channel construction strategy is used for constructing a seismic wave multidimensional analysis system, the first channel clearly shows the time domain difference of natural seismic progressive fluctuation and non-natural seismic pulse mutation, the second channel accurately captures microsecond mutation which is easily ignored in traditional time domain analysis, the third channel clearly distinguishes natural seismic low-frequency energy concentration and non-natural seismic medium-frequency characteristic spectral lines, and the self-adaptive brightness adjustment technology aims at the multi-source seismic signal intensity difference, improves non-natural and natural seismic edge distinction and firmly builds a recognition root.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING

title_en: Communication power supply system evaluation method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evaluation method and device of a communication power supply system, which relate to the technical field of communication and comprise the steps of collecting dynamic operation data, static configuration parameters and historical maintenance records in real time through a multi-source heterogeneous data collection module; the method comprises the steps of constructing a three-layer risk assessment architecture of a device level, a system level and a subsystem level, calculating subjective weights by adopting an improved fuzzy analytic hierarchy process, deploying an LSTM-GAN hybrid model to generate device degradation simulation data, establishing a deep residual convolution network, constructing a dynamic risk propagation matrix, establishing a virtual mirror image system based on a digital twin technology, generating a three-dimensional visual risk thermodynamic diagram, outputting a customized maintenance scheme, and updating a device health file through a blockchain intelligent contract. Therefore, multidimensional indexes such as voltage ripple, temperature rise rate, equipment aging curve and the like are integrated through the multisource data fusion architecture, and information island is eliminated, so that dynamic information stability under complex working conditions is ensured.
assignees: WEIFANG HANTING DISTR POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Vehicle safety early warning method and system for expressway network
abstract_en: The application provides a vehicle safety early warning method and system for a highway network, relates to the field of traffic safety control, and solves the technical problem of inaccurate early warning in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of collecting environment data of a highway, dividing the highway into a plurality of areas, calculating an initial risk value of each area according to the environment data, calculating a risk propagation value of each area according to the initial risk value based on a dynamic risk propagation equation, determining a risk grade of each area according to the risk propagation value, and triggering early warning measures of each area according to the risk grade. The method is used for real-time safety management and control of the expressway network in severe weather, and can realize accurate prediction and hierarchical early warning of risks through multidimensional data fusion and dynamic risk propagation modeling, so that the safety and the passing efficiency of the expressway network under complex meteorological conditions are improved.
assignees: ANHUI TECH HANDGO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent analysis and fault intelligent diagnosis method and system for photovoltaic power station
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of fault diagnosis and discloses an intelligent analysis and fault diagnosis method and system for a photovoltaic power station. The method comprises the steps of collecting electrical and environmental data of a photovoltaic power station through a sensor network, transmitting the electrical and environmental data to a data processing unit for preprocessing and standardization, extracting multidimensional features and constructing a feature matrix. And inputting the feature matrix into a multi-scale pulse neural network for fault diagnosis to obtain fault type and position information. And evaluating the fault severity according to the fault result, generating a maintenance scheme, and finally sending the maintenance scheme to the terminal equipment through the management system. According to the intelligent fault diagnosis method based on the pulse neural network, the intelligent fault diagnosis system based on the pulse neural network is introduced, and fault propagation analysis, maintenance priority allocation, path planning and resource matching optimization are combined, so that the problems of low fault diagnosis precision and low maintenance resource scheduling efficiency in the prior art are solved, and the operation and maintenance efficiency and the equipment reliability of the photovoltaic power station are improved.
assignees: XIAN THERMAL POWER RES INST CO;HAINAN ZHOUSHINENG PHOTOVOLTAIC POWER GENERATING CO LTD;XIAN TPRI THERMAL CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Line early warning judging method and system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of power transmission line maintenance and provides a line early warning judging method and system based on multi-source data fusion, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-dimensional knowledge graph and establishing a semantic association network; the method comprises the steps of collecting weather and equipment state data in real time, integrating the data into a knowledge graph space through a mapping function, identifying an abnormal weather-equipment combination mode through fuzzy reasoning, calculating the thickness change rate by combining an icing growth prediction model, calculating the icing thickness and galloping probability, generating a composite early warning grade, dynamically generating a risk thermodynamic diagram on a GIS map, and visually displaying a risk propagation path. The system breaks through the limitation of single parameter criteria of the traditional early warning through semantic fusion, composite risk modeling and spatial decision of multi-source data, realizes intelligent identification and dynamic early warning of meteorological-equipment coupling risks, and remarkably improves the accuracy and operation and maintenance decision efficiency of disaster early warning of the power transmission line.
assignees: HUBEI CENTRAL CHINA TECH DEVELOPMENT OF ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Safety inspection method for intelligent power plant
abstract_en: The application discloses a safety inspection method of an intelligent power plant, which comprises the steps of collecting historical operation fault information, classifying the collected historical operation fault information, constructing a network structure of a power generation system by determining nodes and edges according to equipment of the power plant, calculating node degree and edge weight according to the determined nodes and edges, simulating fault propagation according to the node degree and edge weight in the network structure, calculating propagation speed and influence range, adjusting fault association parameters according to the network structure, collecting fault time nodes, generating a fault association interval, determining influence association parameters based on the fault association interval, constructing a multi-level data model, and inputting monitoring data into the multi-level data model to obtain a safety early warning result. By embodying the thermal power generation system as a network structure and adjusting fault-related parameters, nonlinear propagation paths of faults in the system can be captured by the parameters, and interactions and dependency among components in the system can be more comprehensively considered.
assignees: DATANG WUDING NEW ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Cable bridge fault diagnosis method based on sensor network and related equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cable bridge fault diagnosis method and related equipment based on a sensing network, which comprises the following steps of carrying out vibration monitoring on a cable bridge to obtain dynamic response data, obtaining an abnormal vibration time period sequence through time window segmentation and abnormal identification, tracking a vibration propagation path according to the abnormal vibration time period sequence, positioning a fault source region, generating a bridge weak link distribution map by combining structural stress concentration analysis, carrying out fault grade judgment according to the map, and outputting maintenance decision advice, thereby solving the technical problems that most schemes still stay in a static parameter acquisition stage, lack an effective analysis mechanism for dynamic vibration response, and are difficult to accurately identify the occurrence position and evolution trend of bridge abnormal behavior.
assignees: FOSHAN CHANCHENG HUANQIU ELECTRIC PORCELAIN ELECTRICAL APPLIANCE MAT CO LTD

title_en: Multi-tenant architecture-based wind power plant cloud platform management method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of new energy wind power operation and maintenance, in particular to a wind power plant cloud platform management method based on a multi-tenant architecture. And constructing a three-dimensional decision model based on the fan power predicted value, the network delay coefficient and the tenant priority weight, dividing the resource partition by adopting an improved K-means algorithm, and generating a resource allocation topological graph. And constructing a fault processing sandbox in the trusted execution environment, performing fault propagation analysis by using a graph neural network model, and outputting equipment control parameter correction and a scheduling path. And combining the dynamic reconfiguration logic mapping relation and the bandwidth weight to generate a resource scheduling instruction, thereby completing the closed-loop control link. The method can realize the intelligent scheduling and fault self-adaptive handling of the resources of the multi-tenant wind power cluster, and improves the real-time performance, the credibility and the fine management level of the system operation.
assignees: SHANDONG ENERGY SHENGLUNHUAALASHANMENG NEW ENERGY CO LTD;YUNDING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Financial risk analysis early warning system and method
abstract_en: The application relates to a financial risk analysis early warning system and a financial risk analysis early warning method. The system comprises a stock right relation network construction module, a high management relation network construction module, a double-layer network fusion module and a risk analysis early warning module, wherein the stock right relation network construction module is used for collecting and processing stock right relation data of a local financial institution and constructing a network topology taking the financial institution as a node and the stock right relation as edges, the high management relation network construction module is used for collecting and processing social relation data of a high management of the local financial institution and constructing a weighted network taking the high management as a node and the social relation as edges, the double-layer network fusion module is used for fusing the stock right relation network and the high management social relation network to generate a double-layer complex network large diagram, and the risk analysis early warning module is used for analyzing a conduction path and a propagation rule of financial risks in the double-layer network and carrying out quantitative evaluation and early warning on the financial risks faced by the local financial institution. The scheme provided by the application can carry out deep fusion on the data of the equity relationship and the social relationship, and effectively meets the comprehensive and accurate monitoring and early warning requirements of the supervision department on the financial risk.
assignees: GUANGZHOU FINANCIAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Enterprise production risk hidden danger identification method and system based on AI
abstract_en: The invention discloses an enterprise production risk hidden danger identification method and system based on AI, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a dynamic risk map by utilizing a depth space-time attention mechanism according to production environment multi-source data acquired in real time, carrying out risk propagation modeling by adopting a graph neural network with dynamic side weight adjustment based on the dynamic risk map to obtain a risk node set and a diffusion path thereof, constructing a dual-stage reinforcement learning model according to the risk node set to optimize a treatment scheme, outputting an optimized treatment scheme set containing priority ordering, generating a risk treatment instruction set based on production state data fed back in real time, synchronously updating the dynamic risk map, and outputting a visual early warning signal and treatment path guide through a multi-mode interactive interface. By utilizing the embodiment of the invention, the full-flow closed-loop management of multi-source data fusion, dynamic risk propagation modeling, intelligent treatment scheme optimization and visual interaction can be realized, so that the intelligent level of enterprise production safety management is improved.
assignees: ZHONGZHEXIN TECH CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Target intelligent cooperative identification method based on unmanned aerial vehicle cluster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a target intelligent collaborative identification method based on unmanned aerial vehicle clusters, and belongs to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle cluster control and computer vision. The method comprises the steps of realizing cluster networking and model initialization through a dynamic heterogeneous federal learning architecture, optimizing task allocation by adopting a space-time attention mechanism, extracting multi-view target characteristics by utilizing a deformable network, providing a cascading characteristic distillation fusion strategy, carrying out modal compression and cross-modal gating fusion on multi-source data such as multi-spectrum, laser radar and the like, designing an anti-interference elastic communication mechanism based on meta learning, enhancing system robustness by combining space-time countermeasure detection and dynamic spectrum sensing technology, establishing an unsupervised federal increment learning system, and realizing model online evolution through momentum weighted aggregation. According to the invention, the target recognition accuracy is improved by 35% under a complex environment, the time delay is reduced to 200ms, and high-precision real-time recognition support is provided for scenes such as military reconnaissance, disaster rescue and the like.
assignees: UNIV NANJING AERONAUTICS & ASTRONAUTICS

title_en: New energy battery fire disaster rapid inhibition system and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy battery fire fast inhibition system and a preparation method thereof, wherein the new energy battery fire fast inhibition system comprises a microcavity array module, a carbon nanotube anode is electrically connected with a high-voltage pulse generator, a graphene cathode film and the carbon nanotube anode are arranged at intervals in parallel, a vacuum maintenance system module is coated with a Zr  84 V 10 Fe 6  getter on the side wall of a microcavity, the thickness of the vacuum maintenance system module is 15+/-2 mu m, a temperature control triggering module comprises an LSPR temperature sensor, a high-voltage pulse generator and an FPGA controller, the LSPR temperature sensor is attached to the inner cavity surface of the microcavity array module, when the detection temperature is more than 80 ℃, the FPGA controller triggers high-voltage pulses, the FPGA controller calculates a thermal runaway propagation model in real time based on an LSTM neural network, the precision is more than 95%, the high-voltage pulse generator outputs 0-5kV adjustable pulses, and the response time is less than or equal to 0.8ms. The invention breaks through the physical limit of the traditional fire extinguishing technology, realizes the response speed of <1ms level, constructs a three-dimensional fire extinguishing network, and achieves the free radical clearance of 99.9%.
assignees: SUIREN FIRE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network fault propagation path tracing method
abstract_en: The application provides a power distribution network fault propagation path tracing method. The method comprises the steps of preprocessing polymorphic measurement information in a power distribution network to generate node characteristic data by collecting the polymorphic measurement information and a system operation log, and extracting a time sequence characteristic set by combining the system operation log to provide a high-quality data base for subsequent analysis. By constructing the information difference graph, the information interconnection relation and the change condition between each target assembly before and after the fault can be intuitively reflected, so that the dynamic characteristics of fault propagation are captured. Further, sequencing learning is carried out on the time sequence feature set to generate a sequencing score, and a fault propagation path is determined by combining the information difference graph, so that a complete closed loop from data acquisition to path tracing is realized. The method not only improves the accuracy of fault location, but also remarkably improves the efficiency and reliability of fault tracing through multidimensional data fusion and intelligent analysis, and provides powerful support for the stable operation of the power distribution network.
assignees: ZHONGSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting-oriented AI driving resource scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of public service data processing, and provides an intelligent fire-fighting oriented AI driving resource scheduling method and system. The method comprises the steps of acquiring first data through an intelligent sensor, carrying out multi-source data fusion, generating a first tensor formed by a space map through a neural network and modeling processing, extracting node characteristics and edge characteristics from the first tensor, carrying out linear transformation on the node characteristics and the edge characteristics based on a learnable weight matrix and an activation function to determine a risk propagation matrix of a fire condition, generating an alternative strategy based on the risk propagation matrix and resource data, minimizing total loss of the alternative strategy to generate a resource allocation strategy, determining a scheduling strategy based on the resource allocation strategy of adjacent areas and a preset inter-area cooperation protocol through Nash equilibrium, and sending a generated scheduling instruction to a target terminal. The accurate prediction of risks is realized through multi-source data fusion and space-time modeling, the fire spreading risks and the emergency response cost are effectively reduced, and the efficiency and the effect of fire-fighting resource scheduling are improved.
assignees: XIAN JIANRONG IND GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned plane marshalling dynamic human body real-time three-dimensional reconstruction method based on 3D Gaussian sputtering
abstract_en: The invention relates to a real-time human dynamic three-dimensional reconstruction method of unmanned aerial vehicle marshalling based on 3D Gaussian sputtering, belonging to the technical field of computer vision and unmanned aerial vehicle coordination. The method comprises the steps of deploying unmanned aerial vehicle grouping carrying RGB-D cameras, constructing a forward link communication network, conducting parameter calibration, predicting human motion trend through a self-adaptive Gaussian distribution model, dividing an observation area, optimizing unmanned aerial vehicle paths, conducting incremental parameter fusion through a gradient sharing fusion algorithm, generating local dense point clouds in real time, constructing an unsupervised space-time segmentation model, distinguishing static background and dynamic human body areas, designing a 3D Gaussian weight weighting algorithm to optimize point cloud density, enhancing shielding area integrity, optimizing Gaussian parameters through a differential rendering frame, generating a high-precision surface grid, and conducting denoising restoration through a cascading filtering network to achieve real-time three-dimensional reconstruction of the dynamic human body. The invention obviously improves the reconstruction speed and the integrity of the shielding area, and is suitable for the fields of emergency rescue, film and television manufacture and the like.
assignees: UNIV NANTONG

title_en: Mutation early warning model and mutation control method of E-commerce supply network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mutation early warning model and a mutation control method of an e-commerce supply network, and belongs to the technical field of e-commerce and supply chain management. Aiming at the cascade failure risk of an e-commerce supply network under an emergency public event, the invention constructs a multidimensional network model through a super network theory, characterizes the complex interaction relationship among suppliers, logistics nodes, e-commerce platforms and consumers, and dynamically updates a network structure based on real-time data. And analyzing the critical state of the network by adopting the mutation theory, and combining an intelligent optimization algorithm and a multi-agent simulation technology to realize the real-time early warning of the mutation risk. The control method effectively reduces the mutation influence and optimizes the network stability through the flow steps of dynamic monitoring, short-term optimization adjustment, intervention opportunity prediction, long-term topology reconstruction and effect evaluation. The invention breaks through the static limitation of the traditional model, remarkably improves the early warning accuracy, the response speed and the network toughness, and provides an innovative solution for the E-commerce platform to maintain high-efficiency operation under the emergency.
assignees: HUBEI UNIV OF ECONOMICS

title_en: System and Method for Managing Road Structure and Resident Welfare Facilities using Real-Time Location-Based
title_ko: 실시간 위치기반을 이용한 도로 시설물 및 주민 복지 시설 관리 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention is configured to manage road facilities and resident welfare facilities with a real-time location-based system. Accordingly, the installation engineer and the manager share location information in real time, thereby improving management efficiency. In addition, the response to complaints will be quickened and damage to facilities will be prevented based on weather and disaster information. A real-time location-based road facility and resident welfare facility management system includes a road facility management server, a situation room management terminal, and an installation technician terminal. By using the GPS base location information, it transmits a message the establishment location and action information and the management server receives a message request and result information. Moreover, the installation need location is detected based on the weather information. The number of complaints and number of execution are counted and establishment is selected over the standards. This is offered to the situation room terminal. It transfers map to the installation technician terminal and the communications unit receives a message the completion information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도로 시설물의 안정적이고 효율적으로 관리할 수 있는 실시간 위치기반을 이용한 도로 시설물 및 주민 복지 시설 관리 시스템 및 그 방법을 제공하기 위한 것으로서, 상기와 같은 목적을 달성하기 위한 본 발명에 따른 실시간 위치기반을 이용한 도로 시설물 및 주민 복지 시설 관리 시스템의 특징은, 도로 시설물 관리서버, 상황실 관리 단말기 및 설치기사 단말기 간의 통신을 통해, 도로 시설물 및 주민 복지 시설물(이하, "도로 시설물"이라 칭함)의 관리를 제공하는 시스템에서, 상기 도로 시설물 관리서버는, GPS모듈로부터 수집한 민원인 단말기 및 설치기사 단말기의 현재 위치정보를 기반으로 설치/보수/조치가 필요한 도로 시설물의 위치정보 및 도로 시설물의 설치/보수/조치 정보를 설치기사 단말기 및 상황실 관리 단말기로 송신하고, 설치기사 단말기, 상황실 관리 단말기 중 적어도 하나 이상으로부터 설치/보수/조치가 필요한 요청정보, 설치/보수/조치에 대한 결과 정보, 도로 시설물에 관리에 상응하는 관리정보를 수신하는 통신부와, GPS 위성의 전파신호를 수신하거나, 저장부에 미리 저장되어 있는 도로 시설물의 위치정보 및 고유정보를 검출하여, 특정 도로 시설물의 위치좌표를 계산하여 위치정보를 검출하는 시설물 위치 검출부와, 상기 시설물 위치 검출부에서 도로 시설물의 위치가 마킹된 지도 맵을 표시하고, 상기 통신부를 통해 상황실 관리 단말기 및 설치기사 단말기 중 적어도 하나로부터 전달되는 정보를 모니터링 할 수 있도록 표시하는 표시부를 포함한다.
assignees: KIM JOO EUN

title_en: Construction worker adventure behavior propagation simulation method and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a simulation method and a storage medium for the risk taking action of a construction worker, which belong to the field of software of a risk taking action spreading algorithm of the construction worker, and are technically characterized in that S100, input parameters such as an infection rate beta, a recovery rate alpha, an awareness rate gamma, a forgetting rate delta and a control rate kappa, S200, a relation network structure matrix G is determined according to the total number N of the construction worker and the working relation of the worker, S300, initial values of the input parameters are S  1 (0)～S N (0),I 1 (0)～I N (0),R 1 (0)～R N  (0), S400, parameters obtained in S100, S200 and S300 are input into a risk taking action spreading dynamic model of the construction worker based on the relation network structure and SIRS, the parameters are spread on the model, and t-S (t), t-I (t) and t-R (t) curves are output to display the risk spreading process of the construction worker.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Gas waste heat utilization method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of gas waste heat utilization and discloses a gas waste heat utilization method and system based on artificial intelligence. The method comprises the steps of collecting sensor parameters of a gas extraction system in real time and processing the sensor parameters to obtain a standardized data set, inputting the standardized data set into a fusion convolutional transducer neural network for analysis modeling to obtain a gas waste heat prediction model, carrying out decision analysis on gas waste heat utilization based on the gas waste heat prediction model and a preset expert knowledge base to obtain a control strategy, and carrying out parameter regulation and control on a heat exchanger, a waste heat boiler, a circulating pump and control valve equipment according to the control strategy to obtain a cascade utilization execution scheme. The application dynamically adjusts the strategy of gas waste heat recovery, ensures the high-efficiency recovery of the gas waste heat and ensures the safety of the system.
assignees: CHENGZHUANG MINE OF JINCHENG LANYAN COAL IND CO LTD

title_en: Cascade electric energy metering management system and method for redundant double-clothes and intelligent network control
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a redundant double-clothes and intelligent network-controlled step electric energy metering management system and a method thereof, which aim to solve the problems of single function, low reliability of data acquisition and transmission, low operation and maintenance efficiency and the like of the existing step dispatching centralized control center electric energy metering management system; the invention provides an electric energy metering management system integrating 14 application functions of electric quantity data acquisition, storage, statistics, metering service management, semi-automatic side-generation electric quantity processing, data inquiry, operation condition monitoring, change calculation and analysis, report application, system management, system alarm, parameter maintenance, file synchronization, cross-isolation data synchronization, system migration and the like; the system adopts redundant server configuration and intelligent network technology, ensures high availability and stability of the system, improves convenience and high efficiency of system maintenance through a simple and easy maintenance diagnosis tool, reduces operation and maintenance cost, and provides powerful guarantee for safe and efficient operation of power production.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Micro coordination wide area balance regulation and control method and system under multi-micro grid access scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power distribution system simulation, in particular to a method and a system for regulating and controlling micro-coordination wide area balance in a multi-micro-grid access scene, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out cluster division on a plurality of micro-grids based on the electric coupling degree and net power between the micro-grids; the method comprises the steps of carrying out clustering on resources of a region where a micro-grid is located by adopting a pre-built multi-energy coupling source load prediction model, carrying out load prediction on the clustered clusters based on the clustered resources to obtain clusters, resources and groups formed by corresponding loads, solving a pre-built platform region or micro-grid layer optimization model, a feeder line level optimization model and a region layer optimization model by adopting a target cascading method based on the groups to realize scheduling optimization of the power distribution network and the micro-grid, and optimizing power exchange cost, power generation cost and environmental cost between the micro-grid and the power distribution network by constructing a multi-layer optimization model.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power grid cable wiring path optimization method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid cable wiring path optimization method and device, the method comprises the steps of carrying out load analysis on geographic distribution data and electricity consumption data of a power grid system to generate load region types and weight data corresponding to the region types, carrying out fault propagation risk assessment on power grid nodes in the power grid system according to the load region types and the weight data, generating a cable capacity scheme according to a risk assessment result, generating a candidate path set through a multi-objective balance mechanism and an adaptive path growth algorithm according to the load region types, the weight data and the cable capacity scheme, and carrying out toughness evaluation and optimization on the candidate path set under the preset multiple simulation scene conditions to generate the power grid cable wiring scheme. According to the invention, the distribution characteristics of the power grid load, the fault propagation risk and the system toughness are comprehensively considered, a cable wiring scheme which is suitable for a complex load environment and has fault resistance capability can be generated, and the reliability and the stability of a power grid system are obviously improved.

title_en: Power network anomaly detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power network anomaly detection method and a system, which relate to the technical field of intelligent power grid monitoring and measurement and comprise the steps of constructing a neuron-like power network graph model, nodizing equipment and introducing a multi-factor anomaly score function, and dynamically activating anomaly nodes by combining an improved Winner-Take-All mechanism; the method comprises the steps of dynamically optimizing connection weights through a topology-aware composite gradient descent method, constructing a multi-layer neural network structure to achieve cross-layer forward propagation and feedback adjustment, establishing an abnormal path model by combining propagation phase differences and information entropy, identifying abnormal paths by using a propagation score function and a weighted shortest path algorithm, and performing fault tracing. The power network anomaly detection method provided by the invention constructs a neuron-like graph model and introduces a multi-factor anomaly activation mechanism, so that comprehensive perception of the power grid node state under the multi-dimensional time characteristic can be realized, and the sensitivity of anomaly identification and the multi-point simultaneous activation capability are effectively improved.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Water quantity scheduling method and system for cascade reservoir pump station group
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of water resource scheduling, and provides a water quantity scheduling method and system for a cascade reservoir pump station group. The method comprises the steps of executing modeling of a cascade reservoir water supply system, activating a sensor network, establishing a real-time state according to monitoring data and modeling results, utilizing the modeling results to establish scheduling constraint, obtaining crop irrigation demands and establishing irrigation priorities, establishing a multidimensional objective function, carrying out water quantity scheduling adaptation optimization according to the priorities, the scheduling constraint, the real-time state and the objective function to form an optimizing result, and carrying out cascade reservoir pump station group water quantity scheduling management according to the optimizing result. The application solves the technical problems of low water resource distribution efficiency and high water shortage risk caused by unbalanced water resource supply and demand and complex scheduling constraint in the group water quantity scheduling process of the cascade reservoir pump station, and achieves the technical effects of realizing the accuracy and flexibility of water quantity scheduling and reducing the water quantity loss by introducing a multidimensional objective function and real-time state monitoring.
assignees: XINJIANG HAMI DONGTIAN WATER CONSERVANCY GROUP CO LTD;XINJIANG WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER SURVEY AND DESIGN INST CO LTD;XINJIANG HAOYUAN WATER SUPPLY CO LTD;CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Method and system for regulating and controlling stable operation of circuit board of industrial control equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automatic control and discloses a method and a system for regulating and controlling the stable operation of a circuit board of industrial control equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of analyzing the characteristics of the circuit board corresponding to the circuit board of the industrial control equipment, analyzing the operation stability factor of the circuit board, and deploying a multisource heterogeneous sensing network of the circuit board; the method comprises the steps of collecting multisource heterogeneous data of a circuit board, analyzing industrial control characteristics of the circuit board, constructing a dynamic stability matrix of the circuit board, determining an environment disturbance propagation path of the circuit board in the dynamic stability matrix, calculating a parameter fluctuation variance of the dynamic stability matrix of the circuit board, generating a stability margin index of the circuit board, determining a dynamic regulation parameter of the circuit board, analyzing a twin stability optimization coefficient of the dynamic regulation parameter, and executing stable operation regulation of the circuit board by utilizing the dynamic regulation parameter when the twin stability optimization coefficient is larger than a preset threshold value. The invention can improve the timeliness and accuracy of circuit board regulation and control.
assignees: SHENZHEN XUANSHENG ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: LNG cold energy cascade utilization equipment and high-pressure gas storage tank capacity collaborative configuration optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for optimizing collaborative configuration of LNG cold energy cascade utilization equipment and high-pressure gas storage tank capacity. The method comprises the steps of establishing LNG cold energy cascade power generation-refrigeration capacity configuration and operation models, establishing high-pressure gas storage tank capacity configuration and operation models according to optional number parameters of the high-pressure gas storage tank, taking distributed resources in a multi-functional micro-grid system, purchasing electricity with an upper power grid and balance constraint of electric-cold-gas multi-energy flows into consideration, aiming at minimizing total configuration investment cost and operation cost in a planning period, establishing a multi-functional micro-grid energy management optimization model comprising LNG cold energy cascade utilization, constructing fuzzy sets based on Wasserstein distance according to prediction data of new energy output and electric-cold-gas load during planning, converting the models into two-stage distribution robust collaborative configuration optimization models, and solving to obtain the optimal configuration capacity of the LNG cold energy cascade utilization equipment and the high-pressure gas storage tank.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Gradient reservoir optimal scheduling system and method based on graphic neural network and reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade reservoir optimal scheduling system and a cascade reservoir optimal scheduling method based on a graph neural network and reinforcement learning, which overcome the limitation of the traditional algorithm by constructing a cascade reservoir optimal scheduling model based on the graph neural network and reinforcement learning. Specifically, a graph neural network architecture is adopted, a local relation between reservoirs is extracted by using a message passing neural network MPNN, a global relation is captured through a self-attention mechanism of a transducer encoder, so that a complex space-time dependency relation between cascade reservoirs is comprehensively modeled, in addition, a PPO reinforcement learning model is combined, a scheduling strategy can be autonomously learned in a dynamic environment, and a global optimal solution is gradually approximated. Compared with the traditional method, the method has remarkable advantages in calculation efficiency, global optimality and capability of adapting to complex scheduling scenes, and provides an innovative solution for solving the problem of optimal scheduling of the cascade reservoir.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Whole-process standardized closed-loop safety control method and system for power enterprises
abstract_en: The invention discloses a whole-process standardized closed-loop safety control method and system for an electric power enterprise, which relate to the technical field of safety control for the electric power enterprise and comprise the steps of acquiring image characteristics and sensor characteristics in real time based on multi-source heterogeneous data and executing unified coding. And constructing a working and equipment node diagram based on the synchronous time sequence, and modeling hidden danger trend by adopting a space-time neural network. And triggering preventive intervention based on the classified classification of the hidden danger prediction results, and updating data backflow after the intervention is completed. The method establishes the dynamic evolution risk prediction capability, so that a safety management and control system can identify potential high-risk nodes and key propagation paths in advance, and the prospective and systematicness of hidden danger prevention and control are remarkably improved. The safety control mechanism of the power enterprise with dynamic optimization and standardized closed loop in the whole process is formed, the continuous evolution of four integration of hidden danger identification, intervention, feedback and optimization is realized, and the stability, the intelligence and the reliability of the system under a complex operation environment are greatly improved.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Complex supply chain network toughness simulation method and system under climate risk impact
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for simulating network toughness of a complex supply chain under climate risk impact, and relates to the field of climate risk assessment. The method comprises the steps of quantifying the impact proportion of climate risks to local areas, measuring the impact degree by adopting the proportion of different climate risk impact degrees, constructing a complex supply chain network, taking countries and areas related to the upstream and downstream links of the supply chain as nodes, taking corresponding trade amounts as edges, analyzing key node characteristics of the complex supply chain network by adopting node degree, node strength and core degree indexes, carrying out toughness test on the complex supply chain network in different climate risk disturbance modes, and measuring the impact category and toughness change of the complex supply chain network toughness under the climate risk impact by combining cascade failure simulation. According to the method, the weak links in the supply chain network are accurately identified through analysis of key indexes such as node importance, link reliability and the like under the climate risk impact, and quantitative support and policy inspiring are provided for pointedly formulating risk coping strategies.
assignees: INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS

title_en: Failure chain quantitative analysis and risk assessment method and system based on multi-level security model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a failure chain quantitative analysis and risk assessment method and system based on a multi-level security model, and aims to solve the defects that accident cause analysis of a complex social technology system is inaccurate and effective verification of a risk assessment result is lacking. The method comprises the steps of systematically constructing a multi-level causal model, extracting a multi-dimensional failure chain (MDFC), quantifying multi-dimensional risks of the MDFC, constructing a directional weighted failure propagation network based on the MDFC, and analyzing structural characteristics of the MDFC to identify key risk factors. The method has the core innovation that the reverse accident cause tracing and the forward risk propagation path analysis based on the weighted network are combined, and mutual verification and iterative optimization are realized by comparing the two path analysis results, so that the understanding of an accident evolution mechanism is deepened, and the reliability of evaluation is improved. The system vulnerability can be more comprehensively disclosed, powerful support is provided for formulating accurate risk control measures, and the overall safety level of a complex system is improved.
assignees: UNIV CHINA PETROLEUM EAST CHINA
