title_en: Residential user short-term electricity consumption prediction method and system based on cluster classification and back propagation neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical fields of power system load prediction, artificial intelligent neural network, data mining and machine learning, in particular to a residential user short-term electricity consumption prediction method and system based on cluster classification and back propagation neural network. The method comprises the steps of acquiring residential user electricity consumption data every 15 minutes by using a metering automation system, carrying out data statistics, classifying residential user electricity consumption behaviors by using a fuzzy c clustering algorithm, reflecting the user electricity consumption behaviors by using historical electricity consumption data of users, selecting factors affecting the user electricity consumption as input of a back propagation neural network, determining weights according to the influence degree, and carrying out short-term electricity consumption prediction by taking the weighted influence factors and the historical electricity consumption data as learning samples of a classified BP neural network. By the aid of the refined prediction method, operation efficiency and reliability of the power system can be effectively improved, energy consumption is reduced, and intelligent energy management is achieved.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Indicating lamp multi-state cascade identification method based on deep learning shared network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an indicator light multi-state cascade identification method based on a deep learning shared network, and belongs to the field of intelligent patrol of power equipment. The method comprises the steps of extracting low-order textures and spatial features of an image through a unified convolutional neural network to form a shared feature map, distributing the shared feature map to parallel branches of color recognition and state detection according to dimension weight by adopting a channel separation mechanism, analyzing geometric outline features by a full-connection layer through a morphological discrimination branch at the uppermost layer to realize circular/strip classification, respectively reinforcing red/green spectral responses by a color recognition branch through a double-channel convolution kernel, completing color discrimination through feature map comparison, merging space pooling and brightness statistical analysis by the state detection branch, and establishing a decision boundary of a lighting-extinguishing state. The method can reduce the parameter redundancy, improve the identification precision of each subtask, and meet the requirement of the inspection equipment on real-time discrimination of the multidimensional state.
assignees: YIJIAHE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire fighting water system fault detection and early warning method and system based on fire fighting Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire control monitoring, in particular to a fire water system fault detection and early warning method and system based on a fire-fighting Internet of things, wherein the method comprises the following steps of 1, periodically collecting pressure data through pressure sensors deployed at an outlet of a fire-fighting water pump, a branch point of a main pipe of a pipe network and the most unfavorable tail end; the method comprises the steps of step 2 of generating theoretical pressure expected values and dynamic tolerance bands of all nodes according to current valve opening, pump states and historical normal working condition data, step 3 of marking abnormal nodes and reversely constructing a fault propagation tree along a topology model when measured pressure deviates from the theoretical pressure expected values by more than the dynamic tolerance bands, and step 4 of triggering grading early warning based on the number of the abnormal nodes, fault propagation paths and accumulated values of the weight factors according to fault types. The system can automatically take measures when faults occur through the equipment linkage function, so that the high-efficiency operation of the fire-fighting water system is ensured, and the efficiency and the safety of fire emergency response are improved.

title_en: Rumor propagation control method based on user emotion analysis and differential dynamic system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rumor propagation control method based on a user emotion analysis and differential dynamic system, and belongs to the field of propagation dynamics. The method comprises the steps of 1) introducing system parameters into an actual network scene to describe the propagation of rumors, constructing a differential power system, and simulating and analyzing the propagation of rumors in a social network. 2) And solving a balance point according to a differential equation. 3) And according to Lyapunov, deducing the stability of the model and providing basis for formulating a control strategy. 4) The design algorithm predicts the trend of rumor transmission and provides a method for rumor control. 5) And (3) adopting LS estimation to fit the rumor event parameters to obtain the system parameter prediction rumor event transmission trend. 6) The verification method is effective, and compared with other methods, the optimal prediction method is obtained. The invention considers the interaction of the emotion of the user and the propagation of the rumors, and agrees with the propagation of the rumors in the social network. The method predicts the transmission of rumor events by analyzing rumors, controls the transmission of rumors in real time, and reduces the transmission of rumors.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING POSTS & TELECOM

title_en: Power transmission line galloping risk early warning and system based on multi-physical-field fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission line galloping risk early warning and system based on multi-physical-field fusion, which comprises the steps of firstly acquiring a multi-physical-field data set of a power transmission line galloping process, and generating a dynamic three-dimensional point cloud sequence through space-time alignment and three-dimensional gesture reconstruction; extracting dancing energy distribution characteristics, frequency spectrum characteristics and space track characteristics from the dancing energy distribution characteristics, fusing the dancing energy distribution characteristics, the frequency spectrum characteristics and the space track characteristics to obtain fused characteristic vectors, inputting the vectors into a physical constraint enhanced two-way long-short-term memory network, predicting a dancing evolution trend, outputting a combined prediction matrix of a dancing amplitude value and a frequency, inputting the matrix into a pre-trained risk propagation reasoning model, calculating a multi-level risk quantification index, generating a risk early warning prompt according to the index, and sending the risk early warning prompt to corresponding risk management equipment to realize the dancing risk early warning of the power transmission line. The method and the device can accurately predict the galloping evolution trend of the power transmission line, thereby accurately pre-warning the galloping risk of the power transmission line.

title_en: Urban physical examination accurate analysis method and system based on AI multi-modal data collaboration
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data analysis, in particular to an urban physical examination accurate analysis method and system based on AI multi-modal data cooperation, comprising the following steps of constructing a self-adaptive fractal space-time grid, and mapping an urban multi-modal data source into a space-time coding vector with fractal dimension; the method comprises the steps of establishing a physical field driven collaborative resonance network, extracting abnormal collaborative modes exceeding a normal resonance threshold, calculating a modal entropy chain value according to the real-time metabolic rate of an urban system, generating an optimal weight matrix through an unbalanced thermodynamic model, fusing the abnormal collaborative modes and the dynamic weight matrix, and generating a space-time causal map showing fault origins and propagation paths by using a causal discovery algorithm. According to the invention, the multi-mode data collaboration and causal analysis technology is utilized, so that the emergency response capability of the urban system in the face of sudden faults is improved, the stability of urban operation is ensured, and the space-time causal map provides comprehensive visual information for the fault propagation process.

title_en: Equipment manufacturing supply chain risk propagation early warning method based on large language model semantic analysis
abstract_en: A device manufacturing supply chain risk propagation early warning method based on large language model semantic analysis belongs to the field of supply chain risk early warning. The risk propagation probability calculation module accurately calculates risk propagation probability of each node in a supply chain network, comprehensively considers risk propagation probability under forward, reverse, same-direction and same-level transverse situations, outputs node risk probability under dynamic propagation, the risk value determination module extracts associated risk factors from the obtained massive unstructured text data by means of a large language model by combining the output of the risk propagation probability calculation module, builds a risk factor judgment matrix by means of a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, integrates a bias correlation analysis method and determines comprehensive evaluation weight of the risk factors, the risk level early warning module establishes DPC-RF algorithm to operate in two stages based on the result of the risk value determination module, initially divides risk level clusters through DPC preliminary clustering, and then determines risk early warning levels of the nodes and generates early warning information by means of an RF model.

title_en: Broadband oscillation suppression method, system and medium for offshore wind power soft direct grid-connected system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of stable control of power systems, in particular to a broadband oscillation suppression method, a system and a medium of an offshore wind power soft direct grid-connected system, which comprise the steps of sequentially injecting positive and negative sequence perturbation sine harmonic signals at grid-connected points of a wind turbine generator, constructing a multi-input multi-output impedance matrix, and reducing the multi-input multi-output impedance matrix into single-input single-output equivalent positive sequence impedance; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a stability margin of an offshore wind power soft direct grid-connected system based on equivalent positive sequence impedance quantification, reconstructing a fan network side converter into a matrix control structure by cascading a weighting coefficient matrix between an inner loop control loop and an outer loop control loop of the fan network side converter when the stability margin is lower than a preset margin threshold value, iteratively optimizing the matrix control structure based on impedance sensitivity, and synchronously carrying out impedance remodeling on a low-pass filter connected in series with a voltage and current feedback channel to complete broadband oscillation risk inhibition. According to the invention, broadband oscillation suppression of the offshore wind power soft-direct grid-connected system is realized through impedance modeling and matrix control strategies.

title_en: Non-key unit fire risk assessment method integrating human factor analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-key unit fire risk assessment method integrating human factor analysis, which comprises the steps of constructing a fire human factor analysis time sequence analysis model, dividing an assessment subspace and collecting human factor dynamic data; and extracting fire risk parameters such as the use frequency of the electrical equipment and the like, and fusing the fire risk parameters with corresponding human data characteristics to form vectors. The vector element relationships are captured by means of a detrimental multi-headed attention mechanism architecture, generating attention weighted feature vectors. According to the vector, a time sequence analysis model is combined to deduce a human factor change trend, and each subspace risk influence factor is determined. And (3) establishing a risk propagation network, setting weights by considering subspace physical positions and personnel flows, and simulating risk diffusion. And finally, determining the overall fire risk level of the non-key unit by combining the risk diffusion simulation result, the artificial factor model deduction result and the attention weighted feature vector through the comprehensive evaluation model, and providing a scientific basis for fire prevention and control.
assignees: CHENGDE YUNFANG SMART FIRE FIGHTING CO LTD

title_en: Distributed photovoltaic and energy storage cooperative power distribution network voltage fluctuation suppression method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for suppressing voltage fluctuation of a distribution network by cooperation of distributed photovoltaic and energy storage, and relates to the technical field of voltage fluctuation suppression, comprising the following steps of constructing a disturbance propagation reachability matrix among nodes based on real-time operation data of the distribution network, and identifying a voltage disturbance path set; the method comprises the steps of constructing a disturbance irreversible structure diagram based on a voltage disturbance path set, identifying a unidirectional amplification chain, calculating disturbance excitation probability according to historical disturbance data of a unidirectional amplification chain source node, generating a disturbance active propagation domain, constructing an energy storage intervention buffer zone in the disturbance active propagation domain, and generating a collaborative strategy activation condition by simulating disturbance propagation to evaluate reverse blocking capacity of energy storage in the energy storage intervention buffer zone. According to the invention, through disturbance path simulation evaluation, energy storage redundant configuration and power consumption are reduced, and the inhibition efficiency and adaptability of the system are improved.

title_en: Improved super-network rumor propagation model building method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of supernetworks, and provides an improved supernetwork rumor propagation model building method which comprises the following steps of 1, building a SEIAR supernetwork rumor propagation model with opposite states according to a classical SEIR model, 2, building a differential kinetic equation set according to rumor propagation rules, 3, calculating a rumor-free balance point of the model according to the differential kinetic equation set, 4, calculating a basic regeneration number, 5, calculating local and global progressive stability conditions of the balance point by utilizing Routh-Hurwitz criteria and Lyapunov stability theorem, and 6, adopting a control strategy according to rumor propagation conditions. The invention can better describe the behavior of refute a rumour in the social network and reveal the dynamic influence of refute a rumour on the rumor propagation process.
assignees: UNIV QINGHAI NORMAL

title_en: Intelligent fault diagnosis method and system for electrical equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fault diagnosis of electrical equipment, in particular to an intelligent fault diagnosis method and system of electrical equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of uniformly fusing equipment state information, electrical distance weighted connection and phase dynamic coupling relation by constructing a multidimensional tensor model, and extracting an abnormal propagation mode by utilizing high-order singular value decomposition; the method comprises the steps of designing a space-time-frequency coupling interference stripping mechanism, combining structure-guided disturbance deconstruction, multi-scale dictionary learning and sparse low-rank decomposition to accurately separate transmissibility and non-transmissibility interference, reconstructing a fault track based on a generation countermeasure mechanism, coupling a graph structure dynamic encoder, a topology consistency discriminator and a time controllable generator to restore a real propagation path, and finally integrating tensor semantic compression, a three-view graph neural network and fault label back projection interpretation through a multi-source semantic fusion mechanism. The invention realizes the fault diagnosis and tracing of the space-time and structure, and improves the accuracy and the interpretability.
assignees: SHANDONG LUSHANG ARCH DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Energy storage optimization scheduling system based on physical guide model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power regulation, and particularly discloses an energy storage optimization scheduling system based on a physical guide model, which is used for solving the problems of frequency, power angle, voltage linkage instability and energy storage response hysteresis caused by new energy grid connection, and comprises a data acquisition layer, a physical guide model layer, an extreme disturbance response analysis layer, a data driving decision layer and an execution control layer; according to the invention, through multi-layer modularized closed-loop self-adaptive feedback and physical data coupling modeling, an energy storage charging and discharging strategy is corrected in real time, and control parameters are dynamically optimized, so that the frequency, voltage and power angle compound change of a second cascade dynamic response power grid can be realized under the multi-source disturbance of wind power or photovoltaic extreme fluctuation and equipment sudden fault, the stable operation of the power grid is realized, the economic benefit is maximized, and the service life of energy storage equipment is prolonged.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Grape disease identification and early warning method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grape disease identification and early warning method based on the Internet of things, which relates to the technical field of plant disease identification, and comprises the steps of arranging image acquisition equipment and environment sensing nodes in a grape garden to obtain leaf surface images and corresponding temperature, humidity, illumination and soil moisture parameters, inputting the images into a neural network integrating cavity convolution and residual attention mechanisms to achieve extraction of disease spot areas and disease spot variation characteristics and generate a preliminary identification result, constructing a multi-factor evolution sample set by combining the identification result and the environment state of a time node, constructing a space-time correlation map model based on the graph neural network to estimate disease propagation risk paths and diffusion probability, and carrying out early warning judgment at a gateway end through a multi-factor gate control judgment algorithm.
assignees: NINGXIA AGRICULTURAL PRODUCTS QUALITY STANDARDS AND TESTING TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE NINGXIA AGRICULT

title_en: Water conservancy facility operation and maintenance method based on multi-source data
abstract_en: The invention relates to a water conservancy facility operation and maintenance method based on multi-source data, which comprises the steps of collecting multi-source heterogeneous data of the water conservancy facility to obtain a standardized multi-dimensional data matrix, extracting multi-mode features of the standardized multi-dimensional data matrix through a graph neural network fusion algorithm to obtain fusion feature vectors, carrying out fault diagnosis on the fusion feature vectors through a knowledge graph reasoning algorithm automatically constructed by a domain ontology to obtain fault diagnosis information, carrying out facility state evolution analysis through a space-time coupling degradation prediction model based on the fault diagnosis information to obtain a space-time degradation prediction result, carrying out state assessment of the water conservancy facility through a dynamic weight distribution algorithm optimized by double targets according to the space-time degradation prediction result to obtain an operation and maintenance state assessment result, and carrying out cross-river-field cascade fault prevention and control on the water conservancy facility based on the operation and maintenance state assessment result to obtain a cascade fault prevention and control scheme. The method improves the prediction precision of the degradation of the water conservancy facilities and enhances the risk resistance of the water conservancy infrastructure.
assignees: GANSU RUISHENG WATER CONSERVANCY AND HYDROPOWER ENG CO LTD

title_en: Low-voltage power failure range analysis method and system based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power supply systems, and particularly discloses a low-voltage power failure range analysis method and system based on machine learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of collecting equipment operation parameters of a low-voltage power supply area, calculating equipment state abnormality indexes and power failure abnormality indexes, dynamically adjusting and carrying out electric power early warning to generate an adjusting scheme of the low-voltage power supply area, dynamically adjusting four monitoring periods to realize risk classification management and control, inputting the power failure abnormality indexes and multidimensional features into a machine learning model, identifying and mapping a fault propagation path and a power grid topology, defining a power failure geographic scope and quantitatively affecting indexes, automatically generating a command strategy comprising fault positioning, material scheduling and path planning based on emergency level, and obviously improving the risk prevention and control timeliness and the emergency repair resource scheduling accuracy of the low-voltage power distribution network.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Underground pipe network defect intelligent identification and early warning method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention provides an underground pipe network defect intelligent identification and early warning method and system based on deep learning, which relate to the technical field of pipe network detection and comprise the steps of acquiring multi-source data by adopting a pipeline detection robot and preprocessing; the method comprises the steps of mapping features to manifold space, constructing a similarity matrix, carrying out geometric difference weighted fusion, constructing an associated matrix, calculating space distance and mechanical strength, carrying out iterative propagation to generate a defect feature map, acquiring an evolution sequence by adopting a self-adaptive sliding window, determining influence factors based on inverse fact intervention, calculating state transition probability and determining an optimal maintenance scheme. The invention improves the accuracy of pipe network defect identification and realizes the intellectualization of pipeline state prediction and maintenance decision.

title_en: Dynamic control method for water level lower limit of cascade hydropower station for supporting power grid supply protection
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic control method for a lower limit of a water level of a cascade hydropower station for supporting power grid supply protection, and belongs to the field of multi-energy power system planning. The method is based on prediction data of the annual runoff represented by the dead water and the new energy output, and the supply-keeping period is set on the premise of meeting hydropower operation parameters and constraints. In order to ensure the water and electricity bearing supply and demand in the period, a 'electricity-based water fixing' algorithm which is used for coupling a fourth-order Dragon-grid-tower method and a success-failure search method is innovatively adopted to solve the required power generation flow. And further, combining the water balance principle, calculating an initial reservoir capacity through reverse iteration, determining an initial water level lower limit by utilizing a piecewise linear interpolation method, and finally correcting according to the operation constraint. And in the simulation period, dynamically updating the lower limit of the water level by adopting a rolling calculation strategy to form a complete dynamic control curve of the lower limit of the water level. The method has the remarkable advantages of simple and convenient solution, convenient parameter adjustment, high calculation efficiency, quick response to the real-time power grid supply protection instruction and the like through the direct reverse recursion physical process.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN TECH

title_en: Power supply fault diagnosis method and system for low-voltage distribution network based on power outage and restoration logic
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power supply fault diagnosis method of a low-voltage distribution network based on power outage and restoration logic, which belongs to the technical field of power supply fault diagnosis and comprises the steps of converting unstructured power outage complaints of a user into standardized event labels by utilizing a natural language processing technology, synchronously aligning power outage pulses of an ammeter with action records of a branch switch to construct a multidimensional space-time event sequence, establishing a fault propagation logic network through topology division of power supply units, deducing a fault diffusion path according to power outage time sequence differences of adjacent units and failure states of a protection device, and reversely positioning initial fault points. And meanwhile, dynamically correcting the fault association probability among the units to generate a weighted candidate fault chain. The fault propagation tree is modified in reverse through a variety of validation mechanisms. And finally, screening out a fault chain with optimal space-time consistency by calculating the confidence coefficient. The method solves the problems of multi-source information fracturing, time-space association weakening and insufficient verification reliability in fault location of the low-voltage distribution network.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent fault tree generation method and system based on joint simulation and dynamic causal reasoning
abstract_en: An intelligent fault tree generation method and system based on joint simulation and dynamic causal reasoning relate to the technical field of fault trees and solve the problems of low artificial construction efficiency, high hidden failure path omission rate and disjoint model and operation and maintenance data of a complex system fault tree. The method comprises the steps of constructing a system joint simulation model with multiple physical field coupling, capturing propagation paths of faults among functional units in real time to generate a fault propagation map, constructing a minimum cut set based on Monte Carlo simulation AND Bayesian network reasoning, automatically adapting an AND/OR logic gate to generate a fault tree, AND dynamically updating a knowledge map by combining an online learning technology. The invention has good application prospect in the field of health management of high-safety-requirement equipment.
assignees: HARBIN ELECTRIC MACHINERY CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle power distribution network inspection image real-time identification method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle distribution network inspection image real-time identification method based on artificial intelligence, which relates to the field of image identification and comprises the steps of carrying out space-time calibration on a multi-mode data packet, extracting characteristics of each mode, using a cross-mode attention mechanism to fuse the characteristics, obtaining multi-mode characteristic vectors, constructing an abnormal pattern through distribution network topology data, setting nodes and edges, giving the multi-mode characteristic vectors to the nodes, using a graph convolution neural network to aggregate neighbor equipment characteristics, updating node representation, outputting an abnormal classification result and an abnormal propagation path prediction result of distribution network equipment, receiving the abnormal classification result and the abnormal propagation path prediction result by a bandwidth network center, continuously monitoring and utilizing historical network data and an environmental factor training bandwidth prediction model, and predicting bandwidth change trend.
assignees: YONGCHENG DISTRIBUTION NETWORK CONSTRUCTION BRANCH OF NINGBO POWER TRANS AND DISTRIBUTION CONSTRUCTI

title_en: Multi-energy complementary system market trading profit distribution method based on Aumann-Shapley method
abstract_en: A multi-energy complementary system market trading profit distribution method based on Aumann-Shapley value method comprises the steps of building benefit models of a cascade hydropower station, a wind power station, a photovoltaic power station and electric hydrogen production equipment under independent operation conditions, building a water-wind-light-hydrogen combined system benefit maximization model by combining the characteristics of time-sharing electricity prices of all energy sources in the electric power market and production and trade capacities in different time periods, decomposing the water-wind-light-hydrogen combined system benefit maximization model into profit maximization sub-problems and cost minimization sub-problems based on an alternate direction multiplier distributed optimization algorithm, building an augmentation Lagrange function model for solving optimal trade capacities, building a Aumann-Shapley value benefit distribution model based on the water-wind-light-hydrogen combined system benefit, and realizing reasonable profit distribution through marginal contribution quantification. The method promotes market participation enthusiasm of the multi-energy complementary system, promotes efficient collaborative operation of the energy network, and enhances economic feasibility and sustainability of the comprehensive energy system.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Node electricity price joint probability prediction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system electricity price prediction and discloses a node electricity price joint probability prediction method which comprises the steps of constructing a dual-state monitoring system, simultaneously tracking physical states and market fluidity indexes of a power grid to generate physical constraint state vectors and market fluidity state vectors, designing critical early warning indexes through nonlinear combination of physical constraint degrees and fluidity levels, introducing a state space mapping algorithm to divide a physical fluidity state space into a stable region, a metastable region and a critical region, constructing refined representation of a system state, tracking physical constraint changes to influence market fluidity by influencing behaviors of market participants based on a propagation mechanism model of a directed causal graph, and modeling extreme price distribution by applying condition extremum theory aiming at the identified critical state.

title_en: Knowledge-graph-based safety production risk identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety production risk identification method and a system based on a knowledge graph, which relate to the technical field of safety production risk identification, and the invention adopts a graph neural network to generate embedded representation by acquiring entity nodes and relationship edge data of the knowledge graph and extracting feature vectors, calculating node weights by using an attention mechanism to determine a risk mode, traversing the associated paths to generate a risk propagation sequence, fusing time sequence features to update entity states and determine a dynamic propagation path, extracting key node subgraphs to adjust edge weights to optimize the risk mode, and finally identifying a complete risk propagation chain by iteratively querying and integrating environmental features. The method and the system realize dynamic tracking of equipment, personnel and environmental network risks and cross-dimension cascading risk identification.

title_en: Intelligent water affair integrated platform mass data intelligent analysis processing and decision support method based on GIS and Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of operation and maintenance of water service management networks, in particular to an intelligent water service integrated platform mass data intelligent analysis processing and decision support method based on GIS and the Internet of things, which constructs a pressure anomaly propagation map and corrects a hydraulic model by marking pipe explosion monitoring points and generating an initial influence domain, reversely tracking upstream nodes, the method is used for solving the problems of large estimation deviation of the traditional pipe explosion influence range and lack of accuracy of the valve closing instruction, improving the pipe explosion emergency response efficiency, reducing the water resource waste, guaranteeing the water supply stability and being suitable for urban water affair fine management.
assignees: SHANDONG HUATE WISDOM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Lightning arrester performance degradation index construction method based on improved neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lightning arrester performance degradation index construction method based on an improved neural network. The method is used for collecting the environmental temperature, the humidity, the accumulated impact times and the running time as inputs, taking resistive current and capacitive current as outputs, constructing a neural network model, introducing an attention mechanism, combining a counter-propagation algorithm and an improved cosine annealing learning rate to optimize and update model parameters, constructing performance degradation indexes, visually displaying the state of the lightning arrester through the change of electric parameters, judging whether the lightning arrester can normally run, supervise running or stop replacing, effectively improving the processing capability of the model on complex data, providing reliable basis for timely and accurately judging the performance degradation condition of the lightning arrester for an electric power system, and having important significance and popularization value for guaranteeing the safe and stable running of the electric power system.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ENERGY GROUP RES INST

title_en: Tap reservoir characteristic water level planning method and system for cascade small hydropower station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tap reservoir characteristic water level planning method and system for small-scale hydropower stations. The method comprises the steps of dividing a year into three periods according to the water inflow condition of local small hydropower stations, respectively calculating warehouse-in flow corresponding to the three periods according to relative flow, namely a dead water period, a rich water period and a flat water period, calculating the required power generation amount of each period step small hydropower station through time integration according to photovoltaic daily power generation data and local power grid load requirements, determining the power generation adjustment time of the corresponding period according to the required power generation amount of the small hydropower station and the small hydropower station basic information, calculating the power generation adjustment warehouse capacity according to the warehouse-in flow, determining the maximum water storage warehouse-out time of the corresponding period according to the local hydrologic information, calculating the warehouse-out capacity according to the local reservoir requirements and the calculated adjustment warehouse-out capacity and the calculated warehouse-out capacity, setting the characteristic water level, and constructing a dam for the tap reservoir. The invention ensures the stability of small hydropower generation and improves the adjusting capacity of the whole river basin.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP;UNIV HOHAI;STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Power failure area prediction method, power failure sensitive user identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent power grids. The invention provides a power failure area prediction method, a power failure sensitive user identification method and a power failure sensitive user identification system, which are used for extracting characteristics of nodes in a device node set according to historical power data to obtain initial node characteristics, determining initial edge weights according to physical or logical relations, updating the initial node characteristics and the initial edge weights according to nodes with changed states to obtain updated node characteristics and updated edge weights, determining node power failure probability according to the updated node characteristics, determining edge fault propagation probability according to the updated node characteristics and the updated edge weights, determining all fault nodes according to the node power failure probability and the edge fault propagation probability, and identifying power failure sensitive users by taking areas where all the fault nodes are as power failure area prediction results.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG

title_en: Modeling method for accurate traffic flow prediction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a modeling method for accurate traffic flow prediction, which comprises the following steps of S1, integrally modeling all intersections and roads into a road network undirected graph, defining an adjacent matrix and a distance matrix, S2, defining the propagation delay of traffic flow of the intersections, combining the propagation delay and the influence of abrupt change of the traffic flow of the adjacent intersections to confirm the comprehensive effect of each intersection at a moment t to obtain the traffic flow representation of the intersection at the moment t, S3, aggregating the characteristics of each intersection through the adjacent matrix and the propagation delay by a space graph convolution layer, capturing the dynamic rule step through a time graph convolution layer, combining the graph convolution layer and the time convolution layer to form a time space graph convolution network, outputting final traffic flow prediction, S4, giving a final traffic flow prediction and a kernel density estimation matrix of GKDE, setting three learnable matrices, and S5, outputting through a feedforward neural network.
assignees: UNIV ZHENGZHOU

title_en: Construction progress dynamic optimization method and system based on BIM and computer vision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction progress dynamic optimization method and a construction progress dynamic optimization system based on BIM and computer vision, which particularly relate to the technical field of building construction management and comprise the following steps of automatically registering a BIM model with a construction site image; the method comprises the steps of processing a construction site image by adopting a visual recognition algorithm to generate a visual recognition result, constructing a four-dimensional dynamic BIM model, mapping the visual recognition result to a corresponding component in real time through multi-feature similarity calculation, monitoring progress deviation by utilizing a key path dynamic recognition and deviation propagation matrix, and combining a Bayesian network and Monte Carlo simulation prediction risk. According to the invention, by fusing BIM and computer vision technology, a construction progress optimization system integrating automatic registration, dynamic monitoring, risk prediction and intelligent decision is constructed, the problems of low efficiency, delay in progress monitoring, fuzzy risk prediction and rough resource allocation in traditional manual inspection data acquisition are solved, and accurate monitoring, risk early warning and resource optimization configuration of construction progress are realized.
assignees: ZHEJIANG LIDE ENG CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent integrated service method and system for anti-overflow anti-static controller
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent integrated service method and system for an anti-overflow anti-static controller, which relate to the technical field of risk prediction and comprise the steps of calling a fault time sequence tracking data set of a historical sample controller according to a model ID of a target controller, wherein the target controller is the anti-overflow anti-static controller; performing index fluctuation association analysis, constructing a fault fluctuation association tree, constructing a cross-level risk prediction network, performing polling backtracking of association sensing equipment to obtain an intersection index monitoring time sequence array, outputting scene matching probability distribution, performing risk prediction level verification, outputting an integrated risk prediction result, matching a fault propagation path map, and performing source parameter inhibition regulation. The invention solves the technical problems that the overflow-preventing anti-static controller in the prior art mostly judges whether faults occur by setting a fixed threshold value, lacks flexibility and adaptability, is easy to cause false alarm and leakage alarm, and further influences the running stability and safety of equipment.
assignees: JINAN TEMEIRUI ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Reliability evaluation method and system for multi-power-supply radiation type power grid
abstract_en: The invention provides a reliability evaluation method and a system for a multi-power radiation type power grid, which comprise the steps of generating a partition branch current node injection matrix and a partition node current branch injection matrix and outputting an isolation node matrix, enabling the multi-power to be equivalent to common nodes and generating an undirected graph adjacent matrix of the power grid, determining connectivity among power grid nodes under each fault scene to obtain a branch fault node connectivity matrix, updating a load classification matrix, determining a corresponding load classification matrix, determining the power branch fault node connectivity matrix and a standby power branch fault node connectivity matrix by combining corresponding priority strategies, updating parameters of the load classification matrix, calculating a node reliability index and a system reliability index according to the updated load classification matrix, and evaluating the reliability of the power grid. The method considers the cascading failure of the power grid and the influence of the cascading failure on the multiple power supplies, and can accurately and rapidly evaluate the reliability of the radiation type power grid with multiple power supplies.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Device for predicting state of charge based deep learning, system for managing microgrid system having the same and methods thereof
title_ko: 딥러닝 기반의 soc 예측 장치, 이를 포함하는 마이크로그리드 시스템의 운영 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: A deep learning-based soc prediction device for operating a microgrid system includes: a solar power generation prediction value calculation unit that calculates a solar power generation prediction value at time t by applying a backpropagation algorithm to a pre-built first artificial neural network model; a power demand load prediction value calculation unit that calculates a power demand load prediction value at time t by applying a backpropagation algorithm to a pre-built second artificial neural network model; and an soc estimation unit that estimates the soc of the energy storage device at time t using the soc at time t-1, the total capacity of the energy storage device, the solar power generation prediction value at time t, and the power demand load prediction value at time t. The present invention optimizes the charging/discharging schedule of the solar-ESS microgrid by deep learning-based SOC prediction. The system improves the power operation efficiency and stability. Moreover, the surplus power loss and operating cost are reduced. It contributes to the carbon neutrality.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 본 발명의 실시예는 딥러닝 기반의 SOC 예측 장치, 이를 포함하는 마이크로그리드 시스템의 운영 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 태양광 발전원과 에너지 저장 장치가 결합된 하이브리드 에너지 시스템의 운영 시 중요한 변수인 SoC(State of Charge)를 예측하기 위해 태양광 발전량과 전력수요부하를 특정 딥러닝 모델과 역전파 알고리즘(Back propagation algorithm)을 활용하여 추정하고 이를 기반으로 SoC를 예측하는 장치, 이를 포함하는 시스템과 그 방법에 관한 것이다. 
일례로, 스마트 미터 인터페이스를 통해 태양광 발전 장치로부터 태양광 발전량에 영향을 주는 제1 데이터 및 에너지 저장 장치로부터 전력수요부하 전력량에 영향을 주는 제2 데이터를 각각 주기적으로 수집하는 데이터 수집 장치; 미리 구축된 제1 인공신경망 모델에 상기 제1 데이터 및 역전파 알고리즘을 적용하여 t시점에서의 태양광 발전량 예측치를 산출하는 태양광 발전량 예측치 산출부; 미리 구축된 제2 인공신경망 모델에 상기 제2 데이터 및 역전파 알고리즘을 적용하여 t시점에서의 전력수요부하 예측치를 산출하는 전력수요부하 예측치 산출부; 및 t-1시점에서의 SOC 값, 에너지 저장 장치의 총 용량, 상기 t시점에서의 태양광 발전량 예측치 및 상기 t시점에서의 전력수요부하 예측치를 이용하여 에너지 저장 장치의 t시점에서의 SOC 값을 추정하는 SOC 추정부를 포함하는 SOC 예측 장치; 및 상기 SOC 예측 장치를 통해 추정된 SOC 값을 이용하여 전력 분배 최적화를 위한 상기 에너지 저장 장치의 충방전 제어 동작을 수행하는 전력 제어 장치를 포함하는 마이크로그리드 시스템의 운영 시스템을 개시한다.
assignees: TELDA CO LTD

title_en: Power transmission and distribution line hanging foreign matter detection method and system based on image processing and deep learning
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for detecting suspended foreign matters of a power transmission and distribution line based on image processing and deep learning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a history point cloud set on the surface of a power transmission tower, generating a deformation gradient map through dynamic registration of curvature differences of adjacent point clouds, marking a superthreshold area as a deformation association area, extracting foreign matter outline parameters, mapping node strain signals to the association area through time-frequency decomposition, reserving steady-state components, forming a strain map, calculating displacement offset of the deformation association area, constructing a deformation propagation network, extracting load superthreshold nodes, constructing a stress diffusion network, superposing the network, fusing displacement and load values in the superposition area to generate a risk index, and combining the foreign matter coordinates and the risk index to output early warning. According to the technical scheme provided by the application, the cross-modal dynamic analysis of the deformation propagation and stress diffusion paths is integrated, and the foreign matter attachment and structural abnormality risk early warning efficiency of the power transmission tower is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD EHV POWER TRANS COMPANY

title_en: Multi-mode social network public opinion hidden trouble investigation method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-modal social network public opinion hidden danger investigation method and system, wherein multi-modal data of a social platform are collected in real time through distributed edge nodes, the multi-modal data comprise text, image and audio data, a plurality of social network communities are divided based on user interaction relations, the user interaction relations comprise but are not limited to topic rings, friend relations, comment interaction and forwarding praise, community propagation dynamics features, community topology features and content features are extracted from the plurality of social network communities one by one based on the multi-modal data, a plurality of suspected hidden danger communities are screened out from the plurality of social network communities based on the community propagation dynamics features, the community topology features and the content features and a preset screening strategy, and a plurality of hidden danger classifications corresponding to the plurality of suspected hidden danger communities are output after hidden danger detection and hidden danger classification are carried out on the plurality of suspected hidden danger communities based on the multi-modal data. The method and the system of the application obviously improve the comprehensiveness and the accuracy of public opinion hidden danger identification.
assignees: DATA SPACE INST

title_en: Robust observer-based power distribution network control input attack detection and state estimation method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power system automation and information safety, and discloses a power distribution network control input attack detection and state estimation method based on a robust observer, which comprises the steps of constructing a power distribution network linear discrete dynamic model based on a Droop control, and improving the observability of a system by utilizing a multi-step observation structure and differential modeling; based on a disturbance propagation matrix and a zero space projection technology, the attack detection problem is converted into a sparse optimization problem, an Unknown Input Observer (UIO) is designed, the robustness is enhanced by combining a dynamic compensation matrix and feedback gain, and an online feedback mechanism is introduced to realize parameter self-adaptive update. The method can realize real-time identification of control instruction tampering attack and high-precision estimation of system state, and meets high requirements of power distribution network operation on safety, instantaneity and reliability.

title_en: Distributed photovoltaic grid-connected area protection method and system
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of photovoltaic grid connection, and particularly relates to a distributed photovoltaic grid connection area protection method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a distributed photovoltaic grid connection system based on a preset number of photovoltaic nodes, and acquiring sensing data by using sensing equipment which is pre-deployed in the photovoltaic nodes, wherein the sensing data at least comprises infrared thermal imaging data, high-frequency transient signal data and acoustic data, and each photovoltaic node corresponds to one group of sensing data; creating time windows and setting the risk state of the sensing data under each time window. According to the method, the risk precursor can be timely identified by calculating the similarity, the space-time propagation path and the influence range of the abnormal event are analyzed, the influence range of the fault node can be accurately calculated by counting the total number, the accuracy of fault isolation is improved, the running risk and loss are greatly reduced, a quantitative basis is provided for risk assessment and decision making, the non-fault influence is reduced, and the safe and stable running of the main power grid is effectively ensured.
assignees: ZHUCHENG CITY POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO WEIFANG POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Intelligent monitorable lightning protection system based on copper mesh cable combination
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent monitorable lightning protection system based on copper network cable combination, which relates to the technical field of monitoring lightning protection and comprises a distributed sensing network module, a high-speed synchronous acquisition module, a lightning current reconstruction module, a thermal stress prediction module, a visual early warning module and a central control module; the system comprises the following working processes of paving copper net cables, embedding triaxial magnetic fields and temperature sensor arrays into nodes, recording three-dimensional coordinates, triggering lightning stroke events through magnetic field change rate threshold values, synchronously collecting magnetic field and temperature time sequence data by the nodes of the whole net, reconstructing three-dimensional space current density distribution based on a dynamic weight matrix and a field intensity integration algorithm, predicting plastic deformation risks of conductors of all the nodes by combining Joule heat accumulation and a time heating stress equation, marking high-risk current areas and super yield strength stress points, and outputting damage coordinate early warning. According to the invention, through distributed sensing of copper mesh nodes, the propagation path, the intensity distribution and the time-varying characteristics of lightning current in a three-dimensional space are reconstructed in real time.
assignees: ZHONGFU CARBON FIBER CORE CABLE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Probabilistic network planning method for new energy clusters and novel power distribution network
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of planning prediction models, in particular to a probabilistic network planning method for a new energy cluster and a novel power distribution network, comprising the following steps of setting planning period granularity and adjusting time granularity; and carrying out synchronous optimization solution of multi-dimensional time periods based on planning period granularity division on the source load balance model based on a group search algorithm, and predicting a new energy maximum output curve and an output strategy of the corresponding power grid partition. The method is added with time constraint, is more suitable for actual production conditions, has higher practicability of algorithm output, performs optimization solving of decision variables in each planning period granularity through synchronization of multiple time dimensions, is favorable for exploring and solving multiple time periods in a short time, and strengthens front-back association of the time dimensions, so that the output capacity of the time constraint is strengthened, and the counter-propagation capacity of the group search algorithm is increased.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CORPORATION DONGYING HEKOU DISTR POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Sewage system traceability analysis and intelligent monitoring method, system, equipment and storage medium based on graphic neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a sewage system traceability analysis and intelligent monitoring method, system, equipment and storage medium based on a graph neural network, and belongs to the technical field of environment monitoring and artificial intelligence. The invention aims to solve the technical problems of low efficiency, low precision, difficulty in processing multi-source data, improper monitoring network and the like of the existing pollution tracing method of the sewage system. The method comprises the steps of constructing a sewage system knowledge graph integrating multi-source heterogeneous data such as water quality and water quantity, adopting a multi-scale graph neural network model to learn pollution propagation characteristics based on the knowledge graph, carrying out pollution path backtracking by combining a physical model such as flow conservation after a pollution event occurs so as to identify a pollution source, carrying out uncertainty quantification on a backtracking result by introducing Bayesian inference so as to evaluate the credibility of the backtracking result, and finally carrying out dynamic optimization on the layout of monitoring points based on criteria such as information gain and the like. The invention can realize the rapid and accurate positioning of the pollution source and is suitable for the intelligent supervision of the urban sewage system.
assignees: ZHEJIANG BAINUO SHUZHI ENVIRONMENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid dynamic risk assessment method considering fault evolution under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, in particular to a power grid dynamic risk assessment method considering fault evolution under typhoon disasters, which comprises the steps of establishing a typhoon wind speed space distribution model and a system element fault probability model, quantifying the influence of typhoon strength and paths on the output of a power transmission line and an offshore wind farm, generating a typical fault scene through Monte Carlo sampling and scene reduction based on information entropy, constructing comprehensive risk indexes of load rejection, wind rejection and line out-of-limit, analyzing a power grid abnormal propagation path driven by unit rescheduling and island processing, and outputting a space-time dynamic risk assessment result. By the dynamic entropy interval control technology, efficient screening of fault scenes is achieved, a fault-tide coupling evolution model is established, cascading fault propagation paths during typhoon passing are accurately depicted, the problems that power grid risks are not accurately quantized and fault evolution paths are not clear under extreme disasters are solved, and typhoon resistance of coastal power grids is remarkably improved.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Public space dynamic risk network assessment method integrating space-time characteristics
abstract_en: The invention provides a public space dynamic risk network assessment method integrating space-time characteristics, which relates to the technical field of network assessment and comprises the steps of obtaining basic data, adopting an octree algorithm to adaptively divide grid units, establishing a connection relation diagram, calculating risk propagation probability by using a graph neural network, calculating a risk propagation path by applying an improved A algorithm, and finally outputting risk level distribution, propagation path risk change and prevention and control deployment suggestions. The method and the system realize the fine quantitative assessment of the public space risk and improve the risk early warning accuracy and the pertinence of prevention and control measures.

title_en: Disaster chain prediction method and system based on infrastructure cascade failure
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster chain prediction method and system based on infrastructure cascade failure, wherein the method comprises the steps of S1, screening and materializing extreme natural disasters, constructing extreme natural disaster scenes conforming to characteristics of a research area, S2, constructing various infrastructure single-layer network topologies, constructing a cascade failure mechanism based on coupling characteristics of multiple types of infrastructures, constructing an infrastructure multi-layer coupling network conforming to spatial distribution characteristics of the research area and actual operation logic based on the single-layer network topologies and the cascade failure mechanism, and S3, superposing the constructed extreme natural disaster scenes on the infrastructure multi-layer coupling network, and predicting a disaster chain space-time evolution process under the impact of the extreme natural disasters by taking the infrastructure multi-layer coupling network as a carrier of disaster propagation. The disaster chain prediction method and the disaster chain prediction device can predict disaster chains.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Virtual power plant electric energy scheduling scheme optimization method based on intelligent decision analysis
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric energy dispatching, in particular to a virtual power plant electric energy dispatching scheme optimization method based on intelligent decision analysis, which comprises the steps of obtaining multisource related parameter data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a cascade type prediction model based on equipment basic data and external environment data to obtain prediction results of all levels, constructing a risk assessment model based on the prediction results of all levels and combining the equipment basic data and the external environment data, generating a risk map by combining a network vulnerability analysis method to form a schedulable resource pool, acquiring market risk data to obtain a market risk comprehensive score, triggering a corresponding safety alternative scheme, constructing a decision tree, determining a decision path by combining the risk map, and generating a final optimization strategy. According to the invention, high precision, strong adaptability and intellectualization of virtual power plant electric energy dispatching are realized through multi-dimensional means such as cascade prediction, risk quantification evaluation, resource optimization screening and market risk coping.
assignees: SHANDONG YUNSHI ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-energy complementary-oriented source network charge storage integrated planning platform and resource optimization configuration method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a source network and lotus storage integrated planning platform oriented to multi-energy complementation and a resource optimization configuration method, belonging to the technical field of source network and lotus storage planning, and comprising a data layer, a model layer, an optimization layer and an application layer; according to the invention, the platform realizes multi-energy flow synergy, so that energy is utilized in a cascade way, comprehensive energy efficiency is improved to more than 80%, cross-energy complementation is adopted, electrolysis water is used for gas production during wind and light power generation peak time, fuel cells are used for generating electricity during low-peak time, the contradiction between new energy consumption and peak regulation is solved, the platform can perform dynamic resource adaptation, a space-time elastic resource pool is established, the elastic allocation and utilization of resources can be realized, the waste of resources and energy is avoided, the problems of system fluctuation, multi-energy flow coupling complexity and investment economy challenges under high-proportion new energy access are effectively solved through multi-energy complementation collaborative modeling, dynamic optimization of source network charge storage and full life cycle cost control, and the practical application effect of the whole platform is good.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGNENG GUANGLIAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Risk intelligent identification and analysis method based on multi-mode heterogeneous data fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a risk intelligent identification and analysis method based on multi-modal heterogeneous data fusion, which relates to the technical field of risk management and comprises the steps of generating semantic vectors by collecting multi-source data and constructing symbol-nerve double-space processing, extracting features through orthogonal matrix decomposition and a bidirectional long-short-term memory network, utilizing a self-adaptive weight mechanism to fuse multi-modal information, constructing a risk propagation topology network by utilizing a map embedding algorithm, realizing accurate identification and early warning of risks, and effectively improving risk prevention and control capability and prediction accuracy.
assignees: HANGZHOU ZHUIXING VIDEO TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wind-solar power station energy storage capacity configuration method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind-solar power station energy storage capacity configuration method and system, wind power generation power prediction is respectively carried out by using a model based on a convolution neural network and a long-short-period memory network based on historical related data of each wind power station, photovoltaic power generation power prediction is respectively carried out by using a reverse propagation neural network model based on a genetic algorithm based on historical related data of each photovoltaic power station, total prediction power of a wind-solar power station is obtained based on a wind power generation power prediction value of each wind power station and a photovoltaic power generation power prediction value of each photovoltaic power station, energy storage capacity optimization configuration is carried out according to an actual load state and the total prediction power of the wind-solar power station, so that the accuracy of wind-solar power station power prediction is effectively improved, and energy storage capacity optimization configuration is carried out according to an actual load state and the total prediction power of the wind-solar power station, the accuracy and reliability of configuration are improved, and the accuracy and reliability of energy storage capacity configuration are improved.
assignees: ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Three-network fault propagation risk assessment method and system for complex network analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-network fault propagation risk assessment method and system for complex network analysis, which belong to the technical field of toughness assessment and disaster risk management of an electric power system; the method comprises the steps of constructing a node importance evaluation function, carrying out weighted correction, outputting three-network coupling node importance ranking, generating a fault event trigger list, updating a node state matrix until the node state is not changed, outputting a fault influence range and a fault propagation path, calculating three-network overall connectivity loss rate, function recovery time estimation, key node fault sensitivity and coupling dependence vulnerability index, and outputting three-network fault propagation risk estimation indexes. The method can truly reflect the dependency relationship and the influence intensity among the three networks, quantify the contribution degree of the nodes to the system toughness, and realize the multidimensional, quantifiable and interpretable effective evaluation of the fault propagation risk under the complex network.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: Method for predicting required power by considering wind resistance change in vehicle team following vehicle running
abstract_en: The invention relates to a demand power prediction method considering wind resistance change in the process of fleet following and driving, which belongs to the technical field of energy management of hybrid electric vehicles and comprises the following steps of S1, measuring the front and rear vehicle distances in real time by using a binocular vision ranging cascade algorithm based on YOLOv and an improved BP neural network algorithm, S2, realizing future vehicle distance prediction by using a self-adaptive PSO-GRNN on-line vehicle distance prediction method considering cold starting, and S3, considering the influence of wind resistance coefficient change on demand power change under the fluid dynamics in the process of fleet following and driving, and correcting the rear vehicle wind resistance based on the front and rear vehicle distances measured in the step S1 and the future vehicle distances predicted in the step S2. According to the invention, based on the vehicle distance prediction model, the wind resistance coefficient under the vehicle following working condition is dynamically corrected to accurately calculate the required power, and meanwhile, the optimal vehicle following distance is provided to optimize the power distribution of the hybrid electric vehicle, so that the fuel economy and the complex vehicle following scene adaptability are improved.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Power grid operation situation analysis system combined with knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid operation situation analysis system combining a knowledge graph, which relates to the technical field of intelligent power grids and comprises a power grid data acquisition module, a power grid characteristic extraction module, a monitoring information event analysis module, a power grid graph construction module and a power grid event intelligent research and judgment module, wherein the power grid data acquisition module acquires power grid data, the power grid characteristic extraction module extracts characteristics, the monitoring information event analysis module outputs an overhaul label, a fault label, a related equipment list and a fault list, the power grid graph construction module generates a power grid knowledge graph, a fault propagation path and a threshold value are output, and the power grid event intelligent research and judgment module pushes abnormal data and fault information. According to the invention, automatic cleaning, intelligent fault research and judgment and cross-station propagation path analysis of mass monitoring signals are realized through natural language processing and machine learning technologies, so that manual intervention is reduced, fault identification accuracy is improved, grading alarms are pushed in real time, and power grid situation sensing and emergency disposal efficiency is remarkably improved.
assignees: POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL BRANCH OF INNER MONGOLIA POWER GROUP CO LTD;BEIJING YONGSHANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multistage scheduling method considering cascade hydroelectric layering optimization and flexibility constraint
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multistage scheduling method considering hierarchical hydropower layered optimization and flexibility constraint, which mainly comprises the steps of 1, generating a multi-path uncertainty scene by combining Latin hypercube sampling based on a joint probability prediction model of a bidirectional time convolution network-a bidirectional long-short term memory-attention mechanism and Gaussian process regression, 2, constructing a middle-term scheduling model, generating through adjusting structure identification and capability boundary, describing an adjustable section of a system, 3, designing a decoupling type multi-target daily scheduling model, introducing a structure tag to identify an adjusting path form, 4, constructing a confidence domain rolling scheduling model, embedding a seasonal tag mechanism to realize dynamic correction, 5, establishing a cross-stage feedback mechanism, adjusting a linkage middle-term and daily path, and uniformly constraining an expression structure. The method has the beneficial effects that the adjustment capability, the operation stability and the resource cooperative efficiency of the multi-energy system under uncertain scenes are remarkably improved.
assignees: UNIV ELECTRONIC SCI & TECH CHINA

title_en: Day-ahead power load prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a daily electric load prediction method and system, and belongs to the technical field of electric load prediction. The method comprises the steps of (1) constructing a model, wherein for the load of the d day and the t time to be predicted, the numerical value is influenced by multiple factors, constructing a hybrid neural network and a continuous conditional random field according to the multiple factors, (2) carrying out model solving and parameter training, realizing the hybrid neural network and continuous conditional random field training through forward derivation-error back propagation, and (3) carrying out power load prediction by using the trained hybrid neural network and continuous conditional random field. According to the invention, the time sequence dependency relationship of the load between every two moments in the day is quantized by using the Gaussian kernel function, and multiple dependency relationships are embedded into the probability undirected graph frame of the CCRF to carry out integral modeling and prediction solving, so that the accuracy of load prediction before the day is improved.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG

title_en: Dynamic identification method, system, equipment and medium for key transmission line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic identification method, a system, equipment and a medium of key power transmission lines, which comprise the steps of modeling wind power output data by adopting a first statistical model to generate a first time sequence, establishing a time sequence cascading failure diagram considering wind power output fluctuation according to the first time sequence, establishing a maximum influence theoretical model based on the time sequence cascading failure diagram, analyzing fault influence propagation paths and identifying the key power transmission lines, acquiring fault influence degree of each key power transmission line by adopting a first influence calculation algorithm and quantifying the effect in a fault propagation process, and screening the key power transmission lines by adopting the first line identification algorithm and combining the maximum influence theoretical model to acquire a final identification result. According to the method, through innovatively integrating time sequence modeling, dynamic network analysis and intelligent optimization algorithm, accurate identification and risk assessment of the key power transmission line in the wind power fluctuation environment are achieved.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Distribution network line fault detection data processing method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system fault diagnosis and discloses a distribution network line fault detection data processing method, a system, equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining load data of a target distribution line detection point, and performing first preprocessing on the load data to obtain a fusion feature vector; the method comprises the steps of carrying out second optimization operation on fusion feature vectors to obtain optimized fusion feature vectors, calculating potential feature matrixes according to the optimized fusion feature vectors, mapping the potential feature matrixes to a low-dimensional space to obtain a low-dimensional sample set, presetting an adaptive label propagation algorithm, carrying out fault category judgment on the low-dimensional sample set based on the adaptive label propagation algorithm, and storing judgment results in a relational database. The method effectively solves the problems of inaccurate feature extraction, insufficient new fault expansion capability of a classification model and the like in a high-noise environment, and improves the robustness of fault signal processing.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Full-polarization programmable antenna unit and design method
abstract_en: The full-polarization programmable antenna unit comprises a digital amplitude-phase programmable matching network module and a horn-type radiation antenna module, wherein the digital amplitude-phase programmable matching network module comprises a T-shaped power divider, a 90-degree directional coupler, an FPGA control module and two 360-degree digital phase shifters, and the amplitude is realized by mutually cascading the power divider, the 360-degree phase shifters and the 90-degree directional coupler, and the FPGA control module is used for realizing programmable regulation. The amplitude and phase modulation of two polarization components of the antenna unit can be realized through the digital amplitude phase programmable matching network module, specifically, the programmable matching network module for feeding is connected with the antenna radiator through the radio frequency coaxial line, so that the full polarization programmable capacity is greatly improved, the polarization loss can be reduced and the polarization interference capacity can be improved through polarization change in a complex and changeable electromagnetic environment, and the method can also be applied to application scenes such as polarization imaging in combination with related algorithms in the aspect of polarization information identification.
assignees: UNIT 63893 OF PLA

title_en: Extreme weather-oriented power distribution network operation risk early warning method, device and storage medium
