abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of safety protection of power systems, and discloses an extreme weather-oriented power distribution network operation risk early warning method, device and storage medium, which comprise the steps of collecting meteorological data, power grid equipment data and power grid topology data, and formulating and calculating equipment influence components based on the meteorological data and the power grid equipment data; the method comprises the steps of calculating equipment failure strength based on equipment impact components, judging failure probability of i pieces of equipment based on the equipment failure strength, combining power grid topology data with failure probability of i pieces of equipment, traversing adjacent equipment sets of each node in a power grid, calculating failure transfer risk values of the adjacent equipment based on the i pieces of equipment failure probability, calculating cascade failure probability of the nodes based on failure transfer risk values of all the adjacent equipment through complementary joint probability, and judging early warning grades according to maximum value of failure strength of all the equipment and system risk entropy.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY LIJIN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Power grid secondary equipment defect identification method based on knowledge graph and Bayesian network fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system fault protection, in particular to a method for identifying defects of secondary equipment of a power grid based on fusion of a knowledge graph and a Bayesian network, which comprises the steps of carrying out semantic extraction on multi-source heterogeneous data to construct a defect knowledge graph, breaking through the limitation of data islands and realizing full-dimensional association analysis of equipment defect characteristics; mapping the defect knowledge map of the secondary equipment of the power grid to a Bayesian network framework, and quantifying prior probability and conditional probability of defect occurrence based on prior knowledge of historical data; and finally, providing accurate fault mode positioning by means of defect subgraph search of a knowledge graph, and completing defect propagation path prediction by utilizing probability reasoning of a Bayesian network, wherein the two are combined, so that the method can comprehensively utilize multi-source heterogeneous data of secondary equipment of the power grid to accurately describe complex relations and probability influences between defect phenomena and multi-layer reasons, remarkably improve defect identification accuracy and response timeliness, and provide support for safe and stable operation of the power grid.
assignees: SOUTHWEST BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA

title_en: Building construction safety risk assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating the safety risk of building construction, which relate to the technical field of building construction safety management and comprise the steps of identifying a plurality of risk factors influencing the construction safety based on multi-source construction data acquired at a construction site, constructing a multi-layer fuzzy ANP network based on fuzzy dependency among the risk factors, and calculating the fuzzy weight of each risk factor; the method comprises the steps of converting a multi-layer fuzzy ANP network into a Bayesian graph, generating initial conditional probabilities of risk factors by using fuzzy weights, constructing a failure propagation path set of the risk factors in the Bayesian network, calculating propagation probabilities and accumulated risk intensities of the paths by combining preset severity levels of each risk factor, dynamically correcting the conditional probabilities and severity levels in the Bayesian network by combining real-time construction data, updating the ordering results of the failure paths and the risk factors, and outputting a risk assessment result of a current construction stage. And the real-time assessment of the construction safety risk is realized, and the accuracy of the assessment result is improved.
assignees: GUIZHOU CONSTRUCTION ENG GROUP GUANSHANHU CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Low-carbon economic dispatching method and system for multi-region interconnected electric heating combined system considering carbon emission flow and demand response
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-carbon economic dispatching method and system of a multi-region interconnection electric heating combined system considering carbon emission flow and demand response, wherein the method comprises the steps of analyzing tie line trend, decomposing the multi-region interconnection electric heating combined system into a plurality of independent region subsystems, analyzing coordinated coupling relations of the region subsystems, building a low-carbon economic dispatching model of the multi-region interconnection electric heating combined system considering carbon emission flow and demand response based on a target cascade analysis method according to region decomposition results, comprising an upper-level main problem and lower-level sub-problems corresponding to the region subsystems, solving the model after modeling, and calculating carbon emission allocation results of the region subsystems according to optimization results. According to the invention, the thermodynamic system heat supply network pipeline and the carbon emission flow thereof are modeled in a refined mode, on the basis, the heat supply side is led to participate in demand response according to the carbon emission allocation condition while the multi-region independent optimization is carried out, the confidentiality of data of subsystems in each region is facilitated, and the low-carbon economic scheduling of the multi-region interconnection electric heating combined system is realized.
assignees: UNIV HUNAN

title_en: High-fidelity reconstruction method and system for synchrotron radiation diffraction spectrum
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-fidelity reconstruction method and a high-fidelity reconstruction system for a synchrotron radiation diffraction spectrum. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a broadband light diffraction spectrum phi  pink  of a sample, extracting spectral intensity information characteristics, obtaining a monochromatic light diffraction spectrum phi  mono  of the sample, extracting spectral peak position information characteristics, inputting the extracted characteristics into a spectral information fusion network after splicing, wherein the spectral information fusion network comprises a plurality of multi-scale information fusion networks and a single-layer convolution network which are connected in cascade, each stage of multi-scale information fusion network firstly processes input data D into a plurality of characteristic images with different resolutions and respectively inputs the characteristic images into a spectrum sensitive attention network, carrying out characteristic extraction on the characteristic images output by each spectrum sensitive attention network after layer-by-layer aggregation, adding the characteristic E with the input data D, inputting the characteristic E into a next stage of multi-scale information fusion network, obtaining a characteristic F by the characteristic F output by the final stage of multi-scale information fusion network through the single-layer convolution network, and adding the characteristic F with phi  mono  to generate a predicted spectrum.
assignees: INST HIGH ENERGY PHYSICS CAS

title_en: Power consumption management peak avoidance method based on multi-objective planning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system management and discloses a power management peak avoidance method based on multi-objective planning, which comprises the steps of constructing a power system heterogeneous graph network structure, defining an uncertainty characterization model on the graph structure, constructing an uncertainty propagation dynamics model, realizing an uncertainty propagation algorithm perceived by the graph structure, constructing a robust optimization framework perceived by the graph structure, realizing a multi-level risk partition management strategy and finding out an uncertainty complementation effect.

title_en: Trans-regional ammeter anomaly detection method and system based on transfer learning and ammeter
abstract_en: The application discloses a trans-regional ammeter anomaly detection method and system based on transfer learning and an ammeter, belonging to the technical field of ammeter detection, and comprising the steps of constructing a layered characteristic extraction network and inputting ammeter data into the layered characteristic extraction network; the method comprises the steps of carrying out cross-regional feature alignment on feature data extracted from a hierarchical feature extraction network, classifying the abnormality of an ammeter in a target region through a classifier after the cross-regional feature alignment is carried out, carrying out time sequence analysis on the abnormality data through a time sequence abnormality positioning network, and identifying the association among a plurality of abnormal events after the abnormality positioning to construct an abnormality propagation diagram. In the implementation process of the technical scheme, the characteristic data are subjected to cross-regional characteristic alignment through a layered characteristic extraction network, the abnormal condition of the ammeter in the target region is classified and positioned through a classifier, then the association among different abnormal events is identified through an association analysis technology, and the abnormal detection effect of the ammeter is improved.

title_en: Enterprise risk assessment method based on multi-agent risk assessment algorithm MA-ERC
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of data evaluation, and discloses an enterprise risk evaluation method based on a multi-agent risk evaluation algorithm MA-ERC, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing an enterprise multidimensional risk knowledge graph; S2, designing a risk assessment algorithm MA-ERC to assess initial risks of enterprises and quantify propagation risk values among the enterprises, S3, constructing an MNF-GNN model to carry out enterprise risk assessment, S4, constructing an enterprise risk assessment interpretable graph EG, combining a multi-agent architecture based on a large language model with a graph-based risk propagation algorithm to simulate the risk propagation process among the enterprises more accurately and reasonably, wherein the calculated propagation risk values can effectively improve the assessment precision of the risk assessment model, and a new idea is provided for the technical combination of the multi-agent architecture based on the large language model, a knowledge graph, a graph neural network and the like.

title_en: Wind driven generator multi-working-condition flow field prediction method and device based on neural network
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical fields of wind power generation, artificial intelligence and hydrodynamics, and discloses a prediction method and a prediction device for a multi-working-condition flow field of a wind power generator based on a neural network. And under the condition of training the wake field prediction model for a new round, carrying out back propagation on the total loss, and optimizing the neural network parameters. In this way, a double branch loss collaborative optimization mechanism is formed. The physical information neural network is combined with the domain countermeasure neural network, and the complementary advantages of the physical information neural network and the domain countermeasure neural network are fully exerted. When the data is limited or the distribution difference is large, the wake field prediction with high precision and physical consistency can be realized.
assignees: OCEAN UNIV CHINA

title_en: Low-altitude economy oriented vertical take-off and landing facility unmanned aerial vehicle image location method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-altitude economy oriented image location method and system for a vertical take-off and landing facility unmanned aerial vehicle, and belongs to the technical field of image data processing and modeling. According to the method, oblique photogrammetry and laser radar scanning are carried out on a building roof through an unmanned plane to obtain high-overlapping-rate image and laser point cloud data, a live-action three-dimensional grid model and an obstacle surface three-dimensional model are constructed after pretreatment, a preliminary layout scheme is screened according to the clearance height of a roof available area based on the model, then airspace safety simulation and noise propagation simulation are carried out on each scheme, a minimum interval distance and noise intensity distribution diagram is calculated, and a final site selection scheme is screened according to airspace safety and noise constraint. The invention realizes the automation and the accurate site selection of the vertical take-off and landing facilities in the complex roof environment.

title_en: Shallow tunnel blasting earth surface vibration waveform prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for predicting surface vibration waveforms of shallow tunnel blasting, which relate to the technical field of surface vibration waveform prediction and comprise the steps of collecting geological, blasting and environmental parameters of historical and current blasting, and forming a standardized parameter set through three-level index storage, outlier screening and standardization treatment; the method comprises the steps of establishing a mapping relation between blasting parameters and a time domain sequence of a vibration waveform based on an LSTM neural network, predicting the current blasting vibration waveform, fusing a geological condition influence factor, an environment sensitivity influence factor and predicted waveform characteristics to generate a comprehensive safety evaluation index, dividing risks into four levels of safety, low risk, medium risk and high risk according to a matching result of the index and a multi-level safety threshold, and executing differential control to realize accurate prediction and dynamic regulation of blasting vibration risks. The invention can accurately simulate the propagation process of vibration waves in the blasting construction of the shallow tunnel, thereby better evaluating the influence of blasting.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY FIRST GROUP CO;THE SEVENTH ENG CO LTD OF CHINA RAILWAY FIRST GROUP;CHINA RAILWAY FIRST GROUP MUNICIPAL ENVIRONMENTAL PROT ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent power distribution operation and maintenance management system based on 5G transmission
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution operation and maintenance management, and discloses an intelligent power distribution operation and maintenance management system based on 5G transmission. The system comprises a 5G real-time acquisition module, a multidimensional feature fusion module, a dynamic topology generation module, an abnormal propagation analysis module and a strategy optimization feedback module. The system comprises a 5G real-time acquisition module, a multi-dimensional feature fusion module, a dynamic topology generation module, a state fluctuation analysis module, a strategy optimization feedback module and a strategy optimization feedback module, wherein the 5G real-time acquisition module acquires running state data streams such as current and voltage waveforms of power distribution equipment, equipment temperature sequences and environment monitoring indexes through a 5G network, the multi-dimensional feature fusion module separates equipment state features, calculates mutual information quantity and generates equipment state feature tensors, the dynamic topology generation module constructs an association strength matrix according to the feature tensors to generate a hierarchical connection path and a dynamic equipment topology map, the state fluctuation analysis module extracts a state fluctuation sequence, identifies an abnormal transmission path and marks a core transmission node, and the strategy optimization feedback module generates a maintenance strategy priority queue according to the state fluctuation sequence, feeds back an execution result to update the dynamic topology map, so that the intellectualization and the accuracy of power distribution operation and maintenance management are improved.
assignees: WENZHOU JIANLI ELECTRIC APPLIANCE CO LTD;BEIJING RAILWAY ELECTRIFICATION COLLEGE

title_en: Electric power knowledge graph multi-tenant cluster management system based on cloud primordia
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of tenant management, and provides a cloud-protogenesis-based power knowledge graph multi-tenant cluster management system which comprises a multi-tenant cluster, a cloud protogenesis platform and a central dispatching center, wherein the multi-tenant cluster manages power grid data and distributed computing resources of tenants through a data access unit and a tenant management unit, the cloud protogenesis platform generates a power knowledge graph through a knowledge modeling unit and a data extraction unit, and the central dispatching center determines a fault propagation path and key equipment through a knowledge fusion unit, an inference computing unit and a service interface unit, generates a fault diagnosis result, feeds back the fault diagnosis result to the tenant management unit and triggers tenant alarms or operation and maintenance instructions. According to the invention, through the cooperative work of the multi-tenant cluster, the cloud primary platform and the central dispatching center, the accuracy and the efficiency of fault diagnosis of the substation equipment are effectively improved.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Coordinated standby-based multi-level scheduling operation solving method for national network province
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of grid collaborative optimization, in particular to a national grid province multi-level scheduling operation solving method based on collaborative reserve, which comprises the following steps of establishing a multi-level scheduling model considering collaborative reserve constraint according to each level objective function participating in cross-province energy scheduling and reserve scheduling; decomposing the multi-level scheduling model into sub-problems of a national scheduling level, a network scheduling level and a provincial scheduling level based on an augmented Lagrangian relaxation method, and carrying out collaborative solution on each sub-problem by utilizing a target cascading method to obtain a global optimal scheduling scheme. The multi-level dispatching operation solving method for the national province can provide references for exploring a multi-level cooperative dispatching mode suitable for the national province by constructing a national-network-province multi-level dispatching model considering a cooperative standby mechanism, and in addition, solves by adopting a target cascading method, not only considers actual and internal mechanisms of a power grid under each level, but also improves the optimal dispatching solving efficiency of a power system under the cooperation of the whole network.

title_en: Early warning method and system applied to hydraulic engineering construction risk assessment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction risk assessment early warning method and system applied to hydraulic engineering, which belong to the technical field of hydraulic engineering construction safety, and are used for collecting multi-source data of construction areas, constructing a multi-dimensional construction information flow set divided by time, working procedures and working points, constructing a time-space risk causal map based on construction units, expressing time sequence association and risk propagation paths among the construction units, mapping the information flow to a map structure, training a multi-task map neural network model, acquiring risk scores and future risk evolution trends of the construction units, carrying out cluster analysis on risk states, identifying high-risk working point sets, identifying risk linkage chains based on the causal map, and triggering grading early warning signals when the risk scores exceed a dynamic threshold or a closed propagation structure exists.
assignees: JIANGXI PROVINCE WATER CONSERVANCY ACADEMY JIANGXI PROVINCE DAM SAFETY MAN CENTER JIANGXI WATER RESO

title_en: Urban power grid information physical system security situation early warning method based on cross-space fault propagation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of safety of electric power information physical systems, and discloses a city power grid information physical system safety situation early warning method based on cross-space risk propagation; the method comprises the steps of constructing a power grid physical layer and information layer coupling model and a cellular space false data injection attack model, simulating a fault cross-space propagation mechanism through an event-driven cellular automaton theory, predicting the running state of a power grid through an integrated core limit learning machine model, realizing multi-dimensional data fusion through a radial basis function, fusing a plurality of model prediction results through an integrated structure to improve model prediction accuracy, establishing an early warning system comprising voltage out-of-limit, line overload and load loss indexes, dynamically distributing weights through an entropy weight method, and dividing early warning grades. The method solves the problem of low early warning precision of the urban power grid security situation under the condition of multiple disturbance, and can effectively improve the accuracy and the robustness of the security situation early warning.
assignees: UNIV NANJING POSTS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle distributed scheduling method and system applied to communication interruption region
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle distribution scheduling method and system applied to a communication interruption area, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining unmanned aerial vehicle information used for the communication interruption area, and carrying out aerial networking on all unmanned aerial vehicles according to the unmanned aerial vehicle information; after networking is successful, defining coordinate sets of all unmanned aerial vehicles participating in networking, constructing a logarithmic path loss model according to the coordinate sets, obtaining signal propagation intensity of any position point of a communication interruption area according to the path loss model, constructing a signal coverage rate objective function according to the signal propagation intensity, constructing a network average link quality objective function and a node energy consumption balance objective function to obtain a comprehensive objective function, maximizing the comprehensive objective function as a target, and solving by adopting an improved particle swarm optimization algorithm to obtain the deployment position of all unmanned aerial vehicles in the communication interruption area. The invention can obviously improve the deployment efficiency and reliability of the disaster area communication system.

title_en: Method, device, medium and equipment for calculating ecological flow in plain river network area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, a medium and equipment for calculating ecological flow in plain river network areas, and relates to the technical field of river network ecological environments. The method comprises the steps of determining the non-flood-period ecological water level, the flood-period ecological water level and the main-flood-period ecological water level of the river network, further determining the water level index of the river network, determining the first water depth of the river network according to the proper water depths of various aquatic plants in the river network, determining the second water depth of the river network according to the proper water depths of various fishes in the river network, further determining the first water flow speed of the river network according to an algae water flow speed statistical model or a chlorophyll a water flow speed statistical model, determining the second water flow speed of the river network according to the stimulating water flow speed required by spawning behaviors of various fishes in the propagation period, further determining the water flow speed index of the river network, and adjusting the ecological flow of the river network according to the association relation among the water level index, the water depth index and the water flow speed index. By the scheme, the ecological flow of the plain river network area can be accurately calculated.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI;UNIV EAST CHINA NORMAL

title_en: Typhoon path prediction method, system, terminal and storage medium of multi-mode data and antique model based on sounding equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of typhoon path prediction and discloses a typhoon path prediction method, a system, a terminal and a storage medium based on multi-mode data of a sounding device and a large model of the antique, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring multi-source heterogeneous data acquired by a sounding device related to typhoon prediction, fusing and adaptively enhancing the multi-source heterogeneous data based on the large model of the antique, and generating a high-resolution three-dimensional field; the method comprises the steps of constructing a cascading AI downscaling network, introducing a physical constraint layer, carrying out local refined modeling on a typhoon eye area according to the high-resolution three-dimensional field, outputting a high-resolution three-dimensional gas image field, designing a typhoon-environment field interaction model based on a graph neural network, carrying out typhoon prediction according to the high-resolution three-dimensional gas image field, and outputting typhoon path set prediction and typhoon thermodynamic structure analysis report containing a confidence interval. The method improves the speed and the precision of typhoon path prediction, reduces the prediction time and the prediction error, and saves the calculation resources.
assignees: GUANGDONG LABORATORY OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE AND DIGITAL ECONOMIC SHENZHEN

title_en: Low-altitude safety emergency system based on large model application
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of low-altitude safety emergency, and discloses a low-altitude safety emergency system based on large-model application. The system comprises a low-altitude state sensing module, a dynamic state prediction model is constructed based on historical flight data, a low-altitude target track coordinate sequence, radar echo and communication signal characteristics are collected in real time, and theoretical security state values are output. The multi-source data fusion analysis module performs three-dimensional difference analysis on theoretical and actual measurement situation values, and relates to time domain trend deviation, airspace coverage deviation and event sequence matching degree to generate a target level difference feature matrix. The risk propagation path deduction module inputs the matrix into a geographic topology analysis network, and generates a probability thermal distribution map of the abnormal risk propagation path by combining airspace node communication parameters and target positions to locate a risk influence area. The intelligent treatment strategy generation module enables high-frequency monitoring to the high-probability area according to the graph configuration parameters, and applies communication disturbance test to the adjacent targets.

title_en: High-toughness coordinated operation method for power grid under multi-source disturbance scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid state analysis, in particular to a power grid high-toughness coordinated operation method under a multi-source disturbance scene. The method uses oscillation frequency as a node to construct an inter-frequency influence graph structure, and uses a poorly-converged mapping algorithm to analyze driving influence relation between oscillation components in the graph structure. And taking the two nodes meeting the verification condition as analysis objects, and utilizing the peak significance to represent energy transfer between frequencies so as to adjust the edge weight of the graph structure and obtain the verification oscillation image graph. A dominant impact path is obtained. By analyzing the propagation power on the main path and the variation characteristics of the propagation power, the power grid oscillation state can be determined by combining the other basic power grid characteristics. According to the invention, the power grid state can be identified before the oscillation event occurs by analyzing the propagation power change characteristics of the oscillation frequency on the dominant influence path, so that monitoring hysteresis is avoided, and the real-time performance and decision efficiency of the coordinated operation decision of the power grid are improved.

title_en: Power distribution network node power quality dynamic management demand quantification method
abstract_en: The application discloses a power quality dynamic management demand quantification method for nodes of a power distribution network, which belongs to the technical field of power quality management of the power distribution network and comprises the steps of constructing a voltage out-of-limit characteristic curve and a harmonic out-of-limit characteristic curve of each node, extracting node power quality management demand characteristic indexes, constructing power quality problem characteristic vectors of the nodes based on the node power quality management demand characteristic indexes, introducing ideal worst management state vectors, constructing worst node reference characteristics, constructing initial management priority indexes based on the worst node reference characteristics and the power quality problem characteristic vectors of the nodes, introducing voltage influence factors and harmonic propagation factors, correcting the initial management priority indexes based on the voltage influence factors and the harmonic propagation factors, and identifying key nodes with most urgent management demands on different time sections in the power distribution network based on the corrected initial management priority indexes. The method can effectively improve the accuracy of power quality control of the power distribution network.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Digital twinning-based gastrointestinal peristalsis space-time simulation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a gastrointestinal tract peristaltic space-time simulation method based on digital twinning, which is characterized by abstracting a nerve muscle activation process of a gastrointestinal tract into a physiological excitation field, constructing a variable topological strain network of a gastrointestinal wall to form a functional contraction path, introducing a control equation set to enable the excitation field to embody fluctuation evolution in time and embody tension distribution in space to cause geometric deformation in structure, analyzing the behavior difference between a twinning body and a real gastrointestinal system by utilizing an error field, transmitting error feedback to excitation field parameters to realize closed-loop adjustment, fusing historical state data and current feedback, modeling peristaltic trend by adopting a time sequence diagram network, mapping a continuous peristaltic process into a space-time activity density map from fitting reality to predicting future behavior ability evolution, extracting activity mutation, peristaltic stagnation and reverse propagation characteristics of a key region by utilizing topological convolution, outputting semantic class indexes which are easy to understand, constructing a predictable peristaltic behavior model, and improving clinical visibility and auxiliary diagnostic value.
assignees: AFFILIATED HOSPITAL JIANGSU UNIV

title_en: Monitoring method and system for industrial chain breakpoint treatment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of industrial chain monitoring and treatment, in particular to a monitoring method and a system for industrial chain breakpoint treatment; the method comprises the steps of acquiring production, logistics, finance, policy and environment dynamic information through multi-source data, generating industrial chain comprehensive characteristics through standardization, multidimensional embedded representation and cross-dimension fusion, introducing historical trend dependence enhancement prospective prediction, constructing a dynamic coupling network, quantifying risk propagation intensity among nodes by using dynamic side weights to realize cross-level breakpoint propagation analysis, calculating risk indexes through fusion of node characteristics and a network structure, screening breakpoint candidate nodes by combining self-adaptive thresholds, predicting multi-step evolution trend by using a nonlinear propagation function, and mapping the multi-step evolution trend into multi-level early warning grades. Generating a treatment strategy according to the risk level, evaluating the effect in real time through a closed-loop optimization mechanism, and dynamically adjusting parameters. The invention realizes the closed-loop management of risk identification, prediction and self-adaptive treatment.
assignees: HIGH QUALITY STANDARDIZATION RES INSTITUTE SHANDONG CO LTD

title_en: Optimal decentralized coordination control method for micro-grid in new energy power system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of large-scale power grid safety guarantee, in particular to an optimal decentralized coordinated control method of a micro-grid in a new energy power system. According to the invention, the virtual disconnection verification of the key transmission lines is implemented one by acquiring the power grid topology and line tide data in real time, the simulation and analysis of the line fault scene are realized, the full-network cascading risk quantification index is established on the basis, the initial fault line with the greatest threat to the system security is identified by comparing with the security threshold in real time, the vulnerable line risk contribution list is generated, the positioning and early prevention of the high-risk line are realized, and the power adjustment quantity required by the micro-grid group is directly calculated according to the risk contribution list, so that the prospective tide dredging instruction set is formed.

title_en: Power equipment risk assessment method and device based on space-time diagram neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a power equipment risk assessment method and device based on a space-time diagram neural network. The method comprises the steps of obtaining historical meteorological data of a place where target power equipment is located, coordinates of the target power equipment, service life, maintenance frequency and load rate, and coordinates of a plurality of first power equipment, predicting to obtain the meteorological data at future time through a space-time diagram neural network based on the historical meteorological data, calculating equipment vulnerability indexes based on the service life, the maintenance frequency and the load rate, calculating risk propagation coefficients corresponding to the first power equipment based on the meteorological data at the future time, the coordinates of the first power equipment and the coordinates of the target power equipment for each first power equipment, and determining probability of risk occurrence of the target power equipment based on the vulnerability indexes and the risk propagation coefficients corresponding to the plurality of first power equipment. The method and the system can improve the accuracy of equipment risk assessment in the power grid, adjust the assessment result and ensure the stability of the power grid.
assignees: DIGITAL TECH BRANCH OF HEBEI ZHONGXING JINENG ELECTRIC POWER DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;INFORMATION & COMMUNICATION BRANCH COMPANY STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Source-charge collaborative carbon reduction method and system considering social association of users
abstract_en: The invention discloses a source-load collaborative carbon reduction method and system considering user social association, which comprises the steps of firstly building a source-load collaborative carbon reduction model, taking wind-solar uncertainty and a carbon transaction mechanism into consideration by a source side, and taking carbon emission responsibility into consideration by the load side, and visually apportioning and responding to low-carbon requirements, combining a same group effect principle and a demand response context in social psychology in the low-carbon demand response of the load side, providing a load side same group influence propagation model to quantify the user social association, taking same group influence as one of influence factors of user behavior decisions, and building a user response model considering the social association by using a linear regression method. Finally, online learning of user response model parameters by using maximum likelihood estimation technology is proposed to cope with randomness of user response behavior. The method is beneficial to improving the source-load synergistic carbon reduction efficiency by utilizing a social network, realizes effective reduction of the carbon emission of the two sides, and has good application effect.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Distributed optical fiber multi-parameter testing system and method for landslide surge model test
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide surge model test distributed optical fiber multi-parameter test system and a method, wherein the system comprises a landslide surge physical model module, a distributed optical fiber sensing network module, an integrated demodulation module and a data processing module; the method comprises the steps of determining the size of a landslide and surge physical model, arranging a distributed optical fiber sensing network module, synchronously demodulating multi-parameter signals, carrying out data denoising and feature extraction, establishing a Kalman filtering state equation and an observation equation of a multi-parameter coupling state vector, and capturing the whole process of landslide impact, wave height propagation and energy transfer of dam vibration. The test system of the invention realizes high-precision, distributed and synchronous monitoring of physical and mechanical parameters in the whole landslide and surge process, introduces Kalman filtering denoising in the test method, calculates multi-parameter time domain characteristic values, solves the problems of multi-equipment dispersion and poor data consistency in the traditional scheme, and has the advantages of high precision, electromagnetic interference resistance, corrosion resistance, long test distance and high spatial resolution.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Agricultural full-industry chain tracing method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for tracing an agricultural full-industry chain based on big data, which relate to the technical field of agricultural tracing and comprise the steps of constructing a static knowledge graph in a graph database based on a full-chain data set, setting and initializing nodes, edges and initial weights, predicting environmental changes through an LSTM model, dynamically adjusting the nodes and the edge weights through reinforcement learning, generating a dynamically updated knowledge graph, constructing a multi-factor risk conduction matrix according to the dynamically updated knowledge graph, defining an initial risk propagation path, integrating the full-chain data set through a Bayesian network model, calculating the conditional probability of the initial risk propagation path, generating an optimized risk propagation path, and predicting the risk probability through the optimized risk propagation path by using a random forest model.
assignees: SINOVINE BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Water-light-storage complementary and direct-current outgoing two-stage random optimization scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of optimal scheduling of power systems, in particular to a water-light-storage complementary and direct-current outgoing two-stage random optimal scheduling method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a water-light-storage complementary and direct-current outgoing system model comprising a thermal power unit, a photovoltaic unit, step hydropower, a pumped storage unit, a static reactive compensator and direct-current outgoing; the method comprises the steps of constructing a two-stage random optimization scheduling model by taking operation cost minimization as an objective function and taking node balance constraint, branch flow constraint, thermal power unit constraint, photovoltaic output constraint, pumped storage power station constraint, cascade hydropower constraint, static reactive compensator constraint and tributary operation constraint as constraint conditions, generating a typical scene by taking photovoltaic uncertainty into consideration of a condition generation countermeasure network CGAN, reducing the generated scene through a Euclidean hierarchical clustering method EAHCM, solving the two-stage random optimization scheduling model to obtain an optimization scheduling result, and achieving the aim of economic scheduling.

title_en: Load prediction method and system based on virtual power plant operation
abstract_en: The invention provides a load prediction method and a system based on virtual power plant operation, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a hybrid prediction model based on an ant colony optimization algorithm dynamic weighting combination LSTM time sequence sub-model, XGBoost gradient lifting sub-model and fuzzy clustering sub-model, positioning a main deviation source through an error propagation network, triggering the reconstruction of the hybrid prediction model according to the real-time operation state of the virtual power plant, calculating the load predictability index of the reconstructed hybrid prediction model, and correcting the load prediction result of the hybrid prediction model according to the load predictability index to obtain a final load prediction value. According to the method, the mixed prediction model is built by dynamically weighting and combining all the sub-models through the ant colony optimization algorithm, the deviation source is positioned through the error propagation network, the sub-model weight is adjusted according to the real-time running state reconstruction model of the power plant, the reliability of the model is estimated by calculating the predictability index of the model so as to correct the result, and the accuracy of the load prediction of the virtual power plant is greatly improved.
assignees: CHENGDU HUAMAO NENGLIAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Knowledge graph-based shield risk tracing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shield risk tracing method based on a knowledge graph, and belongs to the technical field of shield risk analysis. Determining a set of entities Sum relation set The method comprises the steps of constructing a mode layer of a knowledge graph, preprocessing document data to obtain a processed text, extracting knowledge triples meeting requirements, outputting structured knowledge triples according to a preset format, aligning entities to obtain normalized knowledge triples to construct the knowledge graph, calculating the membership degree of nodes based on the knowledge graph, combining the posterior probability of the nodes to obtain the posterior probability of the nodes, deducing potential risk propagation paths and relationship strength based on the posterior probability of the nodes in the knowledge graph, and realizing dynamic analysis and prediction of a knowledge network. The invention realizes the structural association of risk factors through the knowledge graph, and combines the fuzzy Bayesian inference to quantify uncertainty, thereby solving the problem that the traditional method is difficult to process complex causal relationship and information ambiguity.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY 14TH BUREAU GROUP SHIELD ENG CO LTD;CHINA RAILWAY 14 BUREAU GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent allocation and early warning method for international trade measure workflow
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent allocation and early warning method of international trade measure workflow, which relates to the technical field of resource scheduling and distribution, and aims to realize penetration and forward prospective early warning from macroscopic environment to microscopic core asset risk by calculating vector differences of policy texts in semantic vector space and introducing information source authority as a regulating factor to accurately quantify talent policy tightness, and simultaneously, adopting a principal component analysis method to carry out weighted fusion on basic emotion components of public opinion, logarithmic propagation influence factors and topic risk weights so as to objectively calculate social public opinion rejection degree and focus on public opinion really having systematic threat, and finally, carrying out probability coupling on the accurately quantified external environment risk and core talent loss impact index inside an enterprise by utilizing a dynamic Bayesian network, thereby converting the fuzzy trade risk into manageable and accurate internal safety problem to people and obviously improving the accuracy and efficiency of decision.
assignees: UNIV SHANXI AGRICULTURAL

title_en: Vehicle network model modeling method and system under working condition of cutting magnetic force lines by pantograph
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle net model modeling method and system under the working condition of cutting magnetic lines by a pantograph, and relates to the technical field of modeling, comprising the following steps of constructing a lumped tau-shaped circuit of a traction net in unit length based on self-impedance and earth admittance of a contact line, self-impedance and earth admittance of a steel rail and mutual impedance between the contact line and the steel rail; and cascading the lumped tau-shaped circuit with a unit length, taking dynamic electromotive force generated during train operation as an equivalent voltage source, connecting one end of the equivalent voltage source with a contact line which is in sliding connection with a pantograph in the chain lumped tau-shaped network model, connecting the other end of the equivalent voltage source with the roof end of the train model, and connecting the bottom end of the train model with a steel rail to obtain the train network model under the working condition that the pantograph cuts magnetic lines. The invention provides a modeling method of a train network model for cutting magnetic lines of force by a pantograph of a high-speed train, which can simulate and obtain the influence of the magnetic lines of force of the pantograph cutting on each line of a train and a traction power supply system under different running speeds of the train.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;BEIJING INST ASTRONAUTICAL SYS ENG

title_en: Centralized heating network management monitoring method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention provides a centralized heating network management monitoring method and system based on artificial intelligence, which collect pressure, temperature, flow and pipe wall acoustic vibration time sequence data of each node. The multi-modal fusion feature vector is generated by calculating the hydraulic imbalance, enthalpy difference change rate and extracting the MFCC features of the acoustic vibration signal. Initializing the pipe network topology into a graph structure, and dynamically calculating the association weight among nodes by using a relationship attention mechanism, thereby constructing a time-varying thermodynamic propagation graph. And the space-time characteristics are fused and extracted through a double-branch time convolution module, the space-time characteristics are input into a fully connected network, the fault type and the position are output, and a topological perception weighting loss function optimization model is adopted during training.
assignees: SHANXI SHANAN LANTIAN ENERGY SAVING TECH CO LTD;SHANXI INSTALLATION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Underground space protection evaluation system and method based on BIM and multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The underground space protection evaluation system based on BIM and multisource data fusion comprises a data input layer, an evaluation engine layer and a result output layer, wherein the data input layer, the evaluation engine layer and the result output layer are sequentially used for data transmission and processing, the data input layer is configured to construct a three-dimensional BIM model, an association rule base based on an attack mode and a damage path of a terrorist attack parameter base and a real-time environment data stream based on multisource sensor data fusion, the three-dimensional BIM model integrates geological survey data, topographic survey, structural parameters and civil air defense engineering data through a space topology modeling technology, the evaluation engine layer is configured to receive the three-dimensional BIM model, the association rule base and the real-time environment data stream of the data input layer, a key damage propagation simulation result and a vulnerability analysis result are generated through explosion dynamic response simulation and space topology network analysis, and the result output layer is configured to generate a three-dimensional space classification map, a dynamic design adjustment suggestion and a model self-examination report based on the damage propagation simulation result and the vulnerability analysis result of the evaluation engine layer.
assignees: CN RAILWAY SIYUAN SURVEY & DES;CHINA RAILWAY CONSTRUCTION CORP LTD

title_en: Distributed blocking processing method, device and equipment for power distribution network
abstract_en: The application relates to a distributed blocking processing method, a distributed blocking processing device, computer equipment, a computer readable storage medium and a computer program product. The method comprises the steps of inputting the example data of the power distribution network during operation into a target distributed blocking processing model, and carrying out data analysis on the example data through the target distributed blocking processing model to obtain a power distribution network distributed blocking processing result. The target distributed blocking processing model is obtained by carrying out model optimization on an initial distributed blocking processing model based on a target cascade analysis algorithm, the initial distributed blocking processing model is obtained by carrying out model coupling on a power distribution network double-layer model through the target cascade analysis algorithm, and the power distribution network double-layer model is obtained by constructing power distribution network parameters based on a power distribution network. By adopting the method, the regulation and control requirement of the blocking phenomenon of the power distribution network can be met efficiently.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Knowledge graph-based multi-scale safety monitoring method for power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid multi-scale safety monitoring method and system based on a knowledge graph, and belongs to the technical field of operation and control of power systems. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source heterogeneous data of a power grid to construct a heterogeneous time sequence knowledge graph, calculating real-time Risk Propagation Indexes (RPIs) of nodes according to the current running state of the power grid, dynamically generating a self-adaptive multi-scale graph hierarchical structure based on the RPIs, performing state-aware space-time feature learning on each hierarchy to generate hierarchical state embedding, performing cross-scale causal inference on an embedded input prediction model to predict a future safety event sequence and a propagation path of the future safety event sequence, and finally generating a safety situation assessment report and a preventive control strategy. The method solves the problems of single analysis scale and solidification of a hierarchical structure in the prior art, realizes active and accurate prediction of the security situation of the power grid through a risk-driven dynamic multi-scale analysis framework, and remarkably improves the prediction and defending capacity of cascading failures.
assignees: GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Construction environment abrupt change risk field prediction method fusing geological meteorological data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction environment abrupt change risk field prediction method for fusing geological meteorological data, which belongs to the technical field of construction engineering risk prediction and comprises the steps of obtaining geological data, meteorological data and construction progress data of a construction area, and generating graph data containing multi-modal characteristics after structuring the multi-modal heterogeneous data. The invention adopts the space-time self-adaptive graph neural network prediction model based on the attention mechanism, can dynamically calculate and distribute weights of different characteristics according to the real-time environment and construction data, and captures the space-time propagation relationship of risks among geographic nodes by utilizing the message transmission mechanism of the graph. The method can deeply fuse data of different modes, realizes accurate prediction of abrupt change risk of construction environment, triggers corresponding early warning according to the risk level, improves the accuracy and timeliness of risk prediction, and provides scientific support for intelligent decision of construction engineering.

title_en: Open-air dyeing tracing and soil nutrient migration analysis method integrating spectrum analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of in-situ monitoring, in particular to a field dyeing tracing and soil nutrient migration analysis method integrating spectrum analysis, which effectively focuses on a key concentration evolution channel by adopting a statistical analysis and threshold screening strategy of total gradient change of the channel, avoids interference of a redundant path on the whole analysis precision, adopts a graph convolution neural network to topologically propagate and embed an adjacency relation constructed by concentration difference nodes to represent, and adopts a combination judgment mode of concentration change rate, an included angle cosine value and a distance, the graph structure is ensured to have physical continuity when the nutrient migration space evolution characteristics are expressed, similarity measurement and high-frequency numbering clustering treatment between node characteristic vectors are realized, extraction and structural expression of a concentration migration hot spot area are realized, a frequency chart generated by combining time and depth index statistics is effectively reduced, the dynamic evolution trend of a local high risk area in soil is effectively reduced, and the analysis precision and the expression level of complex nutrient migration behaviors are improved.
assignees: UNIV ANSHUN

title_en: Fire-fighting electric fire early warning method and system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire early warning, and particularly discloses a fire-fighting electric fire early warning method and a fire-fighting electric fire early warning system based on the Internet of things, wherein the method comprises the steps of configuring an edge computing gateway, and acquiring a current waveform signal and a high-frequency electromagnetic radiation signal of an electric loop based on the edge computing gateway; the method comprises the steps of acquiring a power grid topological structure, constructing a risk value prediction and propagation model based on a graph neural network model, generating a data packet when the coupling relation between the harmonic feature and the electromagnetic radiation feature meets a joint triggering condition, inputting the data packet into the risk value prediction and propagation model, outputting a dynamic risk value and a fault source position based on the risk value prediction and propagation model, and carrying out bimodal acquisition to early find out potential electrical fire hazards, carrying out real-time feature extraction by utilizing an edge computing gateway, reducing data transmission quantity, modeling the power grid topology by using the graph neural network model, accurately predicting a fault propagation path and improving early warning precision.
assignees: JIANAN CONSTRUCTION GUANGDONG CO LTD

title_en: Power quality abnormality tracing and purifying strategy generation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power quality monitoring and treatment, and discloses a power quality anomaly tracing and purifying strategy generation system. The electric energy acquisition module acquires waveform data of key nodes of the group network in real time and sets a monitoring interval, the characteristic analysis module decomposes spectral characteristics to generate pollution characteristic vectors, the anomaly tracing module extracts core index construction tracing rules, the pollution evaluation module identifies propagation paths to calculate pollution indexes, the parameter optimization module derives optimal parameters to generate deviation sequences, and the strategy generation module integrates the sequences to form a purification strategy. The system realizes abnormal accurate tracing and dynamic management, improves the comprehensive analysis and strategy intelligent level, and is suitable for electric energy quality control of the power grid.
assignees: WUXI CHENGCHENG ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: System reliability assessment method based on time sequence multi-layer complex network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a system reliability evaluation method based on a time sequence multi-layer complex network, which comprises the following steps: step one, space-time division of maintenance records; step two, constructing a single-layer network; step three, multi-layer network coupling; generating a super-adjacency matrix; step five, characteristic centrality solving; step six, extracting reliability indexes; step seven, evaluating the confidence coefficient; aiming at the problems of reliability prediction and warranty management of complex products, the invention creatively provides a time-aware multi-layer network framework, breaks through the limitations of system structure simplification and cascade fault neglect in the traditional reliability analysis, integrates the degradation short-term mutual dependence and cross-layer cascade failure mechanism of the product components by constructing a cross-layer time analysis network, and develops a super-centrality matrix and dynamic node centrality measurement, thereby systematically quantifying the influence of the product components on the system reliability and accurately identifying key nodes.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: Intelligent decision support and risk early warning method, device and equipment for drilling construction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drilling construction intelligent decision support and risk early warning method, device and equipment, which are used for collecting drilling sound wave response data, carrying out harmonic analysis to identify a reservoir resonance node, constructing a reservoir energy conduction network, tracking a fluctuation propagation path based on the energy conduction network, identifying a construction risk region through stress wave spectrum characteristics, extracting porosity and permeability data to carry out phase difference analysis to generate seepage-construction mismatch factors, actively generating a construction optimization window, constructing a geological potential gradient field to determine an overflow influence range, carrying out tensor coupling on multidimensional risk factors to generate a three-dimensional construction decision matrix, generating an optimal construction scheme through energy minimization and risk-efficiency dynamic balance treatment, monitoring construction parameter response change in real time, identifying abnormal parameter combination symptoms, generating a grading risk early warning instruction, and realizing intelligent decision support and risk early warning of drilling construction.
assignees: GUANGDONG YINGGEER GEOLOGICAL EQUIPMENT TECH CO LTD;UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY;GUANGDONG PROVINCE COMMUNICATIONS PLANNING & DESIGN INST GROUP CO LTD;CHINA RAILWAY MAJOR BRIDGE RECONNAISSANCE & DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Laboratory risk control method based on graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a laboratory risk control method based on a graph neural network, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a dynamically updated interaction event graph based on interaction event sequences of laboratory equipment, personnel and environments, S2, dynamically updating a state space of each node according to an event precursor relation to generate a synchronous node state sequence, S3, generating an early warning feature set of a node state change trend by adopting graph convolution operation, S4, constructing a risk correlation matrix among nodes according to the early warning feature set to generate an updated risk propagation path, S5, evaluating the probability of transition from a node state to an abnormal state to generate a state risk predicted value, S6, inputting a wolf' S group optimization algorithm, and optimizing parameter combinations to obtain a laboratory risk predicted result. The invention improves the real-time performance and accuracy of laboratory risk prediction.
assignees: XINDAO SOFTWARE JIANGSU CO LTD

title_en: System log data anomaly detection and management system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system data processing and network security, in particular to a system log data anomaly detection and management system and method. The system comprises a map building module, an abnormality identification module and a feedback adjustment module. According to the invention, a global knowledge graph is constructed through a graph establishing module, deviation degree is calculated by combining with a historical baseline, direct association anomalies are judged, potential influence degree among nodes is calculated by an anomaly identification module based on a graph neural network propagation mechanism, indirect association anomalies are identified through feature vector cosine similarity, anomaly types are determined by combining with a multidimensional feature matching rule base, response measures are executed, a feedback adjustment module collects execution data through buried points, validity is quantitatively evaluated, feature backtracking and root cause positioning optimization schemes are adopted, iteration is carried out by depending on digital twin simulation and gray landing implementation schemes, accuracy of anomaly detection and dynamic adaptation capability of response measures are improved, and the method is suitable for log management and risk prevention and control of a complex system.
assignees: DALIAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Underwater target positioning method and system based on side-scan sonar data
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an underwater target positioning method and system based on side-scan sonar data, and belongs to the technical field of underwater detection and positioning. The method comprises the steps of reading a side-scan sonar data file in a target format, extracting sonar image data, converting the sonar image data into a general image format, inputting the general image format into a pre-trained convolutional neural network model, identifying an underwater target, outputting relative coordinates of the image, fusing attitude and position data of sonar equipment and a ship, obtaining sonar real-time geodetic coordinates through Kalman filtering, and mapping the relative coordinates into longitude and latitude coordinates by using a side-scan sonar wave beam propagation geometric model in combination with water depth, inclined distance and wave beam angle. The invention improves the accuracy, reliability and real-time performance of underwater target positioning through multi-source data fusion and geometric modeling, and is suitable for the scenes of ocean engineering detection, underwater search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Multi-energy collaborative optimization energy saving and emission reduction system and method based on intelligent regulation and control
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent regulation-based multi-energy collaborative optimization energy conservation and emission reduction system and method, comprising an intelligent sensing layer, a dynamic analysis layer, a collaborative decision layer, a flexible interaction layer and a flexible interaction layer, wherein the intelligent sensing layer monitors stress changes, preprocesses multi-source heterogeneous data and sends the multi-source heterogeneous data to the dynamic analysis layer, the dynamic analysis layer builds a digital twin model of coupling equipment based on the multi-source heterogeneous data, quantifies interaction effects among the equipment, simulates a linkage propagation path of a single fault, combines an equipment operation limit value and a vulnerability index to generate an anti-interference capability assessment report, the collaborative decision layer generates an initial scheduling scheme and sends the initial scheduling scheme to the flexible interaction layer, then triggers a fault response mechanism through the collaborative scheduling model, synchronously starts standby equipment, the flexible interaction layer responds to power grid auxiliary service requirements in real time, receives a user side load adjustment instruction, optimizes green electricity transaction quota through a bi-directional interaction mechanism, and finally rapidly calls regional standby resources when encountering faults.
assignees: UNIV GUILIN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Intelligent monitoring method and system for energy consumption and carbon emission of data center
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent monitoring method and system for energy consumption and carbon emission of a data center, which are characterized in that energy consumption monitoring data and environmental data in an operating environment of the data center are monitored, a time sequence analysis is adopted to identify an energy consumption mode and generate hierarchical quality configuration, marginal utility evaluation is carried out based on the energy consumption mode to determine an accuracy configuration boundary, a carbon source strength index is generated through influence strength evaluation and is converted into an influence coverage area, a carbon propagation network is constructed by analyzing a change track of the environmental data, a key propagation path is obtained and a monitoring network is reconstructed, an abnormal propagation range of the influence coverage area is evaluated to determine a monitoring expansion area, a self-adaptive monitoring configuration is constructed and an emission reduction potential area is identified, the emission reduction potential area is decomposed into space monitoring nodes and is subjected to utility weight distribution, a matrix operation is carried out through a differentiated monitoring sequence to generate an energy consumption carbon emission analysis matrix, and finally, a monitoring configuration parameter is generated through statistical evaluation, so that intelligent monitoring management of the energy consumption and carbon emission of the data center is realized.

title_en: Two-stage sea-iron intermodal network toughness optimization method under uncertain cascade failure
abstract_en: The invention relates to a two-stage sea-iron intermodal network toughness optimization method under uncertain cascade failure, which comprises the steps of S1, acquiring a failure junction node, generating a container operation load redistribution scheme based on a sea-iron intermodal network dynamic load distribution stochastic programming model under uncertain cascade failure, wherein the sea-iron intermodal network dynamic load distribution stochastic programming model under uncertain cascade failure takes the total loss expectation of all substitute nodes and the minimum container freight volume which cannot be redistributed as targets, distributing the original container operation requirement of the original failure junction node to the peripheral uninterrupted substitute nodes, and S2, taking the generated container operation load redistribution scheme as the input of a sea-iron intermodal network transportation organization optimization model under the interruption of a key interval, generating a new shift-on operation requirement, and generating a new feasible restorable transportation scheme through the sea-iron intermodal network transportation organization optimization model reconstruction path when the key region interruption occurs to the new shift-on operation requirement. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of and the like.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Steel manufacturing process energy consumption prediction method and system based on multi-scale channel mixed convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting energy consumption in a steel manufacturing process based on a multi-scale channel mixed convolutional neural network, which are used for acquiring production data in the steel manufacturing process and preprocessing to obtain a historical data set; the method comprises the steps of constructing a data embedding module, performing size conversion on historical data to obtain embedded features, performing channel mixing on the embedded features to realize channel feature interaction, constructing a multi-scale cavity convolutional neural network with a plurality of convolution kernels with different sizes to obtain multi-scale features, constructing a regression based on a feedforward neural network, inputting the multi-scale features into the regression to perform output prediction, optimizing the multi-scale channel mixed convolutional neural network by utilizing a gradient back propagation algorithm until the maximum iteration number is reached, acquiring real-time data of input variables in a steelmaking production process, inputting the optimized multi-scale channel mixed convolutional neural network to obtain a predicted value of energy consumption, and effectively improving the accuracy and reliability of energy consumption prediction.
assignees: UNIV TONGJI

title_en: Smart grid fault prediction method, system and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and equipment for predicting faults of a smart power grid, and relates to the technical field of power grid fault prediction. Performing operation fault analysis to generate a fault feature vector group, performing migration learning to generate a fault probability distribution matrix, performing fault risk analysis according to the fault probability distribution matrix, dividing a plurality of risk classes, and performing propagation path simulation of a target intelligent power grid on the plurality of fault early warning signals to generate a fault prediction report. The intelligent power grid fault prediction method and the intelligent power grid fault prediction device solve the technical problems of low prediction precision and poor timeliness caused by the fact that intelligent power grid fault prediction lag and fault propagation path simulation inaccuracy in the prior art, achieve accurate prediction and risk early warning of intelligent power grid faults, and improve the timeliness and accuracy of fault prediction.
assignees: STATE POWER TECH ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Ladder dam group risk chain type transfer effect diagnosis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade dam group risk chain transfer effect diagnosis method, which comprises the steps of counting the distribution characteristics of upstream and downstream dam reservoir water levels and downstream dam material parameter failure risk influence factors, training a depth neural network for adjacent cascade dam-break flood evolution, randomly sampling the upstream and downstream dam reservoir water levels, calculating a breach flow process line, solving the highest dam front water level of a downstream dam affected by the upstream dam-break flood, selecting failure modes according to the downstream dam type characteristics, constructing a structural limit state function under constant load, solving the downstream dam failure risk rate before and after the upstream dam-break flood is affected, performing repeated sampling calculation, obtaining risk transfer coefficients under a plurality of upstream and downstream reservoir water level combinations, solving a mean value, and obtaining a final risk transfer coefficient. The method breaks through the limitation of the traditional 'only top failure' criterion, and has stronger universality and higher accuracy.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Power plant equipment intelligent coordination control method and system based on multi-source heterogeneous data
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent coordination control method and system for power plant equipment based on multi-source heterogeneous data, which belong to the technical field of intelligent manufacturing and industrial automation, and comprise the steps of deploying a multi-mode sensor network in the power plant equipment, collecting the multi-source heterogeneous data in real time, and preprocessing the real-time data through an edge computing node; the method comprises the steps of carrying out collaborative modeling on preprocessing data by adopting a mixed analysis framework, predicting equipment state trend, identifying a fault propagation path, positioning a root cause and optimizing a maintenance decision scheme, evaluating equipment failure probability by a fault diagnosis result, triggering a hierarchical early warning mechanism and updating an optimization rule base by combining a dynamic knowledge base, constructing a three-dimensional model by utilizing a digital twin technology for virtual simulation and remote control, and carrying out maintenance guidance by an augmented reality auxiliary technology. The invention realizes high-efficiency real-time monitoring and fault prediction, combines a fault tree model and a digital twin technology, obviously reduces fault diagnosis time and operation and maintenance cost, and improves equipment operation safety and reliability.
assignees: HUANENG POWER INT INC YINGKOU POWER PLANT

title_en: Online generation method of operation strategy of electric hydrogen energy system based on unsupervised learning
abstract_en: The application is suitable for the technical field of power-natural gas network collaborative optimization, and provides an online generation method of an electric hydrogen energy system operation strategy based on unsupervised learning, which comprises the following steps: acquiring network structures, operation coefficients and historical scene state data of a power grid and an air grid in an electric-hydrogen-air hybrid integrated energy system, establishing an electric-hydrogen-air hybrid integrated energy system operation model taking the lowest total cost of the system as an objective function according to the data, establishing an unsupervised learning neural network based on a Transformer, constructing a physical mapping layer corresponding to the constraint of the operation model, constructing an unsupervised learning training model in cooperation with the back propagation of a loss function, acquiring real-time scene state data, applying the unsupervised learning training model to the system, and generating an operation strategy. The application can rapidly and stably realize the on-line generation of the system operation strategy on the premise of lower constraint violation degree, and ensures the cooperative coupling operation of the electric power-hydrogen-doped natural gas network.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Coal-fired unit depth peak shaving system of collaborative economy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a depth peak regulation system of a coal-fired unit with synergistic economy, which comprises a data real-time acquisition module, a combustion unit screening and sequencing module, a historical peak regulation data analysis module, a power grid demand detection matching module, a refinement management module and an effect verification module.
