The invention belongs to the technical field of peak shaving of coal-fired power generation units, and particularly provides a deep peak shaving system of a coal-fired power generation unit, which solves the problem of poor economy under a low-load working condition through boiler combustion optimization, waste heat cascade utilization, energy storage system coordination and intelligent control and realizes the synergistic economy of dual promotion of peak shaving capacity and economic benefit.
assignees: HUADIAN LAIZHOU POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic evaluation method and device for toughness of supply chain network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic evaluation method for toughness of a supply chain network. The method comprises the steps of defining normal operation, damage and interruption states of nodes, simulating interruption propagation and tracking node state changes through constructing an improved cascade failure model, counting the number of normal operation nodes at each moment to generate a structural performance curve, constructing a maximum flow model with maximum total delivery capacity as a target, solving the total delivery capacity at each moment to generate an operation performance curve, respectively calculating maximum performance degradation, recovery duration and average performance maintenance rate according to the structural performance curve and the operation performance curve, and quantifying the network toughness of a supply chain from three dimensions of absorption capacity, recovery capacity and adaptive capacity. The invention also discloses a supply chain network toughness dynamic evaluation device, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a computer program product. The invention can dynamically evaluate the toughness of the supply chain network when the supply chain network is at risk of interruption, provides stability and reliability basis, and is suitable for evaluating and optimizing the toughness of the supply chain network.
assignees: UNIV BEIHANG

title_en: Intelligent management method for electric power marketing archives
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent management method of an electric power marketing archive, which comprises the steps of receiving archive data through an electric power data acquisition interface, identifying an electric price feature code in a matched archive based on a real-time electric price policy, injecting a version calibration mark into unmatched data, constructing an electric power consumption anomaly prediction model based on a user historical load mode and an environment factor, generating a dynamic illegal gold parameter based on a user behavior portrait and a rule base when responding to a query request, generating a quantum key distribution path based on a power grid topological structure, implementing cascade encryption along a physical connection node, dynamically associating user operation authorities with a power grid operation risk signal, automatically disabling core operation in a high risk state, analyzing the archive data in a safe isolation environment, driving line loss optimization, electric charge tracing and fault pre-judging service flow in real time, and updating the archive based on service output. The invention improves the safety, reliability and operation efficiency of the power marketing archive management.
assignees: DIGITAL RES BRANCH OF INNER MONGOLIA POWER GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Multi-sensor fusion emergency lamp strip control method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a multi-sensor fusion emergency light strip control method and system, wherein after an abnormal event is monitored by receiving environment monitoring data fed back by a plurality of groups of emergency light strips and carrying out abnormal event monitoring, a second emergency light strip which is in cooperative response with a first emergency light strip is dynamically determined based on a partition structure diagram of a building, the type of the abnormal event and abnormal characteristic parameters, so that the control range of the emergency light strip is not limited to a single area any more, and is linked with a building space structure according to a risk propagation rule, a cooperative control network covering a related area is formed, and the influence range of the abnormal event is ensured to be positioned and warned rapidly. Furthermore, the evacuation route and the forbidden region are determined by fusing the second environment monitoring data and the characteristic parameters, and the differential control is performed by combining a preset lamp band control strategy, so that the characteristics of different abnormal events are considered, and the real-time environment parameters are combined, so that the fine control of the emergency lamp band is realized.
assignees: SHENZHEN LEDODM LIGHTING CO LTD

title_en: Urban hydropower network safety monitoring method, device, home host and system
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a device, a home host and a system for monitoring the safety of an urban water-electricity network, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring hydropower data acquired by a home terminal of the home host, and extracting abnormal characteristic data based on the hydropower data; the method comprises the steps of receiving abnormal characteristic data shared by other home hosts in an intelligent joint defense network, carrying out group intelligent analysis on the received abnormal characteristic data and the abnormal characteristic data extracted by the intelligent joint defense network by utilizing a group intelligent analysis model, identifying a space-time association relation of urban hydro-electric pipe network abnormal propagation, determining whether regional disasters exist in the urban hydro-electric pipe network according to the space-time association relation, and carrying out alarming in an alarming mode matched with the type of the regional disasters according to the type of the regional disasters under the condition that the regional disasters exist in the urban hydro-electric pipe network. Therefore, regional disasters of the urban water supply network can be accurately identified, and regional disaster prevention and control capability is improved.
assignees: GREE ELECTRIC APPLIANCES INC ZHUHAI;ZHUHAI LEAYUN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban rail transit station safety assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a security assessment method and a security assessment system for urban rail transit stations, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing network topology, setting an initial security state value of each node, applying external disturbance to the nodes, calculating a coupling strength coefficient of each node, calculating the security state value of each node, judging whether a failure node is newly added at the current moment, and eliminating the newly added failure node if the failure node is newly added. The urban rail transit station safety evaluation method and system provided by the disclosure dynamically describe the coupling relation between the nodes, so that the safety modeling is more complete, regional safety association analysis is realized, the disturbance influence of the node safety state and the passenger flow on the safety state is combined with the node coupling relation between the regions, the dynamic description of the linkage propagation of the node failure is realized, and the accuracy and the reliability of urban rail transit station safety evaluation are effectively improved.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI ENG SCIENCE

title_en: Reverse variation network modeling method driven by assembly line performance change requirement
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide an assembly line performance change demand driven reverse deformation network modeling method which comprises the steps of constructing a five-dimensional association model matched with an assembly line to be changed, establishing mapping and constraint relations among dimension elements, identifying key assembly links and change transfer mechanisms, constructing a dynamic feedback model among assembly process parameters, production line configuration parameters and assembly line performance, obtaining topology indexes of any node in a network corresponding to the five-dimensional association model, quantifying propagation risks from an initial node to a potential influence range, establishing an optimization function, solving the optimization function, outputting a set of optimal solution sets, and enabling any solution in the optimal solution sets to represent an optimal change strategy among risks, time and cost. The present disclosure can improve production efficiency, reduce operating costs, and enhance market competitiveness.
assignees: UNIV GUANGDONG TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Low-voltage distributed multi-energy complementary coordination green power consumption conversion system and optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-voltage distributed multifunctional complementary coordinated green power consumption conversion system and an optimization method, wherein data acquisition and state monitoring are realized by acquiring output data of a distributed energy unit in real time through a communication module of an intelligent control unit, the power supply reliability is improved to 99.99%, a plug-and-play interface supports flexible access of newly added distributed energy or load, a system architecture is not required to be reconstructed, and the system is suitable for multiple scenes such as villages, industrial parks, micro-grids and the like. The intelligent control unit is compatible with DL698, modbus and other multiprotocol communication, can be used for seamlessly butting the existing power grid dispatching system and accelerating the application of technology to land, and the invention comprehensively improves the digestion capacity, the operation efficiency and the reliability of low-voltage distributed green power and provides key technical support for low-carbon transformation of a novel power system through the innovative integration of multi-energy complementary configuration, multi-form energy storage fusion, intelligent cooperative regulation and control and cascade utilization technology.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Source side electric carbon space-time coupling electric carbon emission tracing method, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon metering of power systems, in particular to a source side electricity carbon space-time coupling electricity carbon emission tracing method, equipment and medium, which are used for constructing a multidimensional reference model by fusing power grid topology, generator fuel characteristics and real-time output data; the method comprises the steps of decoupling electric energy transmission and carbon propagation paths based on admittance matrixes, distributing carbon emission space distribution through tide calculation, correcting carbon emission factors in real time to capture transient characteristics, breaking static factor limitation, fusing tide distribution and dynamic factors, calculating load nodes to directly/indirectly contribute to carbon emission by adopting a power flow proportion recursion mechanism, generating dynamic carbon flow distribution patterns and traceability decision reports by connecting real-time data, accurately identifying key carbon conduction paths and responsibility main bodies, providing verifiable decision basis for low-carbon transformation, carbon transaction and scheduling optimization, and improving timeliness and operability of carbon management.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Multi-type charging station collaborative planning method considering comprehensive satisfaction of users
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-type charging station collaborative planning method considering comprehensive satisfaction of users, which relates to the field of power system planning and traffic energy infrastructure planning and comprises the following steps of constructing a charging satisfaction model based on fast charging waiting time and idle slow charging pile remaining amount according to charging behavior characteristics of fast charging users and slow charging users of an electric automobile; and solving the upper and lower cascading optimization models based on an iterative capacity expansion method of a greedy algorithm, converting an upper planning problem into a multi-round quick and slow pile filling configuration expansion problem, adjusting configuration based on the operation result of the previous round in each round of iteration until convergence conditions are met, and outputting a charging station configuration scheme meeting planning constraint, optimizing system operation cost and user satisfaction. The scientificity and the high efficiency of the layout of the charging facilities are realized.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Forward variation network modeling method driven by product change demand
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a forward modification network modeling method driven by product changing requirements, which comprises the steps of determining the product changing requirements, obtaining changing requirements of an assembly line to be changed according to the product changing requirements, obtaining key parts in an existing assembly line as parameter nodes to form a parameter node library, obtaining association relations between any two nodes in the parameter node library based on a five-dimensional model, initially constructing a parameter node network model reflecting an assembly line structure, optimizing the parameter node network model, constructing a forward modification network, predicting and analyzing a changing propagation path, and processing the changing requirements of the assembly line to be changed by utilizing the forward modification network to conduct assembly line modification path planning, guide and realize quick reconstruction of the existing assembly line. The method shortens the reconstruction period, improves the reconstruction efficiency, reduces unnecessary resource waste and reduces the reconstruction cost.
assignees: UNIV GUANGDONG TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Multi-mode data-based power distribution network fault knowledge graph construction method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for constructing a power distribution network fault knowledge graph based on multi-mode data, belonging to the technical field of intelligent power grids, comprising the following steps: based on the regional monitoring space-time record, the meteorological environment parameters and the equipment operation state data, the change matching of the spatial position signals and the meteorological parameters is carried out, the time period is divided, analysis is carried out according to the spatial position association, and the data overlapping property is screened to obtain the multi-mode data association distribution table. According to the method, the multi-mode data integration and the abnormal feature extraction are realized through matching and screening of the time-space record, the meteorological parameters and the equipment state data, the cross analysis of the signal fluctuation and the meteorological conditions is combined, the abnormal signal classification and the path association are optimized, the fault propagation rule is accurately analyzed, the efficiency of the power distribution network abnormal recognition, the fault positioning and the propagation analysis is obviously improved through integral optimization, the operation reliability and the fault processing capability are enhanced, the data redundancy and the error are reduced, and the safety and the stability of a power grid are improved.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for predicting growth of tree species in power transmission corridor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for predicting tree species growth in a power transmission corridor, which belong to the technical field of tree growth prediction and comprise the steps of obtaining tree species data and environment data in the area of the power transmission corridor, and preprocessing the tree species data and the environment data to obtain a training data set; training the cascade recurrent neural network model based on the training data set to obtain a trained cascade recurrent neural network model, predicting the growth trend of tree species according to the trained cascade recurrent neural network model to obtain a prediction result, carrying out error analysis on the prediction result, optimizing the trained cascade recurrent neural network model according to the error analysis result, carrying out growth trend analysis according to the prediction result to determine the growth trend of tree species, and carrying out early warning on the growth trend of tree species according to the prediction result and combining a preset safety threshold. The invention improves the precision of tree species growth prediction through the cascade structure.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent visualization method and system for electric power emergency management
abstract_en: The application relates to an intelligent visualization method and system for power emergency management, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting real-time operation data of a power grid through multi-source data collection equipment, preprocessing the real-time operation data, identifying abnormal events in the power grid, marking time of the abnormal events to obtain preprocessed data, analyzing the preprocessed data through a fault prediction model based on deep learning to generate a prediction result of a fault position, calculating an influence range of fault propagation through power flow analysis based on the fault prediction result, determining an affected area, performing space mapping on the fault position and the affected area to generate a visual power grid fault diagram, displaying power supply conditions of the affected area, generating an emergency response plan based on the fault position and the affected area, and pushing the emergency response plan to a relevant power dispatching and operation maintenance terminal. The application has the effect of improving the accuracy of fault identification.
assignees: SHANDONG DENENG IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid equipment operation and maintenance data safety management system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an operation and maintenance data safety management system of power grid equipment based on artificial intelligence, which relates to the technical field of operation and maintenance safety management of power system equipment, and comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a data element mapping model with credibility marks, S2, carrying out cross dimension logic consistency check according to credibility data, S3, constructing a multi-stage evolution track graph according to consistency check data, S4, screening out conflict evolution paths based on a state graph model, S5, carrying out asynchronous disturbance propagation modeling according to a purification path graph, S6, carrying out nested structure encryption processing based on a disturbance propagation model, S7, carrying out data output and system feedback adjustment according to an encryption data structure, and solving the problem that the equipment state modeling in the prior art lacks a dynamic evolution mechanism and lacks the structural expression capability of a path analysis means by arranging a state evolution vector field modeling module and a multi-dimensional path jump graph construction module.
assignees: BEIJING BEE GONGWU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Output optimization method, system, equipment and medium under complementary scheduling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for optimizing output under complementary scheduling, wherein the method acquires data of cascade hydropower, wind farms and optical electric farms, constructs a graph neural network based on geographic position data, configures weights of edges according to historical power generation data, nodes of the graph neural network represent fans, photovoltaic arrays and hydropower stations at different geographic positions, performs weather prediction according to current short-term weather data based on the constructed graph neural network, constructs an evaluation model based on double-layer Monte Carlo-condition risk, outputs probability density functions of output prediction according to the evaluation model, and performs output optimization. According to the invention, a graph neural network is established to capture the propagation condition of weather elements possibly existing in a non-uniform observation network, comprehensive evaluation of water, wind and light is realized by constructing an evaluation model, and a reference direction for short-term complementary output optimization is given by a probability density function, so that the scheduling effect of complementary optimization is improved.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Wind power large-base energy efficiency collaborative power prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power large-base energy efficiency collaborative power prediction method and system, which are used for solving the problems that a traditional prediction model does not account for the state of a wind turbine, insufficient regional weather coupling and weak cooperativity of multiple stations, constructing a power main band through a self-adaptive bandwidth kernel function, removing abnormal data to generate a reference health data set, aggregating a wind turbine health index based on a power deviation rate, combining a long-period memory neural network to dynamically correct power output, fusing multiple source data, reconstructing a regional wind field through a limit gradient lifting model, embedding a topographic wake characteristic weight into a loss function to optimize and predict, identifying a dominant station through a force complementary coefficient matrix, establishing a propagation chain to realize wide-area association modeling, remarkably improving the state sensing capability of the wind turbine, strengthening regional weather coupling modeling precision, realizing the collaborative prediction of the multiple stations, reflecting the whole available power generation capability of the large-base, effectively improving the power prediction precision, and providing reliable support for power grid dispatching and power markets.
assignees: NANJING GUODIAN NANZI VALMET AUTOMATION CO LTD

title_en: Chemical industry park safety management system and method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The application provides a chemical industry park safety management system and method based on the Internet of things, which are used for generating a dynamic monitoring data set by collecting multi-source monitoring data in a chemical industry park, applying space-time causal constraint to multi-hop connection paths in a device topological graph of the chemical industry park to generate path confidence distribution, constructing entity characteristic embedding of each device in the chemical industry park, determining a time-varying causal association matrix through all entity characteristic embedding and the path confidence distribution, dividing risk device groups with different risk levels, constructing risk propagation tensors of a device risk partition topological network in the chemical industry park through each risk device group, generating dynamic risk vectors through the time-varying causal association matrix and the risk propagation tensors, and early warning safety risks in the chemical industry park based on the dynamic risk vectors. By adopting the scheme of the application, the space-time registration of the multisource monitoring data of the sensing node of the Internet of things can be realized, and the time-varying causal relationship among the devices can be mined to realize dynamic security risk early warning.

title_en: Big data mining method, system, equipment and medium for analysis and prediction of electric power service hot spot event
abstract_en: The invention discloses a big data mining method, a system, equipment and a medium for analysis and prediction of electric power service hot events, which belong to the technical field of electric power customer service and comprise the steps of obtaining customer service data of a plurality of electric power service interaction systems, constructing an electric power service risk comprehensive data set containing customer appeal and service behaviors, carrying out joint analysis of voiceprint features and text semantics on customer interaction contents to generate customer emotion scores of each service event, constructing a dynamic heterogeneous map, analyzing propagation paths of risk events in space-time dimensions by using a graph neural network model to generate risk diffusion prediction results of each service event, calculating comprehensive risk indexes of each service event, generating early warning work orders of corresponding levels when the comprehensive risk indexes exceed preset multi-level thresholds, and triggering message notification to scheduling personnel of corresponding levels according to risk areas and event types indicated by the comprehensive risk indexes. The invention realizes the automation of risk early warning.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Pig farm flow yield early warning method and system integrating space-time diagram network and knowledge enhancement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pig farm flow yield early warning method and system with a fused time-space diagram network and knowledge enhancement, which comprises the steps of connecting a blue ear disease risk knowledge map of each pig farm at each historical moment according to the affiliated organization and geographic position, extracting an inter-field relationship topological diagram reflecting pig farm-organization-city relationship, generating intra-field embedding of event subgraph fusion time weights in each pig farm by utilizing a diagram attention network, learning the inter-field relationship topological diagram and the intra-field embedding by utilizing the diagram attention network again, generating inter-field embedding with space propagation risk, acquiring time sequence trend by inputting a long-short term memory network after splicing the inter-field embedding and the historical abortion rate of each pig farm, respectively predicting abnormal abortion rate risk probability and specific abortion rate value of three time windows in the future, and judging and early warning. According to the method, risk events in and among pig farms are comprehensively considered, so that the dependence relationship of the flow rate at each moment is captured, and the accuracy of pig farm blue ear disease risk early warning is improved.

title_en: Construction safety risk monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of safety monitoring and intelligent early warning, discloses a construction safety risk monitoring method and a construction safety risk monitoring system, and aims to solve the problems of isolation, static state and hysteresis of a traditional construction safety monitoring means. The method comprises the steps of deploying a multi-mode sensing network to collect environment, personnel, equipment and structure data, constructing a risk factor time sequence matrix through space-time alignment and feature normalization, constructing a dynamic association map by combining a risk conduction rule base and a historical case, predicting risk propagation potential energy of each node by utilizing a graph neural network, triggering early warning according to a multi-level threshold value, outputting a conduction path and blocking advice, and linking field equipment to execute a hierarchical inhibition action. The system comprises six modules of sensing deployment, data fusion, map construction, potential energy prediction, early warning decision making and execution linkage. According to the application, through space-time modeling and intelligent deduction, active identification and second-level intervention of a risk link are realized, construction safety is promoted to be converted from passive response to active prevention, and accident probability and loss scale are reduced.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY FIRST GROUP RAILWAY CONSTRUCTION CO LTD;CHINA RAILWAY FIRST GROUP CO

title_en: Real-time risk identification and active safety control method and system for industrial operators
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of industrial safety monitoring, in order to improve the accuracy and efficiency of the safety monitoring technology, the invention provides a real-time risk identification and active safety control method and system for industrial operators, which realize real-time acquisition and edge preprocessing of man-machine-environment data by integrating physiological/environment/equipment multi-mode sensors, the FPN network is utilized to fuse space-time characteristics, an interpretable risk propagation model is built by combining a sample-PC causal inference and GBDT integration algorithm, risk indexes are calculated, three-level early warning is divided, and hierarchical intervention is performed aiming at different risk levels, including local early warning, environment regulation and control, emergency evacuation and multi-department emergency linkage. The closed loop optimization of the intervention strategy is realized through LSTM trend prediction and reinforcement learning dynamic parameter adjustment, the problems of information fracture, response lag and the like of the traditional monitoring system are solved, the risk identification precision and emergency treatment efficiency of a chemical high-risk scene are remarkably improved, and the method is suitable for operation safety control under high-temperature, high-pressure and toxic and harmful environments.
assignees: POWERCHINA CHENGDU ENGINEERING CORP LTD;UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Fault dynamic simulation method and device for hydrogen-electricity mixing combined system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault dynamic simulation method and device of a hydrogen-electricity mixing and combining system, belonging to the technical field of comprehensive energy system simulation, the fault dynamic simulation method utilizes a discretized dynamic power flow model of the hydrogen-mixed natural gas system, a discretized frequency response model of the power system and an electric-gas coupling link model to carry out alternate solution to accurately and low-complexity determine the changes of pressure, flow and gas components in the hydrogen-mixed natural gas system and the frequency response of the power system so as to characterize the fault cross-system propagation caused by the coupling of a gas network and a power network after hydrogen loading. The method can quantitatively represent the running state of the combined system and define the fault propagation mechanism when the mixed hydrogen natural gas pipeline breaks down, is used for guiding the running of the mixed hydrogen-electric combined system of distributed hydrogen-doped/centralized hydrogen-doped, and can improve the safety and reliability of the system.
assignees: UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH;STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Geological disaster risk intelligent pre-judging method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent pre-judging method for geological disaster risk based on deep learning, which relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning, and can automatically perform high-precision alignment and feature extraction on monitoring data with different time-space resolutions such as optical remote sensing, radar measurement, laser point clouds and the like and different physical meanings through a depth feature extraction and attention weighted fusion mechanism to generate unified and information-rich characterization, thereby laying a solid data base for follow-up accurate prediction and overcoming the limitation of data splitting application in the traditional method; by constructing a space-time diagram taking the slope unit as a node and utilizing a concentration mechanism diagram convolution network introducing hydrologic directivity, the model can accurately describe the space propagation process of slope substances moving, accumulating and blocking a river channel along with a converging path under the rainfall condition, and meanwhile, the time sequence module effectively learns the influence of the past hydrologic state on the future evolution trend.

title_en: Multi-source energy linkage heat storage method and system based on gradient heating of large-temperature-difference unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-source energy linkage heat storage method and a system based on cascade heating of a large-temperature-difference unit, which belong to the technical field of central heating and comprehensive energy utilization, and comprise the steps of obtaining a water inlet temperature parameter and an external environment prediction parameter of a heating pipe network to generate load demand characteristics; the method comprises the steps of establishing a dynamic optimization model according to load demand characteristics and acquired energy price time sequence parameters, calculating operation parameters of a multi-stage heating unit group and scheduling parameters of a double-medium heat storage tank through the dynamic optimization model to generate a multi-source scheduling instruction, executing the multi-source scheduling instruction, controlling a self-adaptive valve group to switch heat source paths and linking the double-medium heat storage tank to charge and discharge heat. The invention adopts the operation mode of establishing a dynamic optimization model to cooperatively control the multi-stage heating unit group and the double-medium heat storage tank, can realize the cascade high-efficiency utilization and intelligent economic dispatch of multi-source energy sources, and remarkably improves the economy and the operation stability of the heating system.
assignees: ZHONGKE HUIRONG HEBEI ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Shock wave overpressure field reconstruction method based on physical information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shock wave overpressure field reconstruction method based on physical information, which relates to the technical field of gun firing and comprises the following steps of establishing a multi-scene overpressure experience formula library comprising Henrych formula, M.A. Sadovsky formula and national defense design specification, embedding physical priori knowledge into a neural network for training through a weighted loss function, forming an attention module with channel-space cooperative reinforcement capability by fusing one-dimensional efficient channel attention, extruding an excitation network and reducing dimension CBAM, dividing a forward shock wave field and a post-muzzle wavefront subtask according to shock wave propagation characteristics, realizing regional prediction through dynamic feature routing, optimizing network parameters by adopting a low data quantity training strategy, and outputting overpressure peak field distribution. According to the invention, by constructing a physical data fusion constraint mechanism and an EC-SEAM mixed attention mechanism, the network physical interpretation and the near field mutation feature extraction capability are improved, and the dependence on the annotation data is obviously reduced.

title_en: Intelligent operation and maintenance management platform fault monitoring method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault monitoring method of an intelligent operation and maintenance management platform based on big data, which comprises the steps of constructing a text graph structure based on historical operation and maintenance knowledge data, processing a Laplacian matrix of the text graph structure to obtain node characteristic values, extracting first characteristics in the historical operation and maintenance knowledge data according to the node characteristic values, simulating the propagation process of the first characteristics in a semantic space, constructing an operation and maintenance knowledge graph based on the obtained semantic propagation result, extracting characteristics of the operation and maintenance knowledge data, embedding and fusing the extracted second characteristics with the operation and maintenance knowledge graph, constructing and training a teacher network based on the fusion characteristics, constructing a student network for fault detection and positioning, optimizing the student network based on the trained teacher network, and inputting real-time operation and maintenance knowledge data into the optimized student network to obtain a fault detection type and a positioning result. The method of the invention improves the operation and maintenance management level of the power grid information system.
assignees: STATE GRID HUITONG JINCAI BEIJING INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Deep learning-based attack behavior analysis engine construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep learning-based attack behavior analysis engine construction method and system, and belongs to the technical field of network security of power systems. Firstly, a multi-layer feature extraction module for service semantic decoupling is constructed, deep grammar tree analysis is carried out on an electric power industrial control protocol, and semantic level mapping from network messages to service operation intents is realized by combining a pre-constructed electric power service knowledge graph, so that a three-dimensional feature tensor is generated. Secondly, a dynamic countermeasure training mechanism is designed, a countermeasure network synthesis high-simulation countermeasure sample is generated by adopting Wasserstein which obeys the constraint of power business logic, and the robustness of a detection model is continuously optimized. And finally, establishing a topological-aware graph neural network attack detection model, converting the device connection relation of physical scenes such as a transformer substation into a graph structure, and analyzing an attack propagation chain crossing nodes by utilizing a graph convolutional network. The invention obviously improves the detection precision and response speed of complex attacks such as advanced persistent threats and the like.
assignees: GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Crack identification method and system for airport pavement, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: A crack identification method, system, electronic equipment and medium for airport pavement relate to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-time phase image data and flight operation data of an airport pavement, extracting the multi-time phase image data to obtain crack evolution characteristics of a plurality of areas, calculating load response characteristics of each area, determining load transmission paths and transmission strength between adjacent areas as side weights by taking the crack evolution characteristics as node attributes, generating a damage network structure, determining crack evolution rates of a plurality of damage nodes and evolution coefficients of corresponding areas through the damage network structure, constructing a load-evolution association matrix, screening each damage node, determining target damage nodes, determining propagation paths and influence ranges of the target damage nodes, determining crack propagation trends in a target period, and generating corresponding maintenance reports. By implementing the technical scheme provided by the application, the accuracy of identifying the crack of the airport pavement can be improved.
assignees: BEIJING JINGANG FIELD ROAD ENG CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Power consumption behavior anomaly identification method, system, equipment and medium based on local cascade neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for identifying abnormal electricity consumption behavior based on a local cascade neural network, which belong to the technical field of intelligent power grid abnormality detection and comprise the steps of collecting multi-mode time sequence data of a plurality of monitoring nodes in a power grid, carrying out data preprocessing, dynamically generating a suspected local area based on a real-time electricity consumption coupling relation, inputting an output node set into a first-stage local neural network, carrying out feature extraction and residual calculation, outputting an information packet, inputting the information packet into a second-stage neural network, carrying out time sequence causal discovery and abnormal conduction path research and judgment, calling a corresponding incremental normal mode dictionary based on the output suspected source node, carrying out comparison and output verification conclusion, and carrying out comprehensive research and judgment through a multi-mode evidence fusion decision engine to generate a final structured abnormal report. The invention realizes high-precision, low-delay and interpretable detection and tracing of power consumption abnormality, and particularly shows remarkable robustness and practicability in a high-noise power grid environment.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional cascade multi-network converged communication guarantee system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of communication guarantee, in particular to a multifunctional cascade multi-network fusion communication guarantee system which comprises a central console, a plurality of groups of leakage cable communication lifesaving illumination lines and a plurality of groups of wire coils, wherein one end of the central console is cascaded with the wire coils through the leakage cable communication lifesaving illumination lines, cascade expansion is realized between adjacent wire coils through the leakage cable communication lifesaving illumination lines, the leakage cable communication lifesaving illumination lines are wound on the wire coils, and the leakage cable communication lifesaving illumination lines can be optionally wound and unwound according to actual demands during use. The multifunctional cascade multi-network fusion communication guarantee system solves the problems of communication coverage, multi-service data transmission, guiding illumination, power supply coordination and the like in a closed environment and a complex environment through wired and wireless multi-mode fusion communication, a wide-frequency-band cable leakage transmission technology and an integrated design, improves the fire rescue efficiency and the self safety, guarantees the smooth communication of various devices of firefighters, and achieves no communication.

title_en: Three-dimensional dynamic working condition coupling operation and maintenance management method and system based on power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional dynamic working condition coupling operation and maintenance management method and system based on a power distribution network, which belong to the technical field of intelligent power grid operation and maintenance management and comprise the steps of carrying out space-time synchronization point cloud data acquisition through different devices based on the power distribution network to construct a point cloud data set; the method comprises the steps of performing data thinning on a meteorological-electrical appliance coupling coefficient, extracting and classifying ground points and non-ground points, respectively performing three-dimensional model construction on the classified ground points and non-ground points, performing three-dimensional fault coupling deduction on an output result of the three-dimensional model to obtain a suspected fault point, injecting short-circuit disturbance into the suspected fault point in a simulation platform, and verifying whether a cascading fault path is matched with actual deduction. According to the invention, through the closed loop chain, the meteorological, electrical and mechanical failure chains are deeply coupled, the span from passive overhaul to fault early and accurate intervention of the operation and maintenance of the power distribution network is realized, the galloping/tower-reversing accident rate is obviously reduced through actual measurement, and the operation and maintenance efficiency and the reliability of the power grid are comprehensively improved.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Cross-domain fault prediction method and system based on graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a cross-domain fault prediction method based on a graph neural network, which comprises the steps of obtaining data of an electric power network and a traffic network, constructing graph structure data containing electric power element nodes and traffic element nodes based on the data, inputting the graph structure data into a pre-trained graph neural network model, obtaining predicted fault states of the electric power element nodes and the traffic element nodes through model processing data, and determining a joint fault scene containing the electric power element nodes and the traffic element nodes in the fault states according to the predicted states. The method solves the problem that the cascade faults between the power network and the traffic network cannot be effectively predicted in the prior art, realizes the accurate prediction of the cross-domain cascade faults, improves the recognition capability of large-area concurrent faults, and provides decision support for active disaster prevention and reduction.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: Data security compliance risk assessment system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of digital security assessment and discloses a data security compliance risk assessment system which comprises the steps of automatically retrieving data related to a target industry based on a preset network model, extracting structural risk factors and aging identifications of the data, judging whether index differences exist or not, carrying out semantic alignment and difference comparison on output knowledge segments and local risk indexes, judging whether a credible score of a risk adjustment suggestion exceeds a set threshold value, judging whether an update result identifies a high risk item according to the generated update suggestion, constructing an attack path corresponding to the high risk item based on a multidimensional logic deduction algorithm in a virtualized security event simulation environment, simulating a multi-scene risk propagation process, calculating a comprehensive risk index and outputting a deduction result, and recording the risk propagation path based on the deduction result to form a verified risk knowledge segment and feeding the verified risk knowledge segment back to a security compliance assessment database. The invention has the advantage of improving the accuracy of the evaluation result.
assignees: DONGFANG KOUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban crowd emergency evacuation optimization method and system based on multimode traffic network
abstract_en: The invention provides an urban crowd emergency evacuation optimization method and system based on a multi-mode traffic network, which belong to the technical field of emergency evacuation management, take the total evacuation time and evacuation risk minimization in the whole multi-mode network as optimization targets, consider the coupling characteristics of different traffic modes, establish a multi-mode traffic network dynamic collaborative evacuation model, and decide the dynamic requirements born by each traffic mode, and solve the established multi-mode traffic network dynamic collaborative evacuation model to obtain an optimal regulation strategy. According to the invention, three evacuation traffic modes of private cars, emergency buses and urban rail transit transfer emergency buses are considered, a dynamic multi-mode traffic evacuation model based on a system optimal criterion is established, the dynamic congestion propagation of people in large-scale evacuation is considered, and a decomposition algorithm based on Lagrange relaxation is provided for solving, so that an optimal multi-mode evacuation strategy is obtained, the collaborative optimization of multi-mode evacuation is realized, and the efficiency of urban large-scale crowd evacuation is improved.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG

title_en: Big data management and intelligent evaluation system for air quality of hospital environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent regulation and energy conservation of air quality of a hospital environment, in particular to a big data management and intelligent evaluation system of air quality of the hospital environment, which comprises a multi-mode data acquisition module, a data processing module, a dynamic transmission modeling module, a dynamic Bayesian network risk modeling module, a prospective risk hedging module and an energy consumption optimizing module, wherein the system calculates a dynamic air transmission coefficient by acquiring environment and people flow data and builds a dynamic Bayesian network model to calculate a cross-region propagation risk probability, and the core is that when the risk probability exceeds a threshold value, the system actively solves a multi-objective optimization problem with minimum energy consumption as a target to generate an optimal HVAC control instruction.

title_en: Coal mine fluidization exploitation dynamic disaster prevention and control method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for preventing and controlling dynamic disasters in coal mine fluidization exploitation, and relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and control. The method comprises the steps of establishing a risk map based on multi-field information of a mining area, setting a focus intensity upper limit, a path attenuation target and an energy absorption displacement target, performing in-situ transformation under control index constraint to form a distributed microcrack network, calculating a residual dynamic carrier spectrum to weaken the focus, constructing an artificial barrier and an energy absorption band with abrupt wave impedance change according to the residual dynamic carrier spectrum to realize propagation energy cutting, configuring a flexible energy absorption protection system according to the residual dynamic carrier spectrum and a propagation attenuation coefficient, monitoring microseismic, stress and displacement data in real time, and realizing parameter self-adaptive correction through threshold triggered linkage treatment. The method constructs a source-diameter-field integrated active prevention and control system, realizes dynamic regulation and closed-loop management of the fluidized mining process, and obviously improves the intrinsic safety and the intelligent level of deep mining.

title_en: Power supply and demand prediction method suitable for complex market environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power supply and demand prediction, and discloses a power supply and demand prediction method suitable for a complex market environment. The method comprises the steps of collecting multidimensional real-time data of an electric power market, covering a user side load fluctuation sequence and a market price fluctuation signal, constructing an electric power supply and demand dynamic prediction model based on the data, outputting a theoretical supply demand prediction value, comparing the theoretical prediction value with actual metering electric power data, carrying out multidimensional difference analysis of load sequence deviation response delay to generate a market-level difference coefficient matrix, inputting the matrix into an area energy network analysis model, combining power grid node transmission capacity and economic main body distribution information to generate a supply and demand abnormal propagation path probability distribution map, positioning a potential market imbalance area, starting high frequency data monitoring on the high probability imbalance area according to a probability distribution map self-adaptive configuration prediction regulation strategy, applying policy disturbance test on an associated market main body, and supporting stable operation of the electric power market.
assignees: HANGZHOU QIZHI ENERGY TECH CO LTD;ZHEJIANG QIZHI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ocean drilling safety situation diagnosis and early warning method based on entropy weight Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of marine drilling safety, and discloses a marine drilling safety situation diagnosis and early warning method based on an entropy weight Bayesian network. The method is characterized in that accurate risk assessment is realized through dynamic coupling of an entropy weight method and a Bayesian network. The method comprises the steps of extracting evaluation indexes from a marine drilling accident library and drilling related specification files, outputting a data set through a standardized processing module, generating a dynamic index weight vector through a practical entropy weight method, constructing a Bayesian network topology by combining a Bow-tie model, coupling the weight vector to a non-root node condition probability table through an entropy weight driving type aggregation function, and finally outputting top-level node risk level probability distribution. Meanwhile, an index database containing early warning measures is established, the prior probability of the root node is combined with the historical data and the default probability, the dynamic expansion of the evaluation index is supported, the risk propagation path is visualized through the three-dimensional drilling situation interface, multi-stage early warning is triggered, and the accuracy and timeliness of ocean drilling safety early warning are improved.
assignees: SHANDONG INSTITUTE OF PETROCHEMICAL TECH

title_en: Same-city distribution intelligent order and path planning method and system based on real-time road condition
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for intelligent distribution and path planning in the same city based on real-time road conditions, which relate to the technical field of path planning and comprise the steps of collecting real-time road condition information to construct time-space road network characteristics, calculating transit time cost, constructing order time-space correlation characteristics based on historical tracks, calculating order time-space overlapping degree, dynamically adjusting a clustering algorithm by using association strength, calculating an initial distribution path for clustered order clusters, and carrying out risk assessment and path optimization by a road congestion propagation model. The invention can improve the distribution efficiency, reduce the delay risk and adapt to complex and changeable urban traffic environments.
assignees: SHENZHEN WEIWEI DIGITAL CO LTD

title_en: AI-based power equipment health state prediction system and method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention discloses an AI based system and method for predicting the health status of power equipment, belonging to the field of intelligent operation and maintenance of power equipment. The system includes a data acquisition and preprocessing module, a multimodal deep layered attention fusion module, a health status evaluation and prediction module, and a decision support and linkage module. The present invention innovatively proposes a multimodal deep layered attention fusion architecture, which extracts the temporal characteristics of dissolved gas concentration in oil color spectrum through the bottom layer temporal feature extraction network, associates the temporal and spatial patterns of infrared thermal images and ultrasonic spectra through the middle layer spatiotemporal pattern recognition network, and constructs a device family defect propagation model through the top layer device family relationship network, achieving full dimensional analysis of multimodal data and collaborative perception of device groups; At the same time, establishing information flow paths between different hierarchical networks through cross level information fusion mechanisms improves the comprehensiveness and accuracy of feature extraction.
assignees: QINGDAO HENGXING UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: River flood rapid forecasting method based on physical information neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a river flood rapid forecasting method based on a physical information neural network, and belongs to the field of river flood forecasting. The method comprises the steps of introducing boundary condition parameters as input variables on the basis of a traditional physical information neural network (Physical InformedNeural Network, PINN), so that PINN learns flood wave propagation rules under different boundary conditions. Furthermore, a physical information neural network flood rapid forecasting framework (Physics InformedNeural Networks for Rapid Flood Forecasting, RFF-PINN) integrating a hydrodynamic method is provided on the basis, a numerical solution based on grid dispersion is reconstructed into a continuous function on a time-space domain through a piecewise polynomial interpolation method, residual loss between network output and a hydrodynamic model simulation value is constructed, network parameters are optimized in cooperation with PDE loss, and the problem that network parameter optimization effect is reduced due to the fact that PDE loss in a complex fluid region is difficult to converge is avoided. The method has the beneficial effects that the water depth change process of each section of the river under any boundary condition can be accurately and rapidly predicted.
assignees: UNIV FUZHOU

title_en: Power distribution network graph clustering toughness assessment method for decision-oriented under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to a clustering toughness assessment method of a power distribution network graph guided by decision under typhoon disasters, which relates to the technical field related to power distribution network toughness assessment and fault calculation, and comprises the following steps of firstly, constructing a typhoon-driven power distribution network multi-source coupling progressive fault mechanism model; the method comprises the steps of generating a typical cascading failure scene based on a multidimensional scene subtraction method, modeling a power distribution network based on cascading failure effect, and finally, making a decision-oriented toughness assessment index and assessing the toughness level of the power distribution network under typhoon disasters by using a graph clustering method. The method is simple and feasible, can effectively evaluate the capability of the power distribution network for resisting typhoon disasters, provides scientific decision basis for the operation and maintenance of the power system, thereby improving the toughness of the power distribution network in a targeted manner, and has good operability and wide applicability.
assignees: UNIV NORTHEAST FORESTRY;ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for classifying disaster recovery data of power distribution network in grading mode
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for classifying disaster-relief data of a power distribution network, belonging to the field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting a plurality of pieces of disaster-relief data from the power distribution network and constructing nodes of each piece of disaster-relief data; establishing a plurality of sub-connection sides between two nodes according to the association relation between disaster recovery data corresponding to any two nodes to obtain a knowledge graph, determining the weight of the corresponding sub-connection side according to the association relation, carrying out weighted calculation on the weight of the corresponding sub-connection side between the two nodes through a graph attention mechanism to obtain a first adjacent matrix of the knowledge graph, inputting the first adjacent matrix and embedded representation of each node into a preset graph convolution neural network to carry out feature propagation, and obtaining a classification result corresponding to each label dimension of disaster recovery data corresponding to each node. Therefore, the method and the device can solve the problem of low accuracy of the classification result in the disaster recovery data classification process.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Distribution network fault type identification method, system, equipment and storage medium based on distributed sensing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system fault detection, in particular to a distributed sensing-based power distribution network fault type identification method, a distributed sensing-based power distribution network fault type identification system, distributed sensing-based power distribution network fault type identification equipment and a storage medium. And constructing an IEEE33 node power distribution network simulation model, configuring 33 distributed sensing nodes among the nodes, realizing full-network coverage type acquisition of power distribution network fault information, and comprehensively capturing the complex changes of fault current distribution and propagation paths after the distributed power supply is accessed. The method comprises the steps of constructing a fault feature matrix by extracting effective values, positive sequence, negative sequence and zero sequence components of a voltage and current signal, converting an original electric signal into a feature vector with definite physical meaning, adopting a random forest classifier comprising 120 decision trees, and optimizing parameter configuration by combining grid search, so as to realize intelligent automatic identification of various fault types. The invention can still keep high-precision fault type identification under the complex power distribution network environment of large-scale access of the distributed power supply by establishing a confidence evaluation mechanism and a result post-processing verification system.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Environment risk reasoning method and system based on environment-friendly intelligent management and control platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment risk reasoning method and system based on an environment-friendly intelligent management and control platform, comprising the following steps: and (3) searching historical environment risk examples based on the production attributes of the target industrial park, and extracting the characteristic analysis evolution process to generate a risk evolution characteristic set. And deep mining the cascade relation in the feature set, constructing a risk evolution feature domain and a risk cascade feature domain, and fusing the risk evolution feature domain and the risk cascade feature domain into an environmental risk knowledge graph. And establishing an inference model by utilizing the atlas, and deducing an environmental risk situation through real-time sensor data. And when the risk is identified, calling a preset strategy to perform Monte Carlo intervention simulation and optimize a regulation scheme. And constructing a regulation response network according to equipment layout, and identifying a weak area through efficiency characteristic analysis to generate a network optimization suggestion so as to realize closed-loop optimization of a management and control system. Thereby promoting the environment treatment to be converted from passive response to active prediction and from single-point control to system control, and improving the overall efficiency and the intelligent level of regional environment risk control.
assignees: DACHENG DEXIN TECH SHANXI CO LTD

title_en: Micro-grid group cooperative scheduling method based on master-slave strategy
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system dispatching, in particular to a micro-grid group collaborative dispatching method based on a master-slave strategy, which comprises an upper-layer uncertainty propagation simulator and a plurality of lower-layer local robust optimizers. The upper simulator collects real-time uncertainty source data and network topology, generates a collaboration Lu Bangyu through simulating an uncertainty propagation path, and sends the collaboration Lu Bangyu to the lower layer as a probability constraint. And the lower-layer optimizer executes local cost minimization optimization under constraint and reports the operation point and the uncertainty index. The upper layer calculates the overall collaborative entropy, and expands the robust domain through a feedback mechanism to maximize the benefit if the overall collaborative entropy is lower than the threshold, and reduces the risk if the overall collaborative entropy is higher than the threshold. And the iterative process adjusts domain boundary parameters by using a gradient algorithm until convergence or a scheduling period is finished, so that the micro-grid group robust cooperative scheduling is realized. The invention dynamically maximizes the cooperative operation benefit and the robust potential of the micro-grid group on the premise of ensuring the global stability of the system.

title_en: Landslide body monitoring method based on unmanned aerial vehicle laser radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide body monitoring method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle laser radar, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a bare earth surface point cloud model of a first time phase, S2, constructing a bare earth surface point cloud model of a second time phase, S3, constructing a standard point cloud data set, S4, constructing a multidimensional time sequence feature vector sequence, S5, introducing an ARIMA and neural network fusion prediction model, outputting a prediction sequence of a final landslide body deformation trend, S6, constructing a disaster chain propagation model, outputting a landslide early warning grade according to a preset grading threshold value, and performing real-time early warning information publishing and response linkage. According to the invention, through fusion of laser radar point cloud registration analysis and ARIMA-neural network prediction modeling, high-precision dynamic monitoring and early warning of small deformation of the landslide body are realized, and the method is suitable for landslide early identification and disaster emergency response scenes in complex terrain environments.
assignees: HUBEI COAL GEOLOGICAL AND GEOPHYSICAL SURVEY TEAM

title_en: Water-wind-light complementary scheduling scheme optimization method, system and equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a water-wind-solar complementary scheduling scheme optimization method, a system and equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of defining a multi-dimensional index system for the economy and safety of a reaction scheduling scheme; the method comprises the steps of simulating a disturbance propagation process and influence degree based on a logic association network, calculating the size of each index of a scheduling scheme, inputting a disturbance scene to be simulated into the logic association network, simulating the propagation effect of disturbance in the logic association network based on the topology structure of the logic association network, selecting key indexes, determining the system disturbance risk of the disturbance scene based on the size and change degree of each key index after disturbance propagation, selecting the disturbance scene, calculating the system disturbance risk of each disturbance scene, calculating the comprehensive risk index of each scheduling scheme, sequencing the scheduling schemes and selecting an optimal scheduling scheme. The logic association network provided by the application can reflect the association between indexes, evaluate the linkage influence of disturbance on a plurality of indexes, and minimize the risk caused by disturbance.
assignees: THREE GORGES JINSHA JIANGCHUAN CLOUD HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent verification method for multidimensional scene perception
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent verification method for multi-dimensional scene perception, which comprises the steps of obtaining service data, edge computing environment information and network state information of a power supply station, constructing a multi-dimensional scene feature vector, constructing a meta-confidence coefficient model based on the multi-dimensional scene feature vector by adopting a feature progressive strategy, generating initial confidence coefficient, decision advice and decision context information of an edge computing result based on the meta-confidence coefficient model, receiving cloud verification results, constructing a timing memory module and an error propagation diagram by combining the decision context information, generating a verification feedback optimization instruction and predictive feedback buffer data, updating the meta-confidence coefficient model based on the verification feedback optimization instruction and the predictive feedback buffer data, and executing a final decision by combining the initial confidence coefficient and the decision advice to generate a service execution report. The invention solves the problems of cold start and asynchronous verification inefficiency through a characteristic progressive structure and a predictive feedback buffer mechanism.

title_en: Multi-scale power load prediction method and system based on dynamic graph neural network
abstract_en: The application provides a multiscale power load prediction method and a multiscale power load prediction system based on a dynamic graph neural network, and particularly relates to the technical field of power load prediction. The method comprises the steps of constructing a dynamic association diagram based on a power load sequence and external factor data by nonlinear statistical measurement, dividing a multi-scale view of the power load sequence through significant period detection, inputting a multi-branch encoder to generate multi-scale feature representation, executing mixed neighborhood propagation on the dynamic association diagram to generate space enhancement features, splicing the space enhancement features and the multi-scale feature representation to obtain space-time fusion features, and decoding the space-time fusion features into future power load predicted values. In addition, the key parameters of the multi-branch encoder and the mixed neighborhood propagation are adaptively adjusted by adopting a parameter optimization algorithm. The method solves the problem of precision optimization of dynamic space-time correlation and multi-scale feature collaborative modeling in power load prediction, improves prediction precision and adaptability, and reduces prediction deviation.
assignees: UNIV XIAN SCI & TECHNOLOGY;STATE GRID SHAANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD TRAINING CENTER

title_en: Risk early warning method and system based on power service sensitive event
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk early warning method and system based on an electric power service sensitive event, which belong to the technical field of deep learning and comprise the steps of obtaining customer service voice texts, work order data and weather early warning information, constructing a heterogeneous space-time diagram comprising power distribution equipment and electric power users, inputting the heterogeneous space-time diagram into a graph neural network model to obtain event propagation path probability distribution and potential source nodes, generating an early warning work order based on the event propagation path probability distribution and a preset sensitive word stock, generating a supervision work order according to the early warning work order triggering supervision flow, configuring elink message sending rules, sending elink messages to appointed responsible personnel, feeding back supervision processing results and updating model parameters. The invention realizes the spanning type upgrade from passive disposal to active prevention and control, from experience judgment to data intelligence and from single-point analysis to system management, and has obvious technical advancement, management practicability and engineering popularization value.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Attribution evaluation method for composite extreme climate event of Qinghai-Tibet plateau
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of meteorological monitoring and climate prediction, in particular to a method for attributing and evaluating composite extreme climate events of Tibet plateau; the method comprises the steps of integrating ground observation, remote sensing and analysis data through a multisource data dynamic space-time weight fusion technology to achieve outlier correction and non-uniform interpolation, adopting a multivariate combined extreme index and space-time coupling graph model to identify a composite event and generate a structured label comprising intensity, range, duration and evolution paths, constructing a multiscale causal network analysis driving factor contribution, implementing physical constraint disturbance based on causal weights, recovering high-resolution response through combining a Bayesian agent model with terrain constraint random downsampling, deducing space-time evolution through an event propagation network, and adopting a kernel polynomial mixed uncertainty propagation framework to generate a probabilistic scene set to achieve multilevel risk early warning and dynamic knowledge base optimization. The invention comprehensively improves the attribution precision and the early warning efficiency of the original composite extreme event.
assignees: NAT CLIMATE CENTRE;CHENGDU PLATEAU METEOROLOGICAL INST OF CHINA METEOROLOGICAL ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Urban data fusion event early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of smart city safety and emergency management, and provides a city data fusion event early warning method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a physical environment time sequence data set, a city facility asset data set and an API call behavior log data set; the method comprises the steps of establishing a dynamic digital twin map based on the data set, positioning initial risk trigger nodes based on the dynamic digital twin map and a physical environment time sequence data set, performing graph traversal search to establish a potential risk propagation path set based on a sliding time window abnormality detection mechanism, quantitatively evaluating and generating an early warning event set by adopting a chained probability model, calling a natural language generation function based on a high risk event, matching an optimal emergency plan from an emergency plan knowledge base, and analyzing the optimal emergency plan to generate a scheduling instruction in combination with a natural language early warning message visualization early warning scene. The invention constructs an event early warning and response mechanism oriented to the urban system, and is suitable for intelligent urban early warning emergency management.

title_en: Multi-mode data fusion-based power operation risk identification method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid monitoring, in particular to a power operation risk identification method, a system, equipment and a storage medium based on multi-mode data fusion. Aiming at the problems of multi-mode data fracturing, topology constraint missing and the like in traditional power disturbance analysis, an improved BERT model is constructed, the time-frequency characteristics of electric signals and text semantic information are mapped to a unified vector space through a multi-mode embedding mechanism, a time-dependent relation between the signals and the text is established by adopting a time sequence attention mechanism, risk propagation modeling under the power grid topology constraint is realized by combining a graph attention network, and disturbance classification, risk prediction and trend analysis are cooperatively optimized through a multi-task learning framework. The method effectively solves the technical problems of difficult heterogeneous data fusion and insufficient risk identification precision, realizes accurate identification and intelligent early warning of power operation risks, and improves the safe operation level of the power grid.
assignees: KUNMING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power grid fault mode prediction and plan generation method and system based on self-supervision learning
