abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting a power grid fault mode and generating a plan based on self-supervision learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting real-time operation data and historical data of a power grid by a power grid monitoring system and other sensors and preprocessing the data; the method comprises the steps of automatically identifying a fault mode of a power grid by utilizing historical data and real-time data of the power grid through a self-supervision learning method, predicting fault types, occurrence time, influence areas and propagation trends, and generating an emergency plan based on the prediction results when the self-supervision learning model is generated for the fault emergency plan to complete the prediction of the fault mode of the power grid. The invention realizes the intellectualization and automation of the fault plan by combining the self-supervision learning and the multi-objective optimization algorithm, and can find the optimal balance among a plurality of optimization objectives by the multi-objective optimization algorithm, thereby ensuring the comprehensiveness and the effectiveness of the fault plan.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Power transmission network fault positioning system based on edge agent cooperation decision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission network fault positioning system based on edge agent cooperative decision, and belongs to the technical field of power system fault diagnosis. The system comprises a token relay communication module, a consensus arbitration module and an unknown event cognition module, wherein the token relay communication module is used for carrying out orderly token directional relay transfer among edge intelligent agents according to the physical propagation direction of fault energy wave fronts, the consensus arbitration module is used for diagnosing and arbitrating the health degree of a preliminary positioning conclusion through joint evaluation of decision entropy and physical space correlation so as to inhibit error consensus caused by systematic deviation, and the unknown event cognition module is used for stopping positioning and generating a structured characteristic sketch report when detecting an unknown fault in a semantic gap with a local knowledge stock. The invention fundamentally improves the reliability, robustness and safety of fault location by constructing a complete-flow ordered cooperative mechanism.

title_en: Collaborative management method and system for construction engineering construction based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of building engineering construction, in particular to a collaborative management method and system for building engineering construction based on the Internet of things. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-mode data of a construction site through Internet of things equipment, constructing a construction knowledge graph, selecting a small amount of construction risk-marked data on the multi-mode data as a sample data set to train an initial risk prediction model, generating a cross-mode consistency constraint expansion training set through pseudo tags, dynamically updating the risk prediction model based on a sliding window increment learning method, inputting the construction knowledge graph into a heterogeneous graph neural network to propagate and aggregate characteristics of nodes and edges, identifying a risk causal chain in the construction knowledge graph, virtually intervening based on a causal inference method, calculating intervention probability of risks of subsequent nodes, calculating causal priority of each risk event according to the intervention probability, and retraining the risk prediction model according to feedback of a management platform.
assignees: TANGSHAN CAOFEIDIAN XINCHENG URBAN CONSTRUCTION MAN CO LTD

title_en: Electrical equipment remote monitoring and fault diagnosis system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention provides an electrical equipment remote monitoring and fault diagnosis system based on the Internet of things. According to the invention, a self-adaptive acquisition strategy is adopted through a multi-source heterogeneous sensor network, an edge computing node calculates a signal entropy value in real time, when abnormal chaotic signals are found, acquisition frequency is automatically improved, beidou grid code space labeling is started, a power frequency interference and environmental noise are separated by combining an attention mechanism of an LSTM-CNN hybrid network, a standardized vector is output, the problem that a traditional filtering algorithm is easy to lose fault characteristics is solved, a cloud server builds a device component fault graph model through a graph neural network, an improved message transfer algorithm is utilized to analyze node coupling relations, a device three-dimensional model and a signal propagation path reverse thrust algorithm are combined, accurate positioning of hidden faults such as transformer winding turn-to-turn short circuits is realized, a digital twin dynamic mapping device real-time state is realized, a maintenance knowledge graph generates three-dimensional visual maintenance guide based on monitoring evidence, and maintenance decision efficiency is remarkably improved.
assignees: BENGANG STEEL PLATES CO LTD

title_en: House security level prediction method and system based on Bayesian network
abstract_en: A house security level prediction method and system based on a Bayesian network relate to the technical field of house security assessment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining structural feature parameters, environment influence factors and historical state information of a target house, carrying out three-level quantification processing on the structural feature parameters to obtain a structural evaluation matrix, constructing a dynamic attenuation function based on the environment influence factors to calculate dynamic attenuation weights, generating historical state indexes based on the historical state information through a multidimensional feature fusion technology, calculating structural redundancy as hidden variables based on the structural evaluation matrix, the dynamic attenuation weights and the historical state indexes, constructing a three-layer Bayesian network, carrying out probability propagation calculation through a Bayesian network inference engine, and determining the house security level of the target house according to probability distribution of an output layer. By implementing the technical scheme provided by the application, the actual security level of the house can be accurately estimated and predicted.
assignees: SICHUAN WATER CONSERVANCY VOCATIONAL COLLEGE;CHENGDU JINMAO TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid knowledge graph generation method and device, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid knowledge graph generation method, a device, terminal equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the field of knowledge graphs. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a power grid node entity set, a power grid node relation set and power grid topological structure data, constructing a message transmission mechanism, carrying out path search by taking an abnormal detection point as a starting point according to a current fault propagation node and the message transmission mechanism to generate a fault prediction path set, taking the current fault propagation node as the power grid node entity set during first search, constructing a target path selection function for the fault prediction nodes in the fault prediction path set according to a preset power grid node weight matrix and a characteristic vector of each power grid node, and updating the current fault propagation node by taking a fusion function constructed by a semantic score function and the target path selection function as a target at maximum, and generating a power grid knowledge map when a preset loss function value converges. By implementing the method and the device, the problem of low accuracy of knowledge graph generation in the prior art is solved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD;GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Real-time power grid topology analysis method based on graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a real-time power grid topology analysis method based on a graph neural network, which comprises the steps of firstly, carrying out electric topology analysis by constructing an optimized power system physical connection model and combining a Label Propagation Algorithm (LPA) at a substation level, accurately identifying a calculation region, and simultaneously, optimizing the calculation region division by utilizing the Graph Neural Network (GNN), enhancing the topology adaptability, reducing the false division and improving the robustness of the equipment state change. In addition, the method further improves the instantaneity, the accuracy and the intelligent level of the power grid topology analysis by predicting the influence of the state change of the circuit breaker and the disconnecting switch on the power grid topology and training the GNN model and the Reinforcement Learning (RL) optimization region division strategy through historical data. Finally, bus-branch connection is optimized through depth-first search (DFS), topology integrity is ensured, and efficiency of electric island analysis, power supply area division and fault recovery is remarkably improved. The method effectively improves the instantaneity, the accuracy and the intelligent level of the power grid topology analysis.
assignees: NANJING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Order information pushing method, equipment and medium based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses an order information pushing method, equipment and medium based on big data analysis, which relate to the technical field of big data analysis and intelligent decision intersection, and comprise the steps of collecting an order bright data stream and a dark data source for preprocessing, extracting global features and generating a federal feature vector matrix; the method comprises the steps of calculating an order comprehensive risk according to a dynamic side weight matrix, generating an order risk knowledge graph, executing a mixed decision engine on the order risk knowledge graph, generating a decision instruction set, performing hierarchical response on an order based on the decision instruction set, outputting a pushing execution log, collecting a performance monitoring ternary data set in real time according to the pushing execution log, calculating order comprehensive benefit according to the performance monitoring ternary data set, and generating an order information pushing report. According to the method, dynamic decision reasoning based on map topology is realized, the risk propagation path is analyzed by combining the map neural network and the rule engine, the response strategy generation is optimized, and the decision self-adaptability and the real-time response efficiency are enhanced.
assignees: CHENGCHENG ZHISHU TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Coal dust explosion risk early warning system and method for underground coal mine area
abstract_en: The invention relates to a coal dust explosion risk early warning system and method for an underground coal mine area, and belongs to the technical field of underground coal mine safety production. The invention solves the problems of insufficient real-time performance, limited monitoring range, high false alarm rate and incapability of dynamically evaluating risks of the traditional coal dust explosion early warning. The technical scheme includes that the real-time data acquisition module acquires dynamic data of an underground sensor through an industrial ring network, the database stores dynamic data and static index data of coal dust, the monitoring point coal dust explosion risk analysis module calculates a risk value by using a back propagation neural network, the regional coal dust explosion risk analysis module synthesizes the monitoring point risk value in a region and corrects the monitoring point risk value by using a spark monitoring condition, and the coal dust explosion risk early warning display module visualizes early warning results. The method has the technical effects of realizing comprehensive dynamic risk assessment of the underground environment, providing regional comprehensive early warning capability, enhancing intelligent analysis accuracy, reducing false alarm rate, improving safety response efficiency, optimizing dust treatment strategies and remarkably improving safety and reliability of coal mine production.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Emerging load power supply potential improving method based on dynamic prediction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system dispatching, in particular to a dynamic prediction-based emerging load power supply potential improving method, which comprises the steps of obtaining emerging load power consumption, meteorological environment and power grid schedulable resource data of a target area through an Internet of things sensing terminal, predicting a load curve through a double-channel modeling by using a deep space-time network, establishing a model to quantify resource regulation potential, according to load fluctuation and resource evaluation results, a scheduling priority list and a capacity allocation strategy are generated by means of a matching rule base, actual scheduling effects are fed back to a prediction model, and a closed-loop optimization link is formed through error back propagation correction parameters.
assignees: SHANDONG GUOYAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Artificial intelligence intelligent park multisource data monitoring and analyzing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent park data monitoring and discloses an artificial intelligence multi-source data monitoring and analyzing method for an intelligent park. The method comprises the steps of constructing a park operation state basic model, extracting data dynamic change characteristics by utilizing a space-time data fusion technology when the model is abnormal, identifying a specific region abnormal event mode by combining deep belief network deep analysis, calculating data complexity by using permutation entropy, optimizing and analyzing an abnormal propagation path by combining an A star algorithm, evaluating a diffusion range and an influence path, identifying a comprehensive risk region according to the data, analyzing the regional environment and equipment state characteristics by utilizing a multispectral imaging technology, evaluating the operation abnormality by combining real-time multisource data, and executing accurate intervention on the comprehensive risk region according to the abnormal condition. The method realizes effective integration and analysis of multi-source data of the intelligent park, accurately identifies abnormality and grasps risk, provides scientific means for park management, and ensures stable and efficient operation of the park.

title_en: Power grid safety emergency early warning method and system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid safety emergency early warning method and system based on multi-source data fusion, which relate to the technical field of power grid public opinion monitoring, the invention screens out each public opinion transmission node of each power construction area by setting the netizen inclusion degree and the public opinion influence level of each power construction area, monitors and evaluates the transmission influence condition of each public opinion transmission node to obtain the public opinion monitoring result of each power construction area, and executing a corresponding public opinion safety emergency early warning scheme, accurately locking key nodes, avoiding the resource waste of generalized monitoring, improving the monitoring efficiency, and tracking the emotion change track of the netizens generating interactive behaviors in public opinion propagation according to the public opinion guiding effect, so as to judge the actual condition of public opinion guiding, effectively identify potential public opinion risks, and make a response strategy with strong pertinence and high efficiency when public opinion occurs, thereby effectively maintaining enterprise images.
assignees: LIAONING POWER ENERGY DEV GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Mathematical description method of cascade reservoir group joint scheduling system based on complex network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mathematical description method of a cascade reservoir group joint scheduling system based on a complex network, which comprises the following steps of step 1, determining network types, step 2, defining nodes of the cascade reservoir group complex network, step 3, defining edges of the cascade reservoir group complex network, step 4, defining an adjacency matrix A of the cascade reservoir group complex network, step 5, defining node attributes of the cascade reservoir group complex network and constraint sets thereof, step 6, defining natural running water as input variables of the reservoir group system, step 7, describing hydraulic coupling relations among the cascade reservoirs, step 8, describing a state transfer equation among the cascade reservoirs, and the method can more comprehensively capture the interrelationships among reservoirs, intuitively embody the network properties among the reservoirs in the cascade reservoir group joint scheduling system, provide more analysis angles for reservoir optimal scheduling and provide a mathematical description method of the system for reservoir group complex network analysis.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Market bidding method and system for adjusting capacity of cloud-edge cooperative charging station
abstract_en: The invention relates to a market bidding method and a system for adjusting capacity of a cloud-edge cooperative charging station, and belongs to the technical field of interaction between a charging station and a power grid. The method comprises the steps of establishing an optimization model for adjusting capacity and participating in market bidding on the basis of a view angle of an edge electric vehicle charging station, establishing an electric power system market clearing model based on a view angle of a cloud electric power system to reduce economic cost for acquiring various services, forming cloud-edge collaborative optimization problems by the charging station model and the electric power system model, respectively introducing Lagrange penalty items into the cloud-edge distributed optimization model and the edge distributed optimization model, and carrying out distributed solving on the cloud-edge collaborative optimization problems by utilizing a target cascading method to obtain a vehicle network interaction strategy optimal for each of the charging station and the electric power system. The invention effectively reduces the economic cost of the power system for obtaining energy, regulating capacity and other services, and takes into account the benefits of both the charging station and the power system, thereby promoting the further development of vehicle network interaction.
assignees: CHENGDE POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY LTD

title_en: Hidden power outage space-time trajectory inversion method for waveform characteristic transfer learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hidden power outage space-time trajectory inversion method for waveform characteristic transfer learning, and relates to the technical field of power distribution network fault analysis. The method comprises the steps of collecting three-phase voltage and current waveform data before and after a fault, conducting filtering and noise reduction processing, extracting a plurality of transient characteristics to construct feature vectors, mapping the characteristics to power grid topological nodes through an attention mechanism, establishing a power failure risk probability model, conducting space-time propagation on the power grid topology by using a graph convolution network with initial risk probability as input to obtain a node dynamic risk probability matrix, generating a space-time power failure track set through threshold judgment, finally exporting the track to a GIS platform, and adjusting a visual mark according to the number of users. The invention breaks through the dependence of the switch signal, realizes the dynamic tracking and track inversion of the hidden power failure, and effectively improves the rush-repair efficiency and the power supply reliability of the power distribution network.
assignees: HONGHE POWER SUPPLY BUREAU YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Multi-scale photovoltaic power prediction method and system integrating numerical weather forecast and physical information neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-scale photovoltaic power prediction method and a system integrating numerical weather prediction and physical information neural network, which relate to the technical field of photovoltaic power prediction, and the invention realizes rolling prediction of future meteorological parameters and horizontal radiation intensity through numerical weather prediction, combines quantile mapping and cascade correction of a time sequence mode attention neural network, and effectively improves the authenticity and stability of meteorological data; and then, through the combined modeling of the physical information neural network and the time sequence characteristic network, the weather and radiation data subjected to multi-level correction and conversion are deeply fused with the physical rule of the photovoltaic system, so that the high-precision prediction of the photovoltaic power is realized. The whole prediction flow has the automatic abnormal rejection and missing compensation capabilities, not only enhances the prediction robustness under complex weather conditions and extreme environments, but also optimizes the time sequence response and physical consistency of the photovoltaic power, thereby greatly improving the engineering applicability and the intelligent level of the system.
assignees: UNIV NINGXIA;INST ATMOSPHERIC PHYSICS CAS

title_en: Lightning stroke fault prediction protection method and system for primary equipment of new energy power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lightning stroke fault prediction protection method and system for primary equipment of a new energy power system, wherein the method comprises the following steps of constructing a monitoring network to obtain cloud/ground flash data, meteorological data and equipment parameters; the lightning stroke transient simulation method comprises the steps of constructing a lightning stroke space-time distribution prediction model, generating a regional lightning stroke probability thermodynamic diagram based on cloud/ground flash data and meteorological data, constructing a fusion model, receiving the regional lightning stroke probability thermodynamic diagram, equipment parameters and historical fault data, generating lightning stroke risk grades of each primary equipment, determining high-risk equipment according to a set threshold value, constructing a digital twin lightning stroke transient simulation model, calculating to obtain an overvoltage propagation path and identifying an insulation weak point, and generating an optimized lightning arrester configuration scheme through a multi-target genetic algorithm model. The prediction precision and the protection efficiency of the lightning stroke faults of the new energy power system are improved.
assignees: HUANENG QINBEI POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Cascading failure accident chain generation method considering second-level safety and stability standard of power system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system cascading failure accident chain generation, and discloses a cascading failure accident chain generation method considering a second-level safety and stability standard of a power system, which comprises the steps of constructing a network model, calculating network indexes, and constructing an initial fault set by arranging circuit vulnerability indexes through objective and subjective comprehensive assignment of the indexes; and checking whether the second-stage safety, stability and control measures are triggered and corresponding countermeasures are carried out until all data of the initial fault set are deduced. According to the method, the coupling mechanism of the second-stage safety and stability measures and fault propagation of the power system is dynamically deduced, an accident chain set considering the second-stage stability control measures and cascading fault evolution characteristics is generated, and simulation support is provided for constructing a power grid safety risk knowledge graph and optimizing a power grid defense system.
assignees: UNIV NANJING POSTS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS

title_en: Power failure event digital management method and system for important users
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for digitally managing a blackout event, which comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining basic user data, constructing a power user knowledge graph, S2, training a user importance scoring model, applying a clustering algorithm to carry out user automatic grading, constructing a user digital twin model, S3, constructing a device data acquisition network, S4, identifying potential faults based on a time sequence prediction model according to device data acquired by the device data acquisition network, S5, constructing a blackout propagation model based on a graph neural network, predicting a fault propagation path according to the potential faults identified by the time sequence prediction model, combining the user digital twin model, realizing real-time state digital twin of a power grid, visually displaying the health state of the power grid, and S6, customizing and generating risk early warning for different levels of important users according to the predicted fault propagation path. The invention not only improves the intelligent level of power failure management, but also obviously improves the power supply reliability of important users.
assignees: MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Enterprise risk early warning method and system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of data management, in particular to an enterprise risk early warning method and system based on multi-source data fusion. The method comprises the steps of receiving an internal document and a knowledge base, extracting an enterprise data set, constructing a dynamic knowledge graph, executing multi-layer iterative message transmission based on a double-layer attention mechanism in an influence propagation model based on a space-time diagram neural network, generating a health state vector, inputting the health state vector into a multi-task decoding framework, purifying the characteristics of each risk task through an opposite unbiasing network, generating a risk specific vector, enabling the risk specific vector to pass through a plurality of task unbiasing terminals to obtain a risk estimated value, and updating the influence propagation model through a collision resolution optimizer based on gradient projection by the difference value of the risk estimated value and real loss. According to the invention, the systematic risk exposure is quantified through a double-layer attention mechanism, and the pseudo-correlation interference in the multi-source data is reduced through the antagonism unbiased network.
assignees: SUZHOU ZHONGLU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital power grid supply chain security risk assessment method, system, equipment and medium based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital power grid supply chain security risk assessment method, system, equipment and medium based on artificial intelligence, which belong to the technical field of power security and comprise the steps of acquiring open source component dependency relationship data of a digital power grid system and constructing an initial dependency graph; calculating confidence scores of all the dependency edges in the initial dependency graph, determining a noise filtering threshold value to generate a filtered dependency graph, carrying out propagation calculation on component risks based on the filtered dependency graph by adopting a graph neural network, outputting risk propagation values of all the components, respectively extracting code feature vectors, safety feature vectors and power industry context feature vectors of all the components, fusing the code feature vectors, the safety feature vectors and the power industry context feature vectors to generate component comprehensive risk vectors, and determining risk ratings of all the components according to the risk propagation values and the component comprehensive risk vectors. The invention improves the accuracy and reliability of the safety risk identification of the digital power grid open source software supply chain.
assignees: GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Disease and pest control management system and method for tree breeding
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disease and pest control management system and method for tree breeding, and relates to the technical field of tree breeding and seedling raising, wherein the method is characterized by collecting environment data and soil rhizosphere data by collecting multi-mode images of leaves and trunks of pinus massoniana young forests and video of leaf gnawing and clustered diffusion of pinus massoniana; the method comprises the steps of constructing a disease and pest identification model by utilizing a convolutional neural network, carrying out definite diagnosis on pine wood nematode diseases, masson pine caterpillars and monochamus alternatus, quantifying the occurrence area and the pest port density of each subarea, calculating the control demand index of the pine wood nematode diseases, comparing the control demand index with a threshold value, triggering corresponding control strategies, calculating the diffusion coefficient of the masson pine caterpillars, comparing the diffusion coefficient with a risk threshold value, formulating a control scheme, calculating the propagation coefficient of the monochamus alternatus, judging the propagation risk and giving the control strategies, and realizing the intelligent identification of the disease and pest, the quantification of the risk and the closed-loop control of the control strategies, thereby being beneficial to the control and scientific control and improving the disease and pest control efficiency and the forest stand health level of the masson pine young forest.
assignees: SICHUAN FORESTRY AND GRASSLAND INVESTIG AND PLANNING INSTITUTE SICHUAN FORESTRY AND GRASSLAND ECOLOG

title_en: Risk knowledge graph construction and intelligent early warning method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence-based risk knowledge graph construction and intelligent early warning method which comprises the following steps of collecting multisource risk related data and preprocessing the multisource risk related data to generate a composite input data set, constructing an enhanced TabPFN structure and introducing a risk logic rule constraint matrix to generate a risk prediction result set, mapping the risk prediction result set to a knowledge graph entity node and a relationship set to generate a risk knowledge graph structure, introducing Sheaf Neural Networks into the risk knowledge graph structure to generate a consistency parameter set, updating the knowledge graph structure to generate a risk knowledge graph enhanced representation, and executing reasoning by combining the risk prediction result set and the consistency parameter set to output an intelligent early warning result set. According to the invention, the form data modeling and graph consistency propagation are fused, so that the risk prediction accuracy and the early warning reliability are improved.

title_en: Multi-node cooperative electric vehicle charging station insurance policy optimization method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a multi-node cooperative electric vehicle charging station insurance policy optimization method and system, belonging to the technical field of electric vehicle charging station insurance policy optimization, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring heterogeneous data from a charging station local sensor, a power grid API and a user terminal application in real time, processing the heterogeneous data and generating a standardized data set; based on standardized data, generating a premium adjustment parameter and a load shunt strategy parameter by utilizing a pre-constructed multi-node reinforcement learning model, wherein each charging station is used as an independent intelligent body to realize global strategy synchronization through a federal learning mechanism, dynamically calculating premium by combining a real-time risk assessment model, generating a premium adjustment parameter and generating a final premium by utilizing the premium dynamically calculated by the multi-node reinforcement learning model, predicting a fault propagation path through a space-time diagram neural network, and iteratively updating the premium adjustment parameter and the load shunt strategy parameter under cascade risk constraint by adopting a multi-objective optimization algorithm.
assignees: SHANDONG UNIV OF FINANCE AND ECONOMICS

title_en: Hydropower station equipment operation and maintenance risk assessment method and system based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydroelectric power generation equipment state monitoring, in particular to a hydropower station equipment operation and maintenance risk assessment method and system based on big data analysis, comprising the following steps of 1, hydropower station specific data fusion acquisition; the method comprises the steps of step 2 of extracting hydraulic-mechanical coupling characteristics, step 3 of dynamically constructing a fault propagation network, step 4 of generating a dynamic risk field and outputting a decision, wherein the step 4 is to inject coupling factors and wet pollution indexes into network nodes of equipment, generate risk density distribution through three-dimensional spatial interpolation, dynamically adjust risk threshold values in combination with real-time working conditions, and output a priority maintenance node and a maximum maintenance time window under constraint conditions. The hydraulic-mechanical coupling failure mechanism is deeply analyzed, the risk conduction path of the equipment cluster is quantized, and dynamic risk assessment is realized by combining a big data analysis technology, so that the accuracy, the instantaneity and the efficiency of the operation and maintenance of the hydropower station equipment are remarkably improved.
assignees: SICHUAN HUANENG DONGXIGUAN HYDROPOWER CO LTD

title_en: Water pump controller parameter self-adaptive adjustment control method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent control of water pumps and discloses a water pump controller parameter self-adaptive adjustment control method and a system, wherein the water pump controller parameter self-adaptive adjustment control method comprises the steps of acquiring weather early warning data, pressure pulsation signals of all pump stations and pipe network topology data, and generating a time-space synchronous disaster monitoring data set through a data fusion algorithm; the method comprises the steps of inputting a disaster monitoring data set into a deep space-time diagram neural network, outputting a pipe network damage probability distribution diagram, generating a pulsation propagation prediction model comprising propagation delay and attenuation coefficients based on a fluid dynamics equation and the pipe network damage probability distribution diagram, calculating a PID controller parameter cooperative regulation scheme of each pump station by minimizing an objective function comprising pressure deviation, flow fluctuation and parameter regulation quantity, and acquiring system response data in real time to realize self-adaptive optimization of a control strategy. The invention realizes the stable operation of the water supply system under the disaster condition.

title_en: Method for designing optimization of supply chain resilience considering risk propagation effect
title_ko: 위험 확산효과를 고려한 공급망 회복탄력성 최적화 설계방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 위험 확산효과를 고려한 공급망 회복탄력성 최적화 설계방법에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 공급망의 붕괴와 같이 개별 노드에서 발생한 위험이 네트워크 상에서 확산되는 상황을 반영하여, 공급망의 회복탄력성에 높은 영향을 미치는 핵심 노드(critical node)를 식별하고 식별된 핵심 노드에 대한 관리방안, 개선방안 및 위기대응 역량개선방안을 도출함으로써, 공급망의 효율성을 증대하고 지속가능한 공급망(sustainable supply network)을 구축할 수 있는, 확산효과를 고려한 공급망 회복탄력성 최적화 설계방법에 관한 것이다.
assignees: UNIV HANNAM INST IND ACAD COOP

title_en: Method for estimating shock wave generation points in water pipeline network
title_ko: 상수도 관망 충격파 발생 지점 추정방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 상수도 관망 충격파 발생 지점 추정방법에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명에 따른 방법은, (a)복수의 상수도관이 연결되어 있는 상수도 관망을 복수의 블럭으로 구획하고, 블럭 내 상수도관의 위치정보와 블럭 내 상수도관에 설치된 복수의 압력센서의 위치정보를 파악하는 단계; (b)블럭 내 상수도관의 특정 지점에서 충격파를 발생시키고 상수도관을 따라 전파된 충격파가 압력센서들에 수신된 시간 및 압력값을 계측하는 테스트 단계; (c)X축은 충격파를 발생시킨 지점으로부터 각 압력센서까지의 시간, Y축은 압력센서에서 계측된 압력값으로 하는 XY 평면에 계측값을 플로팅하고, 충격파 발생 지점으로부터의 시간에 따른 압력값에 대한 기본감쇠그래프를 형성하는 단계; (d)블럭 내에서 충격파가 발생하여 복수의 압력센서에서 충격파를 순차적으로 수신하면, X축은 복수의 압력센서에서 충격파를 수신한 전파시간, Y축은 압력센서에서 계측된 압력값으로 하는 이벤트감쇠그래프를 형성하는 단계; (e)기본감쇠그래프에서 이벤트감쇠그래프의 형태와 대응되는 대응영역을 결정하는 단계; (f)기본감쇠그래프의 대응영역을 이용하여 충격파 원점까지의 거리를 추정하는 단계; 및 (e)대응영역 내에 포함된 압력센서들로부터  충격파 원점까지의 거리를 이용하여 충격파가 발생한 발생지점을 추정하는 단계;를 구비하는 것에 특징이 있다.
assignees: HS CMT CO LTD

title_en: Comprehensive intelligent management platform for mulberry field
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive intelligent management platform for a mulberry field. The platform gathers data such as job progress, resource consumption, quality detection, weather and the like, dynamically adjusts weight parameters according to the growth stage and the external environment, and completes risk classification. And by constructing the operation cooperation network, identifying the central node and the fragile link, carrying out negative event propagation deduction, and realizing real-time hierarchical early warning by combining a rule engine. The system comprises an edge gateway and a scheduling unit, supports breakpoint continuous transmission and automatic generation of a treatment scheme, forms an evaluation-early warning-scheduling-feedback closed loop, and is suitable for mulberry fields of different scales.
assignees: SICHUAN ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES SPECIAL ECONOMIC AND PLANT RES INSTITUTE OF SICHUAN ACADEMY;NANCHONG SHENGRUI AGRICULTURE CO LTD;SICHUAN NANCHONG TAOYUAN BIOCHEMICAL RES AND DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Urban toughness assessment method based on multidimensional data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city toughness assessment method based on multidimensional data analysis, which relates to the technical field of city toughness assessment, and the method comprises the steps of integrating geographic information and multisource heterogeneous data of an Internet of things sensor, and constructing a city subsystem network diagram through standardization and vectorization; the method comprises the steps of utilizing a graph neural network to learn the dependency relationship among nodes, generating a quantized interaction matrix, identifying high-risk links and weak points, dynamically updating interaction strength by combining real-time sensor data and an attention mechanism, simulating a crisis propagation path, calculating a system toughness score, and finally generating a city toughness diagnosis report through a visualization tool. The method and the system realize effective fusion of the multi-source data and quantitative analysis of interaction among subsystems, and improve accuracy and instantaneity of urban toughness assessment.
assignees: NINGXIA HUI AUTONOMOUS REGION BASIC GEOLOGICAL SURVEY INST NINGXIA HUI AUTONOMOUS REGION GEOLOGICAL

title_en: Centralized and distributed power-subway coupling network modeling and vulnerability assessment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban infrastructure safety evaluation and discloses a centralized and decentralized power-subway coupling network modeling and vulnerability evaluation method, which comprises the following steps of system physical modeling, namely respectively constructing a physical model of an urban power grid, a subway network and a traction power grid with centralized and decentralized modes; the method comprises a step of cross-layer coupling dependency relationship definition, a step of cascade fault propagation process simulation, a step of comprehensive vulnerability quantitative evaluation and a step of comprehensive vulnerability quantitative evaluation, wherein the step of cross-layer coupling dependency relationship definition is to differentially define functional dependency relationships among networks according to a power supply mode of a traction power grid to form a unified coupling model, the step of cascade fault propagation process simulation is to simulate cascade propagation of an initial fault in the coupling network and calculate out total cut load quantity of an urban power grid, and the step of comprehensive vulnerability quantitative evaluation is to combine the total cut load quantity with accessibility loss of a subway network and calculate out a comprehensive vulnerability index. According to the method, the power supply modes are distinguished, and the comprehensive index containing the accessibility loss is introduced, so that the accuracy and the comprehensiveness of vulnerability assessment of the power-subway coupling network are improved.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Wave matrix-based cascading super-surface electromagnetic transmission modeling and analysis method and cascading super-surface
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascading super-surface electromagnetic transmission modeling and analyzing method based on a wave matrix and a cascading super-surface, belonging to the technical field of high-frequency communication and artificial electromagnetic super-surface, wherein the method takes the wave matrix theory as a core, a cascading structure comprises a medium baffle plate and n thin sheet admittance layers, the total electric field is the sum of the forward and reverse propagation fields, a magnetic field expression is obtained by combining a 90-degree rotation matrix, a four-port network is equivalent, a wave matrix and a scattering and transmission matrix are associated, a total wave matrix is obtained by combining each layer of wave matrix, an isolation medium is introduced for correction, and parameters are solved to complete modeling. The cascading super-surface electromagnetic transmission modeling and analyzing method based on the wave matrix and the cascading super-surface can form a cross-building surface signal enhancement system frame, improve the transmission efficiency of electromagnetic waves penetrating through the glass curtain wall, reduce the deployment maintenance cost, further endow the super-surface with mechanical adaptability, enhance the compatibility with the glass curtain wall and support large-scale deployment of complex scenes.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI

title_en: Construction method and system for double-layer robust optimal scheduling strategy of wind, light and water storage
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for constructing a double-layer robust optimal scheduling strategy of wind, solar and water storage, and relates to the technical field of energy management, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly acquiring multi-source data of a wind power plant, a photovoltaic power station and a cascade hydropower station; the method comprises the steps of carrying out feature extraction and integrated prediction based on multi-source data to generate a wind-solar power prediction result, further combining hydrodynamic coupling modeling analysis to obtain a hydropower station power generation capacity and adjustable water quantity sequence, constructing a multi-layer energy coupling diagram and carrying out spectral domain structure optimization to form a power coupling network representing space-time association and ecological sensitivity of a system, and finally adopting double-layer distributed robust optimization to synchronously optimize economic targets and ecological risk constraints to generate a collaborative scheduling strategy. The invention effectively solves the problem of time sequence matching between wind-light fluctuation and water-electricity time stagnation, improves the renewable energy source digestion capacity and the water resource utilization efficiency, and reduces the ecological operation risk.
assignees: UNIV XICHANG

title_en: Narrow-band ad hoc network multi-hop link optimization deployment method integrating three-dimensional propagation modeling
abstract_en: A narrow-band ad hoc network multi-hop link optimization deployment method integrating three-dimensional propagation modeling comprises the steps of constructing a three-dimensional space visual view of a deployment area, constructing a direction topological graph based on deployed narrow-band ad hoc network base station equipment, carrying out propagation path type division and propagation path loss estimation on each node in the direction topological graph based on the three-dimensional space visual view, acquiring estimated path loss from each node to a target point, judging whether an effective overlapping area exists between each node in the direction topological graph, acquiring points to be deployed based on the estimated path loss if the effective overlapping area exists, determining the range of the points to be deployed, narrow-band ad hoc network constraint and fitness function if the effective overlapping area does not exist, outputting an optimal multi-hop link deployment scheme, carrying out deployment based on the optimal multi-hop link deployment scheme, carrying out link deployment dynamic adjustment according to monitoring results, obviously improving the estimated propagation loss accuracy, and adapting diversified scene requirements.
assignees: SHANGHAI ICOM COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Risk propagation probability learning method among nodes in supply chain network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk propagation probability learning method among nodes in a supply chain network, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a scoring function L (W) related to risk propagation probability based on final running state data of a provider and a structure of a risk propagation relationship, then randomly initializing a value of the risk propagation probability W in a given interval, then calculating a derivative of the scoring function L (W) and determining a learning rate, and carrying out repeated iteration update on the risk propagation probability W by using the learning rate of the calculated derivative until the maximum iteration number is reached or convergence conditions are met. The invention can learn to obtain the risk propagation probability between nodes in the supply chain network based on the final operation state data of the suppliers and the structure of the risk propagation relationship.
assignees: TECH TRAINING CENTER OF STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Nuclear accident risk propagation model based on three-layer coupling network
abstract_en: The nuclear accident risk propagation model based on the three-layer coupling network comprises a three-layer coupling network model and a risk propagation dynamics model, wherein the three-layer coupling network model comprises an RMN layer based on a dynamic Gaussian plume model, an IN layer based on coupling of a traffic network and a communication network and an EN layer comprising four types of nodes, a coupling mechanism comprises an overrun of radiation dose rate IN a grid of the RMN layer, marking of damaged states by nodes at the same position of the IN layer, quantification of two-way dependency density of the IN layer and the EN layer through coupling strength epsilon, and the risk propagation dynamics model adopts a Caputo fractional derivative to construct a risk propagation dynamics model, and comprises a tri-state migration dynamics equation and the dynamic Gaussian plume model. The invention constructs a dynamic interaction system of a physical field-topological network-decision chain, quantifies the function dependency relationship of nodes by using a complex network theory, and describes the memory effect and the critical threshold of risk propagation based on a risk propagation dynamics model.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH CHINA

title_en: Cascade hydropower station accident evolution key node and path identification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade hydropower station accident evolution key node and path identification method, which comprises the steps of collecting basic data of a target cascade hydropower station, preprocessing data of the cascade hydropower station accident text, determining association relations among accident factors, classifying, constructing a cascade hydropower station accident evolution network model by adopting a complex network method, constructing an accident propagation probability model by combining network topology characteristics and accident factor point mutual information indexes, calculating the cascade hydropower station accident propagation probability by combining a Bayesian network, operating the cascade hydropower station accident evolution network model, identifying a key path in accident propagation, introducing a node recovery function, and identifying the key node in accident propagation. The key risk nodes and the evolution paths thereof in the emergency process of the cascade hydropower station accidents can be accurately identified, the risk management and control precision of the cascade hydropower station is improved, the risk of cascade accident diffusion is reduced, and the overall safety management and control level is improved.

title_en: Substation foundation settlement prediction analysis system and method based on industrial cloud platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of online monitoring, in particular to a transformer substation foundation settlement prediction analysis system and method based on an industrial cloud platform, the method comprises the steps of establishing a digital grid unit of a three-dimensional space of a transformer substation, collecting real-time working condition data and ground water level data of all equipment in the transformer substation, and predicting and obtaining real-time settlement rate and accumulated settlement of each grid unit; and constructing a double risk propagation network, calculating a settlement risk probability value and a global risk entropy value, and generating a three-dimensional visual maintenance navigation. The method solves the problems of low accuracy of predicting the settlement risk of the transformer substation caused by insufficient integration of multi-source dynamic data and incapability of quantifying time-varying coupling effect of a static load model in the prior art.
assignees: TAIAN ZHONGDING POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent regulation and control method, device, equipment and medium for energy storage-mechanical load energy matching
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent regulation and control method, device, equipment and medium for energy storage-mechanical load energy matching. The regulation and control method comprises the steps of generating a restarting risk coefficient and a no-load time length by analyzing mechanical load starting and stopping state data, constructing a dynamic credibility weight matrix by combining the risk coefficient and the no-load time length, building a weighted directed topology network based on the matrix and energy storage capacity and load requirements, generating an optimal allocation decision matrix by constraint optimization solution, and when sudden restarting of equipment is detected, positioning conflict equipment according to the decision matrix, calculating compensation capacity and freezing time length to form an energy storage regulation and control scheme. The method effectively solves the problem of system breakdown caused by capacity deficiency occupation conflict during cooperative operation of multiple devices, rapidly isolates the conflict during sudden restarting of the devices through a dynamic risk quantification and intelligent buffer mechanism, avoids cascading faults, and remarkably improves the system stability and the energy utilization rate.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST PETROLEUM

title_en: Geological disaster prediction method based on deep learning and machine learning model cascade
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster prediction method based on deep learning and machine learning model cascading, which comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source data of each evaluation unit in a research area, obtaining traditional geoscience factors and initial evaluation factor sets according to the multi-source data, inputting the initial evaluation factor sets into an improved U-Net network to obtain a geological disaster space probability distribution map, forming a cascading evaluation factor set by the geological disaster space probability distribution map and the traditional geoscience factors together, and inputting the cascading evaluation factor set of each evaluation unit in the research area into a trained machine learning model to obtain geological disaster prediction probability of each evaluation unit. The method and the device remarkably improve the precision and reliability of the geological disaster prediction method, greatly enhance the interpretability and reliability of the improved U-Net network, innovatively realize the deep coupling of two technical paradigms, and improve the generalization capability and practicability of the geological disaster prediction method instead of simple superposition.
assignees: EMERGENCY MAN DEPARTMENT BIG DATA CENTER

title_en: Power grid voltage sag source positioning method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for positioning a power grid voltage sag source, and relates to the field of positioning of power grid voltage sag sources, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining voltage and current waveform data of monitoring points during power grid voltage sag; the method comprises the steps of inputting voltage and current waveform data of monitoring points in a grid voltage sag into a trained graph attention network to obtain the position of a grid voltage sag source, wherein the graph attention network comprises an input layer, a cascaded graph attention layer, a pooling layer and an output layer, a multi-head attention mechanism and a voltage sag amplitude are introduced into the graph attention layer, the voltage sag amplitude is determined by the voltage and current waveform data, the graph attention network is trained by adopting an improved loss function and comparison learning, and the improved loss function introduces the grid voltage sag source judgment based on instantaneous disturbance power quantity and disturbance energy into the loss function. The application improves the accuracy of positioning the power grid voltage sag source.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Facility system capacity assessment method considering internal coupling relation and cascade failure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of protection engineering, in particular to a facility system capacity assessment method considering internal coupling relation and cascade failure, which comprises the following steps of S1, modeling a facility system based on a complex network theory; S2, constructing a facility system capacity evaluation calculation model considering internal coupling relations and cascade failures, S3, simulating the propagation of the cascade failures based on point failures and the propagation of the cascade failures based on edge failures in the facility system capacity evaluation calculation model, S4, and obtaining the functional level of the facility system through the evaluation calculation model based on system functional association according to simulation results. According to the invention, the functional level of the facility system is calculated through the evaluation calculation model based on the system functional association, so that an accurate evaluation result is obtained.
assignees: RES INSTITUTE FOR NATIONAL DEFENSE ENGINEERING OF ACADEMY OF MILITARY SCIENCE PLA CHINA

title_en: Power distribution network cascading failure prediction and failure defense method, system, equipment, medium and product
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, and discloses a method, a system, equipment, a medium and a product for predicting and defending cascading faults of a power distribution network, wherein the method determines the fault probability of target equipment of the power distribution network through environmental data of the power distribution network when typhoon disasters occur, constructs a dynamic Bayesian network based on a power supply chain according to a power supply chain and a fault propagation path of the power distribution network, predicts the predicted probability state distribution of the power supply chain at the future time by using the dynamic Bayesian network, and according to the predicted probability state distribution, the predicted cascade fault propagation probability of the power supply chain is determined, the power distribution network fault defense optimization problem is converted into a Markov decision process problem, and according to the predicted probability state distribution and the predicted cascade fault propagation probability, the Markov decision process problem is solved based on a deep reinforcement learning algorithm, so that an optimal fault defense strategy is obtained, and the power distribution network is effectively defended against faults.
assignees: FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Multi-source heterogeneous water service data fusion method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing and discloses a multi-source heterogeneous water service data fusion method which comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source heterogeneous water service monitoring data to generate an initial data set, detecting the running state of a system component through analyzing indexes such as heartbeat signals, data transmission quality and the like, identifying fault nodes, establishing a fault influence propagation model, analyzing fault types and influence ranges, dynamically reassigning calculation and storage tasks based on fault conditions, optimizing resource scheduling, reconstructing and repairing affected data by utilizing historical data, spatial correlation and parameter correlation, dynamically adjusting a fusion strategy according to a system state, adopting a self-adaptive weight fusion network to realize intelligent fusion of the multi-source data, generating a high-reliability fusion data result and carrying out quality assessment. The invention realizes the integrity of the data fusion link and the reliability of the fusion result under the condition of local component faults, and obviously improves the toughness and the reliability of the water service data fusion system.
assignees: BIJIE BIG DATA GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Natural resource asset checking method and system for abnormal event influence analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, and discloses a natural resource asset checking method and system for abnormal event influence analysis. Firstly, constructing a basic database integrating natural resource background and dynamic monitoring data, sensing abnormal events and extracting structural features through a multi-channel monitoring network, then constructing a disaster stress wave propagation model to generate a value loss field intensity distribution map, dividing a check area according to the map, acquiring data by intelligent scheduling investigation equipment, and finally comparing data to optimize model parameters and generate an investigation report; the system comprises a multi-source data fusion module, an event intelligent perception module, a stress wave deduction analysis module, an intelligent scheduling module, an intelligent checking module, a model optimization module and a report generation module, and the system solves the problems of low and inaccurate traditional evaluation efficiency and realizes efficient and accurate checking of natural resource assets.
assignees: UNIV INNER MONGOLIA AGRI

title_en: Propagation trend deduction method and system based on multi-agent cooperation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and discloses a propagation trend deduction method and a propagation trend deduction system based on multi-agent cooperation; the method comprises the steps of constructing a social network environment with a plurality of agents, defining image vectors for the agents, generating a social adjacency matrix, enabling an internal cognitive module of each agent to be responsible for processing internal states of the agents, enabling an external behavior module to define parameterized actions of the agents for interaction with the social network environment and other agents, enabling an embedded vector obtained based on the internal states and external information of the agents to serve as input of a decision model, integrating a social context bias matrix into an attention mechanism of a decision encoder of the decision model to reflect social local atmosphere, generating an internal position based on the embedded vector, and outputting external actions in combination with the social environment to drive propagation simulation and trend deduction. The method has remarkable advantages in the aspects of processing multi-modal information, describing individual heterogeneity and realizing large-scale prospective prediction.

title_en: Data management method and system for water and electricity river basin overhaul
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data management method and a system for water and electricity watershed overhaul, and relates to the technical field of data management.A full-quantity overhaul data analysis of target overhaul equipment is obtained, and a longitudinal overhaul quality improvement rate reference value and a transverse overhaul quality improvement rate reference value are established by combining a reference overhaul period quantized quality improvement rate deviation, so that the problems of scattered overhaul data and lack of a unified analysis reference are solved, and the evaluation accuracy and consistency are improved; the method comprises the steps of screening target associated equipment through work associated attributes, presenting the associated relation among the equipment by combining an associated mapping table, realizing collaborative management of the overhaul state of the hydropower basin equipment, avoiding cascading failures, predicting the quality improvement rate of the next overhaul period through a long-short-period memory network model, generating a predicted overhaul key associated data table, matching the predicted overhaul key associated data table with the current data table, extracting key overhaul equipment information, generating an early warning suggestion table, solving the problem of overhaul plan hysteresis, realizing prospective judgment, providing basis for active maintenance and reducing the risk of fault shutdown.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Preventive island partitioning method and system for cascade fault prevention and control and elastic lifting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for preventing and controlling cascade faults and improving elasticity, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining equipment data, operation data and typhoon related parameters of an electric power system, calculating the fault rate of each element of the electric power system under typhoon according to the equipment data, the operation data and the typhoon related parameters of the electric power system, calculating risk values of each element of the electric power system under typhoon according to the fault rate of each element of the electric power system under typhoon, and activating a preventive island strategy to divide the electric power system into a plurality of sub-islands when the risk values exceed a preset threshold value. According to the factors such as a power grid topological structure, load distribution, power supply characteristics and the like, an optimization algorithm is used for scientifically dividing the power system into a plurality of sub-islands which have independent operation capability and controllable risks, so that the risk of cascading faults is effectively reduced, and the overall elasticity of the system is improved.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHAANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent dividing method for coal mine multi-disaster risk areas based on graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent dividing method of a coal mine multi-disaster risk area based on a graph neural network, which comprises the following steps of collecting multi-disaster monitoring data and space structure information to form original monitoring data, constructing a composite graph structure based on the original monitoring data, obtaining directional input through directional association according to the composite graph structure, introducing Hodge-Laplacian directional information transmission mechanism based on the directional input to obtain an edge state updating result, converging the edge state updating result to corresponding connection nodes to output node states, generating enhanced node representation based on the node states in a fusing mode, constructing an anisotropic thermonuclear diffusion graph model to generate a multi-disaster risk propagation graph, carrying out normalization and threshold division according to node scores according to the multi-disaster risk propagation graph, and outputting a coal mine multi-disaster risk area dividing graph layer with continuous boundaries. The invention realizes the intelligent division of the multi-disaster risk areas of the coal mine.
assignees: UNIV XIAN SCI & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Interpolation-free hybrid line simulation model with accurate zero sequence impedance and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system simulation, and discloses an interpolation-free hybrid line simulation model with accurate zero sequence impedance and a construction method thereof, wherein the model comprises a decoupling module, a parallel compensation module and a series synthesis module; the decoupling module is used for enabling electromagnetic propagation delay time to be equal to simulation step length of a simulation program and realizing interpolation-free calculation decoupling at two ends of a line, the parallel compensation module is used for compensating additional parallel susceptance introduced and inter-phase capacitance introduced into an original physical model of the line, and the series synthesis module is used for synthesizing residual series impedance of the line so that total series positive-sequence impedance and zero-sequence impedance of an equivalent model are matched with a preset target value under fundamental wave frequency. The invention can provide calculation decoupling without interpolation for the short line and accurately simulate the full-sequence network parameters including zero sequence components, thereby being capable of well meeting the requirements of high-fidelity parallel simulation of the modern power distribution network.

title_en: Data tracing method and device based on whole process management of equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a data tracing method and device based on equipment whole process management, and relates to the technical field of power grids. When a data abnormal event is detected, the unique identifier of the device is extracted, the time sequence data corresponding to the unique identifier of the device, the associated device state and the blood edge association relation are obtained through analysis by combining the blood edge map of the data in the blockchain database, and then source tracing reasoning is carried out through a causal reasoning model, an abnormal source, an abnormal reason and an abnormal propagation path are determined, and a data tracing result is automatically generated. The problem of grid equipment data blood relationship fracture and difficult tracing is solved, and automatic tracing of the grid equipment data is realized.
assignees: DIGITAL TECH BRANCH OF HEBEI ZHONGXING JINENG ELECTRIC POWER DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;INFORMATION & COMMUNICATION BRANCH COMPANY STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power grid fault rapid diagnosis system fusing AI algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid fault rapid diagnosis system fused with an AI algorithm, which relates to the technical field of power grid fault diagnosis, and comprises the steps of acquiring three-phase voltage and current data of a power distribution network and real-time output data of distributed photovoltaic, and inhibiting data noise by utilizing a self-adaptive morphological filter so as to extract fault characteristic data under photovoltaic disturbance; and analyzing the fault propagation relationship among all nodes in the power distribution network topological structure by combining a graph neural network with causal reasoning enhancement to generate a fault tracing path. Therefore, the accuracy of fault feature extraction under the photovoltaic disturbance environment can be effectively improved, meanwhile, the precision and the efficiency of fault tracing and positioning are improved, and quick and accurate power grid fault diagnosis is facilitated, so that the operation safety and reliability of the power distribution network are guaranteed.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHENGTU ELECTRIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: LLMs-KG-based underground station facility flood vulnerability cascade effect analysis method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, and discloses a LLMs-KG-based underground station facility flood vulnerability cascade effect analysis method, which is characterized in that an underground station facility knowledge graph of object-behavior-state three-domain association is constructed by analyzing underground station facility components and association relations from top to bottom, a cellular automaton calculation model of flood evolution-facility component coupling is constructed, interaction between underground station facility components and flood is depicted, formal modeling and explicit semantic expression of the underground station facility association relations are realized through KG on one hand, and on the other hand, intelligent reasoning is carried out on interaction and cascade propagation paths between the underground station facility components under the action of flood disasters by utilizing LLMs, so that the transformation from traditional split type evaluation to system integral vulnerability evaluation is realized. Related achievements can provide important theoretical basis and technical support for establishing flood targeted emergency strategies of underground stations and improving system toughness.

title_en: Groundwater safety assessment method under extreme climate event
abstract_en: The invention relates to an underground water safety assessment method under extreme weather events, which comprises the steps of collecting multi-source heterogeneous data such as weather, geology, hydrology and remote sensing, constructing a unified underground water safety knowledge graph through standardized cleaning, semantic alignment and missing complementation, monitoring the extreme weather events in real time, updating node relation weights and sparsifying transmission paths based on knowledge graph dynamic evolution and time sequence attention mechanisms, carrying out risk propagation path reasoning on the dynamic knowledge graph by combining an improved graph neural network, identifying key pollution nodes, outputting structured risk grades and coping suggestions, and realizing high adaptability and reasoning accuracy of emergency response by a system based on evolution feedback continuous optimization graph and model parameters. The method improves the intelligence, the real-time performance and the accuracy of the groundwater risk assessment. The method solves the problems that the underground water pollution propagation path is difficult to dynamically identify and the decision adaptability is insufficient under the extreme climate event.
assignees: SCIENT INSTITUTE OF PEARL RIVER WATER RESOURCES PROTECTION

title_en: Rainy season forest coverage area monitoring serialization method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of monitoring geological disasters of covered areas of rainy seasons, and provides a rainy season forest covered area monitoring serialization method based on deep learning, which aims at solving the problems that radar interference images of rainy seasons are difficult to obtain effectively and slope risk monitoring is easy to break, the method superimposes topography and water system to define a slope area and a management partition, utilizes the interference images of the dry seasons to extract abnormal areas and form an area deformation mode, associates slope according to the coverage proportion and the water flow relation, the method comprises the steps of constructing a layered causal network consisting of slope surfaces, observation and driving factor nodes, establishing a time updating model taking a deformation mode as a priori, determining time response based on satellite positioning monitoring points, determining a transfer relation by combining rainfall grids and road excavation information, setting an alarm threshold value, calculating risk states of each slope surface along causal connection propagation in a radar interference image unavailable period in a rainy season, and outputting regional hierarchical management and control information.
assignees: UNIV CHENGDU;The First Geological Brigade of Sichuan Province

title_en: Intelligent micro-grid source network load storage integrated coordination management and control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent micro-grid source network load storage integrated coordination control system, which relates to the technical field of intelligent micro-grid and comprehensive energy regulation and control and comprises a multi-energy flow data acquisition unit, a multi-energy flow coupling modeling and optimizing unit, a multi-energy flow cascade utilization execution unit, a mode self-adaptive switching unit and a main control unit, wherein the multi-energy flow data acquisition unit is connected with the multi-energy flow data acquisition unit; according to the invention, through the multi-energy flow coupling modeling and optimizing unit, an electric-thermal-gas multi-energy flow coupling model comprising a heat supply network transmission loss calculation sub-model is constructed, a renewable energy source absorption constraint sub-model is additionally arranged, an improved mixed particle swarm algorithm is adopted for dynamic optimization solution, and an optimal scheduling strategy is generated, so that the absorption rate of renewable energy sources is improved, and through a heat energy distribution priority regulation mechanism and the efficiency optimization control of a waste heat recovery module, the electric-thermal cascade utilization and high-efficiency configuration are realized, and the dependence of heat load on electric energy is remarkably reduced.
assignees: XIANYANG XINXING DISTRIBUTED ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Multidimensional information fusion evaluation method for intelligent product quality security risk
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-dimensional information fusion evaluation method of intelligent product quality safety risk, which comprises the steps of calculating raw material production data aggregation degree and deviation degree, carrying out anomaly identification to obtain an anomaly result, calculating a potential hardware risk coefficient, calculating a first influence degree, correcting the potential hardware risk coefficient to obtain a hardware risk coefficient, carrying out data quality evaluation and cross enhancement to obtain a software integration risk coefficient according to user feedback matching anomaly result and feature enhancement to obtain risk characteristics, constructing a risk correlation propagation network and an intelligent product quality safety risk evaluation model, and inputting multi-dimensional information of an intelligent product to be evaluated into the intelligent product quality safety risk evaluation model to obtain an intelligent product quality safety risk evaluation result. The method not only can promote the comprehensiveness, the dynamics and the accuracy of the risk evaluation of the intelligent product, but also has important significance for improving the reliability of the intelligent product and the industry risk management and control level.
assignees: CHINA NAT INST STANDARDIZATION

title_en: Power plant equipment fault detection system based on AI image recognition algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power plant equipment detection, and discloses a power plant equipment fault detection system based on an AI image recognition algorithm.
