The system comprises six core modules, namely, equipment image acquisition, fault feature analysis, fault propagation modeling, fault region judgment, fault level classification and fault structure output. The power plant equipment fault detection and management system comprises an equipment image acquisition module, a fault feature analysis module, a fault structure output module and a power plant equipment fault precision detection and efficient management module, wherein the equipment image acquisition module acquires real-time monitoring image data of power plant equipment, equipment feature points are extracted through region segmentation, a feature point topological relation is established by combining equipment types, an equipment feature topological diagram is generated, the fault feature analysis module carries out multidimensional feature extraction based on the topological diagram, a feature point similarity matrix is calculated to construct a fault feature association network, the follow-up module sequentially establishes a fault propagation model, screens a fault core region set, generates a fault grade label group, and finally generates a fault classification map by the fault structure output module.
assignees: ZHONGYING QINGCHUANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake monitoring data analysis method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake monitoring, in particular to an earthquake monitoring data analysis method and system based on big data, comprising the following steps of analyzing the spatial relationship between a station and the earthquake based on the spatial distribution information of an observation station, and judging the change characteristics of the main seismic wave band at each station, and adjusting event distribution and frequency band response by combining the continuity of a propagation path, the depth change of a seismic source and the trend of heat flow density to obtain a frequency band response optimization set. According to the invention, by automatically matching the station sequence with the seismic event propagation path and combining the structural band with the heat flow change trend, synchronous judgment of event characteristics, space partition and trend classification is realized, a data period updating mechanism promotes a monitoring network to adapt to change in real time, frequency band response distribution is automatically adjusted, continuity and sensitivity of trend identification are continuously enhanced, structural richness and risk identification capability of seismic monitoring data are comprehensively improved, and capability of adapting to complex scenes is endowed to seismic observation.
assignees: EARTHQUAKE ADMINISTRATION OF GANSU PROVINCE

title_en: Nuclear safety simulation verification method, equipment and medium based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nuclear safety simulation verification method, equipment and medium based on digital twinning, which relate to the technical field of nuclear engineering and digital twinning and comprise the steps of training a physical information neural network based on a digital twinning initial model by combining a nuclide transport equation and a thermal hydraulic equation, outputting a nuclear safety multi-field simulation result, establishing a space-time diagram structure based on the nuclear safety multi-field simulation result, extracting dynamic evolution characteristics by utilizing a space-time diagram convolution network, outputting a nuclear accident propagation path and a risk distribution diagram, and performing credibility evaluation on a virtual-real alignment nuclear safety digital twinning model to generate a nuclear safety simulation verification result.

title_en: Electric power network security defense method and device based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based electric power network security defense method and a digital twinning-based electric power network security defense device, which belong to the technical field of network security, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring electric power data of an electric power network in real time; the method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin simulation environment of an electric power network according to electric power data, extracting electric power characteristic data in the digital twin simulation environment, carrying out layer-by-layer risk analysis on the electric power characteristic data according to each layer of hyperplane functions of a preset decision tree to determine a risk type and a risk matrix of the electric power network, reconstructing a propagation path of a current attack according to the risk matrix in the digital twin simulation environment, and generating a security defense strategy of the electric power network according to the risk type and the propagation path. Therefore, by implementing the invention, the problem of low detection accuracy of the risk of the power network in the prior art can be solved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Geothermal pipe network intelligent monitoring method and system based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geothermal pipe network monitoring, in particular to a geothermal pipe network intelligent monitoring method and system based on edge calculation; the method comprises the steps of collecting sound pressure signals, vibration signals and pressure signals in real time, carrying out first-order differential calculation based on the pressure signals to obtain a differential pressure change sequence, inputting the sound pressure signals and the vibration signals into a micro-seismic intelligent recognition model, outputting micro-seismic risk quantization scoring indexes, generating execution regulation and control instructions, recording execution feedback data to form a micro-seismic scoring feedback data set, carrying out time sequence reconstruction on the differential pressure change sequence by using a nerve differential equation model, identifying an abnormal propagation source point and a shortest propagation path, constructing a water hammer propagation response structure, transmitting the micro-seismic scoring feedback data set and the water hammer propagation response structure to a cloud platform, and carrying out real-time monitoring and early warning on the state of a geothermal pipe network. The invention realizes the intelligent monitoring and tracking of the slight earthquake abnormal state and the water hammer effect of the geothermal pipe network.

title_en: Deep learning-based seismic data noise identification method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for recognizing seismic data noise based on deep learning, which relate to the technical field of seismic data processing and comprise the steps of collecting repeated seismic event records of different earthquake magnitudes and different propagation paths in multiple regions of the world, extracting seismic waveform pairs corresponding to the same station, labeling multiple types of noise labels and constructing a pure real training data set without synthetic data; constructing a multi-scale global collaborative deep learning network, training through a pure real training data set and a multi-target coupling loss function, iteratively optimizing network parameters by using a gradient descent algorithm until preset convergence conditions are met to obtain a trained seismic noise identification model, inputting standardized seismic data into the trained seismic noise identification model, and reasoning out noise types, noise intensity and noise distribution position information. The invention can realize the accurate recognition of multiple types of complex noise, simultaneously ensure the fidelity of effective signals of earthquakes and promote the automation and the instantaneity of noise recognition.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA WATER RESOURCES & ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Distributed energy storage virtualization sharing system scheduling method based on target cascading method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed energy storage virtualization sharing system scheduling method based on a target cascading method, which comprises the steps of 1, constructing an operation model comprising a producer community containing distributed energy storage and a producer community renting virtual energy storage, 2, constructing a service life model of a generator set, thereby utilizing an interactive power equivalent calculation strategy of the distributed energy storage-virtual energy storage to construct an operation model of an operator, 3, constructing a three-layer optimization model of the distributed energy storage virtualization sharing system, 4, solving the three-layer optimization model based on the target cascading method, and solving a scheduling scheme of the distributed energy storage virtualization sharing system. According to the invention, by introducing the distributed energy storage-virtual energy storage interactive power equivalent method and combining the distributed target cascade optimization method, the three-layer optimization model of the distributed energy storage virtualization sharing system is solved, and on the basis of ensuring the safe operation boundary of the power network and equipment, the carbon emission of the system is effectively reduced and the utilization rate of the distributed energy storage is improved.

title_en: Enterprise financial analysis and risk early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an enterprise financial analysis and risk early warning method and system, which relate to the technical field of enterprise financial analysis and early warning, and comprise the steps of obtaining multisource structured financial data of a target enterprise, carrying out cleaning, normalization and time alignment processing on the financial data to form a financial time sequence data sequence, extracting a group of core financial indexes based on the financial time sequence data sequence, identifying time sequence relationships and influence hysteresis periods among the indexes through a Granges causal test and a dynamic time regulation method, constructing a financial index dynamic coupling network, carrying out risk propagation path deduction by utilizing the financial index dynamic coupling network, generating a risk conduction map, determining a key risk driving index based on influence strength of each node in the map, collecting external unstructured information related to the target enterprise, identifying important event types occurring in the enterprise, combining event properties and occurrence time, and calculating impact strength of each event on the enterprise and influence weight of each event on time attenuation.
assignees: NANJING DONGJU INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Heavy-duty card charging health evaluation method based on optimized graph rolling network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a re-card charging health evaluation method based on an optimized graph rolling network, which particularly relates to the technical field of electric operation and maintenance, and aims to realize space-time correlation modeling and intelligent maintenance path planning of the health state of a charging pile by collecting multi-source heterogeneous operation data of the charging pile and dividing a uniform time window, constructing a dynamic multi-graph structure integrating space, electric and behavior coupling relations, extracting local state evolution trend and neighbor influence factors of nodes to generate a joint feature vector, inputting features under the multi-time window into the multi-scale attention-enhanced graph rolling network to obtain joint potential health degree representation, calculating health scores based on the potential representation, identifying high risk nodes, constructing a potential failure propagation path map, combining the centrality index with degradation rate to generate a maintenance priority table, and outputting an optimized inspection path.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring and early warning method, device and equipment of supply chain and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of supply chain monitoring and discloses an intelligent monitoring and early warning method, device, equipment and storage medium of a supply chain, wherein the method comprises the steps of deploying a plurality of types of internet of things sensors at each target node in the supply chain, collecting supply chain state data, and executing time sequence analysis and anomaly detection in an edge server to obtain local early warning information; the method comprises the steps of carrying out graph neural network analysis based on local early warning information and a preset supply chain network structure to obtain a node risk representation vector and a risk propagation probability matrix, carrying out early warning strategy calculation through a multi-agent deep reinforcement learning algorithm according to the node risk representation vector and the risk propagation probability matrix to obtain an early warning strategy set, and carrying out risk propagation simulation calculation on the early warning strategy set and the supply chain network structure to obtain comprehensive early warning decision information. The risk propagation path and the risk propagation speed can be accurately identified, and the accuracy of risk propagation prediction of a supply chain is improved.
assignees: CHENGTIAN INT SUPPLY CHAIN SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: System for managing and monitoring
title_ko: 인파 관리 및 모니터링 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 인파를 영상촬영하여 영상정보를 생성하는 AI기반 CCTV(110), 영상정보의 전체 이미지프레임을 M×N 크기의 ROI 영역으로 그리드분할하고, 밀집도 적응적인 실시간 군중계수 네트워크 모델을 통해서, ROI 영역의 입력영상을 입력으로 하여 각 ROI 영역별 객체를 인식하여 인구 밀집맵을 산출하는 제1분석을 수행하여 위험 단계를 각각 예측하고, 제1분석에 따른 인구 밀집맵이 미리설정된 기준 인구 밀집맵을 초과하거나 기준 인구 밀집맵에 대해 초과가 예상되는 특정 ROI 영역에 대해 인구 밀집맵을 조절하는 제2분석을 수행하여 특정 ROI 영역에 대해 객체를 인식하여 인파가 급증하는 이상징후를 식별하도록 하는, 인파 식별부(120), 인구 밀집맵에 따른 위험 단계 및 이상징후에 해당하는 위험경고정보를 생성하고, 제2분석에 상응하는 특정 ROI 영역에 해당하는 특정 밀집지역을 집중 관리하는, 모니터링부(130), 및 디지털 사이니지(141)를 통해 위험상황을 전파하고 안전가이드를 제공하도록 하는 현장안내부(140)를 포함하여, 인파가 급증하는 위험상황을 정확하게 파악하여 안전사고를 예방하도록 하는, 인파 관리 및 모니터링 시스템을 개시한다.
assignees: BUILPLAN

title_en: Intelligent earthquake monitoring network optimization design and real-time reconstruction system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of seismic monitoring, in particular to an intelligent seismic monitoring network optimization design and real-time reconstruction system, which comprises a seismic data acquisition module, a network evaluation module of a base Yu Liman manifold, a geodesic analysis module, a network reconstruction decision module, an execution control module and a performance evaluation feedback module, wherein the system models a seismic monitoring space into a Riemann manifold, calculates geodesic of a seismic wave propagation path through manifold convolution extraction characteristics, analyzes geodesic density distribution, accurately identifies a monitoring blind area and performs risk rating; generating a network reconstruction strategy comprising temporary site deployment and existing site parameter adjustment according to the evaluation result; the invention breaks through the limitation that the traditional monitoring network cannot accurately identify dead zones and dynamically adjust, and remarkably improves the monitoring coverage rate.
assignees: UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES WUHAN

title_en: Comprehensive evaluation method for weak links of power system related to multidimensional indexes in extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive evaluation method for weak links of an electric power system, which relates to multidimensional indexes in extreme weather. Firstly, a multidimensional index system comprising safety and optimized operability is established, wherein the multidimensional index system comprises line outage probability, load loss probability, electric energy deficiency expectation, line overload rate and network loss rate. And secondly, constructing a line fault model and a cascading fault model in extreme storm weather, describing the fault probability change by combining a Gaussian function and Weibull distribution, and simulating line sectional failure by using Poisson distribution. And calculating the system state after the fault through a direct current optimal power flow model, and acquiring a large amount of simulation data by combining a non-sequential Monte Carlo method. Further, subjective and objective weights are calculated by a fuzzy analytic hierarchy process and a CRITIC process respectively, subjective and objective comprehensive evaluation is realized by weighting fusion, and weak links of the system are identified. The method has the advantages of evaluating scientificity and calculating efficiency, and is suitable for real-time risk evaluation and weak link identification of a large-scale power system in extreme weather.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power grid basic data stain propagation path marking and identifying method and related equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a method for marking and identifying a stain propagation path of power grid basic data, namely related equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining the power grid basic data and determining a power grid knowledge graph according to the dependency relationship between the power grid basic data; the method comprises the steps of carrying out initial stain marking on key nodes in a power grid knowledge graph to generate initial stains, utilizing a graph neural network to represent the nodes of the power grid knowledge graph, merging edges in the power grid knowledge graph into the graph neural network to determine embedded vectors of the nodes in the power grid knowledge graph, dividing the embedded vectors into a training set and a verification set, training a stain path reasoning model through the training set, responding to the detection of the initial stains, determining a second knowledge graph corresponding to the initial stains, inputting the trained stain path reasoning model, and determining all stains and stain transmission paths.
assignees: BEIJING CHINA POWER INF TECH;STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Space-time correlation-based power system short-circuit parameter prediction method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid safety evaluation, in particular to a power system short-circuit parameter prediction method, a system, equipment and a storage medium based on space-time correlation. And extracting space-time correlation characteristic vectors comprising time dimension characteristics, space-time coupling characteristics and state characteristics by constructing a multi-dimensional state vector comprising node voltage vectors, branch current vectors, short circuit impedance matrixes, space position information and time characteristic vectors. Wavelet transformation, fourier analysis and graph theory analysis are adopted to identify parameter change rules and propagation effects. And constructing a multi-level prediction model of a statistical prediction layer, a deep learning layer and a fusion layer, and comprehensively describing the dynamic characteristics of the short circuit parameters through space-time feature fusion. The method adopts a staged training strategy, and comprises the steps of establishing a basic model through offline training, updating parameters in real time through online learning and quantifying uncertainty through a probability prediction framework. And establishing a prediction correction mechanism and a reliability evaluation system to form a complete prediction-evaluation-correction closed loop.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent factory equipment monitoring method and system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for monitoring the health state of equipment based on the Internet of things. The method comprises the steps of obtaining data in a multi-source sensor, preprocessing the data to obtain a real-time operation data set of the equipment, and determining a health quantification deviation value and a health state trend through the real-time operation data set. When the health state is abnormal, the starting point coordinates of the abnormal events are recorded, the triggering time stamp of the abnormal events is marked, and the dependency relationship among the devices is analyzed by utilizing graph network modeling. The method and the system further analyze the potential risk probability through the long-short-time memory network, realize real-time monitoring, fault propagation prediction and risk assessment of the health state of the equipment, and improve the operation reliability and maintenance efficiency of the industrial equipment.
assignees: NANTONG SHIDAO INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: New unit equipment risk management and control and spare part demand optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for risk management and control of new unit equipment and optimization of spare part requirements, and relates to the technical field of intelligent operation and maintenance, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting operation condition signals in real time, constructing a digital twin model of each part of the unit equipment, and forming a unified discrete state vector; the method comprises the steps of carrying out feature extraction on an operation condition signal according to a fixed window, combining process attributes to construct a Bayesian network of a layered causal structure, carrying out posterior reasoning on the Bayesian network through belief propagation to obtain the posterior probability of faults of causal nodes, calculating risk scores according to weights and result costs, carrying out life parameter estimation, simulating and predicting the demand by using Monte Carlo, and calculating the optimal spare part ordering quantity by combining inventory constraint. The method can discover potential risks in time, reduce unplanned shutdown, reduce inventory redundancy and capital occupation, and improve the safety, reliability and economy of operation of the new unit.
assignees: HUANENG HAINAN CHANGJIANG NUCLEAR POWER CO LTD

title_en: Multi-energy complementary scheduling method for multi-pumping and storage collaborative operation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of grid-connected power generation, and discloses a multi-energy complementary scheduling method for multi-pumping and storage cooperative operation, which comprises the steps of constructing a multi-target multi-energy complementary power generation scheduling model; the method comprises the steps of inputting predicted output values of a wind-solar power station and a nuclear power station, cascade hydroelectric power generation capacity and load demand values of a power grid into a multi-energy complementary power generation scheduling model to obtain an initial cascade hydroelectric and thermal power output process, inputting a unit state obtained through an operation sequence decision scheme of a pumping and accumulating unit into the multi-energy complementary power generation scheduling model to optimize a thermal power output sliding window and an operation process of the pumping and accumulating unit, and carrying out cascade hydroelectric power total load distribution again through the multi-energy complementary power generation scheduling model according to a cascade hydroelectric power output plan. The invention has the advantages that the new energy is consumed as much as possible under the condition of ensuring the high matching between the power supply and the load by the regulation capability of the cascade hydroelectric power station and the pumped storage power station group, the peak regulation depth of the thermal power is reduced, the flexibility margin of the system is released, and the invention provides reference for the collaborative scheduling operation of flexible resources under the large-scale new energy grid-connected background.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Urban underground rail transit network earthquake response deterministic physical simulation method and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deterministic physical simulation method and equipment for earthquake response of an urban underground rail transit network, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a hybrid earthquake source model based on movable fault parameters and kinematic parameters of a target area, integrating deterministic slippage components with low wave numbers and stochastic slippage components with high wave numbers on fault fracture surfaces by the earthquake source model, and generating a broadband earthquake wave field source reflecting the physical process of the earthquake source; the method comprises the steps of taking a constructed seismic source model as input, combining a regional crustal velocity structure model, simulating the propagation of seismic waves in a layered geological medium by utilizing a frequency-wave number domain method, calculating to obtain a seismic vibration space-time field, establishing a finite element model of an urban underground rail transit network, applying the seismic vibration space-time field as non-uniform seismic vibration input to the finite element model, and solving to obtain the dynamic response of the whole underground rail transit network in the seismic process through dynamic time-course analysis. The invention can reproduce the complete physical chain from the source break to the structural response.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: Power distribution network risk assessment method containing distributed photovoltaic based on functional resonance analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network risk assessment method containing distributed photovoltaic based on functional resonance analysis, which comprises the following steps of identifying key functional modules of a power distribution network from four aspects of 'figure pipe ring', wherein each functional module is completely defined through a six-element model based on a functional resonance theory, driving typical fault backtracking analysis based on scene level, calculating comprehensive risk indexes of scenes, and constructing a 'node-link-loop-scene' system integrated risk assessment system. The method has the beneficial effects that the risk propagation mechanism of the power distribution network can be divided into a node level, a path level, a loop level and a scene level four-layer system based on the dynamic characteristics of the functional coupling relation, and the accurate analysis of the multi-dimensional risk propagation mechanism of the high-proportion photovoltaic power distribution network is realized by constructing a node-link-loop-scene four-level risk assessment system.
assignees: NANJING INST TECH

title_en: Data processing method and system based on multi-layer architecture
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent power grid real-time monitoring, in particular to a data processing method and a system based on a multi-layer architecture, wherein the method comprises the following steps of 1, generating a dynamic priority queue, and generating a dynamic priority sequencing queue based on real-time feature analysis of multi-source sensing data of power equipment, wherein high priority data enter a processing channel preferentially; step 2, modeling cross-layer anomaly association, namely establishing a multi-layer anomaly propagation model through the physical connection relation of the equipment and the historical operation mode by utilizing the priority queue data output in the step 1, and step 3, carrying out resource self-adaptive scheduling, dynamically adjusting a task allocation strategy of a data processing node according to the anomaly propagation model established in the step 2, and ensuring the supply of processing resources of a key anomaly path. The method can obviously improve the accuracy and response speed of the abnormality processing of the power equipment, and finally realizes the efficient maintenance and management of the power equipment.
assignees: BEIJING NORTH STAR TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for evaluating influence of construction disturbance on natural protected land biodiversity
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating the influence of construction disturbance on the biodiversity of a natural protected area, which relate to the technical field of computers and comprise the steps of acquiring species distribution data, construction disturbance data and environment data in the natural protected area; the method comprises the steps of constructing an ecological correlation network according to species distribution data to obtain a species interaction network, extracting network structural features according to the species interaction network to obtain a key species set, conducting disturbance propagation dynamics modeling according to the key species set and construction disturbance data to obtain an influence propagation path diagram, conducting biodiversity response prediction according to the influence propagation path diagram and environment data to obtain a variation trend of the biological community composition, conducting comprehensive influence assessment according to the variation trend of the biological community composition, and outputting an influence grade index by comparing deviation degrees of historical baseline states. The invention effectively improves the integrity and predictive evaluation accuracy of the influence of construction disturbance on the natural protected land biodiversity.

title_en: Fault recovery method, device and program product based on multiple data centers
abstract_en: The application discloses a fault recovery method, a device and a program product based on a plurality of data centers, which relate to the field of big data, and the method comprises the steps of collecting the running states of the data centers and a plurality of disaster recovery data centers through a monitoring tool; the method comprises the steps of synchronizing incremental data in a data center to a plurality of disaster recovery data centers based on a log synchronization mechanism, detecting faults of the data center according to hardware states, network states and storage equipment states to obtain detection results, and executing a fault recovery strategy according to the data center and the disaster recovery data centers after synchronizing the incremental data under the condition that the detection results indicate that the data center has faults. The application solves the problems of long service interruption time caused by long time consumption in the traditional manual switching process to the disaster recovery center when the data center fails in the environment of the multiple data centers in the related technology.
assignees: INDUSTRIAL & COMMERCIAL BANK OF CHINA CO LTD

title_en: Power failure cause tracing and restoration decision method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to a power failure cause tracing and recovering decision method and a system, belonging to the technical field of intelligent operation and fault processing of a power system; the method comprises the steps of constructing a power grid GIS topological graph, generating an extreme weather fault sample through a TC-GAN topological constraint based on the power grid GIS topological graph and power distribution network operation data, analyzing a causal chain of a voltage event and a work order text of an intelligent ammeter by adopting an artificial intelligent large model based on the TC-GAN generated extreme weather fault sample, outputting a root cause probability distribution matrix, dynamically deducting a fault propagation path through a TV-GNN time-varying graph neural network based on the power grid GIS topological graph and the root cause probability distribution matrix, generating a node risk coefficient thermodynamic diagram, generating a layered recovery strategy through reinforcement learning based on the node risk coefficient thermodynamic diagram, checking the safety of the layered recovery strategy through an embedded N-1 rule base, and issuing if the check is passed.
assignees: AOSTAR INF TECH CO LTD

title_en: Legal contract risk monitoring and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a legal contract risk monitoring and early warning method, which particularly relates to the technical field of risk early warning, and aims to construct a multi-contract risk propagation network by identifying propagation clauses in a plurality of legal contract texts, generate a multi-contract propagation path topology network model by adopting a graph theory algorithm, output a cascade trigger mechanism for identifying inter-contract risk propagation clauses by utilizing time sequence causal analysis, obtain propagation path sensitivity grading data by carrying out sensitivity grading on each risk propagation path, integrate the cascade risk propagation links and the propagation path sensitivity grading data, construct a contract network risk propagation comprehensive assessment model, output a comprehensive risk assessment result, and compare the comprehensive risk assessment result with a preset risk early warning threshold rule to generate corresponding risk prompt information.
assignees: UNIV MUDANJIANG NORMAL

title_en: Financial wind control and anomaly detection method and system based on graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a financial wind control and anomaly detection method and system based on a graph neural network, which relate to the field of financial risk control and comprise the following steps: constructing a financial transaction graph network, constructing a feature graph by combining transaction time sequence information, extracting time sequence feature vectors, calculating risk propagation feature vectors, determining node embedding vectors and fusion node vectors, constructing a transaction flow graph, performing community division, and finally determining abnormal transaction communities and early warning through fuzzy clustering.
assignees: STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Business-impact-oriented network security asset risk pricing and management method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of network security asset risk pricing and management, in particular to a service-impact-oriented network security asset risk pricing and management method and system, a service-resource portraits library is constructed by integrating historical service data, infrastructure resource data and external environment data, a potential interruption event prediction model is trained based on random forests or long-short term memory network LSTM, constructing a multi-objective cost optimization function comprising resource preset cost, service interruption loss cost and resource idle penalty cost, solving an optimal resource preset strategy by adopting a non-dominant sorting genetic algorithm NSGA-II or a particle swarm optimization algorithm, and performing feedback data updating model and function to form closed-loop optimization. The method and the system realize accurate prediction of risk, dynamic balance of cost and continuous adaptation of strategies, effectively ensure service continuity, reduce the overall operation cost of enterprises, and promote pertinence and effectiveness of network security asset risk pricing and management.
assignees: FUZHOU HENGAO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for predicting short-term power output of offshore floating type photovoltaic field
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting short-term power output of an offshore floating type photovoltaic field, which comprises the steps of analyzing meteorological characteristic factors of a complex environment where the offshore floating type photovoltaic field is located, screening out main meteorological characteristics affecting offshore photovoltaic power generation as model input, establishing a power prediction model based on a BP neural network to predict output power of the floating type photovoltaic field, training the BP neural network through an error propagation rule based on a gradient descent method, considering an initial weight sensitivity problem existing in the BP neural network prediction model, establishing a PSO-BP prediction model based on the fact that the structure of the BP neural network prediction model is unchanged through a PSO algorithm, optimizing weights through global optimization, and finally evaluating and verifying the method provided by the invention, so that feasibility of the method is verified. The method can accurately predict the power output of the offshore floating photovoltaic field, and has certain guiding significance for photovoltaic grid connection and stable field operation.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN TECHNOLOGY;NORTH CHINA BRANCH OF CHINA POWER CONSTRUCTION NEW ENERGY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Automatic early warning system after equipment failure for intelligent power plant
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic early warning system after equipment failure for an intelligent power plant, which comprises the following components: the system comprises a data acquisition unit, a fault point judging unit, a fault propagation relation network building unit, a shutdown risk assessment unit and an early warning unit. The intelligent power plant fault diagnosis method has the advantages that through the cooperative work of the data acquisition, fault point judgment, fault propagation relation network modeling, shutdown risk assessment and early warning units, fault propagation cascading reactions are dynamically quantized, the problem that path analysis is incomplete and risk calculation is delayed in a multi-equipment fault scene in the traditional method is solved, the precision of fault early warning is improved, effective emergency response basis is provided for operation and maintenance personnel of an intelligent power plant, the final propagation probability is corrected according to the sign value of actual propagation of a fault by the propagation probability matrix generation module, and the final propagation probability is corrected every time a fault propagation event, so that prediction becomes more and more accurate along with system operation.
assignees: NINGXIA ZAOQUAN POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Impact propagation in it systems
abstract_en: A method of evaluating impact of a change on nodes of a network, including collecting information of changes to configuration items of the network with a change management module that is executed on a computer of the network and forming a list of changes, receiving a dependency graph that defines dependencies between nodes of the network, receiving an impact model that includes an impact value that provides an indication of a risk value for different types of changes to nodes of the dependencies, executing an impact score generation module configured to receive the dependency graph, the impact model and the list of changes to determine a risk value responsive to a specific change to a node of the network and an impact of the change on other nodes of the network, repairing or predicting problems in the network based on the determined risk value for each change.
assignees: E S I SOFTWARE LTD

title_en: Dynamic Asset Relationship Mapping and Risk Propagation Analysis Using Degree of Connections
abstract_en: A system generates a graph of assets in a network. The system defines connections between assets within the graph. The system identifies a risk event with an associated risk severity. The system determines a number of connections to traverse for generating a risk analysis pathway through the graph of assets in the network based on the associated risk severity associated with the risk event. The system generates a recommendation to address the identified risk.
assignees: ORDR INC

title_en: Intelligent knowledge base management system
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent knowledge base management system, which relates to the technical field of knowledge maps and comprises a knowledge map construction module, a scene perception module, a knowledge retrieval module, a risk assessment module, a dynamic shielding module and a recommendation output module, wherein the knowledge map construction module is used for constructing a layered knowledge map, the scene perception module is used for collecting scene characteristics of the current running state of a power grid in real time and fusing the scene characteristics to obtain scene embedded vectors, the knowledge retrieval module is used for executing directional propagation in the layered knowledge map according to user inquiry to obtain candidate knowledge nodes, the risk assessment module is used for calculating total risks of the candidate knowledge nodes based on the topological attribute vectors and the scene embedded vectors, the dynamic shielding module is used for shielding candidate knowledge nodes with inverse fact risk differences exceeding a risk threshold to obtain unshielded candidate knowledge nodes, and the recommendation output module is used for sequencing and outputting the unshielded candidate knowledge nodes according to the total risks from low to high. The invention can realize knowledge retrieval and recommendation which not only accords with the operation rule of the power grid, but also can avoid scene-dependent high-risk operation.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER IND CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for predicting double-carbon marketization service market scale of power grid company
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for predicting the market scale of a dual-carbon marketization service of a power grid company, wherein the method comprises the following steps of constructing a basic assumption of the dual-carbon marketization service diffusion of the power grid company, wherein the assumption comprises a customer group division assumption, a dual-channel propagation assumption and a price acceptance mechanism assumption, establishing an improved Bass diffusion model based on the assumption, wherein the model comprises a final customer number change speed equation and a final customer number accumulation equation, completing parameter estimation and fitting goodness verification of the improved Bass diffusion model by combining historical data and expert scoring and questionnaire investigation data through a nonlinear least square method, and respectively carrying out market scale prediction on carbon transaction services which are already developed and carbon capture services which are not already developed by the power grid company based on parameter estimation results.
assignees: STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Dynamic safety evaluation system of electric power facility based on blasting vibration propagation characteristics
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric power facility dynamic safety evaluation system based on blasting vibration propagation characteristics, which relates to the field of electric digital data processing and comprises a sensing and data acquisition module, a physical modeling and parameter library module, a real-time evaluation and risk inference module and a feedback execution and self-adaption module, wherein the sensing and data acquisition module is used for converting on-site physical signals into high-quality data streams, the physical modeling and parameter library module is used for providing construction physical modeling and management parameter information, the real-time evaluation and risk inference module is used for mapping sensing data into system states and risk indexes through observation-model assimilation, the feedback execution and self-adaption module is responsible for driving decision execution, collecting feedback and continuously improving a system model, the system can monitor the influence of blasting vibration on an electric power facility in real time, accurately evaluate the damage degree of a structure and the running risk of the system, and provide scientific basis for safety protection and emergency decision of the electric power facility.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Partial differential morphology and label propagation-based power grid partitioning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid partitioning method based on partial differential morphology and label propagation, which abstracts a power network into a weighted graph, and based on a selection strategy of electric centrality, namely k nodes with the largest electric centrality are selected as seed nodes to obtain a seed node set, unique labels are allocated to each seed, the morphology propagation and the label propagation are combined in the power grid partition, the morphology propagation is outwards propagated from the seed node set, the label propagation and the morphology propagation are operated in parallel to dynamically adjust the label attribution of the nodes, and when the cost of all the nodes is not changed any more, each node is endowed with a final label at the moment, so that the partitioning of the power grid is completed. The method can effectively realize the efficient partition control and management of the power grid, realize the accurate identification and reasonable division of the topological structure of the power grid, and provide scientific support for the planning and management of the power system.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: Water network dynamic risk assessment method and system based on space-time diagram convolution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water network dynamic risk assessment method and system based on space-time diagram convolution, and relates to the field of intelligent monitoring of water networks. The method comprises the steps of constructing a water network diagram structure, obtaining static and dynamic properties of physical nodes and pipe sections, generating virtual nodes in response to external events, calculating pollution propagation probability and influence weight, generating a dynamic adjacency matrix through self-adaptive diagram learning based on water quality and time sequence water flow data, calculating leakage risk values through space-time separation convolution, and calculating time-varying stability index assessment risks by fusing design efficiency reference values, real-time network efficiency and the like. The system comprises a data acquisition module, an event response module, a graph structure construction module, a risk calculation module and a stability evaluation module. The method solves the problems of static hysteresis and insufficient scene coverage in the traditional evaluation, improves the risk prediction precision and emergency response efficiency, and is suitable for real-time risk monitoring of various water networks.

title_en: Method and system for separating and cleaning runoff of rainwater in water-deficient city
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban rainwater management, in particular to a method and a system for cleaning and diverting runoff of rainwater in a water-deficient city. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a distribution diagram of a road section easy to accumulate water and a distribution diagram of a rainwater pipe network, determining a pipeline section at risk of deposition, determining initial interception indexes according to rainfall data, determining starting shear stress according to continuous rainfall-free time, calculating effective shear stress in a pipeline in a diversion stage, calculating pollution propagation speed when the effective shear stress is not smaller than the starting shear stress, calculating predicted time for pollutants to reach a diversion node according to the pollution propagation speed, and introducing rainwater runoffs into a sewage treatment path when the predicted time and the pollution propagation speed meet requirements. According to the invention, the moving process of the lagged pollution peak is dynamically tracked and predicted through the double monitoring points, so that the rainwater recycling utilization rate is improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN ACADEMY OF ENV SCIENCES

title_en: Dynamic population flow-based labor force heat exposure supply chain loss assessment method
abstract_en: A labor force heat exposure supply chain loss assessment method based on dynamic population flow belongs to the field of industrial chain risk assessment and decision support. The method comprises the steps of calculating urban population weighted wet ball black ball temperature WBGT indoors and outdoors, calculating daily production LOSS rates of different labor intensity industries according to WBGT in combination with heat exposure-reaction functions and air conditioner coverage, calculating labor exposure direct economic losses indoors and outdoors, constructing labor flow adjustment coefficients containing population migration compensation effects based on labor daily flow dynamic data, calculating corrected production LOSS rates, calculating supply chain cascade economic losses of labor heat exposure through a complex supply chain network model based on an adaptive main body according to the corrected production LOSS rates, obtaining policy gain according to total LOSS LOSS' -LOSS after implementation of adaptive measures, and further evaluating economic effectiveness of applied measures.
assignees: BEIJING INSTITUTE TECH;UNIV BEIJING NORMAL

title_en: Power distribution network weak node identification method, equipment and medium based on short circuit parameters
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems and automation thereof, and discloses a method, equipment and medium for identifying weak nodes of a power distribution network based on short-circuit parameters. Based on the standardized data, respectively calculating the related index of the short circuit parameter, the voltage stability index and the network topology strength index of the node, determining the weight coefficient of each evaluation index by adopting an objective weighting method, and establishing a weighted evaluation model. And introducing a dynamic response model based on frequency deviation, and evaluating the dynamic response characteristic of the node under the disturbance condition. According to the propagation characteristics of the faults in the network, the influence degree of the faults on adjacent nodes is analyzed, and a comprehensive evaluation model is generated.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Cascade water light and light storage complementary planning and scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a cascade water light storage complementary planning and scheduling method and system, which belong to the field of operation control of electric power systems, and comprise the steps of calculating target electric quantity of a cascade water light storage complementary system in each unit time period to be transmitted to a power grid according to total guaranteed electric quantity of the cascade water light storage complementary system in a unit time period in a scheduling period, calculating total regulated electric quantity of the cascade water light storage complementary system in any unit time period according to the total guaranteed electric quantity and total water light resource electric quantity of any unit time period, determining regulated electric quantity of each reservoir according to the total regulated electric quantity and preset quota coefficients corresponding to each reservoir in the cascade water light storage complementary system, and determining water level change quantity of each reservoir according to the regulated electric quantity and a potential energy analysis formula of each reservoir. According to the invention, the distribution scheduling model based on the reservoir power generation potential energy analysis expression is established, so that the reservoir optimization scheduling is converted from the traditional high-dimensional nonlinear programming problem into the algebraic solving problem, and the efficiency and stability in calculating the water level variation of the reservoir are improved.
assignees: HUADIAN JINSHA RIVER UPSTREAM HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD;CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;POWERCHINA NORTHWEST ENG CORP LTD;UNIV XIAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Intelligent energy full-flow management and control platform integrating AI decision
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent energy full-flow management and control platform integrating an AI decision, which comprises an energy data acquisition module, an AI decision center module and a multi-energy coordination module, wherein the energy data acquisition module is used for acquiring energy full-flow data through Internet of things equipment and integrating meteorological data, market data and user behavior data at the same time, the AI decision center module is used for training a neural network model through historical energy full-flow data, dynamically predicting energy load fluctuation, new energy output and market price trend in a future time period, constructing a multi-agent game framework, training a strategy network through a near-end strategy optimization algorithm, generating a dynamic scheduling strategy of source network charge storage, establishing an energy virtual model, simulating the actual running state of energy in real time, verifying the feasibility of the dynamic scheduling strategy of the source network charge storage and early warning potential risks in advance, and the multi-energy coordination module is used for carrying out multi-energy cascade collaborative utilization through a cooling-heating power system, simulating scheduling scheme execution effect in a virtual environment, discovering potential risks in advance and avoiding economic losses in actual running.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG

title_en: Cascade Transformer fusion method and system based on multi-source heterogeneous geological data
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of geological data, in particular to a cascade Transformer fusion method and system based on multi-source heterogeneous geological data. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a historical paper geological data set and a real-time multi-source geological monitoring data stream, generating a multi-source heterogeneous geological feature set based on the historical paper geological data set and the real-time multi-source geological monitoring data stream, carrying out multi-level feature extraction from coarse to fine and cross-modal attention fusion through a cascading Transformer network based on the multi-level geological data set and the multi-target collaborative optimization calculation based on the multi-level feature extraction from coarse to fine, generating a risk-resource integrated three-dimensional geological model for quantifying disaster risk probability and resource economic value by integrating geological priori knowledge rules, and carrying out optimization of hidden disaster targeting management and resource re-exploitation through a decision mapping engine based on the geological data set, and generating a collaborative optimization engineering scheme set. In the data cascade fusion process, the intelligent level and the comprehensive benefit of geological engineering activities are remarkably improved.

title_en: Power grid cascading failure risk assessment method for wind power direct current output system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid cascading failure risk assessment method of a wind power direct current delivery system, which comprises the steps of 1, establishing a network model of the wind power direct current delivery system according to characteristics of the wind power system, selecting a cascading failure sequence, 2, establishing cascading failure risk assessment indexes suitable for the wind power direct current delivery system, 3, calculating subjective and objective weights of all the cascading failure risk assessment indexes obtained in the step 1,4, linearly combining the subjective and objective weights obtained in the step 3, 5, optimizing the subjective and objective weights obtained in the step 4 by adopting an improved black-wing iris algorithm, further obtaining a risk assessment comprehensive index, and 6, assessing influence degree of the cascading failure on the wind power direct current delivery system by using the risk assessment comprehensive index processed in the step 5. The method solves the problem that the prior method can not comprehensively grasp and evaluate the characteristics of the cascading failure of the wind power direct current output system.
assignees: UNIV XIAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Tunnel crossing strong outburst coal seam group construction risk evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating construction risks of tunnel crossing strong outburst coal seam groups, which comprises the steps of incorporating 15 risk factors of geology, construction technology and operators into a comprehensive evaluation framework, acquiring global comprehensive weights of the 15 risk factors by adopting a fuzzy analytic hierarchy process, inputting the weights into a back propagation neural network as parameters, realizing dynamic prediction of risks, and constructing an intelligent risk evaluation model capable of being updated in real time. The method effectively solves the problem of subjectivity and index dependency in expert judgment, and the method utilizes strong nonlinear mapping and learning capacity to realize dynamic simulation and prediction of complex system risks. The method remarkably improves the tunnel construction risk identification precision and early warning capability under the complex geological environment, and can be widely applied to high-risk underground engineering safety management.
assignees: UNIV KUNMING SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Multi-cascade model-based complex-working-condition offshore floating type photovoltaic array fault diagnosis method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation systems, in particular to a multi-cascade model-based complex-working-condition offshore floating photovoltaic array fault diagnosis method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a photovoltaic array power generation model considering the influence of offshore waves; the method comprises the steps of carrying out fault analysis and feature quantity extraction on an offshore floating photovoltaic array according to a photovoltaic array power generation model, respectively constructing a primary fault diagnosis model based on a GA-LSTM neural network and a secondary fault diagnosis model based on a 1D-CNN-GRU, constructing a collaborative decision mechanism of the primary fault diagnosis model and the secondary fault diagnosis model, determining a fault diagnosis result based on the primary fault diagnosis model, the secondary fault diagnosis model and the collaborative decision mechanism, and effectively improving the diagnosis robustness and accuracy of the system in an offshore complex environment through task decomposition and collaborative processing, and overcoming the limitation of single model adaptability.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST

title_en: Three-phase unbalance dynamic regulation and control method for power distribution network based on hybrid intelligent optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-phase imbalance dynamic regulation and control method for a power distribution network based on a hybrid intelligent optimization algorithm, which belongs to the field of power system automation and comprises the steps of collecting current values and initial phase sequence states of each single-phase load in a power distribution area, establishing a dynamic regulation and control model with minimum three-phase current imbalance degree and minimum switching action times as double targets, solving the model based on an improved genetic algorithm of a fusion experience knowledge guiding mechanism, a pareto optimal selection mechanism and a global and local collaborative search mechanism, generating a phase-change control instruction according to the obtained optimal phase-change scheme, and issuing the phase-change control instruction to a load phase-change switch for execution. The comprehensive improvement of the algorithm in the aspects of convergence speed, solution diversity and global optimality is realized by introducing a gene library to guide the propagation process, a multi-objective selection mechanism based on non-dominant sorting and a local optimization strategy combined with tabu search.
assignees: LANZHOU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Response method and device based on intelligent customer service dialogue state tracking of charging and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a response method, a response device, computer equipment, computer readable storage media and computer program products based on intelligent customer service dialogue state tracking. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a predefined intention slot structure definition set and a historical dialogue data set, inputting the definition set and the historical dialogue data set into a graph neural network model to generate a state graph structure, obtaining semantic input contents of a user in a current round, generating a node context sensing embedded set and a node semantic response strength set by combining an initial node embedded set, determining candidate state scores by combining a platform service state set and a node frequency scalar set, generating candidate state subgraphs and candidate state score vectors according to the candidate state scores, executing graph neural network propagation on the candidate state subgraphs, and determining a current dialogue state, a corresponding slot set and a state propagation path to generate a response strategy for responding the semantic input contents. By adopting the method, the response accuracy to the user request can be improved.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Intelligent bus shelter real-time bus prediction method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent bus prediction, in particular to a method and a system for intelligent bus pavilion real-time bus prediction. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a bus line vector data set, determining a bus operation chained topology table according to the bus line vector data set based on a bus network space-time topological coupling strategy, obtaining a real-time bad weather influence data set, building a bus station pressure propagation network according to the real-time bad weather influence data set and the bus operation chained topology table based on a traffic node load distribution strategy, predicting dynamic pressure influence and networking conduction paths of the dynamic pressure influence on each bus station and each bus line caused by the real-time bad weather, determining a dynamic coupling disturbance conduction network, and predicting the bus condition in the bus operation chained topology table in real time according to the dynamic coupling disturbance conduction network, and outputting and pushing prediction information. The method and the system accurately predict the operation state of the bus in the dynamic scene.
assignees: JIANGXI AODECHUAN AUTOMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fireproof intelligent monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses fireproof intelligent monitoring equipment, relates to the technical field of fireproof monitoring, and aims at solving the problem that the existing fireproof intelligent monitoring equipment cannot be self-protected in a near-ignition condition to cause loss of monitoring capability on the fire condition. The intelligent fireproof monitoring equipment disclosed by the invention has the effects that after the device detects a near-ignition condition and sends an alarm through networking, key equipment used for observation and monitoring on the device is isolated and protected, so that the equipment is isolated from an propagating fire condition, meanwhile, the equipment in the fire condition is ensured not to be self-burned and damaged due to overhigh environmental temperature, and after a fire wire passes through the device, the equipment in the device can normally run and continuously monitor the fire condition, thereby providing real-time fire condition information for firefighters and assisting in improving the coping capability of the firefighters.
assignees: SHANDONG YINGKE INTERNET OF THINGS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Whole-house health environment regulation and control system and method integrating oxygen production and phase change humidification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-house healthy environment regulation and control system integrating oxygen production and phase change humidification, which belongs to the technical field of air conditioning systems. The indoor environment treatment unit is of a vertical laminar flow structure, fresh air circulation, deep purification, oxygen generation, phase change humidification and heat exchange modules are sequentially integrated, a main water tank and a hot water return tank are arranged in the outdoor energy center, energy cascade utilization is achieved, and the building heat exchange network is used as a radiation tail end and is cooperated with an indoor unit to form a regulation strategy of 'mainly radiating and secondarily convection'. The invention realizes the active regulation and control of the indoor oxygen concentration for the first time, and achieves remarkable energy-saving and noise-reducing effects while ensuring healthy and comfortable indoor environment through system-level optimization.
assignees: GUANGDONG WEISEN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban flood rapid mapping method and system based on multi-source data collaborative awareness
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of remote sensing science, in particular to a rapid urban flood mapping method and system based on multi-source data collaborative awareness. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source data to obtain a city flood sample list, dividing the city flood sample list into training samples and test samples, constructing a semantic segmentation network based on the city flood sample list, wherein the network comprises a spectrum feature perception module, a topography feature perception module, a heterologous feature fusion module and a multi-scale feature weighted decoding module, constructing a physical constraint loss function based on the semantic segmentation network, carrying out model parameter backward propagation and minimizing loss values, carrying out iterative training of the semantic segmentation network based on the training sample data and the physical constraint loss function, and finally carrying out quick drawing and accuracy verification of city flood. The invention can break through the limitation of the traditional single data source and network architecture, and promote the identification capability of the global and local flood characteristic information, thereby improving the accuracy of rapid drawing of large-scale urban flood.
assignees: UNIV JIANGXI NORMAL

title_en: Cascade reliability index determination method for multi-level inter-city road network
abstract_en: The application provides a cascading reliability index determining method of a multi-level inter-city road network, which comprises the steps of constructing the multi-level inter-city road network of a target area, calculating initial load and capacity of any first node of the first node set, triggering cascading failure of the multi-level inter-city road network by utilizing an attack strategy based on the betweenness centrality to determine initial failure nodes from the first node set, simulating a cascading failure propagation process by utilizing a multi-path load distribution model driven by identifying equal impedance lines by taking the initial failure nodes as a starting point until the propagation process is finished, and determining the number of newly-increased failure nodes, the network efficiency ratio, the global node cascading failure rate and the local node cascading failure rate of each round in the cascading failure propagation process as cascading reliability indexes of the multi-level inter-city road network. The application improves the authenticity and accuracy of the cascade reliability index of the multi-level inter-city road network of the target area.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING NORMAL

title_en: Smart IoT Fire Alarm System
title_ko: 스마트 IoT 화재 경보 시스템
abstract_ko:
스마트 IoT 화재 경보 시스템이 개시된다.  본 발명의 실시예에 따른 스마트 IoT 화재 경보 시스템은, 소방시설법상 장착되어야 할 구역 및 화재로부터 취약한 경계구역에 다수 장착된 화재감지센서로부터 화재발생정보를 실시간으로 수신하고, 수신된 화재발생정보를 서버에 전달하는 IoT모듈이 내장된 스마트 IoT 화재수신기; 및 상기 스마트 IoT 화재수신기로부터 전달된 데이터를 바탕으로 소방서에 화재관련 신고를 수행하고, 건물 관계인에게 실시간으로 화재수신기 작동 정보를 전송하는 서버;를 포함하는 것을 구성의 요지로 한다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 소방안전관리자들의 휴대폰으로 화재 발생 위치 및 대처 방법을 포함하는 화재 경보 메세지를 자동 발송하여 보다 구체적인 화재발생 관련정보를 소방안전관리자들에게 전파함으로써 호재발생에 대응하여 효과적인 대처를 가능하게 하는 스마트 IoT 화재 경보 시스템을 제공할 수 있다.
assignees: KIM JIN SUK

title_en: High-altitude canyon strong wind forecasting method based on WSTD-KOA-BPNN technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for forecasting the strong wind of a plateau canyon based on WSTD-KOA-BPNN technology. The method comprises the steps of collecting historical wind speed data, temperature and other meteorological element data of a target area of a plateau canyon by using a distributed wind speed sensor, filling missing data points by using a cubic spline interpolation method, carrying out noise filtering by using a wavelet soft threshold denoising algorithm (WSTD), carrying out normalization processing on the denoised wind speed data by using a Min-Max method, optimizing Back Propagation Neural Network (BPNN) parameters based on a KOA Optimization Algorithm (KOA), constructing a KOA-BPNN prediction model, and carrying out real-time monitoring and prediction result output. According to the invention, through fusion WSTD of noise suppression, KOA global parameter optimization and BPNN nonlinear modeling capability, the capturing precision and generalization performance of complex strong wind characteristics of the plateau canyon are remarkably improved, and reliable technical support is provided for disaster prevention and reduction.
assignees: HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER UPSTREAM HYDROPOWER CO LTD;UNIV CHINA THREE GORGES CTGU

title_en: Cascading failure early warning method of power transmission system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascading failure early warning method of a power transmission system, which belongs to the technical field of early warning of power systems and comprises the steps of S1, early warning data preparation, S2, early warning failure screening, S3, early warning grade judgment, S4, early warning execution, S, early warning information output and real-time dynamic update, wherein the early warning data preparation comprises multi-source data acquisition and analysis and quantitative characterization of power grid heterogeneous characteristics, the S2, early warning failure screening comprises simulation model construction and failure searching based on an accident chain, the S3, early warning grade judgment comprises risk value quantitative calculation and risk grade division. According to the cascading failure early warning method of the power transmission system, during operation, the heterogeneous phenomenon of a complex power grid with new energy grid connection in the aspects of operation conditions and grid structures is researched, characterization indexes reflecting the operation conditions of the power grid and the heterogeneous degree of the grid structures are constructed, meanwhile, a cascading failure process analysis model which comprehensively considers new energy and load fluctuation and is suitable for the working condition of a given power grid is built, the influence mechanism of the power grid heterogeneity on the cascading failure is researched, and the problem caused by new energy grid connection is well solved.
assignees: KAIFENG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Water service state on-line monitoring management method and system for intelligent water service
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water service state monitoring and management, in particular to a water service state online monitoring and management method and system for intelligent water service, which form a quantifiable flow direction judging basis by establishing node pressure grading and flow difference, ensure that the flow path and intersection proportion are unified in a calculation level to form a dynamic evolution structure with time-dependent characteristics, enhance the recognition capability of pressure wave propagation and hysteresis response, realize multi-characteristic anomaly synchronous recognition through node pressure anomaly frequency, flow difference rate and long-short-term memory network, reduce random fluctuation false alarm, improve anomaly rejection accuracy and stability, ensure parameter consistency of a constraint coordination system, calculate a matrix of balance indexes and neighborhood influence coefficients and isolate forests to form a quantified stable distribution pattern, realize accurate modeling of a dynamic pipe network, and improve anomaly detection sensitivity, flow direction prediction accuracy and operation stability evaluation reliability.
assignees: CHONGQING INTELLIGENCE WATER CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network fault classification method and system based on deep convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network fault classification method and system based on a deep convolutional neural network, and relates to the technical field of power grids, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining current data and preprocessing; the method comprises the steps of performing wavelet packet transformation on processed data, decomposing current into nodes, calculating wavelets Bao Jishu of each frequency band, extracting time-frequency energy spectrum, dividing the transformed data into a training set and a testing set, inputting the training set into a deep convolution gating neural network, removing time sequence fault characteristics, inputting the training set into a full-connection layer and a Softmax layer, updating network parameters by using a counter propagation BPTT algorithm and a cross loss function, iterating for multiple times to form a high-proportion new energy access distribution network fault classification model, inputting the testing set into the trained fault classification model, and outputting corresponding fault characteristics. According to the invention, the fault characteristics are extracted through wavelet packet transformation, the fault classification model is established, the fault classification speed is high, the accuracy is high, and the application prospect in the power distribution network accessed by high-proportion new energy sources is good.
assignees: KUNMING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Depth learning-based turbid water body holographic turbulent flow field three-dimensional reconstruction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a depth learning-based three-dimensional reconstruction method and a depth learning-based three-dimensional reconstruction system for a holographic turbulent flow field of a turbid water body, which relate to the technical field of underwater optical imaging, and the method comprises the steps of adopting a holographic light path to irradiate the turbid water body and driving a camera to capture a transient holographic interference image sequence; denoising by adopting a noise suppression model, outputting an optimized hologram, positioning particles by using a cascade convolution neural network to generate an initial plane coordinate set, calculating the axial depth of the particles to obtain a transient space coordinate set, executing space-time diagram association and generating a three-dimensional particle field dynamic sequence, and executing flow field inversion to generate a three-dimensional transient turbulence velocity field. The method solves the technical problems that the traditional three-dimensional reconstruction method based on the image is difficult to overcome the noise intensity of the holographic image and the distortion of the particle signal in the turbid water scene, and achieves the effects of effectively resisting the interference caused by the scattering of the turbid water, comprehensively and accurately acquiring key data required by the three-dimensional reconstruction of the turbulent flow field, thereby accurately realizing the technical effect of the three-dimensional reconstruction of the turbulent flow field of the turbid water.
assignees: TIANJIN RESEARCH INST WATER TRANSP ENGINEERING MOT

title_en: Searching method suitable for cascading failure chain containing direct current system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a searching method suitable for a cascading failure chain of a direct current system, which belongs to the technical field of power systems and comprises the steps of S1, preparing early-stage data and converting formats, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting full basic data of a power grid and uniformly converting multi-format data, S2, constructing an accident chain model with non-direct current characteristics, S3, setting failure searching constraint and termination criteria, including limiting a searching range and defining an accident chain termination criterion, S4, dynamically iterating to search the cascading failure chain, S5, screening and verifying a high-risk failure chain, and S6, outputting a searching result.
