The method is suitable for the searching method of the cascading failure chains of the DC system, achieves the screening of high-risk chains by calculating the risk values and simulation verification, and finally outputs the failure chain evolution diagram and the risk parameter table, so that the high-risk cascading failure chains in the AC-DC series-parallel power grid can be accurately positioned, clear failure evolution paths and risk parameters are provided for power grid dispatching personnel, scientific prevention and control strategies are assisted to be formulated, and the occurrence probability of blackout accidents is effectively reduced.
assignees: KAIFENG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Cascade hydropower station cloud native application assembly method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade hydropower station cloud primary application assembly method, in particular relates to the technical field of intelligent power grid dispatching and resource management, and aims to solve the problems that how to assemble a platform through cloud application under a cloud primary architecture, realize high-efficiency circulation and real-time response of full power grid data by using a distributed data processing and intelligent optimization algorithm, and ensure expandability and flexibility of a system. By combining a Yun Yuansheng architecture-based intelligent scheduling system with real-time data stream processing, deep learning and machine learning algorithms, dynamic prediction and intelligent scheduling optimization of power grid load are realized. The method can effectively solve the core problems of lack of real-time response and intelligent scheduling in the prior art, and ensure that the system can adjust the power grid load distribution in real time when the power grid load fluctuates or the number of power stations increases. The method has higher response speed and accuracy, and can dynamically adjust the scheduling strategy according to real-time data feedback, thereby improving the efficiency and stability of power grid operation.
assignees: SHANGHAI INVESTIGATION DESIGN & RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Road water damage disaster rapid identification method and system based on remote sensing image analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid recognition method and a rapid recognition system for highway water damage disasters based on remote sensing image analysis, which belong to the technical field of remote sensing image analysis and disaster detection, wherein the method comprises the steps of extracting a change region of a remote sensing image before and after the disaster through a multi-scale differential twin network change detection module; identifying five types of water damage types, namely roadbed impact damage, pavement collapse, side slope collapse, retaining wall collapse and bridge and culvert damage through a cascade attention water damage semantic segmentation network; calculating a damage degree grade by fusing morphology, spectrum and spatial characteristics through a multidimensional damage degree cooperative evaluation module; the traffic state is judged and the rush repair priority report is generated through the traffic influence self-adaptive quantification module, so that the rapid identification, accurate classification and comprehensive evaluation of the road water damage disasters are realized, and technical support is provided for the post-disaster rush repair and conservation decision.
assignees: Yulin Highway Bureau

title_en: On-Device AI Mediation and Edge Computing-Based Adaptive Precision Positioning Disaster Communication System and Method
title_ko: 온디바이스 ai 중재 및 엣지 컴퓨팅 기반의 적응형 정밀 측위 재난 통신 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 온디바이스 AI 중재와 5G MEC 기반 3계층 아키텍처를 통해 재난 신고와 전파의 정확성·신속성·생존성을 극대화하는 시스템 및 방법이다. 사용자 단말은 적응형 칼만 필터(AKF)로 멀티모달 센서를 융합하여 GPS 음영 지역에서도 정밀 위치를 확보하고, AI 모듈이 허위·중복 신고를 원천 차단한다. 엣지 서버는 ST-DBSCAN 알고리즘을 통해 실시간 재난 클러스터를 형성하며, 중앙 관제 서버는 이동통신사 망 및 민간 플랫폼과 연동된 하이브리드 전파를 수행하고 실시간 도달률 모니터링(ACK)을 통해 미수신자에게 보완 전파를 수행한다. 아울러 통신 인프라 붕괴 시에는 D2D 메쉬 네트워크로 통신을 복원하고, PoA 블록체인을 통해 전 과정의 데이터 무결성을 보장한다.
assignees: LEE JI MIN

title_en: Gangue storage bin intelligent early warning management system based on coal preparation processing
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of intelligent management of ore storage, and discloses an intelligent early warning management system of a gangue storage bin based on coal preparation processing, which comprises a distributed phase change sensing network module, a storage module and a control module, wherein the distributed phase change sensing network module is connected with the storage module; the system comprises a distributed phase change sensing network module, a phase change memory tensor construction module, a memory tensor maintenance module, a multi-time-scale frequency division coupling prediction module, a memory guidance activation control module, a memory learning network reconstruction module and a multi-scale early warning decision module, wherein the distributed phase change sensing network module is connected with the phase change memory tensor construction module, the memory tensor maintenance module is connected with the phase change memory tensor construction module, the multi-time-scale frequency division coupling prediction module is connected with the distributed phase change sensing network module, and the memory guidance activation control module is connected with the multi-time-scale frequency division coupling prediction module. Through integral operation and multi-time scale memory kernel function, the technical effects of structural solidification and deep learning of the time-space evolution information of the historical multi-physical phase change field are achieved, so that the early warning management system can identify key precursor features and propagation paths from historical events, and the knowledge base of early warning decisions is improved.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA GUANGHUI COAL PREPARATION CO LTD

title_en: Power grid line vulnerability identification method, system, medium and equipment considering cascading failure
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of power systems and discloses a method, a system, a medium and equipment for identifying vulnerability of a power grid line in consideration of cascading failures, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring data information in a power system and numbering the power grid line in sequence, and determining a cascading failure triggering criterion, a cascading failure propagation criterion and a cascading failure ending criterion according to the data information; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a fault chain set by using a cascading failure triggering criterion, a cascading failure propagation criterion and a cascading failure ending criterion, traversing the fault chain set, determining the average load loss of a system according to the weight and the load power loss of all fault chains comprising the current power grid line, determining the vulnerability index of the power grid line according to the average load loss, and sequencing the power grid lines according to the vulnerability index of each power grid line to identify high vulnerability lines, so that the vulnerability links of the power grid can be more accurately revealed, thereby effectively preventing large-scale power failure accidents and guaranteeing the safety of a power system.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Multistage cascade wireless fire-fighting system linkage communication path optimization method
abstract_en: The application provides a multistage cascade wireless fire control system linkage communication path optimization method, relates to the technical field of fire alarm, and solves the technical problems that a multistage cascade star network issued fire control linkage control command path is complex and the total communication times are large in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of carrying out upward recursion statistics on linkage node numbers of each node in a communication network when a fire-fighting component to be linked exists under a wireless gateway, calculating path efficiency scores of all potential public ancestor nodes based on the linkage node numbers, selecting the potential public ancestor node with the highest score as the public ancestor node, packaging data packets according to the public ancestor node, sending the data packets to a lower node by using a wireless controller, continuing to send the data packets to sub-nodes of the lower node, clearing the linkage node numbers of the wireless gateway nodes corresponding to the packaged data packets, updating the linkage node numbers of all nodes on a path upwards, and repeating the steps until all the components to be linked are processed.
assignees: BENGBU EI FIRE ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Forestry environment monitoring system for fire alarm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of forest fire alarm, and discloses a forest environment monitoring system for fire alarm. The environment sensing module of the system acquires multidimensional environment parameters of a forest area in real time by means of a distributed sensor network. The fire risk feature extraction module performs multi-scale feature fusion on the parameters, extracts key fire risk features and generates a three-dimensional fire risk feature tensor. The fire propagation deduction module builds a fire propagation dynamics model according to the forest land topography digital elevation model and the historical fire data, and inputs a fire characteristic tensor to calculate a fire diffusion rate and a direction angle. The monitoring strategy optimization module dynamically adjusts the sampling frequency and the space density of the sensor according to the fire diffusion rate, and enables an infrared spectrum scanning mode for a high diffusion rate region. And when the fire spreading rate exceeds a preset threshold value, the emergency response triggering module generates a multi-level linkage control instruction set comprising unmanned aerial vehicle routing inspection path planning and fire-proof isolation belt activation schemes.
assignees: RIZHAO CHAOLI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;Jinan State owned Liubu Forest Farm

title_en: Emergency communication command method for long tunnel construction site based on multi-network fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a long tunnel construction site emergency communication command method based on multi-network integration, in particular relates to the technical field of wireless communication network switching, and is used for solving the problems of command service interruption and session state loss caused by cross-network switching in the existing emergency communication system; the method comprises the steps of continuously monitoring and generating session snapshots containing real-time transmission protocol and transmission layer protocol states in the moving process of a terminal, predicting network coverage weak areas by combining the moving state prediction with an electronic map intelligent predicting network, dynamically selecting an optimal target network based on multidimensional network stability quantitative analysis and digital simulation deduction, pre-distributing resources by a command center, issuing a switching instruction, and finally realizing cross-network seamless switching and complete recovery of service session to realize high-continuity transmission guarantee of emergency command service.
assignees: TIANJIN BRANCH CRSC ENG GROUP COMPANY LTD;CRSC ENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Power grid data processing method and device for offshore wind power, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid data processing method, a device, terminal equipment and a storage medium for offshore wind power, belonging to the field of offshore wind power, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a topological structure of a receiving end power grid, a thermal power and wind power output curve, line transmission capacity limitation, a target line and a target node; the method comprises the steps of calculating static load bearing margin of an alternating current line, carrying out cascading failure simulation based on a target line to obtain line transmission capacity after failure, calculating cascading failure toughness margin based on the line transmission capacity after failure, calculating three-phase short-circuit current for a target node, calculating short-circuit capacity adaptation degree based on the three-phase short-circuit current, carrying out weighted calculation on the static load bearing margin of the alternating current line, the cascading failure toughness margin and the short-circuit capacity adaptation degree to obtain an adaptability evaluation value, and determining an operation state of a receiving end power grid.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Power supply reliability index grading prediction method based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power supply reliability index grading prediction method based on machine learning, which relates to the technical field of power supply reliability grading, and comprises the steps of adding a topological embedded vector and a space-time characteristic tensor into a attention mechanism, calculating the association weight of the topological embedded vector and the space-time characteristic tensor, carrying out weighted fusion, generating a joint characteristic matrix, collecting historical power supply reliability data, constructing a grading strategy model by using a PPO algorithm, splicing the joint characteristic matrix and the historical power supply reliability grading data into a state vector by the grading strategy model, carrying out forward reasoning, generating power supply reliability grading weight, inputting the joint characteristic matrix into a Bayesian neural network, combining the power supply reliability grading weight, and carrying out forward propagation by Monte Carlo to obtain the power supply reliability grade. The invention increases the generalization capability of the model on different time and space scales through a machine learning algorithm, and also improves the accuracy and the robustness of power supply reliability prediction.
assignees: SHIJIAZHUANG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH CO STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Method and equipment for optimally configuring lightning damage grade driving lightning arrester of 10KV distribution line
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of lightning protection of distribution networks, in particular to an optimization configuration method and equipment for a lightning damage level driving lightning arrester of a 10KV distribution line. The method takes grade evaluation, model matching, layout optimization, grounding reinforcement and simulation verification as a main line, provides a set of engineering method and system capable of landing, can ensure the reliability of power supply and simultaneously consider the economical efficiency, and is suitable for differential and refined protection and large-scale deployment of a power distribution network in a lightning damage high-rise area. The method has the advantages that accurate type selection and arrangement according to the sections are realized, the unit length and multiphase concurrent flashover rate are reduced, the remote overvoltage propagation and counterattack discharge risks are restrained, and the lightning protection precision and the practicability of the power distribution system are improved under engineering constraint and economic requirements.
assignees: XIZANG AGRICULTURE AND ANIMAL HUSBANDRY UNIV

title_en: Comprehensive energy system scheduling method considering dynamic cascade and fault chain reaction
abstract_en: The invention provides a comprehensive energy system scheduling method considering dynamic cascade and fault cascade reaction, and belongs to the technical field of energy. The method comprises the steps of constructing a constraint model of the comprehensive energy system based on an equipment model, a dynamic operation constraint model, a coupling constraint model and a pipe network transmission inertia model of the comprehensive energy system, constructing an objective function considering economy, new energy consumption rate, environmental protection, flexibility and reliability based on a flexibility index calculation model and a reliability index calculation model of the comprehensive energy system, optimizing operation parameters of the comprehensive energy system based on an optimization objective and the objective function, calculating flexibility indexes and reliability indexes of the comprehensive energy system under any operation parameter based on a Monte Carlo method and a space-time chain reaction relation, and scheduling the comprehensive energy system based on an objective function value of the comprehensive energy system under the operation parameter and a target value of the operation parameter. The invention can obtain the scheduling effect considering economy, new energy consumption rate, environmental protection, flexibility and reliability.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Urban source network charge storage risk pre-judging method, scheduling method and system in extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a scheduling method and a system for predicting urban source network charge storage risk in extreme weather, wherein the risk predicting method comprises the steps of acquiring real-time information of urban infrastructure states in extreme weather based on disaster-tolerant sensors deployed on urban infrastructure; based on the acquired weather data and real-time information, coupling extreme weather with vulnerability of urban source network charge storage by using a pre-constructed space-time coupling risk conduction model to obtain risk conduction prediction data of the extreme weather on the urban source network charge storage and source network charge storage node alarm information, wherein the space-time coupling risk conduction model is constructed based on a space-time diagram convolution network. The space-time coupling risk conduction model can give consideration to composite conduction pre-judgment of multi-disaster coupling, linkage cascade and tail risk, realizes quantitative prediction on the linkage process of extreme weather-equipment failure-load reduction-energy storage exhaustion, and remarkably improves the risk pre-judgment precision. The disaster tolerance sensor provided ensures the reliability of data transmission.
assignees: STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER ENGINEERING RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Water supply scheduling variable frequency regulation strategy optimization method based on pressure equalization
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water supply reconstruction, and discloses a water supply scheduling variable frequency regulation strategy optimization method based on pressure equalization, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining topographic elevation data and pipe network topology data of a construction area, preprocessing the data, generating topographic gradient feature vectors, calculating gravitational potential energy distribution by using a topographic flow field coupling analysis algorithm, generating a topographic influence coefficient matrix, analyzing pipe network segmentation conditions caused by construction based on a graph cutting algorithm, calculating topology change features of affected sub-networks, and integrating the topographic influence coefficient matrix and the topology change features. According to the invention, the quantitative relation between gravitational potential energy distribution and pressure propagation is established through the terrain flow field coupling analysis algorithm, so that the influence of terrain factors on pressure can be accurately quantified, the pressure compensation requirements of different elevation positions are obtained to be differentiated by introducing the terrain influence coefficient matrix, and the defect that the traditional method simplifies the terrain influence into a single parameter is overcome.
assignees: ZHAOQING HIGH TECH ZONE YUEHAI WATER CO LTD

title_en: Operation and maintenance analysis method, device, equipment and medium of virtual power plant
abstract_en: The application discloses an operation and maintenance analysis method, device, equipment and medium for a virtual power plant, which are used for acquiring structural time sequence data, text data and image data generated in the operation and maintenance process of the virtual power plant, and extracting characteristics of the multi-mode data to obtain multi-mode fusion characteristics. The multimodal fusion feature is then input into the constructed causally enhanced multi-agent fault diagnosis framework for reasoning to determine the root cause of the fault and its propagation path for the virtual power plant. Meanwhile, an equipment health state evaluation model based on meta reinforcement learning is constructed, and the model is combined with the multi-mode fusion characteristics and the dynamic knowledge graph to evaluate the health state of equipment in the virtual power plant and output corresponding maintenance actions. The method and the system can improve the accuracy and the practicability of the operation and maintenance analysis of the virtual power plant, and are beneficial to enhancing the operation reliability, economy and flexibility of the virtual power plant in a complex power grid environment. The application can be widely applied to the technical field of electric power.
assignees: SOUTHERN POWER GRID PEAKING FREQUENCY MODULATION GUANGDONG ENERGY STORAGE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent traffic analysis platform and method for multi-source data fusion for smart city
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent traffic analysis platform and method for multi-source data fusion for smart cities, and relates to the technical field of traffic data analysis. The method comprises the following steps of S1, collecting traffic analysis data in real time, preprocessing the data, S2, dividing an urban traffic network into different space units and different time periods, constructing a space-time joint characteristic data set, quantifying the sensitivity of each space unit and time period combination, screening a sensitive area, S3, quantifying the abnormality degree aiming at the space unit and time period combination of the sensitive area, performing time space clustering and positioning, S4, generating a corresponding emergency response strategy, synchronously evaluating the abnormal risk propagation probability among the space units, adjusting the space early warning range and emergency scheduling measures, and performing visual display and parameter optimization. The problem that traffic anomalies in the edge space and abnormal time periods are easy to ignore and high-risk points of the masses are difficult to discover in time due to the fact that the traditional traffic analysis technology is generally focused on the central hot spot area is solved.
assignees: ZHONGXING HAOTIAN BEIJING CONSTRUCTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic Bayesian network construction risk prediction method based on sliding window self-adaptive learning and particle filtering
abstract_en: A dynamic Bayesian network construction risk prediction method based on sliding window self-adaptive learning and particle filtering relates to the technical field of engineering construction safety management and intelligent prediction. The method comprises the steps of risk factor state input, dynamic Bayesian network topological structure construction, CPT updating based on sliding windows, risk state recursion reasoning based on particle filtering, risk prediction based on forward Monte Carlo propagation, and risk level assessment. The method can efficiently establish the accurate time sequence mapping relation between the risk state and the multisource observation, realize global state estimation and uncertainty quantification by combining a dynamic Bayesian network with particle filtering, and realize quick response and online updating of distributed drift by matching with sliding window self-adaptive learning, thereby comprehensively improving prediction efficiency and precision and early warning timeliness.
assignees: HARBIN INST TECHNOLOGY;FIRST CO CHINA 8TH ENG BUREAU LTD

title_en: Power grid cascading failure probability risk assessment method considering transformer mixed failure
abstract_en: The application discloses a power grid cascading failure probability risk assessment method considering a transformer mixed failure, which comprises the steps of S1, system data acquisition, S2, life end failure modeling, S3, weather related random failure modeling, S4, current related overload protection power failure model building, S5, transformer mixed failure probability model building, S6, double-cycle non-sequence Monte Carlo simulation and S7, reliability index calculation. The power grid cascading failure probability risk assessment method considering the transformer mixed failure integrates life-end failure, weather-related random failure and current-related overload protection outage into a joint outage probability, iteratively updates unavailability of the rest equipment in NMC under new current/new temperature, explicitly simulates cascading propagation, quantitatively outputs EENS, PLC, PCFE indexes, and provides a determinable basis for planning and asset management.
assignees: SUZHOU ELECTRICAL APPLIANCE SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Transport path optimization method and device considering port cascade failure risk
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transportation path optimization method and device considering port cascade failure risk, and belongs to the technical field of port logistics and transportation network optimization. Aiming at the problems of insufficient consideration of systematic risk of a port and easy initiation of chain reaction due to single-point failure in the conventional transportation path planning, the invention provides a comprehensive evaluation and optimization mechanism, which characterizes a port transportation network by constructing a weighted directed graph model, integrates port bearing capacity, historical failure probability and multidimensional external risk factors, and realizes quantitative measurement and calculation of port cascade failure risk. On the basis, a multi-objective optimization function is designed, the minimum product of time and cost is taken as an optimization target, meanwhile, the minimum probability of failure risk of the whole path is restrained, and the optimal transportation path is solved by utilizing algorithms such as gradient descent and the like. By dynamically adjusting traffic distribution, high risk nodes are effectively avoided, and network robustness and transportation reliability are improved. The method can be widely applied to the scenes of international maritime transportation, container scheduling and the like, obviously reduces the transportation cost and the interruption risk, and enhances the capability of coping with emergency events.
assignees: INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS

title_en: Security and protection fire-fighting integrated linkage system and method based on multidimensional sensing
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of intersection of computer technology and intelligent security and fire protection, discloses a security and fire protection integrated linkage method and system based on multidimensional sensing, and aims to solve the problems of isolated security and fire protection system data, single sensing dimension, delayed linkage response and difficulty in studying and judging composite risk events in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of fusing security, fire and three-dimensional space structure data, constructing a unified space-time situation map, identifying abnormal event clusters by utilizing a graph neural network, judging event types by a multi-mode classifier, predicting event evolution trend by combining a risk propagation model, and dynamically generating an integrated collaborative treatment instruction set to drive security and fire equipment to carry out linkage. The system comprises five modules of multidimensional sensing acquisition, data fusion, intelligent research and judgment, strategy generation and linkage execution. The method and the system realize data depth fusion, accurate identification of the compound event, active risk prediction and closed loop cooperative treatment, and remarkably improve the intelligentization and cooperative efficiency of safety response.
assignees: GUANGZHOU KEZE SOFTWARE CO LTD

title_en: Water-light-storage collaborative optimization scheduling method and system based on A3C multi-agent parallel mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-light storage collaborative optimization scheduling method and system based on an A3C multi-agent parallel mechanism, which comprises the steps of constructing a water-light storage collaborative optimization scheduling system operation scene of 'perception-network-application' three layers, constructing a cascade hydropower station group joint scheduling model by taking hydropower station water balance constraint, upstream and downstream hydraulic connection, water level limitation, power generation flow limitation, hydropower station output constraint and channel constraint as constraint conditions, constructing a water-light storage daily dynamic output distribution model by taking the maximum total rewarding value of the water-light storage optimization scheduling system as an objective function, simulating the operation scene and coupling relation of water, light and a power storage station, converting the water-light storage optimization scheduling problem into a Markov process, and realizing efficient exploration and learning of strategies by an A3C algorithm to obtain the optimal scheduling method of the water-light storage optimization scheduling system. The invention can obviously promote the power consumption of the water-light storage optimizing and dispatching system, reduce the phenomena of water and light rejection and ensure the power supply in Xinjiang.
assignees: XINJIANG XINHUA YEERQIANG RIVER BASIN WATER RESOURCES AND HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD;UNIV HOHAI;NANJING NARI WATER CONSERVANCY AND HYDROPOWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Collaborative optimization scheduling method and device for heterogeneous resources, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a collaborative optimization scheduling method, device, electronic equipment and medium for heterogeneous resources, which are used for solving the problems of insufficient regulation and control capability and incomplete scheduling of mass distributed heterogeneous resources at present. The method comprises the steps of applying a cloud-side-end collaborative regulation and control system constructed based on an active power distribution network, a virtual power plant cluster and a multi-element equipment cluster to each virtual power plant of the virtual power plant cluster, obtaining controllable loads and energy equipment data sets transmitted by the multi-element equipment cluster, constructing a controllable load characteristic model based on the controllable loads, constructing a carbon transaction cost model according to the energy equipment data sets, constructing a first optimization regulation and control model of the virtual power plant based on the controllable load characteristic model and the carbon transaction cost model, constructing a second optimization regulation and control model of the active power distribution network with the aim of minimizing the network loss cost of the power distribution network, and carrying out double-layer cascading optimization solving according to each first optimization regulation and control model and each second optimization regulation and control model to obtain an optimization scheduling result.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;HARBIN INST TECHNOLOGY;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Rapid screening method for high-risk cascading failures
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid screening method of high-risk cascading failures, which belongs to the technical field of cascading failure screening of electric power systems and comprises the steps of collecting real-time operation data and off-line stored historical failure data from a power grid dispatching system, obtaining power grid core data in different formats, preprocessing the power grid core data, unifying data formats, adapting simulation tools, constructing a failure screening model by defining accident chain constitution, ending conditions and influencing factors, and reducing the failure searching range. According to the rapid screening method of the high-risk cascading faults, the efficiency is remarkably improved through multiple optimization, on one hand, the fault searching range is limited on a core power supply path of a power supply side-load side, invalid fault combinations of non-key branch lines are eliminated, the calculation space is greatly compressed, on the other hand, the influence degree of the faults is quantized based on a link condition function, only links with influence values exceeding a threshold value are continuously searched, and meaningless path extension is avoided.
assignees: KAIFENG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Electromagnetic radiation array applied to emergency rescue
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of electromagnetic radiation and antenna arrays, in particular to an electromagnetic radiation array applied to emergency rescue, which comprises a Butler matrix of a substrate integrated waveguide, wherein the Butler matrix is formed by cascading a plurality of hybrid couplers, fixed phase shifters and cross couplers, and input ports and output ports of the Butler matrix are interconnected through non-cross waveguide transmission lines. The application is based on the optimized substrate integrated waveguide Butler matrix, obviously reduces the insertion loss and crosstalk of a feed network through port rearrangement and non-intersecting wiring, effectively solves the core problems of weak anti-interference capability, short communication distance and limited network capacity in the traditional emergency communication system, and is suitable for reliable communication and detection tasks of unmanned aerial vehicles or ground mobile platforms in complex emergency environments.
assignees: CHENGDU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Power grid security situation awareness platform and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid security situation sensing platform and a method, which relate to the technical field of power grid sensing and comprise the steps of collecting power grid topology, real-time measurement and meteorological data and constructing a space-time aligned feature matrix; the method comprises the steps of calculating node power anomaly and line weather fragile factors as dynamic characteristics, designing a space-time convolution kernel to construct a graph neural network, extracting node association characteristics in a layered mode, calculating dynamic fault propagation factors through fault permeability and gradient fields, calculating path selection entropy values based on a propagation probability matrix to generate a risk thermodynamic diagram, and dynamically rendering the fault propagation paths by superposing the entropy thermodynamic diagram to a GIS system. According to the method, the early and accurate capturing of the hidden faults of the power grid is realized through a dynamic fault propagation factor algorithm, weak links can be identified before the faults are dominant, and a longer early warning response window is provided for scheduling personnel.
assignees: STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Grid-connected scheduling management method, device, equipment and medium constructed by combining knowledge graph
abstract_en: The application relates to a grid-connected scheduling management method, device, equipment and medium constructed by combining a knowledge graph. The method comprises the steps of constructing a comprehensive data set by integrating multi-source data such as new energy output, power grid topology, load, weather and historical fault records, forming a dynamic knowledge graph by utilizing entity identification and relation extraction technology, constructing a probability causal graph model by extracting causal paths and adding probability parameters, quantifying uncertainty propagation strength by combining a time sequence graph neural network, calculating risk index conditional probability by adopting probability causal reasoning based on the propagation model, simulating a fault propagation sequence by cascading failure theory to realize multi-level risk assessment, generating a self-adaptive scheduling strategy by relying on a multi-objective optimization model and deep reinforcement learning, realizing complete technical closed loop from data fusion, causal reasoning to intelligent decision, and achieving the technical effects of describing the new energy uncertainty propagation path, assessing the power grid risk situation by looking ahead, and dynamically generating an optimal grid-connected scheduling scheme.
assignees: TONGLIAO POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID EAST INNER MONGOLIA ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Grid division-based power distribution network information physical system risk analysis method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grid division-based power distribution network information physical system risk analysis method, a grid division-based power distribution network information physical system risk analysis system, a grid division-based power distribution network information physical system risk analysis device and a grid division-based power distribution network information physical system risk analysis storage medium, and relates to the field of power system risk analysis, wherein the method comprises the steps of analyzing power distribution network related data, establishing a multi-source data space-time corresponding relation, and dividing operation data of a power distribution network physical system and an information system into unit grids and grid groups; the method comprises the steps of searching potential faults to generate a fault event set, carrying out batch simulation on the fault event based on a multi-thread programming framework by adopting a grid group parallel computing technology, quantifying load loss under different faults and generating load loss data, calculating feeder risk coefficients and system risk coefficients based on the load loss data and the introduced defense resource parameters, and quantitatively analyzing risk propagation paths.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power plant carbon footprint accounting space-time data compression and anomaly detection recovery method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power plant carbon footprint calculation space-time data compression and anomaly detection recovery method, which comprises the steps of inputting a correlation network diagram and a carbon emission space-time data sequence into an anomaly detection recovery model, extracting time characteristics of the space-time data sequence and space characteristics of power plant nodes in the correlation network diagram, constructing the time characteristics and the space characteristics into space-time fusion characteristics, modeling a dynamic matrix for describing high-order dynamic correlation relations among the nodes in a time window where the space-time data sequence is located, performing high-order graph convolution propagation on each time step of the space-time fusion characteristics based on the dynamic matrix to obtain a dynamic graph convolution sequence, decoupling trend components and disturbance components of the dynamic graph convolution sequence, respectively compressing and reconstructing the trend components and the disturbance components, fusing the trend components and the disturbance components to obtain fusion reconstruction characteristics, processing the fusion reconstruction characteristics to obtain a reconstructed carbon emission data sequence and data outliers, and repairing the data outliers by using the reconstructed carbon emission data sequence.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Subway freight network operation robustness evaluation method based on cascade failure
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of underground transportation, and particularly relates to a subway freight network operation robustness evaluation method based on cascade failure. The method comprises the steps of establishing a subway freight network cascade failure redistribution policy, constructing a subway freight network cascade failure load redistribution model, constructing a subway freight network robustness assessment index, combining the established subway freight network cascade failure redistribution policy, the constructed cascade failure load redistribution model and a proposed robustness assessment index system, designing an assessment algorithm for the robustness of the subway freight network, and realizing quantitative assessment of the operation robustness of the network under the cascade failure situation. The invention can provide scientific basis for planning and operation management of the subway freight system, and effectively improve the reliability and safety of the urban comprehensive transportation system.
assignees: UNIV NANJING SCI & TECH

title_en: Causal graph neural network grid cascading failure prediction method supporting multi-source heterogeneous data fusion
abstract_en: The application discloses a causal graph neural network grid cascading failure prediction method supporting multi-source heterogeneous data fusion, which relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and comprises the steps of preprocessing grid parameters, calculating the preprocessed grid parameters to obtain importance scores between nodes and edges in a grid, constructing causal subgraphs and deviation subgraphs based on the grid parameters and the importance scores, generating unbiased samples based on the causal subgraphs and the deviation subgraphs, training a graph neural network by using the unbiased samples and cascading failure simulation data sets to obtain a target graph neural network, and sending the grid parameters to be predicted to the target graph neural network to output a grid cascading failure prediction result, so that the limitation of relying on experience rules or preset physical models is avoided, the accuracy and the reliability of predicting the time and the range of cascading failures in the grid are improved, and the safety of the grid is improved.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING POSTS & TELECOM;MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power distribution network information physical coupling risk propagation deduction method, system, equipment and medium based on hidden Markov model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent power distribution networks and discloses a power distribution network information physical coupling risk propagation deduction method, a system, equipment and a medium based on a hidden Markov model. According to the method, complex information physical coupling risk events are disassembled into independent risk event sets, so that characteristics of each risk event can be analyzed in depth, risk influence can be estimated accurately according to multivariate information such as an originating side, a damage loss type, occurrence probability and influence range, propagation mechanisms of risks at different layers are described clearly, workers can position risk sources quickly, and effective measures are taken to block risk propagation.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power outage risk prediction method, device, equipment, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The application discloses a power failure risk prediction method, device, equipment, storage medium and program product, and belongs to the technical field of power failure risk prediction. The method comprises the steps of receiving text information of a power system, carrying out deep semantic understanding on the text information of the power system by using a preset language model, extracting key information comprising fault equipment, fault reasons and influence ranges, carrying out scanning matching on the text information of the power system by using a preset keyword library to obtain risk keywords and corresponding real-time risk weights, finding new candidate risk keywords, inputting the key information into a pre-constructed power system knowledge graph to locate fault entities and determine associated topological subgraphs, inputting the topological subgraphs into a graph neural network model to carry out power failure risk propagation deduction to obtain potential linkage fault information, and carrying out power failure risk prediction by using a dynamic risk rule library to obtain power failure risk early warning information. The embodiment of the application can effectively improve the accuracy of power failure risk prediction.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Double-layer international railway freight network toughness assessment method based on cascade failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade failure-based dual-layer international railway freight network toughness assessment method, which belongs to the technical field of road traffic network assessment and comprises the steps of constructing a topology model of a basic circuit network and a transportation service network, constructing a network assessment system and an importance assessment system of each node in the network, constructing a cascade failure-based network vulnerability assessment model, combining each network and assessment model, simulating a cascade failure condition through a simulation experiment, and evaluating the network by combining the assessment system, wherein the model adopts a node state model for improving CML and a cargo redistribution strategy. The invention takes the characteristics of international railway freight into consideration, constructs a double-layer coupling network of a basic line network and a transportation service network, establishes a multidimensional toughness evaluation index system and a cargo allocation mechanism, and can simulate the cascade failure condition in the international railway freight network.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG

title_en: Landslide evolution based dynamic identification method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic identification method and a device based on landslide evolution, which relate to the technical field of landslide identification and comprise the steps of constructing a space-time similarity matrix based on a direction consistency item and a space adjacent item of monitoring point data, and constructing a matrix to represent total energy by decomposing characteristic values of the space-time similarity matrix; according to space-time similarity matrix analysis, obtaining a main energy concentration index, calculating the standard deviation of the energy concentration as a fluctuation measure in combination with a sliding time window, judging the development stage of the main energy concentration index, the fluctuation measure and a fluctuation constraint condition according to matrix representation total energy to obtain a sliding belt development stage result, training a depth feedforward neural network based on a back propagation algorithm, and inputting slope parameters, rock-soil mass parameters and the sliding belt development stage result into the trained neural network to predict a slope safety coefficient to obtain a sliding slope evolution result. The invention solves the problem of insufficient recognition precision in the slide belt forming stage.

title_en: Multi-dimensional risk quantitative analysis method, system, equipment and storage medium for CPS (control system) of power distribution Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-dimensional risk quantitative analysis method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for CPS (control system) of a power distribution Internet of things, and relates to the field of information side and physical side fusion, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining key factors influencing CPS risk by relying on physical equipment and information system data of the power distribution Internet of things, constructing a multi-level and multi-dimensional risk evaluation index system, analyzing the association coupling effect and risk conduction rule of system components, and establishing a fault propagation model; the method and the system can accurately evaluate CPS risk of the power distribution Internet of things, assist operation and maintenance personnel to prevent and control in advance, reduce power failure risk, optimize power grid planning and improve operation efficiency and economic benefit.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Group intelligent driven cascade reservoir autonomous negotiation scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a group intelligent driven cascade reservoir autonomous negotiation scheduling method which comprises the steps of firstly generating a scheduling basic data set, respectively packaging reservoir nodes of a cascade reservoir group into independent reservoir units, carrying out parallel calculation and distributed negotiation on each reservoir unit through a group fusion negotiation strategy based on interaction data of the local scheduling basic data set and a neighborhood reservoir unit, generating a preliminary scheduling scheme, adopting a distributed negotiation mode of a contract network protocol or a bidding mechanism based on the function type of the reservoir units by the group fusion negotiation strategy, determining a preliminary scheduling scheme by taking the minimum transaction cost among the reservoir units as a core objective function and combining flood control, power generation and ecological multi-objective weight coefficients, carrying out digital twin simulation verification, carrying out fine adjustment to obtain a final scheme, and carrying out intra-group coordination in priority and group linkage in case of abnormality. The method improves dispatching efficiency, ensures multi-objective balance of flood control, power generation and the like, and enhances risk resistance.
assignees: YELLOW RIVER INSTITUTE OF HYDRAULIC RES;Yellow River Laboratory

title_en: Wind power soft direct delivery system hardware-in-the-loop equivalent modeling and simulation method and device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of new energy simulation, and discloses a method and a device for modeling and simulating the hardware-in-the-loop equivalent of a wind power system through flexible direct delivery, wherein the modeling method comprises the steps of modeling a converter of a wind power unit in a form of a switching function, performing equivalent modeling on a wind power station collecting wire based on a constant power loss principle, modeling an alternating current delivery circuit in a multi-pi cascade structure with multiple resistor and inductance parallel branches, modeling each bridge arm of a flexible direct current converter station in an average value model, modeling a receiving end power grid in a controlled voltage source and equivalent RLC impedance, and constructing a hardware-in-the-loop equivalent model of the wind power system through flexible direct delivery based on the modeling model. According to the invention, through respectively carrying out equivalent processing on each part, model simplification is carried out, simulation requirements are reduced, meanwhile, the simulation precision and accuracy of the whole system can still be ensured, and finally, the rapid and accurate simulation of wind power through the flexible direct current grid-connected system is realized, so that the real-time simulation requirement of hardware in the ring is met.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Load type virtual power plant resource pool optimization method based on industrial risk modeling
abstract_en: The application discloses a load type virtual power plant resource pool optimization method based on industrial risk modeling, and belongs to the technical field of power systems and energy Internet. The method comprises the steps of firstly constructing a resource association network based on an industry input-output relation, then simulating a dynamic propagation process of industry risks in the resource network by adopting an SIRS model, describing an evolution rule of a resource long-period adjustable capacity, further combining power grid topological faults and scheduling requirement fluctuation, constructing a short-period disturbance scene, generating a multi-time scale scene tree through combining long-period uncertainty and short-period uncertainty, clustering and extracting a typical scene set, finally constructing a double-layer random optimization model, optimizing resource pool structure selection at the upper layer, optimizing scheduling strategies at the lower layer, and introducing a resource long-period stability coefficient by the lower layer model through capacity boundary constraint to realize collaborative optimization of structure and scheduling. The application effectively improves the benefit redemption capability and the risk resistance robustness of the load type virtual power plant in a complex uncertainty environment.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Power grid operation fault prediction and abnormal trend early warning method, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid operation fault prediction and abnormal trend early warning method, equipment and medium, which are used for constructing a four-element fault sequence based on power grid multi-source data and realizing second-level fault evolution dynamic tracking. By updating the topological base diagram of the power grid in real time, the problem of model hysteresis is solved, and the accuracy of the propagation path is improved. And the electric coupling strength is introduced as the edge weight of the graph convolution network, and the electric topography of the power grid is etched in the vector space, so that the calculation is simplified and the accuracy is improved. And similarity diffusion is carried out by using the topological embedded vector, so that a high-precision influence range subgraph can be generated in millisecond level, and prediction distortion is avoided. Converting the subgraph into a local monitoring area, quickly constructing a low-dimensional fault state vector, integrating a dynamic fault propagation map, and clearly displaying fault tracing, paths and termination logic. Finally, by means of the graph attention network, the risk probability and the multidimensional influence index of the nodes are output by one key, an early warning instruction is automatically generated, and the second-level control and protection capability of the power grid is obviously enhanced.
assignees: LINYI POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Intelligent sensing, identifying and compiling system for power grid communication overhaul risk
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent sensing, identifying and compiling system for power grid communication overhaul risks, which belongs to the technical field of power grid overhaul analysis and is used for solving the technical problems of poor flexibility and reliability of active implementation of power grid communication overhaul risk identification and compiling in the existing scheme, capturing the associated risks of power grid communication network nodes, links and topology through a space-time convolution and attention mechanism, continuously learning in a digital twin environment by using reinforcement learning intelligent agents, realizing online evolution of overhaul strategies, flexibly selecting high-risk inhibition, high-resource investment or balance strategies according to power grid operation scenes through generated pareto optimal solutions, visualizing an output risk propagation path and a reinforcement learning decision process, automatically converting the pareto optimal solutions into execution strategies through intelligent contracts, effectively improving the resource utilization rate through a real-time feedback and deviation adjustment mechanism, and reducing the deviation of actual values and predicted values of the risk inhibition rates.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD YANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network operation risk assessment method based on traffic flow transmission theory
abstract_en: The power distribution network operation risk assessment method based on the traffic flow transmission theory comprises the steps of constructing a weather state transfer model to obtain probability distribution under different meteorological conditions, establishing a photovoltaic output probability density function based on Beta distribution to generate a photovoltaic output scene, establishing a space-time propagation model of photovoltaic disturbance in the power distribution network, introducing dynamic influence of line current on temperature, establishing a line resistance temperature correction model, establishing a power flow correction model based on LWR model output disturbance density on the basis of a power flow calculation result, constructing a comprehensive risk assessment index system comprising dimensions such as voltage out-of-limit, line overload and system loss, applying the established comprehensive risk assessment index system to an IEEE node system, carrying out simulation verification based on MATPOWER software packages under a MATLAB environment, and analyzing dynamic evolution characteristics of the power distribution network operation risk under the traffic flow transmission theory. The method realizes the whole process fine evaluation from disturbance generation to propagation diffusion through a multi-dimensional modeling and dynamic coupling mechanism.
assignees: UNIV CHINA THREE GORGES CTGU

title_en: Cascade water-light complementary scheduling method for distribution network system with multiple uncertainty of water-light load
abstract_en: The invention provides a cascade water-light complementary scheduling method of a distribution network system with multiple uncertainty of water-light load. Belongs to the field of power system dispatching optimization. The method comprises the steps of combining a cascade hydropower station power generation model, a photovoltaic power generation model and a distribution network system model, establishing a cascade water-light complementary power generation joint optimization scheduling model, converting the cascade water-light complementary power generation joint optimization scheduling model into a two-stage robust optimization model, performing linearization treatment, decomposing the two-stage robust optimization model into a main problem and a sub-problem, relaxing the decomposed sub-problem and constructing a new objective function to obtain an infeasible test sub-problem, and iteratively solving the main problem, the sub-problem and the infeasible test sub-problem to obtain a daily scheduling plan. The invention considers the multiple uncertainties of the natural water supply and the photovoltaic output of the small hydropower station, digs the power generation flexibility of the cascade hydropower station to realize the improvement of the photovoltaic digestion capacity, and realizes the efficient solution of the model by providing a linearization method and a sub-problem feasibility test method of the hydropower model.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: Expressway construction area risk situation sensing method based on environment sensing
abstract_en: The invention relates to an expressway construction area risk situation awareness method based on environment awareness, which comprises the steps of deploying a multi-source sensing device network along the expressway construction area and at key structure positions to collect data and label, constructing and training an expressway construction area risk situation awareness model, obtaining a trained model through counter propagation and joint optimization of all trainable parameters of the model, deploying the trained model to a construction area edge computing platform, outputting a final prediction result through the trained model according to the data collected in real time, judging whether early warning is carried out or not according to the prediction result, calibrating the risk position and grade, and continuously screening a high confidence sample through a pseudo tag self-enhancement module to carry out fine tuning on the model. According to the invention, the constructed model is trained, so that the construction risk can be predicted more quickly and accurately, workers are guided to carry out emergency treatment in time, and the safety index in the construction process is improved.
assignees: SHANDONG LUQIAO GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Power grid mountain fire prediction method based on causal driving and space-time diagram convolution network
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid mountain fire prediction method based on a causal driving and space-time diagram convolution network, and belongs to the technical field of mountain fire prediction. Designing dynamic and static feature encoders to extract weather time sequence information, geographical space environment and high-dimensional space-time features of multi-source heterogeneous data of power transmission line distribution, constructing a causal graph topology of dynamic evolution by adopting a causal discovery algorithm, identifying real causal driving relations among variables, decoupling causal strength matrixes into positive and negative adjacent matrixes, designing causal constraint graph rolling modules to aggregate and propagate high-order information, and finally realizing precise prediction of mountain fire of a power grid. The causal GCN layer in CSTGCN model extracts the space dependent features by utilizing the adjacency matrix of causal structure constraint, and CSTGCN model embeds causal structure information into a space-time feature learning frame, so that the causal structure information has higher prediction precision and generalization performance.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Vehicle public opinion intelligent analysis method and system based on Internet of vehicles, product and vehicle
abstract_en: The application provides a vehicle public opinion intelligent analysis method, a system, a product and a vehicle based on the Internet of vehicles, and relates to the technical field of vehicle public opinion analysis, wherein the method utilizes a cross-modal attention mechanism to dynamically evaluate and weight emotion contribution degrees of all data sources by comprehensively integrating vehicle-mounted system logs, in-vehicle voice, social media videos and other multi-modal data in the Internet of vehicles, thereby effectively overcoming the one-sided performance of single-modal analysis and improving the accuracy and robustness of public opinion emotion judgment; the method further comprises the steps of deep mining public opinion propagation information by means of a space-time diagram neural network, constructing a propagation path model, generating an event-emotion-propagation force three-dimensional thermodynamic diagram, realizing visual insight and trend prediction of public opinion evolution situation, constructing a local and external cooperative hierarchical emergency response mechanism on the basis, relieving anxiety of users, and effectively restraining poor public opinion diffusion.
assignees: CHINA FAW GROUP CORP

title_en: Digital twinning-based modeling method for underground pipe network of power grid engineering area
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of digital twinning, and in particular relates to a modeling method of an underground pipe network in a power grid engineering area based on digital twinning, which comprises the steps of initializing a digital twinning model of the underground pipe network, carrying out gridding on the digital twinning model, and calibrating static parameters; the method comprises the steps of carrying out state propagation on particles representing states of grid nodes based on a state transfer equation of a plurality of coupled physical fields to obtain predicted particles, evaluating engineering risk degrees of all the grid nodes, determining the engineering risk degrees based on construction risk coefficients, state uncertainty and safety margin, reallocating the particles according to the engineering risk degrees, fusing heterogeneous sensor data, calculating the weight of the predicted particles, calculating a state optimal estimated value of the grid nodes according to the normalized weight of the predicted particles, and updating the digital twin model. The method and the device realize non-uniform distribution of computing resources to the key areas, and improve model estimation precision and real-time performance of risk early warning.
assignees: State grid shanghai electric power design co ltd

title_en: Method for inhibiting cascading failure of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for inhibiting cascading failures of a power system, which comprises the steps of formulating a first strategy and a second strategy by judging the scale of the cascading failures, wherein the first strategy is a reinforcement learning algorithm based on a feature separation technology and a PPO (point-to-point) improvement algorithm, and the second strategy is combined with the first strategy based on imitation learning. The invention can obviously improve the dispatching efficiency for solving the cascading failure of the power system, can provide intelligent auxiliary decision for a power grid dispatching center and improves the emergency response capability of large-scale power grid faults.
assignees: UNIV SOOCHOW

title_en: Supply chain demand prediction and risk early warning method and system based on multi-source data
abstract_en: The application relates to a supply chain demand prediction and risk early warning method and system based on multi-source data, comprising the steps of collecting multi-source heterogeneous data and constructing a feature vector set; the method comprises the steps of establishing a supply chain network topology structure, inputting a feature vector set and the supply chain network topology structure into a risk propagation model to obtain a risk space-time distribution map, inputting the feature vector set and the risk space-time distribution map into a demand prediction model to obtain collaborative prediction result information, generating a node criticality distribution map based on the supply chain network topology structure, comparing the node criticality distribution map, identifying high-risk nodes, obtaining risk level information and generating hierarchical risk early warning information.
assignees: SHENZHEN MAIGEBAO TECH CO LTD

title_en: Risk grading method for fusion of tunnel seismic wave data and geological information
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster early warning, in particular to a risk classification method for fusion of tunnel seismic wave data and geological information, which comprises the following steps of S1, collecting amplitude, frequency response and propagation delay information of multi-time-phase seismic waves of a tunnel, identifying abnormal response events, extracting spatial propagation paths of the abnormal response events by combining a tunnel structure, and generating a seismic wave induction response event chain set; S3, calculating trend activating factors by counting the liveness, the derivative direction and the time sequence trend of the structural units in the conduction diagram, and generating a risk level map with predictability and evolution capability. According to the method, the dynamic, accurate and predictive hierarchical assessment of the tunnel structure risk is realized by constructing the seismic response event chain and the structure conduction network, fusing multi-source geological information and introducing trend activating factors.

title_en: 1.5-Dimensional transmission line matrix model construction method, system and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 1.5-dimensional transmission line matrix model construction method, a system and a medium, which comprise the steps of establishing a basic equation for the propagation of a partial discharge signal in a conductor circuit, introducing a radial layered equivalent RL network structure of a conductor on the basis of a traditional one-dimensional transmission line matrix model, establishing a first model, taking a tower structure and an accessory connection part thereof as impedance discontinuous units, modeling by adopting a multi-section cascade TLM sub-model to obtain a second model, obtaining a second model-level link tower impedance model, and solving the first model and the second model by combining in a time domain according to the basic equation to form a solving structure of the 1.5-dimensional transmission line matrix model. The invention simultaneously considers the skin effect and the impedance discontinuity of the transmission line to carry out the matrix modeling of the high-frequency overhead line time domain transmission line, and solves the problem of larger deviation between the simulation result and the actual measurement.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: Data processing method and system of water regime monitoring real-time management platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water regime monitoring, in particular to a data processing method and a data processing system of a water regime monitoring real-time management platform. The method comprises the steps of obtaining pipe network multipoint pressure monitoring data, counting pressure change fluctuation characteristic data of each monitoring point according to the pipe network multipoint pressure monitoring data, determining a pipe network operation state based on the pipe network multipoint pressure monitoring data and the pressure change fluctuation characteristic data, detecting pressure anomaly deviation trend data of each monitoring point according to the pipe network operation state, determining a disturbance propagation path in the pipe network according to the pressure anomaly deviation trend data, determining pipe network pressure distribution unbalance characteristics according to the pressure anomaly deviation trend data and the disturbance propagation path in the pipe network, and determining the damage condition of the structural integrity of the pipe network based on the pipe network pressure distribution unbalance characteristics. According to the method, the position of the abnormal source is reversely calculated by analyzing the time difference and the propagation rule of the abnormality detected by each monitoring point.
assignees: ZHUJIANG HYDROLOGY WATER RESOURCE EXPLOR CENTER

title_en: Intelligent power distribution equipment state on-line monitoring and evaluating method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent power distribution equipment state on-line monitoring and evaluating method and system, which relate to the technical field of intelligent power grids and comprise the steps of obtaining fault characteristic data of target equipment, carrying out semantic mapping based on a power distribution equipment knowledge graph, and acquiring a candidate source device set through the topological connection relationship, calculating a time sequence consistency score and a tracing confidence coefficient, determining a fault source device, extracting a fault propagation link and a transmission mechanism, and generating an analysis result. The invention realizes the rapid positioning and tracing of the faults of the power distribution equipment, improves the fault processing efficiency and reduces the power failure loss.
assignees: STATE GRID JIBEI POWER CO LTD SMART DISTRIB NETWORK CENTER

title_en: Deep learning-based intelligent hierarchical prediction method, system, equipment and medium for power grid alarm signals
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent operation and fault diagnosis of electric power systems, and discloses an intelligent hierarchical prediction method, an intelligent hierarchical prediction system, intelligent hierarchical prediction equipment and medium for electric power network alarm signals based on deep learning, wherein the intelligent hierarchical prediction method, the intelligent hierarchical prediction system, the intelligent hierarchical prediction equipment and the medium comprise the steps of constructing a heterogeneous graph network comprising equipment, alarm and defect nodes through a multi-mode feature extraction step; the method comprises the steps of adopting an improved graph attention network fused with power grid topology information to extract space association features, utilizing a transducer encoder with causal mask to extract time sequence association features, deeply fusing space-time features through a cross attention mechanism, outputting a four-level defect prediction result and an uncertainty quantization index based on an evidence theory, and realizing continuous learning of a model through self-adaptive online optimization. The method effectively overcomes the defect of insufficient modeling of the topological association and the time sequence causal relationship of the power grid in the prior art, and remarkably improves the accuracy of alarm classification, the identification capability of cascading failures and the rapid adaptability to new scenes.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: System and method for predicting power grid abnormality deduction and evaluating scheduling efficiency in extreme scene
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid abnormal deduction prediction and scheduling efficiency evaluation method and system in an extreme scene, wherein the method comprises the following steps: S1, acquiring core characteristics of each extreme scene and power grid operation parameters and preprocessing; S2, performing time feature extraction based on preprocessed power grid operation parameters, converting the current power grid topology into a graph structure based on graph theory, performing space feature extraction according to the power grid topology graph structure, fusing the extracted time feature vector and the space feature vector to obtain a fused multi-mode feature vector, S3, performing deduction prediction on the abnormal probability of the power grid in the extreme scene by taking the multi-mode feature vector and the extreme scene core feature vector as input of an abnormal deduction prediction model, and S4, constructing an evaluation dimension and index system and dynamically evaluating the dispatching efficiency of the power grid in the extreme scene. The invention reduces the prediction deviation of the extreme scene and remarkably improves the capability of predicting cascading failures under disasters such as typhoons, ice disasters and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Efficient wind farm system reliability assessment method and system based on graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wind power plant system reliability high-efficiency evaluation method and system based on a graph neural network, wherein the method comprises the steps of modeling uncertainty and spatial correlation of wind speed through Weibull distribution and a t-Copula function, and capturing time correlation by combining a vector autoregressive model so as to generate a wind speed sequence with space-time correlation; sampling the wind power plant output state and the element fault scene by adopting a non-sequential Monte Carlo method, constructing a minimum output reduction mixed integer linear programming model considering spare cable switching, introducing a graph neural network based on double graph topology, establishing a mapping relation between the fault scene and the output reduction through cooperative training of a full-set edge supervision graph and a closed edge propagation graph, realizing EWOL rapid regression and edge classification of a branch switch state, and balancing the precision of graph stage and edge task through a weighted joint loss function. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of efficiently estimating the average loss power of the sample and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV CHONGQING POSTS & TELECOM

title_en: Power line image processing method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power line image processing method, a device, equipment and a medium.
