The method comprises the steps of obtaining an original inspection image of a power line, preprocessing the original inspection image to obtain a target inspection image, inputting the target inspection image into a target semantic segmentation model, and outputting the semantic segmentation image of the power line, wherein the target semantic segmentation model adopts a double-branch feature extraction architecture and comprises a main extraction network layer and an auxiliary extraction network layer, the main extraction network layer is formed by cascaded multi-scale convolution modules, the feature extraction end is connected with a multi-directional perception convolution module, and the auxiliary extraction network layer comprises a shallow convolution module. According to the technical scheme, the feature extraction is respectively carried out by adopting the double-branch structure in the target semantic segmentation model, so that the real-time segmentation accuracy of the power line image is ensured, the model parameter quantity and the operation quantity are obviously reduced, and the model reasoning speed is obviously improved.
assignees: XUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH CO STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;JIANGSU XUDIAN CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic power station health assessment and prediction method based on self-attention mechanism and space-time diagram neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic power station health assessment and prediction method based on a self-attention mechanism and a space-time diagram neural network. The method comprises the following steps of S1, data acquisition and preprocessing, S2, space-time diagram construction, S3, multi-dimensional attention space-time diagram network (MAST-GNN) model construction and forward propagation, S4, a multi-task output layer and model output, S5, model training and optimization, and S6, model deployment and application. According to the invention, comprehensive health monitoring and early warning are carried out on the photovoltaic power station through a deep learning technology, and two functions of evaluation and prediction are seamlessly integrated, so that comprehensive and integrated intelligent management on the health condition of the photovoltaic power station is realized, and the operation efficiency and safety of the power station are improved.
assignees: MCC HUATIAN NANJING ELECTRICAL ENGINEERING & TECH CO LTD;MCC HUATIAN ENG & TECH CORP;HUATIAN NANJING ENGINEERING & TECHNOLOGY CORP MCC

title_en: Intelligent monitoring and evaluating method and system for power quality of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent monitoring and evaluating method and system for electric energy quality of a power distribution network, which relate to the technical field of electric energy quality management of an electric power system and comprise the steps of constructing a node electrical correlation matrix, and mapping harmonic characteristic vectors to form a harmonic propagation characteristic diagram; performing spatial cluster analysis on the feature map, constructing a boundary convergence algorithm to locate pollution source nodes by using the ratio of the electrical distance to the harmonic impedance, matching the pollution source features with a preset library to identify the type of equipment, and constructing a multi-objective optimization model to generate a treatment scheme. The invention realizes the accurate positioning and identification of the harmonic pollution source and improves the power quality management efficiency.
assignees: STATE GRID JIBEI POWER CO LTD SMART DISTRIB NETWORK CENTER

title_en: Wheat pest remote monitoring and early warning method, device, equipment and medium based on intelligent agriculture
abstract_en: The application relates to a wheat pest remote monitoring and early warning method, device, equipment and medium based on intelligent agriculture. The method comprises the steps of generating a disease occurrence probability distribution map through collecting multisource environment data of a wheat field, combining real-time meteorological data, outputting a predictive disease space-time risk probability field through a disease propagation dynamics model, calculating information value evaluation scores of each node, generating an elastic scheduling strategy based on the information value evaluation scores, collecting new rounds of multisource environment data to optimize model parameters and replay a disease propagation dynamics model after the elastic scheduling strategy is executed, generating an updated disease space-time risk probability field, and generating early warning information of wheat diseases and insect pests by combining a preset early warning threshold value. By adopting the method, the intelligent interaction between the virtual model and the physical perception network can be realized, the problems of missed detection of the high-risk area and resource waste of the low-risk area in the traditional static sampling mode are effectively solved, and the accuracy and the high efficiency of monitoring the wheat diseases and insect pests are improved.
assignees: TIANSHUI AGRICULTURAL SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Hub connection public transportation network cascade failure analysis method based on capacity load model
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for analyzing cascade failure of a junction public transportation network based on a capacity load model aiming at the problem of analyzing cascade failure of a passenger junction public transportation network. The method comprises the steps of (1) extracting site operation intensity, determining site capacity, establishing a capacity load model to redistribute invalid passenger flows, (2) determining site repair time, establishing a model analysis invalid passenger flow recovery propagation mechanism, updating site loads, and (3) extracting network efficiency evaluation indexes, analyzing key parameter influences and providing optimization suggestions. The invention provides a coupling method for constructing a double-layer public transportation network, establishes a full-period simulation model for the passenger flow transfer of the transportation junction public transportation network, provides a theoretical basis for the organization and optimization of the transportation junction network, and effectively improves the overall service level of the transportation junction.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST;NANJING MODERN INTEGRATED TRANSP LABORATORY

title_en: Real-time monitoring and early warning method and system for hoisting operation of wind generating set
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time monitoring and early warning method and a system for hoisting operation of a wind turbine generator, and relates to the technical field of wind turbine generator construction, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a digital twin model of a hoisting operation site, collecting state data in real time for dynamic coupling, and constructing a virtual monitoring network; the method comprises the steps of carrying out short-time Cheng Chaoqian parallel simulation in the network to obtain future state track clusters under different potential interferences, extracting key safety index time sequences from the track clusters, calculating future instability risk probability, generating multi-level early warning information and triggering active intervention when the risk probability exceeds an adaptive early warning threshold value. The invention solves the technical problems that the instability risk is difficult to identify and intervene in time due to the lack of real-time prediction of the system state in the complex environment in the existing hoisting operation of the wind generating set, and achieves the technical effects of real-time early warning and effective intervention in the hoisting process by constructing a digital twin monitoring network and performing risk propagation prediction.
assignees: ZHONGWEI MAIDUOSHAN NEW ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Multi-source risk identification method and device for foundation pit
abstract_en: The application discloses a foundation pit multisource risk identification method and device, which realize quantitative description of dynamic association relation among risk factors by constructing a dynamic risk propagation network, fusing multisource monitoring data and adopting a causal and related joint modeling method, break through the limitation of a traditional static analysis model, realize real-time identification and trend prediction of risks in the foundation pit construction process and ensure the safety of foundation pit construction. Further, the embodiment of the application combines the node centrality analysis and the weighted path identification mechanism, quantitatively identifies the key risk factors and the high risk propagation channel, and improves the stability and traceability of the risk identification result through the time aggregation mechanism, thereby obviously enhancing the accuracy and engineering adaptability of foundation pit risk control.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;GUANGZHOU METRO GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network multisource risk intelligent early warning method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The application relates to an intelligent power distribution network multi-source risk early warning method based on artificial intelligence, in particular to an intelligent power distribution network multi-source risk early warning method based on artificial intelligence, which aims to solve the problems of low power distribution network risk early warning accuracy, high false alarm rate and difficult prospective pre-judgment in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source heterogeneous data such as weather, equipment states, loads and topology and constructing a fusion matrix of unified space-time references, extracting key risk features through principal component analysis and self-encoder joint dimension reduction, constructing a dynamic risk evolution model by using a gate control circulation unit neural network to predict risk probability distribution of 15 minutes to 2 hours in the future, combining a graph convolution network with an improved Dijkstra algorithm to deduce a risk space-time propagation path, and realizing five-level risk level judgment by adopting fuzzy comprehensive evaluation and automatically releasing grading early warning information.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGHANG RUOYI ELECTROMECHANICAL ENG CO LTD

title_en: Power grid black start system and method based on step hydroelectric characteristics
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of recovery control of an electric power system, in particular to a power grid black start system and a method based on cascade hydropower characteristics, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a software and hardware integrated system integrating physical equipment and intelligent control; the system comprises a software and hardware integrated system, a central decision unit, a synchronous phasor measurement unit PMU, a central decision unit, a power grid framework expanding step by step, wherein the software and hardware integrated system is used for carrying out situation awareness, automatically identifying a power outage range of a power grid after a large-area power outage, positioning an available step hydropower station, automatically triggering a black start plan, simultaneously instructing a plurality of upstream hydropower station start units according to preset rules to establish a plurality of independent power islands, each power island is used for transmitting power to a next-stage transformer substation or a power station in parallel after stabilizing own frequency and voltage, carrying out regional collaborative recovery, dynamically distributing loads to be recovered, carrying out synchronous parallel operation by utilizing real-time phase angle difference data provided by the synchronous phasor measurement unit PMU, and carrying out synchronous parallel operation on a plurality of subsystems which are operated stably.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Deep learning-based supply chain prediction and dynamic adjustment system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of supply chain management, in particular to a deep learning-based supply chain prediction and dynamic adjustment system, which comprises a data acquisition module, a data preprocessing module, a prediction model construction module, a risk assessment module, a decision support module, an execution module, a simulation and optimization module and a monitoring and reporting module, wherein the prediction model construction module utilizes a deep neural network comprising an LSTM (link state machine) and an attribute mechanism to construct a demand prediction model, the risk assessment module innovatively introduces a topological data analysis method, and generates three sub-modules to realize accurate identification and quantification of risks through topological feature extraction, risk propagation modeling and intelligent response, the decision support module generates an optimal inventory strategy and a supply chain adjustment scheme based on prediction data and a risk assessment result, and the execution module is integrated with an ERP (enterprise resource planning), a WMS (wireless local area network) and a provider system through an API (application program interface), and an automatic execution purchase plan), so that high-precision prediction and dynamic adjustment of a supply chain are realized.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG

title_en: Construction whole process engineering consultation management method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a device, equipment and a medium for building whole process engineering consultation management. The method comprises the steps of obtaining local priori update data of all participating objects of a project, wherein the local priori update data are used for representing dynamic propagation conditions among all risk factors, integrating the local priori update data of all participating objects based on preset reputation weight parameters of the participating objects to obtain normal priori update data, updating a preset federal Bayesian network according to the normal priori update data to obtain a dynamic Bayesian network, the federal Bayesian network comprises nodes and connecting edges, the nodes are all the risk factors, the connecting edges are used for representing standard priori propagation probabilities among all the risk factors, risk propagation simulation is conducted on the dynamic Bayesian network to obtain engineering risk propagation reports, and the engineering risk propagation reports are used for representing the risk factors existing in the project and influences caused by the risk factors. By adopting the method, the accuracy of the engineering management of the whole process of the building can be improved.
assignees: GUO QING

title_en: Strategic mineral resource overseas supply chain risk space-time monitoring and early warning method and equipment based on complex network and improved SEIR infectious disease model
abstract_en: The application provides a strategic mineral resource overseas supply chain risk space-time monitoring and early warning method and equipment based on a complex network and an improved SEIR infectious disease model, which are applied to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the steps of surrounding strategic mineral resource overseas supply chain risk monitoring and early warning, integrating supply chain multi-class data, identifying a critical path based on an algorithm, generating network topology information, modeling five risk causal relations by adopting a Bayesian network to obtain risk conduction information, preprocessing unstructured text, designing an NLP model to generate risk identification information, setting evaluation rules according to multi-level requirements to generate evaluation information, optimizing and improving SEIR model parameters to generate risk propagation prediction information, defining Agent behavior rules to generate evolution simulation information, and finally integrating multi-source data to generate full-flow intelligent early warning response information containing monitoring, early warning and plan matching to realize risk dynamic monitoring and efficient response.
assignees: UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES BEIJING

title_en: Space-time associated transformer area voltage risk event identification method, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, equipment and medium for identifying a voltage risk event of a space-time associated transformer area, which are characterized in that a voltage risk space-time cube covering a future preset period is constructed for each dynamic cluster, the space-time cube forms a three-dimensional data structure by two-dimensional space and one-dimensional time, voltage distribution of each node in the cluster in the future period is obtained through time sequence trend calculation, voltage values are quantized into risk indexes by adopting a continuous risk scoring function to form a visualized risk space-time distribution pattern, a 3D convolutional neural network is adopted to carry out deep processing on the space-time cube, a space-time speckle pattern of low voltage risk is extracted, propagation and evolution characteristics of risks in space-time dimension are effectively captured, the space-time speckle pattern is divided into independent risk events through multidimensional connected domain analysis, characteristic parameters such as space-time boundary, risk intensity and the like are marked for each event, data authenticity of a risk identification process is ensured, risk capturing capacity is improved, and overall risk identification efficiency and accuracy are improved.
assignees: ZHUMADIAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Urban waterlogging disaster chain modeling and blocking method based on large language model and complex network analysis
abstract_en: A modeling and blocking method for urban waterlogging disaster chains based on large language models and complex network analysis belongs to the field of disaster prevention and reduction. The method comprises the steps of inputting multi-source media texts into data, automatically extracting disaster events and causal relations thereof by using a large language model, analyzing and calculating support, confidence and lifting degrees among the events through association rules, constructing a weighted directed disaster chain network for describing cascading propagation relations of urban waterlogging events, identifying key nodes and fragile propagation paths based on indexes such as centrality, connectivity and network efficiency of complex network theory calculation nodes and edges, designing progressive node and edge removal experiments, evaluating various intervention strategies, and determining an optimal disaster chain blocking scheme. The invention can realize automatic modeling and quantitative analysis from unstructured text data to disaster chain network, rapidly identify key transmission links and system weak points in waterlogging, and remarkably improve the identification precision, analysis efficiency and scientificity of prevention and control decisions of urban waterlogging disaster chains.

title_en: Space-time self-adaptive power prediction system and method for mountain area distributed photovoltaic power generation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space-time self-adaptive power prediction system and a space-time self-adaptive power prediction method for mountain area distributed photovoltaic power generation, in particular to the technical field of fault prediction and health management, which are used for solving the problems that in the prior art, the accuracy of power prediction and equipment health state assessment is affected due to the fact that environmental characteristic data reconstruct benchmark drift is caused by equipment performance attenuation; the method comprises the steps of constructing a space-time data sequence by acquiring historical data of a photovoltaic unit, constructing a space-time correlation network of power generation among devices and evaluating the performance stability of a reference device group, analyzing a performance attenuation space-time mode to identify common characteristics and individual characteristics when the stability does not meet the conditions, analyzing a propagation path of the performance attenuation on the space-time correlation network based on characteristics, evaluating critical points, performing reference correction on environmental characteristic data by utilizing the common characteristics and the critical points, and finally performing power generation prediction and device health state evaluation by using the corrected environmental characteristic data, thereby realizing the improvement of prediction accuracy and health management reliability.
assignees: STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD QIMEN COUNTY POWER SUPPLY CO;MATERIAL CO OF STATE GRID TIBET ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Interlayer heat dissipation equalization and signal interference suppression system for multilayer circuit board
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multilayer circuit board interlayer heat dissipation balancing and signal interference suppression system, which relates to the technical field of multilayer circuit boards, and comprises a parameter acquisition module, a coupling analysis module, an electric field suppression module and a heat dissipation scheduling module; the invention collects multi-dimensional field parameters between layers through a sensor array arranged in each interlayer gap of a multilayer circuit board, analyzes the coupling association degree, coupling interference propagation path and influence rule among a thermal field, an electric field and a magnetic field, dynamically adjusts the potential distribution of each grounding point of the grounding network by butting the grounding network of the multilayer circuit board, blocks the propagation path from the source of electric field coupling interference, and avoids signal distortion caused by field coupling; dividing the interlayer region of the multilayer circuit board into a plurality of independent radiating unit regions, identifying the thermal field intensity and the magnetic field disturbance degree of each region based on thermal field distribution and magnetic field disturbance rule data, and realizing hierarchical radiating resource distribution by calculating radiating resource distribution coefficients and dividing radiating grades.
assignees: BOLUO JINGKE ELECTRONIC CO LTD

title_en: Cooperative scheduling method, device and equipment of power grid unmanned aerial vehicle and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooperative scheduling method, device and equipment for a power grid unmanned aerial vehicle and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an initial inspection work order and effective coverage area data of at least one fixed airport, wherein the effective coverage area data are obtained by calculation based on a three-dimensional signal propagation attenuation model, constructing a multi-objective optimization function, primarily distributing the initial inspection work order to the fixed airport meeting the conditions based on the multi-objective optimization function and a preset constraint condition, and determining a target airport for executing the emergency inspection task based on the priority of the emergency inspection task, the initial inspection work order and a collaborative scheduling mechanism simulating market bidding under the condition that the emergency inspection task is received, and scheduling the target airport to execute the emergency inspection task. The technical effects of improving the allocation rationality of the inspection tasks, guaranteeing the efficient execution of emergency tasks and optimizing the utilization of fixed airport resources are achieved.
assignees: JIANGSU FANGTIAN POWER TECH CO;UNIV NANJING AERONAUTICS & ASTRONAUTICS;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Composite energy storage topology simulation design optimization method for enhancing safety and stability of power grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy storage topology regulation, in particular to a composite energy storage topology simulation design optimization method for enhancing the safety and stability of a power grid, which comprises the steps of obtaining a high-frequency component of a history regulation period of a cascade multiport topology; the method comprises the steps of analyzing a peak value stage and regulating and controlling the requirement condition of the whole process on power energy storage, constructing an expected electric energy requirement classification model of each cascading multiport topology, inputting high-frequency components of a requirement frequency modulation period of a target cascading multiport topology into the expected electric energy requirement classification model to obtain the high-frequency requirement gain degree of the target cascading multiport topology, correcting the power of real-time high-frequency components of the target cascading multiport topology according to the high-frequency requirement gain degree, and performing scheduling optimization of the composite energy storage topology by utilizing the corrected real-time high-frequency components and real-time low-frequency components. The invention aims to avoid the situation that static energy storage is easy to judge the actual discharge capacity within the future duration time by mistake and improve the safety and stability of the composite topology.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH;XUJI ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Novel source load-oriented power distribution network sensitive data flow anomaly detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel source load-oriented power distribution network sensitive data flow anomaly detection method and system, which comprise the steps of defining a three-dimensional space of power distribution network data, fusing associated features by utilizing an associated fusion matrix, generating a fused feature vector, constructing three cross verification functions, mutually verifying different dimensions of time sequence, physics and topology by utilizing the three cross verification functions to obtain a verification error result, dynamically adjusting a weight coefficient in a comprehensive consistency measurement according to the historical verification error result, calculating the comprehensive consistency measurement according to the weight coefficient, judging that anomalies exist when the comprehensive consistency measurement exceeds a threshold value, creating a propagation model of anomaly data among different dimensions, and reversely solving the anomaly source by sparse optimization according to the observed deviations by utilizing the propagation model. The method can be used for rapidly locking the key abnormal nodes, and improves the operation and maintenance efficiency.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RESEARCH INSTITUTE;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Building Entry and Exit Electric Vehicle Fire Hazard Detection System
title_ko: 건물 진출입 전기차 화재 위험 감지 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 다양한 건물 및 주차시설의 진출입시설에서 활용 가능한 건물 진출입 전기차 화재 위험 감지 시스템에 관한 것이다. 전기차의 화재 위험이 충전시에만 한정된 것이 아니라 충전 및 주행을 반복하는 전주기에 발생하므로 건물 진출입시 화재 위험 여부를 판단하여 화재 발생 초기에 신속하게 대상 차량을 침수, 열차단포등의 조치로 인명과 재산을 대량 참사로부터 건물내 주차전에 보호해야 할 필요가 있다. 본 발명은 기존의 진출입로에 설치된 주차 차단기와 연동 또는 독립적으로 동작하며 다음과 같이 구성된다.건물 진출입 전기차 화재위험 감지 시스템은 진입한 차량을 일반차(내연기관)과 전기차(전기차, 하이브리드 자동차, 수소전기차)로 구분 위한 각종 센서와 카메라 기반의 차량 정보 획득 장치(11a), 열화상 카메라(11b)의 열화상 이미지에서 획득한 열화상 이미지에서 발화를 확인하는 화재 판단 모듈(12b)과 일반차와 전기차를 구분하는 차량 인식 모듈(12a) 및 출입 차단 모듈(13a)과 경광등-사이렌(13b), 위험정보를 생성 및 전파하는 긴급 통신 모듈(14a)을 포함한다.
assignees: CHANG JOON WOO

title_en: Remote controlled composite disaster response supplies smart storage box control system
title_ko: 원격제어형 복합재난 대응 물품 스마트 보관함 관제 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 방호물품 및 긴급 의약품의 위급사항대비 물품을 보관하는 스마트 보관함(100), 스마트 보관함(100)과 통신네트워크를 통해 연결되어, 스마트 보관함(100)으로부터 환경정보와 중량정보와 수량정보를 수신하여 실시간 모니터링하고, 도어락을 제어하고 재난전파정보를 전송하는, 재난상황 통제 관련 스마트 보관함 플랫폼(200), 및 스마트 보관함 플랫폼(200)과 통신네트워크를 통해 연결되어, 스마트 보관함(100)을 실시간 모니터링하고 원격제어하는 관리자 단말기(300)를 포함하여, 스마트 보관함 플랫폼(200)에 의해 스마트 보관함(100)의 본체(110)와 경광등(130)을 원격제어하여 위급사항에 대비하도록 하는, 원격제어형 복합재난 대응 물품 스마트 보관함 관제 시스템을 개시한다.
assignees: T HUB CO LTD

title_en: Oil transportation safety supervision method and device based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence-based petroleum transportation safety supervision method and device, and relates to the technical field of petroleum transportation, comprising the following steps of S1, quantification of transportation chain safety factors and construction of intrinsic risk indexes; S2, obtaining a dynamic dangerous field index, S3, constructing a safety control priority index, S4, constructing a risk coupling propagation model, S5, quantifying response intensity, outputting a multi-strategy response coefficient, S6, automatically deriving a final intervention instruction, and constructing a safety supervision device based on the steps. The system can identify the intrinsic risk, the transient risk and the cross-node linkage risk in the transportation chain in real time, automatically screen the proper regulation and control strategy according to the risk propagation intensity, and finally generate the intervention instruction capable of being directly executed. The method realizes the upgrading of the safety supervision from 'point-level monitoring' to 'networked, predictive and active safety control', and greatly improves the overall safety level and the operation reliability of the petroleum transportation system.
assignees: UNIV YANGTZE

title_en: Geological disaster real-time monitoring system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster real-time monitoring system based on the Internet of things, which relates to the technical field of geological disaster intelligent early warning, and aims to acquire original data such as earth surface displacement, rainfall, and earth sound signals through a multi-source sensing acquisition module, extract disturbance characteristics and calculate disturbance entropy and energy indexes through an edge intelligent processing module, construct a regional topological map through a graph neural network, predict propagation paths and risk probabilities of induction factors, fuse weather prediction and the topography factors to construct a multidimensional mapping model, identify disaster development trend, judge whether to enter a critical state and trigger early warning based on a causal reasoning map, dynamically adjust sensor sampling frequency and communication priority through combining historical abnormal similarity, realize resource optimization configuration, and the intelligent monitoring and early warning system has the advantages of high identification accuracy, high response speed, low energy consumption and strong deployment adaptability, and is suitable for intelligent monitoring and early warning of geological disasters such as landslide and debris flow.
assignees: SICHUAN NO 8 GEOLOGICAL BRIGADE

title_en: Audit risk early warning method, device, equipment and storage medium based on dynamic AI model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an audit risk early warning method, device, equipment and storage medium based on a dynamic AI model, and relates to the technical field of digital audit, comprising the steps of acquiring historical audit data and real-time business data, and carrying out dynamic risk identification on the historical audit data and the real-time business data based on an industry vertical large model to obtain an initial risk score; the method comprises the steps of inputting an initial risk score into a self-adaptive threshold model to obtain a dynamic risk threshold, carrying out risk judgment on real-time business data based on the dynamic risk threshold to generate a risk early warning signal, inputting the risk early warning signal into a knowledge graph module to carry out association analysis to obtain a risk propagation network, generating a risk early warning report based on the risk propagation network and uploading the risk early warning report to a group audit digital comprehensive platform to obtain audit risk early warning result data, and realizing dynamic risk identification on history and real-time data at the same time, wherein the risk score is automatically updated along with business changes.
assignees: HUADIAN SHAANXI ENERGY CO LTD;CHINA HUADIAN CORPORATION LTD

title_en: Quantum Monte Carlo-based power grid fault situation quantum simulation system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for quantum-based grid fault situation quantum simulation, which are used for carrying out data processing based on grid data to obtain a simplified grid model based on quantum states, constructing a parameterized quantum circuit by adopting a quantum variation algorithm based on the simplified grid model of the quantum states, carrying out grid fault simulation on the parameterized quantum circuit on a quantum computer by adopting a Monte Carlo simulation algorithm, obtaining fault scene probability distribution by measuring the quantum bit state of the parameterized quantum circuit, and carrying out statistics according to the fault scene probability distribution to generate a grid fault evaluation report. The method solves the technical problems that when the existing grid fault analysis method based on Monte Carlo simulation is used for processing the cascade fault problem of a large-scale complex grid, a large amount of calculation resources and time are needed, the calculation cost is high, the multistable operation mode of the grid is difficult to effectively process, and the accuracy of the grid risk assessment is reduced.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST CO LTD CSG;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Energy time sequence prediction method and device based on frequency domain decoupling and multi-scale fusion
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence and energy time sequence prediction, and provides an energy time sequence prediction method and device based on frequency domain decoupling and multi-scale fusion. The method comprises the steps of 1) carrying out feature embedding and normalization preprocessing on input energy time series data, 2) carrying out frequency domain analysis by adopting fast Fourier transform, carrying out multi-scale division and reconstruction according to the cycle length of a main cycle component so as to extract multi-scale cycle features, 3) constructing a double-branch structure combining a gating unit and a multi-head attention mechanism, respectively modeling long-term trend dependence and short-term dynamic features, 4) distinguishing the relationship between homogeneity and heterogeneity of variables based on pearson correlation coefficients, 5) realizing structured information propagation among multiple variables by utilizing a graph convolution network, and outputting prediction results of a plurality of time steps in the future through a linear projection layer, and 6) deploying the model in a plurality of energy monitoring systems for long-time sequence prediction of energy scenes such as natural gas flow, electric load, solar energy yield and the like. The method can effectively capture the association relation between the multi-scale periodic rule and the complex variable of the energy time sequence data, thereby improving the prediction precision of the energy system and the intelligent level of operation scheduling.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Electric vehicle charging demand prediction method based on vehicle-pile-network interactive coupling model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of electric automobiles and intelligent traffic systems. The electric vehicle charging demand prediction method based on the vehicle-pile-network interactive coupling model is characterized by comprising the following steps of 1, taking a data layer as a system input end, integrating an electric vehicle track data set, actual traffic network data obtained from an OSM open platform, the number of electric vehicles on station of a real-time charging station and distribution network parameter data, 2, constructing a cross-domain collaborative model based on data layer output by a model layer, 3, extracting urban trip OD matrix distribution from the track data, generating a traffic flow space-time thermodynamic diagram, providing macroscopic demand input for path planning, and 4, carrying out multi-layer cascade simulation on the data layer, the model layer and an algorithm layer, establishing a three-layer closed-loop simulation frame, and finally simulating and predicting electric vehicle charging demand load. The method predicts the charging demand in real time.
assignees: YICHANG CHANGJIANG SANXIA ANDIAN TECH CO LTD;YICHANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV CHINA THREE GORGES CTGU

title_en: Enterprise risk early warning method, device, equipment and medium based on big data
abstract_en: The application relates to an enterprise risk early warning method, device, equipment and medium based on big data. The method comprises the steps of respectively extracting time dynamic characteristics and space topological characteristics of nodes through dynamic heterogeneous risk graphs, generating unified space-time embedded representation through cross-modal fusion, adopting nonlinear propagation effects of event logic enhanced dynamic heterogeneous composition attention network modeling risk events, outputting enhanced node representation and global representation, obtaining topology residual scores through deviation of topology residual detection calculation nodes and community mean values, obtaining representation similarity scores through minimum similarity of similarity analysis calculation nodes and known risk prototypes, linearly combining and normalizing the two scores to generate unknown risk scores, calculating the known risk probabilities based on a pre-training model, obtaining comprehensive risk indexes through maximum value operation, achieving comprehensive monitoring and early warning of known and unknown risks of enterprises, and remarkably improving coverage range, accuracy and timeliness of risk identification.
assignees: UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Buried pipeline failure prediction method based on space random field and dynamic corrosion model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a buried pipeline failure prediction method based on a space random field and a dynamic corrosion model, which is characterized in that the space distribution of environmental parameters is analyzed by constructing the space random field model of soil pH value and resistivity, the actual condition of the soil environment is reflected more accurately, the corrosion process is described more accurately by simulating the non-stationary characteristic of corrosion pit growth in a dynamic gamma process, the spatial dependence of adjacent pipe section corrosion increment is quantized by adopting a Copula correlation model, the propagation rule of corrosion in space is understood better, the failure probability of the whole pipe network universe is calculated by a Monte Carlo simulation method, scientific basis is provided for pipeline maintenance and management, the transition of a high risk area is early-warned by utilizing a self-adaptive grid discretization technology to realize the accurate management and control of the service life of the pipe network, and compared with the traditional prediction model, the method can predict the failure condition of the buried pipeline more accurately and provide powerful guarantee for the safe operation of the pipeline.
assignees: PUYANG POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Fault traveling wave positioning method and system for power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution network fault positioning, in particular to a power distribution network fault traveling wave positioning method and a power distribution network fault traveling wave positioning system, wherein a distributed traveling wave sensing unit synchronously collects transient signals and extracts initial traveling wave arrival time; the method comprises the steps of constructing a self-adaptive wave speed model based on line physical parameters to calculate equivalent propagation speed, dynamically generating a traveling wave propagation tree according to a real-time switch state to determine an effective monitoring path, determining a preliminary fault point by adopting an optimization algorithm based on the propagation path and actual arrival time, calculating a consistency index of the traveling wave polarity of adjacent nodes, starting a multi-hypothesis tracking mechanism in a preliminary point neighborhood when the consistency index is lower than a threshold value, carrying out confidence weighting evaluation by combining a traveling wave attenuation model, and outputting an accurate positioning result. According to the invention, through the cooperation of dynamic topology mapping, self-adaptive wave speed correction and multi-source closed loop verification, the precision, reliability and self-adaptive capacity of fault positioning in a complex power distribution network environment are obviously improved, and the operation and maintenance requirements of rapid self-healing are met.
assignees: ZHANGJIAKOU POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID JINBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LIMITED

title_en: Multi-dimensional historical data-based distribution network material supply chain node load analysis method, equipment, medium and product
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, equipment, medium and product for analyzing the load of a power distribution network material supply chain node based on multidimensional historical data, and relates to the technical field of power distribution network material supply chain management, wherein the method comprises the steps of extracting the spatial characteristic and the temporal characteristic of the load of the supply chain node; the method comprises the steps of constructing a dynamic effective capacity model of a node according to physical attribute data, constructing a multi-factor demand generation model according to business logic data and time characteristics, predicting node load demands, defining a composite load index according to the dynamic effective capacity model of the node and a node load demand predicting result, quantifying the load state of the node to obtain a load quantifying result, constructing a power distribution network supply chain space-time network according to space characteristics and the load quantifying result, and identifying key bottleneck nodes by utilizing a node load pressure propagation algorithm. The application can reveal potential bottlenecks and risk points of the supply chain and provide data support for network structure optimization and emergency strategy formulation.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECHNOLOGICAL RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Meteorological-driven rural highway risk prediction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a weather-driven rural highway risk prediction method which comprises the steps of constructing a road-weather double-map structure based on input road network information and weather lattice point information, fusing roads and weather information based on a cross-domain attention propagation mechanism, generating road-weather fusion feature vectors, introducing road physical attribute vectors based on the generated road-weather fusion feature vectors, carrying out feature interaction fusion and nonlinear modulation through fusion physical priori feature modulation to obtain feature vectors modulated through physical constraint, inputting the modulated feature vectors into an edge-center collaborative reasoning frame to carry out risk prediction, carrying out collaborative calculation of edge nodes and center nodes to realize local quick response and global fine optimization, carrying out model parameter update through a prediction-inspection hierarchical feedback mechanism based on the result of the risk prediction, and generating a visualized risk map and management strategy. The method can realize rural highway risk prediction with high precision, high real-time performance and long-term self-adaption capability.
assignees: FUJIAN PROVINCIAL TRANSPORTATION RESEARCH INST CO LTD;UNIV FUJIAN

title_en: Regional risk assessment method based on warning information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional risk assessment method based on alarm information, which relates to the technical field of public safety and emergency management information and is characterized in that by collecting multidimensional position data of an alarm occurrence place, a home, a working place and the like of a disaster-bearing individual, and constructing a region association network under multi-level spatial resolution, defining a region risk index, a risk hot spot region and a risk source diversity index based on network side weights and spatial distances, and realizing comprehensive quantitative evaluation from microscopic individual behaviors to macroscopic region risks. The invention can fully utilize the data of the existing information system, effectively identify the risk propagation path and the hot spot area, improve the early warning accuracy and the self-adaptive capacity, and provide scientific basis for emergency decision of the emergency.
assignees: TIANJIN RENAI COLLEGE

title_en: Demand side resource hierarchical classification method based on interaction behavior driving factors
abstract_en: The application provides a demand side resource hierarchical classification method based on interaction behavior driving factors, which comprises the steps of obtaining a current clustering label set of a current demand side resource set by adopting a clustering total model constructed based on a convolutional neural network, a self-encoder and a Gaussian mixture model, obtaining a current behavior feature set and a current interaction influence index set of the current demand side resource set by adopting a dynamic factor analysis model constructed based on a graph neural network, obtaining a hierarchical classification result of the current demand side resource set according to the current clustering label, the current behavior feature set and the current interaction influence index set by adopting a hierarchical classification model, and constructing the hierarchical classification model based on a historical demand side resource set, the clustering total model, the dynamic factor analysis model, a self-adaptive deep cascade forest and multi-task reinforcement learning. The method has the advantages of high data processing efficiency and precision, prediction accuracy, deep improvement of decision support and strong adaptability in complex environments, and improves the intellectualization and accuracy of resource scheduling.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST CO LTD;MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Dynamic prediction and analysis method and system for water supply network node pressure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for dynamically predicting and analyzing the pressure of a node of a water supply network, which relate to the technical field of intelligent monitoring of the water supply network and comprise the steps of obtaining topological structure data, historical pressure and flow time sequence data of the water supply network, and generating a pressure flow characteristic matrix through multidimensional analysis; the method comprises the steps of carrying out time sequence dimension reduction on a feature matrix, extracting time dimension features to construct an optimized feature vector, inputting the optimized feature vector into a variable structure depth neural network for training to obtain a pressure prediction model, analyzing the feature matrix to identify peak time, dividing the feature vector in the peak time, constructing a pressure propagation space topological graph based on the feature vector in the peak time, calculating the relevance of pressure propagation time delay to generate a correction coefficient, inputting the feature vector into the prediction model to obtain an initial prediction value, and combining the correction coefficient and topological structure data to generate a dynamic pressure prediction result. The invention improves the accuracy of the pressure prediction of the water supply network.
assignees: NORTH CHINA MUNICIPAL ENGINEERING DESIGN & RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent supervision management and control system for engineering construction number
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent supervision and control system for engineering construction numbers, and relates to the technical field of engineering construction supervision. The system comprises an information acquisition module, a data fusion layer module, an analysis monitoring module, a built-in progress calculation and prediction unit, a deviation judgment unit and a digital modeling unit, wherein the information acquisition module is used for acquiring equipment states, images and environmental data, the data fusion layer module is used for cleaning, aligning and Kalman filtering fusion of multi-source data to generate multi-mode construction data streams, the analysis monitoring module is used for updating the progress states based on XGBoost models and analyzing node dependency relations by utilizing a graph neural network, calculating deviation propagation risk coefficients and generating a grading deviation signal by combining three-level judgment conditions, and the management and control layer module is used for executing grading response according to the grade of the deviation signal and feeding execution effect data back to the front end module to realize model optimization and closed loop iteration. The invention realizes intelligent perception, risk prediction and self-adaptive management and control of the construction process, and improves the instantaneity, accuracy and autonomy of engineering supervision.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGKE GUOJIN ENGINEERING MAN CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Network situation awareness method based on heterogeneous graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a network situation awareness method based on a heterogeneous graph neural network, which comprises the steps of cleaning and standardizing structured data, constructing a unified semantic space based on a subject priori, forming a robust sample representation by adopting a cross-modal alignment and attention fusion method, aligning time, entities and link relations of different platform data, extracting a trigger-argument-role triplet, fusing explicit/implicit propagation evidence to construct a directed propagation graph, obtaining candidate paths through causality consistency, and screening key links by means of multipath reliability and saliency inspection, so as to realize origin positioning and cross-platform association. The method can realize network situation awareness with locatable origin, trackable path and interpretable result under multi-source heterogeneous and high-noise scenes, improves robustness through saliency control and multi-path fusion, improves decision reliability through calibration and uncertainty propagation, and can be applied to scenes such as public safety monitoring, public opinion research and judgment, compliance wind control and the like.
assignees: UNIV CHENGDU INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY;INFORMATION ENGINEERING UNIV OF PEOPLES LIBERATION ARMY OF CHINA

title_en: Commercial district passenger flow prediction method based on graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and mainly relates to a business district passenger flow prediction method based on a graph neural network, which aims to solve the problems that the prior art cannot dynamically describe the propagation of passenger flow in a complex junction, lacks multi-source real-time data deep fusion, is difficult to adapt to real-time control in model structure solidification, and lacks closed-loop decision support from prediction to intervention; the invention integrates four real-time data of passenger flow, traffic, commercial activities and external environment by constructing a dynamic adjustable business district physical network, and fuses multi-source characteristics for network nodes; further, combining a graph neural network with time sequence modeling, and dynamically learning passenger flow rules among nodes; finally, conducting diversion scheme simulation and comparison based on a prediction result to form a decision closed loop of 'perception-prediction-simulation-intervention'; the method has the dynamic adaptation and real-time response capability, and realizes the transition from passive early warning to active dispatching optimization.
assignees: DENGHUO XINGQIU BEIJING INTERNATIONAL DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Comprehensive quantitative evaluation method and system for fault probability of power distribution equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a comprehensive quantitative evaluation method and a comprehensive quantitative evaluation system for fault probability of power distribution equipment, which relate to the technical field of power distribution equipment, and realize intelligent management of fault prediction and maintenance strategy of the power distribution equipment by integrating a physical information neural network, abnormal score analysis, a space-time diagram neural network, maintenance decision calculation and the like, improve the accuracy and reliability of the fault prediction, reduce false alarm rate through probability output and support uncertainty quantization; the system has the advantages of enhancing the sensitivity of anomaly detection, facilitating early warning and priority sequencing, improving the response speed of the system to an anomaly state, comprehensively modeling space and time dependence, optimizing risk assessment and resource allocation, reducing cascade fault risks, generating a data-driven maintenance strategy, improving maintenance efficiency and quality, reducing cost and downtime, generating dynamic risk portraits through attribution analysis, supporting real-time monitoring and decision making, and enhancing the transparency of the system.
assignees: SHENYANG INST ENGINEERING

title_en: Model-energized supply chain risk early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a model-energized supply chain risk early warning method and system, which comprise the following steps of detecting whether an abnormal ordering block exists in acquired supply chain data, if so, carrying out supply chain path restoration according to the abnormal ordering block to obtain a risk link diagram, inputting the risk link diagram into a preset time sequence diagram neural network model to carry out risk conduction analysis to obtain risk probability distribution and a prediction influence range, generating a risk early warning report based on the risk probability distribution and the prediction influence range, and pushing the risk early warning report to a relevant decision maker to support risk prevention and control and emergency response, thereby solving the technical problem that the conventional method cannot judge a path of abnormal order propagation in time, and the risk early warning is often delayed from a process of actual risk occurrence.
assignees: SHENZHEN WANHENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for predicting generated power
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for predicting generated power, which relates to the technical field of electric power and is used for improving the prediction accuracy of the generated power in a wind-solar storage system. The method comprises the steps of obtaining predicted environment data, wind power generation equipment parameters and photovoltaic power generation equipment parameters, determining first predicted power generation power according to the predicted environment data, the wind power generation equipment parameters and the photovoltaic power generation equipment parameters, inputting the predicted environment data into a trained power generation power prediction model to obtain second predicted power generation power, establishing the power generation power prediction model based on a long-short-term memory network LSTM model and a genetic algorithm-back propagation GA-BP neural network model, and carrying out weighted summation on the first predicted power generation power and the second predicted power generation power to obtain predicted power generation power.
assignees: XINXIANG POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Analysis early warning method based on agricultural product price analysis model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an analysis and early warning method based on an agricultural product price analysis model, which relates to the technical field of intelligent agriculture and intelligent supply chain management and comprises the following steps of integrating climate data, historical yield, logistics cost and market transaction information of each main production area, and constructing a full-chain data set covering production to circulation; based on the full chain data set, the time-space correlation of climate influence between main production areas is captured by adopting a graph rolling network, and hysteresis characteristics of a production sequence are extracted by combining a long-period memory network. According to the method, a mixed model of a space-time diagram convolution network and a long-short-period memory network is constructed, the space-time correlation and hysteresis effect between climate data and yield sequences are deeply mined, and the propagation rule of climate stress factors such as continuous drought and the like between main yield areas is captured, so that the model can break through the limitation of the traditional method, the recessive influence of climate abnormality is explicit, and probability and visual accurate prediction of potential yield reduction risks in the future is carried out.
assignees: HUBEI AISINO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent risk identification method and system for energy adding station
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of industrial Internet of things and edge computing, in particular to an intelligent risk identification method and system for an energy adding station; the method comprises the steps of deploying a sensor network at an energy adding station, synchronously collecting signals, extracting multi-scale time-frequency and physical response characteristics, mapping heterogeneous characteristics to energy flow fingerprints through a mixed projection model, carrying out self-calibration enhancement by utilizing a differential baseline, decoding and mapping the energy flow fingerprints into semantic characteristics, identifying candidate abnormal modes through short-term trend analysis and multi-source cross correlation and calculating local abnormal scores, constructing a physical semantic constraint local causal network based on the candidate abnormal, deducing an abnormal propagation path, quantifying node risk contribution, grading and positioning key risk sources, packaging risk information into a token matching strategy library, executing a transactional action chain according to a grading intervention principle, monitoring effects in real time and supporting rollback upgrading. The invention realizes real-time identification, causal deduction and intelligent dynamic response of the energy adding station risk.
assignees: JIANGSU YUNPENG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Forest grass fire scene situation sensing system based on multisource remote sensing data and artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest fire scene situation awareness system based on multi-source remote sensing data and artificial intelligence, which is characterized by comprising a data acquisition module, a space-time analysis module, a decision optimization module and a decision-making module, wherein the data acquisition module acquires multi-source satellite original data streams, acquires forest fire scene data with unified space-time reference through automatic calibration and geometric correction preprocessing operation, the space-time analysis module automatically extracts fire scene element entities through an optimized space-time sensing element learning extractor based on the forest fire scene data to construct an entity space-time position mapping table, the decision-making module defines graph nodes of a graph neural network based on the entity space-time position mapping table, acquires potential association score among the nodes, constructs an edge set of the graph neural network according to the potential association score, updates final representation analysis space-time propagation relation of all the nodes, and acquires a forest fire scene space-time knowledge map, and the decision-making module simulates fire scene evolution paths under different intervention strategies through an antagonistic reasoning mechanism based on the flame scene space-time knowledge map to realize forest fire scene situation awareness.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA BANGFEI TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Power grid vulnerability assessment method, system, equipment and medium for meteorological disaster data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for evaluating grid vulnerability of meteorological disaster data fusion, and relates to the technical field of meteorological disaster defense of power systems. By constructing a dynamic coupling field model of disaster physical mechanism and power grid equipment tolerance characteristics, deep space-time fusion of multi-source heterogeneous data is realized, and the defect that disaster data and power grid vulnerability are disjointed in the traditional technology is solved. Complex physical processes such as mountain fire heat radiation conduction, icing stress propagation, lightning stroke ground potential lifting and the like are quantized into equipment-level risk functions, and risk penetration dynamic deduction is performed by combining real-time power flow distribution and load importance grading of a power grid, so that disaster early warning accuracy is improved.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Network information traceability analysis system for multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of data processing, and mainly relates to a network information traceability analysis system for multi-source data fusion, which solves the problem of heterogeneous data alignment and matching between different devices and systems by integrating information from different data sources and unifying data formats, time sequences and semantics; carrying out association analysis on the cross-domain data through a cross-domain event alignment and association scoring module, and uniformly associating different events distributed in a plurality of systems; analyzing the propagation path and key nodes of the attack by an attack-process link construction module; the system can effectively cope with complex cross-domain attacks in modern industrial environments, and improves the recognition precision and the emergency response efficiency of safety events.
assignees: BEIJING BANGZHIYAN NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and medium for acquiring water flow propagation time in dead water period and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water conservancy and discloses a method, a medium and electronic equipment for acquiring the propagation time of water flow in a dead water period, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring initial data of a research area; the initial data comprises river basin topography data, river network water system boundary data, inflow position data and inflow data, and the initial data is input into a medium-low water level radial flow evolution model to perform simulation calculation so as to obtain the water flow propagation time in the dead water period. The method accurately describes the hydrologic power process in the dead water period of the research area, predicts available water resources of all river sections in the river basin, provides quantitative basis for water distribution, is beneficial to optimization of the dead water period scheduling schemes of water conservancy projects such as reservoirs, sluice gates and the like in the river basin, predicts the effect of the water replenishing scheduling scheme, and aims at solving the key problems in the management of the river basin in the dead water period.

title_en: Public safety-oriented Chinese text intelligent recognition and classification method
abstract_en: The invention provides a public security-oriented Chinese text intelligent recognition and classification method, which relates to the technical field of network security text data natural language processing, and aims to support high-concurrency text stream processing by introducing an asynchronous computing framework based on a Graphic Processing Unit (GPU), integrate a plurality of semantic perception models comprising context enhancement, entity recognition and event extraction to cooperatively work, embed a structured knowledge map constructed by taking a public security case library and a judicial case abstract as cores into classification logic, fuse a custom emotion dictionary, combine emotion trigger maps constructed by field hot events, and trigger label cascading and grade response strategies after multi-level judgment is completed. The method and the system can make up for the defect that the general model lacks of field support aiming at text recognition in the professional field, have good interpretability in the decision process, can meet strict compliance requirements, and can be effectively applied to various high-risk real-time decision scenes.
assignees: WUHAN ZHONGZHI DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Abnormality monitoring and processing method based on power operation and maintenance
abstract_en: The invention provides an anomaly monitoring and processing method based on power operation and maintenance, which comprises the steps of collecting running state data, environment influence data and history information of equipment, constructing a simplified digital twin model to output health state scores, dynamically adjusting anomaly identification sensitivity by combining the history degradation degree of the equipment, carrying out cooperative evaluation of running and environment stress change to judge whether to trigger early warning, calculating a transmission activating factor by combining the current anomaly score, a cooperative offset factor and a history inducibility index of the equipment to obtain a deduction result based on a power grid topological structure after the anomaly is judged, fusing the transmission activating factor, a system influence score and a real-time load state to generate a risk regulation index according to the result, and automatically executing graded emergency response operation according to the risk regulation index. The method realizes the early recognition of the abnormality, the quantification of the propagation risk and the closed-loop regulation and control, and improves the intelligent level of the operation and maintenance of the power grid.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Multi-dimensional evaluation method for vulnerability of combat system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vulnerability multidimensional assessment method of a combat system, and belongs to the technical field of complex system safety assessment. The method decomposes a combat system into a physical layer, a logic layer and a cross-layer coupling layer for multidimensional modeling, wherein the physical layer calculates topology indexes such as degree centrality and medium number centrality based on a complex network theory, the logic layer searches a killing chain and quantifies indexes such as the number of chains and average path length based on a killing chain theory through an Ullmann algorithm, and the cross-layer coupling layer analyzes element failure cascade effect and capability recovery degree. And integrating the multidimensional evaluation results through the intersection and union operation to form a vulnerability interval based on the average path length of the killing chain. The invention solves the problems of single-dimension evaluation in the prior art and lack of cross-layer coupling analysis, realizes multi-dimension quantitative evaluation of vulnerability of the combat system, and provides scientific basis for system destruction-resistant optimization and key node protection.
assignees: KINGDOM TECH LTD CHANGSHA

title_en: Photovoltaic cluster power prediction method based on progressive spatial feature clustering and improved graph attention network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic cluster power prediction method based on progressive spatial feature clustering and an improved graph attention network, which relates to the field of photovoltaics and comprises the following steps of constructing a distributed photovoltaic cluster data set, carrying out primary cluster division by taking physical characteristics of a photovoltaic component as a feature input affinity propagation AP algorithm, carrying out secondary cluster division by taking a solar altitude sequence as a feature input AP algorithm, and finally dividing the photovoltaic cluster into a plurality of sub-clusters; and for each light Fu Ziji group, after the historical power and the historical meteorological time sequence data are combined, inputting the historical power and the historical meteorological time sequence data into a GAT-Encoder-Decoder deep learning model for training, reasoning and outputting a daily power prediction result of each power station in the sub-cluster, and accumulating the prediction results of all the power stations to obtain a power prediction result of the whole photovoltaic cluster. According to the invention, clustering calculation is carried out through the step-by-step spatial features so as to obtain the sub-group division result which can reflect the spatial feature states of the photovoltaic power stations, and the relevance of the output of the photovoltaic power stations in the sub-group is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Distribution network investment strategy optimization method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The application discloses an artificial intelligence-based power distribution network investment strategy optimization method which comprises the steps of constructing a multi-region coupling network model for quantifying the power flow influence intensity among regions according to the electric topology and the power flow data of a target power distribution network, establishing an investment benefit propagation prediction model for quantifying the benefit generated by investment allocation vectors of power supply regions on the whole network based on the multi-region coupling network model, outputting a steady-state benefit change flow distribution tensor in a preset planning period, and obtaining the current optimal investment strategy for N power supply regions according to a preset investment optimization model aiming at maximizing global cooperative net benefit in the planning period based on the steady-state benefit change flow distribution tensor. Therefore, the accuracy of optimizing the investment strategy of the power distribution network is realized.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECHNOLOGICAL RESEARCH INST STATE GRID HEILONGJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID HEILONGJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LIMITED;GUODIAN HUAYAN BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent monitoring system for state of relay protection hard pressing plate
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system monitoring and discloses an intelligent monitoring system for a relay protection hard pressing plate state. The system comprises a state acquisition module, a characteristic analysis module, a joint characterization module, an abnormality prediction module, a decision execution module and a decision execution module, wherein the state acquisition module acquires mechanical displacement, contact resistance and surface infrared thermal imaging data of a hard pressing plate in real time, the characteristic analysis module respectively processes the data to generate a displacement characteristic vector, a resistance characteristic matrix and a thermodynamic characteristic map, the joint characterization module inputs the characteristics into a cascade attention fusion network, outputs multi-source joint state characterization through space alignment and weight distribution, the abnormality prediction module inputs the characteristics into a lightweight time sequence prediction model embedded into contact physical constraint to predict displacement offset, resistance attenuation rate and hot spot diffusion trend of the hard pressing plate in three working cycles, and the decision execution module generates a hard pressing plate maintenance instruction set comprising mechanical lubrication grade, contact polishing frequency and cooling fan rotating speed adjustment according to a prediction result.

title_en: Cascading failure searching method and system based on game theory
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power grid safety protection, and provides a cascading failure searching method and system based on game theory, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining an initial failure; the method comprises the steps of determining initial faults, adopting an optimal defense strategy based on the determined initial faults, calculating the defense cost of the optimal defense strategy, pruning a search path by taking the line fault probability and the line fault result of lower-level faults as pruning indexes to obtain a next-level fault line set, carrying out one-by-one simulation on each cascading fault of the line in the next-level fault line set, counting the emergency control cost and the fault probability of each cascading fault to judge whether the fault level reaches a threshold value, stopping searching if the fault level reaches the threshold value, otherwise, increasing the fault level by one level, continuing fault defense and searching, determining the control cost and the fault risk value of each cascading fault, and sequencing according to the fault risk value to obtain the cascading fault set. The method can accurately search the AC/DC high-risk cascading faults which are difficult to effectively defend the power grid.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Fault diagnosis method, device, apparatus, storage medium, and program product
abstract_en: The present application relates to a fault diagnosis method, apparatus, device, storage medium, and program product. Relates to the technical field of power systems. The method comprises the steps of processing acquired electrical quantity data, equipment parameters, environment data and unstructured data of a power distribution area in real time to obtain processed data, dynamically updating a pre-constructed knowledge graph based on the processed data, carrying out aggregation processing on node feature vectors in a latest knowledge graph based on a pre-constructed graph neural network model, determining fault probability corresponding to nodes according to the node feature vectors obtained through aggregation, and determining a fault propagation path and/or positioning faults based on topological relations in the knowledge graph under the condition that the fault probability is larger than a set threshold value. By adopting the method, the database can be updated in time along with the change of the fault scene, so that the fault report missing rate is reduced.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Electric vehicle cooperative scheduling optimization method, system and medium based on countermeasure evolution strategy
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric vehicle cooperative scheduling optimization method, system and medium based on an anti-evolution strategy, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining dynamic reconfiguration topological state, new energy fluctuation characteristics, vehicle group migration track data and total load time number of a distribution network, constructing a space-time four-dimensional characteristic tensor through deep tensor decomposition enhanced by graph rolling, designing a generator-discriminator cooperative evolution framework, generating a scheduling strategy by the generator, evaluating the safety margin of the scheduling strategy in real time based on a time-varying safety margin function by the discriminator, directionally optimizing the scheduling strategy through an anti-gradient counter-propagation mechanism with self-adaptive gradient penalty, establishing a federal double-path anti-facts reasoning model to quantify individual processing effects of electric price signals on users, feeding back to the generator, and outputting the pareto optimal scheduling strategy through iterative optimization by the generator. The invention constructs a new mechanism integrating dynamic topology awareness, user behavior intervention and resource collaborative optimization, and ensures safe and economic operation of the power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LIMITED ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RESEARCH INSTITUTE;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LIMITED;STATE GRID CORP CHINA
