title_en: Cascade hydropower station economic dispatching method considering spare capacity configuration optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses an economic dispatching method of a cascade hydropower station considering spare capacity configuration optimization, and relates to the field of electric power systems, wherein the method comprises the steps of generating a probability density curve of joint errors based on probability distribution characteristics of new energy output and load, and determining the total requirement of the spare capacity of the system according to confidence level; the method comprises the steps of taking the minimum total cost as an objective function, wherein the total cost comprises the starting and stopping cost, the output cost and the spare capacity cost of the unit, taking thermal power unit constraint, new energy constraint, step hydroelectric unit constraint, line capacity constraint and electric power and electric quantity balance constraint into consideration, and realizing collaborative economic dispatching and spare capacity configuration of the step hydroelectric station and the thermal power unit through production simulation optimization solution. Through the cooperative optimization of economy and reliability, the invention not only reduces the running cost of the system, but also improves the accuracy of spare capacity configuration and the toughness of the power grid, and provides an innovative solution for the safe and efficient scheduling of a high-proportion new energy power system.
assignees: STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for predicting electricity price under influence of multiple source factors based on big data model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power markets and big data analysis, and discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for predicting electricity price under the influence of multi-source factors based on a big data model, wherein high-frequency data reflecting the real-time state of a system and low-frequency data of long-term trend are configured from power grid dispatching, power trading, meteorological and planning departments; the method comprises the steps of respectively constructing feature vectors of spot and medium-long price prediction through data cleaning and routing, respectively inputting features into improved spot and medium-long price prediction models, enabling the spot models to adopt GBDT architecture fused with self-adaptive attention mechanisms, enabling the medium-long models to adopt cascade GBDT and multi-scale feature fusion frames, calibrating spot prediction by using medium-long price prediction results, and simultaneously feeding back actual data of spot markets to drive rolling update of the medium-long models. The method effectively overcomes the defects of insufficient field knowledge fusion and multi-time-scale prediction cleavage in the prior art, and remarkably improves the accuracy, the robustness and the practicability of prediction.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Cold chain risk source priority screening method and system based on missing link inference
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cold chain risk source priority screening method and system based on missing link inference, and relates to the technical field of cold chain risk source identification and screening. Firstly, constructing an initial circulation network based on cold chain tracing data, identifying and deducing a missing link, complementing the network according to a triple principle, secondly, executing reverse risk tracing on a polluted terminal node, calculating initial risk values of all upstream nodes based on a multi-path risk accumulation principle, then dynamically correcting the propagation weight of the missing link based on a risk value result of the upstream nodes, eliminating a higher risk value caused by link inference errors through a self-adaptive mechanism, and repeatedly executing the risk tracing and the link correction process until the risk values of the upstream nodes are converged to generate a priority screening sequence of a cold chain risk source.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING TECHNOLOGY & BUSINESS

title_en: Intelligent fire control monitoring and early warning system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of intelligent fire protection and discloses an intelligent fire protection monitoring and early warning system based on the Internet of things, which comprises a data acquisition unit, an abnormal fluctuation feature extraction unit and a spatial correlation analysis unit, wherein the data acquisition unit acquires a fire protection environment through an Internet of things sensor network to obtain a fire protection environment data set, the abnormal fluctuation feature extraction unit extracts abnormal fluctuation feature vectors from the fire protection environment data set, the spatial correlation analysis unit analyzes the abnormal fluctuation feature vectors, the comprehensive monitoring of the fire protection environment is realized through the Internet of things sensor network, advanced technologies such as deep reinforcement learning and a graph neural network are combined, fire protection environment data can be analyzed in real time, a fire source potential area can be dynamically evaluated, early warning signals can be sent out in advance, the early-stage quick response of a fire disaster is ensured, the early warning accuracy and timeliness are remarkably improved, a fire source potential area and a fire propagation path can be identified, scientific basis is provided for fire protection resource allocation and fire source positioning, and fuzzy judgment and delayed response of a fire source position in a traditional scheme are avoided.
assignees: GUANGZHOU SHUNAN FIRE ENG EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Laser process parameter generation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of laser repair, in particular to a laser process parameter generation method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein single pulse energy data are acquired according to preset measurement position data, the single pulse energy data are analyzed according to a preset Gaussian distribution method and a preset polynomial fitting method to obtain an ablation energy sequence, the maximum effective ablation depth is generated according to a preset laser scanning area and the ablation energy sequence, the ablation energy sequence and the maximum effective ablation depth are analyzed based on preset ablation depth constraint, a preset material network model and a preset laser propagation rule to obtain laser process parameters, fitting spot energy data are acquired accurately to generate effective ablation depth, the laser process parameters are optimized in a simulation mode, the ablation depth is controllable, the repair yield and efficiency of an OLED panel are improved, a multi-defect scene is adapted, and the laser repair process is promoted to be standardized and intelligently upgraded.
assignees: JI HUA LABORATORY

title_en: Multi-mode dynamic cooperation-based voltage out-of-limit prediction method
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of voltage out-of-limit prediction, and provides a voltage out-of-limit prediction method based on multi-modal dynamic coordination, which comprises the steps of collecting multi-modal data of a target area, inputting the preprocessed data into a pre-trained multi-modal collaborative evaluation network to extract multi-modal characteristics, and outputting a comprehensive voltage out-of-limit risk index after fusing the characteristics; and according to the magnitude of the comprehensive voltage threshold crossing risk index, invoking a time sequence extrapolation model, a multi-mode fusion prediction model and a space-time propagation simulation model to conduct voltage threshold crossing prediction, obtaining the voltage threshold crossing probability of each node relative to the dynamic voltage threshold crossing probability in the future preset time based on the output of the invoked prediction model, and determining a key target node and an estimated influence range. According to the method, the prediction models with different complexity are intelligently called according to different risk levels, and the dynamic voltage safety domain boundary is introduced, so that the prediction robustness in a high dynamic scene is effectively improved.
assignees: GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic simulation and risk assessment method and system for power system with collaborative source network and charge storage
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of operation and control of power systems, and particularly relates to a power system dynamic simulation and comprehensive risk assessment method and system integrating the cooperative interaction characteristics of source, network, load and storage, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a source network load storage cooperative simulation model based on multiple intelligent agents; the method comprises the steps of setting a simulation scene comprising initial disturbance and uncertainty, running a collaborative simulation model, aiming at a system risk state identified in a simulation result, adopting a path backtracking and contribution analysis algorithm based on a time-varying system interaction directed graph, deconstructing a key propagation path causing the risk state, quantifying the contribution degree of each agent and an interaction event in risk formation, generating a collaborative control strategy package related to a plurality of links of a source, a network, a load and a storage based on the contribution degree deconstructing result with the aim of minimizing the current risk and the future risk propagation uncertainty, and feeding back the collaborative control strategy package as a new control input to the collaborative simulation model for verification and effect evaluation to complete closed loop.
assignees: LUOHE POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: High-resistance fault unsupervised identification method and system based on prototype comparison and knowledge distillation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-resistance fault unsupervised identification method and a system based on prototype comparison and knowledge distillation, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out standardized pretreatment on a high-resistance fault signal and converting the high-resistance fault signal into a two-dimensional characteristic representation; the method comprises the steps of carrying out depth feature coding on two-dimensional feature representation by using a residual network, extracting high-level semantic features, implementing a contrast learning strategy, enhancing the discrimination of features by means of pulling similar samples and pushing different samples, keeping priori knowledge by using a knowledge distillation technology in a continuous domain adaptation process, designing domain adaptation loss, carrying out weighted combination on classification loss, contrast loss, distillation loss and domain adaptation loss to form a total loss function, gradually adapting to new target domains by adopting a gradient back propagation optimization model parameter, carrying out fault category prediction on test samples, and outputting fault types and confidence. The invention has the advantages of high detection precision, good environmental adaptability, high calculation efficiency and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LIMITED ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RESEARCH INSTITUTE;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LIMITED;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Auxiliary decision-making method, system, equipment and storage medium for power distribution network fault maintenance
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power automation and discloses a power distribution network fault overhaul auxiliary decision-making method, a system, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining real-time operation data of electric power equipment to be overhauled in a power distribution network, and carrying out data preprocessing and state identification on the real-time operation data to obtain an equipment state; the method comprises the steps of inputting equipment states into a knowledge graph to perform fault reasoning to obtain a plurality of initial fault paths, calculating path confidence of the initial fault paths according to a fault propagation causal chain, extracting reliable fault paths from the initial fault paths according to the path confidence, obtaining fault diagnosis results according to the reliable fault paths, and extracting corresponding recommended treatment measures according to the fault diagnosis results. By introducing an interpretable reasoning path mechanism, the invention can clearly display the logical reasoning process between the fault phenomenon and the processing suggestion, obviously enhance the transparency and the reliability of the decision result and improve the operation safety and the reliability of the power distribution network.
assignees: QIANTANG BRANCH OF ZHEJIANG DAYOU IND CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent building curtain wall early warning method based on multi-source data
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent early warning method for a building curtain wall based on multi-source data, which comprises the steps of collecting and preprocessing multi-source data to form a multi-mode data set, constructing a health sample, generating a sensing network diagram, mapping the multi-mode data into multi-dimensional tensors, executing layering decomposition, calculating crack energy and phase stability, establishing a structure-environment causal directed acyclic diagram, generating a counterfactual baseline and a residual sequence for environmental parameter intervention, constructing a physical constraint twin comparison learning model, inputting the health sample and a sample to be tested, generating an anomaly score, fusing a potential energy sequence and the anomaly score, updating a risk threshold, constructing a dynamic risk potential field, searching a propagation path, triggering early warning when a risk track or a margin triggering condition is met, and outputting a result to an operation and maintenance platform. According to the invention, through multi-source data fusion, causal inference and physical constraint twin contrast learning, early identification and intelligent early warning of hidden danger of the building curtain wall are realized.
assignees: GUANGDONG FENGYUE TECH ENGINEERING CO LTD;GUANGZHOU VOCATIONAL AND TECHNICAL UNIV

title_en: Digital twinning-based power distribution system operation risk assessment and response method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for evaluating and responding to the running risk of a power distribution system based on digital twin, and relates to the technical field of power grids. And determining a risk index on the digital twin body according to a layering strategy, predicting trend of time sequence data of the risk index, and giving index weight according to the trend prediction, so as to construct a risk index system. Analyzing risk propagation paths in a virtual environment, simulating occurrence probabilities of different risk scenes by combining historical fault data, mapping each index into a risk level, and formulating a corresponding response scheme based on the historical data and a tolerance threshold. And optimizing digital twin parameters by using operation and maintenance feedback information, forming a risk assessment system based on the updated twin, and carrying out high-efficiency assessment and response on the system operation risk.
assignees: HANGZHOU KAIDA ELECTRIC POWER CONSTRUCTION CO LTD;HANGZHOU CITY YUHANG DISTRICT POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Individualized water and fertilizer application decision-making method for potted flower planting
abstract_en: The invention provides a potted flower planting personalized water and fertilizer application decision method, which comprises the steps of acquiring key physiological and environmental parameters of plants through multi-mode non-invasive sensing, constructing a five-dimensional observation tensor aligned in time and space, performing noise suppression, sampling frequency normalization and feature standardization on multi-source data to generate a multi-dimensional state feature sequence, constructing a multi-dimensional health risk propagation chart based on the multi-dimensional state feature sequence, performing evolution deduction on a risk path by utilizing a graph neural network and a space-time attention mechanism to realize precise spatial positioning and time prediction of health crisis, combining historical response characteristics and a risk mode, generating a personalized water and fertilizer adjustment instruction by adopting a meta-learning strategy, and performing early warning, dynamic adjustment efficiency and personalized adaptability of strategies on the health risks of the plants by continuously feeding back optimized threshold values and adjustment parameters.
assignees: GUANGZHOU HUIXING AGRICULTURAL DEV CO LTD

title_en: New energy black start partition optimization method considering irregular risks
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of stable control of power systems, and provides a new energy black start partition optimization method considering irregular risks, which comprises the steps of simulating the irregular risks possibly encountered by a power system by adopting Monte Carlo sampling; the method comprises the steps of extracting wind power output characteristics under an unconventional risk by adopting variable-fraction modal decomposition, carrying out output prediction by combining a long-period memory neural network, dividing a recovery partition of a power system based on an LPA algorithm, improving the LPA algorithm by considering a balance principle of the size of the partition, so that the partition area is more balanced and the label vibration effect is reduced. According to the method, a black start partition optimization model which is generated by combining new energy output uncertainty modeling with a non-conventional risk scene is designed, and the partition scheme is cooperatively solved by adopting an improved label propagation algorithm.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Extreme rainfall flood risk propagation path identification method based on hydrologic connectivity
abstract_en: The invention discloses an extreme rainfall flood risk propagation path identification method based on hydrologic connectivity, which comprises the steps of constructing a hydrologic topological network, calculating the yield and hydrologic potential energy of each grid unit, constructing a connectivity weight matrix according to potential energy difference and Manning roughness coefficient, generating a dynamic connectivity adjacency matrix through a ponding depth trigger threshold, constructing a risk propagation probability transfer matrix, and identifying a risk propagation main path and key conduction nodes. The method can dynamically characterize hydrologic connectivity change under extreme rainfall conditions, effectively identify flood risk propagation paths and key nodes, and provide technical support for urban flood disaster risk early warning and emergency management.
assignees: XINJIANG INST ECO & GEO CAS

title_en: Safety inspection method, device, equipment, storage medium and program product for intelligent power plant
abstract_en: The application discloses a safety inspection method, a device, equipment, a storage medium and a program product of an intelligent power plant, and relates to the technical field of power plant inspection. The intelligent power plant fault detection method comprises the steps of dynamically updating a fault propagation network based on a device health state tensor, predicting a fault propagation path according to the updated fault propagation network, carrying out self-optimization of a routing inspection path based on risk nodes in the fault propagation path to obtain an optimized routing inspection path, carrying out safety routing inspection based on the routing inspection path, and determining potential faults of the intelligent power plant based on routing inspection results of the safety routing inspection. The multi-mode data in the intelligent power plant are obtained and fused to obtain the device health state tensor, so that the limitation of the traditional single-mode analysis is avoided.
assignees: JIALING RIVER TINGZIKOU WATER RESOURCES AND HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Microblog rumor detection method and system based on static and dynamic knowledge enhancement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microblog rumors detection method and system based on static and dynamic knowledge enhancement. The method comprises the steps of preprocessing a microblog text, including text cleaning, word segmentation, part-of-speech tagging and named entity recognition, so as to obtain structured text and entity information, and then carrying out knowledge linking and semantic enhancement on the text entity by utilizing a pre-constructed domain static knowledge graph, extracting entity attributes, relations and related facts, and realizing the deep combination of the text and background knowledge. Aiming at the core statement that the knowledge graph is not covered or has disputes, the invention further introduces a dynamic search enhancement mechanism, acquires authoritative external evidence through a search engine and constructs dynamic knowledge representation. And then, a knowledge consistency verification module is adopted to evaluate semantic consistency and logic consistency between the microblog content and static knowledge and dynamic evidence respectively, and the credibility of the microblog content is quantized. Finally, text semantic features, knowledge enhancement features, user behavior features, propagation features and knowledge credibility scores are fused, a multidimensional comprehensive feature vector is constructed, and rumor recognition is completed by using a deep neural network classifier. Compared with the traditional detection technology depending on content or transmission structure, the method can simultaneously utilize structured knowledge and real-time external evidence to realize accurate identification of complex, novel and time-efficient rumors, and provides more reliable and efficient technical support for social media content auditing, public opinion monitoring and public safety management.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG TECHNOLOGY

title_en: A functional Fire Sign Detection System of Power equipment
title_ko: 기능성 전력설비의 화재 징후 감지 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 전력설비의 화재 징후 감지 시스템에 관한 것으로, 특히 화재 징후를 사전에 감지하여 점검을 유도함과 더불어 설치가 용이하며 전력설비의 종합적인 화재 예측 판단이 가능한 기능성 전력설비의 화재 징후 감지 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 전력설비 중 다수의 전원 케이블에 각각 결합되고 아크 발생에 따라 발생하는 저항열을 검출하여 무선 통신을 통해 외부로 전송하는 다수의 아크 검출부와, 상기 전력설비에 구성되어 상기 각 아크 검출부로부터 검출된 아크 검출신호를 전달받아 외부로 전송하는 전송 단말기와, 상기 전송 단말기로부터 아크 검출 신호를 전달받아 증폭하여 전파 음영지역을 극복하고 전송거리를 연장 및 확장하는 중계기와, 상기 중계기로부터 아크 검출 신호를 수신하여 상기 전력 설비에서 발생하는 아크 정보 데이터를 수집하는 수집기와, 상기 수집기로부터 수집된 상기 전력설비의 아크 정보에 대한 데이터를 전달받아 저장하고 분석하는 관리 서버를 포함하여 구성되고, 상기 아크 검출부는 전원을 공급하는 배터리와, 상기 배터리로부터 전원을 공급받아 동작하고 상기 검출된 아크 정보를 무선 통신을 통해 외부로 전달하는 무선 통신부와, 상기 전력 케이블에서 아크 발생에 따른 전력 케이블의 저항열을 감지하여 기계적으로 온 또는 오프되어 상기 배터리와 무선 통신부를 선택적으로 연결하는 바이메탈과, 상기 바이메탈이 동작하여 상기 무선 통신부를 통해 아크 정보를 송부되면 점등하여 발광하는 발광부와, 상기 발광부, 무선 통신부 및 배터리를 수납하는 제 1 수납 케이스와, 상기 제 1 수납 케이스와 체결되고 상기 바이메탈을 수납하는 제 2 수납 케이스와, 상기 제 2 수납 케이스의 측면에 구성되어 상기 전력 케이블에 체결되는 체결부와, 상기 제 1 수납 케이스의 내부 수납 공간에 구성되어 외부에서 조작에 의해 구동되어 송신기와 수신기간의 주기적인 통신 점검을 실행하는 트랙 스위치와, 상기 트랙 스위치의 외부 조작을 위해 상기 제 1 수납 케이스의 표면에 구성되는 트랙 스위치 조작홀을 포함하여 구성되는 기능성 전력설비의 화재 징후 감지 시스템을 제공하고자 한다. 
또한 본 발명의 상기 바이메탈은 일표면에 열전도성 완충부가 부착되어 있는 것을 특징으로 하는 기능성 전력설비의 화재 징후 감지 시스템을 제공한다. 
또한 본 발명의 상기 전송 단말기, 중계기 및 수집기를 포함한 무선 네트워크망은 비상시에도 동작이 가능하도록 2차 전지를 내장하고 있는 것을 특징으로 하는 기능성 전력설비의 화재 징후 감지 시스템을 제공한다. 
또한 본 발명의 상기 아크 감지 수신기는 내부에 온도, 습도, 조도를 감지하는 센서를 내장하고 정기적으로 상기 전송 단말기를 통해 상기 관리 서버로 전달하는 것을 특징으로 하는 기능성 전력설비의 화재 징후 감지 시스템을 제공한다. 
또한 본 발명의 상기 관리 서버는 온도, 습도, 조도와 더불어 화재 징후 감지 신호를 전달받아 분석하여 상황에 따라 해당 전력 설비에 대한 점검 메시지를 표출하는 것을 특징으로 하는 기능성 전력설비의 화재 징후 감지 시스템을 제공한다.
assignees: UTRON CO LTD

title_en: Hydropower generation capacity determining method based on scheduling procedure digitization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydropower generation capacity determining method based on digitalization of a scheduling rule, and belongs to the technical field of hydropower scheduling modeling and power generation capacity assessment. The method comprises the steps of taking hydropower station scheduling procedure texts as basic data, adopting knowledge graph construction and semantic analysis technology to extract constraint conditions and effective situations in the scheduling procedure, converting scheduling information into structural parameters and constructing a database to realize digital modeling of the scheduling procedure, identifying an effective scheduling constraint set according to information such as running water, power station operation, power grid capacity and the like in a prediction period, constructing a power generation capacity calculation model, calculating an average active power interval of the power station in a specific period, considering constraint correction of upstream outlet warehouse to downstream running water among cascade hydropower stations, and completing rolling calculation of the power generation capacity of a river basin step by step. The invention can provide scientific support and decision basis for electric power market participation, power grid dispatching safety check and river basin optimization operation.
assignees: DADU RIVER HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Power grid damage consequence evaluation method considering cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid damage result evaluation method considering cascading failures, and belongs to the technical field of power system dispatching. The method comprises the steps of establishing a HEMP E1 environment model, obtaining peak field intensity of a key equipment installation position of a power grid, establishing a key equipment fault probability model based on the peak field intensity, generating an initial fault through Monte Carlo simulation, establishing a cascading fault evolution model integrating direct current flow calculation, power grid regulation measures and communication equipment influence, iteratively simulating a fault process until the power grid is stable, calculating indexes such as load loss ratio, average utilization rate of line capacity and the like, and quantitatively evaluating the damage result of the power grid. The invention breaks through the limit of the existing equipment layer evaluation, realizes the accurate simulation of the cascading failure evolution of the system layer, gives consideration to the evaluation accuracy and the calculation efficiency, and provides important support for formulating the power grid defense strategy in the HEMP E1 environment.
assignees: HUANENG YIMIN COAL & ELECTRICITY CO LTD;UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: Temperature-tide security domain mapping-based two-stage planning method for power grid side energy storage under sea-wind access scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to a two-stage site selection and volume determination method for power grid side energy storage under a sea wind access scene considering temperature influence on a tide security domain, which comprises the steps of adopting a temperature trend prediction model combining LSTM and TCN; the method comprises the steps of calculating a temperature variable capacity expected coefficient by adopting a Gaussian mixture model, reconstructing a tide security domain, adopting a typical source-holiday track clustering method, establishing a random optimization scene set of source-load space-time coupling, establishing a power distribution network energy storage, locating and capacity-fixing planning layer model with the maximum comprehensive effect as a target, establishing a power distribution network energy storage, locating and capacity-fixing operation layer model with the minimum voltage fluctuation square sum as a target, establishing a DistFlow multi-period optimal tide model under a sea wind access scene, solving the planning layer by adopting second order cone relaxation, and carrying out secondary optimization charge-discharge and capacity configuration strategy by adopting a target cascade algorithm on the basis of an anchor planning layer locating and capacity-fixing decision variable by the operation layer. The method can be used for effectively collaborative planning and operation targets and realizing comprehensive optimal configuration of energy storage at the power grid side.
assignees: UNIV FUZHOU

title_en: Wind power credible capacity assessment method and device based on cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power credible capacity assessment method and device based on cascading faults, which comprise the steps of obtaining grid network frame topological structure information of a target power system, conventional attribute information of a conventional unit and wind power attribute information of a wind power unit, obtaining actual power grid operation information of a target area in a preset time period, constructing representative scenes of the target power system before, during and after cascading faults based on the information, respectively carrying out fault evolution operation simulation on the target power system in the representative scenes before, during and after faults, determining a power grid state feature matrix of the target power system in the representative scenes of all faults based on simulation results, and determining wind power credible capacity by means of alternate iteration based on the power grid state feature matrix by using an upper layer model and a lower layer model.
assignees: EAST CHINA BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA

title_en: Intelligent ammeter data anomaly detection and quality evaluation optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for detecting abnormal data and evaluating quality of an intelligent electric meter, and relates to the technical field of intelligent power grids, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining measurement data of electric energy metering equipment and constructing a map model based on topological relation; the method comprises the steps of extracting multi-order associated features through a graph structure propagation mechanism, inputting the features and measured data into an anomaly detection model to calculate the deviation degree, judging anomalies beyond a threshold value, and calculating a data quality assessment index according to the anomaly frequency and the duration. The method and the device fully utilize network topology constraint, can improve the abnormality detection accuracy and realize accurate evaluation of the data quality of the ammeter.
assignees: STATE GRID JIBEI POWER CO LTD SMART DISTRIB NETWORK CENTER

title_en: Fire-fighting communication anti-interference relay device and method for energy storage system
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of battery energy storage communication, and provides an anti-interference relay device and method for fire control communication of an energy storage system, wherein the anti-interference relay device comprises a signal processing module, a signal processing module and a power supply module, wherein the signal processing module is used for carrying out anti-interference processing on a received model; the system comprises a signal amplifying and shaping module, a cascade interface module, a fire signal detection and communication module, a signal processing module and a signal processing module, wherein the signal amplifying and shaping module is used for carrying out gain adjustment and waveform shaping on signals, the cascade interface module is provided with a double CAN bus interface and is connected with an upstream relay device and a downstream relay device based on ring network topology and used for outputting shaped signals and realizing cascade expansion and redundant communication of the relay device, the fire signal detection and communication module is used for marking fire data as the highest priority and transmitting the fire data to the signal processing module when fire signals are detected, and the signal processing module is enabled to schedule and forward the fire data preferentially through an improved token ring communication protocol. The problems of large signal attenuation, weak interference resistance, poor expansibility and insufficient emergency communication capability of the traditional relay device in a complex industrial environment are solved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power project data logic abnormality correction method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for correcting logic abnormality of power project data, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a data logic check network based on an association rule mining algorithm so as to express constraint relation among fields; the method comprises the steps of verifying non-zero dependence of a data record through a constraint propagation mechanism, generating a logic abnormal result when a violation of a constraint is detected, triggering automatic correction, namely obtaining a similar normal case from a historical knowledge base to generate a correction scheme, applying the correction scheme to an abnormal field to obtain a corrected record, and performing secondary verification to ensure that correction is effective. The application realizes the rapid and accurate dynamic correction of logic abnormality by constructing the verification network, verifying the dependence, automatically correcting and secondarily verifying, and overcomes the defects of low efficiency and lack of verification of manual correction.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ECONOMIC RESEARCH INST

title_en: Photovoltaic facility operation and maintenance decision method based on knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic facility operation and maintenance decision method based on a knowledge graph, which comprises the steps of S1, constructing the knowledge graph, establishing equipment, fault modes, characteristic parameter nodes and causal association, S2, carrying out state diagnosis based on an improved Markov logic network, utilizing a structure regularization factor decomposition model and a confidence level adjustment mechanism to obtain equipment state probability, a fault propagation chain and influence degree, S3, constructing an operation and maintenance index system, extracting risks, fault influence and performance degradation, combining cost and power generation recovery rate to form an evaluation vector, S4, optimizing the operation and maintenance strategy based on the improved VIKOR method, introducing an index coupling degree matrix and a compromise correction factor, calculating group utility, individual regrets and compromise evaluation values, S5, outputting operation and maintenance decision, generating a priority and alternative scheme, and providing fault chain interpretation and weight correction basis. The invention realizes intelligent diagnosis and operation and maintenance auxiliary decision-making of the photovoltaic facilities, improves operation and maintenance efficiency, reduces fault risk and optimizes power generation income.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA HUANENG KUBUQI ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Cloud-protogenesis-architecture-based power distribution network collaborative design system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a collaborative design system and method of a power distribution network based on a cloud native architecture, wherein the collaborative design system comprises a user terminal and a cloud server cluster, wherein the user terminal and the cloud server cluster are used for establishing data transmission through a WebSocket and carrying out real-time interaction of an incremental data packet and a calculation result, the user terminal is used for providing an interaction interface for a user, carrying out light rendering on a power distribution network drawing and capturing operation of the user on the power distribution network drawing, and the cloud server cluster is used for centralizing business logic, electric calculation and collaborative control of the power distribution network drawing. The invention provides a collaborative design system and a collaborative design method for a power distribution network based on a cloud primary architecture, which can greatly reduce network bandwidth occupation and ensure operation smoothness in a weak network environment. The electric topology cascade conflict is solved, and the data security of multi-user cooperation is ensured. The design-calculation real-time closed loop is realized, and the engineering design efficiency is remarkably improved. And realizing cross-platform lightweight access.
assignees: CHANGZHOU CHANGGONG ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Barrel type medical waste intelligent allocation system and method based on risk propagation dynamics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a barrel type medical waste intelligent allocation system and method based on risk propagation dynamics, and belongs to the technical field of automatic control. According to the system, the state and the environmental parameters of the waste bin are collected in real time through the intelligent sensor network, the dynamic risk evolution of the waste bin is calculated by the risk propagation dynamics engine based on the differential equation model, the risk distribution map of the three-dimensional space of the hospital is constructed by the risk field calculation engine, the potential risk burst is monitored and early warned in advance by the risk phase change detector, the optimal scheduling sequence is generated by combining the risk distribution and the resource constraint by the risk neutralization scheduler, and the related transportation units are driven to execute, so that the dynamic and intelligent management and control of the whole flow of medical waste are realized.
assignees: ESSENIOT SMART TECH DEVELOPMENT SUZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent trade compliance early warning system based on cross-border supply chain state risk assessment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent trade compliance early warning system based on cross-border supply chain state risk assessment, which comprises a multi-source data acquisition module, a data semantic analysis and standardization module, a supply chain graph modeling module, a multi-dimensional risk index construction module, a graph neural network situation modeling module, a time sequence abnormality detection module and a compliance early warning and strategy linkage module. According to the invention, by fusing multi-national customs policies, real-time logistics states and multi-source heterogeneous data of geopolitical events, a cross-border supply chain topological graph is constructed, and dynamic propagation modeling and prospective recognition of compliance risks are realized based on a graph neural network and time sequence anomaly detection, so that multi-national policy differences and superposition effects thereof can be uniformly described, early warning can be carried out on policy mutation and sanction diffusion non-stationary risks, and the real-time performance, accuracy and overall prevention and control capability of cross-border trade compliance management are remarkably improved.
assignees: HONGQIAO HIGH TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Lithium iron phosphate battery system for high-voltage direct-hanging type mining emergency energy storage power supply and operation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lithium iron phosphate battery system for a high-voltage direct-hanging type mining emergency energy storage power supply and an operation method. The battery system is an energy storage unit formed by a plurality of high-voltage battery clusters and chain link power modules, and three-phase star connection is formed by cascading the chain link power modules, so that the battery system can be directly connected into a high-voltage alternating current power grid without a step-up transformer. The battery core adopts a lithium iron phosphate system, the battery module, the battery pack and the battery cluster adopt a multi-level grouping structure, and a liquid cooling system, a ventilation system, a perfluorinated hexanone and water spraying fire-fighting system and a three-level architecture BMS are configured, so that SOC/SOH monitoring, fault diagnosis and hierarchical protection are realized. The invention is suitable for mining emergency high-voltage direct-hanging energy storage equipment.
assignees: WANBEI COAL ELECTRICITY GROUP CO LTD;HEFEI INST PHYSICAL SCI CAS;ANHUI HENGYUAN COAL & ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Heat supply load ultra-short-term prediction method and system based on depth residual error network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy management and discloses a heat supply load ultra-short-term prediction method and a heat supply load ultra-short-term prediction system based on a depth residual error network, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining multidimensional data flow, preprocessing, obtaining data characteristic vectors, then dynamically modeling to obtain a long-period memory network model and generating a corresponding hidden state sequence; the method comprises the steps of calculating the change amplitude of a hidden state sequence, updating a model parameter and recording the hidden state sequence if the change amplitude exceeds a threshold value, extracting attention weight from the hidden state sequence, calculating a predicted deviation value of a model, adjusting the model parameter and carrying out forward propagation on a data characteristic vector if the deviation value exceeds the threshold value, taking the calculated result as an ultra-short-term load predicted value to obtain preliminary predicted output, calculating an association value of the preliminary predicted output and the data characteristic vector, and fine-tuning the parameter if the association value is lower than the threshold value to determine final predicted output. The method can solve the problem that the ultra-short-term accurate prediction of the heating load cannot be realized in the distributed system.
assignees: HUANENG RIZHAO THERMAL CO LTD;XIAN THERMAL POWER RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Networking method and device based on cloud platform, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of networking based on a cloud platform, and discloses a networking method, a networking device, electronic equipment and a storage medium based on the cloud platform, wherein the networking method comprises the following steps: the cloud authorization and the automatic networking between the terminals realize the minute-level automatic disaster recovery under the physical link fault, change the situation of long-time service interruption caused by relying on manual maintenance, and realize the automatic networking. The application has the beneficial effects that the safe resource sharing across the user equipment is innovatively realized under the centralized management and control of operators, the inherent defects of the traditional ad hoc network scheme in the aspects of authentication, charging and safety are overcome by utilizing the dynamic security token and the encryption tunnel technology, meanwhile, the compliance and the controllability of the operators' network are ensured, the whole process is completely transparent to the users, no manual configuration is needed, and the seamless switching service experience is provided while the efficient operation and maintenance are realized.
assignees: SHENZHEN TONGKANG CHUANGZHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic power prediction method and system based on variation modal decomposition and time sequence modeling
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power prediction, in particular to a photovoltaic power prediction method and a system based on variation modal decomposition and time sequence modeling, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a photovoltaic power sequence and meteorological observation data corresponding to the photovoltaic power sequence, and filling a missing value and carrying out normalized mapping treatment; the method comprises the steps of performing multi-scale decoupling on a processed power sequence through variation modal decomposition to obtain a plurality of modal functions, screening the plurality of modal functions by combining correlation contribution degree evaluation to obtain effective modes, constructing a time-varying modal weight function according to correlation between the modes and a current power state, introducing a cross-modal shared convolution kernel structure into a time sequence convolution network to dynamically weight and fuse the effective modes in different time scales, explicitly embedding the modal weight function into a conditional quantile prediction model, and predicting photovoltaic power by using the trained conditional quantile prediction model. According to the invention, the fine depiction of the dynamic characteristics of multiple time scales of the photovoltaic power and the uncertainty propagation rule is realized.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RESEARCH INSTITUTE;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST CO LTD;BEIJING XIQING ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power supply and distribution equipment state monitoring method for large-scale power grid safety guarantee
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power supply and distribution equipment state monitoring method for large-scale power grid safety guarantee, which relates to the technical field of electrical engineering, and comprises the steps of constructing a multi-dimensional power grid equipment layer comprising power supply, power transmission and distribution layers according to a power grid power supply and distribution equipment group; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a perception data set according to hierarchical monitoring of an Internet of things module, carrying out dynamic fault perception modeling according to a fault disturbance evolution mechanism, establishing a first fault perception graph network, then establishing a fourth fault perception graph network through abnormal disturbance correction of a perception scene, topology association propagation optimization and environment interference evolution compensation, and executing power grid security guarantee management based on the graph network. The invention solves the technical problems that the traditional monitoring means are difficult to adapt to the layered structure, the dynamic evolution characteristic of faults and the association of complex environments of large-scale power grid power supply and distribution equipment, and achieves the technical effects of accurately sensing, comprehensively covering and dynamically adapting faults of the power supply and distribution equipment and effectively improving the safety guarantee capability of the large-scale power grid.
assignees: NANJING HUIPAI SMART LOGISTICS SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Power system transient stability evaluation method and device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of transient stability evaluation of power systems and discloses a method and a device for evaluating the transient stability of a power system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining initial samples of the power system in different operation scenes, wherein the initial samples comprise steady-state characteristics, fault positions and transient stability judging results; extracting a training set and a verification set from initial samples, screening important features from steady-state features to obtain a candidate feature set, training based on the training set and the verification set to obtain an initial transient stability evaluation neural network, calculating uncertainty indexes of all samples in the training set based on the results of multiple forward propagation of a Dropout layer of the initial transient stability evaluation neural network, classifying the samples according to the uncertainty indexes, constructing a condition generation countermeasure network model, training the condition generation countermeasure network model based on the classified samples to obtain a transient stability evaluation model, and performing transient stability evaluation on a power grid according to the transient stability evaluation model.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Bulk logistics optimization system and method based on digitization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bulk logistics optimization system and method based on digitalization, wherein the system comprises an intelligent logistics control center, an Internet of things data acquisition layer, a supply chain knowledge graph engine and a blockchain trusted memory system, wherein multi-mode logistics data are acquired through multi-protocol access, a pareto optimal path solution set is generated through a reinforcement learning algorithm after standardized processing, dynamic risk assessment and optimal scheduling are realized by combining a graph neural network risk propagation model, and key information is stored and intelligent contracts are executed through a blockchain alliance chain. The method solves the problems of traditional logistics visualization limitation, path optimization lag and risk management and control deficiency, realizes full-link transparent management, dynamic self-adaptive optimization and prospective risk prevention and control, remarkably improves logistics efficiency, reduces operation cost, and can be widely applied to large-scale commodity cross-border trade logistics scenes.
assignees: PUSAN TECH DEVELOPMENT SICHUAN CO LTD

title_en: Automatic heat dissipation system of high-low voltage distribution room based on neural fuzzy control
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution room heat dissipation, in particular to a high-low voltage power distribution room automatic heat dissipation system based on nerve fuzzy control, which comprises a model construction module, a power distribution room data processing module and a power distribution room data processing module, wherein the model construction module is used for acquiring power distribution room data to construct a simulation model, and the power distribution room data comprise equipment load parameters and environment parameters; the system comprises a simulation module, a correlation prediction module, a heat dissipation control module and a heat dissipation control module, wherein the simulation module is used for acquiring environmental parameters of corresponding monitoring points in a power distribution room and equipment load parameters in real time to determine target pheromones, and correlating a plurality of target pheromones based on a single monitoring point with corresponding propagation space to obtain a correlation network.
assignees: JINING LUXING ELECTRIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Cascade reservoir group flood emergency dispatching method and system integrating dynamic risk assessment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering and emergency management, and discloses a cascade reservoir group flood emergency dispatching method and system integrating dynamic risk assessment, wherein the method comprises the steps of utilizing a set forecast product of numerical weather forecast to drive a hydrologic model to generate a flood set, calculating the instantaneous dam-overflow risk probability of each reservoir, and constructing a risk chain type propagation network model to evaluate the overall accident probability of a system in a dynamic risk assessment stage; and in the intelligent decision support stage, triggering is performed when the overall failure probability of the system exceeds a risk threshold, similar historical cases are searched by adopting a graph neural network based on a water conservancy domain knowledge graph, and an optimal treatment scheme is generated and recommended through a multi-attribute utility evaluation model. The invention realizes dynamic quantification of risks, accurate identification of systematic risks and intellectualization of emergency decisions, solves the problems of static isolation of traditional risk assessment and dependence of emergency decisions on experience, and improves flood control emergency response capability of a cascade reservoir group.
assignees: CHINA CONSTR 8TH ENG DIVISION

title_en: Alternating current/direct current power grid cascading failure evolution and fragile path identification system and method containing new energy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for identifying cascading failure evolution and a vulnerable path of an alternating current/direct current power grid containing new energy, and relates to the field of safety analysis of power systems. The system comprises a power system modeling module, an element fault modeling module, a vulnerability assessment index module, a cascading failure simulation module and a vulnerable path identification module. By constructing a power system and element fault model containing new energy and alternating current-direct current series-parallel connection, based on entropy weight method fusion structure, tide and voltage multidimensional vulnerability indexes, random scenes are generated through Monte Carlo sampling, fault chains are generated through simulation cascade fault evolution, key vulnerable paths and alternating current-direct current strong coupling risk lines are accurately identified, and the influence of uncertainty factors such as new energy output fluctuation is quantized. The method overcomes the limitation of traditional analysis, can truly simulate fault evolution, improves the identification accuracy of the fragile path, and provides a quantization basis for power grid planning and operation control.
assignees: NORTH CHINA BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA;HARBIN INST OF TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Contract auditing method, device, equipment, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The application relates to a contract auditing method, device, equipment, storage medium and program product. The method comprises the steps of obtaining text data of a contract to be checked, identifying risk-free clauses in the text data by adopting a lightweight classification model, screening to obtain a plurality of suspected risk clauses, sequentially carrying out deep semantic analysis on the plurality of suspected risk clauses by utilizing a preset large model to determine corresponding key elements and a first risk checking result, constructing a logic association map by using a graph neural network model, and determining a second risk checking result among clauses according to the logic association map. The application adopts a layered cascade large model architecture, and completes the primary screening through a lightweight class model, thereby remarkably reducing the overall calculation cost and response time. The large model concentrates computational effort to make deep reasoning on high risk clauses. And revealing the association risk and the potential conflict among the clauses through the logic association map, and realizing global logic verification. The auditing efficiency and the auditing accuracy can be balanced.
assignees: SHANGHAI PUDONG DEVELOPMENT BANK CO LTD

title_en: Multi-scene whole station fault self-healing method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-scene whole station fault self-healing method and system, and belongs to the technical field of power systems. The method comprises the steps of calculating attention weight of a scene to determine a scene recognition result, calculating multi-step propagation accumulated faults to determine a fault equipment set, calculating shortest paths from a transfer power supply point to a decompression target point through an improved Yen algorithm to generate a candidate scheme set, constructing a multi-objective function of each path in the candidate scheme set, solving to obtain a non-dominant optimal solution set, comprehensively scoring the non-dominant optimal solution set by using an entropy weight method to generate a sequencing scheme sequence, calculating similarity of graph structural features of the sequencing scheme sequence and graph structural features of a historical scheme to determine multi-criterion confidence scores of the scheme, and selecting the scheme with the confidence scores higher than a set threshold as a final fault self-healing scheme. The invention improves the load recovery speed of the whole station of the main network fault distribution network, improves the co-processing efficiency of the main network fault distribution network, and improves the risk coping capability.
assignees: STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST CO LTD;STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD;BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Carbon emission reduction and ecological cooperative gain accounting method for geothermal development full life cycle
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of big data analysis and processing, and particularly relates to a full life cycle carbon emission reduction and ecological synergy gain accounting method for geothermal development. The method comprises the steps of firstly constructing a graph containing life cycle stage unit process nodes, space grids or land block nodes and ecological index nodes, setting process influence edges, space adjacent edges and space observation edges in the graph, secondly constructing a graph neural network model which adopts a graph attention network layer and graph convolution network layer combination on the graph, and thirdly writing operation information of a target geothermal development scheme into attribute fields of the life cycle stage unit process nodes and the space grids or land block nodes to obtain a full life cycle carbon emission reduction and ecological cooperative gain accounting result of geothermal development. The invention can simultaneously consider the staged influence of engineering activities, the spatial propagation characteristics and the dynamic response of an ecological system, so that the carbon emission reduction effect and the ecological synergistic effect are presented in a spatial mode on the full life cycle scale.
assignees: SHANDONG PROVINCIAL LAND SPACE ECOLOGICAL RESTORATION CENTER SHANDONG PROVINCIAL GEOLOGICAL DISASTER;UNIV SHANDONG SCIENCE & TECH;LUNAN GEOLOGICAL ENGINEERING INVESTIGATION INST OF SHANDONG PROVINCE SECOND GEOLOGICAL BRIGADE OF SH

title_en: Product quality inspection management system and method
abstract_en: The application discloses a product quality inspection management system and method, and belongs to the field of product quality inspection and control. The system comprises a network topology construction module, an anomaly detection module, an influence degree calculation module, an evaluation index module, an early warning monitoring module and a differentiation dynamic monitoring and treatment mechanism, wherein the network topology construction module dynamically constructs a network topology structure based on multi-source inspection data to realize space-time correlation analysis of quality states, the anomaly detection module identifies anomaly nodes and risk sources through an anomaly detection algorithm, the influence degree calculation module responds to anomaly identifications output by the anomaly detection module, the diffusion range and the intensity of anomaly correlations in the whole quality analysis system are quantized based on a propagation model, the evaluation index module constructs a multi-dimensional quality evaluation index system and calculates relative weights of indexes by adopting a hierarchical analysis method, the early warning monitoring module monitors network topology change and influence degree calculation results in real time, identifies anomaly correlations of different severity degrees by combining a hierarchical early warning threshold value, and the differentiation dynamic monitoring and treatment mechanism is started.
assignees: TIANJIN WANFU FINANCIAL CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Heating system abnormality detection and repair system and method based on data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heating system abnormality detection and repair system and a method based on data analysis, which relate to the technical field of heating system data analysis, and the invention collects multi-source data of a heating system user unit and aggregates system state vectors of all user units to form a system state vector set; the method comprises the steps of analyzing consistency coefficients of theoretical relations and actual readings among internal parameters of user units, analyzing external linkage difference degrees among adjacent user units in a heating network topology, analyzing and fusing abnormal indexes by integrating the consistency coefficients and the external linkage difference degrees, repairing accumulated heat based on repaired instantaneous parameter values, analyzing and repairing each accumulated heat repairing value, constructing a propagation directed graph, analyzing root cause suspected indexes of all nodes in the propagation directed graph, constructing a key root cause node candidate set based on a root cause suspected node sequence, and sending the key root cause node candidate set to an administrator, thereby improving accuracy of a final repairing result and improving diagnosis efficiency.
assignees: SHANDONG HETONG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Drainage pipe network water quality diffusion prediction method and system based on directed topology network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drainage pipe network water quality diffusion prediction method and system based on a directed topology network, and relates to the technical field of water quality monitoring. Aiming at the defects of the traditional water quality analysis method, the method comprises the steps of collecting water quality monitoring related data of a drainage pipe network, integrating the data into a standardized data set trained by an adaptation model after pretreatment and characteristic engineering screening, constructing a directed topology network model, introducing a water quality diffusion mechanism, fusing the data, enabling the network model to truly reflect the propagation rule of water quality among different nodes along with water flow, constructing a prediction model, training and optimizing the prediction model based on the standardized data set, comparing and verifying the prediction result of the prediction model with synchronous actual monitoring results, evaluating the accuracy and reliability of the model, predicting the water quality by using the drainage pipe network water quality diffusion prediction model qualified in evaluation, displaying the water quality prediction result of the prediction model by using a visualization tool, and synchronously displaying a water quality diffusion analysis report.
assignees: INSPUR SMART CITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power equipment state prediction method, equipment and medium based on data analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power equipment state prediction and discloses a power equipment state prediction method, equipment and medium based on data analysis. The method comprises the steps of obtaining and fusing time sequence operation data, wide area monitoring data and local scanning data of the power equipment to generate a unified equipment comprehensive state image. On the basis, the device is divided into a plurality of state evaluation units, a dynamic evolution model is built for each unit, and the evolution track of future state parameters is predicted. By identifying abnormal segments in the trajectory, potential points of failure inside the device are located. And analyzing space-time correlation among the abnormal points, constructing a global fault risk propagation network, and identifying key nodes and vulnerable paths to determine maintenance priority. The method realizes early accurate early warning of the local hidden trouble of the equipment and simulation of the system-level fault chain reaction, and improves the prospective of state prediction and the accuracy of maintenance decision.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ENERGY GROUP ENERGY SERVICES CO LTD

title_en: Voltage sag evaluation method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a voltage sag evaluation method and device. The application considers the voltage sag depth of the electric equipment, can improve the accuracy of the voltage sag, can furthest reduce the power interruption risk, and provides guarantee for the reliable and safe operation of the electric equipment. In the process of calculating the voltage sag depth of the electric equipment, the power grid coupling factor, the influence factor of the new energy equipment and/or the energy storage equipment and the comprehensive exposure index of the electric equipment are considered, the propagation and evolution process of the voltage sag in the power grid can be dynamically reflected, the evaluation accuracy and reliability are further improved, and the normal operation of the electric equipment is ensured. According to the application, the grading evaluation of the voltage sag is realized by setting different risk thresholds, different protection strategies can be provided for different power supply areas and different electric equipment, and the emergency response capability of the power supply areas and the electric equipment can be improved.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Subway station cascade failure risk early warning method based on dynamic passenger flow deduction
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of urban rail transit operation management, and particularly discloses a subway station cascade failure risk early warning method based on dynamic passenger flow deduction, which comprises the steps of carrying out hierarchical division on facilities in a subway station according to service facility functions, establishing a directional connection relationship between facilities based on passenger travelling paths, and setting passenger flow weights to construct a directional layered network model; the method comprises the steps of generating joint coupling parameters based on path association and passenger flow volume, establishing a dynamic state evolution model, determining a facility state by combining a facility bearing upper limit and the current passenger flow volume, updating a network structure, adjusting the passenger flow volume, deducing a comprehensive state at the next moment, predicting the congestion risk of the subway station according to the comprehensive state, and describing the in-station structure by means of facility layering and directed modeling, introducing passenger flow weight and joint coupling parameters, describing facility dependence, realizing cascade deduction by combining bearing judgment and passenger flow adjustment, and realizing subway station congestion risk prediction based on the dynamic state.
assignees: DEQING RAIL TRANSIT GROUP CO LTD;HANGZHOU METRO CONSTRUCTION MAN CO LTD

title_en: Hypergraph structure-based fault diagnosis method and hypergraph structure-based fault diagnosis system for multiple physical field transformers
abstract_en: The invention provides a hypergraph structure-based fault diagnosis method and system for a multi-physical-field transformer. The method comprises the steps of collecting multiple physical fields of a transformer in the operation process, forming a multi-channel data matrix, establishing a transformer multi-physical field coupling simulation model, simulating normal working conditions and multiple fault working conditions by adjusting related parameters, outputting simulation data, generating a hypergraph structure based on the simulation data by adopting a proximity relation method, obtaining a node set, a hyperedge set and a hyperedge weight matrix, mapping actually collected multi-physical field signals to a hypergraph, carrying out propagation calculation on node characteristics by utilizing a hypergraph convolution network, obtaining low-dimensional embedded vectors of all channels, carrying out characteristic splicing to form global characteristic vectors, and finally outputting corresponding fault categories. According to the invention, a stable hypergraph topological structure is constructed in an auxiliary way through simulation data, and the efficient fusion of the characteristics of multiple physical fields is realized by combining with real data, so that the lightweight fault diagnosis of the transformer is realized under the condition of reducing the sensor and the computing resources.
assignees: ULTRAHIGH PRESSURE CO OF STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Collaborative optimization control method and device for power distribution network and micro-grid
abstract_en: The application provides a collaborative optimization control method and a collaborative optimization control device for a power distribution network and a micro-grid, which relate to the technical field of intelligent grids, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining micro-distribution monitoring data flow; the method comprises the steps of carrying out multi-level fault prediction tracing, carrying out multi-level power flow reconstruction scheduling on a micro-cooperation power grid according to a micro-cooperation power grid prediction tracing map based on load time-varying characteristics, constructing a micro-cooperation dispatching space, introducing a reconstruction dispatching risk analysis model to carry out reconstruction dispatching risk filtering, carrying out power supply quality fitting evaluation filtering based on the load time-varying characteristics, and carrying out double-branch guide differential propagation optimizing on the micro-cooperation dispatching space to obtain a micro-cooperation dispatching optimizing result. According to the application, the technical problem of insufficient stability of the micro-grid coordination due to difficulty in effectively coping with faults and load fluctuation of the power distribution network and the micro-grid in the prior art is solved, and the intelligent scheduling and management capacity of the micro-grid coordination is improved, so that the reliability and stability of power supply are improved.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;UNIV HEFEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Robustness assessment method, device and equipment of power grid information physical system
abstract_en: The invention provides a robustness assessment method, a device and equipment of a power grid information physical system, and relates to the technical field of power information, comprising the steps of removing a fault power node and a fault information node from a first topological structure of the power grid information physical system to obtain a plurality of second topological structures; the method comprises the steps of determining fault probability of each power node and/or power line based on data transmission information of each information node in each second topological structure and a power flow calculation result of a power network corresponding to each second topological structure, removing at least one potential fault power network element and potential fault information node based on the fault probability of each power node and/or power line in each second topological structure for each second topological structure to obtain a third topological structure, and carrying out robustness assessment on a power grid information physical system. The invention can take into account the fault propagation process between the power network and the information network and quantify the influence of the information network fault on the power network.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RESEARCH INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;HEBEI HUIZHI POWER ENG DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Water conservancy rain radar coverage area simulation method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for simulating a coverage area of a water conservancy rain radar, and aims to solve the problem of coverage blind areas caused by relief of topography and equipment performance. According to the method, radar parameters, topographic data and atmospheric parameters are input, three-dimensional topography is converted into a distance-height two-dimensional section, electromagnetic wave distribution is solved by utilizing a parabolic equation, two-dimensional path loss is calculated by combining a propagation factor formula, three-dimensional path loss data is accumulated, and a coverage area simulation result is output by combining a radar detection capacity threshold value. Taking radar networking of 3 parts of a river basin as an example, simulation shows that the coverage area is increased from 11580.7km2 to 17848.9km2, and the dead zone ratio is reduced from 24.77% to 21.43%. The invention can provide technical support for optimizing the monitoring layout of three-line defense in a river basin and selecting rain-measuring radar equipment.
assignees: CHANGJIANG RIVER SCIENTIFIC RESEARCH INST OF CHANGJIANG WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION

title_en: Landslide hazard prediction method, device, equipment and medium based on machine learning
abstract_en: The application discloses a landslide hazard prediction method, device, equipment and medium based on machine learning, and relates to the field of geological hazard monitoring; the landslide disaster prediction method comprises the steps of distributing corresponding time period feature weights for each environmental monitoring data according to a time period where a first monitoring window is located, fusing various environmental monitoring data according to the time period feature weights to construct fused feature vectors, inputting the fused feature vectors into a landslide displacement prediction model to obtain predicted displacement, and determining landslide disaster prediction results of a to-be-predicted area according to the predicted displacement and a plurality of preset displacement risk thresholds, wherein the landslide displacement prediction model is trained based on an initial displacement prediction model constructed by fusing a long-short-period memory neural network and a reverse propagation neural network. By implementing the landslide disaster prediction method and device, the accuracy of landslide disaster prediction can be improved.
assignees: SOUTH SURVEYING & MAPPING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Hydraulic engineering risk intelligent regulation and control method based on expert balance
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering risk management, and discloses an intelligent hydraulic engineering risk regulation and control method based on an expert equal rights. The method comprises the steps of constructing a dynamic global risk network, abstracting facilities and environments into nodes and connections, and defining a basic risk unit. And calculating the real-time risk field intensity under the current network topology by scanning the acquired unit characteristics. When the field intensity exceeds the threshold value, an expert equal rights is triggered to make a decision, the risk contribution degree analysis is performed on the related units, and equal rights regulation coefficients are generated according to the risk contribution degree analysis and mapped into specific regulation instructions. And before execution, evaluating the control conflict through virtual deduction, and completing final control according to the result. The method can accurately quantify the dynamic propagation and aggregation effects of risks in the network, realize cooperative regulation and control based on contribution degree traceability, and improve the overall coordination of risk coping and the rationality of measure allocation.
assignees: HENAN WATER CONSERVANCY SURVEY CO LTD

title_en: Risk element identification and multi-factor association modeling method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a risk element identification and multi-factor association modeling method and system, and belongs to the field of risk analysis of flow industry. The modeling method comprises the steps of collecting an original text data set, preprocessing the original text data set to obtain a standardized corpus, carrying out risk semantic recognition on the standardized corpus by using a large language model, extracting semantic elements, carrying out semantic normalization processing on the extracted semantic elements, constructing a risk element coding system, establishing a relation network among the risk elements, storing semantic nodes and associated edges into a graph database to generate a risk event multidimensional associated model, carrying out risk analysis in the graph database, and analyzing the propagation path and key control relation of a risk event by using a visual interface. The invention improves the identification precision of the risk factors, effectively captures the potential risk factors in different data sources, improves the generalization capability of the model under diversified data sources, and ensures the timeliness and flexibility of the risk management system.
assignees: UNIV NANJING AERONAUTICS & ASTRONAUTICS

title_en: Intelligent troubleshooting method and system for distribution and utilization ring network faults
