abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent power grid industry, in particular to an intelligent troubleshooting method and system for a distribution and utilization ring network. The method generates the ring network situation primitive through multi-source heterogeneous data fusion. And (3) extracting the initial characteristics of the instantaneous faults by inputting the primitives into synchronous compression transformation, and mapping the initial characteristics of the instantaneous faults into fault propagation path characteristics through a graph rolling network considering topological structure constraints. And then, inputting the features into a space-time associated prediction model, integrating defect type discrimination and trend prejudgement features, and generating a fault diagnosis evidence set. And starting an investigation mechanism based on the evidence set to determine an investigation interval, and performing closed loop verification by constructing a fusion judgment matrix based on multi-mode physical sensing information to realize the physical space locking of fault defect points. The invention integrates deep learning diagnosis and multi-mode positioning, and effectively improves the detection precision and positioning efficiency of ring network defects and the recognition capability of transient hidden faults.
assignees: NANJING XUANMIAO ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wind-light power uncertainty evaluation method and system under Sha Chenwu haze meteorological conditions
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of wind-light power evaluation, and particularly relates to a wind-light power uncertainty evaluation method and system under sand-dust haze meteorological conditions, wherein the core flow comprises the steps of firstly acquiring key meteorological parameters such as sand-dust concentration, PM2.5 and the like, and extracting multi-scale space-time evolution characteristics by utilizing an improved space-time convolution neural network; and secondly, combining improved dynamic time warping and mutual information theory, and dynamically identifying nonlinear space-time correlation between meteorological changes and power fluctuation. On the basis, a probability model is built by combining a Bayesian neural network with a Monte Carlo Dropout algorithm, the separation and quantification of the cognitive uncertainty and the accidental uncertainty are realized, and finally, four-dimensional risk indexes such as power fluctuation entropy, prediction confidence interval width, conditional risk value, risk propagation coefficient and the like are calculated, and the comprehensive risk indexes are weighted and fused to realize the real-time and comprehensive assessment of the power generation risk of the new energy.
assignees: STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INSTITUTE;STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;IEC INT STANDARDS PROMOTION CENTER NANJING

title_en: Critical risk identification method, system and storage medium based on social network analysis and gravitation model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of complex system risk management, and relates to a key risk identification method, a system and a storage medium based on social network analysis and an gravitation model. Firstly, constructing a risk factor network model of a complex system, calculating the centrality, the middle centrality, the near centrality and the feature vector centrality of each risk factor by using a social network analysis method, normalizing the indexes, and determining the quality of the risk factor by an exponential function and a maximum and minimum normalization method. Secondly, the strength of action among risk factors is characterized by using Jaccard similarity coefficients, and the risk propagation distance is defined. And finally, calculating the gravitation values among the risk factors based on the quality and the propagation distance among the risk factors, and realizing the identification of the key risks by summarizing the total gravitation of each risk factor. The invention can comprehensively reflect the structural characteristics and the action intensity of risk factors in a complex system and improve the scientificity and accuracy of risk identification.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Power system state dynamic evaluation method, system, equipment and medium for abnormal signal diffusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system state dynamic evaluation method, a system, equipment and a medium aiming at abnormal signal diffusion, belonging to the technical field of power system safety and scheduling control, comprising the steps of collecting multiple abnormal signals and constructing a directed multi-source heterograph; the method comprises the steps of carrying out system state modeling by utilizing a multi-stage dynamic propagation model based on the graph, combining the power grid topology and the weighted propagation weight, adopting an optimization graph search algorithm to identify an abnormal propagation path, evaluating the stability influence of the system according to the path identification result, and generating an intelligent auxiliary decision. The method realizes accurate simulation and path identification of multi-anomaly signal concurrent propagation of the power system by constructing the anomaly signal propagation path identification and diffusion model, combines an optimized graph search algorithm and a multi-dimensional evaluation system, improves the efficiency and accuracy of anomaly analysis in a large-scale power grid environment, and finally provides a scientific basis for rapid response for a dispatcher through an intelligent decision generation mechanism.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Rapid prediction method for thermochemical energy storage carrier particle thermo-mechanical coupling process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid prediction method of a particle thermal-force coupling process, which is characterized by scanning carrier particles based on a micro-focus computed tomography technology to generate a three-dimensional digital model, importing the three-dimensional digital model into a multi-physical-field simulation platform to establish a transient full-order model, generating training data sets and test data sets under different working conditions and corresponding temperature fields and stress fields based on the transient full-order model, decomposing and calculating the training data sets by utilizing an intrinsic orthogonal decomposition POD (point-of-sale) reduced-order model to obtain POD basis functions and spectrum coefficients, establishing a mapping model from an input working condition to an output spectrum coefficient based on a BP (back propagation) neural network, inputting the target working condition into the mapping model to output the POD spectrum coefficient, and reconstructing full-field physical quantity distribution at any moment under the target working condition by linear combination based on a calculation result and the POD spectrum coefficient. The method solves the problems of low calculation efficiency and high resource consumption of the traditional numerical simulation.

title_en: Power grid fault risk positioning method, device, equipment and medium based on energy margin
abstract_en: The application discloses a power grid fault risk positioning method, device, equipment and medium based on energy margin, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining basic energy margin of each node in a power grid according to power grid operation data; the method comprises the steps of correcting a basic energy margin based on a hybrid neural network of a long-term memory network and a reverse propagation network to obtain a corrected dynamic energy margin, constructing a graph neural network according to a power grid topology, determining node characteristics of the graph neural network based on the dynamic energy margin to generate vulnerability scores of all elements in the power grid based on the graph neural network, constructing a two-dimensional risk assessment matrix according to the dynamic energy margin and the vulnerability scores, and judging risk grades of all elements in the power grid to perform risk positioning. The method and the system can improve the instantaneity and accuracy of power grid fault risk positioning.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Power demand prediction method, equipment and medium for power distribution network based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power demand prediction method, equipment and medium for a power distribution network based on big data analysis, which belong to the technical field of power demand prediction and comprise the steps of dividing the power distribution network into a plurality of power nodes, collecting power data of the power nodes, and screening to obtain power abnormal nodes; the method comprises the steps of collecting demand information of power abnormal nodes, extracting to obtain power demand events according to the demand information, obtaining event information of the power demand events, evaluating to obtain propagation effect conditions of the power demand events according to the event information, collecting real-time prediction demand values of the power abnormal nodes, determining power change values of other power nodes in combination with the propagation effect conditions, collecting real-time environment data of the power nodes, predicting to obtain basic power demand values according to the real-time environment data, and superposing the power change values to obtain real-time power demand values. The method and the system improve the accuracy of power demand prediction of the power distribution network based on big data analysis.
assignees: GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent mine pressure monitoring and early warning system based on AI algorithm and dynamic analysis method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ore pressure early warning, and discloses an ore pressure intelligent monitoring early warning system based on an AI algorithm and a dynamic analysis method thereof, wherein the ore pressure intelligent monitoring early warning system based on the AI algorithm comprises a distance sensitive spectrum information extraction module for obtaining distance sensitive spectrum information; the system comprises a radial sequence determining module, a radial graph generating module, a node level risk amount calculating module, an alarm triggering state determining module and a space positioning module, wherein the radial sequence determining module determines a radial sequence, the radial graph generating module generates a radial graph, the node level risk amount calculating module generates a node level risk amount, the alarm triggering state determining module determines an alarm triggering state, and the space positioning module identifies the maximum value position of a continuous risk field as a space positioning result. According to the invention, the distance sensitive spectrum information is extracted and is integrated with the medium dispersion characteristic, the association rule of the signal and the propagation distance is captured, the ordered radial graph is constructed by combining the energy centroid and the radial sequence, and the internal connection of the spatial distribution and the spectrum characteristics among the nodes is excavated through the neural network, so that the false alarm and missing report condition of the alarm is reduced, and the safety production guarantee capability is improved.
assignees: HUAIBEI MINING IND CO LTD;SICHUAN AEROSPACE ELECTRO & HYDRAULIC CONTROL CO LTD

title_en: Industrial waste heat cascade utilization regulation and control method based on multi-source flow cooperation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of industrial waste heat utilization and intelligent regulation, in particular to an industrial waste heat cascade utilization regulation method based on multi-source flow cooperation, which comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin body to comprehensively deconstruct and simulate an industrial waste heat pipe network, accurately grasping the whole process of waste heat generation, transmission and consumption, prompting the system to distribute high-grade waste heat to high-demand users preferentially through a gradient stable rewarding function, reasonably utilizing medium-low temperature waste heat, avoiding waste of the waste heat, the cascade utilization of waste heat is realized, the overall utilization efficiency is remarkably improved, the punishment index of pipe network stability is fully considered in the decision-making process of the DRL algorithm, the excessive pressure fluctuation of the pipe network is avoided due to the regulation and control strategy, the DRL algorithm outputs the optimal regulation and control strategy covering multiple working conditions through trial and error learning in a digital twin environment, and meanwhile, the adaptability and stability of the algorithm under different scenes are ensured through covering the generalization capability of the applicable index evaluation strategy.
assignees: XINJIANG DERUN THERMAL POWER CO LTD;XINJIANG DERUN ECONOMIC CONSTRUCTION DEV CO LTD

title_en: Low-carbon planning method for power distribution network considering low-carbon sharing of multiple types of energy stations
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power distribution network planning, and relates to a power distribution network low-carbon planning method considering low-carbon sharing of multiple types of energy stations. The method comprises the steps of dividing energy stations into high-carbon energy stations, zero-carbon energy stations and carbon-negative energy stations according to carbon emission levels, determining equipment parameters, operation constraint and power distribution network basic parameters of various energy stations, establishing CCER a gain sharing model and an equivalent carbon emission right sharing model, constructing an objective function of a low-carbon planning model of a power distribution network and an objective function of a cooperation sharing model of the energy stations, representing uncertainty of photovoltaic output and load, calculating expected cost, carrying out model solving by adopting an objective cascading analysis algorithm, and obtaining a power distribution network planning scheme and an energy station operation strategy by iteratively updating Lagrange multipliers and exchange power. The method and the system realize the reduction of the cost of the power distribution network, the great reduction of carbon emission, the improvement of the overall benefit of the energy station, the efficient coordination of the benefit main body and the sharing mechanism diversification, and the improvement of the flexibility and the carbon reduction potential of the system.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Urban water consumption prediction system and method based on multi-source heterogeneous data coupling modeling
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of smart cities, in particular to a city water consumption prediction system and method based on multi-source heterogeneous data coupling modeling, comprising the following steps that a multi-source data acquisition module acquires multi-dimensional influence factor data from heterogeneous data sources; the data preprocessing and coupling module cleans and normalizes data and generates a structured training data set through space-time alignment and fusion operation, the prediction model building module builds a three-layer BP neural network prediction model based on the data set, the model training and optimizing module divides the data set into a training set and a testing set and carries out iterative training and parameter optimization on the model by utilizing the training set and a back propagation algorithm, the model precision verification module evaluates the prediction performance of the trained model by utilizing the testing set and calculates a plurality of precision evaluation indexes, and the prediction service deployment module packages and deploys the model which is qualified in verification into a callable prediction service so as to realize quick and accurate prediction on new input data.
assignees: LUOYANG URBAN PLANNING & ARCHITECTURE DESIGN RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Pt/pt-z camera command, control & visualization system and method utilizing artificial intelligence
abstract_en: A system and method for wildfire detection, monitoring, and consequence modeling integrate digital cameras with artificial intelligence to identify, track, and predict fire behavior. The system processes camera imagery, satellite data, environmental inputs, aircraft telemetry, and contextual information to detect ignition points, triangulate fire locations, and model projected fire spread. A fire propagation engine generates maps, graphs, and consequence estimates, including burned area, affected infrastructure, population exposure, and financial loss. Alerts are triggered based on detection and modeled impact, with filters to suppress false positives, merge repeated detections, and escalate based on user-defined risk thresholds. The system includes tools for managing prescribed fires, tracking smoke-only detections, and customizing alert logic by geography, asset proximity, or scenario. External datasets may be ingested via API or file upload to support consequence scoring and operational prioritization. Users may run simulations, analyze historical conditions, and export results for planning, response coordination, or regulatory reporting.
assignees: DIGITAL PATH INC

title_en: Ceiling-mounted electric vehicle charging system equipped with fire spread delay function
title_ko: 화재 확산 지연 기능을 구비한 천장형 전기차 충전 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전기차의 주차 공간의 천장에 배치되는 것으로서, 주차된 전기차에 전력을 공급하는 충전 코드, 상기 충전 코드와 연결되는 연장 케이블 및 상기 충전 코드를 제어에 따라 인출 및 수납하는 충전 본체를 포함하는 천장형 전기차 충전부; 상기 충전 본체의 내부에 배치되고, 주차된 전기차와 연결되었을 때 통신을 통해 충전을 위한 전압과 전류를 확인하여 조정하고, 충전된 전력량을 측정하는 전기차 충전 제어부; 상기 충전 본체의 내부에 배치되고, 상기 전기차 충전 제어부와 통신 가능하며 전기차의 화재 발생을 감지하기 위해 구비되는 화재 감지 처리부; 상기 천장형 전기차 충전부의 외부에서 상기 전기차 충전 제어부 및 상기 화재 감지 처리부와 통신하며, 전기차의 배터리 상태정보와 충전 상태를 수집하는 전기차 충전 관제부; 및 상기 천장형 전기차 충전부의 외부에서 상기 화재 감지 처리부와 통신하며, 화재 발생을 수신하고 전파하는 시설 및 건물 화재 수신부를 포함하는 화재 확산 지연 기능을 구비한 천장형 전기차 충전 시스템에 관한 것이다. 이러한 본 발명에 따르면, 천장형 이동식 전기차 충전 시스템의 가지고 있는 설치 위치에 대한 이점을 활용하여 차량 화재 발생시 화재 발생을 빠르게 감지하고, 화재의 확산 속도를 늦추는 장치를 장착하여, 화재 피해를 줄일 수 있다.
assignees: KIM CHANG KYU

title_en: Method and system for supporting brain-like simulation model learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for supporting learning of a brain-like simulation model, wherein the method comprises the steps of managing all parameters in the brain-like simulation model, classifying the parameters into fixed parameters, variable parameters, non-micro parameters and learnable parameters according to calculation characteristics, designing an approximate function operator library for the non-micro parameters, integrating the library into the system, designing an application rule of an approximate function, enabling the original calculation function of the non-micro parameters to be adopted in the forward calculation process of the model, calling the approximate function of the non-micro parameters to conduct differential derivation calculation in the backward propagation gradient solving stage, designing an approximate function call interface of the brain-like simulation model, replacing a non-differential calculation part in the model, and constructing a learnable brain-like simulation model network to conduct task learning training. According to the invention, through refined parameter management and combination of approximate function simulation gradient calculation, efficient learning and training of the brain-like simulation model are realized, and the method is successfully applied to complex classification tasks.
assignees: CHINA NANHU ACAD OF ELECTRONICS AND INFORMATION

title_en: Drones and abnormal noise detection alarm systems for monitoring military guard areas and critical dangerous facilities, and their methods
title_ko: 군사 경계 경비지역 및 중요 위험시설 감시용 드론 및 이상소음 탐지 경보 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 군사 경계 경비지역 및 중요 위험시설 감시용 드론 및 이상소음 탐지 경보 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 온디바이스 AI 소음 센서를 사용하여, 드론 및 이상소음의 음향 특징을 추출하여 드론 및 이상소음을 정확하게 탐지하고 자동으로 경보하며 상황실로 드론 및 이상소음의 탐지정보를 실시간 전송함으로써, 드론의 침입에 의한 위협을 조기에 차단 및 격멸할 수 있다. 본 발명에 의한 군사 경계 경비지역 및 중요 위험시설 감시용 드론 및 이상소음 탐지 경보 시스템은, 군사 경계 경비지역 및 중요 위험시설물에 설치된 고정형 음향탐지경보장치(110)의 온디바이스 AI 소음 센서(200)를 통해, 드론 및 이상 소음원에 대한 주파수 스펙트럼과 시간 및 증폭도를 검출하여 드론 및 이상 소음원을 탐지하고 자동으로 경보하는 군사 경계 경비지역 및 중요 위험시설 감시용 드론 및 이상소음 탐지 경보 시스템에 있어서, 상기 고정형 음향탐지경보장치(110)는, 상기 군사 경계 경비지역 및 중요 위험시설물에 설치되며, 전방에 호른 원형구조로 개구된 안쪽에 음원감지 마이크(112)가 배치되고 상부에 상황전파용 무선송출 안테나(113)가 배치되며 하부에 배치된 전원공급 잭(116)에 전원공급 플러그(117)가 연결된 방수 및 방폭 케이스(111); 상기 방수 및 방폭 케이스(111)의 내부에 배치되며, 상기 음원감지 마이크(112)를 통해 드론 및 이상 소음원이 입력되면 AI가 동작하여 ANN 알고리즘의 머신 러닝을 통해 드론 및 이상 소음원에 대한 소음 상태를 스캔 및 데이터 필터링하고 소음원의 원시 데이터를 식별하며, 소음원의 진폭과 주파수 변화 여부를 나타내는 의미 있고 정보성이 있는 한 개 이상의 레이블을 추가하여 컨텍스트를 제공하는 데이터 레이블링을 수행하며, 상기 드론 및 이상 소음원에 대한 정상 상태의 기준 소음데이터와 변화된 소음데이터를 머신 러닝을 통해 연산하여 소음원에 대한 정상과 비정상적인 조건을 구분하고 정상과 비정상 결과를 도출하여 드론 및 이상 소음원을 탐지하며, 상기 드론 및 이상 소음원의 탐지 데이터를 무선랜, 블루투스, USB 중 어느 하나를 통해서 에지 게이트웨이 디바이스로 전송하는 온디바이스 AI 소음 센서(200); 상기 방수 및 방폭 케이스(111)의 후방에 고정된 각도조절 링크(114); 상기 각도조절 링크(114)를 상하 소정의 각도로 회전 가능하게 결합하여 고정하는 링크 고정부(115); 및 상기 링크 고정부(115)를 전방의 고정판(118a)에 체결하여 고정하는 고정용 브라켓(118);을 포함한다.

title_en: Hilbert fractal medium-short wave antenna
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a Hilbert fractal medium-short wave antenna, which belongs to the field of antennas and comprises a radiation part, a grounding grid part and a feed part. The radiation part comprises a metal support rod, a Hilbert fractal structure and a wave trap, so that the original surface current distribution path is cut off, and a cascade inductance is introduced to inhibit the high-frequency skin effect. The grounding grid system is of a double-layer structure, wherein the middle grounding grid intercepts space waves, and the bottom grounding grid is connected with ferrite magnetic beads in series to absorb common mode noise. The feed system is internally provided with a balun and pi-T mixed matching network, and the standing wave ratio is less than or equal to 1.5. The working bandwidth of the antenna is 526.5KHz-28MHz, the interference suppression depth is-35 dB, and the antenna is suitable for portable emergency communication and fixed monitoring stations.
assignees: NO 202 STATION NAT RADIO AND TELEVISION ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Photovoltaic safety early warning method based on Bayesian dynamic belief propagation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic safety early warning method based on Bayesian dynamic belief propagation, and relates to the field of photovoltaic safety early warning. According to the method, a dynamic Bayesian network model of risk evolution along with time is constructed, the BD-BP algorithm is utilized to perform belief propagation reasoning on multi-source heterogeneous data, and the risk weighting convergence is performed by combining with the network topology centrality. Therefore, false alarm caused by environmental noise is effectively restrained, dynamic tracking and accurate positioning of gradual change type risks of the photovoltaic equipment are realized, early warning has the characteristics of high anti-interference capability and accurate key node identification, and crossing from single-point passive alarm to system-level active situation sensing is realized.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CORPORATION SICHUAN ENERGY INVEST CO LTD;CHINA THREE GORGES CORP

title_en: Ship SOFC system safety analysis method, computing device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ship SOFC system safety analysis method, and belongs to the technical field of risk prevention and control. The method comprises the steps of determining cause factors of a ship SOFC system, constructing a failure accident tree and an event tree model, constructing a Bow-Tie model according to the failure accident tree and the event tree model, quantitatively analyzing the potential cause factors to obtain key factors affecting the SOFC system, combining analyzed ship SOFC system accident cause data and collected ship fuel cell standard specification data to form a data system, constructing a ship SOFC system accident risk prevention knowledge graph, and analyzing the SOFC system safety according to the ship SOFC system accident risk prevention knowledge graph. The method and the system define the key degree, the hierarchical relationship and the action path of each cause factor, construct the cause factors into the accident cause complex network, and deeply disclose the accident cause propagation mechanism by combining the semantic information of the knowledge graph and the analysis capability of the complex network, thereby providing a comprehensive view for understanding the occurrence and the development of the accident.
assignees: SHIP INFORMATION RESEARCH CENTER CHINA SHIPBUILDING CORPORATION LIMITED NO 714 INST;BEIJING INST OF PETROCHEMICAL TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Method and system for dynamically analyzing domino accident evolution path of petrochemical device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for dynamically analyzing a domino accident evolution path of a petrochemical device, wherein the method is used for mapping accident objects and information into a mathematical model after basic information of accident objects related to the petrochemical device is determined to form a network model, the influence of different types of accidents on equipment is quantitatively analyzed by considering the influence of the different types of accidents based on the network model of the petrochemical device, the dynamic upgrading probability of the equipment is determined, an equipment association relation diagram is formed based on the equipment distribution and the dynamic upgrading probability of the network model of the petrochemical device, the visual display of a domino accident chain is realized, a foundation is provided for establishing accident guarantee measures of different equipment, and the domino accident occurrence probability is controlled. The scheme can overcome the defects of the relevance and comprehensiveness of the existing accident analysis technology, quantitatively analyzes the dynamic evolution occurrence probability of the accident chain based on the domino accident dynamic evolution analysis logic, and is convenient for providing support for realizing flexible prevention and blocking.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP;SINOPEC SAFETY ENGINEERING RESEARCH INST CO LTD;SINOPEC NATIONAL PETROLEUM PROJECT RISK ASSESSMENT TECH CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Cascade water wind-solar storage integrated scheduling method, system, equipment and medium for multi-energy complementary system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of control, and discloses a step water, wind and solar energy storage integrated scheduling method, a system, equipment and a medium for a multi-energy complementary system. The method comprises the steps of constructing a water-wind-solar-storage multifunctional complementary integrated model based on a river basin cascade hydropower station, transforming a conventional cascade hydropower station into a hybrid pumped storage power station, introducing water balance, pumping mutual exclusion and power constraint specific to hybrid pumped storage, performing upper-layer optimization with the aim of minimizing net load peak-valley difference of a power grid to generate a smooth initial net load curve, performing lower-layer optimization with the aim of minimizing comprehensive operation cost of a system based on the upper-layer optimization, comprehensively considering thermal power cost, new energy operation and maintenance cost, waste wind and waste light cost, ladder carbon transaction cost and energy storage cost, and finally verifying the effectiveness of the model through simulation experiments. The invention improves the system adjustment flexibility, new energy consumption capability and economic operation efficiency, and realizes the high-efficiency and low-carbon collaborative scheduling of the multi-energy complementary system.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Multi-dimensional visualization method, system, equipment and medium for electric carbon flow
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric carbon flow multidimensional visualization method, an electric carbon flow multidimensional visualization system, electric carbon flow multidimensional visualization equipment and an electric carbon flow multidimensional visualization medium, and relates to the technical field of energy information visualization. And calculating the flow direction difference between the node injection power and the node delivery power, and generating a path offset migration characteristic quantity. And comparing the phasor direction sequences of the adjacent nodes to obtain path replacement aggregate mapping data. And calculating the difference of the adjacent powers of the nodes, generating gradient turning density information, evaluating the abnormal response characteristics of the nodes in the carbon propagation diagram, and identifying and judging the abnormal behavior type. The invention realizes the real-time response and dynamic optimization of the electric carbon distribution along with the load fluctuation. The dynamic propagation path and space aggregation relation of the carbon flow in the power grid is presented through path migration correction and structural rearrangement, the gradient turning density extraction technology is utilized to carry out multi-scale structural analysis on power time sequence change, and finally the type of abnormal behavior is identified and judged.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Lightning strike fire spreading simulation method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a lightning strike fire spreading simulation method and a system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source space-time characteristic data corresponding to lightning strike fire; the method comprises the steps of carrying out feature extraction and fusion on corresponding multi-source space-time feature data through a pre-constructed space-time feature fusion network, outputting prediction parameters used for representing fire state conversion, constructing a multi-state cellular automaton comprising smoldering states and open flame states, positioning lightning strike ignition points, initializing states of cells corresponding to the lightning strike ignition points to be smoldering states, giving initial heat energy to the cells corresponding to the lightning strike ignition points, carrying out phase change discrimination on the cells in the smoldering states based on the prediction parameters and dynamic time sequence features, carrying out vector correction based on a neighborhood propagation rule based on a phase change discrimination result, carrying out lightning strike fire propagation simulation, and outputting a simulation result. By utilizing the scheme of the application, the accuracy and the scientificity of lightning fire simulation are obviously improved through deep coupling of deep learning feature extraction and physical mechanism modeling.
assignees: CHINA FIRE AND RESCUE INST

title_en: Metal fitting and connector making use thereof
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide metal fittings capable of sufficiently maintaining strength of a joint section when a sleeper for a large cross section is constructed, solving such a problem as the occurrence of the condensation or the fragility in the case of a disaster, reducing processing expenses of a member and, in addition, being used for joining a foundation enabling also cracks occurring in the sleeper to control with the sleeper and a connector making use of the metal fittings.  <P>SOLUTION: Since a part of load acting on the sleeper 41 is transferred to the sill 31 from the uneven step line 17 of the metal fittings 11 by connecting the sleeper 41 having a large cross section to the sill 32 by using the connector constituted of the metal fittings 11 forming an step line 17 capable of being mounted on the upper surface of a sill 31, a fastening member consisting of a bolt 14 for fixing the metal fittings 11 to the sill 32 and a nut 15 and a drift pin 16, the concentration of the load to everyone of the sill 32, the sleeper 41 and the metal fittings 11 can be prevented to make it possible to surely maintain reliability of a building.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Electric generator reconstruction hydraulic cylinder device
title_ko: 유압 실린더 장치를 재 구성한 발전시스템
abstract_en: An electric power system remaking a hydraulic cylinder device is provided to produce non-polluted electricity by using a hydraulic cylinder equipped with a cylinder shaft, a joint shaft, and a clutch gear set and obtaining big power from small electrical energy. An electric power system remaking a hydraulic cylinder device comprises hydraulic cylinder devices(1,2). The hydraulic cylinder obtains the big power from small electrical energy. The hydraulic cylinder comprises cylinder shafts(3,4), joint shafts(5,6), and clutch gear sets(7,8). The cylinder shaft pushes the joint shaft as a two-stroke piston. The joint shaft is converted from linear motion to rotational motion and rotates the clutch gear set. The connection shaft is connected to the cylinder shaft and the clutch gear set and increases torque. Excessive electric energy over 90% is obtained by power generation consumption electricity below 10%. Three back up batteries are equipped and self-driving is performed in power outage.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 기성풍력발전기의 연속성이 결여된 풍양풍속과 과다한 설치비용 엔진발전기의 공해와 생산비용 이러한 불합리적 불안정한 요소들을 모두 해결한 다목적 동력전달 장치로서 작은 전력으로도 큰 파워의 동력을 얻을 수 있는 기성의 유압 장치를 재 구성한 시스템이다. 유압 펌프에 2세트의 실린더를 재 구성하여 2행정을 하게하고 실린더 축과 클러치기어 (클러치 베어링) 세트 중간에 지렛대 역할의 연결 축을 구성하여 유압실린더의 막강 파워와 연결 축의 지렛대 역할까지 배가된 큰 파워로 클러치기어 (클러치 베어링) 세트를 순서대로 (rotation) 밀어 직선운동에서 회전운동으로 클러치기어 축을 회전시켜 증 감속기어박스를 거치며 안정된 회전과 파워로 기성발전기에 터빈 또는 로터 축을 회전시켜 값싼 양질의 무공해 전기를 생산하는 발전기 동력전달 시스템 이다. 
     특히 본 발명은 작은 양의 기성전기 (예:100kw 생산에 시스템 운전전기 10kw미만 소비됨)나 충전된 배터리 장착으로 처음운전이 시작되면 2차 3차로 구성된 충전용 배터리 시스템이 순서대로 (rotation) 동작 충전이 되어 1차 배터리전원이 소진되면 2차로 2차가 소진되면 3차로 다시 1차로 이러한 시스템으로 운전이 되며 운전전기는 생산전기의 10％이하 소비됨으로 값싼 양질의 무공해 잉여전기를 90％이상 생산할 수 있는 것이다 풍력발전의 불안정한 바람이나 엔진발전기에 공해덩어리 화석연료 이모든 불확실성을 해결한 것을 특징으로 하며 기성전기를 사용할 경우 충전배터리 시스템은 비상시를 대비한 예비전력 (spare)인 동시에 장시간 사용도  가능케 한 것 또한 큰 성과이다.

title_en: Railway disaster prevention wind early warning method
abstract_en: The invention provides a railway disaster prevention wind early warning method which is based on wind historical data of a wind data acquisition subsystem in a railway disaster prevention system, identifies a wind early warning probability mathematical model of the point through analysis of sample points formed by the wind historical data, and calculates the condition of wind speed distribution of the next stage through the model and the current wind speed. The method is used for predicting the probability of the strong wind in the next stage under the condition of the current wind and giving early warning to the wind speed in the next time interval in a confidence interval mode.
assignees: JIAXUN FEIHONG ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Disaster-preventing ecological roof tile and structure thereof
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To solve the problems of conventional predominate roof tiles such that a pottery roof tile highest in heat-insulating property among them is heavy in weight and apt to cause the penetration of rainwater due to its fragility, and its heavy body weight is the main factor of collapse of a wooden structure; reflection of solar light to the air or release of radiation heat runs counter to prevention of warming; and the temperature difference between the outside and the inside is bad for health and causes molding or the like through dew condensation.  <P>SOLUTION: The disaster-preventing ecological roof tile is a structure composed of a foam body in low density. Therefore, this roof tile can be extremely reduced in weight to reduce a member strength, and thus allows replacement without needing reinforcement in reform or the like to promote earthquake countermeasures. The disaster-preventing ecological roof tile structure is excellent in heat insulation to secure an exterior thermal insulation effect for a structure. Therefore, the temperature difference between room temperature and outside air can be eliminated to prevent dew condensation. Further, a living environment which is cool in summer and warm in winder can be attained with increased ecological effect such as reduction in usage of an air conditioner or the like. The penetration of rainwater observed in the pottery roof tile can be also prevented by eliminating a gap by an EPS heat-insulating base.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT
assignees: SAN BISO KK

title_en: Method for prewarning Doppler radar remote sensing strong storm
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic prewarning method for strong storms. Doppler weather radar data is used. According to identification on storms, false combination of storms can be successfully identified by adopting a method based on mathematical morphology, namely expansion operation and corrosion operation are comprehensively used during multi-threshold identification, and relatively near storms can be separated from a storm cluster; then, according to tracking of the storms, the tracking process is greatly simplified by adopting a sequential monte carlo method, and situations of splitting, combination and leakage detection of the storms can be handled; and finally, the storms are prewarned, namely linear fitting extrapolation prewarning is realized by being combined with a motion vector field obtained by an optical flow method. According to the method, complicated situations that radar echo is densely distributed and frequently split and combined can be handled. The method has the advantages that a prewarning software system is arranged in provincial and municipal weather stations; high-convection weather prewarning service is provided; and the urgent demands for preventing and reducing disasters in China are met.
assignees: OCEAN UNIV CHINA

title_en: A kind of wind farm risk evaluation method based on monte carlo method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of wind energy turbine set disaster risk estimation method based on monte carlo method.The present invention includes following steps, step (1) is set up based on the wind series forecast model of time series method; First, raw data standardization: secondly, Model Identification: then, parameter is determined: step (2) allusion quotation is based on the bulk power system reliability assessment taking into account wind energy turbine set of sequential Monte Carlo method; First, random sampling: secondly, reliability assessment: the present invention is based on a large amount of wind-powered electricity generation database, take into full account the randomness of wind speed; And adopting Monte Carlo fast algorithm, speed is fast.

title_en: Lattice type single-row reinforcing bar L-shaped section concrete column
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lattice type single-row reinforcing bar L-shaped section concrete column, and belongs to the technical field of shock absorption and disaster prevention. A steel bar framework of the L-shaped column is L-shaped. Two pieces of lattice single-row reinforcing fabric (3) are welded to form two limbs which are in an L shape. Pieces of ladder-lattice-shaped reinforcing fabric (2) are welded on the end portions of the two limbs of the L-shaped lattice single-row reinforcing fabric (3). Tie bars (4) are vertically welded on the centers of transverse horizontal steel bars of the ladder-lattice-shaped reinforcing fabric (2), and are distributed at even intervals along the direction of the height of the column. The lattice type single-row reinforcing bar L-shaped section concrete column utilizes single-row reinforcing bars, so that construction is simple and steel bar consumption is low. Lattice reinforcing steel pieces are welded to form the reinforcing bars, and therefore the lattice type single-row reinforcing bar L-shaped section concrete column is suitable for industrial production. The lattice reinforcing bars are utilized, inclined web bars are good in shearing resistance, and therefore fragility shearing destruction of deformed-section short columns is prevented and anti-earthquake ductility of the lattice type single-row reinforcing bar L-shaped section concrete column is improved. In the end portions of a section of the lattice type single-row reinforcing bar L-shaped section concrete column, short steel bars are utilized to be combined with ecological wall boards or ecological wall bricks closely, so that the purposes that the integrity of a house is enhanced and overall anti-earthquake and energy-dissipated capacity is improved are achieved. Accordingly, the lattice type single-row reinforcing bar L-shaped section concrete column is applied to rural houses.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Wind power farm risk assessing system based on Monte Carlo method
abstract_en: Embodiments of the utility model disclose a wind power farm risk assessing system based on the Monte Carlo method. The risk assessing system comprises a data processing module, a wind speed predicting module, a random sampling module and a risk assessing module. The output end of the data processing module makes wind speed standardization data input into the wind speed predicting module. The output end of the wind speed predicting module outputs wind speed predicting signals to the random sampling module. The output end of the random sampling module outputs element state signals of an electric power system to the risk assessing module. The system which is applied for setting up a large power grid system reliability rapid analysis model applied for wind power farm calculation and based on Monte Carlo simulation takes the randomness of the wind speed and the forced outage rate of a wind generation set into full consideration and performs reliability assessment on a large power grid system of calculated wind power farms. The wind power farm risk assessing system has a wide application prospect and potential economic values.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: The method that assessment mountain fire causes transmission line malfunction probability
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of method assessing mountain fire initiation transmission line malfunction probability, belong to Power System and its Automation technical field。Present invention achieves mountain fire and cause the qualitative assessment of transmission line malfunction probability, the mechanism of transmission line malfunction is caused according to mountain fire, establish line fault probabilistic model accurately, correctly reflect the inside and outside portion factor relevant to transmission line malfunction, make mountain fire cause line fault probability assessment and be not necessarily dependent on the accumulation of historical data, and it is contemplated that key factor, there is very strong adaptability。The present invention has greatly promoted transmission line of electricity risk management, improves the ability of power system defence external disaster。

title_en: Substation operation risk evaluation method based on graph theory
abstract_en: A substation operation risk evaluation method based on a graph theory comprises the following concrete steps: carrying out data input and constructing an input data module for substation operation risk evaluation; using an element outage model module to calculate the outage probability of substation elements; using a Monte Carlo module to simulate the randomness for the substation elements to exit operation so as to form a substation system state; identifying connectivity of the system state of the substation by a graph theory method and judging whether a load point is communicated with a power supply point; and evaluating a substation operation risk and calculating a corresponding substation operation risk index. According to the substation operation risk evaluation method of the invention, consideration is given to the randomness of substation events, the system state of the substation is extracted by a Monte Carlo method, the method of identifying the connectivity through the use of the graph theory is proposed, substation main wiring risk evaluation is converted into a problem of identification of connectivity between the load point and the power supply point inside the substation, the complexity of problem analysis is simplified, and the purpose of substation operation risk evaluation is achieved.
assignees: UNIV NANCHANG

title_en: Power grid operating state assessment method based on risk theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid operating state assessment method based on the risk theory. The method comprises the following steps: data is collated, and a data processing module is established; the outage probability of power grid elements is calculated; the element outage probability data is stored; the power grid operating state is extracted through the Monte Carlo method; the system state is analyzed; system state analysis is performed through a submodule 5 to judge whether problems, such as the circuit overload problem, the voltage out-of-limit problem, the bus isolation problem, the problem that a system is separated into isolated islands, etc., occur; the power grid operating risk indicators are calculated; and the power grid operating state risk indicator result is analyzed to give out the weak link of the power grid. According to the invention, risk assessment is performed on the power grid operating state; the actual operating state of the power grid is simulated by using the Monte Carlo method, the event random nature of the power grid is taken into account reasonably; different risk indicators are used, multi-angle and multi-level assessment is performed on the power grid operating state risk; and the power grid operating state risk assessment result is analyzed to give out the weak link of the power grid.

title_en: Hydroenergy storage station participates in the dispatching method containing wind-powered electricity generation electric power system
abstract_en: The invention provides the dispatching method that a kind of hydroenergy storage station participates in containing wind-powered electricity generation electric power system, first the installed capacity of hydroenergy storage station is divided and carry out option screening and obtain feasible program, then set up according to different feasible programs the scheduling model a few days ago that hydroenergy storage station participates in containing wind-powered electricity generation electric power system; Then solving model obtain the operating point of hydroenergy storage station regulating units, the Unit Combination of fired power generating unit and operating point under different feasible program, system operating cost and abandon air quantity; What relatively contain wind-powered electricity generation electric power system under each feasible program abandons air quantity, if it is inconsistent to abandon air quantity, then choosing and abandoning the minimum scheme of air quantity is optimal case; Otherwise, total positive and negative spinning reserve that each period system can provide is calculated according to the above results, use the expected loss of energy of Monte Carlo simulation approach computing system and then obtain outage cod, finally compare the total cost under each feasible program, and to choose the minimum feasible program of total cost be optimal dividing scheme.

title_en: Method for quickly evaluating economic losses generated by landslides caused by earthquakes
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for quickly evaluating economic losses generated by landslides caused by earthquakes. The method includes the steps that firstly, a study area is divided into different geological areas according to geological classes, and then gradient data of the study area are acquired; safety coefficients of the geological areas are calculated, limit acceleration and ground motion peak acceleration data of the geological regions are calculated, risk parameters of the landslides probably causing the economic losses of the geological areas are calculated, and the average value of the risk parameters of the landslides in each county is acquired with the county as the unit; economic fragility parameters of each county are calculated, reduction coefficients are calculated for the areas where the earthquake intensity limit degree is larger than or equal to VI or ground motion peak acceleration is larger than or equal to 0.05 g in the areas administrated by each county, and finally the number of the economic losses probably generated by the secondary landslides caused by the earthquakes in the study area is calculated. The method for quickly evaluating the economic losses generated by the landslides caused by the earthquakes can quickly evaluate the economic losses probably generated by the secondary landslide disasters.

title_en: A kind of power transformer Forecast of Economic Life method based on lifetime data
abstract_en: At present both at home and abroad there is no the unified definition for forming the transformer economic life, research is concentrated mainly in economic evaluation.The present invention proposes a kind of power transformer Forecast of Economic Life method based on lifetime data.Present invention structure is with the transformer Forecast of Economic Life model of the year minimum foundation of equivalence cost; for the key parameter in computation model; the life-cycle data of transformer are subjected to classification and critical data extraction, failure rate and the probability distribution of downtime duration are calculated using the proportional hazards model and Monte Carlo Analogue Method of distribution-free；Then economic factor is analyzed, on the basis of annual overhaul cost, annual outage cost and the annual operating cost for calculating power transformer, realizes the quantitative forecast of power transformer economic life.The present invention can not only efficiently use equipment life data, and prediction result is reasonable, and the planning and improvement of O＆M decision and future substation to transformer has directive significance.

title_en: Smart disaster managing system for combined disaster management
title_ko: 통합적인 재난관리를 위한 스마트 재난관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart disaster managing system for integrated disaster management, and the smart disaster managing system for integrated disaster management of the present invention is configured to integrate disaster-related weather information, a radar image, a satellite image, a CCTV, a steep slope-land fragility, high tide danger prediction, a flooding forecast chart, bit data (Tweeter) , and a field survey data, and to display the integrated data on one map screen, so that a sign of a disaster can be detected. As the smart disaster managing system for integrated disaster management of the present invention is configured as above, a disaster risk area can be visually recognized at a glance by displaying real-time weather information on a map, and, by utilizing SNS information through Twitter, the sign of disaster and real-time information can be collected, and, further, the public response to a disaster scene can be recognized. The smart disaster managing system therefor can be utilized as an open platform through which information can be effectively managed by collecting information scattered in several places.

title_en: A kind of power network infrastructure Vulnerability Assessment
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of power network infrastructure Vulnerability Assessment, comprise the steps：(1) assessment indicator system of power network infrastructure is built；(2) obtain and achievement data and it is handled in assessment indicator system；(3) pressure index value VP, the state indices value VS and response index value VR in power network infrastructure fragility are determined；(4) according to pressure index value VP, state indices value VS and response index value VR, the basic model of axonometric projection is set up；(5) triangle classification chart is built, the fragility classification and fragility trend to power network infrastructure are evaluated.The present invention has important directive function for formulating the safeguard measure of power network important infrastructure; the evaluation method can provide effective technological means for safety management, hidden troubles removing, safety evaluatio of each important electrical network facilities of Utilities Electric Co.'s system etc.; it can prevent because of all kinds of accidents that power network important infrastructure fragility triggers, the economic loss that reduction accident is caused.

title_en: Predictive human behavioral analysis of psychometric features on a computer network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a predictive network behavioural analysis system for a computer network, IT system or infrastructure, or similar. More particularly, the present invention relates to a behavioural analysis system for users of a computer network that incorporates machine learning techniques to predict user behaviour. According to a first aspect, there is provided a method for predicting a change in behaviour by one or more users of one or more monitored computer networks for use with normalised user interaction data, comprising the steps of: identifying from metadata events corresponding to a plurality of user interactions with the monitored computer networks; testing the identified events using one or more learned probabilistic models, each of said learned probabilistic models being related to a behavioural trait and being based on identified patterns of user interactions; and calculating a score using said one or more learned probabilistic models indicating the probability of a change in a behavioural trait of the user.

abstract_en: A kind of transmission line forest fire trip risk control method of comprehensive meteorology and artificial fire break's measure, comprise the following steps: first pass through transmission line forest fire monitoring and warning system and obtain the history mountain fire disaster monitoring data near power transmission line corridor, set up the transmission line forest fire tripping operation probabilistic model P considering rain factor according to the data obtained R , consider Vegetation condition transmission line forest fire tripping operation probabilistic model P T , consider the transmission line forest fire tripping operation probabilistic model P of mountain fire distance and fire prevention measure factor F With the transmission line forest fire tripping operation probabilistic model P that consideration punctures type V , finally give transmission line forest fire tripping operation comprehensive probability model P=P R ·P T ·P F ·P V , and take corresponding control measure, to tackle transmission line forest fire trip accident according to monitoring the transmission line forest fire tripping operation combined chance acquired in real time.The present invention have simple to operate, practical, data acquisition is easy, speed is fast, predict the outcome the advantage such as more accurately and reliably.

title_en: Comprehensive assessment method for vulnerability of high-voltage transmission lines in freezing disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive assessment method for vulnerability of high-voltage transmission lines in a freezing disaster, and belongs to the technical field of power grid safety analysis. The assessment method comprises: for a small world network based high-voltage transmission line vulnerability analysis result, a Monte-Carlo weather sampling based high-voltage transmission line freezing disaster vulnerability analysis result, and an expert scoring based high-voltage transmission line freezing disaster vulnerability analysis result, conducting united-decision by using a DS evidence fusion theory, and taking a final fusion result as a comprehensive index for assessing the vulnerability of the high-voltage transmission lines in the freezing disaster; and then, according to the value of the index, removing lines with relatively high vulnerability, and calculating a lost load percentage of a power system, thereby finally determining the vulnerability of the high-voltage transmission lines in the freezing disaster. The assessment method has the advantages that the method is a fused decision of a plurality of theories or methods, the accuracy of assessment of a power grid system on the vulnerability of the high-voltage transmission lines in the freezing disaster is improved, and an effective basis is provided for high-voltage transmission line inspection.

title_en: Power system partition reliability evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power system partition reliability evaluation method. The method comprises the steps of inputting the data of a to-be-evaluated power grid, marking the partition of a power system in a power grid topology structure to respectively marking out five regions in the power system, grading the rates of the five regions according to the sizes of loads, evaluating the reliability of the power grid at all voltage levels based on the Monte Carlo Simulation method, recording the result of the reliability evaluation, conducting the statistics on the accident information in each region according to the result of the reliability evaluation, classifying accidents based on the two standards of the out-of-load ratio and the power-outage user ratio, calculating the accident risk index value of the power grid, and adopting the obtained index value as the result of the reliability evaluation in each region of the power grid. According to the technical scheme of the invention, during the planning and running stage of the power grid, the risk levels of the power grid at different accident levels can be evaluated, so that improvement measures are conveniently and correspondingly provided for the power system. Therefore, the risk of the system is reduced. Meanwhile, the power supply capability of the power system is improved.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating wind power plant operation risk by combining weather and wind speed
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for evaluating the operation risk of a wind power plant by combining weather and wind speed, which comprises the following steps: a. determining the outage probability of the equipment element in the evaluation period under the current weather; b. constructing a time sequence by adopting an ARMA model and carrying out matrix transformation to obtain a wind speed sequence of each wind power plant; c. obtaining a system state according to the outage probability of the current weather, and sampling by adopting a non-sequential Monte Carlo method; d. adding 1 to the sampling number to obtain the wind speed of each wind power plant at the current moment, and calculating the output of each wind power plant; e. screening out load buses meeting preset conditions and corresponding load shedding values thereof according to the output of each wind power plant, and accumulating the load buses and the corresponding load shedding values to be used as the minimum load loss of the system; f. calculating a risk index according to the minimum load loss; g. returning to the step d when the variance of the risk index is smaller than the precision each time; otherwise, outputting the risk index. By implementing the method, the accuracy and the reliability of the wind power plant operation risk assessment can be improved, so that the assessment result is more scientific and reasonable, and the method has expandability.

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster critical rainfall probability analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent disaster critical rainfall probability analysis method. The method comprises the following steps: extracting no disaster-caused rainstorm information and solving an upper limit curve and a lower limit curve of critical rainfall; constructing a nonlinear model of critical rainfall-pro-phase rainfall, and comparing the nonlinear model with a linear relation model which is established on the basis of classical discriminant analysis, so as to illustrate the superiority of the new method; and fitting a probability distribution model of the critical rainfall by utilizing logarithmic normal distribution, approximatively taking a taking value interval formed by the upper limit curve and the lower limit curve as a 3(Sigma) confidence interval of the critical rainfall, carrying out inquiry to obtain distribution parameters of the critical rainfall, and carrying out inquiry to obtain mountain torrent disaster critical rainfalls under different probability conditions. Compared with the critical rainfall analytical calculation method recommended by the national mountain torrent disaster control program, the critical rainfall probability analysis method disclosed in the invention has feasibility and reliability.

title_en: Power generation system reliability rapid evaluation method based on state clustering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for quickly evaluating the reliability of a power generation system based on state clustering, which belongs to the technical field of power system reliability evaluation and mainly adopts a non-sequential Monte Carlo sampling and state clustering method to evaluate the reliability of the power generation system, by providing a non-sequential Monte Carlo sampling method of the conventional unit operation (fault) state of the system and taking into account the forced outage rate of the generator set, the method not only replaces the conventional method of increasing the spare capacity of the system to ensure the reliability of the system, and fully takes into account the operational randomness and uncertainty of all the units in the system, establishes a probability model of the available generating capacity of the system, by clustering the sampled available power generation capacity samples into a typical available power generation capacity scene, the workload of reliability calculation is reduced, the reliability evaluation speed is greatly improved, and the purpose of quickly evaluating the reliability of a large-scale power system is achieved.

title_en: Power distribution network operation and power supply reliability assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating the operation and power supply reliability of a power distribution network. The method comprises the following steps: designing an equipment outage model according to the influence of equipment aging factors and incomplete preventive maintenance factors on equipment failure conditions; randomly sampling a plurality of devices in a power distribution network to be evaluated; calculating equipment reliability parameters corresponding to each sampling equipment according to the equipment shutdown model; and calculating the operation and power supply reliability indexes of the whole power distribution network according to the Monte Carlo algorithm and the reliability parameters of the plurality of random devices. The method for evaluating the operation and power supply reliability of the power distribution network fully considers the influence of incomplete preventive maintenance on equipment operation, simultaneously considers the influence of equipment aging, can effectively avoid the situation that the evaluation error of the reliability of the power distribution network is continuously increased along with the increase of the equipment operation time, and can accurately predict the long-term operation and power supply reliability level of the power distribution network.

title_en: Power transmission system reliability assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating reliability of a power transmission system. The method comprises the following steps: designing an equipment outage model according to the influence of equipment aging factors and incomplete preventive maintenance factors on equipment failure conditions; randomly sampling a plurality of devices in a power transmission system to be evaluated; calculating equipment reliability parameters corresponding to each sampling equipment according to the equipment shutdown model; and calculating the reliability index of the whole power transmission system according to the Monte Carlo algorithm and the reliability parameters of the plurality of random devices. The method for evaluating the reliability of the power transmission system fully considers the influence of incomplete preventive maintenance on equipment operation, simultaneously considers the influence of equipment aging, can effectively avoid the error of evaluating the reliability of the power transmission system from continuously increasing along with the increase of the equipment operation time, and can accurately predict the medium-term and long-term reliability level of the system.

title_en: Power grid line section differentiation planning method considering risks
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk-considered power grid line section differentiation planning method. According to the method, an economic risk assessment index after a line fault occurs is introduced, a line sectional differentiation planning design method with the minimum sum of risk and differentiation cost is provided, by taking ice disaster as an example, a Pearson III type distribution function is used for forming different line comprehensive fault probability models, then a line economic risk assessment method is established according to the line comprehensive fault probability and the load loss of a power line after the fault, and then a line sectional differentiation planning model with the minimum sum of risk and differentiation planning cost is established; and reasonably selecting a segmented line strengthening standard by adopting a Monte Carlo-random sampling algorithm, solving the optimal solution of the model, and carrying out differential planning design on the segmented line according to the optimal solution. The method is suitable for line differentiation planning of the power grid across meteorological areas, minimizes line fault risks under the condition of meeting the minimum strengthening cost, and improves the disaster prevention and resistance capability of the power grid.

title_en: Attitude control method and device for unmanned aerial vehicle, unmanned aerial vehicle and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of computers, and provides an attitude control method and device of an unmanned aerial vehicle, the unmanned aerial vehicle and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of acquiring flight information of the unmanned aerial vehicle at the current moment through a sensor on the unmanned aerial vehicle, setting the flight information into observation data of a variable-structure discrete dynamic Bayesian network, generating flight attitude information of the unmanned aerial vehicle at the next moment through the variable-structure discrete dynamic Bayesian network, sending the flight attitude information to a ground station associated with the unmanned aerial vehicle, translating the flight attitude information into flight attitude instructions through the ground station, receiving the flight attitude instructions returned by the ground station, and controlling the flight of the unmanned aerial vehicle according to a preset time-varying sliding mode controller and the flight attitude instructions, so that the robustness and the precision of the flight control of the unmanned aerial vehicle under a complex dynamic scene (such as a disaster relief scene) are effectively improved, and the flight stability of the unmanned aerial vehicle is effectively improved.

title_en: A kind of vulnerability assessment method of power information physics emerging system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of vulnerability assessment method of power information physics emerging system, in the technical program, the vulnerability assessment method of the power information physics emerging system of offer, illustrates the reciprocal effect and cascading failure of information and physical space in power information physics emerging system.Consider that physical message virtual link can effectively assess the fragility of power information physics emerging system using the method for the present invention, analyze the fragile link of system.

title_en: A kind of photovoltaic electric station grid connection methods of risk assessment for considering meteorologic factor
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of photovoltaic electric station grid connection methods of risk assessment for considering meteorologic factor, first, is formed cluster feature vector with meteorological index, force data is gone out to photovoltaic history and carries out cluster analysis, establishes the photovoltaic plant output power probabilistic model for considering meteorologic factor；Then, according to element outage model, extract photovoltaic plant and conventional generator is in the metastasis sequence of operation, drop volume and stoppage in transit state；Then, the photovoltaic output power sequence containing outage model, the conventional generator sequence containing outage model and load sequence are chronologically superimposed, obtains the available nargin model of system, negative allowance needs appropriate reduction plans, and positive nargin needs suitably abandon light；Finally, sequential Monte Carlo method, calculated load loss risk and power loss risk indicator are utilized.It is contemplated that considering influence of the meteorologic factor of the strong correlations such as irradiation level and temperature to photovoltaic output power probabilistic model, and then analyze photovoltaic plant and access the risk brought to power grid.

title_en: Pipe gallery disaster chain methods of risk assessment
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of pipe gallery disaster chain methods of risk assessment.The described method includes：The risk assessment parameter of pipe gallery is determined according to pipe gallery O＆M monitoring risk data, the O＆M monitoring risk data is the frequency of the environmental monitoring data and generation corresponding to the alert event or Disaster Event occurred during pipe gallery O＆M；The Bayesian network model of pipe gallery disaster chain is built according to the risk assessment parameter；The risk assessment of pipe gallery disaster chain is carried out according to the Bayesian network model；Corresponding mitigating the disaster by cutting the disaster chain in the headstream measure is implemented according to assessment result.The present invention can build Bayesian network model according to the Evolution of Potential hazards in pipe gallery, the probability and the assessment piping lane extent of damage that each disaster of prediction piping lane occurs, so as to propose scientific and effective pipe gallery mitigating the disaster by cutting the disaster chain in the headstream mechanism and measure.

title_en: A kind of power distribution network methods of risk assessment under distributed generation resource Thief zone
abstract_en: The invention discloses the power distribution network methods of risk assessment under a kind of distributed generation resource Thief zone, the characteristics of considering the access of large-scale distributed power supply, risk assessment, step are carried out to power distribution network：1) consider the fluctuation and intermittence that distributed generation resource is contributed, establish distributed generation resource output model；2）Line outage model is established according to circuit historical failure information；3) consider the probability and consequence of power distribution network operation risk under distributed generation resource Thief zone, establish and consider power distribution network operational reliability and abundance Risk Assessment Index System；4) the power distribution network risk evaluation model under distributed generation resource Thief zone is solved using Monte Carlo simulation population breadth first search integration algorithm, determines risk assessment desired value, complete the power distribution network risk assessment under distributed generation resource Thief zone.

title_en: A kind of power generation analogy method for considering regenerative resource and load multi-space distribution character
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of power generation analogy methods for considering regenerative resource and load multi-space distribution character, consider that regenerative resource shares 16 scene compositions with load spatial and temporal distributions characteristic, consider the four seasons, working day and day off, be combined round the clock, then count and the spatial coherence of regenerative resource and load；Consider the auto-correlation coefficient of regenerative resource and load, the distributed constant of regenerative resource and load under each scene is obtained using Pair Copula and the Quasi-Monte-Carlo method of sampling；Consider to carry out outage cod calculating under regenerative resource and 1 fault conditions of N of load multi-space distribution character.The present invention considers regenerative resource and load distribution performance and spatial coherence under different scenes, reduce the calculation error caused by different scenes and spatial coherence, so that power generation simulation is more accurate, power generation simulation can be carried out for Electric Power Network Planning personnel, guidance instruction is provided.
assignees: ECONOMICS & TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;EAST CHINA ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD CHINA POWER ENG CONSULTING GROUP;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Systems and methods for cognitive control of data acquisition for efficient fault diagnosis
abstract_en: Remote sensing techniques are being increasingly used for periodic structural health monitoring of vast infrastructures. Conventionally, analysis of visual and other signals captured from sensing devices are used to diagnose faults. Such data collection and analysis is expensive in terms of both computational overheads as well as towards robotic maneuvering of data collection systems, such as a UAV. In accordance with the present disclosure, the data acquisition system is modeled as an intelligent situated agent that autonomously controls data gathering and analysis activities through a cognitive cycle of perception-recognition-action, in order to optimize the cost of efforts in identifying faults that may exist. Also, a reactive, economical planning algorithm around Qualitative Bayesian Network (QBN) that controls the sequence of data collection and analysis has been implemented.
assignees: TATA CONSULTANCY SERVICES LTD

title_en: Dynamic mine disaster integral early warning method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses dynamic mine disaster integral early warning method and devices, it is related to coal mining dynamic disaster prediction and evaluation technical field, this method by mine planted agent force signal, sound signal, electric field signal, temperature signal and Gas Signal, and pre-stored stress signal reference value, sound signal reference value, electric field signal reference value, temperature signal reference value and Gas Signal reference value, corresponding stability function is established, error function is established according to the theoretical value of stability function and stability function；And Constrained equations are established to error function, and the Constrained equations are solved with the α for current time error minimum of sening as an envoy to according to Monte Carlo EGS4 method i (n) and β i (n) namely by above-mentioned steps solution the α for current time error minimum of sening as an envoy to i (n) and β i (n) it can estimate the stability function value at current time, the safety in the moment mine be may determine that with the difference of stability function value and the theoretical value of stability function, so as to reach the safety in dynamic evaluation mine.
