assignees: ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Distribution line-oriented lightning trip probability analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of electric power, and particularly relates to a lightning trip-out probability analysis method and system for a distribution line, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the ground flash density of a lightning area and an effective lightning receiving area of the power distribution line to determine the ground flash density of the effective lightning receiving area; calculating the flashover rate of the distribution line by using a Monte Carlo method; and obtaining the lightning trip-out probability of the distribution line according to the ground flash density, the flashover rate and the arc establishment rate of the effective lightning receiving area. Determining the ground flash density of the effective lightning receiving area by acquiring the ground flash density and the effective lightning receiving area of the distribution line; calculating the flashover rate of the distribution line by using a Monte Carlo method; according to the ground flash density, the flashover rate and the arc establishing rate of an effective lightning receiving area, obtaining the lightning trip-out probability of the distribution line; the lightning trip-out occurrence can be reasonably predicted, and lightning protection work can be guided, so that damage caused by lightning disasters is reduced.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for identifying key links of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for identifying key links of an electric power system, which are used for predicting the element fault rate data of the electric power system by acquiring disaster intensity characteristic data and element topology data of the electric power system in extreme events and according to the disaster intensity characteristic data; the method comprises the steps of determining the fault scale of the power system according to element fault rate data by using a Monte Carlo sampling method, identifying the key links of the power system according to the fault scale and the element topology data by using a preset key link identification model to obtain key nodes and key lines of the power system, describing the correlation between the disaster intensity and the element fault rate and between the element fault state and the power supply state of the load node through a machine learning model, and effectively avoiding the display expression of complex functions, thereby researching the disaster defense and strengthening capacity of the elastic power system and providing technical support for the power system to deal with extreme events in the follow-up process.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Flame-retardant, low-temperature-resistant and brittleness-resistant electrical casing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti fire-retardant low temperature resistant fragility electrician's sleeve pipe, which comprises a pipe body, one side of body is equipped with fire-retardant structure, fire-retardant structure includes fire-retardant layer one and fire-retardant layer two, the outer wall of fire-retardant layer one and the inner wall fixed connection of body, the outside of fire-retardant layer one is equipped with fire-retardant layer two, the inner wall fixedly connected with low temperature resistant layer of fire-retardant layer two. The flame-retardant low-temperature-resistant brittleness-resistant electrical casing pipe is characterized in that the flame-retardant layer I and the flame-retardant layer II are aluminum silicate refractory fiber layers by matching the pipe body, the flame-retardant layer I and the flame-retardant layer II, the aluminum silicate refractory fiber is prepared by taking clay clinker with low impurity content as a raw material and melting at 1800-2000 ℃, jetting or spinning into fibers, the content of Al2O3 in the fibers is about 45%, the long-term use temperature is not more than 1000 ℃, the flame-retardant capability of the electrical casing pipe is improved, and the damage of the electrical casing pipe and the damage of electric wires caused by fire disasters in the surrounding environment are avoided.
assignees: ZHEJIANG RONGZHENG TUBE CO LTD

title_en: An efficient radionuclide analysis method using a CZT detector-based portable neutron and gamma-ray simultaneous measurement system
title_ko: Czt 검출기 기반 휴대용 중성자 및 감마선 동시측정 시스템을 활용한 핵종분석방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a nuclide analysis method using a CZT detector-based portable neutron and gamma ray simultaneous measurement system. The nuclide analysis method comprises: a pre-processing step of calculating a pure coefficient density using equation 1 and a pure gamma dose rate using equation 2 by using raw data obtained from a CZT detector-based measurement system and determining whether the calculated pure gamma dose rate exceeds the reference set value (R1) that can establish a reasonable judgment on the possibility of the existence of a suspected source to be distinguished from environmental radiation, taking into account the measurement uncertainty of the CZT detector-based measurement system itself to determine the possibility of the existence of a neutron or gamma ray emission source; and a post-processing step of precisely evaluating and confirming the detection of neutrons, the energy level thereof, and the type, energy, and radioactivity of the gamma ray emission source when it is determined that there is the possibility of the existence of the neutron or gamma ray emission source in the pre-processing step. The present invention makes it possible to visually and clearly confirm and analyze whether or not the neutron emission source that is difficult to confirm is detected and its energy level by using a compound semiconductor, a CZT (Cd-Zn-Te; Cd (cadmium)-Zn (zinc)-Te (tellurium)) detector, and neutron and gamma ray response characteristics and to more efficiently identify and analyze the type, energy, and radioactivity of the gamma ray emission source.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 CZT 검출기 기반 휴대용 중성자 및 감마선 동시측정 시스템을 활용한 핵종분석방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 이를 위해 CZT 검출기 기반 측정 시스템으로부터 취득되는 원시자료(raw data)를 활용하여 [수학식 1]을 적용한 순수 계수밀도, [수학식 2]를 적용한 순수 감마선량률을 산출하고, 산출된 순수 감마선량률이  CZT 검출기 기반 측정 시스템 자체의 계측불확실성을 감안하여 환경방사선과 구분되게 의심 선원의 존재 가능성에 대한 합리적 판단을 수립할 수 있는 기준설정치(R1)를 초과하는지 여부를 판별하여 중성자 또는 감마선 방출선원의 존재 가능성을 판별하는 전처리 단계; 및 전처리 단계에서 중성자 또는 감마선 방출선원의 존재 가능성으로 판별된 경우 중성자 검출 여부 및 에너지 준위 그리고 감마선 방출선원의 종류, 에너지 및 방사능을 정밀하게 평가 및 확인하는 후처리 단계;가 포함된다. 
상기와 같이 구성된 본 발명은 화합물반도체인 CZT(Cd-Zn-Te; Cd(카드뮴)-Zn(아연)-Te(텔루늄))검출기와 중성자 및 감마선 반응특성을 활용하여 확인이 어려운 중성자 방출선원의 검출 여부와 그 에너지 준위를 가시적으로 명확하게 확인하고 분석할 수 있도록 하고, 감마선 방출선원의 종류, 에너지 및 방사능을 보다 효율적으로 확인 및 분석할 수 있도록 한 것이다.
assignees: NUCLEAR ENVIRONMENT TECH CO

title_en: Method for evaluating fragility of immovable cultural relics
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vulnerability assessment method of immovable cultural relics, which comprises the following steps: 1. determining a vulnerability assessment index; 2. determining a grade standard of a vulnerability value of an evaluation index; 3. obtaining evaluation index data and fragile value assignment; 4. determining vulnerability assessment index weight; 5. constructing a vulnerability assessment model; 6. dividing the vulnerability grade; 7. calculating a vulnerability index; 8. and determining the vulnerability grade of the immovable cultural relics. The method can well evaluate the vulnerability of immovable cultural relics under different scales under the influence of natural disasters such as flood, earthquake and the like, and has universal applicability.
assignees: CHINESE ACAD OF CULTURAL HERITAGE

title_en: Lifting type automatic stereo parking garage scheduling method based on improved DQN
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lifting type automatic stereo garage scheduling method based on improved DQN; the current state of the garage is obtained through the internet of things technology, an improved DQN is adopted to train a scheduling model of the lifting type automatic three-dimensional parking garage, the Q network with the optimal decision making capability under random interference is obtained by taking the minimum user waiting time and the minimum mechanical loss cost as targets, and the Q network is used for guiding the garage to perform real-time scheduling. The deep reinforcement learning method provided by the invention solves the problem of dimension disaster possibly caused by large-scale complex state space, and can realize dynamic real-time scheduling. In addition, different from the traditional DQN reinforcement learning method, the improved DQN algorithm combines the Monte Carlo thought, and estimates the state value by sampling a plurality of complete state sequences, so that the influence of each step of garage scheduling on subsequent scheduling can be fully considered, and the practical requirement of garage scheduling is better met.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: Tool for business resilience to disaster
abstract_en: Methods, systems, and computer programs are presented for estimating downtime and recovery time after a disaster. One method includes an operation for calculating component fragility functions for components of a facility that are vulnerable to damage after a disaster. Further, the method includes calculating component recovery functions for the components of the facility. The component recovery functions indicate a probability of recovery after a disaster over time. The method further includes operations for calculating a facility fragility function and a facility recovery function based on the component fragility functions and the component recovery functions, and for determining a downtime for the facility for a given intensity associated with the disaster. Further, the method includes an operation for causing presentation of the downtime for the facility on a user interface (UI).
assignees: ONE CONCERN INC

title_en: Coastal region ocean disaster risk refined assessment research method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for finely evaluating and researching marine disaster risks in coastal areas, which comprises the following steps: 1. identifying risk factors, selecting evaluation indexes and acquiring data; 2. analyzing each index weight by an AHP method; 3. implementing fine research by adopting a Lawson algorithm and an origin Kriging interpolation method; 4. constructing a risk evaluation model, and calculating risk values of all evaluation units; 5. and drawing a risk assessment graph and a risk division graph. The method comprehensively considers the natural attributes and the social attributes of the marine disasters, comprehensively considers the marine disaster risks based on four dimensions of dangerousness, fragility, exposition and defensiveness, and is convenient for index evaluation and calculation. The method is used for constructing an index evaluation system based on AHP, and realizes refinement by adopting a Lawson algorithm and an orbit Kriging interpolation, thereby realizing refined evaluation of the risk of the marine disaster and improving the evaluation accuracy.
assignees: SHANGHAI WATER ENG DESIGN & RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Flood risk space-time dynamic propagation analysis model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood risk space-time dynamic propagation analysis model, which comprises the following steps: s1, determining a model framework for urban flood risk propagation analysis; s2, selecting subdivision indexes and a calculation formula to quantize; s3, acquiring satellite remote sensing data and urban meteorological data, and searching historical related data; s4, determining an urban flood disaster occurrence area, a flood inundation area and disaster loss; s5, calculating to obtain a numerical value of urban flood risk; s6, carrying out space-time dynamic propagation analysis of flood risks. According to the invention, the flood risk space-time dynamic propagation analysis model is adopted, and by constructing the urban flood risk propagation analysis model and combining urban historical data and future prediction data, the risk distribution of different areas of the city is identified, the capability of the city to cope with the flood disasters is evaluated, the state and degree of the flood risk propagation in the urban area can be dynamically monitored, and the purpose of urban flood monitoring and early warning is achieved.
assignees: UNIV JIANGSU

title_en: Market force assessment method considering multiple uncertainties under ice disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a market force assessment method considering multiple uncertainties under ice disaster, which comprises the following steps: establishing a fault probability model of the overhead line and the wind turbine generator under the ice disaster according to meteorological data under the ice disaster and initial data of the power system; forming an overhead line and a wind turbine generator set fault set by using a Monte Carlo sampling method based on a fault probability model of the overhead line and the wind turbine generator set under ice disaster; constructing a direct current power flow model taking the minimum power generation set MGI as an objective function according to the overhead line and the wind turbine generator set fault set, and calculating a space-time market force evaluation index; by comparing the sizes of the space-time market force evaluation indexes, key generators with higher market force risks and key time periods are identified. The method can effectively identify key power generators and key time periods with higher market force risks under frozen disasters, prevent market participants from carrying out market force abuse, and provide effective guidance for a supervision organization to establish a risk prevention and control strategy under extreme weather.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Method of calculating the vulnerability index of water treatment facilities due to natural disasters
title_ko: 자연재해에 따른 수처리 시설의 취약도 지수를 산출하는 방법
abstract_en: A method of calculating a vulnerability index of a water treatment facility due to natural disasters according to one embodiment of the present invention relates to a method of calculating a vulnerability index of a water treatment facility such as a water purification plant and wastewater treatment plant due to natural disasters such as floods, typhoon inundation, and earthquakes, and to a method of calculating a vulnerability index of a water treatment facility due to natural disasters, comprising: a necessary information acquisition step of acquiring information necessary to calculate a vulnerability index; an evaluation item determining step of determining evaluation items to calculate the vulnerability index; a primary vulnerability index calculation step of primarily calculating the vulnerability index based on detailed items of the determined evaluation items; a suitability calculation step of calculating a suitability for the determined evaluation items and the primarily calculated vulnerability index based on standard information obtained from an external device; an evaluation item weighting step of assigning weights to the evaluation items based on the calculated suitability; and a secondary vulnerability index calculation step of calculating a secondary vulnerability index based on the assigned weight.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 자연재해에 따른 수처리 시설의 취약도 지수를 산출하는 방법은 홍수, 태풍에 의한 침수, 지진과 같은 자연재해에 따른 정수장 및 폐수처리장과 같은 수처리 시설에 대한 취약도 지수를 산출하는 방법에 관한 것으로서, 취약도 지수를 산출하기 위해 필요한 정보를 획득하는 필요 정보 획득 단계; 취약도 지수를 산출하기 위한 평가 항목을 산정하는 평가 항목 산정 단계; 산정된 평가 항목에 대한 세부 항목을 기초로, 1차적으로 취약도 지수를 산출하는 1차 취약도 지수 산출 단계; 외부 장치로부터 획득한 기준 정보를 기초로, 산정된 평가 항목 및 1차적으로 산출된 취약도 지수에 대한 적합도를 산출하는 적합도 산출 단계; 산출된 적합도를 기초로, 평가 항목에 대해 가중치를 부여하는 평가 항목 가중치 부여 단계; 및 부여된 가중치를 기초로, 2차 취약도 지수를 산출하는 2차 취약도 지수 산출 단계;를 포함하는, 자연재해에 따른 수처리 시설의 취약도 지수를 산출하는 방법 일 수 있다.
assignees: G&C ENV SOLUTION CO LTD

title_en: Transformer substation dynamic flood risk assessment method based on fuzzy Bayesian and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fuzzy Bayesian-based substation dynamic flood risk assessment method and a readable storage medium. Firstly, from a disaster theory angle, selecting multi-mode factors such as a disaster-tolerant environment, disaster factors, a disaster-bearing body and the like to construct a dynamic flood risk assessment index system of the transformer substation, thereby establishing a Bayesian network prior model; secondly, discretizing meteorological data by adopting K parabolic membership functions, combining a disaster-tolerant environment and a disaster-bearing body membership degree to obtain a flood condition priori data fuzzy table, and deriving to obtain a dynamic flood condition risk probability calculation table of the transformer substation; and finally, carrying out fuzzification treatment on the dynamic meteorological data with the fuzzy boundary by using a fuzzy Bayesian classification method, fusing polymorphic data, analyzing causal association between the data and the flood of the transformer substation, and calculating a probability value so as to obtain a dynamic flood risk assessment result of the transformer substation.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Comprehensive assessment method and system for flood control capacity of transformer substation based on information gain fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive assessment method and system for flood prevention capability of a transformer substation based on information gain fusion, and belongs to the technical field of power risk assessment. Firstly, from a disaster theory angle, establishing a substation static flood control capacity assessment index system covering multi-mode factors such as a disaster-tolerant environment, a disaster-bearing body and the like, weighting each assessment index by using a hierarchical analysis method in combination with prior knowledge of expert fields, and establishing a substation static flood control grade assessment sub-model by a fuzzy comprehensive assessment method; then taking disaster factors into consideration to construct a dynamic risk prevention evaluation index system of the transformer substation, and obtaining a dynamic flood prevention capability evaluation sub-model of the transformer substation by using a fuzzy Bayesian network; and finally, carrying out weight distribution on the two sub-models by utilizing an information gain fusion strategy, and establishing a comprehensive assessment model of the flood control capacity of the transformer substation based on the information gain fusion, thereby realizing high-precision assessment of the flood control risk capacity of the transformer substation.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV WUHAN TECH

title_en: Dynamic evaluation method for urban deep karst collapse risk based on Bayesian network
abstract_en: A dynamic evaluation method for urban deep karst collapse risk based on Bayesian network mainly comprises the steps of deep karst collapse risk identification, deep karst collapse risk level standard, deep karst collapse risk dynamic Bayesian network structure learning, deep karst collapse risk dynamic Bayesian network parameter learning, deep karst collapse risk probability analysis, deep karst collapse risk loss analysis, deep karst collapse risk evaluation and the like; through the steps, the method solves the problems of low effectiveness, practicality and accuracy of the existing assessment method for the deep karst collapse disasters, more accurately reflects the change rule of the risks of the deep karst collapse disasters in the dense urban buildings and the lifeline corridor areas, timely obtains the risk states of the deep karst collapse disasters, and provides decision basis for subsequent control.
assignees: BEIJING URBAN CONSTR DESIGN & DEV GROUP CO LTD

title_en: N-k fault risk assessment method and system based on probabilistic load flow calculation
abstract_en: The application provides an N-k fault risk assessment method and system based on probability power flow calculation, comprising the following steps: based on semi-invariant and Gram-Charlier series, calculating the power system expansion probability flow taking the random fluctuation of new energy output into consideration; obtaining a branch outage probability model based on the branch power probability distribution characteristics in the power flow calculation result; analyzing a possible N-k fault chain in the power system to obtain a cut load corresponding to the fault chain; calculating occurrence probability of each N-k fault chain based on the related variables and the Bayesian network; taking the product of the occurrence probability of the N-k fault and the severity of the N-k fault result as an N-k fault risk index, calculating the N-k fault risk of each fault chain, and grading the risk index to obtain an evaluation result. The technical problems that the influence of the randomness of the new energy of the actual power system and the reliable guarantee of important user power supply are not fully considered in the existing evaluation method are solved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Characterization method, device, equipment and storage medium of dynamic load response characteristics of anchor rod
abstract_en: The invention provides a characterization method, a device, equipment and a storage medium of dynamic load response characteristics of an anchor rod, which are implemented by acquiring a preprocessed test data set; the preprocessed test data set comprises the rod body load and the accumulated rod body elongation of the anchor rod; calculating through a moving average algorithm, a standard deviation algorithm, a confidence interval algorithm, a maximum and minimum value algorithm or a quantile algorithm to obtain a target data set; drawing a target curve corresponding to the target data set by taking the accumulated elongation of the rod body as an abscissa and the load of the rod body as an ordinate; the target curve includes an upper envelope, a lower envelope, and a median. The method can obtain the target curve of the dynamic load response characteristic of the anchor rod, can intuitively reflect the trend and the fluctuation of test data through the target curve, is favorable for detecting abnormal values, and can provide key basic data support in aspects of anchor rod support selection of a mine tunnel, tunnel support scheme optimization, tunnel rock burst disaster prevention and control and the like.
assignees: CCTEG COAL MINING RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Wind-light-cascade reservoir deep reinforcement learning short-term random optimization scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind-light-cascade reservoir deep reinforcement learning short-term random optimization scheduling method which comprises the steps that a cascade reservoir describes randomness through a Copula function based on pearson III type distribution and generates corresponding random scenes based on a Markov Monte Carlo sampling method, wind power output and photovoltaic output describe randomness based on a non-parameter estimated nuclear density estimation method and generate corresponding random scenes based on the Markov Monte Carlo sampling method, scene reduction is respectively carried out on the random scenes based on a Bisecting k-means algorithm of a related distance, then the random scenes of a complementary system are combined and constructed, calculation efficiency is improved, parameter optimization is carried out on the complementary system based on a deep reinforcement learning DQN algorithm, and an optimal strategy is solved.

title_en: Disaster chain reasoning prediction method and system based on knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster chain reasoning prediction method and system based on a knowledge graph, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing an ontology model of a disaster event knowledge graph; extracting entity information of disaster events by performing dependency syntactic analysis on the text data, and performing knowledge fusion on entity information with the same meaning by a clustering algorithm; storing the fused entity information into a graph database and constructing a disaster event knowledge graph based on the ontology model; coupling the disaster event knowledge maps and mining disaster chain knowledge maps of the disaster events; constructing a Bayesian network model corresponding to the disaster chain knowledge graph according to the disaster chain knowledge graph; and determining the probability that the event node to be predicted is in the target state according to the Bayesian network model and the known parent node state set of the event node to be predicted. The method aims at mining complete links of disaster events and carrying out probability prediction on states of event nodes in the links.

title_en: Tunneling roadway coal and gas outburst prediction method based on dynamic probability reasoning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a tunneling roadway coal and gas outburst prediction method based on dynamic probability reasoning, and belongs to the field of tunneling roadway coal and gas outburst disaster prediction methods. In order to make risk variable reasoning more comprehensive and accurate and to construct 13 variables and introduce expansion (dynamic Bayesian network) in Bayesian network reasoning, the development of underground tunneling working faces with risk connection is provided as a time slice, a risk prediction scheme of continuous probability reasoning is realized, and two methods of parameter learning under a expectation maximization algorithm and expert reasoning decision under a fuzzy set theory are combined to determine the probability distribution of initial Bayesian network nodes without influence. The structure is compact and coherent, the prediction is flexible, and the accuracy is high.

title_en: State early warning method, system, storage medium and terminal based on fragile curve
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a state early warning method, a state early warning system, a storage medium and a terminal based on a fragility curve, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining the support displacement working condition of the transmission tower according to the ground surface deformation state; establishing a failure criterion of the transmission tower according to the failure level; establishing a finite element structure model of the transmission tower according to the yield strength and the elastic modulus of the material; carrying out displacement step-by-step loading on the finite element structure model of the transmission tower according to the support displacement working condition and the failure criterion, and obtaining a displacement stress curve; and determining the fragile curves of the displacement and failure probability according to the displacement stress curves, and determining the states of the transmission towers under different earth surface deformation states according to the fragile curves of the displacement and failure probability. The disaster prevention prediction and early warning can be carried out in the operation and maintenance management of the transmission tower through the fragile curve of the displacement and failure probability; reliability check can be performed under the ground surface deformation state, so that the disaster prevention and resistance of the power grid can be improved. Meanwhile, reference data can be provided for insurance pricing under the power geological disaster.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Quantitative risk assessment method and system based on real-time monitoring of multiple disaster species in park
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of environmental monitoring, and provides a quantitative risk assessment method and a quantitative risk assessment system based on real-time monitoring of multiple disaster species in a park, wherein the quantitative risk assessment system comprises a detection module and a storage module, the storage module comprises a park public area storage unit, a park workshop storage unit and a park storehouse storage unit, real-time detection data of the detection module are stored in the corresponding storage units, and the detection module comprises temperature detection information, gas concentration detection information and fire detection information; the investigation and acquisition of the historical information data of the storage module, through the historical information data of the storage module, comprises the following steps: step one: identifying a major hazard source in the park by using an FMEA method; step two: carrying out accident scenario modeling and occurrence probability calculation by using a bow tie diagram; step three: performing risk update by using a Bayesian network; step four: and analyzing and calculating the accident scenario results. Through above-mentioned technical scheme, solved among the prior art manual work and patrolled and examined not in place, patrol and examine the lower problem of efficiency simultaneously.
assignees: HEBEI JIEYUAN ANPING ENVIRONMENTAL PROT CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Quantification method, system and medium for ship accident risk influence by intelligent technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quantification method, a quantification system and a quantification medium for ship accident risk influence by an intelligent technology, which are applied to the technical field of ship safety, can quantitatively evaluate the ship collision accident risk influence by the application of the intelligent technology, effectively improve the navigation safety of intelligent ships and reduce the occurrence probability of ship accidents. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a scene analysis frame according to a preset disaster system theory; analyzing according to the scene analysis framework and combining with the characteristics of the water traffic accident to obtain a preset analysis result; constructing a Bayesian network model of the ship collision accident according to the preset analysis result; the occurrence probability of the preset risk influence factors is obtained through expert questionnaires and a hypothesis analysis method and a preset fuzzy set theory analysis calculation; and inputting the ship collision accident case data and the occurrence probability of the preset risk influence factors into the ship collision accident Bayesian network model for quantitative analysis to obtain a quantitative analysis result.
assignees: UNIV WUHAN TECH

title_en: Probabilistic Inference Methodology and System for Evaluating Process-Plant-System based on Bayesian Network
title_ko: 베이지안 네트워크의 확률추론 연산 알고리즘에 기반한 산업시설물의 리스크 평가정보 제공 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for providing risk evaluation information on industrial facilities based on the probabilistic inference computation algorithm of a Bayesian network, which calculate the probability that the entire industrial facility will not operate normally due to the abnormal operation of devices, or that the respective devices constituting the industrial facility will malfunction or operate abnormally, by using the probabilistic inference computation algorithm of the Bayesian network, in case of the abnormal operation in which in industrial facilities such as gas plants, petrochemical plants, and steel plants, the devices forming the industrial facility malfunction due to earthquakes, various natural disasters, or other various causes, and provides the same to an operator, thereby enabling the operator to accurately identify the current status of the industrial facility and establish reasonable measures, such as which devices to repair or replace to resolve abnormal operating conditions of the industrial facility and further which devices to repair preferentially. The method comprises a step of enabling an algorithm execution module to perform probabilistic inference operations according to the algorithm of the Bayesian network to calculate the probability of destruction of all nodes forming the Bayesian network.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 가스플랜트, 석유화학 플랜트, 제철플랜트 등과 같은 산업시설물에 대하여 지진이나 각종 자연재해 내지 기타 다양한 원인으로 인하여 산업시설물을 구성하는 설비가 고장 나는 등의 비정상적인 작동을 하는 경우, 이러한 설비의 비정상적인 작동으로 인하여 산업시설물 전체가 정상적으로 운영되지 않거나 또는 산업시설물을 이루는 각각의 설비들이 고장 내지 비정상적인 작동을 하게 될 확률을 확률추론 연산 알고리즘으로서 베이지안 네트워크(Bayesian Network)를 이용하여 산출하여 운영자에게 제공함으로써, 운영자로 하여금 산업시설물의 현상을 정확하게 파악할 수 있게 하고, 산업시설물의 비정상적인 운영상태를 해소하기 위하여 어떠한 설비를 보수 내지 교체할 것인지, 더 나아가 어떠한 설비에 대해 우선적으로 보수 등을 수행할 것인지 등의 합리적인 대책을 세울 수 있게 하는 "베이지안 네트워크의 확률추론 연산 알고리즘에 기반한 산업시설물의 리스크 평가정보 제공 시스템 및 제공 방법"에 관한 것이다.
assignees: KOREA INST CIVIL ENG & BUILDING TECH

title_en: Quick coal rock destabilization damage judgment method based on seismic source spatial distribution
abstract_en: The application discloses a coal rock destabilization damage judgment method based on seismic source spatial distribution, which comprises the following steps: constructing an initial voronoi diagram based on the calibrated initial point of the coal rock; constructing a sliding time window; establishing a union voronoi diagram of any window based on the sliding time window; calculating the volume of the Veno area of each seismic source event point of the union Veno diagram in any window by adopting a Monte Carlo algorithm; acquiring the total volume of control areas of all the seismic source event points in each window based on the sliding time window; acquiring a time-varying line based on the total volume of the control area and the sliding time window; if a preset type trend section exists on the time-varying line, judging that the coal rock is instable and damaged; the method can rapidly acquire the complete information of the coal rock mass, realize rapid judgment and identification of the coal rock destabilization damage precursor characteristics, more accurately predict the damage state of the corresponding coal rock mass, further reveal the coal rock destabilization damage precursor law, and have important significance for realizing coal rock dynamic disaster monitoring and early warning.

title_en: Multi-source heterogeneous disaster situation data fusion understanding method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-source heterogeneous disaster situation data fusion understanding method, and belongs to the field of information fusion. The method includes the steps that the data types of input multi-source disaster data are divided into four types of text, images, videos and audios, different feature extraction algorithms are respectively used for extracting features of different types of data, and feature sets are classified according to support vector machines of multiple kernel functions; and carrying out weight distribution by using a multi-attribute weight algorithm based on information entropy, judging whether disaster occurs or not by combining Bayesian network reasoning, and realizing polymorphic multi-scale space-time fusion understanding of disaster information semantics.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING INF SCI & TECH

title_en: Photovoltaic panel vulnerability modeling method based on Bayesian theory under typhoon
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of photovoltaics, in particular to a photovoltaic panel vulnerability modeling method based on Bayesian theory under typhoons, which comprises the steps of analyzing faults of a photovoltaic module to obtain fault reasons and disaster data; establishing an updating model of a Bayesian formula based on prior distribution of wind speed and likelihood functions of faults of the photovoltaic module; and generating samples of posterior distribution by using a Monte Carlo Markov algorithm to obtain a probability density function of the posterior distribution, and obtaining an updated vulnerability function through integration. According to the invention, by updating the vulnerability function of the photovoltaic module of Goodman, more reasonable vulnerability function estimation is obtained than based on numerical value estimation, and the method is used for constructing the risk indexes of the photovoltaic module affected by typhoons in different regions, so that the problem of analysis of the operation condition of the photovoltaic unit under typhoon disasters is solved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Risk assessment method for power transmission and transformation system containing multi-state wind power plant
abstract_en: The invention provides a power transmission and transformation system risk assessment method comprising a multi-state wind power plant, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of constructing a wind turbine generator power model, discretizing a wind turbine generator output power curve to obtain the probability of corresponding fan capacity outage rate at random wind speed, constructing a risk assessment model of a power transmission and transformation combined system, performing risk assessment calculation on a bus element in the power transmission system equivalent to a transformer substation, sampling by using double-layer Monte Carlo, combining the obtained power transmission and transformation system element operation state and wind power plant output to form the operation state of the whole system, calculating the probability and load shedding condition of various states of the power transmission and transformation system according to the system operation state formed by sampling, and forming the reliability index of the power transmission and transformation combined system by statistics. The method can reflect the influence of the multi-state characteristics of the wind turbine generator on the risk assessment of the power transmission and transformation combined system during large-scale wind power grid connection, and can make up for the gap that no effective method exists at present for quantitative calculation of the risk of the power transmission and transformation combined system under the wind power grid connection.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;UNIV WUHAN TECH

title_en: Building structure Bayesian system identification and model selection method based on self-adaptive sequence Monte Carlo
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of building structures, and discloses a building structure Bayesian system identification and model selection method based on a self-adaptive sequence Monte Carlo. The method solves the problems of the identification of the building structure Bayesian system and the selection of the model class in a unified way, and the proposed new formulas of the model class evidence values can efficiently calculate the high-dimensional integral which cannot be calculated by the traditional method, and the formulas can respectively quantify the data fitting degree and the information gain of the model class so as to select the optimal model class, so that the model accuracy is ensured and meanwhile the model class is not excessively complex. The invention can efficiently solve the problems of Bayesian system identification and model class selection of a real complex building structure, so as to accurately predict the structure behaviors under different loads, and provide accurate models and theoretical supports for disaster prevention and reduction of the later-stage building structure.

title_en: WLPG viability evaluation method, device and storage medium under extreme external environment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power grid viability evaluation, and particularly relates to a WLPG viability evaluation method, a WLPG viability evaluation device and a WLPG storage medium under an extreme external environment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring system data of a weak contact power grid WLPG; according to the definition of extreme events aiming at WLPG, external disasters are divided into a plurality of classes of extreme events according to severity; establishing three-level evaluation indexes, wherein the first-level indexes of the three-level evaluation indexes are comprehensive survival indexes; carrying out Monte Carlo sampling evaluation on the viability indexes under various extreme events to obtain three-level index values of the viability under each type of extreme events; respectively synthesizing the three-level indexes of the survivability under various extreme events into two-level indexes by using a preset information entropy model; and using a preset principal component evaluation model, and combining the secondary indexes into a primary index to obtain comprehensive survival indexes under various extreme events. The invention can accurately and objectively evaluate the survivability of WLPG in extreme environment.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: Power distribution network toughness assessment method considering distributed power supply support
abstract_en: A toughness evaluation method of a power distribution network considering distributed power supply support relates to the technical field of power, and comprises the following steps: according to the related parameters such as the load curve, the grid structure, typhoon meteorological data and the like of the power distribution network, calculating the fault rate of each element of the power distribution network under extreme disasters and the fault probability of the power distribution network line; 10000 scenes are generated by adopting a Monte Carlo method, the fault power failure range and the influence time under each scene are determined, and the occurrence probability of each scene is calculated; and determining derated running load by considering the supporting effect of the distributed power supply on the micro-grid load in the fault area, and calculating the toughness index of the power distribution network. According to the method, a plurality of fault scenes are generated by using a Monte Carlo method, the probability and the running load of each scene are considered, and the toughness index is obtained by adopting comprehensive calculation of the loss load proportion of the power distribution network. The model can be used for evaluating disaster adaptability of the power distribution network with the distributed power supply, provides a basis for further proposing distributed power supply layout optimization and improving toughness research of the power distribution network, and guides construction of the power distribution network.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID QIANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Typhoon storm surge disaster risk assessment method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a typhoon storm surge disaster risk assessment method and device, comprising the following steps: step S1, acquiring typhoon storm surge disaster risk evaluation indexes; step S2, obtaining a Bayesian network structure containing a typhoon storm surge disaster risk index set according to the hierarchical structure of the typhoon storm surge disaster risk evaluation index; s3, obtaining a typhoon storm surge disaster risk assessment model according to the Bayesian network; and S4, inputting a preset typhoon storm surge situation into a typhoon storm surge disaster risk assessment model to obtain the associated risk level and probability of the typhoon storm surge disaster risk assessment index. By adopting the technical scheme of the invention, the quantitative prediction of the typhoon storm surge disaster risk level is realized.
assignees: UNIV CHINA PETROLEUM EAST CHINA

title_en: Scene deduction and result prediction method and system for dust explosion accident
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for deducing and predicting consequences of dust explosion accident situations, which relate to the technical field of dust explosion disaster research and comprise the following steps: constructing a dust explosion accident scene deduction model based on a dynamic Bayesian network; constructing a dust explosion accident result prediction model based on a dynamic Bayesian network; based on a dust explosion accident scene deduction model and a dust explosion accident result prediction model, formulating a dust explosion accident acceptable level criterion, and constructing a two-dimensional matrix; based on the two-dimensional matrix, a dust explosion accident scene deduction and result prediction model is obtained, and the dust explosion accident is predicted. The invention makes up the defect of acceptable risk criteria in the field of dust explosion in China, and further improves the risk management of dust explosion industry in China. The method provides reference basis and technical support for predicting the evolution direction of dust explosion accidents, deployment of emergency rescue decisions and prediction and evaluation of disaster damage results.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Post-earthquake disaster evacuation behavior rule analysis method based on social network data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-earthquake disaster evacuation behavior rule analysis method based on social network data, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of preprocessing data by acquiring the occurred seismic event, constructing an evacuation behavior theory and a Bayesian network structure model, converting the Bayesian network structure into a junction tree, further optimizing the performance and accuracy of the model, and revealing the evacuation behavior rule of the disaster victims in a short time after earthquake from a quantitative angle by calculating node probability distribution. The invention provides scientific basis and decision support for earthquake disaster handling, and finally can extract the regularity information of the evacuation behaviors of post-earthquake disaster people from the social network data, and the discovery and interpretation of the regularity has important scientific significance and decision value for earthquake disaster handling so as to better understand and predict the evacuation behaviors of people.
assignees: UNIV CIVIL AVIATION CHINA

title_en: Method, equipment and medium for evaluating line toughness under tornado disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating line toughness under a tornado disaster, which relates to the technical field of power transmission line risk evaluation and is used for filling the blank that the prior art lacks in carrying out power transmission line risk evaluation on tornados, and the method comprises the following steps: calculating parameter probability distribution according to the historical data; generating a tornado path according to the parameter probability distribution, and constructing a position relationship between a power transmission line and the tornado; the wind field model is used for calculating the point location wind speed at the power transmission line; establishing vulnerability curves of all elements of the power transmission line, and calculating the failure probability of the elements of the power transmission line according to the wind speed; and calculating the fault probability of a single line according to the element fault probability, and calculating by combining a Monte Carlo state sampling method and a toughness evaluation index to obtain a toughness evaluation result. The invention also discloses electronic equipment and a computer storage medium for evaluating the line toughness under the tornado disaster. The method effectively estimates the toughness of the power transmission line under the tornado disaster through the Monte Carlo method.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Urban storm waterlogging disaster chain risk assessment system based on Bayesian network
abstract_en: A Bayesian network-based risk assessment system for urban storm waterlogging disaster chains utilizes the probability reasoning capability of the Bayesian network and the feature extraction capability of deep learning to encode, correlate and fuse the storm data of each link in the urban storm waterlogging disaster chains so as to obtain the predicted value of the occurrence probability of the disaster, thereby realizing the risk assessment of the urban storm waterlogging disaster chains.

title_en: Power system risk assessment method considering carbon balance under forest fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system risk assessment method considering carbon balance under mountain fire disasters, which comprises the following steps of S1: establishing a deduction model of the mountain fire disaster time-space evolution process; step S2: a carbon unbalance severity calculating method considering carbon emission increase and carbon sink loss is provided; step S3: constructing a carbon price increase model based on the severity of carbon imbalance; step S4: the power system operational risk is assessed based on the carbon price sensitivity of the power source-load. According to the invention, the carbon unbalance risk caused by the mountain fire disaster is considered, and the influence of the mountain fire disaster on the operation risk of the power system can be effectively evaluated based on the Monte Carlo sampling algorithm.
assignees: NARI GROUP CORP;UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: Toughness evaluation method for multi-microgrid system for taking hydrogen transportation into account under typhoon
abstract_en: The invention discloses a toughness evaluation method for a multi-microgrid system for calculating and transporting hydrogen under typhoons, which comprises the following steps: modeling typhoons and quantifying the damage of typhoons to the power distribution network; based on a vehicle path planning model, a hydrogen transportation multi-micro-grid model is established to meet hydrogen demand load (hydrogen adding station, chemical plant and the like) in a multi-micro-grid system, and the influence of typhoons on a hydrogen transportation system in a transportation network is quantified by taking the transportation cost of a hydrogen truck as an index; based on a Monte Carlo method, typhoon disturbance is set, and the fault state of the multi-microgrid system is simulated; aiming at the system fault state, an optimal load shedding model is established, and the load loss is calculated to quantify the damage of typhoons to the multi-microgrid system; finally, the index evaluation toughness is proposed from the two layers of infrastructure and system operation.
assignees: UNIV NANJING NORMAL

title_en: Bridge toughness assessment method and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a bridge toughness assessment method and electronic equipment, belonging to the technical field of bridge infrastructure safety monitoring, wherein the method comprises the following steps: applying a plurality of sets of seismic wave data to a pre-established finite element model of the bridge to be evaluated, and obtaining a plurality of sets of seismic response displacement vectors corresponding to the bridge to be evaluated under the action of the plurality of sets of seismic wave data; expanding the number of the plurality of groups of earthquake response displacement vectors by using a Monte Carlo simulation method; calculating an initial toughness index of the bridge to be evaluated corresponding to each seismic response displacement vector by using each seismic response displacement vector based on the seismic response displacement vectors with the number expanded; and carrying out lognormal distribution fitting on all initial toughness indexes, and carrying out toughness evaluation on the bridge to be evaluated according to fitting results. The method realizes the quantitative evaluation of the toughness of the bridge, has the advantages of strong operability, relatively reliable data and good standardized suitability, and has popularization value.
assignees: CN RAILWAY SIYUAN SURVEY & DES

title_en: Method and device for simulating construction process of steel box girder bridge based on hybrid simulation model
abstract_en: The application provides a method for simulating a construction process of a steel box girder bridge based on a hybrid simulation model, and relates to the technical field of intelligent construction for infrastructure construction, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a construction process simulation model based on multiple agents; constructing a construction control model based on system dynamics; constructing a construction risk prediction model based on a Bayesian network model; constructing a construction period simulation model based on discrete events; and constructing a hybrid simulation model based on the correlation of the constructed multiple models and the multiple models in the construction process, and simulating the construction process of the steel box girder bridge by changing the hybrid simulation model. The application adopting the scheme realizes the hybrid simulation of the construction process of the steel box girder bridge.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: Mine underground debris flow risk analysis method based on coupling weighting network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for analyzing underground mine debris flow risk based on a coupling weighting network, which relates to the field of mine safety risk prevention and control, and comprises the following steps: performing risk factor interaction analysis on the mine underground debris flow risk analysis index model to construct a multi-layer structure network model; mapping the multi-level structure network model into a Bayesian network to construct a Bayesian network structure analysis model; constructing inter-node connection weights according to the coupling degree of the risk factors, and executing coupling weighting of the Bayesian network structure analysis model according to the inter-node connection weights to obtain a coupling weighted Bayesian network structure analysis model; and carrying out diagnosis and reasoning according to the coupling weighted Bayesian network structure analysis model to obtain a mining underground debris flow risk analysis result. The method solves the problem that in the prior art, key risk factors and key disaster-causing paths are difficult to determine due to complex relationships of mine underground debris flow risk factors.
assignees: UNIV KUNMING SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Event probability prediction method, system and terminal under tsunami disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses an event probability prediction method, an event probability prediction system and a terminal under tsunami disasters, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a global tsunami historical data set, screening variables and initial data sets corresponding to the variables from the global tsunami historical data set, filling missing values of the discretized data sets through a Markov blanket node state value combination strategy, and obtaining a complete data set; learning the Bayesian network structure by using the complete data set to obtain a basic Bayesian network structure; constructing a causal edge candidate set, correcting the basic network structure by using the causal edge candidate set, pruning the corrected network structure, and obtaining a target network structure; and acquiring variable data under the tsunami disaster to be predicted, and inputting the variable data into a target network structure to obtain the probability of occurrence of a corresponding event under the tsunami disaster to be predicted. The invention constructs the Bayesian network with complete structure, and can accurately predict the occurrence probability of the event when the tsunami disaster comes, thereby making a correct emergency decision.
assignees: UNIV SHENZHEN

title_en: Power failure processing method, device, equipment and medium for power guarantee area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power outage processing method, device, equipment and medium for a power guarantee area, wherein the method comprises the steps of marking time at the moment when a power outage occurs according to a high-precision time synchronization method, collecting historical operation data of all nodes of a power system at the same time point, extracting features of the operation data based on a deep learning algorithm, extracting depth feature vectors reflecting the intrinsic structure and time scale features of the data, establishing a power outage risk assessment model according to the depth feature vectors, optimizing the power outage risk assessment model by adopting a Bayesian network or Markov decision process method, obtaining current operation data of the power system, inputting the current operation data into the optimized power outage risk assessment model, outputting an assessment result, and constructing a power outage processing strategy matched with the assessment result and executed by a safety early warning terminal. The method provided by the invention realizes accurate monitoring and effective control of the power failure risk of the power system.

title_en: Loess slope stability reliability analysis method, loess slope stability reliability analysis system, loess slope stability reliability analysis equipment and loess slope stability reliability analysis medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of slope engineering safety evaluation, and discloses a loess slope stability reliability analysis method, a loess slope stability reliability analysis system, loess slope stability reliability analysis equipment and loess slope stability reliability analysis media, wherein the loess slope stability analysis method comprises the following steps: constructing a slope finite element model; carrying out slope stability analysis on the slope finite element model to obtain a slope stability coefficient; constructing a mapping relation between random parameters and slope stability coefficients based on a response surface method, and calculating slope failure probabilities under different rainfall conditions based on the mapping relation and a Monte Carlo method; wherein the random parameter is a slope loess intensity parameter added with a correlation coefficient or a variation coefficient. The technical scheme of the invention can provide reference for researching the stability of the multi-step loess slope and disaster prevention and reduction.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY CONSTRUCTION THE 20TH GROUP MUNICIPAL ENG CO LTD;CHINA RAILWAY 20 BUREAU GROUP CORP

title_en: Risk evolution assessment method, device, equipment, medium and product for tripping of natural disaster-induced power transmission line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk evolution assessment method, a device, equipment, a medium and a product for tripping a natural disaster induced power transmission line. The method comprises the following steps: determining a plurality of events corresponding to each natural disaster type and occurrence probabilities corresponding to the plurality of events based on the historical comprehensive accident statistical information; determining an accident tree corresponding to each natural disaster type based on a plurality of events and occurrence probabilities corresponding to the plurality of events; the accident tree corresponding to each of the natural disaster types is converted into a Bayesian network diagram; in the Bayesian network diagram, determining the sensitivity of each relevant node of each layer corresponding to the natural disaster type based on the occurrence probability of each relevant node of each layer corresponding to the natural disaster type; determining a target node of each layer based on the sensitivity of each related node of each layer; and determining a risk evolution path corresponding to the natural disaster type based on the target nodes of each layer. The embodiment can provide support for emergency decision and reduce the occurrence of tripping accidents of the power transmission line.
assignees: NANJING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID ENERGY RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Dynamic Bayesian network assessment method for urban storm waterlogging evolution toughness
abstract_en: A dynamic Bayesian network evaluation method for urban rainstorm waterlogging evolution toughness comprises the following steps: s1, collecting dynamic indexes and static indexes of the evolution toughness of rainstorm and waterlogging, and acquiring comprehensive toughness indexes of disasters, society, economy, environment and infrastructure based on the initial stage, the flood stage and the recovery stage of secondary rainstorm; s2, establishing a DBN topological relation; s3, calculating the DBN prior probability and weight of the comprehensive toughness index, calculating the DBN conditional probability of the comprehensive toughness index, determining a dynamic toughness index threshold value, acquiring time-varying evidence of the dynamic toughness index, and forming DBN input data; s4, constructing a DBN based on the comprehensive toughness index, the DBN topological relation and the DBN input data to form a total toughness graph of urban storm waterlogging evolution time-varying, analyzing the evolution process of toughness in the initial stage, the flood and the recovery stage of the storm waterlogging from a dynamic angle, and identifying a critical threshold value of toughness change. The method is beneficial to improving the accuracy of the toughness level evaluation of the sponge city.
assignees: UNIV GUANGXI

title_en: Toughness evaluation method and equipment for electric-thermal comprehensive energy system under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to a toughness technology of a power distribution network under extreme natural disasters, in particular to a toughness evaluation method and equipment of an electric-thermal comprehensive energy system under typhoon disasters, wherein the method builds an element fault probability model under typical typhoon disasters and establishes a typical fault scene based on a Monte Carlo method; aiming at three core characteristics of toughness, a time-period assessment system for an electric-thermal comprehensive energy system is established, and multi-level and multi-angle assessment of the toughness of the system is realized through three primary indexes of pre-disaster strain, in-disaster defensive power and post-disaster restoring power and six secondary indexes of load energy supply path redundancy, system standby state, network retention rate, load retention rate, unit adjustment time and element repair time. Compared with the traditional electric heating system, the evaluation method has the advantages that the operation level of the electric-thermal integrated energy system taking the dual inertia of the heat supply network into consideration in the disaster environment is higher, the load loss is smaller, and the toughness level is higher.
assignees: UNIV WUHAN

title_en: Flood disaster chain scene deduction method and system based on dynamic Bayes
abstract_en: The application provides a flood disaster chain scene deduction method and system based on dynamic Bayes, which relate to the technical field of natural disasters, and the method comprises the following steps: constructing an ontology model of a city storm waterlogging disaster chain scene; constructing a city storm waterlogging disaster chain scene according to the body model and the city storm waterlogging historical disaster event; according to the urban storm waterlogging disaster chain scene, the attribute of the disaster bearing body and the countermeasures, constructing a dynamic Bayesian network model corresponding to the urban storm waterlogging disaster chain scene; and determining the probability that the scene element node to be predicted in the dynamic Bayesian network model is in the target state in the time period to be predicted according to the scene element node and the countermeasure node with known states in the dynamic Bayesian network model. The method aims at comprehensively considering the influence of various influencing factors on the scene deduction process of the disaster chain, so that the accuracy of scene deduction of the disaster chain is improved, and scientific selection of various disaster coping schemes is realized.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI;UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: Off-grid power system reliability assessment method considering marine environmental influence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reliability evaluation method of an off-grid power system considering marine environmental influence. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a power equipment reliability model considering marine environmental influence, obtaining reliability according to the power equipment reliability model, dividing states, calculating outage time, and obtaining an equipment outage probability matrix according to the reliability model; and simulating the equipment outage condition according to the equipment outage probability matrix, and performing reliability evaluation on the off-grid power system by adopting a Monte Carlo method to obtain the load loss and power shortage condition in the off-grid power system. The method can effectively evaluate the reliability of the off-grid power system influenced by the marine environment, overcomes the defect that the conventional power system evaluation method ignores the long-term influence of the environment on equipment, solves the problem of lower accuracy of the reliability evaluation result of the power system under the influence of the marine environment, and can reduce the running risk of the power system.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Position pre-dispatching system in movable emergency resource disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a position pre-dispatching system in a movable emergency resource disaster, which is characterized in that a transportation vehicle is decoupled from movable energy storage, the movable energy storage is taken as an independent unit, and a plurality of energy storage units are transported by the vehicle at the same time; obtaining typhoon data and geographic data, predicting the distribution of typhoon fields, establishing a comprehensive wind field model based on extremum distribution, and carrying out accurate wind speed prediction; determining failure probability of the distribution line by adopting a structural vulnerability model of a stress-intensity interference theory; generating a typical fault scene by adopting Monte Carlo sampling and an SBR algorithm; establishing a mobile energy storage access point optimization model taking the minimum load loss as an objective function through a fault scene; and determining the running time of each road section of the road network system through the traffic flow of the road network, and scheduling the mobile energy storage to an optimal position. The time expectation of accessing the network is minimum in all possible fault scenes by the mobile energy storage, so that the aim of minimizing the expected load loss in all fault scenes is fulfilled, and the power supply stability of the load is ensured.
assignees: HULUDAO ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Special equipment for intelligent analysis edge calculation of non-coal mine risk
abstract_en: The invention provides intelligent analysis edge computing special equipment for non-coal mine risk, which relates to the technical field of edge computing. The device comprises a data access module, a data exchange module, a data transmission module, a data storage module, an analysis processing module, an information alarm module and an information safety module, and intelligent analysis and edge early warning are carried out by collecting internet of things sensing, industrial production and video data through various protocols. And the high-bandwidth PCIE bus ensures efficient data exchange and processing by adopting a modularized design and a Linux operating system. The built-in safety isolation unit guarantees network isolation and data safety through optical unidirectional transmission, provides a Bayesian network logic reasoning and disaster occurrence probability calculation model, improves risk early warning and management capacity, and provides firm data support and guarantee for safety production of non-coal mine enterprises.
assignees: EMERGENCY MAN DEPARTMENT BIG DATA CENTER

title_en: Water-wind-solar complementary system cascade pre-flood energy storage risk analysis and control method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power system power generation scheduling, and discloses a method for analyzing and controlling energy storage risk before cascade flood of a water-wind-solar complementary system. The method comprises the steps of taking pre-flood energy storage as constraint, establishing a dead period hydro-fluctuation model and a flood period water storage scheduling rule to determine a simulation operation criterion, establishing a dead period electricity shortage, flood period water abandon, annual end energy storage shortage and wind-solar energy electricity abandon index set to quantify multi-stage multi-source operation risks, coupling Monte Carlo and fuzzy membership to represent a multi-dimensional uncertainty scene and probability thereof, and determining quantitative relation of complementary benefits, risk probability and risk loss of pre-flood energy storage and water-wind-solar energy by adopting simulation analysis. Through the example analysis of a water-wind-light complementary system of a certain oversized river basin, the result shows that the risk can be comprehensively described in terms of occurrence probability and loss, the verification result shows that the power generation amount of the system is increased by 5.8 hundred million kWh through the accurate description of the risk and the reasonable control of energy storage, and the risk loss is reduced by 42% on average, so that the method has good practicability.

title_en: Regional sluice system scheduling optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional sluice system scheduling optimization method and a regional sluice system scheduling optimization system, comprising the following steps: deep learning and graph neural network technology is adopted to perform multi-source heterogeneous data fusion and feature extraction, so as to realize multi-scale analysis of hydrodynamics features; generating an countermeasure network by using a dynamic Bayesian network and conditions, and generating a high-resolution hydrological scene set; constructing a multi-scale hydrodynamic model, and improving the accuracy and timeliness of the model by combining a self-adaptive grid technology and a data assimilation method; and (3) optimizing the sluice group cooperative scheduling by applying a deep reinforcement learning and game theory method to realize multi-objective intelligent scheduling. The method remarkably improves scientificity, efficiency and adaptability of sluice scheduling, and effectively balances flood control and disaster reduction, water resource utilization and ecological protection requirements.
assignees: NANJING HYDRAULIC RES INST

title_en: Thunderstorm weather early warning method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of disaster event response alarm, in particular to a thunderstorm weather early warning method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting observation data information; determining a forecasting factor, wherein the forecasting factor at least comprises a quantized amplitude V  e , a quantized differential change rate ring ratio V  p  and a quantized Euclidean distance ratio V  f ; establishing condition expectations and acquiring an early warning threshold; executing a Monte Carlo test to obtain an optimal weight combination and an early warning threshold under the condition that the forecasting critical success index in the three-stage early warning is maximum; and executing early warning. According to the application, the lightning early warning is realized by adopting the ideas of sample selection, factor normalization processing, condition expected establishment and Monte Carlo test, the obvious contradiction between the prediction hit rate and the blank report rate exists by adopting the prior art limited to an assignment threshold method or a change rate threshold method, and the problem that the hit rate and the blank report rate are not balanced is rapidly and effectively solved.
assignees: JIANGSU METEOROLOGICAL DISASTER PREVENTION TECH CENTER

title_en: Method for predicting and analyzing stability of reservoir bank soil slope based on Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for predicting and analyzing the stability of a reservoir bank soil slope based on a Bayesian network. The method comprises the steps of statistically analyzing influence factors of the stability of the bank slope, performing single factor sensitivity analysis on the counted influence factors, perfecting classification of disaster causing factors and the stability evaluation indexes of the bank soil slope, establishing a prediction evaluation index system, applying an improved interpretation structure model to determine ordering and interlayer directivity connection of the influence factors, improving a construction method of a Bayesian network structure, establishing a bank slope stability prediction model based on the Bayesian network, and performing the stability prediction and destabilization mechanism analysis of the bank soil slope based on causal reasoning and diagnosis reasoning functions of the Bayesian network model. The method can predict the stability of the bank slope, discover hidden danger in time, immediately take corresponding measures to treat, and provide technical support and safety guarantee for long-term safe operation of reservoirs and tailing reservoirs.
assignees: MCC WUKAN ENGINEERING TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Power infrastructure toughness assessment method considering multi-factor coupling influence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power infrastructure toughness assessment method considering multi-factor coupling influence, which comprises the steps of calculating response result data corresponding to each preset index type based on seismic intensity historical data, processing the response result data according to a maximum correlation minimum redundancy algorithm, determining key influence factor types and secondary influence factor types from the preset index types, creating a plurality of power infrastructure seismic simulation events based on Monte Carlo simulation, respectively extracting first simulation data corresponding to the key influence factor types and second simulation data corresponding to the secondary influence factor types according to simulation results, correcting the response result data according to the first simulation data and the second simulation data to obtain corrected result data, and inputting the corrected result data into a preset assessment result calculation formula to obtain a power infrastructure toughness assessment result. According to the method, the coupling influence of a plurality of index types on the toughness evaluation of the electric power infrastructure is considered, so that the quantitative evaluation of the seismic toughness is realized.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Confidence calibration for systems with cascaded predictive models
abstract_en: In general, techniques are described that address the limitations of existing conformal prediction methods for cascaded models. In an example, a method includes receiving a first validation data set for validating performance of an upstream model of the two or more cascaded models and receiving a second validation data set for validating performance of a downstream model of the two or more cascaded models wherein the second validation data set is different than the first validation set; estimating system-level errors caused by predictions of the upstream model based on the first validation data set; estimating system-level errors caused by predictions of the downstream model based on the second validation data set; and generating a prediction confidence interval that indicates a confidence for the system based on the system-level errors caused by predictions of the upstream model and based on the system-level errors caused by predictions of the downstream model.
assignees: STANFORD RES INST INT

title_en: Fire disaster treatment system and method applied to lithium battery energy storage power station of rail transit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire disaster treatment system and a fire disaster treatment method applied to a lithium battery energy storage power station of rail transit. The sensor collects temperature, smoke concentration, combustible gas concentration, humidity and other data in the power station in real time, the data are transmitted to the control module, and the control module performs probabilistic reasoning analysis on the real-time data according to the Bayesian network model to predict fire risks. The system starts the gas fire extinguishing device to spray perfluoro-hexanone for local inhibition at the initial stage of fire, and if the fire is enlarged, the system is switched to a high-pressure water mist system for large-area fire extinguishing. Meanwhile, the waste liquid treatment system is started, and waste liquid generated by fire extinguishment is collected, monitored and treated, so that the emission is ensured to meet the environmental protection standard. The invention has the advantages of accurate early warning, high fire extinguishing efficiency, environment-friendly waste liquid treatment and the like, and is particularly suitable for the safety protection of industrial energy storage power stations such as rail transit and the like.
assignees: SHANGHAI INST TECH
