Time series analysis is used to calculate dynamic weights, and dynamic Bayesian networks are used for coupling analysis to output geological hazard risk probability values in real time, thereby triggering corresponding warning levels and emergency responses. This method is mainly used for real-time monitoring, precise risk assessment, and timely early warning of geological hazards.
assignees: CHINA HIGHWAY ENG CONSULTANTS CORP;Zhongzi data co ltd

title_en: Method for evaluating bearing capacity of power distribution network on newly-added electric vehicle charging facility
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating the bearing capacity of a power distribution network to a newly-added electric vehicle charging facility, and belongs to the technical field of power system planning and operation; the method comprises the steps of firstly collecting distribution facility capacity, load and charging facility charging power of three levels of distribution transformer, circuit and transformer substation, setting a plurality of development scenes of electric vehicles according to the distribution facility capacity and load, secondly setting probability distribution of charging start time and daily driving mileage compliance of the vehicles, obtaining charging start time and daily driving mileage of the electric vehicles under different development scenes by using a Monte Carlo sampling method, extracting maximum daily charging load of the electric vehicle charging facilities, then calculating superimposed load and remaining capacity of the distribution facilities under each scene, and finally accurately calculating bearing capacity of the three levels of distribution facilities on newly-added electric vehicle charging facilities by using an interpolation method. The invention realizes accurate and efficient assessment of the bearing capacity of the power distribution network and provides effective decision support for scientific planning of charging infrastructure and safe operation of the power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD TAIZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH

title_en: Method for evaluating toughness of receiving-end power grid considering frequency stability under typhoon disaster and related equipment thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a receiving end power grid toughness assessment method considering frequency stability under typhoon disasters and relevant equipment thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of responding to a receiving end power grid toughness assessment request, locating an area and acquiring historical typhoon data; the method comprises the steps of establishing typhoon scenes based on data fitting probability distribution and sampling, establishing a typhoon scene model by combining data and a gradient wind balance equation, generating a fault scene under each typhoon scene by combining Monte Carlo sampling according to the influence mechanism of the typhoon scene model on a power grid element, calculating the total instantaneous power deficiency of a system, establishing and simplifying a frequency deviation model by taking a system toughness assessment index as output and combining power deficiency to obtain a system frequency response deviation model, establishing an optimal frequency response optimization model with a minimum toughness index as a target by traversing scenes, solving the optimal frequency response optimization model, calculating the overall toughness assessment index of the system, establishing by using the typhoon scene and an influence mechanism, assessing the frequency stability under extreme weather by using one-time frequency modulation frequency drop integral, reflecting the frequency accumulation deviation, and accurately assessing the resistance capability of the system.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Multi-objective optimization decision system for whole life cycle of pole tower in typhoon disaster scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-objective optimization decision system for a whole life cycle of a pole tower in a typhoon disaster scene, which relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of the pole tower, and comprises a multi-source data acquisition, analysis and construction, calculation risk assessment, multi-objective optimization decision and block chain coordination module, wherein the multi-objective optimization decision and block chain coordination module acquires information by using satellites, unmanned aerial vehicles and sensors, and realizes completion and standardization through federal learning and generation of an countermeasure network; the method comprises the steps of generating a fault probability result through data driving and mechanism model double-channel fusion, deducing a dynamic updating risk by combining Monte Carlo and Bayesian in a risk assessment stage, outputting a survival rate thermodynamic diagram and collapse probability distribution, generating a reinforcement scheme, a rush repair path and a recovery time sequence by adopting an improved NSGA-III algorithm in an optimization decision stage, realizing reliable linkage by a blockchain coordination module through distributed account book and knowledge map reasoning, and realizing second-level response by combining multi-level early warning and edge calculation. And closed-loop management of data fusion, risk assessment and emergency coordination is realized.
assignees: GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Individual trip and charging demand deducing method based on mobile phone signaling data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of intelligent transportation and big data analysis, and particularly discloses an individual trip and charging demand deducing method based on mobile phone signaling data, which comprises the following steps of S1, acquiring original mobile phone signaling data of an operator, and filtering noise through a preprocessing module; the method comprises the steps of S2, judging moving points and stay points of cleaned data, dividing a single-day travel section of a user, S3, extracting a constant travel track through two DBSCAN clusters and Hausdorff distance, S4, combining historical travel frequencies of the user, splicing to generate a typical single-day travel chain, S5, calculating energy consumption of each travel section through an energy consumption modeling module, updating a battery SOC, and S6, calculating charging events through Monte Carlo simulation, and outputting space-time distribution of potential charging demands of the electric automobile. The individual trip and charging demand deducing method based on the mobile phone signaling data solves the problem of traditional dependence on existing charging facility data, improves potential demand identification and planning response capability, and provides support for scientific layout of urban charging infrastructure.
assignees: UNIV INNER MONGOLIA

title_en: Accident cause tracing early warning method and system based on accident tree and Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention provides an accident cause tracing early warning method and system based on an accident tree and a Bayesian network, comprising the steps of constructing an accident tree model, utilizing a predefined mapping relation to convert the accident tree model into a Bayesian network model, acquiring the prior probability of each leaf node, acquiring the prior probability of each intermediate node based on a conditional probability table and the prior probability of each leaf node corresponding to each intermediate node, acquiring the prior probability of each root node based on the conditional probability table and the prior probability of each root node by utilizing the occurrence probability of each intermediate node, carrying out early warning by utilizing the occurrence probability of the root node in the Bayesian network model, fusing the logic sharpness of the accident tree with the bidirectional reasoning advantage of the Bayesian network, accurately positioning the disaster source, quantifying the influence weight of each cause factor, and providing scientific and effective disaster prevention, control and emergency management decision basis for a coal mine.
assignees: XIAN BOSSUN SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for analyzing inherent relevance among multi-disaster-species disaster-causing factors
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of natural disaster risk assessment, in particular to an inherent relevance analysis method between multi-disaster-causing factors, which comprises four steps of data preprocessing, bayesian network relevance model construction, space-time dynamic evolution analysis and risk early warning threshold model, and realizes the deep coupling analysis of the multi-disaster-causing factors such as torrent-mud-rock flow and the like. The method comprises the steps of firstly collecting 17 disaster factor data of terrain, precipitation and the like, analyzing the dimension reduction through a kernel principal component, calculating dynamic weights by adopting an entropy method, then constructing a Bayesian network model quantization conditional probability association, introducing a space-time attention mechanism to optimize multi-scale coupling weights, and finally establishing a coupling risk early warning threshold and outputting a correlation intensity matrix. The method solves the problem that the traditional single disaster analysis method can not capture the time-space linkage effect of the disaster causing factors, improves the early warning accuracy of multi-disaster risk, and provides scientific decision support for regional disaster prevention and reduction.
assignees: UNIV ZHENGZHOU

title_en: Associated infrastructure toughness performance analysis method based on fault tree and dynamic Bayesian network and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a fault tree and dynamic Bayesian network-based related infrastructure toughness performance analysis method and a storage medium, which belong to the technical field of urban key infrastructure evaluation, and are technically characterized in that S100, key infrastructure systems related to a target building or a target community are identified, and each key infrastructure system determines the key component composition; and S200, obtaining the failure probability of each key infrastructure system in a non-disaster scene by using a fault tree analysis model, and S300, calculating the toughness performance of the disaster scene curve and the recovery strategy scene curve by adopting a dynamic Bayesian network. By adopting the technical scheme of the application, the quantitative output of the toughness performance is realized under the conditions of disaster situations and recovery strategies.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Assessment method and system considering forced outage and station service electricity equivalent capacity
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evaluation method considering forced outage and plant electricity equivalent capacity, which comprises the steps of obtaining original load data, setting electricity consumption simulation times, obtaining a probability density function through the original load data and the electricity consumption simulation times, calculating a demand response capacity and a response load curve according to the response degree, judging whether the set electricity consumption simulation times are reached, taking the demand response capacity and the response load curve as random samples when the set electricity consumption simulation times are reached, calculating a demand response capacity confidence interval, outputting a calculation result, obtaining an interval evaluation index of the load curve after response by using interval number operation, and providing a reference basis for more scientifically evaluating the effect of demand response.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Water-wind-light-hydrogen combined system collaborative scheduling method based on ecological value accounting
abstract_en: The water-wind-light-hydrogen combined system collaborative scheduling method based on ecological value accounting respectively establishes an ecological service value assessment model, quantifies the ecological value of each energy main body through indexes such as ecological flow guarantee, carbon emission reduction and the like, establishes an ecological footprint model of a multi-energy complementary system, establishes an ecological bearing capacity assessment model in combination with regional resource environment capacity, predicts the output of a wind power plant and a photovoltaic power station by adopting Monte Carlo simulation in combination with a K-means clustering algorithm, establishes an output operation model of a cascade hydropower station and an electrolytic hydrogen production system, establishes a double-layer collaborative scheduling optimization model, solves the double-layer collaborative scheduling optimization model by adopting an NSGA-II multi-objective optimization algorithm, and obtains a Pareto optimal solution set through non-dominant sequencing and crowding degree calculation to obtain an optimal scheduling scheme which takes both ecological benefit and economic benefit into consideration. The method solves the problem that the traditional scheduling method is difficult to consider ecological protection and economic benefit by quantifying the ecological benefit of the renewable energy system and constructing an ecological-economic cooperative optimization model.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD;UNIV CHINA THREE GORGES CTGU

title_en: Fault propagation analysis and root cause identification method for early design stage of complex system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault propagation analysis and root cause identification method for an early design stage of a complex system, which comprises the steps of developing failure modes and influence analysis, identifying potential failure modes and fault characterization of the complex system, determining a fault propagation path through fault tree analysis, quantifying causal strength of fault propagation by using a Bayesian network, fusing elements, the fault propagation Bayesian network and the fault characterization, developing causal enhanced multi-layer Bayesian networks for quantifying probability mapping relations between component fault modes and the fault characterization, providing two importance models based on the multi-layer Bayesian networks, namely cascading failure Birnbaum importance and element Birnbaum importance, respectively identifying key root causes and key components, and constructing a fault characteristic probability matrix based on the analysis. The invention can effectively identify the weak links of the complex system and identify the potential fault propagation paths and the root causes of the faults.
assignees: UNIV BEIHANG

title_en: Method for predicting lightning strike fault probability of power transmission line based on lightning meteorological information and evaluating reliability of power transmission line and related device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for predicting the lightning fault probability of a power transmission line based on lightning meteorological information and evaluating the reliability of the power transmission line and a related device, wherein the method comprises the steps of preprocessing multi-source data (meteorological radar data, line parameters and topographic data) and outputting a standardized feature set; predicting lightning current amplitude and distribution of 1 hour in the future through a ConvLSTM model based on the data set, determining discharge point coordinates by using the amplitude distribution, calculating a lightning side distance, inputting the amplitude, the distance, the terrain and line parameters into a XGBoost model, outputting section lightning fault probability, and calculating LOLP and EENS reliability indexes by taking the probability as forced outage probability and combining a Monte Carlo method. According to the lightning risk prediction method, accurate prediction of lightning risk is achieved through multi-source data fusion and space-time sequence modeling, scientific basis is provided for lightning protection design and operation and maintenance of a power system, and operation reliability of a power grid is improved.
assignees: HUBEI CENTRAL CHINA TECH DEVELOPMENT OF ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;WUHAN OPTICS VALLEY INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Landslide volume overrun probability prediction method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of landslide disaster prediction and discloses a landslide volume overrun probability prediction method which comprises the steps of collecting and arranging landslide volume data and landslide trigger factor data, constructing a landslide volume probability model by adopting lognormal distribution, introducing priori distribution for parameters in the landslide volume probability model, wherein the parameters comprise regression coefficients and variance parameters, sampling the parameters by using a Markov chain Monte Carlo method to obtain samples of posterior distribution, calculating overrun probability under a single sample after obtaining the samples of posterior distribution, and averaging the overrun probability under all the samples to obtain a final prediction result. The application can flexibly adapt to landslide volume distribution characteristics in different areas and under different triggering conditions, and has more universality and adaptability. Meanwhile, the occurrence probability of the ultra-large-volume landslide can be stably evaluated, and scientific basis is provided for engineering safety redundancy design and extreme disaster prevention and control.
assignees: INST OF AEROSPACE INFORMATION HENAN ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Disaster prevention and rescue method, system, equipment and medium based on quantum computation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of structural data processing and disaster prevention and rescue, and particularly relates to a disaster prevention and rescue method, system, equipment and medium based on quantum computing. According to the invention, data are acquired by arranging a multi-mode quantum sensor at a key point, noise is reduced on the data through a lambda noise reduction filter, a quantum wavelet transformation algorithm is used for carrying out feature extraction on the noise reduction data, a quantum principal component analysis is used for carrying out dimension reduction on the feature extracted data, high-dimensional space mapping is carried out on the dimension reduced data by using a kernel function, vector classification is carried out on the mapped data, probability of occurrence of disasters is calculated on the classified data by using a quantum Monte Carlo, a disaster influence range is predicted by using a quantum diffusion model, early warning information is generated according to the probability and the disaster influence range, an early warning information is issued through a quantum communication technology, an emergency scheme is generated according to the disaster influence range, and after evaluation and optimization on the scheme are carried out, disaster prevention and rescue are carried out according to the data before and after disasters, and suggestions are provided.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY 14 BUREAU GROUP CO LTD;THE 1S ENG CO LTD OF CHINA RAILWAY URBAN CONSTRUCTION

title_en: Dynamic Bayesian network-based method for evaluating safety and toughness of structure of flue plate at top of highway tunnel after fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for evaluating the safety and toughness of a top flue plate structure of a post-fire centralized smoke-discharging highway tunnel based on a dynamic Bayesian network, which comprises the specific steps of constructing the dynamic Bayesian network by collecting related data of the top flue plate structure of the post-fire highway tunnel, and describing the evolution process of the risk level of the top flue plate structure of the post-fire highway tunnel; and calculating the change trend of the risk level of the tunnel top flue plate structure after the fire disaster by using the dynamic Bayesian network. Compared with the traditional static evaluation method, the method can predict the risk level change trend of the tunnel top flue plate structure after fire, provide scientific basis for operation management departments, help the operation management departments to formulate reasonable maintenance and repair schemes, prolong the service life of the tunnel and reduce the operation cost and risk.
assignees: UNIV WUHAN SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Storm disaster chain risk diffusion path identification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying a storm disaster chain risk diffusion path, and relates to the technical fields of disaster risk management and disaster prevention and reduction. The method is based on historical storm disaster chain text records, disaster causing factors, disaster bearing bodies and disaster conditions are extracted to construct a disaster chain index system, a Bayesian network model is adopted to establish directed causal relation among elements, a chain type risk diffusion network is built, reliability of the model is verified through Brier, 10 total risk diffusion paths from two levels to five levels are identified through causal reasoning, chain type risk amplification and disaster condition superposition effects are revealed, a risk degree method is further introduced, broken chain disaster reduction benefits of disaster bearing bodies such as agriculture, population, houses and the like are quantized, high risk objects and risk overflow effect are identified, and basis is provided for disaster prevention and disaster reduction priority ordering. The method realizes the whole process quantitative analysis from path identification to disaster reduction decision support of the storm disaster chain, and has the advantages of strong scientificity, high operability, wide application prospect and the like.
assignees: UNIV CHIFENG

title_en: Priority decision method for land utilization collaborative optimization in homeland space planning
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of homeland space planning, and discloses a priority decision method for land utilization collaborative optimization in homeland space planning, which comprises the following steps of setting a multidimensional target of land utilization planning and identifying corresponding constraint conditions; the method comprises the steps of establishing a Bayesian network model, identifying target conflicts through a dynamic perception technology, dynamically updating and generating priority weights of targets, constructing a three-dimensional geographic information model based on multi-source geographic space data, evaluating natural disaster risks by combining a big data analysis and deep learning algorithm, defining a high-risk area, designing a comprehensive treatment scheme for the high-risk area, formulating a plurality of land use planning schemes according to the priority weights of the targets and the comprehensive treatment scheme, and screening the scheme with the highest score as an optimal land use planning scheme. The application ensures the comprehensive optimization of economic, ecological and social benefits and the continuous adjustment capability of planning.
assignees: ZAOZHUANG HAOZE SURVEY PLANNING CO LTD

title_en: Coal rock dynamic disaster early warning method and system based on Bayesian dynamic extremum modeling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal rock dynamic disaster early warning method and system based on Bayesian dynamic extremum modeling, which relate to the technical field of coal rock dynamic disaster monitoring and comprise the steps of dividing and extracting characteristics of multi-source sensor signal data of a coal mine mining working face based on a preset time window, and constructing dynamic extremum event indexes and dynamic covariant vectors; the method comprises the steps of combining and updating dynamic covariate vectors based on a multi-frequency sampling asynchronous fusion mechanism, generating a dynamic covariate matrix by combining dynamic extreme event indexes, constructing a Bayesian dynamic extremum model based on the dynamic covariate matrix, updating the Bayesian dynamic extremum model based on a Markov chain Monte Carlo method, calculating a dynamic risk index of a coal mine mining working face based on the Bayesian dynamic extremum model, and carrying out disaster early warning on the coal mine mining working face based on the dynamic risk index. The invention relieves the technical problem of insufficient capturing capacity for the disaster instantaneous mutation risk in the prior art.
assignees: SHAANXI COAL MINING HANCHENG MINING CO LTD;UNIV CHINA MINING

title_en: Shallow sea geological disaster identification and pipeline stability assessment method based on light-scale intelligent model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ocean engineering safety monitoring and evaluation, in particular to a shallow sea geological disaster identification and pipeline stability evaluation method based on a light-scale intelligent model, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a shallow sea area disaster disturbance nesting map; and S2, executing disaster disturbance path identification and pipeline risk propagation modeling, outputting a pipeline disturbance influence graph containing disturbance transfer paths and node influence intensities, and S3, calculating stability scores of all pipe sections, and outputting disaster sources, propagation paths and disturbance link graphs which cause instability. According to the invention, through constructing the response relation between the disaster disturbance propagation path and the pipeline structure, the integrated expression of disaster influence identification, propagation modeling and stability evaluation is realized, and the accuracy and the interpretability of the shallow sea geological disaster on the analysis of the pipeline influence are improved.
assignees: FIRST INST OF OCEANOGRAPHY MINISTRY OF NATURAL RESOURCES

title_en: Anchor slope landslide instability risk evaluation method under rainfall condition
abstract_en: The invention provides an anchor slope landslide instability risk evaluation method under rainfall conditions, which belongs to the technical field of geotechnical engineering and geological disaster prevention and control, and comprises the steps of constructing a theoretical calculation formula of a multilayer geotechnical body anchor slope stability coefficient under rainfall infiltration based on a segmented sliding surface method, introducing reliability indexes based on a Monte Carlo probability analysis framework, establishing a slope reliability integrated evaluation model, acquiring soil body, rainfall, support and geometric parameter data of a slope, defining various parameters as random variables, carrying out large-scale sampling calculation based on the theoretical formula, calculating probability distribution of the statistical stability coefficient, solving reliability indexes and failure probability, establishing a risk monitoring criterion, judging whether each index exceeds an allowable value, and carrying out risk dynamic early warning based on a judging result. The invention constructs an integrated evaluation technical system for the reliability of the anchored side slope under the rainfall of a multi-layer rock-soil body, and realizes the high-efficiency quantification of the reliability of the side slope under the multi-parameter coupling effect.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Electric power transaction risk identification method, system, equipment and medium based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of power transaction risk identification. The method comprises the steps of performing feature extraction processing on acquired power transaction multisource heterogeneous data to generate a node set, performing hypergraph construction processing on the basis of the node set to generate a power transaction risk hypergraph, performing risk propagation modeling processing on the power transaction risk hypergraph to output risk event triggering probability, performing fusing strategy deduction processing on the basis of the risk event triggering probability and the power transaction risk hypergraph to generate a cascading interruption effect report, and performing deviation detection processing on the basis of the power transaction risk hypergraph, the cascading interruption effect report and real-time power purchasing behavior data to generate a power purchasing strategy deviation early warning signal so as to achieve the technical effects of improving the recognition precision of a multi-factor combined risk conduction path, reducing early warning false report rate and enhancing fusing strategy intervention effect and actual scene fitting degree.
assignees: SHANDONG STATE POWER INVEST ENERGY MARKETING CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle emergency disaster rescue cluster system and method based on large visual language model
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle emergency disaster rescue cluster system and method based on a large visual language model, comprising the steps of carrying out space-time alignment on acquired multi-modal environment observation data through a cross-modal space-time fusion mechanism; the method comprises the steps of combining a multi-mode encoder with an online contrast learning mechanism, utilizing a large visual language model to generate a structured situation description comprising disaster objects, positions and states, dynamically planning an optimal path through a Monte Carlo tree search algorithm, and monitoring the flight state of the unmanned aerial vehicle in real time through a time sequence anomaly detection network on the basis, wherein anomaly events occur in the unmanned aerial vehicle to trigger task migration and topology recombination. The disaster situation recognition method and the system can improve disaster situation recognition accuracy, shorten task planning response time, remarkably improve rescue efficiency, are suitable for high-dynamic disaster scenes, provide a reliable technical framework for multi-source heterogeneous data fusion and group intelligent decision, and further solve the problems of poor flexibility and low adaptability of a traditional unmanned aerial vehicle cluster rescue system.
assignees: UNIV NORTHWESTERN POLYTECHNICAL

title_en: Risk assessment method for large-scale cascade utilization of retired power battery
abstract_en: The application provides a large-scale cascade utilization risk assessment method of retired power batteries, which comprises the steps of S1, classifying the retired power batteries into at least one battery unit, screening out the battery units with obvious physical defects, S2, establishing a three-layer Bayesian network risk assessment model, S3, constructing a directed acyclic graph to characterize the dependency relationship among all nodes, S4, collecting relevant data, sequentially calculating the risk probability of each level of nodes based on the relevant data and the Bayesian network, S5, judging whether cascade utilization is suitable or not based on the risk probability of a top-layer target node and a middle-layer risk node, S6, if the retired power batteries are not suitable for cascade utilization, identifying key risk factors, deciding to disassemble the battery units for reevaluation or material recovery according to the risk sources of the key risk factors, S7, outputting a risk assessment result, and using the risk assessment result for new utilization risk assessment of the retired power batteries. The risk assessment method and the risk assessment system can improve the scientificity and the reliability of risk assessment.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC INST CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for supporting field operations using by risk level assessment of earthquake disaster area
title_ko: 지진재해 지역위험도 평가를 통한 현업 지원 방법 및 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 지진재해 지역위험도 평가를 통한 현업 지원 시스템은, 각 지역 별로 지질학적 데이터 및 지역 단층 구조를 포함하는 지진 정보를 수집하거나, 지진 관련 관측 장치로부터 실시간으로 지진재해 관련 관측 정보를 수집하는 정보 수집장치; 수집된 지질학적 데이터와 더불어 건축물의 구조 유형, 내진 설계 기준, 그리고 지진 취약도 데이터를 조합하여 각 건축물의 피해 위험도를 산출하고, 지진 발생 가능성이 기준보다 높은 지역을 대상으로 지질학적 데이터 및 지역 단층 구조를 수집 및 분석하여 해당 지역의 지진 위험성을 평가하는 지진재해 평가장치; 상기 지역별로 산출된 건축물 피해 위험도를 격자 기반의 공간 분석 기법을 통해 지진재해 위험도 지도로 시각화하고, 시각화된 지진재해 위험도 지도를 기반으로, 특정 지역의 우선 대응 필요성을 판단하고, 내진 보강 및 방재 계획 수립을 지원하며, 평가된 데이터와 시각화를 종합적으로 분석하여 지역, 정부 및 관련 기관에 실시간으로 제공하기 위한 플랫폼을 구축하는 현업 지원 장치; 및 상기 지진재해 평가장치로부터 해당 지역의 지진 위험성 평가 결과를 제공받거나, 상기 현업 지원 장치로부터 지진재해 위험도 지도를 제공받거나, 평가된 데이터와 시각화를 종합적으로 분석한 결과를 제공받는 사용자 단말장치를 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: NATIONAL DISASTER MANAGEMENT RESEARCH INST

title_en: Virtual Power Plant With Digital Twin Modeling And Artificial Intelligence-based Optimal Pricing And Contract Renewal System
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 모델링 및 인공지능에 의한 최적 가격 결정 및 계약 갱신 시스템이 적용된 가상발전소
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 디지털 트윈 모델링 및 인공지능에 의한 최적 가격 결정 및 계약 갱신 시스템이 적용된 가상발전소에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 발전원의 기준기간당 발전량을 추정하는 발전량 추정 모듈과 전력수요원의 전력 소비량을 추정하는 전력수요량 추정 모듈과 상기 발전량 추정 모듈과 전력 수요량 추정 모듈로부터 각각 추정되는 발전량과 전력소비량 데이터를 기초로 하여 강화학습된 인공지능에 의해 최적 가격을 도출하는 가격 결정 모듈을 포함하는 최적 가격 결정 시스템; 전력공급원의 실시간 에너지 거래 및 그 이력에 대한 데이터를 관리하며 상기 최적 가격 결정 시스템으로 결정된 가격과 실제 거래 가격간의 차이를 보상하는 매개변수값을 연산하여 상기 발전량 추정모델에 출력하는 전력원 관리 모듈; 전력수요원의 실시간 에너지 거래 및 그 이력에 대한 데이터를 관리하며 상기 최적 가격 결정 시스템으로 결정된 가격과 실제 거래 가격간의 차이를 보상하는 매개변수값을 연산하여 상기 전력수요량 추정 모듈에 출력하는 수요원 관리 모듈; 상기 최적 가격 결정 시스템을 관리하고, 실시간 전력 거래를 모니터링하고 그 이력을 관리하는 모니터링 모듈; 상기 모니터링 모듈로부터 입추출력되는 전력 거래에 대한 모든 데이터를 처리 및 관리하여 사용자에게 제공하는 클라우드 데이터 서버 모듈; 및 상기 클라우드 데이터 서버 모듈로부터 전 계약기간동안의 공급측의 전력 공급 이력 데이터 및 이로부터 연산되는 최대 최소 범위 데이터를 기초로 하여 공급측의 계약 갱신 조건을 모델링하여 복수개의 공급측 계약 갱신 디지털 트윈 모듈을 생성하는 공급측 디지털 트윈 모델링 모듈과 상기 클라우드 데이터 서버 모듈로부터 전 계약기간동안의 수요측의 전력 수요 내지 소비 이력 데이터 및 이로부터 연산되는 최대 최소 범위 데이터를 기초로 하여 수요측의 계약 갱신 조건을 모델링하여 복수개의 수요측 계약 갱신 디지털 트윈 모듈을 생성하는 수요측 디지털 트윈 모델링 모듈과 복수개의 공급측 계약 갱신 디지털 트윈 모듈과 수요측 계약 갱신 디지털 트윈 모듈 사이를 조합하여 각각 계약 합치 조건 범위를 인공지능에 의해 연산하여 출력하는 계약 갱신 모듈을 포함하는 계약 갱신 시스템;을 포함하여 구성되되, 상기 발전량 추정 모듈은 추정되는 발전 전력 공급에 대한 데이터 및 이로부터 연산되는 최대 최소 범위 데이터를 기초로 하여 가격에 대한 공급량을 모델링하는 복수개의 공급측 디지털 트윈 모델을 포함하며, 상기 전력수요량 추정 모듈은 추정되는 전력수요량에 대한 데이터 및 이로부터 연산되는 최대 최소 범위 데이터를 기초로 하여 가격에 대한 수요량을 모델링하는 복수개의 수요측 디지털 트윈 모델을 포함하며, 상기 가격 결정 모듈은 복수개의 공급측 디지털 트윈 모델과 복수개의 수요측 디지털 트윈 모델로부터 도출되는 각각의 가격에 대한 공급량과 수요량을 서로 매칭하여 결정되는 복수개의 가격으로부터 인공지능에 의해 최적의 가격 범위를 결정하는 것을 특징으로 하는 디지털 트윈 모델링 및 인공지능에 의한 최적 가격 결정 및 계약 갱신 시스템이 적용된 가상발전소에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Industrial complex energy metaverse system utilizing non-erosive load technology
title_ko: 비침식 부하 기술 활용 산단형 에너지 메타버스 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 개시의 전술한 과제 해결 수단에 의하면, 비침식 부하 제어 알고리즘을 적용함으로써, 생산 공정이나 설비 가동에 영향을 주지 않으면서 전력 부하를 효율적으로 조정할 수 있어, 생산성과 품질 저하 없이 전력 수요 최적화를 실현한다. 또한, 본 개시의 전술한 과제 해결 수단에 의하면, 태양광, 풍력 등 재생에너지 출력 변동에 실시간으로 반응하여 부하 재배치, ESS 충·방전 제어를 자동 수행함으로써, 전력망 안정성을 확보하고 전력 품질 저하를 방지한다. 또한, 본 개시의 전술한 과제 해결 수단에 의하면, 디지털 트윈 기반의 메타버스 플랫폼을 통해, 산업단지 전력 인프라와 설비의 상태를 가상공간에서 시각화·모니터링하고, 다양한 운영 시나리오를 실시간 시뮬레이션할 수 있어, 운영 효율성과 의사결정 속도를 향상시킨다.
assignees: CONNECTED INC

title_en: Centralized intelligent management system for full life cycle of photovoltaic power station
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power station management, and particularly discloses a centralized intelligent management system for the whole life cycle of a photovoltaic power station. The system comprises a model management module, a data service module, a decision guiding module and a state tracing module. The digital twin body constructed by the model management module can dynamically reconstruct the granularity and depth of the model according to the life cycle stage of the power station, the data service module performs standardized packaging on full-period heterogeneous data according to a predefined data structure template, the decision guiding module generates a strategy instruction based on the simulation state of the digital twin body, and the state tracing module records all state changes as a linear event sequence for tracing and auditing. The invention realizes the whole process from planning to retirement of the photovoltaic power station, self-adaption and traceable integrated management through the cooperation of the modules.
assignees: ZHANG GEYAN

title_en: Method for optimizing regional heating system operation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for optimizing the operation of a district heating system. The system comprises a primary network, a plurality of heat supply substations and a secondary network. The method comprises the steps of a) providing a primary network digital twin model based on operation data, simulating thermal and hydraulic characteristics of a primary network and a heat supply substation, b) providing a secondary network digital twin model for predicting heat demand distribution in a secondary network, c) calibrating the primary and secondary network models, d) predicting the heat demand distribution in the secondary network, e) optimizing primary network operation according to the heat demand distribution and heat supply parameters by using the primary network model, and f) generating a heat supply plan. Through the digital twin platform, the invention reduces energy consumption waste and improves system comfort and operation efficiency.
assignees: ELECTRICITE DE FRANCE

title_en: Realtime hydrogen pipe network simulation system based on digital twin
title_ko: 디지털트윈-기반 실시간 수소관망 시뮬레이션 시스템
abstract_ko: 수소도시 구축을 위한 수소관망에 있어서, 실제 수소관망과 동일한 구조 및 운전조건을 디지털트윈 환경에 구현함으로써, 실시간 유동 해석과 운용 시나리오 검증을 수행하고, 수소관망 설계 최적화와 비상 대응 능력을 향상시킬 수 있으며, 또한, 수소관망 도면 데이터를 기반으로 자동화된 네트워크 모델을 구성하고, 설비 특성 데이터를 반영한 해석 환경을 마련하며, 센서 데이터를 실시간으로 연동하여 운영 조건에 따른 압력 및 유량의 변화를 정밀하게 분석할 수 있고, 또한, 다양한 운용 시나리오를 가상으로 재현하고, 그 결과를 시각적으로 제공함으로써 설계 검증과 운영 효율성을 동시에 달성할 수 있는, 디지털트윈-기반 실시간 수소관망 시뮬레이션 시스템이 제공된다.

title_ko: 심층 전이학습 기반 태양광 발전량 예측 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 심층 신경망 학습을 통해 태양광 발전량을 예측하는 시스템에 있어서, 고객별 인버터로부터 발전량과 설비 메타데이터를 수집하고 저장하는 데이터베이스부; 외부 기상 예보 자료를 연동하여 시계열 정렬, 품질관리, 결측 보정 및 피처 엔지니어링을 수행하여 학습 및 추론 가능한 데이터셋을 생성하는 데이터 전처리부; 상기 데이터 전처리부로부터 제공된 복수 고객의 데이터를 이용해 공통 표현을 학습하는 심층 신경망 백본 네트워크를 훈련, 검증 및 버전관리하는 신경망 학습부; 신규 또는 데이터가 제한된 고객에 대하여 상기 백본 네트워크의 가중치를 일부 고정한 상태에서 출력 계층을 중심으로 미세조정하여 고객별 예측 모델을 생성 및 제공하는 전이 학습부; 및 상기 데이터베이스부, 데이터 전처리부, 신경망 학습부 및 전이 학습부에 각각 연결되어 상기 데이터베이스부, 데이터 전처리부, 신경망 학습부 및 전이 학습부의 작동을 제어하는 제어부;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
