title_en: Pipe network global early warning visualization method based on Beidou positioning system and AI
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pipe network global early warning visualization method based on a Beidou positioning system and AI, which comprises the steps of constructing a 1:1 pipe network model through a BIM+GIS double platform, combining Beidou grid position codes based on a GeoSOT (Geo-Spatial One-Time Code) theory to realize centimeter-level positioning, constructing a full scene information base through digital twinning, completing millisecond-level virtual-real mapping in cooperation with Beidou, integrating AI models such as isolated forests, LSTM (LSTM) and the like, integrating 7 early warning factors to construct a four-dimensional early warning frame, early warning waterlogging risks for 72 hours, and ensuring reliable storage of key data by a block chain to form a technical closed loop of twin data, beidou positioning and block chain storage certificate. The invention realizes that the early warning response speed is improved by more than or equal to 50 percent, the fault positioning error is less than or equal to 1.5mm, the pipe network management is promoted to be converted from passive response to active management and control, and full-chain support is provided for multi-disaster early warning, intelligent operation and maintenance and cross departments in cooperation.

title_en: Frequent power failure early warning method for transformer area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a frequent power failure early warning method for a transformer area, and belongs to the fields of safe operation of a power system and operation and maintenance of a power distribution network. The method is based on multi-source data fusion, digital twin modeling and intelligent algorithm, and concretely comprises the steps of obtaining relevant data of a power system area, constructing a grid network frame digital twin model by adopting deep learning and knowledge map fusion technology based on network frame topology data, analyzing the topological relevance of power nodes of the power system area by adopting a two-dimensional weight improved graph neural network to obtain an updated background area power node network, carrying out feature engineering processing on the updated background area power node network data, carrying out abnormal power failure risk analysis processing on the power system area by combining a long-term memory network with a short-term memory network capturing time sequence feature, and executing corresponding power failure early warning operation. According to the scheme, user feedback false alarm can be effectively eliminated, the power failure early warning accuracy and the operation and maintenance efficiency of the transformer area are improved, the operation and maintenance is promoted to be changed from passive rush repair to active prevention, and the electricity reliability of users is guaranteed.

title_en: Apparatus and method for managing data of power grid, system for managing data thereof
title_ko: 전력의 데이터 관리 장치, 데이터 관리 방법 및 데이터 관리 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전력의 데이터 관리 장치, 데이터 관리 방법 및 데이터 관리 시스템에 관한 것으로, 데이터 관리 장치는 적어도 하나의 발전소의 설비로부터 수집 데이터를 수집하는 데이터 수집부, 상기 수집 데이터의 결함 데이터를 산출하고, 상기 결함 데이터의 결함 원인을 분석하는 데이터 분석부 및 상기 결함 원인에 기초하여 학습 모델을 통해 상기 결함 데이터를 보정하는 데이터 보정부를 포함할 수 있고, 상기 결함 데이터는, 상기 수집 데이터의 수집 기간 범위가 비연속적인 제1 결함 데이터 및 결측값, 연속된 중복값, 음수값 및 0값 중 적어도 하나인 제2 결함 데이터를 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: KOREA ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: System and Method for Determining Rental Price and Managing Building Operations Based on Operating Costs Between Lessor and Lessee
title_ko: 임대인 및 임차인간 건축물 운영비용 기반의 임대료 산정 및 건축물 운영체계
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 건축물의 운영비용 구조를 기반으로 임대료를 산정하고, 에너지 운영 전략과 재무 흐름을 통합적으로 최적화하는 임대인 및 임차인 간 건축물 운영체계에 관한 것이다. 최근 탄소중립 정책 강화, ESG 공시 확대, 전력시장 구조 변화 및 RE100 이행 요구가 증가함에 따라, 건축물 운영자는 에너지 비용 절감뿐 아니라 장기적인 탄소 리스크와 재무 리스크를 동시에 고려한 전략 수립이 요구되고 있다. 그러나 종래의 임대료 산정 방식은 고정 단가 기반 구조에 머물러 있으며, 에너지 가격 변동, 탄소세 도입, 전력시장 참여 수익 등 외생 변수를 반영하지 못하는 한계를 가진다. 
특히 상업용 건축물에서는 임대인과 임차인이 서로 다른 목적함수를 가지며, 설비 투자 회수 기간과 임대계약 기간 간 불일치로 인해 비용 부담의 구조적 불균형이 발생한다. 또한 종래의 그린 리스, 보조금 제도, 제로에너지 인증 체계 등은 정책적·제도적 장치에 의존할 뿐, 시간단위 에너지 소비 패턴, 시장 가격 신호, 설비 부분부하 효율, 사용자 행태 변화 등을 반영한 정량적 의사결정 체계를 제공하지 못한다. 
아울러 기존 스마트빌딩 및 디지털트윈 기술은 데이터 수집 및 시각화 중심으로 구성되어 있어, 임대료 산정 구조와 장기 재무 흐름 분석을 연계하지 못하며, 전력시장 참여, 수요반응(DR), ESS 운영, 직접 PPA 및 REC 거래 전략을 통합적으로 최적화하는 기능 역시 부족하다. 특히 국내 제로에너지 인증 프로그램은 연간 평균 소비량 기반의 정태적 분석 구조를 채택하고 있어, 시간단위 부하 이동 전략과 동적 시장 참여 전략을 반영하지 못하는 구조적 한계를 가진다. 특히 Positive Energy District와 같이 현재 지구단위 별 공동 신*재생전력원, 연료전지, Energy 저장장치 및 수소생산설비의 공용화를 추진하는데 있어, 설비 소유주 및 설비간 연계 여부를 구체적으로 구분하여 운영하는 S/W는 없다. 더욱이, 건축물 시공비 뿐만 아니라 효율적 관리가 대두되고 이는 임대료를 비롯, 부동산 시장에 영향을 미치는 부분으로 이에 대하여 합리적 의사결정을 도와주는 S/W는 없다. 
이에 본 발명은 건축물의 시간단위 에너지 소비 패턴과 설비 운전 특성을 정밀하게 반영하고, 전력시장 가격 신호, RE100 이행 전략, 시장 참여 수익 및 이해관계자 간 전략적 상호작용을 수리적으로 정식화하여, 균형 임대료와 최적 운영 스케줄을 도출하는 통합 시스템 및 방법을 제안한다. 본 발명은 순차적 의사결정 구조를 반영한 모델을 통해 임대인과 임차인의 상이한 목적함수를 조정하고, 장기 재무 흐름과 정책 요건을 동시에 고려하는 동적 분석 체계를 제공함으로써, 종래 기술의 정태적·단일 목적 최적화 한계를 극복하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
또한 본 발명의 특징은 기존 개발된 건축물 Energy 분석의 경우 비주거 및 주거용 건축물에 국한되며 시간단위의 동적해석 기능은 포함하지 않는다. 본 발명에서 적용되는 대상의 건축물은 물류 기반의 냉동창고를 비롯 기타 산업시설의 운영 역시 포함하며, 임대인과 임차인의 구조가 존재하며 매집형 Energy 사업자가 존재하는 한 유효하다. 
특히, 기존 개발된 건축물 Energy 분석의 경우, Digital Twin 구현에 있어 지식이 부족한 경우 별도로 Digital Twin 구현에 필요한 시각화 도구를 구매하는 경우가 많아 보급형으로 구현하기 힘들었으나, 본 S/W에서는 공간별 좌표를 직접 입력하고 입력한 좌표에 해당하는 공간과 연계여부를 별도의 입력항으로 구분하여 운영함에 기존 건축물 Energy 분석 S/W와 차별성이 있다. 특히 탈부착 가능한 신*재생전력원의 동적 영향을 추가로 고려하는 점 역시 기존 S/W와는 차별성이 있다.
assignees: LEE JAE HO

title_en: Data collection device for monitoring water hammer in water supply network
title_ko: 상수관망 수격 모니터링용 데이터 수집 장치
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 상수관망 수격 모니터링용 데이터 수집 장치에 관한 것으로서, 상세하게는 상수관망에서 발생하는 수격현상(water hammer)을 모니터링하기 위한 데이터 수집 장치에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 디지털 트윈 시스템과 연동되어 실시간으로 수격 데이터를 수집, 저장 및 전송할 수 있는 장치에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 의하면, 실시간으로 관제 시스템까지 데이터를 전송할 수 있도록 하는 WiFi 통신 모듈을 탑재함으로써, 해당 모니터링 센서 모듈의 정상 동작 여부를 확인할 수 있는 효과를 제공한다.
assignees: NEMOBLUE CO LTD

title_en: Method for smart operation management of power plant by linking power plant digital twin system and mobile-based online drawing management system, apparatus and computer program for performing the method
title_ko: 발전소 디지털 트윈 시스템과 모바일 기반 온라인 도면 관리 시스템의 연동을 통한 발전소 스마트 운영 관리 방법, 이를 수행하는 장치 및 컴퓨터 프로그램
abstract_ko: 발전소 디지털 트윈 시스템과 모바일 기반 온라인 도면 관리 시스템의 연동을 통한 발전소 스마트 운영 관리 방법, 이를 수행하는 장치 및 컴퓨터 프로그램은, 발전소 디지털 트윈 시스템과 모바일 기반 온라인 도면 관리 시스템의 연동을 통해 발전소의 스마트 운영 관리를 수행함으로써, 발전소 운영 현장에서 디지털 트윈 시스템을 통하여 실제 환경과 유사한 상황에서 교육 훈련을 하고, 위험 상황 발생 시의 대체 요령을 미리 숙지할 수 있는 기능을 제공하여, 긴급 상황 발생 시에 신속하고 정확한 대응이 가능하며, 설비 관리 시스템과의 연동을 통해 유지 보수 계획 수립으로 고장 발생 전에 예방 조치가 가능하고, 현장 작업자의 최적화된 작업 계획 수립으로 운영 비용의 절감 및 사고 예방이 가능하다.
assignees: KOREA SOUTH EAST POWER CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin system, processing method, and program
abstract_en: One aspect of the present disclosure is a digital twin system that constructs a cyber space of a digital twin, said digital twin system comprising: an object construction unit that constructs a network in which a plurality of objects and a connecting object that connects the plurality of objects are configured in the cyber space; an analysis unit that performs a simulation on the basis of an added object which is added to the network and attribute information for said added object; and a first output unit that outputs the cyber space on the basis of the result of the simulation by the analysis unit, wherein the analysis unit causes the connecting object to connect to the added object in accordance with the positional relationship between the connecting object and the added object, and performs the simulation on the basis of the attribute information.
assignees: MITSUBISHI ELECTRIC CORP

title_en: Digital twin visual monitoring device for offshore wind power supporting structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a digital twin visual monitoring device for an offshore wind power supporting structure, which comprises a supporting structure monitoring unit, an environmental parameter acquisition unit, a central data processing unit, a self-adaptive digital twin modeling module, a power supply module, a communication module and a multifunctional visual display terminal. The support structure monitoring unit is used for monitoring stress, vibration and attitude information of the support structure in real time, the environment parameter acquisition unit is used for acquiring wind speed, wave height, ocean current and water level change data, the central data processing unit performs edge processing and buffering on the acquired data, the self-adaptive digital twin modeling module dynamically updates the three-dimensional simulation model of the support structure according to the processed data, the power supply module provides independent power supply, the communication module realizes remote data transmission, and the multifunctional visual display terminal displays the structure state in real time. The utility model realizes real-time monitoring and intelligent management of the offshore wind power supporting structure, and improves the structural health assessment and remote operation and maintenance level.

title_en: Solution derivation method and solution derivation device for volage control systems
title_ko: 전압 제어 시스템의 솔루션 도출 방법 및 솔루션 도출 장치
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전력 계통의 전압을 제어하는 전압 제어 시스템의 최적 솔루션을 도출하는 솔루션 도출 장치에 관한 것으로, 상기 전압 제어 시스템으로부터 실시간 전력량 데이터 및 제어 데이터를 수집하는 수집부; 상기 전력 계통을 모사하기 위해 상기 실시간 전력량 및 제어 데이터에 기초하여 디지털 트윈 기반의 가상 계통을 구성하고, 상기 가상 계통의 시뮬레이션을 수행하는 시뮬레이션부; 및 상기 시뮬레이션부에서의 시뮬레이션 결과에 기초하여 상기 전압 제어 시스템으로 전달될 최적 시나리오 세트를 도출하는 도출부를 포함한다. 이를 통해 주요 계통 설비들의 실시간 전력 계측 값을 수집하여 전체 전력 계통의 전력 흐름과 전압 상태를 시뮬레이션하고, 그 결과를 기반으로 전 설비 수준의 전압 영향을 정밀하게 예측하는 것은 물론, 해당 전압 제어 시스템의 최적 솔루션을 도출하여 전력 계통의 에너지 효율성과 안정성을 동시에 확보할 수 있다.
assignees: SYNERGY INC

title_en: Target informing system and method using digital twin and directional acoustic device
title_ko: 디지털트윈 및 지향성 음향 장치를 이용한 표적 알림 시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 경기장, 공연장 또는 다중 이용 시설 등 대규모 인파가 군집하는 시설물 내에서 실시되는 각종 경보 또는 안내 등 음향 기반 정보 제공에 관한 것으로, 해당 시설물에 대한 3차원 전산 모형인 디지털트윈(21)을 구축하고, 현실 시설물에는 디지털트윈(21)과 연동되어 제어 가능한 지향성 음향 장치를 설치함으로써, 운영자의 디지털트윈(21) 조작에 따라 시설내 제한된 영역에 국한된 표적 알림이 가능하도록 한 것이다. 
본 발명을 통하여, 인파 군집 시설물내 지향성 음향 장치 운용에 있어서, 신속하고 정확하며 간편한 표적 알림이 가능하게 되었으며, 이로써 재난 발생시 적절하고 효율적인 경보가 가능할 뿐 아니라, 시설물내 영역별로 특화된 음향 정보를 제공할 수 있다.
assignees: U INFRAWAY CO LTD

title_en: System and method for telematics service through road status real time update
title_ko: 도로상황 실시간 업데이트를 통한 텔레메틱스 서비스시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: A system and a method for providing a telematics service through real-time road status update and a method thereof are provided to give better driving path information to a user by providing a circuitous route on the basis of real-time updated road status information in case that the state of a road gets worse due to a traffic accident or a natural disaster. A system for providing a telematics service through real-time road status update comprises the first mobile terminal(15a), the second mobile terminal(15b), a database(12), and a telematics server(11). The first mobile terminal transmits road status information. The second mobile terminal receives driving path information and provides it to the user. The database updates and stores road status information. The telematics server receives road status information from the first mobile terminal, updates the database, and reflects real-time updated road status information into the driving path information which is provided to the second mobile terminal.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 도로상황 실시간 업데이트를 통한 텔레메틱스 서비스 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명은 이동통신단말기의 사용자나 도로정보제공서버로부터 전송되는 사고 또는 자연재해 등의 발생으로 인한 도로 상황 정보를 실시간으로 업데이트하여 텔레메틱스 서버에 저장하고, 이동통신단말기에 도로 주행을 위한 주행 경로 정보를 제공하는 경우에 이동통신단말기 사용자에게 제공되는 주행 경로 상의 도로에 사고, 자연재해 등의 발생으로 인하여 도로 상황이 악화 되면 업데이트된 도로 상황 정보에 의거하여 이를 실시간으로 반영하여 우회 경로를 제공함으로써, 항시 양호한 주행 경로를 사용자에게 제공한다. 
       
     텔레메틱스, 주행경로
assignees: SK TELECOM CO LTD

title_en: Power system state estimator applicable to wide area measurement system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power system state estimator applicable to a wide area measurement system in the technical field of operation and control of power systems. The power system state estimator comprises a data fusion module, a system identification module, a transient stability control module and a security evaluation module, wherein the data fusion module only stores 'key' data which reflect electric network characteristics and meet measurement accuracy; the system identification module modifies system parameters and data, and an output of the system identification module is connected with the transient stability control module; the transient stability control module sends processed data into the security evaluation module and performs security evaluation on the system; and the security evaluation module finally outputs important information. The power system state estimator can realize the fusion, real-time state estimation and analytical evaluation for mass data, ensure the safe and stable operation of the system, and can also improve the accuracy of state estimation by identifying electric network parameters and processing bad data at the same time; and the power system state estimator can provide good application interfaces and alarm prompts, and effectively play roles in electric network dynamic early warning and accident treatment of the system.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: A kind of anti-difference of electric power system method for estimating state based on the exponential type target function
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of anti-difference of electric power system method for estimating state of exponential type target function, belong to the dispatching automation of electric power systems field.This method comprises: the state estimation Mathematical Modeling of setting up new exponential type target function according to the electric network model and the real-time measuring data of actual electric network, adopt method of Lagrange multipliers to estimate electrical network busbar voltage and phase angle, thereby calculate the meritorious and idle of equipment such as circuit, transformer, generator, load.The present invention can realize the big measurement of error is tending towards 0 to the influence of target function automatically, and correct measurement is tending towards 1 to the influence of target function.Therefore, the state estimation algorithm that the present invention proposes can carry out the bad data identification, and it is convenient to realize, the computational efficiency height.In addition, do not exist in system under the situation of bad data, the estimated performance of this method is similar with classical weighted least-squares method.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Leak detection and control system and mehtod
abstract_en: A system and method for detecting leaks using sensors to report the leak and communicate with a control unit to turn off the source of the leak once detected. A valve can be turned off in the event of a leak and embodiments employing battery power can function during loss of power such as a power blackout. Wireless sensors can be employed to detect leaks that wirelessly communicate with a control and operate solely with a designated control unit. The wireless sensors can operate using low power provided by batteries. The control panel can display alarm conditions from the sensors, including: low battery, poor signal, wet sensor, communication failure, sensor failure.
assignees: MEYERS TIMOTHY MEYER

title_en: Maintenance scheduling safety evaluation method based on power generation loss and load supply adequacy
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of maintenance scheduling evaluation and optimization in the power system and relates to a maintenance scheduling safety evaluation method based on power generation loss and load supply adequacy. The method comprises the following steps: firstly integrating network topology data and planning data into flow data, extracting the missing data from the reference flow data to form complete flow, simultaneously carrying out sensitivity analysis based on network topology and computing the generating capacity loss and the load supply adequacy according to the results of sensitivity analysis and flow computation, wherein evaluation based on the generating capacity loss is to compute the sensitivity of a generator to all the branches by system network topology and compute the normalized value of the generating capacity loss according to the formula; and evaluation based on the load supply adequacy is to compute the adequacy of bus load supply according to the flow computation result, the sensitivity computation result and the branch operating limit restraint. The method solves the problems in the existing methods.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD;NORTH CHINA GRID CO LTD

title_en: Data gap management in a remote data mirroring system
abstract_en: A method includes monitoring a sequence of transactions in one or more volumes. The transactions are transferred to a primary storage (112) in a given order, and are replicated to a secondary storage (114). The volumes belong to a volume group (204) for which the transactions are guaranteed to be replicated while retaining the given order. Artificial write transactions (228) are periodically issued to a protection application field, which is predefined in a given volume (212) belonging to the volume group. Records indicative of the transactions, including the artificial transactions, are stored in a disaster-proof storage unit (144). Upon verifying that a given artificial transaction has been successfully replicated in the secondary storage, the records corresponding to the given artificial write transaction and the transactions that precede it in the sequence are deleted from the disaster-proof storage unit.
assignees: AXXANA ISRAEL LTD;WINOKUR ALEX

title_en: Water supply management system and control method thereof
title_ko: 상수도 운영관리 시스템 및 그 제어방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A system for managing operation of a waterworks and method for controlling the same are provided to integrally mange waterworks through a real time update of a data related to a waterworks pipe line. CONSTITUTION: A data measurement unit(110) includes a flux measurer, a water quality measurer and a water pressure measurer. A web server(130) collects measurement data in real time from an oil data integrated metrology. The web server performs calculation and analysis for maintaining, analysis, and monitoring of a waterworks pipe line. A GIS(Geographic Information System) server(160) provides waterworks distribution network of the waterworks pipe line.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 상수도 운영관리 시스템 및 그 제어방법에 관한 것이다. 
     이를 위해 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 상수도 운영관리 시스템은 단위 블록별로 블록화된 상수도 관망의 각 블록 내 설치되어 각 구역별로 상수의 유속, 유량, 수위를 측정하는 유량계측부와, 수질을 측정하는 수질계측부와, 수압을 측정하는 수압계측부를 포함하는 데이터계측수단; 상기 상수의 유속, 유량, 수위, 수질, 수압을 측정한 계측 데이터를 유무선 통신망을 통하여 상기 데이터계측수단으로부터 실시간으로 수집하고, 수집된 상기 계측 데이터를 바탕으로 미리 저장된 알고리즘들을 이용하여 상기 상수도 관망의 모니터링, 분석 및 유지관리를 위한 연산 및 분석을 하며, 상기 연산 및 분석된 결과를 전송하는 웹서버; 인터넷을 통하여 상기 웹서버에 접속하여 상기 결과를 출력하는 사용자단말기; 및 상기 인터넷을 통하여 상기 웹서버와 연동하여 상기 상수도 관망의 상수도 관망도를 제공하는 GIS(Geographic Information System)서버; 를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
     이러한 구성에 의하면, 상수도 관로의 모니터링, 유지관리, 누수량 분석 및 유수율 분석과 함께 상수도 관로 운영관리의 효율성을 높일 수 있는 서비스 및 상태정보와 제어정보를 사용자(관리자)에게 웹 페이지를 통해서 제공하고, 상수도 관로 관련 데이터의 실시간 업데이트를 통하여 상수도를 통합 관리할 수 있는 효과가 있다. 
     
     상수도, 블록화, 노후관, GIS, 알고리즘, 관망도, 관망해석, 칼만필터
assignees: MATRIX CO LTD E

title_en: Power system state estimating method for taking zero injection measurement equality constraint into consideration
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power system state estimating method for taking zero injection measurement equality constraint into consideration, belonging to the technical field of power system dispatching automation and grid simulation. The method comprises the following step of: adding zero injection measurement as an equality constraint into an optimized model of state estimation to form an equality constraint-contained optimized model. As for the model, a voltage amplitude value and a phase angle of a zero injection node are used as basic variables and a voltage amplitude value and a phase angle of a nonzero injection node are used as nonbasic variables for participating in optimization; the basic variables and the nonbasic variables are solved by adopting a reduced gradient method; and the zero injection node voltage is confirmed according to nonzero injection node voltage. The method disclosed by the invention can ensure that a zero injection constraint equation is strictly met and solve the problem that an estimating result does not meet a flow equation because zero injection node power mismatching amount is larger in the traditional power system estate estimation.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: System and method for automated, range-based irrigation
abstract_en: A centralized irrigation system provides non-decision-making controllers in combination with a client server architecture that employs irrigation algorithms for monitoring and control. Live feedback means send information back to a server for use with sophisticated modeling capabilities to monitor exceptions to a planned control scheme, adjust control parameters, and provide a real-time update to system performance. This feedback is instantaneously routed from the server to monitoring and feedback client software connected to the server through a network and enables volume-based cycles and soaks of irrigation. Range-based control strategies determine a total volumetric water-holding capacity for a volume of soil and a range of desirable soil moisture. The system permits a shared-savings business model where the vendor provides a system and the customer only pays the vendor a portion of the savings obtained by using the system. It further permits rapidly deploying improved control systems to save water for a community.
assignees: COOK KENNETH W

title_en: Real time update system reflecting the topography change by disaster
title_ko: 재해 및 오염에 의한 지형변화가 반영된 수치지도의 실시간 업데이트시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A real-time update system of a digital map which is subject to topographic change by disaster and contamination is provided to apply topographic change due to disaster in case of digital map renewal. CONSTITUTION: A ground image collector(100) comprises a GPS receiver(110), a signal generator(120), and a camera(130). The GPS receiver confirms the GPS information of current position. The signal generator transmits identification signals of a fixed frequency band. The camera photographs the ground and creates aviation photographing images. A standard point display device(200,200',200") comprises a laser(210), a signal sensor(220), and a light emission device. The laser is installed on the upper side of a case and emits laser light by supplying electricity. The signal sensor receives identification signals and controls the operation of a laser. The light emission device emits the standard laser light to a light accepting panel.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재해 및 오염에 의한 지형변화가 반영된 수치지도의 실시간 업데이트시스템에 관한 것으로, GPS수신기(110)와 신호발생기(120)와 카메라(130)로 구성된 지상이미지 수집장치(100); 지지대(250)와 회동프레임(260)과 케이스(270)와 레이저(210)와 신호감지기(220)와 충전기(230)와 구동기(240)와 앵커바아(280)와 발광기(290)로 구성된 기준점 표시장치(200, 200', 200"); 및 이미지입력기(310)와 도화기(320)와 수치정보입력기(330)와 입출력수단(340)으로 구성된 수치지도 작성장치(300);를 포함하면서, 기준점표시장치로부터 조사되는 레이저광의 위치 변화를 감지해서, 사용자가 지형변화를 손쉽게 인지할 수 있고, 이를 통해 수치지도 갱신시 재해로 인한 지형변화를 효과적으로 반영한다.
assignees: GO ONE AERIAL INFORMATION CO LTD

title_en: Method for splicing multi-stage multi-region interconnected power grid relay protection model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for splicing multi-stage multi-region interconnected power grid relay protection model. The method comprises the following steps of: establishing a power grid model and a relay protection model in a domination area by using each stage of power grid scheduling center, performing simplification or equivalence processing on an outer net, marking to form a gateway power grid definition, and outputting a model data file; collecting a power grid model file and a relay protection model data file transmitted by each stage of scheduling center by using a highest stage scheduling center, and performing data check; eliminating simplification or equivalence equipment according to the gateway power grid definition by using the highest stage scheduling center to form a whole power grid model data library, and performing model verification and state estimation; and matching the relay protection model with the whole power grid model data library by using the highest stage scheduling center to form data for online verification of relay protection, and forwarding the data for online verification of relay protection to each stage of scheduling center. Due to the adoption of the method, complete power grid model and protection model data can be provided for each stage of power grid scheduling center, and a data basis is particularly provided for an online relay protection verification system.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO;NARI RELAYS ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: System for estimating distributive state of intelligent transformer station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system for estimating a distributive state of an intelligent transformer station. The system comprises a scheduling center state estimation platform and a distributive state estimation plant terminal platform, and the distributive state estimation plant terminal platform comprises a transformer station real-time database, a transformer station graphic topology analysis module, a transformer station state estimation module and a distributive state estimation database. The transformer station graphic topology analysis module carries out transformer station topology analysis on station internal remote signaling on the basis of a power grid model static database maintained at a station terminal, relationship of topology connection and node device connection of station internal switch nodes and device parameters to form transformer station internal system topology; the transformer station state estimation module carries out transformer station state estimation on the station internal telemetry information and calculates credibility quality grade of information; and the distributive state estimation database is used for transmitting measurement data to a scheduling center state estimation real-time database through a transformer station communication server and a scheduling data network and simultaneously receiving information of the scheduling center state estimation real-time database. According to the system for estimating the distributive state of the intelligent transformer station, disclosed by the invention, the reliability and the accuracy of transformer station basic data can be improved, and the processing on secondary information defects is accelerated.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD;SUZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Optimal identification method of node equivalent transmission parameters based on single PMU measurement section
abstract_en: The invention provides an optimal identification method of node equivalent transmission parameters based on single PMU (Power Management Unit) measurement section, belonging to the technical field of power grid stability monitoring and early warning based on a WAMS (Wide Area Measurement System). The method combines the existing SCDA(Supervisory Control And Data Acquisition)/EMS(Energy Management System) power grid actual topological structure and the state estimation data, obtains equivalent resistance and equivalent reactance of each node of the power grid through a short circuit calculation program, and takes the equivalent resistance and the equivalent reactance as the initial value of an optimal identification algorithm. The PMU measurement data is filtered, and based on a trace sensitivity technology, node equivalent model parameters are identified quickly and effectively. The optimal identification method of node equivalent transmission parameters based on single PMU measurement section effectively avoids influence of PMU actual measurement data noise on the identification result, and provides reliable data basis for realizing online estimation and preventive control on steady state of a large power grid, thereby improving the intelligent real-time monitoring level of the large power grid.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Online state estimation method for electric power system by means of hybrid measurement
abstract_en: The invention discloses an online state estimation method for an electric power system by means of hybrid measurement, which belongs to the technical field of state estimation of electric power systems. The online state estimation method includes the steps: 1) initializing a state estimation system; 2) predicting corresponding node voltage amplitude by the aid of harmony search-Gaussian process regression algorithm; 3) predicting node voltage phase angles by the aid of the harmony search-Gaussian process regression algorithm; 4) revising predicted values in the step 2) and the step 3) by the aid of a Newton-Raphson iteration method to obtain state estimation values; and 5) acquiring measurement data of front T time of T+1 time, repeating the step 2) to the step 4) and obtaining the state estimation value of the T+1st time to realize continuous prediction. The online state estimation method has the advantages that high precision is realized in terms of state estimation of hybrid measurement of the electric power system, and the online state estimation method is fast in prediction speed and can meet the requirement of online state estimation on instantaneity.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELEC POWER

title_en: Management device, unmeasurable power consumption estimation program and unmeasurable power consumption estimation method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a technique capable of highly accurately estimating power consumption of an electric device when the power consumption cannot be measured.SOLUTION: An electric power acquisition unit 110 acquires a result of measuring electric power supplied from an external power source to an information device 30. An operation state acquisition unit 111 acquires an operation state of the information device 30 from an awareness server 70. An unmeasurable operation period specification unit 112 specifies an unmeasurable operation period in which the information device 30 operates in a period in which the power consumption of the information device 30 is not measured. An electric power storage state estimation unit 113 estimates an electric power storage state of a battery in the information device 30 before and after the period in which the power consumption of the information device 30 is not measured. A power consumption estimation unit 114 estimates power consumption of the information device 30 during the period in which the power consumption of the information device 30 is not measured, on the basis of the unmeasurable operation period and the electric power storage state of the battery.
assignees: FUJITSU LTD

title_en: Power load data refining method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power load data refining method used in the field of grid control. The power load data refining method includes the following steps: acquiring power load data; carrying out identification and data supplementation on missing data points in the power load data; outputting a data supplementation result; carrying out identification and data correction on singular value data points in the power load data; and outputting a data correction result. The power load data refining method has the technical advantage that by carrying out data supplementation on the missing data points in the power load data and data correction on the singular value data points in the power load data, the power load data refining method can increase the quality of the power load data, thus laying a foundation for the subsequent mining and analysis of the power load data.
assignees: SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELEC POWER

title_en: A kind of exact linearization method of Power system state estimation measurement equation
abstract_en: The present invention proposes a kind of exact linearization method of Power system state estimation measurement equation, it is characterized in that, comprises the following steps: set up network model, computing node admittance matrix; Choose state vector, and choose measurement vector; And formation Jacobi matrix, obtain the measurement equation of exact linearization method.The present invention is by choosing state vector, and choose measurement vector, thus the measurement equation of exact linearization method can be obtained, based on the measurement equation of this exact linearization method, existing any one state estimation solving state vector can be adopted, and then obtain the estimated value of branch powers all in network, node injecting power etc., thus greatly reduce the complicacy of state estimation model, more easily solve.

title_en: Method for assessing state estimation credibility of power system based on cumulants method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for assessing the state estimation credibility of a power system based on a cumulants method, which belongs to the field of analysis and control of power systems. The invention proposes a state estimation credibility index of a power system based on a confidence interval, which not only can be used for assessing the estimation credibility of single measurement, but also can be used for assessing the credibility of the whole state assessing system. The invention further proposes a solving method for an assessing result confidence interval based on a cumulants method, which only requires one-step matrix operation in the state estimation iteration process and is small in calculated amount, little in change of the state assessing system, suitable for different state estimation methods and different measurement error distributions and high in calculation precision. The assessing for a state estimation result is beneficial to the improvement on the estimation precision and avoidance of serious results possibly brought from a bad estimation result to a control system, and thus, the foundation is laid for the automatic closed-loop control.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Robust state estimation method for full PMU measurement
abstract_en: The invention provides a robust state estimation method for full PMU measurement, which comprises the following steps: initializing a network topology model and network parameters of the power system, and updating a switch measurement value and a PMU measurement value; performing topology contraction and measurement matching; identifying a range of observable nodes; performing equivalent measurement transformation; and establishing a state estimation model and solving. The robust state estimation method for full PMU measurement obviously improves the convergence rate, the qualification rate and the calculation frequency of the state estimation system, greatly lightens the maintenance workload of the state estimation system, and lays a foundation for realizing quick sensing, comprehensive sensing and accurate sensing of a power grid. Compared with the existing method, the robust state estimation method provided by the invention has the advantages that the calculation precision, the calculation speed and the convergence rate are obviously improved.
assignees: CHINA SOUTH POWER GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;UNIV TSINGHUA;HAINAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power grid measurement data and power grid model correction method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a power grid measurement data and power grid model correction method. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring power grid measurement data and power grid model data from a data acquisition and monitoring control system; performing state estimation of the actual operating state of the power grid according to the power grid measurement data and the power grid model data; matching the result of the state estimation with the preset conditions, and positioning the error in the power grid measurement data and the power grid model data according to the matching conditions; and correcting the positioned error according to the preset rule. The invention also discloses a power grid measurement data and power grid model correction device. According to the method, the accuracy of the power grid measurement data and the power grid model data can be improved, and a guarantee is provided for performing advanced application based on the data.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CORP;NINGBO ELECTRIC POWER BUREAU

title_en: A kind of method of opposing electricity-stealing excavated based on power load Management System Data
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of method of opposing electricity-stealing excavated based on power load Management System Data, the method comprises the following steps: 1) obtain the user's historical load data in power load Management System Data storehouse, and it is supplementary to carry out consolidation to missing data by Newton interpolating method; 2) arrange according to the historical load data sample after temporal regularity supplements consolidation, set up autoregressive moving-average model by Model Distinguish and parameter estimation, obtain short-term load forecasting equation, calculate short-term load forecasting value; 3) compare predicted load and actual acquisition value, judge whether active user exists stealing probable behavior, if, then send the alarm of " stealing possibility ", if not, then actual acquisition value is saved to power load Management System Data storehouse, returns step 1).Compared with prior art, the present invention have that precision of prediction is high, stealing suspicion screening accuracy advantages of higher.

title_en: The analysis method for reliability and device of operator's state estimation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of analysis method for reliability and device of operator's state estimation, wherein, this method includes：Multiple PSF to be used are determined, wherein, PSF is used for state estimation；Determine the incidence relation of the incidence relation and each PSF and state estimation reliability node between each PSF in multiple PSF and other PSF in addition to itself；Reliability analysis model based on the causal operator's state estimations of PSF is set up with the reliability of analysis operation personnel according to above-mentioned each incidence relation.By with the present invention, solve correlation technique and do not account for the operator influence of suffered situation envirment factor and their influence causality in itself, so as to bring the possibility for computing repeatedly its influence, the problem of estimation of mistake is likely to result in state estimation probability of failure, and then qualitative and quantitative method is provided for operator's state estimation fail-safe analysis, provide countermeasure for power plant's reduction operator's state estimation failure probability.

title_en: Assessment method of electric power system state estimation result accuracy based on cross entropy
abstract_en: The invention relates to an assessment method of electric power system state estimation result accuracy based on cross entropy and belongs to the technical field of electric power system dispatching automation and power grid emulation. All measured residual error numeral values are calculated firstly according to an electric power system state estimation result and a cross entropy evaluation function, corresponding to each measured residual error numeral value, in a negative index square mode is calculated; comprehensive average is conducted on all of the measured cross entropy evaluation functions and meanwhile, a zero injection evaluation criterion is introduced for examining whether zero injection constraint is satisfied or not, so that comprehensive evaluation of the accuracy of the electric power system state estimation is obtained. The theoretical foundation of the method is stricter, the zero injection constraint is considered and the zero injection constraint examining criterion is added. The compatibility of the method and a widely-used traditional acceptability criterion is good and the mode of percentage is adopted, so that the method is convenient to achieve.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Electric power system dynamic state estimation method based on synchronous phase-angle measuring device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power system operation and control and discloses an electric power system dynamic state estimation method based on a synchronous phase-angle measuring device. According to the technical scheme, the method comprises the steps of A, reading current network parameters of an electric power system and a network topological structure of the electric power system, and therefore forming a node admittance matrix and a branch-node incidence matrix; B, establishing an equivalent circuit according to the network topological structure of the electric power system, and configuring a measurement function of the electric power system and a PMU of the electric power system, wherein the measurement of the system comprises node voltage amplitude measurement, node current amplitude measurement, node power injection measurement and node load flow measurement; C, conducting dynamic state estimation on the system on the basis of extended Kalman filtering; D, judging conditions of convergence. According to the electric power system dynamic state estimation method based on the synchronous phase-angle measuring device, due to the introduction of the PMU, real-time and accurate measurement information such as the voltage and the phase angel can be supplied to the system, the higher measurement redundancy rate of the system is obtained, and therefore the precision of the state estimation is improved. The electric power system dynamic state estimation method based on the synchronous phase-angle measuring device has the advantages of being good in robustness, high in state estimation precision and good in convergence performance.
assignees: UNIV JIAOTONG SOUTHWEST

title_en: Method for setting measurement weight of state estimation of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a measurement weight setting method for power system state estimation, which puts forward that measurement errors and measurement types need to be considered when setting weights, and the measurement errors and the measurement types need to be considered according to variance sigma in the prior art 2 Multiplying the weight set by a type factor k w The invention divides the measurement into 3 types, which are voltage amplitude value measurement, branch power measurement and node injection power measurement. Through multiple tests, the type factor k of voltage measurement w The value range is 0.8-1.2; type factor k of node injection power measurement w Taking the weight of the mixture to be 2.5-3.5; type factor k for branch power measurement w The ratio is 8.5-11.5. The embodiment shows that the quantity weight setting method provided by the invention can obviously improve the accuracy of the state estimation of the power system. For an IEEE30 system, when each measurement has 1% error, the method of the invention is adopted to set the measurement weight, and the precision can be improved by 4.9%.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN MARITIME

title_en: Power grid energy management system (EMS) based on service component architecture
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid energy management system (EMS) based on service component architecture. Service units which form the EMS are divided into fine-grain atomic service units for sorting analysis, linear equation set solution, nonlinear equation set solution, optimal calculation and the like. Coarse-grain functional service units for real-time monitoring, history information management, model management, SCADA (Supervisory Control And Data Acquisition), IEEE model analysis, CIM (Common Information Model) model analysis, dispatching management, real-time dispatching, dispatching planning, automatic power generation control, safety evaluation, advanced application, dispatcher training simulation, topological analysis, state estimation, load flow calculation, optimal load flow and the like are formed through data exchange, analysis and processing among the atomic service units. Finally, the EMS with complete functions is formed by the function service units according to an agreed calling method. By dividing the EMS into the atomic service units, the extensibility, flexibility, openness and elasticity of the system are guaranteed and enough spaces are reserved for the development and upgrade of the EMS.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELEC POWER;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Identification method and system of element parameters and power correction factors of electric power system
abstract_en:
The invention proposes the discrimination methods and system of a kind of power system component parameter and corrected coefficient of power, comprising: inputs the active power telemetering steady-state value with the power grid of n element

 And voltage telemeering steady-state value
