An operation state estimation unit 11 estimates the state of how EV2, 4 are practically used, on the basis of the past operation performance data of EV2, 4. A charge amount prediction unit 14 predicts the amount of charges to EV2, 4 on a discretionary prediction day by simulating the practical use of EV2, 4 using the estimation result of the operation state estimation unit 11. A charging schedule creation unit 18 creates a charging schedule 19 for EV2, 4 on the prediction day so as to raise the utilization of photovoltaic power generation (PV).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: TOSHIBA CORP

title_en: Energy efficiency management service system of power distribution network area
abstract_en: The invention provides an energy efficiency management service system of a power distribution network area. Functional modules of the system mainly comprise six functional modules, namely a distribution network data acquisition and monitoring module, a power distribution network analysis and control module, a power distribution network automation module, an energy efficiency management module, a power distributing equipment evaluating module and an energy consumption optimization module. The energy efficiency management service system is characterized in that the distribution network data acquisition and monitoring module performs functions of data acquisition, data processing and service calculation; the power distribution network analysis and control module performs functions of network modeling and topology, state estimation, load prediction, power distribution network operation data statistics and analysis, micro-grid energy management and operation ticket management. The power distribution network automation module performs power distribution room automation and feed line automation. The energy efficiency management module performs energy consumption data acquisition, energy consumption data statistics, energy consumption data analysis, energy consumption data evaluation, energy consumption early-warning and energy consumption prediction. The system architecture of the energy efficiency management service system accords with a big data platform logic architecture and is a relatively good intelligent commodity power distribution network solution.
assignees: WUHAN NARI LTD LIABILITY CO OF STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: A kind of evaluation method and device of natural gas pipe network gas supplying reliability
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of evaluation methods and device of natural gas pipe network gas supplying reliability, are related to natural gas transmission technical field.Method includes：Establish the Capacity-network of gas distributing system；It determines first failure probability of each piping unit under each default failure mode, and determines first state distribution of each piping unit in a preset time；It determines the second failure probability of each natural gas station unit, and determines second state distribution of each natural gas station unit in a preset time；Capacity-network described in real-time update；Each user supply into gas distributing system determines the supply situation information of each user；The average deficency amount of the reliability and each user supplied to each user is determined according to the supply situation information of each user.Can be with the supply reliability of accurate evaluation gas distributing system under disturbance factor by the present invention, the supply quality for solving the problems, such as current natural gas pipe network is difficult to confirm.

title_en: Distribution network state estimation method based on semi-definite programming
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network state estimation method based on semi-definite programming. The method is characterized by comprising the following steps of step 1 establishing a mathematical description of a WLS (Weighted Least Squares) estimation problem; step 2 establishing a semi-definite programming model of the WLS estimation problem; step 3 determining a coefficient matrix of the semi-definite programming model; and step 4 solving. The distribution network state estimation method based on semi-definite programming has super-linear convergence and good precision, a computed result thereof is consistent to a computed result of the general WLS method, the obtained solution can be guaranteed to be globally optimal, the storage efficiency is improved and the computation complexity is greatly reduced.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO WEIFANG POWER SUPPLY CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;SHANGHAI SAILING INFORMATION TECH DEV CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for establishing quantitative relationship of general power line loss rate influencing factors
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for establishing quantitative relationship of general power line loss rate influencing factors, and the method comprises the following steps: obtaining the original indicator data which influence the general power line loss rate; verifying and correcting the anomaly data and missing data in the original indicator data in and conducting a smooth and stable process to these data; verifying the processed data to determine a model; introducing an adjustment effect by regarding other variables except investment that affect the line loss rate as regulatory variables; using a panel data model to fit the data and using the significance of the variable coefficient as the judging criterion to discard variables that do not pass the significance test and to re-fit the remaining variables so that after several rounds of significance test, all variables pass the significance test; and after several times of fitting and screening, outputting the quantitative relationship between the general power line loss rate and various indicator data.
assignees: BEISE POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD;HUBEI STATE GRID HUAZHONG TECH DEV CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent power distribution network situation perception method based on multivariate time-space information modeling
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent power distribution network situation perception method based on multivariate spatio-temporal information modeling, which is used for perception of the situation of an intelligent power distribution network for the first time, and aims to deeply excavate and effectively utilize state information and measurement information of the power network in consideration of the development of potential connection and inherent characteristics of the power network; meanwhile, the node voltage amplitude and the node voltage phase angle with higher precision obtained by modeling are used as virtual measurement information, so that the measurement redundancy of the power distribution network is increased, the convergence speed and the convergence precision of state estimation of the power distribution network are improved, the state estimation time is shortened, and the possibility is provided for online estimation of the intelligent power distribution network; finally, safety and stability analysis is carried out on the real-time state and the future state of the power distribution network, potential risks of the power distribution network at the future moment are pre-judged, and reference is provided for system scheduling and system decision.

title_en: Main and distribution network integrated distributed state estimation method based on two-stage method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a main and distribution network integrated distributed state estimation method based on a two-stage method, which comprises the following steps: establishing a main and distribution network integrated state estimation model; decoupling a distribution network model of the integrated state estimation model of the main distribution network into a plurality of subsystems; establishing a linear relation between the state quantity of the main and distribution networks before decoupling and the state quantity in the decoupled subsystem; independently carrying out state estimation on the decoupled subsystems in a distributed mode; and establishing a state estimation model for state estimation by taking the linear relation of the state quantities of the main network and the distribution network before and after decoupling as a measurement equation to obtain the integrated state of the main network and the distribution network. The method provided by the invention reduces the calculated amount, effectively and accurately solves the problem of the disaster of the integrated state estimation dimension of the main network and the distribution network caused by the huge network scale of the distribution network, can obtain the consistent and accurate real-time state of the main network and the distribution network, provides basic data for the analysis and calculation of the integration of the main network and the distribution network, and further improves the operation reliability of the integration of the main network and the distribution network.

title_en: Hyperbolic tangent robust state estimation method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the electric power system scheduling automation field, especially relates to a hyperbolic tangent robust state estimation method. The hyperbolic tangent robust state estimation method comprises the steps that a hyperbolic tangent robust state estimation basic model is established, and by using a primal-dual interior point algorithm, the hyperbolic tangent robust state estimation is solved. The hyperbolic tangent robust state estimation method is advantageous in that strong robust performance and high calculation efficiency are provided, and leverage point adverse data is inhibited, and a good engineering application prospect is provided.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: A kind of electric-thermal coupling multipotency flow network method for estimating state
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of electric-thermals to couple multipotency flow network method for estimating state, belongs to the operation and control technology field of integrated energy system.This method compensates for blank of the heat supply network in terms of state estimation, forms a kind of electric-thermal coupling multipotency stream mode estimation for considering coupled relation between power grid and heat supply network.Compared with independent state estimation, this method is conducive to improve the estimation effect of network, and especially in the case where electric-thermal coupling multipotency flow network port measures inaccuracy, this method has apparent superiority.The automatization level of heat supply network is not able to satisfy the demand of this method even at present, and the application of this method needs to install more measurement facilities in heat supply network.Success is after electric-thermal couples multipotency flow network application this method, the available higher globally consistent ground state flow solution of precision, couples the assessment of multipotency flow network safety on line for subsequent electric-thermal, Optimized Operation lays the foundation.

title_en: Power construction main body benefit analysis method based on PCA-DEA two-dimensional comprehensive evaluation model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power construction main body benefit analysis method based on a PCA-DEA (Principal Component Analysis-Data Envelopment Analysis) two-dimensional comprehensive evaluation model, comprising sample data pre-processing, and rejecting samples including abnormal data and missing data; utilizing a PCA method to screen principal component indexes from original sample data, and analyzing the internal resource transfer ability of power construction enterprises; using the principal component indexes as operating variables, selecting an input index and an output index, and using a DEA method to compare and analyze benefits among the power construction enterprises; and comparing evaluation results of two methods, respectively using a DEA evaluation value and a PCA evaluation value as an x-axis and a y-axis to establish a two-dimensional coordinate, and comprehensively evaluating and analyzing a power construction main body. The power construction main body benefit analysis method is simple and practical, and can be used as a main base for evaluating enterprise competitiveness and enterprise benefit distribution in a whole market, and provide a practical side reference for the integral analysis of an electric power engineering market.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: A kind of redundancy electrodynamic pump ontology failure monitoring reliability method based on fault tree
abstract_en: The redundancy electrodynamic pump ontology failure monitoring reliability method based on fault tree that the present invention is to provide a kind of.Step 1: the monitoring information of online acquisition redundancy pump, constitute a status monitoring sign space Ω, step 2: the state of online recognition redundancy electrodynamic pump, step 3: redundancy electrodynamic pump reliability model of the online updating based on modularization fault tree, step 4: in the reliability of redundancy electrodynamic pump subsystem of the line computation based on fault tree.The present invention can overcome the shortcomings of conventional failure tree method in terms of the apparatus body state of modelling redundancy electrodynamic pump and online updating.It effectively reduces the scale of redundant system logic fault tree and simplifies modeling process, reduce the development cost of model.The existing modeling software based on fault tree can be made full use of, convenient for being received by nuclear power engineering and application personnel, is convenient for Project Realization.

title_en: Electric power system state estimation device, electric power system state estimation program, and electric power system state estimation method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To execute state estimation processing of a power system without interruptions even when system information includes an erroneous measurement result.SOLUTION: The electric power system state estimation device includes: a state estimation part for estimating a state of an electric power system on the basis of a plurality of values showing a state of an electric power system and a plurality of coefficients defined for each of the plurality of values; an error determination part for determining whether or not each of the plurality of values is erroneous on the basis of an estimation result of the state estimation part and the plurality of values; an output part for outputting, as the plurality of values, a first value determined to be not erroneous of the plurality of values and a predetermined third value defined correspondingly to a second value determined to be erroneous when any of the plurality of values is determined to be erroneous; and an efficient output part for outputting, as the plurality of coefficients, the first coefficient corresponding to the first value of the plurality of values and a third coefficient formed by changing the second coefficient corresponding to the second value so that an estimation result of the state estimation part obtained on the basis of the third value is the third value when any of the plurality of values is determined to be erroneous.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: FUJI ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: A kind of power distribution network intelligent diagnosis system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of power distribution network intelligent diagnosis system, including following functions module: status information of equipment acquisition module, status information of equipment ETL module, smart machine state estimation module, equipment state management module, Maintenance Schedule Optimization module, result output module, smart machine state estimation module is according to the various status informations of Distribution Network Equipment, analytical data feature, equipment state is defined the level, and passage combines new status information of equipment and deduces equipment state over time.System uses intelligent evaluation, machine learning, the Internet, database technology, equipment various to distribution are monitored in real time and assess, remind staff to carry out and make an inspection tour service work targetedly, improve the initiative making an inspection tour service work, and tour repair schedule can be generated, and the maintenance material list of correspondence and service kit inventory, instruct constituent parts to carry out service work, help people to improve tour overhaul efficiency and quality.
assignees: JINAN LICHENG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Electric power system state estimation device, electric power system state estimation program, and electric power system state estimation method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an electric power system state estimation device which narrows down erroneous information even if redundancy of measuring points is insufficient.SOLUTION: An electric power system state estimation device 10 comprises: a first state estimation unit which estimates a state of a power system on the basis of measured system information indicating a power system state; a first determination unit which determines whether the system information has an error or not on the basis of the estimation result of the first state estimation unit; an error identification unit which performs, when an error is determined, a process of identifying the error on the basis of the estimation result; a second state estimation unit which estimates, when the error is not identified, a voltage phase angle of the power system on the basis of an active power and a voltage phase angle and a voltage swing of the power system on the basis of a reactive power and a voltage swing; and a second determination unit which determines whether the measured voltage phase angle is wrong or not on the basis of the estimated voltage phase angle of the power system, and whether the measured voltage swing is wrong or not on the basis of the estimated voltage swing of the power system.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: FUJI ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Non-perfect losses of distribution network appraisal procedure based on least square fitting method under information
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of non-perfect losses of distribution network appraisal procedure based on least square fitting method under information, first collect power distribution network topological structure parameter, data measured by Substation SCADA System, data measured by SCADA system are done identification and the detection of bad data, to missing data in data measured by SCADA system and error larger data, data interpolating is used to process with least square data fitting method, data after data interpolating processes with least square data fitting method are carried out Load flow calculation, the last power distribution network operational factor obtained according to Load flow calculation, using feeder line as elementary cell, the loss on this section of feeder line is calculated by the active power of each bus on feeder line, thus calculate the loss of whole power distribution network.Instant invention overcomes existing Line Loss of Distribution Network System rate computational methods, the shortcoming that error calculated is big, amount of calculation is big.
assignees: NANRUI (WUHAN) ELECTRICAL EQUIPMENT AND ENG ENERGY EFFICIENCY EVALUATION CENTER;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;NANJING NARI GROUP CORP;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Micro-capacitance sensor method for estimating state based on converter Control characteristic
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of micro-capacitance sensor method for estimating state based on converter Control characteristic.Initially set up the steady-state model of each element in alternating current-direct current series-parallel connection micro-capacitance sensor, sagging (Droop) control type DG running status is added in the state variable of state estimation, and configure corresponding pseudo-measurement to ensure the observability of state estimation；Secondly, in view of nonlinear function complicated between branch current magnitudes and three-phase node voltage, propose a kind of Techniques for Converting Measurements based on branch power, simplify the calculating of Jacobian matrix；Finally, weighted least square is used to solve the state estimation model of proposed alternating current-direct current series-parallel connection micro-capacitance sensor.The present invention can effectively process the state estimation problem under grid-connected/two kinds of isolated island method of operation of the alternating current-direct current series-parallel connection micro-capacitance sensor containing Droop control type DG, and consider wherein converter Control characteristic and micro-capacitance sensor islet operation characteristic, there is the calculating fast and accurate feature of speed, have good engineer applied to be worth.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Power grid parameter identification method based on particle swarm optimization algorithm and local state estimation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power grid basic parameter identification and estimation, and particularly relates to a power grid parameter identification method based on a particle swarm optimization algorithm and local state estimation. Based on the characteristic that different parameters have errors, the state estimation objective function value is increased, the adjustment quantity of the suspicious parameters is optimized by using a particle swarm optimization algorithm, the adjustment quantity of the suspicious parameters with the minimum corresponding evaluation indexes is finally determined, and the adjustment of the suspicious parameters is realized. The invention is used for adjusting suspicious parameters generated in the operation process of the power grid, providing reliable original data for executing various EMS application module functions, correcting suspicious element parameters generated due to deviation or error of a power grid model in the actual power grid by using a modern optimization algorithm, ensuring the accuracy of basic parameters of the operation of the power grid, and simultaneously improving the practicability level of various advanced analysis and application of the EMS of the power dispatching control center and the accuracy, reliability and precision of the power dispatching control.

title_en: Emergency mapping system
abstract_en: A unified, weighted, and common language mapping system and method for disaster response is described, with the ability to overlay infrastructure damage, responder assets, data source, and weighting factors including the ability to redact such maps for dissemination to media, the public, or the like. The system and method described herein also enable the real-time updating of maps with social media information and the like.
assignees: AVAYA INC

title_en: Boiler combustion optimization air distribution method based on online model prediction
abstract_en: Provided is a boiler combustion optimization air distribution method based on online model prediction. The method includes: constructing a boiler combustion optimization air distribution model by employing an improved BP neural network algorithm and model online update calculation; and performing optimization calculation on parameters such as the optimal oxygen amount, the primary air amount, each secondary air door and a burnout air door etc. with the combination of an adaptive genetic algorithm and dynamic optimization boundary so that a multi-target function constructed by the boiler efficiency and the pollutant discharge capacity reaches the optimal combustion range.
assignees: XI'AN IBL TECH DEV CO LTD

title_en: A kind of adaptive robust state estimation method of the power distribution network of parallel computation and device
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of adaptive robust state estimation method of the power distribution network of parallel computation and devices, comprising: carries out subregion to network and obtains network sub-district；The network is decoupled by parallel computation processing；State estimation is carried out using method for estimating state corresponding with the sub-district according to the real-time amount measuring point in network sub-district；The state estimation result of network is exported according to the state estimation result of the network sub-district.The present invention, which is realized, carries out subregion to network, can relatively easily be deployed in multiple stage computers, carry out distributed parallel state estimation, can guarantee faster speed；And the method for estimating state for being suitable for the sub-district is chosen according to sub-district, it is ensured that the accuracy and reliability of state estimation result.

title_en: Method for correcting missing data in intelligent power utilization based on two-stage interpolation model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for correcting missing data in intelligent power utilization based on a two-stage interpolation model, and the method is characterized in that the method comprises the steps: firstly selecting power users with at most one missing item at a first stage, calculating a plurality of candidate interpolation values for each missing item of the power users through employing a PMM regression model based on chain-type equation multiple interpolation, and then calculating a unique final interpolation value through employing a linear regression model; secondly calculating the interpolation values of the missing data of the remaining power users at the second stage through employing a linear interpolation method; finally integrating the results at the two stages, and obtaining the complete intelligent power utilization of all power users. The method can achieve the more precise correction of the missing data in intelligent power utilization, effectively reduces the calculation complexity, can quickly complete the interpolation of a sparse data set with missing variables, and is good in stability.
assignees: UNIV HEFEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Electric power engineering construction quality monitored control system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electric power engineering construction quality monitored control system, including monitor platform, data information acquisition module and video information acquisition module, be equipped with the server in the monitor platform, the server is connected with storage module, display module, alarm device respectively, data information acquisition module includes microprocessor, microprocessor passes through router connection service ware, radio frequency identification unit and image acquisition unit link to each other with microprocessor respectively, the video information acquisition module includes unmanned aerial vehicle, unmanned aerial vehicle passes through the zigbee transceiver and connects the basic station server. The utility model discloses can reduce staff's working strength in real time to electric power engineering construction quality's control, have higher security and practicality, can carry out real time monitoring to the real -time update of power equipment data, the staff has realized the comprehensive control to electric power engineering construction quality through the video information that unmanned aerial vehicle acquireed electric power engineering construction region.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANDONG PROVINCE HUIMIN COUNTY POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Power use state estimation method, power use state estimation device, and program
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a power use state estimation method, a power use state estimation device, and a program with which it is possible to improve the accuracy of FHMM learning results.SOLUTION: The power use state estimation method includes parameter estimation steps (S13, S14) for estimating a model parameter when the operating states of a plurality of electric apparatuses connected to a power distribution board are modeled by a probability model using the total value of power consumption by the plurality of electric apparatuses. In the parameter estimation steps (S13, S14), a model parameter with which the likelihood calculated by a likelihood function becomes maximum is estimated on the basis of the features of power data that can be previously determined as prior knowledge from the operation tendency of each of the plurality of electric apparatuses, the probability model being a Factorial Hidden Markov Model (FHMM), the likelihood being a value indicating the likelihood of the pattern of the total value of power consumption by the plurality of electric apparatuses modeled by the FHMM to the total value of the actual power consumption.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3A
assignees: PANASONIC IP CORP AMERICA

title_en: A kind of three-dimensional digital electrical network intelligent patrol system
abstract_en: A kind of three-dimensional digital electrical network intelligent patrol system, including teledata platform, client, control end and makes an inspection tour end., using 4D Display Techniques by three-dimensional digital electrical network map real-time update to teledata platform, intuitive is strong for the present invention, informative comprehensively, the electrical network operation/maintenance data for obtaining is true, accurately, image and directly perceived.The present invention using client, control end and makes an inspection tour end, enables tour data accurately to push to client and control end in real time.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;ZIBO POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: The constraint GPC optimal control method of multi-region interconnected electric power system LOAD FREQUENCY
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of constraint GPC optimal control method of multi-region interconnected electric power system LOAD FREQUENCY, the controlled autoregressive integrated moving average model of multi-region interconnected electric power system LOAD FREQUENCY is established by small signal mechanism method for analyzing and modeling and transform, using constraint generalized predictive control as control method, by the square value of error between system prediction output and reference locus, the weighted value of this three of the square value and the square value of control output of controller output increment is as optimization object function, and design the online rolling optimization of efficient adaptive Evolutionary optimization solver realization constraint GPC a kind of, the each variable of real-time update system is to realize LOAD FREQUENCY optimal control.Using the achievable multi-region interconnected electric power system LOAD FREQUENCY optimal control effect of the present invention, there is more excellent steady-state performance and dynamic property and more healthy and stronger robustness compared with prior art.

title_en: Power distribution system state estimation device and power distribution system state estimation method
abstract_en: The power distribution system management device according to the present invention includes a communication unit that receives measurement values from a plurality of high-voltage sensors that each measure a voltage and a power flow of a power distribution line in a high-voltage system, and receives, from a plurality of smart meters that each measure an amount of power, information on the amount of power; and a voltage control unit that sections the power distribution line between two high-voltage sensors among the plurality of high-voltage sensors into a plurality of sections to estimate a voltage distribution along the power distribution line based on two of the measurement values received from the two high-voltage sensors and on the amount of power of each of the sections.
assignees: MITSUBISHI ELECTRIC CORP

title_en: Power grid user power consumption curve data filling method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for filling power consumption curve data of a power grid user, wherein the method comprises the steps of estimating a line loss rate according to the state of a transformer area line T and estimating missing user power data according to the state of a user day curve; and fine-tuning the estimated line loss rate value and the estimated missing user power value to fill up the missing data. The apparatus comprises an estimation unit and an adjustment unit. The technical scheme provided by the invention fills data in a longitudinal and transverse combination mode and carries out fine adjustment, so that a better and more stable result can be obtained, and the correctness of curve data filling is improved.

title_en: A kind of State Estimation for Distribution Network measuring characteristic based on AMI
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of State Estimation for Distribution Network measuring characteristic based on AMI, including：(1) system model, parameter are determined according to distribution net work structure, according to the characteristic of different measurements, is measured using the SCADA in typical day load curve and trend true-value simulation system and AMI is measured；(2) delay disposal is carried out to AMI metric data；(3) period that state of electric distribution network is estimated in the case that SCADA is measured and AMI metric data coordinates is determined；(4) determined by step (2) and step (3) on the basis of metric data, state estimation is carried out to power distribution network, determines the operating status of system.The present invention considers that the measurement characteristic of AMI proposes the delay of AMI metric data and the solution with the SCADA data measurement period the problems such as inconsistent in state estimation comprehensively, realizes the state of electric distribution network estimation of comprehensive utilization SCADA and AMI metric data.

title_en: A kind of electric power system model based on multi-layer Fuzzy method and quality testing method
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of electric power system model based on multi-layer Fuzzy method and quality testing method, by obtaining power system basic model and data, obtains power system Back ground Information；Set up the mutiple-stage model index factor collection of power system Back ground Information；Weight distribution is carried out to mutiple-stage model index factor collection, mutiple-stage model index system is obtained；Fuzzy mathematics calculating is carried out to mutiple-stage model index system, Fuzzy comprehensive evaluation result is obtained；And then power system basic model and data are estimated.Method proposed by the present invention effectively prevent Back ground Information influence of the missing to overall data quality evaluation, solve state estimation can not flexibly and multi-angle evaluation power system basic data quality present situation；For electric power system model and the quality of data provide accurate and effectively evaluating result and amendment scheme, integrality, correctness and the accuracy of archetype and data are improved；And then ensure that the stable operation of power system.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;JINZHOU ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Bilinear WLAV (weighted least absolute value) state estimation method with equality constraints considered
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bilinear WLAV (weighted least absolute value) state estimation method with equality constraints considered; given that power mismatch of a zero injection node has important influence on power system safety estimation, zero injection constraint is added to bilinear WLAV state estimation in equality constraint form; the method retains the original high calculating efficiency of bilinear WLAV state estimation, may also reduce the power mismatch of the zero injection node and has partly improved robust performance; it is verified based on IEEE (Institute of Electrical and Electronic Engineers) standard system and simulation results for an actual province-level network of China that the method is effective in reducing power mismatch of a zero injection node.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Power transmission cable synthetical condition assessment method and system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of power transmission cable synthetical condition assessment method and system, its method includes：The related service data of each cable assembly of power transmission cable is obtained, the membership function value of each state grade of each evaluation status amount is determined according to related service data；Obtain the weighted value of each evaluation status amount；Each membership function value after treatment is weighted is weighted to the membership function value of each state grade of each evaluation status amount according to weighted value；Each membership function value after confidence level coefficient corrects weighting respectively, obtains each state grade and probabilistic confidence level functional value of each evaluation status amount；Each state grade and probabilistic confidence level functional value to each evaluation status amount carry out synthesis treatment, obtain each state grade and probabilistic confidence level functional value of power transmission cable and then the comprehensive state of determination power transmission cable.Using the solution of the present invention, the accuracy and confidence level of power transmission cable state estimation can be lifted.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU;UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: Consider the method for estimating state of outer net extended Ward equivalent
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is directed to the deficiency of existing consideration outer net State Estimation Study method, it is proposed that a kind of method for estimating state of consideration outer net extended Ward equivalent.Specific steps include：Read in the parameter and SCADA metric data of power network；Extended Ward equivalent model is constructed with reference to the outer net typical section network information；Consider outer net extension Ward models, form new measurement information；The weighted least-squares state estimation with equality constraint is individually carried out to Intranet.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: A kind of management method of distributed network equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of management method of distributed network equipment, the reliability for solving network device management in wireless communication system is low, poor synchronization, the weak problem of long-distance disaster ability.Methods described is to dispose many ZooKeeper servers in a local network, multimachine is formed cluster using the characteristic of ZooKeeper；Corresponding network equipment client is disposed in the network equipment to be monitored, and node data model is created to ZooKeeper servers, according to the data real-time update nodal information that internal network is received；Monitor these node data models at Web server end, the node data information Store for getting in Web server, for foreground access.By the way that to transmitting the synchronization for realizing data on node data model, the monitoring of real time data and statistics, the present invention has good autgmentability and stability.
assignees: HEBEI FAREAST COMMUNICATION SYSTEM ENG CO LTD

title_en: It is a kind of to process the power network Fast decoupled state estimation method that branch current is measured
abstract_en: The power network Fast decoupled state estimation method that branch current is measured is processed the present invention relates to a kind of, overcoming existing Fast decoupled state estimation technology cannot process the shortcoming and deficiency of current measurement, current measurement is expressed using the active power and reactive power loss of branch road, without being directly formed branch current measurement, so that new property of the measurement with algorithm quicksort, so as to produce the characteristic of a small amount of computation burden and Fast Convergent, it is suitable for the extensive Power Network Status Estimation containing branch current measurement.
assignees: STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: The term load forecasting for distribution and device of a kind of meter and photovoltaic
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a kind of meter and the term load forecasting for distribution and device of photovoltaic, the load bus for solving existing power distribution network is numerous, if all individually predictions, computationally intensive, with error accumulation effect；If the load of whole region is superimposed be predicted, the otherness of different load characteristic, precision of prediction technical problem not high are have ignored.A kind of meter of the embodiment of the present invention and the term load forecasting for distribution of photovoltaic include：S1：The missing data and bad data of the net load power data constituted to distributed photovoltaic and network load are pre-processed；S2：The net load power data that will meet predetermined condition by fuzzy C-means clustering method is divided into 5 cluster loads；S3：Clustering load to each respectively by the short-term load forecasting method based on similar day and SVMs carries out load prediction, and the load prediction results of each cluster load are overlapped.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Power storage system management device, power storage system management method, power storage system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To optimally perform an operation management of a BESS (Battery Energy Storage System) in accordance with a deterioration state of a secondary battery.SOLUTION: In a BESS management device 7, a hysteresis database 71 stores operation hysteresis data relating to operation hysteresis of a BESS and a price hysteresis data of a service. A state estimation part 72 estimates a charging state and a deterioration state of a battery. A simulation part 73 calculates actual score of the BESS with respect to the provision of the service on the basis of the operation hysteresis data stored in the hysteresis database 71 and the charging state and the deterioration state of the battery which are estimated by the state estimation part 72. A price prediction part 74 calculates a price prediction value of the service on the basis of the price hysteresis data stored in the hysteresis database 71. A control parameter selection part 75 selects a control parameter for controlling the operation of the BESS on the basis of the actual score and the price prediction value.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2
assignees: HITACHI LTD

title_en: A kind of photovoltaic generation multi-stage combination status assessing system and appraisal procedure
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of photovoltaic generation multi-stage combination status assessing system and appraisal procedure, assessment system includes data monitoring and acquisition module, intensive data memory module, historical data excavates module, key equipment state dynamic evaluation module, photo-voltaic power generation station real-time status estimation module, photo-voltaic power generation station state prediction module and control centre's the whole network state estimation module, the present invention from estimate two dimensions of object and time, can realize that the accurate status containing generation of electricity by new energy power network are assessed, realize ONLINE RECOGNITION and the amendment of photovoltaic generation model parameter, the real-time regulation performance of accurate evaluation photo-voltaic power generation station grasps its dynamic support ability to power network.In Object Dimension, using the hierarchy state estimation of photo-voltaic power generation station control centre two-layer, the cooperation state estimation of photovoltaic electrification component, photovoltaic generation unit, photo-voltaic power generation station and power network can be realized；In time dimension, the linking of the different time category information such as historical data, real time data and prediction data should be realized.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: A kind of fire disaster emergency rescue skills
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of fire disaster emergency rescue skills, including：Room area and outdoor area are divided according to urban geographic information, network model is set up to outdoor area, grid model is set up to room area, the grid model and the network model are combined as network of network model；The information that fire incident is met an urgent need a little is determined on the network of network model, and determines to rescue the information of resource and/or the information of Evacuation area；The parameter of network of network model described in real-time update；Resource Allocation Formula and rescue and/or evacuation route are rescued according to the parameter determination of the network of network model according to the emergent demand.Resource dispatching model of the invention is studied in solid space, solves the scheduling for concentrating on and resource and vehicle being carried out in plane coordinates.Set up on the basis of many emergency events simultaneously, solve the unbalanced shortcoming of single emergent scheduling of resource.
assignees: LI HONGGA

title_en: A kind of SINS Initial Alignment of Large Azimuth Misalignment On methods based on KF and STUPF combined filters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of SINS Initial Alignment of Large Azimuth Misalignment On methods based on KF and STUPF combined filters, nonlinear initial alignment Filtering Model under large misalignment angle is decomposed into linearity and non-linearity two parts, the state equation and measurement equation of linear filtering model discretization are established, is processed using Kalman filtering；With reference to the state equation and measurement equation of linear segment, the observed quantity of non-linear partial is obtained, and then set up the initial Filtering Model for being directed at non-linear partial discretization, state estimation is carried out using the UPF filtering of strong tracking, obtain the estimate of misalignment.The present invention is based on KF and STUPF combined filter algorithms, both ensure that initial alignment precision, and filter status dimension is reduced again, avoid dimension disaster, computationally intensive, poor real deficiency is overcome, the real-time of initial alignment is improved while initial alignment precision is ensured, with practical value.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: A kind of enhancing virtual reality method for electricity substation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of enhancing virtual reality method for electricity substation, on the basis of transformer station's virtual reality scenario is set up, during the information of real physical world further incorporated into virtual reality scenario, enhancing virtual reality is realized.By receiving electric power data storehouse information, can in virtual reality system interactive display current transformer substation and its equipment working condition；By the monitoring information for importing transformer station's multi-camera system, the corresponding dummy model of the moving target for entering transformer station place can be realized being laid in virtual reality scenario, and its position of real-time update, its movement locus is shown, and safety alarm is sent according to its residing region.
assignees: HANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID ZHENGJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV XIAN JIAOTONG

title_en: A kind of power distribution network distributed parallel method for estimating state and device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of power distribution network distributed parallel method for estimating state and device, methods described includes：Network partition is carried out to power distribution network using Lagrangian relaxation technology；Network decoupling is carried out to all subregion, the boundary condition of all subregion is determined；Carry out state estimation parallel to all subregion, update the boundary condition of all subregion；The technical scheme that the present invention is provided, network auto-partition is realized by Lagrangian relaxation technology, and zone Divided Parallel Calculation is realized by interregional decoupling method, so as to develop a set of suitable power distribution network feature, the less state of electric distribution network of data dependence with stronger concurrency between task estimate Parallel implementation algorithm.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: A kind of plant stand bad data detection and device based on multisource data fusion
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of plant stand bad data detection and device based on multisource data fusion, belongs to computer software and power system automation technology field.The present invention is based on the steady state datas of substation, construct the detection model of substation's corresponding data identification main body；According to the detection model of constructed different data identification main body, the identification rule of corresponding raw data detection model is formulated；PMU dynamic data is merged, is judged using accuracy of the identification rule to measuring value and/or quantity of state that the detection model for participating in identification main body calculates, to determine the quality and estimated value of measuring value and/or quantity of state.The present invention constructs substation's raw data detection model according to the steady state data of substation；Merge substation PMU dynamic data, the verification of building substation's bad data and evaluation mechanism；To realize that covering substation equipment measures, the automatic of the bad data of equipment state detects and state estimation, the accuracy sent on plant stand end data is improved.

title_en: Method for filtering SCADA bad data of electric power system based on reactive power loss
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for filtering SCADA bad data of an electric power system based on reactive power loss, which comprises the steps of solving the reactive power loss on a line or a transformer in each time period according to the reactive power in SCADA measurement data at two ends of the line or the transformer, and further solving the average value and the standard deviation of the reactive power loss in N time periods; and defining the length of a confidence interval of the reactive power loss, obtaining the confidence interval of the measured data of a corresponding time period of a certain line according to the length of the confidence interval, the average value and the standard deviation of the reactive power loss of the N time periods, and removing the measured data distributed outside the confidence interval. Compared with the existing measured data eliminating method, the method is simple and convenient, does not need to establish a complex nonlinear equation, is high in execution speed, can be applied to actual engineering, can be used for preprocessing measured data, and improves the accuracy of state estimation, load flow calculation and the like.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: A method for recognizing contingencies in a power supply network
abstract_en: A monitoring system adapted to recognize a contingency in a power supply network, PSN, (2), the monitoring system (1) comprising in-field measurement devices (3) adapted to generate measurement data (MD) of said power supply network (2) and a processing unit (4) adapted to process the measurement data (MD) generated by the in-field measurement devices (3) of said power supply network (2) by using a local network state estimation model (LNSM) to calculate local network state profiles (LNSPs) used to generate a global network state profile (GNSP), wherein said processing unit (4) is further adapted to process the measurement data (MD) generated by the in-field measurement devices (3) of said power supply network (2) to provide a relevance profile (RP) comprising for the in-field measurement devices (3) a relevance distribution indicating a probability where the origin of a contingency within the power supply network, PSN, (2) resides, wherein the processing unit (4) is further adapted to compute a similarity between a candidate contingency profile (CCP) formed by the generated global network state profile (GNSP) and by the calculated relevance profile (RP) and reference contingency profiles, rCP, stored in a reference contingency database (5) of said monitoring system (1) to identify the reference contingency profile, rCP, having the highest computed similarity as the recognized contingency within the power supply network, PSN, (2).

title_en: Missing data supplementing method and device for scheduling simulation system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a missing data supplementing method and device for a dispatching simulation system, relates to the technical field of information power system simulation, and is used for supplementing missing data when data is missing in active power values of partial branches of a power grid dispatching simulation system with RTDS as a data source. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring branch parameters of branches in a high-voltage transmission network; setting the branch with the parameter lacking active power value as the branch to be solved; and constructing an independent loop equation corresponding to the independent loop containing the branch to be solved and a node current balance equation corresponding to the bus node containing the branch to be solved based on the branch parameter of the branch in the high-voltage transmission network, and solving the independent loop equation and the node current balance equation simultaneously to obtain the active power value of the branch to be solved.

title_en: A kind of fire early warning and fire control unit and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of fire early warning and fire control unit and methods, are applied to battery case or supercapacitor case, including control module, and, detection module, including at least one sensor, for acquiring the environmental data in battery case or supercapacitor case；The output of sensor is connected to the input of control module, and control module carries out fault detection to detection module, and when detecting failure, closes corresponding sensor and/or output alarm command；The control module handles received data, to export the signal of alarm command and/or starting fire extinguishing according to the condition of a disaster information.The present invention can cause the protection to battery case or supercapacitor case to be failed to avoid because of sensor failure.

title_en: The distribution net equipment state evaluation system analyzed based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of distribution net equipment state evaluation system analyzed based on big data, it is related to distribution net equipment detection technique field.Described distribution net equipment state evaluation system, using big data analytical technology, and combine it with state estimation technology, expert system technology, on-line monitoring technique, health status to distribution net equipment is estimated, comprehensive assessment timely and accurately is carried out to the health status and reliability of distribution key equipment in each critical stage, detect and repair in time according to assessment result, it is ensured that the safe and reliable operation of distribution key equipment, make the work that network system is more safe and stable；The distribution net equipment state evaluation system makes condition evaluation results and the state outcome of actual distribution net equipment be consistent by proof of algorithm, improve the state estimation accuracy rate of distribution net equipment state evaluation system, in time, accurately overhauled so as to staff, improve operating efficiency, reduce the further deterioration of distribution net equipment, it is ensured that the safety of network system.

title_en: A kind of electric power system robust state estimation method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the present invention provides a kind of electric power system robust state estimation method and device based on piecewise nonlinear weight function, and method includes building the bus admittance matrix of power system, measurement measurement equation and zero injection equality constraint；The Jacobian matrix and measurement residual error of power system are calculated, the weight of each measurement is obtained；State variable is updated, and judges whether iterative algorithm reaches convergence threshold, if then obtaining the node voltage amplitude and phase of final power system.The present invention carries out bad data detection and identification and state estimation simultaneously, while state estimation is calculated, can change measurement weight, bad data weight is constantly reduced in iteration, suppress the influence that bad data is brought, effectively reduce amount of calculation, improve operating efficiency；And directly bring the residual error of measurement into segmentation nonlinear weight function, it is to avoid and the calculating of standardized residual, calculating speed can be greatly promoted, the calculating time is saved, is very suitable for engineer applied.

title_en: It is a kind of containing public supply mains node water requirement inversion method of the large user with water information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of containing public supply mains node water requirement inversion method of the large user with water information.By introducing water supply network large user's water requirement information, node water requirement inversion accuracy is improved, is water supply network modeling, stress management etc. provides scientific basis.Step is as follows：(1) data assimilation is carried out to pressure monitoring information, monitoring point of fixing a breakdown is smoothed to normal data of monitoring point；(2) node water requirement to be allocated is initialized, loop approach is carried out, contrastive detection point measured data calculates adjustment result error amount；(3) sensitivity coefficient matrix of monitoring point pressure and flow on node water requirement under current state is calculated, utilize large user's water consumption measured data, by solving system of linear equations, node water requirement adjustment direction and step-length, progressive updating node water requirement are obtained；(4) error amount of current adjustment result is calculated, iteration is terminated when error amount is less than permissible value, otherwise, return to step (3) continues to calculate.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Singular value decomposition CDKF-based power system dynamic state estimation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system dynamic state estimation method based on singular value decomposition (CDKF). The method comprises the steps of firstly, introducing singular value decomposition, namely SVD technology into a central differential filtering CDKF, replacing Cholesky decomposition on a covariance matrix in the CDKF with singular value decomposition, then, with the help of a Stering difference formula, using a polynomial to approximate derivation operation of a nonlinear function, and using the central differential formula to replace a first-order derivation formula and a second-order derivation formula in a Taylor expansion formula. The method solves the problem of uncertain covariance matrix caused by calculation error and rounding error, enhances the numerical stability of the method, avoids complex derivation operation, and has the advantages of simple calculation, simple and convenient parameter adjustment and high filtering precision. The result shows that the numerical stability of the method is superior to that of a square root form method, and the filtering precision is superior to that of an extended Kalman filtering method and an unscented Kalman filtering method.

title_en: The evaluation method and power transmission and transforming equipment of a kind of dynamic evaluation transformer equipment state
abstract_en: The invention provides a kind of evaluation method of dynamic evaluation transformer equipment state, comprise the following steps：Count the historical data of each quantity of state of transformer equipment；Based on the historical data of each quantity of state, the importance of each quantity of state is calculated using random forests algorithm；The importance of each quantity of state is modified according to the quantized value of modifying factor, then by revised quantity of state importance discretization, is converted into parameter set in advance, reflects the importance grade of each quantity of state；State estimation is carried out to transformer equipment according to the importance grade of each quantity of state, the real-time status of equipment is determined；Using the importance grade of each quantity of state in method for evaluating state as historical data, and above step is repeated, realize the self-optimization and dynamic evaluation of evaluation method.The present invention, which is also provided, a kind of includes the power transmission and transforming equipment of transformer equipment in evaluation method.This method effectively improves grid company equipment state and evaluates promptness, accuracy and objectivity.

title_en: Dynamic State Estimation of Power Distribution System
abstract_en: A method for dynamic state estimation (DSE) in a power distribution system (PDS) determines a new state of the PDS from a current state of the PDS via an indirect state transition model defining a transition of the current state of the PDS to the new state of the PDS through a transition of a current power injection to a new power injection on each bus of the PDS. The method measures one or combination of power flows, power injections, voltage magnitudes and phase angles on the measuring buses in the PDS and updates the new state of the PDS based on corresponding differences between one or combination of the estimated power flows, the estimated power injections, the estimated voltage magnitudes and the estimated phase angles with the measured power flows, the measured power injections, the measured voltage magnitudes and the measured phase angles.
assignees: MITSUBISHI ELECTRIC RES LABORATORIES INC

title_en: Power transmission route state detection device, power transmission route state detection system, power transmission route state detection method, power transmission route state detection program and power conversion device
abstract_en: This power transmission route state detection device (10) is provided with a power transmission route determination unit (13), a first power amount acquisition unit (11), a second power amount acquisition unit (12) and a state estimation unit (14). The power transmission route determination unit (13) determines a power transmission route for interchanging power between utility customers connected to a node (52) of a mesh-type power network (51). The first power amount acquisition unit (11) acquires the amount of power transmitted by an interchange-source utility customer (G20). The second power amount acquisition unit (12) acquires the amount of power transmitted to an interchange-destination utility customer (G30) from the interchange-source utility customer (G20). The state estimation unit (14) estimates the state of the determined power transmission route on the basis of the amount of power acquired by the first power amount acquisition unit (11) and the amount of power acquired by the second power amount acquisition unit (12).

title_en: A kind of transformer station does not change the method and system of telemetry automatic detection

title_en: A kind of digital substation relay protection evaluation mode of system condition method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of method for evaluating state of digital substation relay protection system, comprise the following steps：According to the configuration of digital relay protection system, participate in evaluation and electing equipment and the state evaluation index of relay protection system are determined；Standardization processing is carried out according to the state evaluation pointer type of determination；According to the current service data of the equipment of acquisition and the later state variation tendency of the pre- measurement equipment of history data；Result to prediction carries out the calculating of fuzzy membership；The calculating of each index weights and the calculating of equipment weight；The state evaluation score of system is drawn according to the weight of the weight and index of fuzzy membership and equipment.The state estimation of digital substation relay protection system is applied to without correlation technique at present; the present invention can carry out evaluation and prediction quasi real time to the relay protection system of digital transformer substation; the reliability of relay protection system can be effectively improved, to ensureing that electric power netting safe running plays an important role.

title_en: A kind of hydroenergy storage station unit can draw water, generate electricity hour number calculating method
abstract_en: A kind of hydroenergy storage station unit of present invention offer can draw water, generate electricity hour number calculating method, comprise the following steps：Step one：Under power generation situation, if A1 A6>A7 A3 then A7 A3=A1 A2；If A1 A6<A7 A3 then A1 A6=A1 A2；Calculate the hourage T1 that can generate electricity；Step 2：In the case of drawing water, if A3 A8>A5 A1 then A5 A1=A3 A4；If A3 A8<A5 A1 then A3 A8=A3 A4, calculating can draw water hourage T2；Step 3：Above-mentioned logical calculated is realized by the monitoring system of An Deli hereby, to reach real-time update, the upload function of data.The present invention can be realized by the program draw water, the real-time update of generating hourage, upload；Hiding storage capacity restrictive condition is cleverly make use of, using simple alignment algorithm rather than using traditional iterative algorithm, can also mitigate the load factor of system well while program has been simplified.

title_en: Bad data recognition method based on load prediction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of bad data recognition method based on load prediction, belong to Power system state estimation bad data detection and identification technical field.This method is mainly the actual measurement by counting each physics bus, each measurement associated with the physics bus is subjected to algebraically summation, whether actual remote measurement is correct according to associated by KCL principles differentiate the bus, and these measurements are included into suspicious remote measurement collection if KCL principles are unsatisfactory for.By concentrating each suspicious telemetry station to ask for the method with other telemetry station measuring value coefficient correlations suspicious remote measurement, real bad data is obtained.The bad data is carried out using KCL general principles for detected bad measurement.Bad data recognition method of the present invention, can be detected to the bad data present in bulk power grid metric data, improved the practicality and accuracy of metric data, met the basic demand of state estimation.

title_en: Consider the typhoon day short-term load forecasting method of path trace and the condition of a disaster Risk Evaluation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of typhoon day short-term load forecasting method for considering path trace and the condition of a disaster Risk Evaluation, comprise the following steps：The historical load data and meteorological data of the typhoon real time information and dispatcher-controlled territory Nei Ge cities needed for 1. typhoon day short-term load forecasting is gathered by communication network；2. judge urban distribution network whether by typhoon influence；If 3. by typhoon influence, building typhoon the condition of a disaster risk evaluation model and typhoon the condition of a disaster intensity being defined the level；According to the evaluation result of typhoon the condition of a disaster intensity series, typhoon load forecasting model is built；4. build the basic load forecast model of each utility grid；5. superposition final load prediction results during obtaining typhoon；6. it is corrected and amendment obtains 96 point load prediction curves during final typhoon；7. real-time update amendment typhoon relevant information and meteorological data, correct 96 point load prediction curves in real time.The present invention improves the accuracy rate of typhoon load prediction by studying the load loss amount by typhoon influence city.

title_en: A kind of electric power acquisition data restorative procedure based on MCMC algorithms

title_en: Method and device for establishing IPSAN disaster recovery system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method and a device for establishing an IPSAN disaster recovery system. The method comprises the steps of building a storage double-active system locally for a current storage device, building disaster recovery double-active sites in different places, and building a disaster recovery system comprising the local storage double-active sites and the remote disaster recovery double-active sites, wherein an SRM server manages the local storage double-active sites and the disaster recovery double-active sites of the disaster recovery system through a storage application adapter; and establishing a partnership between the local storage double-active site and the remote disaster backup double-active site through the IPSAN, and establishing a mapping relation through remote replication so as to realize synchronous real-time updating of the storage capacity of the user data service. When one storage site breaks down, the data can be migrated to other three sites, so that the data is under triple protection, the problem of data loss and damage caused by artificial or natural disasters is effectively avoided, the data has extremely high availability, and the reliability and stability of the whole storage system are improved.

title_en: Short-term optical power prediction method based on time series similarity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-term optical power prediction method based on time series similarity. Firstly, the meteorological data and the equipment operation data of the photovoltaic power station collected in real time are repaired, unreasonable numerical values or missing data are supplemented, and then all photovoltaic arrays are divided into several types through power data analysis. And finding out a power curve of each type of photovoltaic array under similar meteorological conditions in the same period of the last year according to meteorological prediction data, and predicting the future power by adopting a weighted average mode. The method adopts a big data analysis method, comprehensively utilizes historical data and meteorological prediction data to improve the prediction accuracy of the optical power, and has very important significance for ensuring the stable operation of the power grid.

title_en: A kind of magnanimity electric network data measures the quick detection discrimination method of bad data
abstract_en: The invention discloses the quick detection discrimination method that a kind of magnanimity electric network data measures bad data, belong to the detection and identification field of electric network data, for the bad data detection method of existing state estimation, bad data discrimination power height can not be met when in the presence of in face of mass data simultaneously, the problem of calculating speed is fast, the shortcomings that additionally there are missing inspection and flase drop, the present invention proposes the quick detection identification technique of magnanimity electric network data both sides bad data, first, topological analysis is carried out to remote signalling, it is then based on topological relation, carry out bad data detection SCADA identifications, dynamic partition finally is carried out to bad data, bilayer becomes more meticulous bad data detection with recognizing, realize in the case of big data, quick and precisely efficient bad data detection and identification, improve bad data identification accuracy rate, save detection time, improve efficiency.

title_en: Fully distributed filtering for load-based dynamic state estimation
abstract_en: Methods and Systems for dynamic state estimation (DSE) in an electric power system (EPS) having a multi-control area interconnected power network. Estimating current states of buses in a control area using historical data via a state transition model of buses of the control area. Receiving, a current state of 1-hop and n-hop neighboring buses located in neighboring control areas. A 1-hop neighboring bus connects to one boarder bus of the control area via a tie-branch and n-hop neighboring bus is connected to the 1-hop neighboring bus via at least one tie-branch, wherein n is greater than one. Determining measurements of states from buses in the control area. Finally, updating the current state of the buses using a measurement model on a basis of estimated current states of the control area, the received states from the neighboring control areas, and the measurements of states from buses in the control area.
assignees: MITSUBISHI ELECTRIC RES LABORATORIES INC

title_en: Incomplete parallel state estimation realization method based on network structure dynamic partitioning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a state estimation incomplete parallel implementation method based on network structure dynamic partitioning, which comprises the following steps: high voltage network equivalence; medium and low voltage network equivalence; performing serial state estimation calculation on the high-voltage network; carrying out parallel state estimation and parallel computation on the medium-low voltage network; and correcting a calculation result. The state estimation incomplete parallel implementation method based on the network structure dynamic partition is provided based on the evolution of the power grid structure in the current extra-high voltage power grid construction process, is based on the equivalence of an original network, is not based on the coefficient matrix block formed after the topological analysis, and is simple to implement; because the scale of the high-voltage network is small, the serial calculation consumes little time and can be almost ignored; the calculation efficiency can be greatly improved without carrying out parallelization transformation on the original serial state estimation algorithm.

title_en: Power grid stabilization system and stabilization method
abstract_en: Provided are a grid stabilization system and a stabilization method in which the number of power generators that are disconnected is reduced in order to narrow down a blackout region when it is determined that the reliability of a state estimation calculation is high. A power grid stabilization method is applied to a power grid comprising a plurality of feeders including a circuit breaker, a plurality of nodes, a plurality of power generators, and a plurality of loads, wherein: the circuit breaker is controlled to be opened after an accident is detected by a protection relay that uses the output of a first sensor installed near the circuit breaker, and is also controlled to be opened by means of a power grid stabilization output; a state estimation value of the power grid, obtained using the output of the first sensor, and a state detection value of the power grid including information of a measurement time at which a measurement is performed in the power grid are compared with each other to determine the reliability of the state estimation value; information relating to a circuit breaker that is to be newly tripped, from the viewpoint of power grid stability, after the occurrence of an accident at a virtual accident point in the power grid is stored, and information relating to a circuit breaker that is to be newly tripped according to each reliability determination result of the state estimation value is also stored; and a trip command for a circuit breaker to be newly tripped, selected in accordance with the reliability determination result of the state estimation value, is used as the power grid stabilization output when an accident in the power grid occurs.

title_en: Short-term and long-medium term power load forecasting method based on machine learning model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of short-term and long-medium term power load forecasting method based on machine learning model.Data are pre-processed first, i.e., smooth abnormal data and fill up missing data, the factor of analyzing influence load variations, including historical data, time cycle property, weather characteristics of variables.Naturalization is carried out to all input variables in order to accelerate pace of learning and improve precision of prediction.The present invention compares linear regression, support vector regression and gradient lifting and returns the performance in short-term and long-medium term power load forecasting.With the extension of predicted time, the performance of gradient lifting regression model is better than the performance of other two kinds of models.The present invention proposes a kind of AdaBoost algorithms using gradient lifting regression tree as base grader, carries out load prediction, effectively increases the precision of load forecast.
