title_en: A kind of Optimal Configuration Method of the real-time distributed state estimation of power distribution network based on PMU and PMU
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of real-time distributed state estimation of power distribution network based on PMU and PMU Optimal Configuration Method.Mainly distributed power grid state estimator is obtained by the use of nonlinear IEM model algorithm (MMSE) and tide model as core calculations；PMU allocation position prioritization schemes are obtained by the use of genetic algorithm as core calculations.Real-time PMU method for estimating state is calculated accurate voltage, phase angle estimate, ensures the stable operation and regulation and control of power system in the trend of distributed power grid quickly changes；By genetic algorithm optimization PMU allocation positions, reduce state estimation error.The state estimation and its optimization method can improve the precision of the state estimation in the power network containing distribution type electric energy resource, make wind energy in power network, voltage rapid fluctuations problem caused by photovoltaic generation to influenceing to be resolved caused by state estimation.

title_en: A kind of intelligent distribution network fault early warning method based on failure gene table
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of intelligent distribution network fault early warning method based on failure gene table, belong to intelligent distribution network fault pre-alarming field.The running status of intelligent distribution network is divided into first excellent, it is good, neutralize poor four kinds of states, then state estimation and the failure with reference to corresponding to are carried out to the historical data of intelligent power distribution network operation using BP neural network algorithm, obtain the mapping relations between each section of state transfer time sequence and failure, so as to construct the gene table that is out of order, then the periodically online state transfer time sequence for obtaining intelligent distribution network, and it is matched with all genes in failure gene table by Smith Waterman algorithms, if maximum matching value reaches the threshold value of setting, the then corresponding failure of early warning.The problem of present invention can become increasingly complex in face of intelligent distribution network well, improve the accuracy rate of intelligent distribution network fault pre-alarming, guidance and help is provided for maintenance of the related management personnel to intelligent distribution network, effectively raises the science and foresight of operation of power networks decision-making.

abstract_en: The invention discloses a surface temperature field multi-scale data assimilation method based on photovoltaic power station measurement data. title_en: Power grid load missing data completion method based on k-means clustering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid load missing data completion method based on k-means clustering, which completes missing data by taking days as units according to the regular characteristics of power grid load data; the method includes clustering existing complete daily load curves, classifying the daily load curves containing missing data according to existing data information of the daily load curves, performing telescopic transformation on mass center vectors corresponding to the missing daily load curves, and completing filling of missing data to vacant parts of the daily load curves; the method fully considers the characteristic that the load data of the power grid has time periodicity similarity, enables the completion data to be closer to the real data, has small completion error, can be used as a data preprocessing step necessary for load prediction, and enables the load prediction to have higher accuracy; the data completion method can be applied to photovoltaic power generation missing data completion and wind power generation missing data completion.

title_en: Wind power modeling and performance evaluation method based on confidence equivalent power curve band
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of wind power data processing, in particular to a wind power modeling and performance evaluation method based on a confidence equivalent power curve band, which comprises the following steps: carrying out primary screening and removing on abnormal data samples; dividing the wind speed into three areas, and counting the probability distribution conditions of the wind speed and the power in each area by adopting a kernel density estimation method to obtain a Copula function of each area; obtaining a confidence equivalent power boundary model of the corresponding region by adopting a maximum likelihood estimation method; reconstructing missing data by adopting a three-stage Hermite interpolation method, and finishing cleaning of an original data sample; taking the mean value of the confidence coefficient bandwidth ratio as a model performance evaluation index, verifying upper and lower boundary models of different areas by adopting a d-fold cross verification method, and determining the upper and lower boundary models of the different areas when the index is basically stabilized at a certain value; and updating data by adopting a rolling time window method, taking the deviation of the confidence coefficient bandwidth ratio as a trigger condition, and updating the upper and lower boundary models when a certain threshold value is exceeded.

title_en: Data cleaning and predicting method and mobile charger system of electric automobile
abstract_en: The invention relates to a data cleaning and predicting method, which comprises the following steps: s1, carrying out cluster analysis on data in a database to obtain data which are not classified into any class as abnormal data, namely data to be cleaned; s2, deleting abnormal data; s3, predicting and filling the data gaps after cleaning the abnormal data through a wavelet neural network and a combined prediction method; s4, predicting the SOC value of the single battery; the utility model also relates to an electric automobile removes charging system, including battery module, the module of discharging, the module of charging, display screen, its characterized in that still includes insulation monitoring module, data acquisition array module and intelligent monitoring management module. According to the invention, the intelligent monitoring management module is used for cleaning abnormal data of the single battery in the charge and discharge process acquired by the data acquisition array, and the wavelet neural network and the combined prediction method are used for accurately predicting the value of the data vacancy of the cleaned abnormal data and the SOC value of the single battery, so that the reliability and the stability of the system are ensured.

abstract_en: The present invention provides an energy management system for energy management. The energy management system for energy management comprises: a meter measuring an electricity consumption amount of a specific area; an area agent receiving control information on operation of multiple electronic devices from a user terminal capable of controlling the operation of the multiple electronic devices installed in the area and generating operation state current measurement data of the multiple electronic devices in accordance with the control information, wherein the area agent receives electricity consumption amount data of the area from the meter; and a machine learning device receiving the electricity consumption amount data and the operation state current measurement data from the area agent and generating operation state estimation data on the multiple electronic devices by a machine learning model including the electricity consumption amount data as input data, wherein the machine learning device learns the machine learning model using operation state error data in accordance with differences between the operation state current measurement data and the operation state estimation data.

title_en: Medium and low voltage distribution network state estimation pseudo quantity measurement determination method based on data mining
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for measuring and determining the state estimation false quantity of a medium-low voltage distribution network based on data mining, which belongs to the field of analysis and control of the distribution network and comprises the following steps: dividing the city map into N power supply grids, and collecting power user information in the N power supply grids by using a network data acquisition method to form an open-source power user information set; cleaning the structured data and the semi-structured data by using a regular expression, converting the unstructured data into power consumer building information, and performing attribute reduction on the cleaned data and the power consumer building information to obtain attribute characteristics of power consumers; according to the attribute characteristics of the power users, carrying out concentrated equivalence analysis on the power users by using a regular expression to obtain concentrated users and non-concentrated users; and further obtaining user load power, and obtaining pseudo measurement data according to the user load power. The invention realizes the maximum utilization of data resources in a targeted manner, and accurately and efficiently determines the measurement of the false quantity in the power distribution network.

abstract_en: The water sand prediction technique and system of an embodiment of the present invention provides a kind of strong alluvial stream based on data assimilation, the landform altitude scatterplot data specially obtained using sampling generate sealene triangle terrain mesh unit；Obtain the water sand information and initial fields information on strong alluvial stream inlet and outlet boundary；With the triangular element of terrain mesh body in order to control, the two-dimentional Water-sand model of strong alluvial stream is carried out discrete, selects method for solving to be calculated, obtain the calculated value of control volume；The urban river water sand status information for acquiring strong alluvial stream in real time establishes the real-time prediction model based on data assimilation according to water sand status information, obtains assimilation state variable and parametric variable；Water sand prediction finally is carried out to strong alluvial stream using two-dimentional water sand data assimilation model.The water sand real-time status of strong alluvial stream can be effectively predicted, is regulated and controled so as to Zhi Chishui sand, and foundation is provided for flood control and disaster reduction, water environment protection and water resources management by above-mentioned processing.

title_en: Hierarchical multi-objective optimization method for comprehensive energy management of micro-grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hierarchical multi-objective optimization method for comprehensive energy management of a micro-grid, which comprises the steps of firstly, acquiring data, and then, defining objective functions and constraint conditions during model building; after initialization, obtaining an optimal individual through evaluation, and carrying out assimilation without load data on a poor individual through sequencing to accelerate convergence; then carrying out two times of variation, wherein the variation adopts isolated cross variation, the process is load scheduling, energy storage and power scheduling, and after the scheduling is finished, carrying out population evaluation and sequencing to select a representative load scheduling best individual; and then, the optimal individual is subjected to load data assimilation on other individuals through load scheduling, then, mutation crossing is performed again, then, the population is evaluated and sequenced, and a representative optimal individual is selected. Then checking whether iteration is finished or not, and if not, recycling; and if so, outputting a scheduling scheme for reference. The invention can meet the requirements of energy management.

abstract_en: The present invention provides an acoustic tomography system to observe and monitor marine environments in real-time, comprising: a data measurement unit (P.1) including an acoustic data measurement unit and an environmental data measurement unit; a data transmission unit (P.2) connected to the data measurement unit (P.1) to transmit the measured acoustic and environmental data to a data processing unit (P.3); a first data processing unit (P.3) receiving the data from the data transmission unit (P.2) to calculate a flow speed distribution by each vertical layer; a second data processing unit (P.4) receiving the data from the data transmission unit (P.2) to calculate a sound speed distribution; and a data synchronization unit (P.5) using a result of the first and second data processing units (P.3, P.4) and a digital marine model to correct data and output a result. According to the present invention, seawater temperature and flow direction/speed changes of the sea are able to be monitored, thereby being used for marine product industries, such as a cultivating industry, fishery, and the like, and performing a role for predicting and preventing natural disasters, such as red tide, tsunami, and the like.

According to the method, the distribution situation of the snow depth of the power transmission line corridor with higher precision is obtained, early warning is carried out on the snow depth of the power transmission line corridor according to the operation suggestion, the purpose of accurately estimating the snow change of the power transmission line corridor in real time is achieved, and the worst snow and ice situation of the power transmission line is predicted.

title_en: Online generation method for external network equivalent model of designated area in power system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an online generation method of an external network equivalent model of a designated area in an electric power system, and belongs to the technical field of electric power system dispatching automation. The method comprises the following steps: monitoring the available time change of the power grid model in real time, and automatically acquiring an updated power grid model; acquiring real-time operation data of a power grid according to a set period; and performing area external network equivalent calculation, optimizing the output external network equivalent model according to the set branch circuit breaking threshold value and the set branch circuit shrinking threshold value, and respectively outputting a state estimation data file and a real-time data file. The invention comprises the following steps: extracting key nodes of a power supply path of a high-risk customer; acquiring a real-time operation topology model of a power grid; constructing a power grid equipment connection relation model; constructing a high-risk customer power supply path topological model; carrying out vector graphical modeling on the topological model; the automatic drawing of the power supply path of the high-risk client is realized. The invention realizes the visualized display of the power supply path of the high-risk client and the real-time update of the power supply path change, and can really improve the power supply reliability and the power supply quality of the user.

title_en: Power equipment running state estimation method and device and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a method and a system for estimating the running state of power equipment, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring operation state parameters of multiple dimensions of each power device in the transformer substation during operation; classifying the operating state parameters, generating radar maps of the operating states of the power equipment according to the operating state parameters of various categories, and overlapping the radar maps corresponding to the power equipment to generate overlapped radar maps; and estimating the operating state of each electric power device according to the superposed radar map, wherein if the difference between the operating state parameters of the electric power devices and the operating state parameters of other electric power devices is larger than a preset difference threshold value, the operating state of the corresponding electric power device is judged to be abnormal. The invention improves the accuracy of the estimation of the running state of the power equipment.

title_en: A kind of fire extinguishing host apparatus of battery case alarm and the automatic control system put out a fire
abstract_en: The utility model is related to the fire extinguishing host apparatus of the automatic control system of a kind of alarm of battery case and fire extinguishing, including controller, fire extinguisher, total solenoid valve, header solenoid valve and detection devices；The fire extinguisher at least one；The fire extinguisher delivery outlet is provided with total solenoid valve；The fire extinguisher is connect with header solenoid valve using main feedline；It is connected at least one isocon on the header solenoid valve；The isocon of the fire extinguishing host apparatus uses battery case piping connection with battery case；The detection device is arranged in battery case.The utility model overall structure closely, for each battery case and its detection device, including host apparatus itself carries out malfunction monitoring, avoids causing the device not work or partial failure because of sensor failure；Local fire extinguishment is carried out for different battery cases, and grade analysis is carried out to the condition of a disaster, starts extinguishing device, it is efficient, it is with strong points, effectively fire behavior is avoided to expand, security performance is stronger.

title_en: A kind of the fire load appraisal procedure and system of nuclear power plant
abstract_en: The fire load appraisal procedure and system, method of a kind of nuclear power plant include：S1, the combustible information database for establishing nuclear power plant；S2, the standardization calorific value database for establishing nuclear power plant；S3, for the newly-increased material for being put into nuclear power plant every time, the information of synchronized update combustible information database, the fire load data of newly-increased material are determined every time according to the standardization calorific value database, and real-time update increases total fire load of corresponding storage area after material newly every time, calculates fire load density, fire duration, the fire maximum temperature of corresponding storage area in real time according to total fire load after newly-increased material；S4, it determines the fire load minimax risk criterion that the storage area after newly-increased material every time is adapted to, assess and prompts every time risk class of the storage area after newly-increased material under identified fire load minimax risk criterion.The present invention is convenient for the examination ＆ approval that the statistics of fire load data is stored with inquiry, power plant's material, it can be achieved that online evaluation increases the function of fire load newly.

title_en: A kind of ultra-high-tension power transmission line operating status appraisal procedure under microclimate environment
abstract_en: The present invention provides the ultra-high-tension power transmission line operating status appraisal procedure under a kind of microclimate environment, by the resistance R of parameters of electric power, reactance X and susceptance B combination microclimate detection parameters data：Temperature and humidity data form system structure parameter database；Parameters of electric power assesses curved surface with formation parameters of electric power microclimate after microclimate parameter fitting；Curved surface is assessed using the data real-time update database and parameters of electric power microclimate acquired in real time, the parameters of electric power microclimate assessment curved surface based on history big data is built into after a large amount of data acquisition update adjustment, as the initial baseline curved surface and formation standard database of parameter evaluation, and pre-alarm difference threshold is set.It is monitored for electric power system tide, voltage dynamic stability monitors and early warning, the record of dynamic process prison and crash analysis, and the integration and management of three-state data provide great data supporting, the manual labor's pressure for mitigating track walker provides the accurate data of dynamic in real time for electric system.

title_en: It is online to authorize Interlocking Methods and system
abstract_en: Interlocking Methods are authorized the invention discloses online, anti-error host makes and the anti-error data of real-time update；Hand-held intelligent terminal by radio communication network to anti-error host send the first equipment unlocking request；After anti-error host receives unlocking request, anti-error logic analysis is carried out according to the first equipment of anti-error data pair and correlation logic is analyzed；If analysis result, which is the state of at least one second equipment associated with the first equipment, is unsatisfactory for the unlocking condition of the first equipment, then anti-error host sends unlock instruction by hand-held intelligent terminal to Intelligent key, and Intelligent key is made to be unlocked operation to the lockset corresponding at least one second equipment and the lockset corresponding to the first equipment successively according to unlock instruction.Anti-error locking system is authorized the invention also discloses online.Using the embodiment of the present invention, the online mandate error-unlocking prevention operation that grid equipment can be realized in the operation order drawn up in advance can not be depended on, it is easy to operate, improve the efficiency of anti-misoperation locking.

title_en: Auxiliary method for using shore power for port berthing ship
abstract_en: The invention discloses an auxiliary method for using shore power for a port berthing ship, which comprises the steps of sharing historical information of ship connection shore power through information interaction between a ship shore power data center and a port shore power data center, and guiding a ship berthing direction and a ship party to select proper shore power capacity by automatically searching the historical berthing information of the ship before the ship berths at a port; during the inspection work before ship bank connection, the operation personnel can be clearly indicated to carry out the test of the safety circuit, the problem of uncertainty caused by non-uniform design standards of the safety circuit, non-real-time updating of later-stage transformation information and the like is avoided, and the shore power service efficiency of the port is improved. The port side uses the historical information of the ships for berthing for reference, adopts a weighting coefficient method to process data, configures proper shore power capacity, avoids excessive configuration and increases investment cost.

title_en: Method for reconstructing, solid state disk of the logic to physical image table after a kind of power-off restarting
abstract_en: Method for reconstructing, solid state disk the present invention relates to logic after a kind of power-off restarting to physical image table.Including：S1：Read the system information data preserved before power-off；S2：The logic preserved before power-off is obtained to physical image table；S3：Obtain the block list preserved before power-off；S4：The single-layer type storage element block used before power-off is obtained according to block list, and the physics of the data having been written into institute mapping updates to logic to physical image table logical image；S5：Three-layer type storage element storage area currently in use is updated, reconstruction of the physics to mapping table is completed.By applying the present invention, under unexpected power blackout situation, the Missing data for avoiding being currently written into using the characteristic of SLC, and increase and rebuild efficiency reduction reconstruction time.

title_en: Photovoltaic power station monitoring data restoration method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data restoration processing, and particularly discloses a photovoltaic power station monitoring data restoration method, which comprises the following steps: searching whether temperature and humidity information, illumination intensity and historical photovoltaic power station output power data in the monitoring data of the photovoltaic power station at the same moment are missing; if the data item is missing, marking the missing data item and excluding the missing data item; training the monitored photovoltaic power station monitoring data after the missing data items are eliminated to obtain a state conversion function; fitting according to an interpolation theory to obtain missing data items, and completing the missing data items in the monitoring data of the photovoltaic power station; inputting the temperature and humidity information, the illumination intensity and historical photovoltaic power station output power data in the completed photovoltaic power station monitoring data into a state conversion function for prediction to obtain a predicted value; and filtering the predicted value to obtain a photovoltaic power station monitoring data restoration result. The photovoltaic power station monitoring data restoration method provided by the invention can realize data restoration.

title_en: A kind of reservoir operation Application of risk decision method of Coupled Numerical meteorological model DATA PROCESSING IN ENSEMBLE PREDICTION SYSTEM
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of reservoir operation Application of risk decision method of Coupled Numerical meteorological model DATA PROCESSING IN ENSEMBLE PREDICTION SYSTEM, including establish reservoir watershed numerical value meteorological model DATA PROCESSING IN ENSEMBLE PREDICTION SYSTEM model, the peb process in rail vehicle roller test-rig basin；The uncertainty that hydrology DATA PROCESSING IN ENSEMBLE PREDICTION SYSTEM is assessed using the Bayesian model method of average, inquires into the probability of happening of Bayes posterior probability real-time update future flood scene；Based on hydrology DATA PROCESSING IN ENSEMBLE PREDICTION SYSTEM as a result, building flood Analysis by Scenario Trees using the method based on probability metrics, and sanction branch is carried out to flood Analysis by Scenario Trees；Optimizing scheduling of reservoir Random Chance-Constrained Programming Model is established, reservoir optimal scheduling decision, and evaluation decision risk are obtained using Optimization Method.The method of the present invention can effectively extend hydrologic forecast leading time and improve forecast precision；It combines between consideration pattern and the uncertainty of different data assimilation scheme；Suitable for middle or short term real-time reservoir operation, the reliability of reservoir operation decision can be significantly improved.

title_en: System and method implemented by computer for linking block-chains to digital twins
abstract_en: To provide a method and a system implemented by a computer using block-chain technology as a storage system for data obtained from digital twins.SOLUTION: A block-chain can be used to generate an immutable transaction history of data generated by digital twins. In the event of the occurrence of an error, a failure, an accident, or a calamity, an interested party can access and analyze an immutable data set. A block-chain network can also execute a digital smart contract based on the data received from the digital twins. The present invention may be used in relation to the Bitcoin block-chain or another block-chain protocol.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Precursor data processing method, method for forecasting earthquake and system for earthquake prediction
abstract_en: Monitoring data processing method, method for forecasting earthquake and system for earthquake prediction, it is related to disaster alarm field, by premonitoring region lay monitoring of earthquake precursors point monitor at the monitoring of earthquake precursors point because earth interior activity caused by earth's surface physical field and chemical fields variation characteristic, and then obtain with because earth interior it is movable caused by the relevant measurement data of the variation characteristic of earth's surface physical field and chemical fields, measurement data is counted, is forecasted earthquake according to statistical result to premonitoring region.Due to innovation proposition to because earth interior activity caused by the variation characteristic of earth's surface physical field and chemical fields be monitored, realize the dangerous sending forecast that the round-the-clock monitoring of earthquake and the real-time update of data, earthquake can occur in time by the analysis to data.So that the people in its earthquake centre region is begun to take risk avoidance measures in advance, reduces the casualties and property loss of broad masses of the people.

title_en: A kind of failure prediction method of micro-capacitance sensor, device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of failure prediction methods of micro-capacitance sensor, device and electronic equipment, obtain the fault tree models of micro-capacitance sensor, calculate the minimal cut set and minimum path sets of the fault tree models, according to the minimal cut set and minimum path sets being calculated, calculate the different degree for causing the top event to occur when each elementary event occurs, the different degree for causing the top event to occur when occurring based on each elementary event, each elementary event is ranked up, obtain ranking results, when micro-capacitance sensor failure, each infrastructure device in the micro-capacitance sensor is successively detected according to the ranking results, and then preferentially the higher infrastructure device of different degree can be detected, and then it being capable of quick positioning failure equipment, it is time saving and energy saving.
assignees: HEFEI SUNGROW NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid electricity stealing detection method based on state estimation and with privacy protection
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid electricity stealing detection method based on state estimation and with privacy protection, which comprises the following steps of: s1, a trusted third party TPP generates two pairs of keys for a control center CC and a local area network LAN gateway; s2, users in the area send user electricity utilization information to a Local Area Network (LAN) gateway, and the LAN gateway verifies the information and receives the information; s3, analyzing the power consumption of a user by the LAN gateway, detecting whether a power stealing behavior exists, and detecting whether the user is attacked or not and whether the power is modified or not; and S4, the LAN gateway aggregates the total power consumption of the area into Y to be sent to a control center CC as a standard for electric quantity scheduling of the power company. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of being more suitable for practical application, higher in information security, lower in cost and the like.

title_en: The powernet analysis system and method for data grids based on memory
abstract_en: The present invention provides the powernet analysis systems and method of data grids based on memory, are related to technical field of power systems, comprising: memory data grid, for being stored using distributed master/slave data model storage to node/branch logic analysis model；Node/branch logic analysis model generates power grid logic analysis model and state change event for the data processing mode using memory calculating and according to power grid metrical information and state estimation result information；Event analysis module generates the stable assessment information of power grid for carrying out simulation analysis to power grid logic analysis model according to state change event.The data processing mode that the present invention is calculated by using distributed master/slave data model storage and memory, be to the processing of power grid metrical information and state estimation result information it is non-linear, real-time and dynamic, greatly improve the response speed of on-line security and stability analysis.

title_en: Monitoring data processing method for earthquake prediction, earthquake prediction method and system
abstract_en: A monitoring data processing method, a seismic forecasting method and a system for seismic forecasting relate to the field of disaster early warning, and are characterized in that monitoring points are distributed in a pre-monitoring area, characteristics of charged particles overflowed from the surface of the monitoring points are monitored, further measurement data related to the characteristics of the charged particles are obtained, statistics is carried out on the measurement data, a statistical value is obtained according to a statistical result, a current statistical value is compared with a previous statistical value, fluctuation representing the change of the measurement data is obtained according to a comparison result, and the seismic forecasting of the pre-monitoring area is achieved. The innovation is based on monitoring the surface overflow charged particles, so that all-weather monitoring of the earthquake and real-time updating of the data are realized, and the danger of the earthquake can be timely predicted through analysis of the data. People in the earthquake area begin to take danger avoidance measures in advance, and casualties and property loss of masses are reduced.

title_en: Active power distribution network FTU optimal configuration method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an active power distribution network FTU optimal configuration method, which comprises the following steps: establishing an optimization model comprising a comprehensive objective function with optimal investment cost and state estimation precision, reliability index constraint, node voltage and branch power qualification rate constraint and load shedding constraint; reducing the 'three remote' of the active power distribution network feeder terminal to 'two remote'; reducing the 'two remote' of the part of the active power distribution network feeder terminal to be an un-matched terminal; and outputting optimization results of the FTU optimization configuration stages of three-remote and two-remote. The active power distribution network FTU optimal configuration method mainly considers the FTU configuration of the line switch, and can comprehensively consider factors such as state estimation precision, investment cost, reliability and the like when the power distribution terminal of the active power distribution network is optimally configured.
assignees: STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Robust state estimation method for power system based on t distribution
abstract_en: A robust state estimation method for a power system based on t distribution relates to the technical field of power system analysis. Reading specific parameters of the power system to form a node admittance matrix and a node-branch model; establishing an equivalent computing circuit according to a topological structure of the power system, and allocating synchronous phasor measuring devices at corresponding nodes according to considerable preconditions of the system; fitting the t distribution and the Gaussian distribution to the historical data of the measured values based on the t distribution and the Gaussian distribution; reading the new measurement value, represented by vector z (k); constructing a robust state estimation algorithm under t distribution based on a maximum likelihood estimation basic theory; and judging a convergence condition to obtain the estimation of the robust state of the power system based on the t distribution. The method has the advantages of strong anti-interference capability, good robustness and high estimation precision.

title_en: Grid early warning information-based typhoon and waterlogging disaster power distribution network risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk assessment method for a power distribution network with typhoon, wind and flood disasters based on gridding early warning information, which comprises the following steps: (1) evaluating the fault probability; (2) generation of an expected failure: generating a direct expected fault set caused by typhoon and waterlogging damage, and supplementing to generate a complete expected fault set under the typhoon and waterlogging damage; (3) analyzing the network topology: network topology analysis is carried out on the power distribution network by combining with power distribution network state estimation data to obtain line information of a plant station and a root node of the plant station, and load loss area evaluation is carried out on the power distribution network under typhoon, waterlogging disaster and disaster damage to obtain a power distribution network load loss area; (4) risk assessment of the power distribution network: calculating to obtain the loss load probability of the regional power distribution network and the loss load of the station; and calculating to obtain the risk value of the distribution network in the area under the typhoon, wind and flood disasters according to the importance level of the load and the load loss probability of the plant station. The invention adopts the early warning information based on gridding, thereby improving the engineering practicability.

title_en: Nuclear power plant's fire-proof curtain management method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of nuclear power plant's fire-proof curtain management method and system, method includes: database update step: in fire-proof curtain information update, by newest fire-proof curtain information real-time update into dynamic fire-proof curtain database；Operating risk monitoring step: for fire-proof curtain operation each time, connected room combination is identified from the fire-proof curtain information of dynamic fire-proof curtain database, determine fire-proof curtain set present in room combination, based on the fire-proof curtain type and state in fire-proof curtain set, fire risk assessment that the room combines is assessed from multiple dimensions as a result, and considering the superposed risk of different types of fire-proof curtain operation in fire-proof curtain set in evaluation process.The present invention facilitates plant personnel easily to carry out fire-proof curtain data query；The working efficiency for promoting and optimizing power plant's fire-proof curtain management can be applied to fire-proof curtain and open licensing examination & approval, serves the workbench of the daily fire-proof curtain management of nuclear power plant.

title_en: A kind of power network resources monitoring and managing method and system based on dipper system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of power network resources monitoring and managing method and system based on dipper system, is related to equipment supervision area, method includes the following steps: selecting power network resources equipment to be regulated；The job information of each power network resources equipment is obtained in real time, and job information is obtained by preset monitoring system monitoring, includes multinomial running parameter data corresponding with device class in job information；Obtain the geographic orientation of each power network resources equipment in real time using dipper system；Device class, job information and the geographic orientation of each power network resources equipment are packaged, supervision information packet corresponding with each power network resources equipment is obtained, supervises the data in information packet according to job information and geographic orientation real-time update；Power network resources overview map is constructed according to each supervision information packet.The present invention intuitively shows the distribution situation and its working condition of power network resources equipment, provides convenience to the supervision of equipment situation for staff.

title_en: Power distribution network robust state estimation method based on least square sum-by-one sum
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system dispatching automation, and particularly relates to a power distribution network robust state estimation method based on least square and one-times sum, which comprises the following steps: step A: constructing a power distribution network robust state estimation basic model based on the sum of least squares and one product by using the power distribution network node measurement vectors and the state vectors; and B: introducing auxiliary variables to transform the basic model to obtain a everywhere-guided equivalent model; and C: and solving the equivalent model by using a prime-dual interior point algorithm. The method can effectively inhibit a plurality of bad data including the bad data with consistency in the estimation process, shows good tolerance, has high calculation efficiency, and is very suitable for practical engineering application.

title_en: A kind of heat supply network steady-state operation method for parameter estimation measured based on multi-state
abstract_en: The heat supply network steady-state operation network parameter estimation method based on multi-state that the present invention relates to a kind of, belongs to the operation and control technology field of integrated energy system.This method comprises: establishing heat supply network equivalent model, the objective function that carries out network parameter estimation to the heat supply network of steady-state operation based on heat supply network equivalent model, establish parameter Estimation, the constraint condition for establishing heat supply network steady-state operation, MATLAB Optimization Toolbox being utilized to solve parameter estimation result.This method is based on heat supply network bilateral equivalent model, establishes the heat supply network steady-state operation method for parameter estimation based on multi-state, has comprehensively considered the resistance coefficient (inner wall of the pipe roughness) in hydraulic regime and the coefficient of heat transfer in thermal drying., inner wall of the pipe corrosion and ageing degree height longer for runing time leads to the heating network of the given reference value of Hydro-thermodynamic parameter drift-out producer, be conducive to further realize co-generation unit state estimation, safety analysis and security control, Optimized Operation, improve system administration level, increases social total benefit.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Wind speed prediction method based on depth limit learning machine, system and unit thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind speed prediction method based on a depth limit learning machine, a system and a unit thereof, belonging to the field of wind turbines. The method for predicting the wind speed value through the time series prediction method of the deep extreme learning machine comprises the following steps: acquiring a group of historical observation data sequences at the time t and before the time t in the power generation process of the wind turbine generator; extracting a training sample data set by a time sequence prediction method of a deep extreme learning machine; derivation of a prediction model: extracting nearest neighbors of the prediction sequence Q from the training sample data set as recombined samples, wherein the recombined samples have single-step characteristics and multi-step characteristics when corresponding to single-step prediction and multi-step prediction; respectively carrying out deep extreme learning machine training on single-step characteristics and multi-step characteristics of a DELM model with multiple hidden layers, and integrating the deep extreme learning machine training into a prediction model through local selection; predicting a wind speed value X by a prediction model t+s . The method has higher accuracy and generalization performance, and can improve the prediction performance and the real-time updating capability.

title_en: Interpolation method of wind measurement missing data of hub of fan based on GAN
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for interpolating wind measurement missing data of a hub of a wind turbine based on GAN, and relates to the technical field of wind turbine fault diagnosis. The method comprises the steps of acquiring an initial wind speed data set from a wind field SCADA system, deleting abnormal data in the initial wind speed data set, and forming a wind speed data set according to the serial number of a fan; after the correlation analysis of the wind speed data among different fans is carried out, a correlation coefficient matrix is obtained; sorting the wind speed data of different fans by adopting an ant colony algorithm; constructing a training sample required in the process of generating the confrontation network training, and constructing a generator model and a confronter model for generating the confrontation network; and inputting the training samples into the generator model and the countermeasure model, and performing iterative training to complete the interpolation work of the data. According to the method, the data of the wind farm are subjected to correlation analysis, so that the data with high correlation can be gathered more closely, the picture becomes smoother, and the convergence speed of model training is improved; the method can perform data interpolation for a long time.

title_en: A kind of bird trouble on transmission line state estimations method neural network based
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of bird trouble on transmission line state estimations methods neural network based, include the following steps: S1, the flying bird activity near electric power line pole tower is detected by Doppler radar, obtains flying bird flight path information, extracts flight path characteristic information；S2 constructs flight path neural network prediction mathematical model；S3, using Regularization algorithms training flight path neural network prediction mathematical model network；The present invention can effectively reduce the bird-proof device number of starts in terms of the anti-bird pest of transmission line of electricity, and then greatly reduce the power consumption of existing bird-proof device, also it realizes that existing bird-proof device reaches intelligent bird repellent, is provided a great convenience for subsequent patrol officer, there is stronger practical value.

title_en: A kind of bottoming data creation method, data disaster tolerance method and relevant device

title_en: A kind of method and apparatus for Operation Event of Nuclear Power Plants analysis
abstract_en: A kind of method and apparatus for Operation Event of Nuclear Power Plants analysis, are related to npp safety technical field, wherein the method comprising the steps of one, is investigated run case and forms Operation event report and is uploaded to State Bureau of Nuclear Safety's Experience Feedback system；Step 2: carrying out qualitative analysis to run case by analysis module and identifying the basic reason that run case occurs；Step 3: importing basic reason quantitative data obtained in step 2 based in quantitative computing module constructed by Bayesian network model, the occurrence frequency with such run case of real-time update is quantitatively calculated；Step 4: the calculated result obtained based on step 3 is determined prevention and reduces the experience of such run case generation and by obtained Experience Feedback to each nuclear power plant's operating organization.Integrated use qualitative analysis program of the present invention and quantitative calculating instrument analyze the run case of nuclear power plant, improve the analysis efficiency and precision to Operation Event of Nuclear Power Plants, advantageously reduce the probability of happening of run case.

title_en: A kind of detection method based on bad data in improved BP state estimation
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of detection method based on bad data in improved BP state estimation, is related to Power system state estimation technical field.This method first improves traditional BP neural network, and then the good data in Power system state estimation is input in improved BP neural network, is trained to improved BP neural network；Again by trained improved BP neural networks model, the suspicious data collection in electric system is filtered out；Finally utilize the bad data in traditional quartile method detection and Identification of Power System.Detection method provided by the invention based on bad data in improved BP state estimation, can preferably the data obtained in Power system state estimation be detected and be recognized using improved BP neural network, the time of detection data can be shortened simultaneously, it is effective to reject bad data, improve the precision of data in state estimation.

title_en: A kind of power distribution network dynamic state estimator method based on historical data driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of power distribution network dynamic state estimator methods based on historical data driving, this method establishes state of electric distribution network equation using the existing historical data of power distribution network, the correlation between each quantity of state is considered comprehensively, off-diagonal state-transition matrix is formed, and state-transition matrix and noise matrix are obtained by the parameter Estimation based on Huber function；And then the state estimation of power distribution network is obtained using Unscented kalman filtering.The present invention is directed to distribution network system for the first time and proposes the dynamic state estimator method based on historical data, existing information is made full use of to establish complete status predication equation, more traditional weighted least-squares method and Extended Kalman filter method increases in estimated accuracy, and provides more accurate status predication value and provide reference frame for further system optimization and control.

title_en: Electronic device, the electric power data Missing Data Filling method based on XGBoost and storage medium
abstract_en: The present invention proposes electronic device, electric power data Missing Data Filling method and storage medium based on XGBoost, which comprises obtains electric power data of the predetermined building in the first time predefined section；According to the integrality for the electric power data that the detection of predetermined data integrity detection method obtains, to obtain the first complete electric power data collection and the first missing electric power data collection；The Missing Data Filling model completed according to preparatory training carries out Missing Data Filling to the first missing electric power data collection, to complete the filling of the first missing electric power data collection missing values.It can be improved the accuracy that missing data is predicted in electric power data, and the filling of missing data can be rapidly completed, provide reference data for the construction and popularization of smart grid.

title_en: A kind of power distribution network operation risk cognitive method and device
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of power distribution network operation risk cognitive method and devices, first carry out ultra-short term and distribution network status estimation；Determine each power distribution network evaluation index value in power distribution network evaluation index system；Power distribution network operation risk is perceived, obtained sensing results are operations staff's discovery, find out risk reason and risk source provides foundation, and limitation is not present, and accuracy height can provide reliable basis for the formulation of risk-aversion control measure；The present invention can effectively reduce error in measurement and measure influence of the bad data to power distribution network real time execution Situation Assessment result, and provide the overall recognition result of power distribution network operation risk, quantify the real-time running state of power distribution network, provides important technology and data support for the operation control of power distribution network；The present invention more meets the characteristic of Electrical Power System Dynamic state estimation algorithm, reduces the calculating time of state estimation, improves the computational accuracy of state estimation.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power grid loss calculation method based on deep learning and elastic network regularization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid loss calculation method based on deep learning and elastic network regularization, which adopts a statistical method or a real-time power grid model-based method, wherein the former has large workload and low calculation precision, particularly for a large power grid, the realization difficulty is higher, the latter highly depends on the power grid automation level, if the dispatching automation state estimation or the power flow calculation qualification rate is lower, the practical degree of the power grid is seriously influenced, the uncertainty is enhanced and the power grid loss calculation is more complex under the condition of continuous change of the current power grid characteristics, compared with the two traditional power grid loss calculation methods, the method utilizes a self-coder technology to carry out learning training on historical power grid loss samples from the deep learning view point, thereby obtaining a power grid loss calculation model, on one hand, the prediction of future power grid loss can be realized, meanwhile, the power grid loss calculation without the model can be carried out, and the samples can be from real-time data or simulation models, the efficiency and the degree of practicality of the network loss calculation are greatly improved.

title_en: A kind of Short-Term Load Forecasting of Electric Power System, model, apparatus and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Short-Term Load Forecasting of Electric Power System, model, apparatus and systems, this method comprises: receiving load data, and carry out Supplementing Data to its missing data；Influence factor data are received, the influence factor data include temperature record, festivals or holidays data and industry data, are quantified to influence factor using quantization method corresponding with load data；Load data is handled using wavelet decomposition, and carries out de-noising and feature extraction obtains four sequences, correlation analysis is carried out with influence factor data respectively, obtains related to influence factor pair of load characteristic of set；Four sequences obtained according to load data are subjected to tentative prediction using Three-exponential Smoothing algorithm, related to influence factor pair of load characteristic of set is adjusted the factor using the prediction of ARIMA-GARCH method, tentative prediction result and Dynamic gene input shot and long term memory network are obtained into final prediction result.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG

title_en: A kind of dynamic path planning method under the conditions of car networking
abstract_en: The invention discloses the dynamic path planning methods under the conditions of a kind of car networking, this method uses the following steps: the planning of dynamic lane-change track improves the objective function of synthesis the lane-change time and peak acceleration of comfort and traffic efficiency by building first, utilize Cubic Spline Method, constraint condition and objective function solve optimal lane-change track, and the real time information that can be provided according to car networking refers to lane-change track, data real-time update can timely feedback when emergency situations occurs in front and re-start planning path to decision package, to prevent from colliding, so that lane-change vehicle adapts to the variation of surrounding vehicles motion state；This invention has safety, comfort and high efficiency in terms of reducing the lane-change time and preventing collision by introducing objective function and determining the equation of locus planned in terms of optimal solution.
assignees: UNIV JIANGSU

title_en: Voltage sag state estimation method based on limited information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a voltage sag state estimation method based on limited information, which comprises the steps of collecting voltage sag monitoring data and power grid structural parameters of any node in a power grid, and regarding a grounding point as a virtual node to form an impedance matrix; combining the impedance matrix, representing the sequence voltage of the other nodes by monitoring the point sequence voltage according to the boundary conditions of fault sequence components under different fault types, and obtaining a temporary reduction phase voltage equation of the other nodes by utilizing phase sequence transformation; analyzing the impedance relation of each sequence in the residual voltage equation, and simplifying the fault residual voltage equation by utilizing the transformation relation of fault phase sequence voltages under different fault types; and deducing a general equation of the residual voltage under each fault type based on the voltage sag monitoring information of any point, thereby obtaining the voltage sag state distribution of the whole network. According to the method, the voltage sag state distribution of the whole network is analyzed according to actual monitoring information, the calculation is simple, the conservatism of the traditional voltage sag state estimation method is improved, and the method is more in line with engineering practice.

title_en: Power system monitoring system, power system monitoring method, and program
abstract_en: To provide a power system monitoring system, power system monitoring method, and program, capable of accurately estimating stability of a system state of a power facility in the future even in a state in which the degree of learning of machine learning is low.SOLUTION: A power system monitoring system includes a system state estimation unit, input data determination unit, and stability derivation unit. The system state estimation unit estimates a system state in the future in a power system on the basis of system information measured in the power system and previously set power information including information on power demand/supply of the power system. The input data determination unit, on the basis of input data including the estimated system state and assumed accident information and learning data based on past input data generated using a predetermined evaluation model, determines the degree of learning of the learning data with respect to the input data. The stability derivation unit, using a method corresponding to the determined determination result, derives system stability of the power system in the future on the basis of the input data.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: TOSHIBA CORP;TOSHIBA ENERGY SYSTEM & SOLUTION CORP

title_en: Power system distribution substation load data anomaly detection and repair method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for detecting and repairing load data anomalies of a power system distribution substation, and belongs to the technical field of power system analysis and control. The method comprises two stages of rough detection and micro detection of abnormal conditions of load data of the distribution transformer substation: in the 'coarse detection' stage, the missing data is complemented by utilizing a low-rank matrix technology, and obvious abnormal values are primarily repaired; in the micro-detection stage, a random forest quantile regression model is utilized to construct the influence relationship of factors such as historical load, weather, day type and the like on the load to be detected, and fine adjustment is carried out on local abnormal data. The method can fully utilize the diversified data and the historical load data to detect and repair the abnormal data in the load of the distribution transformer station in the power system, provides a reliable data base for power load prediction and power system operation, effectively improves the power load prediction precision and reduces the cost of power system operation.

title_en: A kind of distributed photovoltaic power prediction main station system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the present invention provides a kind of distributed photovoltaic power prediction main station system, which includes data acquisition subsystem, data storage subsystem, data process subsystem, mesoscale NWP subsystem and power prediction subsystem.Distributed photovoltaic power prediction main station system provided in an embodiment of the present invention, in a distributed manner based on photovoltaic plant real-time running data and environment detector meteorological data, the meteorological data index value in region to be predicted on each stereoscopic grid is obtained by mesoscale NWP subsystem, data assimilation processing is carried out in conjunction with history observation meteorological data, obtains accurate mesoscale NWP meteorological data.Power prediction subsystem obtains distributed photovoltaic power prediction information according to mesoscale NWP meteorological data and distributed photovoltaic historical data, realize the prediction of distributed photovoltaic list station power prediction, area power, distributed power precision of prediction is improved, realizes the fine-grained management to distributed photovoltaic.

title_en: Real-time database model online updating method and apparatus for distribution main station system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the real-time database model online updating method and apparatus for distribution main station system, belong to distribution network technology field, establish real-time database state and update list, update operation for real-time database state all during recording real-time database model online updating；The real-time database being currently running is run mode real-time database, establishes future-state real-time database using the run mode real-time database as source；Future-state real-time database carries out real-time database model modification；Meanwhile run mode real-time database response real-time database state updates operation；Future-state real-time database is switched to new run mode real-time database；List is updated according to real-time database state, it executes corresponding real-time database state and updates operation, realize the online updating of real-time database model, the present invention has an adverse effect to the locking of real-time database to the reliable continuous operation of distribution main station system during solving the problems, such as online updating, is of great significance to the safe and stable operation of distribution main station system.

title_en: A kind of disaster tolerant backup system based on distributed structure/architecture
abstract_en: The present invention relates to standby system technical fields, especially a kind of disaster tolerant backup system based on distributed structure/architecture, including calamity for device, the calamity is connected to the network with asynchronous remote mirror-image system and synchronous remote mirroring system respectively for device, the asynchronous remote mirror-image system and synchronous remote mirroring system are connect with mirror image switch module network, the mirror image switch module is successively connect with network delivery system and disaster recovery backup plant network, the disaster recovery backup device and the first data transportation system are connected to the network, the present invention can monitor calamity for device and disaster recovery backup device in real time by safety monitoring system, when safety monitoring system monitors that calamity has small data loss for device or disaster recovery backup device, it can carry out mutually passing in real time updating, can to data carry out in real time monitoring with it is synchronous, data can be accessed by interface unit , by disaster recovery backup device by pull-up of both working out a scheme, temporary offer service is not needed, provides application service in time for user.

title_en: Power grid robust state estimation method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid robust state estimation method based on multi-source data fusion, and belongs to the field of power distribution network dispatching automation. The method comprises the following steps: fusing the mixed measurement data of the power grid; and solving the state estimation of the fused measured data by using an robust state estimation algorithm based on the sum of least squares and one product. The example analysis shows that the robust state estimation based on the sum of least square and one multiplication is provided, the convergence and the robust are improved, and the defects that a BP network is easy to fall into local optimum and the training time is long due to the random initialization weight are overcome by adopting the DBN; the method can well fuse RTU and PMU measurement data, has good tolerance and is very suitable for practical engineering application.

title_en: A kind of micro-grid system dispatching method and device
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of micro-grid system dispatching method and device, comprising: environmental threshold value and fault threshold is arranged according to history scheduling scheme；Micro-grid system environmental parameter and micro-capacitance sensor operating parameter are obtained in real time；Judge whether the environmental parameter reaches scheduling thresholds: being, then controls micro-grid system and enter transition mode and isolated power grid judgement is carried out according to micro-capacitance sensor operating parameter and fault threshold；It is no, then it controls micro-capacitance sensor and keeps grid-connect mode.The present invention can automatically be scheduled micro-grid system, and enhance stability of the micro-grid system when meeting with extreme weather and micro-capacitance sensor failure by the way that transition mode is arranged.

title_en: Load coordination prediction method based on information re-correction
abstract_en: The application discloses a load coordination prediction method based on information re-correction, relates to the field of load prediction, and aims to solve the problem that the prediction precision of the existing load prediction method is not high. The method comprises the following specific steps: firstly, establishing a mathematical model by using the thought of power system state estimation and historical data, solving the reliability value of each level of prediction result by using a gray correlation theory, and evaluating the reliability value of the prediction result; secondly, carrying out secondary correction on the evaluated numerical value to obtain a secondary corrected numerical value; and thirdly, solving the reliability value of each new prediction result by utilizing the gray correlation theory. According to the method, the historical data is solved by adopting the gray correlation theory, then evaluation and secondary correction are carried out to obtain the secondary corrected numerical value, and then the secondary corrected numerical value is solved by adopting the gray correlation theory, so that the load prediction precision of each level and each voltage level can be improved.

title_en: Power grid missing data complementing method based on fuzzy clustering and Lagrange's interpolation

title_en: Method and arrangement for estimating a grid state of a power distribution grid
abstract_en: A method estimates a grid state of an electrical power distribution grid having a multiplicity of network sections, in which a central computer arrangement is used to receive measured values from measuring devices. A state estimation device is used to make a prediction of a future grid state, wherein a voltage and a phase angle are respectively ascertained for each network section, and in that a naive Bayes method is used for the prediction.

title_en: A kind of power distribution network multiple time scale model method for estimating state and system

title_en: Line parameter identification method based on parameter comprehensive suspicion
abstract_en: A line parameter identification method based on parameter comprehensive suspicion comprises the following steps: 1) Constructing a state estimation model based on a Lagrange multiplier method; 2) Utilizing the state estimation model in the step 1), establishing a suspicious circuit parameter set based on the suspicious measurement judging function and the parameters of the suspicious parameter judging function, and synthesizing suspicious degree indexes; 3) And performing closed loop correction on parameters in the suspicious line parameter set. The invention has the following advantages: 1. can have higher identification accuracy under the condition of measurement errors and even bad data. 2. The method has the advantages of higher parameter correction precision, good numerical stability, no reduction of state estimation redundancy and good stability. 3. The application prospect is wide: the power grid parameter identification and correction method can provide good technical support for the power grid parameter identification and correction method, so that the power grid parameter identification and correction method has good application prospect.

title_en: A kind of bilinearity WLAV method for estimating state considering zero injection-constraint
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of bilinearity WLAV method for estimating state for considering zero injection-constraint, and feature includes: the network parameter of 1 acquisition electric system；2 obtain node admittance matrix；3 obtain telemetry from electric system；4 calculate the weight of each measurement；5 gusts of calculating Jacobian matrixs；6 describe zero injection-constraint meter with equality constraint and arrive bilinearity WLAV state estimation.The present invention is effectively improved the estimated accuracy of zero injection node, so as to obtain more accurate state estimation result.

title_en: Project implementation condition managing method and system based on power grid

title_en: A kind of power scheduling Workforce Management on duty

title_en: Deep learning method for smart grid server flow anomaly detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep learning method for smart grid server flow anomaly detection. The method is based on high-dimensional time sequence data information for monitoring the flow of a power grid server, and utilizes an Encoder-Decoder deep neural network based on two layers of LSTM neurons to construct flow normal state estimation. And analyzing the distribution situation of the residual error between the estimated normal flow behavior and the actually measured value based on the estimated normal flow behavior, and finally giving a confidence interval as a control limit for judging the abnormal behavior, thereby realizing the detection of the abnormal flow behavior of the smart grid server. The method can self-adapt to the nonlinear relation between dynamic approximation variables, does not need to manually intervene to select variable characteristics, does not need to reduce the dimension of data, has certain universality, and has very important scientific significance and application value for preventing serious faults.

title_en: Multi-region distributed state evaluation method for power system
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-region distributed state evaluation method for an electric power system. According to the invention, an electric power system is divided into a plurality of non-overlapping areas, each area is provided with a state estimator, local state estimation is carried out according to measurement data provided by the SCADA system, and global information is obtained through an average consistency algorithm to carry out system level state estimation. The estimation process of each state estimator is parallel and is divided into an initialization phase and an iterative computation phase. An initialization stage gives a state estimation initial value, and obtains a measurement vector inside the region and a boundary measurement vector; in the iterative computation stage, the internal measurement update quantity of the state quantity is computed, the boundary measurement update quantity of the state quantity is computed after the global information is obtained through an average consistency algorithm, the total update quantity of the state quantity is computed according to the internal measurement update quantity and the boundary measurement update quantity, and the iterative computation process is ended when the total update quantity is smaller than a preset threshold value. The invention has high precision, high estimation speed, high reliability and less information exchange quantity.

title_en: Line loss prediction method under missing data set based on compressed sensing
abstract_en: The invention provides a line loss prediction method under a missing data set based on compressed sensing, and the method provided by the invention realizes the line loss prediction of a power grid under the missing data set, and comprises the following steps: clustering all characteristic quantities of the historical load data by adopting a clustering method according to three characteristic quantities of total load, load rate and peak-valley difference rate in the historical data of the power grid according to the principle of maximum profile coefficient; sorting the historical line loss data of each category into a time sequence matrix according to 24 integral points and decomposing the line loss time sequence into eigenmode components; and selecting a proper dictionary matrix, and performing sparse transformation on the mode components. Performing data completion based on compressed sensing on the transformed sparse matrix; carrying out inverse transformation of sparse transformation on the repaired matrix to recover a complete component sequence on a time domain; and (5) completing line loss prediction under the repair data set by utilizing an elman neural network. The method can be used for completing the missing data of the power grid and predicting the line loss of the power grid.

title_en: A kind of micro-capacitance sensor photovoltaic power generation short term prediction method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The present invention relates to micro-capacitance sensor photovoltaic generating system research fields, more particularly, to a kind of micro-capacitance sensor photovoltaic power generation short term prediction method based on deep learning, it the steps include: 1, data prediction, supplement amendment is carried out to bad data, the missing data in historical data, is then normalized to form training sample data；2, processed sample data is divided into the sample set of Various Seasonal, different broad sense weather patterns, inputs LSTM prediction model as training sample；3, LSTM Short-term Forecasting Model is established according to weather pattern and complete to train；4, the season according to belonging to prediction day and weather pattern forecast information select corresponding LSTM to predict submodel, export the photovoltaic power generation short-term forecast value of future time instance.The present invention is deeply excavated the power producing characteristics of photovoltaic power generation and is established prediction model using deep learning algorithm, is not needed valuable meteorologic survey equipment and instrument, is reduced costs, and has the wider scope of application.

title_en: A kind of parameter Estimation and bearing calibration of power supply transien process

title_en: Transformer equipment standing book checking processing method
abstract_en: The application discloses a checking and processing method of a transformer equipment standing book, which comprises the steps of firstly, acquiring data to be recorded of the transformer equipment standing book; checking and identifying whether the data to be recorded of the transformer equipment ledger is abnormal ledger data or not according to a database; if the data to be recorded in the transformer equipment ledger is abnormal ledger data, correcting the abnormal ledger data; and recording the corrected standing book data to be recorded in the database. And the automatic checking and processing of the abnormal standing book data of the power transformation equipment are realized, and the identification and statistics of the error and missing data are carried out. Compared with an artificial checking mode, the transformer equipment ledger checking processing method saves a great amount of time and cost, greatly improves the quality of the ledger basic data, ensures the uniqueness, the integrity and the accuracy of the equipment basic information, the technical parameters and other data, and provides support for promoting the improvement of the production management lean level.
