abstract_en: Disclosed is a 5-Layer based smart energy digital twin architecture method for realizing a sustainable smart energy city. According to the present invention, a 5-Layer based architecture comprises: a digital layer (layer 1); a home/buildings layer (layer 2); a mobility layer (layer 3); an infrastructure layer (layer 4); and a virtual layer (layer 5).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 스마트에너지시티 구현을 위한 5-Layer 기반 스마트 에너지 디지털 트윈 아키텍쳐법을 개시한다.
assignees: UNIV CHUNG ANG IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Distribution network voltage data missing filling method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a distribution network voltage data missing filling method and a distribution network voltage data missing filling device, and the method comprises the following steps: preprocessing the acquired historical section data to obtain a dimensionless section data set; clustering analysis is carried out on the dimensionless section data set by adopting an Euclidean distance algorithm or a log-likelihood distance algorithm to obtain a first clustered data set after clustering is successful; checking the first clustering data set through a strong association rule framework constructed according to a preset Apriori algorithm to obtain a second clustering data set; constructing a time sequence group according to the second clustered data set and the current missing data, wherein the time sequence group comprises a historical data sequence and a current missing data sequence; and filling the current missing data by the optimal historical data sequence selected according to the similarity determined by the time sequence group. The application solves the technical problems that the existing power grid voltage data missing filling technology is too complex and has no actual pertinence, and the power grid development requirement cannot be met.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Load prediction method based on meteorological similar days
abstract_en: The invention discloses a load prediction method based on meteorological similar days, which belongs to the technical field of power load prediction and comprises the following steps: s10, counting actual measurement load data and corresponding meteorological data; s20, preprocessing data, including removing missing data and abnormal data; carrying out data normalization on the load data after the elimination; s30, clustering, namely dividing load days into different categories according to meteorological data to form meteorological similar days; s40, establishing a support vector machine prediction model based on each moment of known load in the class to which the weather similar days belong; s50, training a support vector machine prediction model; s60, inputting the meteorological data of the day to be predicted into a support vector machine prediction model after training is completed, and obtaining the load prediction of the day to be predicted. On the basis of cluster analysis, the invention builds a regression prediction model by using the support vector mechanism, optimizes punishment parameters and kernel function parameters of the model based on the idea of cross validation, reduces prediction errors and improves prediction precision.

title_en: Design method of pipeline digital twin system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of pipeline safety and life cycle management, and particularly relates to a design method of a pipeline digital twin system, which consists of a pipeline digital twin body, a pipeline monitoring system, a pipeline inside/outside nondestructive detection database, a pipeline design/operation maintenance database and a pipeline data mining analysis system, wherein the pipeline digital twin body forms a higher-level co-intelligence twin body through information exchange with a geological disaster twin body. The modeling of the pipeline digital twin body adopts a global-local method, takes a real-time displacement acquisition value of a pipeline monitoring system as a displacement boundary condition, and takes a strain/temperature value of a detection optical fiber as verification and correction data. The pipeline data mining analysis system is applied to promote the evolution of a pipeline digital twin body. The pipeline digital twin system can display a high-risk area of a pipeline in real time, propose internal detection requirements, recommend supplementary monitoring points, identify the falling position of a detection optical fiber, evaluate the safety margin of the pipeline, recommend a reinforcing method and predict reinforcing effects.

title_en: Model prediction control-based power system equipment overload correction control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a model predictive control-based power system equipment overload correction control method, which is applied to power system equipment overload real-time correction control, and is used for judging the equipment overload amount based on measurement data of an SCADA (supervisory control and data acquisition) system of a dispatching control center, acquiring the running state of the system within a period of time in the future from ultra-short-term dispatching plan, load prediction and new energy power prediction data, calculating the control sensitivity of a conventional unit and a new energy unit by adopting state estimation data, solving an objective function comprehensively considering the minimum control cost and the maximum new energy consumption to realize the online rolling optimization of a control strategy sequence for 15min in the future, and taking a first group of control measures of the control strategy sequence to be issued and executed by an AGC (automatic gain control) system. The method realizes the automatic control of the real-time correction of the overload of the power system equipment based on model predictive control, and greatly improves the dynamic performance, stability and robustness of the control.

title_en: Second-order cone planning robust state estimation method and system for electric heating comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention provides a second-order cone planning robust state estimation method of an electric heating comprehensive energy system, which comprises the steps of obtaining measurement of the electric heating comprehensive energy system, inputting the measurement into a pre-built second-order cone planning state estimation model of the electric heating comprehensive energy system to obtain an estimated value of node voltage amplitude of an electric power system, an estimated value of node phase angle of the electric power system, an estimated value of node pressure of a thermodynamic system, an estimated value of node heat supply temperature and an estimated value of node heat regeneration temperature, wherein the measurement of the electric heating comprehensive energy system comprises measurement of the electric power system and measurement of the thermodynamic system.

title_en: Double-layer robust state estimation method and system for electric heating comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention provides a double-layer robust state estimation method of an electric heating comprehensive energy system, which comprises the following steps: acquiring measurement of an electric power system quantity and measurement of a thermodynamic system quantity of an electric heating comprehensive energy system; the thermodynamic system quantity measurement comprises hydraulic network quantity measurement and thermodynamic network quantity measurement; measuring the quantity of a power system and the quantity of a hydraulic network, inputting the measured quantities into a hydraulic network state estimation model of the power system, and obtaining a state variable estimation value and a hydraulic network state variable estimation value of the power system, and branch flow and node injection flow estimation values of the hydraulic network; the method comprises the steps of measuring branch flow of a hydraulic network, estimated value of node injection flow and a thermal network quantity, inputting a thermal network state estimation model, and obtaining estimated value of state variable of the thermal network.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power distribution network D-PMU optimal configuration method considering node differences
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network D-PMU optimal configuration method considering node difference, which comprises the following steps: obtaining a node-branch adjacency list of the power distribution network based on breadth-first search, and calculating four single node vulnerability indexes of node degree, node cohesion degree, node betweenness and node compactness of the power distribution network; acquiring comprehensive weight of indexes based on objective weight and subjective weight obtained by an entropy method and an analytic hierarchy process; solving a node comprehensive vulnerability index by adopting the TOPSIS-grey correlation degree, and taking the node comprehensive vulnerability index as a node weight in an optimized configuration model; adopting self-adaptive genetic calculation to satisfy a completely considerable D-PMU optimal configuration scheme of the system at one time; calculating the unobservable depth by adopting a depth-first search and Dikostricke combined method; sequencing the one-time schemes according to the importance degree of the nodes, and reducing the unobservable depth stage by stage to obtain a staged D-PMU configuration scheme; and D-PMU equipment is configured stage by stage according to the priority order according to the configuration scheme, so that the maximum measurement redundancy is obtained, and the precision of the state estimation of the power distribution network is improved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: Power electronic circuit fault diagnosis method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power electronic circuit fault diagnosis method based on digital twinning, which comprises the steps of firstly, collecting a load voltage signal of an actual power electronic circuit to be detected, and establishing an initial digital twinning model according to the working principle of the actual power electronic circuit to be detected and nominal component parameters; mapping the collected load voltage signal and the running state of the actual power electronic circuit to be tested to the initial digital twin model to obtain a residual expression and an error square sum target function of the load voltage of the actual power electronic circuit to be tested and the initial digital twin model, optimizing the target function by using a least square algorithm to update the initial digital twin model, finally realizing component parameter estimation of the actual power electronic circuit to be tested to obtain a parameter estimation value, analyzing the parameter estimation value to diagnose a fault position, and finally realizing fault diagnosis of the actual power electronic circuit to be tested.
assignees: UNIV ANHUI SCI & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Power system state determination method, device, computer medium and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of computers, in particular to a method and a device for determining the state of a power system, a computer medium and a storage medium, wherein the method for determining the state of the power system comprises the following steps: acquiring system measurement data, system topological network information and a node admittance matrix and establishing a power system state estimation model; processing a system state quantity equation according to an ensemble filtering algorithm, and establishing a time updating ellipsoid; processing a system quantity measurement equation according to a self-adaptive algorithm; and determining a measurement update ellipsoid. According to the method for determining the state of the power system, provided by the embodiment of the invention, the state estimation is carried out on the system state quantity equation through the collective filtering algorithm, and the collective filtering algorithm is combined with the adaptive algorithm program, so that the non-Gaussian noise distribution can be better adapted, meanwhile, the adaptive algorithm is utilized to process the system quantity measurement equation, the data processing sequence in the system quantity measurement equation can be adjusted, the redundancy of the measured data is fully utilized, and the numerical precision is further improved.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Electric power missing data identification method and related device
abstract_en: The application discloses a power missing data identification method and a related device, a clustering set is obtained by clustering and analyzing historical voltage data at a certain voltage position, multidimensional correlation analysis is carried out by utilizing voltage data correlation attributes, data with the maximum attribute comprehensive weighted value in the historical voltage data are taken as a substitute value of the certain voltage position, and abnormal point judgment is carried out on the substitute value based on a nuclear clustering analysis method, so that the substitute value finally filled to the voltage missing position is determined, the missing data filling accuracy is improved, the existing technical problem that power grid data quality is reduced due to power grid data missing and inconvenience is brought to information development of a smart power grid is solved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Abnormal operation data processing method for wind turbine generator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for processing abnormal operation data of a wind turbine, which comprises the following steps: preprocessing data: for wind speed-power abnormal data with wind speed greater than cut-in wind speed and less than cut-out wind speed and power less than or equal to zero, eliminating the data of the part; the preprocessed wind speed-power abnormal data is firstly identified and removed by using a Thompson tau method; performing secondary identification and elimination on the wind speed-power abnormal data after the primary identification and elimination by using a quartile method; adopting a four-point interpolation subdivision algorithm to carry out interpolation reconstruction on the misdeleted and missing data; the method solves the technical problems that the abnormal operation data processing of the wind turbine generator is inapplicable under the condition of more wind power plant fan types, the dependence on available data of adjacent wind power plants is too high, the error is gradually increased along with the increase of the distance of the fans, the accuracy is reduced, the reconstruction result depends on the correlation degree of the wind power plants, the model solving is complex when the data quantity is more, and the like.

title_en: Power system dynamic security assessment method based on generation countermeasure network
abstract_en: A dynamic safety assessment method for a power system based on a generation countermeasure network comprises the following steps: step 1: constructing an initial sample set containing a large number of operation variables and transient stability margin safety indexes; step 2: constructing an efficient sample set containing key characteristic data and TSMs (short range switches) labels; and step 3: obtaining a GAN model and a dynamic security assessment model which can accurately fill up missing data; and 4, step 4: detecting the integrity of the PMUs data in real time through an intelligent system, and if the data are complete, directly inputting the data into a DSA model to perform DSA of the power system; and if the data are missing, inputting incomplete data acquired by the PMUs into a GAN model to fill the missing data, and inputting the filled complete data set into a DSA model to perform DSA of the power system. The invention provides a power system DSA method based on GAN, which can quickly and accurately fill up missing data and carry out DSA on the system aiming at the problem of data loss of the power system, is beneficial to electric power operators to quickly take control measures and avoids faults and economic loss.
assignees: UNIV CHINA THREE GORGES CTGU

title_en: Fire prediction method, storage device and processor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire prediction method, a processor and a storage device, wherein the fire prediction method comprises the steps of obtaining a fire-fighting monitoring object and fire-fighting equipment associated with the fire-fighting monitoring object; acquiring the relative position of the fire fighting equipment relative to the corresponding fire fighting detection object, and binding the fire fighting equipment with the relative position; establishing a digital twin system with the state vector and relative position relation of the fire fighting equipment at each moment; predicting values of state vectors of all fire fighting equipment associated with the fire fighting monitoring object at a certain moment; and calculating the probability that the value of the state vector of all the fire fighting equipment associated with the fire fighting monitoring object is possibly a fire disaster, and multiplying the probabilities corresponding to all the fire fighting equipment associated with the fire fighting monitoring object to obtain the probability that the fire fighting monitoring object generates the fire disaster at a certain moment. The method can predict the probability of fire at a certain time in the future, eliminate the hidden fire danger in advance, reduce property loss and improve the safety of buildings.
assignees: GREE ELECTRIC APPLIANCES INC ZHUHAI

title_en: MIMO radar target tracking method based on parallel segmentation particle filtering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a MIMO radar target tracking method based on parallel segmentation particle filtering, which comprises the following steps: s1, obtaining MIMO radar trace data; s2, initializing particle filter parameters: step 3, calculating the target number and the target state of the MIMO radar trace data based on a potential probability hypothesis density filtering algorithm at the moment when k = 1; s4, calculating the target number and the target state of the MIMO radar trace data by adopting a parallel segmentation particle filtering algorithm based on potential probability hypothesis density filtering at the moment that k is larger than 1; and S5, repeatedly executing the step S4 to finish the target tracking of the MIMO radar. Compared with the existing particle filter target tracking algorithm based on the potential probability hypothesis density, the method can solve the problem that dimensionality disasters are easy to occur in the prior art, and has obvious performance advantages in target number and state estimation accuracy.

title_en: Dynamic assessment method for air conditioner load demand response capability
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic assessment method for air conditioner load demand response capability, which is applied to real-time dynamic assessment of the capability of an air conditioner cluster participating in power grid auxiliary service through demand side response; the method is realized by depending on an intelligent terminal ST deployed in a load local, a management terminal MT deployed in a dispatching center and a bidirectional communication infrastructure between the intelligent terminal ST and the management terminal MT; the method comprises the steps that a local intelligent terminal ST identifies load characteristic parameters based on operation data of an air conditioner, a parameter model and a real-time operation state are adopted to solve response capacity indexes, and the required data are periodically uploaded to a management terminal MT; the management terminal MT receives data uploaded by each intelligent terminal ST in the jurisdiction range, combines an operation state estimation algorithm to obtain high-time-precision air conditioner response capability information, considers two capability indexes of response power and response duration to complete response capability aggregation of an air conditioner cluster, and can realize response capability evaluation of different update frequencies by adjusting an iteration period lambda.

title_en: Power system prediction auxiliary state estimation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for estimating a prediction auxiliary state of an electric power system, which comprises the steps of constructing a dynamic model for predicting the state of the electric power system; calculating the state estimator of the dynamic model by using a nonlinear Kalman filter; judging whether an abnormality occurs based on the number of counted new information, performing abnormality detection, and distinguishing an abnormality caused by a plurality of bad data from sudden load changes which unevenly affect all new information; identifying bad data by using a maximum innovation method according to the detected abnormal type, identifying nodes with sudden load change, and identifying nodes removed after a fault; if any bad data is identified, deleting the bad data and returning to the anomaly detection step, if any sudden load change is identified, refusing to predict and executing static estimation; if any branch is identified as a broken line, prediction is rejected, topology is updated and static estimation is performed. The invention can accurately detect and identify three abnormal types and identify abnormal positions under different power system operation conditions.

title_en: Full-period power battery management system applying digital twinning technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a full-period power battery management system applying a digital twin technology, which can effectively reduce the experimental amount in the early development process and shorten the development period compared with the prior art. The on-line end and the cloud end respectively adopt algorithms with different time scales, so that the real-time performance of on-line end processing can be guaranteed, and meanwhile, higher calculation accuracy is realized at the cloud end. According to the system, through analysis of the cloud twin system on historical data, defects in the aspects of battery materials, structures and the like can be found in time, meanwhile, tracing can be conducted on a fault battery, fault reasons can be explored, powerful reference is provided for optimization and development of a new battery core, and therefore data closed loop is achieved. For the echelon utilization process, the real state of the physical model can be judged through the twin model, and classification and recombination of batteries in different aging states are quickly realized, so that the problems that the state before recombination of the traditional echelon utilization batteries is difficult to quickly judge, and the inconsistency after recombination is large are effectively solved.
assignees: BEIJING INSTITUTE TECH

title_en: Power distribution network distributed state estimation method based on hybrid measurement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network distributed state estimation method based on hybrid measurement, which comprises the following steps: step 1, firstly, forming mixed measurement by using measurement data of mu PMU and SCADA in a power distribution network, considering the data combination problem and the time synchronization problem under the background of the mixed measurement, and modeling the mixed measurement; step 2, considering the electrical distance of the system nodes of the power distribution network, taking the modularity as an evaluation index, and performing non-overlapping optimal partitioning on the power distribution network based on a community discovery algorithm; and 3, performing distributed state estimation on the power distribution network according to the model of the hybrid measurement and the optimal partitioning result. The method can make up the defect of the current state estimation method in the real-time property of the obtained measurement data, improves the precision and speed of the state estimation algorithm, and provides theoretical support for the safety evaluation fault location of the power distribution network.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Filtering estimation and prediction estimation method for multi-state variables of power system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of filtering estimation and prediction estimation of state variables and discloses a filtering estimation and prediction estimation method for multi-state variables of a power system, which comprises the following steps: step 1: establishing a time point estimation method based on a Kalman filter; step 2: establishing a Kalman filter-based vector block state estimation method; and step 3: establishing block state real-time smooth estimation, filtering estimation and prediction estimation based on Kalman filtering; the model established by the method is more reasonable, accords with the actual situation, has higher actual use value, and effectively improves the working stability of the distributed power grid; the goal of minimizing the estimated error is achieved.
assignees: HENAN BOTELI INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY SERVICES CO LTD

title_en: Online state estimation method and device for hybrid energy storage system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of clean energy storage, and discloses an online state estimation method for a hybrid energy storage system, which comprises the steps of obtaining the instant voltage and the instant current of a storage battery and a super capacitor which are processed by a sampling circuit; when the increase value of the instant current is detected to exceed a preset threshold value, performing online capacity estimation on the instant voltages of the storage battery and the super capacitor; performing feature extraction on the instant voltage, and estimating the residual electric quantity of the storage battery and the super capacitor through a trained fuzzy brain emotion learning model; sending output data of the fuzzy brain emotion learning model; the device is also disclosed, the voltage and the current of the hybrid energy storage system after the load is impacted are utilized, and a neural network model designed by combining a fuzzy inference system and a brain emotion learning model is used as a state classifier, so that the state of the hybrid energy storage system is quickly, accurately and timely estimated on line, the device is suitable for being applied to a micro-grid and an uninterruptible power system, and the reliability of a power system is improved.

title_en: Cloud-based hybrid state estimation
abstract_en: Systems, methods, techniques and apparatuses of power network state estimation are disclosed. One exemplary embodiment is a method for state estimation in a power network comprising receiving a set of supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) information including a power network topology; generating a SCADA state estimation using the set of SCADA information; receiving, with a cloud-computing architecture, a set of PMU phasors; aligning, with the cloud-computing architecture, a timestamp of the SCADA estimation and a timestamp of the set of PMU phasors; updating, with the cloud-computing architecture, the power network topology using the set of PMU phasors; generating, with the cloud-computing architecture, a hybrid state estimation using the updated power network topology, the set of PMU phasors, and the SCADA state estimation; and transmitting the hybrid state estimation to a local control system.
assignees: HITACHI ENERGY LTD

title_en: Deep learning-based power utilization risk judgment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep learning-based power utilization risk judgment method, which comprises three steps of historical data cleaning and missing value completion, risk judgment model establishment and detection, power utilization prediction and risk judgment, wherein the historical data cleaning and missing value completion uses an expectation maximization algorithm to perform interpolation on missing data, the risk judgment model establishment and detection adopts an FCM fuzzy clustering algorithm to process data set characteristics according to historical data samples, and each characteristic weight and model data are extracted; and finally, predicting the electricity consumption condition according to the characteristic weights, and giving a prediction data judgment result according to a judgment principle. According to the invention, the field of big data analysis, neural network and electric power marketing is combined, so that the power consumption prediction capability and the power consumption risk monitoring capability are improved.
assignees: Jiangsu electric power information technology co ltd;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Utility network project modeling & management
abstract_en: Provided herein are embodiments of systems, devices, and methods for a digital collaborative system for electric, water and gas engineering and operations. The systems, devices, and methods include an automatic and intelligent synchronization of simultaneous and parallel project or digital twin modifications between multiple users in a collaborative environment that integrates utility engineering and operation teams.
assignees: SHOKOOH FARROKH;KHANDELWAL TANUJ;SHOKOOH SHERVIN

title_en: Anti-electricity-stealing early warning method based on space-time correlation matrix
abstract_en: An anti-electricity-stealing early warning method based on a space-time incidence matrix relates to the field of power grids and comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of cleaning and correcting abnormal data of the low-voltage household meter, calculating theoretical line loss of a transformer area, analyzing line loss fluctuation, analyzing current fluctuation, identifying space dimensionality, identifying time dimensionality and identifying relation dimensionality, calculating a pre-estimated value of missing data through cleaning and correcting the low-voltage household meter, then calculating theoretical line loss, analyzing line loss fluctuation and analyzing current fluctuation, identifying electricity stealing risks, judging whether electricity stealing behaviors exist in a low-voltage user or not only when the three are judged to have the electricity stealing risks, analyzing the electricity stealing behaviors in three dimensions of space-time-relation, comprehensively analyzing whether the low-voltage user has the electricity stealing behaviors or not, judging the user as an electricity stealing user if one of the three dimensions is judged to be the electricity stealing user, and detecting the electricity stealing behaviors of the low-voltage user.

title_en: Industrial power load prediction method based on multi-Agent distributed mass data processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses an industrial power load prediction method based on multi-Agent distributed mass data processing, which comprises mass high-dimensional data preprocessing, a multi-Agent distributed processor and gene expression programming algorithm model training and prediction. Preprocessing mass high-dimensional data, supplementing or deleting missing data, and performing weight calculation on characteristic influence factors to obtain a weighted industrial power load matrix; the multi-Agent distributed processor groups the preprocessed data, places all groups of data in different agents, respectively inputs the data into a gene expression programming algorithm model for training, inputs the characteristic vector of a day to be predicted, and calculates and outputs all groups of predicted load values; and training and predicting the gene expression programming algorithm model by using the grouped historical data as a training set, inputting the date to be predicted into the model after the training is finished, and outputting a predicted value. The invention reduces the difficulty of processing massive high-dimensional data and improves the speed and accuracy of prediction.

title_en: Auxiliary positioning method and system for power inspection unmanned aerial vehicle based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention provides an auxiliary positioning method and system for an unmanned power inspection machine based on digital twins, and relates to the field of power inspection. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring tower three-dimensional point cloud data, tower foundation data, tower geographic data, unmanned aerial vehicle three-dimensional point cloud data, unmanned aerial vehicle foundation data, unmanned aerial vehicle flight control data and tower surrounding environment three-dimensional point cloud data; processing the three-dimensional point cloud data based on a digital twinning technology to obtain three-dimensional models; combining the three models to obtain a power inspection digital twin scene; acquiring an observation radius and an observation angle of the unmanned aerial vehicle based on basic data of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and determining a third visual angle observation point of the unmanned aerial vehicle; determining the real-time position of the unmanned aerial vehicle relative to the tower; and displaying the real-time position of the unmanned aerial vehicle relative to the tower in real time in the electric power inspection digital twin scene, and displaying a third person weighing visual angle picture of the unmanned aerial vehicle based on a third visual angle observation point of the unmanned aerial vehicle. The invention has high safety and reliability.
assignees: UNIV HEFEI TECHNOLOGY;ANHUI TRANS AND TRANSFORMATION ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Data driving method for dynamic security assessment of power system
abstract_en: A data driving method for dynamic security assessment of an electrical power system, comprising the steps of: step one): obtaining operation data of the power system, constructing corresponding dynamic safety indexes, and constructing an initial sample set containing the operation data set and the dynamic safety indexes; step two): processing the initial sample set to achieve the purposes of data compression and dimension reduction, and generating a high-efficiency sample set; step three): obtaining a dynamic security assessment model; step four): acquiring a near-real-time updating sample set to finish updating the dynamic security assessment model; step five): and (3) finishing the evaluation of the real-time dynamic safety state of the power system to obtain a real-time dynamic safety evaluation result. The invention aims to provide a dynamic safety assessment method which is beneficial to improving the assessment speed and the prediction precision, and is beneficial to system operators to take preventive control measures in time, so that the running stability of a power system and the reliability of power supply are improved.

title_en: Method for supplementing missing value by applying Bayesian estimation in power load prediction
abstract_en: In power load prediction, the historical load data of a given unit is usually the important basic data for performing prediction calculation and simulation, but it is the principle that the data set of the power load data contains missing values due to various reasons (such as data loss caused by an emergency, etc.), and these missing values are usually left as blank or marked as placeholders. When the power load prediction model trains a data set containing many missing values, the presence of the missing values may greatly affect the performance of the machine learning model. The invention provides a method for supplementing missing data by applying Bayesian estimation to missing values in historical load data in power load prediction, which is characterized in that a Bayesian estimation method is used for calculating maximum likelihood to supplement the missing values in a power historical load data set.
assignees: SHANGHAI IESLAB ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for supplementing missing value by applying multiple interpolation in power load prediction
abstract_en: In the power load prediction model, accurate and effective power historical load data are very important, play an important role in power prediction data analysis and model calculation, and when the abnormal values are brought into the power load prediction model or mathematical analysis, the accuracy and simulation effect of power load prediction can be greatly reduced, and the abnormal values need to be analyzed and eliminated through a mathematical statistical method. In addition, many missing values may be caused by various uncontrollable reasons during power operation, which may cause the imperfection of the historical power load data set. The missing values can be supplemented through a reasonable and effective method, and the supplemented data set is an important part for guaranteeing the accurate prediction of the power load prediction model. The invention provides a method for supplementing missing data by applying a Multiple Interpolation (MICE) method to missing values in historical power load data, and the missing data is supplemented to ensure the integrity of the historical power load data.
assignees: SHANGHAI IESLAB ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid state estimation method of GPU parallel acceleration preprocessing conjugate gradient iteration method
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid state estimation method of a GPU parallel acceleration preprocessing conjugate gradient iteration method, which adopts a preprocessing conjugate gradient iteration method by utilizing the symmetrical positive characteristic of a linear equation set coefficient matrix A in the state estimation of a weighted least square method, wherein the preprocessing conjugate gradient method is based on the conjugate gradient method, and the preprocessed coefficient matrix M is used for replacing the original coefficient matrix A so as to reduce the condition number of the coefficient matrix, accelerate the convergence rate of an algorithm, and meanwhile, an incomplete LU decomposition preprocessing method is adopted, so that the GPU parallel computing architecture is adopted, the computing speed and the computing efficiency of the state estimation of a power system are improved, the occupancy rate of a memory and a video memory are reduced, and the real-time requirement of the state estimation of the large-scale power system is met.

title_en: Anti-differential state estimation method for intelligent power distribution network
abstract_en: A method for estimating the anti-differential state of an intelligent power distribution network comprises the steps of constructing a static model and a dynamic model of the system according to various parameters and measurement configuration conditions of the intelligent power distribution network, obtaining an initial value through static anti-differential state estimation, then obtaining measurement of a mu M-PMU in an SDADA measurement period, generating a corresponding measurement model according to the obtaining time, carrying out state prediction after dynamic filtering, and obtaining an anti-differential state estimation result. According to the invention, static robust state estimation is introduced into two-period dynamic state estimation, and a two-period data fusion method is established, so that robust estimation can be carried out by effectively utilizing SCADA data, and data of two periods before and after the estimation can be associated by utilizing an estimation result.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG;STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power distribution network state estimation method considering mining history data
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution network state estimation method considering mining history data, and relates to the field of power system dispatching automation. Firstly, calculating a mining measurement estimated value of a station area which is not measured and acquired in real time in a power distribution network at the current moment by an interpolation method; then according to the real-time topological structure of the power distribution network, combining real-time measurement configuration in the power distribution network and real-time measurement of a power distribution feeder gateway, calculating the acquired measurement correction estimated value of a transformer area which is not acquired by real-time measurement in a transformer area list powered by each feeder at the current moment; and finally, comprehensively considering the real-time measurement data and the measurement variance of the corrected data by using the measurement estimation, and calling a power distribution network state estimation method to finish the accurate estimation of the power distribution network running state. The invention fully utilizes the mining history data to expand the observable range of power distribution network calculation, greatly saves the equipment investment required by real-time data acquisition of the power distribution network, realizes the accurate estimation of the running state of the power distribution network, and plays an important role in the analysis control of the power distribution network.

title_en: Method for adjusting position of camera based on three-dimensional scene of power transmission line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for adjusting the position of a camera based on a three-dimensional scene of a power transmission line, which relates to the field of video monitoring of high-voltage power transmission lines and comprises the following steps: step 1: reading in point cloud data of the digital twin model; step 2: respectively extracting characteristic points according to point cloud classification; and step 3: reading the fed back camera parameters; and 4, step 4: iteratively reading the positions of all cameras in the adjusting range of the bracket; and 5: calculating the visual fields of all the concerned objects under each position; step 6: ranking the view quality under each position according to the weight of the attention object; and 7: giving the optimal adjusting position of the camera according to the sequencing result; and 8: adjusting the position of the camera according to the optimal adjusting position; the shielding of adjacent objects such as iron towers and the like is effectively avoided, visual blind areas are reduced, manual operation of supervision personnel can be assisted, and the efficiency and the accuracy are improved; and a 5G network can be adopted, so that the remote transmission rate is further improved.
assignees: SOUTHWEST ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD CHINA POWER ENG CONSULTING GROUP

title_en: A system employing electrical digital twin for solar photovoltaic power plant
abstract_en: : An automated system and method, which implements an electrical digital twin 5 (100), for efficient operation & maintenance and asset management of a solar pv power plant is disclosed herein. The said system comprises plurality of weather sensors (400) for collecting "time-stamped" operational data of geo-location specific solar pv power plant in real-time or on-demand; a "plant build" module (300) to configure an as-built and as-operated solar PV power plant; a "component" 10 module (200) to configure OEM device specific data related to the solar pv power plant; an "electrical digital twin engine" (100) for making performance and losses predictions by utilizing weather data generated by the weather sensors and plant configuration data generated by the "plant build" and the "component" module; and a remote server to store, execute and deliver the predictions data to consumers.
assignees: HELIOS IOT SYSTEMS PRIVATE LTD

title_en: Linearization technology for optimizing power grid operation constraint calculation
abstract_en: The invention provides a linearization technique for optimizing power grid operation constraint calculation, which utilizes the principle of an inversion process in a linearization process, applies a state estimation technique to search the internal state of a network, and generates a linearization diagram according to input and output Jacobian matrixes. In linearized mapping, a pseudo matrix is used instead of the inverse matrix on the input jacobian side to avoid the singularities of the system. Inequality constraints are created using arbitrary system output vectors for various control variables, linear programming is applied to find the best solution, and a solution demonstration is performed on a 29 bus electrical network. The method overcomes the defect that when the low rank of the system is insufficient or the output end has too much constraint, a solution of the corresponding situation can be found.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Online updating method for ADACC _ N platform alarm card of nuclear power plant
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of DCS control of nuclear power plants, and particularly relates to an online updating method for an ADACS _ N platform alarm card of a nuclear power plant. The alarm card comprises an alarm picture and an alarm logic sketch, and the alarm picture and the alarm logic sketch are stored separately and are updated separately; the method realizes the online updating of the alarm card by writing an online updating method script of the alarm card, and the online updating method script of the alarm card is placed in a system management engineer station. The invention solves the problem that the ADACS _ N platform can not update the alarm card on line, optimizes the alarm function of the digital nuclear power plant, realizes the online update of the alarm card under the condition of not influencing the functions of a main control room, can newly add a temporary alarm card at any time according to the operation requirement, makes up the short board for updating the alarm card of the ADACS _ N platform, and avoids the condition that an operator takes the paper version alarm rules again to influence a monitoring disc.

title_en: Method for interpolating and supplementing missing value based on neighbor algorithm in power load prediction
abstract_en: In the commercial operation reform of the power grid, accurate power load prediction data has important applications in both economy and operation. In power load prediction, accurate historical load data is an important basis for prediction calculation and simulation. The data quality of the historical load data is particularly critical to accurately and efficiently operate the power load data prediction model. The invention discloses a method for supplementing missing data by applying a KNN interpolation method to missing values in historical power load data, which can effectively fill the aims of the missing data and abnormal data rejection caused by various reasons in the historical power load data, practically improve the data quality applied to a power load prediction model, further improve the power load prediction effect and provide powerful support for power grid operation management, decision making and the like.
assignees: SHANGHAI IESLAB ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Accurate prediction method for power selling amount of power distribution station area based on modal GRU learning network
abstract_en: A method for accurately predicting the electricity selling amount of a power distribution station area based on a modal GRU learning network comprises the following steps: s1, obtaining historical data of electricity sales of the distribution room, and dividing a test set and a training set; s2, preprocessing data, complementing sampling time points to ensure continuity of the sampling time points, and filling missing data of sampling points by using an average interpolation method; s3, determining the optimal mode number K of Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD) according to the center frequency of each mode component by using an experimental method; s4, VMD decomposition is carried out on the historical data of the electricity sales volume of the distribution room, and low-frequency modal components and high-frequency modal components after decomposition are respectively extracted; s5, respectively predicting a low-frequency mode and a high-frequency mode by using a Prophet prediction model and a GRU learning network; and S6, reconstructing prediction results of each mode to obtain a predicted value of the power selling amount of the distribution room. The method and the device can improve the prediction precision of the power selling amount of the distribution room, and can provide theoretical and practical support for the accurate prediction and management of the power selling amount of the distribution room.
assignees: NANJING INST TECH

title_en: Power transmission line structure health assessment method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The application relates to a method and a system for evaluating the structural health of a transmission line based on digital twins, comprising the following steps: taking the structural parameters of the power transmission line and external loads as input, and taking stress states, damage states and fatigue lives corresponding to the power transmission line under different environmental conditions as output, training a machine learning model; constructing a digital twin model of the power transmission line to be evaluated; and transmitting the real-time environment state information along the power transmission line to be evaluated to the digital twin model, outputting stress information, damage information and fatigue state corresponding to the power transmission line to be evaluated, and evaluating the structural health condition of the power transmission line to be evaluated in real time. According to the invention, the health state of the power transmission line is monitored and evaluated in real time in the digital space, so that the defect identification is more comprehensive and the identification efficiency is higher.

title_en: Power load prediction method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power load prediction method and a device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: inputting the original data set into a BP neural network, traversing and searching to obtain the position of missing data, outputting the missing data value, and filling the missing data to obtain a complete data set; parameter optimizing is carried out on the complete data set, and an optimal super parameter is output to generate an optimal super parameter vector; constructing an LSTM neural network by utilizing the optimal super-parameter vector, and inputting training data to train the LSTM neural network to obtain an LSTM model; inputting test data, and testing an LSTM model; inputting characteristic values to the LSTM model which passes the test, and carrying out power load prediction, wherein the characteristic values comprise air temperature, humidity, wind speed, historical data and predicted time points; the invention has the advantages that: time and resources are reduced, and prediction accuracy and authenticity are improved.

title_en: Wind turbine generator loss electric quantity on-line calculation method based on generated energy availability
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind turbine generator loss electric quantity on-line calculation method based on generated energy availability, which comprises the following steps: classifying the loss electric quantity according to the state code of the wind turbine generator; establishing a curve as a reference curve for calculating real-time loss electric quantity by referring to a Bien method in the national standard; performing sliding average on the curve according to a preset period to realize online updating of the reference curve; taking the average wind speed of each statistical period as input, and calculating the theoretical power of the current moment by combining a reference curve; calculating real-time statistical values of theoretical power generation capacity, actual power generation capacity and loss electric quantity of each statistical period based on the theoretical power and the actual power; and quantitatively evaluating the loss electric quantity of the wind turbine generator according to the category by combining the state classification of the loss electric quantity of the wind turbine generator. According to the technical scheme, the wind speed-power curve of the wind turbine generator is used as a reference, the loss electric quantity is calculated in real time, and is classified according to the standard loss electric quantity of the generated energy availability, and quantitative evaluation is carried out.
assignees: ZHEJIANG WINDEY CO LTD

title_en: User electricity utilization characteristic selection method based on maximum correlation minimum redundancy criterion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power consumer electricity utilization characteristic selection method based on a maximum relevant minimum redundancy criterion, which comprises the following steps: preprocessing user power consumption data acquired by the intelligent measurement terminal, including filling and removing missing data and distortion data; providing a method for selecting a clustering class number k value, and obtaining an optimal k value and completing clustering by constructing an aggregate return index with both aggregation degree and separation degree; and (3) providing a feature selection method comprehensively considering the effectiveness and the simplicity of the features, adopting a maximum correlation minimum redundancy criterion as a criterion, and solving by a traversal method to obtain an optimal feature set. Compared with the prior art, the method can be an optimal feature set which is optimized and has both effectiveness and simplicity, and the selected high-quality power utilization feature set can greatly reduce the data required to be calculated during analysis, reduce the calculated amount and effectively improve the analysis performance in the face of the rapid increase of power utilization data in a big data environment.

title_en: State estimation of a power grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to a computer-assisted method for the state estimation (2) of a power grid, in particular a low- and/or medium-voltage grid, by means of an artificial neural network (1), wherein the neural network (1) has one or more inputs (41) technically associated with the power grid, and wherein the state estimation (2) is calculated using captured temporal measurement signals (4) of the power grid which are used as inputs (41) for the neural network (1). The method is characterized in that at least the amplitude (42) of a harmonic of one of the measurement signals (4) is used as an input (41) for the neural network (1). The invention also relates to an associated method for training an artificial neural network (1) and to a corresponding artificial neural network (1).
assignees: SIEMENS AG

title_en: Method for interpolating and supplementing missing value by applying classification regression tree in power load prediction
abstract_en: A method for interpolating and supplementing missing values by applying a classification regression tree in power load prediction. How to accurately predict future power load becomes a core component for ensuring the safety of a power system and realizing scientific management and scheduling of a power grid in the current power operation. In power load prediction, when historical load data is missing, a prediction model system can lose a large amount of useful information, uncertainty shown in the prediction model system can be more obvious, and the deterministic component of the implication in the system is more difficult to grasp, so that manual intervention is required, and the missing value is supplemented through a mathematical method. The invention discloses a method for supplementing missing data by applying a classification regression tree interpolation method to missing values in historical power load data, which can effectively fill the purpose of missing values in the historical power load data caused by various reasons, improve the data integrity applied to a power load prediction model, ensure the accuracy of the result of power load prediction and provide powerful support for power grid operation management, decision and the like.
assignees: SHANGHAI IESLAB ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-element pregnant disaster digital twin intelligent perception identification early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a multivariate pregnancy disaster digital twin intelligent perception identification early warning system and a method thereof, which relate to the technical field of mine production, can realize effective complementation of virtual and reality, have more accurate information utilization and are beneficial to dynamically adjusting an exploitation scheme; the method comprises the following steps: s1, modeling according to the real mining environment to obtain a stratum model; s2, carrying out lightweight processing and modeling on the mining equipment, the supporting equipment and the monitoring equipment to obtain an equipment model; s3, importing the equipment model into the stratum model to obtain a final digital twin model; s4, demonstrating the mining process in the digital twin model in advance, judging whether the mining process is safe according to the demonstration result, and mapping the mining process to the actual mining process; and S5, feeding back the result of real mining to the digital twin model, realizing real and virtual repeated verification and comparison, and adjusting the model according to the result of verification and comparison. The technical scheme provided by the invention is suitable for the process of mining.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: PMU-based power system state estimation performance evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a PMU-based power system state estimation performance evaluation method, which specifically comprises the following steps: actual measurement of measurement value S of observation object by PMU of power system m Obtaining S m State estimation value S of se Will S m And S se Inputting a trained classification model to obtain classification accuracy and a marking value and calculating a state estimation performance evaluation index, wherein the training process comprises the following steps: obtaining a measurement error data set X of an observed object through a power system simulation platform, carrying out normalization processing on the X and calculating a probability density function of the X Obtaining S through a power system simulation platform t By superposition of S t And to obtain S m Obtaining each S m State estimation value S of se ，α m Taking 0 or 1, using S t 、S m 、S se And alpha m And training a classification model. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of high accuracy, simplicity and convenience in operation, labor saving and the like.

title_en: Dynamic state estimation method for comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic state estimation method of a comprehensive energy system, which comprises the following steps: defining a specific state quantity form, determining the measurement quantity of the comprehensive energy system, calculating a step length, and forming a forecast error variance matrix and a measurement error variance matrix; forming a system state transition matrix and a measurement matrix according to the topological structure and the element parameters of the comprehensive energy system and the power balance relationship between the gas turbine unit and the cogeneration unit; forecasting the state quantity according to the state transition matrix to obtain t The forecast value of the state quantity at +1 moment and a forecast error variance matrix; form a t Measuring phasor at +1 moment, calculating filter gain, and calculating t State quantity estimated value and estimation error variance matrix at +1 moment; and judging whether the calculation is finished or not, outputting an estimation result, and otherwise, estimating at the next moment. The invention can not only be applied to a comprehensive energy systemThe dynamic process is forecasted, and meanwhile, the state quantity can be estimated, so that accurate dynamic information is obtained.
assignees: UNIV NANJING INFORMATION SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Data processing method and system based on state estimation of improved algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data processing method and a system based on state estimation of an improved algorithm, which comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source data by using equipment parameters and measurement data; carrying out bad data processing on the multi-source data, and finding and eliminating DAS bad data by utilizing a compatibility analysis strategy; repairing and checking the bad data required by the economic operation analysis and calculation of each distribution network; classifying, compressing and storing the repaired bad data into a corresponding subject database according to the application analysis requirement of the distribution network for observability analysis processing to obtain an observability analysis result; virtually measureing the observability analysis results using state estimation based on an improved algorithm; the observability and the measurement redundancy of virtual measurement of the power distribution network are improved, the data information loss of the power distribution network is solved, and the requirement of advanced application analysis on data of different power distribution networks is met and the data is rapidly acquired; and estimating the state of the power distribution system with high precision, integrity and reliability by utilizing the measurement information of the power distribution network.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Extraction method of power consumption missing data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data extraction algorithm constructed for power supply data, which is used for realizing data extraction under the condition of incomplete data and providing a basis for research in aspects of power market evaluation, prediction and the like. Aiming at the problems of irregular distribution, lack of data and many inquiry factors, the extraction method of the power consumption missing data is provided, has higher efficiency and precision, and is very suitable for irregularly distributed power data. The weighted neighborhood interpolation algorithm is suitable for data query acquisition under the condition of more parameters, can provide a comprehensive data query interpolation algorithm tool for the electric power market information platform, effectively improves the use efficiency of electric power data, and provides convenience for electric power market research.

title_en: BFA-Elman-based power load prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a BFA-Elman-based power load prediction method. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring original load data, preprocessing and normalizing the load data of the original load data, removing irregular data and filling missing data; constructing an Elman neural network topological structure, determining parameters of the network, and initializing a weight value and a threshold value of the Elman neural network; setting parameters of a bacterial foraging algorithm BFA, and solving an optimal solution through bacterial decoding to obtain an optimal weight threshold; updating a weight threshold value of the Elman neural network, training the Elman neural network optimized based on the BFA algorithm, and predicting the future power load. The BFA-Elman-based power load prediction method is high in prediction accuracy and meets the demand of a power system on power load prediction.

title_en: Anti-electricity-stealing analysis method based on Lasso analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-electricity-stealing analysis method based on Lasso analysis, which comprises the following steps of firstly, obtaining all user electricity quantity freezing data of a whole station area and station area total meter electricity quantity freezing data from an acquisition system; step two, performing data preprocessing on all data, and performing interpolation processing on missing data; step three, subtracting the sum of all the user electricity consumption data from the station area general table data to obtain line loss values of each time period of the station area; step four, calculating the line loss of the transformer area and the regression coefficients of all the electric meters according to the Lasso regression model; step five, calculating the electricity stealing probability of each ammeter according to the line loss of the transformer area and the Lasso coefficient; and step six, positioning suspected electricity stealing users according to the electricity stealing probability. The method is simple to realize, only needs to acquire all user power consumption data and table area general table data of the whole table area, overcomes the influence of high interference of required data dimensionality, does not need artificial definition characteristics, and does not need to add excessive extra equipment.
assignees: QINGDAO TOPSCOMM COMMUNICATION CO LTD;SHENYANG KEYUAN STATE GRID POWER ENG SURVEY DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Equipment scheduling management method and system of comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention provides a device scheduling management method and a device scheduling management system of a comprehensive energy system, which comprise the steps of obtaining current predicted values of load demands and energy supply time of various energy devices of the comprehensive energy system, inputting the current predicted values into a pre-built device scheduling management digital twin model DT3 to obtain energy inflow, outflow and device capacity of the various energy devices, controlling start-stop and output of the various energy devices of the comprehensive energy system based on the energy inflow, outflow and device capacity of the various energy devices, and constructing the device scheduling management digital twin model DT3 by considering coupling relations, input constraint and power flow constraint among various energy sources of the comprehensive energy system and device operation scheduling cost constraint.

title_en: Operation ticket safety checking system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an operation ticket safety checking system and a method thereof, wherein the operation ticket safety checking system comprises an operation ticket analysis module, a man-machine interaction module, an operation ticket trend application module, a state estimation interface module and an intelligent anti-error application module; through the cooperation of the five modules, the intelligent anti-error safety check in the whole flow of the operation order and the issuing execution is realized, and the safety of the power grid operation is guaranteed.
assignees: STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;BEIJING KEDONG ELECTRIC POWER CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Distributed electrical-thermal coupling system state estimation method considering communication packet loss
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed electrical-thermal coupling system state estimation method considering communication packet loss, which is based on an R-ADMM algorithm and comprises the following steps: s1, setting the iteration times k to be 0, the algorithm termination condition, the relaxation parameter and the penalty parameter of the algorithm, and initializing boundary variables and auxiliary variables of the power grid and the heat grid; s2, boundary information is calculated and exchanged, an auxiliary variable is updated according to the communication packet loss condition between adjacent areas, and the iteration number k is updated to k + 1; s3, solving a power grid subproblem and a heat grid subproblem to obtain corresponding state estimation values; and S4, calculating and judging whether the residual error reaches the algorithm termination condition, if so, outputting the optimized state estimation value, and if not, repeating S2-S4 until the termination condition is met. The invention considers the communication packet loss condition which may occur when the power grid and the heat supply network exchange boundary information in the state estimation process, and achieves the effect of centralized coordination and optimization while ensuring the operation independence and information privacy of the power grid and the heat supply network.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: Transient stability prediction method for time-varying power system based on inheritance idea
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transient stability prediction method of a time-varying power system based on inheritance ideas, belongs to the technical field of power generation, power transformation or power distribution, and has important significance for emergency decision and control after a power grid has a serious fault. The method comprises the following steps: and selecting samples and characteristics which can be applied to the current operation mode in the transient stability data of the historical operation mode by using the breadth inheritance idea. And fusing transient stability data and migration data of the current operation mode of the power system, and applying the transient stability data and the migration data to artificial intelligence algorithm training of current power grid transient stability prediction. And the transient stable state of the power grid can be accurately evaluated under the condition that the data of the new operation mode is insufficient. In the current operation mode, transient stability data are continuously increased, and the newly added data are used for updating the transient stability prediction model on line by utilizing the deep inheritance idea. The method can solve the problems of insufficient training data volume of the artificial intelligence algorithm caused by time-varying characteristics of the power grid and model online updating of continuously increased data.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Harmonic state estimation method based on asynchronous data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a harmonic state estimation method based on asynchronous data, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring power quality monitoring record data of a monitored node of a main transformer in the power quality monitoring system; s2, constructing a harmonic state estimation model based on asynchronous data according to the power quality monitoring record data and the power equation of the nodes of the power system; s3, judging whether the observable matrix of the harmonic state estimation model is full rank, if so, the power system network is observable, and entering step S4, if not, the power system network is not observable, increasing distribution points according to injection equivalent inference until the power system network is observable, and entering step S4; s4, establishing a harmonic wave state objective function, and solving a harmonic wave state estimation model by adopting a nonlinear optimization algorithm to obtain a harmonic wave state estimation value of the power system network; the invention solves the problem of how to estimate the harmonic state by using the existing electric energy quality online monitoring system in China.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic analysis and quantitative evaluation method for running state of stability control device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic analysis and quantitative evaluation method for the running state of a stability control device, which belongs to the technical field of power grid safety and comprises the following steps: s1, constructing a digital virtual model completely mapped with the stability control device by using a digital twinning technology; s2, the stability control device and the digital virtual model output data form a twin database of the stability control device; s3, realizing comprehensive perception of the running state of the stability control device through multi-dimensional data real-time acquisition and data preprocessing technology on the basis of a twin database of the stability control device; s4, constructing a fault feature library and a safety index system of the stability control device according to the comprehensive perception result of the operation state of the stability control device, and carrying out dynamic analysis and quantitative evaluation on the operation state of the stability control device. The method of the invention utilizes a digital twin simulation means to realize dynamic analysis and quantitative evaluation of the operation state of the power grid stability control device, thereby ensuring safe and stable operation of the power grid under the condition that the power supply structure, the load type and the network topology are deeply changed.
assignees: INST ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCES STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Energy collaborative management system based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy collaborative management system based on machine learning, which comprises: the system comprises a metering control module, an energy structure analysis auxiliary module, an electric topology and service topology compiling module, an energy flow digital twin module based on a machine learning algorithm and an energy cooperative control module based on machine learning; the energy structure analysis auxiliary module, the electrical topology and business topology establishment module, the energy flow digital twin module and the energy cooperative control module are sequentially connected; the metering control module is respectively connected with the energy structure analysis auxiliary module, the energy flow digital twin module and the energy cooperative control module; the metering control module is also used for being connected with a target customer energy system; the energy cooperative control module is also used for being connected with an electric power market. The energy collaborative management system can guide or control the transaction activities of the customers and the electric power market, help the customers to reduce the energy consumption cost, and can automatically optimize the upgrade to ensure the function effect.

title_en: Power system operation data visualization system and method based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a power system operation data visualization system based on a digital twinning technology, which comprises a data acquisition module, a control module, a digital twinning model construction module and a display module, wherein the control module is in communication connection with the data acquisition module; a machine learning module is arranged in the control module, and the input end of the digital twin model building module is connected with the output end of the control module; the input end of the display module is connected with the output end of the digital twin model building module. The invention also provides a visualization method of the operating data of the power system, wherein the data acquisition module acquires the operating data of the power system in real time and then transmits the operating data to the control module, the control module analyzes, identifies and predicts the operating data according to a machine learning module arranged in the control module, and then transmits the analysis, identification and prediction results to the digital twin model construction module to construct a three-dimensional digital twin model of the power system, and then transmits the three-dimensional digital twin model to the display module to realize the visualization of the operating data.
assignees: ZHONGSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Power system prediction state estimation method and system based on data driving
abstract_en: The utility model provides a power system prediction state estimation method and system based on data drive, comprising: acquiring historical data of a power system and measurement data of nodes; inputting historical data into a recurrent neural network to obtain a trained recurrent neural network model; judging whether the measured data of the node has abnormal data or not; if the abnormal data do not exist, the measured data of the nodes are subjected to Gaussian process state estimation to obtain the predicted state of the power system; if abnormal data exist, inputting the measured data of the nodes into a trained recurrent neural network model, correcting the measured data of the nodes through current flow calculation, and obtaining accurate predicted states of the power system through the corrected measured data of the nodes through a Gaussian process state estimation process; a power system state prediction model based on the long-term memory neural network is established, the problem of data loss can be solved through load flow calculation, and the method has high accuracy and robustness.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Power plant circulating water pump prediction state assessment method and system
