The visualization system includes: the goods and goods position information visualization module is used for visualizing the goods in the warehouse, the goods position information of the goods, the goods position information and the goods position occupation condition; the operation visualization module is used for visualizing warehousing operation, ex-warehouse operation, checking operation and shifting operation information; the equipment visualization module is used for visualizing the common equipment, the video monitoring equipment, the fire-fighting monitoring equipment, the electric power monitoring equipment and the inspection and inventory robot in the warehouse; the unified visualization module is used for carrying out unified visualization on various monitoring information in the warehouse; and the inspection and inventory robot state visualization module is used for visualizing the working states of the inspection and inventory robot in the warehouse.
assignees: BEIJING DIANQI LIANJIANG TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;CHINA MOBILE GROUP INNER MONGOLIA CO LTD

title_en: Elasticity index evaluation method based on electric power system missing data reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention discloses an elasticity index evaluation method based on power system missing data reconstruction, which comprises the following steps: according to an operation scene of a power system, matching a first historical data set corresponding to missing data in a continuous time period, and filling the missing data to obtain first time sequence data; and reconstructing the missing data according to the trained reconstruction model and the first time sequence data to obtain second time sequence data under a continuous time period, performing inverse normalization on the second time sequence data, responding to the selection of a user on the elasticity index, and performing elasticity index evaluation on the power system according to the data after inverse normalization. According to the embodiment of the invention, missing data reconstruction in continuous time periods and real-time elasticity index evaluation can be realized.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Comprehensive energy supply station control operation and maintenance system based on digital twins
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive energy supply station control operation and maintenance system based on digital twins, which comprises a comprehensive energy supply station planning service architecture based on granularity, wherein an application scene of the twins of a comprehensive energy supply station is divided into a work level part, a station length level part and a total department level part from the perspective of the granularity; the method comprises the steps of integrating a planning business architecture of an energy supply station based on module functions, and dividing the planning business architecture into five primary scenes of intelligent safety, intelligent infrastructure, intelligent marketing, intelligent service and intelligent management according to a construction target and a business process; the technical architecture comprises an entity acquisition end, a data core layer, an index core layer and a function application layer. The comprehensive energy supply station planning business architecture and the technical architecture are explained, the comprehensive energy supply station technical architecture is mainly matched with the entity acquisition end, the data core layer, the index core layer and the function application layer, and the system technical architecture design is carried out around the comprehensive energy supply service station operation management business and the trip service business, so that the safety is improved, and the experience is optimized.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG OCEAN;ZHEJIANG HIGH SPEED ENERGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Unsafe state detection method based on digital twin workshop mixed data set
abstract_en: The invention provides an unsafe state detection method based on a digital twin workshop mixed data set, which comprises the following steps: classifying unsafe states of workers in a production and manufacturing workshop, simulating the unsafe states in a digital twin virtual workshop according to the type of the unsafe states of actual workers to be used as a virtual data set for deep learning, and acquiring the unsafe states of the workers in the real workshop through a camera to be used as a real data set; mixing the collected virtual data set and the real data set, labeling the real data set through a labeling tool and labeling the virtual data set through an automatic labeling script, and then putting the virtual data set and the real data set into a network for target detection to train so as to generate a weight file based on a virtual-real mixed data set; putting the trained weight file into a target detection network to detect unsafe states of workshops; the safety of workshop workers during the working of the workshop can be visually monitored on line. The method utilizes the virtual-real mixed data set training model to detect the unsafe state of workshop workers in real time, can reduce the occurrence of the unsafe state of the workshop workers, and ensures the safety of the workshop production workers in the workshop production process.
assignees: UNIV ZHENGZHOU LIGHT IND

title_en: Power transmission line safety state assessment method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transmission line safety state assessment method based on digital twinning, which comprises the following steps: obtaining regional power grid structure information, and obtaining equipment parameters, operation data and external information of a power transmission line to be modeled; performing feature mapping on the transmission line entity from an electrical angle, and establishing a digital twin model of the transmission line taking electromagnetic mechanism into consideration; performing feature mapping on the power transmission line entity from a mechanical angle, and establishing a digital twin model of the power transmission line taking structural characteristics into consideration; providing an intelligent state evaluation index of the power transmission line considering the external factors of the meteorological conditions by using an analytic hierarchy process; scoring the indexes of each level, calculating the comprehensive safety evaluation value of the power transmission line by weighting the obtained indexes, and classifying the line into three levels of low risk, medium risk and high risk according to the calculation result; the method solves the technical problems that the safety evaluation of the power transmission line depends on sensing data and manual handling experience, and the real-time risk evaluation and risk management and control requirements of the power transmission line cannot be met.

title_en: Digital twinning-based wind power plant dynamic sector management optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wind power plant dynamic sector management optimization method and system based on digital twinning, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a weather research and forecast model considering the surface condition of a wind power plant; the method comprises the steps of establishing a wind power plant wake high-end dynamic pneumatic simulation and virtual blade coupling model, carrying out simulation calculation on wind power plant parameters at a position where a fan is arranged, obtaining a precise wake model for wind power plant control by scanning laser wind measurement to verify wake details obtained through calculation, obtaining fan health state information based on an online health monitoring and diagnosing system of an impeller of a machine, participating in fan control optimization in a unit health state, and adopting self-adaptive optimization control and dynamic wake control based on hearing by a wind power plant single machine and wind power plant group according to wake influence conditions. The invention takes wind-knowledge-group control as a basic characteristic, realizes the dynamic sector management of the wind power plant, and effectively improves the intelligent monitoring and power generation profitability of the wind turbine of the offshore wind power plant.

title_en: Chemical workshop field data acquisition method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based chemical workshop field data acquisition method, which relates to the technical field of combination of artificial intelligence, virtual reality and the Internet of things, and comprises the following steps: establishing a mapping relation between a real space and a virtual space; arranging a gas concentration sensor in a chemical workshop, and collecting a time sequence numerical value of gas concentration; dividing a virtual space into a plurality of subspaces; establishing a risk model of gas concentration; obtaining a cost function through learning; iteratively calculating a risk model to obtain a learned risk model; calculating the probability of risk on the subspace; and when the probability of the risk existing on a certain subspace is greater than the probability of the risk existing on the rest subspaces, taking the subspace as a risk source, and labeling the subspace. The method comprises the steps of establishing a virtual space according to field space data and gas concentration data, establishing a corresponding risk model, analyzing the probability of risk sources existing in different positions on the field by adopting a neural network method, and marking and warning high-probability risk points in the virtual space.

title_en: Network load interaction method based on multi-energy complementation of flexible resources at load side
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network load interaction method based on multi-capability complementation of flexible resources at a load side, wherein the method for guiding a user to participate in load response to improve the power supply and demand balance capacity of a power grid comprises the following steps: constructing a park comprehensive energy system digital twin system model fusing renewable energy; step two: constructing a source network load storage low-carbon multifunctional cooperative interaction strategy and system omnibearing evaluation system; step three: a park load response strategy and flexible resource mining under a multi-excitation mechanism of a novel power system are oriented; step four: the park multi-energy flow comprehensive energy management platform for the novel power system is based on a network load interaction method with load side flexible resource multi-energy complementation, a source network load storage low-carbon multi-energy collaborative interaction strategy is formed by the system, and each unit operation strategy of the comprehensive system reasonably participates in power grid exchange, so that the system operation cost is reduced, carbon emission is reduced, the new energy consumption rate is improved, and the energy consumption is reduced.
assignees: KGE CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus and method for operating power system stability
title_ko: 전력계통 운영 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: A power system operating device is disclosed. According to the present invention, the power system operating device comprises: a digital twin system that diagnoses and predicts a state of a power facility by reflecting data due to facility operation from the power facility connected to a power system to a virtualization model that virtually implements the power facility; and an integrated control unit that controls the power facility according to diagnostic prediction information generated by the digital twin system.
abstract_ko: 전력계통 운영 장치가 개시된다. 본 발명의 전력계통 운영 장치는 전력계통에 연결된 전력설비로부터 설비 운영에 따른 데이터를 전력설비를 가상으로 구현한 가상화 모델에 반영하여 전력설비의 상태를 진단 및 예측하는 디지털 트윈 시스템; 및 디지털 트윈 시스템에 의해 생성된 진단 예측 정보에 따라 전력설비를 제어하는 통합 제어부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: KOREA ELECTRIC POWER CORP;UNIV NAT MOKPO IND ACAD COOP GROUP

title_en: Apparatus for providing operation and maintenance management platform service of solar power generation system based on digital twin, and method for operating and maintaining solar power generation system using the same
title_ko: 디지털 트윈을 기반으로 한 태양광 발전 시스템의 운영 유지 보수 관리 플랫폼 서비스 제공 장치 및 이를 이용한 태양광 발전 시스템의 운영유지보수 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for providing an operation and maintenance management platform service for a photovoltaic power generation system, and a method for operating and maintaining a photovoltaic power generation system using the same, the apparatus implementing a virtually-simulated photovoltaic power generation system corresponding to each of one or more actual photovoltaic power generation systems, predicting whether there is a failure in any actual photovoltaic power generation system on the basis of a difference between actually measured data on the actual photovoltaic power generation system and estimated data on the corresponding simulated photovoltaic power generation system, notifying a system manager, adjacent to an actual photovoltaic power generation system in which a failure is predicted, of the same from among pre-registered system managers, so that the failure can be responded to rapidly, and allowing differentiated compensation to be paid depending on response speeds to system managers who have participated in failure recovery, thereby enabling a photovoltaic power generation system failure to be more actively handled.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 태양광 발전 시스템의 운영 유지 보수 관리 플랫폼 서비스 제공 장치 및 이를 이용한 태양광 발전 시스템의 운영유지보수 방법에 관한 것으로서, 적어도 하나의 실존 태양광 발전 시스템 별로 각각에 대응한 가상의 모의 태양광 발전 시스템을 구현한 후, 실존 태양광 발전 시스템의 실측 데이터와, 대응된 모의 태양광 발전 시스템의 추정 데이터의 차이에 의거하여, 임의의 실존 태양광 발전 시스템의 고장 여부를 예측하고, 미리 등록된 시스템 관리자들 중 고장이 예측된 실존 태양광 발전 시스템에 인접한 시스템 관리자에게 이를 알림으로써, 고장에 신속하게 대응할 수 있도록 하고, 고장 복구에 참여한 시스템 관리자에게, 대응 속도에 따라 차별화된 보상금을 지급함으로써, 태양광 발전 시스템의 고장시 보다 능동적으로 대처할 수 있도록 하는 특징이 있다.
assignees: PARK KI JU;PARK JAE SEONG;PARK SAE HEE

title_en: Reactive power-voltage optimization control method for new energy power system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reactive-voltage optimization control method of a new energy power system based on digital twinning, and the reactive-voltage optimization control method considering new energy power generation is constructed based on a digital twinning technology architecture and a SVG control parameter dynamic optimization strategy. Acquiring and generating an original data set with a larger influence weight on the voltage characteristic of the system as the perception access of a digital twin body by a sensing network and a twin data dynamic processing method; the digital twin fusion deep neural network algorithm is used for carrying out real-time deduction and analysis on the system operation situation, generating a dynamic optimization instruction under multiple scenes and multiple states, feeding back the dynamic optimization instruction to a physical system through a communication transmission network, and carrying out dynamic optimization on SVG control parameters so as to release the reactive power regulation potential of the SVG under extreme conditions, relieve the adverse effects of sudden dynamic and fault conditions of a new energy high-permeability power grid, realize optimization-oriented control on the power grid voltage and guarantee the safe and stable operation of the power grid.
assignees: UNIV NANJING SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Photovoltaic short-term power interval prediction method based on EEMD-LSTM microgrid
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power interval prediction, in particular to a photovoltaic short-term power interval prediction method based on an EEMD-LSTM microgrid, which comprises the following steps: s1, data input: inputting photovoltaic power generation related data including information such as meteorological factors, power generation system parameters, photovoltaic output and the like; s2, data preprocessing: the integration of multi-source data is mainly to integrate and summarize data in a multi-file or database so as to analyze data characteristics of different levels, and a KNN algorithm is adopted to detect missing data. According to the photovoltaic short-term power interval prediction method based on the EEMD-LSTM microgrid, through the photovoltaic output sample feature extraction method based on the XGboost, model training can be avoided by directly utilizing a large number of features, factor screening can be performed on factors simultaneously by considering influence on photovoltaic power more comprehensively, and modeling efficiency is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD JIAXING POWER SUPPLY CO;JIAXING HENGCHUANG ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Multi-heat-source heat supply system collaborative optimization scheduling method based on layered reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-heat-source heat supply system collaborative optimization scheduling method based on layered reinforcement learning, which comprises the following steps: establishing a digital twin model of a multi-heat-source networked heat supply system; performing multi-heat source networked operation hydraulic calculation under different working conditions based on a multi-heat source networked heat supply system digital twin model, analyzing the operation characteristics of each heat source at the corresponding position of the system, dividing the heat supply range of each heat source and obtaining the operation characteristics of each heat source; establishing a multi-heat source heat supply system collaborative optimization scheduling model, determining a system objective function and relevant constraint conditions, and modeling the scheduling model as a Markov decision process; the method comprises the steps that a multi-heat-source networking scheduling strategy obtained based on a multi-heat-source heat supply system collaborative optimization scheduling model is used as a total task, the total task is decomposed into a plurality of subtasks through a hierarchical reinforcement learning algorithm, a scheduling hierarchical structure model is built, and the subtasks are learned to obtain the multi-heat-source networking scheduling strategy; and verifying and issuing the multi-heat-source networking scheduling strategy based on the digital twin model.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ENGIPOWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Electric power digital space resource pooling management and scheduling system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power digital space resource pooling management and scheduling system based on digital twins, which belongs to the technical field of intelligent management and comprises a data cloud end, a management platform, a region selection module, a remote sensing satellite, a data acquisition module, a power grid, a three-dimensional construction module, a resource pooling module and a scheduling management module; the intelligent power utilization line graph system can be operated conveniently by workers, data acquisition steps are simplified, data acquisition efficiency is improved, various groups of data can be analyzed automatically, a scheduling scheme is established, manual analysis is not needed, workload of the workers is reduced, working efficiency of the workers is improved, meanwhile, a user can receive the daily power utilization line graph in real time through the intelligent mobile phone, the user can check power utilization information more intuitively, and use experience of the user is improved.
assignees: BEIJING STATE GRID INFORMATION TELECOMMNICATION GROUP ACCENTURE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD;STATE GRID SIJI DIGITAL TECH BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Device and method for monitoring power system
abstract_en: To provide a device and method for monitoring a power system capable of extracting a future tidal current state that will be severe in reliability on the basis of a reliability index designated by a system operator.SOLUTION: A power system monitoring device 1 that assumes a tidal current state of a power system, comprises: an input part 201 that receives a reliability index; a system parameter database DB2 that stores a system parameter; a state estimation cross section database DB3 that stores a state estimation cross section; a prediction information database DB4 that stores prediction information on power demand/supply; a variable/constant type database DB5 that stores a variable/constant type for setting whether factors of the power system are fluctuated or constant; a severity forecast tidal current cross section generation part 203 that generates a severity forecast tidal current cross section and a reliability index value; a severity forecast tidal current cross section database DB6 that stores the severity forecast tidal current cross section and the reliability index value; a display part 204 that displays the severity forecast tidal current cross section and the reliability index value; and an output part 205 that outputs the severity forecast tidal current cross section and the reliability index value.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2
assignees: HITACHI LTD

title_en: Digital twin communication network database device based on GIS technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twin databases, in particular to a GIS technology-based digital twin communication network database device, which comprises a GIS digital twin database, a safety platform, a collection component, a refraction component, a monitoring component, a ventilation component and a sealing component, wherein the GIS digital twin database is vertically arranged, the safety platform is horizontally inserted into the upper end of the GIS digital twin database, a plurality of collection mirrors are symmetrically arranged at the lower end of the device, and then the refraction component of the safety platform refracts surrounding scenes collected by the collection mirrors to the monitoring probe, so that one probe can simultaneously monitor a plurality of azimuth angles, the monitoring probe is internally provided and is not easy to damage, the safety performance is improved, meanwhile, a liquid nitrogen tank is arranged in the safety platform, and when a fire-fighting liquid nitrogen fire disaster occurs in the GIS digital twin database device, the fire-fighting liquid nitrogen communication network database device can be matched with a control component and a sealing component to extinguish fire and cool the interior of the GIS digital twin database device, so that the data storage safety is improved, the operation is simple, and the use is convenient.
assignees: SHANDONG VOCATIONAL COLLEGE IND

title_en: Power industry carbon emission monitoring method and device based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for monitoring carbon emission in the power industry based on digital twinning, wherein the corresponding method comprises the following steps: acquiring carbon dioxide emission generated in a fuel combustion process, a desulfurization process and a power purchasing and using process of a power generation enterprise; the method comprises the steps of obtaining sulfur hexafluoride emission generated in the using process of sulfur hexafluoride equipment of a power grid enterprise and carbon dioxide emission generated in the power distribution loss process to determine greenhouse gas emission of the power grid enterprise; and monitoring the carbon emission of the power industry according to the greenhouse gas emission of the power generation enterprises and the greenhouse gas emission of the power grid enterprises. The invention combines carbon emission monitoring and digital twinning technology from two aspects of power enterprises and power grid enterprises, thereby realizing parallel simulation of carbon emission data in a power link on a virtual digital platform, and finally realizing digital combination, visibility, accurate calculation and good management of carbon emission in the power industry.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method and device for evaluating power quality, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a method, an apparatus, a computer device and a storage medium for power quality assessment. The method comprises the steps of determining integrity index data, consistency index data and accuracy index data by acquiring power quality data to be evaluated; determining the weight of the integrity index data, the weight of the consistency index data and the weight of the accuracy index data according to a pre-constructed judgment matrix; according to the integrity index data, the consistency index data, the accuracy index data, the weight of the integrity index data, the weight of the consistency index data and the weight of the accuracy index data, the result of power quality evaluation is determined, the power quality data is analyzed from three dimensions of integrity, consistency and accuracy, and the one-sidedness of a single index method for power quality data evaluation is overcome; different weights are given to different types of missing data, and the complexity of evaluation can be reduced under the condition that the influence of the actual data on the evaluation result is kept to the maximum extent.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Transformer substation disaster prevention and reduction digital twin system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electrical engineering, and particularly provides a transformer substation disaster prevention and reduction digital twin system, which comprises: the wireless monitoring sensor network and the transformer substation disaster-suffered physical analysis module; the wireless monitoring sensor network is used for monitoring natural monitoring data related to the damage of the transformer substation caused by natural disasters; and the transformer substation disaster physical analysis module is used for analyzing the transformer substation damage condition caused by the natural disaster based on the natural monitoring data related to the transformer substation damage caused by the natural disaster. The technical scheme provided by the invention can realize effective monitoring and evaluation of various disasters, and has the characteristics of advanced technology, strong integration and high efficiency compared with a monitoring and evaluation system in the prior art.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network measurement optimization configuration method and terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network measurement optimization configuration method and a terminal, wherein scalar functions of Fisher information matrixes of multiple time sections are used as parameters affecting pheromone updating in a first ant colony algorithm, an initial measurement set of the power distribution network is compressed into a candidate measurement set, state estimation precision values of the multiple time sections are used as parameters affecting pheromone updating in a second ant colony algorithm, and a measurement configuration scheme with optimal state estimation precision is solved from the candidate measurement set. Therefore, in the second stage of calculation, the existence of the first stage greatly reduces the number of optional measurement when the ants walk, and the calculation time is saved while ensuring that the measurement configuration can obtain the optimal solution. Meanwhile, due to the fact that two-section measurement optimization configuration of multiple time sections is considered, the problem that observability of an active power distribution network is insufficient in the past can be effectively solved, and accuracy of solving an optimal measurement configuration scheme is improved.

title_en: Model-data hybrid drive-based comprehensive energy system interval state estimation method
abstract_en: A comprehensive energy system interval state estimation method based on model-data hybrid driving includes the steps of firstly collecting historical measurement data of a comprehensive energy system, then establishing a comprehensive energy system interval state estimation model, sending the historical measurement data into the model, solving point state estimation values by means of an artificial fish swarm method, then obtaining estimation error intervals with different confidence degrees by means of probability distribution inverse functions of kernel density estimation fitting errors based on errors between point state true values and point state estimation values, calculating comprehensive energy system interval state estimation results with different confidence degrees, then training a long-term and short-term memory neural network by taking the historical measurement data and the interval state estimation results as sample data, obtaining a comprehensive energy system interval state estimation model, and finally inputting real-time measurement data into the interval state estimation model to obtain a comprehensive energy system real-time interval state estimation result. The method can effectively improve the accuracy and timeliness of the interval state estimation of the comprehensive energy system.

title_en: Fire-fighting equipment door body based on digital twin factory workshop
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-fighting equipment door body based on a digital twin factory workshop, which comprises a door body and a door frame, wherein one side of the door body is rotatably connected with one side of the door frame through a cylindrical door shaft, a T-shaped lock body is arranged at the middle position of the other side of the door body, and a rectangular locking notch matched with the T-shaped lock body is arranged on the inner wall of the middle part of the other side of the door frame; door frame bottom rear end butt has two to carry the ware platform, carries to be equipped with control platform between the ware platform for two, carries the bottom of ware platform to install pressure sensor, control platform's mid-mounting has main control unit, wireless transmission module is installed to main control unit's front end, main control unit's rear end is installed and is dismantled the power. The utility model provides a poor and easily rust, the poor problem of glass door body security of the single structure of the traditional fire-fighting equipment door body, lock flexibility, designed a fire-fighting equipment door body based on the workshop of twin plant of digit.
assignees: WUXI UNIV

title_en: Water hammer protection and intelligent regulation and control system for water supply engineering based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention provides a water hammer protection and intelligent regulation and control system for water supply engineering based on digital twinning, which comprises: the monitoring management system monitors various state information of the water supply project; the digital twin system is used for establishing a relevant hydraulics model and an analysis and prediction algorithm model of the water supply project according to the hydraulic power running state, the equipment running state and the equipment state of the water supply project; the data center stores various information of the water supply project, models, modes, cases and the like of the water supply project; the distributed water hammer protection equipment realizes the protection of a conventional water hammer; the intelligent scheduling system for the transient process controls the performance of a hydraulic assembly of the system, and achieves the water yield and water pressure target and the process safety. The water hammer protection and intelligent regulation and control system for the water supply engineering, which is based on-line monitoring, takes network cooperative sharing as a link, takes digital twin and intelligent analysis as a core, and takes the running water quantity and pressure of a water supply network as targets, ensures the safety of daily running and scheduling processes, and realizes the monitoring and early warning of the whole life cycle of a water supply system.
assignees: DONGFANG SHUIGU CARBON TECH CO LTD;ZHUZHOU ZHUHUA SMART WATER TECH CO LTD;ZHUZHOU SOUTHERN VALVE CO LTD

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for estimating state of electric-gas coupling system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system, equipment and a medium for estimating the state of an electric-gas coupling system, comprising the following steps: high-frequency measurement data and low-frequency measurement data based on the acquired measurement data of the electric-gas coupling system; carrying out nonlinear decomposition on the high-frequency measurement data based on a pre-trained high-frequency long-short term memory neural network state estimation model to obtain a high-frequency state quantity; carrying out nonlinear decomposition on the low-frequency measurement data based on a pre-trained low-frequency long-short term memory neural network state estimation model to obtain a low-frequency state quantity; estimating the state of the electro-pneumatic coupling system based on the high frequency state quantity and the low frequency state quantity; the method solves the problem of state estimation under the nonlinear influence of the electric-gas coupling system, decomposes the measured data, obtains the state quantity by using the long-short term memory neural network state estimation model, and estimates the state of the electric-gas coupling system after superposing the state quantity, thereby realizing the reconstruction of high-frequency components and low-frequency components and improving the estimation accuracy.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method for forming Jacobian matrix elements for measuring transformer by fast decomposition method state estimation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for forming a Jacobian matrix element for measuring a transformer by state estimation through a fast decomposition method  r  P row and i column element B  r.pi  The method is multiplied by a correction coefficient beta on the basis of the traditional method, wherein the beta is related to the scale and the structure of a power system and generally has the value range of [1.01,1.10]]. The invention improves the calculation method of the transformer reactive power measurement Jacobian matrix for fast decomposing state estimation by multiplying the elements of the transformer reactive power measurement Jacobian matrix by a correction coefficient beta, and can effectively improve the convergence of state estimation. Practice ofThe calculation example shows that the method can obviously improve the convergence and obviously reduce the iteration times of the state estimation of the power system.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN MARITIME

title_en: Method for forming line measurement jacobian matrix element for fast decomposition method state estimation
abstract_en: When the p-th measurement is the measurement of the dead quantity of a line head end node i, if the line to earth susceptance B  c  is 0, the p-th row i column element B  r.pi  of the Q-U type constant jacobian matrix B  r  is multiplied by a correction coefficient alpha on the basis of the traditional method, the alpha is related to the scale and structure of the power system, the value range is [1.001,1.100], and if B  c  is not 0, the correction quantity 3B  c  is added on the basis of the traditional method to the element B  r.pi  of the B  r . The invention improves the calculation method of the line reactive power measurement jacobian matrix for rapidly decomposing the state estimation by multiplying the line head reactive power measurement jacobian matrix element by a correction coefficient alpha or adding the correction quantity 3b  c , and can effectively improve the convergence of the state estimation. The embodiment shows that the invention can obviously improve the convergence and obviously reduce the iteration times of the power system state estimation.

title_en: Fire control method and device based on digital twin platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire control method and a device based on a digital twin platform, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when a target fire event is detected, analyzing the target fire event based on the digital twin platform to obtain node information of the target fire event; determining a building to be firefighted corresponding to a target firefighting event and building information of the building to be firefighted according to the node information and a preset firefighting judging model, wherein the building information comprises floor information of a target floor where the target firefighting event occurs; generating a target fire-fighting scheme aiming at the building to be fire-fighting according to the fire-fighting judging model, the building information and the site information of the fire-fighting site, and executing fire-fighting treatment operation on the building to be fire-fighting according to the target fire-fighting scheme, wherein the fire-fighting site is the site for treating the target fire-fighting event. Therefore, the method and the device can accurately position the specific information of the fire disaster accident building, and then intelligently make a high-efficiency and reliable treatment scheme, thereby improving the treatment efficiency and the treatment accuracy of treating the emergency fire disaster.

title_en: Digital twin fine collaborative simulation method for driving on high-speed railway bridge under earthquake action
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning fine collaborative simulation method for driving on a high-speed railway bridge under the action of earthquake, which comprises the following steps: establishing a digital twin simulation calculation model of the upper structure subsystem; establishing a digital twin simulation calculation model of the lower structure subsystem; establishing a track irregularity digital twinning simulation calculation module; obtaining the coupling power relation of the wheel-rail contact surface; establishing a seismic wave digital twin simulation calculation module; obtaining a digital twin coupling power relationship between the upper structure subsystem and the lower structure subsystem; establishing an elastic-plastic fiber beam column unit digital twin earthquake simulation analysis module; and obtaining the digital twin safety evaluation index of the high-speed train operation. The method can carry out digital construction aiming at digital twin fine collaborative simulation of the vehicle travelling on the high-speed railway bridge under the earthquake action, and solves the bottom key technical problems of accurate mapping modeling, design, analysis, diagnosis and decision of a physical model and a data driving model of the vehicle travelling on the high-speed railway bridge under the earthquake action.

title_en: Electricity larceny prevention early warning data analysis method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to an electricity larceny prevention early warning data analysis method. The method comprises the following steps: writing an electricity larceny prevention early warning data analysis system program in mobile computer terminal equipment; loading a plurality of analysis methods including but not limited to state estimation, matrix decomposition, data mining, machine learning, game theory, AI recognition, and the like; connecting a terminal with electric energy data acquisition equipment; acquiring electric energy data, analyzing and summarizing; selecting and adjusting a method to analyze and process data; and making a corresponding electricity larceny prevention scheme according to the analysis result. The invention designs that the analysis system is arranged in the mobile computer terminal equipment and a plurality of data analysis methods are loaded, so that the mobile computer terminal equipment is convenient to be connected and applied with a plurality of different power management systems; analyzing and matching the electricity utilization data and calling an applicable method to analyze electricity stealing; the corresponding electricity larceny prevention scheme can be customized according to the analysis result, so that electricity larceny behavior is reduced, and electricity utilization safety is guaranteed.
assignees: ZHAOTONG POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster intelligent monitoring cloud platform based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster intelligent monitoring cloud platform based on a digital twin technology, which is characterized in that geological data of each target slope is obtained in real time, a disaster risk coefficient of each target slope is obtained through analysis, whether each target slope has a disaster risk or not is judged, the geological data of each target slope stored in a target slope geological information base is further extracted, a geological hidden danger coefficient of each target slope is obtained through analysis, meteorological information of each target slope is obtained at the same time, a meteorological influence coefficient of each target slope is obtained through analysis, a disaster prediction index of each target slope is obtained through evaluation according to the geological hidden danger coefficient and the meteorological influence coefficient of each target slope, corresponding processing is carried out, the defects existing in the traditional landslide monitoring technology are overcome, the reliability, the accuracy and the timeliness of monitoring results are greatly improved, a decision basis is provided for geological disaster engineering safety measures, and malignant geological disasters are avoided.
assignees: WUHAN YITELANRUI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power system transient stability evaluation method and system based on imaging data driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric power system transient stability evaluation method and system based on imaging data driving, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a feature candidate set; collecting historical operating data of the power system according to the feature alternative set, generating transient stability simulation data by using simulation analysis software, and constructing a sample set; carrying out data preprocessing on a sample set and carrying out sample classification by using a transient stability index, arranging samples in the sample set into a two-dimensional matrix according to two directions of time and characteristics, and endowing corresponding gray values according to different values of matrix elements to form an original image of the samples; performing feature dimension reduction on the original image to obtain a feature image; constructing a transient stability evaluation convolutional neural network model; and training a transient stability assessment convolutional neural network model by using the sample set based on the characteristic image and performing transient stability assessment on the power system by using the trained model. The invention has the advantages of high calculation efficiency, high evaluation precision, real-time monitoring and online updating and the like.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Transformer substation operation and maintenance method and system based on digital twins
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transformer substation operation and maintenance method and system based on digital twins. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a digital twin holographic model according to the BIM information of the transformer substation and the BIM facility asset information; acquiring operation and maintenance data of a transformer substation; evaluating the equipment state of the transformer substation in the digital twin holographic model according to the operation and maintenance data to obtain an evaluation result; and carrying out operation and maintenance on the transformer substation according to the evaluation result. According to the scheme provided by the invention, the application of a digital twin technology in each business link such as power grid operation management, power grid operation and maintenance overhaul and the like is realized through operation dimension data in a data twin global system model, each business data is acquired in real time and can be analyzed and predicted, the self-perception of the power grid state and the coordinated operation of the power grid and equipment are realized, the experience of personnel is not required to be relied on, the labor with high repetition rate and large workload is carried out, and the data processing efficiency is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;QINGYUAN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Electric load completion method and system based on DBSCAN clustering
abstract_en: The application relates to an electric load completion method and system based on DBSCAN clustering, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical power data, and establishing a plurality of electric quantity completion strategies based on the historical power data; and matching corresponding electric quantity completion strategies for the target users according to the historical electricity utilization conditions of the target users in the historical electricity data, and obtaining the completed electric quantity of the target users on the analysis day through the corresponding electric quantity completion strategies, wherein the electric quantity completion strategies comprise DBSCAN density clustering completion strategies. By means of the method and device for restoring the abnormal power data, the problem of how to restore the abnormal power data accurately is solved, the difference of the power utilization characteristics of residential users is considered to be large, the distribution rule of the power utilization data of different users is explored through descriptive statistical analysis, the purpose of restoring the power loads of different users in a targeted mode is achieved, missing data can be restored with high accuracy, and meanwhile the combination of multiple restoration strategies has strong robustness.

title_en: Performance evaluation method and device for power system state estimation
abstract_en: The invention provides a performance evaluation method and a performance evaluation device for power system state estimation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring state measurement data and state estimation data of the power system; and evaluating the performance of the state estimation of the power system according to the state measurement data and the state estimation data of the power system. The method solves the problem that the performance of the state estimation of the power system cannot be accurately estimated due to the unknown real state of the power system in the prior art, and realizes the accurate estimation of the state estimation performance of the power system.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Power system state estimation method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a device for estimating the state of a power system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a topological structure of a power system and PMU measurement data, and establishing a power system measurement model; calculating a covariance matrix of an expected vector of a measurement error vector of the bus voltage and the measurement error vector of the bus voltage; calculating a covariance matrix of an expected vector of the state vector of the bus voltage and the state vector of the bus voltage; substituting the expected vector of the measurement error vector of the bus voltage, the covariance matrix of the measurement error vector of the bus voltage, the expected vector of the state vector of the bus voltage and the covariance matrix of the state vector of the bus voltage into a parameter estimation equation set to obtain an estimated value of the bus voltage; the parameter estimation equation set is constructed according to an estimation value solution equation in the power system measurement model and linear Bayesian estimation. The embodiment of the invention realizes the quick and accurate acquisition of the state estimation result of the power system.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Digital twin intelligent building brain machine device and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligence, in particular to a digital twin intelligent building brain machine device and a system, which comprise: a brain-computer interface, a brain-computer database, a brain-computer engine and a brain-computer center; the brain-computer center comprises a 3M brain-computer center, a fire-fighting security brain-computer center, an electromechanical logic brain-computer center, a carbon brain-computer center, a whole-process consultation brain-computer center and a network-connected building brain-computer center; the brain-computer engine includes: 3M +3S engine, ioT engine, UWB positioning engine and OA engine; the brain-computer interface provides a brain-computer data interface module and a conversion protocol under a standard protocol; the brain-computer database includes: ioT database, 3M +3S database, expert knowledge database. The invention creates a digital twin intelligent building brain machine device and system which can vertically penetrate through a CIM (common information model), and on the basis of not changing the original design of an intelligent building, the brain machine device is implanted into the traditional intelligent building, the traditional intelligent building is transversely fused, and the intelligent application is enabled and promoted.

title_en: Power system state estimation method capable of adjusting weight
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power system state estimation, and discloses a power system state estimation method capable of adjusting weight, which comprises the following steps: a) Inputting a measurement vector z and a given initial value x  0  Performing primary iteration by adopting a weighted least square method-power system state estimation WLS-SE fixed algorithm to obtain a state correction vector Wherein, the weight and the step length of the WLS-SE fixed algorithm are fixed values; b) Adjusting the weight of the WLS-SE fixed algorithm by adopting an IGG robust method to obtain a WLS-SE adjusting algorithm with variable weight; c) Adjusting algorithm pair by WLS-SE Performing loop iteration until the state correction vector of the kth iteration And (5) reaching a convergence condition and outputting an optimal state estimation value. The weight is automatically adjusted according to the calculated residual error in each iteration process of the algorithm, so that variable weight operation is realized, and after the weight is adjusted to the optimal state, the system can better weaken the influence of bad data and greatly improve the estimation quality.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Learning model generation device, operating state estimation device, learning model generation method executed by learning model generation device, estimation method executed by operating state estimation device, and program
abstract_en: To assist in recovery work by estimating an operating state of an elevator facility in the event of occurrence of a disaster.SOLUTION: A learning model generation device (4) includes a learning unit (42) that performs machine learning by use of teacher data including location information indicating a location of an elevator facility, disaster information including a degree of a disaster at the location, and operating-state information indicating an operating state of the elevator facility in the event of occurrence of the disaster, thereby using the location information on a target elevator facility and the disaster information as input data to generate a learning model (451) for outputting an operating state of the target elevator facility.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: FUJITEC KK

title_en: Data diagnosis device to cope with malicious data injection in power measurement facilities
title_ko: 전력 계측 설비의 악의적인 데이터 주입에 대응하기 위한 데이터 진단 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: According to one aspect of the present invention, a data diagnosis apparatus to cope with malicious data injection in a power measurement facility may include: a pre-processing unit which converts past measurement data into time series data; a recurrent neural network which predicts a future measurement value by learning from the time series data; a front failure identification module which determines whether there is a failure based on state estimation of a measurement value measured by an actual power measurement facility; and a rear failure identification module which compares the measurement value predicted by the recurrent neural network with a measurement value determined as normal by the front failure identification module so as to diagnose failure data when a difference of a prediction value and an actual value exceeds a threshold value. The present invention has an advantage of increasing security of a power management system.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 측면에 따른 전력 계측 설비의 악의적인 데이터 주입에 대응하기 위한 데이터 진단 장치는, 과거 계측 데이터를 시계열 데이터로 변환하는 전처리부; 상기 시계열 데이터로 학습하여 미래 계측값을 예측하는 순환 신경망; 실제 전력 계측 설비가 측정한 계측값을 상태 추정 기반으로 장애 여부를 판정하는 전단 장애 식별 모듈; 및 상기 순환 신경망으로 예측한 계측값과 상기 전단 장애 식별 모듈에서 정상이라고 판정한 계측값을 비교하여, 예측값과 실제값의 차이가 임계값을 넘으면 장애 데이터로 진단하는 후단 장애 식별 모듈을 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: KOREA ELECTRIC POWER CORP;IAC IN NAT UNIV CHUNGNAM

title_en: Power grid digital twin body construction method and platform for supporting debugging operation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid digital twin body construction method and a platform for supporting debugging operation, which comprise the following steps: acquiring power grid online data and offline data for constructing a power grid digital twin; according to the characteristics of the online data and the offline data of the power grid, different file adapters are constructed, and the file adapters are adapted to the online data and the offline data of the power grid; and analyzing the power grid online data and the power grid offline data through the file adapter, adapting the power grid online data and the power grid offline data into corresponding power grid models through the file adapter, mapping data to a power grid digital twin body, and constructing the power grid digital twin body. The problem that the scheduling service lacks real-time flexible and agile decision support is solved.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Power battery management architecture and method based on Rainbow chain
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power battery management architecture and a method based on a Raspy chain, wherein the power battery management architecture comprises a vehicle end user layer, a cloud end micro service layer and a cloud end twin model layer which are sequentially connected and form the Raspy chain, functions required by a vehicle end are abstracted into micro services, the cloud end platform adopts a hierarchical design, a plurality of power battery digital twin models are established at the cloud end to solve the service functions, the digital twin models are evaluated and preferably selected to serve as the micro services to be provided to the vehicle end users based on a competition mechanism, parameters and the like are stored based on competition results to form an information chain, the model capability under the condition of subsequent micro service requests is improved, and the direct and efficient management of the power battery is realized by adopting a Raspy chain multi-level control architecture.
assignees: UNIV BEIHANG

title_en: Digital twin operation monitoring system for electric power facilities
abstract_en: The invention relates to a digital twin operation monitoring system of an electric power facility, which covers the electric power facility and comprises a transformer substation and an electric transmission line, wherein the system comprises an existing data acquisition and monitoring subsystem; a sensor acquisition network; a network camera monitoring unit; a data bus; a digital twinner; a digital twinning visualization subsystem. Compared with the prior art, the method establishes the digital twin body, and realizes one-to-one correspondence and two-way linkage of the business entity object and the digital object; a digital twin visualization subsystem is also established, the actual running state of the power facility is more efficiently reflected through a visual two-dimensional or three-dimensional digital model presentation mode, and the efficiency of information sharing and data analysis can be greatly improved by combining the output of a large-screen, PC, VR, AR and other multi-type interactive terminals.
assignees: NANJING ZELIN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for automatically acquiring and visualizing urban waterlogging real-time information
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for automatically acquiring and visualizing urban waterlogging real-time information, which is developed based on social media data, can fully utilize the characteristics of real-time updating of media data and large data volume of who calls you, and can play a role in feeding back urban waterlogging geographic information in real time when a flood disaster occurs; by means of the web crawler and the neural network model, dependence on actual conditions basically does not exist, and the method can be suitable for acquiring urban waterlogging geographic information of different places, different time periods and different environments; the method provides excellent and accurate search keywords, and realizes automatic acquisition and visualization of urban waterlogging real-time information by combining a neural network deep learning technology and a longitude and latitude conversion technology.
assignees: UNIV ZHONGSHAN

title_en: Power grid planning system based on three-dimensional landform
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid planning system based on three-dimensional landforms, which comprises three-dimensional model data based on a power grid key region and multi-dimensional heterogeneous data acquired by various devices, and a remarkable visualization method based on multi-dimensional projection of visual data in time domain and space domain is adopted to fuse massive multi-dimensional heterogeneous data into a three-dimensional model, so that three-dimensional fusion display of massive heterogeneous data is realized. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the method has the advantages that a three-dimensional panoramic power grid digital construction mode is used, a regional digital twin digital power grid is created, the data sharing efficiency is improved, a data sharing mechanism is established, and support is provided for better self operation of the power grid and better service place economic and social development.
assignees: STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD CHENGDE POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Prediction auxiliary state estimation method, device, equipment and medium for power system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of data processing, and provides a prediction auxiliary state estimation method, a prediction auxiliary state estimation device and a prediction auxiliary state estimation medium for a power system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an initial state prediction value and an initial state transition matrix of the power system; inputting the initial state prediction value and the initial state transition matrix into a pre-constructed state prediction model to obtain a state prediction value at a target moment; the state prediction model is constructed on the basis of a vector autoregressive model; and acquiring a state measured value of the target time, and acquiring a state estimation result of the target time based on the state predicted value of the target time and the state measured value of the target time. The state prediction model can comprehensively consider the time correlation and the space correlation of the power system data, so that the obtained state prediction value is more accurate, the accuracy and the reliability of the state estimation result can be improved, the application range is wider, and the problems of small application range, low accuracy and low reliability of the conventional prediction auxiliary state estimation method are solved.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Electric energy indication value fitting repair method for electric power spot transaction
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric energy indication value fitting repair method for electric power spot transaction, which comprises the following steps of: s1, determining a user category distinguishing basis by analyzing user composition participating in spot transaction, and acquiring electric energy indicating value curve data successfully acquired by various users; s2, conducting abnormity study and judgment on the user electric energy indicating curve, and emptying abnormal node indicating values in the electric energy indicating curve, namely rejecting abnormal points; s3, after the abnormal node indicating values are eliminated, according to actual requirements of a spot trading market, different fitting rules are designed for various users distinguished in the step S1, and missing data after the electric energy indicating value curves of various users are emptied are subjected to complete restoration according to the fitting rules; and S4, carrying out anomaly study and judgment verification on the data fitted in the step S3 again, and repeating the steps S2 and S3 until the abnormal points of the electric energy indicating value curve are completely repaired.
assignees: MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;GREAT POWER SCIENCE AND TECH STOCK CO LTD STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CORPORATION

title_en: Power distribution system state estimation method and system considering measurement of communication reliability
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power systems, and provides a power distribution system state estimation method and system considering measurement of communication reliability. Firstly, a random state estimation model of the power distribution system considering measurement loss is established, and a series of random 0-1 variables are introduced into the model to represent the random loss condition of the measurement. In order to calculate the value of each random variable, a method for calculating the measurement communication reliability by considering the operation state of the communication equipment is provided. And searching communication paths between the measurement and the estimator based on depth-first traversal, calculating the reliability of each path based on the running time of the current equipment, then performing orthogonalization processing on all paths, and adding the reliabilities of all orthogonal paths to obtain the measurement communication reliability. And finally, deducing an extended Kalman filtering algorithm of the established random state estimation model based on the projective theory, and introducing the communication reliability of each measurement into the estimation process to realize reasonable distribution of measurement weight and improve the state estimation precision.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG

title_en: Digital twin-based multi-energy coupling optimization scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of energy optimization scheduling, and provides a digital twin-based multi-energy coupling optimization scheduling method and system. The method comprises the steps of obtaining historical operation data, equipment constraint conditions and initial states of the multi-energy-flow comprehensive energy system, and predicting similar daily load and power generation data based on a deep neural network; correcting the coefficient of the virtual space twin model corresponding to the multi-energy flow comprehensive energy system according to the predicted similar daily load and the predicted power generation data; and performing multi-objective optimization decision based on the maintenance cost function, the transaction cost function and the environmental protection cost function according to the electricity price and the equipment constraint condition of each time period to obtain an optimal solution set, and finally determining the charge and discharge power of the energy storage device, the output power of each unit and the power of a connecting line.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Self-adaptive integrated load prediction method for power distribution network facing edge calculation
abstract_en: An edge-computing-oriented power distribution network self-adaptive integrated load prediction method comprises the following steps: inputting relevant information of a region governed by a power distribution network edge computing device; respectively carrying out standardization processing on a load historical data set and an environment temperature historical data set in an initial training set to obtain training sets; reducing the dimension of the echo state variable of the reserve pool; obtaining an integrated echo state network prediction model of day 1; obtaining the load prediction result of the nth day; obtaining an integrated echo state network prediction model of the (n + 1) th day; judging whether the long-term prediction day identification is less than or equal to the long-term prediction day identification; and obtaining a new model weight coefficient. The method not only gives play to the advantages of generalization of the integrated learning model, but also avoids redundant calculation of the integrated learning model; further reducing computing and storage resources during online updating; the self-adaption problem of the edge side load prediction model is solved, and the complexity of the model is reduced to the maximum extent by covering the whole prediction period.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID DIGITAL GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Subway deep foundation pit construction safety early warning and auxiliary decision making method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a subway deep foundation pit construction safety early warning and auxiliary decision-making method and system, comprising the steps of obtaining physical data of a subway deep foundation pit; the physical data comprises foundation pit entity information, foundation pit state information and foundation pit environment information, a clustering algorithm is applied to partition a subway deep foundation pit based on the physical data, a CSA-BPNN neural network is applied to each partition, geological parameter inversion is conducted by combining simulation data output by a digital twin model of the subway deep foundation pit, geological parameter predicted values, foundation pit entity simulation information and foundation pit environment simulation information obtained based on the digital twin model of the subway deep foundation pit are input into a foundation pit state predicted model, foundation pit state predicted values of each partition are obtained, and construction safety pre-warning and auxiliary decision are conducted. Based on refinement subregion is carried out to the foundation ditch to can carry out the state prediction to each subregion, improve the accuracy of state prediction and then more accurate safety precaution and the auxiliary decision of carrying out.

title_en: Method and system for analyzing loss correlation degree of active power distribution network
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for analyzing loss correlation degree of an active power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting N groups of operating parameters of each electrical device in the active power distribution network; performing data cleaning on the collected operating parameters of each group of electrical equipment, filling missing data by adopting a K-NN method, and removing abnormal data by adopting a K-means clustering method; calculating to obtain the total loss and the subsection loss of the active power distribution network corresponding to each group of parameters; and respectively calculating the association degrees between the total loss and the subsection loss and the operation parameters of each electrical device by adopting a Pearson correlation coefficient method. According to the embodiment of the application, the loss reason of the active power distribution network can be simply and efficiently globally analyzed.
assignees: STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Method and system for complementing collected data of power utilization area
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for complementing collected data of a power utilization area. The method for complementing the acquired data of the power utilization area comprises the following steps: s1, historical power consumption data of electric energy meters at all ports of an electric power station area and corresponding acquisition time are obtained, and a data historical curve is established. S2, acquiring the station area information of the current day of the power utilization station area; the station zone information comprises the equipment number and the port information of the electric energy meter, and the starting value and the cutoff value of the electric energy meter on the current day. And S3, judging whether the starting value and the stopping value of the electric energy meter at the same port are missing or not at the same day, and completing the missing data. And S4, calculating the electric quantity Er of the current day according to the initial value and the cutoff value of the current day, further judging whether the electric quantity data of the corresponding electric energy meter is normal, and correcting. According to the invention, the problem of failure of analysis algorithm models such as distribution room curves and line losses caused by data loss abnormality is solved by compensating and correcting data loss or abnormality acquired by the distribution room.
assignees: ANHUI NANRUI ZHONGTIAN ELECTRIC POWER ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent power plant digital engineering platform
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent power plant digital engineering platform, which comprises: the two-dimensional data analysis module is used for accessing the third-party system data of the power plant and providing two-dimensional data service; the digital twinning module is used for carrying out three-dimensional digital twinning operation and maintenance management by taking the three-dimensional model as a carrier; and the coupling module is respectively connected with the two-dimensional data analysis module and the digital twin module, and is used for coupling the two-dimensional data analysis module and the digital twin module pushed by the pixel stream through a WEB browsing end, so that a user can simultaneously perform two-dimensional data service and three-dimensional digital twin operation and maintenance management through the WEB browsing end. From this, through coupling module with two-dimensional data analysis and three-dimensional digital twin fortune dimension management combine together, both have the advantage that digital twin system is directly perceived, the integration nature is strong, have two-dimensional fortune dimension high efficiency, convenient advantage again, the promotion of the intelligent power plant fortune dimension efficiency of being convenient for can realize the fortune dimension of intelligent power plant more succinctly, high-efficiently.
assignees: EAST CHINA ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD CHINA POWER ENG CONSULTING GROUP

title_en: Electric power spot market test system and method and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a power spot market test system, method and electronic device, the power spot market test system comprising: an integrated mirror module; mirror simulation for the electric power spot market based on digital twinning techniques; a real-time data synchronization module; the system comprises a mirror image module, a data acquisition module, a data processing module and a data processing module, wherein the mirror image module is used for acquiring the electric power spot data of an electric power spot market; a power spot market simulation module; the method is used for constructing a current spot market testing simulation platform and a real-time spot market testing simulation platform based on the electric power spot data. The present market test simulation platform includes: the system comprises a physical model access and management unit, an economic model access and management unit, a plan type and declaration type data access and management unit, a multi-day reliability unit combination unit, a day-ahead electric energy market unit, a day-ahead standby market unit and the like. The real-time spot market test simulation platform comprises: the system comprises a spot real-time market data management unit, a case creation unit, a clearing unit, an analysis unit and a real-time security check unit.
assignees: TRAINING CENTER STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Optimized operation method of renewable energy-containing multi-heat-source networked heating system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimized operation method of a renewable energy-containing multi-heat-source networked heating system, which comprises the following steps: establishing a digital twin model of a multi-heat-source networked heating system containing renewable energy; setting a system operation control mode according to the energy distribution characteristics of the system region; establishing a multi-heat source networking heating system operation model with a multi-objective function with the minimum system comprehensive cost, the minimum carbon emission and the maximum energy consumption satisfaction degree and setting system constraint conditions; converting a multi-heat-source networked heating system operation model into a Markov decision process; and (3) improving a deep reinforcement learning algorithm: the method comprises the steps that a current network is set to comprise two critic value networks and an operator strategy network, each network is provided with a corresponding target network, the optimal action is selected through the operator strategy network in the current network, and the optimal action selected through the strategies is evaluated and analyzed through the two independent critic networks in the target networks, so that the optimal operation strategy of the system is obtained.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ENGIPOWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network harmonic state estimation method based on cooperation of PQM, TTU and SM measurement data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network harmonic state estimation method based on measurement data cooperation of PQM, TTU and SM. The method overcomes the defect that the traditional power distribution network harmonic state estimation method needs a large amount of same-type measurement data, can estimate the probability distribution of node injection harmonic current, realizes high-frequency estimation of node harmonic voltage, and improves the accuracy of estimation results.

title_en: Transformer substation management method and system based on digital twins
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transformer substation management method and system based on digital twins. The method comprises the following steps: determining model information of the digital twin substation; constructing a digital twin model of the transformer substation according to the model information; acquiring operation and maintenance data of the transformer substation; and managing the transformer substation through the digital twin model according to the operation and maintenance data. According to the scheme provided by the invention, the key technology of the digital twin power grid is developed, the processes of equipment deployment, data collection and analysis are automated, the working efficiency of workers is improved, and the normal and healthy operation of the power station is ensured.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;QINGYUAN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Method and system for constructing digital twin body of power grid equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for constructing a digital twin body of power grid equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: aiming at typical equipment in a target power grid, constructing a digital twin body standard model of the equipment; establishing a mapping relation between a device real object and the digital twin standard model; according to the mapping relation, mapping from a device real object to the digital twin body standard model is achieved; constructing a three-dimensional virtual scene of the digital twin body standard model by taking a city as a basic geographical background, and displaying the real-scene information of the target power grid through the three-dimensional virtual scene; providing a visual rendering style of the digital twin body standard model under different scales through a distribution network topological graph; and realizing three-dimensional visualization of the distribution network rack through the digital twin body standard model so as to reflect the running state of the power grid in real time.
