abstract_en: The invention discloses an analysis and correction method based on big data, which is applied to an analysis and correction system based on big data, and comprises the following steps: collecting and preprocessing historical power data, inquiring, downloading and summarizing the historical power load data through big data; preprocessing the acquired data, and establishing a power load prediction model by adopting a three-layer BP neural network optimized by a particle swarm optimization algorithm; after the prediction model is constructed, the prediction result is further optimized, and the prediction of the optimal estimation at the next moment is completed by utilizing the algorithm characteristic of Kalman filtering and according to the existing data structure and constructing the state quantity, the observed quantity and the real-time update of the state; building a power load prediction analysis model; the model predictive value is corrected by combining the predictive result at each moment with the sectional predictive result, and the invention has the characteristics of improving the power predictive precision and stability.
assignees: ZHENG ZHENFU

title_en: Knowledge driven power grid topology identification and state estimation method considering measurement deficiency
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of circuit diagnosis, in particular to a knowledge driven power grid topology identification and state estimation method considering measurement deficiency. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring measurement data of a power distribution network, and predicting topology parameters of the power distribution network based on the measurement data to obtain predicted topology parameters of the power distribution network; based on the topological structure prediction model, predicting the topological structure of the power distribution network through measurement data of the power distribution network and predicted topological parameters of the power distribution network; and carrying out state prediction on the power distribution network based on the topological structure of the power distribution network and the measurement data of the power distribution network to obtain the power distribution network state of the power distribution network. The method and the device realize timely and accurate mastering of the running state of the power distribution network under the condition that the power distribution network has higher complexity, and ensure real-time mastering of the running state of the power distribution network, so that the power distribution network can be maintained timely when the state of the power distribution network is abnormal.
assignees: SOUTHERN POWER GRID DIGITAL GRID RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Full-journal cleaning and storing method based on power grid environment
abstract_en: The application provides a full-log cleaning and storing method based on a power grid environment, which comprises the following specific steps: receiving log data sent by network security equipment through Kafka; performing repeated data cleaning based on a quick log matching method of secondary query; processing the isolated point data by using a capping method to eliminate noise; setting the missing data as a sequence average value; normalizing log formats of different equipment types and different manufacturers, and converting the multi-source heterogeneous log types into uniform format for storage after normalization; extracting templates from the public data parts with the same characteristics, and independently storing the templates; based on the hadoop big data platform, mass log data are stored in a distributed mode, and follow-up distributed calculation and analysis are facilitated. The method adopts a secondary matching mode, greatly improves efficiency, and realizes unified storage of multi-source heterogeneous logs. The method is convenient for further analysis of the data, and the log is subjected to generalized storage, so that storage resources are saved.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Model predictive control method and system for steel gas balance based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention provides a model predictive control method and a system based on digital twin steel gas balance, which belong to the technical field of intelligent energy, and specifically comprise the following steps: based on influencing factors of the heat value of the gas, adopting a combustible prediction model based on an intelligent algorithm to obtain the heat value of the gas; based on the load demand of the load side, combining the heat value of the gas to obtain the flow demand of the gas of the load side; constructing a storage model of the gas conveying pipe network at least based on the structure, the inner diameter and the length of the gas conveying pipe network and the characteristics and the flow of the gas, so as to obtain the gas storage capacity of the gas conveying pipe network under different working conditions; based on the gas storage capacity of the gas conveying pipe network, the flow demand of the gas at the load side and the pressure constraint of the gas conveying pipe network, the valve opening at the gas generation side and the valve opening at the load side are adjusted, so that the reliability of the gas conveying pipe network and the operation stability of the load are ensured.
assignees: ZHEJIANG YINGJI ZHONGGONG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Building-based virtual power plant load prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building-based virtual power plant load prediction method, which relates to the technical field of virtual power plants, and is used for collecting central air conditioner operation data and establishing a corresponding air conditioner digital twin model and a building model; establishing a central air conditioner parameter data set, constructing a correlation analysis model, and determining the influence degree of variables in the central air conditioner parameter data set on the actual temperature; establishing a load change data set and acquiring a central air-conditioning state evaluation value Ktz to form a central air-conditioning load correlation coefficient Fxs; establishing a weather state data set and a corresponding weather influence coefficient Txs, and establishing a virtual power plant load prediction set and a virtual power plant load prediction model; and predicting possible running risks of the virtual power plant dispatching system, matching corresponding countermeasures and outputting. The strategy for adjusting the temperature in the building has a guiding effect, and the load of the virtual power plant is effectively reduced and the pressure of the dispatching system is reduced when the optimal temperature is obtained by combining the change of the load of the virtual power plant.

title_en: Power distribution network PMU optimal configuration method based on node evaluation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power distribution network PMU optimal configuration method based on node evaluation, which comprises the following steps: establishing a multi-constraint power distribution network global observable PMU optimization model; solving a PMU optimization model based on a 0-1 integer programming solver to obtain the optimal deployment node number and all feasible point distribution schemes; considering the time-space correlation among the nodes of the power grid, constructing a measurement index of the importance of the nodes to obtain an optimized distribution scheme under the limited condition of a PMU device; and estimating the state of the power grid under the condition that the optimized point distribution scheme does not meet the observability of the global topology based on the pseudo measurement structure and the state estimation method. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of optimizing the point distribution scheme under the limited PMU condition, estimating the power grid state and making up the observability of the system under the condition that the PMU point distribution does not meet the observability of the global topology, and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Reservoir flood control management method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention provides a reservoir flood control management method based on digital twins, which comprises the steps of establishing a digital twins water regime analysis model, establishing a digital twins visual display model, forecasting the twins water regime analysis model, issuing and early warning the forecasting result of S3, previewing the digital twins visual display model and executing the previewing result of S5; the method comprises the steps of applying a digital twin model, realizing functions of supporting forecasting, early warning, rehearsal and planning, and establishing a four-prediction mechanism for safety of downstream resident groups of a reservoir manager; the traditional reservoir manager's early warning mechanism is mainly to issue early warning work through rainfall forecast or real-time water level forecast.
assignees: BUREAU OF HYDROLOGY CHANGJIANG WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION;XIANGJI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Coal mine production three-dimensional visual information system based on Internet of things and sensor technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine production three-dimensional visual information system based on the Internet of things and sensor technology. The invention restores the whole mine production system by means of a three-dimensional modeling technology and a visualization technology, effectively combines various effective parameters which can be collected in the mine production process with the visual model of the coal mine industrial field and the underground production system in real time, vividly and integrally presents the real operation information of the mine in multi-dimensional data, breaks through all data islands to form a visual big data center, builds a digital twin management system, guides the daily safety production management of the mine, has more visual guidance function on the processing of emergent events, and lays an information foundation for the disaster prevention and relief of the mine.
assignees: HUAIBEI MINING IND CO LTD

title_en: Shockproof disaster reduction data management system based on digital twins
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based anti-seismic and disaster-reduction data management system, which comprises a data acquisition module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for collecting anti-seismic and disaster-reduction data including DEM (digital elevation model) topographic data, remote sensing image data, vector data, fracture data and white film data in a sorting area. The invention discloses a digital twin-based earthquake prevention and mitigation data management system, which is characterized in that seismic data information is preprocessed and fused, a global basic three-dimensional space data base is constructed, and a set of digital twin city earthquake visual interactive system prototype is designed. And selecting representative seismic data, and carrying out visual expression of seismic data information fusion on a certain subregion. The method aims to solve the problem of information island, improves data collection, circulation and sharing capacity, strengthens data asset value and promotes the improvement of earthquake-proof and disaster-reduction data management capacity.
assignees: EARTHQUAKE ADMINISTRATION OF BEIJING MUNICIPALITY;ZHONGKE YUNXING BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Safety level prediction of users after occurrence of a disaster
abstract_en: There is provided techniques for predicting safety level of a user after occurrence of a disaster. A method is performed by a controller. The method comprises obtaining an indication of a disaster in an area where the user is located. The method comprises, in response thereto, obtaining a current instance of a digital twin of the user from information received over a wireless network from a user equipment associated with the user. The method comprises computing an anomaly score for the user by comparing the current instance of the digital twin to at least one previous instance of the digital twin as defined by sensor data of the user obtained prior to the indication of the disaster. The method comprises predicting the safety level of the user after the disaster has occurred based on the anomaly score for the user.
assignees: ERICSSON TELEFON AB L M;GUELEN UTKU

title_en: Distributed photovoltaic power station output prediction method, system, computer and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a system, a computer and a storage medium for predicting output of a distributed photovoltaic power station, and belongs to the technical field of photovoltaic power stations; the method comprises the steps of collecting periodic historical data of a target distributed photovoltaic power station; the periodic historical data is subjected to a preprocessing algorithm to obtain effective output data; optimizing relevant parameters of the class II classification model by adopting a particle swarm algorithm based on the effective output data to obtain a prefabricated prediction algorithm; and according to weather data of the target distributed photovoltaic power station on the prediction day, carrying out short-term output prediction on the power generation power on the prediction day by utilizing a prefabricated prediction algorithm. According to the method, the data quality can be improved by deleting and interpolating the abnormal data and the missing data, the regularization parameters and the nuclear parameters of the two-class classification model are optimized by utilizing the particle swarm algorithm, the prediction precision and the solving speed of the prefabricated prediction algorithm on the photovoltaic power generation power can be improved, and the method has stronger generalization capability and result stability.

title_en: Method and device for constructing false data injection attack model
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for constructing a false data injection attack model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: according to a power flow model of the power system, establishing a nonlinear relation between the quantity measurement and the state quantity under alternating current state estimation; converting the nonlinear relationship into a linear relationship under direct current state estimation; maximizing the power generation cost and the load shedding cost of the power system as an objective function of an upper layer of the model, minimizing the active power output by the generator and the load shedding amount on the node after the safety constraint economic dispatch is executed as an objective function of a lower layer model, and constructing a double-layer model by combining with preset constraints; and converting the double-layer model into a single-layer nonlinear programming model to obtain an attack model. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that a double-layer model is built, so that a false data injection attack model is obtained, factors such as system power generation cost, load shedding cost and the like are fully considered, extra energy consumption is caused by normal start and stop of a generator set, and attack efficiency can be effectively improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Risk management and analysis method for supply chain, and computer-readable storage medium recorded with program for executing the same
title_ko: 물자 공급망 위험관리 및 분석 방법과, 동 방법을 컴퓨터에서 실행하기 위한 컴퓨터 프로그램이 기록된, 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록매체
abstract_en: The present invention provides a risk management and analysis method for a material supply chain, and a computer-readable storage medium recorded with a computer program for executing the same method in a computer, wherein the method comprises: a transaction big data acquisition step of acquiring big transaction data between supply chain participating companies for each material and each type; a connectivity and supply chain analysis step of classifying companies connected to a transaction network and analyzing a transaction volume, a transaction amount, an inter-company connectivity, and a supply chain; a cluster classification step of classifying core supply company group clusters; a supply chain crisis analysis step of analyzing a spread flowchart, a spread period, related costs, and supply capacity reduction of the supply chain in time phases affected by supply restrictions or blocking of a specific country or specific company; a digital twin model analysis step of analyzing key information, a supply capacity, a reorganization period, and a cost change about supply chain participating companies using a digital twin model; an alternative supply chain analysis step of analyzing a survival probability, a survival period, a monopoly ratio, a transportation period, a transportation distance, and a cost change in an alternative supply network when the alternative supply network in accordance with a specific scenario is applied; a roadmap generation step of generating a supply chain roadmap for crisis management of the supply chain for materials that are likely to occur in the future, thereby analyzing the supply chain for materials in worldwide international countries and domestic countries, reorganizing the supply chain, and establishing countermeasures through alternative supply chains in the event of a supply chain crisis.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 물자 별 및 종류 별 공급망 참가기업 간 거래 빅데이터를 획득하는, 거래 빅데이터 획득 단계, 거래망으로 각각 연결된 기업들을 분류하고, 거래량과 거래금액과 기업 간 연결도와 공급망 사슬을 분석하는, 연결도 및 공급망 사슬 분석 단계; 핵심 공급기업군 클러스터를 분류하는, 클러스터 분류 단계, 특정 국가 또는 특정 기업의 공급 제한 또는 차단으로 인해 영향을 받는 공급망의 시차 별 확산순서도와 확산기간과 관련비용과 공급능력 감소를 분석하는, 공급망 위기 분석 단계, 디지털 트윈 모델을 이용하여, 공급망 참가기업들에 대한 주요정보와 공급능력과 재편소요기간과 비용변화를 분석하는, 디지털 트윈 모델 분석 단계, 특정 시나리오에 따른 대체공급망 적용시, 대체공급망에서의 생존확률, 생존기간, 독과점비율, 운송기간, 운송거리 및 비용변화를 각각 분석하는, 대체공급망 분석 단계, 및 미래에 발생할 가능성이 높은 물자에 대한 공급망의 위기관리를 위한 공급망 로드맵을 생성하는, 로드맵 생성 단계를 포함하여, 전세계 국가 간 및 국내 물자의 공급망을 분석하며, 공급망을 재편하고, 공급망 위기 시 대체공급망을 통해 대책을 수립하는, 물자 공급망 분석 및 위험관리 방법과, 동 방법을 컴퓨터에서 실행하기 위한 프로그램이 기록된 컴퓨터 판독가능한 기록매체를 개시한다.
assignees: ALLSEADATA INC

title_en: AI-based energy edge platform, systems, and methods having a digital twin of a mining environment
abstract_en: An AI-based platform for enabling intelligent orchestration and management of power and energy is disclosed. The platform includes a digital twin system having a digital twin of a mining environment. The digital twin includes at least one parameter that is detected by a sensor of the mining environment. In some disclosed embodiments, the at least one parameter is associated with one or more of an unmined portion of the mining environment a mining of materials from the mining environment, a smart container event involving a smart container associated with the mining environment, a physiological status of a miner associated with the mining environment, a transaction-related event associated with the mining environment, and a compliance of the mining environment with one or more contractual, regulatory, and/or legal policies.
assignees: STRONG FORCE EE PORTFOLIO 2022 LLC

title_en: Power edge calculation method, system, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power edge calculation method, a system, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that initial power monitoring data collected by a data collection terminal are obtained by connecting to the preset data collection terminal; preprocessing the initial power supervision data to obtain target power supervision data; performing power utilization characteristic analysis based on the target power supervision data, and determining power utilization abnormity based on the analyzed power utilization characteristic data; the invention avoids the generation of abnormal data such as missing data, redundant data and the like, improves the data quality, ensures the data reliability, improves the power utilization abnormality detection efficiency and the accuracy of the power utilization abnormality detection, and ensures the stable operation of the system.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD;SOUTHERN POWER GRID DIGITAL GRID RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Method, system and medium for constructing digital twin information model of power distribution terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and a medium for constructing a digital twin body information model of a power distribution terminal, which comprise the following steps: s1, obtaining a modeling source of a digital twin information model of a power distribution terminal; s2, modeling a digital twin logical node of a power distribution terminal; s3, modeling of digital twin logic equipment of the power distribution terminal; and S4, modeling a digital twin information model of the power distribution terminal. The method of the invention provides a digital twin information model modeling method of the power distribution terminal based on IEC61850 and a digital twin technology to perform digital twin modeling and information model modeling on the power distribution terminal, thereby realizing comprehensive monitoring and plug and play of the power distribution terminal.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Offshore wind farm operation and maintenance method and system based on digital twins
abstract_en: The invention discloses an offshore wind farm operation and maintenance method and system based on digital twins, and belongs to the technical field of offshore wind farm intelligent operation and maintenance. Signals required for establishing a digital twin system are collected on a data perception level, data fusion is realized through edge calculation, a digital twin model with mechanism data dual drive is established, the signal collected in a physical space is used for activating the model, functions of power prediction, state evaluation, fault early warning, fault diagnosis, service life prediction and the like based on the digital twin are realized, and self-adaptive correction of the digital twin model can be realized along with the change of the running state of equipment. Through the practical application of the digital twin system, the invention can effectively reduce field personnel, reduce maintenance time, reduce annual average shutdown time and reduce the failure rate of the unit, can serve for the safe, efficient and intelligent development and utilization of large-scale offshore wind power, and effectively improves the technical level of offshore wind power operation and maintenance.
assignees: HUANENG CLEAN ENERGY RES INST;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD

title_en: Electric energy quality data cleaning method based on correlation analysis
abstract_en: The invention mainly aims to solve the problem that the reliability of a power quality analysis result is influenced by the data quality problems such as missing, abnormity and the like in power quality data acquired by a power grid harmonic monitoring and analyzing system, and provides a power quality data cleaning method based on correlation analysis, wherein the missing data is filled based on the measurement index correlation; the abnormal data are detected based on the control chart, and are identified based on the measurement index correlation and the time series model, so that the data quality problems of deletion, abnormality and the like in the power quality monitoring data are solved, the reliability of the power quality monitoring data is improved, and the power quality management decision effect is prevented from being influenced by the fact that the power quality is analyzed in error due to the data quality problems.
assignees: TONGXIANG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution system state estimation method and system for high-permeability unmonitored photovoltaic power generation
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution system state estimation method and system for high-permeability unmonitored photovoltaic power generation, comprising the following steps: the method comprises the steps that a server classifies all photovoltaic power generation nodes in a power distribution network to obtain a first node set and a second node set; determining a first power generation characteristic as a third power generation characteristic; the server compares the third power generation characteristic with the corresponding second power generation characteristic to obtain a distinguishing characteristic, obtains power generation relation information of the corresponding second photovoltaic power generation nodes and the first photovoltaic power generation nodes based on the distinguishing characteristic, counts the first photovoltaic power generation nodes and power generation relation generation state estimation corresponding tables corresponding to all the second photovoltaic power generation nodes respectively, and stores the power generation relation information and the power generation state estimation corresponding tables in the database; and generating second electric energy information corresponding to the second photovoltaic power generation node based on the state estimation correspondence table and the first electric energy information, and generating power distribution system state estimation data according to the first electric energy information and the second electric energy information.
assignees: YONGKANG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;YONGKANG GUANGMING POWER TRANS AND TRANSFORMATION ENGINEERING CO LTD;JINHUA POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: New energy power system dispatching method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of new energy power system dispatching, and particularly relates to a new energy power system dispatching method based on digital twinning; it comprises the following steps: constructing a short-term direct probability prediction model suitable for photovoltaic power; constructing an electric power digital twin system, and utilizing ubiquitous Internet of things and electric power data flow to assist decision making of power grid operation management regulation through real-time situation awareness and real-time virtual deduction; based on the new energy interval prediction result, a robust scheduling model is established, the automatic power generation control response of the unit is considered to cope with the new energy output fluctuation, and the power balance of the power grid is ensured; the invention has higher prediction area coverage rate and smaller average width ratio of the prediction interval, based on the existing real-time data information of each level at the dispatching side, the prediction model has real-time updating property, the applicability and generalization of the prediction model to the local power grid situation are improved, and the optimization and improvement of the existing dispatching system are realized based on the real-time prediction result of the new energy interval.
assignees: BEIXIANG COUNTY POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Digital twinning-based method and device for monitoring natural disaster risk of immovable cultural relics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based natural disaster risk monitoring method for an immovable cultural relic, which comprises the steps of S1, determining a natural disaster risk entity of the immovable cultural relic, wherein the natural disaster risk entity comprises a natural disaster risk monitoring object, a natural disaster risk monitoring main body and a natural disaster risk monitoring means, S2, constructing twinning data of the immovable cultural relic, the natural disaster risk monitoring object, the natural disaster risk monitoring main body and the natural disaster risk monitoring means, S3, acquiring monitoring data related to the immovable cultural relic, and S4, judging the risk of the immovable cultural relic by utilizing the twinning data and the monitoring data. The invention also provides a monitoring device. The invention can provide early warning and guidance for the preventive protection of the immovable cultural relics.

title_en: Power communication resource operation and maintenance control method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twinning-based power communication resource operation and maintenance control method, which comprises the following operation steps: s1: analyzing the bearing relation of the electric power communication resources and the digital twin requirement; s2: the method comprises the steps of collecting static and dynamic data of power communication resources, and constructing a visual expression model suitable for digital twin of the power communication resources; s3: digital twin agility modeling of power communication resources based on multi-source data; s4: the digital twin body of the power communication resource cooperatively interacts with the entity resource; s5: and (5) establishing a prototype and verification of the digital twin platform of the power communication typical resource. The invention is applied to the construction of the power information communication resource risk early warning and optimizing system, can reduce the construction difficulty to a great extent, shortens the construction period, avoids entering a technical error zone, further reduces the investment risk and improves the investment income.
assignees: NANYANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Novel power system digital twin deduction optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel digital twin deduction optimization method and system for a power system, comprising the following steps: generating a multi-distribution operation sample based on sample distribution contained in historical acquisition data of the power system, and acquiring the multi-distribution operation sample; constructing a digital twin hybrid model based on the multi-distributed operation samples, and acquiring an operable digital twin hybrid model; determining operational state data corresponding to the input operational data based on the operational digital twin hybrid model; setting an optimal result, and determining an association relationship between the running state data and the optimal result based on a preset digital twin dual model; based on the association relation, the digital twin body operation data in the optimized operation state is used as an optimization basis of the physical equipment of the power system, so that the power system equipment is optimized based on digital twin deduction.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Electric power facility early warning method and system based on twin platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric power facility early warning method and system based on a twin platform, comprising the following steps: s1: the acquisition module acquires facility information and environment information, and configures facility conditions, facility results and an early warning scheme; s2: constructing a digital twin model based on the facility information and the environment information; s3: the display module displays the digital twin model and the facility information, and if the facility information meets the facility conditions, the control module executes the facility result and the early warning module executes the early warning scheme. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the information of the electric power facilities can be displayed through the twin model, and the early warning and the control of the electric power facilities can be realized.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD JIAXING POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Power grid situation supervision method, system and storage medium based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based power grid situation supervision method, a digital twin-based power grid situation supervision system and a storage medium, wherein a digital twin-based power grid model is constructed, power grid transmission data and power grid power supply data of a preset area are monitored and obtained in real time based on the Internet of things, the power grid transmission data and the power grid power supply data are imported into the power grid model to simulate power grid operation, and visual power grid supervision data are obtained; acquiring environmental data of a preset area, generating a plurality of groups of environmental simulation parameters according to the environmental data, guiding the environmental simulation parameters into a power grid model to perform power grid operation simulation, performing power grid power supply pressure analysis based on simulation results, and generating a power supply correction scheme. The invention can adapt the power grid system to various sudden environmental changes, improve the stability of the power grid power transmission and supply load and improve the running efficiency of the power grid.
assignees: SANHE POWER TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Communication data analysis method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for analyzing communication data, and relates to the technical field of computers. The analysis method of the communication data comprises the following steps: acquiring communication behavior data in a historical time period after occurrence of a preset geological disaster event, wherein the communication behavior data are as follows: presetting data generated by communication of terminal equipment in a target area corresponding to a geological disaster event; filling missing data into the communication behavior data to obtain target communication behavior data; and carrying out cluster analysis according to the target communication behavior data to obtain a cluster result, wherein the cluster result is used for representing the distribution condition and the movement condition of the terminal equipment. And (3) automatically communicating the behavior data, and then filling missing data into the communication behavior data, so that the acquired target communication behavior data is more complete, and clustering analysis is performed on the basis of the target communication behavior data to obtain a clustering result, thereby efficiently determining the distribution condition and the movement condition of the disaster-stricken masses and saving human resources.

title_en: Digital twin power grid system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin power grid system and a method, wherein the system comprises: the sensing layer is used for acquiring the internal working condition data of the power grid, which are acquired by the sensors in the power grid, and acquiring a power grid banded digital three-dimensional model acquired by the unmanned aerial vehicle and a power grid massive live-action three-dimensional model acquired by the satellite; the network layer is used for receiving the power grid internal working condition data uploaded by the sensing layer; the representation layer is used for fusing the power grid banded digital three-dimensional model and the power grid massive real three-dimensional model to obtain a power grid real three-dimensional model, taking the power grid real three-dimensional model as a carrier, and accessing and storing power grid internal working condition data uploaded by the network layer; and the application layer is used for carrying out real-time monitoring, emergency management and statistical analysis on the operation of the power grid based on the power grid live-action three-dimensional model and the power grid internal working condition data. The invention can realize real-time monitoring, emergency management and statistical analysis of the power grid, and is beneficial to guiding the operation decision of the power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER SPACE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Data preprocessing method and device for power system load model parameter identification
abstract_en: The invention provides a data preprocessing method and a device for power system load model parameter identification, wherein the method comprises the following steps: extracting original time sequence data of a power system load model, wherein the original time sequence data comprises active power, reactive power, voltage amplitude and voltage phase angle; and performing limit value verification processing and missing data filling processing on the original time sequence data to obtain pre-processing time sequence data, wherein the pre-processing time sequence data is used for identifying the parameters of the load model of the power system. According to the method, abnormal data in the original time sequence data are removed and replaced in a limit value check and missing data filling mode, so that input data for power system load model parameter identification is more reasonable, accurate input data can be input in the power system load model parameter identification process, parameter identification errors caused by the input of the abnormal data are avoided, and accuracy of a power system load model parameter identification result is effectively improved.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Intelligent meteorological digital twin visualization method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of meteorological monitoring, in particular to an intelligent meteorological digital twin visualization method and system. The method comprises the steps of constructing a 3D scene model of a target area, and importing meteorological monitoring equipment information and a digital twin body of the meteorological information into the 3D scene model; and acquiring meteorological monitoring data, a sea, land and air site and a service theme, and establishing a meteorological conduction neural network by combining the 3D scene model, wherein the comprehensive observation system cluster of the multi-dimensional visual three-dimensional perception target area. And (3) building a 3D model based on the target area, digitally recovering meteorological information and monitoring equipment information, building a disaster weather monitoring network, a city weather monitoring network and an environment weather monitoring network, comprehensively dialyzing a target area meteorological conduction neural network, and forming a built-in data series and platform linkage by a multi-dimensional visual three-dimensional perception ultra-large city comprehensive observation system cluster to build a more meticulous and more precise monitoring system.
assignees: HEFEI ZIXI ENERGY SAVING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Day-ahead scheduling method and system for power system based on big data filling and clustering
abstract_en: The invention provides a power system day-ahead scheduling method and system based on big data filling and clustering, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining historical load data of a power system; processing historical load data of the power system by adopting K-means clustering to obtain a scene set of load and wind and light; filling the load and wind-light data according to the load generated by clustering and the scene set of the wind-light; constructing a day-ahead scheduling model of the wind-solar power system; and solving the day-ahead scheduling model according to the filled load, the wind-solar data and the particle swarm algorithm to obtain an action scheme of each adjustable device. According to the method, the transverse and longitudinal comparison of the scene where the missing data are located is considered, the missing value is properly filled, and the recognition effect of the model is improved; the utilization rate of a large amount of load data is improved, the time change of load characteristics can be predicted, the reasonability of a day-ahead scheduling strategy is improved, and the scheduling result meets the development requirement of the power grid containing new energy.
assignees: STATE GRID HEILONGJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;JIXI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HEILONGJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power utilization map dynamic construction method and system based on crowd source sensing data prediction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power utilization map dynamic construction method and system based on crowd source sensing data prediction, comprising the following steps: s1, a step of cleaning real-time crowd source sensing data, which is used for summarizing and cleaning collected historical power consumption data and real-time sensor data, removing redundant data and error data, and simulating and supplementing missing data; s2, predicting the regional power consumption, wherein the power consumption is used for building a model; s3, a dynamic updating step of regional electricity consumption prediction is used for optimizing an electricity consumption prediction model based on newly acquired user electricity consumption at regular intervals, so that the prediction accuracy is improved; s4, carrying out map grading association on the power consumption prediction data, wherein a user carries out grading association on the real-time power consumption prediction data with the map; and S5, an electric map dynamic construction step, which is used for rendering and displaying the ArcGIS map newly built in the step four and the associated predicted electricity consumption in real time. The invention can realize small granularity prediction of regional power consumption.
assignees: SHIJIAZHUANG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH CO STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Visual design method of smart city energy management system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twinning-based visual design method for a smart city energy management system, which comprises the following steps: step 1: the energy management system main interface visual design; step 2: visual design of environmental data of an energy management system; step 3: energy consumption information visual design of an energy management system; step 4: visual design of energy management system water supply equipment; step 5: visual design of power supply equipment of an energy management system; step 6: the energy management system is a photovoltaic energy storage system and an information visual design; step 7: visual design of the photovoltaic power generation flow of the energy management system; step 8: visual design of the power distribution room of the energy management system; step 9: visual design of an energy management system water supply system and a pump house; step 10: according to the invention, through the visualization of the Hightopo application software, the urban energy consumption situation is tracked and effectively managed in time by utilizing two-dimensional, three-dimensional and other visualization means, and the centralized monitoring, management and decentralized control of energy sources are realized.
assignees: ZHEJIANG UNIV DEQING ADVANCED TECHNOLOGY AND INDUSTRY INSTITUTE

title_en: Power distribution network operation optimization method under digital twin framework
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network operation optimization method under a digital twin framework, which relates to the technical field of power distribution network operation optimization, and comprises the following steps: acquiring data of the power distribution network, and constructing a digital twin model of the power distribution network; forming an intelligent brain optimization module by adopting a particle swarm algorithm; the intelligent brain optimization module is used for calling the data of the power distribution network, planning the optimal topological structure of the power distribution network and realizing the real-time optimization of the operation of the power distribution network; based on the optimal topological structure of the power distribution network obtained through planning, the output signal is fed back to the power distribution network through a data interaction interface; the real-time optimization of the topological structure of the power distribution network can be realized, the network loss is effectively reduced, the voltage deviation is reduced, the economic benefit is improved, and the national energy conservation and emission reduction call is responded.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Petroleum drilling digital twin system based on deep neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an oil drilling digital twin system based on a deep neural network. Wherein, a deep neural network is introduced into the digital twin server. The method comprises the steps that a data sensor is installed on petroleum drilling equipment, acquired data such as vibration, temperature, pressure, position and the like and equipment operation parameters such as rotating speed, steering and hydraulic pressure and the like are sent to a deep neural network of a digital twin virtual twin through a digital twin data server, a trained deep neural network sends processed signals to a controller of a physical entity and a virtual twin scene, real-time state monitoring, forecasting and early warning of field equipment are achieved, automatic linkage control and intelligent operation among the drilling equipment are completed, an emergency situation is reacted in time, and drilling accidents are avoided.
assignees: NANJING UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Power distribution network fault processing method and device based on digital twin model
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution network fault processing method and device based on a digital twin model. According to the method, the digital twin model is constructed through the fault sample and the system function, so that the state monitoring and fault detection of each node in the power distribution network are realized. The method combines the measurement and control data, the protection data, the wave recording data and other diagnosis data of a plurality of adjacent nodes, comprehensively determines the fault condition of each node in the power distribution network, obtains fault information of fault feeders, fault types, fault positions and the like of fault points, and realizes the fault analysis and processing of the active power distribution network. The method and the device divide the scenes of the diagnostic data of each node in the active power distribution network, independently analyze the faults based on each divided test scene, and improve the effectiveness and the accuracy of the fault analysis of the active power distribution network.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID HEBEI ENERGY TECH SERVICE CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Provincial power spot market security check calculation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a provincial power spot market security check calculation method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: timely acquiring real-time state result data of the regional power grid, automatically checking a stored state estimation result, deleting result data failing to check, and avoiding developing provincial power spot market calculation based on an abnormal regional power grid model; the virtual control area part and interpolation method of the current province in the current province time state estimation result are utilized to replace the missing data of the state estimation result part equipment, so that the problem that the state estimation result is missing or has large deviation from actual measurement due to network delay and instability is solved; based on the historical stored regional power grid state estimation result, the power receiving calculation of the external province and the regional balance stretching are adopted to generate the power generation plan and the load prediction data of the external province, so that the problem that the power generation plan and the load prediction data of the external province are difficult to obtain when the power spot market safety check calculation is carried out on the provincial power grid is solved.
assignees: STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD;STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network partition bus voltage prediction method based on longitudinal federal learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network partition bus voltage prediction method based on longitudinal federal learning, which belongs to the field of power distribution network partition voltage prediction, and comprises the steps of respectively selecting partition bus voltage and partition power information as output and input of a prediction model, forming samples, identifying the samples by adopting an ID-based encryption sample alignment technology, identifying and replacing abnormal data in the aligned samples, filling missing data to complete preprocessing of sample data, training a XGBoost model based on longitudinal federal learning by utilizing the preprocessed sample data, and predicting partition bus voltage by utilizing a trained XGBoost model for reasoning.

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for constructing digital twin body architecture of power distribution terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for constructing a digital twin body architecture of a power distribution terminal, wherein the method comprises the steps of S1, analyzing the meaning and the characteristics of a digital twin body; s2, analyzing the digital twin body architecture characteristics of the power distribution terminal; s3, establishing a digital twin body modeling principle of the power distribution terminal; and S4, establishing a digital twin framework of the power distribution terminal. According to the method, the digital twin body of the power distribution terminal is constructed, the master station can comprehensively analyze the state of the power distribution terminal, and the defects that IEC 61850 can only reflect information interaction of the power distribution terminal, and the visualization degree is low and incomplete are overcome.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Nuclear power digital construction management platform, method and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a nuclear power digital construction management platform, a nuclear power digital construction management method and a readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of nuclear power management. The nuclear power digital construction management platform comprises a construction information model system, a progress management system and a project cluster management system, wherein the construction information model system is constructed with a digital twin model and used for generating material table information according to the digital twin model, and the progress management system is used for generating an operation plan and inputting the operation plan into the project cluster management system. The digital twin model can acquire data of the project cluster management system in real time for updating. The nuclear power digital construction management platform provided by the invention is constructed based on digital twin thinking, and is beneficial to realizing digital and visual management of the whole nuclear power construction process, so that the management efficiency and the management accuracy can be improved.
assignees: CHINA NUCLEAR IND 5TH CONSTR CO LTD

title_en: Method for identifying displacement area in space, and device therefor
title_ko: 공간 내 변위구역을 파악하는 방법 및 그 장치
abstract_en: A method for identifying a displacement area in a space, and a device therefor are disclosed. A device for identifying a displacement area receives a real-time image from a CCTV camera for photographing a predetermined area, compares a predefined reference image for the predetermined area and the real-time image so as to extract a displacement area in which a difference appears, and identifies, on the basis of predefined three-dimensional spatial information for the predetermined area, a three-dimensional location corresponding to the displacement area. The present invention is provided as a result of research and development conducted with the support of the "Digital Twin-based Disaster Safety Management Platform Technology Development" project of the Ministry of Science and ICT (Task identification No: 1711126503, Task No: 2020-0-00061-002, Department Name: Ministry of Science and ICT, Research Project Title: Digital Twin-based Disaster Safety Management Platform Technology Development (R&D), Research Task Title: Digital Twin-based Underground Culvert Fire and Disaster Support Integrated Platform Technology Development).
abstract_ko: 공간 내 변위구역을 파악하는 방법 및 그 장치가 개시된다. 변위구역파악장치는 일정 영역을 촬영하는 CCTV 카메라로부터 실시간 영상을 수신하고, 미리 정의되어 있는 일정 영역에 대한 기준영상과 실시간 영상을 비교하여 차이가 나타나는 변위영역을 추출하고, 일정 영역에 대하여 기 정의된 3차원 공간정보를 기초로 변위영역에 해당하는 3차원 위치를 파악한다. 본 발명은 과학기술정보통신부의 '디지털트윈기반재난안전관리플랫폼기술개발' 사업의 지원을 받아 수행한 연구개발의 결과로 도출된 것이다(과제고유번호:1711126503, 과제번호:2020-0-00061-002, 부처명:과학기술정보통신부, 연구사업명: 디지털트윈기반재난안전관리플랫폼기술개발(R&D), 연구과제명:디지털트윈 기반의 지하공동구 화재·재난 지원 통합플랫폼 기술개발).
assignees: ANYANG UNIV ACADEMY IND COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Digital twin program for generating flexible demand resource information
title_ko: 유연 수요 자원 정보를 생성하는 디지털 트윈 프로그램
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a digital twin program and, more specifically, to a digital twin program in which flexible demand resource information, which is information about electric power consumption that a market participant participating in an electric power trading market can change for a demand management operator according to a demand increase or decrease order, is calculated, and accurate flexible demand resource information can be continuously updated and generated by tuning the calculation method according to successful bid results.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 디지털 트윈 프로그램에 관한 것으로, 보다 구체적으로는 전력 거래시장에 참여하는 시장 참여자가 수요관리 사업자에게 수요 증감 주문에 따라 자신이 변화시킬 수 있는 전력 사용량에 관한 정보인 유연 수요 자원 정보를 계산하고 낙찰결과에 따라 계산방법을 튜닝하여 정확한 유연 수요 자원 정보를 지속적으로 갱신하여 생성할 수 있는 디지털 트윈 프로그램에 관한 것이다.
assignees: RAONFRIENDS CO LTD

title_en: 3d visualization method based on digital twin technology to manage urban air mobility substantiation
title_ko: 도심항공교통 실증 관리를 위한 디지털 트윈 기술에 기반한 3d 가시화 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for setting an airway of a UAM aircraft, which comprises the steps of: designing a UAM platform based on a digital twin technology; designing a dedicated airway for flying a UAM aircraft; designing a vertiport and arrival/departure routes for flying the UAM aircraft; and analyzing the risk of an airway of the UAM aircraft. In order to design a UAM platform based on a digital twin technology, a UAM digital infrastructure including at least one of a 2D infrastructure, a 3D infrastructure, and a UAM-dedicated database is constructed, and a 2D-based simulation and a 3D-based digital twin simulation can be performed. Also, in order to design a dedicated airway for flying a UAM aircraft, a guide based on at least one of GNSS and GPS is provided by applying a required navigation performance (RNP) navigation. In addition, in response to a case where the UAM aircraft satisfies the navigation performance of RNP 0.02, a horizontal range is designed to be 148 meters. In response to a case where the UAM aircraft satisfies the navigation performance of RNP 0.05, the horizontal range is designed to be 370 meters, and a vertical extent of the airway can be designed to be 60 meters with respect to one of 300 and 460 meters from a ground surface. Therefore, 3D simulation and visualization for airway creation and vertiport operation can be effectively expressed.
abstract_ko: UAM 기체의 항로를 설정하는 방법은, 디지털 트윈 기술 기반의 UAM 플랫폼을 설계하고, UAM 기체의 운항을 위한 전용 항로를 설계하며, 상기 UAM 기체의 운항을 위한 버티포트 및 입출항 경로를 설계하고, 상기 UAM 기체의 항로에 대한 위험도를 분석하는 것을 포함할 수 있다.  디지털 트윈 기술 기반의 UAM 플랫폼을 설계하기 위하여, 2D 인프라, 3D 인프라, 및 UAM 전용 데이터베이스 중 적어도 하나를 포함하는 UAM 디지털인프라가 구축되고, 2D 기반의 시뮬레이션 및 3D 기반의 디지털 트윈 시뮬레이션이 수행될 수 있다.  UAM 기체의 운항을 위한 전용 항로를 설계하기 위하여, RNP(Required Navigation Performance) 항법을 적용하여 GNSS 및 GPS 중 적어도 하나에 기반하는 가이드가 제공되고, 상기 UAM 기체가 RNP 0.02의 항법 성능을 충족하는 경우에 응답하여, 수평적 범위는 148 미터로 설계되고, 상기 UAM 기체가 RNP 0.05의 항법 성능을 충족하는 경우에 응답하여, 수평적 범위는 370 미터로 설계되며, 상기 항로의 수직적 범위는 지표면으로부터 300 미터 및 460 미터 중 하나를 중심으로 하는 60 미터로 설계될 수 있다.
assignees: INCHEON METROPOLITAN CITY;INST FOR AEROSPACE INDUSTRY ACADEMIA COLLABORATION;NEIGHBOR SYSTEM;RUDA SYS CO LTD

title_en: Method for providing Digital twin based Plant Management System using AI based image recognition technology and apparatus therefor
title_ko: Ai 기반 영상 인식 기술을 이용한 디지털 트윈 기반 공장 관리 시스템 제공 방법 및 이를 위한 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a digital twin-based factory management system using AI-based image recognition technology. The digital twin-based factory management system comprises: a wireless communication unit; a display unit; an image capture unit; and a processor. The display unit displays one or more facilities of factory in a virtual space output to the display unit by using digital twin technology. The processor determines the presence or absence of a predefined disaster situation in an image of a worker recognized from the image captured using the image capture unit based on deep learning-learning data. If it is determined that the disaster situation exists, the processor controls the wireless communication unit to transmit a danger signal to the worker's terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 AI 기반 영상 인식 기술을 이용한 디지털 트윈 기반 공장 관리 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 상기 디지털 트윈 기반 공장 관리 시스템은 무선 통신부; 디스플레이부; 영상촬영부; 및 프로세서를 포함하고, 상기 디스플레이부는 공장의 하나 이상의 설비를 디지털 트윈 기술을 이용하여 상기 디스플레이부에 출력되는 가상의 공간에 표현하고,상기 프로세서는 딥러닝 학습 데이터에 기반하여 상기 영상촬영부를 이용하여 촬영된 영상으로부터 인지된 작업자의 영상에서 사전에 정의된 재해 상황의 존부를 판단하며, 상기 프로세서는, 상기 재해 상황이 존재한다고 판단되면, 상기 작업자의 단말로 위험 신호를 송신하도록 상기 무선 통신부를 제어하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: JNE WORKS CO LTD

title_en: Implementation method and system for generating work ticket overhaul diagram based on electric power primary wiring diagram
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system automation, and provides a realization method and a system for generating a work ticket overhaul drawing based on a primary power wiring drawing. Setting colorless and transparent monitoring canvas on the map according to a coordinate area of the device in the map, and responding to an instruction of clicking the area to match the coordinate of the clicking position with a coordinate range in the map to obtain the device corresponding to the instruction; according to the state stored by the equipment, dynamic switching or manual selection switching is carried out, after the target state is determined, the primitive of the target state is combined with the original graph, so that manual adjustment of the equipment state based on the primary equipment wiring graph as the basic primitive is realized, and the generated work ticket overhaul graph supports real-time updating of the position, local interception of the dynamic graph and setting of a marked overhaul signboard.
assignees: JINXIANDAI INFORMATION IND CO LTD

title_en: Three-dimensional live-action twin method and system based on position intelligent technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a three-dimensional live-action twin method based on a position intelligent technology, which comprises the steps of constructing a digital-to-analog twin body standard-to-Chinese model of equipment aiming at typical equipment in a target power grid; establishing a mapping relation between a device object and the digital twin standard model; according to the mapping relation, mapping from the equipment object to the digital twin body standard model is realized; constructing a three-dimensional virtual scene of the digital Li Sheng standard model by taking a city as a basic geographic background, and displaying the real scene information of a target power grid through the three-dimensional virtual scene; providing visual rendering patterns of the digital twin standard model under different scales through a distribution network topological graph; and realizing three-dimensional visualization of the grid distribution network frame through the digital twin body standard model so as to reflect the running state of the power grid in real time.
assignees: ANHUI JIYUAN SOFTWARE CO LTD;STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD

title_en: Three-dimensional visualized information system for coal mine production based on Internet of things and sensor technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a three-dimensional visual information system for coal mine production based on the Internet of things and a sensor technology, and belongs to the technical field of coal mine production. The system comprises a three-dimensional modeling module, a production process real-time monitoring module, a video linkage visual management module, an MES management module, an alarm analysis module, a report curve analysis module, a three-level authority management login module and a navigation module. The invention restores the whole mine production engineering system by means of a 3D visualization technology, combines various effective parameters which can be acquired in the mine production process with the effective real-time of the visualization model of the coal mine industry square and the underground production system, integrates the real operation information multidimensional data of the mine into a whole, opens up all data islands, forms a visualized big data center, builds a digital twin management system, guides the daily safe production management of the mine, has more visual guiding function on the handling of emergency events, and lays information foundation for disaster prevention and relief of the mine.
assignees: HUAIBEI MINING IND CO LTD

title_en: Digital power plant-oriented resource collaborative scheduling management method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a resource collaborative scheduling management method and a system for a digital power plant, and relates to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring a plurality of monitoring items related to power generation operation in a target power plant; analyzing a plurality of correlation coefficients of abnormal occurrence of a plurality of monitoring items and abnormal occurrence of power generation operation; constructing a digital twin model for monitoring the power generation operation of the target power plant; according to the correlation coefficients, acquiring a plurality of pieces of update frequency information for carrying out data acquisition and update on a plurality of monitoring items in a next preset time period and M pieces of data scale information for carrying out image data acquisition and update on M areas, carrying out monitoring data acquisition and update on the plurality of monitoring items in the next preset time period, inputting the monitoring data acquisition and update into a digital twin model, obtaining operation abnormal probability, and carrying out early warning. The invention achieves the technical effect of improving the rationality of the scheduling management of the power generation operation monitoring resources in the digital power plant.
assignees: GUANGZHOU JIANXIN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based advanced warning method and system for potential insulation hazards
abstract_en: The invention relates to a digital twinning-based advanced warning method and a digital twinning-based advanced warning system for insulation hidden danger, which belong to the technical field of electric power monitoring. The invention fully considers the heating conditions of the urban cable insulation layer under various seasons and corresponding weather conditions, thereby screening abnormal monitoring points according to the heating conditions of the urban cable insulation layer and effectively improving the accuracy of identifying the abnormality of the urban cable. On the other hand, the wireless sensor monitoring network is set according to the actual scene condition, so that the monitoring of the abnormal condition of the urban cable is more reasonable.
assignees: SHENZHEN PAOWUXIAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Smart grid false data injection attack positioning method based on frequency spectrum domain data driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for positioning false data injection attack of a smart grid based on frequency spectrum domain data driving. Constructing a smart grid graph structure model based on the physical knowledge of the power grid; constructing a data set containing normal samples and attack samples, and randomly dividing the data set into a training set, a verification set and a test set; constructing a false data injection attack positioning model comprising two sub-modules of frequency spectrum domain time feature extraction and frequency spectrum domain space feature extraction, wherein the time feature extraction sub-module consists of discrete time short-time Fourier transform and a convolutional neural network, and the space feature extraction sub-module consists of a graph convolution neural network; and obtaining the trained frequency spectrum domain data driving attack positioning model by using the training set limited iteration attack positioning model. The method and the system effectively realize the positioning of false data injection attack and ensure the safety of intelligent power grid state estimation.

title_en: Bidirectional risk early warning system and method for operation of large power grid backbone optical communication system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power automation, and discloses a system and a method for early warning running bidirectional risks of a backbone optical communication system of a large power grid, wherein the system comprises the following components: the data acquisition layer is used for acquiring equipment data and actual environment information of the large power grid network in the physical entity layer and uploading the equipment data and the actual environment information to the digital twin layer; the digital twin layer is used for constructing a power-communication bidirectional coupling network twin body by the equipment data of the large power grid network and the actual environment information uploaded by the data acquisition layer; and the application layer is used for operating the bidirectional risk early warning on the large power grid backbone optical communication system by utilizing the equipment data and the actual environment information of the power-communication bidirectional coupling network twin body and the large power grid network. According to the invention, through analyzing the real-time operation data of the large power grid and the backbone optical communication system matched with the large power grid, fault hidden danger is found in time, and early warning is sent out.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION BRANCH;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Management method and system based on digital twin cell metering acquisition equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of metering and collecting systems, in particular to a refined management system of a district metering and collecting device based on a digital twin technology. The cell metering and collecting equipment refined management system based on the digital twin technology provided by the invention realizes the digital mapping of physical entities of all metering and collecting equipment of a cell in an information space by using the digital twin technology, can effectively predict the running condition of actual power distribution equipment, and can effectively monitor, diagnose, predict and schedule and control the states and behaviors of the physical entities of all equipment in the actual power distribution area in a real environment by using a diagnosis algorithm model constructed based on different management requirements, thereby ensuring that the power distribution area maintains a good running state.
assignees: WUXI HUACHUANGYUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power system state estimation method and system based on super-parameter particle swarm optimization
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power systems, and particularly relates to a power system state estimation method and system based on super-parameter particle swarm optimization, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical power data; according to the acquired data and a preset power system state estimation model, completing state estimation of a power system; the power system state estimation model is a double-layer super-parameter simulation optimization model, wherein an upper model of the double-layer super-parameter simulation optimization model adopts a mean square error function of power data state quantity, and a lower model adopts an exponential type objective function state estimation model; and taking the window width of the exponential type objective function state estimation model as a super parameter, carrying out iterative solution of a double-layer super parameter simulation optimization model by using a particle swarm algorithm to obtain an optimal window width, and carrying out state estimation of the electric power system based on the obtained optimal window width.

title_en: Industry type-based power data processing method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides an industry type-based power data processing method and device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining complete data and missing data in the electric power data according to a predetermined missing boundary of the industry to which the electric power data belongs and the electric power data; determining a maximum consecutive days of absence of the missing data; supplementing the missing data according to the maximum continuous missing days and the complete data. According to the industry type-based power data processing method and device, data are reclassified based on industry power utilization characteristics, and aiming at quality problems of data missing, data abnormality and the like in the processes of collecting, transmitting and storing power data, an intelligent algorithm for effectively eliminating abnormal values and complementing the missing is provided, and complete power utilization data are provided for work such as analysis experiments and application of industry and enterprise power utilization.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV TSINGHUA;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Digital twin space data organization method and system for power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for organizing digital twin space data of a power distribution network, which are used for integrating electrical topology and three-dimensional space data, realizing integration of the electrical topology through terminal number matching, being more accurate than the traditional integration mode, and simultaneously superposing longitude and latitude information of power grid facilities to meet the requirement of geographic information calculation; the traversal is more efficient, and compared with the method of carrying out association inquiry by relying on ID numbers, the method is more rapid and efficient, and can support large-scale digital twin service analysis; and the measurement data of the power grid are fused and accessed, and the measurement data are updated in real time by arranging the timing poller, so that the real-time and usability of the digital twin body is ensured. According to the invention, the electric topology is integrated into the digital twin body of the power grid, and the measurement information is correspondingly associated through the equipment, so that a richer and usable data basis is provided for digital twin application.
assignees: STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power distribution network fault detection method and related device based on digital twin system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid transmission distribution fault monitoring, and provides a power distribution network fault detection method and a related device based on a digital twin system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a three-dimensional model of the power distribution network according to preset power distribution network entity data and the power scene image, and compiling Beidou grid codes; fusing real-time power distribution network data information to obtain a power distribution network digital twin body; when the digital twin body is monitored to have faults, acquiring a fault electric power equipment overhaul image through a power distribution network camera, and identifying a Beidou grid code where the faults are located; the state and information of the power distribution network are timely and accurately reflected through the digital twin bodies, the Beidou grid codes are accurately positioned on the power equipment, and when the equipment fails, the Beidou grid codes where the faults are located are identified through the corresponding cameras, so that the faults can be quickly and accurately repaired, and stable power supply of the power distribution network is ensured.

title_en: Operation and maintenance control method, system, equipment and medium for energy storage power station
abstract_en: The invention discloses an operation and maintenance control method, system, equipment and medium for an energy storage power station, which comprises the following steps: collecting monitoring data of each energy storage battery unit; performing edge calculation processing on the monitoring data of each energy storage battery unit; wherein the edge calculation process includes: performing edge data analysis, edge data prediction and edge data visualization processing on the data of the managed and controlled energy storage battery unit, and storing according to preset rules; carrying out cloud computing processing on the data after the edge computing processing, wherein the cloud computing processing comprises the following steps: and carrying out data analysis, data prediction, data visualization processing, digital twin and digital training on the received data. The invention provides the corresponding functions for customizing and deploying the processing capacity of different levels of the energy storage power station, so that a user can customize and deploy different functions in an edge service layer, a cloud service layer and a dispatch control service layer according to own requirements, and the digitization and the intellectualization of the battery energy storage operation and maintenance management and control platform are realized.
assignees: HUANENG CLEAN ENERGY RES INST

title_en: Intrusion monitoring method, system, equipment and medium for oil and gas pipeline
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intrusion monitoring method, a system, equipment and a medium for an oil and gas pipeline, and relates to the technical field of oil and gas pipeline monitoring, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining at least one piece of current monitoring data aiming at the oil and gas pipeline; and S2, inputting the current monitoring data into a pre-constructed target digital twin model for the oil and gas pipeline for each piece of current monitoring data, and determining whether an intrusion event occurs or not through the target digital twin model. The oil gas pipeline comprises a plurality of pipeline sections, the acquired current monitoring data are analyzed and judged by utilizing the target digital twin model for the oil gas pipeline, whether an intrusion event occurs to the pipeline section corresponding to the current monitoring data is determined, follow-up alarming to an operation enterprise of the oil gas pipeline according to the intrusion event is facilitated, and the operation enterprise makes a timely decision according to the occurrence position of the intrusion event, so that accidents and disasters are prevented.

title_en: Digital twinning-based cross-border logistics transportation line simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of logistics transportation, and discloses a digital twinning-based cross-border logistics transportation line simulation method and a digital twinning-based cross-border logistics transportation line simulation system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step 1: establishing a database, collecting available route data in the Internet, converting the available route data into a machine-readable language, and storing implemented historical transportation route data; step 2: receiving logistics transportation material information, identifying key characteristics, preliminarily acquiring starting point and end point data, butting and operating a map simulation model; according to the method, all available network points are obtained through carding the current logistics transportation information, planning of a path is carried out, comprehensive analysis of historical data and real-time acquisition data is carried out, risk assessment is carried out, and therefore limitation of a final determined line scheme is reduced, various indexes serving as references are comprehensive, dynamic display of the line scheme and measures of speed change adjustment are carried out, and a user can intuitively know a transportation line.

title_en: Intelligent loss reduction method based on digital twinning
