abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent loss reduction method based on digital twinning, which specifically comprises the following steps: carrying out virtualization on power grid equipment based on a virtual twin method, acquiring the running condition of the power grid equipment through the virtualized power grid equipment, and acquiring multi-source data according to the running condition of the power grid equipment; carrying out data cleaning on the multi-source data, positioning abnormal data in the multi-source data according to a data cleaning result, calling historical data of power grid equipment, filling the positioned abnormal data according to the historical data of the power grid equipment, and obtaining line loss judging and researching data; and setting constraint conditions of a power grid structure and new energy consumption capacity, carrying out line loss abnormality judgment on line loss judgment and research data according to the set constraint conditions by a prediction twin method, and formulating line loss reduction measures according to line loss abnormality judgment results. According to the invention, under the condition that new energy is continuously connected to the network, data cleaning of mass data and prediction of line loss conditions are realized, and the efficiency of line loss management is effectively improved.
assignees: YONGKANG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;JINHUA POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for analyzing and evaluating running state of power system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for analyzing and evaluating the running state of an electric power system, which relate to the technical field of electric power system analysis, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring measurement data of the operation states of all elements in the operation process of the power system; filling missing data in the measured data by using an LSTM model; regarding the measurement data of the running states of all elements of the power system as node information of the graph, regarding the topological relation among all elements as side information, and obtaining graph node characteristic description and adjacency matrix for the running data of the power system; and a GCN model is utilized to realize a two-class model for stability evaluation and a multi-class model for fault location. The invention can not influence the analysis and evaluation result of the final power system running state even if the data is lost due to the failure of the element, and the final analysis and evaluation result can adapt to the complex topological relation of the element of the power system and the change of the topological relation, so that the analysis and evaluation result is more accurate and reliable.
assignees: NORTH CN ELEC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method, system, device and storage medium for constructing digital twin-map model of power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, a device and a storage medium for constructing a digital twin-map model of a power grid, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining power grid model data; performing hierarchical organization operation according to the characteristics of the power grid model; constructing nodes in a plurality of layers obtained by executing the hierarchical organization operation; and constructing a directed edge according to the topological connection relation and the hierarchical relation between the nodes. According to different characteristics of the massive power grid model, hierarchical organization operation is performed, so that a power grid digital twin graph model is constructed, a graph database based on the power grid digital twin graph model can be used as an important component of the power grid digital twin heterogeneous database, index support is provided for the power grid digital twin heterogeneous database, efficient query of a multi-level massive model retrieval scene of the digital twin power grid is supported, and the power grid data topology analysis capability is effectively improved. The invention is widely applied to the technical field of electric power information.

title_en: Disaster Monitoring System based on Digital Twin using Indoor Positioning and Real-time Remote Control and Method for Controlling the same
title_ko: 실내 측위 및 실시간 원격제어를 이용한 재난 감시 디지털 트윈 시스템 및 이의 제어 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster monitoring digital twin system using indoor positioning and real-time remote control which enables a disaster monitoring digital twin system stably constructed using an ultra-wideband (UWB) indoor positioning technology and a real-time streaming remote control vehicle and a controlling method thereof. The disaster monitoring digital twin system comprises: an RC vehicle unit having a UWB TAG attached; an anchor unit composed of a plurality of anchors exchanging a UWB signal with the RC vehicle unit and measuring a distance value with the RC vehicle unit; a gateway receiving the distance value measured from the anchors of the anchor unit, converting the position of the UWB TAG into a coordinate, and transmitting a coordinate of an RC vehicle based on the coordinate of the UWB TAG; a cloud server receiving an IP address from the RC vehicle, receiving the coordinate of the RC vehicle from the gateway, and transmitting the same to user devices; and a user device receiving the IP address of the RC vehicle and the coordinate of the RC vehicle from the cloud server and mapping the same in real-time to a virtual space.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 UWB(ultra-wideband) 실내 측위 기술과 실시간 스트리밍 원격 제어 차량을 이용하는 재난 감시 디지털 트윈 시스템을 안정적으로 구축할 수 있도록 한 실내 측위 및 실시간 원격제어를 이용한 재난 감시 디지털 트윈 시스템 및 이의 제어 방법에 관한 것으로,UWB TAG가 부착된 RC 차량부;상기 RC 차량부와 UWB 신호를 주고받으며 RC 차량부와의 거리값을 측정하는 복수의 앵커(Anchor)들로 구성되는 앵커부;상기 앵커부의 앵커들로부터 측정한 거리값을 전송받아 UWB TAG의 위치를 좌표로 환산하고, 상기 UWB TAG 좌표를 기반으로 RC 차량의 좌표를 전송하는 게이트웨이;상기 RC 차량으로부터 IP 주소를 전달받고, 상기 게이트웨이로부터 RC 차량의 좌표를 전달받아 사용자 디바이스들로 전송하는 클라우드 서버;상기 클라우드 서버로부터 RC 차량의 IP 주소 및 RC 차량의 좌표를 전달받아 가상 공간으로 실시간 매핑시키기 위한 사용자 디바이스;를 포함하는 것이다.
assignees: ANDONG NATIONAL UNIV INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Three-dimensional immersive dam safety monitoring method and system based on UE technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional immersive dam safety monitoring method and system based on a UE technology. The dam safety monitoring application system comprises safety monitoring visualization, safety monitoring inspection, safety monitoring analysis and safety monitoring early warning. The invention aims to strengthen engineering safety visualization based on a digital twin base on the basis of a traditional reservoir dam safety monitoring system, improve disaster early warning capability, realize three-dimensional visualization of engineering, controllable state checking, guard a safety bottom line and ensure comprehensive benefits of reservoirs.

title_en: Automatic verification method for initial state of simulation model of digital twin system of nuclear power station
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of nuclear power simulation, in particular to an automatic verification method for an initial state of a digital twin system simulation model of a nuclear power station. The method comprises the steps of obtaining user demands, starting automatic verification according to the user demands, calling real-time numerical values of each subsystem model parameter and corresponding unit history data in a preset steady-state simulation model according to the user demands, comparing and verifying the unit history data with the model parameter real-time numerical data of the appointed important parameters, and judging the running condition of the appointed subsystem model under the steady running condition or the transient accident condition. The method has the advantages that the initialization module based on the method can automatically reach the actual steady-state operation data state of the power plant at a specified moment in a short time by the operated simulation model, so that the digital twin system has the same capacity as the state of the nuclear reactor system at the specified moment.

title_en: Novel power distribution network-oriented digital twin model automatic reconstruction method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twin model automatic reconstruction method and device for a novel power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring source data, and initializing a basic data structure according to the source data and metadata corresponding to the source data; constructing a digital twin model according to the basic data structure; acquiring a data structure which is called when a service access request accesses the digital twin model each time; generating a metadata frequent item set corresponding to any type of service access request according to all data structures called by any type of service access request and a frequency threshold; generating a data structure corresponding to any type of service access request according to the metadata frequent item set and the source data corresponding to the metadata frequent item set; and constructing a digital twin model corresponding to any type of service access request according to the data structure corresponding to any type of service access request. The invention solves the problem of low reconstruction efficiency of the digital twin model in the related technology when the service application scene is changed.
assignees: STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Matching short-term load prediction method based on digital twin and neural network technology
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power load prediction, and particularly relates to a matching short-term load prediction method based on digital twin and neural network technology. The invention comprises the following steps: step 1, collecting load data and carrying out load characteristic analysis; step 2, preprocessing the collected load data; step 3, correcting the load data after data preprocessing based on the prediction result of the similar day; and 4, carrying out short-term load prediction based on the digital twin power distribution network. The invention is based on a single distribution transformer load prediction method, a digital twin technology is utilized to establish a twin power distribution network data center, the twin power distribution network obtains physical power grid data from the data center, a GRU neural network model is utilized to train a short-term load prediction model, and a similar day correction method is utilized to correct the prediction result. The load fluctuation rule can be captured more accurately, the predicted value is more close to the true value, the prediction precision is obviously improved, and the prediction precision reaches 95.3%.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Nuclear power plant digital twin system state tracking method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of nuclear power simulation, in particular to a method for tracking the state of a digital twin system of a nuclear power station. The method comprises the steps of data processing, namely acquiring actual operation data of a power plant at a designated moment, processing the actual operation data to acquire tracking point data, establishing unit data mapping between the tracking point data and thermal software calculation data, and matching calculation, namely acquiring the nearest IC according to the unit data mapping, resetting the IC, determining model boundary parameter conditions of each subsystem model, and then performing system decoupling, so as to define the boundary parameter conditions, automatically starting calculation and parameter correction, and iterating calculation until initialization calculation is completed. The method has the advantages that the method can analyze and extract the power plant data closely related to the unit operation state from the unit operation data, and automatically complete the initialization of system parameters and the decoupling, monotone and joint debugging of the model, thereby laying a foundation for carrying out operation event analysis and thermal performance analysis.

title_en: Bayesian state estimation method for unobservable distribution network based on embedded tide neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a Bayesian state estimation method of an unobservable distribution network based on an embedded power flow neural network, which comprises the following steps of: step 1, learning two-dimensional Gaussian mixture probability distribution of active power and reactive power injected into each node; step 2, sampling and obtaining sufficient node injection power data from the GMM to obtain a large number of injection power samples; step 3, obtaining mass data samples for neural network training; step 4, establishing a Bayesian state estimation model of the unobservable power distribution network based on the PFENN, and obtaining a consistent solution meeting the power flow constraint of the power grid operation by superposing a physical loss penalty term of the power flow in a loss function to perform neural network training; and 5, inputting real-time measurement into the neural network model trained in the off-line stage, and rapidly obtaining a voltage estimation result through forward calculation. The method and the device can solve the problem that the existing power distribution network state estimation method is low in accuracy under the condition of insufficient real-time measurement.
assignees: UNIV HEBEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: System and method for detecting state of power grid equipment under extreme descent
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for detecting the state of power grid equipment under extreme descent, comprising the following steps: the basic platform is used for collecting power grid equipment state information; the basic platform is connected with a digital model and displays physical equipment and state information thereof; an emergency processing module is arranged between the basic platform and the digital model, and the detection index is changed to the basic platform according to extreme weather and state information; the influence on the power grid equipment can be accurately detected under the extreme descent, the operation reliability of the power grid can be detected from local to whole, and the monitoring and emergency response of the power grid under the extreme descent can be realized; the comprehensive monitoring of the power grid is realized, the failure of various power grid equipment with different sizes of the power grid caused by extreme precipitation can be monitored and the working reliability of the power grid equipment can be detected, and the detection effect of a plurality of small power grid equipment in the case of extreme precipitation is improved; the accuracy of the real-time state estimation of the power grid equipment is improved, and the state detection reliability of the power grid equipment in extreme weather is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD JIAXING POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Digital twinning-based power distribution network risk situation sensing method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution network risk situation sensing method and device based on digital twinning. The method comprises the steps of establishing a digital twin body of a power distribution network, and simulating a preset typical fault of the power distribution network based on the digital twin body to obtain a fault data set reflecting the running state of the power distribution network, wherein the fault data set at least comprises transient voltage data, transient current data and power data; screening the fault data set by using a pre-established data screening model to obtain effective data, wherein the effective data represents data with the influence degree on the running state of the power distribution network reaching a set height condition; establishing a nonlinear evaluation model of effective data and the running state of the power distribution network; and acquiring actual data corresponding to the effective data of the power distribution network. The invention can obtain the actual running situation of the power distribution network by utilizing the digital twin and the neural network algorithm, and realizes the rapid identification, positioning and diagnosis of the running state of the power distribution network.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID HEBEI ENERGY TECH SERVICE CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power transmission and transformation equipment missing data filling method based on mechanism model driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission and transformation equipment missing data filling method based on mechanism model driving, which comprises the following steps: acquiring original data of operation of power transmission and transformation equipment in a certain scene in a power grid system, extracting data items with deletion, and integrating the data items into new deletion data; marking the column name of the data according to the requirement of the missing data filling method, and arranging the column in which the missing data is positioned in the last column to obtain the data in the required format; reading data in the required format, extracting data variables, searching an established mechanism model library, and performing model matching through program traversal; if the matching is successful, calculating based on the mechanism model directly, if the matching is failed, carrying out regression fitting by using data, calculating to obtain model parameters, and importing the data according to the obtained fitting mechanism model for calculating; the invention can more accurately complement the missing data and improve the equipment state monitoring precision and efficiency based on the data.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin model correction method and device for electric power equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twin model simulation, in particular to a digital twin model correction method and device of electric equipment, comprising the following steps: substituting a characteristic curve of each component in the electric power equipment under the current actual working temperature condition into a digital twin model of the electric power equipment to simulate, so as to obtain a state quantity simulation result of the electric power equipment and an operation parameter simulation result of each component in the electric power equipment under the current actual working temperature condition; and correcting the operation parameters of each component in the digital twin model of the electric equipment based on the state quantity simulation result of the electric equipment and the operation parameter simulation result of each component in the electric equipment under the current actual operating temperature condition. The technical scheme provided by the invention can reduce the error between the actually measured state quantity and the calculated state quantity of the digital twin model, and further improve the simulation accuracy of the digital twin model.
assignees: STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power distribution network state estimation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network state estimation method, which comprises the following steps: optimizing the configuration of the PMU measuring device, and generating a FNN network model according to the configured regional division condition; optimizing an implicit layer structure of the FNN network model according to a configuration result of the PMU measuring device, and simplifying the FNN network model by combining a power distribution network physical model; collecting historical data to generate a data set, and dividing the data set into a training sample and a test sample; training the FNN network model to obtain a prediction model for estimating the state of the power distribution network; and acquiring real-time data of the power distribution network and obtaining an estimation result of the power distribution network state according to the prediction model. According to the invention, through configuration optimization of the PMU measuring device, the area of each part is optimally divided, so that the complexity of a required FNN network model is reduced; and meanwhile, the FNN network model is simplified and pruned by combining with the physical model of the actual power distribution network, so that the time and the calculation cost of the model training stage are reduced.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD JIAXING POWER SUPPLY CO;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD HAINING POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Cluster measurement and control data voltage, current and frequency disturbance analysis and evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an effective analysis and evaluation method for the influence of disturbance on the voltage, current and frequency of a cluster measurement and control device, which is characterized in that filtering, fitting and interpolation are carried out on original data acquired by the cluster measurement and control device to calculate result data, the result data is input into a state estimation system, and whether the input data is normal data is judged according to the output result of the state estimation system; deleting the abnormal data; the method solves the problem that the cluster measurement and control can automatically identify data abnormality under the condition that the stable operation of the power grid system has data mutation and disturbance, carries out state estimation, eliminates abnormal data, ensures the correct uploading of the data and avoids the influence of the abnormal data on the stable operation of the power grid.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin deduction method for urban flood
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin deduction method for urban flood, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring three-dimensional model data, and establishing a three-dimensional city model; s2, respectively constructing a two-dimensional hydrodynamic model and a one-dimensional hydrodynamic model according to the two-dimensional model data and the one-dimensional model data to obtain an urban flood simulation result; s3, obtaining basic attributes of the flood simulation according to the urban flood simulation result, and describing a flood process according to the basic attributes of the flood simulation; and S4, rendering an urban flood ponding process according to the three-dimensional urban model and the description of the flood process, and completing digital twin deduction of the urban flood. The invention can realize the superposition display of the water depth, the water surface, the flow velocity and the flood risk on the three-dimensional city model, and can more intuitively realize the deduction of the city ponding process. The invention can realize the construction of urban digital twin effect based on a small amount of public data, and realize dynamic deduction and display of urban flood by dynamically coupling with the numerical simulation result.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Power grid digital twin system construction method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for constructing a power grid digital twin system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring data of electrical quantity and non-electrical quantity of equipment in a power grid; after feature extraction is carried out on electrical quantity and non-electrical quantity data, the data are associated with a twin model of equipment, and an equipment-level digital twin is established, wherein the twin model of the equipment is generated according to equipment entity modeling; aggregating the equipment-level digital twins according to the power utilization requirements and the equipment attributes of the pre-divided areas; and layering the aggregated equipment level digital twins according to an optimized scheduling target, and establishing a multi-level virtual power plant digital twins. By the method and the device, the problem that the coordinated management of a large amount of distributed energy resources by utilizing a digital twin is lacked in the related technology is solved.
assignees: STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Natural disaster emergency scheduling system based on digital twins
abstract_en: The invention discloses a natural disaster emergency scheduling system based on digital twins, and relates to the technical field of digital twins. The problem of in the prior art, can't construct unified emergency rescue dispatch platform, lead to rescue goods and materials to distribute unevenly, influence the implementation of rescue scheme, can't accomplish the management system of global command is solved in order to solve. The natural disaster emergency dispatching system based on the digital twin comprises a natural disaster monitoring platform, a data processing platform and a data processing platform, wherein the natural disaster monitoring platform is used for acquiring environmental data under a monitoring environment and updating a digital twin model of the natural disaster emergency dispatching system in real time; the emergency dispatching platform is used for acquiring dispatching schemes of the natural disaster monitoring platform and dispatching emergency equipment for each dispatching scheme in sequence from high to low based on the emergency dispatching grades; by providing an emergency management system with full-member cooperation and global command, the dispatching efficiency of the emergency dispatching system is improved, the dispatching time is saved, and the safety supervision effect on the system supervision area is effectively improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN ZHONGXUN NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Carbon emission comprehensive prediction system based on electric power big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pollution emission, and discloses a comprehensive carbon emission prediction system based on electric power big data, which comprises the following modules: the data monitoring module monitors the concentration of carbon dioxide, economic and social activities and natural environment changes in the atmospheric environment in real time by using a digital twinning technology; the data analysis module is used for comprehensively accounting the monitored carbon emission data and knowing the carbon emission process condition; the carbon emission calculation module is used for dynamically monitoring and calculating the carbon emission frequency in one day and the carbon emission frequency in one month based on a big data application technology; according to the invention, an LMDI model and a system dynamics model are combined for use, an LMDI method is used for analyzing factors influencing carbon dioxide emission, the mutual restriction and mutual promotion among all variables can be cleared, the mutual relationship is causal, carbon emission prediction data can be more accurate, and in addition, the future carbon emission condition can be predicted through data analysis and big data by monitoring all power types.
assignees: STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD INFORMATION COMMUNICATION COMPANY

title_en: Online analysis method for new energy cluster output outward-sending risk under natural disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses an online analysis method for new energy cluster output outward-sending risks under natural disasters, which comprises the following steps: acquiring power grid state estimation data, new energy power station prediction data to be analyzed, power transmission channels associated with the new energy power station set and assessment fault data of the power transmission channels according to a set risk analysis period; performing static security check according to the acquired data to obtain the sensitivity of the active output of each new energy power station to the active power flow of a power transmission channel and branch disconnection distribution factors, solving a pre-constructed new energy power station set output optimization model to obtain the maximum output sum of a new energy power station set and key limited factors thereof, and determining the delivery shortage risk of the new energy power station set according to the maximum output sum and the key limited factors; determining the output shortage risk according to the predicted data of the new energy power station; and determining the output and output shortage risk of the new energy power station set according to the magnitude relation between the output shortage risk and the output shortage risk. The method can comprehensively quantify the risks of natural disasters on the power generation and the sending of the new energy cluster from the source side and the network side, and provides quantitative basis for the regulation and control of the new energy in extreme weather.
assignees: HARBIN INST TECHNOLOGY;NARI TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD;NARI GROUP CORP;STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Operation and maintenance system and method for fuel cell energy station
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a fuel cell energy station operation and maintenance system and method, wherein the system comprises a digital operation and maintenance server and an intelligent operation and maintenance platform at a cloud side, a micro-grid control device at an edge side and a fuel cell energy station at an end side, the intelligent operation and maintenance platform is used for carrying data visualization, man-machine interaction and intelligent service calling, the intelligent operation and maintenance platform is used for realizing a remote monitoring function, a digital twin function, a fault diagnosis function, a performance life prediction function and an operation and maintenance scheduling function, the micro-grid control device is used for edge calculation, edge storage and edge control, and the fuel cell energy station comprises one or more of a fuel cell power generation device, a fuel cell electrolysis device, an energy storage battery and a hydrogen storage device. The remote monitoring function, the digital twin function, the fault diagnosis function, the performance life prediction function and the operation and maintenance scheduling function of the fuel cell energy station are realized efficiently.

title_en: Method for rapidly constructing overhead transmission line body based on digital twinning technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for quickly constructing an overhead transmission line body based on a digital twinning technology, which comprises the following steps of: s1, acquiring and processing basic machine account data; s2, defining a data rule of the digital twin equipment body; s3, extracting and processing data of the digital twin equipment body model information; s4, automatically constructing an index file and generating: according to the digital twin data information of the overhead transmission line body equipment, the automatic generation of a regular index file for direct connection between a tower and the tower and a regular index file for connection between hanging line points of the tower body is realized; s5, assembling the automatic analytic index file and the digital twin line; and S6, visually presenting the digital twin result of the overhead transmission line body. The method makes full use of the powerful computing power and the parallel processing power of the computer to replace the traditional manual work for data processing and rule matching, greatly shortens the time required by constructing the whole overhead transmission line body, and greatly improves the construction efficiency of the overhead transmission line.
assignees: CHENGDU HANTAO TIANTU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Distributed photovoltaic digital twin system power prediction method based on GA-BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed photovoltaic digital twin system power prediction method based on a GA-BP neural network, which comprises the following steps: s1, constructing a digital twin system for distributed photovoltaic power generation prediction; s2, quantifying a photovoltaic operation state and analyzing photovoltaic output fluctuation based on the actual power generation amount of the distributed photovoltaic power generation system; and S3, building a photovoltaic power generation power prediction model based on the GA-BP neural network in the digital twin system based on the quantitative analysis result, and performing power prediction. The distributed photovoltaic power generation digital twin system is constructed, so that a stable environment can be provided for photovoltaic cluster access capability evaluation and power accurate prediction; a genetic algorithm is adopted to optimize the weight and the threshold on the basis of the BP photovoltaic power generation power prediction model, so that the accuracy of power prediction can be greatly improved.
assignees: STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY FENGDU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power distribution network state estimation method and system based on self-adaptive particle filtering
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a power distribution network state estimation method and system based on adaptive particle filtering, comprising the following steps: generating particles required by particle filtering based on a random pseudo-Monte Carlo sampling method; based on the obtained current measurement data of the power distribution network system, the state estimation value at the previous moment and the generated particles, the state estimation of the power distribution network system at the current moment is realized by using a particle filtering algorithm; when estimating the state of the power distribution network for the first time, the number of particles required by the particle filtering adopts a preset reference value; in the state estimation of the subsequent power distribution network, the number of particles required by the particle filtering is determined based on preset expected estimation precision, preset reference particle number and state estimation precision of the previous moment.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG

title_en: Intelligent monitoring and diagnosis method for underground drainage pipe network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent monitoring and diagnosing method for an underground drainage pipe network, which constructs a monitoring and diagnosing platform for the underground drainage pipe network, and the system platform utilizes a digital technology to realize the full life cycle construction and operation and maintenance management of the drainage pipe network with safety, high efficiency, energy conservation, consumption reduction and intelligent management and control. The digital technology mainly comprises GIS, IOT, big data modeling, cesium open source three-dimensional earth engine and the like. The digital twin world linked with the real physical world is established by integrally utilizing the GIS and Cesium open-source three-dimensional earth engine technology, so that the drainage pipe network has the characteristics of a living body, and the capabilities of sensing, recording, analyzing, deciding and the like are preliminarily provided, thereby realizing the functions of intelligent sensing, auxiliary deciding and the like of the drainage pipe network, effectively forming intelligent drainage, replacing the work of people to a great extent and realizing the intelligent construction of drainage management.
assignees: NORTH CHINA MUNICIPAL ENG DESIGN & RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Multi-machine power system elastic state estimation method for extreme weather measurement signal attenuation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-machine power system elastic state estimation method for extreme weather measurement signal attenuation, which comprises the following steps: s1, establishing a multi-machine power system dynamic state estimation model considering measured signal attenuation; s2, initializing parameter values of an MEKF state estimation method; s3, calculating state prediction at time k+1 based on prediction steps of an estimation methodA value and prediction error covariance matrix; s4, calculating an improved extended Kalman filtering gain value at the time of k+1; s5, calculating a state estimation value at the moment k+1 S6, updating a state estimation error covariance matrix at the moment k+1; s7, dynamically estimating the system state according to the time sequence according to the steps S2-S6 until iteration stops when k+1 is more than N, and outputting a state estimation result. The filtering performance is effectively improved, and the robustness is high; the system operation information can be reliably provided for dynamic monitoring and analysis of the power system under extreme weather influence.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Autonomous planning method and system for electric power communication network based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention provides an autonomous planning method and system for an electric power communication network based on digital twinning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a digital communication network reflecting the entity network state in real time based on a digital twin technology; carrying out service importance degree weight evaluation on service flow data to obtain service importance degree weight scores; inputting the business flow data into a digital communication network, and simulating different business planning strategies to obtain priori data required by autonomous planning algorithm learning; and realizing autonomous planning of different services in the power communication network based on an autonomous planning algorithm. According to the digital twin-based power communication network autonomous planning method, different service planning strategies can be simulated to obtain priori data required by the autonomous planning algorithm learning, the autonomous planning of different services in the power communication network is realized, the convergence speed of the autonomous planning algorithm can be improved, the problem of delay reduction caused by error attempts during learning is solved, and the reliability of the power communication network autonomous planning is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Kalman filtering-based electric-gas multi-energy system state evaluation method
abstract_en: The Kalman filtering-based electric-gas multi-energy system state evaluation method comprises the following steps: firstly, establishing a power distribution network state space, a power distribution network-gas distribution network coupling element model and a gas distribution network state space model; then establishing a prediction equation, a measurement noise update equation and a filtering equation of a Kalman filtering algorithm; filtering and transforming the state space model of the power distribution network and the state space model of the gas distribution network, and combining the filtering and transforming result with the time sequence state constraint of the gas distribution network and the electric-gas boundary coupling constraint to form a Kalman filtering constraint equation; finally, establishing an electric-gas energy system state evaluation model based on Kalman filtering, importing the evaluation model into MATLAB software, and performing state estimation on an electric-gas multi-energy system; the state evaluation model of the electric-gas multi-energy system is optimized by adopting the Kalman filtering algorithm, so that the state evaluation accuracy and the overall robustness of the electric-gas multi-energy system can be better improved by the evaluation method.

title_en: Service autonomous planning method and device based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a business autonomous planning method and device based on digital twinning, which acquire a first business type by acquiring and carrying out business identification on a real-time business data stream; inputting the first service type and the real-time service data stream into the improved DQN model, so that the improved DQN model carries out simulated transmission on the real-time service data stream in the data twin network according to the first service type, and outputs an autonomous planning strategy of a routing path; wherein, the pre-construction process of the improved DQN model comprises: based on a plurality of service types, respectively constructing a service experience pool for each service type, and storing service data corresponding to different service types in the corresponding service experience pool; respectively extracting the same number of first service data from each service experience pool to form a training sample set for training the DQN model to obtain an improved DQN model; compared with the prior art, the technical scheme of the invention can improve the autonomous routing planning efficiency of the service.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: New energy power state estimation method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: New energy power system state estimation method and system based on deep learning, comprising the following steps: step 1, providing a new energy power system state estimation method and system based on improved DNN; step 2, predicting RTU data based on BILSTM in the step 1, generating pseudo measurement by utilizing the Spline interpolation, and fusing the pseudo measurement with PMU measurement measured by the node; step 3, based on the fusion data set obtained in the step 2, providing a combined space-time FC mechanism based on compatibility measurement and a BILSTM data identification technology; step 4, based on the data identification technology proposed in the step 3; removing bad data in the data by carrying out deep identification on the data, and reserving fluctuation data so as to obtain an original data set; and 5, establishing a new energy power system state estimation model according to the original data set obtained in the step 4. The method improves the precision and the speed of the state estimation of the new energy power system on the basis of keeping the original characteristics of the new energy measurement data, and is more suitable for the development requirement of the new power system.
assignees: UNIV XINJIANG

title_en: Industrial control system security threat response treatment method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for handling safety threat response of an industrial control system based on digital twinning, which comprises the following steps: when the industrial control system is detected to be under the network attack, determining the current state of the industrial control system and the attack type of the network attack; searching a target response strategy corresponding to the attack type from a preset strategy library; if the corresponding target response strategy is not found, carrying out network information safety detection and industrial control equipment function safety detection on a plurality of preset risk assessment methods by using an industrial control digital twin system from low risk value to high risk value; and taking the first risk assessment method through network information safety detection and industrial control equipment functional safety detection as an emergency response strategy, and executing the emergency response strategy. The invention constructs a twin system covering the network space and the physical space, realizes the digital twin of the industrial control network and the digital twin of the industrial field, provides a high-fidelity scene meeting the cross-domain detection and verification for the industrial control response treatment, and can be widely applied to the field of network security.
assignees: UNIV GUANGZHOU;INFORMATION COMMUNICATION BRANCH STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Ai-based autonomous control integrated building automatic control system
title_ko: Ai 기반의 자율제어 통합 빌딩 자동제어 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is an AI-based autonomous control integrated automatic building control system which comprises: a measurement sensor measuring the operation of building equipment in real time to generate building equipment measurement values; an automatic building control server monitoring the power use status of the building equipment, generating automatic control values for the building equipment on the basis of the building equipment measurement values generated by the measurement sensor, and using the generated automatic building equipment control values to automatically control the building equipment; and a user terminal displaying the power use status of building equipment monitored by the automatic building control server. Accordingly, the AI-based autonomous control integrated automatic building control system is configured to use digital twins to implement the operation and efficiency of a building's energy use in the near future, thereby providing effects of increasing the efficiency of the building's power use and preventing abnormalities, excessive consumption, or waste related to power use.
abstract_ko: AI 기반의 자율제어 통합 빌딩 자동제어 시스템이 개시된다. 빌딩 설비의 동작을 실시간 계측하여 빌딩 설비 계측값을 생성하는 계측 센서; 상기 계측 센서에서 생성된 빌딩 설비 계측값에 기반하여 상기 빌딩 설비의 전력 사용 상황을 모니터링하고 빌딩 설비 자동 제어값을 생성하며, 생성된 빌딩 설비 자동 제어값을 이용하여 상기 빌딩 설비를 자동 제어하는 빌딩 자동제어 서버; 상기 빌딩 자동제어 서버에서 모니터링되는 빌딩 설비의 전력 사용 상황을 표시하는 사용자 단말을 구성한다. 상술한 AI 기반의 자율제어 통합 빌딩 자동제어 시스템에 의하면, 디지털 트윈을 이용하여 건물의 에너지 사용에 관한 가까운 미래 시점의 동작과 효율을 미리 구현하도록 구성됨으로써, 빌딩의 전력 사용의 효율을 높이고 전력 사용에 관한 이상 현상이나 과도한 소비나 낭비를 미연에 방지할 수 있는 효과가 있다.
assignees: DONG YANG E&C CO LTD

title_en: Small hydropower station cluster power generation power prediction method based on BP-SVM multi-model fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small hydropower station cluster power generation power prediction method based on BP-SVM multi-model fusion, which comprises the steps of collecting radial flow small hydropower station original data, repairing the original missing data, extracting power generation characteristics, cluster classification, carrying out normalization pretreatment and eliminating data dimension differences; constructing a self-adaptive small hydropower station fusion prediction model, constructing a BP neural network prediction model and constructing an SVM support vector machine prediction model; fusion optimization prediction is carried out on the generated power; and adopting RMSPE root mean square percentage error to analyze, check and correct the error of the fusion prediction model prediction result. According to the method, the prediction model is constructed through extraction of the hydropower station cluster output and factor correlation characteristics, proper algorithm training is selected, the prediction precision of the power generation power of the radial hydropower station is improved, and the accurate prediction of the power generation power of the radial hydropower station is realized.
assignees: LISHUI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power station parametric modeling method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a power station parameterized modeling method, a device and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining outline data of first target equipment in an energy storage power station, wherein the first target equipment comprises at least one of the following: the method comprises the steps of constructing a three-dimensional model of first target equipment based on outline data by using a preset illusion engine, exporting and deploying an engineering file of the three-dimensional model, loading the engineering file to an energy storage power station digital twin scene displayed by a client in a pixel streaming mode in response to a display request sent by the client, and constructing the digital twin scene of the energy storage power station by using the illusion engine, so that the working efficiency of operation and maintenance personnel is improved.
assignees: HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;HUANENG CLEAN ENERGY RES INST

title_en: Digital twin method and device for power grid facilities and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twinning, in particular to a digital twinning method and device for power grid facilities and electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring multi-angle physical entity images and motion video sequences of power grid facilities, and constructing a static model of the power grid facilities; then determining the corresponding relation between the static model and each frame in the motion video sequence to obtain a dynamic model of the power grid facility; combining the OPC UA technology and the MQTT technology to acquire power grid facility data and constructing a situation database and a physical object database; and finally, constructing a logic model of the power grid facility based on the situation database and the physical object database, and constructing a virtual entity of the power grid facility based on the static model, the dynamic model and the logic model. The invention realizes the real-time mapping and analysis of the data of the power grid facilities, and improves the remote intelligent monitoring and management level and the new energy consumption level of the power grid facilities.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE;STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power grid peak load and loss evaluation method based on load mode reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating peak load and loss of a power grid based on load mode reconstruction, which relates to the technical field of load prediction of a power system and comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of load data acquired by acquisition equipment in a period to be predicted; carrying out subinterval segmentation and subinterval load missing data calculation on a period to be predicted of a plurality of load data; fitting the load prediction data of each subinterval through a preset fitting function, and performing data splicing on the fitting data of each subinterval to construct a target prediction function, wherein the load prediction data comprises load data and load missing data in the same subinterval; and solving the peak load and the network loss of the power grid based on the target prediction function. According to the method, the data integrity can be enhanced by predicting the load missing data and performing data splicing, the network loss error caused by the missing data is reduced, the prediction accuracy of the target prediction function is improved, and finally the accuracy of power grid peak load and power grid loss evaluation is higher through the target prediction function.
assignees: YONGKANG GUANGMING POWER TRANS AND TRANSFORMATION ENGINEERING CO LTD;YONGKANG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;JINHUA POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based power grid fault hidden danger management system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based power grid fault hidden danger management system and method, and belongs to the technical field of digital twinning. Carrying out digital twin mapping on power grid equipment, and establishing a digital twin fault database to avoid the grid system breakout caused by imperfect processing operation; constructing a historical fault event library, and analyzing the flow change condition of fault processing operation; capturing core fault processing operation and analyzing the association relation of power grid equipment; constructing an troubleshooting randomized iteration model, analyzing hidden danger evasion degree of a fault troubleshooting sequence table, and selecting a corresponding fault troubleshooting sequence table when the hidden danger evasion degree is maximum; the fault hidden danger range can be further solved, the condition that the definition is unclear is avoided, repeated work is avoided, more hidden danger fault events can be covered as much as possible when each fault is detected, the limited working time can be maximally utilized, the working efficiency is improved, and the overall hidden danger of a power grid system under each detection is maximally guaranteed to be minimized.

title_en: Transformer digital twin full period management method integrating data and mechanism model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of digital twin technology and power transformer management, in particular to a transformer digital twin full period management method integrating data and mechanism models, which comprises the following specific steps: s1, performing characteristic analysis on a power transformer; s2, collecting real-time monitoring data of the power transformer; s3, constructing a digital twin model formed by fusing two heterogeneous modes of a data model and a mechanism model; s4, optimally designing the power transformer through a digital twin model; s5, inputting key elements of the optimal design into a digital twin model for simulation verification; s6, inputting the data monitored in real time into the digital twin model to predict the real-time performance; s7, taking operation and maintenance measures according to the prediction result; s8, updating and optimizing the model; s9, carrying out full period management through a digital twin technology. The invention realizes the support of the whole period management of the power transformer by the digital twin technology and can effectively improve the reliability of the power transformer.
assignees: JIANGSU HUACHEN TRANSF CO LTD;UNIV XIAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Reliability evaluation method, device, equipment and storage medium for electric power optical communication network
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for evaluating reliability of an electric power optical communication network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting operation state data of an electric power optical communication network; calculating a state layer score; constructing a state layer fuzzy judgment matrix and calculating the element weight of the state layer; calculating the scores of the elements of the index layer based on the scores of the state layer and the weights; constructing an index layer fuzzy judgment matrix, and calculating element weights of the index layer; calculating the scores of all elements of the evaluation layer based on the scores of the index layer and the weights; constructing an evaluation layer fuzzy judgment matrix, and calculating element weights of the evaluation layer; calculating a reliability score of the power optical communication network based on the evaluation layer score and the weight, and determining a reliability grade; predicting future reliability of the power optical communication network by using the trained digital twin model; and determines device abnormality information. The invention can predict the future reliability of the power optical communication network and effectively improve the reliability evaluation accuracy of the power optical communication network.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power system transient stability evaluation method based on Bayesian convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power system transient stability evaluation method based on a Bayesian convolutional neural network, which comprises the following steps: acquiring and processing PMU measurement data of a power system, acquiring transient process time sequence data of the power system, and constructing a data set based on the transient process time sequence data of the power system; constructing an uncertainty transient stability evaluation model of the power system based on a Bayesian convolutional neural network, and training and testing the model based on the data set to obtain a final model; and performing online transient stability evaluation of the power system by using the final model, and obtaining a transient stability state prediction result of the power system and uncertainty estimation of the prediction result. The model constructed by the method has stronger robustness against noise data and feature missing data, has stronger adaptability to small data sets and can be set by operators according to specific requirements so as to improve the prediction result.
assignees: UNIV GUIZHOU

title_en: Intelligent power failure management method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power management, in particular to an intelligent power failure management method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of setting a time window and acquiring historical data of a time window before the current time; deleting abnormal values of the historical data, filling the missing data in the historical data, and constructing a model historical electricity utilization data set; performing cluster division on all users according to the model historical electricity consumption data set; manually marking each cluster, namely giving electricity utilization priority to each cluster; determining a user range needing to provide necessary continuous electricity consumption according to the electricity priority, and providing necessary continuous electricity consumption for users needing to provide necessary continuous electricity consumption according to the reported data; the invention can grade users according to historical electricity consumption information, scientifically cut power for users with different levels, and reduce great social loss caused by power cut.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING POSTS & TELECOM

title_en: Safety protection device based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The utility model provides a digital twinning-based safety protection device which comprises a protection blocking net, a protection barrel and a communicating pipe, wherein an opening is formed in the center of the protection blocking net, the protection barrel penetrates through the opening, a clamping groove and a spray hole are formed in a side plate of the protection barrel, an elastic rod and a sealing film are respectively arranged in the clamping groove and the spray hole, the communicating pipe is inserted into the end face of the protection barrel, a flame-retardant slurry is filled in an area between the protection barrel and the communicating pipe, a partition plate is fixed on the inner wall of the protection barrel, a piston plate is sleeved on the communicating pipe, the rear end of the communicating pipe is connected with a spray head, fireproof cloth is bound on the elastic rod, and a fixed cavity is formed between the fireproof cloth and the protection barrel. The utility model solves the problem that the prior art is provided with the blocking net-shaped protection device, when special conditions such as fire disaster, leakage and the like occur in a production workshop, the blocking effect of the protection net is limited, and the danger source is diffused outwards.
assignees: CCCC JIANSHI DIGITAL TECH SUZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Wind-solar-load combined prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind-solar-load combined prediction method, which comprises the steps of constructing a wind-solar-load sample set through multi-source heterogeneous data assimilation, constructing and optimizing to generate a wind-solar-load high-dimensional feature set through high-dimensional features, and acquiring a new energy prediction typical scene identification model based on the wind-solar-load high-dimensional feature set and cost sensitive learning; based on a Stacking deep learning combination model and a typical scene recognition model, realizing the refined modeling of the new energy station, and upscaling the power prediction result of the station to a provincial cluster by an improved statistical upscaling method; realizing provincial load prediction based on wind power, photovoltaic provincial cluster power and provincial power load historical data; and carrying out joint prediction on the wind-light load power of each station, each cluster and each provincial cluster by a B/S structure-based wind-light load joint prediction system. According to the wind power load prediction method, wind power load fine modeling and combined prediction under different typical scenes can be realized, the wind power, photovoltaic and load prediction precision is improved, and the method has certain popularization value.
assignees: UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH

title_en: Monitoring-free distributed photovoltaic output power estimation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a monitoring-free distributed photovoltaic output power estimation method, which comprises the following steps: step 1, observing the existing polymer and a low-voltage distributed power supply, constructing an estimated point of the low-voltage distributed power supply, and determining a low-voltage distributed power supply partition or polymer according to the geographic position or feeder line of the estimated point; step 2, estimating parameters by adopting a linear estimation model based on consistency of correlation between distributed power supply electric quantity data and power data; and step 3, judging whether to carry out aggregation solution and state estimation parameter calculation again according to the accumulated electric quantity error, and carrying out rolling correction on the state estimation strategy. The invention can solve the problem of low-voltage unsupervised photovoltaic output estimation without real-time data, reduces the calculation complexity in the form of a polymer, improves the estimation efficiency, and simultaneously combines the output curve correction to ensure the accuracy of photovoltaic output power estimation.
assignees: INST ELECTRICAL ENG CAS

title_en: Acousto-optic-electric collaborative inspection method and device based on digital twin transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an acousto-optic-electric collaborative inspection method and device based on a digital twin transformer substation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: carrying out semanteme and objectification treatment on the virtual power transformation equipment to obtain a digital model of the power transformation equipment; calibrating the acousto-optic-electric sensing equipment in a digital twin model of the transformer substation to obtain an acousto-optic-electric virtual sensing model; performing association mapping on the digital twin model and the acousto-optic virtual perception model of the transformer substation; positioning the space position of the inspection equipment in a digital twin model of the transformer substation, and constructing a virtual inspection equipment model; acquiring sensing data and space position information of inspection equipment, and carrying out registration fusion with a digital model of the power transformation equipment; analyzing the perception data to determine the spatial position of the abnormal point; and detecting the spatial position of the abnormal point in the digital twin model of the transformer substation, generating a cooperative task control signal according to the detection result, and sending the cooperative task control signal to an actual transformer substation for corresponding cooperative control.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD TAIZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Digital twin three-dimensional dynamic modeling method for auxiliary equipment of coal-fired power plant
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of real-time 3D modeling, in particular to a digital twin three-dimensional dynamic modeling method for auxiliary equipment of a coal-fired power plant. According to the invention, the ultrasonic wave is transmitted to penetrate and scan the auxiliary equipment to be studied, and on the basis of obtaining the characteristic sizes of the surface and the internal structure of the auxiliary equipment, the corresponding coordinate data is obtained and converted by establishing a coordinate system, so that the virtual three-dimensional comprehensive modeling of the auxiliary equipment is realized. Meanwhile, aiming at the actual running process of auxiliary equipment, the tracer particles are adsorbed on the internal dynamic structure of the auxiliary equipment through a system which is designed and built by self, on the basis of tracking the space coordinates of the particles, a corresponding sub-time model is built, and finally, the sub-time model is fused with a virtual three-dimensional model built by an ultrasonic scanning technology, so that dynamic and fine three-dimensional modeling is realized.
assignees: UNIV TAIYUAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Intelligent cleaning unmanned aerial vehicle, system and cleaning method for photovoltaic panel
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent cleaning unmanned aerial vehicle for a photovoltaic panel, a system and a cleaning method. The invention has the advantages of high efficiency, intelligence and low cost, and solves the problems of poor flexibility, poor environmental adaptability, high cost and the like of the conventional cleaning of the photovoltaic panel; the invention cleans the photovoltaic panel and simultaneously has the functions of flaw detection and digital twin management service system, thereby providing more intelligent management service for the photovoltaic power station; the invention has the advantage of being applicable to various scenes, and is applicable to various large photovoltaic power stations or photovoltaic panels which are difficult to reach by manpower, such as roofs, water surfaces and the like; the invention can reduce the waste of water sources and the labor cost and the risk of manual operation.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Electric power network refined electric carbon tracking method and device based on graph data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a graph data-based power network refined electric carbon tracking method and device. In the method, three sub-methods of electric power network electric carbon graph data construction, electric power network refined electric carbon tracking calculation and electric power network electric carbon tracking result generation are adopted, so that the electric power network electric carbon tracking problem can be converted into the graph searching problem, the complex matrix construction and calculation are avoided, meanwhile, the influence of energy storage equipment on electric power network carbon emission distribution is considered, the electric power network refined time-space scale electric carbon tracking can be realized, and the electric power network refined time-space scale electric carbon tracking method can be combined with the technical depths of electric power network topology identification, state estimation and the like, and has good robustness, expansibility and practicability.
assignees: STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Filling method, device, equipment and storage medium for terminal acquisition data missing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a filling method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for missing data of terminal acquisition, which are used for searching the missing data of the acquired data after executing a data acquisition task; when the missing data is identified and the missing data is not a single or continuous data item of the last acquisition time, analyzing causal features of the missing data by adopting a pre-trained causal Bayesian network, and associating the missing reason with a low-voltage station area fault to perform fault positioning; and adopting the complete data of the missing data set with the data missing as initial data, and filling the missing data according to various filling algorithms. And the corresponding data are filled by adopting a multiple filling method, so that the stable and reliable operation of the electricity consumption information acquisition system is ensured, and the acquisition operation and maintenance efficiency is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD WENZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Power grid fault prediction method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid fault prediction method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of power grid fault prediction, wherein whether a parameter sequence has a data missing position or not is judged by acquiring a parameter sequence of a target power grid generated by operation and maintenance personnel based on a parameter template; if the global feature corresponding to the parameter sequence exists, acquiring the global feature corresponding to the parameter sequence and the local feature of the data missing bit; completing the parameter sequence according to the global features and the local features to obtain a complete parameter sequence; carrying out weight distribution on each parameter in the complement parameter sequence according to the parameter source to obtain a weight parameter sequence; and inputting the weight parameter sequence into a pre-trained attention prediction model to obtain fault prediction information corresponding to the target power grid. The method and the system can solve the problem that the existing power grid fault prediction model is difficult to process the data to be predicted with missing data.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Substation secondary equipment fault prediction method and device based on multi-source data
abstract_en: The application discloses a transformer substation secondary equipment fault prediction method and device based on multi-source data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a multi-source data set of secondary equipment of a transformer substation; carrying out three-dimensional modeling processing according to the multi-source data set to obtain a digital twin model; performing state evaluation processing on secondary equipment of the transformer substation according to the digital twin model to obtain equipment state data; performing data comparison processing on the equipment state data according to a preset reference value to obtain abnormal data; acquiring a working ticket of the secondary equipment of the transformer substation through a power grid management platform, and comparing the working ticket with an image recognition result acquired by a video monitoring system to acquire comparison data; and carrying out fault prediction according to the comparison data and the abnormal data to obtain a fault prediction result. According to the method and the device for predicting the faults of the secondary equipment of the transformer substation, the faults of the secondary equipment of the transformer substation are predicted through the multi-source data, the cost and the complexity of model construction are reduced, and the method and the device can be widely applied to the technical field of fault prediction.
assignees: SOUTHERN POWER GRID DIGITAL GRID TECH GUANGDONG CO LTD

title_en: Optimization method, terminal and storage medium for park-type virtual power plant group
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of virtual power plants, and particularly provides an optimization method, a terminal and a storage medium of a park type virtual power plant group, which comprise the steps of constructing a park type virtual power plant group frame, wherein the park type virtual power plant group frame is configured with a first stage upper model, a first stage lower model and a second stage model; acquiring output data of each period of time before the day of each park-type virtual power plant in each park-type virtual power plant group; the real-time planning is carried out on the overall running dynamics of the virtual power plant cluster step by step through multiple time scales composed of different time periods, so that the friendliness and the external consistency are always kept in participation in market transactions; in addition, the invention adopts a minute time scale through the second stage model, accurately corrects the single day plan by utilizing real-time updated data in a buffer range, and minimizes unbalanced cost of the daily market and the real-time market.
assignees: LAIWU POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power distribution network dynamic state estimation method based on robust adaptive Kalman filtering
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a dynamic state estimation method of a power distribution network based on robust adaptive Kalman filtering, and relates to the field of dynamic state estimation of power distribution networks. Constructing a mathematical model of dynamic state estimation of the power distribution network according to the topology structure of the power distribution network and the type of measurement data, and realizing the dynamic state estimation of the power distribution network by using a volume Kalman filter; the modeling error is classified into unknown system noise by introducing a fault-tolerant noise estimator, so that the original constant unknown system noise is changed into time-varying unknown system noise, then noise estimation is carried out at each time section by the fault-tolerant noise estimator, and the statistical characteristics of the noise are adjusted at all times. When the power distribution network has rough differences, the Kalman filtering gain is corrected by introducing an anti-difference enhancement factor so as to achieve the effect of correcting the state estimation value. According to the invention, the fault-tolerant noise estimator and robust enhancement are introduced into the volume Kalman filter, so that the estimation accuracy and robust performance of the dynamic state estimation of the power distribution network are improved.
assignees: NANJING INST TECH

title_en: Automatic generation method of power failure plan of power distribution network dispatching accident
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic generation method of a power failure plan of a power distribution network dispatching accident, which comprises the following steps: s1, basic data collection, namely acquiring a topological connection relation of a power distribution network, technical parameters of each electrical device and real-time measurement data from a power grid dispatching system, S2, performing state estimation on the power distribution network dispatching system according to the acquired basic data to acquire part of unknown electrical quantity information, and calculating by adopting a Newton Lafson method to acquire active power and reactive power of a node; s3, when the main transformer of the transformer substation fails to cause the load on the bus of the main transformer to lose electricity, transferring the lost electricity load to other buses which normally work; and S4, counting and displaying the power-losing load name, the power-losing load power, the load transfer path, the main transformer and the load rate information of the branch circuit according to the load transfer optimization result. The automatic generation method of the power distribution network accident power failure plan effectively improves the rationality of the load transfer scheme and greatly improves the scheme generation efficiency.
assignees: CHANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Electric power emergency plan deduction method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power emergency plan deduction method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which comprise the steps of building a digital twin geographic power grid wiring model and a power grid control node model; acquiring real monitoring data and control information of network control nodes in a real geographic power grid, independently extracting data when the real monitoring data is abnormal and the control information of the corresponding power grid control nodes to form power grid accident information, and generating a digital twin drilling script model and a standard drilling result model corresponding to the drilling script model; and obtaining the countermeasure input by the user, and generating emergency resource setting information. The method is applied to a server based on the electric power emergency plan deduction system, various emergency situation scene library models are continuously built, and the deduction function of the deduction system is perfected; the ability to provide emergency resource setting information; generating an exercise evaluation result; the method for deducing the power emergency plan is vivid and professional.
assignees: HAIBEI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based power supply path tracing method, device, equipment and medium
