title_en: Decision control method for novel electric power system of park based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a decision control method for a novel power system of a park based on reinforcement learning, which comprises the following steps: step 1: acquiring historical data of a novel power system of a park, cleaning and preprocessing the data, removing abnormal data and supplementing missing data; step 2: establishing a novel power system equipment model of the park according to the historical data; step 3: designing a decision control reinforcement learning framework of a novel power system of the park, and determining a state space, an action space and a reward function; step 4: training a decision control model of a novel power system of the park based on a TD3 algorithm; step 5: and deploying the trained model in a novel park power system under a virtual power plant mechanism, and adjusting the control strategy of the park power system in real time. The invention can better adapt to the condition of continuous change in the novel power system of the park, thereby realizing higher energy utilization efficiency and stable running state.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Incremental photovoltaic power prediction method considering concept drift and privacy protection
abstract_en: The invention provides an incremental photovoltaic power prediction method considering concept drift and privacy protection, which comprises the following steps: in addition, the invention designs an incremental type width learning system model under a distributed type combined learning frame to protect data privacy, finally, an incremental type online updating strategy is provided, new features are continuously and inadvisably learned after concept drift occurs, and test results under a public data set show that the invention can effectively detect the concept drift of stream data, realize rapid online updating of the model and obviously improve the prediction precision on the premise of protecting privacy.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: Matrix completion state estimation method and system for three-phase unbalanced distribution network
abstract_en: The invention provides a matrix completion state estimation method and a matrix completion state estimation system for a three-phase unbalanced power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a low-rank measurement matrix of a three-phase unbalanced power distribution network; setting a post-completion measurement matrix generated based on the low-rank measurement matrix, and expressing a matrix completion problem of recovering unknown items in the low-rank measurement matrix by using a first formula; the low-rank measurement matrix in the first formula is split into 3 single-phase measurement matrices according to A, B, C phase sequences; splitting the single-phase measurement matrix after phase splitting and the measurement matrix after complement according to the partition; the objective function of the first formula comprises two groups of separable variable matrixes, the first formula is converted into a second formula, and matrix completion is carried out on the split measurement matrixes; and obtaining a measurement error, representing the generated measurement weight by using the inverse of the square of the measurement error, and performing state estimation on the complemented measurement matrix by using the obtained measurement weight.

title_en: Regional power system carbon emission measuring and calculating method, device and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional power system carbon emission measuring and calculating method, a regional power system carbon emission measuring and calculating device and a regional power system carbon emission measuring and calculating medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring relevant data of carbon emission measurement and analysis in key industries and areas, screening available data, complementing missing data and detecting abnormal values from the relevant data by adopting a LOF and KNN data preprocessing method, and determining effective relevant data; determining regional carbon emission influencing factors, and calculating contribution degrees of the regional carbon emission influencing factors by using an exponential decomposition method; determining the association relationship between regional carbon emission influencing factors and main economic activities; constructing a regional power system carbon emission measuring and calculating analysis model; the electricity consumption data of each industry and each region in the current month is input into a regional power system carbon emission measuring, calculating and analyzing model to obtain the production process data and the energy activity level data of each industry and each region in the current month, and then the carbon discharge capacity of each industry and each region in the current month is calculated by adopting factors provided by IPCC.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;RES INST ECONOMICS & TECH STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method for intelligent power distribution cabinet operation state based on twin model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method of an intelligent power distribution cabinet running state based on a twin model, which belongs to the technical field of power transmission and transformation equipment monitoring and comprises the following steps: (1) acquiring operation state data of the intelligent power distribution cabinet; (2) performing virtual-real mapping on the acquired data by adopting a digital twin technology; (3) constructing a twin model of the running state of the power distribution cabinet; (4) solving the established twin model through an ant colony clustering algorithm, and gathering fault samples of the same type; (5) constructing an intelligent power distribution cabinet running state evaluation index system based on a twin model and weighting; (6) and outputting a comprehensive evaluation method of the intelligent power distribution cabinet running state based on the twin model. According to the fuzzy evaluation method, a fuzzy evaluation algorithm of the Hamacher operator is adopted, an intelligent power distribution cabinet operation state evaluation index system based on a twin model is established, the omission ratio and the monitoring response time of operation and maintenance of the intelligent power distribution cabinet are reduced, and the operation economy and reliability of a power distribution network are effectively improved.
assignees: SHENYANG INST ENGINEERING

title_en: New energy ultra-short term generation power prediction method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a new energy ultra-short-term generation power prediction method, a device, equipment and a medium, which are characterized in that environmental sensor data, satellite remote sensing data and aerosol degree data of a target area where a new energy generator set is positioned are obtained; the method comprises the steps of obtaining satellite remote sensing data and aerosol data, correcting environmental sensor data based on the satellite remote sensing data and the aerosol data by using a preset data assimilation model, obtaining target environmental data, extracting characteristics of the target environmental data, obtaining environmental characteristic data of a target area, predicting generating power data of a new energy generator set in a short time period in the future according to the environmental characteristic data by using a preset ultra-short-term power prediction model, correcting abnormal data and missing sections in the environmental meteorological data by using the correlation between the satellite remote sensing data and the aerosol data, and achieving data quality of the environmental sensor data, so that accuracy of ultra-short-term prediction is improved.

title_en: Energy Internet digital twin simulation system, method and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an energy Internet digital twin simulation system, a method and a storage medium, which comprise a physical layer, wherein the physical layer is used for acquiring basic parameter information of an on-line element; the data protocol layer is used for acquiring the data communication protocol type, the data transmission mode and the transmitted data precision among the energy internet subsystems; the data communication layer is used for determining target data content, data precision and data format received and transmitted by the network element according to the basic parameter information, the data communication protocol type, the data transmission mode and the data precision of transmission; the system execution layer comprises a system scheduling layer, a real-time data acquisition system and a system simulation subsystem, wherein the system simulation subsystem and the real-time data acquisition system are mutually digital twins and are used for realizing the digital twins simulation system. According to the technical scheme, the energy Internet with higher recombination degree can be optimally scheduled, the stable operation degree of the system is improved, and the renewable energy utilization efficiency can be improved.
assignees: INST ELECTRICAL ENG CAS;INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION BRANCH OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Urban flood prevention four-pre-system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twinning-based urban flood prevention four-pre-system which comprises an integrated monitoring and sensing network, a water service digital twinning base and a four-pre-function scene module, wherein the integrated monitoring and sensing network is used for monitoring weather, rainfall, water level, flow and water depth of an urban area to obtain urban flood prevention influence factor monitoring data, the water service digital twinning base is used for realizing visible digital twinning capacity support through construction of the twinning base, the four-pre-function scene module is responsible for realizing forecast analysis of an urban flood prevention dangerous area based on urban flood prevention influence factor change research, realizing target early warning of uncertain crowd in the flood prevention dangerous area on the basis of forecast results, and realizing flood prevention emergency exercise by fusing real scenes and virtual scenes through a digital twinning technology, so that an urban flood prevention scheme executing feedback mechanism is established. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the urban flood prevention four-prediction system realizes the prediction accuracy, the comprehensive early warning, the prediction reality and the scheme electronization of urban flood prevention.
assignees: SHENZHEN AEROSPACE SMART CITY SYSTEM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin platform assisting in operation management of new energy wind farm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin platform for assisting in operation management of a new energy wind farm, which comprises an application layer, a service layer, a data layer and a hardware layer, wherein the hardware layer comprises a hardware Server, a Server storage device, a Gis-Server Server and safety software, the data layer comprises an image data module, a vector data module, a professional data module and a wind-solar data module, the data layer is in communication connection with the hardware layer, the service layer is in communication connection with the data layer, and the application layer is in communication connection with the service layer. According to the invention, by a platform data micro-service construction technology, a performance safety technology and a wind-light storage cluster digital twin model dynamic visualization technology, an auxiliary decision platform based on fault base and data association is realized, and the visualization display and external service of the power-assisted digital wind-light storage base are realized.
assignees: STATE GRID JIBEI ZHANGJIAKOU SCENERY STORAGE AND TRANS NEW ENERGY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;BEIJING GUOYAO XINTIANDI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Monitoring management method and monitoring management system for electric power energy storage reservoir
abstract_en: The invention provides a monitoring management method and a monitoring management system for an electric energy storage reservoir, which relate to the technical field of electric energy storage reservoir monitoring and comprise the steps of obtaining original data information obtained by monitoring each measuring point of the electric energy storage reservoir; performing linear transformation on the original data information by using a PPCA principle to obtain missing data of each measuring point of the electric energy storage reservoir, and extracting weighted linear combination and key information data representing the overall form of the electric energy storage reservoir; obtaining an importance ranking result affecting the management factors of the electric power energy storage reservoir according to the association degree analysis; and predicting the electric energy storage reservoir based on the importance ranking result and the maximum Lyapunov exponent prediction model, and managing the electric energy storage reservoir. The method has the beneficial effects of improving the informatization and modernization level of the management of the electric energy storage reservoir and providing real-time auxiliary decisions for the dynamic control of the dispatching of the electric energy storage reservoir, the optimal allocation of water resources and the risk management of the electric energy storage reservoir.
assignees: SICHUAN LEDIAN NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin system of power grid
abstract_en: The application discloses a digital twin system of a power grid, and belongs to the technical field of power digital twin. The system comprises a data access module, a data processing module and a data processing module, wherein the data access module is used for accessing multi-source heterogeneous data of a power grid; the modeling module is used for receiving the data output by the data access module and establishing a digital twin model of the multi-service scene; the fusion module is used for associating and fusing digital twin models of the multi-service scene; the computing module is used for carrying out multi-scene collaborative simulation deduction by utilizing the digital twin model; the optimizing module optimizes the digital twin model; wherein the multi-source heterogeneous data comprises: real-time monitoring data, historical operating data, meteorological environment data, equipment model data and geographic information data. The problem of the multisource heterogeneous data fusion inefficiency in the electric wire netting that exists among the prior art is solved, through constructing standardized data access interface, application correlation analysis and knowledge graph technique etc. realized the seamless integration of electric wire netting multisource heterogeneous data, improved data fusion efficiency.

title_en: Digital twin modeling method and system based on video stream
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin modeling method and a digital twin modeling system based on video streams, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a video stream of a real-time working scene of a power grid, carrying out framing pretreatment on the video stream, and marking whether the state of each frame is a critical state of dangerous operation; designing a training depth state identifier and a reward predictor based on the state of each of the video frames; combining a depth state identifier and a return predictor, predicting and positioning potential dangerous operation from the power grid operation video in real time, judging risk level, and positioning key frame information; and continuously analyzing and evaluating according to the risk early warning system, outputting the risk level and key frame information to a monitoring interface, and feeding back early warning information to first-line staff in a layered multi-mode.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Alarming method and system of photovoltaic new energy supervision platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses an alarming method and system of a photovoltaic new energy supervision platform, which relate to the technical field of new energy equipment detection and comprise the steps of constructing a photovoltaic panel fault detection system based on image recognition; constructing a photovoltaic operation and maintenance data management system based on a block chain, and simultaneously realizing automatic abnormal alarm by utilizing an intelligent contract; and establishing a digital twin system according to detailed parameters and data of the actual photovoltaic power station, and realizing simulation prediction of the running state and fault risk of the power station. The invention realizes real-time monitoring and predictive early warning of the running state and fault risk of the power station through image recognition, block chain data management and digital twin technology, ensures the safe and efficient running of the system, and reduces the inspection workload of a large amount of labor force by an automatic supervision system. Meanwhile, cleaning, configuration and replacement decisions are optimized, purchasing and maintenance costs are reduced, and an optimal design scheme is found out through digital twin simulation. And provides reliable digital assistance for subsequent operation and maintenance management.
assignees: HUANENG JIANGSU COMPREHENSIVE ENERGY SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Nuclear power digital twin construction method and system based on digital flow chart
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nuclear power digital twin construction method and a system based on a digital flow chart. The method comprises the following steps: and obtaining a basic flow chart of the nuclear power plant process system, and constructing a digital flow chart according to the basic flow chart. And acquiring production operation element information of the nuclear power plant, and synchronously mapping the production operation element information in a digital flow chart so as to enable the production operation element information to be visually displayed in real time. The invention improves the information integration level in the nuclear power plant operation field based on the digital twin technology, replaces a large amount of manual repetitive labor with data drive, can effectively reduce the load of the operating personnel of the nuclear power plant, reduces the probability of human error and improves the safety performance and the economic level of the nuclear power plant.
assignees: CHINA NUCLEAR POWER BEIJING SIMULATION TEHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Safety isolation system and method based on nuclear leakage accident
abstract_en: The invention relates to a safety isolation system and method based on nuclear leakage accidents. The first monitoring module collects accident data at the accident scene and sends the accident data to the processing module. The processing module simulates the accident scene to establish a three-dimensional model corresponding to the accident scene. The processing module generates a radiation exclusion zone in the three-dimensional model and adjusts the extent and shape of the radiation exclusion zone according to the incident data. The invention performs control of nuclear accident situation aiming at the nuclear power station with digital twinning, and early warning the nuclear leakage accident situation to staff by simulating and establishing the accident scene. According to the invention, the process of performing the nuclear power station radiation source corrective action by the off-site staff is monitored in a virtual-actual combination mode, and warning information is provided, so that data support is provided for the rescue duration monitoring and the post radiation elimination of the follow-up staff.
assignees: DMS CORP

title_en: Method for quickly forming information matrix of power system state estimation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for quickly forming an information matrix of power system state estimation, which adopts a sparse matrix technology to form an information matrix (H)  T  R  ‑1  H) The operation speed is greatly improved. The jacobian matrix H adopts a column-wise storage mode, so that the left-multiplied jacobian matrix transpose H can be conveniently extracted in rows  T  And extracting the elements of the right-hand matrix H by column. When calculating the ith row element of the information matrix, H is taken out  T  And multiplying the i-th row element of the row by a weight value R corresponding to the column number j  jj   ‑1  Then is stored as a one-dimensional array in the j-th column, so that the repeated H pairs in the calculation process are saved  T  The judgment of the column number of the i-th non-zero element not only simplifies the flow, but also reduces the calculation time, improves the speed of calculating the information matrix, and further improves the state estimation of the power systemThe speed is calculated. The embodiment shows that the method for forming the information matrix remarkably reduces the calculation time of the state estimation of the power system, and is very suitable for being used in a very large-scale power system.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN MARITIME

title_en: Power distribution network running state prediction method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting the running state of a power distribution network based on digital twinning, which are used for acquiring multiple performance data of power distribution equipment at multiple preset time points in a preset time period; carrying out data structuring processing on the multiple performance data of the multiple preset time points to obtain a distribution equipment performance parameter matrix; extracting inter-parameter association features of the distribution equipment performance parameter matrix; and analyzing the running state of the power distribution equipment and displaying the result based on the inter-parameter correlation characteristics. In this way, the digital twin technology and the artificial intelligence technology based on deep learning are utilized to comprehensively analyze multiple performance data of the power distribution equipment so as to monitor the running state of the power distribution equipment in real time, discover and capture abnormal conditions in time, and further monitor and predict the running state of the power distribution network.
assignees: BEIJING BRANCH OF STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network pseudo-measurement modeling method based on particle swarm optimization and applied to deep neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power distribution network pseudo-measurement modeling method based on a particle swarm optimization deep neural network, which comprises the following steps: step 1, constructing a pseudo measurement model of a power distribution network; and 2, constructing a power distribution network pseudo-measurement error model based on the particle swarm optimized DNN pseudo-measurement model (PSO-DNN) constructed in the step 1. The invention can solve the technical problem that the state estimation is not solvable due to the fact that the number of real-time measurement is small and the system is not considerable.
assignees: STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Modeling method and system of digital twin platform for power grid service
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a modeling method and a modeling system of a digital twin platform for power grid service, belonging to the technical field of state prediction of digital twin models. The modeling method comprises the following steps: constructing physical information and data driving states of components of the digital twin platform; dividing the physical information and the data driving state into a plurality of state intervals according to a preset time interval in time sequence to form a corresponding state description matrix; training an initial Markov network by taking the state description matrix of the former state interval as input and the state description matrix of the latter state interval as output; predicting a state description matrix of the next state interval according to the state description matrix of the current state interval by adopting the trained Markov network; and updating the digital twin platform according to the state description matrix. The modeling method and the modeling system can realize the rapid update of the digital twin platform of the power grid system.
assignees: ANHUI JIYUAN SOFTWARE CO LTD;STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent auxiliary decision-making system for current period of electric power item
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent auxiliary decision-making system for the current period of an electric power project, which relates to the technical field of auxiliary decision-making of electric power engineering projects, wherein a digital base system is used for acquiring multi-source data of a target area, and the multi-source heterogeneous data are fused and intelligently analyzed by utilizing a knowledge graph technology, and the analysis result is displayed in a three-dimensional visual way; the intelligent optimized power engineering site selection and line selection system is used for determining different transmission line path alternatives according to analysis results and displaying the line selection results in a three-dimensional scene by utilizing a digital twin technology; the three-dimensional visualization system is used for carrying out three-dimensional modeling on the map of the target area and the line selection result so as to realize three-dimensional visualization display. The invention can provide visual and interactive display for the site selection and line selection of the power engineering, and help decision-making staff to better understand and analyze the space information of the power engineering.
assignees: QUZHOU GUANGMING ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Scheduling optimization method and device of regional comprehensive energy system and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a scheduling optimization method and device for an area comprehensive energy system and electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target equipment state parameter of the regional comprehensive energy system in a target prediction period, wherein the target prediction period is a period between the current time and a first time different from the current time; according to the state parameters of the target equipment and a first model of the digital twin model, the prediction total operation data of the regional comprehensive energy system in a target prediction period is determined, the first model is obtained by training an initial model through a plurality of sets of training data, and each set of training data in the plurality of sets of training data comprises the data acquired in a historical period: historical equipment state parameters and historical total operational data; acquiring operation constraint conditions of each power generation device in the regional comprehensive energy system; and determining the predicted operation data of each power generation device in the predicted total operation data according to the operation constraint condition, the target device state and the first model.
assignees: CHN ENERGY XINJIANG ENERGY CO LTD;GUONENG XINJIANG GANQUANBAO COMPREHENSIVE ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Visual modeling method for transmission line pole tower based on holographic data
abstract_en: A transmission line pole tower visual modeling method based on holographic data comprises the following steps of: by utilizing an oblique photogrammetry technology, a point cloud layering optimization method is provided, and a three-dimensional scene holographic model of the power transmission line is obtained through four links of point cloud data acquisition, data processing, three-dimensional scene visual modeling, model checking and modification; step 2: the method comprises the steps of obtaining high-precision three-dimensional coordinates of a pole tower by utilizing a LiDAR technology, and realizing rapid construction of a refined model of the pole tower of the power transmission line containing geographic information and rapid matching of the pole tower and a line through pole tower positioning, line orientation, feature point extraction and feature point splicing; step 3: a digital twin modeling method of a transmission line tower based on holographic data is provided by fusing oblique photography and LiDAR technology. By the method, the transmission line tower visual modeling method based on holographic data, which has good practical application effect and strong disaster risk resistance, is provided.
assignees: LIAONING DONGKE ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Optimal scheduling method of multi-energy flow system in steel industry based on maximum entropy reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention provides an optimal scheduling method of a multi-energy flow system in the steel industry based on maximum entropy reinforcement learning, which belongs to the technical field of information, and comprises the steps of firstly collecting real industrial data of a site, denoising and missing data, and simplifying a site pipe network; secondly, a day-ahead model is established by considering the load balance of the multi-energy flow system, mathematical models of a byproduct gas system, a high-pressure steam system and an electric power system are established, and an operation efficiency model of the energy conversion equipment is established; establishing a gas-heat-electricity daily model by taking a byproduct gas pipe network as an input side and taking a high-pressure steam pipe network and an electric power system as an output side through an energy conversion equipment operation efficiency model, and converting the gas-heat-electricity daily model into a daily-day daily model by combining a daily model; and solving by using a solver, saving data of a solving process, and training an agent for approximating the solving process by using the saved data through a maximum entropy reinforcement learning algorithm so as to achieve an acceleration effect. The invention solves the conflict generated by different time scales and accelerates the solving speed.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN TECH

title_en: Digital twin water network construction method and computer equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin water network construction method and computer equipment. The method comprises the following steps: based on a water conservancy map and the like, a river and lake object is obtained, a solution is drawn, node station measurement information is compiled, point and surface data are searched, adjacent nodes are counted, a river and lake node topological relation table is generated, and automatic inspection is carried out, so that a river and lake node topological model is formed. The digital twin water network information includes: scheme code, node ID number, station code, node name, node class, station class, rain area, river segment length, river bottom elevation, adjacent node number, adjacent node ID number, etc. The node ID numbers and the adjacent node ID numbers are mutually related to form a river-lake node topology model to reconstruct a physical river basin, and a digital twin water network facing the water model is established. A digital twin water network may comprise a plurality of water models.
assignees: GUANGDONG PROVINCE PLANNING & DESIGN INSTITUTE FOR WATER TRANSP CO LTD

title_en: Landslide real-time monitoring method and system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: A landslide real-time monitoring method and system based on digital twin technology, relate to the intelligent monitoring field, in this method, the terminal equipment obtains the monitoring data of every landslide monitoring point in real time; constructing a three-dimensional visualization model of each landslide monitoring point on a geographic information system according to the superposition model selected by the user and the monitoring data; when the change range of the displacement data of the landslide is detected to exceed a preset threshold value, determining key information according to the monitoring data; and dynamically displaying the landslide process on the three-dimensional visual model according to the key information, and simultaneously sending early warning information. The landslide real-time monitoring method and system based on the digital twin technology are provided, the landslide real-time displacement data are dynamically displayed through the digital twin platform, key information such as the landslide moving direction, displacement, dangerous area and influence range is convenient for a user to intuitively know, and powerful basis is provided for geological disaster avoidance and disaster prevention work.
assignees: SHENZHEN TELECOMMUNICATION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based large-load line risk prediction method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based large-load line risk prediction method and device. The digital twinning-based large-load line risk prediction method comprises the following steps: constructing a digital twin model of the heavy load line; acquiring a line risk index; and predicting line risk. According to the invention, the line modeling data of the large-load line to be detected and the reference line power data set are obtained, then the line simulation model is built by combining a simulation technology, a line simulation model verification experiment is carried out, then the reference line risk index data set is built, then the line risk prediction model is built, finally the line risk index data in the monitoring time period is obtained by combining the line risk prediction model, the corresponding line risk index is obtained by combining the line simulation model, the line risk condition is predicted according to the calculated line risk index, the large-load line risk prediction accuracy is improved, and the problem of low large-load line risk prediction accuracy in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Dynamic state estimation method based on GRU pseudo measurement modeling
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic state estimation method based on GRU pseudo measurement modeling, which comprises the steps of firstly, superposing acquisition intervals of SCADA data by taking the update time of AMI data as a reference time to obtain a matched reference time period of a measurement data set, and constructing an SCADA-aMI measurement data pair according to the SCADA data and the AMI data with the nearest acquisition time in the matched reference time period. Secondly, a pseudo measurement data generation model based on GRU is built, and the built model is trained by using measurement data pairs, so that the model can fit a nonlinear relation between SCADA data and AMI data. Finally, AMI data and SCADA data are adopted to carry out dynamic state estimation at AMI updating time, and AMI pseudo-measurement data is generated at non-AMI updating time, so that power system dynamic state estimation based on extended Kalman filtering is realized according to the pseudo-measurement data and the SCADA data measured in real time.
assignees: UNIV FUZHOU

title_en: Power data management method, system and device based on digital twin architecture
abstract_en: The invention provides a power data management method, a system and a device based on a digital twin architecture, wherein the method comprises the following steps: according to the requirements of system computing resources, storage resources and network resources under different power grid scales, a digital twin system adapting to a power system network structure is constructed based on the digital twin architecture; setting a data access standard suitable for the service requirement of the power grid for the digital twin system according to a data acquisition, transmission and storage standard system and technical requirements of a power grid enterprise; and acquiring digital twin system data by utilizing the data access standard, and processing the digital twin system data by a data processing tool to realize the relation mapping and logic binding of the model and the structured data. The invention utilizes the digital twin technology, improves the capabilities of enhancing perception, cognition, decision making and the like of the novel power system, and solves the problem of the common requirement of the novel power system on comprehensive acquisition measurement and control, real-time simulation calculation and intelligent optimization cooperation.
assignees: CHENGDE POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY LTD

title_en: Power distribution network interval dynamic state estimation method based on hybrid measurement fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution network interval dynamic state estimation method based on hybrid measurement fusion, which comprises the following steps: step 1: adopting interval number to describe the data errors of different measuring devices and the measurement deviation brought by RTU to carry out uncertainty modeling, and constructing an interval state estimation model; step 2: constructing a data fusion model based on hybrid measurement by taking the updating time of RTU measurement data as a reference time so as to execute high-resolution state estimation; step 3: and analyzing the time sequence change characteristics of the innovation sequence aiming at the influence of the bad data on the state estimation result, and adaptively adjusting corresponding measurement weight coefficients based on the variance change characteristics of the innovation sequence, so as to inhibit the influence of the bad data on the state estimation. By the adoption of the technical scheme, the influence of bad data on state estimation is effectively restrained, so that the efficiency and the accuracy of dynamic state estimation of the power distribution network interval are improved, and network state information can be accurately and rapidly provided.
assignees: UNIV FUZHOU

title_en: Situation prediction method and terminal for power distribution network based on hybrid neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a situation prediction method and a terminal of a power distribution network based on a hybrid neural network, which are characterized in that field operation data of the power distribution network are acquired through a virtual acquisition technology, missing data in the acquired data set are subjected to interpolation processing through an interpolation method, noise in original data is removed, and then feature selection dimension reduction processing is performed on the processed data; and optimizing three super parameters, namely hidden layer dimension, maximum training period and initial learning rate, of the hybrid neural network, and finally inputting processed data into the optimized hybrid neural network to predict the situation of the power distribution network. In this way, the operation risk of the intelligent power grid can be estimated in real time, the future change trend of the state of the intelligent power grid can be accurately predicted, and the distribution management department can be timely reminded to make safety regulation.
assignees: ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Multi-model fusion type power distribution network time-sharing segmentation line loss fine diagnosis method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for finely diagnosing time-sharing and sectional line loss of a multi-model fused power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring data required by time-sharing segmented line loss diagnosis of a power distribution network; utilizing a state estimation method to identify the credibility of the automatic switch to generate a credible switch set; traversing the trusted switch set, and generating a single-switch downstream segmentation set by using a pruning method; traversing a downstream segment set of the single switch, and respectively calculating a time-sharing segment statistical line loss rate and a time-sharing segment theoretical line loss rate of the downstream of the single switch by adopting a statistical method and a state estimation method; developing the comparison of two rates of the line loss of the downstream single switch, and generating a line loss abnormal downstream set of the line; aiming at the downstream set of the line loss abnormal single switch, performing abnormal diagnosis of the section transformation relation based on the power failure event, and outputting a suspected section transformation relation abnormal distribution set; and aiming at the downstream subsection of the line loss abnormal single switch with normal section transformation relation, carrying out distribution transformer electricity utilization abnormality diagnosis, and outputting a suspected electricity utilization abnormality distribution transformer set.
assignees: JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST

title_en: Digital twin-based system and method for reducing peak power and energy consumption in a physical system
abstract_en: A method (1400) includes identifying (1410) a route for passengers seeking to enter a building. The route includes at least one section of road for automobiles to access a building; or at least one access point inside the building for pedestrians to pass through. The method includes receiving (1420) traffic flow information corresponding to the route. The method includes determining (1430) whether the received traffic flow information corresponds to a condition that impedes the route, from among a set of pre-trained conditions. The method includes identifying and displaying (1440) a list of user-selectable state alternatives related to the condition that impedes the route, based on a determination that the received traffic flow information corresponds to the condition.
assignees: DALLAS/FORT WORTH INT AIRPORT BOARD

title_en: Cold end real-time optimization system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power plant cold end intellectualization, and discloses a cold end real-time optimization system based on digital twinning. And the cold end equipment and the digital twin model are mapped and interacted in real time by a digital twin technology, so that the real-time monitoring and optimization of the cold end are realized. The server stores a cold end digital twin model, inputs the received real-time data into the digital twin model, and outputs a cold end optimization instruction and an inspection strategy through analysis and calculation of the model. Through the digital twin technology, the operation data of the cold end equipment can be obtained in real time, the problems can be found and solved in time, and the operation efficiency and stability of the equipment are improved. The digital twin model can carry out optimization analysis on cold end equipment, output an optimization instruction and an inspection strategy, and improve the operation efficiency and the energy utilization efficiency of the equipment. The digital twin technology can predict and diagnose the faults of the cold end equipment, discover and solve the problems in time, and reduce the fault rate and maintenance cost of the equipment.
assignees: CHONGQING ZHONGCHUANG DINGXIN INTELLIGENT ENERGY SAVING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid fault simulation method, device, equipment, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The application relates to a power grid fault simulation method, a power grid fault simulation device, computer equipment, a storage medium and a program product. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring real power grid data to a simulation environment; performing state estimation on real power grid data in a simulation environment through a state estimation model to obtain a target section; on a main network side of a simulation environment, receiving fault simulation information set for real power grid data, and acquiring affected bus identifications based on the set fault simulation information; on the distribution network side of the simulation environment, carrying out load transfer analysis based on the bus identification and the target section to obtain a fault processing strategy, and executing the fault processing strategy; and respectively carrying out power flow analysis on a main network side and a distribution network side in the simulation environment, and recording fault information and a fault processing strategy related to the simulation and a target section after the power flow analysis is finished. By adopting the method, the dispatching personnel can comprehensively control the fault treatment of the distribution network and the change condition of the whole network by the cooperation of the main distribution network, and the simulation efficiency is improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Power generation equipment fault early warning method for N-order depth multivariate state estimation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for early warning of faults of power generation equipment, and relates to the technical field of early warning of faults of the power generation equipment; obtaining a first residual value corresponding to each dimension parameter according to the observed value of the parameter of each dimension and a history memory matrix, wherein the history memory matrix is generated according to the history parameter values of the parameter of the plurality of dimensions of the equipment, obtaining a target matrix according to the history memory matrix and the parameter of the first dimension when the first residual value of the parameter of the first dimension is larger than a first preset value, and obtaining a final estimated value of the parameter of each dimension according to the history memory matrix, the target matrix and the observed value of the parameter of the second dimension, wherein the parameter of the second dimension is the parameter of the plurality of dimensions except the parameter of the first dimension. The estimated value obtained by the method provided by the invention can more accurately reflect the working condition prediction of the equipment, so that early warning can be timely and accurately performed.

title_en: Heat supply data visualization method based on digital twin and computer equipment
abstract_en: According to the heat supply data visualization method and the computer equipment based on digital twinning, the operation state interface diagram with larger size can be converted into the operation state image block queue with smaller size and convenient treatment by performing image block disassembling operation on the operation state interface diagram of the heating power network, so that timeliness and pertinence of later visual simulation can be improved, different heat supply operation state image blocks can be synchronously or asynchronously treated, and operation resource overload caused by directly treating the operation state interface diagram of the heating power network is reduced. On the basis, the heat supply data generated by the visual main body in the heat supply system is subjected to feature extraction to obtain the feature information focused in the preset strategy, and the corresponding digital twin body is generated to help realize the visual display of the heat supply system.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGNENG NORTH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Construction method and system for power grid digital twin foundation commonality service platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method and a construction system for a power grid digital twin basic commonality service platform, wherein the construction method comprises the following steps: acquiring real-time data for constructing a power grid digital twin basic commonality service platform from an entity system through a data flow platform; preprocessing the real-time data through a pre-constructed conversion function; the state space of the digital twin model and the state space of the entity system are subjected to homomorphic mapping and inverse mapping to realize bidirectional data binding between the digital twin model and the entity system; and (5) completing the construction of the digital twin foundation commonality service platform of the power grid. Real-time interaction between the twin platform and the entity system is realized.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Power grid dynamic state estimation method and system based on extended Kalman particle filtering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid dynamic state estimation method and system based on extended Kalman particle filtering. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a mathematical model of power grid dynamic state estimation according to the power grid measurement data and the state data; acquiring measurement data of a power grid and network topology and model parameters of the power grid within a period of time; initializing a power grid state and an extended Kalman particle filter algorithm; and predicting and updating the power grid state by using an extended Kalman particle filter algorithm to finally obtain a power grid state estimation result. The method realizes high-precision dynamic state estimation applicable to the power grid based on the extended Kalman particle filter algorithm, and can be widely applied to the field of power grid state estimation.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: Real-time county energy internet scheduling method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: A real-time county energy Internet scheduling method and system based on digital twinning, the method includes the following steps: constraint is carried out on a pre-established county energy internet scheduling model to obtain an actual working condition scheduling model; the method comprises the steps of establishing an objective function, wherein the total power deviation between frequency modulation instruction output and actual power output is minimum; and solving the actual working condition scheduling model according to the objective function by combining the autoregressive comprehensive moving average model and the balance optimizer algorithm to obtain the optimal real-time county energy Internet scheduling scheme. When the main power grid receives random disturbance, transmitting a total regulation command from the main power grid to the county energy Internet scheduling model; the county energy internet scheduling model solves the optimal real-time county energy internet scheduling scheme and issues the total adjustment command to each frequency modulation unit. The present invention considers the current and future time control intervals, and the optimal cooperative control scheme can be obtained efficiently by utilizing the autoregressive integrated moving balance optimizer algorithm.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION BRANCH OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Intelligent management platform for park and implementation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a park intelligent management platform and an implementation method thereof, wherein the platform comprises the following components: the Internet of things center management platform is used for accessing and managing terminal equipment and acquiring acquired data of the Internet of things data acquisition equipment; the data center management platform is used for acquiring the acquired data on the Internet of things center management platform and establishing a plurality of databases according to the acquired data; the AI central management platform is used for intelligently analyzing the data to obtain an analysis result; the dispatching center management platform is used for dispatching rule management, issuing dispatching and global observation; the space center management platform is used for processing the geographic space data of the park, providing the geographic information of the park and obtaining a digital twin model according to the analysis results of the data center management platform and the AI center management platform; and the business service platform is used for providing services for the user according to the requirement information of the user. The intelligent park is a multifunctional management platform, is beneficial to management, and is beneficial to anticipating disaster occurrence in advance and realizing more intelligent.
assignees: SHANGHAI YOGO ROBOTICS CO LTD

title_en: Diffusion model power load prediction method based on continuous standardized flow optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a diffusion model power load prediction method based on continuous standardized flow optimization, and relates to the technical field of deep learning. The work aims to model power load prediction by using a probability diffusion model and solve the problem that power load historical data is difficult to model effectively due to long-term dependence. Particularly, when historical data is abnormal due to power failure, noise of missing data can be effectively processed based on power load prediction of the probability diffusion model, and generalization of the power load prediction model is improved. Further, the continuous normalized flow is used to accelerate the probability diffusion model denoising process. According to the data preprocessing module, the probability diffusion model for optimizing the continuous standardized flow of the power utilization load prediction, the decoding acceleration method for continuously planning the flow and the power utilization load prediction module are established. The method effectively improves the accuracy of electricity load prediction.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power system state estimation method considering transformer excitation branch
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system state estimation method considering a transformer excitation branch, which improves a transformer model for power system state estimation, wherein the conductance and susceptance of the excitation branch are considered in the transformer model, and the power loss of the excitation branch is not combined with the load on a node connected with the primary side of a transformer, so that the calculation accuracy of power system state estimation is improved. With this transformer model, the measurement functions and the calculation methods of jacobian matrix elements associated with the measurement of the power quantities of the transformer branches are also changed. The transformer model used by the power system state estimation software comprises equivalent resistance, equivalent leakage reactance, excitation conductance, excitation susceptance and transformation ratio parameters, the excitation conductance and excitation susceptance parameters are increased, the calculation accuracy of the power system state estimation software can be improved, and the calculation accuracy of other power system steady state analysis software such as power flow calculation and the like is not affected.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN MARITIME

title_en: Wisdom fire emergency lighting and evacuation indicating system
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent fire emergency lighting and evacuation indicating system, which comprises the following steps: the emergency lighting controller is used for receiving the data information uploaded by the fire emergency lamp, the detection and sensor assembly and the fireproof door unit through the gateway unit, sending instruction information to the gateway unit and monitoring the working states of the fire emergency lamp, the fire detection and sensor assembly and the fireproof door unit in real time and controlling the fire emergency lamp, the fire detection and sensor assembly and the fireproof door unit in a centralized manner; the emergency lighting centralized power supply is used for supplying power to the emergency lighting controller, the fire emergency lamp, the fire detection sensor assembly and the fireproof door unit; the fire detection and sensor assembly is used for acquiring fire information in the monitoring area in real time and uploading the fire information to the emergency lighting controller; the fire door unit is used for controlling the opening or closing of all fire doors in real time by sending instruction information from the emergency lighting controller according to fire information uploaded by the fire detection and sensor assembly; and the emergency lighting and evacuation indicating module is used for summarizing the position information of the fireproof door in the opening state in the fireproof door unit and planning and forming an escape route. The intelligent fire emergency lighting and evacuation indicating system designed by the invention can realize the real-time updating of the escape route on one hand, and can change the state of all lighting or marking lamps along with the change of the escape route on the other hand, so as to guide the trapped personnel to escape quickly in real time.

title_en: Digital twin intelligent brain construction method for power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a digital twin intelligent brain of a power distribution network, and belongs to the field of power distribution network operation situation awareness and auxiliary decision making; the digital twin intelligent brain construction method of the power distribution network comprises the following steps: constructing a data interface, and acquiring historical monitoring data and real-time operation data; constructing an intelligent brain analysis decision layer, constructing a situation awareness framework of the power distribution network, and implementing situation awareness on the power distribution network; constructing an intelligent brain multi-service functional layer, wherein the intelligent brain multi-service functional layer comprises fault positioning, fault type classification, voltage optimization and optimal scheduling; an intelligent brain auxiliary decision layer is constructed, an optimal power flow and power distribution network fault discrimination reconstruction algorithm is utilized to give out an optimal operation suggestion of the power distribution network, and an auxiliary decision aiming at multiple operation scenes of the power distribution network is made; and carrying out situation awareness and auxiliary decision making on the data input into the power distribution network by using an analysis decision making layer, a multi-service functional layer and an auxiliary decision making layer so as to construct the digital twin intelligent brain of the power distribution network.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Digital power grid management system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital power grid management, in particular to a digital power grid management system based on digital twinning, which comprises a management platform, a node supervision unit, an interference recording unit, a management and control adjustment unit, a refinement feedback unit and an operation and maintenance management unit, wherein the management platform is connected with the node supervision unit; according to the invention, through the combination of the interference data and the operation data in an information feedback mode, the power supply equipment in each power supply node in the target area is subjected to deep management and control force evaluation analysis, so that the digital power grid management and control rationality of the target area is ensured, the digital power grid work efficiency, the operation safety and the rationalization management and control force of the target area are further improved, the digital power grid in the target area is rationalized and controlled according to different management and control grades, and the deep analysis is performed by combining the conditions of the digital power grid power supply nodes of the target area, so that the rationalization management and control of the digital power grid power supply nodes of the target area are further refined, and the improvement of the digital power grid power supply node management and control force of the target area is facilitated.
assignees: INFORMATION COMMUNICATION BRANCH STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Cloud edge cooperation method for battery state estimation and EMS coupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cloud edge cooperation method for battery state estimation and EMS coupling, and relates to the technical field of battery management. The method comprises the steps of uploading edge equipment data to an edge node through a battery data acquisition module, preprocessing and screening a large amount of redundant data by the edge node to obtain key data, then transmitting the key data to an EMS, calculating battery model parameters of the current running condition of a battery by the EMS according to the latest data by utilizing the powerful computing capacity of a self processor, optimizing an iterative battery state estimation model algorithm, feeding the iterated model algorithm back to each battery state estimation execution module in a software code mode, and providing the latest and most appropriate current battery performance and running condition estimation algorithm for the battery state estimation execution module to realize the optimal battery state estimation of the whole life cycle of an energy storage system. And meanwhile, by utilizing cloud edge cooperative technology, each edge node uploads key data and a latest battery state estimation model algorithm to the cloud center node.
assignees: DONGFANG ELECTRIC SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent wind power data restoration method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification discloses an intelligent wind power data restoration method and device. According to the method, missing wind power data can be estimated from three dimensions of characteristic parameters, time sequences and spatial distribution, and a model with the highest correlation in a certain dimension is selected from a model pool to finally repair the wind power data. The device is realized based on the method. According to the embodiment of the specification, the wind power missing data can be completely and accurately repaired from multiple dimensions based on objective complex conditions of the wind power missing data.
assignees: TAIJI COMPUTER CO LTD

title_en: Operation and maintenance decision digital twin test system and method for thermal power generating unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin test system and a digital twin test method for operation and maintenance decision of a thermal power generating unit, which relate to the technical field of intelligent power plants. The invention fully utilizes the strong real-time simulation computing capability of the real-time digital simulator, can accurately simulate the characteristics of the actual generator set in real time, and can realize real-time simulation computation, namely, can combine with the physical excitation controller to form a semi-physical digital twin system. According to the invention, the VR display equipment is used for three-dimensionally displaying the running state and running data of the thermal power generating unit equipment, and when the state of the thermal power generating unit equipment is abnormal, the system can carry out operation and maintenance decision prompt and running early warning at corresponding component positions according to the actual structure of the thermal power generating unit equipment in the three-dimensional world displayed by VR.
assignees: DONGFANG ELECTRIC SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Energy storage power station current collection circuit visual construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a visualized construction method of a collector line of an energy storage power station, which comprises the following steps: establishing a digital twin three-dimensional model for a station and equipment of an energy storage power station; classifying the lines among all connection points of the current collecting lines; modeling the current collecting circuit according to the classification condition of the circuit between the connecting points, and manufacturing model maps of different charge and discharge states; importing the three-dimensional model and the model map into a development engine, and making joint effects and animation effects in advance until all lines of the total station are completed; naming all three-dimensional models according to a set rule; and (3) the named three-dimensional model corresponds to the line and the actual equipment one by one, and data are subjected to butt joint. The method can effectively solve the problem that the main wiring diagram of the large energy storage circuit station is not completely displayed, and avoid missing key information of the power station due to limitation of display content; helping related staff to comprehensively master the overall running condition of the site.
assignees: XINYUAN ZHICHU ENERGY DEV BEIJING CO LTD;XINYUAN ZHICHU ENERGY ENGINEERING TECH BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Power consumption prediction device through edge device-based data abnormality detection and missing data supplementation and method for controlling the same
title_ko: 말단 엣지 디바이스 기반 데이터 이상 탐지 및 결손 데이터 보완을 통한 전력소비 예측 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an apparatus and a method for predicting power consumption using data abnormality detection and missing data supplementation based on a terminal edge device. The method comprises the steps of: collecting power data; preprocessing the collected power data; checking the distribution of the preprocessed power data; deleting or interpolating an outlier or abnormality when the outlier or abnormality exists on the collected power data; learning a deep learning model based on the collected power data; predicting a long-term and short-term power consumption through the power prediction deep learning model; and checking and monitoring whether the outlier or abnormality exists when the power data is collected.
abstract_ko: 본 개시는 말단 엣지 디바이스 기반 데이터 이상 탐지 결손 데이터 보완을 통한 전력 소비 예측 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 전력 데이터를 수집하고, 수집된 상기 전력 데이터를 데이터 전처리하고, 전처리된 상기 전력 데이터의 분포를 확인하고, 수집된 전력 데이터에 대해 특이치 또는 이상치가 있는 경우 이를 삭제 또는 보간하고, 수집된 전력 데이터를 기초로 딥러닝 모델을 학습하고, 전력 예측 딥러닝 모델을 통해 장단기 전력 소요량을 예측하고, 전력 데이터가 수집될 당시 특이치 또는 이상치가 있는지 확인하고 이를 모니터링하는 것을 그 요지로 한다.
assignees: UNIV NAT CHONNAM IND FOUND

title_en: New energy power system operation risk online assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, and discloses a new energy power system operation risk online assessment method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: analyzing the new energy power system and determining risk assessment indexes; calculating the risk assessment index according to the historical output conditions of each resource of a new energy power system, and forming an index data set by the historical output conditions of each resource and the calculation results of the risk assessment index; constructing a playback incremental learning paradigm risk assessment model based on the index data set; and carrying out online real-time evaluation on the running risk of the new energy power system according to the playback incremental learning paradigm risk evaluation model. The method can realize online updating of the system operation risk assessment model, and effectively solve the problems that the calculation cost is too high and the operation real-time requirement is difficult to meet.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Nuclear farming coupling heat supply monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a nuclear farming coupling heat supply monitoring method and a system, wherein the monitoring method comprises the following steps: establishing an automatic monitoring system of a nuclear power plant and an agricultural system; the nuclear power plant, the agricultural system and the transmission and distribution system between the nuclear power plant and the agricultural system jointly form a nuclear agricultural heating system; constructing a digital twin model of a nuclear power plant and an agricultural system; and acquiring target data based on an automatic monitoring system, and simulating the target data as the input of a digital twin model to monitor the state change of the nuclear farming heating system in real time. According to the monitoring method, various operation parameters related to equipment and pipelines between the nuclear power plant and the agricultural system can be collected according to the automatic monitoring system, the parameters can be input into the digital twin model to perform simulation calculation of the whole heat supply process, soft measurement values of the whole process are obtained, and therefore the operation efficiency of the nuclear agricultural heat supply system is improved, the safety reliability and the economical efficiency of the nuclear agricultural heat supply system are improved, and the production efficiency and the production quality of the agricultural system are promoted.
assignees: SHANDONG NUCLEAR POWER COMPANY LTD;SHANGHAI NUCLEAR ENG RES & DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Method for constructing digital twin model library of power system and related equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a method for constructing a digital twin model library of a power system, which comprises the following steps: determining a target power system, and determining a digital twin model of the power system through modeling software according to power data of the power system; determining a logic service model according to the digital twin model; and carrying out logic connection on the logic service model and the digital twin model to determine the digital twin model library. According to the method and the device, the logic service model and the digital twin model are logically connected, and the digital twin model library is determined, so that the model library can update model attributes in real time and adjust service relations among the models through data driving, a large-scale complex electric power digital twin service scene is supported, and the influence of manual intervention can be effectively reduced.
assignees: BEIJING CHINA POWER INF TECH

title_en: Data processing method, terminal equipment and storage medium based on digital twin power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data processing method, terminal equipment and storage medium based on a digital twin power grid, which comprises the following steps: constructing a layering model of the power distribution network; transmitting the layered model of the power distribution network to a digital twin body to construct a digital twin model; the digital twin model carries out disturbance processing on the acquired data, the disturbed data is sent to an encoder, the encoded data is mapped into high-dimensional potential vectors through an input projection layer, the potential vectors are covered by combining with a random time stamp, and the covered data is sent to a cavity convolution layer, so that a final processing result is obtained. The method has good effect on the time sequence prediction task and the classification task, can perform better processing on the time sequence, and improves the prediction precision of the time sequence classification task.
assignees: UNIV HUNAN SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Intelligent electric power energy scheduling method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The disclosure provides an intelligent power energy scheduling method and system based on digital twin, and relates to the technical field of power scheduling, wherein the method comprises the following steps: reading a predicted power distribution demand instruction; extracting the power distribution requirement of a d-th prediction area; loading a power energy scheduling topology network; acquiring a d-th electric power energy scheduling registration space; obtaining a d scheduling initial optimizing space; acquiring a power energy scheduling scheme of a d-th area corresponding to the power distribution requirement of the d-th prediction area; the d-th regional power energy scheduling scheme is added to the power grid power energy scheduling scheme, and power energy scheduling in a preset future time zone is carried out on a target power grid, so that the technical problems of poor power scheduling quality and poor power grid operation quality caused by low suitability between power distribution requirements and power scheduling decisions in the prior art can be solved, the aim of improving the suitability between the power distribution requirements and the power scheduling decisions is fulfilled, and the technical effect of improving the power scheduling quality is achieved.

title_en: Optimized scheduling method of electric-gas coupling multi-energy flow system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimized scheduling method of an electric-gas coupling multi-energy flow system, and particularly relates to the technical field of operation and control of electric power systems in various energy forms, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1: state estimation: a model predictive control method in a modern control theory is utilized to establish a dynamic model of the multi-energy flow system, and current state information of the system is obtained through a state estimation algorithm; s2: distributed optimization operation: dividing the whole multi-energy flow system into a plurality of subsystems by adopting a distributed optimization method based on a genetic algorithm; s3: the optimal scheduling method comprises the following steps: and according to the state estimation and the distributed optimization operation result, adopting an optimization scheduling method based on a weighted least square method to schedule the electric-gas coupling multi-energy flow system in real time. The method can effectively improve the energy utilization efficiency, reduce the energy cost, improve the system reliability, optimize the system performance and improve the flexibility and adaptability of the system.
assignees: HULUDAO ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Digital twin model construction method and device of power equipment and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a digital twin model construction method and device of power equipment and computer equipment. The method comprises the steps of determining components contained in a component layer of target equipment and parts contained in a part layer, classifying the parts in the component layer to obtain a visual-level part list and a simulation calculation-level part list, establishing a corresponding first part model according to a first modeling mode for the parts in the visual-level part list, establishing a corresponding second part model according to a second modeling mode for the parts in the simulation calculation-level part list, connecting the first part model and the second part model to form part models corresponding to all the components according to a part connection relation, and connecting the part models to form equipment models corresponding to the target equipment according to the part connection relation. The modeling method of the complex power equipment is realized, the modeling efficiency is improved, and the applicability of the model under different use scenes can be improved.

title_en: Method and device for establishing power grid digital twin system based on graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for establishing a power grid digital twin system based on a graph neural network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: calculating a prediction result of a digital twin model of each device in a device set contained in a target power grid system; determining the device relation between each device in the device set and other devices in the device set; defining a device interaction graph based on the prediction result of the digital twin model and the device relation; acquiring a new representation of each device through a depth map convolution neural network model based on the device interaction map; and combining the new representations of all the devices in the device set to obtain the whole state representation of the device set. The invention uses the prediction result of the digital twin model of the equipment, and then adjusts the prediction result according to the relation between the equipment, thereby obtaining the whole prediction result.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Intelligent digital twinning-based power protection equipment state analysis system
