abstract_en: The invention discloses a power-saving equipment state analysis system based on intelligent digital twinning, which comprises a power supply module, a digital twinning module and a communication module, wherein the digital twinning module is respectively connected with the power supply module and the communication module; the power supply module is used for supplying power; the digital twin module is used for storing historical data, calculating estimated abnormal risk coefficients according to the historical data, calculating a selection function of the estimated abnormal risk percentage according to the estimated abnormal risk coefficients, obtaining the estimated abnormal risk percentage according to the selection function of the estimated abnormal risk percentage, and transmitting the estimated abnormal risk percentage to the communication module; the communication module transmits information for estimating the abnormal risk percentage to the client; the method has the advantages that the estimated abnormal risk percentage is obtained through the digital twin module according to the historical data, workers can pre-judge the possibility of abnormality of the power supply module in advance, and can respond timely when the abnormality occurs to the power supply module, so that the influence on electricity consumption of users is reduced.
assignees: NANNING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Software development data management method and server applied to digital twin
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, and provides a method and a server for managing digital twinned software development data. The method combines key information such as digital twin virtual flow, front and rear sequence characteristics and the like, so that the storage management discrimination viewpoint is more targeted and accurate. The method and the system provide a storage optimization mode label of each digital twin virtual process, and evaluate the importance of corresponding disaster recovery backup, so that development teams can make optimal data management decisions at each stage.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU CHAOYU QIFU ENTERPRISE MAN CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent real-time monitoring system and method for wind turbine generator
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent real-time monitoring system and method of a wind turbine, which are used for detecting an included angle between wind direction and a fan blade and detecting stress parameters of the side part of a machine head in real time, wherein a controller calculates the rotation position of a stepping motor according to the detected included angle, drives the stepping motor to rotate according to the stress parameters of the side part of the machine head until the fan blade rotates to the windward side, and then outputs a first maintenance current to the stepping motor to enable the fan blade to be maintained at the position; in the running process of the wind turbine generator, comparing and analyzing the obtained stress parameters of the side part of the machine head with a preset threshold value, and determining whether to adjust the positions of the blades of the wind turbine according to the analysis result; meanwhile, the running state of the wind turbine generator is monitored based on the constructed digital twin model. Therefore, the running stability of the wind turbine generator system can be improved while the fan head is controlled to track and rotate along with wind power; and on the basis of ensuring the safety of the wind turbine, the maximum power generation power is obtained at the same time.

title_en: Power distribution network state estimation method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power distribution networks and discloses a power distribution network state estimation method, a system, equipment and a medium; the power distribution network state estimation method comprises the following steps: obtaining measurement data of a power distribution network, and enhancing the measurement data by generating an antagonistic neural network to obtain enhanced data; based on the enhanced data, performing operation state estimation by using a gating circulation unit neural network optimized by an improved whale optimization algorithm to obtain a power distribution network state estimation result; the improved whale optimization algorithm is obtained by improving a standard whale optimization algorithm through introducing a nonlinear decrementing factor, an adaptive weight factor and optimal domain disturbance. The technical scheme provided by the invention can realize effective estimation of the running state of the power distribution network, and has higher estimation precision.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power consumption abnormity monitoring system and method based on topological structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power data processing, in particular to a topological structure-based power consumption abnormality monitoring system and a topological structure-based power consumption abnormality monitoring method, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining user electricity data, transformer data, user geographic position and transformer geographic position, the user electricity consumption data comprises voltage data, current data and electricity consumption data; preprocessing the power consumption data of the user, wherein the preprocessing comprises missing data filling and data standardization; building a household transformer relation topological structure through electricity user data and transformer data; the line loss of the adjacent nodes of the user variable relation topology structure is calculated, dividing a region with the line loss higher than the average line loss into a potential power consumption abnormal region; by calculating the voltage fluctuation rate of the potential electricity utilization anomaly region, marking the power consumption abnormal node. The invention improves the accuracy of monitoring the abnormal electricity consumption by constructing the household variable relation topological structure.
assignees: XIAN ZHONGCHUANG XINNENG NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power digital anomaly identification method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twinning-based power digital anomaly identification method and system, and relates to the technical field of power. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring input voltage data, output voltage data and output power data of a transformer in a transformer area, and power consumption data and geographic position data of each ammeter; obtaining a power digital twin model of the transformer area according to the input voltage data, the output power data, the power consumption data and the geographic position data; determining a transformation anomaly score and a district electricity anomaly score; determining a plurality of ammeter clusters according to the geographic position data; determining cluster anomaly scores according to the ammeter clusters, the electricity power data and the output power data; and obtaining the power anomaly score according to the transformation anomaly score, the power utilization anomaly score of the transformer area and the cluster anomaly score. According to the invention, the abnormal conditions of multiple aspects of the transformer area can be observed in real time through the transformer area electric power digital twin model, so that the abnormality can be found in time, and the abnormality identification efficiency is improved.

title_en: Anomaly Detection Method, Power Control Method Using the Anomaly Detection Method, and Computing Device for Performing the Methods
title_ko: 이상 탐지 방법 및 상기 이상 탐지 방법을 이용한 전력 제어 방법 및 상기 방법들을 수행하는 컴퓨팅 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed are an abnormality detection method and a power control method using the abnormality detection method. The abnormality detection method comprises the following steps of: collecting power usage data for different applications via smart metering; dividing the collected power usage data into a training set, a validation set, and a test set for application to an abnormality detection model for detecting abnormality of the power usage data; training the abnormality detection model to detect an abnormal value or a missing value in the power usage data in response to inputting power usage data included in the training set to the abnormality detection model; and validating the performance of the trained abnormality detection model by applying power usage data included in the validation set to the trained abnormality detection model.
abstract_ko: 이상 탐지 방법 및 상기 이상 탐지 방법을 이용한 전력 제어 방법이 개시된다. 이상 탐지 방법은 스마트 미터링을 통해 서로 다른 애플리케이션에 대한 전력 사용량 데이터를 수집하는 단계; 상기 전력 사용량 데이터의 이상을 탐지하기 위한 이상 탐지 모델에 적용하기 위하여 상기 수집된 전력 사용량 데이터를 훈련 세트, 검증 세트 및 테스트 세트로 분할하는 단계; 상기 훈련 세트에 포함된 전력 사용량 데이터를 상기 이상 탐지 모델에 입력함에 대응하여, 상기 전력 사용량 데이터 내의 이상치 또는 결측치를 탐지하도록 상기 이상 탐지 모델을 학습시키는 단계; 및 상기 검증 세트에 포함된 전력 사용량 데이터를 상기 학습된 이상 탐지 모델에 적용하여, 상기 학습된 이상 탐지 모델의 성능을 검증하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: ELECTRONICS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS RES INST

title_en: Energy storage power station management and control system and method based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention provides an energy storage power station management and control system and method based on a digital twin technology, wherein the system comprises the following components: energy storage equipment thing allies oneself with perception layer: the energy storage power station device information acquisition module is used for acquiring energy storage power station device information and outputting the acquired information to an energy storage control strategy supporting layer and an energy storage fault report convergence layer; energy storage management and control strategy supporting layer: the method comprises the steps of combining a basic strategy and a fault strategy, and formulating and executing different equipment management and control modes according to equipment fault processing modes set by operation and maintenance personnel of the energy storage power station; energy storage fault report convergence layer: the system comprises an energy storage power station device, an energy storage digital twin display layer, a fault strategy generation module and a fault strategy generation module, wherein the energy storage power station device is used for collecting relevant information of executing the fault strategy of the energy storage power station device, generating an execution report and outputting the execution report to the energy storage digital twin display layer; and an energy storage digital twin display layer: the system is used for displaying the digital twin system of the energy storage power station and is also used for displaying the execution result information of the basic strategy and the fault strategy. The invention has the advantages that: the problems of difficult and non-visual fault positioning and low fault eliminating efficiency of the energy storage power station equipment are solved.
assignees: XINYUAN ZHICHU ENERGY DEV BEIJING CO LTD;XINYUAN ZHICHU ENERGY ENGINEERING TECH BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent management and control method for urban water supply system integrating big data and cloud computing
abstract_en: An intelligent management and control method for an urban water supply system integrating big data and cloud computing relates to the technical field of environmental engineering. The invention aims to solve the problems of unstable water supply pressure and low utilization rate of booster pump stations in the conventional urban water supply scheduling. The invention establishes a multisource data monitoring network integrating weather-water source-pipe network-user information, performs data intercommunication and visual modeling, performs simulation and decision making based on full-element monitoring data, supports a plan model coping with different events, and enables intelligent management and control of the urban water supply system through big data, cloud computing and digital twin engine driving.
assignees: WATER RESOURCES NATIONAL ENGINEERING RESEARCH CENTER HARBIN INSTITUTE OF TECH;HARBIN INST TECHNOLOGY;GUANGDONG YUEHAI WATER INVEST CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based hydraulic power engineering construction management and control method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydraulic power engineering management and control, and provides a hydraulic power engineering construction management and control method and system based on digital twinning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring hydraulic power engineering construction projects and hydraulic region information, determining construction nodes and positions, and acquiring a corresponding diversion strategy set; and simulating the strategy by utilizing a digital twin technology, generating a strategy simulation database, and connecting the strategy simulation database with the diversion optimizing model to obtain an optimized diversion strategy. The technical problems that a diversion strategy of a construction position of the hydraulic power engineering cannot adapt to complex and changeable water flow environments and the diversion effect is poor are solved, and the technical effects that the construction efficiency and the engineering quality of the hydraulic power engineering are improved by constructing a digital twin model of the hydraulic power engineering, accurately simulating and optimizing the diversion strategy of the construction position, optimizing and adjusting the diversion strategy in advance to adapt to the complex and changeable water flow environments, guaranteeing the diversion effect, further keeping the dryness of the construction position are achieved.
assignees: SICHUAN JIA YUAN ECOLOGICAL DEV CO LTD

title_en: Tower risk assessment method and device based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of power transmission line risk assessment, and provides a tower risk assessment method and device based on a digital twin technology, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring preset environmental parameters and tower information, and establishing a digital twin model of the tower; based on the digital twin model of the tower and preset environmental parameters, obtaining a digital twin model of the superimposed environmental parameters; acquiring the field environment parameters of the tower; and obtaining a risk assessment result of the tower based on the digital twin model of the in-situ environment parameter and the superposition environment parameter of the tower. The risk assessment method and the risk assessment system can achieve risk assessment of the pole tower, further make a coping strategy in advance, and improve stability of the pole tower.
assignees: HENGSHUI ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN CO LTD;STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD HENGSHUI POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power distribution network state estimation method, device, electronic equipment, medium and program product
abstract_en: The application provides a power distribution network state estimation method, a power distribution network state estimation device, electronic equipment, a medium and a program product. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an initial quantity measurement, and performing a measurement transformation operation on the initial quantity measurement to determine an equivalent quantity measurement corresponding to the initial quantity measurement; determining the weight of equivalent measurement, converting the equivalent measurement into a node, and injecting the node into target current measurement; acquiring historical load data, and taking the historical load data as pseudo-quantity measurement; and determining power distribution network state estimation according to the power physical constraint condition, the target current measurement and the pseudo-measurement to determine power distribution network state information. The application uses the historical load data as the pseudo-quantity measurement, supplements the measurement deficiency, can reduce the dependence on real-time measurement data, improves the accuracy of state estimation, can obtain accurate estimation results in a short time when processing the problem of power distribution network state estimation, reflects the state of the power system in real time, and realizes the full-quantity accurate measurement estimation under the condition of limited measurement information.
assignees: STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD;NANJING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Risk management and control platform of metallurgical furnace digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of metallurgical safety production, in particular to a risk management and control platform of a metallurgical furnace digital twin technology, which comprises the following components: the system comprises a data acquisition module, a digital twin module, a risk classification module, a management and control decision module and an execution module. The data acquisition module can acquire key operation data of the kiln, such as temperature, pressure, speed and the like, so as to ensure the immediate grasp of the state of the kiln and help to discover potential problems in time. The risk classification module utilizes real-time simulation data of the digital twin model and combines a preset risk classification model to accurately classify risks in furnace operation; the classification is helpful for distinguishing the severity and the urgency of different risks, provides powerful support for subsequent control decisions, and ensures the efficient, safe and sustainable operation of the metallurgical furnace.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and readable storage medium for estimating dynamic state of power system
abstract_en: The application discloses a dynamic state estimation method, a device, equipment and a readable storage medium of an electric power system, wherein the method acquires a historical state sequence containing operation state variables and measurement vectors of different time sections of the electric power system, and a high-dimensional Coulomb linear system for determining a high-dimensional linear relation between the operation state variables of adjacent time sections of the electric power system and a high-dimensional linear relation between the measurement vectors and the operation state variables corresponding to the same time section, wherein the high-dimensional Coulomb linear system is constructed based on an extended dynamic mode decomposition method EDMD; and carrying out dynamic state estimation on the electric power system based on the high-dimensional Coulomb linear system and the historical state sequence to generate an estimated value of an operation state variable of the electric power system. Therefore, when the dynamic state estimation is carried out, the application does not need to refer to the network topology structure and the system parameters of the power system, reduces the dependence of the network topology structure and the system parameters, avoids the influence of the network topology structure and the system parameters on the accuracy of DSE, and further improves the prediction accuracy of the application. The application can simplify the dynamic state estimation and improve the estimation accuracy.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin firefighting control room graphic display system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twinning and discloses a digital twinning fire control room graphic display system and a digital twinning fire control room graphic display method, wherein the system comprises a data compression mapping module, a flame trend prediction module, a scene recognition module, an association analysis module, a dynamic model optimization module, a resource allocation decision module and a visual presentation module; according to the invention, the response capability of the fire control room to complex conditions is remarkably improved through the methods of data compression mapping, flame trend prediction, scene recognition, association analysis, dynamic model optimization, resource allocation decision and visual presentation, the rescue resource allocation is optimized through accurate fire development prediction and risk recognition, the high efficiency and the intellectualization of fire rescue work are realized, the accuracy of fire prediction is enhanced by utilizing a random forest and graph injection force network, the rationality of resource allocation is improved, visual and real-time data support is provided for command decision by utilizing a three-dimensional visualization technology, and the rescue efficiency and the scientificity of command decision are remarkably improved.
assignees: WEIFANG PINGAN FIRE PROT ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Power transmission line digital twin body modeling method and system based on geological disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for modeling a digital twin body of a power transmission line based on geological disasters, which relate to the technical field of power line modeling and comprise the steps of performing flight acquisition by using an unmanned aerial vehicle to acquire image data of a power line region; processing the acquired image data to generate a three-dimensional scene, and carrying out three-dimensional scene correction by combining geology and a topographic map; acquiring an inclined photo by using a five-spelling inclined camera of the unmanned plane, generating three-dimensional model data and real shooting image data by using control point information, and acquiring two-dimensional vector data with high appearance on the real shooting image data; and integrating various data to construct a refined digital twin model of the power line. The invention has important significance for digital upgrading of the power line, improves the intelligent level and operation and maintenance efficiency of the power grid, reduces the risk cost and has wide application prospect.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method, apparatus and computer readable storage medium for estimating micro-coordination state
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a device and a computer readable storage medium for estimating a matching-micro cooperation state, wherein the method comprises the following steps: partitioning the matching-micro cooperative system based on a node replication method to obtain a plurality of partition systems, and obtaining topological structures and measurement data information corresponding to the partition systems; constructing a weighted least square state estimation model of each partition system according to the state variable and the measurement function of each partition system, and adding coupling constraint to obtain a state estimation model of the micro-coordination system so as to calculate the state estimation of each partition system; based on the state estimation of each partition system, a state estimation model of the coordination-micro coordination system is solved, and a coordination-micro coordination state estimation result is output. Therefore, the technical problems that in the related art, the state estimation accuracy is low, the communication and calculation burden is heavy, the instantaneity is poor and the privacy protection performance is poor due to the fact that the distribution of the power distribution network subsystem is limited and the influence of various factors is caused in the information transmission process are solved.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV NORTH CHINA TECHNOLOGY;STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID ENERGY RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Tunnel fire digital twin model credibility assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reliability evaluation method and a reliability evaluation system for a digital twin model of a tunnel fire, belongs to the technical field of digital twin, and solves the problems that the prior art focuses on static evaluation and lacks dynamic evaluation of the model in an actual running environment which is continuously changed, so that the dynamic evaluation cannot be realized; or despite consideration of dynamic changes of the models, the adaptation to interactions between models and environmental changes is not well-assessed. The method acquires the fire disaster data of the tunnel and visualizes the twin model; performing 'precision analysis-model verification-virtual-real symbiosis' progressive layer-by-layer evaluation on the data visualized by the digital twin model; and comprehensively evaluating the credibility of the digital twin model of the tunnel fire disaster based on the progressive evaluation results. The digital twin model reliability evaluation method is used for the digital twin model reliability evaluation of tunnel fires.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG

title_en: Urban cable management and control method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a management and control method, a device, equipment and a storage medium of an urban cable, which relate to the technical field of power systems, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring operation data of a cable, wherein the operation data comprises cable circuit data and cable basic data; constructing a digital twin model according to the cable basic data, acquiring historical operation data, performing data processing and analysis on the historical operation data and the cable circuit data according to a data analysis model to obtain operation state information of the cable, and inputting the operation state information of the cable into the digital twin model for visual display; and carrying out data mining processing on the running state information to obtain a potential fault prediction result, generating a cable regulation and control decision according to the potential fault prediction result, and managing and controlling the cable according to the cable regulation and control decision. The invention realizes real-time monitoring of the urban cable and timely processing of the running problem of the urban cable.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NINGBO POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Site safety control system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power grid operation safety control and discloses a field safety control system, which comprises a cloud server, an edge computing module, an information acquisition module and an application control system; the information acquisition module acquires the environment and personnel operation information of an operation site; the edge computing power module carries out violation information identification according to the acquired information, then feeds back the violation information to the cloud server and synchronously stores the violation information in the violation sample storage module, and regularly trains the updating model prediction module through the real-time updated violation sample storage module; the cloud server is integrated with a data storage device and an artificial intelligent computing operation program, and is used for managing and controlling key nodes before operation, monitoring in real time in the operation process, performing data analysis and storage after operation, performing safety management and control on site operators, operation processes and operation conditions, synchronizing management and control information to an application management and control system, performing visual safety management and control and violation early warning, and achieving full-process and full-element safety management and control on the operation site.
assignees: LANZHOU LONGNENG ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network operation and maintenance method, system and medium based on digital twin
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a power distribution network operation and maintenance method, system and medium based on digital twin. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining physical distribution network structure composition data, operation environment data and power fixing equipment data, obtaining a distribution network twin body and a distribution network aging rate index, extracting distribution network power distribution data and corresponding regional power demand data, load mutation monitoring data, power parameter monitoring data and historical fault log data according to the distribution network twin body, processing the distribution network power distribution data and the corresponding regional power demand data, the load mutation monitoring data and the power parameter monitoring data respectively, obtaining an abnormal power utilization index and a distribution network anti-interference capacity index, processing the distribution network anti-interference capacity index according to the distribution network aging rate index and the abnormal power utilization index, obtaining a distribution network operation maintenance period index, comparing the distribution network operation maintenance period index with a preset operation maintenance period threshold, obtaining an operation maintenance period deviation rate, and finally adjusting physical distribution network facilities and optimizing a distribution network system through the comparison of the deviation rate.

title_en: Digital twinning-based wind power station management method and system
abstract_en: The application is suitable for the technical field of wind power generation, and provides a digital twin-based wind power station management method and system.
assignees: KUAIBEI NEW ENERGY TECH SHANGHAI CO LTD

title_en: Power plant information analysis and statistics system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power plant monitoring, in particular to a power plant information analysis and statistics system, which is used for collecting data of daily information of a power plant by establishing a sensor, a monitoring instrument and an SCADA system, and importing the data into a data processing environment for subsequent processing; analyzing the data by utilizing a data cleaning technology, removing abnormal values, filling missing data and the like, and ensuring the quality and the integrity of the data; selecting to extract data to be analyzed and calculated from a data storage system according to requirements and targets; analyzing and calculating the data by using a plurality of statistical methods and calculation models; the power plant information analysis and statistics system can provide accurate decision support, improve operation efficiency, forecast and optimize decisions, visualize data and interpretation results, and real-time monitoring and alarm functions. These advantages enable plant managers to better understand and apply plant data, make informed and efficient decisions, and improve plant operation performance and competitiveness.
assignees: HUANENG POWER INT JIANGSU ENERGY DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;XIAN THERMAL POWER RES INST CO;HUANENG NANJING GAS TURBINE POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Power grid equipment energy efficiency optimization method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid equipment energy efficiency optimization method and system based on digital twin, and relates to the technical field of power grid optimization, wherein the method comprises the following steps: carrying out functional simulation modeling on distribution area information and equipment attribute information of power grid equipment and equipment operation performance data streams obtained by monitoring by a sensor group through a digital twin technology, constructing a digital twin model of the power grid equipment, carrying out equipment operation state prediction based on the digital twin model of the power grid equipment, further respectively carrying out energy efficiency analysis on a predicted operation state information set of the power grid equipment obtained by prediction, carrying out cluster parameter optimization on an energy efficiency utilization coefficient set obtained by evaluation, and obtaining energy efficiency optimization control parameters so as to carry out energy efficiency adjustment optimization management on the power grid equipment. The comprehensive optimization analysis of the energy efficiency of the power grid equipment is realized by utilizing the multifunctional application of the digital twin technology, the accuracy and the optimization efficiency of the energy efficiency optimization analysis are improved, and the technical effect of timely optimizing and regulating the energy efficiency of the power grid equipment is further ensured.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for collaborative fire control and calculation unit thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle for collaborative fire protection and a calculation unit thereof, wherein the calculation unit is configured to preprogram a moving route of the unmanned aerial vehicle between a control station of the unmanned aerial vehicle and a plurality of fire positions based on a three-dimensional virtual scene of a digital twin factory, judge fire reasons according to monitoring data of the fire positions to determine monitoring equipment required to be carried by the unmanned aerial vehicle for monitoring the fire positions, control at least two unmanned aerial vehicles to respectively carry one of a visible light camera, a thermal imaging camera and gas concentration monitoring equipment to monitor the fire positions and acquire monitoring data, and quickly generate a digital twin model of the fire positions in the three-dimensional virtual scene to completely embody the conditions of the fire positions. Under the condition that the fire disaster occurs due to the leakage of inflammable gas, the unmanned aerial vehicle is prevented from being dispatched to perform corresponding fire-fighting tasks, the inflammable gas is prevented from being ignited by the open flame of the generator of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the dispatching accuracy of the unmanned aerial vehicle is effectively improved.

title_en: Distribution network cable accessory management and control system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network cable accessory management and control system and a distribution network cable accessory management and control method, and relates to the technical field of intelligent management and control. Compared with the prior management and control technology, the invention improves the problems that no corresponding management and control equipment or system is used for carrying out corresponding management and control on the cable accessories in the prior art, and the conventional monitoring means are difficult to track and monitor the performance change in the structural working process, and carries out judgment, fault prediction, risk diagnosis and residual life prediction of the cable running state in real time based on the omnibearing data of the remote acquisition transmission cable accessories and the service cables thereof and the corresponding data of the environments in which the transmission cable accessories and the service cables are positioned; the operation structure model and the simulation cable model of the cable accessory are built through the corrected finite element master model based on the digital twin technology, the problem that performance change generated in the working process of the cable accessory cannot be tracked and monitored by the conventional monitoring means is solved, the operation state of the cable accessory can be mastered in real time, and the state judgment accuracy rate of the cable accessory is improved.
assignees: ANHUI JIYUAN SOFTWARE CO LTD

title_en: Power equipment inspection method and system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power equipment inspection, and provides a power equipment inspection method and system based on a digital twin technology, which can both: based on a digital twin technology, constructing an area model of an area to be inspected; constructing a device model to be inspected at the corresponding position of the region model based on the position of the device to be inspected in the region to be inspected and the information of the device to be inspected; acquiring information of the inspection robot, and constructing an inspection robot model in the region model; planning a routing inspection route of the routing inspection robot in the area model, and sending the routing inspection route to the routing inspection robot; receiving real-time position information of the inspection robot, and synchronizing the real-time position of the inspection robot model in the region model; based on the real-time position of the synchronous inspection robot model in the region model, controlling the inspection robot to inspect all equipment to be inspected in the region to be inspected according to the inspection route. The invention can carry out the inspection on the power equipment with high efficiency and improves the inspection efficiency.
assignees: TAIAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power transmission line fault detection method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of transmission line fault detection, and particularly relates to a transmission line fault detection method and system based on artificial intelligence, which can both: collecting real-time operation condition data of the power transmission line, inputting the collected operation condition data into a pre-established digital twin model of the power transmission line for operation, and outputting prediction data; inputting the predicted data into a pre-trained machine learning model for calculation, and outputting a predicted running state of a corresponding power transmission line and the occurrence probability of the predicted running state; the pre-trained machine learning model can predict the running state of the power transmission line and the occurrence probability of the running state. The invention can improve the efficiency and the precision of fault detection and assist in improving the reliability and the safety of the power system.
assignees: TAIAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Operation state prediction analysis method and device for digital twin bodies of power distribution network
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for predicting and analyzing the running state of a digital twin body of a power distribution network, which relate to the technical field of power distribution networks. Selecting an installation address before installing a distribution line, and acquiring lightning stroke information of the installation address; analyzing and determining lightning strike information of an installation address to obtain lightning protection information of a high-risk lightning zone grounding grid and fault information of lightning strike after the installation address is installed on a distribution line; inputting lightning protection information of the high-risk lightning area grounding network and fault information of lightning stroke after the distribution line is installed at the installation address into a digital twin body state model for processing and analyzing to obtain a fault value; the application inputs the lightning protection information of the high-risk lightning area grounding network and the fault information of lightning stroke after the installation address is used for installing the distribution line into the digital twin body state model for processing and analyzing to obtain the fault value, and the running state of the high-risk lightning area distribution line can be reflected through the fault value.
assignees: CHINA NAT INST STANDARDIZATION

title_en: Distributed state estimation method and system for power distribution network
abstract_en: A distributed state estimation method and system for a power distribution network comprise the following steps: acquiring measurement data of the operation of a power distribution system; carrying out bad data identification and bad data correction on the acquired measurement data, acquiring an original data set, and carrying out normalization processing on the original data set; and inputting the normalized data into a distributed integrated DNN network model to perform state estimation of the power distribution system. The bad number identification technology for measuring correlation test provided by the invention has higher recall ratio, precision ratio and accuracy in bad data identification; the TCN-BILSTM-based measurement data correction technology is provided, and has higher prediction precision in the aspect of measurement prediction, so that bad data can be corrected more accurately, and the reliability of measurement data is ensured.
assignees: UNIV XINJIANG

title_en: A digital twin-based firefighting activity support system that supports identification of users in case of fire and disaster
title_ko: 화재 및 재난시 요구조자 파악을 지원하는 디지털트윈 기반 소방활동 지원 시스템
abstract_en: The digital twin-based fire fighting support system for identifying personnel in the event of a fire or disaster according to the present invention includes: an APC terminal installed at all entrances and exits of separated spaces within a building to count the number of people entering and exiting the space; an APC management module that registers and manages a plurality of the APC terminals, receives the count of entering and exiting personnel from the APC terminals, and calculates the remaining personnel; and a fire fighting support module that maps the installation locations of the APC terminals provided by the APC management module onto a 3D building layout, and maps the remaining personnel information for the entire building and by floor or section, providing this information to the terminal carried by the fire fighting personnel. This system allows for identifying the building structure and layout of spaces where rescue operations should be conducted, and enables real-time monitoring of the remaining personnel status within those spaces on-site, supporting rapid rescue activities. This contributes to preventing large-scale casualties during fires in facilities such as sports centers and logistics centers.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 화재 및 재난시 요구조자 파악을 지원하는 디지털트윈 기반 소방활동 지원 시스템은 건물 내 분리된 공간의 모든 출입구에 설치되어 그 공간으로 출·입하는 인원을 계수하는 APC 단말; 복수의 상기 APC 단말을 등록관리하고, 해당 APC 단말에서 계수한 입·출입 인원수를 수신받아 잔류인원을 계산하는 APC 관리 모듈; 및 3D 건물도면 상에 상기 APC 관리 모듈로부터 제공받은 상기 APC 단말 설치 위치의 맵핑, 건물 전체와 층별 또는 구역별 잔류인원 정보를 맵핑하여 소방대원이 소지한 단말기에 제공하는 소방활동 지원 모듈;을 포함하여 구조활동을 펼쳐야 할 곳의 건물구조와 공간의 배치 현황을 파악할 수 있고 또한, 그 공간 내 잔류인원 실시간 현황을 시스템적으로 현장에서 확인할 수 있어 신속한 인명구조 활동을 지원함으로써 스포츠센터, 물류센터 등의 화재발생시 대형인명 피해를 예방할 수 있는 효과가 있다.
assignees: KEPCO KDN CO LTD

title_en: Multi-frequency asynchronous architecture-based robust state estimation method for thermoelectric linkage system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a robust state estimation method of a thermoelectric linkage system based on a multi-frequency asynchronous architecture, which comprises the following steps: acquiring historical load power data of the thermoelectric linkage system, and constructing coupling characteristics of the thermoelectric linkage system based on a random matrix theory; acquiring historical operation data of the thermoelectric linkage system, combining the coupling characteristics with the historical operation data to serve as a training set, and constructing a state quantity prediction model; and respectively carrying out dynamic state estimation on a thermodynamic system and an electric system in the thermoelectric linkage system by adopting a multi-frequency asynchronous parallel frame, and iteratively updating estimated values until the constraint of coupling equipment is met, so as to finish system state estimation, wherein the thermodynamic system and the electric system respectively apply a volume Kalman filtering method, and carry out dynamic state estimation based on the state quantity prediction model. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of realizing robust processing of the thermoelectric linkage system data, improving situation awareness level of the thermoelectric linkage system and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: AI-based power grid health state assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an AI-based power grid health state assessment method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: displaying a preset digital twin model corresponding to the power grid; determining an estimated recommended first grid region from the digital twin model; receiving a second power grid region to be evaluated, which is selected from the digital twin model by a user; extracting power grid operation data of the first power grid region and the second power grid region from the digital twin model; determining the health state of the power grid based on the operation data and a preset AI evaluation model; and displaying the health state of the power grid. According to the invention, the AI evaluation model is introduced, the health state of the power grid is determined based on the power grid operation data and the AI evaluation model, the automatic and self-adaptive health state evaluation of the power grid by using AI instead of an evaluator is realized, the labor cost is reduced, and the evaluation efficiency is greatly improved.
assignees: NANNING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Space-time configuration-based multi-charging-pile station electricity consumption prediction method
abstract_en: A prediction method for the electricity consumption of a multi-charging pile station based on space-time configuration comprises the following steps: s1, establishing a database; s2, processing abnormal data; s3, data aggregation; s4, filling missing data; s5, modeling data; s6, outputting a prediction result; s7, storing the data into a database. The invention aims to provide a space-time configuration-based multi-charging-pile-station electricity consumption prediction method, aiming at enhancing the accuracy of prediction of electricity consumption of each charging pile-station by building a space-time network model and building correlations among different charging pile-stations from a space angle, further introducing an example normalization strategy to improve future generalization of model prediction, and further enabling better prediction trend, further reasonably utilizing market electricity price and reducing charging cost of the charging pile-station.
assignees: THREE GORGES POWER CO LTD;CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Highway tunnel fire environment twin modeling method and system with data and knowledge cooperated
abstract_en: The invention discloses a highway tunnel fire environment twin modeling method and system with data and knowledge cooperated, belongs to the technical field of highway tunnel fire environment twin modeling, and solves the problems that fire disaster objects are low in identification precision and tunnel fire scenes cannot be modeled quickly in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a tunnel scene monitoring video; the system comprises an acquisition module, a disaster object multi-level multi-scale information acquisition module and a tunnel fire digital twin scene model establishment module. The method is used for accurately sensing the fire disaster condition of the tunnel and constructing the digital twin scene model of the tunnel fire disaster.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG

title_en: Scheduling control method, device and equipment of main distribution network and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a scheduling control method, a device, equipment and a storage medium of a main distribution network. The method comprises the following steps: determining a target main distribution network to be processed; determining a processing module corresponding to the target main distribution network in a decision processing system of the main distribution network according to a scheduling control target of the target main distribution network, wherein the processing module comprises an environment self-adaptive target prediction algorithm generated after the digital twin model of the power system is optimized; predicting a target main distribution network by using a target prediction algorithm in a processing module, and determining a plurality of decision information corresponding to scheduling control of a target main distribution network system; and determining target decision information corresponding to the target main distribution network system from the plurality of decision information. By adopting the method, the accuracy of the dispatching control of the main distribution network can be improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Short-term power load prediction method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a short-term power load prediction method and device, and belongs to the field of power load prediction. The method comprises the following steps: historical load data and historical observation data affecting the load are obtained from a digital twin power grid terminal; extracting load prediction features of historical load data and historical observation data by using a preset neural network model; correcting the load prediction characteristic according to the collection time of the historical load data and the historical observation data to obtain a load prediction time sequence characteristic; and obtaining a load prediction result based on the load prediction time sequence characteristic. According to the load prediction method and the load prediction device, the load prediction time sequence characteristics which can highlight the time sequence dependency relationship can be obtained by correcting the load prediction characteristics based on the collection time of the historical load data and the historical observation data, so that the load prediction result is more accurately obtained based on the load prediction time sequence characteristics.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE;STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;BEIJING CHINA POWER INF TECH;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Low-voltage distribution network impedance parameter identification method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system state estimation, in particular to a low-voltage distribution network impedance parameter identification method and system based on artificial intelligence, wherein the method comprises the following steps: according to the tree-shaped layered structure characteristics of the low-voltage power distribution network, an abstract topological structure of the low-voltage power distribution network is constructed; setting a branch parameter calculation pool according to the model and the length of a wire based on an abstract topological structure of the low-voltage power distribution network; determining an electric quantity distribution data pool of the low-voltage distribution network under a plurality of types of combinations through tide calculation; and constructing and generating an antagonistic neural network model, training by using the topological parameters and an electric quantity distribution data pool of the low-voltage power distribution network, forming an input-output relationship between the node parameters and the branch parameters, and obtaining an impedance parameter identification result. The method for acquiring the branch impedance parameters of the power distribution network based on the limited measurement data of the nodes of the low-voltage power distribution network is beneficial to line loss analysis and fault location, and can effectively evaluate and correct the impedance parameters of the low-voltage power distribution network.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method for generating input data for a state estimation of a power grid, state estimation and control of a power grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for generating input data for a state estimation of a power grid (1), the power grid (1) having at least two medium-voltage nodes (MV2,..., MV4), and the input data comprising at least covariances and expected values of electrical power at the medium-voltage nodes (MV2,...,MV4), wherein a low-voltage network (LV2,..., LV4) comprising  Ν  households is connected to one of the medium-voltage nodes (MV2,..., MV4), and a low-voltage network (LV2,..., LV4) comprising  Ν  households is connected to the other of the medium-voltage nodes (MV2,..., MV4). The method is characterised in that at least one of the low-voltage networks (LV4) has a smart meter penetration rate lower than a defined threshold, the input data comprising at least one covariance between electrical powers aggregated at the medium voltage nodes (MV2,...,MV4), the covariance being determined by a provided covariance value Cov( Ν,Μ ) depending on the number of households  Ν,Μ  in the associated low-voltage networks. The invention also relates to: a method for state estimation of a power grid (1); a method for controlling a power grid (1) in an open-loop or closed-loop manner; and a computer program product.
assignees: SIEMENS AG

title_en: Data acquisition method and system based on dual-mode communication technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a data acquisition method and a system based on a dual-mode communication technology, which belong to the technical field of electric power, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting data of a power system, and setting a plurality of first time intervals and first classifications every day; counting the actual power data quantity and power data distribution of the first classification; calculating an abnormal data threshold value, and acquiring an abnormal data index according to the abnormal data threshold value; comparing the actual electric power data quantity with the due data quantity to obtain a missing data index; calculating the quality index of the data according to the abnormal data index and the missing data index; the system comprises a data acquisition and classification module, an abnormal data index acquisition module, a missing data index acquisition module and a sampling adjustment module, the accuracy and the quality of the data are accurately estimated through the method and the system, and the sampling frequency is adjusted according to an estimation result, so that the accuracy of data acquisition is improved.
assignees: BEIJING XINSHENG HENGRUI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based power distribution calculation power prediction method, system and medium
abstract_en: The application provides a power distribution calculation power prediction method, a system and a medium based on digital twinning, which relate to the technical field of power distribution prediction, wherein the method comprises the following steps: an initial digital twin power distribution model is constructed by collecting multidimensional power equipment information of a power distribution system, real-time operation data obtained through dynamic monitoring are preprocessed, target operation data are obtained, operation simulation is conducted through the data, simulation operation data are obtained, and simulation operation information is obtained through analysis to obtain a prediction result of power distribution calculation power. The method mainly solves the problems that the prior art is insufficient in instantaneity, and the state change of the power grid cannot be timely found and fed back, so that the prediction result is inaccurate. Real-time data is obtained by monitoring and collecting dynamic running states and removing anomalies, and then power distribution calculation power prediction is performed by simulating a digital twin power distribution model, so that more efficient and reliable energy prediction is realized.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Distribution network state estimation method and system based on event triggering mechanism and filter
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for estimating the state of a distribution network based on an event triggering mechanism and a filter, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring data measurement information in a distribution network, and updating the data measurement information by using an event trigger mechanism; describing the relation between the current time state and the next time state based on the updated data measurement information in combination with a pre-established linearized system equation; based on the relation between the current time state and the next time state, calculating the weighting gain of the hybrid filter by combining a pre-constructed filter model; calculating a state estimate using a hybrid filter based on the hybrid filter weighting gains; the filter model is established by constructing an H-infinity filter objective function and constraint conditions on the basis of a Kalman filter. The invention introduces an event triggering mechanism, effectively reduces unnecessary data transmission times under the condition of ensuring the accuracy of state estimation, improves the network communication efficiency, and does not cause the phenomenon of the odd-numbered items.
assignees: STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;NANJING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Large-scale power distribution network parallel optimization method based on digital twin space
abstract_en: The application provides a digital twin space-based large-scale power distribution network parallel optimization method, which relates to the technical field of edge calculation and comprises the following steps: obtaining power distribution network data assets of a target power distribution network, constructing and generating a power distribution network topological structure, performing specialized splitting, performing edge terminal configuration, pre-constructing a parallel optimization cloud end and communicating with an edge autonomous terminal set to obtain a plurality of twin load data, generating a plurality of load autonomous strategy sets, feeding back the load autonomous strategy sets to the parallel optimization cloud end, and finally performing parallel optimization on the power distribution network. The application can solve the problems that the prior art is difficult to effectively process huge data volume and complex power distribution network topological structure, and simultaneously lacks real-time sensing and quick response capability, so that the overall efficiency is low, and particularly the power distribution network optimization efficiency is seriously affected when the emergency is handled, and the operation efficiency, the power supply reliability and the expandability and flexibility of the system of the power distribution network are improved.

title_en: HGTB-based multi-time-scale power grid blocking prediction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid blocking prediction technology, in particular to a HGTB-based multi-time scale power grid blocking prediction method, which is based on data driving and combines a feature selection theory and a gradient lifting tree theory to realize real-time prediction of power grid blocking in a power system. Based on the gradient lifting tree theory and combined with the data processing method of the histogram box sealing, a power value prediction and multi-classification prediction method suitable for the power grid blocking problem is provided, and real-time prediction and online update of the power grid blocking are realized; the multi-time scale model joint prediction method aiming at the real-time prediction problem of power grid blockage improves the accuracy of prediction, and combines the feature selection method to improve the operation efficiency of the model. The method can exert the advantages of prediction models with different time scales, improves the prediction accuracy on the premise of keeping a longer prediction visual field, and is convenient for a power grid dispatching department to avoid blocking events through advanced planning and management.
assignees: CENTRAL CHINA BRANCH STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV WUHAN

title_en: Digital twin technology-based wind farm multisource data fusion and intelligent analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for fusion and intelligent analysis of multi-source data of a wind power plant based on a digital twin technology, which comprises the steps of collecting multi-source data, then cleaning and preprocessing the collected data, and processing missing values and abnormal values; then, a digital twin model of the wind power plant is constructed according to the actual running state and environmental factors of the wind power plant by utilizing a digital twin technology; the method is characterized in that each part of a fan model is subjected to fine modeling through fan drawing application modeling software, the model is used for equipment simulation in a digital twin scene of a wind power plant, and real-time monitoring of the fan and prediction of the generated energy and the running state of the wind power plant are realized through simulation equipment reflecting the running condition of the fan in an actual scene. The invention improves the reliability, efficiency and safety of the wind farm, reduces the maintenance cost, promotes the sustainable development of the wind power industry, and meets the aims of environmental protection and sustainable energy utilization.
assignees: STATE GRID JIBEI ZHANGJIAKOU SCENERY STORAGE AND TRANS NEW ENERGY CO LTD;BEIJING GUOYAO XINTIANDI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vision system for supporting big data of digital twin model of heating station
abstract_en: The invention provides a visual system for supporting big data of a digital twin model of a heating station, which provides effective big data support for realizing the digital twin model of a modern heating system by utilizing the thermal expansion and contraction characteristics of materials and an artificial intelligent visual algorithm; the temperature field of the heating system is acquired in a non-traditional data acquisition mode with low cost, high efficiency and high precision, so that digital twinning is formed to contribute to the operation and maintenance of the heating system, low-cost high-precision and high-efficiency dynamic real-time temperature field detection can be performed on equipment and environment of the heating system, and powerful support is provided for big data required by the heating system for building a digital twinning model.
assignees: XIAN THERMAL POWER RES INST CO;XIAN XIRE ENERGY SAVING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for predicting and correcting photovoltaic power generation power based on LSTM model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting and correcting photovoltaic power generation power based on an LSTM model, which relate to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation and comprise the steps of collecting multiple meteorological parameters and electrical parameters, and carrying out advanced pretreatment on the collected multiple parameters; introducing the weather parameters after the advanced pretreatment into an LSTM model to predict the photovoltaic power generation power; comparing the predicted value with actual operation data, and performing curve fitting and integration on the error by using a cubic spline interpolation method to evaluate the performance of the LSTM model; the LSTM model is subjected to autonomous learning and self iteration by combining with a daily updating mechanism of actual operation data; and carrying out photovoltaic power generation prediction by using the iterated LSTM model. According to the invention, the optimized LSTM model is utilized, so that missing data can be effectively supplemented under the condition that part of meteorological parameters are missing.
assignees: HUANENG JIANGSU COMPREHENSIVE ENERGY SERVICE CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Thermal power plant risk monitoring visualization realization method and equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a thermal power plant risk monitoring visualization realization method and equipment, which are used for acquiring a target thermal power plant monitoring data sequence, classifying risk events based on a target risk event detection algorithm, and finally detecting and obtaining a target risk event in the target thermal power plant monitoring data sequence according to a risk event attribute corresponding to each data item in the target thermal power plant monitoring data sequence contained in a target type detection character string so as to carry out digital twin visualization display. According to the risk event detection method, the risk event classification results obtained by extracting the risk derived carriers of each layer and carrying out the risk event detection according to the risk derived carriers extracted at the abstraction level and the risk event classification results obtained by carrying out the risk event detection based on the risk derived carriers extracted at the basic level and indicating the basic level of the risk index parameters can be combined, the target risk event in the target thermal power plant monitoring data sequence is determined, and the accuracy of the risk event detection is improved.
assignees: Huadian zibo thermoelectricity co ltd

title_en: Power grid load modeling analysis method based on knowledge graph and digital twin
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid load modeling, in particular to a power grid load modeling analysis method based on a knowledge graph and digital twinning. It comprises the following steps: s1, collecting historical power load data of different time periods in different days in a regional power grid, wherein the collected data comprise total power consumption, load peak values and load valley values; s2, preprocessing the acquired information, and filling corresponding data average values of the first two days and the second two days of the same moment of missing values in the data; s3, extracting the entity from the preprocessed data by using a knowledge graph technology. According to the power grid load modeling analysis method based on the knowledge graph and the digital twin, on one hand, the accuracy of load prediction can be improved by providing more comprehensive and detailed data through the knowledge graph and the digital twin technology, and on the other hand, the LSTM combination XGBoost prediction model is adopted, so that the power load prediction accuracy is improved, and compared with a single model, the power load prediction accuracy is greatly improved.
assignees: XINZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Short-circuit parameter library maintenance method and system based on short-circuit capacity real-time measurement technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-circuit parameter library maintenance method and a short-circuit parameter library maintenance system based on a short-circuit capacity real-time measurement technology, which relate to the technical field of short-circuit parameter library maintenance and comprise the steps of collecting power grid operation parameters and historical data; constructing a short circuit analysis model, judging the short circuit condition and updating the short circuit parameters to a short circuit parameter library in real time; predicting the short circuit risk of the power grid through the short circuit parameter library data and taking risk countermeasures; and (5) carrying out safety protection measures on the short-circuit parameter library and carrying out data backup regularly. According to the invention, the power grid short circuit type is analyzed by collecting the power grid operation parameters so as to construct the power grid short circuit analysis model, so that the real-time update and maintenance of the power grid short circuit parameter library are realized, the prediction algorithm is adopted to predict the future short circuit risk of the power grid, the safety and stability of the power grid are effectively improved, and the accuracy and the real-time performance of data are greatly improved.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Energy storage power station supervisory systems based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of energy storage power stations, in particular to an energy storage power station supervision system based on digital twinning. The utility model provides an energy storage power station supervisory systems based on digit twin, includes intelligent monitoring system and control system, control system includes three-dimensional visual control system and on-the-spot control module, intelligent monitoring system connects three-dimensional visual monitoring system and on-the-spot control module, on-the-spot control module with three-dimensional visual monitoring system connects. The intelligent safety system has the advantages of intelligence, high safety, high efficiency, quick response and convenience.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for improving power system state estimation robustness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for improving the robustness of power system state estimation, which relate to the technical field of power system state estimation and comprise the steps of obtaining a power grid model and measurement data, carrying out cluster analysis on the power grid measurement data by using self-organizing map SOM, and clustering the power grid measurement data into k clusters; calculating a center for each cluster; calculating the distance between each piece of measurement data of the power grid and the center of the measurement cluster by using an improved Sigmoid function, and adjusting a threshold delta according to the distance; initializing state estimation, and calculating weight according to a Huber loss function by using the obtained self-adaptive threshold delta; updating the state estimation and judging whether the convergence condition is satisfied. The invention can improve the state estimation robustness and estimation accuracy under the condition that a great amount of noise and abnormal values exist in measurement.
assignees: STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD;STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Library position dynamic recommendation method and device based on electric power storage digital twin
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power storage, and provides a method and a device for dynamically recommending library positions based on power storage digital twinning. The electric power warehouse digital twinning-based library position dynamic recommendation method comprises the steps of inquiring whether electric power materials to be warehoused exist belonging projects or not from an electric power material information database according to names and order numbers of the electric power materials to be warehoused, and determining corresponding flat warehouses and corresponding storage library areas in the flat warehouses; according to the determined flat warehouse and the corresponding storage warehouse area in the flat warehouse, a grid warehouse model of the corresponding flat warehouse is called; based on the grid type warehouse model of the flat type warehouse and the size of the electric power materials to be warehoused, in the corresponding storage warehouse area of the grid type warehouse model, the electric power materials to be warehoused are put by adopting an attempt putting algorithm, and storable warehouse positions are dynamically recommended.
assignees: STATE GRID INTELLIGENCE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based power grid componentization mapping method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based power grid componentization mapping method, which relates to the technical field of power grid components and is characterized in that the method comprises the following steps: obtaining damage information of a power grid component for power distribution of a residential building, analyzing, mapping and judging whether power distribution faults occur in the residential building of the digital twin power grid component; if the inside of the residential building has a power distribution fault, acquiring damage type information of a power grid component for power distribution of the residential building, basic information of residents in the residential building and influence information of residents in the residential building; judging the type of accessories required to be replaced by the power grid component according to the damage type information of the power grid component for the distribution of the residential building, and acquiring the type information of accessories carried by staff near the distribution fault in the residential building; the effect is that the staff changes in time the electric wire netting subassembly accessory of damage.
assignees: CHINA NAT INST STANDARDIZATION

title_en: Flood control four-pre-platform application system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin flood control four-pre-platform application system, which adopts a B/S mode, relies on a digital twin hydraulic intelligent center, builds a transverse fusion layer infrastructure, a data base plate, a model platform and a knowledge platform, and a standard guarantee system and a network letter safety guarantee system which longitudinally penetrate through the layers, determines a digital twin flood control four-pre-platform, and builds four-pre-scene application based on the digital twin flood control four-pre-platform, wherein the four-pre-scene application comprises a user layer, a portal layer, a service layer and a service layer. The invention can realize the precise forecast and early warning of flood disaster defense and intelligent scheduling decision.
assignees: NANJING ZHONGYU SMART WATER RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Construction scheme management method, system and computer product based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The application relates to a target construction scheme management method, system and computer product based on digital twinning. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring project information of a construction project in the electric power system, and acquiring a project model corresponding to the construction project according to the project information and a digital twin technology, wherein the project information comprises a plurality of project flows and processing time corresponding to each project flow; determining a target project flow constructed at the current moment based on the project model, acquiring target processing time corresponding to the target project flow, and determining construction efficiency of the target project flow according to the target processing time, wherein the target processing time comprises theoretical processing time and actual processing time; planning project flows of the construction projects according to the construction efficiency to obtain a target construction scheme, and managing the construction projects according to the target construction scheme. By adopting the method, the fine management can be realized, the management effect is improved, the actual state of the project can be obtained in real time, and the data instantaneity and the management efficiency are improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Improved non-invasive real-time carbon emission accounting method and device for electric power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an improved real-time carbon emission accounting method and device for a non-invasive power system. The method comprises the following steps: monitoring the power consumption of each device in the power system in real time by using a sensor and monitoring equipment; calculating the direct carbon emission of each device in the power system by using a pre-trained device running state estimation model based on the power consumption condition; calculating the real-time node electrical carbon emission intensity of each device in the power system in real time by adopting an improved carbon emission flow model; according to the node electric carbon emission intensity, calculating the indirect node electric carbon emission amount of each device in the electric power system; and integrating the direct carbon emission and the indirect node electric carbon emission of each device in the electric power system to determine the real-time total carbon emission of the electric power system.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Sewerage asset management method using digital twin based mixed reality
title_ko: 디지털트윈 기반 혼합현실을 이용한 하수도 자산관리 방법
abstract_en: Prior digital twin and virtual reality convergence technologies, including Patent No. 2366293, were developed primarily for simulation or remote management of factory facilities.
