abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid polymorphic cooperative platform and a construction method, which relate to the technical field of power informatization and digital twin, and specifically have the technical scheme that: s1, configuring a space database; wherein the spatial database comprises: a set of geographic information and a set of building information; s2, extracting a building information set based on a space database to generate a building model, and extracting a geographic information set based on the space database to generate a geographic model; s3, converting and integrating the digital power grid based on the building model and the geographic model; s4, carrying out light weight processing on the digital power grid, and carrying out rendering optimization based on the light weight processed digital power grid to obtain the power grid polymorphic cooperative platform. The problems that data among four states are difficult to communicate and the service coordination capability is insufficient are solved, and the requirements of grid polymorphic refinement and coordinated service application are met.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD INFORMATION & COMMUNICATION BRANCH

title_en: Classification error compensation-based medium-and-long-term optical power prediction method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a medium-long-term optical power prediction method and a system based on classification error compensation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting historical data related to optical power, and classifying and performing characteristic processing on the historical data; respectively constructing five error compensation models, and constructing a prediction model of the light power prediction basic value; on-line deployment, obtaining corresponding irradiation and weather data, and performing medium-and-long-term optical power prediction including error compensation; finally, according to the characteristics of each error compensation model and the data samples thereof, a periodic or condition-triggered online updating strategy is selected in a targeted manner, and model online updating is realized in a classified manner. Aiming at the medium-long term optical power prediction scene, compared with the traditional medium-long term prediction method, the method has the characteristics of strong pertinence of error compensation, high online updating efficiency and excellent power prediction precision.
assignees: NANJING GUODIAN NANZI VALMET AUTOMATION CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic information model modeling method and system for novel power distribution system
abstract_en: The invention provides a photovoltaic information model modeling method and system for a novel power distribution system. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: scanning a park label preset in a photovoltaic park to acquire digital twin data; generating a virtual park based on the digital twin data, performing primary damage judgment based on model morphology on a plurality of virtual photovoltaic panels, determining all the virtual photovoltaic panels with morphological damage sub-attributes as a set to be repaired, and determining all the virtual photovoltaic panels with morphological normal sub-attributes as a set to be determined; performing secondary damage judgment based on circuit transmission on the real photovoltaic panels corresponding to the virtual photovoltaic panels respectively, and dividing the real photovoltaic panels into a set to be repaired based on a judgment result; and carrying out multi-dimensional display modification on the virtual photovoltaic panels in the set to be repaired, and carrying out model cutting on other virtual photovoltaic panels except for the multi-dimensional display modification. The invention at least improves the working efficiency.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD YUYAO POWER SUPPLY COMPANY;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NINGBO POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Power supply service command rush repair resource scheduling method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a power supply service command rush repair resource scheduling method, a system, equipment and a medium, belonging to the technical field of power rush repair, wherein the method comprises the following steps: according to various basic data of power supply service command rush repair of at least one rush repair area with faults, a digital twin model of the at least one rush repair area is obtained; determining a first-aid repair area with the maximum user load importance weight value as a target first-aid repair area; obtaining weight values of each resource scheduling scheme; obtaining a combination scheme of each resource scheduling scheme according to the weight value, the rush repair time and the rush repair time limit constraint function of each resource scheduling scheme; and carrying out rush-repair resource scheduling on the target rush-repair area. By constructing an automatic resource scheduling decision scheme, intelligent tool support is provided for a decision maker, so that the accuracy of the resource scheduling decision scheme, the efficiency of power rush-repair work and the power supply service quality of a power supply department and the satisfaction of power consumers can be improved.
assignees: STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for cleaning monitoring data of pumped storage power station
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for cleaning monitoring data of a pumped storage power station, which comprises the steps of selecting missing data to be predicted from all missing data in the monitoring data of the pumped storage power station; after the monitoring data, a prediction model and a plurality of prediction algorithms are utilized to predict the missing data to be predicted, calculating a prediction precision value of each prediction algorithm, wherein the prediction model is a trained long-period and short-period memory recurrent neural network; and supplementing all missing data in the monitoring data of the water energy storage power station by using the prediction algorithm with the highest precision value. The invention realizes the optimized cleaning method under the condition of greatly reducing the computing resources and improves the data cleaning efficiency. The invention also relates to a device and a storage medium.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;CONSTRUCTION COMPANY OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Intelligent operation control platform and control method for circulating cooling water
abstract_en: The invention provides a circulating cooling water intelligent operation control platform and a control method, and belongs to the technical field of circulating cooling water operation control. The intelligent operation control platform for the circulating cooling water is deployed in a circulating cooling water system and comprises a digital twin system and an operation data lake; the operation data lake is used for storing historical operation data of the circulating cooling water system; the digital twin system is used for: constructing a digital twin model based on application demand parameters of the circulating cooling water system; verifying and optimizing the digital twin model based on historical operation data of the circulating cooling water system; and inputting real-time operation data of the circulating cooling water system into the optimized digital twin model to obtain and execute an optimized regulation scheme of the circulating cooling water system. Realize the purpose of circulation cooling water system wisdom operation management and control. And further realizing the real-time linkage, operation and control of the operation and production real-time data of the circulating cooling water system of the coal-fired power plant, and solving the problem of low intelligent level of the conventional circulating cooling water system.
assignees: GUODIAN ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION RES INST CO LTD;CHN ENERGY SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Modeling quality detection method and device for digital twin model of power transformation engineering, computer equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a modeling quality detection method, device and equipment for a digital twin model of a power transformation project and a readable storage medium, relates to the technical field of digital twin, and can improve the accuracy of a modeling quality detection result of the digital twin model of the power transformation project. The method comprises the following steps: determining a qualitative detection result; determining a plurality of first quantitative detection elements for detecting engineering geographic information quality of a power transformation engineering digital twin model per se and a first quantitative detection result; determining a plurality of second quantitative detection elements and second quantitative detection results for detecting the modeling quality of a three-dimensional model of the electrical equipment in the digital twin model of the power transformation project; determining a third quantitative detection element and a third quantitative detection result for detecting the parameter relevance of the digital twin model of the power transformation project; obtaining quantitative detection results according to the first quantitative detection result, the second quantitative detection result and the third quantitative detection result; and determining a modeling quality detection result according to the qualitative detection result and the quantitative detection result.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID ENERGY DEVELOPMENT RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin micro-grid fault diagnosis system
abstract_en: The application discloses a digital twin micro-grid fault diagnosis system, relates to the technical field of micro-grid fault diagnosis, and solves the technical problems that in the existing grid diagnosis system, the real-time performance of a digital twin model is low, and further the diagnosis result is inconsistent with the actual situation, and the accuracy is low; comprising the following steps: model construction module: constructing a digital twin model of the micro-grid according to the basic data of the micro-grid; the central processing module: inputting the environmental data and the operation data into a micro-grid digital twin model to obtain analog power data; generating a bias value based on the historical data; generating a bias threshold based on the bias value and the environmental data; generating a fault warning signal based on the power data, the simulated power data, and the deviation threshold; generating expansion data according to the power data and the environment data; correcting the digital twin model of the micro-grid according to the expansion data; the output of the micro-grid digital twin model is smaller than the output gap of actual equipment, and the detection accuracy is further improved.
assignees: HEFEI YUANLI ZHONGHE ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Distributed photovoltaic power missing data restoration method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a distributed photovoltaic power missing data repairing method and device, comprising the following steps: extracting cloud cover features of a target distributed photovoltaic based on satellite remote sensing data, and dividing weather types of the cloud cover features to obtain a preset number of weather types; aiming at the photovoltaic power generation power data of the target distributed photovoltaic under each weather type, obtaining a low-rank tensor decomposition optimization model according to a graph regularization term and a low-rank tensor optimization function; and solving the low-rank tensor decomposition optimization model to obtain a photovoltaic power generation power reconstruction tensor, and judging and repairing power abnormal data according to the photovoltaic power generation power reconstruction tensor. According to the invention, the low-rank tensor decomposition modeling method is utilized to carry out refined low-rank tensor decomposition modeling on different weather types, and the obtained solving result of the low-rank tensor decomposition optimization model can be used for carrying out power abnormal data identification and restoration, so that compared with the prior art, the robustness is higher and the expansibility is better.
assignees: INFORMATION COMMUNICATION COMPANY STATE GRID SHAANXI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Workload determination method, workload determination device, workload determination computer device, workload determination program product, and workload determination program for digital twin model of power transformation project
abstract_en: The application relates to a workload determination method, a workload determination device, a workload determination computer readable storage medium and a workload determination computer program product for a digital twin model of a power transformation project, which relate to the technical field of digital twin and can accurately and finely determine the total workload consumed in the process of obtaining the digital twin model of the power transformation project. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining respective model parameters of a plurality of sub-models in a digital twin model of the power transformation project; determining the model complexity of the digital twin model of the power transformation project according to parameter association information among a plurality of model parameters; determining a first workload corresponding to a modeling link in a model acquisition flow corresponding to the digital twin model of the power transformation project, and determining a second workload corresponding to a non-modeling link in the model acquisition flow corresponding to the digital twin model of the power transformation project; and determining the working total amount information of the digital twin model of the power transformation engineering according to the model complexity, the first workload and the second workload.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID ENERGY DEVELOPMENT RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Space visualization electric power energy management optimization method
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a space visualization power energy management optimization method, which relates to the technical field of power energy management, and comprises the following steps: acquiring target power distribution information; constructing a target digital twin model; acquiring a first power device and a second power device; dynamically monitoring the first power line to obtain a first circuit characteristic parameter; obtaining a first running state parameter and a second running state parameter; analyzing the first circuit characteristic parameter, the first running state parameter and the second running state parameter to obtain a target energy utilization rate; if the preset utilization rate threshold is not reached, line equipment regulation and control optimization is carried out, and the technical problems that in the prior art, the accuracy and the efficiency of power energy management are low due to the fact that the space visual power energy management degree is low can be solved, the goal of improving the space visual power energy management degree is achieved, and the technical effects of improving the accuracy and the efficiency of power energy management are achieved.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic power station operation and maintenance method and system combining three-dimensional mapping and digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention provides a photovoltaic power station operation and maintenance method and system combining three-dimensional mapping and digital twinning, which relate to the technical field of light Fu Yun dimensions and comprise the following steps: acquiring data of a photovoltaic power station through an unmanned aerial vehicle, acquiring high-precision image data and high-density point cloud data, generating multi-source heterogeneous data, performing space-time synchronization, extracting features of the high-precision image data, determining the position of power station equipment, extracting topological features of the high-density point cloud data, automatically classifying, and fusing to generate a power station live-action model; constructing a full-element information model of the photovoltaic power station, fusing a real model of the power station, generating an initial digital twin model, and constructing a panoramic simulation environment of the photovoltaic power station to obtain the digital twin model of the photovoltaic power station; constructing multi-granularity state evaluation indexes, quantitatively evaluating the photovoltaic power station, generating a power station health state report, generating a routing inspection route for an abnormal area and abnormal equipment, performing remote diagnosis, performing semantic reasoning and causal analysis, and generating an operation and maintenance operation plan.
assignees: YUNNAN DIANNENG SMART ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Construction method of wind power plant digital twin system considering parallel control
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method of a digital twin system of a wind farm considering parallel control, belonging to the technical field of wind power generation, comprising the following steps: a 5D modeling method is adopted to construct a wind power plant digital twin system comprising a physical wind power plant, a virtual wind power plant, a data center, service and parallel control for the wind power plant; collecting data and information for constructing a digital twin system of the wind power plant from the physical wind power plant; constructing a virtual wind power plant comprising a virtual scene of the wind power plant and an artificial system model; the data center is utilized to eliminate information islands, so that closed-loop interaction of the digital and virtual space is realized; the data generated by the physical wind power plant and the wind power plant digital twin system are deeply mined and extracted by features, so that the services such as state monitoring, fault early warning, man-machine interaction, wind power prediction and the like are realized; based on the ACP theory, the operation state of the physical wind power plant is simulated and managed through a parallel control technology, and management is optimized. The intelligent operation and maintenance of the wind power plant can be realized.
assignees: UNIV YANSHAN

title_en: Icing scene-oriented power transmission corridor digital twin construction method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for constructing a digital twin of a power transmission corridor oriented to an icing scene, which relate to the field of power transmission corridors, and comprise the following steps: constructing a digital twin body of a power transmission corridor of the power transmission corridor; acquiring real-time icing monitoring data of a power transmission corridor; processing the real-time icing monitoring data of the power transmission corridor based on a quasi-real-time data aggregation method to obtain processed data; inputting the processed data into a multi-mode data driving model for icing identification and prediction to obtain real-time icing state characteristic indexes; mapping the real-time icing state characteristic index to a digital twin body of a power transmission corridor to perform icing geometric expression and icing physical expression; based on the integrated icing geometric expression and the icing physical expression, the three-dimensional display, icing early warning and insulator electric field analysis are carried out on the digital twin bodies of the power transmission corridor, and the intelligent, efficient and real-time icing monitoring of the power transmission corridor is realized, the safety and reliability of a power transmission system are improved, and the stable operation of the power transmission corridor is ensured.
assignees: YANGTZE RIVER DELTA RES INSTITUTE UESTC HUZHOU;UNIV ELECTRONIC SCI & TECH CHINA

title_en: Full-flow management system for electric power intelligent engineering project
abstract_en: The invention relates to a full-flow management system of an electric power intelligent engineering project, which comprises a project setting module, a database, a progress management module, a cost management module, a contract management module, a purchase management module and a report and data display module; through the highly integrated modular design, the comprehensive control and management of the project are realized, the real-time updating, transparency and accuracy of data are ensured in the whole process from project stand to final completion, and through an intelligent algorithm and a data analysis model, the system not only can improve the efficiency of project management, but also can effectively predict and avoid risks.
assignees: GREAT POWER SCIENCE AND TECH STOCK CO LTD STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CORPORATION

title_en: System and method for constructing electricity-retaining service under different scenes based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of electricity protection, and provides a system and a method for constructing electricity protection service under different scenes based on digital twinning, wherein the system comprises the steps of obtaining equipment structure data, venue structure data, equipment operation data, performance indexes and abnormal state data of electricity protection equipment, and creating a user digital twinning model by utilizing the digital twinning data; acquiring real-time operation data of the power equipment in different scenes, and analyzing fault early warning by using the constructed digital twin model of the user; generating electricity-keeping service under the corresponding scene according to the result of analyzing the fault early warning, and carrying out electricity-keeping maintenance by utilizing the generated electricity-keeping service; the invention adopts a digital means to fuse data of entity objects (equipment, vehicles, personnel and intelligent equipment), entity relations (space and time sequence) and business rules, and forms a new base platform which can be restored, analyzed and interacted.
assignees: JINING POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Photovoltaic power linear element extraction method based on density and time distribution
abstract_en: The invention relates to a photovoltaic power linear element extraction method based on density and time distribution, in particular to the field of photovoltaic monitoring optimization, an intelligent inverter full coverage photovoltaic system is deployed to acquire photovoltaic power data, the power generation condition of the system is helped to be monitored, a more comprehensive data analysis view angle is provided, preprocessing is carried out on each photovoltaic power data and a corresponding time stamp thereof, the influence of analysis results due to missing data is avoided, the data quality and analysis accuracy are improved, a density clustering algorithm is utilized to carry out clustering analysis on the photovoltaic power data, photovoltaic power linear features are extracted according to density clustering and time stamp linear results, a ridge regression model is established based on the extracted photovoltaic power linear features, linear elements of photovoltaic power are predicted through ridge regression model regression coefficients and a test set, the problem that model parameter estimation is unstable and even overfitting is caused by various co-linear features is solved, and the complexity of the model is effectively reduced.
assignees: BEIJING JIUTIAN METEOROLOGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin control and prediction coupling method for nuclear power plant
abstract_en: A digital twin control and prediction coupling method of a nuclear power plant is characterized in that an operation data set based on sensor measurement values in the abnormal working condition transition process and a control operation data set based on system protection measures during abnormal operation of the nuclear power plant are constructed in an off-line stage, the two data sets are simultaneously input into a neural network for training, a time sequence prediction model aiming at the abnormal working condition nuclear power plant operation data is obtained, and real-time working condition data judgment is carried out in an on-line stage through the trained time sequence prediction model. According to the invention, based on actual reactor control requirements, mathematical quantization is performed on control operation measures under abnormal working conditions, the embodiment of human-computer fusion in a prediction model is considered, and accurate prediction of operation data can be realized under the condition that the prediction time is sufficiently advanced.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: Rapid construction method and system of intelligent water conservancy digital twin model applied to reservoir
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of digital twinning, and discloses a rapid construction method and a rapid construction system of an intelligent water conservancy digital twinning model applied to a reservoir. The method constructs a flood control drought resistance knowledge graph library; based on the constructed flood control drought resistance knowledge map library, utilizing knowledge retrieval and reasoning algorithm to perform history similar flood analysis, comprehensive intelligent early warning judgment, intelligent recommendation of a scheduling scheme and intelligent generation of a scheme, and providing intelligent support for four pre-processes of flood control and drought resistance; and constructing a flood control drought resistance four-pre-intelligent support platform by utilizing the historical similar flood analysis, the early warning comprehensive intelligent discrimination, the intelligent recommendation of the scheduling scheme and the intelligent generation result of the planning scheme. The invention analyzes the flood control drought resistance four pre-intelligent support platform based on the knowledge graph, and provides water conservancy knowledge, reasoning algorithm and intelligent capability support for water conservancy business application.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG;PEARL RIVER HYDRAULIC RES INST PEARL RIVER WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION

title_en: Self-adaptive federal learning method of intelligent power grid for digital twin driving
abstract_en: A self-adaptive federal learning method of a smart grid for digital twin driving belongs to the field of smart grids, and comprises the following steps: constructing a smart grid system, and introducing a two-layer privacy computing architecture into the smart grid system, wherein the smart grid system consists of a power equipment layer and a digital twin layer; designing a universal digital twin scheme of the intelligent power grid system; block chain asynchronous federation learning workflow; outdated local model problem definition, design of adaptive aggregation factors, committee leader election in smart grid systems: and measuring the contribution degree of Station to the training task, and randomly electing the committee leader by using a weight according to the obtained contribution degree. The invention combines the digital twin technology, the federal learning technology and the blockchain technology, improves the instantaneity, the response capability, the learning efficiency, the accuracy, the safety and the reliability of the intelligent power grid system, and provides a brand new solution for the aspects of fault analysis, operation decision and the like of the intelligent power grid system.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING POSTS & TELECOMM

title_en: Solar power generation power prediction method based on bidirectional time convolution fusion multi-head attention and twin correction mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a solar power generation power prediction method based on a bidirectional time convolution fusion multi-head attention and twin correction mechanism, and relates to the technical field of solar power generation. Collecting historical power data of the solar power generation module, complementing the missing value, performing feature selection, and processing the selected data by using a bidirectional sliding window to obtain a forward sequence and a reverse sequence; introducing a multi-head attention mechanism to a bidirectional time convolution neural network to construct an MHA-BiTCN model; inputting the forward sequence and the reverse sequence into an MHA-BiTCN model, fusing the extracted bidirectional features through the MHA-BiTCN model to obtain the features with the reinforced generating power time sequence information, and performing primary power prediction; and sending the preliminary predicted power into a digital twin structure, and dynamically correcting by using real-time twin data to obtain a final predicted result. The invention can capture the forward and reverse time sequence information at the same time, avoid the problems of sequential accumulation calculation and long-distance feature forgetting, and improve the accuracy and timeliness of prediction.
assignees: UNIV KUNMING SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Programming generation method of digital twin city base of large city distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large city distribution network digital twin city base programming generation method, which comprises the following steps of: urban data acquisition,  GIS  software data processing, data structure conversion, configuration of a building model asset library and urban building generation of a digital twin system; according to the invention, through preset parameters and rules, the automatic and programmed generation of the urban base model is realized, so that modeling work is not limited by traditional manual operation, large-scale, complex and changeable distribution network requirements can be easily met, and modeling efficiency and scale are greatly improved; by constructing the parameterized model library, the model assembly can abstract and generalize the types and the characteristics of urban buildings to form reusable model assemblies, so that repeated labor is reduced, the working efficiency is improved, and meanwhile, the reusability improvement also means that the consistency and the accuracy of the models are better ensured when different urban base models are constructed.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent power plant digital twin system based on 5G
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the technical field of computers, in particular to a 5G-based intelligent power plant digital twin system. The system comprises: the power plant safety two areas are used for determining the to-be-tested unit equipment and a corresponding measuring point set of the to-be-tested unit equipment, measuring point data of any measuring point in the measuring point set, and sending the measuring point data to the data fusion safety area; the data fusion safety area is used for storing the measuring point data and transmitting the measuring point data to the digital twin equipment operation monitoring system through the 5G private network; the digital twin equipment operation monitoring system is used for constructing a digital mechanism model corresponding to the unit equipment to be tested according to the measurement point data and monitoring the operation state of the unit equipment to be tested based on the digital mechanism model. The method and the device can improve the fine management capability, management efficiency and economic benefit of the power plant.
assignees: SPIC JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE POWER INVEST CORPORATION GCL BINHAI POWER GENERATION CO LTD;STATE POWER INVESTMENT CORPORATION SCIENCE & TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based well coal mining mine gas disaster monitoring deduction system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based system for monitoring and deducting gas disasters of coal mining ores of wells, which relates to the technical field of intelligent monitoring and solves the problems of insufficient disaster monitoring capability and low disaster prevention and control capability caused by complex gas components in the coal mines; the disaster monitoring deduction system comprises an acquisition module, a processing module, a monitoring module, a management module and a cooperation module; the collected real-time data is subjected to deep cleaning by a specially designed data preprocessing method, so that a disaster monitoring twin model is subjected to data feature extraction and model updating iteration; the obstacle and various gases in the coal mine are virtually modeled and predicted through the disaster monitoring twin model, so that the disaster monitoring efficiency in the coal mine is greatly improved, the disaster prevention and control capability is improved, and the life safety of operators is ensured.
assignees: HENAN BOSEAN ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: System for operating and managing water supply network
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 기반의 상수관망 관제시스템
abstract_en: Provided is a system for controlling a water pipe network, which comprises: a pipe line information collection unit (100) collecting pipe network map information of a water supply to form a map and selecting an analysis ranking of a pipe line; a pipe line facility management unit (200) grasping a water flow rate and a pipe line state of the pipe line in real time through a sensor and a detection module as a medium; a database unit (300) receiving information from the pipe line information collection unit and the pipe line facility management unit to construct artificial intelligence-based big data; a simulation unit (400) predicting the water flow rate and water leakage state of the pipe line through AI analysis and visualizing the information; and an integrated control platform (500) constructed based on a digital twin and receiving information from the database unit and the AI analysis unit to smartly propose a water flow rate control of the pipe line and a facility of the pipe line in which water leakage has occurred. According to the present invention, the state of the underground water pipe network and the pipeline buried in the area is provided and guided in a visualized form, thereby intuitively grasping various problems of the pipeline, and quickly and accurately coping with the problems occurring in the pipeline, thereby maximizing the speed and efficiency of the pipeline facility.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 상수관망 데이터를 수집하고, 인공지능 상수관망 관제 기술력을 바탕으로 디지털 트윈 기반의 상수관망 운용시뮬레이터를 구축함으로써 상수관망의 문제 발생을 효과적으로 예측할 수 있으며, 나아가 인공지능 기반의 시나리오형 모의실험을 통해 상황 발생에 대한 최적의 해결방안을 제시하는 등 기존과 차별화된 구조로부터 비롯되는 취급과 사용, 유지 및 관리 보수의 용이함 등으로 인해 사용의 편의성 내지 효율성이 극대화 유도되는 디지털 트윈 기반의 상수관망 관제시스템에 관한 것으로, 상수도의 관망도 정보를 수집하여 맵(map)을 형성하고, 소구역 관로와 중구역 관로의 누수율을 비교한 후 비교값을 기반으로 관로의 분석 순위를 선정하는 관로정보 수집부(100);와, 센서와 탐지 모듈을 매개로 관로의 유수율과 배관 상태를 실시간 파악하는 관로 설비관리부(200);와, 상수관망과 관련된 표준데이터를 수집하고, 관로정보 수집부와 관로 설비관리부로부터 정보를 제공받아 인공지능 기반의 빅데이터를 구축하는 데이터베이스부(300);와, AI 분석을 통해 관로의 유수율과 누수 상태를 예측하고, 해당 정보를 시각화 처리하는 시뮬레이션부(400);와, 디지털 트윈 기반으로 구축되며 데이터베이스부와 AI 분석부의 정보를 인계받아 관로의 유수율 제어와 누수가 발생한 관로의 설비를 스마트하게 제안하는 통합 관제플랫폼(500);으로 구성된다.
assignees: EROUMTECH CO LTD

title_en: Online dynamic equivalent modeling method and system suitable for large-scale wind field
abstract_en: The invention discloses an online dynamic equivalent modeling method and system suitable for a large-scale wind field, which relate to the technical field of modeling of electric power systems and comprise the steps of establishing a single-machine equivalent model of a doubly-fed wind field; establishing a single-machine equivalent model of a direct-drive wind field; on-line dynamic equivalent modeling is performed based on self-learning Xi Rongji Kalman filtering. The online dynamic equivalent modeling method suitable for the large-scale wind field improves the accuracy and the practicability of the model, adopts an improved Levenberg-Marquardt method to correct the accuracy of the traditional Kalman filtering state estimation, ensures the reliability and the stability of the model in actual operation, enhances the generalization capability and the accuracy of the model by updating the observation model of the wind field equivalent model through the BP neural network based on the whale algorithm, ensures the reliability and the accuracy of online dynamic modeling, and improves the modeling efficiency and the accuracy by applying the generalized self-learning volume Kalman filtering algorithm.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Tensor-based incomplete data filling method
abstract_en: The application discloses a tensor-based incomplete data filling method, relates to the technical field of data recovery, and aims at solving the problem that the existing method cannot accurately recover missing power data. Then, the application marks the missing value of tensor data through a tensor nucleation CANDECOMP/PARAFAC (TKCP) factor decomposition method, extracts the prior knowledge of the characteristic correlation under each mode, extracts the nonlinear representation through the implicitly defined kernel space, can fully capture the multipath nonlinear structure of the tensor data under the condition of incomplete data, adopts multipath nonlinear feature mapping, and aims to obtain the dual structure retention kernel of the tensor product feature space, thereby obtaining the decomposed data. Finally, LSTM and ANFIS are combined to recover the missing data in the power system. The technical scheme of the application can accurately recover the missing power data.
assignees: UNIV HEILONGJIANG

title_en: Power distribution network optimization method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network optimization method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a virtual power plant corresponding to a power distribution network based on multi-mode data of the running state of the power distribution network, wherein the virtual power plant comprises a digital twin virtual body corresponding to power distribution equipment in the power distribution network; initializing the virtual power plant based on the current parameter value of the power distribution equipment in the power distribution network to obtain an initialized virtual power plant; based on the initialized virtual power plant to perform state prediction and digital twin virtual body parameter optimization, determining an optimized target parameter value; and carrying out parameter optimization on distribution equipment in the distribution network based on the target parameter value. By the technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention, the comprehensive and careful optimization of the power distribution network is realized, and the running of the power distribution network is ensured to be more economic, efficient and environment-friendly.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;SHAOGUAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Internet of things-based power grid engineering project material management method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for managing materials of a power grid engineering project based on the Internet of things, which relate to the technical field of digital twin, and comprise the steps of collecting equipment operation parameters and mechanical state data in real time and preprocessing, identifying an abnormal working mode of the equipment by utilizing a neural network algorithm, constructing a digital twin model, according to the real-time data and the historical data, the running trend of the equipment is analyzed, the probability of occurrence of future faults is predicted, the material demand is analyzed according to the current stock level and the real-time information of a supply chain, a material allocation strategy is intelligently formulated, the abnormality identification precision is improved, the prediction accuracy is improved, the downtime is reduced, the resource allocation is optimized, and the efficient and stable running of the equipment is ensured.
assignees: GUIGANG POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GRID COMPANY OF GUANGXI

title_en: Power dispatching optimization method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power dispatching optimization method and system based on digital twinning, and relates to the technical field of intelligent power grid management. The method comprises the following steps: determining a target power generation system and constructing a target power utilization network; carrying out load identification on the electronic network to obtain a plurality of load summarizers; carrying out digital twin modeling on a target power generation system to obtain a power generation system twin model; a plurality of customized electricity analysis channels are pre-constructed and respectively deployed on a plurality of corresponding load interfaces for prediction, so that a plurality of sub-network electricity requirements are obtained; a power generation analysis channel is pre-constructed and deployed in a twin model of a power generation system to predict the power supply quantity, acquiring power supply prediction information; setting a supply and demand deviation, and obtaining an optimized power scheduling scheme; power scheduling is implemented based on an optimized power scheduling scheme. The invention solves the technical problems of poor accuracy, efficiency and reliability of power dispatching optimization caused by inaccurate and high-efficiency real-time load acquisition and power supply quantity prediction in the existing power dispatching.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based real-time rendering method for water resource allocation engineering simulation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of real-time rendering, in particular to a digital twin-based water resource allocation engineering simulation real-time rendering method, which comprises the following steps of collecting current load capacity data, network state data and user equipment performance data of all rendering nodes through real-time network monitoring based on a digital twin platform, summarizing the data, executing real-time load analysis according to summarized data, determining resource allocation requirements of all nodes, and generating a load prediction analysis result. In the invention, the real-time monitoring and analysis are carried out on the load capacity, the network state and the user equipment performance of all rendering nodes, so that the resource allocation is allowed to be adjusted in real time, the resource and the demand are more accurately matched, the resource waste is avoided, the rendering efficiency is improved, the rendering objects are adjusted one by collecting the viewpoint movement and interaction behavior data of the user, the individuation and high quality of the rendering output are ensured, and higher practicability is brought to the water resource allocation engineering simulation.

title_en: Hydraulic engineering management and control system and method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic engineering management and control system and method based on digital twin, which relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering, wherein the system constructs a water flow prediction formula, a water flow gathering position prediction formula and a device compression resistance evaluation formula through a prediction analysis module, and calculating and acquiring the water flow Q (t) of the monitored river, the water flow gathering height P (t) and the actual compression resistance index C (t) of the water conservancy equipment in real time. The comprehensive calculation analysis module calculates a first evaluation index Re (T), compares and evaluates the first evaluation index Re (T) with a preset first reliability threshold T1, and primarily analyzes the reliability of the water conservancy equipment under the flood condition. If the equipment is unreliable under the flood condition, the abnormal early warning module further calculates by combining the environmental factors to obtain a second evaluation index Re2 (T), compares and evaluates the second evaluation index Re2 (T) with a second reliability threshold T2, generates corresponding early warning grades, provides more detailed reliability evaluation, and ensures the safety of the water conservancy equipment under the influence of various environmental factors.

title_en: Digital twin data tracing method based on block chain
abstract_en: The application discloses a digital twin data tracing method based on a block chain, which belongs to the field of information processing and management systems, wherein the method comprises the following steps: sensing and collecting monitoring information of a plurality of power grid positions in a power grid, uploading the monitoring information into a twin block chain through power grid nodes of the plurality of power grid positions, and analyzing the matching degree; based on digital twinning, respectively adopting a plurality of monitoring information to construct a plurality of twinning power grid models; carrying out local power grid stability analysis and overall power grid stability analysis on the multiple twin model blocks, identifying the multiple twin model blocks, and adding the multiple twin model blocks into a twin data block chain; when faults occur, the fault position, the local fault scale and the overall fault scale are obtained, tracing is carried out in the twin data block chain, a tracing twin power grid model set is obtained, and the tracing twin power grid model set is used as a tracing result to carry out power grid fault investigation. The application solves the technical problems of the prior art that the accuracy of the power grid monitoring data and the efficiency of fault tracing are low, thereby causing the increase of the difficulty of power grid maintenance and management.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Cloud-edge-collaboration-based power grid digital twin modeling method and platform
abstract_en: The invention provides a cloud edge cooperation-based power grid digital twin modeling method and a platform, which relate to the technical field of digital processing and comprise the following steps: the integrated distributed sensor network is in communication connection with a plurality of real-time monitoring units, and monitoring indexes comprise current, voltage and temperature; an edge computing server is deployed to upload real-time monitoring data and perform rapid fault location; the method comprises the steps of interacting an edge calculation server with a cloud processor, dynamically adjusting a scheduling strategy, and constructing a digital twin model of a power grid; performing local marking to establish a plurality of local update spaces; matching a plurality of independent update periods and priority mechanisms, and adaptively triggering a plurality of local update requests; and performing self-learning iteration reinforcement in the operation process to assist in operation and maintenance management of the target power grid. The invention solves the technical problems of resource waste and unstable system caused by the lack of an intelligent means because the power grid dispatching strategy in the prior art is difficult to adapt to dynamic change in power grid operation.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based power grid equipment state monitoring method
abstract_en: The application provides a power grid equipment state monitoring method based on digital twinning, which relates to the technical field of equipment state monitoring and comprises the following steps: acquiring real-time operation data of power grid equipment; constructing an initial digital twin model, and fusing the initial digital twin model to obtain an updated digital twin model; acquiring health parameter data, analyzing the influence of health monitoring, and establishing an influence adaptability model; performing influence analysis on the health abnormal data and the service life of the equipment to generate health influence coefficients; performing presence evaluation of power grid equipment to generate a health evaluation coefficient; and performing verification evaluation on the power grid equipment to generate a power grid equipment state monitoring result. According to the method and the device for monitoring the health state of the power grid equipment, the technical problems that the monitoring efficiency of the power grid equipment is low and the accuracy of the health prediction is poor due to the fact that the health state of the power grid equipment is not monitored in real time in the prior art can be solved, the technical aim of monitoring the health state of the power grid in real time is achieved, and the technical effects of improving the monitoring efficiency and the accuracy of the health state prediction are achieved.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Water conservancy informatization management method and management system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a water conservancy informatization management method and system based on a digital twin technology, comprising the following steps: acquiring multisource data of a water conservancy infrastructure and an environment of the water conservancy infrastructure; integrating and inputting the multi-source data into a digital twin system to generate a real-time dynamic water conservancy infrastructure digital model; the high-precision geographic information system is combined with the digital twin technology to monitor and analyze the real-time state of the water conservancy infrastructure; based on an artificial intelligence algorithm, carrying out predictive analysis on data in the digital twin model, and identifying potential risks and optimizing management strategies; and automatically adjusting the water resource allocation and the running state of facilities according to the real-time data and the prediction result through the intelligent scheduling system. The invention obviously improves the intelligent and automatic level of water resource management, ensures the safe operation of water conservancy facilities, solves the key problems in the prior art, and provides powerful technical support for water conservancy informatization management.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHISHUI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic power station operation and maintenance method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy, and discloses a photovoltaic power station operation and maintenance method and device, comprising the following steps: establishing a simulation database under different operation conditions; constructing an online monitoring database based on historical data of operation parameters of the photovoltaic power station; according to the simulation database and the online monitoring database, a training library is obtained, and characteristics of different operation conditions in the training library are extracted to obtain an operation and maintenance training model diagnosis library; and the on-line data is analyzed by utilizing an operation and maintenance training model diagnosis library, so that the fault diagnosis, early warning and life prediction of the photovoltaic power station are realized, a foundation is laid for multi-scale and multi-field fusion of simulation technology, and the data requirement in the subsequent construction of a digital twin system is met.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CORP;CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based power distribution network fault monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network fault monitoring system and method based on digital twinning, comprising a data acquisition module, a digital model construction module, a fault detection module and a strategy output module; the digital model construction module comprises a first digital model construction module and a second digital model construction module; the fault detection module is used for predicting and alarming the power grid faults according to the digital model and an intelligent algorithm; and the strategy output module is used for outputting a fault processing scheme according to the power grid digital twin model and the electromechanical information model and carrying out maintenance dispatch by combining a fault priority judgment result. Based on the power grid digital twin model and the electromechanical information model, the invention performs double verification on fault information, improves fault detection precision, outputs an accurate fault processing scheme and adjusts dispatch priority, rapidly processes faults, and realizes the safety and stability of power grid operation.
assignees: GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Substation simulation method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of substation simulation, and provides a digital twinning-based substation simulation method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring parameter information data of a transformer substation and equipment; the parameter information data are subjected to data cleaning and integration, and the format of the cleaned and integrated data is converted; constructing a three-dimensional structure model of the transformer substation according to the converted data; constructing a virtual model of the power system based on a digital twin technology, wherein the virtual model is used for reflecting the actual running state of the power system; and acquiring a simulation instruction input by a user in real time, and performing simulation on the transformer substation according to the three-dimensional structure model and the virtual model to generate a virtual simulation result corresponding to the simulation instruction. According to the invention, the simulation system is constructed based on the parameters of the transformer substation, and the judgment capability and the dispatching efficiency of a dispatcher in a dispatching process can be improved through the simulation system.
assignees: GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent load transfer system and method based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a load intelligent transfer system and method based on a digital twin technology, relates to the technical field of digital twin, and can solve the technical problems of long time consumption, easiness in error, numerous operation devices and low operation efficiency in manually making a transfer scheme. The system comprises: the data acquisition subsystem is connected with the physical model subsystem and is used for acquiring real-time data of the power distribution network; the physical model subsystem is connected with the optimization processing subsystem and is used for inputting real-time data of the power distribution network into the physical model, outputting real-time running conditions of the power distribution network, determining whether line faults exist according to the real-time running conditions of the power distribution network, and if yes, sending the real-time data of the power distribution network and target fault line information to the optimization processing subsystem; the optimizing processing subsystem is used for optimizing processing by utilizing an optimizing processing algorithm to obtain an optimal load transfer execution instruction so as to execute load automatic transfer according to the optimal load transfer execution instruction.
assignees: JINCHENG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Periodic digital twin auxiliary management platform for photovoltaic construction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of photovoltaic management platforms, in particular to a periodic digital twin auxiliary management platform for photovoltaic construction, which comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing and storage module, a digital twin modeling module, an analog and prediction module, a real-time monitoring and fault diagnosis module, a decision support and optimization module and a user interface module; the periodic digital twin auxiliary management platform for photovoltaic construction provided by the invention has the advantages that the construction and operation management level of a photovoltaic power station is obviously improved, the omnibearing management from data acquisition, modeling, prediction, monitoring and diagnosis to decision optimization of the photovoltaic power station is realized, and the accuracy, the intelligence and the reliability of the system are obviously improved.
assignees: HUATIAN POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based intelligent monitoring method and system for coal-fired power plant
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent monitoring method and system for a coal-fired power plant based on digital twinning, wherein the system comprises a coal-fired unit entity equipment layer, a coal-fired unit monitoring data transmission layer, a coal-fired unit monitoring data processing layer, a twinning model layer and a monitoring application layer, wherein the twinning model layer optimizes an LSSVM state prediction model by adopting a FWA parameter optimizing algorithm, so that the accuracy and precision of the LSSVM state prediction model are further improved, the automatic tracking of the running state of coal-fired unit equipment is realized, and the aim of monitoring and early warning the coal-fired unit equipment is fulfilled; the monitoring panel application layer can be used for macroscopic display of abnormal events of the coal-fired unit and automatic tracking of development trend, monitoring and early warning of vibration of a turbine of the coal-fired unit, monitoring and early warning of running state of a fan and monitoring and early warning of turn-to-turn short circuit of a rotor are realized, running state of equipment of the coal-fired unit can be mastered in real time, and equipment fault precursors can be found out in time and processed in time.
assignees: JIANGXI DATANG INT XINYU SECOND POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin-based remote substation equipment overhaul and maintenance method, device and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a overhaul and maintenance method, a device and a medium based on digital twin remote power transformation equipment, which comprise the steps of obtaining data source integration information, generating real-time data of the power transformation equipment according to the data source integration information, obtaining real-time power transformation equipment operation condition information from the real-time data of the power transformation equipment, obtaining digital twin technology, wherein the digital twin technology is used for processing the power transformation equipment to generate virtual simulation environment information, generating real-time monitoring information of the power transformation equipment according to the virtual simulation environment information and the real-time power transformation equipment operation condition information, generating automatic repair and adjustment information according to the real-time monitoring information of the power transformation equipment, and obtaining fault diagnosis robot work information from the automatic repair and adjustment information. The application has the effect of improving the integration of the digital twin technology control power transformation equipment and the robot diagnosis equipment.
assignees: SHENZHEN MINGZE INTELLIGENT ELECTRIC POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent decision management method for power grid load
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent decision management method of power grid load, which belongs to the field of intelligent power grids, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out digital twin modeling according to a power grid side, determining corresponding load lines when a plurality of concurrent load management requests are received by the power grid twin model, carrying out overlapping analysis on the plurality of load lines based on the power grid twin model, fitting the plurality of identification load lines to obtain a fitted load line network, determining a power load control device for carrying out power grid load adjustment, determining a load tolerance section according to the power load control device, inputting the load tolerance section into an intelligent path decision model, carrying out optimizing in the load line network, and carrying out load adjustment on the load line network according to an optimizing line by the power load control device. The method solves the technical problems of low power grid operation efficiency and insufficient stability caused by low power grid load management response speed, low prediction precision and limited adjustment capability in the prior art.

title_en: Digital twinning-based three-dimensional visual panoramic monitoring method and system for power transmission line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based three-dimensional visual panoramic monitoring method and a digital twinning-based three-dimensional visual panoramic monitoring system for a power transmission line. According to the method, three-dimensional data are generated by utilizing laser point cloud and oblique photography, noise and cluster analysis processing is carried out on the generated data, and then data of a power grid resource service center station are filled, so that a three-dimensional visual transmission line digital twin model is generated. The information, the image video, the on-line monitoring device and other operation and inspection data of the tower can be directly checked by clicking the line tower on the three-dimensional map. The invention can construct professional application scenes, realize the fine management and control of equipment, strengthen the visual scene simulation of the operation site, further improve the management and control level of the equipment, improve the monitoring capability of the power transmission line and greatly reduce the inspection cost of the power transmission line.
assignees: NANJING NARI INFORMATION COMM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin-driven power grid load transfer control method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-driven power grid load transfer control method and device, and relates to the technical field of power systems and automation thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of analyzing load transfer demand characteristics of a target power grid, searching a collaborative transfer power grid; the method comprises the steps of collecting physical distribution and operation data of a target power grid and a collaborative transfer power grid, constructing a power grid twin model capable of reflecting an actual operation state based on a digital twin technology, establishing a model for connecting the target power grid and the collaborative transfer power grid by a data sharing mechanism, obtaining a predicted load, carrying out overload judgment on the predicted load of the target power grid, taking the overload load as a target, optimizing a load transfer strategy according to the predicted load of the collaborative transfer power grid, and obtaining a control strategy to realize overload load transfer. The method solves the technical problems that the prior art lacks of fine analysis of the load of the power grid, load transfer cannot be performed in time, and the running state of the power grid is affected, and achieves the technical effects of improving the running performance and economic and social benefits of the power grid.

title_en: Intelligent building scheduling algorithm, storage medium and equipment based on incremental reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent building scheduling algorithm, a system and a medium based on incremental reinforcement learning, wherein the method firstly uses a directed acyclic graph to model a task, and uses part of the change of a DAG structure to reflect the change of the task; secondly, a deep structure and dynamic characteristics of a graph neural network learning DAG are introduced, and real-time updated dependency relationship information is provided for task scheduling; finally, in the face of a dynamically changing environment, incremental learning and deep reinforcement learning are combined, real-time change of the environment and dynamic change of a dependent task are quickly self-adapted, an optimal scheduling decision is made by adjusting on an original scheduling strategy, and multi-objective optimization is realized while energy consumption is reduced.
assignees: UNIV SUZHOU SCI & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Digital twin model construction method for dynamic security assessment and decision of power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin model construction method for dynamic security assessment and decision of a power grid, belonging to the field of control of power systems, the method constructs a digital twin model for dynamic security assessment and decision of the power grid based on a five-dimensional framework comprising a physical entity, a virtual entity, twin data, connection and service, and expands the digital twin application of the power grid by utilizing the service dimension. When the power system of the round is running, data of several rounds in the future can be run in advance through the physical information neural network model, simulation results are output to dynamic safety evaluation and decision service, and finally safety analysis results are output. According to the safety analysis result, a power system regulator can take measures in advance to conduct risk management, potential safety hazards are reduced, the power grid fault handling and safety risk prediction capabilities are improved, and guidance is provided for power grid safe operation.
assignees: UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH;STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Intelligent pricing method and optimizing system for electric vehicle
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric vehicle charging, and particularly relates to an intelligent pricing method and an optimization system for an electric vehicle. The method comprises the following steps of S1, data acquisition: acquiring data of a commercial power time-of-use electricity price and surrounding charging stations; s2, data processing: the captured data is transmitted to a central processing unit of the system for data processing; s3, data cleaning: performing data cleaning on the read data, including processing repeated data, processing missing data, checking abnormal values and the like, so as to ensure the integrity and accuracy of the data; s4, carrying out nonlinear programming modeling by adopting a genetic algorithm; s5, controlling the charging speed and the charging time of the charging facility to determine the actual charging cost. The pricing method in the invention helps the newly built charging station to determine the charging price by utilizing the time-of-use electricity price of the commercial power and the data around the charging station, so as to provide more economical and reasonable charging options, optimize the operation of the charging station, attract users and provide better charging experience of the electric vehicle.
assignees: SHANDONG HUIZE YUANXIN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network accident prediction method, device, system, equipment and medium combining microclimate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network accident prediction method, device, system, equipment and medium combining microclimate, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring microclimate data of a power distribution network, wherein the microclimate data are real-time weather data of an environment where the power distribution network is located; calculating weather change data based on the microclimate data, wherein the weather change data is a weather change value of an environment where the power distribution network is located in a preset time; and carrying out accident prediction on the meteorological change data input value in a preset digital twin scene to obtain a prediction result, wherein the preset digital twin scene is a scene generated by using equipment of a power distribution network and surrounding environment objects after modeling. According to the method, the future weather can be predicted according to the real-time microclimate data, the accident prediction is carried out in a digital twin scene according to the predicted future weather, the actual situation of the power distribution network can be attached, the prediction accuracy is improved, the delay is reduced, and the prompt is carried out in time, so that the prediction timeliness is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network fault prediction method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network fault prediction method based on digital twinning, and relates to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the following steps: a digital twin model of a target power distribution network is called to obtain a plurality of fault update records; performing explicit index feature extraction on the plurality of fault update records to obtain a plurality of explicit index feature sets; performing similar fault aggregation, and performing attenuation accumulation analysis to generate K aggregate explicit index sets and K aggregate explicit index attenuation factor sets; performing device implicit association identification to obtain K implicit index sets, constructing a mapping relation, and generating an explicit-implicit index feature mapping relation; acquiring a real-time explicit index set and a real-time explicit index feature set; and carrying out real-time fault prediction on the target power distribution network to obtain a fault prediction result. The technical problems that in the prior art, the power distribution network fault prediction is inaccurate and timely are solved, and the technical effects of improving the accuracy and instantaneity of the power distribution network fault prediction are achieved.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method for calculating power by using photovoltaic module model under actual irradiation, storage medium and electronic device
abstract_en: A method for calculating power by using a photovoltaic module model under actual irradiation comprises the following steps: step 1, determining a photovoltaic cell voltammetry curve of the solar photovoltaic cell, wherein the voltammetry curve is obtained by the following formula:  . The technical problem to be solved by the invention is to provide a method, a storage medium and an electronic device for calculating power by utilizing a photovoltaic module model under actual irradiation, when photovoltaic power prediction is carried out, based on photovoltaic power generation data and irradiance data in a historical period, retraining is carried out on a photovoltaic prediction model trained in advance, model parameters are updated, an updated photovoltaic prediction model is obtained, real-time update of the photovoltaic prediction model is realized, and photovoltaic prediction is carried out by using the updated photovoltaic prediction model, so that the influence of factors such as photovoltaic use conditions, weather mutation and the like is avoided, and real-time accurate prediction of photovoltaic power generation power is realized.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CORP;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Supply tracking and monitoring system based on electric power material characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a supply tracking and monitoring system based on electric power material characteristics, which comprises an electric power material warehouse production operation management unit, a park operation management unit, an intelligent storage control unit and a mobile application unit; the electric power material warehouse production operation management unit is used for responding to supply demands, improving material supply quality, analyzing material supply modes, business coordination and business overall process monitoring; the park operation management unit integrates the Internet of things perceived data resources by constructing an intelligent park platform and adopting an integrated bus and digital twin technology; the intelligent storage control unit is used for receiving tasks issued by the ERP system, and performing task decomposition and task scheduling locally in the warehouse. The monitoring system is provided with the production auxiliary management module and the business archiving management module for carrying out the adjustment of the receiving plan, so that the allocation of the electric power materials can be more accurately completed, and the whole electric power material allocation management operation is more convenient and accurate.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin system applied to operation management of urban-level virtual power plant
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin system applied to operation management of an urban virtual power plant, relates to the technical field of virtual power plant management, and solves the technical problem that in the prior art, the urban is not partitioned, so that the power resource distribution is unreasonable; the method collects and preprocesses power generation data of a power plant, historical power utilization data of a city and environmental data; constructing a virtual power plant twin model based on standard power generation data; according to the standard electricity consumption data and the standard environment data, predicting and acquiring predicted industrial electricity consumption data, predicted electric pile data and predicted domestic electricity consumption data, dividing the area in the city into an industrial area, a resident area and a charging pile area; the industrial area electricity sequence, the resident electricity sequence and the charging pile electricity sequence are input into a virtual power plant twin model to obtain a power plant power supply plan capable of reasonably supplying urban electricity, so that the energy utilization rate is improved, and the dynamic optimization distribution of power resources is realized.
assignees: HEFEI YUANLI ZHONGHE ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Tou revenue calculation unit, and intelligent management system for photovoltaic tou mode
abstract_en: The present invention is applied to the field of photovoltaics and relates to a TOU revenue calculation unit, and an intelligent management system for a photovoltaic TOU mode. TOU control is performed on a photovoltaic power station according to configured TOU configuration information data. The TOU revenue calculation unit comprises a photovoltaic energy storage system model and a revenue management module, wherein the photovoltaic energy storage system model is formed according to a structural digital twin of the photovoltaic power station; and the photovoltaic energy storage system model simulates the work of the photovoltaic power station in a TOU working mode, and the revenue management module calculates TOU revenue of the photovoltaic power station in the TOU working mode. By means of the intelligent management system for a photovoltaic TOU mode that is provided with a TOU revenue calculation unit, when TOU configuration information data is adjusted, a corresponding TOU revenue calculation can be performed, such that the requirements of a user for autonomous TOU configuration can be better met; and the TOU setting and adjustment process is simple and efficient, such that the technical threshold for an operating user in photovoltaic energy management can be reduced, the user experience can be improved, and the management of a photovoltaic power station can be better realized.
assignees: SHANGHAI SIGEYUAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Electric power construction engineering supervision and management system and method
