abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting medium-long-term market electricity price of electric power based on a digital twin algorithm, which relates to the technical field of electricity price prediction and comprises the steps of collecting historical operation data to obtain a historical electric power data set; the method comprises the steps of carrying out real-time operation monitoring on a medium-and-long-term electric power market to obtain a real-time electric power data set, utilizing a digital twin algorithm to construct an electric price prediction model, synchronizing a historical electric power data set and the real-time electric power data set to the electric price prediction model to obtain electric price prediction data, extracting actual electric price data, comparing the actual electric price data with the electric price prediction data, carrying out feedback verification according to a comparison result to generate feedback optimization data, carrying out deviation correction on the electric price prediction model according to the feedback optimization data to generate the electric price prediction optimization model, and carrying out intelligent electric price prediction on the medium-and-long-term electric power market. The method solves the technical problem of low prediction precision in the prior art for predicting the electricity price, and achieves the technical effect of accurately predicting the electricity price of the medium-and-long-term market of the electric power.
assignees: POWERCHINA NEW ENERGY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Wind resource representative year accurate correction method for mountain wind farm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wind resource evaluation, in particular to a wind resource representative year accurate correction method of a mountain wind farm, which comprises the following steps: collecting historical observation data and reference station data of a wind measuring tower, correcting the wind speed of each wind direction quadrant respectively by adopting a quadrant correction method, removing abnormal values and filling missing data, training a machine learning model by using the historical observation data, further correcting the wind speed value, calculating weight factors according to the change of different wind directions and time periods, introducing the weight factors into the quadrant correction method, correcting by a weighted average method, carrying out sliding average on data after self-adaptive weight adjustment according to one year every 12 months continuously, verifying the corrected representative year data and outputting the final corrected representative year data, wherein the wind speed is influenced by smooth short-term climate change. The method improves the accuracy and reliability of wind resource assessment, and provides firm data support for planning, designing and running of mountain wind power plants.
assignees: SHANGHAI ENERGY TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Flow data differentiation analysis method applied to transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention provides a flow data differentiation analysis method applied to a transformer substation, which relates to the technical field of electric power and artificial intelligence and comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model of the running process of the transformer substation in advance; the digital twin model comprises flow monitoring points, flow data acquired by the flow monitoring points which are arranged in a transformer substation and cover all the power equipment are acquired and imported into the digital twin model, power equipment abnormality information which characterizes abnormality of the power equipment monitored by the flow monitoring points is generated according to the flow data, target flow monitoring points which generate the power equipment abnormality information are acquired from the digital twin model, target flow data corresponding to the target flow monitoring points are acquired, and a differential analysis result is obtained by utilizing a differential evaluation model which is trained in advance based on deep learning to conduct differential analysis on the target flow data. The scheme can improve the accuracy of differential analysis of the flow data of the transformer substation, and further improve the monitoring accuracy of abnormal states of the transformer substation.
assignees: SHIZUISHAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power plant visual information management system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power plant management, and provides a power plant visual information management system based on a digital twin technology, which comprises the following components: based on the operation data, processing and analyzing to obtain an operation deviation representation value, judging whether a fault trend exists, based on the operation data, processing and analyzing to obtain an operation change value, judging the change type of the operation data, selecting a prediction model matched with the operation change value, continuously monitoring the operation voltage in real time in a prediction period, comparing and analyzing by combining the prediction voltage to obtain a change approach value, judging whether the operation voltage change approaches to the predicted operation voltage, obtaining a non-approach similarity value, and judging whether the operation voltage of the power plant equipment at different time points does not approach to the predicted operation voltage to a similar degree, thereby being beneficial to the stable operation management of the power plant.

title_en: Power distribution network state estimation method integrating neural network and attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network state estimation method integrating a neural network and an attention mechanism, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a power distribution network state estimation model integrating a neural network algorithm and the attention mechanism, then constructing input data for training, wherein the input data is divided into two types of processing, one type of processing is directly connected with a traditional DNN, the other type of processing needs to be added with a time sequence dimension to enable the processing to become a three-dimensional data set to be connected with an LSTM (link state machine) network, then combining output results of two parallel modules into an input of attention modules, and realizing accurate estimation of the power distribution network state by distributing weights through the method.
assignees: UNIV ELECTRONIC SCI & TECH CHINA

title_en: Automatic operation and maintenance method and system for electric power distribution network based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic operation and maintenance method and system of an electric power distribution network based on artificial intelligence, which relate to the technical field of electric power operation and maintenance and comprise the steps of collecting operation data of the electric power distribution network in real time through a distributed sensor network, transmitting the collected operation data to a cloud data center to design a multi-agent reinforcement learning framework, dividing the power distribution network into a plurality of subareas, and an intelligent operation and maintenance agent making an individualized fault treatment scheme by carrying out real-time monitoring and analysis on a digital twin model and making an optimal execution plan based on the fault treatment scheme and combining real-time road condition information and positions of maintenance personnel; and respectively issuing the optimal execution plan to mobile terminals of automatic equipment and maintenance personnel through a safe encryption channel, extracting preventive maintenance rules from the historical operation and maintenance records, and formulating a preventive maintenance plan based on the extracted preventive maintenance rules and combining a pre-trained equipment life prediction model.
assignees: ORDOS FANSHENG DATA TECH CO LTD;BEIJING QIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Distribution network resource optimal configuration method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention provides a distribution network resource optimal allocation method and system based on artificial intelligence. The method comprises the steps of establishing a virtual network corresponding to a power distribution network based on a digital twin technology, obtaining a power planning starting point and a power planning ending point selected by a resource allocation end, determining an initial planning route composed of the power planning starting point and the power planning ending point, intercepting a virtual corridor based on a relative position relation between the initial planning route and the virtual corridor to obtain a corridor planning section, segmenting the corridor planning section, updating the route of the initial planning route based on each obtained dividing sub-section of a corresponding idle attribute to obtain a current planning route, configuring route temperature control, sending circuit resource optimization data to the resource allocation end, responding to a configuration completion signal sent by the resource allocation end, obtaining temperature monitoring data, and updating the running state of the current planning route in the virtual network. The invention at least improves the planning efficiency.

title_en: Modularized photovoltaic device and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation, in particular to a modularized photovoltaic device and a control method thereof. The method comprises the steps of obtaining photovoltaic system data, extracting illumination parameter information of the photovoltaic system data to obtain photovoltaic illumination parameter information, carrying out intensity evaluation on the photovoltaic illumination parameter information to obtain photovoltaic illumination intensity data, carrying out intensity clustering on the photovoltaic illumination intensity data to obtain illumination intensity clustered data, extracting temperature data of the photovoltaic system data to obtain photovoltaic temperature data, carrying out photo-thermal cooperative analysis on the photovoltaic temperature data according to the illumination intensity clustered data, and generating photovoltaic photo-thermal cooperative data. Therefore, the photovoltaic array configuration self-adaptive adjustment method and device realize the photo-thermal collaborative analysis of the photovoltaic through the Internet of things technology, the data analysis technology, the self-adaptive control technology and the digital twin technology, so as to realize the self-adaptive adjustment of the photovoltaic array configuration and improve the photovoltaic power output performance.

title_en: Fire control vehicle-mounted information management and control system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of information management and control, in particular to a fire-fighting vehicle-mounted information management and control system. According to the invention, the traffic and emergency information are integrated in real time, the travel route of the fire engine is dynamically regulated, the navigation efficiency of the fire engine in a complex urban environment is remarkably improved, the generation of route information is optimized in real time, the fire engine can bypass a congestion point, the emergency response time is shortened, meanwhile, the self-adaptive regulation of signal frequency and transmission power is carried out on communication equipment, the transmission reliability of data in different network environments is enhanced, the timely and accurate transmission of key instructions is ensured, in addition, the real-time update and state synchronization of an execution command in a fire engine-mounted system are improved, the cooperative combat capability of fire troops is improved, and the consistent execution of the emergency instructions is ensured, so that the overall rescue efficiency and the safety are effectively improved.
assignees: POTEVIO PEACE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wind turbine generator system fault simulation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wind turbine generator fault simulation, and discloses a wind turbine generator fault simulation method which comprises high-resolution environment simulation, real-time climate monitoring, virtual reality and augmented reality technology application, a self-adaptive simulation model based on deep learning, digital twin technology application and an open data sharing and crowdsourcing platform. According to the wind turbine generator system fault simulation method, through application of Augmented Reality (AR) and Virtual Reality (VR) technologies, operators can fully train without directly facing high-risk environments, training safety is improved, more visual and real-time teaching support is provided, fault diagnosis and repair training is more efficient and realistic, and a simulation system is helped to learn a large number of historical operation data and fault cases and forecast possible fault modes in the future by using artificial intelligence, convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and cyclic neural networks (RNNs).
assignees: GUODIAN POWER GUANGXI WIND POWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: AR (augmented reality) glasses-based power equipment inspection method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intellectualization in the power industry, in particular to an AR (augmented reality) -glasses-based power equipment inspection method. According to the method, the device and the system, through the Internet of things technology and the multi-source data fusion algorithm, comprehensive collection and real-time updating of the running data of the device are realized, and the accuracy and timeliness of the data are improved. And the equipment state and the fault risk are deeply analyzed by combining a decision tree and a neural network algorithm, so that the fault prediction accuracy and the early recognition capability are improved. The fault mode influences analysis and the application of the convolutional neural network, accurately identifies a fault source and proposes effective maintenance suggestions, and maintenance cost and downtime are reduced. The genetic algorithm optimizes the routing inspection path and the work plan planning, and improves the routing inspection efficiency. Cloud computing and augmented reality technology are combined, inspection information is visually presented, and working efficiency and accuracy are improved.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA POWER GROUP MENGDIAN INFORMATION COMMUNICATION IND CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic power generation effective data screening and optimizing method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power operation and data processing, in particular to a photovoltaic power generation effective data screening and optimizing method and a system, which aim at the problem of low screening accuracy of the photovoltaic power generation effective data of a new energy power plant in an extreme natural environment, according to the invention, the geographical image data of the photovoltaic power station is constructed by a digital twin technology, and the accurate screening of the data is realized by combining the comparison of the real-time plant natural environment data and theoretical natural environment information and a natural environment simulation model. Meanwhile, the operation data of the screened photovoltaic power station is optimized by utilizing a genetic algorithm, so that the photovoltaic power station of the new energy power station can efficiently and stably operate under the change of natural environment. The invention improves the accuracy of screening the effective data of the photovoltaic power generation and provides powerful support for the intelligent operation and maintenance of the photovoltaic power station.

title_en: Intelligent water conservancy inspection method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of data processing, and discloses an intelligent water conservancy inspection method, device and equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of carrying out dynamic fusion processing on the obtained multi-dimensional water conservancy environment data of the preset target area to obtain a target digital twin body, carrying out intelligent collaborative analysis on the digital twin body to obtain a self-adaptive inspection strategy, carrying out multi-mode sensing data acquisition on the target area according to the self-adaptive inspection strategy to obtain multi-mode data, carrying out federal learning processing on the multi-mode data to obtain holographic situation awareness data, carrying out causal reasoning analysis on the holographic situation awareness data to obtain a dynamic risk map, and inputting the dynamic risk map into a preset depth Q network to carry out prevention and control strategy analysis to obtain an active prevention and control strategy and an inspection report. The intelligent water conservancy inspection system and the intelligent water conservancy inspection method improve the efficiency and the accuracy of intelligent water conservancy inspection.

title_en: Highway electric energy quality early warning system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a highway electric energy quality early warning system, and relates to the field of electric energy quality early warning. The system comprises a monitoring data acquisition module of each block of the expressway, a data cleaning module of each block of the expressway, a power quality prediction module of each block of the expressway, a power quality early warning module of each block of the expressway, a power quality assessment module and a power quality assessment module, wherein the monitoring data acquisition module of each block of the expressway comprises a block geographic environment query unit, a block weather data acquisition unit and a block power quality index acquisition unit, the data cleaning module of each block of the expressway is used for cleaning abnormal data, repeated data and missing data of data acquired by the monitoring data acquisition module of the same block, the power quality prediction module of each block of the expressway comprises a power quality prediction unit and a power quality early warning threshold making unit, the power quality early warning module of each block of the expressway comprises a monitoring data real-time warning unit and a predicted data early warning unit, and the power quality assessment module is used for assessing the power quality. The embodiment improves the accuracy and the difference of early warning.
assignees: HEBEI EXPRESSWAY GROUP CO LTD;JINGQIN BRANCH HEBEI EXPRESSWAY GROUP CO LTD;HEBEI PROVINCIAL COMMUNICATIONS PLANNING AND DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: New energy power optimization scheduling method and system under digital twin platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of new energy power systems, in particular to a new energy power optimal scheduling method and a new energy power optimal scheduling system under a digital twin platform, which firstly establishes a new energy power system optimal scheduling scene based on the digital twin platform, through the scene, a digital twin edge network model is established, and accurate modeling, real-time monitoring, optimal scheduling and decision support of a new energy power system are realized. In terms of power tasks, the intelligent terminal has the option to perform local calculations or offload tasks to an edge server. In addition, the invention builds an optimization model of intelligent terminal unloading decision and computing resource allocation so as to achieve the aim of minimizing the total energy consumption of the whole network. Finally, an on-policy Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) algorithm is adopted to solve the unloading decision and the computing resource allocation strategy, so that the online instantaneity of the unloading decision and the computing resource allocation is greatly improved.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Wind power prediction method, system, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a wind power prediction method, a system, computer equipment and a storage medium, which belong to the technical field of wind power prediction, and firstly, a missing data filling method is provided to be combined with Cross Multiple Interpolation (CMI) so as to obtain a complete environment variable data set. And secondly, selecting characteristic variables based on the maximum information coefficient so as to simplify the data set and obtain required characteristic vectors. And finally, obtaining a wind power prediction model based on a data training Time Convolutional Network (TCN) of the characteristic variable set, inputting the operation data of the fan to be detected into the wind power prediction model, and outputting a wind power prediction value. Compared with other models, the method has better prediction performance, and provides data support for subsequent wind power total amount analysis and prediction.
assignees: UNIV JINAN

title_en: Power supply carbon emission adjusting method and system based on optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The application provides a power supply carbon emission adjusting method and system based on an optimization algorithm, and relates to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: loading a target power supply scheme corresponding to a target power supply demand, modeling according to a data twin system, obtaining a power supply simulation model, then carrying out simulated power supply to obtain simulated power supply data, obtaining a power supply carbon bank verification result through a power supply carbon bank verification model, generating a power supply carbon bank adjusting instruction and activating a power supply carbon bank optimizing algorithm when the power supply carbon bank is unqualified, then carrying out optimizing to obtain a carbon bank optimizing power supply scheme, and carrying out power supply control according to the optimizing power supply scheme. The application mainly solves the problems that the existing method is low in management efficiency and accuracy, lacks an effective carbon-emission adjusting mechanism, and cannot quickly generate corresponding adjusting instructions to perform carbon-emission optimization when the carbon emission exceeds the standard. Through the digital twin system and the simulation model, the running state and the carbon emission condition of the electric power system can be accurately simulated, and efficient carbon emission adjustment can be performed.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Nuclear power construction wisdom construction analysis system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of building construction, and particularly discloses an analysis system for intelligent building construction of nuclear power construction, which comprises a data acquisition module, a big data analysis module, a digital twin module, an emergency response module, a logistics management module and an information sharing module; according to the invention, various data of a construction site are collected and analyzed in real time by arranging the sensor network and the data processing platform, so that a manager can master the construction progress in time, quickly make a decision, delay and downtime in construction are reduced, the construction data are predicted and optimized by a machine learning algorithm, the construction scheme is helped to be optimized, the construction efficiency is improved, the stress and deformation conditions of key structural parts are monitored in real time by the sensor network, the construction quality is ensured, potential structural problems are found and prevented in time, the digital twin technology can realize virtual and real linkage, the construction is ensured to be carried out according to design specifications, and the construction quality is improved.
assignees: CHINA NUCLEAR ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution method, device and equipment based on photovoltaic power generation
abstract_en: The application discloses a power distribution method, a device and equipment based on photovoltaic power generation, and relates to the technical field of power, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining meteorological data of a photovoltaic system in a preset power generation time period; the method comprises the steps of estimating predicted power generation capacity of a photovoltaic system according to meteorological data through a preset photovoltaic power model, obtaining the preset photovoltaic power model through aggregation training of an initial photovoltaic model, obtaining sensitivity training of a power generation scene of the photovoltaic system through the initial photovoltaic model based on an AI algorithm and a digital twin model, determining the power utilization load capacity of the photovoltaic according to power capacity balance data of each power utilization area, and determining the power distribution result of each power utilization area according to the predicted power generation capacity. According to the application, due to the fact that the weather condition and the preset photovoltaic power model are combined, the generated energy can be accurately predicted in advance, so that the power consumption requirements of all power consumption areas are reasonably distributed in advance, the advantage of renewable energy sources is fully utilized, and the energy utilization efficiency of photovoltaic power generation is improved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU ZHEMINGHUI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Scheduling algorithm optimization method and system based on power twinning
abstract_en: The application discloses a dispatching algorithm optimization method and a system based on electric power twin, which belong to the field of digital twin, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a digital twin model of a power plant and establishing a device stability evaluation function; the method comprises the steps of acquiring power demand characteristics, monitoring environment data of clean power generation, establishing a real-time environment data set and a predicted environment data set, initializing a channel of an intelligent dispatching channel according to the power demand characteristics, predicting power generation parameters of clean equipment, generating running stability data according to a prediction result and an equipment stability evaluation function, generating a dispatching decision result, and completing supply dispatching optimization of a power plant. The application solves the technical problems of low power grid dispatching precision and poor coordination caused by the difficulty in accurately predicting and stably matching the clean power generation and the power grid load based on the traditional model in the prior art, and achieves the technical effects of improving the power grid dispatching precision and the coordination by constructing a digital twin and intelligent dispatching channel to cooperatively optimize the clean power generation and the power grid load in real time.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Circuit safety management method based on Internet of things low-voltage safety comprehensive protection module
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of operation and maintenance of power equipment, and provides a circuit safety management method based on an Internet of things low-voltage safety comprehensive protection module. The method integrates the original prediction result and the time-sharing prediction result, periodically updates the data set and trains the prediction model so as to realize the real-time updated low-voltage safety comprehensive protection module circuit safety prediction. The invention improves the prediction accuracy, enhances the adaptability and the flexibility of the system, realizes comprehensive circuit safety management, and promotes the development of the operation and maintenance of the power system to a data driving decision.
assignees: GUANGZHOU NANWANG SCIENTIFIC RESEARCH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid fault emergency rescue method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid fault repair, in particular to a power grid fault emergency rescue method. The method comprises the steps of obtaining power grid topological structure data, key equipment parameters and real-time running state data, constructing a power grid digital twin model according to the power grid topological structure data, the key equipment parameters and the real-time running state data, performing real-time state evaluation to obtain fault risk early warning data and real-time fault condition data, performing fault point positioning and fault type determination based on deep learning according to the fault risk early warning data and the real-time running state data when the real-time fault condition data is displayed as faults, obtaining fault diagnosis data, and constructing a fault influence range model according to the fault diagnosis data and a preset FACTS and HVDC characteristic model. The method integrates deep learning, graph theory and multi-objective optimization technology, and achieves fault intelligent identification, influence range modeling and accurate emergency treatment scheme optimization.

title_en: High-voltage cable digital panoramic system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric power systems, and particularly relates to a high-voltage cable digital panoramic system which comprises an IOT channel, a model fusion module, an equipment panoramic showing module and an equipment positioning and state sensing module, wherein the model fusion module is used for manually collecting a panoramic model and a laser point cloud model, realizing fusion of panoramic and laser point cloud data after processing operation of the panoramic model and the laser point cloud model, the equipment panoramic showing module is used for carrying out transformation processing on a three-dimensional platform on the basis of the model fusion module to realize loading showing of a model fusion result, meanwhile integrating state data of high-voltage cable equipment to realize panoramic showing, and the equipment positioning and state sensing module is used for carrying out comparison correlation with standing account information of the high-voltage cable equipment. The invention can realize the organic fusion of the laser point cloud and the panoramic image, construct the digital twin scene of the cable tunnel, and realize the panoramic display and the tour virtual display of the high-voltage cable tunnel.
assignees: BEIJING ZHUOYUE POWER CONSTRUCTION CO LTD;PIPELINE BRANCH BEIJING JINGDIAN POWER GRID MAINTENANCE GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Electrical fault monitoring system for smart city
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric fault monitoring system for a smart city, which comprises an electric acquisition box, an edge gateway, an Internet of things platform and a local large model. The electric acquisition box can acquire environmental parameters and line current load characteristics, the edge gateway comprises a microcomputer and a communication module, the Internet of things platform can perform bidirectional interaction with a local large model, can analyze, aggregate and permanently store received data, is integrated with a data visualization module, can dynamically display an electrochemical corrosion process of a line interface, and performs dynamic interaction with a user through a data large screen. According to the invention, the load characteristic of the circuit is captured by using the current sensor, a mathematical model is established to predict the temperature change of the circuit in real time, the fire disaster caused by the circuit degradation is predicted, and the visualization is carried out through a digital twin technology.
assignees: HENAN LIGAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Resource scheduling method for power equipment fault handling in extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a resource scheduling method for power equipment fault processing in extreme weather, which relates to the technical field of data processing, and comprises the steps of embedding a power equipment topological point cloud model and a power equipment fault analysis function network by utilizing a digital twin technology, generating a power equipment operation twin model to analyze power equipment operation data flow and obtaining power equipment fault characteristic information; and carrying out influence analysis on the weather information of the power equipment area to obtain a multidimensional weather resource influence factor, transmitting the power equipment fault characteristic information and the multidimensional weather resource influence factor to an operation and maintenance resource cloud for carrying out scheduling analysis to obtain power equipment resource cooperative scheduling parameters for carrying out resource scheduling and equipment fault processing. The method has the advantages that the digital twin technology is utilized to realize power equipment fault analysis and operation and maintenance resource intelligent scheduling, the resource scheduling accuracy and scheduling efficiency are improved, the equipment operation and maintenance cost is reduced, and further the technical effect of timeliness of power equipment fault processing is ensured.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Distribution data missing completion method and device based on matrix decomposition
abstract_en: A distribution data missing completion method and device based on matrix decomposition are provided, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a data characteristic matrix of an electric power system according to network parameters of the electric power system, setting an arrangement form of a distribution data matrix according to the data characteristic matrix and the type and the scale of distribution data measured values, constructing a distribution data matrix completion problem model according to the distribution data matrix, and solving the distribution data matrix completion problem model by using a block coordinate descent algorithm to complete distribution data missing completion. The invention can be applied to state estimation under the condition of low measurement of the power distribution system, and can be flexibly adapted to estimation completion of the power flow data of the power distribution system at a single moment of the characteristic value of the measured data of the power system.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN;LINYI POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Intelligent rail transit power supply operation and maintenance system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based intelligent operation and maintenance system for rail transit power supply, and relates to the technical field of rail transit operation and maintenance. The system comprises a data acquisition unit, an interactive transmission unit, a twin monitoring unit and remote equipment, wherein the data acquisition unit is used for acquiring operation data of a rail transit power supply system in real time, the interactive transmission unit is used for caching the operation data in a set period and carrying out communication transmission on each cached data according to a pop rule, the twin monitoring unit is used for constructing a digital twin model according to the data received in the set period and carrying out fault prediction and maintenance scheduling based on the digital twin model to determine an operation and maintenance scheme, the operation and maintenance scheme comprises output of a fault early warning signal and a resource scheduling signal, and the remote equipment is used for visually displaying each operation data, carrying out warning according to the fault early warning signal and carrying out scheduling prompt to corresponding supervisory personnel according to the resource scheduling signal. The invention can improve the operation and maintenance efficiency.
assignees: Sichuan Railway Vocational College

title_en: Detection method and recovery method for multi-service abnormal data of intelligent power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detection method of multi-service abnormal data of an intelligent power distribution network, which comprises the following steps of setting monitoring points, collecting and monitoring various service data of the intelligent power distribution network by utilizing the monitoring points, respectively extracting data characteristics of the collected service data according to the types of the service data, respectively detecting various data characteristics by adopting a distributed state estimation algorithm according to the classified extracted data characteristics, and screening abnormal data in the data characteristics. According to the invention, aiming at massive service data, the abnormal data detection work of the multi-service data can be efficiently completed, and the detection efficiency is greatly improved. On the other hand, after abnormal data in the intelligent power distribution network system service is detected, the abnormal data is recovered to normal data for the intelligent power distribution network, the relevant detection and recovery work effect is evaluated, and the intelligent power distribution network multi-service abnormal data detection, recovery and evaluation integration is realized.
assignees: UNIV NANJING POSTS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS

title_en: Intelligent energy intelligent management method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based intelligent energy intelligent management method and a digital twin-based intelligent energy intelligent management system, which belong to the technical field of energy management, and are used for solving the technical problems of poor autonomous supervision effect and poor autonomous regulation effect of energy management caused by single supervision dimension and single self-adaptive dynamic regulation mode of implementation of an energy management scheme in the prior scheme, carrying out monitoring statistics and processing analysis on total daily power supply and total daily power consumption in a target area to obtain daily power supply reliable identifications and daily power supply reliable states corresponding to the target area, carrying out periodical processing analysis on daily power supply stable states of the target area by a daily power supply reliable supervision sequence obtained by earlier stage processing, carrying out self-adaptive dynamic management on follow-up implementation of the prior daily power supply scheme according to the stage power supply stable states, carrying out retrospective evaluation on implementation effect of the energy supply stage regulation scheme, and carrying out dynamic optimization management on follow-up implementation of the energy supply stage regulation scheme.
assignees: SHANDONG LIKONG ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Inspection well overflow point forecasting and early warning method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based inspection well overflow point forecasting and early-warning method and system, wherein the system comprises an urban sensing module, a digital twinning body module, an inspection well forecasting module and a flood risk early-warning module; the method comprises the following steps of firstly perfecting an urban knowledge graph to construct an urban perception module, constructing a digital twin city, constructing an inspection well forecasting module and constructing a flood risk early warning module. The urban flood control system is based on a digital twin platform, an urban hydrologic hydrodynamic model is coupled through an Internet of things network and a data flow processing frame, parameters of the coupling model are dynamically calibrated, an inspection well is finely simulated, the urban development state flood inundation condition with multiple space-time scales is displayed in an overall aspect, the actual running state of an urban drainage system is tracked and reflected, the risk level and real-time early warning are dynamically evaluated, the urban emergency management response efficiency is improved, and support is provided for smooth development of urban flood control and drainage work.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;POWERCHINA KUNMING ENG CORP LTD

title_en: Online cooperation and communication platform system for wind farm operation and maintenance personnel and use method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of operation and maintenance of wind power generation equipment, and discloses an online cooperation and communication platform system of wind power plant operation and maintenance personnel and a use method thereof; the fault diagnosis and prediction module is used for diagnosing and predicting faults of the wind turbine generator; the equipment digital twin and simulation optimizing module is used for constructing a digital twin model of the wind power equipment through the Internet of things and data modeling, and the spare part management and scheduling optimizing module is used for the Internet of things and machine learning. The invention can realize remote collaboration, and an operation and maintenance expert can remotely guide on-site personnel to perform fault diagnosis and maintenance, so that long-distance running is avoided, and the running state of wind power equipment can be mastered in real time.
assignees: PENGLAI WIND POWER BRANCH HUANENG SHANDONG POWER GENERATION CO LTD;XIAN THERMAL POWER RES INST CO

title_en: Intelligent power supply planning method based on medium-voltage distribution network
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent power supply planning method based on a medium voltage distribution network, which comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model according to preprocessed data, generating a self-adaptive dynamic clone model pool, monitoring future load changes and equipment states of a power grid, simultaneously coping with different power grid operation conditions and sudden accidents, carrying out load prediction and power supply strategy simulation according to real-time state data output by the clone model pool and the digital twin model, selecting an optimal strategy to cope with various possible power grid operation conditions and sudden events, combining a multi-mode load prediction result and priority ranking calculated according to comprehensive scores, executing the optimal power supply strategy, carrying out real-time monitoring, dynamically adjusting strategy parameters when executing the strategy, and carrying out fault prediction and self-healing mechanisms according to real-time monitoring and feedback data. The invention provides an intelligent, dynamic and integrated solution, which lays a foundation for the development of a future intelligent power grid.

title_en: Power grid engineering meteorological early warning system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of large-scale power grid safety guarantee and defense systems, and particularly discloses a digital twinning-based power grid engineering meteorological early warning system. The system mainly comprises a digital twin model construction module, a weather forecast data acquisition module, a severe weather data extraction module, a facility influence assessment module and an early warning information generation module, wherein the digital twin model construction module is used for constructing a three-dimensional digital twin model of a power grid facility, the weather forecast data acquisition module is used for acquiring weather forecast data, the severe weather data extraction module is used for extracting the severe weather data from the weather forecast data, and the facility influence assessment module is used for assessing influence of the severe weather data on operation of the power grid. The method and the system can quickly identify the meteorological conditions threatening the power grid facilities, effectively evaluate the potential influence of severe weather on the power grid facilities, ensure the accuracy of risk evaluation while having small calculated amount, and realize more targeted early warning and protection measures.
assignees: State grid shanghai electric power design co ltd

title_en: Power-stealing identification method and device based on power distribution network state estimation
abstract_en: A power stealing identification method and device based on power distribution network state estimation acquire measurement data from a D5000 system, an electric acquisition terminal message and an electric consumption information acquisition system, perform state estimation calculation on a line according to calculated measurement values of all parts of the line node, arrange the line according to measurement items, reduce or zero one weight of the measurement data to be detected by adopting a weight reduction method, recalculate the running state of the line by adopting the weight-reduced measurement data, and repeat the process until all measurement values are respectively subjected to one-time weight reduction and recalculation. And solving residual errors of each weight reduction result and calculating correction rate of the residual errors, so that whether abnormal electricity is used in the measurement value node or not is judged, and the purpose of executing electricity larceny identification based on the electricity larceny identification method and device for power distribution network state estimation is achieved.
assignees: SHIJIAZHUANG CITY LUANCHENG DISTR POWER SUPPLY BRANCH COMPANY STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER COMPAN;SHIJIAZHUANG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH CO STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Operation and maintenance management method and platform based on digital twin
abstract_en: The application relates to an operation and maintenance management method and platform based on digital twinning, which are applied to the field of data processing, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring various key values and data of power grid equipment in an edge transformer substation, determining a first power grid equipment and equipment which is strongly related to the first power grid equipment as key equipment according to the equipment key values, aiming at second power grid equipment except the first power grid equipment in a plurality of power grid equipment, determining key equipment and non-key equipment from the second power grid equipment according to the operation duration, the fault times, the service life and the equipment key values of each second power grid equipment, accurately realizing classification of the key equipment and the non-key equipment, constructing digital twin models with different precision for the key equipment and the non-key equipment, ensuring fine management of the key equipment, avoiding resource waste on the non-key equipment, improving the construction efficiency of the digital twin models and reducing the maintenance cost.

title_en: Method, system and product for supplementing abnormal missing data of power system database
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of big data, and provides a method, a system and a product for complementing abnormal missing data of a database of an electric power system, wherein the technical scheme is that multi-source data of the electric power system are acquired, and multi-element time sequence data are obtained through processing; the method comprises the steps of predicting based on multivariate time series data and a missing data prediction model to obtain a predicted value of missing data, predicting the missing data from front and back directions based on historical and characteristic data in combination with a bidirectional attention mechanism, interpolating the predicted value of the predicted missing data to the position of the missing value, and storing the data after the missing value is complemented into a power system database, so that the limitation of the existing missing data processing is solved.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG

title_en: Database system for managing assets of an oil and gas operation within set disturbance limits of a geospatial location
abstract_en: A database management system for managing assets of an oil and gas operation includes a server in data communication with a computing device over a network. The computing device includes an interactive user interface. Memory is stored in the server and accessible by the computing device. Asset data is stored in the memory and is retrievable by the computing device. The asset data includes geospatial information defining at least one disturbance site and spatial feature information defining one or more oil and gas assets located within the disturbance site. The interactive user interface displays a digital twin of the disturbance site based on the asset data.
assignees: ECOPOINT INC

title_en: Intelligent heating system and method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twinning-based intelligent heating system and a digital twinning-based intelligent heating method, comprising a digital twinning model module, an analog calculation module, a data module and a display operation screen, wherein the analog calculation module is respectively connected with the digital twinning model module, the data module and the display operation screen, the digital twinning model module is used for constructing a real heat supply building structure and a heat supply secondary network structure, the data module is used for acquiring and storing real heat supply monitoring data corresponding to the digital twinning model module, the analog calculation module is used for carrying out hydraulic characteristic analog simulation according to the digital twinning model and the heat supply monitoring data, and the display operation screen is used for displaying the digital twinning model, the heat supply monitoring data, analog simulation results, the analog calculation module and the operation. The invention carries out full-flow analog simulation on the heating system based on the digital twin technology, and carries out full-process real-time regulation and control on the heating system by virtue of the simulation operation result.
assignees: PETROCHINA CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for estimating weighted minimum absolute value robust state of power distribution network
abstract_en: The application relates to a weighted minimum absolute value robust state estimation method and device of a power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the steps of adding a relaxation variable to eliminate absolute value quantity in an objective function to obtain a WLAV robust estimation model, constructing a Lagrange function corresponding to the state estimation model based on the WLAV robust estimation model, expanding a KKT condition Taylor of the Lagrange function to obtain a correction equation under the condition that the Lagrange function meets a preset minimum condition to obtain the WLAV state estimation model, and searching an interior point method to solve the robust state estimation result of the power distribution network based on the WLAV state estimation model by using a filter line. Therefore, the problems of complex method model, low calculation efficiency and complex engineering application value caused by high calculation complexity and sensitive initial value of the related technology are solved.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV NORTH CHINA TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Power distribution network bad data identification state estimation method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying and estimating bad data of a power distribution network based on digital twin, which relates to the technical field of power system state estimation and comprises the steps of acquiring real-time measurement data based on a physical power distribution network and sending the real-time measurement data to a digital twin server through a communication protocol; identifying and correcting bad measurement data in a digital twin database of a server, complementing the removed measurement data through a BILSTM neural network, fusing multi-source measurement data on the data quantity and time scale, and estimating line behavior to reflect the real-time state of the power distribution network. The method provided by the invention identifies and corrects bad data through BILSTM neural network, ensures data integrity, solves the problem of time scale difference by adopting a linear state estimation method of multi-source data fusion, realizes accurate and real-time power distribution network sensing, and achieves better effects in the aspects of power distribution network bad data identification and correction, and state estimation precision and efficiency.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SHANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Fusion estimation method for distributed power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fusion estimation method of a distributed power distribution network, which comprises the following steps of S1, establishing a power distribution network system model, S2, obtaining predicted values and predicted information matrixes of a node i and a neighbor node j thereof, S3, setting a filtering estimated value when iteration initial steps and an ith node are carried out for t times of dead point iteration, S4, carrying out Cholesky decomposition, S5, calculating a consensus weighted term of the node i, obtaining a current state optimal estimated value by using a dead point iteration method of a maximum correlation entropy expansion information filter, S6, comparing the current state estimated value with the estimated value of the last iteration step, taking the current state estimated value as the state estimated value of the next iteration if the current state estimated value is smaller than a threshold, calculating a state estimation error covariance, otherwise, updating iteration times, and returning to S5. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of improving the precision of the filter adopted by the power distribution network state estimation method and the like.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI DIANJI

title_en: System and method for processing mountain basin geological disaster data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain basin geological disaster data processing system and a mountain basin geological disaster data processing method, which relate to the technical field of data management, wherein a monitoring area is divided into a plurality of sub-areas, the concentration degree of disaster influence factors in the sub-areas is analyzed, if the concentration degree exceeds expectations, the risk level of each sub-area geological disaster is determined, a geological disaster vulnerability distribution map and a corresponding vulnerability evaluation report are generated, real-time geological related data are collected in a high-risk area and are used as input, geological risks in the high-risk area are predicted by a geological risk digital twin model to obtain geological risk prediction data, risk degrees are constructed by a geological risk prediction data set, multistage alarm is carried out on the geological disasters in the high-risk area according to the risk degrees, and corresponding prevention measures are given for each sub-area. The notification degree is increased through different layers of alarm mechanisms, so that the geological disaster risk can be acquired in advance, and the occurrence of potential safety hazards is reduced.
assignees: UNIV YUNNAN AGRICULTURAL

title_en: Collaborative optimization scheduling method of wind-solar-energy-storage integrated system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of renewable energy sources, and discloses a collaborative optimization scheduling method of a wind-solar-energy-storage integrated system. The method comprises the steps of predicting short-term, medium-term and long-term generating capacity and load according to real-time operation data of a wind power generation subsystem, a photovoltaic power generation subsystem and an energy storage subsystem, constructing a multi-objective optimization function, solving the multi-objective optimization function to obtain a non-dominant solution, integrating a demand side response model based on a graph neural network, performing fault diagnosis and self-healing by establishing a digital twin model, providing power grid support by establishing an adaptive virtual synchronous generator, and establishing a transparent recorded blockchain system for distributed energy transaction and scheduling decision. The wind-solar integrated system can realize accurate prediction of multiple time scales, dynamic optimization of multiple targets and self-adaptive control strategies, and simultaneously considers multiple factors of demand side response, fault diagnosis, self-healing and power grid support service, so that the overall operation efficiency and reliability of the wind-solar integrated system are improved.
assignees: HUANENG LANCANGJIANG NEW ENERGY CO LTD;XIAN THERMAL POWER RES INST CO

title_en: Toughness evaluation method for power system in extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electrical system evaluation, in particular to a novel toughness evaluation method of an electrical system under extreme weather, which comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model, collecting data in real time, carrying out fusion processing on multi-source data, identifying potential risks of the electrical system under the extreme weather, determining system vulnerability, constructing an extreme weather scene, simulating weather events which are possibly happened in future, predicting the occurrence probability and the influence range of the extreme weather, analyzing the vulnerability of the system, identifying key nodes and vulnerable equipment, defining and calculating toughness indexes, optimizing operation strategies, executing emergency plans when the extreme weather happens, evaluating the execution effect of the plans, and continuously optimizing the plans through feedback.

title_en: Power grid monitoring method and device, nonvolatile storage medium and computer equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid monitoring method, a device, a nonvolatile storage medium and computer equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a power grid information sequence of a target area, determining the moment when missing data exists in the power grid information sequence as a missing moment, determining a plurality of adjacent moments of the missing moment as a plurality of reference moments, determining unreasonable amplitude values corresponding to the reference moments based on the power grid information data corresponding to the reference moments, supplementing the missing data based on the unreasonable amplitude values corresponding to the reference moments and the power information data corresponding to the reference moments, obtaining a complete power grid information sequence, removing abnormal data in the complete power grid information sequence, obtaining the target power grid information sequence, and monitoring a power grid of the target area based on the target power grid information sequence. The invention solves the technical problem that the monitoring effect is poor because the abnormal data is easy to remove the missing normal information when the power grid information is collected.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Linkage method of hydrogen-doped natural gas pipe network safety check and real-time prediction linkage system
abstract_en: The invention provides a linkage method of a hydrogen-doped natural gas pipe network safety check and real-time prediction linkage system, which comprises a digital twin module, a detection module, a hydrogen-doped pry module and a dosage prediction module, wherein the detection module comprises an end user, a thermometer and a flowmeter, the thermometer is used for collecting temperature data of the end user, the temperature data are transmitted to the digital twin module, the flowmeter is used for collecting load data of the end user, the load data are transmitted to the dosage prediction module, the dosage prediction module predicts the hydrogen-doped natural gas dosage of the user in real time according to the data collected by the detection module, the hydrogen-doped pry module controls the mixing proportion of hydrogen and natural gas according to the output result of the dosage prediction module, and the digital twin module checks the safety operation feasibility and the hydrogen-doped proportion by calculating physical parameters of the hydrogen-doped natural gas. The method realizes accurate prediction, dynamic scheduling and safety check of the consumption of the natural gas and the hydrogen, and ensures the improvement of the energy utilization efficiency.

title_en: Twin model building method and system for power failure prediction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a twin model building method and a twin model building system for power failure prediction, which relate to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining power system layout information of a target area; traversing K line element sets to perform fault record retrieval in a preset retrieval window to obtain L element fault data sets, obtaining L first digital twin sub-networks, collecting element operation data of the K line element sets in a preset time threshold to generate K element operation data sets, constructing a second digital twin sub-network, generating a target digital twin model based on the L first digital twin sub-networks and the second digital twin sub-network, and performing power fault prediction by using the digital twin model to obtain a target power fault prediction result. The method solves the technical problems of low reliability and high false alarm rate of power failure prediction in the prior art, and achieves the technical effects of improving the power failure prediction efficiency and improving the establishment rate of the twin model.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Optimized scheduling method, system, storage medium and equipment of energy digital twin model for sewage treatment plant
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric energy utilization, and provides an optimized scheduling method, a system, a storage medium and equipment of an energy digital twin model for a sewage treatment plant, wherein the method is used for preprocessing a sewage treatment system and constructing a process flow framework of the sewage treatment plant; and constructing an energy consumption digital twin model of each sewage treatment link according to a process flow framework of the sewage treatment plant, and constructing a daily-life optimized scheduling model of the sewage treatment plant under the electric power market background by considering the condition of the electric power market background and combining the electric power demand response market. The invention solves the problem of researching the optimal scheduling method under the environment of developing the electric power market by specific industrial load.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CORP

title_en: Power plant load visualization control method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twin, and discloses a digital twin-based power plant load visualization control method, which comprises the steps of obtaining power plant entity data to construct and integrate a power plant appearance three-dimensional model and an internal equipment three-dimensional model to obtain a static three-dimensional model, constructing a dynamic digital model based on a mechanism modeling method and a data driving modeling method, integrating the static three-dimensional model and the dynamic digital model to obtain a digital twin model, processing real-time operation data and historical operation data of a power plant based on a reinforcement learning algorithm and a deep learning algorithm to obtain a prediction result, judging an abnormal state based on the static three-dimensional model to obtain a judgment result, evaluating the severity of the abnormal state by using a rule model according to the judgment result to formulate a countermeasure, and calculating a scheduling instruction by using the countermeasure and a PID control algorithm based on the digital twin model to realize visual monitoring and control of the operation state of the power plant.
assignees: STATE GRID E COMMERCE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency water supply command management and control system and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency water supply command management and control system and a construction method thereof, wherein the constructed command management and control system comprises an emergency command decision large screen, emergency task management, a guarantee system, data management, system management, a mobile phone mobile terminal, a digital twin platform and a system interface; the system integrates links such as water finding, well forming, water lifting, water delivery, water purification and the like to form an integrated emergency water supply equipment system. The intelligent command management and control is realized through integrating control objects, functional modules and data flows. Each team can work cooperatively in real time and share information, and the response speed and the response efficiency of emergency water supply are improved. The system can effectively improve the emergency water supply guarantee capability of mountain areas and remote disaster areas, ensure that the survival requirements of people in disasters are met, and solve the problems of difficult data interaction, weak agile scheduling capability, low automation and intellectualization level and the like of the traditional emergency command management and control system.
assignees: UNIV JIANGSU

title_en: Nuclear power plant internal system and equipment evaluation analysis system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to an in-nuclear power plant system and equipment evaluation analysis system based on digital twin, which comprises a digital twin engine, a data storage library and an evaluation analysis model, wherein the digital twin engine is connected with the digital twin engine, the digital twin engine is provided with a data exchange interface, the digital twin engine acquires data in a production system and a service system of the nuclear power plant through the data exchange interface, the data are stored in the data storage library after being preprocessed and standardized, the data storage library is a relational database MySQL, and the evaluation analysis model receives the data stored in the data storage library and performs evaluation analysis and information display on the in-nuclear power plant system and equipment. The digital twin-based system and equipment evaluation analysis system in the nuclear power plant realize the imaging and visualization of the operation information content of the system of the nuclear power plant and form a fault database of the system of the nuclear power plant.
assignees: CNNC NUCLEAR POWER OPERATION MAN CO LTD;QINSHAN NUCLEAR POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method for deducting and evaluating digital twin situation of aircraft under complex meteorological environment
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for deducing and evaluating digital twin situations of an aircraft under a complex meteorological environment, which belongs to the technical field of data processing, and comprises the steps of collecting and processing weather data and covering parameters such as wind direction, wind speed and the like; acquiring performance parameters of the aircraft, building a library, and inputting and analyzing a flight plan. By establishing a three-dimensional deduction model comprising dynamics, weather influence and environmental models, the situation of the aircraft under different weather is deduced, and flight safety, performance and task risks are evaluated. The method has the advantages of comprehensively and accurately analyzing weather factors, quantifying influences through data acquisition and processing and meteorological models, being applicable to various aircrafts, integrating navigation and control systems, realizing remote monitoring management, being scientific and reliable in risk assessment, integrating multiple factors, providing powerful support for flight decisions, and effectively improving the safety and task success rate of the aircrafts in complex weather.
assignees: CHENGDU FEIHANG ZHIYUN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent building facility remote operation and maintenance device and method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of building operation and maintenance, in particular to a digital twin-based intelligent building facility remote operation and maintenance device and method, which aim at the problems that a server needs to be taken out in the existing moving process, the moving is inconvenient, the radiating effect of the server is poor in the wind flowing process, and the fire cannot be extinguished in time when a short-circuit fire disaster occurs, and the safety performance is poor, the invention provides a scheme which comprises an outer frame and a plurality of servers, wherein a backboard is fixedly arranged in the outer frame, a plurality of laminates are arranged between the backboard and the outer frame, the servers are respectively arranged on the corresponding laminates, and a door body is hinged to one side of the outer frame and used for protecting the server; according to the invention, the server can be automatically clamped through the clamping plate and the door body in a matched mode, the server can be effectively radiated through the matching of the exhaust fan and the exhaust fan with the outer frame and the back plate, and the fire can be automatically extinguished when a fire disaster occurs, so that the use is safer.
assignees: Fujian hongsheng construction group co ltd

title_en: Asset management method and system for power equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to an asset management method and system for electric equipment. Determining the selection probability of each dimension under the child nodes according to the distribution of the power data in the child nodes of the isolated tree of the power equipment, determining the segmentation necessity of the child nodes according to the time sequence regularity and the selection probability of the power data in the child nodes and the quantity of the power data in the child nodes, randomly selecting one dimension to divide the child nodes according to the unequal probability of the selection probability when the segmentation necessity is larger than a segmentation threshold value, continuously updating the isolated forest according to the newly generated power data, identifying the current state of the power equipment according to the abnormal score of the current power data, and synchronizing the current state of the power equipment to the digital twin model of the power equipment in real time to realize the monitoring and management of the power equipment assets. The method and the system are accurate and efficient in state identification of the power equipment, and the real-time performance of monitoring and management of the power equipment assets is improved.

title_en: Distribution network state estimation method and device based on trust domain
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of power distribution networks, in particular to a distribution network state estimation method and device based on a trust zone, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining upper and lower limits of active output and upper and lower limits of reactive output of a photovoltaic power generation system in a power distribution network of a power system; and optimizing and solving the power distribution network state estimation model by utilizing a preset trust domain algorithm to obtain a target solution so as to determine a power distribution network state estimation result of the power system by utilizing the target solution. Therefore, the problems of long algorithm iteration time, large occupied memory, poor applicability, reduced applicability and high efficiency of power system state estimation and the like in the related technology are solved.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV NORTH CHINA TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Power grid future operation trend generation method and system for simulation regulation and control of main distribution network
abstract_en: A power grid future operation trend generation method and system for simulation regulation and control of a main distribution network are characterized by comprising the steps of inputting load prediction data and tie line plan data into a topology model of the main distribution network, obtaining state estimation data in a space-time range to be simulated through power flow operation, constructing an initial section, analyzing power generation plan data, carrying out allocation of a power generation plan by using power proportion among model objects, obtaining a bus load prediction curve in the load prediction data and matching the bus load prediction curve with the model objects in the topology model of the main distribution network in real time, regulating the bus load prediction curve, carrying out simulation by using new energy prediction data to push out first power grid future operation trend data, carrying out simulation by using overhaul plan data to push out second power grid future operation trend data, and superposing a preset scheduling sequence in the first power grid future operation trend data or the second power grid future operation trend data to generate a power grid future operation trend based on a pre-scheduling event.

title_en: Method and system for detecting electric false data attack based on graph rolling network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a method and a system for detecting electric false data attack based on a graph rolling network. The method comprises the steps of carrying out power grid state estimation based on SCADA system data, carrying out false data injection attack detection based on the power grid state estimation, constructing a graph neural network based on false data injection attack detection and carrying out FDIA detection by utilizing the graph neural network, analyzing the detection result, and judging whether FDIA attack exists according to the calculation result of the node degree and the tuning parameter. By adopting the graph theory-based method for detection, the problem that the safety of the protected measurement data cannot be always ensured in the traditional method is solved.
assignees: UNIV YANTAI

title_en: Photovoltaic power generation system risk management and control method based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation, and discloses a photovoltaic power generation system risk management and control method based on a digital twin technology, which is used for collecting historical management and control data of a target to be risk managed and controlled, analyzing the historical management and control data and constructing a historical risk management and control behavior set based on an analysis result; the method comprises the steps of performing multi-angle analysis on a historical risk management and control behavior set, calculating a historical risk management and control value according to an analysis result, collecting current operation data of a target to be risk managed and controlled, inputting the current operation data into a risk management and control model, outputting the current risk management and control value of the target to be risk managed and controlled, calculating a comprehensive risk management and control value of the target to be risk managed and controlled based on the historical risk management and control value and the current risk management and control value, judging whether to perform risk management and control early warning on the target to be risk managed and controlled according to the comprehensive risk management and control value, and achieving intelligent risk management and control on a photovoltaic power generation system.
