assignees: HUANENG SHANXI COMPREHENSIVE ENERGY CO LTD;HUANENG YUSHE POVERTY ALLEVIATION ENERGY CO LTD;YUSHE PHOTOVOLTAIC POWER STATION OF HUANENG SHANXI INTEGRATED ENERGY CO LTD;LICHENG YINGHENG CLEAN ENERGY CO LTD;HUANENG RUICHENG COMPREHENSIVE ENERGY CO LTD;HUANENG ZUOQUAN YANGJIAO WIND POWER CO LTD;RUICHENG NINGSHENG NEW ENERGY CO LTD;WUZHAI TAIZHONG NEW ENERGY WIND POWER GENERATION CO LTD;SHUOZHOU TAIZHONG WIND POWER GENERATION CO LTD;FANSHI NENGYU WIND POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Emergency command system based on endophytic safety and command method thereof
abstract_en: An emergency command system and a command method thereof based on endophytic safety belong to the technical field of network space defense. The system comprises an emergency command platform, a safety protection platform and a digital twin platform, wherein the emergency command platform is connected with the safety protection platform, the safety protection platform is connected with the digital twin platform, the emergency command platform comprises an information management module, a multimedia collaboration module, a weather decision module, a map application module, an emergency plan module, a communication scheduling module, a daemon module, a field switching module, an application data temporary storage area and a coding identification area, and the safety protection platform comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module, a monitoring control module, an agent simulation module, a dynamic reconstruction module and a judging and tracing module. According to the invention, a dynamic defense strategy of the twin digital platform is formulated according to comprehensive income expectations, and an original frame of each built-in module of the digital twin platform is adjusted, so that the safety isolation of the digital twin platform is realized.
assignees: WEIMA IND GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic simulation method for digital twin flood flooding of medium and small river basin based on UE5
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic simulation method for digital twin flood flooding of a medium and small river basin based on UE 5. The method comprises the steps of constructing a two-dimensional hydrodynamic numerical model, creating a flood inundation simulation UE5 plug-in engineering, creating a flood role class, constructing a method for drawing triangular grid primitives of the flood model, constructing a method for rendering flood hydrologic characteristics and flood flow states, and realizing a digital twin flood inundation dynamic simulation process. The invention realizes the dynamic rendering and high-fidelity visualization of the flood model with ultra-large data volume in the digital twin three-dimensional scene of the middle and small drainage basin, expresses the multi-dimensional flood inundation numerical simulation results such as water level, water depth, flow velocity, flow direction and the like, and the complex flow state of the flood such as backflow, converging flow, bifurcation flow, flood beach flow, turbulent flow and the like, improves the authenticity and accuracy of flood inundation simulation, and is beneficial to enhancing the flood risk assessment and flood control plan decision support capability of the middle and small drainage basin.
assignees: CHANGJIANG XINDA SOFTWARE TECH WUHAN CO LTD

title_en: VMD-PCA-LSTM ultra-short-term wind power prediction method based on pelican optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The application discloses a VMD-PCA-LSTM ultra-short-term wind power prediction method based on a pelicans optimization algorithm. Firstly cleaning abnormal data of a wind power plant by a quartile method, interpolating missing data, selecting VMD decomposition sub-mode numbers by an energy difference method, decomposing an original power sequence of complex fluctuation, secondly extracting main components of high-dimensional meteorological data by PCA, reducing the mining difficulty of characteristic data, and finally introducing a pelicant optimization algorithm to automatically optimize four-dimensional super parameters of drop rate, learning rate, first hidden layer unit number and second hidden layer unit number of an LSTM prediction model so as to accelerate model convergence and improve fitting precision. The pelican optimization algorithm has simple structure, is easy to realize, has good expandability, and can optimize parameters of the LSTM model, thereby effectively improving the precision of wind power prediction.
assignees: POWERCHINA GUIZHOU ENG CO LTD

title_en: Full-prefabricated decoupling data center construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method of a full prefabrication decoupling type data center, which relates to the technical field of data processing, breaks through serial dependence of traditional civil construction and equipment deployment through modular design of container assembly and factory prefabrication production, realizes parallel propulsion of civil construction and module production, and optimizes a transportation plan and an assembly sequence by means of an intelligent scheduling algorithm, thereby obviously shortening a construction period, adopts a unified interface standard and combines a digital twin technology in a module prefabrication and assembly stage, and verifies compatibility and matching of a module interface by means of real-time data comparison, thereby effectively reducing readjustment cost caused by field construction errors and improving success rate of module assembly, adopts a deep learning algorithm to predict load dynamics and dynamically adjust refrigeration power and paths in a data center operation stage, and simultaneously realizes linkage resource allocation of power supply and distribution and refrigeration modules by combining a reinforcement learning technology, thereby maximizing energy efficiency of a system.

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for estimating harmonic state of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power systems and discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for estimating harmonic states of a power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the steps of dividing the power distribution network into a core measurement area and a local area based on topological features and node distribution of a radial power grid, and arranging the local areas with node connection relations according to numbers; based on the establishment and derivation of the measurement equation, carrying out harmonic state estimation on the core measurement area, updating the weight value of the estimation result in real time, and carrying out data estimation on the nodes with insufficient quantity measurement in the local area according to the node history harmonic state estimation data to obtain node supplementary data; and carrying out harmonic state estimation on each local area by integrating the harmonic state estimation result of the core measurement area, the measurement data in the local area and the node supplementary data. The method is suitable for the common radial power distribution network and the power distribution network with the cloud edge end cooperative architecture, and the calculation workload and the calculation time are greatly reduced.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Digital twinning-based shore power equipment management and control method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based shore power equipment management and control method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of processing first operation monitoring data of each shore power equipment acquired in real time to respectively obtain temperature time sequence data, power time sequence data and pollution discharge time sequence data, processing second operation monitoring data of a target shore power ship acquired in real time to obtain ship power time sequence data, constructing a target shore power digital twin model, acquiring a pollution discharge monitoring key matrix and a power monitoring key matrix, calculating a power supply relative stable index and a power pollution contribution index, determining shore power equipment to be selected, calculating corresponding overload rest factors and a ship shore switching smooth index, acquiring a target shore power equipment sequence, and displaying the target shore power digital twin model to manage and control the shore power equipment in real time. According to the shore power equipment management and control method and system based on digital twinning, which are provided by the embodiment of the invention, the management and control efficiency of the shore power equipment is improved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU SOUTH CHINA OCEANGATE CONTAINER TERMINAL CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network load state estimation method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution network load state estimation, in particular to a power distribution network load state estimation method and system. The method comprises the following steps of estimating the load state of the power distribution network by comprehensively analyzing the load state of the power distribution network, the load change of a transformer, the potential difference of the voltage and the risk of thermal runaway. Firstly, acquiring load log data of a power distribution network, marking node conduction paths, then, extracting transformer load change data, performing non-uniform voltage potential difference simulation, estimating thermal runaway risk probability among different nodes, defining a conduction influence range according to the thermal runaway risk probability data, dividing risk grades, and finally, constructing a load state estimation model by using a strategy gradient algorithm, and uploading the load state estimation model to a cloud platform for execution. According to the invention, the load state estimation technology of the power distribution network is more perfect through optimizing the load state estimation technology of the power distribution network.

title_en: Intelligent rural energy source monitoring and scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rural energy scheduling, in particular to an intelligent rural energy monitoring and scheduling method. The method comprises the steps of carrying out rural energy real-time monitoring processing through a rural energy digital twin platform, constructing a rural energy distribution network according to real-time rural energy data, carrying out rural energy consumption anomaly analysis according to historical rural energy consumption data, carrying out energy distribution network optimization reconstruction processing on the rural energy distribution network based on the rural energy consumption anomaly data, carrying out rural energy correction processing on rural energy storage anomaly transmission data based on the reconstructed rural energy distribution network, designing a rural energy scheduling strategy based on rural energy demand data and corrected rural energy data, carrying out rural energy scheduling operation and carrying out rural energy scheduling data monitoring processing in real time, and carrying out dynamic optimization operation on the rural energy scheduling strategy based on the real-time rural energy scheduling data. The invention realizes intelligent monitoring and scheduling of rural energy.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Power grid data reconstruction method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for reconstructing power grid data, and relates to a data processing technology, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a sample data set according to collected power grid accident information, wherein the power grid accident information comprises at least two accident dimensions, and each accident dimension comprises a plurality of accident data; the method comprises the steps of carrying out feature extraction on accident data corresponding to at least two accident dimensions to obtain accident features corresponding to each accident dimension, training a preset network model based on the accident features corresponding to each accident dimension to obtain a data reconstruction model, and inputting accident texts corresponding to a target power grid accident into the data reconstruction model to obtain missing data of the target power grid accident. The application can output the missing data corresponding to any power grid accident through the trained data reconstruction model so as to ensure the integrity of the accident data, thereby being beneficial to improving the accuracy and reliability of the output result of the early warning model when the early warning model is trained according to the complete accident data.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;HUIZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method for automatically generating photovoltaic calculation report
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for automatically generating a photovoltaic calculation report, which belongs to the technical field of photovoltaic design automation and comprises the following operation steps of determining a photovoltaic design scheme and a digital twin model. And the second step of data acquisition, wherein in the data acquisition stage, two types of data sources are adopted, namely the first type of data is the data determined by the design scheme of the photovoltaic engineering, and the second type of data is the data of the photovoltaic engineering, which adopts different design modes. And thirdly, carrying out data processing, and carrying out calculation by adopting the processes of installed capacity calculation, component serial number calculation, serial-parallel checking calculation and cable calculation which correspond to different fields of photovoltaic design respectively but are important and complicated. And fourthly, converting the data, clicking to export a calculation report, and storing the md file on a desktop. By realizing the automatic calculation and generation of the photovoltaic calculation report, the time required by calculation in the photovoltaic design process is reduced, the work difficulty is reduced, the workload is reduced, and the efficiency of the whole photovoltaic power station design process is improved.
assignees: ZHEJIANG SOUTHEAST SPACEFRAME

title_en: Power distribution network bearing capacity evaluation method considering electric automobile access and terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network bearing capacity assessment method and terminal for electric vehicle access, the method comprises the steps of obtaining historical charging data of electric vehicle charging piles in a target assessment area, obtaining historical environment data in the target assessment area based on a context sensing mechanism, inputting the historical charging data and the historical environment data into a deep reinforcement learning model for training to obtain a target deep reinforcement learning model, inputting target condition data into the target deep reinforcement learning model for prediction, calculating predicted charging load in the target assessment area according to a prediction result, inputting the predicted charging load into a pre-constructed power distribution network digital twin model for dynamically assessing the power distribution network bearing capacity in the target assessment area, and determining whether the power distribution network in the target assessment area can bear the predicted charging load under the target condition data. The method and the device can improve the accuracy of the load bearing capacity evaluation of the power distribution network.
assignees: STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power load prediction method and system based on RF-TCN-FEDFORMER
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power engineering, and particularly discloses a power load prediction method and a power load prediction system based on RF-TCN-FEDFORMER, wherein the method comprises the following steps of: the method comprises the steps of S1, obtaining power load data and influence factor data of a certain area to form an original data set, S2, preprocessing the data, namely, complementing missing data in abnormal data, correcting deviation data in the abnormal data, normalizing the data, dividing the data into a training set, a verification set and a test set according to a certain proportion, S3, constructing a power load prediction model based on an RF-TCN-FEDformer, comprising the construction of a network structure and the setting of relevant super parameters, S4, training the power load prediction model based on the RF-TCN-FEDformer, which is built in the third step, S5, predicting the power load based on the obtained power load prediction model, storing the predicted power load data prediction value into a database, and providing a reliable basis for a power grid power generation plan through the prediction result of the RF-TCN-FEDformer short-term power load model.
assignees: FUYANG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Two-dimensional security risk assessment method for data-driven state estimation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-dimensional security risk assessment method for data-driven state estimation, which relates to the technical field of security risk assessment and comprises the steps of firstly establishing a data-driven state estimation model based on an artificial neural network architecture, measuring the nonlinear relation between analog quantity and state quantity, further, initiating a countermeasure attack by using CGAN to the data-driven state estimation model based on an attacker view angle, then assessing the security risk faced by the state estimation under the countermeasure attack from two dimensions, wherein the first dimension is attack cost and resources required to be input by the attacker during the countermeasure attack implementation, the second dimension is business vulnerability assessment, and the attack strength and concealment of the countermeasure attack are assessed, and finally, establishing a two-dimensional security risk assessment system according to the logic sequence of occurrence of the attack.

title_en: Digital twinning-based intelligent power grid global data monitoring management system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based intelligent power grid global data monitoring management system and method, which relate to the technical field of power grid data, and comprise a user data classification module, a historical abnormal event capturing module, a characteristic response model construction module, a priority ordering module and a response encryption module, wherein the user data classification module is used for classifying user data based on power grid operation data, the historical abnormal event capturing module is used for capturing historical abnormal events triggering response in a digital twin model, the characteristic response model construction module is used for analyzing characteristic response models of each type of user data corresponding to each historical abnormal event, the priority ordering module is used for carrying out priority ordering on the user data of the corresponding type by utilizing characteristic response frequency, and the response encryption module is used for encrypting the user data conforming to the characteristic response model according to the priority order of the user data.
assignees: JIANGSU RESOURCEFULNESS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mu PMU optimization layout method, system, equipment and medium for micro-grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mu PMU (power management unit) optimal layout method, a mu PMU optimal layout system, mu PMU optimal layout equipment and mu PMU optimal layout medium for a micro-grid, and belongs to the technical field of power systems. The method comprises the steps of constructing a power grid data acquisition model, a layout generation model, a layout update model and a layout evaluation model, establishing an objective function with the maximum comprehensive association information degree as an objective to obtain initial layout position information of mu PMU, updating the initial layout position information of mu PMU based on observability and mutual information quantity to obtain optimal layout position information of mu PMU, determining optimal layout configuration information of mu PMU based on state estimation precision of a micro-grid, and completing optimal layout of mu PMU of the micro-grid, so that the installation quantity and installation position of mu PMU can be comprehensively considered, the allocation quantity of mu PMU can be effectively reduced, the layout cost of mu PMU is reduced, the maximization of economic benefit is realized, popularization and use of mu PMU configuration methods are facilitated, and meanwhile, the optimal allocation method of mu PMU based on node association information similarity is considered, and the state estimation precision of ADN of an active power distribution network can be effectively improved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV HANGZHOU DIANZI

title_en: Wind power ultra-short-term prediction error correction method and system based on meteorological data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power ultra-short-term prediction error correction method and system based on meteorological data, and relates to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a target meteorological time sequence, reading a preset meteorological analysis strategy, analyzing the target meteorological time sequence based on the preset meteorological analysis strategy to obtain a target predicted wind energy resource value, traversing preset characteristic indexes in multi-dimensional characteristic information obtained by multi-dimensional characteristic collection of a target wind power plant to obtain target characteristic information, carrying out simulated power generation on the target characteristic information in a digital twin wind power plant model to obtain simulated power generation, and correcting the simulated power generation by taking the target predicted wind energy resource value as a coefficient to obtain the target predicted power generation, wherein the target predicted power generation refers to a power generation predicted value of the target wind power plant in a preset ultra-short period. The technical problem of insufficient wind power ultra-short-term prediction precision in the prior art is solved, and the technical effect of improving the wind power ultra-short-term power generation amount prediction accuracy is achieved.

title_en: Digital twinning-based power transformation and distribution equipment state early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power transformation and distribution equipment early warning, in particular to a digital twinning-based power transformation and distribution equipment state early warning method and system. The method comprises the steps of collecting a state matrix of any transformer in a power distribution network in a preset time period after pretreatment, inputting the state matrix into a sparse self-coding network to obtain a state coding vector, grouping the transformers according to preset state labels of each transformer to obtain a plurality of grouping results, calculating the deviation degree of the transformers according to the state coding vector, constructing a loss function according to the deviation degree, and training the classification network based on the loss function to finish state early warning. By the technical scheme, the accuracy of the abnormal detection result of the power transformation and distribution equipment can be improved, and the safe operation of the power transformation and distribution equipment is ensured.
assignees: HENAN YUBIAN ELECTROTECHNICS CO LTD;HENAN TIANLI ELECTRIC EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic power station design method based on digital twin model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a photovoltaic power station design method based on a digital twin model, which belongs to the technical field of photovoltaic system simulation and comprises the following operation steps of firstly, performing basic investment approximate calculation and investment return estimation on the whole project by a return on investment estimation module. And secondly, the grid-connected calculation tool module is used for design calculation of the photovoltaic power station. And thirdly, creating a digital platform carrier for the scheme design stage, the scheme optimization stage and the operation and maintenance stage of the whole photovoltaic power station through a digital twin model. And fourthly, carrying out design scheme type serial-parallel connection on the array photovoltaic module and the inverter through the system serial-parallel connection module. And fifthly, exporting the data file and directly importing the data file into simulation software. And step six, timely adjusting and correcting the simulation result in the digital model until the optimal design scheme is achieved. The digital twin system of the grid-connected photovoltaic power station is used for creating the digital twin model and realizing the practical application of the digital twin model.

title_en: System and method for evaluating operation suitability of power plant based on digital twin, and computer recording medium comprising the same
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 기반의 발전소 운영 적합성 평가 시스템, 그 방법 및 이를 기록한 컴퓨터 기록 매체
abstract_en: Provided are a system and method for evaluating the operation suitability of a digital twin-based power plant, and a computer recording medium recording the same. The system includes: i) a power plant operation human-machine interface (HMI) unit; ii) a power plant model unit controlled by the power plant operation HMI unit and simulating the same as an actual power plant; and iii) a power plant performance evaluation unit evaluating the performance of the power plant according to the simulation of the power plant model unit, the power plant model unit comprises: i) a power plant control model unit having the same control logic as the actual power plant and converting an operation signal of the power plant operation HMI unit into a control signal; ii) a power plant process model unit receiving the control signal and simulating a power generation process; and iii) a power plant virtual physical model unit generating physical quantity information of the power plant that cannot be measured in reality according to the simulation.
abstract_ko: 디지털 트윈 기반의 발전소 운영 적합성 평가 시스템, 그 방법 및 이를 기록한 컴퓨터 기록 매체를 제공한다.  발전소 운영 적합성 평가 시스템은 i) 발전설비 조작 HMI(human-machine interface, 휴먼 머신 인터페이스) 유닛, ii) 발전설비 조작 HMI 유닛에 의해 제어되고, 실제 발전설비와 동일하게 시뮬레이션하는 발전설비 모델 유닛, 및 iii) 발전설비 모델 유닛의 시뮬레이션에 따라 발전설비의 성능을 평가하는 발전설비 성능 평가 유닛을 포함한다.  발전설비 모델 유닛은, i) 실제 발전설비와 동일한 제어 로직을 가져서 발전설비 조작 HMI 유닛의 조작 신호를 제어 신호로 변환하는 발전설비 제어 모델부, ii) 제어 신호를 입력받아 발전 공정을 시뮬레이션하는 발전설비 공정 모델부, 및 iii) 시뮬레이션에 따라 현실에서 측정 불가능한 발전설비의 물리량 정보를 생성하는 발전설비 가상 물리 모델부를 포함한다.
assignees: KOREA ELECTRIC POWER CORP;KOREA SOUTH EAST POWER CO LTD;KOREA MIDLAND POWER CO LTD;KOREA WESTERN POWER CO LTD;KOREA SOUTH POWER CO LTD;KOREA EAST WEST POWER CO LTD

title_en: Electric power collaborative reasoning scheduling method and system of electric power intelligent center platform
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a power collaborative reasoning scheduling method and system of a power intelligent center platform, and belongs to the technical field of power reasoning scheduling. The power collaborative reasoning scheduling method comprises the steps of obtaining power equipment of a transformer substation, constructing a digital twin model of the transformer substation according to the power equipment of the transformer substation, synchronizing real-time data of the power equipment of the transformer substation to the digital twin model, constructing the digital twin model of the transformer substation according to the power equipment of the transformer substation, performing real-time simulation operation on the power equipment of the transformer substation, simultaneously constructing a power collaborative reasoning scheduling model, inputting real-time operation data to the power collaborative reasoning scheduling model to obtain an optimal solution of power scheduling, and inputting the optimal solution to the digital twin model for simulation operation, so that feasibility and effect of the optimal scheduling scheme can be effectively verified.
assignees: STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD;ANHUI JIYUAN SOFTWARE CO LTD

title_en: Iterative detection method for multiplicative false data injection attack
abstract_en: The invention relates to an iterative detection method for multiplicative false data injection attack, which comprises the steps of S1, establishing a measurement equation and a state estimation model for state estimation of a distributed power system, S2, aiming at an ith sensor node of the system, obtaining actual measurement, and S3, carrying out iterative Kalman filtering detection for the multiplicative false data injection attack based on the actual measurement, the measurement equation and the state estimation model. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of improving accuracy of detection of multiplicative false data injection attack in the distributed system and the like.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI DIANJI

title_en: Power distribution network tower abnormity monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for monitoring abnormity of a power distribution network tower, which relate to the technical field of tower monitoring and comprise the steps of arranging a multi-mode sensor on the power distribution network tower and collecting tower state data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model of the power distribution network pole tower, inputting pole tower state data, predicting the future state of the pole tower, periodically inspecting the pole tower by using an unmanned aerial vehicle, collecting dynamic three-dimensional data of the pole tower, fusing the pole tower state data, the future state prediction result of the pole tower and the dynamic three-dimensional data of the pole tower, monitoring the pole tower for abnormality and early warning. The invention relates to a method for manufacturing a semiconductor device. By applying the multisource data fusion technology, the accuracy and reliability of anomaly detection are effectively improved, a grading early warning mechanism based on comprehensive anomaly indexes provides professional guidance for maintenance personnel, the fault processing efficiency is improved, the accuracy and timeliness of monitoring the tower anomalies are remarkably improved, predictive maintenance and intelligent management are realized, and the safety and reliability of the power distribution network are greatly enhanced.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network state estimation method based on matrix filling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network state estimation method based on matrix filling, which relates to the field of power distribution networks, and aims to solve the problem of power distribution network state estimation based on matrix filling, wherein the influence of power distribution network line parameter deviation on state estimation precision is weakened by utilizing a regular term processing power flow constraint of a penalty function method, a weight matrix aiming at the problem of matrix filling state estimation is designed, the bias of different error levels measured by different types on a matrix filling result is balanced, so that the state estimation precision is improved, the PALM algorithm is improved by introducing extrapolation quantity into a APALM algorithm, the convergence speed is accelerated, the global optimal solution is approached, and the state estimation precision is improved and the solving time is shortened when the power distribution network state estimation problem based on matrix filling is solved. The invention realizes the high-precision power distribution network state estimation based on the SCADA real-time measurement data of part of nodes under the conditions of only SCADA configuration and incomplete measurement, and realizes the high-precision power distribution network state estimation higher than the pseudo measurement frequency.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: Digital twin system of green hydrogen coupling coal chemical industry is cooperated to source lotus
abstract_en: The invention provides a source-load synergistic green hydrogen coupling coal chemical industry digital twin system, and belongs to the technical field of coal chemical industry production. The source-load collaborative green hydrogen coupling coal chemical industry digital twin system comprises a coal chemical industry system and a green electricity green hydrogen system. The method comprises the steps of receiving hydrogen and oxygen by a coal chemical system as raw materials, using the hydrogen and the oxygen as chemical production, improving the utilization efficiency of resources, reducing the waste of byproducts, controlling the electric energy generation part to transmit first residual electric energy formed after the electric energy generation part is used for supplying the raw materials to the coal chemical system for use by the coal chemical system when the first predicted power consumption is smaller than the electric energy generated by the electric energy generation part, improving the utilization rate of the electric energy, fully utilizing the hydrogen and the oxygen generated by green electricity and green hydrogen, providing raw materials for the coal chemical production process, being beneficial to energy conservation and emission reduction in the coal chemical industry, constructing a multi-element complementary comprehensive energy supply system, providing a huge application scene for the development of the green electricity and the green hydrogen, and reducing the construction and operation costs of a secondary system through integrated construction.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: Self-adaptive dynamic state estimation method, device, equipment and medium for power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power distribution network self-adaptive dynamic state estimation method, a device, equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps of establishing a power distribution network dynamic state estimation model, comprising a state equation and a measurement equation, wherein the measurement equation is a power system state estimation linear measurement equation based on PMU measurement, setting a measurement noise covariance matrix based on the statistical property of PMU device phasor errors, carrying out self-adaptive estimation on measurement noise according to the latest measurement before each state estimation, carrying out power distribution network dynamic state estimation by utilizing a Kalman filtering method, taking time-varying posterior statistics of process noise into consideration in the Kalman filtering process, and carrying out self-adaptive adjustment on the process noise covariance matrix by a forgetting memory method. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of accurately predicting the change degree of the state, tracking the dynamic change of the system and the like.

title_en: Index system construction method and system for electric power market operation
abstract_en: The invention provides an index system construction method and system for electric power market operation, wherein the method comprises the steps of integrating data of electric power markets from different sources, preprocessing the data, obtaining the preprocessed data, carrying out data self-supervision data extraction from the preprocessed data, constructing an electric power market multi-task element learning optimization model, constructing and dynamically adjusting a real-time operation index system of the electric power market, constructing a multi-objective strategy optimization algorithm, designing an optimal market strategy according to the real-time adjusted market index, and carrying out system learning and system self-adaption updating according to the optimal market strategy to keep optimal performance. According to the invention, through combining meta learning and self-supervision learning technologies, the system can be quickly adapted under different market environments and scenes, and key operation indexes are automatically mined and generated from large-scale unmarked electric power market data, so that real-time updating and optimization of an index system are realized.
assignees: GUANGZHOU ELECTRIC POWER TRANSACTION CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent emergency command system and method based on scene twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of communication command, in particular to a scene twinning-based intelligent emergency command system and a scene twinning-based intelligent emergency command method. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a scene twinning management module, an emergency situation analysis module, an emergency response decision module and a resource scheduling command module. The multi-source data of the emergency scene is acquired through the sensor network, a scene twinning model is constructed by utilizing the augmented reality and digital twinning technology, and real-time rendering of the virtual scene is realized. And (3) carrying out emergency situation analysis by combining a random matrix theory and a graph neural network algorithm, detecting risks, predicting trends, generating an emergency response strategy by utilizing a decision tree based on analysis reports, and simultaneously scheduling and distributing resources by a multi-objective optimization algorithm to ensure an optimal emergency command scheme. The invention improves the efficiency and scientificity of emergency command and enhances the rapidity and accuracy of emergency response.

title_en: Digital twinning-based multi-model coupling water quality optimization method, system and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based multi-model coupling water quality optimization method, system and equipment, and belongs to the technical field of urban water pollution simulation. The existing water quality optimization scheme is mainly applied to a single system, lacks comprehensive consideration of the synergistic effect of multiple systems in a complex urban environment, and cannot predict the diffusion of pollutants and optimize the layout scheme of an urban underground pipe network. The digital twin-based multi-model coupling water quality optimization method obtains the sudden pollution diffusion information by simulating the hydrologic process and carrying out the sudden pollution diffusion simulation calculation, and obtains the hydraulic building operation optimization scheme based on the digital twin mechanism and the sudden pollution diffusion information, so that the urban sudden pollution diffusion can be fully simulated and optimally scheduled, the sudden pollution diffusion can be timely controlled, the hysteresis of manual intervention and decision can be greatly reduced, the scheduling response time is obviously shortened, and the emergency treatment efficiency is improved.
assignees: ZHEJIANG YUANSUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network FTU optimal configuration method considering reliability and state estimation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network FTU optimal configuration method considering reliability and state estimation, which comprises the steps of obtaining power distribution network information, dividing sections according to FTU positions, constructing a power distribution network topological graph based on a directed graph, analyzing fault outage loss and fault probability of the sections, calculating a system EDNS value, giving a FTU configuration quantity N  f , constructing a mathematical model based on a directed graph method with a minimization system EDNS as a target, solving to obtain a FTU configuration scheme with highest reliability, carrying out state estimation analysis on the FTU configuration scheme, if the accuracy requirement is not met, increasing the FTU configuration quantity N  f , and selecting the minimum FTU quantity meeting the state estimation accuracy requirement as a final configuration scheme. The invention can obtain the FTU configuration scheme with highest reliability, and can minimize the quantity of the FTUs under the condition of meeting the system precision requirement by matching with the state estimation analysis on the basis, and furthest reduce the configuration cost of the FTUs under the condition of considering the reliability of the power distribution network and the system state estimation precision.
assignees: JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST

title_en: Digital twin intelligent fortune dimension evaluation system of energy dissipation damping part
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent disaster prevention, and particularly relates to a digital twin intelligent operation and maintenance and evaluation system of an energy dissipation and vibration reduction component. The system comprises an intelligent perception module, a fidelity reduced-order model and a virtual-real interaction intelligent decision module, and provides a solution for intelligent operation and maintenance of the energy dissipation and vibration reduction component through integration of technologies such as a digital twin technology, an Internet of things technology and edge calculation. The invention adopts digital twin technology to establish the fidelity virtual twin body of the energy dissipation and shock absorption component, and uses the means of the virtual sensor to 'perspective' the overall performance state of the component, thereby providing a new technology for the full life cycle operation and maintenance of the component. By means of the technology, the performance state of the engineering structure core component can be mastered in real time, so that the engineering structure core component can be kept in a full-time on-line transparent state in the whole life cycle, and the disaster resistance and toughness capabilities of the engineering structure are improved as a whole.

title_en: Power grid dispatching training method and system based on panoramic digital twin simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid dispatching training method and system based on panoramic digital twin simulation, which relate to the technical field of power grid dispatching and comprise the steps of obtaining operation data of a power grid and constructing a power grid digital twin model; the method comprises the steps of performing power grid operation scene and fault simulation according to operation data of a power grid, performing power grid operation and scheduling decision on a power grid digital twin model according to selected power grid operation scene and fault type, and performing feedback and evaluation on the power grid operation and scheduling decision. According to the invention, the power grid digital twin model, the power grid operation and scheduling decision twin model are constructed, the power grid operation and scheduling decision twin model reconstruction is carried out, and the power grid scheduling training simulation is carried out through a plurality of twin models, so that a real training environment is provided, the training efficiency and quality of a dispatcher are improved, and the safety and reliability of power grid scheduling are enhanced. The comprehensive, real and interactive training platform is provided for the power grid dispatcher, and the professional skills and emergency processing capacity of the power grid dispatcher are effectively improved.
assignees: TECH COLLEGE BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORPORATION;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;Shandong electric power college

title_en: Abnormality detection method, device and medium for steady-state operation of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an abnormality detection method, device and medium for steady-state operation of an electric power system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining operation data of the electric power system; the method comprises the steps of establishing a probability model containing an input random influence factor according to operation data to obtain probability statistical characteristics of output variables of the power system, carrying out state prediction and missing data replacement on the probability statistical characteristics through a long-period memory network to obtain complete system measurement data, and carrying out abnormal data detection on the complete system measurement data to obtain an abnormal detection result of the power system. The invention provides an abnormality detection method, device and medium for steady-state operation of a power system, which are used for acquiring the probability statistical characteristic of an output variable of the power system by considering uncertainty factors and perfecting the probability statistical characteristic, so that the integrity and effectiveness of data are maintained, the abnormality condition of the power system is accurately identified, and the problem that the power system is difficult to accurately detect the abnormality is solved.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Evaluation analysis management system for mine underground space
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine transportation data processing, in particular to an evaluation analysis management system for mine underground space, which realizes comprehensive evaluation of the mine underground space by integrating data acquisition, image modification, calling and evaluation analysis units, generates mine underground space basic image data by using a digital twin model, and updating construction and production information in real time, when the natural environment or basic data of the mine exceeds a preset safety value, automatically generating real-time image data to be evaluated by the system, and outputting an evaluation result of the underground space of the mine by the evaluation analysis unit through coordinate point configuration, potential safety hazard area matching and comprehensive evaluation models. The invention improves the evaluation precision and efficiency, realizes dynamic monitoring and early warning, and provides powerful guarantee for mine safety production.
assignees: YANTAI JINHE NEW MATERIAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Automatic power distribution network drawing method and system based on TSN network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power distribution networks, and particularly discloses a power distribution network automatic drawing method and system based on a TSN network. The invention provides a new drawing method, namely, a method for giving a data model by a power distribution network equipment device, wherein an upper computer system can automatically distinguish the data model types, display monitoring data acquired by the power distribution network equipment device and automatically draw a graphic of a power distribution network graphic primitive, and the method is used for carrying out real-time transmission, monitoring and dynamic processing of the power distribution network data by introducing a TSN (transmission system network). The method of the invention ensures that the data of all equipment devices in the power distribution network can be kept consistent in time by utilizing the high-precision time synchronization characteristic of the TSN network, and realizes the accurate generation and real-time update of the power distribution network wiring diagram. Meanwhile, the reliable transmission of data is guaranteed due to the deterministic data transmission capability of the TSN network, and the operation efficiency and reliability of the power distribution network are further improved.

title_en: Device and method for power peak management based on digital twin cost mode
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 비용모델 기반 전력피크 관리장치 및 방법
abstract_en: According to one embodiment, a device and a method for power peak management based on a digital twin cost model dynamically construct a digital twin cost model regarding the power peak reduction effect, the production activity degradation cost, and the living environment degradation cost that occur when power consumption reduction control is performed for each facility in factories, buildings, or other structures, thereby enabling the digital twin cost model to be used for power peak control. In one embodiment, the digital twin cost model is periodically updated in real time to optimally perform power peak control. The digital twin cost model provided in one embodiment dynamically updates, for each individual facility, the reduced amount of power peak achieved when power shutdown or power-saving control is performed for each individual facility, the converted cost of electricity bill savings resulting from the reduced amount of power peak, and the costs associated with production activity degradation and living environment degradation resulting from the control of each individual facility.
abstract_ko: 실시예에 따른 디지털 트윈 비용모델 기반 전력피크 관리장치 및 방법은 공장, 건물, 빌딩 등에서 각 설비마다 전력소비절감 제어를 수행한 경우, 전력피크 절감 효과 및 생산활동 저하, 거주환경 저하 비용에 대한 디지털 트윈 비용모델을 동적으로 구성하여 전력피크 제어에 활용할 수 있도록 한다. 실시예에서는 전력피크 제어를 최적으로 수행하기 위해, 디지털 트윈 비용모델을 주기적으로 실시간 업데이트한다. 실시예에서 제공하는 디지털 트윈 비용모델은, 개별설비마다 전원차단 또는 전원절감 제어를 수행했을 때 각각의 전력피크 절감량, 그리고, 전력피크 절감량으로 인한 전력요금 절감 환산 비용, 개별설비 제어에 따른 생산활동 저하 비용 및 거주환경 저하 비용을 동적으로 업데이트 한다.
assignees: BYTEWORX INC

title_en: Power failure warning method, device, electronic equipment and computer readable medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure discloses a power failure warning method, a device, electronic equipment and a computer readable medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a real-time digital twin model, obtaining a target device identification in response to receiving device fault detection information, obtaining a power device association relation map from a distributed server, primarily cutting the power device association relation map according to the target device identification to generate a first cut map, determining first outage influence range information according to the first cut map, obtaining a distribution map from the distributed server, screening at least one piece of first key facility object information from the distribution map, and displaying a first real-time area image corresponding to a first power supply subarea in the real-time digital twin model. The embodiment can quickly and efficiently generate corresponding relevant power failure information aiming at the fault equipment, and timely perform subsequent power equipment maintenance to ensure stable power supply.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Digital twinning-based power grid support performance evaluation system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems and discloses a digital twin-based power grid supporting performance evaluation system and method, wherein the system comprises a data acquisition and processing module, a digital twin model construction and integration module, a multi-scene simulation and prediction evaluation module, an intelligent scheduling and fault prediction module, a multi-source data fusion and big data analysis module, a performance evaluation and optimization decision module and a visualization and man-machine interaction module: the data acquisition and processing module is used for acquiring real-time state, load data and external environment data of equipment in the physical power grid. The system can monitor and optimize the new energy access process in real time through an intelligent scheduling algorithm, a digital twin model and a fault prediction technology, so that the challenge of new energy power generation fluctuation to the stability of the power grid is solved, the algorithm can dynamically adjust the load distribution of the power grid under the condition that the new energy is accessed or fluctuates in a concentrated manner, potential faults are predicted in advance, and the stability of power transmission and the safety of equipment are ensured.
assignees: HUANENG FUXIN WIND POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Water conservancy digital twin informatization management platform
abstract_en: The invention provides a water conservancy digital twin informatization management platform which comprises a data input module, a data acquisition module, a data processing module, a digital twin module, a data transmission module, a data analysis module, a judgment module, a risk assessment module, an emergency scheme generation module, a master control module, a database module, an information feedback module, a display module and an early warning module. According to the invention, by simulating emergency, on the basis of matching with the digital twin model of the flood prevention dam, the bearing capacity characteristic value of the dam after emergency treatment is calculated, compared with the corresponding threshold value, whether an emergency scheme is feasible or not is judged, if the emergency scheme is feasible, the optimal scheme is output, the optimal emergency scheme can be obtained on the basis of saving manpower and material resources and reducing emergency risks, the risk and cost of emergency treatment of the flood prevention dam are reduced, and if the scheme is not feasible, the working of the early warning module is controlled by the master control module to warn staff, so that emergency treatment of the flood is facilitated.
assignees: ANHUI DANFENGYUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based power inspection method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a digital twinning-based power inspection method and system, and belongs to the field of power system risk monitoring. According to the method, the device characteristic quantized value related to the power risk is obtained by inputting the collected device state data, power load data, environment data and service life data of the power device into a pre-trained digital twin model, further, the characteristic index of the power device is obtained according to the device characteristic quantized value, then, the comprehensive risk value is obtained according to the power index, and when the comprehensive risk value is larger than a preset risk threshold value, an early warning signal is generated. According to the collected data of the multi-dimensional power equipment, the power equipment is inspected, and the running state of the power equipment is comprehensively and accurately reflected.
assignees: PINGGAO GROUP CO LTD;PINGGAO INTEGRATED ENERGY SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic correction method and system for power curve of wind farm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic correction method and a dynamic correction system for a power curve of a wind power plant, which are characterized in that through multidimensional real-time data acquisition and edge calculation pretreatment and combination of deep learning and reinforcement learning algorithm, the accurate dynamic correction of the power curve is realized, the accuracy and the instantaneity of power prediction are greatly improved, the reliability of an optimization strategy is enhanced by the introduction of a digital twin system, the reliability and the traceability of data are ensured by a blockchain technology, the trans-scene knowledge migration is realized by a federal element learning framework, the generalization capability and the adaptability of the model are improved, the comprehensive optimization scheme remarkably improves the power generation efficiency of the wind power plant, the equipment failure rate and the operation and maintenance cost are reduced, and the service life of a fan is prolonged.
assignees: HUANENG LANCANGJIANG NEW ENERGY CO LTD;XIAN THERMAL POWER RES INST CO

title_en: Coordinated optimization method for precision-generalization capability of power distribution network state estimation model based on evolution intermediate domain
abstract_en: The invention relates to a coordinated optimization method of power distribution network state estimation model precision-generalization capability based on an evolution intermediate domain. The method comprises the steps of respectively preprocessing daily measurement data in consideration of measurement accuracy, time scale and state estimation calculation synchronism of multi-source data, establishing a multi-layer output single hidden layer state estimation initial model of a power distribution network by using distributed power supply output and measurement data of power distribution network operation as a training data total set through a semi-supervised learning method, providing a pseudo-marking method on the basis of an SSL method, adding a pseudo-label to unlabeled measurement data by using the state estimation initial model to generate pseudo-measurement data, solving the problem of less training model data, designing a progressive antagonism pseudo-marking model to obtain a power distribution network SE model with higher accuracy, providing a double-calibration generalization model, and providing a power distribution network SE model accuracy-generalization capacity coordination optimization method considering an evolution intermediate domain.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ZHENJIANG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;UNIV JIANGSU

title_en: Power distribution network state estimation fusion strategy based on maximum correlation entropy criterion
abstract_en: The utility model provides a power distribution network state estimation fusion strategy based on maximum correlation entropy criteria, which is characterized in that a maximum correlation entropy criteria is adopted to establish an objective function compared with a basic weighted least square estimation method, a state estimator based on the maximum correlation entropy criteria is used in power distribution network state estimation according to the maximum correlation entropy criteria combined with an adjustable Parzen window, a phasor measurement system is fully utilized on the basis of a traditional measurement system, a mixed estimation structure is adopted to respectively carry out fusion processing on results obtained by two measurement data estimation, so that an optimal estimation value is obtained, an algorithm based on the maximum correlation entropy criteria is combined with the fusion structure to be used in power distribution network state estimation, and simulation analysis is carried out on an improved IEEE33 node power distribution network system. The invention provides a power distribution network state estimation method based on the maximum correlation entropy criterion, and simultaneously utilizes a mixed two-stage estimation system structure to fully utilize high-quality phasor measurement on the premise of guaranteeing widely used state estimation measurement data.
assignees: XUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH CO STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: New energy power station perception control method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of new energy power station control, and particularly discloses a new energy power station perception control method and system, wherein the new energy power station perception control method and system comprise S1, data acquisition, S2, state perception, S3, monitoring and early warning, S4, decision and optimization control, S5, execution and feedback, S6, intelligent operation and maintenance, S7 and self-healing scheduling; the invention utilizes the deep neural network DNN to process a large amount of sensor data, so that the system can learn the mode from complex historical data, accurately identify the conditions of power fluctuation, voltage abnormality and the like, and through the real-time updating of the model, the system can timely find potential abnormality, reduce the possibility of false alarm and missing report, the system monitors the running state of the power station in real time, can rapidly identify and classify abnormal conditions, provide instant data support for decision, and can take measures in advance through predicting the abnormality, thereby preventing further expansion of the problem, and through unmanned aerial vehicle inspection and predictive analysis, the system can identify equipment to be maintained, thereby preventing the expansion of faults.
assignees: WEI SHUANGMEI

title_en: Power grid information display method, device, electronic equipment and computer readable medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure discloses a power grid information display method, a device, electronic equipment and a computer readable medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a real-time transmission and transformation equipment data set, generating an abnormal operation equipment information set, determining abnormal area information in response to the fact that the abnormal operation equipment information set is not an empty set, executing a first generation step for the abnormal area information, determining operation equipment information set, carrying out abnormal degree area division on the abnormal area information, determining equipment problem information sets and corresponding problem probability for each abnormal division area information, screening out equipment problem information meeting corresponding problem conditions to obtain at least one target equipment problem information, and displaying an abnormal division area information sequence and the at least one target equipment problem information in a power digital twin model. According to the embodiment, under the condition that the target power grid area is abnormal, abnormal information under the area granularity and the equipment granularity can be accurately and effectively generated.

title_en: Neural network embedding method, equipment and medium for power distribution network state estimation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a neural network embedding method, a device, electronic equipment and a medium for estimating the state of a power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining an input sequence, embedding time information and node type information into vectors through space-time priori information embedding to obtain space-time embedded vectors, sampling interested nodes according to the power flow direction of optimal power flow, fusing node information to obtain node embedded vectors, capturing part of a graph by using a graph isomorphic neural network, embedding the part into a feature vector to obtain a structure embedded vector, fusing the input sequence and three vectors, inputting the graph space-time prediction network, and outputting a prediction result. According to the invention, by introducing space-time priori information, embedding the graph nodes based on the optimal power flow direction and embedding the graph structure of the graph isomorphic neural network, modeling of the characteristics of the power distribution network is realized, the defect of the prior art in the proprietary modeling of the power distribution network is overcome, and the accuracy of the state estimation of the power distribution network is improved.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for scoring operation reliability of coal-fired unit in real time
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for scoring the operation reliability of a coal-fired unit in real time, which relate to the technical field of operation monitoring and evaluation of the coal-fired unit, and comprise the steps of acquiring real-time operation data of the coal-fired unit of a power plant, wherein the actual level of the coal-fired unit from top to bottom comprises a unit, a specialty, a system and equipment; defining early warning levels in a digital twin modeling platform, setting withholding weights of the early warning levels, establishing a virtual power plant hierarchical structure corresponding to a physical power plant, establishing an early warning model under each device in the virtual power plant hierarchical structure, outputting early warning results, calculating real-time early warning quantity and real-time scoring of the system at each early warning level, calculating professional real-time scoring and real-time scoring of a unit according to the real-time scoring and scoring duty ratio of the system, and displaying. According to the invention, an early warning deduction model is established through an intelligent early warning model, a reliability scoring model is built in a layered manner, the running reliability of the unit is scored in real time, and the service life of the unit is prolonged.
assignees: LUCULENT SMART TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power system prediction auxiliary state estimation method and device based on deep learning
abstract_en: The application discloses a power system prediction auxiliary state estimation method and device based on deep learning. The application first collects power system data and inputs to a pre-trained neural network that integrates CNN, attention mechanisms, and LSTM to predict system status. And determining an innovation correction quantity by utilizing the difference value between the predicted value and the measured value, and further adjusting the measurement and process noise covariance matrix. Finally, the adjusted covariance matrix and the Kalman filtering algorithm are combined, so that the real-time and accurate estimation of the state of the power system is realized, and the problem that the state of the power system cannot be accurately estimated in the prior art is solved.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Method for compiling dynamic adaptive aggregate decomposition scheduling rules of watershed water and wind power plants
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of multi-energy coupling complementary scheduling, and discloses a method for compiling a drainage basin water-wind-light dynamic adaptive aggregation decomposition scheduling rule, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of S1, constructing a multivariable joint random simulation model, jointly reconstructing a water-wind-solar non-uniformity combined scene, S2, constructing a complementary optimal scheduling model, adopting a successive approximation dynamic programming method to solve an optimal scheduling track, S3, respectively screening out proper independent variable factors and scheduling decision factors for an aggregation system (an integrated system) and a decomposition system (a water-wind-solar bundling subsystem inside the integrated system) based on an aggregation decomposition theory, S4, taking static scheduling function parameters as initial values based on the water-wind-solar scene under the non-uniformity condition, applying a data assimilation and machine learning coupling model, S5, taking a watershed water-wind non-uniformity scene combination as an input of the model, and applying an EnKFN process in S4 based on the static scheduling function model determined in the step S3.
assignees: UNIV ZHENGZHOU

title_en: Power distribution network state prediction and regulation method considering multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network state estimation and regulation method considering multi-source data fusion. The method comprises the steps of considering measurement accuracy, time scale and state estimation calculation synchronism of multisource data, preprocessing daily measurement data respectively, classifying the measurement data according to different characteristics of a power supply, building a multi-layer output single hidden layer prediction nonlinear model considering system state variables through a data total set of daily and daily data of distributed power supply output and corresponding irradiance, air temperature and wind speed serving as training, defining upper and lower limit values of the state variables, rewriting the multi-layer output single hidden layer prediction nonlinear model into a linear model, expressing the linear model in a matrix mode, building an uncertainty set to describe a fluctuation interval of the system state, rewriting the fluctuation interval into a mode consistent with an active-reactive coordination optimization model of a power distribution network, building the active-reactive coordination optimization relaxation model of the power distribution network based on branch power flow, and optimizing various indexes of the power distribution network.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ZHENJIANG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;UNIV JIANGSU

title_en: Electric power system digital twin body interaction method and system based on large language model
abstract_en: The invention provides a large language model-based digital twin body interaction method and a large language model-based digital twin body interaction system for an electric power system, wherein the method comprises the steps of accessing the large language model into a simulation platform of the electric power system to execute basic element generation tasks of the simulation platform; the method comprises the steps of generating element codes based on topological relation by using a large language model according to a simulation model of a digital twin body, constructing a multi-agent system based on the large language model to interact with the simulation model of the digital twin body by using the multi-agent system, wherein the digital twin body comprises a plurality of basic elements. The invention applies the large language model to the simulation interaction of the digital twin body of the novel power system, utilizes the processing capacity of the natural language text of the large language model, relies on the simulation platform to generate basic elements, generate topological relation codes and intelligently interact, can meet the requirements of the novel power system, and has important theoretical and practical significance.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;WUXIN RESERARCH INSTITUTE OF APPLIED TECHNOLOGIES TSINGHUA UNIV

title_en: Digital twinning-based intelligent frontier defense integrated emotion center system construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method of an intelligent border protection integrated condition finger center system based on digital twinning, which comprises the steps of constructing a border protection risk factor comprehensive knowledge base and a data set, constructing a border protection risk fine granularity knowledge map based on a multi-mode factor base based on the comprehensive knowledge base and the data set, developing a border protection risk event accurate identification and deduction early warning model based on the knowledge map, developing a soft exchange core system for fusion and intercommunication of border protection heterogeneous equipment, constructing a border protection condition finger center digital twinning model based on the early warning model and the soft exchange core system, and developing the intelligent border protection integrated condition finger center system based on digital twinning model integration. According to the intelligent border protection integrated intelligent finger center system, the intelligent border protection risk can be accurately identified and intelligently early-warned, the border protection management and control efficiency and accuracy can be remarkably improved, and powerful technical support is provided for border protection safety.
assignees: XINJIANG NORTHWEST STAR INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based power information management system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based power information management system and a digital twinning-based power information management method, and belongs to the technical field of power safety. The method comprises the steps of feeding back each power abnormal event through digital twin of a power facility, performing weak point scanning on the power abnormal event at an irregular period, scanning fault attribute codes fed back by each power abnormal event to integrate each power abnormal event and record the power abnormal event into an abnormal data cluster, analyzing and calculating first danger correlation between any two fault attribute codes, analyzing and calculating second danger correlation between any two fault attribute codes under the condition of irregularly executing a history process of weak point scanning based on the first danger correlation, judging a fault linkage behavior relation between the fault attribute codes, generating a hidden danger linkage check list based on the fault linkage behavior relation, executing real-time defense response based on the hidden danger linkage check list, and further, reducing the time of weak point scanning and improving the efficiency of power defense response while achieving boundary calibration of the weak point scanning.
assignees: NANJING BAISIAO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-state digital twin and intelligent decision application method for rural intelligent power distribution system
abstract_en: The invention provides a rural intelligent power distribution system polymorphic digital twin and intelligent decision application method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, the method comprises the steps of calculating total power consumption by acquiring subsystem equipment parameters, operation parameters and influence factor indexes, and generating a calculation model of the power consumption and the change of the system operation state along with time. And further constructing a time function of the running current of the equipment and the system resistance, and generating a real-time measuring and calculating model by applying the time function to multi-state digital twin and intelligent decision in the power distribution process. And inputting the operation parameters into the model, outputting the measuring and calculating result, and adjusting the operation parameters in real time according to the measuring and calculating result. The invention can improve the energy efficiency and the operation stability of the power distribution system, reduce the power consumption and enhance the intelligent level of the system.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Intelligent electric power operation and maintenance system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure discloses an intelligent operation and maintenance system for electric power. The specific implementation mode of the electric power intelligent operation and maintenance system comprises electric power three-dimensional display equipment and an intelligent inspection system, wherein the electric power three-dimensional display equipment comprises a power distribution room digital twin unit, a transformer substation digital twin unit and a converter station digital twin unit, the intelligent inspection system comprises a camera, an unmanned aerial vehicle, a robot and a direct-reading instrument, the intelligent inspection system is in communication connection with a system management terminal, a personnel identification unit is in communication connection with the intelligent inspection system, receives personnel behavior image data collected from the camera and carries out illegal behavior identification, an electric power equipment defect detection unit is in communication connection with the intelligent inspection system, receives equipment image data from the camera and the unmanned aerial vehicle, detects appearance defects of equipment, and returns defect detection results to the intelligent inspection system. According to the embodiment, the digital twinning, intelligent three-dimensional inspection and other technologies are used for deep integration, so that monitoring and inspection are more visual and efficient.
assignees: HAINAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ZHEJIANG UNIV;HAINAN TONGLING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mobile Internet of things operation data management method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile Internet of things operation data management method, a device and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of Internet of things data processing, wherein when it is determined that energy consumption of any park is greater than a preset energy consumption standard, attribute information of the energy consumption equipment is acquired, a target park with the same energy consumption equipment is determined according to the attribute information of the energy consumption equipment and simulation model attribute data contained in a digital twin platform, second positioning information of the target park is acquired, first user data of the same energy consumption equipment in historical time is acquired from a database corresponding to each target park, and first historical operation information of the same energy consumption equipment in the target park and second user data of the energy consumption equipment in an energy consumption exceeding park are acquired; and controlling the energy consumption equipment in the energy consumption exceeding park according to the target operation information and the acquisition result of the mobile networking equipment in the energy consumption exceeding park and storing the generated operation data.
assignees: SHANDONG SHANSHI HUIJIN IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-scene visual algorithm evaluation method based on electric artificial intelligent platform
