abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-scene visual algorithm evaluation method based on an electric artificial intelligent platform, which comprises the following steps of S1, integrating data in an electric scene to generate a multi-mode data set, S2, storing and preprocessing the data set to extract key features, S3, selectively sampling data and optimizing a visual algorithm based on a multi-stage active learning mechanism, S4, transferring the optimized algorithm to different environments, adjusting parameters through a self-adaptive strategy to generate a model adapting to different conditions, S5, combining deep learning and expert knowledge to optimize an evaluation flow, S6, utilizing a fault mode library and a simulation technology to perform real-time fault injection and elastic evaluation, S7, constructing a double-layer digital twin virtual evaluation environment to verify the effectiveness of the algorithm under different conditions, and S8, utilizing a distributed data management system to record and track evaluation data and generate an evaluation report. The invention improves the efficiency and reliability of monitoring and fault prediction of the power equipment through an intelligent tuning and evaluating mechanism.
assignees: INFORMATION COMMUNICATION BRANCH CHONGQING ZHIWANG TECH INDUSTRY DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic power prediction and fault diagnosis system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention relates to a photovoltaic technology, in particular to a photovoltaic power prediction and fault diagnosis system based on digital twinning, which comprises a server, wherein the server performs data acquisition through a data acquisition module and creates a virtual model corresponding to a photovoltaic system through a virtual model creation module, the server maps acquired data into the virtual model through a data mapping module and generates a digital twinning model corresponding to the photovoltaic system through a digital twinning model generation module based on the virtual model of the mapped data.
assignees: HEFEI YUANLI ZHONGHE ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unknown measurement information completion method for power distribution network based on data flow mapping
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network unknown measurement information completion method based on data flow mapping, and relates to the technical field of power distribution network monitoring and control. The invention discloses a power distribution network unknown measurement information completion method based on data flow mapping, which comprises the steps of 1, constructing a data flow mapping model, 2, estimating and completing missing data, 3, updating and intelligently optimizing in real time, 4, integrating and applying a system, wherein the step 1 comprises the steps of 1.1 data acquisition and preprocessing, 1.2 feature extraction and analysis, 1.3 mapping model construction, 2 comprises the steps of 2.1 missing data identification and estimation, 2.2 estimate model construction and 2.3 data completion.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ZHENJIANG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH

title_en: Distributed photovoltaic engineering safety management method based on risk assessment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of photovoltaic safety management, in particular to a distributed photovoltaic engineering safety management method based on risk assessment, which comprises the steps of acquiring distributed photovoltaic data of a user side and operation data of photovoltaic power plant equipment, determining key monitoring points by utilizing a data feature extraction technology, monitoring equipment states in real time, constructing a digital twin simulation model, by simulating image comparison, the abnormal equipment and newly-added equipment are found in time, validity detection and verification are carried out, and for unidentified equipment, the historical data and the position information of the unidentified equipment are analyzed to identify unsafe newly-added equipment and evaluate the abnormal equipment area.
assignees: HUANENG NANTONG GAS TURBINE POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Building internal emergency rescue system and method based on digital twin modularization and multi-scale simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based modularized multi-scale simulation building internal emergency rescue system and a digital twinning-based modularized multi-scale simulation building internal emergency rescue method. The system adopts a modularized design, can be independently deployed and can be flexibly combined to adapt to the requirements of different building structures, floor environments and elevator brands. Meanwhile, by means of the multiscale simulation technology of the Unity3D platform, high-precision simulation and visualization of the running state of the equipment are achieved, so that operation and maintenance personnel and rescue personnel can intuitively and accurately know the running state and floor environment of the equipment, an accurate and intuitive virtual environment is provided for emergency rescue, and a powerful technical support is provided for development and application of an emergency rescue system of the simulation equipment.

title_en: Power transmission line fault state early warning method under extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission line fault state early warning method under extreme weather, which belongs to the technical field of power and specifically comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining inspection track data, S2, preprocessing the inspection data, S3, carrying out digital twin three-dimensional modeling, S4, establishing a line state prediction model under the influence of typhoons, and S5, dividing multi-layer early warning grades. By adopting the transmission line fault state early warning method under extreme weather, the invention establishes the transmission line fault probability prediction model by means of leading edge technologies such as unmanned aerial vehicle inspection, digital twin modeling and the like, divides layering early warning levels, realizes fine treatment of dangerous response, and effectively avoids resource waste and manpower loss.
assignees: NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV BAODING

title_en: Harmonic state estimation method, device, electronic apparatus, storage medium, and program
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a harmonic state estimation method, a device, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a program, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining electric energy quality monitoring data of a bus to be monitored in a target electric power system, wherein the electric energy quality monitoring data are data of asynchronous measurement, calculating target phase differences among different measurement points in the bus to be monitored according to the electric energy quality monitoring data, and calculating harmonic state quantities among different measurement points in the bus to be monitored according to the target phase differences and a harmonic state estimation model of the target electric power system. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention can improve the accuracy of the harmonic state estimation in the power system.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;SHANTOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network accident plan auxiliary decision-making method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network accident plan auxiliary decision-making method and system based on digital twinning, comprising the following steps of S101, S102, constructing a digital twinning model of a target power distribution network according to a target power distribution network management data set, S103, determining a fault operation scene of the target power distribution network according to the digital twinning model of the power distribution network and the operation scene of the target power distribution network, and constructing an expected accident set, and S104, constructing an accident plan set according to the expected accident set of the target power distribution network.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;SHANGHAI PROINVENT INFORMATION TECH LTD

title_en: Method for online coordinated optimization scheduling of truck mobile charging stations
abstract_en: Related to the field of charging infrastructure optimization, a method for online coordinated optimization scheduling of truck mobile charging stations. A two-stage framework is proposed: (1) offline training stage, where a multi-period optimization decision model for TMCSs is constructed, and a look-ahead rolling horizon-value function approximation (LRH-VFA) algorithm is then developed to iteratively learn from historical EV charging data, considering the impact of current-period decisions on future profit; and (2) online scheduling stage, where TMCS scheduling decisions are dynamically updated based on the approximate value function obtained from offline training, along with short-term forecasts and real-time information. The method effectively accounts for the impact of uncertain EV charging demand on TMCS scheduling, dynamically adjusting decisions based on real-time updates. It enables better coordination of TMCS online scheduling between EV charging services and energy arbitrage, improving operator profitability while ensuring the quality of charging services.
assignees: UNIV LANZHOU JIAOTONG;UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: Digital twin-based power distribution network relay protection evaluation test method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based power distribution network relay protection evaluation test method, a system, equipment and a storage medium, which relate to the technical field of smart power grids and comprise the steps of performing site selection optimization according to a distribution network topological structure and load distribution, configuring a data acquisition terminal, and building a data transmission network to acquire power distribution network operation data; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing operation data of the power distribution network, constructing a digital twin model, realizing twin synchronous update through data mapping, simulating and testing and verifying faults, and analyzing and optimizing feedback of verification data. The method for evaluating and testing the relay protection of the power distribution network based on the digital twin effectively solves the problems by optimizing data acquisition distribution points, constructing a twin model in real time and verifying multiple scenes in a simulation mode, and provides an innovative solution for evaluating and optimizing the relay protection strategy of the complex power distribution network.
assignees: SHANGHAI PUYUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent evaluation method for power transmission and transformation operation safety quantification of intelligent power grid power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quantitative intelligent assessment method for power transmission and transformation operation safety of an intelligent power grid power system, which relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and comprises the steps of collecting basic information of the power system from multiple channels, deploying sensors around key power facilities through an intelligent sensor network, collecting data in real time, receiving data uploaded by edge computing equipment, carrying out deep analysis on the data through a self-adaptive learning model, outputting assessment reports and recommended measures, establishing a virtual model of the power system by using digital twinning based on the assessment reports and the recommended measures, carrying out simulation, recording the assessment reports, the recommended measures and the simulation results of the model on a block chain, automatically generating safety assessment results according to the information on the block chain, and pushing the recommended measures to operation and maintenance personnel. According to the invention, by utilizing the self-adaptive learning model, the system can update itself according to the historical data and the current state, and the accuracy and reliability of fault prediction are improved.
assignees: JIANGSU WISDOM WORKS TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for generating digital twin of power grid, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, terminal equipment and a storage medium for generating digital twin of a power grid. The method comprises the steps of constructing a relevance topological graph through power grid data with a relevance, searching a shortest path in the relevance topological graph, and taking the power grid data on the shortest path as retention data and other data as candidate data. Because the digital twinning process is complex, the invention skips the steps of twinning mapping on the detained data, obtains corresponding filling data by using a data filling method, still generates the twinning data according to the twinning mapping steps on the candidate data, and then constructs the digital twinning of the power grid according to the filling data and the twinning data. The invention omits digital twin of the retention data, reduces the data exchange times of twin mapping, and improves the performance of the twin system.

title_en: Collaborative interaction method and system for electric power multi-modal data perception and digital twin simulation
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a collaborative interaction method and system for electric power multi-mode data sensing and digital twin simulation, which relates to the field of electric power equipment management and maintenance, and comprises the steps of carrying out electric power multi-mode data sensing on data collected by an edge equipment to obtain state characteristics of single equipment; the method comprises the steps of establishing a digital twin model based on state characteristics of all equipment in a power system to be monitored, establishing a power equipment diagram knowledge base by utilizing the digital twin model, extracting global state characteristics of the equipment from the power equipment diagram knowledge base through a diagram neural network, so as to establish a global state characteristic time sequence of the equipment, inputting the global state characteristic time sequence into a trained time sequence prediction model to predict the state of the equipment at a future moment, adjusting parameters of the digital twin model in real time according to multi-mode data, flexibly adapting to environmental changes, and carrying out equipment operation state prediction by combining time sequence modeling and fault trend analysis functions, thereby further improving the comprehensiveness and the foresight of equipment monitoring.
assignees: STATE GRID INTELLIGENCE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Electric automobile quick charge demand guiding method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric vehicle charging guidance, in particular to a method, a device, equipment and a medium for guiding the quick charging requirement of an electric vehicle, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a dynamic traffic network with real-time updating; the method comprises the steps of constructing a road traffic impedance model and an electric vehicle power consumption model, respectively constructing a private vehicle travel behavior model and a network contract vehicle travel behavior model, constructing a user charging satisfaction quantization index, providing charging selection models of different types of electric vehicles, predicting charging loads of charging stations in each period, dynamically pricing the charging stations with minimum charging load fluctuation as a target, optimizing space-time distribution of quick charging loads according to travel modes of the private vehicle and the network contract vehicle of different types of electric vehicles, and guiding a user to charge when the loads are low through price regulation and control so as to balance the loads of the charging stations, reduce power fluctuation pressure of a power distribution network caused by quick charging and guarantee stable operation of the power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Simulation operation evaluation method and device for power distribution network equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a simulation operation evaluation method and device of power distribution network equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining physical parameters of key equipment in a power distribution network, carrying out three-dimensional modeling on the key equipment based on the physical parameters to obtain a key equipment model, establishing a digital twin model of the power distribution network based on the key equipment model, obtaining simulated operation data of the key equipment model of the digital twin model in a preset period, carrying out feature extraction on the simulated operation data to obtain feature data, establishing a factor set and a fuzzy evaluation set for evaluating the operation state of the key equipment model based on the feature data, obtaining historical operation data of the key equipment in the power distribution network, determining a comprehensive membership value matrix of the key equipment model based on the historical operation data, the factor set and the fuzzy evaluation set, and evaluating an operation result of the key equipment model based on the comprehensive membership value matrix. The invention can accurately reflect the running condition of the actual power distribution network equipment through the model, and improves the accuracy and efficiency of power distribution network management.
assignees: XIONGAN NEW AREA POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Comprehensive energy system state evaluation method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: A comprehensive energy system state evaluation method based on multi-source data fusion relates to the technical field of comprehensive energy systems; the method comprises the steps of establishing an electric-gas coupling measurement model, mapping a measurement vector and a state vector relation, establishing an air network Gaussian inference model and a power network Gaussian mixture distribution model based on probability distribution of Bayesian learning fitting measurement data, generating data samples by Monte Carlo sampling, screening reasonable data through tide checking, establishing a data-driven state estimation model based on LSTM, training and evaluating model performance, effectively improving accuracy of comprehensive energy system state estimation through multi-source data fusion and an LSTM network, solving the problem that the measurement data redundancy is low and structure is not observable, and being suitable for state evaluation of park-level and building-level comprehensive energy systems.
assignees: UNIV CHINA THREE GORGES CTGU

title_en: Server for manageing power and method therefor
title_ko: 전력 관리를 위한 서버 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a server and a method for power management. according to one aspect of the present invention, the server for power management comprises: a memory; and a processor connected to the memory. the processor detects at least one of an outlier and a missing value by applying power usage data collected through smart metering to an anomaly detection model, removes the detected outlier and missing value from the power usage data, and controls charging/discharging of a battery or an electric vehicle using the power usage data from which the outlier and missing value are removed.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전력 관리를 위한 서버 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 본 발명의 일 측면에 따른 전력 관리를 위한 서버는 메모리, 및 메모리와 연결되는 프로세서를 포함하되, 프로세서는 스마트 미터링을 통해 수집된 전력 사용량 데이터를 이상 탐지 모델에 적용하여 이상치 및 결측치 중 적어도 하나를 탐지하고, 전력 사용량 데이터에서 탐지된 이상치 및 결측치를 제거하며, 이상치 및 결측치가 제거된 전력 사용량 데이터를 이용하여 배터리 또는 전기차의 충/방전을 제어하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: ELECTRONICS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS RES INST

title_en: Artificial intelligence system for interpolating missing value of power data and driving method thereof
title_ko: 전력 데이터 결측값을 보간하기 위한 인공지능시스템 및 그 구동방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an artificial intelligence system for interpolating a missing value of power data, which comprises: an input module receiving at least one power consumption amount data according to a time series; an artificial intelligence module clustering and clustering the at least one power consumption amount data according to a preset power consumption pattern, and generating an artificial intelligence model for interpolating the missing value by performing classification and generative adversarial network training; and an output module outputting power consumption amount data in which the missing value generated using the artificial intelligence model is interpolated.
abstract_ko: 본 발명인 전력 데이터의 결측값을 보간하기 위한 인공지능시스템은, 시계열에 따른 적어도 하나의 전력 소비량 데이터를 제공받는 입력모듈, 적어도 하나의 전력 소비량 데이터를 미리 설정된 전력 소비 패턴에 따라 클러스터링(Clustering)하여 군집화하고 분류(Classifiaction) 및 생성적 적대 신경망 모델 학습(Generative Adversarial Network Training)을 수행하여 결측값을 보간하기 위한 인공지능모델을 생성하는 인공지능모듈 및 인공지능모델을 이용하여 생성된 결측값이 보간된 전력 소비량 데이터를 출력하는 출력모듈을 포함한다.
assignees: KYUNGPOOK NAT UNIV IND ACADEMIC COOP FOUND

title_en: Robustness strategy optimization method for user side energy storage
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power generation and energy storage, and discloses a robustness strategy optimization method for user side energy storage, which comprises a robustness strategy optimization system, wherein the robustness strategy optimization system comprises a user side energy storage facility digital twin model, the user side energy storage facility digital twin model comprises a real-time data acquisition module, a data processing module, a digital twin model construction module, a strategy optimization module, a user interaction module, an energy storage control module and an energy storage equipment state monitoring module, and the operation state of the energy storage equipment can be monitored and adjusted in real time by integrating the real-time data acquisition module, the data processing module, the digital twin model construction module, the strategy optimization module, the user interaction module, the energy storage control module and the energy storage equipment state monitoring module, so that the operation efficiency and the service life of the energy storage equipment are improved, the safe and stable operation of the energy storage method is ensured by the real-time monitoring and optimizing strategy, and a comprehensive solution is provided for the management of the user side energy storage equipment.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;INFORMATION COMMUNICATION BRANCH STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Digital twinning-based pumped storage power station management system, method, computer equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a digital twin-based pumped storage power station management system, a digital twin-based pumped storage power station management method, computer equipment and a readable storage medium, wherein the system comprises a sensing layer, a data center layer and a display layer, the sensing layer is used for acquiring monitoring data of all monitoring objects in a pumped storage power station through various monitoring equipment and sending the monitoring data to the data center layer, the data center layer is used for carrying out statistical analysis on the monitoring data sent by the sensing layer in real time through a streaming data center technology to obtain statistical results of all the monitoring objects, the data mining and prediction model is used for acquiring prediction data of all the monitoring objects and sending the statistical results and the prediction data to the display layer, and the display layer is used for displaying the statistical results and the prediction data through a chart. By adopting the method, the utilization rate of the engineering data of the pumped storage power station can be improved, and the lean management level of the construction of the pumped storage power station can be improved.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID ENERGY DEVELOPMENT RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent substation power main equipment digital twin model self-adaptive migration method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive migration method of a digital twin model of an intelligent substation power main device, which comprises the steps of S1, obtaining historical visible light images of the device, S2, preprocessing the historical visible light images, constructing a training data set, S3, constructing an initial diagnosis model, S4, training the initial diagnosis model through the training data set to obtain an appearance abnormality diagnosis model, S5, obtaining real-time visible light images, S6, inputting the real-time visible light images into the appearance abnormality diagnosis model to obtain a diagnosis result, S7, when the severity of an abnormal state is increased, taking the original digital twin model of the power main device as a source template M0, and carrying out appearance map adjustment based on the current real-time visible light images on the basis of M0 to obtain a digital twin model Mn under a new working condition. The invention is beneficial to realizing continuous monitoring and prediction of equipment, thereby improving the reliability and safety of a power system.
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD EHV POWER TRANSF COMPANY;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Harmonic state evaluation method for AC/DC hybrid power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a harmonic state evaluation method of an alternating current-direct current hybrid power system, which comprises the steps of collecting voltage and current waveforms of an alternating current side and a direct current side of the hybrid power system, analyzing and extracting harmonic components in a frequency domain, establishing an LCC-HVDC power transmission alternating current system measurement equation and a converter transformer branch positive and negative sequence harmonic model, further obtaining the LCC-HVDC power transmission system measurement equation, establishing a linear harmonic state estimation model based on a power network, an element and a measurement, a bus voltage measurement equation, a branch current measurement equation and a power transmission system measurement equation, establishing an observability constraint of the alternating current-direct current hybrid power system based on the correlation of measurement values and state quantities by considering an N-1 criterion, and obtaining a stability index of the alternating current-direct current hybrid power system based on the observability constraint and the linear harmonic state estimation model. According to the method and the system, harmonic state evaluation and risk analysis can be carried out on the system to be evaluated according to the harmonic state stability index, and a harmonic treatment optimization suggestion is given.
assignees: NANJING INST TECH

title_en: Low-voltage transformer area power grid three-phase dynamic state estimation method based on data fusion technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-voltage transformer area power grid three-phase dynamic state estimation method based on a data fusion technology, which comprises the following steps of a, establishing a low-voltage transformer area power grid measurement equation; the three-phase DSE method of the low-voltage power grid of the transformer area based on the DF technology has the advantages that by combining mixed measurement data of the intelligent ammeter and the synchronous phasor measurement unit PMU, the accurate and real-time estimation of the running state of the power grid of the low-voltage power grid is realized by utilizing a data fusion technology, powerful support is provided for safe and economic running of the power grid, and the method has stronger adaptability and expandability and can meet the state estimation requirements of the power grids of different low-voltage power grids.
assignees: JINGMEN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;HUBEI JINGNENG POWER TRANS AND TRANSFORMATION ENGINEERING CO LTD;JINGMEN SHENGHE ELECTRIC POWER SURVEY AND DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent operation and maintenance system of transformer substation based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The application relates to a digital twinning-based intelligent operation and maintenance system of a transformer substation, which is characterized in that a physical facility layer collects operation and maintenance data of the transformer substation, a data management layer acquires the operation and maintenance data, mechanism model data, driving model data and a neural network architecture and builds a data operation model, a platform function layer builds a transformer substation scene component and a device component, the device component is arranged in the transformer substation scene component to obtain a transformer substation virtual model, a model building layer carries out virtual digital reduction processing through a digital twinning technology to obtain a transformer substation digital twinning model corresponding to the transformer substation, a simulation analysis layer builds a device digital model according to the operation and maintenance of the transformer substation digital twinning model according to a prediction result, and a future state of equipment in the transformer substation is predicted. The system effectively builds a semantic information model of the power distribution station, realizes virtual digital restoration of real power distribution station equipment, and is convenient for subsequent effective monitoring and operation and maintenance of the power distribution station equipment.
assignees: SHANGHAI FENGXIAN GAS TURBINE POWER GENERATION CO LTD;HUADIAN ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Attention mechanism-fused time convolution neural network model, power system dynamic state estimation method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a time convolution neural network model integrating an attention mechanism, a dynamic state estimation method, a system, equipment and a medium of a power system, which comprise an input layer, an output layer, a full connection layer and a plurality of TCN modules, wherein the input layer, each TCN module, the full connection layer and the output layer are sequentially connected, and a self-attention layer and an activation function module are sequentially arranged between adjacent TCN modules and between the last TCN module and the full connection layer.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: Electric power data tamper-proof processing system
abstract_en: A tamper-proof processing system for electric power data relates to a tamper-proof electric power data processing device, and aims to solve the problem that the existing electric power data is easy to tamper. The storage encryption module is used for storing power data on an encrypted block, the digital signature module is used for carrying out digital signature on the block, if the power data in the block is changed, the digital signature is invalid, the abnormality judgment module is used for judging the validity of the digital signature, generating and sending an abnormality warning for the invalid digital signature, the monitoring and checking module is used for monitoring a data transmission link and a storage link and judging abnormal nodes, the data clearing module is used for clearing the power data in the block with the invalid digital signature, and the backup memory module is used for storing the power data in the backup block and calling the corresponding power data in the backup block so as to supplement the missing data in the block for clearing the power data. The electric power data tamper-proof device has the beneficial effect of effectively preventing the electric power data from being tampered.
assignees: SHUANGYASHAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID HEILONGJIANG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Ground disaster inspection digital twin system based on 5 G+unmanned aerial vehicle and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster inspection, in particular to a digital twin system for ground disaster inspection based on a 5G+ unmanned aerial vehicle and a use method thereof. The system comprises an Internet of things sensing layer, an infrastructure layer, a data resource layer, an application service layer and a user layer, wherein the Internet of things sensing layer comprises an unmanned plane, a camera and a sensor module and is used for acquiring geological disaster information of a research area, the infrastructure layer comprises an Internet, a cloud platform, a 5G network, a server, a display and storage device and is used for supporting a network environment and a hardware environment layer of the whole system, the data resource layer is used for storing data and managing data resources, receiving the data acquired by the Internet of things sensing layer and processing and storing the data, the application service layer is used for providing statistical analysis and calculation service, visual service and unified authority management service, and the user layer is used for providing interaction service and remote monitoring and consultation service for users. The invention optimizes the inspection path and strategy through the intelligent algorithm, and improves the inspection efficiency and effect.
assignees: HUBEI CHAONENG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD EHV COMPANY

title_en: Digital twin service platform construction method based on cloud edge end cooperation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twinning, in particular to a digital twinning service platform construction method based on cloud edge end cooperation. The method comprises the steps of obtaining basic data of an energy system through an edge device, conducting preliminary state modeling on the edge device by utilizing the basic data of the energy system, constructing a virtual energy system model to transmit the virtual energy system model to a cloud server, controlling the cloud server to receive the virtual energy system model uploaded by the edge device, conducting digital twin model construction on the virtual energy system model to obtain the digital twin model of the energy system, conducting energy scheduling optimization according to the digital twin model of the energy system, obtaining energy scheduling data of the energy system, and sending the energy scheduling data to the edge device to conduct energy system scheduling optimization operation. The invention can predict and adjust the power supply gap in advance through multi-scenario simulation and strategy correction, and realize the stable operation of energy supply under various meteorological conditions and load fluctuation conditions.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Intelligent analysis and auxiliary decision-making method for load transfer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a load transfer intelligent analysis and auxiliary decision-making method, which comprises the steps of obtaining power grid model and ground state section data through model management and state estimation, carrying out equipment power failure and out-of-limit transfer analysis, and providing load transfer auxiliary decision-making for real-time monitoring application such as fault collaborative treatment, analysis and check application such as accident plan generation, and scheduling management application such as maintenance plan by adopting a parallel calculation and service mode, so that the risk level of a power grid can be determined according to standard requirements. The invention selects power failure and out-of-limit equipment, automatically calculates corresponding load transfer schemes, analyzes affected important users, clearly displays the important users in front of a dispatcher, and can shorten overload transfer time to a certain extent as reminding and auxiliary basis.
assignees: STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD HEFEI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV ANHUI

title_en: Rural water supply pipe network pressure monitoring and analyzing method and device based on digital twinning
abstract_en: A method for monitoring and analyzing the pressure of rural water supply network based on digital twin includes such steps as collecting the historical basic data of the predicted area, arranging flow and pressure sensors at nodes of rural water supply network to obtain the monitored data, uploading the data to server via data flow processing frame, preprocessing to obtain the preprocessed data, building relation database management system to obtain the batched historical basic data and monitored data, building the water pressure prediction model of rural network, building the pipe explosion detection and water pressure control model, building the geometric model of rural water supply network based on ArcGIS, building the data model of rural water supply network and realizing the visualization of running state of water supply network. The intelligent control system fully considers the rural water supply characteristics and the water use characteristics, realizes intelligent control of the rural water supply system, and effectively ensures the reliability and safety of rural water supply.

title_en: Comprehensive state estimation system of electric power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive state estimation system of a power system, and particularly relates to the technical field of state estimation of the power system. The system comprises a load time period dividing module, a power supply emergency state analysis module, a power supply quality analysis module, a power supply stability evaluation module, a power distribution cabinet environment data acquisition module, a power distribution cabinet environment data analysis module, a power supply environment evaluation module, a comprehensive state evaluation module, a terminal display module and a database. The invention carries out deep analysis on the historical data of the power system, analyzes the emergency response capability of the power system, and can facilitate technicians to pay attention to the potential risks of the redundant system in time. The invention further analyzes the fluctuation, frequency and harmonic waves of the voltage, focuses on the quality problem of the power system, can timely find the quality risk of the power system, eliminates hidden danger and ensures the safety and stability of the power system of the hospital.
assignees: Lianyungang normal college

title_en: Power load data missing value restoration method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a device and a storage medium for repairing a missing value of power load data, which are applied to the technical field of power systems and comprise the steps of classifying a data set to be repaired according to the length of the missing data, adopting different repairing methods according to classification results, adopting an interpolation method if the missing data is short, ensuring accuracy while calculating simply, and acquiring the missing value to fill if the missing data is long by adopting a Markov chain or an adjacent data filling method.
assignees: WUWEI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Extreme temperature environment power grid safety assessment method based on thermal-force-sag tide coupling
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power system current carrying level and line thermal stability analysis, in particular to a thermal-force-sag tide coupling-based extreme temperature environment power grid safety assessment method. According to the scheme, the thermal-force-sag coupling characteristic equation of the overhead line is integrated into the traditional power flow calculation, so that the running state of the power grid under the high-temperature condition is accurately predicted and estimated. The method not only considers the changes of physical parameters such as the temperature, the stress, the sag and the like of the line to carry out comprehensive estimation, but also provides more accurate power system running state estimation by integrating a thermal-force-sag coupling characteristic equation of the overhead line into the traditional power flow calculation. The method enables an operator of the power system to accurately predict the load change of the power grid and the physical response of the circuit under the extremely high-temperature environment, thereby providing scientific basis for the stable operation and timely regulation of the power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY BISHAN POWER SUPPLY BRANCH

title_en: Comprehensive energy system state estimation method based on LSTM automatic encoder
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power systems, and particularly discloses a comprehensive energy system state estimation method based on an LSTM automatic encoder, which comprises the following steps of establishing an IES state estimation model and describing an energy coupling relation in the IES through a constraint equation; the method comprises the steps of carrying out IES state estimation based on a weighted least square method, constructing an LSTM automatic encoder, utilizing historical operation data of the IES as a training data set to train the LSTM automatic encoder to obtain a trained LSTM automatic encoder model, inputting IES system time sequence data to be estimated into the trained LSTM automatic encoder model, obtaining a state estimation result of a comprehensive energy system through forward propagation of the model, and determining a loss function, wherein the loss function comprises prediction loss and regularization loss. The invention has the advantages that the long-term dependency relationship and the nonlinear characteristic in the time sequence data can be effectively learned and captured, thereby improving the accuracy and the reliability of state estimation.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Space-time diagram neural network-based data perception method and system for district distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space-time diagram neural network-based data perception method and system for a district distribution network, which relate to the field of district distribution networks, and the method comprises the steps of constructing an undirected diagram according to an electric network of the district distribution network, generating an adjacent matrix, and obtaining a Laplace matrix through normalization processing; the method comprises the steps of constructing a time sequence diagram neural network model based on a Laplace matrix, recording input characteristics and state estimation data of distribution network nodes of a platform region, constructing tag training data, storing the tag training data into a historical database for model training, training the time sequence diagram neural network model based on the historical data, carrying out distribution network state estimation by using the trained model, monitoring the state of a power grid in real time by a cloud server through a system, carrying out complementary training on the model, combining the advantages of the diagram neural network and the sequence model by the space-time diagram neural network, and improving the accuracy of node perception data by considering the association between the topological structure of the power grid and the nodes.
assignees: STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;INFORMATION COMMUNICATION BRANCH STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution station room monitoring and operation and maintenance system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a power distribution station room monitoring and operation and maintenance system based on digital twinning, and belongs to the technical field of power distribution station room monitoring. The power distribution station room monitoring and operating system comprises a data acquisition unit, a network transmission unit, a background processing unit, a digital twin unit and an application processing unit, wherein the data acquisition unit is used for acquiring detailed three-dimensional model data, environment data and equipment data of the power distribution station room, the network transmission unit is used for transmitting the three-dimensional model data, the equipment data and the environment data, the background processing unit is used for receiving the three-dimensional model data, the environment data and the equipment data and carrying out compliance processing on the three-dimensional model data, the environment data and the equipment data, the digital twin unit is used for receiving the three-dimensional model data and the equipment data of related equipment, constructing a three-dimensional entity model according to the three-dimensional model data and the equipment data of the related equipment, and the application processing unit is used for carrying out scheduling operation and maintenance on the related equipment of the power distribution station room according to the real-time condition of the power distribution station room. The power distribution station room monitoring and operation and maintenance system can monitor the equipment condition of the power distribution station room in real time and visually display the equipment condition.
assignees: ANHUI JIYUAN SOFTWARE CO LTD

title_en: Equipment-level digital twin body construction method based on model data fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a device-level digital twin body construction method based on model data fusion, which belongs to the technical field of renewable energy scheduling, and comprises the steps of collecting operation data and external environment data of photovoltaic power generation, wind power generation and energy storage devices, carrying out data cleaning and data standardization processing on the operation data and the external environment data, constructing a digital twin body of the photovoltaic power generation device, carrying out dynamic adjustment on the digital twin body of the photovoltaic power generation device by utilizing the external environment data, the operation data of the photovoltaic power generation device and historical power generation data, constructing the digital twin body of the wind power generation device, and constructing the digital twin body of the energy storage device. The method has the advantages that the method realizes the fine modeling and dynamic optimization of the equipment through multi-source data fusion, ensures the accurate reflection and regulation of the state of the equipment, and ensures the accurate reflection and regulation of the state of the equipment through the multi-source data fusion.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power grid state monitoring method and device based on digital twin body and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a power grid state monitoring method, device and computer equipment based on a digital twin body. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an urban power grid live-action model, obtaining multi-source urban power grid operation data in a message queue mode, carrying out data collection and data preprocessing on the multi-source urban power grid operation data to obtain target operation data, constructing a power grid digital twin body of an urban power grid according to the target operation data and the urban power grid live-action model, and monitoring the operation state of the urban power grid based on the power grid digital twin body. By adopting the method, the monitoring precision of the running state of the power grid can be improved.
assignees: SOUTHERN POWER GRID DIGITAL PLATFORM TECH GUANGDONG CO LTD

title_en: Space-time data storage graph model construction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for constructing a space-time data storage graph model, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining the structure and equipment relation data of a power system; the method comprises the steps of constructing a graph database based on structure and equipment relation data and used for forming a preliminary graph model, introducing historical measurement storage nodes into the graph database and associating the historical measurement storage nodes with equipment nodes and topology nodes in the graph model, constructing a state estimation result storage node in the graph database and associating the state estimation result storage node with the equipment nodes and the topology nodes in the graph model to obtain a final graph model. The invention utilizes the flexibility and expandability of the graph database, realizes the storage and inquiry of time sequence data by adding the historical data storage nodes and associates with the graph nodes, can comprehensively and accurately represent the time-space characteristics of the power system, realizes the storage and inquiry of the historical data, constructs a more comprehensive and accurate power system graph model, and provides more abundant information for the analysis, planning and optimization of the system running state.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Energy management systems and methods
abstract_en: A smart water heating system is disclosed that uses advanced monitoring and control techniques to optimize energy usage and grid stability. Various features include real-time state of charge estimation for water heaters, a "digital twin" representation of each unit, predictive load modelling, and adaptive control algorithms. The system can operate individual heaters as distributed energy resources, or aggregate them into virtual power plants. It employs strategies such as load shifting to align with renewable energy availability, and cooperative multi-agent control to prevent demand spikes. The technology aims to improve energy efficiency, reduce costs, integrate renewable sources, and enhance grid stability while maintaining user comfort. Additional features include user analytics, comparative consumption reporting, and solutions for low-voltage environments using supplementary battery storage.
assignees: STATE OF CHARGE LTD

title_en: System and method for providing digital twin optimal operating platform to improve reliability of smart energy community
title_ko: 스마트 에너지커뮤니티 신뢰성 향상을 위한 디지털트윈 최적 운영 플랫폼 제공 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: A system and a method for providing an optimal digital twin operation platform according to an embodiment secure system stability for an industrial complex target operation platform, thereby improving power quality reliability. In addition, the system and the method for providing a digital twin optimal operating platform for improving the reliability of a smart energy community according to an embodiment can quickly respond to the operation and management of the smart energy community through a digital twin. In addition, in the embodiment, it is possible to simulate various situations by using the same data as the actual operating situation through modeling through a digital twin.
abstract_ko: 실시예에 따른 디지털트윈 최적 운영 플랫폼 제공 시스템 및 방법은 산업단지 대상 운영 플랫폼을 위해 계통 안정도를 확보하여, 전력품질 신뢰성을 향상시킨다. 또한, 실시예에 따른 스마트 에너지커뮤니티 신뢰성 향상을 위한 디지털트윈 최적 운영 플랫폼 제공 시스템 및 방법은 디지털 트윈을 통해 스마트 에너지 커뮤니티의 운영과 관리에 빠르게 대응할 수 있도록 한다. 또한, 실시예에서는 디지털 트윈을 통한 모델링을 통해 실제 운영 상황과 동일한 데이터를 이용하여, 다양한 상황에 대한 시뮬레이션을 가능하게 한다.

title_en: Method and Apparatus for Power System Control Providing Energy Quantity Visualization Based on a Digital Twin
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 기반의 에너지 물리량 시각화를 제공하는 전력계통 관제 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method and apparatus for controlling a power system based on a digital twin. According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, provided is a digital twin-based power system control method comprising the steps of: obtaining system structure information on a power system including at least one bus and at least one transmission line and system time series information on the power system; generating a virtual space including a first object representing the bus and a second object representing the transmission line based on the system structure information, and generating interest information on at least one of the bus and the transmission line based on the system time series information; and providing a visual effect on at least one of the first object and the second object to generate an interface for displaying the interest information on the virtual space.
abstract_ko: 본 개시는 디지털 트윈에 기반하여 전력계통을 관제하는 방법 및 장치를 제공한다. 본 개시의 일 실시예에 따르면, 적어도 하나의 버스(Bus) 및 적어도 하나의 선로(Transmmission Line)를 포함하는 전력계통에 관한 계통 구조 정보 및 상기 전력계통에 관한 계통 시계열 정보를 획득하는 단계; 상기 계통 구조 정보에 기초하여, 상기 버스를 나타내는 제1 객체 및 상기 선로를 나타내는 제2 객체를 포함하는 가상 공간을 생성하고, 상기 계통 시계열 정보에 기초하여, 상기 버스 및 상기 선로 중 적어도 하나에 관한 관심 정보를 생성하는 단계; 및 상기 제1 객체 및 상기 제2 객체 중 적어도 하나에 대한 시각적 효과를 제공함으로써, 상기 관심 정보를 상기 가상 공간상에 표시하는 인터페이스를 생성하는 단계를 포함하는, 디지털 트윈 기반의 전력계통 관제 방법을 제공할 수 있다.
assignees: PLUXITY CO LTD;RAONFRIENDS CO LTD

title_en: Power grid structure data generation method and device, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid structure data generation method, a device, terminal equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining network quantity requirements and node quantity requirements of each network, generating corresponding quantity of networks according to the network quantity requirements, distributing a node quantity requirement for each network, generating nodes for each network according to the node quantity requirements of each network, preset sliding bus quantity constraint and preset generator-load ratio constraint, generating edges for each network according to the preset edge-node ratio constraint, and obtaining power grid structure data according to all networks. The invention provides a method capable of automatically generating power grid structure data, which fills in the data gap caused by difficulty in acquiring the real power grid structure data.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Graph calculation-based non-direct-connected unit electric energy sensitivity analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power analysis and discloses a graph-calculation-based method and a graph-calculation-based system for analyzing the sensitivity of electric energy of a non-direct-connected unit, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring and importing topological structure model data of a power grid, and acquiring section measurement data of equipment in real time; the method comprises the steps of constructing a power grid power supply association graph model, determining all sources for supplying power to a station through a graph topological structure in the graph model, calculating the total power of the station power supply, determining non-direct connection power supply nodes, calculating the electric energy sensitivity of a non-direct connection unit, and performing visual display. According to the invention, based on the tide state estimation result, the direct-connected power supply unit of the station is determined by searching the power supply path of the target station, and the power generation power of each unit is used for realizing the traceability of the station electric energy, so that the processing speed and the efficiency of the graph calculation technology and the simplified and constructed power grid power supply association graph model are obviously improved compared with those of the traditional method.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Automatic driving platform of long-distance pipeline network heating system based on large model and knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic driving platform of a long-distance pipeline network heating system based on a large model and a knowledge graph, which comprises an infrastructure layer, a data processing layer, a large language model-knowledge graph layer, a large language model construction unit and a large language model construction unit, wherein the infrastructure layer is used for connecting an actual heat source of the long-distance pipeline network heating system, a long-distance pipeline network and a multi-stage pump station heating facility into the platform, the data processing layer comprises a data acquisition unit and a multi-source data fusion unit, the digital twin layer is used for establishing a digital twin model of the long-distance pipeline network heating system, the large language model-knowledge graph layer comprises a graph construction unit used for constructing each business knowledge graph, the large language model construction unit is used for constructing and training each business large language model and processing related business of the long-distance pipeline network heating system automatic driving, the business application decision layer comprises a business application unit used for providing a business application module of the long-distance pipeline network heating system, and the intelligent decision unit is used for carrying out simulation analysis and calling each business large model to output corresponding business decision results according to the digital twin model.
assignees: CHANGZHOU YINGJI POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: High impedance fault (hif) location to assist faster repair and outage restorations
abstract_en: A high impedance fault (HIF) may cause a section of a power line to burn open. When the fault current is in the same order of magnitude as the normal load current, the protection device that is upstream from the faulted power line will not trip, which may make it difficult to quickly identify the location of the faulted power line. Accordingly, disclosed embodiments leverage advanced metering infrastructure (AMI) data in a weighted least squares (WLS) distribution state estimation to estimate a state of the power network. The estimated states from successive WLS distribution state estimations may be used to calculate power-flow drops, which are used to define the search space for the faulted power line. From this search space, a single power line may be identified as the faulted power line, such that remedial action(s) may be performed to resolve any resulting power outages.
assignees: HITACHI ENERGY LTD

title_en: Water supply and drainage monitoring management system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twinning-based water supply and drainage monitoring management system, wherein a physical layer comprises a distributed sensor network arranged on a water supply and drainage pipe network, monitoring data of the water supply and drainage pipe network are collected through an in-pipe monitoring node and an out-pipe monitoring node, a transmission layer is used for transmitting the monitoring data collected by the physical layer to a digital twinning platform in real time through a wireless communication network, the digital twinning platform is used for integrating the received monitoring data into a digital twinning model of the water supply and drainage pipe network, predicting potential risks of each position of the water supply and drainage pipe network according to the monitoring data corresponding to the in-pipe node and the out-pipe node to obtain a risk prediction result, and a user layer is used for a user terminal to obtain mirror image data of the digital twinning model of the water supply and drainage pipe network and conduct visual display. The invention is beneficial to improving the management efficiency and the intelligent level of the water supply and drainage system management.
assignees: HANGZHOU URBAN & RURAL CONSTRUCTION DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Flexible resource parameter identification method based on KAN neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a flexible resource parameter identification method based on a KAN neural network, which relates to the technical field of power grid resource parameter identification, and comprises the following steps of acquiring historical operation data of power grid resources and identifying flexible resources in the power grid resources by a hierarchical analysis evaluation method; the method comprises the steps of constructing a flexible resource digital model through a digital twin technology according to the identified flexible resources, extracting a sample data set according to the flexible resource digital model, constructing and training a resource parameter identification model through a KAN neural network based on the extracted sample data set, acquiring operation data of the flexible resources in real time, and identifying flexible resource parameters by utilizing the trained resource parameter identification model. The invention can improve the accuracy of the model for identifying the flexible resource parameters, and the flexible resource parameters can be identified to provide more accurate decision support for power grid operators, so as to make more reasonable decisions in aspects of resource scheduling, energy allocation and the like.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic state estimation method for minimum information loss of heat supply network and air network of multi-energy system
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic state estimation method for minimum information loss of a heat supply network and an air supply network of a multi-energy system, which comprises the steps of building each subsystem of the comprehensive energy system and a multi-energy system coupling equipment model based on different physical characteristics and different time scales of the electric, thermal and air supply systems, building the heat supply network state estimation model and a quasi-dynamic state estimation model based on each subsystem and the multi-energy system coupling equipment model, substituting parameters at estimated time into the heat supply network state estimation model to obtain a heat supply network state estimation value, substituting the parameters at estimated time into the quasi-dynamic state estimation model, and solving the quasi-dynamic state estimation model by adopting an alternate direction multiplier method to obtain the air supply network state estimation value. The invention converts the nonlinear problem in the state estimation into the linear problem, greatly improves the precision of the state estimation, well balances the contradiction between the calculation complexity and the solving precision in the dynamic calculation of the multi-energy system network, and has good numerical stability and high calculation efficiency.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Multi-version model-based method and system for constructing medium-and-long-term future power flow section of power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for constructing a medium-and-long-term future power flow section of a power grid based on a multi-version model. The method comprises the steps of inquiring future state model version information based on a model multi-version library, extracting corresponding model data and current real-time state model data from the model multi-version library according to the future state model version information, performing model splicing to form complete full model data, inserting real-time state estimation mode data into a full future model, performing automatic grid connection processing on incremental equipment in the future version model by means of a deep topology search technology to endow the future model with complete initial mode data, and finally performing intelligent grouping on future sections of multiple time scales according to multiple future model versions, and superposing future boundary planning data to complete construction of medium-long-term future power flow sections. The method and the device can effectively improve the accuracy and the credibility of future power flow calculation.

title_en: Digital twin intelligent optimization scheduling system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power dispatching of a power distribution network, and discloses a digital twin intelligent optimal dispatching system and a digital twin intelligent optimal dispatching method, wherein the real-time power dispatching total power load parameter of a line distribution end of a target power distribution network is dynamically and accurately counted by combining numerical analysis according to the real-time power load parameter of a power distribution network user end, and the power dispatching operation of the power distribution network distribution end is efficiently and autonomously executed by combining a power management platform; and dynamically matching the power distribution end and the power dispatching electric variable of the user end in the power distribution network line with the power distribution network line according to the space three-dimensional model parameter of the whole power distribution network line, the power dispatching parameter and the three-dimensional model combination parameter of the power distribution end, and the power load parameter and the three-dimensional model combination parameter of the user end, so that the digital twin full scene accurate matching of the power dispatching parameter and the power dispatching object of the power distribution network is realized, and the scientificity and the intellectualization of the power dispatching operation are improved.

title_en: Urban power grid voltage correction method based on data fusion and topology inspection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for correcting urban power grid voltage based on data fusion and topology inspection, belonging to the technical field of intelligent management and control of power systems; the urban power grid voltage correction method based on data fusion and topology inspection solves the problem that actual urban power grid measurement data sampling is asynchronous by means of fusion of multi-source measurement data, solves the problem that traditional urban power grid state estimation is seriously dependent on intelligent ammeter measurement, improves the data quality of voltage measurement, and provides preconditions for accurate state estimation of an urban power grid.
assignees: YICHANG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Evaluation index system construction method and system of digital twin model of power equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for constructing an evaluation index system of a digital twin model of power equipment, and belongs to the technical field of evaluation of digital twin models of power equipment. The method comprises the steps of collecting operation related data text aiming at core power equipment, generating a keyword set according to the collected text, generating a to-be-selected index set of a digital twin model of the power equipment based on the keyword set, screening indexes in the to-be-selected index set, combining subjective weighting results and objective weighting results of the screened target indexes to obtain comprehensive weights of the target indexes, and constructing an evaluation index system of the digital twin model of the power equipment based on the comprehensive weights. The final evaluation index system is integrated with subjective and objective weighting, has obvious evaluation effect and has better popularization value.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION COMPANY;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin gate system construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a digital twin gate system, which relates to the technical field of hydropower stations, and comprises the following steps of acquiring actual operation data of a physical gate system, and correspondingly arranging at least one sensing device in each operation device of an internal operation structure of the physical gate system to acquire the actual operation data so as to form a sensing monitoring network; the method comprises the steps of constructing a three-dimensional model according to a physical gate system, constructing a digital twin gate system according to the three-dimensional model and a sensing monitoring network, comparing actual operation data of each operation device with an operation data threshold value, and sending maintenance reminding information when the actual operation data of any operation device exceeds the operation data threshold value and the corresponding operation device is determined to be in a fault state. The technical scheme provided by the invention can rapidly locate the exact position and related components of the fault, quicken the fault maintenance speed, and has the advantages of reducing the troubleshooting workload and improving the troubleshooting speed.
assignees: GUANGDONG SOUTH CHINA HYDROELECTRICITY HI TECH DEV CO LTD

title_en: Urban electric power early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an urban power early warning method and system, the method comprises the steps of establishing a digital twin map, obtaining power data of a power supply system to conduct cluster analysis, obtaining cluster data required by power prediction of each station area in the power supply system, conducting unified modeling prediction on daily power loads of the station areas through a preset combination model and the cluster data to obtain predicted power data of each station area, confirming whether power accident risks exist according to the predicted power data, obtaining predicted fault positions of corresponding station areas based on the digital twin map when the power accident risks exist, enabling an unmanned plane inspection module to reach the predicted fault positions to detect, obtaining actual power data of the predicted fault positions through a block chain technology and a data lake, and sending early warning result information to a target department according to the predicted power data and the actual power data. The invention improves the fault solving efficiency by carrying out power prediction and real-time detection on the power data of the power supply system and carrying out fault early warning.
assignees: LONGNAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Construction method and device of digital twin model of power distribution network
abstract_en: The application provides a construction method and device of a digital twin model of a power distribution network. The construction method comprises the steps of constructing a three-dimensional live-action model of the ground environment of the power distribution network in an illusion engine by utilizing an oblique photography technology, constructing a three-dimensional BIM model of the underground cable of the power distribution network and a channel of the underground cable of the power distribution network in the three-dimensional live-action model by utilizing a parameterization modeling technology, and carrying out simulation processing on the three-dimensional BIM model by utilizing the illusion engine to generate a digital twin model of the power distribution network. The application solves the problem that the three-dimensional spatial relationship between the cable and the surrounding environment cannot be intuitively displayed in the prior art.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ZHUHAI POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Data cleaning and filling method and system in photovoltaic power generation scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to a data cleaning and filling method and system in a photovoltaic power generation scene, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring a real-time or historical data set generated by a photovoltaic panel, cleaning the data, identifying and processing missing values and abnormal values in the data, and marking the missing values and the abnormal values; the method comprises the steps of generating an overview of corresponding missing and abnormal conditions for comparison and analysis by a user to quickly locate an area needing to be filled and repaired, visually outputting missing data filling and abnormal data correction results by adopting different interpolation algorithms aiming at the missing values and abnormal values existing in cleaned data, calculating filling similarity of the missing data filling and abnormal data correction results and historical similar data, judging and selecting the most suitable interpolation algorithm by the user, visually displaying the missing data filling and abnormal data correction results, visually displaying the whole data condition and the processed data state to the user, and manually adjusting part of abnormal values by the user through an interactive interface. The invention can remarkably improve the accuracy and flexibility of photovoltaic panel current data processing.
assignees: CHINA DATANG GROUP TECH INNOVATION CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for monitoring charging pile assembly based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for monitoring a charging pile assembly based on a digital twin technology. The method comprises the steps of obtaining charging pile power history basic information data, splitting the charging pile power history basic information data, constructing a fault detection model and a charging pile digital twin body according to the split data, enabling output of the fault detection model to be connected to the charging pile digital twin body, collecting charging pile real-time operation data by adopting a first sampling frequency, generating data flow of the charging pile operation data, driving the charging pile digital twin body by adopting the data flow, collecting the charging pile real-time operation data by adopting a second sampling frequency if the charging pile is determined to be faulty according to output of the fault detection model, checking a component with the fault by the charging pile, wherein the second sampling frequency is higher than the first sampling frequency, and displaying the component with the fault by the digital twin body if the checking is successful. The effect of real-time monitoring of the charging pile assembly can be achieved.
assignees: DUONAER ENERGY STORAGE TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Construction safety prompting method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a construction safety prompting method and a construction safety prompting system, wherein the construction safety prompting method comprises the following steps: the environment digital twin model updated in real time is constructed by collecting and fusing multidimensional environment data of a construction site. And carrying out self-adaptive evaluation on the safety state of each worker according to the model and the physiological data of the worker individuals to obtain an individualized dynamic safety threshold. And comprehensively evaluating the security situation by combining the environment digital twin model, the individualized dynamic security threshold and the real-time state data and adopting a graph neural network reasoning technology, and predicting the potential risk trend. According to the security situation assessment result and the risk prediction trend, a situation awareness hierarchical processing mode is adopted to generate self-adaptive early warning and intervention schemes aiming at different risk levels, and accurate security prompt is provided. According to the method, the safety state of workers is monitored and predicted in real time according to the dynamic change of the construction site, the intelligent level and accuracy of construction safety management are improved, and the accident risk is reduced.
assignees: SHENZHEN MABOSHI NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for updating digital twin bodies of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of operation analysis and control of a power distribution network, and particularly relates to a method and a device for updating a digital twin body of the power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring timestamp information of the current state of the twin body of pre-established power distribution network equipment when a state request is received; and judging whether the state of the twin body of the power distribution network equipment needs to be updated or not by utilizing the timestamp information of the current state to obtain a judging result, determining the state of the twin body of the power distribution network equipment at the next moment according to the judging result, wherein the twin body of the power distribution network equipment is created by utilizing the historical operation data of the power distribution network equipment. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, accurate creation and real-time update of the digital twin bodies of the power distribution network are realized, the operation efficiency of a power distribution system is effectively improved, the operation reliability of the system is improved, accurate and real-time auxiliary decision support is provided for power distribution network operators, and the power distribution network is assisted to realize safe, reliable and efficient operation.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method for evaluating resistance capability in power system disaster
