abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of elastic evaluation of power systems, and particularly relates to an evaluation method of countering capability in a disaster of a power system. The voltage magnitude and phase angle vectors of all nodes of the power system are used for representing the state of the power system, for the power system comprising N  b  nodes, 2N  b  -1-dimensional system state vectors of the power system are calculated, when disasters occur, the m-dimensional measurement vectors are used for containing state data collected by the rest available real-time measurement equipment in the power system, the measurement vectors of a node b are selected, all measurement quantities in the system are recorded as vectors z, the relation between a measurement true value z  true  and a system state x can be represented by a set of nonlinear equations, the measurement equation of the node b is solved, and the result of the state estimation is obtained by solving the state estimation based on a weighted least square method. The state estimation technology of the invention utilizes the redundancy of the real-time measurement system to eliminate measurement errors caused by random interference, improves the accuracy of the whole data of the system, and accurately estimates or predicts the running state of the power system.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;INST OF NEW ENERGY WUHAN CO LTD

title_en: Online modeling-based distributed photovoltaic power generation power prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed photovoltaic power generation power prediction method and system based on online modeling, wherein the method comprises the steps of 1, collecting distributed photovoltaic historical data to construct a historical data set, 2, establishing a rolling sampling model, conducting rollback calculation according to the day from the previous day, conducting quality judgment on the daily data set, skipping the day if an effective sample is lower than a threshold value, continuing rollback until the number of effective sample days is greater than a set number of days N1, 3, calculating a day curve characteristic index based on the circularly sampled data, determining the weather track type of the day to be predicted, 4, judging whether the weather track type is matched with the weather type of the day to be predicted, if yes, storing current day data into the effective data set, 5, judging whether the effective number of the data set meets the set condition N2, and if yes, conducting photoelectric conversion modeling on the data set. The invention can realize the online updating of the photoelectric conversion model and improve the prediction precision of the distributed photovoltaic power.
assignees: STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Low-voltage distribution network running state estimation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for estimating the running state of a low-voltage power distribution network, and provides a comprehensive evaluation strategy for the running state of the power distribution network, which is used for accurately and efficiently knowing the running state of a high-proportion distributed photovoltaic low-voltage power distribution network, by considering the increase of the probability of the running of the low-voltage power distribution network in an unsafe normal state after a large-scale distributed photovoltaic is connected into the low-voltage power distribution network. The invention adopts the combination weighting method and the subjective weight and the objective weight as the upper limit and the lower limit of the combination weight, and the adoption of the variation coefficient maximizing combination weighting method can lead the evaluation result of the running state of the low-voltage distribution network to have larger difference, can effectively distinguish the evaluated objects, is convenient for comparing the evaluation result and leads the evaluation result to be more accurate.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Icing thickness prediction method and system based on microclimate data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent weather prediction and power system safety, in particular to an icing thickness prediction method and system based on microclimate data, which are characterized by collecting microclimate data such as air temperature, humidity, wind speed and the like, utilizing time sequence analysis and a machine learning algorithm to extract data and train a model, and simultaneously combining real-time updated weather data to dynamically adjust the model so as to cope with complex and changeable weather conditions; the system has higher prediction accuracy, particularly can provide accurate prediction under extreme weather, a real-time updating mechanism enables a model to reflect the latest weather conditions, updates the prediction result of the icing thickness in time, reduces negative effects caused by icing, has wide adaptability, can be used for icing prediction, can also be applied to flood prediction and drought monitoring, is intuitive and friendly in user interface, and enables professional and common users to easily understand and utilize the prediction result.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin system for monitoring power tower state in real time and identifying common diseases
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twin technology-based power tower state real-time monitoring and universal fault identification system. The system integrates a sensor network module by constructing a high-precision digital twin model module so as to acquire the key data of the pole and the tower in real time. The data processing center module ensures data precision by utilizing an advanced clock synchronization technology, and is matched with the common-fault recognition system module and the health state evaluation module to accurately evaluate the health condition of the tower by adopting finite element analysis and Paris law. The system also comprises an intelligent maintenance decision support module for providing scientific maintenance strategies. In addition, the data visualization platform module and the user interaction interface module enhance the user experience, so that the system is not only limited to monitoring and evaluation, but also realizes optimization of maintenance decision and personalization of user interaction. The whole system design pays attention to real-time performance, accuracy and intellectualization, and aims to improve the operation and maintenance efficiency and safety of the power tower.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CONSTRUCTION ENG QUALITY SUPERVISION CENTRAL STATION

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring and early warning method and system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: A geological disaster monitoring and early warning method and system based on a digital twin technology relate to the technical field of data monitoring. The method comprises the steps of obtaining satellite image information, weather information and geological detection information of a mountain area to be monitored in a preset sampling period, constructing a three-dimensional digital model of the mountain area to be monitored based on the satellite image information, the weather information and the geological detection information, receiving current mountain data, geological data and weather conditions of the mountain area to be monitored, combining the mountain data and the geological data, determining a plurality of risk sources of the mountain area to be monitored under the weather conditions and positions corresponding to the risk sources in the three-dimensional digital model, and carrying out disaster early warning on the basis of the positions of the risk sources when the change rate of any monitoring index in the mountain data or the geological data of the risk sources exceeds a change rate threshold value for each risk source. By implementing the technical scheme provided by the application, the effect of improving the accuracy of geological disaster monitoring and early warning is achieved.
assignees: HENAN PROVINCIAL GEOLOGICAL ENV PLANNING & DESIGNING CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic output prediction method considering haze/dust factors
abstract_en: The invention provides a photovoltaic output prediction method considering haze/dust factors. Firstly, preprocessing data, screening abnormal data and invalid data, and complementing missing data. And classifying weather data by utilizing a decision tree algorithm, deeply understanding internal rules and operation mechanisms by analyzing a haze/sand and dust formation mechanism and a photovoltaic power generation principle, determining main characteristics, firstly establishing a haze/sand and dust influence model 1 and a photovoltaic power generation power prediction model 2 aiming at haze/sand and dust data, obtaining influence parameters of haze/sand and dust factors on photovoltaic power generation power by the model 1, and outputting predicted values of the photovoltaic power generation power by the model 2. The advantages of the mechanism analysis and the data driving model are combined, and the accuracy and the reliability of the model are improved.
assignees: GULANG LYUZHOU PHOTOVOLTAIC POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Transmission line crossing safety performance evaluation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety performance evaluation method for crossing of a power transmission line, which comprises the steps of obtaining a target crossing section type corresponding to a crossing section in the power transmission line, obtaining a crossing structure knowledge graph corresponding to the target crossing section type in a preset digital twin three-dimensional model database, wherein the preset digital twin three-dimensional model database is used for storing the corresponding relation between the target crossing section type and the crossing structure knowledge graph, obtaining monitoring structure data of the crossing section according to the crossing structure knowledge graph, carrying out safety evaluation on the crossing section through a crossing section structure safety model according to the monitoring structure data, and outputting a safety evaluation result. The invention also discloses a corresponding device, equipment and a storage medium. By implementing the method and the device, the accuracy and timeliness of the safety performance evaluation result can be improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Hydraulic engineering-based data analysis processing method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic engineering-based data analysis processing method and system, which relate to the technical field of data processing and comprise the steps of analyzing and processing hydraulic engineering data to be processed in a database system based on a data management terminal to obtain a hydraulic engineering abnormal data position, analyzing and processing the hydraulic engineering abnormal data position based on the data management terminal and determining the type of the hydraulic engineering abnormal data. According to the method, firstly, the missing data is positioned on the hydraulic engineering data to be processed in the database system, then the type of the missing data is analyzed, whether the missing data can be supplemented or not is determined, if the missing data cannot be supplemented, deletion is performed, the interference on the hydraulic engineering power generation equipment during the subsequent analysis of the running state of the hydraulic engineering power generation equipment is avoided, the data analysis time is shortened, and finally, the supplemented hydraulic engineering data are ordered through the time continuity, so that the analysis on the hydraulic engineering data is more convenient and faster during the subsequent invoking of the hydraulic engineering data.
assignees: SIHONG COUNTY WATER CONSERVANCY ENG CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin modeling system of wind power plant and use method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wind power generation and discloses a digital twin modeling system of a wind power plant and a using method thereof, wherein the system comprises an equipment module, a wind power plant control system and a wind power plant control system, wherein the equipment module comprises a bionical self-adaptive fan blade system, a quantum sensing network, a laser radar system, a high-resolution multi-mode imaging system and an intelligent autonomous flying machine crowd system; the network module comprises a 5G private network, a quantum communication network and an edge computing network, the data module comprises a distributed database system, a big data processing platform and an AI training platform, the AI module comprises a wind condition prediction model, a power prediction model, a device health state monitoring model and an adaptive control algorithm model, and the application module comprises a digital twin visualization platform, a holographic mixed reality operation and maintenance system and an intelligent scheduling system. The invention can realize modeling and intelligent management of the wind power plant, improve the power generation efficiency, reduce the operation and maintenance cost and prolong the service life of equipment.
assignees: PENGLAI WIND POWER BRANCH HUANENG SHANDONG POWER GENERATION CO LTD;XIAN THERMAL POWER RES INST CO

title_en: Online optimization adjustment method for stable control strategy based on real-time operation mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stable control strategy on-line optimization adjustment method based on a real-time operation mode, which relates to the technical field of stable control of an electric power system and comprises the following steps: and receiving the stability control actual measurement data, carrying out node power balance inspection on the stability control actual measurement data, adopting a switching device, modifying the equivalent branch injection power to eliminate the power unbalance, and identifying the current controllable quantity according to the state of the pressure plate, the fixed value and the channel state which are actually measured in the stability control. The invention realizes the following technical effects that the data processing module replaces the traditional state estimation data by the rationality check and the power balance check by combining the actual measurement data, improves the reliability of the basic data, and realizes the accurate identification of the current control strategy by the comprehensive analysis of the state of the pressing plate, the fixed value and the channel state.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power plant monitoring operation and maintenance method and device based on digital twin
abstract_en: The application provides a digital twinning-based power plant monitoring operation and maintenance method and a device, which relate to the technical field of hydroelectric generating set operation and maintenance management, and the method comprises the steps of utilizing a multi-source sensing monitoring array to carry out holographic sensing based on dynamic monitoring frequency to obtain an initial multi-source data stream; the method comprises the steps of integrating dimension reduction to determine standard multi-source data flow, identifying the standard multi-source data flow to obtain an abnormal monitoring feature set, executing simulation operation to obtain simulation operation faults, identifying the simulation operation faults which do not meet a planning operation and maintenance scheme, determining the abnormal operation faults, associating the abnormal operation faults, and generating an expected operation and maintenance scheme for operation and maintenance. The application can solve the technical problems of poor running stability and safety of the unit caused by the fact that the running state of the unit cannot be accurately monitored and the potential running and maintenance fault threat can not be found in time due to low intelligent degree of the conventional giant hydroelectric unit running and maintenance method, can realize the aim of intelligent running and maintenance of the unit and ensures the safe and reliable running of the hydroelectric unit.
assignees: LONGTAN HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD LONGTAN HYDROELECTRIC POWER PLANT

title_en: Load prediction and scheduling method adapting to hot user behaviors
abstract_en: The invention discloses a load prediction and scheduling method adapting to thermal user behaviors, relates to the technical field of load prediction, and solves the technical problem that in the prior art, complex problems are difficult to capture all factors influencing the load by using a linear method; the method comprises the steps of establishing a pipe network load simulation model based on historical load data and a thermal user behavior mode, simulating a real-time running state of a pipe network by utilizing a digital twin technology, updating thermal user behavior data in real time, predicting the load change of the pipe network in real time according to simulation results and the thermal user behavior data updated in real time, carrying out self-adaptive regulation and control scheduling according to prediction results so as to adapt to real-time changeable switching requirements of thermal users, optimizing a regulation and control strategy through a machine learning algorithm, and ensuring optimization of a scheduling plan.
assignees: HEFEI THERMOELECTRIC GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Detection data generation method, electric equipment energy consumption processing method and device
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a detection data generation method and a power consumption processing method and device of electric equipment, which can be applied to the technical fields of intelligent equipment, intelligent industry, artificial intelligence and the Internet of things. The method for generating the detection data comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of sensor detection data matched with a target area and a target scene, wherein the target area represents a functional area in a building object, the target scene represents a use scene of electric equipment, the sensor detection data comprise detection data collected by at least one sensor, reconstructing the missing data based on a data missing type in response to the fact that the missing data exist in the plurality of sensor detection data, obtaining sensor reconstruction data corresponding to the missing data, and generating the target detection data according to the sensor reconstruction data and complete data in the sensor detection data.
assignees: BEIJING JINGDONG YUANSHENG TECH CO LTD;BEIJING JINGBANGDA TRADING CO LTD

title_en: Distribution network scheduling method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network scheduling method and a distribution network scheduling system based on big data, and belongs to the technical field of distribution network scheduling. The method comprises the steps of establishing a corresponding distribution network scheduling model according to digital twin bodies and distribution network information, obtaining an original scheduling plan, extracting original influence item data in the original scheduling plan according to influence items, acquiring real-time influence item data corresponding to the influence items from the distribution network scheduling model based on the influence items, processing the original influence item data and the real-time influence item data according to a preset matrix template to obtain a corresponding planning matrix and an influence matrix, calculating a corresponding change matrix according to the planning matrix and the influence matrix, adjusting the original scheduling plan based on the change matrix to obtain a real-time scheduling plan, performing simulation verification on the real-time scheduling plan, and applying the corresponding real-time scheduling plan after the simulation verification is passed.
assignees: JIANGSU XIANGDIAN ELECTRIC POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Peak-regulating thermal power plant energy-saving method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy saving method for a peak-shaving thermal power plant, which relates to the technical field of intelligent energy control and comprises the specific steps of collecting real-time power, obtaining electricity utilization rate under real-time power generation power by means of real-time voltage and current collection, designing a multi-dimensional variable optimizing flow frame, optimizing by adopting a traversing method, firstly fixing temperature R, secondly fixing 5 of 6 variables according to given power, and recording operation conditions of a generator, a condenser and various related devices corresponding to beta' while optimizing by using the traversing method so as to establish a digital twin system of a generator set. When the unit operates according to the scheduling instruction instead of operating under the design capacity of the unit, at the moment, the condensate water required by the power generation power can be reduced, and an optimal operating point is required to be found by applying a working condition optimizing method, so that the unit enters an optimal operating mode, and the problem of energy conservation and loss reduction under the low-output power generation working condition is realized by adopting an optimizing technical means.
assignees: NANJING DIANRUI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Marine wind power fault analysis and positioning method based on residual error correction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a residual error correction-based marine wind power fault analysis and positioning method which comprises the following steps of establishing a digital twin model of a marine wind power grid based on the marine wind power grid, fusing a measured value of a measuring system of the marine wind power grid with the digital twin model, establishing a state estimation model, predicting predicted power of each node of the marine wind power grid through the state estimation model, calculating weighted residual errors of the predicted power and the actual power through collecting actual power of each node of the measuring system, determining a fault section, setting virtual nodes in the fault section, comparing weighted residual errors of adjacent virtual node sections, and obtaining adjacent virtual node sections with the largest weighted residual errors, thereby determining a fault accurate position. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of high positioning precision, wide applicability and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SHANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Multi-time-state power grid track analysis method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-temporal power grid track analysis method based on digital twinning, which belongs to the technical field of power grid analysis and comprises the following steps of S1, carrying out feature reduction on an original power grid sample set, S2, constructing a power grid digital twinning model based on the original power grid sample set after feature reduction, S3, constructing a multi-temporal power grid track deduction model based on the original power grid sample set after feature reduction, S4, generating track data based on the power grid digital twinning model, and inputting a mixed data set formed by the track data and real-time data into the multi-temporal power grid track deduction model for analysis and diagnosis. The invention can comprehensively understand the running state of the power grid through comprehensive analysis of various tenses, and provides scientific basis for power grid dispatching and decision making.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Photovoltaic system dynamic state estimation method and system based on solar irradiance change
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic state estimation method and a system of a photovoltaic system based on solar irradiance change, wherein randomness of solar irradiance is regarded as unknown input of DSE, and the unknown input is combined into an unscented Kalman filtering algorithm in an unbiased minimum variance mode, so that state estimation of the photovoltaic system is realized. The method can accurately estimate the dynamic state of the photovoltaic system in time, solves the problem that the illumination fluctuation influences the estimation precision, and better describes the running state of the power system.

title_en: System for multilateral collaboration using digital twin and extended reality based on geographic information system
title_ko: Gis 기반의 디지털 트윈 및 확장현실을 이용한 다자간 협업 시스템
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a multilateral collaboration system using GIS-based digital twin and expansion reality capable of maximizing ease and efficiency of multilateral collaboration. The multilateral collaboration system comprises: a management server for providing a 3D digital twin map sharing service synchronized between a plurality of users; an operator communication terminal for configuring a 3D digital twin map by receiving configuration information and configuration data of the 3D digital twin map from the management server, and transmitting map operation data generated when the 3D digital twin map is operated to the management server in real time; and an operated operator communication terminal for sharing visual information of the 3D digital twin map operated by the operator communication terminal in real time by applying the map operation data received from the management server to the 3D digital twin map.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 GIS 기반의 디지털 트윈 및 확장현실을 이용한 다자간 협업 시스템에 관한 것으로, 해결하고자 하는 과제는 GIS 기반의 도시 재난 및 안전 등에 대한 이벤트 정보와 항공 영상 정보를 실시간 공유하면서 디지털 트윈 기술에 기반한 3D 지형 및 건물 모델 정보를 확장현실에 기반하여 조작 가능하게 표출하고 상호 공유하는 데이터에 대한 실시간 동기화를 수행함으로써 다자간 협업 용이성과 효율성을 극대화시키는데 있다. 
일례로, 다수의 사용자를 대상으로 지형 및 건물을 포함하는 3D 디지털 트윈 맵의 구성 정보와 구성 데이터를 제공하고, 다수의 사용자 간에 동기화된 3D 디지털 트윈 맵 공유 서비스를 제공하는 관리 서버; 상기 관리 서버로부터 3D 디지털 트윈 맵의 구성 정보와 구성 데이터를 제공 받아 3D 디지털 트윈 맵을 구성하고, 3D 디지털 트윈 맵의 조작 시 생성되는 맵 조작 데이터를 상기 관리 서버로 실시간 전송하는 조작자 통신단말; 및 상기 관리 서버로부터 3D 디지털 트윈 맵의 구성 정보와 구성 데이터를 각각 제공 받아 확장현실 기반의 3D 디지털 트윈 맵을 구성하되, 상기 관리 서버로부터 수신되는 상기 맵 조작 데이터를 3D 디지털 트윈 맵에 적용하여 상기 조작자 통신단말에 의해 조작되는 3D 디지털 트윈 맵의 시각적 정보를 실시간 공유하는 피조작자 통신단말을 포함하는 GIS 기반의 디지털 트윈 및 확장현실을 이용한 다자간 협업 시스템을 개시한다.
assignees: KO IN SUK

title_en: Agricultural product circulation tracing method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural product circulation management and tracing, in particular to an agricultural product circulation tracing method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of recording environmental states such as temperature and humidity, illumination and the like in real time through intelligent material labels, and dynamically binding the environmental states to a digital twin body; the method comprises the steps of detecting environment abnormality by combining an improved isolated forest algorithm to generate an abnormality detection result, carrying out trend prediction on the completed time series data by utilizing a recurrent neural network model and a multivariate interpolation algorithm to generate future state data, constructing a knowledge graph comprising historical, current and future states based on a digital twin and the prediction data, and generating a tracing path and a risk prompt. The invention realizes real-time monitoring, accurate prediction and intelligent traceability of the agricultural product circulation process, improves the risk early warning capability and data transparency, and provides reliable decision support for consumers, producers and supervision authorities.

title_en: Digital twin technology-based photovoltaic power generation system fault diagnosis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault diagnosis method of a photovoltaic power generation system based on a digital twin technology, which comprises the steps of obtaining the ambient temperature, solar irradiance, photovoltaic array voltage and photovoltaic array current of the photovoltaic power generation system to be diagnosed in a preset time period, and calculating the photovoltaic array power at corresponding moments according to the photovoltaic array voltage and the photovoltaic array current of the photovoltaic power generation system to be diagnosed at corresponding moments. The fault diagnosis method of the photovoltaic power generation system based on the digital twin technology constructs a residual vector by making differences among the actually acquired environment temperature, solar irradiance, photovoltaic array voltage and photovoltaic array current and the environment temperature, solar irradiance, photovoltaic array voltage and photovoltaic array current obtained through simulation, judges whether the photovoltaic power generation system has faults according to the residual vector, further diagnoses the fault types through fault diagnosis, and can effectively judge the actual fault types under the condition of only small-scale data training.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Electric energy quality prediction and management platform based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power quality prediction and management platform based on a digital twin technology, and relates to the technical field of power system monitoring. The physical space layer is provided with an electric energy quality monitoring device and an electric equipment state monitoring device, the output multi-time scale data are transmitted to the data space layer for synchronous acquisition and pretreatment, the pretreated data are input into the model space layer, a physical entity mapping relation is constructed through a digital twin basic model, a dynamic feature map is constructed through an attribute expansion model, dynamic analysis is realized through a multi-scale analysis model, and the analysis result is input into an application space layer for prediction, early warning and treatment. The invention establishes a layered digital twin system of basic mapping, characteristic expansion and dynamic analysis, realizes the cooperative analysis of transient disturbance, short-term fluctuation and steady-state characteristics, and provides effective support for the optimal configuration of the electric energy quality control device.
assignees: GUANGZHOU HUITONG GUOXIN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Tunnel rock mass dynamic disaster monitoring system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twinning-based tunnel rock mass dynamic disaster monitoring system, which relates to the technical field of dynamic disaster monitoring and comprises the steps of obtaining strain, surface subsidence and underground water level of a tunnel under dynamic load and strength and rigidity data of the tunnel, extracting natural frequency and damping ratio of the tunnel to generate a dynamic response index, calculating average strain, subsidence and underground water level to generate a stability index and a structural influence index, and combining the indexes to generate a disaster assessment model to form a disaster assessment index. According to the method, the tunnel structure under the dynamic load effect is monitored and evaluated comprehensively and in real time, the disaster evaluation model is generated by utilizing the dynamic response index, the stability index and the structure influence index, and various key parameters of the tunnel are fully considered, so that potential risks can be rapidly identified, and support is provided for decision making.
assignees: PEARL RIVER HYDRAULIC RES INST PEARL RIVER WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION;ZHUJIANG WATER RESOURCES AND HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD;UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: Method and system for supplementing monitoring data of energy storage power station based on feature fusion
abstract_en: The method and the system for supplementing the monitoring data of the energy storage power station based on feature fusion acquire all historical monitoring data and actual monitoring data of the energy storage power station, generate a plurality of groups of monitoring data with different data loss rates based on a probability model, wherein each group of monitoring data comprises completely random missing data, non-random missing data and actual monitoring data; the method comprises the steps of forming a monitoring data set of an energy storage power station by using a plurality of groups of monitoring data with different data loss rates together, establishing an asymmetric noise reduction self-encoder model based on a network structure of a noise reduction self-encoder, taking the monitoring data set as input and taking a preliminary complement data set of the monitoring data set as output by the asymmetric noise reduction self-encoder model, outputting the preliminary complement data set of the monitoring data set of the energy storage power station by using a trained model, filtering the preliminary complement data set by using a moving average filter to obtain the complement data set, and realizing accurate complement of the monitoring data of the energy storage power station.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD SUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH

title_en: Ultra-short-term photovoltaic power prediction method in complex meteorological environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-short-term photovoltaic power prediction method under a complex meteorological environment, which belongs to the technical field of extreme weather power prediction, and comprises the specific steps of selecting historical power data and historical meteorological data of a photovoltaic power station in a Sha Ge barren area, deleting missing data and error data in the historical data, dividing a training set, a verification set and a test set, and finally carrying out normalization processing on the data; the method comprises the steps of (A) obtaining a plurality of IMFs and trend items by using a Surface Mounted Device (SMD), (surface mounted device) decomposing complex meteorological factors to obtain a plurality of IMFs and trend items, and (III) judging whether each characteristic time sequence is relevant according to the obtained trend items and taking a historical value of the meteorological factors as a node characteristic.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Dynamic sensing method and system for digital twin bodies of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic sensing method and a dynamic sensing system for a digital twin body of a power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining real-time data of operation of the power distribution network, monitoring node changes and line state changes of the power distribution network based on the real-time data, updating a power distribution network topological structure diagram in an established digital twin model of the power distribution network based on the node changes and the line state changes in real time, analyzing operation parameters of the power distribution network through the digital twin model of the power distribution network based on the real-time data and historical data to obtain analysis results, and detecting and positioning operation faults of the power distribution network through the digital twin model of the power distribution network based on the analysis results. The invention provides a dynamic sensing method and a dynamic sensing system for a digital twin body of a power distribution network based on multi-element network topology and parameter changes, which can capture and reflect the changeable network structure and parameter changes in the power distribution network in real time, and promote the dynamic sensing capability of the digital twin body, thereby supporting fault early warning and quick recovery of the power distribution network.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH

title_en: State estimation method and system for self-encoder static power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a self-encoder static power distribution network state estimation method and system, and belongs to the field of power systems. The method comprises the steps of collecting simulation data of a static power distribution network system when part of data is missing, generating a repair model, obtaining a target domain model through transfer learning fine adjustment based on the repair model, repairing measured data of the missing part of data through the repair model to obtain complete data, and estimating the state of the static power distribution network system by using the target domain model. The invention can accurately predict the running state of the power system.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST;Quanzhou Power Supply Company Of State Grid Fujian Electric Power Company;SANMING POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power consumption data processing method and system based on time sequence association and trend fitting
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of electricity data processing, and provides an electricity data processing method and system based on time sequence association and trend fitting. The method comprises the steps of obtaining historical electricity utilization data, extracting electricity utilization characteristics from the historical electricity utilization data, carrying out time sequence correlation importance evaluation on the relevant characteristics of each electricity utilization characteristic, screening out an optimal time sequence electricity utilization characteristic set relevant to the user electricity utilization characteristics, capturing user behavior trend characteristics in the historical electricity utilization data by adopting a long-short time neural network algorithm, encoding the user behavior trend characteristics and the optimal time sequence characteristic set relevant to the user electricity utilization characteristics by utilizing an encoder to obtain trend encoding data at the missing moment, and decoding the trend encoding data at the missing moment by utilizing a decoder in combination with environmental state data to obtain a predicted value of a missing value of the user electricity utilization characteristics so as to complement the missing data at the missing value moment. The method can improve the completion accuracy of the power consumption data missing value so as to improve the operation and maintenance efficiency of the intelligent power system.
assignees: DAREWAY SOFTWARE CO LTD

title_en: Fault risk perception method for power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network fault risk sensing method which comprises the following steps of S1, data acquisition and monitoring, S2, data preprocessing, S5 and risk assessment, wherein the data acquisition and monitoring comprises the steps of collecting operation data of a power grid in real time through a sensor, an intelligent ammeter, a fault indicator and a remote terminal unit which are arranged in the power distribution network, the S2 comprises the steps of cleaning the collected original data, removing abnormal values, processing missing data and unifying data formats, the S3 comprises the steps of analyzing real-time data flow by utilizing a big data analysis technology, monitoring the operation state of the power grid and identifying abnormal conditions, the S4 comprises the steps of building a fault early warning model based on historical fault data and current operation data, and the fault early warning model is used for predicting the possibility of fault occurrence and the possible fault type. The invention can sense potential faults in advance and provide key information for preventive maintenance and emergency response, thereby improving the stability and reliability of the power distribution network.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin hydrologic modeling method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: A digital twin hydrologic modeling method, a digital twin hydrologic modeling system, electronic equipment and a storage medium relate to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the steps of obtaining earth surface point cloud data and underground pipe point cloud data of a target area, establishing a first digital model based on the earth surface point cloud data and a second digital model based on the underground pipe point cloud data, performing data mapping on the first digital model and the second digital model to construct a space digital twin model of the target area, obtaining rainfall data and water level data of a plurality of sampling points in the space digital twin model, determining flood risk contour lines of the target area based on the rainfall data and the water level data of the sampling points, and overlapping the flood risk contour lines to the space digital twin model to obtain a hydrological early warning model of the target area. By implementing the technical scheme provided by the application, the effect of improving the accuracy of hydrologic modeling is achieved.
assignees: BEIJING YIBANGDA TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Rural digital twin energy storage management method and system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twinning, in particular to a rural digital twinning energy storage management method and system based on the Internet of things. The method comprises the steps of acquiring real-time operation data through rural distributed energy storage equipment to obtain rural energy storage data, constructing a digital twin model according to the rural energy storage data to obtain a rural energy storage digital twin model, detecting an energy storage state according to the rural energy storage digital twin model to obtain rural energy storage state data, and performing optimal scheduling according to the rural energy storage state data to obtain rural energy storage scheduling data so as to perform rural energy storage management auxiliary operation. According to the invention, through the construction of the digital twin model and virtual-real synchronous management, the system can realize multi-level state monitoring, load prediction and priority scheduling of the equipment, and the efficient operation of the energy storage equipment in rural power grid environments is ensured.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Fire-fighting early warning method and system for electric power fire of transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric fire protection early warning, and provides a method and a system for electric fire protection early warning of a transformer substation, which aim to solve the problem of early warning accuracy reduction caused by limited coverage range of a fire protection early warning system of a large-scale transformer substation. The method comprises the steps of obtaining operation data and position data of a transformer substation, constructing a transformer substation virtual image by combining a digital twin technology, realizing global monitoring, dynamically planning an inspection path by a system according to information of monitoring equipment and mobile inspection equipment, distinguishing known and unknown monitoring ranges, generating a mobile inspection path for an unknown area, collecting data, substituting the data into an early warning model for analysis, and obtaining a fire disaster early warning result. The invention improves the early warning accuracy, effectively ensures the safe and stable operation of the power system, and promotes the intelligent development of the fire-fighting early warning of the transformer substation.

title_en: Power grid bearing capacity assessment method, device, equipment, medium and program
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of information management, and particularly relates to a method, a device, equipment, a medium and a program for evaluating the carrying capacity of a power grid. The method comprises the steps of obtaining power grid parameters based on a digital twin platform, carrying out distributed storage and/or encryption based on a blockchain network after the data of the digital twin platform are synchronized through an Internet of things sensor, and calculating the carrying capacity of a power grid according to fusion weights and the power grid parameters, wherein the fusion weights are weights of the power grid parameters, which are obtained by fusing a first weight and a second weight based on a nonlinear model. The method not only optimizes the efficiency of data processing, but also improves the accuracy, the instantaneity and the safety of monitoring and managing the carrying capacity of the power grid, thereby further improving the reliability of evaluation.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Multi-main-body-participation multi-energy system distributed state estimation method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-main-body-participation multi-energy system distributed state estimation method and device, wherein the method comprises the steps of respectively constructing a gas pipe network dynamic model, a power grid AC tide model and a coupling equipment model; the method solves the privacy protection problem between energy management subjects, avoids the risk of exposing detail sensitive data in the consistency estimation process, has the advantages of simplicity and high efficiency, and can achieve the consistency estimation result without complicated iteration process.
assignees: UNIV XINJIANG

title_en: Digital twin technology-based urban mobile pump truck scheduling system research and development method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin technology-based urban mobile pump truck dispatching system research and development method. The method disclosed by the invention realizes the efficient and intelligent scheduling, the real-time monitoring and the optimal management of the urban mobile pump truck through integrating the third-party navigation system, the real-time data acquisition, the multi-objective optimal scheduling algorithm and the perfect visual emergency response mechanism, and realizes the accurate scheduling and the efficient rescue of the mobile pump truck so as to cope with dangerous situations such as road ponding, water logging in the next interchange and the like, improve the efficiency and the response speed of urban drainage flood prevention, effectively cope with urban waterlogging disasters and ensure urban safety.
assignees: WONDERS INFORMATION CO LTD

title_en: State estimation method and system for distributed multi-region power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a state estimation method and a state estimation system for a distributed multi-region power system, which relate to the technical field of power management, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring local measurement data, neighbor measurement signals and neighbor state estimation value signals of a power system to be measured in a target area in a distributed multi-area power system, further calculating a state priori estimation value, a state error covariance matrix upper bound and a neighbor gain matrix of the power system to be measured at the next moment, thereby obtaining upper bound and neighbor gain parameters of calculated error covariance, obtaining weighted error covariance through Gellan-based decomposition, calculating a state error covariance weight matrix and a measurement error covariance weight matrix through a preset Kerck kernel function, and calculating a gain matrix of a local estimator through an motionless point iteration method to finish state estimation of the power system to be measured. The minimum mean square error condition is replaced by the maximum relative entropy condition of the Cauchy kernel with reasonable design, so that the state estimation under the non-Gaussian noise environment is improved.

title_en: Operation and maintenance intelligent scheduling method, device and system for photovoltaic ground power station
abstract_en: The invention discloses an operation and maintenance intelligent scheduling method, device and system for a photovoltaic ground power station, which belong to the field of operation and maintenance of photovoltaic power stations and comprise the steps of acquiring data, screening and integrating, analyzing fault density based on a digital twin map of the photovoltaic power station, and selecting tasks to be scheduled by utilizing a mode of selecting range faults; the method comprises the steps of constructing a scheduling comprehensive cost model, constructing a PSO algorithm-based scheduling comprehensive cost optimal model, bringing tasks to be scheduled and integration factors into the model, carrying out iterative optimization through the model, finally finding a scheduling comprehensive cost optimal scheme, and outputting the scheduling comprehensive cost optimal scheme. The invention can help the operation staff to more clearly determine the sequence of the operation and the auxiliary content of the operation, improve the operation and maintenance efficiency, reduce the operation and maintenance cost and reasonably carry out task allocation and route planning.
assignees: HANGZHOU PINNET TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for monitoring gas safety of courtyard pipe network and industrial and commercial users based on ultrasonic measurement
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of courtyard pipe networks, in particular to a supervision method for realizing the safety of courtyard pipe networks and industrial and commercial user gas based on ultrasonic measurement. The method comprises the following steps of S1, collecting interest point data and night light image data of courtyard users and business users, S2, dividing the courtyard users and the business users into grids based on the collected data, and carrying out functional area division on the courtyard users and the business users based on a frequency density algorithm, and S3, establishing a pipe network digital twin model based on the results of the gridding and the functional area division, and carrying out simulation calculation. According to the design, the function areas of the courtyard and the business users are divided by collecting the interest point data and the night light image data of the courtyard and the business users and combining the frequency density algorithm, so that a pipe network digital twin model is constructed and simulation calculation is carried out. The method is not only helpful for accurately simulating the actual running state of the gas pipe network, but also can discover potential safety hazards in advance, such as leakage, overpressure and other problems.

title_en: Deep-shallow part coupling three-dimensional ground stress model parameter optimization method based on data assimilation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of earth science and engineering, and provides a deep-shallow part coupling three-dimensional ground stress model parameter optimization method based on data assimilation. The method is realized by the steps of firstly collecting topographic data of an earth surface engineering area, analyzing seismic data to obtain underground geological structure information, actually measuring three-dimensional ground stress data of observation points of the engineering area, secondly constructing a geological model, a mechanical model and a mathematical model, then setting loading conditions, carrying out finite element calculation, solving stress, displacement and deformation, then introducing actual measurement data to carry out data assimilation calibration calculation results, updating an initial stress parameter set of the model and carrying out iterative adjustment, and realizing depth fusion of the observation data and a numerical model through a data assimilation technology, thereby remarkably improving the prediction precision and accuracy of the three-dimensional ground stress model and providing more accurate data support for engineering design and geological disaster prediction.

title_en: Short-term payload prediction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a short-term payload prediction method, which comprises a data preprocessing technology based on various factors such as historical payload data, decomposed payload data, weather data, date data and the like, wherein the data preprocessing technology comprises data cleaning, feature selection and feature scaling, and the data cleaning is used for processing error, missing or invalid data in a data set and comprises the steps of deleting repeated data, processing missing data and abnormal values. The method has the beneficial effects of firstly, improving the prediction accuracy. 2. And the generalization capability of the model is improved. 3. The adaptability and the flexibility of the model are enhanced. 4. And the data utilization efficiency is improved. 5. And the efficient operation and management of the power system are facilitated. Under the power market environment, accurate net load prediction can help power suppliers and users to formulate reasonable transaction strategies, reduce market risk, control cost and promote healthy development of the power market.
assignees: MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power transmission equipment monitoring method and system based on side
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a method and a system for monitoring power transmission equipment based on side. The method comprises the steps of monitoring indexes of target power transmission equipment through a sensor to obtain operation data of the target power transmission equipment, determining standardized scores of the operation data, determining comprehensive health scores of the target power transmission equipment according to the standard scores of the operation data, adaptive deviation correction items of the operation data and a proportionality coefficient, determining comprehensive score indexes of the target power transmission equipment according to the comprehensive health scores, the standardized scores and trend factors of the target power transmission equipment, and determining equipment operation states of the target power transmission equipment according to the comprehensive score indexes of the target power transmission equipment. According to the scheme, the equipment operation state of the target power transmission equipment can be accurately estimated based on the operation data of the target power transmission equipment, the correlation of the operation data among different sampling periods is considered for accurate estimation, and the accuracy and reliability of the operation state estimation of the target power transmission equipment are improved.

title_en: Multi-source heterogeneous data real-time access method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid data processing, in particular to a multi-source heterogeneous data real-time access method and system, which comprises the following steps: and acquiring a substation monitoring data field, extracting current voltage power state attributes, extracting a hierarchical relationship according to a scheduling database, and calculating the association degree among multiple nodes to obtain the power grid hierarchical mapping weight. According to the invention, key monitoring data fields are extracted, the association degree among multiple nodes is calculated according to a scheduling database, a hierarchical relationship is constructed, so that data organization accords with a power grid structure, data matching adopts matching degree calculation and priority setting, accurate matching is ensured, scheduling decision is reduced, error matching influences are reduced, missing data filling is combined with equipment association calculation presumption values, load is adjusted based on trend change, data integrity and reliability are improved, data flow characteristics are analyzed, field change is detected, data mapping is adjusted according to equipment operation records, a system is enabled to adapt to data structure change, storage structure fitting degree is calculated, and data processing efficiency of a scheduling center is improved.
assignees: INFORMATION COMMUNICATION BRANCH STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent apron operation scheduling method and system based on dynamic monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dynamic monitoring-based intelligent apron operation scheduling method and system, which comprise the steps of collecting apron operation data, constructing a digital twin model reflecting real-time operation states of an apron based on the apron operation data, describing the sequence of operation links based on the digital twin model by adopting a directed acyclic graph, calculating the earliest starting time and the latest finishing time of each link through a critical path method, constructing a multi-objective optimization model of apron operation scheduling based on the sequence of operation links and the earliest starting time and the latest finishing time of each link, and solving the multi-objective optimization model of apron operation scheduling to obtain an apron operation scheduling scheme. The invention realizes intelligent scheduling and dynamic optimization of the airport operation, effectively improves the flight turnover efficiency, reduces the operation safety risk and provides powerful support for airport operation management.
assignees: UNIV CIVIL AVIATION CHINA

title_en: Wind-solar power prediction data processing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind-solar power prediction data processing method, which relates to the technical field of energy, and comprises the following steps of data collection; the method comprises the following steps of preprocessing data, selecting features, dividing a data set, selecting a model, training and evaluating, and analyzing and applying results. The invention ensures timeliness and continuity of data, provides high-quality real-time data support prediction, selects proper equipment and platform to ensure accurate and reliable data, reduces noise fluctuation through preliminary checking, processing missing data, normalizing and smoothing data, improves data quality, screens significant features by using statistical analysis and feature selection algorithm, enhances model prediction performance and efficiency, adopts scientific data set dividing method, ensures stable and reliable model evaluation, maintains randomness and representativeness of training set, verification set and test set, prevents overfitting, and improves model generalization capability.

title_en: Comprehensive evaluation and analysis method for power system state estimation precision
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of operation monitoring and control of power systems, and relates to a comprehensive evaluation and analysis method for power system state estimation accuracy. The traditional method depends on a single data source, and has poor model adaptability and incomplete precision evaluation. The invention firstly collects data respectively through the SCADA system and the PMU, fuses the data, calculates weights for all the characteristics according to measurement accuracy, and extracts key characteristics such as power factor, voltage-current ratio, power change rate and the like. And then, selecting SVM and RBF kernel functions to construct a model, and reasonably initializing parameters, and performing grid search and cross-validation optimization. Finally, the performance of the model is evaluated from multiple dimensions by utilizing multiple indexes such as mean square error and the like. The method effectively fuses the multi-source data and the optimization model and comprehensively evaluates the multi-source data, remarkably improves the accuracy, reliability and adaptability of the power system state estimation, ensures the safe and stable operation of the system, and provides a better scheme for the power system state estimation.
assignees: TIANSHUI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Power grid operation risk prediction and cooperative control system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based power grid operation risk prediction and cooperative control system, which comprises a basic supporting layer, a business management and control layer, an intelligent analysis layer and a cooperative control layer. The intelligent analysis layer analyzes data based on an improved Bayesian network to realize power grid situation assessment and risk prediction, and the cooperative management layer executes hierarchical response according to analysis results. The intelligent power grid operation management system solves the technical problems of information island, inaccurate risk prediction, untimely response and the like in the traditional power grid operation management, realizes the accurate sensing of the power grid operation state, intelligent prediction of the risk and cooperative linkage of treatment, remarkably improves the intelligent and automatic level of the power grid operation management, and provides powerful guarantee for the safe and stable operation of the power grid.
assignees: GUANGZHOU HUITONG GUOXIN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for monitoring environmental information of power transmission tunnel, electronic equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for monitoring environmental information of a power transmission tunnel, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining environment information in a power transmission tunnel, synchronously inputting the environment information into a digital twin model of the power transmission tunnel, controlling the digital twin model to operate under the environment information, wherein the digital twin model is a mirror image model corresponding to the power transmission tunnel in a virtual environment and is used for mapping the operation state of the power transmission tunnel, determining a fault prediction result of the environment information according to the operation state of the digital twin model and a simulation calculation result corresponding to the environment information, wherein the simulation calculation result is used for at least indicating the normal operation state of the power transmission tunnel under the environment information, responding to the fault prediction result to indicate that the environment information in the power transmission tunnel has abnormal risk, and triggering the alarm information. The invention solves the technical problem of effectively monitoring the environmental information in the power transmission tunnel.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV WUHAN

title_en: Dynamic estimation method for parameters of drainage basin hydrologic model based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic estimation method of parameters of a hydrological model of a river basin based on a digital twin technology, which relates to the technical field of river basin management and comprises the following steps of comprehensively modeling hydrological, meteorological and geographic characteristics of the river basin through multi-mode data, topography and remote sensing data in the river basin; and for each mountain torrent prone area, extracting key features reflecting the mountain torrent outbreak potential risk of the area by utilizing the acquired multi-mode data. According to the invention, through fusion of multi-mode data and geographic features, an accurate river basin model is constructed, a mountain torrent easy-to-develop area is identified by adopting spatial clustering, and risks are predicted through feature engineering and machine learning. By combining with space-time sensitivity intelligent adjustment, the system can respond to risk change in real time, improves prediction precision and response speed, provides accurate decision support for a river basin manager, and effectively prevents and reduces the influence of mountain torrent disasters.
assignees: ANHUI JINHAI DIER INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;ANHUI CIHUAI XINHE ENGINEERING MAN BUREAU

title_en: CCTV safety management system and method of providing safety management services using it
title_ko: Cctv 안전 관리 시스템 및 이를 이용한 안전 관리 서비스 제공방법.
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a CCTV safety management system and a method for providing safety management services using the same. According to the present invention, a CCTV safety management system and a method for providing safety management services using the same are provided, the system comprising: a wireless communication unit; a display unit; an image capturing unit; and a processor, wherein the display unit displays one or more facilities of an unmanned store in a virtual space output to the display unit using digital twin technology, the processor transmits an image determined to indicate a disaster situation as learning data to a deep learning server existing outside the digital twin-based safety management system, the deep learning server performs deep learning on the image determined to indicate a disaster situation as learning data, and provides one or more pieces of information data to the digital twin-based safety management system based on the result of the deep learning.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 CCTV 안전 관리 시스템 및 이를 이용한 안전 관리 서비스 제공방법에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명에 따르면, 무선 통신부; 디스플레이부; 영상촬영부; 및 프로세서를 포함하고, 상기 디스플레이부는 무인 매장의 하나 이상의 설비를 디지털 트윈 기술을 이용하여 상기 디스플레이부에 출력되는 가상의 공간에 표현하고, 상기 프로세서는 재해 상황이 존재한다고 판단되는 영상을 상기 디지털 트윈 기반 안전 관리 시스템의 외부에 존재하는 딥 러닝 서버로 학습데이터로서 전송하고, 상기 딥 러닝 서버는, 상기 재해 상황이 존재한다고 판단되는 영상을 학습 데이터로 딥러닝을 수행하고, 상기 딥러닝의결과에 기반하여 상기 하나 이상의 정보 데이터를 상기 디지털 트윈 기반 안전 관리 시스템으로 제공하는 것을 특징으로 하는, CCTV 안전 관리 시스템 및 이를 이용한 안전 관리 서비스 제공방법을 제공한다.
assignees: HANSUNG TOTAL SOLUTION CO LTD

title_en: Power equipment inspection method, system, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: A power equipment inspection method, a system, a storage medium and electronic equipment relate to the technical field of equipment inspection. The method comprises the steps of collecting historical point cloud data of each piece of electric equipment, constructing an equipment digital twin library based on the historical point cloud data, determining an inspection task and a target inspection route corresponding to each piece of inspection equipment in an intelligent inspection cluster, controlling the corresponding inspection equipment to inspect each piece of electric equipment according to the inspection task and the target inspection route to obtain multi-source heterogeneous data of inspection, and determining inspection results of each piece of electric equipment based on the multi-source heterogeneous data and the equipment digital twin library. By implementing the technical scheme provided by the application, the abnormal inspection accuracy of each power equipment is improved.

title_en: Data driving linear state estimation method based on deep neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data driving linear state estimation method based on a deep neural network. The method comprises the steps of firstly carrying out linear state estimation on a power distribution network in a complex domain, training and generating an error correction model based on historical measurement data and a state estimation result, then connecting a linear state estimation part with the error correction model in series, and correcting errors of the linear state estimation result by using a data driving method. The algorithm provided by the invention can accurately and efficiently solve the state quantity of the power distribution network in the three-phase unbalanced power distribution network under high-proportion new energy permeation, and provides technical support for acquiring the power distribution network information in real time.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Electric power carbon bank intensity level sensing method considering actual operation mode of power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power carbon bank intensity level sensing method considering the actual operation mode of a power grid, the method constructs the real-time updated electric standard topological net rack model by reading the power supply output, the transformer substation power flow, the line power flow and the switch logic states of the isolating switch and the circuit breaker. And further generating a power supply layer carbon array matrix and a node layer tide crossing matrix, searching a directed line path from a starting node to an end node by means of a breadth-first path searching algorithm, and further forming a grid node power splitting coefficient matrix. And obtaining the accurate node carbon emission value of the load layer by reading the injection power and the carbon emission of each node of the unit injection in the unit carbon emission matrix and weighting. The invention fully considers and gives out the detailed process and the accurate metering method of the electric carbon emission intensity of various types of electric power superimposed on the load layer at different voltage levels and different areas, and provides technical support for accurately counting the electric carbon emission and the carbon emission intensity of the user for various types of electric loads in the area.

title_en: Reservoir dispatching management system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir dispatching management system based on digital twinning, which belongs to the technical field of reservoir dispatching management systems, carries out parameter correction on a water balance model and a flood evolution model, solves the corrected water balance equation and the flood evolution equation by using a numerical method to obtain the water change and the flood evolution condition of a reservoir, effectively blends data of video monitoring equipment and reservoir damage overhaul monitoring equipment into the water balance model and the flood evolution model, improves the accuracy and the reliability of the model, and carries out simulation and deduction on sudden events such as flood, earthquake, water pollution and the like possibly faced by the reservoir and carries out prediction analysis on early warning and equipment conditions around the reservoir by using a digital twinning technology to formulate an emergency plan, thereby improving the emergency management capability and the risk prevention and control level of the reservoir.

title_en: Digital twinning-based tourist attraction disaster experiment deduction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twinning, in particular to a method and a system for deducing a tourist attraction disaster experiment based on digital twinning, comprising the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining tourist attraction geological basic data, evaluating the tourist attraction geological basic data based on an analytic hierarchy process, dividing tourist attraction disaster risk areas according to the risk degree, selecting the area with the highest risk degree for tourist attraction physical model construction and tourist attraction three-dimensional geological digital model construction of the area corresponding to the physical model, mapping, matching and data synchronizing the tourist attraction physical model and the tourist attraction three-dimensional geological digital model to form a digital twin system, and carrying out experimental deduction on disaster scenes through the digital twin system to finish accurate prediction of the tourist attraction disaster evolution process. According to the invention, through the construction of the digital twin system, the real-time mapping and synchronization of the geological model and the three-dimensional digital model of the tourist attraction are realized, and the accuracy and timeliness of disaster risk assessment are remarkably improved.

title_en: Intelligent management and control system for fire safety management
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent management and control system for fire safety management, which relates to the technical field of safety management and comprises a multi-mode sensor module and a digital twin modeling module, wherein the multi-mode sensor module is communicated with the digital twin modeling module through a data transmission network, the digital twin modeling module comprises an edge computing node and a central data processing server in an area, and a three-dimensional digital twin model of a building and the environment thereof is constructed by utilizing a real-time data processing and model updating algorithm through receiving and fusing data from the multi-mode sensor module. The invention realizes the function of constructing and continuously updating the digital twin model of the building and the environment thereof by designing the multi-mode sensor module and the digital twin modeling module, reflects the internal structure, the environment parameters and the personnel flowing state of the building in real time, solves the problems of data dispersion, insufficient instantaneity and model static state of the traditional system, and ensures the accuracy and timeliness of fire risk assessment.

title_en: Digital twinning-based worker ergonomic risk analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of digital twinning, and discloses a method and a system for analyzing human engineering risk of workers based on digital twinning. The method comprises the following steps of converting a space-time track of a worker into a nested network of a region transfer network and a gesture conversion network, respectively calculating the node number, average node strength and transfer degree of the region transfer network and the gesture conversion network, and respectively calculating the human engineering risk related to single action and the human engineering risk related to mechanical circulation action by utilizing the node number, average node strength and transfer degree of the region transfer network and the gesture conversion network, so as to realize human engineering risk analysis. According to the invention, the influence of the posture of the worker, the environmental factors and the mechanical circulating operation is comprehensively considered, a comprehensive worker risk identification model is constructed, and accurate risk monitoring and management are realized.

title_en: Power transmission tunnel fault early warning method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission tunnel fault early warning method and device and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps of carrying out digital twin modeling on a power transmission tunnel to obtain a target digital twin model, obtaining current operation data and current water level depth of the power transmission tunnel in a current period, and obtaining early warning information of the power transmission tunnel by adopting the target digital twin model based on the current operation data and the current water level depth, wherein the early warning information is at least used for indicating an abnormal state and an abnormal type of the power transmission tunnel. The method solves the technical problem of low fault identification efficiency and accuracy of the cable tunnel fault early warning method in the related art.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV WUHAN

title_en: CPDS recovery decision method considering state estimation error risk
abstract_en: The invention discloses a CPDS recovery decision method considering state estimation error risks, which comprises the steps of constructing a CPDS topology model and state constraint, obtaining the rank of a simulated charged domain measurement jacobian matrix according to a reachability matrix and a control reachability matrix, determining the total number of physical nodes of the simulated charged domain, determining the fully observable physical nodes of the simulated charged domain, obtaining the simulated charged domain parameter out-of-limit probability of a recovery node according to the operation interval of an active power estimated value and the operation interval of a reactive power estimated value of a physical edge, obtaining the state estimation error risk of the recovery node according to the loss caused by delayed power supply of the recovery failure of the recovery node, establishing an objective function by taking the maximum recovery net benefit of physical system load estimation as a target, adopting the idea of a scheme tree to carry out recovery decision on the CPDS, and taking an alternative recovery scheme with the maximum recovery net benefit as a recovery scheme, thereby solving the problem that the charged domain cannot safely operate due to insufficient observation in the prior art.
assignees: NANJING UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY;NANJING INST TECH

title_en: Important place power supply path tracing method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based important place power supply path tracing method. The invention establishes a digital twin scene in a grading way, builds a perfect power supply path according to the signal flow relation between the power topology and equipment, traces the power supply path when the equipment fails, determines the influence range, and traces the source quickly and accurately.
assignees: TONGXIANG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD
