title_en: Power transmission line mountain fire risk assessment and early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a forest fire risk assessment early warning system and method for a power transmission line, belonging to the technical field of power transmission line risk assessment, wherein the system comprises an environment DNA power transmission line forest fire risk assessment and early warning system, a quantum sensing power transmission line fire remote monitoring system, a power transmission line forest fire early warning emergency training system, a digital twin power transmission line fire risk dynamic management system, an edge AI and low orbit satellite multi-node power transmission line fire early warning system, a power transmission line fire risk distribution prediction system integrating thermal imaging and deep learning, an AI-driven power load dynamic adjustment and fire prevention system, an intelligent fire protection equipment linked power transmission line fire spreading path prediction system and a distributed quantum computing power transmission line fire emergency simulation and optimization response system.
assignees: DANDONG ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;LIAONING BOCHENG ELECTRIC POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Virtual monitoring method for photovoltaic field station based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a virtual monitoring method and a virtual monitoring system for a photovoltaic power station based on a digital twin technology, which realize virtual monitoring and alarming of the photovoltaic power station by utilizing the digital twin technology. Through the virtual monitoring platform, operation and maintenance personnel can grasp the power station operation state in real time, discover and process abnormal conditions in time, and improve operation and maintenance efficiency. Through virtual monitoring and alarming, the on-site inspection times and manual intervention can be reduced, and the operation and maintenance cost is reduced. ‌ utilizes Momo AI to perform monitoring alarm analysis management of the virtual model, so that comprehensive and real-time monitoring of various elements and behaviors in the virtual environment can be realized, and an alarm ‌ can be timely sent out when an abnormality or a potential risk is detected. By utilizing Momo AI to monitor, alarm, analyze and manage the virtual model, the high-efficiency, accurate and real-time monitoring and alarm functions can be realized, powerful guarantee is provided for the safety and stability of the virtual environment, and the intelligent, virtualized and unmanned monitoring of the photovoltaic power station is realized.
assignees: ZHONGYAODA SHUNENG ECOLOGICAL TECH ZHEJIANG CO LTD

title_en: Building digital twin data processing method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of electric digital data processing, in particular to a building digital twin data processing method based on artificial intelligence, which comprises the steps of obtaining real building digital twin data, training a data expansion model by adopting a generation countermeasure network algorithm based on topological dual optimization to obtain training data, the energy consumption evaluation model of the central building and the energy consumption evaluation model of the local building are obtained by adopting a distributed federal learning method, the energy consumption evaluation model of the local building of each building is trained by adopting an extreme learning machine algorithm based on self-adaptive constraint, the energy consumption evaluation model of the local building is iterated continuously, and new real building digital twin data is evaluated by using the trained energy consumption evaluation model of the local building. The existing construction digital twin data processing method has the problem that the energy consumption level evaluation is inaccurate, and the method is accurate in energy consumption level evaluation.
assignees: THE FOURTH CONSTRUCTION CO LTD OF CHINA CONSTRUCTION SIXTH ENG DIVISION;THE BUILDING CONSTRUCTION CO LTD UNDER CHINA RAILWAY WUJU GROUP

title_en: Photovoltaic power prediction system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic power prediction system and a method, which belong to the technical field of photovoltaic power prediction and comprise a prediction terminal platform, a database, a data acquisition module, a data processing module, a data management module, a power prediction module and an evaluation module, the photovoltaic power prediction system and the method adopt an interpolation method to fuse acquired data and comprehensively process information from a plurality of different data sources so as to obtain more accurate, comprehensive and reliable data, missing data values can be estimated according to known data points, so that a complete data set is supplemented, the continuity of data is guaranteed, the photovoltaic power prediction effect is improved, the influence of different factors on the photovoltaic power prediction is judged by evaluating the photovoltaic power prediction, the comprehensiveness and accuracy of the photovoltaic power prediction are improved, a proper model is selected for visual display, and the prediction result of the photovoltaic power prediction system is displayed more intuitively.
assignees: GANSU SHINING SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Transmission line anti-falling guide rail defect detection and defect identification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a defect detection and defect identification method for an anti-falling guide rail of a power transmission line, which relates to the technical field of power transmission and comprises the following steps of primarily identifying the defect of the guide rail through data acquired by an unmanned aerial vehicle; according to the initial detection result of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the key monitoring area is determined, the corresponding sensor module is installed for continuous time sequence data acquisition, the health state of the guide rail is dynamically estimated according to the time sequence change monitoring data, the high risk areas on the guide rail are automatically marked by the system according to the health state estimation result, and the staff should maintain and repair the high risk areas in time. According to the invention, the sensors are arranged in the key monitoring area, so that the real-time monitoring of the state of the guide rail is realized, the change condition of the defect can be continuously tracked, the expansion and the deterioration of the defect can be timely captured, the further aggravation of potential safety hazards is avoided, and the analysis of time sequence data and the evaluation of the defect evolution trend are further carried out.
assignees: WUXI GUANGYING GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based intelligent power grid monitoring and dynamic scheduling system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based intelligent power grid monitoring and dynamic dispatching system and method, and belongs to the technical field of power grid dispatching. The system comprises a power grid topology generation module, a modeling module, a knowledge graph creation module, a mapping module, a risk analysis module and a scheduling module, wherein the power grid topology generation module generates a power grid topology and a full life cycle file of power equipment, the modeling module and the knowledge graph creation module acquire power grid operation situation data, a digital twin model and a knowledge graph are created by the power grid operation situation data, the power grid topology and the full life cycle file of the power equipment, the mapping module creates a mapping model to obtain a mapping data set, the risk analysis module carries out multi-risk analysis by the mapping data set to generate a comprehensive risk analysis report, and the comprehensive risk analysis report adopts a multi-target self-adaptive optimization algorithm and a load balancing algorithm to obtain a power grid scheduling strategy. The invention effectively improves the risk resistance of the scheduling strategy, and simultaneously improves the accuracy of the scheduling strategy through the comprehensive application of the digital twin model and the knowledge graph.
assignees: EPTC BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Intelligent operation and maintenance method and system based on digital twin technology and intelligent management and control platform
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent operation and maintenance method and system based on a digital twin technology and an intelligent management and control platform, comprising the steps of receiving an operation task; the method comprises the steps of obtaining operation data and environment data of a photovoltaic power station in real time, constructing a digital twin model of the photovoltaic power station, carrying out simulation operation of the photovoltaic power station according to operation tasks by utilizing the constructed data twin model of the photovoltaic power station, predicting equipment fault conditions in the simulation operation process, generating multiple operation and maintenance tasks according to equipment which is in fault in the prediction simulation process, calculating operation and maintenance cost of each operation and maintenance task, adjusting the operation tasks by utilizing each generated operation and maintenance task, carrying out simulation operation of the photovoltaic power station according to the adjusted operation tasks respectively, predicting generated electricity generation amount, calculating generation income and equipment operation cost, calculating operation income, judging the operation income closest to expected income, and obtaining the corresponding operation and maintenance task as optimal operation and maintenance task output. The application can improve the operation and maintenance efficiency and the economic benefit of the photovoltaic power station.
assignees: DATANG XIANGCHENG HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD;DATANG SICHUAN POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Diagnostic analysis method and system based on digital twin technology and intelligent management and control platform
abstract_en: The application discloses a diagnostic analysis method and a diagnostic analysis system based on a digital twin technology and an intelligent management and control platform, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting environmental data of a photovoltaic power station in real time and matching a patrol scheme; the intelligent management and control platform is utilized to call a corresponding inspection device according to an inspection scheme and complete data acquisition, the acquired data are preprocessed, the data are fused and tidied by utilizing a knowledge graph of the photovoltaic power station, the data are divided in a preset layering and blocking mode, the divided data are mapped into a three-dimensional model of the photovoltaic power station which is built in advance according to a progressive verification and construction strategy by utilizing a digital twin technology, a digital twin body of the photovoltaic power station is generated, the photovoltaic power station is subjected to fault prediction and judgment by utilizing the digital twin body of the photovoltaic power station and combining a machine learning algorithm, and the result of the prediction and judgment is displayed in the digital twin body. The application can realize timely and accurate diagnosis of the faults of the photovoltaic power station under complex or extreme environments.
assignees: DATANG XIANGCHENG HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD;DATANG SICHUAN POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent solar power generation and distribution system using digital twin
abstract_en: Disclosed are twin-based systems and methods for predicting solar power generation and optimizing power generation and distribution processes. Employed are a digital twin model of a solar power plant, which includes detailed representations of various components, such as solar panels, inverters, and transformers, as well as real-time weather data and historical data. This advantageously allows for accurate simulations of plant performance under various weather conditions and operational scenarios. Our systems and methods Incorporate novel machine learning algorithms that are trained on historical and real-time data from the digital twin model, weather data, solar power generation data, and other relevant factors. These algorithms utilize an advanced ensemble learning approach, which combines multiple predictive models, such as deep learning, support vector machines, and decision trees, to achieve higher accuracy and robustness in predicting solar power generation
assignees: NEC LAB AMERICA INC

title_en: Digital twinning-based park pipe network monitoring and early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twinning-based garden pipe network monitoring and early warning method and a digital twinning-based garden pipe network monitoring and early warning system, which relate to the technical field of pipe network monitoring and early warning and comprise the steps of constructing a knowledge graph of the field of the garden pipe network, collecting real-time monitoring data and historical operation and maintenance data, and forming a knowledge-enhanced pipe network data set; extracting pipe network performance attenuation characteristics by using a bidirectional gating cyclic neural network, performing deep fusion with expert experience rules in a domain knowledge graph to construct a performance attenuation analysis model, calculating a performance attenuation curve and the residual service life based on the model, predicting potential fault risks and generating maintenance suggestions. The intelligent evaluation method and the intelligent evaluation system realize the accurate evaluation of the performance attenuation of the pipe network, the early warning of the fault risk and the intelligent generation of the maintenance advice, and improve the intelligent level and the reliability of the operation and maintenance of the pipe network in the park.
assignees: GUANGZHOU DABAI DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-oriented transmission line equipment sensing method and system
abstract_en: A digital twinning-oriented transmission line equipment perception method and system, the method firstly constructs a transmission line twinning model based on state data of transmission line equipment and environment, then maps and associates real-time state data between a transmission line scene model and a transmission line physical entity based on the transmission line twinning model to complete virtual and real data fusion processing, then utilizes an improved YOLOv network model to identify the transmission line equipment, and the improved YOLOv network model adopts a K-means++ algorithm to cluster a data set into a target frame. According to the invention, the identification simulation of the power transmission line equipment is realized by combining the digital twin power transmission line model and the improved YOLOv network model, so that the accuracy of target identification and the operation and maintenance effects of the power transmission line are effectively improved.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;Hubei keneng electric power electronics co ltd;STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: AI-based thermal power plant immersive equipment state monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AI-based thermal power plant immersive equipment state monitoring method and system, and relates to the technical field of equipment monitoring, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a digital twin model of a thermal power plant after equipment of the thermal power plant deploys a monitoring sensor; executing attraction clustering according to the equipment topological relation in the digital twin model to establish a multi-level clustering result, reading a monitoring data set of the monitoring sensor, activating an independent anomaly identification network to establish an independent anomaly identification result, establishing equipment criticality according to the independent anomaly identification result, establishing equipment anomaly joint early warning, and carrying out immersive visual presentation. The invention solves the technical problems of insufficient comprehensive and accurate monitoring of the running state of the equipment of the thermal power plant, low equipment management efficiency and difficult guarantee of reliability in the prior art, achieves the technical effects of realizing comprehensive and accurate monitoring of the running state of the equipment of the thermal power plant and effectively improving the efficiency and reliability of the equipment management.
assignees: GUONENG FUZHOU THERMOELECTRICITY CO LTD

title_en: Cold and tide weather photovoltaic power generation prediction method under semi-supervised learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting the photovoltaic power generation of a cold tide weather under semi-supervised learning, which comprises the following steps of (1) obtaining historical power generation data and contemporaneous weather data of a photovoltaic power station, defining a cold tide discrimination standard based on temperature dip characteristics, (2) adopting Grubbs to detect and reject abnormal values, supplementing missing data through a segmentation three-time Hermite interpolation method, constructing a cold tide small sample data set, (3) carrying out data expansion on the cold tide small sample by utilizing an SMOTE algorithm, screening high-confidence samples by combining K-MEDOIDs clustering, using marking data to train and initialize a CNN-LSTM model, (4) adopting a whale optimization algorithm WOA to optimize CNN-LSTM model parameters, finally outputting a photovoltaic output prediction result and carrying out error verification, and the method has important significance for technical researches in the fields of new energy power prediction, power grid scheduling and the like.

title_en: Power transmission and transformation project construction simulation method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of engineering construction simulation, in particular to a power transmission and transformation engineering construction simulation method based on digital twinning. When misoperation occurs in the disassembly and assembly process, the simulation system can calculate the stress change of the virtual construction in real time, judge whether abnormal conditions of falling collision possibly occur, calculate collision impulse based on relative speed, control the bouncing behavior of the virtual construction after collision by combining with a rebound coefficient, simulate tangential motion by utilizing friction force so as to ensure reasonable motion track of virtual construction equipment on the virtual ground, immerse an interaction scene and a future time pre-response mechanism, enable a user to experience construction risks possibly occurring in the future in the virtual environment in advance, warn possible dangerous operation in advance, provide optimization suggestions, enable constructors to identify before actual operation, improve timely coping decision making capability and avoid risks.

title_en: Digital twinning-based high-density urban ponding evolution and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twinning, in particular to a digital twinning-based high-density urban ponding evolution and early warning method. The urban water logging emergency response method comprises the following steps of collecting real-time water logging depth, real-time river channel water level, real-time weather conditions and real-time drainage pipe network water level conditions corresponding to cities in real time through water logging depth, river channel water level, weather monitoring and drainage pipe network sensors installed in the cities, constructing digital twinning to generate an urban water logging digital twinning model, obtaining drainage pipe network distribution and carrying out drainage grid division to generate an urban drainage gridding model, obtaining historical water logging event rules, carrying out water logging area prediction analysis and water logging evolution coupling analysis to generate an urban water logging evolution distribution field, and carrying out water logging time-space evolution analysis and water logging early warning treatment on the urban water logging evolution distribution field to execute corresponding urban water logging emergency response work. The method can provide accurate water accumulation evolution prediction and effective early warning.

title_en: State estimation method, device, equipment and medium of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a state estimation method, a device, equipment and a medium of a power distribution network, wherein the state estimation method of the power distribution network comprises the steps of establishing a dynamic model of the power distribution network; and determining a state estimation value of the power distribution network according to the dynamic model and the sliding mode observer model. According to the technical scheme disclosed by the invention, the strong anti-noise interference capability of the Kalman algorithm and the strong anti-parameter interference capability of the sliding mode observer can be simultaneously synthesized, and the state estimation precision and accuracy of the power distribution network parameters are improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;HUIZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Real-time monitoring and early warning method for distribution network equipment state
abstract_en: The invention relates to a distribution network equipment state real-time monitoring and early warning method, which comprises the following steps of 1, establishing an equipment model by adopting an equipment fault early warning method of a nonlinear state estimation technology, predicting equipment by utilizing the model, 2, constructing an electric energy evaluation index system from the aspects of voltage quality, frequency quality and power supply reliability, and evaluating the electric energy quality, 3, further constructing a distribution area voltage quality index evaluation system to form an early warning parameter system model based on the distribution area power supply quality, 4, adopting a combined weighting method based on AHP-entropy weight to determine a single weight, 5, adopting an evaluation method based on improved TOPSIS to comprehensively evaluate the electric energy quality, and 6, the method has the advantages of acquiring variable data in real time, automatically analyzing related indexes, monitoring all weather and realizing effective real-time early warning.
assignees: XINYANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Conduction detection system and method for wind power generation blade lightning protection device
abstract_en: The application discloses a conduction detection system and method for a wind power generation blade lightning protection device, and belongs to the technical field of wind power lightning protection. The system comprises a digital twin model building module, a conduction state determining module, a conduction failure reason determining module and a conduction failure processing module, wherein the digital twin model building module is used for building a digital twin model comprising wind power generation blades and a lightning protection device, the conduction state determining module is used for determining the actual conduction state of the lightning protection device, the conduction failure reason determining module is used for determining the conduction failure reason of the lightning protection device if the actual conduction state is conduction failure, the conduction failure processing module is used for determining whether remote processing can be performed, and if so, the corresponding processing mechanism and the remote processing scheme can be determined, and the conduction failure processing of the lightning protection device is performed. The scheme can ensure that the problem is immediately detected and responded when the conduction failure occurs, and reduces the downtime and the maintenance cost. Faults can be identified and predicted more accurately, and the accuracy and reliability of decision making are improved. The processing efficiency is improved through remote diagnosis and repair.
assignees: SHANXI ENBOLI LIGHTNING PROT CO LTD

title_en: Ground source heat pump system optimal scheduling method based on probability map digital twin model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground source heat pump system optimizing and scheduling method based on a probability map digital twin model, which belongs to the field of ground source heat pump system operation optimizing, and comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a digital twin model based on a dynamic probability map decision network in a modeling stage; S2, calibrating the digital twin model in a calibration stage, S3, updating the digital twin model in an operation stage, and outputting an optimal operation method of the ground source heat pump system in real time through the updated digital twin model. The physical entity-twin system is abstracted into a group of coupled dynamic systems, the systems evolve with time in a physical state space and a digital state space, and the problems of complex modeling of multi-physical field coupling of the ground source heat pump system, complex dynamic optimization control calculation and high calculation resource requirement are solved through interaction of observation data and control input, so that real-time and automatic optimization control of the ground source heat pump system under complex and changeable underground environment and load requirements is realized.
assignees: Tianfu Yongxing Laboratory

title_en: Topological structure-based power grid state limit operation regulation and control method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid state limit operation regulation and control method and system based on a topological structure, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a power grid topological structure according to nodes and connecting lines of a power grid, monitoring equipment real-time state data of the power grid in real time, estimating the equipment real-time state data according to a state estimation algorithm to obtain the actual operation state of the power grid, constructing a section parameter model of a standardized operation mode, wherein the section parameter model comprises a power failure equipment parameter table, a control grading parameter table and a control limit parameter table, the power failure equipment parameter table and the control grading parameter table are condition parameters, the control limit parameter table is a limiting parameter, and inputting the power grid topological structure, the equipment real-time state data and the actual operation state of the power grid into the section parameter model to obtain the control limit parameter of a power grid section. According to the invention, dynamic calculation of the section control parameters is realized through the standardized section parameter model, so that real-time adjustment of control limit parameters in a complex power grid environment is ensured, and reliable power supply of the power grid is ensured.
assignees: BEIJING E TECHSTAR CO LTD;POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL BRANCH OF INNER MONGOLIA POWER GROUP CO LTD

title_en: An integrated urban planning and building design system for seismic risk mitigation and environmental sustainability
abstract_en: This invention provides an urban planning and building design system based on seismic resilience, environmental sustainability, and urban expansion problems. Using real-time seismic risk assessment, adaptive structural design, and environmentally friendly materials, the system maximizes land use, infrastructure footprints, and building performance in urban areas. Technical specializations which include base isolators, lightweight hybrid structures, and prefabricated modular units provide structural flexibility and a high level of disaster resistance at a lower construction time and cost. It has also integrated IoT-ready sensors and digital twin technology to enable real-time monitoring and predictive maintenance thus increasing effectiveness in disaster preparedness and recovery. It uses low-carbon building materials, passive energy designs, and renewing natural resources such as green corridors and permeable pavements to prioritize environmental sustainability while reducing urban emissions and enhancing urban ecosystems. It is applicable in different urban settings and can apply to inner cities to the most concentrated and vulnerable areas concerning the impact of disasters. This invention supports sustainability all over the world in improving the safety and resilience of urban centers and contributes to the sustainability of an urban environment.
assignees: NOROUZIAN MOHAMMAD MEHDI

title_en: Power grid equipment digital twin data credibility evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid equipment digital twin data credible evaluation method and system, which comprise the steps of obtaining power transmission and transformation equipment data, preprocessing the data, extracting characteristics based on the preprocessed data, defining evaluation indexes and weights corresponding to the indexes according to the characteristics of the power transmission and transformation equipment data, constructing a power transmission and transformation equipment input data quality evaluation model to quantitatively evaluate the input data quality of the digital twin model, establishing a power transmission and transformation equipment fault diagnosis model based on the quantitatively evaluated data, and carrying out fault analysis prediction based on the power transmission and transformation equipment fault diagnosis model. The invention can effectively detect the state of the power transmission and transformation equipment of the power grid, improves the accuracy of fault prediction and provides scientific basis for intelligent management and operation and maintenance of the power grid.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Online updated power quality data self-adaptive acquisition system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an on-line updated power quality data self-adaptive acquisition system and method, and relates to the technical field of data acquisition, wherein the system comprises the steps of acquiring a risk alarm log of a plastic shell type circuit breaker, and excavating a periodic time-based base sampling frequency; the method comprises the steps of constructing a zero-crossing comparator, carrying out electric data acquisition by cooperating with the zero-crossing comparator and a metering device to obtain acquired electric data, and transmitting the acquired electric data to a data center based on a communication interface to carry out electric energy quality assessment and data update. The invention solves the technical problems of lack of pertinence of the sampling frequency of the electric data of the plastic shell type circuit breaker, insufficient precision and comprehensiveness of the electric energy quality evaluation and low data transmission and processing efficiency in the prior art, achieves the technical effects of precision sampling, high-efficiency transmission and comprehensiveness of the electric data of the plastic shell type circuit breaker, and improves the accuracy and reliability of the operation monitoring of an electric power system.
assignees: XINRONGZHI ELECTRONIC TECH HEBEI CO LTD

title_en: Method for estimating state of unobservable power distribution system based on random switching subsystem
abstract_en: The invention relates to an unobservable power distribution system state estimation method based on a random switching subsystem, which comprises the steps of determining state variables of state estimation through input line impedance parameters, load, access positions and capacity of distributed power supplies and configuration information of multi-source measurement data, calculating the rank of an observable matrix in the current period according to the line impedance parameters and the configuration information of the multi-source measurement data, constructing a transition matrix to convert the state variables, solving the converted state variables by adopting a unscented Kalman filtering method, constructing an inverse transformation matrix to restore the converted state variables, and outputting a state estimation result. According to the invention, the power distribution network is modeled as a random switching subsystem under an unobservable condition, the switching path of the power distribution network is disclosed, the frequent switching of the system is reduced, the high-dimensional state variable is mapped to the low-dimensional conversion variable through the state conversion, the improved unscented Kalman filtering algorithm is utilized for solving, and the precision and the speed of state estimation are improved.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: Photovoltaic module quality detection method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and photovoltaic detection, in particular to a photovoltaic module quality detection method based on artificial intelligence, which comprises the following steps: and constructing a spectrum-geometric model and a multi-field coupling model through multi-mode data acquisition, carrying out feature fusion by combining a layered attention mechanism, extracting key deep features by utilizing a generated countermeasure network, accurately positioning a defect region and evaluating the severity. In addition, the scheme simulates the operation condition of the component by a digital twin technology, and the defect expansion trend is predicted by combining a time sequence coupling prediction network, so that the high efficiency and the foresight of defect detection are realized. The method can be widely applied to the field of photovoltaic power generation, obviously improves the precision and efficiency of component defect detection, and provides technical support for efficient operation and maintenance of a photovoltaic system.
assignees: ZHEJIANG HONGNENG ELECTRIC SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent power transmission and transformation project construction management system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent management system for power transmission and transformation project construction based on a digital twin technology. The system comprises a digital twin model building unit, a data acquisition unit, a data processing and anomaly detection unit, a construction process intelligent optimization unit and a control unit. The digital twin model building unit is responsible for building a three-dimensional model of the power transmission and transformation project. The data acquisition unit is configured at a construction site, collects sensor data about construction progress and quality, and maps and compares the sensor data with a digital twin model. The data processing and anomaly detection unit analyzes real-time data, identifies construction anomalies and potential safety hazards, and locates and analyzes the construction anomalies and potential safety hazards through the digital twin model. And the construction process intelligent optimization unit optimizes the construction path and the resource allocation in real time and performs simulation verification on the digital twin model. The control unit provides a user interface enabling a user to monitor construction progress in real time, receive alerts and make decisions.
assignees: HUANGGANG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Urban water system flood control combined dispatching command system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to a urban water system flood control combined dispatching command system based on a digital twin technology, which comprises a multi-stage digital base plate for constructing digital twin urban data resources based on urban geographic space data, wherein the digital base plate is constructed, the digital base plate is classified and constructed according to data precision of model requirements and a construction range corresponding to the model, a three-dimensional electronic water conservancy visual chart is constructed based on the multi-stage data base plate, a flood control platform model library is established, the flood control platform model library comprises a flood prediction and engineering dispatching model with multi-layer information fusion, and flood control combined dispatching command is performed through the multi-stage data base plate, the three-dimensional electronic water conservancy visual chart and the flood control platform model library. According to the method, the urban geographic space data of the urban area are utilized to realize real-time tracking of flood control safety information, a flood control monitoring and early warning system is formed, a urban river channel water system joint scheduling model is built, safety risk identification and early warning capacity of flood control engineering is improved, and technical support is provided for urban flood defense decisions.
assignees: ISTRONG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Regional power carbon emission factor measuring and calculating method and application
abstract_en: The invention provides a regional power carbon emission factor measuring and calculating method and application, and belongs to the technical field of electronic information. The regional power carbon emission factor measuring and calculating method comprises the steps of 1, collecting data, collecting regional related data needing to be subjected to carbon emission calculation through a data collecting channel of a data center platform, storing the data into a full-scale data table of a paste source layer, 2, cleaning the data, sequentially carrying out data processing on missing data and abnormal data, 3, calculating regional power generation carbon emission factors, sequentially calculating thermal power generation carbon emission factors and regional comprehensive power generation carbon emission factors, 4, calculating regional power carbon emission factors, sequentially calculating regional power transfer electric quantity, constructing regional carbon balance equation and solving the regional power carbon emission factors. The regional electric power carbon emission factor calculation method realizes the calculation of the electric power carbon emission factor with finer granularity in time and space, and greatly improves the accuracy and the practicability of calculation.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD INFORMATION & COMMUNICATION BRANCH;BEIJING STATE GRID INFORMATION TELECOMMNICATION GROUP ACCENTURE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Flow field acceleration factor correction method, device, equipment and storage medium based on multipoint short-term anemometry data
abstract_en: The invention provides a flow field acceleration factor correction method, device and equipment based on multipoint short-term wind measurement data and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of wind power plants. The method comprises the steps of obtaining flow field acceleration factors of each grid point of a flow field space, obtaining wind measurement data of each sector of a wind measurement point, carrying out wind measurement point sector reconstruction processing on the flow field acceleration factors of each grid point of the flow field space to obtain reconstructed acceleration factors of flow field reconstruction grid points, carrying out data assimilation processing on the wind measurement data of each sector of the wind measurement point to determine reference acceleration factors of each sector of the wind measurement point, and carrying out correction processing on the flow field acceleration factors based on the reference acceleration factors and the reconstructed acceleration factors to obtain target corrected acceleration factors. According to the embodiment provided by the invention, the accuracy of the generation of the acceleration factor can be improved by correcting the acceleration factor by utilizing the multipoint short-term wind measurement data, the error of the acceleration factor is reduced, and the accuracy of wind speed calculation in the flow field is ensured by correcting the error of the flow field model.
assignees: HUNAN SANY WISDOM NEW ENERGY DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based fire control display method and system for fire point
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twin-based fire control display method and a digital twin-based fire control display system, which relate to the technical field of digital twin fire analysis and comprise the steps of obtaining image data in a garage, inputting the preprocessed image data into a fire recognition model to obtain a fire recognition result; the method comprises the steps of obtaining fire data, inputting the fire data into a situation development prediction model, obtaining a fire development prediction result, identifying potential fire risks and risk levels in a scene based on the fire development prediction result by using a support vector machine algorithm, generating a scene risk assessment result, constructing a fire-fighting relation graph based on the scene risk assessment result, analyzing dynamic relations among entities through a graph attention network, generating a dynamic relation graph, simulating the scene based on the dynamic relation graph, obtaining real-time data changes, constructing a digital twin model, generating a visual interface, deploying and controlling fire-fighting actions according to the visual interface, and realizing accurate fire extinguishing in a garage.
assignees: JINAN ZHONGWEILAI PARK OPERATION MAN CO LTD

title_en: Airport tunnel excavation settlement risk dynamic assessment method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twin-based airport tunnel excavation settlement risk dynamic assessment method which comprises the steps of obtaining airport tunnel excavation settlement information, constructing an earth surface settlement risk assessment model, determining an interaction relation between a risk event and each risk index according to field knowledge and historical data, building a dynamic Bayesian network model taking the risk index as a network node, carrying out earth surface settlement risk twin deduction, adjusting a network structure and parameters through continuously updated dynamic monitoring data, carrying out dynamic deduction on earth surface settlement risk, obtaining a risk event chain and probability of the risk event, wherein the risk event chain possibly causes earth surface settlement, of airport tunnel excavation settlement risk, carrying out dynamic assessment on the tunnel excavation settlement risk, and mapping a dynamically calculated risk event probability result to different risk grades to obtain a tunnel excavation settlement risk dynamic assessment result. In this way, the problems of serious disjointing, insufficient timeliness and insufficient refinement degree of the conventional risk assessment method in actual engineering construction can be solved.
assignees: KUNMING SURVEY DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE CO LTD OF CREEC

title_en: New energy station grid-connected performance evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy station grid-connected performance evaluation method and system, and relates to the technical field of power system analysis and control. The method comprises the steps of preprocessing original data, extracting and calculating fundamental wave components of electrical parameters of the processed data, calculating power set value control capacity by using the extracted quantity, estimating frequency parameters by using an adaptive notch filtering method, and judging whether the frequency parameters meet requirements or not. The method ensures the accuracy of grid-connected performance evaluation through the implementation of the steps of preprocessing the original data, extracting and calculating parameters, calculating power control, evaluating frequency and the like, corrects abnormal data by adopting a variable joint matching method, a smooth filtering method and the like, supplements missing data by combining interpolation processing, ensures the data quality and reliability of an evaluation process, evaluates and optimizes frequency parameters by establishing an adaptive notch filtering method, builds a complete evaluation system based on electric parameter calculation and power control calculation, and improves the operation efficiency of a station.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent monitoring fault prediction system for thermal power plant based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent monitoring fault prediction system of a thermal power plant based on big data, relates to the technical field of thermal power plants, and solves the technical problems that in the prior art, after fault early warning, personnel take time to find problems and overhaul, the efficiency of maintenance and maintenance work is low, and the operation of the power plant is influenced; the method comprises the steps of collecting a plurality of operation data of the thermal power plant in real time, analyzing an abnormal data sequence in an evaluation period, removing the data to obtain a new operation data sequence, establishing a digital twin model of the thermal power plant, obtaining fault information, analyzing key influence factors corresponding to each fault information of the thermal power plant, analyzing fault grades based on the abnormal data sequence, constructing a monitoring fault prediction model based on the key influence factors and the fault grades, realizing early warning of the thermal power plant, accurately identifying fault occurrence positions, improving maintenance operation efficiency and guaranteeing normal operation of the thermal power plant.
assignees: Tianjin chentang thermoelectricity co ltd

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle multisystem navigation decoy system based on intelligent algorithm optimization
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent algorithm optimization-based unmanned aerial vehicle multi-system navigation decoy system, which relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle processing, wherein a sensing module comprises a cognitive radar, a photoelectric/infrared sensor, a magnetic and acoustic sensor and an electromagnetic environment scanning device, a digital twin and countermeasure AI module comprises a digital twin model module and an countermeasure AI engine, a cross-domain multi-source decoy module comprises a multi-system navigation signal synthesis module and a sensor-level decoy module, a communication link interference module comprises a reconfigurable intelligent antenna array, a communication link interference module and a reconfigurable intelligent antenna array, wherein the reconfigurable intelligent antenna array comprises a metamaterial unit, a real-time beam controller and a biological heuristic intelligent algorithm module, and a system security concealment module comprises an encryption access control unit, a micropower frequency expansion unit and a redundancy backup and disaster tolerance unit.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD DC COMPANY

title_en: Dynamic scheduling method, equipment and medium for mobile energy storage resources for recovering electricity after disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, equipment and medium for dynamically scheduling mobile energy storage resources for power recovery after disaster. The method comprises the steps of obtaining information of power equipment and traffic network in a city, establishing a power-traffic coupling digital twin body, determining comprehensive hazard risk levels of all areas in the city, solving optimal power flows of the city according to the comprehensive hazard risk levels of all areas in the city, generating an agent scheduling strategy according to the optimal power flows, and scheduling agents through the agent scheduling strategy. The invention builds a coupling model of the traffic network and the power grid, and ensures that the mobile energy storage system can efficiently transmit and distribute power resources between areas affected by storm surge disasters. By constructing a storm surge risk evaluation framework, a real-time scheduling strategy of the mobile energy storage resource is effectively optimized, the electricity recovery efficiency is maximized, the recovery time is minimized, and the recovery speed and the electricity safety of the urban power system after a storm surge disaster are effectively improved.
assignees: UNIV MACAU

title_en: Transformer time-varying reliability assessment method combining degradation process and real-time state
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of state evaluation of equipment in a thermal power plant and discloses a transformer time-varying reliability evaluation method combining a degradation process and a real-time state, which comprises the following steps of 1, collecting a basic data set; step 2, filling missing data by combining a generalized data reduction method when the missing data exists, step 3, constructing a degradation equation of a historical degradation track of the power transformer, calculating a time-varying aging index HA  i  based on the degradation equation, calculating the internal aging failure probability of the power transformer at the time t  i , step 4, constructing and improving a logistic regression model, determining a parameter value of the logistic regression model, building an external random failure probability assessment model of a meteorological area where the power transformer is located, and step 5, calculating to obtain the time-varying reliability of the power transformer combining the degradation process and the real-time state. The method can effectively evaluate the time-varying reliability of the power transformer, and has higher accuracy and higher practicability.

title_en: Multi-station wind power processing method based on cross data cleaning and reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-station wind power processing method based on cross data cleaning and reconstruction, which is used for processing dead numbers, abnormal values and missing values in wind power field power data and aims at establishing a high-quality wind power data set, and concretely comprises the steps of S1, detecting and removing data with unchanged power values in a certain time period, replacing the data with missing values, removing unreal data, S2, normalizing wind speed data to a 0,1 interval, eliminating dimensional differences among different wind power fields, S3, carrying out neighbor analysis on the power data by using a wind speed grade interval, detecting the abnormal values by a fractional statistics method, marking and processing the data which are not in a statistical range, S4, adopting a K neighbor algorithm, interpolating the missing data by using a weighted average value of similar samples, and recovering the missing values by using space-time correlation.
assignees: NANYANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV ZHENGZHOU

title_en: Energy industry internet interactive system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses an energy industry internet interaction system. The system comprises a grid twin body of a grid main station cloud of a target grid and a polymerization twin body of a polymerization cloud platform under the grid main station cloud, wherein the polymerization twin body is used for sharing the platform running state and the platform energy supply and demand condition of the polymerization cloud platform to the grid twin body, and the grid twin body is used for determining the grid energy supply and demand condition of the target grid and carrying out energy scheduling on the target grid according to the platform running state and the platform energy supply and demand condition respectively shared by a plurality of polymerization twin bodies and the grid energy supply and demand condition. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention solves the problem that the digital twin bodies cannot participate in the interactive operation of the power grid.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Day-ahead optimal scheduling method of optical storage and filling integrated system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a day-ahead optimal scheduling method of an optical storage and filling integrated system, which comprises the steps of obtaining historical storage and filling data and time sequence data of node voltage of the optical storage and filling integrated system, carrying out power balance constraint on the historical storage and filling data and the time sequence data, carrying out equivalence on a power distribution network by taking a parallel point as a port based on the Thevenin equivalent theorem, enabling the power distribution network to be equivalent to constant voltage source series equivalent impedance changing along with time, constructing a neural network time sequence prediction model comprising the historical storage and filling data and the equivalent impedance, collecting the historical data, constructing a data set, training the neural network time sequence prediction model based on the data set, obtaining historical environment data and the historical storage and filling data, inputting the historical storage and filling data into the trained neural network time sequence prediction model to obtain predicted storage and filling data and equivalent impedance, and S5, constructing the optical storage and filling integrated day-ahead optimal scheduling model based on the predicted storage and filling data and the equivalent impedance. The invention provides a distribution network state estimation method, which considers a prediction method based on a neural network to predict system power and distribution network equivalent parameters.
assignees: SHIJIAZHUANG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH CO STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power communication network risk assessment method based on digital twin and complex network theory
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power communication network risk assessment method based on digital twin and complex network theory, which comprises the steps of firstly using a digital twin technology to effectively simulate the running state of a power communication network, then comprehensively identifying and quantifying risks in the power communication network through a multi-level risk assessment mechanism, optimizing resource allocation, reducing the probability of system faults, and improving the safety and reliability of the whole power communication network. According to the invention, by constructing a digital twin model and applying a complex network theory, the real-time monitoring, accurate assessment and intelligent early warning of the operation risk of the power communication network are realized, and a powerful technical support is provided for the safe and stable operation of the power communication network. The invention effectively makes up the defects of the traditional risk assessment in real-time performance and accuracy, and obviously enhances the safety and the anti-attack capability of the power communication network. Meanwhile, dynamic risk identification and early warning of the power communication network are realized, and technical support is provided for constructing a more reliable network protection system.
assignees: STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION COMPANY STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Charging station operation maintenance method based on multidimensional data system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a charging station operation maintenance method based on a multi-dimensional data system, which relates to the field of intelligent optimization and comprises the steps of collecting charging pile operation, environment, user and power grid data, preprocessing the data into JSON, analyzing and classifying the JSON in real time through Kafka-Flume, storing the JSON into a distributed database, establishing a composite index, searching through Presto, cleaning, constructing a space-time map by combining GraphQL with a graph query language, extracting multi-dimensional feature vectors, generating a digital twin model, fusing multi-source data through virtual-real mapping, combining residual correction and reinforcement learning optimization, fusing multi-mode data through a hypergraph neural network, optimizing topology by combining entropy regularization multi-target strategies and element learning, dynamically distributing power, predicting and positioning faults through LSTM-GAN, outputting through PID regulation, automatically triggering equipment freezing and limiting work through a block chain contract, and optimizing scheduling and load balancing through on-chain data feedback. According to the charging station operation and maintenance precision and response efficiency are remarkably improved through a multidimensional data fusion and dynamic optimization mechanism.

title_en: Method for intelligently calculating deduction commonality service of enterprise-level power grid
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for intelligently calculating deduction commonality service of an enterprise-level power grid, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent power grids. The method comprises the steps of accessing and fusing multi-source heterogeneous data of typical scenes, carrying out intelligent calculation deduction common service of an enterprise-level power grid, and carrying out test point application verification of multiple types of typical scenes, wherein the test point application verification comprises regional power grid state estimation and weak link analysis. The method can meet deduction requirements of power grid running state estimation, weak link analysis and multi-time space trend prediction, and supports power grid running state monitoring and lean management.
assignees: STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD;LINYI POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Hydrogen peroxide production and energy management system and its operation method
title_ko: 과산화수소 생산 및 에너지 관리 시스템 및 이의 운용 방법
abstract_en: A hydrogen peroxide production and energy management system includes: a water electrolysis device for electrolyzing water to produce hydrogen and oxygen; a hydrogen tank for storing the hydrogen; a hydrogen tank state estimation device for estimating the amount of hydrogen stored in the hydrogen tank; a fuel cell for generating power using the hydrogen; a renewable power generation device for generating power using at least one of sunlight, wind power, hydroelectric power, geothermal heat, bioenergy, and marine energy; a battery for storing the power produced from the fuel cell or the renewable power generation device; a demand distribution control unit for determining the distribution of hydrogen and power amounts stored in the hydrogen tank and the battery; a hydrogenation tank for supplying a catalyst and the hydrogen to a solution containing an anthraquinone derivative to prepare a first solution; a reaction tank for receiving the first solution from the hydrogenation tank and supplying the oxygen to prepare a second solution; and a separation tank for receiving the second solution from the reaction tank and supplying water to extract hydrogen peroxide.
abstract_ko: 과산화수소 생산 및 에너지 관리 시스템은 물을 전기 분해하여 수소 및 산소를 생산하는 수전해 장치, 상기 수소를 저장하는 수소 탱크, 상기 수소 탱크에 저장된 수소의 량을 추산하는 수소 탱크 상태 추정 장치, 상기 수소를 이용하여 전력을 생산하는 연료 전지, 태양광, 풍력, 수력, 지열, 바이오 에너지, 해양 에너지 중 어느 하나 이상을 이용하여 전력을 생산하는 신재생 발전 장치, 상기 연료 전지 또는 상기 신재생 발전 장치로부터 생산된 상기 전력을 저장하는 배터리, 상기 수소 탱크 및 상기 배터리에 저장되는 수소 및 전력 량의 분배를 결정하는 수요 분배 제어부, 안트라퀴논 유도체를 포함하는 용액에 촉매 및 상기 수소를 공급하여 제1 용액을 제조하는 수소화조, 상기 수소화조로부터 제1 용액을 전달받고, 상기 산소를 공급하여 제2 용액을 제조하는 반응조 및 상기 반응조로부터 제2 용액을 전달받고, 물을 공급하여 과산화수소를 추출하는 분리조를 포함한다.
assignees: KOREA GAS TECH CORPORATION

title_en: Method and device for predicting river flooding based on digital twin
title_ko: 디지털 트윈에 기초하여 하천 범람을 예측하는 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method, an apparatus, and a system for predicting river flooding. According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, a method for predicting river flooding performed by an apparatus comprises the steps of: obtaining an image for a specific river; obtaining intermediate image data by applying a first preprocessing procedure to the intermediate image data for the image for the specific river, obtaining first result image data by applying a second preprocessing procedure for changing color information of the intermediate image data to the intermediate image data, and obtaining second result image data by applying a third preprocessing procedure for applying waves on a river surface from the intermediate image data; and obtaining state information of the specific river by inputting final image data based on the first result image data and the second result image data into an artificial intelligence (ai) model trained to output state information of the river.
abstract_ko: 하천 범람을 예측하는 방법, 장치 및 시스템이 개시된다. 본 개시의 일 실시예에 따른, 장치에 의해 수행되는, 하천 범람을 예측하는 방법은, 특정 하천에 대한 이미지를 획득하는 단계; 상기 특정 하천에 대한 이미지에 대해 제1 전처리 절차를 상기 중간 이미지 데이터에 대해 적용하여 중간 이미지 데이터를 획득하고, 상기 중간 이미지 데이터의 색 정보를 변화시키는 제2 전처리 절차를 상기 중간 이미지 데이터에 대해 적용하여 제1 결과 이미지 데이터를 획득하고, 상기 중간 이미지 데이터에서 하천 표면의 물결을 적용하는 제3 전처리 절차를 적용하여 제2 결과 이미지 데이터를 획득하는 단계; 및 상기 제1 결과 이미지 데이터 및 상기 제2 결과 이미지 데이터에 기초한 최종 이미지 데이터를 하천의 상태 정보를 출력하도록 학습된 인공지능(artificial intelligence, AI) 모델에 입력하여 상기 특정 하천의 상태 정보를 획득하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: ELECTRONICS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS RES INST

title_en: Electric power data recovery method based on visual perception
abstract_en: The application relates to a visual perception-based power data recovery method, which is characterized in that power data are converted into power curve images, and a visual perception technology is utilized for recovery. Firstly, data acquisition and image generation are carried out, a data set is constructed, secondly, feature extraction model training is carried out, image similarity calculation and judgment are carried out, and finally image recovery is carried out, so that continuity and accuracy of recovered data are ensured. By adopting the visual perception technology and by means of image feature extraction and comparison, the similarity of historical data can be fully mined, and the specificity of wind power generation affected by meteorological factors is considered, so that missing data can be accurately recovered. The visual perception model can not only identify images with similar large trends, but also capture detail features and provide a more accurate recovery scheme, thereby effectively solving the defect that the existing method cannot consider the similarity of large-scale historical data.
assignees: UNIV CHINA AGRICULTURAL

title_en: Micro-grid dynamic state estimation method and system considering data loss
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for estimating dynamic state of a micro-grid taking data loss into consideration, wherein the method comprises the following steps of establishing a micro-grid model and a Gilbert-Elliott model; the method comprises the steps of obtaining historical measurement data of a micro-grid from a sensor and a data center of the micro-grid, simulating and supplementing the historical measurement data of the micro-grid by using a Gilbert-Elliott model to obtain a data set containing the historical measurement data and packet loss data, preprocessing the data in the data set containing the historical measurement data and the packet loss data to obtain a preprocessed data set, constructing an LSTM-FNN model, training the LSTM-FNN model by using the preprocessed data set, and inputting the data acquired by the sensor of the micro-grid in real time into the trained LSTM-FNN model to estimate the missing state caused by data loss. The method solves the problems that the existing EKF-based power grid state estimation method highly depends on an accurate mathematical model, is difficult to adapt to the condition of incomplete data, and reduces the accuracy and reliability of state estimation.

title_en: Building energy prediction apparatus that predicts energy consumption for a building using time series data sets comprising missing values and method thereof
title_ko: 결측치를 포함하는 시계열 데이터 세트를 이용하여 건물의 에너지 소비량을 예측하는 에너지 소비량 예측장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are an apparatus and a method for predicting energy consumption, which predict energy consumption of a building by using a time series data set including missing values. To this end, provided is an energy consumption prediction apparatus comprising: a zone data receiving unit for receiving energy consumption and internal environment data for at least one zone in a building; an external data receiving unit for receiving external environment data of an area where the building is located from a meteorological agency; a learning data generating unit for generating learning data from a time series data set including the internal environment data and the external environment data; and a power consumption prediction unit for predicting missing energy consumption for at least one zone using the learning data as an input value and energy consumption for at least one zone as an output value. According to the present invention, it is possible to accurately predict the energy consumption of a building even when missing values exist.
abstract_ko: 결측치를 포함하는 시계열 데이터 세트를 이용하여 건물의 에너지 소비량을 예측하는 에너지 소비량 예측장치 및 그 방법이 개시된다. 이를 위하여 건물 내의 적어도 하나 이상의 구역에 대한 에너지 소비량 및 내부환경 데이터를 수신하는 구역데이터 수신부, 건물이 위치하는 지역의 외부환경 데이터를 기상청으로부터 수신하는 외부데이터 수신부, 내부환경 데이터 및 외부환경 데이터를 포함하는 시계열 데이터 세트로부터 학습데이터를 생성하는 학습데이터 생성부 및 학습데이터를 입력값으로 하고 적어도 하나 이상의 구역에 대한 에너지 소비량을 출력값으로 하여 적어도 하나 이상의 구역에 대해 결측된 에너지 소비량을 예측하는 전력소비량 예측부를 포함하는 에너지 소비량 예측장치를 제공한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 결측치가 존재하는 경우에도 건물의 에너지 소비량을 정확하게 예측할 수 있다.
assignees: EAN TECHNOTOSY CO LTD

title_en: A system for intelligently exploring contextual information
title_ko: 상황정보 지능형 탐색 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention solves the problem of improving the accuracy and speed of disaster response by automatically collecting, integrating, and analyzing contextual information from various sources, generating automatic reports, and providing real-time updates. The intelligent exploration system for contextual information comprises: an exploration base unit for collecting and structuring disaster-related data to accumulate it as big data; and a service model unit for automatically generating an analysis report by analyzing the big data according to a user query. The exploration base unit manages structured data as a knowledge graph and unstructured data as a vector DB, and the service model unit generates a suitable response through an LLM after NLP-based query analysis.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난 상황 정보의 효율적인 수집 및 탐색을 지원하는 지능형 탐색 시스템에 관한 것으로, 특히 상황실에서 상황 파악 후 전파·보고를 위한 자동화된 정보 탐색 및 보고서 생성을 가능하게 하는 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은 다양한 재난 상황에서 필요한 정보를 자동으로 탐색하고 분석하여, 상황 보고서나 대응 전략을 제안하는 인공지능 기반의 탐색 모델을 제공한다. 즉, 재난 상황 정보의 효율적인 수집 및 탐색을 지원하는 상황정보 지능형 탐색시스템에 있어서, 서버 컴퓨터는 상기 외부기관에서 전달된 각종 데이터들을 수집, 구조화하여 빅데이터로 축적하는 탐색 기반부와, 사용자의 질의응답이 접수되면 상기 탐색 기반부에 축적된 빅데이터를 이용하여 문제를 분석하고 답변 생성함으로써 분석보고서를 자동 생성할 수 있도록 하는 서비스 모델부로 구성되는데, 상기 탐색 기반부는 외부기관에서 전달된 각종 데이터들을 구조화된 정보(정형 데이터)와 비구조화된 정보(비정형 데이터)로 분류하여 처리하고, 수집, 구조화하여 빅데이터로 축적하고, 상기 서비스 모델부는 사용자의 질의응답이 접수되면 상기 탐색 기반부에 축적된 빅데이터를 이용하여 인공지능에 의해 문제 분석 및 답변 생성함으로써 분석보고서를 자동 생성할 수 있도록 구성된 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: NAT DISASTER MANAGEMENT RES INST

title_en: Energy storage resource scheduling optimization method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: A digital twin-based energy storage resource scheduling optimization method and system comprises the steps of 1, constructing a digital twin-based energy storage resource scheduling optimization platform, combining physical characteristics and historical data of an energy storage system to establish a digital twin model describing the running state of energy storage equipment, 2, carrying out joint modeling on a wind power generation system, a photovoltaic system and the energy storage system based on the constructed scheduling optimization platform to establish an equivalent model of the joint power generation system, 3, establishing physical and running constraint conditions of a multi-objective optimization function and a scheduling algorithm based on the established equivalent model of the joint power generation system to establish an energy storage system resource scheduling optimization problem, and 4, carrying out problem solving and dynamic adjustment by utilizing a differential evolution algorithm based on the established scheduling optimization problem. The method accurately reflects the running state of the energy storage system, improves the real-time response capability, remarkably improves the economy and stability of a dispatching scheme, and ensures the safety and feasibility of a dispatching strategy.
assignees: STATE POWER ZHEJIANG NINGHAI POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Method for building power distribution network planning digital twin system based on oblique photography technology
abstract_en: The application relates to a method for constructing a power distribution network planning digital twin system based on an oblique photography technology, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of 1 reconstructing a three-dimensional model of a power distribution area, 2 constructing a digital twin scene, and 3 optimizing a planning path of the power distribution network. The oblique photography technology can shoot ground images from multiple angles to generate a high-resolution three-dimensional model, and the point cloud data provides accurate terrain information, so that the combination of the two ensures high accuracy and detail richness of the model. Compared with the traditional manual measurement and paper map, the method greatly improves the efficiency of data acquisition and model construction, ensures the high consistency of the model and the actual environment, and improves the accuracy and feasibility of power distribution network planning.
assignees: SHAOXING POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: ERP and E-commerce platform bidirectional information flow integration method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a system and a method for integrating two-way information flows of an ERP and an e-commerce platform, which relate to the technical field of information flow integration and ensure the non-tamper property and traceability of data through a block chain technology, an edge calculation module improves the data processing efficiency, an event driving module realizes loose coupling communication, a digital twin module maps the state of a supply chain in real time and predicts risks, a federal learning module jointly models and generates a sales strategy, a network slicing technology ensures the stability of the data flow, an Internet of things module enhances the real-time property of the data, a knowledge graph module solves the problem of data isomerism, the method realizes high-efficiency and safe two-way information flow integration through the steps of data recording, preprocessing, event abstraction, digital twin modeling, federal learning, network slicing, internet of things integration and the like, and an electronic device and a storage medium store a program to execute the method, thereby improving the management efficiency of the supply chain and the real-time property of data processing.
assignees: GUANGZHOU ZHIAO TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wind power missing data complement method based on improvement WGAIN
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of wind power missing data completion. In order to solve the problem of wind power data missing, the invention provides a data complement method for generating an anti-interpolation network based on improvement. The method integrates a convolutional neural network, a long-short-time memory network and a self-attention mechanism in a generator so as to fully mine long-term dependence of time series data and potential correlation among multiple features. The discriminator optimizes the difference measurement between the generated data distribution and the real data distribution by introducing the Wasserstein distance, and remarkably improves the completion precision and the overall performance of the model on the missing data.

title_en: Navigation risk dynamic assessment method based on parallel acceleration
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of navigation risk assessment and flow field analysis, and particularly provides a navigation risk dynamic assessment method based on parallel acceleration, which comprises the following steps of data acquisition, drawing a two-dimensional unstructured grid, and carrying out terrain interpolation and numerical interpolation; setting up a two-dimensional hydrodynamic model based on CUDA parallel calculation, setting boundary conditions, carrying out model calculation on the set-up two-dimensional hydrodynamic model, deriving calculation data, drawing a virtual structure grid, carrying out spatial data interpolation, setting up a navigation risk assessment model, carrying out parallel calculation of spatial risks to obtain spatial risk ratings, setting up a risk assessment display platform based on a Cesium framework, dynamically updating navigation risk assessment results under different water flow conditions, and updating the spatial risk ratings after the flow and water level boundary conditions according to real-time updating of flow and water level boundaries. According to the method, the flow field simulation and navigation risk assessment efficiency is improved through a parallel computing technology, and a dynamic risk assessment result is displayed by combining a three-dimensional visual platform, so that powerful support is provided for safe navigation in complex water areas.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Coal preparation plant energy storage system and energy storage method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The application provides an energy storage system and an energy storage method for a coal preparation plant based on digital twin, the energy storage system comprises a hybrid energy storage system, a battery management system, a high-voltage direct current protection system, a pre-charging/discharging loop, a high-voltage alternating current distribution system, a centralized PCS cluster and a power electronic interface of a power grid, and the battery energy storage is connected with power consumption equipment in a coal preparation plant in an integral row. The method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model of power consumption equipment, acquiring a production scheduling plan of a coal preparation plant, determining power consumption equipment required by a process flow under the current production scheduling plan, simulating the work load of all the power consumption equipment under the current production scheduling plan through the digital twin model, predicting the electric quantity W required by a power price peak value under the current production scheduling plan according to the work load of the power consumption equipment, and configuring corresponding energy storage capacity. Through full flow efficiency management and control, production efficiency is improved, an electric energy storage system is established, and an optimal storage and discharge planning plan is given through a digital twin technology and local peak-valley electricity price, so that unit electricity consumption cost is reduced.

title_en: Multi-dimensional data fusion analysis method and device for digital twin
abstract_en: The application provides a multidimensional data fusion analysis method and device for a digital twin body, which relate to the technical field of data analysis and comprise the steps of constructing M fault prediction models in a target power plant; the method comprises the steps of carrying out multi-level data fusion modeling on a plurality of power plant systems, loading M fault prediction models to a plurality of system-level digital twin bodies, carrying out multi-level fault transfer analysis on a target power plant, carrying out fault conduction rendering on an initial twin body of the power plant according to a power plant fault state transfer diagram to obtain a digital twin body of the power plant, loading M real-time equipment operation data to the M fault prediction models to obtain M equipment operation states, and carrying out visualization on the M equipment operation states of the digital twin body of the power plant. The application can solve the technical problem of lower operation and maintenance efficiency of the power plant due to the lack of effective fusion of multidimensional data in the prior art, and the operation and maintenance efficiency of the power plant is improved by constructing the digital twin body of the power plant to realize the visualization of the operation state of the equipment.

title_en: GCB disassembly and assembly process auxiliary decision-making method based on measurement and digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a GCB disassembly and assembly process auxiliary decision-making method based on measurement and digital twinning, which relates to the technical field of power generation equipment management. The method provided by the invention can guide the on-site maintainer to carry out the safe and efficient GCB dismounting process, and reduce the safety risk and human error in the GCB dismounting process, thereby improving the working efficiency and safety of the maintainer.
