title_en: Digital twinning-based suspension structure construction full-period simulation optimization method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twin technology and suspension structure construction, and discloses a suspension structure construction full-period simulation optimization method based on digital twin, which comprises the steps of constructing a multi-level nested graph to represent a suspension structure; the method comprises the steps of realizing a cross-layer attention mechanism, calculating the influence transfer of structural units among different layers, identifying multi-scale key paths in a structure, constructing a dual self-attention-enhanced space-time diagram neural network, identifying key nodes through node self-attention layers, capturing the structural state evolution of a long time scale by the time self-attention layers, learning the structural dynamic characteristics by using a time sequence diagram convolution network, predicting the structural bearing capacity change and dynamic response, generating a structural vulnerability heat map, identifying potential risk areas, and automatically adjusting the monitoring sampling frequency of the key nodes.

title_en: Cross-platform power transaction data interaction optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cross-platform power transaction data interaction optimization method, which particularly relates to the technical field of digital twin of power transaction data, and comprises the steps of generating simulation transaction data of market participants based on an antagonistic neural network model, identifying causal relations among market variables from the simulation transaction data of the digital twin through a causal discovery algorithm, constructing a causal graph, modeling space dependence and causal conduction paths among the market participants through a graph neural network model, performing anti-facts reasoning in a single external impact scene in the digital twin through intervention of key variables in the causal graph, simulating dynamic game behaviors of the market participants in an extreme weather parameter distribution scene, performing power market failure evaluation by combining the causal conduction paths to obtain power market failure evaluation indexes, performing early warning based on the power market failure evaluation indexes, and improving adaptability and stability of a power market in the extreme weather scene.
assignees: INF CT YUNNAN GRID POWER CO LTD

title_en: CT induction power supply system based on cooperative control and distributed optimization and control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of CT induction power supplies, in particular to a CT induction power supply system based on cooperative control and distributed optimization and a control method. The technical scheme is that the CT induction power supply control method based on cooperative control and distributed optimization comprises the following steps of S1, deploying a multi-mode sensing array, synchronously collecting three-phase current harmonic spectra of power supply nodes, magnetostrictive vibration waveforms of an iron core and infrared thermal imaging of the surface of a radiator, generating a digital twin body with space-time correlation through multi-physical field coupling modeling, and S2, constructing a data fusion engine driven by a space-time attention mechanism at an edge computing node, and extracting LSTM features under physical constraints of output and historical operation logs of the S1. According to the invention, through collaborative innovation of multi-mode federal learning and physical embedded edge calculation, a multi-physical-field dynamic modeling mechanism under privacy protection is constructed, and the correlation precision and information safety of electromagnetic-vibration-thermal data are effectively balanced.
assignees: SHIJIAZHUANG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH CO STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for identifying and repairing power grid faults
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for identifying and repairing power grid faults, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model of a power distribution network containing a doubly-fed induction generator; according to the digital twin model of the power distribution network, simulating fault conditions of different nodes in the power distribution network to generate real-time fault data, inputting the real-time fault data into a preset InceptionTime neural network model to perform fault identification to obtain a fault identification result, and according to the fault identification result, scheduling the maintenance unit to the fault node to perform fault repair by adopting a scheduling algorithm based on deep reinforcement learning. According to the application, the digital twin model, inceptionTime neural network, deep reinforcement learning algorithm and other technologies are introduced to identify and repair the power grid faults, so that the precision and robustness of fault identification are improved, the path planning of fault repair is optimized, the time of fault repair is further reduced, and the efficiency of fault repair is improved.
assignees: ZHUHAI HUAFA DIGITAL INTELLIGENCE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Substation inspection task planning management method and device and substation inspection task planning management program product
abstract_en: The invention relates to a substation inspection task planning management method and device, and a computer program product, comprising the following steps: by integrating the three-dimensional digital twin scene and twin camera data, the automatic identification of the patrol points and the optimal path planning are realized; firstly, constructing a three-dimensional digital model of a transformer substation, automatically screening patrol points meeting the conditions according to camera parameters and patrol requirements, and calculating the optimal patrol gesture of a camera; in addition, the method can also detect and avoid the shielding of the obstacle in real time, and ensure the comprehensiveness and accuracy of the patrol task; finally, the execution device of the method generates patrol task management module data according to the information, and realizes the storage and the calling of the data; the method of the invention obviously improves the automation and intelligent level of the inspection work of the transformer substation, reduces the operation and maintenance cost and improves the safety and reliability of the operation of the power grid.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Atmospheric data assimilation method, apparatus, device, and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides an atmosphere data assimilation method, device, equipment and storage medium. Relates to the technical field of computer science and atmospheric science fusion. The method comprises the steps of adding a cost function, prior estimation and a gradient of the cost function into a gradient-based descent algorithm, adding posterior estimation, constructing a four-dimensional variation and set Kalman filtering combination model based on Bayesian prior information, and carrying out data assimilation on atmospheric data based on the four-dimensional variation and set Kalman filtering combination model. The application combines artificial intelligence technology, in particular to deep learning and Bayesian optimization self-adaptive algorithm, enhances and optimizes the traditional data assimilation algorithm, and can be widely applied to prediction of extreme weather events such as high-temperature heat waves and the like. By assimilating the historical data and the real-time observation data, the prediction accuracy of the future climate change trend is remarkably improved, and more powerful support is provided for extreme weather early warning and decision making.

title_en: Energy network state sensing method, device, equipment and medium based on digital twin
abstract_en: The application discloses an energy network state sensing method, device, equipment and medium based on digital twinning, relating to the technical field of expressway energy network information monitoring, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring real-time data of an energy network; the method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model of the expressway energy network based on the real-time data of the energy network, simulating the expressway energy network by using the digital twin model to generate a state sensing result of the expressway energy network, monitoring the state sensing result to obtain a monitoring result, and dynamically adjusting and optimizing the energy gateway key nodes according to the state sensing result.
assignees: SHANDONG HI SPEED GROUP CO LTD;INNOVATION RES INSTITUTE OF SHANDONG HI SPEED GROUP CO LTD;SHANDONG ZHENGCHEN POLYTRON TECH CO LTD

title_en: Beidou-based power grid emergency wireless command system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system management, in particular to a Beidou-based power grid emergency wireless command system which comprises Beidou positioning communication, multi-source data fusion, intelligent decision, heterogeneous communication and a visual command terminal, wherein the Beidou positioning communication module accurately acquires the position of power equipment and transmits encryption instructions, the multi-source data fusion module integrates power, weather and geographic information, performs data cleaning and space-time correlation analysis to provide support for decision making, the intelligent decision module relies on a digital twin dynamic prediction library and a deep reinforcement learning algorithm to generate multi-target optimization decisions by using an improved multi-target genetic algorithm, the heterogeneous communication module integrates various communication units to realize mode dynamic switching and bandwidth aggregation to ensure stable communication, and the visual command terminal displays the situation of a power grid and gives the instructions efficiently by means of augmented reality and multi-level authority management. The invention greatly improves the emergency response and command efficiency of the power grid and powerfully ensures the stable power supply.
assignees: STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO;HAIBEI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Running state prediction method, device and terminal of digital twin body of micro-grid
abstract_en: The invention provides a running state prediction method, device and terminal of a digital twin body of a micro-grid, and belongs to the technical field of digital twin of the micro-grid. The method comprises the steps of obtaining performance data of a micro-grid, inputting the performance data into an operation state prediction model of a micro-grid digital twin body to obtain an operation state prediction result of the micro-grid digital twin body output by the operation state prediction model, wherein the operation state prediction model comprises a feature extraction layer and an output layer, the feature extraction layer is constructed based on a plurality of echo state networks connected in series and is used for carrying out feature extraction on the performance data to obtain operation state features, the output layer is used for carrying out feature conversion on the operation state features to obtain the operation state prediction result, and parameter optimization is carried out on model parameters of the output layer when the operation state prediction model is trained. The method solves the problem of how to realize light abstraction and clipping of the digital twin model of the micro-grid so as to adapt to efficient operation of the digital twin body of the micro-grid at the edge computing terminal.
assignees: BEIJING SMARTCHIP MICROELECTRONICS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban life body full period monitoring system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin technology-based urban life body full period monitoring system, which relates to the technical field of urban management, and integrates multi-source data such as GIS data, remote sensing information, surface permeability data, underground drainage pipe network structures and the like, quantifies a flood high-risk area, adopts extreme weather simulation to deduce the water accumulation range and drainage capacity under different rainfall situations based on historical rainfall trend, current meteorological conditions and drainage network states, dynamically adjusts a flood diffusion trend prediction model, enables flood risk to be identified more accurately, and an intelligent emergency scheduling module automatically matches flood control resources, combines flood high-risk areas, water accumulation points and traffic flow analysis, optimizes a drainage pump station start-stop strategy, remotely adjusts underground drainage gates, dynamically adjusts overflow adjustment capacity of a sewage treatment plant, combines an intelligent traffic management system to optimize an emergency refuge route, and improves the accuracy and execution efficiency of a flood control scheduling scheme.
assignees: BEIJING SINOTOON TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for constructing private network digital twin bodies of power production data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a digital twin body of a private network of electric power production data, which comprises the following steps of 1) establishing a geometric model, a physical model, a behavior model and a rule model according to geometric information, physical information, operation behaviors and operation rules of the private network of electric power production data, integrating the geometric model, the physical model, the behavior model and the rule model into a unified digital twin body model, 2) constructing a real-time data acquisition frame of the digital twin body of the private network of the electric power production data, comprising a perception layer, a transmission layer and a feedback layer, and 3) sending a control instruction to a physical entity according to decision instructions and feedback, and operating and adjusting the virtual model to realize the construction of the digital twin body of the private network of the electric power production data. The method provided by the invention realizes real-time monitoring of the system and optimizes the system decision strategy so as to meet the processing requirement of massive heterogeneous data under the smart grid background and improve the system efficiency.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Particle swarm optimization algorithm-based power production OTN resource scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric power production OTN resource scheduling method based on a particle swarm optimization algorithm, which comprises the following steps of 1) constructing a digital twin model of an electric power production OTN network through a digital twin modeling method fused by multiple models, 2) modeling an electric power production OTN resource scheduling problem, designing a neighborhood searching strategy and a global searching strategy suitable for electric power production OTN resource scheduling by adopting the particle swarm optimization algorithm-based group intelligent optimization method, and realizing the electric power production OTN resource scheduling method based on the particle swarm optimization algorithm. The invention adopts an improved particle swarm optimization algorithm, can dynamically adjust the position and speed of particles according to the real-time network state, realizes self-adaptive optimization and adapts to the changing network environment, and can simultaneously consider a plurality of optimization targets to comprehensively optimize the scheduling scheme, thereby having stronger global searching capability, rapid convergence speed and strong robustness.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for establishing business expansion installation digital twin model based on hybrid drive
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric power, and provides a method and a device for establishing a digital twin model of business expansion and reporting based on hybrid driving, wherein the method comprises the steps of step-by-step multi-element data acquisition, preprocessing multi-element data based on an improved fractional order flexible space method, constructing a data driving model based on an improved TCN-BiGRU method, combining an improved semi-infinite method with the data driving model to obtain the hybrid driving model, constructing a digital twin platform area dynamic model, simulating and deducting a business expansion and reporting scheme and the like; the invention utilizes a digital twin technology to construct a power system model with real-time monitoring and optimizing capabilities. The model can accurately simulate the power grid state of the active station area, analyze the core parameter characteristics under different business expansion schemes, predict the influence of new energy access on the power grid operation, and provide more accurate and flexible scheduling and decision basis for power grid management.

title_en: Risk early warning method, device and system based on dynamic risk field with few samples
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk early warning method, a risk early warning device and a risk early warning system based on a dynamic risk field with few samples, which belong to the technical field of data network security, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining an initial risk field by the boundary of a first low-dimensional anchor node corresponding to the few samples, and mapping a second low-dimensional anchor node corresponding to the rest samples into the initial risk field to obtain a target risk field; and when any sample has data change, remapping the changed sample into the target risk field, and carrying out risk early warning according to the change amount between the current mapping position corresponding to the changed sample and the initial mapping position corresponding to the unchanged sample. The invention constructs high-efficiency risk field based on a small amount of marked data, thereby remarkably reducing the data acquisition cost. Meanwhile, in order to adapt to a highly dynamic social risk environment, the robustness and the practicability of the model can be effectively improved by adopting a dynamic risk field modeling and online updating mechanism.
assignees: UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH

title_en: Networking type energy storage remote management system and method based on Internet technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a networking type energy storage remote management system and method based on the Internet technology, which relate to the technical field of fault detection and analysis and specifically comprise the following steps of networking type energy storage equipment; integrating an energy storage converter and a plurality of sensors, acquiring historical fault data records, analyzing a fluctuation curve of sensor data when faults occur, constructing a fault positioning map according to the correlation, monitoring the network-structured energy storage device in real time, acquiring the sensor data, drawing a real-time evolution curve, judging whether potential faults exist in the network-structured energy storage device according to the fitting degree of the real-time evolution curve and the historical evolution curve, immediately giving an early warning, performing potential fault investigation according to the fault positioning map, and supporting remote operation through a digital twin modeling network-structured energy storage device relative position model. The invention judges potential faults by a unique fitting degree formula, realizes early warning and achieves the purpose of timely checking and maintaining.
assignees: NANTONG GUOXUAN NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: New energy power equipment state judging method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy power equipment state judging method and system based on digital twinning, which are used for classifying normal and abnormal state data of power equipment based on the equality of control parameters and external influence parameters, comparing similar data, extracting initial abnormal factor data sections to form an initial abnormal factor data section group, carrying out secondary classification based on the control parameters, the external influence parameters and the proximity of the initial abnormal factor data section group, carrying out validity interception on the initial abnormal factor data based on repeated characteristics to obtain effective abnormal factor data sections, combining the effective abnormal factor data sections into an effective abnormal factor data section group, analyzing real-time operation data by utilizing the effective abnormal factor data section group, constructing a virtual model by a digital twinning technology, comparing dynamic performance, realizing state judgment, solving the problems of abnormal factor extraction and real-time monitoring in a complex environment, improving the accuracy of state judgment, and being suitable for safe operation monitoring of the new energy power equipment.
assignees: UNIV HEBEI

title_en: Collaborative management method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a collaborative management method based on digital twinning, which relates to the field of power system management and comprises the following steps of collecting equipment account information, operation and maintenance data and geographic distribution data in a physical transformer substation, constructing a corresponding digital twinning transformer substation according to the equipment account information, the operation and maintenance data and the geographic distribution data in the physical transformer substation, setting a monitoring period, acquiring input electric energy and actual output electric energy in the monitoring period, judging whether the physical transformer substation is abnormal by combining the obtained digital twinning transformer substation, generating corresponding power transformation abnormal information if the physical transformer substation is abnormal, marking the corresponding physical transformer substation as an abnormal transformer substation, collecting operation parameters of connecting equipment in the abnormal transformer substation, judging whether the connecting equipment in the abnormal transformer substation is faulty or not based on the digital twinning transformer substation, marking the corresponding connecting equipment as fault equipment if the connecting equipment is faulty, and maintaining the corresponding fault equipment.
assignees: SHENYANG ZHENGFENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-time space scale data fusion power distribution network power outage time account number calculation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, discloses a multi-time space-scale data fusion power distribution network power failure time household number accounting method, and aims to solve the problems of isolated island data, coarse space-time granularity, false alarm and intelligent deficiency and the like in the traditional accounting method. The method comprises the steps of constructing a multisource data fusion framework, carrying out fine space-time grid modeling on a power distribution network, utilizing a time synchronization correction algorithm and a mutation point detection technology to accurately correct the time range and user influence of a power failure event, combining machine learning to predict the number of potential power failure users, filling missing data by using spatial interpolation, improving the accounting integrity and accuracy, and finally generating a multidimensional visual report to provide decision support for power grid operation and planning. The invention obviously improves the accuracy and efficiency of the accounting of the number of households in power failure through multisource data fusion, intelligent algorithm and spatial interpolation technology, provides important technical support for the reliability evaluation and optimization of the power distribution network, and has wide application prospect.
assignees: HONGHE POWER SUPPLY BUREAU YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent planning method for power distribution network
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent planning method for a power distribution network, which comprises the following steps: firstly, dividing a power distribution network into a plurality of functional blocks, collecting and classifying power consumer power consumption data, generating a change curve based on the data to predict power consumption requirements, and obtaining a power consumption data quantity prediction curve. Then, carrying out digital twin modeling and calculation force simulation on each functional block, and recording simulation calculation force indexes; the method can accurately grasp regional electricity utilization characteristics, evaluate system states and calculation power demands in advance, accurately evaluate communication matching degree, timely find potential problems, optimize resource allocation, improve operation stability and efficiency of the power distribution network, and realize reasonable utilization and efficient management of resources.
assignees: GUODIAN HUAYAN BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Power system state estimation method and system for graph data
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for estimating the state of a power system facing to graph data, comprising the steps of extracting characteristics according to state operation graph data of the power system to obtain characteristic description data; the method comprises the steps of establishing a corresponding information equation set according to the characteristic description data, carrying out state estimation on the electric power system by utilizing a conjugate gradient method based on the information equation set, and carrying out characteristic extraction on graph data in the operation process of the electric power system, so that the method is beneficial to fully utilizing computing resources, improving computing efficiency, reducing computing time of state estimation, carrying out state estimation on the electric power system by utilizing the conjugate gradient method, and reducing risk of sinking into a local optimal solution, thereby improving solving quality.
assignees: STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Kalman filter-based multi-element periodic grid power prediction method
abstract_en: The invention provides a Kalman filter-based multi-element periodic grid power prediction method, which relates to the field of new energy generated power prediction and mainly comprises four parts, namely a multi-element periodic grid establishment stage, an initialization stage, a prediction stage and an update stage. According to the method, historical power data and meteorological data of a new energy power station are used as input, a three-dimensional grid model covering power, periodic characteristics and time is constructed, a Kalman filter is used as a prediction tool, and weights among the power, the periodic characteristics and meteorological factors are continuously adjusted by combining the historical data and current real-time input data, so that the grid data is continuously subjected to dynamic rolling update. The method can well capture the periodic characteristics and dynamic changes of the grid data, has remarkable advantages in the aspects of multi-metadata fusion, noise suppression and real-time updating of the system state, has high prediction precision, and is suitable for power prediction scenes with complex periodic fluctuation and changeable environments.
assignees: UNIV NANJING NORMAL

title_en: Generating capacity prediction method and system based on digital twin model of photovoltaic power station
abstract_en: A power generation amount prediction method and a power generation amount prediction system based on a photovoltaic power station digital twin model are provided, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly generating photovoltaic power station operation data conforming to actual distribution, constructing the photovoltaic power station digital twin model, respectively inputting the generated photovoltaic power station operation data into a photovoltaic power station physical model and a photovoltaic power station data driving model constructed by adopting an improved LSTM algorithm to obtain a power generation amount prediction value, and obtaining a final photovoltaic power station power generation amount prediction result by fusing the power generation amount prediction value of the physical model and the power generation amount prediction value of the data driving model. According to the invention, through construction of the digital twin model of the photovoltaic power station, the operation condition of the photovoltaic power station in reality is mapped and simulated more accurately, and the improved LSTM algorithm is adopted to construct the data driving model, so that the adaptability of the model to different time scale fluctuation is enhanced, and through fusion of the prediction results of the physical model and the data driving model, more accurate photovoltaic power generation amount prediction is obtained, and reliable support is provided for power system scheduling decision.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for air port energy balance management
abstract_en: A method, a system, equipment and a medium for energy balance management of an airport relate to the field of energy management. The method comprises the steps of constructing an energy topology map according to multi-source data, predicting energy load demands of an airport in different time periods according to the energy topology map, determining supply amounts of renewable energy sources in different time periods according to predicted illumination intensity and wind power, determining time-sharing energy supply and demand balance probability according to the energy load demands and the supply amounts, determining a preliminary energy management plan according to cost parameters, the time-sharing energy supply and demand balance probability and equipment operation constraint, wherein the preliminary energy management plan comprises an energy storage system charging and discharging time sequence, a standby generator start-stop plan and a power grid electricity purchasing proportion, executing the preliminary energy management plan through a digital twin body of the airport to obtain first energy execution data, and adjusting the preliminary energy management plan according to differences between the first energy execution data and second energy execution data at the current moment. By implementing the technical scheme provided by the application, the energy cost is reduced.
assignees: NANJING LUKOU INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power system state estimation method integrating migration learning and generation countermeasure network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system state estimation method integrating transfer learning and generation of an countermeasure network, which comprises the steps of adding measurement noise to tidal current data of an original topology to obtain the original topology measurement data, preprocessing, building a DA-CNN-BiLSTM neural network, training by using the preprocessed original topology measurement data set to obtain a source domain model, adding the measurement noise to tidal current data of a new topology to obtain a small sample new topology measurement data set simulating actual measurement, carrying out data enhancement on the new topology measurement data set by using a CWGAN-div model to obtain an extended new topology measurement data set, carrying out transfer learning on the number of frozen part layers by using the source domain model and the extended new topology measurement data set, carrying out fine tuning training on an unfrozen part to obtain a target domain model, and inputting the new topology real-time section measurement information into the target domain model to predict the target domain model to obtain the current system state quantity during online estimation. The invention solves the problem of insufficient estimation precision of the original topology estimation model during topology change.
assignees: UNIV FUJIAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: New energy storage power station with electric energy recovery function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy storage power station with an electric energy recovery function, which mainly comprises a control system module, a sensor module, a controller module, an acquisition system module, a compressor module, an air storage tank module, a heat exchange module, a turbine module, an energy storage module and an inverter module, wherein the sensor module, the controller module, the acquisition system module, the compressor module, the air storage tank module, the heat exchange module, the turbine module, the energy storage module and the inverter module are connected with the control system module. In the new energy storage power station, the control system fuses the equipment characteristics with the digital model, the equipment characteristic data are associated with corresponding equipment elements in the digital model, the real-time monitoring and control of the equipment state and performance are realized, and the equipment characteristics and the digital model are tightly combined through the steps of data acquisition, state estimation, optimization algorithm design and control strategy design, so that the monitoring and control capability of the energy storage station is further enhanced. Meanwhile, the method and the system also improve the accuracy of model prediction, the accuracy and the completeness of data, and further optimize the monitoring and control effects of the whole system.
assignees: CHINA ENERGY CONSTRUCTION GROUP GUANGXI ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Group-regulation group-control digital twin method for road surface distributed photovoltaic energy storage system
abstract_en: The invention provides a group-regulation group-control digital twin method for a road surface distributed photovoltaic energy storage system, which comprises the following steps of collecting environment data and system state data in real time, constructing a digital twin model based on a multi-level correlation regression network model, dynamically predicting the system state, predicting photovoltaic power generation capacity and energy demand in a future period based on a self-supervision learning framework, dynamically adjusting the operation mode of a power generation and energy storage unit according to a prediction result and the real-time environment data, and monitoring a scheduling execution result in real time based on a closed loop feedback mechanism to ensure stable operation of the system. The invention has important significance in realizing high-efficiency energy utilization, reducing energy waste and improving system flexibility and intelligent level, and is particularly suitable for the distributed photovoltaic energy storage system in complex environments such as pavement and the like.
assignees: UNIV TONGJI

title_en: Digital twin synchronization method supporting equipment state evolution modeling
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twin, and discloses a digital twin synchronization method supporting equipment state evolution modeling, which comprises the steps of S1, multi-source heterogeneous data acquisition and preprocessing, deployment of a multi-mode sensor array, S2, a physical-virtual state synchronization mechanism, a clock synchronization network of an equipment end and a virtual model end based on an IEEE1588 protocol, S3, equipment state evolution modeling, equipment degradation feature extraction of a mixed model fusing a convolutional neural network and a cyclic neural network, S4, virtual-real state consistency guarantee, design of a double verification mechanism, and comprehensive and accurate acquisition of various key parameters of a concentrator and special-change terminal equipment, including three-phase current harmonic spectrum, temperature field distribution, vibration acceleration spectrum, insulation resistance parameters and the like, through the multi-mode sensor array, data comparability and subsequent processing precision are improved, and a data basis is provided for accurate assessment of equipment states.
assignees: SHENZHEN FRIENDCOM TECH DEV CO LTD;WUHAN FRIENDCOM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power equipment multi-source heterogeneous perception data complement method, device, computer equipment, storage medium and computer program product based on Kalman filtering model
abstract_en: The application relates to a multi-source heterogeneous perception data complement method, a device, a computer device, a storage medium and a computer program product of power equipment based on a Kalman filtering model. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a perception data set corresponding to the power equipment, establishing a Kalman filtering model aiming at the power equipment based on the perception data set, carrying out parameter estimation on the Kalman filtering model by adopting an expectation maximization algorithm to obtain a parameter estimation result, carrying out Kalman filtering recursion based on the parameter estimation result to obtain a perception data prediction result corresponding to the power equipment, carrying out data complementation on the perception data set based on the perception data prediction result to obtain a post-complementation perception data set, and correcting a digital twin body of the power equipment by the post-complementation perception data set. The method can accurately and efficiently complete data.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Wireless sensor network-based intelligent operation and maintenance detection system for complete life cycle of telegraph pole
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of operation and maintenance of power grids, and discloses a telegraph pole full life cycle intelligent operation and maintenance detection system based on a wireless sensor network, which comprises an acquisition module, a detection module and a control module, wherein the acquisition module is used for monitoring the health state of a telegraph pole in real time; the system comprises a data fusion module, a fault prediction module, an early warning processing module, a wireless transmission module and a modeling module, wherein the data fusion module is used for obtaining the health state estimation of a telegraph pole based on a Kalman filtering algorithm, the fault prediction module is used for predicting the fault occurrence probability of the telegraph pole by combining a Bayesian inference algorithm, the early warning processing module is used for sending early warning signals and carrying out emergency response, the wireless transmission module is used for carrying out wireless transmission, and the modeling module is used for displaying information in real time. According to the application, the continuous on-line monitoring of the electric pole in various health states is realized through the acquisition module, so that the modeling and early warning module can accurately calculate based on the real state, the electric pole in a large range can be monitored in real time at the same time, the emergency response speed is improved, and the safe operation of the electric power system is ensured.
assignees: GUANGDONG XINRONGRONG ELECTRIC POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wide-area power system state estimation coordination method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system state estimation, and particularly discloses a wide-area power system state estimation coordination method, which is characterized in that a wide-area power grid is divided into N dynamic monitoring areas based on the physical connection characteristics and the electric coupling strength of the power grid, wherein each area comprises a core node and N edge nodes; and carrying out overall operation state judgment on the wide-area power grid, and carrying out overall adjustment on the wide-area power grid based on the judgment result, thereby being capable of remarkably improving the accuracy and reliability evaluation value of power grid monitoring and supporting accurate state judgment and adjustment. The method has remarkable advantages and necessity in improving the running efficiency of the power grid, reducing risks and optimizing resource allocation, and can effectively cope with the complexity and dynamic change of the modern power grid.

title_en: Regional power grid operation and maintenance management platform based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid operation and maintenance, in particular to a regional power grid operation and maintenance management platform based on digital twinning. According to the invention, an integrated regional power grid operation and maintenance management platform is constructed by a digital twin technology. The platform combines real-time power grid data, meteorological data and equipment physical characteristics, updates the running state of power grid equipment, particularly the stress and deformation conditions of towers and wires in real time through finite element analysis and a dynamic wind load model, and calculates the damage condition of the equipment in real time when the disaster occurs through combining the equipment damage analysis model and a defense strategy optimization module by dynamically feeding back the influence of disasters such as lightning stroke and typhoon, thereby optimizing the defense strategy and minimizing the power failure loss and the defense cost.
assignees: ZHEJIANG LIGHT ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic tracking and early warning method and system for intelligent carbon emission
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic tracking and early warning method and a system for intelligent carbon emission, and relates to the technical field of carbon emission management, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model of a target area, dividing grids based on monitoring precision, and arranging a first layer of fixed monitoring points; the method comprises the steps of planning a mobile monitoring path by combining a carbon emission attention fitting result, configuring a second layer mobile monitoring point, collecting data through the two layers of monitoring points, establishing a carbon emission data network, performing air flow simulation based on a digital twin model, performing tracing inversion by combining the data network, positioning an emission source, and finally realizing equipment-level positioning and carbon emission tracking and early warning through equipment matching analysis. The invention solves the technical problems of limited carbon emission monitoring coverage range and insufficient traceability in the prior art, and is difficult to realize accurate positioning and real-time early warning of the carbon emission source, and achieves the technical effects of high-precision traceability positioning and real-time traceability early warning of the carbon emission source.
assignees: SHENYANG BIHAI ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Municipal works water treatment emergency system and device based on digit twin
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water resource treatment, in particular to a digital twinning-based municipal engineering water treatment emergency system and device, wherein the system comprises a water condition monitoring module, a water condition prediction module and an emergency treatment module; the water regime monitoring module is used for monitoring the water source quality and the water source allowance of the water resources treated by the municipal sewage plant and the running states of various water treatment devices, the water regime prediction module is used for constructing a virtual municipal water network, the water regime prediction module is also used for generating a simulated emergency scheme, the water regime prediction module is used for adjusting the simulated emergency scheme to generate an actual emergency scheme and transmitting the actual emergency scheme to the emergency treatment module, and the emergency treatment module is used for receiving the actual emergency scheme transmitted by the water regime prediction module, carrying out emergency treatment according to the actual emergency scheme and adjusting the water source quality and the water source allowance of the water resources treated by the municipal sewage plant and the running states of various water treatment devices. The invention has complete structure and can effectively improve the efficiency and success rate of emergency treatment of water resources.
assignees: GUANGXI ECO ENG VOCATIONAL & TECHNICAL COLLEGE

title_en: Electric load test and adjustment method for heat supply period of cogeneration unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric load testing and adjusting method for a heat supply period of a cogeneration unit, which comprises the following steps of collecting operation data of the cogeneration unit in the heat supply period, constructing a digital twin model, simulating unit operation states under different electric loads in the digital twin model, determining an optimal operation interval, formulating an electric load adjusting strategy based on an electric load testing result and combining heat supply requirements and power grid dispatching instructions, monitoring the electric load and the heat load of the unit in real time, dynamically adjusting the electric load and the heat load according to the adjusting strategy, and carrying out early warning and corresponding measures in advance by fault diagnosis function of the digital twin model. The invention belongs to the field of monitoring of thermoelectric units, and particularly relates to a method for testing and adjusting an electric load of a heat supply period of a cogeneration unit.
assignees: Huaneng jinan huangtai power generation co ltd

title_en: Disaster prevention digital twin system of transformer substation
abstract_en: A digital twin system for disaster prevention of a transformer substation relates to the technical field of power grid disaster prevention and comprises a multi-mode sensing layer, a dynamic twin modeling layer, a trusted federal learning analysis layer and a disaster coordinated control layer. The intelligent power system monitoring system comprises a multi-mode sensing layer, a dynamic twin modeling layer, a reliable federal learning analysis layer, a disaster linkage control layer, a power system control layer and the like, wherein the multi-mode sensing layer collects equipment, environment and personnel behavior data in real time through various sensors, the dynamic twin modeling layer builds a high-precision static model through laser radar scanning and other technologies, dynamic updating is achieved through a local model refreshing mechanism, the reliable federal learning analysis layer fuses multi-source data, the layered federal learning framework is used for accurately predicting equipment faults, the disaster linkage control layer generates an emergency plan based on a knowledge map, and automatic response under a disaster scene is achieved through cross-system linkage.
assignees: KAIFENG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Safety monitoring system and method for coal-fired power plant
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computer programming languages, and particularly discloses a coal-fired power plant safety monitoring system and method. The system comprises a multi-modal data fusion platform, a federal learning agent network and a digital twin simulation engine. The multi-modal data fusion platform realizes semantic mapping based on a knowledge graph and fuses time-space correlation characteristics of data such as infrared images, gas concentration and the like by adopting a space-time encoder and a cross-modal attention mechanism. The method solves the problems of low multisource data dispersion processing efficiency and high early warning delay and false alarm rate caused by insufficient nonlinear association analysis in the traditional scheme, realizes efficient data fusion, accurate complex risk prediction and automatic safety response, and remarkably improves the instantaneity and reliability of the coal-fired power plant monitoring system.
assignees: HUANENG YINGCHENG THERMOELECTRICITY CO LTD

title_en: Electric power system carbon flow calculation method based on extended incidence matrix
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system carbon flow calculation method based on an extended incidence matrix, which comprises the steps of 1) obtaining a power grid topological structure and parameters of a power system to generate a current tracking model, and 2) carrying out power calculation based on the extended incidence matrix on the current tracking model to obtain a power distribution model of a power supply side-line side and a power distribution model of a power supply side-load side. 3) And performing electric carbon coupling calculation on the power distribution model of the power supply side-line side and the power distribution model of the power supply side-load side to obtain a carbon flow calculation result of the electric power system. The invention is not based on any subjectively set proportion distribution principle, but based on a tide result or a state estimation result, realizes carbon tracking and carbon calculation of a unit-line-load, and effectively improves the calculation efficiency.
assignees: SHANXI ENERGY INTERNET RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Gas integrated management system based on large model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-model-based gas integrated management system, and relates to the technical field of gas management. The integrated gas management system based on the large model comprises a gas monitoring module and a gas safety management module. According to the invention, the monitoring frequency is automatically calculated and adjusted according to the gas use mode of a target resident and the real-time state of a gas pipe network, unnecessary data acquisition is reduced, the potential risk to the privacy of a user is reduced, the real-time performance and accuracy of gas data are ensured, the depth fusion and depth analysis of multi-source data are realized by integrating necessary data such as gas concentration, pipeline pressure, valve state and the like and optional data such as environmental sound frequency spectrum and the like by combining a graph attention network and a digital twin model, the comprehensiveness and accuracy of gas safety judgment are improved, and the sensitivity and reliability of gas safety early warning are effectively improved by adopting a multi-level safety early warning mechanism.

title_en: Digital twinning-based wind power equipment fault simulation training method and device
abstract_en: A wind power equipment fault simulation training method and device based on digital twinning comprises the steps of displaying a digital twinning body corresponding to wind power equipment on an equipment simulation interface, constructing and displaying a first virtual fault scene based on the real-time running state of the wind power equipment and the digital twinning body when the real-time running state of the wind power equipment meets fault triggering conditions, evaluating first fault processing operation performed by a user in the first virtual fault scene, and evaluating second fault processing operation performed by the user in the second virtual fault scene based on the selected equipment part, the fault type of the equipment part and the digital twinning body when a fault selection instruction sent by the user after the equipment part to be trained and the fault type of the equipment part are selected on the equipment simulation interface according to training requirements of the user is received. Through various fault simulation scenes of accurate simulation, the training effect of technical staff on processing the faults of the wind power equipment is improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN TUWEI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based power distribution network construction method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for constructing a power distribution network based on digital twinning, and relates to the technical field of power systems; the method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model of the power distribution network based on power distribution network operation link data, optimizing prediction and decision making capability of the digital twin model of the power distribution network, evaluating and verifying, dynamically simulating the whole life cycle of the power distribution network by using the optimized digital twin model of the power distribution network, analyzing the power distribution network operation state in real time and providing an optimized dispatching scheme in the dynamic simulation process of the whole life cycle of the power distribution network, monitoring the power distribution network equipment state in real time, finding hidden trouble, diagnosing the failure cause and providing a repairing scheme. The method also comprises the steps of encrypting the sensitive data, periodically backing up important data, establishing a perfect data recovery mechanism and implementing strict access rights management. The invention can improve the operation efficiency, reliability, safety and intelligent level of the power distribution network.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method for power distribution of energy system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for power distribution of an energy system, which aims to cope with uncertain factors such as market electricity price, load demand, equipment state and the like. The method comprises the steps of dynamically setting upper and lower bounds based on historical data and real-time data, carrying out weighted summation on data gaps through a weighted multi-factor model, and adjusting power distribution. The optimization control algorithm is used for dynamically generating a minimum revenue distribution line, and is adjusted by combining the equipment state, the market electricity price and the load demand through a nonlinear function. By monitoring the state and environmental change of the energy storage device in real time, the charging and discharging strategies are dynamically adjusted, and the maximization of market income, the minimization of energy cost and the stability of the system are realized.
assignees: BEIJING GUODIANTONG NETWORK TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD;ECONOMIC TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Device and method for constructing the flood preventiong digital twin module using the multi-sensor satellite images
title_ko: 다종센서 위성영상을 활용한 침수 대응 디지털 트윈 모듈 구축 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: According to one disclosure, provided is a method for constructing a digital twin module responding to flooding using a multi-sensor satellite image, which comprises the steps of: generating a flooding response terrain model based on a multi-time sar image; generating an impermeable area model based on a multi-spectral satellite image; and constructing a digital twin module responding to flooding by matching the impermeable area model with the flooding response terrain model.
abstract_ko: 일 개시에 의하여 다중시기 SAR 영상에 기초하여 침수대응 지형 모델을 생성하는 단계, 다중분광 위성 영상에 기초하여 불투수 지역 모델을 생성하는 단계 및 침수대응 지형 모델에 불투수 지역 모델을 정합하여, 침수 대응 디지털 트윈 모듈을 구축하는 단계를 포함하는, 다종센서 위성영상을 활용한 침수 대응 디지털 트윈 모듈 구축 방법을 제공할 수 있다.
assignees: GEO C&I CO LTD

title_en: Multi-time scale optimization regulation and control method for multi-energy virtual power plant based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-time scale optimization regulation method of a multi-energy virtual power plant based on digital twinning, which comprises the following steps of obtaining real-time data in a physical scene of the multi-energy virtual power plant, constructing a digital twinning model based on a deep neural network, constructing a dynamic ladder carbon transaction model by considering a carbon transaction reward and punishment mechanism, constructing a three-stage optimization framework of a day-day internal rolling optimization stage-real-time regulation stage based on the digital twinning model and the ladder carbon transaction model, solving the three-stage optimization framework, obtaining regulation instructions and completing a regulation process. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of realizing carbon emission reduction, improving the renewable energy consumption rate and the like.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: Digital twin system of transformer substation based on three-dimensional model and logic model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a transformer substation digital twin system based on a three-dimensional model and a logic model, which comprises a device and environment sensing module, an information network transmission module, an information modeling module, a device monitoring module, a fault analysis and early warning module and an emergency management module. The information modeling module is formed by carrying out association construction on a three-dimensional model and a logic model in a digital coding mode. And establishing a substation total station logic model by using a semantic-based XML configuration file according to the whole architecture information of the substation. The invention realizes the visual representation of the information such as the space layout and the equipment structure of the transformer substation, can comprehensively sense the state of the transformer substation equipment, improves the monitoring and inspection efficiency, can analyze, forecast, quickly locate, early warn and process the faults, and is beneficial to the daily operation and maintenance of the transformer substation.
assignees: CHINA ENERGY ENGINEERING GROUP LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SURVEY & DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for generating plan based on hydrodynamic model
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for generating a plan based on a hydrodynamic model, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining current flood data, determining a pre-stored hydrodynamic model based on the flood data, outputting the current plan corresponding to the current flood data based on a preset multi-objective optimization function, monitoring the flood data in real time, and optimizing the current plan according to the real-time monitoring data. The method can shorten the plan generation time, and can shorten the plan generation time from a traditional manual number of hours to ten minutes based on GPU acceleration and a proxy model. The prediction error of the inundation loss can be reduced through the high-precision hydrodynamic model and real-time data assimilation. Meanwhile, the multi-target conflict is balanced through an optimization algorithm, so that the utilization rate of emergency resources can be improved.
assignees: INSPUR SMART TECH INNOVATION SHANDONG CO LTD

title_en: Pollution source monitoring method and system based on neural network
abstract_en: A pollution source monitoring method and system based on a neural network relate to the technical field of pollution source monitoring, a preset range of a target drinking water source area is divided into a plurality of grid subareas through a GIS (geographic information system) method, water quality monitoring points are arranged in the grid subareas, water quality monitoring data of all the points are obtained, a digital twin model is built, whether a water quality abnormality alarm signal and a water quality abnormality early warning signal are generated or not is judged according to the water quality monitoring results of all the water quality monitoring points, the correlation coefficient of the water quality abnormality early warning signal and a scene subsequence is obtained from all the water quality monitoring points, the pollution source monitoring model is added through the neural network on the basis of the digital twin model, real-time learning is carried out on the pollution source monitoring model, real-time monitoring and control are carried out by utilizing a sewage treatment full-flow model according to the prediction results of the pollution source monitoring model, and effective early warning of sudden water quality pollution events of the drinking water source area in natural disasters and the like is achieved, and pollution monitoring timeliness is guaranteed.
assignees: CHANGCHUN BEIRUIXIN ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Underground pipe network intelligent sensing and safety evaluation system based on urban lifeline
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground pipe network intelligent sensing and safety assessment system based on an urban life line, which relates to the field of intelligent monitoring and management of urban infrastructure, and can be used for comprehensively monitoring and accurately identifying damage to the urban underground pipe network in real time by integrating advanced sensor network, deep learning algorithm, internet of things technology, digital twin model, meteorological data integration and other leading edge technologies, creating a digital copy of the pipe network by combining a machine learning algorithm with a physical model, a statistical method and the application of the digital twin technology, realizing synchronization of virtual and reality, and combining pipe network monitoring data and meteorological short-term forecasting data by using an integrated meteorological risk assessment tool and an integrated early warning system to assess the potential influence of extreme weather on the pipe network and timely send early warning, so that the health monitoring, risk assessment and emergency response capability of the underground pipe network can be remarkably improved, and intelligent management of the urban infrastructure is realized.
assignees: JIANGSU YANGTZE RIVER DELTA SMART WATER RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;XINJIANG WESTERN UNITED DIGITAL IND DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;ZHEJIANG EAST UNITED WATER ENV CO LTD;ZHEJIANG WEIPU ENVIRONMENTAL TECH CO LTD;NANJING WEIPU WATER ENG CO LTD;NANJING WEIGAN IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Sewage plant-oriented carbon neutralization regulation and control method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of design of a carbon neutralization regulation scheme for a sewage plant, in particular to a carbon neutralization regulation method and system for the sewage plant. The method comprises the steps of collecting water quality, energy consumption and gas emission data in real time through a multi-source sensor, inputting a space-time diagram convolution network to predict carbon emission trend after cleaning through an edge computing node, and dynamically optimizing aeration quantity and sludge reflux ratio based on a fuzzy PID controller. And tracking the whole-flow carbon footprint by adopting a life cycle evaluation method, and generating a multi-target compensation strategy by combining an improved NSGA-III algorithm to schedule photovoltaic, biogas and green electricity resources preferentially. And innovatively integrating a digital twin platform and a blockchain certification module, wherein the digital twin platform calibrates model parameters in real time, and the blockchain certification module generates a tamper-proof carbon neutralization certificate. The invention solves the problems of one-sided data, lag in regulation and control and insufficient credibility of the traditional method, and realizes the minute-scale sensing, prediction and counteracting closed-loop control of the carbon emission in the sewage treatment process.
assignees: SHANDONG ENVIRONMENTAL PROT DEVELOPMENT GROUP ENVIRONMENT HOSPITAL CO LTD

title_en: Power consumption analysis method and system based on non-invasive load identification technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a power consumption analysis method and a power consumption analysis system based on a non-invasive load identification technology. The method comprises the steps of collecting load data through a non-invasive measurement switch or an intelligent ammeter, constructing a power consumption load digital twin model, establishing a bidirectional mapping relation between high-frequency real-time data and the digital twin model, preprocessing the load data, including denoising, time synchronization and normalization, extracting key features from the preprocessed load data, feeding back by the digital twin model, dynamically training and optimally adjusting a neural network model, identifying a decomposition result of each load by using the trained model, evaluating the decomposition result of the load, carrying out load identification on the collected real-time load data, and carrying out multidimensional analysis on power consumption behaviors of users. The invention combines the non-invasive load identification technology with the digital twin technology, improves the power consumption analysis capability by utilizing high frequency data, optimizes the identification model, improves the identification precision and can deeply analyze the power consumption behavior.
assignees: QINGDA ZHINENG BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power plant anti-misoperation monitoring optimization method and related system based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power plant error-monitoring-prevention optimization method based on deep reinforcement learning and a related system, wherein the power plant error-monitoring-prevention optimization method based on deep reinforcement learning comprises a data preprocessing module, an environment simulation module and a detection intelligent agent module. Firstly, sensor data of states of secondary power transformation equipment such as a disconnecting link and the like in a power grid are obtained in a data preprocessing module, standardized processing is carried out on the data, and the data are transmitted to a next module to form a data set for model training. The environment simulation module and the detection agent module form a core of deep reinforcement learning. The environment simulation module provides a simulated environment for interaction with the agent, and reads a device state change event consisting of a series of related sensor readings to extract a feature set. The detection intelligent body internally comprises a power plant secondary power transformation equipment state false detection prevention model, and is mainly responsible for judging the equipment state of an input sensor and adjusting the model according to a feedback result of a simulation environment. The invention can optimize the real-time updated power plant error-prevention monitoring by detecting the continuous interactive circulation of the intelligent agent and the environment simulation to continuously update the model.
assignees: HUATIAN POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent supply chain optimization decision-making system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based intelligent supply chain optimization decision-making system, which relates to the technical field of ERP (Enterprise resource planning), and comprises the steps of acquiring detailed data and interactive data of each link of a supply chain through a multi-channel supply chain digital twinning construction module, constructing a whole digital twinning model of the supply chain by utilizing a graph convolution network and a K-means clustering algorithm, monitoring the running condition of each link in real time by a supply chain risk monitoring module, identifying risk links and evaluating risk grades, simultaneously determining the association links and association tightness of the risk links, formulating and executing an optimization decision-making scheme by a decision-making and executing module according to the related data of the risk links and the association links by using a support vector machine and other technologies, covering production plan adjustment, inventory allocation, logistics route optimization and supplier cooperation strategy change, intuitively displaying the whole digital twinning model of the supply chain and executing condition and effect feedback of the optimization decision-making scheme by a visual presentation module, realizing the fine intelligent management of the supply chain, and improving the efficiency of the supply chain.
assignees: HONGSHANG TECH GUANGZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Fire disaster early warning method and system based on three-dimensional modeling
abstract_en: The application provides a fire early warning method and a fire early warning system based on three-dimensional modeling, which can be used for determining abnormal indexes of fire hazards at different space units through spatial structural features of a three-dimensional digital twin model and state evolution modes of a physical field, further determining a risk cloud picture through all abnormal indexes, extracting a risk subdomain of a fire according to the risk cloud picture, further generating a heat flow density field matrix among different space units, determining risk fitness of different space units through heat flow diffusion information and monitoring information of fire conditions in a target building, carrying out time sequence aggregation on the fire risks in the target building according to all the risk fitness and combining the local temperature fields of each space unit, obtaining fire hazard propagation potential energy, carrying out fire diffusion situation monitoring on the target building according to the fire hazard propagation potential energy, and outputting a fire diffusion early warning signal. By adopting the scheme of the application, the diffusion track of the fire heat flow can be accurately identified in the three-dimensional model.
assignees: FUJIAN VOCATIONAL COLLEGE AGRICULTURE

title_en: Method and system for analyzing reasons of coal mine gas explosion accidents
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a system for analyzing reasons of coal mine gas explosion accidents, and belongs to the technical field of gas explosion accident prevention. The method comprises the steps of collecting report information of historical gas explosion accidents, performing structuring processing on the report information based on a predetermined reason classification frame to obtain structured information, constructing a corresponding accident three-dimensional network model based on the structured information, determining attribute information of each node in the accident three-dimensional network model, analyzing occurrence reasons of the corresponding gas explosion accidents based on the attribute information of each node to obtain analysis results of each analysis index, constructing a corresponding explosion accident self-checking and preventing list based on the analysis results of each analysis index, and pushing the explosion accident self-checking and preventing list to a user side. The scheme of the invention realizes the real-time updating and accurate implementation of accident prevention measures, and provides high-efficiency and feasible technical support for coal mine safety management.
assignees: STATE POWER ECONOMIC RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Online updating method for intelligent energy management strategy of online fuel cell bus
abstract_en: The invention provides an online updating method of an intelligent energy management strategy of a network-connected fuel cell bus, which integrates the ideas of knowledge migration and strategy multiplexing on the basis of deep reinforcement learning, can fully utilize the results of continuous station intervals in model training, realizes the efficient online updating of the intelligent energy management strategy of the whole bus route, and improves the relevance between the energy management executed by the strategy and multi-element traffic information, thereby remarkably improving the accuracy and long-term optimization performance of the strategy.
assignees: BEIJING INSTITUTE TECH

title_en: Wind-solar energy storage optimal configuration method and system
abstract_en: A wind-solar energy storage optimal configuration method and a system relate to the technical field of energy storage optimization, and are used for acquiring wind-solar energy storage digital twin models of all solar photovoltaic power generation energy storage units and all wind-solar power generation energy storage units which run in real time in the wind-solar energy storage process and dynamic models of all wind-solar power generation energy storage units within preset time, acquiring predicted power generation power of all instantiation three-dimensional models and capacity of a prepared battery pack, and carrying out double-layer fuzzy energy storage control on charge and discharge power of the battery pack of all instantiation three-dimensional models according to the power fluctuation when the real-time power fluctuation of all instantiation three-dimensional models within preset time does not meet preset standards in the wind-solar energy storage digital twin models, acquiring real-time charge and discharge power of all instantiation three-dimensional models within preset time, and carrying out timely fluctuation suppression on the output power of the wind-solar energy storage unit when abnormal fluctuation is generated by utilizing fuzzy control, so that load power fluctuation is reduced, overcharging or overdischarging of an energy storage battery is avoided, and the service life of the energy storage battery is more beneficial to be maintained.
assignees: ZHONGHONGJI CHANGCHUN ENERGY STORAGE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Civil construction engineering cost evaluation optimizing system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cost evaluation, in particular to a civil construction engineering cost evaluation optimization system which comprises a characteristic analysis module, a cost evaluation module, a real-time monitoring module, a model training and optimizing module, a risk analysis module, a decision support module, a financial simulation module and a reinforcement learning cost adjustment module. In the invention, a convolutional neural network algorithm and a principal component analysis method in a feature analysis module are used for mining building information model data, key features are screened, a cost estimation module is combined with a multi-layer perceptron neural network and a linear regression model, the cost mode analysis capability is enhanced, the project cost is calculated, a digital twin technology and a dynamic programming algorithm are used for realizing the tracking of project progress and the real-time monitoring of cost change in a real-time monitoring module, a genetic algorithm and a machine learning algorithm are used for realizing the continuous optimization and self-learning of model parameters in a model training and optimizing module, and a Monte Carlo simulation method and a sensitivity analysis method are used for identifying and evaluating project risks in a risk analysis module.
assignees: WUHAN ZHIERXING ENG DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Power equipment predictive maintenance method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a predictive maintenance method of electric equipment based on digital twinning, which comprises the following steps of collecting time sequence operation data of each electric equipment in an electric power system in real time, preprocessing, updating a built digital twinning model integrated with LSTM in real time based on the preprocessed time sequence operation data to obtain a latest digital twinning model which operates synchronously with a physical entity of the electric equipment, carrying out fault prediction by adopting an isolated forest algorithm and the latest digital twinning model based on the time sequence operation data to obtain a fault prediction result, determining a plurality of maintenance schemes based on the fault prediction result, evaluating each maintenance scheme to obtain an optimal maintenance scheme, and completing a predictive maintenance process. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of improving the reliability and safety of the power equipment and the like.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG;STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Mine disaster early warning method and system based on machine learning
abstract_en: The application relates to a mine disaster early warning method and system based on machine learning.
