The method comprises the steps of detecting node response time based on a periodic heartbeat signal to obtain a failure node list, actively sending the periodic heartbeat signal by a control node to indicate all nodes to feed back the node response time, wherein the failure node list is used for representing failed nodes in a network topology graph, calculating an optimal path through a Q-learning algorithm based on the failure node list and the real-time network topology graph to obtain an optimal communication path table, synchronizing early warning information through improvement Raft protocol based on the optimal communication path table to obtain a global consistent early warning information set, planning an optimal escape route based on the global consistent early warning information set and a three-dimensional digital twin model of a mine to obtain an early warning instruction set, and sending the early warning instruction set to an escape terminal. The method can achieve the effect of rapidly agreeing the early warning information in the topological network and dynamically adjusting the escape route.
assignees: SHAANXI SHANMEI CAOJIATAN MINING CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic landslide early warning method and device based on landslide physical model and data assimilation
abstract_en: The dynamic landslide early warning method and device based on the landslide physical model and data assimilation belong to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning, and can dynamically and accurately and timely perform landslide early warning on a monitored area. According to the technical scheme, a landslide physical model for predicting a landslide safety coefficient and a machine learning model for predicting landslide displacement are corrected by adopting a data assimilation technology, so that a landslide safety coefficient threshold value and a landslide displacement rate ratio threshold value are dynamically adjusted, the landslide safety coefficient and the landslide displacement of a predicted landslide body are subjected to multi-model fusion, a landslide early warning index of a monitoring area is generated, and landslide early warning is carried out according to the landslide early warning index.
assignees: UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY

title_en: River flood early warning method based on remote sensing
abstract_en: The invention provides a river flood early warning method based on remote sensing, and relates to the technical field of remote sensing monitoring. The river flood early warning method based on remote sensing comprises data acquisition and preprocessing, wherein the data acquisition comprises remote sensing image acquisition, meteorological data acquisition and geographic information system data acquisition, a high-resolution remote sensing image of a target area is acquired through satellite remote sensing and unmanned aerial vehicle means, the high-resolution remote sensing image mainly comprises precipitation, surface water and soil humidity, meteorological data of the target area are collected, short-term meteorological prediction is carried out by combining a meteorological prediction model, and relevant geographic information data of river topography, river basin area and vegetation coverage rate are acquired. By means of real-time updating of remote sensing images, meteorological data and hydrologic models, weather changes and water level rising can be reflected rapidly, the system can dynamically monitor before, during and after flood occurrence, timely capture of information such as water level, precipitation and earth surface changes, and more accurate prediction and decision support are provided.
assignees: JIANGSU WATER CONSERVANCY SCI RES INST

title_en: Cloud platform-based substation maintenance implementation full-flow intelligent management and control system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a cloud platform-based substation maintenance implementation full-flow intelligent management and control system and a cloud platform-based substation maintenance implementation full-flow intelligent management and control method, belonging to the technical field of intelligent power grid operation and maintenance, wherein the system comprises an acquisition layer, a data layer, a management layer, an information layer and a presentation layer; the acquisition layer comprises a scheme input module, an image acquisition module, a positioning module and an electromagnetic fingerprint acquisition module, and is used for constructing a digital twin overhaul template and acquiring multi-source data, the data layer comprises an intelligent image auditing module, a multi-source positioning compensation module and an electromagnetic fingerprint matching module, and is used for realizing fusion analysis and error compensation of the multi-source data, the management layer comprises a dynamic authority control module and a positioning state decision module, and is used for distributing equipment operation authorities based on biological characteristics and electromagnetic safety parameters, the information layer comprises a dynamic path planning module and an evaluation alarm module, and is used for generating an optimal operation path and triggering multi-stage safety alarm, and the presentation layer realizes visual interaction and alarm prompt through a terminal interface.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD SUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH

title_en: Distribution network fault rush repair full-flow visual tracking method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a distribution network fault rush-repair complete flow visual tracking method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps of establishing a multi-source data acquisition system, acquiring rush-repair personnel biological characteristic data, environment parameters, vehicle positioning information and material RFID tag data in real time through intelligent terminal equipment, establishing a three-dimensional visual digital twin platform, integrating a GIS geographic information system, a BIM power grid model and a real-time dynamic data layer, deploying edge computing nodes for data preprocessing, reducing transmission bandwidth requirements by adopting a time sequence compression algorithm, establishing a dynamic resource optimization model, planning a rush-repair path and allocating resources based on a Markov decision process, realizing intelligent perception of security situation, analyzing personnel behavior video streams through a neural network model, and early warning illegal operation in real time.
assignees: XIAMEN EPGIS INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic update multi-source heterogeneous power user portrayal method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for dynamically updating multi-source heterogeneous power user portraits, which relate to the technical field of power user portraits, and comprise the steps of collecting multi-source data, preprocessing the collected data, carrying out feature splicing and weight adjustment on the preprocessed multi-source data, mapping features of different data sources to the same embedded space, carrying out dimension reduction and noise filtration on fused high-dimensional features, extracting user features, carrying out time sequence modeling, generating a dynamic user portraits based on the dimension reduction core features and time sequence modeling results, carrying out real-time updating on the user portraits, optimizing user portraits feature parameters according to user behavior feedback, and displaying the change and the dynamic of the user portraits. The invention displays the change and the dynamic state of the user portrait through the chart, helps the power company to provide more personalized service, and promotes the environmental protection and the improvement of energy efficiency.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Ship management method and system based on digital twin scene construction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ship management method and system based on digital twin scene construction. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multisource scene data of a target water area in real time, constructing a corresponding ship management digital twin model, carrying out integrity assessment on the constructed digital twin model, carrying out defect compensation according to assessment results to obtain an optimized digital twin model, further collecting ship density and weather condition data of all subareas of the target water area, constructing a network transmission delay prediction model, analyzing relevant data based on the model, generating a network delay coefficient distribution map of the target water area, determining real-time updating hysteresis of all subunits of the optimized model according to the delay distribution map, and correcting ship position information in the digital twin model accordingly. The method can remarkably improve the instantaneity and accuracy of the digital twin model, and enhance the operation management efficiency and safety of the ship in the complex water area environment.

title_en: Multi-dimensional heterogeneous data targeting risk causal reasoning method for whole cereal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-dimensional heterogeneous data targeted risk causal reasoning method for whole cereal food, which is suitable for grain safety early warning. In order to solve the problems of large quantity of missing of spot check data and lack of omnibearing target risk early warning in the whole cereal risk early warning, the method constructs a whole cereal risk index system comprising attribute information indexes and hazard indexes, acquires detection data based on index items, cleans the detection data, fills up missing data based on a generated countermeasure network, calculates the weight of indexes in the hazard index system by using an entropy weight method, determines the risk value of a secondary index and a primary index of each sample, then carries out whole cereal multidimensional heterogeneous data label coding and risk level analysis, and finally carries out whole cereal risk target cause and effect reasoning based on a Bayesian network. The invention improves the accuracy and the credibility of the spot check data, characterizes the risk degree of the whole cereal food, improves the causal reasoning precision and can realize the dynamic risk early warning.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING TECHNOLOGY & BUSINESS

title_en: Converter station in-station equipment energy consumption analysis model and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a converter station in-station equipment energy consumption analysis model and a converter station in-station equipment energy consumption analysis method. Belongs to the field of converter station equipment energy consumption analysis. The method establishes a three-dimensional data acquisition system covering the total station equipment, acquires the electrical measurement data of the equipment in real time through a monitoring system, and captures a converter valve trigger pulse, a cooling water pump rotating speed regulating signal and a breaker opening and closing state through an equipment digital twin interface. And carrying out real-time feature extraction by relying on the edge computing nodes, and triggering high-speed data recording for commutation failure events. Abnormal data is corrected through a sliding window dynamic cleaning mechanism and a wavelet threshold denoising algorithm, and current harmonic distortion rate, voltage fluctuation coefficient and equipment vibration frequency spectrum characteristics are extracted. Further establishing a multidimensional feature matrix containing equipment operation conditions, environment parameters and power grid interaction characteristics, predicting energy consumption by using the hybrid model, generating a dynamic energy efficiency evaluation index, and applying the dynamic energy efficiency evaluation index to energy saving strategy optimization.
assignees: DALI BUREAU OF ULTRA HIGH VOLTAGE TRANS COMPANY CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID COMPANY LIMITED

title_en: Intelligent cooperative working method and system for coal mine equipment of mine hong Meng operating system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of coal mine intellectualization, in particular to a coal mine equipment intelligent cooperative working method and a system thereof of a mine hong Meng operating system, comprising the steps of acquiring model data, running state data and environment data of the coal mine equipment; the method comprises the steps of establishing a multi-dimensional digital model of coal mine equipment based on acquired data, processing the data of the coal mine equipment through a three-layer architecture, wherein the data comprises a data acquisition layer, an equipment modeling layer and a service modeling layer, realizing safe networking and data transmission between the coal mine equipment based on a soft bus technology, realizing intelligent cooperative control and safety monitoring early warning of the coal mine equipment based on processing results, realizing accurate digital twin expression of complex equipment of the coal mine through a multi-dimensional equipment modeling method, solving the problem of non-uniform data format among different equipment, laying a foundation for equipment cooperation, and realizing continuous conversion from physical signals to service values through a three-layer architecture data processing mechanism.
assignees: JINNENG HOLDING EQUIPMENT MFG GROUP CO LTD SIHE COAL MINE;CHONGQING GUANGKEXUN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Shipping goods stability risk identification method and system based on large model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shipping goods stability risk identification method and system based on a large model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: and formulating a cargo counterweight scheme according to the acquired first cargo counterweight information and second cargo counterweight information, simulating the transportation process of a shipping carrier for loading cargoes according to the cargo counterweight scheme in a water body by utilizing a digital twin technology, outputting first cargo stability data and second cargo stability data, analyzing the stability state of the cargoes under the current cargo counterweight scheme according to the first cargo stability data and the second cargo stability data, outputting a stability state analysis result and a stability state related index, and further determining the cargo instability risk level. According to the invention, a cargo counterweight scheme is formulated through cargo counterweight information, cargo stability data is acquired after a transportation process is simulated, cargo stability states are analyzed in real time, a cargo counterweight adjustment strategy is output, and meanwhile, a corresponding specific operation scheme is generated by utilizing powerful reasoning and optimizing capabilities of a large model, so that the safety and efficiency of cargo transportation are improved.
assignees: ANRUI DIGITAL TECH BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Marine wind power monitoring system, method and device based on marine energy mutual fusion standard system
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a marine wind power monitoring system, a method and a device based on a marine energy mutual fusion standard system, which comprise a data acquisition layer and a digital twin service platform, wherein the data acquisition layer is used for acquiring dynamic signals in real time and temperature and strain change data, the digital twin service platform is used for carrying out data interaction with the data acquisition layer and is used for realizing unified management, real-time interaction and intelligent decision of multi-source equipment data through standardized data model definition, high concurrency communication middleware design and virtual-real fusion simulation optimization mechanisms based on the digital twin service platform according to the digital twin service platform, and the problem of data island and response delay of a traditional centralized architecture is broken through.
assignees: UNIV GUANGDONG TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Port cargo intelligent scheduling system and method based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a port cargo intelligent dispatching system and a port cargo intelligent dispatching method based on big data analysis, and relates to the technical field of port cargo dispatching data processing. The system comprises an environment acquisition and evaluation module, a first comparison analysis calling module of the cargo intelligent scheduling distributed computing node and a second comparison analysis calling module of the cargo intelligent scheduling distributed computing node. According to the intelligent closed-loop optimization system for the environment-equipment-computing power through cargo environment monitoring optimization, equipment operation efficiency optimization and computing resource dynamic allocation, the intelligent closed-loop optimization system is formed, and through the sensing layer data acquisition of the Internet of things, digital twin modeling and edge cloud computing, the comprehensive efficiency improvement from a physical infrastructure to a digital decision system of port operation is further realized, and the problem that in the prior art, the distributed scheduling environment adaptation response accuracy of the port cargo intelligent scheduling system under extreme weather is insufficient is solved.

title_en: New energy consumption software model construction method based on simulation platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of new energy power systems, and discloses a new energy consumption software model construction method based on a simulation platform, which comprises the steps of firstly dividing new energy consumption system units, determining topological structures and operation parameters of the new energy consumption system units, and constructing a multi-physical field coupling simulation model; and then, carrying out distributed parallel solution on the model, defining a global optimization target, constructing a joint optimization model and a network reconstruction model, respectively adopting a deep reinforcement learning algorithm and a graph neural network optimization, generating an optimization scheme through multi-agent cooperation, verifying whether the optimization target is converged, outputting control parameters if the optimization target is converged, otherwise, updating optimization variables to continue optimization, and finally, importing the optimization parameters into a digital twin platform calibration model of an integrated block chain technology and adjusting super parameters. The method improves the accuracy of the new energy consumption system model, optimizes the system operation, enhances the cooperative stability, and promotes the efficient utilization of new energy and the sustainable development of the power system.

title_en: Photovoltaic cleaning decision method and system based on time sequence feature fusion and marginal benefit optimization
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent energy, in particular to a photovoltaic clean decision method and system based on time sequence feature fusion and marginal benefit optimization. By fusing short-term weather forecast, long-term fouling rules and equipment state data, adopting GAN complement missing data, designing an economical constraint rewarding function to realize dynamic cost and benefit balance, and combining an edge-cloud cooperative framework to improve instantaneity and iteration efficiency. The application can obviously reduce the cleaning frequency, promote the annual net income, simultaneously maintain high robustness in extreme weather, and is suitable for the operation and maintenance management of large-scale photovoltaic power stations in the regions with multiple sand storm.
assignees: SCEI DISTRIBUTED ENERGY SYSTEMS CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent power distribution network line state real-time monitoring, analyzing and evaluating system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time monitoring, analyzing and evaluating system for the line state of an intelligent power distribution network, which relates to the technical field of power system monitoring and control, and has the advantages that the intelligent power distribution network line monitoring and evaluating system is constructed, data are collected in multiple dimensions, characteristics are extracted by edge calculation, data are screened, a dynamic threshold model is constructed by cloud and abnormal conditions are identified, and a power grid topology modeling generating device is a topology fingerprint and an association weight matrix, and the intelligent power distribution network line monitoring and evaluating system has the advantages that: the three-dimensional digital twin network is constructed based on GIS data and the SCADA system through the power grid topology modeling module, unique topology fingerprints containing electrical connection, physical position and logic control relation are generated for each device, an upstream and downstream device list, a load influence range and a power flow transfer path are marked, and the correlation state evaluation module adopts a graph convolution neural network, so that the electrical coupling, physical proximity and historical fault correlation effect among the devices can be accurately captured.
assignees: STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CORP DINGXI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Digital twinning-oriented power grid dynamic ontology modeling method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-oriented power grid dynamic ontology modeling method and a digital twinning-oriented power grid dynamic ontology modeling system, relates to the technical field of power grid dynamic ontologies, and aims to solve the problem of inaccurate power grid dynamic modeling. According to the invention, through the visualized power grid dynamic model, a worker can more intuitively see the operation data of the power grid, so that potential problems and risks can be found more easily. The method is beneficial to the staff to make decisions in time, corresponding measures are taken to ensure safe and stable operation of the power grid, after the interactive technology is added, the staff can perform interactive operation with the visual model through input equipment such as a mouse, a keyboard and the like, and the data analysis tool is utilized to analyze the test result, so that error data in the model can be efficiently identified and diagnosed. The intelligent method improves the accuracy and efficiency of error identification, and is helpful for quick positioning and solving the problems.
assignees: SHAOGUAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent fuel monitoring system and method for thermal power plant through big data analysis and early warning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of thermal power generation, in particular to an intelligent fuel monitoring system and method for a thermal power plant by big data analysis and early warning, comprising a multi-mode data sensing module, a layered reinforced decision module, a real-time early warning and evaluation unit and a digital twin decision center; the multi-modal data perception module is used for constructing a fuel digital twin body, the layering reinforcement decision module is used for constructing a double-loop intelligent decision system to conduct layering optimization and full life cycle management, the real-time early warning and evaluation unit is used for acquiring data, carrying out deep mining by combining reinforcement learning algorithm, identifying risks, dynamically adjusting early warning threshold values, grading the risks, and the digital twin decision center virtually deducts the risks by means of a digital twin model, generates a target strategy by means of a multi-target optimization algorithm, ensures traceability of instructions, and dynamically adjusts the strategy according to the real-time data. Therefore, the problems of limited data processing capacity, low model adaptability and the like in the prior art are solved.
assignees: HUADIAN ZOUXIAN POWER GENERATION CO LTD;ZOUXIAN POWER PLANT OF HUADIAN POWER INTERNATIONAL CORPORATION LTD

title_en: Electric energy control method and device, electronic equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric energy control method and device, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of electric power, wherein the method comprises the steps of predicting first electric quantity of a power supply trunk circuit based on a target digital twin model to obtain second electric quantity of the power supply trunk circuit, wherein the first electric quantity is electric quantity of a target area in a current preset time period, and the second electric quantity is predicted electric quantity of the target area in a future target time period; the method comprises the steps of determining an initial power utilization control strategy for distributing electric energy to a plurality of power supply branches by a power supply main circuit based on a first difference value, wherein the first difference value is a difference value between second power consumption and rated power consumption of the power supply main circuit, and adjusting the initial power utilization control strategy based on a Q learning algorithm to obtain a target power utilization control strategy. The electric energy control method and device, the electronic equipment and the readable storage medium can improve the accuracy of electric energy control, so that the occurrence of electric energy waste is reduced.
assignees: BEIJING HONGHU YIYUN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Hydropower station safety management method and device based on sensor network
abstract_en: The application discloses a hydropower station safety management method and device based on a sensor network, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model of a hydropower station, simulating different directional sensor node layout schemes and determining an optimal throwing strategy; according to an optimal delivery strategy, a plurality of directed sensor nodes are randomly delivered in a hydropower station to-be-monitored area to obtain an initial arrangement scheme, the initial arrangement scheme is optimized based on a genetic algorithm to obtain a target arrangement scheme, the directed sensor nodes in the target arrangement scheme are activated, current operation information is collected through the activated directed sensor nodes, a multidimensional equipment knowledge graph is constructed, the operation trend of hydropower station equipment is predicted by combining the current operation information, a potential fault chain is identified based on the operation trend, and hydropower station safety pre-warning and safety decision are performed. According to the application, the safety early warning and decision making are carried out by introducing the current operation information of the sensor network acquisition equipment, so that the safety management efficiency and accuracy of the hydropower station are effectively improved.
assignees: WUHAN LIHUA ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus and method for dynamic imputation method for time-series PV power generation
title_ko: 태양광 발전 시계열 데이터 결측치의 동적 처리 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and a method for dynamically processing missing values of solar power generation time series data. The present invention comprises: a raw data generation unit for generating raw data by collecting a solar power generation amount from a solar power plant by time; an identification unit for identifying a missing time based on the raw data; a power generation amount estimation unit for estimating the solar power generation amount corresponding to the missing time; and a processing data generation unit for generating processing data by adding the estimated solar power generation amount and the missing time to the raw data.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 태양광 발전 시계열 데이터 결측치의 동적 처리 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 
태양광 발전소로부터 태양광 발전량을 시간 별로 수집하여 미가공 데이터를 생성하는 미가공 데이터 생성부; 상기 미가공 데이터에 기반하여 누락된 시간을 식별하는 식별부; 상기 누락된 시간에 상응하는 상기 태양광 발전량을 추정하는 발전량 추정부; 및 상기 미가공 데이터에 상기 추정된 태양광 발전량 및 상기 누락된 시간을 추가하여 가공 데이터를 생성하는 가공 데이터 생성부를 포함한다.
assignees: UNIV KOOKMIN IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Disaster safety service apparatus, and supporting method for disaster safety
title_ko: 재난안전서비스장치 및 재난 안전 지원 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a digital twin-based disaster safety support method.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 디지털 트윈(Digital Twin) 기반의 재난 안전 지원 방안에 관한 것이다.
assignees: NAVIWORKS CO LTD

title_en: Digital platform for operating virtual nuclear power plant by using digital twin
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 기술을 이용한 가상 원전 운영 디지털 플랫폼
abstract_en: The virtual nuclear power plant operation digital platform using the digital twin technology comprises the crustaceous nuclear power plant: crustaceous air conditioning system controller: crustaceous sensor unit: simulation matter: and control unit. The present invention constructs a digital twin-based three-dimensional virtual nuclear power plant to predict the operation of the nuclear power plant, reflect it in decision-making, and efficiently optimize the design and air conditioning system.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 디지털 트윈 기술을 이용하여, 격납건물의 각 격실, 보조건물의 주제어실, 터빈건물의 터빈실, 공조기와 환기팬과 냉방기 및 원전연료건물을 3차원 모델로 디지털모델링하고, 운영에 따른 터빈과 공조기와 환기팬과 냉방기의 동작이 구현된, 가상의 원자력 발전소(110), 원자력 발전소(110)의 공조기와 환기팬과 냉방기의 온도 및 유동을 제어하는 가상의 공조설비 제어부(120), 공조기와 환기팬과 냉방기의 온도와 유동을 각각 감지하고, 화재를 감지하는 가상의 센서부(130), 원자력 발전소(110)의 설비의 운영정보에 상응하여 미리설정된 운영시나리오에 따라 원자력 발전소(110)의 운영을 가상으로 다차원 시뮬레이션하는 시뮬레이션부(140), 및 운영시나리오를 설정하고, 시뮬레이션부(140)에 의한 운영에 따른 시뮬레이션 결과를 제공하며, 센서부(130)가 구현된 각 구역별로 센서부(130)의 각 계측값을 모니터링하며 가시화하고, CFD(Computational Fluid Dynamics) 분석하여서, 설계 기준값과 계측값 사이의 차이를 보정하여 최적화하고, 화재 발생시 스모크 거동을 예측하는, 관제부(150)를 포함하여, 실체계의 원자력 발전소의 운영을 예측하고 최적화하는, 디지털 트윈 기술을 이용한 가상 원전 운영 디지털 플랫폼을 개시한다.
assignees: ILJOO GNS CO LTD;ELSOLTEC

title_en: Hydraulic engineering operation and maintenance management system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The application provides a digital twinning-based hydraulic engineering operation and maintenance management system, which relates to the technical field of operation and maintenance management and comprises a hydrologic sensitive point screening module, a hydraulic control module and a hydraulic control module, wherein the hydrologic sensitive point screening module screens a finite element stress hot spot and a hydrologic sensitive point of a target hydraulic engineering; the sensor layout module is used for carrying out multi-mode sensor layout; the system comprises a twin model construction module, a comparison loss value set determination module, a reverse mapping module, an asynchronous sampling module, an operation and maintenance management scheme identification module, a multi-modal sensor network, a comparison loss analysis module, a multi-modal sensor network and an asynchronous sampling module, wherein the twin model construction module pushes real-time data to a digital twin synchronous engine, the comparison loss analysis module performs comparison loss analysis on the real-time digital twin model and a historical digital twin model which is synchronously constructed last time, the reverse mapping module performs reverse mapping on the multi-modal sensor network, and the asynchronous sampling module performs asynchronous sampling on the multi-modal sensor network and performs operation and maintenance management scheme identification. The application can solve the technical problem that the sampling frequency can not be adaptively adjusted according to real-time change in the prior art, realize the technical aim of intelligent sampling of the multi-mode sensor and achieve the technical effect of improving the key data acquisition precision.
assignees: SHANDONG WISETION INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network pseudo measurement modeling generation method, state estimation method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network pseudo measurement modeling generation method, a state estimation method, a device and equipment, which comprise the steps of inputting a node characteristic matrix, an edge characteristic matrix and an adjacent matrix in a multi-section historical diagram data set into a pseudo measurement model of a power distribution network to determine a prediction pseudo measurement value; the method comprises the steps of updating target parameters of a pseudo measurement model based on a predicted pseudo measurement value and a real pseudo measurement value, repeating the steps until a trained pseudo measurement model is obtained, determining a node model of each node and an edge model of each edge through each hidden layer through the pseudo measurement model, determining an initial graph embedding vector based on the node model and the edge model, and processing the initial graph embedding vector through a graph pooling layer and a full connection layer to determine the predicted pseudo measurement value. The invention determines the prediction pseudo measurement value based on the node model and the side model, thereby realizing the prediction of the power injection pseudo measurement of the node which is not equipped with the power measurement equipment or the measurement data missing node.
assignees: NANJING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power grid toughness assessment method in extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid toughness assessment method under extreme weather, which relates to the related field of power grid monitoring, and comprises the steps of configuring a backtracking period, backtracking historical meteorological data and establishing an extreme weather database; the method comprises the steps of accessing a power grid system, constructing a topological structure of the power grid according to an access result, carrying out key node identification based on the topological structure and power grid data, utilizing digital twinning to establish a key node set, constructing an extreme weather simulation scene based on an extreme weather database, carrying out node response test of the key node set, establishing a node test database, constructing a power grid toughness assessment index, carrying out response assessment on the node test database by using the power grid toughness assessment index, outputting a power grid toughness assessment result according to the response assessment result, and carrying out power grid management by using the power grid toughness assessment result. The method solves the technical problems of comprehensiveness and insufficient accuracy of the existing power grid toughness assessment method in extreme weather, and achieves the technical effects of improving the assessment accuracy and comprehensiveness.

title_en: Wind field unit comparison type fault diagnosis method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wind power generation. A method, a system, a device and a storage medium for comparative fault diagnosis of a wind farm unit are provided. The method comprises the steps of synchronously obtaining running and corresponding environment data of the same wind field and the same machine set, establishing a multidimensional data set, establishing a normal working condition multidimensional parameter reference model by using cluster analysis and updating in real time, comparing a target with a reference machine set in a multiscale manner, extracting characteristics and fusing to generate a comprehensive health index, establishing a double-layer diagnosis model, constructing a virtual machine set based on digital twin, positioning potential fault sources by contrast residual errors, detecting outliers by using an improved isolated forest algorithm, determining a fault propagation path by combining association rules, establishing a fault mode knowledge base, and triggering an early warning mechanism according to the comprehensive health index and fault mode classification. The method solves the problems that the fault of the traditional operation and maintenance mode is difficult to predict, the cost is high, a reliable evaluation system is lacked, the state monitoring is limited to single parameters, the multi-unit comparison analysis means is insufficient, and the fault diagnosis is lagged.
assignees: HUANENG DINGBIAN NEW ENERGY POWER GENERATION CO LTD;HUANENG SHAANXI ZICHANG POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: River channel water condition forecasting method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water regime forecasting, in particular to a river channel water regime forecasting method and system based on digital twinning. The method comprises the steps of distributing sensor nodes along a river channel, carrying out real-time monitoring on the river channel environment water conditions along the river channel to obtain river channel along-line water level real-time data, river channel along-line flow real-time data and river channel along-line weather real-time data, carrying out digital twin construction and risk prediction division on the river channel along-line to generate a river channel water condition flood risk prediction period and a river channel water condition drought risk prediction period, carrying out flood risk prediction processing under the river channel water condition flood risk prediction period to execute corresponding river channel water condition flood risk management decision work, and carrying out drought risk prediction processing under the river channel water condition drought risk prediction period to execute corresponding river channel water condition drought risk management decision work. The invention can realize efficient and accurate water regime prediction and decision support.
assignees: PEARL RIVER HYDRAULIC RES INST PEARL RIVER WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION;GUANGZHOU HUANGPU WATER FACILITIES MAN OFFICE

title_en: Communication base station electric power safety monitoring alarm system based on internet of things technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a communication base station electric power safety monitoring alarm system based on the technology of the Internet of things, which relates to the technical field of the electric power safety monitoring of the communication base station of the Internet of things, and is characterized in that a multi-mode sensing fusion and self-calibration sensor for data acquisition is used for accurately acquiring electric power data, the transmission is combined with mixed encryption and self-adaptive dormancy by terahertz communication, so that the safety and low consumption are ensured, the analysis is aided by edge intelligence and federal learning, the diagnosis is aided by a knowledge graph, the alarm is provided with a dynamic threshold and intelligent linkage, and the equipment management relies on digital twin and block chains, so that the whole life cycle of the equipment is ensured to run stably. The intelligent power system and the intelligent power system collect accurate power data, perform high-speed safe transmission and intelligent analysis and processing, realize multistage linkage alarm, remotely control equipment, monitor and prevent faults in linkage environment, comprehensively ensure the power safety of a communication base station and improve the communication stability.
assignees: SHANXI TONGDA MICROWAVE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Shortest considerable path searching method and system based on measurement distribution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shortest considerable path searching method and a shortest considerable path searching system based on measurement distribution, wherein the shortest considerable path searching method comprises the steps of selecting a concerned node, searching outwards from the concerned node, traversing the whole power grid, and carrying out measurement distribution on searched branches according to the existing measurement configuration of the power grid; and (3) based on the measurement distribution result, determining the measurement margin of each branch, the corresponding shortest search number and the target node, and establishing a margin table of the branches, merging and supplementing the margin tables of the branches from the branch at the tail end according to the shortest considerable path principle until the margin table of the concerned node is obtained, and based on the margin table of the concerned node, obtaining the shortest considerable path. The invention can find the shortest considerable path including the concerned node, thereby improving the calculation efficiency of state estimation.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Digital detection method for strong earthquake faults of convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of seismic data processing, and provides a convolution neural network strong-earthquake fault digital detection method, which comprises the steps of preprocessing the obtained three-dimensional seismic volume data of the strong-earthquake fault to obtain preprocessed data; the method comprises the steps of utilizing an improved three-dimensional convolution neural network, adopting a multi-interpolation algorithm fusion technology to process preprocessed data to obtain a data identification result of a strong earthquake fault, utilizing a digital twin technology to carry out digital twin modeling on the earthquake fault according to the data identification result, and being used for digital detection of the earthquake fault. The method can effectively capture deep features in the seismic data, improves the accuracy of fault detection, and provides powerful support for early warning and prevention of seismic disasters.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE GROUP CO LTD;CHINA RAILWAY SOUTHWEST RES INST CO LTD;UNIV WUHAN TECH;CHINA RAILWAY CONSTRUCTION CORP LTD;CHINA RAILWAY CONSTR HEAVY IND CORP LTD;WUHAN GUANGZHOU RAILWAY PASSENGER DEDICATED LINE CO LTD;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Ground surface abnormality monitoring data fusion system based on vibration signal processing
abstract_en: The invention provides a ground surface anomaly monitoring data fusion system based on vibration signal processing, which relates to the technical field of earthquake precursor monitoring and comprises a data acquisition module, a signal processing module, a data fusion and state inversion module and a monitoring and early warning module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for carrying out real-time monitoring on the ground surface by utilizing a distributed multi-parameter sensor network to obtain time sequence monitoring data related to earthquake precursors, the signal processing module is used for processing the time sequence monitoring data by adopting a double-parameter joint optimization algorithm to output separated signal components containing precursor information, the data fusion and state inversion module is used for carrying out fusion processing on the separated signal components by adopting a double-time-scale analysis framework to output a multi-scale precursor state estimation result and an uncertainty quantization index, and the monitoring and early warning module is used for outputting earthquake precursor grading early warning information through a three-layer anomaly identification framework and probabilistic risk assessment. The invention can realize high-precision separation and identification of the earthquake precursor related signals, and reduces false alarm phenomenon through an intelligent early warning mechanism.

title_en: Construction method and system of industrial product natural environment digital test field
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method and a construction system of a digital test field of an industrial product natural environment, and relates to the technical field of digital environment test fields. And reconstructing a real environment by using the environment data, modeling by CFD and BEM, fusing multiple physical field coupling, constructing a digital twin model, realizing dynamic deduction, and acquiring key performance data. The system deduces the power generation, the blade deformation and the durability of the wind driven generator under different environmental conditions, and timely adjusts unqualified equipment through comparison analysis with a preset threshold value. And automatically generating a report after the test is finished, carrying out pattern recognition and trend analysis by combining a deep learning model, predicting optimal test parameters, and providing a precise strategy for optimization and maintenance of the wind driven generator.
assignees: SOUTHWEST TECH ENGINEERING RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA SOUTH INDUSTRIES GROUP CORPORATION

title_en: Fire prevention and control method and device for energy storage system based on artificial intelligence and digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire prevention and control method and a fire prevention and control device for an energy storage system based on artificial intelligence and digital twinning, and aims to solve the problem that the traditional technology cannot timely start effective emergency response when parameters such as temperature, current and the like are abnormal in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of collecting multidimensional data in real time, establishing a fire disaster prevention feedback mechanism based on artificial intelligence, acquiring a safety threshold according to a pre-established fire disaster prediction model, comparing the multidimensional data collected in real time with the corresponding safety threshold, and controlling the state of the fire disaster prevention feedback mechanism according to a comparison result to complete fire disaster prevention and control work.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Multi-agent dynamic task allocation and collaborative routing system for label-free distributed deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-agent dynamic task allocation and collaborative routing system for label-free distributed deep reinforcement learning, which comprises the following steps of firstly receiving state information and environment perception data of each agent in a multi-agent system based on the distributed deep reinforcement learning, secondly extracting characteristic representation of the environment perception data and the state information of the agents, and carrying out multi-source heterogeneous information fusion through an attention mechanism to obtain state-task matching characteristics, thirdly, transmitting the state-task matching characteristics to a multi-agent network in real time, realizing task allocation negotiation among the agents by adopting hierarchical scheduling and state exchange mechanism based on task priority, dynamically detecting newly added task types and carrying out incremental learning, and realizing online updating iteration of a model to assist the multi-agent to optimize task allocation strategy and path planning action.
assignees: UNIV YUNNAN

title_en: Industrial production-oriented generation type counterdeduction method for security event
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to the technical field of security event deduction, in particular to a method for generating type countermeasure deduction of security events facing industrial production, which comprises the steps of determining target equipment, and constructing a deduction model which is adaptive to the target equipment and is based on a generating type countermeasure network; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a device fault tree and a personnel behavior decision tree, encoding the device fault tree and the personnel behavior decision tree into a directed acyclic graph to serve as a causal graph constraint of a deduction model, generating physical parameters under extreme working conditions by a physical generation engine based on the causal graph constraint, generating an operator behavior sequence by a language behavior generation engine based on the causal graph constraint, verifying data consistency by a multi-modal discriminator based on a cross-modal attention mechanism, approving generation under the passing condition, performing iterative training on the deduction model, deploying the deduction model after training, synchronizing a real digital twin model of a target device into the deduction model, and obtaining a deduction result of a safety event in a future preset time output by the deduction model.
assignees: CLP STARLAND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent scheduling method and scheduling system for running equipment of thermal power plant unit
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, in particular to an intelligent scheduling method and system for running equipment of a thermal power plant unit. The method comprises the steps of collecting multi-dimensional historical operation data of a thermal power plant unit to obtain a unit panoramic historical operation data set, constructing a unit digital twin model of the thermal power plant unit based on the unit panoramic historical operation data set to obtain a unit digital twin model, analyzing a nonlinear dynamic system of the unit panoramic historical operation data set to obtain unit performance index dynamic characteristic data, predicting equipment performance degradation trend of the thermal power plant unit based on the unit digital twin model according to the unit performance index dynamic characteristic data to obtain unit equipment performance degradation trend data, and predicting intelligent grid load of the thermal power plant to obtain grid load demand prediction data. The invention can adapt to the rapid change of the power grid load and the real-time change of the running state of the unit.

title_en: Regional prediction method for periodical incoming pressure of large-dip-angle working face
abstract_en: The invention provides a regional prediction method for periodical pressure of a large-dip-angle working face, and belongs to the technical field of coal mining. The method utilizes a digital twinning technology to create a twinning model corresponding to a physical entity, and combines a plurality of algorithms in machine learning to analyze and predict acquired data. And carrying out region division on the working surface through a MeanShift clustering algorithm, and constructing an algorithm model aiming at hydraulic support resistance data of different regions so as to improve the prediction precision and reliability. And meanwhile, consistency tests are carried out on the prediction results of the twin model and the algorithm model, so that the accuracy and consistency of the prediction results are ensured. The regional prediction method for periodical pressure of the large-dip-angle working face realizes dynamic monitoring and high-precision prediction of periodical pressure under complex geological conditions through cooperation of digital twin and multiple algorithms, and provides reliable basis for intelligent management, disaster early warning and safety decision of coal mines.
assignees: UNIV XIAN SCI & TECHNOLOGY;TAIPING COAL MINE OF SICHUAN CHUANMEI HUARONG ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Smart grid state estimation method, system and medium based on space-time diagram convolutional network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a smart grid state estimation method, a system and a medium based on a space-time diagram convolution network, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a topological graph model of a power system according to a topological structure and measurement data of the smart grid; the method comprises the steps of constructing a STGCN model comprising a plurality of space-time convolution blocks, capturing time dependence of time sequence data through a time gating convolution layer by each space-time convolution block, extracting spatial features of a smart grid through a space graph convolution layer, and building a power grid state estimation model based on the STGCN model to perform power system state estimation. The invention ensures the accuracy and reliability of the estimation result by fusing the space and time convolution technology. The method not only can effectively cope with the state estimation challenges under various topological structures, but also can maintain stable estimation performance, and provides powerful guarantee for the safe operation of the intelligent power grid. The operation efficiency and the response speed of the intelligent power grid are greatly improved.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;NANJING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Electric power engineering construction management and control method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of engineering management and control, in particular to a digital twinning-based power engineering construction management and control method and system. The method comprises the steps of obtaining heterogeneous sensing data of a construction area, carrying out dynamic modeling on structural members to obtain a component-level digital twin grid, carrying out environmental factor-material performance response coupling based on the component-level digital twin grid to obtain a material environment response distribution map, carrying out dynamic injection of component environment sensitivity according to the component-level digital twin grid to obtain a construction process dynamic map, carrying out multi-mode construction state field deduction based on the construction process dynamic map to obtain a construction state evolution distribution field, and carrying out reversible process scheduling optimization and simulation according to the construction state evolution distribution map to obtain a reversible scheduling optimization map. The invention can improve the efficiency and the resource utilization rate of the power engineering construction.
assignees: WENZHOU LIHONG DECORATION CO LTD

title_en: Power cable path searching method and device based on Internet platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power cable path searching, in particular to a power cable path searching method and a power cable path searching device based on an Internet platform, wherein in the method, a transmitter injects signals, a receiver processes noise and errors by using Kalman filtering, a built-in thermal imaging camera collects a thermal imaging image, an initial path is generated by means of Internet platform data by an A-type algorithm, a genetic algorithm optimizes the path to balance burial depth and construction cost, and a convolutional neural network is utilized to analyze the thermal imaging image to locate hot spots; the device comprises a signal acquisition module, an initial path generation module, an optimization module and a fault judgment module, can accurately process signals, efficiently plan paths and timely detect faults, realizes data integration and real-time updating by means of an Internet platform, and improves the level of intellectualization and reliability of operation and maintenance of the power cable.
assignees: SHANDONG FANGXIN LIAN ELECTRIC POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Two-stage checking method for water demand of water supply network node and friction coefficient of pipe section
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-stage checking method for water demand of water supply pipe network nodes and friction coefficient of pipe sections, which is applied to the technical field of real-time online correction of water supply pipe network models. The method comprises the following steps of grouping water demand of nodes and friction coefficients of pipe sections based on priori information, calculating covariance matrixes of pressure and flow measuring points, calculating estimated values and covariance of the water demand of the nodes and the friction coefficients of the pipe sections through a first-stage sequential data assimilation algorithm according to monitoring data of the current moment, adding a calculated result serving as an empirical value into a second-stage iterative calculation objective function, performing fine tuning optimization by taking the estimated value as an initial value of the iterative algorithm, obtaining an optimal estimated value of parameters of the current moment and the covariance matrixes thereof, taking the calculated result into the next moment, and repeating the two-stage algorithm to check model parameters of the next moment. The advantage complementation of the two-stage algorithm improves the parameter checking precision and provides a new idea for the real-time online correction of the parameters of the water supply pipe network model.
assignees: UNIV ZHENGZHOU

title_en: Hospital economic risk early warning and prevention and control system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of economic early warning prevention and control, in particular to a hospital economic risk early warning and prevention and control system, which comprises a data acquisition and preprocessing module, an intelligent risk prediction module, a digital twin simulation decision module, a decision fusion module and a user interaction module; the invention adopts a long and short time memory network to carry out time sequence modeling, can capture long-term dependency in data, improves the accuracy of future risk prediction, continuously optimizes a prediction model by the system, adapts to data change, ensures timeliness and reliability of a prediction result, constructs a digital twin model of economic operation of a hospital by a digital twin simulation decision module based on a risk prediction value, simulates system states under different management measures and risk scenes, provides visual decision support for a manager, and carries out fusion processing on the risk prediction value and a scene analysis result by a decision fusion module to generate comprehensive decision indexes to comprehensively reflect the economic risk condition of the hospital and provide scientific decision basis for the manager.
assignees: CENTRAL PEOPLES HOSPITAL OF SIPING

title_en: Wind power generation capacity prediction method and related device based on self-adaptive graph convolution neural network
abstract_en: A wind power generation capacity prediction method based on a self-adaptive graph convolution neural network and a related device are provided, wherein the method comprises the steps of supplementing missing data to be complete by adopting a default value processing technology on wind power generation time sequence data, aligning data with different sampling time, standardizing each type of data, carrying out feature coding on the preprocessed wind power generation time sequence data, coding time information of the time sequence data and mapping the time information to a low-dimensional space, obtaining semantic similarity and time features by semantic graph convolution learning time features, obtaining semantic similarity and time features by geographic space graph convolution learning space features, fusing the semantic similarity, the time features, the geographic space dependence and time-space features, and decoding the fused features into prediction of the power generation capacity of each wind power generator in the future. According to the invention, the mutual influence among wind driven generators is learned through the self-adaptive graph rolling network, so that the prediction precision and generalization capability of wind power generation power can be improved.
assignees: HUBEI CENTRAL CHINA TECH DEVELOPMENT OF ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent operation and maintenance method for power transmission network equipment based on digital twin dynamic coupling
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent operation and maintenance method of power transmission network equipment based on digital twin dynamic coupling, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent detection of power systems. The method comprises the steps of dynamically splitting a power grid panoramic frame into a device physical entity layer and a static background environment layer, generating a panoramic display picture through cloud end and edge end parallel rendering and a terminal HMD picture synthesis technology, establishing real-time bidirectional mapping of a power grid device physical entity and a virtual twin, synchronizing sensor data to a digital twin model, extracting device operation characteristic quantity by adopting an improved permutation entropy algorithm, combining a Bayesian network diagnosis model and an analytic hierarchy process evaluation system, dynamically distributing rendering pipeline resources, constructing a device state quality index, quantitatively evaluating current device health degree and predicting future degradation trend by dynamically comparing the characteristic parameter with an expected value and combining a health factor correction and a time sequence nonlinear prediction model. The invention is beneficial to realizing the full life cycle efficient control of the running state of the power grid equipment.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING POSTS & TELECOM

title_en: Multi-domain element digital twin modeling method for complex disaster scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-domain element digital twin modeling method for a complex disaster scene, which is used for realizing modeling and unified characterization of emergency rescue elements, rescue task elements and objective environment elements based on an improved ontology theory, introducing a four-dimensional hypergraph theory and constructing a multi-level dynamic coupling relationship between tasks, resources and environments. And a dynamic attribute reduction operator is constructed, modeling efficiency and semantic consistency are improved, and a relationship strength calculation model is introduced to realize quantitative representation of nonlinear interaction among multiple elements. The invention can effectively support disaster deduction, resource scheduling and auxiliary decision making, and promote the intelligent level of emergency response under multi-disaster scenes.
assignees: UNIV NANJING POSTS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS

title_en: Enterprise intelligent legal system platform system based on large generated language model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hybrid enhanced enterprise intelligent legal system based on a generated language big model, which is formed by the cooperative work of a hybrid enhanced legal knowledge engine, a multi-mode legal document analysis module, a risk quantification evaluation module and a compliance verification workflow. The mixed enhancement type legal knowledge engine integrates multi-source data to realize real-time updating and semantic reasoning, comprises a map construction, a rule base and an increment learning mechanism, wherein a multi-mode legal document analysis module is used for carrying out structural analysis on a heterogeneous document to generate a feature vector, a risk quantification evaluation module is used for outputting a thermodynamic diagram and a report according to a compliance standard and analyzing feature quantification risks by combining a Monte Carlo simulation and analytic hierarchy process, a compliance verification workflow is driven by a finite state machine, a verification and conflict detection module is integrated, a generated language big model is called to generate an improvement scheme, and an audit record is solidified and optimized in a feedback mode. The system operates according to the flow of analysis, power supply, bias calculation, verification and correction, and the intellectualization and the accuracy of the legal processing are improved.
assignees: XING JIAYI

title_en: Electric power marketing operation digital twin model maintenance method based on consistency constraint
abstract_en: The application relates to a maintenance method of a digital twin model of an electric power marketing operation based on consistency constraint. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a digital twin model corresponding to power marketing operation and monitoring data respectively collected by at least two data sources aiming at the power marketing operation, determining consistency constraint dimensions matched with the power marketing operation based on maintenance requirements of the digital twin model, carrying out consistency analysis on the monitoring data respectively corresponding to the data sources based on the consistency constraint dimensions to obtain consistency constraint data matched with the digital twin model, and maintaining the digital twin model by using the consistency constraint data to obtain an updated model corresponding to the power marketing operation. By adopting the method, the prediction precision of the digital twin model corresponding to the electric power marketing operation can be improved.

title_en: Digital twinning-based wind power plant equipment modeling and operation and maintenance control method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a device for modeling and operation and maintenance control of wind power plant equipment based on digital twin, which are constructed by a high-precision digital twin model, wherein a fan entity is restored based on a 1:1 three-dimensional modeling technology, multi-source data including equipment sensors, video monitoring and GIS topographic data are integrated, and real-time mapping of a physical field and a virtual field is realized. And the intelligent decision support module predicts wind resource distribution by utilizing a dynamic boundary layer model, optimizes a grid-connected control strategy by combining a virtual inertia simulation technology, and realizes the guarantee of transient stability of the power grid under the new energy fluctuation scene. And the full life cycle management platform supports full-flow management from site selection planning, operation monitoring and fault diagnosis, and realizes multi-service data fusion display and interactive operation and maintenance strategy verification through a three-dimensional visual large screen.
assignees: GANSU LONGYUAN NEW ENERGY CO LTD;CHINA LONGYUAN POWER GROUP CO LTD;LONGYUAN DUNHUANG NEW ENERGY DEV CO LTD;LONGYUAN BEIJING NEW ENERGY ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Pump station group scheduling system and method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention provides a pump station group dispatching system and a dispatching method based on digital twin, which relate to the technical field of pump station dispatching, the invention constructs a pump station group digital twin model according to a bearing temperature curve, a flow curve and a pump cabin pressure curve in the rated power working in the history, sets a solving condition I, a solving condition II and a solving condition III according to the task quantity and the task time of dispatching, solves the dispatching quantity which each pump station should acquire in MATLAB, simulating the dispatching quantity in the pump station group digital twin model, obtaining a simulated running state, constructing a running state score, constructing a health state score according to the data of the pump stations, judging the task completion capacity of each pump station by analyzing the running state score and the sequencing of the health state score, and if the situation of incomplete task completion exists, reassigning the dispatching quantity, avoiding faults possibly caused by overload running of the pump stations and ensuring smooth progress of dispatching tasks.
assignees: CHINA WATER HUAIHE PLANNING DESIGN AND RES CO LTD;ANHUI JINHAI DIER INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Machine learning correction forecasting method for wind-light elements of new energy power station under complex terrain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a machine learning correction forecasting method of wind and light elements of a new energy power station under complex terrain, which relates to the technical field of data processing and comprises the steps of acquiring a multi-source observation data set of a target area, and carrying out numerical forecasting assimilation on the multi-source observation data set of the target area; the method comprises the steps of obtaining an output data set of a water-wind-solar power station of a target area, determining a forecasting factor based on a numerical forecasting assimilated multisource observation data set and an output data set through a statistical method, building and training a combined forecasting model according to the forecasting factor, obtaining weather forecasting data of the target area in a time period to be forecasted, and forecasting hydroelectric power, wind power generation power and photovoltaic power of the water-wind-solar power station of the target area in the time period to be forecasted based on the weather forecasting data of the target area in the time period to be forecasted through the combined forecasting model. The method improves the initial field through data assimilation to improve the numerical forecasting effect.
assignees: THREE GORGES JINSHA RIVER YUNCHUAN HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD;CHINA THREE GORGES CORP;BEIJING JIUTIAN METEOROLOGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method, system and storage medium for predicting residual life of large power generation equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and a storage medium for predicting the residual life of large-scale power generation equipment, and relates to the field of equipment life prediction. The method comprises the steps of obtaining service life related data of large-scale power generation equipment, preprocessing service life related data to construct a service life related data set of the large-scale power generation equipment, constructing an initial service life digital twin model of the large-scale power generation equipment based on the design and manufacture data, performing deep learning on the historical service data and the historical service data by using a deep learning model to generate a historical service data-historical service data correlation curve, determining a service state and service correlation parameter, generating a service life prediction digital twin model, inputting current service life related parameters of the large-scale power generation equipment to be predicted into the service life prediction digital twin model, and generating the residual service life of the large-scale power generation equipment to be predicted. The invention can improve the availability and production efficiency of equipment, thereby reducing the operation cost of enterprises.
assignees: JILIN SHULI INTELLIGENT CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Audit data early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power systems, and particularly relates to an audit data early warning method and an audit data early warning system, wherein an original data stream is generated by collecting node voltage and current of a power supply network and charge and discharge efficiency data of an energy storage system in real time through a distributed sensor network; the method comprises the steps of carrying out localized cleaning and standardized format conversion through edge computing nodes, generating a dynamic risk assessment result and a scheduling scheme based on fuzzy logic reasoning and digital twin simulation, analyzing and predicting deviation through meta-learning, and realizing closed-loop optimization by adopting a model distillation technology. The system comprises a distributed sensor network, edge computing nodes, a multi-source data fusion module and the like. The method and the system improve the real-time performance of anomaly detection, the accuracy of risk assessment and the economical efficiency of energy storage scheduling of the power system.
assignees: HUANENG SHANTOU HAIMEN POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Storage optimization method and system for power equipment based on RFID
abstract_en: The invention discloses a warehouse optimization method and a warehouse optimization system of power equipment based on RFID, and relates to the technical field of warehouse optimization methods, wherein a three-dimensional model and position information of the corresponding power equipment are determined according to information analyzed by RFID signals and a warehouse database; and determining a distribution diagram of the power equipment according to the stereoscopic model, the position information and the distribution diagram of the warehouse of the power equipment, so that the accuracy of the distribution diagram of the power equipment is ensured. The method comprises the steps of determining a supplementary stereoscopic model based on a supplementary RFID signal, determining an updated distribution diagram according to the supplementary stereoscopic model and dynamic synthesis of the distribution diagram until the updated distribution diagram presents all the electric devices in the warehouse, determining a region to be optimized according to identification of the updated distribution diagram, and guaranteeing detection of all the electric devices in the warehouse one by one through online updating of the updated distribution diagram so as to facilitate storage optimization of the positions of the electric devices in the region to be optimized.
assignees: CR POWER TECH INSTITUTE CO LTD;CHINA RESOURCES NEW ENERGY INVEST CO LTD

title_en: Reservoir management optimization method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir management optimization method and system based on digital twin, the content comprises multi-source data acquisition and virtualization mapping, digital twin modeling, reservoir risk early warning and reservoir management decision optimization. The invention relates to the technical field of reservoir intelligent management, in particular to a reservoir management optimization method and system based on digital twin, wherein the scheme utilizes multi Bei Xixiao waves and fractal interpolation to construct a virtualized data field, and self-learning dynamic weight fusion is realized through a time sequence convolution network; the method comprises the steps of constructing a macroscopic and microscopic twin body, coupling the macroscopic and microscopic twin body through an asynchronous message bus, constructing a water pressure gradient, an overflow water level, dam stress and seepage flow multisource risk vector, adopting clustering, spatial diffusion and dynamic risk thermodynamic diagram generation and early warning, taking flood control safety, water supply guarantee and ecological environment as multiple targets, establishing a multi-target particle swarm optimization model and flow constraint, solving and executing an optimal scheduling scheme in real time, and realizing high-precision simulation, accurate early warning and intelligent scheduling.
assignees: XINJIANG JIANGHAI SURVEYING AND MAPPING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Virtual power plant green energy consumption cooperative method and system integrating digital twin and reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual power plant green energy consumption cooperative method and system integrating digital twin and reinforcement learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a green energy power plant digital twin model through a simulation tool, collecting data in real time and carrying out normalization and outlier cleaning; the method comprises the steps of inputting data into a digital twin model, mapping the running state of a physical system, previewing the influence of different energy scheduling strategies on green energy consumption rate and power grid frequency in a virtual environment, optimizing a PPO algorithm based on a near-end strategy to update the energy scheduling strategy, feeding the energy scheduling strategy after optimization and update back to the physical system for execution, monitoring the executing effect of the strategy in real time and updating parameters of the digital twin model to form closed-loop control, and solving the problem that the intermittence of renewable energy and the dynamic load demand are not matched.
assignees: HUAIYIN INST TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Method, apparatus, computer device, readable storage medium and program product for generating digital twin model of electric power system
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a device, a computer device, a readable storage medium and a program product for generating a digital twin model of an electric power system. Preprocessing multi-source heterogeneous data of a transformer substation to obtain preprocessed data, carrying out fuzzification processing based on the preprocessed data, extracting fuzzy logic rules, constructing an countermeasure network model to be trained, training the countermeasure network model to be trained based on the fuzzy logic rules, and stopping training under the condition that the model verification condition is confirmed to be met to obtain a digital twin model of the power system. In the modeling process, a model combining fuzzy logic and generation of an countermeasure network is introduced, and the system can be ensured to be suitable for a complex environment of operation of a power system in real time through dynamic rule base management and self-adaptive updating, so that the accuracy of automatic generation of a transformer substation operation ticket is greatly improved, and meanwhile, the rule compliance and the compatibility of a power system standard are ensured.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Operation evaluation method, system, equipment and storage medium for power transformation equipment line
