abstract_en: The invention discloses an operation evaluation method, a system, equipment and a storage medium of a power transformation equipment circuit, wherein the method comprises the steps of combining laser scanning and photogrammetry to construct three-dimensional modeling of a digital twin body of the power transformation equipment; the method comprises the steps of constructing a virtual sensor model, inputting historical data into the virtual sensor, preprocessing and comprehensively grading the state of equipment for feature engineering output, constructing a comprehensive risk assessment function based on the comprehensive grading of the state of the equipment, triggering an alarm when the assessment function exceeds a preset safety range, combining three-dimensional modeling with the comprehensive risk assessment function, constructing a defect state model, inputting the combined result into the defect state model to identify appearance defects and overheat areas, collecting real-time data, inputting the processed result into the defect state model to predict the future state of the equipment, and carrying out early warning and maintenance decision. The invention considers the environment temperature and the environment humidity, can comprehensively evaluate the equipment state, can early warn potential equipment faults in advance, and provides an active maintenance strategy based on data driving.
assignees: STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD;NANJING NARI RUITENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Campus low-carbon energy-saving intelligent classroom management method and system based on virtual classroom
abstract_en: The invention discloses a campus low-carbon energy-saving intelligent classroom management method and system based on a virtual classroom, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a basic classroom resource pool; the intelligent classroom management system comprises an environment sensing device, network transmission equipment and an intelligent controller, wherein an intelligent classroom infrastructure layer is built through the environment sensing device, the network transmission equipment and the intelligent controller, a digital twin model of a virtual classroom is built by combining attribute information of basic classroom resources and classroom environment parameters acquired by the intelligent facilities, the operation condition of each hardware equipment of the classroom is monitored in real time based on the digital twin model, an operation and maintenance scheme is generated according to the operation condition of the equipment and a prediction analysis result, an operation and maintenance file is formed, an energy consumption model of the virtual classroom is built, multidimensional evaluation is carried out on energy consumption of the classroom in real time, carbon efficiency indexes are built, corresponding classroom services are developed according to attribute characteristics of different types of classrooms, and corresponding service interfaces are provided for different service objects to realize input of classroom use requirements. A complete technical system for low-carbon energy-saving intelligent classroom management is constructed.
assignees: HUBEI UNIV OF ECONOMICS

title_en: Unmanned intelligent operation method and system for bucket wheel machine of power plant based on AI algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned intelligent operation method and system of a bucket wheel machine of a power plant based on an AI algorithm, and relates to the technical field of bucket wheel machines, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining running state information of the power plant and bucket wheel machine information; the method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model of a power plant-bucket wheel machine according to power plant running state information and bucket wheel machine information, carrying out correlation analysis on fuel reserve of the power plant and transportation tasks of the bucket wheel machine based on the digital twin model of the power plant-bucket wheel machine to obtain an optimized transportation scheme, carrying out discrete event simulation processing according to the optimized transportation scheme to obtain an efficiency simulation result, carrying out optimization processing based on the efficiency simulation result, and obtaining an operation scheme by setting an objective function and solving an optimal solution. According to the invention, through future prediction of the state of power plant equipment, modeling of the bucket wheel machine state transition probability matrix and the equipment cooperative working mode, the running state of the equipment can be monitored and dynamically adjusted in real time, and the overall working efficiency is improved.
assignees: LAICHENG POWER GENERATION PLANT HUADIAN INT POWER CO LTD

title_en: Nuclear power station operation and maintenance management method, system, equipment, storage medium and product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nuclear power station operation and maintenance management method, a system, equipment, a storage medium and a product. The method comprises the steps of generating a sensing parameter set according to real-time state data of all components in a nuclear power station, updating a digital twin model of a production system of the nuclear power station in real time based on the sensing parameter set, distributing at least one production role for a user based on a role database, determining a total key index of the user according to authority of the at least one production role, wherein the role database comprises role definitions of all production roles in the production system of the nuclear power station and digital twin representation of all production roles in the production system of the nuclear power station, distributing corresponding computing resources for the user according to the total key index of the user, configuring personalized model display parameters for the user according to the computing resources, and carrying out three-dimensional dynamic picture display on the digital twin model according to the model display parameters. The method can better realize the whole operation and maintenance management in limited computing power resources, and avoid resource waste.
assignees: STATE POWER INVEST NUCLEAR ENERGY CO LTD;UNIV BEIJING

title_en: Regional wind power coordination prediction method and system for central platform-wind power station data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional wind power coordination prediction method and system for data fusion of a central platform-wind power station. The method is based on Fourier neural operators, extracts physical space-time rules and other uncertainty motion rules contained in wind vector fields, constrains by utilizing Fourier approximate loss, is oriented to space-time wind vector field simulation results and regional wind power station power measurement, performs data assimilation through a dense-sparse self-adaptive convolution network, corrects wind field simulation results by utilizing measurement truth value data, considers data fusion requirements of regional center platforms and edge wind power stations, utilizes separation federal learning to achieve safe and rapid solution of center side wind field simulation and edge side local power prediction, and cooperatively improves regional wind power prediction accuracy, calculation friendliness and data privacy protection capability. The method can be applied to a large number of regional power dispatching regulation center platforms for grid connection of wind power stations, and regional wind power prediction results of 1-10 hours are provided.

title_en: Typhoon intensity prediction method, medium and computer program based on AI initial field driven NWP region mode and fused vortex power initialization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a typhoon strength prediction method, medium and computer program based on an AI initial field driving NWP region mode and fused with vortex power initialization, belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence and region numerical simulation, and aims to improve strength prediction precision and structure reduction capability of rapid enhanced typhoons. The method comprises the steps of firstly constructing an AI weather model based on deep learning, generating a continuous initial field and a boundary field which cover multiple meteorological elements, driving an area NWP mode, secondly introducing a vortex power initialization process before starting to strengthen consistency and strength accuracy of a typhoon axisymmetric structure in the initial field, then carrying out integral simulation based on an atmosphere-ocean bidirectional coupling mode, realizing local structure dynamic optimization by combining high-frequency multi-source observation data assimilation, and finally constructing an AI-NWP residual error feedback mechanism to realize closed loop correction of prediction errors and model fine adjustment. The method is suitable for high-precision prediction of typhoon intensity and has good engineering practicability.

title_en: Linear intelligent monitoring method for large-span continuous rigid frame construction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a linear intelligent monitoring method for large-span continuous rigid frame construction, which relates to the technical field of large-span continuous rigid frame construction and comprises the following steps of S1, data acquisition, S2, data processing, S3, multistage intelligent early warning, S4, construction regulation and control, and S5, result output. According to the invention, the multisource equipment is used for synchronously collecting data, the real-time performance and the integrity of the data are ensured, the abnormality is removed through deep learning, the neural network is used for constructing an environmental influence model and correcting the data, the influence of environmental factors on linear data is corrected, the digital twin is combined with the finite element and the neural network to predict the deformation trend, the prediction precision is improved, the linear deviation trend is prejudged in advance, the construction scheme is optimized, the threshold value is dynamically adjusted according to multiple factors through multistage intelligent early warning, early warning information is accurately issued, the risk response timeliness is enhanced, the decision advice and feedback evaluation effect can be automatically generated through construction regulation, and the construction process is optimized.

title_en: Digital twinning-based plant power load monitoring and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twin-based plant power load monitoring and early warning method, which belongs to the technical field of digital twin and power load prediction, combines WTConv with i transform for power load prediction, solves the challenge that the traditional power load prediction method is difficult to deal with in a complex dynamic plant environment, causes strong time-varying and nonlinear characteristics of load data due to the influence of multiple factors such as production rhythm, equipment running state and external environment in the actual plant running process, and can better capture complex time-space pattern and multi-scale characteristics through the combination of WTConv and iTransformer, thereby obviously improving the accuracy and robustness of power load prediction, providing more reliable load prediction support for a power system, helping enterprises to optimize production scheduling, reducing energy loss and effectively preventing the load risk of the power system.

title_en: Carbon reduction and synergy optimization operation method and system for water network system in agriculture and animal husbandry
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbon reduction synergy optimization operation method and system for a water network system of an agriculture and animal husbandry, which are characterized by collecting data of the agriculture and animal husbandry, constructing a database of the agriculture and animal husbandry, constructing a dynamic coupling model, optimizing model parameters, constructing an optimization model of a crop planting structure, solving the model to obtain a quarterly planting planning scheme, inputting the dynamic coupling model to obtain a corresponding collaborative scheduling scheme, constructing a daily scale scheduling model, solving the model to obtain a daily scheduling scheme set, screening an optimal daily scheduling scheme, formulating a water storage and electricity storage strategy, adjusting operation of a water pump and wind-solar storage equipment, constructing a real-time monitoring platform of the water network system of the agriculture and animal husbandry based on a digital twin technology, generating a control strategy and a carbon reduction synergy evaluation report, and optimally adjusting parameters in the dynamic coupling model. The invention realizes the cooperative scheduling of water resources, electric power resources and agricultural loads, improves the utilization rate of renewable energy sources such as wind and light, and improves the overall operation benefit of the system.
assignees: WATER RESOURCES AND HYDROPOWER PLANNING AND DESIGN GENERAL INST MWR;UNIV INNER MONGOLIA AGRI

title_en: Federal learning line loss computing system and method for power distribution network
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of electrical power systems, in particular to a federal learning line loss computing system and a method thereof for a power distribution network, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the platform region edge learning system adopts an improved LSTM-GCN hybrid network to build a model, obtains a platform region line loss model by combining a federal learning algorithm of privacy protection, a local data center aggregates local historical data and real-time data, builds line loss characteristic engineering and performs clustering classification, obtains the line loss rate of each platform region based on the platform region line loss model according to state estimation and topology identification, builds a consensus and mutual trust mechanism between a power grid business layer and a power grid data layer, ensures the validity and effectiveness of whole network data acquisition, provides functional support of consensus interaction, data exchange, state information interaction and model interaction, and a cloud service center receives calculation information and a clustering center of the platform region edge learning system and effectively protects data privacy by utilizing line loss rate characteristic engineering and clustering analysis and platform region line loss rate data comprehensive analysis.
assignees: UNIV SHAANXI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Ground-air cooperative fireproof isolation belt opening method based on digital twin and neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground-air collaborative fireproof isolation belt opening method based on a digital twin and neural network, and belongs to the technical field of forest and grassland fireproof. Firstly, geographic information, weather and fire monitoring data are collected and preprocessed, and a digital twin model simulation weather element is constructed. And then constructing an evaluation index system to evaluate fire risks and dividing risk grades. And planning the isolation belt by adopting a genetic algorithm, and exploring parameter combinations through selection, crossing and mutation operations. During ground-air collaborative operation, the unmanned aerial vehicle guides construction, and the helicopter lifts materials, and the adjustment scheme is monitored in real time. And evaluating the fire retarding effect, the opening efficiency and the cost effectiveness through simulation and actual data, and optimizing each link according to the result. The method accurately evaluates the fire risk, scientifically plans the isolation belt, improves the ground-air cooperative operation efficiency, realizes dynamic monitoring and optimization, reduces the cost and provides an effective means for preventing and controlling forest and grassland fires.
assignees: CHINA FIRE AND RESCUE INST;FOREST FIRE AFFAIRS CENTER OF BEIJING GARDEN AND GREENING BUREAU BEIJING AVIATION GUARANTEE FOREST S

title_en: Park thermal load curve completion method based on RC network thermal dynamic model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of thermal load prediction, and provides a park thermal load curve completion method based on an RC network thermal dynamic model, which comprises the steps of establishing the RC network thermal dynamic model of each building in the park; the method comprises the steps of collecting heat load data as an input standard of a model, calculating missing heat load data by using an RC network model, comparing the completed heat load data with actual measurement data to evaluate the completion effect, optimizing a completion algorithm according to an evaluation result, repeating the third to fifth steps until deviation of the completion data and the actual data meets a preset precision requirement, and realizing comprehensive completion of a thermal load curve of a park by using the optimized model and the optimized algorithm. According to the invention, the missing data is calculated by simulating the heat transfer process of the building and utilizing the known heat load data, and the completion precision is improved by optimizing the model parameters, so that the problem of incomplete load data of a park is effectively solved.
assignees: TIANJIN BAIZE QINGYUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Workload determination method, device and equipment for digital twin model of power transmission engineering
abstract_en: The application relates to a workload determination method, a workload determination device and workload determination equipment for a digital twin model of a power transmission project. The method comprises the steps of determining three-dimensional geometric model workload according to modeling time lengths and modeling efficiency coefficients of various model types in a digital twin model of the power transmission project, determining engineering geographic information data workload according to data processing time lengths of various engineering geographic information data, determining document data workload according to the number of document data in the power transmission project, determining logic model workload according to the number of elements of a plurality of logic elements in a logic model of the power transmission project and processing time lengths of each logic element, determining attribute data workload according to attribute information contained by the various model types and processing time lengths required by each attribute information, and summing the plurality of workloads to obtain total workload of the digital twin model of the power transmission project. By adopting the method, the workload assessment accuracy of the digital twin model of the power transmission project can be improved.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID ENERGY DEVELOPMENT RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin irrigation system for combination of agriculture and clean energy
abstract_en: The invention discloses an irrigation digital twin system for combining agriculture and clean energy, which belongs to the technical field of agricultural irrigation and comprises a physical body, a twin body and a digital twin platform, wherein data mirroring, mapping reconstruction, information interaction and simulation of a virtual body and the physical body are realized through data driving of the digital twin platform, the digital twin platform is taken as a frame, a model is taken as a substrate, and data are taken as driving to construct a simulation model and the twin body. The digital twin technology is used for combining agriculture, irrigation and clean energy power generation, twin modeling is carried out on a crop model, a power generation model and an irrigation model, and a system and a platform integrating monitoring, optimizing adjustment, simulation, control and operation and maintenance are formed through modules of the digital twin platform, such as data management, an optimizing model and machine learning.
assignees: POWERCHINA GUIYANG ENGINEERING CORP LTD

title_en: Multi-source data fusion text travel safety monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for text and travel safety monitoring based on multi-source data fusion, which relate to the technical field of safety monitoring and comprise the steps of acquiring multi-source heterogeneous data in real time, preprocessing the multi-source heterogeneous data to generate a structured data stream, constructing an initial digital twin body, triggering self-adaptive grid reconstruction based on the change of the structured data stream to obtain a dynamically updated digital twin model, constructing a microscopic, mesoscopic and macroscopic three-level coupling risk conduction network through a graph neural network by adopting the dynamically updated digital twin model, performing cross-space-time scale risk analysis, generating a risk conduction analysis result, simulating N intervention schemes in a virtual intervention sand box based on the risk conduction analysis result to obtain N simulation results, selecting an optimal intervention scheme through a reinforcement learning algorithm, and transmitting the N simulation results to physical equipment to implement optimal intervention scheme.

title_en: Three-dimensional live-action intelligent operation and maintenance method of power system based on multi-level detail modeling and artificial intelligence
abstract_en: A three-dimensional live-action intelligent operation and maintenance method of an electric power system based on multi-level detail modeling and artificial intelligence belongs to the field of intelligent operation and maintenance of the electric power system. The method comprises the steps of 1, collecting transformer substation information, determining hierarchical relation and category distinction of a model, initially constructing a visual three-dimensional real-scene platform, 2, adopting an LOD technology to reduce data complexity and optimize dynamic scheduling and rendering of the model, 3, carrying out evaluation and fault diagnosis, constructing a power equipment health management and operation and maintenance knowledge graph, combining a digital twin technology to realize monitoring and intelligent operation and maintenance of a physical entity, 4, applying a rendering technology to the three-dimensional real-scene model, integrating an artificial intelligent auxiliary operation and maintenance mechanism into the platform, and constructing a complete visual three-dimensional real-scene platform of a typical power transmission line of a power system. The invention provides the three-dimensional live-action intelligent operation and maintenance method of the power system based on multi-level detail modeling and artificial intelligence, which has good practical application effect and high intelligent degree.
assignees: LIAONING DONGKE ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Energy management method and energy management system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of energy management, and provides an energy management method and an energy management system. The method comprises the steps of obtaining distribution design parameter information of a target park, carrying out 3D visualization based on the distribution design parameter information to generate a three-dimensional space model of the park, carrying out equipment marking on the three-dimensional space model of the park to obtain N energy equipment, carrying out calculation network division and deployment by taking the N energy equipment as a key point set to build M distributed energy networks, calling an energy analysis network warehouse based on the M distributed energy networks to carry out energy data collection and analysis processing to obtain M distributed energy utilization parameter sets, carrying out regulation strategy analysis and simulation and optimization by utilizing a digital twin technology to determine energy regulation strategy parameters, and carrying out response management and closed-loop control on the energy equipment based on the strategy parameters to solve the technical problem that in traditional park energy management, the energy utilization rate is not high due to uneven energy equipment distribution and low energy regulation efficiency.
assignees: SHANDONG TIANSHI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic collaborative optimization method for mobile virtual power plant based on traffic energy fusion large model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dynamic collaborative optimization method of a mobile virtual power plant based on an traffic energy fusion large model, which belongs to the technical field of power system optimization scheduling and comprises the following steps of S1, constructing the traffic energy fusion large model to integrate a dynamic coupling relation between a traffic network and an energy network, S2, establishing a mobile virtual power plant resource aggregation model, S3, establishing a dynamic collaborative optimization model of the traffic-energy network, S4, adopting a distributed collaborative optimization algorithm to realize collaborative scheduling of the virtual power plant in the traffic-energy network, S5, dynamically updating traffic energy fusion large model parameters through a real-time verification optimization result of a digital twin platform and based on feedback data to form dynamic collaborative optimization.
assignees: JIANGSU HUAKUN SHUZHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Operation and maintenance decision method and system of electric power metering equipment, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an operation and maintenance decision-making method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium of electric power metering equipment, which comprise the steps of obtaining physical structure information of the metering equipment and equipment topological relation, and constructing a digital twin body of the metering equipment; the method comprises the steps of collecting metering equipment operation state data based on a metering equipment digital twin body, identifying metering equipment operation behavior dynamics based on the metering equipment operation state data, evaluating current metering equipment operation behavior risk based on an operation behavior dynamic identification result, and optimizing a metering equipment maintenance strategy based on an evaluation result. According to the invention, through integrating augmented reality and artificial intelligence technology, state evaluation, fault root analysis and dynamic generation of operation and maintenance strategies are realized in the operation and maintenance field of the electric power metering equipment, the problems of response lag, high misjudgment rate, strong artificial dependency and the like in the existing operation and maintenance system are effectively solved, and intelligent and accurate operation and maintenance decision of the metering equipment is realized.
assignees: GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Electric iron accessory state monitoring and managing method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power iron accessory state monitoring and managing method which comprises the following steps of firstly arranging a multi-mode intelligent sensor at a key part of a power iron accessory to generate real-time accessory state data and uploading the multi-source data to a cloud platform, secondly constructing a digital twin virtual model according to physical characteristics, an operating environment and historical data of the power iron accessory and combining finite element simulation, thermodynamic modeling and aging trend analysis technologies, and further comprising a data acquisition module for acquiring the operating state and environmental parameters of the power iron accessory in real time. The intelligent monitoring and management method for the electric power iron accessory prolongs the service life of the electric power iron accessory, and achieves intelligent monitoring and management of the electric power iron accessory through the organic combination of the Internet of things technology, the digital twin model and the self-adaptive dynamic threshold adjustment mechanism.
assignees: JIANGSU XINFU ELECTRIC POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent safety monitoring system and dynamic decision method for photovoltaic curtain wall
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent safety monitoring system of a photovoltaic curtain wall and a dynamic decision method, which comprise a hardware system, a software system and a decision output terminal, wherein the hardware system comprises a sensing layer, a transmission layer and a decision layer, the software system comprises data acquisition, feature extraction and risk assessment, the operation state of the photovoltaic curtain wall can be comprehensively sensed from multiple dimensions through multi-mode sensing and digital twin depth fusion, the fault detection accuracy is greatly improved by utilizing an advanced algorithm and a model for analysis, and the dynamic decision method enables the photovoltaic curtain wall to still maintain certain power generation efficiency through reasonably adjusting an operation strategy under a fault working condition, and reduces the power generation loss caused by faults.
assignees: LIANJIAN JIANGSU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Commercial building energy consumption monitoring method, program product, electronic equipment and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of energy consumption monitoring, and provides a business building energy consumption monitoring method, a program product, electronic equipment and a system. The energy consumption monitoring method comprises the steps of obtaining an energy consumption characteristic factor set and actual energy consumption of each energy consumption monitoring area, inputting the energy consumption characteristic factor set into a corresponding energy consumption prediction model to obtain predicted energy consumption, calculating energy consumption abnormal coefficients based on the actual energy consumption and the predicted energy consumption of each energy consumption monitoring area, generating color coding values of each energy consumption monitoring area based on the energy consumption abnormal coefficients, performing color rendering on corresponding model components in a commercial building digital twin model according to the color coding values to obtain a digital twin energy consumption thermodynamic diagram model, and outputting an energy consumption thermal diagram. The invention also provides a computer program product, electronic equipment and a commercial building energy consumption monitoring system. The abnormal energy consumption coefficient is utilized to accurately feed back the abnormal energy consumption condition, and the abnormal energy consumption degree can be visually checked through the energy consumption thermal power display diagram.
assignees: TONGYAN SHUZHI TECH CHONGQING CO LTD

title_en: Line parameter identification method based on collaborative variance matrix
abstract_en: The invention discloses a line parameter identification method based on a collaborative variance matrix, which comprises the following steps: s1, establishing a parameter model, and expressing line parameters as undetermined coefficients; s2, constructing an optimized objective function related to the undetermined coefficient by utilizing the historical measurement data and the tide equation; s3, carrying out optimization solution on the line parameters based on the collaborative variance matrix, adding physical constraint conditions, and searching the line parameters; s4, judging according to iteration conditions of the optimization algorithm, and finally outputting the identified line parameters; according to the invention, a line parameter identification technology based on a CMA-ES optimization algorithm is provided, and a Newton Lafson method is adopted to evaluate the population fitness; the physical based on line parameter identification-information fusion driven power distribution network tide state estimation model is designed, the problem that line parameters are inaccurate or missing is effectively solved, and reliable data support is provided for planning and operation of a novel power system.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RESEARCH

title_en: Multi-source data fusion misoperation-preventive locking intelligent decision and early warning method for wind farm booster station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-source data fusion anti-misoperation locking intelligent decision and early warning method for a wind farm booster station, which relates to the technical field of intelligent anti-misoperation of a power system and comprises the following steps of multi-source heterogeneous data acquisition, data acquisition through a distributed sensor network and preprocessing through edge calculation; the method comprises the steps of data space-time alignment and fusion, equipment state evaluation, construction of a deep belief network and Bayesian network mixed model calculation health index, misoperation prevention rule modeling, operation logic verification based on a Petri network and an expert knowledge base, risk early warning decision, fusion of multi-source early warning information to divide risk grades, intelligent locking control, reinforcement learning and optimization locking strategy, decision support and visualization, construction of a three-dimensional digital twin model and display of operation guidance and risk early warning by combining with an AR technology. According to the invention, through multi-source data fusion and intelligent decision, the accuracy and the efficiency of error locking prevention are improved, the early warning of equipment faults is advanced by 3 months, and the safety and the operation and maintenance level of the booster station are obviously enhanced.
assignees: BEIJING YANENG ELECTRICAL EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Heating system multi-working-condition scheduling control method based on large model and multiple intelligent agents
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heating system multi-working condition scheduling control method based on a large model and multiple agents, which comprises the steps of establishing a heating system digital twin model, setting a scheduling control center management agent, adopting the large language model to combine a thermal load prediction model to predict thermal load demands, dividing the system into a plurality of operation working conditions, setting a plurality of working condition sub-agents corresponding to the operation working conditions, judging whether the working condition sub-agents under the corresponding operation working conditions are triggered to start working by the scheduling control center management agent, simultaneously transmitting thermal load demand values of future time periods predicted by adopting the large language model and heat production quantity of a new energy heating unit to the corresponding working condition sub-agents, adopting the large language model to establish a system optimization scheduling control knowledge map based on the large language model by the working condition sub-agents, obtaining scheduling control strategies of all devices on the source network load side of the heating system, and feeding back to the digital twin model for guiding the actual heating system operation management.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ENGIPOWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-dimension factor-fused power storage dynamic storage allocation method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of warehousing automation, and particularly discloses a method and a system for distributing electric power warehousing dynamic storage bits by fusing multidimensional factors, comprising the following steps of constructing an electric power warehousing digital twin environment based on edge calculation, acquiring multi-source heterogeneous data in real time through an OPC-UA (optical control-vertical processing) protocol and establishing a three-dimensional data association model; and extracting a 28-dimensional state vector based on the three-dimensional data association model, and constructing a reinforcement learning state space. According to the method and the system for allocating the power storage dynamic storage position integrating the multi-dimensional factors, disclosed by the embodiment of the invention, the storage virtual environment mapped in real time is constructed through the edge calculation and digital twin technology, and the intelligent upgrading of power storage management is realized by combining reinforcement learning and cross-system linkage rules.
assignees: ANHUI XICHENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Smart grid state monitoring method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twin-based intelligent power grid state monitoring method and system, the method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source data in a power grid operation environment to form scene feature vectors and corresponding operation scene labels, selecting a basic twin model template according to the operation scene labels, mapping the scene feature vectors into node parameters in the basic twin model template to obtain corresponding parameter sets and digital twin model examples, constructing a causal graph structure of the running state among devices according to the digital twin model examples to reflect causal dependency paths among current power grid state variables, judging trend risks according to the abnormal causal path sets, and outputting structured early warning response information. The invention effectively solves the problem of insufficient generalization capability caused by the static state of the traditional twin structure.
assignees: UNIV MINJIANG;FUJIAN AUTOMATION ELECTRIC POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Big data driven enterprise operation credit trend prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of enterprise credit risk prediction and big data wind control, in particular to a big data driven enterprise operation credit trend prediction method and a big data driven enterprise operation credit trend prediction system, wherein the method comprises the following steps that a digital twin construction module integrates operation data of an enterprise group into a twin snapshot; the method comprises the steps of carrying out multi-frequency band splitting on time sequence indexes in a twin snapshot by a wavelet manifold extraction module and combining manifold or persistent coherent analysis to generate a time-frequency manifold characteristic vector, enabling a chaotic pulse training module to deepen perception of extreme conditions through chaotic mapping and output enterprise risk state vectors to Holonic multi-agent hierarchical scoring, enabling a quantum search decision module to search and execute multiple linkage schemes in parallel when high risk or abnormality occurs, enabling an increment updating module to quickly correct network weights in a small-batch online training mode after default occurs, enabling the risk vectors to adapt to the latest operating conditions, and accordingly remarkably improving accuracy and timeliness of enterprise credit risk prediction.
assignees: SHANGHAI BEITONG ENTERPRISE CREDIT INVESTIG CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting equipment fault identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing and recognition, in particular to a fault recognition method and system of intelligent fire-fighting equipment, which comprises the steps of executing according to a set first period, generating simulation data through a constructed digital twin model; the method mainly comprises the steps of collecting operation data of real equipment through a sensor network, comparing deviation values of simulation data and the data of the real equipment, triggering a causal reasoning engine when the deviation values exceed a preset threshold, calibrating digital twin model parameters and adjusting the operation parameters of the equipment, wherein the prior art mainly depends on fixed threshold alarming, early progressive faults of the equipment are difficult to capture and response is lagged, the digital twin simulation is combined with active fault detection, and deep insight on the health state of the equipment is formed by periodically injecting micro disturbance signals into the equipment and analyzing dynamic response characteristics of the micro disturbance signals, and tiny degradation of the performance of the equipment can be captured in a fault latency period, so that maintenance intervention is triggered in advance, and the advance and the accuracy of fault early warning are remarkably improved.
assignees: WEIFANG PINGAN FIRE PROT ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent collaborative optimization method for source network charge storage
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system optimization scheduling, and provides an intelligent collaborative optimization method for source network charge storage, wherein sensors are respectively deployed at four ends of the source network charge storage, real-time collection is performed by a cloud data center, four-end data are consistent in time sequence through a PTP (precision time protocol), a topological graph is constructed according to parameters and data, and a model is selected in a digital twin environment for simulation; dividing a source network charge storage four-end independent agent, setting observation data, execution space and excitation feedback, forming an excitation item by economy, stability and environmental protection, recording interactive circulation actual data, a prediction instruction and an excitation value into a sequence input strategy network, calculating and outputting logarithmic probability gradient update strategy network parameters, completing the interactive circulation by the agent according to the strategy network to generate a local scheduling instruction, carrying out weighted calculation on an aggregation instruction, generating a global scheduling scheme, transmitting the global scheduling scheme to an execution device, and re-solving the global scheduling scheme and transmitting the global scheduling scheme by utilizing the average deviation update parameters calculated by a deviation vector to form a closed-loop mechanism.
assignees: BEIJING RUIZHI POLYMER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin emergency evacuation method and system for highway tunnel
abstract_en: The invention provides a highway tunnel digital twin emergency evacuation method and system, which comprises the steps of S1, collecting multi-source fire data of a plurality of positions in a tunnel at fixed time intervals, S2, constructing a temperature field model, calculating thermal strain of each position based on the multi-source fire data, S3, constructing a structural field model, generating local stress of each position according to the thermal strain, correcting temperature field model parameters by using the local stress, and repeating steps S2-S3 until the local stress is not changed, S4, constructing a smoke field model, calculating fire source power of each position according to the multi-source fire data, calculating smoke flow diffusion rate of each position according to the fire source power by using the smoke field model, and S5, generating an optimal personnel evacuation scheme according to the smoke flow diffusion rate and the local stress of each position. The method solves the problems that the prediction of the fire development situation by using the static model is inaccurate and the accurate support for the emergency decision cannot be provided in the prior art.
assignees: CHINA MERCHANTS CHONGQING COMMUNICATIONS TECH RESEARCH & DESIGN INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Power flexible capacity demand measuring and calculating method and device based on body-building digital twin and scene-based perception
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of power capacity measurement and calculation, and discloses a power flexible capacity demand measurement and calculation method and device based on body-building digital twin and scene-based perception. Aiming at a power supply protection scene and a new energy consumption scene, a power supply protection double-layer measuring and calculating model and a new energy consumption double-layer measuring and calculating model are respectively established. Based on the model, the reliability of flexible resources in the power system is dynamically evaluated by adopting a body-building digital twin technology, the load and power generation state change are perceived in real time, and an optimized resource scheduling strategy is provided, so that the flexibility and reliability of the power system in a complex operation environment are effectively improved. And the scene perception technology is adopted to evaluate the multi-scene adaptability, the scheduling strategy of the flexible resources is dynamically adjusted, and the new energy consumption level is remarkably improved. Meanwhile, through the optimization of the down-regulation capability and the real-time power discarding control, the power discarding amount of new energy power generation is effectively reduced, and the efficient utilization of the power-assisted renewable energy is realized.
assignees: NORTHWEST BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA;UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: Electric power emergency resource scheduling method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power resource scheduling, and provides a power emergency resource scheduling method and system based on digital twinning, wherein the power emergency resource scheduling method comprises the following steps: the power grid related areas are divided into a plurality of power grid subareas, each power grid subarea is analyzed and compared to find out a power failure area, the power generation requirements of all the power failure areas are compared with the power generation capacity of the existing power generation equipment, whether the existing power generation equipment can meet the power generation requirements of all the power failure areas is judged, the power utilization users in the power failure areas are classified, so that the power supply priority of each power failure area is judged, the power generation equipment is sequentially distributed to the power failure areas according to the power supply priority, the problem that the power failure areas with higher power generation requirements cannot be timely recovered due to the fact that the existing power generation equipment cannot meet the power generation requirements of all the power failure areas is solved, and the rationality of power emergency dispatching distribution is improved.
assignees: ZHAO WEIWEI

title_en: Digital twinning-based power engineering construction management method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twinning-based power engineering construction management method and a digital twinning-based power engineering construction management system, which relate to the technical field of construction management, wherein the method comprises the steps of quantitatively evaluating reusability scores of all rules in an inherent construction management rule base under a new scene when a power engineering is transferred to the new scene; the method comprises the steps of judging whether a reusability score is lower than a preset threshold value, eliminating rules with reusability scores lower than the preset threshold value, determining a management rule missing domain in a new scene based on function distribution of the remaining rules, generating supplementary management rules adapting to the new scene aiming at the management rule missing domain, updating an inherent construction management rule base, and carrying out construction management on the new scene through a digital twin model based on the updated inherent construction management rule base. The invention solves the problems that the fixed rule base has poor adaptability and low efficiency depending on manual adjustment when in scene conversion, improves the real-time decision-making capability and scene adaptation effectiveness of the digital twin model in dynamic power engineering construction management, and remarkably improves the power work construction management effect.

title_en: Mobile tent hospital medical information management system and method based on WeChat applet
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical information management, in particular to a mobile tent hospital medical information management system and method based on WeChat applet, comprising the following steps: the medical record system comprises an applet login verification module, a treatment process recording module, a wound classification and bed allocation module, a network topology management module and a medical record rapid export module. According to the invention, the behavior data identification behavior abnormality during user login is analyzed, the identity verification flow is adjusted, the safety threshold of data access is improved, the defending capability of data leakage events is enhanced, the RFID tag is utilized to realize automatic identification of patient information and real-time update of electronic medical records, the response efficiency of temporary medical facilities is improved, the continuity and efficiency of medical services in disaster coping scenes are ensured, the smooth transmission of data in a medical network is ensured through real-time monitoring and optimization of network topology, and the rapid derivation of electronic medical records is realized by combining the analysis and formatting processing of text contents of the electronic medical records.
assignees: CHINA JAPAN FRIENDSHIP HOSPITAL CHINA JAPAN FRIENDSHIP INST OF CLINICAL MEDICINE

title_en: Intelligent generation method and system based on inside and outside industry integrated ground disaster prevention report
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ground disaster prevention report generation, in particular to an intelligent generation method and system of an integrated ground disaster prevention report based on inside and outside industries, wherein the generation method comprises the steps of collecting disaster information of ground disaster hidden danger points; the method comprises the steps of searching geological information of a related area, determining hidden danger point types, matching target templates, generating a target template directory structure, calling a workflow intelligent agent module according to the directory structure order, generating a manuscript text, inserting chart data into the manuscript text to obtain a complete report, checking and optimizing compliance of the complete report, and outputting a final report. The generation system comprises a data acquisition module, an intelligent search engine, a template management unit, a workflow scheduling center and an inspection optimization module, wherein the data acquisition module, the intelligent search engine, the template management unit, the workflow scheduling center and the inspection optimization module are sequentially connected and realize data transmission, so that the synchronous real-time update of inside and outside industry data is realized, the data dispersion and the information omission are avoided, and the generation efficiency and the accuracy of a ground disaster prevention report are improved.
assignees: YUNNAN NON FERROUS GEOLOGICAL BUREAU 308 TEAM

title_en: Marine wind power plant equipment state fault detection method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of state sensing and intelligent operation and maintenance of wind power equipment and discloses a digital twinning-based marine wind power plant equipment state fault detection method. The method comprises the steps of firstly collecting electrical, mechanical and environmental parameters of equipment to construct a node set of the equipment, introducing a connection mechanism of a parity symbol self-adaption and modulo alignment disturbance density factor construction graph to generate an adjacent relation, introducing a rotation coupling factor, carrying out feature aggregation based on a non-European collaborative projection method to obtain a structure aggregation expression vector, dividing a training set and a testing set, constructing a multi-channel abnormal scoring mechanism by combining basic scoring, rank entropy driving adjustment and local entropy weighting to complete modeling, and finally inputting the testing set to output a fault scoring result. The method can dynamically model the running state of equipment, improves the fault identification accuracy and the grading stability, and is suitable for long-term monitoring and intelligent operation and maintenance of offshore wind farms.
assignees: DATANG SHANTOU NEW ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for filling and quantifying multi-source data of power system by bimodal hybrid algorithm in extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for filling and quantifying multi-source data of a power system by a bimodal hybrid algorithm in extreme weather, belongs to the technical field of power distribution networks, and is based on a reverse chaotic whale transfer algorithm, dynamically adjusts by combining with meteorological features, constructs a load prediction model to fill missing data, and outputs distribution parameters and weight coefficients. Meanwhile, a meteorological condition matrix is introduced, a Gaussian mixture model is constructed, and uncertainty of filling data is quantized through a Monte Carlo subset deduction algorithm. The method effectively solves the problems of low processing efficiency and large error of the traditional method in extreme weather, and experiments show that the method has high convergence speed and high estimation precision, remarkably improves the accuracy and reliability of the data of the power system, and provides a guarantee for the stable operation of the power dispatching system.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent operation and maintenance management and control method and system based on digital twin wind power plant
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent operation and maintenance control method and system based on a digital twin wind power plant, and relates to the technical field of digital twin, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a time sequence signal of a wind power plant fan, constructing a feature vector, performing hash mapping and storing the feature vector into a segmented hash table; judging an operation mode through a bloom filter, generating a label triplet flow, summarizing abnormal hash keys, counting hash value frequencies in a time window, labeling high risk values, generating a hash frequency distribution vector, calculating mutual information among nodes, constructing an adjacent forest through minimum generated forests, sampling a sample flow, storing inflection points of low-frequency signals, constructing an abnormal decision tree, judging abnormal nodes, extracting a weighted subgraph, dividing the weighted subgraph into fault mode clusters, calculating a fault urgency score and generating an operation and maintenance work order. Through multisource time sequence signals, hash mapping, decision trees and spectrum division algorithms, wind farm fault detection, pattern recognition and operation and maintenance scheduling are optimized, and operation efficiency and sustainability are improved.
assignees: NEW ENERGY OPERATION AND MAINTENANCE BRANCH OF JIANGXI WATER INVEST DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Cross-regional water diversion project intelligent scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent water conservancy and discloses a trans-regional water diversion project intelligent scheduling method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin system based on a geographic information system, hydrologic monitoring data and a space topological structure, and integrating weather evolution prediction, drainage basin hydrologic response and a water demand prediction model; the method comprises the steps of utilizing a space-time convolutional neural network and a gating circulation unit to predict water demand and adjustable water quantity, establishing a multi-objective optimization model taking water supply benefit, ecological influence and energy consumption cost as optimization objectives, generating an optimal water dispatching scheme through the cooperation of a Markov decision process and multiple agents, and carrying out robustness assessment on the scheme and generating an emergency dispatching scheme. The invention obviously improves the dispatching efficiency and adaptability of the water dispatching engineering and realizes the efficient configuration of water resources and the quick response under extreme situations.
assignees: UNIV ZHENGZHOU

title_en: Wind power plant data reconstruction method based on graph attention mechanism and manifold self-encoder
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of data reconstruction, and particularly relates to a wind power plant data reconstruction method based on a graph attention mechanism and a manifold self-encoder, which comprises the following steps of firstly, constructing a graph structure of a wind power plant site, representing the site as a node, wherein node characteristics comprise wind speed, wind direction, temperature and power generation, and edges between the nodes are defined based on geographic proximity or characteristic similarity; then, dynamically distributing the weights of the neighbor nodes through an attention mechanism by using an attention encoder to generate a low-dimensional embedded representation of each site; and finally, mapping the low-dimensional embedding back to the high-dimensional data space through a graph decoder to realize the reconstruction of the missing data. The total loss function provided by the invention combines the data reconstruction error, manifold constraint loss and regularization term, and model training is completed by optimizing the total loss function.

title_en: Mine accident emergency rescue deduction system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of accident emergency rescue, in particular to a mine accident emergency rescue deduction system and a method, wherein a digital twin model for mine accident emergency rescue deduction is firstly established, a multi-rescue role collaborative rescue system is accessed, and then the entrance priority of each type of rescue role is obtained by analyzing the entrance urgency degree and basic response efficiency of each type of rescue role; and finally, establishing a response curved surface combining disaster evolution, entrance opportunity and response income, and obtaining the optimal entrance opportunity of each type of rescue roles by maximizing the response income and restricting entrance priority. According to the invention, when the real-time emergency rescue deduction is carried out, the multi-rescue role handover entrance opportunity can be dynamically scheduled according to disaster evolution, random variables and the like, so that rescue tasks and time are orderly unfolded, and the multi-role collaborative rescue efficiency is improved.
assignees: JIANGSU WECAN ZONGHENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Remote data disaster recovery system and data backup method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to a remote data disaster recovery system and a data backup method, wherein the system comprises a source end and a target end, the source end and the target end are connected through a virtual private network, the source end comprises a source end server, a physical backup module and a source end database, the target end comprises a target end server and a target end database, the physical backup module is used for generating a backup strategy according to the importance and change frequency of data and generating backup data based on the backup strategy, and the virtual private network is used for establishing a data synchronization channel from the source end database to the target end database. The technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention can efficiently capture the change event of the database and transmit the change event to the disaster recovery end, thereby realizing real-time or quasi-real-time update of the data. The risk of data loss can be reduced, the protection level of the data can be further enhanced through physical isolation, the safety of sensitive information is ensured, and enterprises are helped to obey relevant compliance standards.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU SHIKONGSUIDAO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Electric vehicle charging station site selection optimization method, system and equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to an electric vehicle charging station site selection optimization method, system and equipment, and relates to the technical field of charging station planning, comprising the steps of constructing an OD matrix of a target area based on a plurality of nodes for charging station site selection, and carrying out real-time updating to obtain an OD matrix sequence; and performing site selection optimization in a plurality of nodes based on particle swarm optimization according to the flow weight and the load weight to obtain a plurality of optimal nodes as site selection optimization results. The application solves the problem of insufficient accuracy of the site selection scheme caused by insufficient consideration of traffic flow dynamic change and power grid load impact in site selection of the traditional charging station.

title_en: Main and auxiliary integrated power flow calculation method and system considering missing data completion
abstract_en: A main and auxiliary integrated power flow calculation method and system considering missing data completion. The method comprises the steps of carrying out space-time characteristic complementation on node power data of a data missing time point in actual operation of a power distribution network, initializing power injected into the power distribution network by boundary nodes, carrying out power flow calculation of the power transmission network, enabling the equivalent of the power transmission network at the boundary nodes to be a Thevenin equivalent circuit, calculating equivalent parameters, adopting historical data modeling to strengthen the equivalent parameters, updating the power injected into the power transmission network by the boundary nodes based on the complementation data and the strengthened equivalent parameters, judging whether the iteration meets convergence criteria according to the power injected into the power transmission network by the boundary nodes before and after updating, if so, ending iteration, otherwise, carrying out iteration feedback updating, updating the equivalent parameters of the Thevenin equivalent circuit by the power injected into the power transmission network by the boundary nodes after updating, and returning to equivalent circuit characterization. According to the invention, the accuracy and stability of the overall power flow calculation are improved through gradual convergence of the coupling relation between the power distribution network and the power transmission network.

title_en: Processing method and system for power project data
abstract_en: The application provides a processing method and a processing system for electric power project data, and relates to the technical field of computers. And secondly, extracting features of unstructured data to generate text coding vectors and image feature vectors, and simultaneously calculating sliding window time sequence correlation coefficients of the structured data. And then, the features are fused to construct a cross-modal dynamic alignment factor, and the cross-modal dynamic alignment factor, the dynamic line loss rate and the device health vector are input into a space-time knowledge fusion model, and a device risk matrix and the line loss abnormal probability are output. And then, inputting the technical document into the electric cognition large model, analyzing the model result by combining the professional prompt template, and searching the related data to generate a treatment scheme. After the finite element simulation verification of the digital twin module, if the line loss variation is lower than the dynamic threshold, the line loss variation is pushed to the power management system to be executed. The method can realize accurate risk assessment and intelligent decision of the power system.
assignees: HEXU SUSTAINABLE GANSU TECH INNOVATION CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic planning system of power distribution network based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid planning, in particular to a dynamic planning system of a power distribution network based on digital twinning. The method can accurately identify fault equipment and abnormal equipment by collecting current, voltage, post-earthquake position offset, inclination angle and insulation resistance values of the equipment in real time and combining analog analysis of a digital twin model, dynamically adjusts the collection period and the coincidence rate threshold value, optimizes monitoring efficiency and accuracy, simultaneously generates an electric power allocation planning report, provides scientific basis for optimal operation of a power distribution network, can quickly respond and restore power supply particularly in emergency situations such as post-earthquake, reduces the influence of disasters on the power grid, and effectively solves the problems of inaccurate monitoring and inflexible planning caused by complicated influence of earthquakes and too-dependent static parameters.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA ELECTRIC POWER ECONOMIC TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE BRANCH INNER MONGOLIA POWER GROUP CO

title_en: Transformer substation fault detection method and related equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a transformer substation fault detection method and related equipment, by acquiring real-time data of a secondary system of a transformer substation, and a scene prediction model is formed by using the deep learning model and the dynamic Bayesian network, and a fault detection result is determined by combining a digital twin system. The deep learning model can deeply mine multi-source real-time data characteristics, accurately identify fault information in complex scenes, solve the problem of insufficient information mining of the traditional data driving method, and improve the accuracy of fault detection and positioning. The dynamic Bayesian network performs probability modeling on the dynamic change of the system state, and solves the problems that the traditional method is difficult to adapt to complex working conditions and can not accurately simulate the system evolution. Meanwhile, the digital twin system realizes the deep fusion analysis of multi-source data, constructs an intelligent processing closed loop from data acquisition to maintenance decision, remarkably improves the timeliness, accuracy and intelligent level of fault detection, and provides reliable guarantee for the stable operation of the transformer substation.
assignees: ZHUHAI POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Wind power mixed tower damage prediction method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for predicting damage of a wind power mixing tower based on digital twin, the method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source data of the wind power mixing tower, wherein the multi-source data comprise structural response data, environment load data and historical operation and maintenance data, a digital twin model of the wind power mixing tower is built based on a building information model and finite element model fusion technology, the multi-source data are input into the digital twin model to achieve real-time mapping of the wind power mixing tower and the digital twin model, real-time structural state data of the wind power mixing tower are obtained through the digital twin model, the multi-source data and the real-time structural state data are input into a pre-trained LSTM-GRU mixed neural network model, damage evolution trend of the wind power mixing tower is predicted by combining an attention mechanism, maintenance schemes of the wind power mixing tower are generated by utilizing a multi-target particle swarm algorithm based on the damage evolution trend, balance optimization of maintenance cost, power generation loss and risk level is achieved, and operation and maintenance efficiency and safety of the wind power mixing tower are improved integrally.
assignees: HUANENG SHAANXI ZICHANG POWER GENERATION CO LTD;HUANENG DINGBIAN NEW ENERGY POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Pipe network management system based on three-dimensional visualization technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a pipe network management system based on a three-dimensional visualization technology, which comprises a data management module, a model maintenance module and a visualization interaction module, wherein the data management module is used for storing and managing life cycle data of all equipment main bodies in a pipe network and receiving mapping data of the pipe network acquired by a mapping instrument through actual measurement, the model maintenance module is used for constructing an initial twin model of the pipe network according to the life cycle data and carrying out space precision calibration on the initial twin model according to the mapping data to form a three-dimensional twin model of the pipe network, and the visualization interaction module is used for providing an interaction display interface for a user and providing a preset management function for managing the three-dimensional twin model for the user. The method and the system construct a pipe network management system based on a three-dimensional visualization technology, construct a digital twin model of the pipe network, calibrate the space precision of the twin model by combining pipe network mapping data, enable the twin model to accurately reflect the actual constitution of an underground pipe network, provide various management functions, realize three-dimensional visualization management and effectively improve user management efficiency.
assignees: HUANENG JILIN POWER GENERATION CO LTD JIUTAI ELECTRIC FACTORY

title_en: Digital twin emergency rescue deduction optimization method for complex disaster scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin emergency rescue deduction optimization method for a complex disaster scene, which is characterized in that a complex random model is constructed aiming at the high dynamic property and randomness of emergency resources, rescue task demands and environmental elements in the disaster scene by utilizing a random process theory and discretization method, a deduction algorithm of a continuous state space and a discrete time step is constructed based on a digital twin deduction technology, the bidirectional mapping of a physical space and a virtual space is realized, an emergency rescue optimization module based on a matched game mechanism is embedded in the digital twin deduction frame, task demand gaps and resource cost are used as target functions, and the global optimal solution is gradually approximated by utilizing multi-round iteration and local strategy exchange, so that the efficient optimization of resource allocation in the disaster scene is realized. The method can not only predict the future disaster trend in real time, but also realize the double optimization of task demand meeting and resource cost control.
assignees: UNIV NANJING POSTS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS

title_en: Intelligent tool warehouse management system
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent tool and instrument warehouse management system, which belongs to the field of instrument management and comprises a multi-mode sensing module, an intelligent access control module, an edge calculation module, an anomaly analysis module and a visualization module. The intelligent access control system comprises a multi-mode sensing module, an intelligent access control module, an edge computing module, an anomaly analysis module, a visualization module and a display module, wherein the multi-mode sensing module is used for realizing identity recognition, real-time positioning and integrity verification of a tool through RFID and UWB dual-mode positioning, visual recognition and sensor fusion technologies, the intelligent access control module is used for controlling and sensing a goods shelf based on dynamic authorities to ensure that the tool accesses compliance, the edge computing module is used for adopting localized data processing and low-power consumption communication to support network breaking disaster recovery, the anomaly analysis module is used for recognizing illegal operation through an LSTM model and triggering hierarchical alarm, and the visualization module is used for displaying tool states and storehouse thermodynamic diagrams in real time based on a digital twin technology. The invention solves the problems of dependence on manpower, low efficiency and easy error of the traditional warehouse management, and realizes high-precision tracking, intelligent early warning and optimal scheduling of the whole life cycle of the tool.
assignees: TAIYUAN LONGWAY ELECTRONIC SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based wind power plant power prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power plant power prediction method and system based on digital twinning, and relates to the technical field of wind power plant power prediction. The invention takes ConvLSTM +GCN as a baseline model for improvement, a single-layer convolution layer with the same step length and convolution kernel size is cascaded behind ConvLSTM, a characteristic diagram output by ConvLSTM is compressed, fan geographical position information can be still reserved after data is subjected to space dimension reduction of the convolution layer through flattening operation and position coding, the model can sense and utilize the space position relations, an algorithm of an adjacent matrix in the traditional GCN is improved, the adjacent matrix is dynamically updated through cross correlation calculation, real-time association strength among fans is quantized, 3D modeling is carried out on the fans, and a virtual-real fusion visual monitoring system is constructed by combining a digital twin technology, so that the method is suitable for intelligent operation and maintenance, predictive maintenance and optimal scheduling of a wind power plant.

title_en: Wind turbine generator wake optimization cooperative control system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wind power generation control, in particular to a wake flow optimization cooperative control system and method of a wind turbine generator. The wind turbine generator wake optimization cooperative control system comprises a feedforward LiDAR array, an LSTM wind field predictor and a data fusion module, wherein the feedforward LiDAR array is deployed at the position 1-2km upstream of the wind power field main wind direction and is used for collecting upstream three-dimensional wind field data in real time, the set embedded sensor group comprises an ultrasonic anemometer and an inertial measurement unit IMU which are installed in each wind turbine generator cabin, the sampling frequency is not lower than 20Hz, the data fusion module is used for carrying out space-time alignment and noise filtering on the LiDAR array and the set embedded sensor data through a convolutional neural network CNN and a Kalman filtering algorithm to generate a dynamic wind field digital twin model, and the LSTM wind field predictor is used for predicting wind speed and wind direction change trend within 30 seconds based on the dynamic wind field digital twin model. Through multisource sensing fusion and dynamic game optimization, the operation efficiency and safety of the wind power plant under dynamic wind conditions are remarkably improved.
assignees: HEBEI CONSTRUCTION INVEST NEW ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Wind power gear box health management system based on oil multi-parameter on-line monitoring
abstract_en: The invention provides a wind power gear box health management system based on oil multi-parameter on-line monitoring, which belongs to the technical field of health monitoring, and comprises a sensor array module, a data processing module, a prediction module and a visualization module, wherein a sensor is deployed in the wind power gear box to acquire original parameter data in real time, the data processing module receives the original parameter data through an industrial Ethernet and synchronously and normally processes the original parameter data to acquire standard parameter data, the prediction module predicts the residual life of the wind power gear box by constructing a digital twin model to generate a diagnosis result and a maintenance decision, and the visualization module visually displays the health state of the wind power gear box and generates a maintenance work order and a spare part demand list according to the diagnosis result. The operation and maintenance efficiency and reliability of the wind power gear box are improved, and the fault risk and the operation and maintenance cost are reduced.
assignees: HUANENG XINJIANG SANTANGHU WIND POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Urban pipe network management system and method based on digital twin and cross-system cooperation
