abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based building operation and maintenance management system, which relates to the technical field of digital twin, and comprises a data collection module, a conference hall reservation response module, a conference hall pre-cooling time prediction module, a digital twin simulation and optimization module and an execution terminal, wherein the data collection module integrates operation data, response data of the conference reservation system, physical data of an environment sensor and time sequence data of equipment operation into a unified analysis frame for the first time, and dynamically predicts pre-cooling time points by combining the number of participants and indoor and outdoor temperatures to replace the traditional static rule, so that the pre-cooling efficiency is high, the instantaneity is higher, and the accurate matching of cold supply and real requirements is realized; according to the invention, the model parameters are adaptively adjusted through the equipment operation quality scores, the reserved time point is predicted again, the operation quality of the refrigeration equipment is ensured to be optimal under the condition of meeting the refrigeration requirement, and the balance of the efficiency, the energy consumption and the power performance of the refrigeration equipment is ensured.

title_en: Fan yaw cooperative control method and system for offshore floating wind power plant
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for cooperatively controlling the yaw of a fan of an offshore floating wind power plant, and relates to the technical field of offshore wind power, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin body of the offshore floating wind power plant to obtain the twin wind power plant; the method comprises the steps of locally calling historical wind condition data, solving yaw collaborative strategies in a twin wind farm based on the historical wind condition data to construct a reference collaborative control library, accessing a remote weather forecast center to obtain predicted wind condition data falling into a prediction time window, traversing the reference collaborative control library based on the predicted wind condition data to output a reference collaborative yaw angle, taking the reference collaborative yaw angle as an initial point, carrying out yaw collaborative control optimizing in the twin wind farm according to the predicted wind condition data to output a predicted collaborative yaw angle, and executing power generation intervention on the offshore floating wind farm according to the predicted collaborative yaw angle in the prediction time window. Thereby achieving the technical effects of prospective power generation intervention and improving the power generation efficiency and stability.
assignees: CHINA DATANG GROUP TECH INNOVATION CO LTD

title_en: Automatic control system and method for urban waterlogging emergency roadblock based on water level induction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban flood control and emergency management, and discloses an automatic urban flood emergency roadblock control system and method based on water level induction, wherein the automatic urban flood emergency roadblock control method based on water level induction comprises the steps of constructing an urban hydrologic digital twin model, and integrating urban geographic data and hydrologic parameters to form a digital model; a network fluid dynamics solver of a graph structure is built based on a digital twin model, and an urban road network and a water flow channel are abstracted into a flow network of a node edge structure; the method and the system for controlling the water flow of the road block have the advantages that the calculation complexity is reduced, the rapid response and active prevention of waterlogging and ponding are realized, the water flow evolution trend can be predicted in advance, the control strategies of a plurality of road block nodes are coordinated, and the problem of chain reaction caused by local control is effectively avoided.
assignees: SHANDONG HUAXI INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid digital twin technology analysis method and system based on AI image recognition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid data processing, in particular to a power grid digital twin technology analysis method and system based on AI image recognition, comprising the following steps of collecting visible light images and ultraviolet images of an insulator chain through an unmanned aerial vehicle carrying a multispectral camera, and simultaneously obtaining line leakage current waveform data; the method comprises the steps of generating a multi-scale pollution characteristic matrix, calculating equivalent resistivity of a pollution conductive path, reconstructing surface electric field distribution of a digital twin body based on the equivalent resistivity, simulating field intensity distortion gradient under different humidity conditions, generating a grading early warning signal when the field intensity distortion gradient reaches a preset percentage of air breakdown field intensity, and generating a humidity-field intensity mapping relation by simulating electric field distortion under different humidity conditions of a pollution layer so as to judge whether insulation performance of electrical equipment is affected or not.
assignees: HUNAN JINBU ZHIRONG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Management method of intelligent power plant based on digital twin and AI technology
abstract_en: The application discloses a management method of an intelligent power plant based on digital twin and AI technology, which relates to the technical field of power plant management and comprises the steps of constructing an initial signal data set composed of equipment operation parameters, carrying out hierarchical analysis on the initial signal data set, mapping the equipment operation parameters to a feature vector space to generate a unified feature data set, carrying out real-time comparison on the equipment operation parameters by utilizing an operation state classifier, calculating an abnormal probability distribution matrix of the equipment operation parameters, determining an abnormal risk level of the current equipment operation, extracting abnormal fragment data from the unified feature data set according to a state deterioration early warning signal, carrying out segmentation processing to obtain a segmented abnormal data set, carrying out future track deduction on the segmented abnormal data set to determine a future abnormal development track of potential faults, determining abnormal points of equipment based on the future abnormal development track, and carrying out association binding on the abnormal development track and the equipment operation parameters of the current abnormal points, thereby improving the accuracy and timeliness of equipment operation abnormal state monitoring.
assignees: JIANGSU SHENGDA WISDOM TECH INFORMATION CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin-driven dynamic topology network intelligent fire fighting coordination method and system
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the field of fire extinguishment and automatic control, and provides a digital twin-driven dynamic topology network intelligent fire-fighting collaborative method and a digital twin-driven dynamic topology network intelligent fire-fighting collaborative system, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model of a fire-fighting monitoring site, monitoring data in real time through various devices, and dynamically updating the model; and then analyzing the monitoring scene, defining task priority by combining the resource and environment information, distributing tasks and scheduling the communication nodes, and finally visualizing the output result. The system brings task allocation, resource scheduling and communication optimization into a unified mathematical framework, overcomes the defect of traditional fire control decision fracture, and improves rescue efficiency.
assignees: UNIV JILIN

title_en: Power grid digital twin scenerization application construction method and operation and maintenance management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method and an operation and maintenance management system for digital twin scene application of a power grid, comprising the steps of collecting power grid state data in real time through a sensor network deployed on a physical power grid, and inputting a space-time encoder to generate a dynamic feature vector by combining a power grid topological structure and equipment physical parameters; the method comprises the steps of constructing an entity relation map based on a power grid equipment knowledge base, carrying out space-time alignment on dynamic feature vectors and the entity relation map to construct a multi-source data lake, dynamically dividing application scene categories based on power grid service requirements to generate an application scene tag set, extracting space-time matching data from the data lake through relevance analysis to generate corresponding twin sub-bodies, and combining the twin sub-bodies of each service requirement to obtain the power grid digital twin scenerization application. The method has the advantages that through real-time data acquisition, space-time alignment and multi-source data lake construction, the power grid operation efficiency and equipment operation and maintenance management are effectively improved, potential risks are identified in advance, and the intelligent and self-adaptive capacity of the power grid is optimized.
assignees: ZHONGSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Misoperation prevention method and system suitable for novel power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-misoperation method and system suitable for a novel power system. The misoperation prevention method comprises automatic forced locking of an intelligent misoperation prevention terminal, remote control forced locking and mechanical interlocking forced locking, and mainly achieves the prevention of electric misoperation by monitoring the state of a secondary device of a power system in real time, establishing communication connection, setting forced locking and the like, and covers basic subsystems such as the control of the misoperation prevention of the Internet of things, intelligent electronic two-ticket operation management and control, intelligent tool management, intelligent lock control, overhaul isolation locking, field operation management and control and the like, so that the safety of the power equipment and the operation normalization of personnel are ensured. Meanwhile, advanced systems such as digital twin-prevention error, intelligent personnel management and control and remote intelligent control subsystem and the like are also covered, and the monitoring efficiency and the emergency response capability are improved by utilizing technologies such as 5G, AI and the like. The invention can prevent misoperation of the power system, improve the efficiency and safety of switching, overhauling and operation and maintenance operations, and ensure safe and stable operation of the novel power system.
assignees: MAO YIQIN

title_en: Wave energy recovery method and system for estuary area
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wave power generation, and provides a wave energy recovery method and a wave energy recovery system for estuary areas. The method comprises the steps of predicting second environmental information in a future time window by adopting a gradual evolution mode aiming at the collected first environmental information, generating an uncertain interference signal through data assimilation processing based on intermediate state environmental information generated in the gradual evolution process, performing rolling optimization solving based on a model prediction control algorithm by taking the total daily power generation capacity maximization and the output power smoothing of a wave power generation equipment group as optimization targets and taking the mechanical limit and the electric power output limit of the equipment as constraint conditions to obtain an optimal control instruction set of each wave power generation equipment in the future time window, and transmitting the optimal control instruction set to a power extraction device corresponding to each wave power generation equipment for execution. The invention effectively solves the technical problems of response lag, lack of synergy and predictability of the traditional method in the complex environment of the estuary, and can obviously improve the total power generation amount and the power quality all the day.
assignees: ZHEJIANG INST OF HYDRAULICS & ESTUARY ZHEJIANG MARINE PLANNING AND DESIGN INST

title_en: Digital twin-based computational electricity collaborative optimization method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twin-based computational electricity collaborative optimization method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which belong to the technical field of power resource scheduling optimization and comprise the steps of acquiring historical and real-time power system parameter information and calculation task information, and constructing a digital twin-based dynamic recursion state prediction model; and on the basis of preliminary scheduling, carrying out collaborative optimization on the scheduling of the power demand and the computing task load at the current moment according to a Lagrange optimization algorithm so as to generate a scheduling result which minimizes the scheduling deviation of the power demand and the computing task load, and dynamically adjusting the scheduling result through a stability correction factor. The invention realizes the accurate collaborative optimization between the power demand and the calculation task load.
assignees: SHANDONG HANXIN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Distribution equipment state early warning method and system based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution equipment state detection, in particular to a power distribution equipment state early warning method and a power distribution equipment state early warning system based on edge calculation, wherein the edge calculation unit loads and operates a dynamic digital twin body model for each downlink connected power distribution equipment, the dynamic digital twin body model is used for calculating and outputting twin state vectors representing ideal operation states of the power distribution equipment based on power distribution equipment operation data acquired in real time as driving input; real-time phase-dividing the operation data of the power distribution equipment and the twin state vector to obtain a twin-residual vector, carrying out causal relation analysis on a time sequence of the twin-residual vector to construct a residual causal graph, judging whether a preset abnormal causal propagation chain appears in the residual causal graph, packaging the fault source, the abnormal causal propagation chain and early warning information into a data packet after finishing judgment, and reporting an event. By the method, the rapid and accurate localization early warning of the fault source of the power distribution equipment is realized.

title_en: Digital twin modeling method and system for distribution network towers
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twin modeling method and a digital twin modeling system for a distribution network tower, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out classification statistical analysis on geometric structure characteristic data of a target tower so as to determine parameter distribution proportions of various components; the method comprises the steps of selecting modeling samples from a tower point cloud database to construct a three-dimensional modeling sample set, ensuring that component parameter distribution in the sample set is consistent with statistical proportion, generating model construction instructions based on the sample set, driving a digital twin modeling engine to reconstruct a tower, and collecting modeling process performance data to generate quality evaluation indexes. According to the method, through parameterized sample selection and standardized instruction generation, accurate and efficient reconstruction of the tower model is achieved, and a quantitative evaluation basis is provided for modeling quality. The invention can improve the construction precision and efficiency of the digital twin model of the distribution network tower and support modeling evaluation and optimization.
assignees: HUBEI CENTRAL CHINA TECH DEVELOPMENT OF ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Hydrogen convergence microgrid integrated energy management system and operation method thereof
title_ko: 수소 융복합 마이크로 그리드 통합 에너지 관리 시스템 및 이의 운용 방법
abstract_ko: 수소 융복합 마이크로 그리드 통합 에너지 관리 시스템은 물을 전기 분해하여 수소를 생산하는 수전해 장치, 상기 수소를 저장하는 수소 탱크, 상기 수소 탱크에 저장된 수소의 량을 추산하는 수소 탱크 상태 추정 장치, 상기 수소를 이용하여 전력을 생산하는 연료 전지, 태양광, 풍력, 수력, 지열, 바이오 에너지, 해양 에너지 중 어느 하나 이상을 이용하여 전력을 생산하는 신재생 발전 장치, 상기 연료 전지 또는 상기 신재생 발전 장치로부터 생산된 상기 전력을 저장하는 배터리, 및 상기 수소 탱크 및 상기 배터리에 저장되는 수소 및 전력 량의 분배를 결정하는 수요 분배 제어부를 포함한다.
assignees: UPTEC

title_en: Power prediction method and system for new energy power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power prediction method and a system for a new energy power grid, which relate to the technical field of new energy power prediction, acquire new energy power data, perform missing data complement processing on the new energy power data by adopting a space-time Kriging interpolation method to acquire corresponding target power data, perform meteorological power quantization association processing on the target power data to acquire a corresponding meteorological power coupling matrix, and perform power prediction on the meteorological power coupling matrix by adopting a pre-trained power prediction model to acquire a corresponding power point prediction value. The method and the system solve the problems that in the prior art, modeling is mainly performed based on meteorological data and physical characteristics of power generation equipment, so that the power of a new energy power grid is predicted, but the power is predicted according to single meteorological data, and the accuracy of the power prediction of the new energy power grid is reduced.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: Power equipment full life cycle management system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of electric power asset management and discloses a digital twin technology-based electric power equipment life cycle management system. The method comprises the steps of constructing a knowledge graph containing causal relations among equipment, environments and management activities, carrying out inverse fact deduction based on the graph to dynamically learn strategy rules, quantifying the value of potential maintenance decisions by adopting a physical option model, carrying out combination optimization under the resource constraint of budgets, spare parts and the like to generate an optimal decision combination, and finally generating standardized maintenance decision credentials for decisions in the combination. The application can quantify the decision flexibility and the environmental uncertainty into specific economic value, realize future-oriented and globally optimal resource allocation, and solidify the decision process and the result into traceable and manageable digital assets.

title_en: Method, medium, device and program product for predicting drift of marine distress target
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, medium, equipment and program product for predicting drift of a marine distress target, and relates to the technical field of marine search and rescue, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring the real-time updated initial position of the marine distress target and real-time marine power environment field data; the method comprises the steps of calculating a drift movement speed component caused by marine power environment field data, vector synthesizing the speed component to obtain an initial marine distress target drift speed, analyzing historical data to generate a compensation drift speed by using an artificial intelligent model, synthesizing the initial marine distress target drift speed and the compensation drift speed to obtain a marine distress target drift speed, and establishing a marine distress target drift track prediction model by combining the initial position of the marine distress target and the marine distress target drift speed to predict the marine distress target position in real time. The method can improve the prediction precision and timeliness of the drift track of the marine distress target.
assignees: UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES WUHAN

title_en: Construction method of large digital twin reservoir management system
abstract_en: The invention provides a large digital twin reservoir management system construction method, which comprises an entity project, an information infrastructure, a digital twin platform and intelligent application, wherein the entity project comprises an engineering dam area, a reservoir area, an upstream and downstream influence area, a building and electromechanical equipment, the information infrastructure comprises monitoring sensing equipment, a communication network, engineering automation control and an engineering foundation environment, the digital twin platform comprises a model library, a knowledge base and a multidimensional multi-space-time data model, and the intelligent application comprises intelligent forecasting and scheduling of flood control, intelligent analysis and early warning of engineering safety and intelligent comprehensive management of production operation. The invention ensures that reservoir management staff can know the current water rain condition, gate, safety monitoring and video monitoring information of the reservoir in real time, and can also predict the water level change condition of a future reservoir area and the safety and stability condition of a dam body in time through model calculation, and when the future precipitation exceeds the maximum storage capacity of the reservoir, the management staff is reminded to link the PLC system to open the gate and discharge floodwater in time.
assignees: HANGZHOU HUACHEN ELECTRIC POWER CONTROL CO LTD;POWERCHINA HUADONG ENGINEERING CORP LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based predictive maintenance method and system for air suspension fan
abstract_en: The application provides a digital twin-based air suspension fan predictive maintenance method and system, which comprise the steps of collecting airflow mutation characteristics when high-temperature dust-containing waste gas floods into the air suspension fan, transmitting the airflow mutation characteristics to a digital twin-based system, determining the airflow mutation characteristics, extracting local clearance shrinkage trend of foil and a bearing from the non-uniform expansion quantity of the foil, calculating the spatial distribution after clearance shrinkage to obtain a target air film thickness value, comparing the target air film thickness value with a preset rub threshold value, evaluating rub risk probability through a Monte Carlo method if the target air film thickness value is smaller than the threshold value, calculating air film rigidity fluctuation range based on a gas dynamic theory if the rub risk probability exceeds a preset safety range, and extracting vibration amplitude analysis results from dynamic response parameters of the foil bearing of the air suspension fan, and calculating a stability prediction index.
assignees: LEICI INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT GANZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic power station multidimensional information management method and system based on dynamic data aggregation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic power station multidimensional information management method and system based on dynamic data aggregation, comprising the steps of collecting real-time photovoltaic power station related data and uploading the collected data to a cloud; the photovoltaic power station related data comprise inverter real-time data and weather station data, the cloud end performs dynamic slicing processing on the acquired data by adopting a time window according to a user query time range, performs visual self-adaptive dynamic rendering on the data queried by the user according to the fluctuation degree of each data slice, performs dynamic emission reduction calculation in real time based on the inverter real-time data and the weather station data, and displays a calculation result. The method has the outstanding advantages of realizing dynamic aggregation and real-time updating of the multidimensional data of the photovoltaic power station, providing a self-adaptive visual interaction mechanism, improving the analysis efficiency of a user on complex data, reducing the emission, calculating high precision and the like.
assignees: GREE ELECTRIC APPLIANCES INC ZHUHAI

title_en: Automatic production line scheduling method and system for MicroLED display based on AI (advanced technology attachment) drive
abstract_en: The invention provides a MicroLED display automation production line scheduling method and system based on AI driving. Belongs to the technical field of display production. The method comprises the steps of obtaining various sensing data of MicroLED automatic production lines of the display, carrying out topological structure analysis on the production lines according to MicroLED production flow data of the display, constructing MicroLED production topological structure models of the display based on topological analysis results, carrying out deep fusion on the MicroLED production topological structure models of the display and the sensing data of the production lines, constructing a comprehensive MicroLED production line sensing network, carrying out production demand prediction by using an AI algorithm based on the constructed sensing network, generating MicroLED production demand prediction dataset of the display, constructing a production line digital twin model through topological structure analysis, realizing visualization and dynamic simulation of a production process chain, carrying out real-time optimization on process parameters by combining the AI algorithm, obviously improving production precision and efficiency, and reducing defective product rate.
assignees: DACHEN DISPLAY TECH QUZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Network safety monitoring method and system for digital twin water conservancy large model
abstract_en: The application provides a network safety monitoring method and system of a digital twin hydraulic large model, belonging to the technical field of hydraulic safety monitoring, wherein the method comprises the steps of aligning operation data and prediction data based on a time stamp, and calculating a difference vector sequence as a residual sequence; the method comprises the steps of calculating statistics of Euclidean norms of a residual sequence in a continuous sliding time window, marking the statistics as primary abnormal events when the statistics continuously exceed a preset residual threshold, carrying out feature extraction on physical equipment operation data and corresponding prediction data in the primary abnormal event time window to obtain abnormal feature vectors, inputting the abnormal feature vectors into a safety evaluation model to obtain safety scores, determining probability distribution of potential attack types based on the safety scores, constructing a fusion feature set based on a preset space-time diagram, inputting the fusion feature set into a pre-trained space-time diagram neural network model to obtain monitoring results, and determining corresponding safety response strategies based on the monitoring results.
assignees: HENAN RUIDA INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mountain road emergency management system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a mountain road emergency management system based on a digital twin technology, which belongs to the technical field of mountain road emergency management, wherein a digital twin model is created by a mountain road and surrounding environments through an informatization means, the association between the digital twin model and the real world is built in the construction and operation process of the mountain road, and data support is provided in the disaster early warning and emergency rescue processes; the system comprises a physical entity unit, a virtual model unit and a mountain road emergency management system, wherein the physical entity unit is a structure of a surrounding environment topography and a disaster-bearing body in the real world, the virtual model unit is a digital mirror image of the surrounding environment and the disaster-bearing body physical entity, and the mountain road emergency management system based on the digital twin technology is utilized, and by means of artificial intelligence, the advantage of big data, such as convenience in acquiring and using disaster-causing factor (official data such as weather and earthquake) data, is fully utilized, so that the analysis of the occurrence probability and the degree of a predicted disaster are facilitated.
assignees: SHAANXI XINGTONG SUPERVISION CONSULTING CO LTD;ALI REGIONAL TRANSP AUTHORITY;UNIV XIHUA;UNIV CENTRAL SOUTH

title_en: Digital twinning-based power station video inspection strategy generation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twin-based power station video inspection strategy generation method which comprises the following steps of S1, supplementing inspection points and an industrial television system camera model based on a three-dimensional model, perfecting a digital twin-based power station model, S2, marking attributes of all the inspection points and the industrial television system camera, S3, carrying out spatial visibility analysis of the inspection points by the industrial television camera, meeting the requirement of recording the space visible inspection point-camera binary set, S4, generating an industrial television system camera preset point, and forming a triad inspection strategy of the inspection point-camera-preset point. The invention realizes the automatic analysis of the space visibility between the camera of the industrial television system and the inspection point in many-to-many mode based on the space analysis capability of the three-dimensional model, and the automatic calculation of the preset point of the camera and the automatic generation of the inspection point-camera-preset point triple inspection strategy, thereby improving the efficiency of the inspection strategy generation and the strategy configuration and avoiding the defects of manual configuration.

title_en: Industrial production line and machine room facility collaborative management method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field related to intelligent production control, in particular to a digital twinning-based industrial production line and machine room facility collaborative management method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: and configuring a hybrid network architecture containing control, non-control and management information partitions according to the industrial production line communication environment, constructing a digital twin mapping model of multi-partition equipment to form a cross-partition database, generating a collaborative strategy set, and transmitting the collaborative strategy set back after simulated iterative optimization to realize dynamic collaborative management. The intelligent analysis of equipment data is realized through a semantic association rule base, accurate state input is provided for a digital twin model, and the technical effect of efficient collaborative management of the production line and the machine room facilities is realized according to a real-time data dynamic adjustment collaborative strategy.
assignees: GUANGZHOU SPEED ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic project intelligent operation and maintenance management method and system based on data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent operation and maintenance management method and system for a photovoltaic project based on data analysis, which belong to the technical field of intelligent energy management and comprise the steps of S1, collecting performance data of all photovoltaic module units in a photovoltaic power station, S2, collecting electrical design information of the photovoltaic power station, S3, identifying slight attenuation module units with all performance parameters lower than a preset health datum line and higher than a preset serious fault threshold value based on the performance data to form a list to be evaluated, S4, constructing a digital twin electric stress topological model based on the electrical design information, calculating electric stress topological criticality and calculating attenuation cluster formation potential aiming at each slight attenuation module unit in the list to be evaluated, and accurately projecting the module units with highest marginal benefit for maintaining electric stress topological steady state of a power station system to avoid resource waste on non-critical nodes.

title_en: AC/DC hybrid micro-grid control system based on straight and flexible transformer area
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power grid control, in particular to an AC/DC hybrid micro-grid control system based on straight and flexible transformer areas, which mainly comprises the following components: the method comprises the steps of collecting data through hardware such as deployment sensors and solid state breakers, constructing flexible topology, predicting the state of a power grid by using Gaussian-Newton method, LSTM (least squares) algorithm and the like, optimizing a control strategy by using a power cost model and heuristic algorithm, realizing AC-DC cooperative stability by using the current transformer, droop control and the like, rapidly responding to faults by using traveling wave ranging and the solid state breakers, and finally driving multi-scale optimization by using digital twin and MPC algorithm to form a micro-grid control system with cooperation of software and hardware.
assignees: QIYIN TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic power station power prediction method and system suitable for karst terrain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic power station power prediction method and a system suitable for karst terrain, which comprises deploying a sensor network in a photovoltaic power station area, and synchronously collecting the topographic feature parameters, the microclimate environment parameters and the photovoltaic equipment operation state parameters. According to the invention, by deploying equipment such as a three-dimensional laser scanner, a six-element weather station, an infrared thermal imager and the like, the topographic elevation, micro weather parameters and component temperature distribution are obtained, the multi-source data acquisition is realized, the DBSCAN algorithm is adopted to identify abnormal values, the bidirectional LSTM interpolation is adopted to fill time sequence missing data, the topographic influence coefficient matrix is generated by constructing a CFD wind field correction model and a SVAT thermal environment model, the GCN-TCN space-time characteristic extraction module is designed, a photovoltaic physical equation is embedded as a regular term, model parameters are dynamically adjusted based on an online learning frame, and the increment update of error threshold triggering is realized, so that the accuracy of a power prediction result is improved, and the demands of staff are met.
assignees: GUIYANG COLLEGE OF HUMANITIES SCIENCE AND TECH

title_en: Electric power operation data outlier cleaning method based on contrast learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for cleaning abnormal values of power operation data based on contrast resistance learning, and belongs to the technical field of power system data processing. Aiming at the problems of insufficient countermeasure robustness, limited characteristic characterization capability, rare labeling data and the like in the existing electric power data cleaning technology, the method realizes high-precision anomaly detection and cleaning by fusing countermeasure learning and contrast learning mechanisms. The method comprises the steps of 1) constructing a physical constraint countermeasure sample generator, applying Gaussian smoothing and amplitude limitation in the gradient disturbance direction to generate enhancement data conforming to the characteristics of electric power waveforms, 2) designing a heterogeneous dual-channel coding network, extracting local time sequence characteristics by a main encoder through causal convolution, combining multi-head attention with bidirectional LSTM capturing long-range dependence by an auxiliary encoder, 3) providing a dynamic weight comparison loss function, balancing characteristic alignment and inter-class comparison through an exponential decay strategy to optimize characteristic space distribution, and 4) fusing characteristic space mahalanobis distance and probability distribution JS divergence to construct multidimensional anomaly scores, and setting a self-adaptive threshold value to judge anomalies by combining a sliding window quantile method. The invention enhances the anti-interference capability of the model, and the introduced dynamic learning mechanism remarkably improves the abnormal recognition precision under unbalanced data and provides reliable data support for power system state estimation and safety early warning.
assignees: NORTH CHINA BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA

title_en: Visual multidimensional monitoring system of transmission line based on AI model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power transmission line monitoring, in particular to a power transmission line visual multidimensional monitoring system based on an AI model, which comprises an image acquisition module, an edge calculation module, a deep learning analysis module, an intelligent diagnosis module and a time sequence correlation analysis module. The image acquisition module acquires multispectral data through the visible light camera, the infrared thermal imager and the unmanned aerial vehicle, the edge calculation module adopts an FPGA chip to realize data preprocessing, the deep learning analysis module comprises a feature fusion, anomaly detection and three-dimensional reconstruction sub-module which is respectively used for extracting multiscale features, identifying equipment defects and constructing a digital twin body, the intelligent diagnosis module integrates a knowledge graph to provide decision support, and the time sequence association analysis module combines an LSTM-GRU model to realize state prediction. Through multi-source data fusion and intelligent analysis, the problems of multiple blind areas, low recognition accuracy and the like in the traditional monitoring are solved, and all-weather intelligent monitoring and operation and maintenance of the power transmission line are realized.
assignees: TIANJIN JINGRUI ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: AI-driven intelligent power monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power monitoring and discloses an AI-driven intelligent power monitoring method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, collecting operation parameters of a multi-energy system in an intelligent park, and energy consumption data, environment parameters and equipment operation state data of a user side in real time through a multi-type sensor network; the method comprises the steps of S2, preprocessing acquired data by adopting an edge computing node, S3, inputting the preprocessed data into an AI analysis engine, wherein the AI analysis engine comprises a multi-mode deep learning model and a layered reinforcement learning model which are operated in parallel, S4, constructing virtual mapping of an intelligent park comprehensive energy system through a digital twin system, combining user energy demand prediction and external environment change, simulating system operation conditions under different energy scheduling strategies in real time, and S5, triggering a multi-level early warning mechanism and generating a decision report when potential energy supply abnormality or equipment failure is detected.
assignees: Guangzhou huiyuan communication construction supervision co ltd

title_en: Automatic power big data reasoning platform and power distribution system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic power big data reasoning platform and an electric power distribution system, and relates to the technical field of electric power systems, wherein the platform comprises a knowledge acquisition unit, a knowledge processing unit and a power distribution unit, wherein the knowledge acquisition unit acquires and preprocesses internal and external data of electric power, and the internal and external data are converted into structural data through the knowledge processing unit; the invention relates to a method for generating a power distribution scene, which comprises the steps of constructing a dynamic knowledge graph, organizing triple data to form an initial graph, monitoring new dynamic, correcting or adding graph content in real time by an updating unit, utilizing a fault diagnosis and demand prediction algorithm by an inference unit to realize accurate reasoning of power faults and future demand trend prediction based on the dynamic graph, realizing efficient integration and dynamic evolution of power knowledge through the construction and the real-time updating of the dynamic knowledge graph, ensuring timeliness and accuracy of the graph, providing reliable data for fault diagnosis, and generating a distribution scheme of an adaptation scene by a closed loop architecture of data acquisition, reasoning analysis, scheme formulation and execution control and combining an intelligent sensor and an optimization algorithm.

title_en: Virtual power plant regulation and control method and system for realizing new energy consumption
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of virtual power plants and discloses a virtual power plant regulation and control method and a system for realizing new energy consumption, wherein the system comprises a multi-source heterogeneous data acquisition module, an intelligent prediction analysis module, a resource aggregation modeling module, an optimization decision module, a block chain cooperation module and a digital twin evaluation module; the novel energy output and load demand are subjected to multi-time scale coupling prediction through the deep space-time convolutional neural network, the fluctuation and intermittence characteristics of the novel energy can be described, the short-term and ultra-short-term prediction accuracy is improved, the waste wind light rejection rate and the load reduction risk are reduced, the high matching of a virtual power plant scheduling plan and actual operation conditions is ensured, and a virtual machine set capable of efficiently scheduling can be formed by constructing a flexible resource characteristic matrix and carrying out fine modeling and aggregation on distributed energy storage, interruptible load and electric automobile multi-element resources, so that the resource utilization efficiency is improved, and the overall scheduling cost is reduced.

title_en: Multi-mode collaborative optimization method and system for intelligent micro-grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-mode collaborative optimization method and a multi-mode collaborative optimization system for a smart micro-grid, and belongs to the field of smart grids. The method comprises the steps of collecting electric data of a public connection point and a distributed unit, quantifying harmonic responsibility coefficients by using an improved complex independent component analysis and partial coherence method, constructing a dynamic electricity price game model, solving an optimal excitation coefficient by non-cooperative games, constructing a multi-objective optimization model, strengthening learning of agent correction model prediction control parameters by means of digital twin body training, rolling optimization, outputting scheduling instructions and achieving multi-mode switching. The system comprises four layers of data acquisition, regional collaboration, cloud computing and digital twin and intelligent optimization. The invention integrates the power quality and the economic dispatch, and improves the intelligent and safety of the micro-grid optimization.

title_en: Power transformer fault prediction method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power data processing, in particular to a power transformer fault prediction method and system based on digital twinning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a focusing data set, constructing a reference model to be calibrated comprising multiple physical field couplings, adjusting preset uncertainty parameters through a Bayesian calibration method, outputting a digital twin model, selecting a fault anchor point through a filling space experiment design method, simulating the fault anchor point to generate a sample for training a proxy model, generating a virtual fault sample set through the proxy model, carrying out enhancement processing on the virtual fault sample set according to noise characteristics of a sensor to obtain an enhanced fault sample set, extracting spatial characteristics and time sequence characteristics to form a characteristic vector data set, and training a fault prediction model through a multi-task learning architecture as training data. According to the invention, a large number of fault samples are generated through the digital twin model and the proxy model, and comprehensive decision support is provided for the state maintenance and health management of the transformer.
assignees: JIANGSU DONGXISHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent checking method and system for power engineering
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent checking method and system for electric power engineering, which relate to the technical field of electric power engineering checking and comprise the steps of generating an electric power engineering multidimensional checking data source containing space-time characteristics and association relations; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a key check item with a priority coefficient and a non-key check item based on a trained deep confidence network classification analysis model, carrying out bidirectional rule matching check on the key check item and the non-key check item to generate a preliminary check result containing a risk early warning coefficient, constructing a virtual check scene of an electric power engineering based on a digital twin technology, carrying out iterative dynamic correction on the preliminary check result by combining real-time feedback data, and generating an optimal check conclusion of the electric power engineering with a correction path planning. According to the invention, a closed-loop intelligent checking system is constructed through an intelligent algorithm, and the intellectualization, the precision and the high efficiency of the electric power engineering checking are realized by combining a dynamic self-adaptive checking rule and a weight mechanism and performing iterative correction and correction path planning driven by risks.
assignees: QUZHOU GUANGMING ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: GIS-based power distribution network years planning layer iteration updating method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for iterative updating of a power distribution network many-year planning layer based on GIS, and relates to the technical field of planning layer updating. According to the method for iteratively updating the multi-year planning layer of the power distribution network based on the GIS, the GIS initial planning layer is established by acquiring multi-source power distribution network data, the running state data is acquired by combining a digital twin model of the power distribution network, the area to be adjusted is determined through risk assessment, the layer is updated, real-time linkage of the planning layer and the running state of the power grid is realized, the planning scheme can be dynamically optimized based on data driving, the accuracy, adaptability and risk coping capability of the planning of the power distribution network are improved, the fact that the planning layer continuously fits actual requirements of the power grid is ensured, powerful support is provided for efficient running and scientific planning of the power distribution network, and the problems that planning and actual running are disjointed and power grid state changes and risk hidden hazards cannot be responded in time due to the fact that the data is isolated and a dynamic updating mechanism is lacked in the existing power distribution network planning are solved.
assignees: STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD AKSU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Method and system for estimating irrigation water consumption per unit area based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for estimating irrigation water consumption in a unit area based on multi-source data fusion, which relate to the field of irrigation water consumption estimation and are used for estimating crop evaporation amount under the principle of energy balance by fusing multi-source heterogeneous data such as remote sensing images, meteorological data, soil humidity, crop growth information and the like and reducing errors of observation and models by utilizing data assimilation; and introducing a crop actual irrigation area identification model based on deep learning, effectively distinguishing the actual irrigation areas of different crop types, and dynamically reflecting the influence of space-time variation on irrigation efficiency. The invention can realize high-precision and rapid estimation of irrigation water in unit area of single crop and multiple crops on different area scales, remarkably improves timeliness and accuracy of irrigation water quota estimation, has strong adaptability to climate change, soil difference and crop diversity, and provides powerful technical support for precise irrigation and intelligent water conservancy management.

title_en: Support capability assessment method and system of flexible direct current transmission system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a support capacity assessment method and system of a flexible direct current transmission system, wherein the method comprises the following steps of obtaining operation data of the flexible direct current transmission system in an offshore wind power plant, constructing a support capacity assessment model comprising a physical model layer, a data driving layer and a model data fusion layer, inputting the operation data into the physical model layer to construct a physical model of the flexible direct current transmission system, obtaining a state prediction vector, inputting the state prediction vector into the data driving layer to construct an error correction model based on a deep learning model, obtaining a state prediction correction vector, carrying out weighted calculation on the state prediction vector and the state prediction correction vector by the model data fusion layer, obtaining a state estimation vector, establishing and calculating an assessment index value corresponding to a support capacity assessment index, judging the relation between each assessment index value and a corresponding preset threshold value, and obtaining an assessment result.
assignees: POWERCHINA FUJIAN ELEC POWER SURVEY & DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Energy digital management method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy digital management method and system, the method comprises the steps of receiving multi-source heterogeneous energy data acquisition signals, generating initial energy feature patterns based on a space-time correlation feature extraction algorithm, conducting image neural network coding on the initial energy feature patterns, constructing an energy knowledge pattern vector set, decomposing high-dimensional vectors in the knowledge pattern vector set into a plurality of subspace vectors, conducting real-time scheduling decision on the subspace vectors by using an energy flow optimization model driven by reinforcement learning to generate an energy distribution strategy set, applying a digital twin verification algorithm to the energy distribution strategy set to conduct physical-digital space consistency verification to generate a trusted energy scheduling scheme, and conducting blockchain storage and intelligent contract execution on the trusted energy scheduling scheme to generate an untwistable energy transaction record. By utilizing the embodiment of the invention, the scheduling precision and the response speed of the energy system can be improved, and the full-link credible management from decision making to execution can be realized.
assignees: BEIJING YINHENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Online assessment method and system for adjustable capacity of light storage direct-flexible power distribution system
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of light Chu Zhi flexible power distribution systems, and provides an online assessment method and system for the adjustable capacity of a light storage direct flexible power distribution system, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring historical operation data and real-time operation data of the light storage direct flexible power distribution system; the method comprises the steps of respectively constructing a photovoltaic power generation power output model, an energy storage charge-discharge dynamic model and a load adjustable range model, generating a multidimensional physical model of the light storage direct-soft system through a system-level electric coupling relation, calculating an initial adjustable capacity evaluation value of the system in a target time period through an optimization algorithm under a preset constraint condition based on the multidimensional physical model, carrying out online parameter correction on the multidimensional physical model through a time sequence deep learning model according to dynamic characteristic parameters in real-time operation data, and fusing corrected model output with the initial evaluation value to generate a real-time updated adjustable capacity prediction value. The flexibility and reliability of the system operation are effectively improved, the energy utilization efficiency is improved, and the operation cost is reduced.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power production loss evaluation method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention provides a power production loss evaluation method and system based on digital twinning, relates to the technical field of power system energy efficiency management, and determines a comprehensive power loss score of a power grid to be evaluated in a first time period based on equipment loss score, power grid topology loss score, environmental loss score and management loss score of the power grid to be evaluated in the first time period. And if the comprehensive power loss score of the power grid to be evaluated in the first time period is smaller than or equal to the score threshold value, predicting the comprehensive power loss score of the power grid to be evaluated in the second time period. And if the difference between the comprehensive power consumption score of the power grid to be evaluated in the first time period and the comprehensive power consumption score of the power grid to be evaluated in the second time period is larger than a difference threshold value, prompting the first early warning information. And if the comprehensive power loss score of the power grid to be evaluated in the second time period is larger than the score threshold value, prompting second early warning information. According to the invention, accurate assessment, dynamic early warning and optimization of power loss are realized through multi-dimensional data fusion, and the power generation efficiency of a power grid is improved.
assignees: ANHUI ZHIHUI YUNZHOU TECH CO LTD;SMART YUNZHOU BEIJING SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Environment-friendly energy-saving building energy consumption real-time monitoring and intelligent optimizing system and method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent buildings, and relates to a system and a method for monitoring and intelligently optimizing energy consumption of a green energy-saving building in real time based on the Internet of things, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the sensing layer comprises an environmental sensor group, a sensing layer and a sensing layer, wherein the environmental sensor group is used for collecting temperature, humidity, illumination intensity and CO  2  concentration; the non-invasive electric energy monitoring module measures equipment current through a Rogowski coil with the precision of +/-0.5%, the equipment state acquisition terminal acquires the frequency and the lighting switch state of an HVAC compressor, the network layer comprises a multi-protocol edge gateway supporting ZigBee/LoRa/Modbus to MQTT protocol, the block chain storage module generates SHA-256 hash values for energy consumption data and links the SHA-256 hash values, the platform layer comprises a digital twin engine generating an energy consumption three-dimensional thermodynamic diagram based on a BIM model, and the optimization control core comprises an LSTM load prediction unit and an NSGA-II multi-objective optimization unit. The invention realizes the energy efficiency leap of 12-18% of comprehensive energy conservation (5-8% average level in far beyond industry) through the technology chain of accurate perception-intelligent decision-closed loop control.
assignees: SHANDONG WANYI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power system state estimation hessian matrix method based on optimal control
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system state estimation hessian matrix method based on optimal control, and belongs to the technical field of power system state estimation. The invention establishes a node power equation for state estimation of an alternating current power distribution network, deduces a jacobian matrix and a hessian matrix of node power unbalance amount on node voltage and phase angle, establishes a state estimation optimization model aiming at the minimum square sum of node power measurement errors, and provides a power system state estimation hessian matrix method based on optimal control, which improves the state estimation convergence and ensures the calculation speed.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Intelligent water conservancy digital twin model construction method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence-based intelligent water conservancy digital twin model construction method, which relates to the technical field of intelligent water conservancy and comprises the following steps: establishing a project twin model based on intelligent water conservancy, and carrying out associated project analysis to obtain associated equipment; establishing a twin model network, and acquiring response conditions and response contents of each node; a response analysis model built by the response content of the real-time node; the method is used for solving the problem that in the existing intelligent water conservancy digital twin model construction method, when various types of water conservancy data exist and abnormal changes exist in certain types of water conservancy data, the digital twin model corresponding to the water conservancy equipment with large data fluctuation cannot be constructed in a targeted and real-time mode, and effective data monitoring cannot be conducted on the equipment with the abnormality in the water conservancy engineering in a targeted mode.
assignees: CHANGJIANG RIVER SCIENT RES INST CHANGJIANG WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION

title_en: Voltage data repair method and system for power distribution network fault detection
abstract_en: The invention provides a voltage data repair method and a system for power distribution network fault detection, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting voltage time sequence data of each node in a power distribution network; the method comprises the steps of screening collected voltage time sequence data of each node, reserving effective fault data, removing ineffective data to obtain cleaned voltage time sequence data, and repairing the cleaned voltage time sequence data based on topology relevance of a power distribution network. The intelligent power distribution system has the advantages that large-scale training data is not needed, the hardware compatibility is strong, the intelligent power distribution system can be embedded into the existing power distribution automation terminal, and key technical support is provided for real-time state estimation and self-healing control of the intelligent power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Intelligent system for early warning of leakage risk and emergency decision of mine water seal storage layer
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent system for early warning and emergency decision of leakage risk of a mine water seal storage layer, which is characterized in that a distributed sensor is used for collecting osmotic pressure gradient, microseismic event, tracer migration rate and rock stratum displacement data in real time, a standardized multi-parameter data set is generated through wavelet threshold denoising, variation modal decomposition and other processes, a fuzzy neural network model is utilized for outputting a leakage probability value P and a potential rupture azimuth angle theta, pore pressure is regulated and controlled according to the P value in three stages, when P is more than or equal to 0.3 and less than 0.6, the pore pressure is regulated and controlled, when P is more than or equal to 0.6 and less than or equal to 0.85, an optimal evacuation path is calculated, a grouting pressure gradient field is constructed according to theta and early warning grades, the proportion of plugging materials is dynamically matched, and online updating of model parameters is realized through closed loop control. The system realizes multi-physical field coupling monitoring and dynamic self-adaptive decision, and improves leakage risk assessment accuracy and emergency response efficiency.
assignees: SHAANXI ZHONGTAI ENERGY INVEST CO LTD;SCIMEE TECH CO LTD;GENERAL PROSPECTING INSTITUTE CHINA NAT ADMINISTRATION OF COAL GEOLOGY

title_en: Intelligent control method and system for lightning arrester of power transmission line based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent control method and system for a transmission line lightning arrester based on multi-source data fusion, which relate to the technical field of lightning arrester control and comprise the following steps of preprocessing acquired multi-source lightning arrester data to form a fusion data source; according to the method, a digital twin body with multiple physical fields coupled is constructed through a multi-physical-field collaborative modeling and dynamic mapping method, multiple physical-field distribution is dynamically simulated through an edge-cloud collaborative framework built in the digital twin body, physical state vectors are output, a first fault risk corresponding to the physical state vectors is deduced according to the acquired lightning arrester knowledge graph, multi-mode cross checking is conducted on the physical state vectors and the first fault risk through a three-dimensional evaluation space, a second fault risk is obtained, and a grading control strategy of a lightning arrester is dynamically generated and output through reinforcement learning based on the second fault risk. The method is used for solving the problems of modeling distortion of multiple physical fields of the lightning arrester of the power transmission line and insufficient dynamic performance of risk assessment and control strategies.
assignees: STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD WUHU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Energy storage power station operation safety assessment method, device, medium and program product
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy storage safety, and discloses an energy storage power station operation safety assessment method, an energy storage power station operation safety assessment device, an energy storage power station operation safety assessment medium and an energy storage power station operation safety assessment program product. Furthermore, the multi-time scale data are processed through stacked past decomposable mixing blocks, and the operation trend of the energy storage power station is predicted by combining a target deep learning model capable of understanding the relation between the upper level and the lower level and the mechanism relation, so that the prediction accuracy is remarkably improved. Furthermore, the multi-time scale optimization method and the digital twin-based lithium battery thermoelectric coupling model are combined for further optimization and verification, and the operation safety risk of the energy storage power station is evaluated by combining the preset safety domain model, so that the comprehensive and dynamic safety evaluation of the operation state of the energy storage power station is realized, the prediction precision and the safety evaluation reliability are improved, and the operation safety, reliability and economy of the energy storage power station are improved.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CORP

title_en: Distributed photovoltaic power missing data restoration method based on similar matching and cross-domain associated modeling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed photovoltaic power missing data restoration method based on similar matching and cross-domain associated modeling, and belongs to the technical field of new energy and power systems. According to the method, a deep-layer similarity matching strategy is utilized, deep features of a historical irradiance sequence are extracted through a self-encoder, feature reconstruction is carried out, multidimensional similarity between a period to be repaired and a historical period is calculated, a similar power candidate set is constructed, an optimal matching sample is screened out, and a similar feature matrix is formed. On the basis, a depth crossover network model is introduced to perform association modeling on cross-time domain similar features, high-order nonlinear features are extracted through feature crossover, and accuracy and robustness of power data restoration are improved. The method can effectively relieve the problem of power data missing caused by abnormal acquisition, channel congestion or equipment failure, remarkably improve the input data quality of the power prediction model and support the safe and efficient operation of the distributed photovoltaic system.

title_en: Digital twinning-based real-time vulnerability early warning method for power terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based real-time vulnerability early warning method for an electric power terminal, which realizes quantitative evaluation of dynamic electricity utilization difference by constructing a physical layer current fluctuation curve and a network layer third-order peak fluctuation parameter analysis model. The method realizes a robustness threshold early warning mechanism, has a false alarm rate of <5%, response delay of <1 second, leak detection rate of 93.2%, system availability of 99.997%, annual operation and maintenance cost reduction of 62%, and comprehensive efficiency improvement of 3.4 times compared with the traditional scheme, and solves the problems that the existing electric power terminal leak detection method cannot respond to dynamic supercharging behaviors in real time, so that the false alarm rate is high, and a unified data processing frame is not established, so that continuous analysis data are difficult to fuse and analyze efficiently.

title_en: Distribution network engineering construction and transportation collaborative checking and management system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network engineering construction and transportation collaborative checking and management system based on multi-source data fusion, which belongs to the technical field of distribution network engineering construction and transportation collaborative checking and management and comprises a multi-source data acquisition module; the system comprises a multi-source data fusion engine, a transfer collaborative checking module, a dynamic decision support module and a dynamic decision support module, wherein the multi-source data fusion engine is used for generating a fusion data pool by correlation analysis of multi-source data of a deep learning model, the transfer collaborative checking module is used for synchronously executing quality deviation labeling in a construction stage, equipment transaction tracking in a handover stage and risk early warning in an operation and maintenance stage based on the fusion data pool. The invention relates to a method for real-time correlation of structured/unstructured data through a fusion engine, and solves the problems of data fracture and responsibility tracing fault caused by a traditional phasing system. Dynamic decision is driven by virtual-real mapping, namely the field physical state is synchronously mapped to a digital system based on a real-time updating mechanism of a GIS map, so that the problem that the field and system data are not synchronous is solved.
assignees: ZHUMADIAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Building energy consumption real-time monitoring and carbon emission assessment method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The application provides a digital twin-based building energy consumption real-time monitoring and carbon emission assessment method, which comprises the steps of obtaining regional energy supply real-time data and building group load demand data, predicting energy supply fluctuation trend and load change trend to obtain a short-term supply and demand dynamic prediction result, adjusting an operation mode of a building group combined cooling heating and power system in real time according to an optimization scheme of mode switching, dynamically matching output change of distributed energy, feeding back the output change to a digital twin model, extracting carbon emission data from an optimized load distribution scheme, predicting carbon emission total amount and peak change trend by using the digital twin model, adjusting a carbon emission control threshold and constraint to generate a final energy scheduling scheme, obtaining the operation data according to the final energy scheduling scheme, and calculating energy utilization efficiency and carbon emission reduction of a building group by an energy efficiency assessment method preset in the digital twin model to obtain an execution effect assessment result of the scheduling scheme.
assignees: GUANGZHOU ZHONGKE ZHIXUN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin power prediction method and system based on adaptive multi-resolution wavelet filtering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin power prediction method and a digital twin power prediction system based on self-adaptive multi-resolution wavelet filtering, and relates to the technical field of power prediction; the method comprises the steps of obtaining multivariable power time sequence data, carrying out reversible instance normalization processing, inputting the normalized power time sequence data into an inverted embedding layer, mapping the normalized power time sequence data into a high-dimensional feature space to obtain an initial sequence, carrying out self-adaptive multi-resolution discrete wavelet transform on the initial sequence to extract low-frequency and multi-scale high-frequency components of the initial sequence, carrying out element-by-element multiplication on frequency domain components and a leachable filter core to complete self-adaptive wavelet filtering, reconstructing a filtered time domain sequence through the inverse wavelet transform, carrying out cross-channel aggregation and feature redistribution through a star aggregation-redistribution module, and inputting the extracted feature sequence into a feedforward neural network to obtain a power index prediction result of a future time step. The modeling method and the modeling system for the non-stationary power data effectively enhance modeling capability and prediction robustness of the non-stationary power data, are high in adaptability and easy to deploy.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN

title_en: Wind power probability prediction method integrating confidence triggering and missing data fault tolerance
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of wind power prediction and provides a wind power probability prediction method integrating confidence triggering and missing data fault tolerance, which comprises the steps of clustering a plurality of offshore wind farms to obtain a plurality of wind farm clusters; the method comprises the steps of inputting historical power data of offshore wind farms in a wind farm cluster into an improved transducer model to be processed, obtaining initial power probability prediction results of all the offshore wind farms, judging whether a target offshore wind farm with the initial power probability prediction results meeting a confidence triggering condition exists or not, taking the initial power probability prediction results as final power probability prediction results if the target offshore wind farms do not exist, interpolating the historical power data of the target offshore wind farms if the target offshore wind farms exist, and inputting the interpolated historical power data into the model again to be processed. The method can improve the wind power probability prediction precision, and is suitable for multi-step advanced power joint probability prediction under wind power plant clusters.

title_en: Digital twinning-based intelligent water conservancy pipeline section adjusting method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering, and particularly discloses an intelligent adjustment method for a section of a hydraulic pipeline based on digital twinning, which uses a sensor to collect entity operation data in the hydraulic pipeline; the method comprises the steps of collecting data, transmitting the data to a central processing system through a network, carrying out data modeling on the data based on a digital twin model through entity operation data, monitoring meteorological data of an initial section of a water conservancy pipeline by using a meteorological sensor, transmitting the monitored meteorological data to the central processing system, predicting the meteorological data by using big data analysis, and carrying out reducing regulation and control on the water conservancy pipeline according to the predicted meteorological data and pipeline supply real-time data. The automatic process from data acquisition, transmission and analysis to pipeline section regulation and control is realized, and the management efficiency is greatly improved by monitoring the real-time running state of the water conservancy pipeline without manually and frequently carrying out on-site inspection and manually regulating the pipeline section.

title_en: Coagulant addition prediction method for sparse coding and graph space-time attention fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coagulant addition prediction method for fusion of sparse coding and graph space-time attention, and relates to the technical field of time sequence data modeling prediction. The method effectively improves the missing data complement precision through the combination of a transducer coding-decoding architecture and a sparse self-attention and top-k sparsification strategy, provides high-quality and non-missing input data for subsequent predictive modeling, captures node association of multiple subsystems of a water production system by means of a graph attention network in a spatial feature expression level, improves the information entropy of the spatial features by dynamically calculating the association weights among the nodes and aggregating neighbor features, greatly enhances the expression capability of the spatial features on the multi-node coupling relationship, and can dynamically focus key time sequence nodes by a time attention mechanism in a time sequence predictive performance level, further improves the utilization rate of the key time sequence features and improves the accuracy rate of coagulant addition prediction.
assignees: CHENGDU QIANJIA TECHNOLOGY CO

title_en: Wind turbine generator performance dynamic evaluation method and system based on multi-source data fusion
