abstract_en: The application discloses a wind turbine generator performance dynamic evaluation method and system based on multi-source data fusion, wherein the wind turbine generator performance dynamic evaluation method based on multi-source data fusion comprises the steps of utilizing a quantum encryption algorithm and an edge gateway to synchronize multi-mode heterogeneous data, constructing a space-time semantic graph network through a deep semantic analysis technology to generate a precise space-time feature matrix, generating a physical enhancement feature vector based on an attention mechanism, constructing a cross-working condition health index map by using a machine learning algorithm, quantifying a cross-working condition comparable health index, generating a dynamic maintenance priority sequence by using a hierarchical increment learning architecture and utilizing a multi-target optimization algorithm, constructing a digital twin platform, performing closed-loop verification on the maintenance priority sequence, and generating a unit maintenance scheme. The method solves the problem of difficult fusion of multi-source data of the wind turbine generator, improves the quantitative accuracy of the health index under the complex working condition, optimizes the dynamic maintenance strategy and realizes the closed-loop optimization of the maintenance scheme.
assignees: NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic simulation and fault prediction method for power system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of power systems, and discloses a dynamic simulation and fault prediction method of a power system based on digital twinning. The method comprises the following steps of S1, collecting multi-source heterogeneous data in a power system in real time based on a deployed sensor network, preprocessing the multi-source heterogeneous data, wherein the multi-source heterogeneous data comprises power data and heat data, S2, calculating the preprocessed multi-source heterogeneous data based on a dynamic association model, analyzing a thermo-electric relation of power electronic equipment through a calculation result, and S3, establishing a dynamic mapping function of the thermo-electric relation in a digital twin model. According to the application, a digital twin model is adopted to fuse the thermal data characteristic of the power electronic equipment and the thermal-electric relation effect of the power data characteristic of the power grid, so that dynamic simulation is realized, the simulation precision is improved, and the prediction deviation caused by model mismatch is reduced. Meanwhile, virtual and real linkage is realized, and the two-way feedback of simulation results and fault prediction is realized.

title_en: Digital twinning-based energy-carbon integrated management method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a digital twin-based energy-carbon integrated management method, which relates to the technical field of energy-carbon management and comprises the steps of obtaining clean energy data, thermoelectric equipment data, outsourcing energy data, planned load data and production process flow data, predicting a supplied carbon emission transmission network by using a preset first carbon emission transmission model, obtaining a required carbon emission transmission network by using a preset second carbon emission transmission prediction model, calculating carbon emission factors according to the clean energy data, the thermoelectric equipment data and the outsourcing energy data, generating preliminary regulation and control instructions according to the carbon emission factors, the supplied carbon emission transmission network and the required carbon emission transmission network, performing simulation by combining equipment execution instructions and load regulation and control instructions to obtain simulation results and determining carbon deviation results, and performing instructions and load regulation and control instructions by using preset carbon integration system regulating equipment to obtain energy-carbon cooperative regulation and control instructions. The application can effectively improve the accuracy of carbon management.
assignees: WUHAN MAKER SCI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power system state estimation device, computer program for power system state estimation device, and power system state estimation method
abstract_en: To provide a power system state estimation device capable of accurately grasping a state of a power system.SOLUTION: A power system state estimation device 1 includes: an observation object determination unit 201 which determines whether a power system 90 includes a measurement point where a measurement point is lost, on the basis of measurement values regarding electric quantities measured at a plurality of measurement points of the power system 90 which supplies power; an estimation AI model creation unit 205 which, when the observation object determination unit 201 has determined that the power system 90 has a measurement point where the measurement value has lost, creates an arithmetic model which estimates a missing value being a lost measurement value, on the basis of a measurement value measured at another measurement point related to a measurement point where a measurement value; and a missing value estimation unit 206 which calculates the missing value with the arithmetic model created by the estimation AI model creation unit 205.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: TOSHIBA CORP;TOSHIBA ENERGY SYSTEM & SOLUTION CORP

title_en: Rural new energy power generation and digestion method, system and medium based on storage and charging cooperation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twinning, in particular to a rural new energy power generation and consumption method, system and medium based on storage and charging cooperation. The method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-objective rural new energy power generation and consumption model consisting of a rural new energy on-site consumption evaluation model, a distributed rural new energy load self-consumption model and a charge-discharge model of a storage and charge system, and finally solving the rural new energy power generation and consumption model based on storage and charge cooperation based on preset constraint conditions to obtain a final rural new energy power generation and consumption method. Through simulation analysis, the rural new energy power generation and consumption model based on storage and charging cooperation can not only meet the premise of on-site consumption of power load, but also ensure the minimum effect of waste energy, and realize the optimal energy storage loss under the condition that the fluctuation of the output power of the new energy is the flattest.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Communication-conduction-remote cooperative emergency processing method based on multi-source satellite data fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency monitoring and discloses a general and remote cooperative emergency processing method based on multi-source satellite data fusion. The invention aims to solve the technical pain points of poor situation awareness timeliness and low precision caused by response lag, manual driving and link fracture in the existing emergency monitoring flow. According to the invention, multi-source heterogeneous data such as unified space-time reference and deep fusion communication and remote control are constructed, so that multi-star cooperation and air-ground integrated linkage is realized. The method is characterized by constructing a regional digital twin body fusing the deep learning and disaster physical model, planning observation in real time, fusing tracking data, and rapidly generating and sharing an emergency situation report. By constructing the closed-loop intelligent service system, the real-time performance and the accuracy of disaster monitoring and early warning are obviously improved, and the autonomy, the safety and the application efficiency of the key space information acquisition and service are greatly enhanced.
assignees: NORTHWEST INSTITUTE ECO ENVIRONMENT & RESOURCES CAS

title_en: Interactive fusion method and system for seamless weather forecast product
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of weather forecast, in particular to an interactive fusion method and system for a seamless weather forecast product. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a forecasting background field to form a comprehensive data set containing different meteorological elements, loading and displaying background field data of a forecasting product according to a network geographic information system and the comprehensive data set, carrying out subjective and objective interaction form adjustment on the forecasting product, carrying out latticed post-processing to revise the forecasting product, setting association rules among the meteorological elements on the revised forecasting product to further revise the forecasting product, and fusing a meteorological disaster early warning signal, a streaming potential forecasting product and the revised forecasting product to obtain a seamless meteorological element forecasting product which is fused across time effects. According to the invention, through parameter limit value setting such as space-time fusion distribution of meteorological elements and association rules among the meteorological elements, and real-time updating and dynamic adjustment of fusion strategies, the consistency and consistency of each forecast product in time and space are ensured, and the forecast accuracy is improved.
assignees: JIANGXI METEOROLOGICAL OBSERVATORY JIANGXI ENV METEOROLOGICAL FORECASTING CENTER

title_en: Power system voltage optimization control method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power systems, and provides a digital twin-based power system voltage optimization control method, which comprises the following steps of obtaining independent voltage constraint ranges of a main network and a power distribution network, constructing a transformer transformation ratio association model, and obtaining a main network compatible voltage sub-range and a power distribution network compatible voltage sub-range; the method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model to simulate dynamic operation conditions, and outputting a dynamic voltage range of a main distribution network through simulation analysis, wherein the dynamic voltage range of the main distribution network comprises the dynamic voltage range of the main network and the dynamic voltage range of the distribution network, the problem of effect offset caused by blind adjustment is optimized, the main network synchronous auxiliary adjustment is ensured to be executed when the main network is prioritized, and the contradiction between the main network depressurization and the distribution network pressurization is solved when the main network is prioritized.
assignees: BAIYIN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;BAIYIN YINZHU ELECTRIC POWER GROUP CO LTD

title_en: 3D visual medical rescue command system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of rescue systems, discloses a 3D visual medical rescue command system, and aims to solve the problems of untimely information acquisition, incomplete information acquisition, low processing efficiency, insufficient decision support and the like in the traditional marathon event medical rescue command system, and provide an efficient and intelligent solution for modern medical rescue command. The system comprises an acquisition module, a synchronization module, an allocation module, a path module, an execution module, a 3D display terminal, a rescue path instruction, a control module and a control module, wherein the acquisition module acquires personnel positioning and on-site video streaming in real time and builds a three-dimensional digital twin model, the synchronization module performs time stamp alignment and space registration on multi-source data, the allocation module generates a resource allocation scheme, a disaster diffusion prediction graph and an unmanned aerial vehicle obstacle avoidance flight path according to unified coordinate data, the path module dynamically renders multiple layers on the 3D display terminal, and the execution module issues a rescue path instruction to control unmanned aerial vehicle bee colony to execute tasks and deliver materials. The invention realizes the intellectualization and visualization of medical rescue command of the marathon event, effectively improves the rescue efficiency and accuracy, and provides scientific and efficient decision support for emergency rescue.
assignees: JIANGSU YOUMAI SPORTS DEV CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent power plant integrated monitoring management system of electric power Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent power plant comprehensive monitoring management system of an electric power Internet of things, which relates to the technical field of monitoring control, and the intelligent power plant comprehensive monitoring management system comprises the steps of deploying Internet of things monitoring equipment in a power plant area required to be monitored and managed, constructing a monitoring network based on the deployed Internet of things monitoring equipment, collecting historical monitoring data in the power plant area, processing the collected historical monitoring data in a data processing mode after the collection is completed, and analyzing the processed historical monitoring data in a data analysis mode; after analysis, based on the analyzed historical monitoring data, a comprehensive monitoring management prediction model is built in a digital twin mode, finally monitoring data in a plant area are collected in real time and predicted through the comprehensive monitoring management prediction model, and meanwhile, the comprehensive monitoring management is carried out on the power plant area based on the comprehensive monitoring management prediction data, so that the accuracy of the comprehensive monitoring management of the power plant is improved.
assignees: CHN ENERGY LIAOCHENG POWER GENERATION CO LTD;ZHONGYING QINGCHUANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Cooperative development method for offshore wind power and ocean pasture
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooperative development method of offshore wind power and ocean pasture, belonging to the field of comprehensive development and utilization of ocean resources. The method comprises the steps of acquiring ecological data of different depths, determining ecological adaptation parameters of a net cage and a wind power pile foundation, simulating the influence of pile foundation layout on hydrodynamic force by using a genetic algorithm, optimizing the space allocation proportion of the net cage, generating pile foundation and net cage differential design parameters by combining the water depth and tide characteristics, adopting modularized parallel construction flow to make a construction time cooperation plan, constructing a digital twin virtual interaction platform, optimizing operation parameters in real time, deploying a sensor network, acquiring real-time data of pasture management, analyzing biological attachment and water quality changes, designing an ecological coating of the pile foundation, generating ecological restoration parameters, and driving pasture water pumps and oxygenation equipment by using surplus wind power to realize power allocation of energy and ecological cooperation. The invention realizes multidimensional coordination of wind power and pasture in space, time, energy and ecology, and improves the utilization rate of resources.
assignees: UNIV GUANGDONG OCEAN

title_en: Virtual power plant vehicle network resource optimal control method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual power plant vehicle network resource optimization control method and system based on digital twin, which belongs to the technical field of intelligent power network resource optimization, the method comprises the steps of collecting video stream data and battery state data, extracting physical connection stability characteristics, thermal stress characteristics and energy state characteristics, and carrying out dynamic clustering on the electric automobile to form a resource cluster, taking the resource cluster as an intelligent agent, constructing a digital twin collaborative optimization model based on a multi-intelligent-agent deep reinforcement learning algorithm, and generating a charge and discharge control instruction. According to the invention, the physical connection reliability is assessed by introducing computer vision, the battery health state is assessed by combining with the network of the gate control circulation unit, the comprehensive perception of the vehicle state is realized, the problems of scheduling execution failure and accelerated decay of the battery life caused by incomplete state assessment in the prior art are solved by the collaborative optimization of dynamic clustering and multi-agent deep reinforcement learning, and the safety, accuracy and reliability of vehicle network resource optimization control are improved.

title_en: Digital twinning-based full life cycle management method and system for electric power project
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of engineering management, and particularly relates to a full life cycle management method and system of an electric power project based on digital twinning, which are used for solving the technical problems of digital twinning and construction plan disjointing, lack of real-time data-driven risk assessment and permanent data capitalization mechanism, and the management method comprises the following steps of S1, acquiring a construction plan of a task unit and a digital twinning model; S2, establishing an association relation between a task unit and a component, S3, calculating vector deviation between a field entity state and a digital twin model target state, calculating a risk coefficient of the component, forming a dynamic construction plan, S4, carrying out structured packaging and hash linking on the vector deviation, the risk coefficient, a quality acceptance result and resource consumption data, and generating construction process data bound with the component. The method overcomes the defect of the disjoint of the planning and the model in the traditional management, can predict and avoid the space and resource conflict possibly occurring in the future, and ensures the integrity and the authenticity of the process data.

title_en: Intelligent early warning and self-adaptive regulation and control platform driven by digital twinning of water affair system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water conservancy project intellectualization, and discloses an intelligent early warning and self-adaptive regulation and control platform for digital twin driving of a water service system, which comprises the following steps of collecting multi-source data related to the operation of the water service system through Internet of things equipment to generate a data set with a uniform format; the method comprises the steps of integrating multi-source data through a cross-domain data fusion engine to generate a fusion feature set, analyzing causal relations among variables in the multi-source data through a time sequence causal reasoning engine to generate a dynamic causal graph, optimizing a system operation mode through information interaction among nodes to generate distributed cognitive data, generating a state graph of a water service system through a synchronous state graph visualization engine based on a topological network and the dynamic causal graph, generating a regulation command according to a multi-target cooperative regulation strategy, and updating the data set. According to the invention, through the cross-domain data fusion engine and the time sequence causality reasoning engine, abnormal events in the water service system can be accurately identified.
assignees: LUOYANG JINGGENGTUO TECH CO LTD;BEIJING FANGXINGYUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Distributed power generation scheduling system and method for reservoir group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed power generation dispatching system and a method for reservoir groups, in particular to the technical field of water and electricity dispatching, comprising a water and electricity digital twin model construction module, a distributed power data acquisition module, a unit power generation regulation module, a photovoltaic energy storage power generation regulation module and a distributed power load early warning module, the method has the advantages that the running stability of the high-efficiency unit is maintained by combining the excessive flow of the water turbine, the power generation output of the low-efficiency unit is improved, the energy storage and power supply are carried out by calculating the photovoltaic energy storage schedulability index and using a capacity allocation algorithm, the stability and the efficiency of power generation scheduling of the reservoir group are improved, the line load rate of each monitoring subarea of the reservoir group is evaluated, the power generation scheduling grid load is prevented, the line pressure is reflected through the load rate by multi-source power superposition, and the grid safety is improved.

title_en: AI and big data-based intelligent power equipment inspection method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent power equipment inspection method and system based on AI and big data, which comprises the steps of planning an optimal path of an inspection task based on a pre-built digital twin model of the power equipment, controlling the inspection equipment to collect multi-mode operation data of the power equipment according to the optimal path, carrying out de-duplication, normalization and labeling pretreatment on the multi-mode operation data to obtain fusion data, carrying out feature extraction to obtain a plurality of candidate operation features of the power equipment, screening the plurality of candidate operation features based on a pre-built knowledge graph to obtain a plurality of target operation features of the power equipment, inputting the plurality of target operation features into the pre-built anomaly monitoring model to carry out anomaly detection to obtain anomaly information of the power equipment, realizing collaborative processing on the multi-mode data, reducing the data dimension, improving the inspection efficiency and improving the reliability of inspection results.
assignees: HUANENG XINDIAN POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Large power grid operation real-time scheduling method based on model predictive control
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large power grid operation real-time scheduling method based on model predictive control, which relates to the technical field of intelligent control and comprises the steps of carrying out feature extraction on historical operation data and weather predictive information of a power grid to generate fusion feature data, generating power grid load predictive data through a deep learning predictive model, calculating voltage phasors, line power flows and frequency deviations of power grid nodes based on the preprocessed power grid operation data to generate a power grid state estimation result, utilizing the power grid state estimation result to identify potential abnormal modes through a machine learning algorithm to generate a power grid early warning signal, evaluating complexity and constraint tensioning degree of scheduling problems according to the power grid early warning signal and the power grid state estimation result to generate an optimizer selection result, and carrying out preprocessing, deep learning load prediction, high-precision state estimation and model predictive control by fusing multi-source data to quickly generate reliable control instructions, so that comprehensive improvement of safety, instantaneity and adaptability is realized.
assignees: HUANENG YIMIN COAL & ELECTRICITY CO LTD;NORTHEAST BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA

title_en: Power distribution network state estimation method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power distribution network state estimation method and system in the technical field of power distribution networks, and the method comprises the following steps of establishing a power distribution network state estimation model comprising a state equation and a measurement equation, carrying out state prediction based on the state equation to obtain a state prediction value and an error covariance prediction matrix, carrying out measurement prediction to obtain an error covariance measurement initial matrix and a cross covariance initial matrix, calculating an fading factor, updating the error covariance prediction matrix by using the fading factor to obtain an error covariance prediction adjustment matrix, carrying out measurement prediction based on the error covariance prediction adjustment matrix to obtain an error covariance measurement update matrix and a cross covariance update matrix, carrying out state estimation update, and updating an observation noise covariance based on an update result, thereby solving the problems that the existing power distribution network state estimation method cannot accurately model unknown noise, is difficult to effectively track the rapid change of a system, and the estimation accuracy and the robustness are obviously reduced.
assignees: KERUN INTELLIGENT CONTROL CO LTD

title_en: Multi-dimensional parameter health monitoring system and method for offshore wind power tower
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-dimensional parameter health monitoring system and method for an offshore wind turbine tower. The multi-source sensing module integrates a triaxial acceleration sensor, an optical fiber strain gauge, a corrosion rate probe and other devices, acquires structural response, environmental load and corrosion data in real time, the data preprocessing module improves data quality by adopting a self-adaptive Kalman filtering and multi-mode standardization method, the feature extraction module extracts 28-dimensional feature vectors through time domain statistics, frequency domain power spectrum and wavelet transformation, the state evaluation module outputs a health state index (SHI) based on a bidirectional LSTM-Attention model, the uncertainty quantization is realized by combining a Monte Carlo Dropout, the early warning output module triggers three-level grading early warning according to an SHI threshold, the linkage digital twin system realizes three-dimensional visualization and intelligent report generation, and the operation and maintenance intelligent level of the offshore wind power tower can be effectively improved.
assignees: SENKONG TECH JIANGSU CO LTD

title_en: Operation data analysis method for compact multi-loop feeder cabinet
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to the technical field of big data analysis and discloses an operation data analysis method for a compact multi-loop feed cabinet, which comprises the following steps of S1, collecting multi-dimensional feed cabinet data, namely constructing a multi-dimensional feed cabinet data set; the method comprises the steps of S2, preprocessing multi-dimensional data, namely constructing a multi-dimensional power feeding cabinet data characteristic set, S3, carrying out edge-cloud collaborative analysis, namely obtaining a power feeding cabinet comprehensive operation state evaluation index, S4, carrying out power feeding cabinet operation state evaluation, namely judging the operation state grade of the multi-loop power feeding cabinet, constructing a multi-loop power feeding cabinet digital twin model, S5, carrying out power feeding cabinet operation state adjustment, S6, carrying out data feedback and model optimization, namely constructing a fault case library, regularly optimizing model parameters and control strategies based on newly-added data, and effectively adapting to the high loop density and the complex electromagnetic environment scene through aiming at the characteristic acquisition parameters of the compact multi-loop power feeding cabinet, and rapidly positioning the fault physical position through the digital twin model, thereby effectively improving the fault positioning efficiency.
assignees: KUNSHAN UNELECTRA ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: CNN-BiLSTM-based dynamic filling method for electric power measurement data
abstract_en: The invention provides a CNN-BiLSTM-based dynamic filling method for electric power measurement data, which is based on history synchronous similar data and adopts a convolutional neural network and a two-way long-short-term memory network to realize dynamic missing filling of data sent on a platform intelligent fusion terminal. The invention takes time sequence characteristics, history characteristics, relativity among data and other influencing factors of electric power measurement data into consideration, and constructs a data dynamic prediction model based on a CNN-BiLSTM network, wherein a convolutional neural network CNN is adopted to extract local characteristics of data, a two-way long-short-term memory network is adopted to learn time sequence characteristics, relativity and history characteristics of the measurement data, finally, based on a dynamic fusion strategy, the missing data is dynamically filled by combining the history characteristics and prediction results, and filling effect evaluation is carried out under different scenes. The method is simple, easy to implement, high in generalization capability and accuracy, and can adapt to scenes with high deletion rate and complex data.

title_en: Digital twinning-based power data processing method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based power data processing method and system, which relate to the field of power, and comprise the steps of carrying out data acquisition on power equipment, establishing a patrol cockpit, modeling, simulating and monitoring the power equipment by utilizing a computer technology and a digital twin technology, uploading a three-dimensional design result model, carrying out intelligent security integrated management and control on the power equipment, carrying out visual patrol, simulating the operation of the power equipment based on the digital twin technology, simulating the operation fault of the power equipment, optimizing the power equipment and providing decision support. According to the invention, by utilizing a digital twin-based power data processing method, the three-dimensional model of the power equipment is built by collecting and processing the data of the power equipment, so that operation and maintenance personnel can intuitively monitor the state of the equipment and timely discover and process potential faults, and potential risks can be identified in advance and corresponding inspection reports can be generated by simulating and simulating the faults of the equipment.
assignees: ANHUI HUAIHE ENERGY XIEQIAO POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Energy storage system economical evaluation method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy storage system economical evaluation method, an energy storage system economical evaluation system and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of energy storage systems. The method comprises the steps of acquiring operation data, electric power market transaction data and equipment state data of an energy storage system in real time through a multi-source data acquisition module, screening key influence factors through a dynamic characteristic engineering module, constructing a comprehensive evaluation index system integrating market characteristics, technical characteristics and environmental characteristics, constructing an economy prediction model based on an LSTM neural network, inputting data of the comprehensive evaluation index system into the economy prediction model, outputting multi-time-scale economy evaluation results including short-term gain prediction, medium-term probabilistic gain interval and long-term attenuation correction evaluation, generating a gain-risk balance charging and discharging strategy through a reinforcement learning algorithm, previewing strategy effects in a digital twin environment, and dynamically adjusting high-risk operation. The accuracy and the adaptability of the energy storage system economic evaluation can be remarkably improved.
assignees: UNIV CENTRAL SOUTH

title_en: Enterprise relation graph construction system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of enterprise atlas construction and discloses an enterprise relationship atlas construction system. The enterprise data acquisition module acquires business registration information, investment relation data and business state change data of a plurality of enterprise entities in real time, transmits acquired enterprise basic data to the stock right relation analysis module, performs stock right penetration calculation on the received enterprise basic data to generate a direct stock control relation and an indirect stock holding proportion among enterprises to form a preliminary stock right relation chain, the map generation control module constructs an enterprise relation network topology comprising a plurality of layers of stock holding relations according to the preliminary stock right relation chain and a preset enterprise association degree judgment rule, and the map dynamic update module continuously monitors newly-added data streams and triggers node recombination and connection weight adjustment of the enterprise relation network topology when the variation of a specific enterprise stock right structure is detected. The system realizes the accurate construction and real-time updating of enterprise relations and clearly presents multi-layer equity association.
assignees: BEIJING MICROORANGE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for reconstructing missing power data of photovoltaic energy storage facility
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for reconstructing missing power data of a photovoltaic energy storage facility, and relates to the technical field of photovoltaic energy storage. The method comprises the steps of data preprocessing, cleaning, standardizing, wavelet decomposing and equipment ageing correcting of acquired historical power data and meteorological data of the photovoltaic energy storage facility, constructing a multi-model fusion framework which comprises an improved time sequence model, a meteorological-cloud layer association model, an optimized similar day model and a space distance weight model, training each model by utilizing the preprocessed data, inputting effective data before and after missing data into the trained models to obtain a prediction result of each model, and obtaining final reconstruction data through dynamic weighting fusion. According to the application, the space-time characteristics, equipment aging, cloud cover shielding and other factors are comprehensively considered, the accuracy and reliability of missing power data reconstruction are obviously improved, and powerful support is provided for the optimal operation and management of the photovoltaic energy storage system.
assignees: HARBIN INST TECHNOLOGY WEIHAI

title_en: Digital twinning-based intelligent operation and maintenance system for grounding network and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a digital twinning-based intelligent operation and maintenance system for a grounding network and computer equipment. The method comprises the steps of generating a multi-factor coupled corrosion dynamics equation based on a laboratory grounding grid steel sheet accelerated corrosion test, wherein the corrosion dynamics equation is used for predicting the instantaneous corrosion rate of a galvanized steel sheet and estimating the steel sheet quality corrosion loss in a specified time, combining the corrosion dynamics equation with a simulation model to establish a steel sheet corrosion data set, training a physical information neural network to construct a corrosion prediction physical model, training the corrosion prediction physical model by adopting a neural network regression algorithm, constructing a grounding grid digital twin model by taking the corrosion prediction physical model as a base and combining with on-site environment monitoring data, defining a Markov decision process in the grounding grid digital twin environment, training by adopting a near-end strategy optimization algorithm based on feedback and a reward function of the grounding grid digital twin model to obtain an intelligent decision body, and continuously optimizing the decision of the intelligent decision body by an on-line fine tuning function.
assignees: NANNING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network twinning management method, system, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The application provides a power distribution network twin management method, a system, a storage medium and a program product, and relates to the technical field of power digital twin. The method comprises the steps of obtaining operation data of a power distribution network system, tracing a power quality disturbance source according to the operation data based on a disturbance source equivalent model when the operation data represent that the power quality disturbance exists in the power distribution network system, obtaining a power quality disturbance source positioning result, determining target treatment measures aiming at the power quality disturbance source positioning result according to the power quality disturbance source positioning result, carrying out panoramic simulation deduction on the power quality of a target power distribution network area based on the target treatment measures to obtain a power quality treatment simulation result, carrying out power quality treatment by applying the target treatment measures to the target power distribution network area when the power quality treatment simulation result meets preset requirements, and visually displaying power quality comparison results before and after treatment of the target power distribution network area. The method is used for improving the electric energy quality evaluation accuracy and the tracing accuracy.
assignees: SHANTOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power grid load prediction and scheduling optimization system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence-based power grid load prediction and scheduling optimization system, in particular relates to the technical field of power system automation, and solves the technical problems of low precision of traditional power grid load prediction, poor robustness of scheduling strategies and insufficient coordination of source network load storage. The multi-source heterogeneous data space-time alignment is realized by constructing a data acquisition layer based on edge calculation, a load prediction result is generated by adopting an AI prediction module fused by a graph convolution network and an attention mechanism, a source network load storage collaborative scheduling scheme is generated by a multi-target risk hedging optimization algorithm, and closed-loop optimization is realized by utilizing digital twin pre-verification and increment learning. And finally, the load prediction accuracy, the scheduling decision reliability and the system self-adaptive capacity of the new energy access environment are improved.
assignees: Xinjiang information industry co ltd

title_en: Method and system for coordinated prediction control of heat absorption, heat storage and power generation of tower type photo-thermal power station
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of tower type photo-thermal power station control, and provides a method and a system for coordinated prediction control of heat absorption, heat storage and power generation of a tower type photo-thermal power station, wherein cold salt pump flow, hot salt pump flow and steam turbine valve opening are used as input variables, and the molten salt outlet temperature of a heat absorber, main steam pressure and power generation power are used as output variables to establish a state space model of the tower type photo-thermal power station system; and the state space model is converted into an incremental expansion state space model, so that the indirect coupling effect of limited heat storage capacity to the heat absorption and power generation subsystems is disclosed, meanwhile, other coupling effects among the heat absorption, heat storage and power generation subsystems are fully considered, the state estimation is carried out by adopting a dynamic Kalman filter according to the prediction model and the performance index function of coordinated prediction control constructed by considering the liquid level constraint of the heat storage tank, and the controller parameters are obtained, so that the load tracking performance and the running stability of the tower type photo-thermal power station are effectively improved.
assignees: SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER ENGINEERING CONSULTING INST CORP LTD

title_en: Transmission line operation and maintenance simulation system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transmission line operation and maintenance simulation system based on a digital twin technology, which relates to the technical field of intelligent operation and maintenance and simulation of electric power systems, and comprises a data acquisition module, a model construction and adjustment module and a comparison analysis module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring real-time operation state data of a transmission line and establishing a data link, the data comprises meteorological information, current-carrying capacity, temperature, tension and wire sag multi-source heterogeneous operation state data, the model construction and adjustment module is used for constructing or adjusting virtual simulation model parameters based on the real-time operation state data, the comparison analysis module is used for carrying out multi-dimensional comparison analysis on an updated virtual simulation model and an actual transmission line, the comparison dimension comprises tension change trend, wire vibration response and thermal stability distribution, and the transmission line operation and maintenance simulation system based on the digital twin technology improves the automation, intellectualization and scientization level of transmission line operation and maintenance management.
assignees: SHOUGUANG BRANCH OF SHANDONG WUZHOU ELECTRIC CO LTD;STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO SHOUGUANG POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Basic unit emergency management service vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency management, and discloses a basic-level emergency management service vehicle which is used as post sentry post equipment for basic-level emergency management, and comprises an integrated intelligent command, emergency energy, ring generation monitoring, miniature fire protection, propaganda response, treatment instruments and an isolated transfer seven-function system, wherein the functional system is a modularized emergency management intelligent platform, each system is an independent assembly unit, instant assembly is realized through a bus architecture, an intelligent command center maps the field environment by means of a digital twin technology and combines an AI decision engine to generate a task allocation and resource scheduling scheme, and an intelligent cooperative cluster system and a terrain self-adaptive system respectively realize intelligent networking cooperation and terrain self-adaptive adjustment of multiple vehicles. The invention can remarkably improve the daily prevention and early warning management level of basic emergency management, the flexibility, the synergy and the scene suitability of the track staff, has high effect on the management and control of diversified emergency treatments, and plays an pioneering role in daily work and capacity construction of basic emergency management.
assignees: CHONGQING GUOXING YIMIN INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Distribution area fluctuation load early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution area fluctuating load early warning method and a distribution area fluctuating load early warning system, and relates to the technical field of intelligent monitoring and control of an electric power distribution network. The method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model synchronous with an operation state, carrying out time domain and frequency domain joint analysis on a digital twin data set, extracting a power amplitude change rate and a phase jump index, generating a load fluctuation vector, determining a self-adaptive threshold value based on the statistical characteristic and historical load distribution of the load fluctuation vector, generating a primary early warning signal when fluctuation exceeds a limit, adopting a distributed collaborative analysis algorithm to identify a dominant load source and an unbalanced class, carrying out correlation analysis on a dominant load source identification result and the primary early warning signal, generating comprehensive early warning information, and outputting the comprehensive early warning information to a power distribution area monitoring platform to realize dynamic visualization and intelligent regulation. The method can realize real-time identification and active early warning of the fluctuating load of the distribution area, and improves the safety and the intelligent level of the operation of the system.
assignees: BAICHENG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Three-dimensional digital twin-driven full life cycle visual operation system for wind farm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional digital twin-driven wind power plant full life cycle visual operation system, which relates to the field of wind power plant operation and comprises a data acquisition module, a modeling display module, a device monitoring processing module and a processing execution module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring and receiving wind power plant data to acquire a wind power plant data set, the modeling display module is used for constructing a three-dimensional model through the wind power plant data set and outputting three-dimensional model display data, the device monitoring processing module is used for presetting a past device state database, monitoring the device state and analyzing the past device state database and the three-dimensional model display data to acquire a device parameter set, and the processing execution module is used for analyzing the wind power plant data set and the device parameter set to output spare part instructions. The method aims at solving the technical problems that full life cycle data are difficult to fuse, the best spare part replacement time is calculated quantitatively, and the equipment state is matched with the cost effectiveness in the prior art.
assignees: RUICHENG JINGUANGFENG WIND POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Wind power plant output prediction method based on EIG model
abstract_en: A wind power plant output prediction method based on an EIG model belongs to the field of wind power plant output prediction. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a target wind power plant historical output data set, processing missing data and normalizing, constructing a data sample set matrix, taking output at a certain moment and historical output in the past for a period of time as an output value and an input value respectively, training a basic prediction model to obtain a preliminary prediction result, training an error prediction model through a difference value between the preliminary result and actual output, combining the two models to form an EIG prediction model, inputting the historical data before the moment to be predicted to obtain a prediction result, and updating the input to obtain the result of any future period of time. According to the method, the accuracy of wind power plant output prediction is improved through data processing, model training and error compensation, grid-connected impact can be reduced, and stable operation of a power system is ensured.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Automatic CAD-based debris flow circulation area slope material source dynamic reserve estimation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic CAD-based debris flow circulation area slope material source dynamic reserve estimation method, which relates to the technical field of mountain disasters and comprises the following steps: step one, acquiring object source section geometrical data and constructing an AutoCAD digital twin model of the integrated object source section geometrical data, the channel distribution length and the channel boundary topological relation. The invention provides a channel runoff strong hydrodynamic direct flushing area + Slump response zone +Rainfall and slope runoff weak hydrodynamic progressive erosion area The partition coupling mechanism decomposes the erosion process into the synergistic effect of multiple physical mechanisms, and compared with the prior method, the method considers different damage modes of different parts of the slope surface collapse object source body, and meets the requirement of finely estimating the slope surface object source dynamic reserve.
assignees: UNIV CAS;INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Power distribution network risk auxiliary decision-making method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network risk auxiliary decision-making method, a system, equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source data of a power grid; the method comprises the steps of carrying out protocol unified conversion on power grid multisource data, converting a plurality of heterogeneous communication protocols into a unified data format, carrying out real-time analysis and anomaly detection on the converted power grid multisource data through an edge calculation layer to generate edge layer early warning information, uploading the edge layer early warning information and key detection data to a cloud platform layer to carry out deep data analysis, constructing a power distribution network digital twin model by utilizing historical operation data to generate equipment fault risk assessment data and space risk distribution data, and carrying out multi-channel early warning release on a power distribution network risk assessment result and an emergency treatment scheme. The risk auxiliary decision-making system of the power distribution network adopts a five-layer architecture, and improves the comprehensiveness and instantaneity of risk monitoring of the power distribution network in extreme weather through multi-source heterogeneous data fusion and edge-cloud cooperative processing.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power transmission line icing prediction method, system, equipment and medium based on satellite data assimilation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for predicting icing of a power transmission line based on satellite data assimilation, which relate to the technical field of ice and snow monitoring and comprise the steps of obtaining satellite microwave emissivity observation data, generating meshed meteorological data by integrating the data assimilation observation data with a numerical mode background field, and processing the meshed meteorological data by utilizing a space-time feature joint modeling technology, reconstructing the meteorological data of continuous time steps into space-time coupled four-dimensional tensors, synchronously extracting space-time dimension dynamic evolution features through three-dimensional convolution kernels, fusing historical states and current features based on a gating mechanism, and outputting a spatial distribution prediction result of the icing thickness of the power transmission corridor. According to the invention, by acquiring the high-precision meteorological field and synchronously extracting the space-time dynamic characteristics of icing evolution, combining with an improved gating mechanism and attention screening key meteorological factors, the accurate closed-loop simulation of icing of the power transmission corridor is realized based on iterative prediction of physical constraint, and the accuracy and reliability of icing early warning are remarkably improved.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Chemical industry park distributed state estimation method and system considering multi-energy mass flow dynamics
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of distributed state estimation, and provides a chemical industry park distributed state estimation method and system taking into account multi-energy mass flow dynamics, wherein a state space model of a power distribution network, a heat supply network, a chemical material flow network and the like and a coupling element model of hydrogen/ammonia/methanol chemical production equipment are constructed according to time sequence coupling of electric and thermal heterogeneous mass energy flows and hydrogen/ammonia/alcohol multi-element material flows and differential dynamic characteristics thereof, so that a green electrochemical industry park real-time state estimation model taking into account mass-energy coupling and dynamic characteristics is constructed; the method takes a particle filtering algorithm as a framework, builds distributed state estimation based on an asynchronous parallel architecture, solves the problem of data privacy between electric power and chemical subsystems, and builds a green chemical park multi-time scale distributed state estimation architecture combined with an innovation triggering mechanism. The invention solves the problems of measurement uploading period difference and calculation resource waste caused by time constant difference among different networks.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG

title_en: Water conservancy information automation and security control method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of water conservancy informatization, and provides a water conservancy information automation and safety control method and system, comprising the following steps that S1, water level, flow, water quality, weather and engineering structure safety data are collected in real time through an Internet of things sensing device deployed on a water conservancy project site; the method comprises the steps of S2, constructing a digital twin model comprising four-dimensional linkage of forecasting, early warning and planning based on historical disaster data, real-time monitoring data and hydraulic engineering characteristic parameters, S3, sending a control instruction to an executing mechanism through an Internet of things platform according to a risk assessment result, and realizing automatic acquisition, processing, analysis and intelligent decision of hydraulic information through integrating advanced technologies such as Internet of things, edge calculation, deep learning, digital twin, reinforcement learning and the like, wherein the real-time monitoring, early warning and emergency response capability of the hydraulic engineering is remarkably improved, the safe operation of the hydraulic engineering is ensured, the resource allocation is optimized, and the management efficiency is improved.
assignees: ZHANG XIAOFEI

title_en: Cable quality detection method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a cable quality detection method, a system, equipment and a storage medium, which belong to the technical field of power cables; the method comprises the steps of inputting target data into a pre-built digital twin model to obtain quality parameters of a cable to be tested, wherein the pre-built digital twin model is used for converting the target data into the quality parameters capable of quantifying the quality of the cable, judging a threshold range of the quality parameters based on a quality standard database, judging the quality grade of the cable to be tested to be qualified if the quality parameters meet a first condition, judging the quality grade of the cable to be tested to be unqualified if the quality parameters do not meet a second condition, and judging the quality grade of the cable to be tested to be unqualified if the quality parameters are not met, wherein the first condition is that the quality parameters are in the threshold range of the quality standard database. The cable quality detection method, the system, the equipment and the storage medium can realize the accurate detection of the cable quality in the production period and the composite scene, and improve the detection efficiency.
assignees: GONGNIU CABLE HEBEI CO LTD

title_en: Emergency command control method and system based on Beidou emergency patrol car
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency command control method and system based on a Beidou emergency patrol car, which are characterized in that a multi-source sensor network is deployed to acquire various signal data from a complex environment, and data fusion processing is carried out for the condition of communication signal interruption to determine a preliminary position estimation result; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a preliminary position estimation result, carrying out optimization adjustment on positioning accuracy by adopting a positioning algorithm based on multi-source data correction to obtain high-accuracy positioning data, constructing a live-action dynamic model frame through the high-accuracy positioning data, fusing terrain and obstacle distribution characteristics, obtaining related information of environmental change perception, determining a real-time updated three-dimensional scene description, analyzing the requirement of dynamic resource allocation according to the real-time updated three-dimensional scene description, and identifying key nodes and resource distribution states in multiparty collaborative command to obtain a priority sequence of resource allocation. The invention realizes full-flow automation and intellectualization, reduces the manual intervention cost and improves the emergency response speed.
assignees: HUNAN YUNDONG CULTURAL SPORTS IND DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;HUNAN AUTOMOTIVE ENG VOCATIONAL COLLEGE

title_en: Open source hong-Mongolian-based visualized application construction method for digital intelligence water service data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing visual application of digital intelligent water service data based on open source hong Mongolian, which comprises the steps of connecting a sensor and a GIS pipe network through an open source hong Mongolian system, collecting and aligning water service data, identifying abnormal values of the sensor in the data of Ji Shui by utilizing a self-adaptive threshold algorithm, filling the missing data by utilizing a KNN adjacent algorithm, fusing the target water service data with pipe network node connectivity, inputting the water service space-time characteristic matrix into an improved 3D-ResNet neural network model for mapping, constructing a three-dimensional water service digital twin system in the open source hong Mongolian system based on BIM+GIS technology, and inputting the water service state evaluation index into the three-dimensional water service digital twin system for visual display. The water affair management personnel can master the running condition of the water affair system comprehensively in real time, and abnormal nodes and potential risks can be positioned rapidly.
assignees: GUIZHOU HUAXU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Active disconnection and island operation method based on load importance degree under disaster condition
abstract_en: The invention relates to an active disconnection and island operation method based on load importance under disaster conditions, and belongs to the technical field of power systems and automation thereof. The method comprises the steps of constructing a dynamic grading system of load importance based on disaster types and power supply area characteristics, optimizing weights through a hierarchical analysis-index weight optimization cooperative algorithm and combining real-time updating to generate grading results, deploying a wide area and local monitoring device to collect power grid data, setting a safety threshold, triggering a disconnection decision when the trend is worsened, calculating a instability rate through a multi-parameter cooperative instability pre-judging algorithm and starting pre-disconnection preparation, calling a target disconnection section optimization algorithm to determine a section through the combination of the grading results and the power grid data, generating a disconnection instruction after island stability is verified through power flow calculation, and performing classification stability control on isolated islands. The invention can realize accurate load grading and advanced destabilization prejudgement, ensure important load power supply such as medical treatment, reduce catastrophe loss and is suitable for power grid management and control under various disasters.
assignees: JIANGSHAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Construction method and system of digital twin body of hydraulic and hydroelectric engineering
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intellectualization of hydraulic and hydroelectric engineering, in particular to a method and a system for constructing a digital twin body of the hydraulic and hydroelectric engineering. The method comprises the steps of constructing a three-dimensional model of the hydraulic and hydroelectric engineering, dividing the hydraulic and hydroelectric engineering into a plurality of substructures, collecting space-time data in the hydraulic and hydroelectric engineering, wherein the space-time data comprises hydrologic data and meteorological data, building a space-time diagram structure according to the plurality of substructures and the space-time data of the hydraulic and hydroelectric engineering, constructing a digital twin body of the hydraulic and hydroelectric engineering based on a space-time diagram attention network, a physical constraint nerve radiation field and a deep reinforcement learning model, inputting the space-time diagram structure into the digital twin body, and outputting scheduling instructions of the hydraulic and hydroelectric engineering. The digital twin body established by the invention realizes the accurate simulation of the hydraulic and hydroelectric engineering scheduling strategy by combining a space-time diagram attention network, a physical constraint neural radiation field and a deep reinforcement learning model, thereby intelligently generating corresponding scheduling decisions.

title_en: Port shore power system running state prediction method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of data processing, and particularly relates to a method and a system for predicting the running state of a port shore power system based on digital twinning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a combined feature space integrating the internal running state and the external environment influence of the system, constructing a dynamic instability map reflecting the change sensitivity of the system under different running situations, designing a self-adaptive kernel bandwidth function based on the dynamic instability map, realizing the self-adaptive adjustment of the model observation scale, weighting historical data according to the self-adaptive kernel bandwidth function, solving the problem of local weighted least square, obtaining a prediction model parameter specific to the situation, and predicting the future running state of the system in real time. The method effectively solves the problem that the traditional fixed-scale model is difficult to consider precision and robustness under complex and variable working conditions, improves the prediction capability of the key fluctuation period, and provides data support for safe and efficient operation of the port shore power system.
assignees: SHANDONG BOS ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for checking error result based on station gateway metering point
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for checking an error result of a metering point of a station gateway, wherein the method comprises the steps of synchronously collecting real-time dynamic data and historical operation data of the station gateway, and preprocessing the collected data; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a theoretical load curve of a power grid dispatching system, comparing preprocessed metering data with the theoretical load curve, calculating an initial error value, constructing a digital twin simulation model based on equipment state data and historical operation data, correcting the initial error value by using simulation residual errors to obtain a corrected error value, dynamically calculating an allowable error range according to the equipment state data and the environmental data, and carrying out error classification based on the corrected error value. The invention can effectively solve the problems in the prior art, remarkably improve the efficiency and accuracy of error checking of the station gateway metering point and provide powerful guarantee for the stable operation of the power system.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning technology-based scheduling operation ticket execution process monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dispatch operation ticket execution process monitoring method based on a digital twin technology, which belongs to the field of electric power system detection and comprises the steps of obtaining a step sequence and logic association from an operation ticket, analyzing and generating a data set, constructing a logic dependency graph and a digital twin instance, analyzing the matching degree of a step precondition and a real-time state, identifying a failure step and generating alarm information, inquiring equipment interaction records, extracting a dynamic change factor list causing state conflict, analyzing and obtaining a subsequent step influence weight by combining the logic dependency graph, identifying a high risk step, calling the state evolution of digital twin instance simulation equipment, evaluating potential chain reaction risk, adjusting the step sequence of the operation ticket according to the triggering probability of a protection device, generating a dispatch instruction set meeting the real-time state, monitoring deviation in real time and generating a dynamic correction instruction, verifying the correction instruction and generating an operation ticket scheme. The intelligent level and the safety of the execution of the dispatching operation ticket are improved, and the power grid accident caused by misoperation is effectively prevented.
assignees: QINGDAO HUANGDAO POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Intelligent operation and maintenance management system for distributed photovoltaic project
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent operation and maintenance management system for a distributed photovoltaic project, which relates to the technical field of project operation and maintenance management, wherein 18 kinds of perception terminals are deployed, 5G+LoRa networking is adopted, millisecond-level snapshot is carried out during abnormal time, data is uploaded after being processed by edge nodes, a 1:1 holographic model is built by a digital twin operation and maintenance center, equipment states are mapped in real time, fault conditions are simulated, a self-adaptive evolution fault diagnosis module fuses multisource data to generate a fault tree, a dynamic scheduling module integrates resources to generate a dispatching scheme to support unmanned aerial vehicle inspection, an energy efficiency self-adaptive optimization module links energy storage peak regulation, an MPPT strategy is optimized, and an active safety protection module rapidly handles and alarms when detecting abnormality. The invention improves the operation and maintenance efficiency and the power generation efficiency of the photovoltaic project, reduces the cost, ensures the safety, digs the comprehensive value and is suitable for various distributed photovoltaic projects.
assignees: LIAONING LISHENG ELECTRIC POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-source data fault operation and maintenance decision method and system based on point cloud model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a point cloud model-based multi-source data fault operation and maintenance decision method and a point cloud model-based multi-source data fault operation and maintenance decision system, which belong to the technical field of intelligent power grid operation and maintenance management and comprise the steps of collecting power distribution point cloud data and constructing a power distribution point cloud model; the method comprises the steps of carrying out point cloud reconstruction on missing data in a point cloud model through virtual repair, carrying out physical mapping on the reconstructed point cloud model to identify invisible faults, driving hierarchical operation and maintenance with bidirectional sensitivity, and constructing multi-objective optimization modeling to carry out power transmission maintenance optimization. The invention forms a data acquisition-model reconstruction-fault positioning-decision execution closed loop, and realizes triple breakthroughs of invisible fault early screening, resource elastic allocation and operation and maintenance economical efficiency improvement in the power transmission and transformation field for the first time.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin emergency resource scheduling method and system for multi-disaster coupling deduction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin emergency resource scheduling method and a system for multi-disaster coupling deduction, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring a plurality of sensing data corresponding to a target area; predicting current disaster information corresponding to the target area according to the trained multi-disaster prediction model and the sensing data, reasoning to obtain future disaster information corresponding to the target area according to the current disaster information and a disaster cascade reasoning model, and calculating to obtain a medical resource scheduling scheme corresponding to the target area based on a digital twin model according to the current disaster information and the future disaster information. Therefore, the invention can realize accurate medical resource scheduling based on multi-disaster prediction and digital twinning, improve disaster response efficiency and resource allocation rationality, and reduce rescue delay risks caused by improper disaster prediction or scheduling.
assignees: GUANGZHOU RED CROSS HOSPITAL

title_en: Multi-scale tensor map space-time network wind power prediction method integrating space-time correlation and environmental factors
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-scale tensor graph space-time network wind power prediction method integrating space-time correlation and environmental factors, which comprises the steps of firstly decomposing based on tensor loops, combining graph structure constraint, time smooth constraint and non-negative constraint, realizing high-quality completion of incomplete wind power data, and dynamically balancing the importance of constraint items through a self-adaptive weight mechanism; and finally, constructing a double-layer dynamic graph structure consisting of a long-term dependency graph and a short-term dependency graph, dynamically adjusting edge weights by combining a physical model, and realizing time sequence modeling of multiple time spans in the multi-scale expansion time convolution. The method can reconstruct missing data effectively, accurately delineate complex space-time dependency relationship among fans, give consideration to minute-level wind speed mutation and hour-level environmental change characteristics, and show higher precision and stability in long-term prediction tasks.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST;NANJING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Multi-mode data driving-based power distribution network equipment state evaluation and optimization method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of data processing, and particularly relates to a multi-mode data-driven power distribution network equipment state evaluation and optimization method, which comprises the steps of S1, multi-source data fusion, S2, deep learning model optimization, S3, edge calculation deployment, S4, digital twin modeling, S5, multi-target dynamic optimization, multi-source data fusion integrates multiple data sources such as electric signals, infrared images, vibration signals and environmental parameters, and the like, so that multiple aspects of equipment operation are comprehensively covered, the limitation of relying on only a single data source is avoided, corresponding preprocessing methods are adopted for different types of data, effective characteristics of various types of data are extracted, the extracted characteristics are integrated to form unified characteristic vectors, unified characteristic space is constructed, data islands are eliminated through PCA dimension reduction, the effective fusion utilization of the multi-source data is realized, and the problem of insufficient data utilization is avoided based on the effective characteristic.
assignees: CHENGDU YUNANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent park digital twin model construction method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of digital twinning, in particular to a method for constructing a digital twinning model of an intelligent park based on multi-source data fusion, which comprises the steps of collecting multi-source data of the intelligent park, and constructing a digital twinning platform of the intelligent park so as to acquire the production efficiency and the total power of electricity consumption of workshops in the intelligent park and the electricity storage quantity of renewable electricity resource stations in real time; the method comprises the steps of screening workshops to be regulated, obtaining the change coefficient of each workshop to be regulated at each moment, obtaining the availability of each renewable power resource station to each workshop to be regulated at each moment and the dispatching cost of each power grid access point to each workshop to be regulated, determining the optimal electric quantity for carrying out power dispatching on each workshop to be regulated at each moment, and carrying out power dispatching on each workshop to be regulated at each moment. The application aims to ensure the stable and efficient operation of production equipment in an intelligent park by acquiring an optimal power dispatching scheme and further carrying out power dispatching.
assignees: SUZHOU WUTU DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based power grid dynamic frequency self-adaptive regulation and control method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based power grid dynamic frequency self-adaptive regulation and control method, a system, equipment and a medium, which belong to the technical field of power grid dynamic frequency regulation and control and comprise the steps of collecting power grid operation data through a data acquisition device arranged at a key node of a physical power grid; the method comprises the steps of transmitting power grid operation data to a digital twin construction and operation platform, synchronously updating virtual power grid states in real time, obtaining power grid operation states and dynamic parameters by the aid of the digital twin construction and operation platform, predicting frequency dynamic response tracks of a power grid in disturbance or expected scenes based on the power grid operation states and the dynamic parameters, adjusting control parameters of participating frequency regulation resources according to the frequency dynamic response tracks, and sending the control parameters to a corresponding device of a physical power grid through a control instruction execution interface to be executed. The invention obviously improves the dynamic quality of the frequency of the power grid, and improves the frequency stability margin and the overall operation safety.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Virtual power plant multi-target carbon economy optimization method based on group intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of collaborative optimization of virtual power plants, and discloses a multi-target carbon economy optimization method of a virtual power plant based on group intelligence, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a digital twin body of the virtual power plant, and synchronizing distributed energy output, load demand and carbon emission data of a physical VPP (virtual power plant) in real time; the method comprises the steps of S2, establishing a double-target optimization model capable of carbon economy, S3, solving the double-target optimization model through an improved group intelligent algorithm, wherein the algorithm dynamically adjusts the weights of economy and carbon emission targets, S4, outputting a Pareto optimal solution set based on real-time data of a digital twin body.
