abstract_en: The invention relates to a short-term wind power prediction method and system based on digital twin, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting operation data of wind power equipment, calling a simulation algorithm to process the operation data, constructing operation simulation models of all the equipment, and updating the operation simulation models in real time by utilizing an operation scheme of the wind power equipment; the method comprises the steps of obtaining wind power data of an updated operation simulation model, inputting the wind power data into a wind power short-term prediction model to obtain a wind power short-term prediction result, wherein the wind power short-term prediction model is obtained by training an LSTM prediction model through a training set, and the training set comprises original wind power data. The method can better adapt to different wind power equipment and operation scenes, improves the generalization capability of the model, and reduces the influence of equipment difference and operation environment change on the prediction precision.
assignees: JILIN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Comprehensive energy system fault identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault identification method and system for a comprehensive energy system, and relates to the field of comprehensive energy. The comprehensive energy system fault identification method and system comprise the following steps of firstly constructing a digital twin model of a comprehensive energy system, secondly simulating operation states of the comprehensive energy system under different fault types based on the digital twin model, thirdly extracting characteristics of a fault sample data set, fourthly constructing a fusion fault identification model based on a deep belief network and a support vector machine, fifthly acquiring real-time operation data of the comprehensive energy system in real time, and sixthly inputting real-time fault characteristic vectors into the trained fusion fault identification model. According to the comprehensive energy system fault identification method and system, the fault identification precision can be improved, the feature extraction is carried out through an improved principal component analysis algorithm, the feature with high correlation degree with the fault type is highlighted by introducing the self-adaptive weight factor, and the interference of irrelevant features is reduced.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY PINGDU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Production management system for coal enterprises
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of enterprise production management, in particular to a coal enterprise production management system, which comprises a data acquisition module, wherein the data acquisition module acquires environmental data in real time based on an underground sensor network, the environmental data comprises gas concentration data, roof pressure data and constructor data, a dynamic region risk thermodynamic diagram is built based on a machine learning model, the underground construction management module dynamically adjusts safety measures of a construction region based on the region risk thermodynamic diagram built by the data acquisition module, a construction task list is generated by combining geological modeling data and is distributed to a working team, the underground equipment management module builds a digital twin model of a mining machine and conveyor belt equipment based on the construction task list of the underground construction management module, predicts equipment degradation trend by utilizing a CNN-LSTM fusion model and generates a maintenance work order by acquiring real-time parameters of equipment vibration, temperature and current parameters.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA MENGTAI BULIANGOU COAL IND CO LTD

title_en: Trusted fusion method for supply chain carbon data based on edge calculation-blockchain-digital twin collaborative architecture
abstract_en: The invention provides a supply chain carbon data trusted fusion method based on an edge calculation-blockchain-digital twin collaborative architecture, which comprises the steps of deploying a carbon sensing terminal through an edge node to collect equipment-level carbon emission data in real time, performing light weight processing by utilizing an edge gateway and attaching a trusted identifier, constructing a layered blockchain network to achieve same-domain low-delay consensus and cross-domain intelligent contract verification, generating a space-time correlation hash chain in a blocking mode according to a process stage, constructing a carbon flow-process coupling model on a digital twin platform to dynamically load on-chain data, solving multi-objective optimization to generate a low-carbon process instruction and feeding the low-carbon process instruction back to an edge layer, and generating a verifiable carbon credential based on blockchain data. The method solves the problems of poor real-time performance, low reliability and difficult cross-domain verification of the carbon data of the supply chain, and realizes the whole-flow reliability traceability and dynamic optimization of the carbon footprint.
assignees: HAINAN INDUSTRY RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Wind-solar power prediction system and prediction method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wind-solar power prediction and discloses a wind-solar power prediction system and a prediction method based on artificial intelligence, wherein the system comprises a data acquisition processing module, a feature extraction module, an intelligent prediction module, a dynamic correction module, a blockchain verification module and a man-machine interaction module; before wind-solar power prediction model training, the original data is cleaned and filled by adopting an abnormal data detection algorithm based on 3 sigma criterion and box diagram analysis and an improved KNN missing data filling algorithm, so that noise and errors in the data can be identified and corrected, the quality of a generated standardized wind-solar power training sample set is ensured, prediction deviation is reduced, and a reliable data base is laid for generating a high-precision prediction result.
assignees: UNIV INNER MONGOLIA SCI & TECH

title_en: Data processing-based power inspection method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power inspection method and a system based on data processing, and relates to the technical field of power inspection, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting real-time environmental data of an inspection area; the method comprises the steps of processing environment data by adopting a Kalman filtering state estimation algorithm, outputting fused environment state information, dividing three-dimensional grids with fixed sizes, constructing a three-dimensional dynamic risk field model, calculating an optimal inspection path from a starting point to target equipment based on the model, positioning a maximum heat source point by adopting a gradient ascending algorithm when an unmanned plane flies to the vicinity of the target equipment, acquiring an inspection image, setting a multi-level risk threshold, and monitoring three-dimensional grid risk values on the path in real time. According to the invention, the inspection data under the extreme environment can be acquired through the multi-type sensor, the real-time three-dimensional dynamic risk field model is constructed, the risk level of each power region can be quantified, unmanned aerial vehicle equipment is prevented from entering the high risk region, the probability of guiding the unmanned aerial vehicle to the high risk region in extreme weather is reduced, and the method is suitable for complex scenes.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD INFORMATION & COMMUNICATION BRANCH

title_en: Intelligent power grid equipment early warning system and method based on Internet of things sensor network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent early warning system and method for power grid equipment based on an Internet of things sensor network, and relates to the technical field of intelligent early warning.A piece of Internet of things equipment is installed in a power grid equipment monitoring area, historical operation data of the power grid equipment is collected based on the installed piece of Internet of things equipment, meanwhile, the collected historical operation data of the power grid equipment is processed in a data processing mode based on the historical operation data of the power grid equipment, training analysis is carried out on the processed historical operation data in a data analysis mode after the processing is finished, real-time operation data of the power grid equipment are collected, and fault positions and types of the real-time operation data of the power grid equipment are determined in an intelligent judgment mode based on the analyzed historical operation data; after the position and the type of the power grid equipment fault are determined, the power grid equipment is subjected to fault early warning in a digital twin mode, and the timeliness of the power grid equipment fault early warning is improved.
assignees: XIAMEN MINTOU TECH SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Offshore wind power fault monitoring method based on knowledge graph and digital twin fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a knowledge graph and digital twin-based offshore wind power fault monitoring method, which aims at the problems that in the operation state monitoring of offshore wind power equipment, multisource data acquisition is scattered, transmission delay is high and real-time convergence and integration are difficult to realize; the intelligent early warning system comprises a knowledge map construction module, a digital twin modeling module, an intelligent early warning decision module, a visual interaction module and a third party interfacing support, wherein the knowledge map construction module solves the problems of extraction, fusion and storage of entity relationships of equipment, the digital twin modeling module achieves visual presentation and accurate simulation of physical equipment states, the fault monitoring reasoning module solves the problems of abnormal detection and root cause positioning, the intelligent early warning decision module clearly warns the grade and efficiently matches the solution, the visual interaction module solves the problems of information display dispersion and poor linkage, and the intelligent early warning decision module supports third party interfacing.
assignees: UNIV GUANGDONG TECHNOLOGY;GUANGZHOU YUANSHENG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-factor analysis method for energy efficiency loss of photovoltaic system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-factor analysis method for energy efficiency loss of a photovoltaic system, and belongs to the technical field of photovoltaics. The invention aims to solve the problem that the traditional operation and maintenance mode is difficult to accurately and uncoupling to quantify energy efficiency loss caused by various abnormal factors. The method comprises the steps of firstly collecting multi-source heterogeneous data by using an unmanned plane, an intelligent robot and a station sensor network, and constructing a high-fidelity digital twin body model which is synchronous with a physical power station in real time in geometric form, electrical topology and running state. And then, accurately identifying and parameterizing various abnormal factors such as dirt, shielding, hot spots, performance attenuation and the like existing in the power station by fusion analysis of the multi-mode data. Finally, the system combines performance degradation prediction with a multi-objective optimization algorithm. The invention realizes accurate tracing from macroscopic total loss to microscopic cause, provides unprecedented data insight for operation and maintenance of the power station, and remarkably improves scientificity and economic benefit of operation and maintenance decision.
assignees: HUANENG HAINAN NEW ENERGY POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for predicting ultra-short-term wind power of long-short-term memory network of displacement entropy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting ultra-short-term wind power of a long-short-term memory network of a replacement entropy, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting historical wind power data, repairing missing data and abnormal values in the historical wind power data, carrying out normalization processing on the preprocessed historical wind power data, inputting the normalized data, optimizing and solving the number K of decomposition modes and a punishment factor alpha by using a multi-objective gray wolf algorithm, guaranteeing that an fitness function RMSE and PE are the smallest globally, obtaining the required parameters and then decomposing, obtaining a decomposed subsequence, taking the decomposed subsequence as input, carrying out prediction model training of the subsequence, carrying out rolling decomposition, inputting a prediction model of the subsequence, superposing a subsequence prediction value, and carrying out inverse normalization to obtain a prediction result, thereby realizing rolling prediction. The method solves the problem that the existing prediction technology has low data prediction precision with strong volatility, and reduces the problem that a wind power plant faces examination due to inaccurate prediction.
assignees: HUANENG GUANGXI CLEAN ENERGY CO LTD;XIAN THERMAL POWER RES INST CO

title_en: High-speed railway station house comprehensive energy efficiency analysis and judgment system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a comprehensive energy efficiency analysis and judgment system of a high-speed rail station house based on digital twinning, which comprises a multi-dimensional sensing acquisition module, a dynamic coupling modeling module, an optimization algorithm knowledge base module, a model prediction control or reinforcement learning module, an equipment state parameter combination and an energy efficiency index generation module, an energy efficiency cooperation judgment module, an energy efficiency report generation module, an equipment maintenance suggestion, an energy efficiency and state double-closed-loop module, a pipe network pressure difference, temperature uniformity and energy efficiency ratio deviation triggering model correction, wherein the multi-objective genetic algorithm, the particle swarm optimization algorithm, the model prediction control or reinforcement learning algorithm are dynamically activated according to characteristic indexes of passenger flow growth rate and temperature rise rate, the simulation module generates an equipment state parameter combination and an energy efficiency index, the energy efficiency cooperation judgment module generates a global energy efficiency evaluation report through pareto front analysis and Markov decision, and the energy efficiency report generation module outputs a visual chart and an equipment maintenance suggestion.
assignees: RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ELECTRONIC COMPUTING TECH CHINA ACADEMY OF RAILWAY SCIENCES CORPORATION LIMITE;Beijing jingwei information technology co ltd;CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD

title_en: Digital twin decision self-adaptive optimization method and system for improving workover efficiency
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin decision self-adaptive optimization method and system for improving well repair efficiency, and belongs to the field of petroleum engineering. The method comprises the steps of acquiring well repair full-factor data through multi-source data acquisition, constructing a physical system 1:1 virtual mapping model after edge layer light weight treatment, dynamically calibrating by adopting Ka lman filtering algorithm, simulating a downhole environment based on fluid mechanics and tool abrasion model, realizing multi-objective global optimization and resource scheduling by combining NSGA-I I algorithm, adjusting operation parameters in real time through reinforcement learning algorithm, outputting advice through man-machine collaborative decision, executing operation and feeding back a data iteration optimization model. The system comprises a physical perception layer, an edge calculation layer, a digital twin layer, a cloud optimization layer and a man-machine cooperation layer, and the data flow is in closed loop linkage. The scheme solves the problems of low efficiency, high cost and insufficient data utilization of the traditional well repair, and promotes the operation to be converted into data driving, so that the intelligent development of the power-assisted oil-gas field is realized.
assignees: NANZHI CHONGQING ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Service collaborative management method and system based on power grid comprehensive plan
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of big data analysis and discloses a business collaborative management method and a system based on a power grid comprehensive plan, wherein the business collaborative management method comprises the steps of integrating multi-source heterogeneous data through ontology modeling to construct a global business entity relationship map; the method comprises the steps of intelligently identifying relations among business elements by using a graphic neural network, generating plan elements, performing multi-objective collaborative optimization by adopting multi-agent reinforcement learning, generating a global optimal plan scheme, performing real-time deduction and dynamic early warning on plan execution by means of a digital twin technology, storing key data by using a block chain, and realizing closed-loop self-optimization of an AI model by using an evaluation result. The method effectively solves the problems of data island, difficult collaboration, control lag and the like in the prior art, realizes the full-flow intelligentization, collaboration and closed-loop management from planning, monitoring execution to evaluation optimization of the power grid business, and remarkably improves the resource allocation efficiency, operation management level and strategic decision-making capability of the power grid enterprise.
assignees: STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for monitoring and evaluating homeland space planning data
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for monitoring and evaluating homeland space planning data, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-mode data, constructing an atmospheric diffusion model based on the multi-mode data, reversely positioning a pollution source, obtaining a pollutant responsibility matrix, carrying out space grid fusion calculation on the pollutant responsibility matrix and carbon sink data to generate a carbon source-carbon sink distribution map representing a homeland space carbon balance pattern, generating a homeland space carbon planning scheme based on regional characteristics of the carbon source-carbon sink distribution map through a low-carbon guiding algorithm, constructing a disaster model based on the multi-mode data, carrying out space coupling analysis on a disaster risk area and a high-carbon sink potential area output by the disaster model to obtain the homeland space carbon restoration scheme, constructing a digital twin platform according to the multi-mode data, the atmospheric diffusion model and the disaster model, and carrying out deduction verification on expected carbon sink increment values of the homeland space carbon planning scheme through the digital twin platform, and carrying out implementation iteration.
assignees: YANTAI PENGLAI PLANNING AND RES CENTER

title_en: Energy consumption optimization method and system for operation of boiler steam engine of thermal power plant
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy consumption optimizing method and system for the operation of a boiler turbine of a thermal power plant, and relates to the technical field of energy consumption optimization of boiler turbines, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining basic technical parameters of the boiler turbine of the thermal power plant; the method comprises the steps of configuring a multi-target optimizing model meeting the heat consumption requirement of a steam turbine, dynamically adjusting fuel supply quantity, air supply quantity and water supply temperature parameters, simulating thermodynamic cycle efficiency under different operation working conditions by using digital twin, generating an optimal steam parameter combination by combining the multi-target optimizing model, deploying edge computing nodes, and sending out operation control instructions of a boiler and a steam turbine of a thermal power plant according to the optimal steam parameter combination. The invention solves the technical problems of high energy consumption, insufficient thermodynamic cycle efficiency and inaccurate parameter adjustment of the operation of the boiler and the turbine of the thermal power plant in the prior art, achieves the technical effects of realizing the accurate optimization of the energy consumption of the operation of the boiler and the turbine of the thermal power plant, and improves the thermodynamic cycle efficiency.
assignees: CHANGCHUN NO 3 THERMAL POWER BRANCH OF DATANG JILIN POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Water and electricity intelligent management method and platform based on electric power prediction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydropower intelligent management method and platform based on electric power prediction, which belong to the technical field of hydropower management and specifically comprise the steps of collecting hydrological forecast data, electric power load data, equipment running state data and historical scheduling records, establishing a unified data storage library, and ensuring real-time updating and format standardization of various data; generating uncertainty quantitative indexes of all sources by adopting a probability distribution model, an error sequence analysis and a fault tree analysis method according to three sources of hydrologic prediction errors, load prediction deviations and equipment fault probability respectively, constructing a mapping model, establishing a risk level assessment system according to a mapping result, outputting specific levels of scheduling risks in real time, formulating a targeted scheduling strategy according to the risk levels, executing the generated scheduling strategy, synchronously monitoring the change of prediction data and the fluctuation of the risk levels, enabling the uncertainty indexes to exceed a threshold value, and immediately triggering the dynamic adjustment of the scheduling strategy.
assignees: UNIV MINJIANG

title_en: Intelligent dispatching method for energy storage power station
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent operation and maintenance of an electric power system and discloses an intelligent dispatching method of an energy storage power station, which comprises the following steps of 1, collecting working state data of operation and maintenance technicians, wherein the data comprise the number of current work orders, start-stop time and response time of each work order, and identifying the work order with processing time exceeding a set range as an abnormal work order; and step 2, cleaning the acquired data, eliminating time conflict and incomplete recorded data, establishing a technician information set containing professional skills, experience years and history processing records, and classifying the history worksheets. According to the invention, a dynamic dispatching mechanism based on combined optimization of technician load scores and skill matching scores is adopted, and the accurate matching of the worksheets and technicians is realized by constructing a real-time updated worksheet number, response time and skill proficiency model, so that the technical effects of quick response and efficient fault handling are achieved.
assignees: BEIJING HYPERSTRONG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin management system for heat distribution pipe network operation and dimension
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of operation and maintenance management of a heating power pipe network, and discloses a heating power pipe network operation and dimension digital twin management system which comprises a data acquisition module, a data preprocessing module, a dynamic topology modeling module, a federal learning module, a hybrid physical solving module, a physical constraint optimization module and a visualization and early warning module, wherein the data acquisition module acquires real-time data of temperature, pressure, flow and vibration of the heating power pipe network, the data preprocessing module cleans and aligns the data, the dynamic topology modeling module constructs a pipe network graph model with dynamic characteristics, the federal learning module trains and generates a global model through distributed data, the hybrid physical solving module is based on the global model and current pipe network real-time data, and the visualization and early warning module generates a three-dimensional visualization interface of the heating power pipe network. According to the invention, by combining the dynamic topology modeling module and based on high-quality sensor data, a pipe network graph model with dynamic characteristics is constructed, and the effect of reflecting the state and characteristics of the pipe network in real time is achieved. Compared with the static modeling scheme in the prior art, the method solves the problem that the system change cannot be adapted.
assignees: JINAN URBAN INVEST DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based intelligent river basin management method, device, equipment and medium thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a digital twin-based watershed intelligent management method, a device, equipment and a medium thereof, wherein the method extracts core topography attributes through topography feature decoupling and coding, migrates disaster response functions of an optimal source watershed based on topography and rainfall similarity, combines a hydrodynamic model and migration functions to generate a physical constraint synthesized disaster data set, constructs a dual-channel neural network model integrating topography features and rainfall dynamics, continuously learns dynamic calibration model parameters by bayes by utilizing target watershed real-time monitoring data, and finally forms a digital twin system with flood evolution prediction capability, solves the problem of quick construction of a flood prediction model under the condition without historical data, and remarkably improves timeliness and accuracy of sudden flood early warning of a medium-small watershed.
assignees: SHAANXI WEIHE ECOLOGICAL AREA PROT CENTER

title_en: Multi-source low-temperature waste heat self-adaptive grid-connected optimization method based on electrothermal cooperative scheduling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-source low-temperature waste heat self-adaptive grid-connected optimization method based on electric heat cooperative scheduling, which relates to the technical field of energy management and comprises the steps of establishing an economic objective function and a carbon emission objective function according to a dynamic weight coefficient, a node marginal electricity price and a real-time power generation instruction, and performing multi-target cooperative optimization to generate a power set value of power generation equipment; and executing power generation operation based on the power set value of the power generation equipment, generating a hierarchical control instruction of the heat pump and the heat exchanger, collecting the running state parameters of the equipment to construct a digital twin body, generating an actual heating load value through a compensation algorithm, and updating the global federal learning model parameters by utilizing the deviation of the actual heating load value and a heat supply network load prediction curve. The invention realizes high-dimensional space-time modeling of the nonlinear coupling relationship between economy and carbon emission targets, and breaks through the technical limitation that the electricity price and the carbon price are difficult to respond to real-time fluctuation.

title_en: Digital twin reservoir solid modeling and reservoir capacity integrated calculation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin reservoir solid modeling and reservoir capacity integrated calculation method which comprises four-dimensional structured data construction, virtual drilling generation, three-dimensional solid model construction, reservoir capacity integrated calculation and dynamic correction, and a system used by the digital twin reservoir solid modeling and reservoir capacity integrated calculation method. According to the invention, multi-source data is integrated through four-dimensional structured data, the data format and the standard are unified, information loss caused by cooperation of multiple software is avoided, and the problem of data splitting is solved. The intelligent management system can be coupled with a hydrologic dynamic model to realize dynamic simulation of reservoir capacity-water supply-flood discharge, support four-prediction (prediction, early warning, preview and planning) decision-making of flood control and assist reservoir intelligent management.
assignees: ZHEJIANG GUANGSHA VOCATIONAL AND TECHNICAL UNIV OF CONSTRUCTION

title_en: Virtual power plant scheduling method and system based on multidimensional adjustment capability check
abstract_en: The invention provides a virtual power plant scheduling method and a system based on multi-dimensional adjustment capability check, which relate to the technical field of virtual power plant scheduling and comprise the steps of constructing a digital twin body of a target virtual power plant, wherein the output of the digital twin body comprises multi-dimensional adjustment capability parameters and range values corresponding to each dimensional adjustment capability parameter; the method comprises the steps of obtaining an initial effective power contract as a current effective power contract, collecting operation data of the current effective power contract after acting on a target virtual power plant in real time, inputting the operation data into the digital twin body, outputting multi-dimensional adjustment capacity parameters and range actual values corresponding to each dimensional adjustment capacity parameter, checking the multi-dimensional adjustment capacity, generating the power contract to be effective based on checking results, and carrying out power grid dispatching of the virtual power plant. According to the invention, a scheduling plan is formulated based on the adjustment capability parameters closer to the actual situation, so that the problem of power grid operation safety caused by deviation from the contractual adjustment capability is avoided.
assignees: SHANDONG FUTURE GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Cross-mode pedestrian re-identification method and system for deep emergency rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cross-modal pedestrian Re-identification method and system for deep emergency rescue, which are characterized in that a double-flow neural network is utilized to extract multi-layer characteristics of two modes, the characteristics are subjected to multi-granularity semantic enhancement through a self-adaptive multi-granularity enhancement module, a cross-modal fusion attention module is introduced, a multi-head graph attention mechanism is adopted to promote robustness and generalization capability based on graph structure fusion cross-modal adjacency relation, the discriminativity of cross-modal characteristics is effectively promoted by combining cross-modal aggregation loss and joint loss optimization strategies, a near-real-time digital twin model of a subsurface space is constructed, and a two-dimensional cross-modal Re-ID result is coupled with Gaussian splash-based incremental three-dimensional reconstruction, so that three-dimensional positioning of identified personnel in a digital twin scene is realized. The invention can improve the pedestrian characteristic expression capability, reduce the modal difference, expand the two-dimensional video information of the rescue personnel into the three-dimensional position information of the personnel, and remarkably improve the rescue searching and positioning efficiency and the intuitiveness of command decision.
assignees: SHENDI SCIENCE AND ENG YUNLONG LAKE LABORATORY;UNIV CHINA MINING

title_en: Intelligent power distribution network safety protection situation awareness analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a security protection situation awareness analysis method and system for an intelligent power distribution network, and relates to the technical field of power distribution networks, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining situation awareness data of edge nodes and constructing a group intelligent collaborative computing model; mapping physical nodes to a digital twin space through a digital twin technology, verifying a task allocation scheme in advance, iteratively optimizing cooperative rule parameters based on verification results, updating a model and executing a task allocation strategy, calculating cooperative representation value design excitation functions to dynamically adjust weights, executing situation awareness analysis and generating a security evaluation report and a decision suggestion. The method and the system realize accurate assessment and intelligent decision support of the security situation of the power distribution network.
assignees: STATE GRID JIBEI POWER CO LTD SMART DISTRIB NETWORK CENTER

title_en: Intelligent operation and maintenance method and system for photovoltaic field station
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent operation and maintenance method and system for a photovoltaic station, and relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation. The method comprises the steps of collecting station data through a sensor network and carrying out hierarchical encryption processing, generating a preliminary operation and maintenance strategy by utilizing a large language model finely tuned in the field, converting the strategy into optimization parameters through a knowledge distillation module based on a pre-training semantic model, inputting the optimization parameters into a multi-agent reinforcement learning engine to obtain an optimization strategy, carrying out safety verification by adopting a high-fidelity digital twin system, calculating a dynamic safety threshold according to equipment types and service years, executing the strategy passing verification, and updating the model in a closed loop. The system adopts a layered deployment architecture and comprises a data acquisition processing module, an intelligent analysis module, a strategy optimization module, a safety verification module and an execution feedback module. The invention realizes complete intelligent operation and maintenance from semantic understanding to optimal decision, ensures the scientificity and safety of decision through knowledge distillation and digital twin verification, and greatly improves operation and maintenance efficiency and system reliability.
assignees: NINGXIA JINGYIN WISDOM NEW ENERGY CO LTD;SHIZUISHAN JINGAO NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent control system for gate-controlled river reach water quality multiphase conversion
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent control system for gate-controlled river reach water quality multiphase conversion, in particular to the field of water treatment, which realizes accurate dynamic perception of the gate-controlled river reach water quality multiphase conversion process by constructing a high-fidelity digital twin body and fusing a real-time data assimilation technology, can predict complex space-time patterns of the evolution of a pollutant concentration field and a phase state under different control strategies by means of a space-time map neural network proxy model based on an attention mechanism, automatically generates a globally optimal gate group cooperative control scheme by adopting a multi-agent reinforcement learning algorithm based on the complex space-time patterns, effectively coordinates multiple targets such as water quality improvement, ecological protection and engineering operation, and finally reliably converts a theoretical strategy into physical action by a rolling optimization and closed-loop execution mechanism and can adaptively adjust according to environmental feedback, thereby comprehensively improving emergency response speed of sudden water pollution events, scientificity of a control decision and intelligent level of water quality management of the whole river network.

title_en: Distributed rock stress real-time inversion method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed rock stress real-time inversion method and a system, wherein the method comprises the steps of dispersing a rock structure of a target area through a discontinuous structure stress field model and collecting parameters, and constructing a geological-physical constraint inversion frame; and establishing a mapping relation to invert the initial distribution by introducing distributed rock stress parameters, and realizing real-time updating by continuously collecting data and repeatedly processing. The system comprises a plurality of association units which respectively execute functions of discrete acquisition, framework construction, inversion optimization and the like. The method and the system improve the accuracy of geological-physical constraint quantification, solve the problem of imperfect real-time updating mechanism, improve the accuracy, comprehensiveness and efficiency of inversion, and provide reliable technical support for geological engineering, disaster early warning and the like.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Cloud-edge cooperation-based electric power metering data management system and electric quantity distributed acquisition method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric power metering data management system based on cloud edge cooperation and an electric quantity distributed acquisition method, and relates to the technical field of electric power information acquisition and processing. The system comprises a smart meter terminal layer, an edge computing node layer, a regional collaboration gateway layer and a cloud data center. The intelligent terminal can dynamically adjust sampling frequency according to load change rate and historical volatility, and identify abnormality through an LSTM-ATT model, the edge node judges based on Kalman filtering and RMSE to realize prediction caching, the regional gateway executes topology weighted dynamic time regularity and consistency arbitration, and the cloud end completes digital twin modeling and abnormality storage. The method improves the instantaneity and accuracy of the power data acquisition, reduces the occupation of communication bandwidth, enhances the abnormal sensing capability and the running stability of the system, and is suitable for intelligent power distribution networks and distributed energy metering scenes.
assignees: MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Network toughness prediction method, system and device based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network toughness prediction method, system and device based on digital twinning, and relates to the technical field of ecological monitoring and network toughness modeling. The network toughness prediction method, system and device based on digital twinning comprise the steps of S1, collecting multiple types of ecological monitoring data through ecological monitoring equipment, carrying out standardized pretreatment on the ecological monitoring data, S2, comprehensively evaluating modeling difficulty of each ecological data, realizing automatic screening and grading treatment of data quality, S3, carrying out state synchronous evaluation on the data to be modeled, dynamically updating operation states of corresponding ecological entities in the digital twinning body based on state evaluation results, and S4, identifying key fragile nodes and risk paths in each ecological entity, and outputting corresponding ecological risk grades and regulation suggestions. The method solves the problems that in the prior art, static threshold risk judgment is only carried out based on a small amount of observation data, and multisource isomerism and dynamic evolution characteristics existing in an ecological system cannot be effectively applied.
assignees: INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS

title_en: AI and digital twin-based energy carbon management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy and carbon emission management, and provides an energy carbon management system based on AI and digital twinning, which comprises a digital twinning module and an AI module, wherein the digital twinning module is used for constructing a digital twinning model of a real energy carbon management scene and collecting energy carbon data, the digital twinning model comprises a device twinning layer, an environment twinning layer and a network twinning layer, energy carbon equipment is deployed in the real energy carbon management scene, the AI module comprises at least one data analysis node, at least one data processing node and at least one energy carbon management node, the data analysis node is used for receiving first energy carbon data of a first energy carbon equipment instance of the device twinning layer, the data processing node is used for responding to a first loss compensation instruction of the first energy carbon data in the environment twinning layer, and the energy carbon management node is used for responding to an operation scheduling instruction of a second energy carbon equipment instance determined by the network twinning layer according to the first loss compensation instruction and the first energy carbon data.
assignees: NAT INST METROLOGY CHINA

title_en: Intelligent water service operation management and control system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent water service operation management and control system based on the Internet of things, which relates to the technical field of industrial Internet of things and comprises the steps of collecting multidimensional operation data in a water supply network, carrying out preliminary time scale alignment and preprocessing to generate a multisource synchronous perception data set, importing a comprehensive risk list into a digital twin body, dynamically injecting corresponding fault and abnormal scene parameters in the digital twin environment, carrying out massive parallel deduction through a Monte Carlo simulation algorithm to generate a pre-modeling result data set, carrying out multi-objective decision analysis on the pre-modeling result data set, carrying out prediction comprehensive plan utility score based on preset safety weight and economic weight, and calculating an optimal management and control plan through iterative optimization. According to the invention, the multi-source heterogeneous data is deeply fused through the graph neural network of the risk identification module, the dynamic impedance characteristics of the pipe network are accurately extracted, early anomalies are identified, and the advanced diagnosis of the multi-mode coupling risk is realized.

title_en: Intelligent inspection method and related device for power station
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent inspection, and discloses an intelligent inspection method and a related device for a power station, wherein the intelligent inspection method for the power station comprises the steps of acquiring multi-mode data of target equipment in the power station in real time through inspection, and obtaining an equipment state deviation value through a built digital twin model of the power station equipment by the multi-mode data Based on device state deviation values Acquiring equipment fault risk coefficient Through improvement of The algorithm is based on the risk coefficient of equipment failure The invention constructs a new closed-loop, intelligent and self-adaptive power station inspection mode by deeply fusing digital twin and dynamic path planning, and remarkably improves the intelligent level and comprehensive efficiency of inspection.
assignees: HUANENG JIANGXI CLEAN ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Full life cycle data management method and system for digital low-voltage cabinet
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power equipment management, in particular to a full life cycle data management method and system of a digital low-voltage cabinet, wherein the method comprises the steps of distributing global unique digital identity identifiers for the low-voltage cabinet and key components and parts, and constructing a standardized digital mapping model based on an OPCUA framework; the method comprises the steps of taking digital identities as indexes, converging full-flow multi-source heterogeneous data to a cloud edge cooperative platform to form a data blood edge chain, creating a digital twin body, dynamically updating a model through real-time data and iterating calibration parameters, carrying out anomaly identification, health assessment and residual life prediction by using an AI algorithm to generate operation and maintenance instructions, and feeding the instructions back to an upstream system. The invention breaks the data island, realizes the optimization from predictive maintenance to full period, and improves the safety and the operation efficiency of the equipment.
assignees: HANGZHOU JINENG SHUZHI EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent water affair monitoring management system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based intelligent water service monitoring management system, which relates to the technical field of intelligent water service and comprises a water service monitoring management platform, wherein the water service monitoring management platform is in communication connection with a multi-source data acquisition module, a data processing module and a data processing module, wherein the multi-source data acquisition module is used for acquiring and preprocessing water service monitoring data from a plurality of monitoring points of a water service system, monitoring the change of a pipe network topological structure and acquiring dynamic data of pipe network connection relation and geometric parameters. According to the invention, through a digital twin technology, multi-monitoring point location data can be integrated in real time, and by combining an abnormal trend analysis module, abnormal events such as water quality pollution, equipment failure, water shortage, hydraulic change and the like are rapidly identified, and an early warning signal is automatically generated, so that the response time is obviously shortened by an instant early warning mechanism, management staff can take measures at the early stage of the abnormal event, the problem is effectively prevented from expanding, and the timeliness and the accuracy of water management are improved.
assignees: NANJING RANQIU SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Operation risk assessment method and system for heating ventilation air conditioning system based on neural network time sequence model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a heating ventilation air conditioning system operation risk assessment method and system based on a neural network time sequence model, wherein the method comprises the steps of S1, respectively collecting time sequence state data, S2, establishing an LSTM neural network architecture to obtain a digital twin model and integrating the digital twin model into a heating ventilation air conditioning system, S3, training an equipment failure mode identification model, a fault cause analysis model and an event evolution prediction model, S4, quantifying operation risk priority, an operation anomaly root cause, occurrence probability and an operation anomaly development path to obtain comprehensive risk indexes of all equipment, S5, predicting an actual anomaly part according to the comprehensive risk indexes by using the prediction model, S6, establishing an association corresponding relation between the simulation anomaly indexes and the comprehensive risk indexes, S7, obtaining the corresponding comprehensive risk indexes by the association corresponding relation, and predicting the actual anomaly part according to the comprehensive risk indexes by using the prediction model.
assignees: HUAXI NEW ENERGY TECH FUJIAN CO LTD

title_en: Evacuation strategy generation method for hydropower station
abstract_en: The invention provides a hydropower station evacuation strategy generation method which comprises the steps of obtaining physical space data of a hydropower station, including topography, building structures and equipment layout data, constructing a dynamic risk model based on the physical space data, identifying risk source types and diffusion paths, and collecting personnel distribution data through a positioning terminal to generate an evacuation demand map. The method comprises the steps of calculating the safe passing capacity of a limited evacuation channel, generating an initial evacuation path set by combining an evacuation demand pattern, performing coupling optimization on the initial evacuation path set based on three factors of path length, risk exposure time and crowd density change rate, dynamically monitoring the state change of a risk source through a risk sensor network, triggering strategy update when the risk diffusion speed exceeds a preset threshold, and finally outputting an optimized evacuation strategy to terminal execution equipment. The invention can realize real-time updating and efficient optimization of the hydropower station evacuation strategy, and improve evacuation efficiency and personnel safety guarantee capability.
assignees: POWERCHINA KUNMING ENG CORP LTD

title_en: Nuclear power digital twin data warehouse structure system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of nuclear power data asset automation management, in particular to a nuclear power digital twin data warehouse structure system which comprises a data processing layer, a data integration layer, a semantic enhancement layer and an analysis application layer, wherein the data processing layer reads original data of a nuclear power industrial Internet platform, performs data standardization processing on the original data to obtain standard data, constructs a nuclear power industrial subject database according to the standard data, performs data coding mapping, data classification and data fusion on the data of the nuclear power industrial subject database to form a subject database, the semantic enhancement layer marks the data in the subject database formed by the data of the nuclear power industrial subject database and the data integration layer, constructs a structured feature tag database by the data after related feature tags, and the analysis application layer reads the data of the feature tag database, and constructs a digital twin algorithm database and a digital twin sample database through algorithm analysis and training samples. The system is based on a nuclear power industry internet platform bottom layer support and a four-layer progressive architecture, and supports equipment operation and maintenance from periodic overhaul to predictive maintenance.
assignees: CHINA NUCLEAR POWER OPERATION TECHNOLOGY CORP LTD;JIANGSU NUCLEAR POWER CORP;CHINA NAT NUCLEAR POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power grid equipment maintenance and service life optimization method based on asset full life cycle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for maintaining and optimizing the service life of power grid equipment based on an asset full life cycle, which relates to the technical field of power system equipment management and comprises the following steps of acquiring multi-source heterogeneous data of target power grid equipment in each stage of the full life cycle to form a full life cycle data set; the method comprises the steps of establishing a digital twin body of power grid equipment based on a full life cycle data set, evaluating the real-time health state of the power grid equipment based on the digital twin body, predicting the fault risk and the residual service life of the power grid equipment, and generating a maintenance strategy based on the evaluation and prediction results and with the total cost of the full life cycle of the asset as an optimal target. The invention solves the problems of limited view angle and lack of economic consideration of the existing maintenance strategy, realizes the transition from passive maintenance to active predictive maintenance, and achieves the overall optimal asset management goal.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;CEEC ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent analysis system and method for influence of multi-scene new energy power generation on distribution network
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of power systems and intelligent power grids, in particular to an intelligent analysis system and an intelligent analysis method for influence of multi-scene new energy power generation on a distribution network, comprising a data acquisition module, a multi-scene modeling module, an influence analysis module, an intelligent evaluation module and an optimization suggestion generation module, and the data acquisition module, the multi-scene modeling module, the influence analysis module, the intelligent evaluation module and the optimization suggestion generation module are in communication connection with an external data bus. According to the application, a mixed digital twin model is constructed through a multi-scene modeling module, four typical scenes such as new energy output fluctuation, extreme weather, AC/DC mixed access and power grid topology change are dynamically simulated, dynamic configuration of scene parameters (such as new energy permeability and load growth rate) is supported, and the model can more truly reflect the running state of the distribution network under the coupling action of multiple scenes through fusion modeling (such as a tidal current equation+LSTM time sequence+graph neural network GNN) of a physical mechanism and data driving.
assignees: FUXIN POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Three-dimensional laser point cloud-based method and system for in-depth vegetation management in transmission corridors
abstract_en: Disclosed are a three-dimensional laser point cloud-based method and system for in-depth vegetation management in transmission corridors. The method comprises: collecting multi-source data by means of an unmanned aerial vehicle- and helicopter-mounted multi-sensor system, and preprocessing the multi-source data; using the processed multi-source data to create a digitalized power grid corridor and construct a vegetation management analysis model; on the basis of data analyzed by the vegetation management analysis model and geofencing technology, designing a hazard vegetation clearing-cost-compensation prediction model; and developing a mobile application for analyzing hazard vegetation data flows and the closed-loop management of vegetation management service flows. The described method achieves high-precision and high-coverage data collection, precisely identifies transmission line digital twins and hazard vegetation, standardizes and automates the management of hazard vegetation clearing and related compensation, and develops a mobile application for analyzing hazard vegetation data flows and the closed-loop management of vegetation management service flows, thereby achieving the end-to-end digital and mobile management of vegetation management. The organic combination of steps comprehensively improves the intelligence and efficiency of transmission line vegetation management.
assignees: LIJIANG POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power outage restoration in distribution systems assisted by state estimation
abstract_en: Embodiments described herein provide for power distribution control systems and methods. The power distribution control systems and methods estimate one or more signal measurements of one or more nodes of a power distribution network using state estimation, identify a location of an outage in the power distribution network, identify a status of one or more switches that form a configuration to restore power to one or more cells of the power distribution network based on the one or more signal measurements estimated using state estimation, and output control signaling to control the one or more switches based on the identified status.
assignees: UNIV TEXAS TECH SYSTEM

title_en: System and method for arc prediction and control in photovoltaic installations
title_ko: 태양광 설비용 아크 예측 및 제어 시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 태양광 어레이, 태양광 접속반 및 전력 전선 중 적어도 하나의 상태 정보를 실시간으로 수집하도록 구성된 복수의 센서부와, 상기 복수의 센서부로부터 데이터를 수신하고 태양광 발전 설비의 아크 발생 가능성을 판단하여 제어 신호를 생성하도록 구성된 중앙 제어 서버, 그리고 상기 중앙 제어 서버로부터 데이터를 전달받도록 구성된 사용자 단말을 포함하는 태양광 설비용 아크 예측 및 제어 시스템에 관한 것이다. 중앙 제어 서버는 통신부, 프로세서, 저장부를 포함하며, 프로세서는 데이터 처리부, 아크 예측부, 디지털 트윈 시뮬레이션부, 제어 판단부로 구성된다. 본 발명은 다양한 센서 데이터를 기반으로 2단계 하이브리드 AI 구조(Bi-LSTM + XGBoost)를 통해 아크 발생 가능성을 예측하고, 이를 디지털 트윈 시뮬레이션으로 검증한 후, 이중 검증 결과에 따라 단계별 제어 조치를 수행한다. 이를 통해 아크 발생 이전에 선제적 대응이 가능해져 화재와 같은 중대 사고를 예방하고, 오탐지율을 낮추며, 설비 수명을 연장시키는 효과가 있다. 또한 준지도학습 기반의 지속적 자가 학습을 통해 시간이 지남에 따라 시스템 성능이 향상되는 특성을 가진다.
assignees: SM TECHNICAL GROUP LTD

title_en: Dynamic optimization planning method and system for full life cycle of dam engineering
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering management, in particular to a dynamic optimization planning method and a dynamic optimization planning system for the whole life cycle of dam engineering, comprising the steps of constructing a digital twin body fusing a geologic body stress field, a reservoir capacity time-varying function and an ecological constraint boundary; the method comprises the steps of generating an initial dam space coordinate set and a flood discharge channel topological relation based on a topological time-varying fitness algorithm, receiving deformation time sequence data and osmotic pressure gradient data of a dam monitoring terminal in a running period, inputting a risk entropy feedback model to dynamically generate a gate opening regulation instruction set, and constructing a retired cost transfer function and a reservoir capacity release curve by combining a material consumption list and a dam aging damage model in a retired period to form a full life cycle decision package capable of feeding back and updating initial planning. The invention can realize the cooperative optimization of dam structure safety, operation stability and retired economic environmental benefit, and promote the intelligent management level of the whole life cycle of dam engineering.
assignees: SOIL AND WATER CONSERVATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF SHANXI AGRICULTURAL UNIV SHANXI SOIL AND WATER CON

title_en: Ocean pasture intelligent decision-making system based on self-playing
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent ocean pasture decision system based on self-playing, which comprises a multi-modal data perception module, a large model decision center module, a dynamic game optimization module and a virtual-real linkage execution module, wherein the multi-modal data perception module is used for acquiring multi-modal data and constructing a space-time association characteristic map through a graph neural network, the large model decision center module is used for mapping the multi-modal data to a unified semantic space through a cross-modal alignment technology and carrying out variable association reasoning based on an injected ocean ecological causal map, the dynamic game optimization module is used for taking an ecological protection target and an economic benefit target as two game parties and searching for pareto optimal solutions, and the virtual-real linkage execution module is used for driving a digital twin body of the ocean pasture to execute corresponding operation with physical equipment according to decision instructions and realizing dynamic update of model parameters through federal learning. The invention can improve the culture yield, reduce the ecological disaster loss, support the digital authentication of carbon sink assets, and provide intelligent decision support with ecological adaptability and economic robustness for the marine pasture.

title_en: Transformer substation fire risk dynamic assessment method and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic assessment method for fire risk of a transformer substation, which comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model of the transformer substation according to live information of the transformer substation; and generating fire risk assessment information of the transformer substation according to the fire disaster deduction information output by the fire disaster deduction model of the transformer substation. By adopting the method for dynamically evaluating the fire risk of the transformer substation, the current data of the transformer substation can be acquired and analyzed in real time to dynamically evaluate and predict the fire risk, the fire risk management and prevention and control level of the transformer substation are obviously improved, and the operation requirements of the transformer substation on high reliability and high safety are met.
assignees: GUIYANG BUREAU EHV POWER TRANS CO CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Multi-robot collaborative inspection and task optimization scheduling system for power station
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of operation and maintenance of power stations and discloses a power station multi-robot collaborative inspection and task optimization scheduling system which comprises a digital twin modeling module, a task modeling and decomposition module, a task and capacity matching scheduling module, a dynamic rescheduling module, a cloud edge collaborative control module, a data acquisition and feedback module and a man-machine interaction and visualization module, wherein the digital twin modeling module is used for building a digital twin model of a power station environment, equipment and multi-type inspection robots and realizing real-time mapping of a physical space and a virtual space of the power station through state synchronization. The task node diagram construction, the robot capability vector modeling, the local hot start rescheduling and the digital twin closed loop self-learning mechanism are integrated, so that distribution continuity can be maintained when the task changes or the robot state is updated, parameters are continuously corrected based on operation data, and collaborative improvement of the inspection task execution efficiency, the dispatching response speed and the system stability is realized.
assignees: BEIJING ANXIN YIWEI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Buried gas pipeline management method and system based on multi-source sensing digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a buried gas pipeline management method and system based on multi-source sensing digital twinning, and relates to the field of human buried gas pipeline safety management. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source heterogeneous real-time state data collected by a buried gas pipeline along a line sensor network, calling a multi-physical-field finite element model coupled with soil pipeline interaction and temperature stress effect based on the real-time state data, obtaining corrected settlement amount and stress distribution of the pipeline through dynamically calculated correction coefficients, constructing and dynamically updating a digital twin model by adopting a data assimilation algorithm to generate a mechanical twin model synchronous with the physical pipeline in real time, and generating risk early warning information and/or optimized predictive maintenance decision based on the corrected settlement amount and stress distribution output by the mechanical twin model. The invention solves the problems of fragmentation of traditional monitoring data, misalignment of model calculation, hysteresis of management decision and the like.
assignees: NANZHI CHONGQING ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power system state estimation method based on large language model
abstract_en: The application discloses a power system state estimation method based on a large language model, which relates to the field of power system state estimation, and comprises the steps of S1, obtaining an input sequence based on a user problem and a preset system prompt word, S2, determining the next output Token by adopting a fine-tuned large language model based on the input sequence and the current output sequence, S3, obtaining a final result of power distribution network state estimation based on the current output sequence if the next output Token is a preset ending symbol Token, adding the tool Token to the current output sequence to obtain a tool output sequence if the next output Token is the tool Token, calling an external mathematical tool corresponding to the tool Token to obtain a prediction result, converting the prediction result to a text Token sequence, adding the text Token to the tool output sequence, returning to S2, and returning to S2 after adding the common Token to the current output sequence if the next output Token is the common Token. The application improves the accuracy and the intelligence of the state estimation of the power system.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Hydropower station equipment visual operation and maintenance method and system combining digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydropower stations, in particular to a hydropower station equipment visual operation and maintenance method and system combined with a digital twin technology, comprising the following steps of S1, acquiring real-time sensor data from key equipment of the hydropower station through a multi-layer data acquisition device, and generating equipment state data streams with multiple time domains and multiple frequencies through an asynchronous and synchronous technology; S3, analyzing fault modes and trends through a multi-layer neural network based on the adjusted predicted values and operation data, generating fault probability and optimizing maintenance strategies. According to the invention, through real-time data acquisition and synchronization, digital twin technology and multi-layer neural network analysis, the equipment state is accurately predicted, and the maintenance strategy is optimized, so that the real-time performance, the prediction precision and the maintenance efficiency of equipment monitoring are improved.
assignees: SICHUAN HUANENG DONGXIGUAN HYDROPOWER CO LTD

title_en: Deep reinforcement learning-based multi-agent cooperative management method for energy storage power station
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy storage power station multi-agent cooperative management method based on deep reinforcement learning, and relates to the technical field of intelligent control. The multi-agent collaborative management method for the energy storage power station based on deep reinforcement learning comprises the steps of S1, collecting energy storage collaborative awareness data, preprocessing the energy storage collaborative awareness data, S2, dividing three types of control units, evaluating the operation collaborative deviation degree of the energy storage power station, dynamically selecting action strategies of the control units and constructing an action value evaluation model, S3, constructing a state, action and rewarding triplet sample, iterating and optimizing the action value evaluation model round by round, S4, deploying the control units into a simulation operation environment, executing action decision and state interaction feedback, and judging whether a strategy correction mechanism is triggered after each action decision is executed. The problems that the prior energy storage power station is not timely coordinated with each subsystem, and the battery state estimation error is difficult to timely feed back, so that strategy lag and equipment operation unbalance are caused are solved.
assignees: TIANJIN TEEL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Voltage sag state estimation method and system based on complex task decomposition reasoning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a voltage sag state estimation method and a system based on complex task decomposition reasoning, which are characterized in that firstly, practical problems in the physical world are solved by guiding LLM to apply a mathematical tool, and text output fitting reality is given by combining the mathematical tool and feedback of a thinking tree structure simulating human thinking behaviors. In order to solve the actual problem of the physical world, the invention constructs a DGCN model of physical driving, and the output of the mathematical tool is more fit with the actual situation by combining a multi-layer graph convolution layer and taking the power grid topological connection relationship as a physical constraint condition. Finally, an improved DGCN model based on collaborative training and cross-grid region knowledge migration is introduced, and the overall generalization and adaptation capability of LLM in voltage sag state estimation of unknown grid topology are improved.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous navigation obstacle avoidance method oriented to real-time strong noise interference
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous navigation obstacle avoidance method oriented to real-time strong noise interference, and belongs to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous navigation. The method solves the problem that the prior method has larger state estimation error under the interference of real-time strong noise. The method comprises the steps of obtaining time sequence state information of a plurality of continuous moments of the unmanned aerial vehicle, respectively constructing a time sequence feature matrix and a space difference matrix according to the time sequence state information of the plurality of continuous moments, respectively inputting the time sequence feature matrix and the space difference matrix into a time branch sub-network and a space branch sub-network to conduct feature extraction to obtain time branch features and space branch features, respectively embedding a transducer module into the time branch sub-network and the space branch sub-network, fusing the time branch features and the space branch features to obtain joint feature representation, and outputting flight control instructions of the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the joint feature representation. The method is mainly used in the fields of city inspection, disaster relief, agricultural monitoring and the like.
assignees: HARBIN INST TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Digital twinning-based forestry carbon sink project full life cycle metering method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a full life cycle metering method and system for forest carbon sink project based on digital twinning, which relates to forest carbon sink metering and comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source heterogeneous basic data such as three-dimensional framework topology of forest, carbon dioxide flux time sequence, mycorrhiza network distribution, meteorological data and the like, and carrying out coupling treatment on digital genes of the forest and tensors of ecological processes to generate a digital gene tensor field; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a double-path carbon flux field of dominant conduit transfer and recessive mycorrhiza transfer through inversion of carbon transfer driven by a conduit bundle network, constructing a carbon sink phase transition field of stability boundary constraint based on analysis of carbon sink phase transition critical points, obtaining a carbon redistribution map regulated by a biological network through deduction of a trans-scale carbon redistribution path, and finally outputting an optimized and adjusted carbon sink value through optimization and metering treatment of full life cycle carbon sink entropy. The method realizes the conversion of carbon sink measurement from static estimation to dynamic simulation, and remarkably improves the accuracy and reliability of the full life cycle estimation of carbon sink projects.

title_en: Digital twinning-based air, space, ground and sea integrated network intelligent coordination system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an aerospace, land and sea multi-domain network intelligent collaboration system and method, and belongs to the technical field of communication networks. The system collects heterogeneous network data through a multi-domain sensing layer, builds a digital twin body by utilizing quantum reinforcement learning to realize network state prediction, converts user intention into a resource demand matrix by adopting semantic analysis, and combines non-orthogonal multiple access and dynamic spectrum sharing technology to realize joint optimization allocation of star-air-sea-ground resources. Compared with the prior art, the intelligent resource scheduling method has the advantages of 1) supporting intelligent resource scheduling which is driven by intention, improving service matching precision by 40%, 2) realizing cross-domain spectrum sharing through federal learning, enabling spectrum utilization rate to reach 92%, and 3) enabling transmission reliability to reach 99.99% in an anti-interference mode, and is suitable for scenes such as emergency communication, ocean monitoring and the like.
assignees: ZHONGSHAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE CHANGCHUN UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Dynamic load adjusting and controlling method for power transmission and transformation line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic load regulation control method for a power transmission and transformation line, which relates to the technical field of power system automation and comprises the following steps of S1, collecting multi-source heterogeneous data and environment data of the power transmission and transformation line, and S2, carrying out fusion processing on the multi-source heterogeneous data through an edge intelligent aggregation node arranged near a data collection source to generate high-dimensional characteristic data used for representing the comprehensive running state of the line. According to the dynamic load regulation control method for the power transmission and transformation line, the edge intelligent aggregation nodes are used for carrying out on-site fusion and feature extraction on the multi-source heterogeneous data to generate high-dimensional feature data, so that the problems of communication bandwidth pressure and decision delay caused by mass original data transmission are effectively solved, and the timeliness and the efficiency of data processing are improved. Meanwhile, the method utilizes a digital twin technology to carry out analog deduction and safety verification on the regulation strategy in advance, so that the safety of load regulation operation is ensured, and the system risk caused by improper strategy is avoided.
assignees: QUANFU CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Active power distribution network affine type interval state estimation method and system considering distributed photovoltaic grid-connected strategy
abstract_en: According to the method and the system for estimating the affine type interval state of the active power distribution network by considering the distributed photovoltaic grid-connected strategy, firstly, the single-phase and three-phase grid-connected control strategy of the distributed photovoltaic is considered on the basis of the existing method for estimating the affine type interval state of the active power distribution network, a more specific measurement model is provided for estimating the affine state of the active power distribution network, and the precision of state estimation is improved. Secondly, a recursive affine state estimation solving method is provided based on a full-pure embedding principle and a weighted least square method for solving the strong nonlinear problem of an affine type interval state estimation equation of an active power distribution network caused by introducing a distributed photovoltaic grid-connected control strategy, the original nonlinear WLS problem is converted into a plurality of linear overdetermined recursive solving problems, nonlinear operation of affine matrix inversion is avoided, an additional updating step is not needed, and the conservation of affine state estimation results under a strong nonlinear measurement model is effectively reduced while the calculation efficiency is improved.
assignees: UNIV FUZHOU

title_en: Integrated wind power mixing tower structure safety monitoring platform management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a management system of an integrated wind power mixing tower structure safety monitoring platform, which relates to the technical field of wind power generation and comprises a data acquisition module, a data preprocessing and fusion module and a data processing and fusion module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring monitoring data acquired by a plurality of types of sensors on a wind power mixing tower structure, and the data preprocessing and fusion module is connected with the data acquisition module and is used for carrying out time synchronization and standardization processing on the monitoring data to form a data unit with a unified time scale.
