According to the integrated wind power mixing tower structure safety monitoring platform management system, the multistage diagnosis and verification center is constructed, so that the deep fusion and intelligent analysis of the multi-source heterogeneous monitoring data of the wind power mixing tower are realized, and the problems of data fracture and one-sided analysis in the prior art are effectively solved. The dynamic threshold comparison, the multi-mode association rule matching and the digital twin simulation verification progressive workflow are adopted, so that the false alarm and missing alarm risks caused by single parameter alarm can be effectively reduced, and the comprehensiveness of state diagnosis and the reliability of early warning decision can be improved.
assignees: HARBIN QUANAN MEASUREMENT & CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Water conservancy management system and method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based water conservancy management system and a digital twin-based water conservancy management method, which relate to the technical field of water conservancy management and comprise the steps of collecting water flow sound wave signals through vibration optical fiber sensors deployed on water conservancy facilities and water channels, and converting the water flow sound wave signals into digital pulse signals carrying flow velocity, impact force and flow direction information; the method comprises the steps of constructing a hydraulic topological network based on a hydraulic engineering drawing, dividing geographical units along the boundary of a water channel by a preset distance, creating a geological memory capsule for each geographical unit, searching a target geological memory capsule in the influence range of a scheduling instruction when the scheduling instruction is received, calling evolution operators of the target geological memory capsule to deduce geological responses of different time scales in parallel, carrying out space superposition analysis on the positions of real-time water flow resistance break points identified by the hydraulic topological network and a geological fragile area distribution map, and generating and executing a hydraulic facility regulation instruction with the minimum overlapping area as a target.
assignees: LIANYUNGANG TONGYU HEBEI YANSONG WATER ENGINEERING MAN OFFICE

title_en: Auxiliary analysis application system for cloud fusion of all-scenic spots of power distribution network
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of electric power distribution networks and discloses a comprehensive point cloud fusion auxiliary analysis application system of a distribution network, which comprises a data processing module, a registration fusion module, a holographic construction module, a labeling measurement module and an auxiliary analysis module, wherein the data processing module is used for acquiring three-source laser data and panoramic image data, the registration fusion module is connected with the data processing module and is used for carrying out key point detection on the three-source laser data and the panoramic image data and fusing the three-source laser data and the panoramic image data to obtain three-dimensional point cloud data, the holographic construction module is used for recognizing a three-dimensional object in a drawing to construct a holographic digital twin model, the labeling measurement module is respectively connected with the registration fusion module and the holographic construction model and is used for carrying out standardized processing on the three-dimensional point cloud data and labeling on the holographic digital twin model to construct a comprehensive life cycle management storage platform, and the auxiliary analysis module is respectively connected with the holographic construction module and the standard measurement module and is used for constructing a real-scene digital twin system according to the holographic digital twin model. The application updates various intelligent models in real time and discovers potential hazards of equipment.
assignees: LINPING BRANCH ZHEJIANG DAYOU IND CO LTD;ZHEJIANG DAYOU IND CO LTD;HANGZHOU LINPING POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent campus decision analysis system and method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based intelligent campus decision analysis system and method, which are used for acquiring standard multi-source heterogeneous data through an Internet of things sensor, constructing a campus digital twinning model based on GIS and BIM technologies, dynamically updating the model through the standard multi-source heterogeneous data, outputting digital twinning model data, constructing a dynamic graph structure of campus resources, analyzing the digital twinning model data, mining implicit relations among the resources through a graph neural network, extracting multidimensional feature vectors, setting a decision target to maximize teaching efficiency, minimizing potential safety hazards, taking the multidimensional feature vectors as a state space, defining an action space to adjust a curriculum schedule and optimize security resource configuration, and training and outputting decision suggestions of teaching strategy adjustment and risk early warning through a PPO algorithm. And the overall teaching efficiency is improved.
assignees: CHONGQING DINGXINGHUI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for constructing and optimizing configuration of user side energy storage system configuration optimization model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy storage, and discloses a method for constructing and optimizing configuration of a configuration optimization model of a user side energy storage system, according to the invention, through integrating the historical monthly electricity price, load, renewable energy and energy storage system parameters, the optimization deviation caused by the missing data dimension is avoided, and the suitability of the model to the actual electric power market environment is improved. Furthermore, based on the moon dynamic charge-discharge threshold candidate set and the particle swarm optimization algorithm, the model can accurately capture the moon price fluctuation characteristic of the electric power market, the limitation of the traditional fixed or seasonal threshold is broken through, and the refinement degree of the energy storage operation strategy is improved. Furthermore, the annual return on investment rate is maximized as an objective function, so that the full life cycle economy of the model focused energy storage system can be guided, the optimization result is ensured to directly serve the core requirements of users for reducing electricity cost and improving investment income, and a reliable technical basis is provided for energy storage project investment decision.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CORP

title_en: Wireless ad hoc network monitoring method based on digital twin model
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a wireless ad hoc network monitoring method based on a digital twin model, which relates to the technical field of the Internet of things and comprises the steps that a main control node periodically receives data uploaded by an edge control node connected with the main control node to obtain a state data matrix containing state data of each node; the method comprises the steps of determining that an abnormal node exists based on a state data matrix, generating a fault type label of the abnormal node, updating the state data matrix and the fault type label of each period to a digital twin model of the wireless ad hoc network, and determining the abnormal node in the wireless ad hoc network according to the mapping relation between each virtual node and the corresponding node in the digital twin model. The application realizes the efficient scheduling of heterogeneous network resources, can ensure the real-time synchronization of the digital twin model and the physical network, remarkably improves the network operation and maintenance efficiency and fault response capability in an industrial scene, and can provide reliable wireless networking and visual decision support for the fields of intelligent manufacturing, emergency communication and the like.
assignees: UNIV NANJING POSTS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS

title_en: Distributed photovoltaic access capability assessment method and system for power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed photovoltaic access capability assessment method and system of a power distribution network, wherein a photovoltaic output probability model based on irradiance distribution and a load probability model based on statistical characteristics are established, the photovoltaic output probability model and the load probability model are randomly sampled to respectively generate a photovoltaic output data set and a load data set, a photovoltaic limit access capacity data set corresponding to different loads and different topologies is obtained through calculation, an MPNN model is used as a state estimation model, network structures and parameters of the MPNN model are set, node injection power and branch power flow power results obtained through probability power flow calculation are used for constructing graph data, multi-section historical graph data are used for conducting offline training on the MPNN model, and the real-time graph data set of the power distribution network is input into the trained MPNN model to obtain real-time photovoltaic limit access capacity of the power distribution network. The method can effectively improve the distributed photovoltaic access potential of the power distribution network.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST;JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Electric vehicle charging intention dynamic sensing method and system applied to charging station server
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for dynamically sensing the charging intention of an electric vehicle, which are applied to a charging station server, and the method comprises the steps of obtaining a charging request containing the real-time position of the vehicle, and calculating the initial probability of selecting the charging station; the method comprises the steps of determining a commitment score commonly represented by travel progress and heading deviation according to the real-time position of a vehicle and a preset navigation path, extracting an evolution trend of the commitment score according to time sequence change of the commitment score, generating a dynamic correction factor, adjusting initial probability by the correction factor to obtain a real-time updated dynamic selection probability, and finally updating a future charging load prediction curve of the charging station based on the dynamic probability and the rated power of the vehicle.
assignees: EAST CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: Intelligent warehouse management system based on logistics data processing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of logistics data processing and artificial intelligence, and discloses an intelligent warehouse management system based on logistics data processing, which comprises a multi-source heterogeneous data fusion preprocessing module, a space-time correlation demand prediction module, a multi-constraint global inventory optimization module, a reinforcement learning intelligent scheduling module, an environment state space, a digital twin visual decision support module, a physical warehouse and digital model real-time synchronization module, a decision suggestion and risk early warning module, wherein the multi-source heterogeneous data fusion preprocessing module is used for acquiring global distributed warehouse center data in real time and outputting a space-time standardized multi-dimensional characteristic data set, the space-time correlation demand prediction module is used for constructing a space-time model, a long-short-term memory network and an attention mechanism are used for deep prediction, the multi-constraint global inventory optimization module is used for constructing a multi-target optimization model, a solution is obtained through a decomposition coordination method, the environment state space is established, the physical warehouse and the digital model are synchronized in real time, and the decision suggestion and the risk early warning module is used for realizing intelligent prediction of culture perception.
assignees: SHANDONG DINGRUAN TIANXIA INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Maintenance training information monitoring method, system, equipment and medium based on virtual reality
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of virtual reality, in particular to a maintenance training information monitoring method, system, equipment and medium based on virtual reality. The method comprises the steps of collecting static data, dynamic data, visual data and historical data of a transformer substation, constructing a digital twin model of the transformer substation through a geometric modeling engine, presetting maintenance tasks in the digital twin model, dividing the tasks into equipment inspection, fault processing and safe operation categories, decomposing operation steps by using a behavior tree modeling method, collecting and maintaining related behavior data through wearable equipment such as head-mounted VR equipment, data gloves, voice input equipment and motion capture equipment, performing feature extraction and intelligent evaluation on the behavior data by using a deep learning algorithm combining a long-short-term memory network and a fully-connected neural network, and generating a personalized training report comprising general score analysis, detailed step analysis, operation optimization suggestion and comparison analysis.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD TALENT DEV CENTER

title_en: Power supply safety real-time protection system based on power transmission line construction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power supply safety real-time protection system based on power transmission line construction, which comprises a multidimensional sensing module, a high-precision positioning and attitude determination module and a construction site edge calculation unit, wherein the multidimensional sensing module is used for acquiring pose data of construction machinery, environmental meteorological data, personnel position data and power grid operation data in real time, the high-precision positioning and attitude determination module is used for acquiring centimeter-level three-dimensional space coordinates and attitudes of the tail end of a movable part of the construction machinery and personnel, and the construction site edge calculation unit is in communication connection with the multidimensional sensing module and the high-precision positioning and attitude determination module and is used for carrying out space-time registration, fusion and local real-time calculation on multi-source heterogeneous data to construct a construction local digital twin body. The invention can more comprehensively realize the power supply safety real-time protection of the power transmission line construction.
assignees: ANHUI OUYUE INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based power system parameter dynamic verification method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system monitoring, in particular to a digital twinning-based power system parameter dynamic verification method, a system, equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model of an electric power system, establishing a state mapping relation between a physical system and the digital model, realizing bidirectional dynamic mapping between the physical system and the digital model through a digital mapping mechanism, obtaining system operation characteristics, constructing a parameter verification model based on the operation characteristics, obtaining a verification objective function through fusion of physical constraints and data driving, adopting a self-adaptive parameter correction algorithm, dynamically adjusting a parameter value through real-time evaluation model error to generate a parameter correction amount, carrying out self-adaptive adjustment optimization strategy according to an operation state based on a multi-objective optimization dynamic optimization mechanism, carrying out continuous optimization on a verification process, and carrying out multidimensional evaluation on a verification result through a verification accuracy evaluation system to generate a parameter verification result. The technical problems of inaccurate modeling, slow response speed and poor adaptability of the traditional method are effectively solved.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Distributed resource relief power distribution network heavy load method and device under electricity protection and communication constraint
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for relieving heavy load of a power distribution network by distributed resources under power conservation and communication constraint, which relate to the technical field of operation optimization of power systems, and are used for receiving original communication data, inputting the original communication data into a missing data prediction model, and outputting and obtaining a complete communication data prediction result based on an attention mechanism and a Bayesian neural network technology; the method comprises the steps of inputting a complete communication data prediction result into a pre-established energy information model which is distributed towards heavy duty responsibility of a power grid, outputting a trained distributed resource agent based on a multi-agent safety reinforcement learning technology and heavy duty constraint of the power distribution network, inputting the trained distributed resource agent into a pre-established multi-equipment aggregation management model, aiming at frequent power conservation constraint of a user side, considering resource availability under the power conservation condition, and finally outputting a distributed resource agent decision result meeting the power conservation requirement.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Distributed photovoltaic-oriented intelligent power grid load prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent power grids, in particular to a distributed photovoltaic-oriented intelligent power grid load prediction method and system, comprising the steps of collecting total load data, distributed photovoltaic power generation power data and meteorological data of a target area and adjacent areas thereof, and preprocessing; the method comprises the steps of extracting space correlation features and time sequence evolution features of photovoltaic power generation power data, fusing the space correlation features and the time sequence evolution features to generate a low-dimensional space-time feature matrix, splicing the space-time feature matrix, total load data and meteorological data to form a multi-mode fusion feature vector, inputting a machine learning prediction model to generate an initial load prediction result, introducing real-time updated ultra-short-term meteorological prediction data, dynamically correcting the initial prediction result through a linear regression error correction model, and outputting a final load prediction value. The method can remarkably improve the space-time precision and the real-time adaptability of load prediction in the distributed photovoltaic scene, and has good practicability and engineering popularization.
assignees: YUNCHENG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Grape wine fermentation predictive monitoring system based on machine learning and digital twin
abstract_en: The invention relates to a machine learning and digital twin-based wine fermentation predictive monitoring system, which belongs to the field of automatic control and comprises the steps of acquiring real-time operation parameters and system configuration parameters of a fermentation process through a data acquisition module; when the power grid is monitored to be powered off, the system can determine the net heat flux consisting of heat generated by metabolism of yeast and heat transferred from the environment based on the temperature of the fermentation broth, the ambient temperature and the sugar degree, and determine the total energy absorbable by the wine and the cooling system based on the temperature of the fermentation broth and the temperature of the cooling medium. The system divides the total absorbable energy by the net heat flux to calculate a flexible time window to predict the length of time required for the broth temperature to reach the upper safety limit, and compares the time window to a preset threshold to determine the risk level. The invention realizes prospective prediction of fermentation risk through an accurate thermodynamic coupling model and self-optimizing capability, and provides decision basis and intervention opportunity for operators.
assignees: QINGDAO HUADONG WINERY CO LTD

title_en: Novel distribution network transient stability judging method and system based on fault panoramic information
abstract_en: Novel distribution network transient stability judging method and system based on fault panoramic information. The method comprises the steps of continuously injecting an active detection sequence into a power grid, collecting echo signals of key nodes, calculating a real-time echo feature vector reflecting the current state of the power grid by comparing the frequency spectrums of the echo and the detection sequence, comparing the real-time echo feature vector with a reference vector generated based on a digital twin body, quantifying deviation and calculating a transient stability entropy value, carrying out frequency spectrum decomposition on the echo signals once the transient stability entropy value or the increasing rate of the transient stability entropy value exceeds a preset threshold value, identifying unstable resonance frequency, and finally judging that the power grid is in an unstable state and giving an early warning if the frequency exceeds a steady state range. By implementing the technical scheme provided by the application, the sensitivity of the transient stability judgment of the distribution network is improved.
assignees: XINING POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Multi-dimensional dynamic intelligent management and control method and system for power supply reliability of high-voltage distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-dimensional dynamic intelligent management and control method and system for power supply reliability of a high-voltage distribution network, which are characterized by constructing a differential index system, determining key indexes, constructing a digital twin body of the high-voltage distribution network, establishing a calculation logic chain mapping relation between each key index and real-time data streams of a plurality of data sources, processing the real-time data streams based on a weight self-adaptive multi-source data fusion algorithm to obtain real-time data corresponding to the key indexes, performing real-time calculation of indexes based on the fusion data, simultaneously injecting prediction data to perform simulation deduction in the digital twin body, outputting a current index value and a predictive index value, performing root cause analysis through a knowledge graph when the current index value and/or the predictive index value are abnormal, determining root cause, executing the optimization strategy based on a generation rule base matching optimization strategy, and feeding back a closed loop self-evolution of a driving strategy base and the differential index system based on an execution effect.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Digital twinning-fused power plant equipment fault prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for predicting faults of digital twin-fused power plant equipment, and relates to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting real-time multi-mode time sequence operation data of equipment, preprocessing the data through an edge computing node, and obtaining preprocessed multi-mode time sequence data; according to the preprocessed multi-mode time sequence data, dynamically evolving the running state of virtual equipment through a multi-physical field coupling model in a digital twin body, carrying out on-line calibration on rigidity, damping and heat conduction coefficient parameters in the twin model by taking measured data of a physical entity as a reference to generate simulation data which is consistent with the physical entity in a time-frequency domain, and carrying out time domain, frequency domain and time domain feature fusion on the simulation data and various fault samples in a historical fault database to construct a high-dimensional initial feature set. The invention improves the safety and the economic efficiency.
assignees: HUANENG DONGGUAN GAS TURBINE THERMOELECTRICITY CO LTD;XIAN THERMAL POWER RES INST CO

title_en: Distribution line digital twin voltage monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution line digital twin voltage monitoring method and system. The method comprises the steps of calibrating electrical parameters of a thermal conversion probe through a temperature control box, establishing a digital file, constructing a static digital twin body of the integrated file, collecting optical fiber back scattering signals through a DTS host computer to generate a temperature profile, calculating a preliminary voltage value through temperature rise after processing, generating an error correction field based on a standard voltage true value of an anchor point probe, combining spatial distance and environmental similarity, dynamically calibrating a common probe to obtain a final accurate voltage value, further realizing equipment health state diagnosis through analyzing temperature rise residual errors, and finally inputting the voltage value into the digital twin body to perform tide calculation to generate a voltage cloud picture and realize out-of-limit early warning. The method solves the problems of dead zone and insufficient precision of the existing monitoring method, and realizes comprehensive sensing, accurate measurement and intelligent early warning of the voltage state of the power distribution network.
assignees: STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CORP DINGXI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for predicting short-term water demand of town water supply network
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a device, equipment and a medium for predicting short-term water demand of a town water supply network, wherein the method comprises the steps of preprocessing a sample data set, determining a missing value corresponding to a missing data point according to an average value of corresponding variables of K sample data points, and then normalizing the processed sample data set with a maximum value and a minimum value; the method comprises the steps of calculating and determining the mean value and variance of a sample data set according to preset sample dimensions, introducing a learnable affine parameter to dynamically adjust characteristic distribution, dividing the sample data set into blocks according to the size of preset time blocks and preset step length to determine the number of the time blocks of the sample data set, dividing the sample data set into a plurality of sample data point subsets according to the number of the time blocks, and inputting the sample data point subsets into a short-term water demand prediction model trained to a convergence state to determine the short-term water demand of a town water supply network in a target period. The application can avoid the phenomenon of insufficient supply or waste caused by the rapid increase of the short-term water demand.
assignees: UNIV GUANGDONG TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Substation operation scheme compiling method based on three-dimensional model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional model-based substation operation scheme compiling method, which relates to the technical field of electric power operation and maintenance and comprises the steps of collecting multi-source data, constructing a three-dimensional digital twin body, accessing real-time data to form a digital twin platform, inquiring maintenance tasks, carrying out text structuring treatment to form a maintenance equipment set, carrying out special analysis and providing special analysis results, displaying maintenance scenes in the digital twin platform, generating and outputting maintenance operation schemes, returning on-site maintenance data after maintenance operation is finished, and updating the digital twin platform data. According to the invention, by constructing the three-dimensional digital twin body synchronously mapped and dynamically updated with the transformer substation, the overhaul operation scheme is compiled based on the real-time on-site state, the problems of static display and on-site disconnection of the traditional three-dimensional visual system are solved, the traditional steps which depend on manual experience and are tedious and error-prone are converted into automatic algorithm calculation, the time required by special analysis generation is greatly reduced, and the operation and maintenance cost is reduced.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD INFORMATION & COMMUNICATION BRANCH

title_en: AR-based operation and maintenance inspection method for electric power communication machine room
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of operation and maintenance of an electric power system and discloses an AR-based electric power communication machine room operation and maintenance inspection method which comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin causal map comprising a plurality of nodes and directed edges defining causal relations among the nodes, acquiring a real-time scene of the electric power communication machine room and real-time operation data corresponding to physical equipment in the real-time scene through augmented reality equipment, executing reverse tracing attribution from the nodes corresponding to the abnormal states on the digital twin causal map when the abnormal states exist in the real-time operation data, and determining a fault causal chain causing the abnormal states through the augmented reality equipment. According to the invention, the problem that the conventional operation and maintenance tracing is difficult to trace the complex fault source is solved by carrying out AR visualization on the fault cause and effect chain, and the accuracy and efficiency of operation and maintenance inspection of the power communication machine room are remarkably improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN JITONG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Substation construction previewing and safety analysis system based on digital twin three-dimensional model
abstract_en: The invention provides a construction previewing and safety analysis system of a transformer substation based on a digital twin three-dimensional model, which relates to the technical field of digital twin, and comprises a construction previewing module, a construction model analysis module and a construction model analysis module, wherein the construction previewing module is used for previewing future construction projects based on artificial intelligence through the digital twin three-dimensional model of the transformer substation which is dynamically updated based on real-time data interaction; the system comprises a safety analysis module for carrying out safety analysis on the future construction project previewing process, and a command layout module for carrying out safety command advanced layout on the future construction project based on the safety analysis result. According to the invention, based on artificial intelligence, the future construction project is previewed through the digital twin three-dimensional model of the transformer substation which is dynamically updated based on real-time data interaction, the future construction project previewing process is automatically analyzed in safety, and based on the result of the safety analysis, the future construction project is subjected to safety command advanced layout, so that the stability and safety of a transformer substation power system are ensured.
assignees: JIANGSU HAOHAN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Railway bridge digital twin system architecture design method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a railway bridge digital twin system architecture design method and system, which belong to the technical field of railway disaster prevention risk early warning technology and architecture design, form a system demand table according to system overall target analysis system demands, simultaneously deeply mine and analyze system function processes based on demands, establish a system function table and a database, construct a data flow diagram, convert the data flow diagram into a weighted directed graph, calculate a system fuzzy association strength matrix based on node relations in the weighted directed graph in a qualitative and quantitative combination mode, obtain a system physical architecture based on system logic architecture mapping, and divide a subsystem according to a fuzzy hierarchical clustering method again. According to the invention, the functional process is carded out based on the requirements, the functional process is aggregated into the functional domains, and the functions with compact data connection are divided into one functional domain, so that the internal structure of the functional domain is more compact, the correlation and influence degree among the functional domains are reduced, the corresponding speed of the system is improved, and the cost is saved.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG

title_en: Risk control method, device and equipment for enterprise full service chain
abstract_en: The application provides a risk control method, a risk control device and risk control equipment for an enterprise full-service chain, belonging to the technical field of data analysis, and comprising the steps of acquiring real-time service data corresponding to different projects of an enterprise in a current time period; the method comprises the steps of inputting real-time service data of each project into a pre-built full service chain digital twin body based on a space-time attention algorithm to obtain an updated full service chain digital twin body, carrying out risk analysis on the updated full service chain digital twin body by utilizing a pre-trained multi-dimensional anomaly detection model, a settlement risk prediction model and an improved lightweight graph neural network to obtain a risk analysis result of an enterprise full service chain, generating risk early warning information if the risk analysis result meets a configured early warning rule, and determining a risk control strategy corresponding to the configured risk analysis result according to the risk analysis result. The application can intelligently analyze business risks of enterprises and realize real-time risk response.
assignees: ZHONGJIE TELECOMMUNICATIONS CO LTD

title_en: Cloud computing-based irrigation area water resource scheduling optimization method
abstract_en: The invention provides a cloud computing-based irrigation area water resource scheduling optimization method which comprises the following steps of collecting irrigation area multi-source data in real time through an air-space-ground integrated sensing network, preprocessing the data, uploading the data to a cloud platform, constructing a digital twin body of the irrigation area in the cloud platform, dividing the irrigation area into a plurality of subareas according to water attributes, integrating a hydro-mechanical and hydrologic agricultural model, fusing real-time data with future meteorological information, generating a water demand predicted value through a water demand predicted model by taking the subareas as a unit, generating a scheduling scheme by adopting a multi-target optimization algorithm based on the predicted value, taking economic benefit, water resource utilization rate and energy consumption as optimal targets, performing simulation evaluation on the scheme by utilizing the digital twin body, outputting performance index auxiliary decisions, and finally determining the optimal scheduling scheme. The method realizes accurate prediction, dynamic optimization and intelligent scheduling of water resources in the irrigation area, and improves the utilization efficiency of the water resources and the irrigation management level.
assignees: HENAN WATER PLANNING AND DESIGN RES CO LTD

title_en: System and method for ensuring data consistency of low-voltage distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for ensuring the data consistency of a low-voltage distribution network, comprising the following steps of acquiring multi-source operation data uploaded by each acquisition device in the low-voltage distribution network and converging the multi-source operation data into a unified processing channel; the method comprises the steps of adopting a timestamp dynamic alignment and mapping mechanism to detect and correct sampling frequency and time offset to generate a unified time axis, executing unit conversion and field unified operation according to a data type label to construct a standard field structure, adopting a time sequence sliding window interpolation model to predict and compensate missing data, adopting a sliding window abnormal rate detection strategy to identify numerical mutation and execute abnormal replacement, and carrying out structured output on a data set subjected to consistency processing. The method can realize fine alignment, standardization processing and high-reliability correction of the multi-source heterogeneous data, and improve the data consistency level and decision support capability of the low-voltage power distribution network in operation monitoring, analysis and control scenes.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD SHANWEI POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Water supply and drainage monitoring management method based on intelligent early warning
abstract_en: The application discloses a water supply and drainage monitoring management method based on intelligent early warning, and belongs to the technical field of water supply and drainage monitoring management. The method comprises the steps of 1, collecting real-time monitoring data, pump station operation data, weather forecast data and historical maintenance record data, 2, abstracting a pipe network topological structure into a weighted directed graph, constructing a dynamic digital twin model by combining the real-time data, 3, dividing a drainage pipe network into a plurality of independent sub-network units, establishing a comprehensive blockage risk assessment index system, 4, implementing a differential early warning strategy according to the importance and potential influence range of pipe sections, introducing space-time correlation analysis to optimize early warning precision, 5, recording actual treatment results and blockage conditions after each early warning, automatically updating risk scoring parameters in the network topological graph by root cause analysis, and 6, generating a maintenance scheduling scheme according to the blockage prediction results, calculating an optimal inspection and dredging time window, and realizing active preventive maintenance management.
assignees: GUANGXI XIANGBAIBO TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based active protection system and method for tornado of large-span high-speed rail suspension bridge
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure relates to a digital twinning-based active protection system and method for a tornado of a large-span high-speed railway suspension bridge, which are used for acquiring and fusing multi-source heterogeneous data through a three-dimensional monitoring network and a federal Kalman filtering algorithm, so that the rapid positioning of the generation position of the tornado and the accurate prediction of a moving path are realized, and the problems that the space separately rate of the traditional early warning system is low, the timeliness is behind, the tornado effect analysis method of the large-span suspension bridge is too simplified, the accuracy is low and the like are solved, and the wind resistance performance of a bridge structure and the driving safety of a high-speed train under the action of the tornado are ensured.
assignees: CHINA STATE RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD;CHINA RAILWAY SHANGHAI GROUP CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST;CHINA RAILWAY FIFTH SURVEY & DESIGN INST GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent switchboard system with fire prevention function
title_ko: Ai 기반 예지 보전 기능 수행 및 화재 예방 기능을 갖춘 지능형 배전반 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 AI 기반 예지 보전 알고리즘, SiC 기반 고속 차단 기술, 디지털 트윈 연동 시각화, 엣지 컴퓨팅 로컬 분석, 그리고 자연어 이해 기반 사용자 인터페이스(NLU UI)를 포함하는 차세대 지능형 배전반 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 지능형 배전반 시스템은 전력 라인의 상태를 실시간으로 모니터링하고, 고장 징후를 사전에 판단하여 사고를 예방할 수 있으며, 직관적인 사용자 명령 기반 제어가 가능하다. 디지털 트윈, 산업 현장, 지능형 빌딩, 데이터센터, 공공시설 등 다양한 응용 분야에 적용 가능한 AI 기반 예지 보전 기능 수행 및 화재 예방 기능을 갖춘 지능형 배전반 시스템에 관한 것이다.
assignees: AWON CO LTD

title_en: Knowledge graph-based multi-objective decision-making reasoning method and system for new energy consumption
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy consumption multi-objective decision reasoning method and system based on a knowledge graph, the method comprises the steps of completing data acquisition and preprocessing, extracting a core entity and relation between the entities to generate a structured triplet, further constructing the knowledge graph of the energy domain, training and integrating the GNN perceived by the power grid topology by combining historical dispatching data with economy and stability as an optimization objective design loss function to complete model construction, recognizing entity change and relation update in the new data through an incremental learning method, automatically supplementing or correcting the knowledge graph of the energy domain, then extracting a corresponding correlative sub-graph from the updated knowledge graph according to current dispatching requirements, inputting the trained GNN model, outputting a dispatching decision scheme, and accessing the dispatching decision scheme output by the GNN into a power grid digital twin simulation platform to complete simulation and feedback adjustment. The high-efficiency and safe consumption of new energy in a dynamic environment is ensured.
assignees: UNIV HUBEI EDUCATION

title_en: Chemical enterprise safety production informatization management system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of production management of chemical enterprises, in particular to a chemical enterprise safety production informatization management system which comprises a perception network layer architecture, a digital twin management platform, a risk management and decision center, a flow closed-loop management center and an emergency cooperative processing platform. According to the chemical enterprise safety production informatization management system and method, the chemical knowledge graph is constructed, the prediction of the residual service life of equipment, the capture of tiny process anomalies and the simulation processing of accident consequences are realized based on the dynamic risk matrix and the AI prediction model library, meanwhile, the low-level alarm is associated through the root cause analysis module, the fault source is automatically inferred through traversing the knowledge graph, the binding of physical equipment and a virtual model is realized through the entity-model mapping engine, the model state is dynamically updated by combining a real-time rendering technology, and the optimization of process parameters, the deduction of accidents and the verification of schemes can be completed in the simulation engine, so that the management intuitiveness and the decision scientificity are effectively improved.
assignees: HUBEI NINGHUA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Industrial internet NFV energy-saving power supply control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of industrial Internet energy-saving control and discloses an industrial Internet NFV energy-saving power supply control method. The method comprises the steps of obtaining energy supply request information in an industrial Internet environment, generating an energy control semantic vector by adopting a context-aware load analysis mechanism, establishing a power supply coordination network architecture for a distributed virtual network functional entity, expressing entity and side to express energy interaction or functional association by nodes, optimizing network morphology and coordination performance by means of a real-time updating mechanism, configuring the network morphology and coordination performance in an industrial cloud distributed processing framework, dynamically determining a regulation and control area matched with energy saving semantics by using a multistage mapping calculation method based on the energy control semantic vector, selecting an alternative regulation and control measure set meeting the energy saving intention through a multi-dimensional information integration matching process in the regulation and control area, implementing optimization and adjustment, and integrating energy efficiency association, regulation and control measure execution characteristics and environmental context factors in the selection process.
assignees: RUSHAN CITY POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Method and system for generating water engineering scheduling scheme
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for generating a water engineering scheduling scheme. The method comprises the steps of constructing a water engineering scheduling scene database, carrying out feature extraction and clustering on data in the water engineering scheduling scene database to obtain a multi-dimensional scene set, extracting a core scene subset from the multi-dimensional scene set, constructing a reinforcement learning driven water resource allocation model, respectively inputting each core scene in the core scene subset into the water resource allocation model to obtain a water resource allocation scheme corresponding to each core scene, constructing a digital twin water network model, carrying out real-time collaborative scheduling on the water resource allocation scheme corresponding to each core scene by utilizing the digital twin water network model, and generating a corrected water resource scheduling scheme corresponding to each core scene. And constructing an intelligent interpretation frame of the scheduling scheme, and interpreting the corrected water resource scheduling scheme corresponding to each core scene according to the intelligent interpretation frame of the scheduling scheme.
assignees: CHINA WATER RESOURCES BEIFANG INVESTIGATION DESIGN & RES CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based dynamic planning method and system for source network charge storage capacity
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dynamic planning method and a system for a source network charge storage capacity based on digital twinning, which comprise the steps of obtaining operation parameter data of each device to obtain a final device operation parameter set, carrying out mathematical abstraction on each device by adopting a unified modeling mode to obtain a unified device model, extracting device heterogeneous characteristic parameters from the unified device model, adjusting the energy storage capacity by a dynamic allocation mechanism, carrying out real-time capacity allocation by adopting an optimized scheduling algorithm according to an energy storage capacity allocation scheme and real-time load change data to obtain a device operation instruction set, obtaining a device cooperative operation state, obtaining a resource utilization efficiency evaluation result based on the device cooperative operation state, and readjusting the unified device model parameters based on the resource utilization efficiency evaluation result to obtain an optimized capacity allocation scheme. Compared with the prior art, the method and the system realize unified modeling and dynamic allocation of different types of equipment, and have the advantages of improving the collaborative efficiency and the resource utilization rate of a source network charge storage system and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Pipe network heat supply planning transformation and scheduling method based on AI and digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heating planning transformation and scheduling method of a pipe network based on AI and digital twinning, which belongs to the technical field of pipe network optimization and comprises the following steps of S1, S2, constructing a first heating pipe network digital twinning model, S3, acquiring heating pipe network real-time thermodynamic distribution data, S4, clustering, S5, dividing a real-time high-temperature area, a medium-temperature area and a low-temperature area of a heating pipe network, S6, calculating participation rates of all pipelines, S7, planning transformation and scheduling schemes of the heating pipe network, S8, generating new heating pipe network paving data, and constructing a second heating pipe network digital twinning model by local modification based on the first heating pipe network digital twinning model, S9, intuitively knowing the pipe network layout and scheduling results after planning transformation, and not only can add pipelines to meet the demands of users, but also can reduce transformation cost and improve energy utilization rate.
assignees: SUZHOU NUANWEI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Forest satellite fire monitoring method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a forest satellite fire monitoring method based on deep learning, which comprises the steps of collecting multispectral images of a target forest through a satellite remote sensing system, preprocessing the multispectral images, extracting characteristic information of the preprocessed multispectral images, classifying the extracted characteristic information by adopting a convolutional neural network to obtain classified characteristic vectors, determining a fire source area according to the classified characteristic vectors, obtaining a first fire source area set, obtaining environment data, obtaining a second fire source area set according to the environment data and the preprocessed multispectral images through a support vector machine model, obtaining real fire point pixels according to the first fire source area set and the second fire source area set, mapping the real fire point pixels to geographic coordinates of the collected target forest, filling missing data by adopting a spatial interpolation technology, and obtaining final fire point distribution. The invention obviously improves the accuracy and reliability of forest fire detection under complex terrain conditions.
assignees: CHINA FIRE AND RESCUE INST

title_en: Space-time twin CNN-based rural micro-grid group scheduling optimization method, device, equipment, medium and product
abstract_en: The application discloses a space-time twin CNN-based rural micro-grid group scheduling optimization method, device, equipment, medium and product, and relates to the technical field of power system automation and digital twin. The method comprises the steps of obtaining operation data of a rural micro-grid group, carrying out feature extraction on the operation data to determine feature information, determining time-space change rule information according to the feature information based on a deep learning model of a time-space twin CNN, enabling the deep learning model to be a double-branch network and comprise a convolution layer, a pooling layer and a full-connection layer which are sequentially connected, carrying out demand prediction according to the time-space change rule information based on a micro-grid group operation data prediction model to obtain a prediction demand result, and carrying out scheduling optimization on the operation data according to the prediction result based on operation constraint conditions to obtain an optimization result. The application can perform space-time characteristic mining and processing on the operation data of the micro-grid group, and realize the dispatching optimization of the micro-grid group.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Integrated full-cycle management and safety assurance system and method for hydrogen infrastructure in the built environment
title_ko: 건축 환경내 수소 인프라 통합 전주기 관리 및 안전 보증 시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 건축 환경 내 수소 인프라의 통합 전주기 관리를 위한 시스템으로서, 데이터 처리 서버; 및 상기 데이터 처리 서버에 의해 실행될 때, 공통 데이터 환경(CDE)을 유지하여 BIM(Building Information Modeling) 모델 및 운영 데이터를 저장하는 단계와, 상기 수소 인프라와 연관된 다수의 IoT 센서로부터 실시간 시계열 데이터를 수신하는 단계와, 상기 시계열 데이터의 재구성 오류에 기초하여 이상 현상을 식별하도록 구성된 이상 감지 모듈과 식별된 상기 이상 현상에 대한 상기 시계열 데이터 내 각 IoT 센서의 기여도를 결정하도록 구성된 설명 가능한 근본 원인 분석 모듈을 포함하는 AI(Artificial Intelligence) 엔진을 실행하는 단계와, 상기 수소 인프라의 디지털 트윈 및 각 IoT 센서의 결정된 기여도를 표시하는 사용자 인터페이스를 생성하는 단계를 수행하도록 하는 명령어들을 저장하는 비일시적 컴퓨터 판독 가능 매체;를 포함하도록 한 건축 환경내 수소 인프라 통합 전주기 관리 및 안전 보증 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 건축물의 전체 생애주기에 걸쳐 수소 인프라를 안전하고, 효율적으로 설계, 시공 및 관리하기 위한 통합적이면서, 지능적이며, 사전 예방적일 뿐만 아니라, 예측적 및 설명 가능한 안전 관리를 가능하도록 하는 플랫폼을 제공하도록 하는 효과를 가진다.
assignees: BANG JAE WOONG

title_en: Digital Twin-based Electric Vehicle Battery Fire Safety And Health Condition Diagnosis System, Electric Vehicle Battery Fire Safety And Health Condition Diagnosis Method, And Electric Vehicle Battery Fire Safety And Health Condition Diagnosis Data Processing Cloud Server
title_ko: 디지털 트윈에 기반한 전기차량 배터리 화재안전 및 건전상태 진단 시스템과 전기차량 배터리 화재안전 및 건전상태 진단 방법 및 전기차량 배터리 화재안전 및 건전상태 진단 데이터 처리 클라우드 서버
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 디지털 트윈에 기반한 전기차량 배터리 화재안전 및 건전상태 진단 시스템과 전기차량 배터리 화재안전 및 건전상태 진단 방법 및 전기차량 배터리 화재안전 및 건전상태 진단 데이터 처리 클라우드 서버로서, 보다 상세하게는 디지털 트윈(digital twin)을 이용하여 전기차량 배터리 상태를 진단할 수 있도록 구성되는 배터리 진단시스템에 있어서, 상기 배터리 진단 시스템은 디지털 트윈 시뮬레이터 진단기, 상기 디지털 트윈 시뮬레이터 진단기와 유무선 통신 네트워크에 의해 접속되는 클라우드 서버 기반의 디지털 트윈 데이터 저장부 및 상기 디지털 트윈 데이터 저장부와 유무선 통신에 의해 데이터를 수신받거나 각종 조건 설정, 데이터 출력 및 제어 명령을 송신하는 단말기를 포함하여 구성되며, 상기 디지털 트윈 시뮬레이터 진단기는 일정 시간 주기로 측정하되, 전기차량 충전기에 설치된 센서 보드를 이용하여, 충전 전압, 충전 전류 및 주변 대기온도를 포함하는 데이터를 수집하여 처리하는 디지털 트윈 데이터 수집부; 충전되는 실제 전기 차량 배터리와 동일한 해석 조건 및 각종 파라메터 초기값을 가지도록 가상의 디지털 배터리 모델을 설정하는 디지털 트윈 모델 설정부; 상기 디지털 트윈 데이터 수집부를 통해 수집된 각각의 데이터에 근거하여, 디지털 배터리 모델의 내부 전기화학적 거동해석 및 모의실험을 수행하여 수치해석 데이터를 출력하는 디지털 트윈 수치해석부; 상기 디지털 트윈 수치해석부에서 출력되는 수치해석 데이터를 내부 단락과 열폭주 검출 알고리즘과 배터리 열화정도 진단 및 잔존수명 예측 알고리즘에 적용 하여 배터리 내부 단락과 열폭주 여부 판단 데이터 및 배터리 열화 정도와 예측된 잔존수명 진단 데이터를 출력하는 디지털 트윈 배터리 진단부; 및 상기 디지털 트윈 수치해석부에서 출력하는 수치해석 데이터 및 디지털 트윈 배터리 진단부에서 출력되는 진단 데이터를 저장하며 디스플레이 장치에 시각적으로 디스플레이하되, 유무선 통신모듈을 포함하여 상기 디지털 트윈 데이터 저장부에 송신하고, 단말기로부터 입력되는 명령을 수신하여 처리하는 디지털 트윈 출력부;로 구성되며, 상기 디지털 트윈 데이터 저장부는 사물인터넷(IoT) 서버를 포함하여 디지털 트윈 출력부로부터 송신되는 전기차량 배터리 전압, 전류, 온도 데이터를 포함하는 상태정보 데이터와 상기 디지털 트윈 수치해석부에서 출력하는 수치해석 데이터 및 디지털 트윈 배터리 진단부에서 출력되는 진단 데이터를 실시간으로 모니터링하여 저장하고, 저장 데이터의 이력 관리를 수행하여, 유무선 통신에 의해 단말기에 관리 정보를 전송하며, 디지털 트윈 배터리 진단부의 진단 결과 배터리의 내부 단락 또는 열폭주가 있는 것으로 판단되면 경고 메시지 및 신호를 단말기와 미리 설정된 외부통신기기에 전송하며, 상기 단말기는 차량 사용자 단말기 및 차량 충전소 관리자 단말기를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 디지털 트윈에 기반한 전기차량 배터리 화재안전 및 건전상태 진단 시스템과 전기차량 배터리 화재안전 및 건전상태 진단 방법 및 전기차량 배터리 화재안전 및 건전상태 진단 데이터 처리 클라우드 서버에 관한 것이다.
assignees: WONTECH WORLDWIDE CO LTD

title_en: Mobile photovoltaic energy storage power station remote monitoring method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of remote monitoring and discloses a remote monitoring method of a mobile photovoltaic energy storage power station based on the Internet of things, which comprises the following steps that firstly, an edge intelligent terminal is deployed on the site of the mobile photovoltaic energy storage power station, and a digital twin model which is communicated with the mobile photovoltaic energy storage power station in real time is built for the mobile photovoltaic energy storage power station at a cloud server; and step two, the edge intelligent agent terminal collects real-time operation data of the power station. By adopting the technical scheme that the edge intelligent agent terminal is locally deployed in the mobile power station and the AI anomaly detection model is built in for real-time online reasoning, the technical effect of realizing millisecond recognition and autonomous protection intervention of the local emergency fault precursor under the condition of no need of depending on a cloud is achieved, and compared with the technical scheme that the cloud platform is completely relied on for centralized data processing and decision making in the prior art, the system solves the defects that intervention lag is caused by long-distance transmission delay of data and the system completely loses the local autonomous protection capability when a network is interrupted.
assignees: ZHEJIANG JUNNENG NEW ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Full-stack digital twin simulation method and system of power grid dispatching master station
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twin and simulation, and discloses a full stack digital twin simulation method and a full stack digital twin simulation system of a power grid dispatching master station, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a voltage power flow result data set and a temperature field distribution data set, constructing a unified virtual coordinate system, constructing an initial two-dimensional thermodynamic distribution diagram according to an initial mapping matrix, and executing Delaunay triangulation on the initial two-dimensional thermodynamic distribution diagram to generate a mapping error distribution diagram; the method comprises the steps of constructing a Markov chain state sequence, calculating a state transition probability matrix and predicting to generate a corrected mapping matrix, loading the correction matrix by edge nodes to generate a lightweight state vector, uploading the lightweight state vector to a cloud end through multi-level cache to form a set, updating the matrix by the cloud end and issuing a new version, capturing, predicting and correcting the voltage-temperature rise mapping relation in real time along with working condition drift, inhibiting hidden coupling deviation caused by inconsistent data caliber, and ensuring that full-stack digital twin simulation always maintains an electric-thermodynamic combined situation with high precision and high consistency in operation.
assignees: STATE GRID GANGSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY TRAINING CENTER

title_en: Cloud-edge cooperation-based dynamic aggregation and optimal regulation method for multidimensional resources of virtual power plant
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cloud-edge-collaboration-based dynamic aggregation and optimization regulation method for multidimensional resources of a virtual power plant, which comprises the steps of collecting multidimensional data and encrypting the multidimensional data to generate a data stream with a timestamp, extracting global feature vectors through cloud-edge-end federal learning, dividing an aggregation unit by Nystrom accelerated spectrum clustering based on features to construct a virtual power plant model capable of refreshing along with feature drift, designing a three-time-scale regulation closed loop and combining a digital twin synchronous state, and realizing uplink, automatic settlement and model reverse optimization of regulation results based on a alliance chain. The cloud-edge cooperation-based multidimensional resource dynamic aggregation and optimization regulation method for the virtual power plant guarantees data privacy, improves resource aggregation dynamics and regulation precision, realizes cross-main-body trusted cooperation, and is suitable for efficient operation of the virtual power plant.
assignees: XINJIANG YILAIKETE ELECTRIC POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning and wind-light uncertainty-based power grid day-ahead optimal scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twinning and wind-light uncertainty-based power grid day-ahead optimization scheduling method, and relates to the technical field of power grid scheduling optimization; the method comprises the steps of establishing a wind-light uncertainty model according to historical wind-light related data, obtaining a wind power predicted value and a photovoltaic power predicted value by utilizing digital twin and Monte Carlo simulation, adjusting confidence level by utilizing fuzzy opportunity constraint, obtaining wind power expectation and photovoltaic power expectation based on the digital twin and wind power predicted value and the photovoltaic power predicted value, constructing power grid generation power and load power balance constraint, constructing a power grid day-ahead optimization scheduling model, solving based on fuzzy opportunity constraint planning, and outputting an optimal scheduling strategy. The method can effectively capture and quantify the influence of wind and light uncertainty on the day-ahead dispatching of the power grid, and realize the efficient and reliable operation and cost optimization of the day-ahead dispatching of the power grid.
assignees: UNIV GUANGDONG TECHNOLOGY

title_en: VBA technology-based intelligent management system, device and storage medium for power grid review service
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of office systems, and particularly relates to an intelligent management system, equipment and a storage medium for power grid review business based on a VBA technology, aiming at solving the problems of complexity and inefficiency in the traditional manual management process. The tool is based on Microsoft Office VBA programming technology, the system mainly comprises an input end, a data processing module and an output end, wherein the input end comprises modules such as data year, work category, keywords and the like, the data processing module performs preprocessing and calculation, and the output end provides automatic management of review files and daily work related contents. Through the digital and intelligent means, the digital twin technology of the review flow is initiated, three stages of pre-review preparation, process control and post-review tracking are converted into programmable logic, the review work efficiency and quality are effectively improved, the defect of professionals is overcome, and the management flow of power grid engineering is optimized.
assignees: JIXI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HEILONGJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Pumped storage participation power grid frequency modulation control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pumped storage participation power grid frequency modulation control method, which relates to the technical field of power grid dispatching automation and comprises the following steps that S1, a total frequency modulation power instruction issued by a power grid dispatching end is received; and S2, acquiring upper reservoir water level and lower reservoir water level data through a power station monitoring system, and calculating the real-time operation water head of the power station. The pumped storage participation power grid frequency modulation control method effectively solves the adaptability problem of power distribution under the dynamic water head condition by combining the feedforward optimization of the digital twin model with the feedback verification of the local sensor of the unit. According to the method, when the power grid frequency modulation instruction is responded, a power distribution scheme which takes both the operation economy and the equipment safety into consideration can be automatically generated, the failure of executing or entering an unstable operation area due to the fact that the unit exceeds the actual capacity range is avoided, and the reliability of frequency modulation response is improved.

title_en: Intelligent early warning method and system for accident condition of nuclear power station
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of nuclear energy safety and discloses an intelligent early warning method and system for accident conditions of a nuclear power station, wherein the method comprises the steps of unifying the format of real-time operation parameters of the nuclear power station, and quantifying the accident conditions of the nuclear power station based on the state prediction residual error between the optimal estimation and the prediction estimation after data assimilation in the nuclear power station to obtain the current accident state; the method comprises the steps of performing non-invasive sensing on behavior data of an operator to obtain a cognitive load state of the operator, performing prospective deduction and risk assessment on a treatment strategy to obtain a future evolution track, taking a hypothetical fault of the operator as a strong constraint condition based on a current accident state and the future evolution track, performing data reassification to obtain constraint state estimation of the hypothetical fault, performing variable sensitivity identification on observable real-time operation parameters of the nuclear power station to obtain early warning information of the nuclear power station, and improving intelligent early warning efficiency of accident conditions of the nuclear power station.
assignees: JIANGSU NUCLEAR POWER CORP

title_en: New energy station power prediction model feature image construction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy station power prediction model feature image construction method and a system, which belong to the technical field of new energy power systems and automation thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps of extracting basic features of a standardized multi-dimensional unified data set, constructing derivative features, removing the derivative features related to weak power and performing deep screening to obtain a core feature set; and constructing a three-dimensional image system according to the core feature set, wherein each dimension comprises a feature attribute table and an association rule base, calculating mutual information values between feature images of any two dimensions to construct a feature association matrix, and establishing scene combination rules and performing dynamic updating according to the feature association matrix to obtain a real-time updated three-dimensional feature image system so as to complete cross-dimension image fusion. The invention can solve the problems of the prior art that each dimension feature is always stored independently and used independently and lacks systematic integration.
assignees: HUANENG DONGYING HEKOU WIND POWER GENERATION CO LTD;HUANENG CLEAN ENERGY RES INST

title_en: Intelligent line migration and change system and method based on power transmission and transformation
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent line migration and transformation system and method based on power transmission and transformation, which relate to the technical field of data analysis and specifically comprise the following steps of simulating power transmission and distribution line layout to construct a three-dimensional digital twin map and marking bridge positions; the method comprises the steps of carrying out a clustering on the bridge frames according to Euclidean distance among the bridge frames based on the bridge frame positions, calculating a risk evaluation value of the bridge frames according to bearing time length and bearing weight of the bridge frames based on a clustering result, carrying out transition modification on a power transmission and distribution line when the risk evaluation value is larger than a preset first risk threshold value, screening a target bridge frame based on the curvature of the power transmission and distribution line, selecting an optimal target bridge frame based on the risk evaluation value of the target bridge frame, the average curvature and the transition modification length of the power transmission and distribution line, and executing transition modification of the power transmission and distribution line. The application can realize predictive maintenance of the power transmission and transformation circuit and effectively avoid large-scale power supply abnormality caused by bridge damage.

title_en: Energy storage battery module intracavity self-suppression hierarchical fire extinguishing system
abstract_en: The invention provides an energy storage battery module intracavity self-inhibition hierarchical fire extinguishing system which comprises a battery module intracavity self-inhibition unit, a cluster-level strong hedging jet fire extinguishing unit, a cabin-level total-submerged cooling and anti-reburning unit and an intelligent linkage control unit, wherein the intelligent linkage control unit comprises a signal acquisition module, a digital twin pre-judgment module and a fire-fighting linkage controller, the signal acquisition module acquires the state of a power core and the environmental information of a battery, the digital twin pre-judgment module constructs a battery core-module-cluster-cabin full-scale model based on the thermal physical parameters of the battery to predict a thermal runaway path, an FIC receives SAM signal and a digital twin pre-judgment result, and executes a multistage linkage jet strategy of the battery module intracavity self-inhibition unit, the cluster-level strong hedging jet fire extinguishing unit and the cabin-level total-submerged cooling and anti-reburning unit to realize early warning, accurate prevention and control and complete blocking of the energy storage fire of the battery.

title_en: Power failure overhaul scene deduction method for digital twin transformer substation
abstract_en: A method for deducing a digital twin substation power outage overhaul scene comprises the steps of 1, establishing a substation digital twin refined model through multi-source data fusion, 2, establishing and matching a power outage overhaul operation module and an operation mechanical library model, 3, intelligently identifying a space static safety distance, and 4, planning an operation route in real time by using a UE4 simulation space obstacle avoidance and NavMesh navigation algorithm through an overhaul operation dynamic safety deduction optimization method. And 5, performing light-weight display by a front-end and rear-end separation technology. According to the invention, through intelligent matching of the overhaul operation module and the operation machinery library, static safety distance intelligent identification is realized by combining space measurement, and construction operation path optimization is realized aiming at each construction task to be executed, so that light-weight construction flow display is realized through rapid analysis and smooth loading of the digital twin model.
assignees: POWERCHINA HENAN ELECTRIC POWER SURVEY & DESIGN INST CO LTD;POWERCHINA CENTRAL CHINA ELECTRIC POWER ENGINEERING CORPORATION LTD

title_en: Electric power energy optimal scheduling method, device, equipment and medium based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention relates to a digital twin-based power energy optimal scheduling method, device, equipment and medium, which comprises the steps of performing data cleaning and standardization processing based on sensing data and metering data of a power grid physical node to generate a power grid running state data set; the method comprises the steps of extracting equipment capacity and line tide data of corresponding nodes from a high congestion risk node list, analyzing physical operation boundaries to generate capacity margin indexes, constructing an optimization model to generate a regulation strategy parameter set, dynamically updating the regulation strategy parameter set based on external condition changes, converting the regulation strategy parameter set into a control instruction, issuing and executing the control instruction to generate an execution result, fusing prediction data to update a power grid operation state data set to obtain an updated power grid operation state data set, and completing optimization scheduling. The method and the device can achieve the technical effects of improving node congestion risk identification precision, realizing dynamic balance of economy and safety and enhancing self-adaptability of the regulation and control strategy.
assignees: NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV BAODING

title_en: Intelligent booster station outdoor terminal positioning management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent booster station outdoor terminal positioning management system, which relates to the technical field of electric power facility management. The system comprises a collecting module, an analyzing module, a decision module and a decision module, wherein the collecting module is used for obtaining multi-source original data of a cooperative target and a non-cooperative target in a booster station, the analyzing module is used for carrying out fusion processing on the multi-source original data to obtain target state information and generating a multi-target optimal path according to a pre-constructed real-scene terrain model, the decision module is used for identifying a motion state according to the target state information through a preset strategy rule, self-adaptively adjusting and positioning sampling frequency and generating a real-time updated visual path. According to the invention, through multi-source data fusion and intelligent analysis, the positioning accuracy and reliability are improved, the real-time monitoring and dynamic path planning of a moving target are realized, and the safety management efficiency and the emergency response capability of the booster station are effectively improved.
assignees: BEIJING CENTURY CONCORD OPERATION AND MAINTENANCE WIND POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Cantilever bridge construction risk monitoring system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cantilever bridge construction risk monitoring system based on digital twinning, which relates to the technical field of intelligent monitoring and comprises a construction module and an analysis module, constructing a crane construction spectrogram, obtaining construction parameters according to the current construction data and the crane construction spectrogram, analyzing the construction environment, and registering the crane parameters. According to the invention, a crane construction spectrogram is generated by using historical big data, experiences are converted into quantization boundaries, errors of manual subjective judgment are avoided, current operation parameters are compared with spectrograms in second level, an overrun trend is found in advance, pre-warning rather than post-remediation is realized, zero deviation of a pre-warning instruction and a real pose is guaranteed through VR, AR targets, point clouds and ICP, wind power and rainfall are written into a registration matrix in real time, the crane allows an operation interval to automatically stretch along with weather, the shutdown false alarm rate is reduced, four key parameters of distance, rotation, pitching and lifting are registered and locked at one time, and a driver does not need multi-system switching, so that the operation efficiency is improved.
assignees: GUIZHOU ROAD & BRIDGE GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution cabinet health state predictive maintenance system based on digital twinning and intelligent sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution cabinet health state predictive maintenance system based on digital twin and intelligent sensing, which comprises a data acquisition and preprocessing module, a causal degradation characteristic extraction module, a digital twin modeling module, a constraint fusion prediction module, a counterfactual maintenance simulation module, a scheduling and strategy generation module and an optimal scheduling and execution strategy, wherein the data acquisition and preprocessing module is used for acquiring multisource operation data to generate a normalized input data set, the causal degradation characteristic extraction module is used for constructing a causal degradation map to generate a degradation characteristic vector, the digital twin modeling module is used for constructing a power distribution cabinet digital twin model to establish a power distribution cabinet diagram structure topology, the constraint fusion prediction module is used for outputting a component health index, a degradation parameter estimated value and a future state predicted result, and the counterfactual maintenance simulation module is used for introducing a counterfactual maintenance simulator to generate a risk change value and a maintenance cost value. According to the invention, through the combination of multi-mode intelligent sensing and digital twin modeling, the accurate prediction of the health state of the power distribution cabinet and the optimal generation of the maintenance strategy are realized.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGHANG RUOYI ELECTROMECHANICAL ENG CO LTD

title_en: Hydraulic dynamic decision method and system based on digital twin and multi-source heterogeneous data
