The invention breaks through the traditional hysteresis operation and maintenance mode taking the 'temperature overrun' as the judgment basis, and truly realizes the quality change from static monitoring to dynamic prediction and from passive warning to active pre-control.
assignees: BEIJING NORTH STAR TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Grid group load-based power distribution network operation risk early warning method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grid group load-based power distribution network operation risk early warning method, a grid group load-based power distribution network operation risk early warning system, grid group load-based power distribution network operation risk early warning equipment and a grid group load-based power distribution network operation risk early warning storage medium, and relates to the technical field of intelligent power grid safety prevention and control, wherein the method comprises the steps of calculating load similarity and power flow sensitivity of a power distribution network through STGCN based on a reconstruction instruction and power distribution network multi-dimensional operation parameters, constructing a dynamic grid topological graph and marking a state label; calculating a transfer path data set through a DC tide equation based on the dynamic grid topological graph and the state label, and superposing communication delay to generate a risk thermodynamic diagram; identifying the running state of the power distribution network line according to the risk thermodynamic diagram, acquiring a blocking strategy, cutting off a high-risk boundary line, verifying the effectiveness of the blocking strategy through digital twinning, and outputting a final strategy; and the strategy closed-loop verification and dynamic optimization are realized, and the electrical risk is cooperatively restrained and the topological stability is enhanced.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: River channel inundation loss rapid assessment method based on space interpretation coupling
abstract_en: The invention provides a rapid assessment method for river flooding loss based on space interpretation coupling, which comprises the steps of collecting large-section topographic data in a river range, constructing water level calculation data of a one-dimensional hydrodynamic model based on the large-section topographic data, satellite image interpretation data of two banks of the river, determining deep geopoint coordinates and water levels of all sections based on the large-section topographic data, calculating water levels corresponding to all features, judging whether all features are submerged, outputting flooding influence data and processes in a river reach, and performing visual display on a digital twin system, wherein the whole assessment process can be driven only by a conventional river section, hydrological station water level-flow process and a post-disaster remote sensing/unmanned plane interpretation flooding boundary, and a high-precision DEM and building group three-dimensional model are not needed, so that the basic data threshold is greatly reduced.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD;BUREAU OF HYDROLOGY CHANGJIANG WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION

title_en: Construction method of digital twin system of water supply and drainage pipe network for mountain city
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method of a digital twin system of a water supply and drainage pipe network for mountain cities, and particularly relates to the technical field of digital twin, comprising the following steps of: the method comprises the steps of S1, mountain pipe network multidimensional feature digital mapping, S2, structural failure mechanism modeling under geological environment constraint, S3, pipe network hydraulic model reduction of high differential pressure partition, S4, monitoring data and twin body state synchronous channel construction, and S5, digital twin system materialization encapsulation. According to the invention, the quantitative evaluation of the structural risk of the pipe network is formed by calculating the difference value between the sliding force of the slope body and the pulling resistance of the slope protection anchor rod in the high-cut slope section, which exceeds the traditional scope of only focusing on the hydraulic state, meanwhile, the partition level is established according to the hydraulic response based on the identification of the pressure partition by the multi-stage pump station and the pressure regulating tower, the mode of indiscriminate integral solution of the whole pipe network is changed, and the weighted state correction can be performed according to the partition level.
assignees: ZHICHENYUNKE CHONGQING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for estimating virtual inertia of virtual power plant based on MAML and UKF
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric power systems, in particular to a method for estimating virtual inertia of a virtual power plant based on MAML and UKF, which takes a parallel point observability as an entrance, adopts a layered decoupling architecture to construct a data closed loop, provides model support by a digital twin layer after data preprocessing, determines initial parameters and short window evidence through meta-learning and short window posterior inference, the UKF and the noise self-adaptive module are combined to continuously correct the virtual inertia, safety coverage is ensured by means of uncertainty management, the estimated virtual inertia parameters can be further used for generating energy neutral frequency modulation control signals, control actions are executed under the constraint of a preset guardrail, and model updating and evolution are realized through health monitoring and continuous learning. The virtual inertia estimation method based on the frequency modulation can estimate the virtual inertia rapidly and accurately with few samples in a new scene, has the capability of continuously updating evolution and safety compliance, and is suitable for frequency modulation control of the virtual power plant with variable working conditions of a unit or a power grid.
assignees: UNIV KUNMING SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Big data-based energy management method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy management method and system based on big data, belonging to the technical field of energy management, wherein the method constructs a digital twin model of an enterprise energy system through a digital twin modeling module, and establishes a physical and virtual real-time mapping relation; the method comprises the steps of integrating multidimensional data such as energy consumption, service operation, environmental parameters and real-time electricity price through a multisource data fusion module, generating a unified energy state feature vector based on self-adaptive fusion weights, learning an optimal energy configuration strategy through a reinforcement learning optimization module by adopting a deep Q network algorithm, evaluating the energy configuration effect in real time through a closed loop feedback adjustment module, generating feedback adjustment parameters and transmitting the feedback adjustment parameters to a front module, and forming a deep coupled closed loop cooperative system through the four modules.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Digital twinning-based intelligent water affair dynamic supervision method and platform
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a digital twinning-based intelligent water affair dynamic supervision method and a digital twinning-based intelligent water affair dynamic supervision platform, which relate to the technical field of intelligent water affair supervision and comprise risk data fusion, risk early warning and situation deduction, emergency decision and dispatching command, post-treatment evaluation and knowledge precipitation. According to the invention, a comprehensive and scientific risk quantification system is constructed by combining a multi-source data fusion and analytic hierarchy process and an entropy weighting process, and a real-time working condition correction coefficient and a second-level updating mechanism are combined to realize dynamic and accurate depiction of risks of each section of pipeline and each node of a pipe network.
assignees: CHONGQING INTELLIGENCE WATER CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based park carbon emission monitoring method, device and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a digital twinning-based garden carbon emission monitoring method, digital twinning-based garden carbon emission monitoring equipment and digital twinning-based garden carbon emission monitoring medium, and relates to the technical field of carbon emission. The method comprises the steps of collecting energy consumption data, operation data, environment and space data and management and policy data in a park in real time to establish a topological relation between energy consumption equipment and building blocks to form a multidimensional characteristic data set, constructing a digital twin body of the park, simulating real-time carbon flow through the digital twin body, simulating simulated carbon emission of the park based on equipment power, operation time and corresponding energy carbon emission factors, predicting the carbon emission of the preset time by adopting a machine learning algorithm, carrying out attribution analysis on a prediction result, and identifying a key emission source. According to the method, the digital twin body which interacts with the physical park in real time is constructed, and the mixed simulation, machine learning prediction and multi-objective optimization technology is fused, so that the whole-flow fine control of the carbon emission of the park is realized.
assignees: SHANDONG INSPUR WISDOM BUILDING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin body self-adaptive virtual-real synchronization method, system, equipment and medium for risk early warning of electric power marketing operation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of safety and risk management of power systems, and discloses a digital twin self-adaptive virtual-real synchronization method, a system, equipment and a medium for power marketing operation risk early warning. Meanwhile, an adaptive virtual-real synchronization mechanism is introduced, so that the virtual twin can be subjected to prediction-correction integrated adjustment according to the operation state and the environmental change, and the high-fidelity consistency of the virtual-real model is maintained. The invention can effectively improve the risk prevention and control capability and the safety management level of the electric power marketing operation, and provides powerful support for ensuring the safety of operators, standardizing the operation flow and improving the intelligent degree of on-site management.
assignees: HAINAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Regional power grid static security risk early warning system and method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of power system automation and digital twin, in particular to a regional power grid static security risk early warning system and method, the system comprises a multisource heterogeneous data intelligent fusion module, a high-fidelity static security analysis module, a multidimensional dynamic risk assessment module, a hierarchical linkage early warning decision module and a full-link result tracing and optimizing module. The application supports the unified access of four types of heterogeneous data of SCADA, WAMS and equipment on-line monitoring and weather prediction, breaks through the 'data island' of the traditional system, adopts a dynamic time warping algorithm to realize time stamp alignment, corrects space deviation based on GIS kriging interpolation, solves the analysis distortion problem caused by the traditional system time/space deviation, adopts a sparse matrix compression technology and MPI parallel computing framework, improves the efficiency, meets the real-time analysis requirement, dynamically generates N-1/N-2 fault scenes based on equipment health indexes, comprises only N-1 check of healthy equipment, and increases N-2 check of sub-healthy equipment.
assignees: FUXIN POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Distributed distribution network data analysis method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed distribution network data analysis method, a system, equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source heterogeneous data of a distribution network and extracting characteristics; obtaining a load prediction result, obtaining task allocation priority, dividing the task allocation priority into final subareas, generating supplementary measurement data, constructing a state prediction model, generating an initial area state vector, obtaining final global state estimation through fusion correction of an optimization algorithm, and generating an early warning report. According to the method, multi-source heterogeneous data are cooperatively fused through the pre-training language model, the multi-layer perceptron model, the time sequence neural network model and the state prediction model, the problem that single model fusion is difficult is solved, the accuracy of a load prediction result and the robustness of final global state estimation are improved, a state estimation, risk assessment and scheduling optimization closed loop is formed, a final sub-area is divided, load balancing and topological association are considered to obtain an early warning report, support is provided for power distribution network analysis, risk prevention and control and intelligent scheduling, and novel power system requirements are adapted.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Distributed resource state estimation and power prediction method, device and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed resource state estimation and power prediction method, a device and a medium, which belong to the technical field of power system intellectualization, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring equipment operation data and environment data of distributed resources; extracting spatial features through a graph neural network, extracting time sequence features through a time convolution network and a multi-head attention mechanism, performing feature stitching and mapping to output a joint feature vector, inputting the joint feature vector into a pre-built self-adaptive mixed state estimation model to output a real-time state estimation result of distributed resources, inputting the joint feature vector and the state estimation result into a pre-built future power prediction model, outputting a future power prediction result through a generator of an countermeasure network, and optimizing the future power prediction result based on the embedded power balance of a discriminator and the capacity constraint of equipment. The invention solves the problems of state sensing and multi-time scale power prediction under the access of high-permeability distributed resources.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Virtual power plant capacity configuration and regulation operation optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual power plant capacity configuration and regulation operation optimization method, which comprises the steps of constructing an aggregation model and a physical consistent digital twin, establishing a linearization power distribution network model containing voltage and tide constraints, describing resource efficiency and time lag characteristics, forming a time-varying uncertainty set through split calibration and set drift constraint, establishing a capacity-operation combined double-layer optimization model, realizing capacity configuration under full life cycle cost constraint, obtaining a rolling scheduling strategy through distributed robust optimization, ensuring power grid safety before issuing, generating multi-variety collaborative quotations through opportunity constraint and risk measurement on the market side, realizing hierarchical self-adaption re-optimization based on trigger criteria, realizing continuous calibration of the twin model through hardware in a loop experiment, realizing model updating through federal learning and differential privacy, executing degradation control under abnormal conditions, smoothly rolling back after recovery, and finally evaluating and correcting capacity and operation parameters through performance and life linkage.
assignees: BEIJING JINGNENG DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban river water level dynamic prediction and flood early warning system and method based on AI
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AI-based urban river water level dynamic prediction and flood early warning system and method, and belongs to the technical field of urban intelligent flood prevention. The system comprises a system dynamic characteristic analysis module, a risk decoupling and quantizing module, an adaptive decision module and a workflow scheduling engine, wherein the system dynamic characteristic analysis module is used for constructing a city state digital twin body and calculating a system response fingerprint vector representing the dynamic response characteristic of the system, the risk decoupling and quantizing module is used for comparing the system response fingerprint vector with a healthy elastic fingerprint template to determine a fingerprint distortion vector and decouple and output a multidimensional risk vector, the adaptive decision module is used for determining a target action scheme based on the multidimensional risk vector and decision cost, and the workflow scheduling engine is used for executing a workflow corresponding to the target action scheme. By analyzing the system response fingerprint distortion in real time, the invention realizes more accurate and more prospective flood early warning and decision making.
assignees: SUYI DESIGN GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Hydropower station power production management system and method based on industrial digitization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydropower station power production management system and method based on industrial digitization, the system comprises a data acquisition layer, a data management and standard layer, a business application layer, a decision support layer and a security and network layer. The method realizes data interconnection and intercommunication of cross departments and cross links by establishing a unified data center and a standardized treatment system, establishes a digital twin model by combining BIM, GIS and IoT equipment, introduces an AI intelligent prediction and dynamic scheduling mechanism, improves the automation and refinement level of construction and operation and maintenance, and simultaneously integrates a knowledge graph and a risk early warning model at a decision support layer to realize dynamic monitoring and timely response of project progress, cost and safety risk in overseas complex environments, thereby remarkably improving the operation efficiency, safety and risk controllability of the hydropower station.
assignees: CHINA INT WATER & ELECTRIC CORP;CHINA HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based whole-flow collaborative state monitoring method for adhesive tape production line
abstract_en: The invention relates to a digital twinning-based whole-flow collaborative state monitoring method of an adhesive tape production line, which comprises the following steps of S1, starting from process monitoring demand carding, deploying an Internet of things sensor and a visual system, constructing an adhesive tape production line whole-flow perception network, collecting data through an industrial gateway, performing preliminary processing, S2, performing equipment modeling based on the processed multidimensional data, establishing a production flow twinning model by combining a Petri network, realizing process parameter driven simulation and linkage with an MES system, S3, constructing an AI analysis unit, performing state analysis based on the processed multidimensional data, including equipment health prediction and workshop section risk detection analysis, and S4, fusing an AI analysis result with a twining body, and generating a multi-angle state risk view. The invention effectively improves the efficiency and reliability of the cooperative risk monitoring of the adhesive tape production line.
assignees: Fujian youyi adhesive tape group co ltd

title_en: Power scheduling method, equipment and medium for hierarchical optimization of wind-solar-storage direct-current micro-grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power scheduling method, equipment and medium for hierarchical optimization of a wind-solar-storage direct-current micro-grid, which belong to the technical field of energy management of new energy micro-grids, and comprise the following steps of integrating multi-source data of micro-grid operation to obtain a prediction result of load requirements and renewable energy output; the method comprises the steps of establishing a system state space equation, taking a prediction result of load requirements and renewable energy output and key state parameters of a micro-grid as inputs, constructing a double-layer model prediction control framework, generating a control strategy, combining the control strategy with a multi-agent reinforcement learning algorithm to adjust system control parameters, and feeding back the adjustment result to data processing and the system state space equation. According to the invention, the power scheduling performance of the wind-solar-storage direct-current micro-grid is improved through the organic combination of the multi-source fusion prediction module, the real-time state estimation module, the hierarchical optimization scheduling module and the self-adaptive coordination control module.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Transformer bushing adapter and preventive diagnostic system using the same
title_ko: 송전단 전력 추정 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 송전단 전력 추정 장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 송전단 전력 추정 장치는, 수요 입찰을 위해 사내 계량기를 통해 취득되는 전력데이터를 수집하기 위한 데이터 수집부; 상기 데이터 수집부에 의해 수집된 전력 데이터에 대해 반복값 처리, 결측값 처리 및 전력 데이터 집계 방식을 변경하며 케이스 스터디(case study)를 통한 전처리를 수행하기 위한 데이터 전처리부; 및 상기 데이터 전처리부에 의해 처리된 전처리 데이터에 대해 추정 모델을 적용하되, 결측값을 강제로 포함시킨 결측 데이터를 추정 모델 학습에 사용되는 데이터 중 일부 데이터로 사용하여 송전단 전력을 추정하기 위한 송전단 전력 추정부;를 포함한다.
assignees: KOREA ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: Event-driven distribution area digital twin deduction method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution area digital twin deduction method, a system, equipment and a medium based on event driving, which belong to the technical field of digital twin and situation awareness of a distribution system and comprise the steps of collecting running state information of a distribution area; the method comprises the steps of carrying out structural modeling on running state information to construct a load aggregation sequence and an extended disturbance event sequence, inputting the load aggregation sequence and the extended disturbance event sequence into a twin deduction module, carrying out multi-time step prediction by a deduction core based on the structural deduction input output by a driving core, outputting a continuous evolution sequence of the outlet power of the station transformer, and reserving a characteristic channel of a disturbance event to correspond to the prediction output in the deduction process to realize explicit association expression between disturbance factors and a power evolution track. According to the invention, by constructing the three-layer collaborative architecture of the physical layer, the information layer and the twin layer, the expansibility and maintainability of the system in terms of structural definition and functional modularization are obviously improved.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Public building electric power metering carbon emission data missing chain reporting method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a public building electric power metering carbon emission data missing chain reporting method and system, and belongs to the technical field of building carbon emission monitoring and management. The method comprises the steps of collecting original power time sequence data, carrying out structural transformation to generate power standard data, inputting the power standard data into a missing data identification model to identify power data missing items, generating a data abstract for the identified power data missing items, storing the data abstract and associated metadata through a blockchain to obtain stored power data missing items, generating a complement data sequence by adopting a data complement model, associating the complement data sequence with corresponding storage verification information to generate a structural report for the power data missing items, the complement data sequence and the storage verification information, and pushing the structured report to a supervision platform. The invention solves the defects of the traditional method in the aspects of missing perception, data complement and trusted memory, and improves the integrity and the credibility of the building carbon emission data.
assignees: MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD METRIC CENTER;STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent operation and maintenance system and method for oil and gas field station based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent operation and maintenance system and method for an oil and gas station based on the Internet of things, which relate to the technical field of intelligent operation and maintenance and comprise the steps of constructing a station data acquisition module for acquiring station data of the oil and gas station, wherein the station data comprises environment data and equipment operation data; the invention remarkably optimizes the operation and maintenance flow, improves the decision scientificity and improves the predictability and safety of the operation and maintenance of the station by constructing a multi-level three-dimensional data acquisition network and an intelligent decision closed loop based on digital twinning and artificial intelligence.
assignees: HUABEI OILFIELD KEDA DEV CO LTD

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for determining distributed photovoltaic digestion capability of power distribution network
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a method, a device, equipment and a medium for determining distributed photovoltaic digestion capacity of a power distribution network, and relates to the technical field of power. The method comprises the steps of obtaining real-time operation data, load data, photovoltaic output data of a power distribution network in a preset time period, meteorological data of an area where the power distribution network is located, fault probability data of power equipment, operation characteristics of the power distribution network and constraint conditions of a distributed photovoltaic access power distribution network, and obtaining voltage distribution, power flow and line load rate of each node of the power distribution network after the distributed photovoltaic access power distribution network by using a dynamic digital twin model of the power distribution network obtained in advance based on the data. And finally determining the digestion capacity of the distributed photovoltaic based on the voltage distribution, the power flow, the line load rate, the operation characteristics of the power distribution network and the constraint conditions. By the method, accurate evaluation and quantification of the distributed photovoltaic digestion capacity of the power distribution network are realized, so that stable, safe and economic operation of the power distribution network is ensured.
assignees: SHAOGUAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Hydropower station comprehensive monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention provides a hydropower station comprehensive monitoring system, which constructs a high-fidelity virtual model of power station equipment and predicts the equipment state through a full-element digital twin engine module to provide situation prejudging capability. The dynamic reconfigurable deterministic transmission network constructed by the intelligent elastic network architecture module ensures differentiated service quality and transmission reliability. The multi-mode data fusion center generates unified panoramic situation perception information by integrating and fusing multi-source heterogeneous data and prediction results, and provides comprehensive basis for decision making. The intelligent strategy generation module can form a distributed cooperative control strategy, so that the intelligent and cooperative efficiency of system control is improved. And the disaster recovery autonomous recovery module utilizes the strategy and the panoramic information to realize the rapid positioning and automatic recovery of the system faults. And finally, an intelligent resource scheduling module ensures the high-efficiency utilization and the overall operation fluency of system resources. Thereby finally achieving the overall improvement of the operation efficiency, the safety and the reliability.
assignees: HUANENG XINJIANG ENERGY DEV CO LTD TUOSHI GANHE HYDROPOWER BRANCH

title_en: Intelligent power distribution network abnormal state identification method and system based on unmanned aerial vehicle inspection
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent recognition method for abnormal states of a power distribution network based on unmanned aerial vehicle inspection, which comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining power distribution network inspection related data comprising asset main data, historical operation and maintenance data and environmental constraint, S2, constructing a power distribution network digital twin based on the power distribution network inspection related data, obtaining mapping from equipment ID to space pose and parameters, S3, generating a risk heat map based on historical defect and environmental risk scoring, S4, constructing a knowledge map of equipment-geography-working conditions, combining the mapping from equipment ID to space pose and parameters with the risk heat map, generating inspection targets and priorities according to line segments to obtain task packages, S5, performing multi-target navigation line inspection according to the task packages, the risk heat map and the mapping from equipment ID to space pose and parameters, and intelligently recognizing abnormal states of the power distribution network. The invention effectively improves the running reliability of the power distribution network and improves the power supply quality.
assignees: LUOYANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Intelligent power distribution network fault self-healing system and method based on digital twin and artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent power distribution network fault self-healing system and method based on digital twinning and artificial intelligence, and belongs to the technical field of power system automation. The system comprises a physical entity layer, a data perception and interaction layer, a digital twin engine layer, an AI intelligent central layer and an application and display layer. The method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model synchronous with a physical power grid, utilizing a deep learning model to achieve millisecond-level accurate positioning of faults, taking a digital twin environment as a simulation sand table, generating an optimal self-healing strategy through online optimizing of a reinforcement learning agent, issuing and executing the strategy after safety verification, and achieving self-evolution of the model based on feedback data. According to the invention, model synchronization is realized through a Kalman filtering algorithm, fault diagnosis is performed by adopting a mixed model containing 1D-CNN and LSTM, and a multi-objective rewarding function optimization recovery strategy is utilized, so that the problems of poor flexibility and non-optimal decision in the prior art are solved, and the rapid, safe and intelligent self-healing of the faults of the power distribution network is realized.
assignees: CHENG ZIYUE

title_en: Carbon emission factor calculation method and functional module of adapter gateway meter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbon emission factor calculation method and a function module of an adaptive gateway meter, belonging to the technical field of carbon emission of an electric power system, wherein the method comprises the following steps of collecting real-time carbon emission trend data and upstream and downstream position information of the electric power system by utilizing a carbon emission measurement function of the gateway meter; the method comprises the steps of filling missing data, establishing a thermal power unit carbon emission model based on a thermal power unit carbon emission quantification algorithm with enhanced time sequence characteristics aiming at a source side carbon emission factor calculation functional module, calculating net side and load side carbon emission factors, designing a carbon emission factor calculation functional module with corresponding carbon metering factor calculation and communication functions according to different positions of a gateway meter, uploading the calculated carbon emission factors to a cloud electric carbon platform, and displaying regional node hour-level carbon emission factors on the local carbon emission factor calculation functional module. According to the method, the accuracy, the instantaneity and the reliability of regional carbon emission data are remarkably improved by constructing an MS-CBAM-CNN cascade architecture.
assignees: MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Robust light-weight time sequence prediction method based on bidirectional filling and geometric attention
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robust light-weight time sequence prediction method based on bidirectional filling and geometric attention, and belongs to the field of multi-element time sequence data missing filling and prediction. The problem of sensor frequent failure leads to monitoring data to lack under the complicated geological environment is solved, accuracy and reliability of geological disaster prediction are promoted. The invention provides a collaborative processing framework for fusing a bidirectional cyclic interpolation time sequence (bidirectional recurrent imputation for TIME SERIES, BRITS) and a SimpleTM lightweight prediction model. The framework captures forward and backward time sequence dependency and multivariate variable relevance of sensor data by utilizing a BRITS model, accurately identifies failure modes and realizes efficient data filling, and then, by combining a specific stable wavelet transformation multi-scale decomposition and geometric product attention mechanism of the SimpleTM model, finely granularity time sequence characteristics of the filled data are deeply mined under low calculation cost, so that reliable support is provided for subsequent disaster prediction. The method and the system remarkably improve the prediction precision and robustness under the missing data scene, simultaneously give consideration to the light deployment requirement in the tunnel construction environment with limited resources, and effectively ensure the railway tunnel construction safety.

title_en: Collaborative data processing method and system based on source network load storage integration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a collaborative data processing method and a collaborative data processing system based on source network load storage integration, which are used for data acquisition, processing and optimal scheduling of multi-source heterogeneous equipment. The method comprises the steps of registering power generation side equipment, energy storage side equipment, power distribution network equipment and load side equipment, obtaining self-description information, automatically identifying a communication protocol, loading corresponding drivers, generating a standardized data stream through protocol conversion and semantic mapping, executing real-time feature extraction and preliminary calculation by an edge node, performing global state estimation, predictive analysis and optimal scheduling by a cloud platform, establishing a time delay monitoring and task priority mechanism, realizing edge and cloud dynamic collaboration, performing quality assessment and anomaly restoration on transmission data, generating a high-quality data set, establishing a probability distribution model based on the data, calculating uncertainty weight, performing feature fusion and weighted dimension reduction by a collaborative data processing engine, forming weighted confidence matrix input optimal scheduling, realizing system robustness enhancement, and being suitable for a power system with high new energy proportion and large load fluctuation.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID QIANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;CLEAN ENERGY DEVELOPMENT RES INSTITUTE STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Main and power distribution network integrated scheduling monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of monitoring of a main power distribution network, in particular to a main power distribution network integrated scheduling monitoring method and system. When the operation data of the main distribution network are fused, the traditional Bayesian fusion algorithm is improved by using the confidence factor, so that the heterogeneous data sources can be integrated more effectively, more accurate information is provided for the operation and maintenance of the main distribution network, the fused state estimation value reflects the most probable value of the state parameters of the main distribution network under the condition that all the observation data and priori knowledge are given, the information of all the data sources is integrated, and the reliability of different data sources is constrained by the confidence factor, so that the state estimation value is more accurate and reliable.
assignees: SOUTHERN POWER GRID LANMEI INT ENERGY CO LTD;YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting rescue team fire-fighting supervision remote supervision platform for social fire-fighting important units
abstract_en: The application relates to a remote supervision platform for firefighting supervision of firefighting rescue teams on social firefighting key units. The platform comprises an intelligent perception layer comprising a multi-mode sensor network and an edge computing gateway, a heterogeneous communication layer adopting LPWAN and 5G fusion network architecture, an intelligent platform layer comprising a data center, a service center, an AI analysis engine and a blockchain evidence storage module, wherein the data center comprises a time sequence database and a graph database which are respectively used for storing equipment operation time sequence data and facility association relation data, the AI analysis engine comprises a water pressure trend prediction model based on an LSTM neural network and the like, the blockchain evidence storage module adopts HYPERLEDGER FABRIC chained storage operation records, and an application service layer comprises a multi-terminal interaction system, a multi-level alarm system and a digital twin interface. The platform realizes the intellectualization, high efficiency and precision of fire supervision through the cooperative work of each layer, and effectively solves the problems of manpower deficiency, low efficiency, enterprise operation interference and the like in the traditional fire supervision mode.
assignees: ZHANG YUANXIANG

title_en: Switch cabinet monitoring method, equipment and medium based on Internet of things technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a switch cabinet monitoring method, equipment and medium based on the technology of the Internet of things, and relates to the technical field of integration of the Internet of things, wherein a multi-mode time sequence data set is input into a multi-physical field coupling digital twin model to generate a predictive instruction set; the method comprises the steps of dynamically adjusting a discrimination probability threshold and a surge degree parameter in a lightweight convolutional neural network based on a risk level quantification value in a predictive instruction set to obtain an adjusted lightweight convolutional neural network, carrying out pattern recognition on partial discharge pulse waveform data by using the adjusted lightweight convolutional neural network to generate a fault early warning event identifier, and realizing efficient fusion and time synchronization of information of multiple physical fields such as partial discharge, temperature and vibration of a switch cabinet by constructing a multi-mode time sequence data set, thereby improving the data integrity and accuracy of state perception and effectively guaranteeing the safety and stability of long-term operation of the switch cabinet.
assignees: FUJIAN HUADIAN KEMEN POWER GENERATING CO LTD

title_en: Power grid operation risk assessment model training method and power grid operation risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid operation risk assessment model training method and a power grid operation risk assessment method, which comprise the steps of obtaining a power grid operation history record in a demarcation area, constructing a digital twin scene of a power grid operation scene according to a typical power grid operation scene, randomly generating power grid operation risk parameter combinations in a plurality of demarcation areas, respectively combining the power grid operation risk parameter combinations with the digital twin scene to obtain a simulated power grid operation record, constructing a training data set according to the power grid operation history record and the simulated power grid operation record, training the risk assessment model by combining the training data set, adjusting parameters of the risk assessment model until model output conditions are met, and outputting the trained risk assessment model.
assignees: GUANGZHOU JINGKAI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for monitoring health of mass energy network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for monitoring health of an energy network, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring real-time monitoring data of the energy network by utilizing a preset energy network digital twin body based on multi-source heterogeneous data in the operation process of the energy network, determining parameter values of preset health indexes based on the real-time monitoring data, calculating the parameter values of the preset health indexes and preset weights by utilizing a preset health index formula to obtain health indexes of the energy network, determining an abnormal event identification result of the energy network based on the multi-source heterogeneous data by utilizing the preset energy network digital twin body, and generating monitoring information of the energy network according to the health indexes and the abnormal event identification result. The method and the device realize real-time sensing, accurate assessment and abnormal early warning of the health state of the mass energy network.
assignees: NAT PETROLEUM PIPELINE NETWORK GROUP CO LTD

title_en: MEMS-based high-integration meteorological detection system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of meteorological detection, in particular to a high-integration meteorological detection system based on MEMS, the system comprises an intelligent MEMS sensing unit, a multi-source dual correction fusion module, an intelligent cooperative scheduling module, an intelligent prediction early warning module and a self-adaptive power consumption management module. The intelligent MEMS sensing unit integrates multiple meteorological parameter sensors, the multi-source dual correction fusion module adopts a sensor error correction-multi-source data assimilation framework, the multi-source data are fused to generate 50-meter resolution grid meteorological products, the intelligent collaborative scheduling module realizes dynamic linkage of fixed and mobile platforms based on edge calculation and rapidly responds to meteorological element mutation, the intelligent prediction early warning module adopts an improved LSTM model which introduces an attention mechanism to realize accurate early warning of future 3-hour local disaster weather, and the self-adaptive power consumption management module dynamically adjusts power consumption and prolongs equipment endurance.
assignees: BEIJING QIANHAI LEADCENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-objective optimization-based railway bridge digital twin system computing resource allocation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for distributing computing resources of a railway bridge digital twin system based on multi-objective optimization, which belong to the technical field of railway disaster prevention risk early warning and resource allocation, and are used for analyzing a railway bridge digital twin system architecture, dividing subsystems and analyzing computing and transmission data size of each functional module of the system, constructing a multi-objective computing resource optimization model by combining computing resources such as performance requirements, computing capacity, price and the like of the system and computing data and transmission data size, simply improving a multi-objective genetic algorithm by adopting integer coding, multi-point crossing and a variation scheme based on Shannon entropy, and solving the multi-objective optimization model to obtain a series of system computing resource optimization allocation schemes. The invention realizes the optimal computing resource allocation of the digital twin system of the railway bridge after the real-time requirement is met through inspection, and plays an important role in promoting the development of the railway disaster prevention field and the application of the digital twin technology in the railway field.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG

title_en: Urban underground pipe network digital map construction and optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital map construction and optimization method of an urban underground pipe network, which belongs to the technical field of urban infrastructure management, and aims to realize comprehensive monitoring, analysis, early warning, evaluation and decision support of the urban underground pipe network such as water supply, water drainage, heat supply, fuel gas and the like through an integrated digital twin technology, an artificial intelligent algorithm, a big data analysis, a three-dimensional visualization technology and a data management technology, realize real-time updating and dynamic simulation of the state of the pipe network through real-time data acquisition and integration and combined with the construction of the three-dimensional modeling and the digital twin model, deeply analyze the data of the pipe network, predict potential risks, optimize maintenance plans, reduce operation risks and improve resource allocation efficiency.
assignees: JIANGSU YANGTZE RIVER DELTA SMART WATER RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;XINJIANG WESTERN UNITED DIGITAL IND DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;ZHEJIANG EAST UNITED WATER ENV CO LTD;ZHEJIANG WEIPU ENVIRONMENTAL TECH CO LTD;NANJING WEIPU WATER ENG CO LTD;NANJING WEIGAN IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: New energy intelligent operation and maintenance system based on AI and digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy intelligent operation and maintenance system based on AI and digital twin, which relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation and energy storage. According to the invention, the sensing and control layer is used for collecting power station equipment and environmental data in real time, the data collection and edge calculation layer is used for completing preliminary analysis and quick response locally, timeliness of fault processing is effectively improved, the cloud platform is used for carrying out deep mining and model training on mass data by depending on an AI analysis engine, system performance is continuously optimized, an updated model is issued to the edge side, local intelligence is continuously enhanced, meanwhile, the digital twin and decision visualization module is used for realizing holographic mirroring and dynamic deduction of the running state of the power station, accurate decision and predictive maintenance are carried out by assisting management staff, and finally, a continuously evolved closed-loop intelligent operation and maintenance system is formed, so that energy utilization efficiency, equipment reliability and operation and maintenance automation level are remarkably improved.
assignees: ZHEJIANG JEC NEW ENERGY ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Heating power pipeline overhead laying simulation system for cross-sea bridge
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of overhead laying simulation of thermal pipelines, and discloses an overhead laying simulation system of a thermal pipeline for a cross-sea bridge, which comprises a sea surface simulation module, a pipeline simulation module, a coupling simulation module, a digital twin calibration module and a comprehensive decision module; the sea surface simulation module is used for collecting and quantifying multisource parameters of typhoons, waves and piers at a cross-sea bridge, and finally outputting a spatially continuous power distribution cloud picture, and the pipeline simulation module can acquire the average pressure, flow and flow speed transient changes of the whole cross-sea pipeline at each time step, establish a structural coupling model of the fluid transient changes in the pipeline and the pipe wall, and output the transient flow pressure in the pipeline. The application breaks through the limitation of the traditional steady state assumption by reconstructing the high-resolution wind wave field of the sea surface simulation module and accurately capturing the internal transient flow of the pipeline simulation module, and can truly reproduce the dynamic process of the wind-wave-bridge-pipe multiple coupling effect when typhoons pass through the environment.
assignees: DALIAN POWER PLANT OF HUANENG POWER INT INC

title_en: Power grid operation and inspection service management method based on informatization means
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid operation and detection service management method based on an informatization means, which belongs to the field of network operation and maintenance and comprises the steps of S1, establishing integrated data information of the power grid operation and detection service, generating multisource data flow with a time stamp, S2, constructing an operation and detection operation relation model of a hierarchical knowledge graph, conducting semantic modeling on equipment, personnel and operation scenes, achieving task and risk matching identification, S3, executing task dynamic allocation and resource reconstruction, conducting priority optimization and cross-region scheduling, S4, conducting digital twin operation and detection site virtual re-carving, synchronously mapping sensing data and operation images, achieving track, working condition and risk node visualization, S5, conducting abnormal working condition closed-loop management, pushing abnormal data through event triggering and combining historical feedback to form iterative optimization, S6, forming comprehensive performance evaluation and data archiving, and integrating task execution, risk response and equipment maintenance into an intelligent archiving system. The method has the beneficial effects of improving the operation and detection efficiency, accuracy and traceability of the power grid.
assignees: INF & TELECOMMUNICATION CO STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Digital twinning-based source network load storage collaborative optimization scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a digital twin-based source network load storage collaborative optimization scheduling method which comprises the following steps of collecting power system operation data and external data, preprocessing, constructing a full-element digital twin model based on the preprocessed power system operation data and the external data, constructing a dynamic adjustment factor, predicting power system loads based on the full-element digital twin model, simultaneously optimizing the dynamic adjustment factor based on the predicted load data, outputting an energy storage charging and discharging plan, a load switching instruction and a power output curve based on the dynamic adjustment factor, scheduling energy storage charging and discharging based on the energy storage charging and discharging plan, scheduling a load side based on the load switching instruction, and scheduling power output based on the power output curve.
assignees: HUANENG HENAN ZHONGYUAN GAS POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: New energy power grid load balance regulation and control system based on flexible resource allocation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy power grid load balance regulation and control system based on flexible resource allocation, which relates to the technical field of new energy power grid regulation and control, and comprises a data acquisition module, a model construction module, a new energy output and user load prediction module, a configuration scheme generation and robustness screening module and a regulation and control strategy execution module; according to the invention, dynamic optimization of load balance is realized by constructing a digital twin model of a power grid, industrial, commercial and residential electricity data and environmental parameters such as wind speed and illumination are collected through a smart electric meter, a meteorological API (application program interface), distributed energy equipment and a SCADA (supervisory control and data acquisition) system to form a standardized data set, the power grid running state is mapped in real time by integrating a power grid topology, equipment parameters and running state sub-model, the model output is corrected by an equipment deviation calibration algorithm, the prediction precision is ensured, the limitation of a single data source is broken through, and the accuracy of new energy output and user load prediction is improved through a space-time load prediction algorithm.
assignees: HEBI POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HANAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Watershed intelligent scheduling method integrating hybrid graph model and multi-objective hierarchical optimization
abstract_en: The invention provides a watershed intelligent scheduling method integrating a mixed graph model and multi-objective hierarchical optimization, which comprises the steps of obtaining geographic information system data and edge sensor data of a watershed, generating a weighted directed graph through a dynamic topology reconstruction module according to the geographic information system data and the edge sensor data, generating a multi-objective hierarchical optimization strategy through a multi-objective optimization engine according to the weighted directed graph and preset scheduling targets and constraint conditions, selecting an optimization algorithm through a self-adaptive dimension reduction engine according to the multi-objective hierarchical optimization strategy, generating a scheduling scheme, and outputting a final scheduling result through a feedback control layer according to the scheduling scheme and a digital twin body adjustment scheduling strategy. The method can also promote the power generation income of the power station, reduce the economic expenditure caused by ecological problems, and promote the sustainable development of the ecological environment of the river basin while guaranteeing the economic benefit.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Transmission and distribution cooperative real-time carbon flow analysis method
abstract_en: The invention provides a transmission and distribution cooperation real-time carbon flow analysis method, which comprises the steps of acquiring power grid model and green electricity related data of a full voltage level from a provincial regulation system, a distribution network system and a regulation cloud database, realizing data synchronization through a forward isolation device, constructing a multi-level cooperation state estimation model based on a provincial county three-level power grid topology, correcting parameter deviation of a power distribution network by adopting a distributed Kalman filtering algorithm, combining the power generation side carbon emission intensity and a line loss dynamic correction coefficient, calculating node carbon emission factors in real time by utilizing an improved carbon flow tracking algorithm, generating a space-time distribution carbon flow analysis result, realizing carbon flow tracking of the full voltage level of a power system, accurately calculating the node carbon emission factors, and improving the accuracy of carbon flow analysis.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD PINGHU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD JIAXING POWER SUPPLY CO;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic hazard source identification and safety path generation method for fire scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic hazard source identification and safety path generation method for a fire scene in the technical field of data processing for prediction purposes, and relates to the technical field of data processing for prediction purposes.A multi-source heterogeneous data is acquired in real time through a multi-dimensional sensor network to form a multi-mode state snapshot; and the dynamics control equation is obtained by carrying out forward solution by using an embedded physical information neural network and taking real-time data as boundary conditions, outputting a core dynamics vector comprising the fire spreading speed and the toxic gas generation rate, driving a fire digital twin model coupled with the building information model, compressing a minute-level evolution process to a second-level by utilizing parallel calculation to complete prediction, and generating a high-precision three-dimensional risk map capable of accurately simulating a nonlinear jump-type diffusion mode under the influence of an obstacle, thereby improving the prediction speed and accuracy.
assignees: YANGZHOU POLYTECHNIC INST;DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE OF JIANGSU JIANGJIAN GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Power transmission line operation and maintenance method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission line operation and maintenance method and system based on digital twin, which comprise the steps of collecting structural data and operation data of a power transmission line, extracting data characteristics, constructing a digital twin model, carrying out operation state assessment on the digital twin model of the power transmission line, analyzing icing conditions of the power transmission line through assessment results, and formulating an anti-icing operation and maintenance strategy of the power transmission line according to the icing conditions to control the operation of the power transmission line. The invention utilizes the existing acquisition equipment and the transmission line informatization platform data and system to integrate the acquired data so as to establish a perfect transmission line running state monitoring and comprehensive management system in a digital twin mode, thereby realizing the whole process analysis and early warning of the formation and development of ice coating of the overhead transmission line and the intelligent generation of an anti-icing operation and maintenance strategy of the transmission line, and guiding the operation and maintenance of the transmission line before, during and after ice coating.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Novel power grid dispatching control method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel power grid dispatching control method and system based on artificial intelligence, which relate to the technical field of power grid dispatching control and comprise the steps of performing topology fusion modeling on power grid multisource real-time measurement data by adopting a space-time diagram convolution network to obtain a dynamic digital twin body; the method comprises the steps of carrying out risk field prediction on a dynamic digital twin body by adopting a space-time attention mechanism to obtain a time-varying risk distribution result, carrying out ultra-short-term scheduling analysis on the time-varying risk distribution result by adopting a gating space-time unit to obtain dynamic weights of scheduling instructions, carrying out plan optimization on the dynamic weights of the scheduling instructions by adopting a Transformer-OPF hybrid architecture to obtain a power generation plan, checking the power generation plan to obtain scheduling actions, updating the scheduling actions by adopting a differential game mechanism to obtain updated strategy parameters, carrying out dynamic calibration on the updated strategy parameters by adopting Kalman filtering to obtain digital twin body parameter correction, and updating the dynamic digital twin body based on the digital twin body parameter correction.
assignees: STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Intelligent analysis method, device, equipment and medium for unmanned aerial vehicle mapping data
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of data mapping, in particular to an intelligent analysis method, device, equipment and medium of unmanned aerial vehicle mapping data, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining unmanned aerial vehicle mapping data of a target area, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle mapping data represents geological mapping information of the target area; the unmanned aerial vehicle mapping data are subjected to disaster analysis to obtain a monitoring result of the target area, in the case that the monitoring result comprises a preset ground disaster event, in a preset digital twin model, rescue areas of the target area are divided according to rescue functions based on the unmanned aerial vehicle mapping data to obtain a plurality of rescue areas, and a rescue plan is formulated based on the rescue areas. The geological disaster can be predicted in advance, meanwhile, after the geological disaster occurs, the rescue area is rapidly divided, the stable progress of the rescue task is ensured, and the secondary damage of the geological disaster is reduced.
assignees: TIANJIN ZHONGTENG SURVEYING AND MAPPING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based power grid data association method, device, equipment and product
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a digital twin-based power grid data association method apparatus, devices and products. The method comprises the steps of constructing a first model which is characterized as a three-dimensional digital twin model of the power grid static equipment according to standing account data and remote sensing image data in the power grid static equipment in a mirror image modeling mode, constructing a second model which is characterized as the three-dimensional digital twin model of the power grid operation according to equipment state time sequence data, fault and maintenance historical data and environment interaction historical data of historical operation data in the power grid static equipment, carrying out matching fusion on dynamic data of the second model and attribute data of the first model after time stamp alignment according to corresponding matched data identification to generate an associated model of the power grid static equipment, and inputting real-time operation data of the power grid static equipment into the associated model of the power grid static equipment to obtain and display a monitoring picture of the power grid static equipment. The method is used for achieving the effect of improving the use experience of the user.
assignees: SHAOGUAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Multi-source data fusion method for interpolation of power system dispatching data missing sequence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multisource data fusion method for interpolation of a power system dispatching data missing sequence, which comprises the steps of carrying out feature extraction on multisource power grid dispatching data, carrying out standardization processing on the data, extracting attribute set features of the power grid dispatching data missing sequence by adopting the multisource data fusion method on the basis of the obtained density distribution, carrying out pre-state estimation, estimating state following distribution and calculating values of each power grid dispatching data missing sequence, constructing an LSTM long-short-term memory network model, completing interpolation on missing values in a test set, solving the technical problems that the data missing is commonly existed in the power grid dispatching data, and the missing dispatching data has serious influence on safety operation and decision making of a power system.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Wind power engineering wind power intelligent prediction method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a wind power intelligent prediction method, device, equipment and storage medium in wind power engineering, the method comprises the steps of firstly constructing a multi-dimensional digital twin body of a wind power plant containing meteorological, equipment, geography and power grid layers, acquiring full life cycle data of a wind power system based on the multi-dimensional digital twin body, and constructing a four-layer data space set containing meteorological environment, equipment operation, geography and power grid interaction layer data; the method comprises the steps of calculating the influence coefficient of each layer of layer, coupling each coefficient through the product to obtain the comprehensive power generation influence index, and finally outputting the wind power prediction result based on the index and the theoretical power. According to the method, the multidimensional digital twin body is constructed, multidimensional data are collected and fused in real time, the influence coefficients of all layers are calculated and coupled to form a comprehensive index, and the accurate wind power prediction result is output by combining theoretical power, so that the accuracy, adaptability and data comprehensiveness of prediction are remarkably improved.
assignees: CCCC FIRST HARBOUR CONSULTANTS CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for predicting interval state of power system of photovoltaic power station
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a power system interval state estimation method and device for a photovoltaic power station, and relates to the field of power system state estimation, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a space-time correlation model for the target photovoltaic power station based on historical data of the target photovoltaic power station, space uncertainty data of the target photovoltaic power station and time uncertainty data of the target photovoltaic power station; the method comprises the steps of taking uncertainty measurement as a distance boundary between an upper limit and a lower limit of a section and a true value, establishing an uncertainty measurement section state model aiming at a target photovoltaic power station according to measurement uncertainty data of each measurement point of the target photovoltaic power station, adopting an exponential function as an objective function, constructing a state perception model, substituting actual data of the target photovoltaic power station into a power system section state pre-estimated model consisting of a space-time correlation model, the uncertainty measurement section state model and the state perception model, and solving the power system section state pre-estimated model by adopting a Newton method to obtain a state estimation result aiming at the target photovoltaic power station.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD WENSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Substation power equipment discharge monitoring operation and maintenance system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of equipment monitoring, in particular to a substation power equipment discharge monitoring operation and maintenance system, which is characterized in that a substation three-dimensional model is built and equipment information is integrated to form a digital twin body, an ultrasonic sensor array deployed in the substation is utilized to continuously collect signals, an arrival time difference algorithm is adopted to accurately calculate three-dimensional space coordinates of a discharge source after preprocessing, a discharge type is identified, a positioning result is matched with the three-dimensional model to be related to specific equipment, multi-dimensional information such as signal intensity, growth trend, discharge type risk and equipment weight is integrated to intelligently evaluate hidden danger emergency degree indexes, and a corresponding maintenance strategy and a corresponding work order are finally automatically generated. Therefore, the problem that the traditional mode cannot realize continuous monitoring and accurate positioning is effectively solved, the limitation of single threshold alarming is overcome, full-flow automation and intellectualization from discharge discovery, positioning and evaluation to operation and maintenance decision are realized, and hidden danger identification accuracy and operation and maintenance efficiency are remarkably improved.
assignees: DATANG CHONGQING ENERGY MARKETING CO LTD

title_en: Tunnel-scene-oriented vehicle-tunnel collaborative innovation mode and safety operation and maintenance management and control system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a tunnel-scene-oriented vehicle-tunnel collaborative innovation mode and a safety operation and maintenance management and control system and method thereof. The vehicle-tunnel cooperative subsystem consists of an intelligent vehicle and an intelligent tunnel side subsystem, realizes multi-source sensing fusion, road condition prediction and cooperative decision, and provides low-delay vehicle-tunnel integrated data flow for a vehicle-tunnel digital base. The tunnel safety operation and maintenance and intelligent disaster prevention subsystem collects the running state and environment data of the electromechanical equipment and uploads the running state and environment data to the tunnel digital base. The vehicle tunnel digital base relies on a full-time space digital twin model and an artificial intelligent algorithm to uniformly process, analyze and decide vehicle and tunnel data, allocate road resources for an automatic driving vehicle and issue electromechanical equipment control instructions. The system improves the tunnel passing safety, reduces the operation and maintenance difficulty and the cost, and supports the safety operation and intelligent management of the whole life cycle of the tunnel.
assignees: UNIV TONGJI

title_en: Building digital twin energy saving method, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a building digital twin energy-saving method, equipment and medium, wherein the method comprises the steps that an edge computing node collects building multi-mode data and constructs a data set; the method comprises the steps of optimizing an artificial neural network super-parameter by a particle swarm optimization algorithm to obtain an optimized model, predicting building energy consumption in a preset future period, quantizing characteristic contribution degree of a prediction result by a SHAP framework to generate an analysis result, inputting the two to a reinforcement learning body, combining a near-end strategy optimization algorithm and virtual sand table training to generate an optimal control instruction, instructing a issuing edge node to drive a load to act, collecting energy consumption and environment data after execution, feeding back to a digital twin platform, and updating the model super-parameter. The method reduces the peak value of building energy consumption and the operation cost, is suitable for buildings such as houses, businesses, medical treatment and the like, improves the energy efficiency management efficiency, and solves the problem of prediction, analysis and control disjointing.
assignees: SHANDONG INSPUR WISDOM BUILDING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Data center design method and system suitable for power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data center design method and system suitable for an electric power system, and belongs to the field of data management of the electric power system. The method comprises the steps of constructing a quantitative mapping model through multi-source data acquisition, outputting a standardized data value index, establishing a dynamic asset catalog, adopting a multi-objective optimization algorithm to achieve accurate mapping of value to resources, constructing an event-resource-carbon bank joint prediction model to generate an optimal regulation strategy, identifying event regression based on the value index, achieving stable recovery of a system through a value recovery curve, generating a standardized value certificate through a blockchain technology, and completing value conversion through a cross-chain protocol. The method solves the problems of missing data value evaluation, low efficiency of resource scheduling, insufficient prediction capability and the like in the prior art, realizes accurate quantification of data value, intelligent resource scheduling, running situation prediction, stable system recovery and value closed-loop conversion, and remarkably improves the intelligent level of data management of the power system.
assignees: INF & TELECOMMUNICATION CO STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: New energy equipment virtual overhaul system and method supporting fault drilling
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of new energy power construction and operation and maintenance, in particular to a new energy equipment virtual overhaul system and method supporting fault exercise, comprising five core modules, namely an asset and twin modeling module, an electric-mechanical-thermal multi-physical field coupling digital twin model of a wind generating set, a photovoltaic inverter and an energy storage battery cluster, and a fault exercise engine; the fault training engine triggers a fault scene based on a preset event-condition-action logic and an operation state of an operation ticket, activates a fault evolution chain through illegal operation, the operation ticket and flow arrangement module simulates a full flow of overhaul and checks safety constraint in real time, the safety interlocking and protection simulation module triggers protection action and feeds the protection action back to the fault engine when illegal according to relay protection fixed value real-time check operation, the virtual command and the virtual command are synchronized to the engine and an external device through a communication protocol by the virtual-real integration interaction module, consistency of virtual-real operation and protection action is ensured, and full-system collaborative simulation and safety verification are realized.
assignees: XIAN THERMAL POWER RES INST CO;HUANENG BAOTOU NEW ENERGY POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Distribution network power outage risk assessment and early warning method based on multisource information fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network power failure risk assessment and early warning method based on multi-source information fusion, which relates to the technical field of intelligent distribution network risk assessment and comprises the steps of decoding a risk rule set into twin parameters through a semantic analyzer, and outputting a reliability index matrix based on a digital twin risk deduction engine; according to the reliability index matrix, a three-pool linkage optimization deduction engine is adopted, a grading strategy instruction is generated through a particle swarm collaborative optimizing mechanism, the grading strategy instruction is executed, a new energy fluctuation response quantification index is generated through a control disturbance-power supply response transmission method, and a risk assessment early warning result is obtained through the new energy fluctuation response quantification index and combining with a rural distribution network partition risk threshold. According to the method, by generating the risk assessment early warning result, accurate quantification and reliability early warning of the power failure risk of the rural power grid scene are achieved.
assignees: SHIJIAZHUANG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH CO STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Abnormal discharge tracking method for emergency sewage treatment device in chemical industry park
