abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sewage treatment and discloses a method for tracking abnormal discharge of an emergency sewage treatment device in a chemical industry park, which comprises the following steps of data synchronization, namely synchronously acquiring multi-source water quality time sequence data and hydraulic operation data of multiple monitoring points of a park pipe network; the anomaly detection comprises the steps of establishing a time-varying self-adaptive baseline model based on the time sequence data and calculating residual errors of the time-varying self-adaptive baseline model to detect water quality anomaly events, constructing a response core, constructing a time-varying transport response core from a potential source point to a monitoring point through a dynamic model and a data assimilation technology based on pipe network topology and real-time hydraulic data, and performing traceable inversion by inputting the residual errors and the time-varying transport response core into an inverse problem solving model introducing physical constraint and sparse prior. The method for tracking the abnormal emission of the emergency sewage treatment device in the chemical industry park aims to solve the problem that the abnormal emission event is accurately and reliably traced under the condition that the hydraulic working condition of the pipe network of the chemical industry park is difficult to dynamically change.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Dynamic optimization method, system, terminal and medium for new energy power spot transaction
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric power transaction, and particularly discloses a dynamic optimization method, a system, a terminal and a medium for new energy electric power spot transaction. The method comprises the steps of collecting data at a new energy power generation station side, executing prediction processing at the station side to obtain a power generation power prediction result, uploading encrypted model parameters to a coordination node, forming a global optimization prediction model at the coordination node end, then issuing the model parameters to each station, constructing a power grid digital twin body based on the global optimization prediction model, simulating power grid topology and transmission margin parameters, previewing a power spot transaction strategy to obtain a transaction decision result, conducting encryption verification on the power deviation data, outputting an optimization scheme of new energy power spot transaction when verification is passed, triggering an abnormal processing flow when verification is not passed, and conducting rechecking on transaction data. The method and the system realize quick prediction, dynamic simulation and trusted verification while guaranteeing the data privacy, and are suitable for new energy power spot market transactions with cooperative participation of multiple stations.
assignees: SHANDONG INSPUR SMART ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Building semantic map construction and facility management integrated method and system based on AI
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AI-based building semantic map construction and facility management integrated method, which comprises the steps of collecting multi-source data of a building environment through a sensor and a robot, removing noise and redundancy by adopting a data cleaning method to obtain a standardized data set, inquiring historical data records according to abnormal position coordinates, predicting fault evolution trend by adopting a long-short-period memory network, determining an action priority sequence, extracting high priority items from the action priority sequence, generating an executable maintenance instruction through a rule reasoning engine to obtain an optimized scheme list, carrying out simulation verification on the optimized scheme list, confirming scheme validity if the simulation result shows that energy consumption is reduced, obtaining a final deployment path, and driving self-evolution of a digital twin body and meta optimization of a diagnosis rule according to the final deployment path and execution effect thereof.
assignees: GUANGZHOU XINYAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent control and optimization system and method for full process of photovoltaic power station
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent control and optimization system and method for a full flow of a photovoltaic power station, which are characterized in that a component-level high-fidelity digital twin body is built through multi-source heterogeneous data fusion and attention-enhancing deep learning models, marked historical fault data are injected, a feature embedding layer and an countermeasure generation network are combined for training to generate a digital mapping body with fault evolution deduction capability, a three-layer framework is introduced, reinforcement learning and multi-objective optimization algorithm is fused, and autonomous decisions of power station level power output maximization, equipment loss minimization and maintenance cost optimization are realized in a virtual simulation environment built by the digital mapping body. The invention realizes accurate dynamic mapping of physical entities and virtual spaces, fault pre-judgment deduction and closed-loop management and control of global autonomous optimization, improves the intelligentization level and full life cycle economy of the photovoltaic power station, and solves the problems of insufficient fidelity, lack of fault deduction capability and low-efficiency pain point of global optimization in the prior art.
assignees: NANTONG HAOQIANG ELECTRICAL EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic power generation power prediction method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation power prediction, in particular to a photovoltaic power generation power prediction method and device, comprising the steps of obtaining photovoltaic power generation characteristic data of a current period, and preprocessing the photovoltaic power generation characteristic data of the current period; and taking the preprocessed photovoltaic power generation characteristic data as input of a pre-trained hybrid model to obtain photovoltaic power generation power data of the next period of time output by the pre-trained hybrid model, wherein the photovoltaic power generation characteristic data comprises at least one of power generation power, solar irradiance and temperature. The technical scheme provided by the invention has high online updating and deployment capability, and can adapt to the scenes of modern intelligent power grid dispatching, load adjustment, energy management and the like.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;INFORMATION COMMUNICATION BRANCH STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Distribution network operation auxiliary decision-making method and device based on large-model multi-agent cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-model multi-agent cooperation-based auxiliary decision-making method and device for operation of a distribution network, which belong to the field of power system automation, wherein the method comprises the steps of decomposing a task request at a moment t into a plurality of subtasks which can be executed in parallel at the moment t, and distributing the subtasks to different heterogeneous agents by adopting an auction algorithm; the method comprises the steps of establishing a digital twin model of a distribution network, wherein the digital twin model is used for simulating a simulation execution result obtained after a subtask is executed by each heterogeneous intelligent agent at the moment t, calculating Q values of a plurality of local actions corresponding to each heterogeneous intelligent agent in an action space based on the simulation execution result of each heterogeneous intelligent agent at the moment t, and carrying out multi-objective solution according to the Q values to determine a global optimal decision of each heterogeneous intelligent agent when the distributed subtask is executed. The method can efficiently and accurately generate the auxiliary decision of the distribution network operation, and the generated auxiliary decision of the distribution network operation can consider a plurality of targets.
assignees: UNIV WUHAN;STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Future state power grid overhaul risk identification method based on power grid knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention discloses a future state power grid overhaul risk identification method based on a power grid knowledge graph, which relates to the technical field of power system operation and overhaul, and the invention enables a graph to synchronously refresh node states and risk association weights when new energy output, power flow measurement and state estimation are rapidly changed by introducing a time stamp alignment real-time data stream oriented increment update mechanism on a unified power grid knowledge graph, thereby avoiding the problems of risk missing report and early warning lag in a high fluctuation scene of a traditional offline construction graph; after the future state operation mode and the tide scene corresponding to the target maintenance scheme are generated, the influence of the future state tide out-of-limit margin, the topology cut-over on connectivity and the prediction error sensitivity are written back to the side layer of the map, so that the scene and time-sequential calculation of the maintenance operation object risk is realized, and the risk identification result can truly reflect the operation tension in the maintenance period.
assignees: HUNAN WUXIANG ELECTRIC POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Distribution network operation digital twin real-time reconstruction and intelligent investigation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network operation digital twin real-time reconstruction and intelligent investigation method and system, and mainly relates to the field of distribution network operation investigation. The method comprises the steps of autonomous reconnaissance of an unmanned aerial vehicle, real-time return of image streams, three-dimensional reconstruction and light-weight rendering of incremental live-action, accurate measurement of spatial safety distance of semantic guidance, intelligent identification of operation risks of multi-factor coupling, dynamic operation simulation and dangerous point prediction, automatic generation of a reconnaissance report driven by data and specific measure matching. The invention has the beneficial effects that the technical problems of low efficiency and insufficient accuracy in the existing network distribution on-site investigation can be solved, the traditional off-line manual investigation is converted into on-line intelligent analysis and decision based on a high-precision digital twin model, the short-time, high-efficiency and accurate investigation process is finally realized, the burden of a base layer is reduced, and the operation safety level is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO WEIFANG POWER SUPPLY CO;SHANDONG WUZHOU HEXING DESIGN CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic monitoring method and device for carbon reduction amount of power grid infrastructure project
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic monitoring method and device for carbon reduction amount of a power grid infrastructure project, which belong to the technical field of digital twinning, and the method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twinning model according to topology data of each infrastructure project of a target power grid system, and updating the digital twinning model according to real-time power data of each infrastructure project from the starting moment of a period; the method comprises the steps of calculating running time according to current time and cycle starting time, calculating accumulated carbon emission reduction of a target power grid system based on power data of a digital twin model and the running time, calculating predicted total carbon emission reduction of the target power grid system based on the accumulated carbon emission reduction, the running time and cycle total time, calculating carbon emission reduction deviation ratio between the predicted total carbon emission reduction and the target total carbon emission reduction, and adjusting the running state of the target power grid system when the carbon emission reduction deviation ratio exceeds a preset deviation ratio value. Therefore, the method and the device can solve the problem of low timeliness of carbon reduction adjustment in the prior art.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: System and method for supporting high-proportion new energy operation by power grid dispatching intelligent platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of high-proportion new energy, in particular to a system and a method for supporting high-proportion new energy transportation by a power grid dispatching intelligent platform. The method is characterized in that the method relies on data in a real-time parameter data acquisition module, and generates the generated energy between the traditional power generation and the new energy power generation through a digital twin technology in an accurate prediction module to meet different power utilization demands, but the new energy needs to meet a high proportion criterion between the traditional power generation and the new energy power generation, so that a power grid intelligent platform can support high proportion new energy operation, when the generated energy is generated through the digital twin technology, the generated energy is calculated through a new energy permeability formula, and accordingly whether the generated power generation duty ratio generated in the digital twin technology accords with the flow or not can be obtained.
assignees: STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Digital twin-based road disaster response system and method thereof
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 기반 도로 내 재난 대응 시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 실시예에 따른, 디지털 트윈 기반 도로 내 재난 대응 시스템은: 재난 대응 서버; 관리자 장치; 현장 센서; 및 도로에 설치되는 복수의 재난 대응 설비를 포함하고, 현장 센서는 도로 내 폐쇄 공간에 설치되는 복수의 카메라 및 복수의 거리 센서를 포함하고, 재난 대응 서버는: 학습 데이터베이스에 기초하여, 재난에 관한 특성 벡터를 입력받고, 복수의 재난 대응 설비 각각의 동작을 나타내는 대응 벡터를 출력하는 제1 인공지능 모델을 생성하고; 현장 센서로부터 현장 센싱 정보를 수신하고; 현장 센싱 정보에 기초하여 도로 내 폐쇄 공간에 존재하는 객체의 종류 및 위치를 결정하고; 결정된 객체의 종류 및 위치에 기초하여 도로 내 폐쇄 공간의 디지털 트윈을 생성하여 관리자 장치에 송신하고; 결정된 객체의 종류 및 위치에 기초하여 미리 결정된 유형의 재난이 발생하였음을 결정하고; 재난이 발생한 경우, 재난에 관한 제1 특성 벡터를 생성하고; 제1 인공지능 모델에 제1 특성 벡터를 입력하여 제1 대응 벡터를 확인하고; 복수의 재난 대응 설비가 제1 대응 벡터에 따라 동작하는 디지털 트윈 및 제1 대응 벡터에 대응하는 설명을 나타내는 제1 대응 옵션 데이터를 관리자 장치에 송신하고; 관리자 장치로부터 제1 대응 옵션 데이터에 대한 승인이 수신되는 것에 응답하여 제1 대응 벡터에 따라 복수의 재난 대응 설비를 제어하고; 재난 상황이 해소된 것으로 판단된 경우, 재난 발생 이전과 같이 복수의 재난 대응 설비를 제어하도록 구성되고, 미리 결정된 유형의 재난은 정지차량 발생, 낙하물 발생, 화재 발생, 충돌 사고, 역주행 차량 발생, 및 보행자 존재를 포함하고, 특성 벡터는 재난의 유형, 보행자 위치, 보행자 수, 보행자 속도, 화재 위치, 화재 범위, 정지차량 위치, 정지차량 대수, 역주행차량 위치, 역주행차량 속도, 역주행차량 대수, 낙하물 위치, 낙하물 속도, 폐쇄 공간의 입구로부터 사고 위치까지 존재하는 객체들의 종류 및 위치, 및 사고 위치로부터 폐쇄 공간의 출구까지 존재하는 객체들의 종류 및 위치를 나타내고, 대응 벡터는 구조 차량이 폐쇄 공간의 입구로부터 사고 위치에 접근할지 아니면 폐쇄 공간의 출구로부터 사고 위치에 접근할지를 더 나타낸다.
assignees: ANJ SOLUTION

title_en: Artificial Intelligence-Based Multi-Degree-of-Freedom Rotating Solar Power Generation System and Its Driving Method
title_ko: 인공지능 기반 다자유도 회전 태양광 발전 시스템 및 이에 대한 구동방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 인공지능(AI) 기반 다자유도 회전 태양광 발전 시스템 및 이에 대한 구동 방법에 관한 것으로, 기존 3축 회전 시스템을 확장하여 4축 이상의 다자유도 회전 시스템을 적용하고, AI 알고리즘을 활용하여 태양광 패널의 위치를 실시간으로 최적화함으로써 발전 효율을 극대화한다. 또한, AI 기반 풍속 예측 및 구조 강성 조정 기술을 통해 강풍, 태풍, 지진 등의 외부 환경 변화에 능동적으로 대응할 수 있도록 한다. 디지털 트윈 기술을 적용하여 실시간 유지보수 및 자동 점검 기능을 제공하며, 스마트 에너지 네트워크와 연동하여 효율적인 전력 배분 및 저장이 가능하도록 한다. 이를 통해 기존 태양광 발전 시스템의 한계를 극복하고, 높은 효율과 안정성을 갖춘 차세대 태양광 발전 시스템을 제공할 수 있다.
assignees: A STOCK COMPANY GOLD ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Thermal power plant waste heat cascade utilization management method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a thermal power plant waste heat cascade utilization management method and system, belongs to the field of energy and power engineering, and aims to solve the problems of unreasonable waste heat cascade matching, low-temperature waste heat recovery efficiency and insufficient system integration in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-physical field coupling digital twin model and correcting in real time, establishing a dynamic matching matrix of a waste heat source and a heat load based on Yong balance analysis, solving a pareto optimal operation scheme through a multi-objective optimization model, and generating and issuing a cooperative control instruction. The system comprises four modules including panoramic data perception, digital twin modeling, Yong balancing and optimizing decision and collaborative control instruction generation. According to the invention, through global optimization and dynamic regulation, the waste heat utilization efficiency, economy and equipment reliability are obviously improved.
assignees: BAOTOU NO 1 THERMAL POWER PLANT OF BEIFANG UNITED ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based intelligent cooperative control system and method for universe of photovoltaic power station
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of photovoltaic power station control systems, in particular to a digital twin-based intelligent cooperative control system and method for the whole domain of a photovoltaic power station. The invention aims to solve the technical problem of providing a digital twin photovoltaic power station global intelligent cooperative control system and method based on digital twin photovoltaic power station global intelligent cooperative control, which can map the operation state of a physical power station in real time and realize panoramic insight and intelligent cooperative control of the power station. The intelligent cooperative control system and method for the photovoltaic power station universe based on digital twinning comprises a data acquisition and perception layer which is deployed in a physical space of the photovoltaic power station and is used for acquiring operation data and environment data of the photovoltaic power station universe in real time; and the digital twin body constructing and simulating layer is in communication connection with the data acquisition and sensing layer and is used for constructing and updating a digital twin model of the photovoltaic power station based on the acquired data. The invention achieves the effects of mapping the operation state of the physical power station in real time and realizing panoramic insight and intelligent cooperative control of the power station.
assignees: XINJIAN TECH FUJIAN CO LTD

title_en: Distributed collaborative algorithm-based dynamic adjustment control method for output of multi-type power supply cluster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed collaborative algorithm-based multi-type power supply cluster output dynamic adjustment control method, which relates to the field of power grid dispatching, and comprises the steps of constructing a photovoltaic, wind power and energy storage power supply model containing environmental interference and multi-parameter association, realizing cluster topology dynamic coupling through a dynamic association matrix, defining a global state vector covering key parameters of each power supply and the power grid, establishing a multi-scale coupling state estimation model, determining time-varying coupling weights based on dynamic association matrix and state estimation deviation, solving an output adjustment coefficient, respectively adjusting photovoltaic MPPT voltage, wind power pitch angle and energy storage charge and discharge power according to the adjustment coefficient, constructing a multi-objective function containing cost, energy consumption, adjustment speed and health penalty, optimizing power by adopting an improved PSO algorithm of collaborative variable coupling, and finally correcting a photovoltaic temperature coefficient, a wind power turbulence coefficient and an energy storage capacity attenuation coefficient to form closed-loop optimization.
assignees: LAIXI BRANCH STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Operation and maintenance decision method and device of transformer main equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses an operation and maintenance decision method and device of a transformer main device. The method comprises the steps of obtaining current multi-mode equipment related data corresponding to target power transformation main equipment, inputting the current multi-mode equipment related data into a multi-mode encoder to determine current operation state data corresponding to the target power transformation main equipment, inputting the current operation state data into an analysis intelligent body to determine equipment fault reasons and initial operation and maintenance decision schemes corresponding to the target power transformation main equipment, inputting the initial operation and maintenance decision schemes into a verification intelligent body so as to enable the verification intelligent body to perform simulation operation and maintenance processing on equipment digital twin models corresponding to the target power transformation main equipment in a virtual sandbox based on the initial operation and maintenance decision schemes to obtain verification results, inputting the initial operation and maintenance decision schemes into a feedback intelligent body to obtain correction operation and maintenance decision schemes if the verification results are not passed, and outputting and displaying the equipment fault reasons and the correction operation and maintenance decision schemes.
assignees: NORTH CN ELEC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Distribution line rush repair operation risk assessment method, system, equipment and medium based on multi-source perception data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution line rush-repair operation risk assessment method, system, equipment and medium based on multisource perception data, which belong to the technical field of rush-repair operation risk assessment and comprise the steps of collecting and aligning multisource data of perception data, operation data and environment data in a space-time manner, carrying out quality check and missing repair to generate fusion characteristics with credibility weights, constructing a dynamic graph structure taking space nodes and participation roles as vertexes in an operation scene, introducing physical consistency index constraint for reflecting an operation safety boundary into the graph structure to form an interpretable risk characterization mechanism, carrying out distribution robustness and interval calibration on a risk characterization result, carrying out counter-fact simulation on a plurality of candidate response schemes based on digital twin modeling, triggering the perception equipment to execute active compensation operation according to an information value maximization strategy, and feeding the perception and simulation result back to a model for updating iteration. The invention realizes the whole operation process of the power transmission line intelligent risk identification and adaptive control of (a).
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Optical storage straight-flexible system optimization method based on distributed space-time cooperative control
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of system optimization and new energy, and provides an optical storage direct-soft system optimization method based on distributed space-time cooperative control, aiming at the problems of system stability and energy efficiency deficiency in the prior art, comprising the steps of constructing an initial load prediction model by utilizing a graph neural network and realizing long-time cross-region load prediction by adopting federal Kalman filtering; the method comprises the steps of dividing a load curve into different stages through self-adaptive spline interpolation and density clustering, designing a heterogeneous state space and a mixed action space in a multi-agent reinforcement learning scheduling stage, introducing a local rewarding and global collaborative rewarding dynamic adjustment mechanism, collaborative optimizing photovoltaic, energy storage and load through MADDPG algorithm, and realizing edge-cloud closed loop verification and dynamic adjustment through multi-dimensional index evaluation effect and digital twin. The optical storage direct-soft system optimization method based on distributed sensing-layered decision-space-time coordination comprehensively improves the system coordination efficiency, the system energy efficiency and the stability.
assignees: CHANGAN UNIV;HENAN JIAOTOU NEW ENERGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Electric power visual analysis and display method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention provides a large data-based power visual analysis and display method and a large data-based power visual analysis and display system, wherein the method comprises the steps that a server side requests and collects power data of a preset administrative region from a third party power grid platform through a network interface; the method comprises the steps of uniformly packaging collected power data by a server end and sending the power data to a front-end terminal, receiving the power data by the front-end terminal and analyzing the power data by the front-end terminal, associating and binding analyzed data fields with corresponding variable parameters of each component in a local component library by the front-end terminal, converting the analyzed data fields into a visual large screen by a rendering engine of the front-end terminal for display, and dynamically refreshing the running state of a power grid based on real-time updated data. The visual construction system based on the open source and front-end and rear-end separation architecture not only reduces the use and development thresholds, but also combines expansibility and high performance, and is suitable for various business scenes.
assignees: HUNAN XINGTONG POWER INFORMATION COMMUNICATION CO LTD

title_en: Energy management method and system for park comprehensive energy system considering photovoltaic prediction error
abstract_en: The invention relates to a park comprehensive energy system energy management method and system considering photovoltaic prediction errors, which construct a photovoltaic digital twin prediction model based on data driving. Firstly, historical output data and meteorological data of a photovoltaic system are collected, a long-short-period memory neural network is utilized to learn time sequence characteristics of the photovoltaic system, an initial data-driven prediction model is built, and complex physical mechanism modeling is avoided. And then, by monitoring the output data of the physical entity in real time and dynamically comparing the output data with the model predicted value, when the error exceeds a set threshold value, automatically triggering a model updating process, and carrying out on-line adjustment and retraining on the super-parameters of the LSTM model. The mechanism ensures that the prediction model can continuously self-optimize along with environment transition and equipment state evolution, thereby remarkably improving the robustness and reliability of the prediction precision in the whole life cycle.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INSTITUTE STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV SHANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Photovoltaic power station cloud edge cooperative operation and maintenance regulation system and method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention relates to a photovoltaic power station cloud edge cooperative operation and maintenance regulation system and method based on digital twinning, and relates to the field of program control systems in industrial Internet. The system comprises a synchronous identification device, an operation and maintenance regulation device and a control device, wherein the synchronous identification device is arranged at a cloud end, a multi-dimensional digital twin body of a target photovoltaic power station is used for synchronously identifying current hidden crack coverage data, current hot spot coverage data and current dust coverage data of a photovoltaic panel array according to field multi-type data, and the operation and maintenance regulation device is arranged at the cloud end, executes corresponding operation and maintenance alarm operation based on synchronous identification results and provides corresponding operation and maintenance regulation strategies. Aiming at the technical problems that a photovoltaic power station operation and maintenance regulation mechanism lacks a targeted multidimensional state change synchronous analysis mechanism and a cloud edge cooperative operation and maintenance regulation mechanism, the technical problems are solved by establishing a multidimensional digital twin body corresponding to a target photovoltaic power station and establishing a cloud edge cooperative operation and maintenance regulation system at a local end and a cloud end of the target photovoltaic power station.
assignees: JIANGSU FANGYANG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Landslide real-time monitoring and stability assessment system and method based on Internet of things and artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide real-time monitoring and stability assessment system and method based on the Internet of things and artificial intelligence, wherein the system and the method comprise a multi-source heterogeneous sensing network, an Internet of things gateway and a digital twin engine, wherein the multi-source heterogeneous sensing network is used for collecting displacement and inclination data of the surface of a landslide body and stress and water content data inside the landslide body, the Internet of things gateway is used for receiving the data of the multi-source heterogeneous sensing network and carrying out protocol conversion and edge calculation, and the digital twin engine is used for constructing and updating a three-dimensional virtual model of the landslide body according to the data uploaded by the Internet of things gateway, and the three-dimensional virtual model can dynamically reflect the physical state and mechanical behavior of the landslide body.
assignees: QINGHAI METEOROLOGICAL DISASTER PREVENTION TECH CENTER

title_en: Digital twin-forward power distribution network power quality management method based on data-driven decision autonomous evolution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-forward power distribution network power quality management method based on data-driven decision autonomous evolution, which comprises the following steps of S1, collecting data and preprocessing; the method comprises the steps of S2, identifying the power quality problem, the position and the severity, S3, generating a treatment scheme, S4, evaluating the scheme, S5, issuing a control instruction, S6, autonomous evolution of the treatment capability, deep matching of the treatment scheme and the real-time running state of the power distribution network is realized through a dynamic weight decision model, decision deviation caused by data dimension deficiency, equipment reliability deficiency or risk scene misjudgment is effectively avoided, the aim of improving the power quality in a safety boundary is ensured by each treatment action by means of a digital twin preview mechanism and a space-time coupling evaluation model, stable running of the power distribution network is ensured, and technical support is provided for long-term stable power quality guarantee of the power distribution network through an autonomous evolution mechanism of multi-dimensional feedback.
assignees: LAIXI BRANCH STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Autonomous intelligent office system and method for power transmission profession based on multi-mode sensing and digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of informatization and intellectualization of an electric power system, and particularly relates to an autonomous intelligent office system and method of power transmission profession based on multi-modal sensing, digital twin and artificial intelligent technology, wherein the system comprises a cross-modal service model serving as a core cognitive engine of the system; the multi-mode fusion sensing module is used for comprehensively judging the states of a user intention and an office scene through voiceprint, voice, gestures and environment sensor data, the digital twin of the transmission line is synchronous with the data of the transmission line and the panoramic platform in the physical world in real time and used for carrying out state prediction, fault simulation and operation deduction, and the workflow engine with intelligent body drive is used for autonomously planning, scheduling and executing a complex office task sequence.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Digital supervision system and method for highway water transport construction market
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital supervision system and a digital supervision method for highway water transport construction markets, which relate to the technical field of market digital supervision, wherein the system comprises a market authentication archiving module, a public network module and a public network module, wherein the market authentication archiving module is used for establishing globally unique digital identities for all participants and establishing a dynamic linked trusted archive; the system comprises an Internet of things sensing inspection module, an engineering twinning tracking module and a progress quality linkage analysis information processing module, wherein the Internet of things sensing inspection module is used for extracting project information and personnel identity information in a trusted archive, identifying illegal events of a highway water transportation project by combining Internet of things monitoring data acquired by Internet of things equipment, outputting a structured engineering construction record, and the engineering twinning tracking module is used for constructing a digital twinning body fused with the highway water transportation project, combining the engineering project and the engineering construction record and outputting progress quality linkage analysis information. According to the invention, through integrating the multi-module cooperative work, the intelligent level of engineering supervision is improved, scientific decision basis is provided for a manager, the resource allocation is optimized as a whole, and the occurrence probability of engineering delay and quality accidents is reduced.
assignees: HEILONGJIANG TUQI INFORMATION TECH ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: High-proportion new energy power grid energy management method, device, system and equipment based on digital twin
abstract_en: The application relates to a digital twin-based high-proportion new energy power grid energy management method, a device, a system and equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining sampling budget and initial iteration times, and obtaining n pieces of real-time working condition information and m pieces of power scheduling decisions of high-proportion new energy power grid operation; the method comprises the steps of carrying out iterative processing according to sampling budget, initial iteration times, n pieces of real-time working condition information and m pieces of power dispatching decisions to obtain k groups of dispatching decision data, carrying out cluster analysis and optimization processing on each simulation data and each prediction result of each group of dispatching decision data to obtain optimal power dispatching decisions, and screening out the optimal power dispatching decisions with the maximum corresponding posterior mean value from all the optimal power dispatching decisions to serve as an optimal power dispatching scheme for high-proportion new energy power grid operation. The method realizes better power energy dispatching and regulation and control with lower communication cost under the condition of higher accurate simulation difficulty of the high-proportion new energy power grid.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Digital twinning-based demand side response resource adjustment potential evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power resource control, in particular to a digital twinning-based demand side response resource adjustment potential evaluation method and system. According to the method, a plurality of actual electricity consumption data of a user are counted based on a digital twin system for analysis, response execution coefficients are estimated based on historical instruction execution conditions, habit stability coefficients of the user are obtained based on similarity between a single-day load baseline curve and a current-day load curve, an initial adjustment coefficient can be obtained by combining the habit stability coefficients with the response execution coefficients, and theoretical adjustable potential values are adjusted. After the first correction potential value is obtained and instruction feedback is carried out, the actual response deviation is further fed back to the adjustment coefficient to be corrected, and a new potential value result is obtained.
assignees: STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;UNIV NORTH CHINA TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Intelligent management system for power supply service
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power supply service intelligent management system, which relates to the technical field of intelligent power grids, and comprises a power grid holographic sensing module, a device health twin module, a customer energy efficiency service module, a dynamic scheduling decision module and a power grid optimal scheduling strategy and an emergency response scheme, wherein the power grid holographic sensing module is used for acquiring multi-dimensional unstructured data of a power system, extracting core features through cross-domain fusion analysis and generating a power grid real-time operation state map, the device health twin module is used for constructing a device health model by combining a digital twin technology and outputting a device fault early warning signal and a residual life prediction value, the customer energy efficiency service module is used for generating an individualized energy efficiency optimization scheme and an electricity utilization suggestion after analyzing association relation, and the dynamic scheduling decision module is used for generating the power grid optimal scheduling strategy and the emergency response scheme. The invention utilizes the power grid holographic sensing, digital twin technology, dynamic scheduling, block chain and encryption technology to monitor the power system in real time, evaluate the health of equipment, predict faults, optimize electricity consumption, save energy and reduce emission, ensure the data safety and the stable operation of the system and improve the collaborative efficiency of power enterprises and users.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NINGBO BEILUN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Method and system for sensing full life cycle state of energy storage system battery and value circulation
abstract_en: The method and the system for sensing the full life cycle state of the energy storage system battery and circulating the value of the energy storage system battery comprise the steps of generating a digital twin body of each battery module according to static battery information, setting life cycle stage identifiers in the digital twin body, training based on federal task scheduling contracts, dynamically matching edge computing units of each energy storage power station to enter corresponding federal collaborative clustering groups according to the life cycle stage identifiers, acquiring corresponding staged global sensing models and model parameters thereof, updating the corresponding staged global sensing model parameters by utilizing global model parameter updating quantity obtained through decryption, writing state evaluation results and evaluation time stamps into the digital twin body of each battery module according to the parameters updated by the staged global sensing models and real-time operation data of each battery module by an off-link service network, monitoring SOH of each battery module in real time to update the life cycle stage identifiers, training based on federal task scheduling contracts, and constructing a full life cycle data file.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD SUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;UNIV SUZHOU SCI & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Multi-mode collaborative optimization method and system for hydrogen-electricity coupling power market
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrogen-electricity coupling electric power market multimode collaborative optimization method and system, which relate to the technical field of electric power system automation and comprehensive energy management and comprise the steps of collecting wind-solar new energy output prediction data and electric power market data in real time, constructing a multiple profit model integrating spot, auxiliary service, green license and carbon transaction, introducing equipment depreciation cost constraint, calculating optimal profit combination through mixed integer linear programming, realizing rapid switching of hydrogen production and power generation modes based on critical electricity price, generating an optimal scheduling instruction set, collaborative transaction strategies and automatically reporting markets, and carrying out full life cycle economy and safety verification on operation strategies by utilizing a digital twin simulation platform. The invention realizes flexible switching and multi-market income maximization of the hydrogen electric coupling system, remarkably improves the income ratio in projects, enhances the peak regulation and frequency modulation capacity of the new energy power grid, and constructs a full-flow automatic closed-loop system.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Power grid relay protection method based on digital twin model and related equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a power grid relay protection method based on a digital twin model and related equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining protection function logic inside relay protection devices of different protection types, constructing a digital twin model of the protection devices of the relay protection devices based on the protection function logic and intelligent electronic equipment capacity description files of the relay protection devices, determining a digital twin model of target protection devices matched with the field protection devices in the configuration description files of the field intelligent substations in the digital twin model of the protection devices, carrying out instantiation configuration on the digital twin model of the target protection devices based on the configuration description files of the field intelligent substations and field fault data, and determining protection action behaviors of the field protection devices by using the digital twin model of the target protection devices after the instantiation configuration. The method realizes standardized modeling of the digital twin model of the protection device, completes instantiation of the digital twin model of the protection device and remarkably improves power grid fault diagnosis.
assignees: EAST CHINA BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA

title_en: Industrial park power demand optimization scheduling method based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power dispatching and discloses an industrial park power demand optimization dispatching method based on a digital twin technology, which comprises the steps of obtaining regional distribution and historical energy consumption data of an industrial park, dividing the industrial park into a plurality of nodes, determining key characteristics of each node, and constructing an industrial park digital twin model based on the key characteristics; the method comprises the steps of collecting power data and equipment data of each node in an industrial park in real time, predicting power demand and trend characteristics of equipment in the industrial park in the next time period according to the power data and the equipment data based on a digital twin model, generating an optimal scheduling strategy, scheduling the power of the industrial park according to the optimal scheduling strategy, monitoring the operation effect after scheduling, and adjusting the optimal scheduling strategy based on the operation effect to obtain an adjustment scheduling strategy. The invention reduces unnecessary loss through reasonable scheduling of the power resources and improves the overall utilization rate.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING;UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING;CRRC QIHANG NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wide-area measurement intelligent resource regulation and control system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, in particular to a wide-area measurement intelligent resource regulation and control system and a method, comprising the following steps: the system comprises a data acquisition module, a data preprocessing module, a state estimation and data analysis module, a regulation strategy generation module, a safety evaluation module and a regulation execution and feedback module which are connected in sequence in a data interaction mode. According to the invention, through the collaborative operation of the multiple modules, wide area measurement data is accurately acquired and efficiently processed, the operation state of the power system is deeply analyzed, the regulation and control strategy is intelligently generated and optimized, the regulation and control effect is monitored in real time, the optimal allocation of the power system resources is realized, and the safe, stable and economic operation of the power system is ensured.
assignees: STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Intelligent safety monitoring and dynamic risk management and control system and method for polyvinyl chloride polymerization working section
abstract_en: An intelligent safety monitoring and dynamic risk management and control system and method for a polyvinyl chloride polymerization working section comprise a sensing and executing layer, a reliable transmission and safety network layer, a digital twin and intelligent central layer, an algorithm and service center and a business application layer, and an intelligent digital twin body which is in deep interaction and fusion with a physical working section is constructed according to the intelligent digital twin body, so that the fundamental transition from passive response to active early warning, from experience driving to data and model driving and from single-point monitoring to global synergy is realized. The invention realizes autonomous intelligent closed loop of perception-mapping-diagnosis-decision-control, thereby comprehensively improving the safety production level of the working section.
assignees: Shandong lutai chemical co ltd

title_en: Digital twinning-integrated urban power distribution network whole-process scene chain closed-loop monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of smart grids, in particular to a digital twinning-integrated urban power distribution network whole-process scene chain closed-loop monitoring method and system. The method comprises the steps of six-step closed loop control, collecting multi-source data through fusion of a weighted evidence theory and a dynamic time bending algorithm, constructing a physical mechanism-data driving hybrid enhanced digital twin model, based on the model, researching and judging abnormality through an improved isolated forest algorithm, generating a hierarchical alarm, carrying out simulation deduction through Monte Carlo-Latin hypercube sampling, screening an optimal strategy through a non-dominant ordering genetic algorithm III containing uncertainty, carrying out landing execution instruction after topological verification of a graph neural network, forming feedback through acquisition results, and optimizing a calibration model and an optimization strategy through element learning and Bayesian. The system comprises six cooperative units, integrates an intelligent algorithm and a digital twin technology, improves the abnormal identification precision, decision scientificity and self-adaptive capacity of the power distribution network, and ensures safe and efficient operation.
assignees: LUOYANG MENGJIN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Cross-season rock-soil heat storage system based on multi-source waste heat and intelligent regulation
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of geothermal energy storage, and discloses a multi-source waste heat and intelligent regulation-based cross-season rock-soil heat storage system which comprises a physical layer, a multi-source waste heat access and pretreatment unit, an underground heat exchange pipe network, an energy intelligent allocation unit, an information and control layer, an information and control system and an intelligent decision and dispatch center, wherein the physical layer comprises a rock-soil heat storage body, the multi-source waste heat access and pretreatment unit is connected with the underground heat exchange pipe network, the information and control layer comprises a multi-physical-field sensing network which is arranged in the rock-soil heat storage body, a digital twin and multi-physical-field coupling simulation engine which is connected with the multi-physical-field sensing network, and the intelligent decision and dispatch center is communicated with the physical layer and the digital twin and multi-physical-field coupling simulation engine. By introducing the geological stress health index as a key quantization index and utilizing the digital twin and multi-physical field coupling simulation engine to perform real-time calculation and prospective safety check, potential structural damage can be predicted and avoided, and the structural safety and operation reliability of the system are improved.
assignees: WANJIANG NEW ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Method for realizing digital twin of offshore photovoltaic power generation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of offshore power generation, in particular to a method for acquiring marine environment data and motion state data of an offshore photovoltaic power generation system in real time, preprocessing the acquired data, then completing space-time feature fusion, outputting a fusion feature matrix with a time stamp and a space coordinate label, realizing multidimensional feature extraction, mechanical property evaluation and power generation efficiency association analysis based on the fusion feature matrix, constructing a core feature set and attaching a reliability label, constructing a high-fidelity virtual mapping model of the offshore photovoltaic power generation system based on the fusion feature matrix and the core feature set, and simulating real-time dynamic interaction of a physical entity and a virtual model through the high-fidelity virtual mapping model, multi-physical field coupling simulation and full life cycle visual management.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: Autonomous investigation and decision-making method and system for distribution network uninterrupted operation unmanned aerial vehicle group
abstract_en: The invention discloses an autonomous investigation and decision-making method and system for an unmanned aerial vehicle group for distribution network uninterrupted operation, and mainly relates to the field of distribution network uninterrupted operation. The system comprises a step from task issuing to report generation, a step of acquiring and AI processing through multi-sensor fusion, a step of providing objective and quantized data base for safety analysis, and a step of quickly and automatically converting a physical site into an interactive and analyzable digital twin body, so that the system has the capability of coping with environmental changes, and can optimize own investigation strategy through history data learning, thereby realizing the crossing from 'automation' to 'intellectualization'. The invention has the beneficial effects that the invention can solve the technical problems of insufficient flexibility and larger subsequent data processing capacity in the exploration of the existing unmanned aerial vehicle, improves the flexibility of the route in the exploration process, and reduces the difficulty and the workload of subsequent data processing.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO WEIFANG POWER SUPPLY CO;SHANDONG WUZHOU HEXING DESIGN CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Offshore wind power environment element coupling forecasting method and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coupling forecasting method and device for elements of an offshore wind power environment, which belong to the technical field of offshore wind power environment forecasting, are based on a wind-wave-current deep coupling mechanism of an MCT coupler and a power dependent design of sea ice and storm surge on a coupling result, realize full-chain coupling of five elements of wind, wave, current, ice and tide from data assimilation and cooperative calculation to result output, remarkably improve the integral precision and physical consistency of multi-element association forecasting in a complex marine environment, realize the design of a customized output module aiming at multi-scene requirements of the offshore wind power, realize the precise adaptation of forecasting data and practical application, creatively establish the sea ice and storm surge forecasting on a power frame driven by wind-wave-current coupling, and overcome the limitations of a traditional experience model.
assignees: HUANENG CLEAN ENERGY RES INST

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for hierarchical and regional visual modeling of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system, equipment and a medium for visual modeling of layering and partitioning of a power distribution network, which comprise the steps of obtaining multi-source data of the power distribution network and unifying space-time references, dynamically partitioning the area where the power distribution network is located, constructing digital twin layering models of all the partitions by utilizing the multi-source data of the power distribution network and the unified space-time references and a power distribution network component library aiming at all the partitions, splicing the digital twin layering models of all the partitions, and adopting a deduction technology to render working condition scenes of the power distribution network to construct the digital twin layering models of the power distribution network. The method unifies the multi-source data to the same space-time coordinate system, eliminates the reference difference of the multi-source data, improves the positioning precision, builds a layered model by utilizing the multi-source data with the unified space-time reference, solves the problem of splitting the geographic coordinate and electrical connection relation of equipment, builds a standardized component library, improves modeling flexibility and multiplexing capacity under different scenes, builds a seamless splicing mechanism of the partitioned model, and breaks through the limitation that the local update of the large-scale power distribution network model needs integral reconstruction.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Multidimensional information fusion processing system for photovoltaic power station
abstract_en: The multi-dimensional information fusion processing system for the photovoltaic power station is characterized in that processing of massive operation data of the photovoltaic power station is achieved through a cooperative framework of an edge computing layer, a fog computing layer and a cloud platform layer, accurate real-time accounting of carbon emission of the full life cycle of the power station is achieved through construction of a dynamic carbon intensity model, indirect influences such as indirect power grid replacement emission are taken into consideration, and accordingly reliable basis is provided for carbon transaction income calculation, a digital twin body is constructed through the cloud platform layer, a randomness optimization model is operated, economic value and carbon footprint of different operation strategies in long-term operation can be evaluated in a simulation environment, comprehensive influences of various uncertainty factors in the future are fully considered, finally comprehensive balance and fusion decisions are conducted on multiple dimensions such as economy, risk and environmental protection through a multi-attribute value function model, comprehensive optimal operation and maintenance strategies are output, and collaborative optimization of economic benefit, operation safety and carbon emission reduction benefit is achieved.
assignees: LONGYUAN BEIJING NEW ENERGY ENGINEERING DESIGN RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;LONGYUAN BEIJING SOLAR ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid engineering planning scheme optimization management system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid engineering planning scheme optimization management system based on digital twinning, in particular to the technical field of power system planning, which comprises a data perception and fusion module, the system comprises a dynamic interactive digital twin module, an uncertainty quantization and scene generation module, a multi-target self-adaptive robust optimization module and a cross-stage collaborative management module. According to the invention, the digital twin body is driven by real-time data to carry out multi-time scale dynamic deduction, an uncertainty scene set is constructed by utilizing a depth generation model, a distributed robust optimization model aiming at minimizing the worst expected cost is further adopted to generate a robust optimal planning scheme with strong adaptability, and finally, lossless transmission and closed-loop feedback of planning results to a design and construction stage are realized through a digital passport mechanism, so that the robustness, economy and full life cycle management efficiency of the planning scheme are remarkably improved.

title_en: Digital twin-based power distribution network multi-target intelligent scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a digital twin-based power distribution network multi-target intelligent scheduling method and system, and relates to the technical field of power distribution networks. The scheduling method comprises the steps of obtaining physical information data of a power distribution network to form multi-source data, constructing a digital twin model according to the multi-source data, processing the multi-source data to obtain scheduling tasks, and carrying out optimizing scheduling in the digital twin model according to the scheduling tasks to obtain an optimal scheduling scheme of the scheduling tasks. According to the method, the multi-target intelligent scheduling of the power distribution network is realized, the comprehensive economic cost of power grid operation is minimized, the resource allocation is optimized, the voltage deviation of all nodes is minimized, the voltage is ensured to be in a stable and safe range, the equipment damage is avoided, and the cost is saved.
assignees: BEIJING STATE GRID INFORMATION TELECOMMNICATION GROUP ACCENTURE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent water management system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent water management system based on deep learning, which comprises a data acquisition and preprocessing module, a topology modeling module, a state initialization module, a state evolution calculation module, a multi-objective decision module, a physical constraint projection module, a dynamic simulation feedback module and a dynamic simulation feedback module, wherein the data acquisition and preprocessing module is used for acquiring water supply network data and constructing a standardized water supply network input tensor, the topology modeling module is used for generating a water supply network graph structure and graph structure representation thereof, the state initialization module is used for fusing the input tensor and the graph structure to generate an initial state vector, the state evolution calculation module is used for establishing an augmented state evolution equation and carrying out self-adaptive integration to generate a predicted state sequence and source sink estimation, the multi-objective decision module is used for constructing a comprehensive cost function and generating a pump station and valve control instruction, the physical constraint projection module is used for executing water pressure, flow velocity and water age constraint projection and outputting an executable scheduling instruction, and the dynamic simulation feedback module is used for carrying out digital twin simulation and updating a model and sparse estimation weight. The invention realizes fine control and dynamic feedback optimization of the water affair system, and improves the operation efficiency and the dispatching intelligence level.
assignees: CHONGQING AIPAI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power system safety risk prediction method based on digital twinning and related device
abstract_en: The application provides the technical field of power systems, and particularly provides a digital twinning-based power system security risk prediction method and a related device. The application can acquire the operator data, tool data, planning ticket data and system environment data related to the operation of the electric power system in real time, and accordingly update the twin body state of the electric power safety digital twin body, so that the electric power safety digital twin body can be linked with the real situation of the physical world in real time, and the multi-source heterogeneous data of operators, operation plans, operation tools, system environment and the like are deeply fused, thereby providing comprehensive data support for risk analysis. The risk coupling model can be based on the updated twin body state to carry out real-time deduction on the security risk which is continuously changed in the operation process, so that advanced early warning and quantification of the security risk can be realized, and potential security risks possibly related in the field operation process of the electric power system can be comprehensively and accurately predicted.
assignees: GUANGZHOU JINGKAI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Thermal power plant dispatching optimization method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a thermal power plant dispatching optimization method based on multi-source data fusion, which belongs to the technical field of operation and control of power systems and comprises the steps of accessing multi-source data through a containerized micro-service cluster and a mixed communication protocol, generating a high-precision space-time feature matrix through cubic spline interpolation optimized by combining sub-millisecond clock synchronization and genetic algorithm, constructing a mixed model integrating data driving and thermodynamic mechanisms, extracting deep features through wavelet and improved empirical mode decomposition, realizing cooperative optimization of economy and safety through a multi-target optimization algorithm and an intelligent evolution strategy, deploying a hierarchical fault-tolerant architecture and a simulation environment based on a high-speed distributed computing platform and a digital twin technology, and introducing a Kalman filtering closed-loop feedback and online self-learning mechanism to enable the model to have self-evolution capability. The method can remarkably improve the prediction precision, the adjustment performance and the operation economy of the dispatching of the thermal power generating unit, and simultaneously ensure the safety and the stability of the system.
assignees: BAOTOU NO 1 THERMAL POWER PLANT OF BEIFANG UNITED ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Oil product degradation intelligent analysis and operation and maintenance evaluation system of power plant host equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an oil product degradation intelligent analysis and operation and maintenance evaluation system of power plant host equipment, which relates to the technical field of power plant key equipment state monitoring and fault prediction, and comprises a multi-mode sensing module, an edge preprocessing unit, a dynamic reference model construction module, a residual analysis engine, a mirror image diagnosis engine, a fault tracing module and a self-evolution digital twin platform, the multi-mode sensing module is deployed in a lubrication loop of a power plant host device and is used for collecting physical characteristic parameters, pollution state parameters, electrochemical characteristic parameters and abrasion information parameters of oil in real time. The intelligent analysis and operation and maintenance evaluation system for oil degradation of the power plant host equipment realizes high-precision real-time monitoring of multiple parameters of oil states, effectively identifies and filters environmental interference data, ensures accuracy and reliability of fault diagnosis, ensures that the identification time of abnormal states of the equipment is advanced, and effectively controls false alarm conditions.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ZHENENG YUEQING POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Power equipment fault maintenance and debugging system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution equipment maintenance, in particular to a power equipment fault maintenance debugging system and method, wherein the system comprises a multi-mode data fusion acquisition module, a digital twin fault simulation positioning unit, a self-adaptive debugging execution module, a maintenance safety linkage control unit and a full life cycle data closed-loop management module; the method comprises the steps of multidimensional data acquisition, digital twin simulation positioning, self-adaptive strategy debugging, safety linkage monitoring and data closed-loop optimization. According to the invention, the problem of single traditional data is solved through multi-mode data fusion, the 1:1 simulation positioning of a fault scene is realized by combining digital twinning, the self-adaptive module can be automatically matched with various fault debugging strategies, the safety linkage unit interacts with the power grid dispatching system in real time through an IEC61850 protocol, the automatic early warning/power failure of the electric parameter of the overhaul region is realized, the data closed loop module optimizes the strategy library based on historical overhaul data, so that the overhaul efficiency is improved, and the debugging period is shortened.
assignees: UNIV NORTHWEST MINZU

title_en: Urban rail transit emergency command method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of urban rail transit emergency command, and in particular relates to a digital twinning-based urban rail transit emergency command method, which comprises the steps of collecting multi-source data and setting emergency triggering conditions; the invention provides a track traffic command method, which solves the problems of how to estimate the flow direction of people and give an evacuation strategy when a camera is shielded by smoke or powered off in the scene of urban track traffic, and can realize the estimation of the flow direction of people without line of sight and give an evacuation command according to the estimated flow direction.
assignees: HANGZHOU CHUANGMING ZHICAI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power equipment state monitoring system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power equipment state monitoring system based on a digital twin technology, and relates to the technical field of crossing of the digital twin technology and power equipment. The invention constructs the digital twin model of the power equipment by layering, combines geometric simplification and feature preservation to realize model optimization, and adapts different terminal performances by a dynamic loading mechanism to cooperate with feature extraction and visual display, thereby bringing multiple benefits. The hierarchical management ensures that the model accurately reflects the equipment structure and parameters, simplifies the processing balance precision and resource requirements, improves the adaptability and efficiency of the system by dynamic loading, and facilitates the rapid identification of anomalies by visually presenting the equipment state through color mapping by feature visualization. The standardized display logic reduces the learning cost, and the whole scheme improves the equipment monitoring accuracy and the management efficiency, ensures the safe and stable operation of the power equipment, and has strong practicability.
assignees: JINING XINNENG THERMAL POWER CO LTD

title_en: System and method for providing optimal digital twin operation platform for improving reliability of smart energy community
title_ko: 스마트 에너지커뮤니티 신뢰성 향상을 위한 디지털트윈 최적 운영 플랫폼 제공 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: A system and method for providing an optimal digital twin operation platform, according to an embodiment, secure system stability for an industrial complex target operation platform, thereby improving power quality reliability. In addition, the system and method for providing an optimal digital twin operation platform for improving the reliability of a smart energy community, according to an embodiment, can quickly respond to the operation and management of the smart energy community by using a digital twin. In addition, in an embodiment, it is possible to simulate various situations by using the same data as an actual operating situation through modeling using the digital twin.
abstract_ko: 실시예에 따른 디지털트윈 최적 운영 플랫폼 제공 시스템 및 방법은 산업단지 대상 운영 플랫폼을 위해 계통 안정도를 확보하여, 전력품질 신뢰성을 향상시킨다. 또한, 실시예에 따른 스마트 에너지커뮤니티 신뢰성 향상을 위한 디지털트윈 최적 운영 플랫폼 제공 시스템 및 방법은 디지털 트윈을 통해 스마트 에너지 커뮤니티의 운영과 관리에 빠르게 대응할 수 있도록 한다. 또한, 실시예에서는 디지털 트윈을 통한 모델링을 통해 실제 운영 상황과 동일한 데이터를 이용하여, 다양한 상황에 대한 시뮬레이션을 가능하게 한다.
assignees: POWER21 CORP

title_en: Method for managing energy using digital twin and electronic device performing the same
title_ko: 디지털 트윈을 사용하여 에너지를 관리하는 방법 및 이를 수행하는 전자 장치
abstract_ko: 일 실시예에 따른 에너지 관리 방법은 제1 물류 센터에서 제1 전력 정보를 수신하는 단계; 제2 물류 센터에서 제2 전력 정보를 수신하는 단계; 및 상기 제1 전력 정보 및 상기 제2 전력 정보에 기초하여 상기 제1 물류 센터 및 상기 제2 물류 센터의 에너지 분배를 제어하는 단계를 포함한다.
assignees: INS CO LTD

title_en: Power plant flue gas carbon emission real-time prediction and calibration method based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of carbon emission real-time prediction, and relates to a method for predicting and calibrating the carbon emission of power plant smoke in real time based on a digital twin technology, which comprises the steps of constructing a real-time simulation model by collecting operation, fuel, equipment state, environment and historical data, analyzing time sequence data by adopting an ARIMA model to obtain an input and output data set, training the input and output data set by using an LSTM network, optimizing the super parameters of the prediction model through cross verification and whale optimization algorithm, adding mass conservation penalty items into the loss function, outputting a CO2 emission curve through inputting load plans, weather forecast data and a fuel schedule, automatically executing an optimization instruction to generate an operation optimization strategy through setting a carbon optimization mode button, and minimizing predicted carbon emission on the premise of meeting the load demands of a power plant and environmental protection standards.
assignees: UNIV NANJING NORMAL

title_en: Tunnel landslide body morphology analysis system and method based on multidimensional data fusion
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of pipeline construction monitoring and discloses a tunnel landslide body form analysis system and method based on multidimensional data fusion. The method corresponds to the system. The method for predicting the deformation of the landslide body by adopting the decomposition prediction method of displacement components improves the accuracy and the reliability of the deformation prediction of the landslide body, enables a stability assessment result to have high accuracy of machine learning and strong interpretation of a physical model through weighted fusion of a multi-modal neural network model and an intensity folding subtraction method, improves the accuracy and the reliability of a digital twin body through establishing joint inversion of multi-source exploration data and real-time monitoring data, and realizes collaborative monitoring and early warning of the stability of the landslide and the safety state of a pipeline by constructing a complete technical chain from data acquisition, fusion analysis to early warning release, thereby providing an overall process and integrated safety guarantee for the construction of a gas pipeline tunnel.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY NO 5 ENG GROUP;CHINA RAILWAY NO 5 ENG GROUP SOUTH CHINA ENG CO LTD

title_en: Multi-level supply chain service ecological digital twin network collaborative optimization system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of supply chain cooperation, in particular to a multi-level supply chain service ecological digital twin network cooperation optimization system which comprises a system and is used for constructing, optimizing and executing a supply chain digital twin network, wherein the system comprises a physical sensing layer, a physical sensing layer and a control layer, wherein the physical sensing layer is used for acquiring physical entity data and business state data of a whole link of a supply chain in real time through an interface of Internet of things equipment and an information system; the system comprises a physical perception layer, a data fusion and twinning construction layer, a multi-attribute utility theory and a block chain intelligent contract, wherein the physical perception layer is in communication connection with the data fusion and twinning construction layer and is used for carrying out fusion and standardization processing on acquired multi-source heterogeneous data and based on a unified supply chain knowledge graph, realizing full-flow accurate mapping and real-time visualization of a supply chain by constructing a multi-level digital twins, automatically optimizing among multiple targets such as cost aged carbon emission and the like by using an intelligent optimization algorithm, dynamically scheduling third party service resources based on the multi-attribute utility theory, realizing cross-organization credible cooperation by means of the block chain intelligent contract, and forming a complete intelligent closed loop for executing optimization of perception decisions.
assignees: UNIV NANNING NORMAL

title_en: Digital twinning-based supply chain data risk identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of supply chain risk management and control, in particular to a digital twinning-based supply chain data risk identification method and a digital twinning-based supply chain data risk identification system, which are characterized in that humidity, static electricity and temperature parameters of each level of a shelf are collected through deployment of a layered environment monitoring sensor network, the loss of electronic components of each level is calculated by combining a position differential loss model, the actual residual inventory of each level is updated, the number of days of local support of a bottom layer is calculated through a priority consumption simulation engine, acquiring an upstream supplier delay risk level through a supply chain risk interface, adopting a time window overlap matching algorithm to perform association analysis, triggering a outage alarm, the system comprises a layered environment monitoring unit, a position binding loss calculating unit, a layered inventory updating unit and a local risk analysis unit, solves the problems of inaccurate inventory loss, deviation of supporting days and early warning delay of outage, and improves the accuracy of risk identification.
assignees: ZIBO POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Fire-fighting early warning method, fire-fighting early warning equipment and medium
