abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional grid safety evaluation method, equipment and medium based on intelligent gas, which belong to the technical field of gas safety supervision, and solve the technical problems of overcoming the defects of insufficient grid division and gas facility characteristic matching and delayed leakage risk prediction in the prior art, realizing full-flow intellectualization from risk identification to closed-loop management, and improving supervision efficiency and early warning precision; the three-level Internet of things data are acquired, sensor data of an unmanned plane, pipe network pressure equipment and leakage monitoring equipment are integrated, a full-link data system of a terminal sensing layer, an edge computing layer and a cloud storage layer is covered, a double-engine evaluation model is constructed, digital twin visualization is achieved, and moment array scheduling can be achieved.
assignees: INSPUR SMART CITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent decision-making method, system, equipment and medium for intelligent cooperation of intelligent agents for environmental control of transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for intelligent decision making by intelligent agent cooperation for environmental control of a transformer substation, which belong to the technical field of intelligent operation and maintenance and comprise the steps of collecting historical data of the transformer substation, building an intelligent agent interaction environment, modeling decision problems, carrying out state estimation according to local observation and the historical data of the transformer substation, constructing a global objective function, predicting individual contribution degree through a neural network model, defining individual reward signals according to the individual contribution degree, calculating a return index through a first-level algorithm, carrying out strategy training and optimization according to the return index, executing decision making, carrying out normalization processing on the individual reward signals, introducing regularization items into a global objective function, calculating convergence indexes and monitoring convergence. The invention carries out state sensing and decision making, solves the problems of low operation and maintenance efficiency and poor cooperativity in transformer substation control, realizes automatic decomposition and high-efficiency decision making of a global optimization target, and improves the self-adaptive capacity and the overall energy efficiency of the system.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based multi-terminal collaborative modularized power operation and maintenance method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based multi-terminal collaborative modularized power operation and maintenance method and system, comprising the following steps of constructing a global power topological graph of a power energy station, mapping power equipment, sensors and connecting lines into graph nodes and graph edges, and binding static properties of the equipment with a topological structure; and acquiring real-time operation data of the power equipment, and distributing a unified time tag for the multi-source heterogeneous data. According to the invention, the unified twin model of the voltage class, the region and the equipment type is built in the digital twin platform, and the operation data of different equipment such as the photovoltaic, the battery energy storage, the inverter, the protection device, the electric energy meter and the temperature control equipment are expressed in a unified data semantic mode.
assignees: TUANTUANYUN INFORMATION TECH HENAN CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting hydraulic power calculation system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fire-fighting hydraulic calculation system and a method thereof, belonging to the technical field of fire protection, wherein the system comprises a hydraulic network digital twin modeling module, a self-adaptive hydraulic calculation engine module, a reinforcement learning multi-point cooperation optimization module and a real-time monitoring and dynamic feedback adjustment module, a high-fidelity water supply network model is constructed through a digital twin technology, the topological characteristics of a pipe network are captured through a graph neural network, the hydraulic calculation parameters are adaptively adjusted according to fire scene real-time parameters, the water supply demand is accurately calculated, the intelligent cooperation and load optimization of multi-point water supply are realized through multi-agent reinforcement learning, the closed-loop control is formed through the real-time monitoring and the dynamic feedback, the abnormal response and the repeated optimization are quickly responded, the excellent effect is remarkably improved in high-rise building and long-distance water supply scenes, and the water source support of fire fighting is effectively ensured.
assignees: XUNYANG FIRE RESCUE BRIGADE

title_en: Power grid equipment differential inspection planning method and system combining meteorological data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for planning differential inspection of power grid equipment by combining meteorological data, which belong to the technical field of operation and maintenance of power systems and comprise the steps of acquiring equipment information of the power grid equipment and meteorological data of a target area; the method comprises the steps of determining basic risk scores based on equipment information, constructing a space-time coupling weather risk field by combining weather data, extracting weather influence intensity values according to the geographical position of the equipment, calculating comprehensive risk scores, formulating a patrol arrangement according to the comprehensive risk scores, fusing patrol resource constraints and road traffic weather constraints, solving a multi-target patrol path optimization model to generate a patrol task sequence and a resource allocation scheme, inputting the scheme into a power grid digital twin simulation platform for simulation under a matched weather scene, outputting a power supply reliability index and a task completion rate, and adjusting model target parameters and performing iterative optimization until reaching standards if a preset patrol efficiency threshold is not met. The invention obviously improves the inspection accuracy, the resource utilization efficiency and the power supply reliability guarantee capability.
assignees: INFORMATION COMMUNICATION BRANCH STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Energy consumption monitoring system for energy platform of distributed energy coupling park
abstract_en: The invention provides an energy consumption monitoring system of an energy platform of a distributed energy coupling park, which is used for constructing an energy consumption acquisition-distributed energy operation-energy management three-in-one closed-loop energy consumption monitoring system, realizing park low-carbon zero-carbon operation by data driving, wherein an energy consumption acquisition module acquires energy consumption data and operation condition parameters of a park boiler, water equipment, a lighting system, production line equipment and an air conditioning system, eliminates abnormal values based on3 sigma criteria, ensures data accuracy, the distributed energy operation module acquires operation data of waste heat power generation, wind power, photovoltaic, heat pump and hydrogen energy storage equipment, receives regulation and control instructions through a control module comprising a PID and an MPC sub-module, an energy management module outputs a 1h-24h load prediction result through an LSTM neural network, an optimal scheduling unit combines an absorption rate formula and a carbon emission formula, generates regulation and control instructions comprising equipment target parameters, and finally realizes the park digital twin-in-three-dimensional visual monitoring module.
assignees: CHINA CHANG JIANG ENERGY CORP

title_en: Multi-virtual power plant optimal scheduling method for distributed flexible resource aggregation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-virtual power plant optimized scheduling method for distributed flexible resource aggregation, which relates to the technical field of power systems and energy management, and comprises the steps of establishing a digital twin model for each distributed flexible resource; the method comprises the steps of establishing a layered communication structure, generating an aggregate capacity curve of each virtual power plant, constructing a mixed integer and continuous variable optimization model in a rolling time window, generating load, renewable output and resource availability scenes based on historical operation data and short-term prediction results, compressing the scenes through a clustering method, adopting an alternate direction multiplier method ADMM for the mixed integer and continuous variable optimization model, solving sub-problems locally at each virtual power plant and resource nodes, calculating total income according to the multi-virtual power plant optimization results, and distributing the total income. According to the invention, through a layered communication structure and a distributed solving method, the calculation complexity of optimal scheduling is reduced, the real-time performance of rolling time window scheduling is improved, and the maximization of economic benefit is realized.
assignees: CHAOYANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Park comprehensive energy system low-carbon scheduling method combining demand response and carbon emission flow
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-carbon scheduling method of a park comprehensive energy system combining demand response and carbon emission flow, belongs to the technical field of low-carbon scheduling of energy systems, and aims to solve the technical problems that carbon emission responsibility is difficult to reasonably allocate due to the fact that a park comprehensive energy system cannot accurately track the carbon emission transfer path when electric heating gas multi-energy flow coupling is considered, because a graph theory-based directional weighted carbon flow network model is established, a maximum flow minimum cutting theorem and a proportion allocation principle are adopted to track a carbon emission transfer path, a space-time coupling dynamic carbon flow state space model is constructed, a Kalman filtering algorithm is adopted to perform state estimation, carbon emission responsibility is allocated based on a Shapley value method, a stepped carbon transaction cost function is established, and an optimal scheduling strategy is solved through a double-layer iteration optimization framework.
assignees: XUJI GROUP CORP;CHINA ELECTRIC EQUIPMENT GROUP

title_en: Data processing method, device, equipment, medium and product for power generation system
abstract_en: The present application relates to a data processing method, apparatus, device, medium and product for a power generation system. The method comprises the steps of obtaining operation key data and structure related data of all equipment in a power generation system, establishing a virtual physical model according to the structure related data, performing association synchronization on the operation key data and the virtual physical model to obtain a digital twin model, inputting the operation key data into a multi-modal risk assessment model, and combining basic importance weights and trend deterioration degree weights to obtain a risk assessment result, wherein the risk assessment result comprises comprehensive risk scores, current risk grades and/or characteristic dimension contribution degrees. Therefore, operation and maintenance personnel can be effectively helped to grasp the equipment risk priority and formulate an accurate maintenance strategy, the unplanned shutdown probability is reduced, and meanwhile, the operation reliability and operation and maintenance efficiency of the whole life cycle of the equipment are improved.
assignees: BEIJING QIMU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent early warning and positioning method and device for leakage risk of urban gas pipeline
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of public safety of smart cities, and particularly provides an intelligent early warning and positioning method and device for leakage risk of urban gas pipelines, wherein a digital twin body construction and dynamic coupling module constructs and drives a virtual image of a gas pipeline network, a multi-mode data acquisition and fusion module comprehensively perceives the state of the pipeline network, and finally an intelligent early warning and positioning decision module realizes a core intelligent algorithm; the cloud-side-end collaborative architecture is adopted, a terminal sensor is responsible for data acquisition, an edge computing node is deployed at a regional voltage regulating station to perform data preliminary processing and local real-time alarm, and a cloud center is deployed with a digital twin platform and a core AI algorithm model to perform big data analysis, simulation deduction and global decision. Compared with the prior art, the method can realize early and accurate identification and prediction of gas leakage and potential risks (such as stress abnormality) of the pipeline.
assignees: INSPUR SMART CITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Cause identification method for distribution network terminal voltage abnormality under distributed photovoltaic access
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cause identification method for terminal voltage abnormality of a distribution network under distributed photovoltaic access, which relies on four major core innovations of multisource data fusion, AI-electric power theory fusion modeling, distributed collaborative diagnosis with enhanced communication toughness and verification iteration of digital twin driving, breaks through the technical limitations of conventional distributed photovoltaic access distribution network terminal voltage abnormality cause identification, realizes the transition from fragmentation to systemization, from statics to dynamics and from centralization to distribution, greatly improves the accuracy, reliability and adaptability of cause identification, and provides solid technical support for large-scale absorption of distribution network photovoltaic and voltage abnormality target treatment.
assignees: SUQIAN ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD;STATE GRID SHANGHAI ENERGY INTERNET RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Optical storage and charging integrated power distribution network access method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an optical storage and charging integrated power distribution network access method and system, which adopt a digital twin technology to construct a power distribution network model, and combine a query perception partition frame based on learning and a dual-adaptation mechanism driven by a graph structure to realize rapid state search and energy optimization distribution in a large-scale power distribution network environment. According to the invention, through collecting the operation parameters and topological connection relation of the photovoltaic power generation, the energy storage equipment and the charging station, the state search is performed by dynamically dividing the network area by using the deep neural network, then the topological characteristics are analyzed by using the graph neural network to generate an energy distribution strategy, and finally, the control instruction is executed and the distribution effect is evaluated. The invention solves the problems of real-time optimal configuration and energy self-adaptive distribution of the traditional power distribution network system in a large-scale equipment access scene, and improves the stability and the resource utilization efficiency of the power distribution network system.
assignees: YANCHENG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;SHEYANG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;SHEYANG ELECTRIC IND CO LTD

title_en: Electric power training knowledge graph construction method, device, equipment and storage medium based on multi-source heterogeneous data
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for constructing an electric training knowledge graph based on multi-source heterogeneous data, and relates to the technical field of knowledge graphs. The method comprises the steps of obtaining and preprocessing multi-source heterogeneous post training data to obtain structured post description data and course description data, respectively extracting post feature vectors and course feature vectors, calculating semantic similarity between the post feature vectors and the course feature vectors, comparing the semantic similarity with a preset matching threshold value, screening candidate courses matched with target posts, generating triples, constructing and updating a post training knowledge graph based on the triples, and generating new triples to update the knowledge graph when new posts or courses are added. According to the application, through unified processing, post-course semantic matching and dynamic triplet updating of multi-source heterogeneous data, the accurate, structured and real-time updating of post training content is realized, and training pertinence and management efficiency are improved.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Accident early warning method based on dynamic deduction of physical information risk field
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of industrial Internet, safety early warning and artificial intelligence intersection, in particular to an accident advanced early warning and active intervention method and system for complex industrial systems (such as energy sources, chemical industry and traffic) by integrating digital twin, physical information neural network and deep reinforcement learning, comprising the following steps of multi-physical field coupling sensing and data assimilation; the method comprises the steps of constructing and initializing a physical information risk field, dynamically inverting and deducting the risk field, identifying a risk fission point, generating an intervention path, early warning and strategy simulation feedback, realizing the interpretability insight of the risk generation, conduction and evolution path, and finally generating an active intervention strategy to form an intelligent early warning and risk management and control closed loop.
assignees: LUOHE POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Mine multi-disaster collaborative early warning method and system based on multi-model fusion
abstract_en: The application provides a mine multi-disaster collaborative early warning method and system based on multi-model fusion, and relates to the field of data processing. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multisource monitoring data of a deep stope, overlying surrounding rock and a large-scale goaf, forming a multisource monitoring data set through spatial registration and time alignment, constructing and inverting to correct a three-dimensional digital twin body, deducing stable evolution behavior in the twin body to obtain a virtual precursor track set, respectively forming a physical prediction state and a statistical prediction state by combining a physical prediction model and a statistical prediction model, performing difference mapping on the virtual track and the real observation track to construct multidimensional difference features and performing spatial clustering to obtain a silence abnormal cluster, further combining a multisensory coupling relation to construct a multisensory risk map, fusing reasoning, identifying a silence disaster high risk area, and outputting a collaborative early warning result according to spatial connectivity and time persistence. By implementing the technical scheme, the accuracy of the multi-disaster collaborative early warning of the mine is improved conveniently.
assignees: HUBEI YUNTIAN CONSTRUCTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: User electricity charge archive diagnosis method and system based on typical scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a user electricity charge archive diagnosis method and system based on a typical scene, and belongs to the technical field of electricity charge accounting. The method comprises the steps of completing missing data in electric charge file data based on a sliding window algorithm of time attenuation weight, filtering abnormal values in the completed electric charge file data based on a Laida criterion, calculating contract capacity and time-of-use electric charge strategies based on cleaned electric charge data, generating an electric charge optimization strategy and a verification result, analyzing time sequence data in the electric charge optimization strategy and the verification result by using an LSTM network to obtain an electric charge abnormal detection result and a processing suggestion, generating a decision table to update a Drools rule engine based on the electric charge abnormal detection result and the processing suggestion, and outputting a final electric charge verification result. The method realizes the full-flow intellectualization, breaks the situation of disjoint between business rules and technical adaptation by means of a dynamic rule engine, accurate anomaly diagnosis and the like, reduces the manual dependence, improves the data flow verification efficiency, and reduces the problem processing cost.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Distribution network cluster division and planning method suitable for distributed power supply consumption
abstract_en: The utility model provides a distribution network cluster division and planning method suitable for distributed power consumption, belongs to the technical field of intelligent power grid and distributed energy optimization scheduling, and aims to solve the current situation that the traditional centralized scheduling mode is difficult to effectively cope with distributed power fluctuation and local unbalance, and further the running efficiency of a power grid is low and the distributed power consumption capability is insufficient. The cluster division and planning method comprises the following steps of constructing a digital twin model of a power distribution network, realizing high-precision real-time mapping and dynamic updating, realizing self-adaptive cluster division based on electric distance and sensitivity characteristics by using a clustering algorithm, accurately quantifying fluctuation characteristics of a distributed power supply through residual variance and wavelet energy analysis, establishing a double-objective optimization model of running cost and distributed power supply consumption, realizing economic dispatch, designing a layered dynamic coordination control mechanism, and ensuring voltage, frequency stability and overall economy of the power distribution network. The invention obviously improves the digestion capacity of the distributed power supply and the economic operation level of the system.
assignees: UNIV CHINA THREE GORGES CTGU

title_en: Multi-source data fusion wind power plant power generation prediction and intelligent regulation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-source data fusion wind power plant power generation prediction and intelligent regulation system, which belongs to the technical field of wind power plant intelligent control, and comprises a multi-source data fusion preprocessing module, a dynamic graph neural network prediction module, a digital twin simulation module and a reinforcement learning intelligent regulation module, wherein the system fuses multi-source data such as weather, topography, equipment states and historical power, the spatial correlation of wind direction changes among fans is captured through the dynamic graph neural network, a digital twin model evaluation control strategy is constructed, the operation parameters of the fans are optimized through reinforcement learning, a deep coupling closed loop cooperative framework is formed by four modules, prediction guidance simulation, simulation support control and control feedback optimization prediction are realized, the power generation prediction precision is 95.8%, the overall power generation capacity is improved by 11.2%, and the equipment fatigue load is reduced by 18.5%.
assignees: QINGHAI VOCATIONAL AND TECHNICAL UNIV

title_en: Energy resource scheduling method and system for industrial and commercial energy storage system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of power systems and energy management, discloses a method and a system for scheduling energy resources of industrial and commercial energy storage systems, and aims to solve the problems of life damage caused by economic optimization and battery health management fracturing and degradation model simplification and insufficient adaptation to uncertainty of loads and electricity prices in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of integrating multisource heterogeneous state data, constructing and calibrating a battery digital twin model coupling electrochemical, thermal fields and aging mechanisms, executing three-layer collaborative strategies of long-term degradation track planning, medium-term random scheduling optimization and short-term model predictive control, generating battery degradation cost into an economic scheduling target, and realizing high-robustness real-time control through rolling optimization. The system comprises a data acquisition fusion unit, a digital twin module, a probability prediction module, a hierarchical scheduling engine and an instruction execution unit. The application realizes the maximization of the full life cycle value and the unification of the operation reliability.
assignees: JIANGMEN ZETA POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid operation monitoring management method, system and medium based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The application provides a power grid operation monitoring management method, system and medium based on artificial intelligence. The method comprises the steps of obtaining real-time operation monitoring record data of a power grid and pre-stored data of a power grid knowledge graph, processing the data respectively through a preset power grid edge intelligent body and a preset power grid cloud edge collaborative digital twin model to obtain power grid operation control instructions, executing the power grid operation control instructions, obtaining executed power grid operation feedback data, optimizing the preset power grid edge intelligent body and the preset power grid cloud edge collaborative digital twin model to obtain a power grid edge optimization intelligent body and a power grid cloud edge collaborative optimization digital twin model, and obtaining control instructions through construction of the edge intelligent body which is processed in a grading mode through the two modules, and optimizing the edge intelligent body and the cloud edge and digital twin model according to execution feedback.
assignees: INF CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Source network load storage collaborative management and control method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system control, in particular to a source network load storage collaborative management and control method and system; the technical scheme is that the source network load storage collaborative management and control method and system comprise a panoramic sensing and digital twin module, a collaborative optimization decision module and a closed-loop control and execution management module; according to the invention, a closed-loop self-adaptive correction mechanism based on digital twin and model predictive control is introduced, the execution effect of instructions, the actual response of a controlled object and the latest ultra-short-term predictive data are fed back to a digital twin model in real time, the model is used as a system which evolves and continues synchronously with a physical power grid, and the system is not dependent on a preset strategy, can react to various disturbances inside and outside in real time, and the effects of the system on uncertainty and safe and stable operation maintenance are remarkably improved.
assignees: HUANENG JILIN ENERGY SALES CO LTD

title_en: User side multi-energy cooperative energy storage energy management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a user side multi-energy cooperative energy storage energy management system which comprises a battery state monitoring module, a data acquisition module, a health state estimation module, a residual life prediction module, an energy storage cost and benefit modeling module and a multi-objective optimal scheduling and energy management decision module, wherein the battery state monitoring module is used for monitoring original parameters of a battery in real time, the data acquisition module is used for acquiring photovoltaic power generation power, user load power and grid electricity price data in real time, the health state estimation module is used for estimating the current battery capacity attenuation degree, the residual life prediction module is used for predicting a time span from the current moment to capacity attenuation to a failure threshold value, the energy storage cost and benefit modeling module is used for quantifying the total cost and comprehensive benefit of the energy storage system, and the multi-objective optimal scheduling and energy management decision module is used for maximizing the comprehensive economic benefit of the energy storage system. The double breakthrough of stability and economy is realized through dynamic regulation and control and multidimensional data fusion. The six modules form a closed-loop management system from real-time monitoring to dynamic scheduling, so that the problem that the traditional system only pays attention to short-term operation optimization and ignores long-term gain distortion of equipment full life cycle health degradation is solved.
assignees: STATE POWER INVEST FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER INVEST CO LTD

title_en: Multi-level digital twin fault prediction method for high-voltage cascade energy storage system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy storage system fault prediction, and discloses a multi-level digital twin fault prediction method of a high-voltage cascade energy storage system, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a battery monomer layer, an energy storage module layer, a bridge arm layer and a system layer digital twin model aiming at a hierarchical structure of the high-voltage cascade energy storage system; the method comprises the steps of outputting and actually measuring data based on models of all layers, extracting fault characteristic parameters to form a multi-level fault characteristic set, weighting and fusing multi-level characteristics by using an attention mechanism to generate comprehensive characteristic vectors containing cross-level fault information, constructing a short-term, medium-long-term and fault propagation combined prediction model, inputting the comprehensive characteristic vectors to complete fault probability, evolution trend and propagation path prediction, determining a fault source level according to residual degree of models of all levels, positioning a fault assembly through space-time clustering, and determining a fault source by combining causal inference. According to the invention, through cross-level data fusion and fault propagation chain analysis, early prediction and accurate positioning of faults are realized.
assignees: XIAMEN HECHU ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Comprehensive protection management system and method for full life cycle of cultural relics
abstract_en: The invention provides a comprehensive protection management system and method for a full life cycle of a cultural relic, and relates to the technical field of cultural relic protection. The system comprises an environment sensing network, a cultural relic basic attribute database, a central control service platform and an environment control execution terminal. The central control service platform utilizes the full life cycle digital twin construction unit to update the virtual aging state of the cultural relics in real time, and calculates the environment stress accumulation value and the accumulated fatigue index through the accumulated fatigue damage simulation unit. When the circulation request is monitored, the circulation space homogenization control strategy generation unit generates a control instruction containing a lossless ramp curve in combination with the fatigue index. The environment regulation and control execution terminal responds to the instruction, presets the environment to a homogenization state before the cultural relics enter the target space, and gradually adjusts the environment to preset parameters according to a curve. The invention realizes quantitative evaluation of environmental stress of cultural relics and lossless transition protection in the circulation process.
assignees: HENAN MUSEUM

title_en: Cloud computing-based panoramic situation intelligent emergency decision management and control method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of computers, discloses a panoramic situation intelligent emergency decision management and control method and system based on cloud computing, and aims to solve the problems of serious information island, delayed response, weak intelligent decision capability, disjointed resource scheduling and emergency strategy, human-computer interaction fracturing and the like in the existing emergency management system. The method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source heterogeneous data through a global data access engine, forming a unified data lake through data fusion and cleaning, constructing a dynamic three-dimensional digital twin model to realize panoramic situation real-time modeling, and carrying out risk identification and hierarchical early warning by using a deep neural network. According to the technical scheme, the full-domain situation second-level sensing, risk active prediction, scientific auxiliary decision and integrated collaborative management and control are realized, and the emergency response efficiency and the decision intelligentization level are remarkably improved.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGKE CHENJI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin service scene construction and digital mapping method for intelligent regulation and control of water network
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twin service scene building and digital mapping method for intelligent regulation and control of a water network, which comprises the steps of packaging physical water conservancy entities into a series of water conservancy space objects, constructing and storing knowledge maps of physical topological relations among the water conservancy space objects, fusing the water conservancy space objects with service demands to generate water conservancy regulation and control objects, assembling the water conservancy space objects into a service workflow in a building block mode through connecting the series of water conservancy regulation and control nodes, checking the topological correctness of the connection relations among the water conservancy regulation and control nodes in the service workflow, adaptively training a set of optimization parameters for a calculation model in the service workflow by utilizing a deep learning model, executing the service workflow, and acquiring data from the physical water network through an adaptive data synchronization mechanism. The invention realizes the rapid establishment, flexible adjustment and dynamic update of the intelligent regulation digital twin scene of the water network.
assignees: CHANGJIANG INST OF SURVEY PLANNING DESIGN AND RESEARCH CO LTD

title_en: Deep foundation pit construction safety monitoring system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep foundation pit construction safety monitoring system based on the Internet of things, and relates to the field of geotechnical engineering safety monitoring. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a digital twin and data fusion module, an intelligent safety scoring module and an interaction and early warning module which are sequentially connected, wherein multidimensional physical quantity data of a foundation pit is comprehensively acquired through an Internet of things sensor network, a three-dimensional digital twin model is constructed and fused to generate safety feature data, a weighting algorithm is used for calculating comprehensive safety health scores, quantitative assessment and accurate traceability of risks are achieved, and safety trends are predicted through an LSTM model based on a historical scoring sequence. The invention realizes the transition from discrete data monitoring to overall state quantitative evaluation and from passive alarm to active early warning, and remarkably improves the intelligent level and risk prevention and control capability of deep foundation pit construction safety management.
assignees: POWERCHINA CHONGQING ENG CORP LTD

title_en: Hydropower station peak regulation operation strategy optimization method, system, equipment and storage medium based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydropower station peak regulation operation strategy optimization method, a hydropower station peak regulation operation strategy optimization system, a hydropower station peak regulation operation strategy optimization device and a hydropower station peak regulation operation strategy optimization storage medium based on reinforcement learning, and relates to the field of power system optimization scheduling and artificial intelligence application, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting hydropower station operation related data, power grid and market related data, and constructing a digital twin environment by combining operation constraint; the method comprises the steps of designing a reinforcement learning algorithm suitable for hydropower station peak regulation operation based on a constructed digital twin environment, initializing an intelligent body in the digital twin environment, training the intelligent body in the constructed digital twin environment by using the reinforcement learning algorithm, optimizing according to training results, acquiring hydropower station operation data, power grid load data and electricity price data in real time, inputting the trained and optimized intelligent body to generate an optimal scheduling strategy at the current moment, and rapidly responding to dynamic working conditions, balancing peak regulation and water resource utilization, adjusting the strategy in real time, maximizing power generation income and improving the stability and benefit of hydropower station operation.
assignees: THREE GORGES JINSHA RIVER YUNCHUAN HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD;CHINA THREE GORGES CORP

title_en: Customer service platform user tag classification system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital data processing, in particular to a customer service platform user tag classification system and method. The customer service platform user tag classification system comprises a data acquisition module, a large model analysis and generation module and a tag storage module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for continuously acquiring dialogue contents of a user from dialogue between the user and the system, the large model analysis and generation module is used for carrying out deep analysis on processed user session data by utilizing a pre-trained large-scale deep learning model, and the tag storage module is used for classifying and storing generated tags. The system does not depend on a preset rule base, but continuously collects user session data, and dynamically analyzes and generates labels by utilizing the powerful computing power of a large model. The method can accurately reflect the diversity and variability of the demands of clients, and meanwhile, the accurate classification of complex scenes is realized through the real-time updating of the labels and the deep feature extraction.
assignees: CUSTOMER SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based power market data analysis system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based power market data analysis system, which relates to the technical field of power market, generates unified market space-time frames, establishes a power grid twinning body and a mechanism twinning body, generates and verifies a strategy set, executes rule replay and inverse fact deduction, outputs a layered risk exposure list, generates rule suggestion and audit trail, realizes unified fusion and management of multi-source data by constructing the power market digital twinning body, the deep coupling simulation of the power grid operation and the market mechanism is supported, a robust transaction strategy through power grid safety verification can be generated, multi-layer risk penetration management from the asset to the main body is realized, quantitative evaluation and counterfactual deduction of rule influence are supported, market operation is effectively identified, an auditable track is generated, multi-view visualization and intelligent decision support are provided for market operation and supervision, and market transparency, safety and operation efficiency are comprehensively improved.
assignees: CHN ENERGY POWER MARKETING CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Dual-power-supply air-ground integrated network energy side and communication side supply-demand game method and system under digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twin-energized air-ground integrated double-power-supply-network supply-demand game method and system, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent management and control of energy and communication fusion networks. The method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin system of an energy-communication fusion network, accessing and mapping dynamic data from the energy network and the communication network in real time, defining an energy side observation space and a communication side observation space in the digital twin system based on the dynamic data, calculating comprehensive supply and demand unbalance degree of the system, outputting control instructions in a continuous action space by an energy side agent and a communication side agent according to respective observation spaces, respectively aiming at maximizing long-term accumulated benefits of the energy side agent and the communication side agent, coordinating final solution of a game framework to be an optimal strategy combination meeting Nash equilibrium conditions, performing centralized training and distributed execution on the coordinated game framework by adopting a multi-agent depth deterministic strategy gradient algorithm based on supply and demand perception, and performing collaborative decision by the agent based on global supply and demand unbalance degree and local observation.
assignees: UNIV NINGXIA

title_en: Dynamic management method for carbon footprint of power grid based on digital twin reinforcement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic management method for a power grid carbon footprint based on digital twin reinforcement. The method comprises the steps of constructing a power grid digital twin model of key physical assets in a power grid, developing a full life cycle carbon footprint accounting engine to dynamically calculate carbon emission of the power grid from raw material exploitation to retirement recovery, designing and training an intensive training agent, performing deep learning in a simulation environment provided by the power grid digital twin model and the full life cycle carbon footprint accounting engine through interaction with the environment to continuously optimize a decision strategy of the intensive training agent, and performing deep fusion and cooperation on the power grid digital twin model, the full life cycle carbon footprint accounting engine and the intensive training agent to enable the intensive training agent to output an optimal low-carbon decision strategy according to the real-time state of the power grid provided by the power grid digital twin model. According to the invention, through the deep fusion digital twin and reinforcement learning technology, the intelligent level of the power grid carbon footprint management and the emission reduction effect are obviously improved.
assignees: HUZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: System and method for optimizing energy distribution in renewable energy plants
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a system and method for optimizing energy distribution in renewable energy plants. The system (100) comprises a solar power plant or a wind power plant to generate electrical energy. A renewable energy controller (108) monitors real-time energy output and manages energy flow to a grid (112). The renewable energy controller (108) optimizes charging cycles based on forecasts. The renewable energy controller (108) generates dispatch schedules through an intelligent bidding unit (114), considering market prices and grid conditions, while ensuring grid code compliance. A battery digital twin unit (122) is operatively connected to the renewable energy controller (108), to simulate future states of the plant based on historical data, real-time operational data, and weather forecasts, providing inputs for the intelligent bidding unit (114) to optimize energy dispatch and storage.
assignees: SMART GRID ANALYTICS PVT LTD

title_en: A system for charging electric vehicles
abstract_en: A system (100) for charging electric vehicles includes an RFID-enabled charging socket (102) connected to a power supply (106) and positioned within a charger (104) The system features an authentication module (110) to authenticate users via RFID tag (111) and enable access to the charger. A charger monitoring module (112) captures and transmits charger parameter data to a server (114), which processes the data using a data processing module (116) and analyzes it with a machine learning model (118). A fault detection module (120) identifies faults, while a smart metering module (122) calculates charging costs. A control unit (124) relays signals, and an alerts module (126) provides real-time updates and notifications. An application (128) allows user interaction with the charger (104) for monitoring and setting thresholds. The system components are housed in a housing(108).
assignees: THE TATA POWER COMPANY LTD

title_en: Server and method for 3D digital twin of flood information
title_ko: 침수 정보의 디지털 트윈 3차원화 서버 및 방법
abstract_ko: 침수 정보의 디지털 트윈 3차원화 서버가 제공된다. 상기 침수 정보의 디지털 트윈 3차원화 서버는, 관심 지역에 대한 침수 정보와 관련된 소스 데이터를 수집하는 소스 데이터 수집부; 및 상기 수집된 소스 데이터를 상기 관심 지역에 대한 3차원 지도 상에 가시화하는 소스 데이터 가시화부를 포함하되, 상기 소스 데이터는 계측점을 나타내는 위치 좌표(x, y) 및 상기 위치 좌표(x, y) 별 계측 값을 포함하며, 상기 소스 데이터 가시화부는 상기 위치 좌표(x, y) 별 계측 값을 기 설정된 크기의 단위 격자로 이루어진 격자 패턴 이미지로 가시화하고, 이미지 처리부를 더 포함하되, 상기 이미지 처리부는, 상기 격자 패턴 이미지가 상기 관심 지역에 대한 3차원 지도 상에 가시화될 때, 상기 위치 좌표(x, y) 별 계측 값의 차이로 인하여 서로 이웃하는 단위 격자 사이에 단차가 발생되는 경우, 상기 단차가 상쇄되도록 상기 서로 이웃하는 단위 격자를 일부 중첩시킬 수 있다.
assignees: ONPOOM CORP

title_en: System and method for supporting park management priority area prediction automation service using artificial intelligence
title_ko: 인공지능을 활용한 생태공원관리 우선지역 예측 자동화 서비스를 지원하는 시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 인공지능을 활용한 생태공원관리 우선지역 자동 예측 서비스를 지원하는 시스템은 4개 분야 데이터인 생물자원 데이터, 탐방시설 데이터, 재난안전 데이터 및 공공포털 데이터를 수집 및 업데이트하는 데이터 수집 및 업데이트부; 상기 데이터 수집 및 업데이트부에서 수집된 4개의 분야 데이터의 위치정보를 기반으로 공간 데이터 셋을 생성한 후, 생성된 공간 데이터 셋의 결측값, 이상치를 필터링 한 후, 정규화하는 데이터 정제 및 전처리부; 상기 4개 분야 데이터 별 GIS 환경변수 지도를 환경 변수인 공원, 생물종 출현지점 분포, 기후, 식생, 지형 현황에 따라 생성하는 GIS 환경변수 지도 생성부; 생물출현 변수들 간의 ①중심경향성(central　tendency), ② 산포도(dispersion) ③ 분포(distribution) ④ 백분위수(percentile)　중 하나 이상의 기술통계량 및 상관관계를 분석확인하는 통계분석부; 및 사용자가 지정한 적어도 하나 이상의 공원관리와 상관관계가 있는 환경변수들에 해당하는 관리대상 공원지역을 상기 GIS 환경변수 지도 상에 색상 또는 색 농도 변화에 따른 우선순위를 지정하여 제공하는 공원관리 예측지도 모델링부를 포함한다.
assignees: KOREA NAT PARK SERVICE

title_en: Electric power asset full life cycle entity-model bidirectional checking method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based bidirectional checking method for a full life cycle entity model of an electric power asset. Firstly, a system based on a digital twin five-dimensional model is constructed, local data acquisition and precision check are carried out through edge computing nodes, and cloud virtual model synchronous update is driven. And (3) performing bidirectional checking based on the CIM model and the SVG graph, processing nonlinear measurement deviation by fusing a physical information neural network, and realizing complex ring network topology reconstruction and identification by utilizing the graph neural network. And constructing a virtual-real countermeasure game model based on the checking result, and performing pressure test and strategy verification by simulating extreme working conditions and attack scenes. And combining the manufacturing execution system with the full life cycle cost model, and dynamically optimizing model parameters and maintenance strategies by adopting a residual gradient combined optimization mechanism. The invention realizes bidirectional checking and co-evolution of the entity and the model in three dimensions of precision, behavior and structure, and improves the intelligent level of electric power asset management.
assignees: NANJING INST TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Self-adaptive layout method, device and medium for grid rack
abstract_en: The invention relates to a self-adaptive layout method, a self-adaptive layout device and a self-adaptive layout medium for a grid rack of a power grid, belonging to the technical field of power system dispatching and visualization, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining original data of the power grid, preprocessing the data, and constructing a structured graph corresponding to the original data of the power grid; the method comprises the steps of carrying out coordinate initialization on nodes in a structured graph, carrying out iterative optimization on the initialized node coordinates based on a layout optimization criterion through a preset weight scheduling strategy to obtain optimized node coordinates, adjusting weights among the layout optimization criterion in the iterative optimization, and generating a layout graph of a grid rack according to the optimized node coordinates. According to the invention, through a weight scheduling strategy and based on a layout optimization criterion, the optimal plane coordinates of all plant sites can be automatically and efficiently calculated, the intuitiveness of the layout and the scene matching degree are ensured, meanwhile, the rapid calculation and the real-time updating are realized, and the visualization level and the decision efficiency of the power grid scheduling are improved.
assignees: BEIJING KEDONG ELECTRIC POWER CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Global travel big data management platform based on data processing
abstract_en: The application discloses a global travel big data management platform based on data processing, which comprises a data processing module, a digital twin module, an early warning scheduling module, an interaction module and a trusted memory certificate and tracing module, wherein the global travel scene mirror image is built through the digital twin module, the linkage early warning scheduling module forms a management closed loop, a manager can actively prevent and control the problems of congestion, disasters and the like, the fine management efficiency is improved, tourists can enjoy virtual navigation and peak avoidance route recommendation, the travel experience and the safety are synchronously improved, a trusted guarantee mechanism adapting to a travel scene is built by taking a block chain technology as a core, the traceability and audit of travel data are realized, the problems of manual tampering, misoperation modification and the like are effectively avoided, the untwisted reliable basis is provided for supervision audit and consumption dispute processing, the difficulty of lifting certificates and maintenance rights of the tourists can be broken, and the legal interests of the tourists are effectively guaranteed.
assignees: MAIGE INFORMATION TECH BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent inspection method for wind farm booster station based on multi-mode sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent inspection method for a wind power plant booster station based on multi-mode sensing, in particular to the technical field of intelligent operation and maintenance of wind power plants, which comprises the steps of S1, collecting multi-mode sensing data through a plurality of inspection devices, S2, carrying out dynamic space-time fusion on the multi-mode sensing data, S3, inputting the fusion characteristics into a defect detection model to identify equipment defects, S4, constructing and updating a digital twin model, S5, optimizing an inspection strategy by utilizing a multi-agent reinforcement learning algorithm based on the digital twin model, S6, executing an inspection instruction and updating the defect detection model by utilizing an incremental learning mechanism. According to the invention, the detection reliability in a complex environment is improved through a dynamic fusion mechanism of multi-mode data, the optimal configuration of the inspection resources is realized through the combination of digital twin and multi-agent reinforcement learning, and the system has continuous evolution capability through the integration of zero sample detection and incremental learning, so that the technical bottleneck of the traditional inspection method is effectively solved.
assignees: XINTIAN ZHIHUI ENERGY TECH XIONGAN CO LTD

title_en: Method for evaluating ecological environment condition in real time by using remote sensing image
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating ecological environment conditions in real time by utilizing remote sensing images, which comprises the steps of integrating multi-source remote sensing and ground sensor data, constructing a space-air-ground integrated monitoring system, adopting a time domain-space domain joint cloud removal algorithm, combining dynamic adjustment parameters of seasonal features of the green-hiding plateau precipitation, and optimizing cloud area filling precision through Canny edge detection, designing a specific index of alpine ecology, combining NDVI, soil humidity and grazing intensity equivalent meadow degradation, integrating surface temperature and InSAR data to evaluate frozen soil risks, constructing a biological integrity index, adopting a Transformer model to automatically extract multi-scale space features, constructing a space-time convolution network, fusing ResNet-50, U-Net++, LSTM and a attention mechanism, capturing dynamic trends such as vegetation season phase change, frozen soil thawing and the like, constructing a three-dimensional digital twin platform, integrating the data and the ecological index, carrying out dynamic simulation in real time, and providing trend prediction, causal analysis and automatic decision.
assignees: XINING COMPREHENSIVE SURVEY CENTER OF NATURAL RESOURCES CGS

title_en: Water supply network pipe explosion diagnosis positioning method and device, electronic equipment and program product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water supply network pipe explosion diagnosis positioning method, device, electronic equipment and program product, which comprise the steps of collecting sensor data and GIS geographic information of a plurality of pipeline junction points of a water supply network through a AIoT platform, obtaining a topological structure of the water supply network, constructing a digital twin map of the water supply network according to the sensor data, the GIS geographic information and the topological structure, inputting the digital twin map into a pre-trained pipe explosion diagnosis positioning model to obtain a diagnosis positioning result, and carrying out pipe explosion early warning or fault warning according to the diagnosis positioning result, wherein the pipe explosion diagnosis positioning model is obtained based on layered graph neural network training, and the layered graph neural network comprises a space graph convolution layer, a time sequence convolution layer, a characteristic fusion layer and an output layer. The invention improves the accuracy and timeliness of the diagnosis and positioning of the pipe explosion of the water supply network, and can be applied to the technical field of the Internet of things.
assignees: TIANYI WULIAN TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Virtual power plant transaction scheduling optimization system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twinning, in particular to a virtual power plant transaction scheduling optimization system based on digital twinning, which comprises a twinning state mapping module, an instruction twinning verification module and a capacity locking distribution module. The twin state mapping module collects distributed resource time sequence data, reconstructs resource operation efficiency indexes, constructs a time sequence bearing map comprising capacity boundaries and efficiency gradients, instructs a twin checking module to implement time sequence superposition checking of instructions and maps, judges scheduling conflict time periods, shifts overflow quota to surplus capacity time periods to generate a correction scheduling task book, and the capacity locking allocation module generates a resource priority sequence based on response gradient coefficients, locks node capacity and issues execution instructions. The invention utilizes the digital twin technology to carry out the prior simulation and time domain optimization of the scheduling plan, solves the technical problem that the external requirements are not matched with the physical performance capability of the resources, and realizes the closed-loop control of the resource transaction scheduling.
assignees: NENGTAN ZHEJIANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-fused micro-grid energy optimization scheduling system
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twin-fused micro-grid energy optimization scheduling system which comprises a physical micro-grid layer, a data sensing layer, a digital twin platform layer, an energy optimization decision layer, an execution control layer and an energy optimization decision layer, wherein the physical micro-grid layer is used for acquiring real-time operation data through a sensing network and adjusting the operation state of equipment according to equipment control instructions issued by an execution control layer, the data sensing layer is used for receiving, preprocessing and transmitting the real-time operation data, the digital twin platform layer is used for constructing and updating a digital twin model based on the preprocessed real-time operation data, carrying out real-time dynamic simulation, extreme scene simulation and operation state prediction based on the digital twin model and outputting simulation results and prediction data, the energy optimization decision layer is used for receiving the simulation results and the prediction data, taking low carbon and stability as planning targets and solving through an optimization algorithm, and the execution control layer is used for converting the optimal scheduling scheme into equipment control instructions and issuing the equipment control instructions to the physical micro-grid layer so as to better adapt to a complex micro-grid operation environment.
assignees: ZHEJIANG HUADONG ENGINEERING DIGITAL TECH CO LTD;POWERCHINA HUADONG ENGINEERING CORP LTD

title_en: Virtual interaction method and system for power grid production command system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of computers, discloses a virtual interaction method and a virtual interaction system for a power grid production command system, and aims to solve the problems of information island, single interaction dimension, delayed emergency response and low cooperative efficiency of the existing system. The method comprises the steps of converging multi-source heterogeneous power grid data, constructing a digital twin model which is synchronous with a physical power grid in a high-fidelity mode, achieving virtual-real state bidirectional synchronization, fusing and rendering multidimensional operation situations in a VR/AR environment, conducting fault deduction and generating an optimized treatment plan based on the physical model, issuing the plan to a field terminal, and updating the model through feedback closed loop execution. The system comprises six modules of data aggregation, digital twin modeling, state synchronization, enhanced presentation, fault deduction and closed-loop control. The application realizes the panoramic fusion perception, the active predictive emergency treatment and the virtual-real cooperative closed-loop command of the power grid, and remarkably improves the intellectualization and the high efficiency of the production command of the power grid.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic centralized control data scheduling method in unattended mode
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of large-scale power grid safety guarantee and intelligent scheduling, and discloses a photovoltaic centralized control data scheduling method in an unattended mode, which comprises the steps of identifying physical connection topology and electrical impedance distribution of a photovoltaic station, and calculating transient offset gradient of a sampling voltage vector relative to a rated running track by utilizing a digital twin model; predicting a moving track according to cloud layer drift vector mapping, distributing dynamic correction factors, and calculating scheduling weights by combining service characteristics, topology weights and the dynamic correction factors; when the transient deviation gradient exceeds a preset threshold, a relevant node list is searched and a sampling suppression instruction is sent, and a physical layer locks non-defense level service.
assignees: JIANGSU YUEDA LOW CARBON TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Extreme weather transmission line state intelligent monitoring system based on multi-mode fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses an extreme weather power transmission line state intelligent monitoring system based on multi-mode fusion, which comprises a data acquisition and preprocessing module, a multi-mode data fusion module, a history sample construction module, an improved t-SNE analysis module, a real-time fusion estimation module, a risk assessment and early warning module and an early warning information and control result, wherein the data acquisition and preprocessing module is used for acquiring multi-mode monitoring data of a power transmission line and generating a multi-mode original characteristic sequence, the multi-mode data fusion module is used for generating a line state estimation result and a line state prediction result, the history sample construction module is used for forming a history multi-mode state sample set, the improved t-SNE analysis module is used for executing an improved t-SNE algorithm and outputting a low-dimensional embedding result, the real-time fusion estimation module is used for carrying out multi-mode fusion and outputting a comprehensive observation vector and a state estimation result, and the risk assessment and early warning module is used for carrying out risk grade judgment and outputting early warning information and a control result. According to the invention, through multi-mode data fusion and improved t-SNE analysis, accurate monitoring and hierarchical early warning of the state of the transmission line in extreme weather are realized.
assignees: YANCHENG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Predictive energy platform with digital twin
abstract_en: The present invention related to a method and a predictive energy platform for generating a predictive digital twin for at least one power grid. The method may include receiving one or more energy resource operational attributes, from at least one profile manager, corresponding to a plurality of integrated distributed energy resources (IDERs). The method may further include generating, using at least one digital twin model, at least one digital twin of the at least one power grid by creating at least one energy network graph based on the received one or more energy resource operational attributes corresponding to the plurality of IDERs. The method may further include integrating external data with the at least one generated energy network graph for benefit of generating at least one analysis product.
assignees: QSECGRID INC

title_en: Risk assessment method, device and equipment for electric power technical improvement project and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a power technical improvement project risk assessment method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, according to the method, the special risk factors such as the equipment aging factor, the grid collaborative unbalance factor and the like are determined by acquiring the parameters of the power equipment, the power grid topology, the historical data and the real-time monitoring information. And mapping the risk factors into quantifiable virtual parameters such as an ageing index, continuous fault-free operation time length and the like by using a digital twin system, and further determining discrete state spaces such as equipment transformation states, power supply stability states and the like. And calculating the state transition probability according to the history and the real-time data, and generating a dynamic risk relation map. The method integrates the electric power parameters and the digital twin technology, accurately quantifies and dynamically analyzes specific risks, improves evaluation accuracy and dynamic performance, ensures data safety, and provides a reliable basis for decision making.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ECONOMIC RESEARCH INST

title_en: Power distribution network scheduling optimization method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network scheduling optimization method and system based on deep learning, and belongs to the technical field of smart grids. The method comprises the steps of S1, collecting historical data and real-time data of the power distribution network, preprocessing, S2, constructing and training a space-time diagram convolution network STGCN model to extract space-time characteristics in the data, S3, constructing and solving a dynamic optimal power flow model with minimum network loss and voltage deviation as targets based on the output of the STGCN model to generate a scheduling instruction, and S4, executing the scheduling instruction and carrying out real-time verification and feedback by utilizing a digital twin platform. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a space-time feature extraction module, an optimization decision module and an execution verification module. According to the method, the system state is accurately predicted by the deep learning method, prediction and optimization are closely combined, so that accurate sensing and self-adaptive optimal scheduling of the running situation of the power distribution network are realized, and the economical efficiency and the safety of the power distribution network are effectively improved.
assignees: STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD LAIAN COUNTY POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Dynamic operation envelope-based power distribution network day-ahead and day-in scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic operation envelope-based power distribution network day-ahead day scheduling method and a dynamic operation envelope-based power distribution network day-ahead day scheduling system, which belong to the technical field of power distribution network operation optimization and comprise the following steps that in the day-ahead stage, each active user firstly formulates an expected strategy of operation optimization, and then calculates a parameter planning table reflecting own demands based on the expected strategy; and in the daytime, the active users fill the real-time updated distributed energy data into a parameter planning table to obtain an economic function reflecting the interests of the active users and upload the economic function to a power distribution network operator, the power distribution network operator balances the requirements of the active users on the premise of ensuring the safe operation of a network, calculates the dynamic operation envelope fairly distributed to the active users, and finally the active users execute the operation strategy according to the dynamic operation envelope issued by the power distribution network operator and the parameter planning table formulated by the active users. The method not only considers different requirements of multiple main bodies, but also can quickly solve the problem in the day, and can realize safe, efficient and economic operation of the power distribution network operators and all active users.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: New energy Internet of things and multi-layer analysis sharing platform based on twinning of teaching data
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twinning-based multi-layer analysis sharing platform for a new energy Internet of things, wherein an intelligent sensing and edge access module collects data through a multi-mode sensor, and reliable data is provided for subsequent analysis through edge calculation preprocessing and hierarchical transmission. The digital twin construction and dynamic updating module constructs equipment-level, station-level and regional-level digital twin models based on a Bayesian optimization algorithm, and realizes dynamic calibration of the models. The multi-level analysis decision module realizes equipment fault diagnosis, power generation power prediction, energy storage scheduling and power grid optimization through a four-level architecture. The digital twin mirror image regulation and control module establishes a bidirectional control channel and supports remote configuration of equipment parameters and automatic triggering of fault plans. The cross-domain data security sharing module adopts a three-layer security protection system and a federal learning mechanism, so that data security and sharing are ensured. The platform realizes the full-flow intelligent management of the new energy system, and improves the operation efficiency and the safety of the system.
assignees: HUADIAN XINNENG XINJIANG MULEI NEW ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Automatic generation system and method for intelligent emergency disposal flow of energy storage power station
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency treatment of energy storage power stations, in particular to an automatic generation system and method of an intelligent emergency treatment process of an energy storage power station, wherein the system adopts a scheme of multi-mode fault understanding, large language model reasoning and multi-target optimal scheduling, receives multi-mode inputs such as texts, alarm codes, temperature/voltage/alarm marks and the like, is encoded into scene vectors through a double-tower converter, generates candidate plans by combining a knowledge pattern with a GPT-4o finely tuned by LoRA, screens an optimal scheme through a safety, aging and cost ternary optimization function ψ and a particle swarm algorithm, and is subjected to digital twin simulation verification and Zhou Ji closed loop learning iteration; the method has the advantages that a standardized plan is generated in 1.7 seconds, the compiling efficiency is improved by 10  3  times, the execution consistency is improved by 23%, the annual operation and maintenance accident loss is reduced by 18%, the coverage rate of a new month scene is 92%, the operation and maintenance confirmation rate is 96% when an energy storage station is deployed in 100MWh, and the intelligent level of the energy storage safety operation and maintenance is remarkably improved.
assignees: NANTONG WOTAI NEW ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Weak current system running state prediction method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a weak current system running state prediction method based on digital twinning, which comprises the following steps of collecting running data of a weak current system, constructing a digital twinning topological graph of the weak current system, establishing a digital twinning model based on the digital twinning topological graph, constructing a graph neural ordinary differential equation model, realizing a state evolution function by an improved GRAPHSAGE graph neural network, combining weak current system running constraint correction and an event triggering mechanism in a time integration process to obtain a future running state track in a prediction time window, generating a corresponding index sequence and a future track, and evaluating and outputting the future running risk of the weak current system. The invention integrates digital twin, graphic neural network and time continuous modeling technology, realizes the precise prediction and intelligent risk assessment of weak current system state, and improves the prediction accuracy and interpretability.
assignees: HEFEI NANDING INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Construction method and system of novel electric carbon graph of electric power system
abstract_en: A method for constructing a novel electric carbon graph of an electric power system includes the steps of collecting new energy output data, power grid trend data, load data, energy storage side charge state and carbon emission data in real time, preprocessing, respectively establishing an electric carbon coupling model of source charge storage and carbon emission based on the collected data, calculating wind-solar-carbon emission reduction capacity, user electricity consumption carbon emission and charging carbon emission, correcting a carbon loss coefficient of a power transmission unit distance and updating carbon loss of a power transmission link to construct the electric carbon graph, respectively calculating relative errors of the carbon emission output by the source charge storage carbon coupling model and actual carbon emission when the relative errors are larger than a preset error threshold, correcting an average thermal power carbon emission factor of an area and the carbon loss coefficient of the power transmission unit distance, and updating the electric carbon graph. According to the invention, through real-time electric carbon coupling modeling, dynamic correction of the power transmission carbon factors and a parameter self-correction mechanism, accurate calculation and real-time updating of an electric carbon graph are realized.
assignees: BEIJING KEDONG ELECTRIC POWER CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD;STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO;ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Knowledge-graph-based automatic operation and detection method and system for plant station equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automatic operation and maintenance of a power system, in particular to a station equipment automatic operation and detection method and system based on a knowledge graph, wherein the method collects static account data, real-time operation data and historical operation data of station equipment, builds a multi-dimensional associated knowledge graph, creates a digital twin body for target equipment in the station, and creates a bidirectional data channel between the digital twin body and corresponding equipment entity nodes in the knowledge graph; based on a state evaluation rule and a fault propagation path model which are preset in the knowledge graph, real-time health state evaluation is carried out on target equipment by using the state evaluation rule and the fault propagation path model to generate a health index, when abnormality is monitored, tracing is carried out along the electric connection and equipment topological relation in the knowledge graph, a fault source is positioned, confidence probability is calculated, risk level evaluation and processing priority ranking are carried out according to the confidence probability, so that an operation and maintenance diagnosis work order containing execution time sequence is obtained, and the fault cause can be rapidly traced.
assignees: SUZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Digital power grid processing method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a processing method and device of a digital power grid, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of conducting grid division on a power distribution network, determining a plurality of grid community grids, constructing a digital twin model of the grid community grids according to real-time power data and three-dimensional live-action data of the grid community grids aiming at each grid community grid, displaying the digital twin model through a digital grid center, analyzing based on the digital twin model and a reporting work order to obtain target requirements and target solutions under the condition that the reporting work order of the grid community grids is obtained, and displaying the target requirements and the target solutions of the grid community grids through the digital grid center. The method is used for achieving the effect of improving the response efficiency of the digital power grid.
assignees: SHANTOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Mechanism and system for participating EVA in electric power market in sand-goed areas
