assignees: SHIJIAZHUANG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH CO OF STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Digital twin-based intelligent operation and maintenance system and method for digital thermal power plant equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent operation and maintenance, and discloses an intelligent operation and maintenance system and method for digital thermal power plant equipment based on digital twinning, wherein equipment material level state monitoring and energy flow conservation verification are realized through an endophytic ontology sensing module, so that sensor failure can be predicted, a threshold value can be dynamically adjusted, and system paralysis caused by sensor failure can be avoided; the double-space tensor fusion module is used for restraining manifold embedding modeling process by a physical conservation law, ensuring tensor decomposition to conform to a physical rule by structural constraint, solving the problems of model prediction deviation and characteristic generalization failure under nonlinear working conditions, enabling the fault immunity deduction module to realize parameter inversion when a sensor fails and starting working condition prediction based on multi-scale damage data, supporting starting and stopping reliability assessment of a peak shaver set, ensuring data cooperation of all modules by a data storage and interaction unit, integrally improving operation and maintenance reliability and adaptability of a system, and meeting intelligent operation and maintenance requirements of a thermal power plant.
assignees: NAT ENERGY FEI COUNTY POWER GENERATION CO LTD;HUANENG JINGTAI THERMAL POWER CO LTD;XIAN THERMAL POWER RESEARCH INST CO LTD;HUANENG QINBEI POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Flood condition identification and early warning system, method and equipment for gate flood prevention engineering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood condition identification early warning system, a flood condition identification early warning method and flood condition identification early warning equipment for gate flood control engineering, which are provided with a data gathering and simulation driving module, a situation diagnosis module, a digital role decision engine module, a stress perception toughness response module and a progressive early warning and resource preset module, wherein the situation diagnosis module is used for constructing a hydrologic risk potential field based on a water depth and a flow velocity field provided by a digital twin simulation engine and is used for energetically representing risk generation, conduction and superposition of risk intensity and risk conduction directions, the digital role decision engine module is used for converting a multi-objective optimization problem into digital roles with different value preferences and decision weights, and then a formed meeting carries out alliance construction and dynamic bargaining, the stress perception toughness response module is used for autonomously perceiving environmental mutation and rapidly outputting a new control strategy, and the progressive early warning and resource preset module is used for accurately achieving a regional progressive resource preset instruction based on the spatial form of the risk field. A new generation flood control system with situation depth cognition, decision group wisdom and life toughness is constructed.
assignees: HUAIAN HONGZE FLOOD CONTROL AND DROUGHT RELIEF HEADQUARTERS OFFICE HUAIAN HONGZE DISTRICT WATER SUPP

title_en: Virtual power plant operation situation assessment method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of virtual power plants and digital twinning, and discloses a method for evaluating the running situation of a virtual power plant based on digital twinning. The method comprises the steps of collecting historical and multi-source external data, and training a digital twin model of the virtual power plant to obtain a load demand estimated sequence. And then, building a situation directed graph by combining the real-time operation topology and marking the node equipment level. And solving an optimal operation scheduling scheme by using the estimated sequence and the real-time data, and setting up a monitoring framework. In operation, dynamic adjustment is triggered by calculating the deviation of the monitored data from the solution and evaluating the system stability based on the directed graph, identifying high risk units. And finally, executing a standby strategy updating scheduling scheme on the high-risk unit to form closed-loop optimization. The method realizes advanced prediction and accurate regulation of the running state of the virtual power plant, and enhances the robustness of the virtual power plant against internal fluctuation and external interference.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ENERGY GROUP ENERGY SERVICES CO LTD

title_en: Multi-protocol-integrated water-wind-solar cooperative control and remote diagnosis method and related equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a water-wind-light cooperative control and remote diagnosis method and related equipment integrating multiple protocols, which are applied to the technical field of data processing. The application constructs a full-flow technical system of data acquisition, early warning, diagnosis, control, management and evaluation around the cooperative control and remote diagnosis of the water-wind-solar power generation system. The method comprises the steps of firstly collecting core equipment operation data and multisource environment parameters, monitoring the states of key components through edge calculation to generate preliminary fault early warning and power abnormality prompt, then building a simulation platform by means of digital twin, combining a multi-objective optimization algorithm to generate a diagnosis instruction and power distribution scheme, then using a self-adaptive cooperative control algorithm to link power grid load and meteorological data to adjust output to form a cooperative control strategy, further generating a global remote management scheme, finally integrating whole-link information, outputting comprehensive evaluation information comprising system reliability, benefit and the like, and realizing fault accurate diagnosis and system efficient operation.
assignees: NANJING PONDER ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-dimensional data fusion analysis level construction method and related device for power grid digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-dimensional data fusion analysis level construction method of a power grid digital twin body, which aims to solve the problems that the overall understanding, fault diagnosis and optimization scheduling of the power grid state are realized by establishing a power grid digital twin body model, the working principle of the model comprises the steps of data acquisition and preprocessing, multi-dimensional feature extraction, level modeling, analysis and optimization, model verification and updating, and visual display and application, the accuracy and consistency of power grid data are ensured through data cleaning, denoising and format conversion, the power grid information from different data sources is fused and aligned, the difference between the data sources is eliminated, then multi-dimensional features are extracted from the fused data, the important features of a power grid are captured, the analysis level structure of the power grid digital twin body is constructed according to the multi-dimensional features, the model is refined and abstracted, and the model is deeply analyzed and optimized by using a statistical analysis and machine learning method.
assignees: XUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH CO STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;SMART GRID RESEARCH INST CO LTD OF STATE GRID

title_en: Cascaded energy storage digital twin model construction method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for constructing a cascading energy storage digital twin model. The method comprises the steps of carrying out hierarchical assembly modeling on a cascade energy storage system, carrying out geometric simplification and data compression, then constructing a multi-protocol acquisition node, deploying based on a containerization technology, carrying out evaluation analysis by adopting a double-layer framework, carrying out millisecond-level anomaly detection and preliminary marking on real-time sequence data by adopting a lightweight statistical algorithm, carrying out deep diagnosis and root cause analysis on anomaly data segments marked on an edge side at a system cloud, and carrying out mining analysis of cross-period and multi-parameter association on historical full-quantity data so as to generate health evaluation and risk prediction results. The application can ensure that the full-dimensional cognitive ability of the system from millisecond level abnormity real-time perception to long-term health depth mining is realized without damage while greatly reducing the consumption of three-dimensional model construction and rendering resources and improving the elasticity of multi-source data access and storage management.
assignees: PINGGAO GROUP CO LTD;XIAN PINGGAO SMART ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based multi-energy distribution network intelligent verification platform verification method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based multi-energy distribution network intelligent verification platform verification method, a system, equipment and a medium, which belong to the technical field of electric power systems and information, and comprise the steps of realizing high-precision synchronization of a digital model and a physical system by initializing a digital twin instance of equipment and adopting a prediction algorithm to compensate communication delay, providing a real dynamic basis for verification, automatically generating and optimizing a test case by using a genetic algorithm, synchronously executing multidimensional verification and simulating a fault scene, evaluating an electric energy quality index to ensure to meet standards, configuring a communication network and establishing a simulation environment, verifying a protocol fault-tolerant mechanism and a retransmission strategy by injecting communication faults, loading an LSTM prediction model to perform state prediction calculation to generate preventive maintenance suggestions, collecting all verification data to perform uncertainty quantification and credibility assessment, generating a visual test report and utilizing a blockchain technology to perform safe storage, and improving verification efficiency, system reliability and decision credibility.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Electric power capital construction risk prediction method and system based on digital analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting the risk of electric power infrastructure construction based on digital analysis, which relate to the technical field of infrastructure risk prediction, and the method comprises the steps of setting a infrastructure monitoring area, setting a plurality of monitoring points in the set infrastructure monitoring area, constructing a infrastructure monitoring network through a wireless communication mode after the setting of the monitoring points is completed, controlling a camera to periodically acquire building images in the infrastructure monitoring area based on the constructed infrastructure monitoring network, and processing the building images acquired periodically through an image processing mode; and after the processing is finished, risk feature extraction is carried out on the processed building image in a multi-source data fusion risk feature extraction mode, a risk scoring model is constructed at the same time, risk scoring is carried out on the building image with the risk feature extracted based on the constructed risk scoring model, and finally, risk prediction is carried out on the construction of the foundation by a digital twin mode based on the risk scoring result of the construction project of the electric power foundation, so that the real-time performance of construction risk prediction is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD CONSTRUCTION BRANCH

title_en: Distribution network panoramic data intelligent maintenance system based on digital twin model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network panoramic data intelligent maintenance system based on a digital twin model, which belongs to the technical field of operation and maintenance of distribution networks and comprises a data acquisition module, a data distinguishing module and a data processing module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring related data in the digital twin model, the related data comprises currents and loads of lines corresponding to a target distribution network, the data distinguishing module is used for distinguishing the lines corresponding to the target distribution network, the data distinguishing module is used for distinguishing high-fault lines, generating a line group based on the high-fault lines and acquiring the currents and the loads corresponding to historical faults of each line in the line group. According to the invention, through accurately acquiring and analyzing the current and load data of the power distribution network, high-risk lines are efficiently identified, key fault characteristics are extracted, and the operation state of the power distribution network is finely evaluated and fault early-warned by combining a multi-dimensional data fusion processing and intelligent judging mechanism, so that the operation and maintenance efficiency and response speed are improved.
assignees: JIANGSU LAIRUI ELECTRIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin power transformation state evaluation modeling method and system based on transfer learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic power, and particularly discloses a digital twin power transformation state evaluation modeling method and system based on transfer learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting basic data of power transformation equipment, wherein the basic data of the power transformation equipment comprise key basic power transformation part data, non-key basic power transformation part associated data and regional power grid data; determining the key basic power transformation component through a topological graph analysis method, acquiring new energy output data, calculating a load fluctuation coefficient, and based on the key basic power transformation component And dynamically adjusting the value range of the operation parameters of the key basic power transformation component. According to the invention, by introducing the load fluctuation coefficient, the dynamic self-adaptive adjustment of the key component operation parameter range and the model characteristic weight is realized, the evaluation accuracy and the robustness of the model under a new energy high fluctuation scene are obviously improved, and the misjudgment caused by a static threshold value is avoided.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD TAIZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;JIANGSU ANTAI POWER TRANS AND TRANSFORMATION ENGINEERING CO LTD;JIANGSU XIANGTAI POWER IND CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based excitation system fault prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based fault prediction method and a digital twinning-based fault prediction system for an excitation system, which relate to the technical field of power system management and aim to solve the technical problem of the current fault prediction defect of the excitation system. The invention solves the core defect of the digital twinning technology of the existing excitation system through the digital twinning layer, deeply fuses the key physical field parameters of temperature, current, spark and abrasion, can precisely map the key physical mechanisms of carbon brush current harmonic wave on the temperature field of the collecting ring, the association of carbon brush abrasion quantity and contact resistance and the like, provides reliable digital support for fault prediction, effectively avoids equipment shutdown or safety accidents caused by state misjudgment, and ensures the stable operation of the power system.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA CHAOTE HIGH VOLTAGE BRANCH STATE GRID EAST INNER MONGOLIA ELECTRIC POWER CO LIMITED;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Regional power product carbon footprint database construction method and system based on parameterized model
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of electric power product carbon footprint evaluation, and discloses a regional electric power product carbon footprint database construction method and system based on a parameterized model. The method comprises the steps of designing a multi-layer database architecture, including a rear-end storage layer, an intermediate service layer and a front-end application layer, defining a system boundary, a time boundary and a geographic boundary, carrying out modularization and assembly design on power industry chain data, constructing an experience parameter model and a theoretical parameter model, realizing real-time updating and maintenance of a database, and carrying out regional differentiation analysis. According to the method, the back-end storage layer is used for storing original data, the middle service layer is used for preprocessing and integrating the data, the front-end application layer is used for providing modeling and region differentiation analysis of different power generation technologies, and carbon footprint evaluation under various power supply modes is supported. The method realizes the flexibility, the real-time performance and the accuracy of the electric power carbon footprint database.
assignees: SHANGHAI HAIKE SMART DATA TECH CO LTD;SHANGHAI YITAN DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Exponential stable hybrid perception constraint MPC control method for four-rotor wing suspension load
abstract_en: The invention relates to the fields of unmanned plane control technology, model predictive control and perception-control fusion, and discloses an exponential stable hybrid perception constraint MPC control method for a four-rotor suspension load, which comprises the following steps of constructing a hybrid dynamics model of a four-rotor-cable-load system, and uniformly considering dynamic coupling and multiple constraint conditions; the method comprises the steps of designing an exponential stabilization hybrid perception constraint MPC framework, constructing an optimal control problem containing hybrid dynamics constraint, carrying out real-time iterative solution to generate a four-rotor reference track, constructing a hybrid perception constraint system, designing a hybrid mode robust state estimation system, developing a hybrid mode adaptive MPC track tracking execution framework, adapting to complex scenes such as dynamic infeasible track tracking, man-machine interaction manipulation and the like, considering tracking precision and perception safety in high-speed and high-acceleration motion, and expanding the application range and engineering application capability of the four-rotor suspension load system in actual tasks such as disaster response, infrastructure maintenance and the like.
assignees: YUYAO ROBOT RES CENTER;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Nuclear power equipment health intelligent management system and method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of digital twinning, and in particular relates to a nuclear power equipment health intelligent management system and method based on digital twinning, wherein the system comprises a data storage layer, a data storage layer and a data storage layer, wherein the data storage layer is used for storing equipment, images, equipment operation, technicians, files, spare parts and environmental data to form a twinning data storage library; the data map display layer is used for constructing a three-dimensional model of equipment and a three-dimensional model of the operating environment of the equipment according to the data after the data are managed by the data management layer, the data blood relationship management, the data cleaning and the data format conversion technology, and displaying the relationship among the data, the customized data analysis result and the three-dimensional vectorization data of the equipment. The invention can accurately judge the equipment fault reasons and fault points, and realize the rapid formulation, comparison and selection of equipment maintenance multiple schemes.
assignees: SANMEN NUCLEAR POWER CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned multi-mode AI (advanced technology attachment) identification and alarm linkage monitoring system for heat supply pipe network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent operation and maintenance of a heating pipe network, and discloses an unmanned inspection multi-mode AI (advanced technology interface) identification and alarm linkage monitoring system of the heating pipe network, which comprises a three-dimensional reference construction module, a control module and a control module, wherein the three-dimensional reference construction module is used for establishing a pipe network model and a global coordinate system; the unmanned inspection acquisition module acquires multi-mode data and constructs a voxel map, the space calculation analysis module determines candidate abnormal curved surfaces through view cone back projection and Boolean operation, ray stepping detection shielding and thermal and geometric conformal mapping analysis verification are utilized, the space cooperation mutual verification module dispatches ground robots to check based on confidence, the heterogeneous viewpoint volume overlapping degree is calculated, and the alarm linkage control module locks a target curved surface, calculates an abnormal center, drives digital twin display and generates a work order. According to the invention, through the cooperation and mutual evidence of the three-dimensional view cone mapping and the air-ground, the false alarm of environmental interference is effectively removed, and the high-precision positioning and closed-loop linkage monitoring of the abnormality of the heating network are realized.
assignees: SHIJIAZHUANG HUADIAN HEAT SUPPLY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Automatic form filling method and system for heat supply customer service work orders based on large model
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of heat supply management, and provides a large-model-based automatic heat supply customer service work order filling system, which comprises a collaborative agent cluster for parallel processing of user requests, a dynamic knowledge network module, a digital twin body access and simulation module and a work order decision and active intervention engine; the automatic filling method of the heat supply customer service work order based on the large model comprises the steps of accessing a user multi-mode service request through a whole channel; the cooperative agent clusters work in parallel; the dynamic knowledge network carries out multi-hop reasoning according to the output to generate a preliminary diagnosis reasoning chain; the work order decision engine packages the user information, diagnosis chain and situation data into an initial work order, and calls a digital twin body to carry out simulation deduction on the fault influence; the work order processing full-flow data is captured by a self-evolution closed-loop management module; the method realizes the active service without complaints, greatly improves the perception and satisfaction of users, and reduces derivative complaints from the source.
assignees: SHIJIAZHUANG HUADIAN HEAT SUPPLY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic power station early warning and platform construction method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The application discloses a photovoltaic power station early warning and platform construction method based on digital twinning, which relates to the technical field of intelligent manufacturing and comprises the steps of constructing a digital twinning body by utilizing a three-dimensional modeling engine based on design drawings, geographic information system data and equipment asset information of a power station, establishing a unified data middle stage, accessing multi-source heterogeneous data, binding real-time data with entities in the digital twinning body through data mapping rules to realize virtual-real linkage, integrating an AI analysis model, configuring a multi-stage early warning rule engine, realizing early warning and risk grading based on model output and historical data, automatically generating an operation and maintenance work order based on early warning information, providing a processing suggestion by combining an operation and maintenance knowledge base, tracking the whole process of the work order, realizing closed-loop management from early warning to verification, modularizing functions by adopting a micro-service architecture, packaging the functions into independent services, developing a visual interaction portal, and disposing to form an intelligent operation and maintenance platform.
assignees: UNIV INNER MONGOLIA TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Auxiliary transportation scheduling management system for coal mine
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of dispatching management systems, and particularly relates to a coal mine auxiliary transportation dispatching management system which comprises an intelligent collaborative dispatching platform, a multi-mode conflict resolution routing engine, a self-adaptive active anti-collision module, an edge decision node, an elastic hierarchical network architecture, a carrier intelligent terminal cluster, a roadway traffic control device cluster, a dynamic task redistribution module and a digital twin simulation module. The coal mine auxiliary transportation scheduling management system greatly improves the efficiency and safety of coal mine auxiliary transportation. The intelligent collaborative scheduling platform can generate an optimal cross-transportation scheduling scheme according to the carrier capacity model and the task chain decomposition technology, so that efficient collaborative operation of various carriers is realized, and idle waiting time and ineffective operation of the vehicle are reduced. The multi-mode conflict resolution routing engine accurately plans a conflict-free path through space-time track prediction and conflict detection, and effectively avoids traffic jam and collision accidents in a roadway.
assignees: SHANXI COAL TRANSP AND MARKETING GROUP BOJIZHANG COAL INDUSTRY CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent monitoring management system for safety production of power plant
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of safety supervision, in particular to an intelligent monitoring management system for safety production of a power plant, which aims to solve the problems of detection blind areas and early warning hysteresis of the existing single-point detection; the intelligent monitoring system comprises four modules, wherein a three-dimensional modeling module is used for constructing a three-dimensional digital twin model of a power plant and identifying a gas accumulation area, a data acquisition module is used for acquiring gas concentration in real time and generating a thermodynamic diagram by combining an intelligent safety helmet with a sensor node covering the accumulation area, a real-time judgment module is used for determining the position of a user by UWB positioning and judging real-time risks by combining a threshold value, a model prediction module is used for acquiring multi-dimensional space-time data, inputting a space-time fusion attention model, outputting a concentration prediction value and a risk level, and realizing omnibearing non-blind area monitoring and advanced early warning, so that the safety supervision reliability of limited space operation of the power plant is remarkably improved.
assignees: FUJIAN JINJIANG WIND POWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin large-span bridge seismic wind vibration reduction and isolation system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin large-span bridge seismic wind vibration reduction and vibration isolation system and a method, wherein the system is based on a high-fidelity digital model for constructing a large-span bridge, comprises full life cycle monitoring and management of the bridge under the conditions of earthquake, wind vibration reduction and vibration isolation, is based on a space-air-ground-water integrated ubiquitous sensing module, combines with artificial intelligent algorithms such as deep learning, impulse neural networks and the like, and realizes bridge structure real-time state evaluation, material nonlinear analysis, geometric nonlinear analysis, multi-point excitation and pile-soil-structure interaction simulation, wind-induced fatigue damage prediction, seismic vulnerability evaluation and closed-loop control scientific decision based on artificial intelligent bodies. The invention can provide system support and method guidance for the design, intelligent monitoring, operation and maintenance management and vibration reduction and isolation system optimization of the large-span bridge anti-seismic and wind-resistant system.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: Grassland desertification full life cycle intelligent management and emergency response method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grassland desertification full life cycle intelligent management and emergency response method, which comprises the steps of collecting multi-source data through an air-ground integrated monitoring network, constructing a space-time knowledge graph fusing ecological background information, carrying out early recognition and early warning on desertification risks by utilizing a dynamic risk assessment model fusing mechanism and data through the graph, starting an emergency response mechanism when the early warning exceeds a threshold value, generating an optimal resource scheduling scheme with shortest resource scheduling time and lowest transportation cost by adopting a multi-target genetic algorithm, automatically issuing instructions, carrying out long-term ecological and economic benefit prediction and quantitative assessment on a treatment effect based on a digital twin body after emergency action, and feeding back the result to a risk assessment model to form a management closed loop of monitoring, assessment, decision making, treatment and re-monitoring.
assignees: SICHUAN HUIYUAN OPTICAL COMMUNICATIONS CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic power station operation and maintenance management system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based photovoltaic power station operation and maintenance management system, which relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power station management and comprises an acquisition simulation module, a state monitoring module, a combination recognition module and a combination recognition module, wherein the acquisition simulation module acquires operation state data to conduct preprocessing, builds a virtual three-dimensional model of a photovoltaic power station to execute simulation, obtains simulation data and combines the operation state data to generate a data pair, the state monitoring module calculates data errors and weights the data errors based on the data pair to generate an overall error value to conduct abnormal judgment of the photovoltaic power station to obtain a judgment result, the combination recognition module acquires image data of the photovoltaic power station to conduct super-resolution enhancement based on the judgment result, the enhanced high-resolution image is subjected to feature extraction and fusion to generate a fusion feature map, and the attention mechanism is used for combining the fusion feature map to conduct defect category and position recognition.
assignees: SHANGHAI ELECTRIC JIANGSU INTEGRATION ENERGY SERVICES CO LTD

title_en: Virtual power plant panoramic operation simulation and grid-connected test system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention relates to a digital twinning-based panoramic operation simulation and grid-connected test system for a virtual power plant, and belongs to the technical field of virtual power plants. The system acquires relevant parameters of physical equipment through a physical entity layer and generates a structured data packet through preprocessing, a digital twin modeling unit combines the equipment structure, the operation characteristics and the power grid topology to construct a digital twin model containing equipment, the system and an external power grid environment, a panoramic operation simulation unit constructs a plurality of types of operation scenes, invokes processes such as twin model simulation multi-energy coordination scheduling and the like and analyzes simulation indexes, a grid connection test unit generates a multi-condition grid connection test scene, simulates a grid connection process, quantitatively evaluates grid connection performance and further generates a targeted optimization adjustment scheme. The invention improves the consistency of the model and the actual operation through the digital twin technology, realizes scientific evaluation and accurate optimization of grid-connected performance, and provides support for safe and stable operation of the virtual power plant.
assignees: SHANGHAI USKY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic disturbance perception inventory optimization method and system based on supply chain digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of inventory prediction and optimization, and provides a dynamic disturbance perception inventory optimization method and system based on supply chain digital twinning, which are used for acquiring all-link node data of a power grid supply chain, extracting characteristics, constructing a three-dimensional twinning model of the power grid supply chain, considering scene characteristics of the power grid supply chain, constructing disturbance factors, classifying unstructured disturbance factors and structured disturbance factors, fusing the unstructured disturbance factors and the structured disturbance factors, training a hybrid prediction optimization model according to the fused characteristics in combination with power grid inventory management requirements in a power scene, optimizing parameter configuration of the model, and processing inventory data of a target area in a target scene by utilizing the trained hybrid prediction optimization model to determine a replenishment scheme. The invention can improve the accuracy of inventory optimization and is particularly suitable for power scenes.
assignees: MATERIALS CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;SHANDONG LURUAN DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Semantic cognition modeling-based electric power digital twin question-answer interaction generation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of semantic cognition modeling and natural language interaction, in particular to a power digital twin question-answering interaction generation method based on semantic cognition modeling, which comprises the steps of accessing a power grid topology data stream in real time, analyzing equipment hierarchy, power supply attribution and physical connection relation, and constructing a dynamic topology knowledge graph; the method comprises the steps of mapping the hidden topology semantics into a semantic cognition model, embedding topology level fields and association constraint rules, generating an enhanced semantic cognition model with topology association constraint, establishing a topology change monitoring channel to update association relation in real time, receiving user natural language query, identifying keywords, extracting power supply attribution constraint rules, filtering invalid entities, converting hidden topology semantics into combined query sentences, executing query to obtain topology association data, verifying power supply attribution consistency of a result set, filtering homonymous matching errors, triggering model update and secondary verification during topology adjustment, outputting question-answer response conforming to the topology constraint, and improving interaction accuracy and timeliness.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD DIGITAL INTELLIGENCE OPERATION CENTER

title_en: Power failure area division method and device for reliability evaluation of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of reliability evaluation of power distribution networks, and particularly provides a power outage area division method and device for reliability evaluation of a power distribution network. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, through real-time updating of the switch type, the automatic configuration condition and the like, the fault area, the recoverable power supply area and the to-be-transferred area are rapidly calculated, and a support is provided for accurately calculating the reliability index.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID SHAANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power transaction data all-link standardized processing method and system
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of power transaction data processing, and provides a method and a system for processing all-link standardization of power transaction data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when different sample sets respectively correspond to different residual time intervals, determining the residual time interval corresponding to the complement behavior characteristic index of the target complement execution main body, and when the target complement execution main body executes subsequent missing data complement processing consistent with the service type, preferentially distributing the predicted data complement task with the residual time falling into the residual time interval to the target complement execution main body. The invention does not change the existing completion mode and auditing mechanism, but realizes reasonable distribution of the completion tasks through accurate matching of the tasks and time conditions, thereby effectively reducing the amplification effect of the completion error in the abnormal recognition stage and improving the stability and consistency of the abnormal recognition result. The method can stably run in a large-scale and batched data processing scene.
assignees: HAINAN ELECTRIC POWER TRANSACTION CENTER CO LTD

title_en: A system and method for predictive management of industrial flares using a digital twin and blockchain based compliance reporting
abstract_en: A system and method for the predictive management and automated compliance of industrial flares are disclosed. The system integrates multi modal data from optical and thermal cameras, alongside physical sensors, to create a real time digital twin of the flare stack. An artificial intelligence engine analyzes this data to perform predictive analysis, detecting anomalies such as incomplete combustion, gas leaks, and structural degradation, and forecasting potential failures. This enables predictive maintenance, optimizing operational efficiency and safety. The system features a secure, blockchain powered module for generating tamper proof, auditable compliance reports aligned with environmental regulations. It also includes an automated alert system, a comprehensive management dashboard, and advanced analytical reporting. This integrated approach provides a holistic solution for flare management, moving beyond simple monitoring to proactive and secure operational control.
assignees: NARGESI ROHAM;RAZAVI SAREH

title_en: Intelligent scheduling method and system for power grid tasks in multi-cloud environment
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent dispatching method and system for power grid tasks in a multi-cloud environment, wherein the method comprises the steps of enabling an edge cloud to synchronously transmit acquired power grid operation parameters and power grid resource parameters to a private cloud and a public cloud, constructing a power grid digital twin body based on the power grid operation parameters and combining a power grid physical topological structure, responding to a fault trigger signal, updating operation state parameters of a fault area in the power grid digital twin body to obtain a visualized fault association diagram, determining a preliminary dispatching scheme of power grid resources based on the power grid resource parameters and the fault association diagram and combining a power grid physical topological structure and a fault type identifier, performing simulation verification optimization on the preliminary dispatching scheme based on the power grid digital twin body to obtain a target dispatching scheme, and distributing dispatching instructions of the target dispatching scheme to power grid control terminals of corresponding areas. The invention solves the problems of delayed response and insufficient resource cooperation of the traditional scheduling.
assignees: NANWANG DIGITAL OPERATION SOFTWARE TECH GUANGDONG CO LTD

title_en: Power grid equipment state degradation simulation and maintenance optimization method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based power grid equipment state degradation simulation and maintenance optimization method, which comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model, establishing a real-time data interaction link, collecting multidimensional degradation influence parameters, simulating a degradation process through a dynamic collaborative quantization algorithm integrating a coupling relation of the multidimensional degradation influence parameters and a time accumulation effect, determining maintenance optimization priority through a priority calculation model by combining resource constraint parameters, and outputting a scheduling instruction. The method solves the problems of inaccurate degradation simulation and unreasonable maintenance decision in the prior art, and realizes accurate simulation and maintenance optimization of the state of the power grid equipment.
assignees: GUANGZHOU JINYUAN TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Smart grid-based electric power energy consumption early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric power energy consumption early warning method based on a smart grid, which comprises the following steps of collecting power grid operation data, updating a power grid state variable in a digital twin model by utilizing a digital twin model and a state estimation algorithm based on the power grid operation data to enable the digital twin model to be consistent with a physical power grid, analyzing the power grid state variable in the digital twin model in real time, identifying a power unbalance composite risk of coincidence of rapid fluctuation of a power supply side and sudden impact of a demand side, starting simulation of a preset emergency plan aiming at the identified power unbalance composite risk, evaluating the influence of the emergency plan on power grid stability, power gap compensation capability and operation side effect, selecting an optimal emergency plan according to an evaluation result, generating an executable load adjustment or power scheduling instruction, and transmitting the executable load adjustment or power scheduling instruction to intelligent execution equipment through high-speed communication.
assignees: SOUTHERN POWER GRID INTERNET SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based TBM card machine risk assessment index dynamic prediction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunnel construction and construction, and particularly discloses a dynamic prediction method of a TBM card risk assessment index based on digital twinning, which comprises the following steps of 1, constructing a TBM card risk factor association network; step 2, establishing a TBM card risk assessment index system and a static TBM card Bayesian network structure, step 3, constructing an index weight analysis model based on a dynamic Bayesian network, and step 4, dynamically calculating and predicting the index weight driven by TBM monitoring data. According to the invention, real-time monitoring data of equipment such as cutter head rotating speed, torque and the like which are critical to the risk of machine blocking in the TBM construction process are fully utilized, accurate prediction of the risk factor index of the TBM machine blocking is realized, the index weights at different moments are dynamically adjusted by utilizing a dynamic Bayesian network model, the problems that the importance degree change of factors cannot be considered in the existing risk assessment, the time-space transfer effect and the like are solved, and the accuracy, timeliness and construction adaptability of the risk assessment of the machine blocking are remarkably improved.
assignees: SICHUAN TIBET RAILWAY CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG;CHINA STATE RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Electric calculation collaborative integrated management method and system based on virtual power plant
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric calculation collaborative integrated management method and system based on a virtual power plant, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a batch calculation task set to be scheduled, wherein each task in the batch calculation task set to be scheduled is marked with a time window constraint, a resource demand spectrum, a mobility identification and a task priority; based on prospective information provided by a preset digital twin collaborative optimization layer, a power calculation task scheduling optimization model crossing space-time scales is constructed and solved by taking multi-objective optimization of total economic cost and total carbon emission of a system as a guide, a global scheduling blueprint comprising optimal execution time, execution place and resource allocation of each task is obtained, the global scheduling blueprint is decomposed into a real-time scheduling instruction sequence, and the real-time scheduling instruction sequence is issued to a corresponding physical power calculation node for execution, so that power calculation scheduling work is completed. The method completes the cooperative scheduling of the power and the calculation power, and realizes the cooperative idea that the calculation power follows the power or the power follows the calculation power.
assignees: STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD INFORMATION COMMUNICATION CO

title_en: Method and system for uniformly planning and allocating distributed resources of combustion chamber of solid engine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for uniformly planning and allocating distributed resources of a combustion chamber of a solid engine, wherein a complex space-time coupling relation among multiple procedures and multiple resources is uniformly modeled through a time-varying hypergraph and a time expansion network; further constructing a four-target optimization model comprising finishing time, energy consumption, quality loss and distribution robustness CVaR risks, adopting Wasserstein distribution robustness opportunity constraint to process random disturbance, guaranteeing safety and quality probability threshold under uncertain distribution, solving by utilizing a co-evolution distribution robustness multi-target optimization algorithm, combining digital twin on-line calibration disturbance distribution, guaranteeing engineering feasibility of the solution through two-stage feasible domain projection, and finally outputting a robust pareto solution set and an interpretable rescheduling label. The method effectively solves the problems of low feasibility rate and weak risk control of the traditional method under the condition of distributed drift, and achieves multi-objective unified optimization of safety, beat, energy consumption and quality.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING;XIAN AEROSPACE CHEMICAL PROPULSION CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based real-time early warning system for safety risk of building construction site
abstract_en: The application discloses a digital twin-based real-time early warning system for safety risks of a building construction site, which comprises a data acquisition layer, a data fusion processing layer, a digital twin dynamic mapping layer, a safety risk identification and early warning layer and an early warning output and response layer, wherein a technical path for extracting risk characteristics from a digital mirror image by the digital twin dynamic mapping layer is defined, an improved D-S evidence theory and long-short-term memory network model combined data fusion model is established, and the deep interaction between a twin model and a risk assessment model is realized. The structure belongs to the technical field of building construction, and can clearly define a risk feature extraction mechanism of a digital twin dynamic mapping layer, so that real-time identification and efficient treatment of safety risks are realized.
assignees: HANGZHOU TUOJIA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Pumped storage power station 5G+BIM intelligent interaction management system
abstract_en: The application provides a 5G+BIM intelligent interaction management system of a pumped storage power station, which comprises a sensing layer, a network layer, a data layer and an application layer, wherein the sensing layer is used for collecting earth-rock side vehicle transportation data, dam rolling data, underground cavern construction data and monitoring data, dynamic data updating of a BIM model is realized through a 5G camera, a sensor and construction data, the network layer is used for transmitting the dynamic data of the BIM model through a 5G private network and distributing communication resources according to service requirements by adopting a network slicing strategy, the data layer is used for fusing the dynamic data of the BIM model and comprises BIM geometric data, sensor real-time parameters and construction data, constructing a dynamic digital twin database, the application layer is used for carrying out construction state early warning and construction scheduling with the BIM model based on design parameters and sensor parameters, generating decision instructions through a deep learning algorithm, and realizing data depth fusion and network resource optimization and emergency capability improvement through fusing 5G highly reliable communication, BIM dynamic modeling and AI intelligent decision.
assignees: CHANGDIAN ZHANGYE ENERGY DEV CO LTD;CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD;CHINA THREE GORGES CONSTRUCTION ENG GROUP CO LTD;POWERCHINA NORTHWEST ENG CORP LTD

title_en: Integrated hydrogen pipeline network simulator for modeling hydrogen pipeline network, and simulation method for the same
title_ko: 수소관망의 모델링을 위한 통합 수소관망 시뮬레이터 및 그 시뮬레이션 방법
abstract_ko: 수소도시 구축을 위한 수소관망 설계 검증, 운영 모니터링, 유지관리 정책 수립, 교육 및 훈련 시스템에 적용할 수 있으며, 또한, CAD/GIS 설계도면 입력-시뮬레이션-가시화-예지보전으로 이어지는 통합 체계를 제공함으로써 도시 단위 수소 인프라 설계 및 운영에 직접 활용할 수 있고, 또한, 실증 데이터와 연계된 디지털트윈 플랫폼으로 확장하여 스마트시티 에너지 관리 시스템, 복합 에너지 네트워크 운영, 산업용 수소 배관망 안전관리 분야에도 적용할 수 있는,수소관망의 모델링을 위한 통합 수소관망 시뮬레이터 및 그 시뮬레이션 방법이 제공된다.
assignees: KOREA INST CIVIL ENGINEERING & BUILDING TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Emergency command system and method based on endophytic safety
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency command system and an emergency command method based on endophytic safety, which belong to the technical field of network space defense, and particularly comprise an emergency command platform and a safety protection platform, wherein the emergency command platform is used for completing processing and feedback of emergency events, the safety protection platform is used for comprehensively protecting the emergency command platform, and the emergency command system further comprises a risk early warning module which is connected with a monitoring control module and a data processing module and is used for identifying potential risks in advance through real-time analysis of the cleaned information data stream and the state of the digital twin platform based on the information data stream analyzed by the monitoring control module and the data processed by the data processing module.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU HUAJUN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-energy supply and demand balance method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a multi-energy supply and demand balance method and system, which comprises the steps of carrying out data preprocessing on collected electric energy data, heat energy data, hydrogen energy data and environment parameters to generate a standardized data matrix, sequentially carrying out gray correlation analysis, clustering division, quantitative energy complementary relation and piecewise linear coding on the basis of the standardized data matrix to screen out key contradictory features, constructing an electric-thermal-hydrogen dynamic equation on the basis of the key contradictory features, carrying out space-time parameter configuration on the basis of the electric-thermal-hydrogen dynamic equation to generate a digital twin multi-energy coupling model, extracting model constraint parameters on the basis of the digital twin multi-energy coupling model, inputting the model constraint parameters into a deep reinforcement learning network, updating a reward function weight in combination with a real-time state, generating a dynamic scheduling strategy and coding into an equipment executable scheduling instruction. The application has the advantages of accurate optimized scheduling strategy, balanced and efficient supply and demand, strong self-adaptive capacity of the system and improved energy utilization rate.
assignees: MEASUREMENT CENTER OF STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method for constructing full life cycle digital twin body of pumped storage power station
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of life cycle construction, in particular to a method for constructing a full life cycle digital twin body of a pumped storage power station, which comprises the steps of obtaining multisource heterogeneous sensing data in a construction period and an operation period, carrying out standardized cleaning and format unified processing, constructing a two-stage space grid coding system comprising a first-stage global grid and a second-stage local fine grid, carrying out space discretization mapping, establishing full life cycle time axis coding, correlating space grid data, carrying out space-time dimension alignment and multi-precision data fusion calculation, and carrying out digital twin geometric modeling, physical attribute mapping and full life cycle state evolution simulation based on space-time fusion data, effectively reducing risks of model distortion and decision bias, improving accuracy of full life cycle state simulation, further avoiding design defects and operation faults, effectively eliminating long-term negative influence on safety and reliability of a power station, and guaranteeing accuracy and scientificity of full life cycle management.
assignees: STATE GRID XINYUAN CO LTD

title_en: Load and environmental factor coupled reinforced concrete bridge service life prediction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of new generation information, in particular to a service life prediction method of a reinforced concrete bridge with load and environmental factor coupling, which is used for realizing high-frequency real-time acquisition and encryption transmission of load and environmental data through an intelligent sensing node network, generating a lightweight coupling feature vector by utilizing edge calculation to support real-time damage evolution simulation of a digital twin model, and simultaneously polymerizing multi-source bridge data to optimize a global service life prediction model on the premise of protecting data privacy through a federal learning framework.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG;BEIJING MUNICIPAL ENGINEERING RESEARCH INST

title_en: Wind power prediction covariate offset self-adaption method based on conditional energy model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power prediction covariate offset self-adaption method based on a conditional energy model. According to the invention, a wind power generation power prediction model is constructed by using a gating circulation unit network, and the off-line training of the wind power generation power prediction model is completed by adopting a sample weighting mechanism, so that the robustness of distribution change is enhanced. And learning the distribution difference of the training stage and the prediction stage data by adopting a conditional denoising score matching strategy through a conditional energy model, and obtaining a sample weight for measuring the covariate offset degree based on the model. And storing the data samples flowing in real time by using a replay buffer zone, and performing incremental learning on the conditional energy model and the wind power generation prediction model by using an online updating mechanism to keep the prediction performance stable. The method can effectively improve the power prediction precision and the operation scheduling capability of the wind power plant under complex meteorological conditions, and has good engineering practical value and deployment flexibility.
assignees: UNIV HANGZHOU NORMAL;ZHEJIANG BAIMAHU LABORATORY CO LTD

title_en: Waterlogging prediction and scheduling method and system based on digital twin and water conservancy model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a waterlogging prediction and scheduling method and system based on a digital twin and water conservancy model, and relates to the technical field of intelligent water affairs; the method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin body synchronously mapped with a physical drainage system, integrating a unified hydrodynamics mechanism model, quantifying pipe network hidden health state parameters on line through an AI inversion algorithm based on sparse real-time monitoring data, dynamically correcting model parameters, carrying out waterlogging scene simulation based on the corrected model to generate a risk dynamic thermodynamic diagram, constructing a multi-objective optimized scheduling model, and solving to generate a dynamic scheduling strategy library.
assignees: THE ELECTRONIC INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INST OF HEBEI PROVINCE

title_en: Method and system for generating nuclear power plant operation procedure on basis of digital twin platform
title_ko: 디지털트윈 플랫폼 기반으로 원전 운영 절차서를 생성하는 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for generating a nuclear power plant operation procedure on the basis of a digital twin platform, comprising the steps of: retrieving the original text of an operation procedure by means of an operation document system linked to a digital twin platform; using a text scripting function of a digital twin platform configuration solution so as to digitize the retrieved original text of the operation procedure; and using the digital operation procedure and a plurality of performance auxiliary functions so as to generate a user-customized operation procedure.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 디지털트윈 플랫폼 기반으로 원전 운영 절차서를 생성하는 방법으로서, 지털트윈 플랫폼에 연계된 운영문서 시스템을 통하여 운영 절차서의 원문을 호출하는 단계, 상기 디지털트윈 플랫폼 구성 솔루션의 텍스트 스크립팅 기능을 이용하여 상기 호출된 운영 절차서의 원문을 디지털화하는 단계 및 상기 디지털 운영 절차서 및 복수의 수행 보조기능을 이용하여 사용자 맞춤형 운영 절차서를 생성하는 단계를 포함한다.
assignees: KOREA HYDRO & NUCLEAR POWER CO

title_en: Method, device, computer equipment and storage medium for estimating state of energy storage unit
abstract_en: The application relates to a state estimation method, a state estimation device, computer equipment and a storage medium of an energy storage unit. The method comprises the steps of obtaining running state sequence data of all energy storage units in a hybrid energy storage system to be analyzed, inputting the running state sequence data into a normalization model to obtain normalized feature vectors of the energy storage units, taking the normalized feature vectors of the energy storage units as node features, taking association relations among the energy storage units as edges, constructing a full-connection graph, inputting the full-connection graph into a graph neural network model to obtain state estimation information of the energy storage units, and updating the features of the energy storage units by aggregating features of at least one layer of similar energy storage units for each energy storage unit to obtain the state estimation information of the energy storage units. The method can be applied to hybrid energy storage systems comprising different types of energy storage units.
assignees: CHINA DATANG GROUP TECH INNOVATION CO LTD;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Multi-mode digital twin operation and maintenance management and control method, system, equipment and storage medium for power monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-mode digital twin operation and maintenance management and control method, a system, equipment and a storage medium of an electric power monitoring system, and relates to the technical field of electric power monitoring systems, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting various physical quantity data of electric power equipment in real time, and performing preliminary format unification and time stamp marking; based on the unified space-time data set, the state of the power equipment under the action of thermal-force-electric multi-field coupling is simulated in real time through a model based on finite element analysis by a multi-physical-field simulation engine, and fault evolution prediction is carried out, so that a specific operation and maintenance strategy and equipment health assessment are generated, and an external execution unit is automatically triggered.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Robot Fleet Management for Value Chain Networks
abstract_en: A robot fleet management platform includes datastores configured to store a governance library defining governance standards. Processors execute computer-readable instructions to implement a governance-enabling intelligence layer that receives and responds to intelligence requests received from intelligence service clients. The intelligence layer includes artificial intelligence services including machine learning, rules-based intelligence, digital twin, robot process automation, and machine vision. The set of governance standards is applied to decisions made by one or more of the set of artificial intelligence services. An intelligence layer controller coordinates performance of the artificial intelligence services on behalf of the intelligence service clients and performance of analyses corresponding to the artificial intelligence services based on the set of governance standards. The intelligence layer returns decisions determined by the artificial intelligence services in response to the intelligence requests. The decisions are determined based on intelligence service data sources and the set of analyses.
assignees: STRONG FORCE VCN PORTFOLIO 2019 LLC

title_en: Customized flood prediction and warning system using smart pole and virtual sensor data
title_ko: 스마트폴 및 가상 센서 데이터를 이용한 맞춤형 홍수 예경보 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 스마트폴 및 가상 센서 데이터를 이용한 맞춤형 홍수 예경보 시스템은 복수의 스마트폴로부터 수위 및 강우량을 포함하는 계측 데이터를 수신하는 데이터 수집부; 상기 수신된 계측 데이터의 결측치 또는 이상치를 보정하는 데이터 처리부; 상기 보정된 계측 데이터를 이용하여, 물리적 센서가 설치되지 않은 하나 이상의 예측 지점에 대한 예측 수위를 생성하는 가상 센서를 포함하며, 상기 스마트폴의 실제 계측 수위와 상기 가상 센서의 예측 수위를 종합하여 하천 수위를 예측하는 수위 예측부; 및 상기 예측된 하천 수위가 사전에 설정된 기준 수위를 초과할 것으로 판단될 경우 경보를 발생시키는 예경보부;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Apparatus and method for generating turbine installation scenarios for tidal power generation systems
title_ko: 조류 발전 시스템의 터빈 설치 시나리오 생성 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 조류 발전에 사용되는 터빈을 디지털 트윈 방식으로 가상 설치하여 적합성 평가를 수행할 수 있는 조류 발전 시스템의 터빈 설치 시나리오 생성 장치 및 방법이 개시된다. 일 실시예에 따른 시나리오 생성 장치는 외부 장치와 통신을 수행하는 통신부; 및 상기 외부 장치로부터 수신한 조류 예보 데이터에 기초하여 조류 발전 시스템에 대한 하나 이상의 가상 설치 시나리오를 생성하며, 상기 하나 이상의 가상 설치 시나리오 별 적합성 평가 점수를 계산하는 분석부를 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: ANSOLUTIONS CO LTD

title_en: Digital conduction inspection and formation control device and method for corrugated pipe using a smart 3D vision and sensing module for a three-legged ski track linear corrugated pipe
title_ko: 4채널형 스키트랙 리니어식 주름관 스마트 3d 비전·센싱모듈을 통한 주름관용 디지털 도통 점검형성제어장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 기존의 본 출원인 출원하여 등록받은 지중관로 결합트래버스 측량 스마트 제어장치의 경우에, 주로 지중관로 중 주름관이 없는 일반관에서 이루어짐으로서, 주름관이 있는 지중관로에서는 덜컹거림과 흔들림에 의해 적용할 수가 없고, 이동시 영상촬영이 흔들려서 선명한 영상획득이 어려우며, 무엇보다, 지중관로 내부 단면 3차원 Point Cloud Data 정보가 없어 3D를 이용한 디지털 트윈을 구축하여 관로 유지보수 및 디지털화 실현에 한계가 있으며, 밀고 당기는 견인 때 수평 유지를 위한 견인 줄(=윈치줄)의 마찰로 인해 지중관로 내부 손상이 발생하고 흠집이 생겨 관로 침하 및 함몰의 원인이 되고, 이로 인하여 지표면의 건수, 침출수 등의 유입으로 관로 형상 유지에 문제가 발생하여 생애주기가 단축되는 문제점과, 지중관로의 주름관 내부를 이동시, 굴곡진 부위를 이동시, 기존 기술의 경우에, 몸체 일측에 형성된 스키 블레이드로 이동시 굴곡진 부위에 걸리거나 긁어서 손상시키는 문제점을 개선하고자, 하이브리드케이블용 DMI((Distance Measuring Instrument)구동부(100), 종점맨홀용 윈치모터구동부(200), 4채널형 스키트랙 리니어식 주름관 스마트 3D 비전·센싱모듈(300), 지중관로 3D 맵 형성제어모듈(400)이 구성됨으로서, 4채널형 스키트랙 리니어부를 통해, 주름관 직경이 작은 8cm~16cm인 곳에서는 자동으로 접어서 사용하고, 주름관 직경이 큰 17cm~35cm인 곳에서는 자동으로 펼쳐서 사용할 수 있어, 확장성과 범용성을 기존에 비해 1.5배~2배로 높일 수 있고, 4채널형 구조를 통해 침수, 파손, 이물질구간에서도 막힘없이 전진이동하면서 지중관로 내부공간에서 도통이 되도록 형성시킬 수 있으며, MEMS형 IMU(Inertial Measurement Unit) 센서모듈이 구성됨으로서, MEMS 기반으로 설계되어, 소형화와 함께 지중 관로 내부의 극한 환경에서도 안정적으로 동작할 수 있고, 4채널형 스키트랙 리니어식 이동메인본체의 3D 이동 방향 및 회전 운동을 동시에 추적할 수 있으며, 이로 인해, 지중관로 내부에서 발생하는 기울기, 회전, 이동에 대한 정확한 실시간 데이터를 제공할 수 있고, 속도 및 회전에 대한 변화를 실시간으로 감지하여, 주행 안정성을 높이고 불필요한 흔들림이나 꼬임을 방지할 수 있으며, 스마트제어부가 구성됨으로서, 기존 기술에서 발생하는 연속 영상 촬영 후 전체 데이터를 전송하는 방식이 많아 불필요한 데이터 증가와 실시간 처리 부담을 개선하여, 5cm 간격으로 필요한 프레임만 추출하여 전송함으로써 데이터 최적화 및 분석 효율을 기존보다 80% 향상시킬 수 있고, 단순 거리 측정이 아닌, 지중관로의 3D 공간에서의 이동 경로를 추적하는 분위기를 형성시킬 수 있으며,  포인트 클라우드(=3D 점군) 데이터, 이동 궤적 예측데이터, 현재 위치(Pose)의 3차원 좌표정보(x,y,z)데이터, 주름관영상이미지데이터를 하나의 프로토콜로 통합 전송시킴으로서, 지상에 위치한 지중관로 3D 맵 형성제어모듈을 통해 실시간 지중관로 3D 맵 형성 및 이상감지를 표출시킬 수 있고, 4채널형 스키트랙 리니어식 주름관 스마트 3D 비전·센싱모듈이 구성됨으로서, 지중관로 내부 상태를 분석한  포인트 클라우드(=3D 점군) 데이터, 이동 궤적 예측데이터, 현재 위치(Pose)의 3차원 좌표정보(x,y,z)데이터, 주름관영상이미지데이터를 실시간으로 생성시킬 수 있고, 진동 및 흔들림 보정을 통해, 기존보다 80% 향상된 안정적이고 양질의 영상촬영 및 센서 데이터를 확보할 수 있고, 4채널형 스키트랙 리니어 이동으로 주름관 표면을 따라 부드럽게 이동하면서, 측정 효율을 기존보다 1.5배~3배로 높일 수 있으며, 무엇보다 지상에 위치한 지중관로 3D 맵 형성제어모듈과 실시간으로 데이터를 전송시킬 수 있으며, 지중관로 3D 맵 형성제어모듈이 구성됨으로서, 주름관 내부의 실제 형상을 주름관 3D 맵 형상으로 재현시킬 수 있고, 실시간 이상 감지 및 시각화를 통해, 지중관로 유지보수 작업의 효율성을 기존에 비해 80% 향상시키며, 정확한 좌표기반 이상감지기록을 통해, 향후 유지보수 계획 수립 및 클라우드 분석 활용시킬 수 있는 4채널형 스키트랙 리니어식 주름관 스마트 3D 비전·센싱모듈을 통한 주름관용 디지털 도통 점검형성제어장치 및 방법을 제공하는데 그 목적이 있다.
assignees: GEOGRAPIC INFIRMATION SYSTEMS 21 CO LTD

title_en: Multi-target layered intelligent optimization decision method and system for dry limit water level of reservoir
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-objective layered intelligent optimization decision method for a reservoir drought limit water level, which is deployed in a reservoir dispatching automation system and comprises the following logic strong coupling and sequence irreversible steps of constructing a multidimensional objective function topology network for the drought limit water level dispatching, establishing a multi-element marginal triggering rule for the drought limit water level dispatching, establishing a reservoir dispatching digital twin model considering the activation signals, prefabricating 19 non-redundant weight configuration vector sets generated by topological ordering of four target nodes of benefit-risk-cost-efficiency in a system rule engine, taking a key node drought limit water level sequence as a decision variable, and executing a secondary normalization compensation mechanism for eliminating dimension difference on all non-inferior solution sets.
assignees: CHINA INST OF WATER RESOURCES AND HYDROPOWER RESEARCH

title_en: Method and apparatus for optimal control of power grid by using digital twin
title_ko: 디지털 트윈을 활용한 전력 그리드 최적 제어를 위한 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: A method for optimal control of a power grid is proposed. The method may include generating, by using a processor, a digital twin model which learns synthetic data and collected data respectively obtained in a power generation resource unit and a demand resource unit to predict grid balancing. The method may also include correcting power grid data of an open platform by using a power grid data prediction model executed by the processor, based on an error between the power grid data obtained in the open platform and power grid data obtained in a real time simulator (RTS). The method may further include controlling the power generation resource unit and the demand resource unit by using a control module executed by the processor, based on grid balancing data predicted by the digital twin model and the corrected power grid data of the open platform.
abstract_ko: 전력 그리드 최적 제어를 위한 방법이 개시된다. 이 방법은 프로세서가, 발전 자원부 및 수요 자원부 각각에서 획득한 생성 데이터와 수집 데이터를 학습하여 그리드 밸런싱을 예측하는 디지털 트윈 모델을 생성하는 단계; 상기 프로세서에 의해 실행되는 계통 데이터 예측 모델이, 오픈 플랫폼에서 획득한 계통 데이터와 실시간 시뮬레이터(RTS)에서 획득한 계통 데이터 간의 오차에 기초하여 상기 오픈 플랫폼의 계통 데이터를 보정하는 단계; 및 상기 프로세서에 의해 실행되는 제어 모듈이, 상기 디지털 트윈 모델에 의해 예측된 그리드 밸런싱 데이터와 상기 보정된 오픈 플랫폼의 계통 데이터를 이용하여 발전 자원부와 수요 자원부를 제어하는 단계를 포함한다.
assignees: KOREA ELECTRONICS TECHNOLOGY INST

title_en: Digital twinning-based wind power boost pooling station safety state evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wind power operation and maintenance, in particular to a wind power boost pooling station safety state evaluation method and system based on digital twinning, comprising S1, multi-source data acquisition and synchronous preprocessing; S2, generating digital twin simulation working conditions, S3, fusing and expanding simulation and actual measurement data, S4, learning space-time characterization and extracting features, S5, training a safety state evaluation model, S6, carrying out on-line estimation, early warning triggering and operation and maintenance decision support, and constructing a comprehensive sample set which is consistent with a physical rule and is attached to field distribution in a training stage by carrying out formal domain alignment and physical constraint data fusion on a high-fidelity digital twin simulation sample and a field actual measurement sample and adopting a physical constraint-based generation type enhancement strategy. The fault working condition space which can be learned by the model is expanded, the defect of rare or extreme working conditions in a field history sample is made up, and engineering personnel can rely on and adopt the evaluation result as an operation and maintenance judgment basis.
assignees: CHINA CONSTR 6TH ENG DIVISION;CHINA CONSTRUCTION SIXTH ENG DIVISION TRAFFIC CONSTRUCTION CO LTD;UNIV DALIAN JIAOTONG

title_en: Power state estimation method and system based on improved graph isomorphic network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of data analysis, in particular to a power state estimation method and a system based on an improved graph isomorphic network, which firstly acquire original measurement data and topology information of a target power system, then construct a graph structure according to the topology information, and converting the original measurement data into node characteristics and edge characteristics of the graph structure to obtain graph structure data, and then inputting the graph structure data into a preset deep GINE model for characteristic extraction, message transmission and residual aggregation to output a target state estimation value. Compared with the prior art, the method has higher estimation precision and stronger robustness.
assignees: GUANGZHOU UNIPOWER COMPUTER CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic power generation power prediction method based on depth time sequence block model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic power generation power prediction method based on a depth time sequence block model, which comprises the following steps of obtaining photovoltaic power generation power history data and weather history data in a corresponding time period, mapping weather type data into numerical variables, obtaining missing conditions of the data, filling the missing data, carrying out data standardization processing on all data variables, carrying out single-channel treatment on the standardized multi-channel data, decomposing a photovoltaic power sequence by adopting a DFT signal processing method to generate a seasonal partial sequence and a trending partial sequence, dividing each single variable time sequence data into a series of time sequence blocks, searching the optimal time sequence block size by using WOA, inputting the obtained training data into a transform prediction trunk network for model training, and inputting the characteristics of a prediction sample by using a trained model.
assignees: ZHANGJIAKOU POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID JINBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LIMITED;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV BAODING

title_en: Regional energy management system and method based on collaborative intelligence and dynamic self-adaption
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional energy management system and a method based on collaborative intelligence and dynamic self-adaption, wherein the system operates in a two-stage optimization framework of a regional command layer and a single building model layer. The regional command layer receives and aggregates the model update to refine a global energy optimization model, and utilizes the global energy optimization model to adaptively adjust regional optimization strategies, continuous closed loop calibration and update are carried out on a digital twin network through the output of a single building model layer, and the regional command layer dynamically adjusts a cluster-level model in the middle of the control granularity or temporary authorization of the single building model layer according to triggering events or prediction conditions detected in real time, so as to solve the challenges of insufficient data privacy, calculation complexity and system toughness in large-scale distributed energy system management.
assignees: SHENZHEN ZHONGHONG LOW CARBON CONSTRUCTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus and method for disaster prevention of power generation facilities based on digital twin
title_ko: 디지털 트윈에 기반한 발전 설비의 재해 예방 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 디지털 트윈을 이용하여 발전 설비의 재해 발생 가능성을 예측하고, 예측된 결과를 통해 재해를 예방하기 위한 장치 및 방법이 개시된다. 일 실시예에 따른 재해 예방 장치는 발전 설비의 가상 환경 상에서 재해 발생 가능성을 예측하는 재해 예측부; 재해 발생 가능성 및 작업자의 작업 정보, 경력 정보 및 안전 장비 정보 중 적어도 하나를 포함하는 작업자 정보를 기초로 작업 적합도를 계산하는 작업자 관리부; 및 하나 이상의 단말과 통신을 수행하는 통신부를 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: ANSOLUTIONS CO LTD

title_en: System and Method for Port Management using Digital Twin using them
title_ko: 디지털 트윈을 이용한 항만 관리 시스템 및 이를 이용한 항만 관리 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 항만을 구성하는 시설물에 대한 제1 이미지와 상기 항만에 발생하는 기후 변화 정보를 수집하고, 상기 기후 변화 정보에 기초하여 상기 제1 이미지에 포함된 상기 항만의 변화에 기초하여 상기 항만에서 발생한 재난 및 재해에 대한 예측정보를 가상화 모델링 작업으로 추출된 가상 모델에 입력하여 상기 기후 변화 정보에 따른 상기 항만에서 발생한 재난 및 재해에 대해 디지털 트윈(Digital Twin)으로 구현하는 디지털 트윈을 이용한 항만 관리 시스템 및 이를 이용한 항만 관리 방법을 개시한다.
assignees: KOREA INST OCEAN SCI & TECH

title_en: Power Outage-based Incident Report Triage and Remediation
abstract_en: A method comprises determining, by an incident management application executing on a computer system, whether a location of a cell site indicated in an incident report is in a location area of a grid power outage, obtaining, by the incident management application, an estimated restoration time of the grid power outage at the cell site from a power monitoring system, storing, by the incident management application, the incident report at a data store to hold the incident report for a period of time based on the estimated restoration time, and after the period of time, executing, by the incident management application, a remediation action for the cell site according to a rule based on at least one of equipment data describing radio and power equipment at the cell site, priority data associated with the cell site, or power equipment availability data.
assignees: T MOBILE INNOVATIONS LLC

title_en: Method and device for recovering power supply of comprehensive energy system and comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a device for recovering power supply of a comprehensive energy system and the comprehensive energy system. The method comprises the steps of modeling a comprehensive energy system to obtain a device coupling model and an energy consumption model corresponding to the comprehensive energy system, determining an electric power demand interval of the electric power system connected to the comprehensive energy system in a power failure period, determining an objective function corresponding to power restoration in the power failure period based on load reduction cost of the electric power system, wherein a function value of the objective function is a power failure loss minimum value in the power failure period, solving the switching state of each switch in the comprehensive energy system based on the objective function by taking the device coupling model, the energy consumption model and the electric power demand interval as constraints, and controlling each switch according to the control parameters to restore the power supply of the comprehensive energy system. The power supply system can adapt to the power demand of a power system, and aims at minimum power failure loss and recovering the power supply of the comprehensive energy system.
assignees: ZHEJIANG SOLAX POWER NETWORK ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for establishing a power outage recovery plan and computer program therefor
title_ko: 정전 복구 계획 수립 방법 및 이를 위한 컴퓨터 프로그램
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 정전 복구 계획 수립 방법 및 이를 위한 컴퓨터 프로그램에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따른 정전 복구 계획 수립 방법은, 전력 소비 계통 내에 마련되는 자가 발전 설비를 포함하는 복수의 설비들의 구성과 상기 복수의 설비들 각각의 미리 설정된 제약 조건을 파악하는 단계; 상기 미리 설정된 제약 조건을 반영하여 상기 전력 소비 계통의 정전 복구 계획을 수립하기 위한 최적화 문제를 구성하는 단계; 상기 최적화 문제의 솔루션에 기초하여 상기 복수의 설비들 각각의 기동 순서를 결정하는 단계;를 포함한다.
assignees: POSCO CO LTD;RESEARCH INST OF INDUSTRIAL SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Method and system for selective acceleration of remote copy in a network of storage systems
abstract_en: Systems and methods described herein involve prioritizing remote copies for acceleration after a disaster-stricken site is operational to enable faster restore and failback operations.
