The remote copies accelerate processes based on a risk of a Recovery Time Objective (RTO) violation and the impact of failback delays, thereby ensuring timely data restoration and maintaining business continuity. Remote copies that are already in-sync are prioritized for deceleration to free up network resources based on the length of the RTO. Various embodiments remove the maximum bandwidth cap of the highest priority reverse resync operations to accelerate them, or lower the minimum bandwidth cap of the highest priority in-sync remote copies to decelerate them.
assignees: HITACHI VANTARA LTD

title_en: Water conservancy prevents soil erosion and water loss device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of water conservancy, in particular to a water conservancy soil erosion prevention device, which comprises a splicing column, wherein the splicing column is in a regular hexagon shape, a plurality of groups of water outlets for water drainage are formed in the outer side of the splicing column, a female buckle is fixedly connected to one side of the splicing column, a male buckle is fixedly connected to the other side of the splicing column, and a plurality of groups of female buckles and male buckles are arranged at intervals on the outer side of the splicing column. The utility model is provided with the degradable non-woven fabric, the water outlet and the planting matrix, can avoid completely blocking the substance exchange of soil, water and vegetation through the cooperation of the three, does not destroy the living environment of microorganisms and violates ecological restoration targets, and is provided with the snap fastener, the bolt and the nut, so that the device for preventing water and soil loss can be directly paved on a steep slope needing soil fixation through the cooperation of the three, the cost expenditure of a user is reduced, and secondary disasters such as small-scale landslide and the like are avoided.

title_en: A prevention of seepage drainage and vegetation recovery integrated structure for spoil field reclamation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-seepage drainage and vegetation restoration integrated structure for reclamation of a waste soil field, which relates to the technical field of vegetation restoration and comprises a waste soil field, wherein an anti-seepage layer is covered on the outer surface layer of the waste soil field; the anti-seepage device is characterized in that a gravel drainage layer is arranged above the anti-seepage layer, a plurality of water collecting pipes are embedded in the gravel drainage layer, a plurality of water inlet holes are formed in the water collecting pipes, the water collecting pipes are connected with a water draining pipe, the lower end of the water draining pipe extends into the water collecting tank, a water collecting well is arranged at one end of the water collecting tank, and a vegetation protection frame is arranged above the gravel drainage layer. According to the utility model, the non-woven fabric is paved as the impermeable layer, so that the infiltration of moisture into the waste soil field is effectively prevented, the risk of water and soil loss is reduced, the possibility of occurrence of geological disasters such as landslide caused by the infiltration of the moisture is reduced, and the safety and stability of the waste soil field and surrounding areas are ensured.

title_en: Ecological restoration greening device for high-steep rock wall hidden grid hanging basket
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of ecological restoration of high-steep slopes, in particular to an ecological restoration greening device for a high-steep rock wall hidden grid hanging basket. The utility model forms an integral U-shaped ecological restoration greening bulge by using a hanging basket, anchor rods, galvanized iron wires and an ecological bag, wherein the hidden grid hanging basket is formed by adopting a transverse 3-row sleeve (2), a middle horizontal U-shaped rib (3), a vertical 4-row U-shaped rib (4), two hanging ribs (5) on two sides, two transverse ribs (6) at the bottom end, a main anchor rod/auxiliary anchor rod (7), a vertical ecological bag (8) and a galvanized iron wire net (9), and all parts are welded and connected. The utility model has the economic effects that the hidden grid hanging basket is prefabricated by a factory, the greening device is simple, the construction process is simple, the ecological restoration cost is low, the construction speed is high, the greening effect is quick, the ecological environment is further and quickly restored, the problems of high construction cost and long time of the current high-steep slope greening are solved, and simultaneously, the geological disaster is prevented and treated to a certain extent.

title_en: Systems and methods for advancing the restoration process for interdependent critical infrastructures
abstract_en: Systems and methods are provided for advancing the restoration process for interdependent critical infrastructures (CIs) after a disaster. A modeling and solution approach can leverage the strengths of reinforcement learning (RL) to enhance the computational capability of optimization techniques to advance the restoration process. The gap can be bridged between integrative and distinct decision-making, enabling coordinated restoration planning for CIs within a decentralized decision-making context.
assignees: SAHA NAMRATA;AMINI MOHAMMADHADI;REZAPOUR SHABNAM;THE FLORIDA INTERNATIONAL UNIV BOARD OF TRUSTEES

title_en: Ecological restoration structure for geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disaster ecological restoration structure, which relates to the technical field of geological disaster ecological restoration and comprises a grounding nail and a planting frame, wherein a steel wire rope is fixedly connected between the grounding nail and the planting frame, an installation disc is sleeved on the outer surface of the grounding nail, an annular groove is formed in the lower side surface of the installation disc, a clamping groove is formed in the inner wall of the annular groove, the annular groove is also formed in an annular shape, a protection cylinder is arranged on the outer surface of the grounding nail, the protection cylinder is matched with the annular groove, the inner wall of the protection cylinder is slidably connected with a displacement cylinder, the lower side surface of the displacement cylinder extends out of the lower side surface of the protection cylinder, a fixing component can be unlocked by means of displacement cylinder movement, and meanwhile, the unlocking and the taking out can be completed by means of one action due to the fact that the displacement direction of the displacement cylinder is uniform, and meanwhile, the protection cylinder cannot fall down in hands after being separated.

title_en: Floating type wave-eliminating enclosure for ecological treatment of water body
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of water ecological treatment equipment, in particular to a floating type wave eliminating enclosure for water ecological treatment, which comprises a rubber enclosure and floating shell components, wherein the rubber enclosure is of a strip-shaped flexible structure and is distributed along a preset boundary of a water treatment area, the floating shell components are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the rubber enclosure, a plurality of floating shell components are uniformly distributed at intervals along the length direction of the rubber enclosure and provide stable buoyancy support for the rubber enclosure, the floating shell components comprise floating shells, the floating shells are hollow light structures in the interior and are made of high-density polyethylene materials, long-term use requirements of the water ecological treatment are met, the relative independence of a target water area and an external water body is realized in a physical isolation mode, suspended pollutants, algae and the like in the water body are effectively intercepted, the accurate implementation of ecological treatment measures is guaranteed, and the floating shell components can be widely applied to water eutrophication treatment, emergency management and control of the polluted water body, ecological restoration subarea division and other scenes.

title_en: Water conservancy channel side slope landslide reinforcement prosthetic devices
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water conservancy channel slope landslide reinforcement and repair device which comprises a water conservancy channel main body, wherein the inner side of the water conservancy channel main body is of a V-shaped structure, a groove is formed in the inner wall of the water conservancy channel main body, a net box is arranged in the groove, supporting stone blocks are filled in the net box, waterproof cloth is laid on the inner wall of the water conservancy channel main body, a geocell is arranged on the outer wall of the waterproof cloth, diamond through holes are formed in the geocell, a sand stabilizing layer is filled in the diamond through holes, a sand stabilizing layer is filled in the geocell, an ecological protection layer is arranged on the geocell, a net box is arranged on the inner wall of the water conservancy channel main body, the net box, the waterproof cloth, the geocell, the sand stabilizing layer and the ecological protection layer are distributed in bilateral symmetry about bisectors of the water conservancy channel main body, and the net box is positioned at the lower end of the geocell. The device can realize the rapid restoration of the side slope of the water conservancy channel main body so as to realize the normal use of the water conservancy channel main body at the fastest speed.

title_en: Portable support backfill structure for mine subsidence area
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mine geological disaster management and ecological restoration, in particular to a portable supporting backfill structure of a mine subsidence area, which comprises a soil body, wherein a composite geomembrane for isolating crushed rock soil is paved at a subsidence pit of the soil body, a supporting frame component for stably supporting the soil body is arranged at the inner side of the composite geomembrane, after the supporting frame component is deployed and locked, a stable U-shaped supporting space formed by a base and two vertical supporting plates is formed, namely, backfill layer construction can be carried out in the space and at the outer side of the supporting plates, vertical load is mainly borne by the base and the composite geomembrane below the base, lateral soil pressure is borne by the two vertical supporting plates which are locked, and is effectively dispersed into surrounding original soil body through positioning piles, so that rotary force is converted into unfolding power of the supporting plates through a connecting rod and a sliding block structure, and mechanical self-locking is realized by utilizing screws.

title_en: Method and system for remote software installation, recovery, and restoration over a data network
abstract_en: System and method for disaster recovery, remote installation and restoration of software and/or data over a data network, when a computer system includes a CPU, read/write internal memory means, an optional display, an optional input device, means for communicating with a data network, a bootable device input port and a hard disk, a bootable removable media means with a live operating system that is stored therein is coupled to the computer system A server that comprises a CPU and memory and software components for exchanging encrypted data, software packages, optional subscriber database with licensing information of each subscriber, and optional data files is adapted to communicate with a plurality of computer systems. The removable memory means performs a first boot operation, to scan hardware of the computer system and network connections, to establish networking connections, to establish a secured channel between the communicating means of the computer system and the server, over the networking connection, either within one data network, or over multiple data networks, and to transmit an optionally unique hardware signature over the secured channel to the server, for checking if the configuration that corresponds to the signature exists, and for executing a default process or otherwise, proposing relevant recovery options to the user of the computer system and for preparing appropriate files and software packages for the selected recovery option.
assignees: PORTUGALI ELLIE

title_en: Planning method and system for disaster recovery path of satellite network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of satellite network communication, and particularly discloses a planning method and a planning system for a satellite network disaster recovery path, wherein the planning method comprises the steps of monitoring and acquiring a network state in real time, and constructing a satellite network directed graph model based on the network state; calculating normalized information betweenness of all satellite links in a satellite network directed graph model to generate a mixed weight model, constructing a path cost function based on the mixed weight model and path hops, planning a disaster recovery path based on the path cost function and an improved Ford-Fulkerson algorithm to obtain a disaster recovery path planning result, and planning a path based on the disaster recovery path planning result. The method realizes the joint optimization of load balancing and disaster recovery capability, further realizes the synchronous optimization of communication fault restoration and low-centrality alternative paths, and ensures the high efficiency and reliability of network communication.

title_en: Method of optimising the performance of a computer and a main non-volatile memory unit optimised using specific-use sections
abstract_en: A method is revealed to optimize the performance of a computer by establishing purpose-specific sections in its main non-volatile storage medium. This method creates a basic set of purpose-specific sections in order to store, separated at a physical level and at a logical level, basic elements associated to equipment operation such as operating system, dynamic files, applications and user related files; and, optionally, creates an additional set of purpose-specific sections to store other elements separated in like manner. A secondary method is also described to supplement the previous one, in order to quickly optimize an unlimited number of identical computers. In addition, the optimized main non-volatile storage medium that results from employing either of the previous methods is described. For users, owners and technicians of an optimized equipment, the use of this invention generates numerous advantages: minimized file fragmentation; better defragmentation techniques; top operating speed; easier file and disk backups as well as faster restoration; improved system security, operation continuity, and disaster recovery; superior configuration techniques on installed software; optimal system operation; and, thus, minimized total cost of ownership. It is impossible to simultaneously accomplish said advantages using traditional techniques or other optimization approaches published to date.
assignees: MEJIAS BUTRON MANUEL F

title_en: Using a fixed network wireless data collection system to improve utility responsiveness to power outages
abstract_en: A system for determining a service outages and restorations that includes an outage management server (OMS) that generates reports outages and restoration information for metering endpoints. The outages may be caused by faults at various locations in the distribution network. The metering endpoint may include a transmitter having a battery backup that transmits the outage information upon a failure to detect a voltage at the endpoint. The transmission of the information may be filtered based on configurable criteria. The metering endpoints may also inform the OMS when power is restored. Thus, a utility may better service its customers by focusing manpower efforts using the outage and restoration information generated by the OMS.
assignees: ELSTER ELECTRICITY LLC;MASON ROBERT T JR;BORLESKE ANDREW J;SHUEY KENNETH C

title_en: Automated tool for monitoring archaeological sites (ATMAS™)
abstract_en: An automation tool for resource managers to effectively schedule on-site visits and manage information obtained thereby. An embodiment of the present invention, the Automated Tool for Monitoring Archaeological Sites (ATMAS™), automates the process by which cultural resource (CR) managers on various installations prioritize and schedule CR sites for monitoring. Other applications for use by resource management include: environmental, safety, security, military, educational, emergency management, land use, fish and wildlife management, construction and maintenance of highways and waterways, mining, exploration, manufacturing, recreational management, urban restoration and the like. Embodiments of the present invention increase efficiency and reduce cost, while accurately and timely preserving and integrating information. Embodiments of the present invention are useful for post-processing as well as scheduling, analysis, and pro-active direction of ongoing monitoring.
assignees: HARGRAVE MICHAEL L;MEYER WILLIAM D

title_en: System for verifying restored outages, such as in the field outage restoration of public utilities using automatic meter reading (AMR)
abstract_en: Systems and methods for verifying restored outages are described. In some examples, the system samples endpoints to determine an extent of a restoration. The system may compare positive indications received by endpoints to a list of endpoints that indicate utility outages, and provide guidance to a field worker based on the comparison.
assignees: ANGELIS BRUCE

title_en: Video recording/reproducing device and dvd recorder
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To save video data recorded before a blackout as much as possible while enabling return processing from the blackout by utilizing a data structure itself of a DVD-VR standard.  <P>SOLUTION: A DVD recorder 1 executes recording processing and reproduction processing in compliance with the DVD-VR standard. The DVD recorder 1 writes a title ID in a manufacturer unique information writing region of an RDI_PCK of VOBU information together with VOBU_ENT. The last VOBU information in the VOBU information known by backed-up recording management information is specified during power restoration after the blackout so as to make it as "temporary termination" of a VOB. The recording management information is updated by reading out the RDI_PCK from data, which are continuous to the VOBU information of the temporary termination and newer than the VOBU information of the temporary termination, and also, by further extracting the VOBU_ENT from in the RDI_PCK. When the VOBU information, from which the RDI_PCK is read out, has a perfect size, the "temporary termination" is updated so as to make the VOBU information as termination.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT
assignees: FUNAI ELECTRIC CO

title_en: A quick hardening method of the soil
title_ko: 토양 속성고결공법
abstract_en: A quick hardening method of soil is provided to stabilize and solidify the ground in a short time at urgent restoration works for the ground or the ground carried away by the floods or ground subsidence or various foundation works. The invention relates to a quick hardening method of soil for quick-hardening soil in a short time for stabilizing and solidifying soil at urgent restoration works for the road or the ground carried away by the floods or ground subsidence or various foundation works, which comprises the steps of: manufacturing a soil mixture(2) by mixing 80~120 weight percent wet sandy soil, 5~50 weight percent water-soluble silicate against the weight of the wet sandy soil, and 20~80 weight percent bond reinforcing agent against the weight of the water-soluble silicate; paving the manufactured soil mixture on the road or the ground(1) required to be restored in the optimum quantity and tamping; perforating many holes at regular intervals according to a diameter of a gas injection pipe(3) to make the gas injection pipe located to the inner bottom of the part where the soil mixture is paved and inserting a gas injection pipe to each hole; and hardening the soil mixture in a short time by supplying carbon dioxide to the gas injection pipe.
abstract_ko:

title_en: Maintenance/inspection management system
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To suitably respond to inquiry from a customer by acquiring a restoration scheduled time of respective objects when a wide-area disaster such as an earthquake occurs.  <P>SOLUTION: When elevators of the respective objects are stopped by generation of the earthquake, the troubles are informed to a remote monitoring center (step S11-S13). The remote monitoring center receives the information, and working lists of the respective objects requiring the restoration work are prepared and transmitted to a maintenance person (step S14-S18). Here, the remote monitoring center calculates the restoration scheduled time of the respective objects based on the time when the maintenance person arrives at the field and starts the restoration work, and displays this on a monitoring screen or the like (step S19-S22). Re-calculation is performed to renew the display when there is notification of a delay time from the maintenance person and when the work is finished at the field (step S23-S26). Thereby, the restoration scheduled time of the respective objects is acquired and the countermeasure is suitably made to the inquiry from the customer.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Suck-out preventive injection method
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To particularly quicken rising of strength, infiltrate into every part of an injection area, and improve suck-out resistance in a suck-out preventive injection method for use in reinforcement or cut-off of the soft ground, restoration of a building (righting the building) inclined by ground subsidence due to an earthquake, excavation work, or the like, backfilling of a tunnel or the like, filling of a cavity, consolidation under the water surface such as the sea bottom or underwater, or the like.  <P>SOLUTION: Fluidized plastic gel is used as an injection material, and injection materials different in plasticity holding time are used in an initial stage of injection and a subsequent stage of injection. Further, a soil grain infiltrating type nonplastic injection material is injected in the ground in an injection area injected with plastic gel or every part of the injection area. title_en: Switch
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a switch capable of suppressing a secondary disaster which occurs at the restoration of power interruption caused by the occurrence of a disaster such as an earthquake while suppressing malfunction.  <P>SOLUTION: When predetermined vibration is detected by a vibration sensing device 14, a vibration detection signal is output from a vibration detecting relay circuit and input to an overcurrent detecting circuit 46 of a control device 13. Then the control device 13 is put in a tripping operation preparing state (in the power interruption waiting state of an electric line). When the power to the electric line is interrupted, the control device 13 puts a switch body into tripping operation, that is, the switch body is opened when detecting vibration attended with power interruption. The secondary disaster caused by the return of power can thereby be prevented even if a load facility has collapsed or the like. The control device does not put the switch body in tripping operation in the case of detecting vibration not attended with power interruption. This results in suppressing the malfunction of the switch body caused by the erroneous detection of vibration.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT
assignees: ENERGY SUPPORT CORP

title_en: Efficient method to predict integrated circuit temperature and power maps
abstract_en: The temperature distribution associated with a design of an integrated circuit is calculated by convoluting a surface power usage represented by a power matrix with a heat spreading function. The heat spreading function may be calculated from a simulation of a point source on the integrated circuit using a finite element analysis model of the integrated circuit or other techniques. To account for spatial variations on the chip, the heat spreading function may be made dependent on position using a position scaling function. Steady-state or transient temperature distributions may be computed by using a steady-state or transient heat spreading function. A single heat spreading function may be convolved with various alternative power maps to efficiently calculate temperature distributions for different designs. In an inverse problem, one can calculate the power map from an empirically measured temperature distribution and a heat spreading function using various de-convolution techniques. While the forward problem is analogous to image blurring, the inverse problem is analogous to image restoration.
assignees: UNIV CALIFORNIA SANTA CRUZ

title_en: Disaster state analysis system and method thereof using geographic information system
title_ko: 지아이에스를 이용한 재해 상황 분석 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: A system and a method of disaster state analysis using GIS(Geographic Information System) are provided to enhance availability of disaster analysis data by analyzing the disaster data of each sector to share the analyzed data with departments or local autonomous entities. A system of disaster state analysis using GIS comprises a general weather outlook database server(20), a past weather information database(30), a disaster state data server(40) and a disaster state analysis server(10). Each server is able to be connected each other through LAN or WAN. A weather information management server of a meteorological observatory is able to be used as the general weather outlook database server. The disaster state data server comprises a GIS database server(43) and a local disaster injury extent database server(41) and a restoration database server(45). The GIS database server is a part of a NGIS(National Geographic Information System). The restoration database server stores data committed into the disaster such as materials, apparatuses, the number of persons and time.

title_en: Electrical power failure related information provision system
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide electrical power failure related information including information of images and positions expressing the cause of power failure, restoration states, etc. to power consumers, a local government, and so on.  <P>SOLUTION: An electrical power failure related information provision system is provided with a portable terminal apparatus 1 for transmitting electrical power failure caused place site information and a server apparatus 3 for transmitting the received electrical power failure caused place site information and map information to a customer terminal 2 as the electrical power failure related information. title_en: Earthquake emergency control device for elevator
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To prevent the occurrence of such an accident that a car contacts tower equipment when restoring an elevator into a normal operation with automatic inspecting operation after earthquake, and surely prevent secondary disaster such as confinement or damage to the car or the tower equipment after restoration.  <P>SOLUTION: During earthquake, the car is stopped at the nearest floor to be out of service depending on the intensity and the quaking condition of the earthquake. When troubles are not detected with subsequent automatic inspecting operation, temporarily restoring operation is performed. This earthquake emergency operation device comprises a plurality of offset load detecting devices 4 installed on the floor of the car, and an offset load detecting device 16 for detecting the condition of offset load on the car from the output of the plurality of offset load detecting devices. When detecting the condition of offset load on the car during temporarily restoring operation, the operation of the elevator is stopped until the condition of offset load is resolved.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a game device which can compensate for not only a bet amount but also a game condition in an important phase even when a trouble such as a blackout occurs in the important phase in a game involving betting operations.  <P>SOLUTION: The game device includes: a judgment means for judging whether or not the kind of distribution of game media to a player and the order of distribution are fixed; a troubleshooting data storage means for storing troubleshooting data necessary for restoring a game condition in a nonvolatile storage medium at every checkpoint including at least a first timing when virtual game values owned by the player increases or decreases and a second timing when the kind of distribution and the order of distribution are fixed as the result of the game by the betting operation in a prescribed phase of a game as checkpoints; and a troubleshooting means for reading the troubleshooting data from the storage medium at the time of restoration including an outage during the execution of the game and for automatically restoring the game condition at the latest of the checkpoints on the basis of the troubleshooting data.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To carry out mirror finishing without a polishing flaw even on a silicon wafer and the like of a large area, and to improve the flatness of a disaster restoration system 16 by polishing the whole of the wide disaster restoration system 16 while applying uniform pressure.  <P>SOLUTION: While slury 26 mixed with diamond abrasive grains 24 is pressed from one surface 18 toward a second surface 20 of a porous plate 12 having a large number of continuous pores 22 communicating with the second surface 20 from the first surface 18, the second surface 20 is pressed against the disaster restoration system 16 of a polished material 14. title_en: Disaster prevention monitoring system
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To rapidly and properly perform treatment after site confirmation in operation of a fire sensor.  <P>SOLUTION: The fire sensors 18-1 to 18-n connected to a sensor line 14 from a receiver 10 are provided with information transmission/reception parts 20-1 to 20-n connected to a transmission line 16 from the receiver 10. title_en: Simulation determination method and simulation determination device for restoration operation procedure
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To easily discriminate whether a restoration operation procedure for a virtual accident is correct or not.  <P>SOLUTION: A load dispatching office sets the virtual accident and communicates the set virtual accident to a plurality of power relevant facilities. Each power relevant facility which receives the report of the virtual accident analyzes the content of the virtual accident to determine a time for executing a restoration operation to the virtual accident. All of procedure information of the restoration operations executed in the respective power relevant facilities is collected to the load dispatching office, and arranged into one restoration operation procedure. This is the executed restoration operation procedure which was actually executed, and collation of a recommended restoration operation procedure with combination examples thereof is performed. Whether a linkage mistake of the restoration operation procedure is minor or serious can be easily acquired by reporting the corresponding combination. Whether a wrong restoration operation procedure is executed as the procedure for restoring the virtual accident or not can be confirmed in a field where the restoration operation is actually executed.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Disaster tolerance switching method, system and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for switching disaster-tolerance, which includes the steps that: a disaster-tolerance client at a production side instructs a first database at the production side to write data in the cache into a first storage device at the production side and empty a log after the disaster-tolerance switching is started; the written data is synchronized from the first storage device to a second storage device at a disaster-tolerance side; a disaster-tolerance service terminal at the disaster-tolerance side makes a snapshot to the data in the second storage device; a second database at the disaster-tolerance side is started by using the snapshot, and the started second database carries out self-restoration operation according to the newly-generated log after being emptied. The invention also provides a disaster-tolerance switching system, a disaster-tolerance switching device at a service terminal and a disaster-tolerance switching device at the client. The invention shortens the restoration time of the database during the disaster-tolerance restoration period.

title_en: Power control system
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a power control system which prevents fire caused by flashing off to a leaked gas when power supply is recovered, and performs an automatic restoration of an electric power to an electric facility.  <P>SOLUTION: The system 1 is equipped with a first supply 5, a first circuit breaker 2 installed on the first supply 5, a controller 3 connected to the first circuit breaker 2 and an alarm annunciator 12, and a second circuit breaker 4 branched from an upperstream side than the first circuit breaker 2 on the first supply 5 and connected to the alarm annunciator 12 and the controller 3. In the system 1, the first supply 5 is automatically disconnected by the first circuit breaker 2 when a power interruption occurs due to disasters such as an earthquake and the like. When the power supply is recovered, the power is fed only to the alarm annunciator 12 and the controller 3. When the alarm annunciator 12 detects no gas leakage for a predetermined period of time, the controller 3 restores to open the first supply 5 interrupted by the first circuit breaker 2. On the other hand, the first circuit breaker 2 leaves the first supply 5 as interrupting when the gas leakage is detected.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Configuration system of computer system in which front server capable of continuing immediate online operation is arranged when large scale disaster occurs
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To immediately continue an online business without being influenced by conditions such as hard resources of a backup system and conditions and the like of system operations.  <P>SOLUTION: Functions of software is divided into a counter operation processing and processing except a counter operations and the hardware resources are hierarchized by a front SV and a backup computer. When a large scale disaster occurs, system restoration is performed by restoration levels. 1-3. At the restoration level. 1, two front SVs executes a single (virtual HOST) operation to stack transaction data, At the restoration level. 2, starting of operation of a 6 backup system is detected and the transaction data stacked by a 5 front SV is handed over to a backup system. Until processing of all the pieces of stacked transaction data is completed, the 5 front SV continues the single (virtual HOST) operation. By the restoration level. 3, a 9 backup system completes processing of all the pieces of stacked data to be restored to a state of normal operation.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

abstract_ko:

     이러한 수문권양장치에 의하면 수동수문과 자동수문을 선택적으로 개폐할 수 있어 자동수문이 개방되지 않아 발생할 수 있는 하천지역의 침수나 홍수의 피해을 사전에 예방할 수 있다.

title_ko: 전두부를 함유한 전두부 플레이크 제조방법
abstract_en: A method for preparing the whole dubu (bean curd) flake containing the whole dubu is provided to improve the restoration and the texture. A method for preparing the whole dubu flake containing the whole dubu comprises the steps of cutting the whole dubu; freeze-drying the cut one at -30 to -45 deg.C; maintaining the vacuum pressure of the freeze-dryer to 1x10~1x10^-2 Torr; and removing the residual moisture of the whole dubu loaded on a drying stand with maintaining the temperature of the drying stand to be 30-90 deg.C to make the dubu flake.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은, 전두부를 함유한 전두부 플레이크 제조방법에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 제조된 전두부를 일정규격으로 절단하고, 이를 급속동결한 후, 수분함량이 5% 이하가 되도록 진공건조하는 전두부를 함유한 전두부 플레이크 제조방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: System and Method for Providing Power Distribution System Information
abstract_en: A system, method and computer program product for processing utility data of a power grid is provided. In one embodiment, the system includes a datamart comprised of a plurality of physical databases storing utility data, a plurality of applications comprising an automated meter application configured to process power usage data from a plurality of automated meters, a power outage application configured to identify a location of a power outage, and a power restoration application configured to identify a location of a power restoration. The system may include an analysis engine comprising a plurality of analysis objects with each analysis object configured to process data to provide a specific analysis, wherein said analysis engine is accessible via one or more of the plurality of applications, and the system may include a report module configured to receive an output from the analysis engine and to output a report. The plurality of applications may also include a fault analysis application, a transformer analysis application, a theft detection application, a power flow application, a substation automation application, a load shed application and others.
assignees: KREISS DAVID G;BRANCACCIO DANIEL S

title_en: Self-healing control method for urban power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-healing method for urban distribution networks. The method comprises the following steps: (1) defining a system state function with respect to voltage, current, active power and reactive power, and setting ranges of a function value in an emergency state, a function value in a restoring state, a function value in an error state, a function value in an alert state and a function value in a safe state; (2) acquiring an electric capacity parameter;(3) calculating the function value of the state function, comparing the function value with the system set function values and carrying out related control processing steps according to the results of the comparison; (4) emergency control processing; (5) restoring control processing; (6) calibrating control processing; and (7) prevention control processing. The method carries out hierarchical control on the operation state of the urban distribution network and makes the urban distribution network be capable of self-prevention, self-restoration and handling extreme disasters and big power grid emergencies and improves the reliability of the urban distribution network.
assignees: STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;NANJING NARI CORP

title_en: System for fuzzy evaluation of underground gas pipe net risk
abstract_en: The utility model provides a system for a fuzzy assessment on the risk of the underground fuel gas pipe network, which comprises an information acquisition input end and an enterprise management end connected through the network; wherein, the information acquisition input end is arranged into a plurality of computers which can receive and output the test data related to a gas pipeline and the environmental data around the gas pipeline; the enterprise management end comprises a pipeline subsection management module, a management module of information around a pipeline section, a pipeline fuzzy risk assessment module, a pipeline risk pre-alarming module and an auxiliary management module; and the computers of the information acquisition input end are connected with the enterprise management end through the network. The  system for a fuzzy assessment on the risk of the underground fuel gas pipe network establishes an integrated underground fuel gas pipe network safety assessment system through a network connection of the information acquisition end and the enterprise management end and the cooperation of four modules of the enterprise management end by using the computer technology, thus realizing the goal of Tracking inspection-safety assessment-programmatic restoration, and changing a positive emergency repairing method of the gas leakage rescue into an active safe inspection and assessment management mode.

title_en: Power supply state collection system
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a power supply state collection system that is installed and operated easily and determines the point of cause of blackout and further comprehends a power supply state of an area easily and quickly.  <P>SOLUTION: A power meter 2 having a voltage detection relay 22 for monitoring the conduction state of a power line PL and a communication modem 23 for transmitting the monitor results from the voltage detection relay 22 to the outside is arranged on the power line PL on the power supplier side near the responsibility demarcation point between the consumer side and the power supplier side. A host computer includes a blackout task 44 and a restoration task 45 for collecting power supply state of respective consumers for each power supply system based on the monitor results transmitted from the power meter 2, and a determination task 46 for determining the point of cause of blackout based on the collection results.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&amp;INPIT

title_en: Information processing apparatus and data recovering method
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To restore a nonvolatile system status in power outage during power restoration after sudden power outage.  <P>SOLUTION: A backup unit 110 reads original data from a nonvolatile main memory unit 120 when a write access to the nonvolatile main memory unit 120 is detected, writes the data to the address of the nonvolatile main memory unit 120 after storing backup data in a nonvolatile backup memory 130, a commit unit 140 manages the backup data necessary for restoring the nonvolatile main memory unit 120, and a rollback unit 150 extracts the original data from the backup data stored in the nonvolatile backup memory 130, and stores the extracted original data in the address of the nonvolatile main memory unit 120 in rollback instructions. Then, the nonvolatile system status in the power outage is restored during power restoration after the sudden power outage by using the nonvolatile system status as an object for backup of the backup unit 110.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Communication terminal device, communication control method, and program
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a terminal capable of not imposing big load on a network apparatus such as a router and a switch, even if a number of the terminals carry out simultaneous activation from blackout restoration and the like.  <P>SOLUTION: The terminal comprises a notice information sending means and a delay control means. The notice information sending means sends out notice information such as a router solicitation message and an MLD (Multicast Listener Discovery) notification to a network apparatus at least in the case of activation of the terminal. title_en: Method and apparatus for communicating power distribution event and location
abstract_en: A system, device, and method of providing information for a power distribution system is provided. In one embodiment, a method of using a device that receives power from the low voltage power of the power distribution system and experiences a power loss during a local power outage may perform the processes of monitoring a voltage of the low voltage power line, detecting a voltage reduction below a threshold voltage for a predetermined time period, storing information of the voltage reduction in a non-volatile memory prior to the power outage, and transmitting a notification to a remote computer system prior to the outage. The monitoring may comprise making a plurality of measurements of the voltage during a time interval and averaging the plurality of voltage measurements. In addition, the method may include transmitting an alert message upon power up after the outage to indicate a power restoration local to the device.

title_en: Electromotion type valve apparatus for restoration of power failure
title_ko: 정전복구용 전동식 밸브장치
abstract_en: An electric-powered valve apparatus for the power outage recovery is provided to control the flow of fluid smoothly by safely opening and closing a valve or rotating the valve at location value which is set up in advance. An electric-powered valve apparatus(100) comprises a motor(70), a valve position sensor(90), a data storage module(20), a panel(60), an I/O controller(110), a power supply unit(180) and secondary cell unit(220). The data storage module stores position data. The panel comprises a display(50), a valve closing switch(30), and a valve opening switch(40). The I/O controller is connected to a microprocessor(10) and performs the input/output control. The panel comprises a forward/reverse direction controller(130), an external terminal(120), a power supply unit(150), a power outage detecting circuit(170) and a power stabilizing circuit(160). The secondary cell unit comprises a charge circuit(190), and a secondary cell(200) and a DC/DC converter(210). The charge circuit is connected to the secondary battery. The DC/DC converter supplies the drive power of the motor.
abstract_ko:

title_en: Power outage management and power support restoration for devices in a wireless network
abstract_en: Techniques for power outage management and power support restoration for devices in a wireless network are disclosed herein. Such a wireless network may include a number of bi-directional nodes in bi-directional wireless communication with one or more central nodes. Each bi-directional node may have a wireless communication path to one of the central nodes that is either a direct path or an indirect path through one or more intermediate bi-directional nodes serving as relays. Each bi-directional node may be configured to detect when it has become stranded such that it can no longer communicate with its assigned central node via its assigned communication path, to determine a reason for its stranding, and to transmit a stranding notification and the reason therefore.
assignees: ELSTER ELECTRICITY LLC

title_en: The device of multiple using a cold and warmth mattress not to use electricity
title_ko: 전기를 사용하지 않는 냉온겸용 매트리스 장치
abstract_en: A combined cooling and heating mattress device without using electricity does not use an electric heating coil to make it not necessary to pay electric charges due to the consumption of electricity, prevent an electromagnetic wave from being generated, and remove a fire risk due to overheating of the mattress device. A combined cooling and heating mattress device without using electricity comprises: a foldable device body which is divided into a head part(1-a), a back part(1-b), and a leg part(1-c); storage spaces(3,3-1) for the cold and hot water containers, which are formed in the back part and leg part of the device body, and in which the cold and hot water containers are stored; covers(2,2-1) covering the storage spaces for the cold and hot water containers; magic tapes(4,4-1) adhered onto edge portions of the covers to fix the covers to the back part and leg part of the device body; magic tapes(5,5-1) adhered onto the back part and leg part of the device body correspondingly to the magic tapes adhered onto the covers; sewing lines(6,6-1) formed on the device body to fold the device body in three stages; cold and hot water containers(7,7-1); lids(7-a,7-a-1) of the cold and hot water containers; double anti-frost cases(8,8-1) for summertime; and restoration sponges(9,9-1) filling the storage spaces when the cold and hot water containers are not used.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 전기를 사용하지 않는 냉온겸용 매트리스 장치에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 온수나 얼음 등을 이용하여 온열 또는 냉기 매트리스를 계절에 관계없이 사용할 수 있도록 하는 전기를 사용하지 않는 냉온겸용 매트리스 장치에 관한 것이다. 
     상기의 문제를 해결하기 위해 본 발명은 첫째, 전기를 사용하지 않아 전기료가 발생 되지 않게 하고 둘째, 전기 발열코일을 사용하지 않아 전자파의 발생 소지가 없고 셋째, 전기 발열코일을 사용하지 않아 화재의 위험성을 근본적으로 없애고 넷째, 온수 코일이나 모터장치를 사용하지 않아 소음이나 고장의 소지를 없애고 다섯째, 계절에 관계없이 냉온겸용으로 사용 할 수 있게 하고 여섯째, 실외나 야외에서도 사용할 수 있게 하며 일곱째, 사용 후 남은 냉 온열을 이용하여 타 용도로 전이하여 사용할 수 있는 전기를 사용하지 않는 냉온겸용 매트리스 장치를 제공하고자 하는데 그 목적이 있다. 
     상기의 목적을 달성하기 위해 본 발명은, 전기를 사용하지 않고 고온을 유지하기 위하여서는 제공된 냉온수통에 온수를 채워 매트리스 특정 부분을 제외한 공간에 삽입한 후 덮개를 덮고 온열 매트리스로 사용하는 단계, 상기 단계 후 제공된 냉온수통의 온수를 익일 아침 세면 또는 샤워를 하는 단계, 전기를 사용하지 않고 냉기를 유지하기 위하여서는 제공된 냉온수통에 냉수나 음료수를 채워 얼리거나 드라이아이스를 채워 매트리스 특정 부분을 제외한 나머지 부분의 공간에 삽입한 후  덮개를 덮고 냉기 매트리스로 사용하는 단계, 상기 단계 후 제공된 냉온수통의 얼음이 반쯤 녹았을 때 냉수나 냉 음료수를 음용하고, 남은 얼음을 이용하여 다른 탄산음료, 주스, 주류 등을 부어 차게 한 후 음용하는 단계, 상기 단계를 이용할 시 제공된 냉온수통의 외부 표면에 성애가 생겨 매트리스 특정 부분을 제외한 나머지 부분인 냉온수통이 들어가는 부분에 습기가 머금지 못하도록 조처하는 성애 방지용 이중 케이스를 사용하는 단계로 이루어진 것에 특징이 있다. 
     상기의 특징으로 하여 본 발명은, 전기를 사용하지 않아 전기료가 발생되지 않고, 전자파의 발생 소지가 없고, 화재의 위험성이 근본적으로 없으며, 온수코일이나 모터 등의 장치를 사용하지 않아 제작비가 저렴하고 고장의 여지없이 반영구적으로 사용할 수 있고, 계절에 관계없이 냉온겸용으로 사용할 수 있고, 실내외 및 야외에서 모두 사용 할 수 있고, 사용 후 남은 냉 온열을 이용하여 타 용도로 전이하여 사용 할 수 있어 에너지를 거의 버림 없이 고 효율적으로 사용할 수 있게 하는 효과가 있는 전기를 사용하지 않는 냉온겸용 매트리스 장치이다.

title_en: Superhigh speed permeability paving system and construction method for the prevention of flood, drought, global warming, desertification, elevation of sea level and for the recovery of the underground water
title_ko: 홍수, 가뭄, 지구 온난화, 사막화, 해수면 상승 방지 및 토양지하수 복원을 위한  초고속 투수성 블록 도로포장 시스템과 그 시공 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A superhigh speed permeable block road pavement system for flood, drought, global warming, desertification, sea level lift prevention, underground water restoration and a construction method thereof are provided to filter oil, tire dust, and heavy metals with a decontamination mat installed on a floor under a surface layer and a ground. CONSTITUTION: A superhigh speed permeable block road pavement system for flood, drought, global warming, desertification, sea level lift prevention, underground water restoration is composed of a fabricated structure block(20), a retention tank(52), a water tank(51), a pollution prevention bottom mat(53), a gravel layer(54), a pollution prevention upper mat(55), a sand layer(56), and a surface layer block(10). The retention tank stores water on the top of a ground(50) and passes away water. The water tank stores the water. The pollution prevention bottom mat covers the upper surface of the fabricated structure block. The gravel layer is piled up on the upper surface of the pollution prevention bottom mat. The pollution prevention upper mat covers the top of the gravel layer. The sand layer is spread on the top of the pollution prevention upper mat. The surface layer block is piled up on the sand layer. The plural surface layer blocks are connected each other by an upper longitudinal groove of both S-type connections and a projection.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 홍수, 가뭄, 지구 온난화, 사막화, 해수면 상승 방지 및 토양지하수 복원을 위한  초고속 투수성 블록 도로포장 시스템과 그 시공 방법에 관한 것으로서, 투수 기능이 탁월한 고성능 투수 포장 블록을 사용하여 도로 및 도로주변 넓은 면적의 유출수를 포장 면 하부로 투수시키고, 투수된 유출수를 포장 면 하부에 저류 및 저수 용량이 큰 조립식 구조물을 구조물용 블록을 적층 시공하여 지반과 지중으로 침투, 확산시키거나 별도의 저수공간으로 송수 처리하도록 한 것으로, 특히 투수성 블록 자체 공간에도 상당량의 물을 저장 및 저류 할 수 있어 도로상에 내리는 강우는 물론 주변 토지로부터 유출되는 우수를 도로에 포설된 블록 배수홀을 통해 집수할 수 있고 단위 면적당 구조물 공간을 확대할 경우 일정면적의 도로에서도 도로보다 2~100배 이상의 넓은 면적의 우수를 저장, 저류할 수 있어, 바다로 유출되는 우수를 지반 내에 가둘 수 있고 표층 블록 하부 바닥 및 지반에 설치된 오염제거 매트로 기름, 타이어 분진, 각종 중금속이 걸러지게 되어 깨끗한 우수를 지하 공간에 가두는 효과를 얻을 수 있는 홍수조절, 가뭄 방지, 수자원 보존, 해수면 상승 방지 및 토양지하수 복원의 효과가 있다.

title_en: An engineering wood for cultural assets restoration
title_ko: 문화재복원용 목재
abstract_en: PURPOSE: Timber for a cultural assets restoration is provided to reduce manufacturing time and cost, and to enhance preservation property of the timber. CONSTITUTION: Timber for a cultural assets restoration is manufactured by mixing 5~60wt% of polyethylene glycol, 2~20wt% of antiseptic including copper, chrome, an arsenide-based compound, zinc, and fluorine, and 2~20% of flame retardant represented by aluminum hydroxide, for 100 weight of water using an ultrasonic wave emulsification. The timber is precipitated into this solution after processing the timber for 15 minutes using the ultrasonic wave.
abstract_ko:
문화재는 소중한 우리 문화유산으로 그 유지와 복원의 중요성은 시간이 흐를수록 증대된다. 복원용으로 사용되는 목재는 금강송으로 대표되는 형질이 우수한 목재를 사용하지만 이렇게 우량한 목재도 보존성을 향상시키기 위하여 보존성유지에 필요한 여러가지 처리를 한다. 
     과거에는 팔만대장경의 예에서 보듯이 바닷물에 절여 삼투압에 의해 목재를 치밀하게 만들었지만 현대의 기술은 플라스틱물질을 목재조직 내의 공극 속으로 주입시켜 보존성을 향상시킨 것을 특징으로 한다. 
     폴리에틸렌글리콜(Polyethyleneglycol, 이하 PEG)처리는 목재의 색에도 영향을 미치지 않고, 생체실험에도 사용할 만큼 안정된 물질이며, 낮은 온도에서도 액상으로 되기 때문에 보존처리에 많이 이용하지만 장기간에 걸쳐 농도를 5％씩 서서히 높여가야만 하는 단점이 있었다. 또한 문화재용목재에 PEG를 처리한 후에 미생물로 인한 목재의 열화 등을 방지하기 위한 방부처리와 화재 등을 예방하기 위한 난연처리는 별도로 시행하여 작업과정이 복잡하고 인력과 자원이 많이 소요되었다. 
     초음파는 목재 조직 내의 수분을 빼내 목재의 강도를 단단하게 만들어 주는 효과와 PEG의 침투를 도와주는 효과가 있다. 또한 약품의 혼합도 도와주는 효과가 있다. 
     본 발명에서는 초음파의 장점을 이용하여 문화재보호용 목재에 사용하는 PEG와 방부제, 난연제를 미리 초음파로 혼합하고 이 혼합용액을 초음파로 목재에 주입 함으로써 3번의 절차를 한번으로 줄여서 시간을 단축하고 절차를 대폭 간소화하여 인력과 자원을 절감하면서도 소기의 목적을 이룰 수 있는 방법을 제공하고자 한다. 
     초음파로 혼합약제를 주입하여 PEG를 목재세포내로 침투시켜 외관상으로는 목재의 색이나 형상에 변화를 주지 않고도 기존목재보다 수분저항성이 높으면서도 난연성이 6배나 증가시킬 수 있는 문화재 복원용 목재의 제조가 가능하다. 
     이 목재는 문화재보호용 뿐만 아니라 통나무집과 같은 다른 목조건축물의 자재 용도로도 사용이 가능하다. 
       
     문화재복원, Polyethyleneglycol, 초음파, 난연제, 방부처리, 난연처리

title_en: Restoration ability recovering device of the ship and car carrier with the same
title_ko: 선박의 복원력 회복 장치 및 이것을 구비한 자동차 운반선
abstract_en: [PROBLEMS] To provide a righting moment recovery apparatus for a marine vessel that takes conventionally required measures to ensure the stability in the event of damage in the marine vessel. [MEANS FOR SOLVING PROBLEMS] The righting moment recovery apparatus for the marine vessel is characterized in that a remotely openable seawater leading means is provided on a bottom layer watertight flat (5a) which forms a void space (8) at a bottom of the marine vessel. Consequently, in the event that seawater flows into the marine vessel due to damage of ship-side outer plates or the like on the marine vessel, seawater flowing into the marine vessel can be led to the void space (8) by opening the seawater leading means provided on the bottom layer watertight flat (5a). As a result, the void space (8) which is usually served as an enormous backup buoyancy can be made to function as a kind of seawater ballast tank, thereby allowing the righting moment of the marine vessel to be recovered.

abstract_en: A power outage restoration system manages a power grid including a plurality of switching devices. title_en: Disaster recovery data sync
abstract_en: Various embodiments for failure recovery in a computing environment following a data restoration are provided. A catalog locate is performed for each of a plurality of data sets on a base catalog structure (BCS), identifying a plurality of BCS entries. If a first BCS entry is cataloged incorrectly, the first BCS entry is designated to be re-cataloged. The plurality of BCS entries is compared with a plurality of volume table of contents and a plurality of VSAM volume data set (VTOC/VVDS) entries. If a second BCS entry found in the plurality of BCS entries is not found in the plurality of VTOC/VVDS entries, and the second BCS entry indicates that a data set associated with the second BCS entry is located on a volume, an attempt is made to vary on the volume. If the volume cannot be varied on, a request is created to restore the volume.

title_en: Wireless type alarm
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To complete a wireless disaster prevention system by considering the case when an alarm such as a fire sensor is installed at a place where any wireless wave does not reach.  <P>SOLUTION: According to the combination of a wireless communication part 26, a wired input part 34 or a wired output part 38, a transmission selection part 54 selects only a wireless output, or a wired input and a wireless output, or only a wired output, or the wired input and a wired output. An internal event processing part 56 makes, when detecting abnormality by itself, the wireless communication part or the wired output part selected by the transmission selection 54 output an event signal showing abnormality to the outside. An external event processing part 58 makes, when accepting the event signal from the other wireless type alarm through the wired input part 34, the wireless communication part 26 or the wired output part 38 selected by the transmission selection part 54 output the event signal from the other wireless type alarm to the outside. Thus, it is possible to achieve remote restoration control or test control by a bi-directional transmission function.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Apparatus of road safety block

abstract_en: PURPOSE: A road restore block is provided to enable provisional passage by installing sub base layer materials and facilitate the collection of existing materials during pavement restoration. CONSTITUTION: A road restore block(100) comprises a unity protrusion, a unity groove, and a compaction part. The unity protrusion mutually couples blocks in the traverse direction, wherein the upper side of a block body is projected in the lateral direction. The unity groove is formed to mount a unity protrusion on the opposite side of the block body. The compaction part compacts the bottom of the construction field. abstract_en: The utility model discloses a communication base station monitoring extension system, which comprises a PC server. title_en: Method for realizing emergency traffic of debris flow silted road section by adopting bearing umbrella
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing emergency traffic of a debris flow silted road section by adopting a bearing umbrella, wherein the bearing umbrella has the structure that: it includes: the device comprises a metal rod, high-strength waterproof cloth, an anchoring bolt and an exhaust valve; the high-strength waterproof cloth is enclosed into a round table with a closed upper bottom surface and an opened lower bottom surface; the metal rods are arranged in the direction of the circular truncated cone generatrix, the plurality of metal rods are uniformly distributed on the side surface of the circular truncated cone, and the length of each metal rod is the same as that of the circular truncated cone generatrix; the anchoring bolt is arranged at the center of the upper bottom surface of the circular table, and the exhaust valve is arranged at a position close to the anchoring bolt on the upper bottom surface of the circular table; the bearing umbrella can be folded. The invention also discloses a method for realizing the emergency traffic of the debris flow silted road section by adopting the bearing umbrella. The beneficial technical effects of the invention are as follows: the method is suitable for emergency restoration of road traffic of the debris flow silt-buried road section, can effectively shorten the time of road traffic break of the debris flow silt-buried road section, and can restore traffic generally within 2-3 days when the debris flow stops moving.

title_en: Method for restoring building construction with bottom frame posts damaged by vibration
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for restoring a building construction with bottom frame posts damaged by vibration. The method comprises the following steps of: firstly, determining a bottom layer or a lower collapse layer of the building construction as a vibration isolation layer according to the vibration damage condition of the building construction, then arranging a lifting jack (10) between a frame girder (12) of the vibration isolation layer and a foundation, jacking up a basically intact structure (6) at the upper part horizontally, afterwards cutting off each frame post (7) of the vibration isolation layer a section the length of which is greater than the height of a vibration-isolation supporting seat (1), increasing horizontal and vertical reinforcing steel bars, enhancing restoration, installing the vibration-isolation supporting seat (1) at a truncation position, reinforcing a girder post joint (5) of the vibration isolation layer, disassembling the lifting jack (10), varnishing the inside and the outside and then putting into use. The method can be used for the reinforcement and the restoration of the building construction with the frame posts damaged by vibration at the bottom layer after a disaster and the basically intact structure at the upper part and has the advantages of convenient construction, definite mechanism, economy and high applicability.
assignees: UNIV GUANGZHOU

title_en: Piping device for restoring inclination of building
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide piping for infusion beforehand, so that fluid such as cement milk is infused into the bottom of a mat foundation whose pressure lifts a building for restoration when the building sinks and tilts by the influence of an earthquake, ground water, and its own weight.  <P>SOLUTION: A plurality of pipes (2) are planned and provided beforehand on the bottom of the mat foundation (1) of the building, and infusion passages of the fluid (3) are prepared and secured. When the building sinks and tilts later, the fluid (3) such as the cement milk is pressure-injected through the pipes (2). Then the building is elevated by an amount corresponding to the sinking by the pressure. In this manner, piping fixtures are attached and placed so that the subsidence and tilt of the building can be easily restored.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT
assignees: SAKAMOTO YOSHIO

title_en: Self-adaptive data restoration, analysis and distribution system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a self-adaptive data restoration, analysis and distribution system, belonging to a part of a weather-eye environment monitoring and disaster early warning system. A high-reliability cluster server system is used to process data transmitted back from monitoring points distributed in field and to distribute the data to a monitoring center for the use of an early warning system and mobile monitoring personnel. Since no high-bandwidth channel exists in partial field areas and MMS or SMS signaling channels can be used only for transmission, the data is required to be compressed, encoded or documented before transmission. After the data is received, restoration processing is conducted to the data first, then uniform formatting processing is conducted to the data, and finally analysis processing, sorting processing, storage processing and distribution processing are conducted to the data. The format of the distributed data also supports mobile communication network (3G) transmission and MMS and SMS signaling channel transmission other than HTTP format.
assignees: TELE UNION BEIJING COMM TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Information transmission/reception system, apparatus for moving object and information transmission/reception method
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an information transmission/reception system acquiring the restoration status of a road when a disaster occurs in details and in real time, and guiding a route corresponding to the restoration status.  <P>SOLUTION: The information transmission/reception system includes an information distribution organization for distributing disaster-stricken road information indicating the damaged road and an apparatus for a moving object. The apparatus for the moving object includes a disaster-stricken road information acquisition part for acquiring disaster-stricken road information, a display, a position detection part, and a route guide for guiding a route. The system further includes a route guide control part for indicating an impassable road at the display on the basis of the disaster-stricken road information and controlling the route guide to guide the route excluding the impassable road. The system further includes a passing information transmission part for transmitting passing information indicating a passed road and vehicle size information to the information distribution organization. The information distribution organization updates the disaster-stricken road information on the basis of the received passing information and size information and distributes the updated disaster-stricken road information.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Disaster-relieving multifunctional universal folding table and chair
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster-relieving multifunctional universal folding table and chair, which has the novel characteristics that: chair back connecting plates are replaced by slotted flat rods and are locked on a back plate by transverse rods and transverse pins; armrest plates are replaced by four parallel connecting rods, can be folded and locked tightly and can be collected and folded by diagonal pulling wires; scroll bars can be drawn out and detached to be used independently; the function of making various table and chairs, beds, ships, rooms and the like is retained and improved; and the table and chair can be folded quickly to leave all ground space for using an original one-room and multifunctional dinning hall, auditorium or teaching room as a dance hall, a working plate, an assembly place and the like instantly, so that indoor and outdoor completely barrier-free spaces are provided for multiple purposes. In addition, the chair is extremely convenient in folding and transportation, quick in modification, restoration, assembly and disassembly and convenient in use and can vary greatly; and the chair can create great actual profits and benefits, enlighten and pull innovation of enterprises and people as an example and promote the building of a learning-oriented, innovation-oriented and research-oriented society considerably.

title_en: Distribution network failure isolation and quick power service restoration decision support system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power network safety operation, and in particular relates to a distribution network failure isolation and quick power service restoration decision support system. The system is connected with a distribution automation system, comprises a real-time subsystem, a simulation subsystem, an accident inversion subsystem and a knowledge generating subsystem, and acquires power network operation monitoring data from the distribution automation system through a data interface, automatically tracks the real-time operating state of the power network, can quickly provide a power supply restoration scheme and intuitive simulation effect for a dispatcher to determine a proper restoration sequence after a failure happens, and provides accident simulation and accident inversion function; and the subsystems can be subjected to interface switching. The system is suitable for a distribution network which has a complicated network structure and of which the failure cannot be treated by automation equipment.

title_en: Method for searching non-continuity position of embedded conduit
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To promptly search for a non-continuity position of an embedded conduit, thus attaining step-by-step early restoration of conduit circulation upon earthquake disaster.  <P>SOLUTION: The method includes: the process (S1) of connecting a vibration generator to a ground branch pipe of an embedded conduit and vibrating the embedded conduit through the ground branch pipe; the vibration detection process (S2) of detecting vibration generated from the embedded conduit on the ground surface along piping of the embedded conduit from a branch position of the ground branch pipe; and the non-continuity position estimation process (S3) of estimating a position where a continuous detection vibrating level is discontinuous in the vibration detection process to be on a non-continuity position of the embedded conduit.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Disaster recovery support system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a recovery support system, capable of attaining rapid recovery work by labor-saving or automating field survey and preparation operation of a plan document required for recovery construction at a disaster.SOLUTION: The disaster recovery support system uses a GIS (geographical information system) including a storage device which stores drawing data and three-dimensional measurement image data for original form facilities before occurrence of the disaster in a target area, three-dimensional measurement image data after occurrence of the disaster in the target area, and quantity-unit price data linked with a structure in the drawing data of the original form facilities. The drawing data includes a plan view with symbol in which structures are shown by performance management models obtained by classifying performances to several types of models for each process. An estimation affected sediment amount necessary for restoration to original form is calculated from difference information for the three-dimensional measurement data before and after the disaster to form an after-disaster integrated control diagram, and plan document data is formed with respect to a facility designaged by a user in the after-diaster integrated control diagram.

title_en: Apparatus of road safety panel
title_ko: 도로복구판넬
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A road recovery panel which can be rapidly and conveniently transferred is provided to enable pedestrian to pass through a sidewalk by safely covering a construction filed. CONSTITUTION: A road recovery panel comprises the panels formed in order to install on a floor(20) between the both cut parts of pavement(10). The panel is composed of a lower panel(100) and an upper panel(200). The lower panel adheres closely to a floor between both sides of a package. The upper panel is placed on the lower panel with a plurality of ribs formed in horizontal or vertical directions and covers both sides of the package.
