title_en: Method for recovering environment of river's incline
title_ko: 하천 경사면의 생태를 친환경적으로 복원하는 공법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An environmentally-friendly restoration method of the ecosystem on a river slope surface is provided to offer an environmentally friendly growing member for growing plants on the river slope surface. CONSTITUTION: An environmentally-friendly restoration method of the ecosystem on a river slope surface comprises the following: measuring the angle and the water flow speed of the river slope surface to be restored; flatting the river slope surface; laminating gabion(15), ecosystem restoration soil(17), a natural fiber net(19), and aggregate(21) serially on the river slope surface; and installing more than two vegetation-nets(9a) on the upper side of the laminated materials.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 하천 경사면의 생태를 친환경적으로 복원하는 공법에 관한 것으로, 내부가 비어 있으면서 길이 방향으로 연장되고 둘레면이 망 형태로 이루어진 망체와, 상기 망체의 내부에 채워져 망체를 통해 삽입된 씨앗이 뿌리를 내리는 충전 부재, 상기 망체와 충전 부재 사이에 끼워져 망체 내부에 채워진 충전 부재가 망체 바깥으로 빠져나오지 못하도록 하는 충전 부재 보호천으로 이루어진 식생망을 2개 이상 구비하고, 복원하고자 하는 하천 경사면의 침수 정도와, 하천을 따라 흐르는 물의 유속, 하천 경사면의 경사각을 조사하는 제 1 단계와, 들쭉 날쭉하게 튀어나온 하천 경사면을 평평하게 정리하는 제 2 단계를 구비한다. 또한, 본 발명은 하천 경사면을 하천 경사면의 높이에 따라 2개 이상의 구간으로 분할하는 제 3 단계와, 2개 이상의 식생망을 일체로 결합하고, 상기 식생망을 제 1 구간과 제 2 구간의 최상단에 적층시키는 제 4 단계를 더 포함하는바, 상기 제 3 단계는 최하부에 위치한 하천 경사면의 제 1 구간에 돌망태와, 생태 복원토, 천연 섬유 네트(net), 및 골재를 순차적으로 적층하고, 상기 제 1 구간의 상부에 위치한 하천 경사면의 제 2 구간에는 돌망태와, 생태 복원토, 천연 섬유 네트, 및 골재를 순차적으로 적층하는 과정을 포함한다. 이러한 구조로 이루어진 본 발명에 따른 하천 경사면의 친환경 생태 복원 공법은 하천 경사면에 식물 군락을 형성함으로써 하천 경사면의 미관을 아름답게 할 뿐 아니라, 하천 경사면이 더 이상 침식되지 않도록 할 수 있다. 또한, 생태 복원 공사에 환경 친화적 자재를 이용함으로써 환경을 보호할 수 있으며, 하천 경사면의 높이에 따라 적층 되는 구성 물질을 달리함으로써 복원 공사에 필요한 자재를 최대한 절약할 수 있다. 또, 본 발명은 생태 복원토를 적층물의 하부에 배치함으로써 식생망으로부터 뻗어나온 식물 뿌리가 하천 경사면상에 자리를 두고 자랄 수 있도록 한다.
assignees: HANDONG R & C CO LTD;KOREA NEW TECHNOLOGY INDUSTRY CO LTD;SC CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Driving apparatus for elevator at disaster
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a driving apparatus for an elevator at disaster, capable of avoiding stopping of services of all elevators to be group-controlled even when minor failure is detected at one of the elevators to be group-controlled during long duration of a temporary restoration state of the elevator.  <P>SOLUTION: A control part 33 for a supervision apparatus installed in a supervision center 3 built in a remote place distant from buildings 11-11n in which elevators 112-1n2 are installed collects information of operating states of the elevators from monitoring terminals 111-1n1 connected with the respective elevators in the buildings and, if it is determined according to the collected information that any elevator whose restoration state is temporary is group-controlled with the elevators of a predetermined number or more, transmits a group control operation separation command to the monitoring terminals 111-1n1 for detecting operating states of the elevators.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT
assignees: HITACHI BUILDING SYS CO LTD

title_en: Road restoration block
title_ko: 도로복구블록
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a road restoration block for covering eliminated pavements during various road constructions conducted by eliminating some of or the entire existing road pavements, and more specifically, to a road restoration block, which can quickly and safely cover the eliminated pavements by providing blocks that are simply carried, disposed, and disassembled with strong coupling power to the upper part of the eliminated pavements so that people and cars may pass even when the constructions are in progress, thereby providing a safe and pleasant construction environment by preventing the traffic congestion caused by the constructions.; Further, the invention may maximize cost reduction for construction companies by preventing the increase of construction costs and waste of resources caused by temporary pavement works (provisional pavement works) that are currently in operation, and improve the construction quality and prevent poor construction. Consequently, the invention promotes reduction in the national budget, and is usable for emergent road restoration in case of national disaster and thus the safety and wealth of people can be protected.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 기존 도로 포장의 일부 또는 전체를 제거하여 시행하는 각종 도로 공사에서 제거된 포장면을 커버하기 위한 도로복구블록에 관한 것으로서, 구체적으로 제거된 포장면 상부에 운반 및 설치, 해체가 간편하면서도 강한 체결이 가능한 블록을 설치하여 제거된 포장면을 신속하고 안전하게 커버하여, 공사를 수행하는 중에도 사람 및 차량의 통행을 가능하게 하여 공사로 인한 교통 정체발생을 차단하여 안전하고 쾌적한 건설환경을 제공하고, 현재 시행하고 있는 임시포장(가포장) 또는 이중포장으로 인한 자원 낭비 및 공사비 증가를 방지하여 건설사 원가 절감을 극대화시키고, 공사의 품질을 향상시키고 부실공사를 방지하므로 궁극적으로 국가예산 절감을 도모하며, 국가재난시 도로 응급복구용으로도 사용이 가능하여 국민의 안전과 재산을 지킬 수 있도록 한 도로복구블록을 제공하려는 것이다.
assignees: SUNWOO LIM

title_en: Disaster response system for disaster response vehicles and respond method for disasters using therefor
title_ko: 위성망 기반 차량용 재해 대응 시스템 및 이를 이용한 재해 대응 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A disaster response system for disaster response vehicles, and a responding method for disasters using the same are provided to promptly construct an emergency communication network which supports the restoration of power facility by sending an emergency satellite vehicle having mobility to a disaster spot. CONSTITUTION: A satellite communication device(110) searches a satellite repeater(200) through a DVB-S signal confirmation method, and transmits and receives information to and from a central local system by using a TDM(Time Division Multiplexer) mode and/or a TDMA(Time Division Multiple Access) mode. An image transmission device(120) is connected to a satellite communication device through an Ethernet hub(150), photographs and outputs an image for a disaster spot, and transfers the photographed image to the satellite communication device. A wall box(130) includes plural terminals connected to the power facility located in the disaster spot by being installed at a disaster response vehicle. A digital TRS(Trunked Radio System) base station includes a TDMGW(141) which converts a protocol for digital TRS into an Ethernet protocol.
abstract_ko: 영상송출과 디지털 TRS 기지국장치 장애 발생시 긴급 복구기능까지 갖추도록 한 재해 대응 차량용 재해 대응 시스템 및 이를 이용한 재해 대응 방법이 제시된다. 제시된 재해 대응 차량용 재해 대응 시스템은, 재해 대응용 차량에 설치되는 재해 대응 시스템에 있어서, DVB-S 신호 확인방식을 통해 위성중계기를 탐색하고, 탐색된 위성중계기를 통해 TDM 및 TDMA 중에 하나의 방식으로 중심지구국시스템과 정보를 송수신하는 위성통신장치; 이더넷 허브를 통해 위성통신장치와 연결되고, 재해 지역에 대한 재해 영상을 촬영하여 출력하고, 촬영한 재해 영상을 위성통신장치로 전송하는 영상송출장치; 재해 대응용 차량에 설치되어 재해 지역에 위치한 전력설비와 연결되는 다수의 단자가 형성된 월박스; 및 이더넷 허브를 통해 위성통신장치와 연결되고 월박스를 통해 전력설비와 연결되고, 디지털 TRS용 프로토콜을 이더넷 프로토콜로 변환하는 TDMGW를 구비하는 디지털 TRS 기지국 장치를 포함한다.
assignees: KOREA ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: Disaster restoration assistance system of elevator
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a disaster restoration assistance system of an elevator capable of grasping the disaster situation of the elevator at an early stage when an earthquake occurs, and easily setting the area for preferentially collecting information on the elevator and easily changing the setting thereof.  <P>SOLUTION: Collection of information on elevators to be transmitted to a communication control device 3 via a communication line 2 from remote monitoring terminals 1 of the elevators installed in areas A-E is started by the command of a control unit 41 of a server device 4 when an earthquake occurs, and when the predetermined time is elapsed, the control unit 41 calculates the operational ratios QA-QE of seismometers of the elevator in the areas A-E. With reference to the database 42 of the server device 4, the control unit 41 sets the monitoring preference to the areas A-E or changes the setting based on the operational ratios QA-QE of the seismometers. For example, when the disaster situation of the elevator is grasped in an early stage, the monitoring preference in the area in which the operational ratios of the seismometers are relatively high is raised. If any wasteful patrol of a restoration worker is reduced, the monitoring preference in the area in which the operational ratios of the seismometers are relatively low.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT
assignees: HITACHI BUILDING SYS CO LTD

title_en: Combined emergency bridge and erection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention puts forward a combined emergency bridge and an erection method thereof which are designed for solving the problems that in the prior art, the quick restoration on the traffics at the gap positions of highway subgrades and the derogative areas of subgrades is realized by way of building shortcuts, therefore, the restoration is restricted by terrain conditions and affected by secondary geological disasters, meanwhile, the restoration is long in time, time-consuming, labor-consuming and the like. The combined emergency bridge comprises cubic steel frames, triangular prism-shaped steel frames, bearing wire cables, fixing wire cables and road slabs. The combined emergency bridge and the erection method thereof have the following beneficial effects: the bearing wire cables and combined steel frames of the bridge constitute a statically indeterminate self-bearing structure system, horizontal pressures produced by the steel frames are transmitted to the ends of the bridge, and the loads of the triangular prism-shaped steel frames are balanced by the tension of the bearing wire cables; the steel frames of the combined emergency bridge provided by the invention can not be fabricated on site, and the fabrication of the steel frames can be standardized and serialized; and the erection method of the combined emergency bridge is simple without carrying out excessive treatments on disaster sites, therefore, the method has the characteristics of emergency, speediness and convenience.
assignees: CHEN HONGKAI;HE XIAOYING;TANG HONGMEI

title_en: Disaster information providing system and disaster information providing method
abstract_en: A correlation unit (15) correlates earthquake disaster information issued by an administrative agency, an autonomous entity, or the like with base station data including position information of a base station. A base station priority order calculation unit (16) gives a priority order for a restoration countermeasure to the base station in the event of an earthquake disaster, based on the result of the correlation by the correlation unit (15) and the estimated number of users existing under the base station. The calculated priority order of the base station is displayed on a display unit (30). In this way, the base station can be easily given a priority order based on the earthquake disaster information issued by the administrative agency and the autonomous body.
assignees: NTT DOCOMO INC

title_en: Waterproof sheet-type inundation prevention device
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a waterproof sheet-type inundation prevention device which enables a waterproof sheet to be rapidly and simply housed in a pit in the vertical attachment of the waterproof sheet and restoration to an existing state thereof.  <P>SOLUTION: This waterproof sheet-type inundation prevention device includes the pit 1 for housing the waterproof sheet, door stoppers 2 and 2 which are provided on both the sides of the pit 1, respectively, and the waterproof sheet 3, the lower edge of which is fixed to the pit 1 and both the side edges of which have a width allowing contact with the door stopper. A pipe 4, which has both ends protruded from the side edges of the waterproof sheet 3, is attached to an upper edge of the waterproof sheet 3; a protrusive streak 3a is formed on the off-premises side of the waterproof sheet 3; and an appropriate number of fixing pin insertion holes 3b are vertically provided in the protrusive streak 3a. Fixing pins 5 for being engaged with the fixing pin insertion holes 3b are implanted in the door stoppers 2 and 2, respectively; U-shaped waterproof sheet holders 6 and 6, the upper portions of which are provided with retainer portions 2a and 2a for pipe ends 4a and 4a and which are provided with protrusive streaks 6a for being engaged with the insides of the protrusive streaks 3a and 3a of the waterproof sheet 3, are screwed; and the door stoppers 2 and 2 are provided with tightening fittings 7 and 7 for the waterproof sheet holders 6 and 6, respectively.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT
assignees: DAIDO KIKO KK

title_en: Embedded piping structure, pile structural body, and application method
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an embedded piping structure including a pile structural body suitably used for restoration of water supply pipes, fire extinguishing facilities, and the like in an earthquake, the pile structural body, and a method for applying the pile structural body into ground.  <P>SOLUTION: The pile structural body 220 included in the embedded piping structure 200 includes an intake 222 arranged near embedded piping (206, 208, 210) and taking fluid therein, an internal channel leading fluid flowing in from the intake 222, a discharge opening 302b provided at a head part 300 of the pile structural body and discharging fluid flowing in the internal channel to an outside of the pile structural body, an earthquake sensing structure 350 detecting vibration of set intensity or higher, and a light emitting means 350 emitting light in response to detection of vibration by the earthquake sensing mechanism. The embedded piping structure 200 also includes an external channel forming means 224 surrounding embedded piping and forming an external channel G leading fluid leaking from the embedded piping to the intake of the pile structural body.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT
assignees: SUZUKI KAZUO

title_en: Power restoration management method and system
abstract_en: A power restoration method and system. The method includes receiving by a computer processor of a computing apparatus, a signal indicating that a power outage has ended and that an input voltage signal used for powering power consumption devices at a first specified location power will be enabled. The computer processor disables input voltage signal connections to the power consumption devices and detects that the input voltage signal is enabled. The computer processor enables a first input voltage signal connection associated with a first power consumption device and monitors a frequency signal associated with the input voltage signal. The computer processor generates frequency level data comprising a frequency level of the frequency signal and compares the frequency level to a predetermined frequency level value. The computer processor generates results data comprising results of comparing the frequency level to a predetermined frequency level value.
assignees: BOSS GREGORY JENSEN;HAMILTON II RICK ALLEN;HAUGH JULIANNE FRANCES;SAND ANNE R;IBM

title_en: Method and device for seismic strengthening of shape memory alloy pipe networks
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and device for seismic strengthening of shape memory alloy pipe networks, and the method and device provided by the invention are used for reducing the tensile stress and bending stress of pipelines in earthquakes, dissipating the earthquake input energy, decreasing the earthquake reaction of pipe networks and protecting the pipe networks from being damaged and destroyed under the action of the earthquake. The device provided by the invention is composed of pipelines, a fixed connecting piece flange, a pipeline flange, a pipeline connecting bolt, a shape memory alloy bar and a shape memory alloy bar connecting bolt, wherein the pipelines are connected with the pipeline flange; the pipeline flange is connected with the pipeline connecting bolt; the fixed connecting piece flange is positioned at two sides of the pipeline flange, and is connected with the shape memory alloy bar; and the shape memory alloy bar is connected with the shape memory alloy bar connecting bolt. The method and device provided by the invention have the advantages that the earthquake input energy is dissipated, the pipeline earthquake reaction is decreased, and the nonoccurrence of damage and destroy of the pipelines under the action of earthquake is prevented; and after the earthquake, because the shape memory alloy has the capability of self restoration, the deformation of the pipelines is reset automatically without any maintenance and replacement.
assignees: HARBIN INST OF TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Anti-seismic damping bridge support
abstract_en: Aims to improve the anti-seismic performance and avoid the post-quake adjustment procedures, the utility model provides an anti-seismic damping bridge support. The anti-seismic damping bridge support comprises a pair of an upper anchor plate (10) and a lower anchor plate (20) which are vertically arranged at an interval and are parallel to each other, and is characterized in that a top basin (11), a bottom basin (21) and a support body (22) are further included, wherein the top basin (11) is fixedly arranged on the upper anchor plate (10), the bottom basin (21) is fixedly arranged on the lower anchor plate (20), the support body (22) is arranged between the top basin (11) and the bottom basin (21), and sliding friction pairs are formed between the support body (22) and the top basin (11) as well as between the support body (22) and the bottom basin (21). The utility model has the benefits that self-restoration is realized, so as to avoid the post-quake adjustment procedures; the structural stress is optimized, so as to prolong the structure service life and prevent earthquake and other natural disasters from destructively damaging a bridge structure; and the anti-seismic damping bridge support can greatly reduce the construction costs, and is convenient to mount and maintain.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY ERYUAN ENG GROUP

title_en: Seismic strengthening device of shape memory alloy pipe network
abstract_en: The utility model provides a seismic strengthening device of a shape memory alloy pipe network, which can reduce tensile stress and bending stress of a pipeline under an earthquake, dissipate input energy during the earthquake, reduce earthquake response of the pipe network, and protect the pipe network from being damaged under earthquake action. The seismic strengthening device comprises a pipeline, flanges of fixed connecting parts, a pipeline flange, a pipeline connecting bolt, a shape memory alloy rod and a connecting bolt for the shape memory alloy rod, wherein the pipeline is connected with the pipeline flange, the pipeline flange is connected with the pipeline connecting bolt, the flanges of the fixed connecting parts are positioned on two sides of the pipeline flange, the flanges of the fixed connecting parts are connected with the shape memory alloy rod, and the shape memory alloy rod is connected with the connecting bolt for the shape memory alloy rod. The seismic strengthening device can dissipate the input energy during the earthquake, reduce the earthquake response of the pipeline and protect the pipeline from being damaged under the earthquake action. After the earthquake ends up, as shape memory alloy has the self-restoration capability, the deformation of the pipeline can be restored automatically without any maintenance and replacement.
assignees: ANXIN GUO

title_en: Radio disaster prevention system and sensor node
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To appropriately perform event supporting processing by suppressing the time delay to a requisite minimum when an urgent event such as fire reporting to send early or fire restoration occurs during telegram transmission.  <P>SOLUTION: In occurrence of an event A, a transmission processing part of a radio sensor repeats, twice or more, telegram transmission A1-A3 for continuously transmitting the same telegram signal for a predetermined time T1 and telegram pause for pausing the telegram transmission for a predetermined time T2. When an urgent event B occurs during repetition of the telegram transmission A1 and the telegram pause based on the occurrence of the preceding event A by the transmission processing part, a transmission switching part repeats, once, the telegram transmission A1 and the telegram pause based on the preceding event A and pauses them, then switches them to the repetition of the telegram transmission B1, B2, etc. and the telegram pause based on the urgent event B.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT
assignees: HOCHIKI CO

title_en: Radio disaster prevention system and sensor node
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To appropriately perform event corresponding processing by preventing the information lack when state change of a fire and restoration occurs between telegram transmission and telegram pause based on an occurring event and the state change returns by the next telegram transmission timing.  <P>SOLUTION: In occurrence of an event A, a transmission processing part of a radio sensor repeats, twice or more, telegram transmission A1-A6 for continuously transmitting the same telegram signal for a predetermined time T1 and telegram pause for pausing the telegram transmission for a predetermined time T2. When a fire reporting event B and fire restoration event C occur before start of the next telegram transmission in a state where the telegram transmission A1 and A2 and the telegram pause are repeated based on the occurrence of the preceding event A by the transmission processing part, a transmission switching part repeats, at least twice, telegram transmission B1 and B2 based on the fire reporting event B, and then switches them to transmission where telegram transmission C1 and C2 and the telegram pause based on the fire restoration event B are repeated at least twice.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT
assignees: HOCHIKI CO

title_en: Disaster prevention receiver
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a disaster prevention receiver capable of reducing the stress of an operator by displaying information related to progress in a time of starting or in time of restoration of the disaster prevention receiver itself to make the operator acquire the state of the disaster prevention receiver.  <P>SOLUTION: The disaster prevention receiver 100 includes: a starting processing part 191 performing the prescribed starting processing of the disaster prevention receiver 100; an output means outputting various kinds of information related to the starting processing; and a progress information output part 193 outputting the information related to the progress of the starting processing through the output means when the starting processing is performed by the starting processing part 191. The disaster prevention receiver includes a plurality of output means according to processing items of the starting processing. The progress information output part 193 outputs information which is information related to the progress of the starting processing and indicates the presence/absence of the execution of processing related to the processing item of the starting processing through the output means corresponding to the processing item of the starting processing.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT
