title_en: Operation management device, operation system, and definition data synchronization method
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To reduce the time required for restoration in a disaster recovery system.  <P>SOLUTION: The DR system 8 is provided with a primary system data center 2 and a DR data center 6. The primary system data center 2 and the DR data center 6 are connected by a network 4. The DR data sensor 6 is configured to backup the primary system data center 2. A DR management server 14 of the DR data center 6 is configured to acquire primary system definition data 18 having definition on a job in the primary system data center 2 from the primary system data center 2, and to filter the acquired primary system definition data 18 according to necessity in the DR data center 6, and to update DR definition data 20 having definition on a job in the DR data center 6 by using the primary system definition data 18 filtered.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT
assignees: NOMURA RES INST LTD

title_en: Backup interactive method based on remote on-line data disaster tolerance and system for executing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a backup interactive method based on remote on-line data disaster tolerance and a system for executing the method. The system comprises a server platform side, a client side, an on-line backup web side and an on-line backup safety service module, wherein, the server platform side comprises a backup engine server, a WEB restore engine server, a medium engine server, a web server and a database engine server; the client side comprises a data source service module, a data encryption and decryption module, a data service module, a shortcut Shell functional module and a platform backup module; the on-line backup web side is used for the users to carry out an on-line data backup and restoration request, and the web side is connected with the server platform side and the client side through a public network; and the on-line backup server module is distributed in the server platform side, the client side and the on-line backup web side.
assignees: LIAONING GOETHINK TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Aluminum electrolysis cell emergency short circuit power outage device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an aluminum electrolysis cell emergency short circuit power outage device. The device comprises a group of anode guide rods (1) which are connected with a cuboid bus bar (3) through a group of bus bar soft belts (2), and the cuboid bus bar (3) is connected with a short circuit block (5) through short circuit bus bar soft belts (4). During a cell leakage accident of an aluminum electrolysis cell, the device can serve as an emergency tool for the short circuit accident cell for a rapid power restoration of an aluminum electrolysis cell series within a short time, so as to minimize the influence of the cell leakage accident on production, and avoid the phenomenon that the breakdown of other aluminum electrolysis cells due to long-time power outage leads to larger loss.
assignees: GUIYANG AL & MG DES INST CO

title_en: Rubber concrete energy dissipation and shock absorption device of super high-rise steel structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rubber concrete power consumption damping device of super high-rise steel construction, the device include the steel pipe, the steel pipe outside be provided with anti-oxidant flame retardant coating, the steel pipe inboard is provided with rubber concrete layer. The utility model has simple structure and safe and convenient use, and mainly utilizes the plastic deformation of the steel pipe after yielding to play the energy dissipation role; simultaneously, before the steel pipe yields, the rubber concrete layer part of the device enters the plastic state in advance, also can consume a large amount of seismic energy and be unlikely to damage this device, thereby can consume a large amount of energy through this device temporarily when powerful earthquake comes and reduce the destruction of major structure, also can not influence the inside service function of major structure during the restoration.
assignees: UNIV QINGDAO TECHNOLOGICAL

title_en: Pressure reduction and energy saving method for communication power supplies
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pressure reduction and energy saving method for communication power supplies and aims at providing a method to reduce float charge supply voltage of the communication power supplies. The method is used to reduce power consumptions of communication equipment. The method includes the following steps that: a storage battery pack is divided into a main storage battery pack and an auxiliary storage battery pack, wherein the storage battery pack is formed by 24 storage batteries which are connected in series; a main charger and an auxiliary charger are correspondingly parallelly connected with the main storage battery pack and the auxiliary storage battery pack; a load and a directional diode are parallelly connected with two ends of the main storage battery pack to form a float charge power supply circuit, wherein the load is connected in series with the directional diode; a normally open contact of a relay is connected between a cathode and the load of the storage battery pack so as to form a discharge circuit; a controller is used to monitor conditions of power restoration and power outage, wherein the controller is connected in the float charge power supply circuit and the discharge circuit; the controller controls a motion of the relay according to the conditions of the power restoration and the power outage. By using the invention, a requirement of load working voltage can be satisfied, charging quality of the storage batteries can be guaranteed, the power consumptions of the load during float charge power supply can be reduced. The method of the invention is an ideal method which can be used to reduce the power consumptions of the communication equipment.
assignees: ENRONG LUO

title_en: A kind of production method of root key
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of root key production method meeting power industry power information key management system demand.In the production process of root key, use true random number component and the hybrid operation of pseudo random number component, the mode of circulation encryption produces the root key of power industry power information key management system demand, adopt key components local backup and Restoration Mechanism and M? of? N coding techniques carries out key remote backup and Restoration Mechanism two kinds of modes, these two kinds of cipher key backup and Restoration Mechanism complement one another, both facilitate user to carry out backup and the recovery of key, effectively can resist again the catastrophic failure that fire, earthquake etc. cause power information acquisition system root key.This invention meets the key management system root key producing method of current main-stream, has adaptability widely; User's property of participation is strong, and the backup of key and Restoration Mechanism are considered comprehensively, can really meet user's user demand.

title_en: High-performance foam mortar filling method for mine stope
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-performance foam mortar filling method for a mine stope. The method comprises the following steps of: adding a foaming agent into dilution water in a foaming and mixing device to prepare foaming solution; feeding compressed air into the foaming solution to form bubble flow; and then constructing an upper stope and a deep stope respectively according to conditions of the mine stope. In the method, under lubrication action of dense foams which are not interconnected with one another, the using amount of cement in unit cubic meter can be averagely reduced by over 20 percent, the using amount of water can be reduced by over 35 percent, the filling efficiency can be improved by over 20 percent, the firmness rate is enhanced from below 70 percent at present to over 95 percent, and the comprehensive filling cost is reduced by over 10 percent; furthermore, the segregation phenomenon of materials is eliminated essentially; overflowing water is avoided in an underground filling body; as the foam light soil is applied to a foam mortar filling body which is filled in the stope, multiple effects of improving the whole quality of the filling body, reducing the filling cost, improving an underground working environment and the like can be achieved; therefore, the method has great significance for sustainable development of mineral resources, environment restoration and disaster prevention and reduction.
assignees: SHENZHEN ZHONGJIN LINGNAN NONFERROUS METAL CO LTD FANKOU LEAD ZINC DEPOSIT;UNIV GUANGZHOU;GUANGDONG SHENG RUI CIVIL TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent distribution board, distribution device, power outage countermeasure system and distribution method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To realize avoidance of an effect on a power supply system, and power supply from a dispersed power to a load at the time of power outage, and power supply automation from the power supply system at the time of power supply restoration.SOLUTION: The power outage countermeasure system comprises: first switching means (electromagnetic switch 42) which supplies power to a specific load (12B) connected to a power supply system (electric power system 10) and which blocks the power supply system at the time of power outage of the power supply system; second switching means (electromagnetic switch 44) which connects a dispersed power to the load and supplies power to the load from the dispersed power after the first switching means blocks the system; the power supply system which blocks the second switching means and unblocks the first switching means, and then restores the power supply therefrom to the load at the time of power supply restoration.
assignees: NF CORP

title_en: Storage device, controller and control method of storage device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a storage device, a controller and a control method of the storage device, capable of backing up with high disaster resistance and guaranteed ordering.SOLUTION: A storage device includes: data storage means for storing first data stored in first storage means in second storage means; saving means for reading a data group from the second storage means and saving it in third storage means corresponding to the status of use of the second storage means; data group output means for outputting the data group stored in the second storage means to a copy destination device connected communicable with the self device; restoration means for storing the data group saved in the third storage means in two or more pieces of the second storage means that are not in use; and suspension means for outputting all the data group already stored in the second storage means to the copy destination device, suspending the output of the data group to the copy destination device and shifting to a suspension state when an instruction of suspension is received.
assignees: FUJITSU LTD

title_en: Opening/closing device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an opening/closing device whose problem caused by manual operation during a power outage can be corrected.SOLUTION: An opening/closing device comprises: an opening/closing body 10 for opening/closing a closing-direction end thereof by sliding; a rotational drive source 31 for driving the opening/closing body 10 to open/close; a power restoration detection means for detecting a power restoration after a power outage; and a full-closure detection part 34 for producing a full-closure detection signal when the opening/closing body 10 is in a fully-closed position, with the opening/closing body 10 being opened/closed by control of the rotational drive source 31, the opening/closing body 10 is opened when a closing command is produced after the power restoration is detected by the power restoration detection means, the opening/closing body 10 is closed after a predetermined period of time from the opening operation, and the closing operation is stopped on condition that the full-closure detection signal is produced.
assignees: BUNKA SHUTTER

title_en: Method and system for outage restoration
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To efficiently perform management of electric power grid including scheduling of switching and maintenance process at power outage.SOLUTION: A system for maintenance and operation of electric grid includes a work crew team locator configured to receive a location of a work crew team based on a location of a work vehicle associated with the work crew team, a work crew team management subsystem configured to receive locations of some of a plurality of the work crew teams from the work crew team locator, and an asset management subsystem configured to determine repair requirements for electric grid assets and repair times associated with the determined repair requirements. The system also includes an outage management subsystem that determines occurrence of power outage by using a phone to indicate an obstacle/notify a fault; and a restoration optimizer configured to determine a qualified crew to execute the change request, tools and equipment required to achieve the change request, and a capable work crew team including work crew team location determined to satisfy a response timing requirement in order to respond to a grid configuration change request, and initiate crew instructions specified in work requirements and actions for the work crew team to fulfill the grid configuration change request.
assignees: GEN ELECTRIC

title_en: Asphalt concrete paving block
title_ko: 아스콘포장블록
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An asphalt concrete paving block is provided to prevent poser construction by improving the quality and function of the block. CONSTITUTION: An asphalt concrete paving block is composed as follows. Nonslip rough parts(300) are formed on the surface of the block. The corners of the block are rounded. A groove for guiding rainwater to the outside is formed in the block. An asphalt emulsion is spread to gaps between the blocks and cuts off rainwater. Fixing and tamping protrusions are formed in the bottom of the block to prevent the block from moving.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 신규 아스팔트 도로포장 공사나 도로굴착복구 아스팔트 도로포장 공사에서 사용하는 아스팔트콘크리트, 일명 아스콘 재료의 일부 또는 전체를 폐아스콘을 재활용하거나, 신규 아스콘을 블록으로 성형하여 기존 아스팔트 포설 장비 인 휘니셔,각종 로울러,등 많은 장비의 사용없이 아스팔트 포장 밀도,강도 등 재료의 품질확보와 함께 포설하는 아스콘 포장블록에 관한 것으로서, 구체적으로 기존기계투입 포장 아스콘공사를 인력으로도 쉽게설치 할수있게 하여  공사원가를 획기적으로 줄이어 국가예산을 절감하고, 아스콘 포장공사 방법상 기층 포설 후 표층 포설 하기전까지 토사 되메우기 후 다짐작업의 많은 시간과 비용이 투입되는바, 아스콘 기층을 블록성형화 하여 설치하면 아스콘 표층 포설 전까지 차량의 통행하는 자체하중으로 인하여 자연적 다짐이 발생 되고,차량의 통행도 가능하게 되어 다짐장비 사용비의 절약은 물론 도로포장공사중 차량통행금지나,차량정체로 인한 국가적 에너지 절약이 실천되어 국익에 경제적 효과와 민원이 획기적으로 개선될 것이다. 그리고, 수거된 폐아스콘을 재생처리하여 사용할 경우 폐기물처리비용의 막대한 경제적 손실을 억제하고, 도로 아스콘 포장공사로 인한 국가적 예산을 절감시켜 이로인한 경제적 가치는 실로 막대할 것이다. 또한, 현재 시행하고 있는 임시포장(가포장) 또는 이중포장으로 인한 자원 낭비 및 공사비 증가를 방지하여 건설사 원가 절감을 극대화시키고, 공사의 품질을 향상시키고 부실공사를 방지하므로 궁극적으로 국가예산 절감을 도모하며, 국가재난시 도로 응급복구용으로도 사용이 가능하여 국민의 안전과 재산을 지킬 수 있도록 한 도로복구블록을 제공하려는 것이다.
assignees: LIM SUN WOO

title_en: Rubber compaction block
title_ko: 고무 다짐 블록
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A rubber compaction block is provided to reopen the passage of pedestrians or vehicles after a road construction by simply and safely covering road pavement. CONSTITUTION: A rubber compaction block comprises a main body(100) formed with a filling groove of specified depth, a filling part(200) composed of a filling frame(210) with a charge groove which is depressed opposite to the filling groove, a filler(300) inserted in the charge groove of the filling part, and a compaction part(400) with a compaction plate(410).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 기존 도로 포장의 일부 또는 전체를 제거하여 시행하는 각종 도로 공사에서 제거된 포장면을 커버하기 위한 고무다짐블록에 관한 것으로서, 구체적으로 제거된 포장면 상부에 운반 및 설치, 해체가 간편한 블록을 설치하여 제거된 포장면을 신속하고 안전하게 커버하여, 공사를 수행하는 중에도 사람 및 차량의 통행을 가능하게 하여 공사로 인한 교통 정체발생을 차단하여 안전하고 쾌적한 건설환경을 제공하고, 견고한 다짐 기능을 제공하여 안전하고 신뢰성이 향상된 공사를 시공할 수 있도록 하고, 부실공사를 방지하며 기존에 이중적으로 투입되었던 공사비를 절감하며, 현재 시행하고 있는 임시포장(가포장) 또는 이중포장으로 인한 자원 낭비 및 공사비 증가를 방지하여 건설사 원가 절감을 극대화시키고, 공사의 품질을 향상시키고 부실공사를 방지하므로 궁극적으로 국가예산 절감을 도모하며, 재활용 자재의 사용으로 자원 낭비를 막고, 환경파괴를 줄일 수 있으며, 국가재난시 도로 응급복구용으로도 사용이 가능하여 국민의 안전과 재산을 지킬 수 있도록 한 고무다짐블록을 제공하려는 것이다.
assignees: LIM SUN WOO

title_en: Feeder fault handling method
abstract_en: The invention introduces a feeder fault handling method, which comprises the following steps of: 1) conducting online search and locating a feeder fault; 2) conducting network topology analysis to draw a conclusion; 3) finding out the section of the fault; 4) searching for the boundary switch of the fault section and making a fault isolation plan; 5) defining non-fault power outage areas; 6) making power supply restoration plans for outage areas on the upstream side and the downstream side of the fault; 7) conducting safety evaluation to the downstream power supply restoration plan; and 8) executing the plans according to the safety evaluation obtained at the step 7. The feeder fault handling method has the advantages that: 1) the method is suitable for the automatic construction of feeders of a power distribution network which is wired in any way; 2) the practicability is high, the impedance parameters of the equipment of the distribution network are not required and the power flow calculation module is not required to be called; and 3) the power supply restoration can be separately conducted to the non-fault sections, so as to reduce the power outage range and decrease the power outage duration as much as possible.
assignees: SCIENCE RES INST HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;BEIJING SIFANG AUTOMATION CO

title_en: System for multi-phase management of a natural disaster incident
abstract_en: A computerized system for multi-phase management of a natural disaster incident is disclosed. In one embodiment of the invention, the computerized system incorporates a pre-incident risk reduction management module, a crisis response management module, and a restoration and rehabilitation management module to correspond to these three distinct phases of managing a natural disaster incident. This multi-phase natural disaster management system can be utilized by private entities, community groups, state, national, and/or international agencies to assist prevention or reduction of damage to human and natural resources in a particular disaster incident. Furthermore, the multi-phase natural disaster management system can assist or enable protection of lives, health, and safety of community members and disaster incident response personnel. A prioritization model in the pre-incident risk management module can take an empirical or subjective weighting factor in evaluating a particular geographic section to optimize disaster prevention and management.
assignees: DAUS STEVEN J

title_en: Integrated management system of ecological water for multiple water resources and method using the same
title_ko: 다중 용수원을 활용한 생태용수 통합관리시스템 및 이를 이용한 관리방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An ecology water integrated management system utilizing plural water sources and management method using the same are provided to offer additional services by utilizing a monitoring result. CONSTITUTION: A water treatment apparatus(80) supplies water by receiving the water from plural water sources(10, 20, 30, 40, 50). A monitoring apparatus(11, 21, 31, 41, 51) measures information about the quality and quantity of water in restoration target water or the water sources. A calculation control apparatus(61) analyzes the quantity and quality of water received from the water sources through a measured value. The calculation control apparatus controls the calculation control apparatus according to a simulation result.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 실개천, 하천, 연못 또는 호수 등의 수체를 생태적 친환경적으로 복원하거나 복원된 수체를 관리하기 위해서 필요한 생태용수를 확보하는데 있어서, 생태용수를 적정하게 확보하는 과정의 의사결정을 지원하고, 수량 및 수질의 통합적인 관리방법을 제공하는 네트워크화된 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로서, 생태적 친환경적으로 복원하고자 하는 실개천, 하천, 연못 또는 호수 등 대상 수체의 현황을 조사하고, 생태용수로 활용이 가능한 여러 용수원의 수량 및 수질에 대한 현황을 모니터링하고, 생태적 친환경적으로 복원하고자 하는 하천이나 호수에서 복원대상으로 하는 생물종을 하나 또는 복수로 선정하고, 생물종의 생애주기에 따라 변화하는 해당 생물종에 적합한 하천의 수리적, 수질적 관리기준을 결정하고, 복원된 수체에서 사전에 설정된 하나 또는 복수의 모니터링 지점의 수리적, 수질적 상태가 대상 생물종에 적합한지 여부를 검토하고 평가하는 방법을 제공함으로써, 복원의 대상이 되는 수체에 필요한 생태용수를 적정하게 확보하는 과정의 의사결정을 지원하고, 수량 및 수질의 통합적인 관리가 가능한 네트워크화된 장치 및 방법을 제공할 수 있는 이점이 있다.
assignees: KOREA INST CONSTRUCTION TECH

title_en: Intercom system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To notify a control unit of abnormality of a commercial power supply by detecting it in an early stage, before the operation of an intercom master unit surely stops due to blackout of the commercial power supply.SOLUTION: Abnormality of a commercial power supply is detected with an early power supply abnormality detection circuit 12 at a timing earlier than the detection timing with a blackout detection circuit 11 which detects blackout of commercial power supplies 2, 2, ... for supplying power to intercom master units 1a, 1b, ..., which is notified to a control unit CPU40 of a control unit 4 from a master unit CPU14. The control unit CPU can confirm such power conduction state as the abnormality of commercial power supply restores so that the voltage level of a DC power source, detected with the blackout detection circuit, restores to a threshold level or higher after restoration to the power conduction state, as well as such blackout state of commercial power supply as the voltage level of the DC power source detected with the blackout detection circuit is less than the threshold level as before.
assignees: AIPHONE CO LTD

title_en: Device and method for adjusting electricity consumption of a plurality of lighting devices of a lighting system
abstract_en: The invention is based on the idea that control of power consumption in a system comprising power consuming devices like lighting devices, for example, can be performed by dividing the power consuming devices of the system into a plurality of groups and by taking into account power consumption or load shedding or restoration capability for each group. Further, the invention implements an auction mechanism for adjusting power consumption or load in the lighting system such that an effective, fast, user requirements considering and lighting device functions and characteristics considering adjusting is achieved.
assignees: ZHAO MENG;KONINKL PHILIPS NV

title_en: Slope greening restoration method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for restoring slope greening, which is characterized in that a slope protection technology is combined with an ecological protection technology and an engineering protection technology. Firstly, according to the geological condition and the stability of the side slope, the stability of the side slope is ensured or increased by adopting an engineering protection technology according to actual needs; then combining natural factors such as local climate, geological landform, vegetation, land condition and the like, and adopting an ecological protection technology. The active protection system of the protection net takes a steel wire rope net as a main component and covers (actively protects) the steel wire rope net to prevent and control various slope surface geological disasters, avalanche, bank slope scouring and other hazards. The slope protection technology organically combines engineering protection technology and ecological protection technology. The method has the advantages of simple process, no need of excavation, quick construction, convenient operation, less environmental disturbance, controllable quality, low cost, long service life of a protection system, quickest elimination of the threat of geological disasters and the like.
assignees: HANGZHOU LANDSCAPE GARDEN ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Remote power outage and restoration notification
abstract_en: Power outages and restorations at customer premises can be automatically detected and reported. A method includes receiving, from a network terminal, a first notification associated with a power outage; retrieving location information associated with the network terminal; sending a second notification indicating that the outage has occurred and that includes the location information associated with the network terminal; retrieving prior outage information that corresponds to a set of network terminals associated with a group of set top boxes; determining that an outage event is triggered, when a quantity of outages is greater than a threshold, where the quantity of outages is based on the outage and other outages obtained from the prior outage information; and sending a third notification based on the determination that the outage event is triggered, where the third notification includes information associated with the quantity of outages that enables a server to remedy the outage event.
assignees: MEYNARDI ALESSANDRO M;DUBOIS JEAN F;DOEHRING MARTIN;CHENG C P;VERIZON PATENT & LICENSING INC

title_en: Push-in fastener and fixing structure using the same
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a fixing structure which enhances earthquake resistance of a building skeleton made of wood structure material subject to deformation and vibration causing removal of a fastening nail, breaking from a nail hole, enlargement of a nail hole, and reduction or loss of surface pressure holding power, high heat insulation, and high airtight performance of ventilation furring strips.SOLUTION: A fixing structure using a push-in fastener 5 enables a foam synthetic resin plate 1 to be firmly fixed to a structural skeleton 4, so that intrinsic advantages such as shock absorbing property, visco-elasticity, and stress dispersibility can be utilized to a maximum extent, while material mechanical defects such as softness, weak resistance to a concentrated load, and inclination to local breakage are sealed or conquered. The fixing structure allows an entire wall surface of the structural skeleton to maintain excellent heat insulation property for a long period of time. The foam synthetic resin plate 1 functions as an absorber of seismic energy and as a restoring body of the absorbed seismic energy to make elastic deformation and elastic restoration, exhibiting quake resistance or seismic control property for a long period of time.
assignees: KAWAI TAMOTSU

title_en: Distribution network device status evaluating system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network device status evaluating system which comprises a device status information acquisition module, a device status information ETL module, an intelligent device status evaluation module, a device status management module, a repair schedule optimization module, a knowledge base module and a dynamic presentation module, wherein the device status information acquisition module uses a monitoring device to obtain various types of status information of a distribution network device; the device status information ETL module screens and processes device status information data to form data which can be used by the device status evaluation module; the intelligent device status evaluation module diagnoses the device status in accordance with the various types of status information of the distribution network device; the device status management module judges whether the distribution device needs to repaired in accordance with the information of the intelligent device status evaluation module; the repair schedule optimization module comprehensively optimizes a repair schedule based on repair time and load transfer paths; and the knowledge base module stores diagnosis algorithm configuration information and diagnosis results of the intelligent device status evaluation module. The distribution network device status evaluating system can provide the optimized device repair schedule, save the device repair cost and resources, and improve the operation and maintenance level and working efficiency of the distribution network system.
assignees: HUAI AN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;JIANGSU FANGTIAN POWER TECH CO

title_en: Computer generation method for summer short-term load prediction in power consumer electricity utilization information acquisition system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a computer data processing method, particularly a computer data restoration method for a power user electricity consumption information acquisition system, the key points of which are: (1) preprocessing historical electricity load and temperature data; (2) Establish a correlation model between summer temperature and electricity load Where m, n are parameters, and ν is the residual set; (3) Calculate the correlation coefficient ρ between summer temperature and load; (4) Based on summer temperature data and its correlation with load, considering the dependence of the predicted data on the previous week's values, the final load forecast value is obtained. The present invention provides a short-term forecasting method for summer electricity load with high accuracy and strong practicality.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Handheld system for information acquisition, verification, recording, processing, display and communication
abstract_en: A portable system and method that automates collection, integration, analysis, reporting and archiving of data and collection and archiving of specimens in a variety of applications while insuring chain of custody integrity not attainable conventionally. Applications include: forensics, municipal management, utility management, real estate, insurance, environmental protection and remediation, safety, security, education, emergency management, land use, fish and wildlife management, construction and maintenance of highways and waterways, mining, timber, agricultural, resource exploration, manufacturing, recreational management, urban restoration, military, and archaeological preservation. Select embodiments integrate a number of functions in a handheld device, employing digital technology, integrated sensors, marking, tracking and monitoring tags, and specialized software as well as processors for analysis, such as CPUs, ASICs, PCs and the like. Select embodiments are useful to increase efficiency and reduce cost for post-processing and real-time data and specimen collection, reporting, analysis, and facilitate pro-active direction of ongoing field studies.
assignees: BJORNBERG DAVID B;BRITT JOHN T

title_en: Mobile disaster chattel restoration unit
abstract_en: A mobile disaster restoration unit designed to facilitate cleaning efforts by a crew at a disaster recovery site. The mobile unit comprises a modified trailer designed to be parked by a restoration service provider at a disaster site long term. The trailer is modified to include a storage bin, a cleaning room with a variety of cleaning equipment for use by the restoration crew, and a swing office for combined use of the restoration crew, insurance claims adjuster, and homeowner. The cleaning room stocks an array of restoration equipment including a commercial dishwasher and sink, an ultrasonic cleaning tank, shop vac, etc., all powered by a solar-charging battery bank. The mobile disaster restoration unit avoids the need to pack and transport the contents of a disaster-stricken home or building (after a fire or flood) to a commercial cleaning facility. Instead, all cleaning can be done expeditiously onsite.
assignees: BENFIELD JASON P;VON HENDRICKS II BURNELL F

title_en: Output estimation method and output estimation device for photovoltaic power generation
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To implement output estimation for photovoltaic power generation more easily with few sensors than in a conventional way.SOLUTION: The output estimation method for photovoltaic power generation includes: a step for measuring changes in active power and reactive power at an observation point 50b provided on the more upstream side than a plurality of photovoltaic power generation devices PV1-PV3 and a plurality of load devices LD1-LD6 connected to a distribution system 1; a step for calculating a restoration signal by independent component analysis using data of active power and reactive power measured at the observation point 50b; and a step for estimating a change in active power totally consumed at the plurality of load devices LD1-LD6 based on the restoration signal and a change in the active power totally output from the plurality of photovoltaic power generation devices PV1-PV3.
assignees: KANSAI ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV OSAKA PREFECTURE

title_en: Comprehensive fault processing platform and method for power distribution and consumption network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a comprehensive fault processing platform and method for a power distribution and consumption network, and belongs to the technical field of power grid management. The platform comprises a fault information acquisition system, a fault information research and judgment system and a fault first-aid repair power supply stopping information pushing system; the method comprises the steps of collecting repair fault information, line fault information and acquisition fault information in an existing 95598 system, a distribution automation management system and a power utilization information collection system, receiving and checking the information, then carrying out equipment positioning, fault information screening, line topology analysis, equipment operation information analysis and line switch analysis, determining fault types, places and influence areas, displaying the fault types, the places and the influence areas in the existing GIS, guiding fault repair according to determined fault results, and simultaneously pushing fault power failure information and power restoration information to a user. The platform and the method realize the centralized collection and the automatic pre-judgment of the existing fault information, can also actively push the power failure and power supply recovery information to the user, and can interact with the user.
assignees: NANJING POWER SUPPLY CO JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;JIANGSU SUYUAN HIGH TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Aggregated Real-Time Power Outages/Restoration Reporting (RTPOR) In a Secure Mesh Network
abstract_en: Embodiments of the invention provide systems and methods for the reporting of status changes, such as but not limited to power outages and/or power restorations, throughout a smart grid system. Through the use of location-based reporting period selection and/or status change report aggregation, embodiments may provide efficient reporting processes that timely and accurately report status change information from the point(s) of the change to a back-end system via an access point.
assignees: VEILLETTE MICHEL;TRILLIANT HOLDINGS INC

title_en: Disaster recovery using mirrored network attached storage
abstract_en: A system, architecture for initializing and utilizing a mirrored Network Attached Storage (NAS) system is described. The architecture includes a plurality of processing layers that define and control the operation and relationship of component groups in a primary NAS and associated component groups in a secondary NAS. The groups may include, for example, file server groups and disk device groups. The processing layers may include an execution layer, a transaction layer and a storage layer. The modularized architecture of the invention allows NAS systems to be easily apportioned into logical groups at varying levels of granularity with varying relationships. As a result, the component groups are abstracted from their underlying physical characteristics and constraints, thereby enabling complex processes such as initialization, activation and restoration to be performed using simple commands at a command line interface.
assignees: SRINIVASAN KARTHIKEYAN;DEAN ROYCE T;TIAN XUN;EMC CORP

title_en: Restoration status grasping and supporting device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To accurately, surely and quickly grasp a place to be repaired and a restoration status thereof after an accident occurs on a distribution line while contributing to sure and quick restoration of a power failure.SOLUTION: A restoration status grasping and supporting device 2 forms display information based on information such as patrolled sphere information, failure place information, repair requesting place information, and repair place information and distribution line system diagram information, causes a display to display the display information, extracts a place being a sphere, in which an accidental power failure occurs, having been patrolled and having been repaired, further extracts a place adjacent to a section, to which power is transmitted, therefrom, determines that power can be transmitted to the place in a case where a transmission section adjacent to the place is in a forward transmission direction and determines that the power can be transmitted to the place when a current value is within an acceptable range in a case where the transmission section adjacent to the place is in a backward transmission direction.
assignees: CHUGOKU ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: A kind of infosystem realizing the management of distribution network failure fast power restoration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of infosystem realizing the management of distribution network failure fast power restoration.This system comprises: information sharing module, for providing shared real-time failure message to contact staff, repairing dispatch control person, repair personnel, monitoring management personnel at different levels; Customer service support module, for providing the information inquiry of outage information, repairing progress msg to contact staff; Decision assistant module, provides the analysis decision of problem to each link staff for the failure message that provides according to described information sharing module; Data interaction module, for described information sharing module, described decision assistant module, the conversion of communication data between described customer service support module and external data base.Adopt the present invention, can realize repairing procedural information and transmit in time, become more meticulous coverage, integration system detecting/monitoring, really achieves the unified information management system ensureing channel, assist repairing decision-making, improve telegram in reply flow process, break information barrier.

title_en: Internet of things early warning device for forest fire prevention
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an Internet of things early warning device for forest fire prevention and belongs to the field of forest fire prevention. An omnidirectional antenna in the device receives fire situation signals and sends the fire situation signals to a radio frequency (RF) communication module, the RF communication module sends interrupt signals to awake a micro-control unit after receiving the fire situation signals, and the micro-control unit reads the fire situation signals sent by the RF communication module and then analyzes fire situation signals. A state indication circuit and a sound and light alarm circuit respectively send indication lamp early warning information and sound alarm and indication lamp alarm information according to control signals of the micro-control unit. A RJ45 communication module and a global system for mobile (GSM) module respectively send alarm information to the internet and a corresponding mobile terminal according to the control signals of the micro-control unit. The Internet of things early warning device is a measurement and control master station machine for forest fire prevention integrating network fire situation receiving, remote fire situation transfer, detector network management and fire situation alarm prompt, has the remarkable advantages of high reliability, high stability, self-restoration and the like, and achieves intelligentized and informationalized development of monitoring for domestic forest fire prevention.
assignees: CHONGQING YINGKA ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Use of chitosan oligosaccharide and its composition in crop growth restoration after frost damage
abstract_en: The invention relates to use of chitosan oligosaccharide and its composition in crop growth restoration after frost damage, and specificallyprovides the use of a pesticide composition comprisingchitosan oligosaccharide for crops to resist frost. The use provided by the invention is characterized in that the pesticide composition comprises 0.0035% to 0.23% by weight of chitosan oligosaccharide. The use anda method of chitosan oligosaccharide to restore crop growth after frost or freeze damage provided by the invention solve the problem that at present there is no effective measure for restoring crop growth after frost or freeze damage, playing an important role in reducing the effect of natural disasters on crops.
assignees: HAINAN ZHENGYE ZHONGNONG HIGH TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network fault restoration resource scheduling method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a power distribution network fault recovery resource scheduling method. The method comprises the following steps: receiving an input power distribution network fault point set, and taking the input power distribution network fault point set as the input of a resource scheduling model; calculating to obtain an optimal feasible solution of resource scheduling according to a repaired resource scheduling model, wherein the resource repairing model is a fault repairing time function under the condition of considering the emergency degree of the fault; and scheduling the fault repairing resources according to the output of the resource scheduling model. The embodiment of the application also discloses a power distribution network fault repairing resource scheduling device. The embodiment of the application improves the scheduling efficiency and the resource utilization rate of the fault repairing resource scheduling.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD;TAIYUAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Construction method for replacing damaged railway viaduct column
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a construction method for replacing a damaged railway viaduct column, which enables a space under a viaduct to be widened concurrently with the replacement of the railway viaduct column damaged by an earthquake disaster and the like.SOLUTION: In a construction method for replacing a damaged railway viaduct column, concrete in plastic hinge sections 2 and 2' of a damaged existing railway viaduct column 1 is chipped; buckled axial reinforcements 3 and 3' are exposed; the existing railway viaduct column 1 is removed except for buckled axial reinforcements 5 and 5'; treatment of restoration from a buckled state is applied to the buckled axial reinforcements 5 and 5'; joints 7 and 7' make a new axial reinforcement 6 connected to the axial reinforcements undergone the treatment of restoration from the buckled state; protective caps 8 and 8' for the plastic hinge sections are installed; the new axial reinforcement 6 is wound with a hoop tie 9; and concrete 10 is placed on the axial reinforcement 6 wound with the hoop tie 9, and thus, the damaged existing railway viaduct column is replaced by the new railway viaduct column.
assignees: RAILWAY TECHNICAL RES INST

title_en: Method for ecological restoration of mountain
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for ecological restoration of a mountain, which comprises the following steps: (1) forming holes on a rocky mountain; (2) filling cement mortar (1 : 3) in the holes; (3) inserting foundation steel bars into the cement in the holes and allowing the foundation steel bars to protruding out of the rocky mountain at a certain length, and pouring a cement frame or not with the foundation steel bars as center; (4) laying a vertically consecutive planting soil layer along the rock slope of the rocky mountain, wherein the planting soil layer comprises plant growth bags stacked along the rock slope and filling soil for filling gaps; (5) coating a steel mesh on the outer surface of the planting soil layer, wherein the steel mesh is fixedly connected with the foundation steel bars to fix the plant growth bags and is formed of a plurality of steel wires by crossing each other; and (6) watering and curing the plant growth bags. The method provided by the invention perfectly combines plants, soil and the mountain; and not only has rapid and good greening effect and effectively solves the problems of mountain landslide, collapse and the like, but also forms a stable long-life plant community, achieving an original ecological effect.
assignees: BEIJING ZHENGHE HENGJI BINSHUI ECOLOGY ENVIRONMENTAL MAN CO LTD

title_en: Wall body provided with liquefaction countermeasure and steel sheet pile with liquefaction prevention function
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a wall body and a steel sheet pile capable of providing the ground, having a sand layer posing a risk of liquefaction on an occurrence of an earthquake but performing high water permeability in normal time, with a drainage function for liquefaction restoration without inhibiting the water permeability in the normal time.SOLUTION: A planar resin material 13a configuring a drainage member is installed at an inside of a main body of a steel sheet pile 11 surrounded by a web 11a and flanges 11b thereof. The web 11a of the main body of the steel sheet pile 11 has many permeable holes 12 therein. Thus, an environmental-friendly steel sheet pile wall with a liquefaction countermeasure can be constructed in the ground by driving the steel sheet piles 11 with the drainage members into the ground while fitting left and right side joints 11c and 11d thereof. The permeable holes 12 in the web 11a of the main body of the steel sheet pile 11 enable underground water to smoothly flow without being interfered in normal time and thereby solving a problem with drawdown of a well or lowering of an underground water level behind the steel sheet pile wall. Also, the planar resin material 13a configuring the drainage member enables excess pore water pressure to be dispersed therethrough and thereby restraining liquefaction of the ground on an occurrence of an earthquake.
assignees: SUMITOMO METAL IND

title_en: System and method for automated fault control and restoration of smart grids
abstract_en: A self-organizing protection coordination system within a power network is provided. The self-organizing protection coordination system in the power network includes a plurality of distribution devices communicatively coupled to each other in a power network. The power network also includes a protection device coupled to each of the plurality of distribution devices configured to transmit power in the distribution network. The power network further includes a controller coupled to each of the plurality of distribution devices. The controller receives communication channel characteristics from a plurality of distribution devices in a distribution network at an interval of time. The controller also computes a delay in time for receiving the communication characteristics. The controller further determines a plurality of reliability indicators at each of the plurality of distribution devices. The controller adjusts tripping characteristics of the plurality of distribution devices to minimize the reliability indicators based on the computed delay.
assignees: GEN ELECTRIC;BUSH STEPHEN FRANCIS;MAHONY MICHAEL JOSEPH

title_en: Method for estimating power outages and restoration during natural and man-made events
abstract_en: A method of modeling electric supply and demand with a data processor in combination with a recordable medium, and for estimating spatial distribution of electric power outages and affected populations. A geographic area is divided into cells to form a matrix. Within the matrix, supply cells are identified as containing electric substations and demand cells are identified as including electricity customers. Demand cells of the matrix are associated with the supply cells as a function of the capacity of each of the supply cells and the proximity and/or electricity demand of each of the demand cells. The method includes estimating a power outage by applying disaster event prediction information to the matrix, and estimating power restoration using the supply and demand cell information of the matrix and standardized and historical restoration information.
assignees: OMITAOMU OLUFEMI A;FERNANDEZ STEVEN J;US DEPT ENERGY;UT BATTELLE LLC

title_en: The alarm device of transfer of data and voice restoration in Zigbee network
abstract_en: The present invention, to implement the alarm device of transfer of data and voice restoration in Zigbee network, realizes: to gas anomaly automatically monitor with the accuracy reported in time, communicative to the very first time of natural calamity, to the reliability of the General Promotion of public safety, the uniformity broadcasted area information.User sets gas anomaly alarm module, abnormal vibrations alarm module, automaticmanual security alarm module, emergency alarm debug system module, data wireless transmission and data receiver is carried out by Zigbee, directly transmit with MCU pulse data and voice sound data, the voice restoration completing Zigbee synchronizing information carries out corresponding audio alert.Utilize Zigbee MANET to complete the real-time automatic monitoring of complex environment and region.Add the controllability of individual event warning system, multinomial warning system, improve initiative and the accuracy of real-time monitoring data.

title_en: Storage system and data processing method
abstract_en: The present invention comprises a management computer which exchanges information with storage apparatuses and host computers of primary sites and a secondary site via a management network and which manages a data processing performance and a data processing status of each of the sites, wherein, when any of the primary sites is subject to disaster, the management computer selects a normal primary site for which a data transfer time of a restoration target application is within a recovery time objective as a restoration site which possesses processing performance for restoring the application, and remote-copies restoration copy data, which exists at the secondary site, to the storage apparatus of the primary site selected as the restoration site, via a data network.
assignees: HITACHI LTD

title_en: Communication device, management method of storage unit in the same communication device, and management program of storage unit in the same communication device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To solve a problem of being unable to deliver reception data which a management PC has not obtained to a user due to the data disappearance when blackout and the like occurs because of property of a volatile memory, although the volatile memory is used in the storage area of an external storage.SOLUTION: When a first communication unit communicates with an external device, a first storage unit stores reception data received from the external device regardless of on or off of electric power. In addition, a second storage unit stores conversion data converted to a prescribed format from the data received from the external device only when electric power is on, and an output unit is capable of outputting the conversion data. Here, an electric power determination unit is capable of determining whether electric power is on or off, and based on determination that power has been turned on, a restoration management unit converts the reception data in the first storage unit into conversion data to make the second storage unit store the conversion data.
assignees: SEIKO EPSON CORP

title_en: Method and device for communicating with vending machine
abstract_en: Invented method comprises data detection by watching communication between vending machine and its payment system in unified manner, without intervention in this communication, and automated downloading this data; transmitting downloaded data via wireless network by invented device's modem/external peripheral device's resource; analyzing this data by determining events and one-time events and generating states by unifying the meaning of communication between vending machine and its payment systems performed according to multitude of standard communication protocols; extracting from analyzed data of information about technical condition of vending machine/payment systems, about operating regime of vending machine, about sales made by vending machine and revenues in its payment systems; remote control on basis of analyzed data and optional discontinuation/restoration of vending machine operation by invented device at request by external peripheral device connected to vending machine. The data is tracked or monitored and the diagnosis at the vending machine is transferred.
assignees: DATAVEND LTD

title_en: Three-dimensional operation management system of intelligent power grid
abstract_en: The invention provides a three-dimensional operation management system of an intelligent power grid. The three-dimensional operation management system is constructed on a software system architecture according to the following steps: a client server system is used, a data architecture adopts a distribution and centralization combined structure so as to achieve a purpose of smooth compiling and interacting of a graphics system; an open database system is utilized, and a special power system database is used as the database system; a three-layer system architecture technology is utilized so that a GIS (Geographic Information System) simultaneously supports a Client/Server mode and an Internet mode; and a seamless data integration technology is adopted according to the following steps: a database model reflecting a real world is established through using an object oriented technology, all space data and non-space data are stored in the same relation database, and the data submission, backup and restoration technologies are provided. By using the three-dimensional operation management system of the intelligent power grid, client system resources can be utilized to the largest extent, the database of the system has flexibility and relatively good scalability, and the application requirement on the three-dimensional operation of the intelligent power grid is fully satisfied.
assignees: NANXINDA IMAGE TECHNOLOGY ENGINEERING SUZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Mountain fire disaster monitoring and early-warning analysis system based on power grid GIS (Gas Insulated Switchgear)
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a mountain fire disaster monitoring and early-warning analysis system based on a power grid GIS (Gas Insulated Switchgear), which comprises a data acquisition device, a one-way safety isolation device and a data processing device based on the power grid GIS, wherein the data acquisition device is connected with the data processing device based on the power grid GIS through the safety isolation device; the data acquisition device acquires public network data and micro meteorological data and is integrated with a data acquisition platform; and the data of the data acquisition platform is accessed into a power grid GIS platform through the safety isolation device and is analyzed by the data processing device based on the power grid GIS. Through the system, the mountain fire spread trend and the mountain fire spread scope can be forecasted, the sphere of influence of mountain fire to power grid assets and the equipment information are forecasted, the power grid loss and the like caused by the mountain fire disaster are evaluated, a power grid company is guided to timely carry out power supply repair and power supply restoration according to the mountain fire disaster situation, and the safety, the stability and the orderly operation of a power grid are ensured.
assignees: YANGQUAN POWER SUPPLY CO LTD OF SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;HUADA TIANYUAN BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Efficient application-aware disaster recovery
abstract_en: Embodiments are directed to efficiently backing up portions of data and to performing a scoped data recovery. In an embodiment, a computer system preloads data images with data corresponding to various different software applications or operating systems. The computer system chunks the data images, so that each data image is divided into multiple data chunks, and where each data chunk is represented by a hash value. The computer system then receives, from a user, portions of delta data representing data differences between the received user data and the data in the preloaded data images. The computer system also generates a logical backup representation that includes the data chunk hash values for the preloaded data images as well as the delta data received from the user. This logical representation allows restoration of the user's data using only the hash values and the delta data.
assignees: VALIYAPARAMBIL MANOJ K;SINGLA AMIT;SEN VIJAY;ALI ABID;MICROSOFT CORP

title_en: Power restoration system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To ensure power after disasters as much as possible.SOLUTION: When a HEMS receives an emergency disaster prompt report, charging a PHV/EV starts in the case that a vehicle is connected. For example, a vehicle storage battery of the PHV/EV is charged with system power and natural energy. Thereby, the charged vehicle storage battery becomes available after disasters. After occurrence of the disasters, replacement by available power is performed depending on the extent of the disasters. Specifically, when the system power is not available, a power source is switched from the system power to available power (the natural energy or PHV/EV). Thereby, power can be supplied to houses without suspension.

title_en: Caisson foundation stand for restoring caisson type breakwater and restoration method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To solve the problem at the time when a caisson type breakwater is struck by disaster that it is difficult to secure a diver and others engaged in levelling work on a rubble mound so that the disaster-affected caisson type breakwater cannot be restored early.SOLUTION: A caisson foundation stand for restoring a caisson type breakwater of this invention comprises a foundation stand 1 which is installed on a rubble mound 2 of the disaster-affected caisson type breakwater and a caisson 3 is installed on the top face of the foundation stand 1, and the foundation stand 1 is used for reinstallation of the caisson on the rubble mound. The foundation stand 1 is formed in a plate shape and a protrusion 5 for bite in the rubble mound is installed on the underside.
assignees: PENTA OCEAN CONSTRUCTION

title_en: Fast search method for active splitting surfaces for power system on the basis of multilayer graph partitioning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power system stability and control. According to the technical scheme allowing for fast search of splitting surfaces, the fast search method for active splitting surfaces in a power system on the basis of multilayer graph partitioning includes the steps of firstly, combining points or edges in an original graph to obtain simplified graphs G0, repeating combination till final simplified graphs Gn include few nodes only; secondly, initially partitioning the simplified graphs Gn to obtain initial splitting surfaces; and thirdly sequentially restoring the simplified graphs Gn into original graph G0, and improving partitioning results by optimization in each step of restoration. According to impact of coarsening upon solution space of system optimal solutions, a coarsening process in the first step is divided into three sub-steps, namely equivalent coarsening, coarsening based on power flow tracing, and coarsening based on weight edge matching. The method is mainly applied to power system stability and control.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: Complete backspacing searching method for tracing reasons of power failure after appearance of power distribution network fault
abstract_en: The invention relates to a backspacing method in the field of the electrical power system, particularly to a complete backspacing searching method for tracing reasons of power failure after the appearance of power distribution network fault. The method includes the following steps: A, performing recursion search from a node corresponding to a power-losing distribution transformer; B, judging whether a power source is searched; C, confirming a route from the power-losing distribution transformer to the power source, the distance of the route and the information of an switched off switch on the route and nearest to the starting node; and D, obtaining the reason of power failure of the power distribution network. The method is efficient for radial power distribution networks, can be used for efficiently and accurately positioning the reason of power failure, is of vital importance in guiding distribution network dispatching personnel to quickly command power restoration, can be used for clearly positioning topological error and effectively guide planners to eliminate islands and revise the topological error in the aspect of planning, has been applied to the on-line site reliability monitoring platform, and is embodying the practical engineering value.

abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of power distribution network repair method based on automatic division unit and evaluation, comprise the following steps: 1) automatic division unit: 2) information; 3) evaluate guide, the idiographic flow of step 3) is as follows: 31) unit evaluation; 32) circuit report; 33) Strategies of Maintenance; 34) formulate repair schedule. title_en: Power connection control system and method
abstract_en: For each of consumers, a connection control apparatus is provided that includes an opening/closing device capable of connecting or disconnecting an electric power system and a consumer, that, when a power outage occurs in the electric power system, disconnects the electric power system and the consumer from each other by the opening/closing device at a command from an outage management apparatus or the like, and that connects the electric power system and the consumer to each other by the opening/closing device upon receiving a command from the outage management apparatus or the like at the time of restoration from the power outage. A power supply control apparatus supplies electric power from energy provision equipment to electrical appliances during a power outage in the electric power system.

title_en: Method for treating waste
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method for treating wastes, capable of rapidly carrying out the treatment of wastes in disaster area by natural disasters such as earthquakes and tsunamis, and reducing the period and cost until the restoration.SOLUTION: Wastes are collected at a primary temporary placement site installed in each district; then when the wastes collected at the plurality of primary temporary placement sites are collected at a secondary temporary placement site and subjected to an intermediate treatment, the treatment includes at least one of a utilizable extraction step or a recycle processing step; in the occurrence site of the wastes and the primary temporary placement sites and the secondary temporary placement site, at least one of cleaning, disintegration or crushing, and sieving is carried out to make sizes of resultant individual pieces into ≤50 cm; secondary wastes are subjected to at least one of a utilizable extraction step or a recycle processing step; and in the secondary temporary placement site, re-selection and re-treatment are carried out to reduce the volume and reduce the time, cost and labor necessary for transportation and the like.

title_en: A kind of provincial power network black starting-up and large area blackout processing method
abstract_en: A kind of provincial power network black starting-up and large area blackout processing method, the black starting-up of provincial power network is divided into two stages, several subsystem black-start scheme is generated when meeting black starting-up power supply and other constraintss, relatively independent between each subsystem black-start scheme, possess the possibility simultaneously carrying out recovering; After each subsystem recovers, remain non-power transmission node to target grid and carry out power transmission, now power supply point is be with electrical nodes in system, and optimizing has been carried out in power transmission path, and not necessarily black starting-up unit.The present invention for core, utilizes black starting-up optimized algorithm to propose black starting-up prioritization scheme with the quick recovery and optimization algorithm of large area blackout.The black starting-up of provincial power network is divided into two stages and subsystem independence Restoration stage and interconnected, cooperation Restoration stage, makes the formulation systematic science more of black-start scheme.

title_en: Extranet client management and control method for electric power working site management and control system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an extranet client management and control method for an electric power working site management and control system. The method comprises the following steps: providing a page displaying a repair schedule of a team of all users in a work period, and performing dispatch commands; providing a repair schedule detailed information page, wherein the page displays all information of the repair schedule, and work tickets and site survey lists, which are related to the repair schedule; providing an operating page of a camera, and saving a user name of mobile equipment and a global position system (GPS) position where pictures are taken when the pictures are saved; and providing an input page and a signature for filling the work tickets. By the method, multifunctional and visual processing process can be provided for implementation, monitoring and maintenance of electric power overhaul operation so as to improve operation and maintenance, overhaul and first-aid repair management level of power enterprises, standardize work flow of daily operation and maintenance, overhaul and fault first-aid repair, improve fault first-aid repair efficiency, enhance field operation scheduling, improve the ruling capacity of the power enterprises to the modern power grid and ensure that the power grid works reliably, efficiently and economically.
assignees: Fuyang power supply bureau;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power distribution network power supply power restoration method based on photovoltaic power generation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network power supply power restoration method based on a photovoltaic power generation system, and the power distribution network power supply restoration method is characterized in that after a power grid is widely blacked out, and island division is conducted for a photovoltaic system, so that the non-fault blackout area is maximally powered on the premise of maintaining the power of important loads. The power distribution network power supply power restoration method comprises the steps of determining an after-failure photovoltaic power generation system island dividing scheme, and determining a segmental switch configuration position needing to be disconnected when the island dividing scheme is actuated; examining whether a failure branch downstream contains the photovoltaic power generation system or not after the failure happens, and switching the photovoltaic power generation system to be operated in an island form if the failure branch downstream contains the photovoltaic power generation system; finding a segmental position and a blackout area branch segmental switch position needing to be disconnected when the photovoltaic island is formed; adjusting the after-failure power distribution network structural information, searching a restorable route of a non-failure blackout area, determining the quantity of operable segmental switches and contact switches, and determining a basic particle vector; and solving a power distribution power restoration scheme of a non-failure blackout area outside the island according to a binary particle group optimization algorithm.
assignees: Changxing county power supply bureau;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Seismic mitigation and isolation system applied to seismic resistance of long-span continuous beam of single-track railway
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a seismic mitigation and isolation system applied to seismic resistance of a long-span continuous beam of a single-track railway. The long-span continuous beam is supported by piers which are distributed at intervals. A double-curved-surface spherical seismic mitigation and isolation support seat is arranged on the top of each pier, and a viscous damper is vertically mounted on the top of each pier. Limiting devices used for transversely limiting are arranged on two sides of each double-curved-surface spherical seismic mitigation and isolation support seat. The seismic mitigation and isolation system has the advantages that the double-curved-surface spherical seismic mitigation and isolation support seats and the viscous dampers are connected in parallel to form the seismic mitigation and isolation system, and the seismic mitigation and isolation system has a function of bidirectional seismic mitigation and isolation in the horizontal direction, can effectively improve the seismic resistance of the long-span continuous beam in the longitudinal direction of a bridge, enables the bidirectional seismic mitigation and isolation function in the horizontal direction of the double-curved-surface spherical seismic mitigation and isolation support seats to be fully played, can effectively control displacement of bridge beam components when a seismic hazard happens, has certain self-restoration capacity, and brings convenience to post-disaster repair, is reasonable, compact, clear in stress, stable in performance, and convenient to maintain in the future.

title_en: The coast where applies the environmental engineering works fiber which hits, the seabed sand being washed away prevention infrastructure and the spatial-temporal method
title_ko: 친환경 토목섬유를 활용한 해안, 해저 모래 유실 방지용 구조물 및 그 시공방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A seaside and seabed sand loss prevention structure utilizing an environmentally-friendly geotextile and construction method thereof are provided to recycle the dredging sand generated by the dredge on the seaside, thereby minimizing the construction cost of the sand loss prevention structure and providing an environmentally-friendly seaside restoration construction method for the vegetation of a artificial reef. CONSTITUTION: A seaside and seabed sand loss prevention structure utilizing an environmentally-friendly geotextile includes a vegetation soil pouch and a non woven bag. A water soluble adhesion layer is formed by coating a water soluble adhesive onto the covering material of a vegetation soil pouch and the water plant seeds are sown to be attached the adhesion layer. The vegetation soil pouches filled with the dredge soil and the non woven bags are provided to be transported to a construction site. The vegetation pouches are layered in several layers on the unfolded non woven bags in the construction site. An artificial reef is formed by coupling members inserted into coupling rings formed on the edge of the non woven bags whose edges are gathered in the center. The artificial reef is dropped and sunken closely to the spot of the sand loss and dropped and sunken through a dual wall structure. [Reference numerals] (AA) Start; (BB) End; (S100) Coating a water soluble adhesive onto the covering material of a vegetation soil pouch to form a water soluble adhesion layer and spreading and attaching water plant seeds onto the water soluble adhesion layer; (S200) Filling the inside of the vegetation soil pouch with dredge soil produced from a coastal construction or construction site and preparing a plurality of vegetation pouches according to the area of an installation place; (S300) Manufacturing and preparing non woven bags by determining the size and number of the non woven bags according to the conditions of the installation place; (S400) Transporting the prepared vegetation pouches and non woven bags to the site; (S500) Laminating the vegetation pouches in several layers on the top of the unfolded non woven bags in the site; (S600) Gathering the edges of the non woven bags to the center and inserting coupling members into coupling holes formed in the edges, thereby forming an artificial reef; (S700) Dropping and sinking the formed artificial reef in the installation place; (S800) Repeating the steps above to form an artificial reef structure

title_en: System and method for restoring service in power system
abstract_en: A system and method for restoring service within an electrical power system is disclosed. The method may include identifying a restoration path for a blackout area within a power system, selecting a mobile energy resource connection site electrically connected to at least one of the restoration path and the blackout area, sending power injection requests to a plurality of mobile energy resources, at least some of which may be neighboring connection sites, receiving power injection grants from participants in the plurality of mobile energy resources, and implementing the restoration path. The system may include a processor and a computer-readable storage medium having a plurality of machine-readable instructions embedded thereon and configured to perform the method by the processor.
assignees: ABB RESEARCH LTD

title_en: Power system load restoration auxiliary decision system and decision generating method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system load restoration auxiliary decision system and a decision generating method of the power system load restoration auxiliary decision system. According to the power system load restoration auxiliary decision system, a B/S architecture is adopted, and the power system load restoration auxiliary decision system comprises a database server where a structured query language (SQL) Server engine is installed, an algorithm server where a load restoration calculation engine and algorithms are installed, a Web server where a load restoration project management engine is installed, a system diagram template client where a power grid primitive management engine is installed, and a Web client, wherein the database server, the algorithm server, the Web server, the system diagram template client and the Web client are connected through a network. The decision generating method includes that power grid single-line diagrams and power grid data are stored in the database server; a Web browser in the Web client is opened to operate the load restoration project management engine in a remote mode; the power grid single-line diagrams stored in the database server are managed to establish corresponding data management tables; and the load restoration project management engine invokes the algorithms in the algorithm server to generate a load partitioning scheme and load restoration grid structures of all partitioned zones. The power system load restoration auxiliary decision system is low in cost and easy to maintain, and information can be fully synchronized.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA GRADUATE SCHOOL

title_en: Manufacture and application of aluminum plastic composite material light structure building and earthquake isolation device thereof
abstract_en: The invention aims at achieving the purposes of energy conservation, emission reduction, earthquake resistance and hazardous reduction by building light structure buildings. An aluminum plastic composite material, a reinforced concrete frame and a light thermal insulation material are allocated integrally, steel cement tile sandstone are mostly replaced, and therefore whole weight of the building is reduced by higher than one twice, and a new building craft process is formulated according to the feature. The aluminum plastic composite material comprises a plastic clip aluminum composite board and a big caliber aluminum plastic composite tube, the plastic clip aluminum composite board is manufactured by a full-automatic production line of the plastic clip aluminum composite board, and the big caliber aluminum plastic composite tube is manufactured by the full-automatic production line of an aluminum plastic composite tube. By utilizing a specially-made clamp device to strengthen tensile property of a floor spacing board, and scientifically utilizing a triangular inclined strut to strengthen building integrity, and therefore powerful breaking stress from any directions is resisted. The aluminum plastic composite material is not only self combustion resistant, but also extinguishes fire depending on self functions. The earthquake isolation device is manufactured at the premise of great weight reduction to consume earthquake wave in an invisible mode. A compression spring type elastic composite pier with a good elastic function and an elastic restoration function is arranged on the upper portion of the earthquake isolation device, and a specially-made universal wheel which can transform linear motion to rotary motion and eliminate elastic deformation and horizontal deformation.

title_en: Emergency recovery system of burned site using gis
title_ko: Ｇｉｓ를 이용한 산화지의 응급복구시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An emergency restoration system of a burned place using a GIS(Geographic Information System) is provided to predict a secondary damage place and a damage degree after a forest fire. CONSTITUTION: A burned place analysis module(210) predicts second damage information of an area, of which the location information is analyzed, by analyzing the location information of a burned place which is inputted from a first user terminal and a second user terminal. An emergency restoration place calculation module(230) calculates place information which is preferentially restored among the location information of two or more inputted burned places. An emergency restoration method management module(220) provides a restoration method based on the corresponding emergency restoration information. A disaster information output module(240) provides the predicted second damage information and the provided emergency restoration information to the first user terminal and the second user terminal. [Reference numerals] (200) Emergency restoration server of a burned place; (210) Burned place analysis module; (220) Emergency restoration method management module; (230) Emergency restoration place calculation module; (240) Disaster information output module;
