title_en: Switching fire watch control unit
title_ko: 배전반 화재감시제어기
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A switchboard fire watch controller for a semi-permanent failure free state is provided to perform the functions of warning and automatic extinguishment control through an unmanned automatic precision analysis according to the situation of an outbreak of a fire by the installation of a fire watch controller(WB-FR2) and perform multiple functions of remote restoration, power outage monitoring and self-malfunction diagnosis notification through digitalized communications, thereby reinforcing the prevention of malfunction and non-operation using the switchboard fire watch controller which is subminiature and highly effective. CONSTITUTION: A switchboard fire watch controller includes a first power circuit(10) generating and outputting a first voltage for the operation of a relay and a solenoid, a CPU(16) from the output voltage of the first power circuit, a communications module(15) and a second power circuit(14) generating and outputting a second voltage(Vcc) for the operation of an alarm circuit(17) and a display unit(18). The first voltage outputted by the first power circuit composes a dual fire watch circuit by being respectively connected to a first watch serial circuit and a second watch serial circuit. The first voltage outputted by the first power circuit is connected to be applied to a serial circuit formed by a fire extinguisher operating solenoid(19), the contact point of a first line relay, the contact point of a second line relay and resistance for detecting the overcurrent. On both ends of a first sensor socket(34-1) and a second sensor socket(35-1), where a first heat and smoke sensor(24-1) and a second heat and smoke sensor(25-1) are to be mounted, a first sensor test switch and a second sensor test switch are composed in parallel. title_en: Remote power outage notification
abstract_en: Power outages and restorations at telecommunications subscribers' premises can be automatically detected and reported in a manner that is sensitive to subscriber privacy concerns. A server device receives, from a network terminal device installed at a subscriber premise, an alert that the network terminal device has lost primary power from a power grid. The server device determines a physical address of a location for the network terminal and associates the physical address of the network terminal location with particular power grid equipment. The server device determines whether a power outage of the power grid has occurred and outputs a notification of the power outage associated with the particular power grid equipment when the power outage is determined to occur.
assignees: VERIZON PATENT & LICENSING INC;VERIZON PATENT & LICENSING INC

title_en: Artificial living structure for the fresh water fishes
title_ko: 생태하천 복원용 수중생물의 수중생태환경구조체
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An underwater ecological environmental structure of aquatic organisms for ecological river restoration is provided to live in natural environment since aquatic organisms safely live and multiplication is also vigorously occurred. CONSTITUTION: An underwater ecological environmental structure of aquatic organisms for ecological river restoration includes a first shelter space unit(1) formed in a box shape while having a water supply pipe connected to a front face, a cutting slit groove and an entry hole respectively formed and a shelter space formed inside, a living space unit(2) having a living space formed inside, a spawning space unit formed in a box shape, a water supply pipe connected in a front face, an entry hole in a rear face of a downstream side and a spawning space in which a rock layer formed inside, and a second shelter space unit(5) having a divided shelter space by a compartment wall inside.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 생태하천 복원용 수중생물의 수중생태환경구조체는, 생태하천의 수중에 수중생물의 생활시 갑작스러운 주변환경의 변화나 위기상황에서의 보존을 위한 대피공간부와, 일상적인 유영(遊泳)과 먹이활동을 위한 생활공간부와, 산란과 부화 또는 치어들의 안정적인 생장을 위한 산란공간부와, 은닉본능과 스트레스 해소를 위한 휴식공간부를 제공하고, 또한, 각 대피공간부, 생활공간부, 산란공간부, 휴식공간부에 상류에서 신선한 생수공급이 가능하게 되므로서, 생태하천에 서식하는 수중생물의 서식활성화와 수중생태계의 보존을 위한 천연과 유사한 수중생태환경을 제공하는 것이 가능하게 되어 어류, 양서류와 같은 물과 친밀한 생물들의 개채의 증식이 가능하게 되면서 주위의 수변 생태계와의 균형을 이루게 되면서 인간생활에 해로운 각종 곤충의 유충들도 자연 조절됨으로써 인간과 자연의 공존을 모색할 수 있으며, 인근 시민들의 자연친화적 생활, 친환경적 정서함양과 자연관찰, 생태체험장의 역할을 담당하게 되므로 수중생물의 자연생태계의 회복을 이룩하고 건강한 생태하천으로 재탄생하게 된다.

title_en: Regional energy management method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a regional energy management method which instantaneously restores a surrounding area by: securing a power source, after a disaster strikes, for a disaster control base, a disaster prevention base as well as fluctuating number of shelters on a community center level; installing distributed power sources such as photovoltaic power generation as well as wind power generation; and establishing cooperation between the surrounding area and a large-scale facility such as a factory operating an emergency power source.SOLUTION: A regional energy management method comprises the steps of: constructing a system which interchanges a portable battery function, when a disaster strikes, between a restoration base using a business facility and a shelter in a surrounding area; securing a power source at the shelter as well as optimally operates a power supply facility of a factory by using the system; and deciding a power source delivery amount with respect to power supply demand of the shelter on the basis of a business continuation state of the business facility, a power system interconnection state as well as operation information on a battery.
assignees: HITACHI LTD

title_en: Flow soldering device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To solve such a problem that since the output of a pump must be adjusted according to the change of solder liquid level in a solder bath, the pump consumes a lot of electrical energy, and the solder liquid level must be lowered quickly for safety in the event of a disaster.SOLUTION: In the flow soldering device for supplying solder in a solder bath to a solder supply object located above via a jet nozzle, a gas chamber communicating with the solder bath and being filled with gas, and means for adjusting the volume of gas in the gas chamber are provided. Electrical energy being consumed by the pump can be saved by adjusting the volume of gas in the gas chamber thereby adjusting the liquid level of solder in the solder bath. Furthermore, quick lowering of the solder liquid level is contributive to safety measure or early restoration of earthquake.
assignees: HITACHI LTD

title_en: Safety receptacle
title_ko: 안전 콘센트
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A safety socket is provided to block current corresponding to generation of heat by using restoration force of a memory alloy spring and prevent safety accidents. CONSTITUTION: One end and the other end of a plate spring(200) are composed of conductive metal in order to supply power to a coupler(110). One end of a memory alloy spring(300) is fixed to one end of a body. The other end of the memory alloy spring includes a plurality of memory alloys connected to the one end or the other end of the plate spring. When high temperature or overheat is generated, the memory alloy spring separates the plate spring from the coupler at a constant distance.

title_en: System for providing underground facility information using augmented reality of mobile terminal

CONSTITUTION: GIS(Geographic Information System) data which represents underground facility related information is applied to image data which is generated by photographing the outside. An underground facility management server transmits registered underground facility accident breakdown information to the mobile communication terminal for the underground facility administrator as GIS data. abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지하매설물 관리자가 발생되는 지하매설물들의 사고에 따라 사고유형별 작업 우선순위의 노하우를 체득한 숙련자가 아니어도 상수도관, 하수도관, 가스관, 통신선, 전력선 등과 같이 다양한 종류의 지하매설물에서 사고발생 시 즉각적인 대처를 위한 사고유형별 작업 우선순위를 순차적으로 안내하여 주는 기능을 제공함으로써, 지하매설물의 사고발생에 따른 신속한 응급처치를 가능케 하여 주고, 다양한 종류의 지하매설물에서 사고발생 시 즉각적인 대처를 위해 순차적으로 안내되는 사고유형별 작업 우선순위에 사고가 발생된 지하매설물을 관리하는 유관기관 및 해당 복구업체의 연락처를 안내하는 기능이 추가되며, 다양한 종류의 지하매설물에서 사고발생 시 즉각적인 대처를 위해 순차적으로 안내되는 사고유형별 작업 우선순위에 지하매설물의 사고 발생 후 해당 복구업체를 통해 복구 중 또는 복구완료 등을 나타내는 지하매설물 사고관련 후처리 작업의 완료 여부를 인지할 수 있는 기능이 추가된 증강현실을 기반으로 하는 지하매설물 정보안내시스템에 관한 것으로, 외부를 촬영하여 생성된 영상데이터에 지하매설물 관련 정보를 나타내는 GIS데이터를 오버랩함으로써, 증강현실기반으로 지하매설물 정보를 제공받는 지하매설물 관리자용 이동통신단말기(100) 및 그 지하매설물 관리자용 이동통신단말기(100)에게 실시간으로 GIS데이터를 전송하여주는 지하매설물 관리서버(200)에 있어서, 상기 지하매설물 관리서버(200)는 등록된 지하매설물 사고내역정보를 상기 지하매설물 관리자용 이동통신단말기(100)로 전송하고, 상기 지하매설물 관리자용 이동통신단말기(100)에는 사고유형별 작업 우선순위 응용프로그램이 탑재되고, 전송된 상기 지하매설물 사고내역정보에서 안내된 사고지역에서 그 탑재된 사고유형별 작업 우선순위 응용프로그램의 실행에 의해 지하매설물 관리자가 발생된 지하매설물의 사고유형별로 작업의 우선순위를 단계적으로 나타낸 사고유형별 작업처리 안내화면부를 정보표시부(130)를 통해 출력함으로써 지하매설물의 사고 유형별로 작업의 우선순위에 따라 사고작업처리를 수행할 수 있게 안내하는 시스템을 제공하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Systems and Methods for Dynamic Islanding to Minimize Load Shed During Restoration After a Fault
abstract_en: A system and method for minimizing load shed during restoration after a fault in a power distribution network includes collecting customer prioritization data for a set of customers and calculating an inconvenience factor from the customer prioritization data on each customer in the set of customers. A load reduction required for restoration is determined, and at least one zone to be isolated from the power distribution network based the load reduction and the inconvenience factor is identified. The identified zone may then be isolated from the distribution network. The customer prioritization data may include customer priority data, customer load data, customer back-up device data, customer available back-up time, data related to willingness of customer to use their back-up device.
assignees: LOSEE MARC KARL;ARVIND KAMAL KUMAR;MEADOWS VERNON;GEN ELECTRIC

title_en: Multi-space-time navigating power system restoration decision support system and restoration decision method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-space-time navigating power system restoration decision support system and a restoration decision method. The system comprises a man-machine conversation layer being responsible for related display of a restorationdecision and the man-machine interactive operation, an interface adapting layer being responsible for interfacing withEMS and receiving power grid data, a data access layer used for providing underlying data support for a field service layer, and a modeling maintenance layer used for customizing and drawing various charts, wherein the interface adapting layer and the field service layer are connected with the man-machine conversation layer through network communication buses, the field service layer is connected with the data access layer, and the data access layer is connected with the modeling maintenance layer. The system and the method have the advantages that the efficiency and the success rate of power system restoration are improved, the whole-process covering on the restoration decision and the continuous online monitoring on the restoration process are realized, a dispatcher training simulation function is integrated, and the system and the method are applicable to the related power system restoration operation training.

title_en: Heat source system, and method for controlling number of start-up machines at heat source system power restoration time
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a heat source system capable of quickly starting up heat source machines up to the number of activated machines before blackout, at the power restoration time, without providing a device for controlling the number of heat source machines with an uninterruptible power supply, and to provide a method for controlling number of start-up machines in a heat source system.SOLUTION: A heat source system includes: a plurality of heat source machines; and an upper level control device 20 for giving a start-up command to each of the heat source machines, and not connected to an uninterruptible power supply. The upper level control device 20 is provided with a non-volatile first storage unit for storing the number of heat source machines that have been activated immediately before blackout. When being restored from the blackout, the upper level control device controls the number of heat source machines at the power restoration time according to the number of heat source machines stored in the first storage unit.
assignees: MITSUBISHI HEAVY IND LTD

title_en: Progressive network recovery
abstract_en: Technologies are generally described for systems and methods effective to schedule repair (e.g., allocate repair resources, determine a repair sequence, etc.) of a system effected by a large-scale failure caused by a natural disaster, malicious attack, faulty components, or the like. In an example, the system can generate a schedule that indicates amounts of repair resources allocated for repair of specific components of a disrupted system as well as a time or sequence in which the components are to be repaired. The schedule, in some instance, can operate to maximize an amount of restoration, at each stage of a recovery process, relative to the characteristic of the disrupted system. For example, with a communications network as the disrupted system, the schedule can maximize the amount of total traffic flow capacity recovered after respective steps of the recovery process.

title_en: Paddy field restoration method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a paddy field restoration method for restoring a paddy field affected by a tsunami to the paddy field capable of cultivating rice.SOLUTION: A paddy field restoration method to restore a paddy field affected by a tsunami comprises: an excavation process to excavate paddy soil 5 with foreign objects mixed therein due to damage by the tsunami; a cleaning process to clean the excavated paddy soil 5 with cleaning water; a fine debris removal process to remove fine debris, which is the foreign object, from slurry of the paddy soil 5 produced in the cleaning process; a sand component removal process to remove sand, which is also the foreign object, from the slurry which undergoes the fine debris removal process; and a fine grain fraction recovery process to recover a fine grain fraction included in the slurry by flocculating the same through addition of a flocculation agent 50 having mineral as a main component to the slurry which undergoes the sand component removal process. The paddy field restoration method recovers the fine grain fraction as the fine grain fraction with diameters available for the paddy field and returns the recovered fine grain fraction to the paddy field.
assignees: HITACHI SHIPBUILDING ENG CO;ASTECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for controlling electric shutter
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an electric shutter with a single push-button switch which smoothly performs resetting of an upper limit position and shifting to normal operation when recovering from a power supply cutoff state, such as blackout.SOLUTION: An electric shutter is in a blackout recovery mode when starting up the shutter by power-on after interruption of power supply. When starting up the shutter, position information of a shutter curtain is not stored, but a maximum movement amount, which is an operation range between an upper limit position and a lower limit position of the shutter curtain, is stored. In the blackout recovery mode, descending of the shutter curtain by input from the single push-button switch is inhibited, so that the shutter curtain is forcibly raised by input from the single push-button switch to set the upper limit position as a temporary upper limit position. After setting the temporary upper limit position, the inhibition of descending the shutter curtain is eliminated. When the shutter curtain successfully descends by the maximum movement amount, the temporary upper limit position is set as a fixed upper limit position, and the electric shutter shifts from the power interruption restoration mode to a normal operation mode.
assignees: SANWA SHUTTER CORP;SHINANO KENSHI CO

title_en: Underwater revetment based on ecological bags and water body ecological management method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an underwater revetment based on ecological bags and a water body ecological management method. The method comprises a first step of dredging and solidifying, a second step of establishing a water bottom foundation, a third step of clearing up the revetment surface, a fourth step of paving the ecological bags in a step-shaped lamination dislocation mode from the top of the water bottom foundation, a fifth step of planting submerged plants on the ecological bags, a sixth step of stopping river closure or beginning to coffer after the water quality conforms to or superior to the fourth scale of the national surface water environment criterion GB/3838-2002, wherein when the water quality does not conform to or inferior to the fifth scale of the GB/3838-2002, microbial preparation is added into the water according to the water quality measuring result, and a seventh step adding filter feeder fishes or/and herbivorous fishes, shrimps and demersal mussel animals. The method guarantees that floodwater can be drawn off based on the fact that the underwater revetment structure of rivers and lakes is safe, and the cooperative management capacity for the water body is improved through ecological restoration of the underwater revetment.
assignees: CHONGQING DANHAI IND CO LTD

title_en: Structural design optimization method for deepwater catenary mooring rope
abstract_en: The invention relates to a structural design optimization method for a deepwater catenary mooring rope. The method aims at an 'anchor chain-steel rope-anchor chain' three-section combined deepwater catenary mooring rope, structural parameters of length of each section of the rope, top pretension, mooring horizontal radiation distance and the like are determined through iterative computation by giving consideration to specific requirements of design specifications on various indicators under the condition of given rope specifications, operating water depth and allowable limit horizontal offset of a floating body, and accordingly horizontal restoration characteristics of the rope reaches optimum under the condition of controlling total steel consumption and mooring load, and then structure types and stress situations of the rope under different states are computed to bring convenience to type selection of mooring equipment. Compared with existing commercial software such as mooring analysis software MOSES and SESAM, the method has the advantages of oriented design, high practicality, high convergence speed and the like, achieves optimal selection of various design parameters and can be used for preliminary scheme design and performance evaluation of deepwater floating type platform catenary mooring systems.
assignees: CHINA NAT OFFSHORE OIL CORP;CNOOC RES INST

title_en: A kind of online bulk power grid recovers aid decision-making system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of online bulk power grid and recover aid decision-making system, system comprises real-time auxiliary mode and researchs and analyses pattern two kinds of mode of operations, comprises section Operations Analyst module: read and cross section regulation for section; Calculate configuration module: to arrange for calculating parameter, black starting-up Power Selection and be activated Power Selection; Computing function module: for system partitioning, Load flow calculation, EM transient calculation, electromechanical transient calculating and route searching and assessment; Management of computing module: the display generating scheme for system partitioning scheme, voltage waveform, available path rank and black starting-up.Application the present invention develops online power system recovery auxiliary decision-making support system, control centre's available data resource can be made full use of, combine the advantage of prediction scheme restoration methods and intelligent scheduling, without the need to modeling again, reduce system Construction time and cost, improve real-time and the accuracy of decision recommendation, for the fast and reliable after electrical network large-scale blackout is recovered to provide strong support.

title_en: Paint composition
title_ko: 결로 및 수중 조건하의 중성화된 콘크리트의 성능복원 기능성 도료 조성물
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A functional paint composition is provided to enable a performance restoration of the concrete structure which is neutralized on the condition of flooding, condensation by strengthening the alkalinity of the underwater-hardening epoxy- silicate hybrid resin. CONSTITUTION: A manufacturing method of a functional paint composition comprises the following steps. An underwater-hardening epoxy resin and aqueous potassium silicate are provided. A deformed epoxy resin of high viscosity (1,500 CPS) is changed to low viscosity (100-500 CPS) by using a diluent, and less than 5% parts by weight of natural resin is added base on the total weight. 23% of potassium silicate resin compare to the total weight of solid content is stirred at 70-80°C, RPM 1500-2500 for 1-2 hours; potassium hydroxide which is catalyst and water are dropped down. 20-30°C, and the RPM 500-3,000 condition are maintained in the potassium silicate resin. The epoxy resin of low viscosity is dropped down as a small amount (100g) to the edge of vortex. The temperature is increased to 60-100°C and the RPM 200-1,000 condition is maintained. 40-60% of water and dilutent are evaporated base on the total weight of the added water and dilutent. The evaporated resin is cooled at a room temperature and less than 1% of anticoagulation agent is added.
abstract_ko:
하수 및 정수처리장, 지하저장탱크류, 및 해양구조물 등의 콘크리트 구조물들은 침수 혹은 다습한 결로조건하에 항상 노출되어 있으며, 이로 인한 콘크리트의 염해 및 중성화는 가속화된다. 또한 이러한 결로 및 수중 조건하의 중성화된 콘크리트의 보수 및 성능복원은 결로및 수중조건으로 인하여 각종 코팅재 및 성능복원재 등의 시공이 힘들며, 또한 코팅재 등의 건조 및 경화조건을 갖추기가 어려워 사실상 경화반응 및 건조과정이 수반되는 코팅재 및 복원재의 적용이 불가능하다. 
따라서 이러한 결로 및 수중 조건하의 중성화된 콘크리트의 성능복원이 가능한  수중경화형 에폭시 - 실리케이트 하이브리드 기능성도료 조성물과 이를 제조하는 방법을 제시 한다.
assignees: SI CHEM CO LTD

title_en: Safety evaluation system for base isolated building
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a safety evaluation system for a base isolated building, capable of performing suitable safety evaluation considering changes in a building and ground property characteristics after a seismic disaster in the base isolated building.SOLUTION: Acceleration sensors are attached to ground 4 and a building 2. Usual microvibration values of the ground 4 and the building 2 before and after an earthquake and acceleration values during the earthquake are measured, and a base isolation strength restoration characteristic K' and residual displacement δ' of a base isolation layer are found out. Further, an amplification rate G' of surface ground is found out. These values K', δ', G' are reset and base isolation layer response displacement after the earthquake is calculated. Whether the base isolation response displacement is included within a design limit or not is determined to perform safety determination. A residual energy absorption amount of the base isolation layer is calculated from the residual displacement δ' and whether residual energy absorption capacity for an aftershock exists or not is determined.
assignees: DAIWA HOUSE IND

title_en: Sliding sand disaster prevention and control device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a sliding sand disaster prevention and control device used for fixing sliding sand on a sand slope. The sliding sand disaster prevention and control device comprises timber piles, timber pile connecting battens and vegetation planting bags. The timber piles are placed into the sand slope, the tops of the timber piles are connected through the timber pile connecting battens, and the vegetation planting bags are placed beside the timber piles. Compared with the prior art, the sliding sand disaster prevention and control device has the advantages that survival of vegetation can be well promoted by placing the timber piles in the sand slope; restoration and rehabilitation of the ecological environment are facilitated because a protection effective period is long with the method of fixing the sand through the vegetation; construction is simple and convenient because when the device is used, a worker only needs to place the timber piles into the sand slope, connect the tops of the timber piles through the battens and place the vegetation planting bags.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: The distribution network operating safety appraisal procedure of load restoration value is lost based on distribution network failure
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of operating safety appraisal procedure losing load restoration value based on distribution network failure, belong to dispatching automation of electric power systems and grid simulation technical field. Distribution network is carried out N-1 fault scanning by the method, dead electricity load carries out under each fault recovery and optimization and calculates the dead electricity load value that can recover; After having scanned, the cumulative dead electricity load every time recovered obtains total recovery dead electricity load value. According to total dead electricity load value, total mistake load value that may recover, total recovery load value, set up distribution network Operational Safety indicators. This wherein, fault lose load restoration optimization be consider meritorious, idle, voltage and radial operation constraint the detailed recovery and optimization model of distribution network, this MIXED INTEGER quadratic constraints programming problem adopt branch and bound method solve; The present invention based on above-mentioned optimization model, the index of the distribution network operating safety assessment of formulation, it is possible to reflect the security of current distribution network operational conditions and network structure.

title_en: Backhoe
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a backhoe that is suitable for a variety of applications by a single machine, is capable of more quickly and safely carrying out construction work, can urgently be dispatched to in a dangerous zone with the road access thereto being blocked, in preparation not only for restoration from a common disaster but also for a catastrophe anticipated to occur in the near future, and can fully demonstrate its functionality and mobility on site.SOLUTION: A backhoe according to crane specifications whereby a frame mount is attached to a truck frame, namely a moving subject, in a manner fully turnable by 360° and a crane constructed by sequentially connecting a boom, an arm and a hook-equipped bucket is tiltably installed on the frame mount, can be as a whole, disassembled into a plurality of assemblies, units or the like or can be reassembled therefrom, and includes a receiver of maneuver signals from a portable transmitter so that at least travelling, turning and crane operation can be radio-controlled.
assignees: KENKI SERVICE KK

title_en: Power conversion device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To obtain an interleave power conversion device having a plurality of step-up chopper circuits and capable of withstanding a rush current that possibly occurs at power on or restoration from blackout, without a large cost increase.SOLUTION: An interleave power conversion device includes reactors 3a-3d, switching elements 4a-4d and diodes 5a-5d, with a plurality of step-up chopper circuits 9a-9d in parallel connection to raise a voltage by chopping the output of a rectifier circuit 2 for rectifying AC power 1. The interleave power conversion device further includes a second diode 8 that bypasses the plurality of step-up chopper circuits 9a-9d in parallel connection, so that the rush current that occurs at power on or restoration from blackout is made to flow in an integrated manner.
assignees: MITSUBISHI ELECTRIC CORP

title_en: The method controlling light and the system using the same
title_ko: 조명 제어 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A righting control method and system are provided to reduce restoration costs by generally managing lighting restoration of a lighting device after power outage. CONSTITUTION: Power is supplied to a lighting device (300). An information request message is transmitted to a lighting management device (100). An information response message is received through a wireless network. A lamp is executed with lighting information included in the information response message. A lighting execution request message is received from a user interface device (200). [Reference numerals] (100) Lighting management device; (200) User interface device; (300) Lighting device

assignees: SAMSUNG ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Service process fault detection method, device and service node
abstract_en: The invention discloses a service process fault detection method, device and service node, so as to simplify a service process fault detection process, and shorten HBase disaster recovery restoration response time. The service process fault detection method comprises the following steps: a first service node starts a service process and a local mirroring monitor process, wherein the first service node invokes the started service process to provide data inquiry service; the first service node regularly checks the state of the service process according to the mirroring monitor process, and confirming whether the state of the service process is abnormal or not; when the mirroring monitor process confirms that the state of the service process is abnormal, the first service node notices a cluster management node Master.
assignees: ALIBABA GROUP HOLDING LTD

title_en: Comprehensive prevention and control facility structure suitable for wind and sand of railway of plateau river wide-valley section
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a wind and sand comprehensive prevention and control facility structure suitable for wind and sand of a railway of a plateau river wide-valley section. The structure comprises a wide-valley overflow dam, a bank slope eave type T-shaped sand retaining wall, a high vertical V-shaped energy-dissipation, wind-prevention and sand-blocking fence and a chemical sand-fixing, net-covering and artificial vegetation-restoration area, and is arranged on a wide-valley bank slope at the peripheries of the railway and a wide-valley bridge. According to the principle of adjusting measures to local conditions and fortifying to disasters, the comprehensive protection system which integrates sand prevention, sand blocking, sand fixing and sediment discharge is formed, the blind area of the wind and sand prevention and control technology of the plateau railway is filled, and the theoretical basis and technical reserves are provided for the wind and sand prevention and control of the railway of the plateau river wide-valley section. The structure has been applied to the prevention and control of wind and sand disasters of Tuotuo river wide-valley section of Qinghai-Tibet railway, the better ecologic and economic benefits are generated, and the promotion on the safe running of the Qinghai-Tibet railway and the improvement of local ecologic environments is ensured.
assignees: COLD & ARID REGIONS ENVIRONMENTAL & ENG RES INST CAS

title_en: Data management device, data division device, and data restoration device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To reduce the possibility of data losses due to disasters or troubles while maintaining confidentiality under a secrete dispersion law.SOLUTION: A data management device 10 creates divided data of cipher text in addition to divided data of plain text used under a well-known secrete dispersion law, and stores the divided data of plain text and the divided data of cipher text in storage devices 301 to 305. If there are k pieces or more of divided data of plain text, the original data can be restored, and if there l pieces or more of divided data of cipher text, the original data can be restored. A threshold value l used in restoring the original data from the divided data of cipher text is smaller than a threshold value k used in restoring the original data from the divided data of plain text. The data management device 10 normally restores the original data from the divided data of plain text, but if the number of the divided data of plain text is less than the threshold value k, the original dada is restored from the divided data of cipher text.
assignees: HITACHI SOLUTIONS LTD

title_en: Emergency disaster information receiver
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an emergency disaster information receiver which improves peripheral safety by receiving a television broadcast signal from a broadcast station transmitting emergency disaster information by using an AC carrier of a television broadcast signal when disaster occurs, informing a periphery that the emergency disaster information is included in a reception signal when the emergency disaster information is included in the reception signal and operating an external device such as a television receiver.SOLUTION: In emergency earthquake prompt report reception processing, restoration of an emergency earthquake prompt report in an AC demodulation section is displayed on a display section when the report is restored in the AC demodulation section (S110) and an alarm sound is generated from an alarm sound generation section in accordance with setting of a user (S130). A control signal for safely operating an external device such as an elevator is outputted from an output terminal 8 (S190). A command signal (power-on command, emergency broadcast channel selection command) for receiving emergency broadcast is transmitted to an external television receiver from a remote control transmission section (S170 and S180).
assignees: MASPRO DENKO KK

title_en: Power distribution network maintenance embodiment optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of power distribution network maintenance embodiment optimization method, its step is as follows: the collection of power distribution network and controller switching equipment information; Calculate the fault rate of controller switching equipment; The operation risk of assessment power distribution network, the maintenance earning rate of calculating maintenance scheme; Adopt particle swarm optimization algorithm to be optimized maintenance scheme, particle fitness value is the maintenance earning rate of maintenance scheme. Beneficial effect of the present invention is as follows: compared with power distribution network Maintenance Schedule Optimization method instantly, power distribution network Maintenance Schedule Optimization method of the present invention to the assessment of power distribution network risk more comprehensively accurately, consider the interaction of many factors, optimize the repair schedule scheme that obtains more scientific and reasonable, be conducive to effectively carrying out and the reduction of cost of service work.

title_en: Wide area disaster support device system for elevator
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a wide area disaster support device for an elevator capable of effectively implementing a restoration plan with priorities assigned to lifesaving even if a user is confined in an elevator car during wide area disaster.SOLUTION: In this system, if wide area disaster occurs and a wide area disaster support device S1 is started, an analysis result signal from an image analysis device for analyzing by image-processing imaged data by imaging devices provided in elevating machines EL1 to EL3 is issued to a monitoring center K1 through monitoring terminals T1 to T3 and a general public telephone circuit N. The image analysis device issues the analysis result signal added with a ranked urgency index if an aspect in need of rescue of users in the elevating machines EL1 to EL3 is identified. The monitoring center K1 identifies a current position of a worker based on positional information acquired from a portable terminal TM for worker, refers to the urgency index indicated in the analysis result signal, produces an optimal traveling route for the elevating machines EL1 to EL3 with priority assigned thereto, and provides it to the portable terminal TM.
assignees: HITACHI BUILDING SYS CO LTD

title_en: Safety storage method for electromagnetic wave emitting substance such as radiation
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method for safely sealing environmental pollutants by radioactivity and surely and stably storing them for long periods, as well as the collection of radioactive materials scattered to environment as known publicly and the restoration of the radiation ray disaster at Fukushima nuclear power plant caused by the earthquake disaster on 11th March is an urgently needed subject.SOLUTION: Waste collected as radioactive waste is safely stored in container cabinets 3, 4, 5, etc. that are treated by radiophylaxis countermeasures, and a storage area is set. This method can ensure the long-term storage of the radioactive waste under an accumulation safety control by techniques such as multi-stage loading technique and a burying technique.
assignees: KATO YOSHIHARU

title_en: Method for managing mine environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for managing the mine environment. The method is characterized by comprising the following steps of cutting slopes, removing dangers, hanging nets, positioning the nets, spraying and sowing base materials, covering a mine with the nets and maintaining. After a year and a half, plants grow naturally, and mine afforesting recovering is finished. According to the method, geological disasters such as collapse and creeping down do not happen on the mine with afforesting recovered, a mine body with the afforesting recovered does not need to be maintained by people, the mine body and surrounding nature mountains are in harmony as an organic whole and are synchronous in four seasons, the plants grow naturally, the natural mountains are recovered, and the method makes a contribution to nation management on the geological disasters and ecological restoration.

title_en: Fire receiver and disaster prevention system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a fire receiver whose operation buttons are operated in appropriate order at the non-occurrence of a fire.SOLUTION: In a fire receiver A connected to a sensor line L2 and a district acoustic line L1, and equipped with a guide display/operation part 23 in which a guide area 23a for the occurrence of a fire and a guide area 23b for the non-occurrence of a fire are separately disposed, a main acoustic stop button 31 for stopping the acoustic of the fire receiver A, a district acoustic stop button 32 for stopping a district acoustic, and a restoration button 35 for restoring the fire receiver A in a monitoring state are longitudinally disposed in order from the top in the guide area 23b for the non-occurrence of a fire of the guide display/operation part 23.
assignees: PANASONIC CORP

title_en: Handshake synchronization by adjusting status of status machine of receiving end to a state indicated by status reset signal
abstract_en: A handshake synchronization restoration method and system based on visible light communication are provided. The method includes: after a transmitting end in which a state machine varies with unit time is powered on again, transmitting in the form of a visible light signal, to a receive and control system, a status reset signal which varies with unit time, wherein the receive and control system comprises one or multiple receiving ends; and receiving, by the receive and control system, the visible light signal, and when it is determined that the received visible light signal is a status reset signal, adjusting status of a state machine of a receiving end to a state indicated by the status reset signal. Status synchronization with the transmitting end is restored, avoiding a case in which the transmitting end is asynchronous with the receiving end after encountering power outage and being powered on again.
assignees: KUANG-CHI INNOVATIVE TECH LTD

title_en: Multifunctional equipment for comprehensively managing coal gangue dumps
abstract_en: The utility model relates to multifunctional equipment for comprehensively managing coal gangue dumps, and belongs to the field of mining machinery and ecological restoration engineering multi-subject technologies. The multifunctional equipment has the advantages that the multifunctional equipment is mainly used for grouting shallow holes; the integral equipment which is provided with an independent framework and is suitable to be carried by different types of vehicles is modified on the basis of a forest mud fire-fighting truck, an additional belt gun driven by a screw pump (10) is specially used for a shallow hole grouting fire extinguishing and fireproofing paddle mixer system with a horizontal shaft, blades (17) can be repositioned and are detachably arranged on a rotary shaft (16), and the multifunctional equipment is specially provided with a water injection system and a safety operation platform (30); the multifunctional equipment is multifunctional, is particularly applicable to shallow hole grouting fire extinguishing, fireproofing and vegetation soil dressing for comprehensively managing the coal gangue dumps, also can be used for extinguishing fire in forests and spraying water in gardens, is easy to popularize and apply and can be easily manufactured on a large scale in a standard manner.
