title_en: Solar power generation module, solar battery cel coating member, and solar power generation system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To secure safety at the time of maintenance work or disaster restoration work of solar power generation system.SOLUTION: A solar power generation module 1 comprises: a solar battery cell 10 which converts the energy of sunlight incident on a light receiving surface into electric energy; and a dimmer film 11 which covers the light-receiving surface of the solar battery cell 10 and which switches between a light transmitted state and a light shielded state depending on the presence of voltage application. In a solar power generation system 200, the dimmer film 11 is connected to a commercial power supply 60. The dimmer film 11 is placed into a light transmitted state by voltage application. Sunlight is incident on the light-receiving surface of the solar battery cell 10, thereby generating electric power. When voltage application to the dimmer film 11 stops, the dimmer film 11 is placed into a light shielded state. Sunlight incident on the light-receiving surface of the solar battery cell 10 is shielded and power generation is thereby stopped.
assignees: TOSHIBA CORP

title_en: Power distribution network fault treatment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power distribution network fault treatment method and belongs to the technical field of power network management. A platform comprises a fault information acquisition system, a fault information study and judgment system and a fault clearing and power failure/supply information push system. The method is characterized by acquiring information of faults requested to be cleared, line faults and consumption acquisition faults in an existing 95598 system, a distribution automation management system and a power consumption information acquisition system, after receiving and verifying the information, carrying out equipment locating, fault information screening, line topology analysis, equipment operation information analysis and line switch analysis to determine and display the fault types, places and areas of influence in an existing GIS (geographic information system), guiding fault clearing according to the determined fault results and simultaneously pushing the power failure information and power restoration information to users. The platform and the method can be used for achieving centralized acquisition and advanced automatic study and judgment of existing various fault information, can be used for actively pushing the power failure and power restoration information to the users and can interact with the users.
assignees: NANJING POWER SUPPLY CO JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;JIANGSU SUYUAN HIGH TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Multiple failure protection/restoration methods and system in Power Optical Fiber Communication Network In China
abstract_en: The present invention provides the multiple failure protection/restoration methods and system in a kind of Power Optical Fiber Communication Network In China, the described method comprises the following steps：Obtain network topological information, business demand information and link information；The grade of service, service protection in the business demand information recover the survivability priority level for requiring to determine given business；M is set up according to the network topological information, link information：N sourcesink nodes pair；When there is multiple failure in detecting Power Optical Fiber Communication Network In China, the M that judgement pre-builds：Whether N sourcesinks node is to that can protect the link that multiple failure occurs；If it is not, then priority protection/recovery survivability priority level business high.The method of the present invention and system ensure that survivability of the power optical fiber communication network under major natural disasters; ensure that the lasting of power optical fiber communication network, reliable communication capacity; Power Optical Fiber Communication Network In China protection is enhanced to the resist ability of failure risk, the property safety of power system is protected.

title_en: Emergent evacuation and escape central control unit system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an emergent evacuation and escape central control unit system. A central control unit serves as a network manager and sends network management messages. All emergency lighting units response sequentially and report respective work states. The central control unit is also compatible with a control room emergency lighting charger for charging a storage battery in a phased manner with full-course restoration, thereby preventing the storage battery from being vulcanized and aged due to being laid up for a long term and prolonging the service life of the storage battery. The charger is provided with a CAN communication interface and maintains the communication with other emergent evacuation and escape chargers. Fault content of the whole system is collected through a CAN bus and the specific positions and fault content are displayed, thereby warning people to remove faults in time, guaranteeing that the system can work normally during disasters, and reducing unnecessary personnel casualties.
assignees: YUAN BO

title_en: Method and system for restoring power after fault of power distribution network containing DGs (distributed generation)
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for restoring power after fault of a power distribution network containing DGs. According to the method, the DGs integrated in the power distribution network are processed in a classified manner according to the control method of the DGs and are divided into main power supplies and ordinary power supplies, wherein the main power supplies are controllable DGs, and the ordinary power supplies are random and uncontrollable DGs; and meanwhile, a standby contact wire is used as a main power supply, then, a multi-agent system for power restoration after fault of the power distribution network containing the DGs is established, and the optimum power supply scheme of a power-losing area is planned in a master-slave control mode. Compared with the prior art, the standby contact wire and the DGs integrated in the power distribution network are fully utilized in the restoration process, the power outage load is restored to the maximum, and the isolated island operation capacity of the DGs and randomness and volatility of output power are given full consideration, so that a restoration scheme can continuously and stably operate.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Management device, power supply system, electronic device, management method, shutdown method, and program
abstract_en: Provided is a management device (30) that has: an electronic device control means for controlling operations of multiple electronic devices (20) which are configured so as to receive electricity from a common uninterruptible power supply device (10) in the event of a power outage of a commercial power supply; and a monitoring means for detecting power outage and restoration of the commercial power supply. The electronic device control means transmits a shutdown command to some of the electronic devices (20) if the monitoring means does not detect restoration of the commercial power supply before a predetermined amount of time passes after the monitoring means detected power outage of the commercial power supply.
assignees: NEC CORP;BINGO HIROAKI

title_en: Mining spoil heap rainfall infiltration experimental apparatus and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mining spoil heap rainfall infiltration experimental apparatus and a method, and belongs to the field of environment geotechnical engineering. The mining spoil heap rainfall infiltration experimental apparatus comprises a control platform, an observing device, a rainfall device, a natural wind stimulator, and a stimulator. The mining spoil heap rainfall infiltration experimental apparatus is capable of stimulating, with consideration of influences of different wind speeds and wind directions, erosion effects, which are caused by different rainfall conditions on mining spoil heaps with different slop angles and different inner structure characteristics, and leaching characteristics which are caused by infiltrated rain in the inner parts of mining spoil heaps. It is beneficial for analysis of environmental geology disasters caused by mining spoil heaps under rainfall conditions. The mining spoil heap rainfall infiltration experimental apparatus is also capable of realizing verification and demonstration on implementation effects of mining spoil heap ecological restoration technology by changing materials in stimulated mining spoil heaps. In addition, in verification processes, parameter setting, data monitoring, recording and processing can all be completed via centralized control processing of the control platform, so that experimental effect is ensured, and experimental efficiency is improve greatly.
assignees: UNIV LIAONING TECHNICAL;INST OF ROCK & SOIL MECH CAS

title_en: Metal-mining-area soil-water interface heavy metal pollution load forecasting method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metal-mining-area soil-water interface heavy metal pollution load forecasting method. The metal-mining-area soil-water interface heavy metal pollution load forecasting method mainly comprises the following steps of sample collection and pre-processing, sample detection, data processing, building of a GIS database, building of a metal-mining-area soil-water interface heavy metal migration and transformation kinetic model, and building, verification and optimization of a forecasting model method. The fitting degree of the forecasting method with a measured value of an actual load can meet the requirement for forecasting precision, and therefore theoretical foundations and scientific bases are provided for evaluation, controlling, treatment, restoration and the like of ecological risks of metal-mining-area heavy metal pollution.
assignees: UNIV HUNAN SCI & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Method for multi-failure power restoration of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for multi-failure power restoration of a power distribution network. The method overcomes the defect that a traditional method for multi-failure power restoration of the power distribution network cannot solve multiple failures. The method for multi-failure power restoration of the power distribution network comprises the steps that multi-failure judgment is conducted on multiple failures with processing unfinished, and multiple failures and multiple independent failures are formed; then independent failure restoration area division is conducted on the multiple failures, and power restoration is conducted on independent failure restoration areas one by one; after the multiple failures are processed, power restoration is conducted on each independent failure. By the adoption of the method for multi-failure power restoration of the power distribution network, the power restoration efficiency is greatly improved, and the real-time performance of power restoration is improved; the factor of load balance is considered when public power restoration lines are decoupled, so that the load rates of the power restoration lines participating in power restoration are more similar after failure restoration, and therefore the power supply reliability of the power distribution network is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;LAIWU POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: A kind of multiple failure service restoration method based on load balancing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of multiple failure service restoration method based on load balancing, the method overcome the shortcoming that traditional distribution network failure restoration methods can not solve multiple failure, multiple failure is carried out independently-powered recovery district subregion, then according to public power point is decoupled by the principle of load balancing, thus realize utilizing substance fail-over policy to be powered independent failure recovery district recovering and not influencing each other.The present invention substantially increases service restoration efficiency, be conducive to the real-time of service restoration, the decoupling of public service restoration circuit when, consider the factor of load balancing, so that after fault recovery, the rate of load condensate of the service restoration circuit participating in service restoration is more nearly, and improves the power supply reliability of power distribution network.

title_en: System for dynamically predicating power load of iron and steel enterprise in short period
abstract_en: The invention provides a system for dynamically predicating the power load of an iron and steel enterprise in a short period and belongs to the technical field of energy predication of iron and steel enterprises. According to hardware, the system comprises an application server, a relational data base server, a client side PC and a network device connecting all computers. The network device comprises a switch, network cables, a firewall and a router device. The application server and the relational data base server are connected to the switch through the network cables. The external client side PC is connected to a router. The router is connected with the switch through the firewall, so that communication between a client side and a server side is achieved. A software system comprises a heterogeneous data platform and a load predicating system. The load predicating system is composed of a load analyzing module, a predication configuration module and a load predicating module. The system for dynamically predicating the power load of the iron and steel enterprise in the short period has the advantages that the power utilization characteristics of each power utilization link, the technological feature, a production plan, a repair schedule and production working condition information are comprehensively considered, classified modeling is conducted, a predication value of the total load is obtained according to superposition of predication results, the predication value is in line with the reality of the iron and steel enterprise, information, technological rhythms and dynamic working condition information are fully considered in the process of dynamic predication, and models are better in adaptability.
assignees: AUTOMATION RES & DESIGN INST METALLURG INDUSTRY

title_en: Transmission and distribution seismic structure of the cable and a number of underground power protection devices guyong
title_ko: 송배전 케이블의 회수와 내진구조를 갖는 지중 전력구용 보호장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a protection device for an underground tunnel capable of collecting transmission and distribution cables and having an earthquake-proof structure and, more specifically, to a transmission and distribution cable protection device which is installed inside a tunnel buried underground. The present invention comprises a cover part (100), plates (200), and a buffer member (300). The cover part has a space part (101) inside and one upper side is connected to the other upper side by a hinge. The cover part is selectively opened by combining a bolt (103) with the side opposite of where the hinge is connected, and comprises a roller part (110) including a groove (111) which is formed from the inside to the outside, an elastic body (112) which has force of restoration and is formed at the lower side of the groove (111), a contact member (113) which is formed on the elastic body (112), and a rotation bearing (114) which is in contact with the upper side of the contact member (113) and rotates by being hung at both end parts of the grooves (111), and a plurality of hooks (120) formed on the outer side. The plates (200) comprise a combination groove (201) which is formed to penetrate in an up-down direction, and multiple protrusions (203) which protrude toward one side and form a groove and is selectively combined with one side of the tunnel (400) through the combination groove (201) by a combination member (205). The buffer member (300) connects each of the hooks (120) of the cover part (100) and the protrusions (203) of the plates (200). The present invention can absorb impacts through the buffer member (300) in seismic events and can easily collect only the transmission and distribution cables (c) while rotating by the roller part (110) when collecting the transmission and distribution cables (c) inserted into the space part (101).
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 송배전 케이블의 회수와 내진구조를 갖는 지중 전력구용 보호장치에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 지중에 매설되는 전력구의 내부에 설치되는 송배전 케이블 보호장치에 있어서, 내부에 공간부(101)가 형성되며 상부 일측이 상호 힌지 결합되고 상기 힌지 결합된 타측에 볼트(103)로 결합 구성되어 선택적으로 개폐 가능하도록 구성되되, 내측에서 외측으로 홈(111)이 형성되며 상기 홈(111)의 하측에 복원력을 갖는 탄성체(112)와 상기 탄성체(112)의 안착되는 밀착부재(113)와, 상기 밀착부재(113)의 상측에 맞닿으며 상기 홈(111)의 양측 끝부에 걸림 되어 회전하는 회전베어링(114)이 구성되는 롤러부(110)와 외측이 다수의 걸림고리(120)가 구성되는 커버부(100)와, 상, 하로 관통되게 형성되는 결합홈(201)과 일측으로 돌출되며 홈을 형성하는 다수의 걸림구(203)가 구성되어 결합부재(205)로 상기 결합홈(201)을 통해 상기 전력구(400)의 일측과 선택적으로 결합 구성되는 플레이트(200)들과, 상기 커버부(100)의 걸림고리(120)와 플레이트(200)들의 걸림구(203)를 각각 연결하는 완충부재(300)로 구성되어, 내진 발생 시 완충부재(300)를 통해 충격을 흡수 할 수 있으며 상기 공간부(101)에 끼움된 송배전 케이블(c)을 회수 시 롤러부(110)에 의해 회전하며 용이하게 송배전 케이블(c)만 회수가 가능한 유지보수가 용이한 발명인 것이다.
assignees: KIM KYU HYEON

title_en: The method that a kind of iron and steel enterprise cost of electricity-generating optimizes
abstract_en: The method that a kind of iron and steel enterprise cost of electricity-generating optimizes, belongs to iron and steel enterprise's integrated power-saving technical field.Step comprises determining that T dispatching cycle needing to carry out cost of electricity-generating optimization, obtains unit generation cost optimization parameter；Obtain the network section for the establishment of generation schedule a few days ago；Determine consider in the cycle coal gas mix burning in the case of generating set fuel cost；The Optimal Operation Model with the minimum target of total system cost of electricity-generating is set up according to enterprise's units consumption, outer purchases strategies and outer power transmission income practical situation；Obtain enterprise's self generating sets according to Optimization Solution to exert oneself, outer purchase of electricity, send the result etc. of electricity outside.Advantage is, can meet production load needs, generating set exert oneself, the task such as line transmission capacity, ensure the safe and stable operation of utility power grid simultaneously, in conjunction with load prediction curve, produce and repair schedule, optimize and revise self power generation further to exert oneself, and self power generation and the proportionate relationship of outer power purchase, make enterprise's cost of electricity-generating minimum.

title_en: A kind of future-state alternating-current flow of power grid generates method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of future-state alternating-current flow of power grid and generate method.The method comprises the following steps: 1) select an electrical network real time execution section as initial section；2) grid generation planning data is obtained；3) maintenance scheduling for power systems data are obtained；4) bus load prediction data is obtained；5) interconnection planning data is obtained；6) electric network swim is driven to calculate；7) dominant eigenvalues deviation value is calculated ；8) modified load injects；9) electric network swim is driven to calculate；10) set each electromotor and participate in adjustment state of exerting oneself as initial set value, obtain from the nominal parameter of electromotor；11) preserve the electrical network section after having adjusted, be successfully generated future-state trend.The present invention, based on true operation of power networks section, takes into full account future anticipation and the planning datas such as generation schedule, repair schedule, interconnection trading program, bus load prediction data, automatically adjusts and generate future-state AC power flow；The power flow solutions of future-state forecast accurately is provided, provides complete basic flow data for plan security check.

title_en: Intelligent community electricity consumption information collecting server system and data processing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power technology, particularly to an intelligent community electricity consumption information collecting server system and a data processing method. According to the technical scheme, the intelligent community electricity consumption information collecting server system comprises an application server, the application server is connected with a client, a browser, an interface server and a prepositive server, the prepositive server is connected with a database server, the client comprises a user interaction module, the browser comprises an information display module, the application server comprises a service application module and a support service module, the prepositive serve comprises a collection task module, a protocol processing module and a communication calling module. The intelligent community electricity consumption information collecting server system and the data processing method have the advantages that a database system in the intelligent community electricity consumption information collecting server system and the data processing method supports complete data backup and restoration mechanisms and can meet the requirements of storage, retrieval, mining and the like of high-capacity data.
assignees: Guiyang Power Supply Bureau

title_en: Predication method for load peak in power distribution area
abstract_en: The invention relates to a predication method for load peak of a power distribution area. Based on a predication model established by a time sequence of long-term data acquisition, the predication method comprises the following steps of (1) obtaining daily peak data of the load of the area according to the historical load data of the area; (2) carrying out discrimination and restoration on distortion and deletion in the data; (3) establishing a periodicity equation according to an autocorrelation function of the daily peak data of the load; (4) establishing a gradient equation according to the autocorrelation function of the data with periodicity; (5) establishing a predication model of the daily peak of the load by combination of the periodicity equation and the gradient equation; (6) obtaining estimation of model parameters by enabling the quadratic sum of errors to be minimum; and (7) obtaining a load predication value of the daily peak of time points in the future according to the established model. The predication method has the advantages that the blank and the defects in the prior art are filled and overcome, the accuracy is high, the operability is high and the predication of the daily peak of the load of the area is realized.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;USTC UNIV SCIENCE TECH CN

title_en: Disaster information management apparatus, disaster information system, disaster information management method, disaster information management program, portable terminal, control method of portable terminal, and control program of controlling operation of portable terminal
abstract_en: To attempt to extend a providing service by allowing collection of various kinds of information and early restoration of a defective function in a disaster response infrastructure network, in a disaster information system, a disaster information management apparatus for collecting disaster information via a network includes a terminal information acquirer that acquires terminal information including the current position and identification information of a portable terminal, a need information generator that generates, from received disaster information, need information including information about a need which can be satisfied by the operation of an apparatus, and a request information generator that generates, based on the terminal information and the need information, request information for requesting the portable terminal existing within a range of a predetermined distance from the occurrence location of the need to operate the apparatus necessary for satisfying the need, and transmits the request information.
assignees: NEC CORP

title_en: Power distribution network dynamic power restoration method based on load curve
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution network dynamic power restoration method based on a load curve, which belongs to the technical field of power distribution system automation. The method utilizes a computer, realizes computing through programs and comprises the steps of inputting basic parameters; computing active load and reactive load of each node in each hour and determining a grid structure in normal operation; determining a fault section, a power supply path of the power side of the fault section and a grid structure after failure isolation; applying a traditional genetic algorithm to determine a candidate grid structure set of the least loss load in each hour during fault restoration; finally determining the optimum dynamic power restoration scheme during fault restoration. The method fully utilizes the load curve, and the dynamic restoration scheme is formulated by hour, so that the grid structure changes along with the change of the load during fault restoration, and accordingly, the method has the characteristics of being capable of effectively reducing power failure areas caused by fault, shortening power failure time for users, reducing the power failure loss of the users, and the like. The method can be widely applied to power distribution network power restoration.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Method for manufacturing assembled type bridge pier by utilizing steel fiber reinforced self-compacting concrete
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for manufacturing an assembled type bridge pier by utilizing steel fiber reinforced self-compacting concrete. The method comprises the steps of preparing the concrete, prefabricating bridge pier segments, assembling the bridge pier segments, fixing the bridge pier segments and the like. By the adoption of the assembled type bridge pier manufactured through the method, construction and pouring quality can be guaranteed, the construction efficiency of a bridge is enhanced, and the seismic performance of the bridge pier can also be improved. The assembled type bridge pier is made of certain steel fiber reinforced self-compacting concrete, the comprehensive power performance of the segments is superior, and seismic performance of connector parts is 2-3 times that of existing common concrete prefabricated segments under the condition that structures and sizes are equal. The bridge pier segments in the structure are assembled in the mode that a shear key is connected with a short reinforcing steel bar in an inserted mode, the shock resistance, pier energy consumption, post-earthquake restoration in potential plastic hinge areas between the segments and other seismic-area dynamic properties are superior, and the method can be applicable to construction of the bridge pier. By the adoption of the steel fiber reinforced self-compacting concrete, concrete on the surface of a finished bridge pier is not prone to cracking, and therefore durability is good.
assignees: CHINA MERCHANTS CHONGQING COMM RES & DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: System and method for managing service restoration in a utility network
abstract_en: Some embodiments include a computer-implemented restoration work plan system and method comprising a processor, a non-transitory computer-readable storage medium in data communication with the processor, and a service restoration management system executable by the processor, and configured to prepare a first distribution system operations storm outage prediction project model forecast substantially in real time based at least in part on a weather forecast. Some embodiments include calculating and displaying an expected outage category level substantially in real time for each division based on the weather forecast, and resource numbers comprising the number of personnel needed to respond to outages and the number of crew needed to repair outages. Some embodiments include calculating and displaying an estimated time of repair within the repair plan based at least in part on a historical productivity assumption, the productivity assumption including a historical rate of assessment and repair and percentage of outages requiring repair.
assignees: PACIFIC GAS AND ELECTRIC CO

title_en: System and operation method for error restoration of distribution line
title_ko: 배전선로 고장복구 시스템 및 이의 운용방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for recovering an error of a distribution line and an operation method thereof capable of supporting the error recovery of the distribution line. The present invention comprises a distribution information obtainment unit and a distribution control unit. The distribution information obtainment unit is installed in a substation and extracts a final blackout feeder by obtaining the state information and the error recovery information of the substation when the error is generated in the substation. The distribution control unit performs the error recovery of the substation by determining whether or not the error recovery is possible through constant opening point connection or constant connecting point separation of the distribution line based on the final blackout feeder. The distribution information obtainment unit extracts the final blackout feeder when the error recovery in the substation is impossible by determining an error type through the state information and determining whether or not the error recovery in the substation is possible. [Reference numerals] (110) Substation; (120) Distribution information obtainment unit; (130) Front end processing device; (140) Distribution control unit; (150) Distribution station
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 배전선로의 고장복구를 지원하는 배전선로 고장복구 시스템 및 이의 운용방법에 관한 것으로, 변전소에 설치되어, 상기 변전소 고장 발생시 상기 변전소의 상태정보 및 고장복구정보를 취득하여 최종 정전 피더(feeder)를 추출하는 배전 정보 취득부; 및 상기 추출된 최종 정전 피더(feeder)를 토대로 상기 배전선로의 상시 개방점 연결 또는 상시 연결점 분리를 통해 고장복구가 가능한지 여부를 판단하여 상기 변전소의 고장복구가 수행되도록 하는 배전 제어부;를 포함하고, 상기 배전 정보 취득부는, 상기 상태정보를 통해 고장 형태를 판단하고, 상기 고장복구정보를 통해 상기 변전소 내부에서 고장복구가 가능한지 여부를 판단하여 상기 변전소 내부에서 고장복구가 불가능하다고 판단되는 경우 상기 최종 정전 피더(feeder)를 추출하는 것을 특징으로 하는 배전선로 고장복구 시스템을 포함한다.
assignees: KOREA ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: System and method for fault restoration blackout of electric power system
title_ko: 전력계통 광역정전 복구 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and method for reconstructing a wide area power outage in an electric power system, which includes: a data acquiring unit for acquiring information data in the electric power system having phase information from monitoring devices in the electric power system; a data analyzing unit for analyzing the information data therein to determine whether power outage occurs and determine the range of which the power outage occurs; and an establishing unit of power outage reconstructing procedure for establishing a power outage reconstructing procedure by checking whether an operating generator is mounted and an interconnection tie path in an external area is able to be connected within the range thereof as a determined result. [Reference numerals] (10) Remote monitoring control unit; (110) Data acquiring unit; (120) Data analyzing unit; (130) Power outage reconstructing procedure establishing unit; (140) Procedure performing mode selecting unit; (145) Information display unit; (150) Operational control unit; (20) Phase measurement unit
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전력계통 광역정전 복구 장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 전력계통의 감시설비들로부터 위상각 정보를 포함하는 전력계통 정보 데이터를 취득하는 데이터 취득부; 상기 전력계통 정보 데이터를 분석하여 정전 발생 여부를 판단하고 정전 발생 범위를 판단하는 데이터 분석부; 및 상기 판단 결과를 이용하여 정전 발생 범위 내 운전 중인 발전기의 유무와 외부지역 연계선로의 연계 가능 여부를 확인하여 정전 복구 절차를 수립하는 정전 복구 절차 수립부;를 포함한다.
assignees: KOREA ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: Power distribution automation protecting method achieved by matching of master station and distributed terminals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution automation protecting method achieved by matching of a master station and distributed terminals. When single failure happens to a power distribution network, a failure area is determined by a power distribution automation terminal, a circuit breaker at the line outgoing position of the power distribution network is controlled to be disconnected, afterwards, section switches at the two ends of the failure area are disconnected by the power distribution automation terminal, so that failure isolation is carried out, at last, the power distribution automation terminal controls the circuit breaker at the line outgoing position of the power distribution network, an interconnection switch and the section switches to be closed, the load in a failure-free area of the power distribution network is supplied in a turning mode, and thus power restoration of the failure-free area is achieved. The power distribution automation protecting method is high in power distribution reliability, short in failure recovery time, small in power outage range and low in transformation, operation and maintenance cost, improves the distribution network planning level, lowers power grid line loss, improves the distribution network dispatching management level and improves first-aid repair working efficiency.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: System and method for operating risk evaluation according to working of nuclear power plant
title_ko: 원자력 발전소의 운전 상태를 반영한 리스크 평가를 위한 운영 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide an operation system and method for evaluating a risk reflecting an operation state of a nuclear power plant by evaluating risk and providing a list of measures corresponding to the degree of risks when a device is suddenly broken (loses its functions) while the nuclear power plant normally operates or when the device is unavailable due to test work, emergent repair or power outage. According to the present invention, in case a device is broken (loses its functions) or is unavailable due to test work, emergent repair, or power outage while the nuclear power plant normally operates, risk may be evaluated, and a list of measures corresponding to the degree of risks is provided in real-time through a terminal of a person in charge or a server in a repair management division. Therefore, work history, current repair work history, risk color, restoration priority, and estimated work time of the device which is currently broken or unavailable according to the risk can be detected and actions may be taken in real-time.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 원자력 발전소의 운전 상태를 반영한 리스크 평가를 위한 운영 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로서, 원자력 발전소 정상운전중 불시에 기기가 고장(기능상실)나거나, 시험작업, 긴급정비 또는 정전으로 인해 기기 이용불능상태가 발생하는 경우, 이에 대하여 리스크를 평가하여 리스크의 정도 각각에 부합하는 조치내역을 제공함으로써, 원자력 발전소의 운전 상태를 반영한 리스크 평가를 위한 운영 시스템 및 그 방법을 제공함에 그 특징적인 목적이 있다.  
상기와 같은 본 발명에 따르면, 원자력 발전소 정상운전중 불시에 기기가 고장(기능상실)나거나, 시험작업, 긴급정비 또는 정전으로 인해 기기 이용불능상태가 발생하는 경우, 이에 대하여 리스크를 평가하여 리스크의 정도 각각에 부합하는 조치내역을 담당자 단말기 또는 정비관리부서 서버를 통해 실시간으로 제공함으로써, 리스크에 따른 현재 고장 또는 이용불능 기기의 작업내용, 현재의 정비작업내역, 리스크 색상, 회복 우선순위 및 예상 작업시간을 실시간으로 확인하고 조치하는 효과가 있다.
assignees: KOREA HYDRO & NUCLEAR POWER CO

title_en: Risk evaluation system and method for periodic test of nuclear power plants
title_ko: 원자력 발전소 정기 및 주기시험에 대한 위험도 평가 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a risk evaluation system and method for regular and periodic tests of a nuclear power plant, and the system includes an information input unit which generates information on a work command and a repair schedule related with regular and periodic tests of the nuclear power plant through an integrated management server and receives the information generated from the integrated management server; a regular and normal test information storing unit which stores information on a functional location according to the regular and periodic tests, and an unavailable device and work order related with the functional location; a command automatic separating unit which selects a period for the regular and periodic tests based on the information stored in the regular and periodic tests information storing unit to automatically separate work command data with respect to the to-be-evaluated unavailable device and unavailable time; a repair scenario storing unit which automatically generates and stores a repair scenario according to the work command data; and a analyzing unit which performs risk evaluation on the unavailable device and unavailable time according to the work command data separated with respect to the regular and periodic test and setting up a repair schedule according to the evaluation result.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 원자력 발전소 정기 및 주기시험에 대한 위험도 평가 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로서, 통합관리 서버를 통해 원자력 발전소의 정기 및 주기시험에 관한 작업명령 및 정비일정에 관한 정보를 생성하고, 상기 통합관리 서버로부터 생성된 정보를 수신하는 정보 입력부; 정기 및 주기시험에 따른 기능위치와, 그에 대한 이용불능 기기 및 작업 순서에 대한 정보를 저장하고 있는 정기 및 주기시험 정보 저장부; 상기 정기 및 주기시험 정보 저장부에 저장된 정보를 바탕으로, 정기 및 주기시험에 대한 주기를 선택하여, 평가 대상 이용불능 기기와 그 이용불능 시간을 기준으로, 작업명령 데이터를 자동 분할하는 명령 자동 분할부; 상기 작업명령 데이터에 따라, 정비 시나리오를 자동 생성하여 저장하고 있는 정비 시나리오 저장부; 및 정기 및 주기시험에 대하여 분할된 작업명령 데이터에 따른, 이용불능 기기 및 그 이용불능 시간에 대하여 위험도 평가를 수행하고, 평가 결과에 따라 정비 일정을 설정하는 분석부; 를 포함한다.
assignees: KOREA HYDRO & NUCLEAR POWER CO

title_en: Rapid construction bridge, and construction method thereof
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a rapid construction bridge capable of expanding the scale of a bridge which can be installed by a crane with a restricted capability in the case where rapid construction for early restoration is required in disasters, and to provide a construction method thereof.SOLUTION: A main girder unit 2a is installed from one side of a river by a crane 11 such as a rafter crane, and a plurality of main girder units 2a are connected in a lateral direction, thereby obtaining a main girder 2. The main girder units 2a are connected with each other by joining connection plates mounted to webs between upper and lower flanges by welding or the like, with bolts. The connection plate is mounted to the main girder unit 2a before installation in advance. Next, a cover plate retaining girder 3 crossing the main girder 2 is successively installed on the main girder 2 by the same crane 11 and fixed to the main girder 2 with a bolt or a fastening metal fitting. Thereafter, a cover plate 4 as a floor slab is installed on the cover plate retaining girder 3 by the crane 11, such that a rapid construction bridge is completed.
assignees: JFE STEEL CORP;GECOSS CORP

title_en: Low-altitude remote sensing image rapid and automatic splicing method without POS assisting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-altitude remote sensing image rapid and automatic splicing method without POS assisting. The method comprises the first step of full-automatic restoration of a low-altitude remote sensing image test area, the second step of conducting fine matching on a preprocessed image according to fine matching seed points to obtain a fine matching result, the third step of conducting free network adjustment iteration on the fine matching result to obtain an adjustment result, and the fourth step of conducting interpolation to generate a digital ground model of the image according to the adjustment result, obtaining a relative outer orientation element of the image under the free network coordinate system according to the adjustment result, conducting orthographic rectification on the image based on the digital ground model and the relative outer orientation element, and meanwhile generating an orthographic image splicing image of the test area. The method is free of POS data assisting, the orthographic image splicing image can be rapidly produced in a full-automatic mode, the remote sensing image quasi real-time processing requirement can be met, and the method is suitable for the fields of disaster emergency response, military security and the like.
assignees: UNIV WUHAN

title_en: Gas supply pipe network management system and gas supply pipe network management program
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a computer system capable of promptly and properly determining a gas supply stop area in a restoration work.SOLUTION: The gas supply pipe network management system includes: a work support screen generation part for generating a supply stop support screen Sa in which a gas supply network layer S1, an altitude layer S2, a user gas plug state layer S3, a supply stop area work layer S4, and a residence map layer S0 are superposed; a supply stop area setting part for setting an area regulated by an input contour line drawn in the supply stop area work layer S4 on the basis of the area to which the supply is actually stopped as a gas supply stop area, while visually recognizing the condition of the gas supply pipe network of the area to be a construction object through the supply stop support screen Sa; and a sealing information generation part for generating supply stop sealing information including a location of a shut off valve for stopping the supply of the gas to the set up gas supply stop area.
assignees: OSAKA GAS CO LTD

title_en: Network-assistant management system and method of electrical power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network-assistant management system and method of an electrical power system. The network-assistant management system comprises a scan module, an analysis module, a storage module, a data interface and a client, wherein the scan module is used for scanning data of a network channel, an exchanger, a router and DHCP device, and interacted with other modules; the analysis module is used for synthetically comparing and analyzing data input of the scan module, the data interface and a manager to conduct analysis and statistic so as to acquire the design result. The network-assistant management system uses a B/S structure. The network-assistant management system and method of the electrical power system have the advantages that 100% control of internal and external network desktop terminal access is achieved, network interrupt caused by a Beijing VRV desktop terminal ARP mechanism is avoided, and hidden troubles of viruses of the ARR are solved; real-time alarming of network device failures is achieved; real-time statistics of unit network device and module are achieved; data analysis of unit network resources is achieved; internal network device management tools are integrated, and efficiency is improved; the multithreading design is adopted to acquire data in real time and then achieve real-time control, identification backup, restoration and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;ZHUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Constrained service restoration with heuristics
abstract_en: A method of determining service routes for a plurality of crews is provided. Outage data identifying a plurality of service outage source locations, a number of affected customers associated with each location of the plurality of locations, and a type of repair to perform at each location of the plurality of locations is received. A repair time is estimated for each location. Crew data identifying a plurality of crews and a start location for the plurality of crews is received. A service route for each crew is determined based on a crew skill indicator associated with each crew satisfying the type of repair to perform at each location and based on the estimated repair time for each location. The service route for a crew of the plurality of crews includes the start location as a first location and at least one location of the plurality of locations.
assignees: SAS INST INC

title_en: Electric power utilization information remote control system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electric power utilization information remote control system. The electric power utilization information remote control system comprises a marketing business system, a marketing real-time charge remote control system, a load control system, an electric power utilization information collection system, a short message platform and a headquarter customer service system. The marketing real-time charge remote control system comprises a charge control and management program, an electric charge calculation program as well as a charge control strategy application and exception management program. The system can comprehensively, safely and efficiently achieve full support for all businesses of the marketing real-time charge remote control application as well as performs operations such as alarming, power cutting and power restoration according to calculation results, thereby playing a role of a smart meter, achieving interaction between purchase and sale, ensuring business smoothness and electric charge recovery, improving work efficiency, reducing labor costs, saving energy, being user-friendly and enhancing customer satisfaction.
assignees: BENXI POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA
