title_en: Sewage treatment apparatus and method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a sewage treatment apparatus and method which can quickly cope with fluctuations in the amount of inflow water and the pollution loading amount at normal times, and can be used for emergency restoration measures against a sewage treatment facility having become dysfunctional by disaster or natural phenomena, such as an earthquake, a tidal wave, or local severe rain.SOLUTION: A sewage treatment apparatus includes: a biological reaction tank 1 which performs aerobic biological treatment of inflow sewage; a filter material module 2 which is provided in the biological reaction tank 1 and arranged with a plurality of string-like filter materials; air diffusers 3a which are provided below the filter material module 2; a solid-liquid separation apparatus 4 which solid-liquid separates a mixed liquid from the biological reaction tank 1 into treated water and separated sludge; and a sludge return pipe 9 which returns the separated sludge to the biological reaction tank 1.
assignees: NISHIHARA ENVIRONMENT CO LTD

title_en: Reinforcement device of rail
title_ko: 레일 보강장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a rail reinforcement device. More specifically, provided is a rail reinforcement device which is able to reinforce and fill soft ground using a bogie with grouting on train railroads, to reinforce the ground by being operated on the railroads, to maximize pleasant and stable operation by reinforcing soft ground through mutual operation and preventing fatigue of soft ground and sinking of underground, to be free from time constraints on the reinforcement work of railroads as both daytime work and nighttime work are easily performed, to easily perform a restoration work after natural disaster, and to be free from interference on train operation owing to reinforcement work as soft ground section can be reinforced without having train operation stopped in the case of double tracks.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 레일 보강장치에 관한 것으로, 그 구성은 한 쌍으로 구비되며, 상호 이격되어 설치되며, 철로의 휨 정도를 측정하고 그에 상응하는 신호를 발송하는 계측센서부재와, 철로 위에서 운행 가능한 대차부재와, 상기 대차부재에 탑재되며, 물과 반응하여 응고되는 가루 상태의 벌크를 수용하는 벌크탱크와, 상기 대차부재에 탑재되며, 물을 수용하는 물탱크와, 상기 대차부재에 탑재되며, 상기 물과 벌크를 교반하는 교반부재와, 상기 벌크탱크에 수용된 벌크를 상기 교반부재로 이송시키는 벌크이송관과, 상기 벌크이송관에 결합되며, 상기 벌크의 이송을 허용 및 차단하는 벌크이송밸브와, 상기 물탱크에 수용된 물을 상기 교반부재로 이송시키는 물이송관과, 상기 물이송관에 결합되며, 상기 물의 이송을 허용 및 차단하는 물이송밸브와, 상기 대차부재에 탑재되며, 지면에 구멍을 천공시키며 상하방향으로 이동되는 외부천공부와, 상기 외부천공부에 삽입되며, 상기 교반부재로부터 이송되는 물과 벌크의 혼합물을 분사하는 내부분사부를 포함하는 천공시추부재와, 상기 교반부재에 수용되는 물과 벌크의 혼합물을 상기 천공시추부재로 이송시키는 혼합물이송관과, 상기 혼합물이송관에 결합되며, 상기 혼합물의 이송을 허용 및 차단하는 혼합물이송밸브 및 상기 벌크이송밸브와 물이송밸브를 열어서 상기 교반부재에 물과 벌크의 혼합물이 교반되도록 제어하며, 상기 계측센서부재로부터 신호를 인가받아 철로가 휘어진 부위로 상기 대차부재가 지나면, 상기 천공시추부재를 가동시켜 지면에 천공을 하며, 상기 혼합물이송관을 열어서 물과 벌크의 혼합물을 상기 내부분사부로 이송시키도록 제어를 하는 제어부재를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 것으로서, 기차가 지나는 선로에 그라우팅을 이용한 대차를 사용하여 연약 지반에 보강 및 충족을 할 수 있으며, 선로를 운행하면서 지반을 보강할 수 있으며, 서로 운행상 연약지반 구간을 보강하고 연약지반 피로도 및 침하를 방지하므로 쾌적하고 안정한 운행을 극대화시킬 수 있으며, 주간 및 야간작업도 용이하여 선로를 보강하는데 시간적 구애를 받지 않을 수 있으며, 천재지변으로 인한 복구를 용이하게 할 수 있으며, 복선 구간인 경우에는 기차의 운행을 중지시키지 않으면서 연약지반 구간을 보강할 수 있으므로 보강작업으로 인한 기차 운행의 간섭을 받지 않을 수 있는 효과가 있다.
assignees: SHIN WOO HITE CO LTD;BUKMA CO LTD

title_en: Coastal area wind prevention security power grid frame construction method based on graph theory algorithm
abstract_en: Disclosed is a coastal area wind prevention security power grid frame construction method based on a graph theory algorithm. The coastal area wind prevention security power grid frame construction method based on the graph theory algorithm includes: using a graph theory path search algorithm to identify power grid frame topology structures of 220KV and above for current and planned power grids, obtaining important degrees of each station and each circuit in topology for normal running and rapid power restoration, and forming a core backbone grid frame of 220V and above in a regional power grid; simultaneously, combing an important user power supply route, selecting a key station and a key circuit which supply power for important users according to a distribution situation and differentiation of the important users, and forming an important user security power supply radiation type fishbone grid frame; then, selecting a contact circuit of a center urban area and an outer area according to grid frame security requirements; finally, organically combining the core backbone grid frame, the radiation type fishbone grid frame and the contact circuit of the center urban area and the outer area so as to construct a coastal area wind prevention security power grid frame. The coastal area wind prevention security power grid frame construction method based on the graph theory algorithm can effectively improve the ability of the regional power grid of withstanding intrusion of natural hazards of typhoons and the like, guaranteeing the important users and supplying power for areas.
assignees: GPGC NETWORK PLANNING CT;GUANGDONG POWER GRID DEV INST CO LTD

title_en: Multicore fiber cable heat-shrinkable tube suitable for electric power emergency communication
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multicore fiber cable heat-shrinkable tube suitable for electric power emergency communication. The tube comprises an external-layer pipe body and an internal-layer reinforcing core; a temperature indicator, a waterproof layer 1 and an anti-corrosion layer 1 are successively arranged on the external surface of the external-layer pipe body from outside to inside; a spiral hot melt adhesive wire, a waterproof layer 2 and an anti-corrosion layer 2 are successively arranged on two end positions of the inner surface of external-layer pipe body from outside to inside; and spiral hot melt adhesive wires are uniformly arranged on other positions of the inner surface of the external-layer pipe body. The beneficial effects of the tube are that heating frequency of the tube is greatly reduced and welding time of fiber cable is greatly reduced, so precious time is gained for restoration of emergency communication fiber cable; waterproof layers and anti-corrosion layers are arranged on the external-layer pipe body, so sealing effects of the heat-shrinkable tube and the fiber cable are ensured simultaneously; and via the design of the spiral hot melt adhesive wires, air in the heat-shrinkable tube can be thoroughly squeezed out, and it can be ensured that a gap between the fiber cable and the heat-shrinkable tube can be sufficiently filled with hot melt glue after hot melting.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;INFORMATION COMM COMPANY STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Fireproof cable sleeve
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fireproof cable sleeve. The fireproof cable sleeve is composed of a cable bushing, a connection sleeve, a sealing plug and a broken cable alarming system. The cable bushing is composed of at least two sections of cable passing pipes which are connected through the connection sleeve. The connection sleeve is composed of a pipe wall and a baffle, the cable passing pipes are of a hollow tubular structure, the pipe wall is composed of an outer insulation wall and an inner hot melting wall, and the outer insulation wall and the inner hot melting wall are connected through rib plates to form a fireproof cavity. The broken cable alarming system is composed of a power source, a switch, a buzzer, an early warning wire and an adjusting resistor, and the early warning wire is embedded into the inner hot melting wall and surrounds the inner hot melting wall. On one hand, the cable ignition accident can be effectively eliminated in time and an alarm is given out in time, so that the risk that a cable triggers a fire is reduced greatly; on the other hand, the situation that after one cable breaks down and causes a fire, adjacent cables are damaged is effectively and completely eradicated, the fire damage is reduced greatly, the restoration cost needed after a disaster happens is saved largely, the restoration time spent after a disaster happens is shortened, and the efficiency for eliminating the fire accident is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;XIUWU COUNTY ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: The objectification power network topology analysis method generated for black-start scheme
abstract_en: A kind of objectification power network topology analysis method generated for black-start scheme, performance for improving black starting-up DSS, its technical scheme is, methods described regard each plant stand in system as an object, Global Topological analysis is first carried out by elementary cell of each plant stand object, then each plant stand object is considered as a mini system, partial network topology is carried out inside plant stand object, finally integrate the topologies of two levels.The present invention regard each plant stand in system as an object, the topological process of power system is clearly divided into two levels of Global Topological and local topology, not only efficiency high, validity are good for this method, and systematicness is strong, program is realized simple, the restoration path in black starting-up can be conveniently generated, it is adaptable to the topological analysis of large-scale electrical power system.

title_en: Method for greening side slopes with greening brick cages
abstract_en: A method for greening side slopes with greening brick cages includes the following steps that restoration is performed, wherein the slope surfaces of the side slopes are finished according to slope ratios, slope heights and flatness of the side slopes, sundries on the slope surfaces are cleaned up, and thus the handled slope surfaces are regular and consistent in slope ratio; meshes are hung, wherein after anchor rods are fixed to the side slopes, the wire meshes are connected with the anchor rods, and the wire meshes are fixed to the side slopes; the cages are hung, the wire mesh brick cages are connected with the anchor rods and the wire meshes so that the wire mesh brick cages can be fixed to the side slopes; borrowed-soil spray-seeding is performed, wherein mixed soil is sprayed in the mesh cages and the wire meshes, and continuous hardened bodies with plant growth matrixes are formed; mixture spraying is sprayed, wherein a mixture made of grass seeds is sprayed onto the mixed soil to form spray-seeding faces; covering is performed, the spray-seeding faces are covered with covering materials. With the method, the side slopes can be effectively greened, borrowed soil can be fixed to the side slopes more firmly, the borrowed soil layers are high in constitutive property, fast greening of the side slopes is achieved, the problem about water and soil loss is solved, and the side slopes have the advantages of being resistant to scouring and landslide, firm, durable and long in greening effect time.
assignees: SHENZHEN HEJING LANDSCAPING CO LTD

title_en: Fault urgent repair site auxiliary mobile platform based on distribution network
abstract_en: The invention provides a fault urgent repair site auxiliary mobile platform based on a distribution network. The fault urgent repair site auxiliary mobile platform comprises a master station terminal system, a mobile terminal and client side system and a wireless communication network, wherein the master station terminal system is in communication connection with the mobile terminal and client side system through the wireless communication network. The master station terminal system comprises a server and a database, and the server carries out operation such as fault work order dispatch, exceptional process execution and work order filing and storage by carrying out related operation on the database; the mobile terminal and client side system transmits fault urgent repair information back to the master station terminal system through the wireless network; the master station terminal system stores the related information to the database, and the mobile terminal and client side system can print customer evaluation return receipts in a Bluetooth mode. According to the fault urgent repair site auxiliary mobile platform, the informationalized level in the distribution network urgent repair process is improved, urgent repair scheduling resources of the electric power department are saved, and therefore the service level of the electric power department is improved substantially.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: A kind of power network ice-melt repair schedule automatic editing method
abstract_en: A kind of power network ice-melt repair schedule automatic editing method, including：(1) data acquisition, power network related data is obtained by software from power information system：Transformer station, circuit, ice-melting device；(2) the given collective data for treating DC ice-melting of user, forms the collective data for treating DC ice-melting；(3) first circuit in first DC ice-melting is chosen according to precedence；(4) first DC ice-melting is formed by algorithm partial circulating；(5) algorithm is by step (3) and step (4) formation systemic circulation, and the rest may be inferred considers second batch, the 3rd batch of ice-melt sequence, untill the ice-melt time is scheduled in needed DC ice-melting；(6) ice-melt repair schedule in batches is formed.The present invention reduces management and running personnel labor intensity, and reasonable arrangement realizes the ice-melt repair schedule of hair power transmission and transforming equipment, it is ensured that power network in the winter time the sleet phase can normally generate electricity, transmit electricity, electricity consumption, save the time that network operation personnel carry out ice-melt work, improve efficiency.

title_en: Fire extinguisher and fire extinguishing method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a fire extinguisher and a fire extinguishing method, which enable efficient fire extinction and rapid restoration to a state before a fire disaster.SOLUTION: A fire extinguisher 1 includes: a container 20 in which a storage space 20A formed inside is put into a vacuum state; and a suction part 10 which connects the container 20 and a burning space S arranged with a material to be burnt, which sucks in the material to be burnt and a produced material, produced in association with burning of the material to be burnt, toward the container 20, and which has one end 10A arranged toward the burning space S arranged with the material to be burnt, in case of fire.
assignees: FIRE DEFENCE AGANCY

title_en: A kind of load of overload circuit is poured out and restoration methods automatically
abstract_en: The load that the invention discloses a kind of overload circuit is poured out and restoration methods automatically, and it comprises the following steps: 1) obtain real-time distribution line parameter, periodically calculates the load factor of distribution line; 2) overload early-warning; 3) overload is poured out; 4) overload recovers.Distribution wire running status in fixed cycle monitoring system of the present invention, starts overload distribution wire early warning mechanism when monitoring distribution wire overload; When distribution wire overload, automatically the sub-load on overload distribution line can be poured out light-loaded circuit by interconnection switch, thus realize this circuit and normally run; After load is poured out, do not causing under circuit overload prerequisite, overload distribution wire load can returned to and pour out front supply power mode.Present invention achieves automatically pouring out of overload distribution wire load, ensure that the safety and economic operation of power equipment, extend power equipment service life, decrease the user's power outage because distribution wire overload causes.

title_en: Wireless communication system and communication terminal devices
abstract_en: Provided are a wireless communication system and communication terminal devices whereby in a case of a power failure occurring due to, for example, a large-scale disaster or the like, in order to prevent occurrence of an event that the communication terminals in charge of the system simultaneously start communications at an opportunity of power restoration and hence the system processing is congested, resulting in a trouble such as system failure, the communication timings of the communication terminal devices can be deconcentrated. A wireless communication system is characterized by performing a control to individually determine communication timings unique to the respective communication terminal devices in the wireless communication system by use of: reference timings referenced to the time commonly recognized by the communication terminal devices existing in the wireless communication network of the wireless communication system; parameters that associate the reference timings with the communication timings of the communication terminal devices in the wireless communication system; and IDs unique to the respective communication terminal devices in the wireless communication system.
assignees: HITACHI INT ELECTRIC INC

title_en: Method for conducting ecological restoration in mine geological disaster region
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for conducting ecological restoration in a mine geological disaster region. The method includes the following steps: (1) breaking coal gangue through a breaking machine into broken blocks with the diameter as 2-5cm, utilizing the coal gangue to pave the collapsed and sedimentation region and leveling the land to be treated; (2) paving a separation layer on the surface of the land to be treated and paving a soil coal gangue partition layer on the surface of the separation layer according to the interval of the soil and the coal gangue; (3) arranging a plurality of vertical separation layers on the connection position of the coal gangue and the soil interval layer, and certain close distances are reserved between the vertical separation layers; (4) filling the gaps between the separation layers with a plant soil layer and the coal gangue mixing layer at intervals. The coal gangue mixing layer is composed of a coal gangue layer, a lime layer, a soil layer and the coal gangue layer from bottom to top. The separation layers are formed by pressing the lime, the clay, quartz sand and water. By means of the method, the ecological environment of the mine ecological disaster region can be greatly improved, the plant survival rate is improved, and the coal gangue stacking problem is solved.
assignees: LIU YONG

title_en: Power grid dispatching determining method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid dispatching determining method and system and relates to a power grid dispatching simulation method and system. Currently, power grid faults are frequently influenced by outside environments, and under extreme weather conditions, people can only wait for happening or developing of faults or accidents passively and cannot conduct prognosis and prevention on dispatching risks initiatively. A power grid structure and topological information are obtained from a power grid SCADA/EMS system, spare power automatic switching information is automatically generated, a repair schedule is combined, and the state information of a spare power automatic switching device is adjusted; combination with weather information can be achieved, the change of equipment outage probability is calculated, the load shedding amount is calculated specific to a threshold-crossing device and a power outage device, and early warning is given specific to large risk changes. According to the technical scheme, a dispatcher can find various risks in the operation process of a power grid in time.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: It is a kind of to suppress the generation schedule optimization method that unit is reversely adjusted in power plant
abstract_en: Disclosed by the invention is the generation schedule optimization method that unit is reversely adjusted in a kind of suppression power plant, including system loading, new energy is predicted, repair schedule, cross-section limitation, compressor emergency shutdown information, unit reference plan and unit are to monitoring element sensitivity information, consider all kinds of constraints, including system balancing constraint, unit operation is constrained, Network Security Constraints and machine group constraint etc., on the basis of optimization routine model, safeguard the mapping relations between unit and power plant, introduce unit in power plant and reversely adjust constraint, form the mathematical modeling that unit in power plant reversely adjusts constraint.The higher unit output plan of the relatively reliable effective degree of being practical of the present invention, lift unit plan and perform level, improve the closed loop level planned a few days ago and in real time with AGC, the intelligent level and decision-making capability dispatched a few days ago with real-time generation schedule are favorably improved, the bulk power grid safe operation demand of increasingly lean is met.

title_en: High restoration robustness secret key management method based on self-organized wireless network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high restoration robustness secret key management method based on a self-organized wireless network. Whether the number of service nodes passing through verification is larger than or equal to a preset number is judged; if conditions are not met, common nodes send requests to auxiliary nodes, and identity identification is carried out through the auxiliary nodes and the service nodes together; when the conditions are met, the requests are accepted, an effective certificate is generated and issued. The method has the advantages that redundancy of secret keys in a system is strategically improved, safety is guaranteed, and system robustness is improved; the problem that the number of the secret keys is lower than a threshold due to network segmentation, and accordingly service based on a threshold scheme is valid is solved; the method is more suitable for typical application of an MANET such as military and emergency rescue; the problem of self restoration of the secret keys in the communication process is solved, work of a server is simplified, and network communication traffic is reduced.
assignees: CHENGDU WESTONE INF IND INC

title_en: Method for assessing reliability of medium voltage distribution network for calculating upstream power restoration operation time
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for assessing reliability of a medium voltage distribution network for calculating upstream power restoration operation time, and the method comprises the following steps of: firstly creating a calculating model, secondly acquiring parameters (including basic parameters and reliability parameters) of all elements from the calculating model, obtaining a fault model result list according to the obtained parameters, and calculating the reliability index of each load point by the list to obtain the reliability index of the whole medium voltage distribution network; because the calculating model is based on production and operation and power supply reliability management of the medium voltage distribution network in China, various influencing factors are comprehensively considered to obtain reliability assessment results with higher reliability, thus the method can solve the problem that the reliability assessment results are low in accuracy in the existing medium voltage distribution network.
assignees: INST ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCES STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power outage protection and restoration using low power states in data storage devices/systems
abstract_en: Systems and methods for early warning of power loss in solid state storage drives are disclosed. An early power loss warning may be used to activate the drive into a low power state before using the energy in the backup power source (e.g., backup capacitor). This low power state may allow for a reduction in power used by the drive, which may provide cost savings and reduce the risk of: the drive will be rendered as reconfigurable by a power outage event.
assignees: WESTERN DIGITAL TECH INC

title_en: A kind of operation reliability evaluation method of power distribution network in power system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of operation reliability evaluation method of power distribution network in power system, belong to Power System Reliability Analysis technical field.The method is calculated based on each monolithic element health index in power distribution network by the conversion of health index and health index Probability Forms, and the system health index is evaluated with reference to its connected mode.And according to its analysis result, rationally determine the time between overhauls(TBO) of equipment, reduce operation of power networks and electric power apparatus examination expense and improve equipment operational reliability.This method evaluates power distribution network health status in 0 to 10 numerical indication forms, can be that reliability service and the repair schedule formulation of power distribution network are provided fundamental basis.So as to further lift distribution network planning, O＆M and managerial skills, power distribution network asset management system is improved.

title_en: System Having Function for Repairing Communication with Isolator Coupled to Bi-directional Communication Loop
title_ko: 양방향 통신루프에 결합된 아이솔레이터를 포함하는 통신 복구 기능을 구비한 환경감지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a communication restoration method using an isolator in the power line communications of shore and marine equipment capable of rapidly monitoring a situation such as cutting a part of communication path or the like and restoring the communication path in equipment for monitoring and alarming a fire or gas situation of massive spaces such as the inside and outside of a vessel and the inside and outside of a plant or a building. A monitoring device comprises the isolator which transmits address information and performs an isolating function which blocks the communication path when a short circuit situation, a ground situation, or a disconnection situation is monitored. The system comprises two line paths and performs one way communications from a terminal of a starting lint path to a terminal of an ending line path and bidirectional communications from another terminal of the ending line path to from another terminal of the starting line path in a communication loop having two terminals at the starting line path and the ending line path. When defects such as the short circuit situation, the ground situation, or the disconnection situation is monitored at a temporary point of the communication loop, the isolator performs communications regardless of the defects such as the short circuit situation, the ground situation, or the disconnection situation by enabling the monitoring device to transmit the address information and state information in a loop of a previous defect generation point to the terminal of the starting line path and enabling another device to transmit the address information and the state information of the loop to the terminal of the ending line path in the loop after the defect generation point.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 육상 및 해상 설비에서 아이솔레이터를 이용한 통신 복구 방법에 관한 것으로, 선박 내/외부, 플랜트 또는 건물의 내/외부와 같이 대규모 공간에서 화재나 가스의 감지 및 경보를 하기 위한 설비에 있어서 통신 선로의 일부가 단선되거나 단락되는 등의 상황을 신속하게 감지하여 통신 선로를 복구할 수 있는 육상 및 해상 설비의 파워 라인을 통한 통신에서 아이솔레이터(isolator)를 이용한 통신 복구 방법을 제공하고자 하는 목적은, 상기 감지장치는 자신의 주소 정보를 전송하고, 단락, 접지 또는 단선의 감지 시, 통신 선로를 차단하는 아이솔레이팅 기능을 수행하는 아이솔레이터를 포함하고, 상기 시스템은 두 선로를 포함하고, 시작 선로 및 끝단 선로에 각기 두 단자를 갖는 통신 루프에서 상기 시작 선로의 한 단자에서 상기 끝단 선로의 한 단자로의 일 방향 통신과, 상기 끝단 선로의 다른 단자로부터 상기 시작 선로의 다른 단자로의 양방향 통신을 수행하고, 상기 아이솔레이터는 상기 한 통신 루프의 임의의 한 지점에서 단락, 접지 또는 단선과 같은 장애가 감지된 경우, 하나의 감지장치가 장애 발견 지점 이전의 루프에서 자신의 주소정보와 상태 정보를 상기 시작선로의 상기 한 단자로 전송하고, 상기 장애 발견 지점 이후의 루프에서는 다른 감지장치가 자신의 주소 정보와 루프의 상태 정보를 상기 끝단 선로의 상기 한 단자로 전송하여 단락, 접지, 단선과 같은 장애에도 불구하고 이상 없이 통신을 수행하는 것을 특징으로 하는 파워라인을 통한 통신에서 아이솔레이터를 이용한 통신 복구 방법에 의해 달성된다.
assignees: KIM YEONG SOO

title_en: Game machine
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a game machine which can execute read-ahead performance even after power restoration when a power outage occurs.SOLUTION: Game control means includes: prior determination means which performs prior determination of an execution content of a variable display game on the basis of start storage stored in start storage reservation means and generates prior determination information; prior determination information transmission means which transmits prior determination information to performance control means before a target game is executed; backup means which can store and reserve information about the game in a prescribed storage area when power outage occurs; means of prior determination during power restoration means which again determines the execution content of the variable display game of the start storage when power outage occurs and generates prior determination information during power restoration; and transmission means of prior determination information during power restoration which transmits to the performance control means the prior determination information during power restoration when the power is restored. The performance control means is provided with prior notification performance means which, before the game execution starts, notifies a player of a degree of expectations that a result mode of the variable display game becomes a special result on the basis of the prior determination information or the prior determination information during power restoration.
assignees: SOPHIA CO LTD

title_en: Automatic analyzer
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an automatic analyzer capable of obtaining down time of a cooling function of a reagent storage by monitoring times, when a power outage occurs, from a power outage start time to a power outage restoration time and preventing the automatic analyzer from getting large in size by eliminating necessity of installing an uninterruptible power source device.SOLUTION: An automatic analyzer 1 comprises: a power source 110 which is connected to a commercial power source section PS; an analysis section 104 which has reagent storage 10A and 10B; a computer 5 which can send and receive information with the analysis section 104 and controls performance thereof; a reagent storage cooling circuit board 120 which is capable of sending and receiving information with the analysis section 104 and has a cooling circuit 160 to cool the reagent storage 10A and 10B getting power input through the power source 110, a counter circuit 202 to count time in synchronization with time information of the computer 5 and a power storage section such as the reagent storage cooling circuit board 120 having a backup capacitor 150 to store power getting the power input through the power source 110.
assignees: TOSHIBA CORP;TOSHIBA MEDICAL SYS CORP

title_en: Apparatus and method for power supply restoration via data link after power outage
abstract_en: The invention relates to an apparatus (1) for enabling power to be supplied to a powered device (2) via a wired data link (3). The apparatus (1) is configured to provide the power to the powered device (2) according to a configuration determined based on at least one parameter transmitted by the powered device (2) via the wired data link (3) during a power cycle. Further, the device (1) comprises: a memory (12) for storing information about said configuration; and a controller (10) for controlling the apparatus (1) to supply power to the power-supplied device (2) according to the same configuration, based on the stored information, in a subsequent power cycle following a power outage. Furthermore, the invention relates to a method for operating a device (1).

title_en: Systems and methods for recovering virtual machines after disaster scenarios
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method for recovering virtual machines after disaster scenarios may include (1) identifying a request to restore a virtual machine disk backup image to a virtual machine disk, (2) in response to the request, identifying a block map of the virtual machine disk backup image, the block map identifying at least one allocated block as allocated on the virtual machine disk and at least one unused block as unused on the virtual machine disk, and then (3) restoring the allocated block from the virtual machine disk backup image to the virtual machine disk upon determining that the block map identifies the allocated block as allocated, but skipping restoration of the unused block from the virtual machine disk backup image to the virtual machine disk due to determining that the block map identifies the unused block as unused. Various other methods, systems, and computer-readable media are also disclosed.
assignees: SHIVDEO VINAYAK;KANSE SAMIR;SYMANTEC CORP

title_en: A kind of spontaneous combustionof coal is burnt the ecological restoration and management method in hidden danger district
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of spontaneous combustionof coal and burn ecological restoration and management method and the standard in hidden danger district, it is a kind of relatively fragile and have Mode of Ecologic Restoration and the technology of the Gullied Rolling Loess Region of disaster hidden-trouble for ecological environment that object is to provide, to meet the needs of its large area Ecological Restoration Works. The present invention is made ground, carries out erosion and torrent control works, is utilized engineering and biological method to reclaim, finally carry out a series of ecological recovery methods such as planting greening by the mining limit, mode limit that the stripping of utilization table soil resource is dug, interior row combines with outer row, for the ecological recovery of administering district provides method and technology.

title_en: Power grid operating risk recognition and prevention method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid operating risk recognition and prevention method and system. According to the method, a power grid model is extracted with the CIM as the standard, and operating measurement data of a power grid are imported into the model at a fixed period to form a near-real-time operating environment; the power grid operating risk grading standard, an electrical topology analysis algorithm and an expert rule base are introduced under the operating environment to set up a power grid operating risk recognition and prevention bank, an auxiliary platform integrating active risk recognition, accident evaluation and restoration control is set up, the data under the power grid real-time operating mode are integrated through the CIM standard, the problem that information system data set up by different manufactures can not be shared is solved, and the sound data support is provided for the power grid safety evaluation; on this basis, the evaluation standard for reasonably evaluating and grading operation risks is increased, and the power grid operating risk recognition and prevention system is constructed; an operating risk prevention and control work mode with the system operation as the center and without participation of related departments together is achieved, and the operating risk prevention and control work level of the power grid is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;NANCHANG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: A kind of grid maintenance working strength graphical representation method based on GIS technology
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of grid maintenance working strength graphical representation method based on GIS technology, comprises the following steps：Obtain repair schedule data；Count the repair schedule duration；Count repair schedule working strength；Repair schedule working strength is defined the level；Obtain GIS data and structure mapping relations；Repair schedule working strength graphical representation.The present invention solves grid maintenance working strength in power system and can not intuitively shown, the defects of being unfavorable for statistical analysis, grid maintenance working strength is intuitively showed with GIS patterned ways, it is easy to comprehensive and plans as a whole reasonable arrangement, avoids occurring the wasting of resources even power outage caused by service arrangement work is inconsiderate.

title_en: The transmission of electricity rack restoration methods emulated based on multiple agent and fired power generating unit cluster
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of transmission of electricity rack restoration methods emulated based on multiple agent and fired power generating unit cluster.This method includes scheduling intelligent body, using simulation for thermal power plant cluster as power plant's intelligent body of kernel and intelligent substation body.First, this method simulates power generation and power transformation link can be used recovery information in scheduling in transmission of electricity rack recovery process in real time identification and acquisition by the two-way information interaction between power plant's intelligent body, intelligent substation body and scheduling intelligent body.In turn, realize that the centralized decision-making to unit recovery sequence and rack structure optimizes based on scheduling intelligent body.Finally, by dispatching intelligent body to the unidirectionally controlled of power plant's intelligent body and intelligent substation body, the simulated operation of recovery process is completed.This method fully simulates the response process that fired power generating unit is restored and different power transformations and power transmission operation complexity, the parameters such as obtained recovery time, recovery generated energy can fully reflect the actual effect after recovery policy execution, and practical guided significance is had more to transmission of electricity rack recovery process.

title_en: Estimation system and estimation device for outage restoration area in jurisdiction of distribution substation
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To early estimate and determine restoration from outage in a power supply area in a jurisdiction of a distribution substation, as the whole area.SOLUTION: An estimation system for outage restoration area comprises: a plurality of buildings 61 to 64 and 71 to 74 in jurisdictions of distribution substations 2 and 3; a monitoring terminal for monitoring a power supply state of an electric facility in the buildings; a monitoring center 1 for receiving detection of the power supply state from the monitoring terminal through a communication channel 4; and power restoration determination means 13 in the monitoring center 1 for determining power restoration in power supply areas 6 and 7 in the jurisdictions of distribution substations. The power restoration determination means 13 determines that power restoration is achieved as the whole power supply area, in the case where the ratio of area of a polygon formed by taking buildings which are positioned in the power supply areas 6 and 7 in the jurisdiction of the distribution substation and in which power restoration is achieved, as the polygon's vertices to the total area of the power supply areas is equal to or larger than a predetermined value.
assignees: HITACHI BUILDING SYS CO LTD

title_en: Task restoration support system, restoration situation management device, and program
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To efficiently restore a task which has been interrupted or deteriorated in an execution level regardless of the type or scale of a disaster or the content of a damage which occurs due to the disaster or the like.SOLUTION: Terminal equipment for site includes: status information input means for inputting status information specifying the operation state of a resource indispensable for executing a task; and measure information presenting means for presenting the restoration measures of each resource on the basis of status information input by the status information input means and status information received from a management server. The management server manages the status information of the resource received from the terminal equipment for site, and specifies and manages the operation state of a task to which the resource is belonging on the basis of the status information of each resource. Also, the management server calculates the restoration time of the task, and obtains the degree of progress of the execution situation of the restoration measures with respect to a restoration scheduled time. Furthermore, the management server predicts a time when the operation of the task to which the resource is belonging is resumed.
assignees: AKIZUKI MASASHI

title_en: Controlling method of construction machinary
title_ko: 건설기계의 제어방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a controlling method for a construction machine, which comprises: a vehicle mode change signal input step which inputs a signal for using a vehicle as a disaster relief vehicle; an exhaust gas processing device failure determination step which determines failure of an exhaust gas processing device of the vehicle being used in an emergency mode in the vehicle mode change signal input step; a function releasing time setting step which sets a fixed period of time in order to release a failure sensing function for an exhaust gas processing device when the exhaust gas processing device is determined as failure; a setting time determination step which determines whether or not the setting time for releasing the function in the function releasing time setting step has passed; and an exhaust gas processing device failure sensing function restoration step which maintains the releasing of the failure sensing function for the exhaust gas processing device when the setting time is determined as not passed yet in the setting time determination step, and restores the failure sensing function for the exhaust gas processing device when the setting time is determined as passed.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예는 건설기계 기능 제어 방법에 관한 것으로, 차량을 재난구호용 긴급 차량으로 사용하기 위한 신호를 입력하는 차량모드 변경신호 입력 단계와, 상기 차량모드 변경신호 입력 단계에서 긴급모드로 사용중인 차량의 배기가스 처리장치의 고장여부를 판단하는 배기가스 처리장치 고장판단 단계와, 상기 배기가스 처리장치 고장판단 단계에서 차량의 배기가스 처리 장치가 고장인 것으로 판단되면, 일정시간을 설정하여 배기가스 처리 장치 고장 감지 기능을 해제하는 기능해제 시간설정 단계와, 상기 기능해제 시간설정 단계에서 기능해제를 위해 설정한 시간을 초과하였는지를 판단하는 설정시간 판단 단계, 그리고 상기 설정시간 판단 단계에서 설정된 시간을 초과하지 않은 것으로 판단되면 배기가스 처리 고장 감지 기능 해제를 유지하고, 설정된 시간을 초과한 것으로 판단되면 배기가스 처리 장치 고장 감기 기능을 복구하는 배기가스 처리장치 고장감지기능 복구 단계를 포함한다.
assignees: DOOSAN INFRACORE CO LTD

title_en: Power grid restoration path searching method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid restoration path searching method, including the steps of: S1, obtaining the quantity of circuit breakers and the opening and closing status of the circuit breakers in a power gird and setting a path solution according to a preset power grid common information model; S2, calculating the fitness of the path solution; S3, determining the crossover probability and the mutation probability of the path solution; S4, crossing and mutating the path solution according to the crossover probability and the mutation probability; S5, calculating the fitness of the path solution after crossing and mutation; S6, judging whether fitness according with preset conditions exists according to the fitness of the path solution after crossing and mutation, if yes, adopting the path solution corresponding to the fitness as a power grid restoration path, and otherwise, executing the steps S3 to S6. The power grid restoration path searching method dynamically changes the crossover probability and the mutation probability of the path according to the fitness of the path, and thereby the path searching efficiency is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power system black-start online recovery decision support platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power system black-start online recovery decision support platform. The decision support platform comprises a hardware frame, a software structure, a black-start recovery target grid frame intelligent generation method, and an online recovery intelligent decision support method. The black-start online recovery decision support platform can determine a target grid frame which should be recovered first according to the topological structure of a power grid and the power and load distribution in the power grid, and offer micro guidance to dispatchers in making a subsequent recovery plan. Further, on the basis of determining an optimization principle in accordance with the actual conditions of the power grid, the real-time operating condition of the system is tracked, the optimal recovery sequence of each recovery phase is calculated dynamically, and an online decision support platform aiming at the specific operation process of emergency recovery is provided for dispatchers.
assignees: YUNNAN ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCH CONTROL CT;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELEC POWER

title_en: Distributed disaster recovery file sync server system
abstract_en: Example implementations are directed to restoration of data not only from the servers, but also from the clients connected to the server. Algorithms are incorporated to identify content that was created or modified after the last backup. This algorithm also identifies and resolves changes in the mount points for shared folders, preventing information leakage. When the server recovers from a failure, it notifies the clients about the recovery on their next connection. Each client then determines the current state of its mount points and file paths and compares them with the server's mount points and file paths. After the comparison, the client comprehends and indicates the mount point differences by renaming them and sends entire local data (all files, folders, mount points) to the server. The server reconciles the differences.

title_en: Power system operating mode generation method based on monthly power transmission and transforming equipment repair schedule

title_en: Geological environment treatment method suitable for steep wall and deep pit type abandoned mine
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological environment treatment method suitable for a steep wall and deep pit type abandoned mine. title_en: Power system grid structure reconfiguration and optimization method based on fuzzy chance constraint
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power system grid structure reconfiguration and optimization method based on fuzzy chance constraints, which belongs to the field of power system security defense and restoration control. The power system grid structure reconfiguration and optimization method comprises a grid structure reconfiguration and optimization model establishing module and a grid structure reconfiguration and optimization algorithm module. The power system grid structure reconfiguration and optimization method adopts triangular fuzzy variables for representing line operation time and restoration reliability, defines an restoration reliability index for evaluating performance of a target grid structure, considers unit start-up time limit, establishes a grid structure reconfiguration and optimization model based on fuzzy chance constraints under the framework of the fuzzy chance constraints, adopts a solution method of combining fuzzy simulation, a crossed particle swarm optimization algorithm and a Dijkstra algorithm, optimizes and determines unit start-up sequence, and reconfigures a restoration grid structure with shortest reconfiguration time and highest reliability. According to the power system grid structure reconfiguration and optimization method based on fuzzy chance constraints, the fuzziness of operation time and restoration reliability when the line is put into operation at the grid structure reconfiguration stage is reasonably considered, the optimized and determined optimal grid structure reconfiguration scheme takes both system reconfiguration speed and safety requirements into account, and the power system grid structure reconfiguration and optimization method has more practical significance.

abstract_en: The invention relates to an ecological tubular bag revetment soil wall and a filling method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of riverbank protection building. title_en: Low voltage intelligent switch closing system for power distribution station

title_en: A kind of intelligent distribution network self-healing method based on improvement ant group algorithm

title_en: A integrated control monitoring device for the local closed circuit television for crime prevention
title_ko: 방범용 cctv 로컬용 통합 제어 감시 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated control monitoring device for a local CCTV for crime prevention. The device comprises: a local equipment connection unit (110) connected to local equipment (10) including an emergency bell (11), a camera unit (12), a warning lamp (13), and a speaker (14); an SMPS (120) configured to output driving power necessary for driving each local equipment (10); an integrated control unit (130) which performs an automatic restoration function when malfunction occurs in the local equipment; and a VoIP communication connection unit (140) connected to a VoIP master server (20) through a network. Therefore, the device enables quick maintenance.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 방범용 CCTV 로컬용 통합 제어 감시 장치에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 방범용 CCTV 로컬용 통합 제어 감시 장치로서, 비상 호출을 위한 비상벨과, 감시지역을 촬영하는 카메라부와, 비상상황을 알리기 위해 경고하는 경광등, 및 음성을 출력하는 스피커를 포함하는 로컬 장비와 연결 접속되고, 상기 로컬 장비에 대한 제어신호 및 구동전원을 공급하는 로컬 장비 접속부; 외부 교류전원(AC 220V)을 공급받아 상기 로컬 장비 접속부에 연결 접속되는 상기 로컬 장비 각각의 구동에 필요한 구동전원을 출력하는 SMPS; 상기 SMPS로부터 공급되는 구동전원을 입력받아 상기 로컬 장비 접속부로 인가되는 구동전원을 제어하여 공급하며, 상기 로컬 장비의 작동상태를 감시하고, 상기 로컬 장비의 장애 발생 시 자동복구 기능을 수행하는 통합 제어부; 및 관제센터의 VoIP 마스터 서버와 네트워크망을 통해 접속되는 VoIP 통신 접속부를 포함하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에서 제안하고 있는 방범용 CCTV 로컬용 통합 제어 감시 장치에 따르면, 로컬 장비에 대한 제어신호 및 구동전원을 각각 공급하기 위한 복수의 접속포트를 구비하는 로컬 장비 접속부와, 로컬 장비 각각의 구동에 필요한 구동전원을 출력하는 SMPS와, 로컬 장비의 구동전원의 제어 공급 및 로컬 장비의 통합 감시 기능을 수행하는 통합 제어부 및 VoIP 통신 접속부를 통합된 하나의 장비로 구성함으로써, 여러 종류로 분류되어 다양한 구동전원을 필요로 하는 로컬 장비가 차지하는 공간을 최소화하고, 케이블 결선을 간소화하여 설치의 편리성을 도모하고, 그로 인한 설치시간을 현저히 단축시킬 수 있도록 하는 등의 작업성이 향상될 수 있도록 할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명에 따르면, 통합 제어부를 통해 로컬 장비로 접속되는 비상벨, 복수의 카메라를 구비하는 카메라부, 경광등, 및 스피커의 구동을 제어함으로써, 로컬 장비의 관리 제어가 용이하고, 주변 장비인 카메라, 경광등, 스피커 등의 동작유무를 자체 점검하여 장애 발생 시 자동복구를 시도하고, 그 결과에 대한 정보를 관제센터의 VoIP 마스터 서버에 통보하여 신속한 유지보수가 이루어질 수 있도록 할 수 있다. 
뿐만 아니라, 본 발명은, 관제센터의 VoIP 마스터 서버로부터 실시간 장애 여부를 모니터링 받음으로써, 통합 제어 감시 장치의 장애에 대한 신속한 대처가 가능하고, 그로인한 방범용 CCTV로서의 본연의 기능을 최대한 가능하도록 함에 따른 범죄에 대한 신속한 대처를 통한 범죄 피해가 최소화될 수 있도록 할 수 있다.

title_en: Evacuation Door for Tunnel

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a rotary portal of a tunnel, which is installed in an evacuation tunnel or an evacuation path, does not interfere with movement of passers, effectively prevents diffusion of various kinds of toxic gas in the event of an accident, and achieves a stable operation. The rotary portal of a tunnel includes: a swing door which has a door shaft; an interlocked gear which has a first link shaft interlocked with the door shaft; a second link shaft which is interlocked with the first link shaft; and an automatic closing device which generates a restoration rotation force in a direction opposite to the rotation force of the first link shaft. The interlocked gear and the automatic closing device are disposed such that the first link shaft and the second link shaft are parallel to each other. The rotary portal of a tunnel further includes: a flexible joint which has one end connected to the first link shaft and the other end connected to the second link shaft to form a round shape and interlocks the first and second link shafts with each other; and a cover-type supporter of which five faces form an elevation body to cover the flexible joint.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 터널 피난 연락 갱 또는 대피로 등에 설치되어서 통행인의 이동에 간섭을 주지 않고, 사고 발생시 각종 유해가스 등의 확산을 효과적으로 방지하며, 안정된 동작이 보장되는 회전식 갱문에 관한 것으로, 도어축을 구비한 스윙도어와, 상기 도어축과 연동하는 제1링크축을 구비한 연동기어와, 상기 제1링크축과 연동하는 제2링크축을 구비하고 상기 제1링크축의 회전력과 반대방향의 복원회전력을 일으키는 자동폐쇄장치가 포함된 회전식 갱문에 있어서, 상기 제1링크축과 제2링크축이 나란하도록, 상기 연동기어와 자동폐쇄장치가 배치되고; 일단이 상기 제1링크축에 연결되고 타단이 상기 제2링크축에 연결되어서 라운드 형태의 자세를 이루며, 상기 제1,2링크축을 연동시키는 플렉시블 조인트와; 상기 플렉시블 조인트를 덮도록 5면이 입면체를 이루는 커버형 서포터;를 더 포함하는 것이다.

title_en: Power estimation device and power estimation method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a power estimation device and a power estimation method capable of performing power estimation, even if a load subjected to reactive power adjustment exists in the system.SOLUTION: In step S1, the learning data for performing analysis by ICA from effective power and the amount of solar radiation that have been entered up to now is created. The number of samples of the learning data can be determined arbitrarily. In step S2, a restoration matrix, that is the inverse matrix of a mixing matrix formulated using the learning data created in step S1 is calculated. In step S3, the effective power of an actual load and the effective power of solar power generation amount are estimated individually, by performing matrix operation of the effective power and the amount of solar radiation measured at an estimation time, for the restoration matrix calculated in step S2.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Intelligent power line repair scheduling system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent power line repair scheduling system, comprising an intelligent repair scheduling centre, a warehouse management information system, a vehicle-mounted GPS system and a GPS intelligent terminal; the intelligent repair scheduling centre and the warehouse management information system carry out network communication; the intelligent repair scheduling centre carries out two-way communication with the vehicle-mounted GPS system and the GPS intelligent terminal through a GPRS wireless network; the power pipe network facilities, traffic network facilities and various repair resources are fused together by taking the advantage of GIS geographic information processing and visualization and are displayed uniformly in a map form; the intelligent mobile power line repair scheduling system is built by combing the GPS and GPRS technology; intelligent positioning of the power fault points, repair vehicle advancing path planning and monitoring, site information communication, and personnel and device scheduling are realized; therefore the power repair efficiency is improved; the repair speed of the fault is increased; and the economic loss is reduced.

title_en: Power system restoration path optimization method considering line operation risk
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power system restoration path optimization method considering line operation risk. The method comprises the following steps of: inputting a power system topological structure; calculating a relative possibility of operation failure of each restoration line; calculating a severity index of operation failure of each restoration line; calculating a mean value and a maximum error value of operation risk of each restoration line; optimizing a unit restoration sequence and inputting to-be-restored unit nodes with the same number as blackstart power nodes; solving a ''serial''-stage restoration model; if to-be-restored units are all restored, updating the power system topological structure; otherwise, combining restored lines and nodes into equivalent power points, updating the power system topological structure, and returning to the step S5; solving a ''parallel''-stage restoration model; and after the model is solved, outputting a restoration scheme. According to the method, a dispatcher can set a robust control coefficient according to the risk that the dispatcher is willing to undertake, thereby obtaining an optimal restoration path.
assignees: STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Power distribution network repair schedule optimization method for access distributed photovoltaic power generation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of smart power grids, and provides a power distribution network repair schedule optimization method for access distributed photovoltaic power generation. The method comprises the following steps that 1, the access distributed photovoltaic power generation output and the distribution network load are used as random fuzzy uncertain source loads for modeling; 2, a power distribution network repair schedule optimization model based on the credibility theory is built; 3, two-layer optimization solving is carried out on the repair schedule, and finally a result is output. The fuzzy factors in the power distribution network repair process are described by introducing the credibility theory, the uncertainty theory and the optimal method are organically combined, and the repair schedule applicability is improved; meanwhile, repair cost and reliably indexes are introduced during repaid schedule optimization, and both economy and reliability of the repair schedule are achieved. In addition, according to the different confidence levels, different optimization schemes can be obtained, and a decision maker can flexibly select the corresponding optimization repair scheme according to the repair cost, reliability and the confidence levels.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Method and device for service restoration after PCRF (Policy and Charging Rules Function) fault
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for service restoration after a PCRF (Policy and Charging Rules Function) fault, and relates to the technical field of information. According to the method and the device for service restoration after the PCRF fault, performance consumption of a PCRF network element can be reduced. The method comprises the steps of when a P-CSCF network element receives a VoLTE service request sent from a user terminal, firstly inquiring a currently registered PCRF network element of the user terminal and judging whether the PCRF network element is in fault by the P-CSCF network element; if the PCRF network element is in fault, sending a notification message to an HSS through an S-CSCF network element, wherein the notification message carries a disaster recovery identifier, and the notification message is used for notifying the S-CSCF network element and the HSS that the PCRF network element is in fault; then sending an IDR message to an MME by the HSS, wherein the IDR message is used for indicating the MME to send an indication message for load release to the user terminal; and finally, when the user terminal receives the indication message for load release sent from the MME, registering a new PCRF network element again by the user terminal. The method and the device are applicable for service restoration after the PCRF fault.

title_en: Direct current convertor station containing power supply recovery route optimization method based on artificial bee colony algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a direct current convertor station containing power supply recovery route optimization method based on an artificial bee colony algorithm. The maximum ratio between electric energy production and recovery time in a recovery process of a to-be-recovered power supply is taken as the optimization target; a partial optimized power transmission path of a to-be-started power supply is solved based on a Dijkstra shortest route algorithm; and a global optimal recovery route is solved based on the artificial bee colony algorithm. The power supply recovery route optimization method comprises the steps of 1, initializing power supply recovery sequence codes; 2, searching a shortest route from an electrified system to the to-be-recovered power supply by adopting the Dijkstra algorithm; 3, performing technological verification on the to-be-recovered power supply and the recovered path of the to-be-recovered power supply; and 4, optimizing the power supply recovery sequences based on the artificial bee colony algorithm. According to the method, a universal mode for optimizing the power transmission route of a power grid containing the direct current convertor station is proposed; the optimization is realized based on the advantages of high rate of convergence and strong global searching capability of the artificial bee colony algorithm; and the optimization method is of great significance for a black-start scheme after blackouts.

title_en: Rice field water purifying agent with sludge as matrix and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a rice field water purifying agent with sludge as a matrix and relates to the technical field of sewage treatment. The water purifying agent is prepared from 500-650 parts of sludge, 50-150 parts of quick lime, 50-150 parts of montmorillonite powder, 20-50 parts of crystal powder and 20-35 parts of sodium hydrogen phosphite. The water purifying agent has the advantages that the characteristics of fast adhesion settling of the sludge and the sludge containing rich plant auxin are adopted and combined with the quick lime for sterilization and deodorization, sodium hydrogen phosphite is used for activating lime ions, the sterilizing effect of the lime can be better, pesticide residues in the sludge can be removed, by the cooperation with the montmorillonite powder and the crystal powder, total suspended solids in water in a rice field can be eliminated thoroughly, a fertilizer mixture mixed and dissolved in the water can be wrapped to deposit on the water bottom, when it rains, the fertilizer mixture can not run off along with rainwater, nutrients of the sludge can support growth of rice seedlings, and the quick lime in the composition has an inhibition effect of rice blast. The water purifying agent is used in the dry field, can preserve moisture, resist disasters and improve soil, and plays important roles in sludge return to the field, sludge water purification and country ecology scene protection and restoration.
assignees: ANHUI RUIYU ENV PURIFICATION CREATIVE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid line fault first-aid repair scheduling simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid line fault emergency repair dispatching simulation method and system, which are characterized in that a power grid structure topological graph is obtained according to power grid line data, the types of switches in the power grid lines and the connection relations between various switches and lines are set according to the power grid structure topological graph, a power grid simulation line is constructed, when a line fault at a certain position in a power grid is simulated, the state of the switches in the power grid simulation line is read, a dispatching instruction is generated, emergency repair personnel are dispatched to the position of a section switch to check and send the front section line in a trial mode according to the dispatching instruction, the operation is repeated until the line in the power grid simulation line trips again, and a line section where the fault is located is determined. In the whole process, the power grid simulation circuit is constructed and the fault simulation processing is carried out, so that the training of power grid workers can be realized, the power grid workers can coordinate and cooperate to quickly isolate faults as soon as possible, and the power supply can be quickly recovered.

title_en: A kind of method of power system restoration power after calculating is had a power failure on a large scale
abstract_en: A kind of method of power system restoration power after having a power failure on a large scale the invention discloses calculating, including：1) particular state of system after identification has a power failure, obtains data used in calculating；2) available black starting-up unit in system is filtered out, calculates the sum of capacity of all black starting-up units and corresponding perunit value；3) each unit to be restored in system is calculated to the average beeline and load bus of black starting-up unit to the average beeline of each machine group node, and the average distance both calculated；4) using the capacity of black starting-up unit and perunit value and step 3) in average distance business as power grid after having a power failure on a large scale restoring force.Advantageous effect of the present invention：Provide a kind of means of quantification to assess and analyzing restoring force of the power grid after having a power failure on a large scale, and can weak spot of the power grid easy to find in terms of restoring force is improved, proposition is correspondingly improved measure.

title_en: The monthly repair schedule economy optimization method of equipment based on decreasing concentration index under network loss
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of monthly repair schedule economy optimization method of the equipment based on decreasing concentration index under network loss, including：Generate the benchmark power system operating mode data under monthly repair schedule economy optimization；The power system operating mode calculating data in initial time section under different maintenance Start Dates can overhauled by generating each adjustable repair apparatus；Calculate decreasing concentration index under the monthly network loss of each adjustable repair apparatus；Considering security scleronomic constraint carries out monthly interior adjustable repair apparatus economy and optimizes layout.The present invention is based on electric power system tides to calculate and time-domain-simulation technology, pass through the optimization layout of the monthly repair schedule of equipment, the total network loss of power system operating mode under the monthly repair schedule of equipment is reduced, sending out the monthly repair schedule economy optimization layout of power transmission and transforming equipment for electric system provides decision support.

When the supply of the second power source is resumed and when the processing unit was previously terminated in error and the automatic restoration disable signal is outputted from the timer unit, the power control unit stops the supply of the first power source and keeps it stopped until the power source is turned on via the push switch.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

The standby pump is installed when a sewage pump has stopped, and sucks sewage water in the sewage tank through the suction hose and discharges the sewage water to the force-feed pipe through the discharge hose.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: System, method, and apparatus for daisy chain network protection from node malfunction or power outage
abstract_en: Systems, methods, and apparatuses for protecting daisy chain networks from node malfunction or power outage are disclosed. One or more communication nodes in a daisy chain network can be bypass-capable communication nodes. Bypass-capable communication nodes can include a sensing and switching subsystem, embedded in the node or external to the node in a fiber optic cable running along the daisy chain network. In embodiments, the sensing and switching subsystem can responsively switch the bypass-capable communication node from communication node primary circuitry to primary circuitry responsive to node malfunction or node power outage. The sensing and switching subsystem also can switch back from bypass circuitry to primary circuitry responsive to restoration of node function or node power. In embodiments, switching occurs responsive to excitation or de-excitation of the node itself.

title_en: Systems and methods for managing power at an optical network terminal
abstract_en: Systems and methods presented herein provide for operating an optical network terminal (ONT) during a power outage. In one embodiment, an ONT includes an opto-electrical converter operable to receive an optical signal and to convert the optical signal to a data signal, and a data processing module operable to process data from the data signal. The ONT also includes a power management unit operable to detect a power outage of a power supply, to initiate a low power mode, to terminate a portion of data processing by the data processing module based on the low power mode, to convert the optical signal to electrical power, and to maintain operation of the low power mode utilizing the electrical power. The power management unit is further operable to monitor the power supply for restoration of power, and to reinitialize the data processing module upon restoration of power.

abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of applying an online safety analysis result to load prediction, and particularly relates to a power dispatching online trend early warning system based on ultra short term load prediction. Particularly, through statistics, analysis and prediction on load data, a power grid future trend is calculated, and a power grid short term trend early warning and accident post-treatment plan is formed. The system of the invention comprises the following operation steps of short term load prediction based on electricity consumption large data analysis, trend tendency analysis through ultra short term load obtained based on an ARIMA algorithm, power grid risk assessment and warning, equipment maintenance schedule management, data access panoramic surveillance, treatment in the accident and power supply restoration after the accident. title_en: Power system restoration device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system restoration device, and the device comprises a voltage monitoring unit, a current monitoring unit, and a restoration unit. The restoration unit is connected with the voltage monitoring unit and the current monitoring unit. The voltage monitoring unit is used for monitoring the voltage operation condition of a power system, and enables an abnormal condition to be reported to the restoration unit when a voltage operation abnormality is found. The current monitoring unit is used for monitoring the current operation condition of the power system, and enables an abnormal condition to be reported to the restoration unit when a current operation abnormality is found. The restoration unit is used for controlling the voltage monitoring unit and the current monitoring unit in real time, and sends an operation abnormality prompt of the power system during the reporting of the abnormality of the voltage monitoring unit or the current monitoring unit. The device provided by the invention can timely send the operation abnormality prompt when the abnormality happens to the power system.

title_en: Method for preventing spontaneous combustion of coal seam of stopping line of strip mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preventing spontaneous combustion of a coal seam of a stopping line of a strip mine. The method is suitable for preventing and treating a spontaneous combustion disaster of the stopping line of the strip mine. Firstly, leveling or sloping treatment is conducted on coal at the stopping line, a relatively gentle working surface is formed, and a mechanical method or an oriented blasting method is used for conducting stripping, so that loose coal and redundant float coal of an outcrop coal surface are removed; then a temperature sensing controlled release type coal spontaneous combustion chemical inhibitor is sprayed on the outcrop coal surface subjected to stripping; furthermore, a coal seam outcrop subjected to inhibitor treatment is filled and blocked with a high-water quick coagulating blocking material; afterward, the upper side of crop coal of the stopping line is covered with a finely ground coverage material, and the finely ground coverage material is flattened and compacted to form a material covering layer; and finally, the material covering layer is covered with soil, and soil conditions are provided for later afforestation and ecological restoration. The method can be used for effectively preventing the later spontaneous combustion disaster of the crop coal of the stopping line, provides a base for ecological restoration of a mine lot with closed pits, and has high practicality.

The ecological restoration system is constructed by the ecological restoration method, and water gushed from a water gushing point can be discharged by arranging a drainage channel, so that uncontrollable flood disasters caused by water gushing diffusion and random channeling are avoided; in addition, the guide drainage layer is laid on the slope surface, so that water burst can be rapidly output, direct impact of the water burst on the vegetation substrate layer and the vegetation layer is avoided, geological disasters such as slumping are caused, and the water burst can be fully utilized to enable the water burst to become a water source required for plant growth.

title_en: A kind of service restoration scheme generation method based on multiway tree search
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of service restoration scheme generation methods based on multiway tree search, comprising: the expecting state of default all switches of multiway tree is to close.Count the power supply number of each node of multiway tree.Count the remaining spare capacity of each node of multiway tree.Multiway tree is traversed, if the remaining spare capacity of its child node that " remaining spare capacity " is negative and its power supply number is 1 of the node that power supply number is 1 is not negative, the switch expecting state for being arranged between the two is set as point.Multiway tree is traversed, if there are the remaining spare capacities of child node and two child nodes that 2 power supply numbers are 1 not to be negative for the node that power supply number is 2, the switch expecting state between the small child node of remaining spare capacity is set as point.New multiway tree is formed, is repeated the above steps.When multiway tree root node power supply number be less than or equal to 1, then can be generated interconnection switch close control command and other switch point control commands.The present invention has the advantages that algorithm is succinctly clear, clear logic, formation speed is fast.

title_en: Multifunctional ecological management method for cavernous body
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multifunctional ecological management method for a cavernous body. The method comprises the construction of a water-retention storage pipe network and an ecological management layer (containing a plant oxygen production layer formed by plants on the water-retention storage pipe network); the water retention storage pipe network collects and stores water from the ground surface and/or the underground, and also conveys the stored water to plants of the ecological management layer to supply water for the growth and evolution of organisms of the ecological management layer. The method combines the reuse of water resource with ecological management engineering, solves the problems of flooding and drought, promotes the formation, development and maintenance of an ecological management system, and helps to promote the great development and revolution of biological oxygen movement. The ecological restoration method is suitable for being applied to the construction fields of cities, towns, new rural areas, constructed wetlands, industrial and mining enterprises and the like, and particularly can be applied to ecological management of areas such as mines, oil fields, geological disaster prone areas, desert lands, saline-alkali soil, desert lands, estuaries, coasts, mudflats, wetlands, hydro-fluctuation belts, traffic roads and the like, and other areas needing ecological restoration in the production and living environment of people.

title_en: Cold load pickup support through local condition detection
abstract_en: A cold load pickup device includes a load controller comprising a microprocessor or microcontroller. The device is programmed to detect restoration of power after a power outage on a circuit powering an electric load. A power outage time for the power outage is determined, and a startup delay for the electric load is determined based on the power outage time. A startup delay mechanism, such as a power relay operated by the load controller or switching of the load on/off by the load controller, is configured to apply the startup delay after the detected restoration of power before restarting the electric load. In some embodiments, the startup delay for the electric load is determined based on the power outage time and a startup delay versus power outage time curve stored in a non-volatile memory of the load controller.

title_en: Non-Volatile Flip-Flop with Enhanced-Scan Capability to Sustain Sudden Power Failure
abstract_en: Non-volatile flip-flops (NVFFs) based circuitries and schemes that incorporate magnetic tunnel junctions (MTJs) are provided to ensure fast data storage and restoration from an intentional or unintentional power outage. The NVFFs based circuitries and schemes also include enhanced scan mode testing capability by exploiting the nonvolatile latch to function as hold latch for delay testing. The NVFFs based circuitries and schemes eliminate additional write drivers, and may operate at an operation frequency of, for example, up to 2 GHz at a supply voltage of 1.1 V and with 0.55 pJ of energy consumption. A near uniform write latency can be achieved through transistor sizing, given write asymmetry of MTJs. NVFFs based circuitries and schemes incorporating data-dependent power gating circuitries can be used to mitigate high static currents generated during retention and back-to-back writing of identical input data.

abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enable correct determination of an insulation deterioration state, by continuing measurement and recording of a line current without troubled by a current value abnormality alarm, if a current value abnormally alarm is raised through the periodic measurement of a signal line current to which terminal equipment is connected.SOLUTION: A tunnel disaster system prevention performs monitoring by connecting terminal equipment, having a report device and detectors 16, 18, to a signal line extracted from a disaster prevention board 10 to the inside of a tunnel. Line current monitor means 72 provided on the disaster prevention board 10 measures and records a current value which flows through the signal line, to which the terminal equipment is connected, for each predetermined period.
