abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of active distribution network multiple faults restorative procedure based on multi-agent system, method and step includes: 1) to be divided with failure power loss region division principle to power loss region, DG and active Load Regulation technology are utilized in all subregion, form all subregion autonomy recovery scheme；2) on this basis, the autonomy based on MAS, concertedness and computation capability, obtain that all subregion target is optimal and system globally optimal solution using DBCC algorithm optimization；3) in view of the new fault condition that happens suddenly, when active distribution network happens suddenly new failure, by regional agency dynamic more new strategy, to complete fault restoration work as early as possible, mixed economy loss is reduced, improves and restores efficiency.

title_en: Underground gasifier quenching and burnt-out area restoration treatment method for coal underground gasification process
abstract_en: The invention relates to an underground gasifier quenching and burnt-out area restoration treatment method. The method includes the steps of (a) cutting off injection of an oxidant; (b) conducting nitrogen sweeping; (c) removing oxidant injection equipment; (d) injecting a coolant at a fixed point to quench a gasifier; and (e) terminating a chemical reaction in a burnt-out area. The underground gasifier quenching and burnt-out area restoration treatment method has the following advantages that small amount of nitrogen, which is a byproduct of air separation, is used for sweeping a whole system, so that the problems that re-combustion is caused by leakage of the oxidant in the quenching stage and equipment is damaged due to burn-back are solved; the small amount of coolant or the nitrogen, which is the byproduct of air separation, is injected to carry out fixed-point rapid fire extinguishing on a combustion area of the gasifier, continuous and circulating injection of a large amount of gas is not needed, and the operation cost is effectively lowered; and geologic structures and conditions of coal seam top/bottom plates and overlying/underlying rock stratums are comprehensively considered, and various geological disasters and secondary pollution in the quenching stage are avoided.
assignees: ZHONGWEI (SHANGHAI) CHEMICAL CO LTD

title_en: A kind of method of intelligent allocation Power Material demand
abstract_en: A kind of method of intelligent allocation Power Material demand, step are as follows：1) based on GPS location and Location based service；2) mobile terminal, submits material requirements application to by 3G/4G networks；Service end receives mobile terminal and submits information to；3) service end calculates dispensing weighted value by comprehensive analysis such as material storage information, warehouse gps coordinate, road datas, formulates goods and materials outbound and distribution project；4) mobile terminal downloads dispensing task, and upgrade in time distribution information；The invention has the beneficial effects as follows：Improve Power Material adjustmenting management flow process, improve existing electric power first-aid personnel and other material requirements personnel complete fast power restoration work, completing engineering duty also needs to consider the present situation of materials measurement work matters, it is that material request personnel and inventory managers provide visualization and informationalized supporting method, logistics center and production division's responsibility are further divided in detail, Each performs its own functions, improves the specialized dispensing of stock in storage and produces the efficiency of fast power restoration.

title_en: Power distributor, control board and distribution board having function of cut-off and recovery by stages against earthquake and optimal operation
title_ko: 내진의 단계별 차단 복구 및 최적 운전기능을 구비한 고저압 배전반, 전동기제어반 및 분전반
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a high-voltage switch board, motor control board, and distribution board having functions of short-circuiting, recovering, and optimal operating based on earthquake-resistant stages, and more particularly to a high-voltage switch board, motor control board, and distribution board having functions of short-circuiting, recovering, and optimal operating based on earthquake-resistant stages, which sequentially trip circuit breakers included in distribution equipment including any one of a high-voltage switch board, a motor control board, and a distribution board, which recover states of the circuit breakers while detecting electrical abnormality and excessive heat when recovering the states of the circuit breakers, and which prevent an electrical shock attributable to a leakage current during a process of the recovery, thereby supporting the recovery to be safely implemented. The high-voltage switch board, motor control board, and distribution board having functions of short-circuiting, recovering, and optimal operating based on earthquake-resistant stages according to the present invention determine an emergency, such as an earthquake, based on a sensing signal of a sensor unit included in distribution equipment, such as a high-voltage switch board, a motor control board, or a distribution board, safely and sequentially trip circuit-breakers of the distribution equipment, perform safe step-wise recovery for each recovery sequence of a corresponding circuit breaker by considering an internal state of the distribution equipment when the emergency is over and states of the circuit breakers are recovered, detect a leakage current generated by a damaged one of components constituting the distribution equipment, and display a result of the detection recognizable to an administrator, thereby providing effects in which safety of the administrator is ensured and the implementation of safe recovery is supported.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 내진의 단계별 차단 복구 및 최적 운전기능을 구비한 고저압 배전반, 전동기제어반 및 분전반에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세히는 이상 상황 발생시 고저압 배전반, 전동기제어반 및 분전반 중 어느 하나로 구성된 배전기기의 차단기를 순차적으로 차단하고, 이를 복구할 경우 전기적 이상 여부와 과열 여부를 확인하면서 차단기를 순차적으로 복구하며, 복구 과정에서 누설 전류에 의한 감전을 방지하도록 하여 안전한 복구가 이루어지도록 지원하는 내진의 단계별 차단 복구 및 최적 운전기능을 구비한 고저압 배전반, 전동기제어반 및 분전반에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은 고저압 배전반, 전동기제어반 또는 분전반과 같은 배전기기에 구성된 센서부의 센싱 신호를 기초로 지진과 같은 이상 상황을 판단하여 안전하게 배전기기의 차단기류를 순차 차단시키도록 동작하며, 이상 상황 해제시 차단기류를 복구하는 과정에서 각 차단기의 순차 복구시마다 배전기기의 내부 상태를 고려하여 안전한 단계별 복구가 이루어지도록 하는 동시에 배전기기를 구성하는 구성요소 중 손상이 발생한 구성요소에 의해 발생하는 누설 전류를 감지하여 그 결과를 관리자가 인지할 수 있도록 표시함으로써, 관리자의 안전을 보장함과 동시에 안정적인 배전기기의 복구가 이루어지도록 지원하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Can repair, formula that restores to throne certainly rectangular concrete -filled steel tube frame column base node

title_en: Wind power plant output data restoration method considering wind speed data segmentation characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power plant output data restoration method considering wind speed data segmentation characteristics, which comprises the following steps of: s1, screening repeated, lacked and unreasonable abnormal data from the obtained data, and dividing the abnormal data into a continuous abnormal type and a local abnormal type according to the length of a continuous time sequence corresponding to the abnormal data; s2, for the local abnormal data, obtaining the repaired wind power plant output data by adopting an interpolation method; s3, for continuous abnormal data, based on the maximum posterior probability, judging whether the abnormal data contains segmentation points by using normal data before and after the abnormal data, then obtaining the wind speed characteristics of each segment by a normal data or mode recognition method, and based on the wind speed characteristics, generating a restored wind speed by using an ARMA model, and further obtaining restored wind power plant output data; s4, verifying the validity of the repair data and outputting a repair report; the decision accuracy of auxiliary service in the power grid is improved, and unnecessary system standby is reduced.

title_en: Carbon fiber reinforced lattice beam structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a carbon fiber reinforced lattice beam structure, which comprises a lattice beam arranged on a sliding belt on a sliding bed, wherein the lattice beam is connected with an anchoring section embedded in the sliding bed through anchor cable traction, a sliding body is stacked between the lattice beam and the sliding bed, and carbon fiber cloth is uniformly pasted on the tensile surface of the lattice beam; after the lattice beam is reinforced by the carbon fiber cloth, the bending resistance of the lattice beam is obviously improved. Therefore, the utility model discloses a landslide prevention and cure lattice girder engineering has provided one set of reasonable effectual restoration, reinforcement method. The method has the advantages of simple and convenient construction, short construction period, small disturbance to the landslide body, flexible and changeable construction range, low cost and the like, prolongs the service life of the lattice beam engineering, ensures the repairing effect of the damaged lattice beam, and ensures the life and property safety of people within the disaster influence range.

title_en: Device for manually recovering from power outage
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an electrical machine capable of manually energizing the circuit without automatically energizing the circuit at a time of energizing to recover the circuit after a power outage.SOLUTION: In the event of a power outage due to an earthquake or the like inside a circuit of a building electrical equipment, or in a circuit of an intermediate interposing plug or a secondary side electric appliance at a socket outlet of a light system outlet, a power supply circuit is shut off, and when the power is restored after the power outage, it is kept in the cutoff state, after checking the state of the secondary side electric appliance, by manually pushing the button 3, restoration energization of the secondary side power supply system is enabled.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Barrier-free tripping system of ultrahigh voltage or high voltage circuit breaker
abstract_en: The invention discloses an obstacle-free tripping system of an extra-high voltage or high-voltage circuit breaker, which mainly comprises a power circuit with a voltage value larger than 600 volts, at least one circuit breaker, at least one current detection device, a current supply and reduction unit, at least one microswitch and a linkage device. By means of the structure, a breaker safety tripping device without extra power supply is arranged on any breaker of an ultrahigh voltage or high voltage power circuit, and by utilizing a simple mechanical action principle, when the breaker encounters a major accident disaster and the power supply of a tripping control circuit is damaged and powered off, so that the original designed tripping isolation function is lost, the self-emergency tripping breaker can still automatically and emergently trip to achieve self protection, the whole power system and a switch bus are not damaged by overlarge fault current, the power system is isolated in real time, and self power-off protection is performed; waiting for the last defense line of the power restoration at any time.

title_en: Terminal-to-terminal enterprise-level dynamic virtual desktop delivery method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a terminal-to-terminal enterprise-level dynamic virtual desktop delivery method. A virtual desktop is supplied to a user in a way of distribution according to needs, so that the user can safely and efficiently access a data centralized data center from any place, and based on a management mode of a B/S architecture, the deployment and management of applications are simplified; and the desktop management cost is decreased by saving the operation expense and improving the flexibility, and the familiar PC application experience, enterprise-level desktop reliability, data protection and disaster restoration capacity are provided for the final user. The data reliability is improved in the aspect of mechanism, and rich management and control means are provided to prevent the data leakage. The virtual desktop issued by the entire data center is managed and maintained in a centralized manner without considering the type of a client machine, so that the management and dispatching and deployment of the virtual desktop are simplified, and the IT resource utilization rate of enterprises is increased.
assignees: JIANGSU PANSHU INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Automated test method and device for simulating server cluster startup
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automated test method and device for simulating server cluster startup. The method includes DC testing and AC testing. The DC testing includes the following steps that: the Linux is set to character interface startup, passwordless login and tested server login; if the test cycle number of tested servers has achieved a preset test cycle number, the testing is terminated, otherwise, the tested servers are tested, and one cycle is added to the test cycle number; next startup time is set; and the tested servers are restarted, and whether the test cycle number of the tested servers achieves the preset test cycle number is judged. The AC testing includes the following steps that: a central control machine is connected with a switch and a PDU, and the PDU is connected with a preset number of tested servers, the tested servers are connected with the switch; and the central control machine is utilized to perform power outage and power supply restoration operation on the PDU for a preset number of times through a control network, and after power supply is restored, the central control machine is adopted to test the tested servers. With the automated test method and device for simulating server cluster startup of the invention adopted, material costs and labor costs are greatly saved, and the safety of a testing process is improved.

title_en: The power failure restorative procedure of power failure repair system and the application system
abstract_en: The present invention provides the power failure restorative procedures of a kind of power failure repair system and the application system.Wherein, which includes controlling main website, the one or more control sub-stations connecting with control main website and the one or more connecting with each control sub-station to execute station；Station is executed to connect with the element in electric system；Control main website is for monitoring fault restoration strategy is broken down and determined to electric system whether；It is also used to obtain the quantity of controlled member and the weight coefficient of control sub-station to one or more control sub-stations, and fault restoration strategy is decomposed；Control sub-station is for decomposing fault restoration substrategy according to the quantity of controlled member；Station is executed for determining strategy execution object according to preset strategy execution rule, fault restoration policy unit is executed to strategy execution object.The present invention improves the efficiency of power failure reparation.

title_en: Method for restoring database and equipment
abstract_en: The invention aims at providing a method for restoring a database and equipment. A mirror image is made for a physical magnetic disk where a Sybase database of a client side is located, so that a mirror image roll of the Sybase database is obtained; the mirror image roll of the Sybase database is snapshot, and a snapshoot picture of the mirror image roll and the snapshooting time point are obtained; backup of the Sybase database is achieved; when the Sybase database suffers from disaster recovery, the Sybase database is restored based on the snapshot picture of the mirror image roll and the snapshooting time point. Backup of the Sybase database is guaranteed, and it is guaranteed that when data is lost, the Sybase database can be fast restored to any restoration time point target.

title_en: Service restoration method after failure under a kind of movement of power distribution network differential protection
abstract_en: Service restoration method after failure under a kind of movement of power distribution network differential protection, step are：Fault zone and non-faulting power loss regional analysis based on differential protection action signal；Scope of power outage internal fault moment load equipment current value is calculated according to the fault moment switched-current sampled value freezed；Non-faulting power loss region is turned to form quick service restoration scheme for route searching；Network optimization reconstruct is carried out, the reconfiguration scheme of whole feasibilities is obtained；Trend verification is carried out to network optimization reconfiguration scheme, selects optimal reconfiguration scheme；Removal of load decision operation is carried out to optimal reconfiguration scheme；Recovery operation is powered according to final service restoration scheme.The present invention restores after capable of carrying out failure fast and reliablely, improves power supply reliability.

title_en: Commercial power restore indicator for sites, such as cellular telecommunications sites
abstract_en: Systems and methods are described herein for determining the restoration of power at a site, such as the restoration of commercial power to a cell site within a telecommunications network. The systems and methods may be utilized to determine whether power is restored at a cell site when a generator is currently or temporarily providing power to the cell site (e.g., during a power outage on a utility grid that provided the power to the cell site), such as by determining the presence of a generator is running alarm message and the absence of a commercial power failure message, among other messages.

title_en: Water supply control system for restoration ecological of water bodies
title_ko: 수공간에서의 생태복원용 처리수 공급 제어시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a water supply control system suitable for representative ecological fish species in a water body. The invention sets a reference range of quality, quantity and flow rate of treated water, to satisfy inhabitation conditions of ecological fish species in the water body, and supplies a certain amount of the treated water for ecological restoration with improved water quality at a constant flow rate according to the reference range. Accordingly, a habitat environment for the ecological fish species in the water body is improved to the optimum condition, thereby maximizing the restorative effects on the ecological target species, and satisfying various treated waters and complicated water quality management standards, so it is possible to efficiently manage the water body economically, ecologically and environmentally. In order to achieve the above object, a treated water supply control system for the ecological restoration in the water body of the present invention includes: a measurement unit for measuring water depth, flow rate, and physicochemical quality of water with respect to water in a water body of an ecosystem restoration target, and transmitting the measured water information through the wired/wireless communication network; a simulation processing unit for simulating the rate of change of supply flow rate and flow speed of the treated water for the ecological restoration while comparing the measured information transmitted and processed by the measurement unit with stored reference information; a control unit for determining the supply flow rate and flow speed of the treated water for the ecological restoration from the simulation result processed by the simulation processing unit, and generating a remote control signal corresponding thereto; and a treated water discharging unit for discharging the treated water for the ecological restoration at a constant flow rate to the restoration target water body at a constant flow speed in accordance with the remote control signal generated from the control unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 수공간에서의 대표생태어종에 적합한 용수원 공급 제어시스템을 개시한 것으로, 이러한 본 발명은 수공간에 서식하는 생태어종의 서식조건을 만족하기 위한 처리수의 수질 및 수량과 유속의 기준범위를 설정하고 그 기준범위에 따라 수질이 개선된 일정수량의 생태복원용 처리수를 일정 유속으로 공급하는 것이며, 이에따라 수공간에서의 생태어종에 대한 서식환경을 최적의 조건으로 개선하여 복원대상 생태어종의 복원효과를 극대화하고, 다양한 처리수와 복잡한 수량적 수질적 관리기준을 만족하면서 경제적, 생태적 친환경적으로 수공간을 효율적으로 관리할 수 있는 것이다.

title_en: Visualization fault handling method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses one kind visualization fault handling method and device.Wherein, the method includes：The troublshooting request that first client sends is received by the second client；Asked by the second client acknowledgement troublshooting, and repairing information in troublshooting request determines the information related to repairing, wherein, after the second client acknowledgement troublshooting is asked, the first client shows the information related to repairing；And after the confirmation that the second client receives fault restoration, troubleshooting result is returned to the first client, wherein, the first client analysis troubleshooting result obtains troubleshooting evaluation result.The present invention solves existing power supply trouble and reports the technical problem that first-aid repair efficiency present in the course of work is low, customer experience is poor for repairment.

title_en: A kind of metering device production planning optimization method based on mixed integer programming
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of metering device production planning optimization method based on mixed integer programming, belong to metering production planning management field.Combing of the present invention metering production operation flow and whole-life cycle fee requirement,Requirement forecasting is considered,Material supply cycle,Central Security stock,Rotation working system,Equipment detection capability and its repair schedule,The factors such as the influence plan such as transport,Establish the metering production planning optimization model based on mixed integer programming,With cost and the minimum object function of stock,With plan for cargo arrival monthly,Calibrating plan,Distribution plan is decision variable,And solved using yalimp tool boxes,And timely feedback modifiers can be carried out according to implementation of the plan and emergency case,The method has effectively evaded the deficiency of artificial experience,Realize that the science of the whole metering production schedule is formulated,Efficiently perform,Not only meet power supply unit and its station institute (two fraction storehouses and straight with storehouse) in time uses table demand,Significantly cut down center stock and production cost,For measurement centre realizes that intelligent running provides strong support.

title_en: A kind of data disaster restoration methods, system and server virtualization system
abstract_en: This application discloses a kind of data disaster restoration methods, comprising: backs up to the metadata on the working terminal of server virtualization system；Working terminal is monitored in real time；It breaks down when monitoring working terminal, then utilizes metadata backup file, corresponding data recovery process is carried out in backup site, then starts backup site.It needs to carry out metadata backup to working terminal in the application, in the case where monitoring working terminal and breaking down, data recovery process will be carried out in backup site using metadata backup file, then the progress of work of the working terminal to break down before being taken over using the backup site Jing Guo data recovery process, it is possible thereby to reduce the business interruption time after system jam, the system failure of server virtualization system is reduced to adverse effect caused by user security risk.In addition, the application further correspondingly discloses a kind of data disaster recovery device and the server virtualization system including the device.

title_en: A kind of network load based on information gap decision theory recovers robust Optimal methods
abstract_en: Recover robust Optimal methods the invention discloses a kind of network load based on information gap decision theory, certainty load restoration Optimized model is changed into Robust Optimization Model, solved using artificial bee colony algorithm, is counted and probabilistic load restoration scheme.This method includes：1st, deterministic load restoration Optimized model during power system restoration is set up；2nd, deterministic models are solved using artificial bee colony algorithm, obtains the optimal solution of certainty load restoration Optimized model；3rd, the acceptable minimum restoring amount of load restoration is determined according to master mould optimal solution；4th, set up based on information gap decision theory and consider the probabilistic Robust Optimization Model of load restoration；5th, robust Model is solved using artificial bee colony algorithm, obtains that the expected load restoration scheme for recovering target can be reached.The load restoration scheme that this method is obtained can bear a range of load fluctuation, it is ensured that the security of power system restoration process, with certain theory value and construction value.

title_en: A kind of load restoration method for considering the cold and hot startup gap of unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of load restoration method for considering the cold and hot startup gap of unit, load to be restored is selected according to the cold and hot starting state of unit based on preference strategy, power failure network load Restoration model is set up, using artificial bee colony algorithm solving model, load restoration scheme is obtained.This method mainly includes：1st, the ranked knowledge base of each load bus is set up according to the position of the cold and hot starting state of unit and load bus；2nd, the preference strategy of selection load point to be restored is determined based on qualitative preference description language and the ranked knowledge base of load point；3rd, load restoration Optimized model is set up；4th, load restoration scheme is obtained using artificial bee colony algorithm solving model.The present invention makes full use of the cold and hot startup gap of unit to recover the load on unit starting circuit and periphery, and both avoided increases the time of load restoration due to putting into new circuit, while load restoration amount is also increased, with certain theory value and construction value.

title_en: A kind of power network restorability appraisal procedure based on multi-agent Technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of power network restorability appraisal procedure based on multi-agent Technology, it includes：The dynamic frame model of the power network restorability evaluation factor based on multiple agent is built, dynamic frame model at least includes restorability index intelligent body alliance, pregnant calamity ambient intelligence body alliance and supporting body intelligent body alliance；The intelligent body assessment models matched with each intelligent body alliance are set up respectively, the intelligent body assessment models can carry out typing to the electric network information in default monitoring area in advance and repeat following processes untill the power system restoration normal power supply of disaster area in identified assessment time interval after there is disaster, the process is to obtain disaster-stricken data in real time, restorability is scored and preserved after carrying out data abstraction to disaster area power network the present situation, while carrying out recovery action to disaster area power network by rule base.The present invention realizes the real-time dynamic evaluation to the restorability of fault recovery this dynamic process.

title_en: Base isolation structure capable of adjusting inclination of building
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To solve the problems associated with the conventional base isolation devices: in which the constriction cost is high because special materials are used; they are difficult to be used for general houses; and only insufficient consideration is given for a method of restoration when the whole building is inclined due to a step and the like occurring in a site, in the event of a natural disaster such as ground subsidence.SOLUTION: A base isolation structure has such a separation structure that building side is formed into a slip part and a ground side is formed into a fixed part. A metal frame is fastened to and integrated with a lower part of a building foundation in the slip part, and a metal member for slip and a metal member for height adjustment are mounted on the lower part of the metal frame at a position corresponding to each column portion on the foundation. A stopper for horizontal and vertical swing range regulation and a metal sole plate are mounted on the fixed part. Due to a slip effect generated between the slip part and the fixed part, resonance of the ground and the building is avoided and swing and inclination of the building are reduced, if the building is inclined, a height adjustment bolt is vertically moved, a laminated metal plate is increasingly or decreasingly adjusted and inserted into a gap generated in the lower part of the metal frame of the slip part, and thereby the inclination of the building can be restored to a normal position, and the base isolation structure can be easily used by general available materials and construction methods.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: A kind of trouble hunting method and system of secondary equipment in power system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to field of power, a kind of trouble hunting method and system of secondary equipment in power system are disclosed, by the topology monitoring information, operational monitoring information and network communicated information that obtain secondary device；According to automation equipment health assessment model, status monitoring is carried out to the topology monitoring information, operational monitoring information and network communicated information；By artificial neural network, the result to status monitoring is analyzed, to analyze the relation between relation and operation hours and equipment degree of unavailability between the running status of automation equipment, running status；According to the relation between operation hours and equipment degree of unavailability, the optimal repair time is calculated；Existing repair schedule is optimized according to the relation between the running status of automation equipment and optimal repair time and fault fast positioning is carried out.The present invention is based on health assessment model, and automation equipment repair based on condition of component strategy more can accurately be judged, improve overhaul efficiency and fault location speed.

title_en: A kind of power distribution network toughness appraisal procedure based on system information entropy
abstract_en: A kind of power distribution network toughness appraisal procedure based on system information entropy, including：According to network structure relevant parameter and typhoon meteorological data, each element failure rate of power distribution network is calculated；The typical fault scene of full system entropy constraint is chosen based on system information entropy；Power distribution network toughness, which is assessed, to be calculated, including calculates typical fault scene probability of happening, determines the scarce delivery of typical fault scene correspondence system, and power distribution network toughness index calculating.The failure scale that the present invention is likely to occur using power distribution network under the method analysis extreme weather of system information entropy, the power distribution network toughness index that areal calculation is obtained is lacked using distribution network load curve, the size of dead electricity loss of the power distribution network in extreme disaster failure process can either be reflected, the time used in distribution network restoration to normal power supply state can be reflected again.The model can be used for the disaster response ability for evaluating power distribution network, and improving measure for further research toughness provides basis, and then instructs distribution network construction.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: Restoration planning management device, restoration planning program and restoration planning method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a restoration planning management device which calculates the number of days and a procedure necessary to restore pieces of equipment while updating BCP in real time, on the basis of actual damage state and restriction of each piece of equipment and a priority showing a restoration order determined in accordance with sales ratios of such pieces of equipment, etc in disaster situations.SOLUTION: The restoration planning management device has a priority calculation part and a restoration procedure creation part. The priority calculation part calculates a priority which serves as an index to determine an order of restoring pieces of equipment on the basis of an impact level which is an index showing an impact given by each piece of equipment to the business. The restoration procedure creation part creates a restoration procedure which is a procedure to restore the pieces of equipment in descending order of the priority.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: The ecological restoring method of tidal river banister pump dispatching method and tidal waterway
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of tidal river banister pump dispatching method and the ecological restoring method of tidal waterway, tidal river banister pump dispatching method is included in river course dry season, closes the gate in river mouth；The gate in river mouth is opened in the river flood phase, during tide position at low ebb, is discharged into flood marine, current unidirectionally flow to marine；In the river flood phase, the gate in river mouth is closed when tide is at high tide, is discharged into flood by pumping plant marine, current unidirectionally flow to marine.The tidal river banister pump dispatching method of the present invention, using water conservancy projects such as the sluice of River Network, pumping plants, by water conservancy projects combined regulating measure, become reversing current as unidirectional stream, ensure river course upstream water body not by trend jacking, speed is let out under quickening, while increases the effect of dilution and the self-cleaning of water body, forms benign cycle, solves tidal river network, by trend and the double action of runoff, the problem of pollutant is back and forth flowed in river network, and the effect of tidal reach restoration of the ecosystem is improved simultaneously.

title_en: A kind of river channel ecology runoff process evaluation method based on Matter Analysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a kind of river channel ecology runoff process evaluation method based on Matter Analysis, it includes：The research each moon ecological flow in basin is calculated using a variety of existing methods, and different ecological runoff processes is formed with this；Determine ecological runoff process evaluation grade and the criteria for classifying；Matter-element to be evaluated is built according to each moon ecological flow, Classical field matter-element and section domain matter-element are built according to the evaluation criterion of determination；Determine the weight of each evaluation index；Each evaluation index is calculated to the degree of association of each opinion rating and the Synthesis Relational Grade of each opinion rating, opinion rating is determined according to Synthesis Relational Grade；The opinion rating for the ecological runoff process being calculated according to distinct methods, the water demand for natural service requirement in binding basin are comprehensive to determine ecological runoff process.The present invention establishes ecological runoff process evaluation standard, can carry out objective evaluation to it, and new method is provided to inquire into river channel ecology runoff process, and the restoration of the ecosystem for also subtracting dehydration section for power station downstream provides technical support.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI

title_en: A kind of Dredging Construction method for the canal that drains off floodwaters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Dredging Construction method for the canal that drains off floodwaters, and from upstream to downstream channel is divided into three construction sections and including following process：First construction section and the desilting process of second segment construction section, the desilting process of the 3rd construction section, dredging residual water precipitation process process and marine stockyard antiseepage process；When carrying out the desilting process of the first construction section and second segment construction section, using environment-protective desilting and using customizing, small-sized strand inhales ship and 4010 types twist and inhale ship construction；When carrying out the desilting process of the 3rd section of construction section, using draining desilting and slush pump is constructed；When carrying out dredging residual water precipitation process process, dredging residual water precipitation process is carried out using two-stage flocculence；Side slope surface is anti-when carrying out marine stockyard antiseepage process, including in the cofferdam of stockyard blends the antiseepage of stockyard bottom surface.The Dredging Construction method of the canal that drains off floodwaters of the present invention not only solves alluvial problem, moreover it is possible to removes the pollutant in bed mud, is laid the first stone further to implement Ecological Restoration Project.

title_en: A kind of active power distribution network islet operation method of consideration source lotus operation characteristic
abstract_en: A kind of active power distribution network islet operation method of consideration source lotus operation characteristic：According to selected distribution system, distribution system structure and parameter are inputted；The mathematical modeling of the active power distribution network islet operation problem of consideration source lotus operation characteristic is established, including：The burden with power amount for being set in distribution system service restoration in fault time is up to object function, considers isolated island main power source unique constraints, system load flow constraint, working voltage constraint, branch current constraint, uncontrollable distributed power source operation constraint and the operation constraint of controlled distribution formula power supply respectively；Obtained mathematical modeling is solved to obtain using prim al- dual interior point m ethod：Target function value, each node voltage amplitude, each node load recovery coefficient, the operation reserve of distributed power source and block switch cut-off state；Export solving result.The present invention establishes a kind of active power distribution network isolated island partitioning model of consideration source lotus operation characteristic, and its mathematics essence is non-linear programming problem, is solved using prim al- dual interior point m ethod, obtains service restoration scheme.

title_en: Pond dissolved oxygen prediction method based on data restoration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pool dissolved oxygen prediction method based on data restoration, which comprises the steps of determining a prediction object, defining a meteorological comprehensive index, restoring data, constructing a GRNN neural network model, initializing a GRNN neural network and training the neural network, and relates to 11 index parameters in meteorological factors and aquaculture environment factors related to pool dissolved oxygen prediction, taking the 11 index parameters as input quantities, restoring lost and abnormal data collected by a sensor by using the meteorological comprehensive index and a linear interpolation method based on the short-time continuity of the meteorological environment data and water quality data, taking the dissolved oxygen concentration as output quantity, determining the GRNN neural network prediction model, wherein the GRNN algorithm has higher precision compared with a BP algorithm in the dissolved oxygen prediction training effect of the traditional BP model, can better reflect the basic trend of the change of the dissolved oxygen in the pond within a period of time.

title_en: A kind of more gate dam plain tract wintering ecology flow calculation methods
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of more gate dam plain tract wintering ecology flow calculation methods, for more gate dam plain tract biology Habitat Characteristics, based on fish overwinter phase Habitat requirement, the method specifically includes: investigating first survey region Status of Fisher Resources, it determines the alternative fish that ecological flow calculates, Fish of interest is further then screened using Hierarchy Analysis Method；Pass through indoor water temperature response experiment for the Fish of interest filtered out and historical summary is collected, establishes Fish of interest Wintering Period to the quantitative response curve of water temperature；According to river temperature Characteristics of Vertical Distribution, combining target species wintering ground Habitat requirement determines the eco-grounderwater level for guaranteeing Fish of interest safe overwintering, and flow needed for maintaining eco-grounderwater level is calculated using water balance formula.The invention can instruct more gate dam plain tract restorations of the ecosystem and protection, and watershed water resources and configuration have important theory and practice meaning.

title_en: A kind of monthly GENERATOR MAINTENANCE SCHEDULING IN optimization method based on bi-level programming
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of monthly GENERATOR MAINTENANCE SCHEDULING IN optimization method based on bi-level programming, comprise the following steps：(1) basic data is counted；(2) first layer planning is carried out, that is, considers the unit maintenance optimization of balance of electric power and ener；(3) second layer planning is carried out, that is, considers the Security Checking that power transmission and transforming equipment maintenance requires；(4) judge that Security Checking passes through situation；(5) maintenance for generation companies constraint is increased；Calculation process of the present invention is simple, and amount of calculation is small, and development difficulty is small, and computational methods are practical, and result of calculation is accurate.The method of the present invention has two aspect remarkable advantages compared with other method：1) consider the requirement of power transmission and transforming equipment repair schedule and balance of electric power and ener requirement, meet actual motion needs；2) two layer models are based on, is two subproblems by the decoupling of former problem, reduces the difficulty of model solution, it is ensured that the solution property of model.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CORP

title_en: A kind of load restoration scheme generation method based on decision tree pruning algorithms
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of load restoration scheme generation method based on decision tree pruning algorithms, belong to power system dispatching automation technique field.This method includes：First, failure being obtained respectively the electric network model after previous minute and failure generation occurring, Load flow calculation is carried out to two models by the power flow equation after simplification respectively, trend before and after failure is contrasted, determines power supply interrupted district；Then, topology search is carried out according to electric network composition after failure, decision tree is generated by root node of power supply interrupted district；Factor of influence is determined, establishes Estimate equation；Finally, beta pruning is carried out by depth-first search on decision tree, obtains the optimal path scheme of load restoration.The inventive method provides scientific and effective supplementary means for the fast quick-recovery of grid power blackout failure, improves the rapidity and reliability of electric load recovery.

title_en: A kind of listed assistance system of intelligence and implementation method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the monitoring of dispatching of power netwoks control, more particularly to a kind of listed assistance system of intelligence and implementation method.The system includes real-time data base, OMS, monitoring backstage module, data processing module and visualizes module；The real-time data base is used to store real time data；The monitoring backstage module obtains real time data from real-time data base, and repair schedule information is obtained from OMS, accessible data is translated the information into, transfers data to the data processing module；The data processing module should be listed by the calculating of series of algorithms, automatic decision, answer delisted position, and result of calculation is passed into the visual presentation module；The visual presentation module is used to show result of calculation.The present invention provides a kind of listed security mechanism for monitoring, dispatcher, can effectively prevent the situation of sign board leakage extension or misplaced, improves the monitoring to dispatching of power netwoks control, is advantageous to the lifting of operating efficiency.

title_en: The device of restorer for an incline

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a slope ecology restoring apparatus which includes an environment monitoring unit for monitoring the degree of submersion of a river slope to be restored, a flow velocity of water flowing along the river, an inclination angle of the river slope, and an environment of soil to restore a slope ecology. The slope ecology restoring apparatus of the present invention comprises: a pair of first and second side frames spaced apart from each other in parallel; an end frame for connecting one end and the other end of the first and second side frames; a subframe for connecting inner surfaces of the first and second side frames; at least one sub-connector on which both ends of the subframe are separately seated on the inner surfaces of the first and second side frames; a vegetation part provided by sequentially stacking a gabion, an ecology restoration soil, a natural fiber net, and an aggregate in at least one vegetation space divided by the first and second side frames, the subframe, and the end frame; a cover net provided in a net shape which covers the vegetation part; an end connector for connecting and fixing the first and second side frames and the end frame with a corner of the cover net at four corner portions to which the first and second side frames and the end frame are connected; and a seed composition sprayed on the top of the vegetation part, and including vegetation soil, a corrosion stabilizer, and seeds capable of naturally growing on soil.

title_en: The arm of hydraulic machine comprising inside flow passage for disaster recovery
title_ko: 내부유로를 포함하는 재난 복구용 유압기계의 암
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an arm of a hydraulic machine for disaster restoration, including an inner flow path. According to the present invention, the arm of a hydraulic machine for disaster restoration includes: multiple links; multiple joints connected to the multiple links; and one or more linear actuators formed in order for the multiple joints to move. The one or more linear actuators include: a housing having an inner space capable of accommodating a fluid; a piston receiving pressure from the fluid accommodated in the inner space and reciprocating in the longitudinal direction; a piston rod connected to the piston by passing through the housing; and a hinge unit connected to the outer side of an outer end of the piston rod or the housing and having the inner flow path. The arm of a hydraulic machine for disaster restoration also includes a connection pin connecting the linear actuator and the link and supplying oil pressure to the piston through the flow path formed inside. According to the present invention, the arm of a hydraulic machine for disaster restoration, including the inner flow path, is prevented from being damaged as the arm of a hydraulic machine for disaster restoration does not have a hose exposed to the outside. So, the flow path is formed in a member, and influence by elasticity can be minimized. Therefore, the arm of a hydraulic machine for disaster restoration can be accurately controlled.

title_en: A Composition for Reinforcing Pile of Reinforcing Soft Ground and Restoring Disparity Sinking Construction Comprising Urethane for Solidifying Ground and Constructing Methods Using Thereof
title_ko: 지반 고결용 우레탄을 포함하는 연약지반 보강 및 침하구조물 복원에 관한 보강파일 조성물 및 이의 시공방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for a reinforced pile and a construction method thereof. The composition for a reinforced pile of the present invention comprises: based on 100 parts by weight of a polymer resin, 20 to 80 parts by weight of a polyol compound; 10 to 60 parts by weight of an isocyanate compound; 5 to 20 parts by weight of an amine compound; 1 to 10 parts by weight of a surfactant; 5 to 30 parts by weight of re-emulsification type polymer powder; 1 to 10 parts by weight of a dispersant; 3 to 40 parts by weight of fiber; 2 to 20 parts by weight of a bonding agent; and 3 to 15 parts by weight of nanoceramic particles. According to the present invention, the reinforced pile can be manufactured by using the composition for the reinforced pile for reinforcing poor ground and restoring a subsided structure. Also, reinforcement and restoration operations can be completed in a short period of time based on simple construction using the composition. Further, according to the present invention, damage of human life and property can be prevented by reinforcing ground under and around an underground structure comprising subways, drainages, underground commercial facilities, and underground power stations, which is poor due to construction of the underground structure and by reinforcing ground which becomes poor over time or due to poor compaction of embankment which is embanked in the construction of housing sites, roads, and railways.

title_en: The penetration gutters mounted in the center that trench cover and removable filter cartridge consisting of filter fabric and fine holes
title_ko: 트랜치 뚜껑 및 여과포와 미세공으로 구성된 탈착형 여과카트리지가 중심부에 장착된 침투측구
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a penetration gutter having a detachable filter cartridge at the center. According to the present invention, the penetration gutter having the detachable filter cartridge at the center can prevent a flooding disaster and can improve a function of removing rainwater by expecting effect of newly constructing a rainwater pipe conduit of a same area as an inner area of the gutter on a road in a case that the penetration gutter is installed on an L-shaped gutter section of the road. The various kinds of components on the road corresponding to a nonpoint pollution source is contained in a filter fabric included in the detachable filter cartridge of the center and is periodically treated by being replaced (expected replacement period of about three years or greater). So, the various kinds of the components are not deposited on the rainwater pipe conduit and a street inlet. Therefore, the penetration gutter prevents contamination of a river and reduces dredging costs of deposits. Also, as the rainwater of good quality treated by the filter cartridge of the center is continuously penetrated into soil through a soil penetration hole installed on the bottom of the penetration gutter, the penetration gutter contains underground water. The penetration gutter prevents a sinkhole generated due to a lack of the underground water and improves a water circulation rate deteriorated by an impermeable layer of a city. In other words, the penetration gutter can obtain the appearance of the road by having a simple design and can prevent environmental contamination by having a filtering function and a foreign substance separating function. Also, the penetration gutter is an only environmentally friendly facility which can be directly installed on the road as an economical facility capable of helping restoration of water circulation and disaster prevention by storage and penetration of the rainwater.

The cured tobacco subjected to freezing disaster restoration has orange appearance quality and color, bright luster, oil content, loose leaf structure and moderate leaf thickness, and is basically not different from normal tobacco leaves.

abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving the proliferation and releasing survival rate of tridacna juvenile mollusk artificially bred. The method disclosed by the invention can effectively improve the survival rate of giant clams and provide technical support for giant clam resource proliferation and coral reef ecological restoration in China.

title_en: Arc dual standby power automatic shutdown receptacle including overload that enables real-time remote monitoring based on IoT
title_ko: IoT 기반의 실시간 원격감시가 가능한 과부하를 포함하는 아크겸용 대기전력 자동차단 콘센트장치
abstract_en: An arc and standby power automatic blocking socket device including overload and capable of real-time remote monitoring based on IoT of the present invention comprises: a power side in which commercial power is input; a detecting unit including a plurality of detectors which are connected between a switch and a load side and detect minute electric currents, series arc, parallel arc, ground arc, and present currents by sockets; a converting unit for receiving a plurality signals detected in the detecting unit and converting the signals; an analyzing unit for receiving a plurality signals converted in the converting unit and analyzing a size of an impulse wave, a repetition rate, continuous time, pattern conversion, a shoulder, a form change of a wave, and voltage drop; a comparing unit for comparing a plurality of signals analyzed in the analyzing unit with a preset value; a judging unit for judging quality of the signals compared in the comparing unit; a controlling unit for driving the switch by the signals judged in the judging unit; a communicating unit for communicating the signals judged in the judging unit with the outside by wire or wireless for remote control; and a reset unit for restoration to an original condition after blocking operation of the switch. Minute electric currents, series arc, parallel arc, ground arc, and overload by socket devices are detected by using a plurality of detectors, among a hall sensor, a converter, or a zero phase converter. In addition, a load line of the socket is only blocked by individually judging whether sockets which are connected to a circuit breaker line for a socket embedded in a panel board have a defect or not. As a result, power outage section is minimized and defect content by sockets is grasped exactly, and reaction can be quick.

title_en: Power distribution network reliability data restoration method and system based on low-rank matrix
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for repairing reliability data of a power distribution network based on a low-rank matrix, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a power distribution network reliability data matrix according to power failure event record information of the power distribution network, determining a weighted low-rank matrix model of the power distribution network reliability data matrix according to the power distribution network reliability data matrix, and obtaining a repaired power distribution network reliability data matrix through the weighted low-rank matrix model of the power distribution network reliability data matrix; according to the technical scheme, the low-rank matrix introducing the weighting method and the Gaussian noise constraint term is utilized to repair the data defect of the reliability data of the power distribution network, so that the accuracy of the reliability data of the power distribution network is ensured while the data repair efficiency is improved, and the reliability data quality of the power distribution network is improved.

title_en: Adaptive power grid restoration
abstract_en: A method of self-healing power grids after power outages includes providing an Adaptive Restoration Decision Support System (ARDSS) for generating a restoration solution using static and dynamic input data from power generator(s) powering transmission lines, from the transmission lines and loads. At a beginning of a restoration period a two-stage problem is solved including a first and second-stage problem with an optimal planning (OP) function as a mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) problem using initial static and dynamic data to determine start-up times for the power generator and energization sequences for transmission lines involved in the power outage. Only the second-stage problem is again solved with an optimal real-time (OR) function using the start-up times and energization sequences along with updated static and dynamic data to determine operating parameters for the grid. The restoration solution is implemented over restoration time steps until all loads involved in the power outage are recovered.

title_en: Vessel seaway and maneuverability supporting system for safety evacuation seaway in event of vessel accident based on evacuation level determination using real-time restoration index, and method thereof
title_ko: 실시간 복원성 지수를 이용한 대피 레벨 결정 기반 선박 사고시 안전한 대피를 지원하기 위한 선박 항로 및 선박 조종 지원 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a vessel seaway and control supporting system for safety evacuation in a vessel accident based on evacuation level determination using a real-time restoration index and a method thereof. According to the present invention, provided is an effect of transferring support information for minimizing damage in abnormal and accident situations of a vessel to a decision maker in the vessel to provide the decision maker with safe and correct information in an emergency situation to drop judgement so as to cope with the emergency situation. Moreover, provided is an effect of providing vessel evacuation guide support for a fast and correct sailing decision of a captain, and providing evacuation guide through a speech and visual guidance. Moreover, provided is an effect of detecting an abnormal state of the vessel based on a low power wireless communication technology and quickly determining an evacuation level of the vessel and a passenger in the vessel accident. Above this, provided is an effect of integrally managing emergency evacuation guide including sea state and sailing environment information around an accident position in the vessel accident. According to the present invention, the system comprises an information management module, an evacuation seaway setting module, a control support module, a real-time restoration index-based evacuation level decision module, and an integrated vessel evacuation support screen providing module.

title_en: A closed transition transfer switch
title_ko: 무정전 절환 절체 스위치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an uninterruptible transition transfer switch and, more specifically, to an uninterruptible transition transfer switch which minimizes redundant transition consumption time between a commercial power source and an emergency power source to prevent occurrence of a power failure during a transition procedure, and restricts a transition manipulating lever connection work during a transition work by a manual lever to prevent occurrence of mortality accidents. To this end, provided is the uninterruptible transition transfer switch, comprising: a cabinet providing an appearance and forming insertion holes at an upper part and a lower part, respectively; a pair of manipulation holders installed at the upper part and the lower part within the cabinet and coupled to main shafts respectively; a pair of interlocking members coupled to one sides of the manipulation holders on the main shafts respectively, and having lower ends at which sliders are installed; a pair of guide members axially coupled to lower sides of the interlocking members respectively, and forming an inclined surface, on which a slider of the interlocking member moves through rotation of the manipulation holder, and a stopper groove which has a concave groove shape on the inclined surface and into which the slider is inserted to be arranged; a pair of springs installed between the cabinet and each guide member and providing restoration force according to rotation of the guide member; and an interlocking linker connected between shafts of the pair of guide members, interlocking with rotation of the pair of guide members by rotation of one between the pair of manipulation holders, and making the slider of the interlocking member positioned at the stopper groove of the other manipulation holder side guide member get out to the inclined surface to restore the other manipulation holder to an original position thereof.

abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of equipment faults to report method of servicing and system for repairment, including：It establishes equipment fault and reports service public network platform for repairment；The device type selected on public network platform according to user and input or the user information transferred generate maintenance service request, push to the mobile phone of maintenance personal；After one of maintenance personal receives the maintenance service request, the information of order maintenance personal is sent to the mobile phone of user；After fault restoration, order maintenance personal sends repair receipt to third-party platform by mobile phone；Third-party platform sends fault restoration to user mobile phone and confirms short message, and after receiving user and replying, return information is sent to the public network platform and is recorded.Method of servicing is reported in equipment fault using the present invention for repairment, and the process of maintenance service can be made more transparent, and the communication between user and maintenance personal is more efficient, improves maintenance efficiency, without configuring backstage contact staff, saves manpower and materials.

title_en: Autonomous restoration of power systems after natural disasters
abstract_en: Systems, methods, and computer-readable media are disclosed for autonomous restoration of power systems after natural disasters. An operating mode of a circuit breaker that is in a power system grid and that is coupled to other circuit breakers in the power system grid via communication channels is determined. Based on determining that the operating mode is a normal operating mode, data to parameterize a plurality of power grid restoration scenarios is collected at the circuit breaker. Based on determining that the operating mode is an exception mode, measurement data that includes current and voltage data is received at the circuit breaker, and one of the power system grid restoration scenarios is initiated at the circuit breaker. The power system grid error restoration scenario is selected based at least in part on a status of the plurality of communication channels coupled to the circuit breaker and on the measurement data.

title_en: Directed unmanned aircraft for enhanced power outage recovery
abstract_en: Methods, systems and computer program products for enhancing power outage recovery using a drone are provided. title_en: Remediation method for flue-cured tobacco after hail disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for remedying flue-cured tobacco after a hail disaster, which comprises the following steps: (a) cleaning the tobacco field, cleaning the ditch to drain water, performing branch leaving treatment on the tobacco field, and applying pesticide; the flue-cured tobacco in the root extending period is subjected to branch-leaving-free treatment under light disaster, medium disaster and heavy disaster; the flue-cured tobacco in the colony period is treated without branches under light disasters; in a middle disaster, performing top branch treatment; under serious disasters, performing bottom-left branch treatment; the method comprises the following steps of (1) carrying out top branch treatment on flue-cured tobaccos in a busy period under light disasters and medium disasters, and carrying out bottom branch treatment under heavy disasters; (b) spraying a leaf fertilizer on the leaf surfaces of the flue-cured tobaccos; (c) applying a cured tobacco restoration fertilizer and applying rooting powder; (d) selecting and remaining flue-cured tobacco branches, and erasing other axillary buds; (e) cultivating and ridging, and applying flue-cured tobacco growth fertilizer. In the remedial method, the remedial treatment such as targeted branch leaving, fertilization and the like is carried out on the flue-cured tobacco which is in different growth periods and is subjected to hail damage of different degrees, so that the yield and the quality of the flue-cured tobacco are improved.

title_en: Testing system for tunnel disaster prevention facility
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To improve work efficiency in a fire alarm test using a tester of a fire detector installed in a tunnel, thereby reducing work cost.SOLUTION: In an alarm test of a fire detector 12, when an examiner 34 irradiates with flame testing light a translucent window of the fire detector 12 by operating a tester 36, a fire signal is transmitted to a disaster prevention receiving panel, and a fire alarm sound is outputted. When the tester 36 emits test restoration light after the fire alarm operation of the disaster prevention receiving panel 10 is confirmed, a remote restoration signal is transmitted from the fire detector 12 and the disaster prevention receiving panel 10 is restored. Then, the fire alarm sound from a telephone call output device 40 is halted, whereby the restoration of the disaster prevention receiving panel 10 is confirmed. The examiner 34 can confirm an alarm operation and the restoration because the alarm sound of the disaster prevention receiving panel 10 is transmitted through an emergency telephone line 15 to be outputted from a loudspeaker.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Power grid power failure event identification method based on multidimensional data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid power failure event identification method based on multidimensional data, which comprises the following steps: step one, constructing a multi-dimensional data model by taking a transformer, a bus, a line and a load as main equipment; reading a remote signaling deflection signal in a detection time period to generate a power failure/power restoration event; reading a current or voltage value in a detection time period, detecting telemetering mutation by a sliding extreme value removing method, and generating a power failure/power restoration event; step four, judging by integrating remote measurement and remote signaling, and identifying the power failure type by associating a protection signal, remote control, listing information and maintenance information; and step five, writing the power failure event into a database. The invention effectively judges the power failure type by combining with multidimensional operation data, thereby automatically triggering and generating corresponding records and expanding other related information, realizing the automation of recording, analyzing and counting power failure events and effectively improving the efficiency of analyzing the power failure events of equipment.

title_en: Power distribution network switched-mode power supply recovery policy optimization method based on complete distributed algorithm

title_en: Adopt the Ecosystem restoration system in sand riverbed
abstract_en: Adopt the Ecosystem restoration system in sand riverbed, including riverbed prosthetic device and server, the riverbed prosthetic device includes connecting plate, the connecting plate includes connection ring flat-plate and lengthened plate, the connection ring flat-plate is connected with each other, the cross section of composition is closed figures, and the lengthened plate is connect with the connection ring board bottom end edge edge, for increasing the height of the riverbed prosthetic device；The connecting plate includes planting unit, and the planting unit is used to place the vegetable seeds for repairing riverbed；The server is used to store bed configuration data, calculates height and quantity that riverbed prosthetic device needs.The Ecosystem restoration system provided by the invention for adopting sand riverbed can adjust the height of riverbed prosthetic device according to riverbed situation; riverbed is tentatively fixed; and the growth of the root system by plant; prevent the landslide in riverbed; guarantee flood control results; aquatic life habitat is protected, to provide water body self-purification ability.

title_en: Methods and Systems for the Prevention, Treatment and Management of Disease and Effects of Aging Via Cell-to-Cell Restoration Therapy Using Subcellular Transactions
abstract_en: This invention describes an cellular and subcellular “social network” at a biomolecular level that provides systems and methods for life extension, disease prevention and cellular rejuvenation through the transfer or exchange of biochemical, electrophysiological and sub-cellular biomolecular constructs and/or their assemblies, either in their totality or in part as carriers of material and/or information through interactions and continuous intercourses between neighboring cells. First responder cells are engineered or primed to support such conveyances including, but not limited to: organelles, macromolecules, lipids, ions, etc. from cells able to dispose of said biomaterials, etc. to cells requiring or standing to benefit therefrom. Among other advantages, these systems and methods provide increased capacity for managing intact mitochondrial (switching) mechanisms for the restoration or improved functionality of compromised cells. As cells or cellular clusters signal or are recognized by neighboring cells, cellular assemblage(s) or biomass, they receive mitochondria that are tagged, selected or engineered for cyto-enhancement. First responder cells may be cells native to the organism in situ; cells native to the organism, but removed and cultured or modified in growth media, optionally synthetically induced to express improved functionality, and returned per ipsis or combined with restorative media to aid healing. Additional immunologically compatible cells cultured from sources other than those native to the organism may be provided as an aid to healing. This process may be activated by using chemical, physical or harmonic activators or a combination thereof.

title_en: A kind of service restoration method after the power distribution network calamity based on path search algorithm
abstract_en: Service restoration method after the power distribution network calamity based on path search algorithm that the present invention relates to a kind of, has initially set up the power distribution network topological model of fault recovery after calamity.The search of load supply path is completed on the basis of the topological model, establishes the supply path collection of load.Using supply path on-off as variable, establish power distribution network main transformer capacity constraint, line energizing flow amount constraint, important load do not power off constraint etc. constraints algebraic expression.Finally using service restoration problem after mixed integer programming tool solution power distribution network calamity.Solving result maximizes the power supply of recovery system power loss load on the basis of ensuring that important load does not power off, and can obtain the corresponding power distribution network topographic morphologies of the maximization result.The present invention can promote emergency disposal ability after power distribution network calamity, enhance power distribution network reliability of operation.

abstract_en: To provide an elevator restoration work support system for performing restoration work with respect to elevators in a plurality of buildings by placing priority on safety of people having difficulty in evacuation when a wide area disaster occurs, and to provide an elevator restoration work support method.SOLUTION: Each of a plurality of elevators 10 includes: an information about people having difficulty in evacuation storage unit 123 for storing information about people having difficulty in evacuation when people having difficulty in evacuation moved to floors higher than a predetermined floor; and notification information generation unit 126 for, in the case where the information about people having difficulty in evacuation is stored when generating elevator stop notification information according to the situation in a building, adding that information to the elevator stop notification information and transmitting it to a monitor center device 40. The monitor center device 40 includes: a priority calculation unit 43 for, when receiving the elevator stop notification information in which the information about people having difficulty in evacuation is added, calculating the elevator restoration work by placing a high priority on that elevator; and a transmission control unit 45 for transmitting the information of the elevator which are restoration work objects in the order of priority to a maintenance operator terminal 50.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Based on cloud calamity for the processing method and system of data backup restoration
abstract_en: The invention discloses the processing methods and system based on cloud calamity for data backup restoration, and when the Backup Data in local backup server changes, the data having backed up are downloaded to local backup server by the interface routine provided using cloud platform server；By the reading data folding of local backup server, the record information of cloud platform server and local backup server is compared, triggering merges queue, changed data set is merged, the data after merging are transferred to cloud platform server again；When the wherein playscript with stage directions disaster occurs for backup server, by another playscript with stage directions backup server connects cloud platform server, and the data backed up in its cloud platform server are restored in local backup server, and is continued to run in the local backup server.The invention has the advantages that: can effectively realize data from this geological disaster public cloud to the utmost, management and space utilization rate of the raising cloud platform server to Backup Data.

title_en: Wireless disaster prevention system and id setting method of wireless disaster prevention system
abstract_en: To provide a wireless disaster prevention system which wirelessly acquires an ID of a relay node within a range at which a radio wave arrives by using a setting device to read and write data with the specified ID.SOLUTION: A setting device 20 transmits a call telegram with no ID specification in which response reception intensity gradually decreasing from an initial value is set to relays 12-1 to 12-3 for reception. The relays 12-1 to 12-3 for reception transmit response telegrams including IDs of themselves when the reception intensity is equal to or more than the specified response reception intensity. When the response telegram is received, the setting device 20 acquires an ID of the relay 12-1 for reception included in the response telegram to be registered, transmits a sleep request telegram to the registered relay 12-1 for reception to suspend a telegram transmission operation. When registration of all the IDs of the relays 12-1 to 12-3 for reception within a range at which a radio wave from the setting device 20 arrives is terminated, a restoration telegram is transmitted to the relays 12-1 to 12-3 for reception to release suspension of the telegram transmission operation.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
