title_en: Online testing method for batch control function of D5000 system load
abstract_en: The invention relates to a test method for a load batch control function of a D5000 system, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of deploying a workstation for testing, connecting an independent PC server, and debugging network communication and system functions; the firewall interface is arranged, so that unidirectional data transmission of the SCADA real-time data to the test PC server is realized; thirdly, the workstation receives real-time data information transmitted by the test PC server, and a plant station system model is constructed; the work station end issues a load removal target value preset instruction to a remote control operation simulation client side of the server terminal for testing; after the remote control operation simulation client receives the preset command of the excision target value sent by the workstation, checking is carried out, and the result is returned to the workstation; the workstation terminal receives a calibration returning instruction of the remote control operation simulation client terminal, executes a load batch control instruction after confirmation, and automatically generates a power transmission recovery sequence; and solving the problem of functional difference in the test process in time.

title_en: Distribution network fault information sending method and system for power supply service command platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network fault information sending method and a distribution network fault information sending system for a power supply service command platform, belongs to the technical field of power dispatching, and particularly relates to a system module for the power supply service command platform, wherein after a fault repair information processing unit receives fault repair information, first information is sent to a distribution transformer area manager, an equipment responsible person and a power user related to the fault repair information; after the fault judgment unit determines the fault point, sending second information to a station manager, an equipment responsible person and a power user of the power equipment within the influence range of the fault point; and after the fault repair information relates to address restoration power supply, sending third information to the personnel receiving the first information and the second information. The method and the system can judge the power-on area and the non-power area according to the circuit topological structure under the condition of accurately providing the distribution network fault information, and timely release the rush-repair information to the related personnel of the non-power area, so that the power supply service command platform meets the technical index of timely and reliably releasing the information.

title_en: Power failure identification analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a power failure identification and analysis method and a power failure identification and analysis system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring power failure alarm event information, equipment information and relevant power failure event information of a production system and a distribution and dispatching system of a metering automation system in real time; judging whether the power failure alarm event is caused by a transformer or a low-voltage user; and judging whether the power failure alarm event is a low-voltage fault power failure event, a medium-voltage fault power failure event or a main network fault power failure event according to the low-voltage user intelligent meter information, the electric meter box, the transformer, the branch line, the transformer substation, the feeder line and other equipment information and a preset strategy, and carrying out power restoration processing on the corresponding low-voltage fault power failure event, the medium-voltage fault power failure event or the main network fault power failure event. The system is used for realizing the method. title_en: Gridding power failure analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a gridding power failure analysis method and a gridding power failure analysis system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining power failure related information, and determining whether a power failure event is a fault power failure or not according to the power failure event information; acquiring emergency repair process information of the power failure event, wherein the emergency repair process information at least comprises a power restoration state, historical position information and real-time position information of emergency repair personnel or emergency repair vehicles; determining an emergency repair track in the emergency repair process according to the historical coordinate information, and playing back and displaying the emergency repair track and the real-time position information on a map; determining the power failure user information influenced by the power failure event according to the power failure event information; determining corresponding grid information according to the power failure user information; and acquiring corresponding map grid information according to the grid information, and displaying the grid information on a map according to the map grid information. The invention well meets the service requirements of monitoring management personnel on monitoring the power failure emergency repair and checking the emergency repair track.

title_en: Component-level building earthquake economic loss fine evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a construction earthquake economic loss fine evaluation method at a component level, and belongs to the technical field of earthquake engineering. The method comprises the steps of firstly, constructing a component earthquake damage evaluation module, evaluating the earthquake damage of each component according to a building information model and a vulnerability database through the component earthquake damage evaluation module, then constructing a loss evaluation module, and calculating the earthquake economic loss of each component and the whole building through the loss evaluation module according to the building information model, the vulnerability database and a restoration standard library; and finally, constructing a visualization module, and carrying out three-dimensional visualization display on the earthquake damage and the loss of the building through the visualization module. The method can accurately evaluate the loss to the component, provides specific component loss distribution, and provides important reference for building earthquake repair strategy or disaster prevention design.

title_en: A Simple House

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a simple house which is a movable dry house with a space creation and restoration function having a movable green-house therein. Moreover, the simple house is manufactured by passing a test of not generating local buckling in a weight up to a designated floor height. Moreover, the simple house is a dry type residential house with excellent resistance against natural disasters. The simple house is formed as a set by a green-house moving on the ground embedded therein, and passes a local buckling test to be robust to the natural disasters, such as earthquake, typhoon, and the like. The simple house avoids a past wet construction method to be formed in an environmentally-friendly construction method so as to provide a home to humankind. Moreover, the simple house is constructed at a good price and a good restoration rate, has better performance than that constructed in the past wet construction method, and is able to be distributed at a low price. In other words, due to the good price and restoration rate, the simple house is able to be moved anywhere and anytime without damage, thereby providing a large profit. The simple house comprises a unit floor and a plurality of wheels.

title_en: Heuristic power distribution network black start reconstruction method based on tabu search
abstract_en: The invention relates to a heuristic black start reconstruction method of a power distribution network based on tabu search. The method comprises the following steps: s1, inputting original data; s2, determining relevant parameters of an optimization model according to engineering experience and actual needs; s3, establishing a black start reconstruction model of the power distribution network; s4, solving a black start reconstruction model of the power distribution network by adopting a heuristic method of tabu search to obtain a solution to be determined; s5, performing power flow verification on the recovery action corresponding to the solution to be determined, if the safety constraint is not met, adding a constraint condition in the power distribution network black start reconstruction model, setting the solution to be determined as an infeasible solution, removing the solution to be determined which does not pass the power flow verification, turning to the step 4, and re-optimizing; and S6, outputting a recovery action corresponding to the undetermined solution passing through the power flow verification. According to the method, the recovery sequence of the power-losing nodes is determined and the recovery path is optimized through heuristic black-start reconstruction of the power distribution network based on tabu search, so that the power failure loss is reduced, and the important load recovery time is shortened.

title_en: Mobile self-organization based method for optimizing and recovering communication network of distribution network in disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile self-organization based method for optimizing and recovering a power distribution network in a disaster, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring the multi-element data in the power distribution network; s2, determining the state of the power distribution network in the disaster by using a grid method; s3, judging whether the power distribution network communication system needs transient recovery or not, and determining a restoration mode of the power distribution network communication system according to a judgment result; s4, researching an optimized repair scheme of the power distribution network communication network based on the characteristics of the mobile ad hoc network; s5, finding out a feasible scheme set under the target by using a path search algorithm of network simplification and depth-first traversal, solving each feasible scheme, and selecting the optimal result as a final repair scheme. According to the method, the state of the power distribution network communication system in the disaster is rapidly determined and the optimal recovery scheme in a corresponding mode is found out through the integration processing of the multivariate information in the power distribution network when the disaster occurs, so that the rush repair time of the power distribution network communication network is shortened to the maximum extent.

title_en: Methods and systems for post-disaster resilient restoration of power distribution system
abstract_en: Systems and methods for configuring micro-grids to restore some power in a power distribution grid (PDG) in response to a power disruption over the PDG. A computing system configured to receive current condition information from devices in the PDG. Form a minimum spanning forest (MSF) to identify a set of micro-grids, each spanning tree in a forest is a self-sustained islanded micro-grid network. Assign a ranking to each inter-bus link within each micro-grid according to constraints, to identify some inter-bus links above a high-ranking threshold to be switched off during a restoration period. Identify switches that restore power to some critical loads of a subset of critical loads with different forest configurations, based on buses that are switched on, to determine a subset of micro-grids less susceptible for link failures during the restoration period. Upon receiving a power disruption, activate the switches to restore some power to the PDG.

The conversion module is configured to receive the relay package input and determine whether a circuit breaker corresponding to the electro-mechanical relay package is opened manually. The conversion module is further configured to determine whether a non-fault scenario has occurred at the circuit breaker and determine whether a time from an opening of the circuit breaker has been more than a preset time. The conversion module is further configured to, based on determining that the circuit breaker was not opened manually, that a non-fault scenario has not occurred, and that the time has not been more than the preset time, outputting a set signal from the conversion module, wherein an automatic outage restoration application resets the circuit breaker based on the set signal.

title_en: Method for emergency water supplement of degraded wetland by clean energy
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for emergency water supplement of degraded wetland by clean energy, which specifically comprises the following steps: 1) Determining a water replenishing source according to local hydrological conditions; 2) Determining a water replenishing position according to local terrain conditions; 3) Determining the minimum ecological water supplement amount and water supplement time according to the wetland restoration target; 4) Determining the power and specification of the wind power water elevator and the solar and wind power integrated water pump according to the local wind and solar water resource gap; 5) Installing water supplementing equipment on site, determining a water supplementing scheme according to site detection data, and implementing accurate water supplementing; 6) And tracking, detecting and evaluating the water replenishing effect. The invention can couple solar energy and wind energy water lifting equipment aiming at the water-deficient wetland with a surface water source or a groundwater water source nearby, and determines the optimal water replenishing time and the optimal water replenishing quantity according to the seasonal difference of the water demands of the wetland at different stages of dominant vegetation and waterfowl so as to fulfill the aims of accurate, ecological and efficient water replenishing.

title_en: Power outage and restoration detection for multi-meter nodes in a mesh network
abstract_en: A system for detecting power status changes, such as power outages or power restorations, at a multi-meter node associated with a power distribution network is provided. For example, a multi-meter node associated with a power distribution network can be configured to detect the power status change event occurred at the node, such as a power outage event or a power restoration event. Based on the type of the event, the communication module of the multi-meter node identifies meters contained in the multi-meter node that are impacted by the event, such as meters that become unpowered due to a power outage event or meters that become powered due to a power restoration event. The communication module generates a consolidated power status change message for the impacted meters and transmits the message to a headend system over a mesh network.

abstract_en: The invention discloses a user electric quantity data restoration method based on a load curve and historical electric quantity, and relates to the field of electric power data acquisition. The method comprises the following steps: judging whether electric quantity abnormality or meter reading data deletion exists or not; when the electric quantity is abnormal or meter reading data is missing, the corrected electric quantity data; if the electricity quantity cannot be corrected, the normal electricity quantity of the meter on the last day T in the first two days is multiplied by the total electricity quantity of the meter with normal rest electricity quantity in the county where the meter is located, and the total electricity quantity is taken as corrected electricity quantity data; if the electricity quantity of the first two days of the meter cannot be corrected, the month electricity quantity of the meter used for settlement in the marketing system is taken, and the daily average electricity quantity is calculated and used as corrected electricity quantity data. abstract_en: An approach is provided in which an Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) system is established in a cloud that includes a plurality of virtual machines. Next, one of a plurality of priorities are assigned to each of the plurality of virtual machines based on the one or more of the plurality of datastores to which each of the plurality of virtual machines is allocated. In turn, the virtual machines are recovered in the cloud in an order determined, at least in part, by their assigned one of the plurality of priorities.

Through the scheme, the anti-interference power supply system achieves the purpose of strong anti-interference capability, and has high practical value and popularization value.

abstract_en: It is a kind of to consider that the spare gas-of energy storage is electrically coupled integrated energy system flexible scheduling method, comprising: integrated energy system to be electrically coupled according to selected gas-, input gas-is electrically coupled the structure and parameter of integrated energy system；It establishes gas-and is electrically coupled integrated energy system equipment operation constraint and cold/electric equilibrium of supply and demand constraint；Carry out the calculating in energy storage spare capacity rolling calculation stage；Carry out the Optimized Operation of economic dispatch stage a few days ago；Carry out the Optimized Operation in real time execution stage.The present invention is electrically coupled the Optimal Scheduling of integrated energy system based on solution gas-, fully consider the complementary coordinative role of power driven equipment, gas driven equipment, and play the responding ability of in emergency circumstances energy storage equipment, it establishes and considers that energy storage cushion gas-is electrically coupled integrated energy system multistage flexible scheduling model, load restoration scheme when obtaining system operation plan and failure occurring a few days ago.

title_en: Nuclear power station three-dimensional model repair control unit, system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a nuclear power station three-dimensional model restoration control unit, a system and a method, wherein the control unit comprises the following components: the coordinate registration module is used for acquiring the three-dimensional model of the nuclear power station to be repaired and the real environment data of the nuclear power station, and carrying out integral three-dimensional space superposition and registration of the three-dimensional model of the nuclear power station to be repaired and the real environment data of the nuclear power station under the same space coordinate system; the deviation analysis module is used for carrying out missing and deviation evaluation analysis on the three-dimensional model of the nuclear power station to be repaired and the real environment data of the nuclear power station after registration, and obtaining an analysis result; and the model repairing module is used for repairing the three-dimensional model of the nuclear power station to be repaired according to the analysis result to obtain a repaired three-dimensional model of the nuclear power station. The method improves the repair precision of the three-dimensional model of the nuclear power station, solves the technical problem of repairing the three-dimensional model of the area which is inaccessible and uncontrollable to personnel, reduces the field workload of engineering personnel and improves the working efficiency.

title_en: Fire night scene restoration method based on Mask R-CNN neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for restoring a fire night scene in a Mask R-CNN model, which comprises the steps of carrying out example segmentation on flame by training a Mask-RCNN model, segmenting a region at the initial stage of the flame at a fire position at night, fusing the segmented region to a monitoring video at daytime, positioning the specific fire position, and superposing the segmented flame region to the monitoring video image at daytime by using an image mixing superposition algorithm in the subsequent operation of the example segmentation, thereby realizing the restoration of the fire scene and assisting in positioning the fire position and laying a solid foundation for the identification of a fire cause.

title_en: Intelligent stage-level studying and judging method and device for power failure and recovery events of transformer area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for intelligently studying and judging a power failure and restoration event level in a transformer area, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, monitoring power failure alarm events in a transformer area in real time, switching to a step S2 when monitoring the alarm events uploaded by a transformer area level terminal, and switching to a step S3 when monitoring the alarm events uploaded by a meter; s2, sequentially judging whether power failure occurs in the station area level terminal and the station area according to the levels, and controlling a corresponding meter to mark a power failure unit; and S3, controlling whether the meter, the terminal to which the meter belongs, the station area terminal and the station area are powered off or not according to the hierarchy according to the state of the power failure of the station area terminal, or sequentially judging whether the meter, the terminal to which the meter belongs, the station area terminal, the station area meter box and the branch line are powered off or not according to the hierarchy, and controlling the corresponding meter marking power failure unit. The method has the advantages of simple implementation method, capability of realizing the intelligent study and judgment of the power failure and power restoration of the transformer area, high study and judgment efficiency and precision and the like.

title_en: Fast reformation in a directed acyclic graph based on deferred contention to higher devices
abstract_en: A network device stores in its nonvolatile memory, in response to detecting a power outage in a tree-based network, an identifier for a preferred parent and a distance identifier for the network device within the network. In response to power restoration, the network device starts a trickle timer based on the ring identifier, for determining whether a beacon request from a transmitting node and destined for the preferred parent is detected during the waiting interval. In response to the network device detecting the beacon request during the waiting interval, the network device sets its channel hopping schedule to the corresponding channel hopping schedule of the transmitting node in response to determining the beacon request is destined for the preferred parent, enabling rejoining with the preferred parent in response to detecting a beacon from the preferred parent to the transmitting node via the corresponding channel hopping schedule of the transmitting node.

title_en: Dual-layer optimization fault recovery method based on electric-gas coupling integrated energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of dual-layer optimization fault recovery method based on electric-gas coupling integrated energy system, the present invention constructs comprehensive energy power distribution network using natural gas as spare energy, keeps non-faulting power loss area power loss amount of recovery maximum and based model for load duration is powered.It establishes bi-level optimal model and comprehensive energy distribution network restoration range is mutually coordinated with economy with the feature of environmental protection, upper layer model is optimal for target with the whole network fault recovery index, switch state and grey target contribution degree are obtained to index objective assignment using ant group algorithm is improved, and utilize grey target target center degree comprehensive assessment recovery scheme；Underlying model establishes the multilevel recovery model based on multi-agent system and obtains specific isolated island recovery scheme using scheduling broker rational management renewable energy and energy storage and pass to layer model using integrated energy system economy and the feature of environmental protection as target.Node emulation, which shows to reduce using electric-gas coupling comprehensive energy recovery power distribution network, gives up load condition, extends to obtain the electric load duration.

title_en: Exterior Emergency Reinforcement Concrete Structures Using Steel Band
title_ko: 스틸밴드를 이용한 철근콘크리트 구조물의 응급 외부 보강구조물
abstract_en: According to the present invention, an emergency exterior reinforcement structure of a reinforced concrete structure comprises: a support member arranged on a reinforced concrete structure; a steel band of a grid structure supported on the support member around the structure to give tension; a reinforcing plate attached to an outer circumferential surface of the reinforced concrete structure reinforced by the steel band by using a fixing bolt; and a steel wire rope coupled to one or more eyebolts installed through the reinforcing plate. The tension is adjusted by adjustment nuts and the eyebolts to which both ends of the steel wire rope are coupled. The emergency exterior reinforcement structure can be simply assembled and installed at a site by binding devices such as steel bands, steel wire ropes, reinforcing plates, and bolts to have excellent constructability. Therefore, improved effects as a seismic reinforcing method before an earthquake occurs can be expected. The emergency exterior reinforcement structure of a reinforced concrete structure using a steel band can be applied as effective emergency reinforcement in earthquake restoration requiring quickness to suppress abrupt collapses by destruction or deformation immediately after an earthquake disaster.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 철근콘크리트 구조물의 응급 외부 보강구조물은, 철근콘크리트 구조물에 구비되는 지지부재 및 상기 구조물 둘레를 따라 상기 지지부재에 지지되어 긴장력을 부여하도록 구비되는 격자 구조의 스틸밴드를 포함하고, 상기 스틸밴드로 보강된 철근콘크리트 구조물의 외주면에 고정볼트를 이용하여 부착시키는 보강판 및 상기 보강판에 관통시켜 설치하는 하나 이상의 아이볼트에 체결되는 스틸와이어로프를 포함하고, 상기 스틸와이어로프의 양단부가 체결된 상기 아이볼트와 조절너트로 인장을 조절하도록 형성되는 것으로서, 현장에서 스틸밴드, 스틸와이어로프, 보강판, 볼트 등과 같은 결속장치로 간단하게 조립, 설치할 수 있어 시공성이 뛰어나며, 따라서, 지진 발생 전, 내진 보강구조물로서 높은 효과를 기대할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 지진 재해 직후 파괴 또는 변형으로 인해 급격한 붕괴를 억제할 수 있도록 신속성이 요구되는 지진 복구에도 유효한 응급 보강으로 적용할 수 있는 스틸밴드를 이용한 철근콘크리트 구조물의 응급 외부 보강구조물에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Exterior Emergency Reinforcement Method of Concrete Structures Using Steel Band
title_ko: 스틸밴드를 이용한 철근콘크리트 구조물의 응급 외부 보강공법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, an emergency exterior reinforcement method of a reinforced concrete structure comprises a first and a second reinforcing step. The first reinforcing step includes: a step of arranging a support member on a reinforced concrete structure; a step of arranging a steel band of a grid structure supported on the support member around the structure; and a step of giving tension to the steel band. The second reinforcing step includes: a step of using a fixing bolt to attach a first reinforcing plate to an outer circumferential surface of the reinforced concrete structure, and using a fixing bolt to attach a second reinforcing plate in a direction opposite to the attached first reinforcing plate; a step of installing one or more eyebolts through the first and the second reinforcing plate; a step of coupling a ring of one side of a steel wire rope to an eyebolt installed on the first reinforcing plate, and coupling a ring of the other side of the steel wire rope to an eyebolt installed on the second reinforcing plate to connect the eyebolts and the steel wire rope; and a step of adjusting tension by adjustment nuts and the eyebolts to which both ends of the steel wire rope are coupled. Simple assembly and installation at a site are possible by binding devices such as steel bands, steel wire ropes, reinforcing plates, and bolts to provide excellent constructability. Therefore, improved effects as a seismic reinforcing method before an earthquake occurs can be expected. The emergency exterior reinforcement method of a reinforced concrete structure using a steel band can be applied as effective emergency reinforcement in earthquake restoration requiring quickness to suppress abrupt collapses by destruction or deformation immediately after an earthquake disaster.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 철근콘크리트 구조물의 응급 외부 보강공법은, 철근콘크리트 구조물에 지지부재를 구비하는 단계; 상기 구조물 둘레를 따라 상기 지지부재에 지지되는 격자 구조의 스틸밴드를 구비하는 단계; 상기 스틸밴드에 긴장력을 부여하는 단계를 포함하는 제1 보강단계와, 상기 보강된 철근콘크리트 구조물의 외주면에 제1 보강판을 고정볼트를 이용하여 부착시키고, 부착된 상기 제1 보강판과 반대 방향으로 제2 보강판을 고정볼트를 이용하여 부착시키는 단계; 상기 제1 보강판 및 상기 제2 보강판에 하나 이상의 아이볼트를 관통시켜 설치하는 단계; 상기 제1 보강판에 설치되는 아이볼트에 스틸와이어로프의 일측 고리를 체결하고, 상기 제2 보강판에 설치되는 아이볼트에 상기 스틸와이어로프의 타측 고리를 체결하여 연결하는 단계; 및 상기 스틸와이어로프의 양단부가 체결된 상기 아이볼트와 조절너트로 인장을 조절하는 단계를 포함하는 제2 보강단계로 구성되는 공법으로서, 현장에서 스틸밴드, 스틸와이어로프, 보강판, 볼트 등과 같은 결속장치로 간단하게 조립, 설치할 수 있어 시공성이 뛰어나며, 따라서, 지진 발생 전, 내진 보강공법으로 높은 효과를 기대할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 지진 재해 직후 파괴 또는 변형으로 인해 급격한 붕괴를 억제할 수 있도록 신속성이 요구되는 지진 복구에도 유효한 응급 보강으로 적용할 수 있는 스틸밴드를 이용한 철근콘크리트 구조물의 응급 외부 보강공법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Optimally deploying utility repair assets to minimize power outages during major weather events
abstract_en: The disclosed embodiments relate to a system that facilitates deployment of utility repair crews to nodes in a utility network. During operation, the system determines a node criticality for each node in the utility network based on a network-reliability analysis, which considers interconnections among the nodes in the utility network. The system also determines a node failure probability for each node in the utility network based on historical weather data, historical node failure data and weather forecast information for the upcoming weather event. The system uses the determined node criticalities and the determined node failure probabilities to determine a deployment plan for deploying repair crews to nodes in the utility network in preparation for the upcoming weather event. The system then presents the deployment plan to a person who uses the deployment plan to deploy repair crews to be available to service nodes in the utility network.
assignees: ORACLE INT CORP

title_en: Track structure with isolation function
title_ko: 면진 기능을 갖는 궤도 구조
abstract_en: Disclosed is a track structure having a seismic insolation function, capable of reducing horizontal and/or vertical vibrations on a track caused by an earthquake and preventing the overturning of a train by preventing strong power from being applied to wheels of the train in a moment even if a lower structure of the track is rapidly moved in a horizontal direction due to the occurrence of an earthquake. The track structure having a seismic insolation function includes: a track in which a pair of rails are fixed in parallel at a distance from a rail support member; a support structure supporting the track from the bottom of the track, and having a second lateral side facing a first lateral side of the rail support member at a distance; and a damper installed between the first lateral side of the rail support member and the second lateral side to provide restoration force and relieve a shock between the support structure and the rail support member when the rail support member is moved to the support structure in a transverse direction. Occasionally, the track structure can include a damper placed between first and second lateral sides of two rail support members, installed on the support structure in a longitudinal direction of the rails to support the rails, in order to provide restoration force and relieve a shock between the rail support members.
abstract_ko: 열차가 주행할 때 지진이 발생하여 궤도 하부의 하부구조물이 횡방향으로 급격하게 이동하더라도 열차 바퀴에 횡방향으로 큰 힘이 순간적으로 가해지는 것을 방지하므로 열차가 전복되는 것이 방지되고, 지진에 의한 궤도의 횡방향 및/또는 종방향 진동이 감쇠되는 면진 기능을 갖는 궤도 구조가 개시된다. 상기 면진 기능을 갖는 궤도 구조는 한 쌍의 레일이 레일 지지부재에 간격을 두고 평행하게 고정된 궤도, 상기 궤도의 하부에서 상기 궤도를 지지하며 상기 레일 지지부재의 양측 제1측면과 간격을 두고 마주보게 배치된 제2측면을 가지는 지지구조물 및 상기 레일 지지부재 양측의 상기 제1측면과 양측의 상기 제2측면 사이에 각각 설치되어 상기 레일 지지부재가 상기 지지구조물에 대해 횡방향으로 이동할 때 상기 레일 지지부재와 상기 지지구조물 사이를 완충하여 주고 복원력을 제공하는 댐퍼를 포함하는 구성을 한다. 때에 따라 본 발명에 따른 궤도 구조는 지지구조물 상에 레일의 길이 방향으로 간격을 두고 설치되어 한 쌍의 레일을 지지하는 두 레일 지지부재의 간격을 두고 마주보는 제1측면과 제2측면 사이에 두 레일 지지부재 사이를 완충하여주고 복원력을 제공하는 댐퍼를 포함하는 구성을 할 수 있다.

title_en: Method for predicting spininess of camel sparsifolia in extremely arid region
abstract_en: The application relates to a method for predicting the growth vigor of leaf-thinning camel spines in an extremely arid region, which comprises the steps of surveying a sample area, obtaining underground water flow field information, determining the weight and water content of soil, determining the salt content of the soil, shooting spectrograms of the sample area and the sample area by adopting an unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing technology, analyzing the coverage rate of vegetation in the sample area through vegetation coverage data in the spectrograms, and simultaneously analyzing the vegetation type and distribution condition in the sample area; combining with ecological investigation, analyzing the change condition of the vegetation in the sample prescription; and (4) establishing a groundwater numerical model, and predicting vegetation growth by combining regional water use planning. The method plays a positive role in exploring the restoration and ecological function protection of the ecological fragile area under the extreme drought condition, provides a practical method for the reasonable development and ecological function protection research of the underground water of the extreme arid area, and provides favorable data support for the reasonable development and ecological function protection of the underground water of the extreme arid area.

title_en: Consider the electric system partition zone optimizing algorithm of recovery time
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of electric system partition zone optimizing algorithms for considering recovery time, preliminary subregion is carried out to electric system according to network topology, startup power, climbing rate and the branch weight for considering generator establish the priority indicator of all units, optimization unit starting sequence；Establish the decision system with uncertain factor based on rough set；To minimize all subregion longest recovery times as target, the electric system partition zone optimizing model for considering recovery time is established；According to the unit that decision system screening needs to adjust, final unit subregion is determined according to electric system partition zone optimizing model adjusted, and unit recovery sequence is combined to carry out partition recovery.The electric system partition model that the present invention establishes considers influence of the recovery time to entire electric system division result, shortens the gap between the partition recovery time, improves recovery efficiency.

title_en: A kind of power distribution network service restoration method considering failure disturbance degree
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of power distribution network service restoration methods for considering failure disturbance degree, pass through analysis distribution network failure impact evaluation failure disturbance degree caused by load and grid structure, it divides failure menace level and matches service restoration model, execute failure recovering algorithm and generate service restoration scheme.The present invention passes through the intrinsic contradictions between the assessment of introducing failure disturbance degree and Controlling model Adaptive matching mechanism coordination service restoration algorithm speed and tactful quality, in power grid occurrence of large-area power loss, system regard the power supply of fast quick-recovery load as unique objects, power supply strategy is turned using particle swarm algorithm search, exits search after obtaining the feasible solution for restoring global load power supply；The load loss of outage caused by electric network fault is relatively light and when will not influence important load power supply, it regard the runnability after load power loss amount, control cost, reconfiguration of electric networks as evaluation index simultaneously, optimal case is searched using multi-objective particle swarm algorithm, promotes the tactful quality of failure recovering algorithm.

title_en: A kind of space resources of lake waters utilizes aid decision-making system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of space resources of lake waters to utilize aid decision-making system, is analyzed by the variation tendency to city inland lake ecological environment eutrophication and correlative environmental factors and obtains its distribution character；Then comparative analysis has been carried out to the eco-environmental quality in city inland lake different function area, has obtained city inland lake eco-environmental quality situation, identifies pollution key factor；Finally by inference pattern; the dynamic change of the Phytoplankton biomass of city inland lake is simulated; it determines the causality characteristic between environmental factor and Phytoplankton biomass dynamic change, provides decision-making foundation for city inland lake environmental protection and restoration of the ecosystem；City inland lake ecological environment is analyzed through the invention, it can not only differentiate the quality condition of city inland lake ecological environment, and ecological environment superiority and inferiority order can be being distinguished, more structurally sound improvement and recovery scenario early warning are carried out to city inland lake ecological environment.

title_en: Management method and device for virtualization platform disaster tolerance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a management method for virtualization platform disaster tolerance, which comprises the following steps: after a fault switching node in a virtualization platform is started, when an IP address of a source host with a fault in the virtualization platform is received, a storage space is created, and backup data in the storage pool are led into the storage space according to the IP address; and determining the virtual machine which needs to be restored in the fault source host and executing the restoration operation according to the backup data imported in the storage space. By the scheme of the invention, the management of the virtualized platform disaster tolerance is more convenient, and the efficiency of the disaster tolerance is improved.

title_en: A kind of distribution elasticity of net method for improving considering micro- energy net supporting role
abstract_en: A kind of distribution elasticity of net method for improving considering micro- energy net supporting role: the distribution elasticity of net evaluation index containing micro- energy net is provided；It proposes to resist the outage management scheme with adaptation failure phase based on micro- energy net, i.e. micro- energy net rolling scheduling model of the foundation based on Model Predictive Control in power distribution network；Establish the fault recovery model in distribution network failure Restoration stage based on power distribution network.The present invention can be suitable for the power distribution network containing mostly micro- energy net under the earth's surfaces natural calamities such as typhoon, thunderstorm, the fault characteristic of power distribution network under the extreme disaster of reply " scale is big, time long ", the overall process terminated to disaster occurs from disaster and promotes distribution elasticity of net, make full use of micro- energy net isolated operation and the two states that are incorporated into the power networks, the effect of multi-energy complementation inside micro- energy net is played to the greatest extent, provides valuable technical foundation for distribution elasticity of net operation under extreme disaster.

title_en: Micro-grid data fault diagnosis method based on intelligent power monitoring instrument
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microgrid data fault diagnosis method based on an intelligent power monitoring instrument, which comprises the following steps: (10) constructing a physical constraint equation: generating a physical relation constraint equation according to the topological connection relation and the physical relation; (20) and (3) timing initiation diagnosis: initiating a diagnosis task regularly by setting a diagnosis period; (30) acquiring microgrid data: obtaining original data and power parameters of system operation, including voltage and current monitoring values; (40) establishing a data restoration and fault diagnosis model: setting a target function based on the power parameters, and establishing a centerless data restoration and diagnosis optimization model; (50) and (3) distributed optimization solution: solving an optimization equation, and solving an estimated value of the electric power parameter of the micro-point network; (60) fault diagnosis and repair: and comparing the fault database to obtain the fault type, repairing the error data and issuing a warning notice. The micro-grid data fault diagnosis method has strong robustness and high operation efficiency.

title_en: Efficient data restoration
abstract_en: A data center communicates with a cloud-based backup system. Client-server roles are established such that a client role is assigned to the data center and a server role is assigned to the cloud-based backup system. On an ongoing basis, backup operations are performed. In the event of disaster or other cause of an outage of the data center, a failover protocol might be invoked such that the cloud-based backup system takes on additional processing operations beyond the aforementioned backup operations. After remediation, the data center issues a data restoration message to the cloud-based backup system. The remediated data center initiates a failback protocol that reverses the client-server roles of the data center and the cloud-based backup system such that the server role is assigned to the data center and the client role is assigned to the cloud-based backup system. After performing system restoration operations, the roles may be reversed again.
assignees: NUTANIX INC

title_en: A kind of black starting-up recovery rack planning algorithm
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of black starting-up racks to restore planning algorithm, belongs to Operation Technique of Electric Systems field.The present invention carries out in the form of breadth first algorithm is combined with dijkstra's algorithm.First in the target section to be restored determined, selection has self-startup ability and the maximum power supply point of capacity as black starting-up power supply, and black starting-up power supply is searched out to each restoration path for being alternatively activated power supply using breadth first algorithm, 4 optimal black starting-up initial stage mini systems are selected according to priority weighting function calculated result, then it uses dijkstra's algorithm with most short weight path principle, whole recovery is carried out to the rack and power supply to be restored of target section.After power grid massive blackout, the present invention rapidly can provide optimal recovery scheme for black starting-up recovery, improve efficiency and success rate that power grid"black-start" restores, Socie-economic loss caused by reducing because of long-term have a power failure.

title_en: A kind of preferential recovery district of aquatic ecosystem and its preferentially restore factor determination method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of determining preferential recovery district of aquatic ecosystem and its preferential methods for restoring the factor, the present invention adds up model using dominance and identifies aquatic organism dominant species, aquatic organism dominant species key environmental factors are analyzed using CCA, simultaneously based on IHSI and MHSI accurate quantification single species to the adaptability of whole key environmental factors and whole dominant species to the responsiveness of the single environment factor, then according to IHSIA w It determines preferential recovery district, finally obtains preferentially repairing the preferential recovery factor in area using MHSIF value.Strong operability of the present invention, required measured data is few, has a wide range of application; eco-environment restoration can be made to have more purpose and high efficiency; simultaneously; determine that preferential recovery district, the preferential mode for restoring factor progress Ecology emphasis recovery can fan out from point to area; the effect of Water Ecological Recovery engineering is improved, aquatic organism diversity is protected.

title_en: Electric power distribution box for apartment house
title_ko: 공동주택 전기의 전기 분전함장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an electric distribution box device for apartment house electricity which comprises: an incoming wire connection means and a withdrawal wire connection means which easily facilitate connection of an input wire and an output wire with regard to a circuit breaker of a distribution box and connect an incoming wire and a withdrawal wire to the distribution box; and an incoming wire separation means and a withdrawal wire separation means which separate the incoming wire and the withdrawal wire from the distribution box. The incoming wire and the withdrawal wire are separated from the distribution box when the distribution box is overheated or a fire occurs in the distribution box so as to prevent the fire of the distribution box from being spread through the incoming wire and the withdrawal wire, thereby minimizing damage due to the fire and quickly performing restoration of incoming and distribution systems.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 공동주택 전기의 전기 분전함장치에 관한 것으로, 분전함의 차단기에 대한 입력전선 및 출력전선의 접속이 용이하도록 함과 아울러 인입전선과 인출전선을 분전함에 접속시키는 인입전선접속수단과 인출전선접속수단 및, 인입전선과 인출전선을 분전함으로부터 탈락시키는 인입전선탈락수단과 인출전선탈락수단을 구비함으로써 분전함에 과열되거나 화재가 발생하였을 때 인입전선과 인출전선이 분전함으로부터 탈락하도록 함으로써 분전함의 화재가 인입전선과 인출전선을 통해 확산되는 것을 방지하여, 화재로 인한 피해를 최소화하고, 인입 및 분전계통의 복구를 신속하게 수행할 수 있도록 한 것이다.

title_en: A kind of power telecom network service restoration method based on SDN multimode channel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of power telecom network service restoration methods based on SDN multimode channel, it include: after perceiving former network link and breaking down, network topology is updated, forms new network link, and not available smart grid business is put into smart grid collection of services to be restored；Based on the new network link, the priority of each of described smart grid collection of services to be restored not available smart grid business is determined；According to priority from high to low sequence, the not available smart grid business in the smart grid collection of services to be restored is restored one by one.A kind of power telecom network service restoration method based on SDN multimode channel provided by the invention can satisfy smart grid business to network bandwidth, delay, the requirement of reliability, can effectively promote the income and smart grid traffic restoration capability of powerline network.

title_en: A kind of ecological restoration of mine system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of ecological restoration of mine systems, belong to ecological restoration technical field, the rebuilt component connected with several by joinery and its construction including water supply system, the rebuilt component includes bearing substrate and the vegetable fiber blanket that is laid on the bearing substrate surface, the bearing substrate is equipped with fixation hole, and fixed drill steel is equipped in the fixation hole；The material of the bearing substrate is degradation material；Gutter and several through-holes are additionally provided on the bearing substrate surface；The water supply system includes reservoir, pump, the feed pipe connecting with the water outlet of the pump and the spray head being mounted on the feed pipe；The spray head has several, several described spray heads are evenly distributed on the laying work area of the rebuilt component.The utility model is not only able to play the role of stable mine soil, prevents landslide, landslide, and also there is low cost, low investment, low-maintenance to afforest mine.
assignees: ANHUI XINYU ECOLOGICAL IND CO LTD

title_en: Path restoration method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a path restoration method, a path restoration device, path restoration equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an identification sequence of a vehicle, wherein the identification sequence comprises identifications written by the vehicle through a toll station entrance, an identification station or a toll station exit in a road network; acquiring a directed graph model of the road network constructed based on the position relationship between the toll station and the identification station in the road network; generating a basic pattern for each path between the toll station entrance and the toll station exit according to the directed graph model, wherein the basic pattern is a sequence comprising the identity of the identity station on the path; and selecting the driving path of the vehicle from paths respectively associated with all the basic modes according to the matching results of the identification sequence and all the basic modes so as to improve the accuracy and stability of the recovery path of the identification station, and further, reduce the time cost spent on manually correcting the path.

title_en: Small fire extinguishers equipped with infiltration fire extin
title_ko: 침윤소화약제와 튜브를 구비한 소형 소화장치
abstract_en: In general, a small fire extinguisher with a fire extinguishing gas and a tube are used for rapid fire detection and rapid fire extinguishing of small spaces for fire extinguishing costs, rapid initial suppression and rapid restoration of facilities. The small fire extinguisher is widely used in an electrical panel. Even if the small fire extinguisher is intended to be applied to cables of cable trays that are linearly stacked in multiple stages, the fire extinguishing gas only extinguishes the surface and does not remove embers from the stacked interior. Therefore, the small fire extinguisher cannot be used for the cable of the cable tray being stacked. In order to solve this problem, the present invention has developed the small fire extinguisher using filtration fire extinguishing chemicals that can be applied to the cable tray in which the cables are stacked by penetrating microcavities.
abstract_ko:
일반적으로 소화비용 및 빠른 초기 진압, 빠른 시설물 복구를 위하여 작은 공간을 신속하게 화재감지하고 신속하게 소화하는 소화가스와 튜브를 구비한 소형 소화장치를 사용한다. 이들 소형 소화장치는 수배전반에 많이 사용하고 있다. 이를 선형적으로 길게 다단으로 적층되는 케이블트레이의 케이블에 적용하고자 하나 소화가스는 표면을 소화하지 적층된 내부의 불씨를 제거하지 못하는 단점이 있어 적층되는 케이블트레이의 케이블에 사용할 수 없는 단점이 있다.    
본 발명에서는 이러한 문제를 해소하기 위해서 미세공간을 침투하여 케이블이 적층된 케이블트레이에 적용할 수 있는 침윤소화약제를 사용하는 소형 소화장치를 개발하였다.
assignees: CHAMSOL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power supply monitoring and allocating method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power supply monitoring and allocating method, which sequentially comprises the following steps: the acquisition module acquires the power distribution and transformation stop and restoration state on site through the power distribution and transformation monitoring device and sends the event message to the receiving module through a short message; the receiving module receives the short message sent by the acquisition module to acquire short message information; the analysis module analyzes the short message information acquired by the receiving module, extracts the telephone number, the power failure and restoration information or the power failure and restoration time of the short message information, analyzes and writes the information into a database; and the issuing module pushes the short message to be sent in the database. The invention solves the problems of power supply monitoring delay and untimely fault processing in the prior art, and is easy to cause potential safety hazard, and provides a power supply monitoring allocation method which is applied to improve the quick power restoration capability, shorten the fault finding time of a distribution line, process faults in time and avoid causing potential safety hazard.
assignees: ZHU RUIQI

title_en: Small-scale source load power abnormal data identification and restoration method based on curve clustering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small-scale source load power abnormal data identification and restoration method based on curve clustering, which mainly comprises the following steps: 1) Acquiring basic data of a power network; 2) Establishing a source charge power curve; 3) Excluding curves with abnormal mutations; 4) Determining a normal curve cluster and an abnormal curve cluster; 5) Normalization; 6) Determining an optimal initial clustering center candidate set U of a normal source load power curve; 7) Determining an optimal clustering number k for a normal source-to-charge power curve  opt  (ii) a 8) Clustering the normal source load power curve; 9) Determining physical characteristic influence factors of each type of typical periodic source charge power curve; 10 Based on physical characteristic influencing factors, repairing the abnormal periodic source charge power curve. The method takes the daily source load power curve as a basic unit, clusters by considering the trend of the curve to realize the identification of abnormal data, and repairs the abnormal source load power curve data by improving a k-means clustering algorithm.

title_en: Direct-current power distribution network reliability assessment method considering source-load uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses a direct-current power distribution network reliability assessment method considering source-load uncertainty, which relates to the field of direct-current power distribution systems, and aims at two operation modes of direct-current power distribution network grid connection and island, and calculates the system side power grid fault rate and the restoration rate of each load point of a direct-current power distribution network in the grid connection operation mode based on a network equivalence method; and calculating a sufficiency conversion rate parameter considering uncertainty of a power supply and a load during the operation of the island, a mechanical fault parameter of the distributed power supply and a starting switching parameter of the island system. Finally, two operation modes are combined, and a Markov model is adopted to calculate the reliability index of the direct-current power distribution network. The method can account for the uncertainty of the power supply and the load, and the influence of the topological structure of the grid frame and equipment factors on the reliability of the direct current distribution network; the dynamic matching relation between the distributed power supply and the load demand in the island operation is fully considered, the influence of source-load uncertainty on the reliability evaluation of the direct current distribution network can be more accurately reflected, and the method has good accuracy.

title_en: Method suitable for topology reduction of single-power-supply tree-shaped power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method suitable for topology restoration of a single-power-supply tree-shaped power distribution network, which is suitable for system topology restoration of a power distribution network which is arranged in a tree shape, has no looped network and supplies power to a single power supply, and belongs to the field of power systems. The method is mainly used for restoring the topology of the power distribution network system according to the voltage of each node in the power distribution network and the injected current value of the node. The method utilizes the voltage and current constraint of a single power distribution network of the power system to restore an adjacency matrix for describing the connection condition between nodes of the distribution network, then utilizes the tree diagram constraint and breadth-first search in the graph theory to check the rationality of the restored distribution network, and finally completes the check of topology restoration of the distribution network by calculating and comparing the impedance matrix of the distribution network.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Digital asset disaster recovery method
abstract_en: A digital asset disaster recovery method, comprising the steps of: dividing the digital asset into N parts of digital subfiles, wherein N is a positive integer greater than 1; the N parts of digital subfiles are dispersedly backed up; when the storage disaster occurs and the complete digital asset needs to be restored, the restoration of the digital asset can be completed only by obtaining M parts of the digital subfiles in N parts, wherein M is less than or equal to N, and M is a positive integer.

title_en: Configuration system and configuration method for relay protection level difference of automatic switch of distribution line
abstract_en: The invention provides a configuration system and a configuration method for a relay protection level difference of an automatic switch of a distribution line, which can scientifically configure the automatic switch of a huge distribution network, and the scientific configuration of the level difference can be beneficial to finding out faults and isolating the faults when the distribution network line fails, provide powerful support for quick power restoration of users and improvement of power supply reliability, and promote the intelligent development of the distribution network. Different technologies and management methods are respectively formulated, which is beneficial to the fine management.

title_en: Weathering crust leaching type rare earth ore in-situ leaching method
abstract_en: The invention provides an in-situ leaching method of weathering crust eluviation type rare earth ore, which comprises the steps of adding an ore leaching agent into an ore body, and adding top water after ore leaching is finished, wherein the top water contains water-absorbent resin microspheres. The method can effectively inhibit clay mineral from water absorption and expansion, prevent landslide, and the injected microspheres have water and fertilizer retention effects, and are beneficial to mine restoration.
assignees: UNIV JIANGXI SCI & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Method, device and system for processing operation parameters of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for processing operation parameters of a power distribution network, which comprises the following steps: collecting a first operating parameter of the power distribution network, compressing the first operating parameter to obtain a compressed operating parameter, and uploading the compressed operating parameter to a data storage module; acquiring a compressed operating parameter in a storage module, and decompressing the compressed operating parameter to obtain a second operating parameter; checking the second operation parameter, and if the checking is unsuccessful, judging whether the checking times reach a preset checking time threshold value; if the checking times do not reach the preset checking times threshold value, performing data restoration on the second operation parameter to obtain a third operation parameter; and checking the third operating parameter, and sending the third operating parameter to the data analysis module for analysis when the checking is successful. In the method, the processing of data compression, decompression, verification and data repair is added in the processing process of the first operation parameter, and the integrity and the safety of transmission are ensured.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Power failure recovery analysis and rush repair method and management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of outage analysis and rush repair, and discloses an outage analysis and rush repair method, wherein an intelligent electric energy meter is adopted to measure the load value of each node in a platform region, the load value is transmitted to a power utilization information acquisition system main station through a concentrator, the complex phase voltage of each node is calculated according to the known load value of each node, then the real-time outage state of each node in the platform region is estimated according to the calculated complex phase voltage of each node, the power utilization information acquisition system carries out reverse tracing treatment on the estimated node with the power failure event, deduces the specific position of the node with the power failure event, pushes the specific position to a target end for realizing the rush repair, and power repair personnel arrive at a designated position to implement the rush repair. The invention realizes the technical effect of actively and conveniently monitoring the fault power failure and power restoration event of each node in the platform area in real time.

title_en: Game machine
abstract_en: To provide a game machine, even when a power outage occurs during output of a security signal, capable of detecting the output of the security signal at least at any of before/after the power outage.SOLUTION: When a power outage is detected, a game control device stops output of a security signal. After power restoration, the game control device restarts the output of the security signal. When (ta+tb)ms exceeds a shortest output time 50 ms when an external device can detect the security signal, the game control device makes it possible for the external device to detect the security signal output before power shutdown. Further, when (ta+tb)ms exceeds the shortest output time 50 ms when an external device can detect the security signal, the game control device makes it possible for the external device to detect the security signal output after the power restoration.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 186

title_en: Dynamically selecting optimal instance type for disaster recovery in the cloud
abstract_en: One example includes performing a VM restore instance type discovery process, creating a test VM with a VM restore instance type matching a VM restore instance type identified during discovery, using the test VM to create a test restore VM at a cloud storage site, restoring the test VM at the cloud storage site using the test restore VM, generating a 4-D baseline vector based on the restoration of the test VM, the 4-D baseline vector identifying a particular VM restore instance type, generating a 5-D vector based on the 4-D baseline vector, ranking the 5-D vector relative to other 5-D vectors, the 5-D vectors identifying the same production site VM, and restoring, at the cloud storage site, the production site VM identified in the 5-D vectors, the production site VM restored at the cloud storage site has a VM restore instance type identified in the highest ranked 5-D vector.

title_en: A business method, apparatus and system for monitoring quantitative and qualitative environmental analytics and managing associated financial transactions
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system, apparatus, and business method for using financial instruments to provide investment incentive to fund disaster mitigation projects and/or ecosystem restoration projects triggered by real world events detected at set points by sensors and analyzed by computing devices. The detection of events results in the computational analysis and determination of a characteristics of a resilience bond or ecosystem-service bond to be issued or returned to investors. Examples involve sensors used to detect events, including flood damage mitigation, earthquake damage mitigation, or air quality improvement. In one preferred embodiment of the disclosure an investor may make an initial payment into a financial instrument being a resilience bond used to fund a mitigation project, said financial instrument pays phases to the mitigation project developer at the completion of phases of the project that occur prior to the occurrence of a disaster.
assignees: RESILIENCE FINANCING INC

title_en: Configuration method, device and equipment for defaulting power-off and power-restoration automatic tracking work order
abstract_en: The invention discloses a configuration method, a control device, equipment and a readable storage medium for  defaulting power-off and power-off automatic tracking work orders, which are characterized in that power-off work orders are obtained, whether each power-off work order is a paid work order is judged in a polling mode, if yes, information of the paid work order is sent to a  designated address, so that a worker in charge of uploading the power-off work order is prompted to process the paid work order in time, then the power-off work orders are obtained, whether each power-off work order is a target power-off work order is judged in a polling mode, if yes, power-off monitoring is carried out on the target power-off work order according to a preset rule, and therefore the worker in charge of power-off execution is prompted to carry out timely power-off processing on the target power-off work order.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD SHANWEI POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Simultaneous line loss abnormal data restoration method based on singular value decomposition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for repairing synchronous line loss abnormal data based on singular value decomposition in the field of power system line loss data management. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a same-period line loss electric quantity matrix in a mode of taking a row by day and taking a column by month according to historical operating data, and carrying out standardized processing; identifying the data type of the line loss abnormality in the same period based on a threshold analysis method; replacing and repairing the constant abnormal data based on a spline regression model, and updating the line loss electric quantity matrix at the same period; splitting the updated same-period line loss electric quantity matrix into a normal matrix A and an abnormal matrix E, and performing singular value decomposition on A; and establishing a synchronization line loss abnormal data restoration model based on a robust component analysis method, and performing iterative optimization on the matrix A to restore abnormal data. The method for repairing the synchronous line loss abnormal data based on the singular value decomposition can realize the repair of different types of abnormal data, is high in repair accuracy and high in speed, and can be used for online repair of the synchronous line loss abnormal data.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Mine side slope repairing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine slope repairing method, which comprises the following steps of S1: cleaning the slope surface of the mine to level the slope surface; s2: arranging a reinforcing belt for stabilizing the slope surface on the mine slope surface; s3: fixing the manufactured flexible steel wire mesh on the reinforcing belt and the mountain body; s4: fixing the plant growth tank on the flexible steel wire mesh and the reinforcing belt; s5: filling soil with loose structure, strong ventilation, water retention and fertilizer retention capacities into the plant growing tank; s6: planting and repairing green plants in the plant growth tank; s7: and installing a drip irrigation water supply pipeline and a water collecting pipeline. According to the invention, the reinforcing belt, the flexible steel wire mesh and other fixing devices are arranged on the exposed mine side slope, the vegetation groove is attached to the mine side slope, and green plants in the vegetation groove can grow on the mine side slope, so that an ecological layer is established on the mine side slope, the greening restoration of the mine side slope is effectively realized, the ecological environment of the side slope is improved, the slope surface structure is reinforced, and the occurrence of natural disasters such as rockfall, debris flow, landslide and the like is greatly avoided.
assignees: LU MINGZHI

title_en: Remote measuring terminal for geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disaster remote measuring terminal, which comprises a processing module, a wireless communication module, a main sensor, a hot standby sensor and a selection module; the main sensor, the selection module, the processing module and the wireless communication module are sequentially connected, and the hot standby sensor is connected to the selection module. The utility model discloses geological disaster remote sensing terminal through setting up above-mentioned circuit, has realized that the heat of remote sensing terminal is equipped with the design under low cost to switching speed is very fast, can also accomplish the activestandby automatic switch-over after the restoration simultaneously.
assignees: CHENGDU XICHUANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: seismic device for distribution board
title_ko: 진동 감쇠 기능을 가지는 수배전반용 내진장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a seismic device for a distribution board and, more specifically, to a seismic device for a distribution board with a vibration damping function capable of minimizing damage to electric devices of a distribution board by effectively reducing and absorbing energy when a shock or a vibration produced from an earthquake occurs. According to the present invention, the seismic device comprises: an upper housing fixed to a lower part of a cubicle frame; a lower housing fixed to an upper part of a foundation frame installed on a concrete floor; a buffer member interposed between the upper and lower housings; a compression spring interposed between the upper and lower housings; assembly bolts and nuts penetrating the cubicle frame, the upper and lower housings, the buffer member and the compression spring to assemble the components; and an elastic plate interposed between the upper and lower housings and having its own elastic restoration force through an elastic adhesion part protruding convexly. Therefore, a vibration is effectively absorbed through the elastic plate having its own elastic restoration force, the buffer member and the compression spring and, in particular, the elastic adhesion part absorbs large vibrations and an elastic curved part absorbs small vibrations so both large and small vibrations can be effectively absorbed.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 수배전반용 내진장치에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 지진 등의 진동이나 충격 발생 시 그 에너지를 효과적으로 감소 및 흡수시켜 수배전반의 전력기기 피해를 최소화하는 진동 감쇠 기능을 가지는 수배전반용 내진장치에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 수배전반용 내진장치는, 큐비클 프레임 하부에 고정 설치되는 상부 하우징; 콘크리트 바닥에 설치되는 기초 프레임 상부에 고정되는 하부 하우징; 상기 상부 하우징과 하부 하우징 사이에 개재되는 완충부재; 상기 상부 하우징과 하부 하우징 사이에 개재되는 압축 스프링; 상기 큐비클 프레임, 상부 하우징, 하부 하우징, 완충부재, 압축 스프링을 관통하여 조립하는 조립볼트 및 너트; 및 상부 하우징과 하부 하우징 사이에 개재되며 볼록하게 돌출되는 탄성 밀착부에 의해 자체 탄성 복원력을 가지는 탄성판; 으로 구성되어, 자체 탄성 복원력을 가지는 탄성판, 완충부재, 압축 스프링에 의해 진동을 효과적으로 흡수하고, 특히, 큰 진동 발생 시 탄성 밀착부에서 흡수하고, 작은 진동 발생 시 탄성 절곡부에서 흡수하여 큰 진동과 작은 진동 모두 효과적으로 흡수하는 효과가 있다.
