title_en: Ecological restoration structure for damage of mountain slope
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a damaged ecological remediation structure of massif side slope, including side slope cement protection frame, cement seat, water strainer, apotheca, the slope body, vegetable layer, polypropylene fibre coating, matrix soil layer, concrete layer, vegetation afforestation layer, clay layer, metalling, rock layer, wash port, connect water bucket and aqueduct. The utility model can better restore the damaged ecology of the side slope by arranging the mutual matching among the polypropylene fiber coating layer, the concrete layer, the vegetation greening layer, the clay layer and the gravel layer, thereby improving the greening degree of the vegetation in the mountain, being beneficial to the plant growth, improving the fixity of the surface of the mountain slope and effectively preventing the landslide phenomenon; through setting up the wash port, connect mutually supporting between water bucket, aqueduct, strainer and the water storage chamber, can be better store the moisture that runs off, the use in the later stage of being convenient for, very big loss of having avoided the soil and water has also strengthened the practicality simultaneously.
assignees: SICHUAN TAIKUN CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: User missing electric quantity data restoration method based on clustering compressed sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for restoring user missing electric quantity data based on clustering compressed sensing. The method comprises the steps of firstly, acquiring the current month electricity utilization information of a user from a metering system, and setting a data missing day and a missing time period; dividing the electricity utilization modes of the users by adopting k-means clustering, and constructing a similar daily electricity utilization matrix according to classification results; calculating a similar daily average power consumption sequence through a similar daily power consumption matrix; pre-filling the electricity quantity of the missing period in the similar day matrix according to the average electricity consumption quantity; judging the distortion degree of the user electric quantity curve, and adopting a pre-filling value to repair serious distortion; dividing the missing time period into blocks according to whether the missing time period is continuously divided before and after, and calculating the electric energy increase rate of each block time period; and if the electric energy fluctuation in the missing period is not in the normal range, the electric energy fluctuation is repaired in a linear interpolation mode, and if the electric energy fluctuation is not in the normal range, the electric energy fluctuation is repaired by adopting compressed sensing. The method can simultaneously consider the horizontal and vertical similarities of the data, and has higher accuracy rate for repairing the continuous missing electric quantity of the user.
assignees: KUNMING ELECTRIC POWER TRANSACTION CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Enterprise ordered power utilization decision method considering load limit
abstract_en: The invention discloses an enterprise ordered power utilization decision method considering load limitation, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring load data of a special transformer enterprise and public transformer load data in a region respectively, and classifying the special transformer enterprise according to the principles of industrial characteristics, protection degree and the like; s2, performing data processing on the MTLAB, combining the special variable and the public variable data, and obtaining a daily load curve of the region through a program; and S3, obtaining the type and name of the enterprise cut in one day, the corresponding load cutting time, the power restoration time of the enterprise cut in the peak valley period and the power restoration amount according to the regional load limit required by the superior through a program. The method has simple implementation process, can effectively solve the increasingly prominent problem of power supply and demand balance, is favorable for relieving the peak load regulation pressure of the power grid in the peak period, improves the load rate of the power grid and the operation efficiency of power grid enterprises, and has obvious economic value and social benefit.
assignees: UNIV CHANGSHA SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Power failure identification method based on electric power big data
abstract_en: The invention provides a power failure identification method based on electric power big data, which comprises the following steps: acquiring the daily operation time of the metering terminal; judging whether the daily running time is less than the preset time or not; if the daily running time is less than the preset time, collecting power failure and restoration alarm information, and acquiring voltage and current data and electric quantity data; and identifying power failure according to the power failure and restoration alarm information, the voltage and current data and the electric quantity data. The invention can conveniently and accurately realize power failure identification.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;CSG POWER GRID TECHNOLOGY RES CT

title_en: Silt loss prevention equipment for river ecological restoration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a silt loss prevention device for river ecological restoration, which comprises a river channel, wherein a silt conveying device for intercepting and conveying silt is arranged in the river channel, a flow control device is arranged in the river channel and positioned on the lower side of a filter screen, the flow control device can adjust the conveying amount of the silt according to the flow velocity of water flow, and a storage device for storing redundant silt is arranged on the right side of the river channel. Can relieve drought conditions of downstream farmlands and reduce downstream flood disasters.

title_en: Automatic closing device and method of vacuum circuir breaker in case of failure recovery by distribution line
title_ko: 배전선로 고장 복구시 진공차단기 자동투입장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic input device and a method of a vacuum circuit breaker in repairing a distribution line fault. The present invention comprises: a relay state detection unit (10) for detecting a relay state value; a voltage current measurement unit (20) for measuring a current value and a voltage value of a distribution line; a central processing unit (30) for receiving a relay state value detected by the relay state detection unit (10), to determine a power outage or power recovery state, receiving the current value and the voltage value measured by the voltage current measurement unit (20) to determine whether or not there is an accident inside or outside, and outputting a circuit breaker control signal by determining a distribution line fault and a distribution line restoration; and a VCB control unit (40) for controlling the vacuum circuit breaker according to the circuit breaker control signal of the central processing unit (30). According to the present invention, the power outage time can be shortened by quickly recovering in the event of a power outage due to a distribution line fault, and the safety of workers can be ensured during power outage recovery.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 배전선로 고장 복구시 진공차단기 자동투입장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 계전기 상태값을 감지하는 계전기 상태감지부(10)와 배전선로의 전류값과 전압값을 측정하는 전압전류 측정부(20)와, 상기 계전기 상태감지부(10)가 감지한 계전기 상태값을 입력받아 정전 또는 복전 상태를 판단하고 상기 전압전류 측정부(20)가 측정한 전류값과 전압값을 입력받아 구내 또는 구외사고 여부를 판단하며 배전선로 고장 및 배전선로 복구를 판단하여 차단기 제어신호를 출력하는 중앙처리부(30)와, 상기 중앙처리부(30)의 차단기 제어신호에 따라 진공차단기를 제어하는 VCB 제어부(40)를 포함한다. 본 발명은 배전선로 고장에 의한 정전 발생시 신속하게 복구하여 정전시간을 단축시킬 수 있으며 정전 복구시 작업자의 안전이 확보될 수 있는 이점이 있다.
assignees: KOREA ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: A distribution board of earthquake-proof type with ability of emergency restoration by using analysis of inclination from earthquake
title_ko: 지진에 의한 기울기 분석 및 기울기 자체응급복구 기능을 갖는 내진형 수배전반
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an earthquake-proof distribution board with a function for analyzing the inclination due to an earthquake and self-restoration of the inclination. The earthquake-proof distribution board comprises: a body; a sensor unit installed in the body and including an angle sensor, an acceleration sensor, a ground disconnection detection unit, a temperature sensor, an arc sensor, and a ground resistance measurement unit; a state restoration adjustment unit mounted on a lower support of the body to adjust a horizontal state of the body; and a control unit which receives a measured value detected by the sensor unit, analyzes the received measured value to determine the horizontal state of the body, and transmits a control signal to the state restoration adjustment unit when the horizontal state of the body becomes abnormal so as to control the horizontal state of the body. The distribution board detects a deformation caused by an external physical impact, a ground state due to deformation, or the like and adjusts the horizontal state of the distribution board according to the detected deformation and the ground state, thereby being capable of increasing the mechanical and electrical safety of the distribution board and minimizing unnecessary power outages.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지진에 의한 기울기 분석 및 기울기 자체응급복구 기능을 갖는 내진형 수배전반에 관한 것으로서, 본체; 상기 본체 내에 설치되는 센서부로서, 각도 센서, 가속도 센서, 접지단선 검출부, 온도 센서, 아크 센서, 접지저항 측정부를 포함하는 센서부; 상기 본체의 하부 지지대에 장착되어 상기 본체의 수평 상태를 조정하는 상태복구 조정부; 및, 상기 센서부로부터 감지된 측정값을 수신하고, 수신된 측정값을 분석하여 본체의 수평 상태를 판단하고, 상기 본체의 수평 상태가 이상 상태가 되면, 상기 상태복구 조정부에 제어신호를 전송하여 본체의 수평 상태를 조정하도록 제어하는 제어부를 포함하는 구성을 마련한다. 상기와 같은 수배전반에 의하여, 외부의 물리적 충격에 의한 변형 및, 그 변형에 의한 접지 상태 등을 감지하고 그에 따라 수배전반의 수평 상태를 조정함으로써, 수배전반의 기계적 전기적 안전도를 향상시키고 불요불급한 정전을 최소화 할 수 있다.
assignees: LEE MOON SU

title_en: Large-scale ground surface arthropod space distribution simulation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a large-scale ground surface arthropod space distribution simulation method, which comprises the following steps of firstly, obtaining the ground surface arthropod number of each sampling point and multisource environment variables influencing arthropod distribution; then, establishing a large-scale ground surface arthropod spatial distribution simulation model according to the ground surface arthropod number of each sampling point and the multi-source environment variables; finally, collecting large-scale multi-source environment variables of the region to be simulated; and inputting the large-scale multi-source environment variable of the area to be simulated into the large-scale ground surface arthropod spatial distribution simulation model, and simulating the large-scale ground surface arthropod spatial distribution condition of the area to be simulated. The large-scale simulation of the space distribution of the arthropods on the ground surface is realized, a better basis can be provided for ecological restoration design and management decision and the like of a mining area by utilizing the large-scale simulation result of the space distribution of the arthropods on the ground surface of the mining area, and the method is a necessary means for evaluating the comprehensive treatment effect of the mountain water forest field, the lake and the grass in the mining area.

title_en: Ecological water supplementing method for river estuary area of sediment-laden river
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological water replenishing method for a river mouth area of a sediment-laden river, which is used for carrying out configuration unit division on the river mouth area based on ecological function zoning, landscape pattern distribution and communication replenishing and discharging relations and carrying out water resource optimization configuration of production, living and ecological water for aiming at the water flow characteristics of the sediment-laden river. A water taking system, a sand settling system, a water conveying system and a water storage system are arranged according to water taking and using requirements so as to meet the water using requirements of a common fresh water ecological system, a saline water ecological system and a fresh and saline water interaction ecological system. A decision maker can select a proper ecological restoration scene according to multiple scenarios, and the perfect water network configuration enables large-scale tidal ditches and tidal flat wetlands in the area to be effectively supplied with fresh water, so that the harmonious, healthy and sustainable restoration and sustainability of the estuary wetland ecosystem are effectively promoted. The invention can make the ecological water supplement of the estuary region reach the effects of ecological system consideration, comprehensive water supplement region and long-term communication of the water network, and fully ensures the sustainable recovery of the ecological system.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Evaluation method of fault recovery scheme of direct-current power distribution network based on AHP-TOPSIS
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evaluation method of a fault recovery scheme of a direct-current power distribution network based on AHP-TOPSIS. Firstly, fault characteristic analysis is carried out on faults occurring at all positions of a direct current distribution network, a typical direct current distribution network fault restorability index which takes direct current distribution network fault restoration as a target is defined, an Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) is utilized to classify the restorability index, and the weight of the defined fault restorability index relative to the direct current distribution network fault restoration is determined. And then, determining a plurality of feasible fault recovery schemes under the fault of the direct current distribution network according to the fault type. And finally, evaluating the relative merits of the various proposed fault recovery schemes by combining a top-down order method (TOPSIS) approaching an ideal value with typical DC distribution network fault recoverability index values under different schemes.
assignees: UNIV HUNAN

title_en: Power grid scheduling exception handling aid decision-making method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid scheduling exception handling aid decision-making method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring historical data of a power grid, predicting the load of the power grid according to the historical data, and formulating an emergency mechanism according to a prediction result; setting preferences of the power grid prediction result in different periods, and carrying out risk prompt according to the preferences of the prediction result; acquiring real-time data of a power grid, and generating a load transfer and power grid restoration scheme as a reference scheme of a dispatcher according to the real-time data of the power grid; the invention can realize the load analysis of the power grid, adopt the pre-control measures to the heavy load equipment, realize the real-time risk analysis of the power grid, reveal the risks in different time intervals, is more efficient and more comprehensive than the prior manual analysis, and can also realize the intelligent generation of a load transfer scheme and the automatic generation of a bus voltage loss power recovery scheme, thereby reducing the workload of a dispatcher for writing a plan to a certain extent.

title_en: Data center remote parallel connection method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method and a system for connecting data centers in parallel in different places, wherein the method comprises the following steps: a first data center and a local first disaster recovery center establish a synchronous relation; the first data center only backs up the incremental data to a second disaster recovery center in different places each time in an incremental cloud backup mode; and using a cloud restoration technology to freely restore the data of any backup time point of the second disaster recovery center in different places to the first data center or the first disaster recovery center. According to the embodiment of the invention, any backup point-in-time data can be freely recovered by using the cloud backup and cloud restoration technology.
assignees: SUZHOU INSPUR INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Shear type steel truss coupling beam with friction damper and capable of being quickly recovered after earthquake
abstract_en: The utility model provides a take friction damper's even roof beam of shearing type steel truss that resumes fast after shake, including chord member, diagonal web member and friction damper. The utility model discloses utilize friction damper power consumption on the basis of ordinary steel truss even roof beam, friction damper includes: the friction main plate, the friction plate, the cover plate and the friction type bolt are arranged on the friction main plate; simple structure and convenient construction. Under a small earthquake, the shear type steel truss connecting beam with the friction damper does not slide, is equivalent to a common steel truss connecting beam, and provides lateral rigidity for the structure; under the condition of middle earthquake, after the skidding load is reached, the friction damper slips, so that the friction energy is consumed, and most of the energy of the earthquake is consumed by the friction damper. The utility model discloses take friction damper's the even roof beam of shearing shaped steel truss that resumes fast after the shake under the earthquake effect, intensity does not take place the degradation, and does not take place to destroy, only needs the friction disc of inspection, change friction damper after the shake, has the advantage that the low, in time use of restoration expense after the shake.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN TECH

title_en: Bending steel truss connecting beam with friction damper and capable of being quickly recovered after earthquake
abstract_en: The utility model provides a bending steel truss connecting beam with a friction damper and capable of quickly recovering after earthquake, which comprises an upper chord member, a lower chord member, an inclined web member, a T-shaped plate and a friction damper; the friction dampers are located at two ends of the lower chord with large deformation and comprise a T-shaped friction main plate, friction plates, a cover plate and friction type bolts. The utility model discloses utilize the friction damper power consumption on the basis of ordinary steel truss even roof beam, can select different loads that slide according to the intensity of seting up defences in different areas. Under a small earthquake, the bending steel truss connecting beam with the friction damper does not slide, is equivalent to a common steel truss connecting beam, and provides lateral rigidity for the structure; under the condition of middle earthquake, after the sliding load is reached, the friction damper generates sliding friction energy consumption, and most energy of the earthquake is consumed by the friction damper. The utility model discloses simple structure, can restore fast after the shake, the restoration expense is low.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN TECH

title_en: Ecological recovery system for field planting of slope protection plants
abstract_en: The invention discloses a revetment plant field planting ecological restoration system. Comprises a fixing component and a planting bucket component. The fixing component comprises a slope protection panel and a fixing ground pile, so that the plant planting system is fixed; slope protection panel contains two bulges and agrees with the structure and two sunken agreeing with the structure on the fixed subassembly, satisfies a plurality of plants field planting systems and makes up. Planting bucket subassembly and fixed subassembly closely combine, plant the bucket and bury the bank protection below fixed subassembly bank protection panel, plant bucket bank protection earth's surface below and combine with the slope body, plant the deep root system plant in the planting bucket, realize the fixed and soil and water conservation effect to slope body soil. The invention not only has the greening function, but also can improve the stability of the side slope, stabilize the structure of the side slope and prevent the danger of side slope landslide. The invention realizes ecological protection on the slope body, has wide size range, convenient installation and operation, compact structure and practical function, and is suitable for wide popularization and application on large-area slopes.
assignees: UNIV GUILIN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: In-situ restoration device and in-situ restoration method for black and odorous water body substrate sludge
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water body restoration, in particular to an in-situ restoration device and an in-situ restoration method for black and odorous water body sediment. The invention provides an in-situ repair device for black and odorous water body substrate sludge, which comprises a biocatalysis system, an induction reaction system and a combined filler system which are sequentially communicated; the water outlet of the combined filler system is communicated with the water inlet of the biocatalysis system; the biocatalysis system is arranged on land; the induction reaction system and the combined filler system are arranged at the bottom of the black and odorous water body. The three systems in the device provided by the invention are operated simultaneously, so that the hydrodynamic force of a target water body can be increased, the dynamic circulation in an independent water area can be realized, the dissolved oxygen in water can be increased, the whole water area can be comprehensively repaired, and the problems of water body blackout and water quality repeated deterioration in the black and odorous water body treatment process can be solved.

title_en: Life saving radio station beacon signal simulation transmitting device
abstract_en: The invention provides a beacon signal simulation transmitting device of a lifesaving radio station, which comprises a radio station signal simulation module, a frequency conversion module, a power amplification module, a control module, a power supply module and an antenna. The invention can generate the beacon simulation signal which is completely consistent with the lifesaving radio station through the ways of sample acquisition, digital processing and inverse processing and signal restoration by the digital cloning technology under the condition of not mastering the technical system and the waveform characteristics of the beacon signal of the lifesaving radio station, thereby providing a new means for researching and developing search and rescue training equipment required by maritime search and rescue training and meeting the guarantee requirement of the search and rescue training equipment on the maritime of a rescue army.
assignees: GUANGDONG SHANFENG MEASUREMENT & CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Silt reducing system for drainage beach of artificial ditch
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drainage beach silt reducing system of an artificial ditch, which belongs to the technical field of coastal wetland ecological restoration, is arranged at the side of a silt beach of an open sea and comprises a water injection ditch, a drainage passage, an outer wall and a water injection system, wherein the water injection ditch is arranged on the land behind the silt beach, the water injection system is matched with the water injection ditch to always inject water into the water injection ditch, the outer wall is arranged at two sides of the water injection ditch, water in the water injection ditch is drained to the beaches at two sides through the drainage passage, fine-particle mud in the drainage passage is started and moved under the action of water flow and is output along with the leaving shoal flow during the ebb period, and the beach is prevented from being argillized. The invention effectively adjusts the action of waves and tides through the ditches which are excavated manually so as to reduce natural disasters; the coastal wetland can effectively degrade pollution and restore the original ecological system and natural balance mechanism; through ecological restoration, the diversity of species is increased. Provides a good foundation for further building leisure tourism and inhabitation facilities and provides a foundation for developing the tourism industry.

title_en: Ecological self-repairing system and construction method for artificial tidal flat
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial tidal flat ecological self-repairing system, which belongs to the technical field of coastal wetland ecological repairing and comprises a highland, a transverse artificial tidal flat, a longitudinal artificial tidal flat, a layered coastal wetland system and an open sea; the transverse artificial tidal channels and the longitudinal artificial tidal channels are arranged between the beaches in a staggered mode to form a net structure, so that tidal water from open sea can freely flow in the middle; the layered coastal wetland system is a transition zone between a beach and a transverse artificial tidal channel and between the beach and a longitudinal artificial tidal channel; the transverse artificial tidal channel and the longitudinal artificial tidal channel are used for introducing tidal water, so that the ecological and biological diversity of the system is restored; when the wave and tide action is strong, a protection project is built in open sea. The invention also discloses a construction method thereof, which effectively regulates the action of waves and tides so as to reduce natural disasters; the coastal wetland can effectively degrade pollution and restore the original ecological system and natural balance mechanism; through ecological restoration, the diversity of species is increased.

title_en: System for detecting signal during power grid equipment power restoration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system for detecting signals when power grid equipment is in power restoration, which comprises: the system comprises an intelligent dispatching command platform, a dispatching master station, a telemechanical system terminal and a measurement and control device, wherein the intelligent dispatching command platform is in communication connection with the dispatching master station, the dispatching master station is in communication connection with the telemechanical system terminal, and the telemechanical system terminal is in communication connection with the measurement and control device. The invention utilizes the dispatching intelligent command platform to construct a detection signal system during power restoration, realizes automatic detection of the restoration signal, and improves the detection efficiency and accuracy.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ZHONGSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Slope ecological restoration system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a side slope ecological restoration system and a side slope ecological restoration method, wherein the side slope ecological restoration system comprises a reservoir dug at the top of a side slope, and a waste residue layer, a slope protection grid and a growth matrix layer which are sequentially paved on the slope surface of the side slope, the growth matrix layer is formed by paving a plurality of sacks filled with plant growth mixed matrix, the gaps between the adjacent sacks are filled with loam soil, the growth matrix layer is covered with an irrigation fixing pipe network, a water suction pump is arranged in the reservoir, the water outlet of the water suction pump is connected with a water outlet pipe, and the other end of the water outlet pipe is communicated with a. The invention has the effects of preventing water and soil loss, slope landslide and the like, and has the function of irrigating the vegetation on the slope. The slope anchoring and the ecosystem repairing are combined together, the top of the slope can be used as a road, and the service life of the whole slope is effectively prolonged.
assignees: SHENZHEN GUIREN ECOLOGICAL CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Planned power failure active monitoring and scheduling method based on metering terminal alarm technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a planned power failure active monitoring and scheduling method based on a metering terminal alarm technology, which comprises the following steps of S1: creating a business model, and combing and generating a power failure event of a plan to be monitored; collecting power failure and power restoration information of a power failure event; and (4) stopping power supply and returning monitoring and abnormal condition scheduling. The invention applies the alarm information of the metering terminal to realize the real-time active monitoring of the power failure and power restoration states of the planned power failure event, and replaces the monitoring mode of manually reporting the information. Through developing the power failure incident and matching, the relation that the same power failure equipment exists in a plurality of power failure incidents in the same power failure period is clarified, and the monitoring efficiency is improved. Meanwhile, the visual management and control of the planned power failure event are strengthened by combining data acquired by the metering terminal and information reported by field workers. Finally, customer service experience is improved, and customer satisfaction is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Pressure-adjustable intelligent underground fire hydrant
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent underground fire hydrant can adjust pressure, including main part and alarm, the outside upper end of main part is provided with the connector, and the lower extreme of main part installs the tubular column, the external connection of tubular column has the protective housing, the bottom of protective housing is provided with collection device, and the outside one end of collection device installs connecting device, the inside one end of connecting device is connected with protector, the alarm is located the outside one end of protective housing, the outside one end of protective housing rear end is provided with the installation pole. This intelligent underground fire hydrant can adjust pressure passes through the setting of collection device, fixed block, inner chamber and protective layer, can collect unrestrained water when fire fighting in the use of fire hydrant, avoids bringing more waste, and the person of facilitating the use uses water, and more convenience can also carry out timely warning when the water pipe accident splits open, and the person of facilitating the use carries out timely restoration to the fire hydrant.
assignees: HENGGUANG FIRE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Flisr without communication
abstract_en: A control system and method for a feeder, or portion of the distribution grid, which enables fault location, isolation and service restoration without communications between the feeder switches. The method uses definite time coordination between feeder switches and local measurements to determine which switches should open or close in order to isolate the fault and restore service downstream of a faulted section. Time-current characteristics and feeder topology are shared with all switches in the feeder prior to a fault event. When a disturbance occurs, a timer is started at each switch. When a switch measures voltage loss in all three phases, it stops its timer. Each switch evaluates the timer values and, when a particular switch determines based on the time-current characteristics that the immediate upstream switch opened to isolate the fault, that particular switch also opens. Power upstream of the particular switch is then provided by an alternative source.
assignees: S & C ELECTRIC CO

title_en: Plain area urban river network water circulation regulation and control method based on ecological restoration target
abstract_en: The invention relates to a plain area urban river network water circulation regulation and control method based on an ecological restoration target, which comprises the steps of surveying the basic situation of the urban river network, and constructing a water quantity-water power-water quality-water ecological index system by taking aquatic organism diversity as the basic target of the urban inland river network water ecological restoration; constructing a fine simulation model of river network hydraulics-water quality-water ecology, optimizing a running water engineering regulation and control scheme by using a hydrodynamic force-water quality simulation result of each scenario scheme, constructing an urban river network large circulation system, and adjusting a section structure of a local tip river reach to realize local small circulation; comprehensively evaluating the flood control safety, the environmental improvement benefit and the influence on a water replenishing source of the regulation and control scheme. The invention realizes that under the existing engineering system, the running water source and the kinetic energy thereof are fully utilized, and the water conservancy project scheduling such as a gate, a pump and the like is taken as a main path to promote the ordered movement of inland river water flow and recover and improve the inland river self-purification capacity.

title_en: Gas meter, control method of gas meter, and gas monitoring system
abstract_en: To provide a gas meter capable of improving a user's convenience and fully considering safety, and capable of executing restoration processing in line with a surrounding disaster situation following earthquake motion, and to provide a control method of the gas meter, and a gas monitoring system.SOLUTION: A control method of a gas meter executes: earthquake motion index derivation control for deriving an earthquake motion index as an index for indicating an influence of earthquake motion on gas facilities from a point of time when gas shutoff control is executed to a current point of time based on a value equivalent to seismic intensity stored from a point of time when gas shutoff control is executed by control for storing a value equivalent to seismic intensity to a current point of time; and restoration processing setting control for setting selectable restoration processing from among plural pieces of restoration processing for shifting a cutoff valve 30 in a closed state to an open state by gas cutoff control based on a seismic intensity index derived by earthquake motion index derivation control.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: OSAKA GAS CO LTD

title_en: Low-voltage fault diagnosis and rapid power restoration method based on mobile App
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-voltage fault diagnosis and rapid power restoration method based on a mobile App, which comprises the steps of extending distribution network fault diagnosis and judgment to a low-voltage transformer area, utilizing a transformer area data concentrator of a low-voltage centralized meter reading system, a centralized meter reading system and a data acquisition network of a low-voltage intelligent electric meter to carry out high-frequency data acquisition on the intelligent electric meter, and judging the tripping state of a low-voltage switch, so that low-voltage state monitoring and active low-voltage fault judgment are realized. By adopting the method, the low-voltage fault can be actively discovered, the first-aid repair work order can be actively generated, the first-aid repair progress of the customer can be actively pushed, and the lean first-aid repair management and the high-efficiency customer maintenance can be realized.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Electric energy prediction and restoration method based on LSTM neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric energy prediction and restoration method based on an LSTM neural network, which comprises the steps of firstly carrying out standardization processing on acquired electric energy data, then building a deep learning model after constructing a standard data format; and finally, predicting, precision testing and abnormal value repairing by using the LSTM model. The invention standardizes the original data, readjusts the distribution of values, avoids reducing the speed of network learning and convergence, and improves the learning efficiency of the network; the method comprises the steps that linear stacking of a plurality of network layers is built, an LSTM layer is added to serve as a bridge for input information and hidden states, a full-connection layer is added to link the hidden states and output information, a model is fitted, and model prediction accuracy is improved; the abnormal electric energy data are restored based on the LSTM prediction model, so that the accuracy of restoring the abnormal electric energy data is improved.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD;NARI GROUP CORP

title_en: System and method for emergency repair scheduling based on ubiquitous power Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for emergency repair scheduling based on ubiquitous power Internet of things, and relates to the technical field of power scheduling management; the system comprises a first terminal, a server and a position checking module, wherein the first terminal is connected with the server through the Internet; the method is based on a first terminal, the Internet and a server, and comprises the steps of S2 checking the position, and the server acquires the position information of the first terminal and generates the position information of the first terminal; the first terminal, the internet, the server, the position checking module and the like are used for improving the working efficiency of electric power rush-repair dispatching.

title_en: Method and system for prioritizing critical data object storage
abstract_en: A method and system for prioritizing key data object restoration during a restore operation. In particular, the methods and systems disclosed herein require reordering data objects in accordance with a sequential order based on closest criticality, waiting to be read from backup storage, and thus queuing in one or more data object queues. The order based on closest criticality can be derived by calculating a correction weight based Euclidean distance between adjacent pairs of data objects queued in any given data object queue. In addition, the calculated euclidean distance based on the correction weight incorporates a data criticality factor associated with the pair of adjacent data objects. By reordering the data objects in a sequential order based on closest criticality, the critical data objects can be restored first, thereby avoiding possible loss of critical data when a disaster occurs during a restoration operation.

title_en: Software robot-based automatic management and control platform and method for electricity consumption fee tracking
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic management and control platform and method for electricity consumption fee tracking based on a software robot. The method comprises the following steps: 1. logging in the system, opening the power failure work order module, judging whether the current work order is a target work order, if so, sending a short message, and writing the short message into an excel table record; 2. judging whether all work orders are checked, if so, opening the power restoration work order module, and judging whether the current work order is a target work order; 3. if yes, judging whether the target work order exceeds 5 hours and the call reply time is not filled, if yes, sending a short message, and writing the short message into an excel form record; if not, judging whether the target work order exceeds 8 hours and does not fill the call reply time, if so, sending a short message, and writing the short message into an excel form record. The invention inquires the payment condition of the defaulting user in real time, automatically creates the power restoration worksheet for the user who does not restore the power in time and tracks the whole process, reduces the human input, improves the service efficiency, shortens the power restoration time and reduces the overtime condition.

title_en: Typhoon emergency data automatic statistical system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic typhoon emergency data statistical system which comprises an automatic data input module, a data matching processing module, a data statistical analysis module, a query module and a data display module, wherein the automatic data input module is used for inputting typhoon emergency data; the automatic data entry module is used for automatically entering the power failure line information from the scheduling platform and automatically entering the power failure event from the marketing system; the data matching processing module is used for matching the corresponding power failure event according to the power failure line information; the data statistics and analysis module is used for counting and analyzing the power failure detail data influenced by the power failure event; the query module is used for allowing an authorized user to query the statistical power failure detail data; and the data display module is used for displaying the power failure and restoration condition, the power failure ratio and the loss load of each district according to the counted data. The invention can automatically acquire the disaster-caused loss data to be counted from the existing platform or system, reduces the labor cost and time cost of a manual counting mode, improves the working efficiency and ensures the accuracy of the data.

title_en: Assembled damage-controllable steel column base
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the building engineering antidetonation, a controllable steel column foot of pin-connected panel damage is provided, including steel basis, crab-bolt, steel column bottom plate, energy dissipater and steel column. On the premise of ensuring the bearing capacity and rigidity of the exposed steel column base, the exposed steel column base with controllable damage and quickly replaceable energy dissipaters is provided in a mode of arranging the energy dissipaters. The utility model discloses a steel column base power consumption ability is stronger, and the damage is controllable, can control the damage in the position that exposes of easy restoration changes such as energy dissipater, improves the column base and shakes the ability of repairing afterwards. After the earthquake, the energy dissipater can be replaced rapidly to realize local rapid repair. The column base is easy to construct, high in energy consumption capacity in an earthquake, controllable in damage and capable of being quickly repaired.

title_en: Wind power plant output data restoration method based on ARMA model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power systems, relates to a wind power generation operation monitoring method, and particularly relates to a wind power plant output data repairing method based on an ARMA model. According to the method, abnormal data are divided into local abnormal data and continuous abnormal data, the local abnormal data are repaired by a polynomial interpolation method of a benchmarking fan, the continuous abnormal data are repaired by an ARMA model, corresponding data are repaired, and output data of other units are obtained based on Cholesky decomposition by taking a test unit as a reference. The invention effectively improves the structural completeness of the power generation and operation data of the wind power plant.

title_en: Photovoltaic power station output data restoration method based on BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power systems, relates to a photovoltaic power generation operation monitoring method, and particularly relates to a photovoltaic power station output data restoration method based on a BP neural network. The method divides abnormal data into local abnormal data and continuous abnormal data, repairs the local abnormal data by a polynomial interpolation method, repairs the continuous abnormal data by a BP neural network, repairs corresponding data, and obtains output data of other units based on Cholesky decomposition by taking a test unit as a reference. The invention improves the power generation data quality and data management level of the energy resource enrichment area, and provides a data analysis basis for light abandoning evaluation and photovoltaic absorption early warning.

title_en: Road network traffic time sequence characteristic data quality diagnosis and restoration method
abstract_en: A road network traffic time sequence characteristic data quality diagnosis and restoration method comprises the following steps: s1, obtaining a regional road network topological structure, and constructing a traffic data prediction model; s2, acquiring historical traffic data, training a model and checking the prediction precision of the model; s3, fusing the traffic data acquired by the traffic detector with the traffic data generated, and detecting and repairing the abnormal data in real time; and S4, performing incremental training on the prediction model to ensure the prediction precision of the model. The invention has the beneficial effects that: and predicting a mode of the data on the day and the comprehensive production data of the combined road network data based on historical data and comprehensively judging the quality of the data, and finally realizing high-quality data with reasonable continuous output and strong relevance.

title_en: Smart wearable device with multiple functions and Safety Monitoring System using the same

title_en: Photovoltaic output data restoration method and system

title_en: Method and system for sharepoint backup for disaster restore
abstract_en: A method is provided for backing up and restoring a web applications platform. The method includes backing up web applications platform databases to a backup system. A search index of the web application platform is backed up. An application programming interface (API) is queried to discover internet information services (IIS) virtual directories associated with the web applications platform. Discovered IIS virtual directories associated with the web applications platform are backed up to the backup system. IIS configuration data, IIS metabase data and registry data for the web applications platform are then backed up to the backup system. A similar process enables the restoration of this data to allow for disaster recovery for the web applications platform.

title_en: Power grid dispatching and maintenance application form processing method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid dispatching and maintenance request form processing method and system, and belongs to the technical field of maintenance and power failure dispatching. The method comprises the steps that maintenance request forms needing to be packaged are selected according to associated equipment of reported applications, and maintenance application packages are obtained; automatically screening out the main application according to the main equipment and the power failure and restoration time for the maintenance application sheet in the maintenance application packet, and marking the rest as auxiliary applications; the screened maintenance application packages are subjected to circulation and replication, a cover sheet is generated according to the replication result, and the cover sheet is added into the maintenance application packages; and scheduling and executing according to the obtained maintenance application packet. The invention can reduce the workload of personnel in each link of dispatching, can improve the refinement level of power grid dispatching and ensures the safe and stable operation of the power station.

title_en: Closed tailing pond and pollution prevention and control ecological system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecosystem for closing a tailing pond and preventing and controlling pollution and a control method thereof, belonging to the technical field of mine ecological restoration. In the reclamation area, 30cm of clean soil is covered on the tailing slag, crops are planted, the reclamation of the tailing pond is realized, and the agricultural production capacity of the areas which are not suitable for cultivation is recovered. The method can recycle precipitation and irrigation water to leach the tailings, prevent the residual heavy metals in the tailings from migrating to the soil and underground water in the mining area, avoid secondary pollution and realize ecological restoration; after the system is operated, the pressure of rainfall on the side wall of the tailing pond can be relieved, and secondary disasters such as dam break, collapse and the like are reduced or avoided; low cost, low energy consumption, convenient operation and maintenance and is suitable for popularization and application.

title_en: Novel pipe huff type shockproof expansion joint
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel telescopic joint that takes precautions against earthquakes of pipeline huff formula belongs to pipeline restoration technical field. The telescopic joint comprises a telescopic joint body, wherein the telescopic joint body comprises an outer layer, an elastic buffer layer and a flexible inner layer, the elastic buffer layer is positioned between the outer layer and the flexible inner layer, and one side of the outer layer is fixed with the elastic buffer layer. The utility model discloses mainly utilize flexible inlayer and elastic buffer layer and skin to replace traditional cast iron formula shell, when the pipeline when the damaged condition that just causes pressure too high, utilize the first keep out of flexible inlayer, keep out back flexible inlayer shape and can change, and keep the shape after the change unchangeable, utilize the inside flexure strip of elastic buffer layer to carry out the weakening of doing all can when receiving flexible inlayer pressure immediately, make and avoid water pressure too high to cause ruptured condition to appear to the outer layer, thereby fine assurance the life of this telescopic joint body.

title_en: Spray-seeding matrix for rush, spray-seeding method and application thereof
abstract_en: A spraying substrate of medulla Junci and its spraying method and application are disclosed, wherein the spraying substrate comprises the following raw materials (by weight portion): 25-80 parts of rush seeds, 100-200 parts of chicken manure biochar, 240-900 parts of sawdust, 50-170 parts of magnetite, 1550 parts of plant biomass and 3500 parts of tailings. The invention uses the rush seeds to prepare the spray-seeding matrix material, thus expanding the application of the spray-seeding matrix material in acid tailing waste land; the addition of the chicken manure and the magnetite ensures that the substrate has good heat capacity and can resist frost disasters; the saw dust is loosened and ventilated to create a microenvironment, magnetite, biochar and the like drive the crystalline phase transformation of the iron oxide, the soil forming process is accelerated, and the adaptability and the survival rate of plants are enhanced. The method is suitable for ecological restoration of extreme geographical positions and environments, and solves the problem of acid tailings.

title_en: Mining area ecological environment restoration system
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the ecological remediation technique and specifically relates to a mining area ecological environment repair system is related to. The mine comprises a side slope and a mine arranged on the side slope, wherein a filling layer is arranged in the mine; the side slope comprises a top surface and an inclined surface, and a water-resisting layer, a soil improvement layer and a seed layer are sequentially arranged on the top surface and the surface of the inclined surface from bottom to top; the seed layer is arranged on the seed layer, the inclined plane is provided with a protective net, the protective net is arranged on the surface of the seed layer, and an anchor rod is fixedly connected between the protective net and the side slope. The utility model provides a pair of mining area ecological environment repair system realizes the improvement of mining area geological disasters, ecological environment's restoration.

title_en: Dual-channel service recovery method based on link life cycle in elastic optical network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dual-channel service recovery method based on a link life cycle in an elastic optical network, belonging to the technical field of communication networks. Aiming at the damage and influence of large-scale natural disasters on the elastic optical network, the method fully utilizes the limited life cycle of a post-disaster link and adopts a dual-path strategy to carry out routing and bandwidth recovery on the interrupted service connection with limited service time. The invention determines the recovery priority according to the remaining service time of the affected service, evaluates the availability of the spectrum resource according to the maximum flow loss threshold in the remaining service time of the service, flexibly utilizes the limited life cycle of the link resource and the dual-channel strategy, and improves the spectrum resource utilization rate of the network, thereby maximizing the connectivity and bandwidth recovery rate of the service in the remaining service time.

title_en: Telephone traffic prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a telephone traffic prediction method, which comprises the following steps: the model is divided into: fault power failure, planned power failure, arrearage power failure and power restoration, electric quantity and electricity charge, customer basic information and electricity service; performing broad-table processing according to the models to obtain input and output variables of each model; data processing: after wide-table data processing is carried out on original data and before data modeling is carried out, data cleaning is carried out on the data, and the data are converted into stable dimensionless input-output variable data; and (3) modeling data, wherein the selected model is an LSTM long-short term memory network model for training, verifying and testing. The invention classifies the models of the telephone traffic, determines the input variable and the output variable of each model, and trains the selected model as an LSTM long-term and short-term memory network model, thereby ensuring the model accuracy rate which can reach more than 80%.

title_en: A prevent soil erosion and water loss guardrail for geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of ecological restoration, in particular to a guard bar for preventing soil erosion and water loss for geological disasters, which comprises a baffle plate, wherein fixed rods are symmetrically and fixedly connected with two sides of the front surface of the baffle plate, a square groove is arranged on the front side of each fixed rod, a first circular hole is arranged on each square groove, a fixed groove is arranged in the center of each square groove, a rubber pad is bonded in the inner cavity of each fixed groove, each fixed rod is movably connected with a portable rod through each square groove, a trapezoidal groove is arranged on one side of the baffle plate, and a trapezoidal block is fixedly connected with; through being equipped with the dead lever, be convenient for fix the dead lever by the end point, then combine together portable pole and fixed slot, and then further fix the dead lever, guarantee the stability of device, through being equipped with trapezoidal piece and dovetail groove, the trapezoidal groove that is equipped with by a device combines together the use with the trapezoidal piece that the same device of opposite side was equipped with, and the extension of being convenient for is installed length, and then guarantees the availability factor of device.

title_en: Recycled aggregate plant-growing concrete precast block
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a recycled aggregate plant-growing concrete precast block, which is in a regular hexagonal prism structure and comprises an outer frame and an inner groove; the outer frame and the inner groove of the precast block are made of recycled concrete, and the concrete is formed by mixing recycled coarse aggregate and slurry made of cement and water; the height of the recycled concrete of the outer frame is higher than that of the recycled concrete of the inner groove; and the inner groove is filled with a vegetation soil layer. The precast block designed by the utility model is directly laid on the soil surface, rainwater can be prevented from directly floating on the soil surface in rainy days, the absorption of rainwater by soil and the scouring effect of rainwater on soil are greatly reduced, landslide is avoided, and the stability is improved; the soil can be prevented from being excessively dried and crushed in sunny days to cause dust emission, and the planting soil is used for planting suitable plants, can purify air, reduce air pollution and plays an important role in ecological reconstruction and restoration.

title_en: Power failure and restoration analysis and emergency repair management system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stop to reply electric analysis and salvage management system, include: after the power consumption information acquisition platform receives the power-off/power-on event uploaded by the terminal, real-time data sharing is realized with the big data application management platform, the big data application management platform accurately positions the power-off branch and pushes the power-off branch to a target end for realizing emergency repair through the power supply service command platform, and therefore the technical effects of intelligent analysis and emergency repair when the power-off event happens actively are achieved.

title_en: Comprehensive evaluation method for restoring force of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive evaluation method for restoring force of a power system, which comprises the steps of firstly considering stage characteristics and influence factors of restoring force evaluation of the power system, constructing an evaluation index system for the restoring force of an elastic power system from multiple dimensions, and screening out key indexes from the evaluation index system; and determining the score and the weight of each level index in the restoring force evaluation index system, obtaining the overall score condition of the power system by a comprehensive scoring method, and performing transverse comparison and longitudinal comparison on the elastic construction level of the power system according to the comprehensive evaluation result. The method can synthesize the influence of a plurality of evaluation dimensions on the power grid resilience, is used for transverse comparison and longitudinal comparison of the power grid elasticity development level, and provides effective reference for system planning operation and restoration decision.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Method for rapidly restoring water storage capacity of highly-degenerated tropical forest soil
abstract_en: A method for rapidly restoring water storage capacity of highly degenerated tropical forest soil belongs to the field of environmental ecology restoration, and comprises (1) taking adjacent undisturbed mountains as reference, comprehensively designing a proper slope, singly planting a plurality of fast-growing tree species, and consolidating a refilled soil layer to prevent serious landslide and other hazards caused by external interference, (2) carrying out mixed planting on original species in adjacent undisturbed areas and the singly planted fast-growing tree species to restore soil moisture storage, thereby providing a method for rapidly restoring water storage capacity of highly degenerated tropical forest soil.

title_en: Traditional rammed earth building repair structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a traditional rammed earth building restoration structure, which can effectively improve the mechanical property of rammed earth building wall surface through three soil layers; the integrity and the strength of the wall body can be enhanced through the arrangement of the wire netting; the repaired building has waterproof property through the waterproof layer; the technical effects of enhancing the earthquake resistance of the building and keeping the integral structure of the house stable can be achieved by arranging the counterfort columns; can strengthen the wholeness in house through the cuff, can practice thrift the cost and reach the anti shear force effect, the cuff also can play the reinforcing action to the vertical crack that link up of wall body simultaneously.
assignees: SICHUAN COLLEGE ARCHITECTURAL TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Environment investigation method aiming at underground water chlorinated hydrocarbon pollution
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of environmental investigation, and discloses an environmental investigation method for underground water chlorinated hydrocarbon pollution, which comprises the following steps: s1: a first stage investigation; s2: analyzing results, if the investigation at the first stage confirms that no possible pollution source exists in the working area and the surrounding area currently and historically, the investigation activity can be ended, and if the pollution source exists in the working area and outside the working area, the environmental investigation at the second stage is carried out; s3: and the second stage of investigation, and primary sampling analysis. The method finds out geological and hydrogeological conditions of the investigation region in detail, finds out pollution source distribution of the investigation region in detail, determines types and components of concerned pollutants, defines the spatial distribution range of main pollutants in soil and underground water, evaluates the pollution degree of the soil and the underground water of the investigation region and evaluates risks, and provides scientific basis and data support for the next treatment, restoration and safe utilization work; and carrying out dynamic monitoring on groundwater pollution.
assignees: JIANGSU YISHUITIAN ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power customer appeal sensitivity supervision and early warning method based on random forest
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power customer appeal sensitivity supervision and early warning method based on a random forest, and S1, customer sensitivity associated factor sets of a production power failure appeal and an arrearage power failure and power restoration appeal are respectively constructed; s2, extracting historical data and filtering abnormal data to form a machine learning data set; s3, dividing the machine learning data set into a training set and a verification set; s4, respectively obtaining a random forest prediction model of a production power failure demand and an arrearage power failure and power restoration demand based on the training set and the verification set; s5, respectively constructing sensitivity index models of the production power failure demand and the arrearage power failure demand and the power restoration demand based on the random forest prediction models of the production power failure demand and the arrearage power failure demand and the power restoration demand; s6, determining a sensitivity index limit of an early warning grade based on the machine learning data set; and S7, carrying out early warning level prediction of the client appeal. The invention further senses the requirements of power customers and improves the power service quality.
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID HUNAN POWER CO LTD POWER SUPPLY SERVICE CENTER METRIC CENTER;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Regional spare power automatic switching control system and operation risk management and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a regional spare power automatic switching control system and an operation risk management and control method thereof.A main processor and a slave processor are arranged in a regional spare power automatic switching device for cooperative coordination processing, so that data can be acquired in time, and data acquisition and data analysis are divided into two processors for processing, so that the data processing speed is improved, the trip time of regional spare power automatic switching is further shortened, the regional spare power automatic switching can effectively isolate faults in time, the power failure range is shortened, the power restoration time is shortened, and the condition that the regional spare power automatic switching fails is avoided; the invention sets the priority for each spare power automatic switching device in the serial supply loop, when a certain device is in fault, a plurality of device spare power automatic switching actions can be caused, and not all the spare power automatic switching device actions are necessary.

title_en: Method and device for evaluating power supply reliability of low-voltage user and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for evaluating the power supply reliability of a low-voltage user and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method for evaluating the power supply reliability of the low-voltage user comprises the following steps: collecting power failure and restoration information of the intelligent electric meters in the statistical area to form a first power failure event set; calculating the power failure duration time of each power failure event according to the formed first power failure event set; removing non-effective power failure events from the first power failure event set to form a second power failure event set; calculating the total number of the households in the power supply reliability statistical area during power failure according to the second power failure event set and the power failure duration time; calculating the average power failure time of the users according to the total number of users and the total number of users in power failure; and calculating the power supply reliability in the statistical area according to the average power failure time of the user. The method can be combined with the user power failure data collected by the intelligent ammeter to evaluate the power supply reliability of the low-voltage users, and provides statistical technology and theoretical support for extending the power supply reliability of the power distribution network to the low-voltage users.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Power distribution network automation system comprehensive planning method based on reliability constraint
abstract_en: The present application relates to the technical field of power system planning and evaluation, and provided is a power distribution network automation system comprehensive planning method based on reliability constraint. The method comprises performing overall planning on a power distribution network automation system, wherein the power distribution network automation system comprises a circuit breaker, a knife switch, a feeder terminal control unit, and a control center; establishing a power distribution network reliability evaluation and optimization model consisting of a target function and constraint conditions; and solving for the model to obtain installation positions of the circuit breaker, the knife switch, and the feeder terminal control unit which meet system reliability requirements, and determining whether a power distribution automation system control center needs to be built. In calculating the reliability constraint, the present application considers approaches of circuit breaker tripping after a fault, fault automatic and manual isolation, and affected load power supply restoration based on network reconstruction, and the method is simple and convenient, and effectively reduces costs while meeting the system reliability.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Dispatching operation robot device for automatically commanding power equipment to stop and recover power
abstract_en: The application discloses automatic command power equipment stops dispatch operation robot device of reply electricity includes: the checking module, the operation ticket compiling module and the operation ticket executing module; the checking module is used for checking power failure notice and a section to be controlled, or checking five necessary checks, namely one confirmation and equipment state double checks; the operation ticket compiling module is used for compiling operation tickets after the checking is passed, and sending the operation tickets to a dispatcher for auditing, wherein the operation tickets comprise power failure tickets and power restoration tickets; the operation ticket execution module is used for executing the operation tickets which pass the auditing, and solves the technical problems that the overhauling process of the existing power grid operation management system is very complicated, and particularly in the dispatching operation signing link, a large amount of confirmation and verification operations of a dispatcher are needed, so that the dispatching operation efficiency and the power grid operation safety are influenced.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD;NANJING NARI INFORMATION COMM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power load prediction method and system based on abnormal restoration
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power load prediction method and a system based on abnormal restoration, wherein the method comprises the following steps: 1) training based on power load sample data to obtain a power load prediction model; 2) acquiring current power load data, and predicting by using the power load prediction model to obtain a predicted value at the moment t +1, wherein t is the current moment; 3) and acquiring an actual value at the t +1 moment, comparing the difference between the predicted value at the t +1 moment and the actual value at the t +1 moment, judging whether an abnormality exists based on the difference, if so, restoring the abnormality and then returning to the step 2), and if not, directly returning to the step 2). Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of capability of realizing abnormal restoration, high prediction accuracy and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power transfer weak ring quantitative identification method influencing power distribution network fault recovery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for quantitatively identifying a transfer power supply weak ring influencing fault recovery of a power distribution network, which comprises the following steps of: s1: modeling a main network and a distribution network, and selecting a starting point; s2: calculating the bus security load; s3: calculating the total restoration load of the single-switching-supply path feeder line; s4: calculating the total load of the multi-turn supply path recovery; s5: calculating the primary load recovery rate of the transformer substation; s6: judging whether the calculation of all the substations is finished or not, if not, repeating the steps S1-S5; s7: sequencing the transformer substations according to the load primary recovery rate, and sequencing the transformer substations according to the load primary recovery rate; s8: and positioning and improving the weak link according to the threshold value. The invention provides a power transfer and supply weak link quantitative identification method which can carry out quantitative calculation on power transfer and supply weak links of a power grid and provides a basis for planning, regulating and controlling a power distribution network and power grid transformation and influences the fault recovery of the power distribution network.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD JIAXING POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Toughness recovery method for power distribution network and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a toughness recovery method of a power distribution network and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: parameters of a power distribution network with communication faults are obtained and set, wherein the parameters comprise communication platform information and total quantity of intelligent flight equipment communication base stations with wireless communication receiving and transmitting functions in power data; calculating communication platform parameters of each intelligent flight device, and obtaining a communication restoration sub-scheme set from each intelligent flight device to an intelligent power distribution terminal device or a power distribution station terminal to construct a communication platform; calculating the toughness index of the power distribution network corresponding to each recovery communication sub-scheme in the recovery communication sub-scheme set; and selecting a communication restoration sub-scheme according to the toughness index and obtaining the deployment strategy of all intelligent flight equipment. The toughness index of the power distribution network considering the influence of the communication system is provided, and a scheme for improving the controllability and the observability of the power distribution network after the communication system faults by establishing an emergency power wireless communication private network based on the intelligent flight equipment communication base station is provided.

title_en: Method and device for filling maintenance list of power grid power transmission and transformation equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for filling a maintenance list of power grid power transmission and transformation equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the first OMS maintenance order is issued to a local dispatching center through a superior dispatching center, so that the local dispatching center associates a local dispatching power-off and power-restoration application with a second OMS maintenance order; converting a first DICP power failure and recovery application uploaded by a plant station into a second DICP power failure and recovery application through a local scheduling center, and uploading the second DICP power failure and recovery application to a superior scheduling center; associating, by the local scheduling center, the second DICP outage request with a second OMS service order; and after the local dispatching center receives the reply of the power-on-reply stopping application of the superior dispatching center, the local dispatching center operates according to the reply information, so that the plant station executes an instruction corresponding to the reply information and fills the reply information into a second OMS maintenance list. The technical problems that the workload of manually filling the OMS overhaul list by operators is large, mistakes are easy to occur, and the overhaul risk of the provincial and local main network equipment exists are solved.

title_en: Ecological protection, restoration and planning zoning method for lakes and grasses in mountain and water forest fields
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for planning and partitioning ecological protection and restoration of lake and grass in mountain and water forest fields, which takes an ecological function partitioning diagram as a base diagram and combines the administrative divisions at county level and the boundary diagram data of a small watershed to determine the range of the ecological protection and restoration partitioning; respectively drawing a leading ecological function diagram and an ecological sensitivity distribution diagram, and comprehensively forming an ecological protection important area; refining various problems into an ecological protection restoration subarea, and determining the spatial distribution characteristics of resource environment problems of each area; the area factors of ecological protection important areas and resource environment problem distribution areas of all the subareas are comprehensively considered, and the subarea ecological protection restoration direction is determined; on the premise of defining the partition range, leading functions, highlighting problems and protecting and repairing directions, forming an ecological protection and repairing partition scheme; the method is convenient for taking small watersheds as units in counties and counties to integrally plan the ecological protection and restoration engineering of the mountainous water, forest, field, lake and grass, comprehensively considers the problems of ecological protection and resource environment, and quantificationally determines the initial direction of ecological protection and restoration in each district.
assignees: CHINESE ACADEMY FOR ENVIRONMENTAL PLANNING MINI OF ECOLOGY AND ENVIRONMENT

title_en: Selective permeation drainage system for mine restoration
abstract_en: The utility model provides a be used for mine to restore perm-selective drainage system, including drainage ditch apron, escape canal, water purification layer, metalling, water catch bowl apron, water catch bowl, filter rod, diversion pipeline, cistern.
