The utility model discloses carry out reasonable flood control planning to mine drainage system, flood disasters have been prevented effectively, deposit the rainwater simultaneously, filter, purify and utilize, for mine groundwater source, the vegetation afforestation, life and industrial water provide a large amount of water source supplies, adopt the temperature, the technical process that microwave and carbomorphism combined together, pollutant and suspended particle in the rainwater are eliminated to the high efficiency, adjustable membrane of permeating water has been set up inside the water-permeable district, the play water area and the direction in the district of can permeating water carry out directional regulation, improve the effective utilization who purifies back rainwater, the water purification layer of self-control has been add, the area of water purification and water has been increased, add the metalling in the entire system lower part simultaneously, play the effect of prevention uneven settlement and firm structure.
assignees: DALIAN DEETOP ENV TECH CO LTD

title_en: Bending steel truss connecting beam with U-shaped damper and capable of being quickly recovered after earthquake
abstract_en: The utility model provides a take crooked shaped steel truss that resumes fast after shake of U-shaped attenuator even roof beam, including the U-shaped attenuator, the utility model discloses utilize U-shaped attenuator power consumption on the basis of ordinary steel truss even roof beam, the U-shaped attenuator includes: the U-shaped upper cover plate, the U-shaped lower cover plate and the bolt; the structure is simple, the construction is convenient, and the disassembly is simple. Under a small earthquake, the bending steel truss connecting beam with the U-shaped damper does not generate plastic deformation, is equivalent to a common steel truss connecting beam, and provides vertical rigidity for the structure; under heavy shock, after the U-shaped damper yield load is reached, the damper is subjected to plastic deformation, so that energy is consumed. Most of the energy in the earthquake is dissipated by the U-shaped damper. The utility model discloses take the curved steel truss that the back of shaking of U-shaped attenuator resumes fast even roof beam is under the earthquake effect, and intensity does not take place the degradation, and does not take place to destroy, only needs the U-shaped apron of inspection, change attenuator after shaking, has the advantage that the low, in time use of restoration cost after shaking.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN TECH

title_en: Game machine
abstract_en: To provide a game machine, even when a power outage occurs during output of a security signal, capable of detecting the output of the security signal at least at any of before/after the power outage.SOLUTION: When a power outage is detected, a game control device stops output of a security signal. After power restoration, the game control device restarts the output of the security signal. When (ta+tb)ms exceeds a shortest output time 50 ms when an external device can detect the security signal, the game control device makes it possible for the external device to detect the security signal output before power shutdown. Further, when (ta+tb)ms exceeds the shortest output time 50 ms when an external device can detect the security signal, the game control device makes it possible for the external device to detect the security signal output after the power restoration.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 186
assignees: SOPHIA CO LTD

title_en: Disaster prevention facility
abstract_en: To reduce a setting space, to avoid duplicate display at the occurrence of a fire and to improve the operability of fire handling and broadcasting by incorporating the function of broadcasting equipment into the receiver of disaster prevention equipment.SOLUTION: In the disaster prevention equipment, a fire is monitored by an analog fire sensor 14 connected to a receiver 10. A reception control part 62 of a receiver 10 performs fire alarm processing when receiving a fire alarm signal from an analog fire sensor 14. The receiver 10 is provided with an emergency broadcast control part 64 and broadcasts for fire alarm and evacuation guidance from a speaker 28 connected at the time of fire occurrence. A receiver 10 is provided with a display 42 provided inside a small door and having a restoration switch for completing all fire alarm processing and restoring to a normal monitoring state and a broadcast restoration switch.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: HOCHIKI CO

title_en: Wind power plant wind speed combined prediction method and device based on decomposition and aggregation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power plant wind speed combined prediction method and a device based on decomposition and aggregation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a historical wind speed sequence of a wind power plant, and decomposing the historical wind speed sequence of the wind power plant to obtain residual components corresponding to wind speeds and characteristic components at different scales; calculating the complexity of the feature components, and attributing the feature components with the complexity difference smaller than a preset threshold value to one class to obtain a plurality of feature component classes; overlapping the feature components of the same feature component category to obtain a plurality of aggregation components; respectively and independently predicting each aggregation component to obtain an aggregation prediction sequence corresponding to each aggregation component; predicting the residual component to obtain a residual prediction sequence corresponding to the residual component; and superposing the residual prediction sequence and each aggregation prediction sequence to obtain a final wind speed prediction sequence. The method not only ensures the restoration of the original sequence to the multi-scale characteristic of the predicted sequence, but also improves the prediction precision.
assignees: GRID POWER PLANNING & RES CT GUANGDONG GRID POWER CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Electric power system and control method therefor
abstract_en: To terminate DC power supply from a fuel cell power generation system to an inverter on restoration of electricity of a system power supply.SOLUTION: The blackout of a system power supply 200 causes the execution of: DC power supply from a fuel cell power generation system 40 to an inverter 13 through a DC output route 354; DC-AC conversion by the inverter 13; and AC power supply from the inverter 13 to a second power distribution board 90 through an autonomous operation time route 353 and a power switchover unit 28. When defining, as a first condition, a condition that the measurement value of a current detector unit 27 is a value indicating that the power of the system power supply 200 is restored during power consumption in an AC load 56, DC power supply is terminated if detection that the first condition is satisfied is made for M1 times.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: PANASONIC IP MAN CORP

title_en: Virtual card power restoration instruction transmission method and device based on digital token
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual card power restoration instruction transmission method and a virtual card power restoration instruction transmission device based on a digital token, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the power restoration instruction generating module generates a remote power restoration instruction; the digital token encryption module encrypts the remote power restoration instruction and the encryption transmission key and generates a ciphertext digital token; the digital token sending module converts the ciphertext digital token into a two-dimensional code digital token and sends the two-dimensional code digital token to a power consumption user; the power utilization user displays the two-dimension code digital token on a power recovery terminal; the complex power terminal restores the two-dimension code digital token into the ciphertext digital token and sends the ciphertext digital token to a security chip in the terminal; the safety chip restores the ciphertext digital token into the remote power restoration instruction; and the power recovery terminal sends the remote power recovery instruction to the intelligent charge control electric energy meter, and the intelligent charge control electric energy meter completes authentication and power recovery operation. In the implementation of the invention, convenient and quick power restoration service is provided.
assignees: GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method for replacing and repairing branch dam-splitting habitat in main and branch hydroelectric development basin
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for replacing and repairing a branch dam-splitting habitat in a main and branch hydroelectric development basin. The method comprises the steps of establishing an evaluation index system for the fish habitat restoration potential after tributary dam splitting and a dam splitting-loss evaluation index system; surveying the fish population, hydrology and geographical conditions, natural disaster conditions and hydropower station conditions in the target basin, and collecting data; calculating each index weight in an evaluation index system of the fish habitat restoration potential after the tributary dam splitting and a value P of the fish habitat restoration potential after the tributary dam splitting, and predicting the fish habitat restoration potential after the tributary dam splitting is carried out; calculating index weight and potential dam-dismantling loss L value in dam-dismantling and loss evaluation index system, and comprehensively evaluating the value after the power station is dismantledPotential loss; calculating feasibility score P of branch dam-splitting habitat alternative scheme F If P is F >60, selecting the highest score to demolish the dam; and after the tributary dam is removed, performing environmental investigation on fish population and habitat in the tributary, and repairing the fish habitat in the tributary river section.
assignees: UNIV YUNNAN

title_en: Operation risk assessment method and device based on network security situation awareness system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an operation risk assessment method and device based on a network security situation perception system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical data of a network security situation perception system in advance and analyzing and processing the historical data; performing feature selection and data preprocessing on historical data of the network security situation perception system to generate a training set and a test set of a training learning model; training a learning model by adopting a machine learning algorithm, and exporting an intelligent analysis model after the learning model meets the requirement of average accuracy; calculating the expected recovery power supply time and the loss load of the intelligent analysis model by adopting a general recovery target algorithm of the power system; and performing risk evaluation calculation according to the expected power restoration time, the loss load and the threat intrusion probability of the intelligent analysis model to obtain a corresponding network safety operation loss risk value. The method and the system can be combined with the power system intrusion probability model and the network security situation perception system to evaluate and calculate the operation risk, and improve the accuracy of risk evaluation.
assignees: CHINA ENERGY ENG GROUP GUANGDONG ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Network attack restoration system and method suitable for power network
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a network attack restoration system suitable for a power network, which comprises: the detection terminal is used for receiving the control instruction which cannot pass through the protocol filtering interface and carrying out network attack restoration on the received control instruction so as to realize detection on the control instruction, determine whether the control instruction is network attack content or not and send information of the attack content to the safety firewall when the control instruction is determined to be the network attack content, so that the safety firewall adds a new detection rule according to the attack content information. The invention also discloses a corresponding method. By implementing the embodiment of the invention, the server can be effectively prevented from receiving network attacks, and the safety of the power network is enhanced.

title_en: Tracking method for processing power failure fault
abstract_en: The invention provides a tracking method for processing power failure faults, which comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining power consumption data related to the current power failure faults from a service system or a database, and sending the data to a power supply bureau of a fault area; step S2, monitoring current power failure fault according to power restoration condition information to judge whether alarm is needed; and step S3, detecting whether the information updating is carried out on the fault processing progress, and if the information updating is not carried out for a long time, scheduling other departments to carry out manual follow-up. The invention can remind service dispatchers to process work orders needing follow-up in real time, improve the emergency repair efficiency, shorten the power failure time, enable users to obtain emergency repair progress in the first time, and reduce telephone inquiry and complaints of the users.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Method and system for rapidly declaring fault
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for rapidly declaring faults, which comprises a fault reporting and recording module, a fault reporting and recording module and a fault reporting and recording module, wherein the fault reporting and recording module is used for acquiring fault reporting contents to be declared by a system, recording fault time and fault types and uniformly reporting the fault time and the fault types; the address query module is used for positioning the current position of the fault reporting terminal, querying the accurate positioning of the fault reporting address, and performing structured processing and storage on the information of the fault reporting address; the power failure event query module is used for displaying event information of all power failures occurring in the last two days and planned power failures in the next two days in a list form according to three categories of power failure waiting, power failure in the middle of power failure and power restoration; and the power failure detail management module is used for acquiring the detailed information of the selected power failure event and distinguishing the selected power failure event according to different types of the power failure event. The invention provides multiple fault reporting ways, improves the handling efficiency, accurately and efficiently determines the fault position, and can display the fault state and progress in real time.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Method and system for inquiring power failure processing progress based on map
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for inquiring power failure processing progress based on a map, which comprises a search positioning module, a power failure processing module and a power failure processing module, wherein the search positioning module is used for inquiring and filtering basic user information according to user information and displaying power failure information, historical power failure information, power failure range information and power failure and power restoration states of relevant cells on the map; the power failure management module is used for displaying the detailed information of the selected power failure event and the first-aid repair progress information and can perform distinguishing display according to different types of the power failure events; the track management module is used for displaying the position information and the emergency repair track of the current emergency repair personnel in real time; and the event query module is used for respectively displaying the event information of all power failures occurring in the near term and the planned power failures in the future according to four dimensions of waiting power failure, power failure medium, historical power failure and frequent power failure in a list mode. The invention displays the emergency repair progress and the emergency repair flow condition of the emergency repair personnel to the client, and simultaneously facilitates the emergency repair personnel to feed back the emergency repair information and realize the map-based visual display.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Assessment method, device and system for anti-exercise effect of nuclear security real soldier
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, equipment and a system for evaluating the effect of confrontation and drilling of a nuclear security real soldier, wherein the method comprises the following steps: loading a three-dimensional nuclear power plant scene, wherein the three-dimensional nuclear power plant scene comprises an infrastructure model, at least one virtual drilling device and at least one virtual character; receiving state parameters transmitted by a recording server, wherein the state parameters are acquired from drilling personnel participating in the confrontation drilling of the real soldiers or state sensors on the drilling equipment, and each virtual drilling equipment or virtual character corresponds to one group of state parameters; and controlling the action of the corresponding virtual drilling equipment or virtual character according to the state parameter so as to realize the restoration of the confrontation drilling of the real soldier. Compared with the prior art, the method can realize accurate and comprehensive countermeasures of the real soldier in the confrontation drilling, thereby ensuring the objectivity of the assessment of the drilling.
assignees: LINGAO NUCLEAR POWER CO LTD;CHINA NUCLEAR POWER ENG CO LTD;CHINA GENERAL NUCLEAR POWER;CGN POWER CO LTD

title_en: Classification interpolation method and system for missing values of power equipment state monitoring data
abstract_en: The application discloses a classification interpolation method and a classification interpolation system for missing values of power equipment state monitoring data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring power equipment state online monitoring data set X  m×n  ，X  m×n  M samples are contained, and each sample contains n types of state variables; according to X  m×n  Lack of measured value, for X  m×n  The missing values in (1) are classified; and constructing interpolation models of different types of missing values and performing missing value interpolation to realize the restoration of the missing values of the state monitoring data. The application follows the principle of easy to arrive and difficult, and provides a classification interpolation method for realizing the sequential repair of three types of missing values. Compared with the method using a single data interpolation model, the classification interpolation method establishes reasonable data interpolationAnd the repair process is suitable for repairing state monitoring data with complex deletion condition and high deletion rate.

title_en: Restoration method for restoring geological disaster area ecology of mining area by utilizing coal gangue
abstract_en: The invention relates to a restoration method for restoring the ecology of a geological disaster area of a mining area by utilizing coal gangue, which adopts a geological restoration paving device of the mining area, wherein the geological restoration paving device of the mining area comprises a mounting plate, an electric slide block, a paving frame, a positioning spring, a supporting frame and a guide mechanism; the method for restoring the ecology in the geological disaster area of the mining area by adopting the geological restoration paving device of the mining area comprises the following steps: s1, crushing coal gangue; s2, processing a mine road foundation; s3, locking the mounting plate; s4, uniformly scattering coal gangue; s5, coal gangue rolling. The invention can solve the problems existing in the prior art when the coal gangue is paved: the unable comprehensive uninstallation of gangue is on the road bed, and the later stage is comparatively loaded down with trivial details, adopts the excavator to carry out the efficiency of shakeout to the gangue lower to the shakeout processing of gangue, and the shakeout roughness of gangue is relatively poor to cause the unsmooth scheduling problem in later stage gangue road surface.
assignees: XU FA

title_en: Self-resetting steel frame beam-column joint with hidden staged energy dissipation damper
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a hidden stage power consumption attenuator from restoring to throne steel frame beam column node, including steel frame post, steel frame roof beam, bracket, stage power consumption attenuator, prestressing tendons and adapting unit. Bracket one end welds in steel frame post side, and the other end passes through upper junction plate, lower connecting plate, high strength bolted connection with the steel frame roof beam. The staged energy dissipation damper is formed by welding an upper connecting plate, a lower connecting plate and a plurality of X-shaped soft steel sheets with clear sizes. The damper is connected between the bracket and the steel frame beam through high-strength bolts, and the X-shaped steel sheets are subjected to stage yielding and energy consumption under different load effects. The prestressed tendons are arranged along the length direction of the beam to meet the functional requirements under the normal use condition, and meanwhile, the restoring force is provided, so that the node has the self-resetting capability after the earthquake. The utility model discloses the simple structure, and mostly bolted connection can realize the assembly. The energy dissipation and the shock absorption in the earthquake can restore to the original position after the earthquake, thereby being convenient for restoration and being widely applied to the technical field of shock absorption and energy dissipation of building structures.
assignees: UNIV YANSHAN

title_en: Friction energy consumption type assembled beam column connecting node
abstract_en: The utility model provides a friction power consumption type assembled beam-column connected node, includes H shaped steel post and H shaped steel roof beam, the top flange, the bottom flange of H shaped steel roof beam all are connected with the column flange of H shaped steel post through the edge of a wing connecting piece, the web of H shaped steel roof beam both sides all is connected with the column flange of H shaped steel post through the web connecting piece, H shaped steel roof beam, bottom flange connecting piece and web connecting piece all are connected with H shaped steel post, H shaped steel roof beam respectively through many sets of high-strength bolt, other bolt holes on the web of the beam are horizontal long round bolt hole, and the bolt hole on the bottom flange connecting piece that is connected with the bottom flange apron is horizontal long round bolt hole. The utility model utilizes the friction energy consumption of each part to weaken the deformation and damage of the earthquake to the node, maintain the relative stability of the main structure and is also beneficial to the restoration after the earthquake; meanwhile, the assembled node can improve the construction efficiency on site and reduce the construction time of the main structure.
assignees: UNIV WUHAN SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Data statistical method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a data statistical method, a device, equipment and a medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring data to be counted uploaded by each data acquisition department; wherein the data to be counted comprises at least one of the following items: the method comprises the following steps of (1) overload line rectification condition, heavy load line rectification condition, highest load growth rate, highest load after daily restoration of the highest load, daily average load, load peak-valley difference, maintenance of distribution network and no forced peak load shifting; counting the data to be counted according to a preset counting method to obtain a counting result; wherein the statistical method comprises at least one of screening, ranking and summarizing; and responding to the query operation of the user, and displaying the statistical result to the user. The embodiment of the invention realizes automatic statistics of the data to be counted, reduces manual intervention, improves the working efficiency and the accuracy of the data, supports the user to inquire the statistical result, and is favorable for finding out the weak link of distribution network operation in time.
assignees: DONGGUAN POWER BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Mine ecological remediation circulation system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of mine ecological restoration, in particular to a mine ecological restoration circulation system, which comprises a reservoir and a side slope system, wherein the upper end of the reservoir is provided with a screen mesh for filtering impurities in rainwater, an adsorption layer is laid at the bottom of the reservoir and used for neutralizing acid mine wastewater, a water inlet at the left side of the reservoir is connected with a water outlet of a water inlet pipe, a solenoid valve is arranged inside a water outlet pipe, underground water can be introduced in the water shortage process, the right side of the reservoir is provided with a filter tank, a filter layer is arranged between the reservoir and the filter tank for filtering impurities in the reservoir, a liquid level sensor is arranged inside the filter tank, a water outlet at one end of the filter tank is connected with a water inlet end of a water outlet pipe, a water discharge end of the water outlet pipe is communicated with the ground and is connected with a water pump arranged on the ground through, the vegetation is planted in the metal grid, so that landslide caused by vegetation growth is prevented, and the vegetation survival rate is improved.
assignees: SHANXI ZHONGLIAN CHUANGTOU ECOLOGICAL ENV ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Transmission line fault location and emergency repair scheduling device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a transmission line fault location and emergency repair scheduling device, includes online data acquisition end, high in the clouds server and handheld data end triplex of synthesizing, high in the clouds server including the server host computer cabinet that has network function, connect online data acquisition end and handheld data end of synthesizing, main function is the trouble and the fault location data that receive online data acquisition end and send, confirms fault location to the handheld data end of synthesizing nearest apart from the fault point sends fault information and fault location information. The utility model discloses detecting the distance between fault point and the transformer substation, through the distance between the position of fault point and the transformer substation, confirm the nearest shaft tower apart from the fault point, give the dispatch center with trouble information transfer, the dispatch center passes through GPS and trails positioning function commander vehicle and personnel of salvageing recently, reachs the scene rapidly according to best route instruction and salvages. The product is easy to install, strong in practicability and high in cost performance, and is suitable for fault location and emergency dispatching of all power transmission lines.
assignees: CHANGCHUN INST TECH

title_en: Ecological restoration method for steep side slope of abandoned mining area
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological restoration, in particular to an ecological restoration method for a steep side slope of a waste mining area. In order to realize the three-dimensional greening of the steep side slope and solve the problem of ecological restoration of the slope with different fall and poor stability, the soil in the planting base disc is stable after a series of operations of land preparation, planting base disc making, planting base disc laying, planting base disc proportioning, planting base disc laying, water replenishing and later period management; the plant seeds can fall down, the seed sources are sufficient, and the supplemented species are native plants, so that the ecological environment of the region is adapted, the water and soil erosion is reduced, the survival rate is high, and the vegetation coverage and species diversity recovery effect is obvious; the hidden dangers of geological disasters such as water and soil loss and damage are avoided, and the ecological water treatment device is gradually integrated with natural ecology after years.
assignees: XINJIANG INST ECO & GEO CAS

title_en: Method for evaluating influence of ecological populus tomentosa on water conservation function based on InVEST model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to water conservation function influence assessment, and particularly relates to a method for assessing influence of ecological populus tremuloides on water conservation function by integrating InVEST models and a multivariate statistical method. The scheme of the invention comprises the following steps: 1) Dividing type information of the wetland remote sensing image, and detecting and analyzing the quantitative relation between the type change of the wetland and the conservation of the water source; 2) Performing hydrologic landform classification on the wetland according to the wetland coverage remote sensing data; 3) Establishing InVEST a model; 4) Calculating the water conservation quantity before and after the change of the regional landscape space pattern to be evaluated by using a InVEST model; 5) And obtaining the degree of the landscape space pattern change to the water conservation function by using a principal component and a cluster analysis method according to the calculation result. The invention adopts InVEST model to evaluate the yield by comparing the water yield before and after each coating engineering change. In addition, land cover variation characteristics of the wetland are determined, and the influence of the water conservation function is evaluated by taking the land cover, climate change and landscape pattern into consideration. The influence on the water conservation function in the ecological poplar-withdrawing engineering is accurately and scientifically evaluated, a valuable reference is provided for the ecological poplar-withdrawing engineering, and the result provides guidance for regional ecological restoration and ecological system function evaluation by the government.

title_en: Prefabricated assembled concrete-filled steel tube self-resetting pier with earthquake damage replaceable components
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a prefabricated assembly steel pipe concrete self-resetting pier with removable component of loss of earthquake, including concrete cushion cap, upper portion steel pipe concrete prefabricated segment, bottom steel pipe concrete prefabricated segment, removable component of loss of earthquake, post-tensioned prestressing tendons and power consumption stop device, upper portion steel pipe concrete prefabricated segment, bottom steel pipe concrete prefabricated segment and concrete cushion cap are pieced together into a whole through the post-tensioned prestressing tendons, and the prestressing tendons pass pier segment pore and cushion cap pore, anchors the ground tackle respectively at concrete cushion cap bottom and pier top; the earthquake damage replaceable component comprises an external steel sheet of the earthquake damage replaceable component and earthquake damage replaceable component concrete. The utility model discloses can not only make the pier realize the quick restoration after shaking, and power consumption stop device can reduce pier earthquake displacement response, increase pier power consumption ability under the condition that does not influence the remaining displacement of pier.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: Method and system for coordinated recovery of power and communication of power distribution network after extreme disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution network automation, in particular to a method and a system for coordinated recovery of power and communication of a power distribution network after extreme disasters, and a double-network fusion model of the power distribution network communication network and the power network is established; determining a necessary communication restoration; judging the length of necessary communication recovery time; responding to the necessary communication recovery time, and executing fixed priority order recovery of the power distribution network; and in response to the long necessary communication recovery time, partitioning the power distribution network communication network and power network double-network fusion model, and recovering communication faults and traditional power faults of each partition one by one. The invention introduces necessary communication recovery based on the influence of the communication information system on the power distribution network rush-repair process, respectively establishes a coordinated recovery strategy of power and communication of the power distribution network according to the length of the necessary communication recovery time, and is effectively used for guiding the recovery of the power distribution network after extreme disasters, helping the smooth proceeding of the post-disaster rush-repair work, thereby shortening the rush-repair time and reducing the loss caused by the power distribution network faults.

title_en: Drought recovery potential evaluation method based on improved combined drought index
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster risk assessment, in particular to a drought restoration potential assessment method based on an improved joint drought index, which comprises the following steps: s10, preprocessing original precipitation data; s20, calculating an edge distribution function of the precipitation sequence; s30, converting to obtain a standardized precipitation index SPI of the precipitation sequence with 1-12 time scales; s40, screening out main components of the standardized precipitation index SPI by adopting a main component analysis method; s50, constructing a joint distribution function among the main components by adopting a high-dimensional C-vine copula function; s60, taking the Kendall distribution function as a probability distribution function of the combined distribution function, and judging the probability that the cumulative probability does not exceed a critical value; s70, obtaining an MJDI index model through standard normal distribution conversion; s80, calculating the precipitation required when the drought is recovered to the normal state in the next month and the probability of obtaining the precipitation correspondingly. Compared with the method based on the ecological water demand prediction, the method can directly reflect the real condition of the drought severity degree, and has low calculation dimensionality and high calculation accuracy.

title_en: Power supply reliability assessment method considering island division and network reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power supply reliability assessment method considering island division and network reconstruction, which comprises the following steps: s1, classifying the system load nodes according to the fault occurrence position of the power distribution system, the power supply capacity of the power distribution system and the load requirements, and completing the division of the network fault area of the system; s2, forming an island through a distributed power supply to supply power to nodes in the region, reconstructing the network to recover the power supply of the rest nodes, and determining the recovery sequence of each node according to the system node parameters; and S3, evaluating the power supply reliability of the power distribution network containing the distributed power supply by adopting a Monte Carlo simulation method according to different running states of the power distribution network.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;EAST CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Novel self-vibration-resistant bracket
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel self-recovery type anti-seismic bracket, which is characterized in that a weight is connected through a U-shaped hanging buckle, the outside is supported against the elastic support of channel steel through a first disc-shaped reed and a second disc-shaped reed, and the support of a first spring plate connecting piece and a second spring plate connecting piece enables a cable-stayed type stabilizing piece to laterally support a bearing screw and the outside resisting channel steel, so that the outside resisting channel steel can absorb shock and resist vibration when being stretched by external force, and natural buffering and resetting are carried out under the support of the cable-stayed type stabilizing piece, so that post-disaster restoration is not needed.

title_en: Repairing fertilizer after cold injury and disaster and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a cold injury post-disaster restoration fertilizer and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of fertilizers, wherein the cold injury post-disaster restoration fertilizer comprises the following components in parts by weight: 200 parts of nitrogen fertilizer, 150 parts of phosphate fertilizer, 250 parts of potash fertilizer, 20-100 parts of organic carbon liquid, 400 parts of antifreeze microbial agent, 2-10 parts of polyglutamic acid, 1-5 parts of xanthan gum, 0-5 parts of NaOH, 5-20 parts of boric acid, 5-10 parts of EDTA calcium, 2-10 parts of soluble magnesium, 2-10 parts of soluble ferrous iron, 1-5 parts of soluble zinc, 2-5 parts of salicylic acid, 2-10 parts of biological stimulant and 400 parts of water. By optimizing the coordination of organic carbon, medium and trace elements, biological stimulants and even major elements, the effect of good cold damage repairing effect is finally achieved, and the raw materials of the cold damage post-disaster repairing fertilizer are easy to obtain and low in cost.
assignees: SHENZHEN BATIAN ECOTYPIC ENG

title_en: Method for optimizing urban water environment system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimization method of an urban water environment system, which relates to the technical field of water environment restoration and comprises the following steps: monitoring the water quality of the water environment; acquiring the capacity of the water environment; carrying out ecological purification treatment on the water environment; performing bypass circulation purification treatment on the water environment; controlling the pollutant input amount of the water environment; the method improves the water quality of the urban water environment by carrying out ecological purification and bypass circulation purification on the urban water environment, and simultaneously controls the discharge amount of reclaimed water according to the water quality and the capacity of the urban water environment, thereby controlling the pollutant input amount of the urban water environment and optimizing the urban water environment system.
assignees: BEIJING DRAINAGE GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Ecological restoration space identification method based on ecological system service view angle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological restoration space identification method and system based on an ecological system service visual angle, wherein the method comprises the following steps: selecting water conservation, wind prevention and sand fixation, soil conservation and carbon fixation as leading ecological system services, and obtaining ecological system service evaluation quantity of an evaluation period of a designated area; dividing the designated area into a plurality of grids, and determining the reverse conversion probability and the loss level of the ecosystem service of each grid according to the evaluation quantity of each ecosystem service in the evaluation period, thereby forming an ecological risk evaluation result of each grid; acquiring a land degradation evaluation result of each grid based on trend test analysis of year-by-year normalized vegetation indexes (NDVI) of the evaluation period; and averaging the ecological risk evaluation result and the land degradation evaluation result of each grid to obtain an ecological restoration priority evaluation result of the grid. The method can identify the key area of the ecological restoration project and can finely make an ecological protection restoration scheme.
assignees: CHINESE RES ACAD ENV SCIENCES

title_en: Water collecting and irrigating device for slope ecological restoration after earthquake
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an irrigation equipment that catchments for ecological recovering of slope after shake, including side slope soil, be provided with a plurality of storage water tanks on the side slope soil, the storage water tank is provided with the escape canal on the side slope soil through burying the pipe connection underground, is provided with in the storage water tank and sprays irrigation equipment, and the storage water tank top is provided with energy memory, and the inflow entrance has been seted up to the storage water tank both sides, and inflow entrance department is provided with the backward flow and protects the way. The utility model discloses a solar panel supplies power with solar energy, and the storage supplies power for the suction pump in the battery, guarantee that it can carry out the ecological recovery of side slope before the shake is rebuild, protect the way through setting up a plurality of backward flows on side slope soil and effectively prevent that rivers from collecting and cause the impact to soil, and preserve rivers in the water storage tank, when irrigating, the water that the suction pump in the storage tank will be stored in the storage tank when the rainfall is taken out, transmit to the vaporific shower nozzle of distribution on the side slope through the connecting pipe on, realize irrigating through the mode of water droplet.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Geological disaster ecological restoration structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of ecological restoration structures, in particular to a geological disaster ecological restoration structure, which comprises a grounding nail, wherein the surface of the grounding nail is provided with a connecting plate, the surface of the connecting plate is provided with a winding column, the end part of the winding column is provided with a struck block, the outer side of the winding column is sleeved with a lantern ring, the surface of the lantern ring is provided with a first bolting ring, the surface of the first bolting ring is bolted with a traction rope, the other end of the traction rope is bolted with a second bolting ring, the second bolting ring is fixed on the surface of a planting frame, the surface of the planting frame is provided with a notch, the inside of the notch is provided with a grid plate, and the upper part of the grid plate is provided with a straw mat; the beneficial effects are that: the utility model provides a geological disasters ecological remediation structure plants the vegetation inside planting the frame, then will plant the frame with the help of the tractive rope and be connected with the lantern ring, and the lantern ring cover is established on fixed rod spare, and two sets of fixed rod bodies are strikeed and are inserted and fix planting the frame through the tractive rope on the slope, avoid planting the frame and drop.
assignees: ZHANG ZHE

title_en: Intelligent well spacing system and method integrating natural gas hydrate exploitation and geological restoration
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent well spacing system integrating natural gas hydrate exploitation and geological restoration, which comprises: a vertical well in which a main gas production line and CO injection are arranged 2 A main pipeline; a horizontal well communicated with the vertical well and divided into a branch pipeline for gas production and a branch pipeline for CO injection 2 Gas recovery well and CO injection for branch pipeline 2 Well, said gas production branch line and CO injection 2 The branch pipeline is respectively connected with the gas production main pipeline and the CO injection main pipeline 2 The main pipeline is communicated; an artificial intelligence slotting robot, the number of which is a plurality, arranged in the CO injection 2 Main pipeline and CO injection 2 In the branch line. The invention also provides an intelligent well distribution method integrating natural gas hydrate exploitation and geological restoration, and the invention divides areasThe block can repair geology quickly and efficiently. The CO2 and the depressurization production pipelines are alternately arranged in a blocking and fixed-distance mode in the multiple horizontal wells, the geology in a small area is efficiently repaired in the blocking and fixed-distance mode, and the possibility of disasters caused by geological damage in the hydrate production process is greatly reduced.
assignees: SHENZHEN QIHANGYUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mine ecological restoration system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an ecological remediation technical field specifically is a mine ecological remediation system, including the mine hillside, the surface of mine hillside laid the non-woven fabrics, the surface of non-woven fabrics be provided with earial drainage mechanism, earial drainage mechanism including earial drainage guide cell body, filter cartridge, interception frame, first pipeline, second pipeline, mounting bracket, installation through-hole, fixing bolt and drainage way. The utility model has the advantages that: through being provided with the earial drainage mechanism, the setting of interception frame equidistance, it is internal to flow into the earial drainage guiding groove after the filter cartridge coarse filtration with the rainwater of interception, collect downwards at last along earial drainage guiding groove body and flow in the drainage, can prevent like this that the rainwater from gathering at mine layer surface and condensing into the thigh and erode mine layer surface, prevent the massif landslide like this, further reduce harm, because the drainage of non-woven fabrics, still be favorable to keeping mine layer earth's surface water content, do benefit to vegetation, prevent that dust from flying upward, the device's practicality has been improved greatly.
assignees: HENAN FUYAN ECOLOGICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Prevention and treatment method for algal bloom disasters of eutrophic water body
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of water body ecological restoration, and particularly relates to a method for preventing and treating algal bloom disasters of an eutrophic water body, which comprises the following steps: (1) seed selection: determining harmless or low harmful algal species having a competitive relationship with the main algal bloom species; (2) propagation: culturing the harmless or low-harm algae; (3) suppressing: by paving the semi-open type photobioreactor clusters in a specific interval of a target water body, harmless or low-harm algal species can more easily obtain survival factors in the target water body, and the competitive advantage and the inhibition effect on harmful algal blooms in the target water body are formed; (4) recovering: through continuous recovery of algae liquid in the semi-open type photobioreactor cluster, high-efficiency removal of nitrogen, phosphorus and other rich nutrient elements in target water is achieved. According to the invention, the artificial culture algae is used for replacing ecological niches of harmful algal blooms, so that the algal blooms are inhibited, and the water quality is improved; the method has the advantages of reducing high investment, high energy consumption and ecological risks in the algal bloom treatment process.

title_en: Work order management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power failure emergency repair, and provides a work order management system, which comprises: an operation interface and a login module; the system comprises a work order module, a fault location module and a fault equipment module, wherein the work order module is used for issuing an emergency repair work order, and the content of the emergency repair work order comprises a fault user, a fault location and fault equipment; and the progress monitoring module is connected with the operation interface and the work order module and used for acquiring the work progress of the monitoring construction team and updating the state of the work order according to the work progress. The system is provided with an operation interface, a login module, a work order module, a progress monitoring module, a confirmation module, an evaluation module, a reward and punishment module and the like, and is used for monitoring all links after the order of a construction team, including the aspects of arrival time, investigation condition, estimated power restoration time, whether maintenance is finished and the like, so that a power supply bureau and a fault reporting user can better understand the maintenance progress of the construction team; and a reward and punishment system is also arranged so as to supervise the work of the construction team.
assignees: GUANGDONG TOPWAY NETWORK CO LTD

title_en: Quick afforestation equipment of high steep side slope in flexible mine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flexible mine high and steep slope quick greening device, which comprises a flexible protective net laid on a mountain slope and a planting disc fixed at the intersection of the flexible protective net, wherein the edge of the planting disc is fixedly provided with a fixing part, the tail end of the fixing part is in a sharp-thorn shape, and a plant fiber mesh belt is fixedly connected with the flexible protective net by winding on the fixing part; the utility model discloses close flexible protection network and planting dish as an organic whole, realize the afforestation restoration of massif simultaneously on the basis that firm substrate prevents the landslide to plant the dish through the better and domatic laminating of flexible protection network, be favorable to planting the dish plant and the massif combination growth.
assignees: HUNAN CHINA NUCLEAR CONSTRUCTION ENG COMPANY

title_en: Radiation type loop-free power distribution network island generation method for power restoration by adopting SNOP (simple noise rejection operation)
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for generating an isolated island of a radiation type loop-free power distribution network by adopting SNOP (single operational noise) for power restoration. The method comprises the following steps: forming complete topological connection among the SNOP nodes, and classifying the topological nodes of the power distribution network containing the SNOP; gradually retrieving the island nodes according to the topological structure; and repeating the iterative retrieval algorithm to generate all the SNOP-containing power distribution network islands. The algorithm makes full use of the radial topological characteristic of the power distribution network, performs topological analysis and node definition according to the tidal current direction and the position of the SNOP equipment in the topological structure of the power distribution network, and reduces the difficulty of the analysis of the whole system. The method for generating the SNOP island algorithm according to the network topology is simple, convenient and practical, has high calculation efficiency, and is beneficial to power grid dispatching personnel to make timely optimization and adjustment according to island node combinations and power grid state indexes when an actual natural disaster occurs, so that the large-scale power failure accident of the power distribution network can be avoided by utilizing the quick power restoration capability of the SNOP.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Maintenance management system
abstract_en: To provide a service appropriate to restore a house to its original state.SOLUTION: The present invention relates to a maintenance management system used to calculate the cost for restoring a building damaged by generation of disasters to its original state, and the maintenance management system includes a server 1. The server 1 includes a maintenance management unit 43, a damage information acquisition unit 46, a damage determination unit 47, and an original restoration cost calculation unit 48. The maintenance management unit 43 manages, as maintenance management information, the history of works done to a house to maintain and manage the house which include at least a part of inspection, maintenance, repair, and renovation at regular intervals. The damage information acquisition unit 46 acquires information of damages on the house associated with the disasters. The damage determination unit 47 determines the locations and the degree of damages on the house by the disasters on the basis of the maintenance management information and the information of damages. The original restoration cost calculation unit 48 calculates the cost for restoring the house to its original state on the basis of the maintenance management information and the locations and the degree of damages on the house.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4
assignees: SOKEN KK

title_en: Method and system for testing fault processing, testing and analyzing of power distribution main station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for testing, processing and analyzing faults of a power distribution main station, which comprises the steps of collecting fault data by using an FTT 1200; injecting the fault data into a testing power distribution main station to carry out real-time information interaction, testing the fault data and outputting test information; constructing a fusion optimization analysis model based on different types of fault information and fault related characteristics to perform fault analysis on the test information to obtain an analysis result; the effectiveness of the FA function of the main station system under the normal condition of the operating environment is tested, the robustness of the main station system under the abnormal environment can be tested, various communication protocols can be adopted to inject the fault characteristic data of the tested power distribution network, and the functions of displaying the whole process of self-fault occurrence, fault positioning, fault isolation and power restoration of a non-fault area of the tested system are achieved.

title_en: Power utilization emergency management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electricity emergency management system, which comprises: the emergency information acquisition module is used for acquiring emergency information from the operation and distribution information integration platform; the statistics module is used for counting the affected clients according to the power failure accidents; the emergency package maintenance module is used for maintaining and updating the emergency package information of the customer; the emergency service module is used for starting corresponding customer emergency service according to the emergency information, and comprises: starting a power failure notification module to send power failure notification information to a client; starting a customer service module to receive the emergency information reported by the affected customer; starting an emergency resource allocation module to allocate resources for the affected customers and arrange and recover power supply according to the emergency information and the emergency package information of the customers; the emergency service monitoring module is used for acquiring the emergency condition reported by the emergency personnel in real time and dynamically updating the emergency condition; and the power restoration notification module is used for sending power restoration notification information to the client. And carrying out emergency treatment on the client according to the information of the client, and improving the emergency management level of the client.
assignees: GUANGDONG TOPWAY NETWORK CO LTD

title_en: Quick power restoration management platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rapid power restoration management platform, which integrates data of a distribution and dispatching intensive application system, a safety production management system and a marketing management system, and comprises: the fault monitoring module generates a fault alarm event when the main network equipment fails; the dispatching fault reporting module generates a fault reporting work order according to the fault warning event and transmits the fault reporting work order to the power failure pool; the fault repair module generates a fault repair work order according to the fault reported by the client and transmits the fault repair work order to the power failure pool; stopping the battery to convert the fault reporting work order into a fault power failure event, synchronizing the fault power failure event to a safety production management system for fault first-aid repair processing and synchronizing the fault power failure event to a marketing management system for power failure notification; the power failure monitoring module counts all fault power failure events in the day; the fault processing progress monitoring module counts the number of faults according to the processing progress of all fault power failure events in the day; and the emergency repair resource management module allocates corresponding emergency repair materials for the fault power failure event. The invention enhances the customer power failure management, reduces the customer power failure time and improves the customer satisfaction.
assignees: GUANGDONG TOPWAY NETWORK CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for testing distribution characteristics of earth exogenous magnetic field by using field effect of carbon allotrope compound
abstract_en: The method and device for testing distribution characteristics of earth external magnetic field by using carbon allotrope compound field effect are characterized by that the artificial polar light induced by carbon allotrope compound field effect device formed from plane electrode plate composite body formed from foamed nickel or carbon fibre which is loaded with ELF low-frequency electric field, communicated in the form of parallel capacitor and deposited with carbon allotrope compound is used as marker, and the distribution characteristics of earth external magnetic field formed from ring band-shaped N pole and ring band-shaped S pole which are alternatively distributed along latitude line of earth are indirectly described by means of special relationship of artificial polar light and earth external magnetic field. The distribution state of the earth external source magnetic field has important values for environmental protection, natural ecology restoration, natural disaster prediction and universe energy utilization.
assignees: LIU NANLIN

title_en: Method for protecting dam body and dam foundation of sand blocking dam
abstract_en: A protection method for a dam body and a dam foundation of a sand blocking dam comprises the following steps: processing the front and back of the main dam and the front and back of the auxiliary dam into a plane and paving soil; planting herbs at the upstream of the main dam and the upstream of the auxiliary dam so as to accumulate silt, slow down flow speed and disperse water flow through the herbs; planting shrubs under the main dam and the auxiliary dam to reduce the flow velocity of flowing water and splash erosion by using the shrubs; moss is planted on the dam body to reduce the erosion of wall-facing flow. The invention utilizes the ecological vegetation to carry out cascade energy dissipation, and can effectively reduce the damage of the upstream long flowing water to the sand blocking dam for a long time. Compared with the existing engineering measures such as a reinforcement gabion and the like, the protection effect of the invention is increased along with the increase of time, the cost is low, the environment is protected, the ecological restoration in a debris flow channel can be accelerated by silting the soil around the grass, and the ecological sustainable development of the channel is facilitated.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Big data-based artificial intelligent power grid regulation and control operation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence power grid regulation and control operation method and system based on big data, the system comprises a main control module, and a bill acquisition unit, a machine language understanding unit, an equipment object matching unit, a sorting binding result library, a sorting binding rule library, a network topology analysis unit, a graph-model integrated introduction unit, a feature extraction unit and a safety check unit which are respectively connected with the main control module, wherein the output end of the bill acquisition unit is sequentially connected with the machine language understanding unit, the equipment object matching unit, the sorting binding result library and the sorting binding rule library, and matching association is carried out on historical comprehensive power failure application tickets and historical scheduling operation tickets to form historical sorting binding result information, and the equipment object sorting binding rule library is established. According to the invention, intelligent functions such as automatic generation and simulation of the equipment power restoration dispatching operation ticket are realized, the intelligent level of power grid regulation operation is improved, the working pressure of a regulator is greatly reduced, and the safe and stable operation level and the working efficiency of a power grid are improved.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Ultrasonic water meter data restoration method based on deep learning model
abstract_en: An ultrasonic water meter data restoration method based on a deep learning model calculates an ultrasonic flight time difference through an ultrasonic water meter time chip to obtain ultrasonic water meter time sequence original data r m Screening abnormal values of the ultrasonic water meter time sequence data set by adopting a dynamic threshold method; preprocessing is carried out, abnormal values in the data set are removed, and configuration of a training set and a testing set is carried out according to the characteristics of the LSTM model; predicting the ultrasonic water meter time sequence data by the forward LSTM prediction model, and predicting the ultrasonic water meter time sequence data by the forward LSTM prediction model; reverse LSTM modeModeling and deducing ultrasonic water meter time sequence data, wherein the reverse LSTM model comprises model optimization parameter setting, model construction and training, carrying out ultrasonic water meter time sequence data deduction according to the reverse LSTM model, and deducing according to a predicted value y' t And the derived value y ″) t And calculating the recovery value of the abnormal data in a weighted mode. The invention has higher repairing precision and higher repairing efficiency.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG TECHNOLOGY;HANGZHOU LAISON TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for detecting and repairing drainage pipe network GIS abnormal data
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for detecting and repairing drainage pipe network GIS abnormal data, which comprises the following steps of firstly preprocessing the drainage pipe network GIS data; then compiling query and repair rules in ArcGIS 'topology' tool box and SQL Server database software to process topology abnormity; constructing an attribute item semi-automatic classification method based on a Jaccard similarity coefficient matrix to classify and repair the drain pipe network text attribute items; an upstream and downstream pipe diameter filling method based on rules is provided for abnormal pipe diameter detection and repair; and the detection and restoration of the elevation of the abnormal pipe section at the multi-way node and the elevation of the abnormal inspection well are realized on the basis of a least square method. Based on the method, the MATLAB language is adopted to develop corresponding programs, man-machine interactive drainage pipe network abnormal data detection and repair are achieved, the method for solving various main data abnormal problems of the drainage pipe network with certain universality can effectively help to improve the data quality of the drainage pipe network.

title_en: Underground water intelligent supervision platform based on three-dimensional geological model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of information networks, and mainly relates to an underground water intelligent supervision platform based on a three-dimensional geological model, which comprises: a spatial database for uploading, storing and managing underground water monitoring data; the three-dimensional visualization system is used for uploading three-dimensional data, three-dimensional display of stratum and drilling data and three-dimensional water level visualization display; the monitoring system is used for monitoring data statistical analysis, dynamic analysis and pollution map functions; the management system is used for background management, user management and updating maintenance. The platform can quickly find a pollution center through plane interpolation processing of water quality monitoring data and three-dimensional display of water level monitoring data, can clearly find the relative position and the stratum of a monitoring well by combining an above-ground oblique photography model and an underground three-dimensional geological model, is favorable for finding the pollution reason of underground water, and provides an all-round basis for underground water treatment and restoration.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ENVIRONMENTAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Uncertainty-based dynamic evaluation method for recovery value of power distribution network object to be recovered
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic evaluation method for the recovery value of an object to be recovered of a power distribution network, which comprises the following steps: evaluating the recovery value of the ith load unit to be recovered, and evaluating the recovery value V of the iota load bus per se  ι‑self  Calculating adequacy in the partition at the current moment, evaluating uncertainty of units on the g-th unit bus, and traversing J from the outward width of the g-th unit bus preferentially  g  Layer, evaluator, perimeter J  g  G-th unit bus recovery value V of layer bus recovery value  g  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the Breadth-first traversal J from iota load bus  ι  Layer, evaluator, perimeter J  ι  Iota load bus recovery value V of layer bus recovery value  ι  . The potential recovery value brought by the recovery of the object to be recovered for the peripheral object is considered, so that the recovery priority of the object to be recovered in the recovery process is effectively determined, the emergency degree reflecting the power supply recovery requirement of the object to be recovered is fully reflected, and the help is provided for the optimization decision of the recovery scheme.

title_en: Be used for prosthetic green slope protection structure of planting of geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of geological disaster treatment, in particular to a green plant slope protection structure for geological disaster restoration, which comprises a fixed seat fixed on a hillside, wherein the outer wall of the fixed seat is fixedly connected with a rock plate, one end of the rock plate far away from the fixed seat is fixedly connected with a protection plate, the bottom of the protection plate penetrates through the ground and extends to the interior of a mountain body, and a clamping groove is arranged between the fixed seat and the protection plate at the bottom of the rock plate; let fixing base, form a whole between guard plate and the massif, increased the firm degree of bank protection bottom, the rethread guard plate blocks the soil of slope body top, slows down the impact force of the downward landing of soil to green plant the layer to on the fixing base and protect, protected ecological environment, the rethread guard plate supports the soil of slope body top, the guard plate has played the effect of accepting, can effectually alleviate the landslide phenomenon that soil on the slope body is landing and causes downwards.
assignees: Shi Wujian

title_en: Ecological stability-oriented surface water and underground water combined regulation and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological stability-oriented surface water and groundwater combined regulation and control method, which comprises the steps of establishing a bottom layer model and a top layer model, wherein the bottom layer model comprises a river basin middle stream sub-model and a river basin downstream sub-model, targets tend to maximize economic and ecological benefits respectively, and the top layer model targets tend to maximize the river basin comprehensive benefits based on a multi-target and multi-water source ecological stability-oriented double-layer water resource optimization regulation and control model of a large system decomposition coordination principle, a water balance principle and a supply and demand water prediction model. The model can coordinate the contradiction between agricultural water and ecological water by optimally adjusting the planting structure, the industrial structure and the water distribution and the groundwater level of each area, thereby realizing ecological stabilization and restoration of the desert oasis.

title_en: Shearing type energy-consumption beam-falling-preventing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a roof beam power consumption technical field is prevented falling by bridge, in particular to roof beam device is prevented falling by shearing type power consumption contains first mount pad and second mount pad, be equipped with yield type metal power consumption subassembly between first mount pad and the second mount pad, first mount pad and second mount pad sliding connection, first mount pad is connected with spacing part, first mount pad passes through adapting unit and connects the movable component, the movable component can drive first mount pad is relative the motion of second mount pad and then makes the type of buckling power consumption subassembly takes place to cut the type diastrophism. The device breaks through the limitation that the existing shearing type dislocation metal damper is difficult to meet the displacement requirement of seismic isolation and reduction design of bridge engineering, is favorable for reducing the cost of the device, improves the rigidity and the bearing capacity of the energy-consumption beam-falling prevention device, increases the effectiveness of energy consumption capability and continuous energy consumption, protects the bridge structure from earthquake damage, and is beneficial to restoration after earthquake.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY ERYUAN ENG GROUP

title_en: Method for operating a gas turbine power plant and gas turbine power plants, in particular a method for supporting a black grid restoration by using a gas turbine with sequential combustors
assignees: Ansaldo Energia Switzerland AG

title_en: Handheld operation and maintenance equipment of electric power intelligent terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a handheld operation and maintenance device of an electric power intelligent terminal, wherein a software module comprises a tool authorization module, a user management module, a work preparation module, a commissioning setting module, a device diagnosis module, a terminal test module, a backup restoration module and a terminal operation and maintenance module; the module is used for debugging the power distribution terminal device before and after commissioning, ex-factory inspection, warehouse acceptance, installation and debugging and operation maintenance; the invention carries out information authentication through the two-dimension code information of the scanning device, can complete the functions of software upgrading, data calibration, automatic test, configuration downloading/backup, fault diagnosis/repair, automatic point alignment of a main station, real-time data monitoring, historical file retrieval, control command issuing, device restarting and the like of the device, carries out targeted function research and development and operation optimization on the operation related to the life cycle of the power distribution terminal device in the whole process from production debugging to delivery operation, reduces the operation difficulty of personnel in each link, shortens the debugging and operation and maintenance time and improves the working efficiency of the personnel.
assignees: JIANGSU SHENRUI HUIYANG ENERGY TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Quick and efficient reinforcing structure for side force resisting prestressed diagonal draw bar of urban bridge disaster damage pier stud
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a quick and efficient strengthening structure of an anti-side force prestressed diagonal draw bar of an urban bridge disaster damage pier stud, which comprises a concrete foundation bearing platform, a concrete pier stud, an anti-side force prestressed diagonal draw bar, a steel backing plate, a rejection area, a stress conversion angle steel, a structural adhesive and an anchor rod; the concrete foundation bearing platform is provided with a concrete pier column, a plurality of lateral force resisting prestressed diagonal draw bars are arranged at the column root of the concrete pier column, and a 45-degree included angle is formed between the bar body of each lateral force resisting prestressed diagonal draw bar and the horizontal plane of the concrete foundation bearing platform. The utility model discloses it is little only to need to reject the former pier stud protective layer area that partial pier stud concrete protective layer destroyed than the tradition and consolidate the restoration method to reduce and consolidate repair time and reduce the disaster and decrease bridge and resume to use required time and material, speed is faster, can also reduce the indirect economic loss because of bridge repair time is many and cause.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST;CHINA ACADEMY OF BUILDING RES;NANJING SHENGYUAN CIVIL ENG HIGH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Service asset network attack restoration tracing device based on power management information system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a business assets network attack reduction traceability equipment based on power management information system in power management information technology field, including traceability host computer and distal end industrial computer, traceability host computer and distal end industrial computer are connected to same router through the twisted pair to be connected with the cloud platform through the internet, the cloud platform connects expert end and user terminal respectively, the distal end industrial computer is connected with display and printer respectively, the traceability result digraph through the host computer of traceing formation can gather the traceability result digraph of traceability host computer collection through the distal end industrial computer, then show through the display to can print it out through the printer, be convenient for carry out audio-visual viewing and analysis; and a corresponding disposal scheme can be given to the experience of accumulating the tracing result directed graph received by the cloud platform through an expert end.
assignees: CHINA POWER OPERATIONS BEIJING INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ecological energy-saving side slope structure constructed based on landscape architecture
abstract_en: An ecological energy-saving side slope structure constructed based on garden landscapes belongs to the technical field of side slope restoration. The side slope is characterized in that a medium coarse sand layer is paved on the broken stone slope surface of the side slope, and a planting soil layer is paved on the medium coarse sand layer; a Reynolds protection cushion layer is laid on the planting soil layer, and an ecological bag is laid on the Reynolds protection cushion layer; the ecological bags are arranged in an overlapping mode to form a ladder shape, and green plants are planted on the ecological bags. The ecological energy-saving side slope structure of the utility model can prevent the slope surface from being washed by rainwater, and can store part of rainwater which seeps downwards, thereby solving the problems that the plant water resource is lack and the plant cannot grow; not only can drain water, store water and grow plants, but also can play a role in protecting slopes, such as stabilizing side slopes and preventing landslide. The utility model has the advantages of simple and reasonable structure, the construction is simple, has wide application prospect.
assignees: YANGZHOU POLYTECHNIC INST

title_en: Detection and deduction of urgent messages in low power and lossy networks
