abstract_en: Techniques and mechanisms for detecting and deducing of urgent messages in low-power and lossy networks (LLNs) using a correlation analysis of the nodes within a network and machine learning (ML) models. Utilizing these techniques, a field network director (FND) of the network can determine neighboring devices within the network. ML models may be utilized to determine that based upon receipt of a power outage notification (PON) message and/or a power restoration notification (PRN) message from nodes, neighboring nodes of the nodes may also have suffered a power outage and/or a subsequent power restoration, even if the FND did not receive a corresponding PON message and/or a corresponding PRN message from the neighboring nodes of the network. Thus, loss of power and subsequent power restoration may be handled for large numbers of neighboring nodes within the network, even when only a few PON messages and/or subsequent PRN messages are received.
assignees: CISCO TECH INC

title_en: Intelligent well spacing system integrating natural gas hydrate exploitation and geological restoration
abstract_en: The utility model provides a natural gas hydrate exploitation and geological remediation in intelligent well spacing system of an organic whole, include: a vertical well in which a main gas production line and CO injection are arranged 2 A main pipeline; a horizontal well communicated with the vertical well and divided into a branch pipeline for gas production and a branch pipeline for CO injection 2 Gas recovery well and CO injection for branch pipeline 2 Well, said gas production branch line and CO injection 2 The branch pipeline is respectively connected with the gas production main pipeline and the CO injection main pipeline 2 The main pipeline is communicated; an artificial intelligence slotting robot, the number of which is a plurality, arranged in the CO injection 2 Main pipeline and CO injection 2 In the branch line. The utility model discloses divide the quick high efficiency of blocking to restore the geology. The CO2 and the depressurization production pipelines are alternately arranged in a blocking and fixed-distance mode in the multiple horizontal wells, the geology in a small area is efficiently repaired in the blocking and fixed-distance mode, and the possibility of disasters caused by geological damage in the hydrate production process is greatly reduced.
assignees: SHENZHEN QIHANGYUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Upright post for flood area and street lamp applying same
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a street lamp that is used for stand and applied this stand in flood area that sends out more, include the hollow cylinder with the vertical rigid coupling of installation face, be equipped with the terminal box that can controlled lift in the hollow cylinder, originally all be located the wiring board of inner chamber lower part in this stand, a controller, inductor etc. can place in the terminal box specially, when needs overhaul the maintenance, open and overhaul the hole and fall the terminal box to the entrance to a cave can, the terminal box all is located cylinder inner chamber upper portion under the conventional condition, even proruption flood disaster, the wiring board of no parcel, a controller, inductor etc. also can not submerged or drench, can effectively reduce street lamp damage rate, the restoration degree of difficulty has still avoidd the electric leakage, potential safety hazards such as electric shock, have very big spreading value and wide application prospect.
assignees: SICHUAN YANCHENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Distribution network emergency repair scheduling system and method
abstract_en: The application provides a distribution network emergency repair scheduling system and a distribution network emergency repair scheduling method, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the distribution network running state monitoring module is used for acquiring distribution network historical state data and distribution network historical fault data; the equipment asset management module is used for acquiring the data of the distribution network equipment; the enterprise standing book module is used for acquiring personnel data of a team; the vehicle management module is used for acquiring emergency vehicle data; the voice calling module is used for acquiring fault repair data; the prediction analysis module is used for acquiring an emergency repair analysis result; the man-machine interaction module is used for displaying an emergency repair analysis result and judging a distribution network fault; and the emergency repair task management module is used for generating an emergency repair task according to the distribution network fault and sending the emergency repair task to the man-machine interaction module so that a scheduling commander can command and schedule the emergency repair task according to the emergency repair analysis result.
assignees: INFORMATION COMMUNICATION BRANCH HAINAN POWER GRID CO LTD;YUNNAN YUNDIAN TONGFANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Green mine construction planning method based on live-action three-dimensional modeling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a green mine construction planning method based on live-action three-dimensional modeling, which comprises the steps of obtaining geographic data of a target area, constructing a point cloud model and a TIN model, constructing an original landform live-action three-dimensional model, constructing a mining area mining planning live-action three-dimensional model and constructing an ecological restoration planning live-action three-dimensional model. Preferably, under the condition that the mine has geological disaster hidden trouble, before the step of constructing the ecological restoration planning live-action three-dimensional model, the method further comprises the step of constructing a mining area disaster management planning live-action three-dimensional model. The invention has the advantages that the unmanned aerial vehicle oblique photography technology and the three-dimensional geographic information software platform are comprehensively utilized, the two-dimensional plane design conversion three-dimensional model, the design model and the current situation real scene three-dimensional model are fused, the mine exploitation, the staged exploitation and greening, the geological disaster treatment and the post-exploitation ecological restoration design scheme are truly presented in the real scene three-dimensional model, and objective and intuitive scientific evaluation support is provided for the construction of green mines.
assignees: CHINA GEZHOUBA GROUP YIPULI CO LTD

title_en: Distribution network dispatching instruction ticket safety checking system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a distribution network dispatching instruction ticket safety checking system and a distribution network dispatching instruction ticket safety checking method, and belongs to the technical field of electric power system dispatching operation. The system comprises a collecting device, an instruction ticket classifying module, a keyword identifying module, a power failure operation ticket checking module, a power restoration operation ticket checking module, a fault log/abnormal defect recording list checking module, a power restoration control module and the like. After the distribution network scheduling instruction ticket safety checking system is formally on line, the human resource waste is reduced, the human resource benefit maximization is achieved, and the problem of shortage of the human resources of the distribution network is solved to a certain extent. And secondly, the safety measure arrangement is changed from the traditional manual input manual check into an automatic intelligent check process, so that the scheduling operation efficiency, the power supply reliability and the safety are improved.
assignees: KUNMING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Thermal stratification type reservoir scheduling optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thermal stratification type reservoir dispatching optimization method, which comprises the following steps: collecting water quality data during thermal stratification of a reservoir, analyzing change characteristics of a dissolved oxygen stratification structure during thermal stratification, extracting control factors of the change characteristics of the dissolved oxygen during thermal stratification of the reservoir, establishing a three-dimensional hydrodynamic-water quality model of the reservoir, checking the model by adopting monitoring data, simulating thermal stratification hypoxia time under different water levels, scheduling operation modes and pumped storage scheduling working conditions by utilizing a control equation, and establishing a scheduling scheme of the reservoir according to distribution of the hypoxia time. The scheme can truly simulate the influence factors of the dissolved oxygen of the reservoir, can accurately provide a scheduling scheme for optimizing the dissolved oxygen, provides a countermeasure for improving the dissolved oxygen of the temperature-stagnation layer of the reservoir, provides effective scientific guidance for the protection and restoration of the water environment of the thermal stratification reservoir, and has good prevention and control effects on the oxygen deficiency of the temperature-stagnation layer of the reservoir.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;HEILONGJIANG PROVINCE INVESTIGATION DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE OF WATER CONSERVANCY AND HYDROPOWER

title_en: Equipment for repairing and improving soil ecology after soil and water disasters in mid-swimming areas of yellow river
abstract_en: The invention relates to equipment for restoring and improving soil ecology after a soil and water disaster in a midstream region of a yellow river in the technical field of soil restoration and improvement equipment, which comprises a mounting plate, wherein the bottom end of the mounting plate is fixedly provided with a support plate, a first rotating shaft is arranged between the right side support plates, a second rotating shaft is arranged between the left side support plates, two ends of the first rotating shaft and the second rotating shaft are respectively fixedly provided with a roller, the top end of the mounting plate is fixedly provided with a mixing assembly feeding and stirring assembly, two sides of the bottom end of the mounting plate are provided with a plowing assembly and a plowing assembly, the bottom of the mounting plate is fixedly provided with a placing plate through a connecting rod, the placing plate is provided; the invention can effectively and fully mix the herbicide and water, ensures the use effect of the herbicide, can supplement soil fertility in a targeted manner, and has the advantages that the arranged driving assembly drives the whole device to move, the pesticide spraying assembly and the fertilizer applying assembly are driven to work in the moving process, and the waste of the fertilizer and the herbicide is avoided.
assignees: UNIV NORTHWESTERN

title_en: Distributed fault recovery method and system for ring distribution network adapting to 5G communication network
abstract_en: According to the distributed fault recovery method and system for the ring distribution network adapting to the 5G communication network, after a fault occurs, circuit fault information is exchanged between adjacent STUs through the 5G network, and fault points are located; secondly, searching a non-fault power-off area through an adjacent STU; thirdly, returning the searched power supply points to the root node of the lower stage of the fault point step by step; then, sending a power supply recovery area searching instruction to a power supply point; the power supply point STU determines the power supply range of the power supply point STU by searching the power supply recovery area and realizes power supply recovery. Based on a 5G communication network, information such as faults, power access points, power supply requirements, power supply capacity and the like is exchanged between an upstream STU and a downstream STU, and finally functions such as fault positioning, identification of a non-fault power failure area, power supply restoration path identification, power supply restoration and the like are realized. The method adopts the 5G-based sparse communication network to realize the distributed fault location and the power supply recovery of the power distribution network, and has the advantages of simple realization, quick response and high reliability.

title_en: Ecological restoration method for mine side slope
abstract_en: The ecological restoration method for the mine side slope comprises the following steps: s1: cleaning dangerous rocks on the mine slope and leveling the slope surface; s2, fixedly arranging a reinforcing layer for stabilizing the slope surface on the mine side slope; s3, fixedly arranging a vegetation groove for cultivating green plants on the reinforcing layer; s4, filling biomass nutrient soil in the vegetation groove; s5, planting green plants in the plant growing tank and distributing a drip irrigation system. According to the invention, the prefabricated reinforcing mesh is anchored on the mountain of the leveled mine side slope through the anchor rod, and the concrete is sprayed to the reinforcing mesh to form a stable integrated reinforcing layer, so that the slope structure of the mine side slope is enhanced, and natural disasters such as rockfall, mountain landslide and debris flow are effectively avoided; the invention fixedly installs a plurality of planting grooves which are arranged in a longitudinal step shape on the reinforcing layer of the mine side slope, plants green plants in the planting grooves, and recovers the ecological landscape of the mine side slope to be consistent with the surrounding environment.
assignees: ANHUI LINHAI LANDSCAPING CO LTD

title_en: Connecting structure of curtain wall for earthquake resistant
title_ko: 내진 커튼월의 연결구조
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a connection structure for an earthquake-proof curtain wall, capable of connecting a horizontal part installed in a horizontal direction between vertical parts inserted in a vertical direction and installed adjacently. The connection structure includes: a connection part having one side coupled with a vertical part and having the other side coupled with a horizontal part; a protrusion part coupled by being fitted into a side of the vertical part; a fixing part fixing and coupling the connection part with a side of the vertical part; and a buffer part buffering a connection part between the vertical part and the horizontal part. Therefore, since the buffer part buffering the connection part between the vertical part and the horizontal part is provided between the connection part and the fixing part, the present invention can provide effects of simplifying earthquake-proof connection work for a curtain wall while improving earthquake-proof performance and restoration performance and improving watertight and airtight properties.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 상하방향으로 입설되며 인접하게 설치된 수직부 사이에 수평방향으로 설치되는 수평부를 연결하는 커튼월의 내진 커튼월의 연결구조에 관한 것으로서, 수직부에 일방이 결합되며 타방에 수평부가 결합되는 연결부와, 수직부의 측면에 끼워맞춤 결합되는 돌기부와, 수직부의 측면에 연결부를 고정 결합시키는 고정부와, 수직부와 수평부 사이의 연결부위를 완충시키는 완충부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 따라서 본 발명은 연결부와 고정부 사이에 수직부와 수평부 사이의 연결부위를 완충하는 완충부를 구비함으로써, 커튼월의 내진 연결작업을 단순화하는 동시에 내진성능 및 복원성능을 향상시키고 수밀성 및 기밀성을 향상시킬 수 있는 효과를 제공한다.

title_en: Restoration plan formulation device, restoration plan formulation method and restoration plan formulation program
abstract_en: To provide a restoration plan formulation device which performs efficient restoration, a restoration plan formulation method and restoration plan formulation program.SOLUTION: In a risk management system 1, a restoration plan formulation device 10 comprises: a restoration priority calculation unit 12d which calculates a restoration priority indicating a degree to make restoration preferential for each facility based on a disaster degree of each facility in the case where a crisis event occurs, and a preset degree of influences onto services in the case where each facility is damaged by the disaster; and a restoration plan formulation unit 12e which forms a restoration plan including resource distribution for restoring each facility based on the restoration priority of each facility calculated by the priority calculation unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: NIPPON TELEGRAPH & TELEPHONE;UNIV TOHOKU

title_en: Method and system for determining groundwater pollution remediation threshold of refuse landfill
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for determining a threshold value for repairing sewage pollution in a refuse landfill, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a primary evaluation system, and carrying out primary evaluation on the environmental risk; dividing the risk into 3 grades according to the risk index, and formulating corresponding repair threshold values according to the grades; calculating a restoration threshold value of a landfill with a risk grade of a middle grade according to a target concentration method; and (4) establishing a restoration threshold value with a high-level risk level of the polluted site by using a health risk evaluation method. And (4) deducing the pollution remediation threshold of the landfill by numerically simulating the migration and transformation process of the underground water in the hydraulic gradient direction for the landfill with the intermediate and high risk levels. The method simplifies the formulation procedure of the remediation threshold of the high-risk polluted site, reduces the workload, and also enhances the pertinence and the accuracy of the remediation threshold of the pollution in the high-risk area.
assignees: CHINESE RES ACAD ENV SCIENCES

title_en: Ecological compound green structure in abandonment quarry
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ecological compound green structure in abandonment quarry among the quarry restoration technical field, in the V-arrangement groove in its domatic compound green unit, the lower extreme of stock inserts in the stock hole, cement mortar has been filled in the stock hole, the exposed part of upper end of stock transversely is fixed with a plurality of rows of horizontal muscle, the board is pour to the cast-in-place formation around stock and the horizontal muscle, the top of pouring the board is equipped with the outlet, it is fixed with domatic through the lacing wire to pour the inboard of board, the outside of lacing wire and the stock fixed connection who corresponds the position, geotechnological net has been laid on the surface of the domatic planting soil of V-arrangement inslot, its bottom is equipped with the gravel, separate through the geotechnological cloth between domatic planting soil and the gravel, the V-arrangement inslot still. The utility model discloses not only can adapt to the geological environment of precipitous side slope, provide good growing environment for domatic regreening vegetation, can also fully guarantee the stability of regreening system, guarantee the regreening effect of precipitous side slope, effectively prevent that secondary geological disasters such as soil erosion and collapse from taking place.
assignees: SHENZHEN ZHONGZHUANG MUNICIPAL LANDSCAPE ENG CO LTD

title_en: Water resource regulation and utilization system for ecological restoration of abandoned opencast limestone mine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ecological restoration water resource regulation and storage utilization system for abandoned opencast limestone mine, which comprises a trough positioned in a karst area and a slope positioned in a non-karst area, wherein a plurality of mined pits are distributed in the trough; a water blocking ditch which is consistent with the extending direction of the trough is arranged at the position close to the lower part of the slope and is combined with a plurality of hair branch ditches for blocking surface water and underground water in the slope; a plurality of grit chambers are arranged in the trough at intervals along the extending direction of the trough, a water diversion canal or a water diversion pipeline is arranged between each grit chamber and the water retaining ditch, between each mine pit and at least one grit chamber and between each vegetation recovery remodeling area and at least one grit chamber, and adjacent grit chambers are connected in series through connecting pipelines to realize regulation and distribution. The method not only can provide water source guarantee for the mining pit water landscape construction and vegetation restoration, greatly improve the utilization rate of water resources in the karst area, but also can quickly dredge atmospheric precipitation in the slope area and buffer surface runoff flowing to the karst trough valley area, thereby playing the roles of disaster prevention and reduction.
assignees: CHONGQING GEOLOGY AND MINERAL EXPLORATION AND DEVELOPMENT BUREAU 208 HYDROGEOLOGY ENGINEERING GEOLOG

title_en: Wireless power transmission
abstract_en: A power transmitter (101) transmits power to a power receiver (105) and includes a power input (209) that receives a supply of power. A power detector (211) detects a restoration of the supply power after a power outage, and a presence detector (213) detects a presence of the power receiver when the supply power is restored. The first communicator (207) may communicate with the second communicator (509) of the power receiver (105) using a short range communication channel. When the supply power is being restored, a message circuit (215) sends a power restoration message to the second communicator (509). A user action detector (217) detects a power receiver user action, and the controller (205) is arranged to: a power transmission to the power receiver is initiated after a power restoration in response to detecting the user action, and if the user action is not detected, the initiation of the power transmission is suppressed after a power restoration. The power receiver (105) may generate a user alert upon receipt of the power restoration message.
assignees: KONINKLIJKE PHILIPS NV

title_en: Pipe-repairing reaming device for drainage pipe network
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a drain pipe network's pipeline is restoreed and is used reaming device relates to drain pipe restoration technical field, including motor housing, motor housing's inside fixed mounting has the coolant liquid case, the top fixed mounting of coolant liquid case has the spray pipe, the one end of spray pipe is passed and is extended to motor housing's outside, the outside fixed mounting of coolant liquid case has the motor, the pivot one end and the axle sleeve fixed connection that takes precautions against earthquakes of installation on the output of motor, plant in the axle sleeve that takes precautions against earthquakes and install the connecting axle, the one end fixed mounting of connecting axle has the drill bit, motor housing's lower fixed surface installs fan housing, fan housing's inside fixed mounting has the fan, the cover is equipped with the shock pad on the outer wall of the axle sleeve that takes precautions against. The utility model discloses a mutually supporting between motor, coolant liquid case, the pull rod has realized the device's function diversification, has also improved the device's work efficiency simultaneously.
assignees: ZHEJIANG HYDROPOWER CONSTRUCTION AND INSTALLATION CO LTD

title_en: Method, device and system for evaluating operation sequence of recoverable equipment after fault
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and a system for evaluating operation sequence of recoverable equipment after a fault, which comprises the steps of obtaining an expected power grid model, wherein the expected power grid model is established on the basis that all cut-off equipment in a power grid to be recovered after the fault is completely cut off in a power grid model before the fault; calculating the power grid risk probability corresponding to each recoverable device in the expected power grid model; sequencing all the calculated power grid risk probabilities to obtain a recovery sequence of each recoverable device; and calculating the real-time evaluation score of the operation condition of the dispatcher based on the recovery sequence of each recoverable device and the sequence of the devices actually operated by the dispatcher in all the recoverable devices, and finishing the evaluation of the operation sequence of the recoverable devices. The method firstly analyzes and calculates the optimal recovery sequence of the power grid recoverable equipment after the fault, and then evaluates the actual operation result of the dispatcher based on the calculated optimal recovery sequence, thereby realizing effective evaluation of the power grid operation rationality after the fault of the dispatcher.

title_en: Simulation and prediction method for ecological influence of inland waterway improvement project
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological impact simulation and prediction method for inland waterway regulation engineering, which comprises the steps of determining indicated aquatic organisms of a regulation river reach, habitat factors forming the aquatic organisms and space-time distribution of the habitat factors, and establishing a fitness model of a habitat of the aquatic organisms; establishing a three-dimensional water-sand mathematical model of the renovation river reach, and predicting three-dimensional space-time distribution data of water depth, flow velocity, flow state and sand content of the renovation river reach under different channel renovation measure parameters; in the design stage of the inland waterway regulation engineering, the predicted habitat factor three-dimensional space-time distribution data is input into the fitness model by adjusting different regulation measure parameters in the three-dimensional water-sand mathematical model, and the influence on the habitat under different waterway regulation parameters is predicted, so that the organic integration of the waterway regulation target and the aquatic environment protection is achieved. The inland waterway regulation engineering influences the three-dimensional space of the indicative biological habitat conditions, develops the river navigation function and simultaneously considers the protection and restoration of the river ecological function.
assignees: TIANJIN RESEARCH INST WATER TRANSP ENGINEERING MOT

title_en: Power failure early warning signal verification method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a power failure early warning signal verification method and a power failure early warning signal verification system, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining a plurality of power failure early warning signals of all terminal equipment in a target power distribution area, wherein the power failure early warning signals comprise power failure equipment information and power failure time information; step S2, merging the plurality of power failure early warning signals to obtain a plurality of power failure early warning events; step S3, calling mining operation is carried out on the power failure equipment corresponding to the power failure early warning event so as to obtain three-phase current information of the power failure equipment; step S4, judging whether the mining calling operation is successful, if so, judging whether the corresponding power failure equipment is in a normal working state according to the comparison result of the obtained three-phase current information and a preset threshold value; and if the corresponding power failure equipment is in a power failure working state or fails in recovery, informing emergency repair personnel to go to the site to perform emergency repair and restoration treatment on the power failure equipment. The off-line state of the equipment is timely and accurately verified according to the power failure signal of the terminal equipment.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Main and distribution network accident recovery processing method based on index set weight
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a main network and distribution network accident recovery processing method based on index set weight, which comprises the steps of analyzing a main network power loss area according to a network topology model after receiving fault equipment, analyzing all main network power return paths according to a fault recovery method of layered partitions, and carrying out priority ordering on pre-arranged plans by an intelligently generated pre-arranged plan set according to the index set weight. After analyzing the main network restoration scheme, if the 10kV bus which is not subjected to power restoration still exists or the 10kV bus which is out of limit exists after the power flow calculation is carried out, the distribution network carries out power restoration or power supply on the capacity gap meeting the 10kV bus according to the power supply transfer capacity gap and the radial network topological structure, each weight coefficient value of each group of power restoration schemes is configured, the distribution network side schemes are subjected to priority sequencing, and a unified and complete main distribution network complex circuit path strategy is formed. The method is beneficial to timely knowing the safe and stable state of the power grid, can be supported by the decision of accident handling in advance, and has important significance for improving the handling capacity of dispatching operation personnel for major faults of the power grid.
assignees: JINHUA POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Method for monitoring vegetation water source conservation amount change
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for monitoring vegetation water source conservation quantity change, which comprises the following steps: acquiring global land total water reserve change data, rainfall, actual evaporation capacity, soil water reserve, snow melting capacity, snow water reserve, surface water reserve, underground water reserve, water resource change capacity, withered branch and fallen leaf layer retention capacity, average natural water content, maximum water holding capacity and withered and fallen object accumulation capacity; preprocessing the data, and calculating the water storage variation of the vegetation canopy; calculating withered branch and fallen leaf layer interception variable quantity; calculating the water storage variation of the soil; and determining the water conservation variable quantity according to the vegetation canopy water storage variable quantity, the withered branch and fallen leaf layer interception variable quantity and the soil water storage variable quantity. The method of the invention discards the traditional method for calculating the soil water storage capacity by multiplying the soil layer thickness and the non-capillary void volume, calculates the soil water storage variation by using the soil water content remote sensing data provided by NASA, and provides new technical support and reference for ecological restoration process, ecological effect evaluation and water source conservation evaluation.

title_en: Scheduling power failure and recovery condition anti-misoperation method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-misoperation method and system for dispatching power failure and restoration conditions based on artificial intelligence, wherein the method comprises the following steps: logic checking; checking the ticket face; checking the tide; and checking the state. By adopting the anti-misoperation method and the system based on the artificial intelligence for the dispatching power failure and recovery condition, the power grid accidents caused by habitual violation can be reduced. Meanwhile, whether the execution of the operation item has a problem can be quickly identified through a condition error prevention method, and the working efficiency of a dispatcher is improved.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Task allocation system for disaster recovery and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a task distribution system for disaster recovery and a use method thereof, belonging to the technical field of task distribution systems. A task distribution system for disaster recovery and a use method thereof can collect real-time parameters and real-time states of a data center through alarm modules of each data center, generate corresponding alarms when a disaster is perceived, quickly perform reasonable analysis and disaster recovery sequencing on tasks in the data center affected by the disaster at present and further provide a more reasonable and optimized task distribution solution through comprehensive analysis on the current situation of a backup data center. Compared with the traditional method, the method can deeply consider the influence of global environmental factors, effectively enhances the feasibility of the task allocation scheme, and optimizes the task disaster recovery performance.

title_en: Intelligent quick power restoration emergency box convenient to maintain and repair
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent quick power restoration emergency box convenient for maintenance and repair, which comprises an emergency box, wherein four corners of one side of the inner wall of the emergency box are respectively fixedly connected with four corners of a mounting plate through fixing devices, a plurality of emergency sockets are fixedly arranged at the middle part of the mounting plate, and the top ends of the plurality of emergency sockets are hinged with a protective cover respectively, the utility model relates to an intelligent quick power restoration emergency box convenient for maintenance and repair, a wire thinning device can comb wires connected with the mounting plate, the inconvenience in maintenance caused by winding is avoided, the four fixing devices can fix the mounting plate under the combined action, the mounting plate is prevented from loosening in the using process, when the emergency box fails, the fixing device is convenient to disassemble and maintain the mounting plate, the plurality of heat dissipation holes and the heat dissipation fan act together, the emergency box is cooled, and the phenomenon that a circuit is softened and short-circuited or even a fire disaster is caused due to overhigh local temperature is avoided.
assignees: FUJIAN DAFU INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Electric power marketing charging method and electric power marketing charging engine
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric power marketing charging method and an electric power marketing charging engine, wherein the electric power marketing charging engine is configured into a plurality of flow components according to a charging flow in advance, an electric quantity and electric charge calculation flow component is divided into a plurality of different primary components according to charging rules of different nationwide provinces (cities) in advance, the primary components are divided into a plurality of secondary components and expansion points according to the charging rules in advance, and places with inconsistent charging rules and inconsistent implementation modes of the nationwide provinces (cities) are unified. The client data required by charging is synchronously stored in the charging database as a snapshot, so that the subsequent electric quantity and electric charge calculation is facilitated, the electric quantity and electric charge calculation result is subjected to charge examination, the accuracy of the calculation result is improved, the problems of low charging speed and low efficiency caused by 'taking and calculating while' in the prior art are solved, the charging result is not influenced even if abnormal conditions such as power failure and power restoration occur in the charging process, and the stability and the reliability of the electric quantity and electric charge calculation are improved.
assignees: BEIJING CHINA POWER INF TECH

title_en: Cut-off system of distribution lines by section
title_ko: 구간별 배전선로의 차단 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for blocking distribution lines for each section, wherein when left and right cables are blocked, a connector is sufficiently maintained to be spaced from a left conductor end unit to reliably prevent an arc occurrence between the left conductor end unit and a joint of the connector, and an operation space is not formed on a shelf and a connector driving means is installed to reliably secure insulation between the cables mounted on a corresponding floor shelf and upper and lower shelves. An insulating film is formed around the exposed conductor end unit of the left cable, which is a power supply cable, to effectively prevent the arc occurrence between the left conductor end unit and the connector and a fire occurrence caused by the same when the left and right cables are blocked, and when a failure occurs, a resin applied to form the insulating film around the left conductor end unit does not scatter to a portion in which the applied resin is unnecessary not to remove the insulating film unnecessarily formed when the underground distribution line is restored to an original state in the future, thereby quickly and easily performing the restoration work.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 구간별 배전선로의 차단 시스템에 관한 것으로, 좌우측케이블이 차단되었을 때 커넥터가 좌측도체단부로부터 충분히 이격된 상태로 유지되어 좌측도체단부와 커넥터의 접속재 간의 아크발생을 확실하게 방지할 수 있고, 선반에 작동공간을 형성하지 않고 커넥터구동수단을 설치하여 당해 층 선반과 상, 하층 선반에 안착된 케이블 간의 절연이 확실하게 확보되며, 전원측 케이블인 좌측케이블의 노출된 도체단부의 주위에 절연피막을 형성함으로써 좌우측케이블의 차단시 좌측도체단부와 커넥터 간의 아크발생과 이로 인한 화재발생을 효과적으로 방지할 수 있고, 고장이 발생하여 좌측도체단부 주위에 절연피막을 형성하기 위하여 도포되는 수지가 불필요한 부분까지 비산되지 않게 하여 추후 지중배전선로를 원상복구할 때 불필요하게 형성된 절연피막을 제거하지 않아도 되어 원상복구 작업을 신속, 간편하게 수행할 수 있도록 한 것이다.
assignees: MI RAI ELECTRIC ENG

title_en: Method and apparatus for reconstructing time series data of climate
title_ko: 기후시계열 데이터 복원 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and device for restoring climate time series data, which comprises the steps of: allowing a climate time series data input unit to receive climate series data of a target area and climate time series data of one or more surrounding areas located around the target area to restore a climate reference average value of the target area from single-year climate time series data of the target area; allowing a reference climate station selection unit to analyze a correlation between the climate time series data of the target area and the climate time series data of the surrounding area and select a reference climate station of the surrounding area for correcting the time series data of the target area through the analyzed correlation; and allowing a climate reference average value restoration unit to correct the climate time series data of the target area based on the climate time series data of the selected reference climate station and restore the climate reference average value for estimating an amount of power generation through the corrected climate time series data of the target area. Therefore, the accuracy and reliability of feasibility evaluation can be improved.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 기후시계열 데이터 복원 방법 및 장치에 관한 것으로서, 기후시계열 데이터 입력부가, 대상 지역의 단일해 기후시계열 데이터로부터 대상 지역의 기후표준평년값을 복원하기 위해, 대상 지역의 기후시계열 데이터 및 대상 지역의 주변에 위치한 하나 이상의 주변 지역의 기후시계열 데이터를 입력받는 단계, 기준 기후측정소 선택부가, 대상 지역의 기후시계열 데이터와 주변 지역의 기후시계열 데이터 간의 상관성을 분석하고, 분석된 상관성을 통해 대상 지역의 기후시계열 데이터를 보정하기 위한 해당 주변 지역의 기준 기후측정소를 선택하는 단계, 및 기후표준평년값 복원부가, 선택된 기준 기후측정소의 기후시계열 데이터에 기초하여 대상 지역의 기후시계열 데이터를 보정하고, 보정된 대상 지역의 기후시계열 데이터를 통해 발전량 추정을 위한 기후표준평년값을 복원하는 단계를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: KOREA ELECTRIC POWER CORP;DAEMYOUNGGEC CO LTD

title_ko: 악취, 역류차단 배관
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a technique for blocking backflow and blocking bad smells and insects and, more specifically, to a technique capable of playing a role of flooding prevention when a blocking film of a window frame of an underground home or an outdoor door is installed together. Damage is increasing each year by typhoons and flooding in the rainy season. Heavy rain caused by global warming causes countless disasters of flooding in lowland apartments and underground parking lots and causes property losses and taxes for restoration. The backflow prevention technique may contribute to the alleviation of future disasters. The technique may have value as intellectual property. And the patented flooding prevention apparatus of the inventor of the present invention is expected to be realized together.
abstract_ko:
역류차단과 악취와 벌레들을 차단시키는 기술이며 옥외 문이나 지하가구 창틀의 차단막이 함께 설치가 되면 침수차단의 역활을 할 수가 있는 기술이며 우기 때 태풍과 홍수로 해마다 피해가 늘어나고 있고 온난화로 인한 폭우가 저지대 노후된 아파트 민가 등 지하 주차장까지 셀 수 없는 재난을 당하고 재산상의 손실과 복구에 대한 혈세가 너무 많이 발생하고 있고 그 대처법으로 미약하나마 앞으로 일어날 재해에 역류차단의 기술이 기여할 수 있는 발명으로 거듭나기를 바라고 이 기술이 지적자산으로서의 가치가 발생되기를 바라며 발명한 기술이다 
그리고 본 발명자의 특허등록된 침수차단 장치가 함께 실현되기를 기대한다.
assignees: NAM EUN TAE

title_en: Movable fire window opening and closing device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a movable fire window opening and closing device, which comprises a fixed arm, a movable arm and a connecting rod, wherein the movable arm is internally provided with a rotary driving device and an energy storage reset device which are matched with each other, the fixed arm is provided with a slide block, one end of the connecting rod is connected with the rotary driving device, and the other end of the connecting rod is hinged with the slide block; an elastic locking mechanism for locking the sliding block is arranged in the fixed arm, and an unlocking device for unlocking the elastic locking mechanism when a fire disaster happens is also arranged in the fixed arm; when the utility model is used, the energy storage and restoration device is stored by the rotating driving device in the rotating process of the window sash; the stable opening of the window sash is ensured through the elastic locking mechanism; when a fire disaster happens, the elastic locking mechanism is unlocked through the unlocking device, and then the energy storage reset device is released to realize the automatic closing of the window sash; the utility model discloses when satisfying the basic fire prevention requirement of fire prevention window, realized the movable of fire prevention window and involved, improved the ventilation and the daylighting requirement of fire prevention window.
assignees: SHENZHEN JIU YAO TECH CO LTD

title_en: Health evaluation and diagnosis method for urban landscape lake water ecosystem
abstract_en: A health evaluation and diagnosis method for an urban landscape lake water ecosystem, comprising: designing an index system as a hierarchical structure, which is divided into a target layer, a criterion layer and an index layer, the target layer representing the comprehensive health index of the urban landscape lake water ecosystem and being used for reflecting the overall level of a health status of an urban landscape lake, the criterion layer reflecting attributes and levels of the health status of the urban landscape lake from different aspects comprising water quality, sediment, biological community and lakeshore zone, the index layer being formed by selecting a plurality of indexes under the criterion layer, and the index evaluation being mainly based on quantitative evaluation, supplemented by qualitative evaluation; specifically dividing various factors influencing the water quality and health of the urban landscape lake, and performing assignment and scoring; determining evaluation weights of the criterion layer and the index layer by using an analytic hierarchy process; obtaining the comprehensive health index of the urban landscape lake water ecosystem according to the score value and weight of each index; and finally, determining the health status of the urban landscape lake according to the comprehensive health index of the urban landscape lake water ecosystem, and formulating corresponding restoration countermeasures.
assignees: GUANGDONG WATER COMPANY LTD;UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH;NATIONAL ENGINEERING RES CENTER OF URBAN WATER RESOURCE

title_en: Evaluation and identification method for plateau lakeside ecological landscape restoration planning
abstract_en: An assessment and identification method based on plateau lakeside ecological landscape restoration planning comprises the following aspects: (1) Evaluating the components of the plateau lakeside ecological landscape based on the vision field; (2) evaluating the restoration value of the ecological landscape of the lakeside of the plateau lake; (3) human activity disturbance intensity assessment; (4) identifying potential habitats of typical wetland waterfowls in plateau lakesides; (5) line selection evaluation of the ecological green roads in the plateau lake shores; and establishing a lakeshore ecological landscape micro-landform recognition algorithm based on the terrain index and the terrain humidity index, and combining with sight analysis to effectively recognize and analyze the composition of the plateau lakeshore ecological landscape system.

title_en: Line first-aid repair operation identification method and device without work ticket
abstract_en: The invention provides a line first-aid repair operation identification method and a line first-aid repair operation identification device without a work ticket, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1: acquiring fault information of distribution network scheduling push; s3, matching the current team information and the fault line position from a preset event data resource pool to obtain a plurality of historical emergency repair operations of the current team at the fault line position and corresponding emergency repair operation information; s4: and determining whether the emergency repair operation aiming at the fault information pushed by the power distribution network is line emergency repair operation without a work ticket according to work ticket transaction data of a plurality of historical emergency repair operations in a preset time from the corresponding historical fault starting time to the historical fault power restoration time. Aiming at the phenomenon of 10KV medium-voltage line fault emergency repair operation carried out without a work ticket, an efficient identification method is established to block the ticket-free emergency repair loophole, so that the special line control of departments such as safety supervision of provincial companies and city bureaus and the biotechnology is not relied on, and a large amount of manpower is saved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: VSC-HVDC (Voltage Source converter-high Voltage direct Current) access power system unit recovery sequence decision method
abstract_en: The invention provides a VSC-HVDC (voltage source converter-high voltage direct current) access power system unit recovery order decision method, and relates to the technical field of power systems. The method for deciding the recovery sequence of the VSC-HVDC-access-considered power system unit comprises the following specific steps: inputting system topology basic data and recovery characteristic data to form an AHP evaluation system; quantifying the system recovery process by branch addition and calculating the system strength index M SCR And setting a new recovery branch as l, and nodes at two ends as p and q, wherein p is a recovered node, and q is a newly recovered node, and gradually adding the branch from a direct current drop point k to the outside by the system to obtain the self-impedance of the point k. The invention provides a dynamic decision method combining system strength by considering the strategy research of unit recovery of VSC-HVDC access to alternating current systems with different system strengths, and adopts a step-by-step optimization methodAnd the state of the system can be quickly decided in real time.
assignees: UNIV GUANGXI

title_en: Methods and systems for detection and notification of power outages and power quality
abstract_en: Described herein are methods and systems for detection and notification of electrical power outages and power quality. A sensor coupled to a circuit transmits a keepalive packet to a server. The sensor detects an input signal generated by electrical activity. The sensor generates an output signal based upon the input signal. The sensor monitors the output signal. During a clock cycle, the sensor determines whether a rising edge occurred and transmits a fault packet to the server when the rising edge occurred prior to a predetermined clock value or when no rising edge occurred. The server receives the fault packet from the sensor and listens for keepalive packets. The server transmits a power outage notification when no keepalive packets are received for at least a defined time period after the fault packet is received. The server transmits a power restoration notification when one or more keepalive packets are subsequently received.
assignees: WHISKER LABS INC

title_en: Optimal recovery path based on distributed power supply and black start strategy
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of operation control of an electric power system, and particularly relates to an optimal recovery path and a black start strategy based on a distributed power supply. The invention comprises the following steps: based on the distributed power supply, the performance and the distribution of important loads of the distributed power supply are considered, and the power distribution network is subjected to island division; providing an improved mathematical model of the island division; realizing an island division strategy by using a power supply recovery sequence optimal method; performing recovery path optimization calculation on the distributed power supply to make the recovery path of the distributed power supply shortest; and optimizing the load recovery path by utilizing the load recovery sequence of the improved hybrid particle swarm algorithm to obtain a global black start strategy. The method can obviously improve the success rate and the recovery efficiency of the black start, recover as many important loads as possible, increase the recovery amount of the total load, and ensure that the island after power supply recovery can stably operate.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Fire mitigation and downed conductor detection systems and methods
abstract_en: A transformer monitoring device has one or more voltage sensors and/or one or more current sensors integral with a housing for detecting voltage and/or current of a power cable of a transformer. The transformer monitoring device can be configured to monitor voltage data, current data, voltage imbalance, phase angle, outage detection and restoration detection, and/or transformer temperature changes, etc., and cause alerts to be issued directly and/or by a remote central computing device if voltage levels drop and/or spike beyond operator-established tolerance(s), and/or if transformer temperature changes occur outside of operator-established tolerance(s), and/or if a power outage or power restoration occurs, and/or if voltage imbalance occurs, along with additional alert messaging capabilities to be provided by the transformer monitoring device where utility operator personnel would find value. The transformer monitoring device further has one or more onboard, and/or external wired and/or wireless environmental and/or transformer conditions sensor(s) and/or sensor packs, including a smoke sensor, ambient temperature sensor, external transformer temperature sensor, a fire/wildfire sensor (e.g., infrared camera, etc.), a humidity sensor, a noxious gases sensor, a nuclear radiation sensor, a seismic or vibration sensor, and/or a surface and/or ground temperature sensor (e.g., infrared camera, etc.) configured to detect smoke, and/or temperature change indicators, and/or other environmental changes in an area surrounding the transformer and/or associated with the transformer, and a processor configured to monitor the smoke sensor, temperature sensors, and/or other environmental change sensors, and/or associated transformer sensors; the processor being configured to transmit data indicative of conditions concerning the transformer and/or surrounding the transformer, and/or issue an alert or critical alert if certain smoke, temperature and/or other environmental conditions are detected surrounding the transformer and/or occurring at or near the transformer. The transformer monitoring device, when used for voltage drops and/or voltage spikes monitoring or detection indicative of broken, down, and/or faulty conductors (e.g., high-impedance faults), and/or when coupled with one or more environmental surroundings sensors (i.e., internal and/or external to the transformer monitoring device), wired and/or wirelessly coupled to the transformer monitoring device, and/or for monitoring transformer and/or intra-grid conditions, becomes a fire mitigation device. The fire mitigation device(s) is used singly or in aggregate to help detect public safety events and/or fire/wildfire conditions, and/or to provide event prevention data to utility operators. When used in aggregate, the fire mitigation devices serve to create an electric distribution grid and/or environmental surroundings monitoring solution. The added implementation of alerts and critical alert messages, in combination with or separately from event prevention data, help to facilitate accelerated awareness and response efforts by operators, first responders, and/or authorities concerning present and/or emerging public safety events and/or fires/wildfires, separately and/or in addition to useful event prevention information.
assignees: GRID20/20 INC

title_en: Precipitation management and control system suitable for ecological environment restoration of mine is administered
abstract_en: The invention discloses a precipitation control system suitable for restoration and treatment of mine ecological environment, which comprises a plurality of precipitation control units arranged step by step from high to low according to mountain ranges, wherein adjacent precipitation control units are connected through a drainage facility to realize step by step water storage, each precipitation control unit comprises a slag water storage body, the slag water storage bodies are positioned between a hill face and a water control diversion dam, the water control diversion dam enables residual water after the slag water storage bodies are saturated to flow to a next precipitation control unit and a mine platform on the other side through the drainage facility, planting ridge platforms arranged transversely are arranged on the ground surface of each slag water storage body at intervals, the table surfaces of the planting ridge platforms are of inward inclined structures, enclosing ridges are arranged at the edges of the mine platforms, and grid-shaped slag reduction ridges are arranged in the inner side areas of the enclosing ridges, and grass and wood vegetation is planted between the slag reduction ridges. The invention can reduce water and soil loss and natural disasters of debris flow, improve the utilization rate of natural rainfall and is suitable for the technical field of mine ecological environment restoration.

title_en: Hydroelectric power plant control device and method
abstract_en: To suppress the congestion of a rising speed of a main machine at an activation restart with a stop operation when a water level of a river reaches a flood water level, and an activation restart operation when the water level of the river is restored to a water acquisition restart water level, and to remarkably alleviate restoration work.SOLUTION: Tilt control means 33 stops a main machine 19 after performing a tilt operation for repeatedly performing opening/closing operations of a guide vane of a water turbine several times at which a water level of a river reaches a flood water level, and speed-increase assist control means 34 opens the guide vane of the water turbine at which a water level of a water tank 15 reaches a full water level. The speed-increase assist control means further performs a speed rise assist for excessively opening the guide vane of the water turbine if the main machine 19 is not raised in a speed up to a synchronization speed within a prescribed time, a generator is consolidated to a power system when the main machine 19 is raised in the speed up to the synchronization speed, and the main machine is stopped if the generator cannot be consolidated to the power system even if repeatedly performing the speed increase assist operations several times.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: TOKYO ELECTRIC GENERATION CO INC

title_en: Self-service big data multistage closed loop restoration method and device for power enterprise
abstract_en: The invention relates to a self-service big data multistage closed loop repairing method for a power enterprise, which comprises the following steps: the data acquisition is carried out in a data acquisition mode according to time intervals, abnormal data identification is carried out by adopting a threshold value method, the captured abnormal data is subjected to partition repair, so that the repair work of the abnormal data is converted into a multi-stage closed loop mode, and the system performance of repairing various data is realized. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the abnormal data identification module is optimized, a data calculation threshold value is set, abnormal data identification is achieved according to a smooth estimation threshold value algorithm, the repair grade is set according to the data type in data repair according to the data partition calculation process, the multi-stage closed-loop data repair process is completed by combining the traditional data repair technology, and the data repair integrity and the data bearing capacity are improved.
assignees: DONGGUAN POWER BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Energy-consuming and beam-falling preventing device for metal pipe for railway bridge
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a beam device is prevented falling in tubular metal resonator power consumption for railway bridges contains the bottom plate, be equipped with the spacing groove on the bottom plate, the limiting groove is equipped with the power consumption subassembly, the power consumption subassembly contains the tubular metal resonator of a plurality of interconnect, vertical setting is all followed to the tubular metal resonator, the one end of power consumption subassembly connect in the tip one of spacing groove, the other end connect in the movable component, the movable component with the interval of the tip two of spacing groove is adjustable. The device has scientific and simple structural design, convenient processing and convenient installation, adopts the cross section direction of the metal pipe as the tension-compression deformation energy dissipation direction, is favorable for improving the stability of deformation, ensures the effectiveness of continuous energy dissipation, can obviously improve the anti-seismic performance of the anti-falling beam to the bridge structure, protects the bridge structure from earthquake damage, and is beneficial to restoration after earthquake.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY ERYUAN ENG GROUP

title_en: Smooth slope vegetation building device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a device is built to level and smooth domatic vegetation relates to side slope vegetation recovery technical field, including domatic base member, planting weak soil has been laid at domatic base member's top, the side slope protection network has been laid at the top of planting weak soil, the top of side slope protection network is provided with the backup pad that the equidistance was arranged, the solid fixed ring of the equal fixedly connected with in the left and right sides of backup pad. The utility model discloses a, through the level and smooth domatic planting weak soil and the side slope protection network of laying of domatic base member, make the spray-seeding substrate adhere to at level and smooth domatic more easily, it is difficult for receiving the precipitation influence to plant the weak soil, cause the circumstances such as soil erosion and water loss, landslide, two adjacent backup pads can be pegged graft to the socket in by the limiting plate in to reach the effect that makes the limiting plate compress tightly the side slope protection network, and then make the side slope protection network difficult because rainwater influences distortion, make grass seeds and vegetation can stably grow, be favorable to the ecological restoration of side slope.
assignees: BEIJING SHOUFA TIANREN ECOLOGICAL LANDSCAPE CO LTD

title_en: River ecological flow regulation and control method based on pollution condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a river ecological flow regulation and control method based on pollution conditions, which comprises the following steps: acquiring satellite remote sensing image data and ground monitoring value data of a river, and processing the data to obtain water flow characteristic data, historical large-section data and flow data of the regional river; analyzing the water flow characteristic data, the historical large-section data and the flow data, and eliminating useless data; the online river flow is comprehensively analyzed and calculated by acquiring water level height, flow velocity data and section information in real time according to water flow characteristic data, historical large section data and flow data and combining the positions of the upper and lower reaches and the left and right bank test stations. The method can effectively identify the river flow velocity, can conveniently and accurately adjust the river flow velocity, can effectively ensure the normal water supply of the river, maintains the health of a river ecosystem, provides technical support for the restoration and protection of the ecological health of the river, and has good economic and social benefits.
assignees: LANTOGIS ECOLOGICAL TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Fault rate evaluation method and device for power line under typhoon disaster condition
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for evaluating the fault rate of a power line under a typhoon disaster condition, and particularly aims to obtain static information of a power grid and dynamic information of typhoon; performing space-time forecast on typhoon based on the dynamic information; and evaluating the fault rate of the power grid based on the static information and the forecasting result of the time-space forecasting to obtain the total fault rate of the power grid. By obtaining the total failure rate of the power grid under the typhoon disaster condition, objective basis can be provided for subsequent repair and power restoration.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Visual management system for drainage pipe network detection data
abstract_en: The utility model provides a visual management system of drainage pipe network detection data, includes data import module, data storage module, map module, data query module, data display module and cost estimation module, the data import module imports drainage pipe network detection data, data storage module has a plurality of pipe network attribute field bars of establishing, the map module calls the pipe network coordinate parameter of storage in data storage module, with the position of pipe network facility like the show, data query module looks over the various basic information and the detection information of pipeline section through condition inquiry or fuzzy inquiry according to different field information, data display module is used for showing the attribute information and the defect information of pipe network, cost estimation module is used for assessing the restoration and the maintenance cost of pipe network defect. The system can automatically import detection videos and defect results, generate a drainage network detection data dynamic database, ensure the accuracy of the data and have good visual display capacity.
assignees: NORTH CHINA MUNICIPAL ENG DESIGN & RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Power tool acquisition method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses an electric power tool acquisition method, an electric power tool acquisition device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring line fault information, and determining target emergency repair work content according to the line fault information; determining electric power tool information related to the target emergency repair work content according to the target emergency repair work content; and determining a target power tool container from the candidate power tool containers according to the power tool information, so as to obtain the power tool from the target power tool container. By operating the technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention, the problem that after a fault occurs, emergency repair personnel often select the tools and the appliances by experience, and the situations of selecting the tools and the appliances in a missing way and selecting the tools in a wrong way often occur in a hurry, so that the tools and the appliances are returned to be taken in the emergency repair process, and the overall progress of emergency repair and power restoration work is seriously influenced can be solved, and the effect of improving the efficiency and the accuracy of obtaining the electric tools and the appliances can be realized.
assignees: MEIZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Recovery improvement method for electricity-gas comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recovery improvement method of an electricity-gas comprehensive energy system. Establishing a network structure topological model of the electricity-gas comprehensive energy system; determining an initial system operation state under an electric-gas integrated energy system network structure topological model; establishing an electric-gas comprehensive energy system recovery sequence optimization model; and processing according to the recovery sequence to obtain the recovery force parameter of the electric-gas integrated energy system, obtaining the recovery condition of the electric-gas integrated energy system, and judging according to the recovery condition to implement improvement. The method can obtain the recovery sequence of the electric power line and the natural gas pipeline after the large-range fault of the electric-gas comprehensive energy system, guide system constructors to repair the electric power line and the natural gas pipeline according to the obtained recovery sequence, and quickly recover the electric power load and the natural gas load in the system, thereby effectively improving the overall recovery capability of the electric-gas comprehensive energy system.

title_en: Computing method and computing system for black start restoration network in zone
abstract_en: The invention discloses a calculation method and a calculation system for a black start recovery network in a zone, which utilize a constructed energy function to determine an optimal network among all units during black start, and naturally consider constraint that the reactive power absorption capacity of a black start power supply is larger than that of capacitive reactive power in a mode of minimizing line reactive power. The optimal starting network can be obtained quickly by solving the differential equation set, and a linear programming tool is not needed, so that a new method is provided for solving the starting network.

title_en: Method for determining ecological water demand of anti-season lake
abstract_en: A method for determining ecological water demand of an anti-season lake comprises the steps of firstly, respectively determining a key month of the ecological water demand of the anti-season lake and a water level variation range of the key month for a germination period of aquatic plants, a growth diffusion period of aquatic plants and a mature period of the aquatic plants. Then, for the key months, the relationship between the water level and the area of the aquatic plants is respectively established, and the relationship between the water level and the area of the water bird habitat is established according to the requirement of protecting the water birds on the habitat. And finally, determining the ecological water demand of each key month according to a relation curve of the water level and the area of the water bird habitat. The method aims at the special water level change mode of the anti-season lake, takes the requirement of protecting the habitat of waterfowls as a core, obtains the ecological water demand of the anti-season lake in a key month, and has important theoretical and practical significance for water resource management and ecological protection and restoration of the anti-season lake.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING NORMAL

title_en: Online evaluation method for line availability in power grid restoration process based on protection information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a line availability online evaluation method in a power grid recovery process based on protection information. The method can acquire the availability probability of the power transmission line in real time, is not limited by the complexity of natural disasters causing power grid blackout, can meet the requirement of decision support in the recovery process of the power system, and ensures the rapid and efficient recovery of the power grid and the load.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHAANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: Connecting structure of curtain wall for earthquake resistant
title_ko: 커튼월의 내진 연결구조
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an earthquake-resistant connection structure of a curtain wall installed at a connection portion between a vertical portion and a horizontal portion of the curtain wall, comprising: a pad portion coupled to the vertical portion to buffer between the vertical portion and the horizontal portion; a connecting portion for connecting the horizontal portion to the pad portion; a fixing portion engaged with the pad portion and fixing and supporting the pad portion in the vertical portion; and a fitting portion for fixing by fitting the connecting portion. Therefore, the present invention provides a buffer in an event of an earthquake by installing the pad portion and the connecting portion at the connection portion between the vertical portion and the horizontal portion, thereby simplifying an earthquake-resistant connection work of the curtain wall, and at the same time improving the earthquake-resistant performance and restoration performance, and providing the effect of improving watertightness and airtightness.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 커튼월의 수직부와 수평부 사이의 연결부위에 설치되는 커튼월의 내진 연결구조에 관한 것으로서, 수직부에 결합되어, 수직부와 수평부 사이를 완충하는 패드부와,이  패드부에 수평부를 연결시키는 연결부와, 패드부에 걸어맞춤되어 패드부를 수직부에 고정지지하는 고정부와, 연결부를 끼워맞춤 결합하여 고정시키는 끼움부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 따라서 본 발명은 수직부와 수평부 사이의 연결부위에 패드부와 연결부를 설치하여 지진시 완충함으로써, 커튼월의 내진 연결작업을 단순화하는 동시에 내진성능 및 복원성능을 향상시키고 수밀성 및 기밀성을 향상시킬 수 있는 효과를 제공한다.
assignees: UNIQUESYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Connecting structure of curtain wall for earthquake resistant
title_ko: 커튼월의 내진 연결구조
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an earthquake proof connecting structure of a curtain wall installed at a connection portion between a vertical part and a horizontal part of the curtain wall, comprising: a fixing unit fixedly coupled to a side surface of one side of the vertical part; a first rotating unit supported at one end of the fixing unit to be able to rotate; a second rotating unit supported at the other end of the fixing unit to be able to rotate; a first rotating support unit supporting the first rotating unit to be able to rotate the first rotating unit; and a second rotating support unit supporting the second rotating unit to be able to rotate the second rotating unit. Therefore, the present invention is provided with the fixing unit, the rotating units and the rotating support units at the connection portion between the vertical part and the horizontal part, thereby simplifying an earthquake proof connecting work of the curtain wall, simultaneously enhancing earthquake proof performance and restoration performance, and enhancing the watertight and airtight properties.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 커튼월의 수직부와 수평부 사이의 연결부위에 설치되는 커튼월의 내진 연결구조에 관한 것으로서, 수직부의 일방 측면에 고정 결합되는 고정부와, 이 고정부의 일단에 회전가능하게 지지되는 제1 회전부와, 고정부의 타단에 회전가능하게 지지되는 제2 회전부와, 제1 회전부를 회전가능하게 지지하는 제1 회전지지부와, 제2 회전부를 회전가능하게 지지하는 제2 회전지지부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 따라서 본 발명은 수직부와 수평부 사이의 연결부위에 고정부와 회전부와 회전지지부를 구비함으로써, 커튼월의 내진 연결작업을 단순화하는 동시에 내진성능 및 복원성능을 향상시키고 수밀성 및 기밀성을 향상시킬 수 있는 효과를 제공한다.
assignees: UNIQUESYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Associating security tags to continuous data protection checkpoints/snapshots/point-in-time images
abstract_en: An in-guest agent in a virtual machine (VM) operates in conjunction with a replication module. The replication module performs continuous data protection (CDP) by saving images of the VM as checkpoints at a disaster recovery site over time. Concurrently, the in-guest agent monitors for behavior in the VM that may be indicative of the presence of malicious code. If the in-guest agent identifies behavior (at a particular point in time) at the VM that may be indicative of the presence of malicious code, the replication module can tag a checkpoint that corresponds to the same particular point in time as a security risk. One or more checkpoints generated prior to the particular time may be determined to be secure checkpoints that are usable for restoration of the VM.
assignees: VMWARE INC

title_en: Water burst disaster treatment system and method suitable for crack development side slope
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for treating water burst disaster of a crack development side slope, wherein the system comprises the following components: the crack development slope, the drainage groove, and the liquid guide hole, the liquid seepage hole and the drainage hole which are arranged in the slope; a curing layer, a matrix layer and a vegetable layer are laid on the slope surface of the fracture development slope and used for slope surface reinforcement, water plugging and ecological restoration; the liquid guide holes are positioned at the water seepage position at the upper part of the crack development side slope and are arranged in parallel with the slope surface, liquid guide pipes are arranged in the liquid guide holes, and small liquid guide holes are distributed on the surface of each liquid guide pipe; the liquid seepage holes are arranged along the direction vertical to the slope surface, a liquid seepage pipe is arranged in the liquid seepage holes, and liquid seepage small holes are distributed on the surface of the liquid seepage pipe; the drainage grooves are arranged along the slope toe at the water seepage position of the crack development slope, the side surface is provided with drainage holes which obliquely extend upwards to the inner part of the slope surface, drainage pipes are arranged in the drainage holes, and small drainage holes are distributed on the surfaces of the drainage pipes; and (4) pouring microorganism curing liquid into the liquid guide pipe to cure the slope toe and the shallow layer of the slope. The invention has the characteristics of low cost, strong applicability and environmental protection.
assignees: NORTH CHINA INST AEROSPACE ENGINEERING

title_en: Automatic restoration smoke detector with timing function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic restore smoke and feel detector with timing function, feel the detector body, spray mechanism, warning mechanism and fixed establishment including automatic restoration smoke, the timer is installed to the inboard of automatic restoration smoke and feel the detector body, and one side of timer is provided with the circuit, the protecting box is installed in the outside of circuit, and one side of protecting box installs the pivot, and one side welding of pivot has the guard gate simultaneously, spray the mechanism and install in the below of automatic restoration smoke and feel the detector body, and spray the equal screwed connection in both sides of mechanism and have the mount. This automatic repair smoke detector with timing function sprays the mechanism through setting up, is favorable to carrying out effectual control effect to the source of smog like this, uses through the controller when smog reaches certain concentration through the timer to spray the mechanism and spray the source, has avoided the potential safety hazard that the further diffusion of the burning things which may cause of a fire disaster in source leads to, has improved the practicality and the security of device like this.
assignees: SUZHOU NABEISI SECURITY INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Retaining wall with mine vegetation restoration hollow brick structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a hollow brick structure barricade is restoreed to mine vegetation belongs to mine vegetation restoration construction technical field. The technical scheme of the utility model is that: the retaining wall (1) with the hollow brick structure is built on a side slope (7) of a strip mine stope, a vegetation culture soil layer (8) is spread on the retaining wall (1) with the hollow brick structure, and an environment-friendly green-covering net (9) covers the vegetation culture soil layer (8) and the retaining wall (1) with the hollow brick structure. The utility model discloses a build hollow brick structure barricade by laying bricks or stones and cover the vegetation on the mining area side slope of having mined out in the open stope, draw materials on the spot, simple structure builds by laying bricks or stones the convenience, does not influence production, does benefit to environmental protection, effectively changes the ecological environment in mine open stope, resumes the mining area vegetation, reduces soil erosion and water loss, alleviates geological disasters and threatens, has guaranteed the safety in production in mine.
assignees: HEBEI IRON & STEEL GROUP MINING CO LTD

title_en: Ecological space optimization and function improvement method for river wetland
