abstract_en: The invention provides an ecological space optimization and function improvement method for a river wetland, and belongs to the technical field of river treatment. Determining and analyzing the space structure of the current river to obtain the area proportion occupied by different river structures; determining the flow capacity of the river and analyzing the current flood discharge capacity of the river; on the basis of the section of the river channel, taking an earthwork balance principle, flood carrying capacity and beach water flooding duration and depth as calculation bases, analyzing by using a dichotomy, respectively determining the excavation position of the river channel, the excavation depth, a vertical dredging space and a dredging volume, and optimizing a river beach wetland; and analyzing the space structure area, the proportion condition and the ecological space change of the river channel before and after optimization respectively, and evaluating the ecological space optimization scheme of the river channel. The invention optimizes and treats the cross section of the river based on the comprehensive consideration of the structure and the function of the river system, realizes the improvement of the ecological function and the environmental optimization of the river, and provides references for the restoration protection and the function improvement of the river wetland in China and the flood control and disaster reduction of the area.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Aeration control system for river ecological restoration and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an aeration control system for river ecological restoration and a control method thereof, wherein the system comprises a sensing module, a control module and an aeration module, the sensing module is used for collecting river basic data of four dimensions of river profile, river water quality, river hydrodynamic force and river biology, and the control module is used for analyzing and processing the data collected by the sensing module, converting the data into parameters for controlling the aeration module and sending control signals to the aeration module. The method comprises the steps of acquiring data of four dimensions, preprocessing the input data by a control module, inputting the preprocessed input data into a neural network model, and calculating a target value of river restoration through aeration; starting an aeration module, monitoring the aeration condition of the river in real time, and maintaining the dissolved oxygen concentration of the river at an expected level; and stopping aeration and informing managers until the current situation of the river reaches the target value of the aeration repair river obtained by the neural network model. The invention reduces the energy consumption of the aeration equipment on the premise of ensuring the aeration effect.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Power distribution network fault emergency repair dispatching-fault recovery coordination method and device
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of fault self-healing, and provides a distribution network fault emergency repair dispatching-fault recovery cooperative method and a distribution network fault emergency repair dispatching-fault recovery cooperative device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: coordinating a fault emergency repair scheduling scheme and a fault recovery scheme, taking the master-slave relation of decision variables of the fault emergency repair scheduling scheme and the fault recovery scheme into consideration, modeling by adopting a two-layer planning theory, taking control variables of an upper-layer planning model as a fault emergency repair scheme, constructing a target function by taking the minimized power loss load loss and the repair time into consideration, considering geographical constraints of the repair scheme, and meeting necessary constraint conditions such as constraints on repair resources and time; the lower-layer planning model takes a fault recovery scheme as a decision maker, takes the minimized power loss load loss as a target function, and takes necessary constraint conditions such as network radial constraint, node voltage constraint, fault recovery and emergency repair progress coordination constraint and the like into consideration. And solving the optimal scheme by adopting a particle swarm algorithm design model, thereby improving the efficiency of fault emergency repair and reducing the loss of power load under the fault state of the distribution network system.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Quick-diversion mine side slope restoration net fence structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a rapid diversion mine side slope restoration net fence structure, which comprises a main body and a diversion frame, wherein the diversion frame is embedded in the top end of the main body; the main part is including water drainage tank, the water catch bowl, inflow groove and lift groove, the reposition of redundant personnel frame is including the flow groove, the lift wheel, embedding ring sum rotation axis, the embedding ring is including the reset block, the rotation axis is including rotating groove and compression tank, the device is provided with the reposition of redundant personnel frame, can guide rivers through the reposition of redundant personnel frame and shunt and reduce its impact force, then discharge rivers through the surface of its net fence for can not direct contact slope surface cause the landslide when its rainwater flows.
assignees: Mao Shushu

title_en: Plant-growing soil concrete suitable for slope ecological restoration engineering and construction method
abstract_en: The invention provides vegetation soil concrete suitable for side slope ecological restoration engineering and a construction method, and relates to the technical field of ecological slope protection. The plant-growing soil concrete suitable for the slope ecological restoration project is prepared by weighing the following raw materials in parts by weight: 300 parts of C10 cement, 8-9.5 parts of SR enhancer, 1650 parts of rubble, 130 parts of water and 7-8 parts of A-B bacteria, wherein the rubble is fine stone which passes through a 100-mesh sieve, and the C10 cement is pozzolanic silicate PI42.5 cement. According to the invention, the SR enhancer and the A-B bacteria are arranged, so that the strength of the vegetation soil concrete is high, slope protection is convenient to realize, the nylon net and the steel wire net which are arranged in a double-layer manner are used, so that the vegetation soil concrete is high in condensation strength, the landslide is not easy to occur, the hydrophobic air permeability is good, the growth of green plants is facilitated, the phenomenon that the green plants cannot grow due to excessive concrete drying is avoided, the green plant coverage rate of the slope protection is greatly increased, and the construction cost of the slope protection is lower.
assignees: HEBEI PROVINCIAL GEOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT MONITORING INSTITUTE HEBEI GEOLOGICAL DISASTER EMERGENCY TEC

title_en: Disaster prevention interlocking system
abstract_en: To enable effectively utilizing system-interlocking by which simultaneous unlocking is performed for fire reception by reducing the simultaneous unlocking of an entry and exit management system interlocked with a non-fire alarm of a fire alarm system.SOLUTION: A fire receiver 14 transmits an information transfer signal to an entry and exit control panel 26 when receiving a fire signal via re-notifying of a fire sensor 16 after a predetermined time elapses from restoration by temporarily cutting off a power supply to the fire sensor 16 giving notice thereof for the restoration after the predetermined time elapses, when outputting a fire alarm by receiving the fire signal via notification of the fire sensor 16. The entry and exit control panel 26 simultaneously unlocks electric locks 30 of all doors when receiving the transfer signal transmitted by the fire receiver 14.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: HOCHIKI CO

title_en: Data processing system, data processor, portable terminal device, and program
abstract_en: To provide a sales data processing system, a sales data processor, a portable terminal device, and a program that can continue coordinated operation during a power outage period.SOLUTION: A sales data processing system includes: a sales data processor that can continue to operate with a standby power supply in the event of an external power outage and that processes sales data for commercial transactions; and a portable terminal device that can be operated by an internal power supply and that makes a first communication connection with the sales data processor via a predetermined relay communication device. The sales data processor and the portable terminal device initiate a second communication connection by direct wireless communication without intervention of the relay communication device when the first communication connection is disconnected due to the cessation of external power supply to the relay communication device, and resumes the first communication connection via the relay communication device when the sales data processor detects the restoration of power supply after the start of the second communication connection.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6
assignees: CASIO COMPUTER CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic suspension of network operations by root for improved power outage recovery in low power and lossy network
abstract_en: In one embodiment, a method comprises: detecting, by a root network device in a low power and lossy network (LLN) operating in a downward-routing mode, an outage among at least a substantial number of LLN devices in the LLN; initiating, by the root network device, a dynamic suspension of network operations in the LLN during the outage, including causing existing Internet Protocol (IP) addresses of all the LLN devices to be maintained during the outage, and causing all the LLN devices to limit transmissions to Power Outage Notification (PON) messages, Power Restoration Notification (PRN) messages, or minimal-bandwidth data packets, based on the root network device switching the LLN from the downward-routing mode to a collection-only mode; and selectively restoring, by the root network device, the LLN to the downward-routing mode in response to detecting PRN messages from at least substantially all the substantial number of LLN devices.
assignees: CISCO TECH INC

title_en: Landslide body side slope ecological restoration structure and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide mass side slope ecological restoration structure and a restoration method, comprising the following steps: a plurality of water reservoirs are arranged and dug on the slope surface of the landslide body; the bottom rock layer is formed by large rocks paved on a flat ground at the slope bottom of the landslide body; the geotextile is laid on the surface of the bottom rock layer; the drainage pipes are arranged on the geotextile, are horizontally and uniformly arranged along the direction vertical to the landslide body, a water suction pump is arranged at a water outlet of each reservoir, water guide pipes are connected to two ends of each water suction pump, the other ends of the water guide pipes are connected with the drainage pipes, and finally, an upper rock layer is formed by small rocks laid above the drainage pipes, and the steel reinforcement framework is arranged by penetrating through the upper rock layer; the geocell foreign soil cultivation layer is arranged on the upper rock layer; the slope ecological restoration structure and the slope ecological restoration method disclosed by the invention have a good slope ecological restoration effect.
assignees: NORTHWEST INSTITUTE ECO ENVIRONMENT & RESOURCES CAS

title_en: Slope ecological restoration method
abstract_en: The invention provides a slope ecological restoration method, which specifically comprises the following steps: (1) leveling the top end of the side slope after cleaning the side slope; (2) building a drainage groove at the upper end of the side slope, and building a gentle belt between the drainage groove and the side slope; (3) paving meshes on the side slope, and carrying out compound organic matter spray seeding; (4) digging planting holes on the side slope, and planting climbing plants in an embedded mode. The slope ecological restoration method is a slope ecological restoration method for planting customized climbing plants in an embedded mode after compound organic matters are sprayed and sown, and has the advantages of preventing landslide and water and soil loss and guaranteeing evergreen slope bodies in winter.
assignees: QINGDAO ZHONGYUANYE ECOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Program and restoration planning support device
abstract_en: To support restoration planning for quickly restoring transportation capacity when failure occurs in a transportation network such as a railway network due to the occurrence of disaster.SOLUTION: A draft plan relating to devoting resources for complete restoration in all failure sections of a transportation network is calculated so that a sum total of amounts of transportation loss which cannot be handled, of transportation OD data satisfies a prescribed minimum condition. The transportation OD data is determined by, until the all failure sections are completely restored, determining a restoration level of each failure section in each day as a result of devoting resources in accordance with the draft plan so that the sum total of amounts of resources devoted to the failure sections in each day is equal to or smaller than an upper limit amount of resources to be devoted, and calculating an anticipated amount of handled results obtained by applying transportation OD data before the occurrence of a disaster, on the basis of an upper limit amount of transportation determined in accordance with the restoration level.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3
assignees: RAILWAY TECHNICAL RES INST

title_en: Concrete precast segment assembly spraying concrete reinforcing soil tank
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a concrete precast segment is assembled and is spouted concrete and consolidate soil box mainly is applicable to high abrupt slope ecological restoration management such as mine, quarry, belongs to the environmental protection technology field. The technical proposal of the utility model is as follows: the mountain rock 5 is punched, and the punching depth is 25 cm; one side of the fixed rib 3 is embedded in the concrete precast slab 1, and the other side is fixed at the punching position; the concrete precast slabs 1 are closely arranged, concrete walls 4 are sprayed on the outer sides and between gaps, and the total thickness of the sprayed concrete walls 4 is 10 cm; and nutrient planting soil 2 is arranged between the concrete precast slab 1 and the mountain rock 5. The utility model discloses by a wide margin reduction ecological remediation's cost, simple and easy rapid construction, it is fast to take effect, has not only controlled further destruction of ecological environment, and geological disasters have also obtained effectual improvement simultaneously.
assignees: THE SECOND GEOLOGICAL BRIGADE OF HEBEI BUREAU OF GEOLOGY AND MINERAL RESOURCES;LI XIAOFENG

title_en: Frame slant power consumption strutting arrangement
abstract_en: The application discloses frame slant power consumption strutting arrangement includes: the energy-consuming device comprises a frame body, a plurality of supporting bodies arranged on the frame body and an energy-consuming assembly used for connecting the supporting bodies; the support bodies are obliquely arranged on the frame body, and the two support bodies are oppositely arranged and connected through the energy dissipation assembly; the energy consumption subassembly just includes: the connecting pieces are respectively arranged at one ends of the two supporting bodies, and the energy dissipation pieces are arranged on the connecting pieces; the two connecting pieces are oppositely arranged, the free ends of the two connecting pieces are hinged with each other, and the energy dissipation piece is used for connecting the end parts of the two supporting bodies, or the energy dissipation piece is used for connecting the end parts of the two connecting pieces. The concrete frame structure adopts a node form, is simple to assemble and is convenient for connection of supports in the concrete frame structure; the earthquake energy can be effectively absorbed during the earthquake, the horizontal connecting rod and the energy dissipation component are convenient to replace after the earthquake, the restoration after the earthquake is easy, and the reinforcement of the building after the earthquake is convenient.
assignees: UNIV HEBEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Game machine
abstract_en: To simplify display control processing in a game machine.SOLUTION: A power outage restoration screen 1201 is the screen display that is constituted by at least a display layer L1 for displaying an error notification screen, a display layer L2 for displaying a power outage restoration screen and a display layer L5 including a small pattern group 502, a special pattern 1 reservation number display 503 and a special pattern 2 reservation number display 504 as display contents, the display layer L2 is arranged in front of the display layer L5, and the display layer L1 is arranged in front of the display layer L2. A performance control device generates the image display of the small pattern group 502, the special pattern 1 reservation number display 503 and the special pattern 2 reservation number display 504 even in a state where observation cannot be performed on the power outage restoration screen 1201. The error notification screen on the display layer L1 may be displayed even after switching to a customer-waiting demonstration screen, a variable display screen, and a win screen since it is displayed independently of the power outage restoration screen.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 185
assignees: SOPHIA CO LTD

title_en: Mechanical embedded fire sprinkler head
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mechanical embedded fire-fighting spray header which comprises a shell, wherein the top end of the shell and the bottom end of a water receiving pipe are integrally formed, a sliding mechanism is installed at the top end of a temperature sensing system, second sliding blocks are fixedly connected to the bottom ends of a plurality of second connecting rods, the outer walls of the second sliding blocks are in sliding sleeve joint with a supporting frame, and a plurality of clamping mechanisms are evenly installed on the lower surface of the inner side of a top cover. This embedded type fire sprinkler of mechanical type, carry out the temperature perception through temperature sensing system, and make in heat transfer to the heat-sensitive material in the splash box, make the heat-sensitive material take place the phase transition when the temperature reaches the target threshold value, make the water receiving pipe open, the fire-fighting water is through water receiving pipe and splash box contact, and the splash is to all around, realize the fire control operation, whole mechanism is lossless except that the fire-fighting water in the course of the work, after the fire control operation is accomplished, upwards promote the support frame, make fixture block and third slide bar looks joint, can realize whole mechanism's restoration, so that reuse.
assignees: GAO HUANBAO

title_en: Intelligent power grid fault handling system and method based on knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid fault intelligent disposal system based on a knowledge graph, wherein a fault disposal plan analysis module of the system is used for acquiring fault disposal entities and relation knowledge; the map generation module is used for storing the identified entity and the entity relation in a triple form to obtain an equipment entity knowledge map, an accident plan knowledge map and a disposal process knowledge map; the fault perception module intelligently perceives and collects information related to the power grid fault in the power grid system; the fault risk evaluation module is used for carrying out risk identification; the intelligent fault handling module is used for reasoning out handling measures suitable for the current fault based on the accident plan knowledge graph and the handling process knowledge graph and by combining topological changes before and after the power grid fault, the power flow and the alternating current power supply frequency after the power grid has the line fault. The comprehensive intelligent alarm system can sense comprehensive intelligent alarm information in an all-round way, and guides dispatching personnel to perform intelligent treatment on power grid risks and power restoration based on the established knowledge graph.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA POWER GROUP CO LTD ULANQAB ELECTRIC POWER BUREAU

title_en: Code semantic analysis-based electric power information system safety protection method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a power information system safety protection method and device based on code semantic analysis, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting operation codes and related operation state information of a power grid information system, and extracting information of key information; performing lexical analysis and grammar analysis on the collected key information to obtain an abstract grammar tree; judging and detecting the code logic of the preprocessed abstract syntax tree according to a preset security model, and identifying code holes; and according to the vulnerability attack behavior judgment condition, carrying out semantic restoration on the source code. The method takes the function as an entry point for attack monitoring, detects the load of SQL attack through analysis processes such as lexical analysis, grammar analysis and the like, and complements the missing grammar. The method has the advantages that the possible loopholes are estimated in advance, the alarm is sent out, the common loopholes are repaired, the safety protection of the electric power information system can be effectively enhanced, the safety loopholes in the application process can be effectively found, and the information safety of the power grid is ensured.

title_en: Water environment restoration and purification device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a water purification technology field, concretely relates to purifier is restoreed to water environment, including purifying box, inlet tube and outlet pipe, the upper end through connection who purifies the box has the inlet tube, and the right-hand member through connection who purifies the box has the outlet pipe. The utility model overcomes prior art's is not enough, through carrying the conveyer trough with the water through the inlet tube in, carry out the sintering through the silt of heater to the aquatic, and the conveyer trough is slope form setting, make the silt that the sintering finishes can be rapid in transporting to depositing the mud case, it raises to have avoided in the water silt too much to make the water, the probability of taking place flood disasters scheduling problem has been reduced, transmit the heat to the metal pole through the heating rod, and the metal pole is the heliciform setting, make the area increase of heating, it leads to heating inhomogeneously to have avoided the too high accumulation of heat, thereby produce the dry combustion method phenomenon, the holistic factor of safety of purifier has been improved, make the life-span extension of heater equipment simultaneously.
assignees: TIANJIN QIBAOLIAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network power supply recovery system and method meeting differentiated reliability requirements
abstract_en: The invention provides a power supply restoration system and a power supply restoration method for a power distribution network, which meet the requirements of differentiated reliability. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module and a database, wherein the data acquisition module and the data processing module are connected with the database. In the invention, the user power consumption data is considered in the making process of the power supply restoration measures, so that the made measures are more practical and can meet the requirements of users on the power supply reliability.

title_en: Scattering chamber type floating breakwater using pe multi-room float and balance block
title_ko: Pe 멀티룸 플로트와 중추블록을 이용한 유수실형 부방파제
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a scattering chamber-type floating breakwater using a PE multi-room float and a balance block, which is able to have no problem such as high cost, corrosion, crack, penetration of water, damage, and deterioration of the conventional floating breakwater made of steel, concrete, and FRP, introduce a unit balance block, secure a wave absorbing draft depth, introduce a wave absorbing scattering chamber in a PE assembly cross-section, maximize the performance of an enclosure unit to reduce penetrating wave, use the enclosure unit's assembly rigidity increasing effects and elastic behavior characteristics by a continuous assembly method where six surfaces of a multi-room float face each other closely, and promote wave force dispersion and member safety, comprising: an enclosure unit allowing multi-room floats with six surfaces and an inner space divided by partitions to be continuously assembled in multiple layers and multiple rows by a continuous assembly method, which allows the six surfaces face each other closely, and to float on a water surface unit and make an elastic behavior toward waves; and a central block unit installed on an upper surface of the enclosure unit and supported, and including a large number of concrete unit central blocks installed in a matrix shape to be placed in rows apart from each other, and having a movement by adapting to the elastic behavior of the enclosure unit, and maintaining the inertia draft depth and buoyancy balance. The enclosure unit and the central block unit divide functions independently from each other, and the enclosure unit on the lower side maintains the buoyancy of the floating breakwater and attenuates the wave energy. The central block unit on the upper side maintains the restoration property and secures the inertia draft depth.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 강재, 콘크리트 및 FRP를 소재로 한 기존 부방파제의 고비용성, 부식, 균열 및 침수, 파손 및 열화의 문제점이 없고 단위 중추블록을 도입하여 소파 흘수심을 확보함과 아울러 PE 조립단면 내 소파 유수실 도입을 통하여 함체부의 투과파 저감성능을 극대화하고 멀티룸 플로트의 6대면이 밀접하게 대면하는 연속조립 방식에 의한 함체부의 조립강성 증강효과와 탄성거동 특성을 활용함으로써 파력 분산성과 부재 안전성을 도모할 수 있도록 한 PE 멀티룸 플로트와 단위 중추블록을 조합한 유수실형 부방파제에 관한 것으로, 내부공간이 격벽에 의해 분할된 6면체의 멀티룸 플로트가 6대면이 밀접하게 대면하는 연속조립 방식에 의해 다층, 다열로 연속조립되어 수면부에 부유하면서 파랑에 대하여 탄성거동하도록 한 함체부; 및 상기 함체부의 상면에 놓여져 지지된 상태로 설치되되, 서로 이격을 두고 열을 지어 배치된 매트릭스 형태로 설치되어 상기 함체부의 탄성거동에 순응하여 움직임을 가지면서 관성 흘수심 및 부력평형을 유지할 수 있도록 한 다수의 콘크리트 단위 중추블록으로 이루어진 중추 블록부;를 포함하며, 상기 함체부와 중추 블록부 간에 독립적으로 기능을 분담하여, 하부의 함체부는 부방파제의 부력성 유지기능과 파랑에너지 감쇠기능을 수행하고, 상부의 중추 블록부는 복원성 유지기능 및 관성 흘수심 확보기능을 수행하도록 한 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: SCOTRA CORP

title_en: Method, system and device for detecting behavior of personnel on electric power operation site
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power operation monitoring protection, and discloses a method, a system and a device for detecting the behavior of personnel in a power operation field, wherein the method for detecting the behavior of the personnel in the power operation field comprises the following steps: collecting real-time scene images of an operation site, evaluating the illumination quality of the collected real-time scene images, and repairing and enhancing scene images with insufficient illumination and uneven illumination; detecting the real-time scene image subjected to quality restoration in real time, and marking the detected violation behavior on the real-time scene image; transmitting the detected real-time scene image to mobile terminal equipment for a safety manager to watch; and when the operator is found to have illegal behaviors, sending out alarm information. The invention has high automation degree, and once the workers with illegal behaviors are found, the sound and light alarm is carried out on the spot to persuade the related workers to leave the power distribution room and immediately inform the safety management personnel of short messages, thereby realizing the automatic detection of the illegal behaviors and saving manpower and material resources.
assignees: XIAN YONGSHENGDA ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid auxiliary decision tool based on meteorological factors
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power grid auxiliary decision devices, and relates to a power grid auxiliary decision tool based on meteorological factors, which comprises a data layer, a service component layer and an application layer; the data layer comprises a plurality of data, is communicated with the service component layer and is used for providing the data to the service component layer for comprehensive analysis and study and judgment of the data; the service component layer comprises a power grid fault characteristic identification service component, a trip circuit rapid restoration research and judgment service component, a real-time meteorological information display and equipment analysis service component and a fault comprehensive emergency auxiliary decision-making service component, and is used for fault characteristic information identification, trip information positioning, meteorological and equipment correlation analysis and fault comprehensive auxiliary decision-making result generation, and the service component layer is communicated with the application layer; the application layer comprises a plurality of display pages for viewing analysis results of the front-end operation and service component layer; through the combination of the data layer, the service component layer and the application layer, the temporary operation management and control of the power grid in disasters are facilitated.
assignees: CSG DIGITAL POWER GRID RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Preparation method of composition for ecological restoration
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a composition for ecological restoration, and relates to the technical field of ecological restoration. The preparation method of the composition for ecological restoration comprises the following specific raw materials: dry clay, animal waste, crop straws, farmyard plant ash, rotten vegetable leaves, soybean cakes, organic-organic composite flocculant, phosphogypsum and grass seeds. Through adopting common material, both acquireing easily, also can realizing the utilization of wastes material simultaneously, can also promoting the growth of grass seed, treat grass seed germination, growth back, can make naked massif or the domatic regreening of rock fast, form the bank protection lawn, both can play ecological remediation effect, also can utilize plant roots to keep soil and water simultaneously to play and prevent geological disasters such as massif landslide or mud-rock flow.
assignees: UNIV GUIZHOU NORMAL

title_en: Damping energy-consuming beam falling prevention device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a roof beam device is prevented falling by shock attenuation power consumption contains two metal damping units, metal damping unit contains at least one U type section, two stand both sides, every are located respectively to the metal damping unit connect respectively in stand and connecting plate, the deformation direction adaptation of metal damping unit the roof beam body for the moving direction of stone pad. The device has the advantages that the anti-falling beam device has remarkable damping and energy dissipation capacity, the structural form is reasonable and simple, the structural size is small, the stress of a pier is reduced, the bridge structure is protected, the post-earthquake restoration is facilitated, the secondary hard-resistance limiting capacity is realized, the direction is provided for the reconstruction of the existing bridge adopting the stone-cushioned anti-falling beam device, the application prospect is good, and the device has great significance for the construction of high-intensity areas of railway bridges in China.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY ERYUAN ENG GROUP;CHENGDU DATONG ROAD & BRIDGE COMPONENTS CO LTD;SICHUAN TIECHUANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Automatic backup method based on LVM snapshot in cloud native environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic backup method based on LVM snapshot in a cloud native environment, which comprises the steps of initializing a system into an application cluster, and creating related custom resources and a custom controller by adopting an Operator expansion mode; the user-defined controller comprises a resource backup controller, a resource restoration controller, a storage volume backup controller and a storage volume restoration controller; the resource backup controller realizes discovery and retrieval of resources to be backed up, packs and stores k8s resource objects to Hami n io, acquires an associated Pod list and generates an appointed backup PodPv; aiming at the Pod list, the storage volume backup controller realizes automatic backup based on the LVM snapshot; and the like. The advantages are that: aiming at a local storage volume with larger data volume and higher requirement on data consistency in backup operation, automation, high stability and almost real-time data synchronous backup are carried out based on an LVM snapshot technology, so that the usability and manageability are greatly improved, and the downtime of a business system and the disaster recovery cost of an application system are reduced to the greatest extent.

title_en: Game machine
abstract_en: To simplify display control processing in a game machine.SOLUTION: A power outage restoration screen 1201 is the screen display that is constituted by at least a display layer L1 for displaying an error notification screen, a display layer L2 for displaying a power outage restoration screen and a display layer L5 including a small pattern group 502, a special pattern 1 reservation number display 503 and a special pattern 2 reservation number display 504 as display contents, the display layer L2 is arranged in front of the display layer L5, and the display layer L1 is arranged in front of the display layer L2. A performance control device generates the image display of the small pattern group 502, the special pattern 1 reservation number display 503 and the special pattern 2 reservation number display 504 even in a state where observation cannot be performed on the power outage restoration screen 1201. The error notification screen on the display layer L1 may be displayed even after switching to a customer-waiting demonstration screen, a variable display screen, and a win screen since it is displayed independently of the power outage restoration screen.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 185
assignees: SOPHIA CO LTD

title_en: Ecological reinforcement and vegetation restoration method and system for soil slope in cold and arid desertification region
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for ecological reinforcement and vegetation restoration of soil slopes in cold and arid desertification areas. Which comprises the following steps: preparing an ecological degradable container, growing seedlings by the ecological degradable container, arranging a side slope cutting and drainage ditch, cleaning a slope surface, hanging a three-dimensional degradable net, reserving holes in the side slope ecological degradable container for punching, preparing a reinforcing material, preparing reinforced soil, spraying the reinforced soil, spraying grass seeds, placing the ecological degradable container, and maintaining the reinforced soil and vegetation. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the ecological reinforcement and vegetation restoration technology is beneficial to improving the stability of soil body and preventing the geological disasters such as side slope peeling, erosion, slumping, slope collapse, landslide and the like caused by precipitation, strong wind and sand and other factors; the influence of the adverse climate environment on the growth and development of the vegetation is reduced; the frequency and the difficulty of vegetation maintenance management in the later stage of engineering are reduced; is favorable for quickly forming richer arbor, shrub and grass vegetation community levels and improving the greening effect and landscape appearance.
assignees: SHANXI PROVINCE TRAFFIC ENVIRONMENTAL PROT CENTER STATION CO LTD

title_en: Runoff frequency spectrum similarity calculation method for quantifying sponge effect and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a runoff frequency spectrum similarity calculation method for quantifying a sponge effect, which comprises the following steps of: acquiring runoff daily value data of a long-time sequence, and generating a runoff frequency spectrum matrix to represent runoff characteristics; generating a runoff spectrogram with an X matrix and a Y matrix respectively representing a natural landform and a sponge city, and reflecting the difference of runoff characteristics; calculating the similarity of a matrix X and a matrix Y directly without calculating graph similarity, moving the flow with different accumulated frequencies in the X matrix and the Y matrix to the closest frequency position to align the accumulated frequencies of the X matrix and the Y matrix, then calculating the similarity of the aligned X matrix and the aligned Y matrix, and calculating the similarity of the aligned X matrix and the aligned Y matrix according to the contrastive difference and the water quantity weight of each group, wherein the similarity represents the nature runoff characteristic repairing degree; the runoff frequency spectrum can be used for evaluating the construction effect and optimizing the engineering scheme, and the restoration degree of the natural runoff characteristics by different development schemes is calculated respectively.
assignees: UNIV TONGJI

title_en: Protective work and protective work constructing method
abstract_en: To provide a technique to quickly construct an emergency countermeasure work at a disaster area after occurrence of disaster when conducting restoration activity and the like at a region where sediment and drift woods overflow due to a landslide disaster.SOLUTION: A protective work 1 is constructed so as to face an expected flow of debris flood and has a foundation 10 installed underground and a trapper 20 that is connected to the foundation 10 so as to be attachable and detachable and traps objects in the debris flood. The foundation 10 has a plurality of pile members 11, 13 formed of steel pipe. The trapper 20 is installed on the ground G and has column members 21, 23 and a beam member 25.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2
assignees: JFE METAL PRODUCTS & ENG INC

title_en: Slope protection structure for landscaping ecological restoration
abstract_en: The invention provides a slope protection structure for landscaping ecological restoration, which relates to the field of garden protection and aims to solve the problems that the existing slope protection structure can only dredge water overflowing from soil generally, the soil still contains a large amount of water after heavy rain, so that the soil is relatively conveyed, and the risk of landslide still exists; the front end of the flow guide mechanism is provided with a connecting mechanism; the front end of the connecting mechanism is connected with a filtering mechanism; and a fixing mechanism is arranged above the filtering mechanism. After rainstorm weather, moisture passes through water conservancy diversion spare in the hillside soil and flows the back, and remaining moisture can adsorb through adsorbing the piece, adsorbs the board that the inside capillary of piece is constituteed, can be effectual with the moisture absorption of residing among the soil and send into inside the water conservancy diversion spare, and then can be quick make soil resume appropriate amount moisture state to this avoids behind the rainstorm soil moisture too much to cause the landslide.

title_en: Power distribution system reconfigurations for multiple contingencies
abstract_en: System and method simulate power distribution system reconfigurations for multiple contingencies. Decision tree model is instantiated as a graph with nodes and edges corresponding to simulated outage states of one or more buses in the power distribution system and simulated states of reconfigurable switches in the power distribution system, Edges related to each outage are disconnected. A reconfiguration path is determined with a plurality of switches reconfigured to a closed state by an iteration of tree search algorithms. A simulation estimates feeder cable and transformer loading and bus voltages on the reconfigured path for comparing against constraints including system capacity ratings and minimum voltage. Further iterations identify additional candidate reconfiguration paths which can be ranked by total load restoration
assignees: SIEMENS CORP

title_en: Geological and geomorphic engineering restoration method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a geological and geomorphic engineering restoration method which comprises the steps of measuring the boundary of a mining pit, calculating the backfill elevation of the mining pit, backfilling muck into the mining pit, backfilling soil into the mining pit, and covering the muck with the soil. By the geological landform engineering restoration method, the mining pit is coordinated with surrounding landforms, the slope meets the vegetation greening requirement, and geological disasters are basically eliminated.
assignees: CCTEG BEIJING LAND CONSOLIDATION AND ECOLOGICAL RESTORATION TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;CCTEG ECOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENTAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for grading recovery suitability of fresh water wetland in delta region
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of wetland restoration, in particular to a method for grading the restoration suitability of fresh water wetland in delta areas, which comprises the following steps: step (1), evaluating underground water constraint conditions of a target area; step (2), evaluating the restraint conditions of the aeration zone of the target area; step (3), evaluating the target area earth surface constraint conditions; and (4) grading the suitable recovery range of the fresh water wetland in the delta region based on the underground water constraint condition, the aeration zone constraint condition and the surface constraint condition of the target region.
assignees: INST HYDROGEOLOGY & ENV GEOLOGY CAGS

title_en: Disaster restoration plan generation apparatus, disaster restoration plan generation method and program
abstract_en: A disaster recovery plan producing device produces a disaster recovery plan for at least one geographically dispersed location and includes an embedding unit which calculates, using a neural network, a feature quantity for each of the locations from input data including at least position information and a priority about the location, a plan producing unit which determines, using a neural network, an order for performing disaster recovery to the at least one location as a disaster recovery plan on the basis of the feature quantity, and a reinforcement learning unit which learns parameters of the neural network which constitutes the embedding unit and parameters of the neural network which constitutes the plan producing unit by reinforcement learning.
assignees: NIPPON TELEGRAPH & TELEPHONE

title_en: Side slope ecological restoration structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a side slope ecological remediation structure belongs to ecological restoration engineering technical field, including the prosthetic devices main part, the prosthetic devices main part includes barrier plate, connecting rod, fixed block and inserted bar, fixed connection between the top of inserted bar and the bottom of fixed block, the last fixed surface of fixed block is connected with the lower surface of connecting rod, the last fixed surface of connecting rod is connected at the lower surface of barrier plate, the fixed block includes mobile jib, auxiliary rod and injection device. The utility model discloses an injection device conveniently injects soil curing agent into the underground to improve the firm degree of soil, avoid appearing landslide, the occurrence that the rainwash leads to the soil erosion and water loss condition, thereby be favorable to the root of firm compound green vegetation, and then reach the purpose of the compound green vegetation of protection, the inserted bar can be fixed the barrier plate on soil surface, thereby form vegetation scour prevention protective layer, solved the easy problem that is erodeed and destroyed of compound green vegetation.
assignees: CHINA COAL RES INST

title_en: Space load prediction method and system for rapid power restoration after disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space load prediction method and system for rapid power restoration after disaster, which are used for determining a period T before prediction according to typhoon disaster information 1 And load prediction target period T 2 (ii) a According to the pre-prediction period T 1 And predicting the target period T 2 Acquiring load data of a power supply grid in a disaster area, wherein the load data comprises a period T before prediction 1 Real-time load data X c (T 1 ) Historical load data X of period before prediction h (T 1 ) Historical load data X of target prediction period h (T 2 ) (ii) a Based on the period T before prediction 1 Corresponding historical load data X h (T 1 ) Obtaining T by fuzzy mean clustering 1 Historical typical load curve C of time interval power supply grid h (T 1 ) And corresponding membership degree matrix U h (ii) a Clustering the result C according to the fuzzy mean h (T 1 ) And real-time load data X c (T 1 ) Construction of Pre-prediction time-Domain real-time load data X c (T 1 ) For historical typical load curve C h (T 1 ) Membership degree matrix U c (ii) a Based on membership degree matrix U h 、U c And historical load data X of the target prediction period h (T 2 ) Constructing a load X for a target time period c (T 2 ) The load of the target period is predicted.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Financial time sequence data prediction method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a financial time sequence data prediction method and a device, which can be used in the technical field of artificial intelligence, and the method comprises the following steps: obtaining a plurality of groups of financial time sequence data in the same time period and reaction time difference data among the groups of financial time sequence data; carrying out gray level transformation on each group of financial time sequence data respectively to obtain a gray level image corresponding to each group of financial time sequence data; according to the reaction time difference data, translating the gray level image corresponding to each group of financial time sequence data; sequentially sliding and selecting the time periods by using a window with a preset length, respectively capturing images of the time periods from each group of gray level images for each sub-time period, and arranging the captured images in sequence to obtain a combined image; inputting the combined images except the target image into a pre-established generation countermeasure network for training; and carrying out image restoration on the target image by using the trained generation countermeasure network, and carrying out financial time sequence data prediction. The invention can improve the prediction accuracy and reduce the error.
assignees: INDUSTRIAL & COMMERCIAL BANK OF CHINA CO LTD

title_en: Energy planning prediction method and device based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy planning prediction method and device based on a neural network, and relates to the technical field of electric power data analysis. The method utilizes the existing energy planning sample data set to train to obtain the data prediction algorithm model and the data restoration algorithm model, performs quality detection and restoration on the energy planning data to be detected through the data prediction algorithm model and the data restoration algorithm model, can improve the quality of the data, is convenient for subsequent energy planning, reduces the processing time of the data by a mode of acquiring the energy planning prediction data through the energy planning prediction model formed by the energy planning data training, reduces the labor cost, can quickly process all data, is not easy to omit the data, improves the accuracy of the energy planning information, and reduces the possibility of energy planning errors and the energy planning cost.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Multi-dimensional vulnerability risk rating method for power monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multidimensional vulnerability risk rating method for a power monitoring system, which comprises the steps of establishing a security vulnerability set, a sound asset metadata set, intelligently scanning vulnerabilities, rediscovery of new vulnerabilities, multidimensional vulnerability risk rating and the like. Compared with the traditional method, the method provided by the invention has the advantages that the functions of vulnerability autonomous thermal reproduction, thermal pudding restoration, multi-dimensional risk rating and the like are added. Has the advantages of scientific and reasonable method, strong applicability, good effect and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;INFORMATION COMMUNICATION CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV NORTHEAST ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Process method and system for intelligently generating operation order according to power grid maintenance order
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flow method for intelligently generating an operation order according to a power grid maintenance order, which comprises the following steps of: step S1, obtaining the line maintenance information of the current equipment, and maintaining the corresponding line equipment according to the maintenance list issued by the scheduling; step S2, caching the initial information of the equipment, and performing information feedback interaction with the line maintenance information of the current equipment; and step S3, judging the line maintenance state of the current equipment, and judging whether the current equipment line is a power failure ticket or a power restoration ticket. The ticket forming function of the invention mainly helps a dispatcher to quickly generate complex and repeated ticket forming operation, improves the ticket forming efficiency, generates the ticket according to a real-time state, and reduces the error rate, thereby having the advantages of improving the intelligent level of dispatching command and improving the ticket forming efficiency of complex repeated work.
assignees: FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Emergency operation and maintenance method for energy storage system in bottom-protection power grid based on disaster full period
abstract_en: According to the emergency operation and maintenance method for the energy storage system in the safety bottom power grid based on the disaster full period, firstly, the power elements and the corresponding restoration time of the regional power system, which are in failure in the disaster full period, are predicted according to the latest disaster intensity distribution information, so that the power grid state and the risk degree of the regional power system are quantified, a basis is provided for determining the response action and the restoration time of the regional power system, after the response action of the regional power system is determined, the failed power elements are restored in the corresponding restoration time, the regional power system is restored, the elasticity assessment result when the regional power system and the safety bottom power grid are affected by the disaster is determined through the elasticity assessment technology, and the emergency operation and maintenance scheme of the energy storage system, which is determined based on the elasticity assessment result, can guarantee the supporting effect of the safety bottom power grid energy storage station on the safety bottom power grid to the maximum extent, and guarantee the stable operation of the energy storage system in the disaster full period.

title_en: Healthy river ecosystem construction method based on water ecological function partition
abstract_en: The invention relates to a healthy river ecosystem construction method based on water ecological function partition, which comprises the following steps: determining all levels of rivers in the target watershed and watersheds corresponding to all levels of rivers through an ArcGIS module based on DEM data of the target watershed, and taking the (i + 1) th level of river watershed as a partition basic unit of the ith level of water ecological functional partition; acquiring natural geographical driving factor data and partition characterization index data of an i + 1-th level river basin; performing cluster analysis on natural geographical driving factor data and partition characterization index data of each i + 1-level river basin in the target basin to obtain partitions on the i-level water ecological function partition; acquiring watershed ecological health index data of each subarea on the ith-level water ecological function subarea, and evaluating the health condition of each subarea on the ith-level water ecological function subarea; and (3) setting ecological restoration measures of different levels based on the health condition of each subarea and the level of the water ecological function subarea corresponding to the subarea, and constructing a healthy river ecological system.
assignees: EAST CHINA SURVEY DESIGN RES INSTITUTE ZHENGZHOU LIMITED COMPANY OF ZHONGZHOU JIANGZHOU PROVINCE;CHINA POWER CONSTRUCTION GROUP EAST CHINA SURVEY DESIGN RES INSTITUTE LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Riverbank zone structure for urban river ecological restoration and restoration method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a river bank zone structure for ecological restoration of an urban river and a restoration method thereof, and river channel areas related to the technology comprise a deep water area, a shallow water area, a river flood area, a revetment and a river channel slope of the urban river. The river channel ecological restoration technology takes river channel habitat restoration as a core, is used as a part of a river channel ecological restoration comprehensive system, and is respectively restored from four aspects of reconstruction of a river channel plane and a section structure, control and regulation of river channel hydrology, change of river bottom matrix, introduction of fast-growing organisms, reconstruction of revetments and reconstruction of river channel slopes to form a stable river channel ecological system and a natural landscape. Different from the traditional 'engineering' river channel reconstruction project, the technology mainly aims at improving the functions of river bank zones as the habitat of river channel aquatic, wet and terrestrial animals and plants, recovering the biological diversity of the river channel, and can essentially improve the ecological integrity and sustainability of the river channel and recover the functions of a natural ecological system of the river channel.
assignees: KESHENG ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Engineering cost approximate calculation method and device special for soil remediation engineering
abstract_en: The invention relates to a project cost approximate calculation method and a device special for soil restoration engineering, which automatically judge whether the current engineering adopts a quota pricing mode or a market pricing mode by using a binary decision tree, and select project characteristics of the split tree based on the principle of maximum amplitude of prediction precision improvement when splitting the decision tree so as to enable the decision tree to split most quickly; meanwhile, for numerical data, data processing is carried out in advance, and a grouping threshold value is determined according to the principle of the maximum prediction precision, so that the algorithm is simple and clear, and the computer computing power is saved; for the soil restoration project without the instructive pricing specification, corresponding model training is carried out, so that the current project can be matched with a proper historical project record, and the accuracy of the approximate calculation of the project cost is improved; meanwhile, an option for independently determining which pricing mode is selected is provided for the user, and the pricing mode can be adjusted in three aspects of manual operation, material operation and mechanical operation, so that the user can use the pricing mode conveniently.
assignees: THE BROTHERS ENG CONSULTING CO LTD;UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: Yun Bianduan-coordinated user outage and restoration monitoring method, system and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a cloud edge end cooperative user outage and restoration monitoring method, a cloud edge end cooperative user outage and restoration monitoring system, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of receiving an edge power outage event list generated by combining effective power outage alarm events collected at the same time point in an area where an Internet of things is located by an edge terminal based on an edge side transformer-split phase line-branch line-user topology model, generating a distribution network power outage event list based on a transformer substation-line-branch line-transformer topology model according to acquired position information and line fault information of a distribution network line outgoing switch, a branch switch and a station transformer combined breaker of an external system, matching the edge power outage event list with the distribution network power outage event list, determining an actual power outage early warning list and a power outage type at the current moment, and powering on and monitoring each power outage area in the actual power outage early warning list based on the power outage type to obtain composite power outage data. By adopting the method, the real-time performance and accuracy of monitoring the power failure event can be improved.

title_en: Method and system for measuring and calculating power distribution station area flooded by rainstorm induced flood
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power disaster prevention and reduction, in particular to a method and a system for measuring and calculating a power distribution area submerged by rainstorm induced flood. The method is deployed in a production monitoring command center of a provincial power grid, collects short-term weather forecast information from a provincial weather station short-term and medium-term early warning center, collects flood forecast information from a hydrological center, collects a power geographic information map from a power geographic information system, analyzes equipment coordinate information, weather forecast information and flood forecast information of a medium-voltage distribution overhead line through a neural network, measures and calculates the range of flooding a distribution station area by rainstorm induced flood, and externally releases early warning information through a Web server of the system. The invention can accurately reflect key factors such as flood arrival time, submergence range, power failure range, regional water depth and the like, and is beneficial to a production monitoring command center to guide the development of emergency response work such as load transfer, facility reinforcement, emergency repair and power restoration and the like.

title_en: Novel from restoring to throne post earthquake-resistant structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a novel self-reset column anti-seismic structure, which comprises a base and a column body, wherein the column body is arranged perpendicular to the base, the base is provided with a mounting hole, the mounting hole is a blind hole, and the bottom of the column body is inserted into the mounting hole; a plurality of prestressed reinforcements are axially arranged in the cylinder body and penetrate through the cylinder body and the base to be fixed; the energy-consuming steel bars penetrate into the base downwards, and the energy-consuming steel bars are unbonded energy-consuming sections at the bottom of the column body. Utility model's an usage is, this from the cast-in-place structure of the relative tradition of maximum deformation and residual deformation of restoration post, through increasing the power consumption reinforcing bar, increases the power consumption performance of structure, adopts the socket joint mode between lower part base and the upper portion cylinder, has avoided the drawback of flush joint for cylinder wholeness and stability obtain improving.
assignees: CHINA STATE CONSTRUCTION PORT ENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network fault research and judgment post analysis system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution network fault studying and judging post analysis system and method, which are characterized by comprising the following steps: the fault analysis system comprises a fault brief report generation module, a fault treatment overall process time consumption statistics module, a fault electric quantity calculation module and a fault study and judgment evaluation module; the fault brief generating module is used for abstracting and summarizing the key points of fault disposal to form brief; the fault handling overall process time consumption counting module is used for recording and analyzing each node change in the handling process to obtain overall process time consumption information aiming at each fault; the fault electric quantity calculation module is used for calculating the power failure electric quantity and the early power restoration electric quantity of the current fault; and the fault research and judgment evaluation module is used for evaluating faults from three levels of terminal action, power distribution master station research and judgment and remote control execution.

title_en: Ecological water storage device is restoreed in mine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ecological water storage device for mine restoration, which comprises a lead wire mesh and three rows of willow piles, wherein every two adjacent rows of willow piles are arranged at intervals in a staggered manner, transverse wickers are transversely woven on the willow piles on the rows on both sides along the respective rows of the piles, and the willow piles on the rows on both sides form woven fence walls respectively; pebbles are filled in an internal space formed by the knitted hedge wall and the willow stump, and the pebbles are wrapped by the lead wire net and filled in the knitted hedge wall; longitudinal wickers are further arranged in the vertical direction of the willow pile row, and the transverse wickers and the longitudinal wickers are alternately woven at the bottom of the willow pile to reinforce the willow pile to form a longitudinal and transverse integral structure; the lower parts of the longitudinal wickers are fixed through the peg of the wickers and are buried in the ditches. The willow piles of the utility model weave longitudinal and transverse willow twigs to form dam body space; filling sand and pebbles in the dam body space to form a check dam; block the solid particles in the trench, reduce the silt content of the surface water, reduce the erosion effect of the water flow, and achieve the aims of treating the debris flow and preventing the water and soil loss.
assignees: SHAANXI NUCLEAR INDUSTRY ENGINEERING SURVEY INST CO LTD

title_en: Method for automatically generating stringing construction scheme
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for automatically generating an overhead line construction scheme, which comprises the following steps: s1, establishing a three-dimensional terrain model through the survey data, and establishing a working condition model on the three-dimensional terrain model; s2, importing the standard working condition data into the working condition model, determining construction data according to the actual working condition data, and generating a stringing construction scheme; s3, adjusting the disaster model data to verify the robustness of the established stringing construction scheme, generating restoration parameters according to the loss corresponding to different disaster grades, and executing S2 to readjust the working condition model; after the robustness is qualified, executing S4; and S4, inputting the actual working condition data and the construction data into the tool library model, and generating the corresponding number of the prepared tools. The construction data are automatically generated by calculating the calculation data items and the calculation rules of all the construction parts, the robustness of the formulated stringing construction scheme is verified, the list of construction devices is automatically derived, and the design efficiency of the stringing construction scheme is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD CONSTRUCTION BRANCH;ZHEJIANG HUAYUN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network power-communication fault cooperative repair method oriented to elastic improvement
abstract_en: The invention discloses an elasticity-promotion-oriented power distribution network power-communication fault collaborative restoration method, which comprises the following steps: 1) after an extreme event, judging the urgency of the optical fiber fault in the power distribution network communication system, determining the optical fiber fault affecting the remote control interconnection switch as an urgent optical fiber fault, generating a repair scheme and repairing, wherein the non-urgent optical fiber fault is not repaired for the time; 2) dividing power nodes and a mobile base station of a power distribution network into 1 and 2-level grids, determining a grid repair sequence, and generating a scheme for repairing power faults and mobile base station faults in the 2-level grids, wherein the faults of a non-emergency mobile base station are not repaired for the time being; 3) and generating a repair scheme for the non-emergency optical fiber fault and the non-emergency mobile base station fault in the communication system and repairing the non-emergency optical fiber fault and the non-emergency mobile base station fault. According to the method, the influence of the power distribution network communication system fault on the load recovery of the power distribution network is considered, the communication fault and the power fault of the power distribution network are repaired in a coordinated mode, the more effective and rapid fault recovery can be achieved, and the elasticity of the power distribution network is improved.
assignees: UNIV XIANGTAN

title_en: Modifier applicable to acid heavy metal contaminated soil and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a modifier suitable for acid heavy metal contaminated soil and application thereof. The modifier comprises, by weight, 15-25% of hydroxyapatite powder, 30-40% of sepiolite powder, 24-32% of montmorillonite powder, 15-25% of potash feldspar powder and 5-15% of dolomite powder. When the modifier is used in the construction process of an ecological restoration project of an extremely acidic mining area, excessive application of quicklime or hydrated lime and the like can be avoided, acid can be quickly eliminated, acid can be controlled, heavy metal toxicity can be reduced, the effect is quick, water and fertilizer can be preserved, crop resistance can be enhanced, meanwhile, the soil structure of the mining area can be continuously improved, medium and trace elements such as silicon, calcium, magnesium, phosphorus and the like can be slowly supplemented, the extremely acidic soil can be continuously improved for a long time, and secondary disasters can not be caused.
assignees: CHINA ENFI ENG CORP

title_en: Switchgear isolation device
title_ko: 수배전반 면진장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a switchgear seismic isolator which forms upper and lower protrusion type uneven surface portions in contact with each other on an upper surface of a bottom member and a lower surface of a center member, moves the upper protrusion type uneven surface portion of the bottom member along a curved surface of the protrusion type uneven surface portion of the center member so that vibration is not transmitted to the center member to prevent a power distribution panel supported in the center member from being shaken by an earthquake so as to have a seismic isolation effect when vibration is transmitted to the bottom member during an earthquake, and elastically supports movement of the bottom member by a restoration spring installed between the bottom member and the center member to automatically restore the bottom member to an initial state, wherein the bottom member is simultaneously inclined to one side while vibration stops.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 바닥부재의 상면 및 센터부재의 하면에 서로 접촉하는 상, 하부 돌출형 굴곡면부를 형성하여, 지진 발생시에 진동이 바닥부재로 전해지면, 바닥부재의 상부 돌출형 굴곡면부가 센터부재의 하부 돌출형 굴곡면부의 굴곡면을 따라 곡면 이동하며 진동의 흔들림이 센터부재로 전해지지 않도록 하여 센터부재에 지지되어 지는 배전반이 지진에 의해 흔들리지 않도록 하여 면진 효과를 가지도록하며, 또한 바닥부재와 센터부재 사이에 설치된 복귀스프링이 바닥부재의 이동을 탄력지지함과 더불어 진동의 멈춤과 동시에 한쪽으로 치우쳐진 바닥부재를 초기상태로 자동 복귀시킬 수 있도록 한 수배전반 면진장치에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Planned power failure standard verification method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a planned power failure standard calibration method and a planned power failure standard calibration device. And matching different database table information according to the basic information of power outage and restoration, performing data extraction and information analysis, and obtaining display results of power outage and power failure and display results of on-line circulation and repair with rush repair. According to the planned power failure standard calibration method and device, comprehensive information such as planned power failure standard information and calibration results is visually displayed in real time, the workload of manual query is greatly reduced, repeated and complicated information integration analysis work is avoided, the operation condition of the distribution network switch can be effectively monitored, and an auxiliary decision function is provided for power distribution network planned power failure management and control.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Deep learning multi-microgrid elastic combination decision-making method based on Boosting perception
abstract_en: The invention provides a deep learning multi-microgrid elastic combination decision method based on Boosting perception, and relates to the fields of Boosting classifiers, deep neural networks, multi-microgrid combination operation scheduling considering operation elasticity and the like. The method comprises three parts of micro-grid combination optimization modeling, learning sample generation based on NATAF transformation and deep neural network learning based on Boosting perceptrons, wherein the micro-grid combination optimization modeling aims at important load power supply restoration capacity and provides a standby power supply path for operators, the learning sample generation based on NATAF transformation expands an original sample to all feasible spaces considering variable correlation, and the deep neural network learning based on the Boosting perceptrons adjusts deep neural network weights through hierarchical iterative traversal of neurons and adopts a cross voting mechanism to upgrade binary perception learning into multi-class learning. The algorithm provided by the invention has high real-time performance, considers the overall elasticity and has no limitation on applicability.

title_en: Method for identifying weak points of power distribution network structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for identifying weak points of a power distribution network structure, which is used for calculating bus security loads, calculating feeder line restoration total loads of a single transfer supply path, calculating multi-transfer supply path restoration total loads, finally calculating the primary load restoration rate of a transformer substation, identifying the weak points of the power distribution network structure by using the primary load restoration rate, quantitatively calculating the weak points of power distribution network transfer power, providing a basis and a method for planning, regulating and controlling the power distribution network and modifying the power distribution network, improving the fault restoration efficiency, reducing the power failure range and shortening the power failure time.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD KAIHUA POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Multidirectional energy-consuming bridge damping support
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multidirectional power consumption bridge damping support belongs to bridge construction technical field. The multidirectional energy-consuming bridge damping support comprises an upper connecting plate and a lower connecting plate, wherein the upper connecting plate is connected with the lower connecting plate through a connecting rod, a connector is arranged at the upper end of the connecting rod, a cantilever plate is arranged at the upper end of the connector, and a slide rail inner core is arranged at the upper end of the cantilever plate; the sliding rail is characterized in that a sliding plate is arranged above the sliding rail inner core, a sliding rail is fixed on the lower surface of the sliding plate, and the sliding rail inner core is connected with the sliding rail. The utility model can complete the restoration of the whole support function by replacing the connecting rod, improve the maintenance convenience of the support, save the maintenance cost of the support and ensure the safety and stability of the whole bridge; and vertical vibration and horizontal vibration can be resisted simultaneously under the action of earthquakes with different strengths, so that the energy consumption capacity is sufficient, and the earthquake energy can be effectively consumed.
assignees: UNIV JIANGNAN

title_en: Sectional type dentate constraint energy consumption node
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the steel construction, a sectional type cusp restraint power consumption node is provided, including post, long beam section, short beam section, power consumption section. The long beam section and the short beam section are connected through the energy consumption section and the high-strength bolt group. The energy consumption section comprises a flange connecting piece and a web connecting piece, energy is dissipated by means of yielding of the energy consumption plate, and the flange connecting piece is provided with a restraining outer sleeve with tooth-shaped protrusions. Under the earthquake, the plastic deformation of the structure can be controlled on the energy consumption section, and meanwhile, due to the existence of the dentate constraint, the energy consumption performance is not reduced because the energy consumption section is excessively bent, so that the main components of the structure are ensured to be always kept elastic. The node has good energy consumption effect, small overall size, simple structure, simple processing and convenient restoration after earthquake, does not influence the spatial layout of the structure, and can be restored to use only by replacing the energy consumption section when being restored after earthquake.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN TECH

title_en: Ecological environment treatment device for geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ecological environment treatment device for geological disasters, which comprises an equipment main body, a supporting seat and a material pouring port, wherein the bottom of the equipment main body is fixedly connected with the supporting seat, the middle part of the top of the equipment main body is fixedly connected with the material pouring port, the top of the material pouring port is movably connected with a sealing cover, one side of the equipment main body is embedded and connected with a water inlet part, the top of the water inlet part is embedded and connected with a control valve, the control valve can control the conveying speed of mixed liquid from the water inlet part, the material enters a treatment block, particles between a conditioner and the conditioner can be mixed to a certain degree firstly, the equipment main body can be filled with water through the water outlet and inlet part, the conditioner and the water are fully stirred and mixed, the conditioner particles are mixed, a filter screen can be detached and replaced, the efficiency and the progress of soil salinization treatment are improved, the protective effect on geology is achieved, is suitable for ecological restoration and has wide development prospect in the future.
assignees: LI SA

title_en: Can effectively prevent soil erosion and water loss's gardens side slope protective structure for ecological restoration
