abstract_en: The invention discloses a protection structure for ecological restoration of a garden side slope, which can effectively prevent water and soil loss, and comprises a side slope, a water-proof structure and a water-proof layer, wherein planting soil is arranged in the side slope, and a steel wire mesh covers the outer surface of the planting soil; the protective frame is positioned on the outer surface of the side slope, a support frame is arranged at the bottom end of the protective frame, a movable shaft is connected inside the support frame, and windmill blades are arranged on the outer surface of the movable shaft; the concrete skeleton is located the surface of planting soil, the surface of concrete skeleton is provided with keeps off the backplate. This can effectively prevent soil erosion and water loss's gardens side slope protective structure for ecological restoration, the skeleton bottom anchors the wire net to enclose in the skeleton outside after forming and keep off protective frame, can avoid the rainwash side slope to lead to not hard up and the landslide that leads to of earth, also can reduce the destruction that soil erosion and water loss caused to the vegetation simultaneously, thereby increase the coverage of side slope vegetation.
assignees: ZHONG AO ECOLOGICAL ENV CO LTD

title_en: Biological manipulation-based ecological system restoration simulation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological system research, and discloses an ecological system restoration simulation method based on biological manipulation, which comprises the following steps: a) Inputting input parameters of different functional groups and the mutual nutrition relation into a Ecopath model to serve as initial data before repair; b) Performing biological manipulation simulation by using Ecosim model; c) And (3) acquiring a food network structure before and after repair, analyzing the energy transmission quantity between each nutrition stage according to the food network structure, acquiring the transmission efficiency between each nutrition stage, and comparing and analyzing the transmission efficiency before and after repair. The structure and function change of the ecological system are researched, the repairing effect is evaluated from the angle of the ecological system, and a theoretical basis can be provided for scientific management of biological repairing.

title_en: Reliability determination method, device, equipment and medium for flexible direct power distribution system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for determining the reliability of a flexible-direct power distribution system. The method comprises the steps of determining each system load point of a target flexible-direct power distribution system, determining the predicted restoration time relative to a main power supply for each system load point, further determining the power failure time of each system load point according to the predicted restoration time and the fault rate of a flexible-direct network in the target flexible-direct power distribution system, and determining the reliability index of the target flexible-direct power distribution system according to the power failure time of each system load point so as to quantify the reliability of the power distribution system comprising the flexible-direct network, thereby realizing the determination of the reliability of the flexible-direct power distribution system and facilitating the analysis and the improvement of the reliability of the power distribution system.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;DONGGUAN POWER BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Groundwater pollution monitoring natural attenuation restoration prediction method, system and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system and a device for nature attenuation repair prediction in underground water pollution monitoring, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the standard establishing module is used for establishing an MNA conceptual model of the polluted site and determining a monitoring target and an MNA control standard of the polluted site; the on-site monitoring network determines a monitoring position, a monitoring object, a monitoring index and a monitoring frequency based on the conceptual model so as to realize on-site monitoring of a polluted site; the evaluation module is used for evaluating the feasibility of the MNA repair technology through an indoor simulation test and field monitoring; if not, strengthening natural attenuation is carried out; and if the MNA is feasible, outputting a final MNA validity evaluation result. The method and the device realize effective prediction of groundwater pollution monitoring natural attenuation restoration, are simple to execute, can realize accurate prediction of medium and long periods, and greatly reduce time cost of evaluation.
assignees: BAOHANG ENV RESTORATION CO LTD

title_en: Information cooperation system and information cooperation method
abstract_en: To provide an information cooperation system and an information cooperation method enabling a restoration work of a power substation where power failure occurs to be efficiently executed.SOLUTION: An information cooperation system of an embodiment has an operation management server, an operator terminal, and a manager terminal. The operation management server plans a restoration procedure of a power substation according to detection of a power failure of the power substation. The operator terminal notifies an operator executing the restoration procedure planned by the operation management server of the procedure. The manager terminal notifies a manager of a restoration work of a state of the work of the power substation based on a result of the restoration procedure executed according to the notification.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: TOSHIBA CORP;TOSHIBA INFRASTRUCTURE SYSTEMS & SOLUTIONS CORP

title_en: Self-diagnosis type earth leakage breaker
title_ko: 자가 진단형 누전차단기
abstract_en: According to the present invention, an earth leakage circuit breaker with self-diagnosis determines fault and defect status of a unique function of an earth leakage circuit breaker through a self-diagnosis function to notify a user of the fault and defect status, prevents a power outage of an entire household even during an earth leakage shutoff test, allows automatic restoration even after the earth leakage shutoff test is completed, diagnoses mechanical and electrical fault status by creating the same earth leakage situation as a real situation by performing the self-diagnosis function through a simple operation of a user or an inspection worker or regular inspection through a schedule in the unique function of the earth leakage circuit breaker, sounds an alarm with naked eyes and noise to notify the user of fault status to be replaced to prevent electrical problems, reduces a heavy burden of human and physical inspection resources for the regular inspection of the Korea Electrical Safety Corporation, and prevents a power outage of an entire household during a self-diagnosis test to safely maintain electrical loads in use without interruption to prevent user complaints and accidents.
abstract_ko: 본 발명인 자가 진단형 누전차단기는 자가진단 기능을 통해 누전차단기 고유 기능의 고장, 불량 여부를 판별하여 사용자에게 알리고, 누전 차단 시험 중에서도 가구 전체의 정전을 방지하게 하며, 누전 차단시 시험이 완료된 후에도 자동으로 복원이 가능하게 하고, 누전차단기의 고유 기능에 있어서 스케줄을 통한 정기적 또는 사용자 및 점검재원이 간단한 조작을 통해 자가진단 기능을 수행하여 실제와 똑같은 누전상황을 발생시켜 기계적, 전기적 고장발생 여부를 진단하고, 소음 및 육안으로 알람을 발생시켜 고장여부를 사용자에게 알려 교체할 수 있도록 하여 전기안전사고를 예방하게 하며, 한국전기안전공사의 정기점검을 위한 인적, 물적 점검재원의 과중을 줄여주고, 자가진단 시험 시 가구 전체의 정전을 방지하여, 사용중인 전기부하를 중단 없이 안전하게 유지하여 사용자 민원 및 사고를 미연에 방지하데 그 특징이 있다.
assignees: CLARUS CO LTD

title_en: Low-voltage power grid first-aid repair, operation and maintenance management method and system combining real-time power failure and power restoration information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-voltage power grid emergency maintenance operation and maintenance management method combining real-time power failure and power restoration information, which is characterized in that the occurrence of a power failure and power restoration event is sensed in real time by combining a real-time power failure and power restoration research and judgment result, the actual personnel in the corresponding area are positioned by utilizing an operator GPS or a network equipment base station to accurately sense the personnel affected by the power failure event, the progress feedback of emergency maintenance personnel and the verification of the power restoration event are combined, the emergency maintenance condition is pushed to the actual affected user in real time, the accurate and humanized pushing of information is realized, the service quality is improved, and the occurrence of complaint events is reduced.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;WUHU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Nature-friendly construction method for the greening of slope using vegetational wire mesh basket and structure
title_ko: 식생철망바구니를 이용한 자연 친화적 사면 녹화 시공 방법 및 구조물
abstract_en: The present invention provides a nature-friendly construction method for greening of a slope using a vegetational wire mesh basket and a structure thereof. The method comprises: (a) a slope clearing and topsoil obtaining step of clearing the sloping slope and obtaining topsoil of a site obtained from a slope clearing work; (b) a rock layer forming step of connecting a plurality of vegetational wire mesh baskets to the cleaned slope and installing the vegetational wire mesh baskets in a horizontal direction, and fixing a rear wire mesh to the slope with a horizontal nail; (d) a soil layer forming step of filling and compacting the soil into a soil filling space to form a soil layer; (e) a cover soil layer forming step of covering the topsoil obtained in the slope cleaning and topsoil obtaining step on the outer surface of the soil layer; (f) a seed sowing step of sowing seeds on the front and top of the cover soil layer with a front cover open, installing an eco-net which prevents soil and plant seeds from leaking and in which the plant seeds decomposes after germination and establishment to provide nutrients necessary for plant seed vegetation, and closing the front cover and a top cover; (g) a soil backfilling step of backfilling and compacting, with the soil, the space between the vegetational wire mesh basket and the slope; and (h) a repeating step of repeatedly performing the steps (b) to (g) until reaching the top along the entire length of the slope. The present invention can satisfy both a disaster prevention effect and ecological restoration.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, (a) 경사진 사면을 정리하고, 사면 정리 작업에서 얻어진 현장의 표토를 수득하는 사면정리 및 표토수득 단계; (b) 정리된 사면에 식생철망바구니를 복수 개 연결하여 수평 방향으로 배열 설치하고, 후면철망을 가로네일로 사면에 고정하는 암석층 형성 단계; (d) 토사충진공간으로 토사를 충진하고 다짐하여 토사층을 형성하는 토사층 형성 단계; (e) 상기 사면정리 및 표토수득 단계에서 수득된 표토를 토사층의 외면에 복토하는 복토층 형성 단계; (f) 전면덮개를 개방한 상태에서 복토층의 전면과 상부에 종자를 파종하되, 토사와 식물 종자의 유출을 방지하고 식물 종자가 발아 및 활착된 후 분해되어 식물 종자의 식생에 필요한 영양분을 제공하는 에코네트를 설치한 후 전면덮개와 상부덮개를 닫는 종자 파종 단계; (g) 식생철망바구니와 사면 사이의 공간을 토사로 되메우고 다져주는 토사 뒷채움 단계; 및 (h) 사면의 경사를 따라 상부에 도달할 때까지 상기 (b) 내지 (g) 단계를 반복하여 실시하는 반복 실시 단계를 포함하는 식생철망바구니를 이용한 자연 친화적 사면 녹화 시공 방법 및 구조물을 제공한다.
assignees: SONG SANG HUN;KIM NAM SOO

title_en: Layered backfill compacting method for dolomite tailing pit
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of mine restoration, and discloses a layered backfilling and compacting method for a dolomite tailing pit, which solves the problems that the overall structure stability of a field is not high, the field is easy to sink and collapse, geological disasters are easy to occur and the like after the existing pit is backfilled and compacted. The invention comprises the following steps: (1) selecting graded stones with the grain size of less than or equal to 50cm for backfilling; (2) spreading upward from the bottom of the backfill pit in a layered manner; (3) and (5) rolling each layer by using a vibration roller at 15-30t after paving. According to the layered backfilling compaction method for the dolomite tailing pit, the backfilling compaction degree is guaranteed by optimizing the components of the graded stone and adopting a layered paving mode, the overall structural stability of the field can be improved in large-area backfilling compaction of the pit, a backfilling area cannot sink and collapse, and geological disasters are avoided.
assignees: CHENGDU SURVEYING GEOTECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE CO LTD OF MCC

title_en: Deep learning-based river network dense watershed water situation trend prediction method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a river network dense watershed water situation trend prediction method based on deep learning and application thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting rainfall, water level time sequence point data and longitude and latitude information of all rainfall stations and river channel water level stations in the full watershed range, and performing whole editing; converting the integrated rainfall and water level time sequence point data into space-time data by an inverse distance weight method and an isosurface map rendering method; constructing and training a watershed high-resolution water level forecasting model, and respectively inputting rainfall and water level time-space data tensors; the watershed high-resolution water level forecasting model comprises a preliminary spatial feature extraction module, a space-time feature extraction module, a stacking module, a splicing module and a feature restoration module; and the model outputs a water level isosurface map of the whole basin in a forecast period to obtain the basin water regime change trend. The method can fully excavate the production convergence mechanism of the basin from historical hydrological data, and can accurately forecast the space-time water regime change of the whole basin.

title_en: River course adds medicine aeration integrated device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of black and odorous river channel restoration and environment-friendly equipment, in particular to a river channel dosing and aeration integrated device. The device has simple structure and convenient operation and control, and can realize an automatic medicine feeding system; the problems of poor mass transfer and mixing, narrow jet flow range and low aeration efficiency of a riverway aeration gas-liquid mixed liquid and a non-aerated low-dissolved oxygen water body in the prior art are solved; the river course adds the medicine and relies on the manual work to spray, and the medicament only is the loading surface of water, is difficult to the diffusion, influences the medicament treatment effect, causes the medicament to use extravagantly, increases the medicament cost and still can bring secondary pollution scheduling problem for the water. The device has the advantages that aeration and dosing are combined, and the effect of improving the water quality of the river is enhanced; the spraying effect is good, the application range is wide, the emergency response is fast, the manual operation is not needed, and the automatic operation can be realized.
assignees: SHANGHAI EMPEROR OF CLEANING HI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid model version control and tracing management method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid model version control and tracing management method and a device, comprising the steps of obtaining a power grid model file; analyzing the power grid model file, and storing each data component of the power grid model file obtained through analysis into a data table established in a database according to a preset mapping relation; inquiring and acquiring a corresponding version model of a corresponding date according to the data table; and combining the constraint relation of the corresponding version models according to a preset data organization rule to generate a corresponding file, and performing spot shipment calculation on the corresponding file by adopting a shipment algorithm. The invention provides a power grid model adding, editing, deleting, inquiring full-flow and closed-loop version control method, which supplements and perfects the version operation that only supports incremental data and does not support power grid model editing and deleting in the existing power grid model management method, effectively supports the requirements of the power grid model management storage and accurate restoration of the power grid model management in the power spot market, and improves the efficiency and accuracy of spot shipment.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for comprehensive evaluation of resilience of power distribution network
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and system for comprehensively evaluating the resilience of a power distribution network. The method comprises: obtaining parameters of a power distribution network, and performing an evaluation according to a preset power distribution network resilience comprehensive evaluation system, wherein the power distribution network resilience comprehensive evaluation system comprises first-level evaluation indices and second-level evaluation indices, and each first-level evaluation index is provided with a corresponding second-level evaluation index; the first-level evaluation indexes comprises perceptibility, adaptability, defense capabilities, restoration capabilities, synergistic capabilities and learning capabilities, and on the basis of an evaluation result of each second-level evaluation index, carrying out a comprehensive calculation according to the weight of each second-level evaluation index and the weight of each first-level evaluation index to obtain a comprehensive evaluation result for the resilience of the power distribution network. Compared to the prior art, the present invention focuses on the three functions of distribution network situation awareness, disturbance response and self improvement capabilities with regards to six categories of key features of a resilient power grid, which can establish a more comprehensive and refined comprehensive evaluation system under resilience requirements, and improve the accuracy and reliability of the evaluation result.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Log model-based power grid operation and maintenance compound method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid operation and maintenance restoration method based on a log model, which belongs to the technical field of power grid operation and maintenance and comprises the specific steps of (1) receiving log data and classifying the log data, (2) establishing a fault knowledge base and extracting information from the fault log, (3) self-matching the log data and recommending corresponding operation and maintenance schemes, (4) updating data of a scheme list according to staff, (5) receiving user feedback information and updating related operation and maintenance schemes, and the method can extract keywords in the log and match the keywords, improve the log matching rate, improve the computer data processing efficiency, update the fault knowledge base in real time, improve the use experience of staff, improve the fault processing rate of the staff, save the maintenance time of the staff, and simultaneously optimize and update according to the user requirements, and improve the fault tolerance of the scheme.

title_en: Multi-point fault emergency repair method and system for elastic power distribution network considering emergency resource scheduling
abstract_en: The disclosure belongs to the technical field of power distribution network optimization, and provides a multipoint fault rush-repair method and system for an elastic power distribution network, which consider emergency resource scheduling, and comprise the following steps: step S01: acquiring fault node position information and load node index weight, judging whether the power distribution network completely recovers power supply, if so, turning to step S03, otherwise, turning to step S02; step S02: performing network reconstruction of the power distribution network with the aim of maximizing the power restoration load until the power is completely restored, and turning to step S03; step S03: judging whether the fault node in the power distribution network is completely recovered, if so, ending the rush-repair, otherwise, turning to step S04; step S04: and repairing the fault node by taking the highest recovery force of the power distribution network as a target until the fault node is completely repaired, and ending the rush repair.

title_en: Improved ship track prediction method and device based on cyclic neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an improved ship track prediction method and device based on a cyclic neural network. Offshore vessels are dense, the traffic environment is complex, and the automatic ship identification system (AIS) data has the following characteristics: (1) there are a large number of anchor tracks in the sea; (2) an abnormal acute angle bend exists in a part of the non-anchored track; (3) the behavior of the ship in different voyages is greatly different. These features can reduce the accuracy of trajectory prediction, and the invention proposes an improved ship trajectory prediction model based on a recurrent neural network: (1) providing an anchor track elimination algorithm to eliminate anchor tracks; (2) Providing a probability-based trajectory restoration algorithm to restore the acute angle bend; (3) Designing a two-stage ship track flow clustering algorithm to distinguish ship behaviors; and (4) constructing a deep bidirectional gate cycle unit (GRU) model. The improved ship track prediction model provided by the invention has higher prediction precision and has a certain reference value in the ship track prediction of an offshore area.

title_en: Island ecological environment management and evaluation platform based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of island ecological environment management and evaluation, in particular to an island ecological environment management and evaluation platform based on big data analysis, which comprises a map display module, a data management module, an evaluation management module and a system management module, wherein the map display module is used for viewing any island attribute information in the system; the evaluation management module comprises an island ecological bearing capacity evaluation module and an ecological safety evaluation module; the platform for managing and evaluating the ecological environment of the island realizes scientific and standardized management of data of the island, realizes an interactive and friendly evaluation and analysis function, and provides technical support for making scientific and reasonable decisions; the method strengthens the consciousness of people in all circles on the protection of the sea areas and the islands, lightens the economic, environmental and social influences on the sea areas and the islands caused by natural disasters, improves the capability of various levels of sea area management departments and social masses in implementing the remediation, restoration and protection of the sea areas and the islands, and has obvious ecological benefit and wide social benefit.
assignees: LIAONING OCEAN AND FISHERIES SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Novel water-reducing management and control system suitable for restoring and treating mine ecological environment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel precipitation management and control system suitable for mine ecological environment restores and administers, including a plurality of according to the mountain vigor by the height to the precipitation management and control unit that the low set up step by step, adjacent precipitation management and control unit links to each other through drainage facility and realizes retaining step by step, precipitation management and control unit includes slay water storage body, slay water storage body is located between hillside tunnel face and the water control reposition of redundant personnel dam, the water control reposition of redundant personnel dam makes the residual water flow after the slay water storage body saturation to the mine platform of next precipitation management and control unit and opposite side through drainage facility, the mine platform is including the dregs protective layer that from top to bottom sets gradually, passenger soil layer and original place layer, original place layer is equipped with the pit water storage body, the mine platform edge is equipped with the enclosure ridge, the inboard region of enclosure ridge is equipped with the desludging sediment ridge of square shape, the vegetation has been planted between the desludging sediment ridge. The utility model discloses can reduce soil erosion and water loss and mud-rock flow natural disasters's emergence, improve the natural precipitation utilization ratio, be applicable to mine ecological environment restoration technical field.
assignees: HEBEI GEOLOGICAL AND MINERAL CONSTRUCTION ENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Traffic light controller and leak detection method thereof
title_ko: 교통 신호 제어기 및 그의 누전 감지 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a traffic signal controller capable of controlling traffic lights for vehicles and pedestrians at crossroads, and a short circuit detection method thereof. The traffic signal controller includes: a main control unit (MCU) performing a control function of the traffic signal controller through a central processing unit (CPU) controlling on/off of traffic lights at crossroads; a plurality of load switch units (LSU) turning on and off traffic lights for vehicles and pedestrians at crossroads in accordance with control signals of the main control unit; a ZCT configuration part connecting the plurality of load switch units with traffic lights for vehicles and pedestrians at crossroads in at least three areas; a display part; and a traffic signal short circuit detection part, when sensing an image current from a predetermined position of the ZCT configuration part, receiving signal operation state information from the CPU to determine in which signal state of signals of the traffic lights for vehicles and pedestrians a short circuit has occurred, in accordance with preset determination criteria, thereby displaying a short circuit occurrence position of the ZCT configuration part on the display part. Therefore, in a state in which power supply is not possible due to a power cutoff by a circuit breaker, a short circuit position can be identified without the restoration of power, a site location and a state can be quickly identified, a leakage cable can be identified in real time to enable quick maintenance, and a power failure accident, a traffic accident and an electric shock accident can be prevented.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 교차로 차량 신호등 및 보행자 신호등을 제어하는 교통 신호 제어기 및 그의 누전 감지 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 교통 신호 제어기는, 교차로 신호등의 온오프를 제어하는 중앙처리장치(CPU)에 의해 교통신호 제어기의 제어 기능을 하는 주제어부(MCU), 상기 주제어부의 제어신호에 따라 교차로의 차량 신호등 및 보행자 신호등을 온오프하는 복수의 등기 구동 장치(LSU: Load Switch Unit), 상기 복수의 등기 구동 장치와 3지 이상의 교차로의 차량 신호등 및 보행자 신호등을 연결하는 ZCT 구성부와, 표시부와, 상기 ZCT 구성부의 소정 위치에서 영상 전류를 감지시, 상기 CPU로부터 신호 운용 상태 정보를 입력받아, 상기 차량 신호등 및 보행자 신호등의 신호들 중에 어느 신호 상태에서 누전이 발생한 것인지 미리 설정된 판단 기준에 따라 판단하여, 상기 ZCT 구성부의 누전이 발생한 위치를 상기 표시부에 표시하는 교통 신호기 누전 감지부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 이에 의하여, 누전 차단기의 전력차단으로 전원공급이 불가한 상태에서, 전원을 복구하지 않는 상태에서도 누전위치를 알 수 있고, 현장 위치 및 상태 파악을 신속하게 수행할 수 있으며, 실시간으로 누설 케이블을 파악하여 신속한 유지/보수가 가능하게 되고, 정전사고, 교통사고, 감전사고를 사전에 예방할 수 있다.
assignees: DONGIN SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Power grid fault handling plan generation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid fault handling plan generation method and a power grid fault handling plan generation system, which relate to the technical field of power grid dispatching, and comprise the following steps: s1: acquiring preset fault equipment information and a power grid topological structure; s2: analyzing and obtaining a tripping switch around the fault equipment according to preset fault equipment information and a power grid topological structure, and obtaining position information of a current power-off station and a power-off bus by taking the tripping switch around the fault equipment as a fault source through a preset judgment process; s3: generating a power restoration plan of the current power loss station and the power loss bus according to a preset power restoration flow; s4: and carrying out preset analysis on the multiple complex power supply plans to obtain an optimal fault handling plan. The method solves the problems of omission and negligence caused by the fact that a dispatcher obtains a power supply path only by means of observation and experience.
assignees: NINGBO TIANLING INFORMATION SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for rapidly culturing dicranopteris pedata prothallium into mature sporophyte
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for rapidly culturing dicranopteris pedata prothallium into mature sporophyte, which takes dicranopteris pedata prothallium material as breeding base material, the culturing process adopts a mode of combining tissue culture and facility culture and is divided into 4 processes, which are respectively as follows: the method comprises the steps of germinating the prothallium, maturing the prothallium, promoting the prothallium to generate juvenile sporophytes in an artificial environment, and promoting the juvenile sporophytes to develop into mature spores through facility cultivation. The invention utilizes tissue culture induction technology and facility cultivation, can obtain a large amount of dicranopteris pedata seedlings which have strong stress resistance and can be directly planted in difficult places such as mines and the like in a short time, is not influenced by seasonal climate change and natural disasters, and provides technical support for factory seedling culture of dicranopteris pedata and culture of clones thereof. The method shortens the cultivation time of the dicranopteris pedata plants, saves the seedling cultivation cost of dicranopteris pedata, and can provide plant planting materials for difficult in-situ ecological restoration of mines, slopes, tailing spoil areas, strong acid soil and the like.
assignees: GUANGZHOU YUEDA FORESTRY CO LTD;JIANGXI ACAD OF FORESTRY

title_en: Information processing device
abstract_en: To relief people who are not actually damaged by a disaster but suffer from rumored damages.SOLUTION: A sightseeing actual disaster area specification part 51 specifies a region in which damages (a damage rate of accommodations is equal to or more than 30%, a period to the restoration of transportation is equal to or more than eight days, or the like) equal to or more than a predetermined value occurs in a sightseeing infrastructure including the accommodation and the transportation, and the region in which indexes represented by an accommodation reduction rate and a non-operation rate of guest rooms satisfy reference (the accommodation reduction rate is 30% or more, the non-operation rate of guest rooms is 30% or more, the period to the restoration of transportation is equal to or more than eight days, or the like) as a sightseeing damaged area among regions around a disaster area damaged by a disaster. A sightseeing damaged area specification part 44 specifies a region in which the accommodation reduction rate is 30% or more, and the region in damages of the sightseeing infrastructure is less than the predetermined value (a damage rate showing a damage situation of the total guest rooms of the accommodation is less than 30%, the period to the restoration of transportation is less than seven days, or the like) as a sightseeing rumored damage area among the regions around the disaster area.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4
assignees: J&J BUSINESS DEV CORP

title_en: Biological ecological remediation system for rural sewage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biological and ecological remediation system for rural sewage, wherein a water quality prediction model unit of the system is used for constructing a water quality prediction model of a rural water environment based on the historical information of the rural water environment and predicting the water quality condition of the rural water environment at the next moment based on the water quality prediction model; the restoration execution unit is used for restoring the water quality according to the future water quality state predicted by the water quality prediction model unit; the restoration execution unit comprises a grid arranged at a sewage inlet, and sewage sequentially enters the primary sedimentation tank, the oxygen pressing tank and the oxygen-poor tank; the aerobic tank is communicated with the secondary sedimentation tank; the secondary sedimentation tank is respectively connected with the sludge concentration tank and the wetland; the wetland is communicated with a reservoir water environment or a river water environment; according to the fore-and-aft change and removal rate of different aquatic plant species and combinations thereof on water pollution indexes of ammonia nitrogen, nitrate nitrogen, total phosphorus and chlorophyll a under the still water condition, the aquatic plants are selected to be planted in the wetland.

title_en: NB-Iot network-based internet of things table user power failure and power failure judgment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an Internet of things netlist user power failure and restoration judgment method based on an NB-lot network.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: N-1 automatic verification method based on power distribution network full model
abstract_en: The invention provides an N-1 automatic verification method based on a power distribution network full model, which comprises the following steps: establishing a power distribution network full model based on a preset general modeling standard; acquiring fault conditions of elements in the power distribution network based on the power distribution network full model, and determining elements to be checked based on the fault conditions; obtaining topology data of a power distribution network, and generating a power restoration scheme corresponding to elements to be verified in the power distribution network according to the topology data; performing N-1 verification on the power restoration scheme according to a first operation index of the power distribution network; and if the N-1 verification is passed, selecting an optimal power restoration scheme according to the second operation indexes of the power distribution network before and after the N-1 verification. The invention can rapidly and safely carry out the automatic verification of N-1 when a certain element fails. And meanwhile, the optimal power restoration scheme is determined by executing the operation indexes of the power distribution network before and after the power restoration scheme, so that the N-1 verification result is more comprehensive and reliable.

title_en: Landslide monitoring devices for ecological restoration of mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide monitoring device for mine ecological restoration, and belongs to the technical field of equipment for mine ecological restoration. The utility model provides a mine is landslide monitoring devices for ecological remediation, includes PMKD, and PMKD top surface rear portion left side is equipped with the backplate, and the terminal surface upside is equipped with the water-collecting box before the backplate, and water-collecting box bottom surface middle part front side has set firmly the rack, and both sides all are equipped with first spring around the water-collecting box bottom surface, and PMKD top surface left side is equipped with the suggestion subassembly, and PMKD top surface middle part top is equipped with the drive cover, and drive cover inner chamber middle part is equipped with the carousel, and the carousel right side is equipped with the warning subassembly. According to the invention, through the cooperation between the water collecting box arranged on the upper side of the front end surface of the back plate, the rack arranged on the front side of the middle part of the bottom surface of the water collecting box and the prompting component arranged on the left side of the top surface of the fixed bottom plate, when the rainfall of the mine to be repaired is large, rainwater can be gathered in the water collecting box, the water collecting box can drive the rack to move downwards, and the prompting component can make a sound to prompt related workers to repair the mine, so that landslide is avoided.
assignees: WANG WENCHAO

title_en: Medium-and-long-term load prediction method considering industry relevance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medium-long term load prediction method considering industry relevance. The method of the invention comprises the following steps: firstly, preprocessing industry load data aiming at the problem of large industry load data loss and large data magnitude difference, providing an industry month load data restoration method based on iterative interpolation, restoring month load loss data of a typical industry, and normalizing the load data by adopting a min-max normalization method. On the basis, the industry relevance is analyzed and quantified based on a Shapiro-Wilk test and a pearson correlation coefficient, and the strong correlation industry is screened according to the relevance index. Finally, based on industry load data, air temperature data and industry relevance, long-term memory (Long Short Term Memory, LSTM) neural networks are utilized to predict long-term loads in the industry. The method can realize high-precision medium-long term load prediction by introducing industry relevance analysis.

title_en: Method for predicting power restoration time of post-disaster power grid by considering toughness of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for predicting the power restoration time of a post-disaster power grid by considering the toughness of a power distribution network, which comprises the following steps of: step S1: acquiring power grid data information of a power distribution network; step S2, according to the power grid data information, introducing a power distribution network toughness index described by the integration of the weighted loss load of the power distribution network and a time axis under natural disasters, and constructing a power distribution network function curve model; s3, acquiring related parameters of the natural disaster, and establishing a natural disaster model according to the related parameters of the natural disaster; s4, constructing a basic calculation model of the post-disaster power grid power restoration total time considering the toughness of the power distribution network; step S5, correcting a basic calculation model of the post-disaster power grid power restoration total time considering the toughness of the power distribution network to obtain an accurate calculation model of the power distribution network fault treatment total time; and step S6, acquiring power grid data information of the post-disaster power distribution network, and acquiring the power restoration time of the post-disaster power distribution network based on an accurate calculation model of the total time of power distribution network fault processing. The method can quickly acquire the power restoration time of the power grid after disaster, has high precision and can effectively improve the reliability of the power distribution network.
assignees: FUJIAN YONGFU POWER ENG CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network post-disaster rush repair scheduling method and device based on greedy algorithm combination
abstract_en: The invention relates to a post-disaster rush-repair scheduling method for a power distribution network based on a greedy algorithm combination, which comprises the following steps of constructing three greedy algorithms for preventing rush-repair strategies, respectively searching optimal solutions according to the current load state of the power distribution network, selecting the optimal solution with the minimum loss of the power distribution network as the rush-repair strategy of the power distribution network, wherein each greedy algorithm comprises the steps of starting from a rush-repair center, respectively selecting the fault point which best meets the corresponding rush-repair strategy for rush-repair by each rush-repair team, and after each rush-repair team finishes the rush-repair, selecting the fault point which is not rush-repaired and best meets the corresponding rush-repair strategy for rush-repair until all faults finish the rush-repair, wherein the corresponding rush-repair strategies of the three greedy algorithms are closest, the best rush-repair effect and the highest rush-repair efficiency. Compared with the prior art, the invention can quickly obtain a satisfactory solution, save a great deal of time spent on exploration in the whole space, and improve the post-disaster solving efficiency while ensuring the optimality as much as possible.

title_en: Ecological environment restoration device for geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an ecological environment restoration device for geological disasters, which comprises a pool body, a supporting block, a first baffle, a camera, a solar panel, a storage battery, a fixed pin, a sand suction pipe, a sand suction pump, a sand discharge pipe, a second baffle, an irrigation water inlet pipe, an irrigation pump, an irrigation water outlet pipe and a filter screen; the pool body comprises a pool part and edge parts, wherein a first edge part and a second edge part in the edge parts are respectively arranged at two sides of the pool part; the supporting block is positioned right above the first edge part, and the top of the supporting block is connected with the first baffle; the top of the first baffle is provided with a solar panel and a storage battery, and the bottom surface is provided with a camera; one end of the second baffle is fixedly connected to the bottom surface of the first baffle, and the other end of the second baffle is suspended in the air; the storage battery is respectively connected with the solar panel, the camera, the sand suction pump and the irrigation pump; the fixed pins are arranged on the lower surfaces of the first edge part and the second edge part, and the sand discharge system and the irrigation system are further arranged, so that the ecological environment can be really treated and repaired.
assignees: CNNC DADI SURVEY AND DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Mountain ecological remediation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mountain ecological restoration device, which belongs to the technical field of ecological restoration and comprises a mountain ridge part, wherein a sludge protection plate is fixedly installed at the top of the mountain ridge part, a drain pipeline is fixedly connected to the bottom of the sludge protection plate, a landslide prevention baffle is fixedly installed at the bottom of the sludge protection plate, ground thorns are fixedly installed on the surface of the landslide prevention baffle, a water outlet is formed in the bottom of the mountain ridge part, a vegetation platform is fixedly installed on the surface of the mountain ridge part, a platform perforation is formed in the surface of the vegetation platform, a penetrating nail is fixedly installed on the platform perforation, and a reverse buckle grab hand is movably installed on the penetrating nail. The utility model adopts the combination of the landslide prevention rubberpost and the ground thorn to tightly buckle the interior of the mountain body by the exquisite design, avoids the damage caused by the debris flow formed by landslide of the mountain body, and can realize the automatic irrigation of vegetation in arid weather and promote the growth of the vegetation by the combined arrangement of the water accumulator and the irrigation system.
assignees: HUBEI ENAN GEOLOGICAL FOUND ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Vegetation resumes and prevents landslide structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a vegetation restoration anti-landslide structure, which comprises a first protection plate and a second protection plate, wherein a fixed seat is arranged at the joint of the first protection plate and the second protection plate, a first mounting plate is fixedly connected to one side of the first protection plate, a first pin is fixedly connected to one side of the first mounting plate, a drainage cylinder is arranged between the first pins, a water seepage pipe is arranged inside the drainage cylinder, a support rod is fixedly connected to the other side of the first protection plate, a first vegetation culture plate is fixedly connected to the tail end of the support rod, a second vegetation culture plate is fixedly connected to the top of the second protection plate, a second mounting plate is fixedly connected to the bottom of the second protection plate, and a second pin is fixedly connected to the bottom of the second mounting plate. Effectively prevent landslide phenomenon, can carry out moisture to the vegetation simultaneously and nourish, help the vegetation to resume.
assignees: SUZHOU RUNZE ECOLOGICAL ENV CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Park post-disaster landscape water ecological cycle restoration equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses ecological cycle restoration equipment for landscape water after a park disaster, which comprises a ship body, wherein a baffle is fixedly connected to the position, close to the left side, of the top of the ship body, a transmission rod penetrates through the position, close to the top, of the baffle, two worms are sleeved on the position, close to the center, of the outer edge of the transmission rod, worm wheels are meshed with the rear sides of the two worms, driven rods penetrate through the centers of the two worm wheels together, a water pumping pipe penetrates through the position, close to the left side, of the top of the ship body, and through mutual matching of the ship body, the baffle, the transmission rod, a windmill blade, the worms, the worm wheels, the driven rods, the water pumping pipe, the movable rods, a cross rod, a connecting rod and other mechanisms, water pumping can be realized through natural wind power so as to perform purification restoration with the water pumping, and no energy loss exists.
assignees: SICHUAN JUNHE CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Landslide mass side slope ecological restoration structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of ecological restoration structures, and particularly discloses a landslide body side slope ecological restoration structure which comprises a restoration mechanism for carrying out ecological restoration on a side slope surface, an upper fixing mechanism for fixing the upper part of the restoration mechanism and a lower fixing mechanism for fixing the lower part of the restoration mechanism, wherein the restoration mechanism comprises a plurality of water guide strips with triangular longitudinal sections, a protective net and a plurality of planting parts, one ends of the corners of the water guide strips are pressed into the side slope surface, the plane of the opening of the water-diversion strips and the slope surface are the same plane, the planting part is fixed on the two water-diversion strips, the protective net is fixed on the water-diversion strips, one end of the upper fixing mechanism is fixed on the top surface of the side slope, the other end is fixedly connected with the top surface of the water-diversion strips, the lower fixing mechanism is fixed on the ground at the bottom of the side slope, and the lower part of the water diversion strip is fixedly connected, the utility model solves the problem that the side slope is easily influenced by water to cause landslide in the prior art.
assignees: CHONGQING BAJUN XIANGJI IND CO LTD

title_en: Small vessel piping monitoring system
title_ko: 소형선박의 배관 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a piping monitoring system for a small vessel. The piping monitoring system is configured to monitor, in real time, the connected or coupled state between pipes or coupling parts when after pieces of equipment are installed in an engine room or a fuel room, which is a narrow space in the small vessel, the pieces are connected by pipes or the parts are coupled, thereby preventing vessel accidents or life damage due to the generation of oil vapors from flammable substances while enabling quick restoration even if as the connected or coupled portions of the pipes or the coupling parts, which are the connecting portions of the pieces of equipment installed in the engine room or the fuel room, which is a narrow space difficult to visually check, are poor so that while gaps are formed, watertightness is reduced or the pipes or the coupling parts are separated. The piping monitoring system comprises: a connection monitoring unit for generating an event signal when the connecting portions are separated; a first communication unit for transmitting the event signal; and a monitoring terminal for receiving the event signal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소형 선박의 배관 모니터링 시스템을 개시한다. 이러한 본 발명은 소형 선박내 협소한 공간을 이루는 엔진룸이나 연료룸에 장비들을 설치한 후 이들을 배관으로 연결하거나 또는 부품들을 결합시킬 때 배관들 또는 결합 부품들의 연결이나 결합 상태를 실시간 모니터링하도록 구성한 것이고, 이에 따라 육안 확인이 어려운 협소한 공간인 엔진룸이나 연료룸에 설치되는 장비들의 장비 연결부위인 배관들 또는 결합부품들의 연결이나 결합부위가 불량해져 틈새가 발생하면서 수밀성이 저하되거나 또는 배관들 또는 결합부품들이 분리되는 이탈되는 현상이 발생하더라도 신속한 복구가 가능하도록 하면서, 인화성 물질의 유증기 발생으로 인한 선박 사고 또는 인명 피해를 방지하는 것이다.
assignees: HANIL NEWS INC

title_en: Method for arranging cutoff valves of town gas pipe network and defining and recovering isolation area
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for arranging cutoff valves of town gas pipe networks and defining and recovering isolation areas, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining partitions of the town gas pipe network, and dividing a large pipe network structure into small pipe network structure partitions by calculating and optimizing modularity; according to the connection relation of the pipe network partitions, when a destructive event occurs, the connection between the pipe sections in the normal operation pipe network partition and the pipe sections in the affected pipe network partition is cut off by opening the cut-off valves arranged between the pipe network partitions, and the gas consumption source quantity of the gas consumption points in the normal operation area of the pipe network is increased; and determining a recovery sequence of the pipe network isolation area, and recovering the gas pipe network according to the recovery sequence. The method applies the town gas pipe network block valve to the arrangement and the division and recovery of the isolation area, improves the gas source quantity of the gas consumption points in the normal operation pipe network subarea, is beneficial to ensuring the integral safety performance of the pipe network, and controls the economic cost.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Power grid equipment power failure and recovery method and system, readable storage medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, a readable storage medium and a device for power grid equipment power failure and restoration, which are applied to a command receiving end of the power grid equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving an operation permission request, and sending the operation permission request to a dispatching terminal after the operation permission request is checked to be correct, wherein the operation permission request comprises a power failure permission request and/or a power restoration permission request; when the received command issued by the dispatching end according to the operation permission request is a confirmation command, controlling the power grid equipment to perform power failure or power restoration; and when the power grid equipment finishes the power failure or power restoration operation, sending an operation finishing instruction to the dispatching end so that the dispatching end archives the power failure or power restoration operation. The invention solves the problem of low safety of unmanned goods delivery in the prior art.
assignees: TELLHOW SOFTWARE CO LTD

title_en: Emergency exit guidance lights
title_ko: 비상구 유도등
abstract_en: The present invention provides an emergency exit guidance light which comprises: a cuboid-shaped case including a display unit which is formed on a front surface portion thereof to indicate a location of an emergency exit and an evacuation direction, and an installation space portion which is formed therein; a light-emitting means installed on the inside of the case to emit light to the display unit and having a white LED showing white light, a yellow LED displaying yellow light, and a red LED displaying red light; a heat detecting means made of a shape-memory alloy and connected to and installed on the case to have one end exposed to the outside of the case and the other end disposed inside the case; a gas detecting sensor connected to and installed on the case to detect carbon monoxide; an operation control means connected to the light-emitting means, the heat detecting means, and the gas detecting sensor to allow the light-emitting means to emit light of the white LED before a fire occurs and enable the light-emitting means to emit light of the yellow LED or the red LED when shape restoration of the heat detecting means is achieved by heat or more than a predetermined concentration of carbon monoxide is detected by the gas detecting sensor; and a power supply means connected to the light-emitting means, the gas detecting sensor, and the operation control means to supply power to the light-emitting means, the gas detecting sensor, and the operation control means. Accordingly, provided is the emergency exit guidance light which can be identified at a remote location even in case of a fire having low visibility.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 전면부에는 비상구의 위치와 대피 방향을 지시하는 표시부가 형성되며, 내측에는 설치공간부가 마련된 직육면체 형상을 가지는 케이스,  표시부에 빛을 조사하도록 케이스 내부에 설치하며, 백색빛을 표출하는 백색LED, 황색빛을 표출하는 황색LED, 적색빛을 표출하는 적색LED를 구비하는 발광수단,  일단은 케이스의 외부로 노출되고, 타단은 케이스의 내부에 배치되도록 케이스에 연결 설치하는 형상기억합금소재로 이루어진 열감지수단,  케이스에 연결 설치하며, 일산화탄소를 감지하는 가스감지센서,  발광수단과 열감지수단 및 가스감지센서와 연결되어, 화재가 발생하기 전에는 발광수단에서 백색LED의 빛이 조사되게 하고, 열감지수단의 열에 의한 복원이 이루어지거나 가스감지센서에서 일정농도 이상의 일산화탄소가 감지되면 발광수단에서 황색LED 또는 적색LED의 빛이 조사되게 하는 작동제어수단,  발광수단과 가스감지센서 및 작동제어수단과 연결되어, 발광수단과 가스감지센서 및 작동제어수단으로 전원을 공급하는 전원공급수단을 포함하는 비상구 유도등을 제공한다.
assignees: NAT UNIV GYEONGSANG IACF

title_en: Distribution network maintenance request form generation system and method based on ring network diagram and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network maintenance request form generation system and method based on a ring network diagram and a storage medium. Distribution network maintenance work is divided into a plurality of dimensions through construction, and task description of high-quality and high-efficiency completion of operation and maintenance personnel applying for maintenance work to dispatching is completed from nine dimensional standardization guide area bureaus of working lines, working places, pre-drawing, post-drawing, load transferring, equipment power failure, equipment power restoration, load transferring and information confirmation. Can mark work place and power failure equipment on the looped netowrk diagram, improve the visual degree that presents of overhauing key information, be convenient for applicant and audit personnel confirm fast. By implementing the method, the system and the device, the applicant can be guided to quickly generate the distribution network maintenance request form, the generation efficiency and accuracy of the request form are improved, and the verification is facilitated.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Degraded high and cold marsh wetland recovery structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a restoration structure of degraded alpine marsh wetland, belonging to the technical field of alpine vegetation restoration, comprising a substrate, wherein a greening mechanism comprises a non-woven fabric bag and a turf layer, a interception groove is embedded and installed at the top of the outer side wall of the substrate, the bottom end of the interception groove is communicated with a water storage tank through a connecting pipe, a spraying assembly comprises a water pump and a rotary spray head, the wetland is greened and restored through the arranged turf layer, the earth surface is solidified, the water and soil loss is reduced, the situations of soil loss, landslide and the like can be prevented, the interception groove is used for collecting rainwater to form a water collection depression, the water and soil loss is reduced, the water conservation capacity of the degraded marsh wetland is improved, the radial source tracing erosion undercutting of a natural water system is reduced, the ecological system function of the degraded alpine marsh wetland is restored, and the rotary spray head is matched with the water pump to carry out auxiliary spraying operation on the turf layer, therefore, the turf layer is irrigated in an auxiliary mode, turf growth is facilitated, and the construction recovery rate is increased.
assignees: Hohhot vocational college

title_en: Mine restoration side slope protective structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mine restoration slope protection structure which comprises a slope body, an upper collecting tank and a lower collecting tank, wherein first filter screens are fixedly arranged at the inner ends of the upper collecting tank and the lower collecting tank respectively, planting soil layers are fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the slope body and are arranged between the upper collecting tank and the lower collecting tank, side partition plates are arranged at the front end and the rear end of each planting soil layer respectively, the two side partition plates are fixedly connected to the outer wall of the slope body, a plurality of planting pots are fixedly arranged on the upper end face of each planting soil layer, and the planting pots are arranged between the two side partition plates. The method has the advantage of high watering efficiency, improves the restoration and greening of the side slope by improving the stability of the surface layer of the planting layer, and realizes a good supporting effect, thereby effectively avoiding landslide and ensuring the safety of the mountain side slope structure.
assignees: KELINWEIER SUZHOU ENVIRONMENTAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Plant restoration method for severe slope of soil engineering wound surface in alpine region
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plant restoration method for a steep slope of a soil engineering wound surface in a alpine region. The existing technology for repairing the soil steep slope is weak, and if the form of slope protection is selected unreasonably or is not implemented in place, serious natural and geological disasters such as water and soil loss, collapse and the like can be caused. The invention firstly trims the engineering wound surface and then digs out the planting hole; mixing water, nutrient soil and seeds and filling the planting holes; and after the plant seeds germinate, carrying out manual maintenance management on the repair area. The invention adopts the plant restoration method to restore the steep slope of the engineering wound surface of the soil texture in the alpine region, thereby reducing the engineering cost, and the vegetation coverage rate and species abundance of the engineering wound surface in the third year after restoration are basically consistent with the method for restoring the hanging net spray-seeding ecological slope protection.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY FIRST SURVEY & DESIGN INST GROUP LTD

title_en: Active power distribution network fault recovery method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for recovering faults of an active power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, outputting distribution network disaster affected probability distribution data according to the current accumulated rainfall of a designated distribution area and weather forecast information of a preset period in the future by combining with historical flood disaster data of the distribution area; s2, processing the distribution network disaster influence probability distribution data, and outputting updated distribution network fault network topology after removing equipment or areas with disaster damage probability larger than a threshold value; s3, after the on-off state of the switch is determined through the updated fault network topology of the power distribution network, controlling the SOP and the MT to restore power to the load, so that the load restoration amount is maximum, and the voltage unbalance amount is minimum. And obtaining disaster probability distribution through weather prediction, removing equipment which is not in a recovery range, and realizing power supply recovery through controlling SOP and MT.

title_en: Power network restoration decision method considering power-natural gas network coupling characteristics
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power network restoration decision method considering power-natural gas network coupling characteristics, which comprises the steps of establishing a power network restoration model based on the power-natural gas network coupling characteristics, establishing the power network restoration decision model based on an augmented Lagrange function, solving the power network restoration decision model based on an ADMM distributed algorithm, and obtaining a power network restoration decision scheme, wherein the power network restoration decision scheme comprises a load restoration scheme, a power supply and air source output planning scheme and a line or pipeline tide. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of high decision efficiency, quick recovery of the power network and the like.

title_en: Highway side slope vegetation recovery device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a vegetation restoration device for a highway side slope, which comprises a slope body, wherein a water tank is fixedly arranged on the right side surface of the slope body and close to the bottom of the slope body, the other end of a water inlet pipe penetrates through and extends to the top surface of the slope body, a spray assembly is arranged on the top surface of the slope body, a water discharge pipe is communicated with the inner wall of the right side of the water tank, electronic valves are fixedly arranged on the outer peripheral wall of the water discharge pipe, three inclined plane frames are fixedly arranged on the right side surface of the slope body, buffer base layers are fixedly connected to the bottom surfaces of the three inclined plane frames, fixed cones are fixedly connected to the bottom surfaces of the three buffer base layers, and a water collection assembly is arranged on the right side surface of the slope body. This highway side slope vegetation recovery device through the three buffering basic units that set up, and then makes the rainwater when washing away the slope body, can reduce the speed of landslide when flowing in proper order, and then reduces the destruction of landslide to the vegetation, has improved the protective rate of whole device to the vegetation.
assignees: YUNNAN COMMUNICATIONS INVEST ECOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Cyber-physical integrated restoration method and system for distribution systems based on emergency mobile communications
abstract_en: A cyber-physical integrated restoration method and system for distribution systems based on emergency mobile communications are provided. After extreme natural disasters which cause serious damage to distribution systems, damages of distribution systems are evaluated through system feedback data. When ground communication base stations are unavailable due to the damages, the method can make full use of existing wireless emergency communication resources to provide emergency communication services, and quickly restore the power supply through distribution automation functions with supports of the backup battery of automatic terminal devices, so as to effectively improve the resilience of distribution systems.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: Meadow vegetation root system sampling and surface soil stripping device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a meadow vegetation root system sampling and surface soil stripping device, which comprises an outer barrel with an open bottom and a sampling barrel arranged in the outer barrel, wherein a vertical downward positioning column and a guard edge extending outwards are arranged at the bottom of the outer barrel; the sampling bucket includes the stoving separation area of upper portion and the sampling area of lower part. The invention is used for the research work of grassland vegetation roots in pasture areas, can completely acquire the plant roots in sampling areas, can quickly dry and separate the soil on the surface layer of the roots according to test requirements, provides convenience for the research of grassland vegetation ecology and ecological restoration plant breeding in pasture areas, provides important research data for drought resistance and disaster reduction in pasture areas and sustainable development of agriculture and animal husbandry, and has high automation degree and high acquisition speed.

title_en: Service recovery priority evaluation method and equipment, storage medium and product
abstract_en: The invention provides a service restoration priority evaluation method and equipment, a storage medium and a product, wherein the service restoration priority evaluation method comprises the following steps: respectively acquiring an RTO (remote terminal operation) evaluation value, an RPO evaluation value, a tolerable minimum QoS (quality of service) evaluation value and a tolerable minimum QoE evaluation value of a target service; and determining the target recovery priority of the target service according to the RTO evaluation value, the RPO evaluation value, the tolerable lowest QoS evaluation value and the tolerable lowest QoE evaluation value. That is, the invention realizes the purpose of establishing disaster recovery priority by introducing the service recovery QoS target and the service recovery QoE target and combining the service recovery QoS target and the service recovery QoE target with the RTO target and the RPO target, thereby ensuring reasonable allocation of disaster recovery resources, establishing a more objective and comprehensive disaster recovery strategy and ensuring the service quality and the experience quality after service recovery to the maximum extent.
assignees: CHINESE TELECOM GROUP SYSTEM INTEGRATED LLC

title_en: Treatment method for mining ground cracks of shallow coal seam in hilly area of hilly landform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for treating a crack of a mining land of a shallow coal seam in a hilly area of a hilly landscape. The invention is based on the differential zone development attribute of the ground fissure, takes the classification and zone of the ground fissure development as the basis, takes the ecological restoration theory and technology of the mountainous area as the guidance, scientifically divides the ground fissure development type and the preferential development area, divides the ground fissure development type into the tension type ground fissure, the open type ground fissure and the step type ground fissure, optimizes the treatment process and measures, adopts a targeted treatment method, follows the principle of local control, realizes the classified zone treatment, organically combines the ground fissure treatment with landslide control, vegetation restoration and water and soil conservation, has good pertinence, systematicness and specificity, has excellent treatment effect, promotes the ecological environment improvement and restoration of the coal mining subsidence in the mountainous area with the peak landscape, has important practical significance for building green mines, and realizes the unification of social benefit, ecological benefit and economic benefit.
assignees: SHANDONG SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY UNIV

title_en: Automatic restoration system and method for abnormal data of asset account of power grid equipment
abstract_en: An automatic restoration system for abnormal data of an asset account of power grid equipment comprises a power grid asset data management module, an abnormal data positioning and marking module, an abnormal data clustering analysis module and an abnormal data automatic restoration module, wherein when the system is operated, the power grid asset data management module acquires the original data information of the power grid equipment assets from an external system, the abnormal data positioning and marking module identifies and marks abnormal fields in the original data, and determining the data abnormal type and the associated field corresponding to each abnormal field, then constructing a weighted clustering algorithm model by the abnormal data clustering analysis module based on the marked abnormal field, carrying out clustering analysis on the marked abnormal field according to the data abnormal type to form a plurality of abnormal classified data sets, and finally adopting a corresponding repairing scheme to carry out abnormal data repairing by the abnormal data automatic repairing module aiming at each abnormal classified data set. The design realizes rapid, accurate and reliable positioning detection and repair of the abnormal data of the asset ledger of the power grid equipment.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID HUBEI POWER CO LTD;WUHAN EASY MORNING CREEPING SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Main network overhauls single flow intelligence processing system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a main network overhaul single-flow intelligent processing system which comprises a main network overhaul single-processing unit, an operation ticket processing unit and a command ticket processing unit, wherein all flows of intelligent processing from main network dispatching overhaul application form notification to automatic export power restoration information are completed; the main network overhaul list processing unit comprises a data receiving module, a data drawing module, a data analyzing module and a data training module. By the automatic processing technology of the single overhaul process based on intelligent ticket formation, automatic command sending and automatic permission completion, intelligent error prevention and automatic processing of the full business process of a single overhaul scheduling side are realized, automatic receiving of power failure operation arrival report is completed, automatic command sending power failure is completed, power failure scheduling logs and automatic export power failure information are automatically recorded, automatic permission is completed, automatic receiving of power restoration operation arrival report is automatically received, automatic command sending power restoration is automatically performed, power restoration scheduling logs and automatic export power restoration information are automatically recorded.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU LTD COMPANY

title_en: Oil field power load management and control system based on data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses the technical field of oilfield power load prediction, which is used for solving the problems that in the existing mode aiming at oilfield power load prediction, correction analysis on abnormal values in load data is omitted, so that the accuracy and precision of oilfield power load prediction results are difficult to ensure, and the management and control work of load prediction on an oilfield power distribution network is greatly influenced, and particularly discloses an oilfield power load management and control system based on data analysis, which comprises a data acquisition unit, an abnormality recognition unit, a repair modeling unit, a data rating unit, an early warning feedback unit and a display terminal; according to the method, the box-line graph method is selected to complete detection and analysis of the abnormal values of the load sequence data, symbolic calibration, formulaic processing and graph comparison are utilized to complete restoration of the abnormal values, and then fusion analysis is conducted on various data signals, so that the accuracy and precision of prediction of the electric load of the oil field are improved, and management and control of the power distribution network of the oil field are promoted.
assignees: SHENGLI COLLEGE OF CHINA PETROLEUM UNIV

title_en: Be used for prosthetic green slope protective structure of planting of geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a green plant side slope protection structure for geological disaster restoration, which comprises a protection breaking body, wherein the inner side of the protection breaking body is fixedly connected with a first reinforcing rod and a second reinforcing rod, the tops of the first reinforcing rod and the second reinforcing rod are fixedly connected with a protection layer, a concrete filling layer is poured on the inner side of the protection layer and the inner side of the protection breaking body, and the right side of the protection layer is fixedly connected with a fixed sleeve. According to the utility model, the right side of the protective layer is fixedly connected with the fixed sleeve, the right side of the fixed sleeve is movably connected with the telescopic loop bar, the surface of the telescopic loop bar is sleeved with the buffer spring, and the right side of the telescopic loop bar is fixedly connected with the baffle plate, so that the effect of buffering the impact force of water flow is achieved, the slope protection soil loss caused by impact can be effectively prevented, the fixed block is fixedly connected to the inner side of the fixed sleeve, the right side of the fixed block is fixedly connected with the return pipe, and the right side of the return pipe is fixedly connected with the water collecting cover, so that the further buffering effect is achieved.
assignees: GANSU PROVINCE GEOLOGICAL ENV MONITORING YARD

title_en: Non-coal mine environment restoration engineering grading method
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-coal mine environment restoration engineering grading method, and relates to the technical field of environment restoration. The method comprises the steps of firstly, determining a non-coal mine environment restoration project grade division object; then considering the influence degree of the mine geological environment of the project area to be repaired, the risk of the mine geological disaster and the natural repair capability of the area to be repaired in the repairing and treating processes, and dividing the project area to be repaired of the non-coal mine mountain environment into four grades; and then endowing different weights for each specified evaluation index according to the importance degree, assigning the influence degree grade of each evaluation index, and linking each specified evaluation index by constructing an objective function so as to complete the grade division of the non-coal mine environment restoration engineering. The method takes the land planning attribute after restoration as a starting point to obtain a non-coal mine environment restoration project grading object, and by setting an analysis method of a target function, the grading is more objective by mainly quantitative analysis and calculation and by assisting qualitative analysis.
assignees: ZHONGMAO SHANGQING ENGINEERING TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Biological symbiotic seawall ecological member
abstract_en: The utility model provides a bionics sea wall ecological member, which comprises an ecological groove body, an ecological bed and wetland plants, wherein the ecological groove body is arranged on a sea wall through a base; ecological groove cell body is equipped with notch holding tank up, tank bottom and cell wall and sets up the through-hole that a plurality of permeates water, install ecological bed in the holding tank, ecological bed cultivates wetland plant in holding tank opening direction and forms the wetland plant, ecological groove cell body forms marine organism's habitat at cell wall, notch. According to the bionics sea wall ecological component, the green ecological channel is arranged on the traditional sea wall substrate, and a method combining artificial restoration and natural restoration is adopted to form a dike ecological protection system for resisting marine natural disasters, and the composite ecological system has ecological functions and aesthetic values.
assignees: CHINA POWER CONSTRUCTION GROUP EAST CHINA SURVEY DESIGN RES INSTITUTE LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Phosphogypsum harmless treatment as ecological restoration material and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a phosphogypsum harmless treatment as an ecological restoration material and a method, which comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 5-10 parts of lime milk, 0.01-0.05 part of water reducing agent and 0.01-0.05 part of dispersing agent. The invention is realized through chemical reaction, even soluble phosphorus and fluorine in the phosphogypsum form insoluble compounds to passivate the phosphogypsum, the phosphogypsum can be used for leveling terraces of concave terrains in building construction and needing miscellaneous filling soil, and open-pit mining needs surface backfill lamps, and can be used for ecological restoration, so that the phosphogypsum is harmless to the environment, the added water reducing agent can enhance the fluidity and play a role in lubrication, the dispersing agent can enhance the capability of particles, the time and the energy needed for completing the dispersing process are reduced, the phosphogypsum can be harmless and can be used as a filling material for ecological restoration after being modified, and the environmental influence and the natural disasters of landslide caused by no restoration after various mines are mined are solved.
assignees: YUNNAN HENWEI CHEMICAL CO LTD

title_en: Distribution network fault emergency repair scheduling system
