abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network fault emergency repair dispatching system, which relates to the technical field of power distribution network fault management.A supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) platform is adopted to acquire operation data of power distribution network operation equipment, fault probability prediction is carried out, a power distribution network equipment map model is established by determining the position of the power distribution network equipment, the position of a fault point is positioned and identified in the map model, an emergency repair starting point is intelligently selected, and a shortest path from the emergency repair starting point to the fault position is acquired by adopting a spanning tree algorithm; the invention provides a power distribution network fault first-aid repair scheduling system which is characterized in that a city power distribution network equipment map model is established, operation data of power distribution network equipment in the model are obtained, abnormity monitoring is carried out, positions of abnormal points are determined according to the abnormal data, a first-aid repair decision scheme is formulated, and an optimal path of abnormal first-aid repair is provided.
assignees: STATE GRID SICHUAN PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY TIANFU NEW DISTR POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Ecological reinforcement and vegetation restoration system for soil slope in cold and arid desertification area
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an ecological reinforcement and vegetation restoration system for soil slopes in cold and dry desertification areas. It comprises a protection main body and a tree cultivating device; the protection main part includes from bottom to top in proper order: the three-dimensional degradable three-dimensional net layer, the reinforced soil layer and the spray-seeding grass seed layer are connected with the slope surface; an ecologically degradable container; a plurality of holes are arranged in the protective main body, and an ecological degradable container is arranged in each hole; the ecological degradable container is filled with seedling growing planting soil and vegetation which has completed seedling growing. The utility model has the beneficial effects that: the ecological reinforcement and vegetation restoration technology is beneficial to improving the stability of soil body and preventing the geological disasters such as side slope peeling, erosion, slumping, slope collapse, landslide and the like caused by precipitation, strong wind and sand and other factors; the influence of the adverse climate environment on the growth and development of the vegetation is reduced; the frequency and the difficulty of vegetation maintenance management in the later stage of engineering are reduced; is favorable for quickly forming richer arbor, shrub and grass vegetation community levels and improving the greening effect and landscape appearance.
assignees: SHANXI PROVINCE TRAFFIC ENVIRONMENT PROT CENTRAL STATION LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Disaster response assistance method and disaster response assistance system
abstract_en: To respond to situation changes in a place of disaster and efficiently provide information for restoring regional roads and planning commodity transportation.SOLUTION: In a disaster response assistance system, a central control device executes the processes of: storing information pertaining to commodity supply and demand bases, importance information of commodities and regional road network information including the supply and demand bases, and estimating a commodity delivery route between the supply and demand bases on the basis of the position of each base and the road network information; specifying the commodity delivery quantity delivered between the bases at a prescribed point of time, on the basis of the transition of commodity supply or demand state along the passage of time since a disaster time at each base; acquiring the damaged point information of the road network from the device that manages disaster information; narrowing down a road among the roads on the delivery route where the disaster has occurred; determining the priority of restoration on the basis of the length of the target road based on the road network information and the commodity delivery quantity and importance information of commodities having been specified regarding the target road; and outputting recommended information for the commodity delivery route in a manner conforming to the priority of restoration.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: HITACHI LTD

title_en: Risk management and control system for treating arsenic pollution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk management and control system for treating arsenic pollution, which is a 'risk-based treatment method' with strong adaptability, and can protect human health and environmental sanitation while managing and controlling soil risk. At present, the concept of soil risk management and control is not defined in detail at home and abroad, but according to risk elements related to soil environment, the soil environment risk management and control refers to that a leaching risk assessment method is established for risk sources, exposure ways and risk receptors, the leaching risk of soil is quantified through surface water body hazard quotient, the formulation of a restoration target value is guided together by combining human health risk assessment results, risk management and control measures are scientifically and reasonably formulated, key prevention and control are carried out on high-risk polluted media, and excessive restoration of low-risk pollutants is avoided.
assignees: GUANGXI ZHUANG AUTONOMOUS REGION ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE;ENERGY SAVING IN CHINA CHINA SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Non-volatile memory
abstract_en: Natural disasters, such as cyclones, earthquakes, landslides, etc., or manmade damages, such as structural member's theft, terrorist attacks, etc., can cause collapse of transmission line towers. If these are not restored in time, there will be monetary loss to utilities as well as loss of service to consumers leading to societal impact. Generally, permanent restoration takes several weeks. Hence, a temporary solution for quick retrieval of power transmission is required. This invention provides a temporary support structural system comprising light weight guyed masts ( 1 ) made of readymade robust modules ( 6  and  7 ), easy to connect connection system, two pin gimbal joint ( 8 ) and easy to construct foundation system ( 9  and  10 ). The invention is flexible enough to develop various configurations for single or double circuit transmission lines. It is also scalable and can be used for 33 to 800 kV transmission lines.
assignees: COUNCIL OF SCIENT AND INDUSTRIAL RESEARCH AN INDIAN REGISTERED BODY INCORPORATED UNDER THE REGN

title_en: Planned outage reporting system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a plan outage reporting system, which comprises an outage information module, a power restoration information module, an information auditing module, an information editing module, an information list module, a file management module and a scheduling log module, wherein the outage information module is used for generating equipment plan outage information, the invention realizes providing a standard platform for reporting the plan outage information and the power restoration information of the dispatching and managing equipment to the superior dispatching, improves the uploading and reporting efficiency of the plan outage information and the power restoration information of the dispatching and managing equipment, improves the accurate reliability of reporting the plan outage information and the power restoration information of the dispatching and managing equipment, can effectively arrange, list display and query the report information, and improves the use experience of dispatching users.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU LTD COMPANY

title_en: One-key sequential control-based automatic issuing system for maintenance order associated operation order
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic issuing system of an overhaul order associated operation order based on one-key sequence control, which comprises an overhaul data acquisition unit, an overhaul order forming unit, an operation order monitoring unit, an issuing order scheduling unit and a database server, wherein the overhaul data acquisition unit comprises a data import module, a data coordination module, a data export module and a data storage module and is used for receiving dynamic data from a power grid in real time, coordinating and calling the dynamic data and exporting the data of a main network scheduling and overhaul order. According to the automatic issuing system of the maintenance order association operation tickets based on the one-key sequence control, the continuous automatic issuing and error prevention of the multiple operation tickets are realized based on the one-key sequence control through designing the sequencing and closing sequence adjusting functions of the multiple power-off/power-restoration operation tickets associated in the maintenance order and according to the operation purposes of the multiple operation tickets and the arrangement and combination relation of the operation orders, and the operation and maintenance work of a dispatching desk and a distribution network working site is improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU LTD COMPANY

title_en: Element identification method, device, equipment and storage medium of power network
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an element identification method, device, equipment and storage medium of a power network, relating to the technical field of power grids, wherein the method comprises the following steps: generating a simulation power network model corresponding to the power network of the area to be identified, wherein the simulation power network model comprises a transformer substation; acquiring the maximum load value and the initial working efficiency of each transformer substation, and attacking at least one first transformer substation in the simulation power network model according to a preset attack strategy; restoring all second substations in the attacked first substations in the simulation power network model according to a preset restoration strategy; and calculating the real-time score of each second substation according to a preset scoring strategy, and taking the second substation corresponding to the real-time score which is greater than or equal to the preset score as a target element in the simulation power network model. The method and the device take the operation and maintenance elasticity among the power networks into consideration, can accurately identify the target elements, and have important practical significance.
assignees: CHENGDU DATA UNITED CLOUD COMPUTING SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Chemical industry garden site pollution early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a chemical industry park site pollution early warning system, which comprises: the multi-scene monitoring system is used for acquiring monitoring values of the pollution conditions of the atmosphere, the soil and the water body; the decision-making system is used for receiving the monitoring values of the multi-scenario monitoring system and carrying out data processing to judge the pollution risk; a precision investigation system for sample analysis; determining a pollution range and carrying out a repairing emergency control and repair system according to a feedback result of the accurate survey system; the multi-scenario monitoring system is connected with the decision-making system and sends the acquired monitoring values of the atmospheric, soil and water pollution conditions to the decision-making system for processing; the accurate investigation system is connected with the decision-making system, when the decision-making system judges that the pollution risk exists, the accurate investigation system carries out sample analysis on the atmosphere, the soil and the water body with the pollution risk, and corresponding restoration treatment is carried out through the emergency control and restoration system after the pollution range is determined.
assignees: JIANGSU PROVINCE ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENCE INST

title_en: Geological disaster ecological restoration structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disaster ecological restoration structure, which comprises a slope body and a planting frame, wherein the slope body has a certain inclination angle, an installation groove is formed in the inclined plane of the slope body, interference holes communicated with the inner bottom of the installation groove are formed in four corners of the upper surface of the planting frame, and a planting area for planting different ecological restoration plants is further arranged on the upper surface of the planting frame; the planting frame is fixed on a slope body through the first fixing nail and the second fixing nail, double protection is conducted on the slope body, the fixing effect is better than that of a traditional soil nail, the reinforcement range between plants and soil is deeper, slope plants with weaker survival ability on the slope body are not prone to death or even leave vegetation to shift along with scouring of flood or torrential rain, and the long-term ecological protection effect can be effectively achieved.
assignees: NORTHWEST COLORED SURVEY PROJECT LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY

title_en: Power failure radio station area display method, device and system based on power grid map
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grids, and discloses a power failure multi-station area display method, device and system based on a power grid map. The invention periodically acquires and stores the power outage and power restoration data from the metering automation system, obtains longitude and latitude information of the power outage and power restoration areas according to the power outage and power restoration data association inquiry, packages and sends the related data to the front-end plug-in, thereby the front-end plug-in displays the power outage and power restoration areas on the power grid map in real time by calling the power grid map application API.

title_en: Resident arrearage power-off and power-restoration management method and related device
abstract_en: The application discloses a resident arrearage power-off and power-restoration management method and a related device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the RPA robot receives the power failure list data and stores the power failure list data in a database; the RPA robot regularly acquires resident arrearage data in a marketing system; the RPA robot matches the resident arrearage data with the power failure list data to screen out paid users; and the RPA robot sends the information of the paid user to the power recovery staff, so that the power recovery staff recovers power according to the information of the paid user. According to the power restoration management method, the RPA robot is adopted to acquire data from the marketing system and the customer service list system, and the automation of processes such as analysis, classification, distribution and the like is performed, so that manual operation links are reduced, process nodes are reduced, and the power restoration is managed and planned more effectively and uniformly. Thereby solved prior art work load big and the inefficiency technical problem.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY;FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGDONG POWER GRID LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY

title_en: Method and sysem for recovering damage of water treatment facilities
title_ko: 수처리 시설의 재난피해 복구 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: According to one embodiment of the present invention, a method for recovering disaster damage of a water treatment facility may comprise: a step of receiving relative importance (RI) for each of first to N^th stages, which are water treatment processes of the water treatment facility; a step of receiving a water quality reference value for each of the first to N^th stages; a step of acquiring a water quality measurement value for each of the first to N^th stages; and a step of calculating priority information for recovering disaster damage for each of the first to N^th stages by using the RI, the water quality reference value, and the water quality measurement value.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 수처리 시설의 재난피해 복구 방법은 수처리 시설의 수처리 공정인 제1 단계 내지 제N 단계 각각에 대한 상대적 중요도(RI)를 입력받는 단계; 상기 제1 단계 내지 상기 제N 단계 각각에 대한 수질 기준값을 입력받는 단계; 상기 제1 단계 내지 상기 제N 단계 각각에 대한 수질 측정값을 획득하는 단계; 및 상기 상대적 중요도, 상기 수질 기준값 및 상기 수질 측정값을 이용하여, 상기 제1 단계 내지 상기 제N 단계에 대한 재난피해 복구 우선순위 정보를 산출하는 단계;를 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: G&C ENV SOLUTION CO LTD;UNIV NAT HANBAT IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Fault diagnosis and power restoration method, device and equipment for regional power grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method, a device and equipment for fault diagnosis and power restoration of a regional power grid, wherein the method comprises the following steps: simulating at least one first power equipment to break down by a PAS of the power-on system to obtain a first voltage-loss and power-loss equipment set; if the second power equipment fails in the regional power grid, acquiring section data before and after the accident time point; analyzing the section data to obtain a third power device with a fault; and matching the third power equipment with the first voltage loss and power loss equipment set to obtain a second voltage loss and power loss equipment set, and performing load transfer and/or power restoration on the power equipment of the second voltage loss and power loss equipment set. When the power grid fails, the method carries out rapid recovery processing on the power grid according to a simulated fault recovery mode, reduces processing time, improves stability of power operation and power supply reliability, and makes full use of power grid resources to realize power conversion without power outage, so that the power grid continues to keep safe, economical and high-quality operation.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY;ZHONGSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGDONG POWER GRID LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY

title_en: Power grid elastic resilience evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating the elastic restoring force of a power grid, which comprises the following steps of: setting a power grid data acquisition system; carrying out power grid loss data acquisition and power grid recovery data acquisition; constructing a circuit loss evaluation model according to the collected power grid loss data; constructing a power grid elastic resilience evaluation model; and adjusting and optimizing the power grid elastic resilience evaluation model through the collected power grid restoration data. According to the technical scheme, the power grid data acquisition device is arranged at the node in the power grid line, the restoring force level of the elastic power distribution network is reflected by the change of the power grid line data acquired from a plurality of stages before, during and after a disaster, the loss condition of the power grid line is reflected by the data such as the circuit state of the power grid node, the telegraph pole continuing state in the power grid line, the disaster degree and the like, a circuit loss evaluation model is constructed and a power grid elastic restoring force evaluation model is constructed through the acquired power grid loss data, the power grid restoring data are substituted and adjusted, and the system evaluation efficiency and precision are improved.
assignees: JIAXING POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF ZHEJIANG PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY OF STATE GRID

title_en: A afforestation equipment for mine side slope ecological remediation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a greening device for ecological restoration of a mine side slope, and the greening device comprises a baffle plate, a positioning plate and a first planting plate in a mode of arranging a planting plate and a planting mechanism on a green-yellow device; the baffle and the locating plate are arranged at intervals to form a structural frame, and the first planting plate is arranged in the structural frame. The first planting plate comprises a limiting hole, a corrugated groove and a planting mechanism, wherein a guide hole penetrating through the side wall of the planting mechanism is formed in the planting mechanism, and the guide hole is communicated with the second planting hole; and a filter screen is arranged in the guide hole. This afforestation equipment is as the basis of guaranteeing side slope structural stability, the effectual afforestation rate that increases the side slope surface, for the vegetation provides good planting environment, has prevented soil erosion and water loss, has guaranteed the consolidation of soil, causes the problem of massif landslide after avoiding soil erosion and water loss.
assignees: CHINESE GULAND DAM GROUP THIRD ENG CO LTD

title_en: Text generation face method based on deep countermeasure generation network
abstract_en: Aiming at generating a face image from text description, the invention designs a face generating method based on a depth countermeasure generation network. The present invention relates generally to applications in the field of generating images from textual descriptions, and more particularly to applications in the field of social public safety for imaging a target person from a witness's description. The method comprises four parts of data set manufacturing, network model design, network model parameter training and network model performance test. The invention fully plays the superiority of the antagonism generation network in the aspect of image generation, designs a set of excellent solution for generating faces from texts, and has wider application prospect in the fields of public safety, face image restoration, film and television media, archaeological research and the like.

title_en: Maximum flow-based power grid elasticity modeling and quantitative evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a maximum flow-based power grid elasticity modeling and quantitative evaluation method, which comprises the steps of firstly, introducing a maximum flow idea to comprehensively consider the vulnerable characteristics of elements and the structural characteristics of a system, and establishing a vulnerability model for real-time measurement of damage of hurricane to a power distribution system; on the other hand, the targets of the shortest power supply recovery time and the fastest power supply quantity lifting of the system are comprehensively considered, the PERT/CPM algorithm is utilized to solve the optimal fault recovery sequence, the recovery performance of the system is estimated according to the maximum current value, finally, the IEEE-30 node network is taken as an example to simulate the damage and the recovery process of the system under hurricane attack, the feasibility and the effectiveness of the method are verified, and the result shows that the method is helpful for identifying key elements of the system and enables the system to recover the power supply of the system in the shortest time.

title_en: Electric vehicle load prediction method under condition of data shortage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting electric vehicle load under the condition of data deficiency, which comprises the following steps: aiming at irregular time lag change between front and back effective observation values in EV load data caused by an empty value, a GRUI cell structure is adopted to enable a traditional GAN to learn potential relation between the observation values containing the irregular time lag, so that an interpolation method of the EV load data is adapted to carry out data restoration, and a data set is obtained; promoting LSTM network performance by adopting a Mogrifier gating mechanism to obtain EV short-term load prediction results on the processed data set; the technical problems that in the prior art, data are lacked and data are abnormal, EV load prediction accuracy is low and the like are solved.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY

title_en: Highway maintenance passageway fire control water generator circulating oil cooling device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a circulating oil cooling device of a fire-fighting water generator for an expressway access passage, which comprises a shell and a generator body, wherein the left side and the right side of the front surface of the shell are fixedly connected with mounting blocks, the left side and the right side of the back surface of the generator body are fixedly connected with a matching plate, the matching plate and the mounting blocks are in plug connection, the inner side of the matching plate is provided with a fixing mechanism, and the inner side of the matching plate is movably connected with the mounting blocks through the fixing mechanism. Through setting up the installation piece on the casing for the board that joins in marriage on installation piece and the generator body is pegged graft, and join in marriage and set up fixed establishment on the board, the pulling pull rod, make the spring that the arm-tie compression was played the intracavity, and the kelly on the arm-tie breaks away from the installation piece, has still set up the pivoted peg on the pull rod, the peg can hang on the peg on joining in marriage the board after through the upset, during the installation, only need insert the back, take off the peg, the installation can be accomplished in the spring restoration, loading and unloading are convenient.
assignees: SICHUAN YAKANG EXPRESSWAY LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY;LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY FOR EXPRESSWAY IN TIBETAN AREA OF SICHUAN

title_en: Distribution network power failure recovery method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network power failure recovery method, a system and a storage medium, which divide power failure nodes into candidate power supply partitions, and perform MEG access optimization aiming at MEG candidate connection point partitions divided with the power failure nodes, and re-dividing the MEG candidate connection point partition outage nodes which are not connected with the MEG, and determining the optimal outage restoration scheme of each candidate power supply partition according to the outage node division result, thereby effectively realizing the outage restoration of the MEG applied to the distribution network.

title_en: Rapid intelligent detection method for remote sensing image destroyed house of post-earthquake unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid intelligent detection method for a damaged house by using a remote sensing image of an unmanned aerial vehicle after a earthquake, which comprises the following steps of A, collecting a remote sensing image sample of the unmanned aerial vehicle, establishing a damaged house sample set, B, based on a YOLOv deep learning model, firstly, introducing a Vision Transformer structure to optimize a Backbone network, improving detection precision, secondly, replacing a PANet network by BiFPN according to the multi-scale characteristics of a target, enhancing multi-scale information fusion capability, further constructing a YOLOv s-ViT-BiFPN model, C, cutting an input remote sensing image of the unmanned aerial vehicle, recording geographic position coding information of the input remote sensing image, D, carrying out the damaged house detection on the cut image based on the model, obtaining a target detection frame, and E, carrying out geographic position information restoration and vectorization on the target detection frame, thus obtaining a damaged house detection frame vector diagram. The method realizes rapid high-precision intelligent detection of the remote sensing image damage house of the post-earthquake unmanned aerial vehicle.

title_en: Power system attacked measurement data two-layer repairing method based on data driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data-driven-based two-layer repairing method for attacked measured data of an electric power system, which relates to the field of operation safety maintenance of the electric power system, and is characterized in that a measured regression model under each topological structure is established according to network parameter information of regional power grids, and attacked measured vectors under FDIA working conditions are simulated; the attacked data is separated by combining multidimensional scaling with federal forest algorithm in the upper layer; inputting the separated normal data into a generator G of an underlying modified CBEGAN to generate data G (z); injecting the G (z) and the history measurement regression model into a discriminator D, and distinguishing authenticity by calculating the Hellinger distance between the reconstruction error distribution of the real sample and the generated sample; and judging convergence through the target M, and finally realizing data restoration. The invention can effectively repair the measured data on the basis of the residual normal data, realizes the self-healing capability of recovery after the power grid is attacked, and has better measurement convergence, control distribution diversity and practicability.

title_en: Memory discharge system and Energy storage system comprising the same
title_ko: 메모리 배출 시스템 및 이를 포함하는 ess
abstract_en: In accordance with one embodiment of the present invention, a memory discharge system includes: a memory housing formed in a part of a container housing a power storage device is housed, to house a memory device storing operation information about the power storage device; a striking plate placed apart from the rear side of the memory housing; an elastic member interposed between the striking plate and an inner wall surface of the memory housing; and an opening/closing device fixing the striking plate to keep the elastic member compressed, and, when detecting the occurrence of a fire in the power storage device, unfixing the striking plate such that the striking plate is moved toward the memory device by an elastic restoration force of the elastic member to discharge the memory device outward through an opening part formed in front of the memory housing. Therefore, the present invention is capable of safely protecting an ESS storage device from a fire.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 메모리 배출 시스템은, 전력 저장 장치를 수용하는 컨테이너의 일부에 형성되어 상기 전력 저장 장치에 관한 운영 정보를 저장하는 메모리 장치를 내부에 수용하는 메모리 하우징; 상기 메모리 하우징의 후방에 이격되어 배치되는 타격 플레이트; 상기 타격 플레이트와 상기 메모리 하우징의 내벽면 사이에 개재되는 탄성 부재; 및 상기 탄성 부재가 압축된 상태를 유지하도록 상기 타격 플레이트를 고정시키며, 상기 전력 저장 장치에 화재 발생이 감지되면 상기 타격 플레이트에 대한 고정 상태를 해제함으로써 상기 타격 플레이트가 상기 탄성 부재의 탄성 복원력에 의해 상기 메모리 장치를 향해 이동하여 상기 메모리 장치를 상기 메모리 하우징의 전방에 형성된 개구부를 통해 외측으로 배출시키도록 하는 개폐 장치; 를 포함한다.
assignees: LG ENERGY SOLUTION LTD

title_en: Black-start path restoration optimization method under composite disaster scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to a black start path recovery optimization method under a composite disaster scene, which establishes a fatigue damage degree model based on disaster time according to the changes of typhoon wind speed and influence range, and solves the line fault probability under the wind disaster condition; meanwhile, considering the influence of rainfall on a power grid under typhoon conditions, recording disasters through a geographic information system, dividing a region by a grid method, solving the landslide probability of the region, establishing an effective rainfall dynamic correction model and a landslide probability model considering the effective rainfall, and simultaneously establishing a slope impact model and a tower impact model, and solving the line fault rate; and determining a black start power supply by adopting an improved entropy weight method combining subjective and objective, establishing an objective function considering importance degree of a line and a node, and determining a black start path through a genetic algorithm and a shortest path algorithm. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of more accurately evaluating the fault rate of the line, avoiding the black start path from passing through the high-risk line and the like.

title_en: High-speed calculation system for electric charge
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-speed electric charge calculation system, comprising: the data integration module is used for extracting the charge control calculation charge related data, initializing the charge control calculation charge related data into the high-performance calculation distributed storage, and performing preprocessing operation; the electric quantity calculation module is used for storing the synchronous surface code data in the marketing management information system in a distributed column storage format in a data processing platform and calculating the electric quantity through an electric quantity calculation algorithm; the electric charge calculation module is used for calculating the electric charge corresponding to each metering point according to the electric quantity calculation result, wherein the electric charge comprises electric charge, fund and additional charge, basic electric charge and power factor adjustment electric charge; the remote charge control management module is used for realizing measurement management and power failure and power restoration management in charge control service; and the result write-back module is used for writing back the generated result data to the marketing management information system after the relevant calculation, the check and the comparison are completed. The invention can assist the marketing management information system to meet the processing requirement of massive user data.
assignees: SOUTHERN POWER GRID HAINAN DIGITAL POWER GRID RES INSTITUTE LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Multi-objective optimization method for post-earthquake community building group recovery scheduling and toughness evaluation
abstract_en: A post-earthquake community building group restoration scheduling and toughness evaluation multi-objective optimization method comprises the following steps: s1, collecting basic information of a building group and a lifeline network of a community to be restored, and dividing work blocks; s2, determining the function loss and the restoration time of each monomer building in the community building group, the function loss and the restoration time of the buildings in each working block after the earthquake and the missing ratio of the network resources of the buildings in the blocks under the corresponding earthquake scene to obtain a function interdependence matrix among the buildings; s3, establishing a recovery objective function and constraint, and establishing a community building group recovery scheduling and toughness evaluation multi-objective optimization model considering the interdependence of building functions under resources; s6, solving the optimization model, and giving a pareto front edge of a recovery track in the optimal recovery process of the community building work block. The invention can obviously improve the post-disaster recovery efficiency of the community building group, and a decision maker can make a final decision from limited optimal scheduling according to other preferences and experiences, thereby providing a basis for disaster prevention and reduction and design planning of an urban management organization.
assignees: DALIAN SCIENCE AND ENGINEERING UNIV

title_en: Power system repair method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method and a device for repairing a power system, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: detecting whether the running state of the power system is normal or not; if not, determining target repair equipment corresponding to the current operation information in the power system, and determining a historical repair scheme corresponding to the current operation information in a pre-stored historical fault database; and determining the historical restoration scheme as a target restoration scheme of the target restoration device, and restoring the target restoration device according to the target restoration scheme. According to the technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention, the target repair equipment can be automatically positioned, and the target repair scheme is determined to repair the target repair equipment, so that the effectiveness and convenience of the repair process of the power system are improved, and the target repair equipment can be accurately and quickly repaired.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY;HUIZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGDONG POWER GRID LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY

title_en: Distribution network power supply safety capability evaluation standard quantification method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for quantifying evaluation criteria of distribution network power supply safety capacity, wherein the method comprises the following steps: carrying out local topology on a feeder line group of a distribution network, and respectively carrying out grid analysis on each feeder line of the feeder line group; calculating a reference risk value corresponding to each feeder line according to the number of medium-voltage users, the number of low-voltage users and the load value which are caused by the feeder lines in the N-1 condition through a corresponding power restoration means and have the greatest influence, and the fault occurrence probability of the line section of the weakest link of each feeder line; determining the grid frame reference risk level corresponding to each feeder line according to the preset corresponding relation between different reference risk value ranges and different grid frame reference risk levels; evaluating the power supply safety capability of the distribution network according to the network frame reference risk level of the feeder group; according to the invention, by establishing the distribution network power supply safety standard which is matched with the super-huge urban distribution network, a user can conveniently and intuitively know the power supply safety capability of the feeder line.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGDONG POWER GRID LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY

title_en: Debris flow treatment device and treatment method based on ecological restoration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a debris flow treatment device and a treatment method based on ecological restoration, in particular to the field of debris flow treatment, which comprises a main connection buffer mechanism and a central pressure transmission mechanism, wherein the main connection buffer mechanism comprises a buffer outer frame, a central connecting block is inserted into the outer surface of the buffer outer frame, a curved pressure plate frame is clamped on one side of the central connecting block, the outer side of the curved pressure plate frame is rotatably connected with a torsion block, two sides of the buffer outer frame are slidably connected with pressure blocks, the blocking equipment is convenient to disassemble and assemble at the later stage by recording the data of each area, and as the number of the blocking equipment is large, if the equipment is damaged, the maintenance personnel can quickly reach the designated area to repair the equipment through the three-dimensional coordinates of each area in a three-dimensional building function diagram, and simultaneously, after debris flow passes, the recording is carried out according to the condition of a large blocking area, and rapidly carrying out ecological restoration on the area by using the water flow obtained by the water flow collecting and filtering frame.
assignees: YANGTZE RIVER TEACHING UNIV

title_en: Key road section road restoration rescue equipment considering landslide hazard
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides key road section road restoration rescue equipment considering landslide disasters, and relates to the field of road restoration. The key road section road restoration rescue equipment considering landslide hazard comprises: landslide section and broken ground subassembly. The landslide section includes road body and landslide body, the landslide body covers a section on the road body, the subassembly that breaks earth includes two sets of pieces that break earth, the tool bit spare that breaks earth, gyro wheel, a plurality of first connecting piece, second connecting piece and first enhancement frame, the tool bit spare that breaks earth is connected in two sets of one end that breaks earth. In the process of dredging the road, only the soil between two broken soil pieces is required to be cleaned, all the soil on the road is not required to be cleaned, the road can be recovered to pass, the time required for recovering the key road to pass is reduced, when the soil is dredged, the landslide body is supported by the broken soil pieces, the landslide body is reduced in the dredging process, the situation that potential safety hazards and workload are increased is caused by collapse and increase again is avoided.

title_en: Optimization method and system for power failure recovery scheme of single partition of power transmission network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimization method and a system of a power failure recovery scheme of a single partition of a power transmission network, which constructs a power failure recovery tree with a certain depth based on a given power failure scene of the single partition of the power transmission network, and calculating the net gain index of the unit electric quantity of each power outage restoration scheme in the power outage restoration tree, and realizing the optimization of the power outage restoration scheme of the single partition of the power transmission network according to the net gain index of the unit electric quantity.

title_en: Temporary restoration method for damage place of building and repair structure for damage place of building
abstract_en: To effectively protect a damage place to prevent rainwater from entering the damage place in a period up to a start of main construction even if the period is long in the case that a roof surface part or external wall surface part of a building is damaged by a disaster such as a typhoon, an earthquake, and a flood.SOLUTION: An outdoor surface part 5 of a building 2 is covered with a repair net 9 capable of holding a water-proof resin liquid so that the entire damage place 6 of the outdoor surface part 5 is covered from an outdoor side, and a net edge part 11 of the repair net 9 is fixed to the outdoor surface part 5 with a pressure-sensitive adhesive tape 12. Then the water-proof resin liquid is blown entirely over the repair net 9 and a range protruding by a necessary width from a net edge 13 of the repair net 9 toward the outward surface part 5. The water-proof resin liquid is hardened to form a water-proof surface part 15, and the net edge 13 is embedded in the resin forming the water-proof surface part 15.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: HIKARI CORP

title_en: Outage restoration time prediction during weather events and optimized solutions for recovery
abstract_en: A method, a computer system, and a computer program product for restoration time predictions and optimized recovery solutions is provided. Embodiments of the present invention may include selecting a dataset based on time series data. Embodiments of the present invention may include building one or more models, wherein the one or more models include a classification and regression tree model, a cross validated decision tree model or a bootstrap aggregating model. Embodiments of the present invention may include selecting a model for predictions using decision trees to reduce a variance of the model. Embodiments of the present invention may include rebuilding the model based on additional data attributes. Embodiments of the present invention may include determining an outage prioritization for each outage node. Embodiments of the present invention may include transmitting results of the outage prioritization.
assignees: IBM

title_en: Disaster recovery collaborated with storage system and backup appliance in hybrid cloud environment
abstract_en: Example implementations described herein are directed to backup and restore of a public cloud and data center for disaster recovery. In a backup process of the disaster recovery, the VM root device information (a public cloud) and storage system volume information (a data center) in a main site are transferred to the disaster recovery tool. In a restoration process, the DR Tool specifies the storage system volume for backup to attach the VM in a backup site with the above information.
assignees: HITACHI LTD

title_en: River course adds medicine aeration integrated device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of black and odorous riverway restoration and environmental protection equipment, in particular to a riverway medicine-adding and aeration integrated device, which comprises a medicine-adding system, a submersible pump (2), a river propulsion medicine-adding device (3) and a jet aerator (5); the river propulsion doser (3) comprises a jet nozzle (11) for feeding gas-liquid mixture and a doser pipe (12) for feeding medicine, the river propulsion doser (3) is also provided with an outlet, the submersible pump (2) is connected with the jet aerator (5), and the outlet of the jet aerator (5) is connected with the jet nozzle (11) of the river propulsion doser (3); the medicine feeding system is connected with a medicine feeding pipe (12) of the river propulsion medicine feeder (3). The device combines aeration and dosing, and strengthens the effect of improving the water quality of the river; the spraying effect is good, the application range is wide, the emergency response is fast, the manual operation is not needed, and the automatic operation can be realized.
assignees: SHANGHAI CHUBAR SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire mitigation and downed conductor detection systems and methods
abstract_en: A transformer monitoring device has one or more voltage sensors and/or one or more current sensors integral with a housing for detecting voltage and/or current of a power cable of a transformer. The transformer monitoring device can be configured to monitor voltage data, current data, voltage imbalance, phase angle, outage detection and restoration detection, and/or transformer temperature changes, etc., and cause alerts to be Issued directly and/or by a remote central computing device if voltage levels drop, and/or if voltage imbalance occurs, along with additional alert messaging capabilities to be provided by the transformer monitoring device where utility operator personnel would find value. The transformer monitoring device further has one or more onboard, and/or external wired and/or wireless environmental and/or transformer conditions sensor(s) and/or sensor packs, including a smoke sensor, ambient temperature sensor, external transformer temperature sensor, a fire/wildfire sensor (e.g., infrared camera, etc.).
assignees: GRID20/20 INC

title_en: Ecological protection restoration landslide drainage system
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide drainage system for ecological protection and restoration, which comprises a slope body and a protective structure arranged on the slope body, wherein the protective structure comprises a cement protective frame paved on the surface of the slope body and an anchoring piece arranged in the slope body, the anchoring piece comprises a columnar body, a drainage channel formed in the columnar body and a water permeable hole formed in the columnar body and communicated with the drainage channel, the end part of the columnar body is integrally arranged with the protective frame, one end of the drainage channel connected with the cement protective frame is communicated with the outside, the cement protective frame and the anchoring piece are integrally arranged by arranging the anchoring piece in the slope body, the strength of the cement protective frame is improved, the cement protective frame is prevented from slipping, the drainage channel is arranged in the anchoring piece, the water permeable hole is arranged in the side wall, and therefore water in the slope body can timely flow into the drainage channel through the water permeable hole, flows out along with the drainage channel, and reduces the risk of landslide.
assignees: SECOND GEOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT INVESTIG YARD OF HENAN PROVINCE GEOLOGICAL MINERAL EXPLORATION AND DEV

title_en: Interval data for a utility meter during a power outage without a battery
abstract_en: A utility meter includes a consumption measurement unit for generating consumption data, a meter processor, and a RTC for time stamping the consumption data to provide interval meter data during interval meter operation. A memory stores the interval meter data. The meter processor implements/initiates responsive to a power loss that suspends RTC operation, switching from interval to relative time operation where consumption data is stored as relative consumption data together with a relative time as relative meter data. Responsive power restoration and receiving a current time, the meter switches from relative time to interval meter operation. The restoration time is calculated using the current and an elapsed time since the restoration. The time of restoration and current time is used to generate calculated times. The consumption data from relative time operation is time stamped with the calculated times to provide time-corrected relative meter data that is stored to the memory.
assignees: HONEYWELL INT INC

title_en: Intelligent electric quantity restoration system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent electric quantity restoration system, which comprises a model construction subsystem and an electric quantity restoration subsystem; the method has the advantages that the transmission reliability analysis of communication signals is realized by constructing a position network and a packet network, meanwhile, the acquisition of the type of the power utilization terminal is realized, the local historical power utilization data of the power utilization terminal is combined, and the repairing waveform is generated in a weight superposition mode, so that the information can be fed back and repaired at the first time when the power utilization information is distorted, and the subsequent real-time complete analysis of the power utilization data is facilitated.

title_en: Soil heavy metal pollution early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soil heavy metal pollution early warning system, which adopts a neural network to analyze pollution factors and degree, backs up data through a cloud storage module, encrypts and manages the data through an intelligent contract and a block chain, can verify the integrity of the data, accurately locate data abnormity, encrypt information and effectively control the data safety problem caused by data destruction behaviors by virtue of a traceability chain while ensuring the integrity of monitored data, not only meets the data processing amount and processing speed in a big data era, facilitates the sharing and calling of polluted data, but also solves the problems of privacy disclosure, unsafe transmission and the like. The modules of the invention have definite, clear and complete description and close connection, and play a good early warning role on the heavy metal pollution of the soil, thereby guiding the pollution control and restoration and being beneficial to the engineering of the soil heavy metal pollution restoration technology.
assignees: RIVER AND SEA UNIV

title_en: Ecological environment restoration treatment method
abstract_en: An ecological environment restoration treatment method comprises the following steps: arranging an irrigation well in the center of the pit, and arranging water reservoirs around the outside of the irrigation well; slope protection and trimming are carried out on the side slopes around the pit, the bottom of the pit is leveled, and the topography of the bottom of the pit is gradually reduced from the periphery to the center; the method comprises the steps that a gravel layer, a mortar layer, a water-proof layer and a soil layer are sequentially arranged at the bottom of a pit from bottom to top; erecting an irrigation water supply pipeline system above the soil layer; according to the invention, ecological restoration is carried out on the pit of the mining area, so that the slope of the pit is planted with grass to prevent landslide, the bottom of the pit is flattened and provided with a water-resisting layer, a soil layer suitable for planting grain crops is paved, and an irrigation water supply pipeline system is arranged above the soil layer, so that automatic spray irrigation, pesticide spraying and fertilizer application are realized, mechanical cultivation operation can be realized, drought and waterlogging are ensured, the stability of an ecological system of the mining area is improved, and the cultivated area is increased for China.

title_en: Black-start partitioning method, system, storage medium and computing device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a black-start partition method, a system, a storage medium and computing equipment, wherein the state of a unit to be restored is considered, the unit to be restored in a thermal state is distributed to each black-start partition as evenly as possible, the power restoration speed of each partition is improved to the greatest extent on the premise that the basic requirement of the black-start partition is met, the difference of restoration time of each partition is reduced, the grid-connected waiting time of the black-start partition is shortened, and the power outage loss of a power grid is reduced.

title_en: First-aid repair full-flow method based on gridding distribution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a first-aid repair full-flow method based on gridding distribution, which comprises the following steps of: after the system receives the work order, the address of the fault position in the work order is analyzed, the analyzed longitude and latitude coordinates are led into a grid model which is constructed in advance, and the work order is distributed to a unit grid where the longitude and latitude coordinates are located; and generating an emergency repair scheme according to the fault position and the fault content of the work order, and selecting service personnel in the unit grid to execute the emergency repair scheme. The substantial effects of the invention include: the mode of gridding distribution is adopted to realize the automatic distribution of the work orders, the distribution is more accurate and faster, the first-aid repair efficiency is improved, and the first-aid repair power restoration time is shortened.
assignees: ZHEJIANG HANGZHOU CITY HANGZHOU AREA POWER SUPPLY LTD COMPANY OF STATE GRID;HANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF ZHEJIANG PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY OF STATE GRID

title_en: River channel ecological management method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a river channel ecological management method and a river channel ecological management system, and relates to the field of river channel ecological restoration. The method comprises the steps that firstly, at least two gabion nets in the river are transversely arranged in the river at intervals along the river flow direction in the river, a backflow pond is formed at the upstream of the gabion nets in the river, and aquatic vegetation is planted in the backflow pond; step two, presetting a flood water level, a design water level and a normal water level; planting flooding-resistant herbs and/or shrubs on the riverway or the side slope between the normal water level and the designed water level; and planting trees on the riverway or the side slope between the designed water level and the flood water level. Has the advantages that: the river channel can not only ensure the proper flow of the river, but also can not cause siltation formed by flood scouring, and can meet the flood standard for ten years; by means of the measures of arranging plants by matching arbor and shrub, original monotonous concrete gray of the revetment is covered, the diversity of ecological landscape of the river channel is realized, and the comprehensive ecological benefit is improved.
assignees: CHINESE GEOLOGICAL UNIV BEIJING

title_en: Impact Buffering Range Extended Quake Resistant Electric Distribution Cabinet
title_ko: 충격 완충 범위가 확장된 내진 기능 수배전반
abstract_en: The present invention provides a switchgear having an earthquake resistant function with an extended shock buffering range, which can more widely absorb and alleviate impacts caused by an earthquake with a large deviation transmitted to the switchgear. To this end, the present invention is provided with an earthquake resistant structure formed by embedding a standing spring and a horizontal backup spring in order to absorb and alleviate impact force applied from top, bottom, left, right, front, and rear sides, while in particular, a spiral spring, to which restoration force is imparted by winding thin metal plate, is installed on the inner side of the horizontal backup spring and a central shaft, protruding to a lower side of the bottom of a cabinet, passes a sleeve located at the center of the spiral spring. Accordingly, the present invention allows the existing standing spring and horizontal backup spring to handle impacts with high seismic intensity, and allows the spiral spring to handle impacts with very high frequency and low seismic intensity, such that many expensive electrical facilities embedded in the switchgear can be protected by absorbing and alleviating the impact energy with more wide-ranged seismic intensity, thereby enhancing reliability as well as a service life of the switchgear.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 수배전반에 전달되는 편차가 큰 크기의 지진에 의한 충격을 보다 폭넓게 흡수, 완화할 수 있도록 한 완충 범위가 확장된 내진 기능 수배전반을 개시한다. 
이를 위하여 본 발명은 상, 하, 좌, 우, 전, 후에서 가해지는 충격력을 흡수, 완화하기 위하여 기립스프링과 수평백업스프링을 내장하여서 된 내진구조체를 구비하되, 특히 상기 수평백업스프링 내측으로 얇은 금속판을 감아서 복원력을 부여한 스파이럴스프링을 설치하고, 상기 스파이럴스프링 중심의 슬리브에 캐비닛 저면 하방으로 돌출된 중심축이 관통되도록 한다. 
이에 따라, 본 발명은 높은 진도의 충격은 기존의 기립스프링과 수평백업스프링이 감당하게 되고 빈도가 매우 높은 낮은 진도의 충격은 스파이럴스프링이 감당하게 됨으로써 보다 보다 폭넓은 진도의 충격 에너지를 흡수, 완화하게 되어 수배전반에 내장된 많은 고가의 전기 설비들을 보호할 수 있게 됨으로써 수배전반의 수명은 물론 신뢰성을 향상시킬 수 있게 되는 완충 범위가 확장된 내진 수배전반을 제공하게 된다.
assignees: CHO SOOK HYUN;WON WOO RIM

title_en: NLP and KG technology-based power grid data intelligent management method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid data management, and discloses a power grid data intelligent management method based on NLP and KG technologies. According to the power grid data intelligent management method based on the NLP and KG technologies, the automatic construction of data assets and the guarantee of data quality are achieved through main data directory generation, data standard generation, quality rule engine generation and quality automatic exploration, data relation and influence chain analysis, automatic data problem restoration and the like.
assignees: SOUTHERN POWER GRID DIGITAL POWER GRID RES INSTITUTE LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: A soil and water protection device for mine ecological remediation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a water and soil protection device for mine ecological restoration, which comprises a base plate, wherein a positioning rod is fixedly connected to the lower surface of the base plate, a shielding mechanism is fixedly connected to the front surface of the base plate, a warning mechanism is fixedly connected to the back surface of the shielding mechanism, the shielding mechanism comprises two positioning disks fixedly connected to the front surface of the base plate, a rotating rod is movably connected to the inner parts of the positioning disks, a main pressing plate is fixedly connected to the outer side of the rotating rod, sliding grooves are formed in the left side and the right side of the main pressing plate, and side pressing plates are movably connected to the inner parts of the sliding grooves. This a soil and water protection device for mine ecological remediation, under the effect that shelters from the mechanism, makes the cooperation of main clamp plate and side pressure board, presses in the loose department of soil property, promotes its intensity, avoids the emergence of landslide phenomenon, and under the cooperation of protection network in warning mechanism simultaneously, encloses main clamp plate and side pressure board inside it, if the landslide phenomenon takes place, and utilizes the protection network to shelter from.
assignees: HEBEI PROVINCE GEOLOGICAL AND MINING BUREAU TERRITORIAL RESOURCE EXPLOR CENTER

title_en: Geological hidden danger point monitoring method and system considering heavy rainfall disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power disaster prevention and reduction, in particular to a geological hidden danger point monitoring method and system considering heavy rainfall disasters. The method and the system creatively realize the function of warning the influence level of the geological disaster, overcome the difficult problems that scientific calculation and visual display are difficult, and the influence of the geological disaster caused by heavy rainfall on the power transmission and distribution facilities is difficult, accurately reflect the monitoring data such as the displacement, the inclination angle and the like of the power transmission and distribution facilities, and support a production monitoring command center to guide the development of emergency work such as load transfer, facility reinforcement, emergency repair and restoration and the like.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE OF GUANGXI POWER GRID LIMITED RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY

title_en: Water and soil conservation measure combination method and system and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a water and soil conservation measure combination method, a device and electronic equipment, the method can carry out multiple combination on water and soil conservation measures according to user input measure parameters, the water and soil conservation measures and risk parameters, and adopts a mathematical average method to calculate the sand reduction flood reduction rate and the vegetation coverage restoration rate under different gradients, different soil types, different land utilization conditions and different water and soil conservation measure combination modes, and finally, the optimal configuration parameters of the water and soil conservation measures which reach the target are displayed, so that the efficiency of outputting the optimal configuration parameters of the water and soil conservation measures is improved, and the accuracy of the optimal configuration parameters of the water and soil conservation measures is also improved.
assignees: BEIJING FOREST UNIV

title_en: Full-service ubiquitous power Internet of things danger coefficient induction and fault repair system
abstract_en: The invention provides a full-service ubiquitous power Internet of things danger coefficient induction and fault restoration system which comprises a data acquisition module, a data storage module, a data receiving module, an edge calculation module, a data analysis module, a maintenance module, an intelligent meter box module, a control center and the like. The method has the advantages that the effects of comprehensive access, edge intelligence, multidimensional perception and safety protection can be achieved, various faults which are about to occur in the power system can be effectively and accurately predicted, dangerous situations of the power system can be timely resisted, the fault rate of the power system is effectively reduced, and the faults can be timely and effectively repaired to enable the power system to recover to a normal state.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER BRANCH COMPANY OF SHENGLI PETROLEUM ADMINISTRATION CO LTD OF CHINA PETROCHEMICAL GROU;UNIV QINGHUA

title_en: Waste quarry rock slope treatment and ecological restoration integrated design method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an integrated design method for treatment and ecological restoration of a rock slope of a waste quarry, which comprises the following steps: determining a treatment and restoration area of a waste quarry, determining geological disaster types induced by different areas based on the elevation of the area, and defining a slope instability-prone area and a slope stability area based on the geological disaster types, the regional climate and the ecological environment characteristics; and aiming at the easy-instability region of the side slope, a pre-stressed anchor rod reinforcing scheme is formulated to ensure the stability of the side slope, and an ecological restoration design method of the whole rock side slope is provided by combining the topographic and geological characteristics of the stable region of the side slope, so that the treatment and restoration of the abandoned quarry are completed. The invention can effectively solve the problems of singleness, non-systematicness and non-integrity in the field of waste mine treatment and ecological restoration.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG

title_en: Method and system for health rank based virtual machine restoration using a conformal framework
abstract_en: A method and system for health rank based virtual machine restoration using a conformal framework. With respect to enterprise data protection, solutions need to address two primary responsibilities: at the onset of failure or disaster, restore any running applications, as well as any lost or damaged data; and minimize (if not eliminate) the future occurrence of such failures or disasters. In tackling the latter responsibility, the disclosed method and system leverage health-score assessments to ensure the restoration of virtual machines onto healthy infrastructure. The aforementioned health-score assessments employ clustering to identify, and a conformal framework to rank, healthy hosts onto which virtual machines may be restored.
assignees: EMC IP HOLDING CO LLC

title_en: Muddy coast ecological restoration and disaster reduction space system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a muddy coast ecological restoration and disaster reduction space system, which is used for muddy coasts and comprises the following components: a double submerged dike protection system, a beach energy dissipation system and a vegetation ecosystem; the system adopts three levels of protection and repair means, comprises an outermost double submerged dike protection system, a middle sand beach energy dissipation system and a vegetation ecosystem close to inland, and forms a three-prevention integrated ecological disaster reduction space system; the influence of severe weather on the coast is effectively reduced, the ecological construction of beaches is enhanced, the diversity of plants and the stability of communities are improved, and the construction and treatment cost is reduced; the method has important effects on coastal ecological safety, improvement of regional disaster prevention and reduction capacity, improvement of regional ecosystem quality and promotion of high-quality development of marine economy.

title_en: Intelligent active filter system
abstract_en: The intelligent active filter system comprises an active filter body and an industrial personal computer, and also comprises a switching unit, a fault detection unit, a software updating unit, a prompting unit, a power supply quality detection unit, a networking control unit, a data transmission unit, a data receiving and controlling unit, a communication identification access unit and a communication simulation unit; the fault monitoring unit is also provided with a voiceprint and noise data acquisition subunit, a voiceprint and noise identification subunit and a database subunit. The device of the invention occupies less space, is more compact, reduces cost, can automatically realize communication networking between the devices after installation and maintenance, can realize communication simulation operation, can automatically switch to another device when a fault occurs, can display related managers to maintain when a corresponding part has a problem, can realize software restoration and update, can realize networking by active filters in different installation areas, can detect working data and performance, and can remotely control opening and closing and adjust output power.
assignees: ONTON SCIENCE AND TECH SHANGHAI LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Mining area soil restoration ecological net and restoration method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mining area ecological restoration, in particular to a mining area soil restoration ecological net and a restoration method thereof. According to the invention, the ground grabbing capacity of the block net is improved through the support columns, a certain distance is reserved between the block net and the slope surface, the water and soil holding capacity of the block net is increased, the loss and landslide of foreign soil are reduced, the anchor pipes are extruded by the expansion rods due to water absorption and expansion of soil in a short period through the arrangement of the anchor pipes, so that the anchor pipes are connected with the ground more firmly, and the block net, the anchor pipes and the expansion rods are gradually decomposed and disappear by microorganisms in the soil in a long period, so that the pollution to the environment is reduced, meanwhile, the continuous constraint and extrusion of green plant root systems are avoided, and the green plant growth is facilitated.
assignees: JIANGSU VOCATIONAL TECH COLLEGE FOR SHIPPING

title_en: Damaged mountain modeling, stability and design integrated analysis method based on remote sensing and GIS
abstract_en: A damaged mountain modeling, stability and design integrated analysis method based on remote sensing and GIS belongs to the technical field of damaged mountain ecological restoration. The integrated analysis technology is suitable for analyzing damaged mountain bodies with steep topography, and firstly, data are collected and used for assisting in early-stage route design; implementing unmanned aerial vehicle oblique photography according to the early-stage on-site survey condition and the route design parameters to obtain oblique multi-view image data with complete area; combining the acquired data and other parameter files, constructing a real-scene three-dimensional model of the measuring area by means of fine modeling software, and analyzing the stability of the real-scene three-dimensional model; and (5) carrying out geological disaster prevention and ecological restoration engineering design on the damaged mountain according to the model analysis result. The invention is an engineering example for accurately detecting and analyzing damaged mountain based on unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing, GIS and other means, and has important reference value for detecting and managing relevant damaged mountain.

title_en: Method and device for analyzing influence of blocked passage of post-earthquake road on building repair progress
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for analyzing influence of blocked road traffic on building repair progress after earthquake, and relates to the technical field of civil engineering and computers. The method comprises the following steps: according to the post-earthquake road trafficability condition, building an abstract model of the urban road network by adopting a scale-free network model; comprehensively considering factors such as road length, vehicle speed and road condition, post-earthquake road accessibility and the like, and calculating an optimal path of the vehicle to the restoration destination; selecting 'transportation time' as an evaluation index, and calculating delay time caused by single transportation; the delay time of single transportation is used as a basic unit, influences are split into each sub-project work of the repair project, the delay time of the overall project progress is calculated, and influences of road trafficability blockage on the building repair process after an earthquake occurs are quantified. The invention provides an optimal path selection method comprehensively considering influences of factors such as material transportation travel, vehicle speed and road trafficability based on post-earthquake road trafficability, and quantifies road influences by taking transportation time as an index.

title_en: Hillock-caving-volume-caving rapid vegetation recovery technology without soil preparation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of water and soil loss treatment, and discloses a rapid restoration method of collapsed vegetation without soil preparation. The collapsed volume is extremely aggressive and bad, the conditions of vegetation growing are poor, and the conventional collapsed volume vegetation recovery often needs to be firstly prepared with soil preparation engineering. According to the method, water and soil conservation herbaceous plants with the pressure-resistant burying characteristic are preferably planted firstly, then the surface erosion is prevented by using a mountain grass covering method, and the furrow erosion is prevented by building the branch check dam, so that a good field condition is provided for vegetation growth. According to the invention, the whole coverage of the collapsed body ground vegetation can be realized after 3-4 months of construction. The required materials can be basically obtained from local materials, and are particularly suitable for the treatment of collapse caused by traffic inconvenience. The invention successfully realizes vegetation restoration of the landslide body under the condition of no land preparation by taking various plant residues as assistance, and is a landslide control method adopting pure plant measures. Because the land preparation construction is not needed, a large amount of construction cost can be saved.
assignees: INST OF ECO ENVIRONMENT AND SOIL SCIENCES GUANGDONG ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Open pit ecological environment restoration treatment system
abstract_en: Open pit ecological environment restores treatment system, including pit side slope grass planting protective structure all around, the antiseep multilayer soil planting structure of pit bottom and the cistern of pit center department: the antiseep multilayer soil planting structure of pit bottom sets gradually bottom metalling, mortar layer, water barrier and soil horizon from bottom to top, and the inlet opening with soil horizon lower part intercommunication is all seted up all around to the pool wall of cistern, and the inlet opening outside is equipped with the stainless steel filter screen. According to the method, the open pit of the mining area is ecologically repaired, so that the side slope of the pit is planted with grass to prevent landslide, the bottom of the pit is flattened and provided with the water-proof layer, a soil layer suitable for planting grain crops is paved, fruits, vegetables and grain crops are planted on the soil layer, drought and waterlogging are prevented, the stability of the ecological system of the mining area is improved, and the cultivated land area is increased for the country.
assignees: EXPLORATION INSTITUTE GUANGDONG BUREAU OF COAL GEOLOGY CHINA NAT ADMINISTRATION OF COAL GEOLOGY

title_en: Method and related device for checking multiple objects of distribution network operation order
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a related device for checking multiple objects of a distribution network operation ticket, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring operation task information, operation step information and operation equipment information of an operation ticket, wherein the type of the operation ticket comprises: transferring power supply, power failure and power restoration; according to the disconnecting link gisid and the feeder line id to which the disconnecting link belongs in the operation step information, performing logic sequence checking on the operation step information of the operation ticket to obtain a logic checking result; according to the operating equipment information, performing text information check on the operating step information of the operating ticket to obtain a text check result; according to the operating equipment information, performing text information checking on the operating task information of the operating ticket to obtain a task text checking result; and feeding back the logic checking result, the step text checking result and the task text checking result to a user in a popup window mode. The problems that in the prior art, the labor cost for checking the operation tickets of the distribution network is high and the checking efficiency is extremely low are solved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Prevent ecological recovery structure of side slope of landslide and soil erosion and water loss
abstract_en: The utility model provides a slope ecological restoration structure for preventing landslide and water and soil loss, which comprises wood piles, bamboo chips, geotextile and ecological bags, wherein seeds and nutrient soil are filled in the ecological bags, and nursery stocks are planted at openings of the ecological bags; the timber pile is according to certain interval vertical fixation in the side slope, the bamboo chip dislocation cross fixation in the timber pile, geotechnological cloth is folded perpendicularly in the timber pile with the bamboo chip is followed side slope uphill direction one side, ecological bag stack in the timber pile is followed side slope uphill direction one side.
