According to the slope ecological restoration structure provided by the utility model, the surface layer water and soil loss is effectively prevented through the wood piles and the bamboo chips arranged on the slope, the fine grained soil loss is prevented through the reverse filtration effect of the geotextile, a good effect is achieved when the slope ecological restoration structure is applied to a region with serious water and soil loss in a dump, the surface layer landslide and the water and soil loss can be effectively prevented, and soil and nutrient elements required by vegetation growth can be ensured.
assignees: CHINA NERIN ENG CO LTD

title_en: Ecological permeable dam for improving water environment capacity of river channel
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a river course water environment among the environmental protection engineering water treatment handles technical field, especially relates to an ecological permeable dam for promoting river course water environment capacity, including building by laying bricks or stones the relative gabion on the riverbed, concrete foundation has been pour between the gabion, set up the ecological interception dam body that permeates water of seepage type on the concrete foundation. Based on the constructed wetland principle and the rapid infiltration mechanism, the capacity of a ditch in front of a dam is utilized to store river water, the controllable seepage of a permeable dam is intercepted through seepage type ecology to adjust the overflow of the dam, and meanwhile, the upstream water level is raised to provide enough water for upstream ecological restoration content; the biological filler-enriched runoff storage dam can block runoff and has a certain purification effect, and the runoff has certain retention time in the dam body, so that the water quality purification effect can be further improved through microorganisms enriched by the biological filler, and the river flood discharge is not influenced.
assignees: SHANDONG LYUZHIXING ENV ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Ecological ditch structure is restoreed in river course
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a riverway restoration ecological ditch structure, which comprises a riverbank, wherein a water channel is laid in the middle of the riverbank, a fine sand layer is laid above the water channel, a gravel layer is laid at the upper end of the fine sand layer, a planting layer is laid at the uppermost part of the gravel layer, side slopes are arranged on two sides above the water channel, planting grids are arranged on the side slopes, and landscape trees are planted on the planting grids. This ecological ditch structure is restoreed in river course, the planting check of echelonment has been set up on the both sides side slope of river levee, the planting that is used for the vegetation through the planting check repairs the river course side slope, avoid serious soil erosion and water loss and landslide phenomenon to appear in the side slope, ensure the planting and the reinforcement of vegetation on the side slope, and seted up the drain pipe on the planting check, communicate through drain pipe and river course bottom, ensure the water of the inside vegetation of planting check, and the vegetation net has been laid to the top of planting check, the online turf of planting of vegetation, cover the upper surface of planting check through the vegetation net, avoid the rainwater to produce to erode the damage to the planting check.
assignees: SHENZHEN MINGZHENG CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: System and method for generating power protection and supply full path diagram
abstract_en: The invention discloses a generating system of a power supply protection full path diagram, which comprises: the device comprises a basic data supporting module, an automatic drawing module, a drawing editing module and a drawing management module. According to the technical scheme, the method can replace manual work to carry out mechanical, repetitive and tedious work, continuously improve the dispatching operation efficiency of the distribution network, reduce the load of a basic layer, continuously improve the power supply reliability of the distribution network, and meet the requirements of quick power restoration of the fault of the distribution network and high-quality service of customers.
assignees: GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Fault line power restoration knowledge reasoning method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault line power restoration knowledge inference method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps of: s1, training a line fault handling Bert model; s2, constructing a fault line power restoration judgment data set; s3, constructing a fault line power restoration judgment deep learning model, and optimizing the model; s4, automatically collecting real-time collection data and advanced application analysis result data related to faults, and automatically retrieving related reference document knowledge information; s5, vectorizing and representing the standard format data and the knowledge information by using the line fault handling Bert model trained in S1; s6, carrying out reasoning calculation of the fault line power restoration judgment model; s7, analyzing the model reasoning result; s8, checking the reasoning result of the model; s9, judging whether the power recovery condition is met; s10, generating a line fault handling record; the scheme provides a quick, accurate, reliable and interpretable decision reference basis for improving the power grid fault handling efficiency and quickly recovering power supply.
assignees: SHAOXING POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Disaster recovery system of anomaly identification data center
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data centers, in particular to an abnormality recognition data center disaster recovery system, which comprises a production center and a disaster recovery center which are connected with each other, wherein the disaster recovery center comprises: the system comprises a data storage module for storing data in real time, a data mirror module for generating an identical copy of the data of a production center and storing the identical copy into the data storage module, a data replication module for copying the data of the production center and storing the copied data into the data storage module, and a central switching module for switching a front-end access node, so as to perform real-time backup on the data backup and simultaneously directly restore the data, and the problems of incomplete data backup and relatively long data restoration time.
assignees: JIANGSU PHOENIX DATA CO LTD

title_en: Self-resetting honeycomb beam node
abstract_en: The utility model provides a from honeycomb roof beam node that restores to throne, belongs to building steel technical field, including the intermediate beam section, intermediate beam section both ends are connected with the short beam section one end that corresponds respectively, and install the friction damper at the junction of short beam section and intermediate beam section, and the short beam section other end is connected with the frame post, and is provided with the steel strand wires between frame post and the short beam section simultaneously. The utility model discloses well roof beam-ends has added the self-reset node that has friction damper and power consumption bolt, and it is an integral node, and the friction damper that this structure was added makes its damage that can the effective control major structure in the earthquake and shake the characteristic that the back has the retrieval function with the power consumption bolt, and it is with low costs to shake the back restoration, and the shock resistance is big. The utility model discloses reducing under self weight condition, can also forming the continuous sheet at the web department welding negative reinforcement of adjacent centre sill section, the overall structure firmness that makes roof beam and building combine back formation is high, and the shock resistance improves by a wide margin.
assignees: UNIV SHENYANG JIANZHU

title_en: Slope supporting structure for mine restoration
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a side slope bearing structure for mine restoration, including the bank protection bed frame, the top fixed connection of bank protection bed frame has the foundation layer, one side fixedly connected with gravel layer of bank protection bed frame is kept away from to the foundation layer, one side fixedly connected with cement layer of foundation layer is kept away from to the gravel layer, one side fixedly connected with gravel layer of gravel layer is kept away from on the cement layer. The utility model discloses a set up the bank protection bed frame, the cement layer, the vegetable layer, the gravel layer, a baffle, pressing plates, the protection network, the dead lever, a spring, the cooperation of guide bar and connecting plate is used, it is comparatively single to the structure of prevention massif landslide usually in the use to have solved current mine restoration and used side slope bearing structure, make it can not play fine prevention effect to soil erosion and water loss, and be not convenient for usually change ageing protection network, can probably lead to the fact the problem of certain influence for people's safety and staff's work efficiency in the use.
assignees: QINGHAI BRANCH OF CHINA NAT GEOLOGICAL EXPLORATION CENTER OF BUILDING MATERIALS INDUSTRY

title_en: Distribution network maintenance safety measure checking method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a distribution network overhaul safety measure checking method, which comprises the steps of obtaining an overhaul application working place input by a user; and checking at least one of the power failure safety measures, the power restoration safety measures and the power conversion safety measures of the maintenance application work place by utilizing a preset distribution network power failure maintenance safety measure checking model. By implementing the method and the device, the workload can be reduced, and the risk of missing audit or incomplete consideration can be reduced.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Constructed wetland system for river-core continent and flood plain
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial wetland system for river-center continents and flood lands, which mainly comprises the following steps that 1) an artificial wetland is arranged into a second-level ladder type, wherein a first-level ladder is an emergent aquatic plant planting area, and a second-level ladder is a irrigation and grass mixed planting area; 2) The outer side of the first-stage ladder of the constructed wetland is provided with a sand setting device; 3) Spraying an erosion-resistant planting substrate layer with the thickness of 3-5cm on the surface of the constructed wetland region; 4) Respectively selecting plants in the emergent aquatic plant planting area and the arbor-shrub mixed planting area according to local climatic environment conditions; 5) Mixing the seeds into the matrix, spraying the mixture on the surface of the matrix layer in the corresponding area, and forming a seed layer with the thickness of 2 cm. The invention effectively solves the problems that the constructed wetland technology is easy to cause sediment accumulation and difficult to preserve plants when applied to the river core continents and the river flood lands, reduces the exposed area of the river core continents and the river flood lands in the dead water period, reduces the wind-blown sand source, prevents sediment accumulation, further expands the river core continents and the river flood lands, and realizes ecological restoration.

title_en: water heater
abstract_en: To provide a water heater which can perform an operation while assuming a disaster even if the operation is not performed by a user when power interruption caused by the disaster occurs.SOLUTION: A water heater comprises control means for detecting the occurrence of power interruption and restoration from the power interruption, and operation means which can be operated by a user. The water heater can perform an operation in a temporary power interruption mode, and an operation in a disaster power interruption mode. When the control means detects the restoration from the power interruption after the detection of the occurrence of the power interruption, the control means makes the operation means issue a notification for prompting to select either of the temporary power interruption mode or the disaster power interruption mode. After the lapse of a certain amount of time from the execution of the notification by the operation means, when either of the temporary power interruption mode or the disaster power interruption mode is not selected, the operation in the disaster power interruption mode is performed.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2
assignees: MITSUBISHI ELECTRIC CORP

title_en: Method and system for optimizing recovery sequence of damaged facilities after disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimization method of a recovery sequence of a post-disaster damaged facility, which comprises the following steps: constructing a recovery sequence model of the damaged facility according to the attribute information of the damaged facility, the attribute information of the user, the attribute information of the facility-user service arc and the decision information; iteratively solving the damaged facility recovery sequence model by using a heuristic algorithm to obtain an optimized feasible solution of the damaged facility recovery sequence; and according to the damaged facility recovery sequence optimization feasible solution, recovering the damaged facility. The invention also provides an optimization system, electronic equipment and a storage medium for the recovery sequence of the post-disaster damaged facilities.
assignees: UNIV SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CHINA

title_en: Power grid dispatching and field operation ticket generating method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for generating a power grid dispatching and field operation ticket, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a line to be powered off in a GIS single line diagram and/or a main switch distribution diagram; the line to be power-off is used for determining a power-off line segment; determining head-end equipment and tail-end equipment in the power failure line section; generating a corresponding operation task description based on the head-end equipment and the tail-end equipment; collecting the operation task description, the head-end equipment and the tail-end equipment to generate a scheduling power-off operation order; the scheduling power-off operation ticket comprises: the method comprises the following steps of (1) power failure line segment information, head end equipment information, tail end equipment information, operation step information and operation project information; and identifying the operation step information and the operation item information, and generating a corresponding field power failure and power restoration operation order by combining the operation task description. Therefore, the method replaces the mode that the existing dispatcher and field personnel agree to fill in the operation ticket, and the dispatching efficiency is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Smart circuit breaker, system including the same, and method of managing power
abstract_en: A smart circuit breaker includes a communication interface, separable contacts, a processing unit having a memory with a routine stored therein which, when executed by the processing unit causes the processing unit to: sense a power outage in an electrical grid, control a meter to open contacts to disconnect from the electrical grid, sense power restoration to the electrical grid, control contacts corresponding to a secondary power source to open, control the meter to close contacts to reconnect to the electrical grid, sense that a frequency of power from the electrical grid matches a frequency of power from the secondary power source, and control the contacts corresponding to the secondary power source to close.
assignees: EATON INTELLIGENT POWER LTD

title_en: Drainage system for landslide ecological restoration
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological restoration, in particular to a drainage system for landslide ecological restoration, which comprises a slope body, a protective structure and a reinforcing platform, wherein at least one horizontal water intercepting groove extending horizontally is arranged on the slope body, a supporting grid chamber is arranged at the position of the horizontal water intercepting groove, the supporting grid chamber is provided with a drainage hole, and top openings of a first vertical water collecting well and a second vertical water collecting well are positioned below the drainage hole of the supporting grid chamber; be provided with the overflow mouth in the first vertical sump pit, overflow mouth department is provided with first vertical sump pit of the oblique drainage channel intercommunication of bowing and second vertical sump pit, and the vertical sump pit open-top of second passes through the shutoff of plugging block, and the second that the vertical sump pit bottom of second set up bows oblique drainage channel and communicates to the cistern of consolidating the inside setting of platform, and this technical scheme accelerates the speed of drainage through the vertical sump pit of second when precipitation is great, different drainage speed when having realized different precipitation.

title_en: Prediction method for underground water level recovery amount
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a method for predicting underground water level restoration amount, which includes: establishing a grid model for the target planting area, wherein the grid model comprises a plurality of grid units; acquiring grid crop irrigation water demand and sustainable irrigation water supply according to each grid unit, and acquiring annual crop net water consumption of each grid unit and annual accumulated crop net water consumption of each grid unit; obtaining the accumulated crop net water consumption of each grid unit in a target period according to the crop net water consumption year by year and the accumulated crop net water consumption year by year; acquiring underground water level monitoring data from each monitoring station, and performing relation fitting on the water level monitoring data and the annual accumulated crop net water consumption; predicting the grid fitting coefficient of each grid unit according to the fitting coefficient of the monitoring station; and obtaining groundwater level recovery data of each grid unit in the target period. The method and the device can be used for continuously utilizing underground water resources and provide a feasible scheme for recovering the underground water level in the future.

title_en: Restoration planning apparatus, restoration planning method, and restoration planning program
abstract_en: To provide a technique for formulating a restoration plan in consideration of a gap between a real-time estimated value of a damage level assumed in the event of a disaster and a damage level assumed in advance.SOLUTION: A restoration planning apparatus 11 includes: a probability density distribution calculation unit (calculation unit) 113 which calculates a probability density distribution indicating an occurrence probability density of a damage level of a damage which occurs due to a predetermined disaster, for each restoration object, in the restoration objects which are facilities to be restored or areas to be restored; a priority calculation unit (setting unit) 114 which receives a real-time estimated value of a damage level of the damage in each restoration object assumed based on the disaster in the event of the disaster, integrates probability densities of a differential section between the real-time estimated value of the damage level and a true value of the damage level of the probability density distribution, and sets priority of changing restoration plans of the restoration objects in descending order of an integrated values, respectively; and a priority display unit (display unit) 115 which displays the priority changing the restoration plans in association with each of the restoration objects, on a screen.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: NIPPON TELEGRAPH & TELEPHONE;UNIV TOHOKU

title_en: Operation confirmation system
abstract_en: To provide an operation confirmation system that can display operation information on a power generation facility even when the Internet line is temporarily cut off due to power outage and restoration of the Internet line is slower than start-up of a web browser.SOLUTION: An operation confirmation system has an operation information acquisition unit, a web server, and a content display unit. The web server and the content display unit are connected with each other via the Internet. The content display unit has a storage unit that stores a program file that can be read and executed by the web browser. The program file executes a connection confirmation operation in a predetermined interval until the content display unit becomes accessible to the web server, and on a condition that the content display unit has become accessible to the web server according to the connection confirmation operation, acquires a first web content from the web server with the web browser.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3
assignees: KANEKA CORP

title_en: Unpowered reclaimed water recycling urban three-dimensional agriculture-urban ecological restoration system
abstract_en: A smart city Internet of things reclaimed water recycling ecological circle zeroing and unpowered reclaimed water recycling urban three-dimensional agriculture/urban ecological restoration system is also called a sponge water-saving urban and artificial wetland ecological corridor; absorb carbon dust, PM2.5 particulate matter haze and noise. The system conforms to the world agricultural development and urban ecological agricultural construction, reduces the damage of the existing reclaimed water utilization mode to the urban ecological environment, omits the municipal construction investment of huge fund for reclaimed water reuse, and is modularly designed; convenient installation, simple maintenance, plant aquatic organism harvesting and full-automatic road cleaning. The system is linked with the Internet of things of a smart city, the intelligent scheduling operation of a reclaimed water reuse three-dimensional agricultural system is realized, the urban flood discharge and underground water storage capacity is multiplied, and the aims of reducing three wastes, not discharging sewage to rivers, lakes and seas and recovering the urban ecology are basically fulfilled.
assignees: WU ZHIYUAN

title_en: TransCGAN-based seismic data reconstruction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a seismic data reconstruction method based on transcGA, which comprises the following steps: step 010: randomly deleting the complete earthquake set to obtain a deleted set; step 020: training the missing set through a transCGAN network to obtain a prediction set; the transCGAN network comprises adjustable parameters; step 030: scoring the prediction set and the seismic integrity set similarly by a discriminator; step 041: comparing the score with a threshold, adjusting the parameter through an optimizer when the score is lower than the threshold, and executing step 020; step 042: and comparing the score with a threshold, and finishing the transCGAN network training when the score is not lower than the threshold to obtain a seismic data reconstruction model. By the method, the seismic data can be restored to more than 90 percent, and the accuracy of data reconstruction and the data restoration proportion are greatly improved.
assignees: UNIV CHINA PETROLEUM EAST CHINA

title_en: Transformer substation power failure and restoration operation system and method based on Beidou high-precision positioning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transformer substation power failure and restoration operation system and method based on Beidou high-precision positioning, which comprises the following steps: the master station operation control system is in wireless connection with the operation terminal system; the master station operation control system comprises a data storage module, and the data storage module is connected with an operation processing module; the operation processing module is connected with the master station wireless communication module; the operation terminal system comprises a terminal wireless communication module which is respectively connected with the operation guidance module and the navigation guidance module; the operation guidance module and the navigation guidance module are respectively connected with the Beidou high-precision positioning module; the method solves the technical problems that in the prior art, the interval of operation and maintenance personnel is judged by methods such as image recognition of substation equipment labels and the like in substation operation management, the recognition error rate is high, the recognition capability at night is poor, misoperation is easy to occur, and the like.
assignees: POWERCHINA GUIZHOU ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Landslide monitoring devices for ecological restoration of mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide monitoring device for mine ecological restoration, belonging to the technical field of monitoring equipment; the device comprises a mounting rack, a first detection mechanism, a second detection mechanism and a signal emission mechanism; the first detection mechanism comprises a collecting cylinder, and a first contact block and two water outlet pipes which are symmetrically arranged are arranged on the collecting cylinder; the second detection mechanism comprises a detection rod, a contact is fixedly arranged on the detection rod, the detection rod is arranged on a pneumatic assembly, and the pneumatic assembly comprises a contact plate; the signal emission mechanism comprises two signal bullet emission barrels, the signal bullets are filled in the signal bullet emission barrels, and when the first detection mechanism or the second detection mechanism detects the danger of landslide, the signal bullet emission barrels emit the signal bullets. According to the invention, the vicinity of the mine is automatically monitored through the first detection mechanism, the second detection mechanism and the signal emission mechanism, so that the risk of landslide can be predicted in advance, and the device has a simple structure and is convenient to operate.
assignees: ZHONGDI SHANSHUI BEIJING ENVIRONMENTAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network fault recovery method based on Monte Carlo tree search and neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution network fault restoration, in particular to a power distribution network fault restoration method based on Monte Carlo tree search and a neural network, which comprises the following steps of 1, acquiring an active power flow matrix and a regional restoration time matrix of a power distribution network, and constructing a power distribution network fault restoration process through the representation of the active power flow matrix and the regional restoration time matrix; the regional repair time matrix is obtained after the historical repair time of each regional feeder line of the power distribution network is processed, and step 2, a reference value, a constraint condition and a state space of an action space of fault recovery are confirmed, wherein the constraint condition is resource constraint of fault recovery, the state space is a set of power distribution network states, and the action space is a set of repair decisions. The method can enable the maintenance guidance scheme to be applied to actual maintenance procedures filled with various accidents and compromises.

title_en: Method, system, medium and processor for calculating splitting and load of feeder line power supply section
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, a medium and a processor for splitting and load calculation of a feeder line power supply section. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a single feeder XML model file of a selected feeder provided by a GIS system; carrying out topology analysis on the single feeder xml model file, and generating a basic feeder topology tree corresponding to the selected feeder by taking a transformer substation outgoing switch as a root node and taking a distribution transformer and tie switch as leaf nodes; splitting a power supply section of the net rack of the selected feeder line according to different switch types to obtain a corresponding recovery power supply section; copying the basic feeder topology tree according to the restoration capability power supply section to generate a corresponding sub feeder topology tree; performing load calculation according to the sub feeder topology tree; the time complexity of the processing mode is low, and the high efficiency of load calculation is ensured.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Assembled reinforced concrete pier based on grouting sleeve
abstract_en: The utility model provides a based on grout sleeve assembled reinforced concrete pier belongs to bridge engineering technical field to solve traditional pier frusta face when receiving the great seismic force of load capacity, take place bending deformation fracture even easily, restore very trouble problem, including the cushion cap subassembly: the bottom of the grouting sleeve structure is connected with the bearing platform assembly; the bottom of the pier stud assembly is connected with a grouting sleeve structure; one end of the top of the external energy consumption device is connected with the pier stud assembly; the pier stud in the device is prefabricated in a workshop, a bearing platform can be prefabricated in the workshop or cast in place, and two components are connected and installed in the site by a grouting sleeve; in order to improve the seismic performance of the bridge, an energy consumption device is arranged outside the pier stud body and used for absorbing seismic wave energy and preventing the seismic waves from further propagating to the upper part of the bridge body; the bridge anti-seismic design is facilitated, and the bridge anti-seismic method is suitable for rapid bridge restoration after an earthquake disaster.
assignees: WANG RIXIN

title_en: Distribution network self-recovery method based on distributed resources
abstract_en: The invention provides a distribution network self-recovery method based on distributed resources, which is used for constructing a black start process recovery characteristic model aiming at different types of power supplies, constructing a distributed resource start sequence optimization model aiming at maximizing available power generation amount and active load recovery amount, constructing a comprehensive path evaluation index based on node importance and path recovery time to optimize a recovery path of a unit to be started, and repeatedly solving the start sequence optimization model, the recovery path optimization model and the load recovery optimization model according to time steps to obtain a final distribution network recovery scheme, so that power outage loads are input in time-sharing steps to minimize power outage loss, and meanwhile, the recovery resources are effectively allocated in consideration of the load recovery sequence, so that the rapidity and the stability of a distribution system recovery process are improved.

title_en: Dynamic simulation and scheduling method and device for coupling water quantity-water quality-aquatic organism integrated community
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic simulation and scheduling method and device for a coupling water quantity-water quality-aquatic organism integrated community, which can quantify the ecological response of an aquatic community to water quantity and water quality and provide scientific basis for key river and lake ecological flow, ecological restoration and scheduling. The method comprises the following steps: step 1, determining a research scene, collecting measured data of a research area, and determining an influence factor and a decision variable of population dynamics; step 2, considering the interaction relationship among multiple populations, the water quantity and water quality effect, population immigration and emigration and the influence of other factors, and constructing a dynamic model of the integrated community coupling the water quantity, the water quality and the aquatic organisms; step 3, calculating the ecological niche width, the environment optimal value and the competition coefficient parameter value in the aggregated community dynamic model based on a quantile regression method and an ecological niche theory; and 4, simulating a collaborative evolution process of a multi-population system in the collective population, and determining the influence degree of water quantity and water quality on the dynamic state of the collective population.
assignees: UNIV WUHAN

title_en: Method for determining optimal underground water burial depth of grassland vegetation communities in semiarid area
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ecological and environment-friendly hydrology and water conservancy, and provides a method for determining the optimal underground water burial depth of grassland vegetation communities in semiarid regions, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: determining vegetation community compositions and community species compositions in a grassland vegetation ecosystem of a research area; step two: establishing a regional vegetation species physiological characteristic database and a regional soil attribute database; step three: calculating capillary water rising height of each vegetation community distribution area; step four: determining the relationship between the root systems of different vegetation species and the maximum rising height of capillary water; step five: and calculating the optimal underground water burial depth of the grassland vegetation community. The method for determining the optimal buried depth of the grassland vegetation community in the semi-arid region has clear physical process and action mechanism, has universality for determining the optimal buried depth of the grassland vegetation community, a grassland underground water level control target and the like, and provides reliable theoretical and technical support for guiding the protection and ecological restoration of the grassland in the semi-arid region.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Pseudo-ginseng cultivation soil replantation risk evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for evaluating the risk of replanting of pseudo-ginseng cultivation soil, which belongs to the technical field of pseudo-ginseng cultivation, wherein after measuring each evaluation index in the soil, each index is subjected to risk classification, and when all the evaluation indexes are in the soil with low risk level, the risk of replanting pseudo-ginseng is lower; pseudo-ginseng can be continuously planted; a part of evaluation indexes, especially the soil with the quantity of pathogenic bacteria and the content of chemosensory substances in the soil at medium risk or medium and high risk levels, show that the re-planted pseudo-ginseng has a certain safety risk, and the management of water and fertilizer medicines should be enhanced in the growth process of the re-planted pseudo-ginseng, so that the phenomenon that the pseudo-ginseng obstacle factors such as soil-borne pathogenic bacteria accumulate too fast and threaten the healthy growth of the re-planted pseudo-ginseng is avoided. All the measurement indexes are in the soil with medium or high risk level, which indicates that the risk of re-planting pseudo-ginseng is extremely high, effective soil restoration measures should be immediately taken, and re-planting can be considered after the risk level of the risk evaluation index is reduced, otherwise, the pseudo-ginseng is not recommended to be planted continuously.

title_en: Reconstruction method of mine ecological restoration soil system
abstract_en: The invention provides a reconstruction method of a mine ecological restoration soil system, and relates to the technical field of mine soil restoration. The method comprises the following steps: step S1: treating the side slope and preventing the side slope from sliding; step S2: digging surface soil; step S3: crushing surface soil; step S4: adding a repair liquid into the surface soil, wherein the repair liquid is used for reducing heavy metal pollution in the surface soil and/or is used for fattening the surface soil; step S5: watering the surface soil; step S6: and respectively sowing grass seeds and planting trees in different areas of the surface soil. When the mine ecology is restored and the soil system is reconstructed, the side slope which is easy to generate landslide is treated firstly so as to prevent the side slope from landslide. After the surface soil is crushed, the repair liquid is added into the surface soil, so that heavy metal pollution in the surface soil can be reduced, and the corresponding repair liquid can be selected to fertilize the surface soil, so that a soil system is reconstructed, and land resources are protected.

title_en: Power grid power failure monitoring method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for monitoring power failure of a power grid, wherein the method comprises the following steps: detecting whether a newly-added power failure event exists, and if so, acquiring power failure data corresponding to the newly-added power failure event; judging whether the newly-added power failure event is a power determining event or not according to a preset power failure correction model and power failure data, if not, analyzing the power failure data according to a preset power failure analysis model to obtain a power determining matching degree corresponding to the newly-added power failure event, wherein the power determining matching degree is used for determining a power restoration scheme for processing the newly-added power failure event; and determining a power restoration parameter corresponding to the newly increased power failure event according to the determined power restoration matching degree and the determined power restoration monitoring model, and generating a corresponding target power restoration scheme according to the power restoration parameter, so that power restoration personnel can process the newly increased power failure event according to the target power restoration scheme. Therefore, the method and the device can automatically verify the accuracy of the newly increased power failure events to screen out repeated and wrong power failure events, and improve the generation efficiency of the subsequent power restoration scheme and the reliability of the generated power restoration scheme.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Low-power-consumption railway disaster monitoring equipment based on MEMS sensor
abstract_en: The utility model provides a low-power consumption railway disaster monitoring facilities based on MEMS sensor, its characterized in that: the system comprises an MCU module, a communication module, a GNSS module, a Beidou module, an MEMS module, a TF card module, an AD sampling module and an alarm transmission system debugging module, wherein the communication module, the GNSS module, the Beidou module, the MEMS module, the TF card module, the AD sampling module and the alarm transmission system debugging module are connected with the MCU module; the MEMS module adopts an ICM-20948 chip, a 16-bit ADC is integrated in the chip, and the working voltage is not lower than 1.71V; the chip is connected with a nine-axis acceleration sensor, a built-in temperature sensor, a communication interface and an interrupt interface, and the nine-axis acceleration sensor wakes up the MCU module through an external interrupt pin when the MEMS module vibrates or displaces. The utility model discloses awaken up the report based on MEMS sensor monitoring vibrations, measure absolute displacement and monitoring relative displacement through high accuracy GNSS module, can predict the emergence of calamity in advance, increase the restoration means, reduce economic loss.
assignees: JIANGSU QITAI INTERNET OF THINGS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for automatically studying and judging power failure event progress
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for automatically studying and judging the progress of a power failure event, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining the work order information of the current power failure event of the power failure information pool; acquiring real-time data information matched with the current power failure event from an automatic system associated with a power failure information pool according to the work order information; determining the progress of the current power failure event according to the real-time data information; wherein the automation system comprises one or more of a dispatch automation system, a distribution automation system, and a metering automation system. Therefore, the method and the device can study and judge the progress of the power failure event in real time, and improve the real-time performance and the accuracy of power failure and power restoration monitoring.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Intelligent networking type movable floating device for modular basin governance
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent networking type movable floating device for modular watershed management. The prior art can not monitor the water quality of the designated position in the flow field and the hydraulic structure; the cost is high in the plugging emergency rescue process. The invention is a hexagonal hull structure, and the top area is used for the production and storage of electric energy; the middle area is a functional area, the central control area is used for receiving, processing and transmitting signals, the hydrological monitoring area is used for monitoring hydrological information at a specified position in a basin, the water quality monitoring area is used for monitoring the water quality condition at a specific position in the basin, the nondestructive detection area is used for monitoring a hydraulic structure in the basin, the structure restoration area is used for storing a plugging filling material of the hydraulic structure, and a dredging device and water body aeration and water quality restoration microorganism equipment are arranged in the ecological restoration area; the bottom area is provided with special equipment and a driving device. The invention can quickly reach any place, quickly plug the dike breach through splicing and combining, and improve the emergency rescue efficiency.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY FIRST SURVEY & DESIGN INST GROUP LTD

title_en: Method and device for predicting pollutant solute distribution under karst landform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for predicting pollutant solute distribution under karst landform, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting pollutant solute concentration and karst landform characteristics in a preset time period, and determining the time and model parameters of the pollutants arriving through a plurality of migration paths based on the pollutant solute concentration and the karst landform characteristics in the preset time period; constructing a three-stage truncated fractional order solute transport model based on the contaminant solute concentration within the preset time period, the time the contaminant arrives through the plurality of transport paths, and the model parameters; and collecting the current pollutant solute concentration, and inputting the current pollutant solute concentration into the three-stage truncated fractional order solute transport model to generate pollutant solute distribution. According to the method, a three-stage truncation fractional order solute migration model is used for simulating a solute migration process in an aquifer under a karst landform, the pollutant and solute distribution of a target area is identified, and data support is provided for underground karst water pollution assessment and restoration.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CORP

title_en: Side slope recovery structure embedded with climbing plants
abstract_en: The utility model provides a side slope recovery structure of embedding climbing plant. The side slope restoration structure embedded with the climbing plants comprises: planting hole and climbing plant embedded in the planting hole and wrapped by degradable nutrition pot. The side slope restoration structure embedded with the climbing plants has the characteristics of preventing landslide and water and soil loss and ensuring that the slope body is evergreen in winter.
assignees: QINGDAO ZHONGYUANYE ECOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for ecological restoration and treatment of mountain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for restoring and treating mountain ecology, which comprises the following steps: and S1, mountain division, namely dividing the mountain to be repaired into a mountain exposed out of rock stratum or a mountain exposed out of broken stone on the mountain, and dividing the mountain to be repaired into a top platform, a slope slate and a slag slope according to expression forms with different heights and degrees. By the method, the structure of the mountain is changed, buffering can be achieved, the stability of the mountain is improved, landslide and collapse of the mountain are reduced, water and soil loss can be retarded, the living soil environment of plants can be rebuilt on the damaged mountain, a new vegetation community of the damaged mountain can be rapidly derived, long-term manual maintenance and management cost after the existing damaged mountain is repaired can be avoided, ecological environment-friendly repair in the true sense can be achieved, the effect is good, and the efficiency is high.
assignees: XUZHOU JIUZHOU ECOLOGICAL GARDEN CO LTD

title_en: Assembled viscoelastic damping device and concrete frame node of restoration reinforcing
abstract_en: The invention discloses an assembled viscoelastic damping device and a concrete frame node for repairing and enhancing, which comprise an assembled viscoelastic damping device, a viscoelastic damping block and a connecting piece unit; the assembly type viscoelastic damping devices are symmetrically arranged around the earthquake damage concrete frame node, and adjacent assembly type viscoelastic damping units are assembled and connected by adopting connecting piece units to form a closed integral damping system; the assembled viscoelastic damping device comprises two arc-shaped middle steel plates, viscoelastic material blocks, constraint steel plates and connecting steel plates, wherein the middle steel plates, the viscoelastic material blocks and the outer constraint steel plates are connected in an assembled mode through the combination of pretightening force and powerful adhesion exerted by a plurality of pretightening bolts.
assignees: UNIV XIAN ARCHITECTUR & TECH

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for calculating workload of dispatcher
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for calculating workload of a dispatcher. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of maintenance lists corresponding to the current value dispatcher and the execution condition of each maintenance list; acquiring the power failure workload, the power restoration workload and the equipment starting workload corresponding to the current value dispatcher according to the execution condition of each maintenance order; and acquiring the work load amount corresponding to the current value dispatcher according to the power failure work load amount, the power restoration work load amount and the equipment starting work load amount corresponding to the current value dispatcher. According to the technical scheme of the embodiment, the power failure workload, the power restoration workload and the equipment starting workload are calculated according to the maintenance order execution condition of the current value dispatcher, and then the total workload is calculated, so that the real-time calculation of the workload of the local dispatching dispatcher can be realized, the accurate evaluation of the workload state can be realized, and the rationality of dispatching work arrangement can be improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;HUIZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method for ecological restoration of waterfowl breeding habitat
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological restoration, in particular to a method for restoring the ecology of a waterfowl breeding habitat. According to the method, the existing bird species, the vegetation conditions, the water quality and the breeding risk are investigated, so that an ecological restoration scheme and a construction management strategy are conveniently formulated according to the obtained investigation result; because habitat restoration is a long-term and dynamic process, the restoration target of the waterfowl breeding habitat needs to be determined, meanwhile, the target bird species is determined, and the ecological requirements of the target waterfowl on the habitat are analyzed; the inhabitation demand and the breeding demand of the target bird species are fully considered, and the quality of the aquatic bird breeding habitat is improved through strategies such as functional area division, habitat design, hydrological management and plant configuration; the diversity of waterfowl communities is monitored during the overwintering season of each year, and the reproductive success of various waterfowl species is monitored during the reproductive season of each year. And comparing various indexes before and after ecological restoration, and evaluating the ecological restoration effect.
assignees: SOUTH CHINA BOTANICAL GARDEN CAS;GUANGDONG PROVINCIAL LABORATORY OF SOUTHERN MARINE SCIENCE AND ENG GUANGZHOU

title_en: Power system partition recovery method and device based on hierarchical analysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for recovering a power system partition based on hierarchical analysis, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring power supply parameters of all power supplies in a to-be-recovered power system partition according to a preset evaluation index; constructing a main power supply selection model aiming at the to-be-recovered power system partition based on an analytic hierarchy process; constructing a first judgment matrix, a second judgment matrix and a third judgment matrix; after passing consistency check, calculating a comprehensive weight vector of each power supply by combining each weight vector; and the power supply with the maximum comprehensive weight vector is used as a main power supply for recovery. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the priority of each power supply is determined by analyzing the levels, considering the time criterion and the power generation criterion and determining the main power supply of the power system partition based on the indexes such as the starting time, the climbing speed, the rated capacity and the distance from the power supply to the important load, so that the technical problem of long power restoration time of the load is solved, more loads are restored in a short time, and the restoration efficiency is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Self-resetting energy-consumption beam column node with prestressed stay cables
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a take prestressing force suspension cable from restoring to throne power consumption beam column node in beam column node structure technical field, be located the concrete beam of the steel frame post left and right sides including steel frame post and interval, the node end of concrete beam is fixed and is provided with the I-steel roof beam, the web of the left and right sides I-steel roof beam pastes the near-end and extends formation round hole articulated end each other, two round hole articulated ends are articulated through power consumption high strength bolt, a plurality of interval distribution's beam cable preformed hole and post cable preformed hole and connect the prestressing force suspension cable all have been seted up on the wall of the left and right sides of both sides concrete beam and steel frame post, can strengthen the anti-seismic performance and the wholeness of node, reduce the cross-section damage, the good power consumption effect of friction that returns of performance and power consumption bolt of application prestressing force suspension cable, make the structure residual deformation reduce after the earthquake, the replaceability of while suspension cable and power consumption component facilitates for the architectural restoration after the earthquake with the characteristic of assembled, and can guarantee the overall safety of structure greatly.
assignees: FUJIAN JINDING CONSTRUCTION DEV CO LTD;UNIV FUZHOU

title_en: Folding wings of aerogenerator
title_ko: 탄성 복원형 접철식 풍력발전기용 날개
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an elastic-restoration type foldable wing for a wind turbine and, more specifically, to an elastic-restoration type foldable wing for a wind turbine, wherein since blades are made to be tilted backward by a spring, even in case of a super strong wind such as a typhoon, the blades are tilted backward separately in accordance with wind pressure exerted to each of the blades without separate pitch control, and when the wind pressure exerted to the blades decreases, the blades are automatically restored forward by elasticity, thereby preventing damage to the wing and reducing a load applied to a wind turbine and fatigue applied to the blades. In accordance with one advisable embodiment of the present invention, the wing for a wind turbine, which is provided to a wind power facility and actuating a generator through a power transmission mechanism transmitting a rotation force when rotated by wind power, includes: a rotary shaft formed horizontally, having a fixing part formed at a front end, and having a plurality of hinge parts formed to be protruding from an outer circumferential surface of the fixing part; a blade having one shaft part formed on one side, and fixed to the hinge parts through a shaft pin to be rotated around the shaft pin; and a spring having both ends connected with the fixing part of the rotary shaft and the blade respectively, in a state in which the blade is unfolded orthogonal to the rotary shaft, and formed to be elastic.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 탄성 복원형 접철식 풍력발전기용 날개에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 블레이드가 스프링에 의하여 후방으로 젖혀질수 있도록 하여, 태풍과 같은 초강풍에도 별도의 피치 제어 없이 각 블레이드에 미치는 풍압에 따라 각각 따로 블레이드가 후방으로 젖혀지고 블레이드에 가해지는 풍압이 감소하면 탄성에 의하여 자동으로 전방으로 탄성 복원되도록 함으로써, 날개의 손상을 방지하고 풍력발전기에 걸리는 하중과 블레이드에 걸리는 피로도를 줄일 수 있는 탄성 복원형 접철식 풍력발전기용 날개에 관한 것이다.
본 발명의 바람직한 일 실시예는 풍력발전장치에 제공되고, 풍력에 의해 회전시 그 회전력을 동력전달장치를 통해 발전기를 가동시키는 풍력발전기의 날개에 있어서, 수평으로 형성되며 전면 단부에 고정부가 형성되며, 고정부의 외주면에 돌출하여 복수의 힌지부가 형성되는 회전축과; 일측에 축부가 구성되고 힌지부에 축핀으로 고정하여 축핀을 축으로 회전가능하게 형성되는 블레이드와; 블레이드가 회전축과 직각인 상태로 평쳐진 상태에서 양단부가 각각 회전축의 고정부와 블레이드에 연결되며 탄성을 갖도록 형성되는 스프링;을 포함하여 이루어진다.
assignees: JEON YONG JUN;JEON U RI;JEON MIN GYU

title_en: Earthquake damage evaluating system for water pipe network using asset management, and method for the same
title_ko: 자산관리를 이용한 상수관망의 지진피해 평가 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: Provided are an earthquake damage evaluating system for a water pipe network using asset management and a method thereof which classify attributes for each segment of a water pipe network, predict a deterioration degree of each attribute, accurately predict earthquake damage of the water pipe network based on this, accurately predict damage to the water pipe network when an earthquake occurs, and easily perform decision-making on earthquake damage restoration, including a restoration priority, restoration costs, and a restoration period.
abstract_ko: 상수관망의 체계적인 관리를 위해 자산관리기법을 이용하여 상수관망의 세그먼트별 속성을 분류하여 각각의 속성의 노후도를 예측하고, 이를 기반으로 정밀한 지진피해를 예측할 수 있고, 또한, 지진 발생시 상수관망의 피해를 정밀하게 예측하고, 회복의 우선순위, 회복비용 및 회복기간을 포함하는 지진피해 복구에 대한 의사결정을 을 용이하게 수행할 수 있는, 자산관리를 이용한 상수관망의 지진피해 평가 시스템 및 그 방법이 제공된다.
assignees: KOREA INST CIVIL ENG & BUILDING TECH;UNIV DANKOOK IACF

title_en: Intelligent voice outbound method for deep learning fault text information extraction
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent voice outbound method for deep learning fault text information extraction. The method comprises the following steps: collecting a large amount of power line fault text data and carrying out preprocessing operation; vectorizing the preprocessed data text and carrying out manual labeling to obtain a data set to be trained; training the obtained data set through a deep pyramid convolution neural network to obtain corresponding network model parameters; extracting equipment information; inquiring a signal table related to the state and reclosing of the circuit breaker through the equipment ID, judging whether the circuit breaker is successfully reclosed according to the time interval of power loss and power restoration, and generating an outbound text by data; and sending the outbound text to the transformer substation operation and maintenance class for scheduling. According to the invention, whether the circuit breaker is successfully reclosed can be quickly judged according to the extracted information, and meanwhile, the voice outbound scheduling is sent to the transformer substation to which the fault equipment belongs, so that the power supply reliability is effectively improved.
assignees: Jiangsu electric power information technology co ltd

title_en: Method for restoring green ecology of mine goaf
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for restoring green ecology in a mine goaf, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: A. preparing soil; B. paving a component; C. filling a culture medium and soil; D. planting plants and trees; E. and (5) management. The novel artificial mountain is quickly constructed in the mine goaf through the supporting function of the components, meanwhile, effective greening is carried out through planted plants and trees, water storage and water retention can be carried out when rainwater arrives, the water conservation capacity is improved, the water release speed is reduced, the water retention period is prolonged, the growth requirements of the plants and the trees are met, the survival rate is improved, the greening effect of the goaf mine is consolidated, the greening landscape is promoted, and landslide and soil erosion of the mountain are effectively prevented. The invention has the advantages of convenient, quick and safe construction, no energy consumption, low restoration cost and good effect, and provides convenient and practical technical support for restoring the ecological environment and restoring the vegetation of the large-area mine goaf.

title_en: Municipal works water conservancy construction bank protection restoration structure
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of slope protection repair, in particular to a municipal engineering water conservancy construction slope protection repair structure which comprises a slope body, a growth base layer, a grid frame and a plurality of vertical plates, wherein the growth base layer covers the slope surface of the slope body; wherein a first fixing component used for reinforcing the growth base layer is arranged between the growth base layer and the slope surface of the slope body; a second fixing component for reinforcing the grid frame is arranged between the grid frame and the growth base layer; soil base layers, stone layers and grid cloth layers are sequentially paved in a plurality of grid units surrounded by the transverse vertical plates and the vertical plates of the grid frame from inside to outside, and the edges of the grid cloth layers are connected with the transverse vertical plates and the vertical plates adjacent to the grid cloth layers. This application can reduce the rainy season bank protection and the possibility of landslide appears, improves bank protection repairing effect.
assignees: TIANJIN XIN ROAD AND BRIDGE CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Mining area water and soil pollution treatment and ecological restoration cooperative control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mining area water and soil pollution treatment and ecological restoration cooperative control method, and belongs to the technical field of mining area ecological restoration. Step 1: treating water and soil pollution; step 2: laying a bottom soil layer; and step 3: laying a core soil layer on the bottom soil layer; and 4, step 4: paving a surface soil layer on the core soil layer and tamping; and 5: excavating a plurality of inverted trapezoidal ditches on the surface soil layer; step 6: paving a protective net in each inverted trapezoidal ditch; and 7: excavating a longitudinal ditch on each trapezoidal ridge, and then paving a plurality of U-shaped grooves which are connected end to end in each longitudinal ditch; and step 8: and filling an organic soil layer in each U-shaped groove, and then planting plants on the organic soil layer. The method uses slag, sludge, purified water and the like generated by water and soil pollution treatment of the mining area for ecological restoration of the area, uses local materials, restores organic soil layers and surface vegetation of the mining area, is beneficial to water and soil conservation of the mining area, prevents water and soil loss and desertification, and effectively reduces the occurrence probability of natural disasters such as landslide and the like.
assignees: NANJING INST OF ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENCES MEE

title_en: Construction method of integral repairing structure of landslide of riverside road
abstract_en: The invention relates to a construction method of an integral restoration structure of a landslide of a river-facing road, which is characterized in that a stable grouting pipe and a grouting stabilizing body are adopted to stabilize a loose soil body at the lower part of an embankment, and a reinforcing rib net and an oblique supporting rib are adopted to stabilize a soil body at the upper part of the embankment; the prefabricated bottom support body comprises a foundation anchor pier, a pier top connecting plate and a plate top connecting groove; the plate surfaces of the bottom baffle and the middle baffle are provided with conical seepage-proof holes, and the back side of the wall is sequentially provided with a loose backfill body and a light backfill body from bottom to top; synchronously carrying out hydraulic compaction and surface vibration compaction on the loose backfill body by adopting the combined compact body; a reinforcing tie bar is arranged between the tie bar anchor plate and an embankment soil body, and the periphery of the reinforcing tie bar is pressed to form an anti-pulling grouting tenon; the movable sliding grooves in the greening planting groove and the top baffle are connected through connecting sliding falcon, and the floating support connecting groove is pasted on the periphery of the greening planting groove. The invention can not only improve the bearing performance of the waterside embankment, but also reduce the difficulty of embankment greening.
assignees: UNIV NANCHANG HANGKONG

title_en: Comprehensive energy data cleaning method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system, equipment and a medium for cleaning comprehensive energy data, which comprise the following steps: screening repairable abnormal data from the comprehensive energy system; predicting repairable abnormal data by using a pre-trained wavelet neural network to obtain a predicted repair value; bringing the predicted restoration value into a pre-trained index fuzzy rule satisfaction classifier for verification to obtain a violation degree corresponding to the predicted restoration value, and taking the predicted restoration value with the violation degree smaller than a preset threshold value as a restoration value; the index fuzzy rule satisfaction classifier takes all normal data of the comprehensive energy system at the same historical moment as input and takes the violation degree of the index fuzzy rule as output to train to obtain the index fuzzy rule satisfaction classifier; the invention utilizes the fuzzy rule satisfaction classifier to detect and repair the abnormal data, can judge the data state without an accurate threshold value, and solves the problem that the comprehensive energy system can not detect and repair the abnormal data by using a definite calculation formula.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Heavy metal contaminated soil treatment and remediation decision-making method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heavy metal contaminated soil treatment and restoration decision-making method, which comprises the steps of firstly, acquiring basic data of heavy metal contaminated soil, wherein the basic data comprises human health risk data, pollution risk data and ecological risk data; then, comprehensively evaluating the human health risk data, the pollution risk data and the ecological risk data to determine different risk levels, substituting the risk data into a pre-trained feedforward neural network model, carrying out auxiliary decision-making on the heavy metal contaminated soil treatment and restoration, and outputting a recommended technical scheme; and finally, carrying out cost accurate measurement and calculation according to the recommended technical scheme and the remediation formula quantities of different risk levels to obtain a treatment and remediation decision-making scheme, establishing a soil remediation range and formula quantity estimation and soil remediation decision-making system based on a neural network model, realizing intelligent and accurate decision-making recommendation of the soil remediation scheme, and providing technical support for efficiently developing heavy metal contaminated soil treatment and remediation.
assignees: YONKER ENV PROT CO LTD;UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: Mobile emergency power supply access point optimization method considering power outage distribution network recovery sequence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile emergency power supply access point optimization method considering the recovery sequence of a power failure distribution network, which comprises the steps of firstly evaluating the fault probability of the distribution network line under extreme natural disasters, and respectively constructing a mobile emergency power supply access point optimization model and a source-network-load-storage cooperative scheduling model considering the recovery sequence, and linearizing and solving the constructed model to obtain an optimized mobile emergency power supply access point optimization scheme considering the recovery sequence of the power failure distribution network. According to the invention, the optimal configuration of the mobile emergency power supply access points is considered in the sequential recovery process, so that the cooperative optimization of the black start node and the recovery path in the power distribution network is realized, the local power generation resources in the power distribution network are utilized to a greater extent, and the power failure time of important loads is reduced.

title_en: Buckling-restrained supporting pin shaft connecting node
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-buckling supporting pin shaft connecting node, open the round pin shaft hole including the connecting plate the upper limb quadrature welding upper limb listrium of connecting plate, lower limb quadrature welding lower limb listrium, the department of linking of connecting plate, upper limb listrium, lower limb listrium and steel column and post bracket adopts the full penetration butt weld of groove to connect the upper limb listrium with steel column weld butt joint sets up a pair of trilateral enclosure welding of post stiffener and is in on the steel column the lower limb listrium with post bracket weld butt joint sets up a pair of trilateral enclosure welding of bracket stiffener and is in on the post bracket, the utility model is suitable for a connection of articulated support between the post, the atress route is clear and definite, under the earthquake power effect, has good anti low all fatigue's performance, and the node simple structure adopts assembled round pin hub connection technique, and the restoration or the change after the anti-buckling support damages after being convenient for the earthquake only need pull out the round pin axle can.
assignees: HANGXIAO STEEL STRUCTURE JIANGXI CO LTD

title_en: Manufacturing method for cultivation of moss and moss cultivation kit for forest recovery thereof
title_ko: 이끼 포자 배양 방법 및 이를 이용한 산림 복구용 이끼 재배 키트
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for culturing moss spores and a moss cultivation kit for forest restoration using the same. The present invention relates to a method of culturing moss spores, which can restore forests by artificially culturing moss to dormant and then spraying the lost forests in the event of a disaster. The moss spore culture method according to the present invention comprises: a first step of cutting the sporangia into 10 to 30 mm; a second step of drying the cut sporangia at 60 to 75℃ for 24 hours and crushing the dried sporangia; a third step of immersing the crushed sporangia in a spore culture medium and dormant; a fourth step of immersing the dormant sporangia in a plant hormone solution for 24 hours; and a fifth step of mixing and spraying the immersed sporangia with a nutrient solution and an adhesive solution.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 이끼 포자 배양 방법 및 이를 이용한 산림 복구용 이끼 재배 키트에 관한 것으로, 이기를 인공 배양하여 휴면시킨 뒤 재난이 발생하면 손실된 산림에 살포하여 산림을 복구할 수 있는 이끼 포자 배양 방법에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명에 따른 이끼 포자 배양 방법은, 포자낭을 10 내지 30 mm로 절단하는 제1단계; 상기 절단된 포자낭을 60 내지 75℃에서 24시간 동안 건조 후 상기 건조된 포자낭을 파쇄하는 제2단계; 상기 파쇄된 포자낭을 포자 배양액에 침지 후 휴면하는 제3단계; 상기 휴면된 포자낭을 식물호르몬액에 24시간 동안 침지하는 제4단계; 상기 침지된 포자낭을 양액 및 접착액과 혼합하여 살포하는 제5단계;를 포함하여 제조되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Novel environmental ecology restores device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a novel environmental ecology restores device, ecological restoration device set up on improving the soil horizon, and it is the slope to improve the soil horizon top, is provided with a plurality of anchor mechanisms on the slope, is connected through expanding spring between the adjacent anchor mechanism, and slope one side is provided with fender mud pile, and fender mud pile side is provided with the screen cloth, and the screen cloth communicates to drainage channel, and drainage channel sets up on unable adjustment base, and the unable adjustment base top is provided with annular connection pad. This ecological prosthetic devices of environment consolidates on the slope to domatic, has the shock attenuation effect of taking precautions against earthquakes, improves the stress of slope when earthquake or landslide come to the time to reduce natural disasters 'such as landslide, mud-rock flow's emergence, multilayer protective action promotes ecological prosthetic devices holistic shock resistance and life simultaneously, is provided with drainage channel and is convenient for massif drainage, avoids the water to soak.
assignees: SHAANXI HEIHE ZHIXING IND CO LTD

title_en: Disaster recovery construction method for existing railway tunnel after earthquake
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field related to restoration construction of railway tunnels after earthquake, and discloses a restoration construction method for disasters after earthquake of an existing railway tunnel, which comprises the following steps: counting and classifying the quantity of surface cracks generated after the earthquake, and carrying out open excavation and layered tamping; inspecting and renovating or repairing the vibrated tunnel portal engineering; aiming at an existing tunnel after earthquake, firstly adopting a temporary steel frame for protection, and then carrying out full-ring radial grouting reinforcement treatment; then, for the tunnel to be dismantled and rebuilt, adopting the inner contour of the tunnel with a single-core circle structure and reserving a certain space in the cross section of the tunnel; and meanwhile, the lining with a circular structure is adopted, and the lining support adopts the structural form of primary support, full-ring damping and energy-dissipating layer, secondary support and reserved space. The method can better adapt to the existing restoration construction process of the railway tunnel after the earthquake, and meet the construction requirements of classification and treatment, emphasis on reinforcement, proper redundancy, rapidness and safety.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY 20 BUREAU GROUP CORP;NO 3 ENGINEERING CORPORATION LTD OF CR20G

title_en: Method and system for evaluating elasticity of power system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating elasticity of an electric power system, which comprises the steps of modeling the electric power system to obtain an electric power system model; modeling a disaster to obtain a disaster model; applying a disaster model to a power system model to obtain a first operation condition of the power system when encountering a disaster; modeling the post-disaster recovery to obtain a post-disaster recovery model; applying the post-disaster recovery model to the post-disaster power system model to obtain one or more second operating conditions of the recovery power system after the recovery measures are taken in sequence; quantifying an effect of a disaster on the power system in a process from when the power system encounters a disaster to when the restoration measures are taken based on the first operating condition and the one or more second operating conditions; evaluating elasticity of the power system based on influence of the disaster on the power system; therefore, the elasticity of the power system can be more comprehensively and accurately evaluated, and a complete post-disaster recovery strategy can be formulated.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP;SICHUAN NEW POWER SYSTEM RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Ecological restoration method for partial collapse of high-fill road
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological restoration method for partial collapse of a high-fill road, which comprises the following steps: s01, adopting first vertical pipe grouting and first transverse pipe grouting to carry out temporary support on a collapsed surface of an original road, adopting second vertical pipe grouting and second transverse pipe grouting to carry out temporary support on a far end of an uncollapsed high-fill roadbed, and fastening a stepped light retaining wall with an original foundation through a vertical prestress anchor rod at a boundary line position of the original road; s02, trimming the collapsed surface of the original road into a ladder shape; s03, sequentially filling wall back layered filling soil, EPS light backfill layer and permeable concrete layer from bottom to top between the stepped light retaining wall and the collapse surface of the original road. The method solves the problems that the engineering quantity is large, secondary disasters are easy to occur when the foundation 7 is disturbed greatly and the manufacturing cost is high when the high-fill collapsed road is repaired in the prior art.

title_en: A afforestation equipment for alumina mine side slope ecological remediation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a afforestation equipment for ecological remediation of alumina mine side slope, including the base, the water tank is installed at the top of base, is equipped with sprinkling irrigation mechanism in the water tank, and the top of water tank is equipped with first collection respectively and fights and the second is collected and fight, and the bottom fixedly connected with connecting pipe that first collection was fought, and the connecting pipe is the slope state setting, and in the one end that first collection was fought was kept away from to the connecting pipe extended to the second and is collected and fight, the second was collected and is fought and is equipped with the power generation mechanism who is used for driving sprinkling irrigation mechanism work. In the utility model, the sprinkling irrigation mechanism is arranged, so that the phenomenon that the vegetation is dry due to the fact that the people cannot water on the steep slope is avoided, and the survival rate of the vegetation is improved; and through the arranged power generation mechanism, the wind energy of the nature can be utilized, the energy is saved, the aims of conserving water sources and preventing water and soil loss and landslide are fulfilled on the mine slope, and the aims of ecological restoration and greening are fulfilled.
assignees: SHANXI MECH CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Leveraging file-based backups to facilitate bare-metal and system-state recovery operations
abstract_en: A method and system for leveraging file-based backups to facilitate bare-metal recovery (BMR) and/or system-state recovery (SSR) operations. In leading to a BMR operation (which may include, but is not limited to, data protected under a SSR operation), logical groupings of data, each including multiple files and/or directories that span across one or more file-systems, may be written to backup media to comply with data backup, archiving, and/or disaster recovery strategies.
