Backing up said logical groupings of data relies on block-based backup technologies, which upon requiring a subset of a given logical grouping of data to be restored, makes the restoration process impossible to fulfill since determining which blocks of data belong to which files and/or directories are not tracked. Accordingly, the disclosed method and system propose an intelligent scheme through which file-based backup technology may be employed to enable BMR and/or SSR from any single BMR-compliant backup copy.
assignees: EMC IP HOLDING CO LLC

title_en: Seismic signal P wave detection method based on PPNet network
abstract_en: The invention provides a seismic signal P wave detection method based on a PPNet network, belonging to the technical field of seismic signal processing; the network can realize higher precision and lower error pickup of earthquake P waves; combining UNet + + coding and a decoder, designing a lightweight P wave arrival time pickup Network PPNet (P-wave radar Network) with seismic facies feature analysis and fusion capability by integrating a feature filter, carrying out depth feature extraction on input seismic signals by adopting a convolution layer with a large convolution kernel low channel number by an encoder module, pressing and filtering other interference information while enhancing the seismic facies arrival time weight in a signal sequence, adding a feature fusion mechanism in the feature restoration process of the decoder module, complementing feature information, realizing accurate identification of each time step in the seismic signal sequence, processing the output feature sequence by only adding the feature filter to three down-sampling modules behind the encoder, refining P wave arrival time features, and improving arrival time pickup precision; the invention is applied to seismic P-wave pickup.
assignees: UNIV TAIYUAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Health evaluation index system and evaluation method for single-inflow river
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of river health evaluation, in particular to a health evaluation index system and an evaluation method for a single-inflow river. The index system comprises 5 criterion layer indexes of hydrology, water quality, biology, habitat and social service functions, wherein the 5 criterion layer indexes comprise 11 common indexes and 5 individual indexes respectively. The evaluation method comprises an Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP), a comprehensive index evaluation method and river health grading. The invention effectively fills the blank of the lack of the single-inflow-sea-river health evaluation index system in the current river research field, and after the technical scheme of the invention is used for evaluating the health condition of the single-inflow-sea river, river restoration suggestions and management countermeasures proposed according to the evaluation result are scientific, reasonable and highly targeted, thereby laying a solid foundation for the long-term treatment and the healthy development of the single-inflow-sea river.

title_en: System and Method for managing performance data when communication errors occur in power plant
title_ko: 발전소 통신장애시 성능 데이터 관리 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system for managing performance data that can enhance usability of a remote monitoring system by restoring or estimating key data for a communication error section, the system for managing the performance data comprising: an overseas plant which generates generation information; a communication relay block which relays the generation information; and a monitoring block which calculates an average generation load during a communication error period from a time of an occurrence of a communication error between the communication relay block and the plant to a time of communication restoration by using the generation information and restores performance data with a preset scenario based on the average generation load. In addition, the time of the occurrence is a case where there is no difference between a current time cumulative output value and an accumulated output value for a preset time.
abstract_ko:
통신오류 구간에 대한 주요 데이터들을 복원 또는 추정하여 원격 감시 체계의 활용성을 강화할 수 있는 성능 데이터 관리 시스템이 개시된다. 상기 성능 데이터 관리 시스템은, 발전 정보를 생성하는 해외 발전소, 상기 발전 정보를 중계하는 통신 중계 블럭, 및 상기 발전 정보를 이용하여 상기 통신 중계 블럭과 발전소간 통신장애의 발생시점으로부터 통신의 복원시점까지 통신장애기간에서의 평균 발전 부하를 산출하고, 상기 평균 발전 부하를 기반으로 미리 설정되는 시나리오로 성능 데이터를 복원하는 모니터링 블럭을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
또한, 상기 발생시점은 미리 설정되는 시간 동안 누적 출력값대비 현시간 누적 출력값의 차이가 없는 경우인 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: KOREA ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: Ecological geological environment restoration grade division method for ecologically fragile mining area
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for dividing ecological geological environment restoration grades of an ecologically fragile mining area, which comprises the following steps of determining total ecological water demand before and after coal seam mining according to vegetation ecological water demand, surface water evaporation capacity and underground diving evaporation capacity, obtaining the ecological water demand change quantity before and after coal seam mining according to the total ecological water demand before and after coal seam mining, determining the ecological water shortage state of the mining area and dividing the mining area, obtaining the landscape pattern indexes before and after mining area mining, determining the ecological risk state of the mining area and dividing the mining area according to the change of the landscape pattern indexes before and after mining area, and determining the ecological geological environment restoration grade of the ecologically fragile mining area and dividing the mining area according to the division of the water shortage state and the division of the ecological risk state.

title_en: Improved Distribution Board seismic device
title_ko: 개선된 수배전반 내진 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an improved distribution board seismic device which implements a seismic device having seismic isolation and seismic functions and a support for bolt fastening in one device to absorb and disperse a seismic force that vertically and horizontally vibrates to lengthen a natural period so as to reduce and extinguish the seismic force, enable restoration of the original state of the seismic device to a normal state by replacing only the support after an earthquake so as to maintain intrinsic modulus of elasticity so as to maintain an intrinsic modulus of elasticity of a spring when an earthquake occurs, and enable compact design and manufacture and have no need of a concrete structure like the prior art so as to drastically reduce processes and costs according to seismic device installation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 개선된 수배전반 내진 장치에 관한 것으로, 하나의 장치에 면진 및 내진 기능과 볼트 체결용 지지대를 갖는 내진 장치를 구현함으로써, 수직 수평으로 진동하는 지진력을 흡수하고 분산시켜 고유주기를 길게 하여 지진력을 감소 및 소멸시키고, 지진 발생 이후에는 지지대의 교체만으로 내진 장치를 평소 상태로의 원상복구가 가능하여 지진이 발생할 경우 스프링의 고유 탄성계수를 유지시킬 수 있으며, 또한 콤팩트하게 설계 및 제작이 가능하고 종래 기술과 같이 콘크리트 구조물이 필요 없기 때문에 내진 장치 설치에 따른 공정과 비용을 크게 줄일 수 있는 효과가 있다.
assignees: NGP CO LTD

title_en: Transformer substation anti-seismic toughness rapid evaluation method based on Bayesian neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for rapidly evaluating the anti-seismic toughness of a transformer substation based on a Bayesian neural network, which is characterized in that a network model of the transformer substation system is built through a directed acyclic graph, the failure probability of the system is rapidly evaluated based on the passing probability of each path under the condition of determining the reliability of various devices, the restoration sequence of the post-earthquake devices is analyzed through setting function indexes, a function recovery function is determined, and the anti-seismic toughness index is obtained, so that the rapid evaluation of the anti-seismic toughness of the transformer substation system is realized. The method has the advantages that the complex network model is disassembled into the probability and the logic connection relation of each sub-node, the data input quantity and the processing quantity of the network model are greatly reduced, the target probability and the earthquake-resistant level of each sub-node are rapidly output, the probability level of the tested node is accurately and efficiently obtained through analysis and calculation of the probability set of each sub-node in the network model, and the problem of poor convergence of the sampling result is avoided.

title_en: Rainwater storage and seepage purification system for mountain restoration
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a massif restoration technical field, and disclose massif restoration rainwater storage infiltration clean system, including massif, basic unit and barricade, the barricade sets up in the department of raising of basic unit, the top of basic unit and the one side that lies in the barricade are equipped with the slope body, the slope domatic afterbody of slope body is equipped with the retaining module, lateral conduit has been laid to the bottom of barricade, the trunk line has been laid to the bottom of hillside body, the one end and the lateral conduit of trunk line are connected, and the other end and the retaining module of trunk line are connected, be equipped with the bed course that permeates water between barricade and the massif, the tip of lateral conduit extends to the bottom of the bed course that permeates water, the internally mounted of retaining module has the water pump, the output of water pump is fixed and is equipped with the sprinkling irrigation pipe; plants are planted on the slope surface of the slope body, and a grass planting ditch system is arranged on the slope surface of the slope body and on one side of the plants. The utility model discloses not only can prevent the landslide, play the effect of solid soil, ooze the purification with the rainwater storage moreover and combine together for the environment obtains better restoration.
assignees: XUZHOU JIUZHOU ECOLOGICAL GARDEN CO LTD

title_en: Electricity sales prediction method based on data restoration and decomposition sequence prediction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for predicting electricity sales amount based on data restoration and decomposition sequence prediction, which belongs to the technical field of economic planning of a distributed energy storage system of a power distribution network, and comprises the steps of firstly, detecting abnormal values of historical electricity sales data by adopting Box-plot; then, interpolating the missing electricity selling data by using the countermeasure generating network; decomposing the electricity selling data into subsequences with different frequencies by adopting an improved adaptive noise complete set empirical mode algorithm; and finally, predicting the low-frequency subsequence by adopting an LEAR method, predicting the high-frequency subsequence by adopting LSTNet, and reconstructing a prediction result into a final electricity sales amount prediction result. The method provided by the invention improves the prediction precision from two aspects of data and a prediction model, and compared with the existing prediction algorithm, the prediction aspect provided by the invention is more accurate and stable.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN;SICHUAN ENERGY INVEST COMPREHENSIVE ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster post-vegetation restoration monitoring method based on high-resolution remote sensing image
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological disaster post-vegetation recovery monitoring method based on high-resolution remote sensing images, which comprises the steps of constructing a fusion type spectrum-vegetation index-texture feature set, uniformly selecting n typical vegetation sample areas in a target area under a clear weather condition, constructing a similar-bagging type integrated learning model, analyzing obvious differences of three types of vegetation of arbor, shrubs and herbaceous plants on vegetation height, single plant vegetation horizontal projection coverage area, root depth and root extension range, and quantitatively analyzing vegetation recovery conditions of the target area by analyzing on-time phase change information of vegetation change rate indexes and vegetation type change rate indexes of remote sensing images of a plurality of continuous time phases, so that accuracy of the method according to pixel classification is effectively improved, accuracy of vegetation quantitative analysis of the target area is greatly improved, and cost of long-term accurate monitoring can be greatly reduced.

title_en: Post-earthquake vegetation restoration monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention provides a post-earthquake vegetation restoration monitoring method which comprises the following steps of selecting an earthquake vegetation damaged area to generate an earthquake area remote sensing image, establishing an earthquake area remote sensing image library in different seasons and different years, extracting a preliminary vegetation-existing area from the earthquake area image by utilizing vegetation, water, bare soil and other non-vegetation ground objects with larger difference in spectral characteristics and utilizing DSCAN density clustering algorithm, defining vegetation sparsity in the earthquake area, quantitatively displaying restoration conditions of various vegetation and integral vegetation, analyzing the restoration good degree of the current vegetation more accurately, obviously comparing which indexes need to be improved, and providing data support for next vegetation restoration measures.

title_en: Power restoration method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a power restoration method, a power restoration device, a computer device, a storage medium and a computer program product. The method comprises the following steps: determining a target fault type to which the power supply equipment causing power failure belongs according to fault information and state information corresponding to the power supply equipment causing power failure; searching a target operation ticket corresponding to the target fault type from a first mapping relation, wherein the first mapping relation is used for indicating a one-to-one correspondence relation between a plurality of fault types and a plurality of operation tickets; sequentially executing corresponding operation tasks according to the operation numbers contained in the target operation ticket, and obtaining the execution duration and the execution result of each operation task; for each operation task, determining the completion degree of the current operation task based on the execution duration and the execution result of the current operation task; and executing power supply recovery operation according to the target fault type and the completion degree of each operation task. By adopting the method, the power supply recovery efficiency can be improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Cable protection pipe repair kit that does not have a power failure to change
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cable protection pipe repair kit without power outage for replacement, which comprises a repair mechanism, an installation assembly and a waterproof assembly, wherein the repair mechanism comprises a repair sleeve, a first installation block and a second installation block, at least 2 groups of repair sleeves are arranged, and the first installation block and the second installation block extend from two ends of each of the 2 groups of repair sleeves respectively. Can wrap original protective case through this restoration pipe fitting, need not have a power failure, restore on original basis, do the original structure of furthest utilization and material, the consumptive material is few, it is low to maintainer technical ability requirement, need not to demolish original protective case, the novel protective case of dismantled and assembled combination formula that can change at any time, it is inseparable to be connected with original protection tube, do not seep water, the later stage need not anticorrosive treatment, moreover, the steam generator is simple in operation, and materials, the instrument is purchased conveniently, and easy operation is mastered, adopt stainless steel to compare with the PVC material, mechanical strength is better, oxidation resistance, corrosion resistance, can carry out different processing according to original tubular product diameter.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Business influence analysis method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of information security, and provides a business impact analysis method, a business impact analysis device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: analyzing interruption influence of various services to determine disaster recovery priorities of the various services; determining the incidence relation between various services and an information system; determining disaster recovery priorities of information systems of different levels according to disaster recovery priorities of various services and incidence relations between various services and the information systems; determining disaster recovery indexes of various services according to disaster recovery priorities of the various services; and determining the disaster recovery indexes of the corresponding information system according to the disaster recovery indexes of various services. The method and the system determine the disaster recovery target of the information system through the incidence relation between the service and the information system, can confirm the importance of the information system, and implement the service influence analysis on the information system supporting the service operation, thereby providing an important basis for the construction of a disaster recovery and service continuity management system.
assignees: CCB FINTECH CO LTD

title_en: Short-term load prediction and restoration method based on historical load data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-term load forecasting and repairing method based on historical load data, which comprises the following steps: carrying out data preprocessing on the historical load data set to obtain a preprocessed historical load data set; performing feature extraction processing on the preprocessed historical load data set through a depth self-encoder to obtain a reconstructed data set; carrying out load prediction on the reconstructed data set through a Stacking integration model to obtain a predicted value; and repairing the historical load data set according to the prediction value to obtain a repaired historical load data set. By using the method and the device, the detection precision of the abnormal load data can be improved by accurately extracting the potential characteristics of the historical load data. The short-term load forecasting and repairing method based on historical load data can be widely applied to the technical field of power load data mining.
assignees: UNIV GUANGDONG TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Spur dike with water ecological restoration function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a spur dike that possesses water ecological remediation function, it is applied to in the river course renovation. The spur dike comprises a dike body connected with a river bank, plant layers fixedly arranged at the positions of the upstream surface and the downstream surface of the dike body, a hollow water-permeable cavity penetrating through the dike body and a reinforcing assembly arranged on the dike body. The dam body comprises a steel reinforcement cage, and a filler and a ceramsite layer which are filled in the steel reinforcement cage. The reinforcing assembly comprises an anti-impact inserting plate arranged at the bottom of the steel reinforcement cage, a cast-in-situ layer and a supporting rod which are arranged in the corresponding hollowed-out water permeable cavity, and a fish reef hole formed in the cast-in-situ layer. The utility model discloses a spur dike, the ecology is good, possesses the resistant erosion ability reinforce of purification performance and upstream surface and the surface of a water back, and in addition, overall structure is firm, provides the habitat that is favorable to river floodbeach fish aquatic animal in slow flow district for the spur dike possesses ecological fish reef effect, with the ecological restoration process of promotion river course water.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ECOLOGICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENCE DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Ecological restoration method for pyrite mine waste land
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ecological restoration, and discloses an ecological restoration method for a pyrite mine waste land, which is used for detecting surface parameters of the positions of the pyrite mine waste land and judging the positions where landslide or collapse is easy to occur; selecting a safe position to excavate, carrying out foreign soil restoration on an excavation pit, and planting vegetation at the restoration position; detecting the water quality parameters of underground water at the position of the pyrite mine waste site; and the pumped underground water is treated by the underground water circulating treatment module and then is discharged into the ground. According to the invention, the judged position which is easy to slide or collapse is avoided, the safe position is selected for excavation, the excavation pit is used for carrying out foreign soil remediation, the vegetation is planted at the remediation position, the soil in the deep layer of the abandoned mine land can be treated, the pumped underground water is treated by the underground water circulating treatment module and then is returned to the underground, the underground water in the abandoned mine land can be treated, and the treatment is more comprehensive and thorough.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN AGRICULTURAL

title_en: Soil pollution prevention and control integrated platform and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a soil pollution prevention and control integrated platform and a method thereof, wherein the soil pollution prevention and control integrated platform comprises a soil environment investigation management module, and the soil environment investigation management module can obtain on-site survey, soil sampling, underground water sampling and sample detection results; the soil environment restoration management module is used for making a soil restoration scheme according to on-site survey, soil sampling, underground water sampling and sample detection results, monitoring the soil restoration process, obtaining a final soil restoration result, judging the final soil restoration result by utilizing evaluation data, and taking corresponding risk control measures for the land parcel which cannot reach an ideal restoration target; and the soil environment comprehensive analysis module is used for counting and analyzing the final soil remediation result and visually displaying the soil environment data. The soil environment can be effectively investigated and managed, the repairing process of the polluted soil needing to be repaired is effectively supervised, the soil pollution prevention and treatment efficiency is improved, and the personnel investment is reduced.
assignees: SUZHOU IND PARK SURVEYING MAPPING AND GEOINFORMATION CO LTD

title_en: Ship track prediction method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ship track prediction method and device, wherein a track distribution range is discretized into a plurality of grid cells based on space-time distribution density of ship tracks in a ship navigation area, grid cells corresponding to current ship track nodes and adjacent grid cells are obtained, a cost function of ship position transfer between the current grid cells and the adjacent grid cells is calculated respectively, and the adjacent grid cell with the minimum cost function is used as a predicted ship track of ship position transfer. According to the scheme, before prediction, reliability evaluation and restoration are carried out on the original data of the training track, the real track is restored, time sequence factor constraint is added in the ship navigation network diagram, and time sequence correlation of the track data is considered while spatial correlation of adjacent tracks is described. The size of the grid unit in the ship navigation network is flexibly set based on the space-time distribution density of the ship track.

title_en: Subway dominant abdominal ground travel chain generation method based on mobile phone positioning data
abstract_en: The invention relates to a subway dominant abdomen ground travel chain generation method based on mobile phone positioning data, which comprises the following steps: step 1: acquiring mobile phone positioning data; step 2: acquiring all subway link tables in the urban subway network according to the geographic information of the railway network; step 3: judging the origin-destination of the passenger flow of the subway station based on the mobile phone positioning data; step 4: space competitive advantage analysis of passenger flow abdominal land based on mobile phone positioning data generates station passenger flow travel chain OD data; step 5: checking subway passenger flow abdomen and station OD distribution based on multivariate data. The method effectively improves the accuracy of abdominal analysis and path restoration of the subway passenger flow whole sample, and greatly reduces the cost. The method has the advantages that the subway station dominant service range and subway passenger flow abdominal land analysis of different regional station classification are carried out through low-cost, wide-coverage and high-sampling-rate mobile phone positioning data, and then the source abdominal land and data check of the whole-sample distributed passenger flow of the subway are realized by combining the surrounding land utilization and population coverage of the station, so that a complete travel chain of the subway passenger flow travel is generated, and technical support is provided for traffic planning and subway design managers in the aspects of track competitive dominant analysis and passenger flow guidance.

title_en: Distribution network-based typical fault first-aid repair method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a first-aid repair method based on a typical fault of a distribution network, which comprises the following steps: disassembling links of a distribution network fault emergency repair process, and researching optimization promotion of multi-source data linkage of FA protection action information in a power distribution automation system, equipment defect hidden danger information in an intelligent inspection terminal and station area power failure and restoration information in a metering automation system on each link of emergency repair; establishing a new mode and a new flow of distribution network line fault emergency repair with multi-professional cooperation of scheduling, emergency repair, operation, protection and customer service, and forming a 'one-line one-strategy' emergency repair operation instruction template; an active first-aid repair system which is suitable for the operation characteristics of a regional distribution network is researched, the information data requirements of all service departments in the first-aid repair link are cooperated, new mode application is developed in a test point area and a test point line, and the application effect of feedback analysis is collected. The invention realizes the timely inquiry and cooperative operation of fault points, solves various problems in time, avoids delaying the rush repair opportunity and increasing the safety risk and reduces complaints.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Delayed power failure punctuality management method based on distribution network operation management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system dispatching operation, in particular to a delay-failure-recovery-power-on-time management method based on a distribution network operation management system. The method comprises the following steps: carrying out stage division on the development progress of the maintenance application work; presetting a delay calculation rule and a reward and punishment rule; establishing a maintenance request form; collecting work development progress information on a maintenance request form; performing punctuality calculation to obtain punctuality data; the reward and punishment rule module calculates and obtains reward and punishment data; and comprehensively displaying the comprehensive indexes of all dimensions. The invention designs the functional arrangement based on the distribution network oms, can automatically track the root cause of delay, and fully reduces the working cost of a dispatcher; by adopting an accurate reward and punishment method, the working enthusiasm of the staff is improved, the on-time of the power failure and restoration is improved, the reliability of the power supply of a user is enhanced, the normal sequence of planned power failure and restoration is maintained, and the safe operation level of a power grid is improved; the automatic statistics and reasonable display of the delay basic data and reward and punishment cashing can be realized, and the edge working pressure of a dispatcher is reduced.
assignees: ZHAOTONG POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power dispatching visual management method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a visual management method and a visual management system for power dispatching, which relate to the technical field of data processing, and comprise the following steps: acquiring a plurality of repair data sets of a target power company; the input data access module analyzes data to obtain a plurality of demand direction label sets; constructing a first constraint condition according to the manpower condition of a target power company; constructing a second constraint condition according to the plurality of demand direction label sets; obtaining a plurality of first-aid repair scheduling schemes; performing double-term optimization on the multiple first-aid repair scheduling schemes according to the first constraint condition, the second constraint condition and the index parameter sets of the multiple first-aid repair scheduling schemes to obtain an optimal first-aid repair scheduling scheme; and inputting the data into a visual display module to perform visual repair scheduling management. The method and the device solve the technical problems of long feedback period and low management efficiency of power scheduling in the prior art, and achieve the technical effects of improving timeliness of power scheduling management, performing management visualization and improving management efficiency.
assignees: SPEED CHINA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Be used for prosthetic green slope protection structure of planting of geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a green slope protection structure of planting for geological disaster restoration belongs to geological disaster restoration technical field, including backfill soil layer, backfill soil layer upper end both sides are provided with spacing roof beam, two be provided with ecological mould frame between the spacing roof beam, ecological mould frame inside is provided with the vegetation bag, ecological mould frame curb plate inside is provided with drainage component, the utility model discloses set up drainage component, make the rainwater discharge through wash port and outlet, thereby avoid the rainwater in the vegetation bag to accumulate and influence the growth of its inside plant, the filter screen can filter the rainwater, the soil loss appears when avoiding the rainwater to discharge, improves the protective effect of green slope protection; the utility model discloses set up coupling assembling, during the connecting hole that makes the connecting plate of an ecological mould frame chamfer department inserted another ecological mould frame chamfer department, can be convenient connect a plurality of ecological mould frames to the non-deformable is stabilized more to the structure when making it lay.
assignees: FUJIAN YANTIAN INFRASTRUCTURE ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Black start path generation method and device and nonvolatile storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a black start path generation method and device and a nonvolatile storage medium. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: determining a target function, a recovery power utilization sequence of a plurality of black-start power supply nodes in a target area and a power grid connection diagram, wherein the power grid connection diagram represents the connection relation between power equipment in the target area; and generating a black start path of a target area by adopting an improved Floiede algorithm according to the power recovery sequence of the black start power supply nodes, the power grid connection diagram and the target function. The invention solves the technical problem that the black start process is not used as a dynamic process when the black start path is generated in the prior art.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;BEIJING DINGCHENG HONGAN TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent payment method for power grid integrated platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent payment method for a power grid integrated platform, which belongs to the field of intelligent payment and comprises the following steps: step 1, establishing an electric power payment big data analysis system, wherein the electric power payment big data analysis system comprises 4 steps of sample extraction, feature construction, data cleaning and model training by selecting an algorithm; and 2, intelligently analyzing, judging and executing the power failure and power restoration data based on the electric power payment big data analysis system established in the step 1, and realizing automation of the whole business process. By the application of the mobile terminal, a distribution room manager can quickly respond to the abnormal power failure and restoration information and perform targeted processing. Through strategy configuration in the system, reason prompt of abnormal information is realized, and the processing efficiency of the distribution room manager for power failure and recovery work is greatly improved.
assignees: YANBIAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID JILINSHENG ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Transmission line fault location, isolation & system restoration (flisr) system
abstract_en: An electrical power network employing fault location, isolation and system restoration. The system includes a plurality of switching devices electrically coupled along a power line downstream of a fault interrupting device. The switching devices each have current and voltage sensing capability and the capability to provide pulse tests for detecting fault presence. The fault interrupting device performs reclosing operations, and when the plurality of switching devices detect fault presence a predetermined number of times in coordination with a number of reclosing operations performed by the fault interrupting device and detect loss of voltage, each switching device opens. The fault interrupting device closes when the switching devices open, and the switching devices sequentially pulse test and close from a furthest upstream switching device when detecting return of voltage and no fault presence until a switching device closest to the fault pulse tests and detects fault presence and locks open.
assignees: S & C ELECTRIC CO

title_en: Data disaster recovery method and device
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of data storage and provides a data disaster recovery method and device, comprising the steps of determining the fault type and the range of data to be recovered in a distributed cluster system; the method comprises the steps of obtaining state parameters of a plurality of normal nodes in a distributed cluster system, obtaining service sensitivity characteristics and data block access characteristics of data to be recovered, carrying out data preprocessing operation, determining a data recovery priority list and a node priority list by adopting a service sensitivity evaluation model and a node state evaluation model respectively, determining a fault processing strategy according to the data recovery priority list and the node priority list, and executing the fault processing strategy. According to the method, the real-time evaluation algorithm of the heterogeneous large data node is added on the basis of dynamically updating the data recovery priority based on the service sensitivity evaluation model, and compared with the prior art, the method can reduce the fault perception of a service system and improve the data disaster recovery efficiency.

title_en: Post-disaster restoration method for existing bridge
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bridge treatment, in particular to a post-disaster resetting method for an existing bridge. According to the technical scheme, the earthquake-damaged beam body of the earthquake-damaged bridge is supported and centered, and then a static load test and a dynamic performance test are carried out on the centered beam body, so that the stress performance of the centered beam body is obtained; according to the stress performance, corresponding reinforcing measures are determined and the righting beam body is reinforced to obtain a reinforcing beam body so as to reset the earthquake damage section, so that the method can righting, resetting and reinforcing the earthquake damage section of the existing bridge after encountering geological disasters in the implementation process, further can repair the bridge after encountering geological disasters, and overcomes the defect that the bridge after encountering earthquake damage cannot be reset in the related technology.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY 20 BUREAU GROUP CORP;NO 3 ENGINEERING CORPORATION LTD OF CR20G

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle obstacle avoidance method capable of effectively tracking preset route
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle obstacle avoidance method for effectively tracking a preset route, which is used for solving the technical problems of slower track recovery speed and larger track deviation degree in the prior art, and comprises the following steps of 1) calculating track recovery point coordinates of an unmanned aerial vehicle; 2) defining an internal common tangent equation of a track recovery turning circle and a threat circle, 3) planning a track of a obstacle avoidance section of the unmanned aerial vehicle by utilizing improved artificial potential field regulations, 4) planning a track recovery section of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and 5) obtaining an obstacle avoidance result of the unmanned aerial vehicle. According to the invention, the whole obstacle avoidance process of the unmanned aerial vehicle is divided into the obstacle avoidance section tracks and the track restoration section tracks for planning respectively, the unmanned aerial vehicle can fly sequentially along the two sections of tracks and finally return to the preset track, the track restoration speed of the unmanned aerial vehicle is improved, the track deviation degree is reduced, and the unmanned aerial vehicle can be used in the fields of collaborative search, communication relay, disaster rescue and the like of the unmanned aerial vehicle.

title_en: Power and communication coordination recovery method and device for power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for coordinated recovery of power and communication of a power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: dividing a region to be restored into a plurality of primary regions to be restored and secondary regions to be restored; taking a first-stage to-be-recovered area where the fault base station is located as an emergency communication recovery area, and determining all emergency communication recovery areas where the fault base station is located; calculating the recovery return of the fault base station in each emergency communication recovery area according to the power parameters of the secondary to-be-recovered area and the communication parameters of the emergency communication recovery area, and recovering the communication faults of the emergency communication recovery area according to the sequence of the recovery returns from large to small; establishing a power communication double-layer optimization model of the region to be restored by taking rapid restoration of power supply of the important load level region as a general target; and solving the power communication double-layer optimization model by using a depth-first traversal path search algorithm to determine a final repair scheme. By adopting the embodiment of the invention, the rush-repair time of the power distribution network after disaster can be greatly shortened, and the power failure loss of the power distribution network is reduced.
assignees: STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD;UNIV NANJING POSTS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Ecological environment treatment device for preventing and controlling geological disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological environment treatment device for preventing and controlling geological disasters, which belongs to the technical field of ecological environment restoration and comprises two outer support plates, wherein a frame is connected to the outer support plates in a sliding manner, a main body support is fixedly connected to the frame, a cover plate is fixedly connected to the main body support, two solar panels are rotatably connected to the cover plate, and a water collecting tank is arranged on the cover plate; the frame is provided with a sowing component for sowing plant seeds; the frame is provided with a soil loosening assembly for loosening soil and digging hard objects such as stones and the like; the main body support is provided with a collapse detection assembly which is used for detecting whether the collapse risk exists on the ground or not and finishing treatment. The invention can detect whether the subsidence risk exists on the ground and solve the problem when sowing vegetation on the repair region, and prevent the loss caused by subsidence of the region under the uncontrollable condition.

title_en: Method for generating human face based on attributes of cross-modal attention generation countermeasure network
abstract_en: Aiming at generating a face image from a visual attribute text, the invention designs a method for generating a face based on the attribute of a cross-modal attention generation countermeasure network. The method relates to the application of generating a face image from an attribute text description, and in particular to the application of portraying a target character according to a language description. The method comprises four parts of data set preprocessing, network model design, network optimal model training and network model performance evaluation. The invention gives full play to the superiority of the generation countermeasure network in the aspect of image generation, designs an end-to-end solution for generating the human face from the visual attribute text, and has very wide application prospect in the fields of image restoration, public safety, archaeological research, movie and television animation and the like.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Emergency response system
title_ko: 통합 화재 대응 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated fire response system. The integrated fire response system may comprise: a fire detection sensor which is installed in a section of a building and outputs a fire detection signal when fire occurs; a camera which captures the section; an image analyzing device which analyzes camera images provided by the camera to identify a person who entered the section and a person who left the section, and counts the number of people who entered or left the section to calculate the number of people remaining in the section; a communication router which transmits the fire detection signal and the number of people remaining through a mobile communication network; and a management server which receives the fire detection signal and the number of people remaining through the communication router and displays a fire occurrence location and the number of people remaining for each section on a structure drawing of the building where the fire occurs. The present invention provides an integrated fire response system which can collect/analyze information on "preparedness-response" among "prevention-preparedness-response-restoration" required in disaster managements.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 통합 화재 대응 시스템에 관한 것이다. 통합 화재 대응 시스템은 건물의 구역에 설치되며, 화재 발생시 화재감지신호를 출력하는 화재감지센서, 상기 구역을 촬영하는 카메라, 상기 카메라가 제공한 카메라 영상을 분석하여 상기 구역에 진입한 진입자와 상기 구역으로부터 나온 진출자를 식별하며, 상기 진입자의 수와 상기 진출자의 수를 카운트하여 상기 구역의 잔류인원수를 산출하는 영상분석장치, 상기 화재감지신호 및 상기 잔류인원수를 이동 통신망을 통해 전송하는 통신 라우터 및 상기 통신 라우터를 통해 상기 화재감지신호 및 상기 잔류인원수를 수신하고, 화재 발생 위치 및 구역별 잔류인원수를 화재가 발생한 건물의 구조도에 표출하는 관제 서버를 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: KNX INFORMATION COMMUNICATIONS;HONG JI YUN

title_en: Shock Absorber for Underground Distribution Cable
title_ko: 건축용 지중배전 케이블 완충장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an underground power distribution cable buffer device for construction which can immediately restore a binding band to a state in which the binding band is tight by an elastic restoration force of a tensile spring when the binding band installed in a power cable is loosened in case of an earthquake. The underground power distribution cable buffer device comprises: a band hook groove (44) formed by cutting a convex surface, formed on a lower surface of a band tensile plate (42), in an eleventh shape along a longitudinal direction and deforming a cut portion to a more gentle curved shape than the band tensile plate (42) and configured to prevent separation of the binding band; and chamfered portions (62, 72) individually formed on facing surfaces of a pin head (61) and a flange (71).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지진시 전력케이블에 설치된 결속밴드가 이완되는 경우 인장스프링의 탄성복원력에 의해 결속밴드가 팽팽한 상태로 즉시 복원될 수 있도록 한 건축용 지중배전 케이블 완충장치에 관한 것으로, 밴드인장판(42)의 저면에 형성된 볼록한 면을 길이방향을 따라 십일자 모양으로 절개한 다음 절개부를 밴드인장판(42)보다 완만한 곡면으로 변형시켜서 형성되고, 결속밴드(20)의 이탈을 방지하는 밴드걸림홈(44); 핀헤드(61)와 플랜지(71)의 마주보는 면에 각각 형성되는 면취부(62)(72)를 포함한다.
assignees: NAROENC CO LTD

title_en: Post-disaster collaborative repair scheduling method for urban power distribution network and traffic system
abstract_en: The invention provides a post-disaster collaborative repair scheduling method for an urban power distribution network and a traffic system, which comprises the steps of acquiring data information according to a fault element of the urban power distribution network and a damaged/interrupted road of the traffic system, establishing constraint conditions of post-disaster operation scheduling of the urban power distribution network, establishing constraint conditions of post-disaster operation scheduling of the traffic system, establishing association constraint of a repair decision of an electric power system repair team under the condition of road operation, establishing respective repair decision constraint, taking the maximized total electric power load recovery amount and road traffic flow as objective functions, establishing a collaborative repair scheduling optimization model for the urban power distribution network and the traffic system after disaster, and solving the acquired data information as input parameters of the collaborative repair scheduling optimization model to acquire a repair scheduling scheme. The invention considers the influence of the dynamic change of the road state of the traffic system on the rush-repair decision of the power system, improves the post-disaster recovery efficiency of the power distribution network and the traffic system, and reduces the economic loss caused by power reduction.

title_en: Power grid enterprise warehousing and distribution network optimization method based on improved genetic algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid enterprise storage and distribution network optimization method based on an improved genetic algorithm, which comprises the steps of coding, establishing a planning model, collecting relevant information of storage and distribution of a region to be planned, coding a region library RDC, a turnover library FDC and a demand unit, generating a total network, namely a chromosome according to a supply and demand relationship, and establishing the planning model; copying, namely copying the chromosome to obtain a population; dividing, namely performing local network division on genes of each chromosome in the population; before mutation operation is carried out, local network division is carried out on each chromosome in the population, effective mutation occurs in the local network according to the division result, and network restoration is carried out on the result after the mutation and the crossover through multiple constraint conditions, so that invalid mutation and crossover can be effectively reduced, the calculation amount is reduced, and the efficiency of storage and distribution network optimization is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method for inhibiting thermal stratification of reservoir by exciting water flow oscillation through reservoir day adjustment and scheduling
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of improvement and restoration of lake and reservoir water, and discloses a method for inhibiting reservoir thermal stratification by exciting water flow oscillation by reservoir daily regulation and scheduling, wherein gravity waves are formed by reservoir main flow caused by the daily regulation and scheduling process of a reservoir, and high-frequency water flow oscillation phenomenon is induced in a tributary bay; the water flow oscillation process causes the water level of the warehouse bay to have high-frequency fluctuation characteristics, intermittently increases or reduces the water flow rate of the warehouse bay, and causes the water to intermittently mix through the periodic high-frequency oscillation process to cause the high-frequency fluctuation of the water temperature, thereby realizing the function of inhibiting water temperature stratification. According to the invention, by adjusting the drainage flow of the water power station, the fluctuation of the water level in front of the dam is generated, the gravity wave of the main flow is induced, and then the high-frequency water flow oscillation phenomenon of the tributary warehouse bay is induced. The invention can effectively improve the density stratification characteristics of deep water lakes and reservoirs, and has the advantages of simple operation, easy realization, obvious effect and the like compared with the existing common engineering measures such as layered water taking, water pumping and aeration.

title_en: Visual whole-process monitoring system for power grid arrearage power failure and power restoration
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of whole-process monitoring of a power grid, and discloses a visual whole-process monitoring system for arrearage, power failure and power restoration of the power grid; the power grid arrearage power failure and power failure visual whole-process monitoring system comprises a GIS geographic information system, wherein the GIS geographic information system is used for visually displaying and reflecting different information on all data in the power grid arrearage power failure and power failure visual whole-process monitoring system, such as different geographic environments, line ranges, power supply of important users, thematic analysis charts of a distribution network and the like, the data can be displayed and analyzed in an overlapping or layered mode, the power supply radius of each line and the load condition of each line can be automatically counted and listed according to query requirements, the model and the production date of equipment to which the line belongs are displayed, and even the operation health condition is displayed, so that weak links of the distribution network are found out for analysis, a reliable basis is provided for distribution network planning, the visualization of the whole process from collection to power supply is realized, and convenience is brought for users to check when power failure occurs and reduce user anxiety.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method for estimating pollution amount of underground LNAPL
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for estimating underground LNAPL pollution amount, which relates to the technical field of underground water pollution and restoration and comprises the following steps of measuring apparent thickness of LNAPL in a plurality of monitoring wells, collecting water-containing medium in a stratum, measuring saturated water content and capillary water penetration amount of the water-containing medium and calculating effective capillary rise height, calculating actual thickness of LNAPL in the stratum according to the apparent thickness of LNAPL in the plurality of monitoring wells and the effective capillary rise height, establishing a coordinate system according to the actual thickness of LNAPL in the stratum and layout forms of the plurality of monitoring wells, endowing a plurality of different coordinate values for the plurality of monitoring wells on the coordinate system, fitting a stratum LNAPL distribution map and a distribution function, and estimating the pollution area, the pollution volume and the pollution amount of LNAPL in the stratum. The invention adopts the effective capillary rise height h  e  to replace h  a  for approximate calculation, thereby greatly reducing the error of LNAPL actual thickness estimation.

title_en: Geological disaster ecological restoration structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disasters ecological remediation structure belongs to ecological remediation technical field, including the ground nail, the fixed surface of ground nail is provided with the connecting plate, the below of connecting plate is inserted and is equipped with protection component, the top of connecting plate is provided with around the post, just it is located the surface of ground nail to wind the post, the surface of winding the post is provided with the tractive rope, the other end of tractive rope is provided with plants frame one, the other end of planting frame one is provided with through the tractive rope and plants frame two, the other end of planting frame two also is provided with the ground nail through the tractive rope, the equal symmetry in one side of planting frame one and planting frame two is provided with the subassembly that shocks resistance, the utility model discloses a set up protection component, conveniently protect the ground nail, by the scratch when avoiding the staff to carry. The utility model discloses a set up the subassembly that shocks resistance, be convenient for cushion the dynamics that the planting frame received.
assignees: FUJIAN YANTIAN INFRASTRUCTURE ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution system post-disaster multiple fault recovery process evaluation method considering maintenance strategy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating a power distribution system after-disaster multiple fault recovery process by considering a maintenance strategy, which overcomes the defects of the prior art and comprises the following steps: s1, determining a fault scene and maintenance parameters, specifically: s101, determining a power distribution system network topology parameter, including: branch information, user information, and power information; s102, determining a set of disaster-caused fault elements in the power distribution system to obtain a system fault scene, analyzing and counting power failure loads to obtain an initial state before the system starts to recover; s103, determining the number of maintenance teams in the system and the maintenance time of a single element; s2, establishing an evaluation index system of the multiple fault recovery process of the power distribution system; and S3, optimizing the maintenance attribute of the fault element, determining an optimal maintenance strategy, determining the power restoration time of each load and user in the recovery process according to the optimal maintenance strategy, obtaining a load recovery curve and a user recovery curve according to the power restoration time, and calculating evaluation indexes of each recovery process.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD WENZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Fault risk assessment method and device for power transmission line and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault risk assessment method and device for a power transmission line and electronic equipment. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: acquiring external fault influence factors of the power transmission line, wherein the external fault influence factors are influence factors causing unplanned outage of the power transmission line; determining a preset fault rate and a preset restoration rate corresponding to each external force fault influence factor; calculating the probability of the power transmission line in each operation state based on the preset fault rate and the preset repair rate, wherein the operation state comprises a normal operation state and at least one of the following states: transient fault state caused by each external fault influencing factor and permanent fault state caused by each external fault influencing factor. The invention solves the technical problems of low fault risk evaluation accuracy and high loss risk in the fault risk evaluation method of the power transmission line in the prior art.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: BIM-based RC frame structure earthquake damage judgment and loss prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a BIM-based earthquake damage judgment and loss prediction method for an RC frame structure, which comprises the following steps: through the model conversion function of RTO (Revitto OpenSEES), earthquake response analysis is directly carried out on the BIM in Revit, building damage levels under the earthquake action are respectively obtained from three layers of a member, a floor and the whole structure according to the evaluation standard of building earthquake resistance toughness, and earthquake damage information of the member is automatically stored in the BIM so as to realize the management and integration of the earthquake resistance performance information of the building structure in the whole life cycle of the building; based on the current engineering quota, the construction cost of the structure is automatically obtained in Revit, and then the post-earthquake restoration cost, the earthquake restoration time, the casualty number and the like are automatically obtained in Revit through the earthquake damage of the structure and the members, so that the building earthquake disaster evaluation directly based on BIM is realized. Therefore, effective structural anti-seismic toughness evaluation function integration and corresponding data sharing are carried out on the BIM platform.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN MINZU

title_en: Traffic flow restoration method and system based on space-time fusion and self-attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traffic flow restoration method and system based on space-time fusion and a self-attention mechanism. The invention provides a traffic flow restoration method based on space-time combination and time-space elimination, wherein the space-time combination enables a model to add spatial information, time information and numerical values and view the sum as a whole when a self-attention mechanism is used, the front-back relation of the spatial information and the time of a road network in a road is fully utilized, and the utilization rate of road map information is improved; a space-time fusion and self-attention mechanism for traffic flow restoration is provided. The space-time fusion and self-attention mechanism enables a model to extract the implicit relation of traffic flow among different roads by combining space and time information, and learns the historical flow characteristics of a road map; a method for repairing and fusing two sequence data of positive sequence and negative sequence is provided. Two sequences are obtained through two traversal methods of positive sequence and reverse sequence, various information of different sequences is extracted, and the repair accuracy is improved.
assignees: UNIV HANGZHOU DIANZI

title_en: Dynamic monitoring method and system for vegetation recovery after fire
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic monitoring method and a dynamic monitoring system for vegetation restoration after fire, which relate to the technical field of ecological environment monitoring and comprise the following steps: acquiring time sequence data of a biomass change index NDVI and a normalized burning index NBR of a vegetation area of a fire passing area to be monitored and an adjacent vegetation area thereof in a period of time before and after the vegetation area is burnt on fire based on a remote sensing cloud platform GEE, and determining the fire time of the fire passing area; respectively calculating the difference value between the mean value of the annual enhanced vegetation index EVI in a period of time after fire disaster and the mean value of the enhanced vegetation index EVI in a period of time before the fire time in the fire passing area, and forming an annual dynamic change curve of the difference value; and analyzing the vegetation recovery condition of the fire area to be monitored after the fire according to the annual dynamic change curve of the difference. The invention improves the working efficiency of vegetation recovery condition monitoring after fire and is beneficial to solving the problem of vegetation index saturation in high vegetation areas.
assignees: INST OF GEOGRAPHICAL SCIENCES HENAN ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Replaceable friction energy-consumption prefabricated partially-wrapped concrete combined connecting beam
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a prefabricated assembled part parcel concrete combination even roof beam of removable friction power consumption, including combination beam section, left friction power consumption beam section, filling plate, right friction power consumption beam section, the combination beam section is including controlling two sections beam sections, left side friction power consumption beam section is connected to the one end of left beam section through screw rod and nut, right side friction power consumption beam section is connected to the one end of right beam section through screw rod and nut, left side friction power consumption beam section is connected just through screw rod and nut with right friction power consumption beam section be provided with the filling plate between left side friction power consumption beam section and the right friction power consumption beam section. The utility model discloses a combination is roof beam even has better deformation and power consumption ability, realizes linking the mechanism that the roof beam yields the power consumption easily, and after the combination is linked the roof beam and is surrendered, removable its power consumption spare of surrendering the position realizes shaking the back and to the quick restoration of impaired structure. Meanwhile, the form of partially wrapping the concrete is adopted, so that the post-earthquake reinforcement of the combined coupling beam is more convenient.
assignees: UNIV HUAQIAO

title_en: Desert earthquake noise suppression method based on multi-scale attention interaction network
abstract_en: A desert earthquake noise suppression method based on multi-scale attention interaction network belongs to the technical field of machine learning and earthquake image processing, the invention provides a multi-scale attention interaction network aiming at the problem of low-frequency noise suppression in desert earthquake images, the network firstly samples input earthquake data, then adaptively learns the complex characteristics of the multi-scale earthquake data by utilizing double-branch convolution layers with different kernel sizes, and then adopts a multi-attention mechanism comprising the integration and interaction of the displacement attention and the coordinate attention on the dimensions of a channel, a space and a coordinate to obtain continuous earthquake signals; according to the method, a mixed loss function of mean-square error and mean cosine similarity is adopted, a multi-scale strategy is combined with an attention mechanism, the desert seismic image denoising effect is improved, and compared with a single-scale denoising convolutional neural network, the desert seismic image denoising method has the advantages that the desert noise suppression effect is obvious, and the desert seismic image denoising method is superior to the restoration of the single-scale denoising convolutional neural network to the same-phase axis continuity.
assignees: UNIV JILIN

title_en: Computer room data backup and disaster recovery method
abstract_en: The invention provides a computer room data backup and disaster recovery method, which comprises the following steps: computer centralized backup and bare computer restoration; backup and restoration of a physical server; backing up and restoring a file server; backing up and restoring a virtualized environment; backup and restore from a backup server. The invention provides a 3-2-1 principle of data backup by constructing a framework based on a master-slave backup server, realizes the centralized backup, bare computer recovery and multiple backup insurance mechanisms of a computer, and can realize data recovery from multiple aspects by the master-slave backup server framework if the computer room fails, thereby ensuring that the data safety problem caused by the computer room failure is reduced.
assignees: GUANGZHOU TURING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dispatch planning system, control method, and program
abstract_en: To make a dispatch plan with high accuracy considering an operating state of a facility not to be remotely monitored at occurrence of a disaster.SOLUTION: A dispatch planning system (10) comprises: a first operating state acquisition unit (11) that acquires an operating state of a facility to be monitored; an estimating unit (52) that estimates a probability of the operating state of a facility not to be monitored; a second operating state acquisition unit (17) that acquires an operating state provided from a monitor terminal for the operating state of the facility not to be monitored in which the probability is equal to or more than a first threshold and less than a second threshold; a restoration target specification unit (14) that specifies a restoration target from elevator facilities; and a search unit (12) that searches for an optimal dispatch plan defining the combination of the restoration targets to which groups are scheduled to be dispatched and the order of dispatch for each of the groups. The restoration target specification unit specifies, as the restoration targets, a facility the operating state of which is acquired by the first operating state acquisition unit, a facility in which the probability of the operating state is estimated to be equal to or more than the second threshold by the estimating unit, and a facility the operating state of which is acquired by the second operating state acquisition unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3
assignees: FUJITEC KK

title_en: Method and system for analyzing spatial heterogeneity of electric power facility affected by flood disaster
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present invention are a method and system for analyzing the spatial heterogeneity of an electric power facility affected by a flood disaster. The method comprises: upon receiving a disaster early warning of a heavy rainfall defense alarm and a flood disaster emergency response notification, starting an analysis process for the spatial heterogeneity of an electric power facility affected by a flood disaster; according to water level sensing and monitoring information of a disaster-affected electric power facility body, the individual area of each disaster-affected electric power facility region, and the total area of the disaster-affected electric power facility regions, constructing a neural network for measuring the range of damage caused by the disaster of the electric power facility regions, and outputting a monitoring and analysis result of the spatial heterogeneity of the disaster-affected electric power facility regions. According to the method and system of the present invention, by solving spatial distribution indexes of disaster-affected electric power facility regions and drawing a spatial distribution curve of a monitored water level, the problem of describing the spatial heterogeneity in flood damage is solved, thereby helping electric power enterprises to direct the execution of emergency early warning, load transfer, flood control reinforcement, emergency repair and power supply restoration, and material allocation, and greatly shortening the outage duration of power equipment and the outage duration of customers.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE OF GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Environment risk assessment method for building material recycling after heavy metal contaminated soil restoration
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of heavy metal contaminated soil environment risk evaluation, and particularly relates to an environment risk evaluation method for building material recycling after heavy metal contaminated soil restoration. The method adopts simulated rainwater to leach the risk assessment system, calculates the diffusion coefficient of the heavy metal in the restored soil, and thus constructs a one-dimensional diffusion model of the heavy metal; then calculating the concentration level of the heavy metal released into the underground water in the building material recycling process according to the dilution attenuation coefficient of the heavy metal in the underground water; and finally quantitatively evaluating the risk of potential drinking groundwater pollution possibly generated by the reuse of the restored soil in the first type of land (residential land). The method of the invention has the advantages of simplicity, definite process, short period, high efficiency, science and reasonability, can accurately predict and evaluate the pollution risk of building material recycling to the local groundwater after the polluted soil is restored, is beneficial to the protection of the groundwater environment, and has wide applicability.
assignees: INST GEOCHEMISTRY CAS;INST OF ECO ENVIRONMENT AND SOIL SCIENCES GUANGDONG ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Ecological prosthetic devices in mine
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of ecological restoration of mines, in particular to a ecological restoration device for mines, which comprises a mine, wherein uniformly distributed planting grooves are formed in the slope surface of the mine, anti-slope protection slopes are formed in the slope surface of the mine, uniformly distributed rectangular through grooves are formed in the anti-slope protection slopes, the uniformly distributed rectangular through grooves are formed in the anti-slope protection slopes and are communicated with the planting grooves, the planting grooves are used for planting greening vegetation, the protection slopes are connected with rectangular frames through connecting rods, the side ends of the rectangular frames are connected with spray heads through the connecting rods, nutrient solution is sprayed on the greening vegetation through the spray heads, watering and fertilizing effects are achieved on the greening vegetation, good survival of the vegetation is guaranteed, greening restoration effects on the ecological environment of the mine are achieved, soil on the mine slope surface is fixed through the vegetation, and landslide problems are prevented.
assignees: HEBEI DIKUANG CONSTRUCTION ENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Slope ecological restoration structure for preventing landslide and soil erosion and manufacturing method
abstract_en: The invention provides a slope ecological restoration structure for preventing landslide and soil erosion and a manufacturing method thereof. The method comprises the steps of sequentially arranging wood piles, bamboo chips and geotextiles on the surface of a side slope of a soil discharge field, vertically driving the wood piles into the slope at certain intervals, fixing the bamboo chips in the wood piles in a staggered and crossed mode, vertically stacking the geotextiles on one side of the wood piles and the bamboo chips along the ascending direction of the side slope, filling seeds and nutrient soil into an ecological bag, stacking the ecological bag on one side of the wood piles along the ascending direction of the side slope, and finally planting nursery stocks at the bag opening of the ecological bag. The slope ecological restoration structure and the manufacturing method provided by the invention can effectively prevent the surface layer landslide and water and soil loss, and can also ensure soil and nutrient elements required by vegetation growth.
assignees: CHINA NERIN ENG CO LTD

title_en: Slope protection structure for ecological restoration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slope protection structure for ecological restoration, which comprises a base, wherein the upper end surface of the base is fixedly connected with an installation table, and a protection mechanism for emergently protecting landslide generated by heavy rain is arranged at an opening of the installation table; a water filtering mechanism for collecting water from the soil with high water content is arranged on the left side of the mounting table; according to the invention, the emergency protection is carried out on the side slope after heavy rain by arranging the protection mechanism, the first suspension block and the second suspension block change along with the rising of the water level, the first suspension block controls the connecting frame to rotate around the fixed shaft through the bearing rod, the protection plate moves upwards gradually, when the water level rises to the limit position, the protection plate is in a vertical state, the second suspension block carries out limit locking on the protection plate through the limit shaft, the protection plate also carries out warning effect on people on road sides while blocking landslide, and compared with the prior art, the invention can correspondingly protect the landslide so as to prevent soil from blocking the road surface.
assignees: LIU JUNQING

title_en: Suburb type river and lake ecological buffer zone
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of agricultural non-point source treatment and ecological restoration of rivers and lakes, and provides a suburb type ecological buffer zone for the rivers and the lakes. The planting method comprises a planting area positioned in a river and lake bank zone, wherein the planting area comprises a plurality of planting units, and each planting unit is closed loop through a first ecological water permeable brick; a regulating and accumulating well is arranged in the interval area between the planting units, and the regulating and accumulating well is communicated with the planting units; and a purification ditch is arranged at one side of the planting area along the river and lake bank zone, and is communicated with the regulation well and the river channel or the lake. Aiming at the situation that small villages and small micro-riverways and lakes with river flood control and drainage functions are not received, and the land zone is used for reclamation to be a planting field, the river and lake buffer system is constructed, the land zone non-point source pollution is effectively intercepted, the land zone landscape of the river and lake is improved, and meanwhile the original agricultural production function is considered.
assignees: JIANGSU PROVINCIAL ENVIRONMENTAL ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Construction method of panoramic display electronic sand table in power failure and power restoration state
abstract_en: The invention relates to a construction method of an electronic sand table for panoramic display in a power failure and restoration state, which comprises the following steps: step S1: data preparation: developing a cell boundary drawing tool; step S2: judging power failure: judging whether the power outage and restoration rule of the cell belongs to power outage, restoration and rush repair or normal; step S3: data presentation: through stopping and re-electrifying data, converting the numbers into visual pages; step S4: and (3) adaptive optimization: self-adapting to various resolution displays; the application of Redis and PG database technology enables data to change dynamically; the invention has the advantages of reasonable structure, visual graphical display and improvement of the modern emergency command capability.
assignees: State Grid Henan Electric Power Company Marketing Service Center

title_en: Method for evaluating secondary disasters of earth-covered fire extinguishing bomb based on pre-dangerous analysis and AHP analysis method
abstract_en: The invention provides a secondary disaster evaluation method of a covered fire extinguishing bomb based on pre-dangerous analysis and AHP analysis. The invention determines the evaluation object, then surveys the related data and divides the related data into a plurality of evaluation subunits, evaluates each subunit according to a pre-dangerous analysis method, determines the weight of each subunit by using an AHP analysis method, and finally calculates the comprehensive evaluation grade of the secondary disaster.
