The invention makes up the gap in the field of evaluating the secondary disasters of the earthing fire extinguishing bomb and provides a judgment basis for quantifying the safety of workers in the fire and the ecological restoration condition after forest disaster.
assignees: CHENGYUAN MINING DEV CO LTD

title_en: Lake optimal water level determination method considering coexistence relation of water level and hydrologic connectivity
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of water resource planning and management, in particular to a lake optimal water level determination method considering the coexistence relation of water level and hydrologic connectivity. The method comprises the following steps: analyzing and processing the remote sensing image of the set lake to obtain hydrologic connectivity data; acquiring water level data of a set lake; calculating a correlation coefficient between hydrologic connectivity and water level, and judging the correlation between hydrologic connectivity and water level series; respectively constructing an edge distribution function of hydrologic connectivity and water level; obtaining a joint probability distribution function of the Copula function and the Copula function by utilizing the Copula function; and setting different water supplementing scenes of hydrologic connectivity and water level by combining lake water supplementing management requirements and ecological restoration targets, and determining the optimal lake water level by utilizing joint probability and conditional probability analysis. The invention considers the coexistence relation between the water level and hydrologic connectivity and the uncertainty of the coexistence relation on the water supplementing management, determines the optimal water level of the lake, and provides a quantitative basis for the water supplementing management of the lake.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING NORMAL

title_en: Restoration intention determination support device and restoration intention determination support method
abstract_en: To provide a restoration intention determination support device and a restoration intention determination support method that plan individual operations in restoration from a power failure of a power distribution system and then make a restoration work plan taking an individual operation plan into consideration so as to achieve power failure restoration for as many users as possible as early as possible.SOLUTION: There is provided a restoration intention determination support device for reconnecting a power system section disconnected owing to an accident of a power system to the power system, and the restoration intention determination support device comprises: an individual operation plan part which defines switch sections divided with adjacent switches in the disconnected power system section, and makes an individual operation plan including, as an individual operation section, a switch section having at least a decentralized power supply therein or arranged with a power supply vehicle; the individual operation plan part making an individual operation plan including, as an independent operation section, a switch section in which facilities having accident or damage are present in the power system; and a restoration work plan part which makes a restoration work plan for an individual operation section in which facilities having accident or damage are present in the switch section among the individual operation plans that the individual operation plan part generates.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: HITACHI LTD

title_en: Ecological restoration protection method for rock-soil body slope
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rock-soil body slope ecological restoration protection method, which comprises the following steps of; step one: cleaning a slope: the slope is trimmed to a proper slope according to the site condition, and then objects such as broken stones and dangerous stones on the slope are cleaned and removed, so that the objects such as broken stones and dangerous stones roll off in the later period to avoid corresponding disasters; step two: slope reinforcement: soil piles or metal nets are arranged in the slope rock soil to consolidate the slope soil and prevent the slope soil from loosening, cracking and collapsing; step three: arranging a drainage facility: arranging drainage facilities on the surface of the slope or the bottom of the rock stratum of the slope, and ensuring that the excessive rainwater accumulated on the slope can be rapidly discharged so as to prevent the internal structure of the slope from being softened or corroded; the rock-soil body side slope ecological restoration protection method can comprehensively strengthen side slope soil, avoid disasters such as water and soil loss, slope collapse and the like as much as possible, and can also build a complete ecological chain on the surface of the side slope so as to promote the gradual restoration of the ecological environment of the side slope.
assignees: SHENZHEN RUIYAOLIN ECOLOGICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Distribution network line rapid power restoration capability analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network line quick-speed re-energizing capacity analysis method and system, which are used for providing distribution network line quick-speed re-energizing capacity indexes through a distribution network line net rack quantification analysis principle, carrying out block division on the distribution network line according to distribution network line equipment account data, distribution network line automatic switching account data and distribution network line topological structure data, analyzing the number of users of quick-speed re-energizing blocks when the blocks are failed, and analyzing the total quantity of equivalent equipment in each block, so that the block quick-speed re-energizing capacity and the distribution network line quick-speed re-energizing capacity are calculated, the fault quick-speed recovering capacity of the distribution network line is dynamically and quantitatively analyzed, and support is provided for improving the distribution network automatic construction effect and carrying out safe and reliable operation on the distribution network.
assignees: FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Method for determining efficiency evaluation grade of underground water restoration technology in petrochemical polluted site
abstract_en: The application provides a petrochemical pollution site groundwater remediation technology efficiency evaluation grade determining method, device, computer equipment and storage medium, and relates to the technical field of water environment. The method mainly comprises the following steps: acquiring weights and values respectively corresponding to a first parameter, a second parameter and a third parameter of the groundwater remediation technology of the target area; calculating the corresponding association degrees of the first parameter, the second parameter and the third parameter in different repair technology efficiency evaluation grades according to the values; determining membership matrixes respectively corresponding to the first parameter, the second parameter and the third parameter through the association degree; and determining the performance evaluation grade of the groundwater remediation technology according to the membership matrix.
assignees: CHINESE RES ACAD ENV SCIENCES

title_en: Fire-fighting injection water track real-time restoration simulation algorithm and application thereof in virtual environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time restoration simulation algorithm for a fire-fighting water monitor jet flow track and application thereof in a virtual environment, wherein hardware equipment required for predicting the jet flow track is less and calculation speed is higher by a mathematical calculation mode of adding a correction coefficient, and a corrected fire-fighting water monitor jet flow track model based on an air resistance theory can accurately and effectively predict the fire-fighting water monitor jet flow track in a Unity virtual scene so as to improve the accuracy of predicting the fire-fighting water monitor jet flow track and verify an established model by an actual jet flow track. The fire-fighting water injection track real-time restoration simulation algorithm and the application thereof in a virtual environment are characterized in that an object pool technology is adopted, an instantiation object of a water drop preform is stored instead of being directly destroyed when the fire-fighting water injection track real-time restoration simulation algorithm is not used, and the cached object is directly given to the user when the fire-fighting water injection track real-time restoration simulation algorithm is used next time without being instantiated, so that resources are fully utilized, the process is accelerated, and the system performance is improved.
assignees: TIANJIN FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Mobile energy storage vehicle emergency dispatching and evaluating method for power restoration after disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile energy storage vehicle emergency dispatching and evaluating method for power restoration after disaster. The invention adopts the technical scheme that: constructing a road network model based on graph theory, and solving an emergency shortest path of the post-disaster mobile energy storage vehicle by adopting a path searching algorithm; establishing a mobile energy storage vehicle multipoint optimization scheduling model considering fuzzy opportunity constraint, and determining a mobile energy storage vehicle emergency scheduling strategy; based on an emergency scheduling strategy of the mobile energy storage vehicles, establishing a parallel coordination optimization model of a plurality of mobile energy storage vehicles, calling a gurobi solver, and determining output power distribution conditions of the plurality of mobile energy storage vehicles at disaster nodes; and establishing a comprehensive load recovery capacity assessment model. Aiming at the extreme disaster scene of the power distribution network, the invention provides a reasonable emergency dispatching strategy and energy coordination optimization method for the mobile energy storage vehicle, which can effectively improve the load power supply recovery capability of the power distribution network in an emergency state and optimize the elastic power supply of the power distribution network.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Device and method for aligning the reference position of the shape restoration device
title_ko: 형상 복원 장치의 기준위치 정렬 장치 및 정렬 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and a method for aligning a reference position capable of improving accuracy and reducing an error of a shape restoring device using an ultrasonic probe to confirm a shape of an object to be photographed in three dimensions without a risk of radiation exposure. The method for aligning a reference position of a shape restoring device according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: an aligning apparatus preparing step of mounting a position reference pin in the shape restoring device, and mounting a position adjusting jig in a water tank including an ultrasonic propagation medium; a reference position aligning step of positioning an image obtaining phantom in the water tank by moving the position adjusting jig after fixing the image obtaining phantom to a phantom fixing member of the position adjusting jig, and allowing a temporary reference plane or a center line of the image obtaining phantom to correspond to a position reference pin; and a reference position aligning confirming step of moving an ultrasonic probe of the shape restoring device to photograph the image obtaining phantom, displaying a marker on an ultrasonic image, confirming an aligning state depending on movement of the ultrasonic probe based on the displayed marker, and modifying the aligning state of the shape restoring device when aligning modification is necessary.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 방사능 피폭의 위험이 없이 피촬영 대상의 형태를 3차원으로 확인할 수 있는 초음파 프로브를 활용한 형상 복원 장치의 정확도 향상 및 오차 감소를 위한 기준위치 정렬 장치 및 정렬 방법에 관한 것으로,  
본 발명의 실시 예에 따른 형상 복원 장치의 기준위치 정렬 방법은, 형상 복원 장치에 위치 기준 핀을 장착하고, 위치 조정 지그를 초음파 전파 매질이 담긴 수조에 장착하는 정렬 장치 준비 단계; 영상 획득 팬텀을 위치 조정 지그의 팬텀 고정 부재에 고정시킨 후, 상기 위치 조정 지그를 움직여 상기 영상 획득 팬텀이 수조 내에 위치되도록 위치시키고, 영상 획득 팬텀의 임의의 기준 평면 또는 중심선이 상기 위치 기준 핀과 일치되도록 정렬하는 기준위치 정렬 단계 및 상기 형상 복원 장치의 초음파 프로브를 상기 영상 획득 팬텀을 촬영하도록 움직이면서, 초음파 영상에 마커를 표시하고 표시한 마커를 기준으로 초음파 프로브의 이동에 따른 정렬 상태를 확인하며, 정렬 수정이 필요할 경우에 상기 형상 복원 장치의 정렬 상태를 수정하는 기준위치 정렬 확인 단계를 포함하여 구성될 수 있다.
assignees: KYUNGPOOK NAT UNIV IND ACADEMIC COOP FOUND

title_en: Intelligent management and control method and device for network cut-over risk operation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network cut-over risk operation intelligent control method and device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: a cutting process is formulated, departments needing to participate in the consultation are determined according to the professional type and the emergency degree of cutting, and cutting pre-approval is sequentially carried out; judging whether risk operation exists, carrying out a corresponding accident risk auditing flow according to the risk level, and calling the capability to realize the restoration verification of the cut-over service; and providing a cut-over view and rule management for the user. The method and the device construct a full life cycle cutting process, which comprises the stages of pre-approval, risk examination in accidents, repeated disc after accidents and the like, form transparent views, audit and manage risk operation of each cutting link, integrate various digitization capacities and promote operator management class digitization transformation.
assignees: ZHONGYING YOUCHUANG INF TECH CO LTD

title_en: Real-time power failure and restoration identification method, device and system based on power big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time power failure and restoration identification method based on large electric power data, which comprises the steps of constructing a data transmission platform by additionally installing related detection equipment and transmission equipment through a fixed structure, and guaranteeing the reliability and timeliness of the data; acquiring power failure power restoration data of the equipment in real time, and judging whether a power failure power restoration event occurs according to the power failure power restoration data; if no power failure and power restoration event occurs, finishing the research and judgment, and if the power failure and power restoration event occurs, entering the research and judgment; analyzing event information according to the power-down power restoration data, and acquiring related information of the event information; judging whether the event is power failure or power restoration according to the event information, and pushing related information. The real-time push of the stop point emergency repair situation and the duplicate electricity to the actual affected users, thereby realizing the accurate and humanized push of the information, improving the service quality and reducing the occurrence of complaint events.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power failure and power restoration monitoring device and monitoring method based on GIS and UE4 system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power failure and restoration monitoring device and a monitoring method based on a GIS and a UE4 system, wherein the power failure and restoration monitoring device comprises a data integration center, the data integration center is composed of a geographic information system, a data monitoring system, a three-dimensional rendering system, a state display system and an automatic analysis system, the data monitoring system is used for acquiring power grid management platform rush repair list information and trip information, the three-dimensional rendering system is used for rendering a power failure area on a three-dimensional scene according to power failure range data provided by power failure detailed information, and meanwhile, the state display system is used for simulating a maintenance process. According to the invention, through realizing visual display and simulation of the power outage and restoration scene, information such as the power outage and restoration range, the overhaul state and the like is visually displayed, through monitoring the running conditions of the power grid and equipment in real time, the running information of the power grid is mastered in time, the accurate rush repair of the production team at the first-line post is effectively supported, and a powerful visual guarantee means is provided for the efficient running of the power grid.
assignees: SOUTHERN POWER GRID DIGITAL PLATFORM TECH GUANGDONG CO LTD

title_en: Electric energy load prediction and restoration method based on LSTM neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power, and discloses an electric energy load prediction and restoration method based on an LSTM neural network, which comprises the following steps: firstly, counting the whole-industry load analysis conditions of five-level power supply units of the 'net-province-city-district-institute'; then inquiring the overall industrial load trend analysis of five-level power supply units of the 'net-province-city-district-institute'; collecting power data information parameters of each partition power transmission line during each time operation; the collected power data information parameters of each subarea are analyzed through an LSTM neural network model to obtain the total power consumption condition of each subarea in the same period of time, and the power parameter loads of the power transmission line can be orderly and effectively predicted and repaired through the whole-industry load analysis of five-level power supply units of the 'net-province-city-district-institute', and the power consumption in different subarea areas can be reasonably scheduled reversely according to the power parameter values.
assignees: SOUTHERN POWER GRID DIGITAL GRID RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Ecological restoration device for mining area
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ecological restoration device for mining areas, which relates to the technical field of ecological restoration of mines and comprises the following components: an ecological restoration blanket, a release mechanism of the ecological restoration blanket is paved, and an irrigation pool for watering the ecological restoration blanket is used; the ecological restoration blanket includes: the silk screen outer cover is arranged in the silk screen outer cover, the vetiver seeds are arranged in the silk screen outer cover and are mixed with nutrient media of the vetiver seeds, and the irrigation pipeline is arranged in the silk screen outer cover. The ecological restoration blanket and the irrigation pool overcome the problems that the bare broken organic matters in the mining area are deficient, the soil water storage capacity is poor, landslide is easy, the newly planted vegetation needs to be supplemented with fertilizer and water for multiple times, the vegetation maintenance difficulty is high and the consumption is high.
assignees: WANG XIAOQUAN;YUNNAN XIANGGENCAO TECH CO LTD

title_en: Electricity stealing prevention analog simulation system and method based on digital simulation and physical scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-electricity-stealing analog simulation system and method based on digital simulation and a real scene, and relates to the field of electricity stealing of a power grid. The existing simulation means can not meet the increasing diversification trend, and the simulation environment of large scale, system level and complex environment is lacked; the system comprises a control center, a physical scene control device, a digital simulator, a data application analysis module and an acquisition simulation module, wherein the control center is connected with the physical scene control device, the digital simulator and the data application analysis module; the technical scheme adopts a simulation technology of mixing digital and real objects, provides a practical training environment consistent with the field for the specialties of electricity stealing prevention, electricity utilization inspection and the like, and meets all-round technical training and application training of model operation, system operation, equipment application and the like. And the real restoration of various electricity stealing scenes is realized through a digital simulation technology.
assignees: STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY LTD MEASUREMENT CENTER;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;ZHEJIANG HUAYUN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Low-end micro-processing data processing method for distribution network on-line monitoring device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-end micro-processing data processing method of an on-line monitoring device of a distribution network, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: collecting parameter information such as voltage, current, power and the like in a power grid in real time; comparing the parameter information with a set characteristic threshold value; processing the comparison result; inputting the information obtained by operation and processing into a low-end microprocessor for operation; outputting monitoring data in one or more sections according to the operation program and recovering a sinusoidal image; the invention starts from a low-end processor and provides a method for carrying out threshold characterization, which aims at reducing the load of a microprocessor and improving the operation precision, effectively solves the problem of restoring the power grid information by using a form of a preset restoration function, monitors the power distribution network on line and realizes effective and comprehensive evaluation, analysis and control of the power distribution network.
assignees: KUNMING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Landslide monitoring device for ecological restoration of mine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of monitoring equipment, in particular to a landslide monitoring device for mine ecological restoration. Including the shell body, the inside of shell body is provided with along its axial equidistance distribution connecting rod, be located the connecting rod of top and shell body and pass through the universal joint and be connected, the bottom rigid coupling of connecting rod has spherical conducting block, the connecting rod top rigid coupling that does not contact with the shell body has the connecting block, adjacent conducting block and connecting block form spherical connection, the power is installed through the link to the shell body, the electric wire is installed to the power, the power passes through the electric wire and is connected with the conducting block electricity, the inside of conducting block is provided with the monitoring piece, the shell body rigid coupling has the flexible sealing member along its different high circumference array of axial, the flexible sealing member is provided with the movable rod, the movable rod rigid coupling has the push pedal of circumference equidistance distribution. According to the invention, the position and the offset of the mine surface are monitored through the monitoring piece, and information is fed back to an operator to prevent the mine landslide.

title_en: Virtual power plant intraday data rolling prediction and restoration method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rolling prediction and restoration method for data in a virtual power plant day, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: collecting historical data in the future and preprocessing the historical data in the future; the pretreatment comprises the following steps: filling missing values; processing a noise value; and (5) initialization treatment. Step two: inputting the preprocessed historical data into a data prediction model to obtain next-day prediction data; the prediction model adopts a GRU model added with a dropout layer; step three: and checking the next-day prediction data and updating the coverage. The checking comprises establishing a threshold value according to a residual value of the next-day prediction data and the day-ahead historical data and checking the next-day prediction data by using the threshold value. And step three, recognizing the abnormal prediction data and updating and covering the abnormal prediction data. The method for rolling prediction and restoration of the data in the day of the virtual power plant can obviously improve the accuracy of the predicted data in the next day and is beneficial to the virtual power plant to make a more accurate and reasonable scheduling plan.
assignees: BEIJING CHINA POWER INF TECH

title_en: Urban river prevention and control unit division method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for dividing urban river prevention and control units, which aims at solving the problem of dividing the prevention and control units based on water ecology and water environment characteristics by dividing a water body unit grid and classifying the prevention and control units on the basis of a prevention and control unit dividing index system, refining and adjusting the boundary of the prevention and control unit, analyzing the priority of the prevention and control unit, adopting the method for constructing the index system, dividing the grid of the water body unit, analyzing clusters, analyzing the hierarchy and evaluating the fuzzy, aiming at the prevention and control units dividing the problem of single management and control element, dividing a cutter by unit and the like, provides the urban river prevention and control unit dividing method based on the space basis of the prevention and control units based on the water ecology and water environment characteristics, and can be used for reversely pushing a water pollution treatment and water ecology restoration scheme by a treatment target, thereby not only facilitating pollution reduction performance assessment, but also having practical operability and realizing the rank ordering of the prevention and control units and providing powerful theoretical basis for developing environmental treatment.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Soil restoration management device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soil remediation management device, and relates to the technical field of soil remediation. The system comprises a management room and a plurality of ground detection modules arranged on a ground base layer; a vertical isolation plate, a central processing module, two vertical plates and a plurality of transverse plates are arranged in the management room; the vertical plate is provided with a sliding block which is fixedly connected with two ends of the transverse plate respectively; the transverse plate is provided with a sliding block which is fixedly connected with the middle vertical partition plate; the ground detection module comprises a storage box, a first air cylinder, a first servo motor, a wind power generation module, a solar power generation module, a storage cylinder, a second air cylinder, a second servo motor, a soil detection module, a processor and a drill bit. According to the system, the soil detection module and the central processing module are arranged, the comparison module compares the characteristic points of the soil pollutants, the characteristic code module generates the characteristic codes for the characteristic points, the analysis module analyzes the soil restoration condition sent by the characteristic points and the unmanned aerial vehicle module, the generation module generates a table to be conveniently checked, the soil restoration management efficiency is improved, and the use cost is reduced.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI;SHANGHAI INST TECH

title_en: Low-cost repair decision method for cable
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power cable engineering, in particular to a low-cost repair decision method for a cable, which comprises the steps of monitoring the insulation state of the cable on line by a spread spectrum time domain reflection method, recording the service life end time of the cable, and collecting the service life end time of a plurality of different cables; the method comprises the steps of establishing a cable reliability model according to the Weibull distribution rule of life end time of a plurality of different cables, establishing an average cost rate model according to preventive restoration probability, fault probability, preventive restoration cost and fault restoration cost, introducing chaos factors into a mathematical model of a chimpanzee optimization algorithm, and carrying out optimization solving on objective functions according to the preventive restoration cost and the fault restoration cost through the chaos chimpanzee optimization algorithm to obtain minimum average cost rate, and outputting an optimal maintenance period and a restoration threshold value of the cable. The invention can output the optimal maintenance period and the repair threshold value of the cable under the condition of ensuring the reliability of the cable, and realize low-cost repair decision.

title_en: Photovoltaic acrylic panel for historical analysis and graphic output method thereof
title_ko: 역사해석용 태양광 아크릴 패널 및 아크릴 패널의 그래픽 출력 방법
abstract_en: According to a photovoltaic acrylic panel for historical interpretation of an embodiment, by displaying graphics combined with remnants of cultural properties outdoors and combining the displayed graphics with the remnants of cultural properties to create a completed shape of cultural properties through a photovoltaic acrylic panel for historical interpretation, a viewer can appreciate the completed shape of cultural properties. In addition, by automatically adjusting an output illuminance of the graphics according to an outdoor illuminance, the viewer can view cultural properties outdoors even in rainy weather or at night. Moreover, by automatically charging a battery of the photovoltaic acrylic panel for historical interpretation through photovoltaic power and automatically adjusting a graphic output illuminance according to a battery charge status, graphics for restoration of cultural properties can be output without manual charging of the battery and time constraints. When the viewer is recognized, graphics are output, and when no viewer objects are recognized in the surrounding area, a charging mode is executed so that the battery efficiency can be improved. The photovoltaic acrylic panel for historical interpretation comprises: a light guide plate; an LED; a control module; and a charging module.
abstract_ko: 실시예에 따른 역사해석용 태양광 아크릴패널은 야외에 있는 문화재 잔존물에 결합되는 그래픽을 디스플레이 하고, 디스플레이 된 그래픽과 문화재 잔존물을 결합하여 역사해석용 태양광 아크릴패널을 통해 완성된 문화재 형상을 생성함으로써, 관람자가 완성된 문화재 형상을 감상할 수 있도록 한다. 또한, 야외 조도에 따라 그래픽의 출력 조도를 자동 조절하여, 우천시나 야간에도 야외 문화재 관람을 가능하게 한다. 또한, 태양열을 통해 역사해석용 태양광 아크릴패널의 배터리를 자동 충전하고, 배터리 충전상태에 따라 그래픽 출력 조도를 자동 조정함으로써, 배터리의 수동 충전 및 시간 제약 없이 문화재 복원용 그래픽을 출력할 수 있도록 한다. 또한, 관람자가 인식되는 경우, 그래픽을 출력하고, 주변에 관람자 객체가 인식되지 않는 경우에는 충전모드를 실행하여 배터리 효율을 향상시킬 수 있다.
assignees: YOON JEONG HWAN

title_en: Strategic rationing of vehicle energy for supporting household loads during power outages
abstract_en: Systems and methods are provided for coordinating and providing bidirectional energy transfer events between electrified vehicles and households or other structures, such as for supporting household loads associated with the structures during power outage conditions. In some implementations, available energy may be rationed from the vehicle to the structure based on a power outage restoration estimate. Rather than supporting household loads with constant energy during power outage conditions, the disclosed systems/methods may provide strategic rationing of bidirectional energy transfer in order to extend appliance operation for the duration of power outage conditions.
assignees: FORD GLOBAL TECH LLC

title_en: Three-dimensional digital twin operation management system for real-time analog simulation deduction of sewage treatment
abstract_en: The application provides a three-dimensional digital twin operation management system for carrying out real-time analog simulation deduction on sewage treatment, and relates to the technical field of sewage treatment. The model based on the digital twin technology also realizes scene simulation and restoration of the sewage treatment plant by the atomic system, realizes transparentization and visual management, can centrally manage a plurality of sewage treatment plant areas in multiple areas, realizes unified management, unified allocation and unified operation of water plant resources, and improves resource utilization rate and operation management efficiency. According to the application, the sewage treatment process is simulated through the process simulation subsystem and the data association subsystem, real-time monitoring data are obtained, real-time simulation deduction is carried out in a virtual three-dimensional digital twin scene, the operation management layer is helped to realize remote and immersive real-time monitoring and management and control without going to the scene, and the management efficiency is improved.

title_en: Method for determining power supply recovery requirement of key electricity utilization facilities required by evacuation of post-disaster traffic network
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for determining power restoration requirements of key electricity utilization facilities required by evacuation of a traffic network after disaster, which belongs to the technical field of power distribution network fault restoration and comprises the following steps: determining a relationship between charging station flow and an interior vehicle; determining a relationship between the power supply of the charging station and the function; based on the relation between the flow of the charging station and the internal vehicles and the relation between the power supply and the functions of the charging station, constructing an evacuation model considering the recovery decision of the post-disaster power distribution network; and solving an evacuation model considering the recovery decision of the post-disaster power distribution network to obtain the electricity consumption requirement decision result of the traffic network electricity utilization equipment. According to the invention, a traffic network dynamic traffic evacuation model considering the influence of traffic key electricity utilization facilities is constructed, and the dynamic traffic flow constraint, the evacuation curve characteristic, the charging station dynamic traffic flow characteristic constraint and the like are considered, so that the personnel evacuation path is determined in the estimated evacuation period, the shortest overall evacuation time is realized, and the traffic evacuation electricity utilization demand reference basis is provided for the recovery decision of the power distribution network.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG

title_en: Operation method and system for simulating flood of reservoir hydropower station
abstract_en: The invention provides an operation method and system for simulating flood of a reservoir hydropower station, which are characterized in that a flood peak value is found out by counting the last year of flood, the flood is used as comparison flood, the reservoir water level in the process of carrying out flood simulation is taken as the upstream water level of the hydropower station, the total full-water flow of the hydropower station at the upstream water level is calculated, the total full-water flow is compared with the maximum flood peak value to obtain a simulation coefficient, the comparison flood process is scaled according to the simulation coefficient, the hour-by-hour operation flow of the hydropower station is obtained, the operation is carried out according to the flow, the flood process simulation is realized, and the restoration function of the reservoir hydropower station to a downstream river channel is improved.
assignees: YELLOW RIVER CONSERVANCY TECHNICAL INST

title_en: A green prosthetic devices that plants for mine side slope
abstract_en: Compared with the existing soil-shifting thin green plant restoration technology, the green plant restoration device provided by the invention has the advantages that no matter whether the restored area is a waste slag field, a mining side slope, a platform pit opening and a stone wall, the restored area can be paved like a spider web, the green plant can be safely planted in the restored area, the restored area can be protected as a protection net to avoid the occurrence of water and soil loss, falling rocks and landslide, the poor water retention capability and low vegetation survival rate in the existing green plant restoration technology are solved; the bonding property of the soil with the foundation is poor, especially in the uneven places; the growing vegetation is easy to be eaten by wild animals, and the vegetation survival rate is poor.
assignees: HENAN SHANSHUI GEOLOGICAL TOURISM RESOURCES DEV CO LTD

title_en: Ecological restoration method for coal mining subsidence land in loess hilly area
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological restoration method for a coal mining subsidence area in a loess hilly area, which comprises the following steps: 1. determining an ecological restoration scheme of the coal mining subsidence land in the loess hilly area; 2. determining the depth and width of the water storage ditch; 3. determining the height of a field ridge; 4. building a terraced field; 5. setting a water storage system; 6. setting a road system; 7. setting an irrigation system; 8. and (5) ecological management. The invention aims at ecological restoration of a subsidence area, takes water and soil loss control as a starting point, proposes to treat the coal mining subsidence area by using a sponge terrace, adopts plant hedges to treat coal mining subsidence cracks, builds a novel ecological restoration mode of the loess hilly area coal mining subsidence area, realizes efficient utilization of water resources, controls water and soil loss, and improves the ecological restoration effect of the subsidence area, the capability of coping with natural disasters and the like.
assignees: SHAANXI COAL CHEMICAL IND GROUP CO LTD;UNIV XIAN SCI & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for calculating fault loss electric quantity of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for calculating fault loss electric quantity of a power distribution network, which comprise the following steps: acquiring a distribution transformer outage and power restoration information array when the power failure of the power distribution network is determined; determining the loss electric quantity of each distribution transformer according to the distribution transformer power outage duration and the distribution transformer loss power; and acquiring the fault loss electric quantity of the power distribution network according to the loss electric quantity of each distribution transformer and the distribution transformer influenced by the power failure fault, wherein the fault loss electric quantity of the power distribution network comprises the total fault loss electric quantity of the power distribution network and the average loss electric quantity of distribution. The power distribution network fault loss electric quantity is rapidly calculated according to the power distribution network fault loss electric quantity, so that the power distribution network fault loss electric quantity can be timely and accurately obtained when the power distribution network fault occurs, and a user can evaluate an automatic system according to the obtained power distribution network fault loss electric quantity.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;HUIZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Ecological restoration engineering management process and quality assessment method and assessment system
abstract_en: The invention provides an ecological restoration project management process, a quality assessment method and an assessment system. The method comprises the steps of determining evaluation contents, evaluation ranges and evaluation periods through early investigation and according to each subsection of an ecological restoration project, each subsection of the ecological restoration project, each implementation stage, each technical means and each expected target, and establishing an index system and an index calculation method; collecting natural geography and regional background information of an engineering area, special geological investigation information, remote sensing information, unmanned aerial vehicle image investigation information and the like, and on-site verification information; and carrying out ecological restoration project implementation progress and rationality, flow standardization, achievement data completeness, project quality achievement degree and project implementation achievement evaluation, and carrying out management process and quality comprehensive evaluation. The method solves the problems of lack of management process, management standardization and project implementation quality achievement assessment in ecological restoration projects. The invention is suitable for different ecological restoration scenes including land reclamation, geological disaster prevention and control, site pollution control, vegetation restoration and the like.
assignees: UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES WUHAN

title_en: Automatic searching method and system for fault self-healing electric paths of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for automatically searching a fault self-healing electric path of a power distribution network, comprising the steps of obtaining the equipment connection relation of the power distribution network; traversing and searching the power distribution network line to obtain a trunk path of the power distribution network line; identifying a diverted path based on status information of switches in the trunk path; and identifying a fault area of the power distribution network, performing remote control isolation on the fault area according to the transferable paths, and performing transfer power supply and power restoration on the non-fault area. According to the power distribution network topology, the method and the device for automatically identifying the power distribution network can search and identify the rotatable supply paths in the power distribution network in real time, can solve the problem of misoperation and refusal of operation caused by inconsistency between the actual power distribution network line and the self-healing model, realize automatic change of the self-healing model according to the power distribution network line topology, and can reduce the workload of manually designating feeder groups. When the distribution network line breaks down, the fault section is rapidly and accurately isolated through the self-healing program, and the non-fault section recovers power supply, so that the power supply reliability of the distribution line is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Optimization restoration method for urban ponding road and computer readable medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an optimization restoration method for urban ponding roads and a computer readable medium. The method comprises the steps of constructing a road undirected network topology model, carrying out traffic simulation through a SUMO open source model to obtain a traffic flow set of nodes in the road undirected network topology model and a traffic flow set of edges in the road undirected network topology model, generating a shortest time point path set among all nodes of the road undirected network topology model and a shortest time edge path set among all nodes of the road undirected network topology model based on dijkstra algorithm, calculating the medium number centrality of the edges and the medium number centrality of the nodes in the road undirected network topology model, carrying out sorting by utilizing a merging sorting algorithm to respectively obtain a set of the edges after descending sorting and a node set after descending sorting in the road undirected network topology model, and further carrying out repairing of water accumulation road sections and water accumulation intersections. The invention has the advantages of considering the traffic time and the traffic flow optimization betweenness centrality and dynamically and accurately reflecting the road network state.

title_en: Tropical forest post-disaster repair detection system based on data analysis
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of forest restoration, and particularly relates to a tropical forest post-disaster restoration detection system based on data analysis, which comprises a server, a forest restoration area segmentation module, an area panoramic monitoring module, an area atmospheric environment diagnosis module, an area soil environment diagnosis module and a comprehensive diagnosis evaluation analysis module; according to the invention, the overall restoration evaluation and regional monitoring judgment of the forest post-disaster restoration area to be monitored are realized through the regional panoramic monitoring module, the restoration monitoring analysis effect is improved, the restoration unqualified area is subjected to atmospheric environmental analysis and soil environmental analysis through the regional atmospheric environmental monitoring module and the regional soil environmental diagnosis module, the comprehensive diagnosis evaluation analysis module generates a corresponding environment early warning signal based on the atmospheric environmental analysis information and the soil environmental analysis information through the comprehensive diagnosis analysis, and the corresponding management personnel can be helped to make corresponding targeted treatment measures subsequently, so that the planning of the subsequent corresponding regional restoration process is facilitated.
assignees: HAINAN ACADEMY OF FORESTRY SCIENCES HAINAN MANGROVE RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Ecological restoration method for rock slope of mine
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ecological restoration of mine rock slopes, and discloses a method for ecological restoration of mine rock slopes. The method for judging the rock slope instability of the mine can carry out scientific cause analysis on landslide disasters and obtain accurate judgment results of the rock slope instability of the mine, so that theoretical basis is provided for reinforcement of the rock slope of the mine, meanwhile, the point cloud data of the slope is divided into a block part and a non-block part by a monitoring method for deformation of the rock slope of the mine, the block deformation method is used for detecting deformation such as rotation and offset of a block, the point cloud subtraction method is used for detecting change of the non-block part, and the two parts are overlapped together to comprehensively analyze and judge the overall deformation condition of the slope. Compared with the traditional point cloud subtraction method, the deformation condition of the rock mass can be accurately and comprehensively detected.

title_en: Method for determining construction scale of medium and small-sized river and lake purification facilities
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for determining the construction scale of a medium and small river and lake purification facility. The method aims at solving the technical problems that the construction scale of the purification facility is determined by relying on engineering experience in the prior art, and large deviation is easy to occur between the construction scale of the purification facility and the actual demand. The adopted technical scheme is as follows: the method for determining the construction scale of the medium and small river and lake purification facilities comprises the following steps: detecting the water quality of the river or the lake to determine out-of-standard pollutants in the river or the lake; estimating pollution load, water environment capacity and ecological restoration reduction amount of the river or lake corresponding to each pollutant; subtracting the water environment capacity and the ecological restoration reduction amount from the pollution load, and calculating the amount to be purified of the river or lake corresponding to each pollutant; according to the to-be-purified amount of each pollutant, respectively calculating the corresponding design scale of the purifying facilities; and taking the maximum value in each design scale as the guiding construction scale of the purification facility.
assignees: SCIMEE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Comprehensive system applied to ecological restoration of rock slope and ground disaster treatment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a comprehensive system applied to ecological restoration and ground disaster treatment of a rock slope, which comprises a plurality of anchor rods used for dividing the rock slope into a plurality of areas, wherein M multiplied by N ecological slice bags are paved in each area, openings for filling tillage soil and grass seeds are formed in the ecological slice bags, a circle of main stranded wires matched with the outline of the ecological slice bags are arranged on the bottom surface of each ecological slice bag, a plurality of retaining rings are arranged on the main stranded wires at intervals, the ecological slice bags are fixed on the rock slope through anchor nails, the ecological slice bags positioned at the edge positions of the areas are fixed through the anchor rods, and the overlapped edges of the adjacent ecological slice bags are fixed through the same anchor rod or anchor nail. The ecological slice bags are fixed on the rock slope to prevent geological disasters from occurring on the rock slope, so that the ground disaster treatment of the rock slope is realized, soil and grass seeds are planted in the ecological slice bags in a ploughing mode, the ecological slice bags can also be used for greening the rock slope, and ecological restoration of the rock slope is completed.
assignees: CHONGQING 208 GEOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;CHONGQING JIANGJIN PLANNING AND NATURAL RESOURCES BUREAU

title_en: Civil aviation route planning method with limit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a civil aviation route planning method with restriction, which comprises the steps of obtaining route data and route restriction data, and generating a route network diagram according to the route data and the route restriction data; calculating the shortest route from a preset starting point to a preset end point under the condition of no route restriction according to the route network diagram; performing route restriction inspection on the shortest route; outputting the shortest route as the shortest route with the route limit when the shortest route passes the route limit check; when the shortest route does not pass the route limit check, carrying out path restoration and neighborhood construction according to the shortest route to obtain a plurality of candidate routes meeting the route limit, and adding the plurality of candidate routes into a preset candidate solution pool to carry out optimal route iterative computation until the preset constraint condition is met; and outputting the optimal route in the candidate solution pool as the shortest route with route restriction. The embodiment of the invention can quickly find out legal paths meeting all the route restrictions, and improves the route optimizing efficiency.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN AIRLINES CO LTD

title_en: Target backbone network frame optimization method for power system restoration decision support
abstract_en: Some embodiments of the present application provide a target backbone network frame optimization method for power system restoration decision support, including: and circularly executing the following operations until the verification result of the target grid frame scheme to be verified is passing, obtaining a target backbone grid frame scheme based on a target grid frame optimization model, and obtaining the target grid frame scheme to be verified, wherein the target grid frame optimization model comprises the following components: an objective function and an objective constraint, the objective constraint comprising: grid connectivity constraints and linearized ac power flow constraints; checking the target net rack scheme to be checked to obtain the checking result; and when the verification result is confirmed to be failed, acquiring abnormal out-of-limit information in the target grid frame scheme to be verified, and updating the target constraint condition based on the abnormal out-of-limit information. Some embodiments of the present application may enable decision support for power system security restoration.
assignees: NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV BAODING

title_en: Anomaly detiection and repair based electrical load forecasting device and method
title_ko: 이상 탐지 및 복원 기반의 전력 수요량 예측 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a power demand forecasting device and method, and more specifically, to a device and method capable of accurately forecasting future power demand through machine learning. The power demand forecasting device according to an embodiment of the present application comprises: a data collection unit for collecting weather data, power data, and time data; a data pre-processing unit for performing a pre-processing operation on the weather data, the power data, and the time data; an outlier detection unit implemented through a variational autoencoder and classifying the preprocessed power data into abnormal data and normal data; an outlier restoration unit implemented through a random forest model and restoring the abnormal data to generate restored data; and a power demand forecasting unit implemented through a sliding window-based LightGBM model, learning a forecast model based on the normal data and the restored data, and predicting power demand. The power demand forecasting device according to the embodiment of the present application detects and restores outliers to use the same as learning data. By restoring the outliers and using the same as the learning data in a situation in which the number of data is insufficient, the power demand forecasting device according to the embodiment of the present application can provide improved forecast performance without overfitting.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전략 수요량을 예측할 수 있는 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 좀 더 자세하게는 기계학습을 통하여 미래의 전략 수요를 정확하게 예측할 수 있는 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 출원의 실시 예에 따른 전력 수요량 예측 장치는 기상 데이터, 전력 데이터 및 시간 데이터를 수집하는 데이터 수집부; 상기 기상 데이터, 상기 전력 데이터 및 상기 시간 데이터에 대한 전처리 동작을 수행하는 데이터 전처리부; 변분 오토인코더를 통하여 구현되며, 상기 전처리된 전력 데이터를 이상 데이터와 정상 데이터로 분류하는 이상치 탐지부; 랜덤 포레스트 모델을 통하여 구현되며, 상기 이상 데이터를 복원하여 복원 데이터를 생성하는 이상치 복원부; 및 슬라이딩 윈도우 기반의 LightGBM 모델을 통하여 구현되며, 상기 정상 데이터와 상기 복원 데이터에 기초하여 예측 모델을 학습하고 전력 수요량을 예측하는 전력 수요 예측부를 포함한다. 본 출원의 실시 예에 따른 전력 수요량 예측 장치는 이상치를 탐지하고 이를 복원하여 학습 데이터로 사용한다. 데이터 수가 충분하지 않은 상황에서 이상치를 복원하여 학습 데이터로 사용함으로써, 본 출원의 실시 예에 따른 전략 수요량 예측 장치는 오버 피팅 없이 향상된 예층 성능을 제공할 수 있다.
assignees: UNIV KOREA RES & BUS FOUND

title_en: Data collection system during disaster, and method of collecting data during disaster
abstract_en: To support that a restoration plan for restoring a mechanism concerning power supplied to a power distribution system, facilities and so forth after disaster occurrence is quickly prepared without imposing any load thereon.SOLUTION: A data collection system during disaster comprises a first processing unit for collecting data comprising power distribution information including a position of a power distribution system and/or equipment, and a power application state of the power distribution system and/or the equipment; a second processing unit for calculating an area restored from a power failure state, based on the position and the power application state of the power distribution system and/or the equipment included in the data; and a third processing unit for determining execution timing of application of preparing a restoration plan with respect to the area, based on a typhoon-elapsing situation of the area obtained using meteorological information about the area, an occurrence state at a fault point indicating a power failure state place in the area, and a collection situation of the data including the power distribution information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7
assignees: HITACHI LTD

title_en: Emergent handling system of highway incident
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of expressway management systems, and particularly relates to an expressway emergency handling system. The system comprises an expressway network emergency treatment database, an expressway emergency element basic data processing module and an expressway emergency resource supporting module, wherein the expressway network emergency treatment database comprises a data server, a data integration unit and a data sharing conversion unit, the expressway emergency element basic data processing module comprises a basic data processing unit and an expressway emergency place network restoration unit, the system is used for establishing an expressway emergency treatment scheme, perfecting and screening multiple schemes, is suitable for fast optimization generation of emergency associated lines and nodes, planning in advance to configure or optimize the distribution mode of the existing emergency treatment resources, improves the coverage of emergency treatment resources, and optimizes the effectiveness of emergency treatment of the emergency.

title_en: Prefabricated assembled type partially-wrapped concrete combined connecting beam with replaceable seismic damage
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a removable prefabricated assembled part parcel concrete combination even roof beam of shock damage, including combination beam section and removable power consumption roof beam section, the combination beam section includes left beam section and right beam section, left beam section and right beam section set up respectively in the left and right sides of removable power consumption roof beam section carries out bolted connection, removable power consumption roof beam section middle part is provided with the power consumption piece. The utility model discloses a combination is roof beam even has better deformation and power consumption ability, realizes linking the roof beam easily and yields the power consumption's mechanism, and works as the combination even roof beam and yields the back, and removable its power consumption piece of surrendering position realizes shaking the back and to the quick restoration of impaired structure. Meanwhile, the form of partially wrapping the concrete is adopted, so that the post-earthquake reinforcement of the combined coupling beam is more convenient. In addition, all parts of the prefabricated assembled type part-wrapped concrete combined connecting beam with replaceable seismic damage can be prefabricated in a factory, are connected through bolts during site construction, can be installed in a short time, and greatly improves the construction efficiency.

title_en: Urban waterlogging traffic network rapid restoration method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for rapidly repairing urban waterlogging traffic road network based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a graph structure of a road traffic network; generating a corresponding road dislocation degree matrix based on the adjacency matrix of the graph structure and the randomly generated feature matrix, and establishing a data set; constructing a deep learning neural network model with an attention mechanism based on the graph convolution neural network and the capsule neural network; training a deep learning neural network model through a data set; and predicting the road dislocation degree through the trained deep learning neural network model, and repairing the road network based on the road dislocation degree prediction result. According to the road network repairing method, the dislocation degree of the roads is represented by the difference of the edge medium number centrality, the dislocation degree of the roads under the rainstorm waterlogging situation is predicted by the deep learning neural network model, and the roads with high dislocation degree of the roads are preferentially selected from the dislocation degree to repair the road network, so that the timeliness of the road network repairing strategy is improved.
assignees: UNIV WUHAN TECH

title_en: Airport infrastructure network disaster resistance toughness analysis method under unfavorable meteorological disasters
abstract_en: An airport infrastructure network disaster resistance toughness analysis method under unfavorable weather disasters. The method comprises the steps of establishing an airport network model, analyzing characteristics of the airport network model by using Ucinet software, obtaining a service efficiency function of the network model by taking the number of flights and the distance of the airlines as parameters, calculating importance of airport nodes, respectively obtaining the number of the airport nodes which fail in the network model under random interference and intentional destruction, determining an optimal recovery sequence of the failed nodes based on a genetic algorithm and the like. The method has the advantages that two damage modes of random interference and intentional damage are considered by establishing an airport network model, the recovery time of an airport infrastructure network and airport guarantee resources are used as optimization targets, and the optimal recovery sequence of failure nodes under different damage actions is analyzed and determined to realize the improvement of the toughness of the airport network, so that the service efficiency of the airport network is ensured, and an analysis means is provided for the improvement of the disaster resistance toughness of the airport infrastructure network.

title_en: Fire extinguishing water spray nozzle clamping device for fire extinguishing in buildings
title_ko: 건축물 화재진화용 소화용수 분사노즐 클램핑장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire extinguishing water spray nozzle clamping device for extinguishing a fire in a building, which can absorb shock and vibration, and prevent an accident, comprising: a pair of ceiling supports; a pair of internal fixtures separately disposed inside the ceiling supports; a pair of lower fixtures disposed at a lower part of the ceiling supports; an internal partition; a pair of external cushioning restoration members; a pair of internal cushioning restoration members; and a horizontal connector.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건축물 화재진화용 소화용수 분사노즐 클램핑장치에 관한 것으로서, 천장에 배치되는 소화용수 공급관의 하부에 간격을 두고 분사노즐이 배치되고, 상기 분사노즐이 위치하는 천장에는 건축물 화재시 상기 소화용수 공급관에서 공급되는 소화용수를 분사하는 분사노즐을 고정 및 지지할 수 있도록 분사노즐 클램핑장치가 각각 장착되되, 상기 분사노즐 클램핑장치는 상기 분사노즐을 기준으로 양측에 간격을 두고 배치되고, 상부 끝단에는 수평방향으로 지지구 결합홈과 수직방향으로 간격을 두고 체결공이 형성된 상부 천장 연결부가 형성되며, 하부에는 내측 수평방향으로 내측 수평 지지구가 형성되는 한 쌍의 천장 지지구; 상기 천장 지지구의 내부에 각각 배치되고, 상부에는 지지구 결합홈에 끼움 결합되면서 상기 천장 지지구의 체결공에 결합되는 체결구와 결합될 수 있도록 체결공이 형성되는 상부 수평 고정부가 형성되며, 하부에는 수평방향으로 하부 고정구와 결합을 위한 하부 끼움 결합홈과 수직방향으로 간격을 두고 체결공이 형성되는 하부 수평 고정부가 형성되는 한 쌍의 내부 고정구; 상기 천장 지지구의 하부에 배치되고, 상부에는 상기 천장 지지구의 내측 수평 지지구 상부와 상기 내부 고정구의 하부 내측 수평부의 사이에 형성된 공간에 삽입되는 하부 고정 수평부가 형성되며, 하부에는 수평방향으로 수평 연결구를 결합을 위한 하부 끼움 결합홈과 수직방향으로 간격을 두고 체결공이 형성되는 하부 내측 수평부가 형성되는 한 쌍의 하부 고정구; 상기 하부 고정구의 내측에 각각 배치되고, 수직바를 기준으로 상부 외측과 내측에 상기 하부 내측 수평부의 하부 끼움 결합홈에 결합되는 수평 구획돌기와 수평 지지돌기가 형성되며, 상기 수직바를 기준으로 외측과 내측에는 외측 공간과 내측 공간이 형성되는 내부 구획구; 상기 내부 구획구의 외측 공간에 배치되고, 상부에는 수평 구획돌기와 하부 끼움 결합홈에 삽입되는 외부 수평돌기가 형성되며, 상기 외부 수평돌기의 끝단에는 수직 지지부가 형성되는 한 쌍의 외부 완충복원부재; 상기 내부 구획구의 내측 공간에 배치되고, 내부에는 상기 분사노즐이 관통하는 노즐 관통홈이 형성되는 한 쌍의 내부 완충복원부재; 상기 하부 고정구의 하부 끼움 결합홈에 끝단이 결합되고 중앙에는 상기 분사노즐이 관통할 수 있도록 분사노즐 관통공이 형성되는 수평 연결구;를 포함한다.
assignees: SUNENG

title_en: Methods and systems for recovering disaster damage in water treatment facilities
title_ko: 수처리 시설의 재난 피해를 복구하는 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: A method for recovering from disaster damage to water processing facilities according to an embodiment of the present invention relates to a method which, when a disaster occurs such as earthquakes, floods, and typhoons, decides a recovery order with respect to each water processing process facility included in water processing facilities to efficiently recover from the disaster damage. The method for recovering from disaster damage to water processing facilities may comprise: a facility information-obtaining step of obtaining facility information which is information with respect to each of first to N process facilities in which water processing processes of first to N steps are sequentially performed in water processing facilities; a basic information-obtaining step of obtaining basic information which is water quality information acceptable for each of the first to N process facilities; a measurement information-obtaining step of obtaining measurement information which is information measuring water quality with respect to each of the first to N process facilities; and a priority information generation step of generating priority information with respect to disaster damage recovery of each of the first to N process facilities on the basis of the facility information, basic information, and measurement information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 수처리 시설의 재난 피해를 복구하는 방법은 지진, 홍수, 태풍과 같은 재난 발생 시, 수처리 시설에 포함된 수처리 공정 시설 각각에 대해 복구 순서를 결정하여 재난 피해를 효율적으로 복구하는 방법에 관한 것으로서, 수처리 시설 내, 수처리 공정인 제1 단계 내지 제N 단계가 순차적으로 수행되는 제1 공정 시설 내지 제N 공정 시설 각각에 대한 정보인 시설 정보를 획득하는 시설 정보 획득 단계; 상기 제1 공정 시설 내지 제N 공정 시설 각각에 대한 허용 가능한 수질 정보인 기준 정보를 획득하는 기준 정보 획득 단계; 제1 공정 시설 내지 제N 공정 시설 각각에 대한 수질을 측정한 정보인 측정 정보를 획득하는 측정 정보 획득 단계; 상기 시설 정보, 상기 기준 정보 및 상기 측정 정보를 기초로 제1 공정 시설 내지 제N 공정 시설 각각의 재난피해 복구에 대한 우선순위 정보를 생성하는 우선순위 정보 생성 단계;를 포함하는, 수처리 시설의 재난 피해를 복구하는 방법일 수 있다.
assignees: G&C ENV SOLUTION CO LTD

title_en: Auxiliary device for ecological restoration of mountain
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an auxiliary device for ecological restoration of a mountain, which comprises a diversion mechanism, a first collecting box, a second collecting box and a diversion groove, wherein the diversion mechanism comprises a mountain ridge, the first collecting box is arranged at the top of the mountain ridge, the second collecting box is arranged at the front of the mountain ridge, and the diversion groove is arranged at the front of the second collecting box; the filtering mechanism comprises a water storage tank and a filtering box arranged at the top of the water storage tank. The utility model has the beneficial effects that: through setting up first collecting box for collect the rainwater at mountain body ridge top, through setting up second collecting box and guiding gutter, be used for carrying out water conservancy diversion and collection to the rainwater of mountain body ridge side, and then be convenient for in time drain the rainwater, avoided appearing the condition of barren rock landslide, solved the ecological prosthetic devices of mountain body at present stage and not possess timely drainage's function, appear barren rock landslide's condition easily, cause the destruction to road building on every side, traditional device does not possess the problem of rainwater collection function simultaneously.
assignees: LI JIYONG

title_en: Post-disaster power grid outage and restoration monitoring method based on night lamplight satellite remote sensing data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster power grid outage and restoration monitoring method based on night lamplight satellite remote sensing data, which comprises the following steps of: step 1, determining the longitude and latitude of a geographic boundary and the monitoring time span of a monitored area; step 2, acquiring a night lamplight remote sensing data set of a monitoring area for data processing to obtain a night lamplight matrix set and a quality marking matrix set; step 3, introducing the night light matrix set and the quality mark matrix set as inputs into an aggregation algorithm and executing to obtain an aggregation night light matrix; and 4, performing data visualization expression on the aggregate night light matrix to obtain a night light change curve of the monitoring area in the monitoring time span, and monitoring the power failure event and the recovery process. The invention meets the requirements of power failure and recovery process observation after urban disaster, and is favorable for promoting the research of urban disaster resistance; can provide references for local government and policy makers, and is beneficial to supporting disaster response and restoration decisions.
assignees: UNIV FUJIAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Distributed backup method and system based on locking
abstract_en: The application discloses a distributed backup method and system based on locking, comprising the following steps: the backup restoration tool is arranged in an installation package of a database in advance and deployed to each node along with the database; during the commit phase, configuring a database kernel to add a shared lock to the backup transaction commit phase of the coordinator node; in the backup stage, adding exclusive locks to the coordination node databases based on the current coordination node by utilizing the backup recovery tool; after each shared lock in the commit phase is released, a consistency point is created and the created consistency point is recorded into a database log. According to the embodiment of the application, the shared lock is added in the submitting stage of the backup transaction of the coordination node, and locking processing is performed in the process of creating the consistency point, so that the data of the whole distributed cluster are ensured to be accurate and consistent, and the disaster tolerance of the distributed database is improved.
assignees: HIGHGO BASE SOFTWARE CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network power supply recovery method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network power supply recovery method and a power distribution network power supply recovery device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a line state index, a line load index and a line guarantee index of the power distribution network to be recovered; calculating the component fragility of the power distribution network to be recovered based on a Monte Carlo simulation method; calculating ideal correlation degrees of line state indexes, line load indexes, line guarantee indexes and component fragility degrees according to a grey correlation analysis method; calculating a line state index, a line load index, a line guarantee index and a weight coefficient of the component fragility degree according to an analytic hierarchy process; calculating a line state index, a line load index, a line guarantee index and a line restoration contribution degree of the component vulnerability degree according to a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method; and performing power supply recovery on the power distribution network to be recovered according to the ideal correlation degree, the weight coefficient and the line recovery contribution degree. By adopting the embodiment of the invention, the recovery efficiency of the power distribution network is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Data disaster recovery method, system, storage medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a data disaster recovery method, a system, a storage medium and equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the corresponding backup environment is deployed for the main environment, and a distributed database synchronization system is deployed in the main environment; synchronizing data of the main environment to the standby environment in a full-volume synchronization mode and an incremental synchronization mode based on a distributed database synchronization system; responding to the failure of the main environment, disabling the incremental synchronization mode, and enabling the standby environment to accept all business services of the main environment; and responding to the restoration of the main environment, and restoring the data of the standby environment to the main environment in a full-scale synchronous mode. The invention realizes the automation of the switching flow of the main environment and the standby environment, and solves the problems of untimely data synchronization, multiple manual participation of the main and standby switching, complicated steps, high error rate, long recovery time and the like in the traditional disaster recovery scheme; the service system can be switched smoothly in the disaster scene, so that the user service can be recovered more quickly.
assignees: JINAN INSPUR DATA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Landslide prevention vegetation net
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mine restoration, in particular to an anti-landslide vegetation net which comprises a storage plate, a winding roller, a bolt, an ear plate and a screw. The storage plate is internally provided with a storage groove, the storage plate is provided with a passing groove communicated with the storage groove, and one side of the storage plate is provided with a tooth slot. The wind-up roll rotates and sets up in accomodating the inslot, winds the protection network on the wind-up roll, and the protection network stretches out the groove of walking and rather than sliding connection, and the mounting panel is connected to the one end that the protection network kept away from the accommodating plate. The bolt slides and sets up in the wind-up roll roller, and the bolt is kept away from the one end of wind-up roll roller and is set up the tooth piece, and the tooth piece inserts in the tooth's socket and with it along horizontal direction sliding connection, and tooth piece and tooth's socket are along vertical direction meshing connection. The otic placode sets up in the one side that accomodates board and mounting panel and keep away from each other, and the screw rod runs through the otic placode and rather than threaded connection, and the bottom of screw rod sets up the hob, and the top of screw rod sets up the carousel. The protective net has adjustable coverage length, and the whole device is simple to install and detach.
assignees: MINGDA MARINE ENG CO LTD

title_en: Electric quantity and electricity charge day measurement and calculation and remote power outage and restoration management system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of data management, and particularly relates to an electric quantity and electricity charge day measurement and remote power outage and restoration management system, which comprises the following components: the system comprises a data acquisition access platform, a computing service platform, a management platform and an external data service interface component; the data acquisition access platform is used for managing the data channel and realizing the acquisition of the power use data; the computing service platform is used for processing the acquired data; the management platform is used for managing the data acquisition access platform and the computing service platform; the external data service interface component is used for shielding the external operation on the bottom database and is used as a container for WEB deployment to realize data interaction between platforms. The remote intelligent acquisition and control of the electricity utilization data can be realized, and the electricity utilization management efficiency is improved.
assignees: GUANGXI BOLIAN INFORMATION COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Automatic driving vehicle content safe caching method based on data disaster recovery
abstract_en: The invention relates to a data disaster backup-based automatic driving vehicle content safe caching method, which is based on a safe caching system and comprises a backup process and a restore process, wherein the backup process comprises the following steps: s100, when an internal and external disaster occurrence signal is obtained, a data disaster backup early warning signal is sent; s200, encrypting data to be cached of the automatic driving vehicle by the privacy protection module; s300, the vehicle node module receives encrypted data; s400, the reverse auction module receives the encrypted data and the auxiliary calculation key and auctions the ECS; s500, the safety buffer module receives encrypted data for disaster recovery; the reduction process comprises the following steps: s600, after receiving the restoration signal, the feedback module feeds back disaster recovery data to the vehicle node module; s700, the vehicle node module decrypts disaster recovery data through the privacy protection module. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of high efficiency, good safety and the like.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI

title_en: Forest recovery evaluation method and device after disaster, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest recovery evaluation method and device after disasters, a storage medium and electronic equipment, wherein the forest recovery evaluation method after disasters comprises the following steps: acquiring forest landscape restoration index data after disasters; the forest landscape restoration index comprises ecological factor index data, economic factor index data and social factor index data; determining the weight of each factor index data in the forest landscape restoration index data by adopting an AHP evaluation model; calculating a forest landscape restoration index after disaster based on the weight of the index data of each factor; and evaluating the forest recovery state after the disaster based on the forest landscape recovery index after the disaster.
