The invention solves the problem of limitation of evaluating the recovery condition of a certain area after a disaster from the aspect of single index, and can evaluate the recovery process of the ecological environment, the industrial environment and the social environment of the area after the disaster by using more comprehensive indexes to evaluate the recovery state of the forest after the disaster.
assignees: SHENZHEN CITY PUBLIC SECURITY TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;CITY SAFETY DEVELOPMENT TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE SHENZHEN

title_en: Comprehensive monitoring technology based on digital operation and maintenance of data center
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital operation and maintenance, and discloses a comprehensive monitoring technology based on digital operation and maintenance of a data center, which comprises a data acquisition and storage module, wherein a sensor is arranged in the data center, the data acquired in real time is uploaded to a blockchain platform, and the data is automatically monitored and managed by utilizing an intelligent contract technology; analyzing and predicting data, analyzing and predicting the data by utilizing an artificial intelligence technology, finding potential risks in time and taking corresponding measures, providing decision support for a decision maker, automatizing operation and maintenance, data encryption technology, access right control, security audit, vulnerability restoration, introducing edge calculation, making a disaster recovery plan, and improving the efficiency and reliability of a data center: through the automatic operation and maintenance, equipment maintenance prediction and other technologies, the efficiency and reliability of the data center can be greatly improved.
assignees: GUIZHOU PAINUO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and Apparatus for prediction of Abnormal Situation through Aging Analysis of Battery Cell
title_ko: 에너지 저장장치의 노화도 분석을 통한 화재사고 예측 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and a device for predicting a fire accident through aging analysis of an energy storage device. The device of the present invention, comprises: a data collection unit for collecting data for analysis on the aging of an energy storage device including input/output data, temperature data and external data of a battery cell through a 3-axis acceleration sensor and an infrared camera; a data processing unit for performing data conversion, data synchronization, data classification, and data restoration for the data collected by the data collection unit; a remaining lifespan prediction unit for predicting a remaining lifespan of the data processed by the data processing unit through a neural network; and an abnormality detection unit for analyzing a state of the battery cell as result of prediction of the remaining lifespan prediction unit. Therefore, the probability of the occurrence of an abnormal situation can be predicted.
abstract_ko: 에너지 저장장치의 노화도 분석을 통한 화재사고 예측 방법 및 장치가 제시된다. 본 발명에서 제안하는 에너지 저장장치의 노화도 분석을 통한 화재사고 예측 장치는 3축 가속도 센서 및 적외선 카메라를 통해 배터리 셀의 입/출력 데이터, 온도 데이터 및 외부 데이터를 포함하는 에너지 저장장치의 노화도 분석을 위한 데이터를 수집하는 데이터 수집부, 상기 데이터 수집부에서 수집된 데이터에 대한 데이터 전환, 데이터 동기화, 데이터 분류 및 데이터 복원을 수행하는 데이터 처리부, 상기 데이터 처리부에서 처리된 데이터에 대하여 신경망 네트워크를 통해 잔존 수명을 예측하는 잔존 수명 예측부 및 상기 잔존 수명 예측부의 예측 결과에 따라 배터리 셀의 상태를 분석하는 이상 감지부를 포함한다.
assignees: KOREA ADVANCED INST SCI & TECH

title_en: Gas shutoff restoration determination system
abstract_en: To provide a gas meter and a gas shutoff restoration determination system capable of streamlining recovery operations while ensuring the safety of the entire gas infrastructure, including gas meters.SOLUTION: The gas meter includes: a flow rate measurement unit that is provided in a flow path through which gas flows to be supplied to gas appliances installed in a home of a customer to measure a flow rate of gas passing through the flow path; a self-diagnosis unit that performs self-diagnosis; a vibration detection unit that detects vibrations; a calculation unit that calculates an earthquake index value representing the magnitude of the earthquake based on the detected vibrations by the vibration detection unit; a shut-off unit that is configured so as to, when the earthquake index value is equal to or greater than a specified value, switch the flow path from an open state allowing gas to flow, to a closed state blocking gas flow through the flow path; and a recovery method determination unit that is configured so as to, when the shut-off unit gets into the closed state, determine a recovery method of the shut-off unit from a closed state to an open state based on the diagnosis result by the self-diagnosis unit and the earthquake index value.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1A
assignees: PANASONIC IP MAN CORP

title_en: Fan abnormal value repairing method based on space-time clustering and decision tree
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fan abnormal value restoration method based on space-time clustering and decision trees, which comprises the steps of clustering the space geographic positions of fans to determine target fans and reference fans in fan position classes; acquiring a solar wind speed curve and a solar wind speed first-order differential curve in a threshold value of a first time period; obtaining the Euclidean distance between the daily wind speed curves of the reference fan and the target fan and the cosine similarity between the daily wind speed first-order difference curves, analyzing the similarity between the target fan and the reference fan in the clustered fan position class to obtain the similar reference fan of the target fan, and predicting and repairing the abnormal value of the target fan at the current moment based on the decision tree model after obtaining the power values of the first T moments of the moment when the abnormal value of the target fan is to be repaired. The wind power prediction accuracy can be improved, the economic benefit of a wind field is improved, and a solid foundation is laid for high-precision wind power prediction.
assignees: MITA CARBON HANGZHOU INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ecological space network optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological space network optimization method, which is a research method for solving the problems of various ecologies and landscape deterioration caused by urbanization by improving the association degree between various landscapes through the connection of broken and dispersed habitat patches. According to the related theory of plaque-gallery-matrix and network structure analysis, on the basis of MSPA and landscape connectivity analysis, an ecological network is constructed by using an MCR model, the whole ecological network structure is evaluated by using a gravity model and network structure analysis, and then an ecological space network optimization strategy is provided. According to the invention, an optimization study is put forward on the whole ecological pattern through an ecological space and network structure analysis method, the overall layout construction of ecological restoration and protection space becomes a typical ecological system space structure, further improvement and optimization are carried out, the regional ecological environment is improved, and the broken ecological space is repaired by improving the surrounding land utilization value.
assignees: UNIV JIANGSU NORMAL

title_en: Analysis management device for low-voltage power supply reliability
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an analysis management device for low-voltage power supply reliability, which is characterized in that an electric parameter acquisition module acquires electric parameters of a power distribution network line, a charging state monitoring module judges whether a current power distribution network node is charged, a recognition module establishes a topology change detection index when the power distribution network node is charged, judges whether the topology of a user is changed, automatically records power failure time and power restoration time after the topology of the user is changed and when the topology of the user is changed, and a statistics module counts average power supply reliability, average power failure time of the user and average power failure frequency of the user.
assignees: STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for cooperating fault repair and fault recovery
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for cooperating fault repair and fault recovery. The method comprises the steps of constructing a fault rush-repair and fault recovery cooperative scheduling model combining source network charge storage resource calling by taking the minimum comprehensive economic loss as an objective function, wherein the comprehensive economic loss is the sum of total loss of power loss and source network charge storage resource calling cost in the power distribution network fault rush-repair period, and constraint conditions of the objective function comprise rush-repair team arrangement coefficient constraint, rush-repair scheduling plan geographic constraint and rush-repair time meeting task constraint and source network charge storage resource calling constraint; and solving the cooperative scheduling model by adopting a binary chaotic particle swarm algorithm to obtain a rush repair scheduling plan and a fault recovery plan. In this way, the economic cost of power distribution network fault rush repair and fault recovery can be reduced.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID HEBEI ENERGY TECH SERVICE CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: NAS data reduction method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of system disaster recovery, and discloses a NAS data reduction method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a time to be restored from a received NAS data restoration instruction; acquiring to-be-restored change file information from a preset change file list from the to-be-restored time to the current time, wherein the preset change file list comprises a plurality of pieces of information obtained by carrying out deep data packet detection on network data passing through NAS equipment; and carrying out data restoration based on the file information to be restored. According to the method and the device for restoring the NAS data, the to-be-restored change file information from the to-be-restored time to the current time is obtained from the preset change file list, the information in the preset change file list is obtained through deep data packet detection on the network data of the NAS device, and then data restoration is carried out based on the to-be-restored change file information, so that the time for restoring the data can be saved, the NAS device is compatible, and the NAS data restoring performance is improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN CLERWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power consumption data restoration method and system based on Bayesian Gaussian tensor decomposition model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of data restoration, and discloses a power consumption data restoration method and a power consumption data restoration system based on a Bayesian tensor decomposition model, which are used for collecting weather, holidays, week types and power consumption data, constructing weather factors, holiday factors and week factors, and constructing a similarity objective function according to the weather factors, the holiday factors and the week factors; optimizing the similarity objective function by using a Trojan optimization algorithm, and searching M similarity days with the highest similarity with the repair day in the history days; and constructing a third-order tensor by using the electricity consumption data of M similar days with the highest similarity, and inputting the third-order tensor into a Bayesian Gaussian tensor decomposition model to carry out data restoration. According to the invention, the improved Trojan optimization algorithm is adopted to select similar days, and incomplete data is restored by inputting the similar days into the Bayesian Gaussian tensor decomposition model, so that the restoration accuracy is improved, the data quality is improved, and the accuracy of behaviors such as prediction and the like is improved.

title_en: Sectional protection and arrangement branch box for 0.4kV low-voltage line
abstract_en: The utility model provides a sectional protection and arrangement branch box for a 0.4kV low-voltage line, which sequentially connects three-phase four-wire voltage current and zero-wire current to a voltage current terminal of an LTU intelligent low-voltage state monitoring terminal, and realizes functions of user outage and power restoration event research, judgment and reporting, self-identification of household change relation of a supporting platform region, automatic fault identification and isolation and accurate supporting of line loss monitoring and management of the meter box based on a meter; the auxiliary grounding electrode is arranged at the bottom of the low-voltage line branch box, so that when a zero line in a certain area fails, the auxiliary grounding in the branch box can be effectively grounded, and 380V voltage is prevented from directly entering a household, so that electrical equipment is prevented from being burnt or even people suffer from casualties; when lightning current occurs in the line, the lightning current is led to the ground quickly, the purpose of protecting equipment is achieved, the equipment in operation is prevented from lightning damage, an external power supply quick connection device is arranged in the low-voltage line branch box, and the generator can supply power immediately through a quick plug connector when the fault occurs, so that the dual-power supply function is achieved.
assignees: ZUO WEIHUA;Ji Zaiyong;KWAN MAN KIT;SUN XILONG;LI TIANYANG;CHO EUN YONG;LIU BO;SUN YE;ZHANG TIANCHENG;ZHAO LIU;ZHANG YANLONG;REN YAN

title_en: Rapid power distribution system restoring force assessment index and assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid evaluation index and an evaluation method and a rapid evaluation system for restoring force of a power distribution system, which are used for modeling power distribution system elements and simplifying topology division cells of the power distribution system elements; according to the method, responses of the power distribution system in various stages under natural disasters are comprehensively considered, recovery power evaluation indexes of the power system in various layers before the disaster and in various stages after the disaster are respectively represented through expected values of system load loss, expected power failure load loss of node cells in the disaster and expected maintenance load loss of node cells after the disaster, the evaluation indexes are calculated through analysis and expression of fault probability events, a system function diagram of the power distribution system is obtained, and the recovery power level of the system is intuitively reflected; the method is used for guiding the line planning, the reinforcement of elements, the configuration of the connecting lines, the configuration of redundant resources and the like of the power system when the disaster does not arrive, and provides a quantitative basis for emergency response scheduling in the disaster and emergency repair restoration decision after the disaster.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD;NANJING NARI INFORMATION COMM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network rush-repair and restoration method considering traffic road interruption and rush-repair
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network rush-repair and restoration method considering traffic road interruption and rush-repair, which comprises the following steps: 1. establishing a fault line clustering model by taking the sum of the distances from the minimized fault line to all warehouses as a target; 2. considering the influence of traffic network road interruption and road rush-repair on the power distribution network rush-repair and recovery, and establishing a traffic network-power distribution network cooperative rush-repair model considering the power distribution network operation by taking the sum of the maximum weighted load recovery amount, the minimum time required by repairing all fault lines and the time required by repairing all interruption roads as an optimization target; 3. modeling on AMPL optimizing software, and calling a solver CPLEX to solve to obtain a cooperative first-aid repair scheme of a power distribution network fault first-aid repair team and a traffic network road first-aid repair team and load recovery conditions of each period. The invention considers the actual traffic situation of the post-disaster road when the power distribution network rush-repair strategy is prepared, and can also improve the power distribution network rush-repair and recovery speed by timely rush-repair and road interruption.
assignees: UNIV HEFEI TECHNOLOGY;STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD HEFEI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Hybrid short-term wind power prediction method considering massive loss of data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hybrid short-term wind power prediction method considering data loss in a large amount, which comprises the following steps: 1) Establishing a data restoration model based on GAN and BiLSTM; 2) Acquiring a wind power data sequence, inputting the wind power data sequence into a data restoration model based on GAN and BiLSTM, and carrying out data enhancement on the wind power data sequence to obtain a wind power data enhancement sequence; 3) Decomposing the wind power data enhancement sequence by using a variation modal decomposition algorithm to obtain a low-fluctuation wind power subsequence; 4) Establishing an improved CNN-BiGRU mixed prediction model based on an attention mechanism; 5) And inputting the low-fluctuation wind power subsequence into an improved CNN-BiGRU mixed prediction model based on an attention mechanism to obtain a wind power prediction result at the next moment. Under the condition of poor data quality, the method can ensure that the prediction precision meets the operation requirement of the power system.
assignees: UNIV GUANGXI

title_en: Distribution network fault rush-repair method, rush-repair scheduling system and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a distribution network fault rush-repair method, a rush-repair scheduling system and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical rush repair information of a plurality of distribution network fault worksheets and a plurality of rush repair personnel; classifying the multiple distribution network fault worksheets to obtain multiple types of distribution network fault worksheets, and determining fault keywords of each type of distribution network fault worksheets; determining the rush-repair keywords of each rush-repair person according to the history rush-repair information of each rush-repair person; for each type of distribution network fault work order set, determining the matching degree between the type of distribution network fault work order set and each rush repair person according to the fault keywords of the type of distribution network fault work order set and the rush repair keywords of each rush repair person; and determining the rush-repair teams for processing each type of distribution network fault work order set according to each matching degree, and issuing corresponding rush-repair tasks to the rush-repair teams for processing each type of distribution network fault work order set. The application can ensure the working reliability of the distribution network.
assignees: INFORMATION & COMMUNICATION BRANCH COMPANY STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Near-natural vegetation restoration method for evergreen broad-leaved forest fire burning zone
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of vegetation restoration, and particularly relates to a near-natural vegetation restoration method for evergreen broad-leaved forest fire burning lands. The near natural recovery mode is adopted, the seedlings are generated by sowing, the artificial planting and the later maintenance are not needed, and the cost is greatly reduced; the fast-growing stress-resistant species which are screened are adopted, so that the growth is fast, the coverage is good, and the ecological function is strong; the native species is adopted, so that foreign species caused by transplanting are reduced, and risks such as biological invasion, diseases and insect pests are reduced; the arbor, shrub and grass are matched to recover near nature, so that the recovery speed of the traditional method can be considered, and the long-term effect can be enhanced; the plant ash (alkaline) can effectively remove the wax layer outside pioneer seeds after fire disaster, which is beneficial to improving the germination rate of seeds of the selected species of Sorbus pohuashanensis, pinus massoniana and the like and shortening the time required for germination. Therefore, the method has obvious advantages in recovery cost, recovery speed, recovery quality and recovery stability, and has ecological benefit, economic benefit and social benefit.
assignees: SOUTH CHINA BOTANICAL GARDEN CAS

title_en: Power distribution network power failure transition strategy generation method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of power systems and discloses a power distribution network power failure transition strategy generation method, a power distribution network power failure transition strategy generation system and a storage medium. The power failure transition strategy generation method of the power distribution network comprises the steps of obtaining all buses under a target voltage-loss substation, traversing all buses, determining whether ring network points exist on all buses, obtaining all opposite-side electrified lines of the buses aiming at each bus with the ring network points, and determining the transition strategy of the target voltage-loss substation based on a constraint strategy and load parameters of all the opposite-side electrified lines. According to the power-failure transition strategy generation method for the power distribution network, by acquiring all buses and all opposite-side live lines of each bus under the voltage-loss substation, a power-failure transition scheme is automatically generated based on the constraint strategy and the load parameters of each opposite-side live line of each bus, intelligent generation of the voltage-loss and power-restoration lines of the substation is realized, and the operation is simple and the efficiency is high.
assignees: CHANGSHA ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Method For Restoring From Damages By Fire On Building
title_ko: 건물화재시 피해 복구방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for restoring from damages by a fire on a building, comprising: a wall foreign matter removal step for manually removing wallpaper damaged by a fire and trash attached to walls; a wall soot removal step for primarily removing soot formed on the walls using a water jet and then secondarily removing the soot manually; a wall diagnosis step for diagnosing the walls, from which foreign matter and soot have been removed, using various inspection devices; a wall restoring and repair step for restoring and repairing walls that need repair or restoration as a result of the wall diagnosis step; and a wall finishing step for inspecting the walls repaired and restored through the wall restoring and repair step, and then aligning the verticality of the walls and leveling the outer surfaces of the walls. According to the present invention, when walls of a building are damaged by a fire, a part or the whole of the walls can be easily restored.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건물화재시 피해 복구방법에 관한 것으로서, 화재로 인해 손상된 벽지와 벽면에 부착된 쓰레기를 수작업으로 제거하는 벽면 이물질 제거단계; 벽면에 형성된 그을음을 일차적으로 워터젯을 통해 제거한 후 수작업을 통해 이차적으로 제거하는 벽면 그을음 제거단계; 이물질과 그을음이 제거된 벽면을 각종 검사기기를 통해 진단하는 벽면 진단단계; 상기 벽면 진단단계를 통해 수리 또는 복구가 필요한 벽면을 복구 및 수리하는 벽면 복구 및 수리단계; 및 상기 벽면 복구 및 수리단계를 거쳐 수리 및 복구가 이루어진 벽면을 검사한 후 수직을 맞추고 외면을 고르게 하는 벽면 마감단계;를 포함한다.
assignees: PYEONGAN CO LTD

title_en: Regional power supply reliability assessment method
abstract_en: The regional power supply reliability evaluation method solves the problem that the existing regional complex power system power supply reliability evaluation efficiency and precision are low, and belongs to the technical field of security inspection systems. The invention comprises the following steps: determining a power grid parameter of a target area; inputting power grid parameters into a power distribution network equipment model to obtain failure outage rates of various equipment in the power distribution network; simulating the running state, forced outage state and prearranged outage state of the equipment, and determining the repair rate of forced outage of the equipment and the repair rate of prearranged outage of the equipment; according to the tripping, fault isolation and power restoration processes of the circuit breaker after a single equipment fault, determining the influence of the fault on the power failure of each load point, and determining the annual power failure time and the power failure times of each load point; and calculating the reliability index of the load point and the system reliability index according to the obtained data.
assignees: HEIHE POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID HEILONGJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power distribution network line fault power failure rush-repair method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power failure emergency repair method for a power distribution network line fault, which relates to the technical field of power distribution networks and comprises the following steps: establishing a rush-repair task according to tripping information of the distribution network line breaker, and compiling a distribution network rush-repair task list pool; selecting a first-aid repair team according to an optimal selection strategy of the first-aid repair team, distributing first-aid repair tasks, and establishing a distribution network fault first-aid repair schedule; the first-aid repair team performs first-aid repair according to the first-aid repair task and feeds back first-aid repair information to the allocation and adjustment center; the distribution center issues instructions according to the progress of the emergency repair task, and issues instructions for restoring power supply after the emergency repair task is completed; and carrying out fault repair task early warning according to the repair progress of the repair team and the fault repair predicted time. The invention discloses a power failure emergency repair system for a power distribution network line fault. The invention helps to ensure safe operation of the power grid and high-quality service of the power grid in the accident processing process, and solves the problems of excessive time limit of rush repair, increased demand of customer power supply capacity, reduced high-quality service capacity and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID XINJIANG POWER CO LTD HAMI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Novel power distribution network frame construction method based on multi-state switch
abstract_en: The invention relates to a novel power distribution network frame construction method based on a multi-state switch, which is characterized by being safe, reliable, economical, efficient, environment-friendly, low-carbon, high-quality in service, optimized and interactive, and the like, wherein 8 loop lines are collected to form independent feeder line clusters, a stronger energy configuration platform is built, and the novel power distribution network frame construction method has the characteristics of flexible load transfer, high efficiency benefit, adaptation to accommodate more new elements of an energy Internet, and the like. Each feeder line in the snowflake grid structure is reasonably segmented and connected, has the self-healing capability of fault automatic detection, isolation, network reconstruction and power restoration, can meet the power supply requirements of various users, improves the utilization efficiency of power distribution equipment, and has the characteristics of clear structure, flexibility, reliability, coordinated development, economy and high efficiency.
assignees: STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY CHENGDONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH

title_en: Dynamic risk assessment method for tanning contaminated site based on reactive solute transport
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic risk assessment method for a tanning contaminated site based on reactive solute migration, which comprises the following steps of S1, collecting contaminated site soil, underground water samples and data materials, investigating the type of the contaminated site, generating working conditions and seepage prevention measures, S2, constructing a soil migration conceptual model and a numerical model according to scenes, calculating migration of pollutants in a gas-covered zone medium, S3, establishing a chemical balance system of the tanning characteristic pollutants based on a thermodynamic database, analyzing migration and transformation rules of the pollutants in an aquifer medium, S4, calculating static exposure and dynamic potential exposure of living residents around the site, and S5, deducing the dynamic exposure of the solute migration in the site by taking the acceptance degree of the exposure as a criterion, and balancing and optimizing site exposure investigation-assessment-management. Reasonable risk management and control, site restoration and ecological environment protection strategies can be further formulated to provide scientific basis.

title_en: Method for optimizing sand area and occupancy rate of Lin Tiancao sand area in semiarid sand area
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimization method of a sand area and a proportion of the sand area in a semiarid sand area Lin Tiancao, which comprises the steps of establishing relations among deep leakage amount of soil moisture, rainfall and vegetation coverage under different land utilization types, constructing an estimation model of deep leakage total amount of the soil moisture in the sand area to be optimized, estimating the deep leakage total amount of the soil moisture in the sand area to be optimized every year according to the land area and the deep leakage amount of the soil moisture in Lin Tiancao sand, constructing a linear model of the deep leakage total amount of the soil moisture in the sand area to be optimized, and inverting the optimization area and the proportion of Lin Tiancao sand in the sand area to be optimized by using a machine learning regression model under the constraint condition of ensuring the water resource safety of the sand area to be optimized. The method solves the problems that the prior northern semiarid sand area treatment does not comprehensively consider the relationship between regional water resource utilization and ecological restoration of main land utilization types such as forests, grasses, sand, fields and the like, and the stability of sand-fixing vegetation and the safety of regional water resources can not be ensured.

title_en: Power generation plant and system stabilization method
abstract_en: The present invention supplies inertial force and reactive power to a system without waiting the restoration of a house power supply. A power generation plant (1) comprises: a power generator (7); a switch (41) that switches whether or not to electrically connect the power generator (7) and an external system (31) to each other; a drive machine (6); another switch (42) that switches whether or not to electrically connect the drive machine (6) and the external system (31) to each other; a power transmission mechanism (51) that switches whether or not to transmit the drive force of the drive machine (6) to the power generator (7); and a synchronous phase adjustment control unit (21) that, when detecting the occurrence of a blackout, closes the switch (41) and, when performing a black start, opens the switch (42) to electrically connect the drive machine (6) and an external system (32) to each other and transmits the drive force of the drive machine (6) to the power generator (7) by the power transmission mechanism (51).
assignees: HITACHI LTD

title_en: Method for comprehensively treating regional water environment
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for comprehensively treating regional water environment, which comprises the following steps: step S10, adjusting regional water system layout; step S20, setting a control gate; s30, ecological restoration of regional water systems; and S40, checking the construction scale of the control gate by using a numerical model. The application optimizes the water system layout, improves the flood prevention, waterlogging removal and drainage and water diversion and regulation capabilities of regional water systems, improves the water quality, improves the water surface landscape effect and ensures the flexible dispatching of regional drainage modes.
assignees: SHANGHAI WATER ENG DESIGN & RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Household transformer relation analysis method based on power outage correlation theory
abstract_en: The application provides a household transformer relation analysis method based on a power failure correlation theory, which comprises the steps of obtaining power utilization data, wherein the power utilization data comprises first data, second data and historical power failure recovery data; extracting a user electricity characteristic curve and user electricity behavior according to a clustering algorithm, and making a power failure and power restoration data acquisition scheme; determining a target period of time in which the influence of the power failure on normal power consumption behavior is minimum and collecting target power failure data; constructing a power-off and power-on judging model to obtain simulated power-off and power-on data; constructing a user-variable relation analysis and identification model; and judging whether the user change relation accords with the user change rule or not by utilizing the user change relation analysis and identification model. The application reduces the influence of the acquisition process on the normal electricity consumption behavior of the user to the minimum through the analysis method, improves the data acquisition efficiency, ensures the data authenticity, reduces the labor cost of user transformer verification, provides a theoretical basis for the line loss of the transformer area, and achieves the purposes of reducing the line loss and improving the management efficiency of the user transformer relation.
assignees: LIJIANG POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Personalized insurance product recommendation engine system based on big data analysis and machine learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of insurance products, and discloses a personalized insurance product recommendation engine system based on big data analysis and machine learning, which comprises data acquisition and storage; machine learning; data analysis and data mining; data encryption, adopting a high-strength encryption algorithm and a security protocol to ensure the security of user data in the transmission and storage processes; the recommendation engine is used for quickly acquiring an insurance product list meeting the requirements of the user based on the user characteristics, the behavior analysis, the insurance product characteristics and other data and generating personalized insurance product recommendation; a user interface; reporting and visualizing; vulnerability restoration, namely timely discovering and restoring security vulnerabilities in a system based on a vulnerability scanning tool, security assessment and real-time monitoring; and (5) making a disaster recovery plan.
assignees: SHENZHEN BAND OF BROTHERS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ecological restoration treatment method based on historical abandoned mine
abstract_en: The application discloses an ecological restoration treatment method based on a historical abandoned mine. The ecological restoration treatment method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of topographic mapping, danger elimination, side slope trimming, site leveling, mine greening reclamation, drainage interception engineering and monitoring maintenance engineering. The application acquires the topography and three-dimensional image data of the current mine by mapping the mine, carries out danger elimination and clearing on dangerous rock bodies, collapse, unstable slopes and other ground disaster points existing in the mine, trims the side slopes, fully utilizes waste stones to level the mine topography, carries out regrinding on the mine, carries out intercepting and drainage engineering arrangement on the mining area, prevents water and soil loss, carries out regular monitoring and maintenance on the mining area after regrinding, and ensures that the survival rate of vegetation increases the coverage rate of the vegetation. The application can be used for treating abandoned mines and has the advantages of good treatment effect, improvement of the stability of mine slopes, reduction of geological disasters, beautification of mine geological environment, high vegetation coverage rate and increase of effective cultivated land.
assignees: MCC WUKAN ENGINEERING TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Mountain ecological restoration treatment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain ecological restoration treatment method, which comprises the steps of dividing a mountain to be restored according to height and gradient, wherein the mountain at least comprises a top platform, a slope and/or a slope toe; the gradient of the top platform is adjusted and the top platform is repaired; pouring lattice beams and carrying out vegetation planting on the processed slope based on the lattice beams; constructing a toe and communicating the lattice beams. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the dual functions of stabilizing the side slope and ecologically coordinating, so that the landslide and the water and soil loss risk are lower, and the plants do not need to be frequently fertilized and watered manually, thereby effectively saving the labor cost.
assignees: POWERCHINA CHONGQING ENG CORP LTD;WUHAN BOTANICAL GARDEN CAS;CHONGQING INST GREEN & INTELLIGENT TECH CAS

title_en: Lake wetland ecological hydrologic regulation and control method considering dynamic requirements of waiting bird habitat
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lake wetland ecological hydrologic regulation method considering the dynamic demand of a waiting bird habitat, which comprises the following steps: (1) Through investigation and analysis of the habitat types of the waiting birds, typical emergent aquatic plants and submerged plants are selected as important habitat factors of the waiting birds; (2) Determining a habitat suitability curve of the typical emergent aquatic plant and the submerged plant; (3) And simulating and evaluating the suitability of the birthday, and calculating an annual average suitability index. According to the method, a bird waiting habitat suitability evaluation model based on hydrodynamic force simulation is constructed, the potential bird waiting habitat area and spatial distribution characteristics are analyzed, the influence degree of the hydrologic process on the bird waiting habitat suitability is quantized, and finally a lake wetland bird waiting habitat simulation and regulation method considering dynamic matching of habitat factors is provided. The invention enriches the system of the method for regulating and controlling the ecological hydrology of the shallow lake wetland, and is helpful for providing references for the operation management and ecological protection restoration of the regulation type lake in the heavy water diversion project.
assignees: NANJING HYDRAULIC RES INSTITUTE NHRI

title_en: Cooking control device and method for controlling cooking status when power failure is restored during cooking
title_ko: 취반 중 정전 복귀 시 취반 상태 제어장치 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a device and a method for controlling a rice cooking state when power is restored during rice cooking. The device may comprise: cooking tools having a heating source; and a control part controlling the cooking device to execute a cooking process, detecting power outage and power restoration state through a power outage detection unit, and when the power outage detection unit detects the power outage, storing a currently ongoing cooking process and a measured temperature through a memory unit, and counting a power outage time during the power outage state.
abstract_ko: 취반 중 정전 복귀 시 취반 상태 제어장치기 및 방법에 관하여 개시한다. 본 발명은, 가열원을 구비하는 조리기기; 및 상기 조리기기를 제어하여 취사 공정을 실행하고, 정전 검출부를 통해 정전 및 복전상태를 검출하며, 상기 정전 검출부에서 정전 검출시 현재 진행 중인 취반 공정과 측정된 온도를 메모리부를 통해 기억 저장하고, 정전 상태에서 정전 시간을 카운터 하는 카운터부로 구성된 제어부;를 포함하여 구성될 수 있다.
assignees: RINNAI KOREA CORP

title_en: Regional power stability analysis and evaluation method based on power outage and restoration event data monitoring
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of regional power stability analysis, and particularly discloses a regional power stability analysis and evaluation method based on power outage and restoration event data monitoring, which comprises the following steps: the application analyzes the meteorological data of the attribution area of each path through analyzing and calculating the stability coefficient of the power transmission structure of the appointed area, and can provide scientific and reasonable support basis for monitoring the power failure event data, reflect the comprehensive influence condition of the power failure event, analyze and calculate the power failure influence index of the appointed area through the power failure data of the appointed area, combine the power load and the electric quantity, improve the multi-dimensionality of monitoring the power failure event data and the accuracy of the data analysis, and simultaneously be beneficial to providing guarantee for the electric energy stable use requirement of the area.
assignees: ANHUI FANGNENG ELECTRIC TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD FEIXI COUNTY POWER SUPPLY COMPANY;STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD HEFEI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Active power distribution network fault rush-repair method and system considering road-source uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for proactively repairing faults of an active power distribution network by considering the uncertainty of a road-source, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring daily road saturation data, constructing a road network uncertainty scene set by using a road impedance function, and determining a scheduling constraint condition of a rush repair person considering the road network uncertainty; constructing a distributed power supply uncertainty set according to a sunlight photovoltaic output prediction curve, and determining a power distribution network reconstruction and island division constraint condition considering the distributed power supply uncertainty; and coupling the traffic network with the power distribution network, establishing a robust optimization model of the road-source uncertainty, solving the robust optimization model of the road-source uncertainty, and generating a power distribution network fault rush-repair scheduling strategy. The invention can simultaneously account for the uncertainty of the two layers of the traffic network and the power distribution network, and accurately delineates the passing time uncertainty set, thereby not only ensuring the feasibility of a dispatching scheme, but also considering the recovery efficiency of the power distribution network faults.
assignees: STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Power distribution network rush-repair command platform
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution network emergency repair command platform, which belongs to the technical field of power grid construction and comprises a control terminal, wherein the control terminal comprises an information acquisition module, a fault analysis module and an emergency repair scheduling module, the information acquisition module is used for acquiring power fault information, collecting the acquired power fault information and transmitting the collected power fault information to the fault analysis module, the fault analysis module is used for analyzing the collected power fault information, judging the cause of the power fault and making a preliminary treatment scheme, the emergency repair scheduling module is used for generating an emergency repair instruction according to the preliminary treatment scheme and transmitting the emergency repair instruction to a maintenance site, and the maintenance site is used for carrying out emergency repair on the power fault according to dispatch personnel of the emergency repair instruction. According to the power distribution network emergency repair command platform, the processing scheme is formulated preferentially, and personnel and materials are dispatched according to the processing scheme to carry out emergency repair, so that the blind emergency repair problem can be avoided, the manpower and material resources are saved, and the emergency repair efficiency is improved.
assignees: CANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Building restoration method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a building repair method, a device and electronic equipment, which belong to the technical field of digital repair, and are characterized in that 3D modeling is performed based on related data of a building to be repaired to obtain a target design model and a current situation model, the two models are compared and analyzed to determine a member to be repaired, after determining a material piece of the member to be repaired, a starting point, an end point and a path network of cutting are determined on the material piece according to the shape structure of the member to be repaired, and then the path network is processed by adopting a shortest path algorithm based on the starting point and/or the end point to obtain a shortest path and optimized to obtain an optimal path, so that the optimal path is encoded into codes, a numerical control machine tool is controlled to execute the codes to cut the material piece to obtain a target member, and the shortest path is obtained by processing the path network and optimizing the shortest path, so that the cutting path and the cutting cost are greatly reduced, the repair period is shortened, and the repair cost is reduced.
assignees: CSCEC SOUTHWEST DESIGN & RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Wirelessly controllable lifesaving member and lifesaving box automation system
title_ko: 무선제어 가능한 구명부재 및 인명 구조함 자동화 시스템
abstract_en: A wirelessly controllable lifesaving member and automated lifesaving box system according to an embodiment protects a golden time for rescuing drowning people by providing the wireless lifesaving member and an automated lifesaving system for a ship hull equipped with the lifesaving member when reporting the drowning people, and enables rapid response in the event of an accident. The lifesaving member according to an embodiment comprises a propeller, is equipped with functions such as automatic recovery and rollover restoration, and is quickly and accurately delivered to the drowning people according to situation room control and automatic route setting. In an embodiment, when an accident occurs and a rescue worker arrives and rescues the drowning people supported by the wirelessly controllable lifesaving member, the lifesaving member floating on the water is moved to a pier using overhead host transport (OHT) technology, is moved vertically, and is seated in the ship hull. In an embodiment, the ship hull can monitor accident and rescue situations in real time through CCTV, and can supply and accumulate electricity through solar energy using a solar collector.
abstract_ko: 실시예에 따른 무선제어 가능한 구명부재 및 인명 구조함 자동화 시스템 은 익수자 발생 신고접수 시 무선화 된 구명 부재 및 구명 부재가 탑재된 함체의 인명구조 자동화 시스템을 제공하여 익수자 구조 골든타임을 사수하고, 사고 발생시 신속한 대응을 가능하도록 한다. 실시예에서 따른 구명 부재는 추진기를 포함하고, 자동 회기 및 전복 복원 등 기능을 탑재하여 상황실 통제 및 자동 경로 설정에 따라 신속하고 정확하게 익수자에게 전달된다. 실시예에서는 사고 발생시 구조대원이 도착하여 무선 제어가능한 구명 부재에 지탱하고 있는 익수자를 구조하면 수면 위에 떠 있는 구명 부재는 OHT(overhead Host Transport, 천장대차장치) 기술을 적용한 교각으로 이동시켜 수직 이동하고 함체로 안착한다. 실시예에서 함체는 CCTV로 사고 및 구조 상황을 실시간 모니터링 할 수 있고, 집열판으로 태양열로 전기를 공급 및 축적할 수 있다.
assignees: KOREA COAST GUARD RES CENTER;LEE SUK HUN

title_en: OSG-based three-dimensional geological disaster investigation and treatment scheme system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster investigation, and particularly discloses an OSG-based three-dimensional geological disaster investigation and treatment scheme system, which comprises the following steps: the system comprises a collection and analysis module, a field investigation and monitoring module, a risk assessment and treatment module and an early warning module; according to the invention, a large-scale and high-resolution geological disaster picture is obtained by utilizing an OSG technology, and geological disaster characteristic information is extracted by utilizing an image processing technology, so that geological disaster information can be accurately obtained in real time, in-situ investigation can be timely carried out, geological disaster phenomena, landform characteristics and environmental background are known, monitoring work is carried out to obtain real-time data, the risk degree of the geological disaster is evaluated, an early warning system is established, early warning information is issued, and an adaptive geological disaster prevention and control plan and design scheme including land utilization adjustment, engineering measures and ecological restoration are formulated according to the risk degree; according to the planning and design scheme, geological disaster management projects such as protection facility construction, vegetation recovery and geologic body stabilization measures are implemented.
assignees: NO 10 GEOLOGICAL BRIGADE OF JIANGXI GEOLOGICAL BUREAU;JIANGXI NONFERROUS GEOLOGICAL AND MINERAL EXPLORATION AND DEVELOPMENT INST

title_en: Ecological restoration method for coal gangue pile in karst area
abstract_en: The invention provides an ecological restoration method for a coal gangue pile in a karst area, which comprises the following steps: the coal gangue in the karst area is trimmed to eliminate the coal gangue pile and the geological disaster hidden trouble area around the coal gangue pile, the coal gangue pile platform is leveled, the slope gradient is smaller than 35-40 degrees, repairing plants are planted in the coal gangue platform area, a coal gangue modifier is prepared, one third of modifier is paved in a planting pit, then a pioneer species or giant fungus grass with economic value is planted, finally, the planting pit is filled with the coal gangue modifier, compacted and finally, watering is carried out. Aiming at the problems of serious water and soil loss, difficult vegetation growth, poor natural restoration, high manual restoration cost, poor effect, low economic benefit, landscape damage and the like of the coal gangue sloping field, the invention repairs the coal gangue in a karst area, applies a coal gangue modifier and plants and restores plants, thereby realizing vegetation restoration and ecological management of a coal gangue pile. The invention can harvest 25 tons of pastures per mu of land per year, the value is 1 ten thousand yuan, and the produced pastures meet the standard of forage grass.
assignees: KUNMING COMPREHENSIVE SURVEY CENTER CHINA GEOLOGICAL SURVEY

title_en: Power grid overhaul data restoration method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for repairing power grid overhaul data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when the preset maintenance conditions are met, obtaining maintenance data of the power grid equipment to be maintained and equipment backup data corresponding to the power grid equipment to be maintained; determining whether the power grid equipment to be overhauled has data loss or not according to the data to be overhauled of the power grid equipment to be overhauled and the equipment backup data; if yes, determining to-be-repaired data of the to-be-repaired power grid equipment according to the to-be-repaired data and the equipment backup data; and sending the data to be repaired to the power grid equipment to be repaired so that the power grid equipment to be repaired updates the self data to be repaired based on the data to be repaired. The embodiment of the invention improves the repair efficiency of the power grid overhaul data and the data reliability of the equipment overhaul data of the power grid equipment.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;HUIZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Anti-seismic ecological restoration method for abandoned mine
abstract_en: An earthquake-resistant ecological restoration method for abandoned mines relates to an earthquake-resistant restoration method for abandoned strip mines, which comprises the steps of slope repair, piling, concrete pouring, water collecting tank installation, water collecting tank maintenance, soil paving, watering penetration, soil pit filling, tree planting, grass planting and periodical maintenance; according to the application, concrete is poured into the space between the fixed pile pipe external pulling and the conical body, so that the enlarged cement blocks formed by gathering the concrete at the positions of the reinforcement cage and the space are obtained, and the anti-pulling and anti-sedimentation effects are also achieved while the anti-seismic effect is increased.
assignees: ECOLOGICAL ENV GEOLOGICAL SERVICE CENTER OF HENAN GEOLOGICAL BUREAU

title_en: Comprehensive investigation and evaluation method for mine geological environment influence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive investigation and evaluation method for mine geological environment influence, which is beneficial to comprehensively evaluating the target mine in multiple aspects based on 6 factors of mine geological disasters, land resource occupation damage, water resource damage, water environment damage, earth and stone environment damage and landform landscape damage by analyzing the comprehensive sampling data. The comprehensive investigation and evaluation method for the mine geological environment influence disclosed by the invention can obtain the comprehensive evaluation result about the mine geological environment according to the environmental data in multiple aspects, is favorable for the accuracy of the mine geological environment evaluation, and is favorable for providing basis for the later development of mine ecological protection and restoration engineering.
assignees: Hunan natural resources affairs center

title_en: Engineering implementation feasibility assessment method for isolated network operation control in flexible direct current zone
abstract_en: The invention discloses an engineering implementation feasibility assessment method for isolated network operation control in a flexible direct current zone, which comprises the following steps: according to a isolated network scene, a data model and operation boundary conditions of a target flexible straight zone region, evaluating the matching degree of the total power supply and the total load in the isolated network, and providing a first control measure according to an evaluation result; constructing a regional isolated network simulation model according to the isolated network scene, the data model and the operation boundary conditions; and evaluating the AC networking restoration measures of the target flexible straight band region after the isolated network accident, and proposing feasible AC networking restoration measures aiming at the AC networking restoration measures. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: corresponding control measures are provided for the isolated network system of the target soft direct-current zone region, simulation verification is carried out, feasibility suggestions are obtained through re-verification of the simulation model, safety and reliability of actual operation of isolated network operation in the soft direct-current zone region are improved, and a practical and effective theoretical basis is provided for engineering implementation.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO;NARI RELAYS ELECTRIC CO LTD;DONGGUAN POWER BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;EXAMING & EXPERIMENTAL CT ULTRAHIGH VOLTAGE POWER TRANS CO CHINA SOUTHEN POWER GRID CO LTD;LIUZHOU BUREAU EHV POWER TRANS CO CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID DIGITAL GRID GROUP INFORMATION COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wind control processing method and system based on big data and multi-feature fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a wind control processing method and a system based on big data and multi-feature fusion, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence. In the invention, a member distribution network is determined; according to the association information, a fusion data description vector is mined, and a member restoration distribution network corresponding to the member distribution network is determined; vector barrel division operation is carried out on the fusion data description vector so as to form barrel division result characterization data; according to the barrel division result characterization data, the member restoration distribution network and the member distribution network, forming an updated distribution network analysis network; mining updated fusion data description vectors through an updated distribution network analysis network, and carrying out vector barrel separation operation on each updated fusion data description vector to form updated barrel separation result characterization data; and analyzing the risk wind control user combination according to the updated barrel classification result characterization data, and carrying out associated risk management and control operation on the risk wind control user combination. Based on the above, the reliability of risk management and control can be improved.
assignees: HANDAN MINGJIANG NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for recovering stone vegetation of wind power plant in stony desertification area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for recovering stone vegetation in a wind power plant in a stony desertification area, which comprises the following steps: s1: determining a habitat investigation range, investigation objects, investigation contents and investigation modes of a wind power plant soil-stone blower platform in a stony desertification region; s2: acquiring plant resources in the habitat investigation range; s3: according to the plant type, utilizing the plant resource to prepare initial stony vegetation, and utilizing the initial stony vegetation to simulate a community; s4: and if the total relevance index value of the simulated community meets the requirement, carrying out stone vegetation restoration by using the initial stone vegetation of the simulated community and the plant resources meeting the requirement. According to the method, the stone vegetation recovery is carried out on the wind farm fan platform in the stony desertification area, so that the fragile ecological environment of the fan platform is improved, and the ecological function of the wind farm is improved.
assignees: SPIC YUNNAN INTERNATIONAL POWER INVEST CO LTD;CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Supply side-oriented national network material supply chain network toughness improvement method
abstract_en: A method for improving network toughness of a national network material supply chain facing a supply side belongs to the field of material supply management. For a certain disaster event, determining a feasible restoration scheme and a restoration state of each provider; for each feasible recovery scheme, defining an importance index of the recovery scheme for a provider; summing the importance indexes corresponding to all feasible recovery schemes, and defining the importance indexes of all suppliers; defining a kepram index for each provider damaged by a given disaster, taking into account all possible events; defining a toughness importance index of the provider based on probability distribution of the provider number value damaged by disaster; the improvement of the network toughness of the national network material supply chain facing the supply side is realized by selecting suppliers with toughness importance indexes meeting requirements. The method quantifies the importance of suppliers based on the supply level and recovery time of each state, sorts the importance of the suppliers, and provides an important decision reference for how to improve the toughness of the national net material supply chain from the supply side.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SHANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Configuration method of plants in photovoltaic power station system
abstract_en: The application discloses a plant configuration method in a photovoltaic power station system in the field of desert ecological restoration, which comprises the following steps: carrying out detailed evaluation on the environment of the photovoltaic power station; step two: selecting plants suitable for planting according to the evaluation result of the step one and the requirements of the photovoltaic power station; step three: determining the plant planting position and density according to the layout design of the photovoltaic power station; step four: making a cultivation management plan of plants; step five: the growth status of plants and factors affecting the performance of the photovoltaic system are monitored periodically. The application reasonably plans the plant configuration, ensures the coordinated operation of the plant configuration and the photovoltaic power station, avoids the adverse effect of the plant on the performance of the photovoltaic system, and simultaneously, the automatic planting system can improve the planting efficiency, reduce the cost and reduce the manual operation.
assignees: NORTHWEST INSTITUTE ECO ENVIRONMENT & RESOURCES CAS

title_en: Electric meter and method for cold load start management
abstract_en: Systems and methods for managing connection of a cooling load to a power distribution network are disclosed. A disclosed system for managing connection of a cooling load to a power distribution network includes an electric meter configured to detect a power restoration after a power outage and, in response to detecting the power restoration after the power outage, restart operation and enter a service limiting mode. The electricity meter remains in the service limit mode for a predetermined period of time. When in the service limit mode, the meter accumulates power and compares the accumulated power to a threshold to determine whether to control the service switch to connect or disconnect one or more loads from the power distribution network. After another predetermined period of time, the meter may reconnect one or more loads to the power distribution network and return to normal operation.
assignees: LANDIS GYR TECH AG

title_en: Circuit breaker and distribution switchboard
abstract_en: To receive information that a user requires when needed with a higher probability via a terminal when power fails.SOLUTION: A circuit breaker 1 includes: an acquisition part 121; a storage part 10a; a reception part 11; a communication part 13; and a backup power supply. The acquisition part 121 acquires power failure information including cause information and power restoration information including procedure information according to occurrence of power failure. The cause information is related to a cause of the power failure, and the procedure information is related to procedures of power restoration corresponding to the cause. The storage part 10a stores the power failure information and the power restoration information. The reception part 11 receives predetermined operation. The communication part 13 starts a communication process according to the predetermined operation, and transmits at least one of the power failure information and the power restoration information to a terminal. The backup power supply supplies power at least to the communication part 13 during a power failure period from the power failure to the power restoration.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2
assignees: PANASONIC HOLDINGS CORP

title_en: Power distribution network reconstruction power restoration method and system based on island division
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power supply and discloses a power distribution network reconstruction restoration power supply method and system based on island division.
assignees: JIANGMEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Method for treating metal surface after fire by using tetra sodium ethylenediamine tetraacetate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for treating the surface of metal after fire by using tetra sodium ethylenediamine tetraacetate, which belongs to the field of metal material restoration, and comprises the following specific steps: (1) collecting and cleaning metal parts affected by disaster; (2) Placing the cleaned metal part into reducing gas for reduction; (3) preparing Na4EDTA solution to soak the metal part; (4) Collecting image information of the metal part and spraying a protective coating; the invention realizes the real-time monitoring and adjustment of the coating application, improves the construction precision and efficiency, and can lead the metal parts to resist corrosion and oxidation for a longer time, thereby reducing the cost of subsequent maintenance and repair, and simultaneously realizing the precise control of the treatment process so as to meet the requirements of different metals and applications.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHULEI ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for plugging water in pit slope footrill
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for plugging water on an open pit side slope, which belongs to the technical field of mine facilities, comprehensively adopts multi-level measures such as retaining walls, waterproof cloth, dike protection, plant ecological systems and the like to ensure that an excellent waterproof effect is realized under extreme hydrologic conditions, effectively reduces the risks of water invasion and soil erosion, passes engineering means such as bearing columns, pile foundations, anchoring treatment and the like, enhances the stability of a footbed structure, reduces the potential risks of geological landslide and soil settlement, ensures the sustainability and safety of the pit side slope, ensures that amphibious plants adopted in the method not only play a role in waterproof aspects, but also provide important habitats for ecological systems, improves vegetation coverage and wild animal and plant habitat, is beneficial to ecological restoration and protection, has lower construction cost of the whole scheme, does not need subsequent maintenance operation, and has high construction flexibility.
assignees: NORTHERN ENG & TECH CORP MCC

title_en: Forest tree network system and forest resource monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a forest tree network system and a forest resource monitoring method. According to the invention, by designing and constructing the forest Internet of things monitoring station, the high-frequency monitoring of the forest growth condition in the forest ecological system can be realized, important index data such as forest growth quantity, consumption, withering loss, forest accumulation in unit area, forest biomass in unit area and the like are directly produced, the regulation, scheduling, control and protection of the forest ecological system are developed, the forest resource investigation precision and quality are improved, the forest resource investigation monitoring cost and risk are reduced, and the forest ecological system protection and restoration precision and timeliness are enhanced.
assignees: SICHUAN FORESTRY AND GRASSLAND INVESTIG AND PLANNING INSTITUTE SICHUAN FORESTRY AND GRASSLAND ECOLOG

title_en: Wind power base planning method based on WRF mesoscale nesting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power base planning method based on WRF mesoscale nesting, which comprises the following steps: performing WRF mesoscale nesting based on the Fitch parameterized model; performing WRF simulation result post-processing; assessing wind resources based on the WRF post-processing data; selecting a planning area according to the wind resource evaluation result; determining a planning capacity through a fitting formula; calculating field-level wake flow of the wind power plant in the main wind direction by adopting an improved BP-Gaussian model; normalized design of wake restoration bands. The invention provides a wind power base planning method based on WRF mesoscale nesting, so that the wind resource evaluation result of the large wind power base is more in line with measured data, and the established design method of the wake flow restoration belt of the large wind power base has better economic benefit and good application prospect in actual engineering.
assignees: POWERCHINA NORTHWEST ENG CORP LTD;UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Systems and methods for restoration of essential systems for catastrophic utility emergency
abstract_en: A method of forming an emergency response and continuity of operations (COOP) area-wide grid of microgrids is provided. The method can include: upon an power outage occurring to an Utility power Distribution grid network, identifying one or more nodes having an electric vehicle service equipment (EVSE) power; forming a power microgrid comprising the one or more nodes; activating a communication payload on the one or more nodes; and forming an area-wide grid of microgrids based on the communication payload and the power microgrid.
assignees: ONCOR ELECTRIC DELIVERYCOMPANY

title_en: Limestone mine stope slope ecological restoration structure and restoration method
abstract_en: The application provides a limestone mine stope slope ecological restoration structure and a restoration method. The limestone mine stope slope ecological restoration structure comprises a plurality of arbor areas, a plurality of first vine areas, a plurality of second vine areas and climbing protection components. According to the application, the slope is repaired and greening through the hierarchical combination of the shielding of the green barrier of the big arbor and the climbing of the plant Kong Tengben, and the method has the characteristics of good stability, high durability, low engineering cost, strong anti-scouring capability and the like, meanwhile, the structural design is reasonable, the later maintenance is easy, the occurrence of geological disasters is controlled in an auxiliary way, the repairing and greening speed is high, the repairing effect is good, a self-maintaining and self-succession biological community can be formed in a stope in a short time, the subsequent investment is reduced, the comprehensive benefit is increased, and the method has good popularization and practical value.
assignees: SHAANXI BRANCH OF CHINA BUILDING MAT INDUSTRY GEOLOGIC EXPLORATION CENTER

title_en: Starting method for energy storage system, energy storage system, and starting apparatus
abstract_en: Provided is a starting method for an energy storage system (10). The energy storage system (10) comprises at least one energy storage sub-module (100). The energy storage sub-module (100) comprises a power module (101) and a battery module (102). The starting method comprises: obtaining a first instruction (S201); and controlling, according to the first instruction, the battery module (102) to charge the power module (101) (S202). According to the starting method, the battery module (102) of the energy storage sub-module (100) can be controlled to charge the power module (101) when a power grid is in a blackout state, so that the power module (101) can be charged to have power-on capability, thereby realizing the self-starting of the energy storage sub-module (100), facilitating the increase of the restoration speed of the power grid.
assignees: CONTEMPORARY AMPEREX TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Device and method for supporting facility operation, and program
abstract_en: To accomplish task implementation, such as plan creation for a facility, more accurately in line with actual conditions.SOLUTION: A power network restoration plan support device 10 for supporting operation of a power network 2 comprises: a UI part 15 for receiving sensor data 111 regarding operation of the power network 2; a data evaluation part 132 for calculating a degree of certainty of the sensor data 111 which is defined by a combination of a plurality of factors in acquiring the sensor data 111 and indicates certainty of the operation data; a data regeneration part 133 for regenerating the sensor data 111 according to the degree of certainty; and a data storage part for storing the operation data and the degree of certainty of the operation data in association with each other in a storage part. The facility operation support device implements creation of an operation plan of a facility by using the operation data stored in the storage part, in accordance with the degree of certainty stored in the storage part.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: HITACHI LTD

title_en: Method and device for judging indoor power failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for judging indoor power failure, which comprises the following steps: collecting incoming line voltage V, incoming line current I and leakage current I of a user at an incoming line position of the user in real time  Leakage device  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the 2. Judging the indoor power failure: judging whether a short circuit fault, a leakage current fault and a current overrun fault are suspected to occur or not; 3. and when at least one of a short circuit fault, a leakage current fault and a current overrun fault is suspected to occur, detecting whether the power P or the incoming line current I of the user is 0 or not, and judging the reason of the indoor power failure. The invention also discloses two power outage judging devices using the indoor power outage judging method. The method and the device for judging the power failure in the house can identify the reason of the power failure in the house of the resident, thus the power failure is generatedThe method can inform the user of detailed reasons during power failure, assist the user to quickly re-power, and improve the satisfaction of the client. For the power failure caused by indoor reasons, the power grid company does not need to send people to the site for investigation, so that the manpower input is reduced, and the user is guided to realize quick power restoration.
assignees: JIANGSU INTELEVER ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Farmland drainage diversion regulation and utilization purification system and operation method thereof
abstract_en: A farmland drainage diversion, regulation and utilization purification system and an operation method thereof are provided, the system comprises a ditch and an isolation wall which are arranged around a farmland, the isolation wall longitudinally separates the ditch into a irrigation ditch and an ecological ditch which are parallel to each other, the irrigation ditch is arranged close to the farmland, one end of the irrigation ditch is communicated with a branch ditch through a first sluice, the other end of the irrigation ditch is communicated with one end of the ecological ditch through a water outlet sluice, the middle part of the ecological ditch is communicated with the middle part of the irrigation ditch through a second sluice, and the other end of the ecological ditch is communicated with the branch ditch through a third sluice. The invention communicates ditches with different functions, can effectively utilize the capabilities of ditches for regulating, storing, draining and purifying water, and simultaneously has multiple functions of ecological restoration, water quality purification, flood storage, flood diversion and the like; in addition, the operation method of the system respectively establishes corresponding irrigation and drainage strategies aiming at the farmland irrigation period, the drainage period and the heavy rainfall period, and can effectively solve the irrigation and drainage problems of different emergency situations such as heavy rain, drought and the like while ensuring the purification efficiency.
assignees: INNOVATION ACADEMY FOR PRECISION MEASUREMENT SCIENCE AND TECH CAS

title_en: Landslide body side slope ecological restoration structure and restoration method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide body side slope ecological restoration structure, which comprises: the ecological restoration layer comprises a plurality of first fixed barrels and a plurality of second fixed barrels, wherein the first fixed barrels and the second fixed barrels are communicated with the water pipe network, herbaceous plants are planted in the first fixed barrels, shrubs are planted in the second fixed barrels, and two adjacent first fixed barrels are connected through anchor rod assemblies.
