When the invention is applied, the landslide slope is firstly leveled, then the metal net, the water pipe net and the ecological restoration layer are sequentially paved on the slope, when heavy rain is encountered, the rainwater flows out through the water pipe net, the erosion of the rainwater to the landslide slope is reduced, and meanwhile, the first fixing cylinder and the second fixing cylinder are communicated with the water pipe net, so that part of the rainwater is absorbed by shrubs and herbaceous plants, the plant growth is promoted, and the soil fixing and slope protection effects are better.
assignees: INST OF GEOLOGY AND NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION GANSU ACADEMY OF SCIENCE

title_en: Electric power user fault maintenance system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of electric power restoration, in particular to an electric power user fault maintenance system and method, wherein a user electricity consumption monitor is used for monitoring whether user electricity consumption is abnormal or not, and transmitting user electricity consumption abnormal information to a platform area server when the user electricity consumption is abnormal; the platform area server is used for receiving the user electricity consumption abnormal information sent by the user electricity consumption monitor and sending the user electricity consumption abnormal information to the data analysis background and the handheld terminal of the maintainer; the maintenance personnel handheld terminal is used for receiving the abnormal user electricity consumption information sent by the platform area server; the data analysis background is used for receiving the user electricity consumption abnormal information sent by the platform region server and carrying out statistical analysis on the user electricity consumption abnormal information. The invention greatly saves the rush repair time and reduces the abnormal perception of the power consumption of the clients. Meanwhile, the system performs statistical analysis on the abnormal information of the electricity consumption of the user, so that the management of the electricity consumption condition of the user is improved, and the service quality of the power user is optimized.
assignees: TAIAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Groundwater level restoration prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of groundwater level prediction, in particular to a groundwater level recovery prediction method and a groundwater level recovery prediction system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of forming a time sequence matrix by collecting related data of each period affecting the change of the underground water level; obtaining a periodic hysteresis relation of the data according to the frequency spectrum curve relation of each row of data and the water level height data; obtaining an environmental change factor according to the periodic hysteresis relationship and the bias correlation coefficient of the groundwater flow, the flow speed and the flow direction data; obtaining a hydrologic environment influence factor according to the environment change factor, the period hysteresis of each row of data and the data distribution condition; and (3) improving the initial weight of each height data in the groundwater in the Adaboost algorithm according to the hydrologic environmental impact factor, and training the prediction result of the output water level height sample of the weak classifier. The method improves the robustness and accuracy of the Adaboost algorithm.
assignees: JINING YULONGYUAN WATER CO LTD

title_en: Data security protection method of electric energy quality monitoring system based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data security protection method of an electric energy quality monitoring system based on edge calculation. According to the invention, a data transmission optimization scheme is established between the edge computing node and the cloud computing node, and the original monitoring data is subjected to security processing such as encryption, masking, fragmentation and the like, and optimization processing such as compression, filtering, aggregation and the like, so that the security, efficiency, reliability and quality of the data in the processes of storage, transmission and computation are ensured; and the processed data are subjected to restoration processing such as decryption, mask removal, merging and the like, and functional processing such as result display and advanced application functions and the like on the sink node, so that richer and more intelligent power quality monitoring service is provided.
assignees: STATE GRID SIJI DIGITAL TECH BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic power station missing power restoration method based on correlation coefficient spline interpolation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a photovoltaic power station missing power restoration method based on correlation coefficient spline interpolation, which comprises the following steps: collecting original data of a photovoltaic power station, including meteorological data and corresponding power generation data thereof; dividing the original data into a data set to be repaired and a complete data set, wherein the data set to be repaired only comprises meteorological data, and the complete data set comprises the meteorological data and corresponding power generation data thereof; performing dimension reduction processing on the complete data set, and removing weather data with smaller correlation from the complete data set and the data set to be repaired; processing the original data by adopting a spline interpolation method to obtain preliminary missing power interpolation; calculating a correlation coefficient based on the meteorological data in the integrity data set and the meteorological data in the data set to be repaired; multiplying the correlation coefficient with the preliminary missing power interpolation to obtain the final missing power interpolation, and completing the repair operation of the missing power. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of improving interpolation accuracy and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SHANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Elastic power distribution network restoration decision method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for recovering and deciding an elastic power distribution network, wherein an EV scheduling model before disaster is built, a mobile energy storage temporary warehouse deployment position is determined based on power distribution network line layout and load information, a pre-disaster stage mobile resource pre-deployment model is built, the post-disaster load recovering process is accelerated while the running cost of mobile resources is saved, a configuration result is determined based on the pre-disaster stage mobile resource pre-deployment model, comprehensive economic cost for post-disaster recovery is used as an objective function, an elastic power distribution network economic post-disaster recovery model matched with mobile energy storage and electric vehicles V2G is built, the mobile resource deployment position and quantity are obtained based on the post-disaster stage mobile energy storage and electric vehicles V2G collaborative recovery model, and the post-disaster power distribution network recovery is realized. The invention can provide a practical and effective power supply recovery scheme aiming at different scenes, and guide an actual power system to quickly recover the power supply of the system while ensuring the dispatching economy.

title_en: Forest Restoration Method
title_ko: 산림 복원 방법
abstract_en: In general, damage to forests is classified into natural damage and artificial damage, natural damage corresponds to forest fires caused by climate change (e.g., drought) or spontaneous ignition, and artificial damage includes transmission towers, wind power generation, forest clearing, logging, and the like. In the case of transmission towers and wind power generators corresponding to artificial damage, regular or irregular forest damage is repeated according to maintenance as well as forest damage caused by the installation of facilities. The present invention is to quickly restore damaged forests through trees without environmental pollution and manage planted trees to be stably grown. The present invention proposes a container capable of containing soil and nutrient-rich soil that can grow together with planting trees in a forest restoration (P40) stage.
abstract_ko:
일반적으로 산림의 훼손은 자연적인 훼손과 인공적인 훼손으로 분류되고, 자연적인 훼손은 기후 변화(ex, 가뭄)나 자연발화 등에 의한 산불등이 해당되며, 인공적인 훼손은 송전탑, 풍력발전, 산림 개간, 벌목 등이 있다. 
상기에서 인위적인 훼손에 해당하는 송전탑, 풍력발전기의 경우, 시설 설치에 따른 산림 훼손 뿐아니라, 유지보수에 따라 정기적 또는 비정기적인 산림 훼손이 반복된다. 
본 발명은 훼손된 산림을 환경오염 없이 식목을 통해 빠르게 복원하고, 식목된 나무가 안정적으로 생육될수 있도록 관리하는 것이다. 
본 발명은 산림복원(P40) 단계에서 식목과 함께 식목이 성장할 수 있는 토양과 양분이 구비된 토양을 담을 수 있는 용기를 제시한다.
assignees: SHINTAEJIN CONSTRUCTION CO LTD;SHIN SANG IL

title_en: Routing field support to vehicles for maintenance
abstract_en: Systems and methods are provided for recovery of autonomous vehicles. In particular, systems and methods are provided for vehicle recovery prioritization in a fleet of vehicles when multiple vehicles request recovery. A vehicle recovery event is generated for vehicles in need of recovery based on the vehicle's sensor log. The recovery service type is determined based on the vehicle recovery event, and vehicles in need of recovery are prioritized based on the recovery service type and the vehicle recovery event. The recovery support can include a recovery support representative and/or a recovery support service technician. Recovery response can be based on the recovery prioritization. Vehicle sensors and computing power can be used to inform onboard processors and/or central computers of a risk profile for the vehicle, and dispatch can trigger a response plan according to a recovery response framework.
assignees: GM CRUISE HOLDINGS LLC

title_en: Risk multilink conduction method for water resource system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water resource system risk multi-link conduction method, which mainly comprises the following steps. The method comprises the steps of collecting risk element data in a researched area and carrying out standardized processing on the risk element data, constructing a water resource system risk link by utilizing relevance among the risk elements, defining a risk conduction mechanism, namely a ① risk opening stage, describing simple mechanism of risk conduction and opening conditions of risks, ② resistance threshold action, describing resistance capability of the system in risk conduction, revealing the risk conduction mechanism and the resistance threshold action of the risk links with different structures according to the conduction characteristics of the risk links, ③ restoration threshold action, namely natural restoration force and social restoration force, enabling the risks not to exist all the time, defining a risk restoration action, ④ threshold updating calculation, namely the resistance capability and restoration capability to be improved, and updating a threshold value, and a ⑤ risk suspension stage, namely deducing conditions of risk suspension according to the risk conduction, wherein ⑥ risk strength and conduction speed relation, namely the greater risk disturbance strength and the higher risk conduction speed are. By exploring a risk link conduction mechanism, the water resource risk assessment system under complex conditions is perfected.

title_en: Ultrasonic metering instrument data management method, device and equipment based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses ultrasonic metering device data management method, device and equipment based on the Internet of things, relate to the technical field of data management, through increasing outage and keep the module, under the circumstances that power module cuts off the power supply, can immediately switch to outage and keep the module according to outage signal fast and supply power, ultrasonic metering device object platform independent work, do not interact with other platforms in the Internet of things system, the operation data during outage is gathered in ultrasonic metering device object platform inside, the quantity of ultrasonic metering devices that is inserted at present is confirmed immediately in response to the power restoration signal, the ultrasonic metering devices that make it switch to the power module when supplying power are fewer under the circumstances that its is less than threshold value quantity, each platform is interconnected again, upload outage operation data to gas management platform by ultrasonic metering device object platform, even if there is outage condition, the Internet of things system also can all acquire complete information in order to realize gas data's management.
assignees: CHENGDU QINCHUAN IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ice melting and rush repair scheduling method and system for comprehensive energy system of emergency power supply vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ice melting and rush repair scheduling method and system for an emergency power supply vehicle comprehensive energy system, wherein the method and system comprise the steps of acquiring icing data and meteorological data of a power transmission line, and establishing a mathematical model of icing increment characteristics of the power transmission line; according to the mathematical model of the icing increment characteristic of the power transmission line, an upper-layer optimization model and a lower-layer optimization model are established by combining with a preset comprehensive energy system scheduling constraint condition of the emergency power supply vehicle; and solving the upper-layer optimization model and the lower-layer optimization model by combining a sperm whale algorithm, and simulating an ice melting decision according to the improved test system to realize ice melting and rush repair scheduling of the comprehensive energy system of the emergency power supply vehicle. The ice melting is maximized and the economy is good on the basis of the safety of the power grid, and the long-time power failure accident is effectively avoided. And the dispatching of the comprehensive energy system and the mobile energy storage system can be optimized according to the deicing emergency repair progress condition, so that the electricity consumption of important load nodes is ensured, and the economic loss of load shedding is further reduced.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Secure data replication to, and recovery of data from, air-gapped data storage pools
abstract_en: An illustrative air-gapped data storage site for storing secure copies at the air-gapped storage site. Using specialized air-gapped media agents installed within the air-gapped storage pool site, the illustrative system, at an unpredictable time, establishes a one-way tunnel from secondary storage site to air-gapped site to receive backup copies of the data stored at primary site. In another embodiment, during disaster recovery, backup copies stored within the air-gapped site are replicated to a non-air gapped site (e.g., secondary storage pools) as “tertiary copies.” Those copies are then restored to the primary site in original application data formats for quick recovery. As restoration of data is complete, the tertiary copies are promoted to “secondary copies” to receive incremental backups.
assignees: COMMVAULT SYSTEMS INC

title_en: Ecological restoration structure for geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of ecological restoration structures, in particular to a geological disaster ecological restoration structure which comprises an ecological restoration structure main body, wherein a fixing assembly is fixedly arranged in the ecological restoration structure main body, a first protection belt is fixedly arranged below the fixing assembly, a second protection belt is fixedly connected below the first protection belt, a first mounting column is fixedly arranged on the top surface of the second protection belt, a second fixing seat is connected with the tail end of the first mounting column in a meshed manner, a second mounting column is fixedly arranged on the right side of the top surface of the second fixing seat, the first protection belt and the second protection belt have water permeability, redundant rainwater received in a planting frame is evacuated downwards, a straw cushion is additionally arranged on a grid plate, and a meadow adsorbs rainwater to meet vegetation growth requirements.
assignees: SICHUAN HUADI ENVIRONMENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power equipment displacement detection restoration device and method based on visual recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for detecting and recovering displacement of power equipment based on visual identification, which relate to the field of fault identification and have the technical scheme that: the image monitoring device is used for judging whether the displacement change of each measuring point of the power equipment exceeds a set displacement limit value; the displacement sensor is used for sending out an overrun signal when each measuring point of the power equipment exceeds a set displacement limit value; and the reset leveling device is used for adjusting the position of the power equipment according to the position information when the overrun signal is received so as to enable the power equipment to be restored to a horizontal state. The invention solves the problem that the prior art can not realize the real-time adjustment of the abnormal response of the power equipment in the normal use process or after earthquake.

title_en: Power supply fault release updating method, device, equipment and medium for power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for issuing and updating power supply faults of a power grid. The method is characterized by comprising the following steps: acquiring a power supply fault event of a target power grid, and acquiring power supply fault information corresponding to the power supply fault event through at least one power supply service system; generating at least one power supply fault form corresponding to the power supply fault event based on the power supply fault information, and publishing the power supply fault form to at least one power supply worker through a preset message middleware; generating a power restoration notification message corresponding to a power failure event according to a preset power restoration notification service on the basis of detecting that a target power grid is in a power restoration state; and sending the duplicate notification message to a power supply worker through a message middleware. The micro-service can carry out information sharing and data generation on the power supply faults, and automatically issue the power supply faults and automatically update the fault states, so that the reaction speed of the power grid system to the power supply faults is improved, and the work efficiency of re-electricity is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;SHANTOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Determination method and internet of things (iot) system for gas supply during maintenance of gas pipeline network
abstract_en: A determination method and an Internet of Things (IoT) system for gas supply during maintenance of a gas pipeline network are provided. The determination method includes: determining a degree of a maintenance impact based on maintenance data; determining a maintenance time period; determining a supply sequence of the maintenance time period based on a first loss feature; determining a gas supply restoration time period and a second loss feature based on a gas supply restoration duration; determining a supply sequence of the gas supply restoration time period based on the second loss feature; determining a target demand for a maintenance pipeline branch in a target time period based on historical usage data; determining a target loss in the target time period based on a target supply and the target demand; determining a replenishment parameter based on the target loss; and calling backup gas from a gas storage station.
assignees: CHENGDU QINCHUAN IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Water bloom early warning method, device, equipment and medium based on water quality monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological restoration of rivers and lakes, and discloses a water bloom early warning method, device, equipment and medium based on water quality monitoring.

title_en: Photovoltaic power station power prediction method and system based on image restoration
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power station power prediction, in particular to a photovoltaic power station power prediction method and a photovoltaic power station power prediction system based on image restoration.

title_en: Distribution network fault recovery method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network fault recovery method and system based on artificial intelligence, which relate to the technical field of distribution network fault recovery and comprise the following steps: after the distribution network line fails, locating a failure point and generating a failure alarm; after the fault points are positioned, executing a fault isolation strategy according to the distribution network topology model; executing a power restoration strategy of the non-fault area; generating a fault repair list according to the fault type, tracking a fault repair state, and executing a recovery strategy of an operation mode before a fault after the repair is finished; and judging whether the self-installed device and the protection device need to be reset according to fault isolation, power restoration and network reconstruction conditions. The distribution network fault recovery method based on artificial intelligence can more accurately locate fault points, improve the fault processing efficiency, rapidly implement fault isolation strategies, recover power supply for non-fault areas as soon as possible, improve recovery accuracy and efficiency, greatly reduce the possibility of manual judgment, and ensure safe and stable operation of a power grid.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Ecological maintenance method and system based on urban landscape water comprehensive restoration system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of environmental engineering, an ecological maintenance method and system based on an urban landscape water body comprehensive restoration system is provided, an urban landscape water body database with different water body characteristics is obtained by classifying and extracting characteristics of the urban landscape water body, a standard water body ecology matched with water body microorganisms and aquatic animals and plants and a water body restoration strategy matched with the standard water body ecology are configured according to the urban landscape water body database, so as to obtain an urban landscape water body comprehensive restoration strategy library, an operating urban landscape water body managed according to the urban landscape water body database is monitored, so as to obtain the current water body characteristics of the operating urban landscape water body, and the corresponding restoration scheme is matched in the urban landscape water body comprehensive restoration strategy library according to the current water body characteristics, so that the systematic planning of the urban landscape water body ecology is realized, the water body characteristics of the urban landscape water body are automatically monitored, and the ecological unbalance of the urban landscape water body is restored.
assignees: SHENZHEN FLOWER IN HEART CULTURE DEV CO LTD

title_en: Power supply restoration method, system and storage medium considering controllable load regulation capability
abstract_en: A power supply restoration method, system and storage medium considering controllable load regulation capability includes: modeling an air-conditioner load and an electric vehicle load; evaluating the adjustment capability of the air-conditioning load and the electric vehicle load; solving an optimal power supply path for adjusting the air-conditioning load and the electric vehicle load. The advantages are that: modeling an air-conditioner load and an electric vehicle load, and accurately describing the load; the power utilization habit of a user is fully considered, the user load adjustable quantity can be accurately calculated, finally, the on-off state of each branch of urban power supply to be recovered is obtained according to the air conditioner load adjustment capability and the electric vehicle load adjustment capability through a quantum evolution algorithm based on alleles, and an optimal path is sought, so that the controllable load on the load side is adjusted, important load power supply is ensured, and the toughness of a power distribution network is improved.
assignees: FUXIN POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;SHENYANG INST ENGINEERING;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Network security system structure construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network security system structure construction method, which is applied to a security operation center and comprises an evaluation and improvement stage, a monitoring and analysis stage, a response loss stopping stage and a recovery and restoration stage; the evaluation improvement stage is used for providing an evaluation improvement field expert service and an evaluation improvement first-line expert service; the evaluation improvement field expert service comprises a management system construction service, a safety training service and a consultation planning service; the evaluation improvement line expert service comprises an asset identification and management service, a business risk evaluation service, a security notification service, an early warning response service and a residence operation maintenance service; the monitoring analysis stage comprises monitoring analysis field expert service and monitoring analysis first-line expert service; the monitoring analysis field expert service comprises a code audit service, a decompilation service, a penetration test service, an exploit analysis service and a sample analysis service. The invention improves the usability and confidentiality of the information system.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Distributed photovoltaic power data restoration method based on multivariate information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed photovoltaic power data restoration method based on multiple pieces of information, and belongs to the field of data processing. According to the invention, on the basis of realizing missing value reconstruction by utilizing satellite remote sensing information and interpolation functions, the time dependence relationship between a power missing sequence and two-side continuous complete power sequences is fully considered, a power restoration model based on a two-way time sequence feature modeling unit and a cross correlation focusing algorithm is established, and multiple information such as two-side time sequence association information, satellite remote sensing information and the like is effectively integrated in the power data restoration process. The method is suitable for the distributed photovoltaic field station which is not provided with special meteorological measurement equipment and has strong output fluctuation and a small number of high-correlation space-time similar samples, solves the adverse effects caused by the fluctuation research of the light resource and the excavation of the correlation between the photovoltaic output and meteorological influence factors due to the loss of distributed photovoltaic power data, improves the prediction precision of the distributed photovoltaic power, and ensures the safe and stable operation of the active power distribution network.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV BAODING;STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD CHENGDE POWER SUPPLY CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Multi-mode operation breathing type tidal flow constructed wetland
abstract_en: A multi-mode operation breathing type tidal flow constructed wetland and an operation method thereof relate to the technical fields of natural ecological restoration, ecological comprehensive treatment of rivers and lakes and environmental protection, and comprise a surface flow constructed wetland system, a lifting pump station, a water inlet distribution valve well, a tidal flow subsurface flow constructed wetland system, a water outlet flow making well, a deep total nitrogen removal constructed wetland unit, a water outlet valve well and a river and lake water body, wherein the tidal flow subsurface flow constructed wetland system operates according to the multi-modes of the tidal flow constructed wetland, namely, four stage periods of water inlet, inundation, water discharge and emptying, simulate the natural tide law of seawater, and realize multi-mode operation repeatedly; the tidal flow wetland is operated in a multi-mode, intermittent water inflow and instant water drainage are carried out, and the wetland bed can be more beneficial to the removal of pollutants in a shorter submerging time and a longer emptying time.
assignees: HEBEI HENGTE ENVIRONMENTAL PROT ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Real-time video restoration system that provides location information of rescuers in case of disaster and safety accident
title_ko: 재난 및 안전사고시 구조자의 위치정보를 제공하는실시간 영상 복원 시스템
abstract_en: A real-time video restoration system for providing the location information of rescuees in the event of a disaster or a safety accident according to the present invention comprises: a camera part for photographing a preset monitoring area; a thermal imaging sensor part for detecting thermal images in the monitoring area; an object detection sensor part for transmitting and receiving signals in a predetermined frequency range to detect an object in the monitoring area; and a video restoration part for determining whether there is a rescuee requiring rescue based on the detection data of the thermal imaging sensor part and the detection result of the object detection sensor part, and generating a real-time fusion image by fusing a photography video of the camera part at a past point of time, in which objects are visually identified, and the video of the rescuee. Therefore, provided is a real-time video restoration system capable of generating a real-time fusion video.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 재난 및 안전사고시 구조자의 위치정보를 제공하는 실시간 영상 복원 시스템은, 미리 설정된 감시영역을 촬영하는 카메라부와, 상기 감시영역의 열상을 감지하는 열화상센서부와, 소정의 주파수 영역의 신호를 송수신하여 상기 감시영역의 객체를 검출하는 객체감지센서부와, 상기 열화상센서부의 감지 데이터와 상기 객체감지센서부의 검출결과를 토대로 구조를 요하는 구조자인지를 판단한 후, 사물이 시각적으로 식별되는 과거시점의 상기 카메라부의 촬영영상에 상기 구조자의 영상을 함께 융합하여 실시간 융합영상을 생성하는 영상 복원부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: SAMJU ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Ecological restoration technology for river system in mountain gorge valley area
abstract_en: The invention provides an ecological restoration technology aiming at a river system in a mountain gorge valley area, which comprises river bed management measures, bank slope protection measures and river flood beach restoration measures, wherein the river bed management measures are used for longitudinally managing a river bed by constructing a ladder system; the bank slope protection measures adopt a fiber roll foreign soil planting method to establish a arbor zone parallel to a river bank line; the river flood restoration measures imitate natural forms to trim the river flood into sand waves, the gabion is utilized to buffer flood impact, and the river flood ecological restoration species are designed according to ecological investigation results. The technology can weaken water flow erosion power to stabilize a river course, control loss of fine materials on a flood plain, promote soil quality improvement of the flood plain, accelerate ecological system restoration of the flood plain, improve local microclimate environment and comprehensively improve ecological service functions of a river system. The invention also specifically provides a calculation method of the ladder system and the sand wave design parameters, and the stability and the persistence of ecological restoration of the river system are ensured.
assignees: UNIV LANZHOU;LI GUOWEI

title_en: Transformer substation vulnerability assessment method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transformer substation vulnerability assessment method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which are used for solving the problems that the existing related assessment method has higher requirements on the technical level of assessment personnel and the assessment method has low practicability. The method comprises the following steps: if the transformer substation is detected to suffer from network attack, an attack target of an attacker is obtained, and when the attack target is a potential vulnerability, a vulnerability cracking list of the attacker and a vulnerability cracking detection list of an defender are generated; potential vulnerability scanning data and vulnerability restoration probability of an defender in each game are calculated, and a vulnerability cracking list and a vulnerability cracking detection list are updated based on the potential vulnerability scanning data and the vulnerability restoration probability; determining final vulnerability cracking data of an attacker according to the updated vulnerability cracking list and the vulnerability cracking detection list; and calculating the invaded probability of the transformer substation by adopting the final vulnerability cracking data so as to evaluate the vulnerability of the transformer substation.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Power distribution network outage information resource pool design method and system based on topology analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power failure information resource pool design method and system for a power distribution network based on topology analysis, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring electricity consumption data of the distribution transformer in real time, and acquiring position change information of an automatic switch; regarding various automatic switches as branches in the topological graph to obtain the topological graph of the nodes and the branches; judging switch deflection information and distribution transformer power failure signal information, and judging a power failure area range and listing power failure information by combining the logic topological relation of an automatic switch and a distribution transformer; and constructing a multi-time real-time power outage information resource pool by utilizing the power outage area range and the power outage information, and establishing a full-quantity power outage information resource pool of the power distribution network. According to the invention, the information is calibrated with a plurality of priorities, the multi-source power failure and restoration information is subjected to data cleaning, the effective information is accurately researched and judged, the power failure area range and the power failure information are determined, a full-quantity power failure information resource pool is constructed, the transparentization level of the power distribution network is improved, and the safe, reliable and efficient operation of the active power distribution network is effectively supported.
assignees: XUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH CO STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Data restoration method, device and equipment based on photovoltaic envelope
abstract_en: The application provides a data restoration method, a device and equipment based on a photovoltaic envelope, which relate to the technical field of data processing and comprise the following steps: acquiring photovoltaic power generation data of each of a plurality of photovoltaic meters, wherein the photovoltaic power generation data comprises original accumulated power generation amounts of each of a plurality of moments; based on the photovoltaic power generation data of each of the plurality of photovoltaic tables, carrying out region clustering on the plurality of photovoltaic tables to obtain a plurality of photovoltaic table clusters; determining a light Fu Baolao curve corresponding to each photovoltaic meter cluster based on photovoltaic power generation data of each photovoltaic meter in the photovoltaic meter cluster aiming at each photovoltaic meter cluster; and on the basis of a light Fu Baolao curve, repairing photovoltaic power generation data of each photovoltaic meter in the photovoltaic meter cluster to obtain target photovoltaic power generation data corresponding to each photovoltaic meter in the photovoltaic meter cluster, wherein the target photovoltaic power generation data comprises target accumulated power generation amounts at a plurality of moments. According to the scheme, the repair of the photovoltaic power generation data can be realized, and the precision of the photovoltaic power generation data is improved.

title_en: Ecological vulnerability evaluation method for key water source area in natural resource monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological vulnerability evaluation method of a key water source area in natural resource monitoring, which relates to the technical field of natural resource management and comprises the following steps: data preprocessing, namely, a step two: and (3) analyzing patterns for developing and utilizing the homeland space and step three: and (5) analyzing ecological vulnerability. According to the method, the interaction relation and effect of the mountain and water Lin Tianhu grass multi-class natural resource elements and the ecological system in the key water source area are deeply researched, the ecological protection restoration path is determined according to local conditions, the quality and stability of the ecological system can be improved, the problem of ecological vulnerability and sensitivity is prevented, the harmful inhibition on the stability of the structure and the function of the land space is prevented, and the potential natural disaster risk high-incidence area can be identified by analyzing the ecological vulnerability and sensitivity of the area.
assignees: HUBEI GEOGRAPHIC GUOQING MONITORING CENTER

title_en: Vegetation restoration construction method for fragile mountain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vegetation restoration construction method of fragile mountain, which comprises the following steps: s1, evaluating a mountain body, comprehensively evaluating the fragile mountain body, determining the fragile degree and the vegetation restoration requirement, improving the soil in an area where the fragile mountain body is corroded or barren by soil so as to improve the soil quality and the water retention capacity, selecting S3 vegetation, selecting vegetation types suitable for local environments and ecological conditions, planting S4 vegetation, planting the vegetation on the fragile mountain body so as to increase the vegetation coverage rate and the stability of a root system, setting slope protection facilities on a slope, preventing water flow from directly flushing the soil, and irrigating and maintaining S6. The vegetation restoration construction method of the fragile mountain can effectively restore the fragile mountain and manage and maintain the fragile mountain after restoration so as to reduce the risk of geological disasters and protect the safety of surrounding environments.
assignees: ANHUI LANDSCAPING ENG CO LTD;CHINA COAL NO 3 CONSTR GROUP CO LTD;HEFEI FOREST PEST CONTROL AND QUARANTINE STATION

title_en: Seasonal river coastal ecological restoration landscape area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seasonal river coastal ecological restoration landscape area, which comprises an ecological restoration landscape area, wherein a dam body is arranged between the ecological restoration landscape area and a river, a water inlet gate and a water outlet gate are sequentially arranged on the dam body along the river direction, a partition wall dam is arranged on one side of the dam body facing the inside of the ecological restoration landscape area, the water inlet gate and the water outlet gate are respectively positioned on two sides of the partition wall dam, a partition dam is arranged between the end face of the partition wall dam and the inner wall of the ecological restoration landscape area, and the partition dam and the partition wall dam divide the space between the ecological restoration landscape area and the dam body into a dirt blocking area, a sediment adsorption landscape area and an aquatic organism cultivation area. The water storage in the high water season is realized, flood in the river can be shunted, flood disasters are prevented, water is used for irrigating or reflowing to the river channel in the dead water season to help the river channel to restore the ecological balance of the water body, and meanwhile, the requirements of landscapes are met.

title_en: Evaluation method for influence of dam removal of power station on habitat quality based on fish protection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating influence of a power station dam removal based on fish protection on the quality of a habitat in the technical field of river ecological restoration of hydropower development, which comprises the steps of constructing an evaluation system for restoring river fish protection objects, and obtaining scores and weights of all evaluation indexes; quantitatively evaluating the repaired river fish through the scores and the weights of the evaluation indexes to determine target fish to be protected; acquiring hydraulic preference of each life stage of the target fish; the method comprises the steps of obtaining habitat hydraulic parameters corresponding to hydraulic preferences before and after dam disassembly by constructing a water-sand transportation model and performing hydrodynamic simulation, and constructing a fish habitat quality assessment model before and after dam disassembly by utilizing the habitat hydraulic parameters and the fish habitat model; and quantitatively evaluating the habitat quality of the target fish in each life stage before and after dam disassembly. The method realizes quantitative evaluation of the influence of the dam removal on the habitat quality of the fish in the key life stage, and provides scientific basis for dam removal and river ecological restoration.
assignees: SHANGHAI INVESTIGATION DESIGN & RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Assembled fish blocking net device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an assembled fish blocking net device, wherein blocking net frames are arranged continuously and are perpendicular to the water flow direction, modularized meshes are detachably arranged in each blocking net frame, and supporting rods are respectively connected with the top end and the lake bottom of the blocking net frame from the upstream and the downstream; on the premise of not influencing river flood discharge, the utility model is arranged at the position of the river inlet and outlet, which not only does not influence the water flow, but also can intercept upstream fishes, thereby protecting the healthy ecological system established in the lake region. Meanwhile, the modularized mesh is convenient to detach, can be replaced in whole when damaged, is convenient and fast, is suitable for underwater operation, and the arrangement of the support rods can ensure the overall stability of the barrier frame, so that the modularized mesh has great popularization prospect in ecological restoration of urban landscape lakes and large-scale lake fishery cultivation.
assignees: NANJING ZHONGKE WATER ENV ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Lake risk prevention and control method based on water volume exchange and ecological restoration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lake risk prevention and control method based on water volume exchange and ecological restoration, which comprises the following steps: evaluating the water quality risk according to the historical water quality data of the target lake, and increasing the water quantity exchange quantity of the target lake when the water quality risk exists so as to prevent and control the water quality risk; evaluating the ecological risk of the target lake, and implementing wetland ecological restoration engineering on the target lake when the target lake has a certain degree of ecological risk; the ecological risk of the target lake is evaluated as follows: and carrying out ecological risk assessment by using the loss of the shoal wetland habitat area after the superposition water quantity exchange working condition. The method takes the water quality risk prevention and control and the ecological risk prevention and control as targets, can simultaneously realize the alleviation of the water quality risk and the ecological risk of the target lake, has more systematicness and operability, and is applicable to the risk prevention and control of different lakes.
assignees: ANHUI SURVEY & DESIGN INST OF WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER CO LTD;CHANGJIANG WATER RESOURCES PROT INSTITUTE

title_en: Method and system for optimizing reliability improvement measures of large sending end system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of data processing, and particularly relates to a method and a system for optimizing reliability improvement measures of a large system at a sending end, wherein the method comprises the steps of calculating the annual value of equipment investment cost and equipment investment cost; acquiring a maintenance cost set; calculating the user outage loss and the outage loss cost of the system according to the classified user outage loss function, and calculating the equipment restoration rate and the unavailability rate; and sorting the reliability lifting measures based on the marginal benefit, and optimizing the lifting measures according to the sorting. And introducing a reliability lifting measure optimization sorting algorithm based on marginal benefit, adopting power system reliability cost benefit analysis based on LCC theory, considering the influence of system elements on the reliability of the power system, finding out weak links of the system, and determining measures for improving the power supply reliability through cost benefit analysis, thereby realizing maximization of economic cost and maximization of social benefit.
assignees: GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: Power distribution network recovery method based on controllable recovery output of photovoltaic power generation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network recovery method based on controllable recovery output of photovoltaic power generation, which comprises the following steps: acquiring weather information and photovoltaic equipment information of a prediction day, and predicting photovoltaic output by adopting a photovoltaic output prediction method based on multi-factor correction; generating a photovoltaic output prediction curve according to a photovoltaic output prediction result, decomposing the photovoltaic output prediction curve, and decomposing the photovoltaic power station into a plurality of virtual power supply combinations which are available in a specific period and controllable in output power; selectively recovering unrecovered charges by adopting constraint conditions according to the power distribution network and virtual power supply data, constructing an objective function, and solving to obtain an island division result and a load recovery sequence; and recovering the power distribution network according to the island division result and the load recovery sequence. The invention reduces the influence of photovoltaic output fluctuation on the recovery of the power system, so that the system has higher stability and reliability.
assignees: UNIV HUBEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Distribution network tie switch configuration optimization method and terminal based on toughness improvement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network tie switch configuration optimization method and terminal based on toughness improvement, which are characterized in that a tie switch configuration optimization model is established based on distribution network structure parameters, the maximum assembly quantity of tie switches, tie line assembly position sets, prediction fault scene sets, remote control switch assembly positions, distributed power supply assembly positions and capacity thereof and bus load shedding cost parameters, the model takes the minimum load shedding cost of a distribution network caused by extreme weather disasters as an objective function, constraint conditions of the model comprise tie switch configuration constraint in a pre-disaster stage and distribution network topology constraint in a post-disaster load restoration stage, and load is transferred to other power supply paths by coordinately considering the remote control switches and tie switch action processes, so that the quick recovery of critical load after disaster is ensured, the resistance and recovery capacity of a distribution system to extreme weather are comprehensively improved, and the toughness level of the distribution system is effectively improved.
assignees: ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Vegetation soil composition for restoration damaged land
title_ko: 훼손지 복원용 식생토 조성물
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a vegetation soil composition comprising: vegetation soil; a soil activator; a soil neutralizer; and a soil anti-caking agent, wherein the vegetation soil comprises 40-50 wt% of purified water sludge, 15-30 wt% of cocopeat, 10-20 wt% of granite soil, 5-10 wt% of loess, and 0. 1-0. The present invention relates to a vegetation soil composition for restoring a damaged area, which is formed by mixing 5 wt% of the vegetation soil composition.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 식생토 조성물에 있어서, 상기 식생토 조성물은 식생토와; 토양활성재와; 토양중화재와; 토양고결방지재를 포함하여 조성하되, 상기 식생토는 정수슬러지40~50중량%, 코코피트 15~30중량%, 마사토 10~20중량%, 황토 5-10중량%, 접착제 0.1~0.5중량%를 혼합하여 조성하는 것을 특징으로 하는 훼손지 복원용 식생토 조성물에 관한 발명이다.
assignees: KSECO TECH CO LTD;CHEONGJU UNIV INDUSTRY & ACADEMY COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Restoring states of real time clock devices for multiple hosts
abstract_en: A process includes, responsive to a primary power source being enabled, receiving, from a real time clock (RTC) device of a computer platform, an indication of a first time. Responsive to the primary power source being enabled, the process includes storing first data in a first non-volatile storage of the computer platform representing a snapshot of the first time and repeatedly updating the snapshot to cause the snapshot to track the first time. Responsive to the primary power source being disabled to begin a power outage, the process includes providing, by a timer of the computer platform powered by a secondary power source, a timer output that represents an accumulated time that corresponds to the power outage. The process includes restoring a state of the RTC device responsive to the primary power source being reenabled to end the power outage. The restoration includes, based on the accumulated time and the snapshot, determining a second time, and storing second data in the RTC device that represents the second time.
assignees: HEWLETT PACKARD ENTPR DEV LP

title_en: Power distribution network restoration deployment scheme determining method and device and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a power distribution network restoration deployment scheme determination method, a device, computer equipment, a storage medium and a computer program product. The method comprises the following steps: generating a plurality of typical waterlogging water logging disaster scenes of the power distribution network; determining a load recovery item and a maintenance time item corresponding to the typical waterlogging water immersion disaster scene, and generating an objective function corresponding to the typical waterlogging water immersion disaster scene according to the load recovery item and the maintenance time item; determining at least one element recovery constraint of the objective function; the element recovery constraint condition is used for constraining the recovery process of the power distribution network; determining a target drainage scheme and a target repair scheme that satisfy at least one element recovery constraint and maximize an objective function; and obtaining a power distribution network recovery deployment scheme based on the target drainage scheme and the target maintenance scheme. By adopting the method, the reasonability of the power distribution network recovery deployment scheme can be improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Hilly terrain vegetation recovery evaluation system used in power grid construction
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of power grid construction vegetation restoration, and discloses a hilly terrain vegetation restoration evaluation system used in power grid construction, which comprises a basic evaluation module, a feature evaluation module, a case data module and a scheme evaluation module, wherein the basic evaluation module is used for evaluating the vegetation restoration commonality characteristics of the area of a target restoration construction site, the feature evaluation module is used for evaluating a plurality of target characteristics of the target restoration construction site, the case data module is used for generating vegetation restoration case data according to the vegetation restoration commonality characteristics and the plurality of target characteristics of the area of the target restoration construction site, the restoration evaluation module is used for evaluating the vegetation restoration state of a vegetation restoration case to obtain the vegetation restoration state characteristics, and a vegetation restoration case evaluation model is generated according to the vegetation restoration case data and the vegetation restoration state characteristics. The power transmission and transformation tower foundation vegetation recovery state of hilly terrain is effectively monitored and evaluated, and the vegetation recovery effect is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Metal mine ecological restoration method based on EOD mode
abstract_en: An EOD mode-based metal mine ecological restoration method comprises the following steps: s1: surveying the landform of the waste stone slope; s2: constructing a cofferdam at the toe of the slope, and then chamfering and pressing the waste stone slope; s3: building a water seepage well in the cofferdam, and filling a water filtering filler in the cofferdam; s4: filling new waste residue stones, and heightening the height of the infiltration well along with the increase of the waste residue stone layer; s5: covering the soil and constructing a ditch; s6: sowing, and irrigating the foreign soil through the seepage well and the ditch; s7: after vegetation recovery, livestock breeding is performed. The invention has at least the following beneficial effects: 1. solves the problem of leaving over the existing waste rock slopes, and avoids the occurrence of geological disasters; 2. solves the problem of placement of redundant waste residue stones; 3. solves the problem of water source and provides precondition for restoration of mine ecology; 4. the ecological restoration scheme of the coordination of vegetation restoration and livestock breeding is provided, and the profitability and sustainability of ecological environment management are improved.
assignees: HENAN FAENDE MINING IND CO LTD

title_en: Vegetation restoration scheme generation method for construction of ecological circle of power transmission line
abstract_en: The invention provides a vegetation recovery scheme generation method for constructing an ecological ring of a power transmission line, which comprises the following steps: soil sampling is carried out on a line area to obtain soil matrix information corresponding to each planting range in the line area, a three-dimensional environment model in the line area is built by combining with climate information of the line area, corresponding optional seeds are matched for the planting ranges, a plurality of planting schemes are generated, a planting conceptual diagram corresponding to each planting scheme is generated in the three-dimensional environment model in a simulation mode, vegetation survival rate corresponding to each planting scheme is analyzed, a vegetation recovery scheme of the line area is generated according to a target planting scheme with the highest vegetation survival rate and a planting mode corresponding to each optional seed, vegetation of a power transmission line construction area is effectively recovered through construction of an ecological circle, and proper plant seeds are selected to adapt to natural environment and climate conditions of a place.

title_en: Method for improving root-crown ratio of newly planted forest after typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving the root-crown ratio of newly planted trees after typhoon. A method for improving root-crown ratio of newly planted forest after typhoon disaster comprises the following steps: and (3) planting in a 4 (2-4) planting mode of the complementary adjacent type of three different woods in the ecological restoration area, so that the different woods are fully contacted with other woods in space, and the root-crown ratio of the planted woods is improved. The method provided by the invention adopts a ' 4 (2-4): (2-4) planting mode of fully adjacent different tree species, so that three newly planted tree species are fully contacted with other tree species in space, and the growth of individuals is changed into reciprocal symbiotic cooperative growth of communities, thereby obviously improving the development and turnover speed of underground root systems of the tree species, obviously improving the ' root cap ratio ' index of the tree species, improving the wind resistance of communities, and effectively improving the ecological restoration quality of urban forests after typhoons.
assignees: GUANGDONG ACAD FORESTRY

title_en: Power grid equipment power recovery checking method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid equipment re-electricity checking method and system, and relates to the technical field of power grids. And updating the preset mode list information table by adopting all maintenance list data to generate an initial mode list set. And carrying out content adjustment according to the power outage notice corresponding to the initial mode list set to generate a to-be-started mode list set. And screening out the overhauling line according to the real-time topology data of the power grid and the mode list in overhauling in the initial mode list set, and constructing a target mode list set. And carrying out verification unit identification on the target mode list set to generate a verification unit set. And carrying out complex electricity verification statement construction based on the verification unit set and the target mode list set to generate a complex electricity verification statement set. And carrying out power grid equipment power restoration check on answer records corresponding to the power restoration check sentences in the power restoration check sentence set respectively to generate power restoration check data. The machine replacement for checking the duplicate electrical condition is realized through the intelligent voice interaction technology, and the traditional manual operation mode is changed.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Systems and methods to facilitate decision making for utility networks
abstract_en: Systems and methods are described for making repair decisions to improve resilience of a utility distribution network (UDN). A graph convolutional network (GCN) integrates reinforcement learning to provide an integrated model framework, in which the GCN encodes the information of the UDN, such as topology and operating characteristics. A neural network is connected to the GCN, and the framework trains the neural network to provide a recovery sequence based on the current state (e.g., a damaged state) of the UDN based one or more performance indicators.
assignees: UNIV CASE WESTERN RESERVE

title_en: Desert photovoltaic ecological environment effect evaluation method based on DPSIR model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological environment, in particular to a desert photovoltaic ecological environment effect evaluation method based on a DPSIR model, which comprises the following steps: collecting desert photovoltaic ecological environment data of a photovoltaic industrial area of a target desert area; constructing an ecological environment effect evaluation model; acquiring a first ecological environment index factor, and carrying out standardized treatment to output a standardized ecological environment evaluation index; calculating the standardized ecological environment evaluation index to output the index weight of the standardized ecological environment evaluation index; the method and the system for evaluating the ecological environment of the desert photovoltaic power station based on the comprehensive index calculate formula output area ecological environment comprehensive evaluation index evaluate the ecological environment influence of the desert photovoltaic power station from a quantitative angle for the first time, systematically construct an ecological environment effect evaluation system, analyze the influence of the construction of the photovoltaic power station on the ecological environment, and provide data support for the ecological environment protection and the ecological system restoration construction of the desert photovoltaic development area.
assignees: UNIV XIAN TECHNOLOGY;QINGHAI HUANGHE HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: New-power-system power grid restoration method and apparatus based on second-order cone transformation
abstract_en: A new-power-system power grid restoration method and apparatus based on second-order cone transformation. The method comprises: acquiring power data of a new power system (101); on the basis of the power data and taking the output uncertainty of a new energy unit into consideration, constructing a mixed-integer nonlinear two-stage robust optimization model based on a multi-state uncertainty set (102), wherein the model comprises an alternating-current power flow constraint; using a second-order cone relaxation technique to simplify the alternating-current power flow constraint, and converting the mixed-integer nonlinear two-stage robust optimization model into a mixed-integer second-order cone two-stage robust optimization model (103); decomposing the mixed-integer second-order cone two-stage robust optimization model into a main question and a sub-question, and solving the main question and the sub-question, so as to obtain an optimization result (104); and on the basis of the optimization result, generating a power grid restoration scheme for the new power system (105).
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY ELECTRIC POWER RES INSTITUTE;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Intelligent decision-making method for restoration and treatment of heavy metal polluted farmland
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of agricultural environment, and provides an intelligent decision method for repairing and controlling heavy metal polluted farmland, which comprises the following steps: investigation and evaluation are carried out on heavy metal polluted farmland areas, the types and the concentrations of heavy metals are determined, pollutant data of the areas to be repaired are obtained, and repair indexes are determined; a multi-technology combination mode is adopted, and a repairing scheme is provided; constructing an optimized repair model, and solving optimal repair parameters and measures; implementing a restoration scheme, monitoring heavy metal dynamic data such as soil, crops, water quality and the like in the restoration process, evaluating restoration effects, and timely adjusting restoration parameters; managing and maintaining the restored farmland; in the method, an intelligent restoration scheme is provided by using a multi-technology combination mode, an optimal restoration parameter and measure are solved by constructing an optimal restoration model, restoration efficiency is improved, and finally a way of digitally restoring the heavy metal polluted area of the cultivated land is realized.
assignees: UNIV HUANGGANG NORMAL

title_en: Method and device for aligning spot daily electricity quantity data and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a spot daily electricity quantity data alignment method, a spot daily electricity quantity data alignment device and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step S1, dividing the time periods of each hour in one day into peaks, flat and valleys, and determining the electricity price type of each hour; step S2, performing preliminary fitting according to the daily freezing total data and the divided electricity price types to obtain a fitting hour table code; s3, performing repair calculation on the fitting hour table code to obtain repaired electric quantity data; and S4, writing the repaired electric quantity data into a push table, and marking a fitting mark. According to the invention, the power data is divided into the peaks, the flat and the valleys, and the preliminary fitting data is subjected to restoration calculation, so that the accuracy of the power data can be remarkably improved, a power supply unit can be helped to know the power demand condition more accurately, and more effective power scheduling and pricing decision can be performed.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Method for diagnosing and treating degree and flow direction of gas pipe network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a diagnosis and treatment method for the degree and flow direction of a gas pipe network, which comprises the steps of obtaining pipe network topology data of the gas pipe network; acquiring actual degrees corresponding to each node in the gas pipe network according to the pipe network topology data, and constructing an illegal degree list and a degree restoration scheme according to the actual degrees of each node; and calculating the actual flow direction of each node according to the pipe network topology data, and constructing an illegal flow direction list and a flow direction restoration scheme according to the actual flow direction of each node. The invention can automatically check the illegal degree and illegal flow direction of the pipe network topology data, and repair the checked illegal degree nodes and illegal flow direction nodes, thereby improving the correctness and reliability of the pipe network topology data.
assignees: SHENZHEN GAS CORP LTD

title_en: Electric power rush-repair scheduling method and system based on vehicle-mounted electric power tool cabinet
abstract_en: The application discloses an electric power rush-repair scheduling method and system based on a vehicle-mounted electric power tool cabinet, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting various electric power operation data samples, extracting a plurality of characteristics of each data sample, and classifying attribute categories of each characteristic; calculating the information gain of each feature on all data samples to obtain the feature information gain; gain screening the characteristics according to the characteristic information to obtain screened characteristics; constructing a decision tree by utilizing the screened characteristics, and obtaining a decision information subset based on the decision tree; and constructing a scheduling processing model by utilizing the decision information subset to obtain a scheduling processing result. The application uses the information gain data as a tie, and uses the decision tree to carry out recursive computation to finally obtain the optimal scheduling processing flow, thereby effectively promoting the management and maintenance efficiency of the rush-repair operation construction.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD TONGLU COUNTY POWER SUPPLY COMPANY;HANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Systems and methods for prioritizing power restoration to sites after a power outage
abstract_en: A device may determine a number of user equipments (UEs) connected to an inactive site during a first period of time and determine that the inactive site experienced a power outage during a second period of time. The device may determine that the UEs connected to a set of active sites during the second period of time. The device may determine one or more key performance indicator (KPI) changes to one or more KPIs, during the second period of time, for each of the set of active sites. The device may determine a plurality of weights associated with the inactive site experiencing the power outage; determine a set of impacts, of the inactive site, on the one or more KPI changes for the set of active sites based on the plurality of weights; and cause power to be restored to the inactive site based on the set of impacts.
assignees: VERIZON PATENT & LICENSING INC

title_en: Fire-fighting facility operator real-operation online examination system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of remote examination and discloses a fire-fighting equipment operator real-operation online examination system and a method, wherein the fire-fighting equipment operator real-operation online examination system comprises an encryption and contract management module, a multi-factor identity authentication module, a behavior monitoring and risk assessment module, a skill and decision analysis module, an examination question self-adaptive updating module, a fault diagnosis and system feedback module and a security maintenance and vulnerability restoration module; the invention uses SHA-256 encryption algorithm, ethereum intelligent contracts and IPFS to store in a decentralization way, improves the data security, uses the behavior feature analysis, logistic regression model, openCV library and Isolation Forest algorithm to carry out identity verification and behavior monitoring, uses the support vector machine, BERT model and convolutional neural network to analyze the skills of examinees, carries out multi-dimensional ability assessment, uses TF-IDF and potential Dirichlet allocation algorithm, combines natural language generation technology, updates the questions, adopts logistic regression and clustering algorithm to predict system faults, and improves the system stability.

title_en: Power distribution network restoration method and apparatus, and device, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The present application relates to a power distribution network restoration method and apparatus, and a device, a storage medium and a program product. The method comprises: by taking a target restoration amount that corresponds to a power distribution network to be restored in a preset restoration period being maximized as an objective, constructing an objective function for restoring said power distribution network; acquiring a constraint condition for constraining said power distribution network, wherein the constraint condition comprises a resource scheduling constraint condition for constraining the scheduling of power restoration resources, and a power distribution network constraint condition for constraining said power distribution network; on the basis of the objective function and the constraint condition, determining a scheduling policy for the power restoration resources; and on the basis of the scheduling policy, restoring power to said power distribution network. By using the method, the restoration effect of a power distribution network can be improved.
assignees: Shenzhen power supply co ltd

title_en: River water level information missing restoration method based on water conservancy big data
abstract_en: According to the river water level information deletion restoration method based on the water conservancy big data, different solutions are constructed for different water level data deletion situations, when the water level information deletion occurs at discrete time points, the data are restored by adopting a cubic spline interpolation method based on time adjacent correlation of the water level information; when the water level information is absent in a continuous time period, repairing data by adopting a multiple linear regression model based on the spatial adjacent correlation of the water level information; when some monitoring stations monitor water level and flow simultaneously, the relation between the water level and the flow is fitted by using semi-supervised regression by utilizing the data relevance between the water level and the flow, and the missing water level information is repaired by using the functional relation; the data of the repair is accurate and reliable, the problem of data missing of the water conservancy informatization system is effectively solved, the accuracy, the practicability and the applicability of the data repair all reach higher level, the utilization efficiency of the hydrologic data is improved, and the use value of the hydraulic engineering is perfected.
assignees: HOU GUANGHUA

title_en: River and lake bottom mud-water separation device for mine restoration
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of environmental engineering, in particular to a river and lake bottom mud-water separation device for mine restoration. In the use process of the existing device, the dehydrated sludge is inconvenient to collect sufficiently, the water cannot be discharged due to blockage caused by the sludge, and the adhered sludge cannot fall sufficiently due to earthquake, so that the sludge-water separation effect is poor. The invention comprises a base, wherein the base is fixedly connected with a shell, and the top of the shell is fixedly connected with a one-way valve. According to the invention, the push plate is driven to slide back and forth by the electric push rod, the push plate can be pushed to slide by continuing to move, so that the extrusion plate and the filter screen frame extrude the sludge together, water in the sludge is extruded, the sludge is dehydrated, the solid content of the sludge is effectively improved, the pollution of the sludge to the water is reduced, and the water is purified.

title_en: Intelligent repair method and system for power grid data based on graph attention network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent repair method for power grid data based on a graph attention network, and relates to the technical field of power grids. Constructing a heterogeneous graph power grid model based on a graph neural network, and learning association weights between nodes and edges by utilizing the heterogeneous graph attention network; enhancing interaction and updating of node information by using a space-time attention mechanism to capture space and time associations between nodes; designing a dual learning-based framework to perform topology-state joint repair so as to complement power grid topology connection and predict the time sequence state of the missing node; and performing reinforcement learning by adopting a PPO algorithm to automatically search the optimal model structure and super-parameter configuration, and performing data restoration by using the optimized graph annotation force network model. The invention constructs a highly-automatic and self-adaptive heterogeneous depth map learning solution, and remarkably enhances the prediction capability and regulation level of stable operation of the power grid.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method for backfilling open pit to build underground gas storage and underground gas storage
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of compressed air energy storage, and provides a method for backfilling open pit and building an underground gas storage, and the underground gas storage, which comprises the steps of deep digging the bottom of an open abandoned pit to excavate partial bedrock, and building the underground gas storage on the bedrock; building a vertical shaft, enabling the bottom of the vertical shaft to be communicated with an underground gas storage, paving a plurality of gas pipelines communicated with the inside of the underground gas storage in the vertical shaft, building artificial surrounding rock at the bottom of a pit, and wrapping the underground gas storage and the bottom of the vertical shaft; backfilling stripping waste slag in the adjacent mine to be mined into an open-air waste pit to form a backfill area, exposing the top of the vertical shaft from the top of the backfill area, and connecting a plurality of gas pipelines in the vertical shaft with a compressor and an expander on the ground surface. The invention can solve the problems of high construction cost and high difficulty of the traditional gas storage chamber, and can also solve the problems of digestion of the adjacent stripping slag, ground disaster prevention and ecological restoration.
assignees: UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES WUHAN

title_en: Ecological restoration partition spraying device and spraying method based on unmanned aerial vehicle
