abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster restoration, and particularly relates to an ecological restoration partition spraying device based on an unmanned aerial vehicle and a spraying method thereof, wherein the ecological restoration partition spraying device based on the unmanned aerial vehicle comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, supporting legs are arranged at the bottom ends of two sides of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, and the unmanned aerial vehicle body comprises a scanning mechanism, a spraying mechanism and a spray head mechanism; the spraying device provided by the invention can identify geological features, acquire ecological geological environment, partition according to the topographic features, select different treatment ways and load different slurries, and can perform partition ecological restoration aiming at different geological disaster types, thereby greatly improving the treatment efficiency and treatment effect of disaster restoration.
assignees: UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Power supply master-slave networking pre-decision method for power grid power supply restoration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power supply master-slave networking pre-decision method facing power supply restoration of a power grid in the technical field of power supply restoration of a power system, which comprises the steps of dividing a power supply into a v/f control power supply and a non-v/f control power supply according to power supply control capability, and searching power supplies in a power supply range by taking each v/f control power supply as a starting point to form a networking sub-scheme set to be verified; acquiring power supply data parameters; checking networking sub-schemes in the networking sub-scheme set to be checked according to the power supply data parameters to obtain a networking sub-scheme set meeting constraint conditions, wherein the constraint conditions are short-circuit capacity ratio and inertial constraint; evaluating expected recovery net benefit and load recovery capacity of networking sub-schemes in the networking sub-scheme set meeting constraint conditions; and arranging the networking sub-schemes in descending order according to the expected net return of the networking sub-schemes to obtain a plurality of groups of power system networking schemes. The invention can combine the control capability, parameters, power grid topological structure and other information of the power supply, adapt to power failure faults in different scenes and decide an optimal networking scheme.
assignees: NANJING UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Efficiency optimization method for in-situ restoration integrated equipment of underground water
abstract_en: The invention discloses an efficiency optimization method of underground water in-situ restoration integrated equipment, which comprises the following steps: s1: modeling a process of repairing a polluted stratum by a GCW+ system through COMSOL; s2: taking a scene, an environment or a stratum condition as input, and inputting the scene, the environment or the stratum condition into a COMSOL model for simulation; s3: obtaining initial pollutant concentration prediction data of different pollution sites according to input conditions; s4: and evaluating and optimizing the output prediction data. Based on a physical model, the prediction accuracy and reliability of underground water flow and pollutant transmission processes are improved through multi-parameter modeling of scenes, environments and stratum conditions, and the method can be widely applied to actual underground water pollution restoration.
assignees: SICHUAN RUIMEIDI ECOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT TECH CO LTD;UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Informationized management method, device, equipment and medium for water ecological restoration engineering
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, and provides an informatization management method, device, equipment and medium for water ecological restoration engineering, which can convert equipment data to obtain data to be processed, and send the data to be processed to a corresponding data processing platform according to a physical data protocol corresponding to each data processing platform for storage and operation processing to obtain data informatization management data so as to realize informatization management of the data; inputting the operation and maintenance data into a configuration database according to a data template to obtain data electronic management data so as to realize electronic management of various data; personnel management is carried out according to the working type of each person to obtain personnel information management data so as to realize effective management of personnel information; performing early warning analysis according to the river water quality change data to obtain river water quality emergency management data so as to realize emergency management of river water quality; and a plurality of management dimensions are integrated, so that informatization management on the water ecological restoration project is realized.
assignees: ZHEJIANG DINGSHENG ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency information management system
abstract_en: The application provides an emergency information management system which comprises a data acquisition module, a power failure and power restoration monitoring module, a data processing module, a visualization module and an information pushing module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring information of a user; the emergency data acquired by the data acquisition module are integrated and analyzed through the data processing module to obtain target data, a power failure area in the target area is determined through the power failure and power restoration monitoring module, and power failure information is generated, so that the visualization module can be combined with GIS service to visually display weather conditions, the target data and the power failure area. Therefore, the power grid staff can intuitively know the integrated and analyzed emergency data, accurately master the power failure area affected by the disaster, avoid the problems of multi-head report, repeated report and the like, furthest realize information sharing, assist the emergency decision of the power grid, enable the power grid unit to timely and effectively develop emergency actions such as equipment rush repair, power failure and power restoration information report and the like, and further improve the efficiency of emergency management of the power grid.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Multi-type ant colony algorithm oriented to collaborative optimization of ecological network function and structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to an ecological network function and structure collaborative optimization-oriented multi-type ant colony algorithm, which designs an ecological network function optimization operator and a fuzzy C-means clustering-based structure optimization operator, integrates a space function and a space structure operator into the multi-type ant colony optimization algorithm, introduces a geographic parallel computing architecture, constructs an ecological network optimization-oriented high-performance land utilization optimization model, and develops plaque-level ecological network function and structure collaborative optimization from the aspects of quantitative and dynamic simulation. The invention can enhance ecological functions such as ecological source quality, plaque connectivity and the like while improving social, economic, ecological and suitability targets, and reduce fragmentation of local ecological networks; in addition, the parallelization calculation framework based on the GPU solves the contradiction between high-precision land utilization simulation optimization and large-scale ecological network construction on calculation efficiency, and provides reference for making fine ecological restoration and land utilization planning decisions.
assignees: EAST CHINA INST TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Strong earthquake geological disaster prevention and reduction method based on natural solution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a strong earthquake geological disaster prevention and reduction method based on a natural solution, which comprises the following steps: s1, obtaining basic geological disaster characteristics of a disaster area; s2, constructing a manual intervention and intervention degree reference table according to basic characteristics of the geological disasters, and determining the intervention degree; s3, determining a natural-based repairing measure according to the intervention degree; s4, constructing an evaluation model for evaluation according to the determined restoration measures, and completing the method for controlling and reducing the strong earthquake geological disasters based on the natural solution. The method aims at judging whether the natural recovery or the manual intervention repair degree is carried out through the obtained data from the natural perspective, further rapidly assembling a natural-based repair scheme, judging whether the strong earthquake geological disaster prevention and reduction technology is based on a natural evaluation system, realizing natural-based ecological repair measures, and promoting fusion of geological disaster prevention and reduction and ecological civilization construction.
assignees: UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Data acquisition and analysis method of electric power concentrator based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power data analysis, and particularly relates to a data acquisition and analysis method of a power concentrator based on the Internet of things, which is characterized in that operation information of each power device in a power grid is acquired by utilizing the power concentrator, so that fault devices are identified, the power supply lines where the fault devices are located are positioned, the abnormal operation detection and the fluctuation operation detection of the corresponding power supply lines are carried out, further, the fault cause prediction is carried out according to the detection result, the effective and comprehensive prediction of the fault cause is realized, the misjudgment rate of the fault cause is greatly reduced, the prediction accuracy is facilitated to be improved, meanwhile, the fault influence degree and the operation load of the fault lines are combined and considered when the fault emergency repair scheduling is carried out according to the fault detection result of the power grid, the importance of the operation load in the fault emergency repair scheduling is highlighted, the emergency repair priority of the fault lines can be more accurately and reasonably determined, and the scientific optimization allocation of emergency repair resources is realized.

title_en: Disaster influence evaluation system, disaster influence evaluation method, and program
abstract_en: To provide a disaster influence evaluation system capable of evaluating an influence of a disaster exerted from the disaster to an evaluation object system in more accordance with a real state of the disaster.SOLUTION: A disaster influence evaluation system according to an embodiment includes: a function loss frequency evaluation unit which evaluates a function loss frequency of each facility when a disaster has occurred in an evaluation object system in which a plurality of facilities are installed; a restoration time evaluation unit which evaluates restoration time when the disaster has occurred according to an intensity of the disaster; and a disaster influence evaluation unit which evaluates the disaster influence to the evaluation object system on the basis of the function loss frequency and the restoration time.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: TOSHIBA CORP;TOSHIBA ENERGY SYSTEM & SOLUTION CORP

title_en: Full life cycle test system for island airport runway foundation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full life cycle test system for an island airport runway foundation, which comprises a power supply module, an upper computer and a lower computer, wherein the power supply module is used for supplying power to the system, the upper computer consists of a control module and a signal excitation and receiving module, and the lower computer consists of a data processing and early warning module. The control module is connected with the signal excitation and receiving module and generates a seismic wave signal through the electric servo control signal excitation and receiving module; the signal excitation and receiving module comprises SPGC and an array type earthquake wave excitation unit and a receiving unit which are integrated on SPGC, and SPGC is used for generating piezoelectric signals when the foundation is subjected to settlement deformation; the data processing and early warning module is connected with the signal excitation and receiving module, analyzes and evaluates the restoration degree and the traffic capacity of the restored foundation, and sends out early warning when the load exceeds the safety traffic capacity or the foundation is deformed greatly. The system of the invention realizes the real-time detection and monitoring of the full life cycle of hidden projects such as airport runway foundations and the like.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Micro-grid group energy storage capacity configuration method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for configuring energy storage capacity of a micro-grid group, which comprise the following steps: determining the source load adaptation degree of the micro-grid group according to the predicted load curve and output curve of the micro-grid, and judging whether the source load adaptation degree is larger than or equal to a preset value; if yes, determining that the micro-grid group does not need to store energy, if not, obtaining the fault average restoration time length of the upper power grid of the micro-grid group, determining the total energy storage demand capacity of the micro-grid group according to the fault average restoration time length, the load curve and the output curve, determining the energy storage distribution coefficient of each micro-grid according to the load curve and the output curve, and calculating the product of the total energy storage demand capacity and the energy storage distribution coefficient to obtain the target energy storage capacity of each micro-grid. The energy storage is realized when the source load adaptation degree of the micro-grid group is smaller than a preset value, the invalid energy storage is avoided, and the energy storage distribution coefficient is determined through the output and the load of the micro-grid, so that the energy storage distribution of the micro-grid is more perfect and reasonable, and the stability and the reliability of the grid are improved.

title_en: GSA-GWO algorithm-based island division method and system for local power grid containing distributed power supply
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system regulation and control, and the method comprises the steps of evaluating loads by adopting an optimal-worst method to obtain load weight values, and determining island division important load recovery priority under local power grid faults; secondly, determining a load grade weight coefficient value by combining the load priority, and constructing a local power grid island division model containing a distributed power supply; then, introducing a chaotic reverse learning and genetic annealing algorithm (GSA) to improve a gray wolf optimization algorithm (GWO); and finally, solving the fault model of the local power distribution network by adopting an improved GSA-GWO algorithm to obtain a better island division result. According to the method, the diversity of the load and the preference of the user to the important load are fully considered, and the model is solved by adopting an improved algorithm, so that the solving efficiency is improved, the island division optimal strategy under the local power grid fault is realized, and the recovery power supply of the important load is ensured.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Automatic power restoration method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic power restoration method, an automatic power restoration device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of power application. The automatic power restoration method comprises the following steps: searching a power grid at the upper stage by taking the current bus where the equipment to be powered back is located as a starting point, and searching to obtain a target bus with voltage; constructing a corresponding candidate power supply path based on a node between the current bus and the target bus; the optimal power supply path of the equipment to be powered back is determined according to the power supply path length of each candidate power supply path, so that automatic power back is carried out on the equipment to be powered back according to the optimal power supply path, the problem that the optimal power back path is difficult to comb when large-area equipment is powered off is solved, rapid combing and rapid power back of the optimal power back path of the equipment are realized, switching operation of a main network regulator is reduced, and economic loss and social influence are reduced.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;HUIZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Data recovery method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a data recovery method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: in the state that the target service operated in the first service server is abnormal, the target service is restored in the second service server, and in the process that the second service server restores the target service and under the condition that the second service server operates the target service, whether the first service server is abnormal or not is detected, so that the situation that the two service servers currently operate the target service and are mistakenly restored is caused, the situation that service data are inconsistent due to mistaken restoration can be avoided, the service disaster tolerance performance when the target service is executed is improved, the target service can be continuously operated only by short-time blocking under the abnormal condition, and therefore the stability of the target service operation is improved.
assignees: TENCENT TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for coordinated source-grid-load-storage dispatch optimization during post-disaster restoration of power distribution system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the technical field of power systems and operations research. Disclosed are a method and system for coordinated source-grid-load-storage dispatch optimization during post-disaster restoration of a power distribution system. The method comprises: acquiring network topology constraint data for a power distribution system, wherein network topology constraints for the power distribution system comprise a virtual network topology constraint for the power distribution system, a geometric network topology constraint for the power distribution system, and an electrical network topology constraint for the power distribution system; on the basis of fault situations of a power source device, a load device and an energy storage device that are caused by a disaster, generating operational characteristic constraint data for devices in the power distribution system, wherein the operational characteristic constraint data for the devices in the power distribution system comprises operational characteristic constraints for the power source device, the load device and the energy storage device; and inputting the network topology constraint data for the power distribution system and the operational characteristic constraint data for the devices in the power distribution system into a pre-established coordinated source-grid-load-storage dispatch optimization model for power distribution systems in a post-disaster restoration scenario, such that a coordinated dispatch optimization result is output.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Important load recovery method and system using mobile power supply
abstract_en: The invention discloses an important load recovery method and system using a mobile power supply, wherein the important load recovery method and system using the mobile power supply monitor the running state of a power grid in real time, acquire the related information of a target load in the power grid, and the related information comprises the load demand and priority of the important load; establishing a power supply restoration mathematical model according to the related information of the target load in the power grid, wherein the power supply restoration mathematical model at least comprises a mobile power supply; when the target load fault occurs, a multi-period robust rolling time domain recovery method is used, a power supply recovery mathematical model is solved in three stages, and fault target load recovery is completed according to a solving result. The power supply recovery capability of the power grid can be effectively improved, and the timely recovery of power supply when faults occur is ensured. Meanwhile, the method can effectively utilize the mobile power supply to recover the power supply of the damaged area and improve the reliability of the micro-grid.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Emergency drop network restoration decision method and system based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for decision-making of a road network restoration under an emergency event based on deep reinforcement learning, which belong to the technical field of road traffic network safety, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing an urban road network graph structure, and generating road network characteristic data according to the urban road network graph structure; taking road traffic network efficiency as a toughness evaluation index, and establishing an urban road network toughness evaluation model under an emergency; constructing a deep reinforcement learning network model, and training the deep reinforcement learning network model through the road network characteristic data and the road traffic network efficiency; and (5) performing road network recovery through the trained deep reinforcement learning network model. The road network toughness assessment and road network recovery are carried out through the pre-trained deep reinforcement learning network model, the calculation can be rapidly carried out after the emergency occurs, and the urban road network toughness under the emergency can be improved.
assignees: UNIV WUHAN TECH

title_en: Intelligent image oil leakage monitoring method and system for new energy wind generating set
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of application of new energy wind power generation systems, and particularly discloses an intelligent image oil leakage monitoring method and system for a new energy wind power generator set, comprising the following steps of collecting visible light and infrared images in a fan cabin by using an industrial-grade double-spectrum camera; performing image restoration and quality enhancement based on deep learning on the visible light image; identifying potential oil leakage points on the surface of the pipeline in the enhanced visible light image by using a target detection model; registering the visible light and the infrared image, and analyzing the temperature distribution of the corresponding potential oil leakage points; and comprehensively judging whether oil leakage exists or not according to the image and the temperature information, and pushing and early warning. The invention has the beneficial effects that: meanwhile, intelligent oil leakage monitoring is carried out by utilizing visible light and infrared bimodal information, and the two are mutually verified, so that the accuracy of oil leakage identification is greatly improved; when oil leakage is detected, early warning can be responded in time, accident response time is obviously shortened, and safety and reliability of wind power equipment are greatly improved.
assignees: NANJING NANZI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Electric power emergency material allocation method, device, equipment and storage medium under geological disaster
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for allocating electric power emergency materials under geological disasters, and belongs to the field of allocation of electric power emergency materials. Determining a transportation path set according to a traffic line between an area to be restored of a power grid and an emergency material reserve point; calculating the material transportation time of each transportation path in the transportation path set by using the triangular fuzzy number, and constructing a triangular fuzzy traffic network diagram according to the transportation path set and the material transportation time; calculating the path guarantee rate corresponding to each transportation path according to the power restoration time; calculating an optimal transportation path in the triangular fuzzy traffic network diagram by using a preset path optimization algorithm based on the triangular fuzzy traffic network diagram and the path guarantee rate; and transporting the emergency materials from the emergency material reserve point to the area to be restored of the power grid according to the optimal transportation path. The application can determine the optimal transportation path under the condition that the road condition information and the transportation time of the disaster area are uncertain, and can provide electric emergency materials for the disaster-stricken site in time.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Fish ladder block structure with an arc-shaped hole on the inside
title_ko: 내측이 원호 형상의 잠공을 갖춘 잠월류 어도블록 구조체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a submersible fishway block structure having an arc-shaped submersible hole on the inside and a construction method thereof. The submersible hole of a conventional submersible fishway having an excellent passage rate of floating fish is improved to the submersible hole having an arc-shaped inner side to shorten a maximum flow rate section, and an inlet and an outlet are widened to be gradually narrowed. Therefore, the submersible fishway block structure has a structure in which a cross section is gradually narrowed and a flow rate is increased when fish sensing a flow of water discharged from the submersible hole changes a direction to enter the submersible fishway block structure. Therefore, the submersible fishway block structure has a short maximum flow rate section to allow benthic fish to move at an instant rush speed. The submersible fishway block structure has a high passage rate of all fish species from the submersible fishway to the floating fishway to the benthic fishway to contribute to restoration of a healthy river ecosystem. Moreover, the submersible fishway block structure is improved to complete a structure in which a bottom of the submersible fishway block is structurally connected between upper and lower fishway blocks on a site without a connection ring between blocks to resist a flowing water force in case of a flood. Therefore, the submersible fishway block structure has excellent structural safety and safety during construction to reduce construction convenience and costs.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 본 발명은 내측이 원호형상의 잠공을 갖춘 잠월류 어도블록 구조체 및 그 시공방법에 관한 것으로, 부유성 어류의 통과율이 우수한 종래의 잠월류 어도의 잠공을 내측이 원호 형상으로 갖춘 잠공으로 개선하여 유속 최대 구간을 짧게하고, 입·출구는 넓게 하여 점차 좁아지는 구조로 갖춤으로써 잠공에서 배출되는 물 흐름을 감지한 어류가 방향을 바꾸어 진입하면 단면이 점차 좁아지며 유속이 빨라지는 구조로서 최대 유속 구간이 짧아 저서성 어류가 순간의 돌진속도로 이동이 가능하고, 잠월류 어도에서 부유성 어류 및 저서성 어류까지 모든 어종들의 통과율이 높아 건강한 하천생태계 복원에 기여함과 아울러 잠월류 어도블록을 구조체로 개선하여 홍수시 유수력에 저항하기 위한 블록간 연결 고리 없이 잠월류 어도블록 바닥을 현장에서 상·하류 어도블록 간 구조적으로 연결되는 구조체로 완성함으로써 구조적 안전성과 시공 중 안전을 확보하여 시공의 편의성과 비용을 절감하는 경제적이고 효율성이 우수하다.
assignees: KIM IN SEONG

title_en: Disaster Management System
abstract_en: To provide a disaster management system capable of accurately, efficiently calculate the cost required for restoration of each disaster area when natural disasters occur.SOLUTION: A disaster management system 1 consists of a portable information processing terminal 2 and a server 3. The portable information processing terminal 2 has an information input part 2a capable of inputting the information 4 for a damage amount calculation of the damage area D in the event of a disaster, an individual damage amount calculation part 2b to calculate the individual disaster amount of the disaster area D based on the predetermined arithmetic expression corresponding to the disaster amount calculation information 4, and a GPS function part 2c capable of measuring the disaster location information using an artificial satellite. The server 3 has an information storage part 3a to acquire the individual damage amount and the damage location information from the portable information processing terminal 2 and to store them by associating them each other, and a total damage amount calculation part 3b to tally the individual disaster amount of each different disaster area D and to calculate the total disaster amount when the disasters occur.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: NEW JAPAN KNOWLEDGE CO LTD

title_en: Method for determining proper planting distance for vegetation ecological restoration in arid region
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining a proper planting distance for vegetation ecological restoration in a arid region, which comprises the following steps: step 1, acquiring soil parameters and soil water parameters of a research area; step 2, determining vegetation parameters of a research area; step 3, collecting hydrologic data of a research area; step 4, determining the transpiration quantity of dominant plant species of vegetation communities in the research area; step 5, calculating the thickness of the diving influence layer in the research area; step 6, determining the thickness of the absorbable utilization layer; step 7, determining the water content in the thickness of the absorbable utilization layer; step 8, determining a proper planting distance of vegetation; the method can effectively solve the problem of desertification of the oasis in the arid region, and provides reliable theoretical and technical support for guiding ecological restoration and reasonable development and utilization of groundwater resources.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Identification method of lakeside zone ecological restoration area under influence of climate change
abstract_en: The invention relates to a recognition method of an ecological restoration area, and particularly provides a recognition method of a lakeside ecological restoration area under the influence of climate change. The method comprises the following steps: (1) According to the predicted meteorological data of the given lake, predicting the water levels of different periods in the future of the given lake by adopting a support vector machine algorithm; (2) According to the elevation of the predicted water level of each period, combining a digital elevation model of the whole lake area of a given lake to identify a newly submerged or exposed area; (3) And determining an ecological restoration area according to the land utilization remote sensing data of the new submerged or exposed area. The method can identify areas such as lakes and the like subjected to climate change in advance, so that ecological restoration engineering is more targeted. Meanwhile, the method can be carried out only by the existing international climate change prediction database and historical water level monitoring data, so that the accuracy and convenience of the identification of the ecological restoration area of the lakeside zone are greatly improved.
assignees: CHINESE RES ACAD ENV SCIENCES

title_en: Pollution site restoration intelligent decision method based on multi-source data
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pollution site repair intelligent decision method based on multi-source data, which is characterized in that pollution site sample data are collected, a to-be-repaired area higher than a risk threshold is determined, comprehensive repair demand assessment is formed by comprehensively analyzing pollutant characteristics, site characteristics and environmental factors of the to-be-repaired area, historical repair data are collected, a neural network decision model is constructed to predict optimal repair targets and repair methods under different conditions, corresponding data are input for specific to-be-repaired areas by utilizing the trained model, and decision results of the repair targets and the repair methods are intelligently output; the invention realizes the scientificalness and the accuracy of the polluted site restoration decision by integrating the multi-source data, improves the restoration efficiency and the restoration effect, and provides powerful support for the polluted site management.

title_en: Steel frame structure staggered truss node with post-earthquake restorable function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a steel frame structure staggered truss node with a post-earthquake restorable function, and relates to the technical field of steel frame structures. This but steel frame structure staggered truss node with function is restoreed after shake, through setting up prestressing steel, friction power consumption board and power consumption coupling assembling etc., connect the girder steel of both sides by the prestressing steel of both sides, alleviate the burden of connecting piece, and realize friction power consumption through friction power consumption board, when the node takes place to deform, friction power consumption board is located friction rotation between the mechanical hinge, increase the power consumption effect, alleviate the atress of power consumption board, and carry out the centre gripping spacing through upper cover plate and lower cover plate to the power consumption board that slits, make things convenient for the restoration of power consumption board after shake, the practicality is improved, and then the stability of steel frame structure has been improved.
assignees: SHAANXI RAILWAY INST;UNIV XIAN ARCHITECTUR & TECH

title_en: Apparatus and method for determining location and capacity of distributed generation
title_ko: 분산 전원의 위치와 용량을 결정하는 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an apparatus and a method for determining a position and a capacity of a distributed power source, and more particularly, to an apparatus and a method for determining a position and a capacity of a distributed power source capable of maximizing a recovery load amount by calculating the recovery load amount in accordance with an optimal recovery sequence when a power failure occurs in a distribution network. In addition, the present disclosure may provide an apparatus and a method for determining a position and a capacity of a distributed power source capable of minimizing large-scale human and property damage caused by a power failure by determining an optimal position and an optimal capacity of a distributed power source capable of a black start function for initiating power failure recovery in a distribution network.
abstract_ko: 본 개시는 분산 전원의 위치와 용량을 결정하는 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로서, 특히, 배전망의 정전 발생 시, 최적의 복구 시퀀스에 따라 복구 부하량을 계산함으로써, 복구 부하량을 최대화할 수 있는 분산 전원의 위치와 용량을 결정하는 장치 및 방법을 제공할 수 있다. 또한, 배전망 내 정전 복구를 개시하기 위한 블랙 스타트(black start) 기능이 가능한 분산 전원의 최적 위치와 최적 용량을 결정함으로써, 정전으로 인한 대규모 인적, 물질적 피해를 최소화시킬 수 있는 분산 전원의 위치와 용량을 결정하는 장치 및 방법을 제공할 수 있다.
assignees: KERI KOREA ELECTROTECHNOLOGY RES INST

title_en: Disaster backup migration method and system for computing power network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster recovery migration method for a computing power network, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that a master node obtains a mode of a current application process and a state of a container in a Kubernetes cluster, the obtained mode of the application process is switched to a check point mode, in the check point mode, check point/restoration CRIU software in a user space is used for converting the state of the container in the obtained Kubernetes cluster into a container group Pod state image file, the master node uses Ceph reliable autonomous distributed object storage block device Ceph RBD to convert the Pod state image file into a Pod backup file which simultaneously comprises Pod state information and persistent data volume backup, the current backup node obtains the Pod backup file from the master node and cold-loads the Pod backup file, the Pod backup file is migrated to a target cluster, and the target cluster uses the obtained Pod backup file to realize Pod restoration in the Kubernetes cluster. The method can solve the technical problem that the existing cross-regional deployment method occupies excessive computing power resources due to repeated deployment of the application and the service at different geographic positions.
assignees: UNIV HUNAN

title_en: Combined ecological revetment applied to river management and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined ecological revetment applied to river treatment and a construction method thereof, wherein the ecological revetment comprises an ecological revetment foundation, a river water purification area and a surface source pollution interception area which are sequentially arranged from a river shallow water area upwards along a river slope, the ecological revetment foundation comprises a pile foundation and a lower lattice peduncles which are arranged along a river trend, the pile foundation is fixed in a river shallow water riverbed, the lower lattice peduncles are fixed on the pile foundation and are arranged along the river trend, the river water purification area extends from the lower lattice peduncles to the river flood level height along the river slope, emergent aquatic plants are planted in the river water purification area, an upper lattice peduncles is arranged at the upper end of the river water purification area, the upper lattice peduncles are arranged along the river trend, the surface source pollution interception area extends from the upper lattice peduncles to the river slope, and herbaceous plants are planted in the surface source pollution interception area. The invention combines the advantages and disadvantages of the traditional hard revetments and natural revetments, realizes the balance of three aspects of ecological restoration, water conservancy anti-scour and landscape lifting, has simple structure, reasonable design and easy construction, and has great reference significance for river management engineering.
assignees: NANJING INST OF ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENCES MEE;CHINA NAT ENVIRONMENTAL MONITORING CENTRE

title_en: A method of providing frequency restoration reserves
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a method of providing secondary frequency reserves. The method comprising the steps of building an uncertainty set by computing probabilities for the activation of thermal loads, placing energy bids by solving an optimization model, and predicting the merit order position of the aggregator in a scale of other secondary frequency reserves providers, wherein the flexibility is limited by energy constraints, wherein the aggregator is configured to estimate a volume of a bid power P<sub>bid</sub> to be released, and wherein the volume of a bid power P<sub>bid</sub> volume is based on a grid request for a total volume of power and wherein a corresponding price per power is based on a prediction of a merit order supply curve.
assignees: THERMOVAULT BV

title_en: Power grid measurement data checking method and system based on artificial intelligence algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid measurement data checking method and system based on an artificial intelligence algorithm, comprising the following steps: step S1, acquiring electric quantity data of equipment in each link to obtain an initial data set; step S2, preprocessing the collected initial data set to obtain a training data set; s3, constructing an abnormal data identification model based on One-Class SVM; s4, constructing an abnormal data restoration model according to a ridge regression algorithm; s5, inputting the data to be checked into a trained abnormal data identification model, identifying abnormal data points, and repairing the data to be repaired by using an abnormal data repairing model to obtain repaired data; and S6, fitting the probability density function of the repaired data, and comparing the fitted probability density function with the distribution characteristics of the original data to evaluate the repairing effect. The method can effectively identify and repair abnormal data, improve the quality and reliability of the data, and provide important support for power grid operation and management.
assignees: GREAT POWER SCIENCE AND TECH STOCK CO LTD STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CORPORATION

title_en: Method for realizing equipment fault rush repair based on GIS (geographic information System)
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing equipment fault rush-repair based on a GIS (geographic information system), which comprises the steps of collecting and preprocessing existing fault data, constructing a fault database, constructing an equipment fault prediction model, training the equipment fault prediction model by taking the fault data as input data, outputting fault prediction information, constructing and calling a GIS module based on the fault prediction information, planning the position of an optimal rush-repair base station to form a rush-repair base station topology network, acquiring real-time fault information, adopting the GIS module to calculate the nearest rush-repair base station and the optimal rush-repair route, forming a rush-repair scheduling data packet, and transmitting the rush-repair scheduling data packet to the rush-repair base station. According to the invention, through integrating the GIS system and the machine learning model, a comprehensive equipment fault rush-repair flow is provided, future fault events are effectively predicted, an optimal rush-repair route is calculated, and meanwhile, the stability and the safety of the system are ensured.

title_en: Power system restoration decision method based on LSTM neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an LSTM neural network-based power system recovery decision method, relates to the technical field of power system recovery, and solves the problems that photovoltaic prediction is not accurate enough and decision output is not complete enough in power system recovery. According to the invention, the photovoltaic output prediction LSTM network is trained through the collected data such as time, irradiance, humidity, air pressure, actual photovoltaic output power and the like, the power output data of a future time period is accurately predicted based on the photovoltaic output prediction LSTM network, and the output of a recovery decision of the power system is carried out based on the predicted data, so that the hysteresis of the recovery decision of the power system is eliminated. In the process of recovering the decision-making output of the power system, the invention takes the most recovered load quantity as an objective function, and constraint conditions comprise unit state constraint, load state constraint, power balance constraint of the power system and the like, thereby further ensuring the accuracy and the effectiveness of the recovery decision-making of the power system.
assignees: GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Emergency command center network security risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vegetation restoration and discloses a network security risk assessment method for an emergency command center.
assignees: GUANGKE TONGLI GUANGDONG DATA SERVICES CO LTD

title_en: Vegetation analysis method and system for ecological fragile area and grass seed recovery device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vegetation analysis method and system for an ecological fragile area and a grass seed recovery device, and relates to the technical field of ecological vegetation recovery, wherein the method and system comprise the steps of obtaining disturbance area information of power transmission and transformation project, and dividing a zonal area and a non-zonal area based on the disturbance area information of the power transmission and transformation project; analyzing the vegetation information of the regional area to obtain a first analysis result, and analyzing the vegetation information of the non-regional area to obtain a second analysis result; determining a typical vegetation community based on the first analysis result, and performing surface layer delicately soil analysis on the typical vegetation community to obtain a primary soil specificity index; performing anti-sensitivity calculation on the second analysis result based on the influence factors of the non-zonal region to obtain a repair coefficient; and correcting the primary soil specificity index according to the repair coefficient to obtain a regulation-grade soil specificity index, and determining vegetation recovery species based on the regulation-grade soil specificity index. The grass seed recovery device comprises the analysis system and a planting system matched with the analysis system, and completes grass seed configuration operation. The analysis result of the zonal area is combined with the repair result of the non-zonal area to serve as a screening foundation of vegetation restoration species, the influence of factors of the non-zonal area on vegetation construction is considered, the planting survival rate of the finally analyzed species can be improved, and the method is more suitable for rapid restoration construction of vegetation in power transmission and transformation projects of ecological fragile areas.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID EAST INNER MONGOLIA ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY LIMITED;UNIS SOFTWARE SYSTEM CO LTD;STATE GRID EAST INNER MONGOLIA ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN COMPANY LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Mine pit repairing method combining mine waste backfill with excess sludge encapsulation
abstract_en: The invention provides a mine pit repairing method by combining mine waste backfill and excess sludge encapsulation. The mine pit repairing method comprises the following steps of: spreading the fly ash-lime stabilized excess sludge to a natural foundation layer at the bottom of a mine hole and to the side wall of the mine hole, compacting to form a bottom sludge lining and a side wall sludge lining respectively; sequentially backfilling excess sludge, anaerobic ammonia oxidation sludge and nitrified sludge on a bottom sludge lining to form a triple composite sludge layer; backfilling mine waste on the triple composite sludge layer to form a mine waste layer. In addition, the mine pit repairing method further comprises the step of paving a top cover layer on the mine waste after backfilling is finished. According to the invention, mine wastes are backfilled in mine pits and solid wastes such as excess sludge are used for encapsulation, so that the treatment of wastes with processes of wastes can be effectively realized, the problems of mining area geological environment disasters, ecological restoration, vegetation restoration and the like are solved, and the environment-friendly mine construction is facilitated.
assignees: POWERCHINA HUADONG ENGINEERING CORP LTD

title_en: Greening recovery method for mine stable rock high-steep side slope
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine stable rock high-steep side slope greening recovery method, which belongs to the technical field of side slope restoration, and comprises the following steps: firstly, the purpose of eliminating geological disaster hidden trouble is to thoroughly clean loose pumice stones, unstable blocks and the like on the slope surface, so that the rock slope surface forms a stable main body. Then spraying mineral substance-dissolving microorganisms on the slope surface, and spraying and maintaining matrix materials on the slope surface in two batches after the surface corrosion process is finished, wherein the first batch of matrix materials mainly comprises moss seed sources, planting matrixes, polymer aggregate agents, colloidal particle agents, water-retaining agents and adhesives; the second batch of matrix materials consists of herbaceous and vine seeds, planting soil, polymer aggregate, colloidal particle agent, water-retaining agent, adhesive and slow-release compound fertilizer. The matrix material is sprayed and attached and then is matched with later-period water and nutrient solution for maintenance, so that basic greening of the slope can be expected to be completed within half a year, and the greening effect and stability are stronger along with the time.
assignees: POWERCHINA MUNICIPAL PLANNING AND DESIGN INST CO LTD;POWERCHINA KUNMING ENG CORP LTD

title_en: Method for remotely controlling and intensively displaying in-situ repair data of multi-site groundwater
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for remotely controlling and intensively displaying in-situ repair data of multi-site groundwater, which comprises the following steps: step 1, determining target power supply parameters based on field sensor equipment, building a power distribution system and then installing the power distribution system and a field industrial personal computer in a modularized movable management and control platform; then transported to the underground water in-situ restoration site. And 2, constructing a cloud server system to process all received underground water in-situ repair field data and perform bidirectional transmission of the data with an application layer, wherein the bidirectional transmission comprises data pushing and receiving. And 3, covering the functions of equipment monitoring, on-site state configuration, data display large screen, user interface design and equipment control by using an application layer system. The invention establishes the functions of the application layer program, such as equipment monitoring, on-site state configuration, data display large screen, user interface design, equipment control and the like.
assignees: UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Emergency power restoration method, power restoration device and emergency power restoration system for power distribution network
abstract_en: The application provides an emergency re-electricity method, a re-electricity device and an emergency re-electricity system of a power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: quickly positioning the fault section to obtain fault positioning information and identifying whether the complex electric path is multipath; under the condition that the complex electric path has multiple paths, analyzing and acquiring complex electric information of a fault section according to the fault positioning information; calculating normalized recoverable charges, normalized predicted recovery time and normalized rush repair cost according to the recovery information; constructing an objective function based on the normalized recoverable charge, the normalized predicted recovery time and the normalized rush repair cost, and iterating the objective function by adopting a particle swarm algorithm until reaching an iteration termination condition to obtain an optimal scheme; and generating a scheduling instruction according to the optimal scheme, wherein the scheduling instruction is used for guiding a rush-repair personnel to carry out the rush-repair of the fault section. The method solves the problem of low scheduling efficiency of power distribution network duplicate under large-area power failure in the prior art.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ZHUHAI POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: High abrupt side slope prevention of seepage treatment equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of steep slope treatment and discloses high-steep slope seepage-proofing treatment equipment, which comprises a slope body, wherein a first protective layer is paved on the upper surface of the slope body, an impermeable layer is poured on the upper end of the first protective layer, a second protective layer is paved on the upper surface of the impermeable layer, a stacking area is vertically paved on the upper surface of the second protective layer, a repairing layer is arranged at the upper end of the filling area, and drop-proofing nets are arranged on two sides and the front end of the repairing layer. This high abrupt side slope prevention of seepage administers equipment can avoid the rainwater to enter into the internal portion of slope through the first protective layer of laying at the slope body upper surface, and the barrier layer can play effects such as anti rain erodees, moisturizes, water retention, and then has further protected the slope body, has avoided the slope body landslide, and the second protective layer can be high the interior soil structure of slope body, avoids the slope body landslide because of the rainwater leads to, and the filling area can let the slope body face complete and thereby the basic unit under the compaction, and the last repair layer utilizes phosphogypsum base ecological restoration material to fill and carries out soil reconstruction.
assignees: YUNNAN YUNTIANHUA ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD;YUNNAN ZHONGHUAN ZHENGHAO ENVIRONMENTAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network power supply restoration method based on optical storage optimal configuration under extreme disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power control, in particular to a power supply recovery method of a power distribution network based on optical storage optimization configuration under extreme disasters, which comprises the steps of obtaining photovoltaic operation maintenance evaluation parameters, energy storage operation maintenance evaluation parameters, network loss evaluation parameters and load evaluation parameters, and determining a multi-objective optimization function; optimizing the multi-objective optimization function based on photovoltaic power generation constraint and energy storage charge-discharge constraint to obtain an optical storage site selection and volume determination planning model; determining the position and the capacity of photovoltaic and energy storage based on an optical storage site selection and volume determination planning model, and determining an initial island; and recovering power supply based on the result obtained by dynamic island division. According to the invention, a double-layer optimization model comprising optical storage location and volume selection and operation dynamic island division of the power distribution network is constructed, and through iterative optimization of an upper layer and a lower layer, the efficiency is considered in a planning layer, the reliability of power supply recovery of an extreme disaster is considered in an operation layer, and the balance of high-efficiency utilization of power distribution network resources and reliable power supply protection of the extreme disaster load is realized.
assignees: JINAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Ecological restoration plant planting structure of high steep slope
abstract_en: The utility model provides an ecological restoration plant planting structure of a high and steep slope, which comprises a slope body and a leveling layer, wherein the surface of the slope body is provided with the leveling layer, positioning piles are inserted on the leveling layer, and a plurality of steel wires are fixedly connected between the positioning piles. The utility model has the advantages that: the core of this structure is that soil conservation, waterproof soil loss performance are good, it can be matched by steel wire spud pile, the fixed muscle is fixed a position, but the pocket tightly plants the bag, landslide, displacement when preventing its direct laying, the setting of layer is sowed in the spraying, can add a layer of spraying at the surface of planting the bag, by alien soil and grass seed constitution, can further consolidate planting the bag and affiliated structure thereof, steel wire, the spud pile, stock and fixed muscle can be as the interior muscle of layer is sowed in the spraying, firm spud pile and the stock on layer can be firmly ground to the leveling layer to guarantee to spray, prevent that the leveling layer is smooth, spud pile and stock have dual action, can fix a position planting the bag, also can fix soil to the leveling layer.
assignees: LI LIANGNA

title_en: Method and system for scheduling multiple distributed resources before and after disaster in cooperation with each other
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of safe operation of power systems, and discloses a method and a system for scheduling a plurality of distributed resources in coordination with pre-disaster and post-disaster, wherein the method comprises the following steps: based on the coupling information of the traffic network and the power grid, constructing a power supply restoration service framework for pre-disaster pre-dispatching and post-disaster collaborative restoration of various distributed resources; based on a power supply restoration service framework of pre-disaster pre-dispatching and post-disaster cooperative restoration, designing a guiding mechanism of the pre-disaster electric automobile and the electric bus to perform pre-disaster pre-dispatching; and building a post-disaster multi-resource collaborative recovery model according to post-disaster information of the electric automobile and the electric bus, and recovering an electric system by cooperating with the electric automobile, the electric bus, the optical storage bus station and the mobile energy storage. The invention can fully exert the advantages of recovering power supply of different distributed resources after disaster, solves the problem of difficult cooperation of various distributed resources, and provides reference advice for decision-making departments when being applied to various distributed resource scheduling of the power system before and after disaster.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: Fault prediction method and management system of intelligent energy storage power station
abstract_en: The application provides a fault prediction method and a management system of an intelligent energy storage power station, wherein enhanced information is added to a monitoring log, operation state semantic detection is carried out to obtain an operation state semantic detection result, so that monitoring log recovery operation is carried out according to the operation state semantic detection result to obtain a second monitoring log of energy storage power station equipment, and finally fault information corresponding to the monitoring log of the first energy storage power station equipment is determined based on a characteristic information commonality metric value between the two monitoring logs. In other words, based on the mode of performing operation state semantic detection on the first energy storage power station equipment monitoring log to obtain an operation state semantic detection result, the operation state semantic detection result guides the log to perform information restoration, the sequence of data items in the restored log is ensured to be consistent, fault information of the sequence of data items in the first energy storage power station equipment monitoring log is determined by comparing the characteristic information commonality metric value, and the precision and the speed of fault detection of the sequence of data items can be increased.

title_en: Wildfire suppressant and forest damage restoration agent comprising eco-friendly biodegradable soil coagulant
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a wildfire spread suppressing agent and a forest damage restoration agent comprising a biodegradable eco-friendly soil coagulant, wherein the eco-friendly soil coagulant of the present invention comprises starch and nanocellulose, and an aldehyde group of the starch is acetal-crosslinked with the nanocellulose, thereby being non-toxic and biodegradable and capable of absorbing a large amount of water, and thus can function as a wildfire spread suppressing agent and a forest damage restoration agent.
assignees: ASIA NANOTECH CO LTD

title_en: Protecting data against malware attacks using cyber vault and automated airgap control
abstract_en: Improving data recovery and restoration times by clamping down security after malware detection, and protect a data center from a cyber recovery vault. Embodiments provide a cyber recovery vault configured to store data backed up for a production site for long-term retention and disaster recovery. The vault is coupled to the data center comprising a production site through an automated air gap controlled by the vault. Control signals transmitted by the vault trigger the air gap to close the coupling between the vault and data center upon detection of a malware attack, and the data center is configured to listen for the control signals and implement heightened security measures to protect its data in response to the control signal.
assignees: DELL PRODUCTS LP

title_en: Intelligent first-aid repair method for power distribution network faults
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution networks and discloses an intelligent rush-repair method for power distribution network faults. The method comprises the following steps: through combining sensor technology, data analysis and artificial intelligence algorithm, realize the quick detection, location and the restoration to distribution network trouble, include: (1) fault detection and localization: the method comprises the steps of utilizing sensors distributed at all nodes of a power distribution network to monitor parameters such as current, voltage and the like in real time; (2) data transmission and processing: transmitting the data acquired by the sensor to a data center, processing and analyzing the data through a data analysis technology, and identifying the possible fault type and position; (3) intelligent decision: based on the data analysis result, diagnosing and positioning the fault by using an artificial intelligent algorithm, rapidly judging the fault point, and generating an optimal rush-repair scheme; (4) performing rush repair; (5) monitoring and optimizing. The method fully utilizes the sensor technology and the artificial intelligent algorithm, and realizes the rapid and accurate rush repair of the power distribution network faults.
assignees: NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV BAODING

title_en: Ecological restoration method for water and soil conservation of slope surface of barren mountain in western cold and dry region
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water and soil conservation ecological restoration method for a barren mountain slope in a western cold and dry region, which relates to the technical field of water and soil conservation ecological restoration for barren mountain slopes in the western cold and dry region, and aims to solve the problems of ecological weakness and uneven distribution in precipitation years of barren mountain slopes in the cold and dry region, the method effectively utilizes rainwater and ice and snow to melt water, adopts a design mode of water diversion soil ditches, drip pipes and straw grids, slows down the converging flow rate of the rainwater and ice and snow to melt water, reduces the harm of the rainwater and ice and snow to soil erosion, controls water and soil loss or debris flow and stores the slope to be used for recovering vegetation of the slope, builds a mode of retaining ecological self-repairing of the water and soil of the slope of the barren mountain, can reduce flood in mountain areas, prevent water and soil loss of the barren mountain and improve vegetation coverage of the slope of the barren mountain.

title_en: Coal mining subsidence wetland pollution control, carbon fixation and sink increase collaborative restoration method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mining subsidence wetland pollution control, carbon fixation and sink increase collaborative restoration method, which comprises the following steps: construction of a coal mining subsidence wetland sewage treatment water system network and collaborative restoration of pollution control, carbon fixation and sink increase. The method of the invention promotes the research and development of the collaborative restoration technology for pollution control, carbon fixation and carbon increment of the coal mining subsidence wetland, can form engineering demonstration (construction of the coal mining subsidence wetland) in the high-water-level mining area so as to be better popularized and applied, can be popularized and applied to coal resource type cities and old industrial bases in the high-water-level area, and provides theoretical and technical references for the coal resource type cities and old industrial bases in the high-water-level area of China by utilizing the coal mining subsidence wetland to realize the 'double carbon' target.
assignees: UNIV WUXI

title_en: Urban power distribution network participation black start auxiliary service profit and capability assessment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for evaluating the benefits and the capabilities of an urban power distribution network participating in black start auxiliary service, which comprises the following steps: step S1, selecting two black start service market pricing modes, and constructing a black start service market settlement cost model comprising DG operator black start capacity compensation cost, DG operator black start use compensation cost and DG operator black start default reimbursement cost; wherein DG is a distributed power supply; and S2, determining an evaluation index of the black start capability of the distributed power supply for the auxiliary service market, and evaluating the benefits and the capability by adopting the evaluation index. Compared with the prior art, the method fully considers the complexity of the black start power restoration auxiliary service market pricing mode, is beneficial to encouraging operators to improve the black start capability of the unit, and excites the enthusiasm of participating in the black start service.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SHANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Wind power prediction method based on data restoration and residual error correction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power prediction method based on data restoration and residual error correction, which belongs to the field of new energy power prediction, and adopts a variable point grouping method and a noisy density clustering algorithm to detect and clean abnormal values of an original wind power sequence, so that the data quality is improved; the spatial characteristics among a plurality of wind turbines are learned by using a graph convolution neural network of a dynamic adjacency matrix, the time sequence characteristics of a long sequence are learned by using a gating circulation unit, and the turbine output at the future moment is obtained based on the fusion characteristics; and finally, learning an error distribution rule of the predicted power and the actual power at the historical moment by using a multi-layer convolution and multi-head attention mechanism, predicting possible prediction errors at the future moment, and returning to the predicted power obtained by the last step. According to the invention, the asymmetric connection relation between the units is obtained through the dynamic adjacent matrix, so that the method is more in line with the actual situation, the number of parameters is reduced through point-by-point convolution, the running speed and the robustness of the system are improved, and a high-precision prediction result is obtained.
assignees: LIANYUNGANG GANYU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH COMPANY STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Power distribution network fault line restoration method and system considering extreme weather oscillation stage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for repairing a fault line of a power distribution network by considering an extreme weather oscillation stage, and belongs to the field of power system optimization operation; the method comprises the following steps: acquiring power distribution network line information, and acquiring time nodes of an extreme weather final oscillation stage and power distribution network line fault information; constructing constraint conditions of operation of the power distribution network; according to the power distribution network line information, a virtual network with the same topological structure as the original network of the power distribution network is established by combining a single commodity flow method, and a power distribution network reconstruction constraint condition based on the virtual network is obtained; constructing an objective function of a fault line repair model considering generalized resource time scheduling in an extreme weather oscillation stage; establishing constraint conditions of a fault line repair model considering generalized resource time scheduling in an extreme weather oscillation stage; and solving a fault line repair model considering the generalized resource time scheduling in the extreme weather oscillation stage to obtain a generalized maintenance resource time scheduling scheme of the fault line in the extreme weather oscillation stage.
assignees: UNIV NANJING SCI & TECH

title_en: Evaluation method and device for complex electricity effect of distribution network line and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for evaluating complex electricity effect of a distribution network line and electronic equipment. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring fault probability of a unit length of a distribution network line, a power failure area distribution variable and a complex power area distribution variable; determining net rack complex electricity effect of the distribution network circuit based on the fault probability of unit length, the power failure area distribution variable and the complex electricity area distribution variable, wherein the net rack complex electricity effect is used for representing the recovery degree of the distribution network circuit; determining the power restoration success probability of the distribution network line based on the unit length fault probability and the power restoration action times of the power restoration area, wherein the power restoration action times are used for representing the times of the power restoration actions executed by the power supply function in the power restoration area; and carrying out complex electricity effect evaluation on the distribution network line based on the complex electricity success probability and the net rack complex electricity effect to obtain a complex electricity effect evaluation result of the distribution network line. The invention solves the technical problem of high evaluation difficulty of complex electric effect of the distribution network line.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Wind power generation data processing system based on double-flow scoring model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power generation data processing system based on a double-flow scoring model, which comprises a data analysis module, an anomaly detection module, a semi-supervised learning module, a data restoration module and a data summarization module. Firstly, the data characteristic attribute is counted by a data analysis module, the initial abnormal condition of the data is analyzed, the quality of the input data is mastered, then the data points which are obviously normal and obviously abnormal are marked by an abnormality detection module, then the data points which are difficult to mark by a common method are thoroughly classified by a semi-supervised learning module, and after the data are repaired by a data repairing module, the data are assembled into a unified format for the subsequent use of various tasks. The invention aims to remarkably improve the abnormality detection accuracy and efficiency of wind power data by combining semi-supervised learning and advanced data processing technology.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Power transmission network emergency repair and restoration method and device based on mobile power supply
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present invention are a power transmission network emergency repair and restoration method and device based on a mobile power supply. The present application improves the power transmission network fault restoration efficiency by the method: reading a preset power transmission network black start strategy optimization model and parameter data acquired from a power transmission network to be restored, wherein the power transmission network black start strategy optimization model is constructed by setting an emergency repair resource constraint, a power transmission network operation constraint and a power transmission network partition constraint, with the optimization objective of minimizing power transmission network load loss; initializing the power transmission network black start strategy optimization model on the basis of the parameter data, and solving the power transmission network black start strategy optimization model by means of a solver to obtain a mobile power supply arrangement scheme and a unit restoration scheme of said power transmission network; and performing emergency repair on said power transmission network on the basis of the mobile power supply arrangement scheme and the unit restoration scheme. The present application can improve the power transmission network fault restoration efficiency and reduce power outage costs by allocating fault repair resources.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD;ELECTRICAL POWER DISPATCHING & CONTROL CENTER OF GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Supply chain optimization safety system based on artificial intelligence fuzzy test
abstract_en: The invention discloses a supply chain optimization safety system based on an artificial intelligence fuzzy test, which comprises a data acquisition preprocessing module, a risk identification and evaluation module, a fuzzy test generation module, a fuzzy test execution and monitoring module, an anomaly detection and response module, a security hole restoration and optimization module, a real-time monitoring and reporting module, a user authority management and access control module, a supply chain network analysis module, a simulation and optimization module, a continuous learning and improvement module and a block chain integration module.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;INF CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Slope ecological restoration structure of damaged mountain
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of slope restoration, and particularly relates to a slope ecological restoration structure of a damaged mountain. The technology includes concrete layer, the concrete layer has been seted up a plurality of and has been used for planting the logical groove of vegetation, is provided with the manger plate frame that is used for the rainwater to shunt in the logical inslot, is provided with the stock that is used for being connected with the mountain body between the logical groove. According to the utility model, the concrete layer is arranged to facilitate the protection of the mountain surface to avoid landslide, the anchor rod is arranged to facilitate the connection between the concrete layer and the mountain, so that the firmness and stability of the mountain are improved, and the water flowing over the mountain and the soil sliding down are conveniently blocked and split by the arrangement of the water retaining frame, so that the influence on vegetation is conveniently reduced, and the soil erosion caused by direct scouring of the vegetation is conveniently avoided.
assignees: GANNAN TIBETAN AUTONOMOUS PREFECTURE ECOLOGICAL ENV BUREAU

title_en: Interconnected power distribution network distributed power supply recovery method based on marginal duplicate cost
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a distributed power restoration method of an interconnected power distribution network based on marginal duplicate cost, wherein the method comprises the following steps: under the condition that a fault distribution network is included in the distribution system, determining a centralized power supply recovery model; decoupling a plurality of power supply restoration models from the centralized power supply restoration model; determining a first target power supply restoration sub-model of the fault power distribution network based on the first power supply restoration model, and determining second target power supply restoration models of other power distribution networks based on the second power supply restoration model; and determining a power restoration scheme of the power distribution system by using the first target power restoration sub-model and the second target power restoration sub-model in a distributed iteration mode. The application solves the problem that an accurate power supply recovery scheme cannot be generated.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ZHUHAI POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Digital regulation task management flow and execution control method in nuclear power station
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nuclear power digital regulations, and particularly relates to a task management flow and execution control method of a digital regulation in a nuclear power station.
