Establishing a standard flow of a digital procedure task according to a flow of daily work task development in a nuclear power station, wherein the standard flow comprises task approval, task creation, task issuing, task acquisition, pre-job meeting, task execution, post-job meeting, task auditing, task archiving, task suspension/restoration, task handover, task rollback, task revocation and an operation step inapplicability identification function; the method for remote execution control of the digital procedure in the off-line mode comprises the steps of randomly generating an authorization code when the task creation procedure is issued, downloading the authorization code to the mobile terminal along with the task, providing a remote off-line execution control application, acquiring and providing the authorization code, and matching and verifying the authorization code to realize off-line execution control. The invention solves the problem that the task management and execution of the digital regulation in the nuclear power station are not mature and uniform in standard form.
assignees: CNNC NUCLEAR POWER OPERATION MAN CO LTD;CNNC 3RD QINSHAN NUCLEAR POWER CO LTD

title_en: Ballasted track ballast square quantity real-time detection device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for detecting the ballast square quantity of a ballasted track in real time, which belong to the field of track detection of track traffic, and the device and the method for detecting the ballast square quantity of the ballasted track in real time are used for acquiring specific changes of time-space point cloud data of a full section along a railway by integrating a GNSS/DMI system, a mobile three-dimensional laser scanner module, an AI module and other devices through an advanced mobile laser image and AI technology, so that the ballast square quantity in different areas of the section of the track is calculated in real time, the technical effects of high-efficiency and high-precision railway detection are achieved, and the device and the method have the advantages of high detection efficiency, high three-dimensional scene restoration and the like, and have important significance for supporting railway operation decisions and disaster early warning.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY MATERIALS GENERAL OPERATION AND MAINTENANCE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ecological integrity-based water ecological health evaluation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological health evaluation method based on ecological integrity and application thereof, wherein an evaluation index system is divided into a target layer, a criterion layer, an element layer and an index layer, different types of indexes are subjected to differential standard determination method based on ecological integrity, a core index is subjected to quantitative and qualitative analysis by adopting a method combining an entropy weight method and a analytic hierarchy process, and finally the health condition of an water ecological system is displayed in a pattern marking and color partition mode which is easy to understand. In conclusion, the method can comprehensively, scientifically and accurately evaluate the health state of the water ecological system, is beneficial to promoting the water ecological assessment, and provides scientific basis for water ecological management and restoration.

title_en: Power grid power failure and restoration monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid power failure and restoration monitoring system and a method, wherein the power grid comprises a plurality of power supply lines, and the power grid power failure and restoration monitoring system comprises: the power grid state acquisition module and the power outage/restoration determination module are used for acquiring power grid states; the power grid state acquisition module is in communication connection with the power outage/restoration determination module; the power grid state acquisition module is used for acquiring the power supply state of each power supply line and sending the power supply state to the power outage/restoration determination module; the power supply state comprises a power failure state and a power restoration state; the power failure/power restoration determining module is used for determining that the power supply line fails when the power supply state is a power failure state and sending a notification of the power failure of the power supply line; and when the power supply state is the power restoration state, determining power restoration of the power supply line and sending a notification of the power restoration of the power supply line. According to the technical scheme, the power grid outage/restoration information can be timely sent to the client, and satisfaction degree of the client on power grid service is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;MEIZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power grid duplicate decision generation method and system based on knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid duplicate decision generation method and system based on a knowledge graph. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: in response to a power grid failure, power grid operation data of the power grid and a power grid structure are obtained, wherein the power grid structure comprises at least one of the following: a centralized power generation grid, a distributed power generation grid; generating a target complex electricity decision map corresponding to a power grid structure, wherein the target complex electricity decision map is used for representing the relationship between a plurality of complex electricity strategy influence elements and a plurality of complex electricity strategy influence elements in the power grid, and the plurality of complex electricity strategy influence elements are used for representing elements influencing the complex electricity operation of the power grid; and processing the power grid operation data based on the target power restoration decision map to obtain a power restoration strategy of the power grid, wherein the power restoration strategy is used for representing a strategy adopted for restoring the power grid to a normal operation state. The invention solves the technical problem of lower generation efficiency of the power grid double-electricity strategy in the related technology.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ZHUHAI POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method, system and equipment for recovering faults of power distribution network under new energy access
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and equipment for recovering faults of a power distribution network under new energy access, which relate to the technical field of power distribution network control and comprise the following steps: generating a pre-reconstruction scheme set according to the operation experience of reconstruction after the power distribution network faults, constructing a double-time section power flow calculation equation for obtaining new energy access to the lower power distribution network, calculating the distribution network power flow and node voltage under the double-time section at the initial stage and the later stage of recovery for each reconstruction scheme, calculating the evaluation values of the corresponding schemes according to the distribution network power flow and the node voltage under each reconstruction scheme, sorting the evaluation values, wherein the scheme with the minimum evaluation value is the current optimal particles, carrying out mutation operation on the current optimal particles to obtain variant particles, and replacing the particles with higher evaluation values in the sorting by the variant particles to obtain the optimal scheme for the power distribution network faults reconstruction. The invention ensures that the selected reconstruction scheme can meet the voltage safety constraint of the distribution network in the whole process of power restoration, and avoids power restoration failure caused by incapability of grid connection and power shortage of distributed new energy.
assignees: UNIV HEBEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Novel ecological flexible retaining wall constructed by improved expansive soil
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel ecological flexible retaining wall constructed by improved expansive soil, which comprises a foundation built by the improved expansive soil, a wall body, a water drain hole, a geocell, geotechnical cloth and a planting platform. Compacting and filling the foundation by using improved expansive soil; the wall body is filled with improved expansive soil in a layered manner and is provided with a water discharge hole; the expansive soil is improved by mixing sodium silicate (Na  2 SiO 3 ), polyacrylamide (PAM) and sisal fiber; the geocell is vertically embedded in the wall body; laying the geotechnical water distribution halving layer, wherein one end of the geotechnical water distribution halving layer is paved on the rear wall to fill soil, and the other end of the geotechnical water distribution halving layer is connected with the geotechnical grid chamber in the wall body in a hot melt manner to be anchored; the planting platforms are arranged outside the wall body (wall surface) in a layered mode and used for greening plant growth. The utility model can be used for supporting road embankment side slope and ecological restoration field, uses local expansive soil as filling material, has the advantages of ecological environment protection, cost saving and good supporting property, and has good anti-seismic performance in earthquake areas.
assignees: UNIV GUILIN ELECTRONIC TECH

title_en: New energy-based power utilization rush-repair analysis method for topology of under-construction power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power consumption rush-repair analysis method of a constructed power distribution network topology based on new energy, which comprises the steps of loading running power grid topology grid frame data before failure; when a fault occurs, determining a fault influence range and the number of influencing users; the method comprises the steps of obtaining latest electronic handover single item information of a station area in a fault influence range, and importing sections of fault feeder lines into running state power grid topology grid frame data to obtain building state power grid topology grid frame data; selecting an optimal access scheme by a rush-repair simulation method, and accessing a standby power supply as a power point into the topology grid frame data of the power grid in a building state to obtain the topology grid frame data of the power grid in a quasi-running state; based on the power grid topological net frame data of the quasi-running state power grid, simulating the power-off and restoration operation of the rush-repair, and after the rush-repair is completed, the standby power supply is withdrawn from the access and restored to the power grid topological net frame data of the running state power grid. The invention solves the problems of low efficiency, long rush-repair time, insufficient personnel safety guarantee and the like of the traditional power utilization rush-repair mode by means of manual field investigation.
assignees: XIAMEN HERETOP INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Heavy metal polluted water area restoration evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heavy metal polluted water area restoration evaluation method and system, in particular to the field of heavy metal polluted water area restoration evaluation systems, which comprises a data acquisition module for acquiring water area data, the data acquisition module is electrically connected with a data analysis module for analyzing and acquiring data information, and the data analysis module is electrically connected with a recording module for recording treatment data information and a treatment module for designing a new treatment scheme. According to the invention, the data acquisition module is used for acquiring water in the water area, the data analysis module is used for analyzing the water, so that whether pollution can be repaired after the polluted water area passes through treatment can be checked, meanwhile, the recording module is used for recording an initial treatment scheme which can be repaired, the treatment module is used for collecting data information and formulating other treatment schemes according to the data information, and secondary treatment is carried out on the treated water area, so that progressive treatment effect is achieved, and water area repair is more perfect.
assignees: SHENZHEN GREEN CENTURY ENVIRONMENTAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Correlation analysis method and system based on structured multidimensional scheduling behavior
abstract_en: The invention discloses a correlation analysis method and a correlation analysis system based on a structured multidimensional scheduling behavior, which are characterized in that data are collected from a data source, preprocessing operation is carried out, corresponding labels are automatically matched with system collected data according to keywords in the collected data content, and business information of different sources is classified and organized; constructing a multidimensional scheduling behavior model in a system; inputting the acquired data into a system for data analysis to form an event model, and timely prompting when the event model is different from a multidimensional scheduling behavior model constructed by an administrator; and excavating the association relation among behaviors, and connecting single behaviors in series according to the correlation of the behavior attributes to form a complete behavior joint debugging. The method can analyze and correlate scheduling behaviors of different dimensions in the power grid outage and restoration scene more conveniently, and the analysis can help us to understand the internal relation between data better and provide more accurate basis for decision.
assignees: GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Evaluation method for ecological drought and waterlogging in alpine plateau region by considering vegetation restoration force
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for evaluating ecological drought and waterlogging in a alpine plateau region by considering vegetation restoration force, which belongs to the technical field of disaster evaluation and comprises the following steps: constructing an improved distributed hydrological model WEP; extracting a water source which is effective for vegetation growth in precipitation of a source area, evaluating water supply branches of slope vegetation, and calculating ecological water supply of the source area; introducing a vegetation ecological system restoring force theory, calculating a slope vegetation month scale ecological water demand elastic interval, and evaluating ecological water demand considering vegetation restoring force; according to the ecological water supply quantity of the source area and the ecological water demand taking the vegetation restoration force into consideration, obtaining the quantitative evaluation and grading result of ecological drought and waterlogging of the slope vegetation in the river basin based on the slope vegetation supply and demand water balance relation; and (3) obtaining synchronous evolution characteristics of slope vegetation drought and waterlogging in time and space by using a clustering algorithm of three-dimensional drought and waterlogging identification, and finishing evaluation of ecological drought and waterlogging in the alpine plateau region. The invention solves the problem that the current ecological drought and waterlogging index can not reflect the vegetation supply and demand balance.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Power supply restoration strategy determination method, device and equipment of comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a device and equipment for determining a power supply restoration strategy of a comprehensive energy system. The method comprises the following steps: under the condition that the fault distribution transformer area exists in the comprehensive energy system, obtaining transformer area operation constraint of the fault distribution transformer area, branch constraint of a coupling branch of the fault distribution transformer area and switch operation constraint of an intelligent soft switch based on the current topological structure of the fault distribution transformer area; constructing a load recovery loss function of the fault distribution transformer area according to load information of loads in the fault distribution transformer area and operation information of the intelligent soft switch; and solving the load recovery loss function according to the operation constraint of the transformer area, the branch constraint, the operation constraint of the switch and the control mode of the intelligent soft switch by taking the minimum function value of the load recovery loss function as a target, and determining the power supply recovery strategies of the fault distribution transformer area in different time periods. By adopting the method, the power supply recovery efficiency of the fault distribution transformer area in the comprehensive energy system during the fault period can be improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Abnormality identification method and system for power dispatching overhaul opinions
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anomaly identification method and system for power dispatching maintenance opinions, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly collecting dispatching behavior data related to power outage and power restoration, establishing an association rule between a power outage and power restoration event and dispatching behavior through an association analysis method, then extracting power equipment state information and maintenance information in a maintenance list through a natural language processing method to form an error prevention condition, finally judging whether the current dispatching behavior accords with safety constraint according to the association rule and the error prevention condition, alarming the abnormal dispatching behavior and taking corresponding countermeasures; the invention can solve the problems of associated analysis and error prevention of the scheduling behavior in the power system power failure and power restoration scene, and effectively improves the safety and stability of the power system.
assignees: GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for realizing strong consistency synchronization of elastic search cluster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for realizing strong consistency synchronization of an elastic search cluster, wherein the method comprises the following steps: writing data into a main partition of a main index to which a document belongs, after the data is written successfully, sending a writing request to a node where the main partition of a slave index to which the document belongs is located, simultaneously regarding the main partition of the slave index as a remote copy of the main partition of the main index, and writing the data into the remote copy to realize real-time data synchronization; the main fragment of the main index sends the segment file which is stored and dropped to the remote copy, and analyzes the storage information of the actual data in the segment file; and the main shard of the main index sends translog logs storing the non-dropped disk to the remote copy, so that the remote copy is restored to a data state consistent with the main shard, and the historical data restoration is realized. The method and the device copy the index in the remote cluster to the local cluster, and ensure the strong consistency of the master-slave data, thereby providing high availability and quick disaster recovery capability and realizing uninterrupted inter-cluster index migration.
assignees: ZHONGYING YOUCHUANG INF TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network fault training evaluation method based on artificial intelligent model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution network fault training, and discloses a power distribution network fault training evaluation method based on an artificial intelligent model, which comprises the steps of establishing a power restoration speed actual information array, a power restoration speed standard information array, a resource allocation actual information array, a resource allocation standard information array, a preventive measure actual information array, a preventive measure standard information array, a decision quality actual information array, a decision quality standard information array, a risk assessment actual information array and a risk assessment standard information array, and a comprehensive evaluation index of the power restoration speed, a comprehensive evaluation index of the resource allocation, a comprehensive evaluation index of the preventive measure, a comprehensive evaluation index of the decision quality and a comprehensive evaluation index of the risk evaluation are established, the comprehensive evaluation index is calculated to obtain a comprehensive score, a plurality of key aspects of a dispatcher in fault processing are comprehensively considered, the learning degree and the operation effect of the dispatcher are evaluated, and the stability and the power supply reliability of the whole power grid system are improved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Data management device and DR cost calculation support method
abstract_en: To provide a data management device for supporting operation by calculating cost at the time of a disaster of the volume of a DR site of a virtual environment, and a DR cost calculation support method.SOLUTION: A data management device being a restoration support device includes a DR operation phase determination part for executing DR operation phase determination processing on the basis of a copy situation table for managing copy configuration information for managing a pair configuration of an object task use volume and a copy volume, and copy situations in the object task use volume and the copy volume in acquiring object task specification information for specifying an object task, and a disaster correspondence cost calculation part for calculating a usage fee of a DR site of a cloud environment until calculating a disaster pattern corresponding to a disaster situation of the volume of an affected disaster object in accordance with the calculated operation phase and completing a system recovery of a use site with a use volume created from a fault occurrence in each disaster pattern.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: HITACHI VANTARA LTD

title_en: Ecological restoration method for silt powder beach
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological restoration, in particular to an ecological restoration method of silt muddy beach of silt, which comprises the steps of firstly obtaining bird data, knowing ecological habits of birds, including inhabitation, foraging and safety factors, and further investigating habitat requirements of the birds, wherein the inhabitation and foraging have certain requirements on ecological factors, including water areas, vegetation, food and matrixes in areas, predators serving as interference factors influence safety of target species, and finally carrying out micro-topography restoration on restoration areas by adopting control of slope releasing angles, three-level tidal ditch modeling, vegetation restoration and three kinds of piled islands according to investigation data. According to the invention, through the technical means, the silt beach of the silt powder is divided into the vegetation restoration area and the light beach area, so that the dual promotion of biodiversity and water quality purification is realized, meanwhile, the planted vegetation can play the function of preventing moisture and resisting waves, the ecological disaster reduction function is realized, and the stability of an ecological system is further improved.
assignees: CHINA DESIGN GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Processing method, device, equipment and storage medium of power data
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for processing electric power data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical power data, and displaying data points corresponding to the historical power data on a preset interface; the data points include unknown data points that are not automatically identified as anomalies; responding to the selection operation of the unknown data point, and processing the abnormal power value of the unknown data point to obtain historical power data after the abnormal processing of the unknown data point; and carrying out electric quantity consumption prediction based on the historical electric power data after the unknown data point is processed abnormally, so as to obtain an electric quantity predicted value. By giving technicians data manipulation capability and performing functional operation of a related visual interface, based on selection operation of response to the displayed unknown data points, the abnormal power values of the unknown data points are replaced, visual restoration of the data is realized, and therefore a power data model is optimized, and further efficiency and accuracy of power energy management are improved.
assignees: GREE ELECTRIC APPLIANCES INC ZHUHAI;GUOCHUANG ENERGY INTERNET INNOVATION CENTER GUANGDONG CO LTD

title_en: Turning sowing device for ecological restoration of slope surface of mine storage yard
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological restoration equipment, in particular to a turning sowing device for slope ecological restoration of a mine storage yard, which comprises a telescopic suspension arm, a turning sowing mechanism and two groups of roller mechanisms, wherein the telescopic suspension arm is used for providing power for movement of the turning sowing mechanism and the roller mechanisms, the telescopic suspension arm is connected with the turning sowing mechanism, the turning sowing mechanism is used for carrying out turning sowing treatment on soil on the slope, the two groups of roller mechanisms are respectively arranged at two sides of the turning sowing mechanism, a plow blade turns the soil and forms a groove, a discharge pipe directly feeds seeds and other additives into the groove, the seeds are ensured to be positioned in the soil, the condition that the seeds are dried or eaten by animals due to wind and insolation is avoided, the survival rate of the seeds is improved, and meanwhile, the root system can penetrate through the soil deeply along with plant growth, so that the stability of the soil is enhanced, and the occurrence of water and soil loss and geological disasters is effectively prevented.

title_en: Intelligent management and operation guarantee system for marine ecological protection and repair
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent management and operation guarantee system for marine ecological protection and repair, which relates to the technical field of marine ecology and comprises a monitoring module, an evaluation module, a data analysis and prediction module, an intelligent decision and support module, a resource scheduling and management module and a safety management and emergency response module. The marine ecological data can be collected in real time through the monitoring module, including information such as water quality, temperature, salinity, etc., the efficiency and the accuracy of monitoring are improved, help in time discover ecological problems, the evaluation module analyzes ecological state according to the monitoring data, evaluate threat and risk that the ecology faces, provide scientific basis for formulating corresponding protection and restoration strategy, data analysis and prediction module utilizes machine learning technology to process data, generate prediction model, provide scientific support for the decision, make the decision more intelligent and accurate, resource scheduling and management module intelligently distributes resources according to demand and priority, ensure smooth going on of protection and restoration work.
assignees: SHANGHAI MIAORUI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Evaluation method for ecological restoration effect of side slope of pumped storage power station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating the ecological restoration effect of a side slope of a pumped storage power station, which specifically comprises the following steps: step one: acquiring an initial ecological environment image near a pumped storage power station to be built by adopting an unmanned aerial vehicle, acquiring a damaged slope ecological environment image after the pumped storage power station is built, further determining an ecological restoration implementation range, and setting a subsequent flight area, a route and a navigation period of the unmanned aerial vehicle; step two: the invention relates to the technical field of ecological restoration and evaluation of a side slope, and discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle for shooting vegetation in a pumped storage power station range by using a sensor and through an oblique photography technology and an orthographic photography technology. According to the evaluation method for the ecological restoration effect of the side slope of the pumped storage power station, the ecological restoration condition of the side slope is evaluated by establishing an evaluation method matched with the ecological restoration of the side slope, a specific restoration plan can be appointed for a specific area according to an evaluation result, the restoration difficulty is reduced, and the restoration efficiency is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;STATE GRID XINYUAN COMPANY LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Abnormal moment power restoration method and system based on multiple photovoltaic stations
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric power energy, and comprises the steps of collecting data of similar power stations at the moment to be repaired and obtaining geographic coordinates of each photovoltaic power station; determining a photovoltaic power station with similar weather conditions, and determining the similar power station by adopting a fuzzy clustering algorithm for improving the similarity; and establishing an offline data correction model, and inputting clustering result data of a similar power station as a training sample into the data correction model for correction to obtain a measured power data correction result at the moment to be corrected. According to the method, the accuracy of the identification of the similar power station is improved by comprehensively considering the similarity identification method of the distance correlation degree and the curve shape correlation degree; meanwhile, by constructing a data prediction model based on the deep neural network, accurate correction of actual measurement power at the moment to be repaired is realized, and the output stability and reliability of the photovoltaic power generation system are improved.
assignees: NANJING GUODIAN NANZI VALMET AUTOMATION CO LTD

title_en: Scene self-adaptive fault first-aid repair scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a scene self-adaptive fault repair scheduling method and system, which relate to the technical field of fault detection and comprise the following steps: the method comprises the steps of monitoring the running state of a target power grid in real time, identifying a plurality of running fault scene parameters, performing fault detection, traversing a fault detection data set, determining a plurality of fault points, evaluating the plurality of fault points, generating a fault rush-repair scheduling scheme, performing dynamic feedback and self-adaptive adjustment, and generating a fault rush-repair scheduling optimization scheme. The application can solve the technical problem of low fault first-aid repair efficiency caused by complex and changeable power grid fault conditions and lack of a dynamic feedback mechanism in the prior art, and the generated fault first-aid repair scheduling scheme is dynamically fed back and adaptively adjusted by integrating multiple data sources for real-time monitoring, so that the technical effect of improving the power grid fault first-aid repair efficiency is achieved.

title_en: Data preprocessing method applied to intelligent operation platform of large hydropower station
abstract_en: A data preprocessing method applied to a large hydropower station intelligent operation platform introduces a data cleaning model based on a particle swarm optimization two-way long-short-term memory neural network model into the intelligent operation platform data preprocessing function, and realizes reconstruction and repair of 'missing values' or 'abnormal values' in an original monitoring data sequence. Firstly, carrying out iterative optimization on key parameters (m and epsilon) of a two-way long-short-term memory neural network model by utilizing a particle swarm optimization algorithm, then judging whether the data in the characteristic data of the test set is a normal value or an abnormal value or a missing value according to a threshold value P, and finally constructing a PSO-BiLSTM combined model to clean the abnormal value or the missing value in the data of the test set, so that reconstruction and restoration of the missing value and the abnormal value are realized, the information of an initial data sequence is restored to the greatest extent, and reliable data quality is provided for judging the health condition of equipment in real time.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Topology archive restoration method, device, equipment and medium based on marketing and distribution data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grids, and discloses a topology archive restoration method based on marketing and distribution data, which comprises the following steps: inquiring whether the message subscription platform contains updated data or not based on the marketing and configuration data linkage requirement; when the update data exists in the message subscription platform, acquiring data corresponding to the theme from the message subscription platform based on the theme of the update data to obtain target marketing and configuration data; decompressing the target marketing and distribution data to obtain decompressed data, and decrypting the decompressed data to obtain decrypted marketing and distribution data; restoring the decrypted marketing and distribution data based on a restoring method to obtain restored marketing and distribution data; and identifying whether the inconsistency exists in the user-variable topology file by using the real-time power failure data in the restoration marketing data, and repairing the user-variable topology file when the inconsistency exists. The invention also provides a topology archive restoration device, equipment and storage medium based on the marketing and distribution data. The invention can improve the operation efficiency of the power system.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Computation of preemptive ranked resiliency measures, including preemptive placement and real-time dispatch of distributed energy resources, using probabilistic optimization for enhanced operational resilience of a power system
abstract_en: When an extreme weather event is forecast, an operator of a power system will typically prepare reactive measures, to facilitate the restoration of the power system after it has been damaged by the event. Disclosed embodiments utilize probabilistic optimization to identify and rank resiliency measures in advance of such an event, such that proactive measures may be implemented before the event, to increase the operational resilience of the power system during the event. This enables the power system to better withstand and recover more quickly from the event, thereby reducing downtime (e.g., power outages) and costs. In an embodiment, these resiliency measures include the preemptive placement and/or dispatch of distributed energy resources, with accompanying network-switch optimization, within the power system. This preemptive placement and/or dispatch may use a risk-driven optimal power flow model that accounts for the criticality of loads and the failure probability of power lines.
assignees: HITACHI ENERGY LTD

title_en: Greening side slope drainage structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of slope restoration, and discloses a greening slope drainage structure which comprises a top drainage groove arranged at the top of a slope and arranged along the length direction of the slope, wherein a bottom drainage groove arranged along the length direction of the slope is arranged at the bottom of the slope, an inward concave rough filtering groove is formed above one side, close to the top drainage groove, of the bottom drainage groove, a stabilizing plate is fixedly connected above one side, close to the bottom drainage groove, of the rough filtering groove, and a rough filtering mechanism is arranged on one side, far away from the bottom drainage groove, of the stabilizing plate. According to the invention, greening repair and installation are rapidly carried out on the side slope, the side slope repair efficiency is improved, the operation difficulty of repair personnel is reduced, the impact force of surface rainwater on the side slope is reduced, the damage degree of the side slope due to the impact of the rainwater is reduced, the side slope landslide condition is effectively prevented, the side slope rainwater can be collected, reverse water supply is carried out on green planting of the side slope during drought, the side slope rainwater is filtered and separated, sediment is separated and isolated, maintenance personnel is reminded to clean the sediment in time, and the cleaning operation is convenient.
assignees: SICHUAN YANJIANG PANNING EXPRESSWAY CO LTD;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Method and system for solving airport station interruption under air-iron intermodal cooperation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of air-iron intermodal transportation, in particular to a method and a system for solving the problem of airport station interruption under the cooperation of air-iron intermodal transportation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step one, acquiring an interrupted airport, an airport flight recovery time period, affected flights, flight information and available high-speed rail train section information; step two, establishing an aircraft recovery model based on air-iron intermodal transportation; the aircraft restoration model comprises an aircraft restoration objective function and constraint conditions; the aircraft recovery objective function is the minimum cost of aircraft recovery, and the constraint conditions are airport capacity and passenger balance; step three, optimizing an aircraft recovery model according to whether the influence of subsequent flights is considered; step four, solving an aircraft recovery model by utilizing a Lagrangian heuristic algorithm; step five, determining an airport station interruption solution; the system is adapted to perform the steps of the method described above. And the good surface communication network is fully utilized through air-rail intermodal transportation cooperation, so that the cost of flight recovery is reduced.
assignees: UNIV CIVIL AVIATION CHINA

title_en: Method and apparatus for regulating and controlling energy stored by power distribution network in participating in power supply restoration of loads in disaster area, terminal device, and storage medium
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present invention are a method and apparatus for regulating and controlling energy stored by a power distribution network in participating in power supply restoration of loads in a disaster area, a terminal device, and a storage medium. The method comprises: on the basis of acquired typhoon disaster area data, power distribution network state data and power distribution network energy storage data, constructing a disaster area load power supply restoration optimization model with the objectives of minimizing a disaster area power distribution network frequency deviation and power distribution network energy storage frequency modulation power, and constructing a stationary energy storage station power constraint, a mobile energy storage vehicle power constraint, a grid-connected point voltage constraint, and an active power exchange constraint; under the constructed constraints, solving for the disaster area load power supply restoration optimization model, so as to generate the proportion of loads borne by the energy stored by a power distribution network when the disaster area power distribution network frequency deviation and the power distribution network energy storage frequency modulation power are minimum; and on the basis of the proportion of the loads borne by the energy stored by the power distribution network, performing regulation and control again on the energy stored by the power distribution network in participating in power supply restoration of the loads in a disaster area. By implementing the present invention, the energy stored by the power distribution network in participating in power supply restoration of the loads in the disaster area is regulated and controlled.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD;ELECTRICAL POWER DISPATCHING & CONTROL CENTER OF GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power data privacy protection and restoration method and device based on federal learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a federal learning-based power data privacy protection restoration method and device, and belongs to the field of incomplete power data restoration of power grids. Wherein the device comprises a server and N client devices; the method comprises the following steps: s1: initializing a server federal learning module; s2: initializing a client device; s3: transmitting the partial hidden characteristic matrix data and the linear deviation to all client devices; s4: receiving incomplete power load data; s5: calculating an approximate power load data matrix by using a tensor implicit characteristic decomposition method; s6: mixing and filling incomplete power load data for multiple times; s7: updating parameters of the client device and calculating federal learning gradient data; s8: transmitting federal learning gradient data to a server; s9: updating a server; s10: and iterating until all client devices complete data recovery under privacy protection. The method can ensure that the recovery of the power data can be accurately realized under the protection of privacy.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST;STATE GRID ENERGY RES INST CO LTD;ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID QIANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Geological environment treatment and ecological restoration method for abandoned mine
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a geological governance and ecological restoration method for abandoned mines, and belongs to the technical field of mine geological disaster governance and ecological environment restoration. The geological environment treatment and ecological restoration method for the abandoned mine comprises the following steps: performing current situation investigation on the abandoned mine to obtain investigation results; the presence survey includes: geological, environmental and ecological aspects; designing a geological governance scheme for survey results of the geological aspects in the current situation survey; designing an environmental governance scheme for a survey result of the environmental aspect in the current situation survey; an ecological restoration scheme is designed for the results of the ecological aspects in the current situation survey. Solves the problems of geological treatment and ecological restoration of abandoned mines.
assignees: ENERGY SAVING AND ENVIRONMENTAL PROT CO LTD MCC GROUP;CENTRAL RES INST BUILDING & CONSTR CO LTD MCC GROUP

title_en: Two-stage restoration algorithm for elastic restoration of power distribution system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a two-stage recovery algorithm for elastic recovery of a power distribution system, which relates to the technical field of power failure recovery methods of power distribution systems, wherein a recovery network is formed in a first stage, the maximum aggregate load capacity recovered in a power distribution network is taken as an objective function, and a power grid model is established by taking constraints of switching devices and power balance constraints into consideration; optimizing the operation of the network in the second stage, taking the aggregate load capacity maximization as an objective function, and establishing a local optimal power flow model by taking constraint conditions such as a switch variable constraint, a power flow constraint, a voltage stabilizer constraint, a capacitor constraint and the like into consideration, thereby developing a distributed optimization algorithm; finally, the model is solved by using simulation software. The two-stage recovery algorithm for elastic recovery of the power distribution system disclosed by the invention increases the elasticity of single-point faults, reduces situation awareness requirements, realizes autonomy by using a distributed algorithm, and reduces the calculation cost compared with a centralized optimal power flow solution.
assignees: DONGFANG ELECTRONICS CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Evaluation method for ecological restoration effect of side slope of pumping and storing power station
abstract_en: The invention relates to a slope ecological restoration effect evaluation method of a pumping and storage station, which comprises the following steps: constructing an ecological restoration effect evaluation index system; constructing an ecological restoration effect evaluation index set based on an ecological restoration effect evaluation index system, dividing the evaluation results of the evaluation indexes into a plurality of grades and constructing an evaluation grade set; the ecological restoration effect of the side slope of the pumping power storage station is evaluated through an ecological restoration effect evaluation index system, and the weight of each evaluation index in the ecological restoration effect evaluation index system is calculated through an entropy method based on the evaluation result, so that an evaluation index weight set is obtained; and constructing a fuzzy relation matrix of each evaluation index corresponding to each evaluation grade in the evaluation grade set, and carrying out multistage fuzzy comprehensive evaluation on the comprehensive evaluation index weight set and the fuzzy relation matrix to obtain an evaluation conclusion of the current pumping power storage station slope.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV FUZHOU

title_en: Elevator/electric vehicle charging/power supply control system and elevator/electric vehicle charging/power supply control method
abstract_en: To smoothly perform temporary restoration of an elevator by supplying power to the elevator by using an electric vehicle during charging or an electric vehicle for power supply instead of the electric vehicle during charging when electric outage of a building occurs during charging of the electric vehicle.SOLUTION: An elevator/electric vehicle charging/power supply control system equipped with a hybrid electric vehicle charging facility which supplies power to an elevator by either a commercial power supply or an electric vehicle inquires of a dedicated application of a user smartphone of a user who owns the electric vehicle during charging whether or not power can be supplied to the elevator, and connects the electric vehicle for power supply to the hybrid electric vehicle charging facility when the user does not permit power supply to the elevator. Thus, a change request of a parking position of the electric vehicle is notified to the dedicated application of the user smartphone.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: HITACHI BUILDING SYST CO LTD

title_en: Correlation method and system of power grid data model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a correlation method of a power grid data model, which relates to the technical field of power grids, and comprises the steps of establishing a data construction model of a power grid, and processing the power grid data according to the constructed model; and detecting the processed data based on the processing result, performing vulnerability optimization restoration on the detected result, and constructing a power grid data model association system. The invention realizes the intelligent monitoring and comprehensive management of the running state of the power grid, and has the advantages of realizing the automatic processing and intelligent analysis of the power grid data, effectively improving the efficiency and reliability of the power grid management and reducing the labor cost and the maintenance cost. In addition, through the full utilization of historical data and effective treatment of abnormal conditions, the potential faults can be timely early-warned and quickly repaired, the safe and stable operation of the power system is finally ensured, and powerful support is provided for sustainable development of power supply.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Pollution prevention and control method for ion type rare earth green exploitation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ion type rare earth green exploitation pollution control method, which comprises the following steps: determining mining area boundaries and ecosystem classifications using the topography measurements and the remote sensing images; calculating an ecological restoration rate based on the NDVI data, constructing an environment accommodation quantity model, and determining the exploitation quantity; analyzing hydrologic conditions by using a hydrogeologic model and a GIS technology, and optimizing exploration network; establishing a hydrological response model, and optimizing a liquid injection and collection system; using numerical simulation to prevent landslide, and setting an early warning threshold value; the integrated exploitation control system realizes real-time monitoring and early warning; and (3) carrying out ecological restoration and tail water treatment after ore closing by adopting a zonal liquid injection technology. According to the invention, through calculation of the exploitation quantity, analysis and display of the spatial variation rule of the rare earth ore resources, the arrangement of the liquid injection project and the liquid collection project is guided, the leaching mother liquor leakage is reduced while the leaching rate and the recovery rate of the rare earth resources are improved, the influence on the groundwater environment is reduced, the water balance in the production of mining areas is ensured, and the pollution is controllable.
assignees: CHANGTING BRANCH OF ZHONGXI FUJIAN RARE EARTH MINING CO LTD

title_en: Linear shortest path indexing method on large-scale multi-attribute road traffic network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a linear shortest path indexing method applied to a large-scale multi-attribute road traffic network, which comprises the following steps: carrying out graph partitioning on the road network graph, and establishing linear astronomical line indexes in the partitions; index construction is carried out based on tree partitions; accelerating index construction by using a convex hull merging and multi-level partition method; shortest path query and path restoration are performed on the basis of a given preference vector. The invention can carry out shortest path inquiry on the multi-price road map according to arbitrary linear attribute weight distribution, and recommends paths according to different preferences of people.
assignees: TIANJIN UNIV HEFEI INNOVATION DEVELOPMENT RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Intelligent data protection method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster recovery processing of electric digital data, in particular to an intelligent data protection method and system, which are characterized in that the predicted access frequency of each target data is firstly predicted through data attribute and access frequency records, then the recovery priority of each target data is obtained by further combining comprehensive consideration of the predicted access frequency, the preset priority and the data quantity, and then the data in a cache data center is updated by utilizing the recovery priority of the target data, so that the latest and most important data can be dynamically cached in the cache data center. Therefore, by utilizing the characteristic that the data recovery speed of the cache data center is higher than that of the disaster recovery backup data center, important data can be recovered in priority through the cache data center rapidly when a disaster occurs, so that basic or hot business functions can be recovered rapidly, loss caused to enterprises is reduced, and the problem that the business functions cannot be recovered rapidly due to low data recovery speed in the prior art is solved perfectly.
assignees: SHENZHEN FEICHUANGYUN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Groundwater quality maintenance capability assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a groundwater quality maintenance capability assessment method, which comprises the following steps: A. acquiring data related to the tolerance of underground water; B. acquiring data related to the groundwater restoration capacity; C. and (5) evaluating the quality maintaining capacity of the underground water. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the invention considers the tolerance capability and the recovery capability of the groundwater environment system, and evaluates the groundwater quality maintenance capability more scientifically. Compared with an evaluation method which simply depends on microorganism data, the evaluation method is more systematic, more scientific, more reasonable and more practical, and can provide powerful support for groundwater development and utilization and protection; the invention quantifies the quality maintenance capability of underground water, so that dynamic early warning becomes possible; in addition, the method has the advantages of small data volume requirement and small data acquisition difficulty, and can be applied under different complex hydrogeological conditions.
assignees: SICHUAN ACADEMY OF ENV SCIENCES;SICHUAN GANZI ECOLOGICAL ENV MONITORING CENTER STATION;UNIV CHENGDU INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY;UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Method, system and equipment for optimizing power restoration and supply of key areas under typhoon disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, in particular to a method, a system and equipment for optimizing power restoration in a key region under typhoon disasters, which comprise the steps of obtaining the probability of cascade power failure of a key power supply region by analyzing the risk of a failure event of a power tie line of the key power supply region in a typhoon influence region so as to calculate and obtain the cascade power failure load loss power of the key power supply region under typhoon influence; and constructing a cascade power failure event power restoration optimization model of the key power supply area by taking the maximum key power supply area load loss restoration power supply power as an optimization target, and solving by utilizing an immune particle swarm optimization-based regular extreme learning machine optimization algorithm to obtain the cascade power failure event load power loss restoration power of the key power supply area. According to the invention, the grid-losing load compound electric power in the cascade power failure of the key power supply area can be rapidly and accurately obtained by adopting an immune particle swarm optimization-based regular extreme learning machine optimization algorithm, so that necessary technical support is provided for safe and stable operation of the power system.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network recovery control method and system with uncertain event adaptability
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network recovery control method and system with uncertain event adaptability, wherein the method and system determine the running states of stations and equipment in a target power distribution network according to the acquired running information, and determine power failure scene information; determining whether to start, end or update judgment information for optimizing a restoration scheme of the global power distribution network or a restoration scheme of the local power distribution network, and whether to suspend execution of the restoration scheme of the global power distribution network or the restoration scheme of the local power distribution network; performing operation mode optimization adjustment on a charged area of the target power distribution network, wherein the power supply of the charged area is recovered; performing online global restoration sub-region division on the target power distribution network; and generating a recovery scheme of each online global recovery sub-region, and optimizing the recovery scheme to obtain a final recovery scheme. The advantages are that: and the recovery subareas are adaptively adjusted according to the uncertain events, and the optimization scheme is updated, so that the influence of the uncertain events on the recovery process is reduced, the power supply of the power distribution network is ensured to be recovered rapidly, safely and economically, and recovery benefits are effectively improved.
assignees: STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Remote fee control method, device and electricity consumption information acquisition system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote fee control method, a remote fee control device and an electricity consumption information acquisition system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: under the condition that a first fee control work order of a user is received, analyzing the first fee control work order to obtain a first analysis result; under the condition that the user arrears power failure is determined based on the first analysis result and delayed automatic power restoration is needed, a first tripping instruction is generated, and the first tripping instruction comprises delayed automatic power restoration time length; and sending the first tripping instruction to the electric energy meter, wherein the electric energy meter executes tripping action based on the first tripping instruction to cut off the power supply of the user, delays the power supply, and executes closing action to recover the power supply of the user under the condition that the delay time reaches the delay automatic power recovery duration. Therefore, the success rate of remote fee control power restoration and the working efficiency of site power restoration execution can be improved through delayed automatic power restoration.
assignees: CHINA GRIDCOM CO LTD;SHENZHEN SMARTCHIP MICROELECTRONICS TECH COMPANY LIMITED

title_en: Topology archive maintenance method, device, equipment and medium based on data update
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, and discloses a topology archive maintenance method based on data updating, which comprises the following steps: acquiring power grid data which are included in dynamic monitoring based on a preset archive restoration instruction, and obtaining monitored data; carrying out polling test on the monitored data, and screening the monitored data by judging whether the monitored data has change or not; when the monitored data changes, acquiring a data section snapshot by judging whether the monitored data changes finally or not, and obtaining section snapshot data; obtaining topology archive data related to the section snapshot data, and obtaining comprehensive power grid state data according to the section snapshot data and the topology archive data; and encrypting and compressing the comprehensive power grid state data, transmitting the comprehensive power grid state data to a related system, and maintaining an initial topology file. The invention also provides a topology archive maintenance device, equipment and storage medium based on data updating. The invention can improve the stability of the power grid system.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network fault reconstruction method based on improved river horse optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network fault reconstruction method based on an improved river horse optimization algorithm, according to the method, the connected components are used for fault recovery evaluation, the load which can be recovered by a reconstruction mode is determined in advance, and the problem solving complexity is reduced. And then, combining the minimum ring set to encode, mapping the solution space of the power distribution network fault reconstruction problem to the search space of an algorithm, wherein the encoding mode can greatly improve the duty ratio of the effective solution. Then, the traditional river horse optimization algorithm is improved by combining the proposed coding strategy, so that the river horse optimization algorithm can adapt to the discrete optimization problem. And finally, the improved river horse optimization algorithm is utilized to quickly solve the power distribution network fault reconstruction strategy, so that quick power restoration is realized.

title_en: Ecological perching fish nest optimal design method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological perching fish nest optimization design method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring environment information of an ecological restoration water area and determining rationality of an ecological restoration target; constructing AQUATOX model prediction calculation to determine the quantity requirements of various types of fish shoals, and respectively determining the quantity requirements of fish nests corresponding to each type of fish shoals; carrying out material selection design on the fish nest based on fish habit; carrying out structural design of the fish nest based on the material selection design result; manufacturing a fish nest based on the material design result and the structure design result, and adjusting and optimizing the design of the fish nest through a test until the attraction effect of the fish shoal reaches the preset requirement; and finally, arranging and designing the fish nest in the ecological restoration water area. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, the design quality of the fish nest can be improved, the attraction effect, the ecological restoration effect and the biodiversity improvement effect on the fish shoals can be ensured to reach the preset requirements through experiments and adjustment and optimization, and the effect of ecological restoration measures is enhanced.
assignees: CCCC THIRD HARBOR ENG CO LTD

title_en: Ecological restoration system and method for geological disaster prevention and control
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of polluted water body restoration treatment, in particular to an ecological restoration system and method for geological disaster prevention and control. The ecological restoration system comprises a sedimentation tank, a first water inlet, a first biological treatment tank, a second biological treatment tank, a first disinfection tank, a second disinfection tank and a second disinfection tank, wherein a first water inlet is formed in the middle of the sedimentation tank, an overflow outlet is formed in the top of the sedimentation tank, supernatant overflowed through the overflow outlet can enter the first biological treatment tank or the second biological treatment tank under the action of a switching baffle, a first water outlet is formed in the lower portion of the first biological treatment tank, the first water outlet is connected to the first disinfection tank through a first filter tube, and a second water outlet is formed in the lower portion of the second biological treatment tank, and is connected to the second disinfection tank through a second filter tube. Can effectively remove sediment which invades the water body, reduce the contents of organic matters and pathogenic microorganisms in the water body, and further reduce the ecological environment recovery time of the polluted water body.

title_en: River ecological water storage restoration system and restoration method
abstract_en: The invention provides a river ecological water storage restoration system and a restoration method, wherein the river ecological water storage restoration system comprises a water storage ditch, a filtering weir and a wetland bubble, the water storage ditch is arranged at the bottom of a river channel, the bottom of the water storage ditch is provided with first vegetation and a first pebble layer, the filtering weir is arranged perpendicular to the trend of the river channel, the wetland bubble is arranged at the bottom of the river channel and communicated with the water storage ditch, the wetland bubble is internally provided with second vegetation, and the wetland bubble is used for water storage. According to the river ecological water storage restoration system provided by the invention, the water level can be stored in the dead water period by combining the water storage ditch with the wetland bubble, the river cut-off is avoided on the premise of not influencing the river flood-passing function, the diversity of the ecological system is kept by arranging the first vegetation and the second vegetation, the water storage ditch can form various complex water conservancy conditions such as rapid flow, slow flow and the like, the wetland bubble has an impurity precipitation function, the filter weir can form a filter effect, and the river ecological restoration system has a good purification effect on aquatic plants and microorganisms, so that the river water quality is improved, and meanwhile, the ecological diversity of the river is enriched.
assignees: NORENDAR INT LTD;UNIV HEBEI GEO

title_en: Transformer substation anti-seismic toughness determination method and system based on data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a substation anti-seismic toughness determination method and system based on data analysis, and relates to the field of power system evaluation. By defining a function state F and a toughness evaluation index R of a transformer substation system, establishing a function relation between a network directed graph model function state F and a device state s of the transformer substation system, determining related variables of a transformer substation system function loss and a recovery simulation process, acquiring a current state vector of the device and the current function state of the transformer substation system, determining a decision deployment time threshold, determining a device recovery priority according to a device recovery time distribution model and device importance, generating a fault device recovery sequence, obtaining the recovery time of each fault device, decomposing the function recovery process according to a time step delta t, distributing available recovery resources according to a fault device recovery sequence pi, updating the device state s and the transformer substation system function state F, obtaining a transformer substation system function anti-seismic toughness curve, and calculating a corresponding toughness evaluation index.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Method and device for determining restoration strategy of power distribution network, storage medium and processor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a restoration strategy determining method, a restoration strategy determining device, a storage medium and a processor of a power distribution network. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring performance indexes and initial constraint conditions of the power distribution network, wherein the performance indexes are used for indicating stability and/or reliability of the power distribution network, and the initial constraint conditions are used for indicating constraint conditions of the power distribution network in the operation process; based on the performance index and the initial constraint condition, respectively determining a target recovery function and a target constraint condition of the power distribution network, wherein the target recovery function is used for indicating a triggering condition to be achieved for recovering the power distribution network, and the target constraint condition is used for indicating a constraint condition of the power distribution network in a recovery process; and determining a recovery strategy of the power distribution network based on the target recovery function and the target constraint condition, wherein the recovery strategy is used for representing a rule for recovering the power distribution network. The method and the device solve the technical problem of low efficiency of determining the recovery strategy of the power distribution network.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ZHUHAI POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Electric bus cooperative scheduling method for improving toughness of power distribution-traffic system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution-traffic system toughness improvement-oriented electric bus cooperative scheduling method, which relates to the field of power distribution networks, considers the electric power-traffic dual attribute of electric buses, and is based on cooperation between the operation requirements of the power distribution networks and traffic networks after disaster and cooperation between power supply and evacuation multitasks of the electric buses, the cooperative multitasking scheduling model of the electric buses for power restoration and trapped people evacuation after the disaster of the power distribution-traffic system is constructed, the application value of the electric buses in the aspect of comprehensive toughness improvement of the coupling system is fully excavated, and the calculation method of partitioning and routing is adopted, so that the high-efficiency and accurate solving of the proposed model is realized.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: Method and device for repairing measurement data of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for repairing measurement data of a power distribution network, which can be applied to the technical field of measurement data processing of the power distribution network. The power distribution network measurement data restoration method comprises the steps of determining a plurality of historical power distribution network measurement data sequences matched with missing measurement data from a historical data set based on different sequence time steps, generating restoration vectors based on the historical power distribution network measurement data sequences and reference data sequences matched with the historical power distribution network measurement data sequences, obtaining a plurality of target restoration vectors based on the restoration vectors and the restoration vectors after dimension reduction, wherein the restoration vectors after dimension reduction are obtained by dimension reduction of the restoration vectors to be dimension reduced, respectively inputting the plurality of target restoration vectors into a restoration model to obtain a plurality of restoration data, and obtaining target restoration data matched with the missing measurement data based on the plurality of restoration data.

title_en: Hydraulic engineering ecological environment treatment system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of hydraulic engineering and ecological environment protection, and particularly relates to a hydraulic engineering ecological environment management system which comprises an intelligent monitoring network, a data integration and analysis platform, an ecological assessment and early warning module, ecological restoration and protection measures, an intelligent scheduling and optimization module and a public participation and education module. According to the hydraulic engineering ecological environment treatment system, the cooperative management of the hydraulic engineering and the ecological environment is realized through an intelligent and systematic means, the accuracy and the efficiency of ecological environment monitoring are effectively improved, scientific basis is provided for ecological environment assessment and restoration, and sustainable utilization of water resources and virtuous circle of the ecological environment are promoted. In addition, the system has higher flexibility and expandability, can be customized and developed according to the characteristics and requirements of different hydraulic engineering, and has popularization and application values.
assignees: ZHONGKE MINGRUI TIANJIN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for relieving waterlogging injury of tea trees and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for relieving waterlogging injury of tea trees and application thereof, wherein a drainage ditch is dredged in time to loosen soil around the tea trees; removing broken branches and injured branches, shearing off the upper section of the tea tree branches, and keeping the distance between the main branches and the ground by 40 cm-50 cm; covering the tea tree with a shading net for 1-2 months. After the method is implemented for 1-2 months, the bud growth vigor of the waterlogged tea tree can be obviously improved, and the damage of waterlogged tea to tea trees is relieved. And the method is low in implementation economic cost, simple, effective and high in reliability, and can be applied to post-disaster restoration after waterlogging of various tea gardens.
assignees: TEA RES INST GUANGDONG ACADEMY AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES;SOUTH CHINA BOTANICAL GARDEN CAS

title_en: Power grid accident early warning and processing method based on multi-factor coupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid accident early warning and processing method based on multi-factor coupling, which comprises the steps of collecting the running state, load data and operation data of power grid equipment; extracting low-dimensional abstract features of grid accidents by using a deep convolution self-coding network; establishing a deep noise reduction self-coding network to perform early warning and processing of power grid accidents; in the accident handling process, making an auxiliary decision based on a standardized flow; and verifying the safety of the fault handling strategy through a power grid tide calculation model. The invention effectively improves the standardization and safety of the dispatching operation; the optimization scheme for fault isolation and power restoration is provided, the decision of a dispatcher is supported, and the efficiency and the accuracy of fault processing are enhanced; therefore, the safety and stability of the operation of the power grid are ensured, and higher early warning accuracy, processing efficiency and safety guarantee capability are shown in practical application.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Post-disaster information-physical cooperative recovery scheme generation method and system for power distribution network considering satellite communication support
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for generating a post-disaster information-physical cooperative recovery scheme of a power distribution network by considering satellite communication support, which relate to the field of power distribution networks and are characterized in that the post-disaster information-physical cooperative recovery process of the power distribution network under the satellite communication support is modeled as an MILP (minimum likelihood procedure), the method takes the restoration initial data of the information-physical system of the power distribution network as input, outputs the restoration sequence of each node of the electric power-information network, the information flow distribution path, the load and unit operation scheme, the satellite communication terminal deployment and the disaster time scheduling scheme, and realizes the efficient generation of the information-physical cooperative restoration scheme. Compared with the prior art, the method comprehensively considers the complex coupling relation between the information and the physical system of the power distribution network, considers the supporting effect of satellite communication on cooperative recovery under the background of new-era technical development, is beneficial to guiding the post-disaster efficient recovery of the power distribution network and improves the toughness of the power distribution network.

title_en: Fault positioning and restoration decision method and system for power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault positioning and restoration decision method and system for a power distribution network, and relates to the field of electric data processing.
