The method comprises the following steps: identifying a target power distribution system and determining a target power distribution topology network; performing fault characteristic analysis, and constructing a multisource sensing monitoring array; extracting abnormal characteristic data sets of a plurality of abnormal monitoring nodes which do not meet the characteristic monitoring threshold; performing power distribution simulation to obtain a simulation characteristic data set; performing fuzzy analysis and fault prediction, and outputting a plurality of fault prediction results; and generating a fault recovery scheme and sending the fault recovery scheme to operation and maintenance personnel. The power distribution network fault prediction method based on the fuzzy analysis solves the technical problems that in the prior art, due to the influence of various power distribution factors, complexity and uncertainty of power distribution fault recognition are large, power distribution network fault prediction accuracy and efficiency are low, through fuzzy analysis on abnormal simulation features, prediction nodes are accurately set, power distribution fault prediction of the prediction nodes is performed by constructing fault prediction sub-channels, and the prediction accuracy and efficiency are improved.
assignees: FEILAI ZHEJIANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent power distribution network rush-repair scheduling system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system management, in particular to an intelligent power distribution network emergency repair scheduling system which comprises an environment sensing module, a fault detection and positioning module, an assessment early warning module, an optimal scheduling decision module, an emergency resource allocation module and a feedback self-learning module, wherein the environment sensing module is used for collecting power distribution network environment information in real time, the fault detection and positioning module is used for detecting power distribution network faults in real time, the assessment early warning module is used for carrying out intelligent assessment on the fault information, the optimal scheduling decision module is used for generating an optimal emergency repair scheduling scheme, the emergency resource allocation module is used for dynamically allocating emergency repair personnel, equipment and materials, and the feedback self-learning module is used for self-learning and optimizing improvement. According to the invention, by integrating efficient fault detection, multi-objective optimal scheduling, dynamic resource allocation and feedback and self-learning mechanisms, the rush repair response speed and the resource use efficiency are remarkably improved, so that the reliability of a power grid is enhanced and the operation and maintenance cost is reduced.
assignees: STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY GONGYI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY;ZHENGZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HANAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Vegetation restoration quality judging method based on mirror image characteristics
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of vegetation restoration monitoring and discloses a vegetation restoration quality judging method based on mirror image characteristics, which comprises the steps of obtaining remote sensing images corresponding to a plurality of time points respectively, performing geometric registration on the remote sensing images corresponding to the time points respectively to obtain a plurality of target remote sensing images, and determining a target power grid construction area in each target remote sensing image; and detecting a vegetation index of the target power grid construction area in each target remote sensing image to obtain target vegetation indexes corresponding to the target remote sensing images respectively, wherein the target vegetation indexes comprise comprehensive indexes of vegetation coverage rate, vegetation growth rate and vegetation weather indexes, and determining a vegetation recovery quality index of the target power grid construction area according to the target vegetation indexes corresponding to the target remote sensing images respectively. The application utilizes the remote sensing image to detect and judge the vegetation restoration quality, and can evaluate the environmental protection effect of vegetation restoration on the power grid construction area by utilizing the remote sensing image.
assignees: STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIS SOFTWARE SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution automation-based power grid fault self-healing method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution automation-based power grid fault self-healing method, which relates to the field of power system engineering. And the deep learning is used for analyzing history and real-time data, predicting the possibility of faults, and the master station constructs a network topological graph according to the possibility of faults and accurately locates potential fault areas. Fault isolation and non-fault zone power restoration are automatically performed. The fault location is accelerated through the dynamic topological graph, the automatic isolation and recovery strategy is matched, the fault influence is effectively controlled, the power supply reliability and the user experience are greatly improved, the intelligent self-healing of the power grid is realized, the operation is optimized, and the safe and stable operation of the power grid is ensured.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Communication emergency guarantee method and device suitable for electric power scene
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of communication emergency, and discloses a communication emergency guarantee method and a device suitable for an electric power scene, the method comprises the steps of system monitoring and fault evaluation, communication recovery strategy selection, field communication guarantee and information collection and transmission, and the device corresponds to the method. The method and the system realize monitoring of the running state of the power communication system and evaluation of the influence range and severity of the fault through system monitoring and fault evaluation, further realize reasonable evaluation of the power communication fault and reservation of an elastic space, realize emergency communication means selection and determination of the order of priority restoration of communication objects through communication restoration strategy selection, realize targeted manpower and material resource distribution of emergency communication security personnel and a field command center through field communication security, realize collection of power communication fault information, emergency repair progress condition and transmission decision security information through information collection and transmission, optimize communication emergency security process, and finally realize communication emergency security applicable to power scenes.
assignees: STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power distribution network two-stage fault restoration optimization method and terminal based on variable time step
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-stage fault repair optimization method and a terminal for a power distribution network based on a variable time step, damage evaluation information of the power distribution network is determined after an extreme weather disaster occurs, a maintenance team scheduling decision model is established according to the damage evaluation information, the power distribution network operation strategy optimization model is established based on the variable time step by taking the total active weighted loss of each scene under the minimum known fault repair sequence as an objective function, the maintenance team scheduling decision model and the power distribution network operation strategy optimization model are solved to obtain an optimal fault repair strategy, the established maintenance team scheduling decision model is a first-stage problem, the established power distribution network operation strategy optimization model is a second-stage problem, an effective and reliable fault repair strategy can be given after the extreme weather disaster occurs through the two-stage optimization problem, and the second-stage problem adopts the variable time step idea modeling, so that the efficiency and accuracy of solving the fault repair strategy are improved, and the toughness level of the power distribution network is effectively enhanced.
assignees: ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Remote sensing evaporation model-based quantitative calculation method for ecological water demand of natural vegetation in arid region
abstract_en: The invention provides a remote sensing evapotranspiration model-based quantitative calculation method for ecological water demand of natural vegetation in an arid region, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of collecting basic data of a research area, collecting and processing long-time sequence satellite remote sensing data, calculating actual evapotranspiration of an area based on a model set, evaluating and verifying the actual evapotranspiration, calculating a regional reference evapotranspiration ratio, calculating the evapotranspiration quantity of natural vegetation blue water, correcting the evapotranspiration of natural vegetation blue water based on water balance, calculating the evapotranspiration coefficient of the natural vegetation blue water and calculating the ecological water demand of the natural vegetation. The method can realize accurate calculation of the ecological water demand of the natural vegetation in the arid region, has the practicability and operability of regional application, and can be used for service application fields such as water resource management, ecological protection and restoration, watershed water resource planning, water resource optimization configuration and the like in the arid region.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_ko: 녹조를 발생시키지 못하도록 작용시켜서 친환경 전기를 생산함과 동시에 인공양어장 기능을 발휘시켜서 어족자원을 증대시킴과 동시에 홍수 피해 방지용 대형 빗물 저류조 기능과 오염된 바닷물과 오염된 하천수를 깨끗한 하천수가 되도록 작용하는 상.하 작동식 녹조 발생 방지용 친환경 가동보가 발생시켜주는 주는 수력과 조력을 이용하여 3중으로 친환경 전기를 생산하는 자연친화적인 친환경 공법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an eco-friendly construction method utilizing a movable weir for preventing algal blooms, while simultaneously restoring river ecosystems. The invention enables the generation of eco-friendly electricity using a fishway that restores aquatic ecosystems without promoting algal growth, and functions as an artificial fish farm to enhance fishery resources. Additionally, it serves as a large-scale rainwater retention reservoir to prevent flood damage. By using the eco-friendly movable weir, polluted river water flowing through rivers, lakes, dams, and reservoirs is naturally purified into clean water. This invention thus provides a nature-friendly, eco-conscious method for improving water quality and supporting ecological restoration.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 녹조를 발생시키지 못하도록 작용하면서 하천생태계를 복원시켜주는 작용하는 어도를 이용하여 친환경 전기를 생산함과 동시에 자연 생태계를 복원시켜주는 인공양어장 기능을 발휘시켜서 어족자원을 증대시킴과 동시에 대형 빗물 저류조 역활을 수행하여 홍수 피해를 예방하여 주도록 작용함과 동시에 하천에 흐르는 하천수와 호수, 댐, 저수지에 저수되어 있는 오염된 하천수를 깨끗한 하천수가 되도록 작용하는 녹조 발생 방지용 친환경 가동보를 이용하여 오염된 하천수를 자연정화시키는 자연친화적인 친환경공법에 관한 발명이다.
assignees: HAN SANG KWAN

title_en: Mortise and tenon type precast block ecological retaining wall suitable for rapid restoration of ground disaster environment slope
abstract_en: The invention provides a mortise and tenon type precast block ecological retaining wall suitable for rapid restoration of a ground disaster environment side slope. The mortise and tenon type precast block ecological retaining wall suitable for rapid restoration of a ground disaster environment side slope comprises a fixed frame, wherein the fixed frame is installed on the front face of the side slope through a plurality of anchors, a plurality of supporting rods are installed at the top of the inner wall of the fixed frame at equal intervals, a plurality of installation pieces are fixedly connected to positions, close to two sides, of the front face of the fixed frame, and first supporting bolts are fixedly connected to one ends of the front face of the installation pieces. According to the mortise and tenon type precast block ecological retaining wall suitable for rapid restoration of the ground disaster environment side slope, concrete or adhesive is not needed to fix the ecological retaining wall through the design, the ecological retaining wall is assembled through the fixing frame, the first mounting rail and the second mounting rail, the assembly efficiency of the ecological retaining wall is improved, the later disassembly difficulty is reduced, and the disassembled ecological retaining wall can be reused.
assignees: NUCLEAR IND JINHUA CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Optical fiber wiring control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of optical fibers, in particular to an optical fiber distribution control method, which comprises at least one idle optical fiber connection line, wherein a first terminal and a second terminal of the optical fiber connection line are respectively inserted into two idle optical fiber ports, the optical fiber connection line is used for controlling a manipulator to pull out the first terminal and the second terminal from the idle optical fiber ports respectively, insert the first terminal and the second terminal into a first optical fiber port and a second optical fiber port to be connected and arrange the optical fiber line from a storage area to a use area, the optical fiber distribution control method is used for solving the technical problems of long time consumption, high labor power and low efficiency of optical cable network operation and maintenance, slow optical cable interruption positioning, disaster influence restoration efficiency, long fiber core detection time consumption and inconvenient data analysis, and realizing remote operation by using the manipulator to replace manpower to execute cable jump tasks in remote areas or dangerous areas, thereby improving the automation degree of the operation and realizing the quick positioning of optical cable interruption and the restoration efficiency of disaster influence.
assignees: GUANGDONG XINTONG COMMUNICATION CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent arrearage early warning and automatic outage and restoration management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electricity management and discloses an intelligent arrearage early warning and automatic power outage and restoration management system which comprises a management system, an electricity consumption system and an electricity consumption list system, wherein the management system comprises a management module, a profiling register for a household residence card module and a payment module, the management module is used for authorizing a manager, the manager can use the device, the profiling register for a household residence card module is used for establishing files of the manager, and the profiling register for a household residence card module is used for establishing files of the user.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Community flood toughness and external relation analysis method based on facility accessibility
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for analyzing community flood toughness and external relations based on facility accessibility, and relates to the technical field of community disaster toughness assessment. In the invention, the complex connection and interaction among elements such as urban roads, facilities, crowds and the like are considered based on the constructed composite space network. In the case of heavy rain, the service flow between community residents and facilities may be disturbed, the road serves as a bridge to connect the community residents and the service facilities, and road interruption caused by heavy rain may cause isolation between part of communities and the service facilities, influence accessibility heterogeneity change, and make community toughness present complex spatial distribution. According to the method, the supporting degree of the service facilities inside and outside the community on the restoration capability of the community can be determined by analyzing the contribution of the road-community inner service facility-community outer service facility to the comprehensive toughness of the community. Based on community disaster toughness evaluation and external association analysis, the embodiment of the invention provides a reliable scientific basis for community disaster prevention and reduction construction.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Multi-level energy efficiency evaluation method for restoring polluted soil by in-situ heat treatment coupling technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-level energy efficiency evaluation method for restoring polluted soil by an in-situ heat treatment coupling technology, which comprises the following steps of S1, restoring polluted land, S2, calculating pollutant removal rate, S3, comprehensively evaluating land reuse performance, S3-1, determining a comprehensive calculation formula, S3-2, determining weights, S3-4, checking a judgment matrix, and S4, and evaluating multi-level energy efficiency. On the basis of land utilization modes, the method comprehensively considers human health risks, building safety risks, ecological risks, underground water utilization and soil fertility faced in the subsequent land development and utilization according to the use scenes of different land utilization modes, combines relevant national standards, builds an evaluation method of the comprehensive restoration effect of the localized in-situ heat treatment and the coupling technology thereof, and provides a more comprehensive evaluation method for the restoration technology comparison of the organic pollution sites in China.
assignees: NANJING INST OF ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENCES MEE

title_en: System and method for compressing and restoring data using multi-level autoencoders and correlation networks
abstract_en: A system and method for compressing and restoring data using multi-level autoencoders and a correlation network. The system compresses data, such as hyperspectral images, using a multi-level autoencoder. Data restoration employs a correlation network trained on image sets to leverage inter-image correlations. Latent space vector grouping may be used to enhance reconstruction accuracy. The approach achieves efficient compression while maintaining data quality through learned correlations.
assignees: ATOMBEAM TECHNOLOGIES INC

title_en: Multi-plant ecological restoration method and system for water body
abstract_en: The application discloses a water body multi-plant ecological restoration method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of detecting whether different functions exist in a water body to be detected, carrying out regional division according to the functions to obtain a water body regional division result, analyzing based on water capacity information and pollutant information to obtain a regional division index Q if the functions do not exist, dividing the water body region to be detected according to the regional division index Q to obtain a water body regional division result, analyzing plants suitable for ecological restoration of the water body to be detected based on pollutant information of the water body to obtain a plant pre-screening database, analyzing whether each plant in the plant pre-screening database is a native plant of the water body to be detected, screening according to weather similarity of a suitable survival area of each plant and the area where the water body to be detected exists if the functions do not exist to obtain a plant two-screening database, and screening plant adaptability information and plant stress resistance information of each plant in the plant two-screening database to obtain a plant selection database. The application has the effect of improving the ecological restoration efficiency of multiple plants in the water body.

title_en: Fault processing method and device and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a fault processing method, a fault processing device and computer equipment. Determining a priority recovery sequence of each load according to the importance level of each load in a fault area to a user, acquiring a current scheduling strategy for recovering power supply of each load, and controlling the recovery power supply of each load in the fault area according to the priority recovery sequence of each load and the current scheduling strategy of each load. By adopting the method, the priority recovery sequence of each load can be determined according to the importance level of each load in the fault area to the user, so that the power can be recovered preferentially to the load with higher sensitivity to the power supply in the fault area based on the priority recovery sequence of each load, and the power can be recovered to the load with lower sensitivity to the power supply in the fault area, thereby improving the recovery effect when the power is recovered to each load in the fault area.
assignees: SOUTHERN POWER GRID ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Route retrieval device, route retrieval method, and program
abstract_en: A route retrieval device according to one aspect of the present invention retrieves routes according to which vehicles are moved to a plurality of bases that provide services to users. The route retrieval device comprises a network information input unit, a status input unit, an order-of-restoration retrieval unit, and an access concentration influence degree calculation unit. The network information input unit inputs network information regarding a network which has a plurality of bases as nodes and links the nodes. The status input unit inputs the status of each of the nodes and links. The order-of-restoration retrieval unit formulates a planning problem for modelling the access concentration of traffic in the network on the basis of the network information and the statuses, and retrieves candidates for the order of restoration of the bases as routes. The access concentration influence degree calculation unit evaluates the influence degree of the access concentration for each of the orders of restoration by using an objective function value obtained by optimizing the planning problem.
assignees: NIPPON TELEGRAPH & TELEPHONE

title_en: Power grid node recovery priority evaluation method and system in extreme environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid node recovery priority evaluation method and a system under extreme environment, wherein the method comprises the steps of calculating and determining disaster influence factors of all nodes according to fault probability of lines in all nodes; the method comprises the steps of determining the output of a unit in each node and the load of the node after being affected by disasters according to disaster influence factors and disaster information of each node, determining the expected recovery benefits after correction of the unit in each node according to the output of the unit in each node and the unit recovery benefits of the unit in each node after being affected by disasters, determining the expected recovery benefits after correction of the load in each node according to the unit recovery benefits of the unit load in each node after being affected by disasters, adding the expected recovery benefits after correction of the unit in each node and the expected recovery benefits after correction of the load to obtain the expected recovery benefits of each node, and determining the recovery priority of each node in a power grid according to the expected recovery benefits of each node. Accurate determination of recovery priority of each node in the power grid is achieved.

title_en: Method and device for evaluating reliability of power distribution network containing multiple types of distributed energy sources
abstract_en: The application provides a reliability evaluation method of a power distribution network containing multiple types of distributed energy, which comprises the steps of determining the relation between disaster intensity and element faults of the power distribution network, describing the association relation between disaster intensity characteristics and element fault rates by using a random forest model, generating disaster fault data sets of the power distribution network by a sampling method, carrying out post-disaster load recovery and line restoration at a post-disaster recovery stage of the power distribution network, establishing a fault recovery model, solving the fault recovery model to obtain a load node power supply state of the power distribution network, and accordingly calculating the reliability index of a power system.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent power distribution network rush-repair scheduling system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power grid maintenance, and particularly relates to an intelligent power distribution network emergency repair scheduling system which comprises a data acquisition module, a data preprocessing module, a data analysis module, a data updating module and a display module, wherein the data acquisition module monitors multi-parameter data of all nodes of a power distribution network in real time through a multi-parameter sensor, the data acquired by the data acquisition module are transmitted to the data preprocessing module in real time in a wireless or wired mode, the data preprocessing module cleans and standardizes the multi-parameter data, the preprocessed multi-parameter data is subjected to model training through the data analysis module, the model comprises LSTM and RNN, meanwhile, the data updating module updates parameters of the data analysis model RNN through an Adam optimization algorithm, the data analysis module outputs specific positions of faults, and the specific positions are displayed through the display module, so that the emergency repair process is completed.
assignees: STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY GONGYI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY;ZHENGZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HANAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Multi-objective optimization method for post-earthquake community building group restoration scheduling and toughness evaluation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-objective optimization method for post-earthquake community building group restoration scheduling and toughness evaluation, which belongs to the technical field of post-earthquake community building group restoration scheduling and comprises the steps of obtaining a seismic source coordinate point, building a post-earthquake building group network based on the seismic source coordinate point, obtaining image data and building structure information of the post-earthquake building group network, obtaining building structure characteristic data based on the image data and the building structure information of the building group network, calculating the building structure characteristic data through a recurrent neural network, determining a building restoration strategy after obtaining a building toughness prediction score, obtaining schedulable resources in real time, solving balance between the building restoration strategy and the schedulable resources based on a multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm, generating an optimal solution set of building restoration scheduling, and restoring the building group based on the optimal solution set of building restoration scheduling. The invention realizes the balance between the building restoration strategy and the schedulable resources through the multi-target particle swarm optimization algorithm.
assignees: UNIV HUNAN

title_en: Power distribution network power failure rush-repair system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power failure emergency repair system for a power distribution network, which relates to the field of power distribution networks and comprises a fault detection module, a fault positioning module, an emergency repair scheduling module, a user notification module, a data recording and analyzing module, a security and authority management module, an interface and integration module, a processing result notification management module and a system maintenance and upgrading module. The power failure rush-repair system for the power distribution network is implemented, so that the quick circulation and the processing efficiency of information are promoted, and meanwhile, the effectiveness of rush-repair work is improved through modern communication and scheduling means. By optimizing the whole rescue process, the stability and reliability of power supply are ensured, and the system is an important support for the management of a modern power system.
assignees: KAIFENG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;KAIFENG XIANGFU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Ecological restoration structure for slope protection of ecological mining area
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ecological restoration structure for slope protection of an ecological mining area, which relates to the technical field of slope protection of the ecological mining area and comprises a water guiding slope body and a plurality of planting boxes, wherein each planting box is fixedly arranged on the side wall of the water guiding slope body, two water outlet pipes are symmetrically arranged on the side wall of the water guiding slope body, a plurality of first water guiding channels are formed in the inner wall of each planting box, a guide pipe is fixedly connected to the inner wall of each first water guiding channel, and each first water guiding channel is obliquely arranged. According to the utility model, the plurality of first water guide channels are obliquely arranged, so that the guiding-out effect of water and sediment can be improved, the guiding-out speed of the sediment is accelerated, the sediment accumulation probability is reduced, the water guide effect of the planting box is improved, the growth of plants is facilitated, and the landslide phenomenon caused by excessive water quantity can be avoided.
assignees: Wei Zesuo

title_en: Automatic repairing method for wind power plant monitoring data based on signal frequency domain feature reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wind power plant monitoring data restoration, and particularly discloses an automatic wind power plant monitoring data restoration method based on signal frequency domain feature reconstruction, which comprises the following steps of obtaining wind power plant monitoring data to be restored and randomly generating a noise vector; the method comprises the steps of constructing a generated countermeasure network model, inputting a noise vector into a generator for generating the countermeasure network model to obtain generated data, calculating loss of the generated data and real wind power plant monitoring data, adjusting the noise vector by alternately using an optimizer strategy to obtain minimized loss of the generated data and the real wind power plant monitoring data, performing iterative optimization for a plurality of times to obtain an optimal noise vector, inputting the optimal noise vector into the generator, outputting a missing part of the wind power plant monitoring data, and completing wind power plant monitoring data restoration. The method solves the problem that the existing wind power data reconstruction and repair method ignores high-frequency detail information of data, and improves accuracy of data reconstruction and filling.
assignees: HUBEI ENERGY GROUP QIYUESHAN WIND POWER CO LTD

title_en: Model training method, data repairing method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a model training method, a data repairing method, a device, equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of constructing an original sample tensor based on electric power measurement sample data, determining an original sample tensor based on the original sample tensor, wherein the original sample tensor comprises complete electric power measurement sample data, decomposing the original sample tensor by utilizing a data restoration model to obtain a preset number of hidden characteristic sample tensors, synthesizing the preset number of hidden characteristic sample tensors to obtain a reconstructed sample tensor, restoring the value of the original sample tensor comprising the missing value in the original sample tensor in the reconstructed sample tensor, and training the data restoration model by utilizing a preset objective function and a preset gradient descent algorithm based on the original sample tensor and the reconstructed sample tensor. The data repairing capability is effectively improved, the resource consumption of data repairing is greatly reduced, and the repairing efficiency and low precision of the data are improved.
assignees: NANJING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power supply output curve data quality restoration method, system, medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system, a medium and equipment for repairing the quality of power output curve data, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting the power output curve data of a target photovoltaic power station; the method comprises the steps of determining data to be repaired, which has problems, from the power output curve data, repairing the data to be repaired by adopting a proportion repairing method if the data to be repaired is multi-day data, and repairing the data to be repaired by adopting a linear interpolation method if the data to be repaired is single-day data. According to the method, single-day data or multi-day data or the combination of the single-day data and the multi-day data are selected for repairing according to the data missing condition, so that the accuracy of repairing the power output curve data of the target photovoltaic power station is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;BEIJING GUODIANTONG NETWORK TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD

title_en: Urban drainage system carbon emission reduction accounting method suitable for pipeline restoration scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbon emission reduction accounting method of an urban drainage system, which is suitable for a pipeline restoration scene and comprises the following steps of (1) collecting water supply data, a drainage water quality background value and running data of a sewage treatment plant in an accounting area, calculating and evaluating pipe network defects of the urban drainage system, (2) collecting relevant carbon footprint evaluation parameters in the urban drainage system, calculating historical carbon emission of the drainage pipeline, the sewage treatment plant and a receiving water body in the urban drainage system, (3) setting the pipe network restoration scene according to control targets of sewage collection rate and external water invasion rate, and (4) inputting the carbon footprint evaluation parameters of the urban drainage system into a Monte Carlo simulation model to obtain dynamic prediction results of the carbon emission of the urban drainage system under different conditions. The invention can quickly determine the influence degree of different pipe network defects on carbon emission in sewage/rainwater collection, transportation, treatment and emission scenes of the drainage system, and assist the urban drainage system to realize the aim of carbon neutralization.
assignees: UNIV TONGJI

title_en: Regulation and control operation command training method, system, medium and processor based on real scheduling service scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regulation and control operation command training method, a system, a medium and a processor based on a real dispatching service scene, which relate to the technical field of power dispatching training, and the method comprises the steps of obtaining historical dispatching service data corresponding to different dispatching service types; processing and analyzing the historical dispatching service data, screening out typical service scene cases of different dispatching service types, generating simulation training contents of typical service scenes according to the typical service scene cases, acquiring simulation training results of a dispatcher in the simulation training contents, and deriving a digital representation of the training results of the dispatcher by analyzing the simulation training results of the dispatcher. According to the invention, the classical service scene cases are screened out from the historical scheduling service data for reverse restoration, so that a dispatcher can train under the condition of truly scheduling service scenes, and the training effect and training quality are effectively improved.
assignees: GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Multi-scale toughness assessment method, device, terminal and medium for urban underground space
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-scale toughness assessment method, a device, a terminal and a medium for urban underground space, wherein the method is used for determining index data of nodes in an urban underground space network according to underground space information, determining node toughness assessment results of the nodes according to the index data of the nodes respectively, determining failure nodes according to the node toughness assessment results, determining a plurality of node restoration schemes according to the failure nodes, respectively calculating comprehensive toughness assessment results of the urban underground space network when the node restoration schemes are adopted, and selecting the node restoration scheme as a target node restoration scheme according to the comprehensive toughness assessment results. According to the method, the nodes and the urban underground space network are subjected to toughness assessment according to different indexes, and a node repairing scheme is formulated and selected according to the toughness assessment result, so that the problem of how to carry out toughness assessment on the urban underground space network after the urban underground space network is damaged is solved, and a repairing scheme is formulated for the nodes according to the toughness assessment result.

title_en: Temporal distribution pattern-based medium-term streamflow forecasting method and system
abstract_en: A temporal distribution pattern-based medium-term streamflow forecasting method includes: acquiring and organizing long-series hydrological streamflow data from a control cross-section of a study basin, including flow data at daily, ten-day, monthly, seasonal, and yearly scales from a hydrological station and inflow data from a reservoir station; performing streamflow restoration calculation based on a water balance principle, and obtaining a natural streamflow series for any basin node; performing an inflow frequency analysis, and determining seasonal and monthly inflow frequencies of any node in different inflow years; calculating distribution ratios of each month's streamflow at any node across first, middle and last ten-day periods, and defining a temporal streamflow distribution coefficient for the corresponding month; and identifying a historical year with a similar characteristic based on a monthly natural flow at a specific cross-section, matching the temporal distribution coefficient of a historical streamflow series, and deriving a forecasted medium-term natural flow value.
assignees: BUREAU OF HYDROLOGY CHANGJIANG WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION

title_en: Side slope prefabricated triangular steel pipe net piece protective structure with reverse filtering function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a side slope prefabricated triangular steel pipe net piece protection structure with a reverse filtering function, which comprises connecting pieces, a steel pipe net piece body and planting bags, wherein the connecting pieces are fixedly arranged on anchor rods on the surface of a side slope, a plurality of steel pipe net piece bodies are fixedly arranged above the side slope through the connecting pieces, the planting bags are fixedly arranged in the middle of the steel pipe net piece body, the steel pipe net piece body is pre-built and the middle of the steel pipe net piece body is filled with the replaceable planting bags in the installation process of the protection structure, then the steel pipe net piece body and the planting bags are fixedly arranged on the anchor rods on the surface of the side slope through the connecting pieces, so that side slope soil is effectively stabilized, water and soil loss and landslide phenomena are prevented, vegetation growth is promoted, ecological restoration capability of the side slope is enhanced, meanwhile, the replaceable modularized design obviously reduces construction difficulty, flexibly copes with different side slope conditions and environmental changes, meanwhile, interference to the environment is reduced, and later operation and maintenance difficulties and cost are reduced.
assignees: CHINA OVERSEAS CONSTRUCTION LTD

title_en: Urban power distribution network toughness recovery management system under extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution network recovery, in particular to a management system for urban power distribution network toughness recovery under extreme weather, which comprises the steps of collecting voltage, current, temperature, humidity and wind speed in real time, cleaning, formatting and standardizing data, identifying abnormal conditions affecting the stability of a power grid, evaluating the performance of the power grid under the extreme weather, providing optimization suggestions, simulating various extreme weather scenes, generating feedback data, carrying out comprehensive risk evaluation, generating coping strategies, identifying fault points needing emergency treatment, scheduling restoration resources and dynamically optimizing the operation strategies of the power grid according to real-time analysis results. Feedback data generated by the system in the simulation is used to further optimize the strategy in the toughness assessment and decision support module, ensuring the adaptability and effectiveness of the strategy in actual extreme weather events.
assignees: UNIV CENTRAL SOUTH

title_en: Discrimination method for terrain transformation elevation interval of shoal-removing ecological restoration engineering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a discriminating method of a land relief and restoration ecological restoration project terrain transformation elevation interval, which relates to the technical field of terrain transformation, and comprises the steps of establishing an elevation relation between a tidal water level and the measured terrain of a to-be-restored area of a culture pond, carrying out high Cheng Fuzhi for the measured tidal water level in a hydrological annual cycle range, and determining the tidal inundation elevation of the area; and defining retire a filling area, a leveling area and a retaining area of the restoring area according to the determined high Cheng Gaizao area so as to guide the construction of the ecological restoration project of the back-raising restoring beach. By utilizing the method provided by the invention, the accurate judgment of the terrain transformation elevation interval of the shoal-returning ecological restoration area can be realized, the implementation of the shoal-returning ecological restoration project is effectively guided, the restoration of the water system of the shoal-returning restoration area retire is facilitated, and the ecological restoration efficiency of the coastal-raising abandoned land is improved.
assignees: UNIV SHENYANG AGRICULTURAL

title_en: Pumped storage power station side slope ecological restoration method and system based on near-natural concept
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pumped storage power station side slope ecological restoration method and system based on a near natural concept, and relates to the field of ecological restoration, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining the landform characteristics of a current pumped storage power station side slope and analyzing to obtain a characteristic factor sequence, obtaining the geographic position of the pumped storage power station side slope and generating a virtual model proportionally; screening plant materials in a plant material library according to the current demand condition and the characteristic factor sequence to obtain target plant materials, marking the target plant materials in a virtual model, generating a sowing strategy, simulating plant material growth vigor in the virtual model, recording virtual plant material growth vigor conditions under different periods, collecting the current plant material growth vigor conditions of a pumped storage power station side slope, comparing and analyzing the current plant material growth vigor conditions with the virtual plant material growth vigor conditions under the same period to obtain the ecological restoration evaluation of the pumped storage power station side slope, and adjusting the sowing strategy according to the ecological restoration evaluation of the pumped storage power station side slope and performing current remediation.

title_en: Park network reconstruction method considering conditional risk value
abstract_en: The invention discloses a park network reconstruction method considering conditional risk values, which comprises the steps of 1) constructing a park network reconstruction model considering distributed power supply and load uncertainty, 2) constructing a park conditional risk value model based on a risk measurement theory and adding the conditional risk value model into the park network reconstruction model, 3) constructing a park network reconstruction model restoration strategy constraint considering the conditional risk values, and 4) solving a park network fault reconstruction optimization model to obtain an optimal park network reconstruction scheme. According to the method, the optimization model of the park network reconstruction taking the condition risk value into consideration is built, the optimal reconstruction scheme of the park network is obtained, and the safety and reliability of the operation of the park system are improved.
assignees: SUQIAN WANDA ELECTRIC POWER IND CO LTD;SUQIAN POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Water area pollutant emergency treatment system and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water area pollutant emergency treatment system and equipment in the technical field of water pollution treatment, wherein the system comprises a plurality of water quality monitoring modules, a data collection module, a prediction module, an emergency pretreatment scheme generation module and a plurality of biological filtering components, wherein the water quality monitoring modules are used for collecting water quality elements of a covered area to generate real-time water quality data, the data collection module is used for acquiring, storing and converting the real-time water quality data, the prediction module is used for analyzing and predicting pollutant component evolution conditions based on the real-time water quality data by using a big data model to generate a pollutant component evolution condition map of the water area, the emergency pretreatment scheme generation module is used for generating a corresponding pretreatment scheme and a pretreatment position based on a pollutant diffusion range map and the pollutant component evolution condition map, and the biological filtering components are deployed at the pretreatment position to filter and clean the water area. According to the invention, plants aiming at specific pollutants are planted on the biological filter assembly, so that the ecological restoration can be realized for a long time while the pollutants in the water area are treated in an emergency manner.
assignees: SHAANXI DIKUANG HANZHONG DETECTION CO LTD

title_en: Power grid regulation and control operation analysis method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for analyzing power grid regulation and control operation. The method is executed by a dispatching field business digital supporting platform and comprises the steps of obtaining a change list predetermined by a dispatching OMS system from a dispatching field business digital supporting platform database, generating an operation plan according to power failure time and power restoration time in the change list, wherein the operation plan comprises operation tasks, planned power failure time and planned power restoration time of the operation tasks, analyzing task saturation according to time distribution of the operation tasks and the number of operators on duty in the operation plan, adjusting the operation plan according to analysis results, and displaying the operation tasks according to the adjusted operation plan. The embodiment of the invention can timely identify and process potential problems in an operation plan, balance the operation quantity, ensure that each operation task is completed on time, improve the overall working efficiency and provide guarantee for the safe operation of the power system.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;DONGGUAN POWER BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power grid node recovery importance assessment method, system, device and medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of large power grid recovery, and discloses a power grid node recovery importance evaluation method, a system, a device and a medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining a power failure area of a power grid based on acquired power grid monitoring state data, dividing the power failure area by a dynamic partitioning method and obtaining a plurality of parallel recovery partitions; and for the nodes to be recovered in the recovery partitions, carrying out importance evaluation on the recovery nodes according to the multidimensional index of the nodes to be recovered. According to the invention, the importance of the power generation nodes and the non-power generation nodes are unified to the expected recovery income, so that unified sequencing of the power generation nodes and the non-power generation nodes is realized, the problem that the traditional method relies on manually appointed unit recovery priority is avoided, and a good foundation is laid for subsequent recovery decision optimization.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Traveling non-contact power supply system
abstract_en: To enable a user to confirm a remaining use time and a drivable distance till power outage of a vehicle with a user riding.SOLUTION: A traveling non-contact power supply system for supply power from a roadside power supply device to a traveling vehicle with a vehicle side power reception device in a non-contact manner, includes a server that can communicate information with the vehicle, and the server acquires a power consumption state and a power remaining amount in the vehicle from the vehicle if power failure occurs, and predicts a restoration time from the power failure and a power supply amount in a route of the restored vehicle, transmits a prediction time till restoration to the vehicle by a wide area communication, and the vehicle predicts an occurrence of power outrage, and outputs a remaining use time or a drivable distance of the vehicle on the basis of the received prediction time.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9
assignees: TOYOTA MOTOR CORP

title_en: Construction method of protection system suitable for aggressive silt coast
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of silt coast restoration, in particular to a method for constructing a protection system suitable for aggressive silt coast, which adopts engineering measures such as a water permeable offshore submerged dike, a riprap bank and the like to eliminate waves in a vegetation restoration area towards the sea side, the high beach is prevented from further erosion by adopting the riprap protection ridge, and the vegetation restoration area is kept in communication with the water system of the open sea by reserving the tidal access opening, so that more proper conditions are provided for vegetation restoration, and the plant survival rate of vegetation restoration on the aggressive beach is improved. Restoring the wetland habitat of aggressive beach degradation, improving the structural integrity and functional stability of the coastal zone ecosystem, improving the capability of resisting marine disasters and guaranteeing regional ecological safety.
assignees: CHINA DESIGN GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Ecological restoration method for shallow garbage landfill of urban core mountain land
abstract_en: The application relates to an ecological restoration method for an urban core mountain shallow garbage landfill, which relates to the technical field of ecological restoration, and provides an ecological restoration method for the urban core mountain shallow garbage landfill, which accurately obtains garbage content through topographic mapping and topographic survey of the urban core mountain shallow garbage landfill, the distribution and the sampling analysis of soil, air and runoff pollution are carried out, so that garbage classification treatment of shallow garbage sites in urban core mountains is carried out, mountain disaster hidden dangers are eliminated, and soil, runoff and air pollution purification treatment is carried out, so that a landscape site is formed, and ecological restoration in multiple years is carried out. Unlike the sealing field, gouge and incineration of shallow garbage landfill in the prior art, the ecological restoration of the shallow garbage landfill in the urban core mountain area is carried out based on the aspect of ecological environment optimization, and the ecological restoration method has the effects of accurately and comprehensively implementing the restoration of the ecological environment, and long-term maintenance and formation of excellent landscape environment through the ecological restoration.
assignees: FUZHOU PLANNING DESIGN & RES INSTITUTE GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Ecological hydrologic model guided underground water super-mining ecological restoration method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological hydrologic model-guided underground water super-mining ecological restoration method, which belongs to the technical field of ecological hydrologic and comprises the following steps of S1, underground water collection and treatment, S2, model construction, evaluation and optimization, S3, underground water super-mining prediction analysis and S4, underground water super-mining ecological restoration. The invention solves the problems that the existing ecological hydrologic model can not guide the scientific and effective ecological restoration of the super-mining condition of the underground water, can not better protect the ecological environment of the underground water, and has poor ecological restoration management effect of the super-mining condition of the underground water. According to the invention, the underground water ecological real-time data is subjected to underground water super-mining prediction analysis based on the optimal ecological hydrologic model, the result of the underground water super-mining prediction analysis based on the ecological hydrologic model is determined, the underground water super-mining situation can be scientifically and effectively restored based on the ecological hydrologic model, the underground water ecological environment can be well protected, and the underground water super-mining ecological restoration management effect can be improved.
assignees: UNIV INNER MONGOLIA AGRI

title_en: Ecological restoration method for hydraulic engineering construction
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of hydraulic ecological restoration, and particularly relates to an ecological restoration method used in hydraulic engineering construction. The invention aims at a pollution area with serious river water pollution in hydraulic engineering construction as a repair area, and the repair of the pollution area comprises three aspects of river channel treatment, river flood beach treatment and step treatment. When dredging in river course treatment, the extracted sludge is filtered by a mesh screen, on one hand, the difficult degradation garbage can be removed by filtration, on the other hand, the filtered sludge is paved on the trimmed river flood beach, and the sludge can be used as waste for plant planting, so that the effective utilization of the waste is realized. Meanwhile, when the land is treated, the comprehensive vegetation system is established by utilizing plant measures of herb, arbor and shrub collocation, and the diversity of the river ecological landscape is realized. The invention adopts the form of regional treatment, can effectively improve the self-purification capability of the river channel, solves the pollution problem of the river channel and realizes ecological restoration.
assignees: HU CHENGLIN

title_en: Modeling method and system for regional water resource ecological safety evaluation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modeling method and a system for ecological safety evaluation of regional water resources, which relate to the technical field of mountain water resource management, the system obtains the current situation of regional water resources, timely discovers subareas with insufficient groundwater supply, and constructing and evaluating a mining intensity coefficient Kc through a water resource evaluation model constructed by a convolutional neural network model CNN, screening out sub-areas with excessive mining, and adopting corresponding regulation and control measures, such as limiting the mining intensity, so as to avoid the burden of the ecological environment and water resources caused by excessive mining. The ecological environment and water quality data are acquired, an ecological pressure coefficient Ep of the subarea is generated, and the subarea with higher ecological damage risk is found in time by combining a pressure early warning threshold value. The system generates corresponding water resource exploitation regulation and control modes by combining the first important monitoring group, the second important monitoring group and the third important monitoring group, and promotes sustainable management and ecological restoration of water resources in the area.
assignees: HEBEI BAODING HYDROLOGY SURVEY RES CENTER

title_en: Power grid fault positioning and outage duplicate strategy verification method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a power grid fault positioning and outage duplicate strategy verification method and device. The method comprises the steps of determining a target area distribution network model, at least one candidate fault positioning strategy and at least one candidate power outage and power restoration strategy, respectively setting fault points of the target area distribution network model according to at least one group of preset fault setting points to obtain a fault distribution network model corresponding to each group of fault setting points, and determining at least one target fault positioning strategy and at least one target power outage and power restoration strategy from the candidate fault positioning strategies and the candidate power outage and power restoration strategies for each fault distribution network model. By adopting the technical scheme of the application, the target fault positioning strategy and the target outage power restoration strategy which can rapidly realize fault positioning and outage restoration are realized under different fault conditions.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;DONGGUAN POWER BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Pumped storage power station side slope near natural ecology monitoring method, system and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and equipment for monitoring the near-natural ecology of a side slope of a pumped storage power station. The method comprises the following steps of S100, preprocessing an ecological environment point cloud picture of a pumped storage power station side slope to generate a sample data set, S300, taking the sample data set as input of a neural network, obtaining a prediction network model through learning and training the neural network, S400, predicting the current pumped storage power station side slope through the prediction network model, realizing comprehensive monitoring and evaluation of the natural ecological environment of the pumped storage power station, and taking the natural state before the pumped storage power station is built as an evaluation standard, and taking the natural ecological environment which is as close as possible to the natural ecological environment before the pumped storage power station is built as a restoration target.
assignees: STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;STATE GRID XINYUAN GROUP CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Mountain vegetation resumes support frame
abstract_en: The utility model provides a mountain vegetation restoration support frame which comprises a protection mechanism and a support mechanism, wherein the protection mechanism comprises a collection cover, a collection cavity is integrally formed in the collection cover, water passing holes are formed in one side of the collection cover in an equidistant mode and communicated with the collection cavity, a water outlet pipe is communicated with one side of the collection cover, a connecting ring is fixedly connected to the bottom of the collection cover, a slot is integrally formed in one side of the connecting ring, the support mechanism comprises two fixing plates, one sides of the two fixing plates are fixedly connected with limiting plates, one side of each limiting plate is clamped with the connecting ring through the slot, and the protection mechanism is used for collecting and guiding rainwater in overcast and rainy weather while protecting a part of vegetation, and dispersing and collecting part of rainwater into the collection cavity and discharging the rainwater to other areas through the water outlet pipe, so that the situation that the mountain local landslide is influenced by excessive flushing of the mountain is prevented.
assignees: HEILONGJIANG HAOMIAO ENG DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Scheduling method of mobile energy storage device after extreme disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a scheduling method of a mobile energy storage device after an extreme disaster, and belongs to the technical field of scheduling of mobile energy storage devices. The method comprises the steps of constructing an objective function of a scheduling model by taking minimum scheduling cost of the mobile energy storage device and minimum equivalent load loss cost of the power distribution network as targets, constructing constraint conditions of the scheduling model, solving the scheduling model, and scheduling the mobile energy storage device according to a solving result, wherein the constraint conditions comprise traffic network constraint, radial network constraint, power flow constraint, node balance constraint, mobile energy storage device scheduling constraint and distribution line restoration constraint. According to the invention, the mobile energy storage device is scheduled in real time under the condition of considering the influence of extreme disasters on traffic conditions, and the obtained scheduling scheme has optimal economy.
assignees: NANZHAO POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Method and device for determining distributed power supply restoration mode of power distribution network
abstract_en: The application relates to a method and a device for determining a distributed power supply restoration mode of a power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of sub-areas of a pre-divided active power distribution system; and according to the switching action paths and the target power supply restoration model, carrying out power supply restoration mode solving processing on the sub-areas to obtain a target restoration mode. The Monte Carlo tree search of the application effectively solves the problem of the sequence of switching actions in the power supply recovery process by continuously exploring and evaluating different topological states, and avoids the computational bottleneck faced by the traditional method when dealing with large-scale non-convex problems. And solving the power supply recovery mode by using the target power supply recovery model, wherein the obtained target recovery mode has good optimization performance.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;UNIV TIANJIN;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Hydropower station group historical runoff data reduction method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a hydropower station group historical runoff data reduction method, a system, equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the step of obtaining a runoff hydropower station reference of a reservoir hydropower station according to the runoff similarity between the runoff hydropower station and the reservoir hydropower station in the hydropower station group. According to the hydraulic characteristics of the radial hydropower station, a radial flow process referenced by the radial hydropower station is obtained, the radial flow trend is obtained based on the radial flow process, and the radial flow trend is used as a radial flow trend reference of the reservoir hydropower station. Expanding the same-time ratio of the runoff trend reference, and restoring the water level process in the period of the expanded runoff trend reference, determining the runoff process of the reservoir-capacity hydropower station by adjusting the same-time ratio of the runoff trend reference, and taking the runoff process of the reservoir-capacity hydropower station as historical runoff restoration data of the hydropower station. The method solves the problem that the historical runoff data of the hydropower station group in the related art is low in accuracy, and improves the accuracy of the historical runoff data recovery.
assignees: CHITAN HYDROPOWER PLANT OF FUJIAN HUADIAN FURUI ENERGY DEV CO LTD;HUADIAN ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;UNIV CHINA THREE GORGES CTGU

title_en: Power distribution network power failure time prediction method and system considering distributed resource access
abstract_en: The invention particularly discloses a power distribution network outage time prediction method and a power distribution network outage time prediction system considering distributed resource access, wherein when a certain element fails, power supply is restored to an upstream area of a failure point after fault isolation, power supply switching area division and switching load analysis are performed to all power supplies in a downstream area of the failure point and connection switches connected with a power failure line, if no connection switch and fault line segment exist in the power failure area, power supply restoration is waited after fault restoration, the outage time of the area is calculated, if the connection switches exist in the switching area and standby power supplies can provide electric energy support, power supply switching is performed to the area, the outage time of the area is calculated, if the standby power supplies do not exist, the situation that the distributed resources are used as power supplies is considered, and the accuracy of power outage time prediction under a novel power distribution system is improved according to different areas related to power outage.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Irrigation monitoring system for restoring original ecology of grass
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of grassland restoration, in particular to an irrigation monitoring system for grassland original ecology restoration, which comprises an irrigation data collection and analysis module, an irrigation demand prediction module, an irrigation strategy intelligent adjustment module, an irrigation equipment state monitoring module and an equipment fault automatic checking module, wherein a sensor network is deployed to collect data, the collected data are preprocessed, the accuracy of the data is improved, the prediction model is used to predict the irrigation demand, manual intervention is reduced, the irrigation strategy is automatically adjusted according to the predicted irrigation demand, the automatic management of irrigation is realized, the safety accidents caused by equipment faults are avoided by monitoring the state parameters of irrigation equipment in real time, and the fault reasons are positioned by utilizing Bayesian theorem and combining early warning signals and the equipment state parameters monitored in real time so as to immediately take measures. The method and the device are used for solving the technical problem that the monitoring management level of the current grassland restoration is not high.
assignees: GANSU GRASSLAND TECH PROMOTION GENERAL STATION

title_en: Slope collapse detection and evaluation method, device, equipment and storage medium based on remote sensing technology
abstract_en: The application discloses a slope collapse detection and evaluation method, device, equipment and storage medium based on a remote sensing technology, and relates to the technical field of remote sensing collapse detection, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining remote sensing slope environment data, slope restoration characteristic data and regional slope risk coefficients; and determining a side slope environment typical area based on the remote sensing side slope environment data, the side slope restoration characteristic data and the area side slope risk coefficient, and detecting the environment risk area based on the side slope environment typical area and evaluating the area side slope environment risk. According to the application, the remote sensing technology is used for comprehensively covering the slope area to obtain remote sensing slope environment data, slope restoration characteristic data and area slope risk coefficients, the slope scene model is intelligently processed and established to determine the typical area of the slope environment, the monitoring accuracy is improved, the environment risk area is detected again, the area slope environment risk is estimated, the stability and risk of the slope are estimated more accurately, the potential collapse risk is early warned in advance, and the slope collapse disaster is effectively prevented.
assignees: SHENZHEN WENKE ECOLOGICAL ENV CO LTD

title_en: Accelerating ransomware recovery using a combination of local and remote backups
abstract_en: Aspects of the disclosure accelerate recovery using a combination of local and remote backups. A backup selector identifies a latest unencrypted remote backup (e.g., created prior to an encrypted backup), a latest unencrypted local backup created prior to the latest unencrypted remote backup, and a penultimate unencrypted remote backup created prior to the latest unencrypted local backup. A restoration manager restores a local computing asset to the state of the latest unencrypted local backup. In a disaster recovery (DR) environment, two differences are generated: one between the latest unencrypted remote backup and the penultimate unencrypted remote backup and another between a newly-generated failback backup and the latest unencrypted remote backup. The two differences are sent to the restoration manager to roll the state of the local computing asset forward in two stages. This approach is faster and reduces egress charges in cloud-based DR environments.
assignees: VMware LLC

title_en: Power supply recovery method and device for power distribution network, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power supply recovery method and device of a power distribution network, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining historical output data, historical weather data and future weather data of a distributed power supply in a power distribution network, predicting the future output of the distributed power supply based on the historical output data, the historical weather data and the future weather data by utilizing a pre-training neural network model, obtaining a future output prediction result, and performing load shedding operation on the distributed power supply based on the future output prediction result to obtain a power supply recovery result, wherein the power supply recovery result is used for representing a power supply recovery result obtained after the load shedding operation is performed on the distributed power supply. The invention solves the technical problem of lower power restoration efficiency for the power distribution network in the related technology.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ZHONGSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Geological disaster and ecological restoration greening spray seeding device and maintenance method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a greening spray-seeding device for geological disasters and ecological restoration and a maintenance method thereof, and relates to the technical field of greening spray-seeding devices. Including mobile device, first driving motor, blowing device, the blowing device includes blowing case, storehouse seat, second sieve charging tray, first sieve charging tray, the fixed discharge chassis that is provided with of bottom outer wall of blowing case. Through starting second driving motor drive mixer rotation, the reaction efficiency of ratio liquid medicine is accelerated, drive the clear scraper blade of mixer outer wall simultaneously and continuously scrape the fertilizer of adsorbing at the inner wall of first sieve charging tray and blowing case, thereby guarantee that the medicine can intensive mixing, the pulling control handle drives the spacer pin downwards and breaks away from corresponding spacing hole, start second driving motor drive first sieve charging tray rotation, make the bin outlet expose, the liquid medicine drops via the bin outlet, carry out secondary filtering again via the second sieve charging tray, start and adjust the shower nozzle and spray the medicine.

title_en: Power grid restoring force assessment method and system under extreme weather disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid restoration force evaluation method and a power grid restoration force evaluation system under extreme weather disasters, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring power grid operation basic data and power grid restoration data for coping with expected faults under the extreme weather disasters, and performing power generation energy diversity evaluation, power preservation rate evaluation, emergency power supply availability evaluation, power supply capacity evaluation and path active power margin evaluation; and carrying out weighted summation on the evaluation results to obtain a comprehensive evaluation result of the power grid restoring force under the extreme weather disasters. The method can accurately identify potential weak links in the power grid, provide scientific basis for reasonable allocation of emergency resources, and help to formulate more effective preventive measures and emergency response plans by quantifying the influence of extreme weather disasters on the recovery capacity of the power grid, thereby remarkably improving the capacity of the power grid for resisting natural disasters, reducing economic loss and social influence caused by disaster and power failure, and showing important theoretical value and practical application value.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO;STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Landslide monitoring mechanism for ecological restoration of mine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of landslide monitoring mechanisms, and discloses a landslide monitoring mechanism for ecological restoration of mines, which comprises a supporting plate, wherein a supporting rod is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the supporting plate, a holding triggering mechanism for receiving water when the supporting plate is rained is arranged on the supporting plate, a pressure sensor is arranged on the supporting plate and is used for supporting and sensing the holding triggering mechanism, and a limiting mechanism for downwards moving and preventing the holding triggering mechanism from moving backwards is arranged on the supporting plate. The landslide monitoring mechanism for mine ecological restoration has the advantages that the trigger mechanism is contained to contain rainwater, the pre-warning effect is achieved, and the vibration is sensed by matching with the use of the liquid level sensor, so that the vibration detection effect is achieved.
assignees: UNIV SHAANXI TECHNOLOGY;SHAANXI MOSICHI NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Data processing method, device, equipment and medium based on spoil field
abstract_en: The application relates to a data processing method, a device, equipment and a medium based on a spoil field.
