The method comprises the steps of carrying out water and soil loss evaluation calculation on each target area by utilizing a water and soil loss model according to water and soil loss evaluation parameters of each target area in a target spoil field to obtain respective soil loss amount of each target area, determining respective erosion risk levels of each target area according to the respective soil loss amount of each target area, determining respective soil protection and restoration measures of each target area according to the respective erosion risk levels of each target area, obtaining rainfall and soil humidity of each target area, determining drainage demand of the target area according to the rainfall, soil humidity and soil loss amount of the target area, and controlling automatic drainage equipment installed in the target area to adjust the drainage according to the drainage demand under the condition that the soil protection and restoration measures of the target area are implemented. By adopting the method, the transformation efficiency of the spoil field can be improved.
assignees: CHINA RESOURCES QINGYUAN SOLAR POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for determining power restoration of fault distribution network and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device and electronic equipment for determining power restoration of a fault power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing an optimization model of power restoration of the fault power distribution network according to a plurality of first constraint conditions; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a main optimization model of a fault distribution network and a plurality of sub-optimization models of the normal distribution network by decomposing an optimization model according to a decomposition algorithm, solving the main optimization model and the plurality of sub-optimization models to obtain a first objective function value, a second objective function value and an objective function value respectively, determining the maximum value of the objective function value of the optimization model according to the sum of the objective function values of the sub-optimization models and the first objective function value, determining the minimum value of the objective function value of the optimization model according to the sum of the objective function values of the sub-optimization models and the second objective function value, comparing the difference between the maximum value and the minimum value with a preset threshold, and recovering power supply of the fault distribution network according to the situation. The method effectively improves the power supply recovery rate on the premise of controlling the cost.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ZHUHAI POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle communication base station and power distribution network collaborative rush-repair method and related device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooperative rush-repair method and a cooperative rush-repair related device for an unmanned aerial vehicle communication base station and a power distribution network, and belongs to the technical field of power distribution network rush-repair; the method comprises the steps of establishing an unmanned aerial vehicle deployment model with full coverage of fault point communication as a target, dispersing a region to be deployed into a point set by using a discretized position set coverage model, obtaining an optimal position to be hovered of an unmanned aerial vehicle through the unmanned aerial vehicle deployment model, introducing a path table and a time vector, establishing an unmanned aerial vehicle communication path planning model through path constraint and time constraint, establishing a power distribution network rush-repair scheduling model with minimum power failure loss and minimum fault rush-repair time of a power distribution network in a post-disaster rush-repair stage as targets through coupling constraint of fault rush-repair and material scheduling and unmanned aerial vehicle communication time sequence, rush-repair team scheduling constraint and power distribution network operation constraint, and obtaining a cooperative rush-repair strategy of a communication base station and the power distribution network through the unmanned aerial vehicle communication path planning model and the power distribution network rush-repair scheduling model based on the optimal position to be hovered of the unmanned aerial vehicle.

title_en: Parallel accelerated solution method for post-disaster restoration of power system based on quantum computing
abstract_en: The present application relates to the technical field of power system operation control, and specifically to a parallel accelerated solution method for post-disaster restoration of a power system based on quantum computing, including: step 1: establishing a model for post-disaster restoration; step 2: according to the quantum proxy Lagrangian relaxation algorithm, decomposing an original optimization problem into node subproblems; and step 3: solving the model for post-disaster restoration, updating Lagrange multipliers and penalty factors in iteration, achieving an optimal solution under the interaction of quantum computing and classical computing, and accelerating the acquisition of a restoration plan to guide a safe operation of the power system. The present application decomposes a problem into subproblems and divides the subproblems into discrete and continuous parts for solution, reducing the difficulty. The effects of parallel computing and quantum-embedding accelerated computing are realized without complete optimization for a relaxed problem, ensuring better convergence.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: Photovoltaic desertification control and characteristic sand industry planning method and system for efficiently utilizing precipitation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic desertification control and characteristic sand industry planning method and system for efficiently utilizing precipitation, and relates to the technical field of photovoltaic desertification control, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting data of a target area, designing a precipitation collection guide system of a photovoltaic board foundation based on the collected data, and maximizing collection and utilization of water resources; the method comprises the steps of collecting water resources by a precipitation collecting and guiding system, setting irrigation quota according to water demand of sand-fixing plants and traditional Chinese medicinal materials, selecting and adjusting planting configuration modes of the sand-fixing plants and the traditional Chinese medicinal materials by using the set irrigation quota and field sand-blast observation data, quantitatively analyzing economic output of different vegetation configuration modes and protection effect of vegetation, implementing planning schemes of desert photovoltaic electric field sand control and characteristic sand industry according to analysis results, and monitoring and evaluating implementation results. The invention improves the survival rate and biomass of vegetation in arid areas, effectively improves the sand fixing capability and ecological restoration effect of the desert photovoltaic electric field, and increases the economic benefit of sand industry.
assignees: HUANENG JIUQUAN WIND POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power communication network toughness evaluation method and system considering network topology association
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power communication network risk assessment, and in particular relates to a power communication network toughness assessment method and system considering network topology association, comprising the steps of obtaining a power communication super-network based on network topology; the method comprises the steps of performing supernuclear decomposition on an obtained power communication supernetwork, calculating the core centrality of the supernetwork, performing risk prediction on topological nodes of the power communication network by adopting a power communication risk prediction method, calculating the damage probability and the damage form of the power communication network, determining the node importance according to the obtained core centrality, performing node restoration by combining the node importance and the damage form, calculating the performance time response function of the power communication network according to the unblocked state of a network topological link, obtaining the damage toughness evaluation value of the power communication network based on the obtained performance time response function, and completing the evaluation of the toughness of the power communication network.
assignees: INFORMATION COMMUNICATION CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Emergency prediction and early warning method for oil spill and dangerous chemical leakage accidents on water
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency prediction and early warning method for oil spill and dangerous chemical leakage accidents on water, which comprises the following steps of establishing a basic database of a inland river, constructing an environmental ecological effect model of an oil spill event, identifying biological population changes under the influence of the oil spill event, evaluating the influence of the oil spill event on an ecological system by utilizing an eDNA macro-stripe code technology, analyzing the relation between a microbial community and environmental elements based on a biometrical method, monitoring and early warning the multidimensional degree of the oil spill event in real time, and providing a targeted pollution cleaning scheme and ecological restoration measures. According to the method, the multi-dimensional real-time monitoring and early warning of the oil spill event are realized by combining the aerial remote sensing, the ship and shore radar, the video monitoring and the buoy data and through a multi-source data fusion technology, and the traditional method usually only depends on a single data source.
assignees: CHINA WATERBORNE TRANSP RES INST

title_en: Comprehensive evaluation method for implementation effect of ecological bottom protection engineering of inland waterway
abstract_en: The invention provides a comprehensive evaluation method for implementation effects of an ecological bottom protection project of a inland waterway, belongs to the field of ecological environment protection of water transport projects, aims at the limitation and the deficiency of the existing evaluation method for implementation effects of the ecological bottom protection project of the inland waterway and the limitation and the deficiency of long-term tracking monitoring of ecological restoration effects of the ecological bottom protection project, comprises three parts, namely an integrated evaluation index system of the ecological bottom protection project of the inland waterway, a weight and scoring criterion system of each item based on the integrated evaluation index system of the ecological bottom protection project of the inland waterway and an implementation effect evaluation criterion system of the ecological bottom protection project based on a ecological compliance index (ECIR-RBPE) of the bottom protection project, and provides a clear, complete, detailed and quantifiable evaluation criterion system for implementation effect evaluation of the ecological bottom protection project of the inland waterway, thereby providing a simple and easy evaluation method for guiding structural design, material selection, engineering arrangement and long-term tracking monitoring of restoration effects of the ecological system of the ecological bottom protection project.
assignees: CHINA WATERBORNE TRANSP RES INST

title_en: Power supply recovery method and device for power distribution network, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power supply recovery method and device of a power distribution network, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining feeder line group data of a power distribution network to be subjected to power restoration, wherein the feeder line group data are used for representing data of a line set formed by a plurality of distribution feeder lines with a connection relationship in the power distribution network, performing fault analysis on the power distribution network based on the feeder line group data to obtain a power restoration initial solution set, constructing a power restoration cost objective function based on the power restoration initial solution set, wherein the power restoration cost objective function is used for representing a cost prediction function for performing power restoration on the power distribution network based on the power restoration initial solution set, and determining a power restoration objective solution set for performing power restoration on the power distribution network based on the power restoration cost objective function and the power restoration initial solution set. The invention solves the technical problem of lower power restoration efficiency of the power distribution network in the related technology.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD ZHAOQING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent recovery system for sharing mobile power supply battery cell
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent battery core recycling, in particular to an intelligent recycling system for a shared mobile power supply battery core, which comprises a detection module, a control module and a control module, wherein the detection module is used for acquiring the use state and the use parameters of the shared mobile power supply through a sensor network; the processing module is used for positioning the shared mobile power supply to be recovered in the monitoring area and notifying the collecting module to execute the recovery task. The invention aims to provide an intelligent recovery system for sharing a mobile power supply battery core, which can effectively predict the service life of the battery core, dynamically adjust recovery priority and optimize recovery time.
assignees: GUANGDONG JIASHANG NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Electric quantity data restoration method and system based on power grid operation mechanism
abstract_en: The application provides an electric quantity data restoration method and system based on an electric network operation mechanism, which comprise the steps of obtaining operation data of an electric network, carrying out data check on the operation data of the electric network by utilizing a consistency check method based on the electric network operation mechanism to obtain abnormal electric quantity data of the electric network, carrying out abnormal classification on the abnormal electric quantity data by utilizing a rule-based classification method to obtain an abnormal type to which the abnormal electric quantity data belongs, carrying out data restoration on the abnormal electric quantity data by utilizing a pre-constructed electric quantity balance model according to the abnormal type, and carrying out data check on the operation data of the electric network by utilizing the electric network operation mechanism, so that judgment errors caused by data errors are reduced, and carrying out data restoration on the abnormal electric quantity data subjected to data check by utilizing the pre-constructed electric quantity balance model so as to quickly, automatically and accurately correct the abnormal electric quantity data.
assignees: BEIJING GUODIANTONG NETWORK TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for protecting privacy in microgrids based on homomorphic encryption algorithm
abstract_en: A method for protecting privacy in microgrids based on a homomorphic encryption algorithm and relates to the technical field of microgrid control includes: designing a distributed cooperative control method for a microgrid based on distributed control theory, to achieve frequency restoration of a microgrid; defining a technical essence of privacy protection and a scope of privacy protection; designing a method for protecting privacy in microgrids based on a homomorphic encryption algorithm according to defined technical essence of privacy protection and scope of privacy protection, and protecting initial and real-time values of each distributed power source in the microgrid from disclosure to neighbor nodes, to achieve a distributed cooperative control objective in the microgrid; and verifying the method for protecting privacy in microgrids based on the homomorphic encryption algorithm through simulation experiments. The method enhances trustworthy monitoring capabilities and privacy security during distributed cooperative operation of microgrids.
assignees: HAINAN RESEARCH INST OF ZHEJIANG UNIVERSITY;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Water quality improvement method for water supply reservoir
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water quality improvement method of a water supply reservoir, which relates to the technical field of ecological restoration and comprises the steps of firstly preprocessing reservoir image and silt data, evaluating the turbidity of a water body, if the water body is turbid, adding a curing agent into an unmanned aerial vehicle, repeatedly monitoring until the water body is clear, analyzing the water body components after the water body is clear, evaluating the eutrophication degree, and if the water body is eutrophicated, adding aquatic plant seeds until the water quality is normal, otherwise, continuously monitoring. According to the invention, the curing agent is put into the unmanned aerial vehicle, so that the curing of reservoir silt is facilitated, the water body is prevented from being smelly caused by loosening of the silt, and the aquatic plant seeds are put into the unmanned aerial vehicle, so that the water quality is improved, and the water body is prevented from being eutrophicated.
assignees: NANJING WEIMI ELECTRONIC INDUSTRY INST CO LTD;NANJING FAERYIN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Environment diagnosis method and device based on numerical simulation and SVM efficient modeling
abstract_en: The invention relates to an environment diagnosis method and device based on numerical simulation and SVM high-efficiency modeling, belonging to the technical field of soil-groundwater pollution prevention and control and risk management and control, wherein the environment diagnosis method comprises the following steps: the method selects related characteristic variables related to the state of the groundwater environment and the space-time evolution, establishes an environment diagnosis model based on numerical simulation and SVM high-efficiency modeling aiming at a complex groundwater environment system under a typical condition frame, can simply realize reliable diagnosis and prognosis of soil and groundwater environment states, evolution processes and related influences of different application scenes on the premise of meeting a given condition frame, improves the accuracy, the high efficiency and the practicability of evaluation and prognosis of the environment evolution and the risk level of the complex groundwater system, protects the water and soil environment system and utilizes the resources safely, and particularly can provide powerful support for precise prevention and control restoration and high-efficiency risk management and control of soil and groundwater pollution, thereby having important practical value.

title_en: Bus journey time prediction method based on space-time diagram attention network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bus journey time prediction method based on a space-time diagram attention network, which comprises the steps of preprocessing bus arrival time data, including bus number definition, repeated record deletion, abnormal record deletion and missing record restoration, calculating interval journey time of each bus number based on the bus arrival time data to obtain average journey time of different time periods of each interval, constructing a directed network by taking the middle point of a station interval as a node of the network and taking a connecting line between the middle points of the station interval as a network edge, fusing a distance matrix and a communication matrix of the nodes to represent space characteristics between the nodes to weight the station interval network, constructing the space-time diagram attention network by taking the historical average journey time of the station interval and the journey time of the latest bus number as inputs, adopting a transfomrer encoder, a graph attention network and a full-connection layer, extracting and fusing time characteristics and space characteristics, and realizing multi-step prediction of the station interval journey time.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Electric power network asset attack surface restoration method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for repairing an attack surface of an electric power network asset, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of determining an asset attack surface according to asset data, constructing an attack surface model according to the asset attack surface and the asset data, formulating an attack surface management strategy according to the attack surface model, and repairing the attack surface model according to the attack surface management strategy. According to the method, an attack surface model is constructed according to the asset attack surface, and the attack surface model is repaired according to an attack surface management strategy generated by the attack surface model, so that the probability of each electric asset being attacked in various activities can be reduced while the accurate defense of each electric asset in the attack surface model against attacks can be improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;DONGGUAN POWER BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Disaster damage situation sensing method and system for power distribution network based on emergency communication under rain and flood
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network disaster situation awareness method and system based on emergency communication under a rainflood, which are used for establishing a power distribution network disaster situation awareness model under urban rainstorm waterlogging, establishing a communication working point location model, determining possible stop points of a mobile unmanned aerial vehicle station and an emergency communication vehicle, determining a scheduling scheme and a transfer path of the mobile unmanned aerial vehicle station and the emergency communication vehicle based on the possible stop points of the mobile unmanned aerial vehicle station and the emergency communication vehicle, taking into consideration path constraint and time constraint, establishing a vehicle-computer cooperative communication restoration model, establishing a power distribution network disaster situation awareness lifting model under urban rainstorm waterlogging based on the constructed power distribution network disaster situation awareness model under urban rainstorm waterlogging and the constructed vehicle-computer cooperative communication restoration model, and solving the power distribution network disaster situation awareness lifting model under urban rainstorm waterlogging to obtain a situation awareness lifting strategy. The invention improves the disaster situation awareness capability of the distribution network and realizes the rapid recovery of the distribution network after disaster.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Element importance evaluation method and device suitable for fault repair, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an element importance assessment method, device, terminal equipment and storage medium suitable for fault restoration, which are used for obtaining the importance assessment result of a power element based on the power supply coefficient, performance parameters and ideal solution set, and further obtaining the fault restoration priority of the power element, wherein the direct power supply capability of the power element to the load element is considered, the influence of the load element with high importance value on the power supply reliability of the power element is considered. The invention considers the actual power supply effect of the power supply element in the power grid and the power supply reliability of the important load element, so that the power supply element with the largest power supply reliability of the important load element has higher corresponding fault repairing priority, ensures that the important load element related to the power supply element with high importance can continuously obtain the preferential power supply when the power grid has fault or load fluctuation, and ensures the integral power supply capacity and reliability of the power grid.

title_en: Electrified quick repair high-voltage drop-out fuse wire clamp
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electrified quick-repair high-voltage drop-out fuse wire clamp, which comprises two operation wire clamps, wherein each operation wire clamp comprises a clamping hook, the bottom of each clamping hook is fixedly provided with a fixed block, a threaded column is screwed and penetrated on each fixed block, the top end of each threaded column is rotatably provided with a chuck, the bottom end of each threaded column is fixedly provided with a connecting block, and two sides of each connecting block are symmetrically fixed with limiting rods; the invention relates to the technical field of drop-out fuse wire clamps; according to the invention, compared with the original live working hericium erinaceus clamp, the working clamp can be hung on the power side and the load side of the drop-out fuse more conveniently, the working clamp can be conveniently installed on the drop-out fuse by the aid of the arranged operating rod matched connector, meanwhile, the length of the working clamp can be adjusted, a worker can conveniently adjust the working clamp according to actual requirements, the working clamp can realize replacement of the high-voltage drop-out fuse without power outage of a main line, quick power restoration is realized, and the problems that spare parts are insufficient and important time nodes cannot be replaced with power outage are solved.
assignees: QINHUANGDAO POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Task chain self-healing transfer prediction method and system based on parameter fingerprint holographic perception
abstract_en: The invention provides a task chain self-healing transfer prediction method and a task chain self-healing transfer prediction system based on parameter fingerprint holographic perception, which relate to the technical field of parameter transfer and comprise the steps of deploying a probe array to collect task chain parameter flow, and extracting feature tensors through a chaotic feature network to generate feature fingerprints. And storing the characteristic fingerprints into a dynamic certificate chain, and constructing a high-dimensional transfer matrix to track the performance change. And constructing a self-adaptive sensing network according to the dynamic certificate chain and the high-dimensional transfer matrix, and training an improved chaotic twin model for constructing an anomaly identification network. And generating a self-adaptive restoration strategy according to the abnormal characteristics and the historical data, and storing the self-adaptive restoration strategy into a distributed knowledge graph. And training a prediction engine based on the knowledge graph and the chaotic twin model, predicting task chain risks, and finally realizing continuous optimization through deep reinforcement learning evaluation system performance. The method and the device can effectively predict the risk of the task chain, realize self-adaptive repair and improve the stability and reliability of the task chain.
assignees: BEIJING KEJIE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Highway structure on barrier body, highway conservation and river drainage collaborative design method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction engineering, in particular to a co-design method for highway structure and highway conservation on a damming body and river drainage, which comprises the steps of sequentially arranging a stone falling groove, a filling roadbed road and a damming lake drainage groove along the cross section direction of a road from a slope toe to the far end of the damming body; the width of the rockfall groove accords with the distribution of the cumulative Weibull probability function, the geometric parameters of the rockfall groove meet the corresponding functional relation, the cross section of the flow discharge groove is in an inverted trapezoid shape, the geometric parameters of the flow discharge groove meet the corresponding functional relation, the geometric parameters of the filled roadbed meet the corresponding functional relation, and the sum of the width of the rockfall groove, the width of the bottom of the filled roadbed and the width of the top of the flow discharge groove is smaller than the total width from the toe to the far end of the dam plug body along the cross section direction of the road. The invention solves the practical problems that the existing post-disaster highway restoration design focuses on single road restoration, lacks dynamic change aiming at post-earthquake falling rocks, and is difficult to comprehensively consider the damming body leakage condition.
assignees: SICHUAN HIGHWAY PLANNING SURVEY DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE LTD

title_en: Mining area ecological restoration artificial influence weather service benefit evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mining area ecological restoration artificial influence weather service benefit evaluation method, which can be used for selecting a target mining area and a comparison mining area, obtaining loss data of vegetation of the target mining area and the comparison mining area, which are influenced by a meteorological disaster in a restoration period, constructing a meteorological re-analysis field, acquiring cloud micro physical parameters by using the meteorological re-analysis field, inverting to obtain a diffusion influence area, acquiring validity evaluation results of a human shadow operation according to the diffusion influence area, acquiring public opinion evaluation results of each participant of different time nodes on the target mining area, fitting the loss data, the validity evaluation results and the public opinion evaluation results on a time scale, and establishing a benefit evaluation model. It can be understood that the technical scheme of the invention can establish a benefit evaluation model in three aspects of loss data, effectiveness evaluation results and public opinion evaluation results, thereby achieving the establishment of a mining area ecological restoration type figure operation benefit evaluation system and forming an ecological restoration type figure operation service benefit evaluation index system.
assignees: CHENG PENG

title_en: Pump station scheduling method, equipment and medium based on image recognition farmland disaster-stricken condition
abstract_en: The application provides a pump station scheduling method based on image recognition of farmland disaster conditions, which comprises the steps of determining at least one first shooting position information corresponding to at least one first restoration image respectively under the condition that the category information of the at least one first restoration image is waterlogging category, determining a target pump station according to the at least one first shooting position information, performing image segmentation processing on the at least one first restoration image, determining waterlogging areas and non-waterlogging areas of the at least one first restoration image, determining first ratio information between the sum of areas of the waterlogging areas of the at least one first restoration image and the sum of areas of all areas of the at least one first restoration image, determining a target waterlogging level according to the first ratio information, and scheduling drainage of the target pump station according to the target waterlogging level. The application can accurately control the drainage flow and improve the drainage scheduling accuracy of the target pump station.
assignees: WUHAN RUISHAN ZHISHUI SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for determining proper threshold value for river basin vegetation restoration
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of river basin vegetation restoration and discloses a method and a device for determining a proper threshold value of river basin vegetation restoration, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining reference carbon fixation and emission reduction corresponding to a river basin reference scenario scheme in a target river basin and carbon fixation and emission reduction caused by vegetation restoration corresponding to the river basin vegetation restoration scheme; the carbon sequestration emission reduction caused by vegetation restoration comprises total water energy carbon emission reduction, total vegetation carbon sequestration and total karst carbon sequestration, a carbon sequestration objective function is constructed based on standard carbon sequestration emission reduction and vegetation restoration induced carbon sequestration emission reduction, wherein the carbon sequestration objective function takes natural constraint and vegetation restoration construction constraint as constraint conditions, and the carbon sequestration objective function is solved to obtain a proper threshold value for river basin vegetation restoration. The method can quickly and reliably calculate the proper scale of the river basin vegetation construction, provides scientific and technological support for the river basin water carbon resource simulation, evaluation, regulation and control and vegetation construction planning, and has important significance for realizing the 'double carbon' target.
assignees: YANGTZE RIVER THREE GORGES GROUP IND DEVELOPMENT BEIJING CO LTD;CHINA THREE GORGES CORP

title_en: Intelligent distribution network overhaul automatic permission data model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a distribution network dispatching automation technology in a power system, in particular to an intelligent distribution network overhaul automatic permission data model. The invention comprises a data acquisition module, a data verification module, an automatic permission module, a device condition verification module before power restoration and a data backfill module. The data acquisition module acquires related data from the distribution network OMS system and the OCS system, the data verification module performs device state consistency verification, logic verification and association verification, the automatic permission module automatically permits and generates permission information after verification passes, the device condition verification module performs verification before re-electrification on the device, and the data backfill module backfills the permission information to the distribution network OMS system. According to the invention, multidimensional data are integrated, the accuracy, reliability and efficiency of overhaul permission are improved through hierarchical verification, and overhaul safety and stable operation of a power grid are ensured.

title_en: Carbon fixation and emission reduction effect evaluation method and device for river basin vegetation recovery
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon sequestration emission reduction effect evaluation, and discloses a carbon sequestration emission reduction effect evaluation method and device for river basin vegetation restoration, wherein the method comprises the steps of calculating reference carbon sequestration emission reduction corresponding to a river basin reference scenario scheme by using a river basin land ecological system water-carbon coupling model; setting leaf area indexes and vegetation types in a target river basin, constructing a river basin vegetation recovery scheme based on the leaf area indexes and the vegetation types, calculating carbon sequestration emission reduction caused by vegetation recovery corresponding to the river basin vegetation recovery scheme by using a water-carbon coupling model of a river basin land ecological system, wherein the carbon sequestration emission reduction caused by vegetation recovery comprises total water energy carbon sequestration, total vegetation carbon sequestration and total karst carbon sequestration, and evaluating carbon sequestration effect of the river basin vegetation recovery based on reference carbon sequestration emission reduction and carbon sequestration emission reduction caused by vegetation recovery to obtain a carbon sequestration effect evaluation result. The invention comprehensively and reliably evaluates the carbon sequestration emission reduction effect of river basin vegetation restoration.

title_en: Power supply fault recovery strategy generation method, device, equipment and medium based on artificial buzzing algorithm
abstract_en: The application relates to a power supply fault recovery strategy generation method, device, equipment and medium based on an artificial buzzing algorithm. The method comprises the steps of obtaining fault types and fault isolation areas reported by a distributed FA control system, obtaining current system parameters of the power grid system, mapping preset multi-target indexes into an adaptability evaluation function of an artificial bee bird algorithm according to the fault types, the fault isolation areas and the current system parameters, and generating a power restoration strategy for a non-fault isolation area in the power grid system by using the artificial bee bird algorithm, wherein the preset multi-target indexes comprise maximization of power restoration quantity of an island area, minimization of operation quantity of a circuit breaker and minimization of power transmission loss of the island area. By adopting the method, the power supply fault can be responded quickly, and the recovery efficiency of recovering the power supply in the non-fault isolation area in the power grid system is improved.
assignees: HUIZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Ecological restoration engineering structure of metal mine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a metal mine ecological restoration engineering structure which comprises a dam body, wherein a restoration layer for planting is arranged on an inclined plane of the dam body, a fixing frame for fixing the restoration layer is arranged on the restoration layer, a plurality of mounting grooves are uniformly formed in the side surface of the restoration layer, the mounting grooves are sequentially formed from top to bottom along the inclined plane of the restoration layer, and a water storage tank for storing rainwater is arranged in the mounting grooves. The ecological restoration device has the advantages of simple integral structure, low restoration cost, reduction of the economic burden of ecological restoration, improvement of the soil-fixing capability of the ecological restoration device by planting vegetation for soil fixing through the restoration layer, prevention of water and soil loss and improvement of the ecological restoration effect, and further reduction of the restoration cost by arranging the fixing frame on the restoration layer to fix the vegetation, so that the restoration layer is prevented from sliding along with rainwater when the rainwater is flushed down from a dam body, the landslide is prevented, the fixing frame can be made of rubber or alloy, and the vegetation can be recycled after the restoration layer is not in landslide risk after soil fixing is completed.
assignees: HENAN FAENDE MINING IND CO LTD

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for tamper-proof and restoration of power system data file
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for tamper resistance and restoration of a data file of an electric power system, which relate to the technical field of safety of the electric power system and comprise the steps of calculating an initial content hash value of a file to be protected; storing file names, file contents, absolute paths and initial content hash values of files to be protected into a preset database, monitoring whether the files to be protected exist at intervals of preset time, restoring the files to be protected based on the file names, the file contents and the absolute paths of the files to be protected read from the preset database if the files to be protected do not exist, calculating current content hash values of the files to be protected if the files to be protected exist, comparing whether the current content hash values are identical to the initial content hash values, deleting the files to be protected if the current content hash values are not identical to the initial content hash values, and restoring the files to be protected from the preset database. The invention relieves the technical problem that the data file of the power system in the prior art is easy to be tampered and attacked.
assignees: NANJING SAC AUTOMATION CO LTD

title_en: Deep sea mining ecological restoration comprehensive partitioning method based on efficient attachment base
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of deep sea mining ecological restoration, in particular to a deep sea mining ecological restoration comprehensive partitioning method based on an efficient attachment base, which comprises the following steps of S1, dividing a deep sea mining area, and primarily dividing a restoration area according to geographic information, substrate type, water flow mode and ecological characteristics of the mining area; S2, carrying out demand analysis on each divided repair area, including ecological diversity recovery demand, water quality improvement demand and biological population recovery demand, and evaluating resource demand of each primarily divided repair area, and S3, carrying out optimization on the divided repair areas by combining the result of the demand analysis of the repair areas, so that the repair resources reach optimal configuration. The invention improves the utilization efficiency of resources, ensures the effect of deep sea ecological restoration and optimizes the sustainability of an ecological system.
assignees: UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES BEIJING

title_en: Self-healing power recovery method and system for power distribution network and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-healing power recovery method, a self-healing power recovery system and electronic equipment of a power distribution network. The method comprises the steps of evaluating the operation state of the power distribution network based on equipment parameters and operation parameters of the power distribution network to obtain an evaluation result, determining the operation state of the power distribution network according to the evaluation result, wherein the operation state of the power distribution network comprises one of a normal state, an abnormal state, an emergency state and a self-healing recovery state, determining an objective function from a plurality of preset objective functions according to the operation state of the power distribution network, solving the objective function to obtain a self-healing power restoration strategy of the power distribution network, and carrying out power restoration on the power distribution network based on the self-healing power restoration strategy. The invention solves the technical problem of low effectiveness of the self-healing power recovery scheme of the power distribution network.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ZHONGSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Power distribution network fault rush-repair scheduling system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network fault rush-repair scheduling system and method, which relate to the technical field of rush-repair scheduling and comprise the following steps of collecting power distribution network operation data, constructing a device health degree evaluation index set, and outputting a device fault probability distribution map through a fault probability prediction model; the method comprises the steps of establishing a device space topology database based on a geographic information system, positioning fault points through a Dijkstra algorithm and generating three-dimensional geographic coordinate labels, establishing a multi-dimensional rush repair resource portrait library, recording the skill level of a rush repair team, the stock state of materials and the real-time position information of a vehicle, establishing a dynamic priority evaluation model, generating a rush repair task priority sequence according to the emergency degree of the fault, influencing the user level and the criticality of the device, solving a rush repair resource scheduling scheme through a multi-objective gray-wolf optimization algorithm, setting an objective function in the direction of minimizing response time, path cost and resource wave rate, issuing an optimal scheduling instruction through a cooperative scheduling platform, and continuously monitoring the task execution state.

title_en: Ecological evaluation method for water environment index of mountain gorge valley type stream
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological evaluation method for water environment indexes of mountain canyon type stream. By comprehensively analyzing the profile of the research area, including natural geography, land utilization, geological structure, human activity influence and the like, a long-term ecological monitoring network is established to evaluate the service function value of the ecological system. Optimizing equipment and an analysis method in hydrologic characteristic monitoring, accurately calculating flood and dead water flow and considering climate change influence. The water quality monitoring adopts an optimization scheme, deepens pollution source analysis and establishes an early warning system. The method for improving the biodiversity investigation refines the protection of rare endangered species and promotes the public participation. The comprehensive evaluation of the health of the ecological system perfects an index system, optimizes an evaluation method and proposes refined ecological restoration and protection suggestions. The invention can comprehensively and accurately evaluate the mountain canyon stream water environment, provide scientific basis and effective strategy for ecological protection and sustainable development, and improve the management level of the ecological system.

title_en: Hydraulic engineering ecological slope protection maintenance method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic engineering ecological slope protection maintenance method which comprises the steps of carrying out comprehensive physical inspection on a slope surface of the slope protection, adopting a sample method or unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing to evaluate vegetation coverage degree, detecting physical properties and chemical properties of slope protection soil, inspecting the growth change of the slope protection vegetation, the stability condition of the slope surface and the running condition of a drainage system, carrying out vegetation maintenance, optimizing an irrigation strategy and a fertilization strategy by using a genetic algorithm, regularly trimming the vegetation, reinforcing the slope surface when the slope surface is slightly loosened or cracked, timely repairing the slope surface when the slope surface is damaged by great damage, carrying out inspection and maintenance on the drainage system, carrying out pest control on the slope protection vegetation, and carrying out monitoring and ecological restoration on the surrounding environment of the slope protection. The method can find potential slope problems and vegetation changes in time, has scientific decision basis and advanced technical means in the operations of watering, fertilizing, pest control and the like in maintenance measures, and avoids resource waste and negative influence on the environment.
assignees: POWERCHINA CHENGDU ENGINEERING CORP LTD

title_en: system
abstract_en: To provide a system.SOLUTION: A system comprises: means for performing a base station design on the basis of geographic information including population and landmark information; means for determining, on the basis of an area coverage ratio, a construction start priority of a base station planned by the base station design; and means for determining, on the basis of road information and field information collected in real time at the time of a disaster, a recovery priority of the base station.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

abstract_en: To determine by an AI, enumeration of elements in coping with restoration corresponding to a disaster, and data of a system required for coping with a disaster, for planning a plan quickly.SOLUTION: A system comprises: means for enumerating elements related to coping with restoration corresponding to a disaster; means for determining by an AI, data of a system required for coping with a disaster; and means for planning a plan quickly.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: To effectively issue information related to measures and actions necessary for the present day which requires the enhancement of disaster prevention consciousness by providing means for acquiring local hazard information from positional information, and analyzing a time necessary for the measures and restoration at the occurrence of a disaster.SOLUTION: A system includes means for acquiring local hazard information from positional information, and means for analyzing a time necessary for measures and restoration at the occurrence of a disaster on the basis of the acquired information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: SOFTBANK GROUP CORP

title_en: Water area ecological resuscitation scheme assessment method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a water area ecological restoration scheme assessment method, a device, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of polluted water area treatment and ecological restoration. The method comprises the steps of determining a target water area scale matrix based on an ecological restoration target and an implementation initial stage, determining a fuzzy consistency matrix corresponding to the scale matrix based on a fuzzy consistency algorithm, normalizing the fuzzy consistency matrix to obtain a weight vector corresponding to a feedback index, determining comprehensive weights, determining a target protection scheme based on sequencing of the comprehensive weights, determining the comprehensive weights based on the fuzzy consistency algorithm by scaling the water area feedback index and the protection scheme, determining the target protection scheme, defining the initial point of water area ecological restoration, comprehensively focusing on the feedback index, determining different protection schemes for different restoration stages, reducing resource waste and improving water area ecological restoration efficiency.
assignees: POWERCHINA HUADONG ENGINEERING CORP LTD

title_en: Method for realizing fee clearing electricity overtime early warning by big data technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing overtime early warning of charge clearing and power restoration by a big data technology, which comprises an information acquisition module connected with a power system and used for acquiring user payment information and searching user specific information, an information processing module which is constructed and used for dividing users into primary, secondary and tertiary power restoration according to power failure time, an external service staff management module which is arranged for managing the states of the external service staff and supporting the external service staff scheduling of the tertiary power restoration requirements, and a scheduling module which is used for predicting the time of the external service staff to reach the scene. In addition, an inspection time prediction module is further arranged, the inspection time is predicted according to the historical power equipment overhaul information, and overhaul reports are generated and sent to the field crews. And the early warning module is used for comprehensively scheduling and checking the time prediction result and sending the duplicate time early warning to the user. The method realizes the efficient and automatic management of the charge clearing current flow, and improves the power service efficiency and the user satisfaction.

title_en: Power proxy service system and method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence-based power agent service system and method, which comprise the steps of collecting power data in real time through a smart electric meter and a sensor, uploading the power data to a cloud platform for preprocessing and marking through an Internet of things, utilizing time sequence analysis, regression, SVM and LSTM methods, combining weather, season and holiday factors to predict power load, optimizing power grid load dispatching through reinforcement learning or genetic algorithm, automatically allocating, monitoring power equipment states in real time through the sensor, predicting fault risks, giving an alarm in advance, providing energy-saving advice according to historical power utilization data of a user, adjusting equipment operation modes in real time, pushing personalized power utilization advice by intelligent customer service based on natural language processing, guaranteeing data safety by adopting encryption technology and multiple identity authentication, and periodically conducting security audit and vulnerability restoration.
assignees: GUANGZHOU LESHUN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Abnormal data evaluation and repair method based on power system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing of power systems, and discloses an abnormal data evaluation and repair method based on a power system, which comprises the following steps of S1, data preprocessing; S2, an abnormal data evaluation model, S2.1, incomplete data identification by using a K-nearest neighbor algorithm, S2.2, inaccurate data identification by using a time sequence abnormal detection method based on a sliding window, S2.3, abnormal data restoration, S3.1, incomplete and inaccurate marked data restoration by using a weighted mean correction model, S3.2, incomplete data restoration by using an ARIMA prediction model, S4, correction result fusion, and comprehensive correction of different types of abnormal data is formed by combining weighted mean correction and ARIMA prediction results by using a weighted ARIMA fusion correction model. The strategy of multi-algorithm fusion avoids the possible limitation caused by a single algorithm, thereby improving the accuracy and pertinence of abnormal data identification.
assignees: INFORMATION & COMM CO STATE GRID HEILONGJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Watershed vegetation restoration optimization layout method, device, equipment, medium and product
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronics and discloses a river basin vegetation restoration optimization layout method, a device, equipment, a medium and a product, wherein the method is characterized in that through annual average water supply capacity and vegetation ecological water demand of each partition in a target area, partitions with annual average water supply capacity larger than vegetation ecological water demand in different partitions are determined as target partitions, vegetation degradation areas are determined based on the target partitions and are used as target units for vegetation restoration construction, target construction areas respectively corresponding to different types of vegetation in the target partitions are determined, gridding treatment is carried out on the target units to obtain a plurality of grids, and fitness grade indexes respectively corresponding to different types of vegetation are calculated in the corresponding grids based on weather geographic element information of each grid obtained in advance; and determining a river basin vegetation restoration optimization layout scheme in the target area based on the fitness grade indexes respectively corresponding to different types of vegetation and the target construction areas respectively corresponding to different types of vegetation laid in the grid.
assignees: YANGTZE RIVER THREE GORGES GROUP IND DEVELOPMENT BEIJING CO LTD;CHINA THREE GORGES CORP

title_en: Soil and water conservation device for ecological restoration of stone slope
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water and soil retaining device for ecological restoration of a stone slope, which comprises a stone slope protection body, wherein the surface of the stone slope protection body is vertically and downwards dredged along the slope of the stone slope protection body from top to bottom and is provided with a plurality of pore canals, anchor rods are arranged in each pore canal, a slope protection net is laid on the surface of the stone slope protection body, a concrete layer is sprayed on the surface layer of the stone slope protection body, a concrete enclosure is poured on the edge of the upper end of the concrete, a plurality of first partition columns and second partition columns are arranged on the inner wall of the concrete enclosure in a crisscross manner, a first soil layer, a straw layer and a second soil layer are laid in each planting frame from bottom to top, reservoir tanks are downwards arranged at the upper end and the lower end of the stone slope protection body, and a cover plate is detachably connected to the opening end of each reservoir tank. The invention not only can strengthen the inside of the stone slope and improve the stability of cairn so as to reduce the risk of landslide, but also can reduce the probability of water and soil loss of the slope in the later ecological restoration so as to achieve the effect of water and soil conservation.
assignees: YUNNAN FORESTRY TECH COLLEGE

title_en: Method and system for deducting scene of water traffic accident
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of scene simulation and discloses a method and a system for deducing scene of a water traffic accident, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing an accident scene based on pre-acquired accident information, constructing scene elements of the accident scene by combining a sand box game concept to obtain an original video file of scene restoration of the accident, editing and synthesizing the original video file of scene restoration of the accident and a video of a traffic accident scene by utilizing a film and television editing technology to obtain an edited accident video file, carrying out information matching processing on the edited accident video file and the accident information, and storing a processing result to obtain an accident database. The invention can realize scene simulation of events such as ship traffic accidents, search and rescue on water and the like.
assignees: TRANSP PLANNING AND RESEARCH INSTITUTE MINISTRY OF TRANSP CHINA

title_en: Mine restoration water and soil loss prevention device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a mine restoration waterproof soil loss device which comprises a spliced protective structure and inclined fixing pin rods, wherein the spliced protective structure is provided with a plurality of groups, the plurality of groups of spliced protective structures are arranged and fixed, the side ends of two adjacent groups of spliced protective structures are connected and fixed through the inclined fixing pin rods, the spliced protective structure consists of ground fixing piles, a protective blocking net structure, ground entering anchor rods and blocking net fixing bolts, the protective blocking net structure is fixed on the top side surface of the ground fixing piles through the blocking net fixing bolts, the ground entering anchor rods are provided with a plurality of groups, and the upper ends of the plurality of groups of ground entering anchor rods are fixed in the ground fixing piles. The utility model optimizes the setting of mine restoration for preventing water and soil loss, designs the problem that soil and water can be locked, landslide and water and soil loss are prevented, and the structure sectional type design can be used for process installation operation, has simple connection and fixing modes and is suitable for popularization and use.
assignees: HAN ZIWEN

title_en: Method for accurately selecting heavy metal pollution farmland restoration measures based on rhizosphere evaluation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological environment protection, and discloses a method for accurately selecting heavy metal polluted farmland restoration measures based on rhizosphere evaluation. The method for accurately selecting heavy metal polluted farmland restoration measures based on rhizosphere evaluation comprehensively considers the heavy metal pollution conditions in soil and agricultural products and the heavy metal pollution level of soil microorganisms under heavy metal stress, comprehensively evaluates the heavy metal pollution level of farmland, combines the pH of the soil and the heavy metal content condition in irrigation water, selects proper soil restoration measures, can accurately restore heavy metal polluted farmland, reduces heavy metal content and ensures the quality of agricultural products, compared with large-scale soil restoration, can carry out partition restoration on farmland through accurate evaluation, improves restoration effect, reduces restoration cost, basically does not influence normal production of farmers, and realizes restoration-side production.
assignees: GUANGZHOU ECOLOGICAL RES CO LTD

title_en: Network management device, method, and program
abstract_en: A network management device according to one embodiment of the present invention includes: an extraction unit that, on the basis of prediction information for an area in which a disaster occurs, extracts a building in an area in which a failure is predicted to occur in communication by the disaster reaching a communication facility, from among buildings which constitute a network configuration of a plurality of areas and which have communication facilities accommodated therein; a resource calculation unit that, under the condition of assuming that the failure indicated by the prediction information has occurred, calculates a resource to be used for a restoration work, of the failure, on the building extracted by the extraction unit; and a plan processing unit that, when a communication failure has actually occurred in the building extracted by the extraction unit, plans the restoration work, of the occurred failure, on the building extracted by the extraction unit, by using the resource calculated by the resource calculation unit.
assignees: NIPPON TELEGRAPH & TELEPHONE

title_en: Optimal configuration method of off-grid wind power hydrogen production system considering full life cycle benefits
abstract_en: The invention provides an optimal configuration method of an off-grid wind power hydrogen production system considering full life cycle benefits, which comprises the following steps of receiving original data, carrying out abnormal value detection and missing value restoration, obtaining multi-scale component data through empirical mode decomposition, generating a time sequence feature matrix, extracting equipment performance feature parameters, establishing a performance prediction model, establishing a system dynamic model based on a Bond Graph method, carrying out stability analysis, calculating various costs and system benefits of the full life cycle, generating a comprehensive evaluation matrix by combining risk analysis, constructing a multi-objective optimization function, solving by adopting a gray wolf algorithm, generating an optimal configuration scheme, and carrying out simulation verification and sensitivity analysis on the optimal configuration scheme to generate a final configuration scheme. The invention fully considers the equipment performance attenuation law and the system dynamic characteristic, and improves the accuracy and the reliability of the optimal configuration.
assignees: ANHUI HUASAI ENERGY TECH CO LTD;ANHUI YOUSAI TECH CO LTD;ANHUI YOUSAI ELECTRICAL EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact type power-off and power-on detection system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact type power outage and restoration detection system, which relates to the technical field of intelligent power grid detection and comprises an application layer, a module processing layer, a protocol layer, a driving layer and a hardware layer, wherein the application layer comprises an uplink communication module, a data acquisition module, a data storage module and a parameter storage module, the data storage module and the parameter storage module form a storage module, the storage module is also in interactive connection with a user layer interface, the module processing layer is used for processing a carrier module, and the protocol layer comprises a data processing module, an RS-485 communication protocol, a data acquisition module, a phase identification module, a power failure identification module, a data storage module, a protocol uploading management module and a dog feeding module. According to the non-contact type power outage and restoration detection system, the non-contact type power outage and restoration detection device and the power outage and restoration position accurate identification method are researched, power outage data acquisition, arrangement and analysis work of the tail end power grid are achieved, data support is provided for application of the intelligent power distribution network big data technology, the actual effect of a power grid feedback link can be further enhanced, and a user can obtain more accurate and high-quality power service.
assignees: SICHUAN SIJI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Water supply network safety evaluation system and method based on multidimensional data fusion
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of pipe network management. A water supply network safety assessment system and method based on multi-dimensional data fusion are provided. The method comprises the steps of collecting static data and dynamic data of a water supply network by a data collecting module, further processing and processing the static data and the dynamic data collected by the data collecting module by a data processing module, inputting the static data and the dynamic data processed by the data processing module into a model prediction module, predicting to obtain the safety grade of the water supply network, generating a safety risk assessment report of the water supply network by a risk assessment module based on the safety grade of the water supply network and combining urgency of user demands, road traffic flow intensity and geographic particularities of pipeline layout, and making a priority restoration and transformation strategy by a decision support module according to the safety risk assessment report. The invention can formulate a more reasonable priority repair and transformation strategy, reduce the complexity of the transformation of the water supply network and improve the transformation effect.
assignees: HANGZHOU WATER SHUZHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mine ecological restoration carbon fixation rate prediction method
abstract_en: The invention aims to solve the problems of the existing ecological restoration carbon fixation rate prediction method and provides a mine ecological restoration carbon fixation rate prediction method. The method comprises the following steps of 1, integrating data to construct a dynamic prediction model of the carbon fixation rate change of the ecological restoration of the mine, 3, verifying and optimizing the prediction model by using historical data and field observation data, and 4, establishing a quantitative relation between the carbon fixation rate change and the ecological restoration means of land utilization, vegetation coverage and soil properties by adopting a machine learning technical means for the optimized prediction model. The method overcomes the influence of extreme climate events on the carbon sequestration rate of the ecological system, can accurately predict the carbon sequestration rate change trend under different ecological restoration strategies in the future, and provides powerful scientific basis for ecological restoration of mining areas.
assignees: ANSTEEL GROUP MINING IND CO LTD

title_en: Data quick recovery method applied to server cluster
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computers and discloses a data quick recovery method applied to a server cluster, which comprises the following steps of S1, storing a plurality of data copies in at least two cloud platforms and at least two geographic areas through cross-cloud platform and cross-regional redundancy design, S2, deploying computing and storage resources on edge computing nodes in the server cluster, and recovering data of the local copies preferentially through the edge computing nodes when a disaster occurs, and S3, intelligently selecting a recovery path according to real-time network bandwidth and delay, and dynamically optimizing a network path for data recovery. The method comprises the steps of deploying computing and storage resources at edge computing nodes, realizing local priority recovery, optimizing network paths, improving data recovery speed, adopting cross-cloud platform and cross-regional redundancy design, solving the problem of single-point failure, improving system reliability, combining intelligent recovery priority computing and dynamic scheduling, ensuring priority recovery of key data, and optimizing disaster recovery efficiency.
assignees: BEIJING HANXINSHENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Hydraulic engineering control method and system based on water system communication condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic engineering control method and a hydraulic engineering control system based on a water system communication condition, and relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering. Inputting the data into a river and lake health evaluation multichannel, generating a health evaluation vector, and calculating standard state deviation to form a health deviation vector. And (5) making a hydraulic engineering control decision based on the deviation vector, and constructing a river and lake resuscitation decision space. And optimizing the decision space by combining the recovery optimizing factors to generate a first strategy of river and lake recovery. And carrying out water system communication evaluation, constructing communication conditions, and optimizing a resuscitation strategy based on the communication conditions to form a final river and lake resuscitation scheme. Thereby achieving the technical effects of comprehensively considering the effective river and lake resuscitating decision of the water system communication and water ecological restoration mutual feedback process and remarkably improving the ecological restoration effect.
assignees: WATER RESOURCES RES INST SHANDONG PROVINCE

title_en: Fail-safe automatic mains-electricity cutoff
abstract_en: A fail-safe automatic mains-electricity cutoff system and method for automatic disconnection from a mains service drop in the event of mains power outage or instability, and automatic reconnection after restoration of stable mains power, with indications of operational status through a unit display, an indicator light, and an RF communication link to a remote unit. A unit enclosure having a unit door and a ground bus houses the fail-safe automatic mains-electricity cutoff system which is installed on the mains service drop, below the electrical meter and above the main breaker panel or main service disconnect switch. Low-voltage DC power for system operation is supplied through a battery unit. Disconnection and connection to mains power is effected through a switching unit providing a mains-voltage sensor, a fail-safe switch and a fail-safe switch actuator. A premises-voltage sensor and current sensor can also be provided in embodiments. A controller controls operation of the fail-safe automatic mains-electricity cutoff system based on real-time measurements and programmed operational parameters, and records and reports system status and measurements.
assignees: ELECTRICAL SAFETY PRODUCTS LLC

title_en: Resource Allocation for Power, Communication, and Transportation Infrastructure Restoration usingDistributed Fiber Optic Sensing
abstract_en: Disclosed are integrated systems and methods that utilize a network of DFOS sensors installed on power lines, communication networks, and transportation systems, which continuously monitor infrastructures and provide real-time data. This data is collected, processed, and analyzed, and used to identify any affected areas of infrastructure and assess severity of any damage. Prioritization and resource allocation is performed and uses this analysis to prioritize restoration efforts and allocate resources such as repair crews, equipment, and materials to areas with a highest priority.
assignees: NEC LAB AMERICA INC

title_en: System and method for compressing and restoring data using hierarchical autoencoders and correlation networks
abstract_en: A system and method for compressing and restoring data using a hierarchical multi-level autoencoder architecture and correlation network. The system compresses data using a cascade of autoencoders, each focusing on different scales or features, allowing for efficient representation across various resolutions. Data restoration employs a corresponding hierarchical decoder structure and a correlation network, trained on cross-correlated data sets. This approach leverages inter-data relationships at multiple scales, potentially recovering more lost information than traditional single-scale methods. The hierarchical structure adapts to diverse data types, achieving higher compression ratios while maintaining data quality, applicable to fields such as remote sensing, IoT data processing, and multimedia compression.
assignees: ATOMBEAM TECHNOLOGIES INC

title_en: Method and system for tracing on-site power supervision service behavior based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power correlation, and provides a tracing method and a tracing system of field power supervision service behavior based on a block chain, which are used for solving the problem of difficult video tracing in the current power service, saving video data of a power monitoring area to the block chain, and extracting abnormal events from the collected video data of the power monitoring area, matching the extracted abnormal events with the complete video data stored in the power monitoring area of the blockchain, and calling the video data corresponding to the abnormal events on the blockchain according to a matching result. When the data is stored in the blockchain server and confirmed, the data cannot be tampered or deleted, so that the integrity and the safety of the data can be ensured, the data is prevented from being tampered or damaged maliciously, the tracing time can be increased, and the abnormal events in the video are extracted and the corresponding video data are called, so that more comprehensive and three-dimensional event restoration is provided.
assignees: MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY METERING CENTER

title_en: Wind-solar combined power generation power prediction method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a wind-solar combined power generation power prediction method and a wind-solar combined power generation power prediction system based on deep learning, which relate to the technical field of wind-solar power generation, and comprise the steps of acquiring a historical meteorological data set and a historical power generation data set in a preset area; performing outlier detection and missing value restoration on a historical meteorological data set to generate a target historical meteorological data set and a problem mask, splicing the target historical meteorological data set and the problem mask to generate a modeling input matrix, performing missing value restoration on the historical generating capacity data set to obtain a target historical generating capacity data set, constructing a wind-light generation combined prediction model based on deep learning, training the wind-light generation combined prediction model according to the modeling input matrix and the target historical generating capacity data set, obtaining a trained wind-light generation combined prediction model by monitoring the change of a preset loss function, collecting real-time meteorological data of a preset area, and predicting wind-light combined power according to the trained model and the real-time meteorological data. In this way, accurate prediction of wind and solar power generation is achieved.
assignees: UNIV GUIZHOU NORMAL

title_en: Ancient landform restoration method, system, computer equipment and storage medium
