abstract_en: The invention discloses an ancient landform restoration method, a system, computer equipment and a storage medium, which relate to the technical field of oil and gas geophysical exploration engineering and equipment, and the method comprises the following steps: establishing a profile restoration well-connecting grid section corresponding to a preset submerged carbonate slope area, and determining a thickness distribution relation between upper-layer granular carbonate rocks and lower-layer deep water carbonate rocks of the preset submerged carbonate rock deep slope area based on basic data of the preset submerged carbonate rock deep slope area; according to the basic data of the preset submerged carbonate deep water slope area, specific data of preferable earthquake attributes are obtained, a preferable earthquake attribute graph is constructed based on the specific data of the preferable earthquake attributes, and the thickness distribution relation between the upper granular carbonate and the lower deep water carbonate of the preset submerged carbonate deep water slope area is thrown onto the preferable earthquake attribute graph to obtain the paleo-topography of the preset submerged carbonate deep water slope area.

title_en: Novel ecological restoration structure for high-steep side slope and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel high-steep slope ecological restoration structure and a construction method thereof, wherein the novel high-steep slope ecological restoration structure comprises a slope stabilizing base unit, a soil nail anchoring assembly and a dynamic permeable guard plate, the surface of the slope stabilizing base unit is covered with an ecological base material layer, the slope stabilizing base unit comprises a plurality of anti-slip stabilizing slope modules distributed along a slope surface array, each anti-slip stabilizing slope module comprises a rigid supporting body, a mortise part is formed on the outer surface of one side of each rigid supporting body, a continuous anti-slip action surface is formed on the inner surface of the other opposite side of each rigid supporting body, the adjacent rigid supporting body is connected with the mortise part through the tenon part in an embedded mode, the soil nail anchoring assembly is connected with the rigid supporting body through a telescopic permeable connecting piece, and the telescopic permeable connecting piece comprises an elastic energy storage supporting assembly and a water absorption expansion body. According to the invention, by constructing the slope stabilizing matrix unit, the ecological restoration effect of the slope is greatly improved, and the occurrence risk of geological disasters such as landslide is reduced.

title_en: Micro-grid post-disaster power supply recovery method and system considering fuel supply elasticity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for recovering power supply of a micro-grid after disaster, which take fuel supply elasticity into consideration. Firstly, a motion path model of a fuel vehicle in a traffic network is built, then fuel consumption models of the fuel vehicle and a gas turbine are respectively built, a micro-grid power supply restoration optimization model considering fuel margin limitation is built, and finally linearization processing and solving are carried out on the built model to obtain a micro-grid power supply restoration optimization result. According to the technical scheme, the fuel supply elasticity is considered in the micro-grid power supply recovery process, so that the continuous and reliable operation of the gas turbine is ensured, and the reliability of the micro-grid power supply recovery scheme after disaster is effectively improved.

title_en: Excavation downhill slag slide pile body slope zoning grading durable control method
abstract_en: The application discloses a regional and hierarchical durable control method for a side slope of an excavation downhill slag pile, which belongs to the technical field of geological disaster management and ecological restoration, the method comprises the steps of firstly carrying out detailed investigation on the excavated side slope of a collapse pile to obtain basic data, then carrying out overall and local stability evaluation according to the basic data and the actual condition of the side slope, and obtaining the overall and local stable states of the excavated slope, classifying the excavated slope according to the deformation damage characteristics and the stable states in a partitioning way, integrating the partitioning and classifying results, and finally, formulating corresponding geological disaster management and ecological restoration schemes based on the partitioning and classifying comprehensive results. Aiming at the characteristics Shi Ce of different areas and grades of slopes, the method organically combines geological disaster management and ecological restoration, can improve the stability of the slopes, reduce the risk of collapse and landslide, ensure engineering safety, promote ecological protection and recovery, reduce the negative influence of disasters on surrounding ecology, realize win-win of engineering construction and ecological protection, and lay a foundation for sustainable development.

title_en: Underwater data center annular layout method combining offshore wind turbine pile foundation scour inhibition and ecological breeding
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater data center annular layout method combining offshore wind turbine pile foundation scouring inhibition and ecological breeding, and belongs to the technical field of offshore wind power engineering. The method solves the scouring problem of the pile foundation of the offshore wind power facility caused by ocean currents and waves. The method comprises the steps of arranging a plurality of UDC modules on the seabed around the pile foundation of the offshore wind turbine to form annular layout, inducing water flow to form reverse secondary vortex so as to reduce the main vortex strength, and arranging an ecological breeding system above the annular area, wherein the ecological breeding system comprises an algae plant area positioned at the upper layer, a mollusc breeding area positioned at the middle layer and a sedimentation area positioned at the lower layer. The annular layout and the biological anti-scour mechanism of the ecological breeding system cooperate to realize comprehensive optimization of ecological restoration, carbon sink gain and economic benefit, and the ecological anti-scour system is suitable for various offshore wind power installation environments, and is particularly suitable for high scour risk or typhoon frequent areas.
assignees: OCEAN UNIV CHINA

title_en: Function-restorable wall and modeling method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a function-restorable wall and a modeling method thereof, wherein the function-restorable wall comprises a hinged wall, self-resetting friction energy dissipation devices, gravity columns and bottom beams, the bottom of the hinged wall is hinged with the bottom beams, the gravity columns are arranged on two sides of the hinged wall and are connected with the hinged wall through a plurality of groups of self-resetting friction energy dissipation devices, the bottom of the gravity columns is hinged with the bottom beams, and the self-resetting friction energy dissipation devices adopt a hierarchical friction structure to realize smooth conversion of static friction and dynamic friction and provide friction energy dissipation and self-resetting capability after earthquake. The self-resetting and energy consumption of the wall body are realized by utilizing the recovery capability of the self-resetting energy consumption friction device, the technical problems of complex self-resetting structure and high construction difficulty of the existing restorable function concrete shear wall are overcome, other parts of the reinforced concrete shear wall structure are not damaged or are low in damage, the post-earthquake restoration difficulty of the reinforced concrete shear wall structure is reduced, the post-earthquake function restorability of the reinforced concrete structure is improved, and the influence of earthquake disasters on normal life and production is reduced.
assignees: UNIV JIANGSU SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Roadbed cavity accurate grouting device and grouting method
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the technical field of road disaster restoration, in particular to a roadbed cavity accurate grouting device and a grouting method, comprising a first detection unit, a second detection unit and a grouting device, wherein the first detection unit is used for detecting a roadbed cavity; the invention discloses a roadbed cavity grouting device, which comprises a first detection unit, a hole digging mechanism, a second detection unit and a grouting mechanism, wherein the first detection unit is used for detecting the roadbed cavity, the hole digging mechanism is used for punching a first filling hole communicated with the roadbed cavity above the roadbed cavity detected by the first detection unit, the second detection unit comprises a detection rod and a detection end head, the detection end head is positioned at one end of the detection rod, the detection rod is connected with one end of the detection end head and is used for being inserted into the roadbed cavity from the first filling hole, and the detection end head is used for scanning the shape of the roadbed cavity.
assignees: SHANDONG HI SPEED ENG CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Method for evaluating ecological effect intensity of typhoons in upper ocean layer in summer
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of typhoon strength evaluation, and provides a method for evaluating the strength of the ecological effect of typhoons on the ocean upper layer in summer, which is based on dynamic change information of the response typhoons of ocean upper layer ecological factors obtained by using ocean multidimensional stereoscopic observation modes such as satellite remote sensing, aviation remote sensing, various buoys, shore-based observation, navigation observation, field sampling and the like, and from the perspective of ecological effect, the ecological influence strength of the typhoons on the response sea area through chlorophyll a is evaluated by calculating the accumulated change of chlorophyll a concentration in a mixed layer during the period of the typhoon passing through the border and the period of 8 days at most, and the ecological phenomena such as regional algal bloom, fish shoal aggregation and the like caused by short-term increase of the primary productivity of the ocean upper layer are explained. The method can provide assessment industry decision basis for aspects such as management of China coastal typhoons in the ocean pasture and high-quality development of the deep-open sea fishery industry, management of ocean ecological disasters, restoration and protection of ocean ecology and the like, and is also a specific direction of ocean big data fusion and application.
assignees: CETC GUOHAIXINTONG TECH HAINAN CO LTD

title_en: Rock mine side slope protection restoration structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a rock mine slope protection and restoration structure, which belongs to the technical field of slope ecological restoration and comprises a slope main body, a reinforcing anchor rod, L-shaped nails, a multistage gentle slope platform arranged on the slope main body, a spraying maintenance assembly and an induction protection assembly, wherein a drainage system is constructed by arranging a multistage gentle slope belt, a drainage ditch and a water interception ditch, so that the water content of a slope body is reduced, geological disasters are prevented, the ecological sustainable development is realized based on a high-performance soil-plant-microorganism composite technology, the relief landscape restoration, geological disaster elimination and ecological system function restoration are considered, precise irrigation is realized according to soil humidity control, the water resource utilization efficiency is improved, an automatic cleaning mechanism in a water spray pipe is used for cleaning blockage by means of an electromagnet, a distance sensor and the like, and during initial heavy rainfall, a telescopic cylinder is controlled by a soil humidity sensor to spread out and prevent matrix from sliding down, so that slope vegetation flushing is lightened, and slope body stability is maintained.
assignees: GUANGXI TRANSP SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network collaborative power restoration method and system based on disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster-based collaborative power restoration method and system for a power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring real-time supply and demand condition data and network topology constraint information, analyzing and extracting key load node sets and power flow distribution boundary conditions to construct a resource distribution model, and obtaining an optimal distribution strategy by combining power flow analysis and a multi-objective optimization method; and determining temporary power supply network configuration and a capacity allocation scheme by combining temporary equipment access parameters, and further planning a deployment path of the temporary power supply configuration so as to deploy the temporary power supply network to perform cooperative power restoration on the power distribution network. The method can rapidly evaluate the supply and demand conditions in the post-disaster environment, optimize resource allocation, ensure key load power supply, improve the recovery efficiency and stability of the power distribution network, and provide an effective solution for rapid recovery of a post-disaster power system.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD WENZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: NSGA-II-based power grid emergency dispatching method and system under extreme disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for power grid emergency dispatching under extreme disasters based on NSGA-II, which relate to the technical field of power grid emergency management and optimization and comprise the steps of collecting power grid data to establish power grid side and user side optimization targets and constructing a multi-target dispatching model; and calculating satisfaction of the multi-objective scheme by using a fuzzy membership function, comprehensively evaluating and selecting the optimal scheme. According to the invention, by constructing a multi-objective optimization model, improving a chromosome coding mode and introducing a fuzzy membership function, comprehensive scheduling is performed on the number of rush repair teams, task allocation and path optimization, the problems of complex power grid rush repair scheduling tasks, low response efficiency and insufficient rush repair resource utilization under flood disaster conditions are solved, and the effects of improving the response speed of the rush repair tasks, optimizing the resource utilization rate and realizing optimal balance in time, resources and task completion degree are achieved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Post-earthquake urban road network restoration time sequence optimization method based on toughness evaluation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-earthquake urban road network restoration time sequence optimization method based on toughness assessment, which comprises the following steps of S1, determining a target urban traffic road network structure, obtaining a target road network earthquake damage condition, S2, confirming damaged road sections, carrying out sequencing numbering on the road sections to be restored, S3, calculating restoration time of each road section to be restored by combining constraint conditions, S4, confirming the node weight and node communication efficiency of the target road network, calculating a road network performance index, S5, taking the road network toughness optimum as a target, establishing a target function, S6, judging whether the target road network has islands, and solving the target function through a genetic algorithm to obtain the optimum restoration time sequence. Under the constraint conditions of limited time, resources and the like, the method and the system of the invention preferentially repair and eliminate the key road sections of 'island', quickly organize traffic restoration work, reduce post-disaster loss as much as possible, ensure better network restoration effect and provide theoretical support for emergency management.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Ecological restoration method for mine slope
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of mine slope restoration, in particular to a mine slope ecological restoration method which comprises the following steps of S1, on-site investigation and evaluation, and comprehensive mapping of mine slope topography and topography development by using a high-precision mapping instrument. The application has outstanding effect on the aspects of earthquake resistance and soil erosion prevention, and has the advantages that on the aspect of earthquake resistance, a deep rock mass is anchored and strengthened, large-diameter high-strength anchor ropes are adopted, foundation rocks are deeply stabilized, prestress is applied, the rock mass integrity is enhanced, reinforced concrete anti-slip piles are arranged near potential sliding surfaces, the anti-slip capability is improved, a damping ditch is excavated between a slope top and a blasting area, loose sand and stone are filled to weaken vibration energy, the earthquake resistance of a slope is comprehensively improved, a drainage system is constructed to intercept surface water when the soil erosion is prevented, vegetation is reasonably configured, planting grooves and fish scale pits are arranged, an ecological restoration composite structure layer is created, and the water erosion and soil erosion is reduced under the condition of multiple pipes in combination with a spraying grass planting and vine climbing system.
assignees: YELLOW RIVER INSTITUTE OF HYDRAULIC RES

title_en: Power load prediction method for multichannel deep learning based on attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power load prediction method based on multichannel deep learning of an attention mechanism, which comprises the steps of carrying out data preprocessing operation of outlier restoration on power load data by adopting IQR quartile range and cubic spline interpolation, setting a fluctuation channel and a smoothing channel according to fluctuation characteristics and smoothing characteristics of the power load data, constructing a load prediction model based on the deep learning of fluctuation-smoothing characteristics fusion based on the fluctuation channel and the smoothing channel, optimizing super parameters of the load prediction model based on the deep learning of fluctuation-smoothing characteristics fusion by adopting an improved leader-guided fishing optimization algorithm, training the load prediction model based on the deep learning of fluctuation-smoothing characteristics fusion by adopting the power load data after the data preprocessing operation, and predicting the power load by adopting the trained load prediction model. The comprehensive efficiency of power load prediction is improved, and the coping capability of the system to power load uncertainty is improved.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CONSTRUCTION ENG GROUP CO LTD;CHANGDIAN ZHANGYE ENERGY DEV CO LTD;ZHANGYE JINYUAN ELECTRIC POWER ENG CO LTD

title_en: Green value coordinated electric power market operation simulation deduction system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric power market operation simulation deduction system with a cooperative green value, which relates to the technical field of green energy, and comprises a characteristic record extraction module, a deviation range calculation module, a data correction module and an early warning prompt module, wherein the characteristic record extraction module is used for obtaining a historical carbon emission record of an electric power enterprise, extracting the characteristic record from the carbon emission record according to the carbon content and the generated energy in the carbon emission record, the deviation range calculation module is used for analyzing the carbon content and the generated energy change in the characteristic record to obtain a deviation range, the data correction module is used for obtaining the current carbon emission record and obtaining data with abnormal carbon content and correcting the data, and the early warning prompt module is used for judging whether to early warn a data correction technology according to the corrected virtual carbon content. According to the invention, by summarizing the historical carbon emission rules, the current carbon content correction data is analyzed, and whether the current data correction technology needs to be prompted is judged, so that the accuracy and the rationality of current data restoration are improved.

title_en: Ecological anti-slip retaining wall
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of geological disaster prevention and control, and discloses an ecological anti-slip retaining wall which comprises a slope bedrock top surface and a surface layer pile body, wherein a retaining wall is arranged on the left side of the surface layer pile body, a gravity type wall body is arranged inside the retaining wall, an anchor rod bearing platform is fixedly connected to the bottom of the retaining wall, an ecological foot wall is fixedly connected to the left side of the anchor rod bearing platform, a vegetation ecological groove is fixedly connected to the top of the anchor rod bearing platform, a plurality of locking anchor rods are fixedly connected to the bottoms of the anchor rod bearing platform and the ecological foot wall, rotating grooves are formed in the left side and the right side of the outer portion of each locking anchor rod, and rotating rods are rotatably connected to the inner portion of each rotating groove. In the utility model, the sizes of the ecological foot wall and the vegetation ecological groove are planned, then soil is filled in the vegetation ecological groove, arbor, shrub or herb is planted, the anti-slip retaining of the surface layer stack is realized, and the ecological restoration of arbor and shrub vegetation is considered.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY 14TH BUREAU GROUP QINGDAO ENG CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Hydraulic engineering risk coping decision recommendation method by collaboration of multi-mode knowledge graph and large model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic engineering risk coping decision recommendation method by synergy of a multi-mode knowledge graph and a large model, which comprises the following steps that a knowledge graph construction process is completed through a knowledge graph development module, a knowledge graph construction module and a knowledge graph optimization module, the advantages of the multi-mode knowledge graph and the multi-mode large model are combined, the knowledge of the related hydraulic engineering inspection field is fully known by the large model in a mode of generating collaborative iteration through retrieval, a targeted and most suitable countermeasure recommendation scheme is provided for the current engineering risk, and hydraulic engineering maintenance personnel are assisted in carrying out risk restoration by the scheme, so that safe and stable operation of the hydraulic engineering is ensured. The recovery of a large language model and the field of water conservancy inspection are inseparable.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA WATER RESOURCES & ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Ecological restoration method and system based on power station construction
abstract_en: The invention provides an ecological restoration method and system based on power station construction, and relates to the technical field of ecological restoration, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring the original vegetation coverage rate of a construction area where a power station is positioned in a pre-construction stage of the power station, and determining an area to be restored according to the construction area; dividing the area to be repaired into all peripheral subareas, determining target vegetation types and target vegetation coverage, determining a repair coefficient according to the original vegetation coverage, determining expected vegetation coverage according to the repair coefficient and the target vegetation coverage, acquiring the current vegetation coverage of each peripheral subarea at the post-construction stage of the power station, and generating an indication instruction corresponding to the peripheral subarea under the condition that the current vegetation coverage is smaller than the expected vegetation coverage. According to the invention, the vegetation coverage rate and vegetation types before and after the power station construction are comprehensively analyzed, the ecological restoration is carried out in targeted sub-areas, the vegetation coverage of the surrounding environment of the power station is realized, and the ecological environment imbalance caused by the power station construction is prevented.
assignees: HUBEI ANYUAN SAFETY ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power parameter damage recovery method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for recovering damaged electric power parameters and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining target power data and environment parameters corresponding to power equipment, retrieving a data recovery model corresponding to the environment parameters, adopting an item identification module in the data recovery model to determine damaged parameter items and non-damaged parameter items from the target power data, adopting a characteristic determination module in the data recovery model to determine first characteristics corresponding to the non-damaged parameter items, adopting a parameter recovery module in the data recovery model to determine recovery parameter values corresponding to the damaged parameter items according to the damaged parameter items and the first characteristics, and adopting a parameter combination module in the data recovery model to recover the target power data according to the recovery parameter values to obtain recovery power data. The invention solves the technical problems of time and labor waste and difficult realization of integral restoration when the electric power parameters with larger damage degree are restored in the related technology.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;BEIJING DINGCHENG HONGAN TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Power system recovery method and system considering social function and load starting characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system recovery method and system considering social functions and load starting characteristics, and belongs to the technical field of power system power supply recovery. The method comprises the steps of solving a power supply restoration importance parameter according to absolute power failure duration, solving a correction coefficient of the power supply restoration importance parameter which takes into account social functions, correcting the power supply restoration importance parameter by using the correction coefficient of the power supply restoration importance parameter which takes into account social functions to obtain the power supply restoration importance of a user, solving the node power supply restoration importance which takes into account the topology connection correction coefficient, generating a strategy for restoring power supply according to the node power supply restoration importance which takes into account the topology connection correction coefficient, and realizing the restoration of a power system which takes into account social functions and load starting characteristics. The invention improves the accuracy of resource allocation and reduces the extra economic loss in the power supply recovery process.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Three-dimensional visual management system and method for underground water resources
abstract_en: The application discloses a three-dimensional visual management system and method of groundwater resources, and relates to the field of groundwater resource management and pollution control, wherein the system comprises a groundwater data acquisition module, a control module and a control module, wherein the groundwater data acquisition module is used for acquiring groundwater dynamic monitoring data of a target area in real time; the system comprises a groundwater environment digital twin model construction module, a groundwater environment digital twin model and a decision support and knowledge management module, wherein the groundwater environment digital twin model construction module is used for constructing a groundwater environment digital twin model based on groundwater dynamic monitoring data, the groundwater change and pollution control simulation module is used for carrying out numerical simulation of groundwater resource and pollutant migration based on the groundwater environment digital twin model, carrying out pollution control region division and making a corresponding groundwater restoration scheme, and the decision support and knowledge management module is used for integrating the groundwater dynamic monitoring data, the groundwater environment digital twin model, the divided pollution control region and the corresponding groundwater restoration scheme to realize data storage, three-dimensional display, data evaluation and user interaction. The application can realize the efficient management and pollution control of groundwater resources.
assignees: UNIV NINGXIA

title_en: Ecological restoration system and method for high-steep sandy soil slope
abstract_en: The invention provides an ecological restoration system and method for a high and steep sandy soil slope, comprising a slope fixing structure, a net hanging structure, a vegetation layer and a water permeable structure, wherein the net hanging structure comprises a protective net paved on a slope, the vegetation layer is sprayed on the slope, the slope fixing structure comprises a retaining wall built on the bottom of the slope, and the retaining wall is used for supporting a slump and slide cover on the slope, a broken rock layer or a landslide. The water permeable structure is arranged in the retaining wall, so that redundant water on the slope body can be discharged. In the technical scheme provided by the invention, in order to improve the stability of the slope, a retaining wall of 2.5 m Gao Chongli is built at the bottom of the slope to support a covering, broken rock stratum or landslide which can collapse and slide on the landslide. Meanwhile, a net hanging and vegetation concrete spraying technology is adopted, so that the slope protection strength and anti-scouring capability are enhanced, the environment for plant growth is rapidly built, meanwhile, the weathering stripping of a slope is prevented, and the rapid forming, ecology and stability of vegetation are ensured.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA MENGCAO SOIL TECH CO LTD;MENGCAO ECOLOGICAL ENV GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned ship operation method for cooperative fish and bird identification and water ecological co-treatment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent water area ecological management and discloses an unmanned ship operation method for synergetic fish and bird identification and water ecological co-treatment, which comprises the following steps of S1, starting an unmanned ship and completing operation preparation; S2, acquiring real-time environment data including fish activity data, bird activity data and water environment parameters in a water area, S3, analyzing the fish activity data and the bird activity data, extracting population distribution, dynamic behaviors and activity rules of fish and birds, S4, analyzing the water environment parameters, S5, executing an ecological restoration task based on distribution characteristics of the fish and the birds and a water quality analysis result, S6, uploading the data after the task is completed to a cloud platform. According to the invention, the optimal operation path is generated by combining the real-time water quality data and the ecological requirements through the path planning and scheduling module, so that the technical effect of efficiently scheduling unmanned ship operation in a complex water area environment is achieved.
assignees: JIANGSU SHENWU ADVANCED TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ENG DESIGN INST GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for quickly recovering power supply of shelter suitable for emergency rescue task
abstract_en: The application provides a shelter rapid power restoration method and system suitable for an emergency rescue task. The method comprises the steps of collecting power interruption signals, analyzing the power interruption signals to generate emergency response instructions, automatically identifying and accurately positioning fault points, evaluating importance levels of electric equipment in a shelter to generate a dynamic priority list and an equipment demand report, intelligently selecting a standby power supply combination scheme, starting a standby power supply switching process to generate a standby power supply activation instruction, dynamically adjusting power supply sequence and power distribution of each equipment to ensure normal operation of key facilities to generate an equipment power supply plan after the standby power supply activation instruction is received, continuously monitoring working states of the standby power supply and influences of the working states on the whole power system of the shelter, dynamically optimizing a power supply strategy, and generating an optimized power supply scheme. The technical scheme provided by the application improves the response speed and the power supply reliability of shelter hospitals or temporary emergency facilities when the power is interrupted.

title_en: Vegetation configuration method and system for mine ecological restoration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vegetation configuration method and a vegetation configuration system for mine ecological restoration, which relate to the technical field of ecological restoration, and are used for collecting flat slope plant data, flat slope soil data and slope state data, analyzing whether the stability of a current slope area is in a controllable range according to the flat slope plant data, the flat slope soil data and the slope state data, outputting a first comparison result, calculating the number of deep root plants according to the first comparison result, outputting a planting signal, and outputting an early warning signal according to the first comparison result. According to the invention, by comprehensively monitoring the physical states of the flat slope plants, the soil and the side slope, the side slope stability is accurately estimated, the deep root plant configuration is scientifically guided, the side slope stability is improved, and the resource waste is avoided. When the side slope is unstable, early warning is timely carried out, irrigation is stopped, geological disasters are effectively prevented, the cost is low, the environment is friendly, ecological restoration and regional economic development are promoted, and ecological and economic win-win is realized.
assignees: SHANDONG PROVINCIAL BUREAU OF GEOLOGY & MINERAL RESOURCESNO 801 HYDROGEOLOGICAL ENG GEOLOGICAL BRIGA

title_en: Mud-rock flow ditch bed ecological restoration system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ecological restoration system for a debris flow gully bed. The structure comprises retaining walls on two sides, a spur dike group which is arranged between the retaining walls and connected with the retaining walls and matched with the spur dike group, and a crust layer and a arbor forest which are planted among the spur dike group. The T-dam group consists of a plurality of lower-chosen T-dams with a certain burial depth, and each two stages of the T-dams are distributed according to a certain interval and are used for beam current and arbor in a protection gap. Compared with the prior art, the method reduces erosion of the gap ditch bed of the double-side spur dike by adjusting the directions of the mud-rock flow and the water flow in the ditch, provides a stable growth environment for vegetation of the ditch bed, solves the problem of high ecological restoration difficulty of the mud-rock flow ditch bed, is beneficial to ecological restoration of a river basin, can reduce erosion of the running water to the spur dike group and the retaining wall after plants in the gap grow, solves the problem of easy failure of geotechnical engineering, and is beneficial to long-term operation of the ecological restoration system.
assignees: GUO SHURONG

title_en: Multi-level regulation-oriented remote centralized control dispatching intelligent interaction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multistage regulation-oriented remote centralized control dispatching intelligent interaction method, wherein a system of the method is deployed in a safe II area and comprises an application, a database and an interface server, and the system is interconnected with each stage of dispatching system by adopting strategies such as a dual-machine hot standby and the like in a B/S architecture. The system comprises a plurality of modules, wherein the information sharing and real-time communication module promotes information flow coordination, the overhaul work management module facilitates overhaul operation and display, the starting scheme execution module is responsible for obtaining a scheme from scheduling and executing and reporting, the safety error prevention module performs multi-aspect check, the data analysis and decision support module performs operation decision, the double-factor authentication module ensures information safety, and the power failure and power restoration application module replaces the traditional application flow. The modules work cooperatively to solve a plurality of problems in the prior art, improve dispatching command efficiency and accuracy and ensure safe production of electric power.
assignees: GUIZHOU QIANYUAN POWER CO LTD

title_en: Performance assessment-based natural resource project evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a performance assessment-based natural resource project evaluation method and system, which relate to the technical field of project evaluation, and are used for acquiring vegetation coverage influence values, soil damage values and rainfall influence values of a target area to calculate disaster influence values of the target area, comparing the disaster influence values of the target area with preset disaster influence value thresholds, determining disaster severity grades of the target area according to comparison results, determining performance assessment standards of environmental restoration in a corresponding natural project of the target area at the next stage according to different disaster severity grades, and thus, in performance assessment of environmental restoration projects of a forest ecological area, when the forest ecological area experiences natural disasters such as typhoons, the environmental restoration performance index assessment of the forest ecological area at the next stage can be adjusted according to actual conditions, so that the performance assessment judgment of the project at the next stage is reasonable and correct, and the influence of a manager on project decision is reduced.
assignees: THE SECOND SURVEYING AND MAPPING INST OF ANHUI PROVINCE

title_en: Soil-structure co-evolution seismic liquefaction analysis device and method based on seismic signals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soil-structure co-evolution earthquake liquefaction analysis device and method based on earthquake signals, which are characterized in that geology and earthquake data of a target area are obtained, a co-scaling system of geometric ratio, time ratio and acceleration ratio is constructed based on Bockingham pi similarity theory, so that a soil liquefaction process of the target area is evolved by the earthquake liquefaction multi-field coupling evolution device, a millimeter-level spatial resolution monitoring network is formed by adopting a distributed optical fiber sensor array and a micro pore pressure meter group, and a high-speed camera system is matched for synchronously capturing pore water pressure, structural strain and a soil shear band expansion process, so that full-element time sequence correlation analysis of vibration triggering-seepage development-structural catastrophe is realized, the influence degree of the full-element time sequence correlation analysis on earthquake is further analyzed, and a direct basis is provided for engineering restoration priority and reinforcement scheme.
assignees: UNIV TONGJI

title_en: Recovery strategy generation method and device suitable for fault rush repair, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recovery strategy generation method, a device, a terminal device and a storage medium suitable for fault first-aid repair, which are used for constructing a first-aid repair scheduling model for measuring the efficiency of the fault first-aid repair and a communication recovery scheduling model for measuring the recovery speed of a communication network, so that the first-aid repair capacity of a construction team, the power supply capacity of a power supply and the recovery requirement of a power distribution network path can be comprehensively considered, the first-aid repair resources of the construction team, a mobile power supply and the like are comprehensively and cooperatively scheduled, and the utilization efficiency of the first-aid repair resources is improved. The invention also fully considers the fault rush-repair and recovery of the communication network, ensures that the state of the router can be adjusted in time, and the switch can be operated normally, thereby avoiding the limitation of the recovery of the power distribution network due to the communication problem.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD;GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Scenic region whole process planning management method and system based on GIS platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landscape area whole process planning management method and system based on a GIS platform, the method comprises the steps of raw data acquisition, data preliminary processing, ecological risk area discrimination, planning management optimization and scenic region planning management. The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent planning management of scenic areas, in particular to a scenic area whole-process planning management method and system based on a GIS platform, which acquire original data through original data acquisition; the method comprises the steps of carrying out data preliminary processing of data space alignment, missing value restoration, semantic feature extraction, data standardization and data set segmentation, carrying out ecological risk area discrimination by adopting a depth contrast map convolution network model, improving the accuracy of ecological risk identification under complex landforms, providing risk support for subsequent planning, carrying out scenic region planning management optimization by adopting a multiparty reinforcement learning model, responding to environmental state change in real time, and feeding back iterative optimization strategies based on historical data in real time.

title_en: Spare power automatic switching device management method and management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a management method of a spare power automatic switching device, which comprises the steps of acquiring and analyzing station equipment data, wherein the station equipment data comprises transformer data, bus data, spare power automatic switching device data, circuit breaker data and connection point number data, judging whether the spare power automatic switching device needs to be deactivated according to the transformer data, the circuit breaker data and preset deactivation conditions, sending out a spare power automatic switching device deactivation early warning when the deactivation conditions are met, and sending out a spare power automatic switching device restoration early warning when the deactivation conditions are not met. The invention can pre-warn the linkage analysis of the main transformer load of the transformer substation and the backup automatic switching, analyze the running condition of the main transformer load of the transformer substation in real time, stop the backup automatic switching and timely pre-warn when the total load of the main transformer exceeds a certain limit, and timely remind the backup automatic switching when the main transformer load is recovered to be normal, so that the dispatcher takes corresponding measures to avoid serious power grid accidents.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD WUXI POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Multi-target toughness maintenance method for water supply network fused with graph convolution reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water supply networks and provides a multi-target toughness maintenance method for a water supply network integrating graph rolling reinforcement learning, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a data set, S2, constructing a degradation damage module, S3, constructing a performance evaluation module, S4, calculating transportation time, S5, calculating recovery degree, S6, calculating toughness evaluation indexes, S7, calculating weights, S8, constructing an M2DRL model, S9, training the model, and S10, generating a pipeline recovery sequence through the trained model, and evaluating based on the toughness evaluation indexes. The invention can cooperatively promote the recovery degree of the water supply network and shorten the recovery time by optimizing the pipeline recovery sequence, and finally enhance the toughness of the system.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG

title_en: Optimized transformation and recovery method for micro-habitat ecological system of high and steep slope of pumping and storing station
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological restoration, and provides an optimization reconstruction and recovery method for a micro-ecological environment ecological system of a high and steep slope of a pumping and storing station, which comprises the steps of obtaining topographic data, soil erosion data and microorganism data of the high and steep slope of the pumping and storing station in a monitoring time period, and judging the current situation of microorganism loss; the method comprises the steps of determining a microorganism loss rule and a microorganism loss amount of a steep side slope of a pumping and storing station according to the microorganism loss current situation, determining a microorganism loss and a terrain correlation according to the microorganism loss rule, water and soil loss data and the terrain data, adapting a target side slope modification process for the steep side slope of the pumping and storing station, determining a microorganism loss and microorganism content correlation according to the microorganism loss rule, the water and soil loss data and different microorganism loss amounts, adapting a target microorganism ecological package for the steep side slope of the pumping and storing station, and determining an optimized modification scheme for the steep side slope of the pumping and storing station according to the target side slope modification process and the target microorganism ecological package.
assignees: STATE GRID XINYUAN COMPANY LTD;STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIS SOFTWARE SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Sprinkler with improved plug opening structure
title_ko: 플러그 개방 구조 개선형 스프링클러
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a sprinkler with an improved plug opening structure, which comprises: a sprinkler main body having an upper inlet through which fire extinguishing water is introduced and a lower outlet connected thereto; a deflector blocking an outlet side of the inlet in the main body and ejecting the fire extinguishing water in all directions when descending; a cylindrical housing coupled to the outlet of the main body and having a vertically penetrating hollow portion for an ejection operation of the deflector therein; a plug disposed in a hollow portion of the housing to support the deflector; and an actuator for fixing the plug and separating the plug downward from the hollow portion of the housing in the event of a fire. The plug supporting the deflector is fixed by a plurality of balls, and when the rotator is rotated by contraction and restoration of a linear structure shape memory alloy wire by heat in the event of a fire, the plurality of balls are retracted when the rotator is rotated by contraction and restoration of the linear structure shape memory alloy wire by heat, so that the supported and released plug and the deflector are automatically opened to eject the fire extinguishing water.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소화수가 유입되는 상부 유입구와 이에 연결되는 하부 분출구를 갖는 스프링클러 본체; 상기 본체에서 유입구의 출구 측을 차단하며 하강 시 소화수를 사방으로 분출시키는 디플렉터(deflector); 상기 본체의 분출구에 결합되며 내부에 상기 디플렉터의 출(出) 동작을 위한 상하 관통형 중공(中空)부를 갖는 원통형 하우징; 상기 하우징의 중공부에 배치되어 상기 디플렉터를 지지하는 플러그; 및 상기 플러그를 고정하고 있다가 화재 발생 시 상기 하우징의 중공부로부터 상기 플러그를 하방 이탈시키기 위한 액추에이터(actuator);를 포함하도록 구현함으로써, 디플렉터를 지지하고 있는 플러그가 다수의 볼에 의해 고정되어 있다가 화재 발생 시 열에 의한 선형 구조 형상기억합금 와이어의 수축 복원을 이용해 로테이터를 회전시키면 다수의 볼이 후퇴됨에 따라 지지 해제된 플러그 및 디플렉터가 자동 개방되어 소화수가 분출될 수 있도록 한 플러그 개방 구조 개선형 스프링클러에 관한 것이다.
assignees: KIM SU YEOB;KIM HAN SONG;JITEL GLOBAL CO LTD

title_en: Flood three-dimensional visualization method based on image access inundation model result
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood three-dimensional visualization method based on an image access inundation model result, and belongs to the technical field of flood three-dimensional visualization. Aiming at the defects of large network transmission data quantity, complex Web end model result data processing and the like in the traditional GIS three-dimensional flood visualization, the invention provides flood simulation data storage, transmission and restoration technology based on image technology, which stores result data such as grid vertex elevation, water depth, flow speed, flow direction and the like in color components, transmits the result data through texture images, reduces the network transmission data quantity, greatly improves the updating efficiency of the flood state in the submerged process, and utilizes a loader technology to carry out flood rendering visualization on the Web end, so that the flood visualization presentation capability is greatly improved, and the important transition from 'good view' to 'good use' of a flood simulation twin scene is promoted.
assignees: PEARL RIVER HYDRAULIC RES INST PEARL RIVER WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION

title_en: Offshore wind power black start path recovery processing method and equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a method and equipment for recovering a black start path of offshore wind power. The method comprises the steps of determining black start capability scores of wind turbines by adopting a gray multi-attribute decision method according to working attributes of the wind turbines, constructing a path recovery objective function of the offshore wind turbines according to the black start capability scores of the wind turbines, determining shortest recovery paths under different wind turbines recovery sequences by adopting a Floride algorithm, and calculating to obtain a black start path of a target offshore wind turbine by adopting a genetic algorithm according to the shortest recovery paths under different wind turbines recovery sequences and the path recovery objective function, wherein the black start path of the target offshore wind turbine is the black start path with the shortest electrical distance and the largest total power generation amount. The method shortens the black start recovery time of the offshore wind power and improves the toughness of the power grid.
assignees: SANXIA NEW ENERGY NANTONG CO LTD;THREE GORGES NEW ENERGY RUDONG CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network system fault recovery method and device, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network system fault recovery method, a device, terminal equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining fault data and power data of a fault power distribution network system; the method comprises the steps of constructing an objective function with the aim of maximizing recovery load based on power data, constructing a power distribution system rush-repair scheduling model, a power distribution system power-on path model, a flexible load reduction model, a demand response model and a power distribution system operation model, solving the objective function under the constraints of fault data, the power distribution system rush-repair scheduling model, the power distribution system power-on path model, the flexible load reduction model, the demand response model and the power distribution system operation model, generating the load recovery amount of a key load, the load recovery amount of an interruptible load and the load recovery amount of an electric vehicle when the maximum recovery load is generated, and performing fault recovery on the power distribution system based on the load recovery amount of the key load, the load recovery amount of the interruptible load and the load recovery amount of the electric vehicle.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD;GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Ecological vegetation blanket for slope ecological restoration and restoration method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ecological restoration, and particularly relates to an ecological vegetation blanket for slope ecological restoration and a restoration method. Aiming at the slope landforms with serious soil pollution and low microorganism and organic matter content, an ecological vegetation blanket is paved. The ecological vegetation blanket is formed by combining and paving a structural layer woven by gunny bag fiber yarns, a vegetation layer containing straws, fertilizers and grass seeds, a nutrition layer formed by paving activated sludge and a protection layer formed by paving crushed corn straws, wheat straws and coal gangue. The activated sludge not only can provide a large amount of microorganism groups for the soil, promote the ecological cycle in the soil and the formation of humus, improve the soil and the fertility, but also has the purification effect on water quality. The method is simple to operate, low in cost and quite considerable in restoration effect on landslide features, can play roles in fixing the side slope and beautifying the environment, provides proper conditions for vegetation growth, and has wide feasibility.
assignees: UNIV LIAONING

title_en: Automatic partitioning method, device, equipment and medium for power grid recovery after extreme disasters
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of automatic power grid partitioning, and particularly relates to a method, a device, equipment and a medium for automatic power grid restoration partitioning after extreme disasters, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a two-dimensional model of a region according to geographic information and meteorological information; the method comprises the steps of taking a power supply building as a node in a two-dimensional model, taking geographic information and meteorological information as attributes of the node, adding fault condition information of a power distribution network into the attributes of the node to obtain an information fusion model, clustering the node according to the attributes of the node based on the information fusion model to obtain clusters, and taking the nodes divided by each cluster center as nodes of the same area. According to the method, the power grid is automatically partitioned according to the types of the power distribution faults, quick rush repair can be conducted according to the types of the power distribution faults after the power grid is partitioned, and the recovery speed of the power grid is high.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Ecological comprehensive restoration and intelligent monitoring method for dry lake basin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dry lake basin ecological comprehensive restoration and intelligent monitoring method, which comprises the steps of realizing edge locking and sand control inside a dry lake basin by carrying out soil-alien transplanting and the like on primary plants in the dry lake basin, forming sand substance sealing and controlling plant strips by planting native plants on the edge of the dry lake basin along the circumferential direction, fixing surface quicksand by planting sandy plants on quicksand lands on the periphery of the dry lake basin and the like, and constructing plant sand fixation grids by planting sand fixation arbor and shrubs in a upwind area on the periphery of the dry lake basin and covering a sand fixation net and the like. The invention can obviously improve the wind prevention and sand fixation efficiency of the surrounding area of the dry lake basin, effectively reduce the frequency of wind and sand disasters, provide firm guarantee for the regional safety, and simultaneously effectively promote the optimization of the soil structure and the natural recovery of vegetation, not only enhance the water and fertilizer retention capacity of the soil, but also obviously improve the service functions of regional ecosystems, such as water conservation, climate regulation and the like.

title_en: Small watershed comprehensive treatment method based on vegetation recovery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small watershed comprehensive treatment method based on vegetation restoration, which relates to the technical field of vegetation restoration and comprises the following implementation steps of configuring IP address information of a remote control area server for comprehensive treatment, entering a treatment planning end, setting a planning scheme for the small watershed comprehensive treatment according to the vegetation area range to realize time sequence hierarchical small watershed comprehensive treatment, entering an ecological tracking end, judging whether ecological restoration and water quality abnormality occur in a river channel in a corresponding vegetation area range in real time, entering an environment acquisition end, and predicting whether the small watershed treatment is abnormal in real time through environmental change and human utilization projects to early warn vegetation reduction or species loss in time. The comprehensive treatment method for the small river basin based on vegetation restoration effectively guides the treatment and protection of the recent river, can combine ecological restoration and water quality conditions of the river course, and can early warn whether ecological problems such as vegetation reduction or species loss occur in treatment projects within the range of the corresponding small river basin.
assignees: UNIV YANAN

title_en: Video restoration tampering detection method based on noise residual error and average optical flow
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of multimedia content security, and in particular relates to a video restoration tampering detection method based on noise residual errors and average optical flows, which comprises the following steps of S1, extracting noise of a video, a forward optical flow mode and a backward optical flow mode, acquiring the noise residual errors based on the noise, and averaging the forward optical flow mode and the backward optical flow mode to obtain the average optical flow mode; the method comprises the steps of S2, inputting a noise residual error and an average optical flow mode into an encoder taking SegFormer as a main network to generate multi-scale features, S3, carrying out intra-feature interaction on the generated noise residual error multi-scale features and the average optical flow mode multi-scale features by using a decoder, S4, carrying out inter-feature interaction on the interacted features through a multi-scale feature fusion module, and S5, merging all the features to obtain a tampered positioning area of a final depth restoration video. The method aims to solve the threat of malicious tampering on videos, which is brought to public safety, in the existing depth video restoration technology. Experimental results show that the method has better performance compared with the existing method.
assignees: UNIV HUNAN SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Intelligent construction method for loess plateau region water forest conservation engineering
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent construction method for a loess plateau region water conservation project, and relates to the field of forestry ecological restoration and water and soil conservation projects. The method comprises the steps of collecting and carrying out normalization processing on various original physical quantities based on space-time sliding windows to obtain normalization values of various physical quantities, constructing a composite physical state function based on the normalization values of various physical quantities, introducing a disturbance propagation response function to construct a measurement evaluation function, carrying out spatial threshold screening processing based on the measurement evaluation function to generate a planting candidate point set, generating a spatial aggregation planting block set based on the planting candidate point set, and determining planting parameters based on gradient change conditions of the measurement evaluation function in the spatial aggregation planting block so as to execute planting operation. The method solves the problems that the traditional water conservation engineering construction method lacks modeling on space disturbance and neighborhood consistency, the construction parameter configuration lacks intelligent adjustment, and the whole flow does not form a closed loop structure of measurement, analysis, decision-making and execution.

title_en: Evaluation method, system, equipment and medium for ecological restoration effect of saline-alkali water body
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system, equipment and a medium for evaluating the ecological restoration effect of a saline-alkali water body, which relate to the technical field of saline-alkali water body restoration evaluation and are characterized in that a double-layer restoration evaluation framework based on a physical layer and a chemical layer is constructed, the environment and biological monitoring data are fused, and the effective matching and dynamic weight adjustment of the environment and biological index trend are realized by adopting a data-driven principal component analysis and dynamic time warping algorithm, so that the scientificity and the accuracy of the restoration effect evaluation are improved. And the time sequence prediction is carried out on the repair process by combining an autoregressive integral moving average model, so that the repair completion time can be quantitatively estimated, and scientific management and decision making are assisted. The overall scheme realizes multidimensional comprehensive evaluation and dynamic closed-loop optimization of the ecological restoration effect of the saline-alkali water body, remarkably enhances the pertinence, the instantaneity and the sustainability of ecological restoration, and provides scientific and efficient technical support for restoration of the saline-alkali soil.
assignees: CHINA CHEMICAL CITY INVEST CO LTD

title_en: Computation of preemptive ranked resiliency measures using probabilistic optimization for enhanced operational resilience of a power system
abstract_en: When an extreme weather event is forecast, an operator of a power system will typically prepare reactive measures, to facilitate the restoration of the power system after it has been damaged by the event. Disclosed embodiments utilize probabilistic optimization to identify and rank resiliency measures in advance of such an event, such that proactive measures may be implemented before the event, to increase the operational resilience of the power system during the event. This enables the power system to better withstand and recover more quickly from the event, thereby reducing downtime (e.g., power outages) and costs. Exemplary resiliency measures include, without limitation, load curtailment, network topology optimization, preemptive electrical islanding, and distributed energy resource (DER) dispatch.
assignees: HITACHI ENERGY LTD

title_en: Computation of preemptive ranked resiliency measures using probabilistic optimization for enhanced operational resilience of a power system
abstract_en: When an extreme weather event is forecast, an operator of a power system will typically prepare reactive measures, to facilitate the restoration of the power system after it has been damaged by the event. Disclosed embodiments utilize probabilistic optimization to identify and rank resiliency measures in advance of such an event, such that proactive measures may be implemented before the event, to increase the operational resilience of the power system during the event. This enables the power system to better withstand and recover more quickly from the event, thereby reducing downtime (e.g., power outages) and costs. Exemplary resiliency measures include, without limitation, load curtailment, network topology optimization, preemptive electrical islanding, and distributed energy resource (DER) dispatch.
assignees: HITACHI ENERGY LTD

title_en: Power transmission and transformation project soil disturbance restoration method and device based on region division
abstract_en: The invention provides a soil disturbance restoration method and device for a power transmission and transformation project based on region division, which are suitable for the technical field of power systems and comprise the steps of obtaining construction information of a target power transmission and transformation project, determining project characteristics and disturbance regions of the target power transmission and transformation project based on the construction information, dividing the disturbance region into a plurality of regions based on the project characteristics, collecting region characteristics of each region, determining a sensitive region, constructing a simulation model of each sensitive region based on the region characteristics of the sensitive region, determining disturbance information of the sensitive region based on the simulation model, determining a corresponding initial restoration scheme based on the disturbance information of each sensitive region, optimizing a corresponding restoration scheme based on neighborhood information, and obtaining a restoration scheme of each sensitive region, and obtaining an integral restoration scheme of the disturbance region based on the restoration scheme of all the sensitive regions. The invention can improve the repairing accuracy by determining the sensitive area and the corresponding repairing scheme.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method for determining target value of restoration of target pollutants in underground water of sulfur smelting area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining a target pollutant restoration target value in underground water of a sulfur smelting area, which comprises the steps of S1, screening target pollutants, S101, determining an exceeding pollutant, S102, determining input parameters of a migration model, S103, judging whether the exceeding pollutant has pollution risks, S104, judging health risks of the exceeding pollutant with pollution risks, and S2, calculating the restoration target value, wherein the method screens key pollutants which are necessary to be restored and managed for a long time from various pollutants through model calculation, calculates the restoration target value, reduces management cost and greatly reduces underground water pollution degree of the sulfur smelting area.
assignees: INST SOIL SCIENCE CAS

title_en: Mud-rock flow pile-up fan ecology and rock-soil measure cooperation silt stopping system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mud-rock flow accumulation fan ecology and rock-soil measure cooperative silt stopping system. The system organically integrates two major types of rock and soil and ecological measures, and is arranged in a three-dimensional mode in a ground flow area and an impact height space area of the debris flow. And sequentially arranging a rock-soil measure section, an ecological rock-soil combination measure section and an ecological measure section along the dredging movement direction. And in each section, the system sequentially generates three layers of stopping effects of opposite impact energy dissipation, diversion peak clipping, ground resistance increasing, space grading blocking and ground resistance increasing and silt stopping on the debris flow by utilizing the measure type selection and the structural characteristics thereof. The technology aims to cooperatively integrate the control efficacy of the rock soil and the ecological measures, enhance the natural ecological restoration capability of the silt stopping system, prolong the service life of the system and eliminate the hidden danger of secondary disasters. The optimized ecological rock-soil combination measure section adopts a staged construction method of matching spatial arrangement with dynamic time, so that stable and organic combination of the two measures is ensured. The invention also provides a design and calculation model of the blocking height of the structures in the system.

title_en: Slope protection method combining multidirectional water guide channel and ecological restoration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slope protection method combining a multidirectional water guide channel and ecological restoration, which relates to the technical field of ecological slope protection, and is characterized in that seed vegetation layers are arranged between adjacent transverse water guide channels at equal intervals, rainwater is guided into a vertical water guide channel and a transverse water guide channel which are communicated with each other at two sides through water guide grids arranged on the upper surfaces of the seed vegetation layers, excessive rainwater is prevented from penetrating into the seed and the planting base layer in the seed vegetation layers, on the one hand, the seed and the planting base layer are prevented from being washed out, on the other hand, a large amount of rainwater is prevented from penetrating into loess side slopes to cause landslide, in addition, the seed and the raw soil of the vegetation are fully stirred and mixed, a layer of planting matrix is paved on the planting blanket in a spraying mode, the compactness of the planting matrix can be effectively improved, the whole transverse water guide channel and the vertical water guide channel are prevented from being linked and fixed on the basis of the above matters, and the fixing effect and slope protection effect of a slope protection structure are improved.
assignees: UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES BEIJING

title_en: Distribution board responding to earthquakes
title_ko: 내진형 배전반
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a switchboard capable of protecting components installed inside the switchboard in the event of an earthquake. More specifically, the seismic switchboard comprises: a housing forming the outer shape of the switchboard; a base unit disposed inside the housing and in which components of the switchboard are installed; a buffer unit including an air ball having one end constrained to the base unit and the other end constrained to the housing; and a restoration unit including an elastic body for restoring the position of the base unit while constraining the base unit between the housing and the circumference of the base unit. When vibration or impact is applied to the housing, the base unit moves in any one of four directions of the base unit by the air ball to block the impact from being transmitted to the internal components to protect the internal components. Accordingly, it is possible to protect components embedded in the switchboard from vibration or impact flowing in four directions when an earthquake occurs.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지진 발생시 배전반의 내부에 설치된 부품을 보호할 수 있는 배전반에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 배전반의 외형을 형성하는 하우징과, 상기 하우징의 내부에 배치되고 상기 배전반의 부품이 설치되는 베이스부와, 일단은 상기 베이스부에 구속되고 타단은 상기 하우징에 구속되는 에어볼을 포함하는 완충부 및 상기 하우징과 상기 베이스부 둘레 사이에 상기 베이스부를 구속하면서 상기 베이스부의 위치를 복원시키는 탄성체를 포함하는 복원부를 포함하되, 상기 하우징에 진동 또는 충격이 가해지면 상기 베이스부가 상기 에어볼에 의해 상기 베이스부의 사방향(四方向) 중 어느 한 방향으로 유동함으로써 상기 내장부품으로 충격이 전달되는 것을 차단하여 상기 내장부품을 보호하는 것을 특징으로 하는 내진형 배전반에 의해 달성된다. 이에 따라, 지진 발생시 사방향(四方向)으로 유입되는 진동 또는 충격으로부터 배전반에 내장된 부품을 보호할 수 있다.
assignees: GREENPOWERTECH

title_en: Power grid planning method and system based on load prediction and energy storage cooperation
abstract_en: The application discloses a power grid planning method and a system based on load prediction and energy storage cooperation, and relates to the technical field of load prediction, comprising the following steps of obtaining load data, wherein the load data comprises load change and load time sequence data; the method comprises the steps of dynamically mapping load change into pseudo-seismic wave amplitude, converting the pseudo-seismic wave amplitude into pseudo-seismic wave signals matched with the time-space characteristics of load time sequence data based on Morlet wavelet basis function, predicting future seismic wave signals according to the pseudo-seismic wave signals, converting the future seismic wave signals into predicted load values based on a dynamic integral restoration algorithm, and verifying the predicted load values and carrying out power grid planning. According to the application, the load change is converted into the earthquake wave form through mathematical mapping, and the earthquake wave analysis technology is multiplexed to realize high-sensitivity load prediction.
assignees: ANHUI FANGNENG ELECTRIC TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Transparentization panorama management and control system based on low-voltage distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transparent panoramic management and control system based on a low-voltage power distribution network, and relates to the technical field of power distribution networks. Compared with the prior distribution network management and control system, the system solves the problems that the accuracy and reliability of the conventional distribution network transparency system cannot be guaranteed, the data acquisition and processing difficulty is high, the level of intelligence and automation is to be improved, the operation data of the distribution network can be obtained in real time by combining a topology optimization algorithm and a transparency management and control technology, the operation data can be accurately analyzed and predicted, and the rapid positioning, automatic isolation and power restoration of faults are realized by utilizing the technologies of artificial intelligence, the Internet of things and the like, so that the reliability and the safety of power supply are improved. The power distribution network transparence management and control platform is used for realizing the full transparence and full perception of the power distribution network, providing comprehensive, real-time and accurate power distribution network operation data, helping users to better know the real-time state of the power distribution network, predicting future operation trend, optimizing resource allocation, improving operation efficiency and ensuring the reliability and safety of power supply.
assignees: ANHUI JIYUAN SOFTWARE CO LTD

title_en: Soil quality assessment method and device for power transmission and transformation project influence area
abstract_en: The invention provides a soil quality assessment method and device for an influence area of power transmission and transformation engineering, and belongs to the field of data analysis. The method comprises the steps of collecting soil data, biological data and environmental data in an influence area to be evaluated in power transmission and transformation engineering, determining influence variable data in the influence area to be evaluated according to the data in the influence area to be evaluated, obtaining soil quality change prediction data according to the influence variable data, and obtaining a soil quality evaluation result in the influence area to be evaluated according to the soil quality change prediction data, the biological variable data and the environmental variable data. According to the invention, the predicted data of the soil quality change obtained by prediction is evaluated, so that the problem that the soil quality evaluation result deviates from the actual soil ecological restoration and repair can be effectively solved. In the process of evaluating the soil quality, the influence of pollutants on organisms including animals and plants is considered, so that the evaluation result is more comprehensive and accurate.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Intelligent research and judgment and power restoration method and system based on low-voltage power distribution network
