abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent studying, judging and re-electrifying method and system based on a low-voltage distribution network, which relate to the technical field of intelligent power grid and power system automation and comprise the steps of collecting monitoring data, carrying out fusion check based on geographic and power management information, dynamically generating a topology file, and constructing a hierarchical visual power grid model; analyzing the state of the breaker and the protection equipment, calculating the main backup protection deviation, analyzing the electric quantity change by combining wavelet transformation and singular value decomposition, identifying a fault section, constructing a whole network sensing system, monitoring three-phase unbalance and zero sequence current in real time, and carrying out quick power restoration and active research and judgment by combining a dichotomy and an intelligent switch optimized power restoration strategy. The intelligent studying, judging and recharging method based on the low-voltage distribution network improves the reliability and the safety of the distribution network by constructing an environment monitoring system, improves the accuracy of fault analysis of a low-voltage transformer area by topology accurate checking and intelligent fusion, improves the fault recovery efficiency by a dichotomy fault isolation and intelligent recharging strategy, and achieves better effects in the aspects of safety, accuracy and efficiency.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Priori knowledge-based method and apparatus for determining road damage of earthquake disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a priori knowledge-based method and a priori knowledge-based device for determining the damage of a seismic disaster road, belongs to the technical field of computer information processing, and solves the problems that the traditional pixel or object-based method is gradually exposed and has strong dependence on data quality and insufficient feature expression. The method comprises the steps of obtaining road remote sensing data of a target area within a preset target time range, preprocessing the road remote sensing data to obtain preprocessed road remote sensing data, obtaining road network vector data of the target area, carrying out association processing on the road network vector data to obtain buffer zone data, and extracting the road remote sensing data according to the buffer zone data to obtain road damage data. According to the scheme, the efficient extraction of damaged roads after disaster is realized through the dynamic buffer zone generation, the self-adaptive threshold segmentation and the topology restoration process.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING NORMAL;NAT DISASTER REDUCTION CENTER OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMENT EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMENT SAT

title_en: Method and system for generating biodiversity restoration scheme for power transmission and transformation engineering
abstract_en: The invention relates to a generation method and a generation system of a biodiversity restoration scheme for power transmission and transformation projects, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining an environment change image of a target area where the power transmission and transformation projects are located, distributing information of the power transmission and transformation projects and ecology change information, identifying differential environment information of the target area through an image differential identification strategy based on the environment change image, identifying sub-ecology influence information of each ecology type of the target area based on the ecology change information of the target area, identifying ecology abnormality ranges of each ecology abnormality factor of the target area based on the differential environment information and the sub-ecology influence information of each ecology type, and generating an ecology restoration strategy corresponding to each ecology abnormality factor through an ecology diversity restoration strategy based on the power transmission and transformation project distributing information and the ecology abnormality ranges of each ecology abnormality factor to serve as an ecology diversity restoration scheme of the target area.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Inter-city highway-railway multi-travel-path multi-agent collaborative reasoning and restoring method and system
abstract_en: Provided is an inter-city public-railway multi-agent collaborative reasoning and restoring method and system for a multi-agent travel path, which realize reasoning and restoring of a real travel path based on inter-city travel sparse track observation data of travelers. The method comprises the steps of obtaining and preprocessing original track observation data and traffic network data, carrying out rasterization processing and storage on the road network data and the track observation data, designing and training path searching intelligent bodies to achieve reasonable recovery path sequence reasoning, identifying the intelligent bodies in a design and training mode to achieve reasonable travel mode sequence reasoning, and achieving recovery of urban public-railway multi-mode travel real paths through trained cooperative reasoning of the two intelligent bodies. According to the invention, the complex inter-city public-railway multi-trip path restoration problem is decoupled into the path search and the mode identification, and two intelligent agents are constructed to respectively solve the two sub-problems, so that the inference restoration of the inter-city trip real path based on the sparse observation track is realized, and a new thought and a new method are provided for the path restoration field.

title_en: Low-voltage distribution network reliability real-time evaluation and promotion system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for evaluating and improving the reliability of a low-voltage power distribution network in real time, and relates to the technical field of intelligent monitoring and alarming. The edge computing node realizes real-time data processing and second-level computation of the power supply reliability index, remarkably improves the response speed of the system, combines a genetic algorithm to optimize weights and thresholds, improves the accuracy of reliability analysis and fault positioning, dynamically generates strategies such as load balancing, equipment replacement priority ordering, complex electric path optimization and the like by the cloud coordination module, and enhances the dynamic optimization capacity of the system. The quick power restoration method combining the dichotomy and the dynamic programming algorithm is provided, so that the power failure time is effectively shortened, and the energy loss in the power restoration process is reduced.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Middle-low voltage model through auxiliary method for power distribution network based on regulation cloud
abstract_en: The invention relates to a low-voltage model through auxiliary method in a power distribution network based on regulation cloud, which comprises the steps of 1, generating a feeder relation comparison table according to dispatching and marketing information, 2, carrying out accurate matching of private transformer, user, public transformer and station area according to each transformer substation and each feeder according to the feeder relation comparison table generated in the step 1,3, generating a visual chart according to an accurate matching result, 4, carrying out fuzzy matching aiming at the matching failure of the accurate matching in the step 2, 5, comparing the matching with the voltage values of electric meters before and after power restoration according to the historical power restoration information of the feeder where the private transformer and the private transformer are located, and if the voltage value of the electric meter just falls to zero in a power failure time period, enabling the surface fuzzy matching result to be in accordance with the actual, and realizing verification of the fuzzy matching relation, and 6, carrying out manual verification aiming at the matching failure of the fuzzy matching in the step 4 and the matching failure matching in the step 5. The invention greatly reduces the number of medium-low pressure modes needing manual checking.
assignees: STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;TORAY POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Underground pipe network intelligent management method and system integrating mapping geographic information and remote sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground pipe network intelligent management method and system integrating mapping geographic information and remote sensing, and relates to the technical field of underground pipe network intelligent management. The method comprises the following steps of obtaining leakage types of an underground pipe network, determining pipeline aging leakage characteristic factors and pipeline burst leakage characteristic factors, respectively obtaining mapping geographic information and remote sensing data by mapping and remote sensing, constructing an underground pipe network topological structure, obtaining pipeline aging leakage characteristic factor data and pipeline burst leakage characteristic factor data, respectively constructing a pipeline aging leakage prediction model and a pipeline burst leakage prediction model by combining a Transformer and an LSTM network to obtain pipeline aging leakage prediction results and pipeline burst leakage prediction results, and generating a routing inspection path containing a restoration strategy by adopting an ant colony algorithm to intelligently manage the underground pipe network. The method and the device realize accurate analysis of the leakage mechanism, promote the prediction result of leakage and further promote the real-time performance of response.

title_en: Interface process-based underground water pollution risk rapid assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for rapidly evaluating underground water pollution risks based on an interface process, which comprises the following steps of S1, carrying out investigation on site pollution conditions and hydrogeological conditions, S2, constructing a site conceptual model based on site pollution conditions and hydrogeological condition investigation results, determining the distance between polluted soil and underground water-bearing layers, inquiring the underground water function classification of an area where a site is located, determining a protection target value of underground water, S3, calculating attenuation coefficients of pollutant distribution processes in different soil textures, S4, calculating attenuation coefficients of a gas-over-air belt soil layer transmission process, S5, calculating the total attenuation coefficient of pollutants entering the underground water-bearing layers, S6, calculating the concentration of the pollutants entering the underground water, S7, evaluating whether the pollutants in soil enter the underground water to pollute the underground water, S8, and calculating a soil restoration target value aiming at the condition that the evaluation result is the pollutants which can pollute the underground water.

title_en: Steam invasion risk rapid assessment method based on interface process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vapor invasion risk rapid assessment method based on an interface process, which comprises the following steps of S1, finding out site pollution conditions and hydrogeological conditions, S2, constructing a site indoor vapor invasion risk conceptual model, S3, calculating attenuation coefficients of volatile transmission of pollutants in soil or underground water in a pollution area to a building room, S4, calculating cancerogenic health risks and non-cancerogenic health risks of vapor invasion exposure in different volatile organic pollutants, S5, taking 1X 10  ‑6  as an acceptable cancerogenic risk level to assess the cancerogenic health risk of target pollutants, taking 1 as an acceptable cancerogenic health risk level to assess the non-cancerogenic health risk of the target pollutants, S6, determining the target pollutants with the health risk exceeding the acceptable level through assessment, calculating a target pollutant restoration value under the acceptable cancerogenic risk level condition and a target pollutant restoration target value under the acceptable non-cancerogenic risk level condition, and taking the low value in the two as a final target pollutant restoration value.

title_en: Composite blocking dam system with disaster prevention and control and ecological restoration functions
abstract_en: The invention provides a composite blocking dam system with disaster prevention, control and ecological restoration functions, the blocking dam performs engineering construction by means of valley terrains in mountain areas, the blocking dam comprises a dam body, a foundation unit, an energy dissipation unit and a reinforcing unit, the middle part of the top of the dam body is provided with a plurality of concave overflow ports, the overflow ports protrude forwards in the upstream direction, the foundation unit comprises a plurality of pile foundations, the pile foundations are provided with transverse bearing platforms, the dam body is positioned on the bearing platforms of the pile foundations and is attached to the pile foundations, the energy dissipation unit comprises a plurality of buffering reinforcing piles positioned behind the dam body, the buffering reinforcing piles are positioned on the upstream of the overflow ports of the dam body and can receive impact of disasters before the overflow ports, and the reinforcing unit comprises a plurality of anchor ropes which can reinforce the pile foundations and/or the buffering reinforcing piles. The composite blocking dam system has the functions of improving the soil quality of loose piles, treating mud-rock flow/mountain torrent disasters, accumulating carbon fixation and soil fixation and water retention.
assignees: UNIV SW SCI & TECH SWUST

title_en: Modular coast sand stabilization device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coast protection and ecological restoration, and particularly relates to a modularized coast sand fixation device. The sand fixing device comprises a device main body, an electrodeposited sand fixing module, a power supply module, a control system, a communication module and an amphibious motion module, wherein the electrodeposited sand fixing module, the power supply module, the control system, the communication module and the amphibious motion module are all arranged on the device main body, the electrodeposited sand fixing module is used for realizing electrifying operation on sand beach, the power supply module is used for supplying power for running of the device, the communication module is used for realizing communication interconnection among a plurality of devices, and the amphibious motion module is used for driving the device to move. According to the invention, ca  2+ 、Mg 2+  plasma in sea water can be activated by applying current to the sand beach to generate mineral binders such as calcium carbonate, magnesium hydroxide and the like to form a solidified layer, so that sand grains are effectively solidified, the stability of the sand beach is enhanced, the corrosion of the sea water is lightened, the corrosion disaster resistance of the coast is improved, and the ecological environment of the sand beach is protected.
assignees: UNIV CHANGSHA SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Big data terminal data restoration system based on power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a big data terminal data restoration system based on a power grid, which comprises a data acquisition module, a data restoration value providing unit, a data restoration value determining unit and a final restoration value determining unit, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring operation data of a power transmission line in real time through a sensor and an ammeter, when data loss or error occurs in the technical field of power grid data processing, the data restoration value providing unit in a risk prediction module is used for predicting the loss or error data, in the data restoration process, other equipment data and operation information related to the data can be acquired through a correlation model, a data inference model of the correlation data is constructed through the correlation data, the loss data or the error data is inferred, the data restoration module is used for calculating the restoration value of the loss data or the error data through a linear interpolation algorithm, and integrating the data restoration value providing unit and the inferred value of the data inference model of the correlation data, and taking the average value of the three data to be determined as the final restoration value. And the data is effectively repaired, and meanwhile, the accuracy of data repair is improved.
assignees: JILIN MINGYAO TECH CO LTD

title_en: River course shore protection ecological restoration structure using novel wave-resistant stone
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a river course revetment ecological restoration structure applying novel wave-resistant stones, which comprises a river bottom, a river bank and a river course, wherein a river bank concrete layer is poured on one side close to the river bank, a wave-resistant water retaining wall connected with the river bank is built above the river bank concrete layer, a river bank planting layer is arranged at the top of the river bank, a section of demolishing section with the height of 0.6-1.2 m is demolished at the top of the wave-resistant water retaining wall, a top pressing layer is arranged at the top of the demolished wave-resistant water retaining wall, a landscape retaining wall is built on the river bank close to one side of the wave-resistant water retaining wall, a restoration bed layer is dug downwards on the river bottom close to one side of the wave-resistant water retaining wall, a wave-resistant stone layer is laid above the restoration bed layer, and a pressed stone layer, a non-woven fabric layer and a river bottom planting layer are sequentially arranged above the wave-resistant stone layer from bottom to top. The utility model not only can obviously improve the bank protection and wave resistance of the river bank, but also can improve the inhabiting propagation environment for small organisms, and can play a basic role in beautifying the revetment, reducing and preventing disasters.
assignees: KUNMING SCIENCE AND TECH PAN ASIA DESIGN GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent environment monitoring and controlling system for surface mine
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of mine restoration and discloses an intelligent environment monitoring and controlling system for an open-pit mine, which comprises an environment monitoring and multi-mode data acquisition module, an environment computing and decision-making module, a data acquisition end, a real-time processing and complex multivariate analysis module and a data processing and decision-making module, wherein the environment monitoring and multi-mode data acquisition module is arranged at a key position of a mine area and is used for acquiring various types of environment data such as air quality, noise, water pollution, soil erosion, geological disasters and the like through a sensor network, an unmanned plane, satellite remote sensing and other detection devices and carrying out local data processing, and the environment optimization and decision-making module is configured to deploy computing resources at a data acquisition end close to a mining area by utilizing an edge computing technology and carry out real-time processing and complex multivariate analysis on the multi-source environment data through a deep learning algorithm. Through multi-mode data acquisition and an environment optimization and decision module based on edge calculation and deep learning, multi-dimensional environment data from a mining area can be rapidly processed.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY 19TH BUREAU GROUP MINING INVESTMENT CO LTD

title_en: Three-stage combined treatment method for urban water consumption prediction
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent water affairs, in particular to a three-level combined processing method for urban water consumption prediction, which comprises the following steps of S1, data restoration, S2, characteristic decoupling, S3, prediction fusion, wherein an abnormal value in a urban water consumption time sequence is corrected by using a dynamic threshold correction method based on multi-scale wavelet decomposition. The method in the technical scheme adopts a dynamic threshold correction method based on multi-scale wavelet decomposition, realizes signal layering analysis through discrete wavelet transformation, combines MAD robust statistics to construct a dynamic threshold mechanism, effectively identifies and corrects abnormal points, constructs a dynamic frequency band division joint model of variable-division modal decomposition and spectrum energy balance, proposes a dynamic frequency band recombination strategy guided by amplitude sequencing, carries out energy balance division and inverse transformation reconstruction on VMD high-frequency subcomponents through fast Fourier transform spectrum analysis, realizes fine separation of high-frequency mutation characteristics and periodic fluctuation and multi-frequency band phase synchronization, and finally constructs a long-period memory network to predict and reconstruct all subcomponents.
assignees: UNIV HEFEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Power grid outage result analysis method considering supply chain-gas-electricity fault conduction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, in particular to a power grid outage result analysis method considering supply chain-gas-electric fault conduction, which comprises the following steps of S1, modeling an electric network coupling relation, S2, analyzing a supply chain weak link, S3, modeling a gas pipe network fault, establishing a pressure and flow calculation model of a natural gas pipe network, S4, modeling a gas-electric coupling component, establishing a mathematical model of a gas turbine and a compressor, S5, modeling an urban power grid fault, evaluating the running state of the power grid under the fault, S6, constructing a power outage result evaluation index, and quantifying social influence and recovery priority under different fault scenes.

title_en: Electric power facility emergency treatment system based on earthquake early warning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power emergency control and discloses an electric power facility emergency processing system based on earthquake early warning, which comprises a region dividing module, a data acquisition module, a fault risk assessment module, an isolation decision and control module, an off-grid operation regulation module, an operation state assessment module and a reconnection restoration module, wherein the region dividing module is used for acquiring electric power topological structure data and generating a plurality of region sections, the data acquisition module is used for acquiring earthquake early warning data, equipment operation data and equipment environment data and representing the earthquake early warning data through a multisource data set, the fault risk assessment module is used for calculating the failure probability of each electric power equipment, the isolation decision and control module is used for calculating the region reliability index of a subarea, determining a target subarea, the off-grid operation regulation module is used for switching the target subarea to the off-grid operation and adjusting control parameters, the operation state assessment module is used for generating an operation health score, and the reconnection restoration module is used for restoring and connecting the target subarea to a main power grid. The intelligent isolation and safe reconnection control of the power subarea under the drive of earthquake early warning are realized.

title_en: Ship navigation sea wave dynamic space-time forecasting method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of marine environment prediction, and discloses a ship navigation sea wave dynamic space-time prediction method and system based on deep learning. The method comprises the steps of carrying out space-time alignment, missing value restoration and standardization processing on collected ship AIS data and ERA5 analysis data sets, generating node characteristic vectors comprising longitude and latitude, time stamps, wind speeds and effective wave heights, quantifying the importance of ship track nodes and the time-space interaction relation through node characteristic codes, center codes, space codes and time codes, constructing SeaGraph models, outputting effective wave height predicted values of target waypoints, and carrying out verification. The invention breaks through the space-time constraint of the traditional static modeling framework, integrates the advantages of a self-attention mechanism and a graph network, strengthens the predictive modeling capability of dynamic evolution of the square wave field before the ship sails, and provides high-precision sea wave forecasting support for intelligent ship sailing under complex sea conditions.
assignees: QINGDAO INNOVATION DEVELOPMENT CENTER OF HARBIN ENGINEERING UNIV;UNIV HARBIN ENG

title_en: Water supply optimizing and scheduling method and system for water works
abstract_en: The invention provides a water supply optimizing and dispatching method and a system for a water supply plant, which relate to the technical field of resource dispatching and comprise the steps of obtaining real-time water supply data of a water supply route; the method comprises the steps of monitoring real-time water supply data of a water supply route to obtain real-time fault nodes and real-time fault information of the water supply route, inquiring scheduling requirements through a constructed emergency scheduling model based on the water supply route according to the real-time fault nodes and the real-time fault information to obtain scheduling requirement data corresponding to the real-time fault nodes, obtaining an optimal rush repair scheduling plan according to the scheduling requirement data, and executing corresponding scheduling tasks according to the optimal rush repair scheduling plan. The optimal scheduling method and the optimal scheduling system can improve the matching of the scheduled manpower and material resources and the fault site, and effectively improve the emergency repair efficiency.

title_en: Ecological restoration effect-based high-diving-level coal subsidence area sloping field vegetation configuration method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vegetation configuration method of a high-water-level coal subsidence area sloping field based on ecological restoration effect, which constructs a three-dimensional measurement system of soil, microorganisms and water, eliminates dimension difference by a vector normalization algorithm through a multi-scale coupling evaluation mechanism, calculates a soil nutrient retention rate (R  SFI ), and calculates a soil bacterial diversity growth rate based on a 16SrRNA sequencing result And the water eutrophication index reduction rate (R  TLI ) of the downstream ponding area generates a vegetation Ecological Restoration Index (ERI), automatically screens a vegetation configuration scheme with soil holding, microorganism growth promotion and water quality purification functions, realizes multi-parameter collaborative quantitative evaluation of the ecological restoration effect of the coal mining subsidence area, provides decision support with space-time dynamic adaptability for vegetation space layout, and remarkably improves the systematicness and accuracy of ecological restoration.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING

title_en: Micro-grid contact path optimization method considering power restoration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microgrid connection path optimization method considering power restoration, which comprises the steps of adopting an NSGA-II algorithm to solve a constructed microgrid connection path multi-objective optimization model to obtain a pareto dominant solution of the microgrid connection path multi-objective optimization model, selecting an optimal solution in a power restoration scene from the pareto dominant solution to obtain a feeder line needing to be connected, and optimizing the installation position of the feeder line needing to be connected to obtain the optimal installation position of the connection. According to the invention, the high-efficiency transfer of the load is realized by optimizing the contact path, so that the power supply reliability and the operation flexibility of the micro-grid under the condition of island operation or main grid power interruption are improved.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method for monitoring ecological restoration index of plateau lake
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monitoring method for ecological restoration indexes of a plateau lake, which comprises the steps of determining a monitoring area, selecting ecological restoration monitoring indexes, deploying monitoring equipment, collecting, processing and analyzing data, visualizing results and generating reports. The method divides the monitoring subareas through a GIS technology, screens key water quality indexes by using a PCA algorithm, and determines the optimal deployment position of the biodiversity monitoring equipment based on an ecological niche model. The data acquisition time interval is dynamically adjusted according to the index change characteristics, a comprehensive index evaluation method is adopted for data processing, and a monitoring report is generated through a data visualization library and a natural language processing technology. Meanwhile, a data quality monitoring system is established, and real-time quality monitoring is carried out on the data. The invention can realize the high-efficiency and accurate monitoring of the ecological restoration condition of the plateau lake and provides scientific basis for formulating and adjusting ecological restoration strategies.
assignees: POWERCHINA KUNMING ENG CORP LTD

title_en: River submerged plant recovery method based on flow velocity regulation and control
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of river vegetation restoration of hydraulic engineering, and particularly relates to a river submerged plant restoration method based on flow rate regulation, which comprises the steps of measuring adaptive threshold values Vu and Vs of flow rate of tilapia, dynamically regulating and controlling water supplementing quantity in combination with a hydrodynamic model MIKE, constructing flow rate gradient of an rapid flow region Vu and a slow flow region Vs, realizing space isolation by utilizing flow rate adaptive difference of fish and plants, and simultaneously introducing snakeheads and benthos to form ecological cooperative control. The invention solves the problems that the traditional enclosing method hinders flood discharge and the fish-preventing device is easy to damage, and constructs the rapid flow area and the slow flow area through the water supplementing quantity regulation and control, thereby replacing the traditional physical blocking device, solving the contradiction between flood discharge safety and fish control, enhancing flood discharge safety and reducing maintenance cost.

title_en: River mouth water quality health system evaluation and ecological restoration method based on microorganism identification
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of environmental science and ecological restoration, in particular to a estuary water quality health system evaluation and ecological restoration method based on microorganism identification. The method has the advantages that the accuracy of predicting pollution risk areas is improved by identifying multiple sources of a water body and calculating the contribution degree of the multiple water body sources to sampling points and combining real-time meteorological and topographic data to simulate pollution diffusion paths, the prediction capability of the pollution source types is improved by evaluating the microbial population distribution mode in the water body samples, the data support provided for identifying the pollution source positions is provided, the multiple source positions of pathogenic microorganisms are identified by combining the comparison with microbial samples of the multiple pollution sources, scientific basis is provided for taking effective water quality protection and disease prevention measures, and the quality and efficiency of environmental management are improved.
assignees: YANTAI INST COASTAL ZONE RES CAS

title_en: Method, system, equipment, medium and product for collaborative scheduling of disaster resources of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of distribution networks and discloses a method, a system, equipment, a medium and a product for cooperatively dispatching disaster resources of a distribution network, wherein the method uses load loss minimization before disaster as a first optimization target, determines a first constraint condition of the first optimization target according to the site selection of a transfer warehouse and the limitation of total material transportation quantity, constructs a pre-disaster resource pre-allocation model, thereby obtaining the pre-allocation resource quantity transported to each fault point by the transfer warehouse, and after the disaster, minimizing power failure loss, material scheduling cost and mobile power supply operation cost to form a second optimization target, determining a second constraint condition of the second optimization target in a scheduling balance state, constructing a post-disaster resource scheduling model, optimizing through the post-disaster resource scheduling model, and obtaining a post-disaster resource scheduling optimization scheme, thereby ensuring the coordination of pre-disaster pre-allocation and post-disaster scheduling through the coordination of pre-disaster resources and post-disaster resources, dynamically coordinating a maintenance team and the mobile power supply, and improving the scheduling efficiency and the post-disaster restoration efficiency.
assignees: FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Marine ecological environment influence tracking and monitoring method based on offshore wind power engineering
abstract_en: The application provides a marine ecological environment influence tracking and monitoring method based on offshore wind power engineering, which relates to the technical field of marine ecological environment and comprises the steps of calculating an ecological risk index based on an obtained multi-mode feature vector to obtain ecological risk data, configuring a space-time sequence based on a preprocessed comprehensive data source and the ecological risk data, and predicting a pollution diffusion path and migration blocking prediction based on the preprocessed comprehensive data source. By introducing a dynamic assessment model of an ecological risk index and combining time sequence modeling and space distribution modeling, dynamic analysis and future trend prediction of ecological risks are realized, a high-risk area is identified and pollutant diffusion paths and biological migration blocking conditions are simulated by generating a risk thermodynamic diagram in real time, and the method can dynamically adjust a monitoring strategy according to real-time monitoring data, provide scientific basis for construction optimization and ecological restoration, and improve the accuracy and timeliness of monitoring and assessment.
assignees: NORTH CHINA SEA FORECAST DISASTER REDUCTION CENTER OF MINI OF NATURAL RESOURCES QINGDAO OCEAN CENTER

title_en: Method for quickly recovering degraded wetland by utilizing micro-relief assembly
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for quickly recovering degraded wetland by utilizing micro-landform assembly, belonging to the technical field of wetland ecological engineering. The method aims to solve the limiting problem of poor heterogeneity of degraded wetland habitat and low sustainability after wetland recovery. The method comprises the steps of site selection and habitat quality assessment of a restored wetland, form optimization of the restored wetland base and construction of a flood water network, collection and micro-landform assembly of a grass dune pier body, sectional hydrologic regulation and dynamic management, and assessment and medium control of restoration effects. The method provided by the invention has clear principle and strong operability, can strengthen the habitat heterogeneity through micro-landform assembly so as to promote the diversity improvement of plants, and has the design thought fitting the near-natural recovery concept, and no engineering implementation hidden danger and secondary ecological risk exist. The method provided by the invention is applied to develop the near-natural recovery of the degraded wetland. The method is used for the near-natural recovery of the degraded wetland with the loss of the habitat heterogeneity.
assignees: NORTHEAST INST GEO & AGROECOLO

title_en: Quick recovery method for degraded marsh based on hydrologic and biological communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid recovery method of degraded marsh based on hydrologic and biological communication, which aims at the problems of water resource shortage and biological isolation of a degraded marsh area, and accurately opens a controllable hydrologic communication channel between the degraded marsh area and an adjacent natural river by constructing the controllable hydrologic communication channel in a natural river flooding season, and synchronously realizes natural and efficient replenishment of water resources to the recovered degraded marsh area and direct input of various aquatic organisms in the natural river by utilizing flood power. According to the key stage of the life cycle of the target aquatic organism, the time, frequency and period of opening the controllable hydrologic communication channel are regulated and controlled, and the biological input effect is maximized. After closing the controllable hydrologic communication channel, the degraded marsh zone is kept stable in the non-flood period, and is assisted with the establishment and monitoring of habitats. The invention has low cost, high efficiency and small ecological risk, can quickly reconstruct aquatic organism communities and ecological network functions, and is particularly suitable for large-scale restoration projects of returning to the soil and degraded marshes.
assignees: NORTHEAST INST GEO & AGROECOLO

title_en: Low-power-consumption hardware encryption system based on geological disaster monitoring scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of hardware encryption and discloses a low-power-consumption hardware encryption system based on a geological disaster monitoring scene, which comprises a layering architecture module, an encryption and decryption module, a key management module and a security protection module, wherein the layering architecture module is used for constructing a terminal perception layer and a cloud platform layer, generating a three-dimensional risk thermodynamic diagram, carrying out short-term early warning model and emergency deduction, carrying out multi-dimensional identity verification based on protocol layering and national encryption algorithm fusion, carrying out dynamic management and eavesdropping monitoring on a key, optimizing a data processing flow, establishing whether encryption or decryption is needed for dynamic negotiation of a security channel, carrying out processing and risk assessment on monitored data, adopting a dynamic key period according to a generated risk level, carrying out key backup and recovery, and the security protection module is used for carrying out intelligent management on system power consumption, adopting a dynamic compression algorithm, selecting a compression strategy according to data types, carrying out security monitoring on hardware and firmware, carrying out intrusion monitoring on the system and carrying out automatic restoration.

title_en: Airport-high-speed rail traffic infrastructure double-layer network disaster-resistant toughness recovery analysis method
abstract_en: An airport-high-speed rail traffic infrastructure double-layer network disaster-resistant toughness recovery analysis method. The method comprises the steps of establishing an airport-high-speed rail traffic infrastructure double-layer network model, performing characteristic analysis on the model, calculating relative importance of an airport and a high-speed rail network layer and intra-layer importance of nodes, calculating global importance of the nodes in the model, selecting an airport and high-speed rail node with a node value, an aggregation coefficient value and a global importance value to damage, obtaining failure nodes in the airport-high-speed rail traffic infrastructure double-layer network model, evaluating the toughness of the model through changes of double-layer network efficiency before and after failure of the calculation nodes, determining optimal recovery sequence of the failure nodes based on a genetic algorithm and the like. The invention effectively improves the disaster resistance toughness of the double-layer network of the airport-high-speed rail traffic infrastructure, and provides an analysis method for improving the operation efficiency of the comprehensive three-dimensional traffic infrastructure in China and integrally allocating the recovery resources under the disaster.
assignees: UNIV CIVIL AVIATION CHINA

title_en: Early fault characteristic data integration method for power equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an early fault characteristic data integration method of power equipment, which belongs to the technical field of power grid fault restoration and comprises an autonomous navigation module, a fault identification module, a fault processing module and a control module, wherein the autonomous navigation module is used for planning an optimal path moving to a pre-repair position and performing autonomous navigation, the fault identification module is used for acquiring an RGB image of the pre-repair position and extracting the early fault characteristic data of the power equipment, the fault processing module is used for inputting the early fault characteristic data of the power equipment into a large language model for integration and outputting integrated fault characteristics, and the integrated fault characteristics are used for controlling a mechanical arm to repair the fault position. The invention solves the problems of low maintenance efficiency, poor safety and inaccurate repair existing in the prior art of integrating the early fault characteristic data of the power equipment.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHAANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID XIAN ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network rush-repair scheduling method and system based on fault prediction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power distribution network rush-repair scheduling method and system based on fault prediction, which solve the problem of low rush-repair scheduling efficiency in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of collecting a power distribution network basic data time sequence in a historical period in a scheduling area, preprocessing to obtain multivariable time sequence data, dividing the scheduling area into a plurality of grids, predicting the number of user power failures at the current moment based on the historical multivariable time sequence data and the corresponding number of user power failures in each grid, constructing a dispatching center address selection optimization model with the minimum dispatching center repair efficiency and the comprehensive influence of power failure loss as targets based on the multivariable time sequence data and the predicted number of user power failures at the current moment, solving to obtain an optimal dispatching center address selection position, constructing a repair team scheduling multi-target model with the minimum repair path distance and repair time as targets based on the optimal dispatching center address selection position and the acquired current fault point list and repair team parameters, and solving to obtain an optimal repair scheduling route of the power distribution network. Realizing scientific rush repair scheduling.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Damaged road network recovery order optimization method based on user balance distribution and targeting maximum toughness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a damaged road network recovery sequence optimization method based on user balance distribution and aiming at maximum toughness, which aims to solve the problems of low recovery efficiency of traffic road networks after disaster and lack of scientific basis for decision making. The method comprises the following implementation steps of firstly constructing a damaged road network toughness assessment framework, combining a traffic network topological structure and traffic demands, defining toughness indexes as the reciprocal of the product of recovery time and total transit time, secondly, establishing damaged road network toughness optimization scene parameters, abstracting the road network into a connected graph and defining a recovery scheme set, then constructing a mixed integer linear programming model with maximum toughness as a target, converting a nonlinear problem into a linear problem through line approximation, setting constraint conditions such as traffic balance and travel demands, and finally, carrying out overall optimization solution on the model by utilizing a high-performance solver to generate an optimal recovery scheme. The method can scientifically quantify the toughness of the road network and optimize the recovery sequence, avoid blindness of empirical decision, rapidly improve the traffic efficiency of the traffic system after the disaster, provide high-efficiency and scientific decision support for the traffic recovery after the disaster, and have important practical application value.

title_en: Method and device for constructing green vegetation pattern by water in semiarid region
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for constructing a green vegetation pattern by water in a semiarid region, and relates to the technical field of vegetation pattern construction and ecological restoration in the semiarid region; according to the water resource data, carrying out water resource evaluation on the semiarid region to obtain a water resource evaluation result, carrying out vegetation water demand analysis on the semiarid region according to the vegetation data and the climate data to obtain a vegetation water demand analysis result, carrying out vegetation suitability evaluation on the semiarid region, screening out vegetation species matched with the water resource condition of the semiarid region, carrying out vegetation pattern design on the semiarid region, and determining a vegetation pattern design scheme so as to facilitate the vegetation planting operation on the semiarid region. The application can realize reasonable matching of vegetation construction and water resources in semiarid regions, and effectively improve the stability and ecological service function of regional ecological systems.
assignees: INST WATER RESOURCES PASTERAL AREA MINI WATER RESOURCES PRC

title_en: Encryption protection method for network data backup and recovery
abstract_en: The invention discloses an encryption protection method for network data backup and recovery, which relates to the technical field of data protection and comprises the steps of adopting a local, cloud and remote three-terminal collaborative backup architecture to respectively implement differential backup strategies; and carrying out local data backup by a combined scheme of complete backup and incremental backup to generate a chained hash value sequence. The invention adopts three-terminal key isolation and dynamic derivation to ensure data security, adopts independent key systems in local, cloud and remote places, generates chained keys based on hash chains in local, and generates version independent keys in cloud and remote places, and the key leakage of any storage terminal does not affect the data security of other terminals. The recovery priority is automatically switched from local to cloud to different places, the incremental data is decrypted layer by layer through a hash chain locally, the cloud directly calls the independent key of the target version, the synthetic backup complete copy is used in different places, and the disaster recovery efficiency is improved through layered recovery and synthetic backup.
assignees: SHANDONG CHAOSHI INFORMATION TECH SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Natural disaster ecological restoration success assessment method and assessment system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of natural disaster ecological restoration success assessment methods, and discloses a natural disaster ecological restoration success assessment method and an assessment system, aiming at solving the problems of imperfect index system, single assessment method, strong subjectivity, lack of systematicness, low automation degree and the like in the existing assessment method. The invention provides a method and a system for comprehensively, objectively and scientifically evaluating ecological restoration effects of natural disasters by comprehensively utilizing various evaluation methods including, but not limited to, a hierarchical analysis method, a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, a principal component analysis method and the like and combining a remote sensing technology, a geographic information system technology and a database technology.
assignees: UNIV LANZHOU

title_en: Ecological restoration system and method for hydro-fluctuation belt
abstract_en: The application discloses an ecological restoration system and method for a hydro-fluctuation belt, and relates to the technical field of ecological engineering, wherein the ecological restoration system comprises an intelligent perception layer, a decision control layer and an execution layer; the intelligent sensing layer comprises a hydrological sensor array and an unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing platform and is used for collecting environmental monitoring data and vegetation coverage data of the hydro-fluctuation belt in real time, the decision control layer is used for predicting a water level prediction value of the hydro-fluctuation belt in a preset time period in the future based on the environmental monitoring data collected by the hydrological sensor array according to a water level prediction model, the execution layer is used for controlling a liftable floating island and mobile biomass processing equipment according to the vegetation coverage data collected by the unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing platform and the water level prediction value of the hydro-fluctuation belt, wherein the liftable floating island is controlled so that plants related to ecological restoration on the liftable floating island are in a corresponding safe water level range, and the mobile biomass processing equipment is used for recycling plant residues. The application improves the ecological restoration effect of the hydro-fluctuation belt and improves the sustainability of ecological restoration.
assignees: GUANGDONG WENKE GREEN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Farmland heavy metal restoration path planning system based on unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing data drive
abstract_en: The invention discloses a farmland heavy metal restoration path planning system based on unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing data driving, which relates to the technical field of farmland restoration and comprises a data acquisition module, a pollution restoration subarea dividing module, an attribute identifying module, a heavy metal restoration means evaluating module, a pollution restoration subarea association effect evaluating module, a composite restoration coefficient calculating module, a global restoration optimizing module and a scheme output module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring real-time remote sensing image data, the pollution restoration subarea dividing module is used for dividing the pollution restoration subareas, the attribute identifying module is used for identifying land block attribute information, the heavy metal restoration means evaluating module is used for evaluating initial restoration coefficients, the pollution restoration subarea association effect evaluating module is used for evaluating restoration migration effects, the composite restoration coefficient calculating module is used for comprehensively evaluating composite restoration coefficients, the global restoration optimizing module is used for globally planning implemented heavy metal restoration means of each pollution restoration subarea, and the scheme output module is used for outputting restoration paths of each heavy metal restoration means. The method has the advantage of providing a powerful intelligent decision support for efficient, accurate and collaborative restoration of heavy metal pollution of the complex farmland.

title_en: System and Method for Compressing and Restoring Data Using Hierarchical Autoencoders and a Knowledge-Enhanced Correlation Network
abstract_en: A system and method for compressing and restoring data using a hierarchical multi-level autoencoder architecture and correlation network. The system compresses data using a cascade of autoencoders, each focusing on different scales or features, allowing for efficient representation across various resolutions. Data restoration employs a corresponding hierarchical decoder structure and a correlation network, trained on cross-correlated data sets. This approach leverages inter-data relationships at multiple scales, potentially recovering more lost information than traditional single-scale methods. The hierarchical structure adapts to diverse data types, achieving higher compression ratios while maintaining data quality, applicable to fields such as remote sensing, IoT data processing, and multimedia compression.
assignees: ATOMBEAM TECHNOLOGIES INC

title_en: Video-Focused Compression with Hierarchical and Lorentzian Autoencoders
abstract_en: A system and method for compressing and restoring data using hierarchical autoencoders and Lorentzian autoencoders for video processing. For general data, the system employs hierarchical autoencoders operating at multiple scales. For video data, Lorentzian autoencoders preserve three-dimensional tensor structure where spatial and temporal relationships remain intact throughout compression and decompression. A correlation network, trained on cross-correlated data sets, enhances restoration by leveraging relationships between compressed representations, recovering information lost during compression. The Lorentzian approach enables advanced video features including temporal prediction and infinite zoom, where users can examine regions beyond original resolution with synthesized yet plausible details. This architecture achieves higher compression ratios while maintaining or improving data quality, particularly for video content where spatiotemporal coherence is critical, applicable to surveillance, medical imaging, entertainment, and remote sensing.
assignees: ATOMBEAM TECHNOLOGIES INC

title_en: Historical culture block riding building structure reinforcement and restoration diagnosis system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for reinforcing, repairing and diagnosing a building structure of a historical cultural block, and relates to the technical field of building repair, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring deformation data of the building surface of the building by adopting a laser scanner, synchronously starting a ground penetrating radar to detect the hollowness rate and mortar compactness of the interior of a wall body, embedding a temperature and humidity sensor to acquire environmental corrosion parameters, and establishing a three-dimensional structure model fusing vibration and corrosion coupling characteristics; the method comprises the steps of generating a wall reinforcing module, a foundation reinforcing module and an earthquake-resistant reinforcing module according to a three-dimensional structure model, constructing a dynamic material database containing a gray plastic layer salt crystal growth rule, calculating a paper-reinforcement gray ratio and a thermal expansion compatible parameter of a reinforced concrete member through a multi-scale stress matching algorithm, carrying out typhoon and induced abortion coupling load simulation based on the repaired three-dimensional structure model, generating a three-dimensional activation scheme in combination with dynamic commercial streamline planning, and deploying an environment response type monitoring network.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-based water body sand content measuring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water body sand content measuring method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the following steps of firstly establishing an inference model from a digital quantized value of a target water body image to the target water body sand content, secondly enabling the unmanned aerial vehicle to fly along the target water body and collect images of different areas of the target water body and transmit the images back to a remote computer, thirdly, manually calibrating the water body areas in all the images collected by the unmanned aerial vehicle, fourthly, calculating an average value DN1 of the digital quantized values of all pixels by the computer aiming at the water body areas calibrated in all the images, and thirdly, obtaining the sand content corresponding to all the images collected by the unmanned aerial vehicle by the computer through the inference model established in the first step. The invention realizes high-efficiency, accurate and low-cost monitoring of the sand content of the water body through 'model driving + unmanned aerial vehicle dynamic acquisition + data processing', is applicable to river management requirements in a large-scale and complex environment, and provides reliable technical support for water resource protection, disaster early warning and ecological restoration.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA WATER RESOURCES & ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Karst big spring monitoring early warning and repair system based on four pre-treatment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of hydrologic monitoring, in particular to a karst big spring monitoring, early warning and repairing system based on four pre-detection, wherein the system comprises a data acquisition module, a groundwater forecasting module, a groundwater early warning module and a groundwater planning module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring karst big spring groundwater data; the underground water prediction module is used for constructing an underground water prediction model to perform three-dimensional dynamic prediction, water level trend analysis and visual display, the underground water prediction module is used for establishing a spring field simulation engine adapting to karst big springs, supporting different spring protection measures and simulating artificial supply effects, the underground water early warning module is used for constructing a karst big spring current breaking early warning model to judge the current breaking risk level, and the underground water early warning module is used for outputting an ecological restoration scheme adapting to the mode. Therefore, the problems of lack of three-dimensional dynamic and visual performance, single early warning index, early warning and repairing dislocation and the like are solved.
assignees: NO 9 GEOLOGICAL BRIGADE OF HEBEI PROVINCIAL BUREAU OF GEOLOGY AND MINERAL EXPLOR AND DEVELOPMENT;XINGTAI GEOLOGICAL AND MINERAL GEOLOGICAL ENGINEERING INVESTIG INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Method, equipment, medium and product for stable and proper coordination of river basin mountain water Lin Tianhu and grass sand
abstract_en: The application discloses a stable and proper coordination method, equipment, medium and product for river basin mountain water Lin Tianhu grass sand, which relates to the field of ecological hydrologic protection and treatment and comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of carrying out gridding treatment on a research area, dividing a river basin into a plurality of research units, solving a model according to river basin basic data corresponding to each research unit, aiming at ecological optimum and hydrologic function balance optimum, aiming at grain and livestock yield maximization, aiming at water resource allocation efficiency optimum, aiming at environmental restoration cost minimization, aiming at social change minimization and aiming at environmental risk minimization, constructing a multi-objective optimization model facing the river basin of an inland river, and solving the model through a mixed algorithm combining a genetic algorithm and a particle swarm optimization algorithm to obtain a river basin mountain Lin Tianhu grass sand stable proper coordination result. The application can realize the integral optimization and dynamic coordination of multiple elements on the drainage basin scale, and meet the long-term stability and suitability requirements of the complex drainage basin ecological system.
assignees: UNIV INNER MONGOLIA AGRI

title_en: Two-stage toughness enhancement method and device for power distribution system based on structure-function coupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a structure-function coupling-based two-stage toughness enhancement method and device for a power distribution system, wherein a vulnerable power distribution line list and an expected fault scene set are generated by combining the ultimate wind resistance strength of a power distribution line and a pole tower based on typhoon disaster forecast data; based on the vulnerable distribution line list and the expected fault scene set, an active loss amount of minimized line reinforcement cost and load is taken as an objective function, a two-stage toughness enhancement model of a distribution information physical system considering line reinforcement and multi-resource flexible scheduling is constructed, and under a set constraint condition, the two-stage toughness enhancement model of the distribution information physical system is solved to obtain an optimal toughness enhancement strategy of the distribution system. The invention realizes the dynamic matching of communication rush repair and power supply restoration in the fault area, and can effectively cope with the cross-domain cascading failure scene.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: Degraded grassland ecological restoration method and system based on ecological water requirements inside and outside river and lake
abstract_en: The invention discloses a degraded grassland ecological restoration method and system based on ecological water requirements inside and outside a river and a lake, which comprises the steps of carrying out field investigation, analyzing main characteristics of the degraded grassland to carry out degradation grade region division, wherein the main characteristics comprise vegetation coverage, species diversity index and soil volume weight, carrying out ecological unit meshing division based on terrain adaptation, constructing a multi-objective function and constraint condition for the degraded grassland ecological restoration based on the ecological water requirements inside and outside the river and lake according to water resource allocation, grassland restoration, grazing management and economic benefit, combining specific grassland degradation grades of a degraded area on the basis of the ecological water requirements inside and outside the river and lake, and carrying out restoration priority sorting, dynamic adjustment strategy and dynamic water resource adjustment according to the multi-objective function and constraint condition to obtain an optimal degraded grassland ecological restoration scheme.

title_en: Sand land landscape pattern optimization method based on internal and external ecology water demand of river and lake
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sand landscape pattern optimization method based on ecological water requirements inside and outside a river and a lake, and relates to the technical field of ecological restoration and water resource management, comprising the following steps of 1, collecting remote sensing images, field ecological data and hydrological meteorological data, and preprocessing to obtain ecological hydrological element data; the method comprises the steps of (1) calculating ecological water demand of the semiarid sandy landscape according to ecological hydrologic element data, (3) constructing a nonlinear-multi-target sandy landscape pattern optimization model according to the ecological water demand and the ecological hydrologic element data, (4) solving the nonlinear-multi-target sandy landscape pattern optimization model by adopting a multi-target optimization algorithm according to condition constraint to obtain a parameter optimal solution, and (5) constructing a sandy landscape pattern strategy according to the parameter optimal solution. The invention realizes sustainable utilization of the sand landscape water resource and improvement of the ecological hydrologic function by comprehensively optimizing the water-sand resource allocation, the ecological water demand inside and outside the river and the lake and cooperatively allocating each landscape element.
assignees: UNIV INNER MONGOLIA AGRI

title_en: Restoration method for restoring geological disaster area ecology of mining area by utilizing coal gangue
abstract_en: The invention provides a restoration method for restoring geological disaster area ecology of a mining area by utilizing coal gangue, and relates to the field of coal gangue restoration of mining areas. The method for repairing the geological disaster area ecology of the mining area by using the coal gangue comprises the following specific repairing steps of 1, cleaning and constructing a disaster collapse area, cleaning loose broken stones and dangerous rocks of the collapse area, trimming a slope surface to enhance the adhesive force of a filling body, 2, repairing the coal gangue, namely, using type II coal gangue mixed cement with the particle size of 30-100mm as a bottom foundation, adding lime accounting for 3% -5% of the total weight of the mixed material and fly ash accounting for 10% -15% of the total weight of the mixed material, reinforcing the middle layer, namely, after the coal gangue blocks are mixed with the cement, forming a compound body with higher compressive strength, and discharging bubbles in the coal gangue blocks after the cement is mixed by a vibrating rod. The mixture has outstanding environmental benefits, can greatly utilize coal gangue and fly ash, reduces solid waste accumulation, and simultaneously can solidify heavy metals by lime, thereby reducing pollution risk.
assignees: SHANDONG PROVINCIAL BUREAU OF GEOLOGY & MINERAL RESOURCESNO 801 HYDROGEOLOGICAL ENG GEOLOGICAL BRIGA;PENGLAIGE SCENIC AREA MAN SERVICE CENTER;UNIV SHANDONG SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Ecological restoration district side slope soil and water conservation structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a slope water and soil conservation structure of an ecological restoration area, which comprises a support main pipe arranged in a slope, wherein the support main pipe is connected with a plurality of support branch pipes, the support branch pipes are connected with a plant frame through connecting plates positioned on the slope, the connecting plates are provided with a plurality of through holes, the support branch pipes and the support main pipe are communicated, and a water absorbing piece for supplying water is arranged between the support main pipe and a planting area of the plant frame. The utility model strengthens the stability of the side slope, is not easy to generate soil erosion and landslide, stably connects the plant frame with the supporting branch pipe, namely, the plant frame is firmly connected with the side slope and is not easy to fall off, the service life is long, the plant frame, the supporting main pipe and the supporting branch pipe are all assembled, the installation and the disassembly are simple and quick, and the damaged part is convenient to be independently replaced in the later period.
assignees: HENAN FOURTH GEOLOGICAL EXPLORATION INST CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network source-network-storage multi-resource collaborative optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electrical engineering, and discloses a power distribution network source-network-storage multi-resource collaborative optimization method and a system, wherein the method and the system are used for segmenting estimated fault restoration time, acquiring SOP control modes and the number of uncharged islands in each time period, constructing a controllable power supply-new energy coordinated micro-network partition model taking total power of restoration load as an optimization target and taking various resource constraints as conditions according to the SOP control modes and the number of uncharged islands, and solving to obtain SOP open and closed states in each time period as a fault restoration scheme. The method fully considers various flexible resources such as distributed new energy, controllable power supply, energy storage and the like in the future power distribution network, and realizes the optimization coordination of the resources in fault recovery through sectional processing and model construction. The method effectively solves the problem that the existing fault recovery means cannot fully consider various resources, can more reasonably integrate various flexible power generation resources, effectively improves the recovery effect of the power distribution network after faults, and reduces the influence caused by power failure.
assignees: ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: New energy wind-light sample data processing method and device based on regularity constraint
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of energy data processing, in particular to a new energy wind-light sample data processing method and device based on regularity constraint, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a regular interpolation model and carrying out interpolation supplementation on data missing which easily occurs in a complex environment of a new energy wind power and photovoltaic system; the method comprises the steps of establishing a data quality assessment model based on a topology perception local reversible attention mechanism, automatically assessing the quality of data generated by different interpolation modes, establishing a dynamic weight fusion model, automatically adjusting the weight of each data source in the data complement process, thereby realizing the optimization of the data restoration effect, establishing an abnormal data rejection model, and improving the integrity and reliability of new energy data. Therefore, the problems that the generalization of the prior art for dealing with complicated and changeable severe weather conditions is poor, the data integrity and accuracy are difficult to be considered effectively, the requirement of a new energy power generation system on high-quality data cannot be met and the like are solved.

title_en: A fertilizer-type forest fire prevention agent with forest fire delay and restoration effects
title_ko: 비료 형태의 산불 지연 및 복원효과가 있는 산불 방재제
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a forest fire disaster prevention agent having a fertilizer type forest fire delay and restoration effect. More specifically, the forest fire disaster prevention agent composed of a triple structure layer comprises: a fertilizer layer disposed on the outermost side of the triple structure layer and formed by mixing nitrogen, phosphoric acid, and chrysanthemum; a retarder layer disposed in the middle of the triple structure layer and including second ammonium phosphate, ammonium carbonate, and urea; and a synedra sp. Disposed in the center of the triple structure layer and nitrogen, phosphoric acid, chrysanthemum, polyammonium phosphate, seed seeds, and sinedra sp. The reconstituting agent layer including is by including comprised. That is, the present invention proposes a forest fire disaster prevention agent composed of a triple composite structure layer pre-sprayed for a composite fertilizer function for a rim, delaying and restoring a forest fire, and through this, unlike an existing liquid acid meal retarder, the present invention proposes a fertilizer-type forest fire disaster prevention agent having a forest fire delay and restoration effect, which has persistence without loss due to precipitation and can naturally implement the release of the forest fire disaster prevention agent without additional help.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 비료 형태의 산불 지연 및 복원효과가 있는 산불 방재제에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 3중 구조층으로 구성되는 산불 방재제에 있어서, 3중 구조층의 최외각에 배치되고, 질소, 인산 및 가리를 배합하여 형성되는 비료층; 3중 구조층의 중간에 배치되고, 제2 인산암모늄, 탄산암모늄 및 요소를 포함하는 지연제층; 및 3중 구조층의 중심에 배치되고, 질소, 인산, 가리, 폴리인산암모늄, 종자 씨앗 및 시네드라(synedra sp.)를 포함하는 복원제층;을 포함하여 이루어진다. 
즉 본 발명은 림에 대한 복합비료기능, 산불의 지연 및 복원을 위해 사전 살포되는 3중 복합 구조층으로 구성되는 산불 방재제를 제안하고, 이를 통해 기존 액상형 산분 지연제와 달리 강수에 의한 유실이 없는 지속성을 가지며, 추가적인 도움 없이 산불 방재제의 방출을 자연스럽게 구현할 수 있는 비료 형태의 산불 지연 및 복원효과가 있는 산불 방재제를 제안하고자 한다.
assignees: YEUNGNAM COLLEGE OF SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Continuous and infinite video zoom using hierarchical and lorentzian autoencoders
abstract_en: A system and method for compressing and restoring data using hierarchical autoencoders and Lorentzian autoencoders for video processing. For general data, the system employs hierarchical autoencoders operating at multiple scales. For video data, Lorentzian autoencoders preserve three-dimensional tensor structure where spatial and temporal relationships remain intact throughout compression and decompression. A correlation network, trained on cross-correlated data sets, enhances restoration by leveraging relationships between compressed representations, recovering information lost during compression. The Lorentzian approach enables advanced video features including temporal prediction and infinite zoom, where users can examine regions beyond original resolution with synthesized yet plausible details. This architecture achieves higher compression ratios while maintaining or improving data quality, particularly for video content where spatiotemporal coherence is critical, applicable to surveillance, medical imaging, entertainment, and remote sensing.
assignees: ATOMBEAM TECHNOLOGIES INC

title_en: Power supply sequence recovery method for cooperation of urban idle resources and emergency resources in extreme scene
abstract_en: The application provides a power supply sequence recovery method for cooperation of urban idle resources and emergency resources under an extreme scene, which comprises the steps of constructing a first scheduling model of available electric vehicles based on the first number of electric vehicles reaching a parking lot during a fault period, constructing a second scheduling model of a mobile energy storage vehicle based on a road impedance model and a time-varying congestion coefficient under the extreme scene delay, constructing an emergency repair team model based on a fault interrupt line, constructing a multi-source cooperation power supply active supporting model taking the sum of load loss cost and each resource scheduling cost as an objective function based on the first scheduling model, the second scheduling model and the emergency repair team model, solving the multi-source cooperation power supply active supporting model, and determining a power supply recovery sequence. The multi-source cooperative power supply active support model comprising the sum of the scheduling cost of each resource is constructed to participate in the power distribution network support power supply, so that the load rapid support power supply and the rapid recovery of a fault line are realized.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD ZHAOQING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;UNIV HUNAN

title_en: Multi-source cooperative power supply recovery method and device considering agricultural biogas power generation support
abstract_en: A multi-source collaborative power restoration method and device considering agricultural biogas power generation support comprises the steps of establishing a power restoration model, establishing an objective function according to load restoration maximization in the power restoration process, determining the number of micro-grids in a system according to dynamic radial constraint of a power distribution network, considering photovoltaic inverter constraint, cold load starting constraint and linear load flow constraint of self-adaptive network topology of the power distribution network in the power restoration model, adding grid-built inverter constraint based on battery energy storage, grid-built inverter synchronous constraint, agricultural biogas power generation constraint and power transmission network power failure and restoration process constraint in the power restoration model, initializing the power restoration model, and solving by using Gurobi solver to obtain a load restoration state of the power distribution network.
