In the invention, the support of agricultural biogas power generation is considered in the power supply recovery process, dynamic radial constraint is developed to support the synchronization process, and the multi-source cooperative power supply recovery is realized.

title_en: Micro-topography reconstruction and ecological restoration system for alpine arid coal mining area
abstract_en: The invention provides a micro-topography reconstruction and ecological restoration system for a severe cold arid coal mining area, which relates to the technical field of ecological restoration of coal mining areas, and comprises the steps of screening out a sample area by an area screening module, and acquiring time sequence data of ground water level and landform parameters of the sample area; the model construction and simulation module acquires the underground predicted water level, the data processing and analysis module generates a terrain influence coefficient and a proper groundwater level coefficient, and the comprehensive evaluation module integrates the proper groundwater level coefficient and the terrain influence coefficient to generate a comprehensive evaluation coefficient so as to guide corresponding ecological restoration measures. The invention can capture multidimensional factors and complex correlations affecting the groundwater level, remarkably improve the accuracy and the reliability when predicting the groundwater level change, and can timely adjust the repairing measures according to the suitability of the groundwater level so as to ensure the effectiveness and the sustainability of ecological repairing.
assignees: NORTHWEST INSTITUTE ECO ENVIRONMENT & RESOURCES CAS

title_en: Food safety monitoring data disaster recovery method and system based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a food safety monitoring data disaster recovery method and a system based on edge calculation, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a food safety monitoring data set uploaded by a plurality of edge calculation nodes in a target monitoring area, wherein the food safety monitoring data set comprises a plurality of monitoring data units; the method comprises the steps of carrying out data feature extraction processing on a food safety monitoring data set to obtain data integrity features and data relevance features of each monitoring data unit, carrying out policy matching processing on the data integrity features and the data relevance features based on a preset disaster recovery policy model to generate disaster recovery priority identifiers and disaster recovery storage policies of the monitoring data units, and indicating the edge computing nodes to execute corresponding data disaster recovery backup operation according to the disaster recovery priority identifiers and the disaster recovery storage policies.
assignees: GUIYANG KANGYANG VOCATIONAL UNIV

title_en: Slope protection system is restoreed to green slope that plants of geological disaster restoration
abstract_en: The application relates to a slope restoration slope protection system for restoring geological disasters, which relates to the technical field of rain-collecting irrigation facilities and comprises a water collecting assembly, an irrigation assembly and a filtering assembly. The water collecting assembly is arranged on the slope, the water collecting assembly is used for collecting rainwater in rainy seasons, the irrigation assembly is connected with the water collecting assembly and used for irrigating the repaired slope, the filtering assembly is arranged on the water collecting assembly and used for filtering the collected rainwater. The application has the effects of reducing the workload and cost of slope irrigation to be repaired and reasonably utilizing rainwater resources.
assignees: SHANXI GEOLOGICAL EXPLOR BUREAU 214 GEOLOGICAL TEAM CO LTD;SHANXI NO 8 GEOLOGICAL ENGINEERING INVESTIG INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Quality risk assessment method and system for inspection and detection mechanism
abstract_en: The invention provides a quality risk assessment method and a quality risk assessment system for a checking and detecting mechanism, and relates to the technical field of risk assessment. According to the method, the risk assessment driven by traditional subjective experience is converted into a data-driven quantization model through dynamic weight calculation (network analytic hierarchy process quantization assessment of dependency relationship among parameters) and operation data integration (covering equipment, personnel, history non-conforming items and the like), the risk score is updated based on the operation data, dynamic early warning is triggered, a restoration suggestion scheme is generated by combining historical abnormal cases, so that 'assessment-early warning-restoration' closed-loop management is formed, and the defects of fragmentation and strong hysteresis of the traditional method are overcome. In addition, the evaluation parameters cover the core risk sources from the dimensions of scale, manpower, quality, technology and the like, are mutually dependent and are cooperatively analyzed by a network analytic hierarchy process.
assignees: NANJING CUSTOMS IND PRODUCTS TESTING CENTER

title_en: Power distribution network power supply recovery method and device, computer equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a power supply restoration method and device for a power distribution network, computer equipment and a readable storage medium, relates to the technical field of power systems, and can quickly restore power supply of the power distribution network after disasters. The method comprises the steps of predicting the fault probability of a power distribution network line and the fault probability of power distribution equipment after extreme disasters, marking a power distribution network node diagram to obtain a power distribution network node diagram to be recovered, inputting the power distribution network node diagram to be recovered to a first recovery model which is built in advance, enabling the number of nodes in a power restoration area to be maximized to be an objective function, generating a power restoration node list based on power output constraint and rigid load demand, inputting the power restoration node list to a second recovery model which is built in advance, enabling the load weight to be maximized to be the objective function by the second recovery model, generating a target power distribution strategy based on flexible load adjustment capacity and power output constraint, and controlling power distribution network switching action according to the target power distribution strategy.
assignees: NANNING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Ecological friendly seawall construction method and ecological modification method of rigid seawall
abstract_en: An ecological friendly seawall construction method and an ecological modification method of a rigid seawall comprise the steps of constructing a seawall open caisson foundation, constructing a stepped revetment on the seawall open caisson foundation, wherein the stepped revetment comprises a stepped concrete revetment and modularized precast concrete steps, a plurality of drain pipes are arranged at the bottom of the stepped concrete revetment, drain outlets of the drain pipes are arranged in a wave-proof forest in front of the seawall, the precast concrete steps comprise an uppermost viewing platform and a plurality of concrete planting ponds, a riprap protecting foot is arranged on the outer side of the stepped revetment, sand is covered above the riprap, and a wind-proof forest behind the seawall and a dike top step are sequentially arranged on the inner side of the stepped revetment. The constructed or transformed seawall integrates ecological restoration, landscaping, dampproof disaster reduction, and the function of coping with storm surge is reserved when the seawall is landscaping.
assignees: BEIJING TUREN CITY PLANNING DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Household-changing relation identification method and related device based on intelligent ammeter outage and restoration big data
abstract_en: The invention provides a household change relation identification method and device based on intelligent ammeter outage and restoration big data, and belongs to the field of data processing and analysis of electric power systems. The method comprises the steps of carrying out clock verification on the on-line electricity meter to obtain the on-line electricity meter with aligned clock time, carrying out meter outage data reading on the on-line electricity meter by using a concentrator subjected to program optimization, storing the meter outage data in a database, extracting collected meter outage data from the database, obtaining a transformer outage time record, comparing the records, and identifying the transformer to which each electricity meter belongs, thereby completing the identification of the household change relation. According to the invention, through analysis and processing of the intelligent ammeter outage and restoration big data, the automatic identification of the household change relation is realized, and the problems of low efficiency, data update lag and the like in the traditional household change relation identification are effectively solved. The invention not only improves the accuracy and efficiency of line loss management work, but also provides powerful technical support for sustainable development of power supply enterprises.
assignees: FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Method, system, equipment and storage medium for evaluating acidic underground water of abandoned mine
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of ecological assessment, and particularly relates to an ecological assessment method, system, equipment and storage medium for acidic underground water of a abandoned mine, which are characterized in that physical and chemical parameters of the acidic underground water of the abandoned mine, including pH value, heavy metal concentration, dissolved oxygen content, temperature and conductivity, are obtained through analysis of a sensor and a laboratory, the collected physical and chemical parameters are subjected to denoising, normalization and interpolation treatment to eliminate abnormal values and ensure the integrity of data, an ecological risk assessment model is trained by using historical data based on a machine learning algorithm, the model comprises a support vector machine, a random forest and a neural network, the ecological risk is classified into three grades of low risk, medium risk and high risk according to the output result of the model, corresponding risk reports are generated, and restoration and treatment suggestions, including an acidic water treatment scheme, a groundwater monitoring plan and ecological restoration measures, are automatically generated according to the risk grades, so that the method has the effect of providing more comprehensive and more detailed assessment results and providing scientific basis for environmental protection decisions.
assignees: HYDROGEOLOGY BUREAU CHINA NAT ADMINISTRATION COAL GEOLOGY

title_en: Forest grass fire disaster land recovery monitoring method based on unmanned aerial vehicle aircraft vision
abstract_en: A forest fire hazard site restoration monitoring method based on unmanned aerial vehicle aircraft vision is characterized by comprising the steps of 1, constructing a forest fire hazard site restoration monitoring system, 2, carrying a multispectral camera on an unmanned aerial vehicle aircraft, shooting video stream remote sensing data of a forest site area in real time, converting the video stream remote sensing data into image frame data, 3, preprocessing the image frame data by an image preprocessing module to obtain a standard image, 4, segmenting a forest fire hazard restoration area in the standard image by using a everything segmentation algorithm by using an image segmentation module to obtain a forest fire hazard restoration area image, 5, carrying out feature enhancement on the forest fire hazard site restoration area image by using a feature enhancement network to obtain an enhanced image, and 6, carrying out forest fire hazard restoration prediction on the enhanced image by using a forest fire hazard site restoration time prediction model, and predicting to obtain a normalized forest fire hazard restoration time index of the enhanced image. The intelligent monitoring and prediction method has the advantages that intelligent monitoring and prediction of the forest fire trace restoration area are realized.
assignees: CHONGQING INTERCONTROL ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Multi-scale feature fusion-based electricity price and load prediction method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for predicting electricity price and load based on multi-scale feature fusion, belonging to the technical field of electric power spot transaction, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out data restoration and data reconstruction on historical transaction data of an obtained electric power market to obtain a multi-scale data matrix; based on the influence of meteorological factors and time factors on the output and time-sharing electricity price of a distributed power supply, carrying out correlation analysis on a multi-scale data matrix, extracting and fusing characteristics related to electricity price change and load change to obtain multi-dimensional characteristic data, inputting the multi-dimensional characteristic data into a preset load-electricity price combined prediction model, and respectively predicting load and electricity price by considering the mutual influence between the load change and the electricity price change to obtain a load predicted value and an electricity price predicted value. Therefore, by implementing the application, the problem that the accuracy of the predicted load and electricity price is lower because the mutual influence between the load and the electricity price is not considered in the prior art can be solved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Railway operation and maintenance communication network optimization system integrating power grid information
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of railway operation and maintenance communication, and discloses a railway operation and maintenance communication network optimization system integrating power grid information. The system comprises a multi-source data fusion module, a communication quality assessment module, a network topology optimization module, a dynamic resource scheduling module, an abnormal collaborative processing module and a federal learning framework, wherein the multi-source data fusion module is used for acquiring electric power, railway and environment data to generate a space-time multi-dimensional data cube, the communication quality assessment module is used for analyzing the data by using a fuzzy logic fusion algorithm to obtain a communication link quality degradation index sequence, the network topology optimization module is used for constructing a dynamic Bayesian network model to calculate an optimal communication routing table, the dynamic resource scheduling module is used for designing a double-layer planning algorithm to realize spectrum and power joint scheduling, and the abnormal collaborative processing module is used for establishing a federal learning framework to generate a cross-domain collaborative restoration instruction set. By fusing the power grid information, the system can accurately evaluate the communication quality, optimize the network topology, reasonably schedule the resources and cooperatively process the anomalies, and effectively improve the performance and the reliability of the railway operation and maintenance communication network.

title_en: Data disaster recovery method supporting multi-backup path switching
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data disaster recovery method supporting multi-backup path switching, which comprises the steps of generating dynamic granularity data fragments based on sensitivity of input data and storage medium characteristics, generating metadata labels comprising data fragment identification, storage preference and recovery priority, constructing a heterogeneous transmission path performance model through the metadata labels, generating a path quality map, distributing an optimal transmission path for each data fragment, monitoring path performance, detecting abnormality and migrating fragments through standard deviation of accumulated transmission delay, adopting Merkle proof of incremental integrity verification and blockchain storage to carry out parallel verification, and retransmitting the verification failure fragments preferentially.

title_en: Ecological restoration method for centralized drinking water source area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for ecologically restoring a centralized drinking water source, which particularly relates to the technical field of ecological restoration of drinking water, and comprises the following steps: S1 partition diagnosis and planning, S2 exogenous pollution interception, S3 substrate improvement and habitat reconstruction, S4 collaborative restoration system construction, S5 hydrologic ecological regulation, S6 intelligent dynamic restoration, S7 long-acting maintenance and evaluation and S8 water supply safety guarantee mechanism. The invention accurately positions pollution hot spots based on partition diagnosis, drives a stepped wetland system to efficiently intercept exogenous pollution, simultaneously lays three-level biological barriers at a water intake to reduce suspended matters, thoroughly blocks the diffusion of pollutants to a deepwater area, and improves the sediment oxygen content by cooperatively lifting submerged plants and carbon sink materials, overlaps quaternary water level regulation and control, improves the submerged vegetation coverage rate, simultaneously automatically triggers an algae control device for real-time water quality monitoring, shortens the outbreak response time of algae, and reduces the annual maintenance cost.
assignees: CHONGQING YIKE ENVIRONMENTAL PROT ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Irrigation method for ecological restoration of high-steep side slope in alpine region
abstract_en: The invention provides an irrigation method for ecological restoration of a high-steep slope in a alpine region, which comprises the steps of acquiring water temperature, water flow rate, ambient temperature and at least one environmental factor parameter in a pipeline in real time, calculating target heating power required by maintaining the target water temperature through a thermal balance model and a feedforward compensation model, converting the target heating power into a pulse width modulation signal, transmitting the pulse width modulation signal to a heating device, and switching and grading control of the heating device according to a water temperature interval. According to the irrigation method for ecological restoration of the high and steep side slopes in the alpine regions, provided by the invention, the heating power required for maintaining the target water temperature is dynamically calculated by combining the heat balance model and the feedforward compensation algorithm, and the heating device is accurately regulated by the hierarchical control mode, so that the problems of freezing and blocking of the high and steep side slope pipelines in the alpine regions can be effectively solved in the irrigation process, the loss of electric energy can be reduced, and the utilization rate of water resources can be improved.
assignees: HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER UPSTREAM HYDROPOWER CO LTD;UNIV BEIJING FORESTRY

title_en: Mud-rock flow slope solid source greening system and implementation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a debris flow slope solid source greening system which comprises an ecological blanket, an automatic water collecting device, a solar panel, a water collecting tank and an intelligent control system, wherein the ecological blanket is formed by compounding a flexible substrate layer and a vegetation recovery layer, the ecological blanket is paved and unfolded along a slope, the automatic water collecting device is arranged at the intersection point of the ecological blanket and the intersection point with the interval of 1.5m, the automatic water collecting device comprises a diversion water collecting tank at the upper part, the solar panel, the water collecting tank at the lower part and the intelligent control system, the solar panel is erected above the water collecting tank, the diversion water collecting tank is suspended between the solar panel and the water collecting tank, and the diversion water collecting tank is communicated with the water collecting tank through a pipeline. According to the invention, through the cooperation of the anti-scouring ecological blanket structure and intelligent water collection-irrigation, the problem that vegetation is easy to scour and irrigation depends on manpower in the traditional technology is solved, and the slope solid source and ecological restoration efficiency are remarkably improved.
assignees: UNIV CHINA THREE GORGES CTGU

title_en: Optimized regulation and control method for land utilization of multiple-outlet watershed
abstract_en: The application provides an optimized regulation and control method for land utilization of multiple-outlet watersheds, which comprises the steps of constructing a spatial attribute regression model, quantitatively analyzing the influence of each land utilization type in a study area on water ecological load, optimizing the spatial attribute regression model by combining rigid boundaries of the study area to obtain corresponding regulation and control potential, evaluating land utilization regulation and control potential and ecological restoration regulation and control potential of the corresponding watersheds by using the optimized spatial attribute regression model, setting land utilization regulation and control scenes and ecological restoration regulation and control scenes, simulating environmental effects related to the land utilization regulation and control scenes by using the optimized spatial attribute regression model, and formulating an optimized restoration measure scheme.
assignees: TIANJIN TIANRONG ENVIRONMENTAL TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Slope reinforcement and restoration device based on pumped storage power station and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a slope reinforcement and restoration device based on a pumped storage power station and a use method thereof, wherein a plurality of reinforcement and restoration mechanisms are paved on a slope body of the storage power station, four corners of the reinforcement and restoration mechanisms are respectively connected with an anchoring mechanism, the lower ends of the anchoring mechanisms are anchored into the slope body, the reinforcing repair mechanism is internally provided with a water collecting mechanism, the water collecting mechanism is connected with a spraying mechanism, and the risk of landslide caused by softening of soil ponding is reduced by arranging an anchoring mechanism, the water collecting mechanism and the spraying mechanism, and the self-supporting effect of irrigation can be realized through a spraying pipe frame in dry seasons.
assignees: POWERCHINA HUADONG ENGINEERING CORP LTD

title_en: Assembly type frame beam column node containing replaceable energy consumption connection
abstract_en: The application provides an assembled frame beam column node with replaceable energy consumption connection, which comprises frame columns and frame beams, wherein beam cantilevers are transversely arranged on one sides of the frame columns in a protruding mode, the beam cantilevers are connected with one ends of the frame beams through web connection plates and high-strength bolts, and the assembled frame beam column node also comprises energy consumption connectors arranged between the beam cantilevers and the frame beams, wherein the energy consumption connectors dissipate external energy through good axial hysteresis performance. The full prefabrication of the components can be realized on a construction site by using bolts by means of the energy-consuming connectors and the web connecting plates. The damaged accessible changes energy consumption connector quick replacement restoration after the shake, and when the structure received disturbance or earthquake, energy consumption connector participated in the power consumption and first entering plastic yield stage as energy consumption first echelon, only need dismantle the quick restoration of change attenuator can accomplish the node afterwards.
assignees: UNIV HUAQIAO

title_en: Emergency power supply scheduling method based on line fault pre-judgment under typhoon
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency power supply scheduling method based on line fault pre-judgment in typhoons, relates to the technical field of power system rush-repair scheduling, and solves the problems that the conventional scheduling model is relatively dead and inflexible due to the fact that the influence of a traffic network on running time and important users of different grades is not fully considered in the whole emergency power supply vehicle scheduling process in the prior art. The method mainly comprises two parts, wherein the first part calculates the fault probability of a power distribution network line, makes prediction before disaster for the subsequent emergency power supply scheduling scheme, and the second part establishes a multi-objective planning model by taking the minimum total loss of power failure as a main function and the spare capacity as a secondary function, and considers the running time of an emergency power supply vehicle under actual traffic and the condition that new energy is arranged on part of nodes to generate power. The invention combines the prediction of line faults under typhoons with the scheduling of the emergency power supply vehicles after disaster, is favorable for making an emergency power supply scheduling scheme in advance, and effectively reduces the loss caused by power failure.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power supply restoration decision method for power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power supply restoration decision method of a power distribution network, which comprises the steps of firstly, obtaining data required by a power supply restoration simulation environment of the power distribution network, and establishing a power distribution network power supply restoration simulation environment based on the acquired data. Secondly, a Markov decision process for power restoration of the power distribution network is defined based on the constructed simulation environment, wherein the Markov decision process comprises a state space, an action space and a reward function. Based on the decision process, a power supply recovery reinforcement learning intelligent agent based on DDQN algorithm is constructed, and is interacted with a simulation environment to obtain a training sample and train. After the training of the intelligent agent is finished, the importance of each input feature to the decision result of the intelligent agent is calculated by using a Shapley value analysis method, visual feature importance ordering is provided for a dispatcher, an interpretable power supply recovery strategy is provided for the dispatcher, and the interpretability and the credibility of the decision are improved.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: Forest and grass fire hazard locus restoration prediction method based on historical bit slice information
abstract_en: A forest fire site restoration prediction method based on historical bit information is characterized by comprising the steps of 1, constructing a forest fire site restoration prediction system, 2, obtaining satellite remote sensing images of a target forest region by an image obtaining module, 3, performing image correction operation on the satellite remote sensing images by an image correction module to obtain standard images, 4, calculating EVI, T and MVHI of the standard images by a multi-mode remote sensing data fusion calculation module, performing normalization processing and data enhancement on the EVI, T and MVHI by a preprocessing module, 6, predicting a first restoration time by a machine learning model in a dynamic time analysis module through a machine learning algorithm, predicting a second restoration time by an ARIMA time sequence model in the dynamic time analysis module according to MVHI, and 7, performing weighted average fusion on the first restoration time and the second restoration time by the dynamic time analysis module to output a final restoration time. The method has the effect of accurately evaluating and predicting the recovery time of the forest grass vegetation after the fire disaster.
assignees: CHONGQING INTERCONTROL ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Network management device, method, and program
abstract_en: A network management device according to one embodiment includes: a generation unit that generates an optimization problem for determining a suitable installation form of a disaster countermeasure facility on the basis of information on the installation location of a communication facility requiring restoration when affected by a disaster and information on a location where a disaster countermeasure facility that is a communication facility for replacing the function of the communication facility requiring restoration can be installed; and an analysis unit that analyzes a suitable installation location of the disaster countermeasure facility by determining a solution of the generated optimization problem.
assignees: NTT INC

title_en: Rapid disposal method for collapse roof of shallow buried section of tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid treatment method for collapse roof collapse of a shallow tunnel buried section, and belongs to the technical field of tunnel disaster treatment. The method comprises the steps of removing residual saturated weak soil in a collapse cavity, constructing a sealing structure to seal a cavity formed by collapse roof-falling on a tunnel vault, constructing a protection structure to protect a side slope of the side wall of the collapse cavity between the sealing structure and the ground surface, constructing a backfill structure to backfill the collapse cavity, and constructing a ground surface greening restoration structure on the backfill structure to further backfill the collapse cavity to the original ground surface. In addition, no extra backfill exists, and the extra backfill is not needed to be chiseled in the follow-up, so that the treatment workload of the collapse roof is obviously shortened, and the treatment time of the collapse roof is shortened.
assignees: GUIZHOU TRANSPORTATION PLANNING SURVEY & DESIGN ACADEME CO LTD

title_en: Construction method of karst landform oversized-section tunnel chamber inner pilot tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method of a pilot tunnel in a karst landform ultra-large section tunnel chamber, which comprises the following steps of 1), geological investigation before construction, 2), advanced geological forecast, 3), pilot tunnel excavation, 4), primary support, 5), karst cave and solution cavity treatment, 6), water-proof and drainage measures, 7), monitoring and measurement, 8) and ecological restoration. The invention has the following technical advantages that 1, collapse, water burst, mud burst and other disasters in the construction process are effectively avoided through detailed geological investigation, advanced geological forecast and reasonable construction schemes, and the safety of constructors and equipment is guaranteed, 2, a proper excavation method and supporting measures are adopted, the construction process is optimized, the construction period is shortened, the construction efficiency is improved, 3, the loss caused by geological disasters and improper construction is reduced, the engineering investment is saved, 4, the ecological restoration is paid attention to, the damage of the construction to the surrounding environment is reduced, and the coordinated development of engineering construction and environmental protection is realized.
assignees: SHANGHAI BAOYE GROUP CORP LTD;BAOYE ZHENGZHOU CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Geological exploration mountain side slope ecological restoration device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of mountain slope restoration, and discloses a geological exploration mountain slope ecological protection device which comprises at least one group of first water blocking areas (5) arranged on two sides of a slow-flow water area (1), wherein a first communication plate (6) is arranged between the first water blocking areas (5) and the slow-flow water area (1), a plurality of first through holes (7) are formed in the first communication plate (6) so as to communicate the slow-flow water area (1) and the first water blocking areas (5), a first water blocking plate (8) is arranged in the first water blocking areas (5), a first buoyancy member (9) is arranged at the bottom of the first water blocking plate (8), and by constructing the slow-flow water area at the top of a slope and the water storage area at the lower part of the slope and matching with the water blocking plate lifting along with water flow, the ecological protection of the mountain slope is effectively realized, and damage caused by disaster phenomena such as landslide, mud flow and the like is reduced.
assignees: NINGBO METALLURGICAL SURVEY & DESIGN RESEARCH CO LTD

title_en: Construction method and device for river dike of hydraulic engineering
abstract_en: The invention provides a construction method and a construction device for a river dike of a hydraulic engineering, which relate to the technical field of edge calculation and comprise the steps of dividing the river dike into M risk dike sections through service risk distribution prediction; the method comprises the steps of carrying out non-uniform deployment of sensors, constructing M edge multi-mode sensing networks, carrying out hierarchical topological risk prediction on the returned M edge multi-mode heterogeneous data through a parallel computing container at a dike risk prediction cloud, outputting a plurality of dike risk feature vectors, dividing a plurality of risk source structures from a dike structure design, carrying out restoration strategy matching to obtain a plurality of construction restoration strategies, and dynamically executing the construction restoration strategies on the dike of the serving river channel according to the risk restoration priority. The invention solves the technical problems that the river dike management in the prior art is usually designed for a single project, the prior technical scheme cannot be directly migrated in different dike areas, and the construction cost is high and the period is long due to the lack of flexible reusability.
assignees: SHAANXI FUBA WEIYE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid post-disaster rush-repair method, device and medium based on small sample graph learning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of post-disaster repair of power grid, and in particular relates to a post-disaster repair method, device and medium for power grid based on small sample graph learning, which comprises the steps of constructing a graph model of power grid topology by utilizing power grid topology data and node attribute data; generating node embedding characteristics, calculating node importance scores based on the power generation capacity, load demand and connectivity of the nodes, initializing repair priorities based on the node importance scores after disasters occur, constructing an intelligent agent dynamic adjustment mechanism to optimize repair orders, building a node repair time model, setting element parameters in new disaster scenes, optimizing the element parameters through multi-task element learning, minimizing comprehensive loss, and generating an optimized repair strategy and repair time based on the node repair time model and the optimized repair orders. The method can quickly generate the efficient restoration strategy under the condition of a small sample, has strong capability of adapting to new disaster scenes, and remarkably improves the restoration efficiency, the load restoration rate and the success rate of load flow calculation of the power grid.
assignees: UNIV HANGZHOU DIANZI;STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Municipal pipe network overflow detection and intelligent repair method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a municipal pipe network overflow detection and intelligent restoration method, which relates to the technical field of municipal pipe network management, and comprises the following specific steps of data fusion and basic analysis, wherein various sensors are used for collecting various data in real time, fusion and pretreatment are carried out in a data processing center, external environment change factors influencing pipe network operation are found out by comparing analysis histories with real-time data to provide basic data, and the invention can realize high-precision simulation of water flow in a pipe network by deeply fusing weather, hydrology and municipal pipe network related data and by means of an intelligent hydrodynamic simulation technology, accurately predict the occurrence position, time and influence range of overflow in advance, automatically formulate and adjust pipe network operation parameter regulation strategies in real time based on accurate overflow risk assessment, and intelligently adjust drainage pump station parameters and pipe network valve opening according to different overflow risk grades, thereby effectively optimizing pipe network operation parameters.
assignees: NANJING INST OF ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENCES MEE

title_en: Retaining wall structure with stepped partition ecological restoration function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a retaining wall structure with a stepped partition ecological restoration function, which relates to the technical field of ecological disaster prevention, and comprises a retaining wall body, a green planting box and a nutrition planting base, the inside of barricade body is filled with the nutrition planting foundation, the green planting box of planting is installed to the last Fang Bushe of nutrition planting foundation, the lower bottom surface of planting the box is the design of macroporous latticed, can form laminating close contact and intercommunication with the nutrition planting foundation. The retaining wall structure with the stepped partition ecological restoration function utilizes the retaining wall body, the nutrition planting base filled in the retaining wall body and the inserted fixed rod at the lower bottom surface, can form a gravity retaining wall structure with the functions of self weight, anti-overturning and anti-sliding under the cooperation of the inserted rod at the lower bottom, stably supports the deformation instability of artificial filling soil, hillside rock-soil body and the like, and can realize greening and planting by utilizing the nutrition planting base and the green planting box arranged above, thereby realizing the composite requirements of disaster prevention and ecological greening.
assignees: INST OF GEOLOGY AND NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION GANSU ACADEMY OF SCIENCE

title_en: Method for repairing soil after fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a post-fire soil remediation method which comprises the following steps of first fire soil diagnosis and pretreatment, second gradient pyrolysis biochar preparation and application, third composite microbial inoculant inoculation and fourth nutrient regulation and plant combined remediation. The invention realizes the cooperative regulation and control of the pH value of soil, heavy metals and organic pollutants after fire disaster by the combined application of the gradient pyrolysis biochar, and simultaneously adopts the carrier embedding technology to obviously improve the survival rate and the colonization capacity of functional microorganisms in a high-temperature environment. The method can effectively shorten the restoration period, remarkably restore the ecological function of the soil, greatly reduce the restoration cost through the use of localized materials, and integrally solve the problems of poor adaptability, low efficiency, high cost and the like in the traditional restoration technology.
assignees: UNIV KAILI

title_en: Ecological flow guaranteeing method based on runoff prediction and replenishment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological flow guaranteeing method based on runoff prediction and replenishment. Collecting data such as weather and hydrology of the Tonkin river basin, constructing and verifying SWAT model simulation runoff, and analyzing extended precipitation based on an R/S method and a wavelet method. And constructing a surface water and underground water coupling model, and predicting the quantity, level and quality of underground water. After the water resource supply and demand balance analysis is carried out, ecological flow guarantee measures are formulated, including optimizing configuration of water resources, strengthening management, ecological water supplementing, water environment treatment, ecological restoration engineering development and the like. The main body and the progress of implementation of measures are clear, the evaluation effect of a monitoring system is established, and the ecological flow is guaranteed by adjusting and optimizing according to the result, so that the sustainable utilization of the water resources of the river basin and the ecological environment protection are realized, the remarkable social, economic and environmental benefits are achieved, and a scientific and effective method is provided for water resource management.
assignees: HUADIAN NINGDE ELECTRIC POWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Pre-disaster, post-disaster and total scheduling method for community multi-element shared energy storage system under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a pre-disaster, post-disaster and total scheduling method of a community multi-element shared energy storage system under typhoon disasters, which realizes resource optimization configuration by optimizing layout of entity energy storage stations, mobile energy storage equipment and electric automobile clusters, and minimizing deployment cost while guaranteeing operation toughness of the system; and in the post-disaster stage, the recovery time, the energy loss and the scheduling cost are taken as optimization targets, and the emergency power supply requirement is responded quickly by combining the constraints of load recovery priority and the like. And feeding back toughness indexes calculated by the post-disaster power supply recovery track to a pre-disaster optimization objective function to form a closed loop iteration optimization mechanism, and adopting a particle swarm optimization algorithm and mixed integer linear programming to jointly solve, thereby considering solving precision and efficiency.
assignees: UNIV GUANGDONG TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Fault reasoning analysis method and system based on large language model
abstract_en: The invention provides a fault reasoning analysis method and system based on a large language model, which comprises the steps of firstly obtaining a multi-source operation and maintenance data set of a system to be diagnosed, comprising a structural performance index, a semi-structural service log and unstructured text description data, then carrying out semantic enhancement on the multi-source operation and maintenance data set to obtain semantic data units containing entity, relation and attribute semantic labels, constructing a semantic association network based on the semantic data units, calling a pre-training large language model to carry out root cause reasoning analysis on the network, generating a candidate root cause set ordered according to confidence, generating an operation and maintenance decision instruction containing entity operation sequences and priority orders according to the candidate root cause set, and sending the operation and maintenance decision instruction to a system management terminal to trigger an automatic restoration process, thereby improving the operation and maintenance efficiency and reliability of the system.
assignees: CHENGDU PVIRTECH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Shallow lake submerged plant community configuration method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological restoration, and discloses a shallow lake submerged plant community configuration method and device, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a submerged plant hierarchical screening model; the submerged plant classifying and screening model comprises a habitat condition classifying model, a substrate condition classifying model and a water quality classifying model, wherein the submerged plant classifying and screening model is used for screening a plurality of submerged plants to determine the types of the submerged plants after screening, the submerged plant character parameters of the plurality of types are obtained, comprehensive tolerance indexes of the submerged plants of the various types are calculated respectively based on the submerged plant character parameters of the plurality of types, the species priority is determined based on the comprehensive tolerance indexes of the submerged plants of the various types, and shallow lake submerged plant communities are configured based on the types, the species priority and engineering parameters of the submerged plants after screening. The invention comprehensively considers the elasticity of the ecological system and the diversity of the species, ensures the functional complementation configuration of the species, and ensures the long-term stability of the configuration of the submerged plant community in the water ecological restoration.

title_en: Ecological restoration area carbon sink increment real-time prediction method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence-based ecological restoration area carbon sink increment real-time prediction method and system, which comprise the following steps of acquiring multi-source data, acquiring a lunar vegetation coverage image through a satellite remote sensing platform, acquiring sensor data such as soil temperature and humidity, air CO  2  concentration and the like by using a laid ground sensor network, acquiring vegetation canopy point cloud data according to a preset period by using an unmanned plane laser radar, collecting biomass actual measurement data of a restoration area in a history preset period, preprocessing the data, performing radiation calibration, atmosphere correction and cutting and splicing on the lunar vegetation coverage image acquired by the satellite remote sensing platform, extracting vegetation coverage and vegetation index time sequence, denoising, ground point separation and single wood canopy segmentation on the vegetation canopy point cloud data acquired by the unmanned plane laser radar, and calculating individual plant vegetation height and canopy width. The method can more accurately realize carbon sink increment prediction.
assignees: INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS

title_en: Automatic operation and maintenance method based on intelligent agent technology and cooperative network
abstract_en: The application discloses an automatic operation and maintenance method and a collaborative network based on an agent technology, wherein an operation and maintenance agent responds to an alarm event and initializes an operation and maintenance task, a data agent is triggered to collect multi-source heterogeneous operation and maintenance data and conduct preprocessing, the operation and maintenance agent initiates a deep root cause analysis request according to the preprocessing data, a code agent is driven to generate an analysis code and execute the analysis code, the operation and maintenance agent positions the root cause and generates a restoration scheme based on an execution result of the code agent, the restoration effect is verified after the execution, an agent collaborative path and an evidence chain in the operation and maintenance process are presented in real time through a preset visual protocol by a visual agent, and a structural report is generated by reporting the agent. The multi-agent cooperative architecture drives dynamic code generation and safe execution, so that end-to-end automatic root cause positioning and repairing closed loop is realized, meanwhile, an evidence chain and a cooperation process are presented in real time by means of protocol visualization, and the intelligent level of operation and maintenance and the transparency of fault diagnosis are improved.
assignees: Tianfu Jiangxi Laboratory

title_en: Mine is administered with multistage side slope ecological remediation structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of ecological restoration of abandoned mines, in particular to a multistage slope ecological restoration structure for mine treatment. Including domatic and adjacent domatic between the horse way platform, the horse way platform is close to the domatic one end in the top adjacent with it and is provided with the drainage slot, set up thick liquid masonry Dan Long between drainage slot and the horse way platform, the horse way platform is close to the domatic one end in the below adjacent with it and is provided with the rectangle gabion, the height of rectangle gabion is greater than thick liquid masonry Dan Danlong, the domatic surface cover has dense mesh. The utility model can discharge precipitation and redundant maintenance water along the drainage groove, reduce flushing, ensure that the re-green plants at the catwalk platform are not flushed when the water quantity is large, ensure that sundries of the catwalk platform are not easy to enter the drainage groove to cause blockage, limit the sundries of the catwalk platform to flush to a lower slope surface, be favorable for stabilizing the slope and prevent landslide phenomenon.
assignees: NO 3 ENG CO LTD CCCC FIRST HARBOR ENG CO LTD;CCCC FIRST HARBOR ENG CO LTD

title_en: River and lake environment comprehensive treatment system based on ecological restoration
abstract_en: The application discloses a comprehensive river and lake environment treatment system based on ecological restoration, which relates to the technical field of monitoring and analysis and comprises an information acquisition module, an analysis processing module, a treatment and regulation module and a prediction module, wherein the information acquisition module is used for acquiring basic data and water quality index data corresponding to a target river and lake, the analysis processing module is used for analyzing and processing the basic data and the water quality index data corresponding to the target river and lake, carrying out safety analysis on the environment corresponding to the target river and lake based on the analysis processing result and formulating a treatment strategy based on the safety analysis result, the treatment and regulation module is used for responding to the treatment strategy and carrying out early warning and regulation on the target river and lake based on the treatment strategy, and the prediction module is used for predicting the water quality risk value of the target river and lake in a future period. The application has the effect of improving the comprehensive treatment efficiency of the river and lake environment.
assignees: UNIV INNER MONGOLIA SCI & TECH

title_en: Long-term weathered sandstone layer deep foundation pit slope restoration and reinforcement system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a long-term weathering sandstone layer deep foundation pit slope repairing and reinforcing system, which belongs to the technical field of building construction and comprises a water intercepting ditch arranged at the top of a deep foundation pit slope and a drainage ditch arranged at the bottom of the slope, wherein a net sheet structure and a plurality of rows of fully-bonded anchor rods are fixed on the slope of the deep foundation pit slope, the net sheet structure covers the water intercepting ditch and the drainage ditch, and a concrete surface layer is integrally sprayed on the net sheet structure. The system ensures that the support of the side slope of the deep foundation pit is firmer and more reliable, avoids the landslide of soil, improves the structural safety of the deep foundation pit, ensures the construction quality, provides a safer and more convenient environment for the construction operation surface of the deep foundation pit, and ensures the long-term stability and safety of projects. Meanwhile, the system of the utility model is provided with the intercepting ditches at the slope top of the side slope and the drainage ditches and the collecting wells at the slope bottom of the side slope, so that the side slope can form a stable system in rainy season or drainage season, the durability of the side slope is increased, and the service life of the side slope is prolonged.
assignees: SHANXI WUJIAN GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Electric energy metering data restoration method based on graph neural network and time sequence attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric energy metering data restoration method based on a graph neural network and a time sequence attention mechanism, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent power grids. According to the invention, the power consumer network is modeled as a graph structure, the graph neural network model is utilized to capture the spatial dependency relationship among users, the time sequence attention module is utilized to capture the time sequence dynamic characteristics of the electric energy metering data, and finally the spatial characteristics and the time characteristics are fused, so that the high-precision electric energy metering data restoration is realized. The method specifically comprises the following steps of data preprocessing and graph construction, spatial feature extraction, temporal feature extraction, feature fusion and dynamic training.
assignees: HANGZHOU ELECTRIC EQUIPMENT MFG CO LTD;FUYANG RONGDA COMPLETE ELECTRICAL MFG BRANCH HANGZHOU ELECTRIC POWER EQUIPMENT MFG CO LTD

title_en: Method for identifying water-level-fluctuating zone treatment area based on water body inundation frequency and terrain limitation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying a hydro-fluctuation belt treatment area based on water flooding frequency and topography limitation, which comprises the steps of obtaining a remote sensing image and preprocessing, calculating a normalized water index based on green light and near infrared wave bands in the remote sensing image after preprocessing, setting a threshold value for the water index, extracting water distribution of each period to obtain a binary image of water and non-water of an annual image, calculating the maximum continuous flooding time frequency of the water, dividing an area into frequent flooding areas, alternate flooding areas and low-frequency flooding areas based on the continuous flooding time frequency of the water, obtaining gradient distribution grid images according to a DEM (digital elevation model) calculation gradient, carrying out superposition analysis in an ArcGIS (geographic information system) according to gradient grids, obtaining the alternate flooding areas and the low-frequency flooding areas, and solving the technical problems that the traditional method lacks a treatment area identification flow based on time dynamic flooding information, the selection deviation of the repair areas, the ecological restoration efficiency and the like.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING FORESTRY

title_en: Geographic information system of pipe network GIS
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of a pipe network GIS geographic information system, in particular to a pipe network GIS geographic information system, which solves the problem of engineering potential safety hazards caused by the traditional fixed threshold value by dynamically correcting the maximum allowable length of a pipe section, automatically screening a compliant pipe section and marking abnormal types, constructs a water supply communication network based on a graph traversal algorithm and intelligently identifies isolation sections, generates restoration suggestions containing newly added node coordinates and quantity, ensures full-coverage water supply of mountain areas or scattered villages, adopts a multi-objective optimization mechanism, quantifies the influence of pressure gradients and pipe diameter parameters on path priorities, dynamically adjusts weight coefficients to balance water pressure guarantee and pipe cost, and generates a candidate path pool covering all water points through a topology model. The method solves the problems that the efficiency of the traditional pipe network geographic information system in the planning of the water supply branch is low, and the cost, the water pressure and the coverage of the isolation section are difficult to be considered.
assignees: UNIV HEZHOU

title_en: Lightning arrester insulation protection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an insulation protection method for a lightning arrester, and relates to the technical field of electric power insulation protection. The method comprises the steps of generating comprehensive insulation risk indexes based on collected insulation state parameters, determining repair penetration strength according to material structural characteristics, constructing electric field compensation factors by combining operation electric field distribution, carrying out periodic data accumulation and analysis on the comprehensive insulation risk indexes, the repair penetration strength and the electric field compensation factors to generate long-term life prediction results covering an operation period, a material subarea and a sampling point, and corresponding the life prediction results to an insulation protection management module to realize subarea level life management and operation risk early warning. The accurate life prediction is realized through multi-dimensional data fusion, the differential protection of the subareas is supported, and the consistency of the operation period and the restoration strategy is maintained, so that the reliability and the stability of the long-term operation of the lightning arrester are comprehensively improved.
assignees: YUGUANG ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Charging station operation data inconsistency detection and restoration method, system, equipment and medium based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a charging station operation data inconsistency detection and restoration method, system, equipment and medium based on multi-source data fusion, relating to the field of intelligent maintenance of charging station operation data, comprising the steps of collecting heterogeneous data sources in the operation and maintenance of a power station; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing collected data to generate a consistent fusion data set, constructing an inconsistency detection model on the basis of the fusion data, extracting data hidden structural features based on a feature learning method of a self-encoder, identifying potential abnormal points by utilizing reconstruction errors, carrying out consistency dynamic detection and classification labeling on multi-source data, inputting the identified inconsistent data to a repair module, executing a repair mechanism, and carrying out complementation, correction and reconstruction on the abnormal data. The multi-source heterogeneous data collaborative analysis framework integrating the running state of the charging pile, the power grid interaction data and the environment perception data is constructed, the limitation of the traditional single data source verification is broken through, and the cross-system data relevance and the anomaly detection coverage rate are remarkably improved.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Transmission and distribution network distributed collaborative power restoration method based on feasible region projection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transmission and distribution network distributed collaborative power restoration method based on feasible region projection. Firstly, establishing an optimization model of a power transmission network, a fault power distribution network subarea and a normal power distribution network subarea, establishing a collaborative optimization model of the power transmission network, the normal power distribution network subarea and the fault power distribution network subarea, then, establishing a power transmission network feasible region projection model comprising a power transmission network objective function and a partition analysis mapping function of an optimization variable, decomposing the power transmission network, the normal power distribution network subarea and the fault power distribution network subarea collaborative optimization model into a main problem and a sub problem based on the power transmission network feasible region projection model, and finally, carrying out distributed iterative solution on the main problem and the sub problem until the difference value between the upper boundary and the lower boundary of a global optimization objective meets a threshold value. By projecting the feasible region into the parameter space of the active power of the boundary node of the transmission and distribution network, establishing a partition analytic mapping function only containing the active power of the boundary node, the equivalent conversion of the high-dimensional power grid optimization problem into the low-dimensional parameter space is realized, and the calculation complexity is effectively reduced.
assignees: UNIV HEBEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Ecological restoration soil and water conservation device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of soil and water conservation and discloses an ecological restoration soil and water conservation device which comprises a slope body, wherein a collecting mechanism is arranged at the top of the slope body, a filtering mechanism is arranged outside one end of the collecting mechanism, a drip irrigation mechanism is arranged at one end of the collecting mechanism, a flow guiding mechanism is arranged on one side of the slope body, the flow guiding mechanism comprises a cement block, one side of the cement block is fixedly connected with an inclined surface of the slope body, a plurality of guide grooves are formed in the surface of the cement block, a plurality of flow dividing plates are fixedly connected with the inclined surface of the slope body, and two ends of each flow dividing plate are fixedly connected with the inner wall of each guide groove. According to the utility model, the cement blocks are paved outside the slope body, and the two sides of the flow dividing plate are lower in rainy days, so that rainwater flows into the guide grooves at the two sides, and the rainwater is discharged, so that the cementability of the slope body is improved, the risks of landslide and erosion are reduced, and the erosion of the slope body by the rainwater is reduced.
assignees: CHINA NONFERROUS METALS INDUSTRY XIAN SURVEY DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Event-based water damage seawall facing block repairing weight calculation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for calculating the restoration weight of a water damaged seawall protecting block based on an event, which comprises the steps of determining a typical typhoon according to tropical cyclone optimal path data, seawall completion time, protecting block arrangement and a pre-seawall tide level process, collecting multi-element collaborative observation data during the typical typhoon, constructing an astronomical tide-storm tide mathematical model and a typhoon wave mathematical model according to the typical typhoon, correcting the two mathematical models by utilizing the multi-element collaborative observation data, calculating the pre-seawall tide level and the washout corrected typhoon wave after correction, designing a protecting block stable weight parameterization scheme, obtaining stable calculated weight based on the pre-seawall tide level and the typhoon wave, combining the actual weight of the protecting block to determine an optimal scheme, calculating a design wind speed according to weather station wind speed data, calculating the design tide level and washout corrected design wave based on the tide level data and the washout tide relation, and obtaining the protecting block restoration weight by adopting the optimal scheme. The method has higher guiding function on coast protection engineering design.
assignees: ZHEJIANG INST OF HYDRAULICS & ESTUARY ZHEJIANG MARINE PLANNING AND DESIGN INST

title_en: Power transmission engineering area ecological restoration monitoring management system based on multisource perception and artificial intelligence decision
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power transmission engineering area ecological restoration monitoring management system based on multi-source perception and artificial intelligence decision. Aims at solving the technical problems of difficult ecological restoration and monitoring, rough management and wide application of vegetation in power transmission engineering in loess hilly areas in northwest of jin. The technical scheme is that the intelligent sensing layer comprises a five-layer cooperative structure, an intelligent sensing layer comprises a self-organizing wireless sensor network formed by an ecological restoration special sensor group, a data processing layer performs space-time normalization processing on multi-source heterogeneous data, extracts vegetation restoration activity indexes, soil moisture content evolution coefficients and water and soil conservation efficiency characteristics, an AI decision layer comprises a state evaluation and prediction module and an optimization decision module, an application layer is related to automatic scheduling resources of a material inventory system, and a feedback layer dynamically adjusts AI decision module thresholds and parameters. The invention constructs a set of intelligent ecological restoration monitoring and management system aiming at the power transmission engineering areas of the loess hills in northwest of jin and provides effective technical support for solving the difficult problem of ecological restoration monitoring and extensive management of the areas.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Comprehensive ecological restoration method and system for power transmission line plots in northwest loess hilly areas of jin
abstract_en: The invention relates to a comprehensive ecological restoration method and system for power transmission line plots in a loess hilly region in northwest of jin. Aims at solving the technical problems of fragmentation, rough management and acceptance dislocation of the power transmission line trace ecological restoration technology in the loess hilly areas of northwest of jin. The technical scheme is that the ecological management system is realized by adopting a five-module three-cycle architecture, and comprises an ecological diagnosis module, a scheme generation module, an intelligent implementation module, a dynamic regulation and control module and an acceptance evaluation module.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Multi-mode data fusion farmland soil accurate variable fertilization method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a farmland soil accurate variable fertilization method and device integrating multi-mode data, which comprises the steps of integrating multi-source data such as soil, topography and the like collected by taking a slope mini-fracture as a center, constructing a spatial heterogeneity map, utilizing a convolutional neural network to extract vegetation root competition characteristics, determining a multi-species nutrient absorption demand mode, integrating the information into a three-dimensional voxel model, combining a hydrologic model, simulating a migration path of water and fertilizer along the fracture, foreseeing a downhill nutrient enrichment risk, and finally generating a three-dimensional voxel model adjustment scheme for carrying out accurate adjustment on the slope, the soil moisture content and a predicted loss path so as to guide accurate variable fertilization and fertility restoration. The invention also provides a device for executing the method. The invention can remarkably improve the precision, foresight and timeliness of precision fertilization and fertility management under complex terrains.

title_en: Multi-mode power data restoration method for local-global association learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-mode power data restoration method for local-global association learning, which comprises the steps of obtaining initial data and preprocessing, obtaining abnormal values of power data, wherein the initial data comprises power operation data, external association data and multi-mode data, carrying out local association learning based on the preprocessed power operation data and the abnormal values of the power data, mining local data association, obtaining a local restoration scheme of the abnormal values of the power data, carrying out global association learning based on the preprocessed initial data and the abnormal values of the power data, mining global association rules of time and source, obtaining a reasonable correction range of the abnormal values of the power data, and generating a power operation data restoration result by combining the local restoration scheme and the reasonable correction range. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device can accurately identify the abnormality of the repair data and greatly improve the accuracy of data repair.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Combined screening and field planting method for lakeside aquatic plants based on complementary ecological niches
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological environment restoration, solves the technical problems of lack of systematicness, insufficient optimizing means and unstable communities of aquatic plant configuration in the prior art, and particularly relates to a lakeside zone aquatic plant combination screening and field planting method based on complementary niches. And carrying out double-objective optimization on the aquatic plant combination through a non-dominant sequencing genetic algorithm to obtain the optimal aquatic plant combination. The selected aquatic plants are configured in a zoning mode according to the proper water depth, and are subjected to feedback regulation and control by combining the ecological monitoring result, so that dynamic optimization of the community structure is realized. The method can utilize the quantitative index and the intelligent algorithm to carry out combination optimization on the basis of fully considering the difference of plant ecological niches and the complementation of functions, so as to construct a lakeside zone plant community with higher stability and functionality, and has obvious ecological restoration and application popularization values.

title_en: Mining area subsidence monitoring method based on unmanned aerial vehicle photogrammetry and LiDAR technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mining area subsidence monitoring method based on unmanned aerial vehicle photogrammetry and LiDAR technology, which comprises the steps of carrying out flight shooting on a mining area by using an unmanned aerial vehicle to obtain mining area earth surface image data, processing the obtained image data through a motion restoration structure algorithm SfM to generate a digital surface model DSM, an orthophoto map DOM and a digital elevation model DEM, scanning the mining area by using an airborne LiDAR system to obtain three-dimensional point cloud data of the surface of the mining area, correcting and improving the precision of the LiDAR point cloud data by using a differential GNSS technology, carrying out registration fusion on the digital elevation model DEM generated by unmanned aerial vehicle photogrammetry and the corrected LiDAR point cloud data under a unified coordinate system, and carrying out processing and analysis on the fused data to construct a mining area subsidence model so as to realize dynamic monitoring on the subsidence condition of the surface of the mining area. The method effectively solves the problems of the traditional mining area subsidence monitoring method and provides powerful technical support for mine geological disaster prevention and control, ecological environment protection and mining area sustainable development.

title_en: Enterprise operation efficiency optimization method, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to an enterprise operation efficiency optimization method, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps of collecting and preprocessing operation data of each department of an enterprise, and extracting the characteristics of department organization, innovation, capital flow, talents and the like by constructing an operation characteristic analysis model; the method comprises the steps of collecting information exchange intensity, fund flow and personnel flow among departments, forming comprehensive connection influence characteristics through weighted summation, constructing a self-adaptive multi-scale attention mechanism graph neural network based on the data, taking the departments as nodes and comprehensive connection as edges, realizing characteristic optimization and generating enterprise comprehensive operation efficiency indexes, detecting abnormal departments based on historical operation characteristics by using an abnormal department identification model when the indexes are lower than a preset threshold, and generating a restoration strategy.
assignees: MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Mine slope geological disaster monitoring and ecological restoration collaborative early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine slope geological disaster monitoring and ecological restoration cooperative early warning system, and relates to the technical field of mine slope monitoring. The mine side slope ecological monitoring system comprises a central processing unit, wherein the central processing unit is connected with a plurality of side slope displacement monitoring units and a plurality of side slope ecological monitoring units through a wireless communication module, the side slope displacement monitoring units are inserted into the surface of a mine side slope side by side along the transverse direction of the mine side slope, the side slope ecological monitoring units are installed at the bottom edge of the mine side slope side by side along the transverse direction of the mine side slope, and any one side slope ecological monitoring unit is arranged between any two adjacent side slope displacement monitoring units. The invention can effectively improve the collaborative early warning effect of mine slope geological disaster monitoring and ecological restoration.
assignees: ANHUI JINLIAN GEOLOGY & MINERAL RESOURCES TECH CO LTD

title_en: NDVI prediction method and system based on ecological response space diversity of water diversion engineering
abstract_en: The invention discloses an NDVI prediction method based on ecological response space diversity of water diversion engineering. The method comprises the steps of firstly, definitely analyzing objects of a water diversion project, secondly, collecting hydrologic element data under a dam after the project is operated and normalized vegetation index NDVI data month by month, thirdly, constructing buffer areas with different radiuses by taking a reservoir dam address as a center, calculating correlation coefficients of hydrologic element data and NDVI indexes of each buffer area, fourthly, constructing a function model F (r) of the variation of the correlation coefficients under different buffer area radiuses, fifthly, calculating a water diversion ecological response range of the reservoir, sixthly, introducing derivative functions of F (r) as geographic weights, and predicting the variation of the NDVI based on an improved space-time geographic weighted regression method. The invention comprehensively considers the change of the hydrological runoff condition and vegetation growth condition after water intake in the water diversion project, can more accurately evaluate the influence range and degree of reservoir water diversion on peripheral vegetation, and provides scientific basis for water diversion ecological response analysis and ecological restoration.

title_en: Method and system for cooperatively controlling recovery after three-network disaster and multi-source resource coordination
