abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for coordinating recovery and multi-source resources after a coordinated control three-network disaster, which belong to the technical field of recovery and toughness improvement of a multi-infrastructure system after the disaster, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a node importance evaluation function through multi-index fusion, and calculating a recovery priority score of an ash starting power supply; the method comprises the steps of estimating node state probability to obtain node state probability, setting boundary conditions of partition power grid restoration feasibility, optimizing restoration sequence through a gray start power supply-load-grid path matching model to generate a restoration path set, adopting a reinforcement learning algorithm, taking node state, resource availability and path communication matrix as state space to output an optimal restoration sequence and a resource scheduling scheme, and generating three-network restoration path recommendation, partition power grid restoration strategy and a multi-element flexible resource scheduling sequence. The invention realizes the efficient scheduling and cross-network cooperative control of the multi-source flexible resources, and effectively improves the recovery efficiency and toughness of the three networks in the scene after disaster.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: Elevator restoration support system, elevator restoration support device, and elevator restoration support method
abstract_en: To provide an elevator restoration support system capable of calculating the priority of elevator restoration work in the event of a wide-area disaster such as an earthquake without pre-registering information on persons requiring assistance in evacuation, and capable of executing the restoration work for elevators in multiple buildings in an optimal order.SOLUTION: The present invention is an elevator restoration support system that provides restoration work support for an elevator system comprising a first imaging device installed in a car and multiple second imaging devices installed at landing places on multiple floors. The elevator restoration support system comprises an attribute detection unit that detects attribute information related to characteristics of each passenger in the car based on first image data or second image data, and a restoration priority setting unit that sets an elevator restoration priority based on the attribute information of each passenger in the car detected by the attribute detection unit when a situation requiring elevator restoration work occurs.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2
assignees: HITACHI BUILDING SYST CO LTD

title_en: Landslide monitoring device for ecological restoration of mine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a landslide monitoring device for mine ecological restoration, which relates to the technical field of mine ecological restoration and comprises a mounting hole and a storage box, wherein the mounting hole is formed in a hillside, a waveguide tube is arranged in the mounting hole, the top of the waveguide tube extends to the upper part of the mounting hole and is fixedly connected with a rain gauge, one side of the waveguide tube is fixedly connected with a detection device, the top of the detection device is fixedly connected with a mounting frame, the inside of the mounting frame is fixedly connected with a photovoltaic panel, the landslide monitoring device for mine ecological restoration is provided with the storage box, a collection hopper and a fixing frame, water and air are sequentially input into a spray tube through a hose, and are sprayed on the surface of the photovoltaic panel through the spray tube, so that the surface of the mounting frame is cleaned and dried, and the cleanliness of the surface of the mounting frame can be guaranteed, and the device can be used for monitoring the mine landslide stably.
assignees: SHAANXI YAOYUAN LYUCHUANG ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Water environment ecological protection allocation evaluation method and system based on data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water environment ecological protection allocation evaluation method and system based on data analysis, which relates to the technical field of water environment ecological protection, the method firstly analyzes the data in the history protection allocation record, analyzes the stress coefficients of each social parameter to ecological restoration in different social activity types, analyzes the protection coefficients of each water ecological restoration measure set to ecological restoration in each social activity type, constructing a mutual feedback relationship thermodynamic diagram, then simulating and optimizing an optimal water ecological restoration measure set of each social activity type, realizing a closed loop system of social activity identification, strategy targeting design, ecological effect evaluation and dynamic optimization, realizing targeted and comprehensive strategy protection of the water environment, and guaranteeing the ecological protection effect.
assignees: SHUIFA PLANNING & DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Construction method of river pollution in-situ remediation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a river pollution in-situ remediation system construction method which comprises the steps of S1, constructing a hydrodynamic force and pollutant migration coupling model, simulating pollutant distribution, 2, constructing a biological collaborative purification quantification model, screening efficient aquatic plants and benthonic animals, constructing a purification kinetic equation, 3, combining biological collaborative purification quantification model output and biological parameters, optimizing plant planting positions, 4, configuring a dynamic three-dimensional ecological position, and constructing a biological remediation system. The invention obviously improves the pollution restoration efficiency through the synergistic effect, builds an ecological friendly in-situ restoration system, does not need interception or dredging, directly builds a biological community in the water body, reduces the damage to the river channel structure, and avoids secondary pollution caused by physical and chemical methods. By simulating a natural river ecosystem, a proper habitat is provided for organisms, so that the recovery of an ecological chain is accelerated, and the self-cleaning capability of a water body is maintained for a long time.
assignees: UNIV QINGDAO TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Geological disaster abnormal data cleaning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for cleaning geological disaster abnormal data, and belongs to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring data processing. According to the method, the data flow is divided locally by setting the sliding window, the relevance and time sequence characteristics among the data are comprehensively utilized, and the abnormal data are effectively identified. According to the method, firstly, data distribution is dynamically monitored, abnormal points are accurately detected based on abnormal probability calculation and combined abnormal judgment, and abnormal data are further subjected to classification analysis so as to identify potential types and reasons of abnormality generation. By improving the dynamic threshold selection strategy and the dependency relationship representation method, the detection accuracy and applicability of the algorithm are remarkably improved. Finally, the high-efficiency cleaning of the abnormal data is realized, and the quality and reliability of the geological disaster data are improved. The invention not only enhances the accuracy and the scientificity of the geological disaster early warning system, but also provides important technical support for subsequent data restoration and risk assessment, and has wide application prospect.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING POSTS & TELECOM

title_en: System and method
abstract_en: To provide a new technique which can be used for realizing early restoration of a life line such as electricity and water supply to a disaster area.SOLUTION: By a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles, objects 4 to be laid which are either electric wires, hoses, or cord-like objects are suspended at intervals. The plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles autonomously fly in tandem flight along a laying route. When the unmanned aerial vehicle 5a of 1-st flight in flight order arrives at a final destination point 22, the plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles release the suspended installation objects 4 to be laid all at once and arrange the objects 4 to be laid on the ground surface.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9
assignees: KYOSAN ELECTRIC MFG

title_en: Road network restoration strategy formulation method for post-earthquake city emergency rescue stage based on entropy weight method
abstract_en: The invention provides a road network restoration strategy formulation method in a post-earthquake city emergency rescue stage based on an entropy weight method. The method comprises the steps of 1, drawing a target city road network, 2, calculating indexes related to road network topology and post-earthquake traffic capacity for each road section in the road network, and 3, calculating the indexes by adopting an entropy weight method to obtain a road section comprehensive evaluation value of each road section, and further, carrying out identification and classification of key road sections by sequencing the road section comprehensive evaluation values. The method integrates and analyzes multidimensional information of the post-earthquake road network, establishes a strategy for repairing the post-earthquake road network in an emergency rescue stage, and can provide a more scientific and comprehensive analysis framework for identifying key road sections in the post-earthquake road network based on an entropy weight method.
assignees: INST ENG MECH CHINA EARTHQUAKE ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Reservoir group optimal scheduling method, system and medium based on hydrologic sequence real-time restoration
abstract_en: The application relates to a reservoir group optimal scheduling method, a system and a medium based on hydrologic sequence real-time reduction, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting measured data of reservoir groups in a research area, extracting runoff reduction amounts in the dimensions of day, month and ten days, collecting historical predicted flow data of reservoir groups in the research area, sequentially adopting at least two distribution methods to construct a reservoir group month runoff ten-day distribution scheme in the research area, inputting the reservoir group month runoff distribution scheme in the research area into a pre-constructed reservoir group optimal scheduling model, adopting a self-adaptive elite simulated annealing multi-target particle swarm algorithm solution model to obtain a non-inferior solution set, and adopting a fuzzy TOPSIS and gray correlation-based decision-making method to make decisions on the non-inferior solution set to obtain an optimal solution, namely the reservoir group optimal scheduling scheme in the research area. The application improves the utilization efficiency of water resources in various fields, reduces the water resource waste, reduces the flood risk, maintains the ecological integrity of the water area, and promotes the sustainable utilization of the water resources and the protection of ecological environment.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CORP;BUREAU OF HYDROLOGY CHANGJIANG WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION

title_en: Dynamic wetland ecological restoration monitoring method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic monitoring method for wetland ecological restoration based on deep learning, which relates to the technical field of ecological restoration and comprises the following steps of acquiring multisource wetland ecological sensor data and remote sensing image streams in real time, constructing a space-time fusion data cube, extracting ecological feature tensors, carrying out degradation mode analysis on the ecological feature tensors to generate an ecological state dynamic topological graph, calculating an ecological connectivity index, carrying out restoration demand identification based on the ecological connectivity index, positioning a degradation hot spot area through a multisystem image convolution network to generate a restoration priority area coordinate set, and constructing a full-flow technical system for intelligently optimizing a restoration scheme from ecological state dynamic perception through multisource data space-time fusion and deep learning and landscape ecology, thereby effectively solving the pain points such as data scale mismatch, degradation area positioning ambiguity, restoration path ecological suitability difference, multi-target cooperative difficulty and the like in traditional wetland restoration.

title_en: Multi-source data sorting and conveying method for power plant
abstract_en: The invention provides a power plant multisource data arrangement and transportation method, which comprises the steps of constructing a multiscale data alignment model, using a B spline curve fitting algorithm to perform time axis mapping, introducing data with large time deviation into a quantum genetic algorithm to optimize a time window, carrying out data fusion, using an improved Dempster-Shafer synthesis rule, combining cloud model quantization uncertainty, carrying out gray correlation analysis on key parameters to calculate correlation, carrying out abnormal data detection and restoration, using an improved isolated forest algorithm to detect, kalman filtering interpolation restoration, implementing data transportation optimization, using an ant colony algorithm optimization route, using a fountain code technology of LDPC codes to schedule real-time data by using a token bucket algorithm, constructing LSTM and ESN fusion model prediction trend, and updating parameters by a sliding window. The intelligent level of the power plant data management is improved, and the intelligent level and the decision accuracy of the power plant data management are improved by the method.
assignees: HUBEI GUCHENG YINLONG ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Multi-strategy-enhanced African bald-awkward algorithm-based pump station multi-objective optimal scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pump station multi-objective optimization scheduling method based on a multi-strategy enhanced African baldness algorithm, and relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering. By acquiring basic data of operation of a pump station, establishing a multi-objective optimization scheduling model taking the minimum electric charge and the minimum water shortage square sum of a water receiving area during operation of the pump station as an objective function, taking the constraint conditions of water pump power constraint, water pump pumping capacity constraint and water pump starting number constraint as constraint conditions, establishing a multi-objective optimization scheduling model adopting a crowding degree distance ordering mechanism and a hypercube mechanism to select double leaders to guide a population, adopting an archiving-based cross variation strategy to reduce the possibility of the multi-objective algorithm to sink into local optimum, adopting a multi-strategy enhanced multi-objective African pattern bald algorithm for restoring out-of-limits solutions after a main cycle is finished by adopting a progressive restoration strategy, so as to enhance the competitiveness of the population to ensure the diversity of the population, and adopting the multi-strategy enhanced multi-objective African pattern bald algorithm to conduct multi-objective optimization scheduling simulation of the pump station, thereby being capable of improving the operation efficiency of the pump station.
assignees: CHONGQING WEST WATER RESOURCES DEV CO LTD;UNIV YANGZHOU;CHONGQING YUFA WATER CONSERVANCY SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Survival risk quantitative evaluation method for sticky and sinking roe
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of environmental science and ecology, and discloses a quantitative evaluation method for survival risk of adhesive-sinking fish eggs, which is used for collecting multi-source environmental data of spawning sites and constructing a water environment model of spawning sites, constructing an egg mass sedimentation model based on sedimentation characteristics of target adhesive-sinking fish eggs, constructing a first survival risk evaluation model of egg masses in a sedimentation period according to the egg mass sedimentation model and the water environment model, constructing a second survival risk evaluation model of egg masses in a hatching period according to the water environment model, evaluating survival risk of egg masses in the sedimentation period according to the first survival risk evaluation model, and evaluating survival risk of egg masses in the hatching period according to the second survival risk evaluation model. According to the invention, biological characteristics of the settlement of the adhesive fish eggs in a lump are coupled with the environmental factors, so that not only is the settlement risk of the adhesive fish eggs accurately estimated, but also the hatching risk in the hatching period is accurately calculated by quantifying the contribution degree of each habitat factor to the risk, and a targeting guide is provided for formulating ecological restoration measures.
assignees: UNIV XIAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Urban medical system double-stage anti-seismic toughness assessment method
abstract_en: A method for evaluating the anti-seismic toughness of an urban medical system in two stages relates to the technical field of civil engineering. The invention aims to solve the problem that the existing medical system evaluation method neglects the dynamic interaction between the regional medical network and the traffic system. The method comprises the steps of establishing a network topology model of a medical system, analyzing medical system states under different earthquake scenes by using the network topology model of the medical system, respectively carrying out functional analysis on the medical system in an emergency period after earthquake and a recovery period by using the medical system states, carrying out earthquake resistance evaluation based on functional loss by using functional indexes in the emergency period after earthquake and the recovery period after earthquake, formulating a restoration strategy according to the medical system states, constructing a functional recovery curve of the medical system, carrying out earthquake resistance evaluation based on the curve, and comprehensively realizing double-stage earthquake resistance evaluation of the urban medical system by using an earthquake resistance evaluation result based on the functional loss and an earthquake resistance evaluation result based on restoration time.
assignees: HARBIN INST TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Underground water restoration process intelligent supervision method and system based on multi-mode monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent monitoring method and system for a groundwater remediation process based on multi-mode monitoring, and belongs to the technical field of groundwater monitoring. The method comprises the steps of arranging exploratory wells according to the actual conditions of a repairing area, setting sensors, adding repairing agents, initializing data acquisition nodes, constructing a water quality data cluster based on the acquisition nodes, dividing repairing stages, evaluating degradation efficiency of different water quality indexes in each stage, realizing dynamic tracking of repairing effects, constructing a degradation state feedback matrix based on degradation efficiency calculation efficiency mean value, marking the degradation state as normal or abnormal, evaluating the abnormal correlation degree of water quality repairing among exploratory wells based on the feedback matrix, identifying exploratory wells with correlation and outputting the exploratory wells to a worker port. According to the invention, through multi-mode monitoring and dynamic efficiency evaluation, the accurate supervision and anomaly traceability of the groundwater remediation process are realized, the water quality change is influenced by the same factor, the problem area can be rapidly positioned, and the remediation efficiency and decision scientificity are effectively improved.

title_en: Intelligent operation and maintenance scheduling method and system applied to wind power generation
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent operation and maintenance scheduling method and system applied to wind power generation, which relate to the technical field of wind power generation, firstly, a performance influence association network of a wind generating set is constructed, the directed association edges among equipment operation elements, environment action elements and performance output elements are covered, then a performance fluctuation sensitive node set is identified based on the performance influence association network, operation and maintenance demand prediction is executed for the set, generating an operation and maintenance task planning scheme comprising a node restoration priority and a node collaborative maintenance strategy, constructing a resource collaborative scheduling model according to the operation and maintenance task planning scheme and a real-time operation and maintenance resource state comprising a personnel skill matrix and a tool adaptation vector, outputting an operation and maintenance resource allocation instruction through the resource collaborative scheduling model, updating the associated edge weight of the efficiency influence associated network according to an operation and maintenance execution result, and realizing intelligent scheduling of wind power generation operation and maintenance.
assignees: HUANENG RENEWABLES CO LTD SHANXI BRANCH

title_en: Photovoltaic area vegetation index prediction method integrating environment driving element hysteresis feedback
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic area vegetation index prediction method integrating environment driving element hysteresis feedback, and belongs to the technical field of vegetation monitoring of photovoltaic power stations. According to the method, meteorological data and soil data of a target area are acquired, and hysteresis effects between each environmental element and vegetation indexes are analyzed by combining vegetation image data, so that the significant hysteresis time is determined, and hysteresis variables are constructed. And a random forest model is adopted, environmental elements and hysteresis variables thereof are used as input, a prediction model is trained, and the performance of the model is improved through an optimization algorithm. And identifying key ecological factors influencing the vegetation index, and providing an ecological restoration strategy according to the importance ranking. The invention can accurately capture the dynamic change of the microclimate environment and vegetation growth lag response caused by the photovoltaic array, obviously improve the prediction precision of the vegetation index of the photovoltaic area, provide scientific basis for ecological management of the photovoltaic power station by the aid of the repair strategy of comprehensive variable lag feedback, and realize 'photovoltaic+ecological' collaborative optimization by aid of assistance.
assignees: INST ELECTRICAL ENG CAS

title_en: Intelligent ecological filtering system for water pollution control
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water environment treatment, in particular to an intelligent ecological filtering system for water pollution treatment, which is characterized in that a data acquisition module is used for acquiring contour, image and topography data of a river and a historical pollution database, a data processing module is used for analyzing the data, extracting river boundaries and constructing a shape mathematical model, a water sample analysis module is used for acquiring a water sample according to the river shape and analyzing pollutant types and concentration distribution, a pollution source tracing module is used for determining a pollution source by utilizing pollutant data and surrounding environment information and combining a tracing algorithm, a permeable dam construction module is used for constructing an initial permeable dam according to the pollution source and the shape mathematical model, a parameter adjustment module is used for monitoring the water quality and the hydrologic data in real time, constructing a pollution diffusion model, calculating water flow adjustment quantity and adjusting operation parameters of the permeable dam to form a target permeable dam. The invention realizes accurate treatment and ecological restoration of water pollution through intelligent analysis and real-time adjustment.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGKEYUQING ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Network for sustainable aquatic ecosystem development
abstract_en: A network for the sustainable aquatic ecosystem development, characterized by comprising a pipeline, an unattended intelligent and automated measurement, control, and operation and maintenance system for network management, a water inlet, and a water outlet. A straight pipe, a vertical pipe, a circular pipe, an inclined pipe, an intersection pipe, a water inlet pipe, a water outlet pipe, a pipe branch, a power pipe, a four-way pipe, a water well pipe, and a pipe connector are connected to form a national and global pipeline; an access and exit channel gate is provided and an access and exit bundling cable is laid in the entry and exit; a pipe gate is provided in the four-way pipe; a flow meter, a motor, an equalization wheel, and rotating blades are arranged in the power pipe; the bundling cable, the wireless communication, and the global communication are connected to the unattended intelligent and automated measurement, control, and operation and maintenance system for network management; and an intelligent lens water level meter is mounted outside the water well pipe, and the flow meter is arranged in the water well pipe. The pipeline network system in the present invention is applied to manage the network in accordance with related regulations to diligently coordinate water supply and drainage on a national scale. This can prevent water-related disasters and pollution, mitigating their harm to both humanity and nature and achieving the safe and efficient conveyance and distribution of water resources from the Four River Sources in the Tibetan Plateau to regions across the entire country. By means of innovative restoration of the Earth's aquatic ecosystems, harmonious five spheres and a stable climate are achieved. This paves the way for the synergistic development of humanity and nature, ensuring human health, well-being, longevity, and happiness, and achieving the sustainable development of both aquatic ecosystems and human civilization.
assignees: YE XIN

title_en: Disaster recovery data restoration method, equipment, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The application discloses a disaster recovery data restoration method, equipment, a storage medium and a program product, which relate to the technical field of data processing, wherein a disaster recovery end actively generates read information after receiving a routing inspection instruction, judges whether the storage medium is abnormal according to the read information, generates error reporting information under the condition that the storage medium is abnormal, acquires a data writing request of hard disk data containing a production end hard disk according to the error reporting information, and writes the hard disk data again by the disaster recovery end to finish data restoration under the condition that the storage medium is abnormal, thereby solving the problem that the storage medium is difficult to identify in the related technology, ensuring the data safety and increasing the reliability of data backup.
assignees: SUZHOU YUANNAO INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mine ecological remediation soil-fixing and flow-dredging structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mine soil fixation and drainage, in particular to a mine ecological restoration soil fixation and drainage structure. Including burying a plurality of drain pipes in the mine, the drain pipe slope sets up, the soil horizon has been laid on the mine, be equipped with top water drainage tank and bottom water drainage tank on the mine, the both ends of drain pipe extend to top water drainage tank and bottom water drainage tank respectively in, soil horizon upper berth is equipped with solid soil net, a plurality of diaphragm and the planting board that the interval set up have been laid on the solid soil net, it has a plurality of planting holes to run through on the planting board, the bottom fixed mounting of planting board has a plurality of anchor pipes, anchor pipe and the planting hole intercommunication that corresponds. Through simple drainage structures to can in time discharge the unnecessary moisture in the infiltration mine soil stone, can effectively prevent that mine soil stone moisture content is too high, thereby can prevent to appear landslide and collapse the problem, bring very big facility for the ecological remediation work of mine.
assignees: HUNAN ZHONGHE CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: River channel section morphological feature recognition method based on remote sensing
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of river channel segment feature recognition, and particularly relates to a method for recognizing morphological features of a river channel segment based on remote sensing. According to the invention, through multi-source remote sensing data fusion analysis, accurate identification and dynamic monitoring of river channel morphological characteristics are realized, the scientificity and efficiency of river channel management are improved, and through construction of river segment classification and morphological modules, fine data support is provided for river channel ecological restoration and management, so that the intelligent and data requirements of river channel management decisions are supported, meanwhile, through time sequence analysis of restoration nodes and current nodes, effective prediction of the river channel morphological evolution trend is realized, and after the prediction result is output, confidence verification and evaluation are also carried out, so that the reliability and applicability of the prediction result are ensured, corresponding data support can be provided for river channel repair engineering by the prediction result, the river channel morphological change trend can be prejudged in advance, and scientific basis is provided for flood control and disaster reduction and water resource management.
assignees: CHINA CONSTRUCTION ECOLOGICAL ENV GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Mud-rock flow along-path automatic diversion dredging, sand blocking and silt stopping combined structure and construction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of disaster prevention and reduction of hydraulic engineering, in particular to a mud-rock flow along-path automatic diversion dredging, sand blocking and silt stopping combined structure and a construction method. The combined structure comprises a plurality of automatic diversion dredging, sand blocking and silt stopping units which are sequentially arranged along the river water flow direction, and each unit comprises a crescent diversion structure, a self-dredging silt blocking dam structure and a funnel type silt stopping field structure. The crescent diversion structure is formed by distributing concrete columns or gabion columns according to the shape of crescent teeth and connecting the concrete columns or the gabion columns through waterproof geotechnical cloth, internally filling soil and stone mixtures and covering vegetation on the top, the self-dredging check dam structure is transversely arranged on a river channel and is provided with a drainage hole, a gate and an overflow port, the funnel type silt stopping field structure comprises an inclined slope, a funnel type silt stopping pond and silt discharging holes, and planting grooves are arranged on the periphery of the funnel type silt stopping field structure. The combined structure is arranged in the river channel, so that the debris flow can be effectively intercepted, automatic diversion dredging is realized, manual maintenance is reduced, disaster prevention and reduction effects are improved, and meanwhile, the ecological restoration function is realized.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Post-disaster power distribution network power supply restoration optimization method, system, equipment, medium and product
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, and discloses a method, a system, equipment, a medium and a product for optimizing power restoration of a post-disaster power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of power supply equipment used for power restoration in the power distribution network, taking the sum of maximum load restoration power as an optimization target and taking the running balance state of each power supply equipment as a first constraint condition in the power restoration process of the power distribution network, and constructing a power supply restoration optimization model of the power distribution network by taking the system operation balance state of the power distribution network as a second constraint condition, so that the power supply restoration optimization model of the power distribution network can solve a power supply restoration scheme of the power distribution network, the maximum restoration load power supply is considered, the operation balance state of each power supply device and the system operation balance state of the power distribution network can be maintained, and the reliability of power supply restoration after disaster is improved.
assignees: FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Power distribution network operation risk prompting method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution network operation risk prompting method and a system, wherein the method comprises the steps of performing image restoration on a detected power distribution network operation image to obtain a restoration image; the method comprises the steps of constructing a data pair of a repair image and text description to form a training set, carrying out pre-training quantization treatment on a pre-trained multi-modal large language model by utilizing an AWQ algorithm to obtain a quantized multi-modal large language model, carrying out fine tuning training on the quantized multi-modal large language model in a Lora fine tuning mode to obtain and utilize the adjusted model to carry out power distribution network operation risk prompt. The method and the system solve the technical problems that the accuracy of predicting the operation risk of the power distribution network is not high and the risk prompt cannot be effectively carried out due to the fact that the data types are multiple in the operation process of the power distribution network.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV ANHUI

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted MiniSAR real-time imaging and emergency communication system for disaster rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted MiniSAR real-time imaging and emergency communication system for disaster relief, which relates to the technical field of emergency communication and radar remote sensing, and comprises a radar path inversion modeling module, wherein the radar path inversion modeling module performs multi-time flight above a target area, acquires radar echo signals at a plurality of moments, acquires flight attitude data and imaging azimuth information of a flight platform, inverts a propagation path of the radar echo signals based on the flight attitude data and the imaging azimuth information, extracts an incident angle and a reflection path length, and generates a reflection path distribution diagram. According to the invention, through multi-time radar path modeling and image stability evaluation, the false target points under multipath interference are accurately identified and removed, image structure restoration is realized by combining a dynamic extension algorithm, a dynamic confidence distribution map is constructed, high-confidence target positioning and rescue area optimization are realized, and the anti-interference and response accuracy of the system is enhanced.
assignees: BEIJING XIONGFENG SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic-based biomass energy plant selection method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic base biomass energy plant selection method and application thereof, aiming at the problem of land resource shortage in energy transformation and renewable energy utilization of a current thermal power plant, based on the condition that photovoltaic power generation vegetation lacks and energy plant planting is combined, the feasibility of ecological restoration and biomass energy plant production of photovoltaic base planting energy plants is researched, mode plant screening standards are established according to indexes such as strong stress resistance, drought resistance, negative resistance, carbon content, cellulose content and the like, growth performance of perennial energy plants on the photovoltaic base, self population update and influence of the photovoltaic base are inspected, interaction mechanisms between the photovoltaic base and crops are analyzed, the improvement effect of different planting modes on land production efficiency is analyzed, the growth effect among different plants is evaluated, the optimal configuration scheme of the photovoltaic base planting energy plants is clarified, an efficient photovoltaic-agricultural comprehensive utilization mode is constructed, and double improvement of economic benefit and ecological benefit is realized.
assignees: JINZHUSHAN THERMAL POWER BRANCH OF DATANG HUAYIN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Mangrove community succession prediction method under influence of sea level rising
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mangrove community succession prediction method under the influence of sea level rising, which relates to the field of environmental simulation and ecological protection and comprises the following steps of obtaining beach elevation, water depth, mangrove distribution, coastline, tide harmony constant and historical typhoon path data of a prediction area; the method comprises the steps of constructing self-adaptive triangular grids, spatially interpolating mangrove distribution data to grid units, defining closed boundaries by utilizing coastline data, driving a three-dimensional finite element model by combining tidal harmonic constants and typhoon path data, solving grid point water level time sequences in current and sea level rising scenes, calculating flooding duration time of each grid unit in the current and sea level rising scenes, updating community spatial distribution according to flooding time change and mangrove species tolerance threshold value, and outputting a prediction graph. The method accurately quantifies the spatial influence of flooding time change caused by sea level rising on mangrove community succession, and provides reliable technical support for ecological protection and restoration of coastal zones.
assignees: NAT MARINE DATA AND INFORMATION SERVICE

title_en: Cable path planning method, apparatus, device, medium and program product
abstract_en: The application provides a cable path planning method which can be applied to the technical field of power systems. The cable path planning method comprises the steps of obtaining layout data of a photovoltaic power station, wherein the layout data comprise positions of a transformer substation in the photovoltaic power station, positions of a converging box used for converging current and positions of gap points needed for connecting the converging box to the transformer substation, determining connection cost among the transformer substation, the converging box and the gap points based on position relations in the layout data, planning an initial path of the converging box connected to the transformer substation through the gap points according to the connection cost, sequentially adjusting the initial path by using a preset path destruction operator and a preset path restoration operator to obtain an updated path, and comparing the connection cost of the updated path with the connection cost of the initial path to output the updated path under the condition that preset conditions are met. The application also provides a cable path planning device, equipment, a storage medium and a program product.
assignees: UNIV SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CHINA

title_en: Method for calculating ecological water demand of lack-of-data city river and lake based on remote sensing image
abstract_en: The invention provides a calculation method of urban river and lake ecological water demand based on a remote sensing image and lack of data, which comprises the steps of firstly determining the calculation sub-items of the basic ecological water demand and the target ecological water demand of the urban river and lake; then, based on remote sensing image toilet sheets, the actual water surface of the lake is extracted, the leakage water quantity and the leakage coefficient are calculated according to water quantity balance, and then, the water quantity required by each sub-item is calculated. The seepage water quantity in the ecological water quantity is close to the real seepage water quantity, the calculated ecological water quantity is scientific and reasonable, and scientific basis and data support are provided for the ecological restoration of rivers and lakes and the reasonable optimization configuration of water resources.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting fire-extinguishing system for building
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire extinguishment, in particular to an intelligent fire extinguishment system for a building. The intelligent decision and fire extinguishing termination judging system comprises a multi-source information acquisition module, a characteristic fusion and situation generation module, an intelligent decision and fire extinguishing termination judging module and an execution and feedback control module. The system firstly collects surface temperature sequence, characteristic gas concentration and electric signal parameters respectively, a multi-source monitoring data set is generated, characteristic parameters are extracted based on the data set, a battery stability situation index is generated, multi-stage decision is carried out according to the index, water spray cooling is maintained when the index is lower than a safety threshold, a stable observation period is started and converted into a heuristic spray mode when the index exceeds the threshold, and a fire extinguishing termination instruction or a water spray restoration instruction is generated through trend stability analysis in the observation period. The invention solves the technical problem of serious water stain loss caused by continuous water spraying when the traditional fire protection system is used for dealing with lithium battery fire, and realizes accurate fire extinguishing control on the premise of ensuring no re-combustion.
assignees: YANG SHUCHANG

title_en: Island energy system based on deep reinforcement learning and scheduling method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to an island energy system based on deep reinforcement learning, which comprises an energy device, an electrolysis device, an energy storage battery, a hydrogen storage device, an oxygen storage device, a pressure swing adsorption device, an ammonia synthesis device, a sea water desalination device and a scheduling device, wherein the energy device inputs electric energy to the electrolysis device, the energy storage battery, the pressure swing adsorption device and the sea water desalination device, the electrolysis device decomposes water provided by the sea water desalination device into hydrogen and oxygen, the pressure swing adsorption device provides nitrogen, the hydrogen storage device stores the hydrogen and the nitrogen and inputs the hydrogen to the ammonia synthesis device, the oxygen storage device stores the oxygen, the scheduling device constructs a real-time running state of the system into a multidimensional state vector to form an equilibrium constraint system of electric-hydrogen-oxygen-ammonia-water multipotent coupling, and the multidimensional state vector is decided based on a near-end strategy optimization algorithm to output optimal strategy parameters. The application optimizes the global relation of electrolytic hydrogen production and multi-energy co-supply by taking the electrolytic device as a pivot, and realizes the low-carbon energy supply, ecological restoration and load demand.
assignees: NO 719 RES INSTITUTE CHINA STATE SHIPBUILDING CO LTD

title_en: Mud-rock flow ditch bed ecological restoration system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological restoration system for a debris flow gully bed. The structure comprises retaining walls on two sides, a spur dike group which is arranged between the retaining walls and connected with the retaining walls and matched with the spur dike group, and a crust layer and a arbor forest which are planted among the spur dike group. The T-dam group consists of a plurality of lower-chosen T-dams with a certain burial depth, and each two stages of the T-dams are distributed according to a certain interval and are used for beam current and arbor in a protection gap. Compared with the prior art, the method reduces erosion of the gap ditch bed of the double-side spur dike by adjusting the directions of the mud-rock flow and the water flow in the ditch, provides a stable growth environment for vegetation of the ditch bed, solves the problem of high ecological restoration difficulty of the mud-rock flow ditch bed, is beneficial to ecological restoration of a river basin, can reduce erosion of the running water to the spur dike group and the retaining wall after plants in the gap grow, solves the problem of easy failure of geotechnical engineering, and is beneficial to long-term operation of the ecological restoration system.
assignees: GUO SHURONG

title_en: Photovoltaic power station data restoration method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic power station data restoration method, aims to solve the problem of power data loss of a photovoltaic power station caused by sensor faults, communication interruption and the like, and belongs to the technical field of photovoltaic power station data processing. And selecting meteorological features strongly related to power through pearson correlation coefficients, constructing a Stacking integrated model with SVR, KNN, RF as a base learner and RR as a meta learner, supplementing reference power station data by combining data normalization and K-fold cross validation, and finally quantifying and repairing precision by using NMAE and NRMSE. Through data verification of a certain 120MW photovoltaic power station, the method is superior to a single model under the condition of 20% -50% loss rate, NMAE is reduced by 9.62% compared with SVR under the condition of 50% loss rate, NRMSE is reduced by 20.69%, repair accuracy is high, robustness is strong, and reliable data support is provided for operation and maintenance of the photovoltaic power station.
assignees: STATE GRID GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY QINGYANG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Method and device for generating distributed flexible resource power supply scheme under extreme disasters
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for generating a distributed flexible resource power supply scheme under extreme disasters, a storage medium and computer equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a first-stage objective function and a first constraint condition of a target power distribution network; the method comprises the steps of solving a first-stage objective function based on a first constraint condition to obtain the optimal installation position and the installation capacity of each distributed flexible resource in a target power distribution network, generating a network topology structure of the target power distribution network according to the optimal installation position and the installation capacity of each distributed flexible resource, constructing a second-stage objective function and a second constraint condition of the target power distribution network according to the network topology structure, solving the second-stage objective function based on the second constraint condition to obtain an island division range of the network topology of the target power distribution network under extreme disasters and a load recovery sequence of each island division range, and generating a power supply scheme of the distributed flexible resources under the extreme disasters based on each island division range and the load recovery sequence.
assignees: NANNING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Water area environment restoration method for aquaculture tail water wetland
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of aquaculture, and provides a water area environment restoration method of a cultivation tail water wetland, which divides a water area of the cultivation tail water wetland into a plurality of subareas, wherein a water quality sensor is arranged in each subarea, the water quality sensor collects and stores water body data of the subareas, the water body data of the subareas are input into a preset neural network model, a water body quality evaluation value of the subareas is generated, and the water area is restored according to the water body quality evaluation value of each subarea. The method can identify the water area environment quality of the aquaculture tail water wetland in a blocking manner, analyze the distribution characteristics of the aquaculture water quality by combining a real-time sensing technology and a neural network model, further locate the water quality deterioration area and the diffusion path thereof, improve the restoration effect, reduce the cost consumption of the traditional sampling analysis method, replace the global treatment by targeted measures, and provide an economic and efficient solution for the large-scale aquaculture tail water treatment.
assignees: GUANGDONG NO 3 WATER CONSERVANCY & HYDRO ELECTRIC ENG BOARD CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network rapid maintenance decision method and system considering incomplete fault information
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power system rush repair scheduling, and provides a power distribution network quick maintenance decision method and system considering incomplete fault information, wherein in the training process of an offline stage, historical fault scene information is preprocessed to generate a fault scene set, the similarity of any two fault scenes is calculated, and the fault scenes are clustered; calculating weak rules of all fault scenes to obtain an alternative weak rule set to form a global maintenance rule set, obtaining current fault scene information, calculating similarity of the current fault scene and fault scenes in a fault scene set, obtaining a neighborhood of the scene on the basis of the similarity, calculating total association degree, and finally identifying an optimal rule as an optimal maintenance decision according to similarity statistics and Bayesian theorem. The invention fully considers the influence of incomplete fault information of the large-scale power distribution network, and identifies the optimal rule in the global maintenance rule set obtained by training in a mode of combining offline training and online decision.
assignees: DEZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Rapid power recovery method, system, equipment and storage medium for multi-type clean energy distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid power restoration method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for a multi-type clean energy power distribution network, which are used for solving the technical problems that the existing power distribution network power restoration system is dependent on physical topology switching during dynamic network reconfiguration, the dynamic reconfiguration is dependent on physical switching action, the response speed is limited, in addition, fault recovery and oscillation suppression strategies are separated, and the rapidity and the stability are difficult to consider. The method comprises the steps of determining a complex electricity area according to fault data of a power distribution network, generating a logic power supply path diagram according to virtual nodes of the power distribution network and a power grid topological graph, obtaining weight of each power supply path in the logic power supply path diagram, determining an optimal power supply path based on the weight and the complex electricity area, obtaining response speeds of all clean energy sources, dividing the clean energy sources into a fast response cluster and a slow response cluster according to the response speeds, calculating real-time inertia of the fast response cluster and real-time damping coefficients of the slow response cluster, and supplying the clean energy sources to the complex electricity area according to the optimal power supply path, the real-time inertia and the real-time damping coefficients.
assignees: ZHUHAI POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Ecological restoration monitoring system for forests and grasses
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest and grass ecological restoration monitoring system which comprises an intelligent sensing layer, a multi-mode fusion layer, a knowledge mining layer, a decision support layer and an ecological ontology library update layer, wherein the intelligent sensing layer is used for carrying out full-coverage access on multi-source data by constructing a self-adaptive sensor network, an unmanned aerial vehicle inspection module and a manual inspection terminal, the multi-mode fusion layer is used for carrying out unified data alignment by adopting a data standardization protocol, adopting a space-time fusion algorithm and a deep learning framework, adjusting fusion weights according to data quality to generate a data set and transmitting the data set to the knowledge mining layer, the knowledge mining layer is used for constructing unified data semantic standards of an ecological ontology library, utilizing a space-time dependency relationship in the data mined by a space-time graph neural network and utilizing a causal reasoning engine to convert an implicit ecological rule into interpretable decision knowledge, the decision support layer is used for displaying core indexes by utilizing an LSTM network and utilizing an optimized recommendation engine to generate an individualized restoration scheme, and dynamically adjusting and optimizing sensor deployment strategies and weight distribution algorithms according to effects, and the updating of the ecological ontology library.
assignees: Weiyuan County Forestry and Grassland Service Center

title_en: Distribution network dynamic topology identification and self-healing control method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network dynamic topology identification and self-healing control method and device, which comprise the steps of collecting operation data of a distribution network, carrying out time synchronization processing, data quality assessment and data restoration to obtain a high-quality network state data set, carrying out dynamic topology identification by adopting a path improved by a relaxation method and a forest enhancement algorithm based on the data set to obtain a dynamic network topology model, constructing a knapsack network model by adopting a cyclic data generation method, assessing distributed photovoltaic output and load conditions, monitoring network abnormality in real time, adopting a machine learning algorithm to assist in judging fault types, positions and influence ranges, comprehensively considering power supply reliability and economy, adopting a multi-objective optimization algorithm to generate a switch operation sequence, executing switch operation to form a temporary micro-network or adjusting a power supply path, and carrying out real-time monitoring and assessment on an execution effect. The method can accurately identify the dynamic topology of the distributed photovoltaic power distribution network with high proportion, and realize fault location and high-efficiency self-healing control.
assignees: YANCHENG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;DONGTAI POWER SUPPLY BRANCH COMPANY STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;JIANGSU MAOYUAN ELECTRICAL CO LTD

title_en: Multi-parameter comprehensive evaluation method for ecological health of underground water body
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-parameter comprehensive evaluation method for ecological health of underground water, which relates to the technical field of water resource protection and ecological environment evaluation, and aims to collect multi-source data such as water quality, hydrology, ecology, human society and the like through a sensor network and comprehensively cover key elements of an ecological system. The method comprises the steps of constructing a model framework for coupling ecological-hydrologic processes, fusing an ecological process model and a groundwater dynamics model, simulating interaction of the ecological process model and the groundwater dynamics model, excavating a pollution source-water body-organism complex relationship by using a groundwater ecological cognition map and a graph neural network, and optimizing an inference rule by combining a dynamic inference engine for autonomous learning, so that high accuracy and strong adaptability of an evaluation model are realized. And finally, according to the reasoning result, outputting management decision suggestions such as pollution prevention and control, water resource scheduling, ecological restoration and the like in a grading manner. Provides a scientific, reliable and operable technical scheme for groundwater resource protection and environment management, and has important application value.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING;NANJIANG HYDROLOGY GEOLOGICAL ENGINEERING GEOLOGICAL TEAM CHONGQING BUREAU OF GEOLOGY AND MINERALS E;UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES WUHAN

title_en: Method and system for determining restoration sequence of non-passable path under flood disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for determining the recovery sequence of an unvented path under a flood disaster, which relate to the technical field of flood disaster risk avoidance and acquire the unvented paths of a road network under different rainfall reproduction periods; the method comprises the steps of establishing a non-directional topology network of a research area, establishing an adjacency matrix to obtain network efficiency, namely quantifying road network connectivity by utilizing the network efficiency, aiming at each side corresponding to an unvented path, obtaining the network efficiency of the non-directional topology network formed by the rest sides after the side is removed as the reference network efficiency of the side, obtaining a change value of each side corresponding to the unvented path by making a difference between the reference network efficiency and the original network efficiency, arranging the change values in a descending order, determining the recovery order of the unvented path by taking the maximum connectivity lifting amplitude after path recovery as a target in the process based on the connectivity actually submerged by the road in a specific disaster scene, and thus efficiently determining the road network recovery order and arranging timely rescue.
assignees: UNIV HENAN TECHNOLOGY;UNIV ZHENGZHOU

title_en: Method, system and storage medium for identifying and alarming total stop risk of power grid in small region
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and a storage medium for identifying and alarming total stop risk of a power grid in a small region, which are based on a real-time data platform full-network model, analyze a power grid topological relation, accurately identify a series county-region power grid model, monitor power supply channel outage, regional load drop and power restoration progress in real time, build a grading evaluation model by combining loss load quantity and power failure duration to evaluate accident grades, roll and update equipment states, dynamically correct a power failure range and a grading result by polling power restoration progress in real time, store the analysis result in a time sequence database in an event structure, and push an alarm picture by a dispatching alarm assistant to realize panoramic visualization of fault information. Compared with the prior art, the method can improve the accuracy of the research and judgment of the total stop risk of the power supply channel in the small region, shorten the sensing time of the accident influence range and the risk information, assist the dispatcher to quickly re-electrify, reduce the economic loss, and is suitable for quick fault response and re-electrifying decision of the county/district-level power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Campus energy consumption monitoring method based on behavior trace aggregation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a campus energy consumption monitoring method based on behavior trace aggregation, in particular to the field of energy consumption monitoring for campus energy consumption big data acquisition, which comprises the steps of acquiring access control data, wireless access data and video anonymous trace data to form a behavior trace sequence; and when the results of different data sources are different, returning to execute track collection again until the mutation area set and the mutation intensity matrix which are consistent are output. The multi-system power consumption unified scheduling method comprises the steps of carrying out aggregation processing on multi-source data such as access control, wireless access, video tracks and the like, identifying mutation areas, constructing a multi-system causal relationship graph, and generating coordinated actions and recovery sequences by combining constraint conditions to realize unified scheduling of multi-system power consumption in a burst scene.
assignees: SHANGHAI YULONG INFORMATION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Clonezilla-based openEuler system rapid backup and restore method, system, equipment and device
abstract_en: A openEuler system quick backup and restore method, system, device and apparatus based on Clonezilla relates to the technical field of operating system backup, and includes making Clonezilla boot disk and ext4 format storage device, starting target device by boot disk, selecting local storage mode and backup strategy, carrying out partition level or full magnetic disk compression backup on openEuler system under enterprise server with merpeng processor developed mainly, all software in system and environment required by installing software, generating bootable system mirror image ISO file, solving problems of poor compatibility, low efficiency and incomplete environmental restoration of traditional Linux backup method under domestic platform by customizing mirror image processing flow, hardware instruction set adaptation and system environment depth capturing technology, and improving response speed of system deployment and disaster recovery.
assignees: SHANXI INFORMATION INDUSTRIAL TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent river ecological water replenishing and water quality regulating and controlling system and method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering and ecological restoration, in particular to an intelligent river ecological water replenishing and water quality regulating and controlling system and method based on the Internet of things, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting river water quality data and environmental parameters; the method comprises the steps of carrying out local real-time preprocessing, eliminating abnormal data, generating an emergency response instruction when dissolved oxygen is detected to be lower than a set value, uploading the preprocessed data to a cloud decision platform, merging an ecological water demand model based on a machine learning model, predicting a water quality change trend, generating a collaborative regulation and control suggestion, calling a dynamic water supplementing algorithm to calculate the rotating speed of a variable-frequency pump station and the opening of an intelligent electromagnetic valve, controlling the multi-stage variable-frequency pump station to start and adjust the flow after receiving the instruction, controlling the intelligent electromagnetic valve to supply water according to the opening, monitoring the running state of equipment in real time, identifying the abnormal state of the pump station, automatically closing an upstream valve, and triggering an emergency stop button to cut off a power supply when the inclination angle of the detection equipment is larger than the set angle. Improving the treatment efficiency and stability.
assignees: INSPUR SMART TECH INNOVATION SHANDONG CO LTD

title_en: Rural plant community configuration and dynamic optimization system suitable for composite pollution sites
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rural plant community configuration and dynamic optimization system suitable for a combined pollution site, which belongs to the technical field of environmental ecological restoration and soil pollution treatment and comprises six modules, namely a rural plant resource database, pollution site information acquisition and processing, intelligent plant community configuration, real-time monitoring and data feedback, dynamic optimization decision and visual interaction. The system realizes intelligent screening and community construction of the native plants through a multi-source data fusion and multi-target optimization algorithm, combines a sensor network and a machine learning model to monitor and dynamically regulate the repair process in real time, improves the repair efficiency, community stability and ecological safety of a heavy metal and organic pollutant composite pollution site, and supports full-period intelligent, low-cost and green sustainable ecological repair management.
assignees: RESEARCH & DEVELOPMENT INSTITUTE OF NORTHWESTERN POLYTECHNICAL UNIV IN SHENZHEN

title_en: Dynamic evaluation method and system for influence of photovoltaic power station on ecological environment
abstract_en: The application provides a dynamic evaluation method and a system for the influence of a photovoltaic power station on ecological environment, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-element real-time monitoring system of the photovoltaic power station, and continuously collecting various ecological environment data inside and outside the power station; the method comprises the steps of acquiring data, transmitting the acquired data to the rear end in real time for data processing to construct a multi-element environment characteristic database, analyzing the data monitored for a long time in the database, determining evolution rules of various environment parameters in a power station, influence change rules of the power station on various ecological environment factors and various ecological influence weights, determining AHP weights based on the various ecological influence weights, constructing various ecological evolution prediction models and operation and maintenance decision prediction models of the power station based on the AHP weights, and determining operation and maintenance strategies and ecological restoration schemes of the power station by using the prediction models. According to the method, the influence of the photovoltaic power station on the ecological environment is dynamically evaluated by fusing multi-source real-time monitoring and multi-dimensional data analysis, so that the accuracy and the comprehensiveness of the evaluation are improved.
assignees: HUANENG XINJIANG ENERGY DEV CO LTD NANJIANG CLEAN ENERGY BRANCH;HUANENG CLEAN ENERGY RES INST

title_en: Active and reactive power coordination optimization scheduling method for wind farm group based on carbon emission constraint
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind farm group active and reactive power coordinated optimization scheduling method based on carbon emission constraint, which comprises the steps of constructing a full life cycle carbon emission model containing manufacturing, construction, operation and maintenance and wind abandon punishment, introducing a carbon transaction mechanism to convert a carbon quota difference into a tradable asset, innovatively providing a carbon intensity sensitivity matrix to realize carbon weight coupling of active-reactive decision variables, adopting an upper-layer power grid scheduling center to send a dynamic carbon price and a lower-layer wind farm to solve a double-layer distributed architecture of a carbon-energy dual object in parallel, combining an improved carbon pricing ADMM algorithm to protect privacy, utilizing model prediction to control rolling update carbon price and prediction, establishing a wind abandon-carbon emission weighing mechanism and an out-of-limit relaxation-restoration strategy to ensure real-time satisfaction of carbon emission constraint, and generating carbon pass through a blockchain intelligent contract to realize real-time settlement of carbon assets among wind farm groups by an optimized result. Simulation shows that the method reduces the running cost by 4.2% while reducing the carbon emission by 18.7%, is quick in calculation and meets the requirement of online application.
assignees: DUAN XIAOYU

title_en: Coastal nitrogen migration dynamic evaluation system based on multi-source data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coastal nitrogen migration dynamic evaluation system based on multi-source data, which relates to the technical field of water environment health evaluation, establishes a causal link based on a multi-source nitrogen data pool, identifies key driving factor nodes and a non-dominant nitrogen input path, generates a migration map, extracts a nitrogen concentration fluctuation mode and combines historical interference data to output a future migration trend map, judges a risk level according to the migration trend, matches regulation measures and outputs an ecological restoration suggestion, the invention provides a coast nitrogen migration dynamic assessment system based on multi-source data, which is characterized in that a multi-source nitrogen data pool is constructed, migration paths and key driving factors are identified through brain-like reasoning, a time, space and event three-label migration map is generated by the system, periodic modeling and trend prediction of nitrogen flux are realized, dynamic early warning and differentiated ecological intervention are supported, and compared with the prior art, the system has the advantages of accurate path identification, non-dominant input discrimination, strong prediction capability and perfect visual interaction.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Industrial network intelligent decision system and method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses an industrial network intelligent decision system and method based on digital twinning. The method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source sensor data on an industrial site, forming standard data vectors through wavelet threshold denoising and short-period memory network missing value restoration, constructing production line geometric, physical and flow models in a digital twin server, achieving time and state synchronization through an IEEE 1588 PTP protocol, inputting the standard data vectors into a Informer-based time sequence prediction model, combining equipment dimension coding to achieve fault type and probability calculation and fault position identification, establishing a multi-target optimization decision model through a genetic algorithm according to detection results, integrating outage loss, maintenance cost and production assurance, generating an optimal maintenance and scheduling scheme, and transmitting the scheme to a local controller for execution. The system realizes closed-loop decision flow from data acquisition, modeling, detection optimization and feedback.
assignees: HEFEI RUIJING AUTOMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ecological restoration system and restoration method for post-earthquake high-steep loose slope
abstract_en: The invention relates to an ecological restoration system and a restoration method for a post-earthquake high-steep loose side slope, wherein the ecological restoration system comprises lattice grids, planting units and irrigation units, the lattice grids are composed of lattice beams which are vertically and horizontally staggered and paved on the side slope and divide the side slope into a plurality of planting areas, the planting units comprise soil retaining plates arranged on the outer side of each planting area and vegetation climbing nets which are covered on the side slope of each planting area, the soil retaining plates, the lattice beams and the side slope jointly enclose to form planting grooves, planting soil is backfilled in the planting grooves, the irrigation units comprise main pipes which are arranged on the lattice beams, branch pipes which are vertically communicated with the main pipes and water outlet parts which are arranged on the branch pipes, and the branch pipes are distributed along the planting areas so as to irrigate the planting soil in the planting grooves at fixed points. The method has the advantages of wide applicability, good re-greening effect, convenient construction, controllable irrigation and remarkable ecological restoration effect, and is particularly suitable for ecological management and re-greening of the post-earthquake high-steep loose side slope.
assignees: CHINA CONSTR 8TH ENG DIVISION

title_en: Anti-scouring grass planting system for hydro-fluctuation belt, preparation method and application thereof, and method for repairing damaged ecological system in steep slope area of hydro-fluctuation belt of lake and reservoir
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ecological restoration, and particularly relates to a composite grass planting system, a preparation method and application thereof, and a restoration method of a damaged ecological system in a steep slope area of a hydro-fluctuation belt of a lake and a reservoir. The composite grass planting blanket provided by the invention mainly takes the degradable biomass material as the raw material, does not cause secondary pollution to the environment in the use process, can well improve the water retention property of the composite grass planting blanket through the layer structure design, is beneficial to vegetation growth, has good erosion resistance, and prolongs the service life of the composite grass planting blanket. When the composite grass planting blanket is used for repairing the steep slope area of the hydro-fluctuation belt of the lake and the reservoir, the steep slope area of the hydro-fluctuation belt of the lake and the reservoir is divided into a constant inundation area, a stormy wave erosion area and a slight inundation area, and different kinds of plants are planted in different areas, so that the survival rate of the plants is ensured, the water and soil loss is reduced, and the ecological repairing is effectively realized.

title_en: Folding field orthopaedics traction restorer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a folding field orthopaedics traction restorer, and belongs to the technical field of medical first-aid appliances. The device comprises a fixing frame and a folding frame hinged with the fixing frame, wherein a traction support driven by a screw rod is arranged in the fixing frame, the rear end of the folding frame is provided with a fixed support, the fixing support and the folding frame are both used for fixing limbs through a fixed belt with ladder buckles, a sliding seat at the rear end of the screw rod, a first connecting rod and a second connecting rod form a sliding block connecting rod mechanism, rapid traction or fine screw rod traction can be achieved, and a pressure sensor is integrated on the traction support for monitoring traction in real time. The invention is foldable, is convenient to store and carry, can provide two traction modes, namely a rapid traction mode and a slow traction mode, has stable and controllable traction process, effectively avoids secondary damage, and is suitable for the first aid restoration in the severe environments such as field operations, disaster rescue and the like.
assignees: THE 920TH HOSPITAL OF JOINT LOGISTICS SUPPORT FORCE OF THE CHINESE PEOPLES LIBERATION ARMY

title_en: Big data-based wheat irrigation optimization system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of resource scheduling, in particular to a wheat irrigation optimization system based on big data, the system comprises a leaf index identification module, a water consumption characteristic reconstruction module, a period supply and demand prejudgment module, a decision water distribution generation module and a dynamic duration execution module.
