According to the invention, a continuous change structure is constructed through leaf area amplification characteristics in a wheat growth stage, dynamic restoration of water demand characteristics in a crop growth process can be realized, a trend curve is established through matching of the evaporation rate and leaf area change to identify water consumption change nodes, accurate time period water demand depiction can be realized in the growth stage, evaporation supply trend is established by combining weather prediction data, prejudgement identification of water supply and demand states in a future time period is realized, time period deviation analysis and supply and demand difference judgment are introduced in an actual water distribution process, scheduling flexibility and resource matching precision are improved, and adaptability and high efficiency of field water regulation in different growth stages are ensured.
assignees: UNIV HEXI

title_en: Unit combination optimization method driven by large language model
abstract_en: A large language model driven unit combination optimization method relates to the technical field of electric power systems and comprises the steps of obtaining economic operation basic data of an electric power system, constructing an integer relaxation safety constraint unit combination model according to the economic operation basic data, solving the unit combination model, further obtaining the unit combination model, solving the unit combination model, constructing a variable dimension reduction algorithm, a constraint dimension reduction algorithm and an infeasible solution restoration algorithm, sequentially carrying out single algorithm evolution on the variable dimension reduction algorithm and the constraint dimension reduction algorithm by adopting the large language model, carrying out single algorithm evolution on the infeasible solution restoration algorithm by adopting the large language model, solving and calculating the unit combination model after the integer relaxation safety constraint, calculating the variable constraint dimension reduction safety constraint unit combination model to obtain an optimal solution, and restoring the optimal solution of the variable constraint dimension reduction safety constraint unit combination model based on the optimal infeasible solution restoration algorithm to obtain a result, wherein the method is used for solving the problem that the conventional model dimension reduction method is insufficient in terms of generality, stability and interpretability.

title_en: Proliferation and release decision control method and system for habitat ecological optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a proliferation and release decision control method and system for habitat ecological optimization. According to the method, firstly, historical release records of different proliferation release areas and corresponding ecological parameter change data are obtained, characteristic association analysis is carried out by utilizing a gradient lifting tree model, and a release-ecological response association network is constructed, so that the influence of different species and release intensity on ecological restoration effects is revealed. And secondly, identifying key ecological factors to be improved by collecting real-time water ecological parameters of the target habitat. And then combining the associated network to determine the proper release species and quantity, and further combining the water quality adaptability data of the selected species to accurately determine the optimal release time point. And finally, a proliferation and release decision strategy is formed, and water quality optimization and ecological balance recovery of the target habitat are realized.
assignees: SOUTH CHINA SEA FISHERIES RES INST CHINESE ACAD FISHERY SCIENCES;BEIHAI MARINE ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT SERVICE CENTER BEIHAI AQUATIC TECH PROMOTION STATION

title_en: Reasonable space allocation method for belt-type shrub protection forest in semiarid grassland area
abstract_en: The invention provides a reasonable space allocation method of a belt type shrub protection forest in a semiarid grassland area, which mainly comprises the following steps of (1) firstly determining potential maximum density of shrub forest belts, (2) determining key ecological hydrologic function parameters of shrub forest belts with different row distances, (3) comprehensively evaluating the ecological hydrologic function parameters of sand-fixing shrub forest belts with different row distances by adopting a hierarchical analysis-entropy weight method, and finally determining the optimal row distance and plant distance of the shrub forest belts by combining the potential maximum density of the shrub forest belts in the step (1) and the key ecological hydrologic function parameters of the shrub forest belts with different row distances in the step (2). The invention has reasonable conception, not only can promote the growth stability of the protective forest, but also can synchronously enhance the wind-proof effect and other ecological functions of the protective forest, and can provide theoretical basis for the efficient utilization of water resources and ecological restoration in arid grassland areas.

title_en: Dynamic identification and restoration decision method for underground water funnel area
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic identification and restoration decision method for a groundwater funnel area, and belongs to the technical field of water conservancy optimization based on deep learning. The method comprises the steps of constructing a high-dimensional groundwater state data set, then establishing a groundwater evolution numerical model by utilizing the data set to realize dynamic and accurate extraction of a three-dimensional boundary and key characteristic parameters of a funnel region, carrying out high-fidelity and uncertainty quantitative rapid prediction on the change of a future water head field on the premise of following a physical rule of groundwater dynamics by utilizing a deep learning prediction model cluster, and finally taking the prediction model as a decision deduction environment, training an agent by utilizing a deep reinforcement learning algorithm to enable the agent to learn autonomously and generate an optimal repair management and control strategy taking the repair benefit, the economic cost and the sustainability into consideration. The invention forms a closed loop intelligent system capable of autonomous learning and continuous optimization, and provides a scientific, efficient and system brand new solution for underground water resource management.
assignees: SHANDONG PROVINCIAL LAND SPACE ECOLOGICAL RESTORATION CENTER SHANDONG PROVINCIAL GEOLOGICAL DISASTER

title_en: Loess gully landform classification method and device based on coupling of unmanned aerial vehicle and remote sensing image
abstract_en: The invention provides a loess gully landform classification method and device based on coupling of an unmanned aerial vehicle and a remote sensing image, which are based on fusion of a new generation information technology and the manufacturing field of high-end equipment, and carry out advanced treatment on the unmanned aerial vehicle and the remote sensing image through computer vision by means of an AI-driven image analysis technology, so that the loess gully landform classification with high precision is realized. The invention not only improves the accuracy and efficiency of image analysis, but also expands the application range of unmanned aerial vehicle and remote sensing technology in loess plateau valley landform research, provides powerful technical support for ecological restoration, emergency disaster relief and the like, and shows important practical value.
assignees: UNIV NINGXIA

title_en: Method for formulating restoration strategy of post-earthquake urban road network emergency rescue stage based on fastest restoration path
abstract_en: The invention provides a post-earthquake urban road network emergency rescue stage restoration strategy formulation method based on a fastest restoration path. According to the method, road repair time of the post-earthquake road network and road repair time of building rubble removal are calculated at two angles, so that medical rescue priority, material transportation priority and the fastest repair path and 'supplementary repair path' comprehensively considering medical rescue and material transportation requirements are determined, and a strategy is formulated for repairing the post-earthquake road network in an emergency rescue stage.
assignees: INST ENG MECH CHINA EARTHQUAKE ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Goaf ecological restoration method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence-based goaf ecological restoration method and system, the method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source remote sensing data and geological investigation data of a goaf, generating a three-dimensional geological damage model of the goaf through a space-time fusion technology, utilizing a deep convolutional neural network to conduct multi-scale feature extraction on the three-dimensional geological damage model to obtain a multi-dimensional ecological feature data set, identifying an ecological fragile area and an instability risk area, outputting an ecological risk level map, conducting parallel processing on the multi-dimensional ecological feature data set to generate an ecological assessment report containing health scores of all ecological subsystems of the goaf, and generating a vegetation-soil/rock-water collaborative restoration strategy by adopting a multi-objective optimization algorithm based on the ecological risk level map and the ecological assessment report. By utilizing the embodiment of the invention, the accurate assessment and collaborative strategy generation of the goaf ecological restoration can be realized, and the scientificity, efficiency and overall ecological benefit of the restoration project are improved.
assignees: ORDOS INSTITUTE OF TECH

title_en: Water data processing method, processing device, user water meter and program product
abstract_en: The application discloses a water consumption data processing method, a water consumption data processing device, a user water meter and a computer program product. According to the method, when the sampling frequency of the water consumption data is increased, the water consumption rule of a user is combined, lossless compression is respectively carried out on the zero-flow water consumption data and the non-zero-flow water consumption data meeting the compression condition, a data packet is formed by packing a compression result, the data packet is uploaded to an upper computer, and water consumption characteristic analysis is carried out after analysis and restoration by the upper computer. In this way, the acquisition capability of the user water meter is not limited by the traditional hardware conditions, is not limited by the low-frequency sampling of tens of minutes, and can realize the high-frequency sampling of seconds or even milliseconds. In the process, the calculation or storage burden of the user water meter is not increased remarkably, the lossless compression is light and efficient, the high-frequency acquisition, the rapid processing and the low-load uploading can be realized under the condition of limited resources, and powerful support is provided for the characteristic analysis of the refined water.
assignees: SHENZHEN TUOAN IOT CO LTD

title_en: Ecological restoration evaluation method and device based on evolution toughness
abstract_en: The application discloses an ecological restoration evaluation method and device based on evolution toughness, and relates to the technical field of ecological restoration evaluation, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining ecological restoration evaluation basic data of a target area, wherein the ecological restoration evaluation basic data comprises ecological disaster restoration data, ecological environment long-term monitoring data and ecological space pattern data; respectively calculating an ecological toughness index, an ecological environment evolution index and an ecological space pattern index, then constructing an evolution toughness evaluation model by adopting a network analysis method, and finally integrating the mutual influence among element clusters by adopting a super matrix weighting algorithm based on the evolution toughness evaluation model to output an evolution ecological toughness evaluation result. The application can integrate complex and various evaluation indexes, comprehensively evaluate ecological restoration from longer time scale and larger space scale, and improve the accuracy of ecological restoration evaluation.
assignees: CHINESE ACAD OF GEOLOGICAL SCIENCES;BEIJING CITY UNIV

title_en: Ammeter historical data restoration method based on multidimensional association relation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ammeter historical data restoration method based on multidimensional association relation, which relates to the technical field of power data management and intelligent restoration, the invention realizes the accuracy and traceability of data restoration by establishing a multisource abnormality type library and an element time-varying degradation model, predefines a plurality of abnormality mode combinations and corresponding restoration strategies aiming at multisource data conflict, locates a fault source through the mode matching of a real-time index and the abnormality type library, the method comprises the steps of selecting reference data by combining historical average deviation rates of a target ammeter and an associated ammeter, avoiding deviation caused by single judgment, determining fault elements of a shunt and an ADC chip aiming at nonlinear degradation, constructing a resistance degradation model and a conversion error model, calculating a theoretical correction value, optimizing a result by a machine learning model trained by historical normal data, and simultaneously storing original readings, model parameters and calculation basis in an associated mode to form a traceable log, so that repair accuracy is guaranteed.
assignees: NANJING TIANSU AUTOMATION CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Ecological protection and restoration climate feasibility demonstration system for mountain wind power plant
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological environment protection, and discloses a system for demonstrating the feasibility of ecological protection and restoration of a wind farm in a mountain area, which comprises a data importing and calculating subsystem and an evaluation data displaying subsystem, wherein the data importing and calculating subsystem comprises a data initializing module, a grid point weather data processing module, a classification factor calculating module and a comprehensive calculating module, and the evaluation data displaying subsystem is a B/S architecture program and comprises a data layer, a logic layer, an interface layer and an application layer and can carry out element distribution and comprehensive evaluation. The dominant effect of meteorological factors on restoration is verified, and particularly water and soil loss caused by heavy rainfall in the construction period is required to be paid attention to. The method provides scientific basis for regional differential restoration strategies, fills the blank of large-scale ecological restoration areas, and has the potential of being popularized to other inland mountain areas.
assignees: HUBEI METEOROLOGICAL SERVICE CENTER HUBEI PROFESSIONAL METEOROLOGICAL SERVICE STATION

title_en: BIM data disaster recovery and restoration method based on domestic cloud computing platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the crossing field of Building Information Model (BIM) technology and cloud computing technology, in particular to a BIM data disaster recovery and recovery method and system based on a domestic cloud computing platform, wherein the system comprises a data acquisition layer, a data preprocessing layer, a data storage layer, a disaster recovery management layer, a recovery execution layer and a user interaction layer which are cooperated; the data acquisition layer acquires project data from BIM software in real time, the data preprocessing layer performs necessary preprocessing operation on the acquired BIM data, the data storage layer is constructed based on a domestic cloud computing platform and provides efficient and reliable data storage service, the disaster recovery management layer is responsible for formulating and executing a data disaster recovery strategy, the recovery execution layer is responsible for quickly recovering the BIM data when needed, and the user interaction layer provides a friendly operation interface.
assignees: CHINA TRANSP INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Deep mining and structured intelligent auditing method and system for high-low voltage power user address data and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power informatization, in particular to a deep mining and structured intelligent auditing method and system for high-low voltage power user address data and a computer readable storage medium, which are used for constructing a three-level closed loop of 'standardized matching-business association-intelligent monitoring', and realizing address standardization by cleaning and weighing multi-source data, formulating power exclusive unified coding and using 'regular fuzzy matching-alias mapping conversion-level membership complement' three-level restoration; setting up an address characteristic-voltage class rule base, establishing address and voltage class association through forward and reverse check, and combining scene hierarchy check and service system coupling to realize intelligent monitoring and closed loop optimization. The invention improves the qualification rate of the address data, reduces the labor cost and realizes the collaborative optimization of data management and business application.
assignees: MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;SHANGHAI BIQIAN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Hydropower station fusion power server and elastic resource management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydropower station fusion power server and an elastic resource management system, which relate to the technical field of automation and intelligent operation and maintenance of electric power systems and comprise a resource state sensing and acquisition module, a key index extraction and quantitative analysis module, an intelligent discrimination and risk identification module, a resource regulation and abnormal driving cleaning module and a resource recovery and node reconstruction module, wherein the resource state sensing and acquisition module is used for acquiring operation data of each computing node and scheduling execution log data information generated by a scheduling platform in real time through a resource state acquisition component deployed in a virtualization management platform. According to the method, the early identification and accurate cleaning of the ghost virtual machine resources are realized through multidimensional sensing and intelligent evaluation, the abnormal exposure is induced by the dynamic regulation and control calculation force threshold value, the node resource state is restored in a self-adaptive mode, an identification-regulation-restoration closed-loop flow is constructed, the calculation force utilization rate and the stability of a dispatching system are improved, and the continuous operation of key business of the hydropower station is ensured.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Self-adaptive management method for groundwater resources
abstract_en: The description discloses a self-adaptive management method of groundwater resources, which comprises the steps of loading historical data and processing time information, calculating annual precipitation to classify and enrich/level/withhold water years, counting seasonal precipitation parameters of each hydrologic year, extracting historical window data to calculate accumulated precipitation, judging precipitation levels by combining hydrologic years and seasons to generate a dynamic strategy containing exploitation/source-supplementing adjustment coefficients, defining decision variables and constraints, initializing an objective function with maximized exploitation efficiency and minimized source-supplementing cost and ecological risk, creating an improved multi-objective evolution algorithm, dynamically adjusting operator parameters, applying intelligent restoration operators and matching with an optimization mechanism, calling a mixed deep learning model to predict water levels, calculating ecological risk and verifying constraints, analyzing Pareto solution sets, setting weight according to hydrologic years to select an optimal scheme and updating system states. The method improves the management adaptability and ensures the scientific and continuous decision making.
assignees: UNIV JILIN

title_en: Frequency domain illumination priori driving non-supervision low-light video enhancement method, system and storage medium for shield slag hole monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a frequency domain illumination priori driving unsupervised low-light video enhancement method, a system and a storage medium for shield slag hole monitoring, which are used for realizing composite noise suppression and basic restoration of a low-light image through a noise suppression module, executing two-dimensional Haer wavelet decomposition on a basic restoration image through a frequency domain illumination priori estimation module, combining a channel-space attention weighting high-low frequency sub-band and fusing to generate frequency domain illumination priori characteristics, completing accurate reconstruction of reflection components through a cross-attention converter unit of a reflection component reconstruction module, generating global index enhancement factors through an illumination enhancement coefficient module to obtain an enhanced image, realizing network unsupervised end-to-end training through gamma conversion branches and multi-dimensional loss constraint, and effectively relieving the problems of overall darkness, detail inundation and serious noise of a shield slag hole monitoring image on the premise of not increasing site continuous illumination burden, and obtaining an enhanced video with balanced brightness, clear detail and controlled overexposure.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY 14TH BUREAU GROUP SHIELD ENG CO LTD

title_en: Cloud communication-based oiling machine remote data management method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of oiling machine data management, in particular to an oiling machine remote data management method and system based on cloud communication. The method comprises the steps of generating a batch data block by a site terminal according to a time threshold packet, executing reversible compression and anchor point insertion, generating batch metadata by taking a hash tree root value as a batch identifier, establishing a safe session with a cloud end when the site terminal is on line and uploading the session according to transaction priority, fountain-framing the data block and the metadata into an optical frame array when the site terminal is off line, broadcasting the optical frame array by a price display screen, acquiring and decoding video of a mobile terminal, and uploading the optical frame array. The cloud end restores the data block based on the reconstruction fragment and the metadata, verifies the integrity by combining frame-level verification and batch identification, writes transaction records and running states into a transaction library and a time sequence library respectively by idempotent deduplication of the site identification and the batch identification, generates a receipt short code synchronous station end, and realizes consistency reconciliation according to batch supplementary transmission according to a missing list after network restoration.
assignees: WENZHOU BLUE SKY ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Enterprise data management system and method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The application provides an enterprise data management system and method based on artificial intelligence, wherein the system comprises a data acquisition module for acquiring enterprise energy consumption data and equipment operation parameters through an interface in a cross-level manner, a data preprocessing module for carrying out anomaly restoration on the energy consumption data by adopting an anomaly detection model and carrying out deletion restoration on the equipment operation parameters by combining a knowledge graph and a filtering algorithm so as to generate an effective data set with a space-time label, a knowledge graph generation module for constructing an ontology model comprising equipment entities, energy media, metering points and process links based on the effective data set, and mining association relations between equipment states and the energy consumption data through a graph neural network so as to generate an energy association knowledge graph, and a management strategy generation module for generating management rules by combining carbon emission data and carrying out root cause analysis based on the energy association knowledge graph so as to generate an enterprise data management strategy and manage the enterprise energy consumption data and the equipment operation parameters accordingly.
assignees: SHANDONG HUAYIYUN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Landslide barrier lake landform utilization and restoration method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide barrier lake landform utilization restoration method, which comprises the steps of carrying out backfill back pressure on a slope foot river channel at the front edge of a landslide, respectively arranging reinforced concrete retaining walls at the two ends of the upper and lower ends of a backfill back pressure area to firmly backfill back pressure area backfill bodies and intercept water coming from the upper stream of a river channel to form a water storage area, arranging reinforced concrete flood discharge sand holes in foundation rocks of a stable mountain outside the landslide area in a linear mode, connecting the inlet end of the flood discharge sand holes with the river channel bank of the upper stream water storage area, connecting the outlet end of the flood discharge sand holes with the bank slope of the lower stream river channel, constructing water pumping stations and pipeline water lifting in a geological stable area of the water storage area, introducing water storage into the landslide area, and carrying out land recycling in the landslide area.
assignees: INST OF GEOLOGY AND NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION GANSU ACADEMY OF SCIENCE

title_en: Analysis method, device, equipment and storage medium for self-repairing tunnel lining
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunnel engineering maintenance and discloses a method, a device and equipment for analyzing self-repairing of tunnel lining and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of collecting real-time monitoring data comprising crack distribution images and stress strain readings through a sensor network, and identifying damage types and severity levels through feature extraction and damage classification models. And retrieving a matched repair material formula generation scheme from a material library, and coupling tunnel environment parameters to simulate a repair process so as to obtain a predictive simulated repair track. And then extracting key control points from the track to make a repair scheduling plan, and dynamically adjusting the plan according to feedback data in actual repair. According to the method, the repair operation is converted from experience judgment to accurate prediction through digital process simulation, and the execution process is dynamically optimized through a closed-loop self-adaptive control mechanism, so that the accurate customization of a repair scheme and the dynamic optimization of the repair operation are realized, and the reliability and consistency of the repair effect are improved.
assignees: SHAANXI COLLEGE COMMUNICATION TECH

title_en: Optimized configuration method for mangrove tree species in pond-returning forest
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of forest breeding and seedling raising, and discloses an optimized configuration method for mangrove tree species in pond-returning and forest returning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a high-precision digital elevation model and tidal hydrologic data, simulating the submerged duration, frequency and flow rate of a global grid unit through a two-dimensional shallow water dynamics model, constructing a multi-factor ecological adaptability evaluation model by combining a mangrove species physiological tolerance database, calculating the adaptability index of each grid to candidate tree species, and establishing a nonlinear density regulation model based on the index to generate an optimal tree species and density configuration diagram of space heterogeneity. The method realizes the accuracy and the intellectualization of mangrove restoration, and remarkably improves the survival rate and the stability of an ecological system.
assignees: HAINAN ACADEMY OF FORESTRY HAINAN MANGROVE RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Photovoltaic data processing method and system based on abnormal scene
abstract_en: The invention provides a photovoltaic data processing method and system based on an abnormal scene, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining an abnormal value in photovoltaic data and setting the abnormal value as a null value; predicting and filling null values in photovoltaic data through a random forest interpolation algorithm, performing correlation analysis on the filled photovoltaic data by using a Pearson correlation analysis method to screen key features, collecting historical features of the photovoltaic data by using a sliding window method, combining the historical features and the key features to form a new data set, constructing an LSTM model, training the LSTM model by using the new data set to obtain a trained LSTM model, and predicting the power generation at the next moment by using the trained LSTM model. The invention combines the LSTM prediction framework of random forest anomaly data restoration and feature optimization, and aims to improve the prediction accuracy of the generated power in an anomaly scene.
assignees: HENAN YUANWANG HECHU ELECTRIC RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;XUJI GROUP CORP;KECHUANG BRANCH OF XUJI GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Evaluation and restoration method for river mouth delta composite water network communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evaluation and restoration method for communication of a river mouth delta composite water network, which is characterized in that a composite water network comprising various elements such as a natural river channel, an artificial channel, a reservoir, a gate dam, a pump station, a wetland and the like and complex connection relations thereof is accurately described, dynamic changes of water flow directions and running states of artificial facilities are dynamically considered, connectivity evaluation of the composite water network under different hydrologic situations and scheduling schemes is realized, customized evaluation indexes for different management targets such as water resource conveying efficiency, ecological gallery effectiveness, pollutant transportation and diffusion capacity, flood storage and drainage capacity and the like are provided, quantitative connectivity evaluation results are generated, and scientific decision support is provided for ecological restoration.
assignees: YELLOW RIVER ENGINEERING CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic treatment method, system and storage medium for agricultural non-point source pollution
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dynamic treatment method for agricultural non-point source pollution. The method comprises the steps of setting an intelligent monitoring network in an agricultural watershed, and monitoring key data in real time through a sensor. The method comprises the steps of utilizing a wireless communication module to transmit data to a central control center for storage and pretreatment, utilizing big data analysis and an artificial intelligent algorithm to deeply analyze the pretreated data, accurately identifying pollution sources and predicting diffusion trend, generating a personalized treatment scheme comprising fertilization and medication guidance, sewage treatment process selection, runoff management measures and the like, dynamically adjusting the treatment scheme according to agricultural production period and climate change, integrating biological restoration, ecological engineering, efficient chemical fertilizer and pesticide preparations and other technical means, constructing a collaborative treatment technical system, realizing accurate and efficient dynamic treatment of agricultural non-point source pollution, improving the quality of agricultural production and promoting sustainable development of agricultural ecology.
assignees: JIANGXI RUIJIE ECOLOGICAL ENV CO LTD

title_en: Offshore housing unit
abstract_en: To solve the problem that it is difficult for residents who cannot live in a house due to an earthquake, a tsunami, a fire, or the like to secure a lodging place for a restoration worker because the residents cannot go to a house with electricity and water while being safe against an aftershock and a tsunami and protecting privacy.SOLUTION: A wooden artificial island is floated on the sea adjacent to the land, a plurality of dwellings are installed on the wooden artificial island, and the wooden artificial island is fixed by setting a concrete guide on the sea adjacent to the land, passing a log connected to the wooden artificial island through the concrete guide, and stopping the wooden artificial island with two wooden stoppers so that the wooden artificial island does not move in the horizontal direction (left, right, front, and back) but can move in the vertical direction to cope with the ebb and flow of the tide.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: HIROTA YUJI

title_en: Soil restoration target dynamic preparation method based on conservation function of protecting underground water source
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of soil remediation, in particular to a soil remediation target dynamic preparation method based on a conservation function of a protected underground water source, which comprises the following steps: and (3) acquiring repair starting points and water level data, identifying a hysteresis period, adjusting boundaries to generate dynamic drawings, extracting a water level gradient and seepage direction sequencing intervention sequence, judging a fluctuation and water stagnation capacity mark regulation section, and setting a repair schedule by superposing concentration and water level trend. According to the invention, a hysteresis relationship is explicitly interfered by extracting a water level inflection point and an infiltration difference value, the boundary response direction is adjusted according to a hysteresis period, the adaptability of a control range is enhanced, an interference priority sequence is constructed by combining a hydraulic gradient and a seepage trend, the restoration efficiency of continuous segments is highlighted, a limit area is judged by utilizing water layer fluctuation and water retention capacity, a concentration regulation position is accurately defined, the water level trend and pollution distribution are overlapped, the restoration frequency and time course are set, and the dynamic coordination of interference identification, boundary adjustment and restoration rhythm is realized.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING NORMAL

title_en: Method for evaluating repairing effect of panel vertical joint water stop structure
abstract_en: The application discloses a panel vertical joint water stop structure restoration effect evaluation method ‌, which comprises the steps of firstly synchronously acquiring surface crack and internal defect data through the cooperative detection of infrared thermal imaging and ultrasonic flaw detection. And (3) carrying out spatial alignment on the point cloud data generated by the three-dimensional laser scanning and the ultrasonic detection result, and establishing a BIM model containing the three-dimensional form of the crack. And (3) simulating an actual engineering environment in a laboratory to perform material accelerated aging, testing key indexes such as elastic recovery rate and the like, evaluating the basal plane state through a temperature and humidity sensor array in a construction stage, performing accurate filling by adopting a six-axis grouting robot, monitoring a curing process by using a synchronous embedded optical fiber sensor, continuously acquiring deformation data by using a distributed optical fiber network after a hydraulic test is combined with climate simulated aging, constructing a comprehensive evaluation model based on mechanical, durability and tightness indexes, and finally optimizing material selection and process parameters through machine learning.
assignees: POWERCHINA KUNMING ENG CORP LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER UPSTREAM HYDROPOWER CO LTD

title_en: Data processing apparatus, data processing method, and data processing program
abstract_en: To provide a data processor, a data processing method, and a program capable of supporting a person in charge of restoration support.SOLUTION: The data processing device includes an input unit that inputs an inquiry from a user involved in disaster recovery, and a processing unit that performs specific processing using a data generation model that generates a predetermined inference result according to the inquiry, and the processing unit performs, as the specific processing, processing of generating a guide corresponding to the inquiry by referring to a database that holds a plurality of pieces of support information for supporting the disaster recovery and providing the generated guide to the user who is an inquiry source when the inquiry is received.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3A
assignees: SOFTBANK GROUP CORP

title_en: Emergency scheduling method and system for electric automobile participating in power restoration of power distribution network
abstract_en: The application relates to an emergency dispatching method and system for an electric vehicle to participate in power restoration of a power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining a quotation interval by checking own cost and estimating opposite side cost, constructing a multi-round price negotiation model of dynamic yield according to a dynamic yield negotiation mechanism, determining a final price, determining a fuzzy reasoning rule according to a state of charge and time flexibility, constructing a fuzzy model of user response will of the electric vehicle, determining user response will, calculating the total discharge capacity of the vehicle, establishing a multi-objective optimization function, and solving to obtain an electric vehicle discharge plan, wherein the optimization targets of the multi-objective optimization function comprise minimum economic loss of a power failure area, maximum user discharge compensation and maximum continuous power supply of important load, and integrating the final price, the user response will and the electric vehicle discharge plan to obtain the emergency dispatching method. The application can realize the benefit balance of the power grid and the user, improve the utilization efficiency of electric automobile resources and obviously reduce the power failure loss.
assignees: UNIV XIAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Intelligent digital power marketing information management method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital electric power marketing information intelligent management method based on the Internet of things, which comprises the steps of reading an RFID electronic tag of a paper marketing information document through RFID equipment, creating a unique document identification code, scanning the paper marketing information document to obtain a scanning image, enhancing the scanning image by using an image restoration algorithm based on a convolutional neural network, generating an electronic marketing information file and an index through OCR (optical character recognition), associating the paper marketing information document, the electronic marketing information file and business data based on the file identification code, constructing a client-marketing information-business data association library, responding to a marketing information inquiry request through an intelligent search engine, recording marketing information operation by using a alliance blockchain network, and generating a tamper-proof log. The invention solves the problems of information island, incomplete paper document information and the like in marketing information management, and realizes the full-flow, high-quality, associated and credible management of marketing information.
assignees: NANYANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Hydraulic engineering full life cycle operation and maintenance management method and platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic engineering full life cycle operation and maintenance management method and a platform, which relate to the technical field of hydraulic engineering management, wherein a weir crest water level Hw, a gate flow Qo, a gate opening and closing pressure Pg, a structure inclination angle Gq and an iron-containing concentration cFe are accurately acquired through a multi-source physical sensing unit, the sensor type, the arrangement position and the acquisition condition corresponding to each parameter are highly matched with the hydraulic engineering operation characteristics, the stability of data sources is ensured, the coverage is wide, and a high-frequency real-time data sensing system is formed. The mechanism breaks through the problem of low parameter reliability in the past, and lays a high-quality data foundation for subsequent operation state modeling and situation map construction. And a structural stability association function constructed based on a water conservancy physical mechanism is introduced as an evaluation index, and abnormal fluctuation in the original data is subjected to sliding window identification and inversion restoration, so that the method is different from a conventional statistical removal method or interpolation filling method, and can utilize the known physical relationship of the system to carry out reasonable tracing correction.
assignees: HENAN WATER PLANNING AND DESIGN RES CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent maintenance system and method for ecological restoration of side slope
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent maintenance system and method for ecological restoration of a side slope, and relates to the technical field of ecological restoration, wherein the intelligent maintenance system comprises a data acquisition module, a sensor array deployed from a road network, and an environment monitoring signal, wherein the environment monitoring signal comprises side slope surface displacement, soil humidity, vegetation coverage and rainfall intensity, an emergency preliminary position and severity description are obtained by fusing multi-source input signals, an event judgment module judges whether an event exceeds a single area processing capability or not by adopting a preset threshold value according to the obtained emergency preliminary position and severity description, and if the event exceeds the single area processing capability, state records and position coordinates of ecological restoration equipment in adjacent areas are extracted from a central database; the intelligent maintenance system and the intelligent maintenance method for the ecological restoration of the side slope have the beneficial effects of intelligent monitoring, rapid response and accurate restoration.

title_en: Desert ecological active restoration collaborative management method based on technology water production
abstract_en: The application relates to a desert ecological active restoration collaborative management method based on technology water production. The method comprises the steps of dividing and generating a plurality of ecological units with similar internal environmental characteristics by adopting a K-means clustering algorithm based on the environmental characteristics of a target area, matching suitable plants for each ecological unit, monitoring the water content of soil and the growth state of the plants at fixed time, dynamically determining the water resource requirements of each unit by combining a preset plant water demand model through time sequence analysis based on monitoring data, generating a cross-unit water resource allocation path by adopting a maximum flow algorithm, and generating and executing a water resource supply scheme by combining the operation parameters of water producing equipment. According to the method, through environmental characteristic clustering, plant water demand dynamic prediction and cross-unit hydraulic network optimization, accurate collaborative supply of water resources in a desert restoration area is realized, and ecological restoration efficiency and resource utilization rate are effectively improved.
assignees: UNIV SHIHEZI

title_en: Intelligent collaborative decision-making method for power distribution system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution systems, in particular to an intelligent collaborative decision-making method of a power distribution system, which comprises the following steps of S1, collecting sampling frequency, uploading delay and data integrity identification of sensing nodes of each subarea, analyzing consistency of an operation data structure, identifying time alignment defects or logic coupling faults and generating a heterogeneous drift characteristic map, S2, reconstructing control input by combining historical data, a topology mechanism and boundary rules to generate a data consistency control input set, and S3, constructing and distributing a collaborative strategy based on the input set, a scheduling target and system constraint to realize intelligent collaborative regulation. According to the invention, by constructing the isomerism drift characteristic map, reconstructing the space-time consistency operation data and generating the collaborative strategy set with self-adaptive execution capacity, the accurate identification, effective restoration and intelligent collaborative regulation and control of the power distribution system under the condition of inconsistent data are realized.
assignees: BEIJING NORTH STAR TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Multi-source data set construction method and system suitable for mining damaged land
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mining damaged lands, in particular to a multi-source data set construction method and system suitable for the mining damaged lands. According to the mining damage land restoration planning method, the earth surface transition characteristics and the geological transition characteristics are extracted from the image data and the geological data of the mining damage area, the earth surface transition characteristics and the geological transition characteristics are input into the deep learning model to predict the ecological restoration evolution condition and the geological disaster hidden danger probability change trend, the classification model is further combined to predict whether the current mining damage area has the classification result of restoration value or not, multi-source data are utilized to provide the user with omnibearing and valuable data display, and the mining damage land with restoration value is further determined from a plurality of mining damage lands according to the classification result whether the current mining damage area has the restoration value or not to carry out restoration planning. The method provides basic support for implementing ecological restoration of mines by utilizing mining waste lands and classifying in regions and promoting comprehensive utilization of resources such as coal gangue, tailings and the like.
assignees: CHINA GEOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT MONITORING INSTITUTE GEOLOGICAL DISASTER TECH GUIDANCE CENTER OF MINIST;TWENTY FIRST CENTURY AEROSPACE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Coal mine waste land partition vegetation configuration method integrating soil and water conservation and biodiversity improvement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for configuring vegetation in a coal mine waste area, which integrates soil and water conservation and biological diversity improvement. Belongs to the field of ecological restoration in abandoned coal mine areas. The method comprehensively utilizes environment multisource data, realizes accurate ecological partition of abandoned land, intelligently screens and configures functional plant communities, optimizes ecological landscape network structures, fuses dynamic feedback and self-adaptive adjustment mechanisms, and monitors and continuously optimizes the repairing process in real time. The invention breaks through the limitation of the traditional restoration means in the aspects of extensive partition, single plant configuration, insufficient landscape connectivity and the like, effectively improves the biodiversity and the stability of an ecological system, reduces the human intervention cost, realizes the efficient and sustainable management of the ecological restoration of the mine abandoned land, and has wide popularization and application values.
assignees: INSTITUTE OF ECOLOGY PROT AND REPAIR CHINESE ACADEMY OF FORESTRY;UNIV BEIJING FORESTRY

title_en: Power failure analysis method for intelligent fusion terminal of transformer area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power failure analysis method for an intelligent fusion terminal of a platform area, which comprises the following steps of step 1, step 2, analyzing power failure events, studying and judging a power failure range and determining a power failure level, step 3, comprehensively judging a fault type, an influence range and a predicted power failure duration by combining the power failure level, the number of influencing users and a historical power failure record, step 4, automatically generating an active first-aid repair work order containing fault positioning coordinates based on a judging result, pushing the active first-aid repair work order to a mobile client, and step 5, monitoring and confirming the power failure events, and generating a power restoration notification completion work order closed loop. The invention realizes real-time accurate sensing of the power failure event of the transformer area and rapid and automatic research and judgment of the faults, shortens the response time of the faults from more than 15 minutes to less than 2 minutes, and achieves the service mode transition from passive repair to active repair.
assignees: QINGDAO TOPSCOMM COMMUNICATION CO LTD;QINGDAO ZHIDIAN NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD;QINGDAO TUOWEI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Backup restoration method and system based on time sequence database
abstract_en: The invention discloses a backup and restore method and a system based on a time sequence database, which belong to the technical field of time sequence databases and comprise full-quantity backup and restore and incremental backup and restore, wherein the full-quantity backup comprises metadata information and stored data information which are all in the time from establishment to current backup execution, and the incremental backup comprises metadata change information and stored data information which are all in the time from last backup to current backup. All the backup and restore operations comprise a plurality of layers, namely an SQL layer, a JOB layer, a metadata layer, a distributed layer and a storage layer, wherein the SQL layer is used for analyzing backup and restore grammar, the JOB layer is used for starting backup and restore tasks, the metadata layer is used for backing up and restoring metadata information of a database/table, the distributed layer is used for sending the backup and restore tasks to each node, and the storage layer is used for acquiring data of a disk. The invention can solve the problem of data migration of the database system, and has better effect on disaster recovery of data, thereby improving the competitiveness of the product.
assignees: SHANGHAI YUNXI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power image processing method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power image processing method, a device, equipment and a medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an original power image, carrying out sensitive target identification on the original power image to obtain a target area set, determining a target mask map based on the target area set and the original power image, and carrying out image desensitization restoration based on the target mask map to obtain a target power image. According to the technical scheme, sensitive information in the electric power image can be accurately identified, and the image with a natural structure and consistent semantics is generated, so that the visual consistency and usability of the target electric power image are ensured.
assignees: BIG DATA CENTER STATE GRID CORP

title_en: Construction method for disaster recovery of river-approaching Gao Douge binded retaining wall foundation undercut
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method for disaster recovery of a river-passing Gao Douge binded retaining wall foundation undercut, and belongs to the technical field of water conservancy and hydropower bank slope water-passing maintenance engineering construction technology. The construction method for disaster recovery of the river Gao Douge binded retaining wall foundation undercut is convenient to construct and operate, and can remarkably improve stability and safety of disaster recovery parts. The construction method comprises the steps of firstly adopting tetrahedral strings to enclose a shoal construction area comprising undercut disaster areas in a high-speed water flow river channel in a dead water period, then erecting concrete casting templates with narrow outside and wide inside in the shoal construction area, then filling block stones in the shoal construction area on two sides of the concrete casting templates, casting cavity concrete of an emptying disaster area based on filling block stones and casting concrete of the block stone filling area, and finally obtaining a temporary Gao Douge bine cage retaining wall restoration foundation comprising tetrahedral string enclosing structures, concrete casting templates, cavity concrete of the emptying disaster area and concrete of the block stone filling area through maintenance.

title_en: Outer elevation closed loop repairing method based on visual network and multi-agent RL
abstract_en: The invention provides an outer elevation closed-loop restoration method based on a visual network and a multi-agent RL, which comprises the steps of defining S1, partitioning and linkage actions, deducing S2, a space-time diagram visual network and a channel, deducing S3, estimating critical time and deducing an executable window, generating and issuing S4, generating and issuing a window-action mask, S5, controlling execution and progress comparison of an event sequence MPC and a disposable executable scheme S6, controlling execution and progress comparison of the multi-agent RL, S7, checking and closing confirmation, locking executable detection before critical evolution of an outer elevation disease of a building, restoring linkage window and action sequence, keeping locking from being damaged by disturbance of environment and channel in the execution process, defining upstream cutting off firstly and downstream sealing later by a channel mechanism, mapping material curing, dew point and weather constraint into action window and forbidden condition, realizing controlled cooperation under the mask constraint by the event sequence MPC and multi-agent reinforcement learning, and achieving the aim of one-time closing before critical evolution of the disease.
assignees: SHANGHAI BAOYE GROUP CORP LTD

title_en: Abnormal node identification system and method based on Fenriver basin ecological restoration
abstract_en: The invention discloses an abnormal node identification system and method based on Fenhe river basin ecological restoration, which relate to the technical field of water area monitoring and solve the problems of simple comparison of index data and standard values which depend on single time points and lack of comprehensive analysis on index time sequence change characteristics; the process converts abstract index fluctuation into quantifiable trend characteristics and curve segments, solves the problem that the pain points which are only dependent on single-point data and are difficult to capture a mutation process in the traditional abnormal period identification, provides clear time direction for tracing abnormal sources, accurately identifies abnormal nodes and traces the sources, can clearly define key areas with poor ecological restoration effects in a river basin, and clearly identifies transmission paths and core sources of abnormal pollution.
assignees: SHANXI INST TECH

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle rescue scheduling optimization method and device based on semantic translation modeling
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle rescue scheduling optimization method and device based on semantic translation modeling, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle emergency rescue intelligent scheduling, comprising the steps of obtaining emergency rescue task description information; the method comprises the steps of converting natural language rules in task description information into standardized constraint expressions, identifying response time targets, coverage area targets, resource parameters and network structure parameters, constructing an initial scheduling model, solving the initial scheduling model through an improved multi-target optimization algorithm to obtain an initial scheduling scheme of the unmanned aerial vehicle, constructing a dynamic re-optimization model by taking the initial scheduling scheme as a disturbance reference when an interference event in the execution process of the initial scheduling scheme is detected, solving the dynamic re-optimization model by taking scheme disturbance cost and arrival delay time as optimization targets, outputting a repair scheduling scheme and an interpretable decision result, and remarkably improving the accuracy, instantaneity and decision reliability of emergency rescue scheduling.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHERN SCI & TECH;PENG CHENG LAB

title_en: Clustering algorithm-based power distribution network line loss restoration calculation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network line loss restoration calculation method and system based on a clustering algorithm. The method comprises the steps of acquiring and processing initial data, including topological structure, distribution transformer accounts, table bottom display number, power, voltage and switch deflection data. And then, identifying the transfer line through a characteristic index extraction and threshold method, and determining the substitution line and the transfer period. Aiming at the line to be diagnosed, a voltage similarity matrix is constructed by utilizing a dynamic time warping algorithm, and a density clustering identification transfer distribution transformer set is adopted. And then, correcting the transfer distribution transformer set and the period of the transfer distribution transformer set by combining the switch segment duty ratio index. And finally, calculating and restoring the contemporaneous line loss of the transfer line and the substitution line according to the optimized data. By implementing the method, the accuracy of the synchronous line loss rate of the transfer line can be improved, and the synchronous line loss rate can be accurately calculated and restored, so that more effective power system management and energy-saving strategy implementation are supported.
assignees: JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST

title_en: Power distribution network medium-voltage power failure fusion research and judgment method and system
abstract_en: A method for judging the medium-voltage power outage of power distribution network includes such steps as collecting multi-source power outage signals, judging the effectiveness of said signals, screening out effective power outage signal set, auxiliary checking, generating power outage event set, generating power outage information list in the power outage range according to the data of equipment account, topology information of electric network, marketing user-to-user relation, distribution transformer and community relation, dividing the power outage event set according to the power outage event type, including whole-line power outage, branch power outage, single distribution transformer power outage and single-medium-voltage user power outage, setting distribution transformer re-power time for power outage distribution transformer in power outage range, and repeating power outage distribution transformer according to conventional power restoration, load negative and overtime negative three-stage progressive power restoration mode. The method can improve the accuracy of middle-voltage power failure research and judgment and the accuracy of positioning the power failure influence range, and greatly shortens the overall time of distribution network fault rush repair.
assignees: NANJING NARI INFORMATION COMM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Quantum encryption-based power system scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system dispatching method and a power system dispatching system based on quantum encryption, which relate to the technical field of power dispatching and comprise the steps of designing a power system dispatching network architecture, determining a dispatching control center and a control node, and carrying out information transmission between the dispatching control center and the control node by adopting a quantum encryption communication link; the method comprises the steps of generating and distributing an encryption key between a dispatching center and each node through a quantum channel, encrypting information and dispatching instructions in the power system, transmitting the encrypted data and dispatching instructions to a target site for restoration, and adjusting operation parameters of the power system to dispatch the power system. The invention effectively reduces the vulnerability of the whole system, enhances the defending capability against external interference, ensures the continuity and efficiency of power grid dispatching, ensures that the power grid can keep stable operation under various conditions, and ensures the real-time performance of signals on the premise of ensuring the accuracy of the signals.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Watershed multi-scale water network optimization scheduling model system based on ecological restoration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a watershed multi-scale water network optimization scheduling model system based on ecological restoration, which relates to the technical field of ecological restoration and comprises the steps of constructing a coupling model and simulating different scheduling situations through data acquisition, hydrologic simulation and hydraulic engineering digitization, establishing a scheduling rule base with ecological flow as a target according to the coupling model, and finally intelligently generating a scheduling scheme based on real-time flow monitoring and rule base to realize the optimization scheduling and ecological guarantee of the watershed water network. The method and the system ensure the downstream ecological flow and repair the aquatic ecological system by constructing the ecological dispatching rule base and monitoring the real-time flow, optimize reservoir dispatching by means of hydrologic simulation and engineering digitization, improve the water resource utilization efficiency, integrate the intelligent decision module to realize quick response and automatic dispatching, provide scientific basis for river basin planning by virtue of multiple conditions Jing Tuiyan, and reduce the test cost and uncertainty.
assignees: SHUIFA PLANNING & DESIGN CO LTD;SHUIFA CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Waste dump oxygen inhibition covering method based on reverse ventilation structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a waste dump oxygen inhibition covering method based on a reverse ventilation structure, which belongs to the technical field of coal gangue disaster prevention and ecological restoration and comprises the steps of carrying out tertiary screening on discarded waste rocks to obtain coarse-grain waste rocks, medium-grain waste rocks and fine-grain waste rocks, sequentially carrying out layered filling and compaction from bottom to top according to the coarse-grain waste rocks, the medium-grain waste rocks and the fine-grain waste rocks obtained by screening to form a reverse ventilation structure with the upper average particle size smaller than the lower average particle size, and after each waste rock layer is paved and compacted, synchronously constructing an oxygen inhibition covering layer matched with the waste rock layer on the surface to form a gradient oxygen inhibition covering system with waste rock layers and covering layers alternately nested. The invention effectively blocks the oxygen diffusion path through the synergistic effect of physical separation, chemical inhibition, structure regulation and dynamic management, solves the technical problem of spontaneous combustion caused by oxygen permeation of the waste dump, and combines ecological restoration and long-term stability.

title_en: Super real-time electric power carbon footprint metering system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a super-real-time electric power carbon footprint metering system, relates to the technical field of electric power system carbon emission metering, and solves the problems that an existing system is difficult to adapt to wind-solar second-level fluctuation, dynamic topology of a power grid, poor in instantaneity, low in accuracy, high in link delay and difficult to meet the requirements of a novel power grid and spot electric power markets. The system comprises a data acquisition module for synchronously acquiring four types of data in second level, a data processing module for completing data restoration and the like within 50ms and outputting a clean tensor, a model module for generating a carbon factor sequence meeting physical constraint by end-to-end frame parallel prediction, and an application module for realizing monitoring and early warning, wherein the overall delay is less than 1s. The system completes multi-scale parallel prediction in a single GPU through zero-copy transmission and three-level self-healing processes, can realize super-real-time metering, high-accuracy carbon factor output and continuous stable operation, and effectively supports efficient operation of a novel power system and the spot market.
assignees: MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Power emergency communication recovery method and related device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power systems, and discloses a power emergency communication recovery method and a related device, wherein communication nodes corresponding to power key recovery nodes are identified based on a node coupling correlation model of a power network and a communication network to form nodes to be analyzed; the power service communication links taking the nodes as starting points are traced back to construct a communication node set to be recovered, the recovery importance of each node in the set is calculated, the importance is obtained by weighted superposition of three indexes of coupling association strength, bearing service value and network hub attribute, and the recovery priority of each communication node is determined by the recovery importance and hierarchical recovery is executed. By accurately identifying the communication nodes strongly related to the key loads of the power grid and quantitatively evaluating the recovery values of the communication nodes, a layered recovery strategy with definite priority is formed, limited emergency resources are guided to be accurately focused towards the core communication nodes, the problem that resource allocation and recovery effects are disjointed in the traditional strategy is solved, and the pertinence and the overall efficiency of power emergency communication recovery are improved.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power distribution network power supply restoration optimization method and system considering micro-grid and voltage regulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power supply restoration optimization method and a power supply restoration optimization system for a power distribution network taking micro-grid and voltage regulation into consideration, and relates to the technical field of optimization management of power systems, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting data of the micro-grid and voltage regulation equipment and preprocessing the data; and modeling the active power distribution network power supply restoration model taking the micro-grid and the voltage regulating equipment into consideration by using a mathematical modeling language AMPL, solving by using a CPLEX solver and outputting a result. The invention considers the reality of the distribution system structure, has flexible application and accurate result, accelerates the solving efficiency of the power supply recovery model, and ensures the convergence optimality through classical optimization technology. From the analysis of the results, a power restoration strategy for the active power distribution network may be defined. The method can ensure that each part of the system presents a radial topological structure and allows the part to keep in a power-off state so that other parts can be restored.
assignees: KUNMING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Simulation method for dynamically fusing multisource meteorological data into wind farm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wind energy development and utilization, in particular to a simulation method for dynamically fusing multisource meteorological data into a wind farm, which comprises the steps of accessing satellite remote sensing, ground station measurement, numerical forecasting and wind farm historical operation data, and outputting standardized meteorological data through format analysis, standardized processing and cleaning; the method comprises the steps of calculating reliability scores based on multidimensional indexes such as data integrity, time consistency and the like, realizing abnormal data restoration or standby data source switching, combining wind power plant DEM topographic features and self-adaptive sliding windows, adjusting data source weights in real time through reinforcement learning to generate dynamic weight values, improving Windpowerlib framework adaptation fusion data, dynamically configuring fan parameters to generate initial simulation results, collecting wind power plant real-time data, and correcting model parameters through Kalman filtering. The wind power plant simulation method and the wind power plant simulation system can improve the simulation precision and timeliness of the wind power plant, enhance the data utilization rate and the model suitability, and reduce the deviation between the simulation result and the actual working condition.
assignees: POWERCHINA BEIJING ENG CORP LTD

title_en: Method for constructing erosion shoreline active coast
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a coast with erosion shoreline activity, and relates to the technical field of ecological restoration, development and utilization of coastal zones. The mode systematically provides four technical modes of green ports, fishing light complementation, ecological seawalls and healthy beaches aiming at different coast types. The ecological engineering construction technology is characterized in that a series of natural-based solutions such as a permeable platform, ecological concrete, an artificial fish reef, a suspension rope type photovoltaic bracket, a flexible sand dune sea wall, an artificial oyster reef, a vegetation protection belt, maintenance and sand supplementing are adopted to ecologically reform or replace the traditional hard engineering. The invention aims to solve the contradiction between coast development and ecological protection, and realizes the aims of disaster prevention and reduction, resource development and ecological system integrity maintenance cooperatively by repairing and enhancing the functions of the natural coast, thereby effectively improving the comprehensive toughness and sustainable development capability of the coastal zone.
assignees: CHINA DESIGN GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Port environment detection system based on Internet of things technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of port environment detection, in particular to a port environment detection system based on the Internet of things technology, which comprises a wind flow driving type environment perception modeling module, a dynamic disturbance perception and correction module, a power supply priority and communication window dynamic regulation strategy, wherein the wind flow driving type environment perception modeling module is used for acquiring data such as wind speed, air pressure and particle concentration and constructing a wind disturbance correction map, the dynamic disturbance perception and correction module is used for identifying an abnormal area based on a wind disturbance mapping function and correcting the abnormal area to output a dynamic environment state set containing trust weight and risk factors, and the power supply priority and communication window dynamic regulation strategy is generated by combining wind power energy storage states through a power induction fusion scheduling decision module, so that power induction coupling scheduling is realized. According to the invention, through wind disturbance correction modeling, dynamic data deviation correction and energy sense fusion scheduling, high-reliability acquisition, intelligent restoration and resource optimization configuration of port environment monitoring data are realized, and the monitoring precision and self-adaptive capacity of the system are remarkably improved.
assignees: Maanshan port group co ltd

title_en: Method for studying, judging and verifying power failure recovery of meter box
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of meter box power failure recovery, in particular to a method for studying, judging and verifying the meter box power failure recovery. The method comprises the following steps of S1, judging the power failure of the meter box, S2, judging the power restoration of the meter box, S3, verifying the power failure of the meter box, S4, and verifying the power restoration of the meter box. The method and the system have the advantages that the primary station processes the power failure event reported for the first time to avoid redundant interference, the marketing in-transit flow is judged to exclude non-real scenes, in addition, the voltage threshold value and the layering confirmation mechanism are combined, the power failure studying and judging accuracy is guaranteed, the time and data double-dimensional verification mechanism is formed, the special studying and judging of the photovoltaic meter box containing the distribution can be indirectly deduced through the load recovery proportion, the scene that the equipment failure is not reported is covered, the power failure and the duplicate verification form the closed loop logic of event triggering-data verification-state confirmation respectively, the actual recovery of event authenticity and power grid state is guaranteed, meanwhile, the information storage pushing forms a complete closed loop, and the tracing and cooperative processing are facilitated.
assignees: WEIHAI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Energy storage control method of energy storage system based on cloud edge cooperation and energy storage system
abstract_en: The application discloses an energy storage control method and an energy storage system based on cloud edge cooperation. The method comprises the steps of generating first energy storage control information of energy storage equipment through a cloud server, wherein the energy storage control information is used for indicating and controlling the energy storage equipment to execute corresponding power charging and discharging operation, controlling the energy storage equipment to conduct electric energy ownership transfer and control on the energy storage equipment to conduct electric energy scheduling on the energy storage equipment, responding to network connection interruption between the cloud server and an edge end controller, generating second energy storage control information of the energy storage equipment through the edge end controller, responding to network connection interruption restoration between the cloud server and the edge end controller, and restoring to use the cloud server to generate new first energy storage control information. The scheme of the application can enable the energy storage system to have self-running capability when communication is interrupted, and realize energy efficiency optimization and system robustness of the system.
assignees: SHENZHEN HELLO TECH ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Method and medium for calculating reverse compensation electric quantity for three-phase user
