abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a medium for calculating the reverse and complementary electric quantity of a three-phase user, and relates to the technical field of electric quantity reduction. The method comprises the steps of calculating three-phase unbalance of a user based on acquired electric energy consumption data, judging whether a power restoration quantity condition is met according to the three-phase unbalance, if not, carrying out power restoration, if so, calculating to obtain a balance correction coefficient according to the acquired user type and the three-phase unbalance, calculating to obtain total power consumption of an abnormal phase of the electric energy meter during a fault period based on the balance correction coefficient, metering data and the wiring type of the electric energy meter, and calculating to obtain the power restoration quantity of the three-phase user according to the total power consumption and the metering data of the abnormal phase of the electric energy meter during the fault period. According to the invention, the three-phase unbalance degree is introduced as an applicability criterion, and different user types and wiring modes are combined to design a differential processing strategy, so that the adaptability and accuracy of the calculation method are remarkably improved.
assignees: JIANGSU FANGTIAN POWER TECH CO

title_en: Intelligent protection device for forest breeding in ecological restoration of geological disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent protection device for wood breeding in ecological restoration of geological disasters, which relates to the technical field of ecological environment management and comprises a multidirectional impact-resistant base, a rotary connecting device, a plurality of anchoring mechanisms, a control adjusting device, a dynamic protection device, an auxiliary adjusting device and a control adjusting device, wherein the multidirectional impact-resistant base is horizontally arranged and fixed in a soil layer, wood seedlings are planted in the middle of the soil layer, the rotary connecting device is fixed at the top of the multidirectional impact-resistant base, the anchoring mechanisms are annularly distributed and provided with a plurality of anchoring mechanisms, the anchoring mechanisms are fixed at the outer side of the rotary connecting device and correspond to the vertexes of the multidirectional impact-resistant base, the control adjusting device is fixed at the top of the rotary connecting device, the dynamic protection device is fixed on the control adjusting device, and the auxiliary adjusting device is movably arranged at the top of the dynamic protection device and is fixedly connected with the control adjusting device through a telescopic arc plate. The intelligent impact-resistant protection device disclosed by the invention realizes intelligent impact-resistant protection under the complex terrain and dynamic geological conditions of the geological disaster area, simultaneously has an ecological restoration function, and remarkably improves the protection effect and ecological benefit of forest breeding in a geological disaster scene.
assignees: HENAN PROVINCE NATURAL RESOURCES MONITORING AND STATE SOIL REGULATION INST

title_en: Side slope supporting device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of slope support, in particular to a slope support device, which aims at solving the problems that the prior device cannot enhance the stability and safety of a slope, so that disasters such as landslide and falling rocks can occur and the ecological restoration of the slope is reduced, and the utility model provides a scheme that the slope support device comprises a slope, wherein the surface of the slope is provided with a plurality of planting areas, and a plurality of drainage ditches are arranged on the periphery of the planting areas; the device comprises a slope, a protection component and an isolation component, wherein the protection component is arranged on the slope and used for preventing the surface of the slope from sliding, and the isolation component is arranged on the slope and used for isolating and protecting falling rocks on the isolation component. According to the utility model, through the combination of the protection component and the isolation component, the stability and the safety of the side slope are obviously enhanced, the occurrence of disasters such as landslide, falling rocks and the like is effectively prevented, the ecological restoration of the side slope is promoted, and the dual aims of side slope protection and ecological management are realized.
assignees: ZHANG LEI

title_en: Unified optimization method for physical toughness and operation configuration of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a unified optimization method for physical toughness and operation configuration of an electric power system, which comprises the following steps of establishing a double-layer computing framework comprising an upper-layer electric network physical system model and a lower-layer energy community model, generating a random scene set and a robust uncertainty set, executing a numerical optimization process under a two-stage random-robust hybrid optimization framework, determining physical topology reinforcing parameters in a long-term planning stage, determining physical repair scheduling parameters in a short-term operation stage, carrying out mathematical coupling on the two stages through technical constraint, and converging and solving the unified optimization process. According to the invention, when a planning decision of long-term physical topology reinforcement is made, a power grid operator can consider physical toughness constraint and economic cost of coupling short-term emergency repair scheduling under worst-case attack, so that an engineering decision scheme with the highest physical security level and optimal economic benefit is output.
assignees: UNIV WUHAN TECH

title_en: Power distribution network fault rush-repair scheduling method, system, terminal and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a power distribution network fault rush-repair scheduling method, a system, a terminal and a medium, which belong to the technical field of power distribution network fault treatment, wherein the rush-repair scheduling method comprises the steps of obtaining the number of fault points, judging whether the number of the fault points is not less than 2, obtaining actual index information of sub-indexes corresponding to each fault point if the number of the fault points is not less than 2, determining the dimension of the sub-index corresponding to each fault point according to a pre-constructed three-dimensional rush-repair urgency evaluation matrix, obtaining a corresponding urgency total score according to the actual index information corresponding to each fault point and the dimension of the sub-index, generating a fault treatment priority according to the urgency total score of each fault point, and generating a rush-repair scheduling plan according to the fault treatment priority;    The application has the beneficial effects of realizing multidimensional and dynamic fault repair scheduling so as to improve the repair efficiency.
assignees: SHANDONG DENENG IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Watershed ecological restoration measure configuration optimization method based on multi-objective cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a watershed ecological restoration measure configuration optimization method based on multi-objective coordination, which is used for respectively calculating water storage benefits, ecological restoration measure corrosion reduction benefits and watershed different ecological restoration measures pollution reduction benefits of watershed different ecological restoration measures according to basic data; and solving and optimizing the multi-objective constraint condition by using an NSGA-II optimization algorithm to obtain a Pareto front of an optimized solution. The optimization method not only reserves the calculation stability of a mature optimization algorithm, but also remarkably improves the simulation efficiency and the result precision, and can effectively avoid the problems of large simulation deviation and low convergence speed in the traditional method through the verification of actual river basin data.
assignees: UNIV XIAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Ecological restoration method and system for power transmission and transformation engineering line in stone mountain area
abstract_en: The invention provides an ecological restoration method and system for a power transmission and transformation project in a rocky mountain area, wherein a target area is divided into a core protection area, a side slope disturbance area and a project line restoration area based on unmanned aerial vehicle aerial survey and ground actual measurement results, so that a partition basis is provided for soil pertinence enhancement and vegetation type determination, a soil enhancement strategy is determined based on area characteristics of the core protection area, the side slope disturbance area and the project line restoration area, physical and chemical properties of soil in the rocky mountain area can be remarkably improved, an adaptation environment is provided for follow-up vegetation rooting and growing, after soil enhancement is completed, a directional planting strategy for vegetation types in the target area is determined based on monitoring data of the target area, a planting strategy is definitely designed by combining engineering line requirements, and the core contradiction between vegetation height and root depth can be controlled pertinently, and ecological restoration and power transmission and transformation safety is solved from a source.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Underground reservoir method for cooperatively storing carbon dioxide and fluoride by high-alkalinity mine water and fly ash
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for cooperatively sealing and storing carbon dioxide and fluoride in high-alkalinity mine water and fly ash in an underground reservoir, which relates to the technical fields of environmental engineering, carbon capture and utilization, sealing and ecological restoration in mining areas, and comprises the following steps: in a coal-electricity integrated park, selecting a abandoned coal mine goaf which is stable in structure, has a waterproof top plate and a waterproof bottom plate and has a buried depth of 200-800m as an underground reservoir, and performing impermeable curtain reinforcement treatment on the underground reservoir by adopting a cement slurry grouting process to form a closed isolation space. The underground reservoir method for cooperatively storing carbon dioxide and fluoride by high-alkalinity mine water and fly ash realizes the cooperative coupling of five resources of CO2, fly ash, coal gangue, high-fluorine high-alkalinity mine water and abandoned goaf for the first time, synchronously solves four problems of carbon emission, solid waste storage, water pollution and geological disasters, and forms a closed loop system of waste recycling, pollutant storage and geological environment restoration.
assignees: ZHONGGUANCUN ZHIZHEN ENVIRONMENTAL PROT CO LTD

title_en: Regional ecological restoration effect evaluation system is renovated in soil and land space based on big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of national space ecological restoration, and discloses a national space remediation area ecological restoration effect evaluation system based on big data. The system continuously captures ecological restoration original monitoring data through a multi-source ecological data acquisition engine to form a multi-source ecological data stream. And the space-time serialization processor performs serialization recombination and standardization conversion on the data stream according to the time dimension and the space dimension to generate an ecological parameter sequence with unified space-time reference. The ecological association network constructor analyzes the ecological elements in the sequence and constructs an ecological association network of the interaction relationship among the elements. The repair path digger extracts a plurality of potential repair paths from the network, performs path fusion and optimization, and generates a repair path set. The dynamic evaluation generator calculates and outputs an ecological restoration effect evaluation index based on the path set and the real-time ecological state data. The system realizes dynamic and accurate evaluation of ecological restoration effect.
assignees: ZHANG ZHIQIANG

title_en: Post-disaster power distribution network power restoration method based on satellite communication vehicle scheduling
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power supply restoration of post-disaster power distribution networks, and particularly relates to a post-disaster power distribution network power supply restoration method based on satellite communication vehicle scheduling. The method comprises the steps of scheduling a satellite communication vehicle to move in a power distribution network area, switching communication gears according to load requirements, activating one type of load and two types of load through the communication coverage area of the satellite communication vehicle, constructing a daily front scheduling model aiming at the minimum daily running cost of the power distribution network after disaster, processing nonlinear constraint by adopting a self-adaptive piecewise linearization method to solve the daily front scheduling model, and controlling the moving path, gear switching and load activation strategy of the satellite communication vehicle according to the solving result of the daily front scheduling model. The invention flexibly activates the load through the satellite communication vehicle, improves the toughness of the system, optimizes the utilization of communication resources by distinguishing the load types, reduces the total operation cost of the system and improves the recovery efficiency of power supply after disaster.
assignees: UNIV ZHENGZHOU

title_en: Intelligent prediction and restoration decision method and system for soil erosion
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent prediction and restoration decision method and system for soil erosion, which relate to the technical field of ecological environment monitoring and restoration and comprise the steps of realizing dynamic updating and refinement of land utilization classification data by constructing a multi-source data space-time coupled database; the method comprises the steps of constructing a soil erosion prediction model based on a neural network model and based on classification guidance of land use, combining sensor data time correction and trend fusion analysis, improving erosion strength prediction accuracy, and simultaneously, constructing a land use type-erosion risk-repair strategy knowledge base, generating a differential repair scheme and carrying out risk early warning. According to the application, through multi-source data fusion and intelligent model application, the full-flow management from dynamic prediction to accurate restoration of soil erosion is realized, the error rate of a restoration scheme is reduced, and scientific support is provided for a ecological restoration decision.
assignees: KUNMING COMPREHENSIVE SURVEY CENTER CHINA GEOLOGICAL SURVEY

title_en: Accurate restoration method for degraded poplar stand
abstract_en: The invention discloses a precise repair method of poplar degraded stand, which relates to the technical field of poplar degraded stand repair and comprises the steps of obtaining a multi-temporal satellite remote sensing image and an unmanned aerial vehicle multi-spectral image of a target area, combining soil moisture content, rhizosphere respiration rate and microclimate data collected by ground Internet of things sensing nodes arranged in the forest, carrying out geographic coordinate registration and time sequence alignment on the data to form a multi-source observation data set, extracting vegetation index, shortwave infrared reflectivity, soil moisture and rhizosphere physiological parameters based on the multi-source observation data set, constructing degradation diagnosis indexes integrating spectral change, water stress and root system activity, calculating degradation degree of each pixel, generating a degradation grade spatial distribution map, determining an area with the degradation degree reaching a set threshold value as a to-be-repaired area, selecting a representative poplar individual in the to-be-repaired area, measuring photosynthetic capacity and calculating individual competition strength by combining three-dimensional point cloud data.
assignees: JIULIANGWA FOREST FARM SHANXI SANGGANHE YANGSHU FENGCHAN EXPERIMENTAL BUREAU

title_en: Automatic operation and maintenance method and system suitable for closed system
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic operation and maintenance method and system suitable for a closed system. The method aims to solve the technical problem that the traditional operation and maintenance scheme is difficult to apply due to network isolation and sample scarcity in closed environments such as finance, energy sources and the like. The method comprises the steps of generating unique and traceable migration identifications for all operation and maintenance data, models and reasoning results through a data and migration treatment module, quantitatively calculating migration scores between a source domain and a target domain through a migration evaluation module, dynamically selecting an optimal model migration strategy according to the migration scores to achieve efficient self-adaptation of the models, executing closed-loop operation and maintenance through a multi-agent cooperation system comprising detection, diagnosis and restoration agents, and achieving self-learning and self-optimization of the system through small sample active learning and knowledge base evolution mechanisms. The invention realizes the rapid construction, continuous evolution and whole process traceability of the artificial intelligence operation and maintenance capability in the closed system, and has remarkable innovation and industrial application value.

title_en: Ecological restoration system for habitat of buffer area of river and gulf
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a habitat ecological restoration system of a buffer area of a warehouse river bay, which comprises the warehouse river bay and river banks arranged on two sides of the warehouse river bay, wherein a river bed is arranged on one side of the river bank, which is close to the center of the warehouse river bay, a plurality of river dams are arranged on one side of the river bed and the other river bank, which is close to the center of the warehouse river bay, floating beds are arranged in the river bed and on the downstream of the river dam, and aquatic plants are planted on the periphery of the river bed and the river dam. The ground ecological restoration system can achieve the purposes of effectively improving the biodiversity of the buffer area of the reservoir and river, restoring the habitat, preventing the disaster caused by heavy rain and reducing the peak value of flood peak.
assignees: URBAN PLANNING & DESIGN INST CO LTD OF SHENZHEN

title_en: Cluster electric automobile regulation and control method and device
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a cluster electric automobile regulation and control method and device. The method comprises the steps of collecting departure time, return time and vehicle transfer probability data of electric vehicles in an electric vehicle cluster in a preset area, generating an electric vehicle travel chain based on a Meng Daka method, collecting charging and discharging behaviors of the electric vehicles, carrying out emergency power supply response potential evaluation based on the electric vehicles of the cluster, generating an emergency power supply response potential evaluation result, establishing a power equation for recovering power supplied by the electric vehicle cluster support step by step under an emergency condition, screening the electric vehicles participating in scheduling according to the power equation for recovering the power supplied by the electric vehicle cluster support step by step, and generating an optimal scheduling strategy based on a particle swarm optimization algorithm with the aim of minimizing total loss of whole power loss. The method and the device realize comprehensive consideration of the load recovery priority and the electric vehicle dispatching priority, and are an optimized solution for emergency power supply of the electric vehicle.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Power supply recovery analysis method for active power distribution network source network load storage synergy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power restoration analysis method of active power distribution network load storage synergy, which comprises the following steps of S1, respectively constructing a distributed power supply model, an energy storage device model and a load characteristic model, S2, constructing a source storage combined output model based on the distributed power supply model and the energy storage device model, S3, determining a priority power supply load based on the load characteristic model, S4, forming an island network by using a distributed power supply after failure, restoring important load power supply, S5, constructing a power distribution network fault restoration model, optimizing by using a genetic algorithm, restoring and reconstructing other power loss loads, and carrying out power restoration in two stages.
assignees: XUCHANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power distribution network dynamic scheduling method considering restoring force lifting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic scheduling method of a power distribution network considering restoration force improvement, which relates to the field of electric power sources and comprises the steps of firstly considering the influence of extreme events on a traffic network, establishing a mobile energy storage space-time dynamic scheduling model under a fault state, secondly considering the dynamic scheduling potential of a data center in the communication network under the extreme events, establishing a data center data load space-time flexibility transfer model, further establishing a dynamic optimization model of the power distribution network based on the model by taking the minimum load shedding cost of the power distribution network, the mobile energy storage scheduling cost, the running cost of the data center and the distributed photovoltaic light rejection cost as objective functions, improving the restoration force of the power distribution network after disaster through the dynamic scheduling of the mobile energy storage and the data load, and finally verifying the rationality and the economical efficiency of the dynamic optimization model of the power distribution network by an example system. The invention can improve the elastic response capability and the quick recovery capability of the power distribution network to extreme events.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Reliability evaluation method, system, equipment and storage medium for active power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reliability evaluation method, a system, equipment and a storage medium of an active power distribution network, which are applied to the technical field of power, and the method comprises the steps of obtaining topological structure data of a target active power distribution network and fault influence data of all power utilization elements on a user side in the target active power distribution network, performing simulated overhaul processing on a plurality of first power utilization elements by using a graph traversal technology based on the topological structure data to obtain a plurality of overhaul power outage matrixes, performing simulated isolation processing on a plurality of second power utilization elements by using the graph traversal technology to obtain a plurality of isolation power outage matrixes, inputting the overhaul power outage matrixes and the isolation power outage matrixes into a power outage restoration relation to obtain power outage restoration data, and processing the power outage restoration data by taking time sequence output of the target active power distribution network as constraint to generate a reliability evaluation result corresponding to the target active power distribution network. The method provided by the invention can realize the effect of accurately and quantitatively evaluating the toughness of the power distribution network.
assignees: STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECHNOLOGICAL RESEARCH INST CO LTD;ECONOMIC AND TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Data-driven path selection and dynamic feedback expressway traffic volume prediction method
abstract_en: S1, multi-source data fusion and management, S2, multi-model fusion path selection probability calculation, S3, dynamic flow distribution based on path resistance iteration, S4, data-driven path resistance calculation and dynamic feedback, and the invention can comprehensively acquire traffic flow information, weather information and the like running on a highway network based on highway toll stations, toll gate running water data and weather data fusion analysis, thereby realizing characteristic construction of all factors affected by path selection; and finally, combining the flow iterative dynamic distribution model to realize the high-precision dynamic restoration of the charging OD data into the road traffic flow state with road section level and high time resolution, and providing reliable basic data for traffic planning, engineering item current period decision, emergency management, real-time induction and the like.
assignees: GUANGZHOU TRANSPORTATION RESEARCH INST CO LTD;GUANGZHOU COMMUNICATION INVEST GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Ecological restoration method for mountain highway gangue side slope
abstract_en: The application provides an ecological restoration method for a mountain highway gangue side slope, which comprises the steps of obtaining real-time monitoring data from the gangue side slope through a sensor network, obtaining an initial feature set, carrying out preliminary grouping on the side slope according to the initial feature set by adopting a clustering analysis method, determining a classification standard threshold value, obtaining feedback data in a restoration implementation process, comparing the feedback data with the preliminary grouping, judging the deviation degree of an effect, updating the classification standard threshold value through a regression analysis model if the deviation of the effect exceeds a preset threshold value, obtaining an adjusted classification system, extracting a corresponding restoration scheme template from a database aiming at the adjusted classification system, generating an optimization scheme version, carrying out virtual test on the optimization scheme version through an analog simulation module, obtaining a prediction effect index, collecting subsequent monitoring data according to final execution parameters, carrying out iterative comparison with the prediction effect index, and obtaining a further adjustment signal.
assignees: GUIZHOU JIAOTONG VOCATIONAL UNIV

title_en: Method for studying, judging and verifying power failure recovery of meter
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power failure recovery maintenance, in particular to a method for researching, judging and verifying meter power failure recovery. The method comprises the following steps of S1, judging power failure, S2, judging power restoration, S3, judging whether a low-voltage branch line where a meter is located is powered off by a main station, judging whether an intelligent measuring switch in a meter box reports power failure or whether at least 1 meter reports power failure/power restoration events, S4, preliminarily confirming that the power failure event is met, S5, preliminarily confirming that the power restoration event is met, S6, judging whether a marketing process exists in the terminal on the same day by the main station, S7, packaging power failure/power restoration event information of a branch line and pushing the power failure/power restoration event information to an external system, S8, starting power restoration completion judging, S9, immediately judging whether the phase A voltage is normal after a next acquisition period of a power failure power restoration station area, a branch and a meter. According to the invention, through multi-dimensional and staged logic judgment, the false alarm of a single meter is avoided, the planned power outage interference is eliminated, and the power outage duplicate judgment is more accurate and scientific.
assignees: WEIHAI POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Technology for repairing ecological landscape of common graves ying in mountain park
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological landscape restoration, in particular to a mountain park common object ying community ecological landscape restoration technology which comprises the steps of acquiring relevant data of a mountain park common object ying community and surrounding mountain areas through a topography maintenance and geological survey technology, excavating and arranging mountain terrains after the mountain common object ying community is excavated and moved outside, arranging a flood discharge channel to be connected with a landscape, economically and adaptively arranging retaining walls with corresponding heights and types, planting different plant varieties according to the difference of ecological restoration habits, wherein the restoration technology is based on water and soil conservation, and avoids the ecological restoration of the mountain common object ying community developed on the ecological restoration level of a ground disaster, thereby effectively avoiding the problems of instability of a mountain surface layer and damage to surrounding municipal facilities due to overflow of the surface runoff in a heavy rain season caused by the excavation and the outside of the common object ying community, and forming an excellent ecological environment restoration effect while preventing and controlling the mountain water and soil conservation through selection and multidimensional planting of ecological vegetation on the change of the season.
assignees: FUZHOU PLANNING DESIGN & RESEARCH INST GROUP CO LTD

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: This system includes a means for collecting data in real time, a means for analyzing the collected data and predicting a disaster, a means for analyzing a state of damage, a means for proposing an optimum countermeasure plan for relief and restoration, a means for providing necessary information, and a means for proposing an optimum moving route.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: SOFTBANK GROUP CORP

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: The system includes a means for acquiring position information, a means for collecting damage conditions when a disaster occurs, a means for transmitting the collected position information and damage conditions, a means for analyzing the transmitted position information and damage conditions to select an optimum restoration solution, and a means for notifying a person in charge of disaster response of the analysis result and the selected restoration solution.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: SOFTBANK GROUP CORP

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: The system includes means for collecting information related to a disaster from social media, means for identifying an important base station from the collected information, means for calculating a priority of a base station based on the identified important base station, and means for generating a restoration plan of the base station based on the priority.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: SOFTBANK GROUP CORP

title_en: Source network load storage collaborative transaction decision support system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of operation and control of power systems, in particular to a source network load storage collaborative transaction decision support system; the technical scheme is that the collaborative transaction decision support system comprises a panoramic monitoring and data fusion module, a multi-time space scale prediction module, a collaborative optimization and game decision module, a transaction strategy management and execution module, a real-time coordination and control module and a simulation deduction and risk assessment module; according to the invention, through constructing the panoramic monitoring and data fusion module, the whole-flow closed-loop management from a data source to high-quality information output is realized, the module breaks barriers among systems through the multi-source data acquisition unit, the indifferent access to source, network, lotus and storage all-link heterogeneous data is realized, the data cleaning and reduction unit extracts massive original data, and the data impurity is removed through systematic abnormal recognition, restoration and standardization treatment, so that the data quality is remarkably improved.
assignees: HUANENG JILIN ENERGY SALES CO LTD

title_en: Park electric data privacy protection and restoration device and method based on space-time federal hidden feature learning
abstract_en: The application discloses a park electric power data privacy protection and restoration device and method based on space-time federal hidden characteristic learning in the field of incomplete electric power data restoration of a power grid. The device comprises a server and a plurality of client devices, wherein the client devices particularly comprise a space-time feature extraction module and a power data module, the power data module particularly comprises a space-time feature correlation matrix storage unit and other client hidden feature vector storage units in the same park, and the method comprises the steps of explicitly and structurally integrating the power data hidden features into a model by constructing a space Laplace matrix and a time difference matrix, so that higher power data recovery precision is obtained. The application solves the problem that the prior art is difficult to use priori knowledge to cause the limitation of the performance in the data recovery, can ensure the accurate realization of the power data recovery under the privacy protection, and effectively improves the recovery precision.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH

title_en: Power distribution network rush-repair and recovery method and system considering multi-source cooperation and incomplete fault information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network rush-repair and restoration method considering multi-source synergy and incomplete fault information, which comprises the steps of 1, establishing an objective function of an upper layer model by minimizing the sum of repair completion time of all faults in a least unfavorable fault scene, 2, establishing rush-repair team scheduling constraint considering the fault scene, 3, establishing distributed robust constraint of fault scene probability, 4, converting the upper layer model into a single-layer minimization problem by utilizing a dual theory, 5, establishing an objective function of a lower layer model by taking the maximized weighted load restoration amount and the minimized network loss as targets, 6, comprehensively considering generator constraint, radial constraint, energy storage constraint, wind-driven photovoltaic constraint, mobile power generation car constraint and power distribution network flow constraint, establishing power distribution network operation constraint, 7, solving the power distribution network rush-repair and restoration double-layer model, and obtaining a power distribution network rush-repair and restoration scheme. The invention considers incomplete fault information and multisource collaborative optimization, is beneficial to accelerating load recovery, reduces power failure loss and improves the toughness of the power distribution network.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RESEARCH INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV HEFEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Method, device, equipment, medium and product for determining post-disaster power system restoration scheme
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment, a medium and a product for determining a post-disaster power system restoration scheme, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a virtual power plant node model, post-disaster traffic topology and communication constraint of a post-disaster power system; the method comprises the steps of establishing an energy accessibility model between a virtual power plant node and a load node to be repaired according to a virtual power plant node model and a post-disaster traffic topology, determining a task matrix of an emergency repair task according to the energy accessibility model, communication constraint and the loss load condition of the load node to be repaired, establishing a double-layer optimization model according to the dynamic energy state of the node and the emergency repair index of the emergency repair task, solving the double-layer optimization model based on an improved multi-objective evolutionary algorithm and the task matrix, and determining an optimal emergency repair path of an electric power system and a virtual power plant coordination scheme. The intelligent matching and coordinated scheduling of the output of the virtual power plant and the rush-repair task are realized, and the dynamic coordination of the multi-source energy after the disaster and the optimal allocation of the rush-repair task are realized.
assignees: SUQIAN POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power grid multi-fault-point rush repair task allocation method and computer equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid multi-fault-point rush-repair task allocation method and computer equipment, which comprise the steps of S1, calculating three coefficients of equipment operation time, load rate and historical faults, building an equipment fault probability model according to the three coefficients, generating a fault point quantization set through a Bernoulli test, calculating traffic passing difficulty through a logic Stir function, building a traffic network quantization matrix, building a manpower resource quantization vector of a rush-repair team, calculating real-time capacity according to exponential decay, summarizing quantization results of the fault point quantization set, the traffic network quantization matrix and the manpower resource quantization vector to obtain a multi-fault-point scene quantization result, S2, building an objective function according to the multi-fault-point scene quantization result, and solving a global optimal task allocation scheme through a self-adaptive peak group algorithm to improve rush-repair scheduling quality and efficiency under a power distribution network multi-fault scene.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Asset ledger topology correction and graph model library integration method based on SCCD-plus model drive
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system automation, in particular to an asset account topology correction and graph model library integration method based on SCCD-plus model driving, which is based on a three-layer two-network architecture of a transformer substation, and comprises the steps of integrating standard SCD files, equipment operation configuration data, network interconnection information, planning topology information, actual topology information and network parameters to construct an SCCD-plus model; the method comprises the steps of importing an asset account, obtaining a corrected asset account list through a field level comparison and equipment level checking correction mechanism, updating a model, generating a planning topology, finding out and generating an actual topology based on the model, obtaining a precise network topology through comparison and correction of the planning topology and the actual topology, and finally outputting the corrected asset account list and the corrected network topology to provide data support for situation awareness platform graph and model library integration. The invention can also automatically generate correction suggestions, support one-key updating of the graphic model database or output of correction lists, and can obviously improve the consistency of the standing accounts and the on-site state and the topology restoration precision.
assignees: CSG EHV POWER TRANSMISSION CO

title_en: Intelligent diagnosis and autonomous management method and system for line loss of power distribution network
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of line loss management, in particular to an intelligent diagnosis and autonomous management method and system for line loss of a power distribution network. The method comprises the steps of collecting various data, carrying out restoration and normalization processing, checking the space consistency of topology, standing accounts and files through a blockchain intelligent contract, calculating a load space-time matrix, constructing a line loss genetic map, identifying abnormal lines, generating and executing a treatment strategy, updating the genetic map according to the treatment effect, and carrying out closed loop iteration. The application solves the problems of difficult data processing, inconsistent topology and station account, and non-intelligent line loss diagnosis and treatment in the prior art, realizes the full-flow intellectualization and automation from data acquisition to treatment, and effectively improves the efficiency and accuracy of the line loss management of the power distribution network.
assignees: JIZE COUNTY POWER SUPPLY BRANCH STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;HANDAN HUILONG ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN RES CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: The system includes a means for monitoring a power supply state of a base station, a means for counting the number of base stations in power failure, a means for determining a wide area power failure from the number of base stations in power failure, a means for transmitting a standby and fuel supply instruction to an operator when a disaster occurs, a means for tracking a position of an active user in a disaster area, a means for determining an optimum base station restoration order based on a user density, a means for updating a restoration situation in real time, a means for preparing an optimum material supply plan, and a means for notifying an operator of an action plan.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: SOFTBANK GROUP CORP

title_en: Knowledge graph construction method in rainstorm flood disaster chain monitoring field
abstract_en: The application provides a method for constructing a knowledge graph in a storm flood disaster chain monitoring field, which relates to the technical field of knowledge graph construction and comprises the steps of preprocessing original multi-source disaster data to obtain multi-class quality controlled data, calling a disaster field fine adjustment large model and a body inference machine based on a preliminary corpus and the multi-class quality controlled data to generate a core body and a sub-document set, screening the sub-document set to construct a document association graph, calling a mapping model to match a structured data field and a core body attribute, carrying out triplet extraction according to the sub-document set and a constructed three-level prompt word template, carrying out vectorization and clustering on the body instance attribute, generating a three-level collaborative system and a graph core structure through field conflict restoration and pruning adjustment, obtaining an instance implicit relation of the disaster field fine adjustment large model complement graph core structure based on the processing process, and constructing a target knowledge graph. The application realizes the construction of the knowledge graph in the disaster field.
assignees: UNIV WUHAN

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for generating water-soil environment evaluation result in river basin ecological restoration project
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for generating a water and soil environment evaluation result in a river basin ecological restoration project, which relate to the field of environmental engineering and comprise the steps of collecting water and soil environment element data, dividing a target river basin into spatial scale domains with different sizes according to the water and soil environment element data, establishing a same-scale element association mechanism in the spatial scale domains and a cross-scale element association mechanism among the spatial scale domains, respectively simulating and evaluating an ecological process meeting preset water and soil environment key process standards based on the same-scale element association mechanism and by adopting corresponding models in each spatial scale domain to obtain corresponding evaluation results, constructing a cross-scale effect model according to the cross-scale element association mechanism and the evaluation results, carrying out iterative correction based on the cross-scale effect model and a pre-constructed evaluation index system to obtain a water and soil environment comprehensive evaluation result, and returning the comprehensive evaluation result to a user side. The application improves the comprehensiveness, scientificity and timeliness of the evaluation result.
assignees: EAST CHINA ENGINEERING SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Long-acting solid-state restoration method for iron ore tailing heavy metal chromium based on dynamic regulation and control rhizosphere microorganism network
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for long-acting solid-state restoration of iron ore tailing heavy metal chromium based on a dynamic regulation and control rhizosphere microorganism network, and relates to the technical field of environmental data processing. The method comprises the specific steps of data extraction and fusion, microorganism application and feedback data acquisition, and finally, a model is updated to reflect the states of microorganisms and heavy metal Cr, so that the effective solid storage and management of the heavy metal Cr in the iron ore tailings are realized, and the ecological restoration of mines and the safety of ecological environment are promoted.
assignees: LANGFANG COMPREHENSIVE SURVEY CENTER OF NATURAL RESOURCES CHINA GEOLOGICAL SURVEY

title_en: Dynamic optimization method for comprehensive evaluation index weight of ecological system restoration effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic optimization method for comprehensive evaluation index weight of ecological system restoration effect, which relates to the technical field of ecological restoration evaluation, and mainly comprises the steps of preprocessing multi-source time sequence index data to obtain multi-source time sequence fusion characteristics, constructing a dynamic graph network, training the dynamic graph network to obtain a trained dynamic graph network and embedding time sequence nodes; and constructing a secondary index intelligent body model according to the index system, training the secondary index intelligent body model by using a reinforcement learning method to obtain a trained secondary index intelligent body model, and obtaining the comprehensive evaluation index weight of the ecological system restoration effect by using the trained secondary index intelligent body model. By implementing the dynamic optimization method for the comprehensive evaluation index weight of the ecological system restoration effect, which is provided by the invention, each index weight in the ecological system restoration effect evaluation index system under multi-source data can be intelligently and dynamically adjusted and optimized.
assignees: UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES WUHAN

title_en: Modularized ecological slope protection device for geological disaster treatment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a modularized ecological slope protection device for geological disaster treatment, which relates to the field of slope protection devices and comprises a main structure and a splicing structure, wherein the main structure comprises an outer frame, an inner cavity of the outer frame is fixedly connected with a protective net, the splicing structure comprises a containing groove, the containing groove is formed in the periphery of the surface of the outer frame, the outer frame is used as a supporting framework of the device, the protective net is used for blocking and slowing down the loss of slope soil and playing a role of slope protection, and can be used as a substrate for plant growth to promote ecological restoration, the containing groove is used for containing and fixing a first rotating plate and a second rotating plate, so that the modules can be conveniently and rapidly spliced and disassembled, the first rotating plate and the second rotating plate are matched, the connection and the fixation of the modules are realized through rotation, the flexibility and the expandability of the device are improved, and the fixing ring and the first inserting ring are used as connecting points in cooperation with a positioning bolt, and the fixation of the modules is realized.
assignees: JIANGSU EAST CHINA NONFERROUS DEEP GEOLOGICAL EXPLORATION CO LTD RESOURCE INVESTIGATION AND EVALUATI

title_en: Power address-oriented power outage and restoration panorama monitoring method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a power address-oriented power outage and restoration panorama monitoring method and device, and relates to the technical field of power grids. According to the invention, the power failure and recovery analysis is carried out by monitoring the real-time data such as the power parameters, the switching state and the fault alarm information of each power address, so that the real-time monitoring of the power failure and recovery in the power system is realized. Furthermore, the invention respectively carries out the power-off and power-on analysis on the actual data of each power address and the related address, determines the first power-off and power-on state and the second power-off and power-on state, and after carrying out state checking, determines the power-off and power-on state, thereby improving the accuracy of power-off and power-on monitoring. According to the invention, the power failure and restoration state of each power address and the power map are combined to perform power failure and restoration panoramic display, so that real-time panoramic monitoring of power failure and restoration in a power system is realized. Compared with the traditional manual inspection and local monitoring, the power grid outage and restoration monitoring efficiency is improved.
assignees: MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Ecological shoreline diagnosis method and system based on hydrologic-biological communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological shoreline diagnosis method and system based on hydrologic-biological communication, which are applied to the technical fields of water environment ecological restoration and shoreline health assessment. The method comprises the steps of dividing intertidal zones of a shoreline research area, generating evenly distributed sampling points in each tidal zone, extracting a plurality of indexes related to hydrology and biological connectivity, constructing a comprehensive hydrology-biological connectivity state index through principal component analysis, acquiring dyke feature data of the shoreline area, carrying out correlation analysis and collinearity screening, screening key shoreline features through a random forest algorithm, constructing a mechanism connectivity index based on a circuit theory, constructing and training a Bayesian network prediction model, and carrying out connectivity state diagnosis, attribution analysis and repair scheme effect simulation on a target shoreline section by utilizing the Bayesian network prediction model. The invention changes from static element evaluation to dynamic ecological process diagnosis by coupling hydrologic and biological connectivity, and accurately locates dominant factors.

title_en: Safety early warning method based on along-mining seismic exploration, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety early warning method, a storage medium and electronic equipment based on the detection of an accompanying earthquake, the method comprises the steps of determining the position of an accompanying area, configuring a first safety radius taking the accompanying area as the center according to the position of the accompanying area, arranging a first earthquake sensing edge network on the first safety radius, detecting in real time according to the first earthquake sensing edge network, outputting a first earthquake sensing signal set corresponding to the first safety radius, carrying out signal restoration on the first earthquake sensing signal set by using a signal restoration module, outputting an earthquake restoration signal set, inputting the earthquake restoration signal set into an earthquake safety early warning module for safety analysis, outputting an earthquake risk index, and generating a safety early warning signal based on the earthquake risk index. The invention achieves the technical effects of improving the accuracy of the identification of the seismic signals and monitoring stability.
assignees: CHN ENERGY XINJIANG ENERGY CHEMICAL CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic path planning method and system considering sudden disturbance and transportation characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic path planning method and a system considering sudden disturbance and transportation characteristics. The method comprises the steps of firstly collecting road network topology, transportation tasks and disturbance event information, secondly, generating an undisturbed driving route plan for each vehicle by adopting an improved Dijkstra algorithm fused with road compatibility and time window constraint, randomly triggering disturbance events through dynamic simulation and updating road network states, then, adaptively selecting a local restoration or global reconstruction strategy to carry out path re-planning by evaluating the criticality of affected vehicle proportion and a failure road section, and finally outputting an optimization scheme integrating the plan and a dynamic adjustment result. The method effectively overcomes the technical defects that the traditional static planning is difficult to cope with dynamic disturbance, neglect the physical compatibility of the transport means and the road network, and the efficiency and the global optimization are difficult to balance during re-planning, and remarkably improves the robustness and the instantaneity of path planning.
assignees: CHINA TELECOM HONGXIN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Quantitative evaluation method for loss degree of main transformer equipment after disaster
abstract_en: The application provides a method for quantitatively evaluating loss degree of main transformer equipment after disasters, which comprises the steps of firstly obtaining natural disaster types and main transformer equipment fault data, constructing a disaster-induced fault influence factor system, calculating disaster weights and fault mode weights, then enumerating equipment maintenance evaluation indexes and preprocessing based on historical disaster damage data and equipment operation states, identifying a core evaluation index set, calculating core index importance weights, then establishing a loss index calculation model according to the weights, calculating basic loss indexes of fault sample data, presetting a loss grade interval, then carrying out nonlinear calibration on the basic loss indexes, fusing multidimensional features to generate comprehensive loss indexes, and finally optimizing the comprehensive loss indexes through a random forest regression model, outputting final loss prediction indexes, and judging equipment restoration priority according to the obtained result. The evaluation method outputs unified and quantifiable loss indexes and grades, and provides decision basis for post-disaster repair priority judgment and manpower and material resource scheduling.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECHNOLOGICAL RESEARCH INST STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic compensation restoration method, system and medium for electric quantity data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic uncompensated reduction method, a system and a medium of electric quantity data, and relates to the technical field of electric measurement, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing direct connection between an electric power center station and a first data source end as well as between an electric power center station and a second data source end; and a bidirectional asymmetric compensation protocol is introduced, a compensation decision device is deployed in a power grid center station, data interaction is carried out between the compensation decision device and a first data source end and a second data source end, compensation decision under double-end decision is executed, electric quantity compensation reduction data are determined, and compensation reduction management of power metering of the power grid is executed according to the electric quantity compensation reduction data. The invention solves the technical problems that the existing electric quantity compensation method cannot effectively cope with bidirectional metering deviation caused by electric energy quality fluctuation and metering information loss, and the precision and adaptability of compensation treatment are poor, and achieves the technical effects of realizing the precision quantization and responsibility division of two types of metering deviation and improving the precision and adaptability of compensation treatment by constructing a double-end decision mechanism of electric energy quality spectrum and information enthalpy quantization.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ZHENJIANG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH

title_en: Ecological regulation and control method and system for repairing water body by using substrate of culture pond fused with AI vision
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological regulation and control method and system for repairing a substrate of an aquaculture pond by fusing AI vision, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining multidimensional sensing data of a plurality of regional nodes in the pond, wherein the multidimensional sensing data comprises vision data, substrate parameters and environment parameters; the method comprises the steps of extracting substrate characteristics in visual data based on a preset substrate image recognition network, determining evaluation indexes and corresponding degradation levels of a pond according to the substrate characteristics, multidimensional sensing data and a preset fusion judgment model, calculating restoration parameter combinations of corresponding area nodes under the current degradation levels according to sensing data corresponding to the evaluation indexes and a parameter optimization network corresponding to the degradation levels, and generating regulation execution instructions received by equipment according to the restoration parameter combinations in response to judgment results output by the fusion judgment model. Therefore, the invention can realize the recognition of microscopic substrate characteristics to macroscopic ecological regulation and control by fusing the sensing data with AI vision, and is suitable for the complex requirements of different cultivation scenes.
assignees: UNIV ZHONGKAI AGRI & ENG;GUANGDONG YUEFU ENG DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Slope collapse preventing device for lead-zinc mine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a slope collapse preventing device for a lead-zinc mine, which comprises a lead-zinc slope, bottom layer wire nets, protective layers, upper layer wire nets and drainage grooves, wherein a plurality of fixing anchors which are arranged in an array are fixedly inserted into a mountain of the lead-zinc slope, the bottom layer wire nets are connected with the fixing anchors in a winding mode to be paved and fixed on the slope of the lead-zinc slope, the protective layers are respectively filled in grids of the bottom layer wire nets, vegetation grooves are arranged in the middle of the protective layers, nutrient soil is filled in the vegetation grooves, cogongrass vegetation is respectively planted in the nutrient soil of each vegetation groove, the upper layer wire nets are connected with the fixing anchors in a winding mode to be paved and fixed on the outer sides of the bottom layer wire nets and each protective layer, the drainage grooves are arranged at the bottom of the lead-zinc slope, and water guide pipes are connected to the side faces of the bottom of the drainage grooves. The device can effectively fix soil, and control collapse and landslide of the slope body. The ecological restoration effect of the lead-zinc mine can be promoted by the imperata vegetation on the surface layer. The drainage system can effectively prevent the influence of rainwater accumulation on the slope stability of the lead-zinc mine.
assignees: UNIV FUJIAN TECHNOLOGY;JINAN URBAN CONSTR GROUP CO

title_en: Dynamic optimization system, method and computer-readable storage medium for ecological restoration of photovoltaic power generation area
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological restoration, in particular to a dynamic optimization system, a dynamic optimization method and a computer readable storage medium for ecological restoration of a photovoltaic power generation area, wherein the system comprises an ecological monitoring module, a monitoring module and a storage module, wherein the ecological monitoring module is used for acquiring environmental data in real time through a sensor network and monitoring equipment deployed in the photovoltaic area; the system comprises a data analysis module, a restoration scheme generation module, an engineering measure management module and a biological measure management module, wherein the data analysis module is used for analyzing the acquired data based on a big data processing technology and a machine learning algorithm to establish an ecological degradation evaluation model to quantify ecological conditions, the restoration scheme generation module is used for combining the result of the evaluation model, regional ecological environment characteristics and a restoration target, and generating a restoration scheme comprising vegetation restoration, soil improvement and water resource management by utilizing a GIS analysis and remote sensing image processing technology, the engineering measure management module is used for managing the implementation process of ecological restoration engineering, and the biological measure management module is used for managing the implementation of biological restoration measures. The invention realizes the collaborative management of engineering and biological measures and improves the ecological restoration efficiency.
assignees: HUANENG LANCANGJIANG NEW ENERGY CO LTD;YUNNAN LYUXUE FORESTRY CONSULTATION CO LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;YUNNAN BINGCHENG FORESTRY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-constraint particle swarm optimization power overhaul scheduling method, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-constraint particle swarm optimization power overhaul scheduling method, equipment and medium, which are used for enhancing global searching capacity by combining a dynamic inertia weight adjustment mechanism and a midpoint guiding variation strategy, and introducing elite retention, random mask crossover and a genetic evolution mechanism of self-adaptive probability variation to improve population diversity and optimization stability. In addition, a multi-neighborhood local mountain climbing search and multi-constraint feasibility restoration function is designed, and the high quality of the scheduling scheme is ensured on the premise of meeting the constraint. Experimental results show that the method is superior to the traditional algorithm in terms of convergence speed, solution feasibility and scheduling quality, and has good engineering applicability and optimization effect.
assignees: BOZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO;ANHUI HONGJI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Space perception type modularized wind resource perception method suitable for offshore wind farm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space perception type modularized wind resource perception method suitable for an offshore wind farm, which comprises the following steps of 1, arranging a wind farm three-dimensional perception system, 2, carrying out multi-source data acquisition and edge preprocessing, 3, carrying out space-time feature modeling and intelligent prediction, and 4, carrying out wind energy evaluation and system feedback optimization. The invention provides a multi-source layout strategy combining a tower barrel, a jacket, a booster station and a buoy, which fully utilizes the structure positions of different heights and areas in a wind power plant to form a three-dimensional sensing network covering vertical wind speed gradient, boundary layer disturbance and overall wind power plant dominant trend. Compared with the traditional single-point or linear layout mode, the scheme realizes higher space resolution and wind farm state restoration capability on the premise of not increasing a large amount of hardware investment, and provides a solid data base for high-precision prediction.
assignees: CHINA NUCLEAR HUINENG CO LTD;Yangjiang offshore wind power laboratory

title_en: Dynamic damage perception collaborative recovery method for coping with flood disasters of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power distribution network restoration, and particularly relates to a dynamic damage perception collaborative restoration method for a power distribution network to cope with flood disasters, which comprises the steps of S1, obtaining local data of a target area, S2, building a disaster scene deduction model, a searching and fault perception model, a random maintenance time model, an unmanned plane-maintenance team collaborative scheduling model, a communication restoration and switching control model, a waterlogging development model and an operation constraint model based on the local data collected by S1, S3, taking the weighted load energy recovered maximally, the waterlogging cost reduced, the fault information FI perception efficiency improved as a target function, building a dynamic damage perception collaborative restoration model for the power distribution network to cope with the flood disasters under the fault information deficiency, and S4, building an event-driven rolling optimization frame and solving to obtain a power supply restoration strategy. The method can sense the damage state in real time, dynamically adjust the recovery strategy and cooperatively schedule the unmanned aerial vehicle and the maintenance resources in a complex environment with dynamic waterlogging development.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING;STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power grid outage plan optimization method and system based on multi-agent reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid dispatching and intelligent optimization, and discloses a power grid outage plan optimization method and system based on multi-agent reinforcement learning. The system comprises a node importance evaluation model based on a power grid topological structure and operation data, a node importance coefficient vector is calculated, a steady-state power flow equation and steady-state operation constraint are constructed, node steady-state voltage, current and branch steady-state power flow power are obtained, an optimization model aiming at minimizing power supply loss of important nodes and system out-of-limit risk is established, an optimal switching operation and transfer scheme is determined, a multi-agent system comprising a switching operation agent, a load transfer agent and an overhaul scheduling agent is designed, an optimal strategy set is obtained by utilizing a concentrated training and decentralized execution mechanism, a power outage plan and transfer path are optimized, and a power outage sequence and a power restoration strategy are output. The method realizes the intellectualization, the dynamics and the self-adaptive optimization of the power failure scheme, and effectively improves the safety and the economy of the power grid overhaul plan.
assignees: SHENYANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic output prediction method and system based on QPSO-LSTM
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic output prediction method and a system based on QPSO-LSTM, and belongs to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation prediction. Collecting photovoltaic output historical data and relevant meteorological data, carrying out anomaly detection by combining STL decomposition with local anomaly factors, carrying out data restoration and reconstruction by using a K nearest neighbor method, and generating a training sample through normalization processing. And carrying out global self-adaptive optimization on the super parameters of the LSTM by using the QPSO to obtain an optimized QPSO-LSTM distributed photovoltaic output prediction model. And inputting the real-time observation data of the target area into the optimized model, and outputting a predicted value. The invention effectively overcomes the defects that the traditional LSTM model depends on empirical parameter adjustment and is easy to be trapped into local optimum, remarkably improves the prediction precision and model robustness, and provides reliable technical support for power grid optimization scheduling.
assignees: STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD JINZHAI COUNTY POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Earthquake damage structure optimal restoration decision determining method based on quick improvement of earthquake resistance toughness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining an optimal restoration decision of a seismic damage structure based on quick improvement of seismic toughness. In order to furthest improve the anti-seismic performance of the earthquake damage structure, a practical and effective optimal restoration decision determining method is provided. Firstly, extracting end displacements of all beam and column members in a vibration loss structure, calculating the rotation angles and damage degrees of the beam and column members according to the end displacements, then, calculating the vibration resistance loss of the members, floors and the structure by combining importance coefficients of the members and the floors, calculating time and cost required by repairing each member on the basis, determining an optimal repairing strategy of the vibration loss structure by combining a greedy-genetic algorithm, and finally, further determining the optimal repairing sequence of the members on the basis of the optimal repairing strategy by taking the repairing effect of the members as an evaluation index. The method can provide powerful help for the establishment of an actual earthquake damage structure restoration decision scheme, and has higher engineering application value.
assignees: UNIV LANZHOU TECH

title_en: Disaster prevention system
abstract_en: To provide a disaster prevention system capable of easily restoring an abnormality detection device.SOLUTION: The disaster prevention system 100 includes an abnormality detection device 10 including an abnormality detection unit 12 that detects an abnormality, a transfer output unit that outputs a transfer signal when the abnormality detection unit 12 detects the abnormality, and a control unit 11 that receives a restoration instruction signal and stops the output by the transfer output unit, a control means that executes an application program 26 having a function of receiving an input of a restoration instruction to the abnormality detection device 10 and transmitting a first signal indicating the received restoration instruction, and a control means connected to the control means via a communication network 60 and connected to the abnormality detection device 10. And a relay device 30 having a signal processing part 31 for converting the first signal transmitted from the control means into a restoration instruction signal and outputting it to the abnormality detection device 10.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2
assignees: NOHMI BOSAI LTD

title_en: Power grid recovery system and method for reducing power influence based on electric energy coupling equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid recovery, in particular to a power grid recovery system and a power grid recovery method for reducing power influence based on electric energy coupling equipment, the method comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a multi-energy coupling power distribution network, namely coupling the power distribution network, an air network, a heat supply network and a traffic network through the electric energy coupling equipment; the method comprises the steps of S2, obtaining an initial disconnection scheme of a power distribution network, S3, obtaining a recovery sequence, establishing a power distribution network recovery optimization model based on the power distribution network state, the load state, the traffic network state and the predicted values of power distribution network power supply and power distribution network load after an extreme event occurs, obtaining an EV transfer path, a rush-repair sequence, a power distribution network line recovery sequence and a load recovery sequence based on the power distribution network recovery optimization model, S4, updating the recovery state, S5, recovering the power grid, and applying the method to the fault scene of the urban multi-energy power system caused by the extreme disaster.
assignees: UNIV LIUPANSHUI NORMAL

title_en: Intelligent low-cost groundwater pollution treatment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent low-cost groundwater pollution treatment method and system, which belong to the technical field of groundwater pollution control, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining hydrogeologic parameters of a polluted area; the method comprises the steps of calculating the total pollutant amount in a polluted area by using on-site sampling analysis and numerical simulation results, calculating the environmental capacity of the polluted area based on hydrogeologic parameters and the total pollutant amount, establishing a groundwater numerical model based on the hydrogeologic parameters, the total pollutant amount and the environmental capacity, simulating the migration rule of pollutants under different groundwater artificial supply amounts, determining the optimal artificial supply amount meeting the standard of the downstream river water quality, monitoring the water quality of the groundwater supply position and the groundwater drainage position of the polluted area in real time, and regulating and controlling the optimal artificial supply amount when the water quality exceeds the standard until the water quality meets the standard. The invention fully utilizes natural hydrologic cycle and environmental capacity, realizes low-cost and intelligent restoration of polluted groundwater, ensures the water quality safety of downstream river channels, and has remarkable economic and environmental benefits.
assignees: SICHUAN NATURAL RESOURCES SURVEY AND DESIGN GROUP ECOLOGICAL ENV CO LTD

title_en: Disaster area loss analysis method, device and medium based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to disaster detection technology and discloses a disaster area loss analysis method and device based on an unmanned plane and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of cruising shooting a disaster area to be detected by using the unmanned plane to obtain real-time laser data, real-time radar data and real-time aerial shooting data, and carrying out point cloud difference analysis, point cloud restoration and three-dimensional modeling on the real-time laser data and historical laser data to obtain a change model group; and carrying out differential interference analysis on the real-time radar data and the historical radar data to obtain an interference phase diagram group, carrying out parallax analysis on the real-time aerial data and the historical aerial data, and carrying out comprehensive loss analysis on the disaster area to be detected according to the variation block diagram group, the interference phase diagram group and the variation block group to obtain a disaster area damage result. The method can be applied to the disaster detection field, can realize triple contrast disaster detection according to the three-dimensional model, the radar data and the two-dimensional image, and improves the disaster detection efficiency.
assignees: MINTAIAN INSURANCE LOSS ADJUSTERS CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network line disaster state sensing method and device based on image recognition
