abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of monitoring and sensing of power distribution line disaster damage states, in particular to a power distribution line disaster damage state sensing method and device based on image recognition, comprising the steps of inputting power distribution line image data into a pre-trained denoising diffusion probability model to obtain denoising image data output by the pre-trained denoising diffusion probability model; and inputting the denoising image data into a pre-trained power distribution network line disaster damage state sensing model to obtain a power distribution line disaster damage category output by the pre-trained power distribution network line disaster damage state sensing model. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, the automatic judgment of different disaster-affected types such as displacement, galloping, wire-lapping, short circuit and the like can be performed, so that the disaster-affected state of the distribution line is output, and key information is provided for disaster emergency repair and power restoration after disaster.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST CO LTD;STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Vegetation damage identification and ecological assessment method for power transmission and transformation construction area
abstract_en: The application relates to a vegetation damage identification and ecological assessment method for a power transmission and transformation construction area, which comprises the following steps of data preparation and pretreatment, vegetation damage area identification, result optimization and verification, ecological system service value loss assessment, ecological restoration suggestion generation, restoration priority partition is carried out by fusing space distribution information of vegetation damage degree and ecological system service value loss, differential ecological restoration measures are provided for different partitions, and a partition ecological restoration planning chart and an assessment report are output.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST

title_en: Active power distribution network distributed fault recovery method based on section sequential recovery evaluation
abstract_en: The invention relates to an active power distribution network distributed fault recovery method based on section sequence recovery evaluation, firstly, comprehensively considering the roles of source charges in the recovery process, and quantifying the recovery value of the load and the supporting potential of the distributed power supply. And secondly, extracting potential information of the downstream section to be restored by multiple layers, establishing a local rolling optimization framework based on a model predictive control idea, and improving the prospective and global optimality of a distributed fault restoration decision. And finally, introducing rapid tide calculation to carry out feasibility verification before each step of decision, and ensuring that the recovery scheme meets the actual operation constraint of the power grid. The design method comprehensively considers regional endogenous load and distributed recovery characteristics, provides a fault recovery method combining comprehensive regional recovery value evaluation with a prospective optimization decision framework, and achieves faster, stable, efficient and reliable power supply recovery of the power distribution network in a distributed environment.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST;NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Ecological efficacy restoration scheme generation method and system for power transmission and transformation project
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for generating an ecological efficiency restoration scheme of power transmission and transformation project, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining ecological data and power transmission and transformation project nodes, quantifying constructed three-way different patterns by utilizing a graph rolling network to obtain a gene flow resistance matrix, inputting a Multi-GNN model to simulate a gene flow blocking effect of the power transmission and transformation project on the ecological efficiency, calculating contribution weights of all nodes in the power transmission and transformation project on the obtained long-term gene flow blocking value by utilizing SHAP values, weighting and calculating the long-term gene flow blocking value and the corresponding contribution weights to obtain a long-term influence value, inputting the ecological data into a pre-constructed ecological pollution behavior quantification model to quantify short-term influence of the power transmission and transformation project on the ecological efficiency, calculating restoration priority weights of all power transmission and transformation nodes based on the long-term influence value and the short-term influence value, inputting the restoration priority weights and the contribution weights into a reinforcement learning strategy to obtain an optimal ecological restoration parameter, and converting the optimal ecological restoration parameter into the ecological restoration scheme.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Multi-factor driven comprehensive evaluation system for coast beach health
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-factor driven comprehensive evaluation system for the health of coast and beach sand, which aims to solve the problems of one-sided property, subjectivity and lack of systematicness in the prior evaluation technology. The multi-factor driven comprehensive coast beach health evaluation system systematically divides a plurality of factors affecting beach health into three categories, namely physical process core factors for calculating physical stability, system states and environment adjusting factors for representing landform ecological conditions, and human activities and environment pressure factors for correcting evaluation results. The invention has the innovation point that a three-layer logic evaluation framework of driving-state-pressure is constructed, and multi-section state scientific classification from healthy, sub-healthy to harmful can be realized. The method overcomes the limitation of traditional evaluation, realizes comprehensive, dynamic and accurate diagnosis of the health state of the beach, and provides powerful decision basis for scientific management, ecological restoration and disaster prevention and reduction of coastal zones.
assignees: TAIHU XINGYUN WUXI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Marine wind power plant collaborative operation and maintenance method based on atmospheric marine environment dynamic simulation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a marine wind farm collaborative operation and maintenance method based on dynamic simulation of an atmospheric marine environment, which is applicable to the field of new energy. The method comprises the steps of S1, carrying out clock synchronization, coordinate conversion, anomaly rejection, missing value restoration and dimension standardization on collected multi-source heterogeneous data to generate a standardized data set in a unified format, S2, constructing an atmospheric ocean environment field dynamic model and an equipment state evolution model, carrying out coupling training on the two models through a multi-scale space-time fusion algorithm to generate an environment change trend prediction result and an equipment running state prediction result, dynamically correcting model parameters according to prediction errors, S3, carrying out quantization grading on equipment fault early warning and environment risks, carrying out matching scheduling on the combination of real-time operation and maintenance resource states, generating a collaborative operation and maintenance plan through a space-time optimization algorithm, executing the collaborative operation and maintenance plan and feeding back an execution state in real time, and realizing iterative optimization of the operation and maintenance plan.
assignees: POWERCHINA HUADONG ENGINEERING CORP LTD

title_en: Cross-domain multi-data center storage management method oriented to computational and electrical fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a storage management method of a cross-domain multiple data center for computing and electrofusion, which comprises the steps of 1) carrying out cross-domain abstract modeling on data center storage resources distributed in different regions, namely distributing global unique identifications or paths for the data centers, abstracting storage nodes of the data centers into unified logic storage pools, generating a resource vector according to the storage capacity, computing power and power states of the data centers as ternary coupling virtualization representation of the data centers, 2) carrying out joint optimization on data storage based on power supply, network bandwidth and storage load, transferring task data which are determined to be high concurrent and high I/O load to the corresponding data centers, and reducing energy consumption through cache classification and I/O path optimization, and 3) carrying out consistency check on data copies among the data centers, and carrying out trend analysis on the load and power of the storage nodes by utilizing a prediction model based on time sequences, so as to realize fault tolerance and self-adaption restoration on the storage nodes.
assignees: SICHUAN TIANFU NEW AREA COSMIC RAY RES CENTER;INST HIGH ENERGY PHYSICS CAS

title_en: Virtual power plant scheduling method and device for power system and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a virtual power plant scheduling method, a device and electronic equipment for a power system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining forecast data, equipment parameters and market information of a virtual power plant in a preset scheduling period; the method comprises the steps of establishing an economic dispatching optimization model of a virtual power plant, solving the economic dispatching optimization model to generate a candidate dispatching scheme in a dispatching period, carrying out iterative optimization on the candidate dispatching scheme, wherein the iterative optimization comprises the steps of uniformly encoding time sequence values of various dispatching variables in the dispatching period into a dispatching variable set of the virtual power plant dispatching scheme, integrating a feasible solution restoration mechanism based on physical constraints of the virtual power plant in an updating process, taking the current optimal virtual power plant dispatching scheme as an optimal dispatching scheme when the iterative process meets a preset termination condition, generating a control instruction corresponding to the dispatching instruction, and executing the control instruction in the preset dispatching period. By adopting the technical scheme, the overall efficiency, reliability and economy of virtual power plant dispatching can be improved.
assignees: BEIJING FIBRLINK COMMUNICATIONS CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic rush repair scheduling and path planning method and system for power transmission line under disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for dynamic rush-repair scheduling and path planning of a power transmission line under a disaster, and relates to the technical field of electric power emergency rush-repair, wherein the method is used for constructing a dynamic resource scheduling model under various constraint conditions by sensing the dynamic change of the topology of the power transmission line under the disaster in real time and fusing the geographical position priority of important users and the distribution information of rush-repair resources; and generating a rush-repair path based on a fastest path algorithm, establishing a restorability evaluation system containing the dimensions of resource matching degree, topology connectivity and the like, and triggering the rush-repair action when the evaluation value reaches 80% or more. The invention solves the problems of delayed response of the traditional rush-repair scheduling, departure of path planning from a disaster real-time scene and mismatching of resource allocation and recovery requirements, realizes the accuracy, the dynamism and the high efficiency of the rush-repair of the power transmission line under the disaster condition, and remarkably improves the recovery efficiency of the power grid after the disaster.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Ecological friendly seawall
abstract_en: An ecological friendly seawall comprises a seawall open caisson foundation, a stepped bank protection, a stone throwing foot protection, a wave prevention forest in front of a dike, a wind prevention forest behind the dike and a dike top pavement, wherein the stepped bank protection is arranged above the seawall open caisson foundation and consists of a stepped concrete slope protection and a modularized precast concrete step, a plurality of drain pipes are arranged at the bottom of the stepped concrete slope protection, drain outlets of the drain pipes are arranged in the wave prevention forest in front of the dike, the precast concrete step comprises an uppermost layer of a viewing platform and a plurality of concrete planting ponds arranged below the viewing platform in a stepped manner, the stone throwing foot protection is arranged at the outer side of the stepped bank protection, the sand soil is covered above the stone throwing to plant the wave prevention forest in front of the dike, and the wind prevention forest behind the dike and the dike top pavement are sequentially arranged at the inner side of the stepped bank protection. The seawall integrates ecological restoration, landscaping, dampproof disaster reduction, and retains the function of coping with storm surge while landscaping the seawall.
assignees: BEIJING TUREN CITY PLANNING DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Construction method and system of microorganism and vegetation synergistic greening system of coastal saline soil engineering plot
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for constructing a microorganism and vegetation synergistic greening system of a coastal saline soil engineering plot. Belongs to the technical field of ecological restoration engineering. The method comprises the steps of carrying out micro-topography characteristic analysis on a coastal saline soil engineering plot, identifying a natural micro-topography heterogeneous area, generating micro-topography characteristic data, designing a differential micro-topography modification scheme according to the micro-topography characteristic data, constructing a micro-topography modification model with spatially differential characteristics, providing a proper micro-environment foundation for the synergistic effect of subsequent microorganisms and vegetation, carrying out deep coupling on a MICP flora induced calcium carbonate mineralization technology and salt-tolerant plant functional group screening, and combining the differential micro-topography modification design, thereby breaking the situation of traditional improvement and planting and cutting, effectively improving the soil structure of the coastal saline soil, enhancing the soil water holding capacity, providing a proper soil environment for vegetation stable establishment, and avoiding the re-greening failure caused by the uncontinuous soil structure improvement.
assignees: QINHUANGDAO POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LIMITED

title_en: Resistant plant screening and configuration equipment for ecological restoration of antimony mine slope
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological restoration, in particular to screening and configuration equipment for resistant plants for ecological restoration of antimony mine hillsides. The resistant plant screening and configuration equipment for ecological restoration of the antimony mine hillside slope comprises a side slope frame, a traveling component, a planting box, a seed discharging component and a seed throwing component. The invention can loosen soil, ditching and planting on the slope, is beneficial to improving the permeability of soil and the penetration of moisture, promotes the growth of plant root systems, ensures the continuity and stability of slope vegetation recovery, realizes the full-automatic flow of plug seedlings from conveying, turning and guiding to planting, greatly improves the planting efficiency, ensures that the plug seedlings can be accurately and completely planted in the slope soil, improves the planting survival rate and uniformity, enhances the structural stability of the slope soil through the soil fixation effect of the vegetation root systems, reduces the occurrence risk of geological disasters such as landslide, collapse and the like, and ensures the safety of mining areas and surrounding environments.
assignees: LENGSHUIJIANG SHIZISHAN ANTIMONY IND CO LTD

title_en: Unit combination feasible solution calculation method based on system constraint restoration contribution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a unit combination feasible solution calculation method based on system constraint restoration contribution, which specifically comprises the steps of solving a unit combination system constraint relaxation model of starting and stopping of a fixed part, calculating a system constraint restoration starting and stopping variable contribution index and updating a starting and stopping variable fixed range; according to the method, the constraint out-of-limit degree of the system is identified by solving the constraint relaxation model of the unit combination system, the contribution degree of the unit start-stop variation to the constraint out-of-limit restoration of the system is estimated by adopting the start-stop variable contribution index, so that the selection of start-stop variables to be optimized in the next iteration is guided, the efficient feasibility restoration of the system constraint infeasible start-stop solution can be realized, the unit combination high-quality feasible solution can be quickly obtained, and the optimal operation of the electric power system is strongly supported.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO
